sentences.pinyin: Kāixué qián yào zhǔnbèi shūbāo hé běnzi.
sentences.translation: Before school starts, you need to prepare a schoolbag and notebook.

sentences.chinese: 这件事要自己做。
sentences.traditional: 這件事要自己做。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yào zìjǐ zuò.
sentences.translation: You need to do this yourself.

sentences.chinese: 我想自己去机场。
sentences.traditional: 我想自己去機場。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ qù jīchǎng.
sentences.translation: I want to go to the airport by myself.

sentences.chinese: 她会自己打开门。
sentences.traditional: 她會自己打開門。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huì zìjǐ dǎkāi mén.
sentences.translation: She can open the door by herself.

sentences.chinese: 我们走吧。
sentences.traditional: 我們走吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu ba.
sentences.translation: Let’s go.

sentences.chinese: 你先走，我马上来。
sentences.traditional: 你先走，我馬上來。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zǒu, wǒ mǎshàng lái.
sentences.translation: You go first, I will come right away.

sentences.chinese: 他每天走回家。
sentences.traditional: 他每天走回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǒu huíjiā.
sentences.translation: He walks home every day.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢走路去学校。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡走路去學校。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zǒulù qù xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: I like walking to school.

sentences.chinese: 这里很近，走路就可以。
sentences.traditional: 這裡很近，走路就可以。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ hěn jìn, zǒulù jiù kěyǐ.
sentences.translation: It is very near, so you can just walk.

sentences.chinese: 她每天晚上走路半小时。
sentences.traditional: 她每天晚上走路半小時。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān wǎnshang zǒulù bàn xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: She walks for half an hour every evening.

sentences.chinese: 他喜欢踢足球。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡踢足球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan tī zúqiú.
sentences.translation: He likes playing football.

sentences.chinese: 我们班今天有足球比赛。
sentences.traditional: 我們班今天有足球比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bān jīntiān yǒu zúqiú bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Our class has a football match today.

sentences.chinese: 他买了一个新足球。
sentences.traditional: 他買了一個新足球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yí ge xīn zúqiú.
sentences.translation: He bought a new football.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢红色。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡紅色。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan hóngsè.
sentences.translation: I like red the most.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆离学校最近。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯館離學校最近。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn lí xuéxiào zuì jìn.
sentences.translation: This restaurant is the nearest to the school.

sentences.chinese: 在我们班里，她来得最早。
sentences.traditional: 在我們班裡，她來得最早。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǒmen bān lǐ, tā lái de zuì zǎo.
sentences.translation: In our class, she arrives the earliest.

sentences.chinese: 我的左手有点疼。
sentences.traditional: 我的左手有點疼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de zuǒshǒu yǒudiǎn téng.
sentences.translation: My left hand hurts a little.

sentences.chinese: 请往左看。
sentences.traditional: 請往左看。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng wǎng zuǒ kàn.
sentences.translation: Please look to the left.

sentences.chinese: 向左走就到了。
sentences.traditional: 向左走就到了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng zuǒ zǒu jiù dào le.
sentences.translation: Go left and you will arrive.

sentences.chinese: 车站就在学校左边。
sentences.traditional: 車站就在學校左邊。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzhàn jiù zài xuéxiào zuǒbian.
sentences.translation: The station is just on the left side of the school.

sentences.chinese: 请坐在我左边。
sentences.traditional: 請坐在我左邊。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zuò zài wǒ zuǒbian.
sentences.translation: Please sit on my left side.

sentences.chinese: 左边那家店卖咖啡。
sentences.traditional: 左邊那家店賣咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Zuǒbian nà jiā diàn mài kāfēi.
sentences.translation: The shop on the left side sells coffee.

sentences.chinese: 我阿姨住在上海。
sentences.traditional: 我阿姨住在上海。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ āyí zhù zài Shànghǎi.
sentences.translation: My aunt lives in Shanghai.

sentences.chinese: 那位阿姨是我的老师。
sentences.traditional: 那位阿姨是我的老師。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi āyí shì wǒ de lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: That aunt is my teacher.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈和阿姨在客厅聊天。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽和阿姨在客廳聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Māma hé āyí zài kètīng liáotiān.
sentences.translation: Mum and my aunt are chatting in the living room.

sentences.chinese: 这把椅子太矮了。
sentences.traditional: 這把椅子太矮了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yǐzi tài ǎi le.
sentences.translation: This chair is too short.

sentences.chinese: 他个子不高，有一点矮。
sentences.traditional: 他個子不高，有一點矮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gèzi bù gāo, yǒu yìdiǎn ǎi.
sentences.translation: He is not tall and is a little short.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子比那张矮。
sentences.traditional: 這張桌子比那張矮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi bǐ nà zhāng ǎi.
sentences.translation: This table is shorter than that one.

sentences.chinese: 我的爱人在医院工作。
sentences.traditional: 我的愛人在醫院工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de àiren zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: My spouse works at a hospital.

sentences.chinese: 他和爱人一起去旅游了。
sentences.traditional: 他和愛人一起去旅遊了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hé àiren yìqǐ qù lǚyóu le.
sentences.translation: He went travelling with his spouse.

sentences.chinese: 这是我爱人给我买的书。
sentences.traditional: 這是我愛人給我買的書。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ àiren gěi wǒ mǎi de shū.
sentences.translation: This is a book my spouse bought for me.

sentences.chinese: 这里很安静，适合看书。
sentences.traditional: 這裡很安靜，適合看書。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ hěn ānjìng, shìhé kàn shū.
sentences.translation: It is very quiet here, which is good for reading.

sentences.chinese: 请安静一点，孩子在睡觉。
sentences.traditional: 請安靜一點，孩子在睡覺。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng ānjìng yìdiǎn, háizi zài shuìjiào.
sentences.translation: Please be a bit quieter; the child is sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 早上的公园很安静。
sentences.traditional: 早上的公園很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang de gōngyuán hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: The park is very quiet in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 晚上一个人回家不太安全。
sentences.traditional: 晚上一個人回家不太安全。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang yí ge rén huí jiā bù tài ānquán.
sentences.translation: It is not very safe to go home alone at night.

sentences.chinese: 这条路很安全，你可以走这边。
sentences.traditional: 這條路很安全，你可以走這邊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn ānquán, nǐ kěyǐ zǒu zhèbiān.
sentences.translation: This road is safe, so you can go this way.

sentences.chinese: 医生说这个药很安全。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說這個藥很安全。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhège yào hěn ānquán.
sentences.translation: The doctor said this medicine is safe.

sentences.chinese: 我买了一把新伞。
sentences.traditional: 我買了一把新傘。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yì bǎ xīn sǎn.
sentences.translation: I bought a new umbrella.

sentences.chinese: 请把门打开。
sentences.traditional: 請把門打開。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ mén dǎkāi.
sentences.translation: Please open the door.

sentences.chinese: 他把书包放在桌子上。
sentences.traditional: 他把書包放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ shūbāo fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.translation: He put the schoolbag on the table.

sentences.chinese: 我来帮你搬桌子。
sentences.traditional: 我來幫你搬桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ lái bāng nǐ bān zhuōzi.
sentences.translation: I will help you move the table.

sentences.chinese: 这箱书太重了，一个人搬不动。
sentences.traditional: 這箱書太重了，一個人搬不動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiāng shū tài zhòng le, yí ge rén bān budòng.
sentences.translation: This box of books is too heavy for one person to move.

sentences.chinese: 他们正在搬椅子。
sentences.traditional: 他們正在搬椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài bān yǐzi.
sentences.translation: They are moving chairs.

sentences.chinese: 我们班级有二十个学生。
sentences.traditional: 我們班級有二十個學生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bānjí yǒu èrshí ge xuéshēng.
sentences.translation: Our class has twenty students.

sentences.chinese: 她是我们班级的新同学。
sentences.traditional: 她是我們班級的新同學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen bānjí de xīn tóngxué.
sentences.translation: She is a new classmate in our class.

sentences.chinese: 我们班级明天去公园。
sentences.traditional: 我們班級明天去公園。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bānjí míngtiān qù gōngyuán.
sentences.translation: Our class is going to the park tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 我们下个月要搬家。
sentences.traditional: 我們下個月要搬家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge yuè yào bānjiā.
sentences.translation: We are moving house next month.

sentences.chinese: 因为工作，他去年搬家了。
sentences.traditional: 因為工作，他去年搬家了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò, tā qùnián bānjiā le.
sentences.translation: He moved house last year because of work.

sentences.chinese: 搬家以后，我家离学校更近了。
sentences.traditional: 搬家以後，我家離學校更近了。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiā yǐhòu, wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào gèng jìn le.
sentences.translation: After moving house, my home is closer to the school.

sentences.chinese: 这件事我今天就办。
sentences.traditional: 這件事我今天就辦。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ jīntiān jiù bàn.
sentences.translation: I will handle this matter today.

sentences.chinese: 我去办公室办手续。
sentences.traditional: 我去辦公室辦手續。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qù bàngōngshì bàn shǒuxù.
sentences.translation: I am going to the office to handle the paperwork.

sentences.chinese: 他正在办新卡。
sentences.traditional: 他正在辦新卡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài bàn xīn kǎ.
sentences.translation: He is applying for a new card.

sentences.chinese: 我有一个好办法。
sentences.traditional: 我有一個好辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge hǎo bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: I have a good solution.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题有办法解决。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題有辦法解決。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yǒu bànfǎ jiějué.
sentences.translation: There is a way to solve this problem.

sentences.chinese: 你想到了什么办法？
sentences.traditional: 你想到了什麼辦法？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎngdào le shénme bànfǎ?
sentences.translation: What solution have you thought of?

sentences.chinese: 老师在办公室里。
sentences.traditional: 老師在辦公室裡。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài bàngōngshì lǐ.
sentences.translation: The teacher is in the office.

sentences.chinese: 我下午要去办公室。
sentences.traditional: 我下午要去辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù bàngōngshì.
sentences.translation: I need to go to the office this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 办公室外面有很多人。
sentences.traditional: 辦公室外面有很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì wàimiàn yǒu hěn duō rén.
sentences.translation: There are many people outside the office.

sentences.chinese: 我等了你半天。
sentences.traditional: 我等了你半天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ děng le nǐ bàntiān.
sentences.translation: I waited for you for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他写这封信写了半天。
sentences.traditional: 他寫這封信寫了半天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě zhè fēng xìn xiě le bàntiān.
sentences.translation: He spent a long time writing this letter.

sentences.chinese: 我们走了半天才到。
sentences.traditional: 我們走了半天才到。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu le bàntiān cái dào.
sentences.translation: We walked for half a day before arriving.

sentences.chinese: 谢谢你帮助我。
sentences.traditional: 謝謝你幫助我。
sentences.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ bāngzhù wǒ.
sentences.translation: Thank you for helping me.

sentences.chinese: 老师常常帮助学生。
sentences.traditional: 老師常常幫助學生。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī chángcháng bāngzhù xuéshēng.
sentences.translation: Teachers often help students.

sentences.chinese: 你可以帮助他搬家吗？
sentences.traditional: 你可以幫助他搬家嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ bāngzhù tā bānjiā ma?
sentences.translation: Can you help him move house?

sentences.chinese: 我吃饱了。
sentences.traditional: 我吃飽了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chī bǎo le.
sentences.translation: I am full.

sentences.chinese: 你还没吃饱吗？
sentences.traditional: 你還沒吃飽嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ hái méi chī bǎo ma?
sentences.translation: Aren't you full yet?

sentences.chinese: 早饭以后，我很饱。
sentences.traditional: 早飯以後，我很飽。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎofàn yǐhòu, wǒ hěn bǎo.
sentences.translation: After breakfast, I am very full.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷每天看报纸。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺每天看報紙。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye měitiān kàn bàozhǐ.
sentences.translation: Grandad reads the newspaper every day.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一份报纸。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有一份報紙。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí fèn bàozhǐ.
sentences.translation: There is a newspaper on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这张报纸是今天的。
sentences.traditional: 這張報紙是今天的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng bàozhǐ shì jīntiān de.
sentences.translation: This newspaper is today's.

sentences.chinese: 学校的北边有一家商店。
sentences.traditional: 學校的北邊有一家商店。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào de běibiān yǒu yì jiā shāngdiàn.
sentences.translation: There is a shop to the north of the school.

sentences.chinese: 我家窗户朝北。
sentences.traditional: 我家窗戶朝北。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā chuānghu cháo běi.
sentences.translation: The windows of my home face north.

sentences.chinese: 鸟往北飞了。
sentences.traditional: 鳥往北飛了。
sentences.pinyin: Niǎo wǎng běi fēi le.
sentences.translation: The bird flew north.

sentences.chinese: 中国北方冬天很冷。
sentences.traditional: 中國北方冬天很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó běifāng dōngtiān hěn lěng.
sentences.translation: Winters in northern China are very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他来自北方。
sentences.traditional: 他來自北方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā láizì běifāng.
sentences.translation: He comes from the north.

sentences.chinese: 北方的雪很大。
sentences.traditional: 北方的雪很大。
sentences.pinyin: Běifāng de xuě hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The snowfall in the north is heavy.

sentences.chinese: 我的书被弟弟拿走了。
sentences.traditional: 我的書被弟弟拿走了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shū bèi dìdi názǒu le.
sentences.translation: My book was taken away by my younger brother.

sentences.chinese: 他被老师叫到办公室了。
sentences.traditional: 他被老師叫到辦公室了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bèi lǎoshī jiào dào bàngōngshì le.
sentences.translation: He was called to the office by the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 窗户被风打开了。
sentences.traditional: 窗戶被風打開了。
sentences.pinyin: Chuānghu bèi fēng dǎkāi le.
sentences.translation: The window was blown open by the wind.

sentences.chinese: 我上课的时候会做笔记。
sentences.traditional: 我上課的時候會做筆記。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shàngkè de shíhou huì zuò bǐjì.
sentences.translation: I take notes during class.

sentences.chinese: 这是我的汉语笔记。
sentences.traditional: 這是我的漢語筆記。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de Hànyǔ bǐjì.
sentences.translation: These are my Chinese notes.

sentences.chinese: 你的笔记写得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 你的筆記寫得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐjì xiě de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Your notes are written very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆比较安静。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯館比較安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn bǐjiào ānjìng.
sentences.translation: This restaurant is relatively quiet.

sentences.chinese: 买东西以前，我喜欢比较价格。
sentences.traditional: 買東西以前，我喜歡比較價格。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi yǐqián, wǒ xǐhuan bǐjiào jiàgé.
sentences.translation: Before buying something, I like to compare prices.

sentences.chinese: 这本书比较难，我看得很慢。
sentences.traditional: 這本書比較難，我看得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bǐjiào nán, wǒ kàn de hěn màn.
sentences.translation: This book is quite difficult, so I read slowly.

sentences.chinese: 我的笔记本在桌子上。
sentences.traditional: 我的筆記本在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de bǐjìběn zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.translation: My notebook is on the desk.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们带笔记本来上课。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們帶筆記本來上課。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen dài bǐjìběn lái shàngkè.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to bring a notebook to class.

sentences.chinese: 这个黑色的笔记本很漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 這個黑色的筆記本很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hēisè de bǐjìběn hěn piàoliang.
sentences.translation: This black notebook is very nice.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢很多运动，比如足球和篮球。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡很多運動，比如足球和籃球。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan hěn duō yùndòng, bǐrú zúqiú hé lánqiú.
sentences.translation: I like many sports, for example football and basketball.

sentences.chinese: 你可以买一些水果，比如苹果。
sentences.traditional: 你可以買一些水果，比如蘋果。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ mǎi yìxiē shuǐguǒ, bǐrú píngguǒ.
sentences.translation: You can buy some fruit, for example apples.

sentences.chinese: 有些地方很安静，比如教室。
sentences.traditional: 有些地方很安靜，比如教室。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē dìfang hěn ānjìng, bǐrú jiàoshì.
sentences.translation: Some places are quiet, for example classrooms.

sentences.chinese: 明天我们班有一场篮球比赛。
sentences.traditional: 明天我們班有一場籃球比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen bān yǒu yì chǎng lánqiú bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Our class has a basketball match tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 两个学校的学生正在比赛。
sentences.traditional: 兩個學校的學生正在比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè xuéxiào de xuéshēng zhèngzài bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Students from two schools are competing.

sentences.chinese: 我哥哥喜欢看足球比赛。
sentences.traditional: 我哥哥喜歡看足球比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēge xǐhuan kàn zúqiú bǐsài.
sentences.translation: My older brother likes watching football matches.

sentences.chinese: 你明天必须早点来学校。
sentences.traditional: 你明天必須早點來學校。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān bìxū zǎodiǎn lái xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: You must come to school earlier tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 坐飞机以前，我们必须带护照。
sentences.traditional: 坐飛機以前，我們必須帶護照。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò fēijī yǐqián, wǒmen bìxū dài hùzhào.
sentences.translation: Before taking a plane, we must bring our passports.

sentences.chinese: 做这件事必须认真。
sentences.traditional: 做這件事必須認真。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò zhè jiàn shì bìxū rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: You must be serious when doing this.

sentences.chinese: 天气变冷了，多穿一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 天氣變冷了，多穿一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn lěng le, duō chuān yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: The weather has turned cold, so wear a bit more.

sentences.chinese: 水变热了，可以喝了。
sentences.traditional: 水變熱了，可以喝了。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ biàn rè le, kěyǐ hē le.
sentences.translation: The water has become hot, so you can drink it.

sentences.chinese: 他的脸一下子变红了。
sentences.traditional: 他的臉一下子變紅了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de liǎn yíxiàzi biàn hóng le.
sentences.translation: His face suddenly turned red.

sentences.chinese: 这本书我看了两遍。
sentences.traditional: 這本書我看了兩遍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn.
sentences.translation: I read this book twice.

sentences.chinese: 老师把这个问题讲了三遍。
sentences.traditional: 老師把這個問題講了三遍。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zhège wèntí jiǎng le sān biàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher explained this question three times.

sentences.chinese: 你把名字再写一遍吧。
sentences.traditional: 你把名字再寫一遍吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ míngzi zài xiě yí biàn ba.
sentences.translation: Write your name one more time.

sentences.chinese: 水太冷了，变成冰了。
sentences.traditional: 水太冷了，變成冰了。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ tài lěng le, biànchéng bīng le.
sentences.translation: The water is so cold that it has turned into ice.

sentences.chinese: 小问题变成大问题了。
sentences.traditional: 小問題變成大問題了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo wèntí biànchéng dà wèntí le.
sentences.translation: A small problem has turned into a big one.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间变成办公室了。
sentences.traditional: 這個房間變成辦公室了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān biànchéng bàngōngshì le.
sentences.translation: This room has turned into an office.

sentences.chinese: 这几年这个城市变化很大。
sentences.traditional: 這幾年這個城市變化很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián zhège chéngshì biànhuà hěn dà.
sentences.translation: This city has changed a lot in recent years.

sentences.chinese: 天气变化太快了。
sentences.traditional: 天氣變化太快了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì biànhuà tài kuài le.
sentences.translation: The weather changes too quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他的想法有了很大的变化。
sentences.traditional: 他的想法有了很大的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfa yǒu le hěn dà de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: His ideas have changed a lot.

sentences.chinese: 晚会上她要表演唱歌。
sentences.traditional: 晚會上她要表演唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnhuì shàng tā yào biǎoyǎn chànggē.
sentences.translation: She is going to perform a song at the evening party.

sentences.chinese: 这些学生表演得很好。
sentences.traditional: 這些學生表演得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē xuéshēng biǎoyǎn de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: These students performed very well.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次在台上表演。
sentences.traditional: 他第一次在臺上表演。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yí cì zài tái shàng biǎoyǎn.
sentences.translation: It is his first time performing on stage.

sentences.chinese: 你还有别的问题吗？
sentences.traditional: 你還有別的問題嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ hái yǒu biéde wèntí ma.
sentences.translation: Do you have any other questions?

sentences.chinese: 我想看看别的颜色。
sentences.traditional: 我想看看別的顏色。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kànkan biéde yánsè.
sentences.translation: I want to look at other colours.

sentences.chinese: 这家店没有了，我们去别的地方吧。
sentences.traditional: 這家店沒有了，我們去別的地方吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn méiyǒu le, wǒmen qù biéde dìfang ba.
sentences.translation: This shop is sold out, so let us go somewhere else.

sentences.chinese: 不要说别人的名字。
sentences.traditional: 不要說別人的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Bùyào shuō biérén de míngzi.
sentences.translation: Do not say other people’s names.

sentences.chinese: 这是别人的书包。
sentences.traditional: 這是別人的書包。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì biérén de shūbāo.
sentences.translation: This is someone else’s schoolbag.

sentences.chinese: 别人都走了，他还在这里。
sentences.traditional: 別人都走了，他還在這裡。
sentences.pinyin: Biérén dōu zǒu le, tā hái zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.translation: Everyone else has left, but he is still here.

sentences.chinese: 我们晚上住在宾馆里。
sentences.traditional: 我們晚上住在賓館裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎnshang zhù zài bīnguǎn lǐ.
sentences.translation: We are staying at a hotel tonight.

sentences.chinese: 那家宾馆很安静。
sentences.traditional: 那家賓館很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā bīnguǎn hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: That hotel is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 宾馆离火车站不远。
sentences.traditional: 賓館離火車站不遠。
sentences.pinyin: Bīnguǎn lí huǒchēzhàn bù yuǎn.
sentences.translation: The hotel is not far from the train station.

sentences.chinese: 杯子里有很多冰。
sentences.traditional: 杯子裡有很多冰。
sentences.pinyin: Bēizi lǐ yǒu hěn duō bīng.
sentences.translation: There is a lot of ice in the cup.

sentences.chinese: 冬天湖上有冰。
sentences.traditional: 冬天湖上有冰。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān hú shàng yǒu bīng.
sentences.translation: There is ice on the lake in winter.

sentences.chinese: 这瓶水太冷了，还有冰。
sentences.traditional: 這瓶水太冷了，還有冰。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè píng shuǐ tài lěng le, hái yǒu bīng.
sentences.translation: This bottle of water is too cold; there is still ice in it.

sentences.chinese: 天太热了，我想吃冰激凌。
sentences.traditional: 天太熱了，我想吃冰激凌。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān tài rè le, wǒ xiǎng chī bīngjīlíng.
sentences.translation: It is too hot; I want to eat some ice cream.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子最喜欢巧克力冰激凌。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子最喜歡巧克力冰激凌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi zuì xǐhuan qiǎokèlì bīngjīlíng.
sentences.translation: This child likes chocolate ice cream best.

sentences.chinese: 冰激凌在桌子上快化了。
sentences.traditional: 冰激凌在桌子上快化了。
sentences.pinyin: Bīngjīlíng zài zhuōzi shàng kuài huà le.
sentences.translation: The ice cream is melting on the table.

sentences.chinese: 牛奶在冰箱里。
sentences.traditional: 牛奶在冰箱裡。
sentences.pinyin: Niúnǎi zài bīngxiāng lǐ.
sentences.translation: The milk is in the refrigerator.

sentences.chinese: 请把苹果放进冰箱。
sentences.traditional: 請把蘋果放進冰箱。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ píngguǒ fàng jìn bīngxiāng.
sentences.translation: Please put the apples into the refrigerator.

sentences.chinese: 我家的冰箱不大。
sentences.traditional: 我家的冰箱不大。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de bīngxiāng bù dà.
sentences.translation: The refrigerator in my home is not big.

sentences.chinese: 医生正在看病人。
sentences.traditional: 醫生正在看病人。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài kàn bìngrén.
sentences.translation: The doctor is seeing a patient.

sentences.chinese: 那个病人今天好一点了。
sentences.traditional: 那個病人今天好一點了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge bìngrén jīntiān hǎo yìdiǎn le.
sentences.translation: That patient is a little better today.

sentences.chinese: 病人在医院休息。
sentences.traditional: 病人在醫院休息。
sentences.pinyin: Bìngrén zài yīyuàn xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The patient is resting in the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 他不但会说中文，还会说英文。
sentences.traditional: 他不但會說中文，還會說英文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búdàn huì shuō Zhōngwén, hái huì shuō Yīngwén.
sentences.translation: He can not only speak Chinese, but also speak English.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方不但安静，而且很安全。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方不但安靜，而且很安全。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang búdàn ānjìng, érqiě hěn ānquán.
sentences.translation: This place is not only quiet, but also very safe.

sentences.chinese: 她不但喜欢唱歌，也喜欢跳舞。
sentences.traditional: 她不但喜歡唱歌，也喜歡跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búdàn xǐhuan chànggē, yě xǐhuan tiàowǔ.
sentences.translation: She not only likes singing, but also likes dancing.

sentences.chinese: 我的手机怎么不见了？
sentences.traditional: 我的手機怎麼不見了？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī zěnme bújiàn le?
sentences.translation: How did my mobile phone disappear?

sentences.chinese: 刚才还在这儿，现在不见了。
sentences.traditional: 剛才還在這兒，現在不見了。
sentences.pinyin: Gāngcái hái zài zhèr, xiànzài bújiàn le.
sentences.translation: It was just here a moment ago, but now it is gone.

sentences.chinese: 他昨天来过，今天又不见了。
sentences.traditional: 他昨天來過，今天又不見了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuótiān lái guo, jīntiān yòu bújiàn le.
sentences.translation: He came yesterday, but today he has disappeared again.

sentences.chinese: 你不用担心。
sentences.traditional: 你不用擔心。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng dānxīn.
sentences.translation: You need not worry.

sentences.chinese: 今天不上班，你不用早起。
sentences.traditional: 今天不上班，你不用早起。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān bú shàngbān, nǐ búyòng zǎoqǐ.
sentences.translation: You do not need to get up early today because you are not working.

sentences.chinese: 这道题太简单，不用问老师。
sentences.traditional: 這道題太簡單，不用問老師。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí tài jiǎndān, búyòng wèn lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: This question is so simple that there is no need to ask the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 他们住在不同的城市。
sentences.traditional: 他們住在不同的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhù zài bù tóng de chéngshì.
sentences.translation: They live in different cities.

sentences.chinese: 这两本书的内容很不同。
sentences.traditional: 這兩本書的內容很不同。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng běn shū de nèiróng hěn bù tóng.
sentences.translation: The content of these two books is very different.

sentences.chinese: 这个班的学生来自不同的地方。
sentences.traditional: 這個班的學生來自不同的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bān de xuéshēng láizì bù tóng de dìfang.
sentences.translation: The students in this class come from different places.

sentences.chinese: 他搬家后不久就找到了新工作。
sentences.traditional: 他搬家後不久就找到了新工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bān jiā hòu bù jiǔ jiù zhǎodào le xīn gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He found a new job not long after moving house.

sentences.chinese: 雨停了不久，太阳就出来了。
sentences.traditional: 雨停了不久，太陽就出來了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le bù jiǔ, tàiyáng jiù chūlái le.
sentences.translation: Not long after the rain stopped, the sun came out.

sentences.chinese: 我们认识不久，但是已经很熟了。
sentences.traditional: 我們認識不久，但是已經很熟了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen rènshi bù jiǔ, dànshì yǐjīng hěn shú le.
sentences.translation: We have not known each other for long, but we are already quite familiar.

sentences.chinese: 这儿不能停车，停在这里不行。
sentences.traditional: 這兒不能停車，停在這裡不行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèr bùnéng tíng chē, tíng zài zhèlǐ bù xíng.
sentences.translation: You cannot park here; parking here is not allowed.

sentences.chinese: 你现在身体不舒服，今天跑步不行。
sentences.traditional: 你現在身體不舒服，今天跑步不行。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài shēntǐ bù shūfu, jīntiān pǎobù bù xíng.
sentences.translation: You do not feel well now, so running today will not do.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法不行，我们再想一个。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法不行，我們再想一個。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ bù xíng, wǒmen zài xiǎng yí ge.
sentences.translation: This method will not work, so let us think of another one.

sentences.chinese: 我昨天晚上十点才回家。
sentences.traditional: 我昨天晚上十點才回家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang shí diǎn cái huí jiā.
sentences.translation: I did not get home until ten o’clock last night.

sentences.chinese: 他学了三个月才会开车。
sentences.traditional: 他學了三個月才會開車。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xué le sān ge yuè cái huì kāi chē.
sentences.translation: He only learned to drive after studying for three months.

sentences.chinese: 现在才六点，我们不用着急。
sentences.traditional: 現在才六點，我們不用著急。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài cái liù diǎn, wǒmen búyòng zháojí.
sentences.translation: It is only six o’clock now, so we do not need to hurry.

sentences.chinese: 请给我看一下菜单。
sentences.traditional: 請給我看一下菜單。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ kàn yíxià cài dān.
sentences.translation: Please let me look at the menu.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆的菜单很简单。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯館的菜單很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài dān hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: This restaurant’s menu is very simple.

sentences.chinese: 我们先看菜单，再点菜。
sentences.traditional: 我們先看菜單，再點菜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān kàn cài dān, zài diǎn cài.
sentences.translation: Let us look at the menu first, then order dishes.

sentences.chinese: 明天你参加比赛吗？
sentences.traditional: 明天你參加比賽嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ cān jiā bǐsài ma?
sentences.translation: Are you joining the competition tomorrow?

sentences.chinese: 很多学生都想参加这个活动。
sentences.traditional: 很多學生都想參加這個活動。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō xuéshēng dōu xiǎng cān jiā zhège huódòng.
sentences.translation: Many students want to join this activity.

sentences.chinese: 我爸爸每年都参加公司的旅行。
sentences.traditional: 我爸爸每年都參加公司的旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi nián dōu cān jiā gōngsī de lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: My dad joins the company trip every year.

sentences.chinese: 牛喜欢吃草。
sentences.traditional: 牛喜歡吃草。
sentences.pinyin: Niú xǐhuan chī cǎo.
sentences.translation: Cows like to eat grass.

sentences.chinese: 下雨以后，草长得更快了。
sentences.traditional: 下雨以後，草長得更快了。
sentences.pinyin: Xià yǔ yǐhòu, cǎo zhǎng de gèng kuài le.
sentences.translation: After it rains, the grass grows faster.

sentences.chinese: 院子里的草很绿。
sentences.traditional: 院子裡的草很綠。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ de cǎo hěn lǜ.
sentences.translation: The grass in the yard is very green.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在草地上玩。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在草地上玩。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài cǎo dì shàng wán.
sentences.translation: The children are playing on the grass.

sentences.chinese: 请不要坐在那块草地上。
sentences.traditional: 請不要坐在那塊草地上。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng búyào zuò zài nà kuài cǎo dì shàng.
sentences.translation: Please do not sit on that patch of grass.

sentences.chinese: 公园中间有一大片草地。
sentences.traditional: 公園中間有一大片草地。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán zhōngjiān yǒu yí dà piàn cǎo dì.
sentences.translation: There is a large grassy area in the middle of the park.

sentences.chinese: 我家住在五层。
sentences.traditional: 我家住在五層。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhù zài wǔ céng.
sentences.translation: My home is on the fifth floor.

sentences.chinese: 这个蛋糕有三层。
sentences.traditional: 這個蛋糕有三層。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dàngāo yǒu sān céng.
sentences.translation: This cake has three layers.

sentences.chinese: 办公室在第二层。
sentences.traditional: 辦公室在第二層。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì zài dì èr céng.
sentences.translation: The office is on the second floor.

sentences.chinese: 老师正在查作业。
sentences.traditional: 老師正在查作業。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài chá zuòyè.
sentences.translation: The teacher is checking homework.

sentences.chinese: 你可以在网上查这个词的意思。
sentences.traditional: 你可以在網上查這個詞的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài wǎngshang chá zhège cí de yìsi.
sentences.translation: You can look up the meaning of this word online.

sentences.chinese: 我先查一下明天的天气。
sentences.traditional: 我先查一下明天的天氣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiān chá yíxià míngtiān de tiānqì.
sentences.translation: I will first check tomorrow’s weather.

sentences.chinese: 今天的天气很差。
sentences.traditional: 今天的天氣很差。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì hěn chà.
sentences.translation: The weather is very bad today.

sentences.chinese: 他的中文还差一点。
sentences.traditional: 他的中文還差一點。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén hái chà yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: His Chinese is still a bit lacking.

sentences.chinese: 这次考试我考得很差。
sentences.traditional: 這次考試我考得很差。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì wǒ kǎo de hěn chà.
sentences.translation: I did very badly in this exam.

sentences.chinese: 我们差不多要出发了。
sentences.traditional: 我們差不多要出發了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen chàbuduō yào chūfā le.
sentences.translation: We are almost ready to set off.

sentences.chinese: 这两件衣服的价格差不多。
sentences.traditional: 這兩件衣服的價格差不多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu de jiàgé chàbuduō.
sentences.translation: The prices of these two clothes are almost the same.

sentences.chinese: 饭差不多做好了。
sentences.traditional: 飯差不多做好了。
sentences.pinyin: Fàn chàbuduō zuò hǎo le.
sentences.translation: The meal is almost ready.

sentences.chinese: 你先尝一口这个汤。
sentences.traditional: 你先嘗一口這個湯。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān cháng yì kǒu zhège tāng.
sentences.translation: Try a mouthful of this soup first.

sentences.chinese: 我想尝一下这种水果。
sentences.traditional: 我想嘗一下這種水果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cháng yíxià zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ.
sentences.translation: I want to taste this kind of fruit.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈让我尝她做的菜。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽讓我嘗她做的菜。
sentences.pinyin: Māma ràng wǒ cháng tā zuò de cài.
sentences.translation: Mum let me taste the dish she made.

sentences.chinese: 他常坐公交车去上班。
sentences.traditional: 他常坐公交車去上班。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng zuò gōngjiāochē qù shàngbān.
sentences.translation: He often takes the bus to work.

sentences.chinese: 这里冬天常下雨。
sentences.traditional: 這裡冬天常下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ dōngtiān cháng xià yǔ.
sentences.translation: It often rains here in winter.

sentences.chinese: 我们常在这家饭馆吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 我們常在這家飯館吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen cháng zài zhè jiā fànguǎn chīfàn.
sentences.translation: We often eat at this restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个很常见的问题。
sentences.traditional: 這是一個很常見的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge hěn chángjiàn de wèntí.
sentences.translation: This is a very common question.

sentences.chinese: 感冒是冬天常见的病。
sentences.traditional: 感冒是冬天常見的病。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎnmào shì dōngtiān chángjiàn de bìng.
sentences.translation: Colds are a common illness in winter.

sentences.chinese: 这种颜色在衣服上很常见。
sentences.traditional: 這種顏色在衣服上很常見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yánsè zài yīfu shàng hěn chángjiàn.
sentences.translation: This colour is very common on clothes.

sentences.chinese: 这是一种常用的学习方法。
sentences.traditional: 這是一種常用的學習方法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yì zhǒng chángyòng de xuéxí fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: This is a commonly used study method.

sentences.chinese: 我把常用的书放在桌子上。
sentences.traditional: 我把常用的書放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ chángyòng de shū fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.translation: I put the books I use often on the desk.

sentences.chinese: 这个字在报纸上很常用。
sentences.traditional: 這個字在報紙上很常用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zì zài bàozhǐ shàng hěn chángyòng.
sentences.translation: This character is commonly used in newspapers.

sentences.chinese: 我常常跟朋友一起打篮球。
sentences.traditional: 我常常跟朋友一起打籃球。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng gēn péngyou yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.translation: I often play basketball with friends.

sentences.chinese: 她常常忘记带手机。
sentences.traditional: 她常常忘記帶手機。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángcháng wàngjì dài shǒujī.
sentences.translation: She often forgets to bring her mobile phone.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷常常坐在门口看报纸。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺常常坐在門口看報紙。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye chángcháng zuò zài ménkǒu kàn bàozhǐ.
sentences.translation: Grandad often sits at the doorway reading the newspaper.

sentences.chinese: 这件白衬衫很干净。
sentences.traditional: 這件白襯衫很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn bái chènshān hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: This white shirt is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 他今天穿了一件新衬衫。
sentences.traditional: 他今天穿了一件新襯衫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān chuān le yí jiàn xīn chènshān.
sentences.translation: He is wearing a new shirt today.

sentences.chinese: 商店里有很多男士衬衫。
sentences.traditional: 商店裡有很多男士襯衫。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō nánshì chènshān.
sentences.translation: There are many men's shirts in the shop.

sentences.chinese: 他的考试成绩很好。
sentences.traditional: 他的考試成績很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de kǎoshì chéngjì hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: His exam results are very good.

sentences.chinese: 老师今天发了我们的成绩。
sentences.traditional: 老師今天發了我們的成績。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jīntiān fā le wǒmen de chéngjì.
sentences.translation: The teacher gave out our results today.

sentences.chinese: 我希望这次比赛有好成绩。
sentences.traditional: 我希望這次比賽有好成績。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng zhè cì bǐsài yǒu hǎo chéngjì.
sentences.translation: I hope to get a good result in this competition.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市很安静。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: This city is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 北京是中国的大城市。
sentences.traditional: 北京是中國的大城市。
sentences.pinyin: Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de dà chéngshì.
sentences.translation: Beijing is a big city in China.

sentences.chinese: 我想去别的城市旅游。
sentences.traditional: 我想去別的城市旅遊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù biéde chéngshì lǚyóu.
sentences.translation: I want to travel to another city.

sentences.chinese: 我今天上学迟到了。
sentences.traditional: 我今天上學遲到了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān shàngxué chídào le.
sentences.translation: I was late for school today.

sentences.chinese: 他开会从来不迟到。
sentences.traditional: 他開會從來不遲到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāihuì cónglái bù chídào.
sentences.translation: He is never late for meetings.

sentences.chinese: 下雨的时候，公交车常常迟到。
sentences.traditional: 下雨的時候，公交車常常遲到。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ de shíhou, gōngjiāochē chángcháng chídào.
sentences.translation: Buses are often late when it rains.

sentences.chinese: 我们明天早上七点出发。
sentences.traditional: 我們明天早上七點出發。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang qī diǎn chūfā.
sentences.translation: We set out at seven tomorrow morning.

sentences.chinese: 火车快开了，我们马上出发吧。
sentences.traditional: 火車快開了，我們馬上出發吧。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē kuài kāi le, wǒmen mǎshàng chūfā ba.
sentences.translation: The train is about to leave, so let's set off at once.

sentences.chinese: 他们从北京出发去上海。
sentences.traditional: 他們從北京出發去上海。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen cóng Běijīng chūfā qù Shànghǎi.
sentences.translation: They set out from Beijing for Shanghai.

sentences.chinese: 我弟弟去年出生。
sentences.traditional: 我弟弟去年出生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi qùnián chūshēng.
sentences.translation: My younger brother was born last year.

sentences.chinese: 她出生在一个小城市。
sentences.traditional: 她出生在一個小城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chūshēng zài yí ge xiǎo chéngshì.
sentences.translation: She was born in a small city.

sentences.chinese: 这只小猫昨天才出生。
sentences.traditional: 這隻小貓昨天才出生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎomāo zuótiān cái chūshēng.
sentences.translation: This kitten was only born yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷今天下午出院。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺今天下午出院。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye jīntiān xiàwǔ chūyuàn.
sentences.translation: Grandpa is being discharged this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 病人下周可以出院了。
sentences.traditional: 病人下週可以出院了。
sentences.pinyin: Bìngrén xià zhōu kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
sentences.translation: The patient can leave the hospital next week.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈出院以后想回家休息。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽出院以後想回家休息。
sentences.pinyin: Māma chūyuàn yǐhòu xiǎng huí jiā xiūxi.
sentences.translation: Mum wants to go home and rest after leaving the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 我姐姐在初中教汉语。
sentences.traditional: 我姐姐在初中教漢語。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zài chūzhōng jiāo Hànyǔ.
sentences.translation: My older sister teaches Chinese at a junior high school.

sentences.chinese: 他从小学毕业以后上初中。
sentences.traditional: 他從小學畢業以後上初中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎoxué bìyè yǐhòu shàng chūzhōng.
sentences.translation: He goes to junior high after graduating from primary school.

sentences.chinese: 这所初中离我家很近。
sentences.traditional: 這所初中離我家很近。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ chūzhōng lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn.
sentences.translation: This junior high school is very near my home.

sentences.chinese: 除了爸爸，大家都来了。
sentences.traditional: 除了爸爸，大家都來了。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle bàba, dàjiā dōu lái le.
sentences.translation: Everyone came except Dad.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题，除了老师，没有人懂。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題，除了老師，沒有人懂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí, chúle lǎoshī, méiyǒu rén dǒng.
sentences.translation: Apart from the teacher, nobody understands this question.

sentences.chinese: 除了汉语，她也会说英语。
sentences.traditional: 除了漢語，她也會說英語。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle Hànyǔ, tā yě huì shuō Yīngyǔ.
sentences.translation: Besides Chinese, she can also speak English.

sentences.chinese: 湖上有一条小船。
sentences.traditional: 湖上有一條小船。
sentences.pinyin: Hú shàng yǒu yì tiáo xiǎo chuán.
sentences.translation: There is a small boat on the lake.

sentences.chinese: 我们坐船去那个小岛。
sentences.traditional: 我們坐船去那個小島。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò chuán qù nàge xiǎo dǎo.
sentences.translation: We are going to that small island by boat.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸喜欢在海边看船。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸喜歡在海邊看船。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba xǐhuan zài hǎibiān kàn chuán.
sentences.translation: Dad likes watching boats by the sea.

sentences.chinese: 春天来了，天气暖和了。
sentences.traditional: 春天來了，天氣暖和了。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì nuǎnhuo le.
sentences.translation: Spring has come and the weather has become warm.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢春天的花。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡春天的花。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chūntiān de huā.
sentences.translation: I like the flowers in spring best.

sentences.chinese: 春天的时候，公园里很漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 春天的時候，公園裡很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān de shíhou, gōngyuán lǐ hěn piàoliang.
sentences.translation: The park is very beautiful in spring.

sentences.chinese: 这本词典是谁的？
sentences.traditional: 這本詞典是誰的？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn shì shéi de?
sentences.translation: Whose dictionary is this?

sentences.chinese: 他买了一本新的汉语词典。
sentences.traditional: 他買了一本新的漢語詞典。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì běn xīn de Hànyǔ cídiǎn.
sentences.translation: He bought a new Chinese dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 这个词我不懂，我想查词典。
sentences.traditional: 這個詞我不懂，我想查詞典。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cí wǒ bù dǒng, wǒ xiǎng chá cídiǎn.
sentences.translation: I don't understand this word, so I want to look it up in the dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子很聪明。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子很聰明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi hěn cōngming.
sentences.translation: This child is very clever.

sentences.chinese: 你这么快就学会了，真聪明。
sentences.traditional: 你這麼快就學會了，真聰明。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhème kuài jiù xuéhuì le, zhēn cōngming.
sentences.translation: You learned it so quickly; you're really clever.

sentences.chinese: 小狗很聪明，会开门。
sentences.traditional: 小狗很聰明，會開門。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu hěn cōngming, huì kāimén.
sentences.translation: The little dog is very smart and can open doors.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈在家打扫房间。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽在家打掃房間。
sentences.pinyin: Māma zài jiā dǎsǎo fángjiān.
sentences.translation: Mum is cleaning the room at home.

sentences.chinese: 我们周末一起打扫教室。
sentences.traditional: 我們週末一起打掃教室。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò yìqǐ dǎsǎo jiàoshì.
sentences.translation: We clean the classroom together at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 请先打扫桌子，再休息。
sentences.traditional: 請先打掃桌子，再休息。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān dǎsǎo zhuōzi, zài xiūxi.
sentences.translation: Please clean the table first, then rest.

sentences.chinese: 我打算明天去北京。
sentences.traditional: 我打算明天去北京。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn míngtiān qù Běijīng.
sentences.translation: I plan to go to Beijing tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 你周末打算做什么？
sentences.traditional: 你週末打算做什麼？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhōumò dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
sentences.translation: What do you plan to do this weekend?

sentences.chinese: 他没有打算买新车。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有打算買新車。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu dǎsuàn mǎi xīn chē.
sentences.translation: He is not planning to buy a new car.

sentences.chinese: 现在大概三点半。
sentences.traditional: 現在大概三點半。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài dàgài sān diǎn bàn.
sentences.translation: It is about half past three now.

sentences.chinese: 从我家到学校大概有十分钟。
sentences.traditional: 從我家到學校大概有十分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào xuéxiào dàgài yǒu shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: It is about ten minutes from my home to school.

sentences.chinese: 他大概不知道这件事。
sentences.traditional: 他大概不知道這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàgài bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: He probably does not know about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 大人在说话，孩子别跑。
sentences.traditional: 大人在說話，孩子別跑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàrén zài shuōhuà, háizi bié pǎo.
sentences.translation: The adults are talking, so the children should not run.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆欢迎大人和小孩。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯館歡迎大人和小孩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn huānyíng dàrén hé xiǎohái.
sentences.translation: This restaurant welcomes adults and children.

sentences.chinese: 我长大以后想做一个有用的大人。
sentences.traditional: 我長大以後想做一個有用的大人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎng dà yǐhòu xiǎng zuò yí ge yǒuyòng de dàrén.
sentences.translation: When I grow up, I want to be a useful adult.

sentences.chinese: 这两个苹果大小差不多。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個蘋果大小差不多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge píngguǒ dàxiǎo chàbuduō.
sentences.translation: These two apples are about the same size.

sentences.chinese: 你喜欢什么大小的杯子？
sentences.traditional: 你喜歡什麼大小的杯子？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme dàxiǎo de bēizi?
sentences.translation: What size cup do you like?

sentences.chinese: 这个房间的大小正好。
sentences.traditional: 這個房間的大小正好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān de dàxiǎo zhènghǎo.
sentences.translation: The size of this room is just right.

sentences.chinese: 我在动物园看见了大熊猫。
sentences.traditional: 我在動物園看見了大熊貓。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài dòngwùyuán kànjiàn le dàxióngmāo.
sentences.translation: I saw a giant panda at the zoo.

sentences.chinese: 大熊猫喜欢吃竹子。
sentences.traditional: 大熊貓喜歡吃竹子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxióngmāo xǐhuan chī zhúzi.
sentences.translation: Giant pandas like eating bamboo.

sentences.chinese: 很多人都觉得大熊猫很可爱。
sentences.traditional: 很多人都覺得大熊貓很可愛。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu juéde dàxióngmāo hěn kě'ài.
sentences.translation: Many people think giant pandas are very cute.

sentences.chinese: 天气冷了，别忘了穿大衣。
sentences.traditional: 天氣冷了，別忘了穿大衣。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì lěng le, bié wàng le chuān dàyī.
sentences.translation: The weather is cold, so do not forget to wear a coat.

sentences.chinese: 这件黑色大衣很好看。
sentences.traditional: 這件黑色大衣很好看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn hēisè dàyī hěn hǎokàn.
sentences.translation: This black coat looks nice.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈给我买了一件新大衣。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽給我買了一件新大衣。
sentences.pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn xīn dàyī.
sentences.translation: Mum bought me a new coat.

sentences.chinese: 请带你的书来学校。
sentences.traditional: 請帶你的書來學校。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dài nǐ de shū lái xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: Please bring your book to school.

sentences.chinese: 他每天带孩子去公园。
sentences.traditional: 他每天帶孩子去公園。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān dài háizi qù gōngyuán.
sentences.translation: He takes the child to the park every day.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我带一支笔。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我帶一支筆。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒ dài yì zhī bǐ.
sentences.translation: The teacher told me to bring a pen.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈很担心你的身体。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽很擔心你的身體。
sentences.pinyin: Māma hěn dānxīn nǐ de shēntǐ.
sentences.translation: Mum is very worried about your health.

sentences.chinese: 别担心，我马上回来。
sentences.traditional: 別擔心，我馬上回來。
sentences.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, wǒ mǎshàng huílái.
sentences.translation: Do not worry, I will be back soon.

sentences.chinese: 下雨了，他担心没带伞。
sentences.traditional: 下雨了，他擔心沒帶傘。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, tā dānxīn méi dài sǎn.
sentences.translation: It is raining, and he is worried that he did not bring an umbrella.

sentences.chinese: 这个蛋糕很好吃。
sentences.traditional: 這個蛋糕很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dàngāo hěn hǎochī.
sentences.translation: This cake is very tasty.

sentences.chinese: 过生日的时候，我们一起吃蛋糕。
sentences.traditional: 過生日的時候，我們一起吃蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Guò shēngrì shíhou, wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo.
sentences.translation: We eat cake together on birthdays.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一个大蛋糕。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有一個大蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shang yǒu yí ge dà dàngāo.
sentences.translation: There is a big cake on the table.

sentences.chinese: 当然可以，我们一起去。
sentences.traditional: 當然可以，我們一起去。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ, wǒmen yìqǐ qù.
sentences.translation: Of course, we can go together.

sentences.chinese: 他当然知道这件事。
sentences.traditional: 他當然知道這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dāngrán zhīdào zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: He of course knows about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 你喜欢的话，当然可以买。
sentences.traditional: 你喜歡的話，當然可以買。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan de huà, dāngrán kěyǐ mǎi.
sentences.translation: If you like it, of course you can buy it.

sentences.chinese: 春天到了，到处都是花。
sentences.traditional: 春天到了，到處都是花。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, dàochù dōu shì huā.
sentences.translation: Spring has arrived, and flowers are everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 周末商场里到处都是人。
sentences.traditional: 週末商場裡到處都是人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò shāngchǎng lǐ dàochù dōu shì rén.
sentences.translation: The shopping mall is full of people everywhere at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 他到处找自己的手机。
sentences.traditional: 他到處找自己的手機。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàochù zhǎo zìjǐ de shǒujī.
sentences.translation: He is looking everywhere for his mobile phone.

sentences.chinese: 我想得一百分。
sentences.traditional: 我想得一百分。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dé yì bǎifēn.
sentences.translation: I want to get one hundred marks.

sentences.chinese: 他今天得了很多礼物。
sentences.traditional: 他今天得了很多禮物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān dé le hěn duō lǐwù.
sentences.translation: He got many presents today.

sentences.chinese: 努力学习就能得高分。
sentences.traditional: 努力學習就能得高分。
sentences.pinyin: Nǔlì xuéxí jiù néng dé gāofēn.
sentences.translation: If you study hard, you can get a high score.

sentences.chinese: 我终于得到了老师的帮助。
sentences.traditional: 我終於得到了老師的幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhōngyú dé dào le lǎoshī de bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: I finally got the teacher's help.

sentences.chinese: 他想得到大家的认可。
sentences.traditional: 他想得到大家的認可。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dé dào dàjiā de rènkě.
sentences.translation: He wants to gain everyone's approval.

sentences.chinese: 努力以后，你会得到机会。
sentences.traditional: 努力以後，你會得到機會。
sentences.pinyin: Nǔlì yǐhòu, nǐ huì dé dào jīhuì.
sentences.translation: After working hard, you will get opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 他在比赛中得分了。
sentences.traditional: 他在比賽中得分了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng dé fēn le.
sentences.translation: He scored in the match.

sentences.chinese: 我们班得分最高。
sentences.traditional: 我們班得分最高。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bān dé fēn zuì gāo.
sentences.translation: Our class got the highest score.

sentences.chinese: 最后一题我没有得分。
sentences.traditional: 最後一題我沒有得分。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu yì tí wǒ méiyǒu dé fēn.
sentences.translation: I did not score on the last question.

sentences.chinese: 你有时间的话，来我家玩吧。
sentences.traditional: 你有時間的話，來我家玩吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shíjiān de huà, lái wǒ jiā wán ba.
sentences.translation: If you have time, come to my house to play.

sentences.chinese: 下雨的话，我们就在家看电影。
sentences.traditional: 下雨的話，我們就在家看電影。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ de huà, wǒmen jiù zài jiā kàn diànyǐng.
sentences.translation: If it rains, we will watch a film at home.

sentences.chinese: 不懂的话，可以问老师。
sentences.traditional: 不懂的話，可以問老師。
sentences.pinyin: Bù dǒng de huà, kěyǐ wèn lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: If you do not understand, you can ask the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 明天考试，你得早点睡。
sentences.traditional: 明天考試，你得早點睡。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān kǎoshì, nǐ děi zǎodiǎn shuì.
sentences.translation: You must go to sleep early because of tomorrow's exam.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题你得自己想。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題你得自己想。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí nǐ děi zìjǐ xiǎng.
sentences.translation: You must think about this question yourself.

sentences.chinese: 去学校得坐公交车。
sentences.traditional: 去學校得坐公交車。
sentences.pinyin: Qù xuéxiào děi zuò gōngjiāochē.
sentences.translation: You need to take the bus to go to school.

sentences.chinese: 房间里的灯很亮。
sentences.traditional: 房間裡的燈很亮。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ de dēng hěn liàng.
sentences.translation: The light in the room is very bright.

sentences.chinese: 晚上我开着灯看书。
sentences.traditional: 晚上我開著燈看書。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ kāi zhe dēng kàn shū.
sentences.translation: I read with the light on at night.

sentences.chinese: 这盏灯坏了。
sentences.traditional: 這盞燈壞了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǎn dēng huài le.
sentences.translation: This lamp is broken.

sentences.chinese: 这块地很大。
sentences.traditional: 這塊地很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài dì hěn dà.
sentences.translation: This piece of land is very big.

sentences.chinese: 下雨以后，地很湿。
sentences.traditional: 下雨以後，地很濕。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ yǐhòu, dì hěn shī.
sentences.translation: After it rains, the ground is very wet.

sentences.chinese: 孩子坐在地上画画。
sentences.traditional: 孩子坐在地上畫畫。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zuò zài dì shang huà huà.
sentences.translation: The child is sitting on the ground drawing.

sentences.chinese: 我们见面的地点在学校门口。
sentences.traditional: 我們見面的地點在學校門口。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jiànmiàn de dì diǎn zài xuéxiào ménkǒu.
sentences.translation: The place where we are meeting is at the school entrance.

sentences.chinese: 请告诉我比赛的地点。
sentences.traditional: 請告訴我比賽的地點。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ bǐsài de dì diǎn.
sentences.translation: Please tell me the location of the match.

sentences.chinese: 这个地点离地铁站很近。
sentences.traditional: 這個地點離地鐵站很近。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dì diǎn lí dìtiězhàn hěn jìn.
sentences.translation: This place is very close to the underground station.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方很安静。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: This place is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 我知道一个吃面条的好地方。
sentences.traditional: 我知道一個吃麵條的好地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yí ge chī miàntiáo de hǎo dìfang.
sentences.translation: I know a good place to eat noodles.

sentences.chinese: 你想去别的地方看看吗？
sentences.traditional: 你想去別的地方看看嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù bié de dìfang kàn kan ma?
sentences.translation: Do you want to go and look at another place?

sentences.chinese: 我先看地图，再出发。
sentences.traditional: 我先看地圖，再出發。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiān kàn dìtú, zài chūfā.
sentences.translation: I’ll look at the map first, then set out.

sentences.chinese: 这张地图上有学校和医院。
sentences.traditional: 這張地圖上有學校和醫院。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú shàng yǒu xuéxiào hé yīyuàn.
sentences.translation: There is a school and a hospital on this map.

sentences.chinese: 你的手机里有北京地图吗？
sentences.traditional: 你的手機裡有北京地圖嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de shǒujī lǐ yǒu Běijīng dìtú ma?
sentences.translation: Is there a map of Beijing on your phone?

sentences.chinese: 晚上没有电，所以房间很黑。
sentences.traditional: 晚上沒有電，所以房間很黑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang méiyǒu diàn, suǒyǐ fángjiān hěn hēi.
sentences.translation: There is no electricity at night, so the room is very dark.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方停电了。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方停電了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang tíngdiàn le.
sentences.translation: The power is out in this place.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子不要摸这个，可能会被电到。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子不要摸這個，可能會被電到。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi búyào mō zhège, kěnéng huì bèi diàn dào.
sentences.translation: Children should not touch this, or they might get an electric shock.

sentences.chinese: 电梯在左边。
sentences.traditional: 電梯在左邊。
sentences.pinyin: Diàntī zài zuǒbian.
sentences.translation: The lift is on the left.

sentences.chinese: 这栋楼的电梯坏了。
sentences.traditional: 這棟樓的電梯壞了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dòng lóu de diàntī huài le.
sentences.translation: The lift in this building is broken.

sentences.chinese: 上七楼可以坐电梯。
sentences.traditional: 上七樓可以坐電梯。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng qī lóu kěyǐ zuò diàntī.
sentences.translation: You can take the lift to the seventh floor.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在手机上看电子书。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡在手機上看電子書。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zài shǒujī shàng kàn diànzǐshū.
sentences.translation: I like reading e-books on my phone.

sentences.chinese: 这本电子书很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這本電子書很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn diànzǐshū hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This e-book is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 老师把这本书做成了电子书。
sentences.traditional: 老師把這本書做成了電子書。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zhè běn shū zuò chéng le diànzǐshū.
sentences.translation: The teacher turned this book into an e-book.

sentences.chinese: 我把钥匙丢了。
sentences.traditional: 我把鑰匙丟了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yàoshi diū le.
sentences.translation: I lost my keys.

sentences.chinese: 不要把垃圾丢在地上。
sentences.traditional: 不要把垃圾丟在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Búyào bǎ lājī diū zài dì shang.
sentences.translation: Don’t throw rubbish on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他把钱包丢在出租车上了。
sentences.traditional: 他把錢包丟在出租車上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ qiánbāo diū zài chūzūchē shàng le.
sentences.translation: He left his wallet in the taxi.

sentences.chinese: 太阳从东边出来。
sentences.traditional: 太陽從東邊出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng cóng dōngbian chūlái.
sentences.translation: The sun rises in the east.

sentences.chinese: 我们的教室在学校东边。
sentences.traditional: 我們的教室在學校東邊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de jiàoshì zài xuéxiào dōngbian.
sentences.translation: Our classroom is on the east side of the school.

sentences.chinese: 东边的天有点红。
sentences.traditional: 東邊的天有點紅。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngbian de tiān yǒu diǎn hóng.
sentences.translation: The sky in the east is a little red.

sentences.chinese: 我爷爷家在中国东北。
sentences.traditional: 我爺爺家在中國東北。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yéye jiā zài Zhōngguó dōngběi.
sentences.translation: My grandpa’s home is in northeastern China.

sentences.chinese: 今天东北风很大。
sentences.traditional: 今天東北風很大。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān dōngběifēng hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The northeast wind is very strong today.

sentences.chinese: 地图的右上角是东北。
sentences.traditional: 地圖的右上角是東北。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú de yòu shàngjiǎo shì dōngběi.
sentences.translation: The upper-right corner of a map is northeast.

sentences.chinese: 太阳从东方升起来。
sentences.traditional: 太陽從東方升起來。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng cóng dōngfāng shēng qǐlái.
sentences.translation: The sun rises in the east.

sentences.chinese: 很多人觉得东方文化很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 很多人覺得東方文化很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: Many people think Eastern culture is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 从这里往东方走，就是车站。
sentences.traditional: 從這裡往東方走，就是車站。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng dōngfāng zǒu, jiù shì chēzhàn.
sentences.translation: If you walk east from here, you will get to the station.

sentences.chinese: 我家在学校的东南。
sentences.traditional: 我家在學校的東南。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài xuéxiào de dōngnán.
sentences.translation: My home is to the southeast of the school.

sentences.chinese: 今天我们往东南走。
sentences.traditional: 今天我們往東南走。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen wǎng dōngnán zǒu.
sentences.translation: Today we are walking southeast.

sentences.chinese: 地图上，右下角是东南。
sentences.traditional: 地圖上，右下角是東南。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng, yòu xiàjiǎo shì dōngnán.
sentences.translation: On a map, the lower-right corner is southeast.

sentences.chinese: 冬天天气很冷。
sentences.traditional: 冬天天氣很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān tiānqì hěn lěng.
sentences.translation: Winter weather is very cold.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢冬天，因为可以看雪。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡冬天，因為可以看雪。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan dōngtiān, yīnwèi kěyǐ kàn xuě.
sentences.translation: Winter is my favourite season because I can see snow.

sentences.chinese: 北方的冬天常常下雪。
sentences.traditional: 北方的冬天常常下雪。
sentences.pinyin: Běifāng de dōngtiān chángcháng xiàxuě.
sentences.translation: It often snows in winter in the north.

sentences.chinese: 她懂得怎么做这个菜。
sentences.traditional: 她懂得怎麼做這個菜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǒngde zěnme zuò zhège cài.
sentences.translation: She understands how to make this dish.

sentences.chinese: 你长大以后会懂得他的意思。
sentences.traditional: 你長大以後會懂得他的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎng dà yǐhòu huì dǒngde tā de yìsi.
sentences.translation: You will understand what he means when you grow up.

sentences.chinese: 我现在更懂得帮助别人了。
sentences.traditional: 我現在更懂得幫助別人了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài gèng dǒngde bāngzhù biérén le.
sentences.translation: I now better understand how to help others.

sentences.chinese: 这个动物不怕人。
sentences.traditional: 這個動物不怕人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dòngwù bú pà rén.
sentences.translation: This animal is not afraid of people.

sentences.chinese: 很多孩子喜欢看小动物。
sentences.traditional: 很多孩子喜歡看小動物。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō háizi xǐhuan kàn xiǎo dòngwù.
sentences.translation: Many children like looking at small animals.

sentences.chinese: 动物也需要安全的家。
sentences.traditional: 動物也需要安全的家。
sentences.pinyin: Dòngwù yě xūyào ānquán de jiā.
sentences.translation: Animals also need a safe home.

sentences.chinese: 星期天我们去动物园。
sentences.traditional: 星期天我們去動物園。
sentences.pinyin: Xīngqītiān wǒmen qù dòngwùyuán.
sentences.translation: We are going to the zoo on Sunday.

sentences.chinese: 动物园里有大熊猫。
sentences.traditional: 動物園裡有大熊貓。
sentences.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu dàxióngmāo.
sentences.translation: There are giant pandas in the zoo.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在动物园玩得很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在動物園玩得很高興。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài dòngwùyuán wán de hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.translation: The children had a great time at the zoo.

sentences.chinese: 这条裤子太短了。
sentences.traditional: 這條褲子太短了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài duǎn le.
sentences.translation: These trousers are too short.

sentences.chinese: 冬天白天比较短。
sentences.traditional: 冬天白天比較短。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān báitiān bǐjiào duǎn.
sentences.translation: Days are relatively short in winter.

sentences.chinese: 他的头发很短。
sentences.traditional: 他的頭髮很短。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tóufa hěn duǎn.
sentences.translation: His hair is very short.

sentences.chinese: 天气热的时候，我喜欢穿短裤。
sentences.traditional: 天氣熱的時候，我喜歡穿短褲。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì rè de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan chuān duǎnkù.
sentences.translation: When the weather is hot, I like to wear shorts.

sentences.chinese: 这条短裤有点儿小。
sentences.traditional: 這條短褲有點兒小。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo duǎnkù yǒudiǎnr xiǎo.
sentences.translation: These shorts are a bit small.

sentences.chinese: 他买了一条蓝色的短裤。
sentences.traditional: 他買了一條藍色的短褲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì tiáo lánsè de duǎnkù.
sentences.translation: He bought a pair of blue shorts.

sentences.chinese: 这段对话很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這段對話很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn duìhuà hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This bit of dialogue is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们读第一段。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們讀第一段。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen dú dì-yī duàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to read the first paragraph.

sentences.chinese: 这段路不太好走。
sentences.traditional: 這段路不太好走。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn lù bú tài hǎo zǒu.
sentences.translation: This stretch of road is not very easy to walk.

sentences.chinese: 我每天早上都去公园锻炼。
sentences.traditional: 我每天早上都去公園鍛鍊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù gōngyuán duànliàn.
sentences.translation: I go to the park to exercise every morning.

sentences.chinese: 身体不好的人更要锻炼。
sentences.traditional: 身體不好的人更要鍛鍊。
sentences.pinyin: Shēntǐ bù hǎo de rén gèng yào duànliàn.
sentences.translation: People in poor health need to exercise even more.

sentences.chinese: 游泳是很好的锻炼。
sentences.traditional: 游泳是很好的鍛鍊。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyǒng shì hěn hǎo de duànliàn.
sentences.translation: Swimming is very good exercise.

sentences.chinese: 课文里的对话不难。
sentences.traditional: 課文裡的對話不難。
sentences.pinyin: Kèwén lǐ de duìhuà bù nán.
sentences.translation: The dialogue in the text is not difficult.

sentences.chinese: 请你和同学练习这段对话。
sentences.traditional: 請你和同學練習這段對話。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ hé tóngxué liànxí zhè duàn duìhuà.
sentences.translation: Please practise this dialogue with your classmate.

sentences.chinese: 他们的对话我都听见了。
sentences.traditional: 他們的對話我都聽見了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen de duìhuà wǒ dōu tīngjiàn le.
sentences.translation: I heard all of their conversation.

sentences.chinese: 我现在有点儿饿。
sentences.traditional: 我現在有點兒餓。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài yǒudiǎnr è.
sentences.translation: I am a little hungry now.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们玩了一下午，都饿了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們玩了一下午，都餓了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen wán le yí xiàwǔ, dōu è le.
sentences.translation: The children played all afternoon and are all hungry.

sentences.chinese: 你饿不饿？要不要吃点儿东西？
sentences.traditional: 你餓不餓？要不要吃點兒東西？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ è bu è? Yào bú yào chī diǎnr dōngxi?
sentences.translation: Are you hungry? Do you want something to eat?

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆不贵，而且菜很好吃。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯館不貴，而且菜很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn bú guì, érqiě cài hěn hǎochī.
sentences.translation: This restaurant isn't expensive, and the food is delicious.

sentences.chinese: 他会说汉语，而且说得很流利。
sentences.traditional: 他會說漢語，而且說得很流利。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě shuō de hěn liúlì.
sentences.translation: He can speak Chinese, and he speaks it very fluently.

sentences.chinese: 今天很冷，而且外面还下雨。
sentences.traditional: 今天很冷，而且外面還下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān hěn lěng, érqiě wàimian hái xiàyǔ.
sentences.translation: It's cold today, and it's also raining outside.

sentences.chinese: 小狗的耳朵很大。
sentences.traditional: 小狗的耳朵很大。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu de ěrduo hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The puppy's ears are very big.

sentences.chinese: 我的耳朵有点儿疼。
sentences.traditional: 我的耳朵有點兒疼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de ěrduo yǒudiǎnr téng.
sentences.translation: My ear hurts a little.

sentences.chinese: 风太大了，我的耳朵都冷了。
sentences.traditional: 風太大了，我的耳朵都冷了。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng tài dà le, wǒ de ěrduo dōu lěng le.
sentences.translation: The wind is so strong that even my ears are cold.

sentences.chinese: 我坐地铁的时候常常戴耳机。
sentences.traditional: 我坐地鐵的時候常常戴耳機。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuò dìtiě de shíhou chángcháng dài ěrjī.
sentences.translation: I often wear earphones when I take the metro.

sentences.chinese: 你的耳机在哪儿？
sentences.traditional: 你的耳機在哪兒？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de ěrjī zài nǎr?
sentences.translation: Where are your earphones?

sentences.chinese: 请不要在上课的时候用耳机听音乐。
sentences.traditional: 請不要在上課的時候用耳機聽音樂。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào zài shàngkè de shíhou yòng ěrjī tīng yīnyuè.
sentences.translation: Please don't use earphones to listen to music during class.

sentences.chinese: 老师给我们发了新书。
sentences.traditional: 老師給我們發了新書。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi wǒmen fā le xīn shū.
sentences.translation: The teacher handed out new books to us.

sentences.chinese: 我晚上给朋友发短信。
sentences.traditional: 我晚上給朋友發短信。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wǎnshang gěi péngyou fā duǎnxìn.
sentences.translation: I send text messages to my friend in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 公司今天发了一个通知。
sentences.traditional: 公司今天發了一個通知。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jīntiān fā le yí ge tōngzhī.
sentences.translation: The company issued a notice today.

sentences.chinese: 孩子昨天晚上发烧了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子昨天晚上發燒了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zuótiān wǎnshang fāshāo le.
sentences.translation: The child had a fever last night.

sentences.chinese: 你发烧的时候要多喝水。
sentences.traditional: 你發燒的時候要多喝水。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ fāshāo de shíhou yào duō hē shuǐ.
sentences.translation: You should drink more water when you have a fever.

sentences.chinese: 他发烧以后没有去上学。
sentences.traditional: 他發燒以後沒有去上學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāshāo yǐhòu méiyǒu qù shàngxué.
sentences.translation: He didn't go to school after getting a fever.

sentences.chinese: 刚才发生了什么事？
sentences.traditional: 剛才發生了什麼事？
sentences.pinyin: Gāngcái fāshēng le shénme shì?
sentences.translation: What happened just now?

sentences.chinese: 这件事发生在去年冬天。
sentences.traditional: 這件事發生在去年冬天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì fāshēng zài qùnián dōngtiān.
sentences.translation: This happened last winter.

sentences.chinese: 学校门口发生了一点儿问题。
sentences.traditional: 學校門口發生了一點兒問題。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào ménkǒu fāshēng le yìdiǎnr wèntí.
sentences.translation: A small problem occurred at the school gate.

sentences.chinese: 我发现这本书很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 我發現這本書很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: I found this book very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 老师发现他今天没来。
sentences.traditional: 老師發現他今天沒來。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī fāxiàn tā jīntiān méi lái.
sentences.translation: The teacher noticed that he didn't come today.

sentences.chinese: 你有没有发现外面下雪了？
sentences.traditional: 你有沒有發現外面下雪了？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu fāxiàn wàimian xiàxuě le?
sentences.translation: Did you notice that it has started snowing outside?

sentences.chinese: 这个城市发展得很快。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市發展得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: This city is developing very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这里的旅游业发展得不错。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的旅遊業發展得不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de lǚyóuyè fāzhǎn de búcuò.
sentences.translation: Tourism here is developing quite well.

sentences.chinese: 这个公司这几年发展得很快。
sentences.traditional: 這個公司這幾年發展得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī zhè jǐ nián fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: This company has developed quickly in recent years.

sentences.chinese: 这里坐公交车很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這裡坐公交車很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ zuò gōngjiāochē hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: It's very convenient to take the bus here.

sentences.chinese: 现在买东西比以前方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 現在買東西比以前方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài mǎi dōngxi bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: Buying things is much more convenient now than before.

sentences.chinese: 明天下午你方便吗？
sentences.traditional: 明天下午你方便嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ nǐ fāngbiàn ma?
sentences.translation: Are you available tomorrow afternoon?

sentences.chinese: 我中午吃了一碗方便面。
sentences.traditional: 我中午吃了一碗方便麵。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhōngwǔ chī le yì wǎn fāngbiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: I ate a bowl of instant noodles at noon.

sentences.chinese: 他饿的时候常常吃方便面。
sentences.traditional: 他餓的時候常常吃方便麵。
sentences.pinyin: Tā è de shíhou chángcháng chī fāngbiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: He often eats instant noodles when he is hungry.

sentences.chinese: 超市里有很多种方便面。
sentences.traditional: 超市裡有很多種方便麵。
sentences.pinyin: Chāoshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng fāngbiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: There are many kinds of instant noodles in the supermarket.

sentences.chinese: 这个方法很简单。
sentences.traditional: 這個方法很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: This method is very simple.

sentences.chinese: 老师教了我们一个好方法。
sentences.traditional: 老師教了我們一個好方法。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiāo le wǒmen yí ge hǎo fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: The teacher taught us a good method.

sentences.chinese: 你有别的方法吗？
sentences.traditional: 你有別的方法嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu bié de fāngfǎ ma?
sentences.translation: Do you have another method?

sentences.chinese: 我们走错方向了。
sentences.traditional: 我們走錯方向了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu cuò fāngxiàng le.
sentences.translation: We went in the wrong direction.

sentences.chinese: 请告诉我学校的方向。
sentences.traditional: 請告訴我學校的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ xuéxiào de fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: Please tell me the direction to the school.

sentences.chinese: 车子往东开，方向对了。
sentences.traditional: 車子往東開，方向對了。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzi wǎng dōng kāi, fāngxiàng duì le.
sentences.translation: The car is going east, so the direction is right.

sentences.chinese: 那座房子很大。
sentences.traditional: 那座房子很大。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zuò fángzi hěn dà.
sentences.translation: That house is very big.

sentences.chinese: 我家旁边有一座老房子。
sentences.traditional: 我家旁邊有一座老房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā pángbiān yǒu yí zuò lǎo fángzi.
sentences.translation: There is an old house next to my home.

sentences.chinese: 他们想买新房子。
sentences.traditional: 他們想買新房子。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiǎng mǎi xīn fángzi.
sentences.translation: They want to buy a new house.

sentences.chinese: 请把书放在桌子上。
sentences.traditional: 請把書放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
sentences.translation: Please put the book on the table.

sentences.chinese: 她把杯子放好了。
sentences.traditional: 她把杯子放好了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ bēizi fàng hǎo le.
sentences.translation: She put the cup in place.

sentences.chinese: 我忘了把钥匙放哪儿了。
sentences.traditional: 我忘了把鑰匙放哪兒了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le bǎ yàoshi fàng nǎr le.
sentences.translation: I forgot where I put the keys.

sentences.chinese: 我们下个月要放假。
sentences.traditional: 我們下個月要放假。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge yuè yào fàngjià.
sentences.translation: We will have a holiday next month.

sentences.chinese: 学校明天开始放假。
sentences.traditional: 學校明天開始放假。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào míngtiān kāishǐ fàngjià.
sentences.translation: School starts the holiday tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 放假的时候我想回家。
sentences.traditional: 放假的時候我想回家。
sentences.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhou wǒ xiǎng huí jiā.
sentences.translation: During the holiday I want to go home.

sentences.chinese: 你放心，我会帮你。
sentences.traditional: 你放心，我會幫你。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ huì bāng nǐ.
sentences.translation: Don't worry, I'll help you.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈说孩子很安全，让我放心。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽說孩子很安全，讓我放心。
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō háizi hěn ānquán, ràng wǒ fàngxīn.
sentences.translation: Mum said the child is very safe, which put me at ease.

sentences.chinese: 听了医生的话以后，他放心了。
sentences.traditional: 聽了醫生的話以後，他放心了。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng le yīshēng de huà yǐhòu, tā fàngxīn le.
sentences.translation: After hearing the doctor's words, he felt reassured.

sentences.chinese: 我们四点放学。
sentences.traditional: 我們四點放學。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen sì diǎn fàngxué.
sentences.translation: We finish school at four o'clock.

sentences.chinese: 放学以后我去打篮球。
sentences.traditional: 放學以後我去打籃球。
sentences.pinyin: Fàngxué yǐhòu wǒ qù dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.translation: After school I go play basketball.

sentences.chinese: 弟弟放学回来很饿。
sentences.traditional: 弟弟放學回來很餓。
sentences.pinyin: Dìdi fàngxué huílái hěn è.
sentences.translation: My younger brother is very hungry when he comes back from school.

sentences.chinese: 请把这些东西分开。
sentences.traditional: 請把這些東西分開。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē dōngxi fēnkāi.
sentences.translation: Please separate these things.

sentences.chinese: 他们住在两个分开的房间里。
sentences.traditional: 他們住在兩個分開的房間裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhù zài liǎng ge fēnkāi de fángjiān lǐ.
sentences.translation: They live in two separate rooms.

sentences.chinese: 我们在车站分开了。
sentences.traditional: 我們在車站分開了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài chēzhàn fēnkāi le.
sentences.translation: We parted at the station.

sentences.chinese: 今天的风很大。
sentences.traditional: 今天的風很大。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de fēng hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The wind is strong today.

sentences.chinese: 外面的风有点冷。
sentences.traditional: 外面的風有點冷。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimian de fēng yǒudiǎn lěng.
sentences.translation: The wind outside is a bit cold.

sentences.chinese: 春天常常有风。
sentences.traditional: 春天常常有風。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān chángcháng yǒu fēng.
sentences.translation: It is often windy in spring.

sentences.chinese: 我收到一封信。
sentences.traditional: 我收到一封信。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shōudào yì fēng xìn.
sentences.translation: I received a letter.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有两封信。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有兩封信。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shang yǒu liǎng fēng xìn.
sentences.translation: There are two letters on the table.

sentences.chinese: 请你把这封信给老师。
sentences.traditional: 請你把這封信給老師。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè fēng xìn gěi lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: Please give this letter to the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 他们是一对年轻的夫妻。
sentences.traditional: 他們是一對年輕的夫妻。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shì yí duì niánqīng de fūqī.
sentences.translation: They are a young married couple.

sentences.chinese: 这对夫妻住在我们楼上。
sentences.traditional: 這對夫妻住在我們樓上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duì fūqī zhù zài wǒmen lóu shàng.
sentences.translation: This couple live upstairs from us.

sentences.chinese: 夫妻之间要互相帮助。
sentences.traditional: 夫妻之間要互相幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Fūqī zhījiān yào hùxiāng bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: Husbands and wives should help each other.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆服务很好。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯館服務很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn fúwù hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: The service in this restaurant is very good.

sentences.chinese: 她在酒店服务客人。
sentences.traditional: 她在酒店服務客人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jiǔdiàn fúwù kèrén.
sentences.translation: She serves guests at the hotel.

sentences.chinese: 我们要认真服务大家。
sentences.traditional: 我們要認真服務大家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào rènzhēn fúwù dàjiā.
sentences.translation: We should serve everyone conscientiously.

sentences.chinese: 学校附近有一家书店。
sentences.traditional: 學校附近有一家書店。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu yì jiā shūdiàn.
sentences.translation: There is a bookstore near the school.

sentences.chinese: 我家附近很安静。
sentences.traditional: 我家附近很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: It is very quiet near my home.

sentences.chinese: 你住在这里附近吗？
sentences.traditional: 你住在這裡附近嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhù zài zhèlǐ fùjìn ma?
sentences.translation: Do you live near here?

sentences.chinese: 考试前我要复习。
sentences.traditional: 考試前我要複習。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì qián wǒ yào fùxí.
sentences.translation: I need to review before the exam.

sentences.chinese: 他晚上常常复习汉字。
sentences.traditional: 他晚上常常複習漢字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wǎnshang chángcháng fùxí Hànzì.
sentences.translation: He often reviews Chinese characters in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 我们一起复习今天的课。
sentences.traditional: 我們一起複習今天的課。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ fùxí jīntiān de kè.
sentences.translation: We review today's lesson together.

sentences.chinese: 你该睡觉了。
sentences.traditional: 你該睡覺了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ gāi shuìjiào le.
sentences.translation: You should go to sleep.

sentences.chinese: 我们现在该出发了。
sentences.traditional: 我們現在該出發了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài gāi chūfā le.
sentences.translation: We should set off now.

sentences.chinese: 这道题该怎么做？
sentences.traditional: 這道題該怎麼做？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí gāi zěnme zuò?
sentences.translation: How should this question be done?

sentences.chinese: 你的房间很干净。
sentences.traditional: 你的房間很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: Your room is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 请把桌子擦干净。
sentences.traditional: 請把桌子擦乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhuōzi cā gānjìng.
sentences.translation: Please wipe the table clean.

sentences.chinese: 洗手间很干净。
sentences.traditional: 洗手間很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Xǐshǒujiān hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: The toilet is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 我对中国历史很感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 我對中國歷史很感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó lìshǐ hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: I am very interested in Chinese history.

sentences.chinese: 他开始对篮球感兴趣了。
sentences.traditional: 他開始對籃球感興趣了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ duì lánqiú gǎn xìngqù le.
sentences.translation: He has started to become interested in basketball.

sentences.chinese: 你对这本书感兴趣吗？
sentences.traditional: 你對這本書感興趣嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ duì zhè běn shū gǎn xìngqù ma?
sentences.translation: Are you interested in this book?

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，我感到很意外。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，我感到很意外。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ gǎndào hěn yìwài.
sentences.translation: I felt very surprised when I heard the news.

sentences.chinese: 她感到有点累。
sentences.traditional: 她感到有點累。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào yǒudiǎn lèi.
sentences.translation: She feels a little tired.

sentences.chinese: 我感到这里很安全。
sentences.traditional: 我感到這裡很安全。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào zhèlǐ hěn ānquán.
sentences.translation: I feel that it is very safe here.

sentences.chinese: 他昨天感冒了。
sentences.traditional: 他昨天感冒了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuótiān gǎnmào le.
sentences.translation: He caught a cold yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 我感冒的时候不想出门。
sentences.traditional: 我感冒的時候不想出門。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào de shíhou bù xiǎng chūmén.
sentences.translation: When I have a cold, I do not want to go out.

sentences.chinese: 天冷了，别感冒。
sentences.traditional: 天冷了，別感冒。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, bié gǎnmào.
sentences.translation: It is cold, do not catch a cold.

sentences.chinese: 他在饭馆干了三年。
sentences.traditional: 他在飯館幹了三年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài fànguǎn gàn le sān nián.
sentences.translation: He worked in a restaurant for three years.

sentences.chinese: 今天你想干什么？
sentences.traditional: 今天你想幹什麼？
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān nǐ xiǎng gàn shénme?
sentences.translation: What do you want to do today?

sentences.chinese: 我一个人干不了这么多事。
sentences.traditional: 我一個人幹不了這麼多事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yí ge rén gàn bù liǎo zhème duō shì.
sentences.translation: I cannot do this many things by myself.

sentences.chinese: 我刚到家。
sentences.traditional: 我剛到家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dào jiā.
sentences.translation: I just got home.

sentences.chinese: 他刚下班，还在路上。
sentences.traditional: 他剛下班，還在路上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng xiàbān, hái zài lùshang.
sentences.translation: He just got off work and is still on the way.

sentences.chinese: 雨刚停，我们出去吧。
sentences.traditional: 雨剛停，我們出去吧。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ gāng tíng, wǒmen chūqù ba.
sentences.translation: The rain has just stopped, let us go out.

sentences.chinese: 你刚才给谁打电话？
sentences.traditional: 你剛才給誰打電話？
