sentences.pinyin: Nǐ gāngcái gěi shéi dǎ diànhuà?
sentences.translation: Who did you call just now?

sentences.chinese: 我刚才在办公室。
sentences.traditional: 我剛才在辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái zài bàngōngshì.
sentences.translation: I was in the office just now.

sentences.chinese: 刚才那班地铁很挤。
sentences.traditional: 剛才那班地鐵很擠。
sentences.pinyin: Gāngcái nà bān dìtiě hěn jǐ.
sentences.translation: The metro just now was very crowded.

sentences.chinese: 我刚刚吃过饭。
sentences.traditional: 我剛剛吃過飯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng chī guò fàn.
sentences.translation: I just ate.

sentences.chinese: 她刚刚发来一条消息。
sentences.traditional: 她剛剛發來一條消息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gānggāng fā lái yì tiáo xiāoxi.
sentences.translation: She just sent a message.

sentences.chinese: 电影刚刚开始。
sentences.traditional: 電影剛剛開始。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng gānggāng kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: The film has just started.

sentences.chinese: 我们坐高铁去北京。
sentences.traditional: 我們坐高鐵去北京。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò gāotiě qù Běijīng.
sentences.translation: We are taking the high-speed rail to Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 高铁站离这里不远。
sentences.traditional: 高鐵站離這裡不遠。
sentences.pinyin: Gāotiě zhàn lí zhèlǐ bù yuǎn.
sentences.translation: The high-speed rail station is not far from here.

sentences.chinese: 坐高铁比开车快很多。
sentences.traditional: 坐高鐵比開車快很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò gāotiě bǐ kāichē kuài hěn duō.
sentences.translation: Taking the high-speed rail is much faster than driving.

sentences.chinese: 根据天气预报，明天会下雨。
sentences.traditional: 根據天氣預報，明天會下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān huì xiàyǔ.
sentences.translation: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 我们根据地图找到了那个地方。
sentences.traditional: 我們根據地圖找到了那個地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen gēnjù dìtú zhǎodào le nàge dìfang.
sentences.translation: We found that place based on the map.

sentences.chinese: 请根据老师的话回答问题。
sentences.traditional: 請根據老師的話回答問題。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gēnjù lǎoshī de huà huídá wèntí.
sentences.translation: Please answer the question according to the teacher's words.

sentences.chinese: 今天比昨天更冷。
sentences.traditional: 今天比昨天更冷。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān gèng lěng.
sentences.translation: Today is colder than yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 你可以说得更慢一点吗？
sentences.traditional: 你可以說得更慢一點嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ shuō de gèng màn yìdiǎn ma?
sentences.translation: Can you speak a little more slowly?

sentences.chinese: 我希望我的中文更好。
sentences.traditional: 我希望我的中文更好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng wǒ de Zhōngwén gèng hǎo.
sentences.translation: I hope my Chinese gets better.

sentences.chinese: 这个西瓜有五公斤。
sentences.traditional: 這個西瓜有五公斤。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xīguā yǒu wǔ gōngjīn.
sentences.translation: This watermelon weighs five kilograms.

sentences.chinese: 我买了两公斤苹果。
sentences.traditional: 我買了兩公斤蘋果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng gōngjīn píngguǒ.
sentences.translation: I bought two kilograms of apples.

sentences.chinese: 这只狗已经三十公斤了。
sentences.traditional: 這隻狗已經三十公斤了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī gǒu yǐjīng sānshí gōngjīn le.
sentences.translation: This dog already weighs thirty kilograms.

sentences.chinese: 我们周末常去公园散步。
sentences.traditional: 我們週末常去公園散步。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò cháng qù gōngyuán sànbù.
sentences.translation: We often go to the park for a walk at weekends.

sentences.chinese: 公园里有很多花和树。
sentences.traditional: 公園裡有很多花和樹。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō huā hé shù.
sentences.translation: There are many flowers and trees in the park.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在公园里玩得很开心。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在公園裡玩得很開心。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài gōngyuán lǐ wán de hěn kāixīn.
sentences.translation: The children are having a great time in the park.

sentences.chinese: 工作日我七点起床。
sentences.traditional: 工作日我七點起床。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngzuòrì wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
sentences.translation: On workdays, I get up at seven.

sentences.chinese: 这家店工作日开到晚上九点。
sentences.traditional: 這家店工作日開到晚上九點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn gōngzuòrì kāi dào wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn.
sentences.translation: This shop stays open until nine in the evening on workdays.

sentences.chinese: 工作日地铁上人很多。
sentences.traditional: 工作日地鐵上人很多。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngzuòrì dìtiě shàng rén hěn duō.
sentences.translation: There are many people on the metro on workdays.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷喜欢给我讲故事。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺喜歡給我講故事。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xǐhuan gěi wǒ jiǎng gùshi.
sentences.translation: Grandpa likes telling me stories.

sentences.chinese: 这本书里的故事很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這本書裡的故事很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū lǐ de gùshi hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: The stories in this book are very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 你能再说一遍那个故事吗？
sentences.traditional: 你能再說一遍那個故事嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng zài shuō yí biàn nàge gùshi ma?
sentences.translation: Can you tell that story again?

sentences.chinese: 今天外面刮大风。
sentences.traditional: 今天外面颳大風。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wàimiàn guā dà fēng.
sentences.translation: It is very windy outside today.

sentences.chinese: 冬天常常刮北风。
sentences.traditional: 冬天常常颳北風。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān chángcháng guā běifēng.
sentences.translation: A north wind often blows in winter.

sentences.chinese: 风太大了，刮得脸疼。
sentences.traditional: 風太大了，颳得臉疼。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng tài dà le, guā de liǎn téng.
sentences.translation: The wind is so strong that it makes my face hurt.

sentences.chinese: 请关门。
sentences.traditional: 請關門。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng guān mén.
sentences.translation: Please close the door.

sentences.chinese: 你睡觉前别忘了关灯。
sentences.traditional: 你睡覺前別忘了關燈。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shuìjiào qián bié wàng le guān dēng.
sentences.translation: Do not forget to turn off the light before bed.

sentences.chinese: 这家店晚上十点关。
sentences.traditional: 這家店晚上十點關。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn wǎnshang shí diǎn guān.
sentences.translation: This shop closes at ten in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们上课前把手机关机。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們上課前把手機關機。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen shàngkè qián bǎ shǒujī guānjī.
sentences.translation: The teacher told us to turn off our phones before class.

sentences.chinese: 电脑出了问题，你先关机吧。
sentences.traditional: 電腦出了問題，你先關機吧。
sentences.pinyin: Diànnǎo chū le wèntí, nǐ xiān guānjī ba.
sentences.translation: The computer has a problem, so turn it off first.

sentences.chinese: 上飞机以后请关机。
sentences.traditional: 上飛機以後請關機。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng fēijī yǐhòu qǐng guānjī.
sentences.translation: Please turn off your device after boarding the plane.

sentences.chinese: 我跟他的关系很好。
sentences.traditional: 我跟他的關係很好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā de guānxì hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: I have a very good relationship with him.

sentences.chinese: 这两个问题有关系。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個問題有關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge wèntí yǒu guānxì.
sentences.translation: These two problems are related.

sentences.chinese: 这件事跟你没关系。
sentences.traditional: 這件事跟你沒關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì gēn nǐ méi guānxì.
sentences.translation: This matter has nothing to do with you.

sentences.chinese: 谢谢你这么关心我。
sentences.traditional: 謝謝你這麼關心我。
sentences.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ zhème guānxīn wǒ.
sentences.translation: Thank you for caring about me so much.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸妈妈都很关心孩子。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸媽媽都很關心孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba māma dōu hěn guānxīn háizi.
sentences.translation: Mum and Dad both care a lot about the child.

sentences.chinese: 老师很关心我们的学习。
sentences.traditional: 老師很關心我們的學習。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn guānxīn wǒmen de xuéxí.
sentences.translation: The teacher cares a lot about our studies.

sentences.chinese: 我想问一个关于工作的事。
sentences.traditional: 我想問一個關於工作的事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn yí ge guānyú gōngzuò de shì.
sentences.translation: I want to ask something about work.

sentences.chinese: 这是一本关于动物的书。
sentences.traditional: 這是一本關於動物的書。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yì běn guānyú dòngwù de shū.
sentences.translation: This is a book about animals.

sentences.chinese: 老师正在讲关于中国历史的故事。
sentences.traditional: 老師正在講關於中國歷史的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài jiǎng guānyú Zhōngguó lìshǐ de gùshi.
sentences.translation: The teacher is telling a story about Chinese history.

sentences.chinese: 很多人关注这场比赛。
sentences.traditional: 很多人關注這場比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén guānzhù zhè chǎng bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Many people are following this match.

sentences.chinese: 我最近开始关注天气。
sentences.traditional: 我最近開始關注天氣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn kāishǐ guānzhù tiānqì.
sentences.translation: I have recently started paying attention to the weather.

sentences.chinese: 请大家关注老师说的话。
sentences.traditional: 請大家關注老師說的話。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā guānzhù lǎoshī shuō de huà.
sentences.translation: Please pay attention to what the teacher is saying.

sentences.chinese: 中国是一个很大的国家。
sentences.traditional: 中國是一個很大的國家。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó shì yí ge hěn dà de guójiā.
sentences.translation: China is a very large country.

sentences.chinese: 这个国家有很多高山。
sentences.traditional: 這個國家有很多高山。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guójiā yǒu hěn duō gāoshān.
sentences.translation: This country has many high mountains.

sentences.chinese: 我想以后去别的国家旅游。
sentences.traditional: 我想以後去別的國家旅遊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yǐhòu qù biéde guójiā lǚyóu.
sentences.translation: I want to travel to other countries in future.

sentences.chinese: 我们一家人喜欢一起过节。
sentences.traditional: 我們一家人喜歡一起過節。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yì jiā rén xǐhuan yìqǐ guòjié.
sentences.translation: Our whole family likes celebrating festivals together.

sentences.chinese: 过节的时候，街上很热闹。
sentences.traditional: 過節的時候，街上很熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Guòjié de shíhou, jiē shàng hěn rènào.
sentences.translation: The streets are very lively during festivals.

sentences.chinese: 很多人回家和家人过节。
sentences.traditional: 很多人回家和家人過節。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén huí jiā hé jiārén guòjié.
sentences.translation: Many people go home to celebrate festivals with their family.

sentences.chinese: 过去的事不用再想了。
sentences.traditional: 過去的事不用再想了。
sentences.pinyin: Guòqù de shì búyòng zài xiǎng le.
sentences.translation: There is no need to think about the past anymore.

sentences.chinese: 我们可以从过去学到很多。
sentences.traditional: 我們可以從過去學到很多。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ cóng guòqù xué dào hěn duō.
sentences.translation: We can learn a lot from the past.

sentences.chinese: 他常常跟孩子讲过去的故事。
sentences.traditional: 他常常跟孩子講過去的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángcháng gēn háizi jiǎng guòqù de gùshi.
sentences.translation: He often tells the children stories about the past.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢听海的声音。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡聽海的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan tīng hǎi de shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: I like listening to the sound of the sea.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市离海很近。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市離海很近。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì lí hǎi hěn jìn.
sentences.translation: This city is close to the sea.

sentences.chinese: 夏天的海很漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 夏天的海很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān de hǎi hěn piàoliang.
sentences.translation: The sea is very beautiful in summer.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子晚上害怕黑。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子晚上害怕黑。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo háizi wǎnshang hàipà hēi.
sentences.translation: Little children are afraid of the dark at night.

sentences.chinese: 她很害怕坐飞机。
sentences.traditional: 她很害怕坐飛機。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn hàipà zuò fēijī.
sentences.translation: She is very afraid of flying.

sentences.chinese: 你不用害怕，我在这里。
sentences.traditional: 你不用害怕，我在這裡。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng hàipà, wǒ zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.translation: You don't need to be afraid; I'm here.

sentences.chinese: 商店里有好多水果。
sentences.traditional: 商店裡有好多水果。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn lǐ yǒu hǎoduō shuǐguǒ.
sentences.translation: There is a lot of fruit in the shop.

sentences.chinese: 今天来了好多同学。
sentences.traditional: 今天來了好多同學。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān lái le hǎoduō tóngxué.
sentences.translation: Many classmates came today.

sentences.chinese: 我还有好多问题想问。
sentences.traditional: 我還有好多問題想問。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǒu hǎoduō wèntí xiǎng wèn.
sentences.translation: I still have a lot of questions to ask.

sentences.chinese: 我们好久没见了。
sentences.traditional: 我們好久沒見了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen hǎojiǔ méi jiàn le.
sentences.translation: We haven't seen each other for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他在外边等了好久。
sentences.traditional: 他在外邊等了好久。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài wàibian děng le hǎojiǔ.
sentences.translation: He waited outside for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 这本书我看了好久。
sentences.traditional: 這本書我看了好久。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le hǎojiǔ.
sentences.translation: I looked at this book for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他今天好像不太高兴。
sentences.traditional: 他今天好像不太高興。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hǎoxiàng bú tài gāoxìng.
sentences.translation: He seems not very happy today.

sentences.chinese: 外面好像下雨了。
sentences.traditional: 外面好像下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn hǎoxiàng xiàyǔ le.
sentences.translation: It looks like it is raining outside.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服好像有点大。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服好像有點大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hǎoxiàng yǒudiǎn dà.
sentences.translation: This piece of clothing seems a bit big.

sentences.chinese: 这个号码不对。
sentences.traditional: 這個號碼不對。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hàomǎ bú duì.
sentences.translation: This number is wrong.

sentences.chinese: 请写下你的号码。
sentences.traditional: 請寫下你的號碼。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiě xià nǐ de hàomǎ.
sentences.translation: Please write down your number.

sentences.chinese: 我忘了房间的号码。
sentences.traditional: 我忘了房間的號碼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le fángjiān de hàomǎ.
sentences.translation: I forgot the room number.

sentences.chinese: 学校后面有一条河。
sentences.traditional: 學校後面有一條河。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào hòumiàn yǒu yì tiáo hé.
sentences.translation: There is a river behind the school.

sentences.chinese: 这条河很长。
sentences.traditional: 這條河很長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé hěn cháng.
sentences.translation: This river is very long.

sentences.chinese: 我们不能在这条河里游泳。
sentences.traditional: 我們不能在這條河裡游泳。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ yóuyǒng.
sentences.translation: We cannot swim in this river.

sentences.chinese: 这双鞋很合适。
sentences.traditional: 這雙鞋很合適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié hěn héshì.
sentences.translation: These shoes fit well.

sentences.chinese: 这个时间不太合适。
sentences.traditional: 這個時間不太合適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shíjiān bú tài héshì.
sentences.translation: This time is not very suitable.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服大小很合适。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服大小很合適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu dàxiǎo hěn héshì.
sentences.translation: The size of this piece of clothing is very suitable.

sentences.chinese: 黑板前面站着一个学生。
sentences.traditional: 黑板前面站著一個學生。
sentences.pinyin: Hēibǎn qiánmiàn zhànzhe yí ge xuéshēng.
sentences.translation: A student is standing in front of the blackboard.

sentences.chinese: 请看黑板上的句子。
sentences.traditional: 請看黑板上的句子。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng kàn hēibǎn shàng de jùzi.
sentences.translation: Please look at the sentence on the blackboard.

sentences.chinese: 过马路以前先看红绿灯。
sentences.traditional: 過馬路以前先看紅綠燈。
sentences.pinyin: Guò mǎlù yǐqián xiān kàn hónglǜdēng.
sentences.translation: Look at the traffic light before crossing the road.

sentences.chinese: 前面那个红绿灯坏了。
sentences.traditional: 前面那個紅綠燈壞了。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánmiàn nàge hónglǜdēng huài le.
sentences.translation: That traffic light ahead is broken.

sentences.chinese: 红绿灯变绿了，我们走吧。
sentences.traditional: 紅綠燈變綠了，我們走吧。
sentences.pinyin: Hónglǜdēng biàn lǜ le, wǒmen zǒu ba.
sentences.translation: The traffic light has turned green, let's go.

sentences.chinese: 后来他去北京工作了。
sentences.traditional: 後來他去北京工作了。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái tā qù Běijīng gōngzuò le.
sentences.translation: Later he went to work in Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 我们后来一起吃饭了。
sentences.traditional: 我們後來一起吃飯了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen hòulái yìqǐ chīfàn le.
sentences.translation: We ate together afterwards.

sentences.chinese: 他先回家，后来又出来了。
sentences.traditional: 他先回家，後來又出來了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiān huí jiā, hòulái yòu chūlái le.
sentences.translation: He went home first, then came out again later.

sentences.chinese: 我后年想去中国旅行。
sentences.traditional: 我後年想去中國旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hòunián xiǎng qù Zhōngguó lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: I want to travel to China the year after next.

sentences.chinese: 后年我弟弟就上大学了。
sentences.traditional: 後年我弟弟就上大學了。
sentences.pinyin: Hòunián wǒ dìdi jiù shàng dàxué le.
sentences.translation: The year after next my younger brother will start university.

sentences.chinese: 我们打算后年搬家。
sentences.traditional: 我們打算後年搬家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn hòunián bānjiā.
sentences.translation: We plan to move house the year after next.

sentences.chinese: 后天我们没有课。
sentences.traditional: 後天我們沒有課。
sentences.pinyin: Hòutiān wǒmen méiyǒu kè.
sentences.translation: We do not have class the day after tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 你的生日是后天吗？
sentences.traditional: 你的生日是後天嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de shēngrì shì hòutiān ma?
sentences.translation: Is your birthday the day after tomorrow?

sentences.chinese: 后天早上八点见。
sentences.traditional: 後天早上八點見。
sentences.pinyin: Hòutiān zǎoshang bā diǎn jiàn.
sentences.translation: See you at eight on the morning of the day after tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 我的护照在包里。
sentences.traditional: 我的護照在包裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de hùzhào zài bāo lǐ.
sentences.translation: My passport is in the bag.

sentences.chinese: 出国以前别忘了带护照。
sentences.traditional: 出國以前別忘了帶護照。
sentences.pinyin: Chūguó yǐqián bié wàng le dài hùzhào.
sentences.translation: Do not forget to take your passport before going abroad.

sentences.chinese: 他的护照快到期了。
sentences.traditional: 他的護照快到期了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de hùzhào kuài dàoqī le.
sentences.translation: His passport is about to expire.

sentences.chinese: 我爷爷在花园里种花。
sentences.traditional: 我爺爺在花園裡種花。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yéye zài huāyuán lǐ zhòng huā.
sentences.translation: My grandfather grows flowers in the garden.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在花园里玩。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在花園裡玩。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài huāyuán lǐ wán.
sentences.translation: The children are playing in the garden.

sentences.chinese: 这个花园很安静。
sentences.traditional: 這個花園很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huāyuán hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: This garden is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 她妈妈是一位画家。
sentences.traditional: 她媽媽是一位畫家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā māma shì yí wèi huàjiā.
sentences.translation: Her mum is a painter.

sentences.chinese: 那个画家画得很好。
sentences.traditional: 那個畫家畫得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge huàjiā huà de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: That painter paints very well.

sentences.chinese: 我想认识那位年轻的画家。
sentences.traditional: 我想認識那位年輕的畫家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng rènshi nà wèi niánqīng de huàjiā.
sentences.translation: I want to meet that young painter.

sentences.chinese: 欢迎你来我家。
sentences.traditional: 歡迎你來我家。
sentences.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐ lái wǒ jiā.
sentences.translation: Welcome to my home.

sentences.chinese: 老师欢迎新学生。
sentences.traditional: 老師歡迎新學生。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī huānyíng xīn xuéshēng.
sentences.translation: The teacher welcomes the new students.

sentences.chinese: 我们都很欢迎他。
sentences.traditional: 我們都很歡迎他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu hěn huānyíng tā.
sentences.translation: We all welcome him.

sentences.chinese: 请把书还给我。
sentences.traditional: 請把書還給我。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū huán gěi wǒ.
sentences.translation: Please return the book to me.

sentences.chinese: 明天我还你钱。
sentences.traditional: 明天我還你錢。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ huán nǐ qián.
sentences.translation: I will return the money to you tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 这把伞是你的，我现在还你。
sentences.traditional: 這把傘是你的，我現在還你。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ sǎn shì nǐ de, wǒ xiànzài huán nǐ.
sentences.translation: This umbrella is yours; I will return it to you now.

sentences.chinese: 这里的环境很好。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的環境很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: The environment here is very good.

sentences.chinese: 我们要保护学校的环境。
sentences.traditional: 我們要保護學校的環境。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù xuéxiào de huánjìng.
sentences.translation: We need to protect the school's environment.

sentences.chinese: 安静的环境让我更容易学习。
sentences.traditional: 安靜的環境讓我更容易學習。
sentences.pinyin: Ānjìng de huánjìng ràng wǒ gèng róngyì xuéxí.
sentences.translation: A quiet environment makes it easier for me to study.

sentences.chinese: 我想换一件大一点的衣服。
sentences.traditional: 我想換一件大一點的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huàn yí jiàn dà yìdiǎn de yīfu.
sentences.translation: I want to change to a slightly bigger piece of clothing.

sentences.chinese: 你可以跟我换座位吗？
sentences.traditional: 你可以跟我換座位嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gēn wǒ huàn zuòwèi ma?
sentences.translation: Can you swap seats with me?

sentences.chinese: 天冷了，该换厚衣服了。
sentences.traditional: 天冷了，該換厚衣服了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, gāi huàn hòu yīfu le.
sentences.translation: It is cold, and it is time to change into thicker clothes.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢黄色的花。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡黃色的花。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan huángsè de huā.
sentences.translation: I like yellow flowers.

sentences.chinese: 她穿着一件黄色的裙子。
sentences.traditional: 她穿著一件黃色的裙子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuānzhe yí jiàn huángsè de qúnzi.
sentences.translation: She is wearing a yellow skirt.

sentences.chinese: 香蕉是黄色的。
sentences.traditional: 香蕉是黃色的。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngjiāo shì huángsè de.
sentences.translation: Bananas are yellow.

sentences.chinese: 请你回答我的问题。
sentences.traditional: 請你回答我的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ huídá wǒ de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Please answer my question.

sentences.chinese: 他没有回答老师。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有回答老師。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu huídá lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: He did not answer the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题很难回答。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題很難回答。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn nán huídá.
sentences.translation: This question is hard to answer.

sentences.chinese: 今天下午我们有个会。
sentences.traditional: 今天下午我們有個會。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒmen yǒu ge huì.
sentences.translation: We have a meeting this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 他还在开会。
sentences.traditional: 他還在開會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái zài kāihuì.
sentences.translation: He is still in a meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这个会很重要。
sentences.traditional: 這個會很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huì hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This meeting is very important.

sentences.chinese: 明天公司有一个重要会议。
sentences.traditional: 明天公司有一個重要會議。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān gōngsī yǒu yí ge zhòngyào huìyì.
sentences.translation: The company has an important meeting tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 会议已经开始了。
sentences.traditional: 會議已經開始了。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yǐjīng kāishǐ le.
sentences.translation: The meeting has already started.

sentences.chinese: 我爸爸下午要参加会议。
sentences.traditional: 我爸爸下午要參加會議。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xiàwǔ yào cānjiā huìyì.
sentences.translation: My dad needs to attend a meeting this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 你想喝茶或咖啡？
sentences.traditional: 你想喝茶或咖啡？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng hē chá huò kāfēi?
sentences.translation: Would you like tea or coffee?

sentences.chinese: 星期六或星期天都可以。
sentences.traditional: 星期六或星期天都可以。
sentences.pinyin: Xīngqīliù huò xīngqītiān dōu kěyǐ.
sentences.translation: Saturday or Sunday is fine.

sentences.chinese: 你可以写字或画画。
sentences.traditional: 你可以寫字或畫畫。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xiězì huò huàhuà.
sentences.translation: You can write or draw.

sentences.chinese: 你可以今天来，或者明天来。
sentences.traditional: 你可以今天來，或者明天來。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ jīntiān lái, huòzhě míngtiān lái.
sentences.translation: You can come today or tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 我们坐车去，或者走路去。
sentences.traditional: 我們坐車去，或者走路去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zuòchē qù, huòzhě zǒulù qù.
sentences.translation: We can go by car, or we can walk there.

sentences.chinese: 晚饭你想吃面，或者吃米饭？
sentences.traditional: 晚飯你想吃麵，或者吃米飯？
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnfàn nǐ xiǎng chī miàn, huòzhě chī mǐfàn?
sentences.translation: For dinner, would you like noodles or rice?

sentences.chinese: 农场里有很多鸡。
sentences.traditional: 農場裡有很多雞。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō jī.
sentences.translation: There are many chickens on the farm.

sentences.chinese: 那只鸡跑得很快。
sentences.traditional: 那隻雞跑得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī jī pǎo de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: That chicken runs very fast.

sentences.chinese: 晚饭我们吃鸡。
sentences.traditional: 晚飯我們吃雞。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnfàn wǒmen chī jī.
sentences.translation: We are eating chicken for dinner.

sentences.chinese: 我几乎每天都运动。
sentences.traditional: 我幾乎每天都運動。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīhū měitiān dōu yùndòng.
sentences.translation: I exercise almost every day.

sentences.chinese: 这道题我几乎做对了。
sentences.traditional: 這道題我幾乎做對了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí wǒ jīhū zuòduì le.
sentences.translation: I almost got this question right.

sentences.chinese: 他几乎不说话。
sentences.traditional: 他幾乎不說話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīhū bù shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: He hardly speaks.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个好机会。
sentences.traditional: 這是一個好機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge hǎo jīhuì.
sentences.translation: This is a good opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 我想给你一个机会。
sentences.traditional: 我想給你一個機會。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ yí ge jīhuì.
sentences.translation: I want to give you an opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 他没有机会去北京。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有機會去北京。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu jīhuì qù Běijīng.
sentences.translation: He has no opportunity to go to Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 这里极安静。
sentences.traditional: 這裡極安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jí ānjìng.
sentences.translation: It is extremely quiet here.

sentences.chinese: 他今天极高兴。
sentences.traditional: 他今天極高興。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān jí gāoxìng.
sentences.translation: He is extremely happy today.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方极美。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方極美。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang jí měi.
sentences.translation: This place is extremely beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 这件事很急，我们现在就去。
sentences.traditional: 這件事很急，我們現在就去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn jí, wǒmen xiànzài jiù qù.
sentences.translation: This matter is urgent, so we should go now.

sentences.chinese: 别急，老师马上来。
sentences.traditional: 別急，老師馬上來。
sentences.pinyin: Bié jí, lǎoshī mǎshàng lái.
sentences.translation: Don't worry, the teacher will be here soon.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很急，一直在看时间。
sentences.traditional: 他看起來很急，一直在看時間。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlai hěn jí, yìzhí zài kàn shíjiān.
sentences.translation: He looks anxious and keeps checking the time.

sentences.chinese: 请记这个号码。
sentences.traditional: 請記這個號碼。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng jì zhège hàomǎ.
sentences.translation: Please remember this number.

sentences.chinese: 我记他的生日。
sentences.traditional: 我記他的生日。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì tā de shēngrì.
sentences.translation: I remember his birthday.

sentences.chinese: 你要记老师说的话。
sentences.traditional: 你要記老師說的話。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yào jì lǎoshī shuō de huà.
sentences.translation: You need to remember what the teacher said.

sentences.chinese: 一年有四季。
sentences.traditional: 一年有四季。
sentences.pinyin: Yì nián yǒu sì jì.
sentences.translation: There are four seasons in a year.

sentences.chinese: 雨季快到了。
sentences.traditional: 雨季快到了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔjì kuài dào le.
sentences.translation: The rainy season is coming soon.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市冬季不太冷。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市冬季不太冷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì dōngjì bú tài lěng.
sentences.translation: The winter season in this city is not very cold.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢春天这个季节。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡春天這個季節。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chūntiān zhège jìjié.
sentences.translation: Spring is my favourite season.

sentences.chinese: 这个季节常常下雨。
sentences.traditional: 這個季節常常下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìjié chángcháng xiàyǔ.
sentences.translation: It often rains in this season.

sentences.chinese: 秋天是很美的季节。
sentences.traditional: 秋天是很美的季節。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān shì hěn měi de jìjié.
sentences.translation: Autumn is a very beautiful season.

sentences.chinese: 请给我的茶加一点糖。
sentences.traditional: 請給我的茶加一點糖。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ de chá jiā yìdiǎn táng.
sentences.translation: Please add a little sugar to my tea.

sentences.chinese: 三加四等于七。
sentences.traditional: 三加四等於七。
sentences.pinyin: Sān jiā sì děngyú qī.
sentences.translation: Three plus four equals seven.

sentences.chinese: 天冷了，我想加一件外套。
sentences.traditional: 天冷了，我想加一件外套。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, wǒ xiǎng jiā yí jiàn wàitào.
sentences.translation: It is cold, and I want to add an extra coat.

sentences.chinese: 假期我想去海边玩。
sentences.traditional: 假期我想去海邊玩。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàqī wǒ xiǎng qù hǎibiān wán.
sentences.translation: I want to go to the seaside during the holiday.

sentences.chinese: 这个假期你有什么计划？
sentences.traditional: 這個假期你有什麼計劃？
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiàqī nǐ yǒu shénme jìhuà?
sentences.translation: What plans do you have for this holiday?

sentences.chinese: 假期结束了，我们明天上课。
sentences.traditional: 假期結束了，我們明天上課。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàqī jiéshù le, wǒmen míngtiān shàngkè.
sentences.translation: The holiday is over, and we have class tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他每天坚持跑步。
sentences.traditional: 他每天堅持跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān jiānchí pǎobù.
sentences.translation: He keeps running every day.

sentences.chinese: 学中文要坚持。
sentences.traditional: 學中文要堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Xué Zhōngwén yào jiānchí.
sentences.translation: You need to persist when learning Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 我会坚持自己的计划。
sentences.traditional: 我會堅持自己的計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huì jiānchí zìjǐ de jìhuà.
sentences.translation: I will stick to my own plan.

sentences.chinese: 医生检查了我的眼睛。
sentences.traditional: 醫生檢查了我的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá le wǒ de yǎnjing.
sentences.translation: The doctor checked my eyes.

sentences.chinese: 出门前请检查门窗。
sentences.traditional: 出門前請檢查門窗。
sentences.pinyin: Chūmén qián qǐng jiǎnchá ménchuāng.
sentences.translation: Please check the doors and windows before going out.

sentences.chinese: 老师正在检查作业。
sentences.traditional: 老師正在檢查作業。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài jiǎnchá zuòyè.
sentences.translation: The teacher is checking the homework.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题很简单。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: This question is simple.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的内容很简单。
sentences.traditional: 這本書的內容很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: The content of this book is very simple.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢简单的生活。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡簡單的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan jiǎndān de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: I like a simple life.

sentences.chinese: 进站前要先检票。
sentences.traditional: 進站前要先檢票。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnzhàn qián yào xiān jiǎnpiào.
sentences.translation: Tickets must be checked before entering the station.

sentences.chinese: 那边有人在检票。
sentences.traditional: 那邊有人在檢票。
sentences.pinyin: Nàbiān yǒu rén zài jiǎnpiào.
sentences.translation: Someone over there is checking tickets.

sentences.chinese: 演出开始前，工作人员会检票。
sentences.traditional: 演出開始前，工作人員會檢票。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnchū kāishǐ qián, gōngzuò rényuán huì jiǎnpiào.
sentences.translation: The staff will check tickets before the performance starts.

sentences.chinese: 他每天运动，所以很健康。
sentences.traditional: 他每天運動，所以很健康。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān yùndòng, suǒyǐ hěn jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: He exercises every day, so he is healthy.

sentences.chinese: 多吃水果对身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 多吃水果對身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Duō chī shuǐguǒ duì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Eating more fruit is good for your health.

sentences.chinese: 我希望爷爷一直健康。
sentences.traditional: 我希望爺爺一直健康。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng yéye yìzhí jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: I hope grandpa stays healthy.

sentences.chinese: 我们明天见面吧。
sentences.traditional: 我們明天見面吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān jiànmiàn ba.
sentences.translation: Let's meet tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次跟老师见面。
sentences.traditional: 他第一次跟老師見面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yí cì gēn lǎoshī jiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: He is meeting the teacher for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 两个人终于见面了。
sentences.traditional: 兩個人終於見面了。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén zhōngyú jiànmiàn le.
sentences.translation: The two people finally met.

sentences.chinese: 请讲中文。
sentences.traditional: 請講中文。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng jiǎng Zhōngwén.
sentences.translation: Please speak Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 老师正在讲故事。
sentences.traditional: 老師正在講故事。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài jiǎng gùshi.
sentences.translation: The teacher is telling a story.

sentences.chinese: 他讲得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 他講得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎng de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: He speaks very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这个面包五角。
sentences.traditional: 這個麵包五角。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège miànbāo wǔ jiǎo.
sentences.translation: This bread costs fifty cents.

sentences.chinese: 这个图形有三个角。
sentences.traditional: 這個圖形有三個角。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège túxíng yǒu sān ge jiǎo.
sentences.translation: This shape has three angles.

sentences.chinese: 一元等于十角。
sentences.traditional: 一元等於十角。
sentences.pinyin: Yì yuán děngyú shí jiǎo.
sentences.translation: One yuan equals ten jiao.

sentences.chinese: 我的脚有点疼。
sentences.traditional: 我的腳有點疼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de jiǎo yǒudiǎn téng.
sentences.translation: My foot hurts a little.

sentences.chinese: 他把脚放在椅子上。
sentences.traditional: 他把腳放在椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiǎo fàng zài yǐzi shàng.
sentences.translation: He put his foot on the chair.

sentences.chinese: 小狗的脚很脏。
sentences.traditional: 小狗的腳很髒。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu de jiǎo hěn zāng.
sentences.translation: The puppy's paws are dirty.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈去学校接孩子。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽去學校接孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Māma qù xuéxiào jiē háizi.
sentences.translation: Mum goes to the school to pick up the child.

sentences.chinese: 你先接电话吧。
sentences.traditional: 你先接電話吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān jiē diànhuà ba.
sentences.translation: Answer the phone first.

sentences.chinese: 他接到了一封邮件。
sentences.traditional: 他接到了一封郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiēdào le yì fēng yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: He received an email.

sentences.chinese: 这条街很安静。
sentences.traditional: 這條街很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: This street is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 我家附近有一条老街。
sentences.traditional: 我家附近有一條老街。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yì tiáo lǎo jiē.
sentences.translation: There is an old street near my home.

sentences.chinese: 街上有很多人。
sentences.traditional: 街上有很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē shàng yǒu hěn duō rén.
sentences.translation: There are many people on the street.

sentences.chinese: 今天有两节课。
sentences.traditional: 今天有兩節課。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu liǎng jié kè.
sentences.translation: There are two lessons today.

sentences.chinese: 第一节是数学课。
sentences.traditional: 第一節是數學課。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī jié shì shùxué kè.
sentences.translation: The first lesson is maths.

sentences.chinese: 儿童节快到了。
sentences.traditional: 兒童節快到了。
sentences.pinyin: Értóngjié kuài dào le.
sentences.translation: Children's Day is coming soon.

sentences.chinese: 他们明年结婚。
sentences.traditional: 他們明年結婚。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen míngnián jiéhūn.
sentences.translation: They will get married next year.

sentences.chinese: 我姐姐已经结婚了。
sentences.traditional: 我姐姐已經結婚了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie yǐjīng jiéhūn le.
sentences.translation: My older sister is already married.

sentences.chinese: 你想在哪儿结婚？
sentences.traditional: 你想在哪兒結婚？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zài nǎr jiéhūn?
sentences.translation: Where do you want to get married?

sentences.chinese: 这个节目很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這個節目很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiémù hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This programme is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 我晚上想看那个节目。
sentences.traditional: 我晚上想看那個節目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wǎnshang xiǎng kàn nàge jiémù.
sentences.translation: I want to watch that programme tonight.

sentences.chinese: 电视上有很多儿童节目。
sentences.traditional: 電視上有很多兒童節目。
sentences.pinyin: Diànshì shàng yǒu hěn duō értóng jiémù.
sentences.translation: There are many children's programmes on TV.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢春节这个节日。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡春節這個節日。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan Chūnjié zhège jiérì.
sentences.translation: My favourite festival is the Spring Festival.

sentences.chinese: 这个节日很热闹。
sentences.traditional: 這個節日很熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiérì hěn rènào.
sentences.translation: This festival is very lively.

sentences.chinese: 学校今天过传统节日。
sentences.traditional: 學校今天過傳統節日。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jīntiān guò chuántǒng jiérì.
sentences.translation: The school is celebrating a traditional festival today.

sentences.chinese: 电影已经结束了。
sentences.traditional: 電影已經結束了。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng yǐjīng jiéshù le.
sentences.translation: The film has already ended.

sentences.chinese: 会议几点结束？
sentences.traditional: 會議幾點結束？
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jǐ diǎn jiéshù?
sentences.translation: What time does the meeting end?

sentences.chinese: 下课以后，比赛就结束了。
sentences.traditional: 下課以後，比賽就結束了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, bǐsài jiù jiéshù le.
sentences.translation: After class, the match will end.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题不容易解决。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題不容易解決。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bù róngyì jiějué.
sentences.translation: This problem is not easy to solve.

sentences.chinese: 我们一起解决这个困难吧。
sentences.traditional: 我們一起解決這個困難吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ jiějué zhège kùnnan ba.
sentences.translation: Let's solve this difficulty together.

sentences.chinese: 老师帮我解决了问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師幫我解決了問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bāng wǒ jiějué le wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher helped me solve the problem.

sentences.chinese: 我有两个姐妹。
sentences.traditional: 我有兩個姐妹。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng ge jiěmèi.
sentences.translation: I have two sisters.

sentences.chinese: 她们是亲姐妹。
sentences.traditional: 她們是親姐妹。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shì qīn jiěmèi.
sentences.translation: They are sisters.

sentences.chinese: 那对姐妹长得很像。
sentences.traditional: 那對姐妹長得很像。
sentences.pinyin: Nà duì jiěmèi zhǎng de hěn xiàng.
sentences.translation: Those sisters look very alike.

sentences.chinese: 我可以借你的笔吗？
sentences.traditional: 我可以借你的筆嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de bǐ ma?
sentences.translation: May I borrow your pen?

sentences.chinese: 他向朋友借了一本书。
sentences.traditional: 他向朋友借了一本書。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng péngyou jiè le yì běn shū.
sentences.translation: He borrowed a book from a friend.

sentences.chinese: 今天我想去图书馆借书。
sentences.traditional: 今天我想去圖書館借書。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ xiǎng qù túshūguǎn jiè shū.
sentences.translation: Today I want to go to the library to borrow books.

sentences.chinese: 这个西瓜有五斤。
sentences.traditional: 這個西瓜有五斤。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xīguā yǒu wǔ jīn.
sentences.translation: This watermelon weighs five jin.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈买了两斤苹果。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽買了兩斤蘋果。
sentences.pinyin: Māma mǎi le liǎng jīn píngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Mum bought two jin of apples.

sentences.chinese: 一斤香蕉多少钱？
sentences.traditional: 一斤香蕉多少錢？
sentences.pinyin: Yì jīn xiāngjiāo duōshao qián?
sentences.translation: How much is one jin of bananas?

sentences.chinese: 我每天都经过这家店。
sentences.traditional: 我每天都經過這家店。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu jīngguò zhè jiā diàn.
sentences.translation: I pass this shop every day.

sentences.chinese: 火车经过了那座桥。
sentences.traditional: 火車經過了那座橋。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē jīngguò le nà zuò qiáo.
sentences.translation: The train passed that bridge.

sentences.chinese: 事情的经过我都知道了。
sentences.traditional: 事情的經過我都知道了。
sentences.pinyin: Shìqing de jīngguò wǒ dōu zhīdào le.
sentences.translation: I know the whole course of what happened.

sentences.chinese: 我们经理今天很忙。
sentences.traditional: 我們經理今天很忙。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jīnglǐ jīntiān hěn máng.
sentences.translation: Our manager is very busy today.

sentences.chinese: 经理正在开会。
sentences.traditional: 經理正在開會。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhèngzài kāihuì.
sentences.translation: The manager is in a meeting.

sentences.chinese: 你可以找经理谈一谈。
sentences.traditional: 你可以找經理談一談。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zhǎo jīnglǐ tán yì tán.
sentences.translation: You can speak with the manager.

sentences.chinese: 我等了你很久。
sentences.traditional: 我等了你很久。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ děng le nǐ hěn jiǔ.
sentences.translation: I waited for you for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 这本书我看了很久。
sentences.traditional: 這本書我看了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.translation: I read this book for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他住在这里很久了。
sentences.traditional: 他住在這裡很久了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhù zài zhèlǐ hěn jiǔ le.
sentences.translation: He has lived here a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他不喝酒。
sentences.traditional: 他不喝酒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù hē jiǔ.
sentences.translation: He doesn't drink alcohol.

sentences.chinese: 这家店卖很多种酒。
sentences.traditional: 這家店賣很多種酒。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng jiǔ.
sentences.translation: This shop sells many kinds of alcohol.

sentences.chinese: 晚饭的时候，爸爸喝了一点酒。
sentences.traditional: 晚飯的時候，爸爸喝了一點酒。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnfàn de shíhou, bàba hē le yìdiǎn jiǔ.
sentences.translation: Dad drank a little alcohol with dinner.

sentences.chinese: 这是一张旧照片。
sentences.traditional: 這是一張舊照片。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yì zhāng jiù zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: This is an old photo.

sentences.chinese: 他还穿着那件旧外套。
sentences.traditional: 他還穿著那件舊外套。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái chuān zhe nà jiàn jiù wàitào.
sentences.translation: He is still wearing that old coat.

sentences.chinese: 我们住在一栋旧房子里。
sentences.traditional: 我們住在一棟舊房子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhù zài yí dòng jiù fángzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: We live in an old house.

sentences.chinese: 我会说几句汉语。
sentences.traditional: 我會說幾句漢語。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō jǐ jù Hànyǔ.
sentences.translation: I can speak a few sentences of Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 这首诗有四句。
sentences.traditional: 這首詩有四句。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī yǒu sì jù.
sentences.translation: This poem has four lines.

sentences.chinese: 请你再读一遍这句。
sentences.traditional: 請你再讀一遍這句。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài dú yí biàn zhè jù.
sentences.translation: Please read this sentence again.

sentences.chinese: 这个句子很简单。
sentences.traditional: 這個句子很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jùzi hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: This sentence is very simple.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我写三个句子。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我寫三個句子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒ xiě sān ge jùzi.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked me to write three sentences.

sentences.chinese: 你能用这个词说一个句子吗？
sentences.traditional: 你能用這個詞說一個句子嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng yòng zhège cí shuō yí ge jùzi ma?
sentences.translation: Can you make a sentence with this word?

sentences.chinese: 我决定明天早起。
sentences.traditional: 我決定明天早起。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng míngtiān zǎoqǐ.
sentences.translation: I decided to get up early tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个重要的决定。
sentences.traditional: 這是一個重要的決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge zhòngyào de juédìng.
sentences.translation: This is an important decision.

sentences.chinese: 你决定好了吗？
sentences.traditional: 你決定好了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ juédìng hǎo le ma?
sentences.translation: Have you decided?

sentences.chinese: 这是我的卡。
sentences.traditional: 這是我的卡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de kǎ.
sentences.translation: This is my card.

sentences.chinese: 请把卡给服务员。
sentences.traditional: 請把卡給服務員。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ kǎ gěi fúwùyuán.
sentences.translation: Please give the card to the waiter.

sentences.chinese: 那张卡已经过期了。
sentences.traditional: 那張卡已經過期了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhāng kǎ yǐjīng guòqī le.
sentences.translation: That card has already expired.

sentences.chinese: 春天来了，树开花了。
sentences.traditional: 春天來了，樹開花了。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, shù kāihuā le.
sentences.translation: Spring has come, and the trees have blossomed.

sentences.chinese: 这些花每年四月开花。
sentences.traditional: 這些花每年四月開花。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē huā měinián sì yuè kāihuā.
sentences.translation: These flowers bloom every April.

sentences.chinese: 花园里的桃树快开花了。
sentences.traditional: 花園裡的桃樹快開花了。
sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ de táoshù kuài kāihuā le.
sentences.translation: The peach trees in the garden are about to bloom.

sentences.chinese: 我们下午要开会。
sentences.traditional: 我們下午要開會。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ yào kāihuì.
sentences.translation: We have a meeting this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 老板正在办公室里开会。
sentences.traditional: 老闆正在辦公室裡開會。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn zhèngzài bàngōngshì lǐ kāihuì.
sentences.translation: The boss is having a meeting in the office.

sentences.chinese: 因为要开会，他来晚了。
sentences.traditional: 因為要開會，他來晚了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi yào kāihuì, tā lái wǎn le.
sentences.translation: He arrived late because he had a meeting.

sentences.chinese: 请先开机。
sentences.traditional: 請先開機。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān kāijī.
sentences.translation: Please turn on the device first.

sentences.chinese: 这台电脑开机很慢。
sentences.traditional: 這臺電腦開機很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo kāijī hěn màn.
sentences.translation: This computer starts up very slowly.

sentences.chinese: 我一开机就看邮件。
sentences.traditional: 我一開機就看郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yì kāijī jiù kàn yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: I check my emails as soon as I turn on the computer.

sentences.chinese: 今天我很开心。
sentences.traditional: 今天我很開心。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ hěn kāixīn.
sentences.translation: I am very happy today.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，大家都很开心。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，大家都很開心。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, dàjiā dōu hěn kāixīn.
sentences.translation: Everyone was happy to hear this news.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在公园玩得很开心。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在公園玩得很開心。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài gōngyuán wán de hěn kāixīn.
sentences.translation: The children had a great time in the park.

sentences.chinese: 看来今天不会下雨。
sentences.traditional: 看來今天不會下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Kànlái jīntiān bú huì xiàyǔ.
sentences.translation: It seems it will not rain today.

sentences.chinese: 他还没来，看来要晚一点。
sentences.traditional: 他還沒來，看來要晚一點。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái méi lái, kànlái yào wǎn yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: He has not arrived yet; it seems he will be a bit late.

sentences.chinese: 看来这个问题不难。
sentences.traditional: 看來這個問題不難。
sentences.pinyin: Kànlái zhège wèntí bù nán.
sentences.translation: It seems this question is not difficult.

sentences.chinese: 我想去，可我今天没时间。
sentences.traditional: 我想去，可我今天沒時間。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù, kě wǒ jīntiān méi shíjiān.
sentences.translation: I want to go, but I do not have time today.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服好看，可有一点贵。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服好看，可有一點貴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hǎokàn, kě yǒu yìdiǎn guì.
sentences.translation: These clothes look nice, but they are a little expensive.

sentences.chinese: 他很累，可还是继续工作。
sentences.traditional: 他很累，可還是繼續工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn lèi, kě háishi jìxù gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He was very tired, yet he kept working.

sentences.chinese: 我跑完步以后很渴。
sentences.traditional: 我跑完步以後很渴。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo wán bù yǐhòu hěn kě.
sentences.translation: I am very thirsty after running.

sentences.chinese: 天气太热了，我觉得很渴。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太熱了，我覺得很渴。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè le, wǒ juéde hěn kě.
sentences.translation: The weather is too hot, and I feel thirsty.

sentences.chinese: 请给我一杯水，我渴了。
sentences.traditional: 請給我一杯水，我渴了。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ, wǒ kě le.
sentences.translation: Please give me a glass of water; I am thirsty.

sentences.chinese: 这个小猫很可爱。
sentences.traditional: 這個小貓很可愛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo māo hěn kě’ài.
sentences.translation: This kitten is very lovely.

sentences.chinese: 她笑起来很可爱。
sentences.traditional: 她笑起來很可愛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào qǐlái hěn kě’ài.
sentences.translation: She looks very lovely when she smiles.

sentences.chinese: 弟弟穿这件衣服很可爱。
sentences.traditional: 弟弟穿這件衣服很可愛。
sentences.pinyin: Dìdi chuān zhè jiàn yīfu hěn kě’ài.
sentences.translation: My little brother looks lovely in these clothes.

sentences.chinese: 我想帮你，可是我不会。
sentences.traditional: 我想幫你，可是我不會。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bāng nǐ, kěshì wǒ bú huì.
sentences.translation: I want to help you, but I cannot.

sentences.chinese: 他来了，可是很快就走了。
sentences.traditional: 他來了，可是很快就走了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lái le, kěshì hěn kuài jiù zǒu le.
sentences.translation: He came, but he left very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 今天是周末，可是我还要上班。
sentences.traditional: 今天是週末，可是我還要上班。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān shì zhōumò, kěshì wǒ hái yào shàngbān.
sentences.translation: It is the weekend, but I still have to work.

sentences.chinese: 现在三点一刻。
sentences.traditional: 現在三點一刻。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài sān diǎn yí kè.
sentences.translation: It is quarter past three now.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子上刻着他的名字。
sentences.traditional: 這張桌子上刻著他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shàng kè zhe tā de míngzi.
sentences.translation: His name is carved on this table.

sentences.chinese: 请在这里刻一个字。
sentences.traditional: 請在這裡刻一個字。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ kè yí ge zì.
sentences.translation: Please carve a character here.

sentences.chinese: 我的课本在书包里。
sentences.traditional: 我的課本在書包裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de kèběn zài shūbāo lǐ.
sentences.translation: My textbook is in my schoolbag.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们打开课本。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們打開課本。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen dǎkāi kèběn.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to open our textbooks.

sentences.chinese: 这本课本很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這本課本很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn kèběn hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This textbook is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 今天家里来了很多客人。
sentences.traditional: 今天家裡來了很多客人。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān jiālǐ lái le hěn duō kèrén.
sentences.translation: A lot of guests came to our home today.

sentences.chinese: 我们请客人先坐下。
sentences.traditional: 我們請客人先坐下。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen qǐng kèrén xiān zuòxia.
sentences.translation: We asked the guests to sit down first.

sentences.chinese: 客人已经到了。
sentences.traditional: 客人已經到了。
sentences.pinyin: Kèrén yǐjīng dào le.
sentences.translation: The guest has already arrived.

sentences.chinese: 今天我们学习新课文。
sentences.traditional: 今天我們學習新課文。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen xuéxí xīn kèwén.
sentences.translation: Today we are studying a new text.

sentences.chinese: 这篇课文不太难。
sentences.traditional: 這篇課文不太難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān kèwén bú tài nán.
sentences.translation: This text is not too difficult.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们读一遍课文。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們讀一遍課文。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen dú yí biàn kèwén.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to read the text once.

sentences.chinese: 夏天我们常开空调。
sentences.traditional: 夏天我們常開空調。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān wǒmen cháng kāi kōngtiáo.
sentences.translation: We often use the air conditioner in summer.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间有空调。
sentences.traditional: 這個房間有空調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān yǒu kōngtiáo.
sentences.translation: This room has air conditioning.

sentences.chinese: 空调坏了，请来看看。
sentences.traditional: 空調壞了，請來看看。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngtiáo huài le, qǐng lái kànkan.
sentences.translation: The air conditioner is broken; please come and take a look.

sentences.chinese: 妹妹摔倒以后哭了。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹摔倒以後哭了。
sentences.pinyin: Mèimei shuāidǎo yǐhòu kū le.
sentences.translation: My younger sister cried after she fell over.

sentences.chinese: 别哭，我来帮你。
sentences.traditional: 別哭，我來幫你。
sentences.pinyin: Bié kū, wǒ lái bāng nǐ.
sentences.translation: Do not cry; I will help you.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，她哭了。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，她哭了。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā kū le.
sentences.translation: She cried when she heard the news.

sentences.chinese: 我不会用筷子。
sentences.traditional: 我不會用筷子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yòng kuàizi.
sentences.translation: I cannot use chopsticks.

sentences.chinese: 请给我一双筷子。
sentences.traditional: 請給我一雙筷子。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì shuāng kuàizi.
sentences.translation: Please give me a pair of chopsticks.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭店的筷子很干净。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店的筷子很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de kuàizi hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: The chopsticks in this restaurant are very clean.

sentences.chinese: 我想买一瓶矿泉水。
sentences.traditional: 我想買一瓶礦泉水。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì píng kuàngquánshuǐ.
sentences.translation: I want to buy a bottle of mineral water.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有两瓶矿泉水。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有兩瓶礦泉水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu liǎng píng kuàngquánshuǐ.
sentences.translation: There are two bottles of mineral water on the table.

sentences.chinese: 天热的时候，我常喝矿泉水。
sentences.traditional: 天熱的時候，我常喝礦泉水。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān rè de shíhou, wǒ cháng hē kuàngquánshuǐ.
sentences.translation: I often drink mineral water when the weather is hot.

sentences.chinese: 我来自英国。
sentences.traditional: 我來自英國。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ láizì Yīngguó.
sentences.translation: I come from the United Kingdom.

sentences.chinese: 这些水果来自中国南方。
sentences.traditional: 這些水果來自中國南方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ láizì Zhōngguó nánfāng.
sentences.translation: These fruits come from southern China.

sentences.chinese: 她说她来自上海。
sentences.traditional: 她說她來自上海。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā láizì Shànghǎi.
sentences.translation: She said she comes from Shanghai.

sentences.chinese: 这个包是蓝的。
sentences.traditional: 這個包是藍的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bāo shì lán de.
sentences.translation: This bag is blue.

sentences.chinese: 今天的天很蓝。
sentences.traditional: 今天的天很藍。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiān hěn lán.
sentences.translation: The sky is very blue today.

sentences.chinese: 她买了一条蓝裙子。
sentences.traditional: 她買了一條藍裙子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì tiáo lán qúnzi.
sentences.translation: She bought a blue skirt.

sentences.chinese: 这座房子很老。
sentences.traditional: 這座房子很老。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò fángzi hěn lǎo.
sentences.translation: This house is very old.

sentences.chinese: 老王是我爸爸的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 老王是我爸爸的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Wáng shì wǒ bàba de péngyou.
sentences.translation: Lao Wang is my dad's friend.

sentences.chinese: 他老迟到。
sentences.traditional: 他老遲到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǎo chídào.
sentences.translation: He is always late.

sentences.chinese: 公园里有很多老人。
sentences.traditional: 公園裡有很多老人。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō lǎorén.
sentences.translation: There are many elderly people in the park.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该帮助老人。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該幫助老人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi bāngzhù lǎorén.
sentences.translation: We should help elderly people.

sentences.chinese: 那位老人每天早上散步。
sentences.traditional: 那位老人每天早上散步。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎorén měitiān zǎoshang sànbù.
sentences.translation: That elderly person goes for a walk every morning.

sentences.chinese: 他已经离开学校了。
sentences.traditional: 他已經離開學校了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng líkāi xuéxiào le.
sentences.translation: He has already left school.

sentences.chinese: 请不要太早离开。
sentences.traditional: 請不要太早離開。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng búyào tài zǎo líkāi.
sentences.translation: Please do not leave too early.

sentences.chinese: 火车快开了，我们要离开了。
sentences.traditional: 火車快開了，我們要離開了。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē kuài kāi le, wǒmen yào líkāi le.
sentences.translation: The train is leaving soon, so we have to go.

sentences.chinese: 这是妈妈给我的礼物。
sentences.traditional: 這是媽媽給我的禮物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì māma gěi wǒ de lǐwù.
sentences.translation: This is a gift from my mum.

sentences.chinese: 生日的时候，他收到很多礼物。
sentences.traditional: 生日的時候，他收到很多禮物。
sentences.pinyin: Shēngrì de shíhou, tā shōudào hěn duō lǐwù.
sentences.translation: He received many gifts on his birthday.

sentences.chinese: 我想给老师买一份礼物。
sentences.traditional: 我想給老師買一份禮物。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi lǎoshī mǎi yí fèn lǐwù.
sentences.translation: I want to buy a gift for the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 我很喜欢学历史。
sentences.traditional: 我很喜歡學歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan xué lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: I really like studying history.

sentences.chinese: 这本书讲中国历史。
sentences.traditional: 這本書講中國歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎng Zhōngguó lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: This book talks about Chinese history.

sentences.chinese: 历史老师今天给我们讲了一个故事。
sentences.traditional: 歷史老師今天給我們講了一個故事。
sentences.pinyin: Lìshǐ lǎoshī jīntiān gěi wǒmen jiǎng le yí ge gùshi.
sentences.translation: The history teacher told us a story today.

sentences.chinese: 他洗完脸就出门了。
sentences.traditional: 他洗完臉就出門了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐ wán liǎn jiù chūmén le.
sentences.translation: He went out after washing his face.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子的脸红红的。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子的臉紅紅的。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi de liǎn hónghóng de.
sentences.translation: The child's face is rosy.

sentences.chinese: 别用手摸脸。
sentences.traditional: 別用手摸臉。
sentences.pinyin: Bié yòng shǒu mō liǎn.
sentences.translation: Do not touch your face with your hand.

sentences.chinese: 我每天练汉字。
sentences.traditional: 我每天練漢字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān liàn Hànzì.
sentences.translation: I practise Chinese characters every day.

sentences.chinese: 他在学校练足球。
sentences.traditional: 他在學校練足球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào liàn zúqiú.
sentences.translation: He practises football at school.

sentences.chinese: 这个动作要多练。
sentences.traditional: 這個動作要多練。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dòngzuò yào duō liàn.
sentences.translation: You need to practise this movement more.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们练习发音。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們練習發音。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen liànxí fàyīn.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to practise pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 我每天练习写汉字。
sentences.traditional: 我每天練習寫漢字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān liànxí xiě Hànzì.
sentences.translation: I practise writing Chinese characters every day.

sentences.chinese: 这本书里有很多练习。
sentences.traditional: 這本書裡有很多練習。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū lǐ yǒu hěn duō liànxí.
sentences.translation: There are many exercises in this book.

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上很凉快。
sentences.traditional: 今天晚上很涼快。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang hěn liángkuai.
sentences.translation: It is pleasantly cool tonight.

sentences.chinese: 秋天的风很凉快。
sentences.traditional: 秋天的風很涼快。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān de fēng hěn liángkuai.
sentences.translation: The autumn wind is nice and cool.

sentences.chinese: 这间房子真凉快。
sentences.traditional: 這間房子真涼快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiān fángzi zhēn liángkuai.
sentences.translation: This room is really cool.

sentences.chinese: 门口停着一辆车。
sentences.traditional: 門口停著一輛車。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu tíngzhe yí liàng chē.
sentences.translation: There is a car parked at the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车是新的。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車是新的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē shì xīn de.
sentences.translation: This car is new.

sentences.chinese: 停车场里有三辆车。
sentences.traditional: 停車場裡有三輛車。
sentences.pinyin: Tíngchēchǎng lǐ yǒu sān liàng chē.
sentences.translation: There are three cars in the car park.

sentences.chinese: 我们晚饭后聊了一会儿。
sentences.traditional: 我們晚飯後聊了一會兒。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎnfàn hòu liáo le yíhuìr.
sentences.translation: We chatted for a while after dinner.

sentences.chinese: 她喜欢跟朋友聊电影。
sentences.traditional: 她喜歡跟朋友聊電影。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan gēn péngyou liáo diànyǐng.
sentences.translation: She likes chatting about films with friends.

sentences.chinese: 他想跟老师聊这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 他想跟老師聊這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gēn lǎoshī liáo zhège wèntí.
sentences.translation: He wants to chat with the teacher about this question.

sentences.chinese: 他们在门口聊天儿。
sentences.traditional: 他們在門口聊天兒。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài ménkǒu liáotiānr.
sentences.translation: They are chatting at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 晚上我们坐在一起聊天儿。
sentences.traditional: 晚上我們坐在一起聊天兒。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen zuò zài yìqǐ liáotiānr.
sentences.translation: In the evening we sit together and chat.

sentences.chinese: 她喜欢和同学聊天儿。
sentences.traditional: 她喜歡和同學聊天兒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan hé tóngxué liáotiānr.
sentences.translation: She likes chatting with her classmates.

sentences.chinese: 我想先了解一下情况。
sentences.traditional: 我想先了解一下情況。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān liǎojiě yíxià qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: I want to understand the situation first.

sentences.chinese: 你了解这个问题吗？
sentences.traditional: 你了解這個問題嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ liǎojiě zhège wèntí ma?
sentences.translation: Do you understand this problem?

sentences.chinese: 老师很了解学生的需要。
sentences.traditional: 老師很了解學生的需要。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn liǎojiě xuésheng de xūyào.
sentences.translation: The teacher understands the students' needs very well.

sentences.chinese: 我的邻居很友好。
sentences.traditional: 我的鄰居很友好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de línjū hěn yǒuhǎo.
sentences.translation: My neighbour is very friendly.

sentences.chinese: 我们常跟邻居打招呼。
sentences.traditional: 我們常跟鄰居打招呼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen cháng gēn línjū dǎ zhāohu.
sentences.translation: We often greet our neighbours.

sentences.chinese: 邻居家有一只小狗。
sentences.traditional: 鄰居家有一隻小狗。
sentences.pinyin: Línjū jiā yǒu yì zhī xiǎogǒu.
sentences.translation: Our neighbour has a little dog.

sentences.chinese: 他明年想去英国留学。
sentences.traditional: 他明年想去英國留學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míngnián xiǎng qù Yīngguó liúxué.
sentences.translation: He wants to go to the UK to study abroad next year.

sentences.chinese: 姐姐在日本留学。
sentences.traditional: 姐姐在日本留學。
sentences.pinyin: Jiějie zài Rìběn liúxué.
sentences.translation: My older sister is studying abroad in Japan.

sentences.chinese: 留学以前，他先学日语。
sentences.traditional: 留學以前，他先學日語。
sentences.pinyin: Liúxué yǐqián, tā xiān xué Rìyǔ.
sentences.translation: Before studying abroad, he first learned Japanese.

sentences.chinese: 学校里有很多留学生。
sentences.traditional: 學校裡有很多留學生。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào lǐ yǒu hěn duō liúxuéshēng.
sentences.translation: There are many overseas students at the school.

sentences.chinese: 那个留学生来自韩国。
sentences.traditional: 那個留學生來自韓國。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge liúxuéshēng láizì Hánguó.
sentences.translation: That overseas student comes from Korea.

sentences.chinese: 我哥哥以前是留学生。
sentences.traditional: 我哥哥以前是留學生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēge yǐqián shì liúxuéshēng.
sentences.translation: My older brother used to be an overseas student.

sentences.chinese: 我们慢慢走上楼梯。
sentences.traditional: 我們慢慢走上樓梯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen mànmàn zǒu shàng lóutī.
sentences.translation: We slowly walk up the stairs.

sentences.chinese: 楼梯旁边有一盆花。
sentences.traditional: 樓梯旁邊有一盆花。
sentences.pinyin: Lóutī pángbiān yǒu yì pén huā.
sentences.translation: There is a pot of flowers beside the stairs.

sentences.chinese: 小猫坐在楼梯上。
sentences.traditional: 小貓坐在樓梯上。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomāo zuò zài lóutī shàng.
sentences.translation: The kitten is sitting on the stairs.

sentences.chinese: 路边停着一辆车。
sentences.traditional: 路邊停著一輛車。
sentences.pinyin: Lùbiān tíngzhe yí liàng chē.
sentences.translation: There is a car parked by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 路边有一家小店。
sentences.traditional: 路邊有一家小店。
sentences.pinyin: Lùbiān yǒu yì jiā xiǎodiàn.
sentences.translation: There is a small shop by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 请不要站在路边玩。
sentences.traditional: 請不要站在路邊玩。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng búyào zhàn zài lùbiān wán.
sentences.translation: Please do not stand by the roadside and play.

sentences.chinese: 前面那个路口左转。
sentences.traditional: 前面那個路口左轉。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánmiàn nàge lùkǒu zuǒzhuǎn.
sentences.translation: Turn left at that intersection ahead.

sentences.chinese: 我们在路口见面吧。
sentences.traditional: 我們在路口見面吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài lùkǒu jiànmiàn ba.
sentences.translation: Let's meet at the intersection.

sentences.chinese: 路口有很多人等车。
sentences.traditional: 路口有很多人等車。
sentences.pinyin: Lùkǒu yǒu hěn duō rén děng chē.
sentences.translation: Many people are waiting for the bus at the intersection.

sentences.chinese: 这匹马跑得很快。
sentences.traditional: 這匹馬跑得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pǐ mǎ pǎo de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: This horse runs very fast.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们喜欢看马。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們喜歡看馬。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan kàn mǎ.
sentences.translation: The children like looking at horses.

sentences.chinese: 农场里有两匹马。
sentences.traditional: 農場裡有兩匹馬。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu liǎng pǐ mǎ.
sentences.translation: There are two horses on the farm.

sentences.chinese: 马路上有很多车。
sentences.traditional: 馬路上有很多車。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎlù shàng yǒu hěn duō chē.
sentences.translation: There are many cars on the road.

sentences.chinese: 小狗跑到了马路中间。
sentences.traditional: 小狗跑到了馬路中間。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu pǎo dào le mǎlù zhōngjiān.
sentences.translation: The little dog ran into the middle of the road.

sentences.chinese: 我马上回来。
sentences.traditional: 我馬上回來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎshàng huílai.
sentences.translation: I will be back immediately.

sentences.chinese: 请你马上给妈妈打电话。
sentences.traditional: 請你馬上給媽媽打電話。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ mǎshàng gěi māma dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.translation: Please call Mum immediately.

sentences.chinese: 老师马上就到了。
sentences.traditional: 老師馬上就到了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī mǎshàng jiù dào le.
sentences.translation: The teacher will arrive very soon.

sentences.chinese: 我对这个礼物很满意。
sentences.traditional: 我對這個禮物很滿意。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhège lǐwù hěn mǎnyì.
sentences.translation: I am very satisfied with this gift.

sentences.chinese: 经理对他的工作很满意。
sentences.traditional: 經理對他的工作很滿意。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ duì tā de gōngzuò hěn mǎnyì.
sentences.translation: The manager is very satisfied with his work.

sentences.chinese: 你对现在的结果满意吗？
sentences.traditional: 你對現在的結果滿意嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ duì xiànzài de jiéguǒ mǎnyì ma?
sentences.translation: Are you satisfied with the result now?

sentences.chinese: 这个苹果五毛钱。
sentences.traditional: 這個蘋果五毛錢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ wǔ máo qián.
sentences.translation: This apple costs fifty cents.

sentences.chinese: 这只狗的毛很长。
sentences.traditional: 這隻狗的毛很長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī gǒu de máo hěn cháng.
sentences.translation: This dog's fur is very long.

sentences.chinese: 我身上没有一毛钱。
sentences.traditional: 我身上沒有一毛錢。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shēnshang méiyǒu yì máo qián.
sentences.translation: I do not have a penny on me.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子有两米长。
sentences.traditional: 這張桌子有兩米長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi yǒu liǎng mǐ cháng.
sentences.translation: This table is two metres long.

sentences.chinese: 他跳了三米远。
sentences.traditional: 他跳了三米遠。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tiào le sān mǐ yuǎn.
sentences.translation: He jumped three metres.

sentences.chinese: 我家离学校不到一百米。
sentences.traditional: 我家離學校不到一百米。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào bú dào yì bǎi mǐ.
sentences.translation: My home is less than one hundred metres from the school.

sentences.chinese: 老师站在大家面前。
sentences.traditional: 老師站在大家面前。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhàn zài dàjiā miànqián.
sentences.translation: The teacher is standing in front of everyone.

sentences.chinese: 我面前有一杯热茶。
sentences.traditional: 我面前有一杯熱茶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ miànqián yǒu yì bēi rè chá.
sentences.translation: There is a cup of hot tea in front of me.

sentences.chinese: 孩子跑到妈妈面前。
sentences.traditional: 孩子跑到媽媽面前。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi pǎo dào māma miànqián.
sentences.translation: The child ran up in front of Mum.

sentences.chinese: 我明白你的意思了。
sentences.traditional: 我明白你的意思了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ míngbai nǐ de yìsi le.
sentences.translation: I understand what you mean.

sentences.chinese: 这件事很明白。
sentences.traditional: 這件事很明白。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn míngbai.
sentences.translation: This matter is clear.

sentences.chinese: 你明白这个问题吗？
sentences.traditional: 你明白這個問題嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ míngbai zhège wèntí ma?
sentences.translation: Do you understand this question?

sentences.chinese: 名单上有十个人。
sentences.traditional: 名單上有十個人。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng yǒu shí ge rén.
sentences.translation: There are ten people on the name list.

sentences.chinese: 请把名字写在名单上。
sentences.traditional: 請把名字寫在名單上。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ míngzi xiě zài míngdān shàng.
sentences.translation: Please write your name on the name list.

sentences.chinese: 老师正在看名单。
sentences.traditional: 老師正在看名單。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài kàn míngdān.
sentences.translation: The teacher is looking at the name list.

sentences.chinese: 这个名人常上电视。
sentences.traditional: 這個名人常上電視。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège míngrén cháng shàng diànshì.
sentences.translation: This famous person is often on television.

sentences.chinese: 那位名人会唱歌。
sentences.traditional: 那位名人會唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi míngrén huì chànggē.
sentences.translation: That famous person can sing.

sentences.chinese: 孩子想和名人拍照。
sentences.traditional: 孩子想和名人拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi xiǎng hé míngrén pāizhào.
sentences.translation: The child wants to take a photo with the famous person.

sentences.chinese: 南在地图的下面。
sentences.traditional: 南在地圖的下面。
sentences.pinyin: Nán zài dìtú de xiàmian.
sentences.translation: South is at the bottom of the map.

sentences.chinese: 风从南边吹来。
sentences.traditional: 風從南邊吹來。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng cóng nánbian chuī lái.
sentences.translation: The wind blows from the south.

sentences.chinese: 我们往南走吧。
sentences.traditional: 我們往南走吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎng nán zǒu ba.
sentences.translation: Let us walk south.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题很难。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題很難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn nán.
sentences.translation: This question is difficult.

sentences.chinese: 数学对他来说很难。
sentences.traditional: 數學對他來說很難。
sentences.pinyin: Shùxué duì tā lái shuō hěn nán.
sentences.translation: Mathematics is difficult for him.

sentences.chinese: 这件事不难。
sentences.traditional: 這件事不難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù nán.
sentences.translation: This matter is not difficult.

sentences.chinese: 南方冬天不太冷。
sentences.traditional: 南方冬天不太冷。
sentences.pinyin: Nánfāng dōngtiān bú tài lěng.
sentences.translation: The south is not very cold in winter.

sentences.chinese: 他来自中国南方。
sentences.traditional: 他來自中國南方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā láizì Zhōngguó nánfāng.
sentences.translation: He comes from southern China.

sentences.chinese: 我们明年去南方旅行。
sentences.traditional: 我們明年去南方旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen míngnián qù nánfāng lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: We will travel to the south next year.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，我很难过。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，我很難過。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ hěn nánguò.
sentences.translation: I felt very sad when I heard this news.

sentences.chinese: 别太难过了。
sentences.traditional: 別太難過了。
sentences.pinyin: Bié tài nánguò le.
sentences.translation: Do not be too sad.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来有点难过。
sentences.traditional: 他看起來有點難過。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànqilai yǒudiǎn nánguò.
sentences.translation: He looks a bit sad.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服有点难看。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服有點難看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎn nánkàn.
sentences.translation: These clothes are a bit ugly.

sentences.chinese: 他的字太难看了。
sentences.traditional: 他的字太難看了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zì tài nánkàn le.
sentences.translation: His handwriting is too ugly.

sentences.chinese: 这个颜色不难看。
sentences.traditional: 這個顏色不難看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yánsè bù nánkàn.
sentences.translation: This colour is not ugly.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人是我爸爸。
sentences.traditional: 那個男人是我爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén shì wǒ bàba.
sentences.translation: That man is my dad.

sentences.chinese: 门口站着一个男人。
sentences.traditional: 門口站著一個男人。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu zhànzhe yí ge nánrén.
sentences.translation: A man is standing at the door.

sentences.chinese: 那两个男人在聊天。
sentences.traditional: 那兩個男人在聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Nà liǎng ge nánrén zài liáotiān.
sentences.translation: Those two men are chatting.

sentences.chinese: 班里有二十个男生。
sentences.traditional: 班裡有二十個男生。
sentences.pinyin: Bān lǐ yǒu èrshí ge nánshēng.
sentences.translation: There are twenty boy students in the class.

sentences.chinese: 那个男生跑得很快。
sentences.traditional: 那個男生跑得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng pǎo de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: That boy student runs very fast.

sentences.chinese: 老师请男生先进去。
sentences.traditional: 老師請男生先進去。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī qǐng nánshēng xiān jìnqù.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the boy students to go in first.

sentences.chinese: 这道数学难题很难。
sentences.traditional: 這道數學難題很難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào shùxué nántí hěn nán.
sentences.translation: This maths problem is difficult.

sentences.chinese: 老师帮我们解决了这个难题。
sentences.traditional: 老師幫我們解決了這個難題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bāng wǒmen jiějué le zhège nántí.
sentences.translation: The teacher helped us solve this difficult problem.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个工作上的难题。
sentences.traditional: 這是一個工作上的難題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge gōngzuò shàng de nántí.
sentences.translation: This is a difficult problem at work.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌不难听。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌不難聽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē bù nántīng.
sentences.translation: This song is not unpleasant to hear.

sentences.chinese: 他说话太难听了。
sentences.traditional: 他說話太難聽了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà tài nántīng le.
sentences.translation: What he said was too unpleasant.

sentences.chinese: 这个名字有点难听。
sentences.traditional: 這個名字有點難聽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège míngzi yǒudiǎn nántīng.
sentences.translation: This name sounds a bit unpleasant.

sentences.chinese: 我弟弟上三年级。
sentences.traditional: 我弟弟上三年級。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi shàng sān niánjí.
sentences.translation: My younger brother is in third grade.

sentences.chinese: 你儿子在几年级？
sentences.traditional: 你兒子在幾年級？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ érzi zài jǐ niánjí?
sentences.translation: What grade is your son in?

sentences.chinese: 我们学校每个年级都有四个班。
sentences.traditional: 我們學校每個年級都有四個班。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào měi ge niánjí dōu yǒu sì ge bān.
sentences.translation: Every grade in our school has four classes.

sentences.chinese: 她很年轻。
sentences.traditional: 她很年輕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn niánqīng.
sentences.translation: She is very young.

sentences.chinese: 这个老师看起来很年轻。
sentences.traditional: 這個老師看起來很年輕。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège lǎoshī kànqilai hěn niánqīng.
sentences.translation: This teacher looks very young.

sentences.chinese: 年轻的时候，我喜欢旅游。
sentences.traditional: 年輕的時候，我喜歡旅遊。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan lǚyóu.
sentences.translation: When I was young, I liked travelling.

sentences.chinese: 那头牛在吃草。
sentences.traditional: 那頭牛在吃草。
sentences.pinyin: Nà tóu niú zài chī cǎo.
sentences.translation: That cow is eating grass.

sentences.chinese: 农场里有很多牛。
sentences.traditional: 農場裡有很多牛。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō niú.
sentences.translation: There are many cows on the farm.

sentences.chinese: 这头牛很大。
sentences.traditional: 這頭牛很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tóu niú hěn dà.
sentences.translation: This cow is very big.

sentences.chinese: 你要努力学习。
sentences.traditional: 你要努力學習。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yào nǔlì xuéxí.
sentences.translation: You need to study hard.

sentences.chinese: 他很努力，所以进步很快。
sentences.traditional: 他很努力，所以進步很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ jìnbù hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: He is hardworking, so he improves quickly.

sentences.chinese: 只要努力，就会成功。
sentences.traditional: 只要努力，就會成功。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǔlì, jiù huì chénggōng.
sentences.translation: As long as you work hard, you will succeed.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人是我妈妈的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 那個女人是我媽媽的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚrén shì wǒ māma de péngyou.
sentences.translation: That woman is my mum’s friend.

sentences.chinese: 这个女人很聪明。
sentences.traditional: 這個女人很聰明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nǚrén hěn cōngming.
sentences.translation: This woman is very clever.

sentences.chinese: 门口有一个女人在等你。
sentences.traditional: 門口有一個女人在等你。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu yǒu yí ge nǚrén zài děng nǐ.
sentences.translation: There is a woman waiting for you at the door.

sentences.chinese: 班里有十五个女生。
sentences.traditional: 班裡有十五個女生。
sentences.pinyin: Bān lǐ yǒu shíwǔ ge nǚshēng.
sentences.translation: There are fifteen girl students in the class.

sentences.chinese: 那个女生唱歌很好听。
sentences.traditional: 那個女生唱歌很好聽。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng chànggē hěn hǎotīng.
sentences.translation: That girl student sings very well.

sentences.chinese: 老师让女生先坐下。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓女生先坐下。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng nǚshēng xiān zuòxia.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the girl students to sit down first.

sentences.chinese: 小猫会爬树。
sentences.traditional: 小貓會爬樹。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomāo huì pá shù.
sentences.translation: The kitten can climb trees.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢地爬上山。
sentences.traditional: 他慢慢地爬上山。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mànmàn de pá shàng shān.
sentences.translation: He slowly climbed up the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子喜欢爬楼梯。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子喜歡爬樓梯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi xǐhuan pá lóutī.
sentences.translation: This child likes climbing stairs.

sentences.chinese: 我不怕狗。
sentences.traditional: 我不怕狗。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù pà gǒu.
sentences.translation: I am not afraid of dogs.

sentences.chinese: 她怕晚上一个人出去。
sentences.traditional: 她怕晚上一個人出去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pà wǎnshang yí ge rén chūqù.
sentences.translation: She is afraid of going out alone at night.

sentences.chinese: 你怕不怕冷？
sentences.traditional: 你怕不怕冷？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ pà bu pà lěng?
sentences.translation: Are you afraid of the cold?

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢用手机拍照。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡用手機拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yòng shǒujī pāizhào.
sentences.translation: I like taking photos with my phone.

sentences.chinese: 这里很漂亮，我们一起拍照吧。
sentences.traditional: 這裡很漂亮，我們一起拍照吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ hěn piàoliang, wǒmen yìqǐ pāizhào ba.
sentences.translation: It is beautiful here; let’s take a photo together.

sentences.chinese: 他正在给孩子们拍照。
sentences.traditional: 他正在給孩子們拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài gěi háizimen pāizhào.
sentences.translation: He is taking photos of the children.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有两个盘子。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有兩個盤子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu liǎng ge pánzi.
sentences.translation: There are two plates on the table.

sentences.chinese: 请把水果放在盘子里。
sentences.traditional: 請把水果放在盤子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shuǐguǒ fàng zài pánzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please put the fruit on the plate.

sentences.chinese: 这个盘子很干净。
sentences.traditional: 這個盤子很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège pánzi hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: This plate is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 这只猫有点胖。
sentences.traditional: 這隻貓有點胖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo yǒudiǎn pàng.
sentences.translation: This cat is a bit fat.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候很胖。
sentences.traditional: 他小時候很胖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou hěn pàng.
sentences.translation: He was very fat when he was little.

sentences.chinese: 太胖对身体不好。
sentences.traditional: 太胖對身體不好。
sentences.pinyin: Tài pàng duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
sentences.translation: Being too fat is not good for your health.

sentences.chinese: 他不喝啤酒。
sentences.traditional: 他不喝啤酒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù hē píjiǔ.
sentences.translation: He does not drink beer.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸买了两瓶啤酒。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸買了兩瓶啤酒。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba mǎi le liǎng píng píjiǔ.
sentences.translation: Dad bought two bottles of beer.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭店有冷啤酒。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店有冷啤酒。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn yǒu lěng píjiǔ.
sentences.translation: This restaurant has cold beer.

sentences.chinese: 我平时六点起床。
sentences.traditional: 我平時六點起床。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ píngshí liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
sentences.translation: I usually get up at six.

sentences.chinese: 她平时喜欢看书。
sentences.traditional: 她平時喜歡看書。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píngshí xǐhuan kàn shū.
sentences.translation: She usually likes reading.

sentences.chinese: 平时这里很安静。
sentences.traditional: 平時這裡很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Píngshí zhèlǐ hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: It is usually quiet here.

sentences.chinese: 桌上有一个空瓶子。
sentences.traditional: 桌上有一個空瓶子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu yí ge kōng píngzi.
sentences.translation: There is an empty bottle on the table.

sentences.chinese: 请把水倒进瓶子里。
sentences.traditional: 請把水倒進瓶子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shuǐ dào jìn píngzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please pour the water into the bottle.

sentences.chinese: 这个瓶子是玻璃做的。
sentences.traditional: 這個瓶子是玻璃做的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège píngzi shì bōli zuò de.
sentences.translation: This bottle is made of glass.

sentences.chinese: 他每天骑自行车上班。
sentences.traditional: 他每天騎自行車上班。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān qí zìxíngchē shàngbān.
sentences.translation: He rides a bicycle to work every day.

sentences.chinese: 你会骑马吗？
sentences.traditional: 你會騎馬嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ huì qí mǎ ma?
sentences.translation: Can you ride a horse?

sentences.chinese: 孩子们喜欢骑车去学校。
