sentences.traditional: 孩子們喜歡騎車去學校。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan qí chē qù xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: The children like riding bikes to school.

sentences.chinese: 这个声音很奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 這個聲音很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shēngyīn hěn qíguài.
sentences.translation: This sound is very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他今天看起来有点奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 他今天看起來有點奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān kànqilai yǒudiǎn qíguài.
sentences.translation: He looks a bit strange today.

sentences.chinese: 我觉得这件事很奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 我覺得這件事很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè jiàn shì hěn qíguài.
sentences.translation: I think this matter is very strange.

sentences.chinese: 其实，我已经知道了。
sentences.traditional: 其實，我已經知道了。
sentences.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒ yǐjīng zhīdào le.
sentences.translation: Actually, I already know.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很忙，其实今天很有空。
sentences.traditional: 他看起來很忙，其實今天很有空。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànqilai hěn máng, qíshí jīntiān hěn yǒu kòng.
sentences.translation: He looks busy, but actually he is quite free today.

sentences.chinese: 这道题不难，其实很简单。
sentences.traditional: 這道題不難，其實很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí bù nán, qíshí hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: This question is not hard; actually it is very simple.

sentences.chinese: 你还有其他问题吗？
sentences.traditional: 你還有其他問題嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ hái yǒu qítā wèntí ma?
sentences.translation: Do you have any other questions?

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢蓝色，不喜欢其他颜色。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡藍色，不喜歡其他顏色。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan lánsè, bù xǐhuan qítā yánsè.
sentences.translation: I like blue and do not like other colours.

sentences.chinese: 除了这本书，我没有其他的。
sentences.traditional: 除了這本書，我沒有其他的。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle zhè běn shū, wǒ méiyǒu qítā de.
sentences.translation: Apart from this book, I do not have any others.

sentences.chinese: 我每天六点起。
sentences.traditional: 我每天六點起。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān liù diǎn qǐ.
sentences.translation: I get up at six every day.

sentences.chinese: 孩子已经起了，不在床上。
sentences.traditional: 孩子已經起了，不在床上。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yǐjīng qǐ le, bù zài chuáng shàng.
sentences.translation: The child is already up and not in bed.

sentences.chinese: 这起事故很突然。
sentences.traditional: 這起事故很突然。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè qǐ shìgù hěn tūrán.
sentences.translation: This incident was very sudden.

sentences.chinese: 飞机马上要起飞了。
sentences.traditional: 飛機馬上要起飛了。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī mǎshàng yào qǐfēi le.
sentences.translation: The plane is about to take off.

sentences.chinese: 这架飞机准时起飞。
sentences.traditional: 這架飛機準時起飛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jià fēijī zhǔnshí qǐfēi.
sentences.translation: This plane took off on time.

sentences.chinese: 火箭已经成功起飞。
sentences.traditional: 火箭已經成功起飛。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒjiàn yǐjīng chénggōng qǐfēi.
sentences.translation: The rocket has already taken off successfully.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸开汽车去上班。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸開汽車去上班。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba kāi qìchē qù shàngbān.
sentences.translation: Dad drives a car to work.

sentences.chinese: 路边停着一辆红色的汽车。
sentences.traditional: 路邊停著一輛紅色的汽車。
sentences.pinyin: Lùbiān tíngzhe yí liàng hóngsè de qìchē.
sentences.translation: A red car is parked by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 这辆汽车很新。
sentences.traditional: 這輛汽車很新。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng qìchē hěn xīn.
sentences.translation: This car is very new.

sentences.chinese: 我用铅笔写字。
sentences.traditional: 我用鉛筆寫字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yòng qiānbǐ xiězì.
sentences.translation: I write with a pencil.

sentences.chinese: 桌上有三支铅笔。
sentences.traditional: 桌上有三支鉛筆。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu sān zhī qiānbǐ.
sentences.translation: There are three pencils on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这支铅笔不太长。
sentences.traditional: 這支鉛筆不太長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiānbǐ bù tài cháng.
sentences.translation: This pencil is not very long.

sentences.chinese: 我前年去了北京。
sentences.traditional: 我前年去了北京。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qiánnián qù le Běijīng.
sentences.translation: I went to Beijing the year before last.

sentences.chinese: 前年我们买了这套房子。
sentences.traditional: 前年我們買了這套房子。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánnián wǒmen mǎi le zhè tào fángzi.
sentences.translation: We bought this house the year before last.

sentences.chinese: 他前年开始学汉语。
sentences.traditional: 他前年開始學漢語。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiánnián kāishǐ xué Hànyǔ.
sentences.translation: He started learning Chinese the year before last.

sentences.chinese: 我前天见过他。
sentences.traditional: 我前天見過他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qiántiān jiàn guo tā.
sentences.translation: I saw him the day before yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 前天下了一整天雨。
sentences.traditional: 前天下了一整天雨。
sentences.pinyin: Qiántiān xià le yì zhěng tiān yǔ.
sentences.translation: It rained all day the day before yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 前天你为什么没来？
sentences.traditional: 前天你為什麼沒來？
sentences.pinyin: Qiántiān nǐ wèishénme méi lái?
sentences.translation: Why did you not come the day before yesterday?

sentences.chinese: 老师说得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 老師說得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The teacher explained it very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 我听得不太清楚。
sentences.traditional: 我聽得不太清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng de bù tài qīngchu.
sentences.translation: I could not hear very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 现在我清楚你的意思了。
sentences.traditional: 現在我清楚你的意思了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ qīngchu nǐ de yìsi le.
sentences.translation: Now I understand what you mean.

sentences.chinese: 我今天要请假。
sentences.traditional: 我今天要請假。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yào qǐngjià.
sentences.translation: I need to ask for leave today.

sentences.chinese: 他因为生病请假了。
sentences.traditional: 他因為生病請假了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shēngbìng qǐngjià le.
sentences.translation: He asked for leave because he was ill.

sentences.chinese: 你请假的时候要告诉老师。
sentences.traditional: 你請假的時候要告訴老師。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ qǐngjià de shíhou yào gàosu lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: When you ask for leave, you need to tell the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 今天我请客。
sentences.traditional: 今天我請客。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè.
sentences.translation: Today it is my treat.

sentences.chinese: 他想请客吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 他想請客吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐngkè chīfàn.
sentences.translation: He wants to treat everyone to a meal.

sentences.chinese: 这次是爸爸请客。
sentences.traditional: 這次是爸爸請客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shì bàba qǐngkè.
sentences.translation: This time Dad is paying.

sentences.chinese: 秋天天气很凉快。
sentences.traditional: 秋天天氣很涼快。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān tiānqì hěn liángkuai.
sentences.translation: The weather is very cool in autumn.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢秋天。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡秋天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan qiūtiān.
sentences.translation: Autumn is my favourite season.

sentences.chinese: 秋天的树叶会变黄。
sentences.traditional: 秋天的樹葉會變黃。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān de shùyè huì biànhuáng.
sentences.translation: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.

sentences.chinese: 我们下午去球场打篮球。
sentences.traditional: 我們下午去球場打籃球。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ qù qiúchǎng dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.translation: We are going to the court to play basketball this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 学校后面有一个大球场。
sentences.traditional: 學校後面有一個大球場。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào hòumiàn yǒu yí ge dà qiúchǎng.
sentences.translation: There is a big sports field behind the school.

sentences.chinese: 球场上有很多学生。
sentences.traditional: 球場上有很多學生。
sentences.pinyin: Qiúchǎng shàng yǒu hěn duō xuéshēng.
sentences.translation: There are many students on the sports field.

sentences.chinese: 这条裙子很漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 這條裙子很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang.
sentences.translation: This skirt is very pretty.

sentences.chinese: 妹妹今天穿了一条新裙子。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹今天穿了一條新裙子。
sentences.pinyin: Mèimei jīntiān chuān le yì tiáo xīn qúnzi.
sentences.translation: My younger sister is wearing a new skirt today.

sentences.chinese: 商店里有红色的裙子。
sentences.traditional: 商店裡有紅色的裙子。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn lǐ yǒu hóngsè de qúnzi.
sentences.translation: There are red skirts in the shop.

sentences.chinese: 我先写作业，然后出去玩。
sentences.traditional: 我先寫作業，然後出去玩。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiān xiě zuòyè, ránhòu chūqù wán.
sentences.translation: I do my homework first and then go out to play.

sentences.chinese: 他喝了水，然后继续跑步。
sentences.traditional: 他喝了水，然後繼續跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hē le shuǐ, ránhòu jìxù pǎobù.
sentences.translation: He drank some water and then kept running.

sentences.chinese: 然后老师开始上课。
sentences.traditional: 然後老師開始上課。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu lǎoshī kāishǐ shàngkè.
sentences.translation: Then the teacher started the lesson.

sentences.chinese: 他对客人很热情。
sentences.traditional: 他對客人很熱情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì kèrén hěn rèqíng.
sentences.translation: He is very warm towards guests.

sentences.chinese: 这里的人都很热情。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的人都很熱情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rén dōu hěn rèqíng.
sentences.translation: The people here are all very friendly.

sentences.chinese: 她热情地欢迎我们。
sentences.traditional: 她熱情地歡迎我們。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rèqíng de huānyíng wǒmen.
sentences.translation: She welcomed us warmly.

sentences.chinese: 你还认得我吗？
sentences.traditional: 你還認得我嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ hái rènde wǒ ma?
sentences.translation: Do you still recognise me?

sentences.chinese: 我认得那位老师。
sentences.traditional: 我認得那位老師。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ rènde nà wèi lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: I know that teacher.

sentences.chinese: 他认得很多汉字。
sentences.traditional: 他認得很多漢字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènde hěn duō Hànzì.
sentences.translation: He recognises many Chinese characters.

sentences.chinese: 我认为这个办法很好。
sentences.traditional: 我認為這個辦法很好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi zhège bànfǎ hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: I think this method is very good.

sentences.chinese: 老师认为他很认真。
sentences.traditional: 老師認為他很認真。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi tā hěn rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: The teacher thinks he is very serious.

sentences.chinese: 你认为谁会赢？
sentences.traditional: 你認為誰會贏？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ rènwéi shéi huì yíng?
sentences.translation: Who do you think will win?

sentences.chinese: 她学习很认真。
sentences.traditional: 她學習很認真。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuéxí hěn rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: She studies very seriously.

sentences.chinese: 做作业的时候要认真。
sentences.traditional: 做作業的時候要認真。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò zuòyè de shíhou yào rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: You should be serious when doing homework.

sentences.chinese: 他认真地听老师讲话。
sentences.traditional: 他認真地聽老師講話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènzhēn de tīng lǎoshī jiǎnghuà.
sentences.translation: He listens carefully to the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 这本书很容易。
sentences.traditional: 這本書很容易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn róngyì.
sentences.translation: This book is easy.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题不容易回答。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題不容易回答。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bù róngyì huídá.
sentences.translation: This question is not easy to answer.

sentences.chinese: 学汉语不容易。
sentences.traditional: 學漢語不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Xué Hànyǔ bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: Learning Chinese is not easy.

sentences.chinese: 如果明天下雨，我就不去。
sentences.traditional: 如果明天下雨，我就不去。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒ jiù bú qù.
sentences.translation: If it rains tomorrow, I will not go.

sentences.chinese: 如果你有时间，请来我家。
sentences.traditional: 如果你有時間，請來我家。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu shíjiān, qǐng lái wǒ jiā.
sentences.translation: If you have time, please come to my house.

sentences.chinese: 如果他来了，我们就开始。
sentences.traditional: 如果他來了，我們就開始。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā lái le, wǒmen jiù kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: If he comes, we will start.

sentences.chinese: 今天下雨了，别忘了带伞。
sentences.traditional: 今天下雨了，別忘了帶傘。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàyǔ le, bié wàng le dài sǎn.
sentences.translation: It is raining today, do not forget to take an umbrella.

sentences.chinese: 这把伞是黑色的。
sentences.traditional: 這把傘是黑色的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ sǎn shì hēisè de.
sentences.translation: This umbrella is black.

sentences.chinese: 门口有两把伞。
sentences.traditional: 門口有兩把傘。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu yǒu liǎng bǎ sǎn.
sentences.translation: There are two umbrellas by the door.

sentences.chinese: 我每天早上扫地。
sentences.traditional: 我每天早上掃地。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang sǎo dì.
sentences.translation: I sweep the floor every morning.

sentences.chinese: 请你把房间扫一下。
sentences.traditional: 請你把房間掃一下。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ fángjiān sǎo yíxià.
sentences.translation: Please sweep the room.

sentences.chinese: 他正在门口扫雪。
sentences.traditional: 他正在門口掃雪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài ménkǒu sǎo xuě.
sentences.translation: He is sweeping snow at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 客厅里有一张大沙发。
sentences.traditional: 客廳裡有一張大沙發。
sentences.pinyin: Kètīng lǐ yǒu yì zhāng dà shāfā.
sentences.translation: There is a big sofa in the living room.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸坐在沙发上看电视。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸坐在沙發上看電視。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba zuò zài shāfā shàng kàn diànshì.
sentences.translation: Dad is sitting on the sofa watching TV.

sentences.chinese: 这张沙发很舒服。
sentences.traditional: 這張沙發很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng shāfā hěn shūfu.
sentences.translation: This sofa is very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 那座山很高。
sentences.traditional: 那座山很高。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zuò shān hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: That mountain is very high.

sentences.chinese: 我们周末去爬山。
sentences.traditional: 我們週末去爬山。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò qù pá shān.
sentences.translation: We are going mountain climbing at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 山上有很多树。
sentences.traditional: 山上有很多樹。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shàng yǒu hěn duō shù.
sentences.translation: There are many trees on the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这件上衣是蓝色的。
sentences.traditional: 這件上衣是藍色的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shàngyī shì lánsè de.
sentences.translation: This top is blue.

sentences.chinese: 我想买一件新上衣。
sentences.traditional: 我想買一件新上衣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn xīn shàngyī.
sentences.translation: I want to buy a new top.

sentences.chinese: 你的上衣放在椅子上。
sentences.traditional: 你的上衣放在椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de shàngyī fàng zài yǐzi shàng.
sentences.translation: Your jacket is on the chair.

sentences.chinese: 请给我一把勺子。
sentences.traditional: 請給我一把勺子。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bǎ sháozi.
sentences.translation: Please give me a spoon.

sentences.chinese: 他用勺子喝汤。
sentences.traditional: 他用勺子喝湯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng sháozi hē tāng.
sentences.translation: He uses a spoon to drink soup.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有两个勺子。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有兩個勺子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu liǎng gè sháozi.
sentences.translation: There are two spoons on the table.

sentences.chinese: 我妈妈一直在我身边。
sentences.traditional: 我媽媽一直在我身邊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ māma yìzhí zài wǒ shēnbiān.
sentences.translation: My mum is always by my side.

sentences.chinese: 请把手机放在身边。
sentences.traditional: 請把手機放在身邊。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shǒujī fàng zài shēnbiān.
sentences.translation: Please keep your phone by your side.

sentences.chinese: 他坐在老师身边。
sentences.traditional: 他坐在老師身邊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò zài lǎoshī shēnbiān.
sentences.translation: He sits beside the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 他的身高是一米八。
sentences.traditional: 他的身高是一米八。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēngāo shì yì mǐ bā.
sentences.translation: His height is 1.8 metres.

sentences.chinese: 医生问了我的身高和体重。
sentences.traditional: 醫生問了我的身高和體重。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng wèn le wǒ de shēngāo hé tǐzhòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor asked about my height and weight.

sentences.chinese: 这个表上写着孩子的身高。
sentences.traditional: 這個表上寫著孩子的身高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège biǎo shàng xiě zhe háizi de shēngāo.
sentences.translation: This chart shows the child’s height.

sentences.chinese: 门外传来一声猫叫。
sentences.traditional: 門外傳來一聲貓叫。
sentences.pinyin: Ménwài chuánlái yì shēng māojiào.
sentences.translation: A cat’s cry came from outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 老师叫了我一声。
sentences.traditional: 老師叫了我一聲。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiào le wǒ yì shēng.
sentences.translation: The teacher called out to me once.

sentences.chinese: 请小声一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 請小聲一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiǎo shēng yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: Please be a bit quieter.

sentences.chinese: 这里的生活很安静。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的生活很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de shēnghuó hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: Life here is very peaceful.

sentences.chinese: 他喜欢乡村生活。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡鄉村生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan xiāngcūn shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: He likes country life.

sentences.chinese: 我们在北京生活了三年。
sentences.traditional: 我們在北京生活了三年。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài Běijīng shēnghuó le sān nián.
sentences.translation: We lived in Beijing for three years.

sentences.chinese: 你不要生气。
sentences.traditional: 你不要生氣。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ búyào shēngqì.
sentences.translation: Do not get angry.

sentences.chinese: 妹妹因为这件事生气了。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹因為這件事生氣了。
sentences.pinyin: Mèimei yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì shēngqì le.
sentences.translation: My younger sister got angry because of this.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有生气。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有生氣。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu shēngqì.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not get angry.

sentences.chinese: 我听见外面有奇怪的声音。
sentences.traditional: 我聽見外面有奇怪的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn wàimiàn yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: I heard a strange sound outside.

sentences.chinese: 这个声音很小。
sentences.traditional: 這個聲音很小。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shēngyīn hěn xiǎo.
sentences.translation: This sound is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 请把电视的声音关小一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 請把電視的聲音關小一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ diànshì de shēngyīn guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: Please turn the TV sound down a little.

sentences.chinese: 这个市不大，但是很干净。
sentences.traditional: 這個市不大，但是很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shì bú dà, dànshì hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: This city is not big, but it is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 我们市有很多公园。
sentences.traditional: 我們市有很多公園。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen shì yǒu hěn duō gōngyuán.
sentences.translation: Our city has many parks.

sentences.chinese: 他在市里工作。
sentences.traditional: 他在市裡工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài shìli gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He works in the city.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服你可以试一下。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服你可以試一下。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu nǐ kěyǐ shì yíxià.
sentences.translation: You can try this item of clothing on.

sentences.chinese: 我想试做中国菜。
sentences.traditional: 我想試做中國菜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shì zuò Zhōngguó cài.
sentences.translation: I want to try cooking Chinese food.

sentences.chinese: 你先试，再告诉我。
sentences.traditional: 你先試，再告訴我。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān shì, zài gàosu wǒ.
sentences.translation: Try first, then tell me.

sentences.chinese: 教室里很安静。
sentences.traditional: 教室裡很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: The classroom is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 会议室在二楼。
sentences.traditional: 會議室在二樓。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì zài èr lóu.
sentences.translation: The meeting room is on the second floor.

sentences.chinese: 他回到办公室了。
sentences.traditional: 他回到辦公室了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huídào bàngōngshì le.
sentences.translation: He returned to the office.

sentences.chinese: 世界很大。
sentences.traditional: 世界很大。
sentences.pinyin: Shìjiè hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The world is big.

sentences.chinese: 我想看看外面的世界。
sentences.traditional: 我想看看外面的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kànkan wàimiàn de shìjiè.
sentences.translation: I want to see the outside world.

sentences.chinese: 这是世界地图。
sentences.traditional: 這是世界地圖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì shìjiè dìtú.
sentences.translation: This is a world map.

sentences.chinese: 我收到了你的信。
sentences.traditional: 我收到了你的信。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le nǐ de xìn.
sentences.translation: I received your letter.

sentences.chinese: 他在门口收快递。
sentences.traditional: 他在門口收快遞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài ménkǒu shōu kuàidì.
sentences.translation: He receives a parcel at the door.

sentences.chinese: 请先把衣服收起来。
sentences.traditional: 請先把衣服收起來。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān bǎ yīfu shōu qǐlai.
sentences.translation: Please put the clothes away first.

sentences.chinese: 我昨天收到了你的邮件。
sentences.traditional: 我昨天收到了你的郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān shōudào le nǐ de yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: I received your email yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 你收到我的消息了吗？
sentences.traditional: 你收到我的消息了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shōudào wǒ de xiāoxi le ma?
sentences.translation: Did you receive my message?

sentences.chinese: 他已经收到那本书了。
sentences.traditional: 他已經收到那本書了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng shōudào nà běn shū le.
sentences.translation: He has already received that book.

sentences.chinese: 他很受欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 他很受歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn shòu huānyíng.
sentences.translation: He is very popular.

sentences.chinese: 这些花受天气影响很大。
sentences.traditional: 這些花受天氣影響很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē huā shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
sentences.translation: These flowers are greatly affected by the weather.

sentences.chinese: 她小时候受过很好的教育。
sentences.traditional: 她小時候受過很好的教育。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou shòuguo hěn hǎo de jiàoyù.
sentences.translation: She received a very good education when she was little.

sentences.chinese: 他最近瘦了很多。
sentences.traditional: 他最近瘦了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn shòu le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: He has got much thinner lately.

sentences.chinese: 这只猫太瘦了。
sentences.traditional: 這隻貓太瘦了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo tài shòu le.
sentences.translation: This cat is too thin.

sentences.chinese: 你看起来比以前瘦了。
sentences.traditional: 你看起來比以前瘦了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kànqǐlai bǐ yǐqián shòu le.
sentences.translation: You look thinner than before.

sentences.chinese: 他受到了大家的帮助。
sentences.traditional: 他受到了大家的幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shòudào le dàjiā de bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: He received everyone's help.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方受到了污染。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方受到了污染。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang shòudào le wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: This place has been polluted.

sentences.chinese: 她的想法受到了支持。
sentences.traditional: 她的想法受到了支持。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ shòudào le zhīchí.
sentences.translation: Her idea received support.

sentences.chinese: 我叔叔会开车。
sentences.traditional: 我叔叔會開車。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu huì kāichē.
sentences.translation: My uncle can drive.

sentences.chinese: 叔叔今天来看我们。
sentences.traditional: 叔叔今天來看我們。
sentences.pinyin: Shūshu jīntiān lái kàn wǒmen.
sentences.translation: My uncle is coming to see us today.

sentences.chinese: 那个叔叔在门口等你。
sentences.traditional: 那個叔叔在門口等你。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shūshu zài ménkǒu děng nǐ.
sentences.translation: That uncle is waiting for you at the door.

sentences.chinese: 院子里有一棵大树。
sentences.traditional: 院子裡有一棵大樹。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ yǒu yì kē dà shù.
sentences.translation: There is a big tree in the yard.

sentences.chinese: 那棵树很高。
sentences.traditional: 那棵樹很高。
sentences.pinyin: Nà kē shù hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: That tree is very tall.

sentences.chinese: 秋天的时候，树叶会变黄。
sentences.traditional: 秋天的時候，樹葉會變黃。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān de shíhou, shùyè huì biàn huáng.
sentences.translation: In autumn, the leaves turn yellow.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢数学。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡數學。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan shùxué.
sentences.translation: I like mathematics most.

sentences.chinese: 我们今天有数学课。
sentences.traditional: 我們今天有數學課。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yǒu shùxué kè.
sentences.translation: We have maths today.

sentences.chinese: 数学不难，但是要认真学。
sentences.traditional: 數學不難，但是要認真學。
sentences.pinyin: Shùxué bù nán, dànshì yào rènzhēn xué.
sentences.translation: Mathematics is not difficult, but you need to study it seriously.

sentences.chinese: 你先刷牙，再睡觉。
sentences.traditional: 你先刷牙，再睡覺。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān shuā yá, zài shuìjiào.
sentences.translation: Brush your teeth first, then go to sleep.

sentences.chinese: 他在厨房刷盘子。
sentences.traditional: 他在廚房刷盤子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chúfáng shuā pánzi.
sentences.translation: He is scrubbing plates in the kitchen.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈正在刷地。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽正在刷地。
sentences.pinyin: Māma zhèngzài shuā dì.
sentences.translation: Mum is scrubbing the floor.

sentences.chinese: 我买了一双新鞋。
sentences.traditional: 我買了一雙新鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yì shuāng xīn xié.
sentences.translation: I bought a new pair of shoes.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一双筷子。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有一雙筷子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì shuāng kuàizi.
sentences.translation: There is a pair of chopsticks on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他有一双大眼睛。
sentences.traditional: 他有一雙大眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǒu yì shuāng dà yǎnjing.
sentences.translation: He has a pair of big eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他的中文水平很高。
sentences.traditional: 他的中文水平很高。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: His Chinese level is very high.

sentences.chinese: 我的游泳水平一般。
sentences.traditional: 我的游泳水平一般。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de yóuyǒng shuǐpíng yìbān.
sentences.translation: My swimming level is average.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭店的服务水平不错。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店的服務水平不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de fúwù shuǐpíng búcuò.
sentences.translation: This restaurant’s service standard is not bad.

sentences.chinese: 司机请我们上车。
sentences.traditional: 司機請我們上車。
sentences.pinyin: Sījī qǐng wǒmen shàngchē.
sentences.translation: The driver asked us to get in.

sentences.chinese: 那位司机开得很慢。
sentences.traditional: 那位司機開得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi sījī kāi de hěn màn.
sentences.translation: That driver drives very slowly.

sentences.chinese: 我爸爸以前是司机。
sentences.traditional: 我爸爸以前是司機。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bàba yǐqián shì sījī.
sentences.translation: My dad used to be a driver.

sentences.chinese: 中国北方四季分明。
sentences.traditional: 中國北方四季分明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó běifāng sìjì fēnmíng.
sentences.translation: The four seasons are distinct in northern China.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢四季里的春天。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡四季裡的春天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan sìjì lǐ de chūntiān.
sentences.translation: I like spring most out of the four seasons.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方四季都很美。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方四季都很美。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang sìjì dōu hěn měi.
sentences.translation: This place is beautiful in all four seasons.

sentences.chinese: 今天太阳很大。
sentences.traditional: 今天太陽很大。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān tàiyáng hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The sun is very strong today.

sentences.chinese: 太阳出来了。
sentences.traditional: 太陽出來了。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng chūlai le.
sentences.translation: The sun has come out.

sentences.chinese: 小猫在太阳下睡觉。
sentences.traditional: 小貓在太陽下睡覺。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomāo zài tàiyáng xià shuìjiào.
sentences.translation: The kitten is sleeping in the sun.

sentences.chinese: 这杯咖啡里没有糖。
sentences.traditional: 這杯咖啡裡沒有糖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bēi kāfēi lǐ méiyǒu táng.
sentences.translation: There is no sugar in this coffee.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子都喜欢吃糖。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子都喜歡吃糖。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi dōu xǐhuan chī táng.
sentences.translation: Children all like eating sweets.

sentences.chinese: 请少放一点儿糖。
sentences.traditional: 請少放一點兒糖。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng shǎo fàng yìdiǎnr táng.
sentences.translation: Please put in a little less sugar.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方特别安静。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方特別安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang tèbié ānjìng.
sentences.translation: This place is especially quiet.

sentences.chinese: 今天的菜特别好吃。
sentences.traditional: 今天的菜特別好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de cài tèbié hǎochī.
sentences.translation: Today's food is particularly tasty.

sentences.chinese: 她穿了一件特别漂亮的裙子。
sentences.traditional: 她穿了一件特別漂亮的裙子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān le yí jiàn tèbié piàoliang de qúnzi.
sentences.translation: She is wearing an especially pretty skirt.

sentences.chinese: 我想提高我的中文水平。
sentences.traditional: 我想提高我的中文水平。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tígāo wǒ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: I want to improve my Chinese level.

sentences.chinese: 多练习可以提高成绩。
sentences.traditional: 多練習可以提高成績。
sentences.pinyin: Duō liànxí kěyǐ tígāo chéngjì.
sentences.translation: More practice can improve grades.

sentences.chinese: 老师希望我们提高写字速度。
sentences.traditional: 老師希望我們提高寫字速度。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xīwàng wǒmen tígāo xiězì sùdù.
sentences.translation: The teacher hopes we can increase our writing speed.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢体育课。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡體育課。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan tǐyù kè.
sentences.translation: PE is my favourite class.

sentences.chinese: 下午我们要上体育。
sentences.traditional: 下午我們要上體育。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒmen yào shàng tǐyù.
sentences.translation: We have PE this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 体育对身体很好。
sentences.traditional: 體育對身體很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tǐyù duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Physical education is good for the body.

sentences.chinese: 学校旁边有一个体育馆。
sentences.traditional: 學校旁邊有一個體育館。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yí ge tǐyùguǎn.
sentences.translation: There is a gymnasium next to the school.

sentences.chinese: 我们常去体育馆打篮球。
sentences.traditional: 我們常去體育館打籃球。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen cháng qù tǐyùguǎn dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.translation: We often go to the gymnasium to play basketball.

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上体育馆很热闹。
sentences.traditional: 今天晚上體育館很熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang tǐyùguǎn hěn rènào.
sentences.translation: The gymnasium is lively tonight.

sentences.chinese: 我不喜欢太甜的饮料。
sentences.traditional: 我不喜歡太甜的飲料。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan tài tián de yǐnliào.
sentences.translation: I don't like drinks that are too sweet.

sentences.chinese: 她做的点心又香又甜。
sentences.traditional: 她做的點心又香又甜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò de diǎnxin yòu xiāng yòu tián.
sentences.translation: The snacks she made are fragrant and sweet.

sentences.chinese: 小狗高兴得跳了起来。
sentences.traditional: 小狗高興得跳了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu gāoxìng de tiào le qǐlai.
sentences.translation: The puppy jumped up happily.

sentences.chinese: 他每天跳绳半个小时。
sentences.traditional: 他每天跳繩半個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān tiào shéng bàn ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: He skips rope for half an hour every day.

sentences.chinese: 别在床上跳。
sentences.traditional: 別在床上跳。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zài chuáng shàng tiào.
sentences.translation: Don't jump on the bed.

sentences.chinese: 我听说他下个月要结婚。
sentences.traditional: 我聽說他下個月要結婚。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō tā xià ge yuè yào jiéhūn.
sentences.translation: I heard he is getting married next month.

sentences.chinese: 听说今天会下雨。
sentences.traditional: 聽說今天會下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō jīntiān huì xiàyǔ.
sentences.translation: I heard it will rain today.

sentences.chinese: 你听说过这个地方吗？
sentences.traditional: 你聽說過這個地方嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ tīngshuō guo zhège dìfang ma?
sentences.translation: Have you heard of this place?

sentences.chinese: 这本书挺有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這本書挺有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tǐng yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This book is quite interesting.

sentences.chinese: 今天天气挺冷的。
sentences.traditional: 今天天氣挺冷的。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì tǐng lěng de.
sentences.translation: The weather is quite cold today.

sentences.chinese: 她说中文说得挺好。
sentences.traditional: 她說中文說得挺好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō Zhōngwén shuō de tǐng hǎo.
sentences.translation: She speaks Chinese quite well.

sentences.chinese: 他是我的新同事。
sentences.traditional: 他是我的新同事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ de xīn tóngshì.
sentences.translation: He is my new colleague.

sentences.chinese: 我跟同事一起吃午饭。
sentences.traditional: 我跟同事一起吃午飯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngshì yìqǐ chī wǔfàn.
sentences.translation: I eat lunch with my colleague.

sentences.chinese: 那些同事都很热情。
sentences.traditional: 那些同事都很熱情。
sentences.pinyin: Nàxiē tóngshì dōu hěn rèqíng.
sentences.translation: Those colleagues are all very enthusiastic.

sentences.chinese: 我同意你的想法。
sentences.traditional: 我同意你的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: I agree with your idea.

sentences.chinese: 老板不同意我们请假。
sentences.traditional: 老闆不同意我們請假。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bù tóngyì wǒmen qǐngjià.
sentences.translation: The boss doesn't agree to let us take leave.

sentences.chinese: 如果你同意，我们就开始吧。
sentences.traditional: 如果你同意，我們就開始吧。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ tóngyì, wǒmen jiù kāishǐ ba.
sentences.translation: If you agree, let's start.

sentences.chinese: 我今天想剪头发。
sentences.traditional: 我今天想剪頭髮。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān xiǎng jiǎn tóufa.
sentences.translation: I want to cut my hair today.

sentences.chinese: 他的头发有点白了。
sentences.traditional: 他的頭髮有點白了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tóufa yǒudiǎn bái le.
sentences.translation: His hair is a bit white already.

sentences.chinese: 天空突然下起雨来。
sentences.traditional: 天空突然下起雨來。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ yǔ lái.
sentences.translation: It suddenly started to rain.

sentences.chinese: 他突然站起来了。
sentences.traditional: 他突然站起來了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán zhàn qǐlái le.
sentences.translation: He suddenly stood up.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想起那件事。
sentences.traditional: 我突然想起那件事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎng qǐ nà jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: I suddenly remembered that matter.

sentences.chinese: 学校旁边有一个图书馆。
sentences.traditional: 學校旁邊有一個圖書館。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yí ge túshūguǎn.
sentences.translation: There is a library next to the school.

sentences.chinese: 我周末常去图书馆看书。
sentences.traditional: 我週末常去圖書館看書。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò cháng qù túshūguǎn kàn shū.
sentences.translation: I often go to the library to read on weekends.

sentences.chinese: 图书馆里很安静。
sentences.traditional: 圖書館裡很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Túshūguǎn lǐ hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: It is very quiet in the library.

sentences.chinese: 她的腿受伤了。
sentences.traditional: 她的腿受傷了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tuǐ shòushāng le.
sentences.translation: Her leg is injured.

sentences.chinese: 我跑步以后腿很酸。
sentences.traditional: 我跑步以後腿很酸。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎobù yǐhòu tuǐ hěn suān.
sentences.translation: My legs are sore after running.

sentences.chinese: 这只狗的腿很短。
sentences.traditional: 這隻狗的腿很短。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī gǒu de tuǐ hěn duǎn.
sentences.translation: This dog's legs are short.

sentences.chinese: 他在外地工作。
sentences.traditional: 他在外地工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài wàidì gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He works out of town.

sentences.chinese: 我妈妈去外地出差了。
sentences.traditional: 我媽媽去外地出差了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ māma qù wàidì chūchāi le.
sentences.translation: My mum went out of town on a business trip.

sentences.chinese: 这个菜不是本地的，是从外地来的。
sentences.traditional: 這個菜不是本地的，是從外地來的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cài bú shì běndì de, shì cóng wàidì lái de.
sentences.translation: This vegetable is not local; it came from another place.

sentences.chinese: 今天太累了，我们点外卖吧。
sentences.traditional: 今天太累了，我們點外賣吧。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān tài lèi le, wǒmen diǎn wàimài ba.
sentences.translation: We are too tired today, so let's order takeaway.

sentences.chinese: 这家外卖来得很快。
sentences.traditional: 這家外賣來得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā wàimài lái de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: This takeaway arrived quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他每天中午都吃外卖。
sentences.traditional: 他每天中午都吃外賣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān zhōngwǔ dōu chī wàimài.
sentences.translation: He eats takeaway every lunchtime.

sentences.chinese: 她会说两种外语。
sentences.traditional: 她會說兩種外語。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huì shuō liǎng zhǒng wàiyǔ.
sentences.translation: She can speak two foreign languages.

sentences.chinese: 学好一门外语不容易。
sentences.traditional: 學好一門外語不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Xué hǎo yì mén wàiyǔ bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: It is not easy to learn a foreign language well.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的外语是汉语。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡的外語是漢語。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de wàiyǔ shì Hànyǔ.
sentences.translation: My favourite foreign language is Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 我已经完成作业了。
sentences.traditional: 我已經完成作業了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng wánchéng zuòyè le.
sentences.translation: I have already finished my homework.

sentences.chinese: 他终于完成了这个工作。
sentences.traditional: 他終於完成了這個工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He finally completed this work.

sentences.chinese: 请你今天完成这件事。
sentences.traditional: 請你今天完成這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jīntiān wánchéng zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: Please complete this matter today.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有两个碗。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有兩個碗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu liǎng ge wǎn.
sentences.translation: There are two bowls on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这个碗很漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 這個碗很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎn hěn piàoliang.
sentences.translation: This bowl is very pretty.

sentences.chinese: 她把碗洗干净了。
sentences.traditional: 她把碗洗乾淨了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǎn xǐ gānjìng le.
sentences.translation: She washed the bowl clean.

sentences.chinese: 火车今天晚点了。
sentences.traditional: 火車今天晚點了。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē jīntiān wǎndiǎn le.
sentences.translation: The train is late today.

sentences.chinese: 因为下雨，飞机可能晚点。
sentences.traditional: 因為下雨，飛機可能晚點。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, fēijī kěnéng wǎndiǎn.
sentences.translation: Because of the rain, the plane may be delayed.

sentences.chinese: 他晚点到也没关系。
sentences.traditional: 他晚點到也沒關係。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wǎndiǎn dào yě méi guānxi.
sentences.translation: It's okay if he arrives a bit late.

sentences.chinese: 学校晚上有一个晚会。
sentences.traditional: 學校晚上有一個晚會。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wǎnshang yǒu yí ge wǎnhuì.
sentences.translation: There is an evening party at the school tonight.

sentences.chinese: 我们要为晚会准备节目。
sentences.traditional: 我們要為晚會準備節目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào wèi wǎnhuì zhǔnbèi jiémù.
sentences.translation: We need to prepare a programme for the evening party.

sentences.chinese: 晚会八点开始。
sentences.traditional: 晚會八點開始。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnhuì bā diǎn kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: The evening party starts at eight.

sentences.chinese: 他每个星期都打网球。
sentences.traditional: 他每個星期都打網球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi ge xīngqī dōu dǎ wǎngqiú.
sentences.translation: He plays tennis every week.

sentences.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢看网球比赛。
sentences.traditional: 我妹妹喜歡看網球比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei xǐhuan kàn wǎngqiú bǐsài.
sentences.translation: My younger sister likes watching tennis matches.

sentences.chinese: 网球很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 網球很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngqiú hěn yǒuyìsi.
sentences.translation: Tennis is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 这个网站很容易用。
sentences.traditional: 這個網站很容易用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn hěn róngyì yòng.
sentences.translation: This website is easy to use.

sentences.chinese: 你可以在网站上买票。
sentences.traditional: 你可以在網站上買票。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài wǎngzhàn shàng mǎi piào.
sentences.translation: You can buy tickets on the website.

sentences.chinese: 我昨天看了那个网站。
sentences.traditional: 我昨天看了那個網站。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān kàn le nàge wǎngzhàn.
sentences.translation: I looked at that website yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 我忘记带钥匙了。
sentences.traditional: 我忘記帶鑰匙了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wàngjì dài yàoshi le.
sentences.translation: I forgot to bring my keys.

sentences.chinese: 请不要忘记写名字。
sentences.traditional: 請不要忘記寫名字。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng búyào wàngjì xiě míngzi.
sentences.translation: Please do not forget to write your name.

sentences.chinese: 他忘记今天要开会。
sentences.traditional: 他忘記今天要開會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wàngjì jīntiān yào kāihuì.
sentences.translation: He forgot that there is a meeting today.

sentences.chinese: 这是为你准备的礼物。
sentences.traditional: 這是為你準備的禮物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wèi nǐ zhǔnbèi de lǐwù.
sentences.translation: This is a gift prepared for you.

sentences.chinese: 大家都为他高兴。
sentences.traditional: 大家都為他高興。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu wèi tā gāoxìng.
sentences.translation: Everyone is happy for him.

sentences.chinese: 我为妈妈买了一束花。
sentences.traditional: 我為媽媽買了一束花。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèi māma mǎi le yí shù huā.
sentences.translation: I bought a bunch of flowers for my mum.

sentences.chinese: 为了身体健康，他每天跑步。
sentences.traditional: 為了身體健康，他每天跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, tā měitiān pǎobù.
sentences.translation: He runs every day for his health.

sentences.chinese: 为了早点到，我们六点出发。
sentences.traditional: 為了早點到，我們六點出發。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile zǎodiǎn dào, wǒmen liù diǎn chūfā.
sentences.translation: In order to arrive early, we set off at six.

sentences.chinese: 她为了考试认真复习。
sentences.traditional: 她為了考試認真複習。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèile kǎoshì rènzhēn fùxí.
sentences.translation: She revised seriously for the exam.

sentences.chinese: 卫生间在楼梯旁边。
sentences.traditional: 衛生間在樓梯旁邊。
sentences.pinyin: Wèishēngjiān zài lóutī pángbiān.
sentences.translation: The bathroom is beside the stairs.

sentences.chinese: 我想先去一下卫生间。
sentences.traditional: 我想先去一下衛生間。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān qù yíxià wèishēngjiān.
sentences.translation: I want to go to the bathroom first.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭店的卫生间很干净。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店的衛生間很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de wèishēngjiān hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: The bathroom in this restaurant is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 我对中国文化很有兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 我對中國文化很有興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà hěn yǒu xìngqù.
sentences.translation: I am very interested in Chinese culture.

sentences.chinese: 每个国家都有自己的文化。
sentences.traditional: 每個國家都有自己的文化。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu zìjǐ de wénhuà.
sentences.translation: Every country has its own culture.

sentences.chinese: 学语言也要了解文化。
sentences.traditional: 學語言也要了解文化。
sentences.pinyin: Xué yǔyán yě yào liǎojiě wénhuà.
sentences.translation: When learning a language, you also need to understand the culture.

sentences.chinese: 这个屋子很小。
sentences.traditional: 這個屋子很小。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wūzi hěn xiǎo.
sentences.translation: This room is small.

sentences.chinese: 屋子里有一张桌子。
sentences.traditional: 屋子裡有一張桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Wūzi lǐ yǒu yì zhāng zhuōzi.
sentences.translation: There is a table in the room.

sentences.chinese: 他们把屋子打扫干净了。
sentences.traditional: 他們把屋子打掃乾淨了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bǎ wūzi dǎsǎo gānjìng le.
sentences.translation: They cleaned the room.

sentences.chinese: 地图上左边是西。
sentences.traditional: 地圖上左邊是西。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng zuǒbiān shì xī.
sentences.translation: On a map, the left side is west.

sentences.chinese: 这边是东，那边是西。
sentences.traditional: 這邊是東，那邊是西。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèbiān shì dōng, nàbiān shì xī.
sentences.translation: This side is east, and that side is west.

sentences.chinese: 我们一直往西走。
sentences.traditional: 我們一直往西走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìzhí wǎng xī zǒu.
sentences.translation: We keep going west.

sentences.chinese: 我家在学校的西北边。
sentences.traditional: 我家在學校的西北邊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài xuéxiào de xīběi biān.
sentences.translation: My home is to the northwest of the school.

sentences.chinese: 风从西北吹来。
sentences.traditional: 風從西北吹來。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng cóng xīběi chuī lái.
sentences.translation: The wind is blowing from the northwest.

sentences.chinese: 我们往西北走就到了。
sentences.traditional: 我們往西北走就到了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎng xīběi zǒu jiù dào le.
sentences.translation: We will arrive if we go northwest.

sentences.chinese: 太阳从西方落下。
sentences.traditional: 太陽從西方落下。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng cóng xīfāng luòxià.
sentences.translation: The sun sets in the west.

sentences.chinese: 这扇窗户朝西方。
sentences.traditional: 這扇窗戶朝西方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shàn chuānghu cháo xīfāng.
sentences.translation: This window faces west.

sentences.chinese: 他站在广场的西方。
sentences.traditional: 他站在廣場的西方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài guǎngchǎng de xīfāng.
sentences.translation: He is standing to the west of the square.

sentences.chinese: 夏天我喜欢吃西瓜。
sentences.traditional: 夏天我喜歡吃西瓜。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān wǒ xǐhuan chī xīguā.
sentences.translation: In summer I like eating watermelon.

sentences.chinese: 这个西瓜很甜。
sentences.traditional: 這個西瓜很甜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xīguā hěn tián.
sentences.translation: This watermelon is sweet.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈买了一个大西瓜。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽買了一個大西瓜。
sentences.pinyin: Māma mǎi le yí ge dà xīguā.
sentences.translation: Mum bought a big watermelon.

sentences.chinese: 学校在我们家的西南边。
sentences.traditional: 學校在我們家的西南邊。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zài wǒmen jiā de xīnán biān.
sentences.translation: The school is to the southwest of our home.

sentences.chinese: 鸟往西南飞。
sentences.traditional: 鳥往西南飛。
sentences.pinyin: Niǎo wǎng xīnán fēi.
sentences.translation: The birds are flying southwest.

sentences.chinese: 地图上那个城市在西南。
sentences.traditional: 地圖上那個城市在西南。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng nàge chéngshì zài xīnán.
sentences.translation: On the map, that city is in the southwest.

sentences.chinese: 我已经习惯早起了。
sentences.traditional: 我已經習慣早起了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng xíguàn zǎoqǐ le.
sentences.translation: I am already used to getting up early.

sentences.chinese: 他有每天跑步的习惯。
sentences.traditional: 他有每天跑步的習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǒu měitiān pǎobù de xíguàn.
sentences.translation: He has the habit of running every day.

sentences.chinese: 刚开始不习惯这里的天气。
sentences.traditional: 剛開始不習慣這裡的天氣。
sentences.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
sentences.translation: At first, I was not used to the weather here.

sentences.chinese: 小朋友都很喜爱这个老师。
sentences.traditional: 小朋友都很喜愛這個老師。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou dōu hěn xǐ’ài zhège lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: The children all like this teacher very much.

sentences.chinese: 她喜爱画画。
sentences.traditional: 她喜愛畫畫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐ’ài huàhuà.
sentences.translation: She loves drawing.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜爱的季节是秋天。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜愛的季節是秋天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐ’ài de jìjié shì qiūtiān.
sentences.translation: My favourite season is autumn.

sentences.chinese: 洗衣机在阳台上。
sentences.traditional: 洗衣機在陽臺上。
sentences.pinyin: Xǐyījī zài yángtái shàng.
sentences.translation: The washing machine is on the balcony.

sentences.chinese: 这台洗衣机很好用。
sentences.traditional: 這臺洗衣機很好用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái xǐyījī hěn hǎoyòng.
sentences.translation: This washing machine is very easy to use.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈正在用洗衣机洗衣服。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽正在用洗衣機洗衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Māma zhèngzài yòng xǐyījī xǐ yīfu.
sentences.translation: Mum is using the washing machine to do the laundry.

sentences.chinese: 我每天晚上洗澡。
sentences.traditional: 我每天晚上洗澡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān wǎnshang xǐzǎo.
sentences.translation: I take a bath every evening.

sentences.chinese: 天热的时候我喜欢洗澡。
sentences.traditional: 天熱的時候我喜歡洗澡。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān rè de shíhou wǒ xǐhuan xǐzǎo.
sentences.translation: When the weather is hot, I like taking a bath.

sentences.chinese: 孩子洗澡以后就睡觉了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子洗澡以後就睡覺了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi xǐzǎo yǐhòu jiù shuìjiào le.
sentences.translation: The child went to sleep after taking a bath.

sentences.chinese: 夏天天气很热。
sentences.traditional: 夏天天氣很熱。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān tiānqì hěn rè.
sentences.translation: Summer weather is very hot.

sentences.chinese: 我们夏天常去海边玩。
sentences.traditional: 我們夏天常去海邊玩。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàtiān cháng qù hǎibiān wán.
sentences.translation: We often go to the seaside in summer.

sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢夏天的水果。
sentences.traditional: 我最喜歡夏天的水果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan xiàtiān de shuǐguǒ.
sentences.translation: I like summer fruit the most.

sentences.chinese: 你先坐一下，我马上来。
sentences.traditional: 你先坐一下，我馬上來。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zuò yíxià, wǒ mǎshàng lái.
sentences.translation: Sit down first, I will come right away.

sentences.chinese: 我们先吃饭，再去看电影。
sentences.traditional: 我們先吃飯，再去看電影。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān chīfàn, zài qù kàn diànyǐng.
sentences.translation: We will eat first, then go and watch a film.

sentences.chinese: 这件事先不要告诉他。
sentences.traditional: 這件事先不要告訴他。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì xiān búyào gàosu tā.
sentences.translation: Do not tell him about this yet.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢吃香蕉。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡吃香蕉。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.
sentences.translation: I like eating bananas.

sentences.chinese: 这根香蕉很甜。
sentences.traditional: 這根香蕉很甜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gēn xiāngjiāo hěn tián.
sentences.translation: This banana is very sweet.

sentences.chinese: 妹妹早上吃了一根香蕉。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹早上吃了一根香蕉。
sentences.pinyin: Mèimei zǎoshang chī le yì gēn xiāngjiāo.
sentences.translation: My younger sister ate a banana this morning.

sentences.chinese: 我相信他说的话。
sentences.traditional: 我相信他說的話。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn tā shuō de huà.
sentences.translation: I believe what he said.

sentences.chinese: 请相信自己。
sentences.traditional: 請相信自己。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiāngxìn zìjǐ.
sentences.translation: Please believe in yourself.

sentences.chinese: 大家都相信这个办法有用。
sentences.traditional: 大家都相信這個辦法有用。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiāngxìn zhège bànfǎ yǒuyòng.
sentences.translation: Everyone believes this method is useful.

sentences.chinese: 箱子里有很多书。
sentences.traditional: 箱子裡有很多書。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngzi lǐ yǒu hěn duō shū.
sentences.translation: There are many books in the box.

sentences.chinese: 这个箱子太重了。
sentences.traditional: 這個箱子太重了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi tài zhòng le.
sentences.translation: This box is too heavy.

sentences.chinese: 请把衣服放进箱子里。
sentences.traditional: 請把衣服放進箱子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yīfu fàng jìn xiāngzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please put the clothes into the box.

sentences.chinese: 教室的窗户向南开。
sentences.traditional: 教室的窗戶向南開。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshì de chuānghu xiàng nán kāi.
sentences.translation: The classroom windows open to the south.

sentences.chinese: 他向老师问了一个问题。
sentences.traditional: 他向老師問了一個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng lǎoshī wèn le yí ge wèntí.
sentences.translation: He asked the teacher a question.

sentences.chinese: 请向前走。
sentences.traditional: 請向前走。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiàng qián zǒu.
sentences.translation: Please walk forward.

sentences.chinese: 他长得很像他爸爸。
sentences.traditional: 他長得很像他爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng tā bàba.
sentences.translation: He looks a lot like his dad.

sentences.chinese: 这朵云像一只小狗。
sentences.traditional: 這朵雲像一隻小狗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duǒ yún xiàng yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
sentences.translation: This cloud looks like a little dog.

sentences.chinese: 这个玩具像真的一样。
sentences.traditional: 這個玩具像真的一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wánjù xiàng zhēn de yíyàng.
sentences.translation: This toy looks real.

sentences.chinese: 这是我新的相机。
sentences.traditional: 這是我新的相機。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ xīn de xiàngjī.
sentences.translation: This is my new camera.

sentences.chinese: 他拿着相机拍照。
sentences.traditional: 他拿著相機拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná zhe xiàngjī pāizhào.
sentences.translation: He is taking photos with a camera.

sentences.chinese: 旅行的时候我带了相机。
sentences.traditional: 旅行的時候我帶了相機。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng de shíhou wǒ dài le xiàngjī.
sentences.translation: I took a camera when travelling.

sentences.chinese: 我家住在一个安静的小区里。
sentences.traditional: 我家住在一個安靜的小區裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhù zài yí ge ānjìng de xiǎoqū lǐ.
sentences.translation: My family lives in a quiet residential community.

sentences.chinese: 这个小区很大。
sentences.traditional: 這個小區很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū hěn dà.
sentences.translation: This residential community is very large.

sentences.chinese: 小区门口有一家超市。
sentences.traditional: 小區門口有一家超市。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoqū ménkǒu yǒu yì jiā chāoshì.
sentences.translation: There is a supermarket at the entrance to the residential community.

sentences.chinese: 你过马路的时候要小心。
sentences.traditional: 你過馬路的時候要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ guò mǎlù de shíhou yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: You need to be careful when crossing the road.

sentences.chinese: 小心，这里很滑。
sentences.traditional: 小心，這裡很滑。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, zhèlǐ hěn huá.
sentences.translation: Be careful, it's slippery here.

sentences.chinese: 他做事一直很小心。
sentences.traditional: 他做事一直很小心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuòshì yìzhí hěn xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: He is always very careful in the way he does things.

sentences.chinese: 校园里有很多树。
sentences.traditional: 校園裡有很多樹。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàoyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō shù.
sentences.translation: There are many trees on campus.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢校园的环境。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡校園的環境。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan xiàoyuán de huánjìng.
sentences.translation: I like the campus environment.

sentences.chinese: 放学以后，校园很安静。
sentences.traditional: 放學以後，校園很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Fàngxué yǐhòu, xiàoyuán hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: After school, the campus is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 校长今天来我们班了。
sentences.traditional: 校長今天來我們班了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng jīntiān lái wǒmen bān le.
sentences.translation: The headteacher came to our class today.

sentences.chinese: 我在办公室见到了校长。
sentences.traditional: 我在辦公室見到了校長。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài bàngōngshì jiàn dào le xiàozhǎng.
sentences.translation: I met the headteacher in the office.

sentences.chinese: 校长在会上说了很多话。
sentences.traditional: 校長在會上說了很多話。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng zài huì shàng shuō le hěn duō huà.
sentences.translation: The headteacher said a lot at the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 我想买一双新鞋。
sentences.traditional: 我想買一雙新鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng xīn xié.
sentences.translation: I want to buy a new pair of shoes.

sentences.chinese: 你的鞋在门口。
sentences.traditional: 你的鞋在門口。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de xié zài ménkǒu.
sentences.translation: Your shoes are at the door.

sentences.chinese: 下雨天要穿防水的鞋。
sentences.traditional: 下雨天要穿防水的鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ tiān yào chuān fángshuǐ de xié.
sentences.translation: You should wear waterproof shoes on rainy days.

sentences.chinese: 我心里很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 我心裡很高興。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīnlǐ hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.translation: I feel very happy inside.

sentences.chinese: 有话请说出来，别放在心里。
sentences.traditional: 有話請說出來，別放在心裡。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu huà qǐng shuō chūlái, bié fàng zài xīnlǐ.
sentences.translation: If you have something to say, say it; do not keep it inside.

sentences.chinese: 他心里一直想着这件事。
sentences.traditional: 他心裡一直想著這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīnlǐ yìzhí xiǎng zhe zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: He has been thinking about this all the time.

sentences.chinese: 新年快到了。
sentences.traditional: 新年快到了。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnnián kuài dào le.
sentences.translation: New Year is coming soon.

sentences.chinese: 我们新年去看爷爷奶奶。
sentences.traditional: 我們新年去看爺爺奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xīnnián qù kàn yéye nǎinai.
sentences.translation: We will visit Grandpa and Grandma at New Year.

sentences.chinese: 老师祝大家新年快乐。
sentences.traditional: 老師祝大家新年快樂。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhù dàjiā xīnnián kuàilè.
sentences.translation: The teacher wishes everyone a happy New Year.

sentences.chinese: 我每天早上看新闻。
sentences.traditional: 我每天早上看新聞。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang kàn xīnwén.
sentences.translation: I watch the news every morning.

sentences.chinese: 这个新闻很重要。
sentences.traditional: 這個新聞很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xīnwén hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This news item is very important.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸正在听新闻。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸正在聽新聞。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba zhèngzài tīng xīnwén.
sentences.translation: Dad is listening to the news.

sentences.chinese: 这水果很新鲜。
sentences.traditional: 這水果很新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuǐguǒ hěn xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: This fruit is very fresh.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢吃新鲜的鱼。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡吃新鮮的魚。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī xīnxiān de yú.
sentences.translation: I like eating fresh fish.

sentences.chinese: 菜市场里的菜都很新鲜。
sentences.traditional: 菜市場裡的菜都很新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Càishìchǎng lǐ de cài dōu hěn xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: The vegetables in the market are all very fresh.

sentences.chinese: 我不信这是真的。
sentences.traditional: 我不信這是真的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú xìn zhè shì zhēn de.
sentences.translation: I do not believe this is true.

sentences.chinese: 他给我写了一封信。
sentences.traditional: 他給我寫了一封信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ xiě le yì fēng xìn.
sentences.translation: He wrote me a letter.

sentences.chinese: 你可以先看这封信。
sentences.traditional: 你可以先看這封信。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xiān kàn zhè fēng xìn.
sentences.translation: You can read this letter first.

sentences.chinese: 我忘了带信用卡。
sentences.traditional: 我忘了帶信用卡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le dài xìnyòngkǎ.
sentences.translation: I forgot to bring my credit card.

sentences.chinese: 这家店可以刷信用卡。
sentences.traditional: 這家店可以刷信用卡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn kěyǐ shuā xìnyòngkǎ.
sentences.translation: This shop accepts credit cards.

sentences.chinese: 你用现金还是信用卡？
sentences.traditional: 你用現金還是信用卡？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yòng xiànjīn háishi xìnyòngkǎ?
sentences.translation: Will you use cash or a credit card?

sentences.chinese: 这样做行吗？
sentences.traditional: 這樣做行嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò xíng ma?
sentences.translation: Is it okay to do it this way?

sentences.chinese: 你要是累了，今天不去也行。
sentences.traditional: 你要是累了，今天不去也行。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi lèi le, jīntiān bú qù yě xíng.
sentences.translation: If you are tired, it is okay not to go today.

sentences.chinese: 他说下午三点行。
sentences.traditional: 他說下午三點行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō xiàwǔ sān diǎn xíng.
sentences.translation: He said three o'clock in the afternoon is okay.

sentences.chinese: 我的行李不多。
sentences.traditional: 我的行李不多。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de xíngli bù duō.
sentences.translation: I do not have much luggage.

sentences.chinese: 请把行李放在这里。
sentences.traditional: 請把行李放在這裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xíngli fàng zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.translation: Please put the luggage here.

sentences.chinese: 他正在整理行李。
sentences.traditional: 他正在整理行李。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài zhěnglǐ xíngli.
sentences.translation: He is packing his luggage.

sentences.chinese: 我对历史很有兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 我對歷史很有興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì lìshǐ hěn yǒu xìngqù.
sentences.translation: I am very interested in history.

sentences.chinese: 她对音乐没有兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 她對音樂沒有興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì yīnyuè méiyǒu xìngqù.
sentences.translation: She has no interest in music.

sentences.chinese: 这个活动让孩子们更有兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 這個活動讓孩子們更有興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huódòng ràng háizimen gèng yǒu xìngqù.
sentences.translation: This activity makes the children more interested.

sentences.chinese: 我爸爸下周休假。
sentences.traditional: 我爸爸下週休假。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xià zhōu xiūjià.
sentences.translation: My dad is taking leave next week.

sentences.chinese: 公司里很多人八月休假。
sentences.traditional: 公司裡很多人八月休假。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī lǐ hěn duō rén bā yuè xiūjià.
sentences.translation: Many people at the company take leave in August.

sentences.chinese: 她休假以后想去海边。
sentences.traditional: 她休假以後想去海邊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiūjià yǐhòu xiǎng qù hǎibiān.
sentences.translation: After taking leave, she wants to go to the seaside.

sentences.chinese: 我需要一杯水。
sentences.traditional: 我需要一杯水。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào yì bēi shuǐ.
sentences.translation: I need a glass of water.

sentences.chinese: 这个工作需要时间。
sentences.traditional: 這個工作需要時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò xūyào shíjiān.
sentences.translation: This work needs time.

sentences.chinese: 你需要帮助吗？
sentences.traditional: 你需要幫助嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào bāngzhù ma?
sentences.translation: Do you need help?

sentences.chinese: 你可以选红色的。
sentences.traditional: 你可以選紅色的。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xuǎn hóngsè de.
sentences.translation: You can choose the red one.

sentences.chinese: 我们一起选一本书。
sentences.traditional: 我們一起選一本書。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ xuǎn yì běn shū.
sentences.translation: Let us choose a book together.

sentences.chinese: 他选了靠窗的位置。
sentences.traditional: 他選了靠窗的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuǎn le kàochuāng de wèizi.
sentences.translation: He chose the seat by the window.

sentences.chinese: 你为什么选择这所学校？
sentences.traditional: 你為什麼選擇這所學校？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme xuǎnzé zhè suǒ xuéxiào?
sentences.translation: Why did you choose this school?

sentences.chinese: 我选择坐地铁去。
sentences.traditional: 我選擇坐地鐵去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xuǎnzé zuò dìtiě qù.
sentences.translation: I choose to go by metro.

sentences.chinese: 她最后选择了蓝裙子。
sentences.traditional: 她最後選擇了藍裙子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìhòu xuǎnzé le lán qúnzi.
sentences.translation: In the end, she chose the blue skirt.

sentences.chinese: 这个学期我有五门课。
sentences.traditional: 這個學期我有五門課。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī wǒ yǒu wǔ mén kè.
sentences.translation: I have five classes this semester.

sentences.chinese: 新学期下周开始。
sentences.traditional: 新學期下週開始。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī xià zhōu kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: The new semester starts next week.

sentences.chinese: 学期结束以后我们去旅行。
sentences.traditional: 學期結束以後我們去旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéqī jiéshù yǐhòu wǒmen qù lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: We will travel after the semester ends.

sentences.chinese: 我有一颗牙很疼。
sentences.traditional: 我有一顆牙很疼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yì kē yá hěn téng.
sentences.translation: One of my teeth hurts a lot.

sentences.chinese: 这颗牙已经松了。
sentences.traditional: 這顆牙已經鬆了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kē yá yǐjīng sōng le.
sentences.translation: This tooth is already loose.

sentences.chinese: 医生说我的牙没问题。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說我的牙沒問題。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ de yá méi wèntí.
sentences.translation: The doctor said my tooth is fine.

sentences.chinese: 我的牙刷是蓝色的。
sentences.traditional: 我的牙刷是藍色的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de yáshuā shì lánsè de.
sentences.translation: My toothbrush is blue.

sentences.chinese: 旅行的时候别忘了带牙刷。
sentences.traditional: 旅行的時候別忘了帶牙刷。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng de shíhou bié wàng le dài yáshuā.
sentences.translation: Do not forget to bring your toothbrush when travelling.

sentences.chinese: 这支牙刷太旧了。
sentences.traditional: 這支牙刷太舊了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī yáshuā tài jiù le.
sentences.translation: This toothbrush is too old.

sentences.chinese: 山上有很多羊。
sentences.traditional: 山上有很多羊。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shàng yǒu hěn duō yáng.
sentences.translation: There are many sheep on the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 那只白羊在吃草。
sentences.traditional: 那隻白羊在吃草。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī bái yáng zài chī cǎo.
sentences.translation: That white sheep is eating grass.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子喜欢看羊。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子喜歡看羊。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo háizi xǐhuan kàn yáng.
sentences.translation: Children like watching sheep.

sentences.chinese: 他家养了两只猫。
sentences.traditional: 他家養了兩隻貓。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiā yǎng le liǎng zhī māo.
sentences.translation: His family keeps two cats.

sentences.chinese: 我想养一条小鱼。
sentences.traditional: 我想養一條小魚。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yǎng yì tiáo xiǎo yú.
sentences.translation: I want to keep a little fish.

sentences.chinese: 她小时候养过兔子。
sentences.traditional: 她小時候養過兔子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou yǎng guo tùzi.
sentences.translation: She kept rabbits when she was little.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们早点到。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們早點到。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen zǎodiǎn dào.
sentences.translation: The teacher requires us to arrive early.

sentences.chinese: 这个工作要求很高。
sentences.traditional: 這個工作要求很高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò yāoqiú hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: This job has high requirements.

sentences.chinese: 你有什么要求吗？
sentences.traditional: 你有什麼要求嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme yāoqiú ma?
sentences.translation: Do you have any requirements?

sentences.chinese: 这一页有很多生词。
sentences.traditional: 這一頁有很多生詞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yí yè yǒu hěn duō shēngcí.
sentences.translation: This page has many new words.

sentences.chinese: 请翻到下一页。
sentences.traditional: 請翻到下一頁。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng fān dào xià yí yè.
sentences.translation: Please turn to the next page.

sentences.chinese: 这本书一共有两百页。
sentences.traditional: 這本書一共有兩百頁。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yígòng yǒu liǎng bǎi yè.
sentences.translation: This book has a total of two hundred pages.

sentences.chinese: 你一定要早点睡。
sentences.traditional: 你一定要早點睡。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yídìng yào zǎodiǎn shuì.
sentences.translation: You must go to bed early.

sentences.chinese: 他明天一定会来。
sentences.traditional: 他明天一定會來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yídìng huì lái.
sentences.translation: He will definitely come tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 这道题我一定能做对。
sentences.traditional: 這道題我一定能做對。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí wǒ yídìng néng zuò duì.
sentences.translation: I can definitely get this question right.

sentences.chinese: 我们一共买了三本书。
sentences.traditional: 我們一共買了三本書。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yígòng mǎi le sān běn shū.
sentences.translation: We bought three books in total.

sentences.chinese: 今天一共有十个人来。
sentences.traditional: 今天一共有十個人來。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān yígòng yǒu shí gè rén lái.
sentences.translation: A total of ten people came today.

sentences.chinese: 这些苹果一共多少钱？
sentences.traditional: 這些蘋果一共多少錢？
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ yígòng duōshao qián?
sentences.translation: How much are these apples altogether?

sentences.chinese: 我们一块儿去吃饭吧。
sentences.traditional: 我們一塊兒去吃飯吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yíkuàir qù chīfàn ba.
sentences.translation: Let us go eat together.

sentences.chinese: 他们常常一块儿做作业。
sentences.traditional: 他們常常一塊兒做作業。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen chángcháng yíkuàir zuò zuòyè.
sentences.translation: They often do homework together.

sentences.chinese: 你可以和我一块儿走。
sentences.traditional: 你可以和我一塊兒走。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ hé wǒ yíkuàir zǒu.
sentences.translation: You can walk together with me.

sentences.chinese: 这两件衣服颜色一样。
sentences.traditional: 這兩件衣服顏色一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu yánsè yíyàng.
sentences.translation: These two clothes are the same colour.

sentences.chinese: 我和哥哥一样高。
sentences.traditional: 我和哥哥一樣高。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé gēge yíyàng gāo.
sentences.translation: I am as tall as my elder brother.

sentences.chinese: 他们说的话都一样。
sentences.traditional: 他們說的話都一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shuō de huà dōu yíyàng.
sentences.translation: What they said was all the same.

sentences.chinese: 下课以后我们去操场。
sentences.traditional: 下課以後我們去操場。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu wǒmen qù cāochǎng.
sentences.translation: After class we will go to the playground.

sentences.chinese: 吃饭以后别马上跑。
sentences.traditional: 吃飯以後別馬上跑。
sentences.pinyin: Chīfàn yǐhòu bié mǎshàng pǎo.
sentences.translation: Do not run straight after eating.

sentences.chinese: 我以后想当老师。
sentences.traditional: 我以後想當老師。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐhòu xiǎng dāng lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: I want to be a teacher in the future.

sentences.chinese: 我以前住在北京。
sentences.traditional: 我以前住在北京。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián zhù zài Běijīng.
sentences.translation: I used to live in Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 以前这里有一家书店。
sentences.traditional: 以前這裡有一家書店。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐqián zhèlǐ yǒu yì jiā shūdiàn.
sentences.translation: There used to be a bookshop here.

sentences.chinese: 他比以前高多了。
sentences.traditional: 他比以前高多了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǐ yǐqián gāo duō le.
sentences.translation: He is much taller than before.

sentences.chinese: 五个人以上可以参加。
sentences.traditional: 五個人以上可以參加。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔ gè rén yǐshàng kěyǐ cānjiā.
sentences.translation: Five people or more can take part.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子五岁以上了。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子五歲以上了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi wǔ suì yǐshàng le.
sentences.translation: This child is above five years old now.

sentences.chinese: 请写三百字以上。
sentences.traditional: 請寫三百字以上。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiě sān bǎi zì yǐshàng.
sentences.translation: Please write more than three hundred characters.

sentences.chinese: 除了他以外，大家都到了。
sentences.traditional: 除了他以外，大家都到了。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle tā yǐwài, dàjiā dōu dào le.
sentences.translation: Everyone arrived except him.

sentences.chinese: 学习以外，他也喜欢运动。
sentences.traditional: 學習以外，他也喜歡運動。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yǐwài, tā yě xǐhuan yùndòng.
sentences.translation: Besides studying, he also likes sport.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方周末以外都很安静。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方週末以外都很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang zhōumò yǐwài dōu hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: This place is quiet except at weekends.

sentences.chinese: 我以为你今天不来了。
sentences.traditional: 我以為你今天不來了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ jīntiān bù lái le.
sentences.translation: I thought you were not coming today.

sentences.chinese: 他以为这本书很便宜。
sentences.traditional: 他以為這本書很便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi zhè běn shū hěn piányi.
sentences.translation: He thought this book was cheap.

sentences.chinese: 你别以为我不知道。
sentences.traditional: 你別以為我不知道。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié yǐwéi wǒ bù zhīdào.
sentences.translation: Do not think that I do not know.

sentences.chinese: 以下是今天的作业。
sentences.traditional: 以下是今天的作業。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐxià shì jīntiān de zuòyè.
sentences.translation: Below is today's homework.

sentences.chinese: 请看以下三个问题。
sentences.traditional: 請看以下三個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng kàn yǐxià sān gè wèntí.
sentences.translation: Please look at the following three questions.

sentences.chinese: 十八岁以下不能进去。
sentences.traditional: 十八歲以下不能進去。
sentences.pinyin: Shíbā suì yǐxià bù néng jìnqù.
sentences.translation: People under eighteen cannot go in.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭店的菜很一般。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店的菜很一般。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de cài hěn yìbān.
sentences.translation: The food at this restaurant is quite ordinary.

sentences.chinese: 他的中文水平很一般。
sentences.traditional: 他的中文水平很一般。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng hěn yìbān.
sentences.translation: His Chinese level is quite average.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题一般人都能回答。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題一般人都能回答。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yìbān rén dōu néng huídá.
sentences.translation: Ordinary people can answer this question.

sentences.chinese: 她一边听音乐，一边写作业。
sentences.traditional: 她一邊聽音樂，一邊寫作業。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān tīng yīnyuè, yìbiān xiě zuòyè.
sentences.translation: She does her homework while listening to music.

sentences.chinese: 我们一边走，一边聊天儿。
sentences.traditional: 我們一邊走，一邊聊天兒。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān zǒu, yìbiān liáotiānr.
sentences.translation: We walk and chat at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 他一边吃饭，一边看电视。
sentences.traditional: 他一邊吃飯，一邊看電視。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chīfàn, yìbiān kàn diànshì.
sentences.translation: He eats while watching television.

sentences.chinese: 他一直住在上海。
sentences.traditional: 他一直住在上海。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zhù zài Shànghǎi.
sentences.translation: He has always lived in Shanghai.

sentences.chinese: 这条路一直往前走。
sentences.traditional: 這條路一直往前走。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu.
sentences.translation: Go straight along this road.

sentences.chinese: 我一直很喜欢历史。
sentences.traditional: 我一直很喜歡歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí hěn xǐhuan lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: I have always liked history.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢听中国音乐。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡聽中國音樂。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan tīng Zhōngguó yīnyuè.
sentences.translation: I like listening to Chinese music.

sentences.chinese: 教室里有轻音乐。
sentences.traditional: 教室裡有輕音樂。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ yǒu qīng yīnyuè.
sentences.translation: There is soft music in the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 他学的是音乐。
sentences.traditional: 他學的是音樂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xué de shì yīnyuè.
sentences.translation: What he studies is music.

sentences.chinese: 我下午要去银行。
sentences.traditional: 我下午要去銀行。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù yínháng.
sentences.translation: I need to go to the bank this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 银行星期天不开门。
sentences.traditional: 銀行星期天不開門。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng xīngqītiān bù kāimén.
sentences.translation: The bank is not open on Sundays.

sentences.chinese: 银行就在学校旁边。
sentences.traditional: 銀行就在學校旁邊。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng jiù zài xuéxiào pángbiān.
sentences.translation: The bank is right next to the school.

sentences.chinese: 我的银行卡在包里。
sentences.traditional: 我的銀行卡在包裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de yínhángkǎ zài bāo lǐ.
sentences.translation: My bank card is in my bag.

sentences.chinese: 这家店可以刷银行卡。
sentences.traditional: 這家店可以刷銀行卡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn kěyǐ shuā yínhángkǎ.
sentences.translation: This shop accepts bank card payments.

sentences.chinese: 请带上你的银行卡。
sentences.traditional: 請帶上你的銀行卡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dài shàng nǐ de yínhángkǎ.
sentences.translation: Please bring your bank card.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的饮料很多。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的飲料很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de yǐnliào hěn duō.
sentences.translation: This shop has many drinks.

sentences.chinese: 你想喝什么饮料？
sentences.traditional: 你想喝什麼飲料？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme yǐnliào?
sentences.translation: What drink would you like?

sentences.chinese: 冰箱里还有两瓶饮料。
sentences.traditional: 冰箱裡還有兩瓶飲料。
sentences.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ hái yǒu liǎng píng yǐnliào.
sentences.translation: There are still two bottles of drink in the fridge.

sentences.chinese: 你应该早点睡觉。
sentences.traditional: 你應該早點睡覺。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zǎodiǎn shuìjiào.
sentences.translation: You should go to bed earlier.

sentences.chinese: 下雨了，我们应该带伞。
sentences.traditional: 下雨了，我們應該帶傘。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, wǒmen yīnggāi dài sǎn.
sentences.translation: It is raining, so we should bring umbrellas.

sentences.chinese: 这件事他应该知道。
sentences.traditional: 這件事他應該知道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tā yīnggāi zhīdào.
sentences.translation: He should know about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 这件事不会影响我们的计划。
sentences.traditional: 這件事不會影響我們的計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù huì yǐngxiǎng wǒmen de jìhuà.
sentences.translation: This matter will not affect our plan.

sentences.chinese: 天气对比赛有很大影响。
sentences.traditional: 天氣對比賽有很大影響。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì duì bǐsài yǒu hěn dà yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The weather has a big influence on the match.

sentences.chinese: 他的决定影响了很多人。
sentences.traditional: 他的決定影響了很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de juédìng yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén.
sentences.translation: His decision affected many people.

sentences.chinese: 我不会用这个软件。
sentences.traditional: 我不會用這個軟件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yòng zhège ruǎnjiàn.
sentences.translation: I cannot use this software.

sentences.chinese: 你可以用我的笔。
sentences.traditional: 你可以用我的筆。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ yòng wǒ de bǐ.
sentences.translation: You can use my pen.

sentences.chinese: 他每天用电脑工作。
sentences.traditional: 他每天用電腦工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān yòng diànnǎo gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He uses a computer for work every day.

sentences.chinese: 我早上收到一封邮件。
sentences.traditional: 我早上收到一封郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang shōudào yì fēng yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: I received a mail message this morning.

sentences.chinese: 请把邮件发给经理。
sentences.traditional: 請把郵件發給經理。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yóujiàn fā gěi jīnglǐ.
sentences.translation: Please send the mail to the manager.

sentences.chinese: 这封邮件很重要。
sentences.traditional: 這封郵件很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng yóujiàn hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This mail message is very important.

sentences.chinese: 这里夏天有很多游客。
sentences.traditional: 這裡夏天有很多遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ xiàtiān yǒu hěn duō yóukè.
sentences.translation: There are many tourists here in summer.

sentences.chinese: 游客都喜欢这个地方。
sentences.traditional: 遊客都喜歡這個地方。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè dōu xǐhuan zhège dìfang.
sentences.translation: Tourists all like this place.

sentences.chinese: 那些游客在拍照。
sentences.traditional: 那些遊客在拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Nàxiē yóukè zài pāizhào.
sentences.translation: Those tourists are taking photos.

sentences.chinese: 这个游戏很好玩。
sentences.traditional: 這個遊戲很好玩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yóuxì hěn hǎowán.
sentences.translation: This game is very fun.

sentences.chinese: 我弟弟喜欢玩电脑游戏。
sentences.traditional: 我弟弟喜歡玩電腦遊戲。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuan wán diànnǎo yóuxì.
sentences.translation: My younger brother likes playing computer games.

sentences.chinese: 老师说上课不能玩游戏。
sentences.traditional: 老師說上課不能玩遊戲。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō shàngkè bù néng wán yóuxì.
sentences.translation: The teacher said we cannot play games in class.

sentences.chinese: 学校门口有一个红色邮箱。
sentences.traditional: 學校門口有一個紅色郵箱。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào ménkǒu yǒu yí gè hóngsè yóuxiāng.
sentences.translation: There is a red mailbox at the school gate.

sentences.chinese: 请把信放进邮箱里。
sentences.traditional: 請把信放進郵箱裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xìn fàng jìn yóuxiāng lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please put the letter into the mailbox.

sentences.chinese: 这个邮箱已经满了。
sentences.traditional: 這個郵箱已經滿了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yóuxiāng yǐjīng mǎn le.
sentences.translation: This mailbox is already full.

sentences.chinese: 这本书和中国历史有关。
sentences.traditional: 這本書和中國歷史有關。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hé Zhōngguó lìshǐ yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: This book is related to Chinese history.

sentences.chinese: 这件事和你有关吗？
sentences.traditional: 這件事和你有關嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hé nǐ yǒuguān ma?
sentences.translation: Is this matter related to you?

sentences.chinese: 这个问题和工作有关。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題和工作有關。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hé gōngzuò yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: This question is related to work.

sentences.chinese: 他是很有名的画家。
sentences.traditional: 他是很有名的畫家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì hěn yǒumíng de huàjiā.
sentences.translation: He is a very famous painter.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭店在城里很有名。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店在城裡很有名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn zài chéng lǐ hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.translation: This restaurant is very famous in the city.

sentences.chinese: 那个地方有名吗？
sentences.traditional: 那個地方有名嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nàge dìfang yǒumíng ma?
sentences.translation: Is that place famous?

sentences.chinese: 这本词典很有用。
sentences.traditional: 這本詞典很有用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn hěn yǒuyòng.
sentences.translation: This dictionary is very useful.

sentences.chinese: 老师的话对我很有用。
sentences.traditional: 老師的話對我很有用。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de huà duì wǒ hěn yǒuyòng.
sentences.translation: The teacher's words are very useful to me.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法真的有用。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法真的有用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ zhēnde yǒuyòng.
sentences.translation: This method really works.

sentences.chinese: 他又迟到了。
sentences.traditional: 他又遲到了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòu chídào le.
sentences.translation: He is late again.

sentences.chinese: 今天又下雨了。
sentences.traditional: 今天又下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān yòu xiàyǔ le.
sentences.translation: It is raining again today.

sentences.chinese: 你怎么又忘了？
sentences.traditional: 你怎麼又忘了？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yòu wàng le?
sentences.translation: How did you forget again?

sentences.chinese: 我妹妹会打羽毛球。
sentences.traditional: 我妹妹會打羽毛球。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú.
sentences.translation: My younger sister can play badminton.

sentences.chinese: 他们常常一起打羽毛球。
sentences.traditional: 他們常常一起打羽毛球。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen chángcháng yìqǐ dǎ yǔmáoqiú.
sentences.translation: They often play badminton together.

sentences.chinese: 学校后面有一个羽毛球场。
sentences.traditional: 學校後面有一個羽毛球場。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào hòumiàn yǒu yí gè yǔmáoqiú chǎng.
sentences.translation: There is a badminton court behind the school.

sentences.chinese: 我会说两种语言。
sentences.traditional: 我會說兩種語言。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō liǎng zhǒng yǔyán.
sentences.translation: I can speak two languages.

sentences.chinese: 汉语是一种很重要的语言。
sentences.traditional: 漢語是一種很重要的語言。
sentences.pinyin: Hànyǔ shì yì zhǒng hěn zhòngyào de yǔyán.
sentences.translation: Chinese is a very important language.

sentences.chinese: 你最想学什么语言？
sentences.traditional: 你最想學什麼語言？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zuì xiǎng xué shénme yǔyán?
sentences.translation: What language do you most want to learn?

sentences.chinese: 外面下雨了，带上雨衣吧。
sentences.traditional: 外面下雨了，帶上雨衣吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn xiàyǔ le, dài shàng yǔyī ba.
sentences.translation: It is raining outside, so bring a raincoat.

sentences.chinese: 这件黄色雨衣是我弟弟的。
sentences.traditional: 這件黃色雨衣是我弟弟的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn huángsè yǔyī shì wǒ dìdi de.
sentences.translation: This yellow raincoat is my younger brother's.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子穿着雨衣在路上走。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子穿著雨衣在路上走。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi chuānzhe yǔyī zài lù shàng zǒu.
sentences.translation: The child is walking along the road in a raincoat.

sentences.chinese: 我昨天在街上遇到了老师。
sentences.traditional: 我昨天在街上遇到了老師。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài jiē shang yùdào le lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: I ran into the teacher in the street yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 遇到问题的时候，可以问经理。
sentences.traditional: 遇到問題的時候，可以問經理。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào wèntí de shíhou, kěyǐ wèn jīnglǐ.
sentences.translation: When you encounter a problem, you can ask the manager.

sentences.chinese: 如果遇到困难，不要放弃。
sentences.traditional: 如果遇到困難，不要放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùdào kùnnan, bú yào fàngqì.
sentences.translation: If you run into difficulties, do not give up.

sentences.chinese: 我昨天在学校门口遇见了他。
sentences.traditional: 我昨天在學校門口遇見了他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài xuéxiào ménkǒu yùjiàn le tā.
sentences.translation: I met him at the school gate yesterday.
