sentences.traditional: 下過雨以後，空氣更加新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Xià guo yǔ yǐhòu, kōngqì gèngjiā xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: After the rain, the air became even fresher.

sentences.chinese: 你要更加认真一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 你要更加認真一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yào gèngjiā rènzhēn yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: You need to be even more serious.

sentences.chinese: 我叔叔在工厂工作。
sentences.traditional: 我叔叔在工廠工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu zài gōngchǎng gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: My uncle works in a factory.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂生产电动车。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠生產電動車。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn diàndòngchē.
sentences.translation: This factory produces electric vehicles.

sentences.chinese: 工厂外面停着很多车。
sentences.traditional: 工廠外面停著很多車。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng wàimiàn tíngzhe hěn duō chē.
sentences.translation: There are many cars parked outside the factory.

sentences.chinese: 他会一点儿中国功夫。
sentences.traditional: 他會一點兒中國功夫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huì yìdiǎnr Zhōngguó gōngfu.
sentences.translation: He knows a little Chinese kung fu.

sentences.chinese: 学好汉语要下功夫。
sentences.traditional: 學好漢語要下功夫。
sentences.pinyin: Xué hǎo Hànyǔ yào xià gōngfu.
sentences.translation: To learn Chinese well, you need to put in effort.

sentences.chinese: 她做菜的功夫很好。
sentences.traditional: 她做菜的功夫很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò cài de gōngfu hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Her cooking skills are very good.

sentences.chinese: 这里是公共地方，不能抽烟。
sentences.traditional: 這裡是公共地方，不能抽煙。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ shì gōnggòng dìfang, bù néng chōuyān.
sentences.translation: This is a public place, so smoking is not allowed.

sentences.chinese: 公共汽车已经到了。
sentences.traditional: 公共汽車已經到了。
sentences.pinyin: Gōnggòng qìchē yǐjīng dào le.
sentences.translation: The public bus has already arrived.

sentences.chinese: 公共厕所就在前面。
sentences.traditional: 公共廁所就在前面。
sentences.pinyin: Gōnggòng cèsuǒ jiù zài qiánmiàn.
sentences.translation: The public toilet is just ahead.

sentences.chinese: 今天的功课很多。
sentences.traditional: 今天的功課很多。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de gōngkè hěn duō.
sentences.translation: There is a lot of homework today.

sentences.chinese: 我晚上先做功课。
sentences.traditional: 我晚上先做功課。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wǎnshang xiān zuò gōngkè.
sentences.translation: I do my homework first in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 老师每天检查我们的功课。
sentences.traditional: 老師每天檢查我們的功課。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī měitiān jiǎnchá wǒmen de gōngkè.
sentences.translation: The teacher checks our homework every day.

sentences.chinese: 我家离学校三公里。
sentences.traditional: 我家離學校三公里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào sān gōnglǐ.
sentences.translation: My home is three kilometres from the school.

sentences.chinese: 这条路长五公里。
sentences.traditional: 這條路長五公里。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù cháng wǔ gōnglǐ.
sentences.translation: This road is five kilometres long.

sentences.chinese: 从这儿到机场有十公里。
sentences.traditional: 從這兒到機場有十公里。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhèr dào jīchǎng yǒu shí gōnglǐ.
sentences.translation: It is ten kilometres from here to the airport.

sentences.chinese: 这条公路很宽。
sentences.traditional: 這條公路很寬。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gōnglù hěn kuān.
sentences.translation: This road is very wide.

sentences.chinese: 下雨以后，公路有点儿滑。
sentences.traditional: 下雨以後，公路有點兒滑。
sentences.pinyin: Xià yǔ yǐhòu, gōnglù yǒudiǎnr huá.
sentences.translation: After the rain, the road is a bit slippery.

sentences.chinese: 这条公路一直到机场。
sentences.traditional: 這條公路一直到機場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gōnglù yìzhí dào jīchǎng.
sentences.translation: This road goes all the way to the airport.

sentences.chinese: 工人们正在修路。
sentences.traditional: 工人們正在修路。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrénmen zhèngzài xiū lù.
sentences.translation: The workers are repairing the road.

sentences.chinese: 我爸爸是工人。
sentences.traditional: 我爸爸是工人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì gōngrén.
sentences.translation: My dad is a worker.

sentences.chinese: 这些工人早上六点开始工作。
sentences.traditional: 這些工人早上六點開始工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē gōngrén zǎoshang liù diǎn kāishǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: These workers start work at six in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 他的工资不高。
sentences.traditional: 他的工資不高。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de gōngzī bù gāo.
sentences.translation: His salary is not high.

sentences.chinese: 我下个月才发工资。
sentences.traditional: 我下個月才發工資。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè cái fā gōngzī.
sentences.translation: I will not get paid until next month.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作的工资怎么样？
sentences.traditional: 這份工作的工資怎麼樣？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de gōngzī zěnmeyàng?
sentences.translation: How is the salary for this job?

sentences.chinese: 我们共买了五本书。
sentences.traditional: 我們共買了五本書。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen gòng mǎi le wǔ běn shū.
sentences.translation: We bought five books altogether.

sentences.chinese: 两个人共用一张桌子。
sentences.traditional: 兩個人共用一張桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén gòng yòng yì zhāng zhuōzi.
sentences.translation: Two people share one desk.

sentences.chinese: 我们班共来了二十个人。
sentences.traditional: 我們班共來了二十個人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bān gòng lái le èrshí ge rén.
sentences.translation: Twenty people from our class came in total.

sentences.chinese: 我们有共同的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 我們有共同的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu gòngtóng de péngyou.
sentences.translation: We have a mutual friend.

sentences.chinese: 他们共同完成了这次活动。
sentences.traditional: 他們共同完成了這次活動。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen gòngtóng wánchéng le zhè cì huódòng.
sentences.translation: They completed this activity together.

sentences.chinese: 共同努力以后，我们成功了。
sentences.traditional: 共同努力以後，我們成功了。
sentences.pinyin: Gòngtóng nǔlì yǐhòu, wǒmen chénggōng le.
sentences.translation: After working together, we succeeded.

sentences.chinese: 这些钱不够。
sentences.traditional: 這些錢不夠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē qián bù gòu.
sentences.translation: This money is not enough.

sentences.chinese: 一天睡八个小时就够了。
sentences.traditional: 一天睡八個小時就夠了。
sentences.pinyin: Yì tiān shuì bā ge xiǎoshí jiù gòu le.
sentences.translation: Sleeping eight hours a day is enough.

sentences.chinese: 菜已经够多了，不要再点了。
sentences.traditional: 菜已經夠多了，不要再點了。
sentences.pinyin: Cài yǐjīng gòu duō le, bú yào zài diǎn le.
sentences.translation: The dishes are already enough, so do not order any more.

sentences.chinese: 我想在网上购买一本词典。
sentences.traditional: 我想在網上購買一本詞典。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài wǎngshàng gòumǎi yì běn cídiǎn.
sentences.translation: I want to buy a dictionary online.

sentences.chinese: 这台电脑是昨天购买的。
sentences.traditional: 這臺電腦是昨天購買的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo shì zuótiān gòumǎi de.
sentences.translation: This computer was purchased yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 买东西以前，他总会先比较再购买。
sentences.traditional: 買東西以前，他總會先比較再購買。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi yǐqián, tā zǒng huì xiān bǐjiào zài gòumǎi.
sentences.translation: Before buying things, he always compares first and then purchases.

sentences.chinese: 周末很多人去商场购物。
sentences.traditional: 週末很多人去商場購物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò hěn duō rén qù shāngchǎng gòuwù.
sentences.translation: Many people go shopping at the mall on weekends.

sentences.chinese: 我妈妈喜欢在超市购物。
sentences.traditional: 我媽媽喜歡在超市購物。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ māma xǐhuan zài chāoshì gòuwù.
sentences.translation: My mum likes shopping at the supermarket.

sentences.chinese: 购物以后，我们一起去吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 購物以後，我們一起去吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Gòuwù yǐhòu, wǒmen yìqǐ qù chīfàn.
sentences.translation: After shopping, we went to eat together.

sentences.chinese: 我估计他还要十分钟才到。
sentences.traditional: 我估計他還要十分鐘才到。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gūjì tā hái yào shí fēnzhōng cái dào.
sentences.translation: I estimate he will need another ten minutes to arrive.

sentences.chinese: 这个箱子估计有二十公斤。
sentences.traditional: 這個箱子估計有二十公斤。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi gūjì yǒu èrshí gōngjīn.
sentences.translation: I estimate this suitcase weighs twenty kilograms.

sentences.chinese: 按现在的速度，估计晚上能到家。
sentences.traditional: 按現在的速度，估計晚上能到家。
sentences.pinyin: Àn xiànzài de sùdù, gūjì wǎnshang néng dào jiā.
sentences.translation: At the current speed, I guess we can get home tonight.

sentences.chinese: 那个穿白衣服的姑娘是我姐姐的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 那個穿白衣服的姑娘是我姐姐的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge chuān bái yīfu de gūniang shì wǒ jiějie de péngyou.
sentences.translation: The girl in white clothes is my older sister's friend.

sentences.chinese: 小姑娘看见小猫以后笑了。
sentences.traditional: 小姑娘看見小貓以後笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo gūniang kànjian xiǎo māo yǐhòu xiào le.
sentences.translation: The little girl smiled after seeing the kitten.

sentences.chinese: 这位姑娘想买什么？
sentences.traditional: 這位姑娘想買什麼？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi gūniang xiǎng mǎi shénme?
sentences.translation: What would this young lady like to buy?

sentences.chinese: 老师鼓励我们多说汉语。
sentences.traditional: 老師鼓勵我們多說漢語。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì wǒmen duō shuō Hànyǔ.
sentences.translation: The teacher encourages us to speak more Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 父母应该鼓励孩子自己想办法。
sentences.traditional: 父母應該鼓勵孩子自己想辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ yīnggāi gǔlì háizi zìjǐ xiǎng bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Parents should encourage children to think of solutions themselves.

sentences.chinese: 你的话鼓励了我。
sentences.traditional: 你的話鼓勵了我。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de huà gǔlì le wǒ.
sentences.translation: Your words encouraged me.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的顾客很多。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的顧客很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de gùkè hěn duō.
sentences.translation: This shop has many customers.

sentences.chinese: 服务员正在帮助那位顾客。
sentences.traditional: 服務員正在幫助那位顧客。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán zhèngzài bāngzhù nà wèi gùkè.
sentences.translation: The waiter is helping that customer.

sentences.chinese: 我们要认真听顾客的意见。
sentences.traditional: 我們要認真聽顧客的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào rènzhēn tīng gùkè de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: We need to listen carefully to customers' opinions.

sentences.chinese: 他不是故意迟到的。
sentences.traditional: 他不是故意遲到的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì gùyì chídào de.
sentences.translation: He wasn't late on purpose.

sentences.chinese: 你是故意这样说的吗？
sentences.traditional: 你是故意這樣說的嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shì gùyì zhèyàng shuō de ma?
sentences.translation: Did you say that on purpose?

sentences.chinese: 我故意没有告诉他答案。
sentences.traditional: 我故意沒有告訴他答案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gùyì méiyǒu gàosu tā dá'àn.
sentences.translation: I deliberately did not tell him the answer.

sentences.chinese: 墙上挂着一张照片。
sentences.traditional: 牆上掛著一張照片。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng guàzhe yì zhāng zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: There is a photo hanging on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 请把衣服挂在门后。
sentences.traditional: 請把衣服掛在門後。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yīfu guà zài mén hòu.
sentences.translation: Please hang the clothes behind the door.

sentences.chinese: 电话挂了以后，他马上出门了。
sentences.traditional: 電話掛了以後，他馬上出門了。
sentences.pinyin: Diànhuà guà le yǐhòu, tā mǎshàng chūmén le.
sentences.translation: After the call ended, he went out at once.

sentences.chinese: 这一步很关键，不能出错。
sentences.traditional: 這一步很關鍵，不能出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yí bù hěn guānjiàn, bù néng chūcuò.
sentences.translation: This step is crucial and cannot go wrong.

sentences.chinese: 学好发音是关键。
sentences.traditional: 學好發音是關鍵。
sentences.pinyin: Xué hǎo fāyīn shì guānjiàn.
sentences.translation: Learning pronunciation well is the key.

sentences.chinese: 关键是我们有没有准备好。
sentences.traditional: 關鍵是我們有沒有準備好。
sentences.pinyin: Guānjiàn shì wǒmen yǒu méiyǒu zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.translation: The key is whether we are prepared.

sentences.chinese: 晚上我们一起观看比赛。
sentences.traditional: 晚上我們一起觀看比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ guānkàn bǐsài.
sentences.translation: We are watching the match together tonight.

sentences.chinese: 很多游客在广场上观看表演。
sentences.traditional: 很多遊客在廣場上觀看表演。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō yóukè zài guǎngchǎng shàng guānkàn biǎoyǎn.
sentences.translation: Many tourists are watching the performance in the square.

sentences.chinese: 观看电影的时候，请把手机关掉。
sentences.traditional: 觀看電影的時候，請把手機關掉。
sentences.pinyin: Guānkàn diànyǐng de shíhou, qǐng bǎ shǒujī guān diào.
sentences.translation: Please turn off your phone when watching the film.

sentences.chinese: 观众很多，大家都很安静。
sentences.traditional: 觀眾很多，大家都很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Guānzhòng hěn duō, dàjiā dōu hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: There are many audience members, and everyone is quiet.

sentences.chinese: 比赛开始了，观众一起鼓掌。
sentences.traditional: 比賽開始了，觀眾一起鼓掌。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài kāishǐ le, guānzhòng yìqǐ gǔzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The match has started, and the audience applauds together.

sentences.chinese: 这些观众喜欢看篮球比赛。
sentences.traditional: 這些觀眾喜歡看籃球比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē guānzhòng xǐhuan kàn lánqiú bǐsài.
sentences.translation: These audience members like watching basketball games.

sentences.chinese: 他不想管这件事。
sentences.traditional: 他不想管這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng guǎn zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: He does not want to deal with this matter.

sentences.chinese: 这位老师管我们班。
sentences.traditional: 這位老師管我們班。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī guǎn wǒmen bān.
sentences.translation: This teacher is in charge of our class.

sentences.chinese: 别管我，你先去吧。
sentences.traditional: 別管我，你先去吧。
sentences.pinyin: Bié guǎn wǒ, nǐ xiān qù ba.
sentences.translation: Do not worry about me, you go first.

sentences.chinese: 她负责管理这家小店。
sentences.traditional: 她負責管理這家小店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fùzé guǎnlǐ zhè jiā xiǎodiàn.
sentences.translation: She is responsible for managing this small shop.

sentences.chinese: 学校管理得很严格。
sentences.traditional: 學校管理得很嚴格。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào guǎnlǐ de hěn yángé.
sentences.translation: The school is managed very strictly.

sentences.chinese: 你来管理这个小组吧。
sentences.traditional: 你來管理這個小組吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ lái guǎnlǐ zhège xiǎozǔ ba.
sentences.translation: You manage this group.

sentences.chinese: 房间里没有光。
sentences.traditional: 房間裡沒有光。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ méiyǒu guāng.
sentences.translation: There is no light in the room.

sentences.chinese: 桌子太光了，很容易滑。
sentences.traditional: 桌子太光了，很容易滑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi tài guāng le, hěn róngyì huá.
sentences.translation: The table is too smooth, so it is easy to slip on.

sentences.chinese: 我今天光喝水，没吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 我今天光喝水，沒吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān guāng hē shuǐ, méi chīfàn.
sentences.translation: Today I only drank water and did not eat.

sentences.chinese: 学校广播里正在放音乐。
sentences.traditional: 學校廣播裡正在放音樂。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào guǎngbō lǐ zhèngzài fàng yīnyuè.
sentences.translation: Music is playing on the school radio.

sentences.chinese: 请大家认真听广播。
sentences.traditional: 請大家認真聽廣播。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā rènzhēn tīng guǎngbō.
sentences.translation: Please listen carefully to the broadcast.

sentences.chinese: 这条新闻是广播里说的。
sentences.traditional: 這條新聞是廣播裡說的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xīnwén shì guǎngbō lǐ shuō de.
sentences.translation: This news was mentioned in the broadcast.

sentences.chinese: 电视上有很多广告。
sentences.traditional: 電視上有很多廣告。
sentences.pinyin: Diànshì shàng yǒu hěn duō guǎnggào.
sentences.translation: There are many adverts on TV.

sentences.chinese: 这个广告很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這個廣告很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guǎnggào hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This advertisement is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 请不要在这里贴广告。
sentences.traditional: 請不要在這裡貼廣告。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng búyào zài zhèlǐ tiē guǎnggào.
sentences.translation: Please do not put up adverts here.

sentences.chinese: 周末我喜欢逛书店。
sentences.traditional: 週末我喜歡逛書店。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuan guàng shūdiàn.
sentences.translation: At weekends I like browsing in bookshops.

sentences.chinese: 他们在商场逛了很久。
sentences.traditional: 他們在商場逛了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài shāngchǎng guàng le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.translation: They browsed around the shopping centre for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 晚上我们去逛夜市。
sentences.traditional: 晚上我們去逛夜市。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen qù guàng yèshì.
sentences.translation: In the evening we are going to stroll through the night market.

sentences.chinese: 学校有很多规定。
sentences.traditional: 學校有很多規定。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yǒu hěn duō guīdìng.
sentences.translation: The school has many rules.

sentences.chinese: 按规定，你要先报名。
sentences.traditional: 按規定，你要先報名。
sentences.pinyin: Àn guīdìng, nǐ yào xiān bàomíng.
sentences.translation: According to the rules, you need to register first.

sentences.chinese: 这个规定大家都知道。
sentences.traditional: 這個規定大家都知道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guīdìng dàjiā dōu zhīdao.
sentences.translation: Everyone knows this rule.

sentences.chinese: 他的国籍是中国。
sentences.traditional: 他的國籍是中國。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de guójí shì Zhōngguó.
sentences.translation: His nationality is Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 请在这里写上你的国籍。
sentences.traditional: 請在這裡寫上你的國籍。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ xiě shàng nǐ de guójí.
sentences.translation: Please write your nationality here.

sentences.chinese: 他们的国籍不一样。
sentences.traditional: 他們的國籍不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen de guójí bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Their nationalities are different.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个国际会议。
sentences.traditional: 這是一個國際會議。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge guójì huìyì.
sentences.translation: This is an international conference.

sentences.chinese: 这个机场有国际航班。
sentences.traditional: 這個機場有國際航班。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jīchǎng yǒu guójì hángbān.
sentences.translation: This airport has international flights.

sentences.chinese: 北京欢迎很多国际游客。
sentences.traditional: 北京歡迎很多國際遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Běijīng huānyíng hěn duō guójì yóukè.
sentences.translation: Beijing welcomes many international tourists.

sentences.chinese: 我想喝一杯果汁。
sentences.traditional: 我想喝一杯果汁。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē yì bēi guǒzhī.
sentences.translation: I want to drink a glass of fruit juice.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的果汁很新鲜。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的果汁很新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de guǒzhī hěn xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: The fruit juice in this shop is very fresh.

sentences.chinese: 天热的时候，他常买果汁。
sentences.traditional: 天熱的時候，他常買果汁。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān rè de shíhou, tā cháng mǎi guǒzhī.
sentences.translation: When the weather is hot, he often buys fruit juice.

sentences.chinese: 学汉语是一个慢慢来的过程。
sentences.traditional: 學漢語是一個慢慢來的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Xué Hànyǔ shì yí ge mànmàn lái de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: Learning Chinese is a gradual process.

sentences.chinese: 这个过程不太容易。
sentences.traditional: 這個過程不太容易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guòchéng bú tài róngyì.
sentences.translation: This process is not very easy.

sentences.chinese: 我们要注意比赛的过程，不只看结果。
sentences.traditional: 我們要注意比賽的過程，不只看結果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhùyì bǐsài de guòchéng, bù zhǐ kàn jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: We should pay attention to the process of the match, not just the result.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们对海洋很有兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們對海洋很有興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen duì hǎiyáng hěn yǒu xìngqù.
sentences.translation: The children are very interested in the ocean.

sentences.chinese: 这本书介绍了海洋动物。
sentences.traditional: 這本書介紹了海洋動物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jièshào le hǎiyáng dòngwù.
sentences.translation: This book introduces sea animals.

sentences.chinese: 海洋比湖大得多。
sentences.traditional: 海洋比湖大得多。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎiyáng bǐ hú dà de duō.
sentences.translation: The ocean is much bigger than a lake.

sentences.chinese: 她一见到生人就很害羞。
sentences.traditional: 她一見到生人就很害羞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí jiàn dào shēngrén jiù hěn hàixiū.
sentences.translation: She becomes shy as soon as she sees strangers.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子有点害羞，不太爱说话。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子有點害羞，不太愛說話。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǒudiǎn hàixiū, bú tài ài shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: This child is a bit shy and does not like talking much.

sentences.chinese: 别害羞，大家都想听你唱歌。
sentences.traditional: 別害羞，大家都想聽你唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Bié hàixiū, dàjiā dōu xiǎng tīng nǐ chànggē.
sentences.translation: Don't be shy; everyone wants to hear you sing.

sentences.chinese: 寒假我想去南方旅行。
sentences.traditional: 寒假我想去南方旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Hánjià wǒ xiǎng qù nánfāng lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: I want to travel to the south during the winter holiday.

sentences.chinese: 学校下个月开始放寒假。
sentences.traditional: 學校下個月開始放寒假。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xià ge yuè kāishǐ fàng hánjià.
sentences.translation: The school starts the winter holiday next month.

sentences.chinese: 今年寒假比去年短一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 今年寒假比去年短一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián hánjià bǐ qùnián duǎn yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: This year's winter holiday is a bit shorter than last year's.

sentences.chinese: 北方的冬天很寒冷。
sentences.traditional: 北方的冬天很寒冷。
sentences.pinyin: Běifāng de dōngtiān hěn hánlěng.
sentences.translation: The winters in the north are very cold.

sentences.chinese: 天气太寒冷了，大家都不想出门。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太寒冷了，大家都不想出門。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài hánlěng le, dàjiā dōu bù xiǎng chūmén.
sentences.translation: The weather is too cold, and nobody wants to go out.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物不能在寒冷的地方生长。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物不能在寒冷的地方生長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù bù néng zài hánlěng de dìfang shēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: This kind of plant cannot grow in cold places.

sentences.chinese: 他站在门口喊我的名字。
sentences.traditional: 他站在門口喊我的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài ménkǒu hǎn wǒ de míngzi.
sentences.translation: He stood at the door and shouted my name.

sentences.chinese: 老师喊大家安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 老師喊大家安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī hǎn dàjiā ānjìng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: The teacher shouted for everyone to quiet down.

sentences.chinese: 你不用大声喊，我听得见。
sentences.traditional: 你不用大聲喊，我聽得見。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng dàshēng hǎn, wǒ tīng de jiàn.
sentences.translation: You don't need to shout loudly; I can hear you.

sentences.chinese: 他跑完步以后出了很多汗。
sentences.traditional: 他跑完步以後出了很多汗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo wán bù yǐhòu chū le hěn duō hàn.
sentences.translation: He sweated a lot after finishing his run.

sentences.chinese: 天太热，我脸上都是汗。
sentences.traditional: 天太熱，我臉上都是汗。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān tài rè, wǒ liǎn shang dōu shì hàn.
sentences.translation: It's too hot; my face is covered in sweat.

sentences.chinese: 先擦一擦汗，再喝水吧。
sentences.traditional: 先擦一擦汗，再喝水吧。
sentences.pinyin: Xiān cā yì cā hàn, zài hē shuǐ ba.
sentences.translation: Wipe off your sweat first, then drink some water.

sentences.chinese: 这个航班今天晚点了。
sentences.traditional: 這個航班今天晚點了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hángbān jīntiān wǎndiǎn le.
sentences.translation: This flight is delayed today.

sentences.chinese: 我们最好提前两个小时到机场等航班。
sentences.traditional: 我們最好提前兩個小時到機場等航班。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zuìhǎo tíqián liǎng ge xiǎoshí dào jīchǎng děng hángbān.
sentences.translation: We had better arrive at the airport two hours early to wait for the flight.

sentences.chinese: 因为天气不好，很多航班都取消了。
sentences.traditional: 因為天氣不好，很多航班都取消了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì bù hǎo, hěn duō hángbān dōu qǔxiāo le.
sentences.translation: Because the weather is bad, many flights were cancelled.

sentences.chinese: 每天运动对身体有很多好处。
sentences.traditional: 每天運動對身體有很多好處。
sentences.pinyin: Měitiān yùndòng duì shēntǐ yǒu hěn duō hǎochù.
sentences.translation: Daily exercise has many benefits for the body.

sentences.chinese: 学外语的好处不只一个。
sentences.traditional: 學外語的好處不只一個。
sentences.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ de hǎochù bù zhǐ yí ge.
sentences.translation: There is more than one benefit to learning a foreign language.

sentences.chinese: 早睡早起有什么好处？
sentences.traditional: 早睡早起有什麼好處？
sentences.pinyin: Zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ yǒu shénme hǎochù?
sentences.translation: What are the benefits of sleeping early and getting up early?

sentences.chinese: 你要好好休息。
sentences.traditional: 你要好好休息。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yào hǎohǎo xiūxi.
sentences.translation: You should have a good rest.

sentences.chinese: 他在家里好好学习。
sentences.traditional: 他在家裡好好學習。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jiālǐ hǎohǎo xuéxí.
sentences.translation: He studies properly at home.

sentences.chinese: 这次我们要好好准备考试。
sentences.traditional: 這次我們要好好準備考試。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: This time we need to prepare well for the exam.

sentences.chinese: 这个故事很好笑。
sentences.traditional: 這個故事很好笑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gùshi hěn hǎoxiào.
sentences.translation: This story is very funny.

sentences.chinese: 他说的话太好笑了。
sentences.traditional: 他說的話太好笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà tài hǎoxiào le.
sentences.translation: What he said was too funny.

sentences.chinese: 我们都觉得这个名字很好笑。
sentences.traditional: 我們都覺得這個名字很好笑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu juéde zhège míngzi hěn hǎoxiào.
sentences.translation: We all think this name is very funny.

sentences.chinese: 你的成绩合格了。
sentences.traditional: 你的成績合格了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de chéngjì hégé le.
sentences.translation: Your score has passed.

sentences.chinese: 这个产品是合格的。
sentences.traditional: 這個產品是合格的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn shì hégé de.
sentences.translation: This product is qualified.

sentences.chinese: 想当队员，身体要合格。
sentences.traditional: 想當隊員，身體要合格。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎng dāng duìyuán, shēntǐ yào hégé.
sentences.translation: To be a team member, your health must meet the standard.

sentences.chinese: 盒子里有什么？
sentences.traditional: 盒子裡有什麼？
sentences.pinyin: Hézi lǐ yǒu shénme?
sentences.translation: What is in the box?

sentences.chinese: 请把礼物放进盒子里。
sentences.traditional: 請把禮物放進盒子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ lǐwù fàng jìn hézi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please put the gift into the box.

sentences.chinese: 这个盒子太小了。
sentences.traditional: 這個盒子太小了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hézi tài xiǎo le.
sentences.translation: This box is too small.

sentences.chinese: 过年的时候，孩子们喜欢收红包。
sentences.traditional: 過年的時候，孩子們喜歡收紅包。
sentences.pinyin: Guònián de shíhou, háizimen xǐhuan shōu hóngbāo.
sentences.translation: During the New Year, children like receiving red packets.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶给了我一个大红包。
sentences.traditional: 奶奶給了我一個大紅包。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai gěi le wǒ yí gè dà hóngbāo.
sentences.translation: Grandma gave me a big red envelope.

sentences.chinese: 这个红包是给你的。
sentences.traditional: 這個紅包是給你的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hóngbāo shì gěi nǐ de.
sentences.translation: This red envelope is for you.

sentences.chinese: 这本书很厚。
sentences.traditional: 這本書很厚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn hòu.
sentences.translation: This book is very thick.

sentences.chinese: 冬天要穿厚一点儿的衣服。
sentences.traditional: 冬天要穿厚一點兒的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān yào chuān hòu yìdiǎnr de yīfu.
sentences.translation: In winter, you should wear thicker clothes.

sentences.chinese: 这面墙又高又厚。
sentences.traditional: 這面牆又高又厚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè miàn qiáng yòu gāo yòu hòu.
sentences.translation: This wall is both tall and thick.

sentences.chinese: 我后悔昨天没有早点睡。
sentences.traditional: 我後悔昨天沒有早點睡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hòuhuǐ zuótiān méiyǒu zǎodiǎn shuì.
sentences.translation: I regret not going to bed earlier yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 他买了以后有一点儿后悔。
sentences.traditional: 他買了以後有一點兒後悔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yǐhòu yǒu yìdiǎnr hòuhuǐ.
sentences.translation: After buying it, he felt a little regret.

sentences.chinese: 现在后悔也没用了。
sentences.traditional: 現在後悔也沒用了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hòuhuǐ yě méi yòng le.
sentences.translation: It is no use regretting it now.

sentences.chinese: 天忽然下雨了。
sentences.traditional: 天忽然下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān hūrán xiàyǔ le.
sentences.translation: It suddenly started raining.

sentences.chinese: 他忽然站起来问老师一个问题。
sentences.traditional: 他忽然站起來問老師一個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hūrán zhàn qǐlái wèn lǎoshī yí gè wèntí.
sentences.translation: He suddenly stood up and asked the teacher a question.

sentences.chinese: 我们走到门口的时候，灯忽然亮了。
sentences.traditional: 我們走到門口的時候，燈忽然亮了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu dào ménkǒu de shíhou, dēng hūrán liàng le.
sentences.translation: When we reached the door, the light suddenly came on.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多人都离不开互联网。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多人都離不開互聯網。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén dōu líkāi bu kāi hùliánwǎng.
sentences.translation: Nowadays many people cannot do without the Internet.

sentences.chinese: 通过互联网，我们可以学很多东西。
sentences.traditional: 通過互聯網，我們可以學很多東西。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò hùliánwǎng, wǒmen kěyǐ xué hěn duō dōngxi.
sentences.translation: Through the Internet, we can learn many things.

sentences.chinese: 我常在互联网上看新闻。
sentences.traditional: 我常在互聯網上看新聞。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cháng zài hùliánwǎng shàng kàn xīnwén.
sentences.translation: I often read the news on the Internet.

sentences.chinese: 护士让我们先排队。
sentences.traditional: 護士讓我們先排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi ràng wǒmen xiān páiduì.
sentences.translation: The nurse told us to line up first.

sentences.chinese: 那位护士很细心。
sentences.traditional: 那位護士很細心。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi hùshi hěn xìxīn.
sentences.translation: That nurse is very careful.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈生病的时候，护士照顾得很好。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽生病的時候，護士照顧得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng de shíhou, hùshi zhàogù de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: When Mum was ill, the nurse took very good care of her.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该互相帮助。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該互相幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: We should help each other.

sentences.chinese: 同学之间要互相尊重。
sentences.traditional: 同學之間要互相尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Tóngxué zhījiān yào hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: Classmates should respect each other.

sentences.chinese: 他们互相看了一眼。
sentences.traditional: 他們互相看了一眼。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen hùxiāng kàn le yì yǎn.
sentences.translation: They looked at each other.

sentences.chinese: 我昨晚看了一场很精彩的话剧。
sentences.traditional: 我昨晚看了一場很精彩的話劇。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn kàn le yì chǎng hěn jīngcǎi de huàjù.
sentences.translation: I watched a wonderful play last night.

sentences.chinese: 这家剧院常常演外国话剧。
sentences.traditional: 這家劇院常常演外國話劇。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jùyuàn chángcháng yǎn wàiguó huàjù.
sentences.translation: This theatre often stages foreign plays.

sentences.chinese: 她大学时参加过话剧表演。
sentences.traditional: 她大學時參加過話劇表演。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué shí cānjiā guò huàjù biǎoyǎn.
sentences.translation: She took part in drama performances at university.

sentences.chinese: 我开始怀疑这个答案是不是对的。
sentences.traditional: 我開始懷疑這個答案是不是對的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kāishǐ huáiyí zhège dá'àn shì bu shì duì de.
sentences.translation: I began to doubt whether this answer was correct.

sentences.chinese: 他从来不怀疑自己的能力。
sentences.traditional: 他從來不懷疑自己的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cónglái bù huáiyí zìjǐ de nénglì.
sentences.translation: He never doubts his own ability.

sentences.chinese: 警察怀疑那个人跟这件事有关。
sentences.traditional: 警察懷疑那個人跟這件事有關。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá huáiyí nàge rén gēn zhè jiàn shì yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: The police suspect that person is connected with this matter.

sentences.chinese: 熬夜对身体有很多坏处。
sentences.traditional: 熬夜對身體有很多壞處。
sentences.pinyin: Áoyè duì shēntǐ yǒu hěn duō huàichù.
sentences.translation: Staying up late has many bad effects on the body.

sentences.chinese: 这件事的坏处比好处更多。
sentences.traditional: 這件事的壞處比好處更多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de huàichù bǐ hǎochù gèng duō.
sentences.translation: This matter has more disadvantages than advantages.

sentences.chinese: 吃太多甜食的坏处你知道吗？
sentences.traditional: 吃太多甜食的壞處你知道嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Chī tài duō tiánshí de huàichù nǐ zhīdào ma?
sentences.translation: Do you know the harm of eating too many sweets?

sentences.chinese: 现在大家越来越重视环保。
sentences.traditional: 現在大家越來越重視環保。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā yuè lái yuè zhòngshì huánbǎo.
sentences.translation: Nowadays everyone pays more and more attention to environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司的产品很环保。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司的產品很環保。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de chǎnpǐn hěn huánbǎo.
sentences.translation: This company's products are environmentally friendly.

sentences.chinese: 为了环保，我们应该少用塑料袋。
sentences.traditional: 為了環保，我們應該少用塑料袋。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huánbǎo, wǒmen yīnggāi shǎo yòng sùliàodài.
sentences.translation: For environmental protection, we should use fewer plastic bags.

sentences.chinese: 你在下一站换乘地铁就可以了。
sentences.traditional: 你在下一站換乘地鐵就可以了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zài xià yí zhàn huànchéng dìtiě jiù kěyǐ le.
sentences.translation: You can just change to the metro at the next stop.

sentences.chinese: 从这里去机场要换乘两次。
sentences.traditional: 從這裡去機場要換乘兩次。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ qù jīchǎng yào huànchéng liǎng cì.
sentences.translation: You need to change twice to get to the airport from here.

sentences.chinese: 这条路线虽然远一点，但是换乘比较方便。
sentences.traditional: 這條路線雖然遠一點，但是換乘比較方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lùxiàn suīrán yuǎn yìdiǎn, dànshì huànchéng bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This route is a bit longer, but changing is more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 我已经回复了他的邮件。
sentences.traditional: 我已經回覆了他的郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng huífù le tā de yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: I have already replied to his email.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们尽快回复这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們盡快回覆這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen jǐnkuài huífù zhège wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to respond to this question as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 你为什么还没有回复我？
sentences.traditional: 你為什麼還沒有回覆我？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ wèishéme hái méiyǒu huífù wǒ?
sentences.translation: Why haven't you replied to me yet?

sentences.chinese: 我昨天已经给他回信了。
sentences.traditional: 我昨天已經給他回信了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān yǐjīng gěi tā huíxìn le.
sentences.translation: I already wrote back to him yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 收到你的来信后，我会马上回信。
sentences.traditional: 收到你的來信後，我會馬上回信。
sentences.pinyin: Shōudào nǐ de láixìn hòu, wǒ huì mǎshàng huíxìn.
sentences.translation: After receiving your letter, I will reply at once.

sentences.chinese: 他的回信写得很认真。
sentences.traditional: 他的回信寫得很認真。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huíxìn xiě de hěn rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: His reply letter was written very carefully.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片让我回忆起小时候的生活。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片讓我回憶起小時候的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn ràng wǒ huíyì qǐ xiǎoshíhou de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This photo reminds me of my childhood life.

sentences.chinese: 旅行结束后，我们常常一起回忆那几天。
sentences.traditional: 旅行結束後，我們常常一起回憶那幾天。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng jiéshù hòu, wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ huíyì nà jǐ tiān.
sentences.translation: After the trip, we often recall those days together.

sentences.chinese: 那是一段美好的回忆。
sentences.traditional: 那是一段美好的回憶。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yí duàn měihǎo de huíyì.
sentences.translation: That is a beautiful memory.

sentences.chinese: 这家书店的会员可以打九折。
sentences.traditional: 這家書店的會員可以打九折。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā shūdiàn de huìyuán kěyǐ dǎ jiǔ zhé.
sentences.translation: Members of this bookshop can get a 10% discount.

sentences.chinese: 你是这家健身房的会员吗？
sentences.traditional: 你是這家健身房的會員嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shì zhè jiā jiànshēnfáng de huìyuán ma?
sentences.translation: Are you a member of this gym?

sentences.chinese: 成为会员以后，你能享受更多服务。
sentences.traditional: 成為會員以後，你能享受更多服務。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngwéi huìyuán yǐhòu, nǐ néng xiǎngshòu gèng duō fúwù.
sentences.translation: After becoming a member, you can enjoy more services.

sentences.chinese: 他还活着。
sentences.traditional: 他還活著。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái huó zhe.
sentences.translation: He is still alive.

sentences.chinese: 这条鱼是活的。
sentences.traditional: 這條魚是活的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú shì huó de.
sentences.translation: This fish is alive.

sentences.chinese: 今天的活很多。
sentences.traditional: 今天的活很多。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de huó hěn duō.
sentences.translation: There is a lot of work today.

sentences.chinese: 周末学校有活动。
sentences.traditional: 週末學校有活動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò xuéxiào yǒu huódòng.
sentences.translation: There is an activity at school this weekend.

sentences.chinese: 我们下课以后去活动一下。
sentences.traditional: 我們下課以後去活動一下。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàkè yǐhòu qù huódòng yíxià.
sentences.translation: We will move around a bit after class.

sentences.chinese: 这个活动很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這個活動很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huódòng hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This activity is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 她是个很活泼的孩子。
sentences.traditional: 她是個很活潑的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì ge hěn huópō de háizi.
sentences.translation: She is a very lively child.

sentences.chinese: 这只小狗很活泼。
sentences.traditional: 這隻小狗很活潑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǐ xiǎogǒu hěn huópō.
sentences.translation: This little dog is very lively.

sentences.chinese: 他的妹妹活泼又爱笑。
sentences.traditional: 他的妹妹活潑又愛笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de mèimei huópō yòu ài xiào.
sentences.translation: His younger sister is lively and loves to smile.

sentences.chinese: 小心，这里有火。
sentences.traditional: 小心，這裡有火。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, zhèlǐ yǒu huǒ.
sentences.translation: Be careful, there is fire here.

sentences.chinese: 山上不能玩火。
sentences.traditional: 山上不能玩火。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shàng bù néng wán huǒ.
sentences.translation: You must not play with fire on the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这家店最近很火。
sentences.traditional: 這家店最近很火。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zuìjìn hěn huǒ.
sentences.translation: This shop has been very popular recently.

sentences.chinese: 这批货明天到。
sentences.traditional: 這批貨明天到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī huò míngtiān dào.
sentences.translation: This batch of goods will arrive tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他们正在搬货。
sentences.traditional: 他們正在搬貨。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài bān huò.
sentences.translation: They are moving the goods.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的货很全。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的貨很全。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de huò hěn quán.
sentences.translation: This shop has a very complete range of goods.

sentences.chinese: 他获得了第一名。
sentences.traditional: 他獲得了第一名。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huòdé le dì yī míng.
sentences.translation: He won first place.

sentences.chinese: 我希望获得这个机会。
sentences.traditional: 我希望獲得這個機會。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng huòdé zhège jīhuì.
sentences.translation: I hope to get this opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 她获得了老师的表扬。
sentences.traditional: 她獲得了老師的表揚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huòdé le lǎoshī de biǎoyáng.
sentences.translation: She received praise from the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 他的画这次获奖了。
sentences.traditional: 他的畫這次獲獎了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huà zhè cì huòjiǎng le.
sentences.translation: His painting won a prize this time.

sentences.chinese: 获奖以后，他很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 獲獎以後，他很高興。
sentences.pinyin: Huòjiǎng yǐhòu, tā hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.translation: After winning an award, he was very happy.

sentences.chinese: 这位学生常常获奖。
sentences.traditional: 這位學生常常獲獎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuésheng chángcháng huòjiǎng.
sentences.translation: This student often wins awards.

sentences.chinese: 我们要先获取信息。
sentences.traditional: 我們要先獲取信息。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiān huòqǔ xìnxī.
sentences.translation: We need to obtain the information first.

sentences.chinese: 你可以从网上获取资料。
sentences.traditional: 你可以從網上獲取資料。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ cóng wǎng shàng huòqǔ zīliào.
sentences.translation: You can obtain materials from the internet.

sentences.chinese: 他想获取更多经验。
sentences.traditional: 他想獲取更多經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng huòqǔ gèng duō jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He wants to gain more experience.

sentences.chinese: 这些都是基本知识。
sentences.traditional: 這些都是基本知識。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōu shì jīběn zhīshi.
sentences.translation: These are all basic facts.

sentences.chinese: 我已经学会了基本用法。
sentences.traditional: 我已經學會了基本用法。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng xuéhuì le jīběn yòngfǎ.
sentences.translation: I have already learned the basic usage.

sentences.chinese: 他的中文基本没问题。
sentences.traditional: 他的中文基本沒問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zhōngwén jīběn méi wèntí.
sentences.translation: His Chinese is basically fine.

sentences.chinese: 这本书我基本上看完了。
sentences.traditional: 這本書我基本上看完了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ jīběnshàng kàn wán le.
sentences.translation: I have basically finished this book.

sentences.chinese: 他基本上每天都跑步。
sentences.traditional: 他基本上每天都跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīběnshàng měitiān dōu pǎobù.
sentences.translation: He basically runs every day.

sentences.chinese: 这件事基本上解决了。
sentences.traditional: 這件事基本上解決了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jīběnshàng jiějué le.
sentences.translation: This matter has basically been solved.

sentences.chinese: 学好汉语要先打好基础。
sentences.traditional: 學好漢語要先打好基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Xué hǎo Hànyǔ yào xiān dǎ hǎo jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: To learn Chinese well, you must first build a good foundation.

sentences.chinese: 这些知识是数学基础。
sentences.traditional: 這些知識是數學基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhīshi shì shùxué jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: This knowledge is the basis of mathematics.

sentences.chinese: 没有基础也可以慢慢学。
sentences.traditional: 沒有基礎也可以慢慢學。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu jīchǔ yě kěyǐ mànmàn xué.
sentences.translation: Even without a foundation, you can still learn slowly.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个好消息，我很激动。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個好消息，我很激動。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào zhège hǎo xiāoxi, wǒ hěn jīdòng.
sentences.translation: I was very excited to hear this good news.

sentences.chinese: 她激动得快哭了。
sentences.traditional: 她激動得快哭了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīdòng de kuài kū le.
sentences.translation: She was so moved that she was almost crying.

sentences.chinese: 老师的话让我很激动。
sentences.traditional: 老師的話讓我很激動。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de huà ràng wǒ hěn jīdòng.
sentences.translation: The teacher's words moved me a lot.

sentences.chinese: 他学习很积极。
sentences.traditional: 他學習很積極。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuéxí hěn jījí.
sentences.translation: He is very proactive in his studies.

sentences.chinese: 大家都积极参加比赛。
sentences.traditional: 大家都積極參加比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu jījí cānjiā bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Everyone actively took part in the competition.

sentences.chinese: 我们要用积极的态度解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 我們要用積極的態度解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yòng jījí de tàidu jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: We should solve problems with a positive attitude.

sentences.chinese: 学语言要慢慢积累。
sentences.traditional: 學語言要慢慢積累。
sentences.pinyin: Xué yǔyán yào mànmàn jīlěi.
sentences.translation: Learning a language requires gradual accumulation.

sentences.chinese: 他积累了很多工作经验。
sentences.traditional: 他積累了很多工作經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīlěi le hěn duō gōngzuò jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He has built up a lot of work experience.

sentences.chinese: 我每天积累几个新词。
sentences.traditional: 我每天積累幾個新詞。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān jīlěi jǐ ge xīncí.
sentences.translation: I learn and build up a few new words every day.

sentences.chinese: 你来得很及时。
sentences.traditional: 你來得很及時。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ lái de hěn jíshí.
sentences.translation: You arrived just in time.

sentences.chinese: 有问题要及时告诉老师。
sentences.traditional: 有問題要及時告訴老師。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí yào jíshí gàosu lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: If there is a problem, tell the teacher promptly.

sentences.chinese: 他及时回复了我的短信。
sentences.traditional: 他及時回覆了我的短信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jíshí huífù le wǒ de duǎnxìn.
sentences.translation: He replied to my text message in time.

sentences.chinese: 即使下雨，我们也要出发。
sentences.traditional: 即使下雨，我們也要出發。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ xià yǔ, wǒmen yě yào chūfā.
sentences.translation: Even if it rains, we still have to set off.

sentences.chinese: 即使很忙，她也每天运动。
sentences.traditional: 即使很忙，她也每天運動。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ hěn máng, tā yě měitiān yùndòng.
sentences.translation: Even if she is very busy, she still exercises every day.

sentences.chinese: 即使只有一天，我们也能完成。
sentences.traditional: 即使只有一天，我們也能完成。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ zhǐyǒu yì tiān, wǒmen yě néng wánchéng.
sentences.translation: Even if there is only one day, we can still finish it.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆的菜既便宜又好吃。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯館的菜既便宜又好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài jì piányi yòu hǎochī.
sentences.translation: The dishes in this restaurant are both cheap and tasty.

sentences.chinese: 他既会开车，也会修车。
sentences.traditional: 他既會開車，也會修車。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì huì kāichē, yě huì xiū chē.
sentences.translation: He can both drive and repair cars.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方既安静又方便。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方既安靜又方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang jì ānjìng yòu fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This place is both quiet and convenient.

sentences.chinese: 我想给朋友寄一张明信片。
sentences.traditional: 我想給朋友寄一張明信片。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi péngyou jì yì zhāng míngxìnpiàn.
sentences.translation: I want to send a postcard to my friend.

sentences.chinese: 这本书是妈妈寄给我的。
sentences.traditional: 這本書是媽媽寄給我的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì māma jì gěi wǒ de.
sentences.translation: This book was sent to me by Mum.

sentences.chinese: 请把这些照片寄回家。
sentences.traditional: 請把這些照片寄回家。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē zhàopiàn jì huí jiā.
sentences.translation: Please send these photos back home.

sentences.chinese: 我们周末有一个旅行计划。
sentences.traditional: 我們週末有一個旅行計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò yǒu yí ge lǚxíng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: We have a travel plan for the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 你计划什么时候回国？
sentences.traditional: 你計劃什麼時候回國？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ jìhuà shénme shíhou huí guó?
sentences.translation: When do you plan to return to your country?

sentences.chinese: 他正在计划明年的工作。
sentences.traditional: 他正在計劃明年的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài jìhuà míngnián de gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He is planning next year's work.

sentences.chinese: 既然你来了，就一起吃饭吧。
sentences.traditional: 既然你來了，就一起吃飯吧。
sentences.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ lái le, jiù yìqǐ chīfàn ba.
sentences.translation: Since you are here, let us eat together.

sentences.chinese: 既然天气很好，我们出去走走。
sentences.traditional: 既然天氣很好，我們出去走走。
sentences.pinyin: Jìrán tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen chūqù zǒuzou.
sentences.translation: Since the weather is nice, let us go out for a walk.

sentences.chinese: 既然决定了，就不要后悔。
sentences.traditional: 既然決定了，就不要後悔。
sentences.pinyin: Jìrán juédìng le, jiù bú yào hòuhuǐ.
sentences.translation: Since you have decided, do not regret it.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司有很好的技术。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司有很好的技術。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǒu hěn hǎo de jìshù.
sentences.translation: This company has very good technology.

sentences.chinese: 学这门技术要很多时间。
sentences.traditional: 學這門技術要很多時間。
sentences.pinyin: Xué zhè mén jìshù yào hěn duō shíjiān.
sentences.translation: Learning this technology takes a lot of time.

sentences.chinese: 新技术让生活更方便。
sentences.traditional: 新技術讓生活更方便。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jìshù ràng shēnghuó gèng fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: New technology makes life more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 雨还在下，我们继续走吧。
sentences.traditional: 雨還在下，我們繼續走吧。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hái zài xià, wǒmen jìxù zǒu ba.
sentences.translation: It is still raining, so let us keep walking.

sentences.chinese: 老师讲完以后，他继续问问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師講完以後，他繼續問問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng wán yǐhòu, tā jìxù wèn wèntí.
sentences.translation: After the teacher finished speaking, he kept asking questions.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想学好，就要继续练习。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想學好，就要繼續練習。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng xué hǎo, jiù yào jìxù liànxí.
sentences.translation: If you want to learn well, you need to keep practising.

sentences.chinese: 那位记者正在写新闻。
sentences.traditional: 那位記者正在寫新聞。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi jìzhě zhèngzài xiě xīnwén.
sentences.translation: That reporter is writing a news story.

sentences.chinese: 她长大以后想当记者。
sentences.traditional: 她長大以後想當記者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǎng dà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng jìzhě.
sentences.translation: She wants to be a reporter when she grows up.

sentences.chinese: 记者问了他几个问题。
sentences.traditional: 記者問了他幾個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě wèn le tā jǐ ge wèntí.
sentences.translation: The reporter asked him several questions.

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上我得加班。
sentences.traditional: 今天晚上我得加班。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ děi jiābān.
sentences.translation: I have to work overtime tonight.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸最近常常加班。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸最近常常加班。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba zuìjìn chángcháng jiābān.
sentences.translation: Dad has been working overtime a lot recently.

sentences.chinese: 因为工作太多，他们周末也要加班。
sentences.traditional: 因為工作太多，他們週末也要加班。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài duō, tāmen zhōumò yě yào jiābān.
sentences.translation: Because there is too much work, they also have to work overtime at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 这套家具很新。
sentences.traditional: 這套傢俱很新。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào jiājù hěn xīn.
sentences.translation: This set of furniture is very new.

sentences.chinese: 我们买了一些新家具。
sentences.traditional: 我們買了一些新傢俱。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi le yìxiē xīn jiājù.
sentences.translation: We bought some new furniture.

sentences.chinese: 房间里的家具不多，但是很干净。
sentences.traditional: 房間裡的傢俱不多，但是很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ de jiājù bù duō, dànshì hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: There is not much furniture in the room, but it is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 我们要加快工作速度。
sentences.traditional: 我們要加快工作速度。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiākuài gōngzuò sùdù.
sentences.translation: We need to speed up our work pace.

sentences.chinese: 雨快来了，大家加快脚步。
sentences.traditional: 雨快來了，大家加快腳步。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ kuài lái le, dàjiā jiākuài jiǎobù.
sentences.translation: The rain is coming soon, so everyone quickened their pace.

sentences.chinese: 为了按时到达，司机加快了车速。
sentences.traditional: 為了按時到達，司機加快了車速。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ànshí dàodá, sījī jiākuài le chēsù.
sentences.translation: To arrive on time, the driver increased the speed.

sentences.chinese: 学校加强了安全检查。
sentences.traditional: 學校加強了安全檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāqiáng le ānquán jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The school strengthened the safety inspections.

sentences.chinese: 医生说要加强锻炼。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說要加強鍛鍊。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō yào jiāqiáng duànliàn.
sentences.translation: The doctor said we should exercise more.

sentences.chinese: 我们要加强对环境的保护。
sentences.traditional: 我們要加強對環境的保護。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiāqiáng duì huánjìng de bǎohù.
sentences.translation: We need to strengthen environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 请把糖加入咖啡里。
sentences.traditional: 請把糖加入咖啡裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ táng jiārù kāfēi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please add sugar to the coffee.

sentences.chinese: 他去年加入了学校的足球队。
sentences.traditional: 他去年加入了學校的足球隊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qùnián jiārù le xuéxiào de zúqiúduì.
sentences.translation: He joined the school football team last year.

sentences.chinese: 欢迎你加入我们的讨论。
sentences.traditional: 歡迎你加入我們的討論。
sentences.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐ jiārù wǒmen de tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: Welcome to join our discussion.

sentences.chinese: 三个人加上你，一共四个人。
sentences.traditional: 三個人加上你，一共四個人。
sentences.pinyin: Sān ge rén jiāshàng nǐ, yígòng sì ge rén.
sentences.translation: Three people plus you makes four people altogether.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间很小，加上一张桌子就更满了。
sentences.traditional: 這個房間很小，加上一張桌子就更滿了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān hěn xiǎo, jiāshàng yì zhāng zhuōzi jiù gèng mǎn le.
sentences.translation: This room is very small; adding one table makes it even fuller.

sentences.chinese: 今天很热，加上没有风，大家都不想出门。
sentences.traditional: 今天很熱，加上沒有風，大家都不想出門。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān hěn rè, jiāshàng méiyǒu fēng, dàjiā dōu bù xiǎng chūmén.
sentences.translation: It is very hot today, and with no wind as well, nobody wants to go out.

sentences.chinese: 她有一个很幸福的家庭。
sentences.traditional: 她有一個很幸福的家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǒu yí ge hěn xìngfú de jiātíng.
sentences.translation: She has a very happy family.

sentences.chinese: 家庭环境对孩子很重要。
sentences.traditional: 家庭環境對孩子很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Jiātíng huánjìng duì háizi hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: The family environment is very important for children.

sentences.chinese: 每个家庭都有自己的习惯。
sentences.traditional: 每個家庭都有自己的習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge jiātíng dōu yǒu zìjǐ de xíguàn.
sentences.translation: Every family has its own habits.

sentences.chinese: 我的家乡在南方。
sentences.traditional: 我的家鄉在南方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de jiāxiāng zài nánfāng.
sentences.translation: My hometown is in the south.

sentences.chinese: 放假以后，她回家乡看父母。
sentences.traditional: 放假以後，她回家鄉看父母。
sentences.pinyin: Fàngjià yǐhòu, tā huí jiāxiāng kàn fùmǔ.
sentences.translation: After the holiday starts, she goes back to her hometown to see her parents.

sentences.chinese: 很多人喜欢介绍自己的家乡。
sentences.traditional: 很多人喜歡介紹自己的家鄉。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén xǐhuan jièshào zìjǐ de jiāxiāng.
sentences.translation: Many people like to introduce their hometown.

sentences.chinese: 车没油了，我们先去加油。
sentences.traditional: 車沒油了，我們先去加油。
sentences.pinyin: Chē méi yóu le, wǒmen xiān qù jiāyóu.
sentences.translation: The car is out of fuel, so we will go refuel first.

sentences.chinese: 明天有比赛，大家一起加油！
sentences.traditional: 明天有比賽，大家一起加油！
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu bǐsài, dàjiā yìqǐ jiāyóu!
sentences.translation: There is a match tomorrow; everyone, let’s cheer on together!

sentences.chinese: 爸爸正在给车加油。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸正在給車加油。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba zhèngzài gěi chē jiāyóu.
sentences.translation: Dad is refuelling the car.

sentences.chinese: 前面有一个加油站。
sentences.traditional: 前面有一個加油站。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánmiàn yǒu yí ge jiāyóuzhàn.
sentences.translation: There is a petrol station ahead.

sentences.chinese: 这家加油站晚上也开门。
sentences.traditional: 這家加油站晚上也開門。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiāyóuzhàn wǎnshang yě kāimén.
sentences.translation: This petrol station is open at night too.

sentences.chinese: 我们在加油站旁边等你。
sentences.traditional: 我們在加油站旁邊等你。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiāyóuzhàn pángbiān děng nǐ.
sentences.translation: We are waiting for you beside the petrol station.

sentences.chinese: 老师请家长明天来学校。
sentences.traditional: 老師請家長明天來學校。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī qǐng jiāzhǎng míngtiān lái xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the parents to come to the school tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 家长都很关心孩子的学习。
sentences.traditional: 家長都很關心孩子的學習。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāzhǎng dōu hěn guānxīn háizi de xuéxí.
sentences.translation: Parents all care a lot about their children’s studies.

sentences.chinese: 开会的时候，很多家长都到了。
sentences.traditional: 開會的時候，很多家長都到了。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhou, hěn duō jiāzhǎng dōu dào le.
sentences.translation: When the meeting started, many parents had arrived.

sentences.chinese: 这是假花，不是真花。
sentences.traditional: 這是假花，不是真花。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì jiǎ huā, bú shì zhēn huā.
sentences.translation: This is a fake flower, not a real one.

sentences.chinese: 那个笑容有点假。
sentences.traditional: 那個笑容有點假。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge xiàoróng yǒudiǎn jiǎ.
sentences.translation: That smile looks a bit fake.

sentences.chinese: 这个消息是假的。
sentences.traditional: 這個消息是假的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi shì jiǎ de.
sentences.translation: This piece of news is false.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服的价格不高。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服的價格不高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de jiàgé bù gāo.
sentences.translation: The price of this item of clothing is not high.

sentences.chinese: 价格太高了，我不想买。
sentences.traditional: 價格太高了，我不想買。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé tài gāo le, wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi.
sentences.translation: The price is too high, so I do not want to buy it.

sentences.chinese: 我们先看看价格，再决定买不买。
sentences.traditional: 我們先看看價格，再決定買不買。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān kànkan jiàgé, zài juédìng mǎi bù mǎi.
sentences.translation: Let’s look at the price first, then decide whether to buy it.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的价钱是多少？
sentences.traditional: 這本書的價錢是多少？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de jiàqián shì duōshao?
sentences.translation: What is the price of this book?

sentences.chinese: 这里的水果价钱不贵。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的水果價錢不貴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de shuǐguǒ jiàqián bù guì.
sentences.translation: The price of the fruit here is not expensive.

sentences.chinese: 买东西以前，他总会先问价钱。
sentences.traditional: 買東西以前，他總會先問價錢。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi yǐqián, tā zǒng huì xiān wèn jiàqián.
sentences.translation: Before buying something, he always asks the price first.

sentences.chinese: 假日的时候，公园里人很多。
sentences.traditional: 假日的時候，公園裡人很多。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàrì de shíhou, gōngyuán lǐ rén hěn duō.
sentences.translation: There are many people in the park during holidays.

sentences.chinese: 这个假日我们想去海边。
sentences.traditional: 這個假日我們想去海邊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiàrì wǒmen xiǎng qù hǎibiān.
sentences.translation: We want to go to the seaside this holiday.

sentences.chinese: 假日过得真快。
sentences.traditional: 假日過得真快。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàrì guò de zhēn kuài.
sentences.translation: The holiday passes very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这条裤子太长了，得减一点。
sentences.traditional: 這條褲子太長了，得減一點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài cháng le, děi jiǎn yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: These trousers are too long and need to be shortened a bit.

sentences.chinese: 医生说他要减体重。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說他要減體重。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā yào jiǎn tǐzhòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor said he needs to reduce his weight.

sentences.chinese: 饭太多了，给我减一点吧。
sentences.traditional: 飯太多了，給我減一點吧。
sentences.pinyin: Fàn tài duō le, gěi wǒ jiǎn yìdiǎn ba.
sentences.translation: There is too much rice; please reduce it a little for me.

sentences.chinese: 这种药可以减轻疼痛。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥可以減輕疼痛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào kěyǐ jiǎnqīng téngtòng.
sentences.translation: This medicine can reduce pain.

sentences.chinese: 休息一下，可以减轻疲劳。
sentences.traditional: 休息一下，可以減輕疲勞。
sentences.pinyin: Xiūxi yíxià, kěyǐ jiǎnqīng píláo.
sentences.translation: A short rest can reduce tiredness.

sentences.chinese: 跑步以后，我的压力减轻了。
sentences.traditional: 跑步以後，我的壓力減輕了。
sentences.pinyin: Pǎobù yǐhòu, wǒ de yālì jiǎnqīng le.
sentences.translation: After running, my stress was reduced.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少压力，他晚上去跑步。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少壓力，他晚上去跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo yālì, tā wǎnshang qù pǎobù.
sentences.translation: To reduce stress, he goes running in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 今年来图书馆的人减少了。
sentences.traditional: 今年來圖書館的人減少了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián lái túshūguǎn de rén jiǎnshǎo le.
sentences.translation: The number of people coming to the library has decreased this year.

sentences.chinese: 医生说我要减少吃糖。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說我要減少吃糖。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yào jiǎnshǎo chī táng.
sentences.translation: The doctor said I need to reduce how much sugar I eat.

sentences.chinese: 我每周去公园健身三次。
sentences.traditional: 我每週去公園健身三次。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi zhōu qù gōngyuán jiànshēn sān cì.
sentences.translation: I go to the park to work out three times a week.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸下班以后常去健身。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸下班以後常去健身。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba xiàbān yǐhòu cháng qù jiànshēn.
sentences.translation: Dad often goes to work out after work.

sentences.chinese: 健身以后，他觉得更有精神。
sentences.traditional: 健身以後，他覺得更有精神。
sentences.pinyin: Jiànshēn yǐhòu, tā juéde gèng yǒu jīngshen.
sentences.translation: After exercising, he feels more energetic.

sentences.chinese: 学校附近新开了一家健身房。
sentences.traditional: 學校附近新開了一家健身房。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn xīn kāi le yì jiā jiànshēnfáng.
sentences.translation: A new gym has opened near the school.

sentences.chinese: 她晚上常去健身房跑步。
sentences.traditional: 她晚上常去健身房跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wǎnshang cháng qù jiànshēnfáng pǎobù.
sentences.translation: She often goes to the gym to run in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 这家健身房的环境很好。
sentences.traditional: 這家健身房的環境很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiànshēnfáng de huánjìng hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: The environment in this gym is very good.

sentences.chinese: 老师建议我们多听中文。
sentences.traditional: 老師建議我們多聽中文。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiànyì wǒmen duō tīng Zhōngwén.
sentences.translation: The teacher suggests that we listen to more Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 你的建议很有用。
sentences.traditional: 你的建議很有用。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de jiànyì hěn yǒuyòng.
sentences.translation: Your suggestion is very useful.

sentences.chinese: 我想先听听大家的建议。
sentences.traditional: 我想先聽聽大家的建議。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān tīngting dàjiā de jiànyì.
sentences.translation: I want to hear everyone’s suggestions first.

sentences.chinese: 这条江比那条河宽。
sentences.traditional: 這條江比那條河寬。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiāng bǐ nà tiáo hé kuān.
sentences.translation: This river is wider than that river.

sentences.chinese: 我家就在江边。
sentences.traditional: 我家就在江邊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā jiù zài jiāng biān.
sentences.translation: My home is right by the river.

sentences.chinese: 夏天的时候，很多人去江边散步。
sentences.traditional: 夏天的時候，很多人去江邊散步。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, hěn duō rén qù jiāng biān sànbù.
sentences.translation: In summer, many people go walking by the river.

sentences.chinese: 老师将作业放在桌子上。
sentences.traditional: 老師將作業放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiāng zuòyè fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.translation: The teacher put the homework on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这个月将有一次考试。
sentences.traditional: 這個月將有一次考試。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yuè jiāng yǒu yí cì kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: There will be an exam this month.

sentences.chinese: 医生将检查结果告诉了他。
sentences.traditional: 醫生將檢查結果告訴了他。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiāng jiǎnchá jiéguǒ gàosu le tā.
sentences.translation: The doctor told him the examination result.

sentences.chinese: 我将来想当医生。
sentences.traditional: 我將來想當醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiānglái xiǎng dāng yīshēng.
sentences.translation: I want to be a doctor in the future.

sentences.chinese: 将来我们还会再见面。
sentences.traditional: 將來我們還會再見面。
sentences.pinyin: Jiānglái wǒmen hái huì zài jiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: We will meet again in the future.

sentences.chinese: 你打算将来住在哪儿？
sentences.traditional: 你打算將來住在哪兒？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn jiānglái zhù zài nǎr?
sentences.translation: Where do you plan to live in the future?

sentences.chinese: 火车将要进站了。
sentences.traditional: 火車將要進站了。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē jiāngyào jìnzhàn le.
sentences.translation: The train is about to enter the station.

sentences.chinese: 电影将要开始，请快一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 電影將要開始，請快一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng jiāngyào kāishǐ, qǐng kuài yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: The film is about to start, so please hurry a bit.

sentences.chinese: 天将要下雨了，带上伞吧。
sentences.traditional: 天將要下雨了，帶上傘吧。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān jiāngyào xiàyǔ le, dài shàng sǎn ba.
sentences.translation: It is about to rain, so take an umbrella.

sentences.chinese: 他得了一个很大的奖。
sentences.traditional: 他得了一個很大的獎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dé le yí ge hěn dà de jiǎng.
sentences.translation: He won a big prize.

sentences.chinese: 学校决定奖他一万元。
sentences.traditional: 學校決定獎他一萬元。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào juédìng jiǎng tā yí wàn yuán.
sentences.translation: The school decided to reward him with ten thousand yuan.

sentences.chinese: 这个奖是给优秀学生的。
sentences.traditional: 這個獎是給優秀學生的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiǎng shì gěi yōuxiù xuésheng de.
sentences.translation: This prize is for outstanding students.

sentences.chinese: 比赛第一名有五千元奖金。
sentences.traditional: 比賽第一名有五千元獎金。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài dì yì míng yǒu wǔ qiān yuán jiǎngjīn.
sentences.translation: First place in the competition has a bonus of five thousand yuan.

sentences.chinese: 他把奖金存进了银行。
sentences.traditional: 他把獎金存進了銀行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiǎngjīn cún jìn le yínháng.
sentences.translation: He deposited the bonus into the bank.

sentences.chinese: 这次奖金比去年高。
sentences.traditional: 這次獎金比去年高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jiǎngjīn bǐ qùnián gāo.
sentences.translation: This time the bonus is higher than last year’s.

sentences.chinese: 他因为成绩很好，拿到了奖学金。
sentences.traditional: 他因為成績很好，拿到了獎學金。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi chéngjì hěn hǎo, ná dào le jiǎngxuéjīn.
sentences.translation: Because his grades were very good, he got a scholarship.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想申请奖学金，得先交材料。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想申請獎學金，得先交材料。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn, děi xiān jiāo cáiliào.
sentences.translation: If you want to apply for a scholarship, you must first hand in the materials.

sentences.chinese: 学校给了她一笔奖学金，让她继续读书。
sentences.traditional: 學校給了她一筆獎學金，讓她繼續讀書。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào gěi le tā yì bǐ jiǎngxuéjīn, ràng tā jìxù dúshū.
sentences.translation: The school gave her a scholarship so that she could continue her studies.

sentences.chinese: 夜里气温降得很快。
sentences.traditional: 夜裡氣溫降得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Yèli qìwēn jiàng de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: The temperature drops quickly at night.

sentences.chinese: 价格一降，顾客就多了。
sentences.traditional: 價格一降，顧客就多了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé yí jiàng, gùkè jiù duō le.
sentences.translation: As soon as the price dropped, there were more customers.

sentences.chinese: 飞机慢慢降下来了。
sentences.traditional: 飛機慢慢降下來了。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī mànmàn jiàng xiàlai le.
sentences.translation: The plane slowly came down.

sentences.chinese: 为了安全，司机降低了车速。
sentences.traditional: 為了安全，司機降低了車速。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ānquán, sījī jiàngdī le chēsù.
sentences.translation: For safety, the driver reduced the speed.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司想降低成本。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司想降低成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī xiǎng jiàngdī chéngběn.
sentences.translation: This company wants to reduce costs.

sentences.chinese: 学校决定降低学费。
sentences.traditional: 學校決定降低學費。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào juédìng jiàngdī xuéfèi.
sentences.translation: The school decided to lower the tuition fees.

sentences.chinese: 这家店今天全部降价。
sentences.traditional: 這家店今天全部降價。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn jīntiān quánbù jiàngjià.
sentences.translation: This shop reduced all its prices today.

sentences.chinese: 如果再降价，我就买。
sentences.traditional: 如果再降價，我就買。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zài jiàngjià, wǒ jiù mǎi.
sentences.translation: If the price drops again, I will buy it.

sentences.chinese: 电脑降价以后，很多人来买。
sentences.traditional: 電腦降價以後，很多人來買。
sentences.pinyin: Diànnǎo jiàngjià yǐhòu, hěn duō rén lái mǎi.
sentences.translation: After the computers went on sale, many people came to buy them.

sentences.chinese: 飞机十分钟后降落。
sentences.traditional: 飛機十分鐘後降落。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī shí fēnzhōng hòu jiàngluò.
sentences.translation: The plane will land in ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 一只鸟降落在树上。
sentences.traditional: 一隻鳥降落在樹上。
sentences.pinyin: Yì zhī niǎo jiàngluò zài shù shàng.
sentences.translation: A bird landed on the tree.

sentences.chinese: 飞机已经安全降落了。
sentences.traditional: 飛機已經安全降落了。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī yǐjīng ānquán jiàngluò le.
sentences.translation: The plane has already landed safely.

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上会降温，别忘了带外套。
sentences.traditional: 今天晚上會降溫，別忘了帶外套。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang huì jiàngwēn, bié wàng le dài wàitào.
sentences.translation: The temperature will drop tonight, so do not forget to bring a coat.

sentences.chinese: 医生先给孩子降温。
sentences.traditional: 醫生先給孩子降溫。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xiān gěi háizi jiàngwēn.
sentences.translation: The doctor first lowered the child's temperature.

sentences.chinese: 下雨以后，天气开始降温。
sentences.traditional: 下雨以後，天氣開始降溫。
sentences.pinyin: Xià yǔ yǐhòu, tiānqì kāishǐ jiàngwēn.
sentences.translation: After it rained, the weather started to cool down.

sentences.chinese: 请把作业交给老师。
sentences.traditional: 請把作業交給老師。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: Please hand the homework to the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 我昨天交了报名表。
sentences.traditional: 我昨天交了報名表。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān jiāo le bàomíng biǎo.
sentences.translation: I handed in the registration form yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 他在学校交了很多朋友。
sentences.traditional: 他在學校交了很多朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào jiāo le hěn duō péngyou.
sentences.translation: He made many friends at school.

sentences.chinese: 你做得很好，我真为你骄傲。
sentences.traditional: 你做得很好，我真為你驕傲。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zuò de hěn hǎo, wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ jiāo’ào.
sentences.translation: You did very well, and I am truly proud of you.

sentences.chinese: 他得了第一名，可是一点儿也不骄傲。
sentences.traditional: 他得了第一名，可是一點兒也不驕傲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dé le dì yī míng, kěshì yìdiǎnr yě bù jiāo’ào.
sentences.translation: He got first place, but he is not arrogant at all.

sentences.chinese: 这是我们班的骄傲。
sentences.traditional: 這是我們班的驕傲。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen bān de jiāo’ào.
sentences.translation: This is the pride of our class.

sentences.chinese: 路口有交警在指挥车。
sentences.traditional: 路口有交警在指揮車。
sentences.pinyin: Lùkǒu yǒu jiāojǐng zài zhǐhuī chē.
sentences.translation: There is a traffic police officer directing traffic at the junction.

sentences.chinese: 那位交警帮老人过马路。
sentences.traditional: 那位交警幫老人過馬路。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi jiāojǐng bāng lǎorén guò mǎlù.
sentences.translation: That traffic police officer helped the elderly person cross the road.

sentences.chinese: 交警让司机靠边停车。
sentences.traditional: 交警讓司機靠邊停車。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāojǐng ràng sījī kào biān tíngchē.
sentences.translation: The traffic police officer told the driver to pull over.

sentences.chinese: 我们常常用中文交流。
sentences.traditional: 我們常常用中文交流。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen chángcháng yòng Zhōngwén jiāoliú.
sentences.translation: We often communicate in Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 开会的时候，大家可以自由交流想法。
sentences.traditional: 開會的時候，大家可以自由交流想法。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhou, dàjiā kěyǐ zìyóu jiāoliú xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: During the meeting, everyone can freely exchange ideas.

sentences.chinese: 跟当地人多交流，对学语言很有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 跟當地人多交流，對學語言很有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Gēn dāngdì rén duō jiāoliú, duì xué yǔyán hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: Communicating more with local people is very helpful for learning a language.

sentences.chinese: 我家在郊区，去市中心要半小时。
sentences.traditional: 我家在郊區，去市中心要半小時。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài jiāoqū, qù shì zhōngxīn yào bàn xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: My home is in the suburbs, and it takes half an hour to get to the city centre.

sentences.chinese: 这个周末我们打算去郊区走走。
sentences.traditional: 這個週末我們打算去郊區走走。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen dǎsuàn qù jiāoqū zǒuzou.
sentences.translation: This weekend we plan to go for a walk in the suburbs.

sentences.chinese: 郊区的空气比城里好一点。
sentences.traditional: 郊區的空氣比城裡好一點。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāoqū de kōngqì bǐ chéng lǐ hǎo yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The air in the suburbs is a bit better than in the city.

sentences.chinese: 早上这里的交通很忙。
sentences.traditional: 早上這裡的交通很忙。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang zhèlǐ de jiāotōng hěn máng.
sentences.translation: The traffic here is very busy in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 下雨的时候交通常常更慢。
sentences.traditional: 下雨的時候交通常常更慢。
sentences.pinyin: Xià yǔ de shíhou jiāotōng chángcháng gèng màn.
sentences.translation: Traffic is often even slower when it rains.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方交通方便，坐地铁很快。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方交通方便，坐地鐵很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang jiāotōng fāngbiàn, zuò dìtiě hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: Transport is convenient here, and the underground is fast.

sentences.chinese: 我们的教练很严格。
sentences.traditional: 我們的教練很嚴格。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de jiàoliàn hěn yángé.
sentences.translation: Our coach is very strict.

sentences.chinese: 教练让我们先跑三圈。
sentences.traditional: 教練讓我們先跑三圈。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoliàn ràng wǒmen xiān pǎo sān quān.
sentences.translation: The coach told us to run three laps first.

sentences.chinese: 他请教练帮他安排训练。
sentences.traditional: 他請教練幫他安排訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐng jiàoliàn bāng tā ānpái xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: He asked the coach to help arrange his training.

sentences.chinese: 她是一名中学教师。
sentences.traditional: 她是一名中學教師。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yì míng zhōngxué jiàoshī.
sentences.translation: She is a secondary school teacher.

sentences.chinese: 学校里有很多年轻教师。
sentences.traditional: 學校裡有很多年輕教師。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào lǐ yǒu hěn duō niánqīng jiàoshī.
sentences.translation: There are many young teachers at the school.

sentences.chinese: 教师这个工作很重要。
sentences.traditional: 教師這個工作很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshī zhège gōngzuò hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: The work of being a teacher is very important.

sentences.chinese: 王教授今天不上课。
sentences.traditional: 王教授今天不上課。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu jīntiān bú shàngkè.
sentences.translation: Professor Wang is not teaching today.

sentences.chinese: 这位教授教我们中文。
sentences.traditional: 這位教授教我們中文。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu jiāo wǒmen Zhōngwén.
sentences.translation: This professor teaches us Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 很多学生都喜欢这位教授。
sentences.traditional: 很多學生都喜歡這位教授。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō xuésheng dōu xǐhuan zhè wèi jiàoshòu.
sentences.translation: Many students like this professor.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校的教学很好。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校的教學很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào de jiàoxué hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: The teaching at this school is very good.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多学校都有网络教学。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多學校都有網絡教學。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō xuéxiào dōu yǒu wǎngluò jiàoxué.
sentences.translation: Many schools now have online teaching.

sentences.chinese: 好的教学能帮助学生进步。
sentences.traditional: 好的教學能幫助學生進步。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎo de jiàoxué néng bāngzhù xuésheng jìnbù.
sentences.translation: Good teaching can help students improve.

sentences.chinese: 家庭教育对孩子很重要。
sentences.traditional: 家庭教育對孩子很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Jiātíng jiàoyù duì háizi hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Family education is very important for children.

sentences.chinese: 学校教育不只是考试。
sentences.traditional: 學校教育不只是考試。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiàoyù bù zhǐshì kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: School education is not only about exams.

sentences.chinese: 这本书讲了很多教育问题。
sentences.traditional: 這本書講了很多教育問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎng le hěn duō jiàoyù wèntí.
sentences.translation: This book talks about many education issues.

sentences.chinese: 这种花叫作百合。
sentences.traditional: 這種花叫作百合。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huā jiàozuò bǎihé.
sentences.translation: This kind of flower is called a lily.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方叫作东湖。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方叫作東湖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang jiàozuò Dōnghú.
sentences.translation: This place is called East Lake.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌叫作《春天》。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌叫作《春天》。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē jiàozuò 'Chūntiān'.
sentences.translation: This song is called 'Spring'.

sentences.chinese: 雨后的街道很安静。
sentences.traditional: 雨後的街道很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu de jiēdào hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: The street is very quiet after the rain.

sentences.chinese: 街道两边有很多小店。
sentences.traditional: 街道兩邊有很多小店。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēdào liǎng biān yǒu hěn duō xiǎodiàn.
sentences.translation: There are many small shops on both sides of the street.

sentences.chinese: 这条街道晚上很热闹。
sentences.traditional: 這條街道晚上很熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào wǎnshang hěn rènao.
sentences.translation: This street is lively at night.

sentences.chinese: 他不能接受这个结果。
sentences.traditional: 他不能接受這個結果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù néng jiēshòu zhège jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: He cannot accept this result.

sentences.chinese: 我接受你的道歉。
sentences.traditional: 我接受你的道歉。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiēshòu nǐ de dàoqiàn.
sentences.translation: I accept your apology.

sentences.chinese: 学校已经接受了我的申请。
sentences.traditional: 學校已經接受了我的申請。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yǐjīng jiēshòu le wǒ de shēnqǐng.
sentences.translation: The school has already accepted my application.

sentences.chinese: 先写名字，接着写地址。
sentences.traditional: 先寫名字，接著寫地址。
sentences.pinyin: Xiān xiě míngzi, jiēzhe xiě dìzhǐ.
sentences.translation: First write your name, then write your address.

sentences.chinese: 老师讲完以后，接着回答了学生的问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師講完以後，接著回答了學生的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng wán yǐhòu, jiēzhe huídá le xuésheng de wèntí.
sentences.translation: After the teacher finished speaking, he then answered the students' questions.

sentences.chinese: 雨停了，大家接着出发。
sentences.traditional: 雨停了，大家接著出發。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, dàjiā jiēzhe chūfā.
sentences.translation: The rain stopped, and everyone then set off.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结果已经出来了。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結果已經出來了。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéguǒ yǐjīng chūlái le.
sentences.translation: The result of the match is already out.

sentences.chinese: 他没带伞，结果淋湿了。
sentences.traditional: 他沒帶傘，結果淋濕了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi dài sǎn, jiéguǒ línshī le.
sentences.translation: He did not bring an umbrella, and as a result got soaked.

sentences.chinese: 我等了很久，结果他没来。
sentences.traditional: 我等了很久，結果他沒來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ děng le hěn jiǔ, jiéguǒ tā méi lái.
sentences.translation: I waited a long time, but in the end he did not come.

sentences.chinese: 节假日的时候，车站人很多。
sentences.traditional: 節假日的時候，車站人很多。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéjiàrì de shíhou, chēzhàn rén hěn duō.
sentences.translation: During holidays, the station is very crowded.

sentences.chinese: 节假日我们常常去看爷爷奶奶。
sentences.traditional: 節假日我們常常去看爺爺奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéjiàrì wǒmen chángcháng qù kàn yéye nǎinai.
sentences.translation: We often go to see our grandparents during holidays.

sentences.chinese: 这个公园节假日不免费。
sentences.traditional: 這個公園節假日不免費。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán jiéjiàrì bù miǎnfèi.
sentences.translation: This park is not free on holidays.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该节约用水。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該節約用水。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jiéyuē yòng shuǐ.
sentences.translation: We should save water.

sentences.chinese: 为了节约时间，我们坐地铁。
sentences.traditional: 為了節約時間，我們坐地鐵。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiéyuē shíjiān, wǒmen zuò dìtiě.
sentences.translation: To save time, we took the underground.

sentences.chinese: 节约一点儿电，对环境也好。
sentences.traditional: 節約一點兒電，對環境也好。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéyuē yìdiǎnr diàn, duì huánjìng yě hǎo.
sentences.translation: Saving a little electricity is also good for the environment.

sentences.chinese: 我们吃完饭去前台结账。
sentences.traditional: 我們吃完飯去前臺結賬。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen chī wán fàn qù qiántái jiézhàng.
sentences.translation: After we finished eating, we went to the front desk to pay the bill.

sentences.chinese: 你是现在结账还是等一会儿？
sentences.traditional: 你是現在結賬還是等一會兒？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shì xiànzài jiézhàng háishi děng yíhuìr?
sentences.translation: Are you paying now or waiting a little while?

sentences.chinese: 结账的时候，他发现没带钱包。
sentences.traditional: 結賬的時候，他發現沒帶錢包。
sentences.pinyin: Jiézhàng de shíhou, tā fāxiàn méi dài qiánbāo.
sentences.translation: When it was time to pay, he realised he had not brought his wallet.

sentences.chinese: 这句话你能解释一下吗？
sentences.traditional: 這句話你能解釋一下嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jù huà nǐ néng jiěshì yíxià ma?
sentences.translation: Can you explain this sentence?

sentences.chinese: 老师解释得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 老師解釋得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiěshì de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The teacher explained it very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他解释了为什么迟到。
sentences.traditional: 他解釋了為什麼遲到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiěshì le wèishénme chídào.
sentences.translation: He explained why he was late.

sentences.chinese: 今后我会更加认真。
sentences.traditional: 今後我會更加認真。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnhòu wǒ huì gèngjiā rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: From now on, I will be more serious.

sentences.chinese: 今后有什么问题，可以告诉我。
sentences.traditional: 今後有什麼問題，可以告訴我。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnhòu yǒu shénme wèntí, kěyǐ gàosu wǒ.
sentences.translation: In future, if you have any questions, you can tell me.

sentences.chinese: 我们今后还会见面。
sentences.traditional: 我們今後還會見面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jīnhòu hái huì jiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: We will meet again in the future.

sentences.chinese: 这本书仅卖十块钱。
sentences.traditional: 這本書僅賣十塊錢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jǐn mài shí kuài qián.
sentences.translation: This book sells for only ten yuan.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动仅对学生开放。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動僅對學生開放。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng jǐn duì xuésheng kāifàng.
sentences.translation: This activity is open only to students.

sentences.chinese: 他仅看了一眼就走了。
sentences.traditional: 他僅看了一眼就走了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǐn kàn le yì yǎn jiù zǒu le.
sentences.translation: He only took one look and then left.

sentences.chinese: 尽管下雨，我们还是去了。
sentences.traditional: 儘管下雨，我們還是去了。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiàyǔ, wǒmen háishi qù le.
sentences.translation: Although it was raining, we still went.

sentences.chinese: 有问题你尽管问。
sentences.traditional: 有問題你儘管問。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí nǐ jǐnguǎn wèn.
sentences.translation: If you have questions, feel free to ask.

sentences.chinese: 尽管他很忙，他也来帮我们。
sentences.traditional: 儘管他很忙，他也來幫我們。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā hěn máng, tā yě lái bāng wǒmen.
sentences.translation: Although he was busy, he still came to help us.

sentences.chinese: 这不仅仅是一个游戏。
sentences.traditional: 這不僅僅是一個遊戲。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jǐnjǐn shì yí ge yóuxì.
sentences.translation: This is not merely a game.

sentences.chinese: 我们仅仅等了五分钟。
sentences.traditional: 我們僅僅等了五分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jǐnjǐn děng le wǔ fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: We waited only five minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他成功不是仅仅靠运气。
sentences.traditional: 他成功不是僅僅靠運氣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chénggōng bú shì jǐnjǐn kào yùnqì.
