sentences.translation: His success is not just due to luck.

sentences.chinese: 明天要考试了，我有点紧张。
sentences.traditional: 明天要考試了，我有點緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎoshì le, wǒ yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: The exam is tomorrow, and I am a bit nervous.

sentences.chinese: 开会的时候，大家的气氛很紧张。
sentences.traditional: 開會的時候，大家的氣氛很緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhou, dàjiā de qìfēn hěn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: During the meeting, the atmosphere was very tense.

sentences.chinese: 这几天我时间很紧张，不能出去玩。
sentences.traditional: 這幾天我時間很緊張，不能出去玩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān wǒ shíjiān hěn jǐnzhāng, bù néng chūqù wán.
sentences.translation: My time is very tight these days, so I cannot go out.

sentences.chinese: 请先敲门，再进入老师的办公室。
sentences.traditional: 請先敲門，再進入老師的辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān qiāomén, zài jìnrù lǎoshī de bàngōngshì.
sentences.translation: Please knock first, then enter the teacher's office.

sentences.chinese: 输入密码以后，就可以进入系统。
sentences.traditional: 輸入密碼以後，就可以進入系統。
sentences.pinyin: Shūrù mìmǎ yǐhòu, jiù kěyǐ jìnrù xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: After entering the password, you can access the system.

sentences.chinese: 他努力学习，终于进入了理想的大学。
sentences.traditional: 他努力學習，終於進入了理想的大學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǔlì xuéxí, zhōngyú jìnrù le lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
sentences.translation: He studied hard and finally got into his ideal university.

sentences.chinese: 比赛将在下周进行。
sentences.traditional: 比賽將在下週進行。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiāng zài xià zhōu jìnxíng.
sentences.translation: The competition will be held next week.

sentences.chinese: 医生正在给病人进行检查。
sentences.traditional: 醫生正在給病人進行檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài gěi bìngrén jìnxíng jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The doctor is examining the patient.

sentences.chinese: 会议进行到一半，突然停电了。
sentences.traditional: 會議進行到一半，突然停電了。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jìnxíng dào yíbàn, tūrán tíngdiàn le.
sentences.translation: Halfway through the meeting, the power suddenly went out.

sentences.chinese: 这里禁止吸烟，请大家注意。
sentences.traditional: 這裡禁止吸煙，請大家注意。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jìnzhǐ xīyān, qǐng dàjiā zhùyì.
sentences.translation: Smoking is prohibited here, please take note.

sentences.chinese: 老师禁止我们上课时玩手机。
sentences.traditional: 老師禁止我們上課時玩手機。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jìnzhǐ wǒmen shàngkè shí wán shǒujī.
sentences.translation: The teacher forbids us from playing with our phones in class.

sentences.chinese: 这个公园禁止带宠物进去。
sentences.traditional: 這個公園禁止帶寵物進去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán jìnzhǐ dài chǒngwù jìnqù.
sentences.translation: Pets are not allowed in this park.

sentences.chinese: 他昨天的演讲非常精彩。
sentences.traditional: 他昨天的演講非常精彩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuótiān de yǎnjiǎng fēicháng jīngcǎi.
sentences.translation: His speech yesterday was excellent.

sentences.chinese: 这场比赛比我们想的更精彩。
sentences.traditional: 這場比賽比我們想的更精彩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài bǐ wǒmen xiǎng de gèng jīngcǎi.
sentences.translation: This match was even more exciting than we expected.

sentences.chinese: 你一定要看最后一集，真的很精彩。
sentences.traditional: 你一定要看最後一集，真的很精彩。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yídìng yào kàn zuìhòu yì jí, zhēnde hěn jīngcǎi.
sentences.translation: You must watch the last episode; it is really exciting.

sentences.chinese: 最近的经济情况不太稳定。
sentences.traditional: 最近的經濟情況不太穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn de jīngjì qíngkuàng bú tài wěndìng.
sentences.translation: The recent economic situation has not been very stable.

sentences.chinese: 为了更经济一点，我们决定坐火车。
sentences.traditional: 為了更經濟一點，我們決定坐火車。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile gèng jīngjì yìdiǎn, wǒmen juédìng zuò huǒchē.
sentences.translation: To save money, we decided to take the train.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法比较经济，也很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法比較經濟，也很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ bǐjiào jīngjì, yě hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This method is more economical and also convenient.

sentences.chinese: 我爷爷很喜欢听京剧。
sentences.traditional: 我爺爺很喜歡聽京劇。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yéye hěn xǐhuan tīng Jīngjù.
sentences.translation: My grandpa really likes listening to Beijing opera.

sentences.chinese: 这是我第一次现场看京剧表演。
sentences.traditional: 這是我第一次現場看京劇表演。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yí cì xiànchǎng kàn Jīngjù biǎoyǎn.
sentences.translation: This is my first time watching a Beijing opera performance live.

sentences.chinese: 虽然我听不太懂京剧，但是觉得很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 雖然我聽不太懂京劇，但是覺得很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ tīng bù tài dǒng Jīngjù, dànshì juéde hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: Although I do not really understand Beijing opera, I find it interesting.

sentences.chinese: 他一个人经历了很多困难。
sentences.traditional: 他一個人經歷了很多困難。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén jīnglì le hěn duō kùnnan.
sentences.translation: He went through a lot of difficulties on his own.

sentences.chinese: 这次旅行是一次难忘的经历。
sentences.traditional: 這次旅行是一次難忘的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng shì yí cì nánwàng de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: This trip was an unforgettable experience.

sentences.chinese: 因为有这样的经历，她更能理解别人。
sentences.traditional: 因為有這樣的經歷，她更能理解別人。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu zhèyàng de jīnglì, tā gèng néng lǐjiě biérén.
sentences.translation: Because of such an experience, she can understand others better.

sentences.chinese: 他工作了几年，已经有不少经验。
sentences.traditional: 他工作了幾年，已經有不少經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò le jǐ nián, yǐjīng yǒu bù shǎo jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He has worked for several years and already has quite a bit of experience.

sentences.chinese: 做这件事以前，你最好先问问有经验的人。
sentences.traditional: 做這件事以前，你最好先問問有經驗的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò zhè jiàn shì yǐqián, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān wènwen yǒu jīngyàn de rén.
sentences.translation: Before doing this, you had better ask someone with experience.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败也给了我很宝贵的经验。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗也給了我很寶貴的經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài yě gěi le wǒ hěn bǎoguì de jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: This failure also gave me very valuable experience.

sentences.chinese: 遇到危险的时候，应该马上找警察。
sentences.traditional: 遇到危險的時候，應該馬上找警察。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào wēixiǎn de shíhou, yīnggāi mǎshàng zhǎo jǐngchá.
sentences.translation: When you are in danger, you should immediately find a police officer.

sentences.chinese: 警察很快就到了现场。
sentences.traditional: 警察很快就到了現場。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá hěn kuài jiù dào le xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: The police arrived at the scene very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他把钱包交给了路边的警察。
sentences.traditional: 他把錢包交給了路邊的警察。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ qiánbāo jiāo gěi le lùbiān de jǐngchá.
sentences.translation: He handed the wallet to a police officer by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市有很多有名的景点。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市有很多有名的景點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: This city has many famous tourist attractions.

sentences.chinese: 我们先去最受欢迎的景点看看。
sentences.traditional: 我們先去最受歡迎的景點看看。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù zuì shòu huānyíng de jǐngdiǎn kànkan.
sentences.translation: Let us first go and see the most popular attraction.

sentences.chinese: 这个景点离地铁站很近，走路就能到。
sentences.traditional: 這個景點離地鐵站很近，走路就能到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jǐngdiǎn lí dìtiězhàn hěn jìn, zǒulù jiù néng dào.
sentences.translation: This attraction is very close to the metro station, and you can get there on foot.

sentences.chinese: 这个景区一年四季都有很多游客。
sentences.traditional: 這個景區一年四季都有很多遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jǐngqū yì nián sì jì dōu yǒu hěn duō yóukè.
sentences.translation: This scenic area has lots of tourists all year round.

sentences.chinese: 进入景区以后，请不要乱扔垃圾。
sentences.traditional: 進入景區以後，請不要亂扔垃圾。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù jǐngqū yǐhòu, qǐng búyào luàn rēng lājī.
sentences.translation: After entering the scenic area, please do not litter.

sentences.chinese: 这个景区的门票比我想的便宜。
sentences.traditional: 這個景區的門票比我想的便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jǐngqū de ménpiào bǐ wǒ xiǎng de piányi.
sentences.translation: The ticket for this scenic area is cheaper than I expected.

sentences.chinese: 这里的景色真的很美，适合拍照。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的景色真的很美，適合拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jǐngsè zhēnde hěn měi, shìhé pāizhào.
sentences.translation: The scenery here is really beautiful and good for taking photos.

sentences.chinese: 山顶的景色和山下完全不一样。
sentences.traditional: 山頂的景色和山下完全不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Shāndǐng de jǐngsè hé shānxià wánquán bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: The scenery at the top of the mountain is completely different from that below.

sentences.chinese: 火车开过海边的时候，窗外的景色特别漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 火車開過海邊的時候，窗外的景色特別漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē kāi guò hǎibiān de shíhou, chuāngwài de jǐngsè tèbié piàoliang.
sentences.translation: When the train passed by the seaside, the scenery outside the window was especially beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 他竟然把这么重要的事忘了。
sentences.traditional: 他竟然把這麼重要的事忘了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìngrán bǎ zhème zhòngyào de shì wàng le.
sentences.translation: He unexpectedly forgot something so important.

sentences.chinese: 这么简单的问题，你竟然做错了。
sentences.traditional: 這麼簡單的問題，你竟然做錯了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhème jiǎndān de wèntí, nǐ jìngrán zuò cuò le.
sentences.translation: You actually got such a simple question wrong.

sentences.chinese: 我没想到她竟然会一个人去旅行。
sentences.traditional: 我沒想到她竟然會一個人去旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào tā jìngrán huì yí ge rén qù lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: I did not expect that she would actually travel alone.

sentences.chinese: 现在找工作的人很多，竞争很激烈。
sentences.traditional: 現在找工作的人很多，競爭很激烈。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài zhǎo gōngzuò de rén hěn duō, jìngzhēng hěn jīliè.
sentences.translation: There are many people looking for work now, and the competition is fierce.

sentences.chinese: 两家公司为了市场一直在竞争。
sentences.traditional: 兩家公司為了市場一直在競爭。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī wèile shìchǎng yìzhí zài jìngzhēng.
sentences.translation: The two companies have been competing for the market.

sentences.chinese: 如果想跟别人竞争，就得先提高自己。
sentences.traditional: 如果想跟別人競爭，就得先提高自己。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng gēn biérén jìngzhēng, jiù děi xiān tígāo zìjǐ.
sentences.translation: If you want to compete with others, you must first improve yourself.

sentences.chinese: 出门前，她总会先照一下镜子。
sentences.traditional: 出門前，她總會先照一下鏡子。
sentences.pinyin: Chūmén qián, tā zǒng huì xiān zhào yíxià jìngzi.
sentences.translation: Before going out, she always looks in the mirror first.

sentences.chinese: 墙上的镜子把房间显得更大了。
sentences.traditional: 牆上的鏡子把房間顯得更大了。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng de jìngzi bǎ fángjiān xiǎnde gèng dà le.
sentences.translation: The mirror on the wall makes the room look bigger.

sentences.chinese: 这面镜子太高，孩子看不见自己的脸。
sentences.traditional: 這面鏡子太高，孩子看不見自己的臉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè miàn jìngzi tài gāo, háizi kàn bújiàn zìjǐ de liǎn.
sentences.translation: This mirror is too high, and the child cannot see their own face.

sentences.chinese: 你究竟想说什么？
sentences.traditional: 你究竟想說什麼？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ jiūjìng xiǎng shuō shénme?
sentences.translation: What exactly are you trying to say?

sentences.chinese: 这件事究竟是谁做的？
sentences.traditional: 這件事究竟是誰做的？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiūjìng shì shéi zuò de?
sentences.translation: Who exactly did this?

sentences.chinese: 我到现在还不知道问题究竟出在哪儿。
sentences.traditional: 我到現在還不知道問題究竟出在哪兒。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dào xiànzài hái bù zhīdào wèntí jiūjìng chū zài nǎr.
sentences.translation: Even now I still do not know where exactly the problem lies.

sentences.chinese: 我找的就是这本书。
sentences.traditional: 我找的就是這本書。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo de jiùshì zhè běn shū.
sentences.translation: This is exactly the book I was looking for.

sentences.chinese: 他就是不想去，没有别的原因。
sentences.traditional: 他就是不想去，沒有別的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiùshì bù xiǎng qù, méiyǒu bié de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: He simply does not want to go; there is no other reason.

sentences.chinese: 就是下大雨，我们也要按时出发。
sentences.traditional: 就是下大雨，我們也要按時出發。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùshì xià dà yǔ, wǒmen yě yào ànshí chūfā.
sentences.translation: Even if it rains heavily, we still have to set off on time.

sentences.chinese: 上课的时候，有问题可以举手。
sentences.traditional: 上課的時候，有問題可以舉手。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou, yǒu wèntí kěyǐ jǔ shǒu.
sentences.translation: During class, you can raise your hand if you have a question.

sentences.chinese: 老师举了一个简单的例子来说明这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師舉了一個簡單的例子來說明這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jǔ le yí ge jiǎndān de lìzi lái shuōmíng zhège wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher gave a simple example to explain this problem.

sentences.chinese: 大家一致举他为代表去参加会议。
sentences.traditional: 大家一致舉他為代表去參加會議。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā yízhì jǔ tā wéi dàibiǎo qù cānjiā huìyì.
sentences.translation: Everyone unanimously recommended him as the representative to attend the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 学校下个月要举办运动会。
sentences.traditional: 學校下個月要舉辦運動會。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xià ge yuè yào jǔbàn yùndònghuì.
sentences.translation: The school will hold a sports meeting next month.

sentences.chinese: 为了庆祝节日，他们举办了一场晚会。
sentences.traditional: 為了慶祝節日，他們舉辦了一場晚會。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile qìngzhù jiérì, tāmen jǔbàn le yì chǎng wǎnhuì.
sentences.translation: To celebrate the festival, they organised an evening party.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动是由学生会举办的。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動是由學生會舉辦的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì yóu xuéshenghuì jǔbàn de.
sentences.translation: This event was organised by the student union.

sentences.chinese: 老师先举例说明这个问题，再让我们自己练习。
sentences.traditional: 老師先舉例說明這個問題，再讓我們自己練習。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān jǔlì shuōmíng zhège wèntí, zài ràng wǒmen zìjǐ liànxí.
sentences.translation: The teacher first used an example to explain this issue, then let us practise on our own.

sentences.chinese: 请你举例告诉我，什么样的人算有经验。
sentences.traditional: 請你舉例告訴我，什麼樣的人算有經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jǔlì gàosu wǒ, shénme yàng de rén suàn yǒu jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Please give an example and tell me what kind of person counts as experienced.

sentences.chinese: 他总是喜欢用自己的经历来举例。
sentences.traditional: 他總是喜歡用自己的經歷來舉例。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì xǐhuan yòng zìjǐ de jīnglì lái jǔlì.
sentences.translation: He always likes to use his own experiences as examples.

sentences.chinese: 我们学校下周将举行一次汉语演讲比赛。
sentences.traditional: 我們學校下週將舉行一次漢語演講比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào xià zhōu jiāng jǔxíng yí cì Hànyǔ yǎnjiǎng bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Our school will hold a Chinese speech contest next week.

sentences.chinese: 婚礼将在海边举行，很多朋友都会来。
sentences.traditional: 婚禮將在海邊舉行，很多朋友都會來。
sentences.pinyin: Hūnlǐ jiāng zài hǎibiān jǔxíng, hěn duō péngyou dōu huì lái.
sentences.translation: The wedding will be held by the sea, and many friends will come.

sentences.chinese: 会议已经按计划举行了。
sentences.traditional: 會議已經按計劃舉行了。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yǐjīng àn jìhuà jǔxíng le.
sentences.translation: The meeting has already been held as planned.

sentences.chinese: 下班以后，大家常聚在楼下的小店聊天。
sentences.traditional: 下班以後，大家常聚在樓下的小店聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, dàjiā cháng jù zài lóuxià de xiǎodiàn liáotiān.
sentences.translation: After work, everyone often gathers at the little shop downstairs to chat.

sentences.chinese: 过年时，全家人都会聚在爷爷奶奶家。
sentences.traditional: 過年時，全家人都會聚在爺爺奶奶家。
sentences.pinyin: Guònián shí, quán jiārén dōu huì jù zài yéye nǎinai jiā.
sentences.translation: During the New Year, the whole family gathers at the grandparents' home.

sentences.chinese: 雨越下越大，路边的人都聚到屋檐下避雨。
sentences.traditional: 雨越下越大，路邊的人都聚到屋簷下避雨。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ yuè xià yuè dà, lùbiān de rén dōu jù dào wūyán xià bìyǔ.
sentences.translation: As the rain got heavier, people by the roadside gathered under the eaves to shelter from it.

sentences.chinese: 为了欢迎新同事，我们晚上一起聚餐。
sentences.traditional: 為了歡迎新同事，我們晚上一起聚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huānyíng xīn tóngshì, wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ jùcān.
sentences.translation: To welcome the new colleague, we are having dinner together tonight.

sentences.chinese: 因为大家时间不一样，这次聚餐改到周五。
sentences.traditional: 因為大家時間不一樣，這次聚餐改到週五。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi dàjiā shíjiān bù yíyàng, zhè cì jùcān gǎi dào Zhōuwǔ.
sentences.translation: Because everyone's schedules are different, this dinner gathering has been moved to Friday.

sentences.chinese: 毕业前，我们班最后一次聚餐特别热闹。
sentences.traditional: 畢業前，我們班最後一次聚餐特別熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyè qián, wǒmen bān zuìhòu yí cì jùcān tèbié rènào.
sentences.translation: Before graduation, our class's last dinner together was especially lively.

sentences.chinese: 她很少参加聚会，更喜欢一个人待在家里。
sentences.traditional: 她很少參加聚會，更喜歡一個人待在家裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn shǎo cānjiā jùhuì, gèng xǐhuan yí ge rén dāi zài jiālǐ.
sentences.translation: She rarely attends gatherings and prefers staying at home alone.

sentences.chinese: 周末我们打算在老地方聚会，顺便聊聊近况。
sentences.traditional: 週末我們打算在老地方聚會，順便聊聊近況。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen dǎsuàn zài lǎo dìfang jùhuì, shùnbiàn liáoliao jìnkuàng.
sentences.translation: At the weekend, we plan to get together at the old place and chat about how things have been.

sentences.chinese: 昨晚的聚会一直到十一点才结束。
sentences.traditional: 昨晚的聚會一直到十一點才結束。
sentences.pinyin: Zuówǎn de jùhuì yìzhí dào shíyī diǎn cái jiéshù.
sentences.translation: Last night's gathering did not end until eleven o'clock.

sentences.chinese: 他拒绝了那份工作，因为离家太远。
sentences.traditional: 他拒絕了那份工作，因為離家太遠。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jùjué le nà fèn gōngzuò, yīnwèi lí jiā tài yuǎn.
sentences.translation: He turned down that job because it was too far from home.

sentences.chinese: 我本来想帮他付钱，但被他拒绝了。
sentences.traditional: 我本來想幫他付錢，但被他拒絕了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng bāng tā fù qián, dàn bèi tā jùjué le.
sentences.translation: I originally wanted to pay for him, but he refused.

sentences.chinese: 面对不合理的要求，我们应该学会拒绝。
sentences.traditional: 面對不合理的要求，我們應該學會拒絕。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì bù hélǐ de yāoqiú, wǒmen yīnggāi xuéhuì jùjué.
sentences.translation: When facing unreasonable demands, we should learn to say no.

sentences.chinese: 我家距离公司不远，坐地铁二十分钟就到。
sentences.traditional: 我家距離公司不遠，坐地鐵二十分鐘就到。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā jùlí gōngsī bù yuǎn, zuò dìtiě èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
sentences.translation: My home is not far from the company; it takes only twenty minutes by underground.

sentences.chinese: 从这里到机场的距离大概有三十公里。
sentences.traditional: 從這裡到機場的距離大概有三十公里。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào jīchǎng de jùlí dàgài yǒu sānshí gōnglǐ.
sentences.translation: The distance from here to the airport is about thirty kilometres.

sentences.chinese: 虽然我们距离很远，但一直保持联系。
sentences.traditional: 雖然我們距離很遠，但一直保持聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen jùlí hěn yuǎn, dàn yìzhí bǎochí liánxì.
sentences.translation: Although we live far apart, we have kept in touch all along.

sentences.chinese: 这家剧院的历史已经超过一百年了。
sentences.traditional: 這家劇院的歷史已經超過一百年了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jùyuàn de lìshǐ yǐjīng chāoguò yì bǎi nián le.
sentences.translation: The history of this theatre already goes back more than a hundred years.

sentences.chinese: 演出开始前，观众已经在剧院门口排起了长队。
sentences.traditional: 演出開始前，觀眾已經在劇院門口排起了長隊。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnchū kāishǐ qián, guānzhòng yǐjīng zài jùyuàn ménkǒu pái qǐ le chángduì.
sentences.translation: Before the performance began, the audience had already formed a long queue outside the theatre.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想看京剧，我可以陪你去那个剧院。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想看京劇，我可以陪你去那個劇院。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng kàn Jīngjù, wǒ kěyǐ péi nǐ qù nà ge jùyuàn.
sentences.translation: If you want to see Beijing opera, I can go with you to that theatre.

sentences.chinese: 别生气，我刚才只是跟你开玩笑。
sentences.traditional: 別生氣，我剛才只是跟你開玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: Bié shēngqì, wǒ gāngcái zhǐshì gēn nǐ kāi wánxiào.
sentences.translation: Don't be angry; I was only joking with you just now.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很认真，其实很喜欢跟朋友开玩笑。
sentences.traditional: 他看起來很認真，其實很喜歡跟朋友開玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn rènzhēn, qíshí hěn xǐhuan gēn péngyou kāi wánxiào.
sentences.translation: He looks serious, but actually he really likes joking with friends.

sentences.chinese: 这种事情不能开玩笑，必须认真对待。
sentences.traditional: 這種事情不能開玩笑，必須認真對待。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shìqing bù néng kāi wánxiào, bìxū rènzhēn duìdài.
sentences.translation: You cannot joke about this kind of thing; it must be taken seriously.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都有自己的看法，没有必要完全一样。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都有自己的看法，沒有必要完全一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de kànfa, méiyǒu bìyào wánquán yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Everyone has their own views, and there is no need for them to be exactly the same.

sentences.chinese: 听了大家的看法以后，我改变了主意。
sentences.traditional: 聽了大家的看法以後，我改變了主意。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng le dàjiā de kànfa yǐhòu, wǒ gǎibiàn le zhǔyi.
sentences.translation: After hearing everyone's views, I changed my mind.

sentences.chinese: 在这个问题上，老师和学生的看法不太一样。
sentences.traditional: 在這個問題上，老師和學生的看法不太一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shàng, lǎoshī hé xuésheng de kànfa bù tài yíyàng.
sentences.translation: On this issue, the teacher's and the students' views are not quite the same.

sentences.chinese: 周末我们常在院子里烤玉米和红薯。
sentences.traditional: 週末我們常在院子裡烤玉米和紅薯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen cháng zài yuànzi li kǎo yùmǐ hé hóngshǔ.
sentences.translation: At weekends, we often grill corn and sweet potatoes in the yard.

sentences.chinese: 这家店烤的鱼很香，所以每天都有很多客人。
sentences.traditional: 這家店烤的魚很香，所以每天都有很多客人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn kǎo de yú hěn xiāng, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu yǒu hěn duō kèrén.
sentences.translation: The fish grilled by this shop smells delicious, so it has many customers every day.

sentences.chinese: 面包在烤箱里烤了二十分钟以后就可以吃了。
sentences.traditional: 麵包在烤箱裡烤了二十分鐘以後就可以吃了。
sentences.pinyin: Miànbāo zài kǎoxiāng li kǎo le èrshí fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù kěyǐ chī le.
sentences.translation: After the bread has baked in the oven for twenty minutes, it can be eaten.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作工资不错，不过我还想再考虑几天。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作工資不錯，不過我還想再考慮幾天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò gōngzī búcuò, búguò wǒ hái xiǎng zài kǎolǜ jǐ tiān.
sentences.translation: The salary for this job is good, but I still want to think it over for a few days.

sentences.chinese: 你做决定以前，应该先考虑清楚后果。
sentences.traditional: 你做決定以前，應該先考慮清楚後果。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zuò juédìng yǐqián, yīnggāi xiān kǎolǜ qīngchu hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, you should first think clearly about the consequences.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在考虑明年把办公室搬到市中心。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在考慮明年把辦公室搬到市中心。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài kǎolǜ míngnián bǎ bàngōngshì bān dào shì zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: The company is considering moving its office to the city centre next year.

sentences.chinese: 考试开始前，考生必须先出示身份证。
sentences.traditional: 考試開始前，考生必須先出示身份證。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ qián, kǎoshēng bìxū xiān chūshì shēnfènzhèng.
sentences.translation: Before the exam begins, examinees must first show their ID cards.

sentences.chinese: 今年参加高考的考生比去年更多。
sentences.traditional: 今年參加高考的考生比去年更多。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián cānjiā gāokǎo de kǎoshēng bǐ qùnián gèng duō.
sentences.translation: More examinees are taking the university entrance exam this year than last year.

sentences.chinese: 对很多考生来说，保持冷静比什么都重要。
sentences.traditional: 對很多考生來說，保持冷靜比什麼都重要。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō kǎoshēng lái shuō, bǎochí lěngjìng bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: For many examinees, staying calm is more important than anything else.

sentences.chinese: 门口那棵树已经有几十年的历史了。
sentences.traditional: 門口那棵樹已經有幾十年的歷史了。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu nà kē shù yǐjīng yǒu jǐshí nián de lìshǐ le.
sentences.translation: That tree by the entrance already has a history of several decades.

sentences.chinese: 院子里种了两棵苹果树，春天开花很好看。
sentences.traditional: 院子裡種了兩棵蘋果樹，春天開花很好看。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzi li zhòng le liǎng kē píngguǒshù, chūntiān kāihuā hěn hǎokàn.
sentences.translation: Two apple trees are planted in the yard, and they look beautiful when they bloom in spring.

sentences.chinese: 山上有一棵特别高的松树，远远就能看见。
sentences.traditional: 山上有一棵特別高的松樹，遠遠就能看見。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shàng yǒu yì kē tèbié gāo de sōngshù, yuǎnyuǎn jiù néng kànjiàn.
sentences.translation: There is an especially tall pine tree on the mountain that can be seen from far away.

sentences.chinese: 现在的科技发展得越来越快，生活也方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 現在的科技發展得越來越快，生活也方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì fāzhǎn de yuèláiyuè kuài, shēnghuó yě fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: Science and technology are developing faster and faster now, and life has become much more convenient too.

sentences.chinese: 很多年轻人希望将来从事科技方面的工作。
sentences.traditional: 很多年輕人希望將來從事科技方面的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng rén xīwàng jiānglái cóngshì kējì fāngmiàn de gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: Many young people hope to work in science and technology in the future.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市因为科技产业发达，吸引了不少人才。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市因為科技產業發達，吸引了不少人才。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yīnwèi kējì chǎnyè fādá, xīyǐn le bù shǎo réncái.
sentences.translation: This city has attracted quite a few talented people because its technology industry is well developed.

sentences.chinese: 我弟弟从小就对科学很感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 我弟弟從小就對科學很感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi cóngxiǎo jiù duì kēxué hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: My younger brother has been very interested in science since he was little.

sentences.chinese: 这种减肥方法一点儿也不科学，你最好别试。
sentences.traditional: 這種減肥方法一點兒也不科學，你最好別試。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiǎnféi fāngfǎ yìdiǎnr yě bù kēxué, nǐ zuìhǎo bié shì.
sentences.translation: This way of losing weight is not scientific at all; you'd better not try it.

sentences.chinese: 老师常常鼓励我们用科学的方法解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師常常鼓勵我們用科學的方法解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī chángcháng gǔlì wǒmen yòng kēxué de fāngfǎ jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher often encourages us to solve problems using scientific methods.

sentences.chinese: 他一感冒就一直咳，晚上也睡不好。
sentences.traditional: 他一感冒就一直咳，晚上也睡不好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì gǎnmào jiù yìzhí ké, wǎnshang yě shuì bù hǎo.
sentences.translation: Whenever he catches a cold, he keeps coughing and cannot sleep well at night either.

sentences.chinese: 说话之前她先轻轻地咳了一声。
sentences.traditional: 說話之前她先輕輕地咳了一聲。
sentences.pinyin: Shuōhuà zhīqián tā xiān qīngqīng de ké le yì shēng.
sentences.translation: Before speaking, she first gave a light cough.

sentences.chinese: 屋里太干了，孩子早上起来总是会咳。
sentences.traditional: 屋裡太乾了，孩子早上起來總是會咳。
sentences.pinyin: Wū li tài gān le, háizi zǎoshang qǐlái zǒngshì huì ké.
sentences.translation: The room is too dry, so the child always coughs when getting up in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 你咳嗽这么厉害，还是去医院看看吧。
sentences.traditional: 你咳嗽這麼厲害，還是去醫院看看吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ késou zhème lìhai, háishi qù yīyuàn kànkan ba.
sentences.translation: You are coughing so badly; you should still go to the hospital and get checked.

sentences.chinese: 他昨晚一直咳嗽，所以今天没有来上班。
sentences.traditional: 他昨晚一直咳嗽，所以今天沒有來上班。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuówǎn yìzhí késou, suǒyǐ jīntiān méiyǒu lái shàngbān.
sentences.translation: He kept coughing last night, so he did not come to work today.

sentences.chinese: 春天天气变化大，很多人容易感冒咳嗽。
sentences.traditional: 春天天氣變化大，很多人容易感冒咳嗽。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān tiānqì biànhuà dà, hěn duō rén róngyì gǎnmào késou.
sentences.translation: Spring weather changes a lot, so many people easily catch colds and cough.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的菜很好吃，可惜离我家太远了。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的菜很好吃，可惜離我家太遠了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de cài hěn hǎochī, kěxī lí wǒ jiā tài yuǎn le.
sentences.translation: The food at this shop is very tasty; it's just a pity that it is too far from my home.

sentences.chinese: 他本来可以参加比赛，可惜突然发烧了。
sentences.traditional: 他本來可以參加比賽，可惜突然發燒了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā běnlái kěyǐ cānjiā bǐsài, kěxī tūrán fāshāo le.
sentences.translation: He could originally have taken part in the competition, but unfortunately he suddenly got a fever.

sentences.chinese: 电影快结束的时候我才到，真可惜。
sentences.traditional: 電影快結束的時候我才到，真可惜。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng kuài jiéshù de shíhou wǒ cái dào, zhēn kěxī.
sentences.translation: I only arrived when the film was almost over; what a pity.

sentences.chinese: 这个蛋糕太甜了，我只吃了五十克。
sentences.traditional: 這個蛋糕太甜了，我只吃了五十克。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dàngāo tài tián le, wǒ zhǐ chī le wǔshí kè.
sentences.translation: This cake is too sweet, so I only ate fifty grams.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他每天少吃二十克盐。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他每天少吃二十克鹽。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān shǎo chī èrshí kè yán.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to eat twenty grams less salt each day.

sentences.chinese: 这包咖啡一共二百五十克，差不多能喝一个月。
sentences.traditional: 這包咖啡一共二百五十克，差不多能喝一個月。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bāo kāfēi yígòng èrbǎi wǔshí kè, chàbuduō néng hē yí ge yuè.
sentences.translation: This bag of coffee is 250 grams in total, which is enough for about a month.

sentences.chinese: 这学期的课程比上学期难多了。
sentences.traditional: 這學期的課程比上學期難多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī de kèchéng bǐ shàng xuéqī nán duō le.
sentences.translation: This term's courses are much harder than last term's.

sentences.chinese: 如果你对这门课程不满意，可以下周申请换班。
sentences.traditional: 如果你對這門課程不滿意，可以下週申請換班。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ duì zhè mén kèchéng bù mǎnyì, kěyǐ xià zhōu shēnqǐng huàn bān.
sentences.translation: If you are not satisfied with this course, you can apply to change classes next week.

sentences.chinese: 这门课程除了考试以外，还要写一篇报告。
sentences.traditional: 這門課程除了考試以外，還要寫一篇報告。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng chúle kǎoshì yǐwài, hái yào xiě yì piān bàogào.
sentences.translation: Besides the exam, this course also requires writing a report.

sentences.chinese: 都是自己人，你不用这么客气。
sentences.traditional: 都是自己人，你不用這麼客氣。
sentences.pinyin: Dōu shì zìjǐ rén, nǐ bú yòng zhème kèqi.
sentences.translation: We're all friends here, so you don't need to be so polite.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然很客气，但是总给人一种距离感。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然很客氣，但是總給人一種距離感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn kèqi, dànshì zǒng gěi rén yì zhǒng jùlí gǎn.
sentences.translation: Although he is very polite, he always gives people a sense of distance.

sentences.chinese: 你帮了我这么大的忙，我跟你客气一点儿也是应该的。
sentences.traditional: 你幫了我這麼大的忙，我跟你客氣一點兒也是應該的。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bāng le wǒ zhème dà de máng, wǒ gēn nǐ kèqi yìdiǎnr yě shì yīnggāi de.
sentences.translation: You've helped me so much, so it's only right for me to be a bit more polite to you.

sentences.chinese: 老师一进课堂，同学们就安静下来了。
sentences.traditional: 老師一進課堂，同學們就安靜下來了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yí jìn kètáng, tóngxuémen jiù ānjìng xiàlái le.
sentences.translation: As soon as the teacher entered the classroom, the students quieted down.

sentences.chinese: 这位老师很会调动课堂气氛。
sentences.traditional: 這位老師很會調動課堂氣氛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī hěn huì tiáodòng kètáng qìfēn.
sentences.translation: This teacher is very good at livening up the classroom atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 在课堂上遇到不懂的问题，要马上提出来。
sentences.traditional: 在課堂上遇到不懂的問題，要馬上提出來。
sentences.pinyin: Zài kètáng shàng yùdào bù dǒng de wèntí, yào mǎshàng tíchūlái.
sentences.translation: If you come across something you don't understand in class, raise it at once.

sentences.chinese: 我家的客厅虽然不大，但是很明亮。
sentences.traditional: 我家的客廳雖然不大，但是很明亮。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de kètīng suīrán bú dà, dànshì hěn míngliàng.
sentences.translation: My living room isn't big, but it is very bright.

sentences.chinese: 客人来了以后，都先坐在客厅聊天。
sentences.traditional: 客人來了以後，都先坐在客廳聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Kèrén lái le yǐhòu, dōu xiān zuò zài kètīng liáotiān.
sentences.translation: After guests arrive, they all sit in the living room and chat first.

sentences.chinese: 他把新买的沙发放在客厅中间。
sentences.traditional: 他把新買的沙發放在客廳中間。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xīn mǎi de shāfā fàng zài kètīng zhōngjiān.
sentences.translation: He put the newly bought sofa in the middle of the living room.

sentences.chinese: 你这么努力，肯定能通过这次考试。
sentences.traditional: 你這麼努力，肯定能通過這次考試。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhème nǔlì, kěndìng néng tōngguò zhè cì kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: You are working so hard that you will surely pass this exam.

sentences.chinese: 他对我的想法表示肯定，让我更有信心了。
sentences.traditional: 他對我的想法表示肯定，讓我更有信心了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ de xiǎngfǎ biǎoshì kěndìng, ràng wǒ gèng yǒu xìnxīn le.
sentences.translation: He expressed approval of my idea, which made me more confident.

sentences.chinese: 我现在还不能肯定他明天会不会来。
sentences.traditional: 我現在還不能肯定他明天會不會來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài hái bùnéng kěndìng tā míngtiān huì bú huì lái.
sentences.translation: I still can't be sure whether he will come tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 这个箱子是空的，里面什么都没有。
sentences.traditional: 這個箱子是空的，裡面什麼都沒有。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi shì kōng de, lǐmiàn shénme dōu méiyǒu.
sentences.translation: This box is empty; there is nothing inside.

sentences.chinese: 楼下那间办公室已经空了好几个月。
sentences.traditional: 樓下那間辦公室已經空了好幾個月。
sentences.pinyin: Lóuxià nà jiān bàngōngshì yǐjīng kōng le hǎo jǐ ge yuè.
sentences.translation: That office downstairs has been vacant for several months already.

sentences.chinese: 他早上没吃饭，空着肚子就去开会了。
sentences.traditional: 他早上沒吃飯，空著肚子就去開會了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǎoshang méi chīfàn, kōng zhe dùzi jiù qù kāihuì le.
sentences.translation: He went to the meeting on an empty stomach because he had not eaten breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 下雨以后，山里的空气特别新鲜。
sentences.traditional: 下雨以後，山裡的空氣特別新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ yǐhòu, shān lǐ de kōngqì tèbié xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: After it rains, the air in the mountains is especially fresh.

sentences.chinese: 这间办公室不开窗，空气不太好。
sentences.traditional: 這間辦公室不開窗，空氣不太好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiān bàngōngshì bù kāi chuāng, kōngqì bú tài hǎo.
sentences.translation: The air in this office is not very good because the windows are not opened.

sentences.chinese: 早上出去散步，呼吸一下新鲜空气，对身体有好处。
sentences.traditional: 早上出去散步，呼吸一下新鮮空氣，對身體有好處。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang chūqù sànbù, hūxī yíxià xīnxiān kōngqì, duì shēntǐ yǒu hǎochu.
sentences.translation: Going for a walk in the morning and breathing some fresh air is good for your health.

sentences.chinese: 这么大的雨，恐怕飞机要晚点了。
sentences.traditional: 這麼大的雨，恐怕飛機要晚點了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhème dà de yǔ, kǒngpà fēijī yào wǎndiǎn le.
sentences.translation: With rain this heavy, I'm afraid the plane will be delayed.

sentences.chinese: 这件事比我们想的复杂，恐怕今天解决不了。
sentences.traditional: 這件事比我們想的複雜，恐怕今天解決不了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bǐ wǒmen xiǎng de fùzá, kǒngpà jīntiān jiějué bù liǎo.
sentences.translation: This matter is more complicated than we thought, so I am afraid it cannot be solved today.

sentences.chinese: 他脸色这么差，恐怕是没休息好。
sentences.traditional: 他臉色這麼差，恐怕是沒休息好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liǎnsè zhème chà, kǒngpà shì méi xiūxi hǎo.
sentences.translation: His complexion looks so bad that he probably did not rest well.

sentences.chinese: 这周我太忙了，恐怕空不出时间见你。
sentences.traditional: 這週我太忙了，恐怕空不出時間見你。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhōu wǒ tài máng le, kǒngpà kòng bù chū shíjiān jiàn nǐ.
sentences.translation: I'm too busy this week and probably can't free up time to see you.

sentences.chinese: 你要是明天下午有空，我们一起去看展览吧。
sentences.traditional: 你要是明天下午有空，我們一起去看展覽吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn zhǎnlǎn ba.
sentences.translation: If you are free tomorrow afternoon, let us go to see the exhibition together.

sentences.chinese: 等我把手上的工作做完，就空下来陪孩子。
sentences.traditional: 等我把手上的工作做完，就空下來陪孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Děng wǒ bǎ shǒu shàng de gōngzuò zuò wán, jiù kòng xiàlái péi háizi.
sentences.translation: Once I finish the work at hand, I will free up time to spend with the child.

sentences.chinese: 他的口语进步很快，已经能跟外国人聊天了。
sentences.traditional: 他的口語進步很快，已經能跟外國人聊天了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de kǒuyǔ jìnbù hěn kuài, yǐjīng néng gēn wàiguórén liáotiān le.
sentences.translation: His spoken Chinese has improved quickly, and he can already chat with foreigners.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章适合书面表达，不太适合口语。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章適合書面表達，不太適合口語。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng shìhé shūmiàn biǎodá, bú tài shìhé kǒuyǔ.
sentences.translation: This article suits written expression and is not very suitable for spoken language.

sentences.chinese: 学外语的时候，多练习口语非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 學外語的時候，多練習口語非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ de shíhou, duō liànxí kǒuyǔ fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When learning a foreign language, practising speaking a lot is very important.

sentences.chinese: 这个药有点儿苦，你喝完以后吃颗糖吧。
sentences.traditional: 這個藥有點兒苦，你喝完以後吃顆糖吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yào yǒudiǎnr kǔ, nǐ hē wán yǐhòu chī kē táng ba.
sentences.translation: This medicine is a bit bitter; have a sweet after finishing it.

sentences.chinese: 咖啡太苦了，我想加一点儿牛奶。
sentences.traditional: 咖啡太苦了，我想加一點兒牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: Kāfēi tài kǔ le, wǒ xiǎng jiā yìdiǎnr niúnǎi.
sentences.translation: The coffee is too bitter, so I want to add a little milk.

sentences.chinese: 这种菜虽然有点儿苦，但是对身体很好。
sentences.traditional: 這種菜雖然有點兒苦，但是對身體很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cài suīrán yǒudiǎnr kǔ, dànshì duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although this vegetable is a bit bitter, it is very good for the body.

sentences.chinese: 为了省时间，他中午常吃快餐。
sentences.traditional: 為了省時間，他中午常吃快餐。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shěng shíjiān, tā zhōngwǔ cháng chī kuàicān.
sentences.translation: To save time, he often eats fast food at noon.

sentences.chinese: 这种快餐虽然方便，但是不太健康。
sentences.traditional: 這種快餐雖然方便，但是不太健康。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kuàicān suīrán fāngbiàn, dànshì bú tài jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: This kind of fast food is convenient, but it is not very healthy.

sentences.chinese: 我偶尔吃一次快餐，可是不想天天吃。
sentences.traditional: 我偶爾吃一次快餐，可是不想天天吃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ǒu'ěr chī yí cì kuàicān, kěshì bù xiǎng tiāntiān chī.
sentences.translation: I eat fast food occasionally, but I do not want to eat it every day.

sentences.chinese: 我买的书已经用快递寄到了。
sentences.traditional: 我買的書已經用快遞寄到了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi de shū yǐjīng yòng kuàidì jì dào le.
sentences.translation: The book I bought has already been delivered by express.

sentences.chinese: 如果你着急，可以选择快递服务。
sentences.traditional: 如果你著急，可以選擇快遞服務。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ zháojí, kěyǐ xuǎnzé kuàidì fúwù.
sentences.translation: If you are in a hurry, you can choose express delivery service.

sentences.chinese: 楼下有人按门铃，说是送快递的。
sentences.traditional: 樓下有人按門鈴，說是送快遞的。
sentences.pinyin: Lóuxià yǒu rén àn ménlíng, shuō shì sòng kuàidì de.
sentences.translation: Someone downstairs rang the bell and said they were delivering a parcel.

sentences.chinese: 这辆高铁速度很快，可以快速到达市中心。
sentences.traditional: 這輛高鐵速度很快，可以快速到達市中心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng gāotiě sùdù hěn kuài, kěyǐ kuàisù dàodá shì zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: This high-speed train is very fast and can reach the city centre quickly.

sentences.chinese: 医生快速看了一下检查结果。
sentences.traditional: 醫生快速看了一下檢查結果。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kuàisù kàn le yíxià jiǎnchá jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: The doctor quickly looked over the test results.

sentences.chinese: 在紧急情况下，我们必须快速做出决定。
sentences.traditional: 在緊急情況下，我們必須快速做出決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, wǒmen bìxū kuàisù zuòchū juédìng.
sentences.translation: In an emergency, we must make decisions quickly.

sentences.chinese: 昨晚睡得太晚了，我现在有点儿困。
sentences.traditional: 昨晚睡得太晚了，我現在有點兒困。
sentences.pinyin: Zuówǎn shuì de tài wǎn le, wǒ xiànzài yǒudiǎnr kùn.
sentences.translation: I went to bed too late last night, so I am a bit sleepy now.

sentences.chinese: 上课的时候如果太困，可以站起来听。
sentences.traditional: 上課的時候如果太困，可以站起來聽。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou rúguǒ tài kùn, kěyǐ zhàn qǐlái tīng.
sentences.translation: If you are too sleepy in class, you can stand up and listen.

sentences.chinese: 吃完午饭以后，我常常觉得很困。
sentences.traditional: 吃完午飯以後，我常常覺得很困。
sentences.pinyin: Chī wán wǔfàn yǐhòu, wǒ chángcháng juéde hěn kùn.
sentences.translation: After lunch, I often feel very sleepy.

sentences.chinese: 虽然过程很困难，但是我们还是坚持下来了。
sentences.traditional: 雖然過程很困難，但是我們還是堅持下來了。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán guòchéng hěn kùnnan, dànshì wǒmen háishi jiānchí xiàlái le.
sentences.translation: Although the process was difficult, we still kept going.

sentences.chinese: 学习新的发音对很多人来说是个困难。
sentences.traditional: 學習新的發音對很多人來說是個困難。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí xīn de fāyīn duì hěn duō rén lái shuō shì ge kùnnan.
sentences.translation: Learning new pronunciation is a difficulty for many people.

sentences.chinese: 遇到困难的时候，不要马上放弃。
sentences.traditional: 遇到困難的時候，不要馬上放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, bú yào mǎshàng fàngqì.
sentences.translation: When you run into difficulties, do not give up at once.

sentences.chinese: 门有点儿重，要用力拉一下。
sentences.traditional: 門有點兒重，要用力拉一下。
sentences.pinyin: Mén yǒudiǎnr zhòng, yào yònglì lā yíxià.
sentences.translation: The door is a bit heavy, so you need to pull it hard.

sentences.chinese: 他把椅子拉到窗边坐下。
sentences.traditional: 他把椅子拉到窗邊坐下。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yǐzi lā dào chuāngbiān zuò xià.
sentences.translation: He pulled the chair over to the window and sat down.

sentences.chinese: 两个人一起拉，箱子很快就搬上去了。
sentences.traditional: 兩個人一起拉，箱子很快就搬上去了。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén yìqǐ lā, xiāngzi hěn kuài jiù bān shàngqù le.
sentences.translation: With two people pulling together, the box was moved up quickly.

sentences.chinese: 请把垃圾分类以后再扔进去。
sentences.traditional: 請把垃圾分類以後再扔進去。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ lājī fēnlèi yǐhòu zài rēng jìnqù.
sentences.translation: Please sort the rubbish before throwing it in.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上都是垃圾，你先收拾一下吧。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上都是垃圾，你先收拾一下吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng dōu shì lājī, nǐ xiān shōushi yíxià ba.
sentences.translation: The table is covered with rubbish, so tidy it up first.

sentences.chinese: 公园里不能随便丢垃圾。
sentences.traditional: 公園裡不能隨便丟垃圾。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ bù néng suíbiàn diū lājī.
sentences.translation: You must not litter in the park.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜有点儿辣，你能吃吗？
sentences.traditional: 這道菜有點兒辣，你能吃嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài yǒudiǎnr là, nǐ néng chī ma?
sentences.translation: This dish is a bit spicy; can you eat it?

sentences.chinese: 我以前不太能吃辣，现在好多了。
sentences.traditional: 我以前不太能吃辣，現在好多了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián bú tài néng chī là, xiànzài hǎo duō le.
sentences.translation: I could not handle spicy food very well before, but now I am much better.

sentences.chinese: 如果你觉得太辣，可以多喝点儿水。
sentences.traditional: 如果你覺得太辣，可以多喝點兒水。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ juéde tài là, kěyǐ duō hē diǎnr shuǐ.
sentences.translation: If you find it too spicy, you can drink a bit more water.

sentences.chinese: 我起晚了，连早饭都来不及吃就出门了。
sentences.traditional: 我起晚了，連早飯都來不及吃就出門了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qǐ wǎn le, lián zǎofàn dōu láibují chī jiù chūmén le.
sentences.translation: I got up late and did not even have time to eat breakfast before going out.

sentences.chinese: 会议马上开始了，现在准备材料恐怕来不及了。
sentences.traditional: 會議馬上開始了，現在準備材料恐怕來不及了。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì mǎshàng kāishǐ le, xiànzài zhǔnbèi cáiliào kǒngpà láibují le.
sentences.translation: The meeting is about to start, so I am afraid there is no time to prepare the materials now.

sentences.chinese: 如果再不走，我们就来不及赶上最后一班车了。
sentences.traditional: 如果再不走，我們就來不及趕上最後一班車了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zài bù zǒu, wǒmen jiù láibují gǎnshàng zuìhòu yì bān chē le.
sentences.translation: If we do not leave now, we will be too late to catch the last bus.

sentences.chinese: 现在出发的话，我们还来得及赶上电影开场。
sentences.traditional: 現在出發的話，我們還來得及趕上電影開場。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài chūfā de huà, wǒmen hái láidejí gǎnshàng diànyǐng kāichǎng.
sentences.translation: If we leave now, we can still make it to the start of the film.

sentences.chinese: 你别着急，材料下午交也来得及。
sentences.traditional: 你別著急，材料下午交也來得及。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié zháojí, cáiliào xiàwǔ jiāo yě láidejí.
sentences.translation: Do not worry; handing in the materials this afternoon is still in time.

sentences.chinese: 从这里坐地铁过去，应该还来得及。
sentences.traditional: 從這裡坐地鐵過去，應該還來得及。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zuò dìtiě guòqù, yīnggāi hái láidejí.
sentences.translation: Taking the underground from here, we should still make it in time.

sentences.chinese: 他不是不会做，只是有点儿懒。
sentences.traditional: 他不是不會做，只是有點兒懶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì bú huì zuò, zhǐshì yǒudiǎnr lǎn.
sentences.translation: It is not that he cannot do it; he is just a bit lazy.

sentences.chinese: 放假的时候，我常常懒得出门。
sentences.traditional: 放假的時候，我常常懶得出門。
sentences.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhou, wǒ chángcháng lǎn de chūmén.
sentences.translation: During holidays, I often cannot be bothered to go out.

sentences.chinese: 如果你一直这么懒，事情只会越来越多。
sentences.traditional: 如果你一直這麼懶，事情只會越來越多。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yìzhí zhème lǎn, shìqing zhǐ huì yuèláiyuè duō.
sentences.translation: If you keep being this lazy, things will only pile up.

sentences.chinese: 把这么好的机会错过了，太浪费了。
sentences.traditional: 把這麼好的機會錯過了，太浪費了。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎ zhème hǎo de jīhuì cuòguò le, tài làngfèi le.
sentences.translation: Missing such a good opportunity is a real waste.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该节约用水，不要浪费资源。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該節約用水，不要浪費資源。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jiéyuē yòng shuǐ, bú yào làngfèi zīyuán.
sentences.translation: We should save water and not waste resources.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服你只穿一次，实在太浪费了。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服你只穿一次，實在太浪費了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu nǐ zhǐ chuān yí cì, shízài tài làngfèi le.
sentences.translation: Wearing this piece of clothing only once is really wasteful.

sentences.chinese: 他们在海边吃晚饭，感觉很浪漫。
sentences.traditional: 他們在海邊吃晚飯，感覺很浪漫。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài hǎibiān chī wǎnfàn, gǎnjué hěn làngmàn.
sentences.translation: They had dinner by the sea, which felt very romantic.

sentences.chinese: 我觉得送手写信比送花更浪漫。
sentences.traditional: 我覺得送手寫信比送花更浪漫。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde sòng shǒuxiě xìn bǐ sòng huā gèng làngmàn.
sentences.translation: I think giving a handwritten letter is more romantic than giving flowers.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影虽然老，但是故事很浪漫。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影雖然老，但是故事很浪漫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng suīrán lǎo, dànshì gùshi hěn làngmàn.
sentences.translation: Although this film is old, its story is very romantic.

sentences.chinese: 动物园里的老虎正在树下休息。
sentences.traditional: 動物園裡的老虎正在樹下休息。
sentences.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ de lǎohǔ zhèngzài shù xià xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The tiger in the zoo is resting under the tree.

sentences.chinese: 小时候我觉得老虎很可怕。
sentences.traditional: 小時候我覺得老虎很可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou wǒ juéde lǎohǔ hěn kěpà.
sentences.translation: When I was little, I thought tigers were scary.

sentences.chinese: 这种画里的老虎看起来特别有气势。
sentences.traditional: 這種畫裡的老虎看起來特別有氣勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huà lǐ de lǎohǔ kàn qǐlái tèbié yǒu qìshì.
sentences.translation: The tiger in this kind of painting looks especially powerful.

sentences.chinese: 我虽然离开老家很多年了，但是一直很想念那里。
sentences.traditional: 我雖然離開老家很多年了，但是一直很想念那裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ suīrán líkāi lǎojiā hěn duō nián le, dànshì yìzhí hěn xiǎngniàn nàlǐ.
sentences.translation: Although I have left my hometown for many years, I still miss it a lot.

sentences.chinese: 每到过年，他都会回老家看父母。
sentences.traditional: 每到過年，他都會回老家看父母。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào guònián, tā dōu huì huí lǎojiā kàn fùmǔ.
sentences.translation: Every New Year, he goes back to his hometown to see his parents.

sentences.chinese: 你老家有什么特别有名的小吃吗？
sentences.traditional: 你老家有什麼特別有名的小吃嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ lǎojiā yǒu shénme tèbié yǒumíng de xiǎochī ma?
sentences.translation: Does your hometown have any especially famous snacks?

sentences.chinese: 人到了老年以后，更要注意身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 人到了老年以後，更要注意身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Rén dào le lǎonián yǐhòu, gèng yào zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: When people reach old age, they need to pay even more attention to their health.

sentences.chinese: 这家社区中心经常为老年人举办活动。
sentences.traditional: 這家社區中心經常為老年人舉辦活動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā shèqū zhōngxīn jīngcháng wèi lǎoniánrén jǔbàn huódòng.
sentences.translation: This community centre often organises activities for elderly people.

sentences.chinese: 老年生活过得充实，也可以很幸福。
sentences.traditional: 老年生活過得充實，也可以很幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎonián shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, yě kěyǐ hěn xìngfú.
sentences.translation: Life in old age can also be very happy if it is fulfilling.

sentences.chinese: 你老是低头看手机，对眼睛不好。
sentences.traditional: 你老是低頭看手機，對眼睛不好。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ lǎoshì dītóu kàn shǒujī, duì yǎnjing bù hǎo.
sentences.translation: You are always looking down at your phone, which is bad for your eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他最近老是忘记带钥匙。
sentences.traditional: 他最近老是忘記帶鑰匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn lǎoshì wàngjì dài yàoshi.
sentences.translation: Lately he keeps forgetting to bring his keys.

sentences.chinese: 别老是拿自己跟别人比较。
sentences.traditional: 別老是拿自己跟別人比較。
sentences.pinyin: Bié lǎoshì ná zìjǐ gēn biérén bǐjiào.
sentences.translation: Do not always compare yourself with other people.

sentences.chinese: 遇到问题的时候，先冷静下来再想办法。
sentences.traditional: 遇到問題的時候，先冷靜下來再想辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào wèntí de shíhou, xiān lěngjìng xiàlái zài xiǎng bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: When you run into a problem, calm down first and then think of a solution.

sentences.chinese: 她说话很冷静，从来不会随便发脾气。
sentences.traditional: 她說話很冷靜，從來不會隨便發脾氣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn lěngjìng, cónglái bú huì suíbiàn fā píqi.
sentences.translation: She speaks very calmly and never loses her temper casually.

sentences.chinese: 在紧急情况下，冷静比着急更重要。
sentences.traditional: 在緊急情況下，冷靜比著急更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, lěngjìng bǐ zháojí gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In an emergency, staying calm is more important than panicking.

sentences.chinese: 我头发太长了，周末想去理发。
sentences.traditional: 我頭髮太長了，週末想去理髮。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tóufa tài cháng le, zhōumò xiǎng qù lǐfà.
sentences.translation: My hair is too long, so I want to get a haircut at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 这家店理发很快，而且价格也不贵。
sentences.traditional: 這家店理髮很快，而且價格也不貴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn lǐfà hěn kuài, érqiě jiàgé yě bú guì.
sentences.translation: This shop cuts hair quickly, and the price is not expensive either.

sentences.chinese: 他今天下午请假去理发了。
sentences.traditional: 他今天下午請假去理髮了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān xiàwǔ qǐngjià qù lǐfà le.
sentences.translation: He took leave this afternoon to get a haircut.

sentences.chinese: 我能理解你现在的心情。
sentences.traditional: 我能理解你現在的心情。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ néng lǐjiě nǐ xiànzài de xīnqíng.
sentences.translation: I can understand how you are feeling now.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章不太难，我基本上都理解了。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章不太難，我基本上都理解了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng bú tài nán, wǒ jīběnshang dōu lǐjiě le.
sentences.translation: This article is not too difficult; I basically understood it all.

sentences.chinese: 如果你不理解这个词，我可以再解释一次。
sentences.traditional: 如果你不理解這個詞，我可以再解釋一次。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù lǐjiě zhège cí, wǒ kěyǐ zài jiěshì yí cì.
sentences.translation: If you do not understand this word, I can explain it again.

sentences.chinese: 跟长辈说话的时候要有礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 跟長輩說話的時候要有禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Gēn zhǎngbèi shuōhuà de shíhou yào yǒu lǐmào.
sentences.translation: When speaking to elders, you should be polite.

sentences.chinese: 他很有礼貌，每次见面都会先打招呼。
sentences.traditional: 他很有禮貌，每次見面都會先打招呼。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu lǐmào, měicì jiànmiàn dōu huì xiān dǎ zhāohu.
sentences.translation: He is very polite and always greets people first when he sees them.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，说“谢谢”是最简单的礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 有時候，說「謝謝」是最簡單的禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou, shuō “xièxie” shì zuì jiǎndān de lǐmào.
sentences.translation: Sometimes, saying “thank you” is the simplest courtesy.

sentences.chinese: 我的理想是将来当一名医生。
sentences.traditional: 我的理想是將來當一名醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì jiānglái dāng yì míng yīshēng.
sentences.translation: My dream is to become a doctor in the future.

sentences.chinese: 在理想的环境里，大家都能安心工作。
sentences.traditional: 在理想的環境裡，大家都能安心工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lǐxiǎng de huánjìng lǐ, dàjiā dōu néng ānxīn gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: In an ideal environment, everyone can work with peace of mind.

sentences.chinese: 理想很重要，但也要一步一步去实现。
sentences.traditional: 理想很重要，但也要一步一步去實現。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐxiǎng hěn zhòngyào, dàn yě yào yí bù yí bù qù shíxiàn.
sentences.translation: Dreams are important, but you also need to realise them step by step.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子记性真厉害，听一次就会了。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子記性真厲害，聽一次就會了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi jìxing zhēn lìhai, tīng yí cì jiù huì le.
sentences.translation: This child has an amazing memory; he learns it after hearing it once.

sentences.chinese: 今天的风很厉害，出门最好多穿一点。
sentences.traditional: 今天的風很厲害，出門最好多穿一點。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de fēng hěn lìhai, chūmén zuìhǎo duō chuān yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The wind is very strong today, so you had better wear a bit more before going out.

sentences.chinese: 她做菜很厉害，朋友们都喜欢来她家吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 她做菜很厲害，朋友們都喜歡來她家吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuòcài hěn lìhai, péngyoumen dōu xǐhuan lái tā jiā chīfàn.
sentences.translation: She is excellent at cooking, and her friends all like coming to her house for meals.

sentences.chinese: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动，没那么大力气。
sentences.traditional: 這個箱子太重了，我一個人搬不動，沒那麼大力氣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi tài zhòng le, wǒ yí gè rén bān bú dòng, méi nàme dà lìqi.
sentences.translation: This box is too heavy; I cannot move it by myself, and I do not have that much strength.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然年纪不大，但是力气不小。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然年紀不大，但是力氣不小。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì bú dà, dànshì lìqi bù xiǎo.
sentences.translation: Although he is not very old, he is quite strong.

sentences.chinese: 搬家那天，多亏大家来帮忙，不然我一个人真没力气。
sentences.traditional: 搬家那天，多虧大家來幫忙，不然我一個人真沒力氣。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiā nà tiān, duōkuī dàjiā lái bāngmáng, bùrán wǒ yí gè rén zhēn méi lìqi.
sentences.translation: On moving day, it was thanks to everyone helping that I managed; otherwise I really would not have had the strength alone.

sentences.chinese: 很多水果都含有维生素，例如橙子和苹果。
sentences.traditional: 很多水果都含有維生素，例如橙子和蘋果。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō shuǐguǒ dōu hányǒu wéishēngsù, lìrú chéngzi hé píngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Many fruits contain vitamins, for example oranges and apples.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢安静的运动，例如散步和游泳。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡安靜的運動，例如散步和游泳。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan ānjìng de yùndòng, lìrú sànbù hé yóuyǒng.
sentences.translation: I like quiet forms of exercise, such as walking and swimming.

sentences.chinese: 有些工作需要团队合作，例如举办大型活动。
sentences.traditional: 有些工作需要團隊合作，例如舉辦大型活動。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē gōngzuò xūyào tuánduì hézuò, lìrú jǔbàn dàxíng huódòng.
sentences.translation: Some jobs require teamwork, for example organising large events.

sentences.chinese: 老师刚才举的那个例子很容易懂。
sentences.traditional: 老師剛才舉的那個例子很容易懂。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gāngcái jǔ de nàge lìzi hěn róngyì dǒng.
sentences.translation: The example the teacher just gave was easy to understand.

sentences.chinese: 你能不能再给我一个例子？
sentences.traditional: 你能不能再給我一個例子？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng bu néng zài gěi wǒ yí gè lìzi?
sentences.translation: Could you give me another example?

sentences.chinese: 生活中有很多这样的例子，我们平时没注意到。
sentences.traditional: 生活中有很多這樣的例子，我們平時沒注意到。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnghuó zhōng yǒu hěn duō zhèyàng de lìzi, wǒmen píngshí méi zhùyì dào.
sentences.translation: There are many examples like this in life; we just do not usually notice them.

sentences.chinese: 咱们俩好久没一起吃饭了。
sentences.traditional: 咱們倆好久沒一起吃飯了。
sentences.pinyin: Zánmen liǎ hǎojiǔ méi yìqǐ chīfàn le.
sentences.translation: The two of us have not eaten together for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他们俩从小就在一个学校上学。
sentences.traditional: 他們倆從小就在一個學校上學。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen liǎ cóngxiǎo jiù zài yí gè xuéxiào shàngxué.
sentences.translation: The two of them have gone to the same school since childhood.

sentences.chinese: 这俩问题看起来差不多，其实不一样。
sentences.traditional: 這倆問題看起來差不多，其實不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎ wèntí kàn qǐlái chàbuduō, qíshí bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: These two problems look similar, but actually they are different.

sentences.chinese: 他太忙了，连午饭都没时间吃。
sentences.traditional: 他太忙了，連午飯都沒時間吃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tài máng le, lián wǔfàn dōu méi shíjiān chī.
sentences.translation: He is so busy that he does not even have time to eat lunch.

sentences.chinese: 这条小路一直连到山脚下。
sentences.traditional: 這條小路一直連到山腳下。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiǎolù yìzhí lián dào shānjiǎo xià.
sentences.translation: This small path connects all the way to the foot of the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这么简单的问题，连小孩子都会回答。
sentences.traditional: 這麼簡單的問題，連小孩子都會回答。
sentences.pinyin: Zhème jiǎndān de wèntí, lián xiǎoháizi dōu huì huídá.
sentences.translation: Even children can answer such a simple question.

sentences.chinese: 到北京以后，你记得跟我联系。
sentences.traditional: 到北京以後，你記得跟我聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Dào Běijīng yǐhòu, nǐ jìde gēn wǒ liánxì.
sentences.translation: After you get to Beijing, remember to contact me.

sentences.chinese: 我已经联系过客服了，他们说明天会回复。
sentences.traditional: 我已經聯繫過客服了，他們說明天會回覆。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng liánxì guo kèfú le, tāmen shuō míngtiān huì huífù.
sentences.translation: I have already contacted customer service; they said they will reply tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 这两个问题其实有很大的联系。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個問題其實有很大的聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè wèntí qíshí yǒu hěn dà de liánxì.
sentences.translation: These two issues are actually closely connected.

sentences.chinese: 秋天的早上有点凉，你最好带一件外套。
sentences.traditional: 秋天的早上有點涼，你最好帶一件外套。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān de zǎoshang yǒudiǎn liáng, nǐ zuìhǎo dài yí jiàn wàitào.
sentences.translation: The autumn mornings are a bit cool; you had better bring a coat.

sentences.chinese: 菜快凉了，你现在吃吧。
sentences.traditional: 菜快涼了，你現在吃吧。
sentences.pinyin: Cài kuài liáng le, nǐ xiànzài chī ba.
sentences.translation: The food is getting cold, so eat it now.

sentences.chinese: 这杯茶有点凉了，我去给你换一杯热的。
sentences.traditional: 這杯茶有點涼了，我去給你換一杯熱的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bēi chá yǒudiǎn liáng le, wǒ qù gěi nǐ huàn yì bēi rè de.
sentences.translation: This cup of tea has gone a bit cool; I will get you a hot one.

sentences.chinese: 买衣服以前最好先量一下肩膀的宽度。
sentences.traditional: 買衣服以前最好先量一下肩膀的寬度。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi yīfu yǐqián zuìhǎo xiān liáng yíxià jiānbǎng de kuāndù.
sentences.translation: Before buying clothes, it is best to measure your shoulder width first.

sentences.chinese: 医生先量了他的体温，然后问他哪里不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 醫生先量了他的體溫，然後問他哪裡不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xiān liáng le tā de tǐwēn, ránhòu wèn tā nǎli bù shūfu.
sentences.translation: The doctor first measured his temperature and then asked where he felt unwell.

sentences.chinese: 这间房子要先量好尺寸，才能买家具。
sentences.traditional: 這間房子要先量好尺寸，才能買傢俱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiān fángzi yào xiān liáng hǎo chǐcùn, cáinéng mǎi jiājù.
sentences.translation: The dimensions of this room need to be measured first before furniture can be bought.

sentences.chinese: 门口停着两辆出租车，你坐哪一辆？
sentences.traditional: 門口停著兩輛出租車，你坐哪一輛？
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu tíng zhe liǎng liàng chūzūchē, nǐ zuò nǎ yí liàng?
sentences.translation: There are two taxis parked at the entrance; which one will you take?

sentences.chinese: 他养了两只猫，一只黑的，一只白的。
sentences.traditional: 他養了兩隻貓，一隻黑的，一隻白的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǎng le liǎng zhī māo, yì zhī hēi de, yì zhī bái de.
sentences.translation: He keeps two cats, one black and one white.

sentences.chinese: 这次旅行我们租了两台车，大家都觉得方便。
sentences.traditional: 這次旅行我們租了兩臺車，大家都覺得方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng wǒmen zū le liǎng tái chē, dàjiā dōu juéde fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: On this trip we rented two cars, and everyone found it convenient.

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上的月亮特别亮。
sentences.traditional: 今天晚上的月亮特別亮。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang de yuèliang tèbié liàng.
sentences.translation: The moon is especially bright tonight.

sentences.chinese: 房间太暗了，把灯打开就亮多了。
sentences.traditional: 房間太暗了，把燈打開就亮多了。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān tài àn le, bǎ dēng dǎkāi jiù liàng duō le.
sentences.translation: The room is too dark; once the light is turned on, it becomes much brighter.

sentences.chinese: 他说到这里的时候，眼睛一下子亮了起来。
sentences.traditional: 他說到這裡的時候，眼睛一下子亮了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō dào zhèlǐ de shíhou, yǎnjing yíxiàzi liàng le qǐlai.
sentences.translation: When he got to this point, his eyes suddenly lit up.

sentences.chinese: 请把今天要讨论的问题列出来。
sentences.traditional: 請把今天要討論的問題列出來。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ jīntiān yào tǎolùn de wèntí liè chūlai.
sentences.translation: Please list the issues that are to be discussed today.

sentences.chinese: 站台上有一列火车正在等乘客。
sentences.traditional: 站臺上有一列火車正在等乘客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàntái shàng yǒu yí liè huǒchē zhèngzài děng chéngkè.
sentences.translation: There is a train at the platform waiting for passengers.

sentences.chinese: 这些名字要按顺序列在表格里。
sentences.traditional: 這些名字要按順序列在表格裡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē míngzi yào àn shùnxù liè zài biǎogé lǐ.
sentences.translation: These names need to be listed in order in the table.

sentences.chinese: 今天夜里气温会降到零下五度。
sentences.traditional: 今天夜裡氣溫會降到零下五度。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān yèlǐ qìwēn huì jiàng dào língxià wǔ dù.
sentences.translation: Tonight the temperature will drop to minus five degrees.

sentences.chinese: 冬天这里常常是零下，所以河面会结冰。
sentences.traditional: 冬天這裡常常是零下，所以河面會結冰。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān zhèlǐ chángcháng shì língxià, suǒyǐ hémiàn huì jié bīng.
sentences.translation: In winter it is often below zero here, so the river surface freezes.

sentences.chinese: 要是在零下的天气里站太久，手会冻得很疼。
sentences.traditional: 要是在零下的天氣裡站太久，手會凍得很疼。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi zài língxià de tiānqì lǐ zhàn tài jiǔ, shǒu huì dòng de hěn téng.
sentences.translation: If you stand too long in below-zero weather, your hands will hurt from the cold.

sentences.chinese: 他每个月都会存一点零花钱。
sentences.traditional: 他每個月都會存一點零花錢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi gè yuè dōu huì cún yìdiǎn línghuāqián.
sentences.translation: He saves a bit of his pocket money every month.

sentences.chinese: 我小时候的零花钱不多，所以买东西很小心。
sentences.traditional: 我小時候的零花錢不多，所以買東西很小心。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou de línghuāqián bù duō, suǒyǐ mǎi dōngxi hěn xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: My pocket money was not much when I was little, so I was careful about what I bought.

sentences.chinese: 爸妈说零花钱应该自己计划着用。
sentences.traditional: 爸媽說零花錢應該自己計劃著用。
sentences.pinyin: Bàmā shuō línghuāqián yīnggāi zìjǐ jìhuà zhe yòng.
sentences.translation: Mum and Dad say pocket money should be planned and spent by yourself.

sentences.chinese: 你有零钱吗？我想坐公交车。
sentences.traditional: 你有零錢嗎？我想坐公交車。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu língqián ma? Wǒ xiǎng zuò gōngjiāochē.
sentences.translation: Do you have any change? I want to take the bus.

sentences.chinese: 这家店可以用手机付款，不用准备零钱。
sentences.traditional: 這家店可以用手機付款，不用準備零錢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn kěyǐ yòng shǒujī fùkuǎn, bùyòng zhǔnbèi língqián.
sentences.translation: This shop accepts mobile payment, so you do not need to prepare change.

sentences.chinese: 我把口袋里的零钱都拿出来了，还是不够。
sentences.traditional: 我把口袋裡的零錢都拿出來了，還是不夠。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ kǒudai lǐ de língqián dōu ná chūlai le, háishi bú gòu.
sentences.translation: I took out all the change in my pocket, but it still was not enough.

sentences.chinese: 看电影的时候，他总喜欢买很多零食。
sentences.traditional: 看電影的時候，他總喜歡買很多零食。
sentences.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng de shíhou, tā zǒng xǐhuan mǎi hěn duō língshí.
sentences.translation: When watching films, he always likes to buy lots of snacks.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子吃太多零食，对身体不好。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子吃太多零食，對身體不好。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi chī tài duō língshí, duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
sentences.translation: It is not good for children to eat too many snacks.

sentences.chinese: 旅行的时候带一点零食会方便很多。
sentences.traditional: 旅行的時候帶一點零食會方便很多。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng de shíhou dài yìdiǎn língshí huì fāngbiàn hěn duō.
sentences.translation: Bringing some snacks when travelling is much more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法不行，我们得想另一个办法。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法不行，我們得想另一個辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ bù xíng, wǒmen děi xiǎng lìng yí gè bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: This method will not work; we need to think of another one.

sentences.chinese: 现在先别讨论这个，我们先看另一个问题。
sentences.traditional: 現在先別討論這個，我們先看另一個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài xiān bié tǎolùn zhège, wǒmen xiān kàn lìng yí gè wèntí.
sentences.translation: Let us not discuss this for now; let us look at another question first.

sentences.chinese: 这笔钱要另存起来，以后可能用得上。
sentences.traditional: 這筆錢要另存起來，以後可能用得上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián yào lìng cún qǐlai, yǐhòu kěnéng yòng de shàng.
sentences.translation: This sum of money should be saved separately; it may be needed later.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题我们以后再谈，另外一个问题更急。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題我們以後再談，另外一個問題更急。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒmen yǐhòu zài tán, lìngwài yí gè wèntí gèng jí.
sentences.translation: We can discuss this issue later; another issue is more urgent.

sentences.chinese: 除了学费以外，另外还要准备一些生活费。
sentences.traditional: 除了學費以外，另外還要準備一些生活費。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle xuéfèi yǐwài, lìngwài hái yào zhǔnbèi yìxiē shēnghuófèi.
sentences.translation: Besides the tuition fees, you also need to prepare some living expenses.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆的菜不错，另外服务也很好。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯館的菜不錯，另外服務也很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài búcuò, lìngwài fúwù yě hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: The food at this restaurant is good; in addition, the service is very good.

sentences.chinese: 你要是累了，就留在家里休息吧。
sentences.traditional: 你要是累了，就留在家裡休息吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi lèi le, jiù liú zài jiālǐ xiūxi ba.
sentences.translation: If you are tired, then stay at home and rest.

sentences.chinese: 这张票请你留好，进门的时候要检查。
sentences.traditional: 這張票請你留好，進門的時候要檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào qǐng nǐ liú hǎo, jìnmén de shíhou yào jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: Please keep this ticket safe; it will be checked when you enter.

sentences.chinese: 他毕业以后决定留在上海工作。
sentences.traditional: 他畢業以後決定留在上海工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìyè yǐhòu juédìng liú zài Shànghǎi gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: After graduating, he decided to stay in Shanghai to work.

sentences.chinese: 山上的水一直流到村子旁边的小河里。
sentences.traditional: 山上的水一直流到村子旁邊的小河裡。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shàng de shuǐ yìzhí liú dào cūnzi pángbiān de xiǎohé lǐ.
sentences.translation: The water from the mountain flows all the way into the small river beside the village.

sentences.chinese: 水管坏了以后，水不停地往外流。
sentences.traditional: 水管壞了以後，水不停地往外流。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐguǎn huài le yǐhòu, shuǐ bù tíng de wǎng wài liú.
sentences.translation: After the pipe broke, water kept flowing out.

sentences.chinese: 眼泪顺着她的脸慢慢地流下来。
sentences.traditional: 眼淚順著她的臉慢慢地流下來。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnlèi shùn zhe tā de liǎn mànmàn de liú xiàlai.
sentences.translation: Tears slowly ran down her face.

sentences.chinese: 他说汉语说得很流利，大家都以为他在中国住过。
sentences.traditional: 他說漢語說得很流利，大家都以為他在中國住過。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō Hànyǔ shuō de hěn liúlì, dàjiā dōu yǐwéi tā zài Zhōngguó zhù guo.
sentences.translation: He speaks Chinese very fluently, and everyone thinks he has lived in China.

sentences.chinese: 要想说得流利，就得多听多练。
sentences.traditional: 要想說得流利，就得多聽多練。
sentences.pinyin: Yào xiǎng shuō de liúlì, jiù děi duō tīng duō liàn.
sentences.translation: If you want to speak fluently, you need to listen and practise more.

sentences.chinese: 她虽然刚学了两年，但是已经能很流利地表达自己的想法。
sentences.traditional: 她雖然剛學了兩年，但是已經能很流利地表達自己的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán gāng xué le liǎng nián, dànshì yǐjīng néng hěn liúlì de biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfa.
sentences.translation: Although she has studied for only two years, she can already express her ideas very fluently.

sentences.chinese: 开会以后，请你留下来一下，我有事跟你商量。
sentences.traditional: 開會以後，請你留下來一下，我有事跟你商量。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì yǐhòu, qǐng nǐ liúxia lai yíxià, wǒ yǒu shì gēn nǐ shāngliang.
sentences.translation: After the meeting, please stay behind for a moment; I have something to discuss with you.

sentences.chinese: 他走得太着急，把手机留下了。
sentences.traditional: 他走得太著急，把手機留下了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu de tài zhāojí, bǎ shǒujī liúxia le.
sentences.translation: He left in such a hurry that he left his mobile behind.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片给我留下了很深的印象。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片給我留下了很深的印象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn gěi wǒ liúxia le hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: This photo left a deep impression on me.

sentences.chinese: 这种衣服去年很流行，今年已经不太常见了。
sentences.traditional: 這種衣服去年很流行，今年已經不太常見了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yīfu qùnián hěn liúxíng, jīnnián yǐjīng bú tài chángjiàn le.
sentences.translation: This kind of clothing was very popular last year, but this year it is already not so common.

sentences.chinese: 最近年轻人中又流行起了复古风格。
sentences.traditional: 最近年輕人中又流行起了復古風格。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn niánqīngrén zhōng yòu liúxíng qǐ le fùgǔ fēnggé.
sentences.translation: Recently retro style has become popular again among young people.

sentences.chinese: 感冒容易在冬天流行，所以要注意保暖。
sentences.traditional: 感冒容易在冬天流行，所以要注意保暖。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎnmào róngyì zài dōngtiān liúxíng, suǒyǐ yào zhùyì bǎonuǎn.
sentences.translation: Colds easily spread in winter, so you need to keep warm.

sentences.chinese: 我今天下班的时候正好路过你家，可以把书还给你。
sentences.traditional: 我今天下班的時候正好路過你家，可以把書還給你。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān xiàbān de shíhou zhènghǎo lùguò nǐ jiā, kěyǐ bǎ shū huán gěi nǐ.
sentences.translation: When I finish work today I will happen to pass by your house, so I can return the book to you.

sentences.chinese: 他每天上学都要路过那个公园。
sentences.traditional: 他每天上學都要路過那個公園。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān shàngxué dōu yào lùguò nàge gōngyuán.
sentences.translation: He passes that park every day on the way to school.

sentences.chinese: 我只是路过这儿，不打算进去买东西。
sentences.traditional: 我只是路過這兒，不打算進去買東西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì lùguò zhèr, bù dǎsuàn jìnqù mǎi dōngxi.
sentences.translation: I am only passing by here and do not plan to go in to buy anything.

sentences.chinese: 我们先把行李放到旅馆，再出去吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 我們先把行李放到旅館，再出去吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān bǎ xíngli fàng dào lǚguǎn, zài chūqu chīfàn.
sentences.translation: Let us put the luggage in the hotel first, and then go out to eat.

sentences.chinese: 这家旅馆虽然不大，但是很干净。
sentences.traditional: 這家旅館雖然不大，但是很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚguǎn suīrán bú dà, dànshì hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: Although this hotel is not big, it is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 旅游季节快到了，附近的旅馆都不便宜。
sentences.traditional: 旅遊季節快到了，附近的旅館都不便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚyóu jìjié kuài dào le, fùjìn de lǚguǎn dōu bù piányi.
sentences.translation: The tourist season is coming soon, and the nearby hotels are all rather expensive.

sentences.chinese: 请各位旅客提前半小时到车站检票。
sentences.traditional: 請各位旅客提前半小時到車站檢票。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gèwèi lǚkè tíqián bàn xiǎoshí dào chēzhàn jiǎnpiào.
sentences.translation: Passengers, please arrive at the station half an hour early for ticket inspection.

sentences.chinese: 飞机因为天气原因晚点了，很多旅客都在等消息。
sentences.traditional: 飛機因為天氣原因晚點了，很多旅客都在等消息。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì yuányīn wǎndiǎn le, hěn duō lǚkè dōu zài děng xiāoxi.
sentences.translation: The plane was delayed because of the weather, and many passengers were waiting for news.

sentences.chinese: 节假日的时候，来这里的旅客特别多。
sentences.traditional: 節假日的時候，來這裡的旅客特別多。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéjiàrì de shíhou, lái zhèlǐ de lǚkè tèbié duō.
sentences.translation: During holidays, there are especially many travellers who come here.

sentences.chinese: 我打算暑假跟朋友一起去云南旅行。
sentences.traditional: 我打算暑假跟朋友一起去雲南旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn shǔjià gēn péngyou yìqǐ qù Yúnnán lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: I plan to travel to Yunnan with friends during the summer holiday.

sentences.chinese: 旅行以前，最好先把酒店和车票都订好。
sentences.traditional: 旅行以前，最好先把酒店和車票都訂好。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng yǐqián, zuìhǎo xiān bǎ jiǔdiàn hé chēpiào dōu dìng hǎo.
sentences.translation: Before travelling, it is best to book the hotel and tickets in advance.

sentences.chinese: 对我来说，旅行不只是放松，也是学习不同文化的机会。
sentences.traditional: 對我來說，旅行不只是放鬆，也是學習不同文化的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, lǚxíng bù zhǐshì fàngsōng, yě shì xuéxí bùtóng wénhuà de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: For me, travelling is not only relaxing; it is also a chance to learn about different cultures.

sentences.chinese: 他请了一位很有经验的律师帮他处理合同问题。
sentences.traditional: 他請了一位很有經驗的律師幫他處理合同問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐng le yí wèi hěn yǒu jīngyàn de lǜshī bāng tā chǔlǐ hétong wèntí.
sentences.translation: He hired a very experienced lawyer to help him handle the contract issue.

sentences.chinese: 如果你遇到法律问题，最好先咨询律师。
sentences.traditional: 如果你遇到法律問題，最好先諮詢律師。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yùdào fǎlǜ wèntí, zuìhǎo xiān zīxún lǜshī.
sentences.translation: If you run into a legal problem, it is best to consult a lawyer first.

sentences.chinese: 那位律师说，这个案子还需要更多证据。
sentences.traditional: 那位律師說，這個案子還需要更多證據。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi lǜshī shuō, zhège ànzi hái xūyào gèng duō zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: That lawyer said that this case still needs more evidence.

sentences.chinese: 你的房间太乱了，先整理一下再出去吧。
sentences.traditional: 你的房間太亂了，先整理一下再出去吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān tài luàn le, xiān zhěnglǐ yíxià zài chūqù ba.
sentences.translation: Your room is too messy; tidy it up before you go out.

sentences.chinese: 别乱说话，这件事还没有弄清楚。
sentences.traditional: 別亂說話，這件事還沒有弄清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Bié luàn shuōhuà, zhè jiàn shì hái méiyǒu nòng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Do not talk recklessly; this matter has not been clarified yet.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束以后，大家不要乱动桌上的文件。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束以後，大家不要亂動桌上的文件。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù yǐhòu, dàjiā búyào luàn dòng zhuō shàng de wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ends, everyone should not move the documents on the table around carelessly.

sentences.chinese: 秋天一到，院子里的叶子就开始往下落。
sentences.traditional: 秋天一到，院子裡的葉子就開始往下落。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān yí dào, yuànzi lǐ de yèzi jiù kāishǐ wǎng xià luò.
sentences.translation: As soon as autumn arrives, the leaves in the yard begin to fall.

sentences.chinese: 他的手机不小心落在出租车上了。
sentences.traditional: 他的手機不小心落在出租車上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shǒujī bù xiǎoxīn luò zài chūzūchē shàng le.
sentences.translation: He accidentally left his mobile phone in the taxi.

sentences.chinese: 太阳落山以后，天气马上凉快了。
sentences.traditional: 太陽落山以後，天氣馬上涼快了。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng luòshān yǐhòu, tiānqì mǎshàng liángkuai le.
sentences.translation: After the sun set, the weather immediately became cooler.

sentences.chinese: 这件事有点麻烦，我们得再想办法。
sentences.traditional: 這件事有點麻煩，我們得再想辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǒudiǎn máfan, wǒmen děi zài xiǎng bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: This matter is a bit troublesome; we need to think of another solution.

sentences.chinese: 不好意思，麻烦你把门关一下。
sentences.traditional: 不好意思，麻煩你把門關一下。
sentences.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, máfan nǐ bǎ mén guān yíxià.
sentences.translation: Excuse me, please close the door.

sentences.chinese: 给别人添了这么多麻烦，我心里很过意不去。
sentences.traditional: 給別人添了這麼多麻煩，我心裡很過意不去。
sentences.pinyin: Gěi biérén tiān le zhème duō máfan, wǒ xīnlǐ hěn guòyìbuqù.
sentences.translation: I feel really bad for having caused others so much trouble.

sentences.chinese: 北方人早上常常吃馒头和豆浆。
sentences.traditional: 北方人早上常常吃饅頭和豆漿。
sentences.pinyin: Běifāngrén zǎoshang chángcháng chī mántou hé dòujiāng.
sentences.translation: People in northern China often eat mantou and drink soy milk in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 这个馒头刚蒸好，还热着呢。
sentences.traditional: 這個饅頭剛蒸好，還熱著呢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège mántou gāng zhēng hǎo, hái rè zhe ne.
sentences.translation: This mantou has just been steamed and is still hot.

sentences.chinese: 他一口气吃了两个馒头，还是觉得饿。
sentences.traditional: 他一口氣吃了兩個饅頭，還是覺得餓。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì kǒuqì chī le liǎng gè mántou, háishi juéde è.
sentences.translation: He ate two mantou in one go and still felt hungry.

sentences.chinese: 这个瓶子已经满了，别再往里倒了。
sentences.traditional: 這個瓶子已經滿了，別再往裡倒了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège píngzi yǐjīng mǎn le, bié zài wǎng lǐ dào le.
sentences.translation: This bottle is already full; do not pour any more into it.

sentences.chinese: 节日那天，广场上站满了来看表演的人。
sentences.traditional: 節日那天，廣場上站滿了來看表演的人。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì nà tiān, guǎngchǎng shàng zhàn mǎn le lái kàn biǎoyǎn de rén.
sentences.translation: On the festival day, the square was filled with people who came to watch the performance.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息以后，她脸上满是笑容。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息以後，她臉上滿是笑容。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi yǐhòu, tā liǎn shàng mǎn shì xiàoróng.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news, her face was full of smiles.

sentences.chinese: 洗完脸以后，请用自己的毛巾擦干。
sentences.traditional: 洗完臉以後，請用自己的毛巾擦乾。
sentences.pinyin: Xǐ wán liǎn yǐhòu, qǐng yòng zìjǐ de máojīn cā gān.
sentences.translation: After washing your face, please use your own towel to dry it.

sentences.chinese: 这条毛巾有点旧了，该换新的了。
sentences.traditional: 這條毛巾有點舊了，該換新的了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo máojīn yǒudiǎn jiù le, gāi huàn xīn de le.
sentences.translation: This towel is a bit old; it is time to get a new one.

sentences.chinese: 旅行的时候，他总会带一条小毛巾。
sentences.traditional: 旅行的時候，他總會帶一條小毛巾。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng de shíhou, tā zǒng huì dài yì tiáo xiǎo máojīn.
sentences.translation: When travelling, he always brings a small towel.

sentences.chinese: 天气转凉了，你最好穿上那件毛衣。
sentences.traditional: 天氣轉涼了，你最好穿上那件毛衣。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì zhuǎn liáng le, nǐ zuìhǎo chuān shàng nà jiàn máoyī.
sentences.translation: The weather has turned cool; you had better put on that sweater.

sentences.chinese: 这件毛衣是我奶奶亲手给我织的。
sentences.traditional: 這件毛衣是我奶奶親手給我織的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn máoyī shì wǒ nǎinai qīnshǒu gěi wǒ zhī de.
sentences.translation: This sweater was knitted for me by my grandmother herself.

sentences.chinese: 商店里新到的毛衣颜色都很好看。
sentences.traditional: 商店裡新到的毛衣顏色都很好看。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn lǐ xīn dào de máoyī yánsè dōu hěn hǎokàn.
sentences.translation: The colours of the newly arrived sweaters in the shop all look very nice.

sentences.chinese: 外面太阳很大，出门别忘了带帽子。
sentences.traditional: 外面太陽很大，出門別忘了帶帽子。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn tàiyáng hěn dà, chūmén bié wàng le dài màozi.
sentences.translation: The sun is strong outside; do not forget to take a hat when you go out.

sentences.chinese: 这顶帽子戴在你头上很合适。
sentences.traditional: 這頂帽子戴在你頭上很合適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dǐng màozi dài zài nǐ tóu shàng hěn héshì.
sentences.translation: This hat suits you well when worn on your head.

sentences.chinese: 他一进门就把帽子放在了沙发上。
sentences.traditional: 他一進門就把帽子放在了沙發上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí jìnmén jiù bǎ màozi fàng zài le shāfā shàng.
sentences.translation: As soon as he came in, he put his hat on the sofa.

sentences.chinese: 这里的海边真美，难怪这么多人来拍照。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的海邊真美，難怪這麼多人來拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de hǎibiān zhēn měi, nánguài zhème duō rén lái pāizhào.
sentences.translation: The seaside here is really beautiful; no wonder so many people come to take photos.

sentences.chinese: 她写的字又整齐又美。
sentences.traditional: 她寫的字又整齊又美。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě de zì yòu zhěngqí yòu měi.
sentences.translation: Her handwriting is both neat and beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这座村子不大，但是夜景特别美。
sentences.traditional: 雖然這座村子不大，但是夜景特別美。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhè zuò cūnzi bú dà, dànshì yèjǐng tèbié měi.
sentences.translation: Although this village is not large, its night view is especially beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 童年的回忆总是特别美好。
sentences.traditional: 童年的回憶總是特別美好。
sentences.pinyin: Tóngnián de huíyì zǒng shì tèbié měihǎo.
sentences.translation: Memories of childhood are always especially beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 大家都希望未来的生活越来越美好。
sentences.traditional: 大家都希望未來的生活越來越美好。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xīwàng wèilái de shēnghuó yuèláiyuè měihǎo.
sentences.translation: Everyone hopes life in the future will get better and better.

sentences.chinese: 虽然过程很辛苦，但是结果很美好。
sentences.traditional: 雖然過程很辛苦，但是結果很美好。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán guòchéng hěn xīnkǔ, dànshì jiéguǒ hěn měihǎo.
sentences.translation: Although the process was hard, the result was wonderful.

sentences.chinese: 站在山顶上，可以看到城市和大海的美景。
sentences.traditional: 站在山頂上，可以看到城市和大海的美景。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàn zài shāndǐng shàng, kěyǐ kàndào chéngshì hé dàhǎi de měijǐng.
sentences.translation: Standing on the mountaintop, you can see the beautiful scenery of the city and the sea.

sentences.chinese: 旅途中拍下的美景，我回家以后还想再看一遍。
sentences.traditional: 旅途中拍下的美景，我回家以後還想再看一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚtú zhōng pāi xià de měijǐng, wǒ huíjiā yǐhòu hái xiǎng zài kàn yí biàn.
sentences.translation: I still want to look again at the beautiful scenery I photographed during the trip.

sentences.chinese: 春天一到，公园里到处都是美景。
sentences.traditional: 春天一到，公園裡到處都是美景。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān yí dào, gōngyuán lǐ dàochù dōu shì měijǐng.
sentences.translation: As soon as spring arrives, the park is full of beautiful scenery.

sentences.chinese: 她穿上那条蓝色的裙子以后，看起来更美丽了。
sentences.traditional: 她穿上那條藍色的裙子以後，看起來更美麗了。
