sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān shàng nà tiáo lánsè de qúnzi yǐhòu, kàn qǐlai gèng měilì le.
sentences.translation: After putting on that blue dress, she looked even more beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市不但现代，而且有很多美丽的老建筑。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市不但現代，而且有很多美麗的老建築。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì bùdàn xiàndài, érqiě yǒu hěn duō měilì de lǎo jiànzhù.
sentences.translation: This city is not only modern, but it also has many beautiful old buildings.

sentences.chinese: 她希望把院子变得更美丽一点。
sentences.traditional: 她希望把院子變得更美麗一點。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng bǎ yuànzi biàn de gèng měilì yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: She hopes to make the yard a bit more beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 来到这里旅行，当然不能错过当地的美食。
sentences.traditional: 來到這裡旅行，當然不能錯過當地的美食。
sentences.pinyin: Láidào zhèlǐ lǚxíng, dāngrán bù néng cuòguò dāngdì de měishí.
sentences.translation: When travelling here, of course you should not miss the local cuisine.

sentences.chinese: 夜市里有很多美食，闻起来都很香。
sentences.traditional: 夜市裡有很多美食，聞起來都很香。
sentences.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō měishí, wén qǐlai dōu hěn xiāng.
sentences.translation: There is a lot of delicious food at the night market, and it all smells great.

sentences.chinese: 这个节目会介绍各地的美食和文化。
sentences.traditional: 這個節目會介紹各地的美食和文化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiémù huì jièshào gèdì de měishí hé wénhuà.
sentences.translation: This programme introduces the cuisine and culture of different places.

sentences.chinese: 昨天晚上我做了一个很奇怪的梦。
sentences.traditional: 昨天晚上我做了一個很奇怪的夢。
sentences.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ zuò le yí gè hěn qíguài de mèng.
sentences.translation: Last night I had a very strange dream.

sentences.chinese: 我昨晚又梦到小时候住过的老房子。
sentences.traditional: 我昨晚又夢到小時候住過的老房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn yòu mèng dào xiǎoshíhou zhù guo de lǎo fángzi.
sentences.translation: Last night I again dreamed of the old house where I lived as a child.

sentences.chinese: 他一直觉得那个梦很真实，好像真的发生过。
sentences.traditional: 他一直覺得那個夢很真實，好像真的發生過。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìzhí juéde nàge mèng hěn zhēnshí, hǎoxiàng zhēn de fāshēng guo.
sentences.translation: He has always felt that dream was very real, as if it had really happened.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都应该有自己的梦想。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都應該有自己的夢想。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu yīnggāi yǒu zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Everyone should have their own dream.

sentences.chinese: 她从小就梦想有一天能当医生。
sentences.traditional: 她從小就夢想有一天能當醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù mèngxiǎng yǒu yì tiān néng dāng yīshēng.
sentences.translation: Since childhood she has dreamed of becoming a doctor one day.

sentences.chinese: 只要努力，梦想不一定离我们很远。
sentences.traditional: 只要努力，夢想不一定離我們很遠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǔlì, mèngxiǎng bù yídìng lí wǒmen hěn yuǎn.
sentences.translation: As long as we work hard, our dreams may not be that far away.

sentences.chinese: 请设置一个容易记住但不容易猜到的密码。
sentences.traditional: 請設置一個容易記住但不容易猜到的密碼。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng shèzhì yí gè róngyì jìzhu dàn bù róngyì cāi dào de mìmǎ.
sentences.translation: Please set a password that is easy to remember but hard to guess.

sentences.chinese: 你是不是又把银行卡的密码忘了？
sentences.traditional: 你是不是又把銀行卡的密碼忘了？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì yòu bǎ yínhángkǎ de mìmǎ wàng le?
sentences.translation: Have you forgotten the bank card PIN again?

sentences.chinese: 为了安全起见，这个网站要求你定期更换密码。
sentences.traditional: 為了安全起見，這個網站要求你定期更換密碼。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, zhège wǎngzhàn yāoqiú nǐ dìngqī gēnghuàn mìmǎ.
sentences.translation: For safety reasons, this website requires you to change your password regularly.

sentences.chinese: 今天超市门口有人免费发饮料。
sentences.traditional: 今天超市門口有人免費發飲料。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān chāoshì ménkǒu yǒurén miǎnfèi fā yǐnliào.
sentences.translation: Today someone is handing out drinks for free at the supermarket entrance.

sentences.chinese: 这个软件可以免费使用一个月。
sentences.traditional: 這個軟件可以免費使用一個月。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ miǎnfèi shǐyòng yí gè yuè.
sentences.translation: This software can be used for free for one month.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆每周三对学生免费开放。
sentences.traditional: 博物館每週三對學生免費開放。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn měi zhōusān duì xuéshēng miǎnfèi kāifàng.
sentences.translation: The museum is open free of charge to students every Wednesday.

sentences.chinese: 面对这样的结果，我们只能冷静下来想办法。
sentences.traditional: 面對這樣的結果，我們只能冷靜下來想辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì zhèyàng de jiéguǒ, wǒmen zhǐ néng lěngjìng xiàlai xiǎng bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Faced with this result, we can only calm down and think of a solution.

sentences.chinese: 他不愿意面对自己的错误，总想找借口。
sentences.traditional: 他不願意面對自己的錯誤，總想找藉口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù yuànyì miànduì zìjǐ de cuòwù, zǒng xiǎng zhǎo jièkǒu.
sentences.translation: He is unwilling to face his own mistakes and always wants to make excuses.

sentences.chinese: 面对陌生的环境，她比我冷静得多。
sentences.traditional: 面對陌生的環境，她比我冷靜得多。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì mòshēng de huánjìng, tā bǐ wǒ lěngjìng de duō.
sentences.translation: Faced with an unfamiliar environment, she is much calmer than I am.

sentences.chinese: 他为了明天的面试，今天晚上准备到很晚。
sentences.traditional: 他為了明天的面試，今天晚上準備到很晚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèile míngtiān de miànshì, jīntiān wǎnshang zhǔnbèi dào hěn wǎn.
sentences.translation: He prepared until late tonight for tomorrow's interview.

sentences.chinese: 面试的时候，对方问了我很多关于工作经验的问题。
sentences.traditional: 面試的時候，對方問了我很多關於工作經驗的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì de shíhou, duìfāng wèn le wǒ hěn duō guānyú gōngzuò jīngyàn de wèntí.
sentences.translation: During the interview, they asked me many questions about my work experience.

sentences.chinese: 只看简历还不够，公司还要安排面试。
sentences.traditional: 只看簡歷還不夠，公司還要安排面試。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ kàn jiǎnlì hái bù gòu, gōngsī hái yào ānpái miànshì.
sentences.translation: Just looking at the CV is not enough; the company also needs to arrange an interview.

sentences.chinese: 比赛开始后，他只用了三十秒就跑到了终点。
sentences.traditional: 比賽開始後，他只用了三十秒就跑到了終點。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài kāishǐ hòu, tā zhǐ yòng le sānshí miǎo jiù pǎo dào le zhōngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: After the race started, he reached the finish line in only thirty seconds.

sentences.chinese: 红灯还有五秒就要变绿了。
sentences.traditional: 紅燈還有五秒就要變綠了。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngdēng hái yǒu wǔ miǎo jiù yào biàn lǜ le.
sentences.translation: The red light will turn green in another five seconds.

sentences.chinese: 这段视频的最后十秒特别精彩。
sentences.traditional: 這段視頻的最後十秒特別精彩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn shìpín de zuìhòu shí miǎo tèbié jīngcǎi.
sentences.translation: The last ten seconds of this video are especially exciting.

sentences.chinese: 中国有五十六个民族，每个民族都有自己的文化特点。
sentences.traditional: 中國有五十六個民族，每個民族都有自己的文化特點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǒu wǔshíliù gè mínzú, měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de wénhuà tèdiǎn.
sentences.translation: China has fifty-six ethnic groups, and each has its own cultural characteristics.

sentences.chinese: 这个博物馆介绍了不同民族的传统服装和节日。
sentences.traditional: 這個博物館介紹了不同民族的傳統服裝和節日。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bówùguǎn jièshào le bùtóng mínzú de chuántǒng fúzhuāng hé jiérì.
sentences.translation: This museum introduces the traditional clothing and festivals of different ethnic groups.

sentences.chinese: 学习一种语言的时候，也要了解那个民族的历史。
sentences.traditional: 學習一種語言的時候，也要了解那個民族的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yì zhǒng yǔyán de shíhou, yě yào liǎojiě nàge mínzú de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: When learning a language, you should also understand the history of that people.

sentences.chinese: 到了学期末，大家都忙着复习考试。
sentences.traditional: 到了學期末，大家都忙著複習考試。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le xuéqī mò, dàjiā dōu máng zhe fùxí kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: At the end of the term, everyone is busy revising for exams.

sentences.chinese: 请你在文末写上自己的名字和日期。
sentences.traditional: 請你在文末寫上自己的名字和日期。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài wén mò xiě shàng zìjǐ de míngzi hé rìqī.
sentences.translation: Please write your name and the date at the end of the text.

sentences.chinese: 年末的时候，公司会总结这一年的工作情况。
sentences.traditional: 年末的時候，公司會總結這一年的工作情況。
sentences.pinyin: Nián mò de shíhou, gōngsī huì zǒngjié zhè yì nián de gōngzuò qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: At the end of the year, the company summarises the year's work.

sentences.chinese: 那对母女长得很像，一看就知道是家人。
sentences.traditional: 那對母女長得很像，一看就知道是家人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà duì mǔnǚ zhǎng de hěn xiàng, yí kàn jiù zhīdào shì jiārén.
sentences.translation: That mother and daughter look very alike; one glance and you know they are family.

sentences.chinese: 地铁上那对母女一直在小声聊天。
sentences.traditional: 地鐵上那對母女一直在小聲聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtiě shàng nà duì mǔnǚ yìzhí zài xiǎoshēng liáotiān.
sentences.translation: That mother and daughter on the underground were chatting quietly the whole time.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影讲的是一对母女之间的故事。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影講的是一對母女之間的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì yí duì mǔnǚ zhījiān de gùshi.
sentences.translation: This film tells a story about a mother and daughter.

sentences.chinese: 她的母亲年轻时候是一名护士。
sentences.traditional: 她的母親年輕時候是一名護士。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de mǔqīn niánqīng shíhou shì yì míng hùshi.
sentences.translation: Her mother was a nurse when she was young.

sentences.chinese: 每次遇到困难，他都会想起母亲对他说的话。
sentences.traditional: 每次遇到困難，他都會想起母親對他說的話。
sentences.pinyin: Měi cì yù dào kùnnan, tā dōu huì xiǎng qǐ mǔqīn duì tā shuō de huà.
sentences.translation: Whenever he runs into difficulties, he thinks of what his mother said to him.

sentences.chinese: 母亲节那天，我给母亲打了个电话。
sentences.traditional: 母親節那天，我給母親打了個電話。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn jié nà tiān, wǒ gěi mǔqīn dǎ le ge diànhuà.
sentences.translation: On Mother's Day, I called my mother.

sentences.chinese: 那对母子每天晚饭后都会一起散步。
sentences.traditional: 那對母子每天晚飯後都會一起散步。
sentences.pinyin: Nà duì mǔzǐ měitiān wǎnfàn hòu dōu huì yìqǐ sànbù.
sentences.translation: That mother and son go for a walk together every evening after dinner.

sentences.chinese: 新闻里讲了一个母子互相支持的故事。
sentences.traditional: 新聞裡講了一個母子互相支持的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnwén lǐ jiǎng le yí gè mǔzǐ hùxiāng zhīchí de gùshi.
sentences.translation: The news told a story about a mother and son supporting each other.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议这对母子都做一下检查。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議這對母子都做一下檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhè duì mǔzǐ dōu zuò yíxià jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised both the mother and son to get checked.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有明确的目标，我们就不知道该往哪儿努力。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有明確的目標，我們就不知道該往哪兒努力。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu míngquè de mùbiāo, wǒmen jiù bù zhīdào gāi wǎng nǎr nǔlì.
sentences.translation: If we do not have a clear goal, we do not know what to work towards.

sentences.chinese: 他给自己定了一个目标，今年读完二十本书。
sentences.traditional: 他給自己定了一個目標，今年讀完二十本書。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi zìjǐ dìng le yí gè mùbiāo, jīnnián dú wán èrshí běn shū.
sentences.translation: He set himself a goal to finish reading twenty books this year.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司未来三年的目标是扩大海外市场。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司未來三年的目標是擴大海外市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī wèilái sān nián de mùbiāo shì kuòdà hǎiwài shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: This company's goal for the next three years is to expand overseas markets.

sentences.chinese: 你做这件事的目的到底是什么？
sentences.traditional: 你做這件事的目的到底是什麼？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zuò zhè jiàn shì de mùdì dàodǐ shì shénme?
sentences.translation: What exactly is your purpose in doing this?

sentences.chinese: 这次调查的目的是了解大家的真实想法。
sentences.traditional: 這次調查的目的是了解大家的真實想法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì diàochá de mùdì shì liǎojiě dàjiā de zhēnshí xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: The purpose of this survey is to understand everyone's true thoughts.

sentences.chinese: 他来中国学习汉语，目的很明确。
sentences.traditional: 他來中國學習漢語，目的很明確。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lái Zhōngguó xuéxí Hànyǔ, mùdì hěn míngquè.
sentences.translation: He came to China to study Chinese, and his purpose is very clear.

sentences.chinese: 飞机因为天气原因晚点了两个小时，最后还是安全到达了目的地。
sentences.traditional: 飛機因為天氣原因晚點了兩個小時，最後還是安全到達了目的地。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì yuányīn wǎndiǎn le liǎng gè xiǎoshí, zuìhòu háishi ānquán dàodá le mùdìdì.
sentences.translation: The plane was delayed for two hours because of the weather, but in the end it still arrived safely at the destination.

sentences.chinese: 出发以前，请大家再确认一下目的地的地址。
sentences.traditional: 出發以前，請大家再確認一下目的地的地址。
sentences.pinyin: Chūfā yǐqián, qǐng dàjiā zài quèrèn yíxià mùdìdì de dìzhǐ.
sentences.translation: Before setting off, please confirm the address of the destination once more.

sentences.chinese: 对我来说，旅行的意义不只是到达目的地，还包括路上的经历。
sentences.traditional: 對我來說，旅行的意義不只是到達目的地，還包括路上的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, lǚxíng de yìyì bù zhǐ shì dàodá mùdìdì, hái bāokuò lùshang de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: For me, the meaning of travel is not just reaching the destination, but also the experiences along the way.

sentences.chinese: 目前公司的情况比去年稳定多了。
sentences.traditional: 目前公司的情況比去年穩定多了。
sentences.pinyin: Mùqián gōngsī de qíngkuàng bǐ qùnián wěndìng duō le.
sentences.translation: At present, the company's situation is much more stable than last year.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题目前还没有找到最好的解决办法。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題目前還沒有找到最好的解決辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí mùqián hái méiyǒu zhǎodào zuì hǎo de jiějué bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: At present, the best solution to this problem has not yet been found.

sentences.chinese: 目前来看，他通过面试的可能性很大。
sentences.traditional: 目前來看，他通過面試的可能性很大。
sentences.pinyin: Mùqián lái kàn, tā tōngguò miànshì de kěnéngxìng hěn dà.
sentences.translation: At the moment, it looks very likely that he will pass the interview.

sentences.chinese: 老师很有耐心，不管学生问多少次都会认真回答。
sentences.traditional: 老師很有耐心，不管學生問多少次都會認真回答。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn yǒu nàixīn, bùguǎn xuéshēng wèn duōshao cì dōu huì rènzhēn huídá.
sentences.translation: The teacher is very patient and answers carefully no matter how many times the students ask.

sentences.chinese: 做这种工作需要耐心，不能太着急。
sentences.traditional: 做這種工作需要耐心，不能太著急。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò zhè zhǒng gōngzuò xūyào nàixīn, bùnéng tài zháojí.
sentences.translation: Doing this kind of work requires patience; you cannot be too hasty.

sentences.chinese: 如果你再耐心一点，也许就能把这个问题想明白了。
sentences.traditional: 如果你再耐心一點，也許就能把這個問題想明白了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ zài nàixīn yìdiǎn, yěxǔ jiù néng bǎ zhège wèntí xiǎng míngbai le.
sentences.translation: If you were a bit more patient, you might be able to figure this problem out.

sentences.chinese: 这个国家的南部一年四季都比较暖和。
sentences.traditional: 這個國家的南部一年四季都比較暖和。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de nánbù yì nián sì jì dōu bǐjiào nuǎnhuo.
sentences.translation: The southern part of this country is fairly warm all year round.

sentences.chinese: 听说中国南部的水果种类特别多。
sentences.traditional: 聽說中國南部的水果種類特別多。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō Zhōngguó nánbù de shuǐguǒ zhǒnglèi tèbié duō.
sentences.translation: I have heard that there are especially many kinds of fruit in southern China.

sentences.chinese: 我们打算先去南部旅游，然后再往北走。
sentences.traditional: 我們打算先去南部旅遊，然後再往北走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn xiān qù nánbù lǚyóu, ránhòu zài wǎng běi zǒu.
sentences.translation: We plan to travel to the south first and then head north.

sentences.chinese: 难道你忘了我们昨天已经说好了吗？
sentences.traditional: 難道你忘了我們昨天已經說好了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nándào nǐ wàng le wǒmen zuótiān yǐjīng shuō hǎo le ma?
sentences.translation: Could it be that you forgot we had already agreed yesterday?

sentences.chinese: 这么简单的问题，难道你一点儿也看不出来？
sentences.traditional: 這麼簡單的問題，難道你一點兒也看不出來？
sentences.pinyin: Zhème jiǎndān de wèntí, nándào nǐ yìdiǎnr yě kàn bu chūlái?
sentences.translation: Such a simple question—could it be that you cannot see it at all?

sentences.chinese: 难道他真的不想参加这次比赛？
sentences.traditional: 難道他真的不想參加這次比賽？
sentences.pinyin: Nándào tā zhēnde bù xiǎng cānjiā zhè cì bǐsài?
sentences.translation: Could it be that he really does not want to take part in this competition?

sentences.chinese: 这家店的二楼主要卖男士衣服。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的二樓主要賣男士衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de èr lóu zhǔyào mài nánshì yīfu.
sentences.translation: The second floor of this shop mainly sells men's clothes.

sentences.chinese: 请问，这位男士是和你一起来的吗？
sentences.traditional: 請問，這位男士是和你一起來的嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhè wèi nánshì shì hé nǐ yìqǐ lái de ma?
sentences.translation: Excuse me, did this gentleman come with you?

sentences.chinese: 那位男士看起来很熟悉，好像在哪儿见过。
sentences.traditional: 那位男士看起來很熟悉，好像在哪兒見過。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi nánshì kàn qǐlái hěn shúxī, hǎoxiàng zài nǎr jiàn guo.
sentences.translation: That gentleman looks very familiar, as if I have seen him somewhere before.

sentences.chinese: 我今天一直觉得胃里不太舒服，很难受。
sentences.traditional: 我今天一直覺得胃裡不太舒服，很難受。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yìzhí juéde wèi lǐ bù tài shūfu, hěn nánshòu.
sentences.translation: I have felt uncomfortable in my stomach all day and feel quite unwell.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息以后，她心里特别难受。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息以後，她心裡特別難受。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi yǐhòu, tā xīn lǐ tèbié nánshòu.
sentences.translation: After hearing this news, she felt especially upset.

sentences.chinese: 如果你还是这么难受，就早点儿去看医生吧。
sentences.traditional: 如果你還是這麼難受，就早點兒去看醫生吧。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ háishi zhème nánshòu, jiù zǎodiǎnr qù kàn yīshēng ba.
sentences.translation: If you still feel this bad, go and see a doctor earlier.

sentences.chinese: 这是我第一次出国旅行，所以感觉特别难忘。
sentences.traditional: 這是我第一次出國旅行，所以感覺特別難忘。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì chūguó lǚxíng, suǒyǐ gǎnjué tèbié nánwàng.
sentences.translation: This was my first trip abroad, so it felt especially unforgettable.

sentences.chinese: 老师对我的帮助让我一直觉得很难忘。
sentences.traditional: 老師對我的幫助讓我一直覺得很難忘。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì wǒ de bāngzhù ràng wǒ yìzhí juéde hěn nánwàng.
sentences.translation: The teacher's help for me has always felt unforgettable.

sentences.chinese: 那次比赛虽然输了，但是过程非常难忘。
sentences.traditional: 那次比賽雖然輸了，但是過程非常難忘。
sentences.pinyin: Nà cì bǐsài suīrán shū le, dànshì guòchéng fēicháng nánwàng.
sentences.translation: Although we lost that match, the process was very unforgettable.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院专门设有男性健康检查中心。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院專門設有男性健康檢查中心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn zhuānmén shè yǒu nánxìng jiànkāng jiǎnchá zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: This hospital has a special men's health check centre.

sentences.chinese: 调查结果显示，男性和女性的看法有一些不同。
sentences.traditional: 調查結果顯示，男性和女性的看法有一些不同。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jiéguǒ xiǎnshì, nánxìng hé nǚxìng de kànfǎ yǒu yìxiē bùtóng.
sentences.translation: The survey results show that men and women differ somewhat in their views.

sentences.chinese: 这本杂志的主要读者是二十到三十五岁的男性。
sentences.traditional: 這本雜誌的主要讀者是二十到三十五歲的男性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì de zhǔyào dúzhě shì èrshí dào sānshíwǔ suì de nánxìng.
sentences.translation: The main readers of this magazine are men aged twenty to thirty-five.

sentences.chinese: 这些资料都属于公司内部文件，不能随便发出去。
sentences.traditional: 這些資料都屬於公司內部文件，不能隨便發出去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīliào dōu shǔyú gōngsī nèibù wénjiàn, bùnéng suíbiàn fā chūqù.
sentences.translation: These materials are all internal company documents and cannot be sent out casually.

sentences.chinese: 请在三天内把这份报告看完并提出意见。
sentences.traditional: 請在三天內把這份報告看完並提出意見。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài sān tiān nèi bǎ zhè fèn bàogào kàn wán bìng tíchū yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please finish reading this report within three days and give your comments.

sentences.chinese: 两小时内到机场的话，时间还是来得及的。
sentences.traditional: 兩小時內到機場的話，時間還是來得及的。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng xiǎoshí nèi dào jīchǎng de huà, shíjiān háishi láidejí de.
sentences.translation: If we get to the airport within two hours, there is still enough time.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的内容很丰富，值得慢慢读。
sentences.traditional: 這本書的內容很豐富，值得慢慢讀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn fēngfù, zhíde mànmàn dú.
sentences.translation: The content of this book is very rich and worth reading slowly.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们先了解课文的主要内容。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們先了解課文的主要內容。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen xiān liǎojiě kèwén de zhǔyào nèiróng.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us first to understand the main content of the text.

sentences.chinese: 这次会议的内容和下个月的计划有关。
sentences.traditional: 這次會議的內容和下個月的計劃有關。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de nèiróng hé xià gè yuè de jìhuà yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: The content of this meeting is related to next month's plan.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他表面很平静，其实内心非常紧张。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他表面很平靜，其實內心非常緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā biǎomiàn hěn píngjìng, qíshí nèixīn fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Although he looked calm on the surface, he was actually very nervous inside.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影把人物的内心变化表现得很真实。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影把人物的內心變化表現得很真實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bǎ rénwù de nèixīn biànhuà biǎoxiàn de hěn zhēnshí.
sentences.translation: This film portrays the characters' inner changes very realistically.

sentences.chinese: 每个人的内心深处都有自己最在意的东西。
sentences.traditional: 每個人的內心深處都有自己最在意的東西。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè rén de nèixīn shēnchù dōu yǒu zìjǐ zuì zàiyì de dōngxi.
sentences.translation: Deep in everyone's heart there is something they care about most.

sentences.chinese: 请你尽快告诉我明天能否参加会议。
sentences.traditional: 請你盡快告訴我明天能否參加會議。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jǐnkuài gàosu wǒ míngtiān néng fǒu cānjiā huìyì.
sentences.translation: Please let me know as soon as possible whether you can attend the meeting tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案能否成功，还要看大家怎么配合。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案能否成功，還要看大家怎麼配合。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn néng fǒu chénggōng, hái yào kàn dàjiā zěnme pèihé.
sentences.translation: Whether this plan succeeds still depends on how everyone cooperates.

sentences.chinese: 我还不确定周末能否抽出时间陪家人。
sentences.traditional: 我還不確定週末能否抽出時間陪家人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái bù quèdìng zhōumò néng fǒu chōu chū shíjiān péi jiārén.
sentences.translation: I am still not sure whether I can make time at the weekend to be with my family.

sentences.chinese: 只要认真准备，你一定能够通过这次考试。
sentences.traditional: 只要認真準備，你一定能夠通過這次考試。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào rènzhēn zhǔnbèi, nǐ yídìng nénggòu tōngguò zhè cì kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: As long as you prepare seriously, you will definitely be able to pass this exam.

sentences.chinese: 现在网络很方便，我们在国外也能够联系家里。
sentences.traditional: 現在網絡很方便，我們在國外也能夠聯繫家裡。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài wǎngluò hěn fāngbiàn, wǒmen zài guówài yě nénggòu liánxì jiāli.
sentences.translation: Now that the internet is convenient, we can also contact home when abroad.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作要求员工能够独立解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作要求員工能夠獨立解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò yāoqiú yuángōng nénggòu dúlì jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: This job requires employees to be able to solve problems independently.

sentences.chinese: 他工作能力很强，所以老板很信任他。
sentences.traditional: 他工作能力很強，所以老闆很信任他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn hěn xìnrèn tā.
sentences.translation: He is very capable at work, so the boss trusts him a lot.

sentences.chinese: 学习一门外语不但要有兴趣，还要有坚持下去的能力。
sentences.traditional: 學習一門外語不但要有興趣，還要有堅持下去的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yì mén wàiyǔ bùdàn yào yǒu xìngqù, hái yào yǒu jiānchí xiàqù de nénglì.
sentences.translation: Learning a foreign language requires not only interest but also the ability to keep going.

sentences.chinese: 我相信你有能力把这件事处理好。
sentences.traditional: 我相信你有能力把這件事處理好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ yǒu nénglì bǎ zhè jiàn shì chǔlǐ hǎo.
sentences.translation: I believe you have the ability to handle this matter well.

sentences.chinese: 老师问我听懂了没有，我点点头说：“嗯，懂了。”
sentences.traditional: 老師問我聽懂了沒有，我點點頭說：「嗯，懂了。」
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèn wǒ tīng dǒng le méiyǒu, wǒ diǎn diǎn tóu shuō: “ǹg, dǒng le.”
sentences.translation: The teacher asked whether I had understood, and I nodded and said, “Mm, I got it.”

sentences.chinese: 电话那头的人只是轻轻地嗯了一声，没有多解释。
sentences.traditional: 電話那頭的人只是輕輕地嗯了一聲，沒有多解釋。
sentences.pinyin: Diànhuà nà tóu de rén zhǐshì qīngqīng de ǹg le yì shēng, méiyǒu duō jiěshì.
sentences.translation: The person on the other end of the phone only murmured “mm” softly and gave no further explanation.

sentences.chinese: 她想了几秒钟，才嗯了一下表示同意。
sentences.traditional: 她想了幾秒鐘，才嗯了一下表示同意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng le jǐ miǎozhōng, cái ǹg le yíxià biǎoshì tóngyì.
sentences.translation: She thought for a few seconds before giving a quiet “mm” to show agreement.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划在年底以前完成这个项目。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃在年底以前完成這個項目。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà zài niándǐ yǐqián wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: The company plans to complete this project before the end of the year.

sentences.chinese: 每到年底，商场里都会有很多打折活动。
sentences.traditional: 每到年底，商場裡都會有很多打折活動。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào niándǐ, shāngchǎng li dōu huì yǒu hěn duō dǎzhé huódòng.
sentences.translation: Whenever it gets to the end of the year, shopping centres have lots of discount events.

sentences.chinese: 我希望能在年底前存够去旅行的钱。
sentences.traditional: 我希望能在年底前存夠去旅行的錢。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng néng zài niándǐ qián cún gòu qù lǚxíng de qián.
sentences.translation: I hope to save enough money for travelling before the end of the year.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他们年龄差不多，但是性格完全不同。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他們年齡差不多，但是性格完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tāmen niánlíng chàbuduō, dànshì xìnggé wánquán bùtóng.
sentences.translation: Although they are about the same age, their personalities are completely different.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作对年龄没有特别要求。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作對年齡沒有特別要求。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò duì niánlíng méiyǒu tèbié yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: This job has no special age requirement.

sentences.chinese: 到了这个年龄，很多人会更重视健康。
sentences.traditional: 到了這個年齡，很多人會更重視健康。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le zhège niánlíng, hěn duō rén huì gèng zhòngshì jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: At this age, many people pay more attention to their health.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候住在农村，后来才搬到城市。
sentences.traditional: 他小時候住在農村，後來才搬到城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou zhù zài nóngcūn, hòulái cái bān dào chéngshì.
sentences.translation: He lived in the countryside when he was little and only moved to the city later.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多年轻人也愿意回农村创业。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多年輕人也願意回農村創業。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō niánqīng rén yě yuànyì huí nóngcūn chuàngyè.
sentences.translation: Nowadays many young people are also willing to return to the countryside to start businesses.

sentences.chinese: 这几年农村的生活条件改善了很多。
sentences.traditional: 這幾年農村的生活條件改善了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián nóngcūn de shēnghuó tiáojiàn gǎishàn le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: In recent years, living conditions in the countryside have improved a lot.

sentences.chinese: 这个机器有点儿复杂，我还没弄明白怎么用。
sentences.traditional: 這個機器有點兒複雜，我還沒弄明白怎麼用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jīqì yǒudiǎnr fùzá, wǒ hái méi nòng míngbai zěnme yòng.
sentences.translation: This machine is a bit complicated, and I still have not worked out how to use it.

sentences.chinese: 你先别着急，我来帮你把这件事弄好。
sentences.traditional: 你先別著急，我來幫你把這件事弄好。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié zháojí, wǒ lái bāng nǐ bǎ zhè jiàn shì nòng hǎo.
sentences.translation: Don't worry first; I’ll help you get this matter sorted out.

sentences.chinese: 衣服上都是油，你是怎么弄脏的？
sentences.traditional: 衣服上都是油，你是怎麼弄髒的？
sentences.pinyin: Yīfu shàng dōu shì yóu, nǐ shì zěnme nòng zāng de?
sentences.translation: Your clothes are covered in oil; how did you get them dirty?

sentences.chinese: 这家公司女性员工的比例越来越高。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司女性員工的比例越來越高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī nǚxìng yuángōng de bǐlì yuèláiyuè gāo.
sentences.translation: The proportion of female employees in this company is getting higher and higher.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议女性每年做一次身体检查。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議女性每年做一次身體檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì nǚxìng měinián zuò yí cì shēntǐ jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: Doctors advise women to have a physical check-up once a year.

sentences.chinese: 这本杂志的主要读者是年轻女性。
sentences.traditional: 這本雜誌的主要讀者是年輕女性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì de zhǔyào dúzhě shì niánqīng nǚxìng.
sentences.translation: The main readers of this magazine are young women.

sentences.chinese: 外面很冷，快进屋里暖和一下吧。
sentences.traditional: 外面很冷，快進屋裡暖和一下吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, kuài jìn wū li nuǎnhuo yíxià ba.
sentences.translation: It is cold outside; come inside and warm up a bit.

sentences.chinese: 今天太阳出来了，天气比昨天暖和多了。
sentences.traditional: 今天太陽出來了，天氣比昨天暖和多了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān tàiyang chūlái le, tiānqì bǐ zuótiān nuǎnhuo duō le.
sentences.translation: The sun came out today, so the weather is much warmer than yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 穿上这件外套以后，你就会觉得暖和一些。
sentences.traditional: 穿上這件外套以後，你就會覺得暖和一些。
sentences.pinyin: Chuān shàng zhè jiàn wàitào yǐhòu, nǐ jiù huì juéde nuǎnhuo yìxiē.
sentences.translation: After putting on this coat, you will feel a bit warmer.

sentences.chinese: 我偶尔会一个人去海边散步，让自己冷静下来。
sentences.traditional: 我偶爾會一個人去海邊散步，讓自己冷靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ǒu'ěr huì yí ge rén qù hǎibiān sànbù, ràng zìjǐ lěngjìng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: I occasionally go for a walk by the sea alone to calm myself down.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然工作很忙，但偶尔也会陪孩子做游戏。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然工作很忙，但偶爾也會陪孩子做遊戲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn ǒu'ěr yě huì péi háizi zuò yóuxì.
sentences.translation: Although he is very busy with work, he still occasionally plays games with his child.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅我不是常来，只是偶尔和朋友聚一聚。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳我不是常來，只是偶爾和朋友聚一聚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng wǒ bú shì cháng lái, zhǐshì ǒu'ěr hé péngyou jù yí jù.
sentences.translation: I do not come to this restaurant often; I just meet friends here occasionally.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片拍得很自然，看起来一点儿也不假。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片拍得很自然，看起來一點兒也不假。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn pāi de hěn zìrán, kàn qǐlái yìdiǎnr yě bù jiǎ.
sentences.translation: This photo was taken very naturally and does not look staged at all.

sentences.chinese: 开会的时候，请不要一直拍桌子打断别人说话。
sentences.traditional: 開會的時候，請不要一直拍桌子打斷別人說話。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhou, qǐng búyào yìzhí pāi zhuōzi dǎduàn biérén shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: During meetings, please do not keep slapping the table and interrupting others.

sentences.chinese: 她一看到美景，就忍不住拿出手机拍下来。
sentences.traditional: 她一看到美景，就忍不住拿出手機拍下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí kàn dào měijǐng, jiù rěnbuzhù ná chū shǒujī pāi xiàlai.
sentences.translation: As soon as she sees beautiful scenery, she cannot help taking out her phone to photograph it.

sentences.chinese: 请把这些书按时间顺序排好，方便大家查找。
sentences.traditional: 請把這些書按時間順序排好，方便大家查找。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē shū àn shíjiān shùnxù pái hǎo, fāngbiàn dàjiā cházhǎo.
sentences.translation: Please arrange these books in time order so everyone can look them up easily.

sentences.chinese: 门口已经排了很长一行人，我们可能要等一会儿。
sentences.traditional: 門口已經排了很長一行人，我們可能要等一會兒。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu yǐjīng pái le hěn cháng yì xíng rén, wǒmen kěnéng yào děng yíhuìr.
sentences.translation: A very long line of people has already formed at the entrance, so we may have to wait a while.

sentences.chinese: 这一排座位都被订完了，我们坐后面吧。
sentences.traditional: 這一排座位都被訂完了，我們坐後面吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yì pái zuòwèi dōu bèi dìng wán le, wǒmen zuò hòumiàn ba.
sentences.translation: This row of seats has all been booked, so let us sit at the back.

sentences.chinese: 路边挂着一块牌，上面写着“禁止停车”。
sentences.traditional: 路邊掛著一塊牌，上面寫著「禁止停車」。
sentences.pinyin: Lùbiān guà zhe yí kuài pái, shàngmiàn xiězhe 'jìnzhǐ tíngchē'.
sentences.translation: There is a sign hanging by the roadside that says 'No Parking'.

sentences.chinese: 这种牌的牛奶比较贵，但是质量很好。
sentences.traditional: 這種牌的牛奶比較貴，但是質量很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng pái de niúnǎi bǐjiào guì, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Milk of this brand is rather expensive, but the quality is very good.

sentences.chinese: 这副牌少了一张，所以没法继续玩下去。
sentences.traditional: 這副牌少了一張，所以沒法繼續玩下去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fù pái shǎo le yì zhāng, suǒyǐ méi fǎ jìxù wán xiàqù.
sentences.translation: This pack of cards is missing one card, so we cannot keep playing.

sentences.chinese: 买票的人太多了，我们得先排队。
sentences.traditional: 買票的人太多了，我們得先排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi piào de rén tài duō le, wǒmen děi xiān páiduì.
sentences.translation: There are too many people buying tickets, so we have to queue first.

sentences.chinese: 上车的时候请大家自觉排队，不要挤。
sentences.traditional: 上車的時候請大家自覺排隊，不要擠。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng chē de shíhou qǐng dàjiā zìjué páiduì, búyào jǐ.
sentences.translation: Please queue voluntarily when getting on the bus and do not push.

sentences.chinese: 他不喜欢浪费时间，所以最怕在银行排队。
sentences.traditional: 他不喜歡浪費時間，所以最怕在銀行排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuan làngfèi shíjiān, suǒyǐ zuì pà zài yínháng páiduì.
sentences.translation: He does not like wasting time, so he hates queueing at the bank most.

sentences.chinese: 学校下周要举行排球比赛，你想参加吗？
sentences.traditional: 學校下週要舉行排球比賽，你想參加嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xià zhōu yào jǔxíng páiqiú bǐsài, nǐ xiǎng cānjiā ma?
sentences.translation: The school is holding a volleyball match next week; do you want to take part?

sentences.chinese: 她虽然个子不高，但是打排球打得很好。
sentences.traditional: 她雖然個子不高，但是打排球打得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán gèzi bù gāo, dànshì dǎ páiqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although she is not tall, she plays volleyball very well.

sentences.chinese: 夏天的时候，很多年轻人喜欢去沙滩上打排球。
sentences.traditional: 夏天的時候，很多年輕人喜歡去沙灘上打排球。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, hěn duō niánqīng rén xǐhuan qù shātān shàng dǎ páiqiú.
sentences.translation: In summer, many young people like to play volleyball on the beach.

sentences.chinese: 这个牌子的手机虽然不便宜，但是很耐用。
sentences.traditional: 這個牌子的手機雖然不便宜，但是很耐用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège páizi de shǒujī suīrán bù piányi, dànshì hěn nàiyòng.
sentences.translation: This brand of mobile phone is not cheap, but it is very durable.

sentences.chinese: 商店门口的牌子写着今天晚上八点关门。
sentences.traditional: 商店門口的牌子寫著今天晚上八點關門。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn ménkǒu de páizi xiězhe jīntiān wǎnshang bā diǎn guānmén.
sentences.translation: The sign at the shop entrance says it closes at eight tonight.

sentences.chinese: 我对牌子没有特别要求，质量好就可以了。
sentences.traditional: 我對牌子沒有特別要求，質量好就可以了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì páizi méiyǒu tèbié yāoqiú, zhìliàng hǎo jiù kěyǐ le.
sentences.translation: I do not have special requirements about the brand; good quality is enough.

sentences.chinese: 不要只听别人怎么说，你要自己判断。
sentences.traditional: 不要只聽別人怎麼說，你要自己判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Búyào zhǐ tīng biérén zěnme shuō, nǐ yào zìjǐ pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Do not just listen to what others say; you need to judge for yourself.

sentences.chinese: 医生需要根据检查结果判断病人的情况。
sentences.traditional: 醫生需要根據檢查結果判斷病人的情況。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào gēnjù jiǎnchá jiéguǒ pànduàn bìngrén de qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Doctors need to determine the patient's condition according to the examination results.

sentences.chinese: 现在下结论还太早，我们得先判断问题出在哪里。
sentences.traditional: 現在下結論還太早，我們得先判斷問題出在哪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài xià jiélùn hái tài zǎo, wǒmen děi xiān pànduàn wèntí chū zài nǎli.
sentences.translation: It is still too early to draw a conclusion; we must first determine where the problem lies.

sentences.chinese: 明天我陪你去医院检查，这样你会放心一点。
sentences.traditional: 明天我陪你去醫院檢查，這樣你會放心一點。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ péi nǐ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá, zhèyàng nǐ huì fàngxīn yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: I will go with you to the hospital for the check-up tomorrow, so you will feel more at ease.

sentences.chinese: 孩子生病的时候，父母最好一直陪在身边。
sentences.traditional: 孩子生病的時候，父母最好一直陪在身邊。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi shēngbìng de shíhou, fùmǔ zuìhǎo yìzhí péi zài shēnbiān.
sentences.translation: When a child is ill, the parents had better stay by their side.

sentences.chinese: 周末他常常陪奶奶去公园散步。
sentences.traditional: 週末他常常陪奶奶去公園散步。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò tā chángcháng péi nǎinai qù gōngyuán sànbù.
sentences.translation: At weekends he often accompanies his grandmother for a walk in the park.

sentences.chinese: 老师批评他，不是因为他不会，而是因为他不认真。
sentences.traditional: 老師批評他，不是因為他不會，而是因為他不認真。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī pīpíng tā, bú shì yīnwèi tā bú huì, érshì yīnwèi tā bù rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: The teacher criticised him not because he could not do it, but because he was not serious.

sentences.chinese: 接受别人的批评以后，最重要的是愿意改正。
sentences.traditional: 接受別人的批評以後，最重要的是願意改正。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēshòu biérén de pīpíng yǐhòu, zuì zhòngyào de shì yuànyì gǎizhèng.
sentences.translation: After accepting other people's criticism, the most important thing is to be willing to correct yourself.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然被领导批评了，但是还是保持得很冷静。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然被領導批評了，但是還是保持得很冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán bèi lǐngdǎo pīpíng le, dànshì háishi bǎochí de hěn lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: Although he was criticised by his manager, he still remained very calm.

sentences.chinese: 春天很干燥，记得保护皮肤。
sentences.traditional: 春天很乾燥，記得保護皮膚。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān hěn gānzào, jìde bǎohù pífū.
sentences.translation: Spring is very dry, so remember to protect your skin.

sentences.chinese: 她的皮肤对这种药很敏感。
sentences.traditional: 她的皮膚對這種藥很敏感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de pífū duì zhè zhǒng yào hěn mǐngǎn.
sentences.translation: Her skin is sensitive to this kind of medicine.

sentences.chinese: 如果皮肤晒伤了，就应该先休息一下。
sentences.traditional: 如果皮膚曬傷了，就應該先休息一下。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ pífū shàishāng le, jiù yīnggāi xiān xiūxi yíxià.
sentences.translation: If your skin gets sunburnt, you should rest first.

sentences.chinese: 他平时脾气不错，很少跟别人吵架。
sentences.traditional: 他平時脾氣不錯，很少跟別人吵架。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píngshí píqi búcuò, hěn shǎo gēn biérén chǎojià.
sentences.translation: He usually has a good temper and rarely argues with others.

sentences.chinese: 你别着急，发脾气解决不了问题。
sentences.traditional: 你別著急，發脾氣解決不了問題。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié zháojí, fā píqi jiějué bù liǎo wèntí.
sentences.translation: Do not get anxious; losing your temper cannot solve the problem.

sentences.chinese: 她虽然脾气有点急，但是心地很好。
sentences.traditional: 她雖然脾氣有點急，但是心地很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán píqi yǒudiǎn jí, dànshì xīndì hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although she is a bit short-tempered, she has a very kind heart.

sentences.chinese: 面试的时候，他穿了一双黑色的皮鞋。
sentences.traditional: 面試的時候，他穿了一雙黑色的皮鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì de shíhou, tā chuān le yì shuāng hēisè de píxié.
sentences.translation: He wore a pair of black leather shoes for the interview.

sentences.chinese: 这双皮鞋有点大，你穿着舒服吗？
sentences.traditional: 這雙皮鞋有點大，你穿著舒服嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuāng píxié yǒudiǎn dà, nǐ chuān zhe shūfu ma?
sentences.translation: This pair of leather shoes is a bit big; are they comfortable to wear?

sentences.chinese: 下雨天穿皮鞋出去不太方便。
sentences.traditional: 下雨天穿皮鞋出去不太方便。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔtiān chuān píxié chūqù bù tài fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: It is not very convenient to go out in leather shoes on rainy days.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章写得很精彩，我看了两遍。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章寫得很精彩，我看了兩遍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng xiě de hěn jīngcǎi, wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn.
sentences.translation: This article is very well written, and I read it twice.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们下周交一篇作文。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們下週交一篇作文。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xià zhōu jiāo yì piān zuòwén.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to hand in a composition next week.

sentences.chinese: 这么长的一篇报告，你一天写得完吗？
sentences.traditional: 這麼長的一篇報告，你一天寫得完嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhème cháng de yì piān bàogào, nǐ yì tiān xiě de wán ma?
sentences.translation: Can you finish such a long report in one day?

sentences.chinese: 请给我两片面包，我有点饿了。
sentences.traditional: 請給我兩片麵包，我有點餓了。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng piàn miànbāo, wǒ yǒudiǎn è le.
sentences.translation: Please give me two slices of bread; I am a little hungry.

sentences.chinese: 窗外是一片安静的田野。
sentences.traditional: 窗外是一片安靜的田野。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài shì yí piàn ānjìng de tiányě.
sentences.translation: Outside the window is a quiet stretch of fields.

sentences.chinese: 医生说这药一次吃两片就可以了。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說這藥一次吃兩片就可以了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè yào yí cì chī liǎng piàn jiù kěyǐ le.
sentences.translation: The doctor said taking two tablets at a time is enough.

sentences.chinese: 他从小学开始打乒乓球，所以技术很好。
sentences.traditional: 他從小學開始打乒乓球，所以技術很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎoxué kāishǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú, suǒyǐ jìshù hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: He has played table tennis since primary school, so his technique is very good.

sentences.chinese: 如果你有空，我们周末一起去打乒乓球吧。
sentences.traditional: 如果你有空，我們週末一起去打乒乓球吧。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu kòng, wǒmen zhōumò yìqǐ qù dǎ pīngpāngqiú ba.
sentences.translation: If you are free, let us go play table tennis together this weekend.

sentences.chinese: 中国很多人都喜欢看乒乓球比赛。
sentences.traditional: 中國很多人都喜歡看乒乓球比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuan kàn pīngpāngqiú bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Many people in China like watching table tennis matches.

sentences.chinese: 他平常话不多，但是很愿意帮助别人。
sentences.traditional: 他平常話不多，但是很願意幫助別人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píngcháng huà bù duō, dànshì hěn yuànyì bāngzhù biérén.
sentences.translation: He is usually not very talkative, but he is very willing to help others.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅平常人不多，周末却很热闹。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳平常人不多，週末卻很熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng píngcháng rén bù duō, zhōumò què hěn rènao.
sentences.translation: This restaurant is usually not crowded, but it is lively at weekends.

sentences.chinese: 你平常几点下班？
sentences.traditional: 你平常幾點下班？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng jǐ diǎn xiàbān?
sentences.translation: What time do you usually finish work?

sentences.chinese: 我的手机屏幕破了，得赶快去修。
sentences.traditional: 我的手機屏幕破了，得趕快去修。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī píngmù pò le, děi gǎnkuài qù xiū.
sentences.translation: My phone screen is broken, and I need to get it repaired quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这条裤子太旧了，膝盖的地方都穿破了。
sentences.traditional: 這條褲子太舊了，膝蓋的地方都穿破了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài jiù le, xīgài de dìfang dōu chuānpò le.
sentences.translation: These trousers are so old that the knees have worn through.

sentences.chinese: 他不小心把杯子打破了。
sentences.traditional: 他不小心把杯子打破了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bǎ bēizi dǎpò le.
sentences.translation: He accidentally broke the cup.

sentences.chinese: 夏天的时候，冰过的葡萄特别好吃。
sentences.traditional: 夏天的時候，冰過的葡萄特別好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, bīng guò de pútao tèbié hǎochī.
sentences.translation: In summer, chilled grapes are especially tasty.

sentences.chinese: 这种葡萄很甜，但是价格不便宜。
sentences.traditional: 這種葡萄很甜，但是價格不便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng pútao hěn tián, dànshì jiàgé bù piányi.
sentences.translation: These grapes are very sweet, but they are not cheap.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们一边聊天一边吃葡萄。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們一邊聊天一邊吃葡萄。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yìbiān liáotiān yìbiān chī pútao.
sentences.translation: The children chat while eating grapes.

sentences.chinese: 这瓶葡萄酒是朋友从法国带回来的。
sentences.traditional: 這瓶葡萄酒是朋友從法國帶回來的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè píng pútaojiǔ shì péngyou cóng Fǎguó dài huílai de.
sentences.translation: This bottle of wine was brought back from France by a friend.

sentences.chinese: 他对葡萄酒不太了解，只是偶尔喝一点。
sentences.traditional: 他對葡萄酒不太了解，只是偶爾喝一點。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì pútaojiǔ bù tài liǎojiě, zhǐshì ǒu’ěr hē yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: He does not know much about wine and only drinks a little occasionally.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的葡萄酒种类很多，你可以慢慢选。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的葡萄酒種類很多，你可以慢慢選。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de pútaojiǔ zhǒnglèi hěn duō, nǐ kěyǐ mànmàn xuǎn.
sentences.translation: This shop has many kinds of wine, and you can choose slowly.

sentences.chinese: 这种看法在年轻人中很普遍。
sentences.traditional: 這種看法在年輕人中很普遍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kànfǎ zài niánqīngrén zhōng hěn pǔbiàn.
sentences.translation: This view is very common among young people.

sentences.chinese: 网上购物现在已经变得很普遍了。
sentences.traditional: 網上購物現在已經變得很普遍了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngshàng gòuwù xiànzài yǐjīng biàn de hěn pǔbiàn le.
sentences.translation: Online shopping has now become very widespread.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题在很多城市都很普遍。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題在很多城市都很普遍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí zài hěn duō chéngshì dōu hěn pǔbiàn.
sentences.translation: This problem is common in many cities.

sentences.chinese: 这是一家很普通的小餐厅，但是味道不错。
sentences.traditional: 這是一家很普通的小餐廳，但是味道不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yì jiā hěn pǔtōng de xiǎo cāntīng, dànshì wèidào búcuò.
sentences.translation: This is a very ordinary small restaurant, but the food tastes good.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然出身普通，却一直很努力。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然出身普通，卻一直很努力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán chūshēn pǔtōng, què yìzhí hěn nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Although he comes from an ordinary background, he has always worked hard.

sentences.chinese: 这种手机的功能比较普通，不算特别先进。
sentences.traditional: 這種手機的功能比較普通，不算特別先進。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shǒujī de gōngnéng bǐjiào pǔtōng, bú suàn tèbié xiānjìn.
sentences.translation: This kind of phone has fairly ordinary functions and is not especially advanced.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想在中国工作，普通话最好说得流利一点。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想在中國工作，普通話最好說得流利一點。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zài Zhōngguó gōngzuò, pǔtōnghuà zuìhǎo shuō de liúlì yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: If you want to work in China, it is best to speak Mandarin a bit more fluently.

sentences.chinese: 老师上课的时候一直用普通话，不用方言。
sentences.traditional: 老師上課的時候一直用普通話，不用方言。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shàngkè de shíhou yìzhí yòng pǔtōnghuà, bú yòng fāngyán.
sentences.translation: The teacher uses Mandarin all through class and does not use dialect.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他的普通话不太标准，但是大家都能听懂。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他的普通話不太標準，但是大家都能聽懂。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā de pǔtōnghuà bú tài biāozhǔn, dànshì dàjiā dōu néng tīng dǒng.
sentences.translation: Although his Mandarin is not very standard, everyone can understand him.

sentences.chinese: 这期节目很精彩，我已经看了两遍。
sentences.traditional: 這期節目很精彩，我已經看了兩遍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè qī jiémù hěn jīngcǎi, wǒ yǐjīng kàn le liǎng biàn.
sentences.translation: This episode is excellent, and I have already watched it twice.

sentences.chinese: 这本杂志每个月出一期。
sentences.traditional: 這本雜誌每個月出一期。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì měi gè yuè chū yí qī.
sentences.translation: This magazine publishes one issue every month.

sentences.chinese: 第一期课程结束以后，大家都觉得收获很大。
sentences.traditional: 第一期課程結束以後，大家都覺得收穫很大。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī qī kèchéng jiéshù yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu juéde shōuhuò hěn dà.
sentences.translation: After the first phase of the course ended, everyone felt they had gained a lot.

sentences.chinese: 期末快到了，大家都在认真复习。
sentences.traditional: 期末快到了，大家都在認真複習。
sentences.pinyin: Qīmò kuài dào le, dàjiā dōu zài rènzhēn fùxí.
sentences.translation: The end of term is approaching, and everyone is revising seriously.

sentences.chinese: 这门课的期末考试比期中考试更难。
sentences.traditional: 這門課的期末考試比期中考試更難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kè de qīmò kǎoshì bǐ qīzhōng kǎoshì gèng nán.
sentences.translation: The final exam for this course is harder than the midterm exam.

sentences.chinese: 如果你平时认真听课，期末就不会太紧张。
sentences.traditional: 如果你平時認真聽課，期末就不會太緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ píngshí rènzhēn tīngkè, qīmò jiù bú huì tài jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: If you listen carefully in class normally, you will not be too nervous at the end of term.

sentences.chinese: 下周我们要参加期中考试。
sentences.traditional: 下週我們要參加期中考試。
sentences.pinyin: Xià zhōu wǒmen yào cānjiā qīzhōng kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: We are going to take the midterm exam next week.

sentences.chinese: 他这次期中的成绩比上次进步了很多。
sentences.traditional: 他這次期中的成績比上次進步了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhè cì qīzhōng de chéngjì bǐ shàng cì jìnbù le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: His results in this midterm improved a lot compared with last time.

sentences.chinese: 期中以后，老师给我们换了新的座位。
sentences.traditional: 期中以後，老師給我們換了新的座位。
sentences.pinyin: Qīzhōng yǐhòu, lǎoshī gěi wǒmen huàn le xīn de zuòwèi.
sentences.translation: After the midterm, the teacher changed our seats.

sentences.chinese: 选择工作的时候，我先看兴趣，其次才看工资。
sentences.traditional: 選擇工作的時候，我先看興趣，其次才看工資。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnzé gōngzuò de shíhou, wǒ xiān kàn xìngqù, qícì cái kàn gōngzī.
sentences.translation: When choosing a job, I look at interest first and salary second.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案价格不高，其次也比较容易实行。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案價格不高，其次也比較容易實行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn jiàgé bù gāo, qícì yě bǐjiào róngyì shíxíng.
sentences.translation: This plan is not expensive, and secondly it is also comparatively easy to carry out.

sentences.chinese: 学好一门语言，首先要多听，其次要多说。
sentences.traditional: 學好一門語言，首先要多聽，其次要多說。
sentences.pinyin: Xué hǎo yì mén yǔyán, shǒuxiān yào duō tīng, qícì yào duō shuō.
sentences.translation: To learn a language well, first you need to listen more, and next you need to speak more.

sentences.chinese: 这次旅行我们去了三个城市，其中我最喜欢成都。
sentences.traditional: 這次旅行我們去了三個城市，其中我最喜歡成都。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng wǒmen qù le sān gè chéngshì, qízhōng wǒ zuì xǐhuan Chéngdū.
sentences.translation: On this trip we went to three cities, and among them I liked Chengdu most.

sentences.chinese: 这本书一共十章，其中两章我已经看过了。
sentences.traditional: 這本書一共十章，其中兩章我已經看過了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yígòng shí zhāng, qízhōng liǎng zhāng wǒ yǐjīng kàn guo le.
sentences.translation: This book has ten chapters in total, and I have already read two of them.

sentences.chinese: 班里来了几个新同学，其中有一个是从北京来的。
sentences.traditional: 班裡來了幾個新同學，其中有一個是從北京來的。
sentences.pinyin: Bān lǐ lái le jǐ gè xīn tóngxué, qízhōng yǒu yí gè shì cóng Běijīng lái de.
sentences.translation: Several new classmates came to the class, and one of them is from Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 运动对保持健康能起到很重要的作用。
sentences.traditional: 運動對保持健康能起到很重要的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng duì bǎochí jiànkāng néng qǐdào hěn zhòngyào de zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Exercise can play a very important role in maintaining health.

sentences.chinese: 老师的话对我起到了很大的鼓励作用。
sentences.traditional: 老師的話對我起到了很大的鼓勵作用。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de huà duì wǒ qǐdào le hěn dà de gǔlì zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: The teacher’s words played a greatly encouraging role for me.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定在解决问题方面没有起到太大作用。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定在解決問題方面沒有起到太大作用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng zài jiějué wèntí fāngmiàn méiyǒu qǐdào tài dà zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: This decision has not played much of a role in solving the problem.

sentences.chinese: 他跑完步以后，还在大口喘气。
sentences.traditional: 他跑完步以後，還在大口喘氣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo wán bù yǐhòu, hái zài dà kǒu chuǎn qì.
sentences.translation: After he finished running, he was still breathing heavily.

sentences.chinese: 你别为这种小事生气，不值得。
sentences.traditional: 你別為這種小事生氣，不值得。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié wèi zhè zhǒng xiǎoshì shēng qì, bù zhídé.
sentences.translation: Do not get angry over such a small matter; it is not worth it.

sentences.chinese: 他故意说这些话，就是想气我。
sentences.traditional: 他故意說這些話，就是想氣我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gùyì shuō zhèxiē huà, jiùshì xiǎng qì wǒ.
sentences.translation: He said these things on purpose just to anger me.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市的气候很舒服，冬天也不算太冷。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市的氣候很舒服，冬天也不算太冷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de qìhòu hěn shūfu, dōngtiān yě bù suàn tài lěng.
sentences.translation: The climate in this city is very comfortable, and winter is not too cold either.

sentences.chinese: 因为南北气候不同，人们的生活习惯也不一样。
sentences.traditional: 因為南北氣候不同，人們的生活習慣也不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi nánběi qìhòu bùtóng, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Because the climates in the north and south differ, people’s living habits are also different.

sentences.chinese: 这儿夏天气候又湿又热，我一开始不太习惯。
sentences.traditional: 這兒夏天氣候又濕又熱，我一開始不太習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèr xiàtiān qìhòu yòu shī yòu rè, wǒ yì kāishǐ bù tài xíguàn.
sentences.translation: The summer climate here is hot and humid, and I was not used to it at first.

sentences.chinese: 天这么热，我想买一瓶汽水喝。
sentences.traditional: 天這麼熱，我想買一瓶汽水喝。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān zhème rè, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì píng qìshuǐ hē.
sentences.translation: It is so hot that I want to buy a bottle of soda to drink.

sentences.chinese: 医生说我胃不好，最好少喝汽水。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說我胃不好，最好少喝汽水。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ wèi bù hǎo, zuìhǎo shǎo hē qìshuǐ.
sentences.translation: The doctor said my stomach is not good, so I had better drink less soda.

sentences.chinese: 桌上那瓶汽水是谁买的？
sentences.traditional: 桌上那瓶汽水是誰買的？
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng nà píng qìshuǐ shì shéi mǎi de?
sentences.translation: Who bought that bottle of soda on the table?

sentences.chinese: 今天气温突然下降了很多，出门要多穿一点。
sentences.traditional: 今天氣溫突然下降了很多，出門要多穿一點。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān qìwēn tūrán xiàjiàng le hěn duō, chūmén yào duō chuān yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The temperature dropped a lot suddenly today, so wear a bit more when going out.

sentences.chinese: 山上早晚气温很低，你最好带件外套。
sentences.traditional: 山上早晚氣溫很低，你最好帶件外套。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shàng zǎowǎn qìwēn hěn dī, nǐ zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào.
sentences.translation: The temperature on the mountain is low in the mornings and evenings, so you had better bring a coat.

sentences.chinese: 春天气温变化大，很容易感冒。
sentences.traditional: 春天氣溫變化大，很容易感冒。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān qìwēn biànhuà dà, hěn róngyì gǎnmào.
sentences.translation: In spring, the temperature changes a lot, so it is easy to catch a cold.

sentences.chinese: 这个西瓜大概有五千克重。
sentences.traditional: 這個西瓜大概有五千克重。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xīguā dàgài yǒu wǔ qiānkè zhòng.
sentences.translation: This watermelon weighs about five kilograms.

sentences.chinese: 这种水果十千克一箱，搬的时候要小心。
sentences.traditional: 這種水果十千克一箱，搬的時候要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ shí qiānkè yì xiāng, bān de shíhou yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: This fruit comes in boxes of ten kilograms, so be careful when carrying it.

sentences.chinese: 他一个月瘦了三千克，看起来精神多了。
sentences.traditional: 他一個月瘦了三千克，看起來精神多了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí gè yuè shòu le sān qiānkè, kàn qǐlái jīngshen duō le.
sentences.translation: He lost three kilograms in a month and looks much more energetic now.

sentences.chinese: 这件事你千万别告诉别人。
sentences.traditional: 這件事你千萬別告訴別人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ qiānwàn bié gàosu biérén.
sentences.translation: You absolutely must not tell anyone about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 下雨天路很滑，开车的时候千万要小心。
sentences.traditional: 下雨天路很滑，開車的時候千萬要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ tiān lù hěn huá, kāichē de shíhou qiānwàn yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: The roads are slippery on rainy days, so you absolutely must be careful when driving.

sentences.chinese: 你千万不要因为一次失败就放弃。
sentences.traditional: 你千萬不要因為一次失敗就放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ qiānwàn búyào yīnwèi yí cì shībài jiù fàngqì.
sentences.translation: You absolutely should not give up because of one failure.

sentences.chinese: 去那个国家旅行以前，要先办好签证。
sentences.traditional: 去那個國家旅行以前，要先辦好簽證。
sentences.pinyin: Qù nàge guójiā lǚxíng yǐqián, yào xiān bàn hǎo qiānzhèng.
sentences.translation: Before travelling to that country, you need to get the visa ready first.

sentences.chinese: 我的签证下个月就到期了。
sentences.traditional: 我的簽證下個月就到期了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de qiānzhèng xià gè yuè jiù dàoqī le.
sentences.translation: My visa will expire next month.

sentences.chinese: 如果材料不完整，签证可能办不下来。
sentences.traditional: 如果材料不完整，簽證可能辦不下來。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ cáiliào bù wánzhěng, qiānzhèng kěnéng bàn bu xiàlái.
sentences.translation: If the documents are incomplete, the visa may not be approved.

sentences.chinese: 前方有点堵车，我们可能会晚到十分钟。
sentences.traditional: 前方有點堵車，我們可能會晚到十分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánfāng yǒudiǎn dǔchē, wǒmen kěnéng huì wǎn dào shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: There is a bit of traffic ahead, so we may arrive ten minutes late.

sentences.chinese: 请注意，前方正在修路。
sentences.traditional: 請注意，前方正在修路。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zhùyì, qiánfāng zhèngzài xiūlù.
sentences.translation: Please note that the road ahead is under repair.

sentences.chinese: 看到前方的红灯以后，他马上把车停下了。
sentences.traditional: 看到前方的紅燈以後，他馬上把車停下了。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào qiánfāng de hóngdēng yǐhòu, tā mǎshàng bǎ chē tíng xià le.
sentences.translation: After seeing the red light ahead, he stopped the car at once.

sentences.chinese: 这件事我前后考虑了一个星期，才作出决定。
sentences.traditional: 這件事我前後考慮了一個星期，才作出決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ qiánhòu kǎolǜ le yí gè xīngqī, cái zuò chū juédìng.
sentences.translation: I considered this matter for about a week before making a decision.

sentences.chinese: 教室前后各有一扇门，进出都很方便。
sentences.traditional: 教室前後各有一扇門，進出都很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshì qiánhòu gè yǒu yí shàn mén, jìnchū dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: There is a door at both the front and back of the classroom, making it easy to go in and out.

sentences.chinese: 他前后来了三次，终于把问题说清楚了。
sentences.traditional: 他前後來了三次，終於把問題說清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiánhòu lái le sān cì, zhōngyú bǎ wèntí shuō qīngchu le.
sentences.translation: He came around three times before finally explaining the problem clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这个国家的经济越来越强了。
sentences.traditional: 這個國家的經濟越來越強了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de jīngjì yuèláiyuè qiáng le.
sentences.translation: This country’s economy is getting stronger and stronger.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然年纪不大，但是责任心很强。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然年紀不大，但是責任心很強。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì bú dà, dànshì zérènxīn hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: Although he is not old, his sense of responsibility is very strong.

sentences.chinese: 今天的风太强了，小孩子最好别出去。
sentences.traditional: 今天的風太強了，小孩子最好別出去。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de fēng tài qiáng le, xiǎoháizi zuìhǎo bié chūqù.
sentences.translation: The wind is too strong today, and it is best for children not to go out.

sentences.chinese: 进老师办公室以前，应该先敲门。
sentences.traditional: 進老師辦公室以前，應該先敲門。
sentences.pinyin: Jìn lǎoshī bàngōngshì yǐqián, yīnggāi xiān qiāo mén.
sentences.translation: Before entering the teacher’s office, you should knock first.

sentences.chinese: 他轻轻地敲了几下桌子，让大家安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 他輕輕地敲了幾下桌子，讓大家安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngqīng de qiāo le jǐ xià zhuōzi, ràng dàjiā ānjìng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: He lightly tapped the table a few times to make everyone quiet down.

sentences.chinese: 外面有人一直在敲窗户，你听见了吗？
sentences.traditional: 外面有人一直在敲窗戶，你聽見了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǒurén yìzhí zài qiāo chuānghu, nǐ tīngjiàn le ma?
sentences.translation: Someone has been knocking on the window outside; did you hear it?

sentences.chinese: 过了这座桥，就能看到火车站了。
sentences.traditional: 過了這座橋，就能看到火車站了。
sentences.pinyin: Guò le zhè zuò qiáo, jiù néng kàndào huǒchēzhàn le.
sentences.translation: After crossing this bridge, you can see the railway station.

sentences.chinese: 因为桥上太堵，我们只好绕远一点。
sentences.traditional: 因為橋上太堵，我們只好繞遠一點。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiáo shàng tài dǔ, wǒmen zhǐhǎo rào yuǎn yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Because the bridge was too congested, we had to take a longer route.

sentences.chinese: 这条河不宽，但是附近没有桥。
sentences.traditional: 這條河不寬，但是附近沒有橋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé bù kuān, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu qiáo.
sentences.translation: The river is not wide, but there is no bridge nearby.

sentences.chinese: 你来得真巧，我们正要出发。
sentences.traditional: 你來得真巧，我們正要出發。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhēn qiǎo, wǒmen zhèng yào chūfā.
sentences.translation: You came at just the right time; we were just about to set off.

sentences.chinese: 这件事太巧了，怎么会发生在同一天？
sentences.traditional: 這件事太巧了，怎麼會發生在同一天？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tài qiǎo le, zěnme huì fāshēng zài tóng yì tiān?
sentences.translation: What a coincidence—how could it happen on the same day?

sentences.chinese: 她手很巧，自己做了一个漂亮的蛋糕。
sentences.traditional: 她手很巧，自己做了一個漂亮的蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu hěn qiǎo, zìjǐ zuò le yí gè piàoliang de dàngāo.
sentences.translation: She is very skillful with her hands and made a lovely cake herself.

sentences.chinese: 我弟弟最喜欢吃黑巧克力。
sentences.traditional: 我弟弟最喜歡吃黑巧克力。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi zuì xǐhuan chī hēi qiǎokèlì.
sentences.translation: My younger brother likes dark chocolate most.

sentences.chinese: 这盒巧克力是朋友从国外带回来的。
sentences.traditional: 這盒巧克力是朋友從國外帶回來的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè hé qiǎokèlì shì péngyou cóng guówài dài huílái de.
sentences.translation: This box of chocolates was brought back from abroad by a friend.

sentences.chinese: 医生说我最近不能吃太多甜的东西，所以我没买巧克力。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說我最近不能吃太多甜的東西，所以我沒買巧克力。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ zuìjìn bù néng chī tài duō tián de dōngxi, suǒyǐ wǒ méi mǎi qiǎokèlì.
sentences.translation: The doctor said I should not eat too many sweet things lately, so I did not buy chocolate.

sentences.chinese: 春节的时候，我们家常常去看亲戚。
sentences.traditional: 春節的時候，我們家常常去看親戚。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié de shíhou, wǒmen jiā chángcháng qù kàn qīnqi.
sentences.translation: During Spring Festival, our family often goes to visit relatives.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然是我的亲戚，但是我们平时联系不多。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然是我的親戚，但是我們平時聯繫不多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán shì wǒ de qīnqi, dànshì wǒmen píngshí liánxì bù duō.
sentences.translation: Although he is my relative, we do not keep in touch much.

sentences.chinese: 家里来了很多亲戚，客厅里一下子热闹起来。
sentences.traditional: 家裡來了很多親戚，客廳裡一下子熱鬧起來。
sentences.pinyin: Jiālǐ lái le hěn duō qīnqi, kètīng lǐ yíxiàzi rènào qǐlái.
sentences.translation: Many relatives came to our home, and the living room suddenly became lively.

sentences.chinese: 她从小就学琴，现在弹得非常好。
sentences.traditional: 她從小就學琴，現在彈得非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù xué qín, xiànzài tán de fēicháng hǎo.
sentences.translation: She has learned an instrument since childhood and now plays very well.

sentences.chinese: 这家店卖各种各样的琴，价格也不一样。
sentences.traditional: 這家店賣各種各樣的琴，價格也不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài gèzhǒnggèyàng de qín, jiàgé yě bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: This shop sells all kinds of instruments, and the prices vary too.

sentences.chinese: 教室里放着一架旧琴，是学校很多年前买的。
sentences.traditional: 教室裡放著一架舊琴，是學校很多年前買的。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ fàng zhe yí jià jiù qín, shì xuéxiào hěn duō nián qián mǎi de.
sentences.translation: There is an old instrument in the classroom, which the school bought many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 这个箱子看起来大，其实一点儿也不轻。
sentences.traditional: 這個箱子看起來大，其實一點兒也不輕。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi kàn qǐlái dà, qíshí yìdiǎnr yě bù qīng.
sentences.translation: This suitcase looks big, but it is not light at all.

sentences.chinese: 这项工作比我想的要轻，不到一个小时就做完了。
sentences.traditional: 這項工作比我想的要輕，不到一個小時就做完了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò bǐ wǒ xiǎng de yào qīng, bú dào yí gè xiǎoshí jiù zuò wán le.
sentences.translation: This task was easier than I expected; I finished it in less than an hour.

sentences.chinese: 她说话的声音很轻，所以后面的人听不清楚。
sentences.traditional: 她說話的聲音很輕，所以後面的人聽不清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de shēngyīn hěn qīng, suǒyǐ hòumiàn de rén tīng bù qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Her voice is very soft, so the people in the back cannot hear clearly.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多青年愿意去外地工作。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多青年願意去外地工作。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō qīngnián yuànyì qù wàidì gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: Many young people nowadays are willing to work in other places.

sentences.chinese: 这位青年虽然年纪不大，却已经很有经验了。
sentences.traditional: 這位青年雖然年紀不大，卻已經很有經驗了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi qīngnián suīrán niánjì bú dà, què yǐjīng hěn yǒu jīngyàn le.
sentences.translation: Although this young man is not old, he already has a lot of experience.

sentences.chinese: 这本杂志主要介绍青年关心的话题。
sentences.traditional: 這本雜誌主要介紹青年關心的話題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì zhǔyào jièshào qīngnián guānxīn de huàtí.
sentences.translation: This magazine mainly covers topics that young people care about.

sentences.chinese: 考试结束以后，大家都觉得轻松多了。
sentences.traditional: 考試結束以後，大家都覺得輕鬆多了。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì jiéshù yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu juéde qīngsōng duō le.
sentences.translation: After the exam ended, everyone felt much more relaxed.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作看上去轻松，其实一点儿也不简单。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作看上去輕鬆，其實一點兒也不簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò kàn shangqu qīngsōng, qíshí yìdiǎnr yě bù jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: This job looks easy, but in fact it is not simple at all.

sentences.chinese: 跟老朋友聊天的时候，我的心情总是很轻松。
sentences.traditional: 跟老朋友聊天的時候，我的心情總是很輕鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Gēn lǎo péngyou liáotiān de shíhou, wǒ de xīnqíng zǒngshì hěn qīngsōng.
sentences.translation: When chatting with old friends, I always feel very relaxed.

sentences.chinese: 你先别着急，把情况慢慢告诉我。
sentences.traditional: 你先別著急，把情況慢慢告訴我。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié zháojí, bǎ qíngkuàng mànmàn gàosu wǒ.
sentences.translation: Do not worry first; tell me the situation slowly.

sentences.chinese: 根据目前的情况，我们可能要改变计划。
sentences.traditional: 根據目前的情況，我們可能要改變計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián de qíngkuàng, wǒmen kěnéng yào gǎibiàn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: According to the current situation, we may need to change the plan.

sentences.chinese: 医生检查以后，说他的情况已经好多了。
sentences.traditional: 醫生檢查以後，說他的情況已經好多了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá yǐhòu, shuō tā de qíngkuàng yǐjīng hǎo duō le.
sentences.translation: After examining him, the doctor said his condition had improved a lot.

sentences.chinese: 为了庆祝比赛胜利，大家晚上一起吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 為了慶祝比賽勝利，大家晚上一起吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile qìngzhù bǐsài shènglì, dàjiā wǎnshang yìqǐ chīfàn.
sentences.translation: To celebrate the victory in the match, everyone had dinner together in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 公司准备举办一个活动，庆祝成立十周年。
sentences.traditional: 公司準備舉辦一個活動，慶祝成立十週年。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhǔnbèi jǔbàn yí gè huódòng, qìngzhù chénglì shí zhōunián.
sentences.translation: The company is preparing to hold an event to celebrate its tenth anniversary.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们高兴地唱歌跳舞，庆祝新年的到来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們高興地唱歌跳舞，慶祝新年的到來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen gāoxìng de chànggē tiàowǔ, qìngzhù xīnnián de dàolái.
sentences.translation: The children happily sang and danced to celebrate the arrival of the New Year.

sentences.chinese: 我们学校的球队今年进了决赛。
sentences.traditional: 我們學校的球隊今年進了決賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de qiúduì jīnnián jìn le juésài.
sentences.translation: Our school team reached the final this year.

sentences.chinese: 这支球队虽然年轻，但是配合得很好。
sentences.traditional: 這支球隊雖然年輕，但是配合得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì suīrán niánqīng, dànshì pèihé de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although this team is young, it works very well together.

sentences.chinese: 他最喜欢的球队上周换了教练。
sentences.traditional: 他最喜歡的球隊上週換了教練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì xǐhuan de qiúduì shàng zhōu huàn le jiàoliàn.
sentences.translation: His favourite team changed coaches last week.

sentences.chinese: 他是个真正的球迷，几乎每场比赛都看。
sentences.traditional: 他是個真正的球迷，幾乎每場比賽都看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì gè zhēnzhèng de qiúmí, jīhū měi chǎng bǐsài dōu kàn.
sentences.translation: He is a real fan and watches almost every match.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结束以后，不少球迷还在门口讨论。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結束以後，不少球迷還在門口討論。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù yǐhòu, bù shǎo qiúmí hái zài ménkǒu tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: After the match ended, quite a few fans were still discussing it at the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 这家店里有很多球迷喜欢买的纪念品。
sentences.traditional: 這家店裡有很多球迷喜歡買的紀念品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō qiúmí xǐhuan mǎi de jìniànpǐn.
sentences.translation: This shop has many souvenirs that sports fans like to buy.

sentences.chinese: 这个区这几年发展得特别快。
sentences.traditional: 這個區這幾年發展得特別快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège qū zhè jǐ nián fāzhǎn de tèbié kuài.
sentences.translation: This district has developed particularly quickly in recent years.

sentences.chinese: 本区的图书馆周末照常开放。
sentences.traditional: 本區的圖書館週末照常開放。
sentences.pinyin: Běn qū de túshūguǎn zhōumò zhàocháng kāifàng.
sentences.translation: The library in this district is open as usual at weekends.

sentences.chinese: 医院在这个区的东边，走路十分钟就到。
sentences.traditional: 醫院在這個區的東邊，走路十分鐘就到。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn zài zhège qū de dōngbiān, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
sentences.translation: The hospital is on the east side of this district; it is only a ten-minute walk away.

sentences.chinese: 这两个颜色看起来差不多，其实有点儿区别。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個顏色看起來差不多，其實有點兒區別。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè yánsè kàn qǐlái chàbuduō, qíshí yǒudiǎnr qūbié.
sentences.translation: These two colours look similar, but there is actually a slight difference.

sentences.chinese: 你能区别这两种茶的味道吗？
sentences.traditional: 你能區別這兩種茶的味道嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng qūbié zhè liǎng zhǒng chá de wèidào ma?
sentences.translation: Can you tell the difference between the flavours of these two teas?

sentences.chinese: 老师说，学外语最重要的是能听出细小的区别。
sentences.traditional: 老師說，學外語最重要的是能聽出細小的區別。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, xué wàiyǔ zuì zhòngyào de shì néng tīng chū xìxiǎo de qūbié.
sentences.translation: The teacher said that the most important thing in learning a foreign language is being able to hear small differences.

sentences.chinese: 你先去银行取钱，我来买车票。
sentences.traditional: 你先去銀行取錢，我來買車票。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù yínháng qǔ qián, wǒ lái mǎi chēpiào.
sentences.translation: You go to the bank to withdraw money first, and I will buy the tickets.

sentences.chinese: 请在前台取房卡，然后上五楼。
sentences.traditional: 請在前臺取房卡，然後上五樓。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài qiántái qǔ fángkǎ, ránhòu shàng wǔ lóu.
sentences.translation: Please collect the room card at reception, then go up to the fifth floor.

sentences.chinese: 这个快递必须本人去取，不能让别人代领。
sentences.traditional: 這個快遞必須本人去取，不能讓別人代領。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège kuàidì bìxū běnrén qù qǔ, bù néng ràng biérén dàilǐng.
sentences.translation: This delivery must be collected in person and cannot be picked up by someone else.

sentences.chinese: 经过大家的努力，我们终于取得了进步。
sentences.traditional: 經過大家的努力，我們終於取得了進步。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò dàjiā de nǔlì, wǒmen zhōngyú qǔdé le jìnbù.
sentences.translation: After everyone's hard work, we finally made progress.

sentences.chinese: 他在比赛中取得了第一名。
sentences.traditional: 他在比賽中取得了第一名。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng qǔdé le dì yī míng.
sentences.translation: He won first place in the competition.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究已经取得了重要结果。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究已經取得了重要結果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū yǐjīng qǔdé le zhòngyào jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: This research has already produced important results.

sentences.chinese: 因为天气太差，明天的活动取消了。
sentences.traditional: 因為天氣太差，明天的活動取消了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài chà, míngtiān de huódòng qǔxiāo le.
sentences.translation: Because the weather is too bad, tomorrow's event has been cancelled.

sentences.chinese: 如果你不想去了，现在还来得及取消预约。
sentences.traditional: 如果你不想去了，現在還來得及取消預約。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng qù le, xiànzài hái láidejí qǔxiāo yùyuē.
sentences.translation: If you do not want to go, there is still time to cancel the booking.

sentences.chinese: 航空公司通知我们，航班没有取消，只是晚点。
sentences.traditional: 航空公司通知我們，航班沒有取消，只是晚點。
sentences.pinyin: Hángkōng gōngsī tōngzhī wǒmen, hángbān méiyǒu qǔxiāo, zhǐshì wǎndiǎn.
sentences.translation: The airline informed us that the flight was not cancelled, only delayed.

sentences.chinese: 这本书我已经看全了，你可以拿去。
sentences.traditional: 這本書我已經看全了，你可以拿去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ yǐjīng kàn quán le, nǐ kěyǐ ná qù.
sentences.translation: I have already read the whole book, so you can take it.

sentences.chinese: 会议的内容我全听懂了。
sentences.traditional: 會議的內容我全聽懂了。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì de nèiróng wǒ quán tīng dǒng le.
sentences.translation: I understood all of the meeting content.

sentences.chinese: 他的衣服都湿了，连鞋子也全是泥。
sentences.traditional: 他的衣服都濕了，連鞋子也全是泥。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yīfu dōu shī le, lián xiézi yě quán shì ní.
sentences.translation: His clothes were all wet, and even his shoes were covered in mud.

sentences.chinese: 这些资料我全部都看过了。
sentences.traditional: 這些資料我全部都看過了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīliào wǒ quánbù dōu kàn guo le.
sentences.translation: I have already looked through all these materials.

sentences.chinese: 他把全部的钱都用来交学费了。
sentences.traditional: 他把全部的錢都用來交學費了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ quánbù de qián dōu yòng lái jiāo xuéfèi le.
sentences.translation: He used all his money to pay the school fees.

sentences.chinese: 全部的票已经卖完了，你只能等下一场。
sentences.traditional: 全部的票已經賣完了，你只能等下一場。
sentences.pinyin: Quánbù de piào yǐjīng mài wán le, nǐ zhǐ néng děng xià yì chǎng.
sentences.translation: All the tickets have already sold out, so you can only wait for the next showing.

sentences.chinese: 菜一上桌，孩子们全都笑了起来。
sentences.traditional: 菜一上桌，孩子們全都笑了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Cài yí shàng zhuō, háizimen quándōu xiào le qǐlái.
sentences.translation: As soon as the dishes were put on the table, the children all started smiling.

sentences.chinese: 这些问题我全都记下来了。
sentences.traditional: 這些問題我全都記下來了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí wǒ quándōu jì xiàlái le.
sentences.translation: I wrote all of these questions down.

sentences.chinese: 下课以后，学生们全都跑到操场上去了。
sentences.traditional: 下課以後，學生們全都跑到操場上去了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, xuéshengmen quándōu pǎo dào cāochǎng shàng qù le.
sentences.translation: After class, the students all ran to the playground.

sentences.chinese: 全球很多国家都在关注气候变化。
sentences.traditional: 全球很多國家都在關注氣候變化。
sentences.pinyin: Quánqiú hěn duō guójiā dōu zài guānzhù qìhòu biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Many countries around the world are paying attention to climate change.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司希望把产品卖到全球。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司希望把產品賣到全球。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī xīwàng bǎ chǎnpǐn mài dào quánqiú.
sentences.translation: This company hopes to sell its products worldwide.

sentences.chinese: 互联网让全球的人联系得更方便了。
sentences.traditional: 互聯網讓全球的人聯繫得更方便了。
sentences.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng ràng quánqiú de rén liánxì de gèng fāngbiàn le.
sentences.translation: The internet has made it easier for people around the world to stay in touch.

sentences.chinese: 他淋了雨以后，全身都湿了。
sentences.traditional: 他淋了雨以後，全身都濕了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lín le yǔ yǐhòu, quánshēn dōu shī le.
sentences.translation: After getting caught in the rain, his whole body was wet.

sentences.chinese: 跑完五公里以后，我全身都是汗。
sentences.traditional: 跑完五公里以後，我全身都是汗。
sentences.pinyin: Pǎo wán wǔ gōnglǐ yǐhòu, wǒ quánshēn dōu shì hàn.
sentences.translation: After running five kilometres, my whole body was covered in sweat.

sentences.chinese: 天气太冷了，我一出门就觉得全身发冷。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太冷了，我一出門就覺得全身發冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài lěng le, wǒ yì chūmén jiù juéde quánshēn fā lěng.
sentences.translation: The weather was so cold that as soon as I went outside, I felt my whole body turn cold.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划很好，只是还缺一点儿时间。
sentences.traditional: 這個計畫很好，只是還缺一點兒時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà hěn hǎo, zhǐshì hái quē yìdiǎnr shíjiān.
sentences.translation: This plan is very good; it just still needs a bit more time.

sentences.chinese: 你还缺什么材料？我可以帮你准备。
sentences.traditional: 你還缺什麼材料？我可以幫你準備。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ hái quē shénme cáiliào? Wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: What materials are you still missing? I can help you prepare them.

sentences.chinese: 这双鞋只缺一个鞋带。
sentences.traditional: 這雙鞋只缺一個鞋帶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié zhǐ quē yí ge xiédài.
sentences.translation: This pair of shoes is only missing one shoelace.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都有优点，也有缺点。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都有優點，也有缺點。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu yōudiǎn, yě yǒu quēdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Everyone has strengths as well as shortcomings.

sentences.chinese: 这台电脑的缺点是电池不太耐用。
sentences.traditional: 這臺電腦的缺點是電池不太耐用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo de quēdiǎn shì diànchí bú tài nàiyòng.
sentences.translation: The weakness of this computer is that its battery is not very durable.

sentences.chinese: 如果你知道自己的缺点，就更容易进步。
sentences.traditional: 如果你知道自己的缺點，就更容易進步。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de quēdiǎn, jiù gèng róngyì jìnbù.
sentences.translation: If you know your own shortcomings, it is easier to improve.

sentences.chinese: 孩子在成长过程中不能缺少父母的关心。
sentences.traditional: 孩子在成長過程中不能缺少父母的關心。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zài chéngzhǎng guòchéng zhōng bù néng quēshǎo fùmǔ de guānxīn.
sentences.translation: Children cannot grow up without the care of their parents.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章内容不错，但是缺少具体的例子。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章內容不錯，但是缺少具體的例子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng nèiróng búcuò, dànshì quēshǎo jùtǐ de lìzi.
sentences.translation: This article has good content, but it lacks specific examples.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区长期缺少干净的饮用水。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區長期缺少乾淨的飲用水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū chángqī quēshǎo gānjìng de yǐnyòngshuǐ.
sentences.translation: This area has long lacked clean drinking water.

sentences.chinese: 我本来想早点睡，却一直睡不着。
sentences.traditional: 我本來想早點睡，卻一直睡不著。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng zǎodiǎn shuì, què yìzhí shuì bù zháo.
sentences.translation: I had wanted to go to bed early, but I could not fall asleep.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很年轻，却已经有很多工作经验了。
sentences.traditional: 他看起來很年輕，卻已經有很多工作經驗了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn niánqīng, què yǐjīng yǒu hěn duō gōngzuò jīngyàn le.
sentences.translation: He looks very young, yet he already has a lot of work experience.

sentences.chinese: 这道题不难，我却想了很久才做出来。
sentences.traditional: 這道題不難，我卻想了很久才做出來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí bù nán, wǒ què xiǎng le hěn jiǔ cái zuò chūlái.
sentences.translation: This question was not hard, but I still thought about it for a long time before solving it.

sentences.chinese: 你说得对，这个办法确实更简单。
sentences.traditional: 你說得對，這個辦法確實更簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì, zhège bànfǎ quèshí gèng jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: You are right; this method really is simpler.

sentences.chinese: 最近天气确实比上个月暖和多了。
sentences.traditional: 最近天氣確實比上個月暖和多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì quèshí bǐ shàng ge yuè nuǎnhuo duō le.
sentences.translation: The weather really is much warmer recently than it was last month.

sentences.chinese: 他学习很认真，成绩确实提高了不少。
sentences.traditional: 他學習很認真，成績確實提高了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuéxí hěn rènzhēn, chéngjì quèshí tígāo le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: He studies very seriously, and his grades really have improved quite a lot.

sentences.chinese: 他已经准备了很久，然而还是有点儿紧张。
sentences.traditional: 他已經準備了很久，然而還是有點兒緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ, rán'ér háishì yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: He had prepared for a long time; however, he was still a little nervous.

sentences.chinese: 这条路看起来近，然而走起来并不快。
sentences.traditional: 這條路看起來近，然而走起來並不快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù kàn qǐlái jìn, rán'ér zǒu qǐlái bìng bú kuài.
sentences.translation: This road looks short; however, it is not quick to walk.

sentences.chinese: 很多人都觉得这份工作轻松，然而真正做起来并不简单。
sentences.traditional: 很多人都覺得這份工作輕鬆，然而真正做起來並不簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu juéde zhè fèn gōngzuò qīngsōng, rán'ér zhēnzhèng zuò qǐlái bìng bù jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: Many people think this job is easy; however, it is not simple when you actually do it.

sentences.chinese: 周末的夜市总是很热闹。
sentences.traditional: 週末的夜市總是很熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò de yèshì zǒng shì hěn rènao.
sentences.translation: The night market is always lively at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 春节的时候，家里比平时热闹多了。
sentences.traditional: 春節的時候，家裡比平時熱鬧多了。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié de shíhou, jiālǐ bǐ píngshí rènao duō le.
sentences.translation: During Spring Festival, the house is much livelier than usual.

sentences.chinese: 楼下太热闹了，我没办法安心看书。
sentences.traditional: 樓下太熱鬧了，我沒辦法安心看書。
sentences.pinyin: Lóuxià tài rènao le, wǒ méi bànfǎ ānxīn kàn shū.
sentences.translation: It is too noisy and lively downstairs, so I cannot read in peace.

sentences.chinese: 人生不可能一直顺利，遇到困难也很正常。
sentences.traditional: 人生不可能一直順利，遇到困難也很正常。
sentences.pinyin: Rénshēng bù kěnéng yìzhí shùnlì, yùdào kùnnan yě hěn zhèngcháng.
sentences.translation: Life cannot always go smoothly; meeting difficulties is normal too.

sentences.chinese: 这本书让我重新想了想自己的人生目标。
sentences.traditional: 這本書讓我重新想了想自己的人生目標。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū ràng wǒ chóngxīn xiǎng le xiǎng zìjǐ de rénshēng mùbiāo.
sentences.translation: This book made me think again about my own life goals.

sentences.chinese: 旅行以后，他对人生有了新的看法。
sentences.traditional: 旅行以後，他對人生有了新的看法。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng yǐhòu, tā duì rénshēng yǒu le xīn de kànfǎ.
sentences.translation: After travelling, he developed a new view of life.

sentences.chinese: 今天来参加活动的人数比昨天多。
sentences.traditional: 今天來參加活動的人數比昨天多。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān lái cānjiā huódòng de rénshù bǐ zuótiān duō.
sentences.translation: The number of people attending the activity today is greater than yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 我们得先确定人数，再订餐厅。
sentences.traditional: 我們得先確定人數，再訂餐廳。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen děi xiān quèdìng rénshù, zài dìng cāntīng.
sentences.translation: We need to confirm the number of people first, then book the restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 如果人数太少，这个班可能不开了。
