sentences.traditional: 如果人數太少，這個班可能不開了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ rénshù tài shǎo, zhège bān kěnéng bú kāi le.
sentences.translation: If the number of people is too small, this class may not open.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在增加技术人员。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在增加技術人員。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài zēngjiā jìshù rényuán.
sentences.translation: The company is increasing its technical staff.

sentences.chinese: 现场工作人员已经准备好了。
sentences.traditional: 現場工作人員已經準備好了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànchǎng gōngzuò rényuán yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
sentences.translation: The staff on site are already prepared.

sentences.chinese: 医护人员马上把他送到了医院。
sentences.traditional: 醫護人員馬上把他送到了醫院。
sentences.pinyin: Yīhù rényuán mǎshàng bǎ tā sòng dào le yīyuàn.
sentences.translation: The medical staff immediately took him to the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 这件事不能告诉任何人。
sentences.traditional: 這件事不能告訴任何人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bùnéng gàosu rènhé rén.
sentences.translation: This matter cannot be told to anyone.

sentences.chinese: 如果有任何问题，请马上联系我。
sentences.traditional: 如果有任何問題，請馬上聯繫我。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, qǐng mǎshàng liánxì wǒ.
sentences.translation: If there are any problems, please contact me immediately.

sentences.chinese: 做决定以前，你得考虑任何可能的结果。
sentences.traditional: 做決定以前，你得考慮任何可能的結果。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò juédìng yǐqián, nǐ děi kǎolǜ rènhé kěnéng de jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, you must consider any possible outcome.

sentences.chinese: 今天的任务比昨天轻松一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 今天的任務比昨天輕鬆一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de rènwu bǐ zuótiān qīngsōng yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: Today's task is a bit easier than yesterday's.

sentences.chinese: 这个任务需要两个人一起完成。
sentences.traditional: 這個任務需要兩個人一起完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège rènwu xūyào liǎng gè rén yìqǐ wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This task needs two people to complete together.

sentences.chinese: 老板把最难的任务交给了他。
sentences.traditional: 老闆把最難的任務交給了他。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bǎ zuì nán de rènwu jiāo gěi le tā.
sentences.translation: The boss gave the hardest task to him.

sentences.chinese: 别把垃圾扔在地上。
sentences.traditional: 別把垃圾扔在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ lājī rēng zài dìshang.
sentences.translation: Do not throw rubbish on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他生气地把旧照片扔进了垃圾桶。
sentences.traditional: 他生氣地把舊照片扔進了垃圾桶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēngqì de bǎ jiù zhàopiàn rēng jìn le lājītǒng.
sentences.translation: He angrily threw the old photos into the bin.

sentences.chinese: 用过的纸不要乱扔。
sentences.traditional: 用過的紙不要亂扔。
sentences.pinyin: Yòng guò de zhǐ búyào luàn rēng.
sentences.translation: Do not throw used paper around carelessly.

sentences.chinese: 虽然已经很晚了，他仍在办公室里工作。
sentences.traditional: 雖然已經很晚了，他仍在辦公室裡工作。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, tā réng zài bàngōngshì lǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: Although it was already very late, he was still working in the office.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题很复杂，我们仍需要时间考虑。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題很複雜，我們仍需要時間考慮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn fùzá, wǒmen réng xūyào shíjiān kǎolǜ.
sentences.translation: This problem is very complicated; we still need time to think.

sentences.chinese: 他知道结果以后，脸上仍没有笑容。
sentences.traditional: 他知道結果以後，臉上仍沒有笑容。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào jiéguǒ yǐhòu, liǎn shàng réng méiyǒu xiàoróng.
sentences.translation: After he learned the result, there was still no smile on his face.

sentences.chinese: 事情过去这么久了，他仍然记得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 事情過去這麼久了，他仍然記得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Shìqing guòqù zhème jiǔ le, tā réngrán jìde hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: So much time has passed, and he still remembers it clearly.

sentences.chinese: 虽然条件不太好，他们仍然决定继续。
sentences.traditional: 雖然條件不太好，他們仍然決定繼續。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tiáojiàn bú tài hǎo, tāmen réngrán juédìng jìxù.
sentences.translation: Although the conditions were not very good, they still decided to continue.

sentences.chinese: 我提醒过他很多次，他仍然忘了带护照。
sentences.traditional: 我提醒過他很多次，他仍然忘了帶護照。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tíxǐng guò tā hěn duō cì, tā réngrán wàng le dài hùzhào.
sentences.translation: I reminded him many times, but he still forgot to bring his passport.

sentences.chinese: 这是我日常生活的一部分。
sentences.traditional: 這是我日常生活的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ rìcháng shēnghuó de yí bùfen.
sentences.translation: This is part of my daily life.

sentences.chinese: 这家店卖的都是日常用品。
sentences.traditional: 這家店賣的都是日常用品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài de dōu shì rìcháng yòngpǐn.
sentences.translation: This shop sells everyday items.

sentences.chinese: 老师希望我们多练习日常口语。
sentences.traditional: 老師希望我們多練習日常口語。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xīwàng wǒmen duō liànxí rìcháng kǒuyǔ.
sentences.translation: The teacher hopes we will practise everyday spoken language more.

sentences.chinese: 她从中学开始写日记。
sentences.traditional: 她從中學開始寫日記。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng zhōngxué kāishǐ xiě rìjì.
sentences.translation: She started writing a diary in secondary school.

sentences.chinese: 我把旅行中的感受都写进了日记里。
sentences.traditional: 我把旅行中的感受都寫進了日記裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ lǚxíng zhōng de gǎnshòu dōu xiě jìn le rìjì lǐ.
sentences.translation: I wrote all my feelings from the trip into my diary.

sentences.chinese: 这本日记记录了他那几年的经历。
sentences.traditional: 這本日記記錄了他那幾年的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn rìjì jìlù le tā nà jǐ nián de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: This diary recorded his experiences from those years.

sentences.chinese: 请你再确认一下会议的日期。
sentences.traditional: 請你再確認一下會議的日期。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài quèrèn yíxià huìyì de rìqī.
sentences.translation: Please confirm the date of the meeting again.

sentences.chinese: 这张票上已经写清楚了演出的日期。
sentences.traditional: 這張票上已經寫清楚了演出的日期。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào shàng yǐjīng xiě qīngchu le yǎnchū de rìqī.
sentences.translation: The date of the performance is already clearly written on this ticket.

sentences.chinese: 如果日期不合适，我们可以改时间。
sentences.traditional: 如果日期不合適，我們可以改時間。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ rìqī bù héshì, wǒmen kěyǐ gǎi shíjiān.
sentences.translation: If the date is not suitable, we can change the time.

sentences.chinese: 这些年他们的日子过得越来越好了。
sentences.traditional: 這些年他們的日子過得越來越好了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē nián tāmen de rìzi guò de yuèláiyuè hǎo le.
sentences.translation: Their life has been getting better and better these years.

sentences.chinese: 一个人在外地工作，日子并不轻松。
sentences.traditional: 一個人在外地工作，日子並不輕鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè rén zài wàidì gōngzuò, rìzi bìng bù qīngsōng.
sentences.translation: Life is not easy when working alone away from home.

sentences.chinese: 快考试了，这几天日子过得特别紧张。
sentences.traditional: 快考試了，這幾天日子過得特別緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè jǐ tiān rìzi guò de tèbié jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: With exams coming, these days feel especially tense.

sentences.chinese: 门一开，大家就都入了会场。
sentences.traditional: 門一開，大家就都入了會場。
sentences.pinyin: Mén yì kāi, dàjiā jiù dōu rù le huìchǎng.
sentences.translation: As soon as the door opened, everyone entered the venue.

sentences.chinese: 他刚入公司时，什么都不懂。
sentences.traditional: 他剛入公司時，什麼都不懂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng rù gōngsī shí, shénme dōu bù dǒng.
sentences.translation: When he had just entered the company, he understood nothing.

sentences.chinese: 一入夜，外面就安静多了。
sentences.traditional: 一入夜，外面就安靜多了。
sentences.pinyin: Yí rù yè, wàimiàn jiù ānjìng duō le.
sentences.translation: Once night falls, it becomes much quieter outside.

sentences.chinese: 请从前面的入口进入景区。
sentences.traditional: 請從前面的入口進入景區。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng cóng qiánmiàn de rùkǒu jìnrù jǐngqū.
sentences.translation: Please enter the scenic area through the entrance ahead.

sentences.chinese: 地铁站的入口就在商场旁边。
sentences.traditional: 地鐵站的入口就在商場旁邊。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtiězhàn de rùkǒu jiù zài shāngchǎng pángbiān.
sentences.translation: The entrance to the underground station is right beside the shopping centre.

sentences.chinese: 医院入口不能停车。
sentences.traditional: 醫院入口不能停車。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn rùkǒu bù néng tíngchē.
sentences.translation: Parking is not allowed at the hospital entrance.

sentences.chinese: 他儿子今年九月正式入学。
sentences.traditional: 他兒子今年九月正式入學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā érzi jīnnián jiǔ yuè zhèngshì rùxué.
sentences.translation: His son will officially start school this September.

sentences.chinese: 入学以前，学校会安排一次体检。
sentences.traditional: 入學以前，學校會安排一次體檢。
sentences.pinyin: Rùxué yǐqián, xuéxiào huì ānpái yí cì tǐjiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before enrolment, the school will arrange a medical check.

sentences.chinese: 对很多留学生来说，入学后的生活并不容易。
sentences.traditional: 對很多留學生來說，入學後的生活並不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō liúxuéshēng lái shuō, rùxué hòu de shēnghuó bìng bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: For many international students, life after enrolment is not easy.

sentences.chinese: 我们下午三点以后才能入住。
sentences.traditional: 我們下午三點以後才能入住。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǐhòu cái néng rùzhù.
sentences.translation: We can only check in after three in the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 客人已经全部入住酒店了。
sentences.traditional: 客人已經全部入住酒店了。
sentences.pinyin: Kèrén yǐjīng quánbù rùzhù jiǔdiàn le.
sentences.translation: The guests have all checked into the hotel.

sentences.chinese: 新房装修好以后，他们下个月就入住。
sentences.traditional: 新房裝修好以後，他們下個月就入住。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnfáng zhuāngxiū hǎo yǐhòu, tāmen xià gè yuè jiù rùzhù.
sentences.translation: After the new house is renovated, they will move in next month.

sentences.chinese: 晚饭后出去散步，对身体很好。
sentences.traditional: 晚飯後出去散步，對身體很好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnfàn hòu chūqù sànbù, duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Going for a walk after dinner is good for the body.

sentences.chinese: 我心情不好的时候，喜欢一个人散步。
sentences.traditional: 我心情不好的時候，喜歡一個人散步。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, xǐhuan yí gè rén sànbù.
sentences.translation: When I am in a bad mood, I like to walk alone.

sentences.chinese: 河边很安静，特别适合散步。
sentences.traditional: 河邊很安靜，特別適合散步。
sentences.pinyin: Hébiān hěn ānjìng, tèbié shìhé sànbù.
sentences.translation: The riverside is very quiet and especially suitable for a walk.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多餐厅都要先扫码点菜。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多餐廳都要先掃碼點菜。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō cāntīng dōu yào xiān sǎomǎ diǎncài.
sentences.translation: Nowadays many restaurants require you to scan a code before ordering.

sentences.chinese: 进门以前，请先扫码登记。
sentences.traditional: 進門以前，請先掃碼登記。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnmén yǐqián, qǐng xiān sǎomǎ dēngjì.
sentences.translation: Please scan the code to register before entering.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出手机扫码以后，马上看到了结果。
sentences.traditional: 他拿出手機掃碼以後，馬上看到了結果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū shǒujī sǎomǎ yǐhòu, mǎshàng kàn dào le jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: After he took out his phone and scanned the code, he immediately saw the result.

sentences.chinese: 这片森林里有很多种动物。
sentences.traditional: 這片森林裡有很多種動物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn sēnlín lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù.
sentences.translation: There are many kinds of animals in this forest.

sentences.chinese: 走进森林以后，空气明显更好了。
sentences.traditional: 走進森林以後，空氣明顯更好了。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu jìn sēnlín yǐhòu, kōngqì míngxiǎn gèng hǎo le.
sentences.translation: After walking into the forest, the air became obviously better.

sentences.chinese: 大火以后，这里的森林需要很长时间才能恢复。
sentences.traditional: 大火以後，這裡的森林需要很長時間才能恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Dàhuǒ yǐhòu, zhèlǐ de sēnlín xūyào hěn cháng shíjiān cái néng huīfù.
sentences.translation: After the fire, the forest here will need a long time to recover.

sentences.chinese: 这件事太重要了，我们得先商量一下。
sentences.traditional: 這件事太重要了，我們得先商量一下。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tài zhòngyào le, wǒmen děi xiān shāngliang yíxià.
sentences.translation: This matter is too important; we must discuss it first.

sentences.chinese: 他们商量了半天，还是没有决定。
sentences.traditional: 他們商量了半天，還是沒有決定。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shāngliang le bàntiān, háishi méiyǒu juédìng.
sentences.translation: They discussed it for ages but still did not make a decision.

sentences.chinese: 你最好先和家里人商量，再告诉我吧。
sentences.traditional: 你最好先和家裡人商量，再告訴我吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo xiān hé jiālǐ rén shāngliang, zài gàosu wǒ ba.
sentences.translation: You had better discuss it with your family first and then tell me.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的商品种类很丰富。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的商品種類很豐富。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de shāngpǐn zhǒnglèi hěn fēngfù.
sentences.translation: This shop has a rich variety of products.

sentences.chinese: 有些进口商品最近又涨价了。
sentences.traditional: 有些進口商品最近又漲價了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē jìnkǒu shāngpǐn zuìjìn yòu zhǎngjià le.
sentences.translation: Some imported products have gone up in price again recently.

sentences.chinese: 购买商品以前，最好先看看评价。
sentences.traditional: 購買商品以前，最好先看看評價。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi shāngpǐn yǐqián, zuìhǎo xiān kànkan píngjià.
sentences.translation: Before buying a product, it is best to read the reviews first.

sentences.chinese: 听到那个消息以后，她伤心得说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: 聽到那個消息以後，她傷心得說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào nàge xiāoxi yǐhòu, tā shāngxīn de shuō bu chū huà lái.
sentences.translation: After hearing that news, she was so heartbroken that she could not speak.

sentences.chinese: 比赛输了以后，他看起来很伤心。
sentences.traditional: 比賽輸了以後，他看起來很傷心。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā kàn qǐlái hěn shāngxīn.
sentences.translation: After losing the match, he looked very sad.

sentences.chinese: 你别太伤心了，事情总会慢慢过去的。
sentences.traditional: 你別太傷心了，事情總會慢慢過去的。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié tài shāngxīn le, shìqing zǒng huì mànmàn guòqù de.
sentences.translation: Do not be too heartbroken; things will slowly pass.

sentences.chinese: 昨天有客人上门拜访，我们忙了一整天。
sentences.traditional: 昨天有客人上門拜訪，我們忙了一整天。
sentences.pinyin: Zuótiān yǒu kèrén shàngmén bàifǎng, wǒmen máng le yì zhěng tiān.
sentences.translation: Yesterday guests came to visit us at home, and we were busy all day.

sentences.chinese: 要是你不方便出门，我可以上门帮你修电脑。
sentences.traditional: 要是你不方便出門，我可以上門幫你修電腦。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ bù fāngbiàn chūmén, wǒ kěyǐ shàngmén bāng nǐ xiū diànnǎo.
sentences.translation: If it is inconvenient for you to go out, I can come to your home to fix your computer.

sentences.chinese: 这家店提供上门服务，所以很受欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這家店提供上門服務，所以很受歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn tígōng shàngmén fúwù, suǒyǐ hěn shòu huānyíng.
sentences.translation: This shop offers door-to-door service, so it is very popular.

sentences.chinese: 请你稍等一下，我马上回来。
sentences.traditional: 請你稍等一下，我馬上回來。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shāo děng yíxià, wǒ mǎshàng huílái.
sentences.translation: Please wait a moment; I will be back at once.

sentences.chinese: 这件事以后再谈，时间稍晚一点也没关系。
sentences.traditional: 這件事以後再談，時間稍晚一點也沒關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǐhòu zài tán, shíjiān shāo wǎn yìdiǎn yě méi guānxi.
sentences.translation: We can discuss this later; it does not matter if the time is a little later.

sentences.chinese: 病人现在情况稍有好转了。
sentences.traditional: 病人現在情況稍有好轉了。
sentences.pinyin: Bìngrén xiànzài qíngkuàng shāo yǒu hǎozhuǎn le.
sentences.translation: The patient's condition has improved slightly now.

sentences.chinese: 这道题有点难，你可以稍微想一想再回答。
sentences.traditional: 這道題有點難，你可以稍微想一想再回答。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí yǒudiǎn nán, nǐ kěyǐ shāowēi xiǎng yì xiǎng zài huídá.
sentences.translation: This question is a bit difficult; you can think about it a little before answering.

sentences.chinese: 今天风大，你最好把窗户稍微关一点。
sentences.traditional: 今天風大，你最好把窗戶稍微關一點。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān fēng dà, nǐ zuìhǎo bǎ chuānghu shāowēi guān yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: It is windy today; you had better close the window a little.

sentences.chinese: 他休息了以后，脸色稍微好了一些。
sentences.traditional: 他休息了以後，臉色稍微好了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiūxi le yǐhòu, liǎnsè shāowēi hǎo le yìxiē.
sentences.translation: After resting, his complexion became a little better.

sentences.chinese: 这样的天气在这个季节很少见。
sentences.traditional: 這樣的天氣在這個季節很少見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèyàng de tiānqì zài zhège jìjié hěn shǎojiàn.
sentences.translation: Weather like this is rare in this season.

sentences.chinese: 他这么安静，今天真是少见。
sentences.traditional: 他這麼安靜，今天真是少見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhème ānjìng, jīntiān zhēn shì shǎojiàn.
sentences.translation: He is so quiet today; that is really unusual.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆里展出的那件东西非常少见。
sentences.traditional: 博物館裡展出的那件東西非常少見。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ zhǎnchū de nà jiàn dōngxi fēicháng shǎojiàn.
sentences.translation: That item on display in the museum is extremely rare.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他每天只喝少量咖啡。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他每天只喝少量咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān zhǐ hē shǎoliàng kāfēi.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to drink only a small amount of coffee each day.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜里放少量盐就够了。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜裡放少量鹽就夠了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài lǐ fàng shǎoliàng yán jiù gòu le.
sentences.translation: Putting a small amount of salt in this dish is enough.

sentences.chinese: 少量运动对身体也有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 少量運動對身體也有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Shǎoliàng yùndòng duì shēntǐ yě yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: A small amount of exercise is also helpful for the body.

sentences.chinese: 只有少数人提前知道这个消息。
sentences.traditional: 只有少數人提前知道這個消息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu shǎoshù rén tíqián zhīdào zhège xiāoxi.
sentences.translation: Only a small number of people knew this news in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定得到了大多数人的支持，只有少数人反对。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定得到了大多數人的支持，只有少數人反對。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng dédào le dàduōshù rén de zhīchí, zhǐyǒu shǎoshù rén fǎnduì.
sentences.translation: This decision won the support of the majority; only a few people opposed it.

sentences.chinese: 在班里，少数学生还没有交作业。
sentences.traditional: 在班裡，少數學生還沒有交作業。
sentences.pinyin: Zài bān lǐ, shǎoshù xuéshēng hái méiyǒu jiāo zuòyè.
sentences.translation: In the class, a small number of students still have not handed in their homework.

sentences.chinese: 那个少年从小就喜欢踢足球。
sentences.traditional: 那個少年從小就喜歡踢足球。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shàonián cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuan tī zúqiú.
sentences.translation: That teenager has liked playing football since childhood.

sentences.chinese: 这本书讲的是一位少年的成长故事。
sentences.traditional: 這本書講的是一位少年的成長故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎng de shì yí wèi shàonián de chéngzhǎng gùshi.
sentences.translation: This book tells the coming-of-age story of a young person.

sentences.chinese: 少年时期养成的习惯常常会影响一生。
sentences.traditional: 少年時期養成的習慣常常會影響一生。
sentences.pinyin: Shàonián shíqī yǎngchéng de xíguàn chángcháng huì yǐngxiǎng yìshēng.
sentences.translation: Habits formed in youth often affect a whole life.

sentences.chinese: 网络的发展已经改变了我们的社会生活。
sentences.traditional: 網絡的發展已經改變了我們的社會生活。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò de fāzhǎn yǐjīng gǎibiàn le wǒmen de shèhuì shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: The development of the internet has already changed our social life.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人对社会问题越来越关心了。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人對社會問題越來越關心了。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīngrén duì shèhuì wèntí yuèláiyuè guānxīn le.
sentences.translation: Young people are becoming more and more concerned about social issues.

sentences.chinese: 大学毕业以后，他很快进入了社会。
sentences.traditional: 大學畢業以後，他很快進入了社會。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, tā hěn kuài jìnrù le shèhuì.
sentences.translation: After graduating from university, he quickly entered society.

sentences.chinese: 今天最高气温有三十五摄氏度。
sentences.traditional: 今天最高氣溫有三十五攝氏度。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān zuìgāo qìwēn yǒu sānshíwǔ shèshìdù.
sentences.translation: Today's highest temperature is thirty-five degrees Celsius.

sentences.chinese: 零下十摄氏度的时候，路上很容易结冰。
sentences.traditional: 零下十攝氏度的時候，路上很容易結冰。
sentences.pinyin: Língxià shí shèshìdù de shíhou, lù shàng hěn róngyì jié bīng.
sentences.translation: When it is ten degrees Celsius below zero, the roads freeze easily.

sentences.chinese: 水在一百摄氏度时会开始变成水蒸气。
sentences.traditional: 水在一百攝氏度時會開始變成水蒸氣。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ zài yìbǎi shèshìdù shí huì kāishǐ biàn chéng shuǐzhēngqì.
sentences.translation: At one hundred degrees Celsius, water starts to turn into steam.

sentences.chinese: 他转过身看我。
sentences.traditional: 他轉過身看我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhuǎn guò shēn kàn wǒ.
sentences.translation: He turned round and looked at me.

sentences.chinese: 我今天穿了一身新衣服。
sentences.traditional: 我今天穿了一身新衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān chuān le yì shēn xīn yīfu.
sentences.translation: I wore a full set of new clothes today.

sentences.chinese: 他站起身向大家问好。
sentences.traditional: 他站起身向大家問好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn qǐ shēn xiàng dàjiā wènhǎo.
sentences.translation: He stood up and greeted everyone.

sentences.chinese: 这条河很深。
sentences.traditional: 這條河很深。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé hěn shēn.
sentences.translation: This river is very deep.

sentences.chinese: 他对这个问题有很深的理解。
sentences.traditional: 他對這個問題有很深的理解。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhège wèntí yǒu hěn shēn de lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: He has a deep understanding of this problem.

sentences.chinese: 夜已经很深了，我们该回家了。
sentences.traditional: 夜已經很深了，我們該回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Yè yǐjīng hěn shēn le, wǒmen gāi huí jiā le.
sentences.translation: It is already late at night; we should go home.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出身份证给警察看。
sentences.traditional: 他拿出身份證給警察看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā náchū shēnfènzhèng gěi jǐngchá kàn.
sentences.translation: He took out his ID card to show the police.

sentences.chinese: 我把身份证忘在家里了。
sentences.traditional: 我把身份證忘在家裡了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shēnfènzhèng wàng zài jiālǐ le.
sentences.translation: I left my ID card at home.

sentences.chinese: 报名时需要身份证。
sentences.traditional: 報名時需要身份證。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng shí xūyào shēnfènzhèng.
sentences.translation: An ID card is needed when signing up.

sentences.chinese: 我想申请这份工作。
sentences.traditional: 我想申請這份工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shēnqǐng zhè fèn gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: I want to apply for this job.

sentences.chinese: 他正在申请新的护照。
sentences.traditional: 他正在申請新的護照。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài shēnqǐng xīn de hùzhào.
sentences.translation: He is applying for a new passport.

sentences.chinese: 申请大学需要准备很多东西。
sentences.traditional: 申請大學需要準備很多東西。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng dàxué xūyào zhǔnbèi hěn duō dōngxi.
sentences.translation: Applying to university requires preparing many things.

sentences.chinese: 他忙得甚至没有时间吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 他忙得甚至沒有時間吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā máng de shènzhì méiyǒu shíjiān chīfàn.
sentences.translation: He is so busy that he does not even have time to eat.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方很安静，甚至能听见鸟叫。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方很安靜，甚至能聽見鳥叫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang hěn ānjìng, shènzhì néng tīngjiàn niǎo jiào.
sentences.translation: This place is so quiet that you can even hear birds singing.

sentences.chinese: 她甚至没告诉我原因。
sentences.traditional: 她甚至沒告訴我原因。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shènzhì méi gàosu wǒ yuányīn.
sentences.translation: She did not even tell me the reason.

sentences.chinese: 她去年生了一个女儿。
sentences.traditional: 她去年生了一個女兒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qùnián shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér.
sentences.translation: She gave birth to a daughter last year.

sentences.chinese: 这棵树春天会生新叶。
sentences.traditional: 這棵樹春天會生新葉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kē shù chūntiān huì shēng xīn yè.
sentences.translation: This tree will grow new leaves in spring.

sentences.chinese: 鸡每天都会生蛋。
sentences.traditional: 雞每天都會生蛋。
sentences.pinyin: Jī měitiān dōu huì shēng dàn.
sentences.translation: Hens lay eggs every day.

sentences.chinese: 这块肉还是生的。
sentences.traditional: 這塊肉還是生的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài ròu háishì shēng de.
sentences.translation: This piece of meat is still raw.

sentences.chinese: 我不喜欢吃生鱼。
sentences.traditional: 我不喜歡吃生魚。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān chī shēng yú.
sentences.translation: I do not like eating raw fish.

sentences.chinese: 这个香蕉有点生，还不能吃。
sentences.traditional: 這個香蕉有點生，還不能吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāngjiāo yǒudiǎn shēng, hái bù néng chī.
sentences.translation: This banana is a bit unripe, so it cannot be eaten yet.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都应该尊重生命。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都應該尊重生命。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi zūnzhòng shēngmìng.
sentences.translation: Everyone should respect life.

sentences.chinese: 水对生命很重要。
sentences.traditional: 水對生命很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ duì shēngmìng hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Water is very important for life.

sentences.chinese: 这次经历改变了他对生命的看法。
sentences.traditional: 這次經歷改變了他對生命的看法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì gǎibiàn le tā duì shēngmìng de kànfǎ.
sentences.translation: This experience changed his view of life.

sentences.chinese: 他的生意越做越好。
sentences.traditional: 他的生意越做越好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēngyi yuè zuò yuè hǎo.
sentences.translation: His business is getting better and better.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的生意很不错。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的生意很不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de shēngyi hěn búcuò.
sentences.translation: This shop's business is quite good.

sentences.chinese: 做生意要讲信用。
sentences.traditional: 做生意要講信用。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò shēngyi yào jiǎng xìnyòng.
sentences.translation: Doing business requires keeping one's word.

sentences.chinese: 四川是中国的一个省。
sentences.traditional: 四川是中國的一個省。
sentences.pinyin: Sìchuān shì Zhōngguó de yí ge shěng.
sentences.translation: Sichuan is a province of China.

sentences.chinese: 我来自湖北省。
sentences.traditional: 我來自湖北省。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ láizì Húběi Shěng.
sentences.translation: I come from Hubei Province.

sentences.chinese: 每个省都有自己的特点。
sentences.traditional: 每個省都有自己的特點。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge shěng dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Every province has its own characteristics.

sentences.chinese: 冰箱里只剩一瓶水了。
sentences.traditional: 冰箱裡只剩一瓶水了。
sentences.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ zhǐ shèng yì píng shuǐ le.
sentences.translation: There is only one bottle of water left in the fridge.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束以后，只剩我一个人在办公室。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束以後，只剩我一個人在辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù yǐhòu, zhǐ shèng wǒ yí gèrén zài bàngōngshì.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, only I was left in the office.

sentences.chinese: 菜不多了，还剩一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 菜不多了，還剩一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Cài bù duō le, hái shèng yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: There is not much food left; there is still a little left.

sentences.chinese: 这次比赛虽然失败了，但我们学到了很多。
sentences.traditional: 這次比賽雖然失敗了，但我們學到了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài suīrán shībài le, dàn wǒmen xuédào le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: Although we failed this match, we learned a lot.

sentences.chinese: 第一次创业失败并不代表以后没有机会。
sentences.traditional: 第一次創業失敗並不代表以後沒有機會。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yí cì chuàngyè shībài bìng bù dàibiǎo yǐhòu méiyǒu jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Failing the first time in starting a business does not mean there will be no chance later.

sentences.chinese: 他的计划因为准备不充分而失败了。
sentences.traditional: 他的計畫因為準備不充分而失敗了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà yīnwèi zhǔnbèi bù chōngfèn ér shībài le.
sentences.translation: His plan failed because the preparation was insufficient.

sentences.chinese: 修空调的师傅一早就到了。
sentences.traditional: 修空調的師傅一早就到了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiū kōngtiáo de shīfu yì zǎo jiù dào le.
sentences.translation: The repairman who fixes air conditioners arrived early in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 这位师傅做菜很有经验。
sentences.traditional: 這位師傅做菜很有經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shīfu zuò cài hěn yǒu jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: This chef is very experienced in cooking.

sentences.chinese: 我请师傅帮我把这张桌子搬上楼。
sentences.traditional: 我請師傅幫我把這張桌子搬上樓。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng shīfu bāng wǒ bǎ zhè zhāng zhuōzi bān shàng lóu.
sentences.translation: I asked the worker to help me move this table upstairs.

sentences.chinese: 人不能因为一次失败就失去信心。
sentences.traditional: 人不能因為一次失敗就失去信心。
sentences.pinyin: Rén bùnéng yīnwèi yí cì shībài jiù shīqù xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: One must not lose confidence because of one failure.

sentences.chinese: 他不想失去这个难得的机会。
sentences.traditional: 他不想失去這個難得的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng shīqù zhège nándé de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: He does not want to lose this rare opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 长时间不联系，朋友之间也可能慢慢失去信任。
sentences.traditional: 長時間不聯繫，朋友之間也可能慢慢失去信任。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān bù liánxì, péngyou zhījiān yě kěnéng mànmàn shīqù xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: If people do not keep in touch for a long time, friends may gradually lose trust in each other.

sentences.chinese: 师生之间应该互相尊重。
sentences.traditional: 師生之間應該互相尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Shīshēng zhījiān yīnggāi hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: Teachers and students should respect each other.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动让师生关系更亲近了。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動讓師生關係更親近了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng ràng shīshēng guānxì gèng qīnjìn le.
sentences.translation: This activity made the teacher-student relationship closer.

sentences.chinese: 学校为师生提供了更好的学习环境。
sentences.traditional: 學校為師生提供了更好的學習環境。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi shīshēng tígōng le gèng hǎo de xuéxí huánjìng.
sentences.translation: The school provided a better learning environment for teachers and students.

sentences.chinese: 听到结果以后，大家都很失望。
sentences.traditional: 聽到結果以後，大家都很失望。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào jiéguǒ yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn shīwàng.
sentences.translation: After hearing the result, everyone was very disappointed.

sentences.chinese: 你别对自己太失望，下次还有机会。
sentences.traditional: 你別對自己太失望，下次還有機會。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié duì zìjǐ tài shīwàng, xià cì hái yǒu jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Do not be too disappointed in yourself; there will still be a chance next time.

sentences.chinese: 他没有完成任务，让老师有点失望。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有完成任務，讓老師有點失望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu wánchéng rènwu, ràng lǎoshī yǒudiǎn shīwàng.
sentences.translation: He did not complete the task, which made the teacher a little disappointed.

sentences.chinese: 这本小说十分精彩，我一晚上就看完了。
sentences.traditional: 這本小說十分精彩，我一晚上就看完了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō shífēn jīngcǎi, wǒ yì wǎnshang jiù kànwán le.
sentences.translation: This novel is extremely exciting, and I finished it in one evening.

sentences.chinese: 他的态度十分认真，大家都很佩服。
sentences.traditional: 他的態度十分認真，大家都很佩服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tàidu shífēn rènzhēn, dàjiā dōu hěn pèifú.
sentences.translation: His attitude is extremely serious, and everyone admires him.

sentences.chinese: 天气变化得十分突然，我们都没准备好。
sentences.traditional: 天氣變化得十分突然，我們都沒準備好。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì biànhuà de shífēn tūrán, wǒmen dōu méi zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.translation: The weather changed very suddenly, and none of us was prepared.

sentences.chinese: 你的想法不错，但实际情况比你想的复杂。
sentences.traditional: 你的想法不錯，但實際情況比你想的複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎngfǎ bùcuò, dàn shíjì qíngkuàng bǐ nǐ xiǎng de fùzá.
sentences.translation: Your idea is good, but the actual situation is more complicated than you think.

sentences.chinese: 学习语言的时候，实际使用很重要。
sentences.traditional: 學習語言的時候，實際使用很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yǔyán de shíhou, shíjì shǐyòng hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When learning a language, actual use is very important.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告没有解决实际问题。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告沒有解決實際問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào méiyǒu jiějué shíjì wèntí.
sentences.translation: This report did not solve actual problems.

sentences.chinese: 请先看一下明天的时间表。
sentences.traditional: 請先看一下明天的時間表。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān kàn yíxià míngtiān de shíjiānbiǎo.
sentences.translation: Please first take a look at tomorrow's schedule.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有时间表，我们很容易安排错。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有時間表，我們很容易安排錯。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu shíjiānbiǎo, wǒmen hěn róngyì ānpái cuò.
sentences.translation: If there is no timetable, we can easily arrange things wrongly.

sentences.chinese: 老师把考试时间表发到了班级群里。
sentences.traditional: 老師把考試時間表發到了班級群裡。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ kǎoshì shíjiānbiǎo fā dào le bānjí qún lǐ.
sentences.translation: The teacher posted the exam schedule in the class group.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很冷静，实际上心里很紧张。
sentences.traditional: 他看起來很冷靜，實際上心裡很緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn lěngjìng, shíjìshàng xīnlǐ hěn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: He looks calm, but in fact he is very nervous inside.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作听起来轻松，实际上并不简单。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作聽起來輕鬆，實際上並不簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò tīng qǐlái qīngsōng, shíjìshàng bìng bù jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: This job sounds easy, but actually it is not simple.

sentences.chinese: 很多人以为他住得很近，实际上要坐一个小时车。
sentences.traditional: 很多人以為他住得很近，實際上要坐一個小時車。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén yǐwéi tā zhù de hěn jìn, shíjìshàng yào zuò yí gè xiǎoshí chē.
sentences.translation: Many people think he lives nearby, but actually it takes an hour to get there by car.

sentences.chinese: 超市里有很多进口食品。
sentences.traditional: 超市裡有很多進口食品。
sentences.pinyin: Chāoshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō jìnkǒu shípǐn.
sentences.translation: There are many imported food products in the supermarket.

sentences.chinese: 买食品的时候要先看生产日期。
sentences.traditional: 買食品的時候要先看生產日期。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi shípǐn de shíhou yào xiān kàn shēngchǎn rìqī.
sentences.translation: When buying food products, you should first check the production date.

sentences.chinese: 这些食品最好放在冰箱里保存。
sentences.traditional: 這些食品最好放在冰箱裡保存。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shípǐn zuìhǎo fàng zài bīngxiāng lǐ bǎocún.
sentences.translation: These food items are best stored in the fridge.

sentences.chinese: 学校食堂的饭菜比外面便宜。
sentences.traditional: 學校食堂的飯菜比外面便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào shítáng de fàncài bǐ wàimiàn piányi.
sentences.translation: The school cafeteria food is cheaper than outside.

sentences.chinese: 我们中午常常在食堂吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 我們中午常常在食堂吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngwǔ chángcháng zài shítáng chīfàn.
sentences.translation: We often eat in the cafeteria at noon.

sentences.chinese: 新食堂环境很好，也很干净。
sentences.traditional: 新食堂環境很好，也很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn shítáng huánjìng hěn hǎo, yě hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: The new dining hall has a very good environment and is also very clean.

sentences.chinese: 医生说这种食物太油，不要吃太多。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說這種食物太油，不要吃太多。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè zhǒng shíwù tài yóu, búyào chī tài duō.
sentences.translation: The doctor said this kind of food is too oily, so don't eat too much.

sentences.chinese: 旅行的时候，我最想念家里的食物。
sentences.traditional: 旅行的時候，我最想念家裡的食物。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng de shíhou, wǒ zuì xiǎngniàn jiālǐ de shíwù.
sentences.translation: When travelling, I miss the food at home the most.

sentences.chinese: 有些食物看起来不错，其实不太健康。
sentences.traditional: 有些食物看起來不錯，其實不太健康。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shíwù kàn qǐlái búcuò, qíshí bù tài jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Some foods look good, but actually are not very healthy.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题太难了，我实在答不出来。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題太難了，我實在答不出來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tài nán le, wǒ shízài dá bù chūlái.
sentences.translation: This question is too hard; I really can't answer it.

sentences.chinese: 你帮了我这么多，我实在不知道怎么感谢你。
sentences.traditional: 你幫了我這麼多，我實在不知道怎麼感謝你。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bāng le wǒ zhème duō, wǒ shízài bù zhīdào zěnme gǎnxiè nǐ.
sentences.translation: You have helped me so much that I truly don't know how to thank you.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的服务实在不错，下次我还想来。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的服務實在不錯，下次我還想來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de fúwù shízài búcuò, xià cì wǒ hái xiǎng lái.
sentences.translation: The service at this shop is really good; I want to come again next time.

sentences.chinese: 前面的十字路口可以往左转。
sentences.traditional: 前面的十字路口可以往左轉。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánmiàn de shízì lùkǒu kěyǐ wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn.
sentences.translation: You can turn left at the intersection ahead.

sentences.chinese: 过十字路口的时候要注意红绿灯。
sentences.traditional: 過十字路口的時候要注意紅綠燈。
sentences.pinyin: Guò shízì lùkǒu de shíhou yào zhùyì hónglǜdēng.
sentences.translation: When crossing an intersection, you should pay attention to the traffic lights.

sentences.chinese: 他站在十字路口等了我十分钟。
sentences.traditional: 他站在十字路口等了我十分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài shízì lùkǒu děng le wǒ shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: He stood at the crossroads and waited for me for ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 这件事使我想起了小时候的生活。
sentences.traditional: 這件事使我想起了小時候的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ xiǎng qǐ le xiǎoshíhou de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This matter made me think of my childhood life.

sentences.chinese: 老师的话使大家更有信心了。
sentences.traditional: 老師的話使大家更有信心了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de huà shǐ dàjiā gèng yǒu xìnxīn le.
sentences.translation: The teacher's words gave everyone more confidence.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法可以使工作更有效率。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法可以使工作更有效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ kěyǐ shǐ gōngzuò gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: This method can make work more efficient.

sentences.chinese: 如果护照丢了，可以去使馆求助。
sentences.traditional: 如果護照丟了，可以去使館求助。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ hùzhào diū le, kěyǐ qù shǐguǎn qiúzhù.
sentences.translation: If your passport is lost, you can go to the embassy for help.

sentences.chinese: 使馆前面常常有很多人排队。
sentences.traditional: 使館前面常常有很多人排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐguǎn qiánmiàn chángcháng yǒu hěn duō rén páiduì.
sentences.translation: There are often many people queueing in front of the embassy.

sentences.chinese: 他明天要去使馆办理签证。
sentences.traditional: 他明天要去使館辦理簽證。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yào qù shǐguǎn bànlǐ qiānzhèng.
sentences.translation: He is going to the embassy tomorrow to process a visa.

sentences.chinese: 请先看说明，再使用这个机器。
sentences.traditional: 請先看說明，再使用這個機器。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān kàn shuōmíng, zài shǐyòng zhège jīqì.
sentences.translation: Please read the instructions first, then use this machine.

sentences.chinese: 老年人也会使用智能手机了。
sentences.traditional: 老年人也會使用智能手機了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoniánrén yě huì shǐyòng zhìnéng shǒujī le.
sentences.translation: Elderly people can also use smartphones now.

sentences.chinese: 使用公共自行车以后，记得按时归还。
sentences.traditional: 使用公共自行車以後，記得按時歸還。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐyòng gōnggòng zìxíngchē yǐhòu, jìde ànshí guīhuán.
sentences.translation: After using a public bicycle, remember to return it on time.

sentences.chinese: 这附近有一个很大的水果市场。
sentences.traditional: 這附近有一個很大的水果市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fùjìn yǒu yí gè hěn dà de shuǐguǒ shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: There is a very large fruit market nearby.

sentences.chinese: 这种产品在市场上很受欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這種產品在市場上很受歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chǎnpǐn zài shìchǎng shàng hěn shòu huānyíng.
sentences.translation: This product is very popular on the market.

sentences.chinese: 我想先了解市场情况，再决定价格。
sentences.traditional: 我想先了解市場情況，再決定價格。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān liǎojiě shìchǎng qíngkuàng, zài juédìng jiàgé.
sentences.translation: I want to understand the market situation first, then decide on the price.

sentences.chinese: 我还没决定是否参加这次比赛。
sentences.traditional: 我還沒決定是否參加這次比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi juédìng shìfǒu cānjiā zhè cì bǐsài.
sentences.translation: I haven't decided whether to take part in this competition yet.

sentences.chinese: 请告诉我明天是否需要加班。
sentences.traditional: 請告訴我明天是否需要加班。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ míngtiān shìfǒu xūyào jiābān.
sentences.translation: Please tell me whether overtime is needed tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他在考虑是否搬到南部去工作。
sentences.traditional: 他在考慮是否搬到南部去工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài kǎolǜ shìfǒu bān dào nánbù qù gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He is considering whether to move to the south for work.

sentences.chinese: 这双鞋很适合长时间走路。
sentences.traditional: 這雙鞋很適合長時間走路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié hěn shìhé cháng shíjiān zǒulù.
sentences.translation: These shoes are very suitable for walking for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 这种工作不太适合没有经验的人。
sentences.traditional: 這種工作不太適合沒有經驗的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gōngzuò bù tài shìhé méiyǒu jīngyàn de rén.
sentences.translation: This kind of job is not very suitable for people without experience.

sentences.chinese: 周末天气凉快，适合出去散步。
sentences.traditional: 週末天氣涼快，適合出去散步。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò tiānqì liángkuai, shìhé chūqù sànbù.
sentences.translation: The weather is cool at the weekend, so it is suitable for going out for a walk.

sentences.chinese: 二十一世纪的生活方式变化很快。
sentences.traditional: 二十一世紀的生活方式變化很快。
sentences.pinyin: Èrshíyī shìjì de shēnghuó fāngshì biànhuà hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: Life in the twenty-first century changes quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥已经有一个多世纪的历史了。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋已經有一個多世紀的歷史了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo yǐjīng yǒu yí gè duō shìjì de lìshǐ le.
sentences.translation: This bridge already has a history of more than a century.

sentences.chinese: 上个世纪，人们没有现在这么方便的网络。
sentences.traditional: 上個世紀，人們沒有現在這麼方便的網絡。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng gè shìjì, rénmen méiyǒu xiànzài zhème fāngbiàn de wǎngluò.
sentences.translation: In the last century, people did not have internet as convenient as now.

sentences.chinese: 我已经把教学视频发到群里了。
sentences.traditional: 我已經把教學視頻發到群裡了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ jiàoxué shìpín fā dào qún lǐ le.
sentences.translation: I have already sent the teaching video to the group chat.

sentences.chinese: 这个视频只有五分钟，很快就能看完。
sentences.traditional: 這個視頻只有五分鐘，很快就能看完。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shìpín zhǐ yǒu wǔ fēnzhōng, hěn kuài jiù néng kànwán.
sentences.translation: This video is only five minutes long, so it can be finished quickly.

sentences.chinese: 通过这个视频，你可以更清楚地了解情况。
sentences.traditional: 通過這個視頻，你可以更清楚地了解情況。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò zhège shìpín, nǐ kěyǐ gèng qīngchu de liǎojiě qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Through this video, you can understand the situation more clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他家离市区有点远，每天上班都要坐很久的车。
sentences.traditional: 他家離市區有點遠，每天上班都要坐很久的車。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiā lí shìqū yǒudiǎn yuǎn, měitiān shàngbān dōu yào zuò hěn jiǔ de chē.
sentences.translation: His home is a bit far from the city centre, and he has to spend a long time commuting every day.

sentences.chinese: 周末市区人很多，停车不太方便。
sentences.traditional: 週末市區人很多，停車不太方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò shìqū rén hěn duō, tíngchē bù tài fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The city centre is very crowded at weekends, and parking is not very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 我们先去市区吃饭，然后再回酒店。
sentences.traditional: 我們先去市區吃飯，然後再回酒店。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù shìqū chīfàn, ránhòu zài huí jiǔdiàn.
sentences.translation: We will first go to the city centre for a meal and then return to the hotel.

sentences.chinese: 老师说这些试题不算太难。
sentences.traditional: 老師說這些試題不算太難。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhèxiē shìtí bù suàn tài nán.
sentences.translation: The teacher said these test questions are not too difficult.

sentences.chinese: 做完试题以后，别忘了检查名字。
sentences.traditional: 做完試題以後，別忘了檢查名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwán shìtí yǐhòu, bié wàng le jiǎnchá míngzi.
sentences.translation: After finishing the exam paper, do not forget to check your name.

sentences.chinese: 这份试题主要考查学生的实际能力。
sentences.traditional: 這份試題主要考查學生的實際能力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn shìtí zhǔyào kǎochá xuéshēng de shíjì nénglì.
sentences.translation: This exam paper mainly tests the students' practical ability.

sentences.chinese: 他刚来这个城市的时候，很难适应这里的生活。
sentences.traditional: 他剛來這個城市的時候，很難適應這裡的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng lái zhège chéngshì de shíhou, hěn nán shìyìng zhèlǐ de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: When he first came to this city, it was hard for him to adapt to life here.

sentences.chinese: 换了新工作以后，我还在慢慢适应。
sentences.traditional: 換了新工作以後，我還在慢慢適應。
sentences.pinyin: Huàn le xīn gōngzuò yǐhòu, wǒ hái zài mànmàn shìyìng.
sentences.translation: After changing to a new job, I am still slowly adapting.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子比大人更容易适应新的环境。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子比大人更容易適應新的環境。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi bǐ dàrén gèng róngyì shìyìng xīn de huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Children adapt to new environments more easily than adults.

sentences.chinese: 这家博物馆周一不收费。
sentences.traditional: 這家博物館週一不收費。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn zhōuyī bù shōufèi.
sentences.translation: This museum does not charge on Mondays.

sentences.chinese: 医院停车场按小时收费。
sentences.traditional: 醫院停車場按小時收費。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn tíngchēchǎng àn xiǎoshí shōufèi.
sentences.translation: The hospital car park charges by the hour.

sentences.chinese: 有些景区节假日期间会提高收费标准。
sentences.traditional: 有些景區節假日期間會提高收費標準。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē jǐngqū jiéjiàrì qījiān huì tígāo shōufèi biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: Some scenic areas raise their charging standards during holiday periods.

sentences.chinese: 他的收入虽然不高，但生活很稳定。
sentences.traditional: 他的收入雖然不高，但生活很穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shōurù suīrán bù gāo, dàn shēnghuó hěn wěndìng.
sentences.translation: Although his income is not high, his life is quite stable.

sentences.chinese: 这份兼职能给我增加一点收入。
sentences.traditional: 這份兼職能給我增加一點收入。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn jiānzhí néng gěi wǒ zēngjiā yìdiǎn shōurù.
sentences.translation: This part-time job can increase my income a little.

sentences.chinese: 公司去年旅游方面的收入增长得很快。
sentences.traditional: 公司去年旅遊方面的收入增長得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī qùnián lǚyóu fāngmiàn de shōurù zēngzhǎng de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: The company's tourism revenue grew quickly last year.

sentences.chinese: 吃完饭以后，大家一起收拾桌子。
sentences.traditional: 吃完飯以後，大家一起收拾桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Chīwán fàn yǐhòu, dàjiā yìqǐ shōushi zhuōzi.
sentences.translation: After the meal, everyone tidied the table together.

sentences.chinese: 出发以前，我得先收拾一下行李。
sentences.traditional: 出發以前，我得先收拾一下行李。
sentences.pinyin: Chūfā yǐqián, wǒ děi xiān shōushi yíxià xíngli.
sentences.translation: Before setting off, I have to pack my luggage first.

sentences.chinese: 你的房间太乱了，应该早点收拾。
sentences.traditional: 你的房間太亂了，應該早點收拾。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān tài luàn le, yīnggāi zǎodiǎn shōushi.
sentences.translation: Your room is too messy; you should tidy it earlier.

sentences.chinese: 我父亲每天早上都收听新闻节目。
sentences.traditional: 我父親每天早上都收聽新聞節目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn měitiān zǎoshang dōu shōutīng xīnwén jiémù.
sentences.translation: My father listens to news programmes every morning.

sentences.chinese: 晚上他喜欢收听音乐节目。
sentences.traditional: 晚上他喜歡收聽音樂節目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang tā xǐhuan shōutīng yīnyuè jiémù.
sentences.translation: In the evening, he likes listening to music programmes.

sentences.chinese: 通过手机，我们可以收听很多广播。
sentences.traditional: 通過手機，我們可以收聽很多廣播。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò shǒujī, wǒmen kěyǐ shōutīng hěn duō guǎngbō.
sentences.translation: With a mobile phone, we can tune in to many broadcasts.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌我小时候就会唱。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌我小時候就會唱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē wǒ xiǎoshíhou jiù huì chàng.
sentences.translation: I could already sing this song when I was little.

sentences.chinese: 这首诗不长，但是很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這首詩不長，但是很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī bù cháng, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This poem is not long, but it is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们每个人背一首古诗。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們每個人背一首古詩。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen měi gè rén bèi yì shǒu gǔshī.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked each of us to memorise a classical poem.

sentences.chinese: 北京是中国的首都。
sentences.traditional: 北京是中國的首都。
sentences.pinyin: Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū.
sentences.translation: Beijing is the capital of China.

sentences.chinese: 这个国家的首都人口很多。
sentences.traditional: 這個國家的首都人口很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de shǒudū rénkǒu hěn duō.
sentences.translation: The capital of this country has a large population.

sentences.chinese: 旅行以前，我先查了那个国家的首都在哪儿。
sentences.traditional: 旅行以前，我先查了那個國家的首都在哪兒。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng yǐqián, wǒ xiān chá le nàge guójiā de shǒudū zài nǎr.
sentences.translation: Before travelling, I first checked where that country's capital was.

sentences.chinese: 开会以前，首先要把资料准备好。
sentences.traditional: 開會以前，首先要把資料準備好。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì yǐqián, shǒuxiān yào bǎ zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting, first the materials need to be prepared well.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题很重要，我们首先得弄清楚原因。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題很重要，我們首先得弄清楚原因。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn zhòngyào, wǒmen shǒuxiān děi nòng qīngchu yuányīn.
sentences.translation: This question is important, so we first have to clarify the reason.

sentences.chinese: 学习一门语言，首先要敢开口说。
sentences.traditional: 學習一門語言，首先要敢開口說。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yì mén yǔyán, shǒuxiān yào gǎn kāikǒu shuō.
sentences.translation: When learning a language, first you need to dare to speak up.

sentences.chinese: 天气太热了，我真的受不了了。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太熱了，我真的受不了了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè le, wǒ zhēnde shòubuliǎo le.
sentences.translation: The weather is too hot; I really cannot stand it anymore.

sentences.chinese: 他每天都这么吵，邻居早就受不了了。
sentences.traditional: 他每天都這麼吵，鄰居早就受不了了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu zhème chǎo, línjū zǎo jiù shòubuliǎo le.
sentences.translation: He is this noisy every day, and the neighbours could not stand it long ago.

sentences.chinese: 如果工作压力一直这么大，谁都受不了。
sentences.traditional: 如果工作壓力一直這麼大，誰都受不了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ gōngzuò yālì yìzhí zhème dà, shuí dōu shòubuliǎo.
sentences.translation: If the work pressure stays this high, nobody can bear it.

sentences.chinese: 售票员告诉我们下一班车快到了。
sentences.traditional: 售票員告訴我們下一班車快到了。
sentences.pinyin: Shòupiàoyuán gàosu wǒmen xià yì bān chē kuài dào le.
sentences.translation: The ticket seller told us that the next bus would arrive soon.

sentences.chinese: 他在车站做了三年售票员。
sentences.traditional: 他在車站做了三年售票員。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chēzhàn zuò le sān nián shòupiàoyuán.
sentences.translation: He worked as a ticket seller at the station for three years.

sentences.chinese: 你有什么问题，可以直接问售票员。
sentences.traditional: 你有什麼問題，可以直接問售票員。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme wèntí, kěyǐ zhíjiē wèn shòupiàoyuán.
sentences.translation: If you have any questions, you can ask the ticket seller directly.

sentences.chinese: 他昨天踢球的时候不小心受伤了。
sentences.traditional: 他昨天踢球的時候不小心受傷了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuótiān tīqiú de shíhou bù xiǎoxīn shòushāng le.
sentences.translation: He got injured accidentally while playing football yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 幸好大家都戴了安全帽，没有人受伤。
sentences.traditional: 幸好大家都戴了安全帽，沒有人受傷。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnghǎo dàjiā dōu dài le ānquánmào, méiyǒu rén shòushāng.
sentences.translation: Fortunately everyone wore safety helmets, and nobody was injured.

sentences.chinese: 手刚受伤的时候，他连字都写不好。
sentences.traditional: 手剛受傷的時候，他連字都寫不好。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu gāng shòushāng de shíhou, tā lián zì dōu xiě bù hǎo.
sentences.translation: When his hand had just been injured, he could not even write properly.

sentences.chinese: 这场比赛我们虽然输了，但是学到了很多。
sentences.traditional: 這場比賽我們雖然輸了，但是學到了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài wǒmen suīrán shū le, dànshì xué dào le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: Although we lost this match, we learned a lot.

sentences.chinese: 这条管道每天给城里输水。
sentences.traditional: 這條管道每天給城裡輸水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo guǎndào měitiān gěi chéng lǐ shū shuǐ.
sentences.translation: This pipeline delivers water to the city every day.

sentences.chinese: 你别怕输，重要的是尽力。
sentences.traditional: 你別怕輸，重要的是盡力。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié pà shū, zhòngyào de shì jìnlì.
sentences.translation: Do not be afraid of losing; what matters is doing your best.

sentences.chinese: 这种水果还没熟，现在吃太酸。
sentences.traditional: 這種水果還沒熟，現在吃太酸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ hái méi shóu, xiànzài chī tài suān.
sentences.translation: This fruit is not ripe yet, so it is too sour to eat now.

sentences.chinese: 饭已经熟了，大家可以开饭了。
sentences.traditional: 飯已經熟了，大家可以開飯了。
sentences.pinyin: Fàn yǐjīng shóu le, dàjiā kěyǐ kāifàn le.
sentences.translation: The rice is cooked, so everyone can start eating.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然来得晚，但是很快就和大家熟了。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然來得晚，但是很快就和大家熟了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán lái de wǎn, dànshì hěn kuài jiù hé dàjiā shú le.
sentences.translation: Although he arrived late, he quickly became familiar with everyone.

sentences.chinese: 我对这条路很熟悉，不会走错。
sentences.traditional: 我對這條路很熟悉，不會走錯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè tiáo lù hěn shúxī, bú huì zǒu cuò.
sentences.translation: I am very familiar with this road, so I will not go the wrong way.

sentences.chinese: 新来的同事还不太熟悉这里的工作流程。
sentences.traditional: 新來的同事還不太熟悉這裡的工作流程。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn lái de tóngshì hái bú tài shúxī zhèlǐ de gōngzuò liúchéng.
sentences.translation: The new colleague is not yet very familiar with the work process here.

sentences.chinese: 多听多说以后，你会越来越熟悉这种表达方式。
sentences.traditional: 多聽多說以後，你會越來越熟悉這種表達方式。
sentences.pinyin: Duō tīng duō shuō yǐhòu, nǐ huì yuèláiyuè shúxī zhè zhǒng biǎodá fāngshì.
sentences.translation: After listening and speaking more, you will become more and more familiar with this kind of expression.

sentences.chinese: 今年暑假我们打算去海边旅行。
sentences.traditional: 今年暑假我們打算去海邊旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián shǔjià wǒmen dǎsuàn qù hǎibiān lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: This summer holiday we plan to travel to the seaside.

sentences.chinese: 暑假结束以后，学生们又要回学校了。
sentences.traditional: 暑假結束以後，學生們又要回學校了。
sentences.pinyin: Shǔjià jiéshù yǐhòu, xuéshēngmen yòu yào huí xuéxiào le.
sentences.translation: After the summer holiday ends, the students have to go back to school again.

sentences.chinese: 他想利用暑假学一点新的技能。
sentences.traditional: 他想利用暑假學一點新的技能。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng lìyòng shǔjià xué yìdiǎn xīn de jìnéng.
sentences.translation: He wants to use the summer holiday to learn some new skills.

sentences.chinese: 这个数太大，我一时算不出来。
sentences.traditional: 這個數太大，我一時算不出來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge shù tài dà, wǒ yìshí suàn bu chūlái.
sentences.translation: This number is too large; I cannot calculate it right away.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们把这些数从小到大写下来。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們把這些數從小到大寫下來。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǎ zhèxiē shù cóng xiǎo dào dà xiě xiàlái.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to write these numbers down from smallest to largest.

sentences.chinese: 这个表里一共有五个数，你先检查一下。
sentences.traditional: 這個表裡一共有五個數，你先檢查一下。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge biǎo lǐ yígòng yǒu wǔ ge shù, nǐ xiān jiǎnchá yíxià.
sentences.translation: There are five numbers in this table altogether; check them first.

sentences.chinese: 这种水果的数量不多，晚来的人可能买不到。
sentences.traditional: 這種水果的數量不多，晚來的人可能買不到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ de shùliàng bù duō, wǎn lái de rén kěnéng mǎi bu dào.
sentences.translation: The quantity of this fruit is not large, so people who come late may not be able to buy it.

sentences.chinese: 我们要先确定材料的数量，再开始生产。
sentences.traditional: 我們要先確定材料的數量，再開始生產。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiān quèdìng cáiliào de shùliàng, zài kāishǐ shēngchǎn.
sentences.translation: We need to confirm the amount of materials first, and then begin production.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们统计图书馆里旧书的数量。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們統計圖書館裡舊書的數量。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen tǒngjì túshūguǎn lǐ jiù shū de shùliàng.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to count the quantity of old books in the library.

sentences.chinese: 穿过前面的树林，就能看到那条小河。
sentences.traditional: 穿過前面的樹林，就能看到那條小河。
sentences.pinyin: Chuānguò qiánmiàn de shùlín, jiù néng kàn dào nà tiáo xiǎohé.
sentences.translation: Once you pass through the woods ahead, you can see that small river.

sentences.chinese: 这片树林夏天很凉快，很多人喜欢来散步。
sentences.traditional: 這片樹林夏天很涼快，很多人喜歡來散步。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn shùlín xiàtiān hěn liángkuai, hěn duō rén xǐhuan lái sànbù.
sentences.translation: This woods is very cool in summer, and many people like to come for a walk.

sentences.chinese: 天快黑了，我们最好不要一个人进树林。
sentences.traditional: 天快黑了，我們最好不要一個人進樹林。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān kuài hēi le, wǒmen zuìhǎo búyào yí ge rén jìn shùlín.
sentences.translation: It is getting dark; we had better not go into the woods alone.

sentences.chinese: 请输入正确的数字密码，然后再按确认键。
sentences.traditional: 請輸入正確的數字密碼，然後再按確認鍵。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng shūrù zhèngquè de shùzì mìmǎ, ránhòu zài àn quèrèn jiàn.
sentences.translation: Please enter the correct numerical password, and then press the confirm key.

sentences.chinese: 这些数字看起来差不多，其实差别很大。
sentences.traditional: 這些數字看起來差不多，其實差別很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùzì kàn qǐlái chàbuduō, qíshí chābié hěn dà.
sentences.translation: These numbers look similar, but in fact the difference is quite big.

sentences.chinese: 医生一看检查报告上的数字，就知道问题不小。
sentences.traditional: 醫生一看檢查報告上的數字，就知道問題不小。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng yí kàn jiǎnchá bàogào shàng de shùzì, jiù zhīdào wèntí bù xiǎo.
sentences.translation: As soon as the doctor looked at the numbers on the test report, he knew the problem was not small.

sentences.chinese: 你弟弟长得真帅，难怪大家都喜欢他。
sentences.traditional: 你弟弟長得真帥，難怪大家都喜歡他。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ dìdi zhǎng de zhēn shuài, nánguài dàjiā dōu xǐhuan tā.
sentences.translation: Your younger brother is really handsome; no wonder everyone likes him.

sentences.chinese: 他不但帅，而且对人也很有礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 他不但帥，而且對人也很有禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búdàn shuài, érqiě duì rén yě hěn yǒu lǐmào.
sentences.translation: He is not only handsome, but also very polite to people.

sentences.chinese: 那个穿黑色西装的男人看起来很帅。
sentences.traditional: 那個穿黑色西裝的男人看起來很帥。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge chuān hēisè xīzhuāng de nánrén kàn qǐlái hěn shuài.
sentences.translation: That man wearing a black suit looks very handsome.

sentences.chinese: 我去超市买牛奶，顺便帮你买面包。
sentences.traditional: 我去超市買牛奶，順便幫你買麵包。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi niúnǎi, shùnbiàn bāng nǐ mǎi miànbāo.
sentences.translation: I am going to the supermarket to buy milk, and while I’m there I’ll buy bread for you as well.

sentences.chinese: 你回家的时候，顺便把这本书还给我。
sentences.traditional: 你回家的時候，順便把這本書還給我。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ huí jiā de shíhou, shùnbiàn bǎ zhè běn shū huán gěi wǒ.
sentences.translation: When you go home, return this book to me on the way.

sentences.chinese: 如果你明天见到王老师，顺便告诉他会议改时间了。
sentences.traditional: 如果你明天見到王老師，順便告訴他會議改時間了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ míngtiān jiàn dào Wáng lǎoshī, shùnbiàn gàosu tā huìyì gǎi shíjiān le.
sentences.translation: If you see Teacher Wang tomorrow, tell him as well that the meeting time has been changed.

sentences.chinese: 在大家的帮助下，活动进行得很顺利。
sentences.traditional: 在大家的幫助下，活動進行得很順利。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dàjiā de bāngzhù xià, huódòng jìnxíng de hěn shùnlì.
sentences.translation: With everyone’s help, the activity went very smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 希望你这次面试一切顺利。
sentences.traditional: 希望你這次面試一切順利。
sentences.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ zhè cì miànshì yíqiè shùnlì.
sentences.translation: I hope everything goes smoothly with your interview this time.

sentences.chinese: 虽然中间出了点问题，但最后还是顺利地解决了。
sentences.traditional: 雖然中間出了點問題，但最後還是順利地解決了。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhōngjiān chū le diǎn wèntí, dàn zuìhòu háishi shùnlì de jiějué le.
sentences.translation: Although there were some problems in the middle, they were smoothly resolved in the end.

sentences.chinese: 请按照顺序一个一个进教室，不要着急。
sentences.traditional: 請按照順序一個一個進教室，不要著急。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào shùnxù yí ge yí ge jìn jiàoshì, búyào zhāojí.
sentences.translation: Please enter the classroom one by one in order; do not rush.

sentences.chinese: 这几个步骤的顺序不能弄错。
sentences.traditional: 這幾個步驟的順序不能弄錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge bùzhòu de shùnxù bù néng nòng cuò.
sentences.translation: The order of these steps must not be mistaken.

sentences.chinese: 我已经把文件按时间顺序排好了。
sentences.traditional: 我已經把文件按時間順序排好了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ wénjiàn àn shíjiān shùnxù pái hǎo le.
sentences.translation: I have already arranged the documents in time order.

sentences.chinese: 对这件事，每个人都有不同的说法。
sentences.traditional: 對這件事，每個人都有不同的說法。
sentences.pinyin: Duì zhè jiàn shì, měi ge rén dōu yǒu bùtóng de shuōfǎ.
sentences.translation: Everyone has a different version of this matter.

sentences.chinese: 你这种说法听起来不太合理。
sentences.traditional: 你這種說法聽起來不太合理。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhè zhǒng shuōfǎ tīng qǐlái bú tài hélǐ.
sentences.translation: This way of putting it does not sound very reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 新闻里的说法和他昨天告诉我的不一样。
sentences.traditional: 新聞裡的說法和他昨天告訴我的不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnwén lǐ de shuōfǎ hé tā zuótiān gàosu wǒ de bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: The version in the news is not the same as what he told me yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 开始使用以前，请先看一下说明。
sentences.traditional: 開始使用以前，請先看一下說明。
sentences.pinyin: Kāishǐ shǐyòng yǐqián, qǐng xiān kàn yíxià shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: Before you start using it, please read the instructions first.

sentences.chinese: 你能不能说明一下你为什么迟到了？
sentences.traditional: 你能不能說明一下你為什麼遲到了？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng bu néng shuōmíng yíxià nǐ wèishénme chídào le?
sentences.translation: Could you explain why you were late?

sentences.chinese: 这张图很清楚地说明了问题。
sentences.traditional: 這張圖很清楚地說明了問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng tú hěn qīngchu de shuōmíng le wèntí.
sentences.translation: This chart explains the problem very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 请先看说明书，再安装这台机器。
sentences.traditional: 請先看說明書，再安裝這臺機器。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān kàn shuōmíngshū, zài ānzhuāng zhè tái jīqì.
sentences.translation: Please read the instruction manual first, then install this machine.

sentences.chinese: 这本说明书写得很清楚，我一看就明白了。
sentences.traditional: 這本說明書寫得很清楚，我一看就明白了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shuōmíngshū xiě de hěn qīngchu, wǒ yí kàn jiù míngbai le.
sentences.translation: This instruction manual is written very clearly; I understood it as soon as I read it.

sentences.chinese: 如果你不会用这个软件，可以看看说明书。
sentences.traditional: 如果你不會用這個軟件，可以看看說明書。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bú huì yòng zhè ge ruǎnjiàn, kěyǐ kànkan shuōmíngshū.
sentences.translation: If you do not know how to use this software, you can read the instruction manual.

sentences.chinese: 她大学毕业以后，打算继续读硕士。
sentences.traditional: 她大學畢業以後，打算繼續讀碩士。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, dǎsuàn jìxù dú shuòshì.
sentences.translation: After graduating from university, she plans to continue studying for a master's degree.

sentences.chinese: 我哥哥是学经济的硕士。
sentences.traditional: 我哥哥是學經濟的碩士。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì xué jīngjì de shuòshì.
sentences.translation: My elder brother has a master's degree in economics.

sentences.chinese: 这个工作要求申请人至少有硕士学历。
sentences.traditional: 這個工作要求申請人至少有碩士學歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge gōngzuò yāoqiú shēnqǐngrén zhìshǎo yǒu shuòshì xuélì.
sentences.translation: This job requires applicants to have at least a master's degree.

sentences.chinese: 这棵树已经死了，可能救不活了。
sentences.traditional: 這棵樹已經死了，可能救不活了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kē shù yǐjīng sǐ le, kěnéng jiù bu huó le.
sentences.translation: This tree is already dead, and it probably cannot be saved.

sentences.chinese: 鱼离开水太久就会死。
sentences.traditional: 魚離開水太久就會死。
sentences.pinyin: Yú líkāi shuǐ tài jiǔ jiù huì sǐ.
sentences.translation: Fish will die if they stay out of water for too long.

sentences.chinese: 他把门关得很死，一点声音也听不见。
sentences.traditional: 他把門關得很死，一點聲音也聽不見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ mén guān de hěn sǐ, yìdiǎn shēngyīn yě tīng bu jiàn.
sentences.translation: He shut the door very tightly, so not a sound could be heard.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车的速度太快了，你慢一点。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車的速度太快了，你慢一點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de sùdù tài kuài le, nǐ màn yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The speed of this car is too fast; slow down a little.

sentences.chinese: 网络速度比昨天快多了。
sentences.traditional: 網絡速度比昨天快多了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò sùdù bǐ zuótiān kuài duō le.
sentences.translation: The internet speed is much faster than yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 我们要在保证质量的同时提高速度。
sentences.traditional: 我們要在保證質量的同時提高速度。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zài bǎozhèng zhìliàng de tóngshí tígāo sùdù.
sentences.translation: We need to improve speed while ensuring quality.

sentences.chinese: 这个杯子是塑料的，不容易摔坏。
sentences.traditional: 這個杯子是塑料的，不容易摔壞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge bēizi shì sùliào de, bù róngyì shuāi huài.
sentences.translation: This cup is made of plastic, so it is not easy to break.

sentences.chinese: 为了环保，我们应该少用一次性塑料产品。
sentences.traditional: 為了環保，我們應該少用一次性塑料產品。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huánbǎo, wǒmen yīnggāi shǎo yòng yícìxìng sùliào chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: For environmental protection, we should use fewer disposable plastic products.

sentences.chinese: 塑料袋用完以后，不要随便乱扔。
sentences.traditional: 塑料袋用完以後，不要隨便亂扔。
sentences.pinyin: Sùliào dài yòng wán yǐhòu, bú yào suíbiàn luàn rēng.
sentences.translation: After using a plastic bag, do not throw it away carelessly.

sentences.chinese: 这个葡萄还没熟，吃起来有点酸。
sentences.traditional: 這個葡萄還沒熟，吃起來有點酸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge pútao hái méi shóu, chī qǐlái yǒudiǎn suān.
sentences.translation: These grapes are not ripe yet, so they taste a bit sour.

sentences.chinese: 我运动以后腿很酸，今天想早点休息。
sentences.traditional: 我運動以後腿很酸，今天想早點休息。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yùndòng yǐhòu tuǐ hěn suān, jīntiān xiǎng zǎodiǎn xiūxi.
sentences.translation: My legs are very sore after exercising, so I want to rest early today.

sentences.chinese: 这汤太酸了，你是不是放多了醋？
sentences.traditional: 這湯太酸了，你是不是放多了醋？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tāng tài suān le, nǐ shì bú shì fàng duō le cù?
sentences.translation: This soup is too sour. Did you add too much vinegar?

sentences.chinese: 我每天早上都会喝一杯酸奶。
sentences.traditional: 我每天早上都會喝一杯酸奶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu huì hē yì bēi suānnǎi.
sentences.translation: I drink a cup of yogurt every morning.

sentences.chinese: 冰箱里还有两盒酸奶，你可以拿一盒。
sentences.traditional: 冰箱裡還有兩盒酸奶，你可以拿一盒。
sentences.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ hái yǒu liǎng hé suānnǎi, nǐ kěyǐ ná yì hé.
sentences.translation: There are still two cartons of yogurt in the fridge; you can take one.

sentences.chinese: 这家店卖的酸奶又新鲜又好喝。
sentences.traditional: 這家店賣的酸奶又新鮮又好喝。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài de suānnǎi yòu xīnxiān yòu hǎohē.
sentences.translation: The yogurt sold in this shop is both fresh and tasty.

sentences.chinese: 这道题不难，我已经算出来了。
sentences.traditional: 這道題不難，我已經算出來了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí bù nán, wǒ yǐjīng suàn chūlái le.
sentences.translation: This question is not difficult; I have already worked it out.

sentences.chinese: 如果这样也算迟到，那我真没办法。
sentences.traditional: 如果這樣也算遲到，那我真沒辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhèyàng yě suàn chídào, nà wǒ zhēn méi bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: If this also counts as being late, then I really have no way around it.

sentences.chinese: 这次考试他算发挥得不错。
sentences.traditional: 這次考試他算發揮得不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì tā suàn fāhuī de búcuò.
sentences.translation: He performed fairly well in this exam, all things considered.

sentences.chinese: 你别太客气，随便坐吧。
sentences.traditional: 你別太客氣，隨便坐吧。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié tài kèqi, suíbiàn zuò ba.
sentences.translation: Do not be so polite; just sit anywhere.

sentences.chinese: 这件事很重要，不能随便决定。
sentences.traditional: 這件事很重要，不能隨便決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòngyào, bù néng suíbiàn juédìng.
sentences.translation: This matter is important, so it cannot be decided casually.

sentences.chinese: 周末吃什么都可以，我随便。
sentences.traditional: 週末吃什麼都可以，我隨便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò chī shénme dōu kěyǐ, wǒ suíbiàn.
sentences.translation: Anything is fine for the weekend meal; I do not mind.

sentences.chinese: 随着天气变暖，来公园散步的人越来越多。
sentences.traditional: 隨著天氣變暖，來公園散步的人越來越多。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe tiānqì biànnuǎn, lái gōngyuán sànbù de rén yuèláiyuè duō.
sentences.translation: As the weather gets warmer, more and more people come to the park for walks.

sentences.chinese: 随着科技的发展，我们的生活方便了很多。
sentences.traditional: 隨著科技的發展，我們的生活方便了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fāzhǎn, wǒmen de shēnghuó fāngbiàn le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: With the development of technology, our lives have become much more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 随着年纪增长，他的想法也慢慢改变了。
sentences.traditional: 隨著年紀增長，他的想法也慢慢改變了。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe niánjì zēngzhǎng, tā de xiǎngfa yě mànmàn gǎibiàn le.
sentences.translation: As he has grown older, his ideas have gradually changed.

sentences.chinese: 我孙女今年五岁，特别喜欢画画。
sentences.traditional: 我孫女今年五歲，特別喜歡畫畫。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ sūnnǚ jīnnián wǔ suì, tèbié xǐhuan huàhuà.
sentences.translation: My granddaughter is five this year and especially likes drawing.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶每天放学后都去接孙女回家。
sentences.traditional: 奶奶每天放學後都去接孫女回家。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai měitiān fàngxué hòu dōu qù jiē sūnnǚ huí jiā.
sentences.translation: Grandma goes to pick up her granddaughter after school every day.

sentences.chinese: 她一看到孙女的照片就笑了。
sentences.traditional: 她一看到孫女的照片就笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí kàn dào sūnnǚ de zhàopiàn jiù xiào le.
sentences.translation: She smiled as soon as she saw her granddaughter's photo.

sentences.chinese: 他带着孙子去公园散步。
sentences.traditional: 他帶著孫子去公園散步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàizhe sūnzi qù gōngyuán sànbù.
sentences.translation: He took his grandson for a walk in the park.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷教孙子下棋，很有耐心。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺教孫子下棋，很有耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye jiāo sūnzi xià qí, hěn yǒu nàixīn.
sentences.translation: Grandfather teaches his grandson chess with great patience.

sentences.chinese: 那个小男孩是王老师的孙子。
sentences.traditional: 那個小男孩是王老師的孫子。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge xiǎo nánhái shì Wáng lǎoshī de sūnzi.
sentences.translation: That little boy is Teacher Wang's grandson.

sentences.chinese: 班里所有同学都已经到了，就差你一个。
sentences.traditional: 班裡所有同學都已經到了，就差你一個。
sentences.pinyin: Bān lǐ suǒyǒu tóngxué dōu yǐjīng dào le, jiù chà nǐ yí ge.
sentences.translation: All the classmates in the class have already arrived; only you are missing.

sentences.chinese: 旅行前，我们把所有东西都准备好了。
sentences.traditional: 旅行前，我們把所有東西都準備好了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng qián, wǒmen bǎ suǒyǒu dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
sentences.translation: Before the trip, we got everything ready.

sentences.chinese: 他把所有的想法都写在纸上。
sentences.traditional: 他把所有的想法都寫在紙上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de xiǎngfa dōu xiě zài zhǐ shàng.
sentences.translation: He wrote all his ideas on the paper.

sentences.chinese: 公司新买了两台电脑。
sentences.traditional: 公司新買了兩臺電腦。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xīn mǎi le liǎng tái diànnǎo.
sentences.translation: The company bought two new computers.

sentences.chinese: 门口停着一台白色的车。
sentences.traditional: 門口停著一臺白色的車。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu tíngzhe yì tái báisè de chē.
sentences.translation: A white car is parked at the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器怎么突然不动了？
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器怎麼突然不動了？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì zěnme tūrán bù dòng le?
sentences.translation: Why did this machine suddenly stop working?

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子太重了，我们一起抬吧。
sentences.traditional: 這張桌子太重了，我們一起抬吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi tài zhòng le, wǒmen yìqǐ tái ba.
sentences.translation: This table is too heavy; let's lift it together.

sentences.chinese: 他一个人抬不动这箱书。
sentences.traditional: 他一個人抬不動這箱書。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén tái bu dòng zhè xiāng shū.
sentences.translation: He cannot lift this box of books by himself.

sentences.chinese: 请把椅子抬到教室外面去。
sentences.traditional: 請把椅子抬到教室外面去。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yǐzi tái dào jiàoshì wàimian qù.
sentences.translation: Please carry the chair outside the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 过马路的时候，你先抬头看看前面的路。
sentences.traditional: 過馬路的時候，你先抬頭看看前面的路。
sentences.pinyin: Guò mǎlù de shíhou, nǐ xiān táitóu kànkan qiánmian de lù.
sentences.translation: When crossing the road, first look up at the road ahead.

sentences.chinese: 我叫了他好几声，他才抬头。
sentences.traditional: 我叫了他好幾聲，他才抬頭。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiào le tā hǎo jǐ shēng, tā cái táitóu.
sentences.translation: I called him several times before he finally looked up.

sentences.chinese: 老师进来的时候，大家都抬头看着他。
sentences.traditional: 老師進來的時候，大家都抬頭看著他。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jìnlai de shíhou, dàjiā dōu táitóu kànzhe tā.
sentences.translation: When the teacher came in, everyone looked up at him.

sentences.chinese: 他的工作态度一直很认真。
sentences.traditional: 他的工作態度一直很認真。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò tàidù yìzhí hěn rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: His work attitude has always been very serious.

sentences.chinese: 你这种态度让人很难接受。
sentences.traditional: 你這種態度讓人很難接受。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhè zhǒng tàidù ràng rén hěn nán jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: This kind of attitude is hard for people to accept.

sentences.chinese: 面对批评，他的态度很冷静。
sentences.traditional: 面對批評，他的態度很冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì pīpíng, tā de tàidù hěn lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: When facing criticism, his attitude is very calm.

sentences.chinese: 她从小就会弹钢琴。
sentences.traditional: 她從小就會彈鋼琴。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù huì tán gāngqín.
sentences.translation: She has known how to play the piano since childhood.

sentences.chinese: 晚饭后，他喜欢弹吉他放松一下。
sentences.traditional: 晚飯後，他喜歡彈吉他放鬆一下。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnfàn hòu, tā xǐhuan tán jítā fàngsōng yíxià.
sentences.translation: After dinner, he likes to play the guitar to relax a little.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌不难弹，你试试看。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌不難彈，你試試看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē bù nán tán, nǐ shìshikan.
sentences.translation: This song is not hard to play; give it a try.

sentences.chinese: 我想跟你谈这件事。
sentences.traditional: 我想跟你談這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ tán zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: I want to talk with you about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 他们正在办公室里谈工作。
sentences.traditional: 他們正在辦公室裡談工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài bàngōngshì lǐ tán gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: They are discussing work in the office.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题我们明天再谈吧。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題我們明天再談吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí wǒmen míngtiān zài tán ba.
sentences.translation: Let's talk about this issue again tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 今天的汤有点儿咸。
sentences.traditional: 今天的湯有點兒鹹。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de tāng yǒudiǎnr xián.
sentences.translation: Today's soup is a little salty.

sentences.chinese: 天冷的时候，喝一碗热汤很舒服。
sentences.traditional: 天冷的時候，喝一碗熱湯很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān lěng de shíhou, hē yì wǎn rè tāng hěn shūfu.
sentences.translation: When it is cold, drinking a bowl of hot soup feels very comforting.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈正在厨房里给我们做汤。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽正在廚房裡給我們做湯。
sentences.pinyin: Māma zhèngzài chúfáng lǐ gěi wǒmen zuò tāng.
sentences.translation: Mum is making soup for us in the kitchen.

sentences.chinese: 他太累了，一回家就躺在沙发上。
sentences.traditional: 他太累了，一回家就躺在沙發上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tài lèi le, yì huí jiā jiù tǎng zài shāfā shang.
sentences.translation: He was so tired that he lay on the sofa as soon as he got home.

sentences.chinese: 医生让病人先躺下来休息。
sentences.traditional: 醫生讓病人先躺下來休息。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng ràng bìngrén xiān tǎng xiàlai xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The doctor told the patient to lie down and rest first.

sentences.chinese: 别一直躺着，起来散步吧。
sentences.traditional: 別一直躺著，起來散步吧。
sentences.pinyin: Bié yìzhí tǎng zhe, qǐlai sànbù ba.
sentences.translation: Do not keep lying down; get up and take a walk.

sentences.chinese: 我今天去了一趟银行。
sentences.traditional: 我今天去了一趟銀行。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qù le yí tàng yínháng.
sentences.translation: I went to the bank once today.

sentences.chinese: 这趟车经过市区吗？
sentences.traditional: 這趟車經過市區嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tàng chē jīngguò shìqū ma?
sentences.translation: Does this bus or train go through the city centre?

sentences.chinese: 他为了办签证跑了好几趟。
sentences.traditional: 他為了辦簽證跑了好幾趟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèile bàn qiānzhèng pǎo le hǎo jǐ tàng.
sentences.translation: He made several trips to handle the visa.

sentences.chinese: 我们正在讨论旅行计划。
sentences.traditional: 我們正在討論旅行計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài tǎolùn lǚxíng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: We are discussing the travel plan.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题需要大家一起讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題需要大家一起討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí xūyào dàjiā yìqǐ tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This problem needs everyone to discuss it together.

sentences.chinese: 会议上，他们讨论了收费标准。
sentences.traditional: 會議上，他們討論了收費標準。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shang, tāmen tǎolùn le shōufèi biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: At the meeting, they discussed the charging standards.

sentences.chinese: 我讨厌下雨天堵车。
sentences.traditional: 我討厭下雨天堵車。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn xiàyǔ tiān dǔchē.
sentences.translation: I hate traffic jams on rainy days.

sentences.chinese: 他说话的态度让人讨厌。
sentences.traditional: 他說話的態度讓人討厭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de tàidù ràng rén tǎoyàn.
sentences.translation: The way he speaks is annoying.

sentences.chinese: 别乱扔垃圾，这种行为很讨厌。
sentences.traditional: 別亂扔垃圾，這種行為很討厭。
sentences.pinyin: Bié luàn rēng lājī, zhè zhǒng xíngwéi hěn tǎoyàn.
sentences.translation: Do not throw rubbish around; this kind of behaviour is annoying.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市最大的特点是交通方便。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市最大的特點是交通方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì zuì dà de tèdiǎn shì jiāotōng fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The biggest feature of this city is convenient transport.

sentences.chinese: 每个学生都有自己的特点。
sentences.traditional: 每個學生都有自己的特點。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge xuéshēng dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Every student has their own characteristics.

sentences.chinese: 请介绍一下这个产品的特点。
sentences.traditional: 請介紹一下這個產品的特點。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng jièshào yíxià zhège chǎnpǐn de tèdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Please introduce the features of this product.

sentences.chinese: 他手里提着一个袋子。
sentences.traditional: 他手裡提著一個袋子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu li tí zhe yí ge dàizi.
sentences.translation: He is carrying a bag in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 老师在课堂上提了一个问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師在課堂上提了一個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài kètáng shang tí le yí ge wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher raised a question in class.

sentences.chinese: 别再提这件伤心事了。
sentences.traditional: 別再提這件傷心事了。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zài tí zhè jiàn shāngxīn shì le.
sentences.translation: Do not bring up this sad matter again.

sentences.chinese: 他提出了一个新的想法。
sentences.traditional: 他提出了一個新的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tíchū le yí ge xīn de xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: He put forward a new idea.

sentences.chinese: 如果有问题，可以直接提出。
sentences.traditional: 如果有問題，可以直接提出。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu wèntí, kěyǐ zhíjiē tíchū.
sentences.translation: If there is a problem, you can raise it directly.

sentences.chinese: 经理提出要提前完成任务。
sentences.traditional: 經理提出要提前完成任務。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ tíchū yào tíqián wánchéng rènwu.
sentences.translation: The manager proposed completing the task ahead of time.

sentences.chinese: 他在日记里提到了这次旅行。
sentences.traditional: 他在日記裡提到了這次旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài rìjì li tídào le zhè cì lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: He mentioned this trip in his diary.

sentences.chinese: 你刚才提到的原因很重要。
sentences.traditional: 你剛才提到的原因很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ gāngcái tídào de yuányīn hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: The reason you just mentioned is very important.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有提到考试日期。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有提到考試日期。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu tídào kǎoshì rìqī.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not mention the exam date.

sentences.chinese: 旅馆提供免费早餐。
sentences.traditional: 旅館提供免費早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚguǎn tígōng miǎnfèi zǎocān.
sentences.translation: The hotel provides free breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 这个网站提供很多学习资料。
sentences.traditional: 這個網站提供很多學習資料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn tígōng hěn duō xuéxí zīliào.
sentences.translation: This website provides a lot of study materials.

sentences.chinese: 警察为旅客提供帮助。
sentences.traditional: 警察為旅客提供幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá wèi lǚkè tígōng bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: The police provide help to travellers.

sentences.chinese: 请提前十分钟到达。
sentences.traditional: 請提前十分鐘到達。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng tíqián shí fēnzhōng dàodá.
sentences.translation: Please arrive ten minutes early.

sentences.chinese: 因为天气不好，活动提前结束了。
sentences.traditional: 因為天氣不好，活動提前結束了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì bù hǎo, huódòng tíqián jiéshù le.
sentences.translation: Because the weather was bad, the activity ended early.

sentences.chinese: 如果要取消，请提前通知我。
sentences.traditional: 如果要取消，請提前通知我。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yào qǔxiāo, qǐng tíqián tōngzhī wǒ.
sentences.translation: If you want to cancel, please notify me in advance.

sentences.chinese: 谢谢你的提醒，不然我差点儿忘了开会。
sentences.traditional: 謝謝你的提醒，不然我差點兒忘了開會。
sentences.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de tíxǐng, bùrán wǒ chàdiǎnr wàng le kāihuì.
sentences.translation: Thanks for the reminder, otherwise I almost forgot the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他按时吃药。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他按時吃藥。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā ànshí chī yào.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him to take his medicine on time.

sentences.chinese: 我已经提醒过你很多次了。
sentences.traditional: 我已經提醒過你很多次了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tíxǐng guò nǐ hěn duō cì le.
sentences.translation: I have already reminded you many times.

sentences.chinese: 公司每年都会安排员工体检。
sentences.traditional: 公司每年都會安排員工體檢。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī měinián dōu huì ānpái yuángōng tǐjiǎn.
sentences.translation: The company arranges medical checkups for employees every year.

sentences.chinese: 入学以前，孩子要先体检。
sentences.traditional: 入學以前，孩子要先體檢。
sentences.pinyin: Rùxué yǐqián, háizi yào xiān tǐjiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before starting school, the child has to have a medical checkup first.

sentences.chinese: 他昨天去医院做了体检。
