sentences.traditional: 他昨天去醫院做了體檢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuótiān qù yīyuàn zuò le tǐjiǎn.
sentences.translation: He went to the hospital for a medical checkup yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 孩子的体温已经恢复正常了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子的體溫已經恢復正常了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi de tǐwēn yǐjīng huīfù zhèngcháng le.
sentences.translation: The child’s body temperature has already returned to normal.

sentences.chinese: 护士先给病人量了体温。
sentences.traditional: 護士先給病人量了體溫。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi xiān gěi bìngrén liáng le tǐwēn.
sentences.translation: The nurse first took the patient’s temperature.

sentences.chinese: 如果体温太高，最好马上去看医生。
sentences.traditional: 如果體溫太高，最好馬上去看醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tǐwēn tài gāo, zuìhǎo mǎshàng qù kàn yīshēng.
sentences.translation: If your temperature is too high, it is best to see a doctor at once.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他控制体重。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他控制體重。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā kòngzhì tǐzhòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to control his body weight.

sentences.chinese: 这半年我的体重增加了五公斤。
sentences.traditional: 這半年我的體重增加了五公斤。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bànnián wǒ de tǐzhòng zēngjiā le wǔ gōngjīn.
sentences.translation: My body weight has increased by five kilograms in the past half year.

sentences.chinese: 保持正常体重对身体很重要。
sentences.traditional: 保持正常體重對身體很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎochí zhèngcháng tǐzhòng duì shēntǐ hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Maintaining a normal body weight is very important for health.

sentences.chinese: 请先填写这张表格，再去前台。
sentences.traditional: 請先填寫這張表格，再去前臺。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān tiánxiě zhè zhāng biǎogé, zài qù qiántái.
sentences.translation: Please fill in this form first, then go to the front desk.

sentences.chinese: 报名的时候要认真填写个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 報名的時候要認真填寫個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng de shíhou yào rènzhēn tiánxiě gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: When registering, you need to fill in your personal information carefully.

sentences.chinese: 有不明白的地方可以问工作人员再填写。
sentences.traditional: 有不明白的地方可以問工作人員再填寫。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu bù míngbai de dìfang kěyǐ wèn gōngzuò rényuán zài tiánxiě.
sentences.translation: If there is anything you do not understand, you can ask the staff before filling it in.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作对经验的条件比较高。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作對經驗的條件比較高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò duì jīngyàn de tiáojiàn bǐjiào gāo.
sentences.translation: This job has rather high requirements for experience.

sentences.chinese: 如果条件允许，我们暑假就去旅行。
sentences.traditional: 如果條件允許，我們暑假就去旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tiáojiàn yǔnxǔ, wǒmen shǔjià jiù qù lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: If conditions allow, we will travel during the summer holiday.

sentences.chinese: 学校宿舍的条件比以前好多了。
sentences.traditional: 學校宿舍的條件比以前好多了。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào sùshè de tiáojiàn bǐ yǐqián hǎo duō le.
sentences.translation: The conditions in the school dormitory are much better than before.

sentences.chinese: 我的中文听力还不够好。
sentences.traditional: 我的中文聽力還不夠好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén tīnglì hái bú gòu hǎo.
sentences.translation: My Chinese listening ability is still not good enough.

sentences.chinese: 老师建议我们每天做听力练习。
sentences.traditional: 老師建議我們每天做聽力練習。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiànyì wǒmen měitiān zuò tīnglì liànxí.
sentences.translation: The teacher suggests that we do listening practice every day.

sentences.chinese: 考试的时候，他的听力部分得分最高。
sentences.traditional: 考試的時候，他的聽力部分得分最高。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì de shíhou, tā de tīnglì bùfen défēn zuì gāo.
sentences.translation: In the exam, he scored highest in the listening section.

sentences.chinese: 这位主持人很会跟听众交流。
sentences.traditional: 這位主持人很會跟聽眾交流。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhǔchírén hěn huì gēn tīngzhòng jiāoliú.
sentences.translation: This host is very good at interacting with the audience.

sentences.chinese: 广播节目结束后，很多听众打来电话。
sentences.traditional: 廣播節目結束後，很多聽眾打來電話。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎngbō jiémù jiéshù hòu, hěn duō tīngzhòng dǎ lái diànhuà.
sentences.translation: After the radio programme ended, many listeners phoned in.

sentences.chinese: 他说的话让在场的听众都笑了。
sentences.traditional: 他說的話讓在場的聽眾都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà ràng zàichǎng de tīngzhòng dōu xiào le.
sentences.translation: What he said made all the listeners present laugh.

sentences.chinese: 雨停以后，我们再出去吧。
sentences.traditional: 雨停以後，我們再出去吧。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tíng yǐhòu, wǒmen zài chūqù ba.
sentences.translation: After the rain stops, we can go out again.

sentences.chinese: 车刚停下来，他就打开了门。
sentences.traditional: 車剛停下來，他就打開了門。
sentences.pinyin: Chē gāng tíng xiàlai, tā jiù dǎkāi le mén.
sentences.translation: As soon as the car stopped, he opened the door.

sentences.chinese: 老师一进来，大家就停了下来。
sentences.traditional: 老師一進來，大家就停了下來。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yí jìnlái, dàjiā jiù tíng le xiàlai.
sentences.translation: As soon as the teacher came in, everyone stopped.

sentences.chinese: 这里不能停车，请往前开一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 這裡不能停車，請往前開一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ bù néng tíngchē, qǐng wǎng qián kāi yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: You cannot park here; please drive a little farther forward.

sentences.chinese: 商场地下有专门的停车区。
sentences.traditional: 商場地下有專門的停車區。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngchǎng dìxià yǒu zhuānmén de tíngchē qū.
sentences.translation: There is a special parking area underground in the shopping centre.

sentences.chinese: 他停车以后才上楼。
sentences.traditional: 他停車以後才上樓。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tíngchē yǐhòu cái shàng lóu.
sentences.translation: He went upstairs after parking.

sentences.chinese: 附近新开了一个很大的停车场。
sentences.traditional: 附近新開了一個很大的停車場。
sentences.pinyin: Fùjìn xīn kāi le yí gè hěn dà de tíngchēchǎng.
sentences.translation: A large parking lot has newly opened nearby.

sentences.chinese: 商场门口的停车场周末常常没有位子。
sentences.traditional: 商場門口的停車場週末常常沒有位子。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngchǎng ménkǒu de tíngchēchǎng zhōumò chángcháng méiyǒu wèizi.
sentences.translation: The parking lot at the shopping centre entrance is often full at weekends.

sentences.chinese: 如果你开车来，可以把车停在地下停车场。
sentences.traditional: 如果你開車來，可以把車停在地下停車場。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ kāichē lái, kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng zài dìxià tíngchēchǎng.
sentences.translation: If you drive here, you can park in the underground car park.

sentences.chinese: 医生让他先停止运动，好好休息。
sentences.traditional: 醫生讓他先停止運動，好好休息。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng ràng tā xiān tíngzhǐ yùndòng, hǎohǎo xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The doctor told him to stop exercising for now and have a proper rest.

sentences.chinese: 雨虽然小了，但是比赛还没有停止。
sentences.traditional: 雨雖然小了，但是比賽還沒有停止。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ suīrán xiǎo le, dànshì bǐsài hái méiyǒu tíngzhǐ.
sentences.translation: Although the rain got lighter, the match still has not stopped.

sentences.chinese: 机器突然停止工作，大家都很着急。
sentences.traditional: 機器突然停止工作，大家都很著急。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì tūrán tíngzhǐ gōngzuò, dàjiā dōu hěn zháojí.
sentences.translation: The machine suddenly stopped working, and everyone became anxious.

sentences.chinese: 这条路一直通到海边。
sentences.traditional: 這條路一直通到海邊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yìzhí tōng dào hǎibiān.
sentences.translation: This road goes all the way to the seaside.

sentences.chinese: 电话一直打不通，我只好发短信。
sentences.traditional: 電話一直打不通，我只好發短信。
sentences.pinyin: Diànhuà yìzhí dǎ bu tōng, wǒ zhǐhǎo fā duǎnxìn.
sentences.translation: The phone would not go through, so I had to send a text message.

sentences.chinese: 这个门通后院，你可以从这儿进去。
sentences.traditional: 這個門通後院，你可以從這兒進去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège mén tōng hòuyuàn, nǐ kěyǐ cóng zhèr jìnqù.
sentences.translation: This door leads to the back yard; you can go in from here.

sentences.chinese: 我们要通过这次考试并不容易。
sentences.traditional: 我們要通過這次考試並不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào tōngguò zhè cì kǎoshì bìng bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: It is not easy for us to pass this exam.

sentences.chinese: 这条消息是通过朋友告诉我的。
sentences.traditional: 這條消息是通過朋友告訴我的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiāoxi shì tōngguò péngyou gàosu wǒ de.
sentences.translation: I heard this news through a friend.

sentences.chinese: 只有努力学习，才能通过面试。
sentences.traditional: 只有努力學習，才能通過面試。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nǔlì xuéxí, cáinéng tōngguò miànshì.
sentences.translation: Only by studying hard can you pass the interview.

sentences.chinese: 学校已经通知大家明天放假。
sentences.traditional: 學校已經通知大家明天放假。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yǐjīng tōngzhī dàjiā míngtiān fàngjià.
sentences.translation: The school has already informed everyone that there will be a holiday tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 你收到面试通知了吗？
sentences.traditional: 你收到面試通知了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shōudào miànshì tōngzhī le ma?
sentences.translation: Have you received the interview notice?

sentences.chinese: 如果时间有变化，我会马上通知你。
sentences.traditional: 如果時間有變化，我會馬上通知你。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shíjiān yǒu biànhuà, wǒ huì mǎshàng tōngzhī nǐ.
sentences.translation: If the time changes, I will inform you at once.

sentences.chinese: 这张老照片让我想起了童年。
sentences.traditional: 這張老照片讓我想起了童年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng lǎo zhàopiàn ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ le tóngnián.
sentences.translation: This old photo reminded me of my childhood.

sentences.chinese: 很多人长大以后还会怀念自己的童年。
sentences.traditional: 很多人長大以後還會懷念自己的童年。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén zhǎngdà yǐhòu hái huì huáiniàn zìjǐ de tóngnián.
sentences.translation: Many people still miss their childhood after growing up.

sentences.chinese: 他的童年是在农村度过的。
sentences.traditional: 他的童年是在農村度過的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tóngnián shì zài nóngcūn dùguò de.
sentences.translation: He spent his childhood in the countryside.

sentences.chinese: 这家店卖水果，同时也卖饮料。
sentences.traditional: 這家店賣水果，同時也賣飲料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài shuǐguǒ, tóngshí yě mài yǐnliào.
sentences.translation: This shop sells fruit; at the same time, it also sells drinks.

sentences.chinese: 两个人同时开口，谁也没听清。
sentences.traditional: 兩個人同時開口，誰也沒聽清。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén tóngshí kāikǒu, shuí yě méi tīng qīng.
sentences.translation: Two people spoke at the same time, so nobody heard clearly.

sentences.chinese: 学习语言的时候，要同时练习听和说。
sentences.traditional: 學習語言的時候，要同時練習聽和說。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yǔyán de shíhou, yào tóngshí liànxí tīng hé shuō.
sentences.translation: When learning a language, you need to practise listening and speaking at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题对我来说同样很重要。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題對我來說同樣很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí duì wǒ lái shuō tóngyàng hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This question is equally important to me.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他们来自不同国家，但有同样的想法。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他們來自不同國家，但有同樣的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tāmen láizì bùtóng guójiā, dàn yǒu tóngyàng de xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: Although they come from different countries, they have the same idea.

sentences.chinese: 这两件衣服质量同样好，很难选择。
sentences.traditional: 這兩件衣服質量同樣好，很難選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu zhìliàng tóngyàng hǎo, hěn nán xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: These two pieces of clothing are equally good in quality, so it is hard to choose.

sentences.chinese: 桌子旁边放着一桶水。
sentences.traditional: 桌子旁邊放著一桶水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi pángbiān fàngzhe yì tǒng shuǐ.
sentences.translation: A bucket of water is placed beside the table.

sentences.chinese: 他提着一桶油上楼。
sentences.traditional: 他提著一桶油上樓。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tízhe yì tǒng yóu shàng lóu.
sentences.translation: He carried a bucket of oil upstairs.

sentences.chinese: 门口放着一个红色的桶。
sentences.traditional: 門口放著一個紅色的桶。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu fàngzhe yí gè hóngsè de tǒng.
sentences.translation: There is a red bucket at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 我的头还是有点儿痛。
sentences.traditional: 我的頭還是有點兒痛。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de tóu háishi yǒudiǎnr tòng.
sentences.translation: My head still hurts a bit.

sentences.chinese: 运动以后，他的腿痛得走不动了。
sentences.traditional: 運動以後，他的腿痛得走不動了。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu, tā de tuǐ tòng de zǒu bu dòng le.
sentences.translation: After exercising, his leg hurt so much that he could not walk.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，她心里很痛。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，她心裡很痛。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā xīnli hěn tòng.
sentences.translation: Hearing this news, she felt great pain in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 我昨天晚上没睡好，今天一直头痛。
sentences.traditional: 我昨天晚上沒睡好，今天一直頭痛。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo, jīntiān yìzhí tóutòng.
sentences.translation: I did not sleep well last night, so I have had a headache all day today.

sentences.chinese: 如果你还头痛，就早点儿去医院检查。
sentences.traditional: 如果你還頭痛，就早點兒去醫院檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ hái tóutòng, jiù zǎodiǎnr qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: If you still have a headache, go to the hospital for a check-up early.

sentences.chinese: 他一感冒就容易发烧头痛。
sentences.traditional: 他一感冒就容易發燒頭痛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì gǎnmào jiù róngyì fāshāo tóutòng.
sentences.translation: Whenever he catches a cold, he easily gets a fever and a headache.

sentences.chinese: 这张图画得很清楚，一看就明白了。
sentences.traditional: 這張圖畫得很清楚，一看就明白了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng tú huà de hěn qīngchu, yí kàn jiù míngbai le.
sentences.translation: This diagram is drawn very clearly; you understand it at a glance.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我根据这张图回答问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我根據這張圖回答問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒ gēnjù zhè zhāng tú huídá wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked me to answer the questions based on this diagram.

sentences.chinese: 这幅图表示医院的位置。
sentences.traditional: 這幅圖表示醫院的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú tú biǎoshì yīyuàn de wèizhi.
sentences.translation: This diagram shows the location of the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 我把旅行时拍的图片都发给你了。
sentences.traditional: 我把旅行時拍的圖片都發給你了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ lǚxíng shí pāi de túpiàn dōu fā gěi nǐ le.
sentences.translation: I have sent you all the pictures I took while travelling.

sentences.chinese: 这本书里的图片比文字更有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這本書裡的圖片比文字更有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū lǐ de túpiàn bǐ wénzì gèng yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: The pictures in this book are more interesting than the text.

sentences.chinese: 请先上传身份证图片，再填写信息。
sentences.traditional: 請先上傳身份證圖片，再填寫信息。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān shàngchuán shēnfènzhèng túpiàn, zài tiánxiě xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Please upload an image of your ID card first, then fill in the information.

sentences.chinese: 下过雨以后，地上的土很湿。
sentences.traditional: 下過雨以後，地上的土很濕。
sentences.pinyin: Xià guò yǔ yǐhòu, dìshang de tǔ hěn shī.
sentences.translation: After it has rained, the soil on the ground is very wet.

sentences.chinese: 这种花适合种在比较松的土里。
sentences.traditional: 這種花適合種在比較鬆的土裡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huā shìhé zhòng zài bǐjiào sōng de tǔ lǐ.
sentences.translation: This kind of flower suits being planted in relatively loose soil.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次进城，穿着有点儿土。
sentences.traditional: 他第一次進城，穿著有點兒土。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yí cì jìn chéng, chuānzhe yǒudiǎnr tǔ.
sentences.translation: It was his first time in the city, and he looked a bit rustic.

sentences.chinese: 门太重了，一个人推不开。
sentences.traditional: 門太重了，一個人推不開。
sentences.pinyin: Mén tài zhòng le, yí gè rén tuī bu kāi.
sentences.translation: The door is too heavy; one person cannot push it open.

sentences.chinese: 他轻轻推了我一下，叫我快点走。
sentences.traditional: 他輕輕推了我一下，叫我快點走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngqīng tuī le wǒ yíxià, jiào wǒ kuàidiǎn zǒu.
sentences.translation: He gently pushed me and told me to hurry up.

sentences.chinese: 请把车推到路边，别挡住别人。
sentences.traditional: 請把車推到路邊，別擋住別人。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ chē tuī dào lùbiān, bié dǎngzhù biérén.
sentences.translation: Please push the bike to the roadside and do not block others.

sentences.chinese: 因为天气太差，比赛推迟到了下周。
sentences.traditional: 因為天氣太差，比賽推遲到了下週。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài chà, bǐsài tuīchí dào le xià zhōu.
sentences.translation: Because the weather was too bad, the match was postponed until next week.

sentences.chinese: 会议不能再推迟了，大家都在等结果。
sentences.traditional: 會議不能再推遲了，大家都在等結果。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì bùnéng zài tuīchí le, dàjiā dōu zài děng jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: The meeting cannot be postponed any longer; everyone is waiting for the result.

sentences.chinese: 如果你来不了，我们就把时间推迟一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 如果你來不了，我們就把時間推遲一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ lái bu liǎo, wǒmen jiù bǎ shíjiān tuīchí yìdiǎnr.
sentences.translation: If you cannot come, we will postpone the time a little.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司最近推出了一款新产品。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司最近推出了一款新產品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zuìjìn tuīchū le yì kuǎn xīn chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: This company recently launched a new product.

sentences.chinese: 为了吸引年轻人，他们推出了新的活动。
sentences.traditional: 為了吸引年輕人，他們推出了新的活動。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn niánqīngrén, tāmen tuīchū le xīn de huódòng.
sentences.translation: To attract young people, they introduced a new activity.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影刚推出的时候就很受欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影剛推出的時候就很受歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng gāng tuīchū de shíhou jiù hěn shòu huānyíng.
sentences.translation: This film was very popular as soon as it was released.

sentences.chinese: 进门以前，请先把鞋脱了。
sentences.traditional: 進門以前，請先把鞋脫了。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnmén yǐqián, qǐng xiān bǎ xié tuō le.
sentences.translation: Please take off your shoes before coming in.

sentences.chinese: 天气一热，他就把外套脱下来。
sentences.traditional: 天氣一熱，他就把外套脫下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yí rè, tā jiù bǎ wàitào tuō xiàlai.
sentences.translation: As soon as the weather gets hot, he takes off his coat.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子还不会自己脱衣服。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子還不會自己脫衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi hái bú huì zìjǐ tuō yīfu.
sentences.translation: The child still cannot take off clothes by himself.

sentences.chinese: 天冷了，记得穿厚一点儿的袜子。
sentences.traditional: 天冷了，記得穿厚一點兒的襪子。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, jìde chuān hòu yìdiǎnr de wàzi.
sentences.translation: It is cold, so remember to wear thicker socks.

sentences.chinese: 这双袜子洗过以后有点儿小了。
sentences.traditional: 這雙襪子洗過以後有點兒小了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuāng wàzi xǐ guò yǐhòu yǒudiǎnr xiǎo le.
sentences.translation: This pair of socks became a bit small after being washed.

sentences.chinese: 他找了半天，还是没找到另一只袜子。
sentences.traditional: 他找了半天，還是沒找到另一隻襪子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǎo le bàntiān, háishi méi zhǎodào lìng yì zhī wàzi.
sentences.translation: He searched for ages but still did not find the other sock.

sentences.chinese: 父母外出的时候，他得自己做饭。
sentences.traditional: 父母外出的時候，他得自己做飯。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ wàichū de shíhou, tā děi zìjǐ zuòfàn.
sentences.translation: When his parents go out, he has to cook for himself.

sentences.chinese: 今天风太大，不适合长时间外出。
sentences.traditional: 今天風太大，不適合長時間外出。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān fēng tài dà, bù shìhé cháng shíjiān wàichū.
sentences.translation: The wind is too strong today, so it is not suitable to be out for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他明天要外出旅行，所以今晚先收拾行李。
sentences.traditional: 他明天要外出旅行，所以今晚先收拾行李。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yào wàichū lǚxíng, suǒyǐ jīnwǎn xiān shōushi xíngli.
sentences.translation: He is going out on a trip tomorrow, so he is packing his luggage tonight.

sentences.chinese: 今天天气有点儿冷，出门前别忘了带上外套。
sentences.traditional: 今天天氣有點兒冷，出門前別忘了帶上外套。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, chūmén qián bié wàng le dài shàng wàitào.
sentences.translation: It is a bit cold today, so do not forget to take your coat before going out.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套虽然不贵，但是穿起来很舒服。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套雖然不貴，但是穿起來很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào suīrán bú guì, dànshì chuān qǐlai hěn shūfu.
sentences.translation: Although this coat is not expensive, it is very comfortable to wear.

sentences.chinese: 他把外套脱下来，挂在门口的椅子上。
sentences.traditional: 他把外套脫下來，掛在門口的椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wàitào tuō xiàlai, guà zài ménkǒu de yǐzi shàng.
sentences.translation: He took off his coat and hung it on the chair by the door.

sentences.chinese: 我完全理解你的想法，只是现在还不能决定。
sentences.traditional: 我完全理解你的想法，只是現在還不能決定。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wánquán lǐjiě nǐ de xiǎngfǎ, zhǐshì xiànzài hái bùnéng juédìng.
sentences.translation: I completely understand your idea; it is just that I still cannot decide now.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划完全失败了，我们得重新讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這個計劃完全失敗了，我們得重新討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà wánquán shībài le, wǒmen děi chóngxīn tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This plan failed completely, so we have to discuss it again.

sentences.chinese: 他说得完全对，我没有别的意见。
sentences.traditional: 他說得完全對，我沒有別的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō de wánquán duì, wǒ méiyǒu bié de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: What he said is completely right; I have no other opinion.

sentences.chinese: 时间不早了，大家互相说了晚安就回房间了。
sentences.traditional: 時間不早了，大家互相說了晚安就回房間了。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, dàjiā hùxiāng shuō le wǎn’ān jiù huí fángjiān le.
sentences.translation: It was getting late, and after saying good night to one another everyone went back to their rooms.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈每天睡前都会跟孩子说晚安。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽每天睡前都會跟孩子說晚安。
sentences.pinyin: Māma měitiān shuì qián dōu huì gēn háizi shuō wǎn’ān.
sentences.translation: Every night before sleeping, the mother says good night to the child.

sentences.chinese: 我刚发完晚安短信，手机就没电了。
sentences.traditional: 我剛發完晚安短信，手機就沒電了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gāng fā wán wǎn’ān duǎnxìn, shǒujī jiù méi diàn le.
sentences.translation: I had just finished sending a good-night text when my phone ran out of battery.

sentences.chinese: 我们今天晚餐吃得很简单，只做了两个菜。
sentences.traditional: 我們今天晚餐吃得很簡單，只做了兩個菜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān wǎncān chī de hěn jiǎndān, zhǐ zuò le liǎng gè cài.
sentences.translation: We had a very simple dinner today and only made two dishes.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他晚餐不要吃得太晚。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他晚餐不要吃得太晚。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā wǎncān búyào chī de tài wǎn.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him not to eat dinner too late.

sentences.chinese: 忙了一天以后，全家终于坐下来一起吃晚餐。
sentences.traditional: 忙了一天以後，全家終於坐下來一起吃晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Máng le yì tiān yǐhòu, quánjiā zhōngyú zuò xialai yìqǐ chī wǎncān.
sentences.translation: After a busy day, the whole family finally sat down to have dinner together.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多人习惯在网上网购日常用品。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多人習慣在網上網購日常用品。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén xíguàn zài wǎngshàng wǎnggòu rìcháng yòngpǐn.
sentences.translation: Nowadays many people are used to shopping online for daily necessities.

sentences.chinese: 这家店虽然没有实体店，但是网购评价很好。
sentences.traditional: 這家店雖然沒有實體店，但是網購評價很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn suīrán méiyǒu shítǐdiàn, dànshì wǎnggòu píngjià hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although this shop has no physical store, its online-shopping reviews are very good.

sentences.chinese: 你网购的时候要先看清楚退换货规定。
sentences.traditional: 你網購的時候要先看清楚退換貨規定。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ wǎnggòu de shíhou yào xiān kàn qīngchu tuìhuànhuò guīdìng.
sentences.translation: When shopping online, you should first read the return and exchange rules carefully.

sentences.chinese: 经验丰富的人往往能更快发现问题。
sentences.traditional: 經驗豐富的人往往能更快發現問題。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngyàn fēngfù de rén wǎngwǎng néng gèng kuài fāxiàn wèntí.
sentences.translation: People with rich experience can often spot problems more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他表面上很安静，心里往往想得很多。
sentences.traditional: 他表面上很安靜，心裡往往想得很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biǎomiàn shang hěn ānjìng, xīnli wǎngwǎng xiǎng de hěn duō.
sentences.translation: He looks calm on the surface, but often thinks a lot inside.

sentences.chinese: 越是简单的错误，往往越容易被忽视。
sentences.traditional: 越是簡單的錯誤，往往越容易被忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Yuè shì jiǎndān de cuòwù, wǎngwǎng yuè róngyì bèi hūshì.
sentences.translation: The simpler the mistake is, the more often it is overlooked.

sentences.chinese: 这个网页打开得太慢了，我等了半天。
sentences.traditional: 這個網頁打開得太慢了，我等了半天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngyè dǎkāi de tài màn le, wǒ děng le bàntiān.
sentences.translation: This webpage opens far too slowly; I waited for ages.

sentences.chinese: 请把报名网页的链接发给我一下。
sentences.traditional: 請把報名網頁的鏈接發給我一下。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ bàomíng wǎngyè de liánjié fā gěi wǒ yíxià.
sentences.translation: Please send me the link to the registration webpage.

sentences.chinese: 如果网页内容太多，手机上看起来会不方便。
sentences.traditional: 如果網頁內容太多，手機上看起來會不方便。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǎngyè nèiróng tài duō, shǒujī shang kàn qǐlai huì bù fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: If a webpage has too much content, it can be inconvenient to view on a mobile phone.

sentences.chinese: 我虽然没见过那位网友，但是我们聊过很多次。
sentences.traditional: 我雖然沒見過那位網友，但是我們聊過很多次。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ suīrán méi jiànguo nà wèi wǎngyǒu, dànshì wǒmen liáo guo hěn duō cì.
sentences.translation: Although I have not met that online friend, we have chatted many times.

sentences.chinese: 她在旅行论坛上认识了几个很热心的网友。
sentences.traditional: 她在旅行論壇上認識了幾個很熱心的網友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài lǚxíng lùntán shang rènshi le jǐ gè hěn rèxīn de wǎngyǒu.
sentences.translation: She met several very helpful netizens on a travel forum.

sentences.chinese: 跟网友见面以前，最好先告诉家人你要去哪里。
sentences.traditional: 跟網友見面以前，最好先告訴家人你要去哪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Gēn wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn yǐqián, zuìhǎo xiān gàosu jiārén nǐ yào qù nǎli.
sentences.translation: Before meeting an online friend, it is best to tell your family where you are going.

sentences.chinese: 请把公司官网的网址发到我的邮箱里。
sentences.traditional: 請把公司官網的網址發到我的郵箱裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ gōngsī guānwǎng de wǎngzhǐ fā dào wǒ de yóuxiāng lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please send the URL of the company’s official website to my email.

sentences.chinese: 这个网址太长了，我总是记不住。
sentences.traditional: 這個網址太長了，我總是記不住。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhǐ tài cháng le, wǒ zǒngshì jì bu zhù.
sentences.translation: This web address is too long; I can never remember it.

sentences.chinese: 输入网址以后，网页还是打不开。
sentences.traditional: 輸入網址以後，網頁還是打不開。
sentences.pinyin: Shūrù wǎngzhǐ yǐhòu, wǎngyè háishi dǎ bu kāi.
sentences.translation: Even after entering the web address, the webpage still would not open.

sentences.chinese: 这里晚上一个人走路不太安全，也比较危险。
sentences.traditional: 這裡晚上一個人走路不太安全，也比較危險。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ wǎnshang yí gè rén zǒulù bù tài ānquán, yě bǐjiào wēixiǎn.
sentences.translation: It is not very safe to walk here alone at night, and it is rather dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 医生说他的情况不算危险，但是要多休息。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說他的情況不算危險，但是要多休息。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā de qíngkuàng bú suàn wēixiǎn, dànshì yào duō xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The doctor said his condition was not dangerous, but he still needs more rest.

sentences.chinese: 在马路中间玩手机是很危险的。
sentences.traditional: 在馬路中間玩手機是很危險的。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mǎlù zhōngjiān wán shǒujī shì hěn wēixiǎn de.
sentences.translation: Playing with your phone in the middle of the road is very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他一直以帮助别人为自己的责任。
sentences.traditional: 他一直以幫助別人為自己的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìzhí yǐ bāngzhù biérén wéi zìjǐ de zérèn.
sentences.translation: He has always regarded helping others as his own responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 学校选他为新一年的学生代表。
sentences.traditional: 學校選他為新一年的學生代表。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xuǎn tā wéi xīn yì nián de xuéshēng dàibiǎo.
sentences.translation: The school chose him as the student representative for the new year.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司以质量为最重要的标准。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司以質量為最重要的標準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǐ zhìliàng wéi zuì zhòngyào de biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: This company regards quality as the most important standard.

sentences.chinese: 这个汤的味太淡了，你可以再放一点盐。
sentences.traditional: 這個湯的味太淡了，你可以再放一點鹽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tāng de wèi tài dàn le, nǐ kěyǐ zài fàng yìdiǎn yán.
sentences.translation: The flavour of this soup is too light; you can add a bit more salt.

sentences.chinese: 这种水果的味有点特别，不是每个人都喜欢。
sentences.traditional: 這種水果的味有點特別，不是每個人都喜歡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ de wèi yǒudiǎn tèbié, bú shì měi gè rén dōu xǐhuan.
sentences.translation: The taste of this fruit is a bit unusual, and not everyone likes it.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候不喜欢中药的味，所以每次都皱眉。
sentences.traditional: 他小時候不喜歡中藥的味，所以每次都皺眉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou bù xǐhuan zhōngyào de wèi, suǒyǐ měi cì dōu zhòuméi.
sentences.translation: When he was little, he disliked the taste of Chinese medicine, so he frowned every time.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的面味道不错，所以常常排队。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的麵味道不錯，所以常常排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de miàn wèidào búcuò, suǒyǐ chángcháng páiduì.
sentences.translation: The noodles at this shop taste good, so there is often a queue.

sentences.chinese: 厨房里传来面包的味道，大家都饿了。
sentences.traditional: 廚房裡傳來麵包的味道，大家都餓了。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfáng lǐ chuánlái miànbāo de wèidào, dàjiā dōu è le.
sentences.translation: The smell of bread came from the kitchen, and everyone became hungry.

sentences.chinese: 药的味道太苦了，孩子不肯喝。
sentences.traditional: 藥的味道太苦了，孩子不肯喝。
sentences.pinyin: Yào de wèidào tài kǔ le, háizi bù kěn hē.
sentences.translation: The medicine tastes too bitter, and the child refuses to drink it.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒我们，饭前洗手对卫生很重要。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒我們，飯前洗手對衛生很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒmen, fàn qián xǐshǒu duì wèishēng hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded us that washing hands before meals is very important for hygiene.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅看起来很卫生，我们就在这里吃吧。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳看起來很衛生，我們就在這裡吃吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng kàn qǐlai hěn wèishēng, wǒmen jiù zài zhèlǐ chī ba.
sentences.translation: This restaurant looks very clean, so let us eat here.

sentences.chinese: 为了保持教室卫生，大家下课后都把垃圾带走。
sentences.traditional: 為了保持教室衛生，大家下課後都把垃圾帶走。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎochí jiàoshì wèishēng, dàjiā xiàkè hòu dōu bǎ lājī dài zǒu.
sentences.translation: To keep the classroom clean, everyone takes their rubbish away after class.

sentences.chinese: 今天的温度比昨天低了很多。
sentences.traditional: 今天的溫度比昨天低了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de wēndù bǐ zuótiān dī le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: Today’s temperature is much lower than yesterday’s.

sentences.chinese: 医生先量了量他的温度，才决定要不要打针。
sentences.traditional: 醫生先量了量他的溫度，才決定要不要打針。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xiān liáng le liáng tā de wēndù, cái juédìng yào búyào dǎzhēn.
sentences.translation: The doctor first took his temperature before deciding whether he needed an injection.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物对温度变化很敏感。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物對溫度變化很敏感。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù duì wēndù biànhuà hěn mǐngǎn.
sentences.translation: This kind of plant is very sensitive to temperature changes.

sentences.chinese: 你先闻一下这杯牛奶，看看有没有坏。
sentences.traditional: 你先聞一下這杯牛奶，看看有沒有壞。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wén yíxià zhè bēi niúnǎi, kànkan yǒu méiyǒu huài.
sentences.translation: Smell this glass of milk first and see whether it has gone bad.

sentences.chinese: 不用看，我闻一下就知道这水果坏了没有。
sentences.traditional: 不用看，我聞一下就知道這水果壞了沒有。
sentences.pinyin: Búyòng kàn, wǒ wén yíxià jiù zhīdao zhè shuǐguǒ huài le méiyǒu.
sentences.translation: There is no need to look; I can tell whether this fruit has gone bad just by smelling it.

sentences.chinese: 他闻了以后，笑着说这花很香。
sentences.traditional: 他聞了以後，笑著說這花很香。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wén le yǐhòu, xiàozhe shuō zhè huā hěn xiāng.
sentences.translation: After smelling it, he smiled and said the flower was very fragrant.

sentences.chinese: 请把这份文件发到我的邮箱里。
sentences.traditional: 請把這份文件發到我的郵箱裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wénjiàn fā dào wǒ de yóuxiāng lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please send this document to my email inbox.

sentences.chinese: 这个文件太大了，手机上打不开。
sentences.traditional: 這個文件太大了，手機上打不開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wénjiàn tài dà le, shǒujī shang dǎ bu kāi.
sentences.translation: This file is too large to open on a mobile phone.

sentences.chinese: 开会以前，经理已经看过所有文件了。
sentences.traditional: 開會以前，經理已經看過所有文件了。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì yǐqián, jīnglǐ yǐjīng kàn guo suǒyǒu wénjiàn le.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting, the manager had already looked through all the documents.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章不长，但是写得很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章不長，但是寫得很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng bù cháng, dànshì xiě de hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This article is not long, but it is written in a very interesting way.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们先读文章，再回答问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們先讀文章，再回答問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiān dú wénzhāng, zài huídá wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher told us to read the article first and then answer the questions.

sentences.chinese: 他把自己的旅行经历写成了一篇文章。
sentences.traditional: 他把自己的旅行經歷寫成了一篇文章。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ de lǚxíng jīnglì xiě chéng le yì piān wénzhāng.
sentences.translation: He turned his travel experience into an article.

sentences.chinese: 我看得懂这些汉字，但是不太会用文字表达。
sentences.traditional: 我看得懂這些漢字，但是不太會用文字表達。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn de dǒng zhèxiē hànzì, dànshì bú tài huì yòng wénzì biǎodá.
sentences.translation: I can understand these Chinese characters, but I am not very good at expressing myself in writing.

sentences.chinese: 图片下面有一小段说明文字。
sentences.traditional: 圖片下面有一小段說明文字。
sentences.pinyin: Túpiàn xiàmiàn yǒu yí xiǎo duàn shuōmíng wénzì.
sentences.translation: There is a short explanatory text below the picture.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，文字不能完全表达一个人的感受。
sentences.traditional: 有時候，文字不能完全表達一個人的感受。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou, wénzì bùnéng wánquán biǎodá yí gè rén de gǎnshòu.
sentences.translation: Sometimes words cannot fully express a person’s feelings.

sentences.chinese: 这条河以前很干净，现在却被工厂污染了。
sentences.traditional: 這條河以前很乾淨，現在卻被工廠污染了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé yǐqián hěn gānjìng, xiànzài què bèi gōngchǎng wūrǎn le.
sentences.translation: This river used to be very clean, but now it has been polluted by factories.

sentences.chinese: 空气污染严重的时候，最好少出门。
sentences.traditional: 空氣污染嚴重的時候，最好少出門。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngqì wūrǎn yánzhòng de shíhou, zuìhǎo shǎo chūmén.
sentences.translation: When air pollution is severe, it is best to go out less.

sentences.chinese: 不要把垃圾扔进海里，这样会污染环境。
sentences.traditional: 不要把垃圾扔進海裡，這樣會污染環境。
sentences.pinyin: Búyào bǎ lājī rēng jìn hǎi lǐ, zhèyàng huì wūrǎn huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Do not throw rubbish into the sea; that will pollute the environment.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告无错误，可以直接发给客户。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告無錯誤，可以直接發給客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào wú cuòwù, kěyǐ zhíjiē fā gěi kèhù.
sentences.translation: This report has no errors and can be sent directly to the client.

sentences.chinese: 山里无网络，所以我们两天没有回消息。
sentences.traditional: 山裡無網絡，所以我們兩天沒有回消息。
sentences.pinyin: Shān lǐ wú wǎngluò, suǒyǐ wǒmen liǎng tiān méiyǒu huí xiāoxi.
sentences.translation: There was no internet in the mountains, so we did not reply to messages for two days.

sentences.chinese: 他的话并无恶意，你别想太多。
sentences.traditional: 他的話並無惡意，你別想太多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huà bìng wú èyì, nǐ bié xiǎng tài duō.
sentences.translation: His words meant no harm, so do not overthink it.

sentences.chinese: 因为系统出了问题，我们暂时无法付款。
sentences.traditional: 因為系統出了問題，我們暫時無法付款。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi xìtǒng chū le wèntí, wǒmen zànshí wúfǎ fùkuǎn.
sentences.translation: Because the system had a problem, we were temporarily unable to pay.

sentences.chinese: 他腿受伤了，今天无法参加比赛。
sentences.traditional: 他腿受傷了，今天無法參加比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuǐ shòushāng le, jīntiān wúfǎ cānjiā bǐsài.
sentences.translation: His leg is injured, so he cannot take part in the competition today.

sentences.chinese: 这件事太复杂，我一个人无法决定。
sentences.traditional: 這件事太複雜，我一個人無法決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tài fùzá, wǒ yí gè rén wúfǎ juédìng.
sentences.translation: This matter is too complicated; I cannot decide it on my own.

sentences.chinese: 周末一个人在家太无聊了，我想出去走走。
sentences.traditional: 週末一個人在家太無聊了，我想出去走走。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò yí gè rén zài jiā tài wúliáo le, wǒ xiǎng chūqù zǒuzou.
sentences.translation: It is too boring to stay home alone at the weekend, so I want to go out for a walk.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影前面有点无聊，但是后面越来越精彩。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影前面有點無聊，但是後面越來越精彩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng qiánmiàn yǒudiǎn wúliáo, dànshì hòumiàn yuèláiyuè jīngcǎi.
sentences.translation: The first part of this film is a bit dull, but it becomes more and more exciting later.

sentences.chinese: 等车的时候，她拿出手机看新闻，免得觉得无聊。
sentences.traditional: 等車的時候，她拿出手機看新聞，免得覺得無聊。
sentences.pinyin: Děng chē de shíhou, tā ná chū shǒujī kàn xīnwén, miǎnde juéde wúliáo.
sentences.translation: While waiting for the bus, she took out her phone to read the news so that she would not feel bored.

sentences.chinese: 无论你做什么决定，我都会支持你。
sentences.traditional: 無論你做什麼決定，我都會支持你。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ zuò shénme juédìng, wǒ dōu huì zhīchí nǐ.
sentences.translation: No matter what decision you make, I will support you.

sentences.chinese: 无论天气多冷，他每天早上都出去跑步。
sentences.traditional: 無論天氣多冷，他每天早上都出去跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn tiānqì duō lěng, tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu chūqù pǎobù.
sentences.translation: No matter how cold the weather is, he goes out running every morning.

sentences.chinese: 无论结果怎么样，我们都要认真准备。
sentences.traditional: 無論結果怎麼樣，我們都要認真準備。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng, wǒmen dōu yào rènzhēn zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: No matter what the result is, we must prepare seriously.

sentences.chinese: 公司附近新开了一家店，我们中午去那里吃午餐吧。
sentences.traditional: 公司附近新開了一家店，我們中午去那裡吃午餐吧。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī fùjìn xīn kāi le yì jiā diàn, wǒmen zhōngwǔ qù nàlǐ chī wǔcān ba.
sentences.translation: A new shop has opened near the office; let us go there for lunch at noon.

sentences.chinese: 为了省时间，他常常在办公室里简单吃午餐。
sentences.traditional: 為了省時間，他常常在辦公室裡簡單吃午餐。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shěng shíjiān, tā chángcháng zài bàngōngshì lǐ jiǎndān chī wǔcān.
sentences.translation: To save time, he often has a simple lunch in the office.

sentences.chinese: 这家学校给学生提供免费的午餐。
sentences.traditional: 這家學校給學生提供免費的午餐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xuéxiào gěi xuéshēng tígōng miǎnfèi de wǔcān.
sentences.translation: This school provides free lunches for students.

sentences.chinese: 你别生气，这只是一个误会。
sentences.traditional: 你別生氣，這只是一個誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié shēngqì, zhè zhǐshì yí gè wùhuì.
sentences.translation: Do not be angry; this is only a misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 我以前误会过他，现在才知道他是好人。
sentences.traditional: 我以前誤會過他，現在才知道他是好人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián wùhuì guo tā, xiànzài cái zhīdao tā shì hǎorén.
sentences.translation: I misunderstood him before; only now do I know he is a good person.

sentences.chinese: 因为一句话没说清楚，他们之间产生了误会。
sentences.traditional: 因為一句話沒說清楚，他們之間產生了誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi yí jù huà méi shuō qīngchu, tāmen zhījiān chǎnshēng le wùhuì.
sentences.translation: Because one sentence was not explained clearly, a misunderstanding arose between them.

sentences.chinese: 这块海绵吸水很快，擦桌子很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這塊海綿吸水很快，擦桌子很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài hǎimián xī shuǐ hěn kuài, cā zhuōzi hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This sponge absorbs water quickly, so it is convenient for wiping the table.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有人抽烟，我不想再吸二手烟了。
sentences.traditional: 房間裡有人抽煙，我不想再吸二手煙了。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒurén chōuyān, wǒ bù xiǎng zài xī èrshǒuyān le.
sentences.translation: Someone is smoking in the room, and I do not want to breathe in second-hand smoke anymore.

sentences.chinese: 她深深吸了一口气，才开始讲话。
sentences.traditional: 她深深吸了一口氣，才開始講話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēnshēn xī le yì kǒu qì, cái kāishǐ jiǎnghuà.
sentences.translation: She took a deep breath before she started speaking.

sentences.chinese: 中国西部有很多美丽的自然风景。
sentences.traditional: 中國西部有很多美麗的自然風景。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó xībù yǒu hěn duō měilì de zìrán fēngjǐng.
sentences.translation: Western China has a lot of beautiful natural scenery.

sentences.chinese: 他大学毕业以后去了西部工作两年。
sentences.traditional: 他大學畢業以後去了西部工作兩年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè yǐhòu qù le xībù gōngzuò liǎng nián.
sentences.translation: After graduating from university, he went to the western region to work for two years.

sentences.chinese: 今年夏天，我们打算去法国西部旅行。
sentences.traditional: 今年夏天，我們打算去法國西部旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián xiàtiān, wǒmen dǎsuàn qù Fǎguó xībù lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: This summer, we plan to travel to western France.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈买了几个西红柿，准备晚上做面。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽買了幾個西紅柿，準備晚上做麵。
sentences.pinyin: Māma mǎi le jǐ gè xīhóngshì, zhǔnbèi wǎnshang zuò miàn.
sentences.translation: Mum bought a few tomatoes and plans to make noodles tonight.

sentences.chinese: 这种西红柿又红又甜，孩子很喜欢吃。
sentences.traditional: 這種西紅柿又紅又甜，孩子很喜歡吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīhóngshì yòu hóng yòu tián, háizi hěn xǐhuan chī.
sentences.translation: This kind of tomato is red and sweet, and the child likes eating it.

sentences.chinese: 菜市场的西红柿今天比昨天便宜一点。
sentences.traditional: 菜市場的西紅柿今天比昨天便宜一點。
sentences.pinyin: Cài shìchǎng de xīhóngshì jīntiān bǐ zuótiān piányi yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Tomatoes at the market are a bit cheaper today than yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 这家书店安静又舒服，吸引了很多年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 這家書店安靜又舒服，吸引了很多年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā shūdiàn ānjìng yòu shūfu, xīyǐn le hěn duō niánqīngrén.
sentences.translation: This bookshop is quiet and comfortable, and it has attracted many young people.

sentences.chinese: 广告做得很特别，很容易吸引顾客的注意。
sentences.traditional: 廣告做得很特別，很容易吸引顧客的注意。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnggào zuò de hěn tèbié, hěn róngyì xīyǐn gùkè de zhùyì.
sentences.translation: The advertisement is very distinctive and easily attracts customers’ attention.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城的历史和文化一直吸引着游客。
sentences.traditional: 這座古城的歷史和文化一直吸引著遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng de lìshǐ hé wénhuà yìzhí xīyǐn zhe yóukè.
sentences.translation: The history and culture of this old city have always attracted visitors.

sentences.chinese: 这支笔写出来的字很细，不太适合老人用。
sentences.traditional: 這支筆寫出來的字很細，不太適合老人用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ xiě chūlái de zì hěn xì, bù tài shìhé lǎorén yòng.
sentences.translation: The writing from this pen is very fine, so it is not very suitable for older people.

sentences.chinese: 这条围巾太细了，冬天戴可能不够暖和。
sentences.traditional: 這條圍巾太細了，冬天戴可能不夠暖和。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo wéijīn tài xì le, dōngtiān dài kěnéng bù gòu nuǎnhuo.
sentences.translation: This scarf is too thin, so it may not be warm enough in winter.

sentences.chinese: 做这种手工活儿的时候，线越细越难操作。
sentences.traditional: 做這種手工活兒的時候，線越細越難操作。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò zhè zhǒng shǒugōnghuór de shíhou, xiàn yuè xì yuè nán cāozuò.
sentences.translation: When doing this kind of handicraft, the finer the thread is, the harder it is to handle.

sentences.chinese: 她做事很细心，所以很少出错。
sentences.traditional: 她做事很細心，所以很少出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn xìxīn, suǒyǐ hěn shǎo chūcuò.
sentences.translation: She does things carefully, so she rarely makes mistakes.

sentences.chinese: 你再细心一点，就不会把名字写错了。
sentences.traditional: 你再細心一點，就不會把名字寫錯了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zài xìxīn yìdiǎn, jiù bú huì bǎ míngzi xiě cuò le.
sentences.translation: If you are a little more careful, you will not write the name wrongly.

sentences.chinese: 护士很细心，一直提醒我们按时吃药。
sentences.traditional: 護士很細心，一直提醒我們按時吃藥。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi hěn xìxīn, yìzhí tíxǐng wǒmen ànshí chī yào.
sentences.translation: The nurse was very attentive and kept reminding us to take the medicine on time.

sentences.chinese: 这几天的气温明显下降了。
sentences.traditional: 這幾天的氣溫明顯下降了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān de qìwēn míngxiǎn xiàjiàng le.
sentences.translation: The temperature has dropped noticeably these past few days.

sentences.chinese: 因为下雨，今天来参观的人数下降了。
sentences.traditional: 因為下雨，今天來參觀的人數下降了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, jīntiān lái cānguān de rénshù xiàjiàng le.
sentences.translation: Because of the rain, the number of visitors today has gone down.

sentences.chinese: 如果质量下降，顾客就不会再买了。
sentences.traditional: 如果質量下降，顧客就不會再買了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhìliàng xiàjiàng, gùkè jiù bú huì zài mǎi le.
sentences.translation: If the quality declines, customers will not buy again.

sentences.chinese: 这种鱼很鲜，清蒸最好吃。
sentences.traditional: 這種魚很鮮，清蒸最好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yú hěn xiān, qīngzhēng zuì hǎochī.
sentences.translation: This kind of fish is very fresh, and it tastes best steamed.

sentences.chinese: 菜市场的菜都很鲜，看起来不错。
sentences.traditional: 菜市場的菜都很鮮，看起來不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Cài shìchǎng de cài dōu hěn xiān, kàn qǐlái búcuò.
sentences.translation: The vegetables at the market are all fresh and look quite good.

sentences.chinese: 刚买回来的草莓很鲜，今天就吃掉吧。
sentences.traditional: 剛買回來的草莓很鮮，今天就吃掉吧。
sentences.pinyin: Gāng mǎi huílái de cǎoméi hěn xiān, jīntiān jiù chī diào ba.
sentences.translation: The strawberries we just bought are very fresh, so let us eat them today.

sentences.chinese: 她生日那天，办公室里摆满了鲜花。
sentences.traditional: 她生日那天，辦公室裡擺滿了鮮花。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēngrì nà tiān, bàngōngshì lǐ bǎi mǎn le xiānhuā.
sentences.translation: On her birthday, the office was filled with fresh flowers.

sentences.chinese: 这家花店的鲜花比网上的更新鲜。
sentences.traditional: 這家花店的鮮花比網上的更新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā huādiàn de xiānhuā bǐ wǎngshàng de gèng xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: The flowers in this flower shop are fresher than the ones online.

sentences.chinese: 看望病人时，很多人会带一束鲜花。
sentences.traditional: 看望病人時，很多人會帶一束鮮花。
sentences.pinyin: Kànwàng bìngrén shí, hěn duō rén huì dài yí shù xiānhuā.
sentences.translation: When visiting a patient, many people bring a bunch of fresh flowers.

sentences.chinese: 这个汤有点儿咸，你少喝一点吧。
sentences.traditional: 這個湯有點兒鹹，你少喝一點吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tāng yǒudiǎnr xián, nǐ shǎo hē yìdiǎn ba.
sentences.translation: This soup is a bit salty, so drink a little less of it.

sentences.chinese: 医生说我不能吃太咸的东西。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說我不能吃太鹹的東西。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ bùnéng chī tài xián de dōngxi.
sentences.translation: The doctor said I cannot eat things that are too salty.

sentences.chinese: 如果菜太咸，可以加一点热水。
sentences.traditional: 如果菜太鹹，可以加一點熱水。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ cài tài xián, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn rèshuǐ.
sentences.translation: If the dish is too salty, you can add a little hot water.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店只收现金，不支持刷卡。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店只收現金，不支持刷卡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎodiàn zhǐ shōu xiànjīn, bù zhīchí shuākǎ.
sentences.translation: This small shop only accepts cash and does not support card payments.

sentences.chinese: 我身上没有现金，只能用手机付款。
sentences.traditional: 我身上沒有現金，只能用手機付款。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shēnshang méi yǒu xiànjīn, zhǐ néng yòng shǒujī fùkuǎn.
sentences.translation: I do not have any cash on me, so I can only pay by phone.

sentences.chinese: 你先把现金准备好，到了那里再交。
sentences.traditional: 你先把現金準備好，到了那裡再交。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ xiànjīn zhǔnbèi hǎo, dào le nàli zài jiāo.
sentences.translation: Prepare the cash first, then hand it over when you get there.

sentences.chinese: 我很羡慕他能一边工作一边旅行。
sentences.traditional: 我很羨慕他能一邊工作一邊旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiànmù tā néng yìbiān gōngzuò yìbiān lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: I really envy him for being able to work while travelling.

sentences.chinese: 别总羡慕别人，先把自己的生活过好。
sentences.traditional: 別總羨慕別人，先把自己的生活過好。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zǒng xiànmù biérén, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de shēnghuó guò hǎo.
sentences.translation: Do not always envy others; first live your own life well.

sentences.chinese: 她一点儿也不羡慕明星的生活。
sentences.traditional: 她一點兒也不羨慕明星的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìdiǎnr yě bù xiànmù míngxīng de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: She does not envy the lives of celebrities at all.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多课程都可以在线上学习。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多課程都可以在線上學習。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō kèchéng dōu kěyǐ zài xiànshàng xuéxí.
sentences.translation: Many courses can now be studied online.

sentences.chinese: 这次会议改成线上举行了。
sentences.traditional: 這次會議改成線上舉行了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì gǎi chéng xiànshàng jǔxíng le.
sentences.translation: This meeting has been changed to take place online.

sentences.chinese: 如果你没时间到现场，也可以线上参加。
sentences.traditional: 如果你沒時間到現場，也可以線上參加。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ méi shíjiān dào xiànchǎng, yě kěyǐ xiànshàng cānjiā.
sentences.translation: If you do not have time to go there in person, you can also take part online.

sentences.chinese: 这家店线上和线下的价格不一样。
sentences.traditional: 這家店線上和線下的價格不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn xiànshàng hé xiànxià de jiàgé bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: This shop’s online and offline prices are different.

sentences.chinese: 我们先在线上联系，再约时间线下见面。
sentences.traditional: 我們先在線上聯繫，再約時間線下見面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān zài xiànshàng liánxì, zài yuē shíjiān xiànxià jiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: Let us first get in touch online, then arrange a time to meet offline.

sentences.chinese: 有些活动必须线下参加，不能只看直播。
sentences.traditional: 有些活動必須線下參加，不能只看直播。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē huódòng bìxū xiànxià cānjiā, bùnéng zhǐ kàn zhíbō.
sentences.translation: Some activities must be attended offline and cannot be watched only by livestream.

sentences.chinese: 公司会先利用现有资源解决这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 公司會先利用現有資源解決這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī huì xiān lìyòng xiànyǒu zīyuán jiějué zhège wèntí.
sentences.translation: The company will first use the existing resources to solve this problem.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的现有产品已经足够满足一般顾客的需要。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的現有產品已經足夠滿足一般顧客的需要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de xiànyǒu chǎnpǐn yǐjīng zúgòu mǎnzú yìbān gùkè de xūyào.
sentences.translation: The existing products in this shop are already enough to meet the needs of ordinary customers.

sentences.chinese: 根据现有情况，我们暂时不能改变计划。
sentences.traditional: 根據現有情況，我們暫時不能改變計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù xiànyǒu qíngkuàng, wǒmen zànshí bùnéng gǎibiàn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Based on the current situation, we cannot change the plan for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的米饭很香，我吃了两碗。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的米飯很香，我吃了兩碗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de mǐfàn hěn xiāng, wǒ chī le liǎng wǎn.
sentences.translation: The rice in this restaurant is very fragrant, and I ate two bowls.

sentences.chinese: 花园里开满了花，空气闻起来很香。
sentences.traditional: 花園裡開滿了花，空氣聞起來很香。
sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ kāi mǎn le huā, kōngqì wén qǐlái hěn xiāng.
sentences.translation: The garden is full of flowers, and the air smells very fragrant.

sentences.chinese: 刚烤好的面包特别香，大家都想先尝一口。
sentences.traditional: 剛烤好的麵包特別香，大家都想先嘗一口。
sentences.pinyin: Gāng kǎo hǎo de miànbāo tèbié xiāng, dàjiā dōu xiǎng xiān cháng yì kǒu.
sentences.translation: The bread just baked smells especially good, and everyone wants to taste a bite first.

sentences.chinese: 相比以前，现在的交通方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 相比以前，現在的交通方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngbǐ yǐqián, xiànzài de jiāotōng fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: Compared with before, transport is much more convenient now.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒店相比那家更安静一些。
sentences.traditional: 這家酒店相比那家更安靜一些。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn xiāngbǐ nà jiā gèng ānjìng yìxiē.
sentences.translation: Compared with that hotel, this one is a bit quieter.

sentences.chinese: 相比价格，我更在意产品的质量。
sentences.traditional: 相比價格，我更在意產品的質量。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngbǐ jiàgé, wǒ gèng zàiyì chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Compared with the price, I care more about the quality of the product.

sentences.chinese: 我本来以为他会反对，结果相反，他很支持。
sentences.traditional: 我本來以為他會反對，結果相反，他很支持。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tā huì fǎnduì, jiéguǒ xiāngfǎn, tā hěn zhīchí.
sentences.translation: I originally thought he would oppose it; on the contrary, he supports it.

sentences.chinese: 这两种做法的效果正好相反。
sentences.traditional: 這兩種做法的效果正好相反。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng zuòfǎ de xiàoguǒ zhènghǎo xiāngfǎn.
sentences.translation: The effects of these two methods are exactly opposite.

sentences.chinese: 天气预报说会下雨，实际情况却正好相反。
sentences.traditional: 天氣預報說會下雨，實際情況卻正好相反。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō huì xiàyǔ, shíjì qíngkuàng què zhènghǎo xiāngfǎn.
sentences.translation: The weather forecast said it would rain, but the actual situation was just the opposite.

sentences.chinese: 同学之间应该相互帮助。
sentences.traditional: 同學之間應該相互幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Tóngxué zhījiān yīnggāi xiānghù bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: Classmates should help each other.

sentences.chinese: 只有相互理解，大家才能合作得更好。
sentences.traditional: 只有相互理解，大家才能合作得更好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu xiānghù lǐjiě, dàjiā cái néng hézuò de gèng hǎo.
sentences.translation: Only through mutual understanding can everyone cooperate better.

sentences.chinese: 这两个部门平时相互联系很多。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個部門平時相互聯繫很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè bùmén píngshí xiānghù liánxì hěn duō.
sentences.translation: These two departments usually keep in touch with each other a lot.

sentences.chinese: 他们穿着相同的校服，很容易认出来。
sentences.traditional: 他們穿著相同的校服，很容易認出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen chuānzhe xiāngtóng de xiàofú, hěn róngyì rèn chūlái.
sentences.translation: They are wearing the same school uniform, so they are easy to recognise.

sentences.chinese: 虽然名字相同，但是他们不是同一个人。
sentences.traditional: 雖然名字相同，但是他們不是同一個人。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán míngzi xiāngtóng, dànshì tāmen bú shì tóng yí gè rén.
sentences.translation: Although the names are the same, they are not the same person.

sentences.chinese: 这两份报告的内容基本相同。
sentences.traditional: 這兩份報告的內容基本相同。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng fèn bàogào de nèiróng jīběn xiāngtóng.
sentences.translation: The content of these two reports is basically the same.

sentences.chinese: 请你把事情的经过详细说一遍。
sentences.traditional: 請你把事情的經過詳細說一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ shìqing de jīngguò xiángxì shuō yí biàn.
sentences.translation: Please tell the course of events in detail once.

sentences.chinese: 说明书里对安装步骤写得很详细。
sentences.traditional: 說明書裡對安裝步驟寫得很詳細。
sentences.pinyin: Shuōmíngshū lǐ duì ānzhuāng bùzhòu xiě de hěn xiángxì.
sentences.translation: The instruction manual describes the installation steps in great detail.

sentences.chinese: 老师详细回答了学生提出的问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師詳細回答了學生提出的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiángxì huídá le xuésheng tíchū de wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher answered the questions raised by the students in detail.

sentences.chinese: 门铃一响，小狗就跑到门口去了。
sentences.traditional: 門鈴一響，小狗就跑到門口去了。
sentences.pinyin: Ménlíng yì xiǎng, xiǎogǒu jiù pǎo dào ménkǒu qù le.
sentences.translation: As soon as the doorbell rang, the little dog ran to the door.

sentences.chinese: 他的手机一直在响，可能有人找他。
sentences.traditional: 他的手機一直在響，可能有人找他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shǒujī yìzhí zài xiǎng, kěnéng yǒu rén zhǎo tā.
sentences.translation: His phone keeps ringing, and someone may be trying to reach him.

sentences.chinese: 外面突然响起了很大的雷声。
sentences.traditional: 外面突然響起了很大的雷聲。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn tūrán xiǎng qǐ le hěn dà de léishēng.
sentences.translation: A very loud clap of thunder suddenly sounded outside.

sentences.chinese: 你的想法很有意思，我想再听听。
sentences.traditional: 你的想法很有意思，我想再聽聽。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ xiǎng zài tīngting.
sentences.translation: Your idea is very interesting, and I would like to hear more.

sentences.chinese: 大家对这个问题的想法不太一样。
sentences.traditional: 大家對這個問題的想法不太一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā duì zhège wèntí de xiǎngfǎ bù tài yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Everyone’s ideas about this problem are not quite the same.

sentences.chinese: 如果你有更好的想法，可以直接提出来。
sentences.traditional: 如果你有更好的想法，可以直接提出來。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu gèng hǎo de xiǎngfǎ, kěyǐ zhíjiē tí chūlái.
sentences.translation: If you have a better idea, you can bring it up directly.

sentences.chinese: 这项工作比我们想的更复杂。
sentences.traditional: 這項工作比我們想的更複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò bǐ wǒmen xiǎng de gèng fùzá.
sentences.translation: This task is more complicated than we imagined.

sentences.chinese: 这项规定对所有人都一样。
sentences.traditional: 這項規定對所有人都一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng duì suǒyǒu rén dōu yíyàng.
sentences.translation: This rule is the same for everyone.

sentences.chinese: 经理提出了一项新的计划。
sentences.traditional: 經理提出了一項新的計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ tíchū le yí xiàng xīn de jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The manager put forward a new plan.

sentences.chinese: 我刚收到一个好消息，下个月可以休假了。
sentences.traditional: 我剛收到一個好消息，下個月可以休假了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gāng shōudào yí gè hǎo xiāoxi, xià ge yuè kěyǐ xiūjià le.
sentences.translation: I have just received good news: I can take leave next month.

sentences.chinese: 这个消息还没有公开，你先别告诉别人。
sentences.traditional: 這個消息還沒有公開，你先別告訴別人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi hái méiyǒu gōngkāi, nǐ xiān bié gàosu biérén.
sentences.translation: This news has not been made public yet, so do not tell anyone first.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息以后，他马上给家里打了电话。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息以後，他馬上給家裡打了電話。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi yǐhòu, tā mǎshàng gěi jiālǐ dǎ le diànhuà.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news, he immediately called home.

sentences.chinese: 这条街上有很多有名的小吃。
sentences.traditional: 這條街上有很多有名的小吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de xiǎochī.
sentences.translation: There are many famous snacks on this street.

sentences.chinese: 来到这里旅游，一定要尝尝当地的小吃。
sentences.traditional: 來到這裡旅遊，一定要嘗嘗當地的小吃。
sentences.pinyin: Láidào zhèlǐ lǚyóu, yídìng yào chángchang dāngdì de xiǎochī.
sentences.translation: When you travel here, you must try the local snacks.

sentences.chinese: 夜市里的小吃又便宜又好吃。
sentences.traditional: 夜市裡的小吃又便宜又好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ de xiǎochī yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
sentences.translation: The snacks in the night market are cheap and tasty.

sentences.chinese: 那个小伙子看起来很热情，主动来帮我们拿行李。
sentences.traditional: 那個小夥子看起來很熱情，主動來幫我們拿行李。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohuǒzi kàn qǐlái hěn rèqíng, zhǔdòng lái bāng wǒmen ná xíngli.
sentences.translation: That young man looked very warm-hearted and came over to help us carry our luggage.

sentences.chinese: 这个小伙子虽然年纪不大，但是做事很稳重。
sentences.traditional: 這個小夥子雖然年紀不大，但是做事很穩重。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiǎohuǒzi suīrán niánjì bú dà, dànshì zuòshì hěn wěnzhòng.
sentences.translation: Although this young man is not very old, he does things very steadily.

sentences.chinese: 门口站着一个穿黑外套的小伙子。
sentences.traditional: 門口站著一個穿黑外套的小夥子。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu zhànzhe yí gè chuān hēi wàitào de xiǎohuǒzi.
sentences.translation: A young man in a black coat was standing at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 我最近在看一本很有意思的小说。
sentences.traditional: 我最近在看一本很有意思的小說。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn zài kàn yì běn hěn yǒu yìsi de xiǎoshuō.
sentences.translation: I have recently been reading a very interesting novel.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家写的小说很受年轻人欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家寫的小說很受年輕人歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā xiě de xiǎoshuō hěn shòu niánqīngrén huānyíng.
sentences.translation: The novels written by this author are very popular with young people.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影是根据一篇短篇小说改编的。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影是根據一篇短篇小說改編的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì gēnjù yì piān duǎnpiān xiǎoshuō gǎibiān de.
sentences.translation: This film was adapted from a short story.

sentences.chinese: 老师把全班分成了几个学习小组。
sentences.traditional: 老師把全班分成了幾個學習小組。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ quánbān fēnchéng le jǐ gè xuéxí xiǎozǔ.
sentences.translation: The teacher divided the whole class into several study groups.

sentences.chinese: 我们小组已经讨论过这个问题了。
sentences.traditional: 我們小組已經討論過這個問題了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎozǔ yǐjīng tǎolùn guò zhège wèntí le.
sentences.translation: Our group has already discussed this problem.

sentences.chinese: 请各小组派一个代表上来发言。
sentences.traditional: 請各小組派一個代表上來發言。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gè xiǎozǔ pài yí gè dàibiǎo shànglái fāyán.
sentences.translation: Please ask each group to send one representative up to speak.

sentences.chinese: 这种药的效果不错，但是不能马上见效。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥的效果不錯，但是不能馬上見效。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào de xiàoguǒ búcuò, dànshì bùnéng mǎshàng jiànxiào.
sentences.translation: The effect of this medicine is good, but it does not work immediately.

sentences.chinese: 运动一段时间以后，减肥的效果才会更明显。
sentences.traditional: 運動一段時間以後，減肥的效果才會更明顯。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng yí duàn shíjiān yǐhòu, jiǎnféi de xiàoguǒ cái huì gèng míngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Only after exercising for a while will the effect of losing weight become more obvious.

sentences.chinese: 如果方法不对，学习效果就不会太好。
sentences.traditional: 如果方法不對，學習效果就不會太好。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāngfǎ bú duì, xuéxí xiàoguǒ jiù bú huì tài hǎo.
sentences.translation: If the method is wrong, the learning result will not be very good.

sentences.chinese: 他刚讲完那个笑话，大家都笑了。
sentences.traditional: 他剛講完那個笑話，大家都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng jiǎng wán nàge xiàohua, dàjiā dōu xiào le.
sentences.translation: As soon as he finished telling that joke, everyone laughed.

sentences.chinese: 我们不能随便笑话别人。
sentences.traditional: 我們不能隨便笑話別人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bùnéng suíbiàn xiàohua biérén.
sentences.translation: We must not laugh at other people casually.

sentences.chinese: 这个笑话太老了，我以前已经听过了。
sentences.traditional: 這個笑話太老了，我以前已經聽過了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàohua tài lǎo le, wǒ yǐqián yǐjīng tīng guò le.
sentences.translation: This joke is too old; I had already heard it before.

sentences.chinese: 他手上流了很多血，大家都很担心。
sentences.traditional: 他手上流了很多血，大家都很擔心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng liú le hěn duō xiě, dàjiā dōu hěn dānxīn.
sentences.translation: A lot of blood was flowing from his hand, and everyone was worried.

sentences.chinese: 医生先帮他止血，然后再检查伤口。
sentences.traditional: 醫生先幫他止血，然後再檢查傷口。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xiān bāng tā zhǐ xiě, ránhòu zài jiǎnchá shāngkǒu.
sentences.translation: The doctor first stopped the bleeding, then checked the wound.

sentences.chinese: 看到地上的血以后，她一下子脸都白了。
sentences.traditional: 看到地上的血以後，她一下子臉都白了。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào dì shàng de xiě yǐhòu, tā yíxiàzi liǎn dōu bái le.
sentences.translation: After seeing the blood on the ground, her face turned pale at once.

sentences.chinese: 他嘴上没说，其实心里很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 他嘴上沒說，其實心裡很高興。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuǐ shàng méi shuō, qíshí xīn lǐ hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.translation: He did not say it aloud, but in his heart he was very happy.

sentences.chinese: 她的心跳得很快，好像有点紧张。
sentences.traditional: 她的心跳得很快，好像有點緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xīn tiào de hěn kuài, hǎoxiàng yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Her heart was beating very fast, as if she were a little nervous.

sentences.chinese: 做事情的时候，只要用心，就会有进步。
sentences.traditional: 做事情的時候，只要用心，就會有進步。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò shìqing de shíhou, zhǐyào yòng xīn, jiù huì yǒu jìnbù.
sentences.translation: When doing things, as long as you put your heart into them, you will make progress.

sentences.chinese: 这段时间你辛苦了，周末好好休息吧。
sentences.traditional: 這段時間你辛苦了，週末好好休息吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn shíjiān nǐ xīnkǔ le, zhōumò hǎohǎo xiūxi ba.
sentences.translation: You have worked hard these days, so have a good rest at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 虽然准备的过程很辛苦，但是大家都没有放弃。
sentences.traditional: 雖然準備的過程很辛苦，但是大家都沒有放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhǔnbèi de guòchéng hěn xīnkǔ, dànshì dàjiā dōu méiyǒu fàngqì.
sentences.translation: Although the preparation process was hard, nobody gave up.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸每天工作到很晚，真的很辛苦。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸每天工作到很晚，真的很辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba měitiān gōngzuò dào hěn wǎn, zhēnde hěn xīnkǔ.
sentences.translation: Dad works until very late every day; he really works hard.

sentences.chinese: 我今天收到朋友的来信以后，心情好多了。
sentences.traditional: 我今天收到朋友的來信以後，心情好多了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān shōudào péngyou de láixìn yǐhòu, xīnqíng hǎo duō le.
sentences.translation: After receiving my friend's letter today, my mood became much better.

sentences.chinese: 旅行的时候，看到这样的美景，大家的心情都很好。
sentences.traditional: 旅行的時候，看到這樣的美景，大家的心情都很好。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng de shíhou, kàndào zhèyàng de měijǐng, dàjiā de xīnqíng dōu hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: When travelling, seeing scenery like this puts everyone in a very good mood.

sentences.chinese: 她最近工作压力很大，所以心情不太稳定。
sentences.traditional: 她最近工作壓力很大，所以心情不太穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bú tài wěndìng.
sentences.translation: She has been under a lot of pressure at work recently, so her mood is not very stable.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方的手机信号很差，常常打不通电话。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方的手機信號很差，常常打不通電話。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang de shǒujī xìnhào hěn chà, chángcháng dǎ bu tōng diànhuà.
sentences.translation: The mobile signal is very poor here, so calls often cannot get through.

sentences.chinese: 红灯亮了以后，就是停车的信号。
sentences.traditional: 紅燈亮了以後，就是停車的信號。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngdēng liàng le yǐhòu, jiù shì tíngchē de xìnhào.
sentences.translation: Once the red light comes on, that is the signal to stop.

sentences.chinese: 看到老师的手势，我们明白了开始的信号。
sentences.traditional: 看到老師的手勢，我們明白了開始的信號。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào lǎoshī de shǒushì, wǒmen míngbai le kāishǐ de xìnhào.
sentences.translation: Seeing the teacher's hand gesture, we understood it was the signal to begin.

sentences.chinese: 请把会议的时间和地点信息发到群里。
sentences.traditional: 請把會議的時間和地點信息發到群裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ huìyì de shíjiān hé dìdiǎn xìnxī fā dào qún lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please send the information about the meeting time and place to the group chat.

sentences.chinese: 这条信息很重要，你最好马上看一下。
sentences.traditional: 這條信息很重要，你最好馬上看一下。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xìnxī hěn zhòngyào, nǐ zuìhǎo mǎshàng kàn yíxià.
sentences.translation: This message is important; you had better look at it right away.

sentences.chinese: 在网上找工作的时候，要注意保护个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 在網上找工作的時候，要注意保護個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǎngshàng zhǎo gōngzuò de shíhou, yào zhùyì bǎohù gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: When looking for work online, you should pay attention to protecting your personal information.

sentences.chinese: 只要认真准备，你一定会对考试更有信心。
sentences.traditional: 只要認真準備，你一定會對考試更有信心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào rènzhēn zhǔnbèi, nǐ yídìng huì duì kǎoshì gèng yǒu xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: As long as you prepare seriously, you will definitely feel more confident about the exam.

sentences.chinese: 老师的话让他重新有了信心。
sentences.traditional: 老師的話讓他重新有了信心。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de huà ràng tā chóngxīn yǒu le xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: The teacher's words gave him confidence again.

sentences.chinese: 虽然刚开始有点难，但是我对自己很有信心。
sentences.traditional: 雖然剛開始有點難，但是我對自己很有信心。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán gāng kāishǐ yǒudiǎn nán, dànshì wǒ duì zìjǐ hěn yǒu xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: Although it is a bit difficult at the beginning, I am very confident in myself.

sentences.chinese: 听说明天要去旅行，孩子们都很兴奋。
sentences.traditional: 聽說明天要去旅行，孩子們都很興奮。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō míngtiān yào qù lǚxíng, háizimen dōu hěn xīngfèn.
sentences.translation: The children are all very excited because they heard they are going travelling tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次坐飞机，心里又紧张又兴奋。
sentences.traditional: 他第一次坐飛機，心裡又緊張又興奮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yí cì zuò fēijī, xīnlǐ yòu jǐnzhāng yòu xīngfèn.
sentences.translation: It was his first time on a plane, so he felt both nervous and excited.

sentences.chinese: 比赛快开始的时候，大家都兴奋得睡不着。
sentences.traditional: 比賽快開始的時候，大家都興奮得睡不著。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài kuài kāishǐ de shíhou, dàjiā dōu xīngfèn de shuì bu zháo.
sentences.translation: When the match was about to begin, everyone was so excited that they could not sleep.

sentences.chinese: 今晚天气很好，天上的星星特别亮。
sentences.traditional: 今晚天氣很好，天上的星星特別亮。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnwǎn tiānqì hěn hǎo, tiānshang de xīngxing tèbié liàng.
sentences.translation: The weather is very good tonight, and the stars in the sky are especially bright.

sentences.chinese: 小时候，我常常坐在院子里数星星。
sentences.traditional: 小時候，我常常坐在院子裡數星星。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou, wǒ chángcháng zuò zài yuànzi lǐ shǔ xīngxing.
sentences.translation: When I was little, I often sat in the yard and counted the stars.

sentences.chinese: 在没有灯光的地方，可以看到更多的星星。
sentences.traditional: 在沒有燈光的地方，可以看到更多的星星。
sentences.pinyin: Zài méiyǒu dēngguāng de dìfang, kěyǐ kàndào gèng duō de xīngxing.
sentences.translation: In places without lights, you can see more stars.

sentences.chinese: 我今天早上六点就醒了，再也睡不着了。
sentences.traditional: 我今天早上六點就醒了，再也睡不著了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang liù diǎn jiù xǐng le, zài yě shuì bu zháo le.
sentences.translation: I woke up at six this morning and could not get back to sleep.

sentences.chinese: 喝了那杯浓茶以后，我一下子就醒了。
sentences.traditional: 喝了那杯濃茶以後，我一下子就醒了。
sentences.pinyin: Hē le nà bēi nóngchá yǐhòu, wǒ yíxiàzi jiù xǐng le.
sentences.translation: After drinking that strong tea, I woke up at once.

sentences.chinese: 请你到了以后给我打电话，免得我还没醒。
sentences.traditional: 請你到了以後給我打電話，免得我還沒醒。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ dào le yǐhòu gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà, miǎnde wǒ hái méi xǐng.
sentences.translation: Please call me when you arrive, in case I am still not awake.

sentences.chinese: 我们要认真考虑这个计划的可行性。
sentences.traditional: 我們要認真考慮這個計劃的可行性。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào rènzhēn kǎolǜ zhège jìhuà de kěxíngxìng.
sentences.translation: We need to seriously consider the feasibility of this plan.

sentences.chinese: 这次讨论让大家认识到了环保的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 這次討論讓大家認識到了環保的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tǎolùn ràng dàjiā rènshi dào le huánbǎo de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: This discussion made everyone realise the importance of environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 使用这种产品以前，最好先了解它的安全性。
sentences.traditional: 使用這種產品以前，最好先了解它的安全性。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐyòng zhè zhǒng chǎnpǐn yǐqián, zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě tā de ānquánxìng.
sentences.translation: Before using this product, it is best to understand its safety first.

sentences.chinese: 请在表格上填写你的姓名和性别。
sentences.traditional: 請在表格上填寫你的姓名和性別。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé shàng tiánxiě nǐ de xìngmíng hé xìngbié.
sentences.translation: Please fill in your name and gender on the form.

sentences.chinese: 我们招聘员工时，不会因为性别而区别对待。
sentences.traditional: 我們招聘員工時，不會因為性別而區別對待。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhāopìn yuángōng shí, bù huì yīnwèi xìngbié ér qūbié duìdài.
sentences.translation: When hiring staff, we do not treat people differently because of gender.

sentences.chinese: 这个活动欢迎所有年龄和性别的人参加。
sentences.traditional: 這個活動歡迎所有年齡和性別的人參加。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huódòng huānyíng suǒyǒu niánlíng hé xìngbié de rén cānjiā.
sentences.translation: This event welcomes people of all ages and genders.

sentences.chinese: 对很多人来说，家人的健康就是最大的幸福。
sentences.traditional: 對很多人來說，家人的健康就是最大的幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō rén lái shuō, jiārén de jiànkāng jiù shì zuì dà de xìngfú.
sentences.translation: For many people, their family's good health is the greatest happiness.

sentences.chinese: 虽然生活不算富有，但是他们一家人过得很幸福。
sentences.traditional: 雖然生活不算富有，但是他們一家人過得很幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán shēnghuó bú suàn fùyǒu, dànshì tāmen yì jiā rén guò de hěn xìngfú.
sentences.translation: Although they are not wealthy, the whole family lives very happily.

sentences.chinese: 真正的幸福不一定来自金钱，而是来自内心的满足。
sentences.traditional: 真正的幸福不一定來自金錢，而是來自內心的滿足。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de xìngfú bù yídìng láizì jīnqián, érshì láizì nèixīn de mǎnzú.
sentences.translation: True happiness does not necessarily come from money, but from inner contentment.

sentences.chinese: 她的性格很开朗，容易和别人交朋友。
sentences.traditional: 她的性格很開朗，容易和別人交朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xìnggé hěn kāilǎng, róngyì hé biérén jiāo péngyou.
sentences.translation: Her character is very cheerful, so it is easy for her to make friends with others.

sentences.chinese: 每个人的性格都不一样，所以看法也会不同。
sentences.traditional: 每個人的性格都不一樣，所以看法也會不同。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xìnggé dōu bù yíyàng, suǒyǐ kànfǎ yě huì bùtóng.
sentences.translation: Everyone's personality is different, so their views may also differ.

sentences.chinese: 他的性格比较安静，不太喜欢热闹的地方。
sentences.traditional: 他的性格比較安靜，不太喜歡熱鬧的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xìnggé bǐjiào ānjìng, bú tài xǐhuan rènao de dìfang.
sentences.translation: His personality is relatively quiet, and he does not really like lively places.

sentences.chinese: 他们兄弟俩一起经营一家小店。
sentences.traditional: 他們兄弟倆一起經營一家小店。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiōngdì liǎ yìqǐ jīngyíng yì jiā xiǎo diàn.
sentences.translation: The two brothers run a small shop together.

sentences.chinese: 我有一个兄弟在外地工作。
sentences.traditional: 我有一個兄弟在外地工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí gè xiōngdì zài wàidì gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: I have a brother working in another place.

sentences.chinese: 这对兄弟虽然性格不同，但是感情很好。
sentences.traditional: 這對兄弟雖然性格不同，但是感情很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duì xiōngdì suīrán xìnggé bùtóng, dànshì gǎnqíng hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although these two brothers have different personalities, their relationship is very good.

sentences.chinese: 动物园里的那只熊看起来很安静。
sentences.traditional: 動物園裡的那隻熊看起來很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ de nà zhī xióng kàn qǐlái hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: The bear in the zoo looks very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 森林里可能有熊，大家不要一个人进去。
sentences.traditional: 森林裡可能有熊，大家不要一個人進去。
sentences.pinyin: Sēnlín lǐ kěnéng yǒu xióng, dàjiā bú yào yí gè rén jìnqu.
sentences.translation: There may be bears in the forest, so people should not go in alone.

sentences.chinese: 孩子抱着一只小熊玩具不肯放手。
sentences.traditional: 孩子抱著一隻小熊玩具不肯放手。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bàozhe yì zhī xiǎo xióng wánjù bù kěn fàngshǒu.
sentences.translation: The child held a little bear toy and would not let go.

sentences.chinese: 这辆自行车坏了，需要找人修一下。
sentences.traditional: 這輛自行車壞了，需要找人修一下。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng zìxíngchē huài le, xūyào zhǎo rén xiū yíxià.
sentences.translation: This bicycle is broken and needs someone to repair it.

sentences.chinese: 我正在修电脑，可能晚一点回复你。
sentences.traditional: 我正在修電腦，可能晚一點回覆你。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài xiū diànnǎo, kěnéng wǎn yìdiǎn huífù nǐ.
sentences.translation: I am repairing the computer, so I may reply to you a little later.

sentences.chinese: 这条路下个月要修，大家出行要提前安排。
sentences.traditional: 這條路下個月要修，大家出行要提前安排。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù xià ge yuè yào xiū, dàjiā chūxíng yào tíqián ānpái.
sentences.translation: This road will be repaired next month, so everyone should arrange their travel in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这家店可以修理手机和电脑。
sentences.traditional: 這家店可以修理手機和電腦。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn kěyǐ xiūlǐ shǒujī hé diànnǎo.
sentences.translation: This shop can repair mobile phones and computers.

sentences.chinese: 电视坏了，我们请师傅来修理。
sentences.traditional: 電視壞了，我們請師傅來修理。
sentences.pinyin: Diànshì huài le, wǒmen qǐng shīfu lái xiūlǐ.
sentences.translation: The television is broken, so we asked a repairman to fix it.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题不难，下午就能修理好。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題不難，下午就能修理好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bù nán, xiàwǔ jiù néng xiūlǐ hǎo.
sentences.translation: This problem is not difficult; it can be repaired by this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 许多学生都报名参加了这次比赛。
sentences.traditional: 許多學生都報名參加了這次比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō xuéshēng dōu bàomíng cānjiā le zhè cì bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Many students signed up to take part in this competition.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市有许多历史景点。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市有許多歷史景點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu xǔduō lìshǐ jǐngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: This city has many historic scenic spots.

sentences.chinese: 我们在旅行中认识了许多有意思的人。
sentences.traditional: 我們在旅行中認識了許多有意思的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài lǚxíng zhōng rènshi le xǔduō yǒu yìsi de rén.
sentences.translation: We met many interesting people during the trip.

sentences.chinese: 这所学院的学费比我想的高。
sentences.traditional: 這所學院的學費比我想的高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéyuàn de xuéfèi bǐ wǒ xiǎng de gāo.
sentences.translation: The tuition fee at this college is higher than I expected.

sentences.chinese: 如果学费太贵，我可能需要申请奖学金。
sentences.traditional: 如果學費太貴，我可能需要申請獎學金。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xuéfèi tài guì, wǒ kěnéng xūyào shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn.
sentences.translation: If the tuition fee is too expensive, I may need to apply for a scholarship.

sentences.chinese: 父母已经帮他付了今年的学费。
sentences.traditional: 父母已經幫他付了今年的學費。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ yǐjīng bāng tā fù le jīnnián de xuéfèi.
sentences.translation: His parents have already helped him pay this year's tuition fee.

sentences.chinese: 这所学院离市区不远，交通很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這所學院離市區不遠，交通很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéyuàn lí shìqū bù yuǎn, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This college is not far from the city centre, and transport is very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 他高中毕业后，进入了一所语言学院。
sentences.traditional: 他高中畢業後，進入了一所語言學院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāozhōng bìyè hòu, jìnrù le yì suǒ yǔyán xuéyuàn.
sentences.translation: After graduating from high school, he entered a language college.

sentences.chinese: 学院通知学生下周入学。
sentences.traditional: 學院通知學生下週入學。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéyuàn tōngzhī xuéshēng xià zhōu rùxué.
sentences.translation: The college notified the students to enrol next week.

sentences.chinese: 不要用手压伤口，先让医生看看。
sentences.traditional: 不要用手壓傷口，先讓醫生看看。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào yòng shǒu yā shāngkǒu, xiān ràng yīshēng kànkan.
sentences.translation: Do not press the wound with your hand; let the doctor have a look first.

sentences.chinese: 箱子太重，把下面的书压坏了。
sentences.traditional: 箱子太重，把下面的書壓壞了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngzi tài zhòng, bǎ xiàmiàn de shū yā huài le.
sentences.translation: The box was too heavy and crushed the books underneath.

sentences.chinese: 他把文件压在书下面，差点儿忘了。
sentences.traditional: 他把文件壓在書下面，差點兒忘了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wénjiàn yā zài shū xiàmian, chàdiǎnr wàng le.
sentences.translation: He pressed the document under the book and almost forgot about it.

sentences.chinese: 最近工作压力很大，他晚上常常睡不好。
sentences.traditional: 最近工作壓力很大，他晚上常常睡不好。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, tā wǎnshang chángcháng shuì bù hǎo.
sentences.translation: He has been under a lot of work pressure recently and often cannot sleep well at night.

sentences.chinese: 考试前有一点压力是正常的。
sentences.traditional: 考試前有一點壓力是正常的。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì qián yǒu yìdiǎn yālì shì zhèngcháng de.
sentences.translation: It is normal to have a little pressure before an exam.

sentences.chinese: 运动可以帮助我们减轻压力。
sentences.traditional: 運動可以幫助我們減輕壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng kěyǐ bāngzhù wǒmen jiǎnqīng yālì.
sentences.translation: Exercise can help us reduce stress.

sentences.chinese: 出门前，他发现牙膏已经用完了。
sentences.traditional: 出門前，他發現牙膏已經用完了。
sentences.pinyin: Chūmén qián, tā fāxiàn yágāo yǐjīng yòng wán le.
sentences.translation: Before going out, he discovered that the toothpaste had already run out.

sentences.chinese: 这支牙膏味道有点奇怪，我不太喜欢。
sentences.traditional: 這支牙膏味道有點奇怪，我不太喜歡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī yágāo wèidào yǒudiǎn qíguài, wǒ bú tài xǐhuan.
sentences.translation: This tube of toothpaste tastes a bit strange, and I do not really like it.

sentences.chinese: 旅行时别忘了带牙膏和毛巾。
sentences.traditional: 旅行時別忘了帶牙膏和毛巾。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng shí bié wàng le dài yágāo hé máojīn.
sentences.translation: When travelling, do not forget to bring toothpaste and a towel.

sentences.chinese: 亚洲的很多国家都使用不同的文字。
sentences.traditional: 亞洲的很多國家都使用不同的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Yàzhōu de hěn duō guójiā dōu shǐyòng bùtóng de wénzì.
sentences.translation: Many countries in Asia use different writing systems.

sentences.chinese: 他计划毕业后去亚洲旅行一年。
sentences.traditional: 他計劃畢業後去亞洲旅行一年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìhuà bìyè hòu qù Yàzhōu lǚxíng yì nián.
sentences.translation: He plans to travel in Asia for a year after graduating.

sentences.chinese: 这个会议邀请了来自亚洲各地的人员。
sentences.traditional: 這個會議邀請了來自亞洲各地的人員。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huìyì yāoqǐng le láizì Yàzhōu gèdì de rényuán.
sentences.translation: This meeting invited personnel from all over Asia.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有烟，孩子们最好先出去。
sentences.traditional: 房間裡有煙，孩子們最好先出去。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu yān, háizimen zuìhǎo xiān chūqu.
sentences.translation: There is smoke in the room, so the children had better go out first.

sentences.chinese: 饭做好以后，厨房里全是烟。
sentences.traditional: 飯做好以後，廚房裡全是煙。
sentences.pinyin: Fàn zuò hǎo yǐhòu, chúfáng lǐ quán shì yān.
sentences.translation: After the meal was cooked, the kitchen was full of smoke.

sentences.chinese: 这种烟对身体不好，最好不要买。
sentences.traditional: 這種煙對身體不好，最好不要買。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yān duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, zuìhǎo bú yào mǎi.
sentences.translation: This kind of cigarette is bad for your health, so it is best not to buy it.

sentences.chinese: 这个汤盐放多了，喝起来太咸。
sentences.traditional: 這個湯鹽放多了，喝起來太鹹。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tāng yán fàng duō le, hē qǐlái tài xián.
sentences.translation: There is too much salt in this soup; it tastes too salty.

sentences.chinese: 做菜以前，先把盐和油准备好。
sentences.traditional: 做菜以前，先把鹽和油準備好。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò cài yǐqián, xiān bǎ yán hé yóu zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.translation: Before cooking, prepare the salt and oil first.

sentences.chinese: 医生让他少吃盐，对身体好。
sentences.traditional: 醫生讓他少吃鹽，對身體好。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng ràng tā shǎo chī yán, duì shēntǐ hǎo.
sentences.translation: The doctor told him to eat less salt, which is good for his health.

sentences.chinese: 这位老师对学生要求很严格。
sentences.traditional: 這位老師對學生要求很嚴格。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī duì xuéshēng yāoqiú hěn yángé.
sentences.translation: This teacher is very strict with students.

sentences.chinese: 公司有严格的安全规定。
sentences.traditional: 公司有嚴格的安全規定。
