sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yǒu yángé de ānquán guīdìng.
sentences.translation: The company has strict safety rules.

sentences.chinese: 如果管理不够严格，问题会越来越多。
sentences.traditional: 如果管理不夠嚴格，問題會越來越多。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ guǎnlǐ bú gòu yángé, wèntí huì yuè lái yuè duō.
sentences.translation: If management is not strict enough, there will be more and more problems.

sentences.chinese: 他正在研究这个问题的原因。
sentences.traditional: 他正在研究這個問題的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài yánjiū zhège wèntí de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: He is researching the cause of this problem.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要先研究材料，再做判断。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要先研究材料，再做判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào xiān yánjiū cáiliào, zài zuò pànduàn.
sentences.translation: We need to study the materials first and then make a judgement.

sentences.chinese: 这位教授研究中国历史很多年了。
sentences.traditional: 這位教授研究中國歷史很多年了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu yánjiū Zhōngguó lìshǐ hěn duō nián le.
sentences.translation: This professor has studied Chinese history for many years.

sentences.chinese: 她大学毕业后想继续读研究生。
sentences.traditional: 她大學畢業後想繼續讀研究生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè hòu xiǎng jìxù dú yánjiūshēng.
sentences.translation: After graduating from university, she wants to continue and study as a postgraduate.

sentences.chinese: 这位研究生正在帮教授做调查。
sentences.traditional: 這位研究生正在幫教授做調查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yánjiūshēng zhèngzài bāng jiàoshòu zuò diàochá.
sentences.translation: This postgraduate is helping the professor conduct an investigation.

sentences.chinese: 学院给研究生提供了新的课程。
sentences.traditional: 學院給研究生提供了新的課程。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéyuàn gěi yánjiūshēng tígōng le xīn de kèchéng.
sentences.translation: The college provided new courses for postgraduate students.

sentences.chinese: 这次错误很严重，必须马上处理。
sentences.traditional: 這次錯誤很嚴重，必須馬上處理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì cuòwù hěn yánzhòng, bìxū mǎshàng chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: This mistake is serious and must be dealt with immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他受伤不严重，休息几天就好了。
sentences.traditional: 他受傷不嚴重，休息幾天就好了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shòushāng bù yánzhòng, xiūxi jǐ tiān jiù hǎo le.
sentences.translation: His injury is not serious; he will be fine after resting for a few days.

sentences.chinese: 空气污染越来越严重，大家都很担心。
sentences.traditional: 空氣污染越來越嚴重，大家都很擔心。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngqì wūrǎn yuè lái yuè yánzhòng, dàjiā dōu hěn dānxīn.
sentences.translation: Air pollution is becoming more and more serious, and everyone is worried.

sentences.chinese: 他在学校的话剧里演一个医生。
sentences.traditional: 他在學校的話劇裡演一個醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào de huàjù lǐ yǎn yí gè yīshēng.
sentences.translation: He plays a doctor in the school play.

sentences.chinese: 这部电视剧是谁演的？
sentences.traditional: 這部電視劇是誰演的？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànshìjù shì shéi yǎn de?
sentences.translation: Who acts in this TV drama?

sentences.chinese: 她第一次上台演，心里有点紧张。
sentences.traditional: 她第一次上臺演，心裡有點緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yí cì shàng tái yǎn, xīnlǐ yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: It was her first time performing on stage, so she felt a little nervous.

sentences.chinese: 这位歌手今晚会演唱三首新歌。
sentences.traditional: 這位歌手今晚會演唱三首新歌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi gēshǒu jīnwǎn huì yǎnchàng sān shǒu xīn gē.
sentences.translation: This singer will perform three new songs tonight.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在节日活动中演唱了一首歌。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在節日活動中演唱了一首歌。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài jiérì huódòng zhōng yǎnchàng le yì shǒu gē.
sentences.translation: The children sang a song during the festival activity.

sentences.chinese: 他演唱的时候，观众都安静地听着。
sentences.traditional: 他演唱的時候，觀眾都安靜地聽著。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǎnchàng de shíhou, guānzhòng dōu ānjìng de tīngzhe.
sentences.translation: When he was singing, the audience listened quietly.

sentences.chinese: 今晚的演出非常精彩，观众一直在鼓掌。
sentences.traditional: 今晚的演出非常精彩，觀眾一直在鼓掌。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnwǎn de yǎnchū fēicháng jīngcǎi, guānzhòng yìzhí zài gǔzhǎng.
sentences.translation: Tonight's performance was very exciting, and the audience kept applauding.

sentences.chinese: 这场演出提前半小时开始，请大家按时到场。
sentences.traditional: 這場演出提前半小時開始，請大家按時到場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǎnchū tíqián bàn xiǎoshí kāishǐ, qǐng dàjiā ànshí dàochǎng.
sentences.translation: This performance will start half an hour early, so please arrive on time.

sentences.chinese: 学校为春节活动准备了一次演出。
sentences.traditional: 學校為春節活動準備了一次演出。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi Chūnjié huódòng zhǔnbèi le yí cì yǎnchū.
sentences.translation: The school prepared a performance for the Spring Festival event.

sentences.chinese: 她的眼镜坏了，所以今天看黑板有点困难。
sentences.traditional: 她的眼鏡壞了，所以今天看黑板有點困難。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjìng huài le, suǒyǐ jīntiān kàn hēibǎn yǒudiǎn kùnnan.
sentences.translation: Her glasses are broken, so it is a bit difficult for her to see the blackboard today.

sentences.chinese: 这副眼镜价格不高，但是质量很好。
sentences.traditional: 這副眼鏡價格不高，但是質量很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fù yǎnjìng jiàgé bù gāo, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: This pair of glasses is not expensive, but the quality is very good.

sentences.chinese: 我把眼镜落在客厅的桌子上了。
sentences.traditional: 我把眼鏡落在客廳的桌子上了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yǎnjìng luò zài kètīng de zhuōzi shàng le.
sentences.translation: I left my glasses on the table in the living room.

sentences.chinese: 眼前的问题不严重，我们可以慢慢解决。
sentences.traditional: 眼前的問題不嚴重，我們可以慢慢解決。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnqián de wèntí bù yánzhòng, wǒmen kěyǐ mànmàn jiějué.
sentences.translation: The problem at the moment is not serious; we can solve it slowly.

sentences.chinese: 他只看眼前的好处，没有考虑将来。
sentences.traditional: 他只看眼前的好處，沒有考慮將來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ kàn yǎnqián de hǎochù, méiyǒu kǎolǜ jiānglái.
sentences.translation: He only looks at the immediate benefits and has not considered the future.

sentences.chinese: 美丽的景色就在眼前，大家都拿出手机拍照。
sentences.traditional: 美麗的景色就在眼前，大家都拿出手機拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Měilì de jǐngsè jiù zài yǎnqián, dàjiā dōu ná chū shǒujī pāizhào.
sentences.translation: The beautiful scenery was right in front of them, and everyone took out their phones to take photos.

sentences.chinese: 这位演员在电视剧里表现得很自然。
sentences.traditional: 這位演員在電視劇裡表現得很自然。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán zài diànshìjù lǐ biǎoxiàn de hěn zìrán.
sentences.translation: This actor performed very naturally in the TV drama.

sentences.chinese: 很多演员为了这次演出，每天练习到很晚。
sentences.traditional: 很多演員為了這次演出，每天練習到很晚。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō yǎnyuán wèile zhè cì yǎnchū, měitiān liànxí dào hěn wǎn.
sentences.translation: Many actors practise until late every day for this performance.

sentences.chinese: 这家剧院邀请了几位年轻演员。
sentences.traditional: 這家劇院邀請了幾位年輕演員。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jùyuàn yāoqǐng le jǐ wèi niánqīng yǎnyuán.
sentences.translation: This theatre invited several young actors.

sentences.chinese: 今天阳光很好，适合出去散步。
sentences.traditional: 今天陽光很好，適合出去散步。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān yángguāng hěn hǎo, shìhé chūqu sànbù.
sentences.translation: The sunshine is very nice today, so it is suitable for going out for a walk.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有阳光，感觉特别暖和。
sentences.traditional: 房間裡有陽光，感覺特別暖和。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu yángguāng, gǎnjué tèbié nuǎnhuo.
sentences.translation: There is sunshine in the room, and it feels especially warm.

sentences.chinese: 他站在阳光下等朋友，心情很好。
sentences.traditional: 他站在陽光下等朋友，心情很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài yángguāng xià děng péngyou, xīnqíng hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: He stood in the sunshine waiting for his friend, and he was in a good mood.

sentences.chinese: 孩子应该从小养成按时睡觉的习惯。
sentences.traditional: 孩子應該從小養成按時睡覺的習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yīnggāi cóng xiǎo yǎngchéng ànshí shuìjiào de xíguàn.
sentences.translation: Children should develop the habit of going to bed on time from a young age.

sentences.chinese: 如果你每天练习，就能慢慢养成说普通话的习惯。
sentences.traditional: 如果你每天練習，就能慢慢養成說普通話的習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ měitiān liànxí, jiù néng mànmàn yǎngchéng shuō Pǔtōnghuà de xíguàn.
sentences.translation: If you practise every day, you can slowly develop the habit of speaking Mandarin.

sentences.chinese: 养成节约用水的习惯，对环保有好处。
sentences.traditional: 養成節約用水的習慣，對環保有好處。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎngchéng jiéyuē yòng shuǐ de xíguàn, duì huánbǎo yǒu hǎochù.
sentences.translation: Developing the habit of saving water is good for environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 他今天的样子有点累，可能昨晚没睡好。
sentences.traditional: 他今天的樣子有點累，可能昨晚沒睡好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān de yàngzi yǒudiǎn lèi, kěnéng zuówǎn méi shuì hǎo.
sentences.translation: He looks a bit tired today; perhaps he did not sleep well last night.

sentences.chinese: 这个帽子的样子很特别，我一眼就看见了。
sentences.traditional: 這個帽子的樣子很特別，我一眼就看見了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège màozi de yàngzi hěn tèbié, wǒ yì yǎn jiù kànjiàn le.
sentences.translation: The style of this hat is very special; I saw it at once.

sentences.chinese: 她把房间收拾成原来的样子。
sentences.traditional: 她把房間收拾成原來的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ fángjiān shōushi chéng yuánlái de yàngzi.
sentences.translation: She tidied the room back into its original state.

sentences.chinese: 我们邀请老师参加周末的聚会。
sentences.traditional: 我們邀請老師參加週末的聚會。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yāoqǐng lǎoshī cānjiā zhōumò de jùhuì.
sentences.translation: We invited the teacher to attend the weekend gathering.

sentences.chinese: 公司邀请顾客参加新的活动。
sentences.traditional: 公司邀請顧客參加新的活動。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqǐng gùkè cānjiā xīn de huódòng.
sentences.translation: The company invited customers to take part in the new event.

sentences.chinese: 他没有收到邀请，所以没有去参加会议。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有收到邀請，所以沒有去參加會議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shōu dào yāoqǐng, suǒyǐ méiyǒu qù cānjiā huìyì.
sentences.translation: He did not receive an invitation, so he did not attend the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 要是明天下雨，我们就取消旅行计划。
sentences.traditional: 要是明天下雨，我們就取消旅行計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qǔxiāo lǚxíng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the travel plan.

sentences.chinese: 要是你有时间，请帮我看一下这个表格。
sentences.traditional: 要是你有時間，請幫我看一下這個表格。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ yǒu shíjiān, qǐng bāng wǒ kàn yí xià zhège biǎogé.
sentences.translation: If you have time, please help me look at this form.

sentences.chinese: 要是价格太高，我们可以再考虑别的办法。
sentences.traditional: 要是價格太高，我們可以再考慮別的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi jiàgé tài gāo, wǒmen kěyǐ zài kǎolǜ bié de bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: If the price is too high, we can consider another way.

sentences.chinese: 我把钥匙忘在办公室了，只好回去取。
sentences.traditional: 我把鑰匙忘在辦公室了，只好回去取。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yàoshi wàng zài bàngōngshì le, zhǐhǎo huíqù qǔ.
sentences.translation: I left my keys in the office, so I had to go back to get them.

sentences.chinese: 这把钥匙打不开前门，可能拿错了。
sentences.traditional: 這把鑰匙打不開前門，可能拿錯了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yàoshi dǎ bu kāi qiánmén, kěnéng ná cuò le.
sentences.translation: This key cannot open the front door; perhaps I took the wrong one.

sentences.chinese: 出门前请检查一下钥匙和手机。
sentences.traditional: 出門前請檢查一下鑰匙和手機。
sentences.pinyin: Chūmén qián qǐng jiǎnchá yí xià yàoshi hé shǒujī.
sentences.translation: Before going out, please check your keys and phone.

sentences.chinese: 也许他已经到车站了，我们打电话确认一下吧。
sentences.traditional: 也許他已經到車站了，我們打電話確認一下吧。
sentences.pinyin: Yěxǔ tā yǐjīng dào chēzhàn le, wǒmen dǎ diànhuà quèrèn yí xià ba.
sentences.translation: Perhaps he has already arrived at the station; let us phone to confirm.

sentences.chinese: 这道题有点难，也许需要老师解释。
sentences.traditional: 這道題有點難，也許需要老師解釋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí yǒudiǎn nán, yěxǔ xūyào lǎoshī jiěshì.
sentences.translation: This question is a bit difficult; perhaps it needs the teacher to explain it.

sentences.chinese: 明天也许会下雨，所以我们先准备雨伞。
sentences.traditional: 明天也許會下雨，所以我們先準備雨傘。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān yěxǔ huì xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen xiān zhǔnbèi yǔsǎn.
sentences.translation: It may rain tomorrow, so we will prepare umbrellas first.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的夜很安静，路上几乎没有人。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的夜很安靜，路上幾乎沒有人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de yè hěn ānjìng, lùshang jīhū méiyǒu rén.
sentences.translation: The night in this city is very quiet, with almost no one on the road.

sentences.chinese: 他为了完成报告，整整工作了一夜。
sentences.traditional: 他為了完成報告，整整工作了一夜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèile wánchéng bàogào, zhěngzhěng gōngzuò le yí yè.
sentences.translation: To finish the report, he worked for a whole night.

sentences.chinese: 冬天的夜比夏天长，早上天亮得晚。
sentences.traditional: 冬天的夜比夏天長，早上天亮得晚。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān de yè bǐ xiàtiān cháng, zǎoshang tiān liàng de wǎn.
sentences.translation: Winter nights are longer than summer nights, and it gets light later in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 夜晚的气温下降得很快，出门要多穿一件外套。
sentences.traditional: 夜晚的氣溫下降得很快，出門要多穿一件外套。
sentences.pinyin: Yèwǎn de qìwēn xiàjiàng de hěn kuài, chūmén yào duō chuān yí jiàn wàitào.
sentences.translation: The temperature falls quickly at night, so wear one more coat when going out.

sentences.chinese: 这个景区夜晚也开放，但是需要提前买票。
sentences.traditional: 這個景區夜晚也開放，但是需要提前買票。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jǐngqū yèwǎn yě kāifàng, dànshì xūyào tíqián mǎi piào.
sentences.translation: This scenic area is also open at night, but you need to buy tickets in advance.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在安静的夜晚写日记。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡在安靜的夜晚寫日記。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zài ānjìng de yèwǎn xiě rìjì.
sentences.translation: I like writing my diary on quiet evenings.

sentences.chinese: 秋天到了，树上的叶子慢慢变黄了。
sentences.traditional: 秋天到了，樹上的葉子慢慢變黃了。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān dào le, shù shàng de yèzi mànmàn biàn huáng le.
sentences.translation: Autumn has arrived, and the leaves on the trees are slowly turning yellow.

sentences.chinese: 这棵植物的叶子很厚，看起来很健康。
sentences.traditional: 這棵植物的葉子很厚，看起來很健康。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kē zhíwù de yèzi hěn hòu, kàn qǐlái hěn jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: The leaves of this plant are thick and look very healthy.

sentences.chinese: 请不要把垃圾扔在草地和叶子上。
sentences.traditional: 請不要把垃圾扔在草地和葉子上。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào bǎ lājī rēng zài cǎodì hé yèzi shàng.
sentences.translation: Please do not throw rubbish on the grass or leaves.

sentences.chinese: 一切准备好以后，我们就可以出发了。
sentences.traditional: 一切準備好以後，我們就可以出發了。
sentences.pinyin: Yíqiè zhǔnbèi hǎo yǐhòu, wǒmen jiù kěyǐ chūfā le.
sentences.translation: After everything is ready, we can set off.

sentences.chinese: 请放心，一切都会慢慢好起来的。
sentences.traditional: 請放心，一切都會慢慢好起來的。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng fàngxīn, yíqiè dōu huì mànmàn hǎo qǐlái de.
sentences.translation: Please do not worry; everything will slowly get better.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难时，他仍然相信一切都有办法解决。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難時，他仍然相信一切都有辦法解決。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan shí, tā réngrán xiāngxìn yíqiè dōu yǒu bànfǎ jiějué.
sentences.translation: When facing difficulties, he still believes there is a way to solve everything.

sentences.chinese: 会议已开始，请把手机调成安静模式。
sentences.traditional: 會議已開始，請把手機調成安靜模式。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yǐ kāishǐ, qǐng bǎ shǒujī tiáo chéng ānjìng móshì.
sentences.translation: The meeting has already started; please set your phone to silent mode.

sentences.chinese: 这项任务已完成，可以交给负责人检查。
sentences.traditional: 這項任務已完成，可以交給負責人檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng rènwu yǐ wánchéng, kěyǐ jiāo gěi fùzérén jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: This task has already been completed and can be given to the person in charge to check.

sentences.chinese: 报名时间已过，恐怕不能再加入比赛了。
sentences.traditional: 報名時間已過，恐怕不能再加入比賽了。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng shíjiān yǐ guò, kǒngpà bù néng zài jiārù bǐsài le.
sentences.translation: The registration time has already passed; I am afraid you cannot join the competition now.

sentences.chinese: 请在三天以内回复这封邮件。
sentences.traditional: 請在三天以內回覆這封郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài sān tiān yǐnèi huífù zhè fēng yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: Please reply to this email within three days.

sentences.chinese: 这个活动只接受十八岁以内的学生参加。
sentences.traditional: 這個活動只接受十八歲以內的學生參加。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huódòng zhǐ jiēshòu shíbā suì yǐnèi de xuésheng cānjiā.
sentences.translation: This event only accepts students under eighteen years old.

sentences.chinese: 从旅馆到景区，步行十分钟以内就能到。
sentences.traditional: 從旅館到景區，步行十分鐘以內就能到。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng lǚguǎn dào jǐngqū, bùxíng shí fēnzhōng yǐnèi jiù néng dào.
sentences.translation: From the hotel to the scenic area, you can get there within ten minutes on foot.

sentences.chinese: 你对这个计划有什么意见，可以直接提出来。
sentences.traditional: 你對這個計劃有什麼意見，可以直接提出來。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ duì zhège jìhuà yǒu shénme yìjiàn, kěyǐ zhíjiē tí chūlái.
sentences.translation: If you have any opinions about this plan, you can raise them directly.

sentences.chinese: 老师认真听取了每位学生的意见。
sentences.traditional: 老師認真聽取了每位學生的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènzhēn tīngqǔ le měi wèi xuésheng de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher listened carefully to every student's opinion.

sentences.chinese: 大家的意见不太一样，所以还需要再商量。
sentences.traditional: 大家的意見不太一樣，所以還需要再商量。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā de yìjiàn bú tài yíyàng, suǒyǐ hái xūyào zài shāngliang.
sentences.translation: Everyone's opinions are not quite the same, so we still need to discuss it further.

sentences.chinese: 这段经历让他一生难忘。
sentences.traditional: 這段經歷讓他一生難忘。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn jīnglì ràng tā yìshēng nánwàng.
sentences.translation: This experience was unforgettable for his whole life.

sentences.chinese: 她把一生的时间都用在教育工作上。
sentences.traditional: 她把一生的時間都用在教育工作上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yìshēng de shíjiān dōu yòng zài jiàoyù gōngzuò shàng.
sentences.translation: She spent her whole life on education work.

sentences.chinese: 一个人的一生会遇到很多机会和挑战。
sentences.traditional: 一個人的一生會遇到很多機會和挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge rén de yìshēng huì yùdào hěn duō jīhuì hé tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: In a person's lifetime, they will meet many opportunities and challenges.

sentences.chinese: 她从小喜欢艺术，后来考上了艺术学院。
sentences.traditional: 她從小喜歡藝術，後來考上了藝術學院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xǐhuan yìshù, hòulái kǎo shàng le yìshù xuéyuàn.
sentences.translation: She liked art from a young age and later was admitted to an art college.

sentences.chinese: 京剧是中国传统艺术的一部分。
sentences.traditional: 京劇是中國傳統藝術的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngjù shì Zhōngguó chuántǒng yìshù de yí bùfen.
sentences.translation: Beijing opera is part of traditional Chinese art.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市经常举办各种艺术活动。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市經常舉辦各種藝術活動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì jīngcháng jǔbàn gèzhǒng yìshù huódòng.
sentences.translation: This city often holds various art events.

sentences.chinese: 天气突然变冷，因此我们把活动改到了室内。
sentences.traditional: 天氣突然變冷，因此我們把活動改到了室內。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tūrán biàn lěng, yīncǐ wǒmen bǎ huódòng gǎi dào le shìnèi.
sentences.translation: The weather suddenly turned cold, so we moved the activity indoors.

sentences.chinese: 他没有按时交表格，因此不能参加面试。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有按時交表格，因此不能參加面試。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu ànshí jiāo biǎogé, yīncǐ bù néng cānjiā miànshì.
sentences.translation: He did not hand in the form on time, so he cannot attend the interview.

sentences.chinese: 这条路正在修理，因此我们要走另一条路。
sentences.traditional: 這條路正在修理，因此我們要走另一條路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù zhèngzài xiūlǐ, yīncǐ wǒmen yào zǒu lìng yì tiáo lù.
sentences.translation: This road is being repaired, so we need to take another road.

sentences.chinese: 这件小事引起了大家的注意。
sentences.traditional: 這件小事引起了大家的注意。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn xiǎoshì yǐnqǐ le dàjiā de zhùyì.
sentences.translation: This small matter attracted everyone's attention.

sentences.chinese: 他的发言引起了不少讨论。
sentences.traditional: 他的發言引起了不少討論。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fāyán yǐnqǐ le bù shǎo tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: His speech caused quite a lot of discussion.

sentences.chinese: 长时间玩手机可能引起眼睛不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 長時間玩手機可能引起眼睛不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān wán shǒujī kěnéng yǐnqǐ yǎnjing bù shūfu.
sentences.translation: Playing on a phone for a long time may cause eye discomfort.

sentences.chinese: 这次旅行给我留下了很深的印象。
sentences.traditional: 這次旅行給我留下了很深的印象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng gěi wǒ liúxià le hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: This trip left a deep impression on me.

sentences.chinese: 他礼貌的态度给老师留下了好印象。
sentences.traditional: 他禮貌的態度給老師留下了好印象。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǐmào de tàidù gěi lǎoshī liúxià le hǎo yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: His polite attitude left a good impression on the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 我对这家旅馆的第一印象不错。
sentences.traditional: 我對這家旅館的第一印象不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè jiā lǚguǎn de dì yī yìnxiàng búcuò.
sentences.translation: My first impression of this hotel was good.

sentences.chinese: 我们队最后赢了比赛。
sentences.traditional: 我們隊最後贏了比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen duì zuìhòu yíng le bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Our team won the match in the end.

sentences.chinese: 他练习了很久，终于赢了这场比赛。
sentences.traditional: 他練習了很久，終於贏了這場比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liànxí le hěn jiǔ, zhōngyú yíng le zhè chǎng bǐsài.
sentences.translation: He practised for a long time and finally won this match.

sentences.chinese: 比赛很困难，可是他还是赢了。
sentences.traditional: 比賽很困難，可是他還是贏了。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài hěn kùnnan, kěshì tā háishi yíng le.
sentences.translation: The match was difficult, but he still won.

sentences.chinese: 她的精彩演出赢得了观众的欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 她的精彩演出贏得了觀眾的歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jīngcǎi yǎnchū yíngdé le guānzhòng de huānyíng.
sentences.translation: Her wonderful performance won the audience's approval.

sentences.chinese: 这个产品质量好，赢得了很多顾客的支持。
sentences.traditional: 這個產品質量好，贏得了很多顧客的支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn zhìliàng hǎo, yíngdé le hěn duō gùkè de zhīchí.
sentences.translation: This product is good quality and has won the support of many customers.

sentences.chinese: 他们靠努力赢得了这次机会。
sentences.traditional: 他們靠努力贏得了這次機會。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kào nǔlì yíngdé le zhè cì jīhuì.
sentences.translation: They won this opportunity through hard work.

sentences.chinese: 他准备去那所学校应聘教师。
sentences.traditional: 他準備去那所學校應聘教師。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǔnbèi qù nà suǒ xuéxiào yìngpìn jiàoshī.
sentences.translation: He is preparing to apply for a teaching job at that school.

sentences.chinese: 应聘前，她认真准备了自我介绍。
sentences.traditional: 應聘前，她認真準備了自我介紹。
sentences.pinyin: Yìngpìn qián, tā rènzhēn zhǔnbèi le zìwǒ jièshào.
sentences.translation: Before applying for the job, she carefully prepared her self-introduction.

sentences.chinese: 这次应聘的人数比去年多。
sentences.traditional: 這次應聘的人數比去年多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì yìngpìn de rénshù bǐ qùnián duō.
sentences.translation: The number of people applying for this job is higher than last year.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难时，他表现得很勇敢。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難時，他表現得很勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan shí, tā biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒnggǎn.
sentences.translation: When facing difficulties, he behaved bravely.

sentences.chinese: 这个小女孩很勇敢，敢在大家面前演唱。
sentences.traditional: 這個小女孩很勇敢，敢在大家面前演唱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo nǚhái hěn yǒnggǎn, gǎn zài dàjiā miànqián yǎnchàng.
sentences.translation: This little girl is brave and dares to sing in front of everyone.

sentences.chinese: 勇敢不是不害怕，而是害怕时也能继续做。
sentences.traditional: 勇敢不是不害怕，而是害怕時也能繼續做。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒnggǎn bú shì bù hàipà, ér shì hàipà shí yě néng jìxù zuò.
sentences.translation: Being brave does not mean not being afraid, but being able to continue even when afraid.

sentences.chinese: 我永远不会忘记这段经历。
sentences.traditional: 我永遠不會忘記這段經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn bú huì wàngjì zhè duàn jīnglì.
sentences.translation: I will never forget this experience.

sentences.chinese: 朋友之间应该永远互相帮助。
sentences.traditional: 朋友之間應該永遠互相幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Péngyou zhījiān yīnggāi yǒngyuǎn hùxiāng bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: Friends should always help each other.

sentences.chinese: 父母的爱会永远留在孩子心里。
sentences.traditional: 父母的愛會永遠留在孩子心裡。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ de ài huì yǒngyuǎn liú zài háizi xīnli.
sentences.translation: Parents' love will stay in a child's heart forever.

sentences.chinese: 这把刀是用来切水果的。
sentences.traditional: 這把刀是用來切水果的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ dāo shì yònglái qiē shuǐguǒ de.
sentences.translation: This knife is used for cutting fruit.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间可以用来开会。
sentences.traditional: 這個房間可以用來開會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān kěyǐ yònglái kāihuì.
sentences.translation: This room can be used for meetings.

sentences.chinese: 密码用来保护个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 密碼用來保護個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Mìmǎ yònglái bǎohù gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Passwords are used to protect personal information.

sentences.chinese: 这些材料主要用于教学。
sentences.traditional: 這些材料主要用於教學。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē cáiliào zhǔyào yòngyú jiàoxué.
sentences.translation: These materials are mainly used for teaching.

sentences.chinese: 这笔钱将用于修理学校的食堂。
sentences.traditional: 這筆錢將用於修理學校的食堂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián jiāng yòngyú xiūlǐ xuéxiào de shítáng.
sentences.translation: This money will be used to repair the school's cafeteria.

sentences.chinese: 这种方法也用于解决日常问题。
sentences.traditional: 這種方法也用於解決日常問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ yě yòngyú jiějué rìcháng wèntí.
sentences.translation: This method is also used to solve everyday problems.

sentences.chinese: 这个方法的优点是简单又省时间。
sentences.traditional: 這個方法的優點是簡單又省時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ de yōudiǎn shì jiǎndān yòu shěng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The advantage of this method is that it is simple and saves time.

sentences.chinese: 每个产品都有自己的优点和缺点。
sentences.traditional: 每個產品都有自己的優點和缺點。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge chǎnpǐn dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn hé quēdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Every product has its own advantages and disadvantages.

sentences.chinese: 她最大的优点是做事很有耐心。
sentences.traditional: 她最大的優點是做事很有耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì dà de yōudiǎn shì zuò shì hěn yǒu nàixīn.
sentences.translation: Her greatest strength is that she is very patient in doing things.

sentences.chinese: 他很幽默，总能让大家笑。
sentences.traditional: 他很幽默，總能讓大家笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn yōumò, zǒng néng ràng dàjiā xiào.
sentences.translation: He is humorous and can always make everyone laugh.

sentences.chinese: 幽默的老师让课堂更轻松。
sentences.traditional: 幽默的老師讓課堂更輕鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Yōumò de lǎoshī ràng kètáng gèng qīngsōng.
sentences.translation: A humorous teacher makes the classroom more relaxed.

sentences.chinese: 这个笑话不太幽默，大家都没笑。
sentences.traditional: 這個笑話不太幽默，大家都沒笑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàohua bú tài yōumò, dàjiā dōu méi xiào.
sentences.translation: This joke is not very funny, and no one laughed.

sentences.chinese: 她是一名优秀的护士。
sentences.traditional: 她是一名優秀的護士。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yì míng yōuxiù de hùshi.
sentences.translation: She is an excellent nurse.

sentences.chinese: 这个学生成绩优秀，也很有礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 這個學生成績優秀，也很有禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xuésheng chéngjì yōuxiù, yě hěn yǒu lǐmào.
sentences.translation: This student has excellent grades and is also very polite.

sentences.chinese: 优秀的团队需要大家互相帮助。
sentences.traditional: 優秀的團隊需要大家互相幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Yōuxiù de tuánduì xūyào dàjiā hùxiāng bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: An excellent team needs everyone to help each other.

sentences.chinese: 这项任务由王老师负责。
sentences.traditional: 這項任務由王老師負責。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng rènwu yóu Wáng lǎoshī fùzé.
sentences.translation: This task is handled by Teacher Wang.

sentences.chinese: 这封信由快递公司送到。
sentences.traditional: 這封信由快遞公司送到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn yóu kuàidì gōngsī sòng dào.
sentences.translation: This letter was delivered by the express delivery company.

sentences.chinese: 考试时间由学校决定。
sentences.traditional: 考試時間由學校決定。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì shíjiān yóu xuéxiào juédìng.
sentences.translation: The exam time is decided by the school.

sentences.chinese: 炒菜时不要放太多油。
sentences.traditional: 炒菜時不要放太多油。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎo cài shí bú yào fàng tài duō yóu.
sentences.translation: Do not use too much oil when cooking.

sentences.chinese: 这瓶油用于做汤。
sentences.traditional: 這瓶油用於做湯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè píng yóu yòngyú zuò tāng.
sentences.translation: This bottle of oil is used for making soup.

sentences.chinese: 地上有油，走路要小心。
sentences.traditional: 地上有油，走路要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shang yǒu yóu, zǒu lù yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: There is oil on the floor, so be careful when walking.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢水果，尤其喜欢葡萄。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡水果，尤其喜歡葡萄。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ, yóuqí xǐhuan pútao.
sentences.translation: I like fruit, especially grapes.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的美食很多，尤其是面条。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的美食很多，尤其是麵條。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de měishí hěn duō, yóuqí shì miàntiáo.
sentences.translation: This restaurant has lots of delicious food, especially noodles.

sentences.chinese: 他对科技很感兴趣，尤其喜欢研究新产品。
sentences.traditional: 他對科技很感興趣，尤其喜歡研究新產品。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì kējì hěn gǎn xìngqù, yóuqí xǐhuan yánjiū xīn chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: He is very interested in technology, especially researching new products.

sentences.chinese: 周末我们去景区游玩。
sentences.traditional: 週末我們去景區遊玩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù jǐngqū yóuwán.
sentences.translation: At the weekend we will go sightseeing in the scenic area.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在公园里游玩得很开心。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在公園裡遊玩得很開心。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài gōngyuán li yóuwán de hěn kāixīn.
sentences.translation: The children had a very good time playing in the park.

sentences.chinese: 旅客可以在这里游玩半天。
sentences.traditional: 旅客可以在這裡遊玩半天。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚkè kěyǐ zài zhèlǐ yóuwán bàn tiān.
sentences.translation: Travellers can spend half a day sightseeing here.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气不好，演出取消了。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣不好，演出取消了。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì bù hǎo, yǎnchū qǔxiāo le.
sentences.translation: Because the weather was bad, the performance was cancelled.

sentences.chinese: 由于时间不够，我们没有参观那个景点。
sentences.traditional: 由於時間不夠，我們沒有參觀那個景點。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shíjiān bú gòu, wǒmen méiyǒu cānguān nà ge jǐngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Because there was not enough time, we did not visit that scenic spot.

sentences.chinese: 他由于身体不舒服，没有参加比赛。
sentences.traditional: 他由於身體不舒服，沒有參加比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yóuyú shēntǐ bù shūfu, méiyǒu cānjiā bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Because he felt unwell, he did not take part in the match.

sentences.chinese: 这里的人很友好，愿意帮助旅客。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的人很友好，願意幫助旅客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rén hěn yǒuhǎo, yuànyì bāngzhù lǚkè.
sentences.translation: The people here are friendly and willing to help travellers.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该用友好的态度交流。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該用友好的態度交流。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi yòng yǒuhǎo de tàidù jiāoliú.
sentences.translation: We should communicate with a friendly attitude.

sentences.chinese: 这两个国家保持友好的关系。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個國家保持友好的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā bǎochí yǒuhǎo de guānxì.
sentences.translation: These two countries maintain a friendly relationship.

sentences.chinese: 他们的友情从小学开始。
sentences.traditional: 他們的友情從小學開始。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen de yǒuqíng cóng xiǎoxué kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: Their friendship began in primary school.

sentences.chinese: 真正的友情需要互相帮助。
sentences.traditional: 真正的友情需要互相幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de yǒuqíng xūyào hùxiāng bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: True friendship requires helping each other.

sentences.chinese: 这次经历让我们的友情更深了。
sentences.traditional: 這次經歷讓我們的友情更深了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì ràng wǒmen de yǒuqíng gèng shēn le.
sentences.translation: This experience made our friendship deeper.

sentences.chinese: 这个故事很有趣。
sentences.traditional: 這個故事很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gùshi hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.translation: This story is very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 我们在森林里看到很多有趣的动物。
sentences.traditional: 我們在森林裡看到很多有趣的動物。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài sēnlín li kàndào hěn duō yǒuqù de dòngwù.
sentences.translation: We saw many interesting animals in the forest.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题听起来很有趣。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題聽起來很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tīng qǐlai hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.translation: This question sounds very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 这个方法很有效。
sentences.traditional: 這個方法很有效。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ hěn yǒuxiào.
sentences.translation: This method is very effective.

sentences.chinese: 这张签证还有效吗？
sentences.traditional: 這張簽證還有效嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng qiānzhèng hái yǒuxiào ma?
sentences.translation: Is this visa still valid?

sentences.chinese: 每天复习对记忆很有效。
sentences.traditional: 每天復習對記憶很有效。
sentences.pinyin: Měitiān fùxí duì jìyì hěn yǒuxiào.
sentences.translation: Reviewing every day is very effective for memory.

sentences.chinese: 我希望我们的友谊一直不变。
sentences.traditional: 我希望我們的友誼一直不變。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng wǒmen de yǒuyì yìzhí bú biàn.
sentences.translation: I hope our friendship never changes.

sentences.chinese: 真正的友谊需要互相理解。
sentences.traditional: 真正的友誼需要互相理解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì xūyào hùxiāng lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: True friendship requires mutual understanding.

sentences.chinese: 这段友谊让我很感动。
sentences.traditional: 這段友誼讓我很感動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn yǒuyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
sentences.translation: This friendship really moved me.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市有着美丽的夜景。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市有著美麗的夜景。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒuzhe měilì de yèjǐng.
sentences.translation: This city has beautiful night scenery.

sentences.chinese: 他有着丰富的工作经验。
sentences.traditional: 他有著豐富的工作經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǒuzhe fēngfù de gōngzuò jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He has rich work experience.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校有着优秀的老师和学生。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校有著優秀的老師和學生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào yǒuzhe yōuxiù de lǎoshī hé xuésheng.
sentences.translation: This school has excellent teachers and students.

sentences.chinese: 祝你旅途愉快。
sentences.traditional: 祝你旅途愉快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhù nǐ lǚtú yúkuài.
sentences.translation: I wish you a pleasant journey.

sentences.chinese: 我们聊得很愉快。
sentences.traditional: 我們聊得很愉快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen liáo de hěn yúkuài.
sentences.translation: We chatted very happily.

sentences.chinese: 这次聚会让大家都很愉快。
sentences.traditional: 這次聚會讓大家都很愉快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jùhuì ràng dàjiā dōu hěn yúkuài.
sentences.translation: This gathering made everyone very happy.

sentences.chinese: 雨停了，于是我们继续散步。
sentences.traditional: 雨停了，於是我們繼續散步。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, yúshì wǒmen jìxù sànbù.
sentences.translation: The rain stopped, so we continued our walk.

sentences.chinese: 他忘了带钥匙，于是给妈妈打电话。
sentences.traditional: 他忘了帶鑰匙，於是給媽媽打電話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wàng le dài yàoshi, yúshì gěi māma dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.translation: He forgot to bring his key, so he called his mum.

sentences.chinese: 大家都同意了，于是活动按时开始。
sentences.traditional: 大家都同意了，於是活動按時開始。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu tóngyì le, yúshì huódòng ànshí kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: Everyone agreed, so the activity started on time.

sentences.chinese: 学习与生活都需要计划。
sentences.traditional: 學習與生活都需要計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yǔ shēnghuó dōu xūyào jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Both study and life need planning.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题与环境有关。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題與環境有關。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yǔ huánjìng yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: This problem is related to the environment.

sentences.chinese: 他愿意与同学一起完成任务。
sentences.traditional: 他願意與同學一起完成任務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuànyì yǔ tóngxué yìqǐ wánchéng rènwu.
sentences.translation: He is willing to complete the task with his classmates.

sentences.chinese: 这条语法规则很重要。
sentences.traditional: 這條語法規則很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yǔfǎ guīzé hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This grammar rule is very important.

sentences.chinese: 老师用例子解释语法。
sentences.traditional: 老師用例子解釋語法。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng lìzi jiěshì yǔfǎ.
sentences.translation: The teacher explains grammar using examples.

sentences.chinese: 他的语法错误比以前少了。
sentences.traditional: 他的語法錯誤比以前少了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǔfǎ cuòwù bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
sentences.translation: His grammar mistakes are fewer than before.

sentences.chinese: 上课前，我会先预习课文。
sentences.traditional: 上課前，我會先預習課文。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng kè qián, wǒ huì xiān yùxí kèwén.
sentences.translation: Before class, I will preview the text first.

sentences.chinese: 预习以后，听课会更轻松。
sentences.traditional: 預習以後，聽課會更輕鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Yùxí yǐhòu, tīng kè huì gèng qīngsōng.
sentences.translation: After previewing, listening in class will be easier.

sentences.chinese: 如果不预习，课堂内容可能很难懂。
sentences.traditional: 如果不預習，課堂內容可能很難懂。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù yùxí, kètáng nèiróng kěnéng hěn nán dǒng.
sentences.translation: If you do not preview, the class content may be hard to understand.

sentences.chinese: 原来你已经知道这件事了。
sentences.traditional: 原來你已經知道這件事了。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánlái nǐ yǐjīng zhīdào zhè jiàn shì le.
sentences.translation: So you already knew about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 这家店原来是一家旅馆。
sentences.traditional: 這家店原來是一家旅館。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn yuánlái shì yì jiā lǚguǎn.
sentences.translation: This shop used to be a hotel.

sentences.chinese: 我原来打算坐公交车，后来改坐地铁。
sentences.traditional: 我原來打算坐公交車，後來改坐地鐵。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yuánlái dǎsuàn zuò gōngjiāochē, hòulái gǎi zuò dìtiě.
sentences.translation: I originally planned to take the bus, but later changed to the underground.

sentences.chinese: 请原谅我刚才的错误。
sentences.traditional: 請原諒我剛才的錯誤。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng yuánliàng wǒ gāngcái de cuòwù.
sentences.translation: Please forgive my mistake just now.

sentences.chinese: 他终于原谅了朋友。
sentences.traditional: 他終於原諒了朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú yuánliàng le péngyou.
sentences.translation: He finally forgave his friend.

sentences.chinese: 如果你能原谅他，他会很感谢你。
sentences.traditional: 如果你能原諒他，他會很感謝你。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng yuánliàng tā, tā huì hěn gǎnxiè nǐ.
sentences.translation: If you can forgive him, he will be very grateful to you.

sentences.chinese: 请说明迟到的原因。
sentences.traditional: 請說明遲到的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng shuōmíng chídào de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: Please explain the reason for being late.

sentences.chinese: 天气是取消比赛的主要原因。
sentences.traditional: 天氣是取消比賽的主要原因。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì shì qǔxiāo bǐsài de zhǔyào yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The weather is the main reason for cancelling the competition.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道她离开的原因。
sentences.traditional: 我想知道她離開的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào tā líkāi de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: I want to know the reason why she left.

sentences.chinese: 请远离危险的地方。
sentences.traditional: 請遠離危險的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng yuǎnlí wēixiǎn de dìfang.
sentences.translation: Please stay away from dangerous places.

sentences.chinese: 为了健康，他决定远离烟。
sentences.traditional: 為了健康，他決定遠離煙。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiànkāng, tā juédìng yuǎnlí yān.
sentences.translation: For his health, he decided to stay away from smoke and cigarettes.

sentences.chinese: 我们要远离不安全的网站。
sentences.traditional: 我們要遠離不安全的網站。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yuǎnlí bù ānquán de wǎngzhàn.
sentences.translation: We should stay away from unsafe websites.

sentences.chinese: 院长在会议上介绍了新计划。
sentences.traditional: 院長在會議上介紹了新計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng zài huìyì shang jièshào le xīn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The dean introduced the new plan at the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 我们向院长提出了建议。
sentences.traditional: 我們向院長提出了建議。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàng yuànzhǎng tíchū le jiànyì.
sentences.translation: We made suggestions to the dean.

sentences.chinese: 院长很关心学生的生活。
sentences.traditional: 院長很關心學生的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng hěn guānxīn xuéshēng de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: The dean cares about the students’ lives.

sentences.chinese: 院子里种了几棵树。
sentences.traditional: 院子裡種了幾棵樹。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzi li zhòng le jǐ kē shù.
sentences.translation: Several trees have been planted in the yard.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在院子里玩得很开心。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在院子裡玩得很開心。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài yuànzi li wán de hěn kāixīn.
sentences.translation: The children are playing happily in the yard.

sentences.chinese: 晚上，院子里很安静。
sentences.traditional: 晚上，院子裡很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang, yuànzi li hěn ānjìng.
sentences.translation: In the evening, the yard is very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 我们约在学校门口见面。
sentences.traditional: 我們約在學校門口見面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yuē zài xuéxiào ménkǒu jiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: We arranged to meet at the school gate.

sentences.chinese: 这条路约有三公里长。
sentences.traditional: 這條路約有三公里長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yuē yǒu sān gōnglǐ cháng.
sentences.translation: This road is about three kilometres long.

sentences.chinese: 他约我周末去看电影。
sentences.traditional: 他約我週末去看電影。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuē wǒ zhōumò qù kàn diànyǐng.
sentences.translation: He arranged to go and see a film with me at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 他今晚有一个重要的约会。
sentences.traditional: 他今晚有一個重要的約會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīnwǎn yǒu yí ge zhòngyào de yuēhuì.
sentences.translation: He has an important appointment tonight.

sentences.chinese: 他们的第一次约会很愉快。
sentences.traditional: 他們的第一次約會很愉快。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen de dì yī cì yuēhuì hěn yúkuài.
sentences.translation: Their first date was very pleasant.

sentences.chinese: 如果你不能来，请提前取消约会。
sentences.traditional: 如果你不能來，請提前取消約會。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù néng lái, qǐng tíqián qǔxiāo yuēhuì.
sentences.translation: If you cannot come, please cancel the appointment in advance.

sentences.chinese: 中秋节我们常常吃月饼。
sentences.traditional: 中秋節我們常常吃月餅。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngqiū Jié wǒmen chángcháng chī yuèbing.
sentences.translation: We often eat mooncakes at Mid-Autumn Festival.

sentences.chinese: 这个月饼太甜了。
sentences.traditional: 這個月餅太甜了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yuèbing tài tián le.
sentences.translation: This mooncake is too sweet.

sentences.chinese: 我买了一盒月饼送给父母。
sentences.traditional: 我買了一盒月餅送給父母。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yì hé yuèbing sòng gěi fùmǔ.
sentences.translation: I bought a box of mooncakes to give to my parents.

sentences.chinese: 阅读能提高我们的语言能力。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀能提高我們的語言能力。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú néng tígāo wǒmen de yǔyán nénglì.
sentences.translation: Reading can improve our language ability.

sentences.chinese: 他每天花半小时阅读文章。
sentences.traditional: 他每天花半小時閱讀文章。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān huā bàn xiǎoshí yuèdú wénzhāng.
sentences.translation: He spends half an hour reading articles every day.

sentences.chinese: 阅读前先看问题会更有效。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀前先看問題會更有效。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú qián xiān kàn wèntí huì gèng yǒuxiào.
sentences.translation: Looking at the questions before reading is more effective.

sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢哪个月份？
sentences.traditional: 你最喜歡哪個月份？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎ ge yuèfèn?
sentences.translation: Which month do you like best?

sentences.chinese: 这个月份的收入比上个月高。
sentences.traditional: 這個月份的收入比上個月高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yuèfèn de shōurù bǐ shàng ge yuè gāo.
sentences.translation: This month’s income is higher than last month’s.

sentences.chinese: 请在表格里填写出生月份。
sentences.traditional: 請在表格裡填寫出生月份。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé li tiánxiě chūshēng yuèfèn.
sentences.translation: Please fill in the month of birth in the form.

sentences.chinese: 天上的云越来越厚。
sentences.traditional: 天上的雲越來越厚。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānshang de yún yuè lái yuè hòu.
sentences.translation: The clouds in the sky are getting thicker.

sentences.chinese: 山顶被白云盖住了。
sentences.traditional: 山頂被白雲蓋住了。
sentences.pinyin: Shāndǐng bèi bái yún gàizhù le.
sentences.translation: The mountain top was covered by white clouds.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢看云慢慢地移动。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡看雲慢慢地移動。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn yún mànmàn de yídòng.
sentences.translation: I like watching clouds move slowly.

sentences.chinese: 学校不允许学生在课堂上吃东西。
sentences.traditional: 學校不允許學生在課堂上吃東西。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bù yǔnxǔ xuésheng zài kètáng shang chī dōngxi.
sentences.translation: The school does not allow students to eat in class.

sentences.chinese: 如果时间允许，我们下午去森林散步。
sentences.traditional: 如果時間允許，我們下午去森林散步。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shíjiān yǔnxǔ, wǒmen xiàwǔ qù sēnlín sànbù.
sentences.translation: If time allows, we will go for a walk in the forest this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 没有签证，他不被允许进入这个国家。
sentences.traditional: 沒有簽證，他不被允許進入這個國家。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu qiānzhèng, tā bù bèi yǔnxǔ jìnrù zhège guójiā.
sentences.translation: Without a visa, he is not allowed to enter this country.

sentences.chinese: 这本杂志里有很多旅行照片。
sentences.traditional: 這本雜誌裡有很多旅行照片。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì li yǒu hěn duō lǚxíng zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: There are many travel photos in this magazine.

sentences.chinese: 她每个月都会买一本科学杂志。
sentences.traditional: 她每個月都會買一本科學雜誌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè dōu huì mǎi yì běn kēxué zázhì.
sentences.translation: She buys a science magazine every month.

sentences.chinese: 我把旧杂志放在客厅的桌子上。
sentences.traditional: 我把舊雜誌放在客廳的桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ jiù zázhì fàng zài kètīng de zhuōzi shang.
sentences.translation: I put the old magazines on the table in the living room.

sentences.chinese: 感谢你再次帮助我们。
sentences.traditional: 感謝你再次幫助我們。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎnxiè nǐ zàicì bāngzhù wǒmen.
sentences.translation: Thank you for helping us once again.

sentences.chinese: 请再次检查表格里的日期。
sentences.traditional: 請再次檢查表格裡的日期。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zàicì jiǎnchá biǎogé li de rìqī.
sentences.translation: Please check the date in the form once again.

sentences.chinese: 比赛因为大雨再次推迟了。
sentences.traditional: 比賽因為大雨再次推遲了。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài yīnwèi dàyǔ zàicì tuīchí le.
sentences.translation: The competition was postponed again because of the heavy rain.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题我们明天再说。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題我們明天再說。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒmen míngtiān zàishuō.
sentences.translation: We will talk about this problem tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 先把作业做完，再说别的事。
sentences.traditional: 先把作業做完，再說別的事。
sentences.pinyin: Xiān bǎ zuòyè zuò wán, zàishuō bié de shì.
sentences.translation: Finish the homework first, then talk about other things.

sentences.chinese: 外面太冷了，再说我也有点儿累。
sentences.traditional: 外面太冷了，再說我也有點兒累。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn tài lěng le, zàishuō wǒ yě yǒudiǎnr lèi.
sentences.translation: It is too cold outside; besides, I am also a bit tired.

sentences.chinese: 我们暂时不能告诉大家结果。
sentences.traditional: 我們暫時不能告訴大家結果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zànshí bù néng gàosu dàjiā jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: We cannot tell everyone the result for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间暂时没人住。
sentences.traditional: 這個房間暫時沒人住。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān zànshí méi rén zhù.
sentences.translation: No one is living in this room for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气不好，活动暂时停止。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣不好，活動暫時停止。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì bù hǎo, huódòng zànshí tíngzhǐ.
sentences.translation: Because the weather is bad, the activity has temporarily stopped.

sentences.chinese: 比赛因为下雨暂停了十分钟。
sentences.traditional: 比賽因為下雨暫停了十分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài yīnwèi xià yǔ zàntíng le shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: The match paused for ten minutes because of the rain.

sentences.chinese: 请先暂停视频，我想记一下。
sentences.traditional: 請先暫停視頻，我想記一下。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān zàntíng shìpín, wǒ xiǎng jì yí xià.
sentences.translation: Please pause the video first; I want to make a note.

sentences.chinese: 这个服务将暂停到月底。
sentences.traditional: 這個服務將暫停到月底。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fúwù jiāng zàntíng dào yuèdǐ.
sentences.translation: This service will be suspended until the end of the month.

sentences.chinese: 早餐我只吃了一个馒头。
sentences.traditional: 早餐我只吃了一個饅頭。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎocān wǒ zhǐ chī le yí ge mántou.
sentences.translation: For breakfast I only ate one mantou.

sentences.chinese: 这家旅馆提供免费的早餐。
sentences.traditional: 這家旅館提供免費的早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚguǎn tígōng miǎnfèi de zǎocān.
sentences.translation: This hotel provides free breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 不吃早餐对身体不好。
sentences.traditional: 不吃早餐對身體不好。
sentences.pinyin: Bù chī zǎocān duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
sentences.translation: Not eating breakfast is bad for the body.

sentences.chinese: 今天早晨空气特别新鲜。
sentences.traditional: 今天早晨空氣特別新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎochen kōngqì tèbié xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: The air was especially fresh this morning.

sentences.chinese: 我习惯在早晨散步。
sentences.traditional: 我習慣在早晨散步。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn zài zǎochen sànbù.
sentences.translation: I am used to taking a walk in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 早晨的阳光很暖和。
sentences.traditional: 早晨的陽光很暖和。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎochen de yángguāng hěn nuǎnhuo.
sentences.translation: The morning sunshine is very warm.

sentences.chinese: 这是每个队员的责任。
sentences.traditional: 這是每個隊員的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì měi ge duìyuán de zérèn.
sentences.translation: This is every team member’s responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 父母有保护孩子的责任。
sentences.traditional: 父母有保護孩子的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ yǒu bǎohù háizi de zérèn.
sentences.translation: Parents have a responsibility to protect their children.

sentences.chinese: 完成这个任务是我的责任。
sentences.traditional: 完成這個任務是我的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Wánchéng zhège rènwu shì wǒ de zérèn.
sentences.translation: Completing this task is my responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 学校今年增加了几门新的课程。
sentences.traditional: 學校今年增加了幾門新的課程。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jīnnián zēngjiā le jǐ mén xīn de kèchéng.
sentences.translation: The school added several new courses this year.

sentences.chinese: 这个月的游客人数增加了不少。
sentences.traditional: 這個月的遊客人數增加了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yuè de yóukè rénshù zēngjiā le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: The number of tourists increased quite a lot this month.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高安全，景区增加了几名工作人员。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高安全，景區增加了幾名工作人員。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo ānquán, jǐngqū zēngjiā le jǐ míng gōngzuò rényuán.
sentences.translation: To improve safety, the scenic area added several staff members.

sentences.chinese: 近几年，这个城市的人口增长很快。
sentences.traditional: 近幾年，這個城市的人口增長很快。
sentences.pinyin: Jìn jǐ nián, zhège chéngshì de rénkǒu zēngzhǎng hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: In recent years, this city’s population has grown very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他的经验随着工作时间增长。
sentences.traditional: 他的經驗隨著工作時間增長。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jīngyàn suízhe gōngzuò shíjiān zēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: His experience grows with his working time.

sentences.chinese: 公司收入增长以后，员工的信心也强了。
sentences.traditional: 公司收入增長以後，員工的信心也強了。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī shōurù zēngzhǎng yǐhòu, yuángōng de xìnxīn yě qiáng le.
sentences.translation: After the company’s income increased, the staff became more confident too.

sentences.chinese: 这家旅馆正在招聘新的服务人员。
sentences.traditional: 這家旅館正在招聘新的服務人員。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚguǎn zhèngzài zhāopìn xīn de fúwù rényuán.
sentences.translation: This hotel is recruiting new service staff.

sentences.chinese: 公司的网站上发布了招聘信息。
sentences.traditional: 公司的網站上發布了招聘信息。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǎngzhàn shang fābù le zhāopìn xìnxī.
sentences.translation: The company published recruitment information on its website.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想应聘，可以先看看招聘要求。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想應聘，可以先看看招聘要求。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng yìngpìn, kěyǐ xiān kànkan zhāopìn yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: If you want to apply, you can first look at the recruitment requirements.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服离火太近，差点儿着了。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服離火太近，差點兒著了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu lí huǒ tài jìn, chàdiǎnr zháo le.
sentences.translation: This item of clothing was too close to the fire and nearly caught light.

sentences.chinese: 火柴没有着，我们又试了一次。
sentences.traditional: 火柴沒有著，我們又試了一次。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchái méiyǒu zháo, wǒmen yòu shì le yí cì.
sentences.translation: The match did not catch light, so we tried again.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车太旧了，开了半天也没着。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車太舊了，開了半天也沒著。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē tài jiù le, kāi le bàntiān yě méi zháo.
sentences.translation: This vehicle is too old; even after trying for ages, it still would not start.

sentences.chinese: 厨房突然着火了，大家马上跑出来。
sentences.traditional: 廚房突然著火了，大家馬上跑出來。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfáng tūrán zháohuǒ le, dàjiā mǎshàng pǎo chūlái.
sentences.translation: The kitchen suddenly caught fire, and everyone ran out at once.

sentences.chinese: 如果发现房子着火，应该立刻报警。
sentences.traditional: 如果發現房子著火，應該立刻報警。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāxiàn fángzi zháohuǒ, yīnggāi lìkè bàojǐng.
sentences.translation: If you discover a house is on fire, you should call the police immediately.

sentences.chinese: 那片森林去年夏天着火过。
sentences.traditional: 那片森林去年夏天著火過。
sentences.pinyin: Nà piàn sēnlín qùnián xiàtiān zháohuǒ guo.
sentences.translation: That forest caught fire last summer.

sentences.chinese: 读者可以在网页上留下意见。
sentences.traditional: 讀者可以在網頁上留下意見。
sentences.pinyin: Dúzhě kěyǐ zài wǎngyè shang liúxià yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Readers can leave their opinions on the webpage.

sentences.chinese: 参赛者需要提前填写表格。
sentences.traditional: 參賽者需要提前填寫表格。
sentences.pinyin: Cānsài zhě xūyào tíqián tiánxiě biǎogé.
sentences.translation: Participants need to fill in the form in advance.

sentences.chinese: 获奖者将在明天的活动中发言。
sentences.traditional: 獲獎者將在明天的活動中發言。
sentences.pinyin: Huòjiǎng zhě jiāng zài míngtiān de huódòng zhōng fāyán.
sentences.translation: The prize winner will speak at tomorrow’s event.

sentences.chinese: 真正的朋友会在困难时帮助你。
sentences.traditional: 真正的朋友會在困難時幫助你。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyou huì zài kùnnan shí bāngzhù nǐ.
sentences.translation: A true friend will help you when you are in difficulty.

sentences.chinese: 他真正关心的是学生的进步。
sentences.traditional: 他真正關心的是學生的進步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhēnzhèng guānxīn de shì xuésheng de jìnbù.
sentences.translation: What he truly cares about is the students’ progress.

sentences.chinese: 这次经历让我明白了真正的责任。
sentences.traditional: 這次經歷讓我明白了真正的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì ràng wǒ míngbai le zhēnzhèng de zérèn.
sentences.translation: This experience made me understand true responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 我花了整整一天整理这些文件。
sentences.traditional: 我花了整整一天整理這些文件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huā le zhěngzhěng yì tiān zhěnglǐ zhèxiē wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: I spent a whole day organising these documents.

sentences.chinese: 他把整本书都读完了。
sentences.traditional: 他把整本書都讀完了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhěng běn shū dōu dú wán le.
sentences.translation: He finished reading the whole book.

sentences.chinese: 整条街都非常热闹。
sentences.traditional: 整條街都非常熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhěng tiáo jiē dōu fēicháng rènao.
sentences.translation: The whole street was very lively.

sentences.chinese: 整个房间都被他收拾干净了。
sentences.traditional: 整個房間都被他收拾乾淨了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhěnggè fángjiān dōu bèi tā shōushi gānjìng le.
sentences.translation: The whole room was tidied up by him.

sentences.chinese: 这件事影响了整个学校。
sentences.traditional: 這件事影響了整個學校。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǐngxiǎng le zhěnggè xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: This matter affected the whole school.

sentences.chinese: 我们用了整个上午讨论这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 我們用了整個上午討論這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yòng le zhěnggè shàngwǔ tǎolùn zhège wèntí.
sentences.translation: We spent the whole morning discussing this problem.

sentences.chinese: 请把桌上的资料整理一下。
sentences.traditional: 請把桌上的資料整理一下。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhuō shang de zīliào zhěnglǐ yí xià.
sentences.translation: Please tidy up the materials on the table.

sentences.chinese: 我正在整理旅行时拍的照片。
sentences.traditional: 我正在整理旅行時拍的照片。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài zhěnglǐ lǚxíng shí pāi de zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: I am organising the photos I took while travelling.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们整理自己的学习计划。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們整理自己的學習計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen zhěnglǐ zìjǐ de xuéxí jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to organise our own study plans.

sentences.chinese: 请把你的证给工作人员看。
sentences.traditional: 請把你的證給工作人員看。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de zhèng gěi gōngzuò rényuán kàn.
sentences.translation: Please show your certificate to the staff.

sentences.chinese: 没有证，游客不能进入这个区。
sentences.traditional: 沒有證，遊客不能進入這個區。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu zhèng, yóukè bù néng jìnrù zhège qū.
sentences.translation: Without a certificate, tourists cannot enter this area.

sentences.chinese: 这个证下个月就到期了。
sentences.traditional: 這個證下個月就到期了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhèng xià gè yuè jiù dào qī le.
sentences.translation: This certificate expires next month.

sentences.chinese: 今天地铁运行正常。
sentences.traditional: 今天地鐵運行正常。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān dìtiě yùnxíng zhèngcháng.
sentences.translation: The underground is running normally today.

sentences.chinese: 体温在这个范围内是正常的。
sentences.traditional: 體溫在這個範圍內是正常的。
sentences.pinyin: Tǐwēn zài zhège fànwéi nèi shì zhèngcháng de.
sentences.translation: A body temperature within this range is normal.

sentences.chinese: 电脑重新启动以后就正常了。
sentences.traditional: 電腦重新啟動以後就正常了。
sentences.pinyin: Diànnǎo chóngxīn qǐdòng yǐhòu jiù zhèngcháng le.
sentences.translation: After the computer restarted, it was normal again.

sentences.chinese: 我到车站时，车正好来了。
sentences.traditional: 我到車站時，車正好來了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dào chēzhàn shí, chē zhènghǎo lái le.
sentences.translation: When I arrived at the station, the bus came just in time.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套大小正好。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套大小正好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào dàxiǎo zhènghǎo.
sentences.translation: This coat is exactly the right size.

sentences.chinese: 我正好有两张票，可以一起去。
sentences.traditional: 我正好有兩張票，可以一起去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhènghǎo yǒu liǎng zhāng piào, kěyǐ yìqǐ qù.
sentences.translation: I happen to have two tickets, so we can go together.

sentences.chinese: 请出示您的证件。
sentences.traditional: 請出示您的證件。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng chūshì nín de zhèngjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please show your ID.

sentences.chinese: 入住旅馆时需要带有效证件。
sentences.traditional: 入住旅館時需要帶有效證件。
sentences.pinyin: Rùzhù lǚguǎn shí xūyào dài yǒuxiào zhèngjiàn.
sentences.translation: When checking into a hotel, you need to bring valid ID.

sentences.chinese: 我把重要证件放在包里。
sentences.traditional: 我把重要證件放在包裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhòngyào zhèngjiàn fàng zài bāo lǐ.
sentences.translation: I put the important documents in my bag.

sentences.chinese: 这份材料能证明他的能力。
sentences.traditional: 這份材料能證明他的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn cáiliào néng zhèngmíng tā de nénglì.
sentences.translation: This material can prove his ability.

sentences.chinese: 你需要提供工作证明。
sentences.traditional: 你需要提供工作證明。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào tígōng gōngzuò zhèngmíng.
sentences.translation: You need to provide proof of employment.

sentences.chinese: 事实证明，我们的判断是正确的。
sentences.traditional: 事實證明，我們的判斷是正確的。
sentences.pinyin: Shìshí zhèngmíng, wǒmen de pànduàn shì zhèngquè de.
sentences.translation: The facts prove that our judgement was correct.

sentences.chinese: 你的答案是正确的。
sentences.traditional: 你的答案是正確的。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de dá’àn shì zhèngquè de.
sentences.translation: Your answer is correct.

sentences.chinese: 请按照正确的顺序填写信息。
sentences.traditional: 請按照正確的順序填寫信息。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào zhèngquè de shùnxù tiánxiě xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Please fill in the information in the correct order.

sentences.chinese: 老师说这个说法不太正确。
sentences.traditional: 老師說這個說法不太正確。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhège shuōfǎ bú tài zhèngquè.
sentences.translation: The teacher said this way of saying it is not very correct.

sentences.chinese: 会议明天正式开始。
sentences.traditional: 會議明天正式開始。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì míngtiān zhèngshì kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: The meeting officially starts tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他收到了一封正式的邀请信。
sentences.traditional: 他收到了一封正式的邀請信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōudào le yì fēng zhèngshì de yāoqǐng xìn.
sentences.translation: He received a formal invitation letter.

sentences.chinese: 这个规定下周正式使用。
sentences.traditional: 這個規定下週正式使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guīdìng xià zhōu zhèngshì shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This rule will be used officially next week.

sentences.chinese: 成功之路并不容易。
sentences.traditional: 成功之路並不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Chénggōng zhī lù bìng bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: The road to success is not easy.

sentences.chinese: 艺术之美需要慢慢体会。
sentences.traditional: 藝術之美需要慢慢體會。
sentences.pinyin: Yìshù zhī měi xūyào mànmàn tǐhuì.
sentences.translation: The beauty of art needs to be appreciated slowly.

sentences.chinese: 未来之路要靠自己努力走。
sentences.traditional: 未來之路要靠自己努力走。
sentences.pinyin: Wèilái zhī lù yào kào zìjǐ nǔlì zǒu.
sentences.translation: The road ahead must be walked through one’s own effort.

sentences.chinese: 我支持你的决定。
sentences.traditional: 我支持你的決定。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhīchí nǐ de juédìng.
sentences.translation: I support your decision.

sentences.chinese: 这项工作需要大家的支持。
sentences.traditional: 這項工作需要大家的支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò xūyào dàjiā de zhīchí.
sentences.translation: This work needs everyone’s support.

sentences.chinese: 很多网友支持这个新的规定。
sentences.traditional: 很多網友支持這個新的規定。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō wǎngyǒu zhīchí zhège xīn de guīdìng.
sentences.translation: Many internet users support this new rule.

sentences.chinese: 请用手机支付费用。
sentences.traditional: 請用手機支付費用。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng yòng shǒujī zhīfù fèiyòng.
sentences.translation: Please pay the fee by mobile phone.

sentences.chinese: 他已经支付了全部房租。
sentences.traditional: 他已經支付了全部房租。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng zhīfù le quánbù fángzū.
sentences.translation: He has already paid all the rent.

sentences.chinese: 这个网页支持线上支付。
sentences.traditional: 這個網頁支持線上支付。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngyè zhīchí xiànshàng zhīfù.
sentences.translation: This webpage supports online payment.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束之后，大家一起去吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束之後，大家一起去吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù zhīhòu, dàjiā yìqǐ qù chīfàn.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, everyone went to eat together.

sentences.chinese: 我到家之后才发现钥匙不见了。
sentences.traditional: 我到家之後才發現鑰匙不見了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dào jiā zhīhòu cái fāxiàn yàoshi bú jiàn le.
sentences.translation: Only after I got home did I realise the key was missing.

sentences.chinese: 十点之后，图书馆就停止进入。
sentences.traditional: 十點之後，圖書館就停止進入。
sentences.pinyin: Shí diǎn zhīhòu, túshūguǎn jiù tíngzhǐ jìnrù.
sentences.translation: After ten o’clock, entry to the library stops.

sentences.chinese: 我们之间有很多共同的兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 我們之間有很多共同的興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhījiān yǒu hěn duō gòngtóng de xìngqù.
sentences.translation: There are many shared interests between us.

sentences.chinese: 城市之间的交通越来越方便。
sentences.traditional: 城市之間的交通越來越方便。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì zhījiān de jiāotōng yuè lái yuè fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: Transport between cities is becoming more and more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 这两个答案之间有什么区别？
sentences.traditional: 這兩個答案之間有什麼區別？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge dá’àn zhījiān yǒu shénme qūbié?
sentences.translation: What is the difference between these two answers?

sentences.chinese: 出发之前，请先检查护照和签证。
sentences.traditional: 出發之前，請先檢查護照和簽證。
sentences.pinyin: Chūfā zhīqián, qǐng xiān jiǎnchá hùzhào hé qiānzhèng.
sentences.translation: Before setting off, please check your passport and visa first.

sentences.chinese: 考试之前，他复习了所有课程。
sentences.traditional: 考試之前，他複習了所有課程。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì zhīqián, tā fùxí le suǒyǒu kèchéng.
sentences.translation: Before the exam, he revised all the courses.

sentences.chinese: 面试之前，我有点儿紧张。
sentences.traditional: 面試之前，我有點兒緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì zhīqián, wǒ yǒu diǎnr jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Before the interview, I was a bit nervous.

sentences.chinese: 阅读能帮助我们积累知识。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀能幫助我們積累知識。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú néng bāngzhù wǒmen jīlěi zhīshi.
sentences.translation: Reading can help us build up knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 这些基础知识非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 這些基礎知識非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē jīchǔ zhīshi fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This basic knowledge is very important.

sentences.chinese: 老师用简单的例子解释这个知识点。
sentences.traditional: 老師用簡單的例子解釋這個知識點。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng jiǎndān de lìzi jiěshì zhège zhīshi diǎn.
sentences.translation: The teacher used a simple example to explain this point of knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 在这些学生之中，他的口语最好。
sentences.traditional: 在這些學生之中，他的口語最好。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèxiē xuésheng zhīzhōng, tā de kǒuyǔ zuì hǎo.
sentences.translation: Among these students, his spoken Chinese is the best.

sentences.chinese: 生活之中常常会遇到困难。
sentences.traditional: 生活之中常常會遇到困難。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnghuó zhīzhōng chángcháng huì yùdào kùnnan.
sentences.translation: In life, one often meets difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 所有选择之中，我觉得这个最合适。
sentences.traditional: 所有選擇之中，我覺得這個最合適。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu xuǎnzé zhīzhōng, wǒ juéde zhège zuì héshì.
sentences.translation: Among all the choices, I think this one is the most suitable.

sentences.chinese: 这张票值多少钱？
sentences.traditional: 這張票值多少錢？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào zhí duōshao qián?
sentences.translation: How much is this ticket worth?

sentences.chinese: 这个旧手机不值一千元。
sentences.traditional: 這個舊手機不值一千元。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiù shǒujī bù zhí yì qiān yuán.
sentences.translation: This old mobile phone is not worth one thousand yuan.

sentences.chinese: 这份经历很值，因为我学到了很多。
sentences.traditional: 這份經歷很值，因為我學到了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn jīnglì hěn zhí, yīnwèi wǒ xué dào le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: This experience was really worth it because I learnt a lot.

sentences.chinese: 这个景点值得参观。
sentences.traditional: 這個景點值得參觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jǐngdiǎn zhídé cānguān.
sentences.translation: This scenic spot is worth visiting.

sentences.chinese: 这本书很值得阅读。
sentences.traditional: 這本書很值得閱讀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn zhídé yuèdú.
sentences.translation: This book is well worth reading.

sentences.chinese: 他的努力值得大家学习。
sentences.traditional: 他的努力值得大家學習。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de nǔlì zhídé dàjiā xuéxí.
sentences.translation: His hard work is worth everyone learning from.

sentences.chinese: 有问题可以直接联系我。
sentences.traditional: 有問題可以直接聯繫我。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ zhíjiē liánxì wǒ.
sentences.translation: If there is a problem, you can contact me directly.

sentences.chinese: 请把文件直接发给负责人。
sentences.traditional: 請把文件直接發給負責人。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn zhíjiē fā gěi fùzérén.
sentences.translation: Please send the file directly to the person in charge.

sentences.chinese: 他回答得很直接，没有绕来绕去。
sentences.traditional: 他回答得很直接，沒有繞來繞去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huídá de hěn zhíjiē, méiyǒu rào lái rào qù.
sentences.translation: He answered very directly and did not beat around the bush.

sentences.chinese: 森林里有很多不同的植物。
sentences.traditional: 森林裡有很多不同的植物。
sentences.pinyin: Sēnlín lǐ yǒu hěn duō bùtóng de zhíwù.
sentences.translation: There are many different plants in the forest.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物适合在温暖的地方生长。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物適合在溫暖的地方生長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù shìhé zài wēnnuǎn de dìfang shēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: This kind of plant is suitable for growing in warm places.

sentences.chinese: 请不要随便破坏景区里的植物。
sentences.traditional: 請不要隨便破壞景區裡的植物。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào suíbiàn pòhuài jǐngqū lǐ de zhíwù.
sentences.translation: Please do not casually damage the plants in the scenic area.

sentences.chinese: 教师是一种重要的职业。
sentences.traditional: 教師是一種重要的職業。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshī shì yì zhǒng zhòngyào de zhíyè.
sentences.translation: Teaching is an important profession.

sentences.chinese: 他想了解不同职业的工作内容。
sentences.traditional: 他想了解不同職業的工作內容。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng liǎojiě bùtóng zhíyè de gōngzuò nèiróng.
sentences.translation: He wants to understand the work content of different occupations.

sentences.chinese: 选择职业时，兴趣和能力都很重要。
sentences.traditional: 選擇職業時，興趣和能力都很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnzé zhíyè shí, xìngqù hé nénglì dōu hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When choosing a career, both interest and ability are important.

sentences.chinese: 老师指着地图上的那个城市。
sentences.traditional: 老師指著地圖上的那個城市。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐ zhe dìtú shang de nà ge chéngshì.
sentences.translation: The teacher pointed to that city on the map.

sentences.chinese: 请指给我看入口在哪里。
sentences.traditional: 請指給我看入口在哪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn rùkǒu zài nǎlǐ.
sentences.translation: Please point out to me where the entrance is.

sentences.chinese: 这里的“他”指的是谁？
sentences.traditional: 這裡的「他」指的是誰？
sentences.pinyin: Zhèli de “tā” zhǐ de shì shéi?
sentences.translation: Who does “he” refer to here?

sentences.chinese: 老师指出了我的语法错误。
sentences.traditional: 老師指出了我的語法錯誤。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐchū le wǒ de yǔfǎ cuòwù.
sentences.translation: The teacher pointed out my grammar mistake.

sentences.chinese: 请指出表格中不正确的地方。
sentences.traditional: 請指出表格中不正確的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zhǐchū biǎogé zhōng bù zhèngquè de dìfang.
sentences.translation: Please point out the incorrect places in the form.

sentences.chinese: 他直接指出了计划的问题。
sentences.traditional: 他直接指出了計劃的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhíjiē zhǐchū le jìhuà de wèntí.
sentences.translation: He directly pointed out the problem with the plan.

sentences.chinese: 外面下雨，我们只好取消比赛。
sentences.traditional: 外面下雨，我們只好取消比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià yǔ, wǒmen zhǐhǎo qǔxiāo bǐsài.
sentences.translation: It is raining outside, so we have to cancel the competition.

sentences.chinese: 没有公交车了，他只好走回家。
sentences.traditional: 沒有公交車了，他只好走回家。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu gōngjiāo chē le, tā zhǐhǎo zǒu huí jiā.
sentences.translation: There were no buses, so he had to walk home.

sentences.chinese: 时间不够，我只好提前离开。
sentences.traditional: 時間不夠，我只好提前離開。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān bù gòu, wǒ zhǐhǎo tíqián líkāi.
sentences.translation: There was not enough time, so I had to leave early.

sentences.chinese: 请给我一张纸巾。
sentences.traditional: 請給我一張紙巾。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì zhāng zhǐjīn.
sentences.translation: Please give me a tissue.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上没有纸巾了。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上沒有紙巾了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shang méiyǒu zhǐjīn le.
sentences.translation: There are no tissues left on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他用纸巾擦了擦手。
sentences.traditional: 他用紙巾擦了擦手。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng zhǐjīn cā le cā shǒu.
sentences.translation: He wiped his hands with a tissue.

sentences.chinese: 这件毛衣的质量很好。
sentences.traditional: 這件毛衣的質量很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn máoyī de zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: The quality of this jumper is very good.

sentences.chinese: 我们要提高服务质量。
sentences.traditional: 我們要提高服務質量。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào tígāo fúwù zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: We need to improve the quality of the service.

sentences.chinese: 价格低不一定代表质量差。
sentences.traditional: 價格低不一定代表質量差。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé dī bù yídìng dàibiǎo zhìliàng chà.
sentences.translation: A low price does not necessarily mean poor quality.

sentences.chinese: 这项工作至少需要三天。
sentences.traditional: 這項工作至少需要三天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò zhìshǎo xūyào sān tiān.
sentences.translation: This task needs at least three days.

sentences.chinese: 你每天至少要喝一杯水。
sentences.traditional: 你每天至少要喝一杯水。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān zhìshǎo yào hē yì bēi shuǐ.
sentences.translation: You should drink at least one glass of water every day.

sentences.chinese: 到机场至少要一个小时。
sentences.traditional: 到機場至少要一個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Dào jīchǎng zhìshǎo yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: It takes at least an hour to get to the airport.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭店的中餐很有名。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店的中餐很有名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de zhōngcān hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.translation: The Chinese food at this restaurant is very famous.

sentences.chinese: 我们今天午餐吃中餐。
sentences.traditional: 我們今天午餐吃中餐。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān wǔcān chī zhōngcān.
sentences.translation: We are having Chinese food for lunch today.

sentences.chinese: 他比以前更喜欢中餐了。
sentences.traditional: 他比以前更喜歡中餐了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǐ yǐqián gèng xǐhuan zhōngcān le.
sentences.translation: He likes Chinese food more than before.

sentences.chinese: 这位中年男士是我们的老师。
sentences.traditional: 這位中年男士是我們的老師。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhōngnián nánshì shì wǒmen de lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: This middle-aged gentleman is our teacher.

sentences.chinese: 到了中年以后，他更注意健康。
sentences.traditional: 到了中年以後，他更注意健康。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le zhōngnián yǐhòu, tā gèng zhùyì jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: After reaching middle age, he paid more attention to his health.

sentences.chinese: 很多中年人开始学习新技术。
sentences.traditional: 很多中年人開始學習新技術。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō zhōngnián rén kāishǐ xuéxí xīn jìshù.
sentences.translation: Many middle-aged people begin learning new technology.

sentences.chinese: 春天我们在院子里种花。
sentences.traditional: 春天我們在院子裡種花。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān wǒmen zài yuànzi li zhòng huā.
sentences.translation: In spring we plant flowers in the courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 他想在农村种一些蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 他想在農村種一些蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zài nóngcūn zhòng yì xiē shūcài.
sentences.translation: He wants to grow some vegetables in the countryside.

sentences.chinese: 这些植物不适合种在家里。
sentences.traditional: 這些植物不適合種在家裡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhíwù bù shìhé zhòng zài jiā li.
sentences.translation: These plants are not suitable for growing at home.

sentences.chinese: 这个箱子太重了，我抬不动。
sentences.traditional: 這個箱子太重了，我抬不動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi tài zhòng le, wǒ tái bu dòng.
sentences.translation: This box is too heavy; I cannot lift it.

sentences.chinese: 这份责任很重。
sentences.traditional: 這份責任很重。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn zérèn hěn zhòng.
sentences.translation: This responsibility is heavy.

sentences.chinese: 请不要把重东西放在桌子上。
sentences.traditional: 請不要把重東西放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào bǎ zhòng dōngxi fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
sentences.translation: Please do not put heavy things on the table.

sentences.chinese: 老师把语法作为今天的重点。
sentences.traditional: 老師把語法作為今天的重點。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ yǔfǎ zuòwéi jīntiān de zhòngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The teacher made grammar the key point for today.

sentences.chinese: 请把重点写在笔记里。
sentences.traditional: 請把重點寫在筆記裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bǐjì li.
sentences.translation: Please write the key points in your notes.

sentences.chinese: 这次会议重点讨论费用问题。
sentences.traditional: 這次會議重點討論費用問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì zhòngdiǎn tǎolùn fèiyong wèntí.
sentences.translation: This meeting will mainly discuss cost issues.

sentences.chinese: 学校很重视学生的听力训练。
sentences.traditional: 學校很重視學生的聽力訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào hěn zhòngshì xuésheng de tīnglì xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: The school pays great attention to students’ listening training.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该重视环境保护。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該重視環境保護。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zhòngshì huánjìng bǎohù.
sentences.translation: We should value environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 他越来越重视身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 他越來越重視身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuè lái yuè zhòngshì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: He pays more and more attention to his health.

sentences.chinese: 学校周围有很多小吃店。
sentences.traditional: 學校周圍有很多小吃店。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō xiǎochī diàn.
sentences.translation: There are many snack shops around the school.

sentences.chinese: 请看看周围有没有停车场。
sentences.traditional: 請看看周圍有沒有停車場。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng kànkan zhōuwéi yǒu méiyǒu tíngchēchǎng.
sentences.translation: Please check whether there is a car park nearby.

sentences.chinese: 他对周围的情况很熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 他對周圍的情況很熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhōuwéi de qíngkuàng hěn shúxi.
sentences.translation: He is very familiar with the surrounding situation.

sentences.chinese: 这个主意听起来不错。
sentences.traditional: 這個主意聽起來不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhǔyi tīng qǐlái búcuò.
sentences.translation: This idea sounds quite good.

sentences.chinese: 我还没想出好主意。
sentences.traditional: 我還沒想出好主意。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi xiǎng chū hǎo zhǔyi.
sentences.translation: I still have not thought of a good idea.

sentences.chinese: 大家一起商量，最后有了一个主意。
sentences.traditional: 大家一起商量，最後有了一個主意。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā yìqǐ shāngliang, zuìhòu yǒu le yí ge zhǔyi.
sentences.translation: Everyone discussed it together and finally came up with an idea.

sentences.chinese: 祝你考试顺利。
sentences.traditional: 祝你考試順利。
sentences.pinyin: Zhù nǐ kǎoshì shùnlì.
sentences.translation: I wish you success in the exam.

sentences.chinese: 我祝他们旅行愉快。
sentences.traditional: 我祝他們旅行愉快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhù tāmen lǚxíng yúkuài.
sentences.translation: I wish them a pleasant trip.

sentences.chinese: 老师祝每位学生新年快乐。
sentences.traditional: 老師祝每位學生新年快樂。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhù měi wèi xuésheng xīnnián kuàilè.
sentences.translation: The teacher wished every student a happy New Year.

sentences.chinese: 我们祝贺他取得好成绩。
sentences.traditional: 我們祝賀他取得好成績。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhùhè tā qǔdé hǎo chéngjì.
sentences.translation: We congratulated him on getting a good result.

sentences.chinese: 大家都来祝贺她获奖。
sentences.traditional: 大家都來祝賀她獲獎。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu lái zhùhè tā huòjiǎng.
sentences.translation: Everyone came to congratulate her on winning the prize.

sentences.chinese: 这封信是为了祝贺你毕业。
sentences.traditional: 這封信是為了祝賀你畢業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn shì wèile zhùhè nǐ bìyè.
sentences.translation: This letter is to congratulate you on graduating.

sentences.chinese: 这是一位著名的京剧演员。
sentences.traditional: 這是一位著名的京劇演員。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí wèi zhùmíng de jīngjù yǎnyuán.
sentences.translation: This is a famous Beijing opera actor.

sentences.chinese: 这个景点在当地很著名。
sentences.traditional: 這個景點在當地很著名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jǐngdiǎn zài dāngdì hěn zhùmíng.
sentences.translation: This scenic spot is very famous locally.

sentences.chinese: 他写过几篇著名的文章。
sentences.traditional: 他寫過幾篇著名的文章。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě guo jǐ piān zhùmíng de wénzhāng.
sentences.translation: He has written several famous articles.

sentences.chinese: 我专门来找你商量这件事。
sentences.traditional: 我專門來找你商量這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhuānmén lái zhǎo nǐ shāngliang zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: I came specially to discuss this matter with you.

sentences.chinese: 这家店专门卖巧克力。
sentences.traditional: 這家店專門賣巧克力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhuānmén mài qiǎokèlì.
sentences.translation: This shop specialises in selling chocolate.

sentences.chinese: 学校开了一个专门的口语课程。
sentences.traditional: 學校開了一個專門的口語課程。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào kāi le yí ge zhuānmén de kǒuyǔ kèchéng.
sentences.translation: The school has opened a special spoken-language course.

sentences.chinese: 他的专业是国际经济。
sentences.traditional: 他的專業是國際經濟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zhuānyè shì guójì jīngjì.
sentences.translation: His major is international economics.

sentences.chinese: 这位律师非常专业。
sentences.traditional: 這位律師非常專業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǜshī fēicháng zhuānyè.
sentences.translation: This lawyer is very professional.

sentences.chinese: 我想了解这个专业的课程。
sentences.traditional: 我想了解這個專業的課程。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng liǎojiě zhège zhuānyè de kèchéng.
sentences.translation: I want to learn about the courses for this major.

sentences.chinese: 请在下一个路口向左转。
sentences.traditional: 請在下一個路口向左轉。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài xià yí ge lùkǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn.
sentences.translation: Please turn left at the next junction.

sentences.chinese: 他把文件转给了负责人。
sentences.traditional: 他把文件轉給了負責人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wénjiàn zhuǎn gěi le fùzérén.
sentences.translation: He transferred the document to the person in charge.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题很快转到了费用方面。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題很快轉到了費用方面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn kuài zhuǎn dào le fèiyong fāngmiàn.
sentences.translation: This issue soon turned to the matter of costs.

sentences.chinese: 我把会议通知转发给了同事。
sentences.traditional: 我把會議通知轉發給了同事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ huìyì tōngzhī zhuǎnfā gěi le tóngshì.
sentences.translation: I forwarded the meeting notice to my colleagues.

sentences.chinese: 这条消息请不要随便转发。
sentences.traditional: 這條消息請不要隨便轉發。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiāoxi qǐng bú yào suíbiàn zhuǎnfā.
sentences.translation: Please do not forward this message casually.

sentences.chinese: 他把老师的要求转发到小组里。
sentences.traditional: 他把老師的要求轉發到小組裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǎoshī de yāoqiú zhuǎnfā dào xiǎozǔ lǐ.
sentences.translation: He forwarded the teacher’s requirements to the group.

sentences.chinese: 我们要在北京转机。
sentences.traditional: 我們要在北京轉機。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zài Běijīng zhuǎnjī.
sentences.translation: We need to change planes in Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 这次转机时间只有两个小时。
sentences.traditional: 這次轉機時間只有兩個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì zhuǎnjī shíjiān zhǐ yǒu liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: The transfer time this time is only two hours.

sentences.chinese: 如果航班晚到，转机就来不及了。
sentences.traditional: 如果航班晚到，轉機就來不及了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ hángbān wǎn dào, zhuǎnjī jiù láibují le.
sentences.translation: If the flight arrives late, there will not be enough time to transfer.

sentences.chinese: 他暑假打工赚了一些钱。
sentences.traditional: 他暑假打工賺了一些錢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǔjià dǎgōng zhuàn le yìxiē qián.
sentences.translation: He earned some money from working during the summer holiday.

sentences.chinese: 这家店每个月能赚不少。
