sentences.traditional: 這家店每個月能賺不少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn měi ge yuè néng zhuàn bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: This shop can earn quite a lot every month.

sentences.chinese: 赚钱不容易，花钱要仔细。
sentences.traditional: 賺錢不容易，花錢要仔細。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuàn qián bù róngyì, huā qián yào zǐxì.
sentences.translation: Earning money is not easy, so you should spend it carefully.

sentences.chinese: 请把这些资料装进包里。
sentences.traditional: 請把這些資料裝進包裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē zīliào zhuāng jìn bāo lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please pack these materials into the bag.

sentences.chinese: 电脑需要重新装这个软件。
sentences.traditional: 電腦需要重新裝這個軟件。
sentences.pinyin: Diànnǎo xūyào chóngxīn zhuāng zhège ruǎnjiàn.
sentences.translation: The computer needs this software installed again.

sentences.chinese: 他装作没有听见我的话。
sentences.traditional: 他裝作沒有聽見我的話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhuāngzuò méiyǒu tīngjiàn wǒ de huà.
sentences.translation: He pretended not to hear what I said.

sentences.chinese: 这个表的时间很准。
sentences.traditional: 這個表的時間很準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège biǎo de shíjiān hěn zhǔn.
sentences.translation: The time on this watch is very accurate.

sentences.chinese: 天气预报说得不太准。
sentences.traditional: 天氣預報說得不太準。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō de bú tài zhǔn.
sentences.translation: The weather forecast is not very accurate.

sentences.chinese: 你放心，他明天准会来。
sentences.traditional: 你放心，他明天準會來。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, tā míngtiān zhǔn huì lái.
sentences.translation: Do not worry; he will definitely come tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 请给我一个准确的地址。
sentences.traditional: 請給我一個準確的地址。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yí ge zhǔnquè de dìzhǐ.
sentences.translation: Please give me an accurate address.

sentences.chinese: 他的判断非常准确。
sentences.traditional: 他的判斷非常準確。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de pànduàn fēicháng zhǔnquè.
sentences.translation: His judgement is very accurate.

sentences.chinese: 这份资料里的数字不够准确。
sentences.traditional: 這份資料裡的數字不夠準確。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn zīliào lǐ de shùzì bú gòu zhǔnquè.
sentences.translation: The figures in this material are not accurate enough.

sentences.chinese: 请大家明天准时到课堂。
sentences.traditional: 請大家明天準時到課堂。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā míngtiān zhǔnshí dào kètáng.
sentences.translation: Please arrive at the classroom on time tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他做事很准时，从来不迟到。
sentences.traditional: 他做事很準時，從來不遲到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò shì hěn zhǔnshí, cónglái bù chídào.
sentences.translation: He is very punctual and never arrives late.

sentences.chinese: 火车一般都准时出发。
sentences.traditional: 火車一般都準時出發。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē yìbān dōu zhǔnshí chūfā.
sentences.translation: Trains generally depart on time.

sentences.chinese: 老师把学习资料发给了学生。
sentences.traditional: 老師把學習資料發給了學生。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ xuéxí zīliào fā gěi le xuéshēng.
sentences.translation: The teacher sent the study materials to the students.

sentences.chinese: 这些资料对研究很重要。
sentences.traditional: 這些資料對研究很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīliào duì yánjiū hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: These materials are very important for the research.

sentences.chinese: 申请签证前，要准备好资料。
sentences.traditional: 申請簽證前，要準備好資料。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng qián, yào zhǔnbèi hǎo zīliào.
sentences.translation: Before applying for a visa, you need to prepare the documents.

sentences.chinese: 请你仔细看看这份文件。
sentences.traditional: 請你仔細看看這份文件。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zǐxì kànkan zhè fèn wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please look over this document carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他做事很仔细，很少出错。
sentences.traditional: 他做事很仔細，很少出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò shì hěn zǐxì, hěn shǎo chū cuò.
sentences.translation: He does things carefully and rarely makes mistakes.

sentences.chinese: 考试前，我仔细检查了答案。
sentences.traditional: 考試前，我仔細檢查了答案。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì qián, wǒ zǐxì jiǎnchá le dá’àn.
sentences.translation: Before the exam, I checked the answers carefully.

sentences.chinese: 自去年起，他一直住在上海。
sentences.traditional: 自去年起，他一直住在上海。
sentences.pinyin: Zì qùnián qǐ, tā yìzhí zhù zài Shànghǎi.
sentences.translation: Since last year, he has been living in Shanghai.

sentences.chinese: 这本书自第一章开始就很有趣。
sentences.traditional: 這本書自第一章開始就很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zì dì-yī zhāng kāishǐ jiù hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.translation: This book is interesting from the first chapter.

sentences.chinese: 请自入口进入，不要从出口进。
sentences.traditional: 請自入口進入，不要從出口進。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zì rùkǒu jìnrù, bú yào cóng chūkǒu jìn.
sentences.translation: Please enter from the entrance, not from the exit.

sentences.chinese: 保护自然环境是我们的责任。
sentences.traditional: 保護自然環境是我們的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù zìrán huánjìng shì wǒmen de zérèn.
sentences.translation: Protecting the natural environment is our responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 她说话的样子很自然。
sentences.traditional: 她說話的樣子很自然。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de yàngzi hěn zìrán.
sentences.translation: Her way of speaking is very natural.

sentences.chinese: 如果你认真准备，面试时自然会更自信。
sentences.traditional: 如果你認真準備，面試時自然會更自信。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ rènzhēn zhǔnbèi, miànshì shí zìrán huì gèng zìxìn.
sentences.translation: If you prepare carefully, you will naturally be more confident in the interview.

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上我在图书馆自习。
sentences.traditional: 今天晚上我在圖書館自習。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ zài túshūguǎn zìxí.
sentences.translation: Tonight I am studying on my own in the library.

sentences.chinese: 考试前，很多学生都会自习到很晚。
sentences.traditional: 考試前，很多學生都會自習到很晚。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì qián, hěn duō xuésheng dōu huì zìxí dào hěn wǎn.
sentences.translation: Before exams, many students study on their own until very late.

sentences.chinese: 老师不在的时候，大家也要安静地自习。
sentences.traditional: 老師不在的時候，大家也要安靜地自習。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bú zài de shíhou, dàjiā yě yào ānjìng de zìxí.
sentences.translation: When the teacher is not there, everyone should still study quietly on their own.

sentences.chinese: 通过不断练习，他对口语更自信了。
sentences.traditional: 通過不斷練習，他對口語更自信了。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò búduàn liànxí, tā duì kǒuyǔ gèng zìxìn le.
sentences.translation: Through constant practice, he has become more confident in spoken Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 面试时保持自信很重要。
sentences.traditional: 面試時保持自信很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì shí bǎochí zìxìn hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: It is important to stay confident during an interview.

sentences.chinese: 这次成功给了她很大的自信。
sentences.traditional: 這次成功給了她很大的自信。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì chénggōng gěi le tā hěn dà de zìxìn.
sentences.translation: This success gave her a lot of confidence.

sentences.chinese: 他利用暑假自学了很多语法。
sentences.traditional: 他利用暑假自學了很多語法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lìyòng shǔjià zìxué le hěn duō yǔfǎ.
sentences.translation: He used the summer holiday to teach himself a lot of grammar.

sentences.chinese: 自学需要明确的目标和计划。
sentences.traditional: 自學需要明確的目標和計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Zìxué xūyào míngquè de mùbiāo hé jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Self-study requires clear goals and plans.

sentences.chinese: 我通过网课自学普通话。
sentences.traditional: 我通過網課自學普通話。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tōngguò wǎngkè zìxué pǔtōnghuà.
sentences.translation: I taught myself Mandarin through online lessons.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，请你总结一下重点。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，請你總結一下重點。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, qǐng nǐ zǒngjié yíxià zhòngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ends, please summarise the key points.

sentences.chinese: 老师的总结帮助我们理解了内容。
sentences.traditional: 老師的總結幫助我們理解了內容。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de zǒngjié bāngzhù wǒmen lǐjiě le nèiróng.
sentences.translation: The teacher’s summary helped us understand the content.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章最后总结了三个原因。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章最後總結了三個原因。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng zuìhòu zǒngjié le sān ge yuányīn.
sentences.translation: This article finally summarised three reasons.

sentences.chinese: 我们想在学校附近租一套房子。
sentences.traditional: 我們想在學校附近租一套房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎng zài xuéxiào fùjìn zū yí tào fángzi.
sentences.translation: We want to rent a flat near the school.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车可以按天租。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車可以按天租。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē kěyǐ àn tiān zū.
sentences.translation: This car can be rented by the day.

sentences.chinese: 他在市区租了一个小办公室。
sentences.traditional: 他在市區租了一個小辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài shìqū zū le yí ge xiǎo bàngōngshì.
sentences.translation: He rented a small office in the city centre.

sentences.chinese: 我们组负责调查这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 我們組負責調查這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǔ fùzé diàochá zhège wèntí.
sentences.translation: Our group is responsible for investigating this problem.

sentences.chinese: 老师把学生分为四组。
sentences.traditional: 老師把學生分為四組。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ xuésheng fēnwéi sì zǔ.
sentences.translation: The teacher divided the students into four groups.

sentences.chinese: 这组数字非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 這組數字非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zǔ shùzì fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This set of numbers is very important.

sentences.chinese: 经过商量，我们最终决定提前出发。
sentences.traditional: 經過商量，我們最終決定提前出發。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò shāngliang, wǒmen zuìzhōng juédìng tíqián chūfā.
sentences.translation: After discussing it, we finally decided to set off early.

sentences.chinese: 他的努力最终取得了成功。
sentences.traditional: 他的努力最終取得了成功。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de nǔlì zuìzhōng qǔdé le chénggōng.
sentences.translation: His effort finally achieved success.

sentences.chinese: 最终结果会在月底公布。
sentences.traditional: 最終結果會在月底公佈。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìzhōng jiéguǒ huì zài yuèdǐ gōngbù.
sentences.translation: The final result will be announced at the end of the month.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该尊重不同的意见。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該尊重不同的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng bùtóng de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: We should respect different opinions.

sentences.chinese: 他很尊重父母的决定。
sentences.traditional: 他很尊重父母的決定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn zūnzhòng fùmǔ de juédìng.
sentences.translation: He respects his parents’ decision very much.

sentences.chinese: 有礼貌的人懂得尊重别人。
sentences.traditional: 有禮貌的人懂得尊重別人。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu lǐmào de rén dǒngde zūnzhòng biérén.
sentences.translation: Polite people know how to respect others.

sentences.chinese: 这件毛衣一百元左右。
sentences.traditional: 這件毛衣一百元左右。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn máoyī yì bǎi yuán zuǒyòu.
sentences.translation: This sweater is about one hundred yuan.

sentences.chinese: 会议十分钟左右就结束了。
sentences.traditional: 會議十分鐘左右就結束了。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shí fēnzhōng zuǒyòu jiù jiéshù le.
sentences.translation: The meeting ended after about ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他看了看左右，然后过了马路。
sentences.traditional: 他看了看左右，然後過了馬路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn le kan zuǒyòu, ránhòu guò le mǎlù.
sentences.translation: He looked left and right, then crossed the road.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的变化很大。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的變化很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà.
sentences.translation: This city has changed a lot.

sentences.chinese: 公园里有一座漂亮的小桥。
sentences.traditional: 公園裡有一座漂亮的小橋。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu yí zuò piàoliang de xiǎo qiáo.
sentences.translation: There is a pretty small bridge in the park.

sentences.chinese: 火车上没有空座了。
sentences.traditional: 火車上沒有空座了。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē shàng méiyǒu kōng zuò le.
sentences.translation: There are no empty seats left on the train.

sentences.chinese: 这种做法不太公平。
sentences.traditional: 這種做法不太公平。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ bù tài gōngpíng.
sentences.translation: This way of doing things is not very fair.

sentences.chinese: 你能介绍一下你的做法吗？
sentences.traditional: 你能介紹一下你的做法嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng jièshào yíxià nǐ de zuòfǎ ma?
sentences.translation: Can you explain your method?

sentences.chinese: 他的做法让大家都很满意。
sentences.traditional: 他的做法讓大家都很滿意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zuòfǎ ràng dàjiā dōu hěn mǎnyì.
sentences.translation: His approach made everyone very satisfied.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家写过很多儿童故事。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家寫過很多兒童故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā xiě guo hěn duō értóng gùshi.
sentences.translation: This writer has written many children’s stories.

sentences.chinese: 她的梦想是成为一名作家。
sentences.traditional: 她的夢想是成為一名作家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì chéngwéi yì míng zuòjiā.
sentences.translation: Her dream is to become a writer.

sentences.chinese: 我们学校请来了一位有名的作家。
sentences.traditional: 我們學校請來了一位有名的作家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào qǐng lái le yí wèi yǒumíng de zuòjiā.
sentences.translation: Our school invited a famous writer.

sentences.chinese: 我昨晚做梦了，梦见自己在海边。
sentences.traditional: 我昨晚做夢了，夢見自己在海邊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn zuòmèng le, mèngjiàn zìjǐ zài hǎibiān.
sentences.translation: I had a dream last night and dreamt that I was by the sea.

sentences.chinese: 他常常做梦都在想这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 他常常做夢都在想這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángcháng zuòmèng dōu zài xiǎng zhège wèntí.
sentences.translation: He thinks about this problem even in his dreams.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子做梦的时候可能会说话。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子做夢的時候可能會說話。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo háizi zuòmèng de shíhou kěnéng huì shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: Children may talk when they are dreaming.

sentences.chinese: 这幅画是他的早期作品。
sentences.traditional: 這幅畫是他的早期作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú huà shì tā de zǎoqī zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: This painting is one of his early works.

sentences.chinese: 学生们把自己的作品放在桌上。
sentences.traditional: 學生們把自己的作品放在桌上。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshengmen bǎ zìjǐ de zuòpǐn fàng zài zhuō shàng.
sentences.translation: The students put their own works on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这部作品受到了很多读者的欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這部作品受到了很多讀者的歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù zuòpǐn shòudào le hěn duō dúzhě de huānyíng.
sentences.translation: This work was welcomed by many readers.

sentences.chinese: 作为老师，他对学生很负责。
sentences.traditional: 作為老師，他對學生很負責。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi lǎoshī, tā duì xuésheng hěn fùzé.
sentences.translation: As a teacher, he is very responsible towards his students.

sentences.chinese: 这间房间可以作为办公室使用。
sentences.traditional: 這間房間可以作為辦公室使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiān fángjiān kěyǐ zuòwéi bàngōngshì shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This room can be used as an office.

sentences.chinese: 他把帮助别人作为自己的责任。
sentences.traditional: 他把幫助別人作為自己的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ bāngzhù biérén zuòwéi zìjǐ de zérèn.
sentences.translation: He treats helping others as his own responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 请把你的座位号告诉我。
sentences.traditional: 請把你的座位號告訴我。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de zuòwèi hào gàosu wǒ.
sentences.translation: Please tell me your seat number.

sentences.chinese: 公共汽车上还有几个空座位。
sentences.traditional: 公共汽車上還有幾個空座位。
sentences.pinyin: Gōnggòng qìchē shàng hái yǒu jǐ ge kōng zuòwèi.
sentences.translation: There are still a few empty seats on the bus.

sentences.chinese: 我们提前订好了靠窗的座位。
sentences.traditional: 我們提前訂好了靠窗的座位。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen tíqián dìng hǎo le kào chuāng de zuòwèi.
sentences.translation: We booked window seats in advance.

sentences.chinese: 今天的作业是写一篇作文。
sentences.traditional: 今天的作業是寫一篇作文。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yì piān zuòwén.
sentences.translation: Today’s homework is to write a composition.

sentences.chinese: 这篇作文写得很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這篇作文寫得很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān zuòwén xiě de hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This composition is written in a very interesting way.

sentences.chinese: 他正在认真地写作文。
sentences.traditional: 他正在認真地寫作文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài rènzhēn de xiě zuòwén.
sentences.translation: He is carefully writing a composition.

sentences.chinese: 这种药很快就会起作用。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥很快就會起作用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào hěn kuài jiù huì qǐ zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: This medicine will take effect very soon.

sentences.chinese: 运动对健康有很大的作用。
sentences.traditional: 運動對健康有很大的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng duì jiànkāng yǒu hěn dà de zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Exercise has a great effect on health.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法的作用是节省时间。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法的作用是節省時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ de zuòyòng shì jiéshěng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The function of this method is to save time.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的作者是谁？
sentences.traditional: 這本書的作者是誰？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de zuòzhě shì shéi?
sentences.translation: Who is the author of this book?

sentences.chinese: 作者在文章中提出了一个重要问题。
sentences.traditional: 作者在文章中提出了一個重要問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòzhě zài wénzhāng zhōng tíchū le yí ge zhòngyào wèntí.
sentences.translation: The author raised an important question in the article.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该尊重作者的想法。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該尊重作者的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng zuòzhě de xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: We should respect the author’s ideas.

sentences.chinese: 哎，你听说了吗？明天的会议提前到九点。
sentences.traditional: 哎，你聽說了嗎？明天的會議提前到九點。
sentences.pinyin: Āi, nǐ tīngshuō le ma? Míngtiān de huìyì tíqián dào jiǔ diǎn.
sentences.translation: Hey, did you hear? Tomorrow’s meeting has been moved forward to nine.

sentences.chinese: 哎，这个办法虽然麻烦，但至少能解决眼前的问题。
sentences.traditional: 哎，這個辦法雖然麻煩，但至少能解決眼前的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Āi, zhège bànfǎ suīrán máfan, dàn zhìshǎo néng jiějué yǎnqián de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Hey, this approach is troublesome, but at least it can solve the immediate problem.

sentences.chinese: 哎，别急着下结论，我们先把情况调查清楚。
sentences.traditional: 哎，別急著下結論，我們先把情況調查清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Āi, bié jízhe xià jiélùn, wǒmen xiān bǎ qíngkuàng diàochá qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Hey, don’t rush to a conclusion; let’s investigate the situation first.

sentences.chinese: 哎呀，我差点把护照落在出租车上。
sentences.traditional: 哎呀，我差點把護照落在出租車上。
sentences.pinyin: Āiyā, wǒ chàdiǎn bǎ hùzhào là zài chūzūchē shang.
sentences.translation: Oh my, I almost left my passport in the taxi.

sentences.chinese: 哎呀，原来问题出在这里，难怪系统一直安装失败。
sentences.traditional: 哎呀，原來問題出在這裡，難怪系統一直安裝失敗。
sentences.pinyin: Āiyā, yuánlái wèntí chū zài zhèlǐ, nánguài xìtǒng yìzhí ānzhuāng shībài.
sentences.translation: Ah, so that’s where the problem is; no wonder the system kept failing to install.

sentences.chinese: 哎呀，你把数据删掉之前，应该先备份一份。
sentences.traditional: 哎呀，你把數據刪掉之前，應該先備份一份。
sentences.pinyin: Āiyā, nǐ bǎ shùjù shān diào zhīqián, yīnggāi xiān bèifèn yí fèn.
sentences.translation: Oh no, before deleting the data, you should have backed up a copy.

sentences.chinese: 唉，这件事已经发生了，后悔也没有用。
sentences.traditional: 唉，這件事已經發生了，後悔也沒有用。
sentences.pinyin: Ài, zhè jiàn shì yǐjīng fāshēng le, hòuhuǐ yě méiyǒu yòng.
sentences.translation: Alas, this has already happened, so regret is no use.

sentences.chinese: 唉，如果当时多检查一遍，就不会造成这么大的损失。
sentences.traditional: 唉，如果當時多檢查一遍，就不會造成這麼大的損失。
sentences.pinyin: Ài, rúguǒ dāngshí duō jiǎnchá yí biàn, jiù bú huì zàochéng zhème dà de sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: Oh, if we had checked once more at the time, it would not have caused such a big loss.

sentences.chinese: 唉，他努力了这么久，结果还是没通过考试。
sentences.traditional: 唉，他努力了這麼久，結果還是沒通過考試。
sentences.pinyin: Ài, tā nǔlì le zhème jiǔ, jiéguǒ háishi méi tōngguò kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: Alas, he worked hard for so long, but in the end he still didn’t pass the exam.

sentences.chinese: 作为市民，我们应该爱护公共环境，而不是随手乱扔垃圾。
sentences.traditional: 作為市民，我們應該愛護公共環境，而不是隨手亂扔垃圾。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi shìmín, wǒmen yīnggāi àihù gōnggòng huánjìng, ér bú shì suíshǒu luàn rēng lājī.
sentences.translation: As citizens, we should take good care of the public environment, rather than casually throwing rubbish around.

sentences.chinese: 这台设备很贵，使用时一定要爱护，不能随便碰。
sentences.traditional: 這臺設備很貴，使用時一定要愛護，不能隨便碰。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái shèbèi hěn guì, shǐyòng shí yídìng yào àihù, bù néng suíbiàn pèng.
sentences.translation: This piece of equipment is expensive; you must take care when using it and not touch it carelessly.

sentences.chinese: 老师提醒学生要爱护图书馆里的书，借走后按时归还。
sentences.traditional: 老師提醒學生要愛護圖書館裡的書，借走後按時歸還。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuésheng yào àihù túshūguǎn lǐ de shū, jiè zǒu hòu ànshí guīhuán.
sentences.translation: The teacher reminded the students to take care of the books in the library and return them on time after borrowing them.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息后，他那颗悬着的心终于安了下来。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息後，他那顆懸著的心終於安了下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi hòu, tā nà kē xuánzhe de xīn zhōngyú ān le xiàlai.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news, his anxious heart finally settled down.

sentences.chinese: 母亲轻轻拍着孩子的背，把他安了下来。
sentences.traditional: 母親輕輕拍著孩子的背，把他安了下來。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn qīngqīng pāizhe háizi de bèi, bǎ tā ān le xiàlai.
sentences.translation: The mother gently patted the child’s back and calmed him down.

sentences.chinese: 听完他的解释，大家才安了心，不再继续争论。
sentences.traditional: 聽完他的解釋，大家才安了心，不再繼續爭論。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngwán tā de jiěshì, dàjiā cái ān le xīn, bú zài jìxù zhēnglùn.
sentences.translation: Only after hearing his explanation did everyone feel reassured and stop arguing.

sentences.chinese: 上车以后，请先系好安全带，再让司机出发。
sentences.traditional: 上車以後，請先繫好安全帶，再讓司機出發。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng chē yǐhòu, qǐng xiān jì hǎo ānquándài, zài ràng sījī chūfā.
sentences.translation: After getting in the car, please fasten your seatbelt before letting the driver set off.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车会提醒乘客没有系安全带。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車會提醒乘客沒有繫安全帶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē huì tíxǐng chéngkè méiyǒu jì ānquándài.
sentences.translation: This car will remind passengers when they have not fastened their seatbelt.

sentences.chinese: 发生事故时，安全带能减少受伤的可能。
sentences.traditional: 發生事故時，安全帶能減少受傷的可能。
sentences.pinyin: Fāshēng shìgù shí, ānquándài néng jiǎnshǎo shòushāng de kěnéng.
sentences.translation: When an accident happens, a seatbelt can reduce the chance of injury.

sentences.chinese: 朋友失去工作后，她陪他聊了一晚上，尽量安慰他。
sentences.traditional: 朋友失去工作後，她陪他聊了一晚上，儘量安慰他。
sentences.pinyin: Péngyou shīqù gōngzuò hòu, tā péi tā liáo le yí wǎnshang, jǐnliàng ānwèi tā.
sentences.translation: After her friend lost his job, she talked with him all evening and tried her best to comfort him.

sentences.chinese: 这封信虽然很短，却给了我很大的安慰。
sentences.traditional: 這封信雖然很短，卻給了我很大的安慰。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn suīrán hěn duǎn, què gěi le wǒ hěn dà de ānwèi.
sentences.translation: Although this letter was short, it gave me great comfort.

sentences.chinese: 别只说空话安慰别人，真正的帮助更重要。
sentences.traditional: 別只說空話安慰別人，真正的幫助更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhǐ shuō kōnghuà ānwèi biéren, zhēnzhèng de bāngzhù gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Don’t just comfort people with empty words; real help is more important.

sentences.chinese: 新买的空调需要专业人员上门安装。
sentences.traditional: 新買的空調需要專業人員上門安裝。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn mǎi de kōngtiáo xūyào zhuānyè rényuán shàngmén ānzhuāng.
sentences.translation: The newly bought air conditioner needs a professional to come and install it.

sentences.chinese: 软件安装完成以后，记得重新启动电脑。
sentences.traditional: 軟件安裝完成以後，記得重新啟動電腦。
sentences.pinyin: Ruǎnjiàn ānzhuāng wánchéng yǐhòu, jìde chóngxīn qǐdòng diànnǎo.
sentences.translation: After the software has finished installing, remember to restart the computer.

sentences.chinese: 如果设备没有按照说明安装，可能会影响安全。
sentences.traditional: 如果設備沒有按照說明安裝，可能會影響安全。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shèbèi méiyǒu ànzhào shuōmíng ānzhuāng, kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng ānquán.
sentences.translation: If the equipment is not installed according to the instructions, it may affect safety.

sentences.chinese: 天色越来越暗，我们最好早点下山。
sentences.traditional: 天色越來越暗，我們最好早點下山。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānsè yuè lái yuè àn, wǒmen zuìhǎo zǎodiǎn xià shān.
sentences.translation: The sky is getting darker and darker; we had better go down the mountain earlier.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间太暗，长时间看书会伤眼睛。
sentences.traditional: 這個房間太暗，長時間看書會傷眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān tài àn, cháng shíjiān kàn shū huì shāng yǎnjing.
sentences.translation: This room is too dark; reading for a long time will hurt your eyes.

sentences.chinese: 屏幕调得太暗，很多细节都看不清楚。
sentences.traditional: 屏幕調得太暗，很多細節都看不清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Píngmù tiáo de tài àn, hěn duō xìjié dōu kàn bu qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The screen is set too dark, so many details cannot be seen clearly.

sentences.chinese: 为了赶报告，他连续两天熬夜，结果身体吃不消。
sentences.traditional: 為了趕報告，他連續兩天熬夜，結果身體吃不消。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile gǎn bàogào, tā liánxù liǎng tiān áoyè, jiéguǒ shēntǐ chībuxiāo.
sentences.translation: In order to finish the report, he stayed up late for two days in a row, and in the end his body could not cope.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议她少熬夜，否则身体会越来越差。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議她少熬夜，否則身體會越來越差。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā shǎo áoyè, fǒuzé shēntǐ huì yuè lái yuè chà.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised her to stay up late less, otherwise her health would get worse and worse.

sentences.chinese: 偶尔熬夜问题不大，但长期熬夜会影响工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 偶爾熬夜問題不大，但長期熬夜會影響工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Ǒu'ěr áoyè wèntí bú dà, dàn chángqī áoyè huì yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Staying up late occasionally is not a big problem, but doing it long term will affect work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 只要把握住这次机会，公司就有可能进入新的市场。
sentences.traditional: 只要把握住這次機會，公司就有可能進入新的市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào bǎwò zhù zhè cì jīhuì, gōngsī jiù yǒu kěnéng jìnrù xīn de shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: As long as we seize this opportunity, the company may enter a new market.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然准备得很充分，但对结果仍然没有完全的把握。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然準備得很充分，但對結果仍然沒有完全的把握。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán zhǔnbèi de hěn chōngfèn, dàn duì jiéguǒ réngrán méiyǒu wánquán de bǎwò.
sentences.translation: Although he was well prepared, he still wasn’t completely certain about the result.

sentences.chinese: 和客户谈条件时，必须把握好语气，既要坚定，也要礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 和客戶談條件時，必須把握好語氣，既要堅定，也要禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Hé kèhù tán tiáojiàn shí, bìxū bǎwò hǎo yǔqì, jì yào jiāndìng, yě yào lǐmào.
sentences.translation: When negotiating terms with a customer, you must handle the tone well: firm but polite.

sentences.chinese: 窗外下了一夜雪，早上整个院子都变白了。
sentences.traditional: 窗外下了一夜雪，早上整個院子都變白了。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài xià le yí yè xuě, zǎoshang zhěnggè yuànzi dōu biàn bái le.
sentences.translation: It snowed outside all night, and by morning the whole courtyard had turned white.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有提前预约，我们很可能会白跑一趟。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有提前預約，我們很可能會白跑一趟。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu tíqián yùyuē, wǒmen hěn kěnéng huì bái pǎo yí tàng.
sentences.translation: Without booking in advance, we may well make the trip for nothing.

sentences.chinese: 他把道理说得再清楚，对方不愿意听也是白说。
sentences.traditional: 他把道理說得再清楚，對方不願意聽也是白說。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ dàolǐ shuō de zài qīngchu, duìfāng bú yuànyì tīng yě shì bái shuō.
sentences.translation: However clearly he explains it, if the other person refuses to listen, it is all in vain.

sentences.chinese: 半夜突然停电，楼里的电梯也停止运行了。
sentences.traditional: 半夜突然停電，樓裡的電梯也停止運行了。
sentences.pinyin: Bànyè tūrán tíngdiàn, lóu lǐ de diàntī yě tíngzhǐ yùnxíng le.
sentences.translation: There was a sudden power cut in the middle of the night, and the lift in the building also stopped running.

sentences.chinese: 他半夜才回到家，怕吵醒家人，连灯都没开。
sentences.traditional: 他半夜才回到家，怕吵醒家人，連燈都沒開。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bànyè cái huí dào jiā, pà chǎoxǐng jiārén, lián dēng dōu méi kāi.
sentences.translation: He did not get home until the middle of the night and, afraid of waking his family, did not even turn on the light.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他不要经常熬到半夜，否则身体迟早会出问题。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他不要經常熬到半夜，否則身體遲早會出問題。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā bú yào jīngcháng áo dào bànyè, fǒuzé shēntǐ chízǎo huì chū wèntí.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him not to often stay up until the middle of the night, otherwise his health would have problems sooner or later.

sentences.chinese: 傍晚的时候，海边的风比中午凉快多了。
sentences.traditional: 傍晚的時候，海邊的風比中午涼快多了。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngwǎn de shíhou, hǎibiān de fēng bǐ zhōngwǔ liángkuai duō le.
sentences.translation: In the evening, the wind by the sea is much cooler than at noon.

sentences.chinese: 我们计划傍晚出发，这样可以避开最热的时间。
sentences.traditional: 我們計劃傍晚出發，這樣可以避開最熱的時間。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà bàngwǎn chūfā, zhèyàng kěyǐ bìkāi zuì rè de shíjiān.
sentences.translation: We plan to set off in the evening, so we can avoid the hottest time of day.

sentences.chinese: 每到傍晚，广场上就会有很多老人出来散步。
sentences.traditional: 每到傍晚，廣場上就會有很多老人出來散步。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào bàngwǎn, guǎngchǎng shang jiù huì yǒu hěn duō lǎorén chūlái sànbù.
sentences.translation: Every evening, many elderly people come out to walk in the square.

sentences.chinese: 请把玻璃杯用厚纸包裹起来，免得运输时摔坏。
sentences.traditional: 請把玻璃杯用厚紙包裹起來，免得運輸時摔壞。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ bōlibēi yòng hòu zhǐ bāoguǒ qǐlai, miǎnde yùnshū shí shuāi huài.
sentences.translation: Please wrap the glass in thick paper so that it does not break during transport.

sentences.chinese: 这个包裹已经寄出三天了，但系统还没有更新物流信息。
sentences.traditional: 這個包裹已經寄出三天了，但系統還沒有更新物流信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bāoguǒ yǐjīng jìchū sān tiān le, dàn xìtǒng hái méiyǒu gēngxīn wùliú zīxùn.
sentences.translation: This parcel was sent three days ago, but the system has not updated the delivery information yet.

sentences.chinese: 她把礼物包裹得很仔细，看起来一点儿也不像自己做的。
sentences.traditional: 她把禮物包裹得很仔細，看起來一點兒也不像自己做的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǐwù bāoguǒ de hěn zǐxì, kàn qǐlái yìdiǎnr yě bú xiàng zìjǐ zuò de.
sentences.translation: She wrapped the present very carefully; it hardly looked homemade at all.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同包含售后服务的内容，签字前请仔细阅读。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同包含售後服務的內容，簽字前請仔細閱讀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong bāohán shòuhòu fúwù de nèiróng, qiānzì qián qǐng zǐxì yuèdú.
sentences.translation: This contract contains the after-sales service details, so please read it carefully before signing.

sentences.chinese: 他的解释虽然很短，却包含了几个关键原因。
sentences.traditional: 他的解釋雖然很短，卻包含了幾個關鍵原因。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiěshì suīrán hěn duǎn, què bāohán le jǐ ge guānjiàn yuányīn.
sentences.translation: Although his explanation was short, it contained several key reasons.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究包含大量真实数据，因此结论比较可靠。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究包含大量真實數據，因此結論比較可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū bāohán dàliàng zhēnshí shùjù, yīncǐ jiélùn bǐjiào kěkào.
sentences.translation: This study contains a large amount of real data, so its conclusion is relatively reliable.

sentences.chinese: 这次培训的内容包括沟通技巧、时间管理和客户服务。
sentences.traditional: 這次培訓的內容包括溝通技巧、時間管理和客戶服務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì péixùn de nèiróng bāokuò gōutōng jìqiǎo, shíjiān guǎnlǐ hé kèhù fúwù.
sentences.translation: The content of this training includes communication skills, time management, and customer service.

sentences.chinese: 除了经理以外，包括新员工在内，所有人都要参加会议。
sentences.traditional: 除了經理以外，包括新員工在內，所有人都要參加會議。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle jīnglǐ yǐwài, bāokuò xīn yuángōng zài nèi, suǒyǒu rén dōu yào cānjiā huìyì.
sentences.translation: Apart from the manager, everyone, including the new employees, must attend the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 报价已经包括运费，所以客户不用再另外付款。
sentences.traditional: 報價已經包括運費，所以客戶不用再另外付款。
sentences.pinyin: Bàojià yǐjīng bāokuò yùnfèi, suǒyǐ kèhù bú yòng zài lìngwài fùkuǎn.
sentences.translation: The quote already includes delivery, so the customer does not need to pay extra.

sentences.chinese: 产品的包装如果太复杂，反而会增加回收的困难。
sentences.traditional: 產品的包裝如果太複雜，反而會增加回收的困難。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn de bāozhuāng rúguǒ tài fùzá, fǎn'ér huì zēngjiā huíshōu de kùnnan.
sentences.translation: If the product packaging is too complicated, it will actually make recycling more difficult.

sentences.chinese: 发货前，仓库会把每一台机器重新包装一遍。
sentences.traditional: 發貨前，倉庫會把每一臺機器重新包裝一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Fāhuò qián, cāngkù huì bǎ měi yì tái jīqì chóngxīn bāozhuāng yí biàn.
sentences.translation: Before dispatch, the warehouse will repackage each machine.

sentences.chinese: 这个品牌很会包装自己，所以看起来比实际更高级。
sentences.traditional: 這個品牌很會包裝自己，所以看起來比實際更高級。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái hěn huì bāozhuāng zìjǐ, suǒyǐ kàn qǐlái bǐ shíjì gèng gāojí.
sentences.translation: This brand is good at packaging itself, so it looks more high-end than it really is.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套太薄，冬天穿出去肯定会冷。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套太薄，冬天穿出去肯定會冷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào tài báo, dōngtiān chuān chūqù kěndìng huì lěng.
sentences.translation: This coat is too thin; it will definitely be cold to wear outside in winter.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告虽然很薄，却把问题分析得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告雖然很薄，卻把問題分析得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào suīrán hěn báo, què bǎ wèntí fēnxī de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Although this report is very thin, it analyses the problem clearly.

sentences.chinese: 切肉片的时候要切得薄一点，味道才容易进去。
sentences.traditional: 切肉片的時候要切得薄一點，味道才容易進去。
sentences.pinyin: Qiē ròupiàn de shíhou yào qiē de báo yìdiǎn, wèidào cái róngyì jìnqu.
sentences.translation: When cutting meat slices, you need to cut them a bit thinner so the flavour can get in easily.

sentences.chinese: 在爷爷眼里，那本旧相册才是真正的宝。
sentences.traditional: 在爺爺眼裡，那本舊相冊才是真正的寶。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yéye yǎn lǐ, nà běn jiù xiàngcè cái shì zhēnzhèng de bǎo.
sentences.translation: In Grandad’s eyes, that old photo album is the real treasure.

sentences.chinese: 别把钱当成唯一的宝，健康和时间同样重要。
sentences.traditional: 別把錢當成唯一的寶，健康和時間同樣重要。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ qián dàngchéng wéiyī de bǎo, jiànkāng hé shíjiān tóngyàng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Don’t treat money as the only treasure; health and time are just as important.

sentences.chinese: 这枚戒指是她母亲留下来的宝，她一直舍不得卖。
sentences.traditional: 這枚戒指是她母親留下來的寶，她一直捨不得賣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè méi jièzhi shì tā mǔqin liú xiàlai de bǎo, tā yìzhí shěbude mài.
sentences.translation: This ring is a treasure left to her by her mother, and she has never been willing to sell it.

sentences.chinese: 只要你按时完成培训，这份工作基本保得住。
sentences.traditional: 只要你按時完成培訓，這份工作基本保得住。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ ànshí wánchéng péixùn, zhè fèn gōngzuò jīběn bǎo de zhù.
sentences.translation: As long as you complete the training on time, you should basically be able to keep this job.

sentences.chinese: 遇到危险时，先保自己的安全，再去帮助别人。
sentences.traditional: 遇到危險時，先保自己的安全，再去幫助別人。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào wēixiǎn shí, xiān bǎo zìjǐ de ānquán, zài qù bāngzhù biérén.
sentences.translation: When you face danger, protect your own safety first, then help others.

sentences.chinese: 这次比赛他压力很大，冠军不一定保得住。
sentences.traditional: 這次比賽他壓力很大，冠軍不一定保得住。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài tā yālì hěn dà, guànjūn bù yídìng bǎo de zhù.
sentences.translation: He is under a lot of pressure in this competition, and he may not be able to keep the championship title.

sentences.chinese: 小区门口的保安提醒我们，外来车辆需要登记。
sentences.traditional: 小區門口的保安提醒我們，外來車輛需要登記。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoqū ménkǒu de bǎo'ān tíxǐng wǒmen, wàilái chēliàng xūyào dēngjì.
sentences.translation: The security guard at the entrance to the residential compound reminded us that outside vehicles need to register.

sentences.chinese: 晚上离开公司时，保安会检查每层楼的灯是否关好。
sentences.traditional: 晚上離開公司時，保安會檢查每層樓的燈是否關好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang líkāi gōngsī shí, bǎo'ān huì jiǎnchá měi céng lóu de dēng shìfǒu guān hǎo.
sentences.translation: When leaving the company in the evening, the security guard checks whether the lights on each floor have been turned off.

sentences.chinese: 为了大型活动的保安工作，主办方提前制定了详细方案。
sentences.traditional: 為了大型活動的保安工作，主辦方提前制定了詳細方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile dàxíng huódòng de bǎo'ān gōngzuò, zhǔbànfāng tíqián zhìdìng le xiángxì fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: For the security work at the large event, the organisers made a detailed plan in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这块玉是奶奶留下的宝贝，家里人都很珍惜。
sentences.traditional: 這塊玉是奶奶留下的寶貝，家裡人都很珍惜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài yù shì nǎinai liú xià de bǎobèi, jiālǐrén dōu hěn zhēnxī.
sentences.translation: This piece of jade is a treasure left by Grandma, and everyone in the family cherishes it.

sentences.chinese: 她常开玩笑说，儿子是她最重要的宝贝。
sentences.traditional: 她常開玩笑說，兒子是她最重要的寶貝。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng kāi wánxiào shuō, érzi shì tā zuì zhòngyào de bǎobèi.
sentences.translation: She often jokes that her son is her most precious treasure.

sentences.chinese: 对研究人员来说，完整的数据比任何宝贝都重要。
sentences.traditional: 對研究人員來說，完整的數據比任何寶貝都重要。
sentences.pinyin: Duì yánjiū rényuán lái shuō, wánzhěng de shùjù bǐ rènhé bǎobèi dōu zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: For researchers, complete data is more important than any treasure.

sentences.chinese: 无论工作多忙，他都尽量保持每天阅读的习惯。
sentences.traditional: 無論工作多忙，他都盡量保持每天閱讀的習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn gōngzuò duō máng, tā dōu jǐnliàng bǎochí měitiān yuèdú de xíguàn.
sentences.translation: No matter how busy work gets, he tries to maintain the habit of reading every day.

sentences.chinese: 如果想保持健康，除了运动，还要注意睡眠质量。
sentences.traditional: 如果想保持健康，除了運動，還要注意睡眠質量。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng bǎochí jiànkāng, chúle yùndòng, hái yào zhùyì shuìmián zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: To stay healthy, besides exercising, you also need to pay attention to the quality of your sleep.

sentences.chinese: 在谈判过程中，双方都保持了冷静和礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 在談判過程中，雙方都保持了冷靜和禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tánpàn guòchéng zhōng, shuāngfāng dōu bǎochí le lěngjìng hé lǐmào.
sentences.translation: During the negotiation, both sides remained calm and polite.

sentences.chinese: 写完报告后，记得及时保存文件，免得突然断电。
sentences.traditional: 寫完報告後，記得及時保存文件，免得突然斷電。
sentences.pinyin: Xiě wán bàogào hòu, jìde jíshí bǎocún wénjiàn, miǎnde tūrán duàndiàn.
sentences.translation: After finishing the report, remember to save the file promptly in case the power suddenly goes off.

sentences.chinese: 这些老照片虽然已经发黄，但仍然被很好地保存着。
sentences.traditional: 這些老照片雖然已經發黃，但仍然被很好地保存著。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē lǎo zhàopiàn suīrán yǐjīng fāhuáng, dàn réngrán bèi hěn hǎo de bǎocún zhe.
sentences.translation: Although these old photos have already yellowed, they have still been well preserved.

sentences.chinese: 这段录音可以保存下来，作为以后分析的材料。
sentences.traditional: 這段錄音可以保存下來，作為以後分析的材料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn lùyīn kěyǐ bǎocún xiàlai, zuòwéi yǐhòu fēnxī de cáiliào.
sentences.translation: This recording can be saved as material for future analysis.

sentences.chinese: 大学期间积累的实践经验，对他后来的工作非常宝贵。
sentences.traditional: 大學期間積累的實踐經驗，對他後來的工作非常寶貴。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxué qījiān jīlěi de shíjiàn jīngyàn, duì tā hòulái de gōngzuò fēicháng bǎoguì.
sentences.translation: The practical experience he built up during university was very valuable for his later work.

sentences.chinese: 别把宝贵的时间浪费在毫无意义的争论上。
sentences.traditional: 別把寶貴的時間浪費在毫無意義的爭論上。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ bǎoguì de shíjiān làngfèi zài háowú yìyì de zhēnglùn shang.
sentences.translation: Do not waste precious time on meaningless arguments.

sentences.chinese: 老师给我们的建议虽然简单，却十分宝贵。
sentences.traditional: 老師給我們的建議雖然簡單，卻十分寶貴。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi wǒmen de jiànyì suīrán jiǎndān, què shífēn bǎoguì.
sentences.translation: Although the advice our teacher gave us was simple, it was extremely valuable.

sentences.chinese: 这座老车站经过改造后，仍然保留了原来的外观。
sentences.traditional: 這座老車站經過改造後，仍然保留了原來的外觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo chēzhàn jīngguò gǎizào hòu, réngrán bǎoliú le yuánlái de wàiguān.
sentences.translation: After being renovated, this old station still retained its original appearance.

sentences.chinese: 如果你对结果不满意，可以保留进一步申诉的权利。
sentences.traditional: 如果你對結果不滿意，可以保留進一步申訴的權利。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ duì jiéguǒ bù mǎnyì, kěyǐ bǎoliú jìnyí bù shēnsù de quánlì.
sentences.translation: If you are dissatisfied with the result, you may retain the right to make a further appeal.

sentences.chinese: 为了照顾老顾客，餐厅特意保留了几道传统菜。
sentences.traditional: 為了照顧老顧客，餐廳特意保留了幾道傳統菜。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile zhàogù lǎo gùkè, cāntīng tèyì bǎoliú le jǐ dào chuántǒng cài.
sentences.translation: To look after regular customers, the restaurant deliberately kept several traditional dishes.

sentences.chinese: 出国旅行前，最好买一份合适的保险。
sentences.traditional: 出國旅行前，最好買一份合適的保險。
sentences.pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng qián, zuìhǎo mǎi yí fèn héshì de bǎoxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before travelling abroad, it is best to buy suitable insurance.

sentences.chinese: 把重要文件备份到云端，会更保险一些。
sentences.traditional: 把重要文件備份到雲端，會更保險一些。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎ zhòngyào wénjiàn bèifèn dào yúnduān, huì gèng bǎoxiǎn yìxiē.
sentences.translation: Backing important files up to the cloud is a bit safer.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案虽然慢一点，但从长期来看更保险。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案雖然慢一點，但從長期來看更保險。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn suīrán màn yìdiǎn, dàn cóng chángqī lái kàn gèng bǎoxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Although this plan is a little slower, it is safer in the long run.

sentences.chinese: 买牛奶时，他总是先看保质期，以免买到快过期的。
sentences.traditional: 買牛奶時，他總是先看保質期，以免買到快過期的。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi niúnǎi shí, tā zǒngshì xiān kàn bǎozhìqī, yǐmiǎn mǎi dào kuài guòqī de.
sentences.translation: When buying milk, he always checks the expiry date first to avoid buying something close to expiring.

sentences.chinese: 这种药的保质期只有一年，过期后不要继续使用。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥的保質期只有一年，過期後不要繼續使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào de bǎozhìqī zhǐyǒu yì nián, guòqī hòu bú yào jìxù shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This kind of medicine has a shelf life of only one year; do not keep using it after it expires.

sentences.chinese: 食品的保质期不只是日期，还和保存条件有关。
sentences.traditional: 食品的保質期不只是日期，還和保存條件有關。
sentences.pinyin: Shípǐn de bǎozhìqī bù zhǐ shì rìqī, hái hé bǎocún tiáojiàn yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: The shelf life of food is not just about the date; it is also related to storage conditions.

sentences.chinese: 新生需要在周一上午到学校报到，并领取宿舍钥匙。
sentences.traditional: 新生需要在週一上午到學校報到，並領取宿舍鑰匙。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnshēng xūyào zài Zhōuyī shàngwǔ dào xuéxiào bàodào, bìng lǐngqǔ sùshè yàoshi.
sentences.translation: New students need to check in at the school on Monday morning and collect their dormitory keys.

sentences.chinese: 他刚到公司报到，就被安排参加入职培训。
sentences.traditional: 他剛到公司報到，就被安排參加入職培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng dào gōngsī bàodào, jiù bèi ānpái cānjiā rùzhí péixùn.
sentences.translation: As soon as he reported to the company, he was arranged to attend induction training.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始前，代表们要先在大厅报到。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始前，代表們要先在大廳報到。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, dàibiǎomen yào xiān zài dàtīng bàodào.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting begins, the representatives need to check in at the hall first.

sentences.chinese: 这篇报道客观地介绍了村民搬迁后的生活变化。
sentences.traditional: 這篇報道客觀地介紹了村民搬遷後的生活變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān bàodào kèguān de jièshào le cūnmín bānqiān hòu de shēnghuó biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This report objectively introduced the changes in the villagers’ lives after the relocation.

sentences.chinese: 记者在报道事故时，必须先核实每一个细节。
sentences.traditional: 記者在報道事故時，必須先核實每一個細節。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě zài bàodào shìgù shí, bìxū xiān héshí měi yí ge xìjié.
sentences.translation: When reporting on an accident, a journalist must first verify every detail.

sentences.chinese: 新闻报道出来以后，公司立刻解释了事情的经过。
sentences.traditional: 新聞報道出來以後，公司立刻解釋了事情的經過。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnwén bàodào chūlái yǐhòu, gōngsī lìkè jiěshì le shìqing de jīngguò.
sentences.translation: After the news report came out, the company immediately explained what had happened.

sentences.chinese: 他把调查报告交给经理，并建议尽快采取措施。
sentences.traditional: 他把調查報告交給經理，並建議盡快採取措施。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ diàochá bàogào jiāo gěi jīnglǐ, bìng jiànyì jǐnkuài cǎiqǔ cuòshī.
sentences.translation: He handed the investigation report to the manager and suggested taking action as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们用数据来报告实验结果，而不是只凭感觉。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們用數據來報告實驗結果，而不是只憑感覺。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen yòng shùjù lái bàogào shíyàn jiéguǒ, ér bú shì zhǐ píng gǎnjué.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to report the experimental results using data, rather than relying only on feelings.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束前，每个部门都要报告本周的工作进展。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束前，每個部門都要報告本週的工作進展。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù qián, měi gè bùmén dōu yào bàogào běn zhōu de gōngzuò jìnzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting ends, every department must report this week’s work progress.

sentences.chinese: 如果陌生人一直跟着你，应该马上报警，而不是独自处理。
sentences.traditional: 如果陌生人一直跟著你，應該馬上報警，而不是獨自處理。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ mòshēngrén yìzhí gēnzhe nǐ, yīnggāi mǎshàng bàojǐng, ér bú shì dúzì chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: If a stranger keeps following you, you should call the police immediately rather than deal with it alone.

sentences.chinese: 商店被偷以后，老板先保护现场，然后才报警。
sentences.traditional: 商店被偷以後，老闆先保護現場，然後才報警。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn bèi tōu yǐhòu, lǎobǎn xiān bǎohù xiànchǎng, ránhòu cái bàojǐng.
sentences.translation: After the shop was robbed, the owner first protected the scene and only then called the police.

sentences.chinese: 她听见楼下有人砸门，吓得连忙打电话报警。
sentences.traditional: 她聽見樓下有人砸門，嚇得連忙打電話報警。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngjiàn lóuxià yǒu rén zá mén, xià de liánmáng dǎ diànhuà bàojǐng.
sentences.translation: She heard someone downstairs smashing the door and was so frightened that she quickly phoned the police.

sentences.chinese: 由于昨晚下了一场暴雨，通往山村的公路被泥石流堵住了。
sentences.traditional: 由於昨晚下了一場暴雨，通往山村的公路被泥石流堵住了。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zuówǎn xià le yì chǎng bàoyǔ, tōngwǎng shāncūn de gōnglù bèi níshíliú dǔzhù le.
sentences.translation: Because there was a rainstorm last night, the road leading to the mountain village was blocked by a mudslide.

sentences.chinese: 天气预报说傍晚可能有暴雨，出门时最好带伞。
sentences.traditional: 天氣預報說傍晚可能有暴雨，出門時最好帶傘。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō bàngwǎn kěnéng yǒu bàoyǔ, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài sǎn.
sentences.translation: The weather forecast says there may be a rainstorm in the evening, so it is best to take an umbrella when going out.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，小区里的积水一直到中午才退。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，小區裡的積水一直到中午才退。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, xiǎoqū lǐ de jīshuǐ yìzhí dào zhōngwǔ cái tuì.
sentences.translation: After the rainstorm, the standing water in the residential area did not go down until noon.

sentences.chinese: 与其一直抱怨条件不好，不如想办法把事情做好。
sentences.traditional: 與其一直抱怨條件不好，不如想辦法把事情做好。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí yìzhí bàoyuàn tiáojiàn bù hǎo, bùrú xiǎng bànfǎ bǎ shìqing zuò hǎo.
sentences.translation: Rather than keep complaining that the conditions are poor, it is better to think of a way to do the job well.

sentences.chinese: 客户抱怨快递太慢，客服只好耐心地解释原因。
sentences.traditional: 客戶抱怨快遞太慢，客服只好耐心地解釋原因。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù bàoyuàn kuàidì tài màn, kèfú zhǐhǎo nàixīn de jiěshì yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The customer complained that the delivery was too slow, so customer service had to patiently explain the reason.

sentences.chinese: 他从不在背后抱怨同事，有意见就当面说清楚。
sentences.traditional: 他從不在背後抱怨同事，有意見就當面說清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng bù zài bèihòu bàoyuàn tóngshì, yǒu yìjiàn jiù dāngmiàn shuō qīngchu.
sentences.translation: He never complains about colleagues behind their backs; if he has an opinion, he says it clearly face to face.

sentences.chinese: 坐久了以后，他的背疼得厉害，只好站起来活动一下。
sentences.traditional: 坐久了以後，他的背疼得厲害，只好站起來活動一下。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò jiǔ le yǐhòu, tā de bèi téng de lìhai, zhǐhǎo zhàn qǐlái huódòng yíxià.
sentences.translation: After sitting for a long time, his back hurt badly, so he had to stand up and move around a bit.

sentences.chinese: 这篇课文太长，孩子背了半天还是记不住。
sentences.traditional: 這篇課文太長，孩子背了半天還是記不住。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān kèwén tài cháng, háizi bèi le bàn tiān háishi jì bu zhù.
sentences.translation: This text is too long; the child spent ages trying to memorise it but still could not remember it.

sentences.chinese: 为了通过考试，他每天早上都背二十个新词。
sentences.traditional: 為了通過考試，他每天早上都背二十個新詞。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tōngguò kǎoshì, tā měi tiān zǎoshang dōu bèi èrshí ge xīn cí.
sentences.translation: In order to pass the exam, he memorises twenty new words every morning.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定的背后，其实有很复杂的经济原因。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定的背後，其實有很複雜的經濟原因。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng de bèihòu, qíshí yǒu hěn fùzá de jīngjì yuányīn.
sentences.translation: Behind this decision, there are actually very complicated economic reasons.

sentences.chinese: 他表面上支持你，背后却把计划告诉了竞争对手。
sentences.traditional: 他表面上支持你，背後卻把計劃告訴了競爭對手。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biǎomiàn shang zhīchí nǐ, bèihòu què bǎ jìhuà gàosu le jìngzhēng duìshǒu.
sentences.translation: On the surface he supports you, but behind your back he told the plan to a competitor.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们躲在门背后，小声商量要给妈妈一个惊喜。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們躲在門背後，小聲商量要給媽媽一個驚喜。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen duǒ zài mén bèihòu, xiǎoshēng shāngliang yào gěi māma yí ge jīngxǐ.
sentences.translation: The children hid behind the door and quietly discussed giving their mum a surprise.

sentences.chinese: 了解作者的时代背景，有助于理解这篇文章的真正含义。
sentences.traditional: 了解作者的時代背景，有助於理解這篇文章的真正含義。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎojiě zuòzhě de shídài bèijǐng, yǒuzhù yú lǐjiě zhè piān wénzhāng de zhēnzhèng hányì.
sentences.translation: Understanding the author’s historical background helps you understand the real meaning of this article.

sentences.chinese: 申请这份工作时，教育背景只是条件之一，经验也很重要。
sentences.traditional: 申請這份工作時，教育背景只是條件之一，經驗也很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng zhè fèn gōngzuò shí, jiàoyù bèijǐng zhǐ shì tiáojiàn zhī yī, jīngyàn yě hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When applying for this job, educational background is only one of the conditions; experience is also very important.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片的背景太乱，反而影响了人物的效果。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片的背景太亂，反而影響了人物的效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn de bèijǐng tài luàn, fǎn'ér yǐngxiǎng le rénwù de xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: The background of this photo is too messy, which instead affects how the person comes across.

sentences.chinese: 晚上降温了，你睡觉前记得把被子盖好。
sentences.traditional: 晚上降溫了，你睡覺前記得把被子蓋好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang jiàngwēn le, nǐ shuìjiào qián jìde bǎ bèizi gài hǎo.
sentences.translation: It has got colder tonight; remember to cover yourself properly with the quilt before you sleep.

sentences.chinese: 这床被子虽然不厚，但保暖效果特别好。
sentences.traditional: 這床被子雖然不厚，但保暖效果特別好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chuáng bèizi suīrán bù hòu, dàn bǎonuǎn xiàoguǒ tèbié hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although this quilt is not thick, it keeps you especially warm.

sentences.chinese: 搬家那天，他只带了几件衣服和一条旧被子。
sentences.traditional: 搬家那天，他只帶了幾件衣服和一條舊被子。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiā nà tiān, tā zhǐ dài le jǐ jiàn yīfu hé yì tiáo jiù bèizi.
sentences.translation: On the day he moved house, he only brought a few clothes and an old quilt.

sentences.chinese: 本店所有商品都有保质期，购买前请仔细查看。
sentences.traditional: 本店所有商品都有保質期，購買前請仔細查看。
sentences.pinyin: Běn diàn suǒyǒu shāngpǐn dōu yǒu bǎozhìqī, gòumǎi qián qǐng zǐxì chákàn.
sentences.translation: All products in this shop have an expiry date; please check carefully before purchasing.

sentences.chinese: 他本想早点回家，结果临时接到一个紧急任务。
sentences.traditional: 他本想早點回家，結果臨時接到一個緊急任務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā běn xiǎng zǎodiǎn huí jiā, jiéguǒ línshí jiēdào yí ge jǐnjí rènwu.
sentences.translation: He had originally wanted to go home earlier, but ended up receiving an urgent task at the last minute.

sentences.chinese: 本公司将于下周公布新的服务标准，请客户留意通知。
sentences.traditional: 本公司將於下週公佈新的服務標準，請客戶留意通知。
sentences.pinyin: Běn gōngsī jiāng yú xià zhōu gōngbù xīn de fúwù biāozhǔn, qǐng kèhù liúyì tōngzhī.
sentences.translation: This company will announce new service standards next week; customers are asked to watch for the notice.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业虽然规模不大，却为本地年轻人提供了不少工作机会。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業雖然規模不大，卻為本地年輕人提供了不少工作機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè suīrán guīmó bú dà, què wèi běndì niánqīngrén tígōng le bù shǎo gōngzuò jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Although this company is not large, it has provided quite a few job opportunities for local young people.

sentences.chinese: 为了适应本地市场，我们把产品说明翻译成了好几种语言。
sentences.traditional: 為了適應本地市場，我們把產品說明翻譯成了好幾種語言。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shìyìng běndì shìchǎng, wǒmen bǎ chǎnpǐn shuōmíng fānyì chéng le hǎo jǐ zhǒng yǔyán.
sentences.translation: To adapt to the local market, we translated the product instructions into several languages.

sentences.chinese: 外地游客一到本地，就被这里的海边风景吸引住了。
sentences.traditional: 外地遊客一到本地，就被這裡的海邊風景吸引住了。
sentences.pinyin: Wàidì yóukè yí dào běndì, jiù bèi zhèlǐ de hǎibiān fēngjǐng xīyǐn zhù le.
sentences.translation: As soon as tourists from other places arrive in the local area, they are captivated by the seaside scenery here.

sentences.chinese: 真正的本领不是靠嘴说出来的，而是在困难中练出来的。
sentences.traditional: 真正的本領不是靠嘴說出來的，而是在困難中練出來的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de běnlǐng bú shì kào zuǐ shuō chūlai de, ér shì zài kùnnan zhōng liàn chūlai de.
sentences.translation: Real ability is not talked into existence; it is trained through difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然年纪不大，却已经学会了修机器的本领。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然年紀不大，卻已經學會了修機器的本領。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì bú dà, què yǐjīng xuéhuì le xiū jīqì de běnlǐng.
sentences.translation: Although he is not very old, he has already learnt the skill of repairing machines.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有独立解决问题的本领，学历再高也未必有竞争力。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有獨立解決問題的本領，學歷再高也未必有競爭力。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu dúlì jiějué wèntí de běnlǐng, xuélì zài gāo yě wèibì yǒu jìngzhēnglì.
sentences.translation: Without the ability to solve problems independently, even a high level of education may not make someone competitive.

sentences.chinese: 这份申请必须由本人签字，不能请别人代签。
sentences.traditional: 這份申請必須由本人簽字，不能請別人代簽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn shēnqǐng bìxū yóu běnrén qiānzì, bù néng qǐng biérén dài qiān.
sentences.translation: This application must be signed by the person themself; someone else cannot sign on their behalf.

sentences.chinese: 本人对以上内容负责，如有错误，愿意承担相应责任。
sentences.traditional: 本人對以上內容負責，如有錯誤，願意承擔相應責任。
sentences.pinyin: Běnrén duì yǐshàng nèiróng fùzé, rú yǒu cuòwù, yuànyì chéngdān xiāngyìng zérèn.
sentences.translation: I am responsible for the above content, and if there are mistakes, I am willing to bear the corresponding responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 面试时，请本人携带身份证原件到前台报到。
sentences.traditional: 面試時，請本人攜帶身份證原件到前臺報到。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì shí, qǐng běnrén xiédài shēnfènzhèng yuánjiàn dào qiántái bàodào.
sentences.translation: At the interview, please come in person with the original copy of your ID card and check in at reception.

sentences.chinese: 这场争论表面上是价格问题，本质上是信任问题。
sentences.traditional: 這場爭論表面上是價格問題，本質上是信任問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhēnglùn biǎomiàn shang shì jiàgé wèntí, běnzhì shang shì xìnrèn wèntí.
sentences.translation: On the surface this argument is about price, but in essence it is about trust.

sentences.chinese: 只有看清问题的本质，才能找到真正有效的办法。
sentences.traditional: 只有看清問題的本質，才能找到真正有效的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu kàn qīng wèntí de běnzhì, cái néng zhǎodào zhēnzhèng yǒuxiào de bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Only by seeing the essence of the problem clearly can we find a truly effective solution.

sentences.chinese: 这两种做法看起来不同，但本质没有太大区别。
sentences.traditional: 這兩種做法看起來不同，但本質沒有太大區別。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng zuòfǎ kàn qǐlai bù tóng, dàn běnzhì méiyǒu tài dà qūbié.
sentences.translation: These two practices look different, but there is not much difference in essence.

sentences.chinese: 合作之前，双方应该先了解彼此的需求和底线。
sentences.traditional: 合作之前，雙方應該先了解彼此的需求和底線。
sentences.pinyin: Hézuò zhīqián, shuāngfāng yīnggāi xiān liǎojiě bǐcǐ de xūqiú hé dǐxiàn.
sentences.translation: Before cooperating, both sides should first understand each other’s needs and bottom lines.

sentences.chinese: 他们虽然性格完全不同，却能彼此尊重，所以关系一直不错。
sentences.traditional: 他們雖然性格完全不同，卻能彼此尊重，所以關係一直不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen suīrán xìnggé wánquán bù tóng, què néng bǐcǐ zūnzhòng, suǒyǐ guānxì yìzhí búcuò.
sentences.translation: Although their personalities are completely different, they respect each other, so their relationship has always been good.

sentences.chinese: 遇到误会时，彼此冷静地沟通比互相指责更有用。
sentences.traditional: 遇到誤會時，彼此冷靜地溝通比互相指責更有用。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào wùhuì shí, bǐcǐ lěngjìng de gōutōng bǐ hùxiāng zhǐzé gèng yǒuyòng.
sentences.translation: When a misunderstanding occurs, calmly communicating with each other is more useful than blaming each other.

sentences.chinese: 比赛最后五分钟，比分仍然是二比二，气氛非常紧张。
sentences.traditional: 比賽最後五分鐘，比分仍然是二比二，氣氛非常緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài zuìhòu wǔ fēnzhōng, bǐfēn réngrán shì èr bǐ èr, qìfēn fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: In the final five minutes of the match, the score was still two-two, and the atmosphere was very tense.

sentences.chinese: 他们在下半场连续进了两个球，把比分反超了。
sentences.traditional: 他們在下半場連續進了兩個球，把比分反超了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài xià bànchǎng liánxù jìn le liǎng gè qiú, bǎ bǐfēn fǎnchāo le.
sentences.translation: They scored two goals in a row in the second half and turned the score around.

sentences.chinese: 教练并不只关心比分，更重视队员在场上的配合。
sentences.traditional: 教練並不只關心比分，更重視隊員在場上的配合。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoliàn bìng bù zhǐ guānxīn bǐfēn, gèng zhòngshì duìyuán zài chǎng shang de pèihé.
sentences.translation: The coach does not only care about the score; he values the players’ cooperation on the field even more.

sentences.chinese: 在这个城市，租房费用占收入的比例越来越高。
sentences.traditional: 在這個城市，租房費用佔收入的比例越來越高。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì, zūfáng fèiyòng zhàn shōurù de bǐlì yuè lái yuè gāo.
sentences.translation: In this city, the proportion of income spent on rent is getting higher and higher.

sentences.chinese: 做蛋糕时，如果材料的比例不合适，味道就会受影响。
sentences.traditional: 做蛋糕時，如果材料的比例不合適，味道就會受影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò dàngāo shí, rúguǒ cáiliào de bǐlì bù héshì, wèidào jiù huì shòu yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: When making a cake, if the proportions of the ingredients are not suitable, the taste will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 调查显示，选择公共交通的人口比例明显上升。
sentences.traditional: 調查顯示，選擇公共交通的人口比例明顯上升。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá xiǎnshì, xuǎnzé gōnggòng jiāotōng de rénkǒu bǐlì míngxiǎn shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: The survey shows that the proportion of people choosing public transport has risen significantly.

sentences.chinese: 老师用“桥”来比喻语言的作用，学生一下子就明白了。
sentences.traditional: 老師用「橋」來比喻語言的作用，學生一下子就明白了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng “qiáo” lái bǐyù yǔyán de zuòyòng, xuésheng yíxiàzi jiù míngbai le.
sentences.translation: The teacher used “bridge” as a metaphor for the role of language, and the students understood it at once.

sentences.chinese: 这个比喻很形象，把复杂的道理讲得简单多了。
sentences.traditional: 這個比喻很形象，把複雜的道理講得簡單多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bǐyù hěn xíngxiàng, bǎ fùzá de dàolǐ jiǎng de jiǎndān duō le.
sentences.translation: This metaphor is very vivid and makes the complicated idea much simpler.

sentences.chinese: 如果比喻用得不准确，反而会让听众更糊涂。
sentences.traditional: 如果比喻用得不準確，反而會讓聽眾更糊塗。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bǐyù yòng de bù zhǔnquè, fǎn’ér huì ràng tīngzhòng gèng hútú.
sentences.translation: If a metaphor is used inaccurately, it may instead make the audience more confused.

sentences.chinese: 无论计划多忙，安全检查必不可少。
sentences.traditional: 無論計劃多忙，安全檢查必不可少。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn jìhuà duō máng, ānquán jiǎnchá bì bù kě shǎo.
sentences.translation: No matter how busy the schedule is, safety checks are essential.

sentences.chinese: 要想长期合作，双方必先建立基本的信任。
sentences.traditional: 要想長期合作，雙方必先建立基本的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Yào xiǎng chángqī hézuò, shuāngfāng bì xiān jiànlì jīběn de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: To cooperate in the long term, both sides must first build basic trust.

sentences.chinese: 参加比赛者必于周五前提交身份证复印件。
sentences.traditional: 參加比賽者必於週五前提交身份證複印件。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā bǐsài zhě bì yú Zhōuwǔ qián tíjiāo shēnfènzhèng fùyìnjiàn.
sentences.translation: Participants must submit a copy of their ID card by Friday.

sentences.chinese: 他这次没考好，毕竟刚换了学校，还需要时间适应。
sentences.traditional: 他這次沒考好，畢竟剛換了學校，還需要時間適應。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhè cì méi kǎo hǎo, bìjìng gāng huàn le xuéxiào, hái xūyào shíjiān shìyìng.
sentences.translation: He did not do well in the exam this time; after all, he has only just changed schools and still needs time to adapt.

sentences.chinese: 别对新人要求太高，毕竟谁都有学习的过程。
sentences.traditional: 別對新人要求太高，畢竟誰都有學習的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Bié duì xīnrén yāoqiú tài gāo, bìjìng shéi dōu yǒu xuéxí de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: Do not expect too much from new people; after all, everyone has a learning process.

sentences.chinese: 我理解你的担心，毕竟这笔钱不是小数目。
sentences.traditional: 我理解你的擔心，畢竟這筆錢不是小數目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ lǐjiě nǐ de dānxīn, bìjìng zhè bǐ qián bú shì xiǎo shùmù.
sentences.translation: I understand your concern; after all, this amount of money is not small.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免误会，合同里的每一项条件都要写清楚。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免誤會，合同裡的每一項條件都要寫清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn wùhuì, hétong lǐ de měi yí xiàng tiáojiàn dōu yào xiě qīngchu.
sentences.translation: To avoid misunderstandings, every condition in the contract must be written clearly.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他避免长期熬夜，否则身体很难恢复。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他避免長期熬夜，否則身體很難恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā bìmiǎn chángqī áoyè, fǒuzé shēntǐ hěn nán huīfù.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him to avoid staying up late for long periods, otherwise his body would be hard to recover.

sentences.chinese: 这个设计可以避免用户重复输入相同的信息。
sentences.traditional: 這個設計可以避免用戶重複輸入相同的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèjì kěyǐ bìmiǎn yònghù chóngfù shūrù xiāngtóng de xìnxī.
sentences.translation: This design can prevent users from repeatedly entering the same information.

sentences.chinese: 闭幕式结束后，志愿者们还要留下来整理场地。
sentences.traditional: 閉幕式結束後，志願者們還要留下來整理場地。
sentences.pinyin: Bìmùshì jiéshù hòu, zhìyuànzhě men hái yào liú xiàlai zhěnglǐ chǎngdì.
sentences.translation: After the closing ceremony ends, the volunteers still have to stay behind to tidy up the venue.

sentences.chinese: 这次运动会的闭幕式虽然简单，却给大家留下了深刻印象。
sentences.traditional: 這次運動會的閉幕式雖然簡單，卻給大家留下了深刻印象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì yùndònghuì de bìmùshì suīrán jiǎndān, què gěi dàjiā liúxià le shēnkè yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: Although the closing ceremony of this sports meeting was simple, it left a deep impression on everyone.

sentences.chinese: 由于暴雨，闭幕式被临时改到室内举行。
sentences.traditional: 由於暴雨，閉幕式被臨時改到室內舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú bàoyǔ, bìmùshì bèi línshí gǎi dào shìnèi jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: Because of the rainstorm, the closing ceremony was temporarily moved indoors.

sentences.chinese: 技术进步必然会改变很多传统行业的工作方式。
sentences.traditional: 技術進步必然會改變很多傳統行業的工作方式。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshù jìnbù bìrán huì gǎibiàn hěn duō chuántǒng hángyè de gōngzuò fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Technological progress will inevitably change the way many traditional industries work.

sentences.chinese: 如果长期忽视安全问题，事故的发生几乎是必然的。
sentences.traditional: 如果長期忽視安全問題，事故的發生幾乎是必然的。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chángqī hūshì ānquán wèntí, shìgù de fāshēng jīhū shì bìrán de.
sentences.translation: If safety issues are ignored for a long time, an accident is almost inevitable.

sentences.chinese: 成功并不是偶然，而是长期努力的必然结果。
sentences.traditional: 成功並不是偶然，而是長期努力的必然結果。
sentences.pinyin: Chénggōng bìng bú shì ǒurán, ér shì chángqī nǔlì de bìrán jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Success is not accidental; it is the inevitable result of long-term effort.

sentences.chinese: 水和空气是人类生存所必需的条件。
sentences.traditional: 水和空氣是人類生存所必需的條件。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ hé kōngqì shì rénlèi shēngcún suǒ bìxū de tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: Water and air are conditions necessary for human survival.

sentences.chinese: 出发前，请确认所有必需的文件都已经准备好。
sentences.traditional: 出發前，請確認所有必需的文件都已經準備好。
sentences.pinyin: Chūfā qián, qǐng quèrèn suǒyǒu bìxū de wénjiàn dōu yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.translation: Before setting off, please confirm that all essential documents have already been prepared.

sentences.chinese: 稳定的电压是这台设备正常运转所必需的。
sentences.traditional: 穩定的電壓是這臺設備正常運轉所必需的。
sentences.pinyin: Wěndìng de diànyā shì zhè tái shèbèi zhèngcháng yùnzhuǎn suǒ bìxū de.
sentences.translation: A stable voltage is essential for this equipment to operate normally.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有必要，我们就不应该收集用户的个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有必要，我們就不應該收集用戶的個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu bìyào, wǒmen jiù bù yīnggāi shōují yònghù de gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: If it is not necessary, we should not collect users’ personal information.

sentences.chinese: 在作出决定之前，听取不同意见是非常必要的。
sentences.traditional: 在作出決定之前，聽取不同意見是非常必要的。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zuòchū juédìng zhīqián, tīngqǔ bùtóng yìjiàn shì fēicháng bìyào de.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, listening to different opinions is very necessary.

sentences.chinese: 他认为这笔开支没有必要，可以暂时取消。
sentences.traditional: 他認為這筆開支沒有必要，可以暫時取消。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi zhè bǐ kāizhī méiyǒu bìyào, kěyǐ zànshí qǔxiāo.
sentences.translation: He thinks this expense is unnecessary and can be cancelled temporarily.

sentences.chinese: 你把申请表交上来，工作人员便会安排下一步审核。
sentences.traditional: 你把申請表交上來，工作人員便會安排下一步審核。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shēnqǐngbiǎo jiāo shànglai, gōngzuò rényuán biàn huì ānpái xià yí bù shěnhé.
sentences.translation: Once you hand in the application form, the staff will then arrange the next stage of review.

sentences.chinese: 如果今晚能确认人数，我们明天便可以预订场地。
sentences.traditional: 如果今晚能確認人數，我們明天便可以預訂場地。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ jīnwǎn néng quèrèn rénshù, wǒmen míngtiān biàn kěyǐ yùdìng chǎngdì.
sentences.translation: If we can confirm the number of people tonight, we can then book the venue tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他一听到孩子哭，便立刻放下工作跑了过去。
sentences.traditional: 他一聽到孩子哭，便立刻放下工作跑了過去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì tīngdào háizi kū, biàn lìkè fàngxià gōngzuò pǎo le guòqù.
sentences.translation: As soon as he heard the child crying, he immediately put down his work and ran over.

sentences.chinese: 最近原材料价格变动很大，公司不得不重新计算成本。
sentences.traditional: 最近原材料價格變動很大，公司不得不重新計算成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn yuáncáiliào jiàgé biàndòng hěn dà, gōngsī bùdébù chóngxīn jìsuàn chéngběn.
sentences.translation: Recently, raw material prices have fluctuated greatly, so the company has had to recalculate costs.

sentences.chinese: 会议时间如果有任何变动，请提前通知所有参加者。
sentences.traditional: 會議時間如果有任何變動，請提前通知所有參加者。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shíjiān rúguǒ yǒu rènhé biàndòng, qǐng tíqián tōngzhī suǒyǒu cānjiāzhě.
sentences.translation: If there is any change to the meeting time, please notify all participants in advance.

sentences.chinese: 人员变动之后，部门之间的责任需要重新划分。
sentences.traditional: 人員變動之後，部門之間的責任需要重新劃分。
sentences.pinyin: Rényuán biàndòng zhīhòu, bùmén zhījiān de zérèn xūyào chóngxīn huàfēn.
sentences.translation: After the personnel changes, responsibilities between departments need to be divided again.

sentences.chinese: 高铁的发展使城市之间的往来更加便利。
sentences.traditional: 高鐵的發展使城市之間的往來更加便利。
sentences.pinyin: Gāotiě de fāzhǎn shǐ chéngshì zhījiān de wǎnglái gèngjiā biànlì.
sentences.translation: The development of high-speed rail has made travel between cities more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 这个应用程序便利了老人在线预约看病。
sentences.traditional: 這個應用程序便利了老人在線預約看病。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng chéngxù biànlì le lǎorén zàixiàn yùyuē kànbìng.
sentences.translation: This app has made it easier for elderly people to book medical appointments online.

sentences.chinese: 为了便利居民出行，政府增加了夜间公交车。
sentences.traditional: 為了便利居民出行，政府增加了夜間公交車。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile biànlì jūmín chūxíng, zhèngfǔ zēngjiā le yèjiān gōngjiāochē.
sentences.translation: To make travel easier for residents, the government added night buses.

sentences.chinese: 楼下的便利店二十四小时营业，买生活用品很方便。
sentences.traditional: 樓下的便利店二十四小時營業，買生活用品很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Lóuxià de biànlìdiàn èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè, mǎi shēnghuó yòngpǐn hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The convenience store downstairs is open twenty-four hours a day, so buying daily necessities is very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 他在便利店买了一瓶水，又顺便取了快递。
sentences.traditional: 他在便利店買了一瓶水，又順便取了快遞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài biànlìdiàn mǎi le yì píng shuǐ, yòu shùnbiàn qǔ le kuàidì.
sentences.translation: He bought a bottle of water at the convenience store and picked up a parcel at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 这家便利店虽然面积不大，但商品种类很全。
sentences.traditional: 這家便利店雖然面積不大，但商品種類很全。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā biànlìdiàn suīrán miànjī bú dà, dàn shāngpǐn zhǒnglèi hěn quán.
sentences.translation: Although this convenience store is not large, it has a very complete range of goods.

sentences.chinese: 文章的标题太普通，很难吸引读者继续往下看。
sentences.traditional: 文章的標題太普通，很難吸引讀者繼續往下看。
sentences.pinyin: Wénzhāng de biāotí tài pǔtōng, hěn nán xīyǐn dúzhě jìxù wǎng xià kàn.
sentences.translation: The article’s title is too ordinary, making it hard to attract readers to continue reading.

sentences.chinese: 请根据内容重新修改标题，不要让它和正文脱节。
sentences.traditional: 請根據內容重新修改標題，不要讓它和正文脫節。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gēnjù nèiróng chóngxīn xiūgǎi biāotí, bú yào ràng tā hé zhèngwén tuōjié.
sentences.translation: Please revise the title according to the content, and do not let it become disconnected from the main text.

sentences.chinese: 一个准确的标题能帮助读者迅速理解文章重点。
sentences.traditional: 一個準確的標題能幫助讀者迅速理解文章重點。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge zhǔnquè de biāotí néng bāngzhù dúzhě xùnsù lǐjiě wénzhāng zhòngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: An accurate title can help readers quickly understand the main point of an article.

sentences.chinese: 这个标志提醒司机前方正在施工，必须减速慢行。
sentences.traditional: 這個標誌提醒司機前方正在施工，必須減速慢行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège biāozhì tíxǐng sījī qiánfāng zhèngzài shīgōng, bìxū jiǎnsù mànxíng.
sentences.translation: This sign reminds drivers that construction is ahead and that they must slow down.

sentences.chinese: 绿色标志通常表示安全通道，不要在附近堆放杂物。
sentences.traditional: 綠色標誌通常表示安全通道，不要在附近堆放雜物。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜsè biāozhì tōngcháng biǎoshì ānquán tōngdào, bú yào zài fùjìn duīfàng záwù.
sentences.translation: Green signs usually indicate safety passages; do not pile miscellaneous items nearby.

sentences.chinese: 这一天标志着项目从计划阶段正式进入实施阶段。
sentences.traditional: 這一天標誌著項目從計劃階段正式進入實施階段。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yì tiān biāozhìzhe xiàngmù cóng jìhuà jiēduàn zhèngshì jìnrù shíshī jiēduàn.
sentences.translation: This day marks the project’s official move from the planning stage into the implementation stage.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然不善于表达感情，但总会用行动关心家人。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然不善於表達感情，但總會用行動關心家人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán bú shànyú biǎodá gǎnqíng, dàn zǒng huì yòng xíngdòng guānxīn jiārén.
sentences.translation: Although he is not good at expressing feelings, he always cares for his family through actions.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章表达了作者对城市变化的复杂感受。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章表達了作者對城市變化的複雜感受。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng biǎodá le zuòzhě duì chéngshì biànhuà de fùzá gǎnshòu.
sentences.translation: This article expresses the author’s complex feelings about urban change.

sentences.chinese: 如果你表达得更清楚，大家就能更快理解你的意思。
sentences.traditional: 如果你表達得更清楚，大家就能更快理解你的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ biǎodá de gèng qīngchu, dàjiā jiù néng gèng kuài lǐjiě nǐ de yìsi.
sentences.translation: If you express it more clearly, everyone can understand what you mean more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 表面上他很平静，其实心里非常紧张。
sentences.traditional: 表面上他很平靜，其實心裡非常緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Biǎomiàn shang tā hěn píngjìng, qíshí xīnlǐ fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: On the surface he seems calm, but actually he is very nervous inside.

sentences.chinese: 这种材料的表面很光滑，不容易留下污渍。
sentences.traditional: 這種材料的表面很光滑，不容易留下污漬。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào de biǎomiàn hěn guānghuá, bù róngyì liúxià wūzì.
sentences.translation: The surface of this material is smooth and does not easily leave stains.

sentences.chinese: 我们不能只看表面，还要分析问题背后的原因。
sentences.traditional: 我們不能只看表面，還要分析問題背後的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zhǐ kàn biǎomiàn, hái yào fēnxī wèntí bèihòu de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: We cannot just look at the surface; we also need to analyse the reasons behind the problem.

sentences.chinese: 调查结果表明，大多数居民支持这个环保计划。
sentences.traditional: 調查結果表明，大多數居民支持這個環保計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jiéguǒ biǎomíng, dàduōshù jūmín zhīchí zhège huánbǎo jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The survey results show that most residents support this environmental protection plan.

sentences.chinese: 他的沉默并不表明他同意你的看法。
sentences.traditional: 他的沉默並不表明他同意你的看法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de chénmò bìng bù biǎomíng tā tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ.
sentences.translation: His silence does not indicate that he agrees with your view.

sentences.chinese: 越来越多的证据表明，这项技术可能改变整个行业。
sentences.traditional: 越來越多的證據表明，這項技術可能改變整個行業。
sentences.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō de zhèngjù biǎomíng, zhè xiàng jìshù kěnéng gǎibiàn zhěnggè hángyè.
sentences.translation: More and more evidence indicates that this technology may change the whole industry.

sentences.chinese: 她脸上的表情很自然，看不出一点紧张。
sentences.traditional: 她臉上的表情很自然，看不出一點緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liǎn shang de biǎoqíng hěn zìrán, kàn bu chū yìdiǎn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: The expression on her face was very natural, and no nervousness could be seen.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息后，他的表情一下子变得严肃起来。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息後，他的表情一下子變得嚴肅起來。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi hòu, tā de biǎoqíng yíxiàzi biàn de yánsù qǐlái.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news, his expression suddenly became serious.

sentences.chinese: 在正式场合，说话时要注意语气和表情。
sentences.traditional: 在正式場合，說話時要注意語氣和表情。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé, shuōhuà shí yào zhùyì yǔqì hé biǎoqíng.
sentences.translation: In formal situations, pay attention to your tone and facial expression when speaking.

sentences.chinese: 他别了家乡，带着简单的行李去外地发展。
sentences.traditional: 他別了家鄉，帶著簡單的行李去外地發展。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bié le jiāxiāng, dàizhe jiǎndān de xíngli qù wàidì fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: He left his hometown and went elsewhere to develop his career with simple luggage.

sentences.chinese: 临走前，她别了朋友们，约定以后常联系。
sentences.traditional: 臨走前，她別了朋友們，約定以後常聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Lín zǒu qián, tā bié le péngyoumen, yuēdìng yǐhòu cháng liánxì.
sentences.translation: Before leaving, she said goodbye to her friends and agreed to keep in touch often.

sentences.chinese: 那年冬天，他别妻离子，去边远地区支援建设。
sentences.traditional: 那年冬天，他別妻離子，去邊遠地區支援建設。
sentences.pinyin: Nà nián dōngtiān, tā bié qī lí zǐ, qù biānyuǎn dìqū zhīyuán jiànshè.
sentences.translation: That winter, he parted from his wife and children to support construction in a remote area.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶做的饼外面很脆，里面却很软。
sentences.traditional: 奶奶做的餅外面很脆，裡面卻很軟。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zuò de bǐng wàimiàn hěn cuì, lǐmiàn què hěn ruǎn.
sentences.translation: The cake Grandma made is crispy outside but soft inside.

sentences.chinese: 这种饼虽然看起来普通，却是当地有名的小吃。
sentences.traditional: 這種餅雖然看起來普通，卻是當地有名的小吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bǐng suīrán kàn qǐlái pǔtōng, què shì dāngdì yǒumíng de xiǎochī.
sentences.translation: Although this kind of cake looks ordinary, it is a famous local snack.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把饼分成几块，主动给同学们分享。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把餅分成幾塊，主動給同學們分享。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ bǐng fēnchéng jǐ kuài, zhǔdòng gěi tóngxuémen fēnxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The child divided the cake into several pieces and shared it with classmates.

sentences.chinese: 病房里需要保持安静，以免影响病人休息。
sentences.traditional: 病房裡需要保持安靜，以免影響病人休息。
sentences.pinyin: Bìngfáng li xūyào bǎochí ānjìng, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng bìngrén xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The ward needs to be kept quiet so as not to affect patients’ rest.

sentences.chinese: 医生每天早上都会到病房了解病人的恢复情况。
sentences.traditional: 醫生每天早上都會到病房了解病人的恢復情況。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng měitiān zǎoshang dū huì dào bìngfáng liǎojiě bìngrén de huīfù qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Every morning the doctor goes to the ward to learn about the patients’ recovery.

sentences.chinese: 家属进入病房前，必须按照规定做好消毒。
sentences.traditional: 家屬進入病房前，必須按照規定做好消毒。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāshǔ jìnrù bìngfáng qián, bìxū ànzhào guīdìng zuò hǎo xiāodú.
sentences.translation: Before family members enter the ward, they must disinfect according to regulations.

sentences.chinese: 经过治疗，他的病情已经明显好转。
sentences.traditional: 經過治療，他的病情已經明顯好轉。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò zhìliáo, tā de bìngqíng yǐjīng míngxiǎn hǎozhuǎn.
sentences.translation: After treatment, his condition has clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 护士会记录病情变化，并及时通知医生。
sentences.traditional: 護士會記錄病情變化，並及時通知醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi huì jìlù bìngqíng biànhuà, bìng jíshí tōngzhī yīshēng.
sentences.translation: Nurses record changes in the condition and promptly inform the doctor.

sentences.chinese: 如果病情突然加重，家属应该立即联系医院。
sentences.traditional: 如果病情突然加重，家屬應該立即聯繫醫院。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bìngqíng tūrán jiāzhòng, jiāshǔ yīnggāi lìjí liánxì yīyuàn.
sentences.translation: If the condition suddenly worsens, family members should contact the hospital immediately.

sentences.chinese: 遇到紧急情况时，请立即拨打报警电话。
sentences.traditional: 遇到緊急情況時，請立即撥打報警電話。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng shí, qǐng lìjí bōdǎ bàojǐng diànhuà.
sentences.translation: When you encounter an emergency, please dial the police number immediately.

sentences.chinese: 拨打国外电话前，你需要先确认国家号码。
sentences.traditional: 撥打國外電話前，你需要先確認國家號碼。
sentences.pinyin: Bōdǎ guówài diànhuà qián, nǐ xūyào xiān quèrèn guójiā hàomǎ.
sentences.translation: Before dialling an overseas number, you need to confirm the country code.

sentences.chinese: 客服热线经常占线，我连续拨打了好几次才接通。
sentences.traditional: 客服熱線經常占線，我連續撥打了好幾次才接通。
sentences.pinyin: Kèfú rèxiàn jīngcháng zhànxiàn, wǒ liánxù bōdǎ le hǎo jǐ cì cái jiētōng.
sentences.translation: The customer service hotline is often busy; I had to dial several times in a row before getting through.

sentences.chinese: 这扇玻璃虽然很厚，但还是被石头砸裂了。
sentences.traditional: 這扇玻璃雖然很厚，但還是被石頭砸裂了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shàn bōli suīrán hěn hòu, dàn háishi bèi shítou zá liè le.
sentences.translation: Although this pane of glass is very thick, it was still cracked by a stone.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少噪音，酒店把普通玻璃换成了双层的。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少噪音，酒店把普通玻璃換成了雙層的。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo zàoyīn, jiǔdiàn bǎ pǔtōng bōli huàn chéng le shuāngcéng de.
sentences.translation: To reduce noise, the hotel replaced the ordinary glass with double glazing.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们参观工厂时，老师提醒他们不要碰玻璃。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們參觀工廠時，老師提醒他們不要碰玻璃。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen cānguān gōngchǎng shí, lǎoshī tíxǐng tāmen búyào pèng bōli.
sentences.translation: When the children visited the factory, the teacher reminded them not to touch the glass.

sentences.chinese: 这座博物馆收藏了大量明清时期的家具。
sentences.traditional: 這座博物館收藏了大量明清時期的傢俱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò bówùguǎn shōucáng le dàliàng Míng-Qīng shíqī de jiājù.
sentences.translation: This museum has a large collection of furniture from the Ming and Qing periods.

sentences.chinese: 我们可以通过博物馆的展览了解这座城市的发展历史。
sentences.traditional: 我們可以通過博物館的展覽了解這座城市的發展歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ tōngguò bówùguǎn de zhǎnlǎn liǎojiě zhè zuò chéngshì de fāzhǎn lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: We can learn about this city’s development history through the museum’s exhibitions.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆每周一闭馆，所以你最好提前查一下开放时间。
sentences.traditional: 博物館每週一閉館，所以你最好提前查一下開放時間。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn měi zhōuyī bìguǎn, suǒyǐ nǐ zuìhǎo tíqián chá yíxià kāifàng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The museum is closed every Monday, so you had better check the opening times in advance.

sentences.chinese: 连续下雨对比赛安排非常不利。
sentences.traditional: 連續下雨對比賽安排非常不利。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù xiàyǔ duì bǐsài ānpái fēicháng búlì.
sentences.translation: Continuous rain is very unfavourable for the competition arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 如果资料准备不充分，谈判时就会处于不利地位。
sentences.traditional: 如果資料準備不充分，談判時就會處於不利地位。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zīliào zhǔnbèi bù chōngfèn, tánpàn shí jiù huì chǔyú búlì dìwèi.
sentences.translation: If the materials are not prepared fully, you will be in an unfavourable position during the negotiation.

sentences.chinese: 这种做法短期内省钱，长期看却不利于公司发展。
sentences.traditional: 這種做法短期內省錢，長期看卻不利於公司發展。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ duǎnqī nèi shěng qián, chángqī kàn què búlì yú gōngsī fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: This approach saves money in the short term, but in the long run it is unfavourable for the company’s development.

sentences.chinese: 不幸的是，航班因为暴雨被取消了。
sentences.traditional: 不幸的是，航班因為暴雨被取消了。
sentences.pinyin: Búxìng de shì, hángbān yīnwèi bàoyǔ bèi qǔxiāo le.
sentences.translation: Unfortunately, the flight was cancelled because of the rainstorm.

sentences.chinese: 他童年经历了不少不幸，但从来没有放弃努力。
sentences.traditional: 他童年經歷了不少不幸，但從來沒有放棄努力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tóngnián jīnglì le bù shǎo búxìng, dàn cónglái méiyǒu fàngqì nǔlì.
sentences.translation: He experienced quite a lot of misfortune in childhood, but he never gave up trying.

sentences.chinese: 这次事故中的不幸消息很快传遍了全镇。
sentences.traditional: 這次事故中的不幸消息很快傳遍了全鎮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù zhōng de búxìng xiāoxi hěn kuài chuánbiàn le quán zhèn.
sentences.translation: The tragic news from this accident quickly spread through the whole town.

sentences.chinese: 你迟到几分钟不要紧，关键是路上要注意安全。
sentences.traditional: 你遲到幾分鐘不要緊，關鍵是路上要注意安全。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ chídào jǐ fēnzhōng búyàojǐn, guānjiàn shì lùshang yào zhùyì ānquán.
