sentences.translation: It does not matter if you are a few minutes late; the key thing is to stay safe on the way.

sentences.chinese: 这点小伤不要紧，休息一会儿就会好。
sentences.traditional: 這點小傷不要緊，休息一會兒就會好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shāng búyàojǐn, xiūxi yíhuìr jiù huì hǎo.
sentences.translation: This small injury is not serious; it will get better after a short rest.

sentences.chinese: 没带现金不要紧，现在大多数地方都可以手机支付。
sentences.traditional: 沒帶現金不要緊，現在大多數地方都可以手機支付。
sentences.pinyin: Méi dài xiànjīn búyàojǐn, xiànzài dàduōshù dìfang dōu kěyǐ shǒujī zhīfù.
sentences.translation: It does not matter that you did not bring cash; most places accept mobile payment now.

sentences.chinese: 如果报告里缺少数据，请在明天之前补充完整。
sentences.traditional: 如果報告裡缺少數據，請在明天之前補充完整。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bàogào li quēshǎo shùjù, qǐng zài míngtiān zhīqián bǔchōng wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: If the report lacks data, please supplement it fully before tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 长时间运动后，身体需要及时补充水分和盐分。
sentences.traditional: 長時間運動後，身體需要及時補充水分和鹽分。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān yùndòng hòu, shēntǐ xūyào jíshí bǔchōng shuǐfèn hé yánfèn.
sentences.translation: After exercising for a long time, the body needs to replenish water and salt promptly.

sentences.chinese: 老师讲完以后，又补充了一个相关的例子。
sentences.traditional: 老師講完以後，又補充了一個相關的例子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng wán yǐhòu, yòu bǔchōng le yí gè xiāngguān de lìzi.
sentences.translation: After the teacher finished explaining, he added another related example.

sentences.chinese: 听说孩子发高烧，她急得不得了。
sentences.traditional: 聽說孩子發高燒，她急得不得了。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō háizi fā gāoshāo, tā jí de bùdéliǎo.
sentences.translation: Hearing that the child had a high fever, she became terribly anxious.

sentences.chinese: 这件事看起来小，其实影响不得了。
sentences.traditional: 這件事看起來小，其實影響不得了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì kàn qǐlái xiǎo, qíshí yǐngxiǎng bùdéliǎo.
sentences.translation: This matter looks small, but its impact is actually very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他在比赛中的表现好得不得了，连教练都很惊讶。
sentences.traditional: 他在比賽中的表現好得不得了，連教練都很驚訝。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng de biǎoxiàn hǎo de bùdéliǎo, lián jiàoliàn dōu hěn jīngyà.
sentences.translation: His performance in the competition was incredibly good; even the coach was surprised.

sentences.chinese: 你的姓名和身份证上的信息不符，暂时不能办理手续。
sentences.traditional: 你的姓名和身份證上的信息不符，暫時不能辦理手續。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de xìngmíng hé shēnfènzhèng shang de xìnxī bùfú, zànshí bù néng bànlǐ shǒuxù.
sentences.translation: Your name does not match the information on your ID card, so the procedure cannot be processed for now.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同的内容与我们之前商量的不符。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同的內容與我們之前商量的不符。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong de nèiróng yǔ wǒmen zhīqián shāngliang de bùfú.
sentences.translation: The contents of this contract are not in accordance with what we discussed before.

sentences.chinese: 如果产品说明与实际情况不符，消费者有权要求退款。
sentences.traditional: 如果產品說明與實際情況不符，消費者有權要求退款。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chǎnpǐn shuōmíng yǔ shíjì qíngkuàng bùfú, xiāofèizhě yǒu quán yāoqiú tuìkuǎn.
sentences.translation: If the product description does not match the actual situation, consumers have the right to request a refund.

sentences.chinese: 长期熬夜会形成不良生活习惯，影响身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 長期熬夜會形成不良生活習慣，影響身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī áoyè huì xíngchéng bùliáng shēnghuó xíguàn, yǐngxiǎng shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Staying up late for a long time can form bad lifestyle habits and affect your health.

sentences.chinese: 这种药可能产生不良反应，服用前要仔细阅读说明。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥可能產生不良反應，服用前要仔細閱讀說明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào kěnéng chǎnshēng bùliáng fǎnyìng, fúyòng qián yào zǐxì yuèdú shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: This medicine may cause adverse reactions, so read the instructions carefully before taking it.

sentences.chinese: 公司必须及时处理不良记录，否则会影响信用。
sentences.traditional: 公司必須及時處理不良記錄，否則會影響信用。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī bìxū jíshí chǔlǐ bùliáng jìlù, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng xìnyòng.
sentences.translation: The company must deal with bad records promptly, otherwise they will affect its credit.

sentences.chinese: 你最好提前出门，不然可能赶不上火车。
sentences.traditional: 你最好提前出門，不然可能趕不上火車。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo tíqián chūmén, bùrán kěnéng gǎn bu shàng huǒchē.
sentences.translation: You had better leave early, otherwise you may not catch the train.

sentences.chinese: 请把文件保存好，不然电脑一重启就可能丢失。
sentences.traditional: 請把文件保存好，不然電腦一重啟就可能丟失。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn bǎocún hǎo, bùrán diànnǎo yì chóngqǐ jiù kěnéng diūshī.
sentences.translation: Please save the document properly, otherwise it may be lost once the computer restarts.

sentences.chinese: 我们得先弄清楚原因，不然很难提出有效的解决办法。
sentences.traditional: 我們得先弄清楚原因，不然很難提出有效的解決辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen děi xiān nòng qīngchu yuányīn, bùrán hěn nán tíchū yǒuxiào de jiějué bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: We need to clarify the reason first, otherwise it will be difficult to propose an effective solution.

sentences.chinese: 从酒店到博物馆并不远，我们决定步行过去。
sentences.traditional: 從酒店到博物館並不遠，我們決定步行過去。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng jiǔdiàn dào bówùguǎn bìng bù yuǎn, wǒmen juédìng bùxíng guòqù.
sentences.translation: It is not far from the hotel to the museum, so we decided to walk there.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少交通压力，政府鼓励市民短途步行。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少交通壓力，政府鼓勵市民短途步行。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo jiāotōng yālì, zhèngfǔ gǔlì shìmín duǎntú bùxíng.
sentences.translation: To reduce traffic pressure, the government encourages residents to walk short distances.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他每天步行半小时，以改善身体状况。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他每天步行半小時，以改善身體狀況。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān bùxíng bàn xiǎoshí, yǐ gǎishàn shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to walk for half an hour every day to improve his physical condition.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告的数据不足，暂时不能作为最终依据。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告的數據不足，暫時不能作為最終依據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de shùjù bùzú, zànshí bù néng zuòwéi zuìzhōng yījù.
sentences.translation: The data in this report is insufficient, so it cannot be used as the final basis for now.

sentences.chinese: 由于经验不足，他在处理客户投诉时显得有些紧张。
sentences.traditional: 由於經驗不足，他在處理客戶投訴時顯得有些緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú jīngyàn bùzú, tā zài chǔlǐ kèhù tóusù shí xiǎnde yǒuxiē jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Because he lacked experience, he seemed rather nervous when handling customer complaints.

sentences.chinese: 资金不足是这个项目推迟的主要原因之一。
sentences.traditional: 資金不足是這個項目推遲的主要原因之一。
sentences.pinyin: Zījīn bùzú shì zhège xiàngmù tuīchí de zhǔyào yuányīn zhī yī.
sentences.translation: Insufficient funding is one of the main reasons why this project has been delayed.

sentences.chinese: 这个年轻人很有才，只是还缺少展示自己的机会。
sentences.traditional: 這個年輕人很有才，只是還缺少展示自己的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège niánqīngrén hěn yǒu cái, zhǐshì hái quēshǎo zhǎnshì zìjǐ de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: This young person has real talent, but still lacks opportunities to show himself.

sentences.chinese: 公司不但要用才，还要懂得留住真正有能力的人。
sentences.traditional: 公司不但要用才，還要懂得留住真正有能力的人。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī búdàn yào yòng cái, hái yào dǒngde liúzhù zhēnzhèng yǒu nénglì de rén.
sentences.translation: A company must not only make use of talent, but also know how to keep truly capable people.

sentences.chinese: 老师认为，才需要靠长期努力才能真正发挥出来。
sentences.traditional: 老師認為，才需要靠長期努力才能真正發揮出來。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi, cái xūyào kào chángqī nǔlì cái néng zhēnzhèng fāhuī chūlái.
sentences.translation: The teacher believes that talent can only truly be brought out through long-term effort.

sentences.chinese: 裁判认为这个动作犯规，因此取消了他的成绩。
sentences.traditional: 裁判認為這個動作犯規，因此取消了他的成績。
sentences.pinyin: Cáipàn rènwéi zhège dòngzuò fànguī, yīncǐ qǔxiāo le tā de chéngjì.
sentences.translation: The referee judged that this move broke the rules, so his result was cancelled.

sentences.chinese: 在比赛现场，裁判必须保持公平，不能受观众情绪影响。
sentences.traditional: 在比賽現場，裁判必須保持公平，不能受觀眾情緒影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zài bǐsài xiànchǎng, cáipàn bìxū bǎochí gōngpíng, bù néng shòu guānzhòng qíngxù yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: At the competition venue, the referee must remain fair and not be influenced by the crowd’s emotions.

sentences.chinese: 这次作文比赛由三位老师共同裁判，结果比较客观。
sentences.traditional: 這次作文比賽由三位老師共同裁判，結果比較客觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòwén bǐsài yóu sān wèi lǎoshī gòngtóng cáipàn, jiéguǒ bǐjiào kèguān.
sentences.translation: This composition competition was judged jointly by three teachers, so the result was fairly objective.

sentences.chinese: 记者采访了几位乘客，了解暴雨对交通的影响。
sentences.traditional: 記者採訪了幾位乘客，了解暴雨對交通的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě cǎifǎng le jǐ wèi chéngkè, liǎojiě bàoyǔ duì jiāotōng de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The reporter interviewed several passengers to understand the impact of the rainstorm on transport.

sentences.chinese: 接受采访时，他没有直接回答关于收入的问题。
sentences.traditional: 接受採訪時，他沒有直接回答關於收入的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēshòu cǎifǎng shí, tā méiyǒu zhíjiē huídá guānyú shōurù de wèntí.
sentences.translation: When being interviewed, he did not directly answer questions about his income.

sentences.chinese: 为了写这篇报道，她连续采访了十多名专家。
sentences.traditional: 為了寫這篇報道，她連續採訪了十多名專家。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile xiě zhè piān bàodào, tā liánxù cǎifǎng le shí duō míng zhuānjiā.
sentences.translation: To write this news report, she interviewed more than ten experts in succession.

sentences.chinese: 如果病情继续恶化，医院将采取进一步治疗措施。
sentences.traditional: 如果病情繼續惡化，醫院將採取進一步治療措施。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bìngqíng jìxù èhuà, yīyuàn jiāng cǎiqǔ jìn yí bù zhìliáo cuòshī.
sentences.translation: If the condition continues to worsen, the hospital will take further treatment measures.

sentences.chinese: 面对成本上升，公司决定采取更严格的管理办法。
sentences.traditional: 面對成本上升，公司決定採取更嚴格的管理辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì chéngběn shàngshēng, gōngsī juédìng cǎiqǔ gèng yángé de guǎnlǐ bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Facing rising costs, the company decided to adopt stricter management methods.

sentences.chinese: 专家建议采取有效措施，避免类似事故再次发生。
sentences.traditional: 專家建議採取有效措施，避免類似事故再次發生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā jiànyì cǎiqǔ yǒuxiào cuòshī, bìmiǎn lèisì shìgù zàicì fāshēng.
sentences.translation: Experts recommend taking effective measures to prevent similar accidents from happening again.

sentences.chinese: 这本儿童读物配有彩色插图，内容也很容易理解。
sentences.traditional: 這本兒童讀物配有彩色插圖，內容也很容易理解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn értóng dúwù pèi yǒu cǎisè chātú, nèiróng yě hěn róngyì lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: This children’s reader includes colour illustrations, and the content is also easy to understand.

sentences.chinese: 请把黑白文件改成彩色版本，方便客户查看。
sentences.traditional: 請把黑白文件改成彩色版本，方便客戶查看。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hēibái wénjiàn gǎi chéng cǎisè bǎnběn, fāngbiàn kèhù chákàn.
sentences.translation: Please change the black-and-white document into a colour version so the client can view it more easily.

sentences.chinese: 会议室的大屏幕能够显示高清彩色图像。
sentences.traditional: 會議室的大屏幕能夠顯示高清彩色圖像。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì de dà píngmù nénggòu xiǎnshì gāoqīng cǎisè túxiàng.
sentences.translation: The large screen in the meeting room can display high-definition colour images.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂采用了新的包装材料，以减少环境污染。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠採用了新的包裝材料，以減少環境污染。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng cǎiyòng le xīn de bāozhuāng cáiliào, yǐ jiǎnshǎo huánjìng wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: This factory has adopted new packaging materials to reduce environmental pollution.

sentences.chinese: 学校决定采用电子教材，学生可以随时下载参考。
sentences.traditional: 學校決定採用電子教材，學生可以隨時下載參考。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào juédìng cǎiyòng diànzǐ jiàocái, xuéshēng kěyǐ suíshí xiàzài cānkǎo.
sentences.translation: The school decided to use electronic textbooks, which students can download and consult at any time.

sentences.chinese: 这个系统采用双重验证，安全性比以前高得多。
sentences.traditional: 這個系統採用雙重驗證，安全性比以前高得多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xìtǒng cǎiyòng shuāngchóng yànzhèng, ānquánxìng bǐ yǐqián gāo de duō.
sentences.translation: This system uses two-factor verification, so its security is much higher than before.

sentences.chinese: 写报告以前，你可以先参考去年的数据和结论。
sentences.traditional: 寫報告以前，你可以先參考去年的數據和結論。
sentences.pinyin: Xiě bàogào yǐqián, nǐ kěyǐ xiān cānkǎo qùnián de shùjù hé jiélùn.
sentences.translation: Before writing the report, you can first refer to last year’s data and conclusions.

sentences.chinese: 这些意见只供参考，最终决定还要由你自己来做。
sentences.traditional: 這些意見只供參考，最終決定還要由你自己來做。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē yìjiàn zhǐ gōng cānkǎo, zuìzhōng juédìng hái yào yóu nǐ zìjǐ lái zuò.
sentences.translation: These suggestions are for reference only; the final decision still has to be made by you.

sentences.chinese: 老师建议我们参考几篇优秀作品，再修改自己的作文。
sentences.traditional: 老師建議我們參考幾篇優秀作品，再修改自己的作文。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiànyì wǒmen cānkǎo jǐ piān yōuxiù zuòpǐn, zài xiūgǎi zìjǐ de zuòwén.
sentences.translation: The teacher suggested that we refer to several excellent works before revising our own compositions.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒店的餐饮服务不错，但房间价格偏高。
sentences.traditional: 這家酒店的餐飲服務不錯，但房間價格偏高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de cānyǐn fúwù búcuò, dàn fángjiān jiàgé piān gāo.
sentences.translation: The catering service at this hotel is good, but the room prices are rather high.

sentences.chinese: 受暴雨影响，景区内的餐饮店全部提前关门。
sentences.traditional: 受暴雨影響，景區內的餐飲店全部提前關門。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu bàoyǔ yǐngxiǎng, jǐngqū nèi de cānyǐn diàn quánbù tíqián guānmén.
sentences.translation: Affected by the rainstorm, all the food and drink outlets in the scenic area closed early.

sentences.chinese: 如果要办大型活动，餐饮安排必须提前确认。
sentences.traditional: 如果要辦大型活動，餐飲安排必須提前確認。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yào bàn dàxíng huódòng, cānyǐn ānpái bìxū tíqián quèrèn.
sentences.translation: If you are organising a large event, the catering arrangements must be confirmed in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这次项目需要所有部门共同参与，不能只靠技术团队。
sentences.traditional: 這次項目需要所有部門共同參與，不能只靠技術團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù xūyào suǒyǒu bùmén gòngtóng cānyù, bù néng zhǐ kào jìshù tuánduì.
sentences.translation: This project requires all departments to participate together, not just rely on the technical team.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想参与讨论，最好先把相关材料看完。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想參與討論，最好先把相關材料看完。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng cānyù tǎolùn, zuìhǎo xiān bǎ xiāngguān cáiliào kàn wán.
sentences.translation: If you want to participate in the discussion, it would be best to finish reading the relevant materials first.

sentences.chinese: 他不仅参与了计划的设计，还负责后期的执行。
sentences.traditional: 他不僅參與了計劃的設計，還負責後期的執行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn cānyù le jìhuà de shèjì, hái fùzé hòuqī de zhíxíng.
sentences.translation: He not only participated in designing the plan, but was also responsible for its later implementation.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把零食藏在抽屉里，以为没人会发现。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把零食藏在抽屜裡，以為沒人會發現。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ língshí cáng zài chōutì lǐ, yǐwéi méi rén huì fāxiàn.
sentences.translation: The child hid the snacks in the drawer, thinking no one would find them.

sentences.chinese: 他把真实想法藏得很深，所以大家都误会了他的意思。
sentences.traditional: 他把真實想法藏得很深，所以大家都誤會了他的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhēnshí xiǎngfǎ cáng de hěn shēn, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu wùhuì le tā de yìsi.
sentences.translation: He hid his true thoughts very deeply, so everyone misunderstood what he meant.

sentences.chinese: 这份文件不能随便藏起来，必须按照规定保存。
sentences.traditional: 這份文件不能隨便藏起來，必須按照規定保存。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn bù néng suíbiàn cáng qǐlái, bìxū ànzhào guīdìng bǎocún.
sentences.translation: This document cannot just be hidden away; it must be stored according to regulations.

sentences.chinese: 使用这台设备前，你必须先了解基本操作步骤。
sentences.traditional: 使用這臺設備前，你必須先了解基本操作步驟。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐyòng zhè tái shèbèi qián, nǐ bìxū xiān liǎojiě jīběn cāozuò bùzhòu.
sentences.translation: Before using this equipment, you must first understand the basic operating steps.

sentences.chinese: 如果系统操作不当，可能会造成数据丢失。
sentences.traditional: 如果系統操作不當，可能會造成數據丟失。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xìtǒng cāozuò bú dàng, kěnéng huì zàochéng shùjù diūshī.
sentences.translation: If the system is operated improperly, it may cause data loss.

sentences.chinese: 这项操作看起来简单，但每一步都不能出错。
sentences.traditional: 這項操作看起來簡單，但每一步都不能出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng cāozuò kàn qǐlái jiǎndān, dàn měi yí bù dōu bù néng chūcuò.
sentences.translation: This operation looks simple, but not a single step can go wrong.

sentences.chinese: 这套教材一共分为三册，第一册最适合初学者。
sentences.traditional: 這套教材一共分為三冊，第一冊最適合初學者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào jiàocái yígòng fēn wéi sān cè, dì-yī cè zuì shìhé chūxuézhě.
sentences.translation: This set of textbooks is divided into three volumes; the first volume is most suitable for beginners.

sentences.chinese: 图书馆新买了两册关于环境保护的研究报告。
sentences.traditional: 圖書館新買了兩冊關於環境保護的研究報告。
sentences.pinyin: Túshūguǎn xīn mǎi le liǎng cè guānyú huánjìng bǎohù de yánjiū bàogào.
sentences.translation: The library has bought two volumes of research reports on environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 这本小说分上下两册出版，内容却连接得很自然。
sentences.traditional: 這本小說分上下兩冊出版，內容卻連接得很自然。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō fēn shàng xià liǎng cè chūbǎn, nèiróng què liánjiē de hěn zìrán.
sentences.translation: This novel was published in two volumes, upper and lower, yet the content connects very naturally.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他每天早晚各测一次血压。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他每天早晚各測一次血壓。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān zǎo wǎn gè cè yí cì xuèyā.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested that he measure his blood pressure once every morning and evening.

sentences.chinese: 工程师先测了墙面的高度，才开始设计安装方案。
sentences.traditional: 工程師先測了牆面的高度，才開始設計安裝方案。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī xiān cè le qiángmiàn de gāodù, cái kāishǐ shèjì ānzhuāng fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: The engineer first measured the height of the wall before starting to design the installation plan.

sentences.chinese: 为了确认数据准确，我们需要再测一遍。
sentences.traditional: 為了確認數據準確，我們需要再測一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile quèrèn shùjù zhǔnquè, wǒmen xūyào zài cè yí biàn.
sentences.translation: To confirm that the data is accurate, we need to measure it again.

sentences.chinese: 新软件上线之前，技术人员要反复测试它的稳定性。
sentences.traditional: 新軟件上線之前，技術人員要反覆測試它的穩定性。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn ruǎnjiàn shàngxiàn zhīqián, jìshù rényuán yào fǎnfù cèshì tā de wěndìngxìng.
sentences.translation: Before the new software goes online, technicians need to repeatedly test its stability.

sentences.chinese: 这次测试的结果表明，产品质量已经明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 這次測試的結果表明，產品質量已經明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì cèshì de jiéguǒ biǎomíng, chǎnpǐn zhìliàng yǐjīng míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: The results of this test show that product quality has already improved noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 老师用十分钟测试学生是否掌握了这部分语法。
sentences.traditional: 老師用十分鐘測試學生是否掌握了這部分語法。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng shí fēnzhōng cèshì xuéshēng shìfǒu zhǎngwò le zhè bùfen yǔfǎ.
sentences.translation: The teacher used ten minutes to test whether the students had mastered this grammar point.

sentences.chinese: 他曾在北京生活过几年，所以对那里的文化很熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 他曾在北京生活過幾年，所以對那裡的文化很熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng zài Běijīng shēnghuó guo jǐ nián, suǒyǐ duì nàlǐ de wénhuà hěn shúxī.
sentences.translation: He once lived in Beijing for several years, so he is very familiar with the culture there.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司曾面临严重困难，但后来慢慢恢复了。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司曾面臨嚴重困難，但後來慢慢恢復了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī céng miànlín yánzhòng kùnnan, dàn hòulái mànmàn huīfù le.
sentences.translation: This company once faced serious difficulties, but later slowly recovered.

sentences.chinese: 我们曾考虑过搬家，不过最后还是决定留下来。
sentences.traditional: 我們曾考慮過搬家，不過最後還是決定留下來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen céng kǎolǜ guo bānjiā, búguò zuìhòu háishi juédìng liú xiàlái.
sentences.translation: We once considered moving house, but in the end we decided to stay.

sentences.chinese: 她曾经因为害怕失败而不敢表达自己的意见。
sentences.traditional: 她曾經因為害怕失敗而不敢表達自己的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céngjīng yīnwèi hàipà shībài ér bù gǎn biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: She once did not dare to express her opinions because she was afraid of failure.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市曾经很安静，如今却成了重要的商业中心。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市曾經很安靜，如今卻成了重要的商業中心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì céngjīng hěn ānjìng, rújīn què chéng le zhòngyào de shāngyè zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: This city was once very quiet, but now it has become an important business centre.

sentences.chinese: 我曾经以为只要努力就一定能成功，后来才明白方向也很重要。
sentences.traditional: 我曾經以為只要努力就一定能成功，後來才明白方向也很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ céngjīng yǐwéi zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yídìng néng chénggōng, hòulái cái míngbai fāngxiàng yě hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: I once thought that hard work alone would certainly lead to success; later I understood that direction is also important.

sentences.chinese: 请把银行卡插进机器，然后按照屏幕提示操作。
sentences.traditional: 請把銀行卡插進機器，然後按照屏幕提示操作。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yínhángkǎ chā jìn jīqì, ránhòu ànzhào píngmù tíshì cāozuò.
sentences.translation: Please insert the bank card into the machine, then follow the instructions on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 他在演讲中插了一段自己的经历，使内容更有说服力。
sentences.traditional: 他在演講中插了一段自己的經歷，使內容更有說服力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài yǎnjiǎng zhōng chā le yí duàn zìjǐ de jīnglì, shǐ nèiróng gèng yǒu shuōfúlì.
sentences.translation: He inserted a section about his own experience into the speech, making the content more persuasive.

sentences.chinese: 会议已经开始了，请不要随便插话。
sentences.traditional: 會議已經開始了，請不要隨便插話。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yǐjīng kāishǐ le, qǐng bú yào suíbiàn chāhuà.
sentences.translation: The meeting has already started, so please do not interrupt casually.

sentences.chinese: 这两种做法表面上差别不大，实际效果却完全不同。
sentences.traditional: 這兩種做法表面上差別不大，實際效果卻完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng zuòfǎ biǎomiàn shang chābié bú dà, shíjì xiàoguǒ què wánquán bù tóng.
sentences.translation: On the surface, there is not much difference between these two approaches, but their actual effects are completely different.

sentences.chinese: 不同地区的饮食习惯有明显差别，这很正常。
sentences.traditional: 不同地區的飲食習慣有明顯差別，這很正常。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng dìqū de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu míngxiǎn chābié, zhè hěn zhèngcháng.
sentences.translation: There are obvious differences in eating habits between different regions, and that is very normal.

sentences.chinese: 经理强调，价格差别并不是我们选择供应商的唯一标准。
sentences.traditional: 經理強調，價格差別並不是我們選擇供應商的唯一標準。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ qiángdiào, jiàgé chābié bìng bú shì wǒmen xuǎnzé gōngyìngshāng de wéiyī biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: The manager emphasised that the price difference is not our only standard for choosing a supplier.

sentences.chinese: 城市和农村在教育资源上的差距正在逐渐缩小。
sentences.traditional: 城市和農村在教育資源上的差距正在逐漸縮小。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì hé nóngcūn zài jiàoyù zīyuán shang de chājù zhèngzài zhújiàn suōxiǎo.
sentences.translation: The gap in educational resources between cities and rural areas is gradually narrowing.

sentences.chinese: 如果不承认差距，就很难找到真正的改进方向。
sentences.traditional: 如果不承認差距，就很難找到真正的改進方向。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù chéngrèn chājù, jiù hěn nán zhǎodào zhēnzhèng de gǎijìn fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: If we do not acknowledge the gap, it is hard to find the real direction for improvement.

sentences.chinese: 这次考试的结果显示，两组学生之间存在明显差距。
sentences.traditional: 這次考試的結果顯示，兩組學生之間存在明顯差距。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de jiéguǒ xiǎnshì, liǎng zǔ xuéshēng zhījiān cúnzài míngxiǎn chājù.
sentences.translation: The results of this exam show an obvious gap between the two groups of students.

sentences.chinese: 西餐桌上如果没有叉子，我反而不知道该怎么吃。
sentences.traditional: 西餐桌上如果沒有叉子，我反而不知道該怎麼吃。
sentences.pinyin: Xīcān zhuō shang rúguǒ méiyǒu chāzi, wǒ fǎn’ér bù zhīdào gāi zěnme chī.
sentences.translation: At a Western dining table, if there is no fork, I actually do not know how to eat.

sentences.chinese: 服务员把刀和叉子摆在盘子两边，显得很正式。
sentences.traditional: 服務員把刀和叉子擺在盤子兩邊，顯得很正式。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán bǎ dāo hé chāzi bǎi zài pánzi liǎngbiān, xiǎnde hěn zhèngshì.
sentences.translation: The waiter placed the knife and fork on both sides of the plate, making it look very formal.

sentences.chinese: 他用叉子轻轻尝了一口蛋糕，立刻说味道不错。
sentences.traditional: 他用叉子輕輕嚐了一口蛋糕，立刻說味道不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng chāzi qīngqīng cháng le yì kǒu dàngāo, lìkè shuō wèidào búcuò.
sentences.translation: He used a fork to taste a small bite of cake and immediately said it tasted good.

sentences.chinese: 这座旧桥不能直接拆，必须先做安全评估。
sentences.traditional: 這座舊橋不能直接拆，必須先做安全評估。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò jiù qiáo bù néng zhíjiē chāi, bìxū xiān zuò ānquán pínggū.
sentences.translation: This old bridge cannot be demolished directly; a safety assessment must be done first.

sentences.chinese: 快递到了以后，他迫不及待地把包裹拆开。
sentences.traditional: 快遞到了以後，他迫不及待地把包裹拆開。
sentences.pinyin: Kuàidì dào le yǐhòu, tā pòbùjídài de bǎ bāoguǒ chāi kāi.
sentences.translation: After the delivery arrived, he could not wait to open the parcel.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定把原来的部门拆成两个小组，以提高效率。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定把原來的部門拆成兩個小組，以提高效率。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng bǎ yuánlái de bùmén chāi chéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, yǐ tígāo xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The company decided to split the original department into two teams to improve efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 这种茶主要产在山区，产量并不高。
sentences.traditional: 這種茶主要產在山區，產量並不高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chá zhǔyào chǎn zài shānqū, chǎnliàng bìng bù gāo.
sentences.translation: This kind of tea is mainly produced in mountain areas, and its output is not high.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂一年能产上百万件电子产品。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠一年能產上百萬件電子產品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng yì nián néng chǎn shàng bǎi wàn jiàn diànzǐ chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: This factory can produce over one million electronic products a year.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区不仅产水果，还发展了相关的加工产业。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區不僅產水果，還發展了相關的加工產業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn chǎn shuǐguǒ, hái fāzhǎn le xiāngguān de jiāgōng chǎnyè.
sentences.translation: This region not only produces fruit, but has also developed related processing industries.

sentences.chinese: 受天气影响，今年小麦的产量比去年低了不少。
sentences.traditional: 受天氣影響，今年小麥的產量比去年低了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng, jīnnián xiǎomài de chǎnliàng bǐ qùnián dī le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: Affected by the weather, this year’s wheat output is much lower than last year’s.

sentences.chinese: 企业不能只追求产量，还要保证产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 企業不能只追求產量，還要保證產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú chǎnliàng, hái yào bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Companies must not only pursue output, but also ensure product quality.

sentences.chinese: 新设备投入使用后，车间的产量明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 新設備投入使用後，車間的產量明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn shèbèi tóurù shǐyòng hòu, chējiān de chǎnliàng míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: After the new equipment was put into use, the workshop’s output increased significantly.

sentences.chinese: 这款产品之所以受欢迎，是因为设计既简单又实用。
sentences.traditional: 這款產品之所以受歡迎，是因為設計既簡單又實用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn zhī suǒyǐ shòu huānyíng, shì yīnwèi shèjì jì jiǎndān yòu shíyòng.
sentences.translation: The reason this product is popular is that its design is both simple and practical.

sentences.chinese: 在正式销售之前，所有产品都必须经过严格测试。
sentences.traditional: 在正式銷售之前，所有產品都必須經過嚴格測試。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì xiāoshòu zhīqián, suǒyǒu chǎnpǐn dōu bìxū jīngguò yángé cèshì.
sentences.translation: Before formal sale, all products must undergo strict testing.

sentences.chinese: 客户提出的意见帮助我们改进了产品的包装。
sentences.traditional: 客戶提出的意見幫助我們改進了產品的包裝。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù tíchū de yìjiàn bāngzhù wǒmen gǎijìn le chǎnpǐn de bāozhuāng.
sentences.translation: Customer feedback helped us improve the product’s packaging.

sentences.chinese: 随着旅游业发展，当地的餐饮产业也越来越成熟。
sentences.traditional: 隨著旅遊業發展，當地的餐飲產業也越來越成熟。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe lǚyóuyè fāzhǎn, dāngdì de cānyǐn chǎnyè yě yuè lái yuè chéngshú.
sentences.translation: As tourism develops, the local catering industry is becoming increasingly mature.

sentences.chinese: 政府希望通过技术创新推动传统产业升级。
sentences.traditional: 政府希望通過技術創新推動傳統產業升級。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xīwàng tōngguò jìshù chuàngxīn tuīdòng chuántǒng chǎnyè shēngjí.
sentences.translation: The government hopes to promote the upgrading of traditional industries through technological innovation.

sentences.chinese: 一个城市要长期发展，不能只依靠单一产业。
sentences.traditional: 一個城市要長期發展，不能只依靠單一產業。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge chéngshì yào chángqī fāzhǎn, bù néng zhǐ yīkào dānyī chǎnyè.
sentences.translation: For a city to develop long-term, it cannot rely on a single industry.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都有自己的长处，关键是能否把它发挥出来。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都有自己的長處，關鍵是能否把它發揮出來。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de chángchù, guānjiàn shì néngfǒu bǎ tā fāhuī chūlái.
sentences.translation: Everyone has their own strengths; the key is whether they can bring them into play.

sentences.chinese: 与其总盯着别人的缺点，不如多学习他们的长处。
sentences.traditional: 與其總盯著別人的缺點，不如多學習他們的長處。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí zǒng dīngzhe biéren de quēdiǎn, bùrú duō xuéxí tāmen de chángchù.
sentences.translation: Rather than always focusing on others’ shortcomings, it is better to learn more from their strengths.

sentences.chinese: 他最大的长处是遇到压力时依然能保持冷静。
sentences.traditional: 他最大的長處是遇到壓力時依然能保持冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì dà de chángchù shì yùdào yālì shí yīrán néng bǎochí lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: His greatest strength is that he can still remain calm under pressure.

sentences.chinese: 这篇报告的长度合适，内容也比较完整。
sentences.traditional: 這篇報告的長度合適，內容也比較完整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān bàogào de chángdù héshì, nèiróng yě bǐjiào wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: The length of this report is appropriate, and the content is also fairly complete.

sentences.chinese: 安装窗帘之前，最好先准确测量窗户的长度。
sentences.traditional: 安裝窗簾之前，最好先準確測量窗戶的長度。
sentences.pinyin: Ānzhuāng chuānglián zhīqián, zuìhǎo xiān zhǔnquè cèliáng chuānghu de chángdù.
sentences.translation: Before installing the curtains, it is best to accurately measure the length of the window.

sentences.chinese: 老师提醒我们，作文的长度不是最重要的，观点清楚才重要。
sentences.traditional: 老師提醒我們，作文的長度不是最重要的，觀點清楚才重要。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng wǒmen, zuòwén de chángdù bú shì zuì zhòngyào de, guāndiǎn qīngchu cái zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: The teacher reminded us that the length of the essay is not the most important thing; clear viewpoints are.

sentences.chinese: 真正长久的合作，必须建立在彼此信任的基础上。
sentences.traditional: 真正長久的合作，必須建立在彼此信任的基礎上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng chángjiǔ de hézuò, bìxū jiànlì zài bǐcǐ xìnrèn de jīchǔ shang.
sentences.translation: A truly long-lasting partnership must be built on mutual trust.

sentences.chinese: 靠低价吸引顾客不是长久的办法。
sentences.traditional: 靠低價吸引顧客不是長久的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Kào dījià xīyǐn gùkè bú shì chángjiǔ de bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Attracting customers through low prices is not a long-term solution.

sentences.chinese: 如果想让关系长久，就不能总是忽视对方的感受。
sentences.traditional: 如果想讓關係長久，就不能總是忽視對方的感受。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng ràng guānxì chángjiǔ, jiù bù néng zǒng shì hūshì duìfāng de gǎnshòu.
sentences.translation: If you want a relationship to last, you cannot always ignore the other person’s feelings.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定采用长期计划，而不是只看眼前的利益。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定採用長期計劃，而不是只看眼前的利益。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng cǎiyòng chángqī jìhuà, ér bú shì zhǐ kàn yǎnqián de lìyì.
sentences.translation: The company decided to adopt a long-term plan rather than only looking at immediate interests.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺乏睡眠会对身体和情绪产生不良影响。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺乏睡眠會對身體和情緒產生不良影響。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá shuìmián huì duì shēntǐ hé qíngxù chǎnshēng bùliáng yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: A long-term lack of sleep can have a harmful effect on the body and emotions.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究需要长期观察，结果不能马上得出。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究需要長期觀察，結果不能馬上得出。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū xūyào chángqī guānchá, jiéguǒ bù néng mǎshàng dé chū.
sentences.translation: This research requires long-term observation; the results cannot be obtained immediately.

sentences.chinese: 在公共场所保持安静，是每个人都应该懂的常识。
sentences.traditional: 在公共場所保持安靜，是每個人都應該懂的常識。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ bǎochí ānjìng, shì měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi dǒng de chángshí.
sentences.translation: Keeping quiet in public places is common knowledge that everyone should understand.

sentences.chinese: 判断新闻真假时，基本常识往往比情绪更可靠。
sentences.traditional: 判斷新聞真假時，基本常識往往比情緒更可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Pànduàn xīnwén zhēn jiǎ shí, jīběn chángshí wǎngwǎng bǐ qíngxù gèng kěkào.
sentences.translation: When judging whether news is true or false, basic common sense is often more reliable than emotion.

sentences.chinese: 这些安全常识虽然简单，但遇到危险时非常有用。
sentences.traditional: 這些安全常識雖然簡單，但遇到危險時非常有用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē ānquán chángshí suīrán jiǎndān, dàn yùdào wēixiǎn shí fēicháng yǒuyòng.
sentences.translation: Although these safety tips are simple, they are very useful when danger occurs.

sentences.chinese: 如果原来的方法没有作用，我们可以尝试另一种做法。
sentences.traditional: 如果原來的方法沒有作用，我們可以嘗試另一種做法。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yuánlái de fāngfǎ méiyǒu zuòyòng, wǒmen kěyǐ chángshì lìng yì zhǒng zuòfǎ.
sentences.translation: If the original method has no effect, we can try another approach.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次尝试用中文做报告，紧张得说错了几个词。
sentences.traditional: 他第一次嘗試用中文做報告，緊張得說錯了幾個詞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chángshì yòng Zhōngwén zuò bàogào, jǐnzhāng de shuō cuò le jǐ ge cí.
sentences.translation: He tried giving a report in Chinese for the first time and was so nervous that he said a few words wrong.

sentences.chinese: 只有不断尝试，才有可能找到更适合自己的方向。
sentences.traditional: 只有不斷嘗試，才有可能找到更適合自己的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu búduàn chángshì, cái yǒu kěnéng zhǎodào gèng shìhé zìjǐ de fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: Only by trying continuously is it possible to find a direction that suits you better.

sentences.chinese: 长途旅行前，最好提前检查车辆和安全带。
sentences.traditional: 長途旅行前，最好提前檢查車輛和安全帶。
sentences.pinyin: Chángtú lǚxíng qián, zuìhǎo tíqián jiǎnchá chēliàng hé ānquándài.
sentences.translation: Before a long-distance journey, it is best to check the vehicle and seatbelts in advance.

sentences.chinese: 他刚下长途飞机，还没来得及休息就去报到了。
sentences.traditional: 他剛下長途飛機，還沒來得及休息就去報到了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng xià chángtú fēijī, hái méi láidejí xiūxi jiù qù bàodào le.
sentences.translation: He had just got off a long-distance flight and went to check in before he even had time to rest.

sentences.chinese: 对老人来说，连续十几个小时的长途车程太辛苦了。
sentences.traditional: 對老人來說，連續十幾個小時的長途車程太辛苦了。
sentences.pinyin: Duì lǎorén lái shuō, liánxù shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí de chángtú chēchéng tài xīnkǔ le.
sentences.translation: For elderly people, a long-distance journey of more than ten hours is too exhausting.

sentences.chinese: 从长远来看，保护环境比短期利润更重要。
sentences.traditional: 從長遠來看，保護環境比短期利潤更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng chángyuǎn lái kàn, bǎohù huánjìng bǐ duǎnqī lìrùn gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In the long run, protecting the environment is more important than short-term profit.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定不仅影响现在，还会带来长远的变化。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定不僅影響現在，還會帶來長遠的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng xiànzài, hái huì dàilái chángyuǎn de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This decision not only affects the present, but will also bring far-reaching changes.

sentences.chinese: 教育的作用往往很长远，不一定马上看得出来。
sentences.traditional: 教育的作用往往很長遠，不一定馬上看得出來。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù de zuòyòng wǎngwǎng hěn chángyuǎn, bù yídìng mǎshàng kàn de chūlái.
sentences.translation: The effect of education is often far-reaching and may not be visible immediately.

sentences.chinese: 医院是公共场所，大家应该尽量保持安静。
sentences.traditional: 醫院是公共場所，大家應該盡量保持安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn shì gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ, dàjiā yīnggāi jǐnliàng bǎochí ānjìng.
sentences.translation: A hospital is a public place, so everyone should try to keep quiet.

sentences.chinese: 这座博物馆不仅是参观场所，也是当地文化教育的重要基地。
sentences.traditional: 這座博物館不僅是參觀場所，也是當地文化教育的重要基地。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò bówùguǎn bùjǐn shì cānguān chǎngsuǒ, yě shì dāngdì wénhuà jiàoyù de zhòngyào jīdì.
sentences.translation: This museum is not only a place for visits, but also an important local base for cultural education.

sentences.chinese: 危险物品不能带进这种封闭场所，以免发生意外。
sentences.traditional: 危險物品不能帶進這種封閉場所，以免發生意外。
sentences.pinyin: Wēixiǎn wùpǐn bù néng dài jìn zhè zhǒng fēngbì chǎngsuǒ, yǐmiǎn fāshēng yìwài.
sentences.translation: Dangerous items must not be brought into this kind of enclosed venue, in order to avoid accidents.

sentences.chinese: 今年的产量超了原来的计划，工人们都很兴奋。
sentences.traditional: 今年的產量超了原來的計劃，工人們都很興奮。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián de chǎnliàng chāo le yuánlái de jìhuà, gōngrénmen dōu hěn xīngfèn.
sentences.translation: This year’s output exceeded the original plan, and the workers were all very excited.

sentences.chinese: 他的成绩已经超了班里大多数同学。
sentences.traditional: 他的成績已經超了班裡大多數同學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì yǐjīng chāo le bān lǐ dàduōshù tóngxué.
sentences.translation: His results have already surpassed most of the students in the class.

sentences.chinese: 费用超了预算，我们只好减少一部分安排。
sentences.traditional: 費用超了預算，我們只好減少一部分安排。
sentences.pinyin: Fèiyòng chāo le yùsuàn, wǒmen zhǐhǎo jiǎnshǎo yí bùfen ānpái.
sentences.translation: The costs exceeded the budget, so we had to reduce some of the arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动的参加人数超出了我们的预料。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動的參加人數超出了我們的預料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng de cānjiā rénshù chāochū le wǒmen de yùliào.
sentences.translation: The number of participants in this event exceeded our expectations.

sentences.chinese: 如果费用超出预算，项目可能需要重新讨论。
sentences.traditional: 如果費用超出預算，項目可能需要重新討論。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fèiyòng chāochū yùsuàn, xiàngmù kěnéng xūyào chóngxīn tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: If the costs exceed the budget, the project may need to be discussed again.

sentences.chinese: 他的回答已经超出了题目的范围。
sentences.traditional: 他的回答已經超出了題目的範圍。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huídá yǐjīng chāochū le tímù de fànwéi.
sentences.translation: His answer has already gone beyond the scope of the question.

sentences.chinese: 这家便利店虽然不大，但买东西超级方便。
sentences.traditional: 這家便利店雖然不大，但買東西超級方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā biànlìdiàn suīrán bú dà, dàn mǎi dōngxi chāojí fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: Although this convenience store is not big, shopping there is super convenient.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候特别喜欢超级英雄，常常把自己想象成其中一个。
sentences.traditional: 他小時候特別喜歡超級英雄，常常把自己想像成其中一個。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou tèbié xǐhuan chāojí yīngxióng, chángcháng bǎ zìjǐ xiǎngxiàng chéng qízhōng yí ge.
sentences.translation: When he was little, he especially liked superheroes and often imagined himself as one of them.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影的画面超级清楚，难怪票房这么高。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影的畫面超級清楚，難怪票房這麼高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de huàmiàn chāojí qīngchu, nánguài piàofáng zhème gāo.
sentences.translation: The visuals in this film are super clear; no wonder the box office is so high.

sentences.chinese: 在学校附近超速，不但危险，还会受到处罚。
sentences.traditional: 在學校附近超速，不但危險，還會受到處罰。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xuéxiào fùjìn chāosù, búdàn wēixiǎn, hái huì shòudào chǔfá.
sentences.translation: Speeding near a school is not only dangerous, but will also result in punishment.

sentences.chinese: 警察提醒司机，雨天开车更不能超速。
sentences.traditional: 警察提醒司機，雨天開車更不能超速。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá tíxǐng sījī, yǔtiān kāichē gèng bù néng chāosù.
sentences.translation: The police reminded drivers that they must not speed even more so on rainy days.

sentences.chinese: 监控显示，那辆车在进入隧道前已经超速了。
sentences.traditional: 監控顯示，那輛車在進入隧道前已經超速了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiānkòng xiǎnshì, nà liàng chē zài jìnrù suìdào qián yǐjīng chāosù le.
sentences.translation: The surveillance footage shows that the car was already speeding before entering the tunnel.

sentences.chinese: 朝窗外看去，可以看到整条街都被雨水淹了。
sentences.traditional: 朝窗外看去，可以看到整條街都被雨水淹了。
sentences.pinyin: Cháo chuāngwài kàn qù, kěyǐ kàndào zhěng tiáo jiē dōu bèi yǔshuǐ yān le.
sentences.translation: Looking out of the window, you can see that the whole street has been flooded by rainwater.

sentences.chinese: 他朝我点了点头，表示已经听懂了我的解释。
sentences.traditional: 他朝我點了點頭，表示已經聽懂了我的解釋。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháo wǒ diǎn le diǎn tóu, biǎoshì yǐjīng tīngdǒng le wǒ de jiěshì.
sentences.translation: He nodded towards me, showing that he had already understood my explanation.

sentences.chinese: 请大家朝这个方向排队，不要堵住入口。
sentences.traditional: 請大家朝這個方向排隊，不要堵住入口。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā cháo zhège fāngxiàng páiduì, bú yào dǔ zhù rùkǒu.
sentences.translation: Please queue in this direction and do not block the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 隔壁装修的声音太吵，连会议内容都听不清。
sentences.traditional: 隔壁裝修的聲音太吵，連會議內容都聽不清。
sentences.pinyin: Gébì zhuāngxiū de shēngyīn tài chǎo, lián huìyì nèiróng dōu tīng bù qīng.
sentences.translation: The renovation noise next door is too loud; we cannot even hear the contents of the meeting clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他们因为停车位吵了半天，最后还是请物业来处理。
sentences.traditional: 他們因為停車位吵了半天，最後還是請物業來處理。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīnwèi tíngchēwèi chǎo le bàntiān, zuìhòu háishi qǐng wùyè lái chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: They argued for ages over a parking space, and in the end they still asked the property management to handle it.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅环境有点吵，不适合谈重要的事情。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳環境有點吵，不適合談重要的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng huánjìng yǒudiǎn chǎo, bù shìhé tán zhòngyào de shìqing.
sentences.translation: This restaurant is a bit noisy, so it is not suitable for discussing important matters.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈把剩下的米饭炒成了鸡蛋炒饭。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽把剩下的米飯炒成了雞蛋炒飯。
sentences.pinyin: Māma bǎ shèngxià de mǐfàn chǎo chéng le jīdàn chǎofàn.
sentences.translation: Mum stir-fried the leftover rice into egg fried rice.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜需要用大火快炒，才能保持蔬菜的口感。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜需要用大火快炒，才能保持蔬菜的口感。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài xūyào yòng dà huǒ kuài chǎo, cái néng bǎochí shūcài de kǒugǎn.
sentences.translation: This dish needs to be stir-fried quickly over a high heat in order to keep the texture of the vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 他为了节省时间，常常一次炒两天的菜。
sentences.traditional: 他為了節省時間，常常一次炒兩天的菜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, chángcháng yí cì chǎo liǎng tiān de cài.
sentences.translation: To save time, he often stir-fries two days’ worth of food in one go.

sentences.chinese: 那场车祸造成道路严重堵塞，公交车都改了路线。
sentences.traditional: 那場車禍造成道路嚴重堵塞，公交車都改了路線。
sentences.pinyin: Nà chǎng chēhuò zàochéng dàolù yánzhòng dǔsè, gōngjiāochē dōu gǎi le lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: That car accident caused serious road congestion, and even the buses changed their routes.

sentences.chinese: 他经历过一次车祸之后，开车变得特别谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 他經歷過一次車禍之後，開車變得特別謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīnglì guò yí cì chēhuò zhīhòu, kāichē biàn de tèbié jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: After he had experienced a car accident, he became especially cautious when driving.

sentences.chinese: 如果看到车祸现场，应该先报警，再帮助伤者。
sentences.traditional: 如果看到車禍現場，應該先報警，再幫助傷者。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kàndào chēhuò xiànchǎng, yīnggāi xiān bàojǐng, zài bāngzhù shāngzhě.
sentences.translation: If you see the scene of a car accident, you should call the police first and then help the injured.

sentences.chinese: 我们把旧家具搬到车库里，等周末再处理。
sentences.traditional: 我們把舊傢俱搬到車庫裡，等週末再處理。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ jiù jiājù bān dào chēkù lǐ, děng zhōumò zài chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: We moved the old furniture into the garage and will deal with it at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 这栋房子虽然不大，但带一个可以停车的车库。
sentences.traditional: 這棟房子雖然不大，但帶一個可以停車的車庫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi suīrán bú dà, dàn dài yí ge kěyǐ tíngchē de chēkù.
sentences.translation: Although this house is not large, it comes with a garage where you can park.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，地下车库里积了不少水。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，地下車庫裡積了不少水。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, dìxià chēkù lǐ jī le bù shǎo shuǐ.
sentences.translation: After the rainstorm, quite a lot of water had collected in the underground garage.

sentences.chinese: 节日期间进城的车辆太多，交通压力明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 節日期間進城的車輛太多，交通壓力明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì qījiān jìnchéng de chēliàng tài duō, jiāotōng yālì míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: During the holiday period, there were too many vehicles entering the city, and traffic pressure clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 进入工厂之前，所有车辆都必须登记。
sentences.traditional: 進入工廠之前，所有車輛都必須登記。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù gōngchǎng zhīqián, suǒyǒu chēliàng dōu bìxū dēngjì.
sentences.translation: Before entering the factory, all vehicles must be registered.

sentences.chinese: 这条路正在维修，禁止大型车辆通行。
sentences.traditional: 這條路正在維修，禁止大型車輛通行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù zhèngzài wéixiū, jìnzhǐ dàxíng chēliàng tōngxíng.
sentences.translation: This road is under repair, so large vehicles are forbidden from passing through.

sentences.chinese: 高峰期的地铁车厢里挤满了人，几乎没有站的地方。
sentences.traditional: 高峰期的地鐵車廂裡擠滿了人，幾乎沒有站的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Gāofēngqī de dìtiě chēxiāng lǐ jǐ mǎn le rén, jīhū méiyǒu zhàn de dìfang.
sentences.translation: During the rush hour, the underground carriage was packed with people, with almost nowhere to stand.

sentences.chinese: 请不要在车厢内大声打电话，以免影响其他乘客。
sentences.traditional: 請不要在車廂內大聲打電話，以免影響其他乘客。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào zài chēxiāng nèi dàshēng dǎ diànhuà, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng qítā chéngkè.
sentences.translation: Please do not speak loudly on the phone inside the carriage, so as not to disturb other passengers.

sentences.chinese: 列车员逐节检查车厢，确认每位乘客都已上车。
sentences.traditional: 列車員逐節檢查車廂，確認每位乘客都已上車。
sentences.pinyin: Lièchēyuán zhú jié jiǎnchá chēxiāng, quèrèn měi wèi chéngkè dōu yǐ shàngchē.
sentences.translation: The train attendant checked each carriage one by one to confirm that every passenger had boarded.

sentences.chinese: 车主如果没有按时缴纳保险，出了事故会很麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 車主如果沒有按時繳納保險，出了事故會很麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzhǔ rúguǒ méiyǒu ànshí jiǎonà bǎoxiǎn, chū le shìgù huì hěn máfan.
sentences.translation: If a vehicle owner has not paid the insurance on time, it will be very troublesome if an accident occurs.

sentences.chinese: 停车场要求车主留下电话，以便紧急情况下联系。
sentences.traditional: 停車場要求車主留下電話，以便緊急情況下聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Tíngchēchǎng yāoqiú chēzhǔ liú xià diànhuà, yǐbiàn jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià liánxì.
sentences.translation: The car park requires vehicle owners to leave a phone number so they can be contacted in an emergency.

sentences.chinese: 警察通过车牌号码找到了车主。
sentences.traditional: 警察通過車牌號碼找到了車主。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá tōngguò chēpái hàomǎ zhǎodào le chēzhǔ.
sentences.translation: The police found the vehicle owner through the number plate.

sentences.chinese: 这次改革虽然困难，但必须彻底解决旧制度的问题。
sentences.traditional: 這次改革雖然困難，但必須徹底解決舊制度的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gǎigé suīrán kùnnan, dàn bìxū chèdǐ jiějué jiù zhìdù de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Although this reform is difficult, it must thoroughly solve the problems of the old system.

sentences.chinese: 房间已经被打扫得很彻底，连窗缝里的灰都没有了。
sentences.traditional: 房間已經被打掃得很徹底，連窗縫裡的灰都沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān yǐjīng bèi dǎsǎo de hěn chèdǐ, lián chuāngfèng lǐ de huī dōu méiyǒu le.
sentences.translation: The room has been cleaned very thoroughly; even the dust in the window gaps is gone.

sentences.chinese: 如果不彻底调查原因，同样的错误还会再次发生。
sentences.traditional: 如果不徹底調查原因，同樣的錯誤還會再次發生。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù chèdǐ diàochá yuányīn, tóngyàng de cuòwù hái huì zàicì fāshēng.
sentences.translation: If the causes are not investigated thoroughly, the same mistake will happen again.

sentences.chinese: 这块石头太沉，一个人根本搬不动。
sentences.traditional: 這塊石頭太沉，一個人根本搬不動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài shítou tài chén, yí ge rén gēnběn bān bú dòng.
sentences.translation: This stone is too heavy; one person simply cannot move it.

sentences.chinese: 船慢慢沉到水底，大家只能眼睁睁地看着。
sentences.traditional: 船慢慢沉到水底，大家只能眼睜睜地看著。
sentences.pinyin: Chuán mànmàn chén dào shuǐdǐ, dàjiā zhǐ néng yǎnzhēngzhēng de kànzhe.
sentences.translation: The boat slowly sank to the bottom of the water, and everyone could only watch helplessly.

sentences.chinese: 他说话的声音很沉，让人感觉十分稳重。
sentences.traditional: 他說話的聲音很沉，讓人感覺十分穩重。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de shēngyīn hěn chén, ràng rén gǎnjué shífēn wěnzhòng.
sentences.translation: His speaking voice is deep, making him seem very steady and reliable.

sentences.chinese: 面对这个敏感的问题，他选择了沉默，没有立刻回应。
sentences.traditional: 面對這個敏感的問題，他選擇了沉默，沒有立刻回應。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì zhège mǐngǎn de wèntí, tā xuǎnzé le chénmò, méiyǒu lìkè huíyìng.
sentences.translation: Facing this sensitive issue, he chose to remain silent and did not respond immediately.

sentences.chinese: 长时间的沉默并不代表同意，有时只是因为失望。
sentences.traditional: 長時間的沉默並不代表同意，有時只是因為失望。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān de chénmò bìng bù dàibiǎo tóngyì, yǒushí zhǐshì yīnwèi shīwàng.
sentences.translation: A long silence does not necessarily mean agreement; sometimes it is only because of disappointment.

sentences.chinese: 她在会议上一直沉默，直到负责人问到她的意见。
sentences.traditional: 她在會議上一直沉默，直到負責人問到她的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shang yìzhí chénmò, zhídào fùzérén wèn dào tā de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: She kept silent throughout the meeting until the person in charge asked for her opinion.

sentences.chinese: 公司内部通常称这项计划为“绿色行动”。
sentences.traditional: 公司內部通常稱這項計劃為「綠色行動」。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī nèibù tōngcháng chēng zhè xiàng jìhuà wéi “lǜsè xíngdòng”.
sentences.translation: Within the company, this plan is usually called the “Green Action”.

sentences.chinese: 学生们习惯称那位老师为“老王”，显得很亲切。
sentences.traditional: 學生們習慣稱那位老師為「老王」，顯得很親切。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēngmen xíguàn chēng nà wèi lǎoshī wéi “Lǎo Wáng”, xiǎnde hěn qīnqiè.
sentences.translation: The students are used to calling that teacher “Old Wang”, which sounds very friendly.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市因美丽的湖水而被称为“水城”。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市因美麗的湖水而被稱為「水城」。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yīn měilì de húshuǐ ér bèi chēngwéi “shuǐchéng”.
sentences.translation: This city is called the “Water City” because of its beautiful lakes.

sentences.chinese: 买水果时，老板先把苹果称了一下，再告诉我价格。
sentences.traditional: 買水果時，老闆先把蘋果稱了一下，再告訴我價格。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi shuǐguǒ shí, lǎobǎn xiān bǎ píngguǒ chēng le yíxià, zài gàosu wǒ jiàgé.
sentences.translation: When buying fruit, the owner weighed the apples first and then told me the price.

sentences.chinese: 这台电子秤坏了，称出来的重量总是不准。
sentences.traditional: 這臺電子秤壞了，稱出來的重量總是不準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái diànzǐchèng huài le, chēng chūlái de zhòngliàng zǒngshì bù zhǔn.
sentences.translation: This electronic scale is broken; the weight it gives is always inaccurate.

sentences.chinese: 寄包裹前，工作人员会先称重量，再计算邮费。
sentences.traditional: 寄包裹前，工作人員會先稱重量，再計算郵費。
sentences.pinyin: Jì bāoguǒ qián, gōngzuò rényuán huì xiān chēng zhòngliàng, zài jìsuàn yóufèi.
sentences.translation: Before sending a parcel, the staff will weigh it first and then calculate the postage.

sentences.chinese: 这种把废物重新利用的做法被称为循环经济。
sentences.traditional: 這種把廢物重新利用的做法被稱為循環經濟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bǎ fèiwù chóngxīn lìyòng de zuòfǎ bèi chēngwéi xúnhuán jīngjì.
sentences.translation: This practice of reusing waste is known as the circular economy.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家因一系列优秀作品被称为现实主义代表。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家因一系列優秀作品被稱為現實主義代表。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā yīn yī xìliè yōuxiù zuòpǐn bèi chēngwéi xiànshí zhǔyì dàibiǎo.
sentences.translation: This writer is known as a representative of realism because of a series of excellent works.

sentences.chinese: 在历史上，这条路曾被称为南方最重要的商道。
sentences.traditional: 在歷史上，這條路曾被稱為南方最重要的商道。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lìshǐ shang, zhè tiáo lù céng bèi chēngwéi nánfāng zuì zhòngyào de shāngdào.
sentences.translation: Historically, this road was once known as the most important trade route in the south.

sentences.chinese: 导演称赞演员的表演自然，没有夸张的痕迹。
sentences.traditional: 導演稱讚演員的表演自然，沒有誇張的痕跡。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn chēngzàn yǎnyuán de biǎoyǎn zìrán, méiyǒu kuāzhāng de hénjì.
sentences.translation: The director praised the actor’s performance as natural, without any trace of exaggeration.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究受到了专家的称赞，因为方法很严谨。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究受到了專家的稱讚，因為方法很嚴謹。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū shòudào le zhuānjiā de chēngzàn, yīnwèi fāngfǎ hěn yánjǐn.
sentences.translation: This study received praise from experts because its method was very rigorous.

sentences.chinese: 老师很少当面称赞学生，但这次她破例了。
sentences.traditional: 老師很少當面稱讚學生，但這次她破例了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn shǎo dāngmiàn chēngzàn xuéshēng, dàn zhè cì tā pòlì le.
sentences.translation: The teacher rarely praises students face to face, but she made an exception this time.

sentences.chinese: 如果原材料价格继续上涨，生产成本会明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 如果原材料價格繼續上漲，生產成本會明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yuán cáiliào jiàgé jìxù shàngzhǎng, shēngchǎn chéngběn huì míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: If raw material prices continue to rise, production costs will increase noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司通过改进流程降低了运营成本。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司通過改進流程降低了運營成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tōngguò gǎijìn liúchéng jiàngdī le yùnyíng chéngběn.
sentences.translation: This company reduced operating costs by improving its processes.

sentences.chinese: 在创业初期，控制成本比盲目扩大规模更重要。
sentences.traditional: 在創業初期，控制成本比盲目擴大規模更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chuàngyè chūqī, kòngzhì chéngběn bǐ mángmù kuòdà guīmó gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In the early stage of starting a business, controlling costs is more important than blindly expanding in scale.

sentences.chinese: 作为项目负责人，他必须承担最终的责任。
sentences.traditional: 作為項目負責人，他必須承擔最終的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi xiàngmù fùzérén, tā bìxū chéngdān zuìzhōng de zérèn.
sentences.translation: As the person in charge of the project, he must bear the final responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 政府不能独自承担所有养老压力，社会也需要参与。
sentences.traditional: 政府不能獨自承擔所有養老壓力，社會也需要參與。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ bù néng dúzì chéngdān suǒyǒu yǎnglǎo yālì, shèhuì yě xūyào cānyù.
sentences.translation: The government cannot bear all the pressure of elderly care alone; society also needs to participate.

sentences.chinese: 她愿意承担额外的工作，是因为团队正遇到困难。
sentences.traditional: 她願意承擔額外的工作，是因為團隊正遇到困難。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuànyì chéngdān éwài de gōngzuò, shì yīnwèi tuánduì zhèng yù dào kùnnan.
sentences.translation: She is willing to take on extra work because the team is facing difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 这次污染的严重程度超过了专家的预期。
sentences.traditional: 這次污染的嚴重程度超過了專家的預期。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì wūrǎn de yánzhòng chéngdù chāoguò le zhuānjiā de yùqī.
sentences.translation: The severity of this pollution exceeded the experts’ expectations.

sentences.chinese: 学生的理解程度不同，老师需要调整讲解方式。
sentences.traditional: 學生的理解程度不同，老師需要調整講解方式。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēng de lǐjiě chéngdù bùtóng, lǎoshī xūyào tiáozhěng jiǎngjiě fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Students’ levels of understanding differ, so the teacher needs to adjust the way he explains things.

sentences.chinese: 他的中文流利程度已经可以应付正式会议。
sentences.traditional: 他的中文流利程度已經可以應付正式會議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén liúlì chéngdù yǐjīng kěyǐ yìngfu zhèngshì huìyì.
sentences.translation: His level of fluency in Chinese is already enough to handle formal meetings.

sentences.chinese: 买护肤品前，我会先看看它的主要成分。
sentences.traditional: 買護膚品前，我會先看看它的主要成分。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi hùfūpǐn qián, wǒ huì xiān kànkan tā de zhǔyào chéngfèn.
sentences.translation: Before buying skincare products, I first look at their main ingredients.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜的成分很简单，却能做出丰富的味道。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜的成分很簡單，卻能做出豐富的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de chéngfèn hěn jiǎndān, què néng zuò chū fēngfù de wèidào.
sentences.translation: The ingredients of this dish are simple, yet it can produce a rich flavour.

sentences.chinese: 报告分析了空气中有害成分的来源。
sentences.traditional: 報告分析了空氣中有害成分的來源。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào fēnxī le kōngqì zhōng yǒuhài chéngfèn de láiyuán.
sentences.translation: The report analysed the sources of harmful components in the air.

sentences.chinese: 经过三年的努力，研究团队终于取得了重要成果。
sentences.traditional: 經過三年的努力，研究團隊終於取得了重要成果。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò sān nián de nǔlì, yánjiū tuánduì zhōngyú qǔdé le zhòngyào chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: After three years of effort, the research team finally achieved important results.

sentences.chinese: 这次展览集中展示了当地教育改革的成果。
sentences.traditional: 這次展覽集中展示了當地教育改革的成果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn jízhōng zhǎnshì le dāngdì jiàoyù gǎigé de chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: This exhibition presents the achievements of local education reform in a concentrated way.

sentences.chinese: 只有把成果应用到实际生活中，研究才更有价值。
sentences.traditional: 只有把成果應用到實際生活中，研究才更有價值。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu bǎ chéngguǒ yìngyòng dào shíjì shēnghuó zhōng, yánjiū cái gèng yǒu jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Only when results are applied to real life does research become more valuable.

sentences.chinese: 他今天的成就并不是偶然的，而是多年努力的结果。
sentences.traditional: 他今天的成就並不是偶然的，而是多年努力的結果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān de chéngjiù bìng bú shì ǒurán de, ér shì duō nián nǔlì de jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: His achievements today are not accidental, but the result of many years of hard work.

sentences.chinese: 只有坚持学习，普通人也能在自己的领域取得成就。
sentences.traditional: 只有堅持學習，普通人也能在自己的領域取得成就。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jiānchí xuéxí, pǔtōng rén yě néng zài zìjǐ de lǐngyù qǔdé chéngjiù.
sentences.translation: As long as they keep learning, ordinary people can also achieve success in their own field.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术成就了许多小企业，使它们有机会进入国际市场。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術成就了許多小企業，使它們有機會進入國際市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù chéngjiù le xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè, shǐ tāmen yǒu jīhuì jìnrù guójì shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: This technology helped many small businesses succeed, giving them the chance to enter the international market.

sentences.chinese: 这个志愿者组织成立以后，帮助了很多独居老人。
sentences.traditional: 這個志願者組織成立以後，幫助了很多獨居老人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhìyuànzhě zǔzhī chénglì yǐhòu, bāngzhù le hěn duō dújū lǎorén.
sentences.translation: After this volunteer organisation was established, it helped many elderly people living alone.

sentences.chinese: 公司刚成立时，办公室只有两张桌子。
sentences.traditional: 公司剛成立時，辦公室只有兩張桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gāng chénglì shí, bàngōngshì zhǐ yǒu liǎng zhāng zhuōzi.
sentences.translation: When the company had just been established, the office had only two desks.

sentences.chinese: 为了调查事故原因，学校成立了一个专门小组。
sentences.traditional: 為了調查事故原因，學校成立了一個專門小組。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile diàochá shìgù yuányīn, xuéxiào chénglì le yí ge zhuānmén xiǎozǔ.
sentences.translation: To investigate the cause of the accident, the school set up a special team.

sentences.chinese: 按照当地法律，孩子成年以后可以独立签合同。
sentences.traditional: 按照當地法律，孩子成年以後可以獨立簽合同。
sentences.pinyin: Ànzhào dāngdì fǎlǜ, háizi chéngnián yǐhòu kěyǐ dúlì qiān hétong.
sentences.translation: According to local law, children can sign contracts independently after they become adults.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然已经成年，但处理问题时仍然不够成熟。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然已經成年，但處理問題時仍然不夠成熟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán yǐjīng chéngnián, dàn chǔlǐ wèntí shí réngrán bú gòu chéngshú.
sentences.translation: Although he is already an adult, he is still not mature enough when handling problems.

sentences.chinese: 父母不能替已经成年的子女决定所有事情。
sentences.traditional: 父母不能替已經成年的子女決定所有事情。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng tì yǐjīng chéngnián de zǐnǚ juédìng suǒyǒu shìqing.
sentences.translation: Parents cannot decide everything for children who are already adults.

sentences.chinese: 新的地铁线路把郊区和城区连接得更紧密。
sentences.traditional: 新的地鐵線路把郊區和城區連接得更緊密。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn de dìtiě xiànlù bǎ jiāoqū hé chéngqū liánjiē de gèng jǐnmì.
sentences.translation: The new metro line connects the suburbs and the urban area more closely.

sentences.chinese: 由于城区停车困难，很多人选择坐公交上班。
sentences.traditional: 由於城區停車困難，很多人選擇坐公交上班。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngqū tíngchē kùnnán, hěn duō rén xuǎnzé zuò gōngjiāo shàngbān.
sentences.translation: Because parking in the urban area is difficult, many people choose to take the bus to work.

sentences.chinese: 老城区的房子虽然旧，却保留了独特的历史气息。
sentences.traditional: 老城區的房子雖然舊，卻保留了獨特的歷史氣息。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo chéngqū de fángzi suīrán jiù, què bǎoliú le dútè de lìshǐ qìxī.
sentences.translation: Although the houses in the old urban area are old, they have kept a unique historical atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 成人在做决定时，应该对自己的选择负责。
sentences.traditional: 成人在做決定時，應該對自己的選擇負責。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngrén zài zuò juédìng shí, yīnggāi duì zìjǐ de xuǎnzé fùzé.
sentences.translation: Adults should be responsible for their own choices when making decisions.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影内容比较复杂，只适合成人观看。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影內容比較複雜，只適合成人觀看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng nèiróng bǐjiào fùzá, zhǐ shìhé chéngrén guānkàn.
sentences.translation: The content of this film is relatively complex and is only suitable for adults to watch.

sentences.chinese: 孩子总有一天会成人，父母也要学会放手。
sentences.traditional: 孩子總有一天會成人，父母也要學會放手。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zǒng yǒu yì tiān huì chéngrén, fùmǔ yě yào xuéhuì fàngshǒu.
sentences.translation: Children will become adults one day, and parents must also learn to let go.

sentences.chinese: 他终于承认自己判断错了，并向同事道歉。
sentences.traditional: 他終於承認自己判斷錯了，並向同事道歉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú chéngrèn zìjǐ pànduàn cuò le, bìng xiàng tóngshì dàoqiàn.
sentences.translation: He finally admitted that his judgement was wrong and apologised to his colleague.

sentences.chinese: 承认问题并不丢人，逃避问题才会造成更大的麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 承認問題並不丟人，逃避問題才會造成更大的麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngrèn wèntí bìng bù diūrén, táobì wèntí cái huì zàochéng gèng dà de máfan.
sentences.translation: Admitting a problem is not embarrassing; avoiding it is what causes bigger trouble.

sentences.chinese: 公司承认系统存在漏洞，已经开始进行修复。
sentences.traditional: 公司承認系統存在漏洞，已經開始進行修復。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī chéngrèn xìtǒng cúnzài lòudòng, yǐjīng kāishǐ jìnxíng xiūfù.
sentences.translation: The company acknowledged that there was a flaw in the system and has already begun repairs.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥能够承受很大的重量，所以大型车辆可以通过。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋能夠承受很大的重量，所以大型車輛可以通過。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo nénggòu chéngshòu hěn dà de zhòngliàng, suǒyǐ dàxíng chēliàng kěyǐ tōngguò.
sentences.translation: This bridge can bear a great deal of weight, so large vehicles can pass over it.

sentences.chinese: 长期的压力让他几乎无法承受，只好请假休息。
sentences.traditional: 長期的壓力讓他幾乎無法承受，只好請假休息。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī de yālì ràng tā jīhū wúfǎ chéngshòu, zhǐhǎo qǐngjià xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The long-term pressure made it almost impossible for him to endure, so he had to take leave and rest.

sentences.chinese: 小企业很难承受原材料价格不断上涨带来的成本压力。
sentences.traditional: 小企業很難承受原材料價格不斷上漲帶來的成本壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo qǐyè hěn nán chéngshòu yuáncáiliào jiàgé búduàn shàngzhǎng dàilái de chéngběn yālì.
sentences.translation: Small businesses find it hard to bear the cost pressure caused by constantly rising raw material prices.

sentences.chinese: 一个成熟的决定需要充分考虑风险和后果。
sentences.traditional: 一個成熟的決定需要充分考慮風險和後果。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge chéngshú de juédìng xūyào chōngfèn kǎolǜ fēngxiǎn hé hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: A mature decision requires full consideration of the risks and consequences.

sentences.chinese: 经过几年的训练，他的写作风格明显成熟了。
sentences.traditional: 經過幾年的訓練，他的寫作風格明顯成熟了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ nián de xùnliàn, tā de xiězuò fēnggé míngxiǎn chéngshú le.
sentences.translation: After several years of training, his writing style has clearly matured.

sentences.chinese: 市场逐渐成熟以后，消费者对产品质量的要求更高了。
sentences.traditional: 市場逐漸成熟以後，消費者對產品質量的要求更高了。
sentences.pinyin: Shìchǎng zhújiàn chéngshú yǐhòu, xiāofèizhě duì chǎnpǐn zhìliàng de yāoqiú gèng gāo le.
sentences.translation: After the market gradually matures, consumers have higher requirements for product quality.

sentences.chinese: 乘务员提醒乘客系好安全带，飞机马上就要起飞了。
sentences.traditional: 乘務員提醒乘客繫好安全帶，飛機馬上就要起飛了。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngwùyuán tíxǐng chéngkè jì hǎo ānquándài, fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēi le.
sentences.translation: The crew member reminded passengers to fasten their seatbelts, as the plane was about to take off.

sentences.chinese: 火车晚点后，乘务员耐心地向大家解释原因。
sentences.traditional: 火車晚點後，乘務員耐心地向大家解釋原因。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē wǎndiǎn hòu, chéngwùyuán nàixīn de xiàng dàjiā jiěshì yuányīn.
sentences.translation: After the train was delayed, the attendant patiently explained the reason to everyone.

sentences.chinese: 遇到紧急情况时，请听从乘务员的安排。
sentences.traditional: 遇到緊急情況時，請聽從乘務員的安排。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng shí, qǐng tīngcóng chéngwùyuán de ānpái.
sentences.translation: In an emergency, please follow the crew member’s arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 办理签证前，你最好先了解具体程序。
sentences.traditional: 辦理簽證前，你最好先了解具體程序。
sentences.pinyin: Bànlǐ qiānzhèng qián, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě jùtǐ chéngxù.
sentences.translation: Before applying for a visa, you had better first understand the specific procedure.

sentences.chinese: 如果程序写得不规范，后期维护会非常困难。
sentences.traditional: 如果程序寫得不規範，後期維護會非常困難。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chéngxù xiě de bù guīfàn, hòuqī wéihù huì fēicháng kùnnán.
sentences.translation: If a program is written in a non-standard way, later maintenance will be very difficult.

sentences.chinese: 按照正常程序，申请结果会在两周内公布。
sentences.traditional: 按照正常程序，申請結果會在兩週內公佈。
sentences.pinyin: Ànzhào zhèngcháng chéngxù, shēnqǐng jiéguǒ huì zài liǎng zhōu nèi gōngbù.
sentences.translation: According to the normal procedure, the application result will be announced within two weeks.

sentences.chinese: 作为项目成员，他必须按时提交进度报告。
sentences.traditional: 作為項目成員，他必須按時提交進度報告。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi xiàngmù chéngyuán, tā bìxū ànshí tíjiāo jìndù bàogào.
sentences.translation: As a project member, he must submit progress reports on time.

sentences.chinese: 所有成员都同意采用新的工作程序。
sentences.traditional: 所有成員都同意採用新的工作程序。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu chéngyuán dōu tóngyì cǎiyòng xīn de gōngzuò chéngxù.
sentences.translation: All members agreed to adopt the new work procedure.

sentences.chinese: 这个团队的成员来自不同的城市，背景也不一样。
sentences.traditional: 這個團隊的成員來自不同的城市，背景也不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì de chéngyuán láizì bùtóng de chéngshì, bèijǐng yě bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Members of this team come from different cities, and their backgrounds are also different.

sentences.chinese: 孩子的成长需要家庭和学校共同支持。
sentences.traditional: 孩子的成長需要家庭和學校共同支持。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi de chéngzhǎng xūyào jiātíng hé xuéxiào gòngtóng zhīchí.
sentences.translation: A child’s growth needs joint support from the family and the school.

sentences.chinese: 在这家公司工作三年后，她的专业能力成长得很快。
sentences.traditional: 在這家公司工作三年後，她的專業能力成長得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā gōngsī gōngzuò sān nián hòu, tā de zhuānyè nénglì chéngzhǎng de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: After working at this company for three years, her professional ability grew quickly.

sentences.chinese: 经历失败以后，他反而成长了不少。
sentences.traditional: 經歷失敗以後，他反而成長了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglì shībài yǐhòu, tā fǎn’ér chéngzhǎng le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: After experiencing failure, he actually matured quite a lot.

sentences.chinese: 这些橙子看起来很普通，味道却特别甜。
sentences.traditional: 這些橙子看起來很普通，味道卻特別甜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē chéngzi kàn qǐlái hěn pǔtōng, wèidào què tèbié tián.
sentences.translation: These oranges look ordinary, but they taste especially sweet.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他多吃水果，比如橙子和苹果。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他多吃水果，比如橙子和蘋果。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā duō chī shuǐguǒ, bǐrú chéngzi hé píngguǒ.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested that he eat more fruit, such as oranges and apples.

sentences.chinese: 她把橙子切成小块，方便孩子带到学校。
sentences.traditional: 她把橙子切成小塊，方便孩子帶到學校。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ chéngzi qiē chéng xiǎo kuài, fāngbiàn háizi dài dào xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: She cut the orange into small pieces so the child could take it to school.

sentences.chinese: 公园里的池不深，但孩子靠近时仍然要小心。
sentences.traditional: 公園裡的池不深，但孩子靠近時仍然要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ de chí bù shēn, dàn háizi kàojìn shí réngrán yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: The pond in the park is not deep, but children still need to be careful when they approach it.

sentences.chinese: 他们在池边安装了新的安全标志。
sentences.traditional: 他們在池邊安裝了新的安全標誌。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài chí biān ānzhuāng le xīn de ānquán biāozhì.
sentences.translation: They installed a new safety sign beside the pond.

sentences.chinese: 这个池原来用来养鱼，现在变成了景点。
sentences.traditional: 這個池原來用來養魚，現在變成了景點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chí yuánlái yòng lái yǎng yú, xiànzài biànchéng le jǐngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: This pond was originally used for keeping fish, but now it has become a tourist spot.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨持续了整整一夜，很多道路都被水淹了。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨持續了整整一夜，很多道路都被水淹了。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ chíxù le zhěngzhěng yí yè, hěn duō dàolù dōu bèi shuǐ yān le.
sentences.translation: The torrential rain lasted the whole night, and many roads were flooded.

sentences.chinese: 如果低烧持续不退，你最好去医院检查。
sentences.traditional: 如果低燒持續不退，你最好去醫院檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dīshāo chíxù bú tuì, nǐ zuìhǎo qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: If the low fever continues and does not go down, you had better go to hospital for a check-up.

sentences.chinese: 公司要想持续发展，就必须重视产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 公司要想持續發展，就必須重視產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yào xiǎng chíxù fāzhǎn, jiù bìxū zhòngshì chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: If a company wants to keep developing, it must attach importance to product quality.

sentences.chinese: 这把尺子不够长，测不了桌子的全部长度。
sentences.traditional: 這把尺子不夠長，測不了桌子的全部長度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ chǐzi bú gòu cháng, cè bù liǎo zhuōzi de quánbù chángdù.
sentences.translation: This ruler is not long enough to measure the full length of the table.

sentences.chinese: 老师让学生用尺子画一条直线。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓學生用尺子畫一條直線。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng xuéshēng yòng chǐzi huà yì tiáo zhíxiàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the students to use a ruler to draw a straight line.

sentences.chinese: 请把尺子放回原处，不然下次找不到。
sentences.traditional: 請把尺子放回原處，不然下次找不到。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ chǐzi fàng huí yuánchù, bùrán xià cì zhǎo bú dào.
sentences.translation: Please put the ruler back where it belongs, otherwise you will not find it next time.

sentences.chinese: 这只鸟的翅膀受伤了，暂时不能飞。
sentences.traditional: 這隻鳥的翅膀受傷了，暫時不能飛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī niǎo de chìbǎng shòu shāng le, zànshí bù néng fēi.
sentences.translation: This bird’s wing is injured, so it cannot fly for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 飞机的翅膀上结了冰，起飞时间被迫推迟。
sentences.traditional: 飛機的翅膀上結了冰，起飛時間被迫推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī de chìbǎng shang jié le bīng, qǐfēi shíjiān bèipò tuīchí.
sentences.translation: Ice formed on the aircraft’s wings, so the departure time was forced to be delayed.

sentences.chinese: 只有翅膀硬了，小鸟才会离开巢。
sentences.traditional: 只有翅膀硬了，小鳥才會離開巢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu chìbǎng yìng le, xiǎoniǎo cái huì líkāi cháo.
sentences.translation: Only when its wings are strong will a young bird leave the nest.

sentences.chinese: 听到警报以后，大家立刻冲出了办公室。
sentences.traditional: 聽到警報以後，大家立刻衝出了辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào jǐngbào yǐhòu, dàjiā lìkè chōng chū le bàngōngshì.
sentences.translation: After hearing the alarm, everyone immediately rushed out of the office.

sentences.chinese: 请先把杯子冲干净，再倒热水。
sentences.traditional: 請先把杯子沖乾淨，再倒熱水。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān bǎ bēizi chōng gānjìng, zài dào rè shuǐ.
sentences.translation: Please rinse the cup clean first, then pour in hot water.

sentences.chinese: 他一紧张，就把咖啡冲得太淡了。
sentences.traditional: 他一緊張，就把咖啡沖得太淡了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì jǐnzhāng, jiù bǎ kāfēi chōng de tài dàn le.
sentences.translation: Whenever he gets nervous, he makes the coffee too weak.

sentences.chinese: 手机快没电了，我得先充电再出门。
sentences.traditional: 手機快沒電了，我得先充電再出門。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī kuài méi diàn le, wǒ děi xiān chōngdiàn zài chūmén.
sentences.translation: My phone is nearly out of battery, so I need to charge it before going out.

sentences.chinese: 这个车库安装了两个电动车充电设备。
sentences.traditional: 這個車庫安裝了兩個電動車充電設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chēkù ānzhuāng le liǎng ge diàndòngchē chōngdiàn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This garage has installed two electric vehicle charging devices.

sentences.chinese: 长途旅行前，所有相机和电脑都要充电。
sentences.traditional: 長途旅行前，所有相機和電腦都要充電。
sentences.pinyin: Chángtú lǚxíng qián, suǒyǒu xiàngjī hé diànnǎo dōu yào chōngdiàn.
sentences.translation: Before a long-distance trip, all cameras and computers need to be charged.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始前，我们需要充分了解客户的需求。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始前，我們需要充分了解客戶的需求。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, wǒmen xūyào chōngfèn liǎojiě kèhù de xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting begins, we need to fully understand the customer’s needs.

sentences.chinese: 只有准备充分，面试时才不会那么紧张。
sentences.traditional: 只有準備充分，面試時才不會那麼緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhǔnbèi chōngfèn, miànshì shí cái bú huì nàme jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Only if you are fully prepared will you not be so nervous during the interview.

sentences.chinese: 他的理由不够充分，所以经理没有批准申请。
sentences.traditional: 他的理由不夠充分，所以經理沒有批准申請。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de lǐyóu bú gòu chōngfèn, suǒyǐ jīnglǐ méiyǒu pīzhǔn shēnqǐng.
sentences.translation: His reason was not sufficient, so the manager did not approve the application.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市虽然很小，却充满了历史和文化气息。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市雖然很小，卻充滿了歷史和文化氣息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì suīrán hěn xiǎo, què chōngmǎn le lìshǐ hé wénhuà qìxī.
sentences.translation: Although this city is small, it is full of historical and cultural atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 他的演讲充满信心，让听众感到很受鼓舞。
sentences.traditional: 他的演講充滿信心，讓聽眾感到很受鼓舞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng chōngmǎn xìnxīn, ràng tīngzhòng gǎndào hěn shòu gǔwǔ.
sentences.translation: His speech was full of confidence, making the audience feel greatly encouraged.

sentences.chinese: 即使遇到困难，她的生活态度依然充满希望。
sentences.traditional: 即使遇到困難，她的生活態度依然充滿希望。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ yùdào kùnnan, tā de shēnghuó tàidù yīrán chōngmǎn xīwàng.
sentences.translation: Even when she encounters difficulties, her attitude towards life remains full of hope.

sentences.chinese: 我刚给手机充值，所以这个月不用担心停机。
sentences.traditional: 我剛給手機充值，所以這個月不用擔心停機。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gāng gěi shǒujī chōngzhí, suǒyǐ zhège yuè bú yòng dānxīn tíngjī.
sentences.translation: I have just topped up my phone, so I do not need to worry about service being cut off this month.

sentences.chinese: 地铁卡余额不足，你可以在机器上充值。
sentences.traditional: 地鐵卡餘額不足，你可以在機器上充值。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtiě kǎ yú’é bùzú, nǐ kěyǐ zài jīqì shang chōngzhí.
sentences.translation: The metro card balance is insufficient; you can top it up on the machine.

sentences.chinese: 网上充值虽然方便，但一定要确认付款页面是否安全。
sentences.traditional: 網上充值雖然方便，但一定要確認付款頁面是否安全。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngshàng chōngzhí suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn yídìng yào quèrèn fùkuǎn yèmiàn shìfǒu ānquán.
sentences.translation: Online top-ups are convenient, but you must make sure the payment page is secure.

sentences.chinese: 只要睡眠充足，第二天的学习效率通常会更高。
sentences.traditional: 只要睡眠充足，第二天的學習效率通常會更高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào shuìmián chōngzú, dì èr tiān de xuéxí xiàolǜ tōngcháng huì gèng gāo.
sentences.translation: As long as sleep is sufficient, study efficiency is usually higher the next day.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动准备得很充足，所以现场没有出现混乱。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動準備得很充足，所以現場沒有出現混亂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng zhǔnbèi de hěn chōngzú, suǒyǐ xiànchǎng méiyǒu chūxiàn hùnluàn.
sentences.translation: This event was very well prepared, so no confusion appeared at the venue.

sentences.chinese: 申请材料必须充足，否则工作人员可能会要求你补充资料。
sentences.traditional: 申請材料必須充足，否則工作人員可能會要求你補充資料。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng cáiliào bìxū chōngzú, fǒuzé gōngzuò rényuán kěnéng huì yāoqiú nǐ bǔchōng zīliào.
sentences.translation: The application materials must be sufficient; otherwise the staff may ask you to provide additional documents.

sentences.chinese: 老师把关键步骤重复了一遍，免得大家操作时出错。
sentences.traditional: 老師把關鍵步驟重複了一遍，免得大家操作時出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ guānjiàn bùzhòu chóngfù le yí biàn, miǎnde dàjiā cāozuò shí chūcuò.
sentences.translation: The teacher repeated the key steps once to prevent everyone from making mistakes during the operation.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题已经讨论过了，没必要再重复。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題已經討論過了，沒必要再重複。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yǐjīng tǎolùn guo le, méi bìyào zài chóngfù.
sentences.translation: This issue has already been discussed, so there is no need to repeat it.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免重复劳动，两个部门决定共享资料。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免重複勞動，兩個部門決定共享資料。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn chóngfù láodòng, liǎng ge bùmén juédìng gòngxiǎng zīliào.
sentences.translation: In order to avoid duplicated work, the two departments decided to share materials.

sentences.chinese: 雨后花园里出现了很多虫子，孩子们却觉得很有趣。
sentences.traditional: 雨後花園裡出現了很多蟲子，孩子們卻覺得很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu huāyuán lǐ chūxiàn le hěn duō chóngzi, háizimen què juéde hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.translation: After the rain, many insects appeared in the garden, but the children found them very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 这只虫子虽然看起来丑，但对植物没有害处。
sentences.traditional: 這隻蟲子雖然看起來醜，但對植物沒有害處。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī chóngzi suīrán kàn qǐlái chǒu, dàn duì zhíwù méiyǒu hàichù.
sentences.translation: Although this insect looks ugly, it does no harm to the plant.

sentences.chinese: 房间太潮湿，难怪会有虫子藏在角落里。
sentences.traditional: 房間太潮濕，難怪會有蟲子藏在角落裡。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān tài cháoshī, nánguài huì yǒu chóngzi cáng zài jiǎoluò lǐ.
sentences.translation: The room is too damp, so it is no wonder there are insects hiding in the corner.

sentences.chinese: 养宠物之前，应该考虑自己是否有足够的时间照顾它。
sentences.traditional: 養寵物之前，應該考慮自己是否有足夠的時間照顧它。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎng chǒngwù zhīqián, yīnggāi kǎolǜ zìjǐ shìfǒu yǒu zúgòu de shíjiān zhàogu tā.
sentences.translation: Before keeping a pet, you should consider whether you have enough time to look after it.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒店允许客人带宠物入住，但必须提前说明情况。
sentences.traditional: 這家酒店允許客人帶寵物入住，但必須提前說明情況。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn yǔnxǔ kèrén dài chǒngwù rùzhù, dàn bìxū tíqián shuōmíng qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: This hotel allows guests to bring pets, but they must explain the situation in advance.

sentences.chinese: 宠物不是玩具，主人要为它的健康和安全负责。
sentences.traditional: 寵物不是玩具，主人要為它的健康和安全負責。
sentences.pinyin: Chǒngwù bú shì wánjù, zhǔrén yào wèi tā de jiànkāng hé ānquán fùzé.
sentences.translation: A pet is not a toy; the owner must be responsible for its health and safety.

sentences.chinese: 他从包里抽出一份报告，递给了经理。
sentences.traditional: 他從包裡抽出一份報告，遞給了經理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng bāo lǐ chōu chū yí fèn bàogào, dì gěi le jīnglǐ.
sentences.translation: He pulled a report out of his bag and handed it to the manager.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他不要再抽烟，否则病情会加重。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他不要再抽煙，否則病情會加重。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā bú yào zài chōu yān, fǒuzé bìngqíng huì jiāzhòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him not to smoke any more, otherwise his condition would get worse.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，我们会抽时间把意见整理出来。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，我們會抽時間把意見整理出來。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, wǒmen huì chōu shíjiān bǎ yìjiàn zhěnglǐ chūlái.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ends, we will make time to organise the opinions.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服颜色不丑，只是不太适合正式场合。
sentences.traditional: 這件衣服顏色不醜，只是不太適合正式場合。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu yánsè bù chǒu, zhǐshì bù tài shìhé zhèngshì chǎnghé.
sentences.translation: The colour of this item of clothing is not ugly; it is just not very suitable for formal occasions.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得自己的字写得很丑，所以不好意思给别人看。
sentences.traditional: 他覺得自己的字寫得很醜，所以不好意思給別人看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zìjǐ de zì xiě de hěn chǒu, suǒyǐ bù hǎoyìsi gěi biérén kàn.
sentences.translation: He thinks his handwriting is very ugly, so he feels embarrassed to show it to others.

sentences.chinese: 别因为外表丑就笑话别人，这样很不礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 別因為外表醜就笑話別人，這樣很不禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Bié yīnwèi wàibiǎo chǒu jiù xiàohua biérén, zhèyàng hěn bù lǐmào.
sentences.translation: Do not make fun of others just because their appearance is ugly; that is very impolite.

sentences.chinese: 垃圾放了好几天，房间里有一股臭味。
sentences.traditional: 垃圾放了好幾天，房間裡有一股臭味。
sentences.pinyin: Lājī fàng le hǎo jǐ tiān, fángjiān lǐ yǒu yì gǔ chòu wèi.
sentences.translation: The rubbish has been left for several days, and there is a stink in the room.

sentences.chinese: 这双鞋被雨水泡过以后，变得又湿又臭。
sentences.traditional: 這雙鞋被雨水泡過以後，變得又濕又臭。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié bèi yǔshuǐ pào guo yǐhòu, biàn de yòu shī yòu chòu.
sentences.translation: After this pair of shoes was soaked by the rain, it became wet and smelly.

sentences.chinese: 如果食物闻起来臭，就不要再吃了。
sentences.traditional: 如果食物聞起來臭，就不要再吃了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shíwù wén qǐlái chòu, jiù bú yào zài chī le.
sentences.translation: If food smells bad, do not eat it any more.

sentences.chinese: 年初的时候，公司制定了新的发展计划。
sentences.traditional: 年初的時候，公司制定了新的發展計劃。
