sentences.pinyin: Niánchū de shíhou, gōngsī zhìdìng le xīn de fāzhǎn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: At the beginning of the year, the company made a new development plan.

sentences.chinese: 这是我们的初步想法，还需要进一步讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這是我們的初步想法，還需要進一步討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen de chūbù xiǎngfǎ, hái xūyào jìnyíbù tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This is our preliminary idea; it still needs further discussion.

sentences.chinese: 他初次参加国际会议，表现得比大家想象的更成熟。
sentences.traditional: 他初次參加國際會議，表現得比大家想像的更成熟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chūcì cānjiā guójì huìyì, biǎoxiàn de bǐ dàjiā xiǎngxiàng de gèng chéngshú.
sentences.translation: He attended an international conference for the first time and performed more maturely than everyone imagined.

sentences.chinese: 这本小说明年春天正式出版。
sentences.traditional: 這本小說明年春天正式出版。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō míngnián chūntiān zhèngshì chūbǎn.
sentences.translation: This novel will be officially published next spring.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告还没经过审查，暂时不能出版。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告還沒經過審查，暫時不能出版。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào hái méi jīngguò shěnchá, zànshí bù néng chūbǎn.
sentences.translation: This report has not been reviewed yet, so it cannot be published for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 出版之前，作者又修改了几个重要章节。
sentences.traditional: 出版之前，作者又修改了幾個重要章節。
sentences.pinyin: Chūbǎn zhīqián, zuòzhě yòu xiūgǎi le jǐ gè zhòngyào zhāngjié.
sentences.translation: Before publication, the author revised several important chapters again.

sentences.chinese: 这门初级课程适合没有基础的学生。
sentences.traditional: 這門初級課程適合沒有基礎的學生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén chūjí kèchéng shìhé méiyǒu jīchǔ de xuésheng.
sentences.translation: This elementary course is suitable for students with no foundation.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他只学过初级汉语，但交流时很有信心。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他只學過初級漢語，但交流時很有信心。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐ xuéguo chūjí Hànyǔ, dàn jiāoliú shí hěn yǒu xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: Although he has only studied elementary Chinese, he is very confident when communicating.

sentences.chinese: 初级阶段最重要的是打好语法和发音基础。
sentences.traditional: 初級階段最重要的是打好語法和發音基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Chūjí jiēduàn zuì zhòngyào de shì dǎ hǎo yǔfǎ hé fāyīn jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: At the elementary stage, the most important thing is to build a good foundation in grammar and pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 项目初期，我们把主要精力放在市场调查上。
sentences.traditional: 項目初期，我們把主要精力放在市場調查上。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù chūqī, wǒmen bǎ zhǔyào jīnglì fàng zài shìchǎng diàochá shang.
sentences.translation: In the early period of the project, we focused our main energy on market research.

sentences.chinese: 在改革初期，很多人对新的做法并不熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 在改革初期，很多人對新的做法並不熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǎigé chūqī, hěn duō rén duì xīn de zuòfǎ bìng bù shúxī.
sentences.translation: In the early period of reform, many people were not familiar with the new approach.

sentences.chinese: 公司成立初期资金不足，只能租很小的办公室。
sentences.traditional: 公司成立初期資金不足，只能租很小的辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī chénglì chūqī zījīn bùzú, zhǐ néng zū hěn xiǎo de bàngōngshì.
sentences.translation: In the early period after the company was established, funds were insufficient, so it could only rent a very small office.

sentences.chinese: 她在面试中的表现非常出色，给大家留下了深刻印象。
sentences.traditional: 她在面試中的表現非常出色，給大家留下了深刻印象。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài miànshì zhōng de biǎoxiàn fēicháng chūsè, gěi dàjiā liú xià le shēnkè yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: Her performance in the interview was excellent and left a deep impression on everyone.

sentences.chinese: 这支球队虽然年轻，但配合得很出色。
sentences.traditional: 這支球隊雖然年輕，但配合得很出色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì suīrán niánqīng, dàn pèihé de hěn chūsè.
sentences.translation: Although this team is young, its teamwork is excellent.

sentences.chinese: 如果想完成出色的作品，就必须花时间反复修改。
sentences.traditional: 如果想完成出色的作品，就必須花時間反覆修改。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng wánchéng chūsè de zuòpǐn, jiù bìxū huā shíjiān fǎnfù xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: If you want to complete an outstanding work, you must spend time revising it repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司决定出售部分设备，以减少经营成本。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司決定出售部分設備，以減少經營成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī juédìng chūshòu bùfen shèbèi, yǐ jiǎnshǎo jīngyíng chéngběn.
sentences.translation: This company has decided to sell some equipment in order to reduce operating costs.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆门口不允许私人出售纪念品。
sentences.traditional: 博物館門口不允許私人出售紀念品。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn ménkǒu bù yǔnxǔ sīrén chūshòu jìniànpǐn.
sentences.translation: Private individuals are not allowed to sell souvenirs at the museum entrance.

sentences.chinese: 这套房子已经停止出售，因为产权还有问题。
sentences.traditional: 這套房子已經停止出售，因為產權還有問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi yǐjīng tíngzhǐ chūshòu, yīnwèi chǎnquán hái yǒu wèntí.
sentences.translation: This property has already been taken off sale because there are still issues with the ownership rights.

sentences.chinese: 由于身体原因，他没能出席昨天的闭幕式。
sentences.traditional: 由於身體原因，他沒能出席昨天的閉幕式。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shēntǐ yuányīn, tā méi néng chūxí zuótiān de bìmùshì.
sentences.translation: For health reasons, he was unable to attend yesterday’s closing ceremony.

sentences.chinese: 出席会议的成员都需要提前阅读相关报告。
sentences.traditional: 出席會議的成員都需要提前閱讀相關報告。
sentences.pinyin: Chūxí huìyì de chéngyuán dōu xūyào tíqián yuèdú xiāngguān bàogào.
sentences.translation: Members attending the meeting all need to read the relevant report in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动规模很大，许多作家和记者都会出席。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動規模很大，許多作家和記者都會出席。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng guīmó hěn dà, xǔduō zuòjiā hé jìzhě dōu huì chūxí.
sentences.translation: This event is large in scale, and many writers and journalists will attend.

sentences.chinese: 这句话出自一位著名作家的早期作品。
sentences.traditional: 這句話出自一位著名作家的早期作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jù huà chūzì yí wèi zhùmíng zuòjiā de zǎoqī zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: This sentence comes from the early work of a famous writer.

sentences.chinese: 他的决定并非出自个人利益，而是为了整个团队。
sentences.traditional: 他的決定並非出自個人利益，而是為了整個團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de juédìng bìngfēi chūzì gèrén lìyì, ér shì wèile zhěnggè tuánduì.
sentences.translation: His decision did not come from personal interest, but was for the whole team.

sentences.chinese: 这些设计灵感出自当地传统建筑。
sentences.traditional: 這些設計靈感出自當地傳統建築。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shèjì línggǎn chūzì dāngdì chuántǒng jiànzhù.
sentences.translation: These design ideas come from local traditional architecture.

sentences.chinese: 除夕晚上，全家人通常会一起吃团圆饭。
sentences.traditional: 除夕晚上，全家人通常會一起吃團圓飯。
sentences.pinyin: Chúxī wǎnshang, quánjiā rén tōngcháng huì yìqǐ chī tuányuánfàn.
sentences.translation: On Chinese New Year’s Eve, the whole family usually eats a reunion dinner together.

sentences.chinese: 今年除夕我们不出门，只在家里陪父母聊天。
sentences.traditional: 今年除夕我們不出門，只在家裡陪父母聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián Chúxī wǒmen bù chūmén, zhǐ zài jiā lǐ péi fùmǔ liáotiān.
sentences.translation: This Chinese New Year’s Eve, we are not going out; we will just stay at home and chat with our parents.

sentences.chinese: 到了除夕，城市里的气氛比平时热闹多了。
sentences.traditional: 到了除夕，城市裡的氣氛比平時熱鬧多了。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le Chúxī, chéngshì lǐ de qìfēn bǐ píngshí rènào duō le.
sentences.translation: By Chinese New Year’s Eve, the atmosphere in the city is much livelier than usual.

sentences.chinese: 遇到矛盾时，领导必须公平处置。
sentences.traditional: 遇到矛盾時，領導必須公平處置。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào máodùn shí, lǐngdǎo bìxū gōngpíng chǔzhì.
sentences.translation: When conflicts arise, leaders must handle them fairly.

sentences.chinese: 他很会处事，所以同事们都愿意和他合作。
sentences.traditional: 他很會處事，所以同事們都願意和他合作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn huì chǔshì, suǒyǐ tóngshìmen dōu yuànyì hé tā hézuò.
sentences.translation: He is good at handling matters, so his colleagues are all willing to work with him.

sentences.chinese: 面对客户的投诉，公司不能随便处置。
sentences.traditional: 面對客戶的投訴，公司不能隨便處置。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kèhù de tóusù, gōngsī bù néng suíbiàn chǔzhì.
sentences.translation: Faced with customer complaints, the company cannot deal with them casually.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题比较复杂，需要尽快处理。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題比較複雜，需要盡快處理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bǐjiào fùzá, xūyào jǐnkuài chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: This problem is fairly complicated and needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 她处理紧急情况时非常冷静。
sentences.traditional: 她處理緊急情況時非常冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chǔlǐ jǐnjí qíngkuàng shí fēicháng lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: She is very calm when handling emergencies.

sentences.chinese: 如果订单出现错误，我们会按照程序处理。
sentences.traditional: 如果訂單出現錯誤，我們會按照程序處理。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dìngdān chūxiàn cuòwù, wǒmen huì ànzhào chéngxù chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: If an order contains an error, we will deal with it according to the procedure.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司目前处于快速成长阶段，需要更多有经验的成员。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司目前處於快速成長階段，需要更多有經驗的成員。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī mùqián chǔyú kuàisù chéngzhǎng jiēduàn, xūyào gèng duō yǒu jīngyàn de chéngyuán.
sentences.translation: This company is currently in a stage of rapid growth and needs more experienced members.

sentences.chinese: 如果长期处于压力之下，身体和情绪都会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果長期處於壓力之下，身體和情緒都會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chángqī chǔyú yālì zhī xià, shēntǐ hé qíngxù dōu huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If you are under pressure for a long time, both your body and mood will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 由于缺少资金，这个项目处于暂停状态。
sentences.traditional: 由於缺少資金，這個項目處於暫停狀態。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú quēshǎo zījīn, zhège xiàngmù chǔyú zàntíng zhuàngtài.
sentences.translation: Due to a lack of funds, this project is in a suspended state.

sentences.chinese: 这处古建筑经过修复后，重新向游客开放。
sentences.traditional: 這處古建築經過修復後，重新向遊客開放。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chù gǔ jiànzhù jīngguò xiūfù hòu, chóngxīn xiàng yóukè kāifàng.
sentences.translation: This historic building was reopened to visitors after restoration.

sentences.chinese: 请在合同右下角签名，并注明日期和住处。
sentences.traditional: 請在合同右下角簽名，並註明日期和住處。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài hétong yòu xià jiǎo qiānmíng, bìng zhùmíng rìqī hé zhùchù.
sentences.translation: Please sign in the bottom-right corner of the contract and state the date and place of residence.

sentences.chinese: 公园里有几处适合休息的地方，视野也不错。
sentences.traditional: 公園裡有幾處適合休息的地方，視野也不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu jǐ chù shìhé xiūxi de dìfang, shìyě yě búcuò.
sentences.translation: There are several places in the park suitable for resting, and the view is also good.

sentences.chinese: 请把这份资料传给缺席的同事，让他了解会议内容。
sentences.traditional: 請把這份資料傳給缺席的同事，讓他了解會議內容。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn zīliào chuán gěi quēxí de tóngshì, ràng tā liǎojiě huìyì nèiróng.
sentences.translation: Please pass this material to the colleague who was absent so he understands the meeting content.

sentences.chinese: 这个消息传得很快，半天之内大家都知道了。
sentences.traditional: 這個消息傳得很快，半天之內大家都知道了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi chuán de hěn kuài, bàn tiān zhī nèi dàjiā dōu zhīdào le.
sentences.translation: The news spread quickly; within half a day everyone knew about it.

sentences.chinese: 他把家里的手艺一代一代传了下去。
sentences.traditional: 他把家裡的手藝一代一代傳了下去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiā lǐ de shǒuyì yí dài yí dài chuán le xiàqu.
sentences.translation: He passed down the family craft from generation to generation.

sentences.chinese: 网络平台使信息传播得更快，但也增加了管理难度。
sentences.traditional: 網絡平臺使信息傳播得更快，但也增加了管理難度。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò píngtái shǐ xìnxī chuánbō de gèng kuài, dàn yě zēngjiā le guǎnlǐ nándù.
sentences.translation: Online platforms make information spread faster, but they also increase the difficulty of management.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片通过真实故事传播环保理念。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片通過真實故事傳播環保理念。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tōngguò zhēnshí gùshi chuánbō huánbǎo lǐniàn.
sentences.translation: This documentary spreads environmental ideas through true stories.

sentences.chinese: 谣言一旦被传播，就很难彻底消除影响。
sentences.traditional: 謠言一旦被傳播，就很難徹底消除影響。
sentences.pinyin: Yáoyán yídàn bèi chuánbō, jiù hěn nán chèdǐ xiāochú yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Once a rumour is spread, it is very hard to completely remove its influence.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片传递了作者对家乡的深厚感情。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片傳遞了作者對家鄉的深厚感情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn chuándì le zuòzhě duì jiāxiāng de shēnhòu gǎnqíng.
sentences.translation: This photo conveys the author’s deep feelings towards their hometown.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，请把最新决定传递给每个部门。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，請把最新決定傳遞給每個部門。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, qǐng bǎ zuìxīn juédìng chuándì gěi měi ge bùmén.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ends, please pass the latest decision on to every department.

sentences.chinese: 良好的教育不仅传递知识，也培养判断能力。
sentences.traditional: 良好的教育不僅傳遞知識，也培養判斷能力。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de jiàoyù bùjǐn chuándì zhīshi, yě péiyǎng pànduàn nénglì.
sentences.translation: Good education not only passes on knowledge, but also develops judgement.

sentences.chinese: 传说这座山里曾经住着一位隐士。
sentences.traditional: 傳說這座山裡曾經住著一位隱士。
sentences.pinyin: Chuánshuō zhè zuò shān lǐ céngjīng zhùzhe yí wèi yǐnshì.
sentences.translation: It is said that a hermit once lived in this mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这个古老的传说反映了当地人的价值观。
sentences.traditional: 這個古老的傳說反映了當地人的價值觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de chuánshuō fǎnyìng le dāngdì rén de jiàzhíguān.
sentences.translation: This ancient legend reflects the values of the local people.

sentences.chinese: 关于这口井的传说，村里老人讲得特别生动。
sentences.traditional: 關於這口井的傳說，村裡老人講得特別生動。
sentences.pinyin: Guānyú zhè kǒu jǐng de chuánshuō, cūn lǐ lǎorén jiǎng de tèbié shēngdòng.
sentences.translation: The village elders tell the legend about this well particularly vividly.

sentences.chinese: 虽然生活方式变了，春节的许多传统仍然被保留下来。
sentences.traditional: 雖然生活方式變了，春節的許多傳統仍然被保留下來。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán shēnghuó fāngshì biàn le, Chūnjié de xǔduō chuántǒng réngrán bèi bǎoliú xiàlai.
sentences.translation: Although lifestyles have changed, many Spring Festival traditions have still been preserved.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐馆把传统做法和现代口味结合起来。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐館把傳統做法和現代口味結合起來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānguǎn bǎ chuántǒng zuòfǎ hé xiàndài kǒuwèi jiéhé qǐlai.
sentences.translation: This restaurant combines traditional methods with modern tastes.

sentences.chinese: 学习传统文化，并不等于拒绝创新。
sentences.traditional: 學習傳統文化，並不等於拒絕創新。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí chuántǒng wénhuà, bìng bù děngyú jùjué chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: Studying traditional culture does not mean rejecting innovation.

sentences.chinese: 她把几盆花放在窗台上，房间一下子有了生气。
sentences.traditional: 她把幾盆花放在窗臺上，房間一下子有了生氣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jǐ pén huā fàng zài chuāngtái shang, fángjiān yíxiàzi yǒu le shēngqì.
sentences.translation: She put several pots of flowers on the windowsill, and the room suddenly felt full of life.

sentences.chinese: 雨水从没关好的窗户流进来，把窗台弄湿了。
sentences.traditional: 雨水從沒關好的窗戶流進來，把窗臺弄濕了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔshuǐ cóng méi guān hǎo de chuānghu liú jìnlai, bǎ chuāngtái nòng shī le.
sentences.translation: Rain came in through the window that had not been shut properly and made the windowsill wet.

sentences.chinese: 孩子站在窗台旁看雪，家长一直提醒他注意安全。
sentences.traditional: 孩子站在窗臺旁看雪，家長一直提醒他注意安全。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zhàn zài chuāngtái páng kàn xuě, jiāzhǎng yìzhí tíxǐng tā zhùyì ānquán.
sentences.translation: The child stood beside the windowsill watching the snow, while the parent kept reminding him to stay safe.

sentences.chinese: 酒店每天都会更换床单，以保证客房卫生。
sentences.traditional: 酒店每天都會更換床單，以保證客房衛生。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn měitiān dōu huì gēnghuàn chuángdān, yǐ bǎozhèng kèfáng wèishēng.
sentences.translation: The hotel changes the bedsheets every day to ensure the cleanliness of the guest rooms.

sentences.chinese: 这条床单洗过很多次，颜色已经明显变浅了。
sentences.traditional: 這條床單洗過很多次，顏色已經明顯變淺了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo chuángdān xǐ guò hěn duō cì, yánsè yǐjīng míngxiǎn biàn qiǎn le.
sentences.translation: This bedsheet has been washed many times, and its colour has clearly faded.

sentences.chinese: 出发前，她把干净的床单叠好放进柜子里。
sentences.traditional: 出發前，她把乾淨的床單疊好放進櫃子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Chūfā qián, tā bǎ gānjìng de chuángdān dié hǎo fàng jìn guìzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Before leaving, she folded the clean bedsheet and put it into the cupboard.

sentences.chinese: 企业要想长期发展，就不能只依靠旧经验，而要不断创新。
sentences.traditional: 企業要想長期發展，就不能只依靠舊經驗，而要不斷創新。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yào xiǎng chángqī fāzhǎn, jiù bù néng zhǐ yīkào jiù jīngyàn, ér yào búduàn chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: If an enterprise wants long-term development, it cannot rely only on old experience; it must keep innovating.

sentences.chinese: 这次技术创新大大降低了产品的生产成本。
sentences.traditional: 這次技術創新大大降低了產品的生產成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jìshù chuàngxīn dàdà jiàngdī le chǎnpǐn de shēngchǎn chéngběn.
sentences.translation: This technological innovation greatly reduced the production cost of the product.

sentences.chinese: 学校鼓励学生提出自己的想法，培养创新能力。
sentences.traditional: 學校鼓勵學生提出自己的想法，培養創新能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào gǔlì xuésheng tíchū zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, péiyǎng chuàngxīn nénglì.
sentences.translation: The school encourages students to put forward their own ideas and develop the ability to innovate.

sentences.chinese: 他辞职以后选择创业，虽然压力很大，但目标很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 他辭職以後選擇創業，雖然壓力很大，但目標很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cízhí yǐhòu xuǎnzé chuàngyè, suīrán yālì hěn dà, dàn mùbiāo hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: After resigning, he chose to start a business; although the pressure was great, his goal was very clear.

sentences.chinese: 创业不只是有一个好想法，还需要稳定的资金和团队。
sentences.traditional: 創業不只是有一個好想法，還需要穩定的資金和團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Chuàngyè bù zhǐshì yǒu yí ge hǎo xiǎngfǎ, hái xūyào wěndìng de zījīn hé tuánduì.
sentences.translation: Starting a business is not just about having a good idea; it also requires stable funding and a team.

sentences.chinese: 政府为年轻人创业提供了培训和贷款支持。
sentences.traditional: 政府為年輕人創業提供了培訓和貸款支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ wèi niánqīngrén chuàngyè tígōng le péixùn hé dàikuǎn zhīchí.
sentences.translation: The government provided training and loan support for young people starting businesses.

sentences.chinese: 良好的工作环境能够创造更多合作的机会。
sentences.traditional: 良好的工作環境能夠創造更多合作的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de gōngzuò huánjìng nénggòu chuàngzào gèng duō hézuò de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: A good working environment can create more opportunities for cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 这位科学家的研究创造了新的治疗方法。
sentences.traditional: 這位科學家的研究創造了新的治療方法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā de yánjiū chuàngzào le xīn de zhìliáo fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: This scientist’s research created a new method of treatment.

sentences.chinese: 教育的目的不只是传递知识，也要鼓励学生创造。
sentences.traditional: 教育的目的不只是傳遞知識，也要鼓勵學生創造。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù de mùdì bù zhǐshì chuándì zhīshi, yě yào gǔlì xuésheng chuàngzào.
sentences.translation: The purpose of education is not only to pass on knowledge, but also to encourage students to create.

sentences.chinese: 他花了三年时间创作这部小说，终于在今年出版。
sentences.traditional: 他花了三年時間創作這部小說，終於在今年出版。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián shíjiān chuàngzuò zhè bù xiǎoshuō, zhōngyú zài jīnnián chūbǎn.
sentences.translation: He spent three years creating this novel, and it was finally published this year.

sentences.chinese: 艺术创作需要灵感，也需要长期的练习。
sentences.traditional: 藝術創作需要靈感，也需要長期的練習。
sentences.pinyin: Yìshù chuàngzuò xūyào línggǎn, yě xūyào chángqī de liànxí.
sentences.translation: Artistic creation requires inspiration, and it also requires long-term practice.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌的创作背景和那段历史有密切关系。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌的創作背景和那段歷史有密切關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē de chuàngzuò bèijǐng hé nà duàn lìshǐ yǒu mìqiè guānxi.
sentences.translation: The background of this song’s creation is closely related to that period of history.

sentences.chinese: 阅读新闻能帮助学习者扩大词汇量。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀新聞能幫助學習者擴大詞彙量。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú xīnwén néng bāngzhù xuéxízhě kuòdà cíhuìliàng.
sentences.translation: Reading the news can help learners expand their vocabulary.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章的词汇不算难，但句子结构比较复杂。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章的詞彙不算難，但句子結構比較複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de cíhuì bú suàn nán, dàn jùzi jiégòu bǐjiào fùzá.
sentences.translation: The vocabulary in this article is not too difficult, but the sentence structure is rather complex.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们把新词汇放进完整的句子里练习。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們把新詞彙放進完整的句子裡練習。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen bǎ xīn cíhuì fàng jìn wánzhěng de jùzi lǐ liànxí.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to put the new vocabulary into complete sentences for practice.

sentences.chinese: 她决定辞职，并不是因为工资低，而是想换一种生活方式。
sentences.traditional: 她決定辭職，並不是因為工資低，而是想換一種生活方式。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng cízhí, bìng bú shì yīnwèi gōngzī dī, ér shì xiǎng huàn yì zhǒng shēnghuó fāngshì.
sentences.translation: She decided to resign not because the salary was low, but because she wanted to change her way of life.

sentences.chinese: 在没有找到新工作之前，他暂时不打算辞职。
sentences.traditional: 在沒有找到新工作之前，他暫時不打算辭職。
sentences.pinyin: Zài méiyǒu zhǎodào xīn gōngzuò zhīqián, tā zànshí bù dǎsuàn cízhí.
sentences.translation: Before finding a new job, he does not plan to resign for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 他递交辞职申请后，公司安排同事接手他的项目。
sentences.traditional: 他遞交辭職申請後，公司安排同事接手他的項目。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dìjiāo cízhí shēnqǐng hòu, gōngsī ānpái tóngshì jiēshǒu tā de xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: After he submitted his resignation application, the company arranged for a colleague to take over his project.

sentences.chinese: 项目在五月完成，此后团队把重点转向市场推广。
sentences.traditional: 項目在五月完成，此後團隊把重點轉向市場推廣。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù zài wǔ yuè wánchéng, cǐhòu tuánduì bǎ zhòngdiǎn zhuǎnxiàng shìchǎng tuīguǎng.
sentences.translation: The project was completed in May; after this, the team shifted its focus to marketing.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次公开道歉，此后很少再提起那件事。
sentences.traditional: 他第一次公開道歉，此後很少再提起那件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì gōngkāi dàoqiàn, cǐhòu hěn shǎo zài tíqǐ nà jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: He apologised publicly for the first time; after this, he rarely mentioned that matter again.

sentences.chinese: 双方签署协议，此后的合作范围不断扩大。
sentences.traditional: 雙方簽署協議，此後的合作範圍不斷擴大。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng qiānshǔ xiéyì, cǐhòu de hézuò fànwéi búduàn kuòdà.
sentences.translation: The two sides signed an agreement, and the scope of cooperation after this continued to expand.

sentences.chinese: 此前，我们已经多次讨论过这个方案的风险。
sentences.traditional: 此前，我們已經多次討論過這個方案的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐqián, wǒmen yǐjīng duō cì tǎolùn guò zhège fāng'àn de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before this, we had already discussed the risks of this plan many times.

sentences.chinese: 会议改在周五举行，但此前的安排仍然有效。
sentences.traditional: 會議改在週五舉行，但此前的安排仍然有效。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì gǎi zài zhōu wǔ jǔxíng, dàn cǐqián de ānpái réngrán yǒuxiào.
sentences.translation: The meeting has been moved to Friday, but the arrangements made before this are still valid.

sentences.chinese: 警方表示，此前没有收到任何报警信息。
sentences.traditional: 警方表示，此前沒有收到任何報警信息。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng biǎoshì, cǐqián méiyǒu shōudào rènhé bàojǐng xìnxī.
sentences.translation: The police stated that before this, they had not received any report information.

sentences.chinese: 此时，现场所有人的目光都集中在发言人身上。
sentences.traditional: 此時，現場所有人的目光都集中在發言人身上。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, xiànchǎng suǒyǒu rén de mùguāng dōu jízhōng zài fāyánrén shēnshang.
sentences.translation: At this moment, everyone at the scene had their eyes fixed on the speaker.

sentences.chinese: 外面突然下起暴雨，此时继续比赛并不安全。
sentences.traditional: 外面突然下起暴雨，此時繼續比賽並不安全。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimian tūrán xià qǐ bàoyǔ, cǐshí jìxù bǐsài bìng bù ānquán.
sentences.translation: It suddenly started raining heavily outside; at this moment, continuing the match was not safe.

sentences.chinese: 此时再去责怪任何人，都已经解决不了问题。
sentences.traditional: 此時再去責怪任何人，都已經解決不了問題。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí zài qù zéguài rènhé rén, dōu yǐjīng jiějué bù liǎo wèntí.
sentences.translation: At this moment, blaming anyone would no longer solve the problem.

sentences.chinese: 新的消费政策有效刺激了本地经济。
sentences.traditional: 新的消費政策有效刺激了本地經濟。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn de xiāofèi zhèngcè yǒuxiào cìjī le běndì jīngjì.
sentences.translation: The new consumption policy effectively stimulated the local economy.

sentences.chinese: 太强的光线会刺激眼睛，长时间看屏幕也不利于健康。
sentences.traditional: 太強的光線會刺激眼睛，長時間看屏幕也不利於健康。
sentences.pinyin: Tài qiáng de guāngxiàn huì cìjī yǎnjing, cháng shíjiān kàn píngmù yě búlì yú jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Excessively strong light can irritate the eyes, and looking at a screen for a long time is also bad for health.

sentences.chinese: 他喜欢有点刺激的运动，比如攀岩和滑雪。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡有點刺激的運動，比如攀岩和滑雪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan yǒu diǎn cìjī de yùndòng, bǐrú pānyán hé huáxuě.
sentences.translation: He likes sports that are a bit exciting, such as rock climbing and skiing.

sentences.chinese: 他从不轻易承诺，但答应过的事一定会做到。
sentences.traditional: 他從不輕易承諾，但答應過的事一定會做到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng bù qīngyì chéngnuò, dàn dāying guò de shì yídìng huì zuòdào.
sentences.translation: He never makes promises lightly, but he will definitely do what he has promised.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司从不忽视客户的安全反馈。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司從不忽視客戶的安全反饋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī cóng bù hūshì kèhù de ānquán fǎnkuì.
sentences.translation: This company never ignores customers’ safety feedback.

sentences.chinese: 无论情况多么紧张，她从不在病人面前表现出慌张。
sentences.traditional: 無論情況多麼緊張，她從不在病人面前表現出慌張。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn qíngkuàng duōme jǐnzhāng, tā cóng bù zài bìngrén miànqián biǎoxiàn chū huāngzhāng.
sentences.translation: No matter how tense the situation is, she never shows panic in front of the patient.

sentences.chinese: 通过长期观察，研究人员发现了关键规律，从而提高了预测的准确度。
sentences.traditional: 通過長期觀察，研究人員發現了關鍵規律，從而提高了預測的準確度。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò chángqī guānchá, yánjiū rényuán fāxiàn le guānjiàn guīlǜ, cóng'ér tígāo le yùcè de zhǔnquèdù.
sentences.translation: Through long-term observation, the researchers discovered a key pattern, thereby improving the accuracy of the prediction.

sentences.chinese: 公司调整了售后流程，从而减少了客户投诉。
sentences.traditional: 公司調整了售後流程，從而減少了客戶投訴。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī tiáozhěng le shòuhòu liúchéng, cóng'ér jiǎnshǎo le kèhù tóusù.
sentences.translation: The company adjusted its after-sales process, thereby reducing customer complaints.

sentences.chinese: 他提前整理资料，从而在报告会上回答得更有把握。
sentences.traditional: 他提前整理資料，從而在報告會上回答得更有把握。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tíqián zhěnglǐ zīliào, cóng'ér zài bàogào huì shang huídá de gèng yǒu bǎwò.
sentences.translation: He organised the materials in advance, thereby answering with more confidence at the report meeting.

sentences.chinese: 从前这个城区交通很不便利，现在地铁已经通到市中心。
sentences.traditional: 從前這個城區交通很不便利，現在地鐵已經通到市中心。
sentences.pinyin: Cóngqián zhège chéngqū jiāotōng hěn bú biànlì, xiànzài dìtiě yǐjīng tōng dào shì zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: In the past, transport in this urban area was very inconvenient; now the underground already reaches the city centre.

sentences.chinese: 从前我以为成功主要靠天赋，后来才明白持续努力更重要。
sentences.traditional: 從前我以為成功主要靠天賦，後來才明白持續努力更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Cóngqián wǒ yǐwéi chénggōng zhǔyào kào tiānfù, hòulái cái míngbai chíxù nǔlì gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: I used to think success mainly depended on talent; later I realised that sustained effort is more important.

sentences.chinese: 从前这条河污染严重，经过治理后水质明显改善。
sentences.traditional: 從前這條河污染嚴重，經過治理後水質明顯改善。
sentences.pinyin: Cóngqián zhè tiáo hé wūrǎn yánzhòng, jīngguò zhìlǐ hòu shuǐzhì míngxiǎn gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: This river used to be seriously polluted; after treatment, the water quality improved noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 她毕业后一直从事儿童教育工作，对学生非常有耐心。
sentences.traditional: 她畢業後一直從事兒童教育工作，對學生非常有耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìyè hòu yìzhí cóngshì értóng jiàoyù gōngzuò, duì xuésheng fēicháng yǒu nàixīn.
sentences.translation: After graduating, she has always been engaged in children’s education and is very patient with students.

sentences.chinese: 如果想从事医疗行业，专业知识和责任感都不可缺少。
sentences.traditional: 如果想從事醫療行業，專業知識和責任感都不可缺少。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng cóngshì yīliáo hángyè, zhuānyè zhīshi hé zérèngǎn dōu bùkě quēshǎo.
sentences.translation: To work in the medical industry, both professional knowledge and a sense of responsibility are indispensable.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然从事销售，但对产品技术也了解得很深入。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然從事銷售，但對產品技術也了解得很深入。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán cóngshì xiāoshòu, dàn duì chǎnpǐn jìshù yě liǎojiě de hěn shēnrù.
sentences.translation: Although he works in sales, he also has a deep understanding of the product technology.

sentences.chinese: 良好的沟通有助于促进团队成员之间的合作。
sentences.traditional: 良好的溝通有助於促進團隊成員之間的合作。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de gōutōng yǒuzhù yú cùjìn tuánduì chéngyuán zhījiān de hézuò.
sentences.translation: Good communication helps promote cooperation among team members.

sentences.chinese: 政府推出新政策，促进本地产业的长期发展。
sentences.traditional: 政府推出新政策，促進本地產業的長期發展。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū xīn zhèngcè, cùjìn běndì chǎnyè de chángqī fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: The government introduced a new policy to promote the long-term development of local industry.

sentences.chinese: 适当的运动能够促进血液循环，改善睡眠质量。
sentences.traditional: 適當的運動能夠促進血液循環，改善睡眠質量。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdàng de yùndòng nénggòu cùjìn xuèyè xúnhuán, gǎishàn shuìmián zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Appropriate exercise can promote blood circulation and improve sleep quality.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败促使他重新思考自己的学习方法。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗促使他重新思考自己的學習方法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài cùshǐ tā chóngxīn sīkǎo zìjǐ de xuéxí fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: This failure prompted him to rethink his own study methods.

sentences.chinese: 消费者的投诉促使公司改进产品包装。
sentences.traditional: 消費者的投訴促使公司改進產品包裝。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě de tóusù cùshǐ gōngsī gǎijìn chǎnpǐn bāozhuāng.
sentences.translation: Consumer complaints prompted the company to improve the product packaging.

sentences.chinese: 连续几天的暴雨促使学校取消了户外活动。
sentences.traditional: 連續幾天的暴雨促使學校取消了戶外活動。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jǐ tiān de bàoyǔ cùshǐ xuéxiào qǔxiāo le hùwài huódòng.
sentences.translation: Several days of continuous heavy rain prompted the school to cancel outdoor activities.

sentences.chinese: 商场正在促销冬季服装，价格比平时低了不少。
sentences.traditional: 商場正在促銷冬季服裝，價格比平時低了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngchǎng zhèngzài cùxiāo dōngjì fúzhuāng, jiàgé bǐ píngshí dī le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: The shopping centre is promoting winter clothing, and the prices are much lower than usual.

sentences.chinese: 为了促销新产品，公司在便利店门口安排了试用活动。
sentences.traditional: 為了促銷新產品，公司在便利店門口安排了試用活動。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile cùxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn, gōngsī zài biànlìdiàn ménkǒu ānpái le shìyòng huódòng.
sentences.translation: To promote the new product, the company arranged a trial event outside the convenience store.

sentences.chinese: 网络平台通过发优惠券来促销，但效果并不一定长久。
sentences.traditional: 網絡平臺通過發優惠券來促銷，但效果並不一定長久。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò píngtái tōngguò fā yōuhuìquàn lái cùxiāo, dàn xiàoguǒ bìng bù yídìng chángjiǔ.
sentences.translation: Online platforms promote sales by issuing coupons, but the effect is not necessarily long-lasting.

sentences.chinese: 别一直催他，复杂的问题需要时间处理。
sentences.traditional: 別一直催他，複雜的問題需要時間處理。
sentences.pinyin: Bié yìzhí cuī tā, fùzá de wèntí xūyào shíjiān chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: Don’t keep rushing him; complicated problems need time to handle.

sentences.chinese: 客户今天又来催付款进度，财务部正在核对资料。
sentences.traditional: 客戶今天又來催付款進度，財務部正在核對資料。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù jīntiān yòu lái cuī fùkuǎn jìndù, cáiwù bù zhèngzài héduì zīliào.
sentences.translation: The customer came again today to chase the payment progress; the finance department is checking the information.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈催我早点睡觉，免得明天上课没精神。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽催我早點睡覺，免得明天上課沒精神。
sentences.pinyin: Māma cuī wǒ zǎodiǎn shuìjiào, miǎnde míngtiān shàngkè méi jīngshen.
sentences.translation: Mum urged me to go to bed earlier so that I wouldn’t lack energy in class tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 重要文件应当存放在安全的地方，避免丢失或损坏。
sentences.traditional: 重要文件應當存放在安全的地方，避免丟失或損壞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhòngyào wénjiàn yīngdāng cúnfàng zài ānquán de dìfang, bìmiǎn diūshī huò sǔnhuài.
sentences.translation: Important documents should be stored in a safe place to avoid loss or damage.

sentences.chinese: 这些化学材料不能和食品存放在同一个仓库。
sentences.traditional: 這些化學材料不能和食品存放在同一個倉庫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē huàxué cáiliào bù néng hé shípǐn cúnfàng zài tóng yí ge cāngkù.
sentences.translation: These chemical materials must not be stored in the same warehouse as food.

sentences.chinese: 请把行李存放在服务台旁边的柜子里。
sentences.traditional: 請把行李存放在服務臺旁邊的櫃子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xíngli cúnfàng zài fúwùtái pángbiān de guìzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please store the luggage in the cabinet beside the service desk.

sentences.chinese: 他每个月都会去银行存款，为以后买房做准备。
sentences.traditional: 他每個月都會去銀行存款，為以後買房做準備。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè dōu huì qù yínháng cúnkuǎn, wèi yǐhòu mǎi fáng zuò zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: Every month he goes to the bank to deposit money, preparing to buy a house in the future.

sentences.chinese: 银行提醒客户，定期存款提前取出可能会损失利息。
sentences.traditional: 銀行提醒客戶，定期存款提前取出可能會損失利息。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng tíxǐng kèhù, dìngqī cúnkuǎn tíqián qǔchū kěnéng huì sǔnshī lìxī.
sentences.translation: The bank reminds customers that withdrawing a fixed deposit early may lead to a loss of interest.

sentences.chinese: 这笔存款虽然不多，却是她多年努力工作的成果。
sentences.traditional: 這筆存款雖然不多，卻是她多年努力工作的成果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ cúnkuǎn suīrán bù duō, què shì tā duō nián nǔlì gōngzuò de chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Although this deposit is not large, it is the result of her many years of hard work.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划仍然存在一些风险，需要进一步讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這個計劃仍然存在一些風險，需要進一步討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà réngrán cúnzài yìxiē fēngxiǎn, xūyào jìn yí bù tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This plan still has some risks, so it needs further discussion.

sentences.chinese: 语言之间存在差异，所以翻译时不能只看字面意思。
sentences.traditional: 語言之間存在差異，所以翻譯時不能只看字面意思。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔyán zhījiān cúnzài chāyì, suǒyǐ fānyì shí bù néng zhǐ kàn zìmiàn yìsi.
sentences.translation: Differences exist between languages, so when translating you cannot only look at the literal meaning.

sentences.chinese: 如果问题长期存在，就不能再把它当作小事处理。
sentences.traditional: 如果問題長期存在，就不能再把它當作小事處理。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wèntí chángqī cúnzài, jiù bù néng zài bǎ tā dàngzuò xiǎoshì chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: If the problem exists for a long time, it can no longer be treated as a minor matter.

sentences.chinese: 政府采取了新的措施，鼓励年轻人参与环保项目。
sentences.traditional: 政府採取了新的措施，鼓勵年輕人參與環保項目。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le xīn de cuòshī, gǔlì niánqīng rén cānyù huánbǎo xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: The government has adopted new measures to encourage young people to take part in environmental projects.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免事故再次发生，公司必须尽快落实这些措施。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免事故再次發生，公司必須盡快落實這些措施。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn shìgù zàicì fāshēng, gōngsī bìxū jǐnkuài luòshí zhèxiē cuòshī.
sentences.translation: To prevent the accident from happening again, the company must put these measures into effect as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这些措施虽然成本较高，但对长期发展很有必要。
sentences.traditional: 這些措施雖然成本較高，但對長期發展很有必要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē cuòshī suīrán chéngběn jiào gāo, dàn duì chángqī fāzhǎn hěn yǒu bìyào.
sentences.translation: Although these measures are relatively costly, they are necessary for long-term development.

sentences.chinese: 双方经过多轮谈判，终于达成了合作协议。
sentences.traditional: 雙方經過多輪談判，終於達成了合作協議。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng jīngguò duō lún tánpàn, zhōngyú dáchéng le hézuò xiéyì.
sentences.translation: After several rounds of negotiation, the two sides finally reached a cooperation agreement.

sentences.chinese: 只要目标明确，团队就更容易达成一致。
sentences.traditional: 只要目標明確，團隊就更容易達成一致。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào mùbiāo míngquè, tuánduì jiù gèng róngyì dáchéng yízhì.
sentences.translation: As long as the goal is clear, the team is more likely to reach agreement.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革需要各部门配合，才能达成预期效果。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革需要各部門配合，才能達成預期效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé xūyào gè bùmén pèihé, cái néng dáchéng yùqī xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: This reform requires cooperation from all departments before it can achieve the expected result.

sentences.chinese: 她今天打扮得很正式，因为要出席公司的年会。
sentences.traditional: 她今天打扮得很正式，因為要出席公司的年會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān dǎban de hěn zhèngshì, yīnwèi yào chūxí gōngsī de niánhuì.
sentences.translation: She is dressed very formally today because she has to attend the company’s annual meeting.

sentences.chinese: 不必为了面试打扮得太夸张，整洁自然就好。
sentences.traditional: 不必為了面試打扮得太誇張，整潔自然就好。
sentences.pinyin: Búbì wèile miànshì dǎban de tài kuāzhāng, zhěngjié zìrán jiù hǎo.
sentences.translation: There is no need to dress too dramatically for the interview; neat and natural is fine.

sentences.chinese: 节日那天，孩子们打扮成传统故事里的人物。
sentences.traditional: 節日那天，孩子們打扮成傳統故事裡的人物。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì nà tiān, háizimen dǎban chéng chuántǒng gùshi lǐ de rénwù.
sentences.translation: On the day of the festival, the children dressed up as characters from traditional stories.

sentences.chinese: 如果吃不完，可以让服务员把剩下的菜打包。
sentences.traditional: 如果吃不完，可以讓服務員把剩下的菜打包。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chī bu wán, kěyǐ ràng fúwùyuán bǎ shèngxià de cài dǎbāo.
sentences.translation: If you cannot finish the food, you can ask the waiter to pack up the leftovers.

sentences.chinese: 搬家前，他花了一整天把书和衣服打包好。
sentences.traditional: 搬家前，他花了一整天把書和衣服打包好。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiā qián, tā huā le yì zhěng tiān bǎ shū hé yīfu dǎbāo hǎo.
sentences.translation: Before moving house, he spent a whole day packing up his books and clothes.

sentences.chinese: 这些产品需要重新打包，否则在运输过程中容易损坏。
sentences.traditional: 這些產品需要重新打包，否則在運輸過程中容易損壞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē chǎnpǐn xūyào chóngxīn dǎbāo, fǒuzé zài yùnshū guòchéng zhōng róngyì sǔnhuài.
sentences.translation: These products need to be repacked; otherwise, they may be damaged during transport.

sentences.chinese: 他正在报告重要数据，我不好意思打断他。
sentences.traditional: 他正在報告重要數據，我不好意思打斷他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài bàogào zhòngyào shùjù, wǒ bù hǎoyìsi dǎduàn tā.
sentences.translation: He is reporting important data, so I feel awkward interrupting him.

sentences.chinese: 会议中请不要随便打断别人，先把意见记下来。
sentences.traditional: 會議中請不要隨便打斷別人，先把意見記下來。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì zhōng qǐng bú yào suíbiàn dǎduàn biéren, xiān bǎ yìjiàn jì xiàlai.
sentences.translation: Please do not casually interrupt others during the meeting; write down your ideas first.

sentences.chinese: 突然响起的警报打断了大家的讨论。
sentences.traditional: 突然響起的警報打斷了大家的討論。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán xiǎngqǐ de jǐngbào dǎduàn le dàjiā de tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: The alarm that suddenly went off interrupted everyone’s discussion.

sentences.chinese: 这个运动员打破了全国纪录，受到媒体广泛报道。
sentences.traditional: 這個運動員打破了全國紀錄，受到媒體廣泛報道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yùndòngyuán dǎpò le quánguó jìlù, shòudào méitǐ guǎngfàn bàodào.
sentences.translation: This athlete broke the national record and received wide media coverage.

sentences.chinese: 创新往往需要打破旧观念，尝试新的做法。
sentences.traditional: 創新往往需要打破舊觀念，嘗試新的做法。
sentences.pinyin: Chuàngxīn wǎngwǎng xūyào dǎpò jiù guānniàn, chángshì xīn de zuòfǎ.
sentences.translation: Innovation often requires breaking old ideas and trying new approaches.

sentences.chinese: 他不小心打破了玻璃，只好主动承担责任。
sentences.traditional: 他不小心打破了玻璃，只好主動承擔責任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn dǎpò le bōli, zhǐhǎo zhǔdòng chéngdān zérèn.
sentences.translation: He accidentally broke the glass, so he had to take responsibility voluntarily.

sentences.chinese: 我想打听一下，附近有没有比较安静的住宿。
sentences.traditional: 我想打聽一下，附近有沒有比較安靜的住宿。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dǎting yíxià, fùjìn yǒu méiyǒu bǐjiào ānjìng de zhùsù.
sentences.translation: I would like to ask whether there is any relatively quiet accommodation nearby.

sentences.chinese: 他到处打听那位作者的联系方式，却一直没有结果。
sentences.traditional: 他到處打聽那位作者的聯繫方式，卻一直沒有結果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàochù dǎting nà wèi zuòzhě de liánxì fāngshì, què yìzhí méiyǒu jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: He asked everywhere for that author’s contact details, but still had no result.

sentences.chinese: 别随便打听别人的收入，这样很不礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 別隨便打聽別人的收入，這樣很不禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Bié suíbiàn dǎting biéren de shōurù, zhèyàng hěn bù lǐmào.
sentences.translation: Do not casually ask about other people’s income; that is very impolite.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案虽然大胆，但也许能带来意想不到的成果。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案雖然大膽，但也許能帶來意想不到的成果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn suīrán dàdǎn, dàn yěxǔ néng dàilái yìxiǎng bù dào de chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Although this plan is bold, it may bring unexpected results.

sentences.chinese: 老师鼓励学生大胆表达自己的观点，不要害怕出错。
sentences.traditional: 老師鼓勵學生大膽表達自己的觀點，不要害怕出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì xuésheng dàdǎn biǎodá zìjǐ de guāndiǎn, bú yào hàipà chūcuò.
sentences.translation: The teacher encouraged the students to express their own views boldly and not be afraid of making mistakes.

sentences.chinese: 面对新的市场，企业需要大胆尝试，而不是一直保守等待。
sentences.traditional: 面對新的市場，企業需要大膽嘗試，而不是一直保守等待。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì xīn de shìchǎng, qǐyè xūyào dàdǎn chángshì, ér bú shì yìzhí bǎoshǒu děngdài.
sentences.translation: Facing a new market, companies need to try boldly rather than keep waiting conservatively.

sentences.chinese: 这里的居民大多选择步行或骑车上班。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的居民大多選擇步行或騎車上班。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jūmín dàduō xuǎnzé bùxíng huò qí chē shàngbān.
sentences.translation: Most residents here choose to walk or cycle to work.

sentences.chinese: 参加培训的人大多是刚进入公司的新成员。
sentences.traditional: 參加培訓的人大多是剛進入公司的新成員。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā péixùn de rén dàduō shì gāng jìnrù gōngsī de xīn chéngyuán.
sentences.translation: Most of the people attending the training are new members who have just joined the company.

sentences.chinese: 这些问题大多出现在项目初期，后来逐渐得到处理。
sentences.traditional: 這些問題大多出現在項目初期，後來逐漸得到處理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí dàduō chūxiàn zài xiàngmù chūqī, hòulái zhújiàn dédào chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: Most of these problems appeared in the early stage of the project and were gradually dealt with later.

sentences.chinese: 本次大会将讨论产业发展和技术创新两个主题。
sentences.traditional: 本次大會將討論產業發展和技術創新兩個主題。
sentences.pinyin: Běn cì dàhuì jiāng tǎolùn chǎnyè fāzhǎn hé jìshù chuàngxīn liǎng ge zhǔtí.
sentences.translation: This conference will discuss two themes: industrial development and technological innovation.

sentences.chinese: 来自各地的代表出席了这场国际大会。
sentences.traditional: 來自各地的代表出席了這場國際大會。
sentences.pinyin: Láizì gèdì de dàibiǎo chūxí le zhè chǎng guójì dàhuì.
sentences.translation: Representatives from various places attended this international conference.

sentences.chinese: 大会结束后，主办方会发布详细的会议报告。
sentences.traditional: 大會結束後，主辦方會發佈詳細的會議報告。
sentences.pinyin: Dàhuì jiéshù hòu, zhǔbànfāng huì fābù xiángxì de huìyì bàogào.
sentences.translation: After the conference ends, the organisers will publish a detailed meeting report.

sentences.chinese: 政府正在大力发展公共交通，以减少城市污染。
sentences.traditional: 政府正在大力發展公共交通，以減少城市污染。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài dàlì fāzhǎn gōnggòng jiāotōng, yǐ jiǎnshǎo chéngshì wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: The government is vigorously developing public transport to reduce urban pollution.

sentences.chinese: 学校大力支持学生参加科技创新活动。
sentences.traditional: 學校大力支持學生參加科技創新活動。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào dàlì zhīchí xuéshēng cānjiā kējì chuàngxīn huódòng.
sentences.translation: The school strongly supports students taking part in science and technology innovation activities.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高产量，工厂大力引进自动化设备。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高產量，工廠大力引進自動化設備。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo chǎnliàng, gōngchǎng dàlì yǐnjìn zìdònghuà shèbèi.
sentences.translation: To increase output, the factory has made great efforts to introduce automated equipment.

sentences.chinese: 那位大妈每天傍晚都在小区门口卖新鲜蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 那位大媽每天傍晚都在小區門口賣新鮮蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi dàmā měitiān bàngwǎn dōu zài xiǎoqū ménkǒu mài xīnxiān shūcài.
sentences.translation: That middle-aged woman sells fresh vegetables at the entrance to the residential area every evening.

sentences.chinese: 迷路时，一位热心的大妈主动带我去车站。
sentences.traditional: 迷路時，一位熱心的大媽主動帶我去車站。
sentences.pinyin: Mílù shí, yí wèi rèxīn de dàmā zhǔdòng dài wǒ qù chēzhàn.
sentences.translation: When I was lost, a warm-hearted auntie took the initiative to lead me to the station.

sentences.chinese: 公园里的大妈们排练节目，准备参加社区演出。
sentences.traditional: 公園裡的大媽們排練節目，準備參加社區演出。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ de dàmāmen páiliàn jiémù, zhǔnbèi cānjiā shèqū yǎnchū.
sentences.translation: The middle-aged women in the park are rehearsing a performance, preparing to take part in a community show.

sentences.chinese: 这袋大米虽然价格高一点，但质量稳定。
sentences.traditional: 這袋大米雖然價格高一點，但質量穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dài dàmǐ suīrán jiàgé gāo yìdiǎn, dàn zhìliàng wěndìng.
sentences.translation: Although this bag of rice is a little more expensive, its quality is consistent.

sentences.chinese: 超市把大米放在入口处，是为了方便顾客购买。
sentences.traditional: 超市把大米放在入口處，是為了方便顧客購買。
sentences.pinyin: Chāoshì bǎ dàmǐ fàng zài rùkǒu chù, shì wèile fāngbiàn gùkè gòumǎi.
sentences.translation: The supermarket puts the rice near the entrance to make it convenient for customers to buy.

sentences.chinese: 如果存放不当，大米很容易受潮或者生虫。
sentences.traditional: 如果存放不當，大米很容易受潮或者生蟲。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ cúnfàng bùdàng, dàmǐ hěn róngyì shòucháo huòzhě shēng chóng.
sentences.translation: If it is not stored properly, rice can easily get damp or attract insects.

sentences.chinese: 长期熬夜会影响大脑的判断力和记忆力。
sentences.traditional: 長期熬夜會影響大腦的判斷力和記憶力。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī áoyè huì yǐngxiǎng dànǎo de pànduànlì hé jìyìlì.
sentences.translation: Staying up late over the long term can affect the brain’s judgement and memory.

sentences.chinese: 阅读和思考能让大脑保持活跃。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀和思考能讓大腦保持活躍。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú hé sīkǎo néng ràng dànǎo bǎochí huóyuè.
sentences.translation: Reading and thinking can keep the brain active.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究表明，运动对大脑健康有积极作用。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究表明，運動對大腦健康有積極作用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū biǎomíng, yùndòng duì dànǎo jiànkāng yǒu jījí zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: This study shows that exercise has a positive effect on brain health.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，大批车辆被困在高速公路上。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，大批車輛被困在高速公路上。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, dàpī chēliàng bèi kùn zài gāosù gōnglù shang.
sentences.translation: After the rainstorm, large numbers of vehicles were trapped on the motorway.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业每年培养大批技术人才。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業每年培養大批技術人才。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè měinián péiyǎng dàpī jìshù réncái.
sentences.translation: This company trains large numbers of technical workers every year.

sentences.chinese: 新产品上市后，吸引了大批年轻消费者。
sentences.traditional: 新產品上市後，吸引了大批年輕消費者。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn chǎnpǐn shàngshì hòu, xīyǐn le dàpī niánqīng xiāofèizhě.
sentences.translation: After the new product was launched, it attracted large numbers of young consumers.

sentences.chinese: 那座大厦的玻璃外墙在阳光下非常醒目。
sentences.traditional: 那座大廈的玻璃外牆在陽光下非常醒目。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zuò dàshà de bōli wàiqiáng zài yángguāng xià fēicháng xǐngmù.
sentences.translation: The glass outer wall of that building is very striking in the sunlight.

sentences.chinese: 公司搬进市中心的新大厦以后，交通便利多了。
sentences.traditional: 公司搬進市中心的新大廈以後，交通便利多了。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī bān jìn shì zhōngxīn de xīn dàshà yǐhòu, jiāotōng biànlì duō le.
sentences.translation: After the company moved into the new building in the city centre, transport became much more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 消防演习结束后，工作人员有序地离开了大厦。
sentences.traditional: 消防演習結束後，工作人員有序地離開了大廈。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofáng yǎnxí jiéshù hòu, gōngzuò rényuán yǒuxù de líkāi le dàshà.
sentences.translation: After the fire drill ended, the staff left the building in an orderly way.

sentences.chinese: 结婚是人生中的大事，双方家庭都很重视。
sentences.traditional: 結婚是人生中的大事，雙方家庭都很重視。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéhūn shì rénshēng zhōng de dàshì, shuāngfāng jiātíng dōu hěn zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: Marriage is an important event in life, and both families take it very seriously.

sentences.chinese: 在作出决定以前，你应该分清这是小事还是大事。
sentences.traditional: 在作出決定以前，你應該分清這是小事還是大事。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zuòchū juédìng yǐqián, nǐ yīnggāi fēnqīng zhè shì xiǎoshì háishì dàshì.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, you should distinguish whether this is a small matter or an important one.

sentences.chinese: 遇到大事时，他总能保持冷静，不轻易抱怨。
sentences.traditional: 遇到大事時，他總能保持冷靜，不輕易抱怨。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào dàshì shí, tā zǒng néng bǎochí lěngjìng, bù qīngyì bàoyuàn.
sentences.translation: When facing important matters, he can always stay calm and does not complain easily.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆里展示了一具完整的大象骨架。
sentences.traditional: 博物館裡展示了一具完整的大象骨架。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ zhǎnshì le yí jù wánzhěng de dàxiàng gǔjià.
sentences.translation: The museum displays a complete elephant skeleton.

sentences.chinese: 大象虽然体型巨大，但动作比人们想象的灵活。
sentences.traditional: 大象雖然體型巨大，但動作比人們想像的靈活。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxiàng suīrán tǐxíng jùdà, dàn dòngzuò bǐ rénmen xiǎngxiàng de línghuó.
sentences.translation: Although elephants are huge in size, their movements are more flexible than people imagine.

sentences.chinese: 保护大象不仅是保护动物，也是保护生态环境。
sentences.traditional: 保護大象不僅是保護動物，也是保護生態環境。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù dàxiàng bùjǐn shì bǎohù dòngwù, yě shì bǎohù shēngtài huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Protecting elephants is not only about protecting animals, but also about protecting the ecological environment.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市每年都会举办大型文化活动。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市每年都會舉辦大型文化活動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì měinián dōu huì jǔbàn dàxíng wénhuà huódòng.
sentences.translation: This city holds large-scale cultural events every year.

sentences.chinese: 大型超市通常需要完善的物流系统支持。
sentences.traditional: 大型超市通常需要完善的物流系統支持。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxíng chāoshì tōngcháng xūyào wánshàn de wùliú xìtǒng zhīchí.
sentences.translation: Large supermarkets usually need support from a complete logistics system.

sentences.chinese: 由于成本太高，这项大型工程被推迟到明年。
sentences.traditional: 由於成本太高，這項大型工程被推遲到明年。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngběn tài gāo, zhè xiàng dàxíng gōngchéng bèi tuīchí dào míngnián.
sentences.translation: Because the cost is too high, this large-scale project has been postponed until next year.

sentences.chinese: 门口那位大爷每天负责提醒车主不要乱停车。
sentences.traditional: 門口那位大爺每天負責提醒車主不要亂停車。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu nà wèi dàye měitiān fùzé tíxǐng chēzhǔ bú yào luàn tíngchē.
sentences.translation: The elderly man at the gate is responsible for reminding vehicle owners not to park carelessly every day.

sentences.chinese: 我向路边的大爷打听附近有没有便利店。
sentences.traditional: 我向路邊的大爺打聽附近有沒有便利店。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàng lùbiān de dàye dǎting fùjìn yǒu méiyǒu biànlìdiàn.
sentences.translation: I asked the elderly man by the road whether there was a convenience store nearby.

sentences.chinese: 那位大爷虽然年纪大了，但走路比很多年轻人还快。
sentences.traditional: 那位大爺雖然年紀大了，但走路比很多年輕人還快。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi dàye suīrán niánjì dà le, dàn zǒulù bǐ hěn duō niánqīng rén hái kuài.
sentences.translation: Although that elderly man is old, he walks even faster than many young people.

sentences.chinese: 如果支出大于收入，公司就必须控制成本。
sentences.traditional: 如果支出大於收入，公司就必須控制成本。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhīchū dàyú shōurù, gōngsī jiù bìxū kòngzhì chéngběn.
sentences.translation: If expenditure is greater than income, the company must control costs.

sentences.chinese: 当温度大于三十度时，系统会自动发出提醒。
sentences.traditional: 當溫度大於三十度時，系統會自動發出提醒。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng wēndù dàyú sānshí dù shí, xìtǒng huì zìdòng fāchū tíxǐng.
sentences.translation: When the temperature is greater than thirty degrees, the system will automatically send a reminder.

sentences.chinese: 报名人数大于预期，所以主办方临时增加了座位。
sentences.traditional: 報名人數大於預期，所以主辦方臨時增加了座位。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng rénshù dàyú yùqī, suǒyǐ zhǔbànfāng línshí zēngjiā le zuòwèi.
sentences.translation: The number of registrations was greater than expected, so the organisers temporarily added seats.

sentences.chinese: 这款产品价格不高，更容易被大众接受。
sentences.traditional: 這款產品價格不高，更容易被大眾接受。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn jiàgé bù gāo, gèng róngyì bèi dàzhòng jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: This product is not expensive, so it is more easily accepted by the public.

sentences.chinese: 新闻报道应该尊重大众的知情权。
sentences.traditional: 新聞報道應該尊重大眾的知情權。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnwén bàodào yīnggāi zūnzhòng dàzhòng de zhīqíngquán.
sentences.translation: News reports should respect the public’s right to know.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆把专业知识用大众能够理解的方式表达出来。
sentences.traditional: 博物館把專業知識用大眾能夠理解的方式表達出來。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn bǎ zhuānyè zhīshi yòng dàzhòng nénggòu lǐjiě de fāngshì biǎodá chūlái.
sentences.translation: The museum expresses specialist knowledge in a way that the public can understand.

sentences.chinese: 这一代年轻人对环境问题更加重视。
sentences.traditional: 這一代年輕人對環境問題更加重視。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yí dài niánqīng rén duì huánjìng wèntí gèngjiā zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: This generation of young people pays even more attention to environmental issues.

sentences.chinese: 他临时代公司出席会议，并说明了目前的困难。
sentences.traditional: 他臨時代公司出席會議，並說明了目前的困難。
sentences.pinyin: Tā línshí dài gōngsī chūxí huìyì, bìng shuōmíng le mùqián de kùnnan.
sentences.translation: He temporarily attended the meeting on behalf of the company and explained the current difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 这种传统已经传了好几代，不能轻易放弃。
sentences.traditional: 這種傳統已經傳了好幾代，不能輕易放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chuántǒng yǐjīng chuán le hǎo jǐ dài, bù néng qīngyì fàngqì.
sentences.translation: This tradition has been passed down for several generations and cannot be given up lightly.

sentences.chinese: 这位成员将代表团队参加大会。
sentences.traditional: 這位成員將代表團隊參加大會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi chéngyuán jiāng dàibiǎo tuánduì cānjiā dàhuì.
sentences.translation: This member will represent the team at the conference.

sentences.chinese: 这项成果不仅代表个人努力，也代表整个项目的进步。
sentences.traditional: 這項成果不僅代表個人努力，也代表整個項目的進步。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng chéngguǒ bùjǐn dàibiǎo gèrén nǔlì, yě dàibiǎo zhěnggè xiàngmù de jìnbù.
sentences.translation: This achievement represents not only individual effort, but also the progress of the whole project.

sentences.chinese: 代表们在会议上提出了多项改进措施。
sentences.traditional: 代表們在會議上提出了多項改進措施。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎomen zài huìyì shàng tíchū le duō xiàng gǎijìn cuòshī.
sentences.translation: The representatives put forward several improvement measures at the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 新产业的发展带动了当地就业。
sentences.traditional: 新產業的發展帶動了當地就業。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn chǎnyè de fāzhǎn dàidòng le dāngdì jiùyè.
sentences.translation: The development of new industries has driven local employment.

sentences.chinese: 一家大型企业入驻后，带动了周边餐饮和交通。
sentences.traditional: 一家大型企業入駐後，帶動了周邊餐飲和交通。
sentences.pinyin: Yì jiā dàxíng qǐyè rùzhù hòu, dàidòng le zhōubiān cānyǐn hé jiāotōng.
sentences.translation: After a large enterprise moved in, it boosted the surrounding catering and transport.

sentences.chinese: 老师用有趣的例子带动学生参与讨论。
sentences.traditional: 老師用有趣的例子帶動學生參與討論。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng yǒuqù de lìzi dàidòng xuésheng cānyù tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: The teacher used interesting examples to encourage students to take part in the discussion.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器可以代替部分重复劳动，但仍需要人工检查。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器可以代替部分重複勞動，但仍需要人工檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì kěyǐ dàitì bùfen chóngfù láodòng, dàn réng xūyào réngōng jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: This machine can replace some repetitive labour, but manual checks are still needed.

sentences.chinese: 如果我出差，李明会代替我主持会议。
sentences.traditional: 如果我出差，李明會代替我主持會議。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ chūchāi, Lǐ Míng huì dàitì wǒ zhǔchí huìyì.
sentences.translation: If I go on a business trip, Li Ming will chair the meeting in my place.

sentences.chinese: 电子文件不能完全代替纸质合同，关键资料还要保存原件。
sentences.traditional: 電子文件不能完全代替紙質合同，關鍵資料還要保存原件。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzǐ wénjiàn bù néng wánquán dàitì zhǐzhì hétong, guānjiàn zīliào hái yào bǎocún yuánjiàn.
sentences.translation: Electronic documents cannot completely replace paper contracts; key materials still need original copies kept.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司提供的待遇比以前好得多。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司提供的待遇比以前好得多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tígōng de dàiyù bǐ yǐqián hǎo de duō.
sentences.translation: The treatment offered by this company is much better than before.

sentences.chinese: 如果员工的待遇长期不公平，就容易影响团队稳定。
sentences.traditional: 如果員工的待遇長期不公平，就容易影響團隊穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yuángōng de dàiyù chángqī bù gōngpíng, jiù róngyì yǐngxiǎng tuánduì wěndìng.
sentences.translation: If employees’ treatment is unfair over the long term, it can easily affect team stability.

sentences.chinese: 他接受这份工作，不只是因为待遇高，也因为有成长空间。
sentences.traditional: 他接受這份工作，不只是因為待遇高，也因為有成長空間。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiēshòu zhè fèn gōngzuò, bù zhǐ shì yīnwèi dàiyù gāo, yě yīnwèi yǒu chéngzhǎng kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: He accepted this job not only because the pay is high, but also because there is room for growth.

sentences.chinese: 单靠经验处理复杂问题并不保险。
sentences.traditional: 單靠經驗處理複雜問題並不保險。
sentences.pinyin: Dān kào jīngyàn chǔlǐ fùzá wèntí bìng bù bǎoxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Relying only on experience to handle complex problems is not very safe.

sentences.chinese: 单从成本来看，这个决定似乎合理。
sentences.traditional: 單從成本來看，這個決定似乎合理。
sentences.pinyin: Dān cóng chéngběn lái kàn, zhège juédìng sìhū hélǐ.
sentences.translation: Judging from cost alone, this decision seems reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 请把这张单保存好，月底还要作为参考。
sentences.traditional: 請把這張單保存好，月底還要作為參考。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng dān bǎocún hǎo, yuèdǐ hái yào zuòwéi cānkǎo.
sentences.translation: Please keep this form safe; it will still be needed as a reference at the end of the month.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题比较复杂，需要单独开会讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題比較複雜，需要單獨開會討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bǐjiào fùzá, xūyào dāndú kāihuì tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This issue is rather complicated and needs to be discussed separately in a meeting.

sentences.chinese: 因为资料涉及个人信息，报告要单独保存。
sentences.traditional: 因為資料涉及個人信息，報告要單獨保存。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi zīliào shèjí gèrén xìnxī, bàogào yào dāndú bǎocún.
sentences.translation: Because the materials involve personal information, the report must be stored separately.

sentences.chinese: 他不愿意单独承担责任，希望大家一起处理。
sentences.traditional: 他不願意單獨承擔責任，希望大家一起處理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì dāndú chéngdān zérèn, xīwàng dàjiā yìqǐ chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: He is unwilling to take responsibility alone and hopes everyone will deal with it together.

sentences.chinese: 她从去年开始担任项目负责人。
sentences.traditional: 她從去年開始擔任項目負責人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng qùnián kāishǐ dānrèn xiàngmù fùzérén.
sentences.translation: She began serving as the project lead last year.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家曾担任大学讲师，后来辞职专心创作。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家曾擔任大學講師，後來辭職專心創作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā céng dānrèn dàxué jiǎngshī, hòulái cízhí zhuānxīn chuàngzuò.
sentences.translation: This writer once worked as a university lecturer, then resigned to focus on writing.

sentences.chinese: 他经验丰富，适合担任这次大会的主持人。
sentences.traditional: 他經驗豐富，適合擔任這次大會的主持人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīngyàn fēngfù, shìhé dānrèn zhè cì dàhuì de zhǔchírén.
sentences.translation: He has rich experience and is suitable to serve as the host of this conference.

sentences.chinese: 这个课程的内容太单一，学生很难保持兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 這個課程的內容太單一，學生很難保持興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège kèchéng de nèiróng tài dānyī, xuésheng hěn nán bǎochí xìngqù.
sentences.translation: The content of this course is too one-dimensional, so it is hard for students to stay interested.

sentences.chinese: 不能只用单一标准判断一个人的能力。
sentences.traditional: 不能只用單一標準判斷一個人的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Bùnéng zhǐ yòng dānyī biāozhǔn pànduàn yí gè rén de nénglì.
sentences.translation: You cannot judge a person’s ability by only one single standard.

sentences.chinese: 产品失败的原因并不单一，而是由多个因素造成的。
sentences.traditional: 產品失敗的原因並不單一，而是由多個因素造成的。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn shībài de yuányīn bìng bù dānyī, ér shì yóu duō gè yīnsù zàochéng de.
sentences.translation: The reason the product failed is not singular; it was caused by several factors.

sentences.chinese: 这个单元讲的是传统节日和社会变化。
sentences.traditional: 這個單元講的是傳統節日和社會變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dānyuán jiǎng de shì chuántǒng jiérì hé shèhuì biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This unit is about traditional festivals and social change.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们完成第三单元的复习题。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們完成第三單元的複習題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen wánchéng dì sān dānyuán de fùxí tí.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to complete the review questions for Unit Three.

sentences.chinese: 每个单元后面都有一篇阅读材料。
sentences.traditional: 每個單元後面都有一篇閱讀材料。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè dānyuán hòumiàn dōu yǒu yì piān yuèdú cáiliào.
sentences.translation: There is a reading passage after each unit.

sentences.chinese: 他并不是胆小，只是做决定前会考虑得更全面。
sentences.traditional: 他並不是膽小，只是做決定前會考慮得更全面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bú shì dǎnxiǎo, zhǐshì zuò juédìng qián huì kǎolǜ de gèng quánmiàn.
sentences.translation: He is not timid; he just thinks more thoroughly before making decisions.

sentences.chinese: 小时候我很胆小，连一个人进黑房间都害怕。
sentences.traditional: 小時候我很膽小，連一個人進黑房間都害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou wǒ hěn dǎnxiǎo, lián yí gè rén jìn hēi fángjiān dōu hàipà.
sentences.translation: When I was young, I was very timid and was even afraid to enter a dark room alone.

sentences.chinese: 如果领导太胆小，团队就很难进行真正的创新。
sentences.traditional: 如果領導太膽小，團隊就很難進行真正的創新。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ lǐngdǎo tài dǎnxiǎo, tuánduì jiù hěn nán jìnxíng zhēnzhèng de chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: If a leader is too timid, it is hard for the team to carry out real innovation.

sentences.chinese: 这道汤味道有点淡，你可以再加一点盐。
sentences.traditional: 這道湯味道有點淡，你可以再加一點鹽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tāng wèidào yǒudiǎn dàn, nǐ kěyǐ zài jiā yìdiǎn yán.
sentences.translation: This soup tastes a little bland; you can add a bit more salt.

sentences.chinese: 经过几个月的冷处理，他们之间的矛盾慢慢淡了。
sentences.traditional: 經過幾個月的冷處理，他們之間的矛盾慢慢淡了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de lěng chǔlǐ, tāmen zhījiān de máodùn mànmàn dàn le.
sentences.translation: After several months of cooling things down, the conflict between them slowly faded.

sentences.chinese: 墙的颜色太淡，照片里几乎看不出来。
sentences.traditional: 牆的顏色太淡，照片裡幾乎看不出來。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng de yánsè tài dàn, zhàopiàn lǐ jīhū kàn bù chūlái.
sentences.translation: The colour of the wall is too light; it can hardly be seen in the photo.

sentences.chinese: 当地政府采取了新的措施来保护环境。
sentences.traditional: 當地政府採取了新的措施來保護環境。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le xīn de cuòshī lái bǎohù huánjìng.
sentences.translation: The local government has adopted new measures to protect the environment.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅使用当地的大米和蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳使用當地的大米和蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng shǐyòng dāngdì de dàmǐ hé shūcài.
sentences.translation: This restaurant uses local rice and vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 我们到达以后，先向当地人打听路线。
sentences.traditional: 我們到達以後，先向當地人打聽路線。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dàodá yǐhòu, xiān xiàng dāngdì rén dǎting lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: After we arrived, we first asked local people about the route.

sentences.chinese: 当年他离开家乡，是为了寻找更好的工作机会。
sentences.traditional: 當年他離開家鄉，是為了尋找更好的工作機會。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngnián tā líkāi jiāxiāng, shì wèile xúnzhǎo gèng hǎo de gōngzuò jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Back then, he left his hometown in order to look for better work opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 这座大厦在当年算是城市里最高的建筑之一。
sentences.traditional: 這座大廈在當年算是城市裡最高的建築之一。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàshà zài dāngnián suàn shì chéngshì lǐ zuì gāo de jiànzhù zhī yī.
sentences.translation: This building counted as one of the tallest buildings in the city back then.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷常说，当年的生活虽然艰苦，却让他学会了坚持。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺常說，當年的生活雖然艱苦，卻讓他學會了堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye cháng shuō, dāngnián de shēnghuó suīrán jiānkǔ, què ràng tā xuéhuì le jiānchí.
sentences.translation: Grandad often says that although life back then was hard, it taught him to persevere.

sentences.chinese: 当前最重要的任务是保证产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 當前最重要的任務是保證產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngqián zuì zhòngyào de rènwu shì bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The most important current task is to ensure product quality.

sentences.chinese: 面对当前的经济压力，公司必须控制成本。
sentences.traditional: 面對當前的經濟壓力，公司必須控制成本。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì dāngqián de jīngjì yālì, gōngsī bìxū kòngzhì chéngběn.
sentences.translation: Facing the current economic pressure, the company must control costs.

sentences.chinese: 当前政策对中小企业的发展很有利。
sentences.traditional: 當前政策對中小企業的發展很有利。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngqián zhèngcè duì zhōng xiǎo qǐyè de fāzhǎn hěn yǒulì.
sentences.translation: The current policy is very favourable for the development of small and medium-sized businesses.

sentences.chinese: 在这些建议当中，第三条最值得考虑。
sentences.traditional: 在這些建議當中，第三條最值得考慮。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèxiē jiànyì dāngzhōng, dì sān tiáo zuì zhídé kǎolǜ.
sentences.translation: Among these suggestions, the third one is most worth considering.

sentences.chinese: 会议当中，他一直保持沉默，没有表达意见。
sentences.traditional: 會議當中，他一直保持沉默，沒有表達意見。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì dāngzhōng, tā yìzhí bǎochí chénmò, méiyǒu biǎodá yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: During the meeting, he kept silent the whole time and did not express an opinion.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们当中，有几个已经能独立完成作业。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們當中，有幾個已經能獨立完成作業。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen dāngzhōng, yǒu jǐ gè yǐjīng néng dúlì wánchéng zuòyè.
sentences.translation: Among the children, a few can already complete their homework independently.

sentences.chinese: 请不要把车停在门口，挡住别人的路。
sentences.traditional: 請不要把車停在門口，擋住別人的路。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào bǎ chē tíng zài ménkǒu, dǎng zhù biérén de lù.
sentences.translation: Please do not park the car at the entrance and block other people’s way.

sentences.chinese: 雨太大了，伞几乎挡不住风。
sentences.traditional: 雨太大了，傘幾乎擋不住風。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tài dà le, sǎn jīhū dǎng bú zhù fēng.
sentences.translation: The rain is too heavy; the umbrella can hardly block the wind.

sentences.chinese: 他用手挡了一下强光，才看清前面的标志。
sentences.traditional: 他用手擋了一下強光，才看清前面的標誌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu dǎng le yí xià qiángguāng, cái kàn qīng qiánmiàn de biāozhì.
sentences.translation: He blocked the strong light with his hand for a moment before he could see the sign ahead clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这间房可以当临时办公室，先解决场所不足的问题。
sentences.traditional: 這間房可以當臨時辦公室，先解決場所不足的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiān fáng kěyǐ dàng línshí bàngōngshì, xiān jiějué chǎngsuǒ bùzú de wèntí.
sentences.translation: This room can serve as a temporary office to solve the shortage of space first.

sentences.chinese: 别把我的提醒当成批评，我只是想帮你避免错误。
sentences.traditional: 別把我的提醒當成批評，我只是想幫你避免錯誤。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ wǒ de tíxǐng dàng chéng pīpíng, wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng bāng nǐ bìmiǎn cuòwù.
sentences.translation: Do not take my reminder as criticism; I only want to help you avoid mistakes.

sentences.chinese: 他把这次失败当作一次宝贵的经验。
sentences.traditional: 他把這次失敗當作一次寶貴的經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè cì shībài dàng zuò yí cì bǎoguì de jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He treated this failure as a valuable experience.

sentences.chinese: 我们不能把一次失败当成永远无法改变的结果。
sentences.traditional: 我們不能把一次失敗當成永遠無法改變的結果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng bǎ yí cì shībài dàngchéng yǒngyuǎn wúfǎ gǎibiàn de jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: We must not treat one failure as a result that can never be changed.

sentences.chinese: 他把同事的建议当成对自己的批评，所以情绪很低落。
sentences.traditional: 他把同事的建議當成對自己的批評，所以情緒很低落。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ tóngshì de jiànyì dàngchéng duì zìjǐ de pīpíng, suǒyǐ qíngxù hěn dīluò.
sentences.translation: He treated his colleague’s suggestion as criticism of himself, so he felt very low.

sentences.chinese: 请把这份报告当成初步方案，后面还会继续修改。
sentences.traditional: 請把這份報告當成初步方案，後面還會繼續修改。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn bàogào dàngchéng chūbù fāng'àn, hòumiàn hái huì jìxù xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: Please treat this report as a preliminary plan; it will still be revised later.

sentences.chinese: 老师把这次讨论当作提高表达能力的机会。
sentences.traditional: 老師把這次討論當作提高表達能力的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zhè cì tǎolùn dàngzuò tígāo biǎodá nénglì de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: The teacher treated this discussion as an opportunity to improve expressive ability.

sentences.chinese: 他们把临时办公室当作新的创业基地。
sentences.traditional: 他們把臨時辦公室當作新的創業基地。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bǎ línshí bàngōngshì dàngzuò xīn de chuàngyè jīdì.
sentences.translation: They treated the temporary office as their new base for starting the business.

sentences.chinese: 不要把沉默当作同意，最好再向他确认一次。
sentences.traditional: 不要把沉默當作同意，最好再向他確認一次。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào bǎ chénmò dàngzuò tóngyì, zuìhǎo zài xiàng tā quèrèn yí cì.
sentences.translation: Do not treat silence as agreement; it is best to confirm with him again.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，路边的一棵树倒了，挡住了车辆。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，路邊的一棵樹倒了，擋住了車輛。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guò hòu, lùbiān de yì kē shù dǎo le, dǎng zhù le chēliàng.
sentences.translation: After the rainstorm, a tree by the road fell and blocked the vehicles.

sentences.chinese: 他累得差点倒在地上，幸好同事及时扶住了他。
sentences.traditional: 他累得差點倒在地上，幸好同事及時扶住了他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lèi de chàdiǎn dǎo zài dì shang, xìnghǎo tóngshì jíshí fú zhù le tā.
sentences.translation: He was so tired that he nearly fell to the ground, but luckily his colleague supported him in time.

sentences.chinese: 如果这堵墙真的倒了，旁边的车库也会受影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果這堵牆真的倒了，旁邊的車庫也會受影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhè dǔ qiáng zhēn de dǎo le, pángbiān de chēkù yě huì shòu yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If this wall really collapses, the garage beside it will also be affected.

sentences.chinese: 这位导演的作品常常反映普通人的生活压力。
sentences.traditional: 這位導演的作品常常反映普通人的生活壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi dǎoyǎn de zuòpǐn chángcháng fǎnyìng pǔtōng rén de shēnghuó yālì.
sentences.translation: This director’s works often reflect the pressures of ordinary people’s lives.

sentences.chinese: 她第一次导演纪录片，就获得了很高的评价。
sentences.traditional: 她第一次導演紀錄片，就獲得了很高的評價。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì dǎoyǎn jìlùpiàn, jiù huòdé le hěn gāo de píngjià.
sentences.translation: The first time she directed a documentary, she received very high praise.

sentences.chinese: 电影结束后，导演亲自向观众解释创作背景。
sentences.traditional: 電影結束後，導演親自向觀眾解釋創作背景。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng jiéshù hòu, dǎoyǎn qīnzì xiàng guānzhòng jiěshì chuàngzuò bèijǐng.
sentences.translation: After the film ended, the director personally explained the creative background to the audience.

sentences.chinese: 长期熬夜可能导致记忆力下降和情绪不稳定。
sentences.traditional: 長期熬夜可能導致記憶力下降和情緒不穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī áoyè kěnéng dǎozhì jìyìlì xiàjiàng hé qíngxù bù wěndìng.
sentences.translation: Long-term staying up late may cause memory decline and unstable emotions.

sentences.chinese: 沟通不足导致双方产生了很大的误会。
sentences.traditional: 溝通不足導致雙方產生了很大的誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Gōutōng bùzú dǎozhì shuāngfāng chǎnshēng le hěn dà de wùhuì.
sentences.translation: Insufficient communication led to a major misunderstanding between the two sides.

sentences.chinese: 如果不及时处理，小问题也可能导致严重后果。
sentences.traditional: 如果不及時處理，小問題也可能導致嚴重後果。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí chǔlǐ, xiǎo wèntí yě kěnéng dǎozhì yánzhòng hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: If they are not handled in time, small problems may also lead to serious consequences.

sentences.chinese: 代表团预计傍晚到达机场，然后直接去酒店报到。
sentences.traditional: 代表團預計傍晚到達機場，然後直接去酒店報到。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán yùjì bàngwǎn dàodá jīchǎng, ránhòu zhíjiē qù jiǔdiàn bàodào.
sentences.translation: The delegation is expected to arrive at the airport in the evening and then go directly to the hotel to check in.

sentences.chinese: 货物已经到达本地仓库，明天可以安排配送。
sentences.traditional: 貨物已經到達本地倉庫，明天可以安排配送。
sentences.pinyin: Huòwù yǐjīng dàodá běndì cāngkù, míngtiān kěyǐ ānpái pèisòng.
sentences.translation: The goods have already arrived at the local warehouse, and delivery can be arranged tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 只有到达一定程度，技术创新才会产生明显作用。
sentences.traditional: 只有到達一定程度，技術創新才會產生明顯作用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu dàodá yí dìng chéngdù, jìshù chuàngxīn cái huì chǎnshēng míngxiǎn zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Only after it reaches a certain level will technological innovation have an obvious effect.

sentences.chinese: 这个道理看似简单，但真正做到并不容易。
sentences.traditional: 這個道理看似簡單，但真正做到並不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dàolǐ kàn sì jiǎndān, dàn zhēnzhèng zuò dào bìng bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: This principle seems simple, but actually doing it is not easy.

sentences.chinese: 他讲了很多道理，却没有提出具体措施。
sentences.traditional: 他講了很多道理，卻沒有提出具體措施。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎng le hěn duō dàolǐ, què méiyǒu tíchū jùtǐ cuòshī.
sentences.translation: He talked about many principles, but did not put forward any specific measures.

sentences.chinese: 孩子虽然年纪小，但已经明白公平的道理。
sentences.traditional: 孩子雖然年紀小，但已經明白公平的道理。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dàn yǐjīng míngbai gōngpíng de dàolǐ.
sentences.translation: Although the child is young, he already understands the principle of fairness.

sentences.chinese: 我的身份证下个月到期，需要提前申请新的。
sentences.traditional: 我的身份證下個月到期，需要提前申請新的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shēnfènzhèng xià ge yuè dàoqī, xūyào tíqián shēnqǐng xīn de.
sentences.translation: My ID card expires next month, so I need to apply for a new one in advance.

sentences.chinese: 合同到期以后，双方可以重新商量待遇。
sentences.traditional: 合同到期以後，雙方可以重新商量待遇。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong dàoqī yǐhòu, shuāngfāng kěyǐ chóngxīn shāngliang dàiyù.
sentences.translation: After the contract expires, both sides can discuss the terms again.

sentences.chinese: 这批产品的保质期快到期了，必须尽快处理。
sentences.traditional: 這批產品的保質期快到期了，必須盡快處理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī chǎnpǐn de bǎozhìqī kuài dàoqī le, bìxū jǐnkuài chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: The shelf life of this batch of products is about to expire, so they must be dealt with quickly.

sentences.chinese: 乘客登机前，必须系好安全带并关闭手机。
sentences.traditional: 乘客登機前，必須繫好安全帶並關閉手機。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngkè dēngjī qián, bìxū jì hǎo ānquándài bìng guānbì shǒujī.
sentences.translation: Before boarding, passengers must fasten their seatbelts and turn off their phones.

sentences.chinese: 他终于登上山顶，看到了远处的城区。
sentences.traditional: 他終於登上山頂，看到了遠處的城區。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú dēng shàng shāndǐng, kàn dào le yuǎn chù de chéngqū.
sentences.translation: He finally climbed to the top of the mountain and saw the urban area in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 请先登录系统，再按照程序提交报告。
sentences.traditional: 請先登錄系統，再按照程序提交報告。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān dēnglù xìtǒng, zài ànzhào chéngxù tíjiāo bàogào.
sentences.translation: Please log into the system first, then submit the report according to the procedure.

sentences.chinese: 舞台上的灯光太强，观众几乎看不清演员的表情。
sentences.traditional: 舞臺上的燈光太強，觀眾幾乎看不清演員的表情。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔtái shang de dēngguāng tài qiáng, guānzhòng jīhū kàn bù qīng yǎnyuán de biǎoqíng.
sentences.translation: The lights on the stage were too strong, and the audience could hardly see the actors’ expressions clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的灯光很暗，反而让气氛更安静。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的燈光很暗，反而讓氣氛更安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de dēngguāng hěn àn, fǎn'ér ràng qìfēn gèng ānjìng.
sentences.translation: The lighting in this restaurant is quite dim, which instead makes the atmosphere calmer.

sentences.chinese: 夜里开车时，合适的灯光能提高安全性。
sentences.traditional: 夜裡開車時，合適的燈光能提高安全性。
sentences.pinyin: Yèli kāichē shí, héshì de dēngguāng néng tígāo ānquánxìng.
sentences.translation: When driving at night, suitable lighting can improve safety.

sentences.chinese: 所有参会人员到达会场后，都需要先登记身份信息。
sentences.traditional: 所有參會人員到達會場後，都需要先登記身份信息。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu cānhuì rényuán dàodá huìchǎng hòu, dōu xūyào xiān dēngjì shēnfèn xìnxī.
sentences.translation: After all participants arrive at the venue, they need to register their identity information first.

sentences.chinese: 系统会自动登记每一次操作，方便以后检查。
sentences.traditional: 系統會自動登記每一次操作，方便以後檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng dēngjì měi yí cì cāozuò, fāngbiàn yǐhòu jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The system will automatically record each operation, making later checks convenient.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有提前登记，游客可能无法进入博物馆。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有提前登記，遊客可能無法進入博物館。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu tíqián dēngjì, yóukè kěnéng wúfǎ jìnrù bówùguǎn.
sentences.translation: If they have not registered in advance, visitors may not be able to enter the museum.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护账户安全，登录时必须输入验证码。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護帳戶安全，登錄時必須輸入驗證碼。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù zhànghù ānquán, dēnglù shí bìxū shūrù yànzhèngmǎ.
sentences.translation: To protect account security, you must enter a verification code when logging in.

sentences.chinese: 他连续输错密码，结果暂时无法登录系统。
sentences.traditional: 他連續輸錯密碼，結果暫時無法登錄系統。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liánxù shū cuò mìmǎ, jiéguǒ zànshí wúfǎ dēnglù xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: He entered the wrong password several times in a row, so as a result he temporarily could not log into the system.

sentences.chinese: 登录平台以后，你可以查看订单状态和支付记录。
sentences.traditional: 登錄平臺以後，你可以查看訂單狀態和支付記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Dēnglù píngtái yǐhòu, nǐ kěyǐ chákàn dìngdān zhuàngtài hé zhīfù jìlù.
sentences.translation: After logging into the platform, you can check order status and payment records.

sentences.chinese: 在结果公布之前，我们只能耐心等待进一步通知。
sentences.traditional: 在結果公佈之前，我們只能耐心等待進一步通知。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jiéguǒ gōngbù zhīqián, wǒmen zhǐ néng nàixīn děngdài jìn yí bù tōngzhī.
sentences.translation: Before the results are announced, we can only wait patiently for further notice.

sentences.chinese: 他没有抱怨，只是在门口安静地等待处理结果。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有抱怨，只是在門口安靜地等待處理結果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu bàoyuàn, zhǐshì zài ménkǒu ānjìng de děngdài chǔlǐ jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: He did not complain; he just quietly waited at the door for the result of the handling.

sentences.chinese: 机会不会一直等待没有准备的人。
sentences.traditional: 機會不會一直等待沒有準備的人。
sentences.pinyin: Jīhuì bú huì yìzhí děngdài méiyǒu zhǔnbèi de rén.
sentences.translation: Opportunity will not keep waiting for people who are not prepared.

sentences.chinese: 请在病房外等候，医生会尽快向家属说明病情。
sentences.traditional: 請在病房外等候，醫生會盡快向家屬說明病情。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài bìngfáng wài děnghòu, yīshēng huì jǐnkuài xiàng jiāshǔ shuōmíng bìngqíng.
sentences.translation: Please wait outside the ward; the doctor will explain the patient’s condition to the family as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 乘客正在车厢门口等候列车员的安排。
sentences.traditional: 乘客正在車廂門口等候列車員的安排。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngkè zhèngzài chēxiāng ménkǒu děnghòu lièchēyuán de ānpái.
sentences.translation: Passengers are waiting at the carriage door for the train attendant’s arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 由于暴雨，很多车辆只能在高速入口等候放行。
sentences.traditional: 由於暴雨，很多車輛只能在高速入口等候放行。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú bàoyǔ, hěnduō chēliàng zhǐ néng zài gāosù rùkǒu děnghòu fàngxíng.
sentences.translation: Because of the rainstorm, many vehicles can only wait at the motorway entrance to be allowed through.

sentences.chinese: 二加三等于五，这是最基本的数学常识。
sentences.traditional: 二加三等於五，這是最基本的數學常識。
sentences.pinyin: Èr jiā sān děngyú wǔ, zhè shì zuì jīběn de shùxué chángshí.
sentences.translation: Two plus three equals five; this is the most basic mathematical common knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 工作时间长并不等于效率高，关键还要看成果。
sentences.traditional: 工作時間長並不等於效率高，關鍵還要看成果。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngzuò shíjiān cháng bìng bù děngyú xiàolǜ gāo, guānjiàn hái yào kàn chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Long working hours do not equal high efficiency; the key is still to look at the results.

sentences.chinese: 如果成本大于收入，就等于做一笔亏本生意。
sentences.traditional: 如果成本大於收入，就等於做一筆虧本生意。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chéngběn dàyú shōurù, jiù děngyú zuò yì bǐ kuīběn shēngyì.
sentences.translation: If the cost is greater than the income, it is equal to doing a loss-making deal.

sentences.chinese: 他听完批评后低头沉默了很久。
sentences.traditional: 他聽完批評後低頭沉默了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng wán pīpíng hòu dītóu chénmò le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.translation: After hearing the criticism, he lowered his head and stayed silent for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 过马路时不要一直低头看手机，以免发生车祸。
sentences.traditional: 過馬路時不要一直低頭看手機，以免發生車禍。
sentences.pinyin: Guò mǎlù shí bú yào yìzhí dītóu kàn shǒujī, yǐmiǎn fāshēng chēhuò.
sentences.translation: When crossing the road, do not keep looking down at your phone, to avoid a traffic accident.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难，他没有低头，而是大胆提出了新的做法。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難，他沒有低頭，而是大膽提出了新的做法。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan, tā méiyǒu dītóu, ér shì dàdǎn tíchū le xīn de zuòfǎ.
