sentences.translation: Faced with difficulties, he did not bow his head, but boldly put forward a new approach.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案的确比原来的做法更便利。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案的確比原來的做法更便利。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn díquè bǐ yuánlái de zuòfǎ gèng biànlì.
sentences.translation: This plan is indeed more convenient than the original approach.

sentences.chinese: 他的报告的确很详细，但标题不够清楚。
sentences.traditional: 他的報告的確很詳細，但標題不夠清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de bàogào díquè hěn xiángxì, dàn biāotí bú gòu qīngchu.
sentences.translation: His report is indeed very detailed, but the title is not clear enough.

sentences.chinese: 这次改革的确带来了变化，不过效果还需要继续观察。
sentences.traditional: 這次改革的確帶來了變化，不過效果還需要繼續觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gǎigé díquè dàilái le biànhuà, búguò xiàoguǒ hái xūyào jìxù guānchá.
sentences.translation: This reform has indeed brought changes, but the effect still needs continued observation.

sentences.chinese: 在这部小说里，真正的敌人不是别人，而是主人公自己的恐惧。
sentences.traditional: 在這部小說裡，真正的敵人不是別人，而是主人公自己的恐懼。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè bù xiǎoshuō lǐ, zhēnzhèng de dírén bú shì biérén, ér shì zhǔréngōng zìjǐ de kǒngjù.
sentences.translation: In this novel, the real enemy is not another person, but the main character’s own fear.

sentences.chinese: 面对共同的敌人，各个部落暂时放下了彼此的差别。
sentences.traditional: 面對共同的敵人，各個部落暫時放下了彼此的差別。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì gòngtóng de dírén, gè ge bùluò zànshí fàngxià le bǐcǐ de chābié.
sentences.translation: Faced with a common enemy, the various tribes temporarily put aside their differences.

sentences.chinese: 这场战争的目的不是消灭敌人，而是保护普通百姓的生命。
sentences.traditional: 這場戰爭的目的不是消滅敵人，而是保護普通百姓的生命。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhànzhēng de mùdì bú shì xiāomiè dírén, ér shì bǎohù pǔtōng bǎixìng de shēngmìng.
sentences.translation: The purpose of this war is not to destroy the enemy, but to protect the lives of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 请把这份申请表递给前台工作人员。
sentences.traditional: 請把這份申請表遞給前臺工作人員。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn shēnqǐngbiǎo dì gěi qiántái gōngzuò rényuán.
sentences.translation: Please hand this application form to the front desk staff.

sentences.chinese: 他没有说话，只是递过来一张写着地址的纸。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有說話，只是遞過來一張寫著地址的紙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shuōhuà, zhǐshì dì guòlái yì zhāng xiězhe dìzhǐ de zhǐ.
sentences.translation: He did not speak; he just passed over a piece of paper with an address written on it.

sentences.chinese: 服务员把菜单递给客人，并耐心介绍特色菜。
sentences.traditional: 服務員把菜單遞給客人，並耐心介紹特色菜。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán bǎ càidān dì gěi kèrén, bìng nàixīn jièshào tèsècài.
sentences.translation: The waiter handed the menu to the guest and patiently introduced the speciality dishes.

sentences.chinese: 学好地理有助于我们理解气候和人口分布。
sentences.traditional: 學好地理有助於我們理解氣候和人口分布。
sentences.pinyin: Xué hǎo dìlǐ yǒuzhù yú wǒmen lǐjiě qìhòu hé rénkǒu fēnbù.
sentences.translation: Learning geography well helps us understand climate and population distribution.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的地理位置十分重要，适合发展物流产业。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的地理位置十分重要，適合發展物流產業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de dìlǐ wèizhi shífēn zhòngyào, shìhé fāzhǎn wùliú chǎnyè.
sentences.translation: This city’s geographical location is very important and suitable for developing the logistics industry.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们根据地图分析当地的地理特点。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們根據地圖分析當地的地理特點。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen gēnjù dìtú fēnxī dāngdì de dìlǐ tèdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to analyse the local geographical features according to the map.

sentences.chinese: 雨停以后，地面仍然很滑，行人经过时要小心。
sentences.traditional: 雨停以後，地面仍然很滑，行人經過時要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tíng yǐhòu, dìmiàn réngrán hěn huá, xíngrén jīngguò shí yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: After the rain stopped, the ground was still slippery, so pedestrians should be careful when passing by.

sentences.chinese: 工人先把地面清理干净，再开始安装新的设备。
sentences.traditional: 工人先把地面清理乾淨，再開始安裝新的設備。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén xiān bǎ dìmiàn qīnglǐ gānjìng, zài kāishǐ ānzhuāng xīn de shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The workers first cleaned the floor, then began installing the new equipment.

sentences.chinese: 飞机接近地面时，乘务员提醒乘客系好安全带。
sentences.traditional: 飛機接近地面時，乘務員提醒乘客繫好安全帶。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī jiējìn dìmiàn shí, chéngwùyuán tíxǐng chéngkè jì hǎo ānquándài.
sentences.translation: When the plane approached the ground, the attendant reminded passengers to fasten their seatbelts.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区的经济发展很快，吸引了大批年轻人来创业。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區的經濟發展很快，吸引了大批年輕人來創業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de jīngjì fāzhǎn hěn kuài, xīyǐn le dàpī niánqīng rén lái chuàngyè.
sentences.translation: This region’s economy is developing quickly, attracting large numbers of young people to start businesses.

sentences.chinese: 不同地区的饮食习惯差别很大，不能用单一标准来判断。
sentences.traditional: 不同地區的飲食習慣差別很大，不能用單一標準來判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng dìqū de yǐnshí xíguàn chābié hěn dà, bù néng yòng dānyī biāozhǔn lái pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Eating habits vary greatly between different regions, so they cannot be judged by a single standard.

sentences.chinese: 政府采取措施，改善偏远地区的交通条件。
sentences.traditional: 政府採取措施，改善偏遠地區的交通條件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ cuòshī, gǎishàn piānyuǎn dìqū de jiāotōng tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: The government has taken measures to improve transport conditions in remote areas.

sentences.chinese: 随着产品质量提高，公司在市场上的地位也越来越稳定。
sentences.traditional: 隨著產品質量提高，公司在市場上的地位也越來越穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe chǎnpǐn zhìliàng tígāo, gōngsī zài shìchǎng shang de dìwèi yě yuèláiyuè wěndìng.
sentences.translation: As product quality improves, the company’s position in the market is becoming more and more stable.

sentences.chinese: 教育在个人成长中具有非常重要的地位。
sentences.traditional: 教育在個人成長中具有非常重要的地位。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù zài gèrén chéngzhǎng zhōng jùyǒu fēicháng zhòngyào de dìwèi.
sentences.translation: Education has a very important position in personal growth.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家的作品使他在现代文学中占有特殊地位。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家的作品使他在現代文學中佔有特殊地位。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de zuòpǐn shǐ tā zài xiàndài wénxué zhōng zhànyǒu tèshū dìwèi.
sentences.translation: This writer’s works give him a special position in modern literature.

sentences.chinese: 这座大厦的地下有两层车库，能够停放上百辆车。
sentences.traditional: 這座大廈的地下有兩層車庫，能夠停放上百輛車。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàshà de dìxià yǒu liǎng céng chēkù, nénggòu tíngfàng shàng bǎi liàng chē.
sentences.translation: There are two levels of underground garage beneath this building, able to park over a hundred cars.

sentences.chinese: 地震发生后，部分地下管道受到了严重破坏。
sentences.traditional: 地震發生後，部分地下管道受到了嚴重破壞。
sentences.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng hòu, bùfen dìxià guǎndào shòudào le yánzhòng pòhuài.
sentences.translation: After the earthquake, some underground pipes were seriously damaged.

sentences.chinese: 这个博物馆把重要文物保存在地下展厅里。
sentences.traditional: 這個博物館把重要文物保存在地下展廳裡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bówùguǎn bǎ zhòngyào wénwù bǎocún zài dìxià zhǎntīng lǐ.
sentences.translation: This museum preserves important cultural relics in an underground exhibition hall.

sentences.chinese: 昨晚地震时，很多人立刻从楼里跑到了空地上。
sentences.traditional: 昨晚地震時，很多人立刻從樓裡跑到了空地上。
sentences.pinyin: Zuówǎn dìzhèn shí, hěnduō rén lìkè cóng lóu lǐ pǎo dào le kòngdì shang.
sentences.translation: During the earthquake last night, many people immediately ran from the building to an open space.

sentences.chinese: 学校定期进行地震演练，以提高学生的安全意识。
sentences.traditional: 學校定期進行地震演練，以提高學生的安全意識。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào dìngqī jìnxíng dìzhèn yǎnliàn, yǐ tígāo xuéshēng de ānquán yìshí.
sentences.translation: The school regularly holds earthquake drills to improve students’ safety awareness.

sentences.chinese: 如果发生地震，首先要保持冷静，避免乘坐电梯。
sentences.traditional: 如果發生地震，首先要保持冷靜，避免乘坐電梯。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāshēng dìzhèn, shǒuxiān yào bǎochí lěngjìng, bìmiǎn chéngzuò diàntī.
sentences.translation: If an earthquake occurs, first keep calm and avoid taking the lift.

sentences.chinese: 会议中间休息时，主办方准备了茶和几种点心。
sentences.traditional: 會議中間休息時，主辦方準備了茶和幾種點心。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì zhōngjiān xiūxi shí, zhǔbànfāng zhǔnbèi le chá hé jǐ zhǒng diǎnxin.
sentences.translation: During the break in the middle of the meeting, the organiser prepared tea and several kinds of snacks.

sentences.chinese: 这种点心虽然包装普通，但味道很有当地特色。
sentences.traditional: 這種點心雖然包裝普通，但味道很有當地特色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng diǎnxin suīrán bāozhuāng pǔtōng, dàn wèidào hěn yǒu dāngdì tèsè.
sentences.translation: Although this snack has ordinary packaging, its flavour is very local.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他少吃太甜的点心，以免影响身体恢复。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他少吃太甜的點心，以免影響身體恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā shǎo chī tài tián de diǎnxin, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng shēntǐ huīfù.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him to eat fewer sweet snacks, to avoid affecting his recovery.

sentences.chinese: 这篇报道发布后，很多网友纷纷点赞并留言支持。
sentences.traditional: 這篇報道發布後，很多網友紛紛點讚並留言支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān bàodào fābù hòu, hěnduō wǎngyǒu fēnfēn diǎnzàn bìng liúyán zhīchí.
sentences.translation: After this report was published, many netizens liked it and left comments of support.

sentences.chinese: 如果你觉得这个视频有帮助，别忘了给作者点赞。
sentences.traditional: 如果你覺得這個視頻有幫助，別忘了給作者點讚。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ juéde zhège shìpín yǒu bāngzhù, bié wàng le gěi zuòzhě diǎnzàn.
sentences.translation: If you think this video is helpful, do not forget to like it for the creator.

sentences.chinese: 他不是为了获得点赞才参加公益活动的。
sentences.traditional: 他不是為了獲得點讚才參加公益活動的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì wèile huòdé diǎnzàn cái cānjiā gōngyì huódòng de.
sentences.translation: He did not take part in the public welfare activity just to get likes.

sentences.chinese: 这部手机的电池老化了，充满电后也用不了多久。
sentences.traditional: 這部手機的電池老化了，充滿電後也用不了多久。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù shǒujī de diànchí lǎohuà le, chōng mǎn diàn hòu yě yòng bù liǎo duōjiǔ.
sentences.translation: This phone’s battery has aged; even after being fully charged, it cannot be used for long.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护环境，用过的电池应该统一回收处理。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護環境，用過的電池應該統一回收處理。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù huánjìng, yòng guò de diànchí yīnggāi tǒngyī huíshōu chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: To protect the environment, used batteries should be collected and processed together.

sentences.chinese: 这辆电动车更换了新电池后，行驶距离明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 這輛電動車更換了新電池後，行駛距離明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng diàndòng chē gēnghuàn le xīn diànchí hòu, xíngshǐ jùlí míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: After this electric vehicle had its battery replaced, its driving range clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 电动汽车的发展正在改变传统汽车产业的结构。
sentences.traditional: 電動汽車的發展正在改變傳統汽車產業的結構。
sentences.pinyin: Diàndòng qìchē de fāzhǎn zhèngzài gǎibiàn chuántǒng qìchē chǎnyè de jiégòu.
sentences.translation: The development of electric cars is changing the structure of the traditional car industry.

sentences.chinese: 这把电动牙刷虽然价格高，但清洁效果的确不错。
sentences.traditional: 這把電動牙刷雖然價格高，但清潔效果的確不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ diàndòng yáshuā suīrán jiàgé gāo, dàn qīngjié xiàoguǒ díquè búcuò.
sentences.translation: Although this electric toothbrush is expensive, its cleaning effect is indeed good.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定采用电动叉车，以减少仓库里的噪音和废气。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定採用電動叉車，以減少倉庫裡的噪音和廢氣。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng cǎiyòng diàndòng chāchē, yǐ jiǎnshǎo cāngkù lǐ de zàoyīn hé fèiqì.
sentences.translation: The company decided to use electric forklifts to reduce noise and exhaust in the warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 购买电器时，除了价格，还要注意使用说明和售后服务。
sentences.traditional: 購買電器時，除了價格，還要注意使用說明和售後服務。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi diànqì shí, chúle jiàgé, hái yào zhùyì shǐyòng shuōmíng hé shòuhòu fúwù.
sentences.translation: When buying electrical appliances, apart from price, you should also pay attention to the instructions and after-sales service.

sentences.chinese: 这些旧电器如果处理不当，可能会造成环境污染。
sentences.traditional: 這些舊電器如果處理不當，可能會造成環境污染。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiù diànqì rúguǒ chǔlǐ bú dàng, kěnéng huì zàochéng huánjìng wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: If these old electrical appliances are not handled properly, they may cause environmental pollution.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，家里的电器要先检查安全，再重新通电。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，家裡的電器要先檢查安全，再重新通電。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guò hòu, jiā lǐ de diànqì yào xiān jiǎnchá ānquán, zài chóngxīn tōngdiàn.
sentences.translation: After the rainstorm, the electrical appliances at home should be checked for safety before the power is turned on again.

sentences.chinese: 电商平台的促销活动虽然吸引顾客，但也增加了物流压力。
sentences.traditional: 電商平臺的促銷活動雖然吸引顧客，但也增加了物流壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Diànshāng píngtái de cùxiāo huódòng suīrán xīyǐn gùkè, dàn yě zēngjiā le wùliú yālì.
sentences.translation: The promotions on e-commerce platforms attract customers, but also increase logistics pressure.

sentences.chinese: 很多小企业通过电商把本地产品卖到全国各地。
sentences.traditional: 很多小企業通過電商把本地產品賣到全國各地。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō xiǎo qǐyè tōngguò diànshāng bǎ běndì chǎnpǐn mài dào quánguó gèdì.
sentences.translation: E-commerce enables many small businesses to sell local products throughout the country.

sentences.chinese: 随着电商的发展，传统商店也不得不调整服务方式。
sentences.traditional: 隨著電商的發展，傳統商店也不得不調整服務方式。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe diànshāng de fāzhǎn, chuántǒng shāngdiàn yě bùdébù tiáozhěng fúwù fāngshì.
sentences.translation: With the development of e-commerce, traditional shops have also had to adjust their service methods.

sentences.chinese: 这家电视台正在制作一档关于环境保护的节目。
sentences.traditional: 這家電視臺正在製作一檔關於環境保護的節目。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànshìtái zhèngzài zhìzuò yì dàng guānyú huánjìng bǎohù de jiémù.
sentences.translation: This television station is producing a programme about environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，电视台立刻派记者到现场采访。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，電視臺立刻派記者到現場採訪。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, diànshìtái lìkè pài jìzhě dào xiànchǎng cǎifǎng.
sentences.translation: After the accident happened, the TV station immediately sent reporters to interview people at the scene.

sentences.chinese: 他在电视台工作多年，对新闻报道的程序非常熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 他在電視臺工作多年，對新聞報導的程序非常熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài diànshìtái gōngzuò duō nián, duì xīnwén bàodào de chéngxù fēicháng shúxī.
sentences.translation: He has worked at a television station for many years and is very familiar with the news reporting process.

sentences.chinese: 纸质文件容易丢失，电子版保存起来更方便。
sentences.traditional: 紙質文件容易丟失，電子版保存起來更方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐzhì wénjiàn róngyì diūshī, diànzǐbǎn bǎocún qǐlai gèng fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: Paper documents are easy to lose; electronic versions are easier to save.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，秘书会把报告的电子版发给所有成员。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，秘書會把報告的電子版發給所有成員。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, mìshū huì bǎ bàogào de diànzǐbǎn fā gěi suǒyǒu chéngyuán.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ends, the secretary will send the electronic version of the report to all members.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的电子版价格较低，但不能随便传播。
sentences.traditional: 這本書的電子版價格較低，但不能隨便傳播。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de diànzǐbǎn jiàgé jiào dī, dàn bù néng suíbiàn chuánbō.
sentences.translation: The electronic version of this book is cheaper, but it must not be shared casually.

sentences.chinese: 总部决定把他调到本地工厂，负责新产品的测试。
sentences.traditional: 總部決定把他調到本地工廠，負責新產品的測試。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒngbù juédìng bǎ tā diào dào běndì gōngchǎng, fùzé xīn chǎnpǐn de cèshì.
sentences.translation: Head office decided to transfer him to the local factory to be responsible for testing the new product.

sentences.chinese: 这台设备的参数还没调好，所以测试结果不稳定。
sentences.traditional: 這臺設備的參數還沒調好，所以測試結果不穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái shèbèi de cānshù hái méi diào hǎo, suǒyǐ cèshì jiéguǒ bù wěndìng.
sentences.translation: The settings on this piece of equipment have not been adjusted properly, so the test results are unstable.

sentences.chinese: 如果工作安排不合理，经理可以临时调人支援。
sentences.traditional: 如果工作安排不合理，經理可以臨時調人支援。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ gōngzuò ānpái bù hélǐ, jīnglǐ kěyǐ línshí diào rén zhīyuán.
sentences.translation: If the work arrangements are unreasonable, the manager can temporarily move staff to provide support.

sentences.chinese: 公司先进行了市场调研，才决定是否推出这款产品。
sentences.traditional: 公司先進行了市場調研，才決定是否推出這款產品。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xiān jìnxíng le shìchǎng diàoyán, cái juédìng shìfǒu tuīchū zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: The company conducted market research before deciding whether to launch this product.

sentences.chinese: 这份调研报告表明，年轻消费者更重视环保包装。
sentences.traditional: 這份調研報告表明，年輕消費者更重視環保包裝。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn diàoyán bàogào biǎomíng, niánqīng xiāofèizhě gèng zhòngshì huánbǎo bāozhuāng.
sentences.translation: This research report shows that young consumers place more importance on environmentally friendly packaging.

sentences.chinese: 为了了解当地需求，团队连续调研了三个月。
sentences.traditional: 為了了解當地需求，團隊連續調研了三個月。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile liǎojiě dāngdì xūqiú, tuánduì liánxù diàoyán le sān ge yuè.
sentences.translation: To understand local demand, the team carried out research continuously for three months.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他定期检查血压，避免病情恶化。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他定期檢查血壓，避免病情惡化。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā dìngqī jiǎnchá xuèyā, bìmiǎn bìngqíng èhuà.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to check his blood pressure regularly to avoid the illness worsening.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司会定期培训员工，以提高服务质量。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司會定期培訓員工，以提高服務質量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī huì dìngqī péixùn yuángōng, yǐ tígāo fúwù zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: This company regularly trains its staff in order to improve service quality.

sentences.chinese: 定期整理文件可以减少丢失重要资料的风险。
sentences.traditional: 定期整理文件可以減少丟失重要資料的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Dìngqī zhěnglǐ wénjiàn kěyǐ jiǎnshǎo diūshī zhòngyào zīliào de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Regularly organising files can reduce the risk of losing important materials.

sentences.chinese: 身份证丢失后，他立刻报警并申请补办。
sentences.traditional: 身分證丟失後，他立刻報警並申請補辦。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnfènzhèng diūshī hòu, tā lìkè bàojǐng bìng shēnqǐng bǔbàn.
sentences.translation: After his ID card was lost, he immediately reported it to the police and applied for a replacement.

sentences.chinese: 如果客户资料丢失，公司必须承担相应责任。
sentences.traditional: 如果客戶資料丟失，公司必須承擔相應責任。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kèhù zīliào diūshī, gōngsī bìxū chéngdān xiāngyìng zérèn.
sentences.translation: If customer data is lost, the company must bear the corresponding responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 他把包裹单号保存好，以免快递信息丢失。
sentences.traditional: 他把包裹單號保存好，以免快遞信息丟失。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ bāoguǒ dānhào bǎocún hǎo, yǐmiǎn kuàidì xìnxī diūshī.
sentences.translation: He saved the parcel tracking number to avoid the delivery information being lost.

sentences.chinese: 天气太冷，地面都冻住了，步行时要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太冷，地面都凍住了，步行時要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài lěng, dìmiàn dōu dòng zhù le, bùxíng shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: The weather is so cold that the ground has frozen, so be very careful when walking.

sentences.chinese: 这些蔬菜如果不及时处理，就会被冻坏。
sentences.traditional: 這些蔬菜如果不及時處理，就會被凍壞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shūcài rúguǒ bù jíshí chǔlǐ, jiù huì bèi dòng huài.
sentences.translation: If these vegetables are not dealt with in time, they will be damaged by freezing.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈把剩下的饺子冻起来，留到下周再吃。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽把剩下的餃子凍起來，留到下週再吃。
sentences.pinyin: Māmā bǎ shèngxià de jiǎozi dòng qǐlai, liú dào xià zhōu zài chī.
sentences.translation: Mum froze the remaining dumplings and kept them to eat next week.

sentences.chinese: 墙上有个洞，冷风一直从那里吹进来。
sentences.traditional: 牆上有個洞，冷風一直從那裡吹進來。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shang yǒu ge dòng, lěng fēng yìzhí cóng nàlǐ chuī jìnlai.
sentences.translation: There is a hole in the wall, and cold wind keeps blowing in from there.

sentences.chinese: 科学家在山里发现了一个很深的洞，暂时禁止游客进入。
sentences.traditional: 科學家在山裡發現了一個很深的洞，暫時禁止遊客進入。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zài shān lǐ fāxiàn le yí ge hěn shēn de dòng, zànshí jìnzhǐ yóukè jìnrù.
sentences.translation: Scientists discovered a very deep cave in the mountains and temporarily banned tourists from entering.

sentences.chinese: 这条地下通道中间塌了一个洞，维修人员正在处理。
sentences.traditional: 這條地下通道中間塌了一個洞，維修人員正在處理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dìxià tōngdào zhōngjiān tā le yí ge dòng, wéixiū rényuán zhèngzài chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: A hole collapsed in the middle of this underground passage, and maintenance staff are dealing with it.

sentences.chinese: 这部动画虽然面向儿童，却包含了很深的人生道理。
sentences.traditional: 這部動畫雖然面向兒童，卻包含了很深的人生道理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù dònghuà suīrán miànxiàng értóng, què bāohán le hěn shēn de rénshēng dàolǐ.
sentences.translation: Although this animation is aimed at children, it contains profound life lessons.

sentences.chinese: 他的作品被改编成动画后，受到了大众的欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 他的作品被改編成動畫後，受到了大眾的歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zuòpǐn bèi gǎibiān chéng dònghuà hòu, shòudào le dàzhòng de huānyíng.
sentences.translation: After his work was adapted into an animation, it was welcomed by the public.

sentences.chinese: 学习动画制作不只是画画，还需要理解故事结构和人物表情。
sentences.traditional: 學習動畫製作不只是畫畫，還需要理解故事結構和人物表情。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí dònghuà zhìzuò bù zhǐ shì huàhuà, hái xūyào lǐjiě gùshì jiégòu hé rénwù biǎoqíng.
sentences.translation: Learning animation production is not just drawing; you also need to understand story structure and characters’ expressions.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影最动人的地方，不是结局，而是人物之间的理解。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影最動人的地方，不是結局，而是人物之間的理解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zuì dòngrén de dìfang, bú shì jiéjú, ér shì rénwù zhījiān de lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: The most moving part of this film is not the ending, but the understanding between the characters.

sentences.chinese: 她在会上讲的经历很动人，许多人听完都沉默了。
sentences.traditional: 她在會上講的經歷很動人，許多人聽完都沉默了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài huì shang jiǎng de jīnglì hěn dòngrén, xǔduō rén tīng wán dōu chénmò le.
sentences.translation: The experience she described at the meeting was very moving, and many people fell silent after hearing it.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌虽然简单，却有一种动人的力量。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌雖然簡單，卻有一種動人的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē suīrán jiǎndān, què yǒu yì zhǒng dòngrén de lìliàng.
sentences.translation: Although this song is simple, it has a moving power.

sentences.chinese: 方案确定后，团队马上动手安装新设备。
sentences.traditional: 方案確定後，團隊馬上動手安裝新設備。
sentences.pinyin: Fāng’àn quèdìng hòu, tuánduì mǎshàng dòngshǒu ānzhuāng xīn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: After the plan was confirmed, the team immediately started installing the new equipment.

sentences.chinese: 与其一直讨论，不如先动手做一个测试版本。
sentences.traditional: 與其一直討論，不如先動手做一個測試版本。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí yìzhí tǎolùn, bùrú xiān dòngshǒu zuò yí ge cèshì bǎnběn.
sentences.translation: Rather than keep discussing it, it would be better to start by making a test version.

sentences.chinese: 孩子想帮忙做饭，妈妈就让他从洗菜动手。
sentences.traditional: 孩子想幫忙做飯，媽媽就讓他從洗菜動手。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi xiǎng bāngmáng zuòfàn, māma jiù ràng tā cóng xǐ cài dòngshǒu.
sentences.translation: The child wanted to help cook, so Mum let him start with washing the vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐馆的麻婆豆腐味道很正宗，但有点辣。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐館的麻婆豆腐味道很正宗，但有點辣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānguǎn de mápó dòufu wèidao hěn zhèngzōng, dàn yǒudiǎn là.
sentences.translation: The mapo tofu at this restaurant tastes very authentic, but it is a bit spicy.

sentences.chinese: 如果你不吃肉，可以用豆腐补充一部分蛋白质。
sentences.traditional: 如果你不吃肉，可以用豆腐補充一部分蛋白質。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù chī ròu, kěyǐ yòng dòufu bǔchōng yí bùfen dànbáizhì.
sentences.translation: If you do not eat meat, you can use tofu to supplement part of your protein intake.

sentences.chinese: 这块豆腐已经过了保质期，最好不要再吃。
sentences.traditional: 這塊豆腐已經過了保質期，最好不要再吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài dòufu yǐjīng guò le bǎozhìqī, zuìhǎo bú yào zài chī.
sentences.translation: This piece of tofu is already past its shelf life, so it is best not to eat it.

sentences.chinese: 很多人早餐喜欢喝豆浆，因为它既便宜又有营养。
sentences.traditional: 很多人早餐喜歡喝豆漿，因為它既便宜又有營養。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén zǎocān xǐhuan hē dòujiāng, yīnwèi tā jì piányi yòu yǒu yíngyǎng.
sentences.translation: Many people like drinking soy milk for breakfast because it is both cheap and nutritious.

sentences.chinese: 这杯豆浆太淡了，几乎没有豆子的味道。
sentences.traditional: 這杯豆漿太淡了，幾乎沒有豆子的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bēi dòujiāng tài dàn le, jīhū méiyǒu dòuzi de wèidao.
sentences.translation: This cup of soy milk is too weak; it hardly has any bean flavour.

sentences.chinese: 她把豆浆倒进杯子里，准备带到办公室喝。
sentences.traditional: 她把豆漿倒進杯子裡，準備帶到辦公室喝。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ dòujiāng dào jìn bēizi lǐ, zhǔnbèi dài dào bàngōngshì hē.
sentences.translation: She poured the soy milk into a cup and prepared to take it to the office to drink.

sentences.chinese: 大学毕业以后，他开始独立承担生活费用。
sentences.traditional: 大學畢業以後，他開始獨立承擔生活費用。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, tā kāishǐ dúlì chéngdān shēnghuó fèiyòng.
sentences.translation: After graduating from university, he began to bear his living expenses independently.

sentences.chinese: 这个部门虽然规模不大，却能独立完成复杂项目。
sentences.traditional: 這個部門雖然規模不大，卻能獨立完成複雜項目。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bùmén suīrán guīmó bú dà, què néng dúlì wánchéng fùzá xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: Although this department is not large, it can complete complex projects independently.

sentences.chinese: 独立思考的能力，比背答案更重要。
sentences.traditional: 獨立思考的能力，比背答案更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì, bǐ bèi dá’àn gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: The ability to think independently is more important than memorising answers.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的独特魅力，来自它的历史和多元文化。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的獨特魅力，來自它的歷史和多元文化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de dútè mèilì, láizì tā de lìshǐ hé duōyuán wénhuà.
sentences.translation: The unique charm of this city comes from its history and diverse culture.

sentences.chinese: 他的设计风格很独特，一眼就能认出来。
sentences.traditional: 他的設計風格很獨特，一眼就能認出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shèjì fēnggé hěn dútè, yì yǎn jiù néng rèn chūlai.
sentences.translation: His design style is very distinctive; you can recognise it at a glance.

sentences.chinese: 每个孩子都有独特的长处，教育不应只看成绩。
sentences.traditional: 每個孩子都有獨特的長處，教育不應只看成績。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge háizi dōu yǒu dútè de chángchù, jiàoyù bù yīng zhǐ kàn chéngjì.
sentences.translation: Every child has unique strengths, and education should not look only at grades.

sentences.chinese: 这个字有两个读音，要根据上下文判断。
sentences.traditional: 這個字有兩個讀音，要根據上下文判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zì yǒu liǎng ge dúyīn, yào gēnjù shàngxiàwén pànduàn.
sentences.translation: This character has two pronunciations, so you need to judge based on the context.

sentences.chinese: 老师纠正了我的读音，因为我把声调读错了。
sentences.traditional: 老師糾正了我的讀音，因為我把聲調讀錯了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiūzhèng le wǒ de dúyīn, yīnwèi wǒ bǎ shēngdiào dú cuò le.
sentences.translation: The teacher corrected my pronunciation because I read the tone incorrectly.

sentences.chinese: 学词汇时，除了意思，还要注意准确的读音。
sentences.traditional: 學詞彙時，除了意思，還要注意準確的讀音。
sentences.pinyin: Xué cíhuì shí, chúle yìsi, hái yào zhùyì zhǔnquè de dúyīn.
sentences.translation: When studying vocabulary, apart from the meaning, you should also pay attention to accurate pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 他独自去了一个陌生城市，从头开始创业。
sentences.traditional: 他獨自去了一個陌生城市，從頭開始創業。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dúzì qù le yí ge mòshēng chéngshì, cóng tóu kāishǐ chuàngyè.
sentences.translation: He went to an unfamiliar city alone and started a business from scratch.

sentences.chinese: 面对压力时，她习惯独自散步，让自己冷静下来。
sentences.traditional: 面對壓力時，她習慣獨自散步，讓自己冷靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì yālì shí, tā xíguàn dúzì sànbù, ràng zìjǐ lěngjìng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: When facing pressure, she is used to walking alone to calm herself down.

sentences.chinese: 这个任务虽然困难，但他决定独自完成。
sentences.traditional: 這個任務雖然困難，但他決定獨自完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège rènwu suīrán kùnnan, dàn tā juédìng dúzì wánchéng.
sentences.translation: Although this task is difficult, he decided to complete it by himself.

sentences.chinese: 路口被事故车辆堵住了，公交车只能绕行。
sentences.traditional: 路口被事故車輛堵住了，公交車只能繞行。
sentences.pinyin: Lùkǒu bèi shìgù chēliàng dǔ zhù le, gōngjiāochē zhǐ néng ràoxíng.
sentences.translation: The junction was blocked by the accident vehicle, so the bus could only take a detour.

sentences.chinese: 下班时间这条路特别堵，最好提前出发。
sentences.traditional: 下班時間這條路特別堵，最好提前出發。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàbān shíjiān zhè tiáo lù tèbié dǔ, zuìhǎo tíqián chūfā.
sentences.translation: This road is especially congested during rush hour, so it is best to set off early.

sentences.chinese: 院子周围新修了一堵墙，把噪音挡住了。
sentences.traditional: 院子周圍新修了一堵牆，把噪音擋住了。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzi zhōuwéi xīn xiū le yì dǔ qiáng, bǎ zàoyīn dǎng zhù le.
sentences.translation: A new wall was built around the yard, blocking out the noise.

sentences.chinese: 今天气温达到三十五度，户外活动需要减少。
sentences.traditional: 今天氣溫達到三十五度，戶外活動需要減少。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān qìwēn dádào sānshíwǔ dù, hùwài huódòng xūyào jiǎnshǎo.
sentences.translation: Today the temperature has reached thirty-five degrees, so outdoor activities need to be reduced.

sentences.chinese: 他对这个项目的熟悉度很高，因此能独立处理大部分问题。
sentences.traditional: 他對這個項目的熟悉度很高，因此能獨立處理大部分問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiàngmù de shúxīdù hěn gāo, yīncǐ néng dúlì chǔlǐ dà bùfen wèntí.
sentences.translation: His familiarity with this project is very high, so he can handle most problems independently.

sentences.chinese: 公司每季度都会评估客户满意度，并据此改进服务。
sentences.traditional: 公司每季度都會評估客戶滿意度，並據此改進服務。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī měi jìdù dōu huì pínggū kèhù mǎnyìdù, bìng jùcǐ gǎijìn fúwù.
sentences.translation: The company evaluates customer satisfaction every quarter and improves its service accordingly.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都有短处，关键是能不能正视并改进。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都有短處，關鍵是能不能正視並改進。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gèrén dōu yǒu duǎnchù, guānjiàn shì néng bù néng zhèngshì bìng gǎijìn.
sentences.translation: Everyone has weaknesses; the key is whether they can face them and improve.

sentences.chinese: 他最大的短处是不愿意听取不同意见。
sentences.traditional: 他最大的短處是不願意聽取不同意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì dà de duǎnchù shì bù yuànyì tīngqǔ bùtóng yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: His biggest shortcoming is that he is unwilling to listen to different opinions.

sentences.chinese: 在面试中，她没有回避自己的短处，反而解释了改进计划。
sentences.traditional: 在面試中，她沒有迴避自己的短處，反而解釋了改進計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Zài miànshì zhōng, tā méiyǒu huíbì zìjǐ de duǎnchù, fǎn’ér jiěshì le gǎijìn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: In the interview, she did not avoid her own weaknesses, but instead explained her improvement plan.

sentences.chinese: 公司暂时采取短期措施，以缓解资金压力。
sentences.traditional: 公司暫時採取短期措施，以緩解資金壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zànshí cǎiqǔ duǎnqī cuòshī, yǐ huǎnjiě zījīn yālì.
sentences.translation: The company has temporarily adopted short-term measures to ease financial pressure.

sentences.chinese: 短期内，这项政策不会产生明显效果。
sentences.traditional: 短期內，這項政策不會產生明顯效果。
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnqī nèi, zhè xiàng zhèngcè bù huì chǎnshēng míngxiǎn xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: In the short term, this policy will not produce obvious results.

sentences.chinese: 如果只追求短期利益，企业很难长期发展。
sentences.traditional: 如果只追求短期利益，企業很難長期發展。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhuīqiú duǎnqī lìyì, qǐyè hěn nán chángqī fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: A business will find it hard to develop long-term if it only pursues short-term benefits.

sentences.chinese: 网络突然断了，会议只好暂停十分钟。
sentences.traditional: 網絡突然斷了，會議只好暫停十分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò tūrán duàn le, huìyì zhǐhǎo zàntíng shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: The internet suddenly cut out, so the meeting had to pause for ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他把烟彻底断了。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他把菸徹底斷了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā bǎ yān chèdǐ duàn le.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to quit smoking completely.

sentences.chinese: 河上的旧桥断了一段，车辆暂时无法通过。
sentences.traditional: 河上的舊橋斷了一段，車輛暫時無法通過。
sentences.pinyin: Hé shang de jiù qiáo duàn le yí duàn, chēliàng zànshí wúfǎ tōngguò.
sentences.translation: A section of the old bridge over the river has broken, so vehicles cannot pass through for now.

sentences.chinese: 桌上堆满了资料，连电脑都快放不下了。
sentences.traditional: 桌上堆滿了資料，連電腦都快放不下了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shang duī mǎn le zīliào, lián diànnǎo dōu kuài fàng bu xià le.
sentences.translation: The desk is piled full of materials, and there is hardly even room for the computer.

sentences.chinese: 门口有一堆旧纸箱，下午需要全部清理掉。
sentences.traditional: 門口有一堆舊紙箱，下午需要全部清理掉。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu yǒu yì duī jiù zhǐxiāng, xiàwǔ xūyào quánbù qīnglǐ diào.
sentences.translation: There is a pile of old cardboard boxes by the door, and they all need clearing away this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 不要把问题都堆到最后一天再处理。
sentences.traditional: 不要把問題都堆到最後一天再處理。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào bǎ wèntí dōu duī dào zuìhòu yì tiān zài chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: Do not pile all the problems up and deal with them on the last day.

sentences.chinese: 通过对比两份报告，我们发现数据差距很大。
sentences.traditional: 通過對比兩份報告，我們發現數據差距很大。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò duìbǐ liǎng fèn bàogào, wǒmen fāxiàn shùjù chājù hěn dà.
sentences.translation: By comparing the two reports, we found that the gap in the data was very large.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章把城市生活和农村生活作了详细对比。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章把城市生活和農村生活作了詳細對比。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng bǎ chéngshì shēnghuó hé nóngcūn shēnghuó zuò le xiángxì duìbǐ.
sentences.translation: This article makes a detailed comparison between urban life and rural life.

sentences.chinese: 对比过去的成绩，他这次进步相当明显。
sentences.traditional: 對比過去的成績，他這次進步相當明顯。
sentences.pinyin: Duìbǐ guòqù de chéngjì, tā zhè cì jìnbù xiāngdāng míngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Compared with his previous results, his progress this time is quite obvious.

sentences.chinese: 公司应该公平对待每一位员工。
sentences.traditional: 公司應該公平對待每一位員工。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yīnggāi gōngpíng duìdài měi yí wèi yuángōng.
sentences.translation: The company should treat every employee fairly.

sentences.chinese: 他对待批评的态度比以前成熟多了。
sentences.traditional: 他對待批評的態度比以前成熟多了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duìdài pīpíng de tàidu bǐ yǐqián chéngshú duō le.
sentences.translation: His attitude towards criticism is much more mature than before.

sentences.chinese: 对待复杂问题，不能只看表面现象。
sentences.traditional: 對待複雜問題，不能只看表面現象。
sentences.pinyin: Duìdài fùzá wèntí, bù néng zhǐ kàn biǎomiàn xiànxiàng.
sentences.translation: When dealing with complex problems, you cannot just look at surface phenomena.

sentences.chinese: 这个对手虽然经验不足，但反应非常快。
sentences.traditional: 這個對手雖然經驗不足，但反應非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège duìshǒu suīrán jīngyàn bùzú, dàn fǎnyìng fēicháng kuài.
sentences.translation: Although this opponent lacks experience, his reactions are very fast.

sentences.chinese: 面对强大的对手，他仍然保持冷静。
sentences.traditional: 面對強大的對手，他仍然保持冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì qiángdà de duìshǒu, tā réngrán bǎochí lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: Facing a powerful opponent, he still remained calm.

sentences.chinese: 他们既是商业对手，也是彼此尊重的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 他們既是商業對手，也是彼此尊重的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jì shì shāngyè duìshǒu, yě shì bǐcǐ zūnzhòng de péngyou.
sentences.translation: They are both business opponents and friends who respect each other.

sentences.chinese: 这支队伍虽然年轻，但合作能力很强。
sentences.traditional: 這支隊伍雖然年輕，但合作能力很強。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī duìwu suīrán niánqīng, dàn hézuò nénglì hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: Although this team is young, its ability to cooperate is very strong.

sentences.chinese: 越来越多的志愿者加入了救援队伍。
sentences.traditional: 越來越多的志願者加入了救援隊伍。
sentences.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō de zhìyuànzhě jiārù le jiùyuán duìwu.
sentences.translation: More and more volunteers have joined the rescue team.

sentences.chinese: 管理一支国际队伍，需要充分理解文化差别。
sentences.traditional: 管理一支國際隊伍，需要充分理解文化差別。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐ yì zhī guójì duìwu, xūyào chōngfèn lǐjiě wénhuà chābié.
sentences.translation: Managing an international team requires a full understanding of cultural differences.

sentences.chinese: 这次调查的对象主要是二十到三十岁的年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 這次調查的對象主要是二十到三十歲的年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì diàochá de duìxiàng zhǔyào shì èrshí dào sānshí suì de niánqīng rén.
sentences.translation: The subjects of this survey are mainly young people aged twenty to thirty.

sentences.chinese: 他还没有结婚对象，所以家人总是替他着急。
sentences.traditional: 他還沒有結婚對象，所以家人總是替他著急。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái méiyǒu jiéhūn duìxiàng, suǒyǐ jiārén zǒng shì tì tā zháojí.
sentences.translation: He still does not have a marriage partner, so his family is always anxious for him.

sentences.chinese: 不同的服务对象，对产品的需求也不一样。
sentences.traditional: 不同的服務對象，對產品的需求也不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng de fúwù duìxiàng, duì chǎnpǐn de xūqiú yě bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Different service users also have different needs for the product.

sentences.chinese: 这辆卡车最多能运十吨货物。
sentences.traditional: 這輛卡車最多能運十噸貨物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē zuìduō néng yùn shí dūn huòwù.
sentences.translation: This lorry can carry at most ten tonnes of goods.

sentences.chinese: 今年大米产量增加了三百吨。
sentences.traditional: 今年大米產量增加了三百噸。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián dàmǐ chǎnliàng zēngjiā le sānbǎi dūn.
sentences.translation: This year’s rice output increased by three hundred tonnes.

sentences.chinese: 这批钢材重二十吨，必须用专门设备搬运。
sentences.traditional: 這批鋼材重二十噸，必須用專門設備搬運。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī gāngcái zhòng èrshí dūn, bìxū yòng zhuānmén shèbèi bānyùn.
sentences.translation: This batch of steel weighs twenty tonnes and must be moved with special equipment.

sentences.chinese: 他在窗台上放了一朵刚开的玫瑰。
sentences.traditional: 他在窗臺上放了一朵剛開的玫瑰。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chuāngtái shàng fàng le yì duǒ gāng kāi de méigui.
sentences.translation: He placed a newly opened rose on the windowsill.

sentences.chinese: 天边那几朵云被夕阳染成了金色。
sentences.traditional: 天邊那幾朵雲被夕陽染成了金色。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānbiān nà jǐ duǒ yún bèi xīyáng rǎn chéng le jīnsè.
sentences.translation: Those clouds on the horizon were dyed golden by the setting sun.

sentences.chinese: 她把每一朵花都仔细包好，准备送给客人。
sentences.traditional: 她把每一朵花都仔細包好，準備送給客人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ měi yì duǒ huā dōu zǐxì bāo hǎo, zhǔnbèi sòng gěi kèrén.
sentences.translation: She carefully wrapped every flower, preparing to give them to the guests.

sentences.chinese: 孩子听见雷声后，躲到妈妈身后。
sentences.traditional: 孩子聽見雷聲後，躲到媽媽身後。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tīngjiàn léishēng hòu, duǒ dào māma shēnhòu.
sentences.translation: After hearing the thunder, the child hid behind his mother.

sentences.chinese: 遇到问题不能总是躲，应该主动处理。
sentences.traditional: 遇到問題不能總是躲，應該主動處理。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào wèntí bù néng zǒng shì duǒ, yīnggāi zhǔdòng chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: When problems arise, you cannot always hide from them; you should deal with them actively.

sentences.chinese: 那只宠物猫躲在沙发下面，不肯出来。
sentences.traditional: 那隻寵物貓躲在沙發下面，不肯出來。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī chǒngwù māo duǒ zài shāfā xiàmiàn, bù kěn chūlái.
sentences.translation: That pet cat hid under the sofa and refused to come out.

sentences.chinese: 很多父母把全部希望都放在儿女身上。
sentences.traditional: 很多父母把全部希望都放在兒女身上。
sentences.pinyin: Hěnduō fùmǔ bǎ quánbù xīwàng dōu fàng zài érnǚ shēnshang.
sentences.translation: Many parents place all their hopes on their children.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然年纪大了，但仍然不想依靠儿女生活。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然年紀大了，但仍然不想依靠兒女生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì dà le, dàn réngrán bù xiǎng yīkào érnǚ shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Although he is old, he still does not want to rely on his children for his living.

sentences.chinese: 教育儿女不只是学校的责任，也是家庭的责任。
sentences.traditional: 教育兒女不只是學校的責任，也是家庭的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù érnǚ bù zhǐ shì xuéxiào de zérèn, yě shì jiātíng de zérèn.
sentences.translation: Educating children is not only the school’s responsibility, but also the family’s responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 这辆二手车虽然便宜，但安全性需要仔细检查。
sentences.traditional: 這輛二手車雖然便宜，但安全性需要仔細檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng èrshǒu chē suīrán piányi, dàn ānquánxìng xūyào zǐxì jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: Although this second-hand car is cheap, its safety needs to be checked carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他在网上买了一台二手电脑，性能还不错。
sentences.traditional: 他在網上買了一臺二手電腦，性能還不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài wǎngshàng mǎi le yì tái èrshǒu diànnǎo, xìngnéng hái búcuò.
sentences.translation: He bought a second-hand computer online, and its performance is quite good.

sentences.chinese: 二手商品如果质量可靠，也能减少浪费。
sentences.traditional: 二手商品如果質量可靠，也能減少浪費。
sentences.pinyin: Èrshǒu shāngpǐn rúguǒ zhìliàng kěkào, yě néng jiǎnshǎo làngfèi.
sentences.translation: If second-hand goods are reliable in quality, they can also reduce waste.

sentences.chinese: 进入博物馆前，游客需要扫二维码登记。
sentences.traditional: 進入博物館前，遊客需要掃二維碼登記。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù bówùguǎn qián, yóukè xūyào sǎo èrwéimǎ dēngjì.
sentences.translation: Before entering the museum, visitors need to scan a QR code to register.

sentences.chinese: 这张海报上的二维码已经失效，无法打开链接。
sentences.traditional: 這張海報上的二維碼已經失效，無法打開鏈接。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng hǎibào shàng de èrwéimǎ yǐjīng shīxiào, wúfǎ dǎkāi liánjiē.
sentences.translation: The QR code on this poster has expired, so the link cannot be opened.

sentences.chinese: 店员把付款二维码放在收银台旁边。
sentences.traditional: 店員把付款二維碼放在收銀臺旁邊。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ fùkuǎn èrwéimǎ fàng zài shōuyíntái pángbiān.
sentences.translation: The shop assistant put the payment QR code beside the till.

sentences.chinese: 教授在国际会议上发表了最新的研究成果。
sentences.traditional: 教授在國際會議上發表了最新的研究成果。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshòu zài guójì huìyì shàng fābiǎo le zuìxīn de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: The professor presented the latest research results at an international conference.

sentences.chinese: 你可以发表不同意见，但要有充分的理由。
sentences.traditional: 你可以發表不同意見，但要有充分的理由。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ fābiǎo bùtóng yìjiàn, dàn yào yǒu chōngfèn de lǐyóu.
sentences.translation: You may express a different opinion, but you need sufficient reasons.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家的文章经常在报纸上发表。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家的文章經常在報紙上發表。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de wénzhāng jīngcháng zài bàozhǐ shàng fābiǎo.
sentences.translation: This writer’s articles are often published in the newspaper.

sentences.chinese: 公司将在官网上发布新的招聘信息。
sentences.traditional: 公司將在官網上發佈新的招聘信息。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāng zài guānwǎng shàng fābù xīn de zhāopìn xìnxī.
sentences.translation: The company will release new recruitment information on its official website.

sentences.chinese: 政府发布预警后，学校取消了户外活动。
sentences.traditional: 政府發布預警後，學校取消了戶外活動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ fābù yùjǐng hòu, xuéxiào qǔxiāo le hùwài huódòng.
sentences.translation: After the government issued a warning, the school cancelled its outdoor activities.

sentences.chinese: 新产品发布之前，市场部已经做了大量准备。
sentences.traditional: 新產品發布之前，市場部已經做了大量準備。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn chǎnpǐn fābù zhīqián, shìchǎngbù yǐjīng zuò le dàliàng zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: Before the new product release, the marketing department had already made a great deal of preparation.

sentences.chinese: 交通越发达，城市之间的联系就越紧密。
sentences.traditional: 交通越發達，城市之間的聯繫就越緊密。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāotōng yuè fādá, chéngshì zhījiān de liánxì jiù yuè jǐnmì.
sentences.translation: The more developed transport is, the closer the connections between cities become.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区的制造业很发达，吸引了大量工人。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區的製造業很發達，吸引了大量工人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de zhìzàoyè hěn fādá, xīyǐn le dàliàng gōngrén.
sentences.translation: This region’s manufacturing industry is well developed and has attracted a large number of workers.

sentences.chinese: 科技发达并不一定意味着人人都更幸福。
sentences.traditional: 科技發達並不一定意味著人人都更幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Kējì fādá bìng bù yídìng yìwèizhe rénrén dōu gèng xìngfú.
sentences.translation: Advanced technology does not necessarily mean everyone is happier.

sentences.chinese: 每个成员都应该发挥自己的长处。
sentences.traditional: 每個成員都應該發揮自己的長處。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè chéngyuán dōu yīnggāi fāhuī zìjǐ de chángchù.
sentences.translation: Every member should make use of their own strengths.

sentences.chinese: 如果方法合适，这项技术能发挥更大的作用。
sentences.traditional: 如果方法合適，這項技術能發揮更大的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāngfǎ héshì, zhè xiàng jìshù néng fāhuī gèng dà de zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: If the method is suitable, this technology can play a greater role.

sentences.chinese: 比赛中，他充分发挥了自己的速度优势。
sentences.traditional: 比賽中，他充分發揮了自己的速度優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài zhōng, tā chōngfèn fāhuī le zìjǐ de sùdù yōushì.
sentences.translation: During the match, he made full use of his speed advantage.

sentences.chinese: 这项发明改变了人们传递信息的方式。
sentences.traditional: 這項發明改變了人們傳遞信息的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fāmíng gǎibiàn le rénmen chuándì xìnxī de fāngshì.
sentences.translation: This invention changed the way people transmit information.

sentences.chinese: 他从小喜欢观察生活，后来发明了一种新工具。
sentences.traditional: 他從小喜歡觀察生活，後來發明了一種新工具。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xǐhuan guānchá shēnghuó, hòulái fāmíng le yì zhǒng xīn gōngjù.
sentences.translation: He liked observing life from childhood and later invented a new tool.

sentences.chinese: 伟大的发明往往来自对普通问题的深入思考。
sentences.traditional: 偉大的發明往往來自對普通問題的深入思考。
sentences.pinyin: Wěidà de fāmíng wǎngwǎng láizì duì pǔtōng wèntí de shēnrù sīkǎo.
sentences.translation: Great inventions often come from deep thinking about ordinary problems.

sentences.chinese: 这项活动由几名大学生发起，后来得到了社区支持。
sentences.traditional: 這項活動由幾名大學生發起，後來得到了社區支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng huódòng yóu jǐ míng dàxuéshēng fāqǐ, hòulái dédào le shèqū zhīchí.
sentences.translation: This activity was initiated by several university students and later received community support.

sentences.chinese: 公司准备发起一项新的环保计划。
sentences.traditional: 公司準備發起一項新的環保計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhǔnbèi fāqǐ yí xiàng xīn de huánbǎo jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The company is preparing to launch a new environmental protection plan.

sentences.chinese: 他发起讨论的目的，是希望大家提出更大胆的想法。
sentences.traditional: 他發起討論的目的，是希望大家提出更大膽的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāqǐ tǎolùn de mùdì, shì xīwàng dàjiā tíchū gèng dàdǎn de xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: His purpose in initiating the discussion was to encourage everyone to put forward bolder ideas.

sentences.chinese: 会议快结束时，代表们还有机会发言。
sentences.traditional: 會議快結束時，代表們還有機會發言。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kuài jiéshù shí, dàibiǎo men hái yǒu jīhuì fāyán.
sentences.translation: When the meeting is about to end, the representatives will still have a chance to speak.

sentences.chinese: 他的发言虽然不长，却把问题的本质说明白了。
sentences.traditional: 他的發言雖然不長，卻把問題的本質說明白了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fāyán suīrán bù cháng, què bǎ wèntí de běnzhì shuō míngbai le.
sentences.translation: Although his speech was not long, it explained the essence of the problem clearly.

sentences.chinese: 请不要打断别人发言，这是基本的会议礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 請不要打斷別人發言，這是基本的會議禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng búyào dǎduàn biéren fāyán, zhè shì jīběn de huìyì lǐmào.
sentences.translation: Please do not interrupt others while they are speaking; this is basic meeting etiquette.

sentences.chinese: 这个词的发音和另一个词很接近，容易听错。
sentences.traditional: 這個詞的發音和另一個詞很接近，容易聽錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cí de fāyīn hé lìng yí ge cí hěn jiējìn, róngyì tīng cuò.
sentences.translation: The pronunciation of this word is very close to that of another word, so it is easy to mishear.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们反复练习这个音，以免发音不标准。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們反覆練習這個音，以免發音不標準。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen fǎnfù liànxí zhège yīn, yǐmiǎn fāyīn bù biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to practise this sound repeatedly to avoid inaccurate pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 如果只看拼音，不听录音，你很难掌握自然的发音。
sentences.traditional: 如果只看拼音，不聽錄音，你很難掌握自然的發音。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ kàn pīnyīn, bù tīng lùyīn, nǐ hěn nán zhǎngwò zìrán de fāyīn.
sentences.translation: If you only look at pinyin and do not listen to recordings, it is hard to master natural pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 学校不会随便罚学生，但会要求他们承担后果。
sentences.traditional: 學校不會隨便罰學生，但會要求他們承擔後果。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bú huì suíbiàn fá xuéshēng, dàn huì yāoqiú tāmen chéngdān hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: The school will not punish students casually, but it will require them to bear the consequences.

sentences.chinese: 司机超速后，被交警罚了五百元。
sentences.traditional: 司機超速後，被交警罰了五百元。
sentences.pinyin: Sījī chāosù hòu, bèi jiāojǐng fá le wǔbǎi yuán.
sentences.translation: After speeding, the driver was fined five hundred yuan by the traffic police.

sentences.chinese: 与其事后罚，不如提前把规则讲清楚。
sentences.traditional: 與其事後罰，不如提前把規則講清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí shìhòu fá, bùrú tíqián bǎ guīzé jiǎng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Rather than punishing people afterwards, it is better to explain the rules clearly in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这项罚款并不是为了赚钱，而是为了提醒大家遵守规定。
sentences.traditional: 這項罰款並不是為了賺錢，而是為了提醒大家遵守規定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fákuǎn bìng bú shì wèile zhuànqián, ér shì wèile tíxǐng dàjiā zūnshǒu guīdìng.
sentences.translation: This fine is not for making money, but for reminding everyone to obey the rules.

sentences.chinese: 如果餐厅把垃圾倒在路边，管理部门可以罚款。
sentences.traditional: 如果餐廳把垃圾倒在路邊，管理部門可以罰款。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ cāntīng bǎ lājī dào zài lùbiān, guǎnlǐ bùmén kěyǐ fákuǎn.
sentences.translation: If a restaurant dumps rubbish by the roadside, the management department can issue a fine.

sentences.chinese: 他没有按期交罚款，结果手续被拖了好几天。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有按期交罰款，結果手續被拖了好幾天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu ànqī jiāo fákuǎn, jiéguǒ shǒuxù bèi tuō le hǎo jǐ tiān.
sentences.translation: He did not pay the fine on time, and as a result the procedure was delayed for several days.

sentences.chinese: 这起案件已经交给法院处理。
sentences.traditional: 這起案件已經交給法院處理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè qǐ ànjiàn yǐjīng jiāogěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: This case has already been handed over to the court to handle.

sentences.chinese: 法院的判决必须建立在证据之上。
sentences.traditional: 法院的判決必須建立在證據之上。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎyuàn de pànjué bìxū jiànlì zài zhèngjù zhī shàng.
sentences.translation: A court judgment must be based on evidence.

sentences.chinese: 他们希望通过法院解决这场长期的争议。
sentences.traditional: 他們希望通過法院解決這場長期的爭議。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xīwàng tōngguò fǎyuàn jiějué zhè chǎng chángqī de zhēngyì.
sentences.translation: They hope to resolve this long-term dispute through the court.

sentences.chinese: 请把书翻到第五十页，我们继续讲下一部分。
sentences.traditional: 請把書翻到第五十頁，我們繼續講下一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū fān dào dì wǔshí yè, wǒmen jìxù jiǎng xià yí bùfen.
sentences.translation: Please turn the book to page fifty; we will continue with the next section.

sentences.chinese: 风太大了，桌上的文件都被翻乱了。
sentences.traditional: 風太大了，桌上的文件都被翻亂了。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng tài dà le, zhuō shang de wénjiàn dōu bèi fān luàn le.
sentences.translation: The wind was so strong that all the documents on the table were turned into a mess.

sentences.chinese: 他一边查词典，一边把这段文章翻成英文。
sentences.traditional: 他一邊查詞典，一邊把這段文章翻成英文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chá cídiǎn, yìbiān bǎ zhè duàn wénzhāng fān chéng Yīngwén.
sentences.translation: He checked the dictionary while translating this passage into English.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜加了番茄以后，味道更酸甜。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜加了番茄以後，味道更酸甜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài jiā le fānqié yǐhòu, wèidào gèng suān tián.
sentences.translation: After adding tomato to this dish, the flavour became more sweet and sour.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他多吃蔬菜，比如番茄和青菜。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他多吃蔬菜，比如番茄和青菜。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā duō chī shūcài, bǐrú fānqié hé qīngcài.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested that he eat more vegetables, such as tomatoes and greens.

sentences.chinese: 超市里的番茄不算便宜，但质量的确不错。
sentences.traditional: 超市裡的番茄不算便宜，但質量的確不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Chāoshì lǐ de fānqié bú suàn piányi, dàn zhìliàng díquè búcuò.
sentences.translation: The tomatoes in the supermarket are not cheap, but their quality is indeed good.

sentences.chinese: 只有产业稳定发展，城市经济才能真正繁荣。
sentences.traditional: 只有產業穩定發展，城市經濟才能真正繁榮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu chǎnyè wěndìng fāzhǎn, chéngshì jīngjì cái néng zhēnzhèng fánróng.
sentences.translation: Only when industries develop steadily can the city’s economy truly prosper.

sentences.chinese: 这条商业街曾经非常繁荣，现在却冷清了许多。
sentences.traditional: 這條商業街曾經非常繁榮，現在卻冷清了許多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shāngyèjiē céngjīng fēicháng fánróng, xiànzài què lěngqīng le xǔduō.
sentences.translation: This commercial street used to be very prosperous, but now it is much quieter.

sentences.chinese: 教育和创新对社会的长期繁荣有重要作用。
sentences.traditional: 教育和創新對社會的長期繁榮有重要作用。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù hé chuàngxīn duì shèhuì de chángqī fánróng yǒu zhòngyào zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Education and innovation play an important role in the long-term prosperity of society.

sentences.chinese: 他的想法和我们的计划完全相反。
sentences.traditional: 他的想法和我們的計劃完全相反。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ hé wǒmen de jìhuà wánquán xiāngfǎn.
sentences.translation: His idea is completely opposite to our plan.

sentences.chinese: 不少居民反对在小区旁边建大型停车场。
sentences.traditional: 不少居民反對在小區旁邊建大型停車場。
sentences.pinyin: Bù shǎo jūmín fǎnduì zài xiǎoqū pángbiān jiàn dàxíng tíngchēchǎng.
sentences.translation: Quite a few residents oppose building a large car park next to the residential area.

sentences.chinese: 我本来以为他会生气，反而他先向我道歉了。
sentences.traditional: 我本來以為他會生氣，反而他先向我道歉了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tā huì shēngqì, fǎn'ér tā xiān xiàng wǒ dàoqiàn le.
sentences.translation: I originally thought he would be angry; on the contrary, he apologised to me first.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败没有让他放弃，反而使他更加认真地准备。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗沒有讓他放棄，反而使他更加認真地準備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài méiyǒu ràng tā fàngqì, fǎn'ér shǐ tā gèngjiā rènzhēn de zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: This failure did not make him give up; instead, it made him prepare more seriously.

sentences.chinese: 我以为价格降低会增加销量，反而顾客更担心质量了。
sentences.traditional: 我以為價格降低會增加銷量，反而顧客更擔心質量了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jiàgé jiàngdī huì zēngjiā xiāoliàng, fǎn'ér gùkè gèng dānxīn zhìliàng le.
sentences.translation: I thought lowering the price would increase sales; instead, customers became more worried about quality.

sentences.chinese: 他没有解释清楚，反而把大家弄得更糊涂。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有解釋清楚，反而把大家弄得更糊塗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu jiěshì qīngchu, fǎn'ér bǎ dàjiā nòng de gèng hútu.
sentences.translation: He did not explain it clearly; instead, he made everyone more confused.

sentences.chinese: 为了确认结果，研究人员反复测试了这个程序。
sentences.traditional: 為了確認結果，研究人員反覆測試了這個程序。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile quèrèn jiéguǒ, yánjiū rényuán fǎnfù cèshì le zhège chéngxù.
sentences.translation: To confirm the result, the researchers tested this program repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题反复出现，说明根本原因还没有解决。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題反覆出現，說明根本原因還沒有解決。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí fǎnfù chūxiàn, shuōmíng gēnběn yuányīn hái méiyǒu jiějué.
sentences.translation: This problem keeps appearing repeatedly, which shows the root cause has not yet been solved.

sentences.chinese: 老师提醒我们不要反复犯同样的语法错误。
sentences.traditional: 老師提醒我們不要反覆犯同樣的語法錯誤。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng wǒmen búyào fǎnfù fàn tóngyàng de yǔfǎ cuòwù.
sentences.translation: The teacher reminded us not to make the same grammar mistake repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 天气突然变坏，登山队不得不提前返回基地。
sentences.traditional: 天氣突然變壞，登山隊不得不提前返回基地。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tūrán biàn huài, dēngshān duì bùdébù tíqián fǎnhuí jīdì.
sentences.translation: The weather suddenly worsened, so the climbing team had to return to base early.

sentences.chinese: 请登录系统后，点击左上角返回上一页。
sentences.traditional: 請登錄系統後，點擊左上角返回上一頁。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dēnglù xìtǒng hòu, diǎnjī zuǒ shàng jiǎo fǎnhuí shàng yí yè.
sentences.translation: After logging into the system, please click the top left corner to return to the previous page.

sentences.chinese: 他出国多年后，终于决定返回家乡发展。
sentences.traditional: 他出國多年後，終於決定返回家鄉發展。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chūguó duō nián hòu, zhōngyú juédìng fǎnhuí jiāxiāng fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: After many years abroad, he finally decided to return to his hometown to develop his career.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息后，大家的反应都很强烈。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息後，大家的反應都很強烈。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi hòu, dàjiā de fǎnyìng dōu hěn qiángliè.
sentences.translation: After hearing this news, everyone’s reaction was very strong.

sentences.chinese: 药物产生了不良反应，医生立刻调整了方案。
sentences.traditional: 藥物產生了不良反應，醫生立刻調整了方案。
sentences.pinyin: Yàowù chǎnshēng le bùliáng fǎnyìng, yīshēng lìkè tiáozhěng le fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: The medicine caused an adverse reaction, so the doctor immediately adjusted the plan.

sentences.chinese: 如果客户没有反应，我们再通过邮件提醒一次。
sentences.traditional: 如果客戶沒有反應，我們再通過郵件提醒一次。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kèhù méiyǒu fǎnyìng, wǒmen zài tōngguò yóujiàn tíxǐng yí cì.
sentences.translation: If the customer does not respond, we will remind them once more by email.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告反映了本地企业面临的主要困难。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告反映了本地企業面臨的主要困難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào fǎnyìng le běndì qǐyè miànlín de zhǔyào kùnnan.
sentences.translation: This report reflects the main difficulties faced by local businesses.

sentences.chinese: 有问题可以向管理部门反映，不必私下抱怨。
sentences.traditional: 有問題可以向管理部門反映，不必私下抱怨。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ xiàng guǎnlǐ bùmén fǎnyìng, bú bì sīxià bàoyuàn.
sentences.translation: Problems can be reported to the management department; there is no need to complain privately.

sentences.chinese: 这部作品反映出作者对城市生活的深入观察。
sentences.traditional: 這部作品反映出作者對城市生活的深入觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù zuòpǐn fǎnyìng chū zuòzhě duì chéngshì shēnghuó de shēnrù guānchá.
sentences.translation: This work reflects the author’s deep observation of urban life.

sentences.chinese: 反正会议已经推迟了，我们不如先处理别的任务。
sentences.traditional: 反正會議已經推遲了，我們不如先處理別的任務。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng huìyì yǐjīng tuīchí le, wǒmen bùrú xiān chǔlǐ bié de rènwu.
sentences.translation: Anyway, the meeting has already been postponed, so we may as well handle other tasks first.

sentences.chinese: 这条路远一点，反正今晚也不着急。
sentences.traditional: 這條路遠一點，反正今晚也不著急。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yuǎn yìdiǎn, fǎnzhèng jīnwǎn yě bù zháojí.
sentences.translation: This road is a bit farther, but in any case we are not in a hurry tonight.

sentences.chinese: 反正结果已经公布了，再争论也没有意义。
sentences.traditional: 反正結果已經公佈了，再爭論也沒有意義。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng jiéguǒ yǐjīng gōngbù le, zài zhēnglùn yě méiyǒu yìyì.
sentences.translation: Anyway, the result has already been announced; arguing any more is pointless.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目的范围太大，必须分成几个阶段完成。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目的範圍太大，必須分成幾個階段完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de fànwéi tài dà, bìxū fēn chéng jǐ ge jiēduàn wánchéng.
sentences.translation: The scope of this project is too large, so it must be completed in several stages.

sentences.chinese: 请把讨论限制在今天会议的范围内。
sentences.traditional: 請把討論限制在今天會議的範圍內。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ tǎolùn xiànzhì zài jīntiān huìyì de fànwéi nèi.
sentences.translation: Please keep the discussion within the scope of today’s meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这次暴雨影响的范围比预想中更广。
sentences.traditional: 這次暴雨影響的範圍比預想中更廣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì bàoyǔ yǐngxiǎng de fànwéi bǐ yùxiǎng zhōng gèng guǎng.
sentences.translation: The area affected by this rainstorm was wider than expected.

sentences.chinese: 这个标志是方的，颜色也很容易辨认。
sentences.traditional: 這個標誌是方的，顏色也很容易辨認。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège biāozhì shì fāng de, yánsè yě hěn róngyì biànrèn.
sentences.translation: This sign is square, and the colour is also easy to recognise.

sentences.chinese: 合同中，甲方的责任必须写清楚。
sentences.traditional: 合同中，甲方的責任必須寫清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Hétóng zhōng, jiǎfāng de zérèn bìxū xiě qīngchu.
sentences.translation: In the contract, the responsibilities of Party A must be written clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他站在舞台右方，负责调节灯光。
sentences.traditional: 他站在舞臺右方，負責調節燈光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài wǔtái yòufāng, fùzé tiáojié dēngguāng.
sentences.translation: He stood on the right side of the stage and was responsible for adjusting the lights.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案虽然成本高，但能彻底解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案雖然成本高，但能徹底解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn suīrán chéngběn gāo, dàn néng chèdǐ jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: Although this plan is costly, it can solve the problem thoroughly.

sentences.chinese: 经过反复讨论，团队终于达成了一个可行的方案。
sentences.traditional: 經過反覆討論，團隊終於達成了一個可行的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò fǎnfù tǎolùn, tuánduì zhōngyú dáchéng le yí ge kěxíng de fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: After repeated discussion, the team finally reached a workable plan.

sentences.chinese: 如果原来的方案不适合，我们就及时调整。
sentences.traditional: 如果原來的方案不適合，我們就及時調整。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yuánlái de fāng'àn bù shìhé, wǒmen jiù jíshí tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: If the original plan is not suitable, we will adjust it promptly.

sentences.chinese: 雨季来临前，政府采取措施防洪。
sentences.traditional: 雨季來臨前，政府採取措施防洪。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔjì láilín qián, zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ cuòshī fánghóng.
sentences.translation: Before the rainy season arrives, the government takes measures to prevent flooding.

sentences.chinese: 为了防被骗，她付款前反复核对了二维码。
sentences.traditional: 為了防被騙，她付款前反覆核對了二維碼。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fáng bèi piàn, tā fùkuǎn qián fǎnfù héduì le èrwéimǎ.
sentences.translation: To prevent being cheated, she repeatedly checked the QR code before paying.

sentences.chinese: 冬天地面结冰，老人出门要防摔倒。
sentences.traditional: 冬天地面結冰，老人出門要防摔倒。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān dìmiàn jiébīng, lǎorén chūmén yào fáng shuāidǎo.
sentences.translation: In winter, when the ground freezes, elderly people need to guard against falling when they go out.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划修复这些老旧房屋，以改善居民的生活条件。
sentences.traditional: 政府計畫修復這些老舊房屋，以改善居民的生活條件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà xiūfù zhèxiē lǎojiù fángwū, yǐ gǎishàn jūmín de shēnghuó tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: The government plans to repair these old buildings to improve residents’ living conditions.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，山脚下的几座房屋受到了严重损坏。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，山腳下的幾座房屋受到了嚴重損壞。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, shānjiǎo xià de jǐ zuò fángwū shòudào le yánzhòng sǔnhuài.
sentences.translation: After the rainstorm, several houses at the foot of the mountain were seriously damaged.

sentences.chinese: 这类房屋虽然面积不大，但设计得非常实用。
sentences.traditional: 這類房屋雖然面積不大，但設計得非常實用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lèi fángwū suīrán miànjī bú dà, dàn shèjì de fēicháng shíyòng.
sentences.translation: Although this type of house is not large, it is designed very practically.

sentences.chinese: 为了防止资料丢失，我们每天都会自动备份一次。
sentences.traditional: 為了防止資料丟失，我們每天都會自動備份一次。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ zīliào diūshī, wǒmen měitiān dū huì zìdòng bèifèn yí cì.
sentences.translation: To prevent data loss, we automatically back it up once every day.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他少熬夜，以防止病情进一步恶化。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他少熬夜，以防止病情進一步惡化。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā shǎo áoyè, yǐ fángzhǐ bìngqíng jìnyíbù èhuà.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to stay up less late to prevent his condition from getting worse.

sentences.chinese: 学校采取了新的措施，防止类似问题再次发生。
sentences.traditional: 學校採取了新的措施，防止類似問題再次發生。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào cǎiqǔ le xīn de cuòshī, fángzhǐ lèisì wèntí zàicì fāshēng.
sentences.translation: The school adopted new measures to prevent similar problems from happening again.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息时，他仿佛一下子失去了所有力气。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息時，他彷彿一下子失去了所有力氣。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi shí, tā fǎngfú yíxiàzi shīqù le suǒyǒu lìqi.
sentences.translation: When he heard the news, he seemed to lose all his strength at once.

sentences.chinese: 雨后的空气很清新，仿佛整个城市都被洗干净了。
sentences.traditional: 雨後的空氣很清新，彷彿整個城市都被洗乾淨了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu de kōngqì hěn qīngxīn, fǎngfú zhěnggè chéngshì dōu bèi xǐ gānjìng le.
sentences.translation: The air after the rain was fresh, as if the whole city had been washed clean.

sentences.chinese: 她看着远处的灯光，仿佛想起了很多年前的事。
sentences.traditional: 她看著遠處的燈光，彷彿想起了很多年前的事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe yuǎnchù de dēngguāng, fǎngfú xiǎngqǐ le hěn duō nián qián de shì.
sentences.translation: Looking at the lights in the distance, she seemed to remember things from many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 公司领导明天将访问当地的合作企业，了解生产情况。
sentences.traditional: 公司領導明天將訪問當地的合作企業，了解生產情況。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī lǐngdǎo míngtiān jiāng fǎngwèn dāngdì de hézuò qǐyè, liǎojiě shēngchǎn qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Company leaders will visit a local partner business tomorrow to understand the production situation.

sentences.chinese: 这个网站每天有上万人访问，系统压力很大。
sentences.traditional: 這個網站每天有上萬人訪問，系統壓力很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn měitiān yǒu shàng wàn rén fǎngwèn, xìtǒng yālì hěn dà.
sentences.translation: This website receives visits from tens of thousands of people every day, so the system is under great pressure.

sentences.chinese: 记者试图访问事故现场，但被工作人员拦住了。
sentences.traditional: 記者試圖訪問事故現場，但被工作人員攔住了。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě shìtú fǎngwèn shìgù xiànchǎng, dàn bèi gōngzuò rényuán lánzhù le.
sentences.translation: The reporter tried to visit the accident scene, but was stopped by the staff.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，今天下午的飞行计划被取消了。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣惡劣，今天下午的飛行計畫被取消了。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, jīntiān xiàwǔ de fēixíng jìhuà bèi qǔxiāo le.
sentences.translation: Due to bad weather, this afternoon’s flight plan was cancelled.

sentences.chinese: 鸟类能够长距离飞行，是一种令人惊叹的能力。
sentences.traditional: 鳥類能夠長距離飛行，是一種令人驚嘆的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Niǎolèi nénggòu cháng jùlí fēixíng, shì yì zhǒng lìng rén jīngtàn de nénglì.
sentences.translation: Birds’ ability to fly long distances is an astonishing ability.

sentences.chinese: 他从小喜欢飞机，梦想将来学习飞行。
sentences.traditional: 他從小喜歡飛機，夢想將來學習飛行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo xǐhuan fēijī, mèngxiǎng jiānglái xuéxí fēixíng.
sentences.translation: He has liked aeroplanes since childhood and dreams of learning to fly in the future.

sentences.chinese: 这名飞行员在紧急情况下保持冷静，成功降落了飞机。
sentences.traditional: 這名飛行員在緊急情況下保持冷靜，成功降落了飛機。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè míng fēixíngyuán zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià bǎochí lěngjìng, chénggōng jiàngluò le fēijī.
sentences.translation: This pilot stayed calm in an emergency and successfully landed the aircraft.

sentences.chinese: 成为飞行员不仅需要技术，也需要很强的责任心。
sentences.traditional: 成為飛行員不僅需要技術，也需要很強的責任心。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngwéi fēixíngyuán bùjǐn xūyào jìshù, yě xūyào hěn qiáng de zérènxīn.
sentences.translation: Becoming a pilot requires not only skill, but also a strong sense of responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 飞行员提醒乘客系好安全带，因为飞机即将起飞。
sentences.traditional: 飛行員提醒乘客繫好安全帶，因為飛機即將起飛。
sentences.pinyin: Fēixíngyuán tíxǐng chéngkè jì hǎo ānquándài, yīnwèi fēijī jíjiāng qǐfēi.
sentences.translation: The pilot reminded passengers to fasten their seatbelts because the plane was about to take off.

sentences.chinese: 他在非洲工作了三年，对当地文化有了更深的了解。
sentences.traditional: 他在非洲工作了三年，對當地文化有了更深的了解。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài Fēizhōu gōngzuò le sān nián, duì dāngdì wénhuà yǒu le gèng shēn de liǎojiě.
sentences.translation: He worked in Africa for three years and gained a deeper understanding of local culture.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片介绍了非洲不同地区的自然环境。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片介紹了非洲不同地區的自然環境。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jièshào le Fēizhōu bùtóng dìqū de zìrán huánjìng.
sentences.translation: This documentary introduces the natural environments of different regions of Africa.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划把产品出口到非洲市场。
sentences.traditional: 公司計畫把產品出口到非洲市場。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà bǎ chǎnpǐn chūkǒu dào Fēizhōu shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: The company plans to export its products to the African market.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，我们在车站分别，各自回家。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，我們在車站分別，各自回家。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, wǒmen zài chēzhàn fēnbié, gèzì huí jiā.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, we parted at the station and each went home.

sentences.chinese: 这两份报告分别由市场部和技术部负责。
sentences.traditional: 這兩份報告分別由市場部和技術部負責。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng fèn bàogào fēnbié yóu shìchǎng bù hé jìshù bù fùzé.
sentences.translation: These two reports are handled by the marketing department and the technical department respectively.

sentences.chinese: 这两个方案表面相似，实际上有明显分别。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個方案表面相似，實際上有明顯分別。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge fāng’àn biǎomiàn xiāngsì, shíjì shang yǒu míngxiǎn fēnbié.
sentences.translation: These two plans look similar on the surface, but actually have clear differences.

sentences.chinese: 这些植物主要分布在气候温暖的地区。
sentences.traditional: 這些植物主要分布在氣候溫暖的地區。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhíwù zhǔyào fēnbù zài qìhòu wēnnuǎn de dìqū.
sentences.translation: These plants are mainly distributed in regions with warm climates.

sentences.chinese: 地图清楚地显示了人口分布的变化。
sentences.traditional: 地圖清楚地顯示了人口分布的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú qīngchǔ de xiǎnshì le rénkǒu fēnbù de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The map clearly shows changes in population distribution.

sentences.chinese: 资源分布不均，是这个地区长期面临的问题。
sentences.traditional: 資源分布不均，是這個地區長期面臨的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zīyuán fēnbù bù jūn, shì zhège dìqū chángqī miànlín de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Uneven distribution of resources is a long-term problem facing this region.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个好消息，大家纷纷表示支持。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個好消息，大家紛紛表示支持。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège hǎo xiāoxi, dàjiā fēnfēn biǎoshì zhīchí.
sentences.translation: After hearing the good news, everyone expressed their support one after another.

sentences.chinese: 雨突然下大，路上的行人纷纷跑进商店避雨。
sentences.traditional: 雨突然下大，路上的行人紛紛跑進商店避雨。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tūrán xià dà, lù shang de xíngrén fēnfēn pǎo jìn shāngdiàn bì yǔ.
sentences.translation: When the rain suddenly became heavy, pedestrians on the road ran into shops one after another to avoid it.

sentences.chinese: 政策公布后，多家公司纷纷调整自己的发展计划。
sentences.traditional: 政策公佈後，多家公司紛紛調整自己的發展計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè gōngbù hòu, duō jiā gōngsī fēnfēn tiáozhěng zìjǐ de fāzhǎn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: After the policy was announced, many companies adjusted their development plans one after another.

sentences.chinese: 这些资料已经按照主题分类，查找起来方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 這些資料已經按照主題分類，查找起來方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīliào yǐjīng ànzhào zhǔtí fēnlèi, cházhǎo qǐlái fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: These materials have already been classified by topic, so they are much easier to look up.

sentences.chinese: 垃圾分类做得越细，资源浪费就越少。
sentences.traditional: 垃圾分類做得越細，資源浪費就越少。
sentences.pinyin: Lājī fēnlèi zuò de yuè xì, zīyuán làngfèi jiù yuè shǎo.
sentences.translation: The more carefully waste sorting is done, the less resources are wasted.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们先给词汇分类，再总结它们的用法。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們先給詞彙分類，再總結它們的用法。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen xiān gěi cíhuì fēnlèi, zài zǒngjié tāmen de yòngfǎ.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to classify the vocabulary first, then summarise their usages.

sentences.chinese: 由于道路被洪水切断，几个村子暂时与外界分离。
sentences.traditional: 由於道路被洪水切斷，幾個村子暫時與外界分離。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú dàolù bèi hóngshuǐ qiēduàn, jǐ ge cūnzi zànshí yǔ wàijiè fēnlí.
sentences.translation: Because the roads were cut off by the flood, several villages were temporarily separated from the outside world.

sentences.chinese: 科学家正在尝试把有用的成分从植物中分离出来。
sentences.traditional: 科學家正在嘗試把有用的成分從植物中分離出來。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài chángshì bǎ yǒuyòng de chéngfèn cóng zhíwù zhōng fēnlí chūlái.
sentences.translation: Scientists are trying to separate useful components from the plants.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他们分离多年，但感情一直没有变淡。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他們分離多年，但感情一直沒有變淡。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tāmen fēnlí duō nián, dàn gǎnqíng yìzhí méiyǒu biàn dàn.
sentences.translation: Although they have been separated for many years, their feelings have never faded.

sentences.chinese: 公司会根据经验和能力分配不同的任务。
sentences.traditional: 公司會根據經驗和能力分配不同的任務。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī huì gēnjù jīngyàn hé nénglì fēnpèi bùtóng de rènwu.
sentences.translation: The company allocates different tasks according to experience and ability.

sentences.chinese: 这些资金应该公平分配到各个地区。
sentences.traditional: 這些資金應該公平分配到各個地區。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zījīn yīnggāi gōngpíng fēnpèi dào gè gè dìqū.
sentences.translation: These funds should be fairly distributed to each region.

sentences.chinese: 老师把时间分配得很合理，所以课程进行得很顺利。
sentences.traditional: 老師把時間分配得很合理，所以課程進行得很順利。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ shíjiān fēnpèi de hěn hélǐ, suǒyǐ kèchéng jìnxíng de hěn shùnlì.
sentences.translation: The teacher allocated the time very reasonably, so the lesson went very smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 他们因为长期在不同城市工作，最终决定分手。
sentences.traditional: 他們因為長期在不同城市工作，最終決定分手。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīnwèi chángqī zài bùtóng chéngshì gōngzuò, zuìzhōng juédìng fēnshǒu.
sentences.translation: Because they worked in different cities for a long time, they finally decided to break up.

sentences.chinese: 分手之后，他才意识到沟通有多重要。
sentences.traditional: 分手之後，他才意識到溝通有多重要。
sentences.pinyin: Fēnshǒu zhīhòu, tā cái yìshi dào gōutōng yǒu duō zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Only after the break-up did he realise how important communication was.

sentences.chinese: 这对情侣虽然分手了，但仍然彼此尊重。
sentences.traditional: 這對情侶雖然分手了，但仍然彼此尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duì qínglǚ suīrán fēnshǒu le, dàn réngrán bǐcǐ zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: Although this couple broke up, they still respect each other.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要先分析原因，再决定采取什么措施。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要先分析原因，再決定採取什麼措施。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào xiān fēnxī yuányīn, zài juédìng cǎiqǔ shénme cuòshī.
sentences.translation: We need to analyse the reasons first, then decide what measures to take.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告分析了消费者行为的变化。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告分析了消費者行為的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào fēnxī le xiāofèizhě xíngwéi de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This report analysed changes in consumer behaviour.

sentences.chinese: 如果只看表面，就很难分析出问题的本质。
sentences.traditional: 如果只看表面，就很難分析出問題的本質。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ kàn biǎomiàn, jiù hěn nán fēnxī chū wèntí de běnzhì.
sentences.translation: If you only look at the surface, it is hard to analyse the essence of the problem.

sentences.chinese: 他愿意把创业经验分享给年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 他願意把創業經驗分享給年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuànyì bǎ chuàngyè jīngyàn fēnxiǎng gěi niánqīng rén.
sentences.translation: He is willing to share his start-up experience with young people.

sentences.chinese: 请在会议上分享一下你的调研结果。
sentences.traditional: 請在會議上分享一下你的調研結果。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài huìyì shàng fēnxiǎng yíxià nǐ de diàoyán jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Please share your research results at the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 网络让知识分享变得更加方便。
sentences.traditional: 網絡讓知識分享變得更加方便。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò ràng zhīshi fēnxiǎng biàn de gèngjiā fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The internet has made knowledge sharing even more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 为了改变家人的生活，他在城市里奋斗了十年。
sentences.traditional: 為了改變家人的生活，他在城市裡奮鬥了十年。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile gǎibiàn jiārén de shēnghuó, tā zài chéngshì lǐ fèndòu le shí nián.
sentences.translation: To change his family’s life, he struggled in the city for ten years.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人不仅要有理想，还要愿意为目标奋斗。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人不僅要有理想，還要願意為目標奮鬥。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén bùjǐn yào yǒu lǐxiǎng, hái yào yuànyì wèi mùbiāo fèndòu.
sentences.translation: Young people should not only have ideals, but also be willing to strive for their goals.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司从小店发展到今天，靠的是不断奋斗。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司從小店發展到今天，靠的是不斷奮鬥。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī cóng xiǎo diàn fāzhǎn dào jīntiān, kào de shì búduàn fèndòu.
sentences.translation: This company has grown from a small shop to where it is today through constant hard work.

sentences.chinese: 他的大学生活丰富多彩，既参加比赛，也做志愿服务。
sentences.traditional: 他的大學生活豐富多彩，既參加比賽，也做志願服務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de dàxué shēnghuó fēngfù-duōcǎi, jì cānjiā bǐsài, yě zuò zhìyuàn fúwù.
sentences.translation: His university life is rich and colourful: he both enters competitions and does voluntary work.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市的文化活动丰富多彩，吸引了很多游客。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市的文化活動豐富多彩，吸引了很多遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de wénhuà huódòng fēngfù-duōcǎi, xīyǐn le hěn duō yóukè.
sentences.translation: This city’s cultural activities are rich and colourful, attracting many tourists.

sentences.chinese: 通过阅读，孩子们能接触到丰富多彩的世界。
sentences.traditional: 通過閱讀，孩子們能接觸到豐富多彩的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò yuèdú, háizi men néng jiēchù dào fēngfù-duōcǎi de shìjiè.
sentences.translation: Through reading, children can come into contact with a rich and colourful world.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家的作品有很明显的个人风格。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家的作品有很明顯的個人風格。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de zuòpǐn yǒu hěn míngxiǎn de gèrén fēnggé.
sentences.translation: This writer’s works have a very obvious personal style.

sentences.chinese: 餐厅的装修风格虽然简单，却让人觉得很舒服。
sentences.traditional: 餐廳的裝修風格雖然簡單，卻讓人覺得很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Cāntīng de zhuāngxiū fēnggé suīrán jiǎndān, què ràng rén juéde hěn shūfu.
sentences.translation: Although the restaurant’s decoration style is simple, it makes people feel very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 在设计方案确定之前，我们需要先统一整体风格。
sentences.traditional: 在設計方案確定之前，我們需要先統一整體風格。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shèjì fāng'àn quèdìng zhīqián, wǒmen xūyào xiān tǒngyī zhěngtǐ fēnggé.
sentences.translation: Before the design plan is confirmed, we need to unify the overall style first.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结束后，球迷们疯狂地庆祝胜利。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結束後，球迷們瘋狂地慶祝勝利。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù hòu, qiúmí men fēngkuáng de qìngzhù shènglì.
sentences.translation: After the match ended, the fans celebrated the victory wildly.

sentences.chinese: 为了抢到演唱会门票，很多人疯狂刷新页面。
sentences.traditional: 為了搶到演唱會門票，很多人瘋狂刷新頁面。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile qiǎng dào yǎnchànghuì ménpiào, hěn duō rén fēngkuáng shuāxīn yèmiàn.
sentences.translation: To get concert tickets, many people refreshed the page like crazy.

sentences.chinese: 这种疯狂的消费行为可能会带来严重后果。
sentences.traditional: 這種瘋狂的消費行為可能會帶來嚴重後果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fēngkuáng de xiāofèi xíngwéi kěnéng huì dài lái yánzhòng hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: This kind of crazy spending behaviour may bring serious consequences.

sentences.chinese: 尊重当地风俗，是旅行中最基本的礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 尊重當地風俗，是旅行中最基本的禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Zūnzhòng dāngdì fēngsú, shì lǚxíng zhōng zuì jīběn de lǐmào.
sentences.translation: Respecting local customs is the most basic courtesy when travelling.

sentences.chinese: 这个村子的婚礼风俗保留了几百年。
sentences.traditional: 這個村子的婚禮風俗保留了幾百年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cūnzi de hūnlǐ fēngsú bǎoliú le jǐ bǎi nián.
sentences.translation: The wedding customs of this village have been preserved for several hundred years.

sentences.chinese: 随着城市发展，有些传统风俗正在慢慢消失。
sentences.traditional: 隨著城市發展，有些傳統風俗正在慢慢消失。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, yǒuxiē chuántǒng fēngsú zhèngzài mànmàn xiāoshī.
sentences.translation: With urban development, some traditional customs are slowly disappearing.

sentences.chinese: 投资之前，你应该先了解可能存在的风险。
sentences.traditional: 投資之前，你應該先了解可能存在的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Tóuzī zhīqián, nǐ yīnggāi xiān liǎojiě kěnéng cúnzài de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before investing, you should first understand the possible risks.

sentences.chinese: 如果不采取措施，项目失败的风险会越来越高。
sentences.traditional: 如果不採取措施，項目失敗的風險會越來越高。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù cǎiqǔ cuòshī, xiàngmù shībài de fēngxiǎn huì yuè lái yuè gāo.
sentences.translation: If measures are not taken, the risk of the project failing will get higher and higher.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，长期熬夜会增加健康风险。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，長期熬夜會增加健康風險。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, chángqī áoyè huì zēngjiā jiànkāng fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him that staying up late long-term will increase health risks.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有否定他的努力，只是指出了方法上的问题。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有否定他的努力，只是指出了方法上的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu fǒudìng tā de nǔlì, zhǐshì zhǐchū le fāngfǎ shang de wèntí.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not dismiss his effort, but only pointed out problems with the method.

sentences.chinese: 这种否定的态度会影响团队的积极性。
sentences.traditional: 這種否定的態度會影響團隊的積極性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fǒudìng de tàidù huì yǐngxiǎng tuánduì de jījíxìng.
sentences.translation: This kind of negative attitude will affect the team’s enthusiasm.

sentences.chinese: 事实摆在眼前，谁也无法否定这个结论。
sentences.traditional: 事實擺在眼前，誰也無法否定這個結論。
sentences.pinyin: Shìshí bǎi zài yǎnqián, shéi yě wúfǎ fǒudìng zhège jiélùn.
sentences.translation: The facts are right in front of us, so no one can deny this conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 面对记者的提问，他否认自己参与了这件事。
sentences.traditional: 面對記者的提問，他否認自己參與了這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jìzhě de tíwèn, tā fǒurèn zìjǐ cānyù le zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: Facing the reporter’s question, he denied taking part in the matter.

sentences.chinese: 公司否认产品存在严重的质量问题。
sentences.traditional: 公司否認產品存在嚴重的質量問題。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī fǒurèn chǎnpǐn cúnzài yánzhòng de zhìliàng wèntí.
sentences.translation: The company denied that the product had serious quality problems.
