sentences.chinese: 你可以解释原因，但不能否认已经造成的损失。
sentences.traditional: 你可以解釋原因，但不能否認已經造成的損失。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ jiěshì yuányīn, dàn bùnéng fǒurèn yǐjīng zàochéng de sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: You can explain the reason, but you cannot deny the losses already caused.

sentences.chinese: 这对夫妇把多年存款都投入了新公司。
sentences.traditional: 這對夫婦把多年存款都投入了新公司。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù bǎ duōnián cúnkuǎn dōu tóurù le xīn gōngsī.
sentences.translation: This couple invested many years of savings into the new company.

sentences.chinese: 那对夫妇虽然收入不高，却经常帮助邻居。
sentences.traditional: 那對夫婦雖然收入不高，卻經常幫助鄰居。
sentences.pinyin: Nà duì fūfù suīrán shōurù bù gāo, què jīngcháng bāngzhù línjū.
sentences.translation: Although that couple’s income is not high, they often help their neighbours.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议这对年轻夫妇定期做健康检查。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議這對年輕夫婦定期做健康檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhè duì niánqīng fūfù dìngqī zuò jiànkāng jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested that this young couple have regular health checks.

sentences.chinese: 看到老人摔倒，他立刻上前扶了一把。
sentences.traditional: 看到老人摔倒，他立刻上前扶了一把。
sentences.pinyin: Kàn dào lǎorén shuāidǎo, tā lìkè shàngqián fú le yì bǎ.
sentences.translation: Seeing the elderly person fall over, he immediately went forward to help him up.

sentences.chinese: 她一边扶着栏杆，一边慢慢走下楼梯。
sentences.traditional: 她一邊扶著欄杆，一邊慢慢走下樓梯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān fúzhe lángān, yìbiān mànmàn zǒu xià lóutī.
sentences.translation: She held the handrail while slowly walking down the stairs.

sentences.chinese: 孩子刚学走路时，父母总要扶着他。
sentences.traditional: 孩子剛學走路時，父母總要扶著他。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi gāng xué zǒulù shí, fùmǔ zǒng yào fúzhe tā.
sentences.translation: When a child is just learning to walk, parents always need to support him.

sentences.chinese: 对很多人来说，家人平安就是最大的福。
sentences.traditional: 對很多人來說，家人平安就是最大的福。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō rén lái shuō, jiārén píng'ān jiù shì zuì dà de fú.
sentences.translation: For many people, the safety of their family is the greatest blessing.

sentences.chinese: 春节时，人们常把福字贴在门上。
sentences.traditional: 春節時，人們常把福字貼在門上。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié shí, rénmen cháng bǎ fú zì tiē zài mén shang.
sentences.translation: During Spring Festival, people often stick the character fu on their doors.

sentences.chinese: 能在困难中得到朋友的支持，也是一种福。
sentences.traditional: 能在困難中得到朋友的支持，也是一種福。
sentences.pinyin: Néng zài kùnnan zhōng dédào péngyou de zhīchí, yě shì yì zhǒng fú.
sentences.translation: Being able to receive friends’ support during difficulties is also a kind of blessing.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司的服装设计既传统又现代。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司的服裝設計既傳統又現代。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de fúzhuāng shèjì jì chuántǒng yòu xiàndài.
sentences.translation: This company’s clothing design is both traditional and modern.

sentences.chinese: 表演开始前，演员们已经换好了服装。
sentences.traditional: 表演開始前，演員們已經換好了服裝。
sentences.pinyin: Biǎoyǎn kāishǐ qián, yǎnyuán men yǐjīng huàn hǎo le fúzhuāng.
sentences.translation: Before the performance began, the actors had already changed into their costumes.

sentences.chinese: 不同场合对服装的要求也不一样。
sentences.traditional: 不同場合對服裝的要求也不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng chǎnghé duì fúzhuāng de yāoqiú yě bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Different occasions also have different requirements for clothing.

sentences.chinese: 他给自己买了一副新的眼镜。
sentences.traditional: 他給自己買了一副新的眼鏡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi zìjǐ mǎi le yí fù xīn de yǎnjìng.
sentences.translation: He bought himself a new pair of glasses.

sentences.chinese: 会议室里挂着一副世界地图。
sentences.traditional: 會議室裡掛著一副世界地圖。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì li guàzhe yí fù shìjiè dìtú.
sentences.translation: A world map is hanging in the meeting room.

sentences.chinese: 她用一副平静的表情回答了所有问题。
sentences.traditional: 她用一副平靜的表情回答了所有問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng yí fù píngjìng de biǎoqíng huídá le suǒyǒu wèntí.
sentences.translation: She answered all the questions with a calm expression.

sentences.chinese: 这个国家虽然富，但也有不少社会问题。
sentences.traditional: 這個國家雖然富，但也有不少社會問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guójiā suīrán fù, dàn yě yǒu bù shǎo shèhuì wèntí.
sentences.translation: Although this country is rich, it also has quite a few social problems.

sentences.chinese: 真正富的人不一定只关心钱。
sentences.traditional: 真正富的人不一定只關心錢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng fù de rén bù yídìng zhǐ guānxīn qián.
sentences.translation: People who are truly rich do not necessarily care only about money.

sentences.chinese: 他靠长期奋斗变富后，仍然保持低调。
sentences.traditional: 他靠長期奮鬥變富後，仍然保持低調。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kào chángqī fèndòu biàn fù hòu, réngrán bǎochí dīdiào.
sentences.translation: After becoming rich through long-term hard work, he still remained low-key.

sentences.chinese: 为了完成这个项目，团队付出了很多时间和精力。
sentences.traditional: 為了完成這個項目，團隊付出了很多時間和精力。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile wánchéng zhège xiàngmù, tuánduì fùchū le hěn duō shíjiān hé jīnglì.
sentences.translation: To complete this project, the team put in a lot of time and energy.

sentences.chinese: 任何成功背后都离不开长期的付出。
sentences.traditional: 任何成功背後都離不開長期的付出。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé chénggōng bèihòu dōu lí bù kāi chángqī de fùchū.
sentences.translation: Behind any success, long-term effort is indispensable.

sentences.chinese: 她愿意为家人付出，却也希望自己的感受被理解。
sentences.traditional: 她願意為家人付出，卻也希望自己的感受被理解。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuànyì wèi jiārén fùchū, què yě xīwàng zìjǐ de gǎnshòu bèi lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: She is willing to give for her family, but she also hopes her own feelings are understood.

sentences.chinese: 这笔房租对刚毕业的年轻人来说是很大的负担。
sentences.traditional: 這筆房租對剛畢業的年輕人來說是很大的負擔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ fángzū duì gāng bìyè de niánqīngrén lái shuō shì hěn dà de fùdān.
sentences.translation: This rent is a heavy burden for young people who have just graduated.

sentences.chinese: 父母不应该独自负担所有教育费用。
sentences.traditional: 父母不應該獨自負擔所有教育費用。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù yīnggāi dúzì fùdān suǒyǒu jiàoyù fèiyòng.
sentences.translation: Parents should not have to bear all education costs alone.

sentences.chinese: 如果工作量继续增加，员工的心理负担会越来越重。
sentences.traditional: 如果工作量繼續增加，員工的心理負擔會越來越重。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ gōngzuòliàng jìxù zēngjiā, yuángōng de xīnlǐ fùdān huì yuè lái yuè zhòng.
sentences.translation: If the workload keeps increasing, employees’ mental burden will become heavier and heavier.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策旨在保障妇女在职场中的平等机会。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策旨在保障婦女在職場中的平等機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè zhǐ zài bǎozhàng fùnǚ zài zhíchǎng zhōng de píngděng jīhuì.
sentences.translation: This policy aims to protect equal opportunities for women in the workplace.

sentences.chinese: 村里的妇女纷纷参加了健康讲座。
sentences.traditional: 村裡的婦女紛紛參加了健康講座。
sentences.pinyin: Cūn li de fùnǚ fēnfēn cānjiā le jiànkāng jiǎngzuò.
sentences.translation: The women in the village joined the health lecture one after another.

sentences.chinese: 现代社会应更加重视妇女的安全与发展。
sentences.traditional: 現代社會應更加重視婦女的安全與發展。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì yīng gèngjiā zhòngshì fùnǚ de ānquán yǔ fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Modern society should pay more attention to women’s safety and development.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家的语言富有想象力。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家的語言富有想像力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de yǔyán fùyǒu xiǎngxiànglì.
sentences.translation: This writer’s language is full of imagination.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然富有，却仍然过着简单的生活。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然富有，卻仍然過著簡單的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán fùyǒu, què réngrán guòzhe jiǎndān de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Although he is wealthy, he still lives a simple life.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市富有历史气息，吸引了大量游客。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市富有歷史氣息，吸引了大量遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì fùyǒu lìshǐ qìxī, xīyǐn le dàliàng yóukè.
sentences.translation: This city has a rich historical atmosphere and attracts large numbers of tourists.

sentences.chinese: 请把这份文件复制到新的文件夹里。
sentences.traditional: 請把這份文件複製到新的文件夾裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wénjiàn fùzhì dào xīn de wénjiànjiā li.
sentences.translation: Please copy this document into the new folder.

sentences.chinese: 这个软件可以自动复制重要数据，避免丢失。
sentences.traditional: 這個軟件可以自動複製重要數據，避免丟失。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ zìdòng fùzhì zhòngyào shùjù, bìmiǎn diūshī.
sentences.translation: This software can automatically copy important data to avoid loss.

sentences.chinese: 文章不能随便复制别人的观点而不注明来源。
sentences.traditional: 文章不能隨便複製別人的觀點而不註明來源。
sentences.pinyin: Wénzhāng bù néng suíbiàn fùzhì biérén de guāndiǎn ér bù zhùmíng láiyuán.
sentences.translation: An article must not casually copy other people’s views without stating the source.

sentences.chinese: 教育改革需要长期的调查和讨论。
sentences.traditional: 教育改革需要長期的調查和討論。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù gǎigé xūyào chángqī de diàochá hé tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: Education reform requires long-term investigation and discussion.

sentences.chinese: 政府希望通过改革提高公共服务的效率。
sentences.traditional: 政府希望通過改革提高公共服務的效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xīwàng tōngguò gǎigé tígāo gōnggòng fúwù de xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The government hopes to improve the efficiency of public services through reform.

sentences.chinese: 如果制度不改革，问题可能会反复出现。
sentences.traditional: 如果制度不改革，問題可能會反覆出現。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhìdù bù gǎigé, wèntí kěnéng huì fǎnfù chūxiàn.
sentences.translation: If the system is not reformed, problems may appear repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 我们根据用户的意见改进了产品设计。
sentences.traditional: 我們根據用戶的意見改進了產品設計。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen gēnjù yònghù de yìjiàn gǎijìn le chǎnpǐn shèjì.
sentences.translation: We improved the product design based on users’ opinions.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术还有很大的改进空间。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術還有很大的改進空間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù hái yǒu hěn dà de gǎijìn kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: This technology still has a lot of room for improvement.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高效率，公司决定改进原来的工作程序。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高效率，公司決定改進原來的工作程序。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, gōngsī juédìng gǎijìn yuánlái de gōngzuò chéngxù.
sentences.translation: To improve efficiency, the company decided to improve the original work procedure.

sentences.chinese: 这项措施明显改善了当地的交通状况。
sentences.traditional: 這項措施明顯改善了當地的交通狀況。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng cuòshī míngxiǎn gǎishàn le dāngdì de jiāotōng zhuàngkuàng.
sentences.translation: This measure clearly improved the local traffic situation.

sentences.chinese: 只要方法得当，睡眠质量是可以改善的。
sentences.traditional: 只要方法得當，睡眠質量是可以改善的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào fāngfǎ dédàng, shuìmián zhìliàng shì kěyǐ gǎishàn de.
sentences.translation: As long as the method is appropriate, sleep quality can be improved.

sentences.chinese: 改善环境不仅需要政府努力，也需要大众参与。
sentences.traditional: 改善環境不僅需要政府努力，也需要大眾參與。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎishàn huánjìng bùjǐn xūyào zhèngfǔ nǔlì, yě xūyào dàzhòng cānyù.
sentences.translation: Improving the environment requires not only government effort but also public participation.

sentences.chinese: 今天太晚了，我们改天再详细讨论吧。
sentences.traditional: 今天太晚了，我們改天再詳細討論吧。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān tài wǎn le, wǒmen gǎitiān zài xiángxì tǎolùn ba.
sentences.translation: It is too late today; let’s discuss it in detail another day.

sentences.chinese: 我临时有事，改天请你吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 我臨時有事，改天請你吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ línshí yǒu shì, gǎitiān qǐng nǐ chī fàn.
sentences.translation: Something has come up; I’ll invite you to dinner another day.

sentences.chinese: 这个展览还有一个月才结束，改天去也来得及。
sentences.traditional: 這個展覽還有一個月才結束，改天去也來得及。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhǎnlǎn hái yǒu yí ge yuè cái jiéshù, gǎitiān qù yě láidejí.
sentences.translation: This exhibition does not end for another month, so going another day will still be in time.

sentences.chinese: 老师指出错误后，他马上改正了答案。
sentences.traditional: 老師指出錯誤後，他馬上改正了答案。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐchū cuòwù hòu, tā mǎshàng gǎizhèng le dá'àn.
sentences.translation: After the teacher pointed out the mistake, he corrected the answer immediately.

sentences.chinese: 发现问题不可怕，关键是愿意改正。
sentences.traditional: 發現問題不可怕，關鍵是願意改正。
sentences.pinyin: Fāxiàn wèntí bù kěpà, guānjiàn shì yuànyì gǎizhèng.
sentences.translation: Finding a problem is not frightening; the key is being willing to correct it.

sentences.chinese: 公司要求各部门在月底前改正报告中的数据错误。
sentences.traditional: 公司要求各部門在月底前改正報告中的數據錯誤。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú gè bùmén zài yuèdǐ qián gǎizhèng bàogào zhōng de shùjù cuòwù.
sentences.translation: The company requires all departments to correct the data errors in the report before the end of the month.

sentences.chinese: 他用毛巾盖住了熟睡的孩子。
sentences.traditional: 他用毛巾蓋住了熟睡的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng máojīn gài zhù le shúshuì de háizi.
sentences.translation: He covered the sleeping child with a towel.

sentences.chinese: 风太大了，别忘了把文件盖好。
sentences.traditional: 風太大了，別忘了把文件蓋好。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng tài dà le, bié wàng le bǎ wénjiàn gài hǎo.
sentences.translation: The wind is strong, so do not forget to cover the documents properly.

sentences.chinese: 这个盒子的盖坏了，所以里面的饼干受潮了。
sentences.traditional: 這個盒子的蓋壞了，所以裡面的餅乾受潮了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hézi de gài huài le, suǒyǐ lǐmiàn de bǐnggān shòucháo le.
sentences.translation: The lid of this box is broken, so the biscuits inside have gone damp.

sentences.chinese: 请你用三句话概括这篇报道的主要内容。
sentences.traditional: 請你用三句話概括這篇報道的主要內容。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ yòng sān jù huà gàikuò zhè piān bàodào de zhǔyào nèiróng.
sentences.translation: Please summarise the main content of this report in three sentences.

sentences.chinese: 他的发言很概括，但把问题的重点都说清楚了。
sentences.traditional: 他的發言很概括，但把問題的重點都說清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fāyán hěn gàikuò, dàn bǎ wèntí de zhòngdiǎn dōu shuō qīngchu le.
sentences.translation: His speech was very concise, but it made all the key points clear.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告最后概括了项目取得的成果和不足。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告最後概括了項目取得的成果和不足。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zuìhòu gàikuò le xiàngmù qǔdé de chéngguǒ hé bùzú.
sentences.translation: This report finally summarised the project’s achievements and shortcomings.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有基本概念，很难理解这套程序的逻辑。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有基本概念，很難理解這套程序的邏輯。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu jīběn gàiniàn, hěn nán lǐjiě zhè tào chéngxù de luójí.
sentences.translation: Without the basic concepts, it is hard to understand the logic of this program.

sentences.chinese: 老师用生活中的例子解释了风险这个概念。
sentences.traditional: 老師用生活中的例子解釋了風險這個概念。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng shēnghuó zhōng de lìzi jiěshì le fēngxiǎn zhège gàiniàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher used examples from life to explain the concept of risk.

sentences.chinese: 这个概念听起来简单，真正操作起来却不容易。
sentences.traditional: 這個概念聽起來簡單，真正操作起來卻不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gàiniàn tīng qǐlai jiǎndān, zhēnzhèng cāozuò qǐlai què bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: This concept sounds simple, but in practice it is not easy to operate.

sentences.chinese: 一个成熟的团队应该敢于承认错误并及时改正。
sentences.traditional: 一個成熟的團隊應該敢於承認錯誤並及時改正。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè chéngshú de tuánduì yīnggāi gǎnyú chéngrèn cuòwù bìng jíshí gǎizhèng.
sentences.translation: A mature team should dare to admit mistakes and correct them promptly.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然经验不足，却敢于提出不同意见。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然經驗不足，卻敢於提出不同意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán jīngyàn bùzú, què gǎnyú tíchū bùtóng yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Although he lacks experience, he dares to put forward a different opinion.

sentences.chinese: 只有敢于尝试，才可能找到新的解决方案。
sentences.traditional: 只有敢於嘗試，才可能找到新的解決方案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu gǎnyú chángshì, cái kěnéng zhǎodào xīn de jiějué fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: Only by daring to try can you possibly find a new solution.

sentences.chinese: 我们刚好赶上最后一班地铁。
sentences.traditional: 我們剛好趕上最後一班地鐵。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen gānghǎo gǎn shàng zuìhòu yì bān dìtiě.
sentences.translation: We happened to catch the last underground train.

sentences.chinese: 这个座位离出口不远，刚好适合老人坐。
sentences.traditional: 這個座位離出口不遠，剛好適合老人坐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zuòwèi lí chūkǒu bù yuǎn, gānghǎo shìhé lǎorén zuò.
sentences.translation: This seat is not far from the exit, so it is just right for an elderly person.

sentences.chinese: 我正想给你打电话，你刚好来了。
sentences.traditional: 我正想給你打電話，你剛好來了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng xiǎng gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà, nǐ gānghǎo lái le.
sentences.translation: I was just about to phone you, and you happened to arrive.

sentences.chinese: 校门口那棵高大的树已经有一百多年历史了。
sentences.traditional: 校門口那棵高大的樹已經有一百多年歷史了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàoménkǒu nà kē gāodà de shù yǐjīng yǒu yì bǎi duō nián lìshǐ le.
sentences.translation: The tall tree at the school gate already has a history of more than one hundred years.

sentences.chinese: 他个子高大，但说话非常温和。
sentences.traditional: 他個子高大，但說話非常溫和。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gèzi gāodà, dàn shuōhuà fēicháng wēnhé.
sentences.translation: He is tall, but he speaks very gently.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆前的高大建筑是这座城市的标志之一。
sentences.traditional: 博物館前的高大建築是這座城市的標誌之一。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn qián de gāodà jiànzhù shì zhè zuò chéngshì de biāozhì zhī yī.
sentences.translation: The tall building in front of the museum is one of the city’s symbols.

sentences.chinese: 这家商场主要出售高档服装和进口电器。
sentences.traditional: 這家商場主要出售高檔服裝和進口電器。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngchǎng zhǔyào chūshòu gāodàng fúzhuāng hé jìnkǒu diànqì.
sentences.translation: This shopping centre mainly sells high-end clothing and imported electrical appliances.

sentences.chinese: 高档产品不一定最适合大众的实际需求。
sentences.traditional: 高檔產品不一定最適合大眾的實際需求。
sentences.pinyin: Gāodàng chǎnpǐn bù yídìng zuì shìhé dàzhòng de shíjì xūqiú.
sentences.translation: High-end products are not necessarily the most suitable for the public’s actual needs.

sentences.chinese: 他们把旧厂房改造成了一家高档酒店。
sentences.traditional: 他們把舊廠房改造成了一家高檔酒店。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bǎ jiù chǎngfáng gǎizào chéng le yì jiā gāodàng jiǔdiàn.
sentences.translation: They transformed the old factory building into a high-end hotel.

sentences.chinese: 这座山的高度超过三千米。
sentences.traditional: 這座山的高度超過三千米。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān de gāodù chāoguò sān qiān mǐ.
sentences.translation: The height of this mountain exceeds three thousand metres.

sentences.chinese: 政府高度重视食品安全问题。
sentences.traditional: 政府高度重視食品安全問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gāodù zhòngshì shípǐn ānquán wèntí.
sentences.translation: The government attaches great importance to food safety issues.

sentences.chinese: 飞行员需要随时注意飞机的高度变化。
sentences.traditional: 飛行員需要隨時注意飛機的高度變化。
sentences.pinyin: Fēixíngyuán xūyào suíshí zhùyì fēijī de gāodù biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Pilots need to pay attention to changes in the aircraft’s altitude at all times.

sentences.chinese: 这门高级课程要求学生具备扎实的基础知识。
sentences.traditional: 這門高級課程要求學生具備紮實的基礎知識。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén gāojí kèchéng yāoqiú xuésheng jùbèi zhāshi de jīchǔ zhīshi.
sentences.translation: This advanced course requires students to have solid basic knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 她被提升为高级工程师，负责整个项目的技术方案。
sentences.traditional: 她被提升為高級工程師，負責整個項目的技術方案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bèi tíshēng wéi gāojí gōngchéngshī, fùzé zhěnggè xiàngmù de jìshù fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: She was promoted to senior engineer and is responsible for the technical plan for the whole project.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒店的高级房间可以看到海景。
sentences.traditional: 這家酒店的高級房間可以看到海景。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de gāojí fángjiān kěyǐ kàn dào hǎijǐng.
sentences.translation: The superior rooms in this hotel have sea views.

sentences.chinese: 高科技企业需要不断创新，才能保持竞争力。
sentences.traditional: 高科技企業需要不斷創新，才能保持競爭力。
sentences.pinyin: Gāokējì qǐyè xūyào bùduàn chuàngxīn, cái néng bǎochí jìngzhēnglì.
sentences.translation: High-tech enterprises need to keep innovating in order to remain competitive.

sentences.chinese: 这些高科技产品已经进入普通家庭。
sentences.traditional: 這些高科技產品已經進入普通家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē gāokējì chǎnpǐn yǐjīng jìnrù pǔtōng jiātíng.
sentences.translation: These high-tech products have already entered ordinary households.

sentences.chinese: 农业也开始利用高科技提高产量。
sentences.traditional: 農業也開始利用高科技提高產量。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngyè yě kāishǐ lìyòng gāokējì tígāo chǎnliàng.
sentences.translation: Agriculture has also begun to use high technology to increase output.

sentences.chinese: 这种高效的工作方式减少了大量重复劳动。
sentences.traditional: 這種高效的工作方式減少了大量重複勞動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gāoxiào de gōngzuò fāngshì jiǎnshǎo le dàliàng chóngfù láodòng.
sentences.translation: This efficient way of working has reduced a large amount of repetitive labour.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证高效沟通，会议前必须把资料发给大家。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證高效溝通，會議前必須把資料發給大家。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng gāoxiào gōutōng, huìyì qián bìxū bǎ zīliào fā gěi dàjiā.
sentences.translation: To ensure efficient communication, the materials must be sent to everyone before the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这台设备运行高效，但维护成本也不低。
sentences.traditional: 這臺設備運行高效，但維護成本也不低。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái shèbèi yùnxíng gāoxiào, dàn wéihù chéngběn yě bù dī.
sentences.translation: This piece of equipment runs efficiently, but maintenance costs are not low.

sentences.chinese: 你别把问题搞得太复杂，先找出主要原因。
sentences.traditional: 你別把問題搞得太複雜，先找出主要原因。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié bǎ wèntí gǎo de tài fùzá, xiān zhǎo chū zhǔyào yuányīn.
sentences.translation: Don’t make the problem too complicated; identify the main cause first.

sentences.chinese: 他最近在搞一个关于传统文化的研究项目。
sentences.traditional: 他最近在搞一個關於傳統文化的研究項目。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn zài gǎo yí gè guānyú chuántǒng wénhuà de yánjiū xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: He has recently been working on a research project about traditional culture.

sentences.chinese: 这件事如果搞不清楚，后面的计划都会受影响。
sentences.traditional: 這件事如果搞不清楚，後面的計劃都會受影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì rúguǒ gǎo bù qīngchu, hòumiàn de jìhuà dōu huì shòu yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If this matter is not clarified, the later plans will all be affected.

sentences.chinese: 毕业那天，同学们在校门口互相告别。
sentences.traditional: 畢業那天，同學們在校門口互相告別。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyè nà tiān, tóngxuémen zài xiàoménkǒu hùxiāng gàobié.
sentences.translation: On graduation day, the classmates said goodbye to one another at the school gate.

sentences.chinese: 他决定告别过去的生活，去一个新的城市重新开始。
sentences.traditional: 他決定告別過去的生活，去一個新的城市重新開始。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng gàobié guòqù de shēnghuó, qù yí gè xīn de chéngshì chóngxīn kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: He decided to say goodbye to his past life and make a fresh start in a new city.

sentences.chinese: 这场演出是老演员告别舞台前的最后一部作品。
sentences.traditional: 這場演出是老演員告別舞臺前的最後一部作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǎnchū shì lǎo yǎnyuán gàobié wǔtái qián de zuìhòu yí bù zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: This performance is the veteran actor’s final work before saying goodbye to the stage.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌的歌词虽然简单，却表达了很深的感情。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌的歌詞雖然簡單，卻表達了很深的感情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē de gēcí suīrán jiǎndān, què biǎodá le hěn shēn de gǎnqíng.
sentences.translation: The lyrics of this song are simple, yet they express deep feelings.

sentences.chinese: 我听不清歌词，只能根据旋律判断是哪首歌曲。
sentences.traditional: 我聽不清歌詞，只能根據旋律判斷是哪首歌曲。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng bù qīng gēcí, zhǐ néng gēnjù xuánlǜ pànduàn shì nǎ shǒu gēqǔ.
sentences.translation: I could not hear the lyrics clearly, so I could only identify the song from the melody.

sentences.chinese: 这段歌词出自一位年轻作者的作品。
sentences.traditional: 這段歌詞出自一位年輕作者的作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn gēcí chūzì yí wèi niánqīng zuòzhě de zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: This section of lyrics comes from the work of a young author.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌曲发布后，很快在网上受到大众欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌曲發布後，很快在網上受到大眾歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gēqǔ fābù hòu, hěn kuài zài wǎngshàng shòu dào dàzhòng huānyíng.
sentences.translation: After this song was released, it quickly became popular with the public online.

sentences.chinese: 她用传统乐器重新创作了这首歌曲。
sentences.traditional: 她用傳統樂器重新創作了這首歌曲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng chuántǒng yuèqì chóngxīn chuàngzuò le zhè shǒu gēqǔ.
sentences.translation: She recreated this song using traditional musical instruments.

sentences.chinese: 这类歌曲的风格比较独特，不一定适合所有人。
sentences.traditional: 這類歌曲的風格比較獨特，不一定適合所有人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lèi gēqǔ de fēnggé bǐjiào dútè, bù yídìng shìhé suǒyǒu rén.
sentences.translation: The style of this type of song is quite distinctive and may not suit everyone.

sentences.chinese: 我和他隔着一张桌子坐，却几乎没有交流。
sentences.traditional: 我和他隔著一張桌子坐，卻幾乎沒有交流。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā gé zhe yì zhāng zhuōzi zuò, què jīhū méiyǒu jiāoliú.
sentences.translation: He and I sat with a table between us, yet hardly communicated.

sentences.chinese: 这两个城市隔得不远，坐高铁半个小时就能到达。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個城市隔得不遠，坐高鐵半個小時就能到達。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè chéngshì gé de bù yuǎn, zuò gāotiě bàn gè xiǎoshí jiù néng dàodá.
sentences.translation: The two cities are not far apart; you can arrive by high-speed rail in half an hour.

sentences.chinese: 请把生熟食品隔开存放，避免互相污染。
sentences.traditional: 請把生熟食品隔開存放，避免互相污染。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shēng shú shípǐn gé kāi cúnfàng, bìmiǎn hùxiāng wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: Please store raw and cooked food separately to avoid cross-contamination.

sentences.chinese: 经过一整夜暴雨，今天早上的空气格外清新。
sentences.traditional: 經過一整夜暴雨，今天早上的空氣格外清新。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò yì zhěng yè bàoyǔ, jīntiān zǎoshang de kōngqì géwài qīngxīn.
sentences.translation: After a whole night of torrential rain, the air this morning is especially fresh.

sentences.chinese: 这次比赛关系到排名，所以队员们格外紧张。
sentences.traditional: 這次比賽關係到排名，所以隊員們格外緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài guānxi dào páimíng, suǒyǐ duìyuánmen géwài jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: This match affects the rankings, so the team members are especially nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他对这位老师格外尊重，因为老师曾经帮助过他。
sentences.traditional: 他對這位老師格外尊重，因為老師曾經幫助過他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhè wèi lǎoshī géwài zūnzhòng, yīnwèi lǎoshī céngjīng bāngzhù guo tā.
sentences.translation: He has special respect for this teacher because the teacher once helped him.

sentences.chinese: 个别学生没有按时提交报告，老师已经单独提醒了他们。
sentences.traditional: 個別學生沒有按時提交報告，老師已經單獨提醒了他們。
sentences.pinyin: Gèbié xuésheng méiyǒu ànshí tíjiāo bàogào, lǎoshī yǐjīng dāndú tíxǐng le tāmen.
sentences.translation: A few individual students did not submit their reports on time, and the teacher has already reminded them separately.

sentences.chinese: 这种情况只是个别现象，不能代表整体水平。
sentences.traditional: 這種情況只是個別現象，不能代表整體水平。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng zhǐ shì gèbié xiànxiàng, bù néng dàibiǎo zhěngtǐ shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: This situation is only an isolated phenomenon and cannot represent the overall level.

sentences.chinese: 我们会根据个别客户的需求调整服务方案。
sentences.traditional: 我們會根據個別客戶的需求調整服務方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen huì gēnjù gèbié kèhù de xūqiú tiáozhěng fúwù fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: We will adjust the service plan according to the needs of individual customers.

sentences.chinese: 人工智能正在影响各行各业的工作方式。
sentences.traditional: 人工智能正在影響各行各業的工作方式。
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng zhèngzài yǐngxiǎng gèháng-gèyè de gōngzuò fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Artificial intelligence is affecting the way people work in all trades and professions.

sentences.chinese: 这次大会邀请了来自各行各业的代表参加讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這次大會邀請了來自各行各業的代表參加討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì dàhuì yāoqǐng le láizì gèháng-gèyè de dàibiǎo cānjiā tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This conference invited representatives from all walks of life to take part in the discussion.

sentences.chinese: 改革措施推出后，各行各业都需要作出相应调整。
sentences.traditional: 改革措施推出後，各行各業都需要作出相應調整。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎigé cuòshī tuīchū hòu, gèháng-gèyè dōu xūyào zuòchū xiāngyìng tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: After the reform measures are introduced, all industries will need to make corresponding adjustments.

sentences.chinese: 个人的发展离不开长期学习和不断尝试。
sentences.traditional: 個人的發展離不開長期學習和不斷嘗試。
sentences.pinyin: Gèrén de fāzhǎn lí bù kāi chángqī xuéxí hé bùduàn chángshì.
sentences.translation: Personal development cannot be separated from long-term learning and constant attempts.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定不仅关系到个人利益，也会影响整个团队。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定不僅關係到個人利益，也會影響整個團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng bùjǐn guānxi dào gèrén lìyì, yě huì yǐngxiǎng zhěnggè tuánduì.
sentences.translation: This decision is related not only to personal interests, but will also affect the whole team.

sentences.chinese: 请在表格上填写个人信息，并确认内容无误。
sentences.traditional: 請在表格上填寫個人信息，並確認內容無誤。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé shang tiánxiě gèrén xìnxī, bìng quèrèn nèiróng wú wù.
sentences.translation: Please fill in your personal information on the form and confirm that the contents are correct.

sentences.chinese: 她的设计很有个性，一眼就能看出与别人不同。
sentences.traditional: 她的設計很有個性，一眼就能看出與別人不同。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shèjì hěn yǒu gèxìng, yì yǎn jiù néng kànchū yǔ biérén bùtóng.
sentences.translation: Her designs have a lot of individuality; you can tell at a glance that they are different from others.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的装修风格很有个性，所以吸引了不少年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的裝修風格很有個性，所以吸引了不少年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhuāngxiū fēnggé hěn yǒu gèxìng, suǒyǐ xīyǐn le bù shǎo niánqīngrén.
sentences.translation: The decoration style of this restaurant has a lot of personality, so it has attracted quite a few young people.

sentences.chinese: 教育不应该要求所有孩子失去个性。
sentences.traditional: 教育不應該要求所有孩子失去個性。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù bù yīnggāi yāoqiú suǒyǒu háizi shīqù gèxìng.
sentences.translation: Education should not require all children to lose their individuality.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，大家各自回到部门继续处理工作。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，大家各自回到部門繼續處理工作。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, dàjiā gèzì huí dào bùmén jìxù chǔlǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, everyone returned to their respective departments to continue dealing with work.

sentences.chinese: 请你们根据各自的经验，提出更实际的建议。
sentences.traditional: 請你們根據各自的經驗，提出更實際的建議。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐmen gēnjù gèzì de jīngyàn, tíchū gèng shíjì de jiànyì.
sentences.translation: Please put forward more practical suggestions based on your own respective experience.

sentences.chinese: 这两个方案各自有优点，也都有需要改进的地方。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個方案各自有優點，也都有需要改進的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè fāng’àn gèzì yǒu yōudiǎn, yě dōu yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfang.
sentences.translation: These two plans each have their own advantages, and both have areas that need improvement.

sentences.chinese: 这棵树的根扎得很深，所以暴雨后仍然没有倒。
sentences.traditional: 這棵樹的根扎得很深，所以暴雨後仍然沒有倒。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kē shù de gēn zhā de hěn shēn, suǒyǐ bàoyǔ hòu réngrán méiyǒu dǎo.
sentences.translation: The roots of this tree go very deep, so it still did not fall after the rainstorm.

sentences.chinese: 桌上只剩一根铅笔，大家只好轮流使用。
sentences.traditional: 桌上只剩一根鉛筆，大家只好輪流使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shang zhǐ shèng yì gēn qiānbǐ, dàjiā zhǐhǎo lúnliú shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: There was only one pencil left on the table, so everyone had to take turns using it.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，不要把那根针随便放在桌边。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，不要把那根針隨便放在桌邊。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, bú yào bǎ nà gēn zhēn suíbiàn fàng zài zhuō biān.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him not to put that needle casually at the edge of the table.

sentences.chinese: 要解决这个问题，必须从根本上改变管理方式。
sentences.traditional: 要解決這個問題，必須從根本上改變管理方式。
sentences.pinyin: Yào jiějué zhège wèntí, bìxū cóng gēnběn shang gǎibiàn guǎnlǐ fāngshì.
sentences.translation: To solve this problem, the management method must be changed at a fundamental level.

sentences.chinese: 这件事的根本原因不是技术，而是沟通不足。
sentences.traditional: 這件事的根本原因不是技術，而是溝通不足。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de gēnběn yuányīn bú shì jìshù, ér shì gōutōng bùzú.
sentences.translation: The root cause of this matter is not technology, but insufficient communication.

sentences.chinese: 他根本没看清楚合同内容，就急着签字。
sentences.traditional: 他根本沒看清楚合同內容，就急著簽字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gēnběn méi kàn qīngchu hétong nèiróng, jiù jízhe qiānzì.
sentences.translation: He simply did not read the contents of the contract clearly before rushing to sign it.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证账户安全，公司要求员工定期更换密码。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證賬戶安全，公司要求員工定期更換密碼。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng zhànghù ānquán, gōngsī yāoqiú yuángōng dìngqī gēnghuàn mìmǎ.
sentences.translation: To ensure account security, the company requires employees to change their passwords regularly.

sentences.chinese: 如果零件已经损坏，就不要再修理，直接更换比较安全。
sentences.traditional: 如果零件已經損壞，就不要再修理，直接更換比較安全。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ língjiàn yǐjīng sǔnhuài, jiù bú yào zài xiūlǐ, zhíjiē gēnghuàn bǐjiào ānquán.
sentences.translation: If the part is already damaged, do not repair it again; replacing it directly is safer.

sentences.chinese: 办理新证件前，请先确认是否需要更换照片。
sentences.traditional: 辦理新證件前，請先確認是否需要更換照片。
sentences.pinyin: Bànlǐ xīn zhèngjiàn qián, qǐng xiān quèrèn shìfǒu xūyào gēnghuàn zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: Before applying for a new document, please first confirm whether you need to change the photo.

sentences.chinese: 这个软件会自动更新，所以用户不需要手动安装新版本。
sentences.traditional: 這個軟件會自動更新，所以用戶不需要手動安裝新版本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn huì zìdòng gēngxīn, suǒyǐ yònghù bù xūyào shǒudòng ānzhuāng xīn bǎnběn.
sentences.translation: This software updates automatically, so users do not need to install new versions manually.

sentences.chinese: 网站内容每天更新，以便读者了解最新消息。
sentences.traditional: 網站內容每天更新，以便讀者了解最新消息。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngzhàn nèiróng měitiān gēngxīn, yǐbiàn dúzhě liǎojiě zuìxīn xiāoxi.
sentences.translation: The website content is updated every day so that readers can learn the latest news.

sentences.chinese: 请在提交报告之前，把所有数据更新到本周。
sentences.traditional: 請在提交報告之前，把所有數據更新到本週。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài tíjiāo bàogào zhīqián, bǎ suǒyǒu shùjù gēngxīn dào běn zhōu.
sentences.translation: Before submitting the report, please update all the data to this week.

sentences.chinese: 学校将在官网公布考试结果，请大家耐心等待。
sentences.traditional: 學校將在官網公佈考試結果，請大家耐心等待。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāng zài guānwǎng gōngbù kǎoshì jiéguǒ, qǐng dàjiā nàixīn děngdài.
sentences.translation: The school will announce the exam results on its official website, so please wait patiently.

sentences.chinese: 政府公布了新的交通规定，引起了社会广泛讨论。
sentences.traditional: 政府公佈了新的交通規定，引起了社會廣泛討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gōngbù le xīn de jiāotōng guīdìng, yǐnqǐ le shèhuì guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: The government announced new traffic regulations, which sparked broad discussion in society.

sentences.chinese: 公司没有及时公布相关信息，导致投资者更加担心。
sentences.traditional: 公司沒有及時公佈相關信息，導致投資者更加擔心。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī méiyǒu jíshí gōngbù xiāngguān xìnxī, dǎozhì tóuzīzhě gèngjiā dānxīn.
sentences.translation: The company did not announce the relevant information in time, causing investors to worry even more.

sentences.chinese: 这项桥梁工程预计明年年底完成。
sentences.traditional: 這項橋梁工程預計明年年底完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng qiáoliáng gōngchéng yùjì míngnián niándǐ wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This bridge project is expected to be completed by the end of next year.

sentences.chinese: 由于成本上升，整个工程不得不推迟三个月。
sentences.traditional: 由於成本上升，整個工程不得不推遲三個月。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngběn shàngshēng, zhěnggè gōngchéng bùdébù tuīchí sān gè yuè.
sentences.translation: Because costs rose, the whole project had to be delayed by three months.

sentences.chinese: 环保工程不仅能改善环境，也能带动本地产业发展。
sentences.traditional: 環保工程不僅能改善環境，也能帶動本地產業發展。
sentences.pinyin: Huánbǎo gōngchéng bùjǐn néng gǎishàn huánjìng, yě néng dàidòng běndì chǎnyè fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Environmental projects can not only improve the environment, but also drive local industrial development.

sentences.chinese: 这位工程师负责检查车辆的安全系统。
sentences.traditional: 這位工程師負責檢查車輛的安全系統。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi gōngchéngshī fùzé jiǎnchá chēliàng de ānquán xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: This engineer is responsible for checking the vehicle’s safety system.

sentences.chinese: 工程师提出的方案虽然复杂，但确实解决了关键问题。
sentences.traditional: 工程師提出的方案雖然複雜，但確實解決了關鍵問題。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī tíchū de fāng’àn suīrán fùzá, dàn quèshí jiějué le guānjiàn wèntí.
sentences.translation: The plan proposed by the engineer was complex, but it did solve the key problem.

sentences.chinese: 成为一名优秀的工程师，需要不断学习新的技术。
sentences.traditional: 成為一名優秀的工程師，需要不斷學習新的技術。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngwéi yì míng yōuxiù de gōngchéngshī, xūyào búduàn xuéxí xīn de jìshù.
sentences.translation: To become an outstanding engineer, one needs to keep learning new technologies.

sentences.chinese: 使用合适的工具，可以大大提高工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 使用合適的工具，可以大大提高工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐyòng héshì de gōngjù, kěyǐ dàdà tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Using suitable tools can greatly improve work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 这款在线工具能帮助学生快速整理资料。
sentences.traditional: 這款在線工具能幫助學生快速整理資料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn zàixiàn gōngjù néng bāngzhù xuésheng kuàisù zhěnglǐ zīliào.
sentences.translation: This online tool can help students organise materials quickly.

sentences.chinese: 安装设备之前，请先确认工具是否齐全。
sentences.traditional: 安裝設備之前，請先確認工具是否齊全。
sentences.pinyin: Ānzhuāng shèbèi zhīqián, qǐng xiān quèrèn gōngjù shìfǒu qíquán.
sentences.translation: Before installing the equipment, please first confirm whether the tools are complete.

sentences.chinese: 这个软件的新功能可以自动整理资料，大大提高了工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 這個軟件的新功能可以自動整理資料，大大提高了工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn de xīn gōngnéng kěyǐ zìdòng zhěnglǐ zīliào, dàdà tígāo le gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The new function of this software can automatically organise materials, greatly improving work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 手机功能越来越多，但并不是每个功能都真正实用。
sentences.traditional: 手機功能越來越多，但並不是每個功能都真正實用。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī gōngnéng yuè lái yuè duō, dàn bìng bú shì měi gè gōngnéng dōu zhēnzhèng shíyòng.
sentences.translation: Mobile phones have more and more functions, but not every function is genuinely practical.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器除了基本功能以外，还能根据需要进行调整。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器除了基本功能以外，還能根據需要進行調整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì chúle jīběn gōngnéng yǐwài, hái néng gēnjù xūyào jìnxíng tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: Besides its basic functions, this machine can also be adjusted according to need.

sentences.chinese: 无论结果如何，比赛的过程必须公平。
sentences.traditional: 無論結果如何，比賽的過程必須公平。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn jiéguǒ rúhé, bǐsài de guòchéng bìxū gōngpíng.
sentences.translation: No matter what the result is, the process of the competition must be fair.

sentences.chinese: 如果制度不够公平，员工的积极性就会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果制度不夠公平，員工的積極性就會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhìdù bú gòu gōngpíng, yuángōng de jījíxìng jiù huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If the system is not fair enough, employees’ motivation will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 老师尽量用公平的标准评价每一位学生。
sentences.traditional: 老師儘量用公平的標準評價每一位學生。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jǐnliàng yòng gōngpíng de biāozhǔn píngjià měi yí wèi xuésheng.
sentences.translation: The teacher tries to evaluate every student using fair standards.

sentences.chinese: 他毕业以后考上了公务员，负责处理居民的日常事务。
sentences.traditional: 他畢業以後考上了公務員，負責處理居民的日常事務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìyè yǐhòu kǎoshàng le gōngwùyuán, fùzé chǔlǐ jūmín de rìcháng shìwù.
sentences.translation: After graduating, he passed the civil service exam and became responsible for handling residents’ daily affairs.

sentences.chinese: 作为公务员，必须严格遵守相关规定。
sentences.traditional: 作為公務員，必須嚴格遵守相關規定。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi gōngwùyuán, bìxū yángé zūnshǒu xiāngguān guīdìng.
sentences.translation: As a civil servant, one must strictly follow the relevant regulations.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作虽然稳定，但公务员也要面对不少压力。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作雖然穩定，但公務員也要面對不少壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò suīrán wěndìng, dàn gōngwùyuán yě yào miànduì bù shǎo yālì.
sentences.translation: Although this job is stable, civil servants also have to face quite a lot of pressure.

sentences.chinese: 恭喜你顺利通过考试，这段时间的努力没有白费。
sentences.traditional: 恭喜你順利通過考試，這段時間的努力沒有白費。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngxǐ nǐ shùnlì tōngguò kǎoshì, zhè duàn shíjiān de nǔlì méiyǒu báifèi.
sentences.translation: Congratulations on passing the exam smoothly; your hard work during this period was not wasted.

sentences.chinese: 听说你升职了，真心恭喜你。
sentences.traditional: 聽說你升職了，真心恭喜你。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ shēngzhí le, zhēnxīn gōngxǐ nǐ.
sentences.translation: I heard you’ve been promoted; sincere congratulations.

sentences.chinese: 大家一起举杯，恭喜他们的新项目取得成功。
sentences.traditional: 大家一起舉杯，恭喜他們的新項目取得成功。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā yìqǐ jǔbēi, gōngxǐ tāmen de xīn xiàngmù qǔdé chénggōng.
sentences.translation: Everyone raised their glasses together to congratulate them on the success of their new project.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市过去依靠工业发展，现在正在转向服务业。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市過去依靠工業發展，現在正在轉向服務業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì guòqù yīkào gōngyè fāzhǎn, xiànzài zhèngzài zhuǎnxiàng fúwùyè.
sentences.translation: This city used to rely on industry for development, but is now shifting towards services.

sentences.chinese: 工业生产提高了效率，也带来了环境方面的挑战。
sentences.traditional: 工業生產提高了效率，也帶來了環境方面的挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyè shēngchǎn tígāo le xiàolǜ, yě dàilái le huánjìng fāngmiàn de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: Industrial production has improved efficiency, but has also brought environmental challenges.

sentences.chinese: 政府鼓励传统工业进行技术更新。
sentences.traditional: 政府鼓勵傳統工業進行技術更新。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gǔlì chuántǒng gōngyè jìnxíng jìshù gēngxīn.
sentences.translation: The government encourages traditional industry to carry out technological updates.

sentences.chinese: 这种茶杯采用传统工艺制作，所以每一个都不完全相同。
sentences.traditional: 這種茶杯採用傳統工藝製作，所以每一個都不完全相同。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chábēi cǎiyòng chuántǒng gōngyì zhìzuò, suǒyǐ měi yí gè dōu bù wánquán xiāngtóng.
sentences.translation: This kind of teacup is made using traditional craft, so each one is not exactly the same.

sentences.chinese: 新工艺降低了成本，同时保证了产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 新工藝降低了成本，同時保證了產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn gōngyì jiàngdī le chéngběn, tóngshí bǎozhèng le chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The new technology has lowered costs while ensuring product quality.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂不断改进工艺，以适应市场需求。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠不斷改進工藝，以適應市場需求。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng búduàn gǎijìn gōngyì, yǐ shìyìng shìchǎng xūqiú.
sentences.translation: This factory continually improves its technology in order to adapt to market demand.

sentences.chinese: 这套公寓虽然面积不大，但离地铁站很近。
sentences.traditional: 這套公寓雖然面積不大，但離地鐵站很近。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù suīrán miànjī bú dà, dàn lí dìtiězhàn hěn jìn.
sentences.translation: Although this apartment is not large, it is very close to the metro station.

sentences.chinese: 他们打算先租公寓，等工作稳定以后再买房。
sentences.traditional: 他們打算先租公寓，等工作穩定以後再買房。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen dǎsuàn xiān zū gōngyù, děng gōngzuò wěndìng yǐhòu zài mǎi fáng.
sentences.translation: They plan to rent an apartment first and buy a home after their jobs are stable.

sentences.chinese: 公寓楼下有便利店，生活起来非常方便。
sentences.traditional: 公寓樓下有便利店，生活起來非常方便。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyù lóuxià yǒu biànlìdiàn, shēnghuó qǐlái fēicháng fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: There is a convenience store downstairs from the apartment, making daily life very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 他为公司的发展作出了重要贡献。
sentences.traditional: 他為公司的發展作出了重要貢獻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèi gōngsī de fāzhǎn zuòchū le zhòngyào gòngxiàn.
sentences.translation: He made an important contribution to the company’s development.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都可以用自己的方式为社会贡献力量。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都可以用自己的方式為社會貢獻力量。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu kěyǐ yòng zìjǐ de fāngshì wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn lìliàng.
sentences.translation: Everyone can contribute their strength to society in their own way.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究的最大贡献在于提出了新的解决思路。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究的最大貢獻在於提出了新的解決思路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū de zuìdà gòngxiàn zàiyú tíchū le xīn de jiějué sīlù.
sentences.translation: The greatest contribution of this research lies in proposing a new way of solving the problem.

sentences.chinese: 共享单车让城市里的短途出行更加便利。
sentences.traditional: 共享單車讓城市裡的短途出行更加便利。
sentences.pinyin: Gòngxiǎng dānchē ràng chéngshì lǐ de duǎntú chūxíng gèngjiā biànlì.
sentences.translation: Shared bikes make short-distance travel in the city more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 团队成员应该及时共享资料，避免重复劳动。
sentences.traditional: 團隊成員應該及時共享資料，避免重複勞動。
sentences.pinyin: Tuánduì chéngyuán yīnggāi jíshí gòngxiǎng zīliào, bìmiǎn chóngfù láodòng.
sentences.translation: Team members should share materials promptly to avoid duplicated work.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司建立了一个平台，让不同部门共享客户信息。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司建立了一個平臺，讓不同部門共享客戶信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jiànlì le yí gè píngtái, ràng bùtóng bùmén gòngxiǎng kèhù xìnxī.
sentences.translation: This company built a platform allowing different departments to share customer information.

sentences.chinese: 遇到问题时，双方应该先沟通，而不是互相抱怨。
sentences.traditional: 遇到問題時，雙方應該先溝通，而不是互相抱怨。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào wèntí shí, shuāngfāng yīnggāi xiān gōutōng, ér bú shì hùxiāng bàoyuàn.
sentences.translation: When problems arise, both sides should communicate first rather than complain about each other.

sentences.chinese: 良好的沟通能减少误会，也能提高合作效率。
sentences.traditional: 良好的溝通能減少誤會，也能提高合作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de gōutōng néng jiǎnshǎo wùhuì, yě néng tígāo hézuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Good communication can reduce misunderstandings and improve cooperation efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 经理希望通过定期会议加强各部门之间的沟通。
sentences.traditional: 經理希望通過定期會議加強各部門之間的溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xīwàng tōngguò dìngqī huìyì jiāqiáng gè bùmén zhījiān de gōutōng.
sentences.translation: The manager hopes to strengthen communication between departments through regular meetings.

sentences.chinese: 这些因素共同构成了问题的主要原因。
sentences.traditional: 這些因素共同構成了問題的主要原因。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē yīnsù gòngtóng gòuchéng le wèntí de zhǔyào yuányīn.
sentences.translation: These factors together constitute the main cause of the problem.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章的构成很清楚，先提出观点，再分析原因。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章的構成很清楚，先提出觀點，再分析原因。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de gòuchéng hěn qīngchu, xiān tíchū guāndiǎn, zài fēnxī yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The composition of this article is very clear: it first presents the view, then analyses the reasons.

sentences.chinese: 信任、责任和沟通构成了一段健康关系的基础。
sentences.traditional: 信任、責任和溝通構成了一段健康關係的基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnrèn, zérèn hé gōutōng gòuchéng le yí duàn jiànkāng guānxi de jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: Trust, responsibility and communication form the foundation of a healthy relationship.

sentences.chinese: 这座城墙很古，经历了许多朝代的变化。
sentences.traditional: 這座城牆很古，經歷了許多朝代的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngqiáng hěn gǔ, jīnglì le xǔduō cháodài de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This city wall is very ancient and has experienced changes through many dynasties.

sentences.chinese: 他对古文字特别感兴趣，常常去博物馆研究。
sentences.traditional: 他對古文字特別感興趣，常常去博物館研究。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì gǔ wénzì tèbié gǎn xìngqù, chángcháng qù bówùguǎn yánjiū.
sentences.translation: He is especially interested in ancient writing and often goes to museums to study it.

sentences.chinese: 这首古曲虽然年代久远，听起来仍然很动人。
sentences.traditional: 這首古曲雖然年代久遠，聽起來仍然很動人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gǔ qǔ suīrán niándài jiǔyuǎn, tīng qǐlái réngrán hěn dòngrén.
sentences.translation: Although this ancient tune is very old, it still sounds moving.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们一听见鼓声，就跟着节奏跳了起来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們一聽見鼓聲，就跟著節奏跳了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yì tīngjiàn gǔ shēng, jiù gēnzhe jiézòu tiào le qǐlái.
sentences.translation: As soon as the children heard the drumbeat, they started dancing to the rhythm.

sentences.chinese: 他的肚子有点鼓，医生建议他少喝汽水。
sentences.traditional: 他的肚子有點鼓，醫生建議他少喝汽水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de dùzi yǒudiǎn gǔ, yīshēng jiànyì tā shǎo hē qìshuǐ.
sentences.translation: His belly is a bit swollen, so the doctor advised him to drink less fizzy drink.

sentences.chinese: 她终于鼓起勇气，向经理提出了自己的建议。
sentences.traditional: 她終於鼓起勇氣，向經理提出了自己的建議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú gǔ qǐ yǒngqì, xiàng jīnglǐ tíchū le zìjǐ de jiànyì.
sentences.translation: She finally plucked up the courage to put forward her suggestion to the manager.

sentences.chinese: 古代的交通不方便，人们出远门往往要花很长时间。
sentences.traditional: 古代的交通不方便，人們出遠門往往要花很長時間。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔdài de jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn, rénmen chū yuǎnmén wǎngwǎng yào huā hěn cháng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: Transport in ancient times was inconvenient, and people often had to spend a long time travelling far from home.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说以古代中国为背景，描写了一个普通家庭的命运。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說以古代中國為背景，描寫了一個普通家庭的命運。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō yǐ gǔdài Zhōngguó wéi bèijǐng, miáoxiě le yí gè pǔtōng jiātíng de mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: This novel is set in ancient China and describes the fate of an ordinary family.

sentences.chinese: 研究古代历史不能只看传说，还要参考可靠的资料。
sentences.traditional: 研究古代歷史不能只看傳說，還要參考可靠的資料。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū gǔdài lìshǐ bù néng zhǐ kàn chuánshuō, hái yào cānkǎo kěkào de zīliào.
sentences.translation: When studying ancient history, you cannot just look at legends; you also need to consult reliable materials.

sentences.chinese: 这座古老的寺庙保存得很好，吸引了许多游客。
sentences.traditional: 這座古老的寺廟保存得很好，吸引了許多遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de sìmiào bǎocún de hěn hǎo, xīyǐn le xǔduō yóukè.
sentences.translation: This ancient temple has been preserved very well and has attracted many tourists.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这个习俗很古老，但年轻人仍然愿意参加。
sentences.traditional: 雖然這個習俗很古老，但年輕人仍然願意參加。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhège xísú hěn gǔlǎo, dàn niánqīngrén réngrán yuànyì cānjiā.
sentences.translation: Although this custom is ancient, young people are still willing to take part.

sentences.chinese: 他们用现代技术修复了一条古老的石路。
sentences.traditional: 他們用現代技術修復了一條古老的石路。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yòng xiàndài jìshù xiūfù le yì tiáo gǔlǎo de shílù.
sentences.translation: They used modern technology to restore an ancient stone road.

sentences.chinese: 演讲结束后，听众热烈地鼓掌。
sentences.traditional: 演講結束後，聽眾熱烈地鼓掌。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng jiéshù hòu, tīngzhòng rèliè de gǔzhǎng.
sentences.translation: After the speech ended, the audience applauded warmly.

sentences.chinese: 当她说出自己的决定时，全班同学都为她鼓掌。
sentences.traditional: 當她說出自己的決定時，全班同學都為她鼓掌。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tā shuō chū zìjǐ de juédìng shí, quán bān tóngxué dōu wèi tā gǔzhǎng.
sentences.translation: When she announced her decision, the whole class applauded her.

sentences.chinese: 他不是为了让别人鼓掌才坚持做这件事的。
sentences.traditional: 他不是為了讓別人鼓掌才堅持做這件事的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì wèile ràng biérén gǔzhǎng cái jiānchí zuò zhè jiàn shì de.
sentences.translation: He did not keep doing this just to make other people applaud.

sentences.chinese: 请把书架固定在墙上，以免孩子碰倒。
sentences.traditional: 請把書架固定在牆上，以免孩子碰倒。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shūjià gùdìng zài qiáng shang, yǐmiǎn háizi pèng dǎo.
sentences.translation: Please fix the bookcase to the wall in case the child knocks it over.

sentences.chinese: 我们每周五固定开一次会，讨论项目进度。
sentences.traditional: 我們每週五固定開一次會，討論項目進度。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen měi zhōu wǔ gùdìng kāi yí cì huì, tǎolùn xiàngmù jìndù.
sentences.translation: We hold a meeting at a fixed time every Friday to discuss project progress.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同把价格固定了三年，对双方都有好处。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同把價格固定了三年，對雙方都有好處。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong bǎ jiàgé gùdìng le sān nián, duì shuāngfāng dōu yǒu hǎochu.
sentences.translation: This contract fixes the price for three years, which benefits both sides.

sentences.chinese: 离开故乡多年后，他最想念的还是家乡的味道。
sentences.traditional: 離開故鄉多年後，他最想念的還是家鄉的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Líkāi gùxiāng duō nián hòu, tā zuì xiǎngniàn de háishi jiāxiāng de wèidào.
sentences.translation: After being away from his hometown for many years, what he misses most is still the taste of home.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌让许多在外工作的人想起了故乡。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌讓許多在外工作的人想起了故鄉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē ràng xǔduō zài wài gōngzuò de rén xiǎngqǐ le gùxiāng.
sentences.translation: This song reminded many people working away from home of their hometown.

sentences.chinese: 他打算退休以后回到故乡，开一家小书店。
sentences.traditional: 他打算退休以後回到故鄉，開一家小書店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn tuìxiū yǐhòu huí dào gùxiāng, kāi yì jiā xiǎo shūdiàn.
sentences.translation: He plans to return to his hometown after retiring and open a small bookshop.

sentences.chinese: 我早上七点就到医院挂号，结果还是排了很久的队。
sentences.traditional: 我早上七點就到醫院掛號，結果還是排了很久的隊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang qī diǎn jiù dào yīyuàn guàhào, jiéguǒ háishi pái le hěn jiǔ de duì.
sentences.translation: I arrived at the hospital at seven in the morning to register, but still ended up queuing for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 如果只是普通感冒，可以先在网上挂号，再去门诊。
sentences.traditional: 如果只是普通感冒，可以先在網上掛號，再去門診。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ shì pǔtōng gǎnmào, kěyǐ xiān zài wǎng shang guàhào, zài qù ménzhěn.
sentences.translation: For an ordinary cold, you can register online first and then go to the outpatient clinic.

sentences.chinese: 她忘了带身份证，所以护士让她重新挂号。
sentences.traditional: 她忘了帶身份證，所以護士讓她重新掛號。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wàng le dài shēnfènzhèng, suǒyǐ hùshi ràng tā chóngxīn guàhào.
sentences.translation: She forgot to bring her ID card, so the nurse asked her to register again.

sentences.chinese: 这件事听起来很怪，我们最好再确认一下。
sentences.traditional: 這件事聽起來很怪，我們最好再確認一下。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tīng qǐlái hěn guài, wǒmen zuìhǎo zài quèrèn yíxià.
sentences.translation: This matter sounds rather strange; we had better confirm it again.

sentences.chinese: 你不要怪他，他也是按照规定办事。
sentences.traditional: 你不要怪他，他也是按照規定辦事。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bú yào guài tā, tā yě shì ànzhào guīdìng bànshì.
sentences.translation: Do not blame him; he was also acting according to the rules.

sentences.chinese: 今天的天气怪冷的，出门前多穿一件外套吧。
sentences.traditional: 今天的天氣怪冷的，出門前多穿一件外套吧。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì guài lěng de, chūmén qián duō chuān yí jiàn wàitào ba.
sentences.translation: The weather is quite cold today, so put on an extra coat before going out.

sentences.chinese: 由于系统维护，网站将于今晚十二点暂时关闭。
sentences.traditional: 由於系統維護，網站將於今晚十二點暫時關閉。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú xìtǒng wéihù, wǎngzhàn jiāng yú jīnwǎn shí'èr diǎn zànshí guānbì.
sentences.translation: Because of system maintenance, the website will temporarily close at midnight tonight.

sentences.chinese: 请在离开办公室前关闭电脑，并确认门窗已经锁好。
sentences.traditional: 請在離開辦公室前關閉電腦，並確認門窗已經鎖好。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài líkāi bàngōngshì qián guānbì diànnǎo, bìng quèrèn ménchuāng yǐjīng suǒ hǎo.
sentences.translation: Please close the computer before leaving the office and confirm that the doors and windows are locked.

sentences.chinese: 工厂因为环保不达标，被政府要求立即关闭。
sentences.traditional: 工廠因為環保不達標，被政府要求立即關閉。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng yīnwèi huánbǎo bù dábiāo, bèi zhèngfǔ yāoqiú lìjí guānbì.
sentences.translation: Because the factory failed to meet environmental standards, the government ordered it to close immediately.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员连续观察了三个月，才发现这种动物的生活规律。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員連續觀察了三個月，才發現這種動物的生活規律。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán liánxù guānchá le sān gè yuè, cái fāxiàn zhè zhǒng dòngwù de shēnghuó guīlǜ.
sentences.translation: The researchers observed continuously for three months before discovering this animal’s living patterns.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们先观察现象，再写出自己的分析。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們先觀察現象，再寫出自己的分析。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiān guānchá xiànxiàng, zài xiě chū zìjǐ de fēnxī.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to observe the phenomenon first and then write our own analysis.

sentences.chinese: 通过观察客户的反应，公司调整了销售策略。
sentences.traditional: 通過觀察客戶的反應，公司調整了銷售策略。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò guānchá kèhù de fǎnyìng, gōngsī tiáozhěng le xiāoshòu cèlüè.
sentences.translation: By observing customers’ reactions, the company adjusted its sales strategy.

sentences.chinese: 关于这个问题，不同专家提出了完全相反的观点。
sentences.traditional: 關於這個問題，不同專家提出了完全相反的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, bùtóng zhuānjiā tíchū le wánquán xiāngfǎn de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: On this issue, different experts put forward completely opposite viewpoints.

sentences.chinese: 你可以不同意我的观点，但最好先听完我的理由。
sentences.traditional: 你可以不同意我的觀點，但最好先聽完我的理由。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ bù tóngyì wǒ de guāndiǎn, dàn zuìhǎo xiān tīng wán wǒ de lǐyóu.
sentences.translation: You may disagree with my opinion, but it would be best to hear my reasons first.

sentences.chinese: 这篇评论的观点很清楚，不过证据还不够充分。
sentences.traditional: 這篇評論的觀點很清楚，不過證據還不夠充分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān pínglùn de guāndiǎn hěn qīngchu, búguò zhèngjù hái bú gòu chōngfèn.
sentences.translation: The viewpoint in this review is very clear, but the evidence is still not sufficient.

sentences.chinese: 随着社会的发展，人们的消费观念也在不断改变。
sentences.traditional: 隨著社會的發展，人們的消費觀念也在不斷改變。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe shèhuì de fāzhǎn, rénmen de xiāofèi guānniàn yě zài búduàn gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: As society develops, people’s ideas about consumption are also constantly changing.

sentences.chinese: 如果管理观念不更新，企业很难适应新的市场环境。
sentences.traditional: 如果管理觀念不更新，企業很難適應新的市場環境。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ guǎnlǐ guānniàn bù gēngxīn, qǐyè hěn nán shìyìng xīn de shìchǎng huánjìng.
sentences.translation: If management ideas are not updated, it is hard for a company to adapt to a new market environment.

sentences.chinese: 他父母的观念比较传统，不太理解他选择自由职业。
sentences.traditional: 他父母的觀念比較傳統，不太理解他選擇自由職業。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fùmǔ de guānniàn bǐjiào chuántǒng, bú tài lǐjiě tā xuǎnzé zìyóu zhíyè.
sentences.translation: His parents’ ideas are relatively traditional, so they do not quite understand his choice of freelance work.

sentences.chinese: 经过激烈的比赛，她终于获得了全国冠军。
sentences.traditional: 經過激烈的比賽，她終於獲得了全國冠軍。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò jīliè de bǐsài, tā zhōngyú huòdé le quánguó guànjūn.
sentences.translation: After an intense competition, she finally won the national championship.

sentences.chinese: 这支队伍连续三年成为联赛冠军，实力确实很强。
sentences.traditional: 這支隊伍連續三年成為聯賽冠軍，實力確實很強。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī duìwu liánxù sān nián chéngwéi liánsài guànjūn, shílì quèshí hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: This team has been the league champion for three years in a row, so its strength is truly impressive.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他没拿到冠军，但他的表现赢得了观众的尊重。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他沒拿到冠軍，但他的表現贏得了觀眾的尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā méi ná dào guànjūn, dàn tā de biǎoxiàn yíngdé le guānzhòng de zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: Although he did not win the championship, his performance earned the audience’s respect.

sentences.chinese: 欢迎您再次光临，我们会为老客户提供特别折扣。
sentences.traditional: 歡迎您再次光臨，我們會為老客戶提供特別折扣。
sentences.pinyin: Huānyíng nín zàicì guānglín, wǒmen huì wèi lǎo kèhù tígōng tèbié zhékòu.
sentences.translation: Welcome to visit us again; we will offer special discounts for regular customers.

sentences.chinese: 如果您明天方便，欢迎光临我们的新展厅。
sentences.traditional: 如果您明天方便，歡迎光臨我們的新展廳。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nín míngtiān fāngbiàn, huānyíng guānglín wǒmen de xīn zhǎntīng.
sentences.translation: If you are free tomorrow, you are welcome to visit our new showroom.

sentences.chinese: 店长亲自站在门口，感谢每一位光临的客人。
sentences.traditional: 店長親自站在門口，感謝每一位光臨的客人。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzhǎng qīnzì zhàn zài ménkǒu, gǎnxiè měi yí wèi guānglín de kèrén.
sentences.translation: The shop manager stood at the door personally, thanking every visiting customer.

sentences.chinese: 经过改革，公司的未来显得更加光明。
sentences.traditional: 經過改革，公司的未來顯得更加光明。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò gǎigé, gōngsī de wèilái xiǎnde gèngjiā guāngmíng.
sentences.translation: After the reforms, the company’s future appears even brighter.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们的笑声给这个偏远的村子带来了光明和希望。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們的笑聲給這個偏遠的村子帶來了光明和希望。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen de xiàoshēng gěi zhège piānyuǎn de cūnzi dàilái le guāngmíng hé xīwàng.
sentences.translation: The children’s laughter brought light and hope to this remote village.

sentences.chinese: 他始终相信，困难过去以后，前面的路会变得光明。
sentences.traditional: 他始終相信，困難過去以後，前面的路會變得光明。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǐzhōng xiāngxìn, kùnnan guòqù yǐhòu, qiánmiàn de lù huì biàn de guāngmíng.
sentences.translation: He has always believed that after the difficulties pass, the road ahead will become bright.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片曝光不足，主要是因为室内光线太暗。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片曝光不足，主要是因為室內光線太暗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn bàoguāng bùzú, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi shìnèi guāngxiàn tài àn.
sentences.translation: This photo is underexposed mainly because the indoor light was too dim.

sentences.chinese: 读书时要注意光线，否则眼睛容易疲劳。
sentences.traditional: 讀書時要注意光線，否則眼睛容易疲勞。
sentences.pinyin: Dúshū shí yào zhùyì guāngxiàn, fǒuzé yǎnjing róngyì píláo.
sentences.translation: When reading, you should pay attention to the light; otherwise, your eyes can easily become tired.

sentences.chinese: 设计师利用自然光线，让整个房间显得更宽敞。
sentences.traditional: 設計師利用自然光線，讓整個房間顯得更寬敞。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī lìyòng zìrán guāngxiàn, ràng zhěnggè fángjiān xiǎnde gèng kuānchang.
sentences.translation: The designer used natural light to make the whole room seem more spacious.

sentences.chinese: 他知识面很广，聊天时总能提出有趣的例子。
sentences.traditional: 他知識面很廣，聊天時總能提出有趣的例子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīshi miàn hěn guǎng, liáotiān shí zǒng néng tíchū yǒuqù de lìzi.
sentences.translation: His knowledge is very broad, so when chatting he can always bring up interesting examples.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策影响范围很广，需要提前向公众解释。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策影響範圍很廣，需要提前向公眾解釋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè yǐngxiǎng fànwéi hěn guǎng, xūyào tíqián xiàng gōngzhòng jiěshì.
sentences.translation: This policy has a very broad scope of impact, so it needs to be explained to the public in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司的业务很广，既做教育，也做技术服务。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司的業務很廣，既做教育，也做技術服務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de yèwù hěn guǎng, jì zuò jiàoyù, yě zuò jìshù fúwù.
sentences.translation: This company has a broad range of business, covering both education and technical services.

sentences.chinese: 晚饭后，很多居民都会到广场上散步。
sentences.traditional: 晚飯後，很多居民都會到廣場上散步。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnfàn hòu, hěn duō jūmín dōu huì dào guǎngchǎng shang sànbù.
sentences.translation: After dinner, many residents go to the square for a walk.

sentences.chinese: 市中心的广场正在举办一场免费的音乐会。
sentences.traditional: 市中心的廣場正在舉辦一場免費的音樂會。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhōngxīn de guǎngchǎng zhèngzài jǔbàn yì chǎng miǎnfèi de yīnyuèhuì.
sentences.translation: The square in the city centre is holding a free concert.

sentences.chinese: 节日期间，广场周围实行交通管制，车辆不能进入。
sentences.traditional: 節日期間，廣場周圍實行交通管制，車輛不能進入。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì qījiān, guǎngchǎng zhōuwéi shíxíng jiāotōng guǎnzhì, chēliàng bùnéng jìnrù.
sentences.translation: During the festival, traffic controls are in force around the square, and vehicles cannot enter.

sentences.chinese: 这项计划得到了广大市民的支持。
sentences.traditional: 這項計劃得到了廣大市民的支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìhuà dédào le guǎngdà shìmín de zhīchí.
sentences.translation: This plan received support from the general public.

sentences.chinese: 广大农村地区的教育条件正在逐步改善。
sentences.traditional: 廣大農村地區的教育條件正在逐步改善。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎngdà nóngcūn dìqū de jiàoyù tiáojiàn zhèngzài zhúbù gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: Educational conditions in vast rural areas are gradually improving.

sentences.chinese: 公司希望通过这次活动接触更广大的客户群体。
sentences.traditional: 公司希望通過這次活動接觸更廣大的客戶群體。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xīwàng tōngguò zhè cì huódòng jiēchù gèng guǎngdà de kèhù qúntǐ.
sentences.translation: The company hopes to reach a broader customer group through this event.

sentences.chinese: 这个话题在网上引起了广泛讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這個話題在網上引起了廣泛討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huàtí zài wǎngshàng yǐnqǐ le guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This topic sparked widespread discussion online.

sentences.chinese: 他的研究涉及历史、经济和社会等广泛领域。
sentences.traditional: 他的研究涉及歷史、經濟和社會等廣泛領域。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yánjiū shèjí lìshǐ, jīngjì hé shèhuì děng guǎngfàn lǐngyù.
sentences.translation: His research covers extensive fields including history, economics and society.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术已经被广泛应用于医疗行业。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術已經被廣泛應用於醫療行業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù yǐjīng bèi guǎngfàn yìngyòng yú yīliáo hángyè.
sentences.translation: This technology has already been widely used in the medical industry.

sentences.chinese: 只要仔细观察，就能发现市场变化的规律。
sentences.traditional: 只要仔細觀察，就能發現市場變化的規律。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào zǐxì guānchá, jiù néng fāxiàn shìchǎng biànhuà de guīlǜ.
sentences.translation: As long as you observe carefully, you can discover the pattern of market changes.

sentences.chinese: 他的生活很有规律，所以身体一直不错。
sentences.traditional: 他的生活很有規律，所以身體一直不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēnghuó hěn yǒu guīlǜ, suǒyǐ shēntǐ yìzhí búcuò.
sentences.translation: His life is very regular, so his health has always been fairly good.

sentences.chinese: 孩子的睡眠时间不规律，难免会影响学习效率。
sentences.traditional: 孩子的睡眠時間不規律，難免會影響學習效率。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi de shuìmián shíjiān bù guīlǜ, nánmiǎn huì yǐngxiǎng xuéxí xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: If a child’s sleep schedule is irregular, it will inevitably affect study efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 这次展览的规模比去年扩大了不少。
sentences.traditional: 這次展覽的規模比去年擴大了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn de guīmó bǐ qùnián kuòdà le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: The scale of this exhibition has expanded quite a lot compared with last year.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有足够资金，项目很难保持现在的规模。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有足夠資金，項目很難保持現在的規模。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu zúgòu zījīn, xiàngmù hěn nán bǎochí xiànzài de guīmó.
sentences.translation: Without enough funding, the project will find it difficult to maintain its current scale.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司虽然成立不久，但发展规模已经相当可观。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司雖然成立不久，但發展規模已經相當可觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán chénglì bù jiǔ, dàn fāzhǎn guīmó yǐjīng xiāngdāng kěguān.
sentences.translation: Although this company has not been established for long, its scale of development is already quite impressive.

sentences.chinese: 比赛开始前，裁判向大家说明了基本规则。
sentences.traditional: 比賽開始前，裁判向大家說明了基本規則。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài kāishǐ qián, cáipàn xiàng dàjiā shuōmíng le jīběn guīzé.
sentences.translation: Before the competition started, the referee explained the basic rules to everyone.

sentences.chinese: 任何人都不能因为身份特殊就违反规则。
sentences.traditional: 任何人都不能因為身份特殊就違反規則。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu bùnéng yīnwèi shēnfèn tèshū jiù wéifǎn guīzé.
sentences.translation: No one can break the rules just because they have a special status.

sentences.chinese: 这张表的排列很规则，查找信息比较方便。
sentences.traditional: 這張表的排列很規則，查找信息比較方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng biǎo de páiliè hěn guīzé, cházhǎo xìnxī bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The arrangement of this table is very regular, so it is fairly easy to look up information.

sentences.chinese: 请问您贵姓？我帮您登记一下。
sentences.traditional: 請問您貴姓？我幫您登記一下。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nín guìxìng? Wǒ bāng nín dēngjì yíxià.
sentences.translation: May I ask your surname? I’ll register it for you.

sentences.chinese: 初次见面时，他很礼貌地问对方贵姓。
sentences.traditional: 初次見面時，他很禮貌地問對方貴姓。
sentences.pinyin: Chūcì jiànmiàn shí, tā hěn lǐmào de wèn duìfāng guìxìng.
sentences.translation: When meeting for the first time, he politely asked the other person’s surname.

sentences.chinese: 前台先确认了客人贵姓，然后才安排座位。
sentences.traditional: 前臺先確認了客人貴姓，然後才安排座位。
sentences.pinyin: Qiántái xiān quèrèn le kèrén guìxìng, ránhòu cái ānpái zuòwèi.
sentences.translation: The front desk first confirmed the guest’s surname and then arranged a seat.

sentences.chinese: 请把合同放进左边那个柜子里。
sentences.traditional: 請把合同放進左邊那個櫃子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hétong fàng jìn zuǒbiān nàge guìzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please put the contract into the cupboard on the left.

sentences.chinese: 这个柜子太重了，最好两个人一起搬。
sentences.traditional: 這個櫃子太重了，最好兩個人一起搬。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guìzi tài zhòng le, zuìhǎo liǎng gè rén yìqǐ bān.
sentences.translation: This cabinet is too heavy; it would be best for two people to move it together.

sentences.chinese: 她把药品锁在柜子里，免得孩子拿到。
sentences.traditional: 她把藥品鎖在櫃子裡，免得孩子拿到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yàopǐn suǒ zài guìzi lǐ, miǎnde háizi ná dào.
sentences.translation: She locked the medicine in the cabinet so the child would not get hold of it.

sentences.chinese: 球从坡上滚下来，差点撞到路边的车。
sentences.traditional: 球從坡上滾下來，差點撞到路邊的車。
sentences.pinyin: Qiú cóng pō shang gǔn xiàlai, chàdiǎn zhuàng dào lùbiān de chē.
sentences.translation: The ball rolled down from the slope and almost hit the car by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 水已经滚了，可以把面条放进锅里。
sentences.traditional: 水已經滾了，可以把麵條放進鍋裡。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ yǐjīng gǔn le, kěyǐ bǎ miàntiáo fàng jìn guō lǐ.
sentences.translation: The water is already boiling; you can put the noodles into the pot.

sentences.chinese: 车轮在泥地里滚了几圈才停下来。
sentences.traditional: 車輪在泥地裡滾了幾圈才停下來。
sentences.pinyin: Chēlún zài nídì lǐ gǔn le jǐ quān cái tíng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: The wheel rolled several times in the mud before it stopped.

sentences.chinese: 汤在锅里煮了一个小时，味道特别浓。
sentences.traditional: 湯在鍋裡煮了一個小時，味道特別濃。
sentences.pinyin: Tāng zài guō lǐ zhǔ le yí gè xiǎoshí, wèidào tèbié nóng.
sentences.translation: The soup simmered in the pot for an hour, so the flavour is especially rich.

sentences.chinese: 做完饭以后，别忘了把锅洗干净。
sentences.traditional: 做完飯以後，別忘了把鍋洗乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò wán fàn yǐhòu, bié wàng le bǎ guō xǐ gānjìng.
sentences.translation: After cooking, don’t forget to wash the pot clean.

sentences.chinese: 这口锅导热很快，炒菜时要注意火候。
sentences.traditional: 這口鍋導熱很快，炒菜時要注意火候。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kǒu guō dǎorè hěn kuài, chǎo cài shí yào zhùyì huǒhou.
sentences.translation: This pot conducts heat very quickly, so you need to watch the heat when stir-frying.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷退休后开始学习国画，最喜欢画山水。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺退休後開始學習國畫，最喜歡畫山水。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye tuìxiū hòu kāishǐ xuéxí guóhuà, zuì xǐhuan huà shānshuǐ.
sentences.translation: After retiring, Grandad started learning traditional Chinese painting, and he likes painting landscapes most.

sentences.chinese: 这幅国画用墨很淡，却表现出很深的意境。
sentences.traditional: 這幅國畫用墨很淡，卻表現出很深的意境。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú guóhuà yòng mò hěn dàn, què biǎoxiàn chū hěn shēn de yìjìng.
sentences.translation: This traditional Chinese painting uses very light ink, yet expresses a deep artistic mood.

sentences.chinese: 学校邀请了一位老师给学生介绍国画的基本技法。
sentences.traditional: 學校邀請了一位老師給學生介紹國畫的基本技法。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yāoqǐng le yí wèi lǎoshī gěi xuéshēng jièshào guóhuà de jīběn jìfǎ.
sentences.translation: The school invited a teacher to introduce the basic techniques of traditional Chinese painting to the students.

sentences.chinese: 国庆期间，很多城市都会举行庆祝活动。
sentences.traditional: 國慶期間，很多城市都會舉行慶祝活動。
sentences.pinyin: Guóqìng qījiān, hěn duō chéngshì dū huì jǔxíng qìngzhù huódòng.
sentences.translation: During National Day, many cities hold celebration activities.

sentences.chinese: 我们计划国庆以后再出发，避开旅游高峰。
sentences.traditional: 我們計劃國慶以後再出發，避開旅遊高峰。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà guóqìng yǐhòu zài chūfā, bìkāi lǚyóu gāofēng.
sentences.translation: We plan to set off after National Day to avoid the travel peak.

sentences.chinese: 今年国庆假期，火车票比平时难买。
sentences.traditional: 今年國慶假期，火車票比平時難買。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián guóqìng jiàqī, huǒchēpiào bǐ píngshí nán mǎi.
sentences.translation: During this year's National Day holiday, train tickets are harder to buy than usual.

sentences.chinese: 他昨晚没休息好，今天果然迟到了。
sentences.traditional: 他昨晚沒休息好，今天果然遲到了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuówǎn méi xiūxi hǎo, jīntiān guǒrán chídào le.
sentences.translation: As expected, he was late today after not resting well last night.

sentences.chinese: 天气预报说会下雨，下午果然下雨了。
sentences.traditional: 天氣預報說會下雨，下午果然下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō huì xià yǔ, xiàwǔ guǒrán xià yǔ le.
sentences.translation: The weather forecast said it would rain, and sure enough, it rained in the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 我早就觉得这个方案有风险，结果果然出了问题。
sentences.traditional: 我早就覺得這個方案有風險，結果果然出了問題。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo jiù juéde zhège fāng'àn yǒu fēngxiǎn, jiéguǒ guǒrán chū le wèntí.
sentences.translation: I had long felt this plan was risky, and as expected, problems occurred.

sentences.chinese: 秋天一到，树上的果实渐渐成熟了。
sentences.traditional: 秋天一到，樹上的果實漸漸成熟了。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān yí dào, shù shang de guǒshí jiànjiàn chéngshú le.
sentences.translation: When autumn arrives, the fruit on the trees gradually ripens.

sentences.chinese: 科学研究的果实需要经过长期积累才能出现。
sentences.traditional: 科學研究的果實需要經過長期積累才能出現。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū de guǒshí xūyào jīngguò chángqī jīlěi cái néng chūxiàn.
sentences.translation: The fruits of scientific research require long-term accumulation before they can appear.

sentences.chinese: 农民把最好的果实送到市场上销售。
sentences.traditional: 農民把最好的果實送到市場上銷售。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngmín bǎ zuì hǎo de guǒshí sòng dào shìchǎng shang xiāoshòu.
sentences.translation: Farmers send the best fruit to the market to sell.

sentences.chinese: 过度使用手机会影响睡眠质量。
sentences.traditional: 過度使用手機會影響睡眠質量。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù shǐyòng shǒujī huì yǐngxiǎng shuìmián zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Excessive use of mobile phones can affect sleep quality.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，过度紧张反而不利于恢复。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，過度緊張反而不利於恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, guòdù jǐnzhāng fǎn'ér bú lìyú huīfù.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him that excessive nervousness is actually not helpful for recovery.

sentences.chinese: 公司如果过度依赖单一客户，风险会很高。
sentences.traditional: 公司如果過度依賴單一客戶，風險會很高。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī rúguǒ guòdù yīlài dānyī kèhù, fēngxiǎn huì hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: If a company relies excessively on a single customer, the risk will be high.

sentences.chinese: 你这样批评他有些过分，毕竟他已经尽力了。
sentences.traditional: 你這樣批評他有些過分，畢竟他已經盡力了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng pīpíng tā yǒuxiē guòfèn, bìjìng tā yǐjīng jìn lì le.
sentences.translation: Criticising him like this is a bit excessive; after all, he has already done his best.

sentences.chinese: 提出合理要求可以，但不能过分影响别人的工作。
sentences.traditional: 提出合理要求可以，但不能過分影響別人的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tíchū hélǐ yāoqiú kěyǐ, dàn bù néng guòfèn yǐngxiǎng biérén de gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: It is fine to make reasonable demands, but you must not affect other people's work excessively.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的价格并不过分，只是装修比较高级。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的價格並不過分，只是裝修比較高級。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de jiàgé bìng bú guòfèn, zhǐshì zhuāngxiū bǐjiào gāojí.
sentences.translation: This shop's prices are not excessive; the decoration is just rather high-end.

sentences.chinese: 我对花粉过敏，春天出门时经常打喷嚏。
sentences.traditional: 我對花粉過敏，春天出門時經常打噴嚏。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì huāfěn guòmǐn, chūntiān chūmén shí jīngcháng dǎ pēntì.
sentences.translation: I am allergic to pollen, so I often sneeze when I go out in spring.

sentences.chinese: 如果你对这种药过敏，一定要提前告诉医生。
sentences.traditional: 如果你對這種藥過敏，一定要提前告訴醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ duì zhè zhǒng yào guòmǐn, yídìng yào tíqián gàosu yīshēng.
sentences.translation: If you are allergic to this medicine, you must tell the doctor in advance.

sentences.chinese: 孩子吃了海鲜以后皮肤发红，可能是过敏了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子吃了海鮮以後皮膚發紅，可能是過敏了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi chī le hǎixiān yǐhòu pífū fāhóng, kěnéng shì guòmǐn le.
sentences.translation: After eating seafood, the child's skin turned red; it may be an allergic reaction.

sentences.chinese: 这张优惠券昨天已经过期，不能再使用了。
sentences.traditional: 這張優惠券昨天已經過期，不能再使用了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yōuhuìquàn zuótiān yǐjīng guòqī, bù néng zài shǐyòng le.
sentences.translation: This voucher expired yesterday and can no longer be used.

sentences.chinese: 过期食品虽然看起来正常，但最好不要吃。
sentences.traditional: 過期食品雖然看起來正常，但最好不要吃。
sentences.pinyin: Guòqī shípǐn suīrán kàn qǐlai zhèngcháng, dàn zuìhǎo bú yào chī.
sentences.translation: Although expired food may look normal, it is best not to eat it.

sentences.chinese: 护照快过期了，他得尽快申请新的。
sentences.traditional: 護照快過期了，他得盡快申請新的。
sentences.pinyin: Hùzhào kuài guòqī le, tā děi jǐnkuài shēnqǐng xīn de.
sentences.translation: His passport is about to expire, so he has to apply for a new one as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划过于理想化，执行起来可能会遇到困难。
sentences.traditional: 這個計劃過於理想化，執行起來可能會遇到困難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà guòyú lǐxiǎnghuà, zhíxíng qǐlai kěnéng huì yù dào kùnnan.
sentences.translation: This plan is too idealistic, and it may run into difficulties when carried out.

sentences.chinese: 他过于关注细节，反而耽误了整体进度。
sentences.traditional: 他過於關注細節，反而耽誤了整體進度。
sentences.pinyin: Tā guòyú guānzhù xìjié, fǎn'ér dānwu le zhěngtǐ jìndù.
sentences.translation: He pays too much attention to details, which has instead delayed the overall progress.

sentences.chinese: 对孩子的要求过于严格，可能会影响他们的自信心。
sentences.traditional: 對孩子的要求過於嚴格，可能會影響他們的自信心。
sentences.pinyin: Duì háizi de yāoqiú guòyú yángé, kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng tāmen de zìxìnxīn.
sentences.translation: Being too strict in your demands of children may affect their confidence.

sentences.chinese: 哈，这个结果跟我猜的完全一样。
sentences.traditional: 哈，這個結果跟我猜的完全一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Hā, zhège jiéguǒ gēn wǒ cāi de wánquán yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Ha, this result is exactly the same as what I guessed.

sentences.chinese: 他听完这个笑话，忍不住哈地笑了出来。
sentences.traditional: 他聽完這個笑話，忍不住哈地笑了出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng wán zhège xiàohua, rěn bu zhù hā de xiào le chūlai.
sentences.translation: After hearing this joke, he could not help laughing out with a 'ha'.

sentences.chinese: 哈，你终于明白我刚才的意思了。
sentences.traditional: 哈，你終於明白我剛才的意思了。
sentences.pinyin: Hā, nǐ zhōngyú míngbai wǒ gāngcái de yìsi le.
sentences.translation: Ha, you have finally understood what I meant just now.

sentences.chinese: 进入这个国家之前，旅客必须先通过海关检查。
sentences.traditional: 進入這個國家之前，旅客必須先通過海關檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù zhège guójiā zhīqián, lǚkè bìxū xiān tōngguò hǎiguān jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: Before entering this country, travellers must first pass through customs inspection.

sentences.chinese: 这批货被海关扣留了，因为申报材料不完整。
sentences.traditional: 這批貨被海關扣留了，因為申報材料不完整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī huò bèi hǎiguān kòuliú le, yīnwèi shēnbào cáiliào bù wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: This batch of goods was held by customs because the declaration documents were incomplete.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在准备海关需要的发票和装箱单。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在準備海關需要的發票和裝箱單。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài zhǔnbèi hǎiguān xūyào de fāpiào hé zhuāngxiāngdān.
sentences.translation: The company is preparing the invoices and packing list required by customs.

sentences.chinese: 很多海外学生毕业后，仍然和当地朋友保持联系。
sentences.traditional: 很多海外學生畢業後，仍然和當地朋友保持聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō hǎiwài xuéshēng bìyè hòu, réngrán hé dāngdì péngyou bǎochí liánxì.
sentences.translation: Many overseas students still keep in touch with local friends after graduation.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司准备把产品卖到海外市场。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司準備把產品賣到海外市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhǔnbèi bǎ chǎnpǐn mài dào hǎiwài shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: This company is preparing to sell its products to overseas markets.

sentences.chinese: 他的小说在海外也受到了不少读者的欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 他的小說在海外也受到了不少讀者的歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiǎoshuō zài hǎiwài yě shòudào le bù shǎo dúzhě de huānyíng.
sentences.translation: His novel has also been welcomed by quite a few readers overseas.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的海鲜很新鲜，不过价格有点高。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的海鮮很新鮮，不過價格有點高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de hǎixiān hěn xīnxiān, búguò jiàgé yǒudiǎn gāo.
sentences.translation: The seafood at this restaurant is very fresh, but the prices are a bit high.

sentences.chinese: 如果对海鲜过敏，点菜前一定要先说明。
sentences.traditional: 如果對海鮮過敏，點菜前一定要先說明。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ duì hǎixiān guòmǐn, diǎn cài qián yídìng yào xiān shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: If you are allergic to seafood, you must explain this before ordering.

sentences.chinese: 沿海城市的市场里，海鲜种类通常特别多。
sentences.traditional: 沿海城市的市場裡，海鮮種類通常特別多。
sentences.pinyin: Yánhǎi chéngshì de shìchǎng lǐ, hǎixiān zhǒnglèi tōngcháng tèbié duō.
sentences.translation: In markets in coastal cities, there are usually especially many kinds of seafood.

sentences.chinese: 这句话含批评的意思，你不要只看表面。
sentences.traditional: 這句話含批評的意思，你不要只看表面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jù huà hán pīpíng de yìsi, nǐ bú yào zhǐ kàn biǎomiàn.
sentences.translation: This sentence contains a critical meaning; do not only look at the surface.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告含大量调查数据，因此比较有说服力。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告含大量調查數據，因此比較有說服力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào hán dàliàng diàochá shùjù, yīncǐ bǐjiào yǒu shuōfúlì.
sentences.translation: This report contains a large amount of survey data, so it is relatively persuasive.

sentences.chinese: 他的眼里含泪，却仍然坚持完成演讲。
sentences.traditional: 他的眼裡含淚，卻仍然堅持完成演講。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎn lǐ hán lèi, què réngrán jiānchí wánchéng yǎnjiǎng.
sentences.translation: There were tears in his eyes, but he still insisted on finishing the speech.

sentences.chinese: 这种饮料的糖含量太高，不适合天天喝。
sentences.traditional: 這種飲料的糖含量太高，不適合天天喝。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào de táng hánliàng tài gāo, bù shìhé tiāntiān hē.
