sentences.translation: The sugar content of this drink is too high, so it is not suitable to drink every day.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他多吃铁含量高的食物。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他多吃鐵含量高的食物。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā duō chī tiě hánliàng gāo de shíwù.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to eat more foods with a high iron content.

sentences.chinese: 包装上会清楚标明脂肪和盐的含量。
sentences.traditional: 包裝上會清楚標明脂肪和鹽的含量。
sentences.pinyin: Bāozhuāng shang huì qīngchu biāomíng zhīfáng hé yán de hánliàng.
sentences.translation: The packaging will clearly state the fat and salt content.

sentences.chinese: 这本书含有不少真实案例，读起来很有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 這本書含有不少真實案例，讀起來很有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hányǒu bù shǎo zhēnshí ànlì, dú qǐlai hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: This book contains quite a few real cases, so it is very helpful to read.

sentences.chinese: 这款药含有可能让人犯困的成分。
sentences.traditional: 這款藥含有可能讓人犯睏的成分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yào hányǒu kěnéng ràng rén fànkùn de chéngfèn.
sentences.translation: This medicine contains ingredients that may make people sleepy.

sentences.chinese: 合同中含有几条关于赔偿的规定。
sentences.traditional: 合同中含有幾條關於賠償的規定。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong zhōng hányǒu jǐ tiáo guānyú péicháng de guīdìng.
sentences.translation: The contract contains several rules about compensation.

sentences.chinese: 运动员的成功离不开长期训练中的汗水。
sentences.traditional: 運動員的成功離不開長期訓練中的汗水。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán de chénggōng lí bu kāi chángqī xùnliàn zhōng de hànshuǐ.
sentences.translation: An athlete’s success cannot be separated from the sweat of long-term training.

sentences.chinese: 他擦了擦额头上的汗水，继续往山顶爬。
sentences.traditional: 他擦了擦額頭上的汗水，繼續往山頂爬。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cā le cā étóu shang de hànshuǐ, jìxù wǎng shāndǐng pá.
sentences.translation: He wiped the sweat from his forehead and continued climbing towards the mountain top.

sentences.chinese: 这份成绩背后，是无数个夜晚的汗水和坚持。
sentences.traditional: 這份成績背後，是無數個夜晚的汗水和堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn chéngjì bèihòu, shì wúshù ge yèwǎn de hànshuǐ hé jiānchí.
sentences.translation: Behind this achievement are the sweat and persistence of countless nights.

sentences.chinese: 请把你的名字写在表格的第一行。
sentences.traditional: 請把你的名字寫在表格的第一行。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de míngzi xiě zài biǎogé de dì yī háng.
sentences.translation: Please write your name on the first line of the form.

sentences.chinese: 这首诗只有四行，却表达了很深的感情。
sentences.traditional: 這首詩只有四行，卻表達了很深的感情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī zhǐ yǒu sì háng, què biǎodá le hěn shēn de gǎnqíng.
sentences.translation: This poem has only four lines, yet it expresses very deep feelings.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们把这些汉字按笔画排成三行。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們把這些漢字按筆畫排成三行。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǎ zhèxiē Hànzì àn bǐhuà pái chéng sān háng.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to arrange these Chinese characters into three lines according to stroke count.

sentences.chinese: 人工智能正在改变许多传统行业的工作方式。
sentences.traditional: 人工智能正在改變許多傳統行業的工作方式。
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng zhèngzài gǎibiàn xǔduō chuántǒng hángyè de gōngzuò fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Artificial intelligence is changing the way many traditional industries work.

sentences.chinese: 进入一个新行业之前，最好先了解基本规则。
sentences.traditional: 進入一個新行業之前，最好先了解基本規則。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù yí ge xīn hángyè zhīqián, zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě jīběn guīzé.
sentences.translation: Before entering a new industry, it is best to understand the basic rules first.

sentences.chinese: 这个行业竞争激烈，服务质量决定了企业能走多远。
sentences.traditional: 這個行業競爭激烈，服務質量決定了企業能走多遠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hángyè jìngzhēng jīliè, fúwù zhìliàng juédìng le qǐyè néng zǒu duō yuǎn.
sentences.translation: Competition in this industry is fierce, and service quality determines how far a company can go.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片上映后，得到了观众的一致好评。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片上映後，得到了觀眾的一致好評。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn shàngyìng hòu, dédào le guānzhòng de yízhì hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: After this documentary was released, it received unanimous praise from the audience.

sentences.chinese: 他的服务态度很好，所以店铺收到了很多好评。
sentences.traditional: 他的服務態度很好，所以店鋪收到了很多好評。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fúwù tàidu hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ diànpù shōudào le hěn duō hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: His service attitude is very good, so the shop received many positive reviews.

sentences.chinese: 好评不只是靠宣传，还要靠真正的质量。
sentences.traditional: 好評不只是靠宣傳，還要靠真正的質量。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎopíng bù zhǐ shì kào xuānchuán, hái yào kào zhēnzhèng de zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Positive reviews do not come only from publicity; they also depend on real quality.

sentences.chinese: 祝你面试顺利，也希望好运一直陪着你。
sentences.traditional: 祝你面試順利，也希望好運一直陪著你。
sentences.pinyin: Zhù nǐ miànshì shùnlì, yě xīwàng hǎoyùn yìzhí péizhe nǐ.
sentences.translation: I wish you a smooth interview, and hope good luck stays with you.

sentences.chinese: 他能通过考试不只是因为好运，更因为准备充分。
sentences.traditional: 他能通過考試不只是因為好運，更因為準備充分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā néng tōngguò kǎoshì bù zhǐ shì yīnwèi hǎoyùn, gèng yīnwèi zhǔnbèi chōngfèn.
sentences.translation: He passed the exam not only because of good luck, but even more because he was well prepared.

sentences.chinese: 有时候好运会来，但机会只留给有准备的人。
sentences.traditional: 有時候好運會來，但機會只留給有準備的人。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou hǎoyùn huì lái, dàn jīhuì zhǐ liú gěi yǒu zhǔnbèi de rén.
sentences.translation: Sometimes good luck comes, but opportunities are only left for those who are prepared.

sentences.chinese: 经过几个月的治疗，他的身体状况终于开始好转。
sentences.traditional: 經過幾個月的治療，他的身體狀況終於開始好轉。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de zhìliáo, tā de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng zhōngyú kāishǐ hǎozhuǎn.
sentences.translation: After several months of treatment, his physical condition finally began to improve.

sentences.chinese: 公司调整了管理方式后，销售情况明显好转。
sentences.traditional: 公司調整了管理方式後，銷售情況明顯好轉。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī tiáozhěng le guǎnlǐ fāngshì hòu, xiāoshòu qíngkuàng míngxiǎn hǎozhuǎn.
sentences.translation: After the company adjusted its management methods, the sales situation clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 天气虽然还冷，但从下午起已经有好转的迹象。
sentences.traditional: 天氣雖然還冷，但從下午起已經有好轉的跡象。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì suīrán hái lěng, dàn cóng xiàwǔ qǐ yǐjīng yǒu hǎozhuǎn de jìxiàng.
sentences.translation: Although the weather is still cold, there have already been signs of improvement since the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 他从小好读书，常常一坐就是一下午。
sentences.traditional: 他從小好讀書，常常一坐就是一下午。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo hào dúshū, chángcháng yí zuò jiù shì yí xiàwǔ.
sentences.translation: He has loved reading since he was young and often sits for a whole afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 这位学者好思考，不轻易接受没有证据的观点。
sentences.traditional: 這位學者好思考，不輕易接受沒有證據的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuézhě hào sīkǎo, bù qīngyì jiēshòu méiyǒu zhèngjù de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: This scholar is fond of thinking and does not easily accept views without evidence.

sentences.chinese: 有些人好面子，所以即使遇到困难也不愿求助。
sentences.traditional: 有些人好面子，所以即使遇到困難也不願求助。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén hào miànzi, suǒyǐ jíshǐ yùdào kùnnan yě bú yuàn qiúzhù.
sentences.translation: Some people care a lot about face, so even when they meet difficulties they are unwilling to ask for help.

sentences.chinese: 孩子对世界充满好奇，总是不停地问为什么。
sentences.traditional: 孩子對世界充滿好奇，總是不停地問為什麼。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi duì shìjiè chōngmǎn hàoqí, zǒngshì bù tíng de wèn wèishénme.
sentences.translation: Children are full of curiosity about the world and are always asking why.

sentences.chinese: 我很好奇，他为什么突然改变了原来的决定。
sentences.traditional: 我很好奇，他為什麼突然改變了原來的決定。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hàoqí, tā wèishénme tūrán gǎibiàn le yuánlái de juédìng.
sentences.translation: I am very curious why he suddenly changed his original decision.

sentences.chinese: 对陌生文化保持好奇，能帮助我们减少误解。
sentences.traditional: 對陌生文化保持好奇，能幫助我們減少誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Duì mòshēng wénhuà bǎochí hàoqí, néng bāngzhù wǒmen jiǎnshǎo wùjiě.
sentences.translation: Staying curious about unfamiliar cultures can help us reduce misunderstandings.

sentences.chinese: 请把书合上，我们先讨论刚才的问题。
sentences.traditional: 請把書合上，我們先討論剛才的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū hé shang, wǒmen xiān tǎolùn gāngcái de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Please close your book; we will discuss the previous question first.

sentences.chinese: 这两块木板合得很紧，几乎看不出缝。
sentences.traditional: 這兩塊木板合得很緊，幾乎看不出縫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng kuài mùbǎn hé de hěn jǐn, jīhū kàn bu chū fèng.
sentences.translation: These two wooden boards fit together very tightly; you can hardly see the gap.

sentences.chinese: 两家公司合在一起后，市场竞争力更强了。
sentences.traditional: 兩家公司合在一起後，市場競爭力更強了。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī hé zài yìqǐ hòu, shìchǎng jìngzhēnglì gèng qiáng le.
sentences.translation: After the two companies joined together, their market competitiveness became stronger.

sentences.chinese: 只有手续合法，这笔交易才能继续进行。
sentences.traditional: 只有手續合法，這筆交易才能繼續進行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu shǒuxù héfǎ, zhè bǐ jiāoyì cái néng jìxù jìnxíng.
sentences.translation: Only if the procedures are legal can this transaction continue.

sentences.chinese: 公司必须证明所有收入都来自合法渠道。
sentences.traditional: 公司必須證明所有收入都來自合法渠道。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī bìxū zhèngmíng suǒyǒu shōurù dōu láizì héfǎ qúdào.
sentences.translation: The company must prove that all its income comes from legal channels.

sentences.chinese: 在网上使用图片时，也要注意版权是否合法。
sentences.traditional: 在網上使用圖片時，也要注意版權是否合法。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǎngshàng shǐyòng túpiàn shí, yě yào zhùyì bǎnquán shìfǒu héfǎ.
sentences.translation: When using images online, you also need to pay attention to whether the copyright is legal.

sentences.chinese: 中午太忙时，大家常常在办公室里吃盒饭。
sentences.traditional: 中午太忙時，大家常常在辦公室裡吃盒飯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ tài máng shí, dàjiā chángcháng zài bàngōngshì lǐ chī héfàn.
sentences.translation: When lunchtime is too busy, everyone often eats boxed meals in the office.

sentences.chinese: 这份盒饭虽然简单，但营养搭配还算合理。
sentences.traditional: 這份盒飯雖然簡單，但營養搭配還算合理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn héfàn suīrán jiǎndān, dàn yíngyǎng dāpèi hái suàn hélǐ.
sentences.translation: Although this boxed meal is simple, its nutritional balance is still fairly reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 火车站附近有一家专门卖盒饭的小店。
sentences.traditional: 火車站附近有一家專門賣盒飯的小店。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn fùjìn yǒu yì jiā zhuānmén mài héfàn de xiǎo diàn.
sentences.translation: There is a small shop near the railway station that specialises in selling boxed meals.

sentences.chinese: 你的建议很合理，我们可以把它加入计划。
sentences.traditional: 你的建議很合理，我們可以把它加入計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de jiànyì hěn hélǐ, wǒmen kěyǐ bǎ tā jiārù jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Your suggestion is very reasonable; we can add it to the plan.

sentences.chinese: 价格上涨需要有合理的解释，否则消费者不会接受。
sentences.traditional: 價格上漲需要有合理的解釋，否則消費者不會接受。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé shàngzhǎng xūyào yǒu hélǐ de jiěshì, fǒuzé xiāofèizhě bú huì jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: A price increase needs a reasonable explanation; otherwise consumers will not accept it.

sentences.chinese: 时间安排得是否合理，会直接影响项目进度。
sentences.traditional: 時間安排得是否合理，會直接影響項目進度。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān ānpái de shìfǒu hélǐ, huì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng xiàngmù jìndù.
sentences.translation: Whether the time arrangement is reasonable will directly affect the project progress.

sentences.chinese: 这条河流经过几个省，最后流入大海。
sentences.traditional: 這條河流經過幾個省，最後流入大海。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo héliú jīngguò jǐ ge shěng, zuìhòu liúrù dàhǎi.
sentences.translation: This river passes through several provinces and finally flows into the sea.

sentences.chinese: 工厂排放废水会严重污染附近的河流。
sentences.traditional: 工廠排放廢水會嚴重污染附近的河流。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng páifàng fèishuǐ huì yánzhòng wūrǎn fùjìn de héliú.
sentences.translation: Factory wastewater discharge can seriously pollute nearby rivers.

sentences.chinese: 古代文明往往在河流两岸发展起来。
sentences.traditional: 古代文明往往在河流兩岸發展起來。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔdài wénmíng wǎngwǎng zài héliú liǎng'àn fāzhǎn qǐlai.
sentences.translation: Ancient civilisations often developed along both banks of rivers.

sentences.chinese: 签合同前，最好仔细阅读每一项条款。
sentences.traditional: 簽合同前，最好仔細閱讀每一項條款。
sentences.pinyin: Qiān hétong qián, zuìhǎo zǐxì yuèdú měi yí xiàng tiáokuǎn.
sentences.translation: Before signing a contract, it is best to read every clause carefully.

sentences.chinese: 如果一方违反合同，另一方可以要求赔偿。
sentences.traditional: 如果一方違反合同，另一方可以要求賠償。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yì fāng wéifǎn hétong, lìng yì fāng kěyǐ yāoqiú péicháng.
sentences.translation: If one party breaches the contract, the other party may demand compensation.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同明确规定了双方的责任和权利。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同明確規定了雙方的責任和權利。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong míngquè guīdìng le shuāngfāng de zérèn hé quánlì.
sentences.translation: This contract clearly sets out the responsibilities and rights of both parties.

sentences.chinese: 毕业典礼结束后，全班同学在校门口合影。
sentences.traditional: 畢業典禮結束後，全班同學在校門口合影。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyè diǎnlǐ jiéshù hòu, quán bān tóngxué zài xiàoménkǒu héyǐng.
sentences.translation: After the graduation ceremony ended, the whole class took a group photo at the school gate.

sentences.chinese: 这张合影记录了我们第一次参加国际会议的经历。
sentences.traditional: 這張合影記錄了我們第一次參加國際會議的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng héyǐng jìlù le wǒmen dì yī cì cānjiā guójì huìyì de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: This group photo records our experience of attending an international conference for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 领导来参观时，工作人员纷纷要求和他合影。
sentences.traditional: 領導來參觀時，工作人員紛紛要求和他合影。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo lái cānguān shí, gōngzuò rényuán fēnfēn yāoqiú hé tā héyǐng.
sentences.translation: When the leader came to visit, the staff members all asked to take a group photo with him.

sentences.chinese: 这次项目需要两个部门密切合作，才能按时完成。
sentences.traditional: 這次項目需要兩個部門密切合作，才能按時完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù xūyào liǎng ge bùmén mìqiè hézuò, cái néng ànshí wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This project requires the two departments to cooperate closely in order to finish on time.

sentences.chinese: 如果双方愿意长期合作，就必须建立互相信任的关系。
sentences.traditional: 如果雙方願意長期合作，就必須建立互相信任的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shuāngfāng yuànyì chángqī hézuò, jiù bìxū jiànlì hùxiāng xìnrèn de guānxì.
sentences.translation: If both sides are willing to cooperate long term, they must build a relationship of mutual trust.

sentences.chinese: 学校和企业合作，为学生提供更多实习机会。
sentences.traditional: 學校和企業合作，為學生提供更多實習機會。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào hé qǐyè hézuò, wèi xuéshēng tígōng gèng duō shíxí jīhuì.
sentences.translation: The school and the company cooperate to provide students with more internship opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 天一黑，山路就变得特别难走。
sentences.traditional: 天一黑，山路就變得特別難走。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān yì hēi, shānlù jiù biàn de tèbié nán zǒu.
sentences.translation: Once it gets dark, the mountain road becomes especially difficult to walk on.

sentences.chinese: 他穿了一件黑外套，在人群中很容易被认出来。
sentences.traditional: 他穿了一件黑外套，在人群中很容易被認出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān le yí jiàn hēi wàitào, zài rénqún zhōng hěn róngyì bèi rèn chūlái.
sentences.translation: He wore a black coat, so he was easy to recognise in the crowd.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片背景太黑，看不清人物的表情。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片背景太黑，看不清人物的表情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn bèijǐng tài hēi, kàn bu qīng rénwù de biǎoqíng.
sentences.translation: The background of this photo is too dark, so the person’s expression cannot be seen clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这条红裙子虽然简单，却显得很有气质。
sentences.traditional: 這條紅裙子雖然簡單，卻顯得很有氣質。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hóng qúnzi suīrán jiǎndān, què xiǎnde hěn yǒu qìzhì.
sentences.translation: Although this red dress is simple, it looks very elegant.

sentences.chinese: 上涨的部分用红标出来，下降的部分用绿色标出来。
sentences.traditional: 上漲的部分用紅標出來，下降的部分用綠色標出來。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngzhǎng de bùfen yòng hóng biāo chūlái, xiàjiàng de bùfen yòng lǜsè biāo chūlái.
sentences.translation: The rising parts are marked in red, and the falling parts are marked in green.

sentences.chinese: 这面红墙和周围的绿色植物形成了鲜明对比。
sentences.traditional: 這面紅牆和周圍的綠色植物形成了鮮明對比。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè miàn hóng qiáng hé zhōuwéi de lǜsè zhíwù xíngchéng le xiānmíng duìbǐ.
sentences.translation: This red wall forms a sharp contrast with the green plants around it.

sentences.chinese: 动物园里的猴子很聪明，会模仿游客的动作。
sentences.traditional: 動物園裡的猴子很聰明，會模仿遊客的動作。
sentences.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ de hóuzi hěn cōngmíng, huì mófǎng yóukè de dòngzuò.
sentences.translation: The monkeys in the zoo are clever and can imitate visitors’ movements.

sentences.chinese: 在那座寺庙附近，猴子常常抢游客手里的食物。
sentences.traditional: 在那座寺廟附近，猴子常常搶遊客手裡的食物。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà zuò sìmiào fùjìn, hóuzi chángcháng qiǎng yóukè shǒu lǐ de shíwù.
sentences.translation: Near that temple, monkeys often snatch food from tourists’ hands.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们一看到猴子爬上树，就兴奋地叫了起来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們一看到猴子爬上樹，就興奮地叫了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yí kàn dào hóuzi pá shàng shù, jiù xīngfèn de jiào le qǐlái.
sentences.translation: As soon as the children saw the monkey climb up the tree, they cried out excitedly.

sentences.chinese: 这块玻璃的厚度不够，承受不了那么大的压力。
sentences.traditional: 這塊玻璃的厚度不夠，承受不了那麼大的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài bōli de hòudù bú gòu, chéngshòu bù liǎo nàme dà de yālì.
sentences.translation: The thickness of this piece of glass is not enough; it cannot bear that much pressure.

sentences.chinese: 设计产品时，材料的厚度会影响重量和成本。
sentences.traditional: 設計產品時，材料的厚度會影響重量和成本。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjì chǎnpǐn shí, cáiliào de hòudù huì yǐngxiǎng zhòngliàng hé chéngběn.
sentences.translation: When designing a product, the thickness of the material affects its weight and cost.

sentences.chinese: 医生通过检查皮肤厚度，判断恢复情况是否正常。
sentences.traditional: 醫生通過檢查皮膚厚度，判斷恢復情況是否正常。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngguò jiǎnchá pífū hòudù, pànduàn huīfù qíngkuàng shìfǒu zhèngcháng.
sentences.translation: The doctor judges whether recovery is normal by checking the thickness of the skin.

sentences.chinese: 如果继续忽视这个问题，后果可能会非常严重。
sentences.traditional: 如果繼續忽視這個問題，後果可能會非常嚴重。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ jìxù hūshì zhège wèntí, hòuguǒ kěnéng huì fēicháng yánzhòng.
sentences.translation: If this problem continues to be ignored, the consequences may be very serious.

sentences.chinese: 做决定之前，应该先考虑可能产生的后果。
sentences.traditional: 做決定之前，應該先考慮可能產生的後果。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò juédìng zhīqián, yīnggāi xiān kǎolǜ kěnéng chǎnshēng de hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, you should first consider the possible consequences.

sentences.chinese: 他没有按规定操作，结果必须承担相应的后果。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有按規定操作，結果必須承擔相應的後果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu àn guīdìng cāozuò, jiéguǒ bìxū chéngdān xiāngyìng de hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: He did not operate according to the rules, so he must bear the corresponding consequences.

sentences.chinese: 家长不能只关心成绩，而忽视孩子的心理健康。
sentences.traditional: 家長不能只關心成績，而忽視孩子的心理健康。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāzhǎng bù néng zhǐ guānxīn chéngjì, ér hūshì háizi de xīnlǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Parents cannot only care about grades while ignoring their children’s mental health.

sentences.chinese: 这个细节虽然小，却不应该被忽视。
sentences.traditional: 這個細節雖然小，卻不應該被忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xìjié suīrán xiǎo, què bù yīnggāi bèi hūshì.
sentences.translation: Although this detail is small, it should not be overlooked.

sentences.chinese: 企业如果忽视顾客的反馈，就很难长期发展。
sentences.traditional: 企業如果忽視顧客的反饋，就很難長期發展。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè rúguǒ hūshì gùkè de fǎnkuì, jiù hěn nán chángqī fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: If a business ignores customer feedback, it will find it hard to develop in the long term.

sentences.chinese: 请放慢呼吸，让身体慢慢恢复平静。
sentences.traditional: 請放慢呼吸，讓身體慢慢恢復平靜。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng fàngmàn hūxī, ràng shēntǐ mànmàn huīfù píngjìng.
sentences.translation: Please slow your breathing and let your body gradually return to calm.

sentences.chinese: 海边的空气很清新，呼吸起来特别舒服。
sentences.traditional: 海邊的空氣很清新，呼吸起來特別舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎibiān de kōngqì hěn qīngxīn, hūxī qǐlái tèbié shūfu.
sentences.translation: The air by the sea is fresh, and breathing it in feels especially comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 跑完五公里后，他的呼吸变得又急又重。
sentences.traditional: 跑完五公里後，他的呼吸變得又急又重。
sentences.pinyin: Pǎo wán wǔ gōnglǐ hòu, tā de hūxī biàn de yòu jí yòu zhòng.
sentences.translation: After running five kilometres, his breathing became both fast and heavy.

sentences.chinese: 这个湖的水质越来越好，吸引了很多鸟类。
sentences.traditional: 這個湖的水質越來越好，吸引了很多鳥類。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hú de shuǐzhì yuè lái yuè hǎo, xīyǐn le hěn duō niǎolèi.
sentences.translation: The water quality of this lake is getting better and better, attracting many birds.

sentences.chinese: 清晨的湖面很平静，像一面巨大的镜子。
sentences.traditional: 清晨的湖面很平靜，像一面巨大的鏡子。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén de húmiàn hěn píngjìng, xiàng yí miàn jùdà de jìngzi.
sentences.translation: The surface of the lake in the early morning is calm, like a huge mirror.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划在湖边修一条供人散步的道路。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃在湖邊修一條供人散步的道路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà zài hú biān xiū yì tiáo gōng rén sànbù de dàolù.
sentences.translation: The government plans to build a path by the lake for people to walk on.

sentences.chinese: 春天一到，花园里就能看到各种颜色的蝴蝶。
sentences.traditional: 春天一到，花園裡就能看到各種顏色的蝴蝶。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān yí dào, huāyuán lǐ jiù néng kàn dào gè zhǒng yánsè de húdié.
sentences.translation: As soon as spring arrives, you can see butterflies of all colours in the garden.

sentences.chinese: 科学家通过研究蝴蝶，了解环境变化对生物的影响。
sentences.traditional: 科學家通過研究蝴蝶，了解環境變化對生物的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā tōngguò yánjiū húdié, liǎojiě huánjìng biànhuà duì shēngwù de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Scientists understand the effects of environmental change on living things by studying butterflies.

sentences.chinese: 那只蝴蝶停在窗边，好像一点也不怕人。
sentences.traditional: 那隻蝴蝶停在窗邊，好像一點也不怕人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī húdié tíng zài chuāngbiān, hǎoxiàng yìdiǎn yě bú pà rén.
sentences.translation: That butterfly stopped by the window as if it was not afraid of people at all.

sentences.chinese: 北京老城区的胡同保留了许多传统生活的痕迹。
sentences.traditional: 北京老城區的胡同保留了許多傳統生活的痕跡。
sentences.pinyin: Běijīng lǎo chéngqū de hútòng bǎoliú le xǔduō chuántǒng shēnghuó de hénjì.
sentences.translation: The hutongs in Beijing’s old city preserve many traces of traditional life.

sentences.chinese: 游客走进胡同以后，才真正感受到这座城市的历史。
sentences.traditional: 遊客走進胡同以後，才真正感受到這座城市的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè zǒu jìn hútòng yǐhòu, cái zhēnzhèng gǎnshòu dào zhè zuò chéngshì de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: Only after tourists walk into the hutongs do they truly feel the history of the city.

sentences.chinese: 虽然那条胡同比较窄，但附近的居民都很熟悉彼此。
sentences.traditional: 雖然那條胡同比較窄，但附近的居民都很熟悉彼此。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán nà tiáo hútòng bǐjiào zhǎi, dàn fùjìn de jūmín dōu hěn shúxī bǐcǐ.
sentences.translation: Although that alley is quite narrow, the nearby residents all know each other well.

sentences.chinese: 老师鼓励学生在课堂上多互动，而不是只听讲。
sentences.traditional: 老師鼓勵學生在課堂上多互動，而不是只聽講。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì xuésheng zài kètáng shang duō hùdòng, ér bú shì zhǐ tīngjiǎng.
sentences.translation: The teacher encourages students to interact more in class rather than only listen.

sentences.chinese: 这种互动方式不仅提高了效率，也拉近了同事之间的距离。
sentences.traditional: 這種互動方式不僅提高了效率，也拉近了同事之間的距離。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng hùdòng fāngshì bùjǐn tígāo le xiàolǜ, yě lājìn le tóngshì zhījiān de jùlí.
sentences.translation: This way of interacting not only improves efficiency but also brings colleagues closer.

sentences.chinese: 孩子在游戏中互动得越积极，学习效果往往越好。
sentences.traditional: 孩子在遊戲中互動得越積極，學習效果往往越好。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zài yóuxì zhōng hùdòng de yuè jījí, xuéxí xiàoguǒ wǎngwǎng yuè hǎo.
sentences.translation: The more actively children interact in games, the better the learning results often are.

sentences.chinese: 周末的户外活动因为天气原因被临时取消了。
sentences.traditional: 週末的戶外活動因為天氣原因被臨時取消了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò de hùwài huódòng yīnwèi tiānqì yuányīn bèi línshí qǔxiāo le.
sentences.translation: The weekend outdoor activity was temporarily cancelled because of the weather.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他多进行户外运动，以改善睡眠质量。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他多進行戶外運動，以改善睡眠質量。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā duō jìnxíng hùwài yùndòng, yǐ gǎishàn shuìmián zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to do more outdoor exercise to improve his sleep quality.

sentences.chinese: 相比室内课程，户外教学更容易让孩子接触自然。
sentences.traditional: 相比室內課程，戶外教學更容易讓孩子接觸自然。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngbǐ shìnèi kèchéng, hùwài jiàoxué gèng róngyì ràng háizi jiēchù zìrán.
sentences.translation: Compared with indoor lessons, outdoor teaching more easily lets children come into contact with nature.

sentences.chinese: 修这座桥花费了大量资金，但确实方便了两岸居民。
sentences.traditional: 修這座橋花費了大量資金，但確實方便了兩岸居民。
sentences.pinyin: Xiū zhè zuò qiáo huāfèi le dàliàng zījīn, dàn quèshí fāngbiàn le liǎng'àn jūmín.
sentences.translation: Repairing this bridge cost a large amount of money, but it really made life easier for residents on both banks.

sentences.chinese: 如果每天在通勤上花费太久，工作效率也会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果每天在通勤上花費太久，工作效率也會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ měi tiān zài tōngqín shang huāfèi tài jiǔ, gōngzuò xiàolǜ yě huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If you spend too long commuting every day, your work efficiency will also be affected.

sentences.chinese: 为了完成这份报告，团队花费了整整两个星期。
sentences.traditional: 為了完成這份報告，團隊花費了整整兩個星期。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile wánchéng zhè fèn bàogào, tuánduì huāfèi le zhěngzhěng liǎng gè xīngqī.
sentences.translation: To complete this report, the team spent a full two weeks.

sentences.chinese: 雨后的台阶很滑，老人上下楼时要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 雨後的臺階很滑，老人上下樓時要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu de táijiē hěn huá, lǎorén shàng xià lóu shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: The steps are very slippery after the rain, so elderly people need to be especially careful going up and down.

sentences.chinese: 他一不小心脚下一滑，差点摔倒在地。
sentences.traditional: 他一不小心腳下一滑，差點摔倒在地。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí bù xiǎoxīn jiǎoxià yì huá, chàdiǎn shuāidǎo zài dì.
sentences.translation: He was careless and his foot slipped, and he nearly fell to the ground.

sentences.chinese: 手机屏幕太小，手指轻轻一滑就容易点错。
sentences.traditional: 手機屏幕太小，手指輕輕一滑就容易點錯。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī píngmù tài xiǎo, shǒuzhǐ qīngqīng yì huá jiù róngyì diǎn cuò.
sentences.translation: The phone screen is too small, so with a slight slide of the finger it is easy to tap the wrong thing.

sentences.chinese: 他们租了一条小船，在湖上慢慢地划。
sentences.traditional: 他們租了一條小船，在湖上慢慢地划。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zū le yì tiáo xiǎo chuán, zài hú shang mànmàn de huá.
sentences.translation: They rented a small boat and paddled slowly on the lake.

sentences.chinese: 风越来越大，我们只好用力往岸边划。
sentences.traditional: 風越來越大，我們只好用力往岸邊划。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng yuè lái yuè dà, wǒmen zhǐhǎo yònglì wǎng ànbiān huá.
sentences.translation: The wind grew stronger and stronger, so we had no choice but to paddle hard towards the bank.

sentences.chinese: 如果不懂得配合，两个人一起划反而会更累。
sentences.traditional: 如果不懂得配合，兩個人一起划反而會更累。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù dǒngde pèihé, liǎng gè rén yìqǐ huá fǎn'ér huì gèng lèi.
sentences.translation: If they do not know how to cooperate, two people paddling together will actually be more tiring.

sentences.chinese: 城市现代化的速度很快，但传统文化也应该被保护。
sentences.traditional: 城市現代化的速度很快，但傳統文化也應該被保護。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì xiàndàihuà de sùdù hěn kuài, dàn chuántǒng wénhuà yě yīnggāi bèi bǎohù.
sentences.translation: The pace of urban modernisation is fast, but traditional culture should also be protected.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司正在推动数字化管理，以减少人工错误。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司正在推動數字化管理，以減少人工錯誤。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài tuīdòng shùzìhuà guǎnlǐ, yǐ jiǎnshǎo réngōng cuòwù.
sentences.translation: This company is promoting digital management in order to reduce human error.

sentences.chinese: 随着社区绿化改善，居民的生活环境明显变好了。
sentences.traditional: 隨著社區綠化改善，居民的生活環境明顯變好了。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe shèqū lǜhuà gǎishàn, jūmín de shēnghuó huánjìng míngxiǎn biàn hǎo le.
sentences.translation: As the community’s greening improved, residents’ living environment clearly got better.

sentences.chinese: 这个月的话费明显增加，可能是因为他经常打国际电话。
sentences.traditional: 這個月的話費明顯增加，可能是因為他經常打國際電話。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yuè de huàfèi míngxiǎn zēngjiā, kěnéng shì yīnwèi tā jīngcháng dǎ guójì diànhuà.
sentences.translation: This month’s phone bill has clearly increased, probably because he often makes international calls.

sentences.chinese: 公司每月给销售人员报销一定额度的话费。
sentences.traditional: 公司每月給銷售人員報銷一定額度的話費。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī měi yuè gěi xiāoshòu rényuán bàoxiāo yídìng édù de huàfèi.
sentences.translation: The company reimburses sales staff for a certain amount of call charges each month.

sentences.chinese: 要是忘了交话费，手机很可能会被暂停服务。
sentences.traditional: 要是忘了交話費，手機很可能會被暫停服務。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi wàng le jiāo huàfèi, shǒujī hěn kěnéng huì bèi zàntíng fúwù.
sentences.translation: If you forget to pay the phone bill, the mobile service is very likely to be suspended.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片的画面非常清晰，让人仿佛亲眼看见了现场。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片的畫面非常清晰，讓人彷彿親眼看見了現場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn de huàmiàn fēicháng qīngxī, ràng rén fǎngfú qīnyǎn kànjiàn le xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: The images in this documentary are very clear, making people feel as if they saw the scene with their own eyes.

sentences.chinese: 导演通过安静的画面表现人物内心的压力。
sentences.traditional: 導演通過安靜的畫面表現人物內心的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn tōngguò ānjìng de huàmiàn biǎoxiàn rénwù nèixīn de yālì.
sentences.translation: The director uses quiet scenes to show the inner pressure of the characters.

sentences.chinese: 电脑突然死机，画面停在了付款页面上。
sentences.traditional: 電腦突然死機，畫面停在了付款頁面上。
sentences.pinyin: Diànnǎo tūrán sǐjī, huàmiàn tíng zài le fùkuǎn yèmiàn shang.
sentences.translation: The computer suddenly crashed, and the screen froze on the payment page.

sentences.chinese: 这个话题比较敏感，开会时最好先听听大家的意见。
sentences.traditional: 這個話題比較敏感，開會時最好先聽聽大家的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huàtí bǐjiào mǐngǎn, kāihuì shí zuìhǎo xiān tīngting dàjiā de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: This topic is quite sensitive, so it would be best to first listen to everyone’s opinions during the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 每当谈到教育问题，他总能提出很多有价值的话题。
sentences.traditional: 每當談到教育問題，他總能提出很多有價值的話題。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dāng tán dào jiàoyù wèntí, tā zǒng néng tíchū hěn duō yǒu jiàzhí de huàtí.
sentences.translation: Whenever education issues are discussed, he can always raise many valuable topics.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免尴尬，她很自然地把话题转到了旅行上。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免尷尬，她很自然地把話題轉到了旅行上。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn gāngà, tā hěn zìrán de bǎ huàtí zhuǎn dào le lǚxíng shang.
sentences.translation: To avoid awkwardness, she naturally shifted the topic to travel.

sentences.chinese: 高中化学不仅要求记公式，还要求理解实验背后的原理。
sentences.traditional: 高中化學不僅要求記公式，還要求理解實驗背後的原理。
sentences.pinyin: Gāozhōng huàxué bùjǐn yāoqiú jì gōngshì, hái yāoqiú lǐjiě shíyàn bèihòu de yuánlǐ.
sentences.translation: High school chemistry not only requires memorising formulae, but also understanding the principles behind experiments.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有基础的化学知识，很难解释这种材料为什么会变色。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有基礎的化學知識，很難解釋這種材料為什麼會變色。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu jīchǔ de huàxué zhīshi, hěn nán jiěshì zhè zhǒng cáiliào wèishénme huì biànsè.
sentences.translation: Without basic chemistry knowledge, it is hard to explain why this material changes colour.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司把化学技术应用到环保产品的开发中。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司把化學技術應用到環保產品的開發中。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī bǎ huàxué jìshù yìngyòng dào huánbǎo chǎnpǐn de kāifā zhōng.
sentences.translation: This company applies chemistry technology to the development of environmentally friendly products.

sentences.chinese: 产品质量下降，问题可能出在生产环节。
sentences.traditional: 產品質量下降，問題可能出在生產環節。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn zhìliàng xiàjiàng, wèntí kěnéng chū zài shēngchǎn huánjié.
sentences.translation: If product quality has fallen, the problem may be in the production stage.

sentences.chinese: 在整个申请过程中，面试是最关键的环节之一。
sentences.traditional: 在整個申請過程中，面試是最關鍵的環節之一。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhěnggè shēnqǐng guòchéng zhōng, miànshì shì zuì guānjiàn de huánjié zhī yī.
sentences.translation: In the whole application process, the interview is one of the most important stages.

sentences.chinese: 如果前一个环节没有完成，后面的工作都会受影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果前一個環節沒有完成，後面的工作都會受影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qián yí gè huánjié méiyǒu wánchéng, hòumiàn de gōngzuò dōu huì shòu yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If the previous stage has not been completed, the following work will all be affected.

sentences.chinese: 多喝水并不能解决所有问题，但可以缓解嗓子干的不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 多喝水並不能解決所有問題，但可以緩解嗓子乾的不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Duō hē shuǐ bìng bù néng jiějué suǒyǒu wèntí, dàn kěyǐ huǎnjiě sǎngzi gān de bù shūfu.
sentences.translation: Drinking more water cannot solve every problem, but it can ease the discomfort of a dry throat.

sentences.chinese: 为了缓解交通压力，市中心增加了几条公交线路。
sentences.traditional: 為了緩解交通壓力，市中心增加了幾條公交線路。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě jiāotōng yālì, shì zhōngxīn zēngjiā le jǐ tiáo gōngjiāo xiànlù.
sentences.translation: To ease traffic pressure, the city centre added several bus routes.

sentences.chinese: 这次谈判虽然没有解决根本矛盾，却暂时缓解了双方的紧张关系。
sentences.traditional: 這次談判雖然沒有解決根本矛盾，卻暫時緩解了雙方的緊張關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn suīrán méiyǒu jiějué gēnběn máodùn, què zànshí huǎnjiě le shuāngfāng de jǐnzhāng guānxi.
sentences.translation: Although this negotiation did not resolve the fundamental conflict, it temporarily eased the tense relationship between the two sides.

sentences.chinese: 由于资料不完整，整个审批过程进展得十分缓慢。
sentences.traditional: 由於資料不完整，整個審批過程進展得十分緩慢。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zīliào bù wánzhěng, zhěnggè shěnpī guòchéng jìnzhǎn de shífēn huǎnmàn.
sentences.translation: Because the documents are incomplete, the whole approval process is progressing very slowly.

sentences.chinese: 老人的身体恢复得比较缓慢，需要家人耐心照顾。
sentences.traditional: 老人的身體恢復得比較緩慢，需要家人耐心照顧。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén de shēntǐ huīfù de bǐjiào huǎnmàn, xūyào jiārén nàixīn zhàogù.
sentences.translation: The old person’s body is recovering rather slowly and needs patient care from family members.

sentences.chinese: 这条河流穿过平原，水流缓慢而平稳。
sentences.traditional: 這條河流穿過平原，水流緩慢而平穩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo héliú chuānguò píngyuán, shuǐliú huǎnmàn ér píngwěn.
sentences.translation: This river passes through a plain, and its current is slow and steady.

sentences.chinese: 夏天吃凉拌黄瓜，既清爽又简单。
sentences.traditional: 夏天吃涼拌黃瓜，既清爽又簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān chī liángbàn huángguā, jì qīngshuǎng yòu jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: Eating cold cucumber salad in summer is both refreshing and simple.

sentences.chinese: 她把黄瓜切成细条，放进了准备好的沙拉里。
sentences.traditional: 她把黃瓜切成細條，放進了準備好的沙拉裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ huángguā qiē chéng xì tiáo, fàng jìn le zhǔnbèi hǎo de shālā lǐ.
sentences.translation: She cut the cucumber into thin strips and put them into the prepared salad.

sentences.chinese: 这种黄瓜在温室里种植，所以一年四季都能买到。
sentences.traditional: 這種黃瓜在溫室裡種植，所以一年四季都能買到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huángguā zài wēnshì lǐ zhòngzhí, suǒyǐ yì nián sì jì dōu néng mǎi dào.
sentences.translation: This kind of cucumber is grown in greenhouses, so it can be bought all year round.

sentences.chinese: 在经济不稳定的时候，很多人会选择购买黄金保值。
sentences.traditional: 在經濟不穩定的時候，很多人會選擇購買黃金保值。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jīngjì bù wěndìng de shíhou, hěn duō rén huì xuǎnzé gòumǎi huángjīn bǎozhí.
sentences.translation: When the economy is unstable, many people choose to buy gold to preserve value.

sentences.chinese: 这条项链不是纯黄金的，所以价格没有想象中那么高。
sentences.traditional: 這條項鍊不是純黃金的，所以價格沒有想像中那麼高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàngliàn bú shì chún huángjīn de, suǒyǐ jiàgé méiyǒu xiǎngxiàng zhōng nàme gāo.
sentences.translation: This necklace is not pure gold, so the price is not as high as imagined.

sentences.chinese: 对运动员来说，赛前几周是提高状态的黄金时期。
sentences.traditional: 對運動員來說，賽前幾週是提高狀態的黃金時期。
sentences.pinyin: Duì yùndòngyuán lái shuō, sài qián jǐ zhōu shì tígāo zhuàngtài de huángjīn shíqī.
sentences.translation: For athletes, the few weeks before a competition are the golden period for improving form.

sentences.chinese: 壁炉里的火灭了，只剩下一层灰。
sentences.traditional: 壁爐裡的火滅了，只剩下一層灰。
sentences.pinyin: Bìlú lǐ de huǒ miè le, zhǐ shèng xià yì céng huī.
sentences.translation: The fire in the fireplace went out, leaving only a layer of ash.

sentences.chinese: 天色越来越灰，看样子很快就要下雨了。
sentences.traditional: 天色越來越灰，看樣子很快就要下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānsè yuè lái yuè huī, kàn yàngzi hěn kuài jiù yào xià yǔ le.
sentences.translation: The sky is getting greyer and greyer; it looks as if it will rain soon.

sentences.chinese: 她把灰倒进垃圾袋之前，确认里面没有火星。
sentences.traditional: 她把灰倒進垃圾袋之前，確認裡面沒有火星。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ huī dào jìn lājīdài zhīqián, quèrèn lǐmiàn méiyǒu huǒxīng.
sentences.translation: Before pouring the ash into the rubbish bag, she checked there were no sparks inside.

sentences.chinese: 听到朋友叫他，他立刻挥了挥手。
sentences.traditional: 聽到朋友叫他，他立刻揮了揮手。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào péngyou jiào tā, tā lìkè huī le huī shǒu.
sentences.translation: Hearing his friend call him, he immediately waved his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他挥动手中的旗子，提醒大家注意安全。
sentences.traditional: 他揮動手中的旗子，提醒大家注意安全。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huīdòng shǒu zhōng de qízi, tíxǐng dàjiā zhùyì ānquán.
sentences.translation: He waved the flag in his hand to remind everyone to pay attention to safety.

sentences.chinese: 临别时，她站在门口挥了挥手，直到车子开远。
sentences.traditional: 臨別時，她站在門口揮了揮手，直到車子開遠。
sentences.pinyin: Líbié shí, tā zhàn zài ménkǒu huī le huī shǒu, zhídào chēzi kāi yuǎn.
sentences.translation: When saying goodbye, she stood at the door and waved until the car drove away.

sentences.chinese: 休息了两天以后，他的体力基本恢复了。
sentences.traditional: 休息了兩天以後，他的體力基本恢復了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiūxi le liǎng tiān yǐhòu, tā de tǐlì jīběn huīfù le.
sentences.translation: After resting for two days, his physical strength had basically recovered.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在努力恢复客户对产品质量的信任。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在努力恢復客戶對產品質量的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài nǔlì huīfù kèhù duì chǎnpǐn zhìliàng de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: The company is working hard to restore customers’ trust in product quality.

sentences.chinese: 地震之后，城市交通花了很长时间才恢复正常。
sentences.traditional: 地震之後，城市交通花了很長時間才恢復正常。
sentences.pinyin: Dìzhèn zhīhòu, chéngshì jiāotōng huā le hěn cháng shíjiān cái huīfù zhèngcháng.
sentences.translation: After the earthquake, it took a long time for urban traffic to return to normal.

sentences.chinese: 他穿了一件灰色外套，看起来很低调。
sentences.traditional: 他穿了一件灰色外套，看起來很低調。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān le yí jiàn huīsè wàitào, kàn qǐlái hěn dīdiào.
sentences.translation: He wore a grey coat and looked very low-key.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片的背景是灰色的，人物显得更加突出。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片的背景是灰色的，人物顯得更加突出。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn de bèijǐng shì huīsè de, rénwù xiǎnde gèngjiā tūchū.
sentences.translation: The background of this photo is grey, making the person stand out more.

sentences.chinese: 天空一直是灰色的，让人感觉有些压抑。
sentences.traditional: 天空一直是灰色的，讓人感覺有些壓抑。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng yìzhí shì huīsè de, ràng rén gǎnjué yǒuxiē yāyì.
sentences.translation: The sky has been grey the whole time, making people feel somewhat oppressed.

sentences.chinese: 学校在每个教室门口都放了回收箱，鼓励学生分类处理垃圾。
sentences.traditional: 學校在每個教室門口都放了回收箱，鼓勵學生分類處理垃圾。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zài měi gè jiàoshì ménkǒu dōu fàng le huíshōu xiāng, gǔlì xuésheng fēnlèi chǔlǐ lājī.
sentences.translation: The school placed recycling bins at the door of every classroom to encourage students to sort rubbish.

sentences.chinese: 这些旧手机还能回收利用，直接扔掉太浪费了。
sentences.traditional: 這些舊手機還能回收利用，直接扔掉太浪費了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiù shǒujī hái néng huíshōu lìyòng, zhíjiē rēngdiào tài làngfèi le.
sentences.translation: These old mobile phones can still be recycled and reused; throwing them away would be too wasteful.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划回收生产过程中剩下的金属材料，以降低成本。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃回收生產過程中剩下的金屬材料，以降低成本。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà huíshōu shēngchǎn guòchéng zhōng shèngxià de jīnshǔ cáiliào, yǐ jiàngdī chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The company plans to recycle the metal materials left over during production in order to reduce costs.

sentences.chinese: 如果汇率继续波动，我们进口原材料的成本会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果匯率繼續波動，我們進口原材料的成本會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ huìlǜ jìxù bōdòng, wǒmen jìnkǒu yuáncáiliào de chéngběn huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If exchange rates continue to fluctuate, the cost of our imported raw materials will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 出国旅游前，他习惯先查一下当天的汇率。
sentences.traditional: 出國旅遊前，他習慣先查一下當天的匯率。
sentences.pinyin: Chūguó lǚyóu qián, tā xíguàn xiān chá yíxià dàngtiān de huìlǜ.
sentences.translation: Before travelling abroad, he usually checks the day’s exchange rate first.

sentences.chinese: 这家银行提供的汇率比机场柜台更合适。
sentences.traditional: 這家銀行提供的匯率比機場櫃檯更合適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yínháng tígōng de huìlǜ bǐ jīchǎng guìtái gèng héshì.
sentences.translation: The exchange rate offered by this bank is better than at the airport counter.

sentences.chinese: 他们的婚礼虽然规模不大，但每个环节都安排得很用心。
sentences.traditional: 他們的婚禮雖然規模不大，但每個環節都安排得很用心。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen de hūnlǐ suīrán guīmó bú dà, dàn měi gè huánjié dōu ānpái de hěn yòngxīn.
sentences.translation: Although their wedding was not large in scale, every part was arranged with great care.

sentences.chinese: 参加婚礼时，穿得太随便会显得不够尊重。
sentences.traditional: 參加婚禮時，穿得太隨便會顯得不夠尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā hūnlǐ shí, chuān de tài suíbiàn huì xiǎnde bú gòu zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: When attending a wedding, dressing too casually can seem insufficiently respectful.

sentences.chinese: 由于亲戚住在海外，婚礼将同时进行网上直播。
sentences.traditional: 由於親戚住在海外，婚禮將同時進行網上直播。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú qīnqi zhù zài hǎiwài, hūnlǐ jiāng tóngshí jìnxíng wǎngshàng zhíbō.
sentences.translation: Since relatives live overseas, the wedding will also be streamed online.

sentences.chinese: 一伙志愿者每周都会来社区帮老人修理家具。
sentences.traditional: 一夥志願者每週都會來社區幫老人修理傢俱。
sentences.pinyin: Yì huǒ zhìyuànzhě měi zhōu dōu huì lái shèqū bāng lǎorén xiūlǐ jiājù.
sentences.translation: A group of volunteers comes to the community every week to help elderly people repair furniture.

sentences.chinese: 那伙游客站在广场中央，一边拍照一边讨论路线。
sentences.traditional: 那夥遊客站在廣場中央，一邊拍照一邊討論路線。
sentences.pinyin: Nà huǒ yóukè zhàn zài guǎngchǎng zhōngyāng, yìbiān pāizhào yìbiān tǎolùn lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: That group of tourists stood in the middle of the square, taking photos while discussing the route.

sentences.chinese: 警察很快认出了那伙长期偷运货物的人。
sentences.traditional: 警察很快認出了那夥長期偷運貨物的人。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá hěn kuài rènchū le nà huǒ chángqī tōuyùn huòwù de rén.
sentences.translation: The police quickly recognised that group of people who had long been smuggling goods.

sentences.chinese: 在创业初期，选择可靠的伙伴比获得资金还重要。
sentences.traditional: 在創業初期，選擇可靠的夥伴比獲得資金還重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chuàngyè chūqī, xuǎnzé kěkào de huǒbàn bǐ huòdé zījīn hái zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In the early stage of starting a business, choosing reliable partners is even more important than obtaining funding.

sentences.chinese: 他和童年的伙伴多年没见，感情却一点也没变。
sentences.traditional: 他和童年的夥伴多年沒見，感情卻一點也沒變。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hé tóngnián de huǒbàn duō nián méi jiàn, gǎnqíng què yìdiǎn yě méi biàn.
sentences.translation: He had not seen his childhood companion for many years, yet their bond had not changed at all.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目需要技术伙伴和销售伙伴共同参与。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目需要技術夥伴和銷售夥伴共同參與。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào jìshù huǒbàn hé xiāoshòu huǒbàn gòngtóng cānyù.
sentences.translation: This project needs both technical partners and sales partners to take part together.

sentences.chinese: 冬天和朋友一起吃火锅，气氛总是特别热闹。
sentences.traditional: 冬天和朋友一起吃火鍋，氣氛總是特別熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān hé péngyou yìqǐ chī huǒguō, qìfēn zǒng shì tèbié rènao.
sentences.translation: Eating hot pot with friends in winter always creates an especially lively atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 这家火锅店的汤底不算辣，适合不太能吃辣的人。
sentences.traditional: 這家火鍋店的湯底不算辣，適合不太能吃辣的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā huǒguō diàn de tāngdǐ bú suàn là, shìhé bù tài néng chī là de rén.
sentences.translation: The soup base at this hot pot restaurant is not very spicy, so it suits people who cannot really eat spicy food.

sentences.chinese: 为了控制花费，我们决定在家自己准备火锅。
sentences.traditional: 為了控制花費，我們決定在家自己準備火鍋。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile kòngzhì huāfèi, wǒmen juédìng zài jiā zìjǐ zhǔnbèi huǒguō.
sentences.translation: To control the cost, we decided to prepare hot pot ourselves at home.

sentences.chinese: 你可以选择直接联系厂家，或是先向销售人员了解情况。
sentences.traditional: 你可以選擇直接聯繫廠家，或是先向銷售人員了解情況。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xuǎnzé zhíjiē liánxì chǎngjiā, huòshì xiān xiàng xiāoshòu rényuán liǎojiě qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: You can choose to contact the manufacturer directly, or first ask the sales staff about the situation.

sentences.chinese: 会议可能改到周三，或是推迟到下个月初。
sentences.traditional: 會議可能改到週三，或是推遲到下個月初。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kěnéng gǎi dào Zhōusān, huòshì tuīchí dào xià ge yuè chū.
sentences.translation: The meeting may be moved to Wednesday, or postponed until the beginning of next month.

sentences.chinese: 面对压力，有些人会选择运动，或是通过写日记来整理情绪。
sentences.traditional: 面對壓力，有些人會選擇運動，或是通過寫日記來整理情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì yālì, yǒuxiē rén huì xuǎnzé yùndòng, huòshì tōngguò xiě rìjì lái zhěnglǐ qíngxù.
sentences.translation: When facing pressure, some people choose exercise, or organise their emotions by writing a diary.

sentences.chinese: 由于海关检查，部分货物暂时无法按时送达。
sentences.traditional: 由於海關檢查，部分貨物暫時無法按時送達。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú hǎiguān jiǎnchá, bùfen huòwù zànshí wúfǎ ànshí sòngdá.
sentences.translation: Due to customs inspection, some goods temporarily cannot be delivered on time.

sentences.chinese: 仓库管理员必须确认货物的数量和包装是否一致。
sentences.traditional: 倉庫管理員必須確認貨物的數量和包裝是否一致。
sentences.pinyin: Cāngkù guǎnlǐyuán bìxū quèrèn huòwù de shùliàng hé bāozhuāng shìfǒu yízhì.
sentences.translation: The warehouse manager must confirm whether the quantity and packaging of the goods match.

sentences.chinese: 这批货物含有易碎物品，运输时需要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 這批貨物含有易碎物品，運輸時需要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī huòwù hányǒu yìsuì wùpǐn, yùnshū shí xūyào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: This batch of goods contains fragile items, so special care is needed during transport.

sentences.chinese: 他没有马上回复，或许是因为正在开会。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有馬上回覆，或許是因為正在開會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu mǎshàng huífù, huòxǔ shì yīnwèi zhèngzài kāihuì.
sentences.translation: He did not reply immediately, perhaps because he was in a meeting.

sentences.chinese: 如果换一种解释，学生或许更容易理解这个概念。
sentences.traditional: 如果換一種解釋，學生或許更容易理解這個概念。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ huàn yì zhǒng jiěshì, xuésheng huòxǔ gèng róngyì lǐjiě zhège gàiniàn.
sentences.translation: If you use a different explanation, the students may find this concept easier to understand.

sentences.chinese: 这条路看起来更远，但或许能避开市中心的堵车。
sentences.traditional: 這條路看起來更遠，但或許能避開市中心的堵車。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù kàn qǐlái gèng yuǎn, dàn huòxǔ néng bìkāi shì zhōngxīn de dǔchē.
sentences.translation: This road looks farther, but perhaps it can avoid the traffic jam in the city centre.

sentences.chinese: 这家研究机构长期关注气候变化对农业的影响。
sentences.traditional: 這家研究機構長期關注氣候變化對農業的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yánjiū jīgòu chángqī guānzhù qìhòu biànhuà duì nóngyè de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This research institute has long paid attention to the impact of climate change on agriculture.

sentences.chinese: 申请签证时，最好通过官方机构确认最新要求。
sentences.traditional: 申請簽證時，最好通過官方機構確認最新要求。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng shí, zuì hǎo tōngguò guānfāng jīgòu quèrèn zuìxīn yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: When applying for a visa, it is best to confirm the latest requirements through an official organisation.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高效率，政府决定合并几个功能相似的机构。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高效率，政府決定合併幾個功能相似的機構。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, zhèngfǔ juédìng hébìng jǐ gè gōngnéng xiāngsì de jīgòu.
sentences.translation: To improve efficiency, the government decided to merge several institutions with similar functions.

sentences.chinese: 这场比赛进行得非常激烈，双方队员都不肯轻易放弃。
sentences.traditional: 這場比賽進行得非常激烈，雙方隊員都不肯輕易放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài jìnxíng de fēicháng jīliè, shuāngfāng duìyuán dōu bù kěn qīngyì fàngqì.
sentences.translation: The match was extremely intense, and players on both sides refused to give up easily.

sentences.chinese: 关于这个方案，会议上的讨论很激烈，但始终保持着尊重。
sentences.traditional: 關於這個方案，會議上的討論很激烈，但始終保持著尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Guānyú zhège fāng'àn, huìyì shàng de tǎolùn hěn jīliè, dàn shǐzhōng bǎochí zhe zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: The discussion about this plan at the meeting was intense, but it remained respectful throughout.

sentences.chinese: 市场竞争越来越激烈，小公司必须找到自己的优势。
sentences.traditional: 市場競爭越來越激烈，小公司必須找到自己的優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Shìchǎng jìngzhēng yuè lái yuè jīliè, xiǎo gōngsī bìxū zhǎodào zìjǐ de yōushì.
sentences.translation: Market competition is becoming increasingly fierce, so small companies must find their own advantages.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器能够自动完成原来需要十个工人的任务。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器能夠自動完成原來需要十個工人的任務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì nénggòu zìdòng wánchéng yuánlái xūyào shí gè gōngrén de rènwu.
sentences.translation: This machine can automatically complete tasks that originally required ten workers.

sentences.chinese: 机器运行时声音突然变大，说明可能需要检查。
sentences.traditional: 機器運行時聲音突然變大，說明可能需要檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì yùnxíng shí shēngyīn tūrán biàn dà, shuōmíng kěnéng xūyào jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: When the machine is running, a sudden increase in noise suggests that it may need checking.

sentences.chinese: 如果不按说明操作，再先进的机器也可能出问题。
sentences.traditional: 如果不按說明操作，再先進的機器也可能出問題。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bú àn shuōmíng cāozuò, zài xiānjìn de jīqì yě kěnéng chū wèntí.
sentences.translation: If it is not operated according to the instructions, even an advanced machine may have problems.

sentences.chinese: 家庭机器人可以照顾老人，也能提供一些基本服务。
sentences.traditional: 家庭機器人可以照顧老人，也能提供一些基本服務。
sentences.pinyin: Jiātíng jīqìrén kěyǐ zhàogù lǎorén, yě néng tígōng yìxiē jīběn fúwù.
sentences.translation: A household robot can look after elderly people and provide some basic services.

sentences.chinese: 不是所有工作都能由机器人完成，人类的判断仍然很重要。
sentences.traditional: 不是所有工作都能由機器人完成，人類的判斷仍然很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Bú shì suǒyǒu gōngzuò dōu néng yóu jīqìrén wánchéng, rénlèi de pànduàn réngrán hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Not all work can be completed by robots; human judgement is still very important.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展出的互动机器人吸引了许多孩子。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展出的互動機器人吸引了許多孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū de hùdòng jīqìrén xīyǐn le xǔduō háizi.
sentences.translation: The interactive robot on display at the museum attracted many children.

sentences.chinese: 长时间不运动，突然跑步很容易让肌肉受伤。
sentences.traditional: 長時間不運動，突然跑步很容易讓肌肉受傷。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān bú yùndòng, tūrán pǎobù hěn róngyì ràng jīròu shòushāng.
sentences.translation: After a long period without exercise, suddenly going running can easily injure your muscles.

sentences.chinese: 运动后的肌肉酸痛通常说明身体正在恢复。
sentences.traditional: 運動後的肌肉酸痛通常說明身體正在恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng hòu de jīròu suāntòng tōngcháng shuōmíng shēntǐ zhèngzài huīfù.
sentences.translation: Muscle soreness after exercise usually shows that the body is recovering.

sentences.chinese: 他为了增加肌肉力量，每周都进行固定训练。
sentences.traditional: 他為了增加肌肉力量，每週都進行固定訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèile zēngjiā jīròu lìliàng, měi zhōu dōu jìnxíng gùdìng xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: To increase his muscle strength, he does regular training every week.

sentences.chinese: 参会人员包括老师、学生及家长。
sentences.traditional: 參會人員包括老師、學生及家長。
sentences.pinyin: Cānhuì rényuán bāokuò lǎoshī, xuésheng jí jiāzhǎng.
sentences.translation: Participants include teachers, students and parents.

sentences.chinese: 合同明确了双方责任及付款方式。
sentences.traditional: 合同明確了雙方責任及付款方式。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong míngquè le shuāngfāng zérèn jí fùkuǎn fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The contract clearly states both parties’ responsibilities and the payment method.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆收藏了书法作品及国画。
sentences.traditional: 博物館收藏了書法作品及國畫。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn shōucáng le shūfǎ zuòpǐn jí guóhuà.
sentences.translation: The museum has collected calligraphy works as well as traditional Chinese paintings.

sentences.chinese: 他今年准备参加汉语二级考试。
sentences.traditional: 他今年準備參加漢語二級考試。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīnnián zhǔnbèi cānjiā Hànyǔ èr jí kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: This year he is preparing to take the Chinese level-two exam.

sentences.chinese: 这次地震达到五级，很多人都感觉到了。
sentences.traditional: 這次地震達到五級，很多人都感覺到了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn dádào wǔ jí, hěn duō rén dōu gǎnjué dào le.
sentences.translation: This earthquake reached magnitude five, and many people felt it.

sentences.chinese: 登山前，我们先爬了几十级台阶热身。
sentences.traditional: 登山前，我們先爬了幾十級臺階熱身。
sentences.pinyin: Dēngshān qián, wǒmen xiān pá le jǐ shí jí táijiē rèshēn.
sentences.translation: Before climbing the mountain, we first climbed dozens of steps to warm up.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片一共分成六集，内容很有深度。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片一共分成六集，內容很有深度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn yígòng fēnchéng liù jí, nèiróng hěn yǒu shēndù.
sentences.translation: This documentary is divided into six episodes and has very in-depth content.

sentences.chinese: 我错过了上一集，只好先看剧情介绍。
sentences.traditional: 我錯過了上一集，只好先看劇情介紹。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cuòguò le shàng yí jí, zhǐhǎo xiān kàn jùqíng jièshào.
sentences.translation: I missed the previous episode, so I had to read the plot summary first.

sentences.chinese: 新的一集上线后，观众的讨论很快变得激烈起来。
sentences.traditional: 新的一集上線後，觀眾的討論很快變得激烈起來。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn de yì jí shàngxiàn hòu, guānzhòng de tǎolùn hěn kuài biàn de jīliè qǐlái.
sentences.translation: After the new episode went online, the audience discussion quickly became intense.

sentences.chinese: 预防疾病比发现以后再治疗更重要。
sentences.traditional: 預防疾病比發現以後再治療更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yùfáng jíbìng bǐ fāxiàn yǐhòu zài zhìliáo gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Preventing disease is more important than treating it after it has been discovered.

sentences.chinese: 这种疾病早期不容易被发现，需要定期检查。
sentences.traditional: 這種疾病早期不容易被發現，需要定期檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jíbìng zǎoqī bù róngyì bèi fāxiàn, xūyào dìngqī jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: This disease is not easy to detect in its early stage, so regular checks are needed.

sentences.chinese: 随着医疗条件改善，许多疾病已经可以得到有效控制。
sentences.traditional: 隨著醫療條件改善，許多疾病已經可以得到有效控制。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe yīliáo tiáojiàn gǎishàn, xǔduō jíbìng yǐjīng kěyǐ dédào yǒuxiào kòngzhì.
sentences.translation: As medical conditions improve, many diseases can already be effectively controlled.

sentences.chinese: 只要认真复习，及格应该不是问题。
sentences.traditional: 只要認真複習，及格應該不是問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào rènzhēn fùxí, jígé yīnggāi bú shì wèntí.
sentences.translation: As long as you revise seriously, passing should not be a problem.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然及格了，但成绩离目标还有不少距离。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然及格了，但成績離目標還有不少距離。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán jígé le, dàn chéngjì lí mùbiāo hái yǒu bù shǎo jùlí.
sentences.translation: Although he passed, his score is still quite far from his target.

sentences.chinese: 学校不仅看学生是否及格，也重视他们的实际能力。
sentences.traditional: 學校不僅看學生是否及格，也重視他們的實際能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bùjǐn kàn xuésheng shìfǒu jígé, yě zhòngshì tāmen de shíjì nénglì.
sentences.translation: The school looks not only at whether students pass, but also values their practical ability.

sentences.chinese: 请大家八点在校门口集合，不要迟到。
sentences.traditional: 請大家八點在校門口集合，不要遲到。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā bā diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé, bú yào chídào.
sentences.translation: Please gather at the school gate at eight o’clock, and do not be late.

sentences.chinese: 经理把团队集合起来，说明新的工作安排。
sentences.traditional: 經理把團隊集合起來，說明新的工作安排。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ bǎ tuánduì jíhé qǐlái, shuōmíng xīn de gōngzuò ānpái.
sentences.translation: The manager gathered the team together to explain the new work arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 这些数据集合在一起，才能看出真正的趋势。
sentences.traditional: 這些數據集合在一起，才能看出真正的趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù jíhé zài yìqǐ, cái néng kàn chū zhēnzhèng de qūshì.
sentences.translation: Only when these data are brought together can the real trend be seen.

sentences.chinese: 公司即将推出新的环保包装，相关部门正在做最后测试。
sentences.traditional: 公司即將推出新的環保包裝，相關部門正在做最後測試。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jíjiāng tuīchū xīn de huánbǎo bāozhuāng, xiāngguān bùmén zhèng zài zuò zuìhòu cèshì.
sentences.translation: The company is about to launch new eco-friendly packaging, and the relevant departments are doing the final tests.

sentences.chinese: 比赛即将开始，观众已经陆续进入体育馆。
sentences.traditional: 比賽即將開始，觀眾已經陸續進入體育館。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jíjiāng kāishǐ, guānzhòng yǐjīng lùxù jìnrù tǐyùguǎn.
sentences.translation: The match is about to begin, and the audience has already been entering the sports hall one after another.

sentences.chinese: 这座老桥即将被修复，以便继续服务附近居民。
sentences.traditional: 這座老橋即將被修復，以便繼續服務附近居民。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo qiáo jíjiāng bèi xiūfù, yǐbiàn jìxù fúwù fùjìn jūmín.
sentences.translation: This old bridge is about to be restored so that it can continue serving nearby residents.

sentences.chinese: 听到孩子在外面哭，她急忙放下手里的工作跑了出去。
sentences.traditional: 聽到孩子在外面哭，她急忙放下手裡的工作跑了出去。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào háizi zài wàimiàn kū, tā jímáng fàngxià shǒu lǐ de gōngzuò pǎo le chūqù.
sentences.translation: Hearing the child crying outside, she hurriedly put down the work in her hands and ran out.

sentences.chinese: 会议临时提前，经理急忙通知各部门调整安排。
sentences.traditional: 會議臨時提前，經理急忙通知各部門調整安排。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì línshí tíqián, jīnglǐ jímáng tōngzhī gè bùmén tiáozhěng ānpái.
sentences.translation: The meeting was brought forward at short notice, so the manager hurriedly informed each department to adjust its arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 发现资料不完整后，助理急忙把缺少的文件补上。
sentences.traditional: 發現資料不完整後，助理急忙把缺少的文件補上。
sentences.pinyin: Fāxiàn zīliào bù wánzhěng hòu, zhùlǐ jímáng bǎ quēshǎo de wénjiàn bǔ shàng.
sentences.translation: After discovering that the materials were incomplete, the assistant hastily added the missing documents.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究的过程极其复杂，任何一个细节都不能忽视。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究的過程極其複雜，任何一個細節都不能忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū de guòchéng jíqí fùzá, rènhé yí gè xìjié dōu bù néng hūshì.
sentences.translation: The process of this research is extremely complicated, and no detail can be overlooked.

sentences.chinese: 在高温环境下工作极其辛苦，所以必须注意休息和补水。
sentences.traditional: 在高溫環境下工作極其辛苦，所以必須注意休息和補水。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gāowēn huánjìng xià gōngzuò jíqí xīnkǔ, suǒyǐ bìxū zhùyì xiūxi hé bǔshuǐ.
sentences.translation: Working in a high-temperature environment is extremely hard, so you must pay attention to rest and rehydration.

sentences.chinese: 这位医生对病人的态度极其耐心，得到了大家的好评。
sentences.traditional: 這位醫生對病人的態度極其耐心，得到了大家的好評。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīshēng duì bìngrén de tàidu jíqí nàixīn, dédào le dàjiā de hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: This doctor's attitude towards patients is extremely patient, and it has received everyone’s praise.

sentences.chinese: 这次决定不是个人意见，而是整个集体讨论后的结果。
sentences.traditional: 這次決定不是個人意見，而是整個集體討論後的結果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì juédìng bú shì gèrén yìjiàn, ér shì zhěnggè jítǐ tǎolùn hòu de jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: This decision is not an individual opinion, but the result of discussion by the whole group.

sentences.chinese: 学校鼓励学生参加集体活动，以提高合作能力。
sentences.traditional: 學校鼓勵學生參加集體活動，以提高合作能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào gǔlì xuéshēng cānjiā jítǐ huódòng, yǐ tígāo hézuò nénglì.
sentences.translation: The school encourages students to take part in group activities in order to improve their ability to cooperate.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难时，集体的力量往往比个人更可靠。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難時，集體的力量往往比個人更可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan shí, jítǐ de lìliàng wǎngwǎng bǐ gèrén gèng kěkào.
sentences.translation: When facing difficulties, the strength of the group is often more reliable than that of an individual.

sentences.chinese: 受灾地区急需干净的饮用水和基本药品。
sentences.traditional: 受災地區急需乾淨的飲用水和基本藥品。
sentences.pinyin: Shòuzāi dìqū jíxū gānjìng de yǐnyòng shuǐ hé jīběn yàopǐn.
sentences.translation: The disaster-affected area urgently needs clean drinking water and basic medicines.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院急需有经验的护士来减轻急诊压力。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院急需有經驗的護士來減輕急診壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn jíxū yǒu jīngyàn de hùshi lái jiǎnqīng jízhěn yālì.
sentences.translation: This hospital urgently needs experienced nurses to reduce the pressure on the emergency department.

sentences.chinese: 如果企业急需资金，就应该先评估贷款的风险。
sentences.traditional: 如果企業急需資金，就應該先評估貸款的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qǐyè jíxū zījīn, jiù yīnggāi xiān pínggū dàikuǎn de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: If an enterprise urgently needs funds, it should first assess the risks of taking a loan.

sentences.chinese: 他半夜突然呼吸困难，家人立刻把他送到急诊。
sentences.traditional: 他半夜突然呼吸困難，家人立刻把他送到急診。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bànyè tūrán hūxī kùnnan, jiārén lìkè bǎ tā sòng dào jízhěn.
sentences.translation: He suddenly had difficulty breathing in the middle of the night, and his family immediately took him to emergency care.

sentences.chinese: 急诊医生需要在很短时间内判断病情的严重程度。
sentences.traditional: 急診醫生需要在很短時間內判斷病情的嚴重程度。
sentences.pinyin: Jízhěn yīshēng xūyào zài hěn duǎn shíjiān nèi pànduàn bìngqíng de yánzhòng chéngdù.
sentences.translation: Emergency doctors need to judge the seriousness of a patient’s condition within a very short time.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院扩大了急诊区域，以便接收更多病人。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院擴大了急診區域，以便接收更多病人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn kuòdà le jízhěn qūyù, yǐbiàn jiēshōu gèng duō bìngrén.
sentences.translation: This hospital has expanded its emergency area so that it can receive more patients.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求大家把注意力集中在文章的主要观点上。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求大家把注意力集中在文章的主要觀點上。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú dàjiā bǎ zhùyìlì jízhōng zài wénzhāng de zhǔyào guāndiǎn shàng.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked everyone to concentrate their attention on the main viewpoint of the article.

sentences.chinese: 资源过于分散会降低效率，因此公司决定集中管理。
sentences.traditional: 資源過於分散會降低效率，因此公司決定集中管理。
sentences.pinyin: Zīyuán guòyú fēnsàn huì jiàngdī xiàolǜ, yīncǐ gōngsī juédìng jízhōng guǎnlǐ.
sentences.translation: Resources that are too scattered will reduce efficiency, so the company decided on centralised management.

sentences.chinese: 这片区域的人口比较集中，公共交通也更加方便。
sentences.traditional: 這片區域的人口比較集中，公共交通也更加方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn qūyù de rénkǒu bǐjiào jízhōng, gōnggòng jiāotōng yě gèngjiā fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The population in this area is relatively concentrated, and public transport is also more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 早高峰时地铁里太挤，连转身都很困难。
sentences.traditional: 早高峰時地鐵裡太擠，連轉身都很困難。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎo gāofēng shí dìtiě lǐ tài jǐ, lián zhuǎnshēn dōu hěn kùnnan.
sentences.translation: During the morning rush hour, the underground is so crowded that even turning round is difficult.

sentences.chinese: 为了挤出时间复习，他把娱乐活动减少了一半。
sentences.traditional: 為了擠出時間複習，他把娛樂活動減少了一半。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jǐ chū shíjiān fùxí, tā bǎ yúlè huódòng jiǎnshǎo le yíbàn.
sentences.translation: In order to squeeze out time for revision, he cut his entertainment activities by half.

sentences.chinese: 别把所有衣服都挤进一个柜子里，容易弄皱。
sentences.traditional: 別把所有衣服都擠進一個櫃子裡，容易弄皺。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ suǒyǒu yīfu dōu jǐ jìn yí gè guìzi lǐ, róngyì nòng zhòu.
sentences.translation: Don’t squeeze all the clothes into one cupboard; they’ll easily get creased.

sentences.chinese: 请把安全带系好，车辆马上就要出发。
sentences.traditional: 請把安全帶繫好，車輛馬上就要出發。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ ānquándài jì hǎo, chēliàng mǎshàng jiù yào chūfā.
sentences.translation: Please fasten your seat belt; the vehicle is about to set off.

sentences.chinese: 登山前，他仔细检查鞋带有没有系紧。
sentences.traditional: 登山前，他仔細檢查鞋帶有沒有繫緊。
sentences.pinyin: Dēngshān qián, tā zǐxì jiǎnchá xiédài yǒu méiyǒu jì jǐn.
sentences.translation: Before climbing the mountain, he carefully checked whether his shoelaces were tied tightly.

sentences.chinese: 这条围巾系得太松，风一吹就可能掉下来。
sentences.traditional: 這條圍巾繫得太鬆，風一吹就可能掉下來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo wéijīn jì de tài sōng, fēng yì chuī jiù kěnéng diào xiàlái.
sentences.translation: This scarf is tied too loosely; it might fall off as soon as the wind blows.

sentences.chinese: 本季度的销售额比去年同期增长了百分之十二。
sentences.traditional: 本季度的銷售額比去年同期增長了百分之十二。
sentences.pinyin: Běn jìdù de xiāoshòu'é bǐ qùnián tóngqī zēngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī shí'èr.
sentences.translation: This quarter’s sales increased by twelve per cent compared with the same period last year.

sentences.chinese: 公司每个季度都会检查项目进度和预算使用情况。
sentences.traditional: 公司每個季度都會檢查項目進度和預算使用情況。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī měi gè jìdù dōu huì jiǎnchá xiàngmù jìndù hé yùsuàn shǐyòng qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The company checks project progress and budget usage every quarter.

sentences.chinese: 如果下个季度市场继续好转，我们可能会增加投资。
sentences.traditional: 如果下個季度市場繼續好轉，我們可能會增加投資。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xià gè jìdù shìchǎng jìxù hǎozhuǎn, wǒmen kěnéng huì zēngjiā tóuzī.
sentences.translation: If the market continues to improve next quarter, we may increase investment.

sentences.chinese: 请把会议中的重要决定记录下来，以免以后出现争议。
sentences.traditional: 請把會議中的重要決定記錄下來，以免以後出現爭議。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ huìyì zhōng de zhòngyào juédìng jìlù xiàlái, yǐmiǎn yǐhòu chūxiàn zhēngyì.
sentences.translation: Please record the important decisions from the meeting to avoid disputes later.

sentences.chinese: 这份记录显示，设备上个月已经检查过一次。
sentences.traditional: 這份記錄顯示，設備上個月已經檢查過一次。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn jìlù xiǎnshì, shèbèi shàng ge yuè yǐjīng jiǎnchá guo yí cì.
sentences.translation: This record shows that the equipment was already checked once last month.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有完整的记录，我们很难追究责任。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有完整的記錄，我們很難追究責任。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu wánzhěng de jìlù, wǒmen hěn nán zhuījiū zérèn.
sentences.translation: Without complete records, it is difficult for us to hold anyone responsible.

sentences.chinese: 他在比赛中打破了学校的跳高纪录。
sentences.traditional: 他在比賽中打破了學校的跳高紀錄。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng dǎpò le xuéxiào de tiàogāo jìlù.
sentences.translation: He broke the school's high jump record in the competition.

sentences.chinese: 这个销售纪录保持了三年，直到今年才被超过。
sentences.traditional: 這個銷售紀錄保持了三年，直到今年才被超過。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìlù bǎochí le sān nián, zhídào jīnnián cái bèi chāoguò.
sentences.translation: This sales record stood for three years and was only surpassed this year.

sentences.chinese: 她连续工作十二小时，创造了部门新的服务纪录。
sentences.traditional: 她連續工作十二小時，創造了部門新的服務紀錄。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liánxù gōngzuò shí'èr xiǎoshí, chuàngzào le bùmén xīn de fúwù jìlù.
sentences.translation: She worked twelve hours continuously, setting a new service record for the department.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片通过真实采访展示了海关工作的压力。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片通過真實採訪展示了海關工作的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tōngguò zhēnshí cǎifǎng zhǎnshì le hǎiguān gōngzuò de yālì.
sentences.translation: This documentary uses real interviews to show the pressure of customs work.

sentences.chinese: 我们看了一部关于古代河流文明的纪录片。
sentences.traditional: 我們看了一部關於古代河流文明的紀錄片。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kàn le yí bù guānyú gǔdài héliú wénmíng de jìlùpiàn.
sentences.translation: We watched a documentary about ancient river civilisations.

sentences.chinese: 导演希望这部纪录片能引起观众对环境问题的关注。
sentences.traditional: 導演希望這部紀錄片能引起觀眾對環境問題的關注。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn xīwàng zhè bù jìlùpiàn néng yǐnqǐ guānzhòng duì huánjìng wèntí de guānzhù.
sentences.translation: The director hopes this documentary will draw the audience's attention to environmental issues.

sentences.chinese: 掌握一门实用技能，比只背理论更有价值。
sentences.traditional: 掌握一門實用技能，比只背理論更有價值。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎngwò yì mén shíyòng jìnéng, bǐ zhǐ bèi lǐlùn gèng yǒu jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Mastering a practical skill is more valuable than only memorising theory.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作要求申请人具备沟通和计算机操作技能。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作要求申請人具備溝通和計算機操作技能。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò yāoqiú shēnqǐng rén jùbèi gōutōng hé jìsuànjī cāozuò jìnéng.
sentences.translation: This job requires applicants to have communication and computer operation skills.

sentences.chinese: 学校应该帮助学生发展解决实际问题的技能。
sentences.traditional: 學校應該幫助學生發展解決實際問題的技能。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yīnggāi bāngzhù xuéshēng fāzhǎn jiějué shíjì wèntí de jìnéng.
sentences.translation: Schools should help students develop skills for solving practical problems.

sentences.chinese: 他们种下这棵树，是为了纪念那位帮助过村民的医生。
sentences.traditional: 他們種下這棵樹，是為了紀念那位幫助過村民的醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhòng xià zhè kē shù, shì wèile jìniàn nà wèi bāngzhù guo cūnmín de yīshēng.
sentences.translation: They planted this tree to commemorate the doctor who had helped the villagers.

sentences.chinese: 这个小杯子是我从故乡带回来的纪念。
sentences.traditional: 這個小杯子是我從故鄉帶回來的紀念。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo bēizi shì wǒ cóng gùxiāng dài huílái de jìniàn.
sentences.translation: This small cup is a souvenir I brought back from my hometown.

sentences.chinese: 每到毕业季，学生们都会合影留作纪念。
sentences.traditional: 每到畢業季，學生們都會合影留作紀念。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào bìyè jì, xuéshēngmen dōu huì héyǐng liú zuò jìniàn.
sentences.translation: Every graduation season, students take group photos as keepsakes.

sentences.chinese: 今天是他们结婚十周年纪念日，所以家人准备了惊喜。
sentences.traditional: 今天是他們結婚十週年紀念日，所以家人準備了驚喜。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān shì tāmen jiéhūn shí zhōunián jìniànrì, suǒyǐ jiārén zhǔnbèi le jīngxǐ.
sentences.translation: Today is their tenth wedding anniversary, so the family prepared a surprise.

sentences.chinese: 公司把成立纪念日安排在广场举行庆祝活动。
sentences.traditional: 公司把成立紀念日安排在廣場舉行慶祝活動。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī bǎ chénglì jìniànrì ānpái zài guǎngchǎng jǔxíng qìngzhù huódòng.
sentences.translation: The company arranged for its founding anniversary celebration to be held in the square.

sentences.chinese: 重要的纪念日不一定要花很多钱，关键是心意。
sentences.traditional: 重要的紀念日不一定要花很多錢，關鍵是心意。
sentences.pinyin: Zhòngyào de jìniànrì bù yídìng yào huā hěn duō qián, guānjiàn shì xīnyì.
sentences.translation: An important anniversary does not necessarily require spending a lot of money; the key is thoughtfulness.

sentences.chinese: 在签合同之前，我们必须先计算总成本和可能的风险。
sentences.traditional: 在簽合同之前，我們必須先計算總成本和可能的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Zài qiān hétong zhīqián, wǒmen bìxū xiān jìsuàn zǒng chéngběn hé kěnéng de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before signing the contract, we must first calculate the total cost and possible risks.

sentences.chinese: 这个公式可以帮助你计算每个季度的利润变化。
sentences.traditional: 這個公式可以幫助你計算每個季度的利潤變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngshì kěyǐ bāngzhù nǐ jìsuàn měi gè jìdù de lìrùn biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This formula can help you calculate the changes in profit each quarter.

sentences.chinese: 如果汇率变化太快，报价就需要重新计算。
sentences.traditional: 如果匯率變化太快，報價就需要重新計算。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ huìlǜ biànhuà tài kuài, bàojià jiù xūyào chóngxīn jìsuàn.
sentences.translation: If the exchange rate changes too quickly, the quotation will need to be recalculated.

sentences.chinese: 现代计算机不仅能处理文字，还能分析大量数据。
sentences.traditional: 現代計算機不僅能處理文字，還能分析大量數據。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài jìsuànjī bùjǐn néng chǔlǐ wénzì, hái néng fēnxī dàliàng shùjù.
sentences.translation: Modern computers can not only process text but also analyse large amounts of data.

sentences.chinese: 这门课介绍计算机如何影响工业和日常生活。
sentences.traditional: 這門課介紹計算機如何影響工業和日常生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kè jièshào jìsuànjī rúhé yǐngxiǎng gōngyè hé rìcháng shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This course explains how computers affect industry and everyday life.

sentences.chinese: 如果计算机系统突然关闭，未保存的记录可能会丢失。
sentences.traditional: 如果計算機系統突然關閉，未保存的記錄可能會丟失。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ jìsuànjī xìtǒng tūrán guānbì, wèi bǎocún de jìlù kěnéng huì diūshī.
sentences.translation: If the computer system shuts down suddenly, unsaved records may be lost.

sentences.chinese: 童年的气味常常能唤起人们深处的记忆。
sentences.traditional: 童年的氣味常常能喚起人們深處的記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Tóngnián de qìwèi chángcháng néng huànqǐ rénmen shēn chù de jìyì.
sentences.translation: Smells from childhood can often awaken memories deep within people.

sentences.chinese: 为了加强记忆，他把新词写进了真实的句子里。
sentences.traditional: 為了加強記憶，他把新詞寫進了真實的句子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiāqiáng jìyì, tā bǎ xīn cí xiě jìn le zhēnshí de jùzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: To strengthen his memory, he put the new words into real sentences.

sentences.chinese: 在我的记忆中，最清楚的画面是故乡冬天的那条小河。
sentences.traditional: 在我的記憶中，最清楚的畫面是故鄉冬天的那條小河。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǒ de jìyì zhōng, zuì qīngchǔ de huàmiàn shì gùxiāng dōngtiān de nà tiáo xiǎohé.
sentences.translation: In my memory, the clearest image is the small river in my hometown in winter.

sentences.chinese: 这本古书详细记载了当地河流的变化。
sentences.traditional: 這本古書詳細記載了當地河流的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn gǔshū xiángxì jìzǎi le dāngdì héliú de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This ancient book records in detail the changes in the local rivers.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆的资料记载，这件瓷器来自古代贸易路线。
sentences.traditional: 博物館的資料記載，這件瓷器來自古代貿易路線。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn de zīliào jìzǎi, zhè jiàn cíqì láizì gǔdài màoyì lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: The museum's materials record that this piece of porcelain came from an ancient trade route.

sentences.chinese: 历史资料记载的不只是胜利，还有普通人的生活。
sentences.traditional: 歷史資料記載的不只是勝利，還有普通人的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Lìshǐ zīliào jìzǎi de bù zhǐ shì shènglì, hái yǒu pǔtōng rén de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Historical materials record not only victories, but also the lives of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 主办方邀请了几位重要嘉宾，参加开幕式并发表意见。
sentences.traditional: 主辦方邀請了幾位重要嘉賓，參加開幕式並發表意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǔbànfāng yāoqǐng le jǐ wèi zhòngyào jiābīn, cānjiā kāimùshì bìng fābiǎo yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: The organiser invited several important guests to attend the opening ceremony and express their views.

sentences.chinese: 作为嘉宾，他没有直接回答敏感问题，而是谈了行业趋势。
sentences.traditional: 作為嘉賓，他沒有直接回答敏感問題，而是談了行業趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi jiābīn, tā méiyǒu zhíjiē huídá mǐngǎn wèntí, ér shì tán le hángyè qūshì.
sentences.translation: As an honoured guest, he did not directly answer the sensitive question, but talked about industry trends.

sentences.chinese: 活动结束后，工作人员带嘉宾参观了新的展厅。
sentences.traditional: 活動結束後，工作人員帶嘉賓參觀了新的展廳。
sentences.pinyin: Huódòng jiéshù hòu, gōngzuò rényuán dài jiābīn cānguān le xīn de zhǎntīng.
sentences.translation: After the event ended, staff took the guests to visit the new exhibition hall.

sentences.chinese: 购买家电时，不能只看价格，还要比较能耗和售后服务。
sentences.traditional: 購買家電時，不能只看價格，還要比較能耗和售後服務。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi jiādiàn shí, bù néng zhǐ kàn jiàgé, hái yào bǐjiào nénghào hé shòuhòu fúwù.
sentences.translation: When buying household appliances, you should not only look at the price, but also compare energy consumption and after-sales service.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司通过回收旧家电减少了资源浪费。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司通過回收舊家電減少了資源浪費。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tōngguò huíshōu jiù jiādiàn jiǎnshǎo le zīyuán làngfèi.
sentences.translation: This company reduced waste of resources by recycling old household appliances.

sentences.chinese: 搬家之前，他把不用的家电都卖给了邻居。
sentences.traditional: 搬家之前，他把不用的家電都賣給了鄰居。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiā zhīqián, tā bǎ bú yòng de jiādiàn dōu mài gěi le línjū.
sentences.translation: Before moving house, he sold all the household appliances he did not use to his neighbour.

sentences.chinese: 这些果实需要经过简单加工，才能运到海外销售。
sentences.traditional: 這些果實需要經過簡單加工，才能運到海外銷售。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē guǒshí xūyào jīngguò jiǎndān jiāgōng, cái néng yùn dào hǎiwài xiāoshòu.
sentences.translation: These fruits need simple processing before they can be shipped overseas for sale.

sentences.chinese: 原料质量再好，如果加工环节不严格，也会影响成品。
sentences.traditional: 原料質量再好，如果加工環節不嚴格，也會影響成品。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánliào zhìliàng zài hǎo, rúguǒ jiāgōng huánjié bù yángé, yě huì yǐngxiǎng chéngpǐn.
sentences.translation: No matter how good the raw materials are, if the processing stage is not strict, it will still affect the finished product.

sentences.chinese: 工厂计划引进机器来加工这些金属零件。
sentences.traditional: 工廠計劃引進機器來加工這些金屬零件。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng jìhuà yǐnjìn jīqì lái jiāgōng zhèxiē jīnshǔ língjiàn.
sentences.translation: The factory plans to introduce machines to process these metal parts.

sentences.chinese: 食物加热过度会影响口感，也可能破坏营养。
sentences.traditional: 食物加熱過度會影響口感，也可能破壞營養。
sentences.pinyin: Shíwù jiārè guòdù huì yǐngxiǎng kǒugǎn, yě kěnéng pòhuài yíngyǎng.
sentences.translation: Excessive heating of food affects the taste and may also destroy nutrients.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器可以自动加热，并保持固定温度。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器可以自動加熱，並保持固定溫度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì kěyǐ zìdòng jiārè, bìng bǎochí gùdìng wēndù.
sentences.translation: This machine can heat automatically and maintain a fixed temperature.

sentences.chinese: 如果盒饭已经凉了，可以先用微波炉加热两分钟。
sentences.traditional: 如果盒飯已經涼了，可以先用微波爐加熱兩分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ héfàn yǐjīng liáng le, kěyǐ xiān yòng wēibōlú jiārè liǎng fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: If the boxed meal has already gone cold, you can heat it in the microwave for two minutes first.

sentences.chinese: 这次合作加深了两家机构之间的信任。
sentences.traditional: 這次合作加深了兩家機構之間的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì hézuò jiāshēn le liǎng jiā jīgòu zhījiān de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: This cooperation deepened the trust between the two organisations.

sentences.chinese: 经常交流能加深彼此的理解，减少不必要的误会。
sentences.traditional: 經常交流能加深彼此的理解，減少不必要的誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngcháng jiāoliú néng jiāshēn bǐcǐ de lǐjiě, jiǎnshǎo bú bìyào de wùhuì.
sentences.translation: Regular communication can deepen mutual understanding and reduce unnecessary misunderstandings.

sentences.chinese: 纪录片里的真实画面加深了观众对疾病的认识。
sentences.traditional: 紀錄片裡的真實畫面加深了觀眾對疾病的認識。
sentences.pinyin: Jìlùpiàn lǐ de zhēnshí huàmiàn jiāshēn le guānzhòng duì jíbìng de rènshi.
sentences.translation: The real images in the documentary deepened the audience’s understanding of the disease.

sentences.chinese: 新政策将加速传统行业的数字化过程。
sentences.traditional: 新政策將加速傳統行業的數字化過程。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè jiāng jiāsù chuántǒng hángyè de shùzìhuà guòchéng.
sentences.translation: The new policy will speed up the digitalisation process of traditional industries.

sentences.chinese: 为了按时交货，工厂决定加速生产。
sentences.traditional: 為了按時交貨，工廠決定加速生產。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ànshí jiāo huò, gōngchǎng juédìng jiāsù shēngchǎn.
sentences.translation: In order to deliver the goods on time, the factory decided to speed up production.

sentences.chinese: 过度追求加速发展，反而可能带来严重后果。
sentences.traditional: 過度追求加速發展，反而可能帶來嚴重後果。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù zhuīqiú jiāsù fāzhǎn, fǎn'ér kěnéng dàilái yánzhòng hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: Excessively pursuing faster development may instead bring serious consequences.

sentences.chinese: 合理分配家务，有助于减少家庭矛盾。
sentences.traditional: 合理分配家務，有助於減少家庭矛盾。
sentences.pinyin: Hélǐ fēnpèi jiāwù, yǒuzhù yú jiǎnshǎo jiātíng máodùn.
sentences.translation: Dividing household chores reasonably helps reduce family conflict.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然工作很忙，仍然坚持每天做一部分家务。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然工作很忙，仍然堅持每天做一部分家務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, réngrán jiānchí měitiān zuò yí bùfen jiāwù.
sentences.translation: Although he is very busy with work, he still insists on doing some household chores every day.

sentences.chinese: 孩子参与家务，不只是帮忙，也是学习责任。
sentences.traditional: 孩子參與家務，不只是幫忙，也是學習責任。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi cānyù jiāwù, bù zhǐ shì bāngmáng, yě shì xuéxí zérèn.
sentences.translation: When children take part in household chores, they are not only helping but also learning responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 合同规定，甲方必须在收到货物后十天内付款。
sentences.traditional: 合同規定，甲方必須在收到貨物後十天內付款。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong guīdìng, jiǎfāng bìxū zài shōu dào huòwù hòu shí tiān nèi fùkuǎn.
sentences.translation: The contract states that Party A must pay within ten days of receiving the goods.

sentences.chinese: 老师把材料分成甲、乙、丙三类，让学生分别分析。
sentences.traditional: 老師把材料分成甲、乙、丙三類，讓學生分別分析。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ cáiliào fēn chéng jiǎ, yǐ, bǐng sān lèi, ràng xuéshēng fēnbié fēnxī.
sentences.translation: The teacher divided the materials into categories A, B and C, so that the students could analyse them separately.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆里那套古代盔甲吸引了很多游客。
sentences.traditional: 博物館裡那套古代盔甲吸引了很多遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ nà tào gǔdài kuījiǎ xīyǐn le hěn duō yóukè.
sentences.translation: The ancient armour in the museum attracted many visitors.

sentences.chinese: 假如明天会议取消，我们就把时间改成客户拜访。
sentences.traditional: 假如明天會議取消，我們就把時間改成客戶拜訪。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎrú míngtiān huìyì qǔxiāo, wǒmen jiù bǎ shíjiān gǎi chéng kèhù bàifǎng.
