sentences.translation: If tomorrow’s meeting is cancelled, we will change the time to a customer visit.

sentences.chinese: 假如你只看表面现象，很容易忽视真正的问题。
sentences.traditional: 假如你只看表面現象，很容易忽視真正的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎrú nǐ zhǐ kàn biǎomiàn xiànxiàng, hěn róngyì hūshì zhēnzhèng de wèntí.
sentences.translation: If you only look at surface phenomena, it is easy to ignore the real problem.

sentences.chinese: 假如大家都同意这个方案，我们下周就开始执行。
sentences.traditional: 假如大家都同意這個方案，我們下週就開始執行。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎrú dàjiā dōu tóngyì zhège fāng'àn, wǒmen xià zhōu jiù kāishǐ zhíxíng.
sentences.translation: If everyone agrees to this plan, we will start carrying it out next week.

sentences.chinese: 书架太高了，孩子够不到最上面那一层。
sentences.traditional: 書架太高了，孩子夠不到最上面那一層。
sentences.pinyin: Shūjià tài gāo le, háizi gòu bu dào zuì shàngmiàn nà yì céng.
sentences.translation: The bookshelf is too high, so the child cannot reach the top shelf.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气突然变化，一架飞机被迫推迟起飞。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣突然變化，一架飛機被迫推遲起飛。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì tūrán biànhuà, yí jià fēijī bèipò tuīchí qǐfēi.
sentences.translation: Because the weather suddenly changed, one plane was forced to delay take-off.

sentences.chinese: 两个孩子为了一个玩具吵得很凶，差点打架。
sentences.traditional: 兩個孩子為了一個玩具吵得很兇，差點打架。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng ge háizi wèile yí ge wánjù chǎo de hěn xiōng, chàdiǎn dǎjià.
sentences.translation: The two children argued fiercely over a toy and nearly started fighting.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然有多年驾驶经验，但在暴雨中仍然开得很慢。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然有多年駕駛經驗，但在暴雨中仍然開得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán yǒu duō nián jiàshǐ jīngyàn, dàn zài bàoyǔ zhōng réngrán kāi de hěn màn.
sentences.translation: Although he has many years of driving experience, he still drove very slowly in the heavy rain.

sentences.chinese: 公司要求所有司机接受安全驾驶培训，以减少事故。
sentences.traditional: 公司要求所有司機接受安全駕駛培訓，以減少事故。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú suǒyǒu sījī jiēshòu ānquán jiàshǐ péixùn, yǐ jiǎnshǎo shìgù.
sentences.translation: The company requires all drivers to receive safe-driving training to reduce accidents.

sentences.chinese: 长时间驾驶容易让人疲劳，因此每隔两小时最好休息一下。
sentences.traditional: 長時間駕駛容易讓人疲勞，因此每隔兩小時最好休息一下。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān jiàshǐ róngyì ràng rén píláo, yīncǐ měi gé liǎng xiǎoshí zuìhǎo xiūxi yíxià.
sentences.translation: Driving for a long time can easily make people tired, so it is best to rest every two hours.

sentences.chinese: 在英国申请驾照需要先通过理论考试。
sentences.traditional: 在英國申請駕照需要先通過理論考試。
sentences.pinyin: Zài Yīngguó shēnqǐng jiàzhào xūyào xiān tōngguò lǐlùn kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: In the UK, applying for a driving licence requires first passing the theory test.

sentences.chinese: 他的驾照过期了，所以不能继续开公司的车。
sentences.traditional: 他的駕照過期了，所以不能繼續開公司的車。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiàzhào guòqī le, suǒyǐ bù néng jìxù kāi gōngsī de chē.
sentences.translation: His driving licence has expired, so he cannot continue to drive the company car.

sentences.chinese: 如果你把驾照忘在家里，遇到检查会很麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 如果你把駕照忘在家裡，遇到檢查會很麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bǎ jiàzhào wàng zài jiā lǐ, yùdào jiǎnchá huì hěn máfan.
sentences.translation: If you leave your driving licence at home, it will be troublesome if you run into an inspection.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告的价值不在于数据多少，而在于分析是否准确。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告的價值不在於數據多少，而在於分析是否準確。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de jiàzhí bú zài yú shùjù duōshao, ér zài yú fēnxī shìfǒu zhǔnquè.
sentences.translation: The value of this report does not lie in how much data it has, but in whether the analysis is accurate.

sentences.chinese: 对他来说，时间的价值比金钱更重要。
sentences.traditional: 對他來說，時間的價值比金錢更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, shíjiān de jiàzhí bǐ jīnqián gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: For him, the value of time is more important than money.

sentences.chinese: 这件古老家具虽然破旧，却具有很高的历史价值。
sentences.traditional: 這件古老傢俱雖然破舊，卻具有很高的歷史價值。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn gǔlǎo jiājù suīrán pòjiù, què jùyǒu hěn gāo de lìshǐ jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Although this old piece of furniture is worn, it has great historical value.

sentences.chinese: 在艰苦的环境下工作，更能看出一个团队的责任感。
sentences.traditional: 在艱苦的環境下工作，更能看出一個團隊的責任感。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jiānkǔ de huánjìng xià gōngzuò, gèng néng kàn chū yí ge tuánduì de zérèngǎn.
sentences.translation: Working in difficult conditions shows a team’s sense of responsibility more clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这段创业经历虽然艰苦，却让他学会了坚持。
sentences.traditional: 這段創業經歷雖然艱苦，卻讓他學會了堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn chuàngyè jīnglì suīrán jiānkǔ, què ràng tā xuéhuì le jiānchí.
sentences.translation: Although this start-up experience was difficult, it taught him to persevere.

sentences.chinese: 山区孩子的学习条件比较艰苦，但他们对知识依然充满好奇。
sentences.traditional: 山區孩子的學習條件比較艱苦，但他們對知識依然充滿好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Shānqū háizi de xuéxí tiáojiàn bǐjiào jiānkǔ, dàn tāmen duì zhīshi yīrán chōngmǎn hàoqí.
sentences.translation: The learning conditions for children in the mountain area are quite difficult, but they are still full of curiosity about knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 面对疾病，她表现得非常坚强，从不轻易抱怨。
sentences.traditional: 面對疾病，她表現得非常堅強，從不輕易抱怨。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jíbìng, tā biǎoxiàn de fēicháng jiānqiáng, cóng bù qīngyì bàoyuàn.
sentences.translation: Faced with illness, she behaved very strongly and never complained easily.

sentences.chinese: 真正坚强的人并不是没有压力，而是知道怎样调整自己。
sentences.traditional: 真正堅強的人並不是沒有壓力，而是知道怎樣調整自己。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng jiānqiáng de rén bìng bú shì méiyǒu yālì, ér shì zhīdào zěnyàng tiáozhěng zìjǐ.
sentences.translation: Truly strong people are not without pressure; they know how to adjust themselves.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败让他变得更坚强，也更愿意听取别人的意见。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗讓他變得更堅強，也更願意聽取別人的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài ràng tā biàn de gèng jiānqiáng, yě gèng yuànyì tīngqǔ biérén de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: This failure made him stronger and more willing to listen to other people’s opinions.

sentences.chinese: 他在广场上捡到一个钱包，马上交给了警察。
sentences.traditional: 他在廣場上撿到一個錢包，馬上交給了警察。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài guǎngchǎng shang jiǎn dào yí ge qiánbāo, mǎshàng jiāo gěi le jǐngchá.
sentences.translation: He found a wallet in the square and immediately handed it to the police.

sentences.chinese: 别把地上的食物捡起来吃，已经不干净了。
sentences.traditional: 別把地上的食物撿起來吃，已經不乾淨了。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ dì shang de shíwù jiǎn qǐlai chī, yǐjīng bù gānjìng le.
sentences.translation: Do not pick up food from the ground and eat it; it is no longer clean.

sentences.chinese: 他每天散步时都会顺手捡一些路边的垃圾。
sentences.traditional: 他每天散步時都會順手撿一些路邊的垃圾。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān sànbù shí dōu huì shùnshǒu jiǎn yìxiē lùbiān de lājī.
sentences.translation: When he goes for a walk every day, he casually picks up some rubbish by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 她把旧衣服剪成小块，用来擦机器。
sentences.traditional: 她把舊衣服剪成小塊，用來擦機器。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiù yīfu jiǎn chéng xiǎo kuài, yòng lái cā jīqì.
sentences.translation: She cut the old clothes into small pieces to wipe the machine.

sentences.chinese: 园丁正在剪树枝，以免它们挡住窗外的光线。
sentences.traditional: 園丁正在剪樹枝，以免它們擋住窗外的光線。
sentences.pinyin: Yuándīng zhèngzài jiǎn shùzhī, yǐmiǎn tāmen dǎng zhù chuāng wài de guāngxiàn.
sentences.translation: The gardener is cutting branches so that they do not block the light outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 这段视频太长，需要先剪掉重复的画面。
sentences.traditional: 這段視頻太長，需要先剪掉重複的畫面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn shìpín tài cháng, xūyào xiān jiǎn diào chóngfù de huàmiàn.
sentences.translation: This video is too long and the repeated scenes need to be cut out first.

sentences.chinese: 这把剪刀很锋利，使用时一定要小心。
sentences.traditional: 這把剪刀很鋒利，使用時一定要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ jiǎndāo hěn fēnglì, shǐyòng shí yídìng yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: These scissors are very sharp, so you must be careful when using them.

sentences.chinese: 孩子用剪刀做手工时，老师一直在旁边看着。
sentences.traditional: 孩子用剪刀做手工時，老師一直在旁邊看著。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yòng jiǎndāo zuò shǒugōng shí, lǎoshī yìzhí zài pángbiān kànzhe.
sentences.translation: When the children used scissors to do handicrafts, the teacher watched beside them the whole time.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有剪刀，我们可以用刀把包装打开。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有剪刀，我們可以用刀把包裝打開。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu jiǎndāo, wǒmen kěyǐ yòng dāo bǎ bāozhuāng dǎkāi.
sentences.translation: If we do not have scissors, we can use a knife to open the packaging.

sentences.chinese: 减肥不能只靠少吃，还需要合理运动和长期坚持。
sentences.traditional: 減肥不能只靠少吃，還需要合理運動和長期堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎnféi bù néng zhǐ kào shǎo chī, hái xūyào hélǐ yùndòng hé chángqī jiānchí.
sentences.translation: Losing weight cannot rely only on eating less; it also requires reasonable exercise and long-term persistence.

sentences.chinese: 他为了减肥，决定减少甜食并每天散步一小时。
sentences.traditional: 他為了減肥，決定減少甜食並每天散步一小時。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèile jiǎnféi, juédìng jiǎnshǎo tiánshí bìng měitiān sànbù yì xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: In order to lose weight, he decided to reduce sweets and walk for an hour every day.

sentences.chinese: 过度减肥可能影响健康，最好先咨询医生。
sentences.traditional: 過度減肥可能影響健康，最好先諮詢醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù jiǎnféi kěnéng yǐngxiǎng jiànkāng, zuìhǎo xiān zīxún yīshēng.
sentences.translation: Excessive dieting may affect your health, so it is best to consult a doctor first.

sentences.chinese: 他的简历写得很清楚，工作经验和技能都很突出。
sentences.traditional: 他的簡歷寫得很清楚，工作經驗和技能都很突出。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiǎnlì xiě de hěn qīngchǔ, gōngzuò jīngyàn hé jìnéng dōu hěn tūchū.
sentences.translation: His CV is written very clearly, and his work experience and skills stand out.

sentences.chinese: 投简历之前，应该根据岗位要求修改内容。
sentences.traditional: 投簡歷之前，應該根據崗位要求修改內容。
sentences.pinyin: Tóu jiǎnlì zhīqián, yīnggāi gēnjù gǎngwèi yāoqiú xiūgǎi nèiróng.
sentences.translation: Before submitting a CV, you should revise the content according to the job requirements.

sentences.chinese: 面试官看了简历以后，对她的海外经历很感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 面試官看了簡歷以後，對她的海外經歷很感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshìguān kàn le jiǎnlì yǐhòu, duì tā de hǎiwài jīnglì hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: After reading the CV, the interviewer was very interested in her overseas experience.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的服务太差了，简直让人无法接受。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的服務太差了，簡直讓人無法接受。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwù tài chà le, jiǎnzhí ràng rén wúfǎ jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: The service at this restaurant is so poor that it is simply impossible to accept.

sentences.chinese: 他把一个简单问题解释得那么复杂，简直是在浪费时间。
sentences.traditional: 他把一個簡單問題解釋得那麼複雜，簡直是在浪費時間。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yí ge jiǎndān wèntí jiěshì de nàme fùzá, jiǎnzhí shì zài làngfèi shíjiān.
sentences.translation: He explained a simple problem in such a complicated way that he was simply wasting time.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个价格，我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個價格，我簡直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào zhège jiàgé, wǒ jiǎnzhí bù gǎn xiāngxìn zìjǐ de ěrduo.
sentences.translation: When I heard this price, I simply could not believe my ears.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划在河边建一座新的图书馆，以改善社区服务。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃在河邊建一座新的圖書館，以改善社區服務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà zài hébiān jiàn yí zuò xīn de túshūguǎn, yǐ gǎishàn shèqū fúwù.
sentences.translation: The government plans to build a new library by the river to improve community services.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥是十年前建的，现在仍然很结实。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋是十年前建的，現在仍然很結實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo shì shí nián qián jiàn de, xiànzài réngrán hěn jiēshi.
sentences.translation: This bridge was built ten years ago and is still very solid.

sentences.chinese: 企业不应该只建工厂，还要考虑对环境的影响。
sentences.traditional: 企業不應該只建工廠，還要考慮對環境的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè bù yīnggāi zhǐ jiàn gōngchǎng, hái yào kǎolǜ duì huánjìng de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Businesses should not only build factories; they also need to consider the impact on the environment.

sentences.chinese: 键盘上的这个键坏了，所以我没法输入数字。
sentences.traditional: 鍵盤上的這個鍵壞了，所以我沒法輸入數字。
sentences.pinyin: Jiànpán shang de zhège jiàn huài le, suǒyǐ wǒ méi fǎ shūrù shùzì.
sentences.translation: This key on the keyboard is broken, so I cannot enter numbers.

sentences.chinese: 使用这台机器时，请先按绿色的启动键。
sentences.traditional: 使用這臺機器時，請先按綠色的啟動鍵。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐyòng zhè tái jīqì shí, qǐng xiān àn lǜsè de qǐdòng jiàn.
sentences.translation: When using this machine, please press the green start button first.

sentences.chinese: 这个软件支持快捷键，能大大提高工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 這個軟件支持快捷鍵，能大大提高工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn zhīchí kuàijié jiàn, néng dàdà tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: This software supports keyboard shortcuts and can greatly improve work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 天气渐渐变冷，晚上出门最好多穿一件衣服。
sentences.traditional: 天氣漸漸變冷，晚上出門最好多穿一件衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì jiànjiàn biàn lěng, wǎnshang chūmén zuìhǎo duō chuān yí jiàn yīfu.
sentences.translation: The weather is gradually getting colder, so it is best to wear an extra layer when going out at night.

sentences.chinese: 经过几个月的练习，他渐渐掌握了演讲的技巧。
sentences.traditional: 經過幾個月的練習，他漸漸掌握了演講的技巧。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de liànxí, tā jiànjiàn zhǎngwò le yǎnjiǎng de jìqiǎo.
sentences.translation: After several months of practice, he gradually mastered the techniques of giving speeches.

sentences.chinese: 随着交流增加，双方的误会渐渐减少了。
sentences.traditional: 隨著交流增加，雙方的誤會漸漸減少了。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe jiāoliú zēngjiā, shuāngfāng de wùhuì jiànjiàn jiǎnshǎo le.
sentences.translation: As communication increased, the misunderstandings between the two sides gradually decreased.

sentences.chinese: 学校希望建立一套更公平的评价制度。
sentences.traditional: 學校希望建立一套更公平的評價制度。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xīwàng jiànlì yí tào gèng gōngpíng de píngjià zhìdù.
sentences.translation: The school hopes to establish a fairer evaluation system.

sentences.chinese: 信任不是一天建立起来的，需要长期的合作。
sentences.traditional: 信任不是一天建立起來的，需要長期的合作。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnrèn bú shì yì tiān jiànlì qǐlai de, xūyào chángqī de hézuò.
sentences.translation: Trust is not built in a single day; it requires long-term cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 他们在海外建立了新的销售机构。
sentences.traditional: 他們在海外建立了新的銷售機構。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài hǎiwài jiànlì le xīn de xiāoshòu jīgòu.
sentences.translation: They established a new sales organisation overseas.

sentences.chinese: 我每天都要用键盘处理大量文件。
sentences.traditional: 我每天都要用鍵盤處理大量文件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu yào yòng jiànpán chǔlǐ dàliàng wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: I have to use a keyboard every day to handle a large number of documents.

sentences.chinese: 新键盘的按键很舒服，长时间打字也不累。
sentences.traditional: 新鍵盤的按鍵很舒服，長時間打字也不累。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jiànpán de ànjiàn hěn shūfu, cháng shíjiān dǎzì yě bú lèi.
sentences.translation: The keys on the new keyboard are comfortable, and typing for a long time is not tiring.

sentences.chinese: 如果键盘进水了，千万不要立刻通电。
sentences.traditional: 如果鍵盤進水了，千萬不要立刻通電。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ jiànpán jìn shuǐ le, qiānwàn bú yào lìkè tōngdiàn.
sentences.translation: If the keyboard gets water in it, do not power it on immediately under any circumstances.

sentences.chinese: 城市建设应该保护历史建筑，而不是全部拆掉。
sentences.traditional: 城市建設應該保護歷史建築，而不是全部拆掉。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì jiànshè yīnggāi bǎohù lìshǐ jiànzhù, ér bú shì quánbù chāi diào.
sentences.translation: Urban construction should protect historic buildings rather than tear them all down.

sentences.chinese: 这项基础设施建设将明显改善当地交通。
sentences.traditional: 這項基礎設施建設將明顯改善當地交通。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jīchǔ shèshī jiànshè jiāng míngxiǎn gǎishàn dāngdì jiāotōng.
sentences.translation: This infrastructure construction will clearly improve local transport.

sentences.chinese: 乡村建设需要资金，也需要当地居民的参与。
sentences.traditional: 鄉村建設需要資金，也需要當地居民的參與。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngcūn jiànshè xūyào zījīn, yě xūyào dāngdì jūmín de cānyù.
sentences.translation: Rural development requires funding, and it also requires the participation of local residents.

sentences.chinese: 这艘船由一家经验丰富的公司建造。
sentences.traditional: 這艘船由一家經驗豐富的公司建造。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè sōu chuán yóu yì jiā jīngyàn fēngfù de gōngsī jiànzào.
sentences.translation: This ship was built by an experienced company.

sentences.chinese: 建造高楼之前，必须仔细检查地基是否稳定。
sentences.traditional: 建造高樓之前，必須仔細檢查地基是否穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Jiànzào gāolóu zhīqián, bìxū zǐxì jiǎnchá dìjī shìfǒu wěndìng.
sentences.translation: Before constructing a tall building, the foundation must be carefully checked to see whether it is stable.

sentences.chinese: 他们打算用环保材料建造新的学校宿舍。
sentences.traditional: 他們打算用環保材料建造新的學校宿舍。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen dǎsuàn yòng huánbǎo cáiliào jiànzào xīn de xuéxiào sùshè.
sentences.translation: They plan to build new school dormitories using environmentally friendly materials.

sentences.chinese: 这座建筑外表普通，内部设计却非常现代。
sentences.traditional: 這座建築外表普通，內部設計卻非常現代。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò jiànzhù wàibiǎo pǔtōng, nèibù shèjì què fēicháng xiàndài.
sentences.translation: This building looks ordinary on the outside, but the interior design is very modern.

sentences.chinese: 保护古老建筑有助于人们了解城市的历史。
sentences.traditional: 保護古老建築有助於人們了解城市的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù gǔlǎo jiànzhù yǒu zhù yú rénmen liǎojiě chéngshì de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: Protecting old buildings helps people understand the history of a city.

sentences.chinese: 他大学学的是建筑，毕业后想参与城市规划。
sentences.traditional: 他大學學的是建築，畢業後想參與城市規劃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué xué de shì jiànzhù, bìyè hòu xiǎng cānyù chéngshì guīhuà.
sentences.translation: He studied architecture at university and wants to take part in urban planning after graduation.

sentences.chinese: 他在这家公司工作了将近十年，对业务非常熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 他在這家公司工作了將近十年，對業務非常熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhè jiā gōngsī gōngzuò le jiāngjìn shí nián, duì yèwù fēicháng shúxī.
sentences.translation: He has worked at this company for nearly ten years and is very familiar with the business.

sentences.chinese: 从这里到机场开车将近两个小时。
sentences.traditional: 從這裡到機場開車將近兩個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào jīchǎng kāichē jiāngjìn liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: It takes nearly two hours to drive from here to the airport.

sentences.chinese: 这次会议持续了将近一整天，大家都很疲惫。
sentences.traditional: 這次會議持續了將近一整天，大家都很疲憊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì chíxù le jiāngjìn yì zhěng tiān, dàjiā dōu hěn píbèi.
sentences.translation: This meeting lasted nearly a whole day, and everyone was very tired.

sentences.chinese: 他的讲话内容很清楚，听众很容易理解重点。
sentences.traditional: 他的講話內容很清楚，聽眾很容易理解重點。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiǎnghuà nèiróng hěn qīngchu, tīngzhòng hěn róngyì lǐjiě zhòngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: His speech was very clear, and the audience could easily understand the key points.

sentences.chinese: 校长在毕业典礼上的讲话鼓励了很多学生。
sentences.traditional: 校長在畢業典禮上的講話鼓勵了很多學生。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng zài bìyè diǎnlǐ shang de jiǎnghuà gǔlì le hěn duō xuésheng.
sentences.translation: The headteacher’s speech at the graduation ceremony encouraged many students.

sentences.chinese: 这段讲话虽然不长，却提到了几个重要问题。
sentences.traditional: 這段講話雖然不長，卻提到了幾個重要問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn jiǎnghuà suīrán bù cháng, què tí dào le jǐ ge zhòngyào wèntí.
sentences.translation: Although this speech was not long, it mentioned several important issues.

sentences.chinese: 中国菜很讲究火候，时间差一点味道就不同。
sentences.traditional: 中國菜很講究火候，時間差一點味道就不同。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó cài hěn jiǎngjiu huǒhou, shíjiān chà yìdiǎn wèidào jiù bù tóng.
sentences.translation: Chinese cooking is very particular about heat control; a slight difference in timing changes the flavour.

sentences.chinese: 他穿衣服不追求贵，但很讲究搭配。
sentences.traditional: 他穿衣服不追求貴，但很講究搭配。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān yīfu bù zhuīqiú guì, dàn hěn jiǎngjiu dāpèi.
sentences.translation: He does not chase expensive clothes, but he is very particular about matching them well.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭店的装修很讲究，连灯光都设计得很细。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店的裝修很講究，連燈光都設計得很細。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de zhuāngxiū hěn jiǎngjiu, lián dēngguāng dōu shèjì de hěn xì.
sentences.translation: The restaurant’s decoration is quite refined; even the lighting has been designed carefully.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定奖励那些在项目中表现突出的员工。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定獎勵那些在項目中表現突出的員工。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng jiǎnglì nàxiē zài xiàngmù zhōng biǎoxiàn tūchū de yuángōng.
sentences.translation: The company decided to reward the employees who performed outstandingly in the project.

sentences.chinese: 适当的奖励能提高孩子学习的积极性。
sentences.traditional: 適當的獎勵能提高孩子學習的積極性。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdàng de jiǎnglì néng tígāo háizi xuéxí de jījíxìng.
sentences.translation: Suitable rewards can increase a child’s enthusiasm for learning.

sentences.chinese: 他因为提出合理建议而受到了学校的奖励。
sentences.traditional: 他因為提出合理建議而受到了學校的獎勵。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi tíchū hélǐ jiànyì ér shòu dào le xuéxiào de jiǎnglì.
sentences.translation: He received a reward from the school because he put forward a reasonable suggestion.

sentences.chinese: 这本书讲述了一个年轻人如何面对困难的故事。
sentences.traditional: 這本書講述了一個年輕人如何面對困難的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎngshù le yí ge niánqīng rén rúhé miànduì kùnnan de gùshi.
sentences.translation: This book tells the story of how a young person faced difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 他用平静的语气讲述了那段艰苦的经历。
sentences.traditional: 他用平靜的語氣講述了那段艱苦的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng píngjìng de yǔqì jiǎngshù le nà duàn jiānkǔ de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: He described that difficult experience in a calm tone.

sentences.chinese: 纪录片通过真实画面讲述海关人员的工作。
sentences.traditional: 紀錄片通過真實畫面講述海關人員的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Jìlùpiàn tōngguò zhēnshí huàmiàn jiǎngshù hǎiguān rényuán de gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: The documentary uses real footage to tell about the work of customs officers.

sentences.chinese: 明天下午有一场关于职业发展的讲座。
sentences.traditional: 明天下午有一場關於職業發展的講座。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu yì chǎng guānyú zhíyè fāzhǎn de jiǎngzuò.
sentences.translation: There will be a lecture about career development tomorrow afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 听完讲座以后，我对这个行业有了更深入的了解。
sentences.traditional: 聽完講座以後，我對這個行業有了更深入的了解。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng wán jiǎngzuò yǐhòu, wǒ duì zhège hángyè yǒu le gèng shēnrù de liǎojiě.
sentences.translation: After listening to the lecture, I had a deeper understanding of this industry.

sentences.chinese: 参加讲座的人太多，后排几乎没有座位。
sentences.traditional: 參加講座的人太多，後排幾乎沒有座位。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā jiǎngzuò de rén tài duō, hòupái jīhū méi yǒu zuòwèi.
sentences.translation: Too many people attended the lecture, so there were almost no seats in the back rows.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区夏季降水较多，出门最好带伞。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區夏季降水較多，出門最好帶傘。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū xiàjì jiàngshuǐ jiào duō, chūmén zuìhǎo dài sǎn.
sentences.translation: This area has relatively heavy precipitation in summer, so it is best to take an umbrella when going out.

sentences.chinese: 连续几天没有降水，河流的水位明显下降。
sentences.traditional: 連續幾天沒有降水，河流的水位明顯下降。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jǐ tiān méiyǒu jiàngshuǐ, héliú de shuǐwèi míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: After several days without precipitation, the water level of the river dropped noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 气象部门预计今晚会有强降水。
sentences.traditional: 氣象部門預計今晚會有強降水。
sentences.pinyin: Qìxiàng bùmén yùjì jīnwǎn huì yǒu qiáng jiàngshuǐ.
sentences.translation: The weather department expects heavy precipitation tonight.

sentences.chinese: 天气太热了，花园里的花需要每天浇一次水。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太熱了，花園裡的花需要每天澆一次水。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè le, huāyuán lǐ de huā xūyào měitiān jiāo yí cì shuǐ.
sentences.translation: The weather is too hot, so the flowers in the garden need watering once every day.

sentences.chinese: 他一边浇菜，一边和邻居聊天。
sentences.traditional: 他一邊澆菜，一邊和鄰居聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān jiāo cài, yìbiān hé línjū liáotiān.
sentences.translation: He watered the vegetables while chatting with his neighbour.

sentences.chinese: 做这个菜时，最后要在菜上浇一点热油。
sentences.traditional: 做這個菜時，最後要在菜上澆一點熱油。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò zhège cài shí, zuìhòu yào zài cài shang jiāo yìdiǎn rè yóu.
sentences.translation: When making this dish, you should pour a little hot oil over it at the end.

sentences.chinese: 会后，双方交换了联系方式，准备继续合作。
sentences.traditional: 會後，雙方交換了聯繫方式，準備繼續合作。
sentences.pinyin: Huì hòu, shuāngfāng jiāohuàn le liánxì fāngshì, zhǔnbèi jìxù hézuò.
sentences.translation: After the meeting, both sides exchanged contact details and prepared to continue cooperating.

sentences.chinese: 学生们可以互相交换意见，而不是只听老师讲。
sentences.traditional: 學生們可以互相交換意見，而不是只聽老師講。
sentences.pinyin: Xuésheng men kěyǐ hùxiāng jiāohuàn yìjiàn, ér bú shì zhǐ tīng lǎoshī jiǎng.
sentences.translation: Students can exchange opinions with each other instead of only listening to the teacher speak.

sentences.chinese: 这次交换经验的活动让我们学到了很多实际方法。
sentences.traditional: 這次交換經驗的活動讓我們學到了很多實際方法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jiāohuàn jīngyàn de huódòng ràng wǒmen xué dào le hěn duō shíjì fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: This activity for exchanging experience taught us many practical methods.

sentences.chinese: 和人交往时，真诚比技巧更重要。
sentences.traditional: 和人交往時，真誠比技巧更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Hé rén jiāowǎng shí, zhēnchéng bǐ jìqiǎo gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When interacting with people, sincerity is more important than technique.

sentences.chinese: 他们交往了三年，决定明年举行婚礼。
sentences.traditional: 他們交往了三年，決定明年舉行婚禮。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jiāowǎng le sān nián, juédìng míngnián jǔxíng hūnlǐ.
sentences.translation: They dated for three years and decided to hold their wedding next year.

sentences.chinese: 如果长期缺少交往，一个人可能会感到孤独。
sentences.traditional: 如果長期缺少交往，一個人可能會感到孤獨。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chángqī quēshǎo jiāowǎng, yí ge rén kěnéng huì gǎndào gūdú.
sentences.translation: If someone lacks interaction with others for a long time, they may feel lonely.

sentences.chinese: 这笔交易如果成功，公司今年的收入会大幅增加。
sentences.traditional: 這筆交易如果成功，公司今年的收入會大幅增加。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ jiāoyì rúguǒ chénggōng, gōngsī jīnnián de shōurù huì dàfú zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: If this transaction succeeds, the company’s revenue this year will increase greatly.

sentences.chinese: 双方已经完成交易，货物下周发出。
sentences.traditional: 雙方已經完成交易，貨物下週發出。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng yǐjīng wánchéng jiāoyì, huòwù xià zhōu fāchū.
sentences.translation: Both sides have already completed the transaction, and the goods will be sent out next week.

sentences.chinese: 市场规则越透明，交易就越公平。
sentences.traditional: 市場規則越透明，交易就越公平。
sentences.pinyin: Shìchǎng guīzé yuè tòumíng, jiāoyì jiù yuè gōngpíng.
sentences.translation: The more transparent the market rules are, the fairer transactions become.

sentences.chinese: 听到门外熟悉的脚步声，她立刻知道父亲回来了。
sentences.traditional: 聽到門外熟悉的腳步聲，她立刻知道父親回來了。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào ménwài shúxī de jiǎobù shēng, tā lìkè zhīdào fùqīn huílái le.
sentences.translation: Hearing the familiar footsteps outside the door, she immediately knew her father had come back.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难，我们不能停下脚步，而要继续寻找办法。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難，我們不能停下腳步，而要繼續尋找辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan, wǒmen bùnéng tíng xià jiǎobù, ér yào jìxù xúnzhǎo bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Faced with difficulties, we must not stop moving forward, but should continue looking for a solution.

sentences.chinese: 城市发展的脚步越来越快，旧街区也在逐渐改变。
sentences.traditional: 城市發展的腳步越來越快，舊街區也在逐漸改變。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì fāzhǎn de jiǎobù yuè lái yuè kuài, jiù jiēqū yě zài zhújiàn gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: The pace of urban development is getting faster and faster, and old neighbourhoods are gradually changing too.

sentences.chinese: 如果从另一个角度看，这次失败也许是一次经验。
sentences.traditional: 如果從另一個角度看，這次失敗也許是一次經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ cóng lìng yí ge jiǎodù kàn, zhè cì shībài yěxǔ shì yí cì jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Seen from another angle, this failure may be a useful experience.

sentences.chinese: 记者需要从不同角度分析事件，而不是只听一种说法。
sentences.traditional: 記者需要從不同角度分析事件，而不是只聽一種說法。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě xūyào cóng bùtóng jiǎodù fēnxī shìjiàn, ér bú shì zhǐ tīng yì zhǒng shuōfǎ.
sentences.translation: Journalists need to analyse events from different angles, rather than listening to only one account.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题的角度很新，讨论起来特别有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題的角度很新，討論起來特別有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de jiǎodù hěn xīn, tǎolùn qǐlái tèbié yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: The angle of this question is quite new, so it is especially interesting to discuss.

sentences.chinese: 这条路线较短，但经过的路口比较多。
sentences.traditional: 這條路線較短，但經過的路口比較多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lùxiàn jiào duǎn, dàn jīngguò de lùkǒu bǐjiào duō.
sentences.translation: This route is comparatively shorter, but it passes through more junctions.

sentences.chinese: 与去年相比，今年的销售额较稳定，没有明显下降。
sentences.traditional: 與去年相比，今年的銷售額較穩定，沒有明顯下降。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ qùnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián de xiāoshòu'é jiào wěndìng, méiyǒu míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: Compared with last year, this year’s sales are relatively stable and have not fallen noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案较合理，所以大家最终都同意了。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案較合理，所以大家最終都同意了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn jiào hélǐ, suǒyǐ dàjiā zuìzhōng dōu tóngyì le.
sentences.translation: This plan is relatively reasonable, so everyone eventually agreed to it.

sentences.chinese: 这套教材把语法点安排得很清楚，适合自学。
sentences.traditional: 這套教材把語法點安排得很清楚，適合自學。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào jiàocái bǎ yǔfǎ diǎn ānpái de hěn qīngchu, shìhé zìxué.
sentences.translation: This set of teaching materials arranges the grammar points clearly and is suitable for self-study.

sentences.chinese: 老师根据学生水平调整教材的难度。
sentences.traditional: 老師根據學生水平調整教材的難度。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gēnjù xuésheng shuǐpíng tiáozhěng jiàocái de nándù.
sentences.translation: The teacher adjusts the difficulty of the teaching materials according to the students’ level.

sentences.chinese: 购买教材之前，最好先确认课程使用的是哪一版。
sentences.traditional: 購買教材之前，最好先確認課程使用的是哪一版。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi jiàocái zhīqián, zuìhǎo xiān quèrèn kèchéng shǐyòng de shì nǎ yí bǎn.
sentences.translation: Before buying the teaching materials, it is best to confirm which edition the course uses.

sentences.chinese: 刚开始接触这项技术时，我觉得它非常复杂。
sentences.traditional: 剛開始接觸這項技術時，我覺得它非常複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ jiēchù zhè xiàng jìshù shí, wǒ juéde tā fēicháng fùzá.
sentences.translation: When I first came into contact with this technology, I found it very complicated.

sentences.chinese: 多接触真实材料，比只背课本更容易提高听力。
sentences.traditional: 多接觸真實材料，比只背課本更容易提高聽力。
sentences.pinyin: Duō jiēchù zhēnshí cáiliào, bǐ zhǐ bèi kèběn gèng róngyì tígāo tīnglì.
sentences.translation: Having more contact with real materials makes it easier to improve listening than only memorising textbooks.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作让他有机会接触来自不同行业的人。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作讓他有機會接觸來自不同行業的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò ràng tā yǒu jīhuì jiēchù láizì bùtóng hángyè de rén.
sentences.translation: This job gives him the opportunity to come into contact with people from different industries.

sentences.chinese: 公司安排了专人接待海外客户，并介绍生产流程。
sentences.traditional: 公司安排了專人接待海外客戶，並介紹生產流程。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī ānpái le zhuānrén jiēdài hǎiwài kèhù, bìng jièshào shēngchǎn liúchéng.
sentences.translation: The company arranged a specialist to receive overseas customers and introduce the production process.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒店的接待服务很周到，给游客留下了好印象。
sentences.traditional: 這家酒店的接待服務很周到，給遊客留下了好印象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de jiēdài fúwù hěn zhōudào, gěi yóukè liúxià le hǎo yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: The reception service at this hotel is very thoughtful and left tourists with a good impression.

sentences.chinese: 明天由销售部负责接待来访的代表团。
sentences.traditional: 明天由銷售部負責接待來訪的代表團。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān yóu xiāoshòu bù fùzé jiēdài láifǎng de dàibiǎotuán.
sentences.translation: Tomorrow the sales department will be responsible for receiving the visiting delegation.

sentences.chinese: 项目进入关键阶段以后，每个环节都不能出错。
sentences.traditional: 項目進入關鍵階段以後，每個環節都不能出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù jìnrù guānjiàn jiēduàn yǐhòu, měi ge huánjié dōu bùnéng chūcuò.
sentences.translation: After the project enters a key stage, no part of it can go wrong.

sentences.chinese: 学语言在不同阶段会遇到不同的困难。
sentences.traditional: 學語言在不同階段會遇到不同的困難。
sentences.pinyin: Xué yǔyán zài bùtóng jiēduàn huì yùdào bùtóng de kùnnan.
sentences.translation: When learning a language, you meet different difficulties at different stages.

sentences.chinese: 这个阶段的目标不是追求速度，而是打好基础。
sentences.traditional: 這個階段的目標不是追求速度，而是打好基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiēduàn de mùbiāo bú shì zhuīqiú sùdù, ér shì dǎ hǎo jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: The goal at this stage is not to pursue speed, but to build a solid foundation.

sentences.chinese: 天黑以后，船慢慢接近了岸边。
sentences.traditional: 天黑以後，船慢慢接近了岸邊。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān hēi yǐhòu, chuán mànmàn jiējìn le ànbiān.
sentences.translation: After it got dark, the boat slowly approached the shore.

sentences.chinese: 他的想法已经接近我们的计划，只需要再调整细节。
sentences.traditional: 他的想法已經接近我們的計劃，只需要再調整細節。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ yǐjīng jiējìn wǒmen de jìhuà, zhǐ xūyào zài tiáozhěng xìjié.
sentences.translation: His idea is already close to our plan; only the details need to be adjusted.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的价格接近市场平均水平，并不算贵。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的價格接近市場平均水平，並不算貴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de jiàgé jiējìn shìchǎng píngjūn shuǐpíng, bìng bú suàn guì.
sentences.translation: The prices at this shop are close to the market average and are not really expensive.

sentences.chinese: 新系统可以自动接收客户发来的订单。
sentences.traditional: 新系統可以自動接收客戶發來的訂單。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng kěyǐ zìdòng jiēshōu kèhù fā lái de dìngdān.
sentences.translation: The new system can automatically receive orders sent by customers.

sentences.chinese: 如果手机信号不好，接收验证码可能会比较慢。
sentences.traditional: 如果手機信號不好，接收驗證碼可能會比較慢。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shǒujī xìnhào bù hǎo, jiēshōu yànzhèngmǎ kěnéng huì bǐjiào màn.
sentences.translation: If the phone signal is poor, receiving the verification code may be rather slow.

sentences.chinese: 学校今年计划接收更多国际学生。
sentences.traditional: 學校今年計劃接收更多國際學生。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jīnnián jìhuà jiēshōu gèng duō guójì xuésheng.
sentences.translation: The school plans to receive more international students this year.

sentences.chinese: 这根绳子太细，稍微一拉就容易打结。
sentences.traditional: 這根繩子太細，稍微一拉就容易打結。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gēn shéngzi tài xì, shāowēi yì lā jiù róngyì dǎ jié.
sentences.translation: This rope is too thin; it easily gets knotted with just a slight pull.

sentences.chinese: 讨论了半天，问题还是没有得出结论。
sentences.traditional: 討論了半天，問題還是沒有得出結論。
sentences.pinyin: Tǎolùn le bàntiān, wèntí háishi méiyǒu déchū jiélùn.
sentences.translation: After discussing it for ages, they still did not reach a conclusion on the problem.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章的结构很清楚，先提出问题，再分析原因。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章的結構很清楚，先提出問題，再分析原因。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de jiégòu hěn qīngchu, xiān tíchū wèntí, zài fēnxī yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The structure of this article is very clear: it first raises the problem, then analyses the reasons.

sentences.chinese: 如果产品结构不合理，成本就很难降下来。
sentences.traditional: 如果產品結構不合理，成本就很難降下來。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chǎnpǐn jiégòu bù hélǐ, chéngběn jiù hěn nán jiàng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: If the product structure is unreasonable, it will be very hard to bring costs down.

sentences.chinese: 城市建设不仅要追求速度，也要重视空间结构。
sentences.traditional: 城市建設不僅要追求速度，也要重視空間結構。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì jiànshè bùjǐn yào zhuīqiú sùdù, yě yào zhòngshì kōngjiān jiégòu.
sentences.translation: Urban construction should not only pursue speed, but also attach importance to spatial structure.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该把理论和实践结合起来，而不是只停留在书本上。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該把理論和實踐結合起來，而不是只停留在書本上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi bǎ lǐlùn hé shíjiàn jiéhé qǐlái, ér bú shì zhǐ tíngliú zài shūběn shang.
sentences.translation: We should combine theory with practice, rather than only staying with what is in books.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案结合了当地资源和市场需求。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案結合了當地資源和市場需求。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng’àn jiéhé le dāngdì zīyuán hé shìchǎng xūqiú.
sentences.translation: This plan combines local resources with market demand.

sentences.chinese: 只有把兴趣和长期目标结合，学习才更容易坚持。
sentences.traditional: 只有把興趣和長期目標結合，學習才更容易堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu bǎ xìngqù hé chángqī mùbiāo jiéhé, xuéxí cái gèng róngyì jiānchí.
sentences.translation: Only by combining interest with long-term goals does study become easier to keep up.

sentences.chinese: 经过多次实验，研究小组终于得出了比较可靠的结论。
sentences.traditional: 經過多次實驗，研究小組終於得出了比較可靠的結論。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì shíyàn, yánjiū xiǎozǔ zhōngyú déchū le bǐjiào kěkào de jiélùn.
sentences.translation: After many experiments, the research group finally reached a fairly reliable conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 在了解全部情况之前，不要急着下结论。
sentences.traditional: 在了解全部情況之前，不要急著下結論。
sentences.pinyin: Zài liǎojiě quánbù qíngkuàng zhīqián, bú yào jízhe xià jiélùn.
sentences.translation: Before understanding the whole situation, do not rush to a conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 会议的结论很明确：项目必须尽快调整方向。
sentences.traditional: 會議的結論很明確：項目必須盡快調整方向。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì de jiélùn hěn míngquè: xiàngmù bìxū jǐnkuài tiáozhěng fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: The conclusion of the meeting was clear: the project must adjust its direction as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 提前规划路线可以节省不少时间和油费。
sentences.traditional: 提前規劃路線可以節省不少時間和油費。
sentences.pinyin: Tíqián guīhuà lùxiàn kěyǐ jiéshěng bù shǎo shíjiān hé yóufèi.
sentences.translation: Planning the route in advance can save quite a lot of time and fuel costs.

sentences.chinese: 公司通过回收包装材料节省了生产成本。
sentences.traditional: 公司通過回收包裝材料節省了生產成本。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī tōngguò huíshōu bāozhuāng cáiliào jiéshěng le shēngchǎn chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The company saved production costs by recycling packaging materials.

sentences.chinese: 节省并不等于什么都不买，而是把钱花在真正需要的地方。
sentences.traditional: 節省並不等於什麼都不買，而是把錢花在真正需要的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéshěng bìng bù děngyú shénme dōu bù mǎi, ér shì bǎ qián huā zài zhēnzhèng xūyào de dìfang.
sentences.translation: Saving money does not mean buying nothing; it means spending money where it is truly needed.

sentences.chinese: 这是他参加的第三届国际电影节。
sentences.traditional: 這是他參加的第三屆國際電影節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì tā cānjiā de dì sān jiè guójì diànyǐng jié.
sentences.translation: This is the third international film festival he has attended.

sentences.chinese: 本届比赛吸引了来自二十多个国家的选手。
sentences.traditional: 本屆比賽吸引了來自二十多個國家的選手。
sentences.pinyin: Běn jiè bǐsài xīyǐn le láizì èrshí duō ge guójiā de xuǎnshǒu.
sentences.translation: This session of the competition attracted contestants from more than twenty countries.

sentences.chinese: 上一届大会提出的建议，今年终于开始实施。
sentences.traditional: 上一屆大會提出的建議，今年終於開始實施。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng yí jiè dàhuì tíchū de jiànyì, jīnnián zhōngyú kāishǐ shíshī.
sentences.translation: The suggestions put forward at the previous conference finally began to be implemented this year.

sentences.chinese: 今日的会议主要讨论海外市场的发展情况。
sentences.traditional: 今日的會議主要討論海外市場的發展情況。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnrì de huìyì zhǔyào tǎolùn hǎiwài shìchǎng de fāzhǎn qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Today’s meeting mainly discusses the development of overseas markets.

sentences.chinese: 截至今日，所有报名材料都已经收到。
sentences.traditional: 截至今日，所有報名材料都已經收到。
sentences.pinyin: Jiézhì jīnrì, suǒyǒu bàomíng cáiliào dōu yǐjīng shōudào.
sentences.translation: As of today, all application materials have already been received.

sentences.chinese: 今日气温明显下降，户外活动需要注意保暖。
sentences.traditional: 今日氣溫明顯下降，戶外活動需要注意保暖。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnrì qìwēn míngxiǎn xiàjiàng, hùwài huódòng xūyào zhùyì bǎonuǎn.
sentences.translation: Today the temperature has dropped noticeably, so outdoor activities require attention to keeping warm.

sentences.chinese: 这双鞋有点紧，走久了脚会不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 這雙鞋有點緊，走久了腳會不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié yǒudiǎn jǐn, zǒu jiǔ le jiǎo huì bù shūfu.
sentences.translation: This pair of shoes is a bit tight; my feet will be uncomfortable after walking for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 时间很紧，我们必须先处理最重要的部分。
sentences.traditional: 時間很緊，我們必須先處理最重要的部分。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn jǐn, wǒmen bìxū xiān chǔlǐ zuì zhòngyào de bùfen.
sentences.translation: Time is tight, so we must deal with the most important part first.

sentences.chinese: 你把绳子系得太紧，箱子都变形了。
sentences.traditional: 你把繩子繫得太緊，箱子都變形了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shéngzi jì de tài jǐn, xiāngzi dōu biànxíng le.
sentences.translation: You tied the rope too tightly, and even the box has become deformed.

sentences.chinese: 情况十分紧急，医生马上安排了急诊手术。
sentences.traditional: 情況十分緊急，醫生馬上安排了急診手術。
sentences.pinyin: Qíngkuàng shífēn jǐnjí, yīshēng mǎshàng ānpái le jízhěn shǒushù.
sentences.translation: The situation was extremely urgent, so the doctor immediately arranged emergency surgery.

sentences.chinese: 遇到紧急问题时，先保持冷静，再通知负责人。
sentences.traditional: 遇到緊急問題時，先保持冷靜，再通知負責人。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào jǐnjí wèntí shí, xiān bǎochí lěngjìng, zài tōngzhī fùzérén.
sentences.translation: When you encounter an urgent problem, first stay calm, then notify the person in charge.

sentences.chinese: 这批货物急需清关，所以我们发了一封紧急邮件。
sentences.traditional: 這批貨物急需清關，所以我們發了一封緊急郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī huòwù jíxū qīngguān, suǒyǐ wǒmen fā le yì fēng jǐnjí yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: This batch of goods urgently needs customs clearance, so we sent an urgent email.

sentences.chinese: 请把合同发给我，我们需要尽快确认细节。
sentences.traditional: 請把合同發給我，我們需要盡快確認細節。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hétong fā gěi wǒ, wǒmen xūyào jǐnkuài quèrèn xìjié.
sentences.translation: Please send me the contract; we need to confirm the details as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 如果发现数据有误，应该尽快记录并报告。
sentences.traditional: 如果發現數據有誤，應該盡快記錄並報告。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāxiàn shùjù yǒu wù, yīnggāi jǐnkuài jìlù bìng bàogào.
sentences.translation: If you find an error in the data, you should record and report it as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 天气即将变坏，施工队决定尽快完成外墙检查。
sentences.traditional: 天氣即將變壞，施工隊決定盡快完成外牆檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì jíjiāng biàn huài, shīgōng duì juédìng jǐnkuài wánchéng wàiqiáng jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The weather is about to get worse, so the construction team decided to complete the exterior wall inspection as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 你尽量早点到，讲座开始后就不方便进场了。
sentences.traditional: 你盡量早點到，講座開始後就不方便進場了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ jǐnliàng zǎodiǎn dào, jiǎngzuò kāishǐ hòu jiù bù fāngbiàn jìnchǎng le.
sentences.translation: Try to arrive a bit earlier; once the lecture starts, it will not be convenient to enter.

sentences.chinese: 写简历时，要尽量把经验和岗位要求结合起来。
sentences.traditional: 寫簡歷時，要盡量把經驗和崗位要求結合起來。
sentences.pinyin: Xiě jiǎnlì shí, yào jǐnliàng bǎ jīngyàn hé gǎngwèi yāoqiú jiéhé qǐlái.
sentences.translation: When writing a CV, try to combine your experience with the requirements of the role.

sentences.chinese: 这两个部门合作得很紧密，所以项目进展很顺利。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個部門合作得很緊密，所以項目進展很順利。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge bùmén hézuò de hěn jǐnmì, suǒyǐ xiàngmù jìnzhǎn hěn shùnlì.
sentences.translation: The two departments work very closely together, so the project is progressing smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 数据之间存在紧密联系，不能单独分析。
sentences.traditional: 數據之間存在緊密聯繫，不能單獨分析。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù zhījiān cúnzài jǐnmì liánxì, bù néng dāndú fēnxī.
sentences.translation: There is a close connection between the data, so they cannot be analysed separately.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证安全，箱子的盖子必须合得很紧密。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證安全，箱子的蓋子必須合得很緊密。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng ānquán, xiāngzi de gàizi bìxū hé de hěn jǐnmì.
sentences.translation: To ensure safety, the box lid must close very tightly.

sentences.chinese: 投资前要谨慎判断，不能只听别人的建议。
sentences.traditional: 投資前要謹慎判斷，不能只聽別人的建議。
sentences.pinyin: Tóuzī qián yào jǐnshèn pànduàn, bù néng zhǐ tīng biérén de jiànyì.
sentences.translation: Before investing, you must judge cautiously and not just listen to other people's advice.

sentences.chinese: 面对不熟悉的行业，他的态度一直很谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 面對不熟悉的行業，他的態度一直很謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì bù shúxī de hángyè, tā de tàidù yìzhí hěn jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: Facing an unfamiliar industry, his attitude has always been very cautious.

sentences.chinese: 填写海关文件时必须谨慎，以免造成麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 填寫海關文件時必須謹慎，以免造成麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: Tiánxiě hǎiguān wénjiàn shí bìxū jǐnshèn, yǐmiǎn zàochéng máfan.
sentences.translation: When filling in customs documents, you must be cautious to avoid causing trouble.

sentences.chinese: 只要每天坚持练习，你的听力一定会有进步。
sentences.traditional: 只要每天堅持練習，你的聽力一定會有進步。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào měitiān jiānchí liànxí, nǐ de tīnglì yídìng huì yǒu jìnbù.
sentences.translation: As long as you practise every day, your listening will definitely improve.

sentences.chinese: 这个学生虽然起点不高，但进步得非常快。
sentences.traditional: 這個學生雖然起點不高，但進步得非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xuésheng suīrán qǐdiǎn bù gāo, dàn jìnbù de fēicháng kuài.
sentences.translation: Although this student's starting point was not high, he improved very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 技术进步改变了人们的工作方式。
sentences.traditional: 技術進步改變了人們的工作方式。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshù jìnbù gǎibiàn le rénmen de gōngzuò fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Technological progress has changed the way people work.

sentences.chinese: 近代以来，交通的发展大大缩短了城市之间的距离。
sentences.traditional: 近代以來，交通的發展大大縮短了城市之間的距離。
sentences.pinyin: Jìndài yǐlái, jiāotōng de fāzhǎn dàdà suōduǎn le chéngshì zhījiān de jùlí.
sentences.translation: Since modern times, the development of transport has greatly shortened the distance between cities.

sentences.chinese: 这本书介绍了中国近代史上的重要人物。
sentences.traditional: 這本書介紹了中國近代史上的重要人物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jièshào le Zhōngguó jìndài shǐ shang de zhòngyào rénwù.
sentences.translation: This book introduces important figures in China's modern history.

sentences.chinese: 近代社会的变化不仅影响经济，也影响普通人的观念。
sentences.traditional: 近代社會的變化不僅影響經濟，也影響普通人的觀念。
sentences.pinyin: Jìndài shèhuì de biànhuà bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng jīngjì, yě yǐngxiǎng pǔtōng rén de guānniàn.
sentences.translation: Changes in modern society affected not only the economy, but also ordinary people's ideas.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司主要从海外进口机器和零件。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司主要從海外進口機器和零件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhǔyào cóng hǎiwài jìnkǒu jīqì hé língjiàn.
sentences.translation: This company mainly imports machines and parts from overseas.

sentences.chinese: 进口食品必须经过海关检查才能进入市场。
sentences.traditional: 進口食品必須經過海關檢查才能進入市場。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnkǒu shípǐn bìxū jīngguò hǎiguān jiǎnchá cái néng jìnrù shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: Imported food must go through customs inspection before it can enter the market.

sentences.chinese: 如果汇率继续上升，进口成本可能会增加。
sentences.traditional: 如果匯率繼續上升，進口成本可能會增加。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ huìlǜ jìxù shàngshēng, jìnkǒu chéngběn kěnéng huì zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: If the exchange rate continues to rise, import costs may increase.

sentences.chinese: 无论结果如何，我们都已经尽力完成任务了。
sentences.traditional: 無論結果如何，我們都已經盡力完成任務了。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn jiéguǒ rúhé, wǒmen dōu yǐjīng jìnlì wánchéng rènwu le.
sentences.translation: Whatever the result, we have already done our best to complete the task.

sentences.chinese: 医生会尽力帮助病人恢复健康。
sentences.traditional: 醫生會盡力幫助病人恢復健康。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng huì jìnlì bāngzhù bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: The doctor will do his best to help the patient recover.

sentences.chinese: 他明知条件艰苦，还是尽力把项目坚持下去。
sentences.traditional: 他明知條件艱苦，還是盡力把項目堅持下去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míngzhī tiáojiàn jiānkǔ, háishi jìnlì bǎ xiàngmù jiānchí xiàqù.
sentences.translation: He knew the conditions were difficult, but still did his best to keep the project going.

sentences.chinese: 近年来，越来越多的人开始关注环保和回收。
sentences.traditional: 近年來，越來越多的人開始關注環保和回收。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, yuè lái yuè duō de rén kāishǐ guānzhù huánbǎo hé huíshōu.
sentences.translation: In recent years, more and more people have begun to pay attention to environmental protection and recycling.

sentences.chinese: 近年来，这个行业的规模扩大得很快。
sentences.traditional: 近年來，這個行業的規模擴大得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, zhège hángyè de guīmó kuòdà de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: In recent years, the scale of this industry has expanded very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 近年来，线上学习已经成为一种常见的方式。
sentences.traditional: 近年來，線上學習已經成為一種常見的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, xiànshàng xuéxí yǐjīng chéngwéi yì zhǒng chángjiàn de fāngshì.
sentences.translation: In recent years, online learning has already become a common method.

sentences.chinese: 近期天气变化很大，出门前最好查看预报。
sentences.traditional: 近期天氣變化很大，出門前最好查看預報。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnqī tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén qián zuìhǎo chákàn yùbào.
sentences.translation: The weather has changed a lot recently, so it is best to check the forecast before going out.

sentences.chinese: 公司近期会公布新的招聘计划。
sentences.traditional: 公司近期會公佈新的招聘計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìnqī huì gōngbù xīn de zhāopìn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The company will announce a new recruitment plan in the near future.

sentences.chinese: 近期的调查结果显示，消费者更加重视服务质量。
sentences.traditional: 近期的調查結果顯示，消費者更加重視服務質量。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnqī de diàochá jiéguǒ xiǎnshì, xiāofèizhě gèngjiā zhòngshì fúwù zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Recent survey results show that consumers attach more importance to service quality.

sentences.chinese: 近日，海关发布了新的进口规定。
sentences.traditional: 近日，海關發布了新的進口規定。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrì, hǎiguān fābù le xīn de jìnkǒu guīdìng.
sentences.translation: Recently, customs issued new import regulations.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片近日在网上引起了广泛讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片近日在網上引起了廣泛討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jìnrì zài wǎngshàng yǐnqǐ le guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This documentary has recently caused widespread discussion online.

sentences.chinese: 近日的降水缓解了部分地区的干旱问题。
sentences.traditional: 近日的降水緩解了部分地區的乾旱問題。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrì de jiàngshuǐ huǎnjiě le bùfen dìqū de gānhàn wèntí.
sentences.translation: The precipitation in recent days has eased drought problems in some areas.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要进一步观察数据，再决定是否调整方案。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要進一步觀察數據，再決定是否調整方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào jìnyíbù guānchá shùjù, zài juédìng shìfǒu tiáozhěng fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: We need to observe the data further before deciding whether to adjust the plan.

sentences.chinese: 双方同意进一步合作，共同开发海外市场。
sentences.traditional: 雙方同意進一步合作，共同開發海外市場。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng tóngyì jìnyíbù hézuò, gòngtóng kāifā hǎiwài shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: Both sides agreed to cooperate further and jointly develop overseas markets.

sentences.chinese: 为了进一步提高效率，工厂引进了新的机器。
sentences.traditional: 為了進一步提高效率，工廠引進了新的機器。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jìnyíbù tígāo xiàolǜ, gōngchǎng yǐnjìn le xīn de jīqì.
sentences.translation: In order to further improve efficiency, the factory introduced new machines.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说虽然写于几十年前，但至今仍被认为是经典作品。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說雖然寫於幾十年前，但至今仍被認為是經典作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō suīrán xiě yú jǐ shí nián qián, dàn zhìjīn réng bèi rènwéi shì jīngdiǎn zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: Although this novel was written decades ago, it is still considered a classic work.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们比较两种经典理论的不同观点。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們比較兩種經典理論的不同觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǐjiào liǎng zhǒng jīngdiǎn lǐlùn de bùtóng guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to compare the different viewpoints of two classical theories.

sentences.chinese: 这首老歌一响起，观众就跟着唱，真不愧是经典。
sentences.traditional: 這首老歌一響起，觀眾就跟著唱，真不愧是經典。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu lǎo gē yì xiǎngqǐ, guānzhòng jiù gēnzhe chàng, zhēn bú kuì shì jīngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: As soon as this old song started, the audience sang along; it really deserves to be called a classic.

sentences.chinese: 连续工作了一整天以后，他已经没有精力处理新的问题了。
sentences.traditional: 連續工作了一整天以後，他已經沒有精力處理新的問題了。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù gōngzuò le yì zhěng tiān yǐhòu, tā yǐjīng méiyǒu jīnglì chǔlǐ xīn de wèntí le.
sentences.translation: After working continuously for a whole day, he no longer had the energy to deal with new problems.

sentences.chinese: 如果想长期保持高效率，就要合理分配自己的精力。
sentences.traditional: 如果想長期保持高效率，就要合理分配自己的精力。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng chángqī bǎochí gāo xiàolǜ, jiù yào hélǐ fēnpèi zìjǐ de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: To maintain high efficiency over the long term, you need to allocate your energy reasonably.

sentences.chinese: 照顾孩子很花精力，但也能带来很多快乐。
sentences.traditional: 照顧孩子很花精力，但也能帶來很多快樂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàogù háizi hěn huā jīnglì, dàn yě néng dàilái hěn duō kuàilè.
sentences.translation: Looking after children takes a lot of energy, but it can also bring a lot of happiness.

sentences.chinese: 经过一夜休息，他今天看起来很精神。
sentences.traditional: 經過一夜休息，他今天看起來很精神。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò yí yè xiūxi, tā jīntiān kàn qǐlái hěn jīngshen.
sentences.translation: After a night's rest, he looks very lively today.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动不仅锻炼身体，也培养了大家的合作精神。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動不僅鍛鍊身體，也培養了大家的合作精神。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng bùjǐn duànliàn shēntǐ, yě péiyǎng le dàjiā de hézuò jīngshén.
sentences.translation: This activity not only exercised the body, but also developed everyone's spirit of cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 长期压力过大可能会影响人的精神状态。
sentences.traditional: 長期壓力過大可能會影響人的精神狀態。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī yālì guò dà kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng rén de jīngshén zhuàngtài.
sentences.translation: Excessive long-term pressure may affect a person's mental state.

sentences.chinese: 她收到海外朋友寄来的礼物时，脸上露出了惊喜的表情。
sentences.traditional: 她收到海外朋友寄來的禮物時，臉上露出了驚喜的表情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōudào hǎiwài péngyou jì lái de lǐwù shí, liǎn shang lùchū le jīngxǐ de biǎoqíng.
sentences.translation: When she received the gift sent by her overseas friend, a delighted expression appeared on her face.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结束前的进球给全场观众带来了巨大惊喜。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結束前的進球給全場觀眾帶來了巨大驚喜。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù qián de jìnqiú gěi quánchǎng guānzhòng dàilái le jùdà jīngxǐ.
sentences.translation: The goal before the end of the match brought a huge surprise to the whole audience.

sentences.chinese: 收到录取通知时，她感到很惊喜。
sentences.traditional: 收到錄取通知時，她感到很驚喜。
sentences.pinyin: Shōudào lùqǔ tōngzhī shí, tā gǎndào hěn jīngxǐ.
sentences.translation: When she received the admission notice, she felt pleasantly surprised.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店由夫妻两人共同经营，已经开了十多年。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店由夫妻兩人共同經營，已經開了十多年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎodiàn yóu fūqī liǎng rén gòngtóng jīngyíng, yǐjīng kāi le shí duō nián.
sentences.translation: This small shop is jointly run by a husband and wife and has been open for more than ten years.

sentences.chinese: 如果只追求速度而忽视质量，企业很难长期经营下去。
sentences.traditional: 如果只追求速度而忽視質量，企業很難長期經營下去。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhuīqiú sùdù ér hūshì zhìliàng, qǐyè hěn nán chángqī jīngyíng xiàqù.
sentences.translation: If a business only pursues speed and ignores quality, it will be hard for it to operate in the long term.

sentences.chinese: 他负责经营海外市场，所以经常需要和外国客户沟通。
sentences.traditional: 他負責經營海外市場，所以經常需要和外國客戶溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fùzé jīngyíng hǎiwài shìchǎng, suǒyǐ jīngcháng xūyào hé wàiguó kèhù gōutōng.
sentences.translation: He is responsible for managing overseas markets, so he often needs to communicate with foreign clients.

sentences.chinese: 会议室里突然静了下来，大家都在等经理讲话。
sentences.traditional: 會議室裡突然靜了下來，大家都在等經理講話。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì lǐ tūrán jìng le xiàlái, dàjiā dōu zài děng jīnglǐ jiǎnghuà.
sentences.translation: The meeting room suddenly became quiet, and everyone was waiting for the manager to speak.

sentences.chinese: 湖面很静，几乎看不到一丝波动。
sentences.traditional: 湖面很靜，幾乎看不到一絲波動。
sentences.pinyin: Húmiàn hěn jìng, jīhū kàn bù dào yì sī bōdòng.
sentences.translation: The surface of the lake was very still, and there was hardly any movement to be seen.

sentences.chinese: 夜深以后，整条胡同都静得让人有点不习惯。
sentences.traditional: 夜深以後，整條胡同都靜得讓人有點不習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Yè shēn yǐhòu, zhěng tiáo hútòng dōu jìng de ràng rén yǒudiǎn bù xíguàn.
sentences.translation: Late at night, the whole hutong was so quiet that it felt a little unusual.

sentences.chinese: 楼下的酒吧周末很热闹，但有时会影响居民休息。
sentences.traditional: 樓下的酒吧週末很熱鬧，但有時會影響居民休息。
sentences.pinyin: Lóuxià de jiǔbā zhōumò hěn rènao, dàn yǒushí huì yǐngxiǎng jūmín xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The bar downstairs is lively at weekends, but sometimes affects the residents' rest.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒吧规定客人离开时不能在门口大声说话。
sentences.traditional: 這家酒吧規定客人離開時不能在門口大聲說話。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔbā guīdìng kèrén líkāi shí bù néng zài ménkǒu dà shēng shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: This bar requires customers not to speak loudly at the entrance when they leave.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护未成年人，酒吧入口处需要检查身份证件。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護未成年人，酒吧入口處需要檢查身分證件。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù wèi chéngnián rén, jiǔbā rùkǒu chù xūyào jiǎnchá shēnfèn zhèngjiàn.
sentences.translation: To protect minors, the entrance of the bar needs to check identity documents.

sentences.chinese: 这个古老传说的年代已经十分久远，很难找到准确记载。
sentences.traditional: 這個古老傳說的年代已經十分久遠，很難找到準確記載。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo chuánshuō de niándài yǐjīng shífēn jiǔyuǎn, hěn nán zhǎodào zhǔnquè jìzǎi.
sentences.translation: This ancient legend dates back a very long way, so it is hard to find accurate records.

sentences.chinese: 虽然故乡的变化很大，但那些久远的记忆仍然清楚。
sentences.traditional: 雖然故鄉的變化很大，但那些久遠的記憶仍然清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán gùxiāng de biànhuà hěn dà, dàn nàxiē jiǔyuǎn de jìyì réngrán qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Although my hometown has changed a lot, those distant memories are still clear.

sentences.chinese: 一项合理的制度，往往会产生久远的影响。
sentences.traditional: 一項合理的制度，往往會產生久遠的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Yí xiàng hélǐ de zhìdù, wǎngwǎng huì chǎnshēng jiǔyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: A reasonable system often has a far-reaching influence.

sentences.chinese: 发现老人摔倒后，路人立刻上前救他。
sentences.traditional: 發現老人摔倒後，路人立刻上前救他。
sentences.pinyin: Fāxiàn lǎorén shuāidǎo hòu, lùrén lìkè shàng qián jiù tā.
sentences.translation: After discovering that the elderly man had fallen, passers-by immediately went forward to save him.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术可以在关键时刻救病人的命。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術可以在關鍵時刻救病人的命。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù kěyǐ zài guānjiàn shíkè jiù bìngrén de mìng.
sentences.translation: This technology can save a patient's life at a critical moment.

sentences.chinese: 火灾发生时，消防员先救被困在楼上的孩子。
sentences.traditional: 火災發生時，消防員先救被困在樓上的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒzāi fāshēng shí, xiāofángyuán xiān jiù bèi kùn zài lóu shang de háizi.
sentences.translation: When the fire happened, the firefighters first rescued the child trapped upstairs.

sentences.chinese: 病人突然呼吸困难，家人马上叫了救护车。
sentences.traditional: 病人突然呼吸困難，家人馬上叫了救護車。
sentences.pinyin: Bìngrén tūrán hūxī kùnnan, jiārén mǎshàng jiào le jiùhùchē.
sentences.translation: The patient suddenly had difficulty breathing, so the family called an ambulance immediately.

sentences.chinese: 为了让救护车尽快通过，前面的车辆主动让路。
sentences.traditional: 為了讓救護車盡快通過，前面的車輛主動讓路。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ràng jiùhùchē jǐnkuài tōngguò, qiánmiàn de chēliàng zhǔdòng ràng lù.
sentences.translation: To let the ambulance pass as soon as possible, the vehicles in front gave way voluntarily.

sentences.chinese: 急诊中心接到电话后，立即派出救护车去现场。
sentences.traditional: 急診中心接到電話後，立即派出救護車去現場。
sentences.pinyin: Jízhěn zhōngxīn jiēdào diànhuà hòu, lìjí pàichū jiùhùchē qù xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: After the emergency centre received the call, it immediately sent an ambulance to the scene.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高就业机会，他毕业前就开始积累实习经验。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高就業機會，他畢業前就開始積累實習經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo jiùyè jīhuì, tā bìyè qián jiù kāishǐ jīlěi shíxí jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: To improve his chances of getting a job, he began gaining internship experience before graduation.

sentences.chinese: 政府推出新的培训计划，帮助年轻人顺利就业。
sentences.traditional: 政府推出新的培訓計劃，幫助年輕人順利就業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū xīn de péixùn jìhuà, bāngzhù niánqīng rén shùnlì jiùyè.
sentences.translation: The government launched a new training programme to help young people find employment smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市的产业结构变化很快，对就业市场影响很大。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市的產業結構變化很快，對就業市場影響很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de chǎnyè jiégòu biànhuà hěn kuài, duì jiùyè shìchǎng yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The industrial structure of this city is changing quickly, which has a big impact on the employment market.

sentences.chinese: 附近居民对新建停车场的噪音问题提出了意见。
sentences.traditional: 附近居民對新建停車場的噪音問題提出了意見。
sentences.pinyin: Fùjìn jūmín duì xīnjiàn tíngchēchǎng de zàoyīn wèntí tíchū le yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Nearby residents raised concerns about the noise from the newly built car park.

sentences.chinese: 社区定期组织活动，鼓励居民之间加强互动。
sentences.traditional: 社區定期組織活動，鼓勵居民之間加強互動。
sentences.pinyin: Shèqū dìngqī zǔzhī huódòng, gǔlì jūmín zhījiān jiāqiáng hùdòng.
sentences.translation: The community regularly organises activities to encourage more interaction among residents.

sentences.chinese: 这项规定实施以后，居民的生活环境明显好转。
sentences.traditional: 這項規定實施以後，居民的生活環境明顯好轉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shíshī yǐhòu, jūmín de shēnghuó huánjìng míngxiǎn hǎozhuǎn.
sentences.translation: After this regulation was implemented, the residents' living environment clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 他平时很谨慎，这次居然忘了检查合同细节。
sentences.traditional: 他平時很謹慎，這次居然忘了檢查合同細節。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píngshí hěn jǐnshèn, zhè cì jūrán wàng le jiǎnchá hétóng xìjié.
sentences.translation: He is usually very cautious, but this time he unexpectedly forgot to check the contract details.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器用了十年，居然还能正常运转。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器用了十年，居然還能正常運轉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì yòng le shí nián, jūrán hái néng zhèngcháng yùnzhuǎn.
sentences.translation: This machine has been used for ten years, yet unexpectedly it still runs normally.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次参加比赛，居然拿到了冠军。
sentences.traditional: 他第一次參加比賽，居然拿到了冠軍。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì cānjiā bǐsài, jūrán ná dào le guànjūn.
sentences.translation: He took part in the competition for the first time and unexpectedly won the championship.

sentences.chinese: 由于房租过高，很多年轻人选择在城市边缘居住。
sentences.traditional: 由於房租過高，很多年輕人選擇在城市邊緣居住。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú fángzū guò gāo, hěn duō niánqīng rén xuǎnzé zài chéngshì biānyuán jūzhù.
sentences.translation: Because rents are too high, many young people choose to live on the edge of the city.

sentences.chinese: 这里交通方便，环境安静，非常适合长期居住。
sentences.traditional: 這裡交通方便，環境安靜，非常適合長期居住。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jiāotōng fāngbiàn, huánjìng ānjìng, fēicháng shìhé chángqī jūzhù.
sentences.translation: The transport here is convenient and the environment is quiet, making it very suitable for long-term residence.

sentences.chinese: 申请人需要提供目前居住地址和联系方式。
sentences.traditional: 申請人需要提供目前居住地址和聯繫方式。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng rén xūyào tígōng mùqián jūzhù dìzhǐ hé liánxì fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Applicants need to provide their current residential address and contact details.

sentences.chinese: 这种橘子皮薄水分多，很受顾客欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這種橘子皮薄水分多，很受顧客歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng júzi pí báo shuǐfèn duō, hěn shòu gùkè huānyíng.
sentences.translation: This kind of orange has thin skin and plenty of juice, so it is very popular with customers.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把橘子分给伙伴们，每个人都拿到了一瓣。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把橘子分給夥伴們，每個人都拿到了一瓣。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ júzi fēn gěi huǒbàn men, měi ge rén dōu ná dào le yí bàn.
sentences.translation: The child shared the orange with his companions, and everyone got a segment.

sentences.chinese: 这些橘子如果再放几天，可能就会过期变坏。
sentences.traditional: 這些橘子如果再放幾天，可能就會過期變壞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē júzi rúguǒ zài fàng jǐ tiān, kěnéng jiù huì guòqī biàn huài.
sentences.translation: If these oranges are left for a few more days, they may expire and go bad.

sentences.chinese: 据调查，越来越多的居民支持垃圾分类和回收。
sentences.traditional: 據調查，越來越多的居民支持垃圾分類和回收。
sentences.pinyin: Jù diàochá, yuè lái yuè duō de jūmín zhīchí lājī fēnlèi hé huíshōu.
sentences.translation: According to the survey, more and more residents support rubbish sorting and recycling.

sentences.chinese: 据工作人员介绍，展览将持续到国庆节以后。
sentences.traditional: 據工作人員介紹，展覽將持續到國慶節以後。
sentences.pinyin: Jù gōngzuò rényuán jièshào, zhǎnlǎn jiāng chíxù dào Guóqìng Jié yǐhòu.
sentences.translation: According to the staff member, the exhibition will continue until after National Day.

sentences.chinese: 据目前的记录来看，这项纪录已经保持了五年。
sentences.traditional: 據目前的記錄來看，這項紀錄已經保持了五年。
sentences.pinyin: Jù mùqián de jìlù lái kàn, zhè xiàng jìlù yǐjīng bǎochí le wǔ nián.
sentences.translation: Judging by the current records, this achievement record has been held for five years.

sentences.chinese: 学校距最近的地铁站只有五百米，学生上下课很方便。
sentences.traditional: 學校距最近的地鐵站只有五百米，學生上下課很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jù zuìjìn de dìtiězhàn zhǐyǒu wǔ bǎi mǐ, xuésheng shàng xià kè hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The school is only five hundred metres from the nearest underground station, so it is convenient for students to come and go.

sentences.chinese: 我们距完成目标还差最后一步，不能在这个阶段放松。
sentences.traditional: 我們距完成目標還差最後一步，不能在這個階段放鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jù wánchéng mùbiāo hái chà zuìhòu yí bù, bù néng zài zhège jiēduàn fàngsōng.
sentences.translation: We are only one final step away from completing the target, so we cannot relax at this stage.

sentences.chinese: 此地距海关办公室不远，办理货物手续比较方便。
sentences.traditional: 此地距海關辦公室不遠，辦理貨物手續比較方便。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐ dì jù hǎiguān bàngōngshì bù yuǎn, bànlǐ huòwù shǒuxù bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This place is not far from the customs office, so handling goods procedures is relatively convenient.

sentences.chinese: 申请这个职位的人必须具备良好的沟通能力。
sentences.traditional: 申請這個職位的人必須具備良好的溝通能力。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng zhège zhíwèi de rén bìxū jùbèi liánghǎo de gōutōng nénglì.
sentences.translation: Anyone applying for this position must possess good communication skills.

sentences.chinese: 这种材料具备耐高温的特点，适合用于特殊设备。
sentences.traditional: 這種材料具備耐高溫的特點，適合用於特殊設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào jùbèi nài gāowēn de tèdiǎn, shìhé yòng yú tèshū shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This material has the characteristic of resisting high temperatures, so it is suitable for special equipment.

sentences.chinese: 只有具备足够的数据，结论才会更有说服力。
sentences.traditional: 只有具備足夠的數據，結論才會更有說服力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jùbèi zúgòu de shùjù, jiélùn cái huì gèng yǒu shuōfúlì.
sentences.translation: Only with sufficient data will the conclusion be more convincing.

sentences.chinese: 这座剧场建于近代，建筑风格很有特色。
sentences.traditional: 這座劇場建於近代，建築風格很有特色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò jùchǎng jiàn yú jìndài, jiànzhù fēnggé hěn yǒu tèsè.
sentences.translation: This theatre was built in modern times, and its architectural style is very distinctive.

sentences.chinese: 演出即将开始，观众陆续进入剧场。
sentences.traditional: 演出即將開始，觀眾陸續進入劇場。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnchū jíjiāng kāishǐ, guānzhòng lùxù jìnrù jùchǎng.
sentences.translation: The performance is about to begin, and the audience is entering the theatre one after another.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证安全，剧场要求每位客人按座位号入座。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證安全，劇場要求每位客人按座位號入座。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng ānquán, jùchǎng yāoqiú měi wèi kèrén àn zuòwèi hào rùzuò.
sentences.translation: To ensure safety, the theatre requires each guest to sit according to their seat number.

sentences.chinese: 这次技术改革给整个行业带来了巨大影响。
sentences.traditional: 這次技術改革給整個行業帶來了巨大影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jìshù gǎigé gěi zhěnggè hángyè dàilái le jùdà yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This technological reform has had a huge impact on the whole industry.

sentences.chinese: 城市规模在短短几年内发生了巨大变化。
sentences.traditional: 城市規模在短短幾年內發生了巨大變化。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì guīmó zài duǎn duǎn jǐ nián nèi fāshēng le jùdà biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The scale of the city has undergone huge changes in just a few years.

sentences.chinese: 面对巨大压力，他仍然保持冷静，最终解决了问题。
sentences.traditional: 面對巨大壓力，他仍然保持冷靜，最終解決了問題。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jùdà yālì, tā réngrán bǎochí lěngjìng, zuìzhōng jiějué le wèntí.
sentences.translation: Facing enormous pressure, he still remained calm and finally solved the problem.

sentences.chinese: 据说这座古老建筑将被改造成一座开放的剧场。
sentences.traditional: 據說這座古老建築將被改造成一座開放的劇場。
sentences.pinyin: Jùshuō zhè zuò gǔlǎo jiànzhù jiāng bèi gǎizào chéng yí zuò kāifàng de jùchǎng.
sentences.translation: It is said that this ancient building will be transformed into an open theatre.

sentences.chinese: 据说这家机构正在开发一种新的教育软件。
sentences.traditional: 據說這家機構正在開發一種新的教育軟件。
sentences.pinyin: Jùshuō zhè jiā jīgòu zhèngzài kāifā yì zhǒng xīn de jiàoyù ruǎnjiàn.
sentences.translation: Reportedly, this institution is developing a new piece of educational software.

sentences.chinese: 据说今年的决赛会在国庆前后举行。
sentences.traditional: 據說今年的決賽會在國慶前後舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Jùshuō jīnnián de juésài huì zài Guóqìng qiánhòu jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: It is said that this year's final will be held around National Day.

sentences.chinese: 关于合作的具体安排，我们还需要进一步讨论。
sentences.traditional: 關於合作的具體安排，我們還需要進一步討論。
sentences.pinyin: Guānyú hézuò de jùtǐ ānpái, wǒmen hái xūyào jìnyíbù tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: We still need to discuss the specific arrangements for the cooperation further.

sentences.chinese: 请把你的观点说得更具体一些，否则大家很难判断。
sentences.traditional: 請把你的觀點說得更具體一些，否則大家很難判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de guāndiǎn shuō de gèng jùtǐ yìxiē, fǒuzé dàjiā hěn nán pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Please express your viewpoint more specifically; otherwise, it is hard for everyone to judge.

sentences.chinese: 这个设计具体体现了节省空间和保护环境的理念。
sentences.traditional: 這個設計具體體現了節省空間和保護環境的理念。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèjì jùtǐ tǐxiàn le jiéshěng kōngjiān hé bǎohù huánjìng de lǐniàn.
sentences.translation: This design specifically embodies the ideas of saving space and protecting the environment.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片具有很高的教育价值。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片具有很高的教育價值。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jùyǒu hěn gāo de jiàoyù jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: This documentary has very high educational value.

sentences.chinese: 成功的管理者通常具有清楚的目标和坚强的决心。
sentences.traditional: 成功的管理者通常具有清楚的目標和堅強的決心。
sentences.pinyin: Chénggōng de guǎnlǐzhě tōngcháng jùyǒu qīngchǔ de mùbiāo hé jiānqiáng de juéxīn.
sentences.translation: Successful managers usually have clear goals and strong determination.

sentences.chinese: 这种方案具有广泛的应用前景，值得继续开发。
sentences.traditional: 這種方案具有廣泛的應用前景，值得繼續開發。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fāng'àn jùyǒu guǎngfàn de yìngyòng qiánjǐng, zhídé jìxù kāifā.
sentences.translation: This plan has broad prospects for application and is worth continuing to develop.

sentences.chinese: 毕业以后，他决定每年捐一部分收入给家乡的学校。
sentences.traditional: 畢業以後，他決定每年捐一部分收入給家鄉的學校。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyè yǐhòu, tā juédìng měi nián juān yí bùfen shōurù gěi jiāxiāng de xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: After graduating, he decided to donate part of his income every year to schools in his hometown.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动鼓励大家捐旧衣服，而不是直接扔掉。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動鼓勵大家捐舊衣服，而不是直接扔掉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng gǔlì dàjiā juān jiù yīfu, ér bú shì zhíjiē rēngdiào.
sentences.translation: This event encourages everyone to donate old clothes rather than throw them away directly.

sentences.chinese: 公司向医院捐了几台急需的机器。
sentences.traditional: 公司向醫院捐了幾臺急需的機器。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng yīyuàn juān le jǐ tái jíxū de jīqì.
sentences.translation: The company donated several urgently needed machines to the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 食品安全是绝对不能忽视的问题。
sentences.traditional: 食品安全是絕對不能忽視的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Shípǐn ānquán shì juéduì bù néng hūshì de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Food safety is an issue that absolutely cannot be ignored.

sentences.chinese: 他对比赛结果有绝对的信心，因为准备得非常充分。
sentences.traditional: 他對比賽結果有絕對的信心，因為準備得非常充分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì bǐsài jiéguǒ yǒu juéduì de xìnxīn, yīnwèi zhǔnbèi de fēicháng chōngfèn.
sentences.translation: He has absolute confidence in the result of the competition because he is very well prepared.

sentences.chinese: 在紧急情况下，保持冷静绝对比急忙行动更重要。
sentences.traditional: 在緊急情況下，保持冷靜絕對比急忙行動更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, bǎochí lěngjìng juéduì bǐ jímáng xíngdòng gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In an emergency, staying calm is absolutely more important than acting hastily.

sentences.chinese: 他们在半决赛中表现出色，终于进入了决赛。
sentences.traditional: 他們在半決賽中表現出色，終於進入了決賽。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài bànjuésài zhōng biǎoxiàn chūsè, zhōngyú jìnrù le juésài.
sentences.translation: They performed brilliantly in the semi-final and finally entered the final.

sentences.chinese: 明晚的决赛将决定谁能成为本届冠军。
sentences.traditional: 明晚的決賽將決定誰能成為本屆冠軍。
sentences.pinyin: Míng wǎn de juésài jiāng juédìng shéi néng chéngwéi běn jiè guànjūn.
sentences.translation: Tomorrow evening's final will decide who can become this session's champion.

sentences.chinese: 如果想在决赛中获胜，队员们必须集中精力。
sentences.traditional: 如果想在決賽中獲勝，隊員們必須集中精力。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng zài juésài zhōng huòshèng, duìyuán men bìxū jízhōng jīnglì.
sentences.translation: If they want to win in the final, the team members must concentrate their energy.

sentences.chinese: 在这个项目中，每个人的角色都十分明确。
sentences.traditional: 在這個項目中，每個人的角色都十分明確。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù zhōng, měi ge rén de juésè dōu shífēn míngquè.
sentences.translation: In this project, everyone's role is very clearly defined.

sentences.chinese: 这位演员把母亲这个角色演得非常真实。
sentences.traditional: 這位演員把母親這個角色演得非常真實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán bǎ mǔqīn zhège juésè yǎn de fēicháng zhēnshí.
sentences.translation: This actor played the role of the mother very realistically.

sentences.chinese: 在国际交流中，语言往往具有桥梁的角色。
sentences.traditional: 在國際交流中，語言往往具有橋梁的角色。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guójì jiāoliú zhōng, yǔyán wǎngwǎng jùyǒu qiáoliáng de juésè.
sentences.translation: In international exchange, language often has the role of a bridge.

sentences.chinese: 面对艰苦的条件，他仍然没有失去决心。
sentences.traditional: 面對艱苦的條件，他仍然沒有失去決心。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jiānkǔ de tiáojiàn, tā réngrán méiyǒu shīqù juéxīn.
sentences.translation: Facing difficult conditions, he still did not lose his determination.

sentences.chinese: 她决心通过努力学习提高自己的专业技能。
sentences.traditional: 她決心通過努力學習提高自己的專業技能。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéxīn tōngguò nǔlì xuéxí tígāo zìjǐ de zhuānyè jìnéng.
sentences.translation: She is determined to improve her professional skills through hard study.

sentences.chinese: 减肥不只需要计划，更需要长期坚持的决心。
sentences.traditional: 減肥不只需要計劃，更需要長期堅持的決心。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎnféi bù zhǐ xūyào jìhuà, gèng xūyào chángqī jiānchí de juéxīn.
sentences.translation: Losing weight requires not only a plan, but also the determination to stick with it long term.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划开发海外市场，因此急需懂外语的人才。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃開發海外市場，因此急需懂外語的人才。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà kāifā hǎiwài shìchǎng, yīncǐ jíxū dǒng wàiyǔ de réncái.
sentences.translation: The company plans to develop overseas markets, so it urgently needs people who know foreign languages.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件还在开发阶段，近期不会正式开放使用。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件還在開發階段，近期不會正式開放使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn hái zài kāifā jiēduàn, jìnqī bú huì zhèngshì kāifàng shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This software is still in the development stage and will not be officially opened for use in the near future.

sentences.chinese: 过度开发可能破坏当地的河流和湖泊环境。
sentences.traditional: 過度開發可能破壞當地的河流和湖泊環境。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù kāifā kěnéng pòhuài dāngdì de héliú hé húpō huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Excessive development may damage the local river and lake environment.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆将在国庆期间免费向公众开放。
sentences.traditional: 博物館將在國慶期間免費向公眾開放。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn jiāng zài Guóqìng qījiān miǎnfèi xiàng gōngzhòng kāifàng.
sentences.translation: The museum will open to the public free of charge during National Day.

sentences.chinese: 一个开放的学习环境能鼓励学生主动提出问题。
sentences.traditional: 一個開放的學習環境能鼓勵學生主動提出問題。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge kāifàng de xuéxí huánjìng néng gǔlì xuésheng zhǔdòng tíchū wèntí.
sentences.translation: An open learning environment can encourage students to ask questions actively.

sentences.chinese: 随着观念逐渐开放，越来越多的人愿意尝试新的生活方式。
sentences.traditional: 隨著觀念逐漸開放，越來越多的人願意嘗試新的生活方式。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe guānniàn zhújiàn kāifàng, yuè lái yuè duō de rén yuànyì chángshì xīn de shēnghuó fāngshì.
sentences.translation: As ideas gradually become more open, more and more people are willing to try new lifestyles.

sentences.chinese: 艺术节将于今晚八点正式开幕，许多嘉宾都会出席。
sentences.traditional: 藝術節將於今晚八點正式開幕，許多嘉賓都會出席。
sentences.pinyin: Yìshùjié jiāng yú jīn wǎn bā diǎn zhèngshì kāimù, xǔduō jiābīn dōu huì chūxí.
sentences.translation: The arts festival will officially open at eight tonight, and many honoured guests will attend.

sentences.chinese: 这次展览开幕后，吸引了大量海外游客前来参观。
sentences.traditional: 這次展覽開幕後，吸引了大量海外遊客前來參觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn kāimù hòu, xīyǐn le dàliàng hǎiwài yóukè qián lái cānguān.
sentences.translation: After this exhibition opened, it attracted a large number of overseas visitors.

sentences.chinese: 会议还没开幕，代表们就已经开始交换观点。
sentences.traditional: 會議還沒開幕，代表們就已經開始交換觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì hái méi kāimù, dàibiǎo men jiù yǐjīng kāishǐ jiāohuàn guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before the conference had even opened, the representatives had already started exchanging views.

sentences.chinese: 运动会的开幕式虽然不长，却给观众留下了深刻印象。
sentences.traditional: 運動會的開幕式雖然不長，卻給觀眾留下了深刻印象。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndònghuì de kāimùshì suīrán bù cháng, què gěi guānzhòng liúxià le shēnkè yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: Although the sports meeting’s opening ceremony was not long, it left a deep impression on the audience.

sentences.chinese: 开幕式结束以后，各国运动员按照顺序走进剧场。
sentences.traditional: 開幕式結束以後，各國運動員按照順序走進劇場。
sentences.pinyin: Kāimùshì jiéshù yǐhòu, gè guó yùndòngyuán ànzhào shùnxù zǒu jìn jùchǎng.
sentences.translation: After the opening ceremony ended, athletes from each country entered the theatre in order.

sentences.chinese: 为了准备开幕式，工作人员连续加班了好几天。
sentences.traditional: 為了準備開幕式，工作人員連續加班了好幾天。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile zhǔnbèi kāimùshì, gōngzuò rényuán liánxù jiābān le hǎo jǐ tiān.
sentences.translation: To prepare for the opening ceremony, the staff worked overtime for several days in a row.

sentences.chinese: 护士提醒病人多喝开水，不要随便喝冰饮料。
sentences.traditional: 護士提醒病人多喝開水，不要隨便喝冰飲料。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi tíxǐng bìngrén duō hē kāishuǐ, bú yào suíbiàn hē bīng yǐnliào.
sentences.translation: The nurse reminded the patient to drink more boiled water and not casually drink iced drinks.

sentences.chinese: 酒店房间里通常会准备热水壶，方便客人烧开水。
sentences.traditional: 酒店房間裡通常會準備熱水壺，方便客人燒開水。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn fángjiān li tōngcháng huì zhǔnbèi rèshuǐhú, fāngbiàn kèrén shāo kāishuǐ.
sentences.translation: Hotel rooms usually provide a kettle so guests can boil water easily.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有干净的开水，户外活动中就容易出现健康问题。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有乾淨的開水，戶外活動中就容易出現健康問題。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu gānjìng de kāishuǐ, hùwài huódòng zhōng jiù róngyì chūxiàn jiànkāng wèntí.
sentences.translation: Without clean boiled water, health problems can easily arise during outdoor activities.

sentences.chinese: 这条地铁线开通后，居民去市中心方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 這條地鐵線開通後，居民去市中心方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dìtiě xiàn kāitōng hòu, jūmín qù shì zhōngxīn fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: After this metro line opened, it became much more convenient for residents to get to the city centre.

sentences.chinese: 银行建议他开通手机支付功能，以便处理日常交易。
sentences.traditional: 銀行建議他開通手機支付功能，以便處理日常交易。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng jiànyì tā kāitōng shǒujī zhīfù gōngnéng, yǐbiàn chǔlǐ rìcháng jiāoyì.
sentences.translation: The bank suggested that he activate the mobile payment function to handle everyday transactions.

sentences.chinese: 网站刚开通时，访问速度还不太稳定。
sentences.traditional: 網站剛開通時，訪問速度還不太穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngzhàn gāng kāitōng shí, fǎngwèn sùdù hái bú tài wěndìng.
sentences.translation: When the website had just gone online, its access speed was not very stable.

sentences.chinese: 这家火锅店下周开业，老板已经开始招聘员工。
sentences.traditional: 這家火鍋店下週開業，老闆已經開始招聘員工。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā huǒguō diàn xià zhōu kāiyè, lǎobǎn yǐjīng kāishǐ zhāopìn yuángōng.
sentences.translation: This hot pot restaurant will open for business next week, and the owner has already started hiring staff.

sentences.chinese: 商场开业第一天，顾客多得连电梯口都很挤。
sentences.traditional: 商場開業第一天，顧客多得連電梯口都很擠。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngchǎng kāiyè dì yī tiān, gùkè duō de lián diàntīkǒu dōu hěn jǐ.
sentences.translation: On the first day the shopping centre opened, there were so many customers that even the lift entrance was crowded.

sentences.chinese: 由于手续还没办完，公司不得不推迟开业时间。
sentences.traditional: 由於手續還沒辦完，公司不得不推遲開業時間。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shǒuxù hái méi bàn wán, gōngsī bùdébù tuīchí kāiyè shíjiān.
