sentences.translation: Because the procedures had not yet been completed, the company had to postpone its opening date.

sentences.chinese: 学校将开展一项关于环境保护的长期调查。
sentences.traditional: 學校將開展一項關於環境保護的長期調查。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāng kāizhǎn yí xiàng guānyú huánjìng bǎohù de chángqī diàochá.
sentences.translation: The school will carry out a long-term investigation on environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高服务质量，医院近期开展了新的培训项目。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高服務質量，醫院近期開展了新的培訓項目。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo fúwù zhìliàng, yīyuàn jìnqī kāizhǎn le xīn de péixùn xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: To improve service quality, the hospital recently carried out a new training programme.

sentences.chinese: 如果缺少资金，这项研究就很难顺利开展。
sentences.traditional: 如果缺少資金，這項研究就很難順利開展。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ quēshǎo zījīn, zhè xiàng yánjiū jiù hěn nán shùnlì kāizhǎn.
sentences.translation: If there is a lack of funding, this research will be hard to carry out smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 邻居出国期间，请他帮忙看房子。
sentences.traditional: 鄰居出國期間，請他幫忙看房子。
sentences.pinyin: Línjū chūguó qījiān, qǐng tā bāngmáng kān fángzi.
sentences.translation: While the neighbour is abroad, they asked him to help look after the house.

sentences.chinese: 工地门口有人专门看门，陌生人不能随便进去。
sentences.traditional: 工地門口有人專門看門，陌生人不能隨便進去。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngdì ménkǒu yǒu rén zhuānmén kān mén, mòshēngrén bù néng suíbiàn jìn qù.
sentences.translation: Someone is specially assigned to guard the gate at the construction site, so strangers cannot enter casually.

sentences.chinese: 这位老人行动不便，白天需要有人看着。
sentences.traditional: 這位老人行動不便，白天需要有人看著。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén xíngdòng bú biàn, báitiān xūyào yǒu rén kānzhe.
sentences.translation: This elderly person has difficulty moving, so someone needs to watch over him during the day.

sentences.chinese: 周末他打算回故乡看望年迈的父母。
sentences.traditional: 週末他打算回故鄉看望年邁的父母。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò tā dǎsuàn huí gùxiāng kànwàng niánmài de fùmǔ.
sentences.translation: At the weekend, he plans to return to his hometown to visit his elderly parents.

sentences.chinese: 听说老师住院后，学生们一起去医院看望她。
sentences.traditional: 聽說老師住院後，學生們一起去醫院看望她。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō lǎoshī zhùyuàn hòu, xuésheng men yìqǐ qù yīyuàn kànwàng tā.
sentences.translation: After hearing that the teacher had been hospitalised, the students went to the hospital together to visit her.

sentences.chinese: 这次出差时间紧，他没来得及看望当地的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 這次出差時間緊，他沒來得及看望當地的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì chūchāi shíjiān jǐn, tā méi láidejí kànwàng dāngdì de péngyou.
sentences.translation: This business trip was rushed, so he did not have time to visit his local friends.

sentences.chinese: 他把这段失败的经历看作一次宝贵的学习机会。
sentences.traditional: 他把這段失敗的經歷看作一次寶貴的學習機會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè duàn shībài de jīnglì kànzuò yí cì bǎoguì de xuéxí jīhuì.
sentences.translation: He regards this failed experience as a valuable learning opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 在许多文化中，金色常被看作财富和好运的象征。
sentences.traditional: 在許多文化中，金色常被看作財富和好運的象徵。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xǔduō wénhuà zhōng, jīnsè cháng bèi kànzuò cáifù hé hǎoyùn de xiàngzhēng.
sentences.translation: In many cultures, gold is often regarded as a symbol of wealth and good luck.

sentences.chinese: 不要把不同观点看作冲突，它们也可能带来新的思路。
sentences.traditional: 不要把不同觀點看作衝突，它們也可能帶來新的思路。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào bǎ bùtóng guāndiǎn kànzuò chōngtū, tāmen yě kěnéng dài lái xīn de sīlù.
sentences.translation: Do not regard different viewpoints as conflict; they may also bring new ways of thinking.

sentences.chinese: 他不想总是靠父母生活，所以努力寻找就业机会。
sentences.traditional: 他不想總是靠父母生活，所以努力尋找就業機會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng zǒng shì kào fùmǔ shēnghuó, suǒyǐ nǔlì xúnzhǎo jiùyè jīhuì.
sentences.translation: He does not want to always rely on his parents for living, so he works hard to look for job opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 请不要靠在玻璃门上，以免发生危险。
sentences.traditional: 請不要靠在玻璃門上，以免發生危險。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào kào zài bōli mén shang, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
sentences.translation: Please do not lean on the glass door, to avoid danger.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店靠近广场，开业后生意一直不错。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店靠近廣場，開業後生意一直不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn kàojìn guǎngchǎng, kāiyè hòu shēngyì yìzhí búcuò.
sentences.translation: This small shop is close to the square, and business has been good since it opened.

sentences.chinese: 为了观察蝴蝶，孩子们慢慢靠近花丛，却尽量不发出声音。
sentences.traditional: 為了觀察蝴蝶，孩子們慢慢靠近花叢，卻儘量不發出聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile guānchá húdié, háizi men mànman kàojìn huācóng, què jǐnliàng bù fāchū shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: To observe the butterflies, the children slowly approached the flowers while trying not to make a sound.

sentences.chinese: 这座新建的剧场靠近地铁站，因此吸引了很多观众。
sentences.traditional: 這座新建的劇場靠近地鐵站，因此吸引了很多觀眾。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò xīnjiàn de jùchǎng kàojìn dìtiě zhàn, yīncǐ xīyǐn le hěn duō guānzhòng.
sentences.translation: This newly built theatre is close to the metro station, so it has attracted many audience members.

sentences.chinese: 别太靠近机器，尤其是在它高速运转的时候。
sentences.traditional: 別太靠近機器，尤其是在它高速運轉的時候。
sentences.pinyin: Bié tài kàojìn jīqì, yóuqí shì zài tā gāosù yùnzhuǎn de shíhou.
sentences.translation: Do not get too close to the machine, especially when it is running at high speed.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他每天吃一颗药，并记录身体的变化。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他每天吃一顆藥，並記錄身體的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān chī yì kē yào, bìng jìlù shēntǐ de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested that he take one pill every day and record the changes in his body.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上放着几颗橘子，都是他从故乡带来的。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上放著幾顆橘子，都是他從故鄉帶來的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe jǐ kē júzi, dōu shì tā cóng gùxiāng dài lái de.
sentences.translation: There are several oranges on the table, all brought from his hometown.

sentences.chinese: 夜空中出现了一颗特别亮的星星，孩子们兴奋地指着它。
sentences.traditional: 夜空中出現了一顆特別亮的星星，孩子們興奮地指著它。
sentences.pinyin: Yèkōng zhōng chūxiàn le yì kē tèbié liàng de xīngxing, háizi men xīngfèn de zhǐzhe tā.
sentences.translation: A particularly bright star appeared in the night sky, and the children pointed at it excitedly.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学在医学科研方面投入了大量资金。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學在醫學科研方面投入了大量資金。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué zài yīxué kēyán fāngmiàn tóurù le dàliàng zījīn.
sentences.translation: This university has invested substantial funding in medical research.

sentences.chinese: 科研人员需要长期观察数据，不能急着下结论。
sentences.traditional: 科研人員需要長期觀察數據，不能急著下結論。
sentences.pinyin: Kēyán rényuán xūyào chángqī guānchá shùjù, bù néng jízhe xià jiélùn.
sentences.translation: Research staff need to observe the data over the long term and must not rush to a conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有稳定的支持，很多科研项目很难继续开展。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有穩定的支持，很多科研項目很難繼續開展。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu wěndìng de zhīchí, hěn duō kēyán xiàngmù hěn nán jìxù kāizhǎn.
sentences.translation: Without stable support, many research projects are hard to continue carrying out.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告列出了详细数据，可见问题比我们想象的严重。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告列出了詳細數據，可見問題比我們想像的嚴重。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào lièchū le xiángxì shùjù, kějiàn wèntí bǐ wǒmen xiǎngxiàng de yánzhòng.
sentences.translation: This report lists detailed data, showing that the problem is more serious than we imagined.

sentences.chinese: 他连续三个月完成目标，可见他的工作能力很强。
sentences.traditional: 他連續三個月完成目標，可見他的工作能力很強。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liánxù sān ge yuè wánchéng mùbiāo, kějiàn tā de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: He has met his target for three months in a row, which shows that his work ability is strong.

sentences.chinese: 这家店开业不久就得到很多好评，可见服务质量不错。
sentences.traditional: 這家店開業不久就得到很多好評，可見服務質量不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn kāiyè bù jiǔ jiù dédào hěn duō hǎopíng, kějiàn fúwù zhìliàng búcuò.
sentences.translation: This shop received many good reviews soon after opening, so it is clear that the service quality is good.

sentences.chinese: 选择合作伙伴时，价格重要，但可靠更重要。
sentences.traditional: 選擇合作夥伴時，價格重要，但可靠更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnzé hézuò huǒbàn shí, jiàgé zhòngyào, dàn kěkào gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When choosing a partner, price is important, but reliability is even more important.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器虽然旧，但性能一直很可靠。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器雖然舊，但性能一直很可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì suīrán jiù, dàn xìngnéng yìzhí hěn kěkào.
sentences.translation: Although this machine is old, its performance has always been reliable.

sentences.chinese: 他的记录十分完整，因此可以作为可靠的参考资料。
sentences.traditional: 他的記錄十分完整，因此可以作為可靠的參考資料。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jìlù shífēn wánzhěng, yīncǐ kěyǐ zuòwéi kěkào de cānkǎo zīliào.
sentences.translation: His records are very complete, so they can be used as reliable reference material.

sentences.chinese: 最可怕的不是失败，而是发现问题后仍然忽视它。
sentences.traditional: 最可怕的不是失敗，而是發現問題後仍然忽視它。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì kěpà de bú shì shībài, ér shì fāxiàn wèntí hòu réngrán hūshì tā.
sentences.translation: The most frightening thing is not failure, but still ignoring a problem after discovering it.

sentences.chinese: 如果疾病得不到及时治疗，后果可能很可怕。
sentences.traditional: 如果疾病得不到及時治療，後果可能很可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ jíbìng dé bù dào jíshí zhìliáo, hòuguǒ kěnéng hěn kěpà.
sentences.translation: If a disease does not receive timely treatment, the consequences may be terrible.

sentences.chinese: 夜里突然停电，整个走廊安静得有点可怕。
sentences.traditional: 夜裡突然停電，整個走廊安靜得有點可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Yèli tūrán tíngdiàn, zhěnggè zǒuláng ānjìng de yǒudiǎn kěpà.
sentences.translation: The power suddenly went out at night, and the whole corridor became a little frighteningly quiet.

sentences.chinese: 他终于克服了紧张情绪，在讲座上顺利发言。
sentences.traditional: 他終於克服了緊張情緒，在講座上順利發言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú kèfú le jǐnzhāng qíngxù, zài jiǎngzuò shang shùnlì fāyán.
sentences.translation: He finally overcame his nervousness and spoke smoothly at the lecture.

sentences.chinese: 要想克服这个技术困难，团队必须紧密合作。
sentences.traditional: 要想克服這個技術困難，團隊必須緊密合作。
sentences.pinyin: Yào xiǎng kèfú zhège jìshù kùnnan, tuánduì bìxū jǐnmì hézuò.
sentences.translation: To overcome this technical difficulty, the team must work closely together.

sentences.chinese: 她通过每天练习，逐渐克服了对公开讲话的害怕。
sentences.traditional: 她通過每天練習，逐漸克服了對公開講話的害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngguò měitiān liànxí, zhújiàn kèfú le duì gōngkāi jiǎnghuà de hàipà.
sentences.translation: Through daily practice, she gradually overcame her fear of public speaking.

sentences.chinese: 如果货物过期或损坏，请尽快联系在线客服。
sentences.traditional: 如果貨物過期或損壞，請盡快聯繫在線客服。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ huòwù guòqī huò sǔnhuài, qǐng jǐnkuài liánxì zàixiàn kèfú.
sentences.translation: If the goods have expired or are damaged, please contact online customer service as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司的客服态度很好，能耐心解释每个环节。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司的客服態度很好，能耐心解釋每個環節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de kèfú tàidu hěn hǎo, néng nàixīn jiěshì měi ge huánjié.
sentences.translation: This company’s customer service has a good attitude and can patiently explain every step.

sentences.chinese: 他把客户的投诉转给客服部门处理。
sentences.traditional: 他把客戶的投訴轉給客服部門處理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ kèhù de tóusù zhuǎn gěi kèfú bùmén chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: He passed the customer’s complaint to the customer service department to handle.

sentences.chinese: 讨论问题时，我们应该保持客观，不能只凭个人感觉。
sentences.traditional: 討論問題時，我們應該保持客觀，不能只憑個人感覺。
sentences.pinyin: Tǎolùn wèntí shí, wǒmen yīnggāi bǎochí kèguān, bù néng zhǐ píng gèrén gǎnjué.
sentences.translation: When discussing problems, we should remain objective and not rely only on personal feelings.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章的角度比较客观，没有故意夸大矛盾。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章的角度比較客觀，沒有故意誇大矛盾。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de jiǎodù bǐjiào kèguān, méiyǒu gùyì kuādà máodùn.
sentences.translation: The angle of this article is fairly objective and does not deliberately exaggerate the conflict.

sentences.chinese: 为了得到客观结论，研究者需要收集更多证据。
sentences.traditional: 為了得到客觀結論，研究者需要收集更多證據。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile dédào kèguān jiélùn, yánjiū zhě xūyào shōují gèng duō zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: To reach an objective conclusion, researchers need to collect more evidence.

sentences.chinese: 这位客户对产品功能很满意，给了我们好评。
sentences.traditional: 這位客戶對產品功能很滿意，給了我們好評。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi kèhù duì chǎnpǐn gōngnéng hěn mǎnyì, gěi le wǒmen hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: This customer was very satisfied with the product’s functions and gave us a good review.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在整理客户资料，以便提供更合适的服务。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在整理客戶資料，以便提供更合適的服務。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài zhěnglǐ kèhù zīliào, yǐbiàn tígōng gèng héshì de fúwù.
sentences.translation: The company is organising customer information in order to provide more suitable services.

sentences.chinese: 如果客户急需货物，我们可以安排更快的运输方式。
sentences.traditional: 如果客戶急需貨物，我們可以安排更快的運輸方式。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kèhù jíxū huòwù, wǒmen kěyǐ ānpái gèng kuài de yùnshū fāngshì.
sentences.translation: If the customer urgently needs the goods, we can arrange a faster method of transport.

sentences.chinese: 实验室需要更大的空间来放新设备。
sentences.traditional: 實驗室需要更大的空間來放新設備。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyànshì xūyào gèng dà de kōngjiān lái fàng xīn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The laboratory needs a larger space to put the new equipment.

sentences.chinese: 在城市中心，公共空间的设计会影响居民的生活质量。
sentences.traditional: 在城市中心，公共空間的設計會影響居民的生活質量。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chéngshì zhōngxīn, gōnggòng kōngjiān de shèjì huì yǐngxiǎng jūmín de shēnghuó zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: In the city centre, the design of public space affects residents’ quality of life.

sentences.chinese: 这个软件占用的空间不大，旧计算机也能运行。
sentences.traditional: 這個軟件佔用的空間不大，舊計算機也能運行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn zhànyòng de kōngjiān bú dà, jiù jìsuànjī yě néng yùnxíng.
sentences.translation: This software does not take up much space, so old computers can also run it.

sentences.chinese: 直升机在空中停了几秒，然后慢慢下降。
sentences.traditional: 直升機在空中停了幾秒，然後慢慢下降。
sentences.pinyin: Zhíshēngjī zài kōngzhōng tíng le jǐ miǎo, ránhòu mànman xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: The helicopter stayed in the air for a few seconds, then slowly descended.

sentences.chinese: 空中交通受到大雾影响，许多航班被推迟。
sentences.traditional: 空中交通受到大霧影響，許多航班被推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngzhōng jiāotōng shòu dào dàwù yǐngxiǎng, xǔduō hángbān bèi tuīchí.
sentences.translation: Air traffic was affected by heavy fog, and many flights were delayed.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们抬头看着空中的风筝，兴奋地鼓掌。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們抬頭看著空中的風箏，興奮地鼓掌。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen táitóu kànzhe kōngzhōng de fēngzheng, xīngfèn de gǔzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The children looked up at the kite in the sky and clapped excitedly.

sentences.chinese: 情绪激动时，他努力控制自己的声音。
sentences.traditional: 情緒激動時，他努力控制自己的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Qíngxù jīdòng shí, tā nǔlì kòngzhì zìjǐ de shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: When he was emotional, he tried hard to control his voice.

sentences.chinese: 政府采取措施控制污染，恢复河流的水质。
sentences.traditional: 政府採取措施控制污染，恢復河流的水質。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ cuòshī kòngzhì wūrǎn, huīfù héliú de shuǐzhì.
sentences.translation: The government took measures to control pollution and restore the river’s water quality.

sentences.chinese: 如果不能有效控制成本，项目规模就得缩小。
sentences.traditional: 如果不能有效控制成本，項目規模就得縮小。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù néng yǒuxiào kòngzhì chéngběn, xiàngmù guīmó jiù děi suōxiǎo.
sentences.translation: If costs cannot be controlled effectively, the scale of the project will have to be reduced.

sentences.chinese: 他摸了摸口袋，发现钥匙不见了。
sentences.traditional: 他摸了摸口袋，發現鑰匙不見了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mō le mō kǒudai, fāxiàn yàoshi bú jiàn le.
sentences.translation: He felt his pocket and discovered that his keys were missing.

sentences.chinese: 手机一直在口袋里震动，可他没有注意。
sentences.traditional: 手機一直在口袋裡震動，可他沒有注意。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī yìzhí zài kǒudai li zhèndòng, kě tā méiyǒu zhùyì.
sentences.translation: The phone kept vibrating in his pocket, but he did not notice.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套的口袋很深，适合旅行时放护照。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套的口袋很深，適合旅行時放護照。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào de kǒudai hěn shēn, shìhé lǚxíng shí fàng hùzhào.
sentences.translation: The pockets of this coat are deep, suitable for keeping a passport while travelling.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅会根据顾客的口味调整菜的辣度。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳會根據顧客的口味調整菜的辣度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng huì gēnjù gùkè de kǒuwèi tiáozhěng cài de làdù.
sentences.translation: This restaurant adjusts the spiciness of dishes according to customers’ tastes.

sentences.chinese: 他从小在海边长大，口味比较清淡，喜欢海鲜。
sentences.traditional: 他從小在海邊長大，口味比較清淡，喜歡海鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo zài hǎibiān zhǎng dà, kǒuwèi bǐjiào qīngdàn, xǐhuan hǎixiān.
sentences.translation: He grew up by the sea, has relatively light tastes, and likes seafood.

sentences.chinese: 为了适应当地口味，品牌重新设计了菜单。
sentences.traditional: 為了適應當地口味，品牌重新設計了菜單。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shìyìng dāngdì kǒuwèi, pǐnpái chóngxīn shèjì le càidān.
sentences.translation: To suit local tastes, the brand redesigned its menu.

sentences.chinese: 货物已经入库，海关文件也准备好了。
sentences.traditional: 貨物已經入庫，海關文件也準備好了。
sentences.pinyin: Huòwù yǐjīng rù kù, hǎiguān wénjiàn yě zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
sentences.translation: The goods have already entered the warehouse, and the customs documents are also ready.

sentences.chinese: 雨季来临前，经理检查了库里的设备和材料。
sentences.traditional: 雨季來臨前，經理檢查了庫裡的設備和材料。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔjì láilín qián, jīnglǐ jiǎnchá le kù li de shèbèi hé cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Before the rainy season arrives, the manager checked the equipment and materials in the warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 这个库太小，无法存放即将进口的机器。
sentences.traditional: 這個庫太小，無法存放即將進口的機器。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège kù tài xiǎo, wúfǎ cúnfàng jíjiāng jìnkǒu de jīqì.
sentences.translation: This warehouse is too small to store the machines that are about to be imported.

sentences.chinese: 这条路虽然不长，但宽得能让两辆车同时通过。
sentences.traditional: 這條路雖然不長，但寬得能讓兩輛車同時通過。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù suīrán bù cháng, dàn kuān de néng ràng liǎng liàng chē tóngshí tōngguò.
sentences.translation: Although this road is not long, it is wide enough for two cars to pass at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 新办公室比原来宽多了，大家的活动空间也更大。
sentences.traditional: 新辦公室比原來寬多了，大家的活動空間也更大。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn bàngōngshì bǐ yuánlái kuān duō le, dàjiā de huódòng kōngjiān yě gèng dà.
sentences.translation: The new office is much wider than the old one, so everyone has more room to move around.

sentences.chinese: 他心胸很宽，不会因为小误会就责怪别人。
sentences.traditional: 他心胸很寬，不會因為小誤會就責怪別人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīnxiōng hěn kuān, bú huì yīnwèi xiǎo wùhuì jiù zéguài biérén.
sentences.translation: He is broad-minded and will not blame others over a small misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 设计师先测量桌子的宽度，再决定键盘的位置。
sentences.traditional: 設計師先測量桌子的寬度，再決定鍵盤的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī xiān cèliáng zhuōzi de kuāndù, zài juédìng jiànpán de wèizhi.
sentences.translation: The designer first measured the width of the desk, then decided the position of the keyboard.

sentences.chinese: 这条河流的宽度在雨季会明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 這條河流的寬度在雨季會明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo héliú de kuāndù zài yǔjì huì míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: The width of this river increases noticeably during the rainy season.

sentences.chinese: 如果通道的宽度不够，救护车就很难进入。
sentences.traditional: 如果通道的寬度不夠，救護車就很難進入。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tōngdào de kuāndù bú gòu, jiùhùchē jiù hěn nán jìnrù.
sentences.translation: If the width of the passage is insufficient, it will be difficult for an ambulance to enter.

sentences.chinese: 这笔交易没有调查清楚，结果公司亏了不少钱。
sentences.traditional: 這筆交易沒有調查清楚，結果公司虧了不少錢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ jiāoyì méiyǒu diàochá qīngchu, jiéguǒ gōngsī kuī le bù shǎo qián.
sentences.translation: This deal was not investigated clearly, and as a result the company lost quite a lot of money.

sentences.chinese: 他为了保护伙伴，宁可自己吃点亏。
sentences.traditional: 他為了保護夥伴，寧可自己吃點虧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèile bǎohù huǒbàn, nìngkě zìjǐ chī diǎn kuī.
sentences.translation: To protect his partner, he would rather suffer a small loss himself.

sentences.chinese: 如果只看价格而忽视质量，最后反而会亏。
sentences.traditional: 如果只看價格而忽視質量，最後反而會虧。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ kàn jiàgé ér hūshì zhìliàng, zuìhòu fǎn'ér huì kuī.
sentences.translation: If you only look at price and ignore quality, you may end up losing out instead.

sentences.chinese: 孩子在户外观察昆虫，并把发现记录下来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子在戶外觀察昆蟲，並把發現記錄下來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zài hùwài guānchá kūnchóng, bìng bǎ fāxiàn jìlù xiàlai.
sentences.translation: The child observed insects outdoors and recorded what he found.

sentences.chinese: 这种昆虫对农作物有害，需要及时控制。
sentences.traditional: 這種昆蟲對農作物有害，需要及時控制。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kūnchóng duì nóngzuòwù yǒu hài, xūyào jíshí kòngzhì.
sentences.translation: This kind of insect is harmful to crops and needs to be controlled promptly.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆的昆虫展吸引了许多好奇的学生。
sentences.traditional: 博物館的昆蟲展吸引了許多好奇的學生。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn de kūnchóng zhǎn xīyǐn le xǔduō hàoqí de xuéshēng.
sentences.translation: The museum’s insect exhibition attracted many curious students.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划扩大地铁网络，以缓解市中心的交通压力。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃擴大地鐵網絡，以緩解市中心的交通壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà kuòdà dìtiě wǎngluò, yǐ huǎnjiě shì zhōngxīn de jiāotōng yālì.
sentences.translation: The government plans to expand the metro network to ease traffic pressure in the city centre.

sentences.chinese: 随着客户数量增加，公司不得不扩大客服团队。
sentences.traditional: 隨著客戶數量增加，公司不得不擴大客服團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe kèhù shùliàng zēngjiā, gōngsī bùdébù kuòdà kèfú tuánduì.
sentences.translation: As the number of customers increases, the company has no choice but to expand the customer service team.

sentences.chinese: 过度扩大规模可能会带来管理上的风险。
sentences.traditional: 過度擴大規模可能會帶來管理上的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù kuòdà guīmó kěnéng huì dàilái guǎnlǐ shang de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Excessively expanding the scale may bring management risks.

sentences.chinese: 这些数据的来源必须可靠，否则结论就不客观。
sentences.traditional: 這些數據的來源必須可靠，否則結論就不客觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù de láiyuán bìxū kěkào, fǒuzé jiélùn jiù bù kèguān.
sentences.translation: The source of these data must be reliable; otherwise, the conclusion will not be objective.

sentences.chinese: 这笔资金来源于海外客户的投资。
sentences.traditional: 這筆資金來源於海外客戶的投資。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ zījīn láiyuán yú hǎiwài kèhù de tóuzī.
sentences.translation: This funding comes from investment by overseas clients.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆会说明每件文物的来源和历史背景。
sentences.traditional: 博物館會說明每件文物的來源和歷史背景。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn huì shuōmíng měi jiàn wénwù de láiyuán hé lìshǐ bèijǐng.
sentences.translation: The museum explains the source and historical background of each cultural relic.

sentences.chinese: 尊重劳动是社会公平的重要基础。
sentences.traditional: 尊重勞動是社會公平的重要基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Zūnzhòng láodòng shì shèhuì gōngpíng de zhòngyào jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: Respecting labour is an important foundation of social fairness.

sentences.chinese: 机器可以提高效率，但不能完全代替人的劳动。
sentences.traditional: 機器可以提高效率，但不能完全代替人的勞動。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì kěyǐ tígāo xiàolǜ, dàn bùnéng wánquán dàitì rén de láodòng.
sentences.translation: Machines can improve efficiency, but they cannot completely replace human labour.

sentences.chinese: 经过一天的劳动，他虽然很累，却觉得很有成就感。
sentences.traditional: 經過一天的勞動，他雖然很累，卻覺得很有成就感。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò yì tiān de láodòng, tā suīrán hěn lèi, què juéde hěn yǒu chéngjiùgǎn.
sentences.translation: After a day of work, although he was tired, he felt a strong sense of achievement.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策的目的，是降低老百姓的生活成本。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策的目的，是降低老百姓的生活成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de mùdì, shì jiàngdī lǎobǎixìng de shēnghuó chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The purpose of this policy is to reduce the living costs of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 只有让老百姓真正受益，改革才算成功。
sentences.traditional: 只有讓老百姓真正受益，改革才算成功。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu ràng lǎobǎixìng zhēnzhèng shòuyì, gǎigé cái suàn chénggōng.
sentences.translation: Only when ordinary people truly benefit can the reform be considered successful.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院的服务价格比较合理，受到老百姓好评。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院的服務價格比較合理，受到老百姓好評。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de fúwù jiàgé bǐjiào hélǐ, shòu dào lǎobǎixìng hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: The service prices at this hospital are fairly reasonable and have received praise from ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 老板决定扩大仓库，以便存放更多货物。
sentences.traditional: 老闆決定擴大倉庫，以便存放更多貨物。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn juédìng kuòdà cāngkù, yǐbiàn cúnfàng gèng duō huòwù.
sentences.translation: The boss decided to expand the warehouse in order to store more goods.

sentences.chinese: 她不是只会命令员工的老板，而是愿意一起解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 她不是只會命令員工的老闆，而是願意一起解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì zhǐ huì mìnglìng yuángōng de lǎobǎn, ér shì yuànyì yìqǐ jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: She is not a boss who only orders employees around, but someone willing to solve problems together.

sentences.chinese: 如果老板过于追求速度，产品质量可能会下降。
sentences.traditional: 如果老闆過於追求速度，產品質量可能會下降。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ lǎobǎn guòyú zhuīqiú sùdù, chǎnpǐn zhìliàng kěnéng huì xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: If the boss pursues speed too much, product quality may decline.

sentences.chinese: 她老公在海外工作，所以他们经常通过视频联系。
sentences.traditional: 她老公在海外工作，所以他們經常通過視頻聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǎogōng zài hǎiwài gōngzuò, suǒyǐ tāmen jīngcháng tōngguò shìpín liánxì.
sentences.translation: Her husband works overseas, so they often keep in touch by video.

sentences.chinese: 我老公对新技术很好奇，家里的家电都是他挑的。
sentences.traditional: 我老公對新技術很好奇，家裡的家電都是他挑的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ lǎogōng duì xīn jìshù hěn hàoqí, jiā li de jiādiàn dōu shì tā tiāo de.
sentences.translation: My husband is very curious about new technology, and he chose all the household appliances at home.

sentences.chinese: 她说老公虽然工作忙，但每天都会分担家务。
sentences.traditional: 她說老公雖然工作忙，但每天都會分擔家務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō lǎogōng suīrán gōngzuò máng, dàn měi tiān dōu huì fēndān jiāwù.
sentences.translation: She says that although her husband is busy with work, he shares the housework every day.

sentences.chinese: 我小时候常住在姥姥家，对那个胡同记忆很深。
sentences.traditional: 我小時候常住在姥姥家，對那個胡同記憶很深。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou cháng zhù zài lǎolao jiā, duì nàge hútòng jìyì hěn shēn.
sentences.translation: When I was little, I often stayed at my grandmother’s home, so I have deep memories of that hutong.

sentences.chinese: 姥姥年纪大了，最近身体才慢慢好转。
sentences.traditional: 姥姥年紀大了，最近身體才慢慢好轉。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎolao niánjì dà le, zuìjìn shēntǐ cái mànmàn hǎozhuǎn.
sentences.translation: Grandmother is old, and her health has only recently started to improve slowly.

sentences.chinese: 每逢国庆，我们全家都会去看望姥姥。
sentences.traditional: 每逢國慶，我們全家都會去看望姥姥。
sentences.pinyin: Měi féng Guóqìng, wǒmen quán jiā dōu huì qù kànwàng lǎolao.
sentences.translation: Every National Day, our whole family goes to visit grandmother.

sentences.chinese: 他老婆经营一家小店，生意一直很稳定。
sentences.traditional: 他老婆經營一家小店，生意一直很穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǎopo jīngyíng yì jiā xiǎo diàn, shēngyì yìzhí hěn wěndìng.
sentences.translation: His wife runs a small shop, and the business has always been stable.

sentences.chinese: 老婆提醒他尽快挂号，因为过敏症状没有缓解。
sentences.traditional: 老婆提醒他儘快掛號，因為過敏症狀沒有緩解。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎopo tíxǐng tā jǐnkuài guàhào, yīnwèi guòmǐn zhèngzhuàng méiyǒu huǎnjiě.
sentences.translation: His wife reminded him to register for a medical appointment as soon as possible because his allergic symptoms had not eased.

sentences.chinese: 他把老婆的建议看作最可靠的参考。
sentences.traditional: 他把老婆的建議看作最可靠的參考。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǎopo de jiànyì kànzuò zuì kěkào de cānkǎo.
sentences.translation: He regarded his wife’s suggestion as the most reliable reference.

sentences.chinese: 姥爷年轻时当过驾驶员，对各种机器都很熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 姥爺年輕時當過駕駛員，對各種機器都很熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoye niánqīng shí dāng guò jiàshǐyuán, duì gè zhǒng jīqì dōu hěn shúxī.
sentences.translation: Grandfather worked as a driver when he was young and is very familiar with all kinds of machines.

sentences.chinese: 姥爷喜欢国画，家里的墙上挂着他的作品。
sentences.traditional: 姥爺喜歡國畫，家裡的牆上掛著他的作品。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoye xǐhuan guóhuà, jiā li de qiáng shang guàzhe tā de zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: Grandfather likes traditional Chinese painting, and his works hang on the wall at home.

sentences.chinese: 我们去故乡看望姥爷，顺便参加一个家族婚礼。
sentences.traditional: 我們去故鄉看望姥爺，順便參加一個家族婚禮。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen qù gùxiāng kànwàng lǎoye, shùnbiàn cānjiā yí ge jiāzú hūnlǐ.
sentences.translation: We went to our hometown to visit grandfather and attended a family wedding on the same trip.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难，他始终保持乐观，没有轻易放弃。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難，他始終保持樂觀，沒有輕易放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan, tā shǐzhōng bǎochí lèguān, méiyǒu qīngyì fàngqì.
sentences.translation: Facing difficulties, he always remained optimistic and did not give up easily.

sentences.chinese: 乐观并不等于忽视风险，而是相信问题可以被克服。
sentences.traditional: 樂觀並不等於忽視風險，而是相信問題可以被克服。
sentences.pinyin: Lèguān bìng bù děngyú hūshì fēngxiǎn, ér shì xiāngxìn wèntí kěyǐ bèi kèfú.
sentences.translation: Being optimistic does not mean ignoring risks; it means believing that problems can be overcome.

sentences.chinese: 尽管市场近期不太稳定，经理对未来仍然很乐观。
sentences.traditional: 儘管市場近期不太穩定，經理對未來仍然很樂觀。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shìchǎng jìnqī bù tài wěndìng, jīnglǐ duì wèilái réngrán hěn lèguān.
sentences.translation: Although the market has not been very stable recently, the manager is still optimistic about the future.

sentences.chinese: 阅读经典小说的乐趣在于，每次重读都会有新的理解。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀經典小說的樂趣在於，每次重讀都會有新的理解。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú jīngdiǎn xiǎoshuō de lèqù zài yú, měi cì chóngdú dōu huì yǒu xīn de lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: The fun of reading classic novels lies in gaining new understanding every time you reread them.

sentences.chinese: 如果只追求成绩，学习本身的乐趣就容易被忽视。
sentences.traditional: 如果只追求成績，學習本身的樂趣就容易被忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhuīqiú chéngjì, xuéxí běnshēn de lèqù jiù róngyì bèi hūshì.
sentences.translation: If you only pursue grades, the fun of learning itself is easily overlooked.

sentences.chinese: 参加户外活动不仅能锻炼身体，也能带来不少乐趣。
sentences.traditional: 參加戶外活動不僅能鍛鍊身體，也能帶來不少樂趣。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā hùwài huódòng bùjǐn néng duànliàn shēntǐ, yě néng dài lái bù shǎo lèqù.
sentences.translation: Taking part in outdoor activities can not only exercise the body but also bring a lot of fun.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，她的眼里立刻含着泪。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，她的眼裡立刻含著淚。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā de yǎn lǐ lìkè hánzhe lèi.
sentences.translation: When she heard the news, her eyes immediately filled with tears.

sentences.chinese: 离开故乡那天，他强忍着泪向父母告别。
sentences.traditional: 離開故鄉那天，他強忍著淚向父母告別。
sentences.pinyin: Líkāi gùxiāng nà tiān, tā qiáng rěnzhe lèi xiàng fùmǔ gàobié.
sentences.translation: On the day he left his hometown, he held back tears as he said goodbye to his parents.

sentences.chinese: 电影结束时，许多观众都被感动得流下了泪。
sentences.traditional: 電影結束時，許多觀眾都被感動得流下了淚。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng jiéshù shí, xǔduō guānzhòng dōu bèi gǎndòng de liú xià le lèi.
sentences.translation: When the film ended, many viewers were moved to tears.

sentences.chinese: 这一类问题看似简单，实际上涉及很多细节。
sentences.traditional: 這一類問題看似簡單，實際上涉及很多細節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yī lèi wèntí kàn sì jiǎndān, shíjì shang shèjí hěn duō xìjié.
sentences.translation: This kind of problem seems simple, but in fact it involves many details.

sentences.chinese: 公司把客户分成几类，以便提供更合适的服务。
sentences.traditional: 公司把客戶分成幾類，以便提供更合適的服務。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī bǎ kèhù fēn chéng jǐ lèi, yǐbiàn tígōng gèng héshì de fúwù.
sentences.translation: The company divides customers into several categories in order to provide more suitable services.

sentences.chinese: 这类食品含糖量较高，减肥期间最好少吃。
sentences.traditional: 這類食品含糖量較高，減肥期間最好少吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lèi shípǐn hán táng liàng jiào gāo, jiǎnféi qījiān zuìhǎo shǎo chī.
sentences.translation: This type of food has a relatively high sugar content, so it is best to eat less of it while losing weight.

sentences.chinese: 颁奖时，冠军激动得泪水顺着脸流了下来。
sentences.traditional: 頒獎時，冠軍激動得淚水順著臉流了下來。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiǎng shí, guànjūn jīdòng de lèishuǐ shùnzhe liǎn liú le xiàlái.
sentences.translation: At the award ceremony, the champion was so excited that tears flowed down their face.

sentences.chinese: 她没有说话，只是用手擦去了眼角的泪水。
sentences.traditional: 她沒有說話，只是用手擦去了眼角的淚水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shuōhuà, zhǐshì yòng shǒu cā qù le yǎnjiǎo de lèishuǐ.
sentences.translation: She did not speak; she only wiped away the tears from the corners of her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 这段纪录片记录了灾区居民含着泪水重建家园的过程。
sentences.traditional: 這段紀錄片記錄了災區居民含著淚水重建家園的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn jìlùpiàn jìlù le zāiqū jūmín hánzhe lèishuǐ chóngjiàn jiāyuán de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: This documentary records the process of disaster-area residents rebuilding their homes with tears in their eyes.

sentences.chinese: 我们过去遇到过类似的情况，所以这次处理得比较快。
sentences.traditional: 我們過去遇到過類似的情況，所以這次處理得比較快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen guòqù yùdào guò lèisì de qíngkuàng, suǒyǐ zhè cì chǔlǐ de bǐjiào kuài.
sentences.translation: We have encountered similar situations before, so we dealt with this one relatively quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这两种机器的功能类似，但价格相差很大。
sentences.traditional: 這兩種機器的功能類似，但價格相差很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng jīqì de gōngnéng lèisì, dàn jiàgé xiāngchà hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The functions of these two machines are similar, but their prices differ greatly.

sentences.chinese: 类似的问题如果反复出现，就说明管理流程需要调整。
sentences.traditional: 類似的問題如果反覆出現，就說明管理流程需要調整。
sentences.pinyin: Lèisì de wèntí rúguǒ fǎnfù chūxiàn, jiù shuōmíng guǎnlǐ liúchéng xūyào tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: If similar problems keep appearing, it shows that the management process needs adjustment.

sentences.chinese: 不同类型的客户，对服务的要求往往不一样。
sentences.traditional: 不同類型的客戶，對服務的要求往往不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng lèixíng de kèhù, duì fúwù de yāoqiú wǎngwǎng bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Different types of customers often have different requirements for service.

sentences.chinese: 这家网站根据内容类型，把纪录片和电视剧分开展示。
sentences.traditional: 這家網站根據內容類型，把紀錄片和電視劇分開展示。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā wǎngzhàn gēnjù nèiróng lèixíng, bǎ jìlùpiàn hé diànshìjù fēnkāi zhǎnshì.
sentences.translation: This website displays documentaries and TV dramas separately according to content type.

sentences.chinese: 选择工作时，先弄清楚自己适合哪种类型的环境。
sentences.traditional: 選擇工作時，先弄清楚自己適合哪種類型的環境。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnzé gōngzuò shí, xiān nòng qīngchu zìjǐ shìhé nǎ zhǒng lèixíng de huánjìng.
sentences.translation: When choosing a job, first work out what type of environment suits you.

sentences.chinese: 这种梨水分很多，适合饭后吃。
sentences.traditional: 這種梨水分很多，適合飯後吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng lí shuǐfèn hěn duō, shìhé fàn hòu chī.
sentences.translation: This kind of pear has a lot of moisture and is suitable for eating after a meal.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他少吃油腻食物，多吃苹果和梨。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他少吃油膩食物，多吃蘋果和梨。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā shǎo chī yóunì shíwù, duō chī píngguǒ hé lí.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to eat less greasy food and more apples and pears.

sentences.chinese: 她把梨切成小块，放进孩子的盒饭里。
sentences.traditional: 她把梨切成小塊，放進孩子的盒飯裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ lí qiē chéng xiǎo kuài, fàng jìn háizi de héfàn lǐ.
sentences.translation: She cut the pear into small pieces and put it into the child’s boxed meal.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定离婚以后，仍然共同照顾孩子。
sentences.traditional: 他們決定離婚以後，仍然共同照顧孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng líhūn yǐhòu, réngrán gòngtóng zhàogù háizi.
sentences.translation: After they decided to divorce, they still looked after the child together.

sentences.chinese: 离婚并不是失败，有时是双方重新开始生活的机会。
sentences.traditional: 離婚並不是失敗，有時是雙方重新開始生活的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Líhūn bìng bú shì shībài, yǒu shí shì shuāngfāng chóngxīn kāishǐ shēnghuó de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Divorce is not failure; sometimes it is a chance for both sides to start life again.

sentences.chinese: 在办理离婚手续之前，他们先向律师了解了法律后果。
sentences.traditional: 在辦理離婚手續之前，他們先向律師了解了法律後果。
sentences.pinyin: Zài bànlǐ líhūn shǒuxù zhīqián, tāmen xiān xiàng lǜshī liǎojiě le fǎlǜ hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: Before going through the divorce procedures, they first asked a lawyer about the legal consequences.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子的宽度是八十厘米，放在客厅刚好合适。
sentences.traditional: 這張桌子的寬度是八十厘米，放在客廳剛好合適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi de kuāndù shì bāshí límǐ, fàng zài kètīng gānghǎo héshì.
sentences.translation: The width of this table is eighty centimetres, so it fits in the living room just right.

sentences.chinese: 医生说伤口大约三厘米长，需要每天换药。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說傷口大約三厘米長，需要每天換藥。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō shāngkǒu dàyuē sān límǐ cháng, xūyào měi tiān huàn yào.
sentences.translation: The doctor said the wound is about three centimetres long and needs its dressing changed every day.

sentences.chinese: 如果误差超过一厘米，零件就无法安装。
sentences.traditional: 如果誤差超過一厘米，零件就無法安裝。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wùchā chāoguò yī límǐ, língjiàn jiù wúfǎ ānzhuāng.
sentences.translation: If the error exceeds one centimetre, the part cannot be installed.

sentences.chinese: 他离职前，把客户资料整理得非常清楚。
sentences.traditional: 他離職前，把客戶資料整理得非常清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lízhí qián, bǎ kèhù zīliào zhěnglǐ de fēicháng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Before resigning, he organised the customer information very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 由于公司搬到外地，她最终选择了离职。
sentences.traditional: 由於公司搬到外地，她最終選擇了離職。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú gōngsī bān dào wàidì, tā zuìzhōng xuǎnzé le lízhí.
sentences.translation: Because the company moved to another place, she finally chose to resign.

sentences.chinese: 员工突然离职，会对项目进度造成一定影响。
sentences.traditional: 員工突然離職，會對項目進度造成一定影響。
sentences.pinyin: Yuángōng tūrán lízhí, huì duì xiàngmù jìndù zàochéng yídìng yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: An employee’s sudden resignation will have a certain impact on the progress of the project.

sentences.chinese: 这套理论如果不能和现实结合，就很难解决实际问题。
sentences.traditional: 這套理論如果不能和現實結合，就很難解決實際問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào lǐlùn rúguǒ bù néng hé xiànshí jiéhé, jiù hěn nán jiějué shíjì wèntí.
sentences.translation: If this theory cannot be combined with reality, it will be very hard to solve practical problems.

sentences.chinese: 光有理论还不够，关键是要在工作中不断实践。
sentences.traditional: 光有理論還不夠，關鍵是要在工作中不斷實踐。
sentences.pinyin: Guāng yǒu lǐlùn hái bù gòu, guānjiàn shì yào zài gōngzuò zhōng búduàn shíjiàn.
sentences.translation: Having theory alone is not enough; the key is to keep practising at work.

sentences.chinese: 他试图从历史角度理论化这种社会变化。
sentences.traditional: 他試圖從歷史角度理論化這種社會變化。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú cóng lìshǐ jiǎodù lǐlùn huà zhè zhǒng shèhuì biànhuà.
sentences.translation: He tried to theorise this social change from a historical perspective.

sentences.chinese: 盒子里头装着几份合同，千万别弄丢。
sentences.traditional: 盒子裡頭裝著幾份合同，千萬別弄丟。
sentences.pinyin: Hézi lǐtou zhuāngzhe jǐ fèn hétóng, qiānwàn bié nòng diū.
sentences.translation: There are several contracts inside the box, so do not lose them.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章里头有不少专业词，读起来比较费力。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章裡頭有不少專業詞，讀起來比較費力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng lǐtou yǒu bù shǎo zhuānyè cí, dú qǐlái bǐjiào fèilì.
sentences.translation: There are quite a few technical terms inside this article, so it is rather hard to read.

sentences.chinese: 他把钥匙放在抽屉里头，结果自己也忘了。
sentences.traditional: 他把鑰匙放在抽屜裡頭，結果自己也忘了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yàoshi fàng zài chōuti lǐtou, jiéguǒ zìjǐ yě wàng le.
sentences.translation: He put the key inside the drawer, and in the end even he forgot.

sentences.chinese: 你拒绝这个计划，总得提出一个合理的理由。
sentences.traditional: 你拒絕這個計劃，總得提出一個合理的理由。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ jùjué zhège jìhuà, zǒng děi tíchū yí ge hélǐ de lǐyóu.
sentences.translation: If you reject this plan, you should at least give a reasonable reason.

sentences.chinese: 他迟到的理由听起来不太可靠，经理没有接受。
sentences.traditional: 他遲到的理由聽起來不太可靠，經理沒有接受。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chídào de lǐyóu tīng qǐlái bú tài kěkào, jīnglǐ méiyǒu jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: His reason for being late did not sound very reliable, so the manager did not accept it.

sentences.chinese: 没有充分的理由，公司不应该随便改变合同。
sentences.traditional: 沒有充分的理由，公司不應該隨便改變合同。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu chōngfèn de lǐyóu, gōngsī bù yīnggāi suíbiàn gǎibiàn hétóng.
sentences.translation: Without a sufficient reason, the company should not casually change the contract.

sentences.chinese: 他用尽全身的力，才把卡住的门推开。
sentences.traditional: 他用盡全身的力，才把卡住的門推開。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng jìn quánshēn de lì, cái bǎ kǎ zhù de mén tuī kāi.
sentences.translation: He used all his strength before he managed to push open the stuck door.

sentences.chinese: 这个品牌在市场上很有影响力。
sentences.traditional: 這個品牌在市場上很有影響力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái zài shìchǎng shang hěn yǒu yǐngxiǎng lì.
sentences.translation: This brand has a lot of influence in the market.

sentences.chinese: 长期阅读能提高孩子的理解力。
sentences.traditional: 長期閱讀能提高孩子的理解力。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī yuèdú néng tígāo háizi de lǐjiě lì.
sentences.translation: Long-term reading can improve a child’s comprehension ability.

sentences.chinese: 发现系统有问题后，技术人员立即停止了操作。
sentences.traditional: 發現系統有問題後，技術人員立即停止了操作。
sentences.pinyin: Fāxiàn xìtǒng yǒu wèntí hòu, jìshù rényuán lìjí tíngzhǐ le cāozuò.
sentences.translation: After discovering a problem with the system, the technician immediately stopped the operation.

sentences.chinese: 如果收到海关通知，请立即联系我们的客服。
sentences.traditional: 如果收到海關通知，請立即聯繫我們的客服。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shōudào hǎiguān tōngzhī, qǐng lìjí liánxì wǒmen de kèfú.
sentences.translation: If you receive a customs notice, please contact our customer service immediately.

sentences.chinese: 雨势突然变大，活动立即被转移到室内。
sentences.traditional: 雨勢突然變大，活動立即被轉移到室內。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔshì tūrán biàn dà, huódòng lìjí bèi zhuǎnyí dào shìnèi.
sentences.translation: The rain suddenly became heavy, and the activity was immediately moved indoors.

sentences.chinese: 听到孩子在哭，她立刻放下手里的工作。
sentences.traditional: 聽到孩子在哭，她立刻放下手裡的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào háizi zài kū, tā lìkè fàngxià shǒu lǐ de gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: When she heard the child crying, she immediately put down the work in her hands.

sentences.chinese: 会议一结束，代表们就立刻赶往机场。
sentences.traditional: 會議一結束，代表們就立刻趕往機場。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yì jiéshù, dàibiǎo men jiù lìkè gǎn wǎng jīchǎng.
sentences.translation: As soon as the meeting ended, the representatives immediately hurried to the airport.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定不能立刻生效，还需要经过审批。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定不能立刻生效，還需要經過審批。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng bù néng lìkè shēngxiào, hái xūyào jīngguò shěnpī.
sentences.translation: This decision cannot take effect immediately; it still needs approval.

sentences.chinese: 团队的力量往往比个人的能力更重要。
sentences.traditional: 團隊的力量往往比個人的能力更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tuánduì de lìliàng wǎngwǎng bǐ gèrén de nénglì gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: The strength of a team is often more important than an individual’s ability.

sentences.chinese: 这场演讲给了很多年轻人继续努力的力量。
sentences.traditional: 這場演講給了很多年輕人繼續努力的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǎnjiǎng gěi le hěn duō niánqīng rén jìxù nǔlì de lìliàng.
sentences.translation: This speech gave many young people the strength to keep working hard.

sentences.chinese: 政策的力量只有在真正落实后才能看出来。
sentences.traditional: 政策的力量只有在真正落實後才能看出來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè de lìliàng zhǐyǒu zài zhēnzhèng luòshí hòu cái néng kàn chūlái.
sentences.translation: The power of a policy can only be seen after it has truly been put into practice.

sentences.chinese: 原材料价格上涨后，公司的利润明显下降。
sentences.traditional: 原材料價格上漲後，公司的利潤明顯下降。
sentences.pinyin: Yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng hòu, gōngsī de lìrùn míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: After raw material prices rose, the company’s profit clearly fell.

sentences.chinese: 他们不能只追求利润，也要考虑客户的长期利益。
sentences.traditional: 他們不能只追求利潤，也要考慮客戶的長期利益。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú lìrùn, yě yào kǎolǜ kèhù de chángqī lìyì.
sentences.translation: They cannot only pursue profit; they also need to consider customers’ long-term interests.

sentences.chinese: 如果销售额增加而成本不变，利润自然会提高。
sentences.traditional: 如果銷售額增加而成本不變，利潤自然會提高。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiāoshòu'é zēngjiā ér chéngběn bú biàn, lìrùn zìrán huì tígāo.
sentences.translation: If sales increase while costs remain unchanged, profit will naturally rise.

sentences.chinese: 公司在做决定时，必须保护员工的合法利益。
sentences.traditional: 公司在做決定時，必須保護員工的合法利益。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zài zuò juédìng shí, bìxū bǎohù yuángōng de héfǎ lìyì.
sentences.translation: When making decisions, the company must protect employees’ lawful interests.

sentences.chinese: 为了眼前的利益而忽视安全，后果会很严重。
sentences.traditional: 為了眼前的利益而忽視安全，後果會很嚴重。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile yǎnqián de lìyì ér hūshì ānquán, hòuguǒ huì hěn yánzhòng.
sentences.translation: Ignoring safety for immediate benefit will have very serious consequences.

sentences.chinese: 双方如果能照顾彼此利益，合作就会更稳定。
sentences.traditional: 雙方如果能照顧彼此利益，合作就會更穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng rúguǒ néng zhàogù bǐcǐ lìyì, hézuò jiù huì gèng wěndìng.
sentences.translation: If both sides can look after each other’s interests, the cooperation will be more stable.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该充分利用现有资源，而不是马上购买新设备。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該充分利用現有資源，而不是馬上購買新設備。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chōngfèn lìyòng xiànyǒu zīyuán, ér bú shì mǎshàng gòumǎi xīn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: We should make full use of existing resources rather than immediately buying new equipment.

sentences.chinese: 他利用周末时间整理资料，为下周的会议做准备。
sentences.traditional: 他利用週末時間整理資料，為下週的會議做準備。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lìyòng zhōumò shíjiān zhěnglǐ zīliào, wèi xià zhōu de huìyì zuò zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: He used the weekend to organise materials and prepare for next week’s meeting.

sentences.chinese: 有些商家利用消费者不懂规则，故意提高价格。
sentences.traditional: 有些商家利用消費者不懂規則，故意提高價格。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shāngjiā lìyòng xiāofèi zhě bù dǒng guīzé, gùyì tígāo jiàgé.
sentences.translation: Some businesses make use of consumers not understanding the rules and deliberately raise prices.

sentences.chinese: 两家公司决定联合开发新的教育软件，以降低成本。
sentences.traditional: 兩家公司決定聯合開發新的教育軟件，以降低成本。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī juédìng liánhé kāifā xīn de jiàoyù ruǎnjiàn, yǐ jiàngdī chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The two companies decided to jointly develop new educational software in order to reduce costs.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目由学校和社区联合完成，效果比预期更好。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目由學校和社區聯合完成，效果比預期更好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yóu xuéxiào hé shèqū liánhé wánchéng, xiàoguǒ bǐ yùqī gèng hǎo.
sentences.translation: This project was completed jointly by the school and the community, and the result was better than expected.

sentences.chinese: 面对自然灾害，各部门必须联合行动，才能及时救人。
sentences.traditional: 面對自然災害，各部門必須聯合行動，才能及時救人。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì zìrán zāihài, gè bùmén bìxū liánhé xíngdòng, cái néng jíshí jiù rén.
sentences.translation: When facing a natural disaster, all departments must act together in order to save people in time.

sentences.chinese: 这条高速铁路连接了几个重要城市，带动了当地经济。
sentences.traditional: 這條高速鐵路連接了幾個重要城市，帶動了當地經濟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gāosù tiělù liánjiē le jǐ ge zhòngyào chéngshì, dàidòng le dāngdì jīngjì.
sentences.translation: This high-speed railway connects several important cities and has driven the local economy.

sentences.chinese: 请先确认电源已经连接好，再启动机器。
sentences.traditional: 請先確認電源已經連接好，再啟動機器。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān quèrèn diànyuán yǐjīng liánjiē hǎo, zài qǐdòng jīqì.
sentences.translation: Please first confirm that the power supply is connected before starting the machine.

sentences.chinese: 良好的沟通能连接不同背景的人，减少误会。
sentences.traditional: 良好的溝通能連接不同背景的人，減少誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de gōutōng néng liánjiē bùtóng bèijǐng de rén, jiǎnshǎo wùhuì.
sentences.translation: Good communication can connect people from different backgrounds and reduce misunderstandings.

sentences.chinese: 听到孩子在哭，她连忙放下工作跑过去。
sentences.traditional: 聽到孩子在哭，她連忙放下工作跑過去。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào háizi zài kū, tā liánmáng fàng xià gōngzuò pǎo guòqù.
sentences.translation: Hearing the child crying, she hurriedly put down her work and ran over.

sentences.chinese: 客户提出意见后，经理连忙安排人员处理。
sentences.traditional: 客戶提出意見後，經理連忙安排人員處理。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù tíchū yìjiàn hòu, jīnglǐ liánmáng ānpái rényuán chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: After the client raised an issue, the manager quickly arranged staff to deal with it.

sentences.chinese: 我发现发票号码写错了，连忙联系财务修改。
sentences.traditional: 我發現發票號碼寫錯了，連忙聯繫財務修改。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn fāpiào hàomǎ xiě cuò le, liánmáng liánxì cáiwù xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: I discovered that the invoice number was written incorrectly and quickly contacted finance to amend it.

sentences.chinese: 他连续三天加班，难怪今天精神不太好。
sentences.traditional: 他連續三天加班，難怪今天精神不太好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liánxù sān tiān jiābān, nánguài jīntiān jīngshen bú tài hǎo.
sentences.translation: He worked overtime for three days in a row, so no wonder he is not very lively today.

sentences.chinese: 如果连续下雨，比赛可能会被推迟。
sentences.traditional: 如果連續下雨，比賽可能會被推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ liánxù xià yǔ, bǐsài kěnéng huì bèi tuīchí.
sentences.translation: If it rains continuously, the match may be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司连续扩大生产，已经需要更多员工。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司連續擴大生產，已經需要更多員工。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī liánxù kuòdà shēngchǎn, yǐjīng xūyào gèng duō yuángōng.
sentences.translation: This company has kept expanding production and already needs more staff.

sentences.chinese: 听完医生的解释，他的脸色才渐渐恢复正常。
sentences.traditional: 聽完醫生的解釋，他的臉色才漸漸恢復正常。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng wán yīshēng de jiěshì, tā de liǎnsè cái jiànjiàn huīfù zhèngcháng.
sentences.translation: After hearing the doctor’s explanation, his complexion gradually returned to normal.

sentences.chinese: 她脸色很差，可能昨晚没有休息好。
sentences.traditional: 她臉色很差，可能昨晚沒有休息好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liǎnsè hěn chà, kěnéng zuówǎn méiyǒu xiūxi hǎo.
sentences.translation: Her complexion looks poor; perhaps she did not rest well last night.

sentences.chinese: 老板一进会议室，大家就注意到他的脸色不太对。
sentences.traditional: 老闆一進會議室，大家就注意到他的臉色不太對。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yí jìn huìyìshì, dàjiā jiù zhùyì dào tā de liǎnsè bú tài duì.
sentences.translation: As soon as the boss entered the meeting room, everyone noticed that his expression looked wrong.

sentences.chinese: 他大学毕业后才开始认真谈恋爱。
sentences.traditional: 他大學畢業後才開始認真談戀愛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè hòu cái kāishǐ rènzhēn tán liàn’ài.
sentences.translation: He only started dating seriously after graduating from university.

sentences.chinese: 恋爱不仅需要感情，也需要互相尊重和沟通。
sentences.traditional: 戀愛不僅需要感情，也需要互相尊重和溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Liàn’ài bùjǐn xūyào gǎnqíng, yě xūyào hùxiāng zūnzhòng hé gōutōng.
sentences.translation: Romance requires not only feelings but also mutual respect and communication.

sentences.chinese: 父母不反对她恋爱，只希望她保持理性。
sentences.traditional: 父母不反對她戀愛，只希望她保持理性。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ bú fǎnduì tā liàn’ài, zhǐ xīwàng tā bǎochí lǐxìng.
sentences.translation: Her parents do not oppose her dating; they only hope she remains rational.

sentences.chinese: 公司要保持良好的信誉，不能只看短期利润。
sentences.traditional: 公司要保持良好的信譽，不能只看短期利潤。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yào bǎochí liánghǎo de xìnyù, bù néng zhǐ kàn duǎnqī lìrùn.
sentences.translation: A company must maintain a good reputation and cannot look only at short-term profit.

sentences.chinese: 良好的学习习惯比临时努力更重要。
sentences.traditional: 良好的學習習慣比臨時努力更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de xuéxí xíguàn bǐ línshí nǔlì gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Good study habits are more important than temporary effort.

sentences.chinese: 经过治疗，他的身体状况已经有了良好的变化。
sentences.traditional: 經過治療，他的身體狀況已經有了良好的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò zhìliáo, tā de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng yǐjīng yǒu le liánghǎo de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: After treatment, his physical condition has already changed for the better.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气影响，今年粮食产量比去年低了一些。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣影響，今年糧食產量比去年低了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì yǐngxiǎng, jīnnián liángshi chǎnliàng bǐ qùnián dī le yìxiē.
sentences.translation: Because of the weather, this year’s grain output is somewhat lower than last year’s.

sentences.chinese: 节省粮食不是小事，而是一种责任。
sentences.traditional: 節省糧食不是小事，而是一種責任。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéshěng liángshi bú shì xiǎoshì, ér shì yì zhǒng zérèn.
sentences.translation: Saving food is not a small matter, but a kind of responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区的粮食主要依靠外地运输。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區的糧食主要依靠外地運輸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de liángshi zhǔyào yīkào wàidì yùnshū.
sentences.translation: The food grain in this area mainly relies on transport from other places.

sentences.chinese: 这次订单的量太大，仓库需要提前安排空间。
sentences.traditional: 這次訂單的量太大，倉庫需要提前安排空間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì dìngdān de liàng tài dà, cāngkù xūyào tíqián ānpái kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: The quantity of this order is too large, so the warehouse needs to arrange space in advance.

sentences.chinese: 请根据实际需要调整量，不要浪费材料。
sentences.traditional: 請根據實際需要調整量，不要浪費材料。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gēnjù shíjì xūyào tiáozhěng liàng, bú yào làngfèi cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Please adjust the amount according to actual needs and do not waste materials.

sentences.chinese: 每天的工作量要合理安排，否则容易忽视细节。
sentences.traditional: 每天的工作量要合理安排，否則容易忽視細節。
sentences.pinyin: Měitiān de gōngzuòliàng yào hélǐ ānpái, fǒuzé róngyì hūshì xìjié.
sentences.translation: The daily workload should be arranged reasonably; otherwise, details are easily overlooked.

sentences.chinese: 他能在这么艰苦的条件下完成任务，真了不起。
sentences.traditional: 他能在這麼艱苦的條件下完成任務，真了不起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā néng zài zhème jiānkǔ de tiáojiàn xià wánchéng rènwu, zhēn liǎobuqǐ.
sentences.translation: That he could complete the task under such difficult conditions is truly amazing.

sentences.chinese: 对一个初学者来说，你的进步已经很了不起了。
sentences.traditional: 對一個初學者來說，你的進步已經很了不起了。
sentences.pinyin: Duì yí ge chūxuézhě lái shuō, nǐ de jìnbù yǐjīng hěn liǎobuqǐ le.
sentences.translation: For a beginner, your progress is already quite extraordinary.

sentences.chinese: 这个团队虽然规模不大，却取得了了不起的成绩。
sentences.traditional: 這個團隊雖然規模不大，卻取得了了不起的成績。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì suīrán guīmó bú dà, què qǔdé le liǎobuqǐ de chéngjì.
sentences.translation: Although this team is not large in scale, it has achieved extraordinary results.

sentences.chinese: 由于降水影响，部分列车将临时调整发车时间。
sentences.traditional: 由於降水影響，部分列車將臨時調整發車時間。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú jiàngshuǐ yǐngxiǎng, bùfen lièchē jiāng línshí tiáozhěng fāchē shíjiān.
sentences.translation: Due to the rainfall, some trains will temporarily adjust their departure times.

sentences.chinese: 这趟列车虽然速度不快，但服务相当可靠。
sentences.traditional: 這趟列車雖然速度不快，但服務相當可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tàng lièchē suīrán sùdù bú kuài, dàn fúwù xiāngdāng kěkào.
sentences.translation: Although this train is not fast, the service is quite reliable.

sentences.chinese: 旅客上列车前需要出示身份证和车票。
sentences.traditional: 旅客上列車前需要出示身份證和車票。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚkè shàng lièchē qián xūyào chūshì shēnfènzhèng hé chēpiào.
sentences.translation: Passengers need to show their ID card and ticket before boarding the train.

sentences.chinese: 经理临时改变了会议安排，大家只好尽快调整计划。
sentences.traditional: 經理臨時改變了會議安排，大家只好盡快調整計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ línshí gǎibiàn le huìyì ānpái, dàjiā zhǐhǎo jǐnkuài tiáozhěng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The manager temporarily changed the meeting arrangements, so everyone had to adjust the plan as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这个岗位只是临时的，合同到月底就结束。
sentences.traditional: 這個崗位只是臨時的，合同到月底就結束。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gǎngwèi zhǐ shì línshí de, hétong dào yuèdǐ jiù jiéshù.
sentences.translation: This position is only temporary; the contract ends at the end of the month.

sentences.chinese: 为了接待海外嘉宾，学校临时开放了一个休息区。
sentences.traditional: 為了接待海外嘉賓，學校臨時開放了一個休息區。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiēdài hǎiwài jiābīn, xuéxiào línshí kāifàng le yí ge xiūxi qū.
sentences.translation: To receive overseas guests, the school temporarily opened a rest area.

sentences.chinese: 上课铃一响，走廊里立刻安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 上課鈴一響，走廊裡立刻安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngkè líng yì xiǎng, zǒuláng lǐ lìkè ānjìng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: As soon as the class bell rang, the corridor immediately became quiet.

sentences.chinese: 门口的铃坏了，客户到了也没人听见。
sentences.traditional: 門口的鈴壞了，客戶到了也沒人聽見。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu de líng huài le, kèhù dào le yě méi rén tīngjiàn.
sentences.translation: The bell at the door is broken, so no one hears when clients arrive.

sentences.chinese: 护士按下床边的铃，请医生尽快来急诊室。
sentences.traditional: 護士按下床邊的鈴，請醫生盡快來急診室。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi àn xià chuángbiān de líng, qǐng yīshēng jǐnkuài lái jízhěnshì.
sentences.translation: The nurse pressed the bell by the bed and asked the doctor to come to the emergency room as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 面对市场变化，企业需要采取更灵活的经营方式。
sentences.traditional: 面對市場變化，企業需要採取更靈活的經營方式。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shìchǎng biànhuà, qǐyè xūyào cǎiqǔ gèng línghuó de jīngyíng fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Facing market changes, companies need to adopt a more flexible way of operating.

sentences.chinese: 这套规则不能太死板，否则实际执行时不够灵活。
sentences.traditional: 這套規則不能太死板，否則實際執行時不夠靈活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào guīzé bù néng tài sǐbǎn, fǒuzé shíjì zhíxíng shí bú gòu línghuó.
sentences.translation: This set of rules cannot be too rigid; otherwise it will not be flexible enough in practice.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然年纪大了，动作仍然很灵活。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然年紀大了，動作仍然很靈活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì dà le, dòngzuò réngrán hěn línghuó.
sentences.translation: Although he is older now, his movements are still very agile.

sentences.chinese: 这位老师领着学生参观古老的建筑。
sentences.traditional: 這位老師領著學生參觀古老的建築。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī lǐngzhe xuésheng cānguān gǔlǎo de jiànzhù.
sentences.translation: This teacher led the students to visit the ancient building.

sentences.chinese: 他把外套的领整理好，准备参加开幕式。
sentences.traditional: 他把外套的領整理好，準備參加開幕式。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wàitào de lǐng zhěnglǐ hǎo, zhǔnbèi cānjiā kāimùshì.
sentences.translation: He straightened the collar of his coat and prepared to attend the opening ceremony.

sentences.chinese: 导游在前面领路，游客们紧紧跟在后面。
sentences.traditional: 導遊在前面領路，遊客們緊緊跟在後面。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyóu zài qiánmiàn lǐnglù, yóukèmen jǐnjǐn gēn zài hòumiàn.
sentences.translation: The guide led the way at the front, and the tourists followed closely behind.

sentences.chinese: 面试那天，他特意系了一条深色领带。
sentences.traditional: 面試那天，他特意繫了一條深色領帶。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì nà tiān, tā tèyì jì le yì tiáo shēnsè lǐngdài.
sentences.translation: On the day of the interview, he deliberately wore a dark necktie.

sentences.chinese: 这条领带和他的西装颜色很合。
sentences.traditional: 這條領帶和他的西裝顏色很合。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lǐngdài hé tā de xīzhuāng yánsè hěn hé.
sentences.translation: This necktie goes very well with the colour of his suit.

sentences.chinese: 公司没有固定要求，但正式会议最好还是打领带。
sentences.traditional: 公司沒有固定要求，但正式會議最好還是打領帶。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī méiyǒu gùdìng yāoqiú, dàn zhèngshì huìyì zuìhǎo háishi dǎ lǐngdài.
sentences.translation: The company has no fixed requirement, but it is still best to wear a tie for formal meetings.

sentences.chinese: 领导在讲话中强调，安全问题绝对不能忽视。
sentences.traditional: 領導在講話中強調，安全問題絕對不能忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo zài jiǎnghuà zhōng qiángdiào, ānquán wèntí juéduì bù néng hūshì.
sentences.translation: The leader emphasised in the speech that safety issues must absolutely not be ignored.

sentences.chinese: 一个有经验的人来领导这个项目，成功的机会会更大。
sentences.traditional: 一個有經驗的人來領導這個項目，成功的機會會更大。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge yǒu jīngyàn de rén lái lǐngdǎo zhège xiàngmù, chénggōng de jīhuì huì gèng dà.
sentences.translation: If an experienced person leads this project, the chance of success will be greater.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然是部门领导，却愿意听取普通员工的观点。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然是部門領導，卻願意聽取普通員工的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán shì bùmén lǐngdǎo, què yuànyì tīngqǔ pǔtōng yuángōng de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: Although he is a department leader, he is willing to listen to ordinary employees’ views.

sentences.chinese: 请凭身份证到前台领取会议资料。
sentences.traditional: 請憑身份證到前臺領取會議資料。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng píng shēnfènzhèng dào qiántái lǐngqǔ huìyì zīliào.
sentences.translation: Please use your ID card to collect the meeting materials at reception.

sentences.chinese: 快递到了以后，系统会提醒客户及时领取。
sentences.traditional: 快遞到了以後，系統會提醒客戶及時領取。
sentences.pinyin: Kuàidì dào le yǐhòu, xìtǒng huì tíxǐng kèhù jíshí lǐngqǔ.
sentences.translation: After the parcel arrives, the system will remind the customer to collect it promptly.

sentences.chinese: 毕业生可以在网站上申请并领取电子证书。
sentences.traditional: 畢業生可以在網站上申請並領取電子證書。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyèshēng kěyǐ zài wǎngzhàn shang shēnqǐng bìng lǐngqǔ diànzǐ zhèngshū.
sentences.translation: Graduates can apply for and receive an electronic certificate on the website.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司在机器人技术方面一直领先于同行。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司在機器人技術方面一直領先於同行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zài jīqìrén jìshù fāngmiàn yìzhí lǐngxiān yú tóngháng.
sentences.translation: This company has always led its peers in robot technology.

sentences.chinese: 比赛还剩十分钟时，主队领先两分。
sentences.traditional: 比賽還剩十分鐘時，主隊領先兩分。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài hái shèng shí fēnzhōng shí, zhǔduì lǐngxiān liǎng fēn.
sentences.translation: With ten minutes left in the match, the home team was ahead by two points.

sentences.chinese: 如果想保持领先优势，就必须继续开发新产品。
sentences.traditional: 如果想保持領先優勢，就必須繼續開發新產品。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng bǎochí lǐngxiān yōushì, jiù bìxū jìxù kāifā xīn chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: To maintain a leading advantage, new products must continue to be developed.

sentences.chinese: 人工智能已经被广泛应用于医疗领域。
sentences.traditional: 人工智能已經被廣泛應用於醫療領域。
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng yǐjīng bèi guǎngfàn yìngyòng yú yīliáo lǐngyù.
sentences.translation: Artificial intelligence has already been widely applied in the medical field.

sentences.chinese: 在这个领域里，经验和技能同样重要。
sentences.traditional: 在這個領域裡，經驗和技能同樣重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège lǐngyù lǐ, jīngyàn hé jìnéng tóngyàng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In this field, experience and skills are equally important.

sentences.chinese: 他的研究领域从古代历史扩大到了近代社会。
sentences.traditional: 他的研究領域從古代歷史擴大到了近代社會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yánjiū lǐngyù cóng gǔdài lìshǐ kuòdà dào le jìndài shèhuì.
sentences.translation: His research field expanded from ancient history to modern society.

sentences.chinese: 经理下令立即关闭危险设备，避免造成更严重的后果。
sentences.traditional: 經理下令立即關閉危險設備，避免造成更嚴重的後果。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xià lìng lìjí guānbì wēixiǎn shèbèi, bìmiǎn zàochéng gèng yánzhòng de hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: The manager gave an order to close the dangerous equipment immediately to avoid more serious consequences.

sentences.chinese: 这项禁令虽然严格，却得到了广大居民的支持。
sentences.traditional: 這項禁令雖然嚴格，卻得到了廣大居民的支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìnlìng suīrán yángé, què dédào le guǎngdà jūmín de zhīchí.
sentences.translation: Although this ban is strict, it has received the support of many residents.

sentences.chinese: 法院的命令一公布，相关机构就开始执行。
sentences.traditional: 法院的命令一公佈，相關機構就開始執行。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎyuàn de mìnglìng yì gōngbù, xiāngguān jīgòu jiù kāishǐ zhíxíng.
sentences.translation: As soon as the court order was announced, the relevant institutions began to carry it out.

sentences.chinese: 这个古老的故事在故乡流传了几百年。
sentences.traditional: 這個古老的故事在故鄉流傳了幾百年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de gùshi zài gùxiāng liúchuán le jǐ bǎi nián.
sentences.translation: This ancient story has been passed down in the hometown for several hundred years.

sentences.chinese: 据说那首民歌最早从山区流传到海外。
sentences.traditional: 據說那首民歌最早從山區流傳到海外。
sentences.pinyin: Jùshuō nà shǒu míngē zuìzǎo cóng shānqū liúchuán dào hǎiwài.
sentences.translation: It is said that the folk song first spread overseas from the mountain area.

sentences.chinese: 好的经验如果没有记录下来，就很难继续流传。
sentences.traditional: 好的經驗如果沒有記錄下來，就很難繼續流傳。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎo de jīngyàn rúguǒ méiyǒu jìlù xiàlái, jiù hěn nán jìxù liúchuán.
sentences.translation: If good experience is not recorded, it is difficult for it to continue spreading.

sentences.chinese: 最近流感传播得很快，学校提醒学生尽量戴口罩。
sentences.traditional: 最近流感傳播得很快，學校提醒學生盡量戴口罩。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn liúgǎn chuánbō de hěn kuài, xuéxiào tíxǐng xuéshēng jǐnliàng dài kǒuzhào.
sentences.translation: Recently the flu has been spreading quickly, so the school has reminded students to wear masks as much as possible.

sentences.chinese: 他不是普通感冒，而是得了严重的流感。
sentences.traditional: 他不是普通感冒，而是得了嚴重的流感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì pǔtōng gǎnmào, ér shì dé le yánzhòng de liúgǎn.
sentences.translation: He does not have an ordinary cold; he has a serious flu.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议老人打流感疫苗，以降低风险。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議老人打流感疫苗，以降低風險。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì lǎorén dǎ liúgǎn yìmiáo, yǐ jiàngdī fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised older people to get a flu vaccine to reduce the risk.

sentences.chinese: 他每天浏览海外新闻，以了解行业的最新变化。
sentences.traditional: 他每天瀏覽海外新聞，以了解行業的最新變化。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān liúlǎn hǎiwài xīnwén, yǐ liǎojiě hángyè de zuìxīn biànhuà.
sentences.translation: He browses overseas news every day to understand the latest changes in the industry.

sentences.chinese: 请先浏览合同内容，再决定是否签字。
sentences.traditional: 請先瀏覽合同內容，再決定是否簽字。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān liúlǎn hétóng nèiróng, zài juédìng shìfǒu qiānzì.
sentences.translation: Please browse the contract content first, then decide whether to sign.

sentences.chinese: 这个网站可以让客户快速浏览所有产品信息。
sentences.traditional: 這個網站可以讓客戶快速瀏覽所有產品信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn kěyǐ ràng kèhù kuàisù liúlǎn suǒyǒu chǎnpǐn xìnxī.
sentences.translation: This website lets customers quickly browse all product information.

sentences.chinese: 如果客服没有接电话，你可以在网页上留言。
sentences.traditional: 如果客服沒有接電話，你可以在網頁上留言。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kèfú méiyǒu jiē diànhuà, nǐ kěyǐ zài wǎngyè shàng liúyán.
sentences.translation: If customer service does not answer the phone, you can leave a message on the webpage.

sentences.chinese: 她在纪念日那天留下了一段感人的留言。
sentences.traditional: 她在紀念日那天留下了一段感人的留言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jìniànrì nà tiān liúxià le yí duàn gǎnrén de liúyán.
sentences.translation: On the anniversary, she left a moving message.

sentences.chinese: 请把你的观点写成留言，方便我们集中处理。
sentences.traditional: 請把你的觀點寫成留言，方便我們集中處理。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de guāndiǎn xiě chéng liúyán, fāngbiàn wǒmen jízhōng chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: Please write your opinion as a message so that we can handle it together more easily.

sentences.chinese: 龙在中国文化中常常代表力量和好运。
sentences.traditional: 龍在中國文化中常常代表力量和好運。
sentences.pinyin: Lóng zài Zhōngguó wénhuà zhōng chángcháng dàibiǎo lìliàng hé hǎoyùn.
sentences.translation: In Chinese culture, dragons often represent strength and good luck.

sentences.chinese: 这幅国画画了一条龙，线条十分有力。
sentences.traditional: 這幅國畫畫了一條龍，線條十分有力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú guóhuà huà le yì tiáo lóng, xiàntiáo shífēn yǒulì.
sentences.translation: This traditional Chinese painting shows a dragon with very powerful lines.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在广场上观看舞龙表演，兴奋得一直鼓掌。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在廣場上觀看舞龍表演，興奮得一直鼓掌。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài guǎngchǎng shàng guānkàn wǔlóng biǎoyǎn, xīngfèn de yìzhí gǔzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The children watched the dragon dance in the square and clapped excitedly the whole time.

sentences.chinese: 屋顶漏水以后，柜子里的文件全被弄湿了。
sentences.traditional: 屋頂漏水以後，櫃子裡的文件全被弄濕了。
sentences.pinyin: Wūdǐng lòu shuǐ yǐhòu, guìzi lǐ de wénjiàn quán bèi nòng shī le.
sentences.translation: After the roof leaked, all the documents in the cabinet got wet.

sentences.chinese: 这道题你漏看了一个条件，所以结论不太可靠。
sentences.traditional: 這道題你漏看了一個條件，所以結論不太可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí nǐ lòu kàn le yí ge tiáojiàn, suǒyǐ jiélùn bù tài kěkào.
sentences.translation: You missed one condition in this question, so the conclusion is not very reliable.

sentences.chinese: 如果发现资料有漏填的地方，请尽快补上。
sentences.traditional: 如果發現資料有漏填的地方，請盡快補上。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāxiàn zīliào yǒu lòu tián de dìfang, qǐng jǐnkuài bǔ shàng.
sentences.translation: If you find any places where information has been missed, please fill them in as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 老师把讲座录下来，方便没到场的学生浏览。
sentences.traditional: 老師把講座錄下來，方便沒到場的學生瀏覽。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ jiǎngzuò lù xiàlái, fāngbiàn méi dào chǎng de xuéshēng liúlǎn.
sentences.translation: The teacher recorded the lecture so that students who were not present could browse it later.

sentences.chinese: 面试时，工作人员会录一段声音作为记录。
sentences.traditional: 面試時，工作人員會錄一段聲音作為記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì shí, gōngzuò rényuán huì lù yí duàn shēngyīn zuòwéi jìlù.
sentences.translation: During the interview, the staff will record a short piece of audio as a record.

sentences.chinese: 节目组正在录新的纪录片，主题是古代建筑。
sentences.traditional: 節目組正在錄新的紀錄片，主題是古代建築。
sentences.pinyin: Jiémùzǔ zhèngzài lù xīn de jìlùpiàn, zhǔtí shì gǔdài jiànzhù.
sentences.translation: The programme team is recording a new documentary whose theme is ancient architecture.

sentences.chinese: 与海洋相比，陆地上的生态环境更容易被人类改变。
sentences.traditional: 與海洋相比，陸地上的生態環境更容易被人類改變。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hǎiyáng xiāngbǐ, lùdì shàng de shēngtài huánjìng gèng róngyì bèi rénlèi gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: Compared with the ocean, ecological environments on land are more easily changed by humans.

sentences.chinese: 飞机即将靠近陆地，乘客们都看到了城市的灯光。
sentences.traditional: 飛機即將靠近陸地，乘客們都看到了城市的燈光。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī jíjiāng kàojìn lùdì, chéngkèmen dōu kàndào le chéngshì de dēngguāng.
sentences.translation: The plane was about to approach land, and the passengers could all see the city lights.

sentences.chinese: 这种昆虫既能在水边活动，也能在陆地上生活。
sentences.traditional: 這種昆蟲既能在水邊活動，也能在陸地上生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kūnchóng jì néng zài shuǐ biān huódòng, yě néng zài lùdì shàng shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This kind of insect can move around by the water and can also live on land.

sentences.chinese: 他被理想的大学录取后，第一时间给家人留言。
sentences.traditional: 他被理想的大學錄取後，第一時間給家人留言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bèi lǐxiǎng de dàxué lùqǔ hòu, dì yī shíjiān gěi jiārén liúyán.
sentences.translation: After being admitted by his ideal university, he left a message for his family straight away.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定录取那位具备海外经验的年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定錄取那位具備海外經驗的年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng lùqǔ nà wèi jùbèi hǎiwài jīngyàn de niánqīngrén.
sentences.translation: The company decided to hire the young person who had overseas experience.

sentences.chinese: 录取名单公布之前，考生们都显得十分紧张。
sentences.traditional: 錄取名單公佈之前，考生們都顯得十分緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Lùqǔ míngdān gōngbù zhīqián, kǎoshēngmen dōu xiǎnde shífēn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Before the admission list was announced, all the candidates appeared very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 突然下雨时，一位路人主动把伞借给了那位老人。
sentences.traditional: 突然下雨時，一位路人主動把傘借給了那位老人。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán xià yǔ shí, yí wèi lùrén zhǔdòng bǎ sǎn jiè gěi le nà wèi lǎorén.
sentences.translation: When it suddenly rained, a passerby took the initiative to lend his umbrella to the elderly person.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，几个路人立即拨打了急救电话。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，幾個路人立即撥打了急救電話。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, jǐ ge lùrén lìjí bōdǎ le jíjiù diànhuà.
sentences.translation: After the accident happened, several passersby immediately called emergency services.

sentences.chinese: 这个画面中，路人匆匆走过，形成了强烈的对比。
sentences.traditional: 這個畫面中，路人匆匆走過，形成了強烈的對比。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huàmiàn zhōng, lùrén cōngcōng zǒu guò, xíngchéng le qiángliè de duìbǐ.
sentences.translation: In this scene, passersby hurry past, creating a strong contrast.

sentences.chinese: 为了节省时间，旅行社重新设计了参观路线。
sentences.traditional: 為了節省時間，旅行社重新設計了參觀路線。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, lǚxíngshè chóngxīn shèjì le cānguān lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: To save time, the travel agency redesigned the sightseeing route.

sentences.chinese: 这条路线虽然距离较远，但沿途风景非常优美。
sentences.traditional: 這條路線雖然距離較遠，但沿途風景非常優美。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lùxiàn suīrán jùlí jiào yuǎn, dàn yántú fēngjǐng fēicháng yōuměi.
sentences.translation: Although this route is relatively long, the scenery along the way is very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 如果路线不清楚，你可以先在手机地图上确认一下。
sentences.traditional: 如果路線不清楚，你可以先在手機地圖上確認一下。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ lùxiàn bù qīngchu, nǐ kěyǐ xiān zài shǒujī dìtú shàng quèrèn yíxià.
sentences.translation: If the route is not clear, you can check it on the mobile map first.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始前，嘉宾们陆续进入剧场。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始前，嘉賓們陸續進入劇場。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, jiābīnmen lùxù jìnrù jùchǎng.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting began, guests entered the theatre one after another.

sentences.chinese: 新政策公布后，各地企业陆续调整了经营方式。
sentences.traditional: 新政策公佈後，各地企業陸續調整了經營方式。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè gōngbù hòu, gèdì qǐyè lùxù tiáozhěng le jīngyíng fāngshì.
sentences.translation: After the new policy was announced, companies in different places adjusted their ways of operating one after another.

sentences.chinese: 春天到了，广场上的花陆续开放，吸引了很多路人。
sentences.traditional: 春天到了，廣場上的花陸續開放，吸引了很多路人。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, guǎngchǎng shàng de huā lùxù kāifàng, xīyǐn le hěn duō lùrén.
sentences.translation: Spring arrived, and the flowers in the square bloomed one after another, attracting many passersby.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免遗漏细节，他把整个采访都做了录音。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免遺漏細節，他把整個採訪都做了錄音。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn yílòu xìjié, tā bǎ zhěngge cǎifǎng dōu zuò le lùyīn.
sentences.translation: To avoid missing details, he made an audio recording of the whole interview.

sentences.chinese: 这段录音可以作为证据，但还需要进一步确认。
sentences.traditional: 這段錄音可以作為證據，但還需要進一步確認。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn lùyīn kěyǐ zuòwéi zhèngjù, dàn hái xūyào jìnyíbù quèrèn.
sentences.translation: This recording can serve as evidence, but it still needs further confirmation.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求学生上传一段中文录音，以检查发音是否自然。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求學生上傳一段中文錄音，以檢查發音是否自然。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshēng shàngchuán yí duàn Zhōngwén lùyīn, yǐ jiǎnchá fāyīn shìfǒu zìrán.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked students to upload a Chinese recording to check whether their pronunciation was natural.

sentences.chinese: 这家旅行社专门安排海外文化交流项目。
sentences.traditional: 這家旅行社專門安排海外文化交流項目。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚxíngshè zhuānmén ānpái hǎiwài wénhuà jiāoliú xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: This travel agency specialises in arranging overseas cultural exchange projects.

sentences.chinese: 如果通过旅行社报名，手续会相对简单一些。
sentences.traditional: 如果通過旅行社報名，手續會相對簡單一些。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tōngguò lǚxíngshè bàomíng, shǒuxù huì xiāngduì jiǎndān yìxiē.
sentences.translation: If you register through a travel agency, the procedures will be relatively simpler.

sentences.chinese: 那家旅行社因为服务可靠，得到了很多好评。
sentences.traditional: 那家旅行社因為服務可靠，得到了很多好評。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā lǚxíngshè yīnwèi fúwù kěkào, dédào le hěn duō hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: That travel agency received many positive reviews because its service is reliable.

sentences.chinese: 写论文时，观点必须有充分的资料支持。
sentences.traditional: 寫論文時，觀點必須有充分的資料支持。
sentences.pinyin: Xiě lùnwén shí, guāndiǎn bìxū yǒu chōngfèn de zīliào zhīchí.
sentences.translation: When writing a paper, the argument must be supported by sufficient materials.

sentences.chinese: 他的毕业论文结合了理论分析和实际调查。
sentences.traditional: 他的畢業論文結合了理論分析和實際調查。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de bìyè lùnwén jiéhé le lǐlùn fēnxī hé shíjì diàochá.
sentences.translation: His graduation thesis combined theoretical analysis and practical investigation.

sentences.chinese: 这篇论文的结论很清楚，但结构还需要调整。
sentences.traditional: 這篇論文的結論很清楚，但結構還需要調整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān lùnwén de jiélùn hěn qīngchu, dàn jiégòu hái xūyào tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: The conclusion of this paper is clear, but the structure still needs adjusting.

sentences.chinese: 你的解释缺少逻辑，所以很难让客户接受。
sentences.traditional: 你的解釋缺少邏輯，所以很難讓客戶接受。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de jiěshì quēshǎo luójí, suǒyǐ hěn nán ràng kèhù jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: Your explanation lacks logic, so it is difficult for the client to accept.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章的逻辑很紧密，读起来非常顺。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章的邏輯很緊密，讀起來非常順。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de luójí hěn jǐnmì, dú qǐlái fēicháng shùn.
sentences.translation: The logic of this article is very tight, so it reads very smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 做决定不能只靠感觉，还要考虑事实和逻辑。
sentences.traditional: 做決定不能只靠感覺，還要考慮事實和邏輯。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò juédìng bù néng zhǐ kào gǎnjué, hái yào kǎolǜ shìshí hé luójí.
sentences.translation: When making decisions, you cannot rely only on feelings; you also need to consider facts and logic.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然很生气，却没有当众骂那个犯错的员工。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然很生氣，卻沒有當眾罵那個犯錯的員工。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn shēngqì, què méiyǒu dāngzhòng mà nà ge fàncuò de yuángōng.
sentences.translation: Although he was very angry, he did not scold the employee who had made a mistake in public.

sentences.chinese: 父母不应该只是骂孩子，而应该告诉他问题在哪里。
sentences.traditional: 父母不應該只是罵孩子，而應該告訴他問題在哪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù yīnggāi zhǐshì mà háizi, ér yīnggāi gàosù tā wèntí zài nǎlǐ.
sentences.translation: Parents should not just scold a child; they should tell him where the problem is.

sentences.chinese: 在网上随便骂人不仅不礼貌，还可能带来法律后果。
sentences.traditional: 在網上隨便罵人不僅不禮貌，還可能帶來法律後果。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǎngshàng suíbiàn mà rén bùjǐn bù lǐmào, hái kěnéng dàilái fǎlǜ hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: Randomly abusing people online is not only impolite but may also have legal consequences.

sentences.chinese: 这笔买卖如果成功，公司本季度的利润会明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 這筆買賣如果成功，公司本季度的利潤會明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ mǎimai rúguǒ chénggōng, gōngsī běn jìdù de lìrùn huì míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: If this deal succeeds, the company's profit this quarter will increase noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 做买卖不能只看眼前利益，还要重视长期信誉。
sentences.traditional: 做買賣不能只看眼前利益，還要重視長期信譽。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò mǎimai bù néng zhǐ kàn yǎnqián lìyì, hái yào zhòngshì chángqī xìnyù.
sentences.translation: When doing business, one must not only look at immediate interests but also value long-term reputation.

sentences.chinese: 那家店的买卖越来越好，老板准备扩大规模。
sentences.traditional: 那家店的買賣越來越好，老闆準備擴大規模。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mǎimai yuè lái yuè hǎo, lǎobǎn zhǔnbèi kuòdà guīmó.
sentences.translation: That shop's business is getting better and better, and the owner is preparing to expand its scale.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案基本能满足客户对质量和价格的要求。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案基本能滿足客戶對質量和價格的要求。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn jīběn néng mǎnzú kèhù duì zhìliàng hé jiàgé de yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: This plan can basically satisfy the customer's requirements for quality and price.

sentences.chinese: 他并不满足于现有成绩，而是希望进一步提高技能。
sentences.traditional: 他並不滿足於現有成績，而是希望進一步提高技能。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù mǎnzú yú xiànyǒu chéngjì, ér shì xīwàng jìnyíbù tígāo jìnéng.
sentences.translation: He is not satisfied with his current achievements; instead, he hopes to further improve his skills.

sentences.chinese: 如果资源有限，我们只能先满足最紧急的需求。
sentences.traditional: 如果資源有限，我們只能先滿足最緊急的需求。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zīyuán yǒuxiàn, wǒmen zhǐ néng xiān mǎnzú zuì jǐnjí de xūqiú.
sentences.translation: If resources are limited, we can only first meet the most urgent needs.

sentences.chinese: 最近工作非常忙碌，他连周末都没有真正休息。
sentences.traditional: 最近工作非常忙碌，他連週末都沒有真正休息。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò fēicháng mánglù, tā lián zhōumò dōu méiyǒu zhēnzhèng xiūxi.
sentences.translation: Recently work has been very busy; he has not truly rested even at weekends.

sentences.chinese: 忙碌的生活让她更加珍惜和家人吃饭的时间。
sentences.traditional: 忙碌的生活讓她更加珍惜和家人吃飯的時間。
sentences.pinyin: Mánglù de shēnghuó ràng tā gèngjiā zhēnxī hé jiārén chīfàn de shíjiān.
sentences.translation: A busy life makes her cherish the time spent eating with her family even more.

sentences.chinese: 尽管每天都很忙碌，他仍然坚持学习中文。
sentences.traditional: 儘管每天都很忙碌，他仍然堅持學習中文。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn měitiān dōu hěn mánglù, tā réngrán jiānchí xuéxí Zhōngwén.
sentences.translation: Although he is busy every day, he still keeps studying Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 老师建议我们用毛笔练习汉字的基本笔画。
sentences.traditional: 老師建議我們用毛筆練習漢字的基本筆畫。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiànyì wǒmen yòng máobǐ liànxí Hànzì de jīběn bǐhuà.
sentences.translation: The teacher suggested that we use a writing brush to practise the basic strokes of Chinese characters.

sentences.chinese: 这支毛笔虽然不贵，但写出来的线条很稳。
sentences.traditional: 這支毛筆雖然不貴，但寫出來的線條很穩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī máobǐ suīrán bù guì, dàn xiě chūlái de xiàntiáo hěn wěn.
sentences.translation: Although this writing brush is not expensive, the lines it writes are very steady.

sentences.chinese: 他从小学习书法，对毛笔的选择很讲究。
sentences.traditional: 他從小學習書法，對毛筆的選擇很講究。
