sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xuéxí shūfǎ, duì máobǐ de xuǎnzé hěn jiǎngjiu.
sentences.translation: He has studied calligraphy since childhood and is very particular about his choice of writing brush.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器一直出毛病，必须尽快联系维修人员。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器一直出毛病，必須儘快聯繫維修人員。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì yìzhí chū máobìng, bìxū jǐnkuài liánxì wéixiū rényuán.
sentences.translation: This machine keeps having problems, so we must contact maintenance staff as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 他讲话太直接，这个毛病有时会影响同事关系。
sentences.traditional: 他講話太直接，這個毛病有時會影響同事關係。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎnghuà tài zhíjiē, zhège máobìng yǒushí huì yǐngxiǎng tóngshì guānxì.
sentences.translation: He speaks too directly, and this fault sometimes affects his relationships with colleagues.

sentences.chinese: 如果身体有小毛病，也不要长期忽视。
sentences.traditional: 如果身體有小毛病，也不要長期忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shēntǐ yǒu xiǎo máobìng, yě bú yào chángqī hūshì.
sentences.translation: Even if there is a small health problem, do not ignore it for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他们的观点看似矛盾，其实可以结合起来理解。
sentences.traditional: 他們的觀點看似矛盾，其實可以結合起來理解。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen de guāndiǎn kànsì máodùn, qíshí kěyǐ jiéhé qǐlái lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: Their viewpoints seem contradictory, but actually they can be understood together.

sentences.chinese: 预算有限和需求增加之间的矛盾越来越明显。
sentences.traditional: 預算有限和需求增加之間的矛盾越來越明顯。
sentences.pinyin: Yùsuàn yǒuxiàn hé xūqiú zēngjiā zhījiān de máodùn yuèláiyuè míngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The contradiction between limited budgets and increasing demand is becoming more and more obvious.

sentences.chinese: 如果不及时沟通，这种矛盾可能会进一步扩大。
sentences.traditional: 如果不及時溝通，這種矛盾可能會進一步擴大。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí gōutōng, zhè zhǒng máodùn kěnéng huì jìnyíbù kuòdà.
sentences.translation: If people do not communicate in time, this kind of conflict may expand further.

sentences.chinese: 会议即将开始，我现在没法儿过去接你。
sentences.traditional: 會議即將開始，我現在沒法兒過去接你。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jíjiāng kāishǐ, wǒ xiànzài méifǎr guòqù jiē nǐ.
sentences.translation: The meeting is about to start, so there is no way I can go and pick you up now.

sentences.chinese: 没有相关记录，客服也没法儿确认订单来源。
sentences.traditional: 沒有相關記錄，客服也沒法兒確認訂單來源。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu xiāngguān jìlù, kèfú yě méifǎr quèrèn dìngdān láiyuán.
sentences.translation: Without relevant records, customer service also has no way to confirm the source of the order.

sentences.chinese: 雨下得太大，我们没法儿按原来的路线出发。
sentences.traditional: 雨下得太大，我們沒法兒按原來的路線出發。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ xià de tài dà, wǒmen méifǎr àn yuánlái de lùxiàn chūfā.
sentences.translation: The rain is too heavy, so there is no way for us to set off along the original route.

sentences.chinese: 她在婚礼上收到了一束红色玫瑰。
sentences.traditional: 她在婚禮上收到了一束紅色玫瑰。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài hūnlǐ shàng shōu dào le yí shù hóngsè méigui.
sentences.translation: She received a bunch of red roses at the wedding.

sentences.chinese: 这种玫瑰看起来普通，却有久远的品种历史。
sentences.traditional: 這種玫瑰看起來普通，卻有久遠的品種歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng méigui kàn qǐlái pǔtōng, què yǒu jiǔyuǎn de pǐnzhǒng lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: This kind of rose looks ordinary, but it has a long history as a variety.

sentences.chinese: 他把干玫瑰夹进书里，作为旅行的纪念。
sentences.traditional: 他把乾玫瑰夾進書裡，作為旅行的紀念。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ gān méigui jiā jìn shū lǐ, zuòwéi lǚxíng de jìniàn.
sentences.translation: He put a dried rose in the book as a souvenir of the trip.

sentences.chinese: 这个事件经过媒体报道后，引起了广大市民的关注。
sentences.traditional: 這個事件經過媒體報導後，引起了廣大市民的關注。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shìjiàn jīngguò méitǐ bàodào hòu, yǐnqǐ le guǎngdà shìmín de guānzhù.
sentences.translation: After this event was reported by the media, it attracted the attention of a wide range of citizens.

sentences.chinese: 企业应当通过媒体公开说明自己的观点。
sentences.traditional: 企業應當通過媒體公開說明自己的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīngdāng tōngguò méitǐ gōngkāi shuōmíng zìjǐ de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: A company should publicly explain its viewpoint through the media.

sentences.chinese: 新媒体的发展改变了人们获取信息的方式。
sentences.traditional: 新媒體的發展改變了人們獲取信息的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn méitǐ de fāzhǎn gǎibiàn le rénmen huòqǔ xìnxī de fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The development of new media has changed the way people obtain information.

sentences.chinese: 这个剧场周末将举办一场儿童美术展览。
sentences.traditional: 這個劇場週末將舉辦一場兒童美術展覽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jùchǎng zhōumò jiāng jǔbàn yì chǎng értóng měishù zhǎnlǎn.
sentences.translation: This theatre will hold a children's art exhibition at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然学的是计算机，却一直对美术很感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然學的是計算機，卻一直對美術很感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán xué de shì jìsuànjī, què yìzhí duì měishù hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: Although he studied computing, he has always been very interested in fine art.

sentences.chinese: 学校希望把美术教育和传统文化结合起来。
sentences.traditional: 學校希望把美術教育和傳統文化結合起來。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xīwàng bǎ měishù jiàoyù hé chuántǒng wénhuà jiéhé qǐlái.
sentences.translation: The school hopes to combine art education with traditional culture.

sentences.chinese: 这里的海鲜被游客看作当地最有名的美味。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的海鮮被遊客看作當地最有名的美味。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de hǎixiān bèi yóukè kànzuò dāngdì zuì yǒumíng de měiwèi.
sentences.translation: The seafood here is regarded by tourists as the most famous local delicacy.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶做的家常菜对他来说是无法替代的美味。
sentences.traditional: 奶奶做的家常菜對他來說是無法替代的美味。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zuò de jiāchángcài duì tā lái shuō shì wúfǎ tìdài de měiwèi.
sentences.translation: To him, his grandmother's home cooking is an irreplaceable delicacy.

sentences.chinese: 真正的美味不一定价格高，关键在于新鲜和用心。
sentences.traditional: 真正的美味不一定價格高，關鍵在於新鮮和用心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de měiwèi bù yídìng jiàgé gāo, guānjiàn zàiyú xīnxiān hé yòngxīn.
sentences.translation: Real delicious food is not necessarily expensive; the key lies in freshness and care.

sentences.chinese: 这座古老城市的魅力在于它保存了真实的生活气息。
sentences.traditional: 這座古老城市的魅力在於它保存了真實的生活氣息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo chéngshì de mèilì zàiyú tā bǎocún le zhēnshí de shēnghuó qìxī.
sentences.translation: The charm of this ancient city lies in its preservation of a genuine sense of everyday life.

sentences.chinese: 他的讲话很有魅力，能让听众迅速集中注意力。
sentences.traditional: 他的講話很有魅力，能讓聽眾迅速集中注意力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiǎnghuà hěn yǒu mèilì, néng ràng tīngzhòng xùnsù jízhōng zhùyìlì.
sentences.translation: His speech is very engaging and can quickly focus the audience's attention.

sentences.chinese: 传统国画的魅力并不只在画面本身。
sentences.traditional: 傳統國畫的魅力並不只在畫面本身。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng guóhuà de mèilì bìng bù zhǐ zài huàmiàn běnshēn.
sentences.translation: The charm of traditional Chinese painting is not only in the picture itself.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院的门诊每天接待大量患者。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院的門診每天接待大量患者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de ménzhěn měitiān jiēdài dàliàng huànzhě.
sentences.translation: The outpatient clinic of this hospital receives a large number of patients every day.

sentences.chinese: 如果症状不严重，可以先去门诊挂号。
sentences.traditional: 如果症狀不嚴重，可以先去門診掛號。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhèngzhuàng bù yánzhòng, kěyǐ xiān qù ménzhěn guàhào.
sentences.translation: If the symptoms are not serious, you can first register at the outpatient clinic.

sentences.chinese: 医院调整了门诊安排，病人等待的时间明显减少。
sentences.traditional: 醫院調整了門診安排，病人等待的時間明顯減少。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn tiáozhěng le ménzhěn ānpái, bìngrén děngdài de shíjiān míngxiǎn jiǎnshǎo.
sentences.translation: The hospital adjusted its outpatient arrangements, and patients' waiting time was clearly reduced.

sentences.chinese: 他最近迷上了研究古代建筑，周末常去博物馆。
sentences.traditional: 他最近迷上了研究古代建築，週末常去博物館。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn mí shàng le yánjiū gǔdài jiànzhù, zhōumò cháng qù bówùguǎn.
sentences.translation: He has recently become fascinated with studying ancient architecture and often goes to museums at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片的画面太精彩，把全班同学都迷住了。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片的畫面太精彩，把全班同學都迷住了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn de huàmiàn tài jīngcǎi, bǎ quán bān tóngxué dōu mí zhù le.
sentences.translation: The scenes in this documentary are so wonderful that they fascinated the whole class.

sentences.chinese: 有些年轻人过度迷恋短视频，反而忽视了学习和休息。
sentences.traditional: 有些年輕人過度迷戀短視頻，反而忽視了學習和休息。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē niánqīngrén guòdù míliàn duǎn shìpín, fǎn'ér hūshì le xuéxí hé xiūxi.
sentences.translation: Some young people are excessively fascinated by short videos and instead neglect study and rest.

sentences.chinese: 在陌生城市里，如果不看地图很容易迷路。
sentences.traditional: 在陌生城市裡，如果不看地圖很容易迷路。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mòshēng chéngshì lǐ, rúguǒ bù kàn dìtú hěn róngyì mílù.
sentences.translation: In an unfamiliar city, it is easy to get lost if you do not look at a map.

sentences.chinese: 孩子迷路后，警察帮他联系了家人。
sentences.traditional: 孩子迷路後，警察幫他聯繫了家人。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi mílù hòu, jǐngchá bāng tā liánxì le jiārén.
sentences.translation: After the child got lost, the police helped him contact his family.

sentences.chinese: 旅行时他没有按路线走，结果在山里迷路了。
sentences.traditional: 旅行時他沒有按路線走，結果在山裡迷路了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng shí tā méiyǒu àn lùxiàn zǒu, jiéguǒ zài shān lǐ mílù le.
sentences.translation: While travelling, he did not follow the route and ended up getting lost in the mountains.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划还处于秘密阶段，不能提前公开。
sentences.traditional: 這個計劃還處於秘密階段，不能提前公開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà hái chǔyú mìmì jiēduàn, bù néng tíqián gōngkāi.
sentences.translation: This plan is still at a secret stage and cannot be made public in advance.

sentences.chinese: 她把这个秘密保存了很多年，从来没有告诉别人。
sentences.traditional: 她把這個秘密保存了很多年，從來沒有告訴別人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhège mìmì bǎocún le hěn duō nián, cónglái méiyǒu gàosu biérén.
sentences.translation: She kept this secret for many years and never told anyone else.

sentences.chinese: 真正的友谊不应该建立在秘密和怀疑之上。
sentences.traditional: 真正的友誼不應該建立在秘密和懷疑之上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì bù yīnggāi jiànlì zài mìmì hé huáiyí zhī shàng.
sentences.translation: True friendship should not be built on secrets and suspicion.

sentences.chinese: 双方保持密切联系，项目进展得很顺利。
sentences.traditional: 雙方保持密切聯繫，項目進展得很順利。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng bǎochí mìqiè liánxì, xiàngmù jìnzhǎn de hěn shùnlì.
sentences.translation: Both sides maintain close contact, and the project is progressing smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 这次合作使两所学校的关系更加密切。
sentences.traditional: 這次合作使兩所學校的關係更加密切。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì hézuò shǐ liǎng suǒ xuéxiào de guānxì gèngjiā mìqiè.
sentences.translation: This cooperation made the relationship between the two schools even closer.

sentences.chinese: 专家指出，饮食习惯和健康之间有密切关系。
sentences.traditional: 專家指出，飲食習慣和健康之間有密切關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā zhǐchū, yǐnshí xíguàn hé jiànkāng zhījiān yǒu mìqiè guānxì.
sentences.translation: Experts point out that there is a close relationship between eating habits and health.

sentences.chinese: 秘书已经把会议记录发给了每位嘉宾。
sentences.traditional: 秘書已經把會議記錄發給了每位嘉賓。
sentences.pinyin: Mìshū yǐjīng bǎ huìyì jìlù fā gěi le měi wèi jiābīn.
sentences.translation: The secretary has already sent the meeting record to every guest.

sentences.chinese: 如果你需要修改行程，可以先联系秘书。
sentences.traditional: 如果你需要修改行程，可以先聯繫秘書。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xūyào xiūgǎi xíngchéng, kěyǐ xiān liánxì mìshū.
sentences.translation: If you need to change the schedule, you can first contact the secretary.

sentences.chinese: 这位秘书不仅工作细心，还很善于沟通。
sentences.traditional: 這位秘書不僅工作細心，還很善於溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi mìshū bùjǐn gōngzuò xìxīn, hái hěn shànyú gōutōng.
sentences.translation: This secretary is not only careful at work but also good at communication.

sentences.chinese: 我们不能只看问题的一面，还要考虑整体情况。
sentences.traditional: 我們不能只看問題的一面，還要考慮整體情況。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zhǐ kàn wèntí de yí miàn, hái yào kǎolǜ zhěngtǐ qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: We cannot look at only one side of the problem; we also need to consider the overall situation.

sentences.chinese: 这面墙需要重新粉刷，否则会影响房间的整体效果。
sentences.traditional: 這面牆需要重新粉刷，否則會影響房間的整體效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè miàn qiáng xūyào chóngxīn fěnshuā, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng fángjiān de zhěngtǐ xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: This wall needs repainting; otherwise it will affect the overall effect of the room.

sentences.chinese: 请把证件有照片的一面朝上放在桌上。
sentences.traditional: 請把證件有照片的一面朝上放在桌上。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèngjiàn yǒu zhàopiàn de yí miàn cháo shàng fàng zài zhuō shàng.
sentences.translation: Please place the side of the document with the photo facing upwards on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这套房子的面积虽然不大，但空间利用得很好。
sentences.traditional: 這套房子的面積雖然不大，但空間利用得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi de miànjī suīrán bú dà, dàn kōngjiān lìyòng de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although the area of this flat is not large, the space is used very well.

sentences.chinese: 森林面积逐年扩大，对环境恢复有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 森林面積逐年擴大，對環境恢復有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Sēnlín miànjī zhúnián kuòdà, duì huánjìng huīfù yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: The forest area is expanding year by year, which helps environmental recovery.

sentences.chinese: 他们需要计算每个展区的面积，再决定展品数量。
sentences.traditional: 他們需要計算每個展區的面積，再決定展品數量。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xūyào jìsuàn měi ge zhǎnqū de miànjī, zài juédìng zhǎnpǐn shùliàng.
sentences.translation: They need to calculate the area of each exhibition zone before deciding the number of exhibits.

sentences.chinese: 公司正面临利润下降的压力。
sentences.traditional: 公司正面臨利潤下降的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèng miànlín lìrùn xiàjiàng de yālì.
sentences.translation: The company is facing the pressure of falling profits.

sentences.chinese: 毕业生在就业时常常面临激烈竞争。
sentences.traditional: 畢業生在就業時常常面臨激烈競爭。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyèshēng zài jiùyè shí chángcháng miànlín jīliè jìngzhēng.
sentences.translation: Graduates often face fierce competition when seeking employment.

sentences.chinese: 如果不及时采取措施，城市将面临严重的交通问题。
sentences.traditional: 如果不及時採取措施，城市將面臨嚴重的交通問題。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí cǎiqǔ cuòshī, chéngshì jiāng miànlín yánzhòng de jiāotōng wèntí.
sentences.translation: If measures are not taken in time, the city will face serious traffic problems.

sentences.chinese: 这门课程主要面向有一定基础的学习者。
sentences.traditional: 這門課程主要面向有一定基礎的學習者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng zhǔyào miànxiàng yǒu yídìng jīchǔ de xuéxízhě.
sentences.translation: This course is mainly aimed at learners with a certain foundation.

sentences.chinese: 新政策面向广大居民，特别是低收入家庭。
sentences.traditional: 新政策面向廣大居民，特別是低收入家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè miànxiàng guǎngdà jūmín, tèbié shì dī shōurù jiātíng.
sentences.translation: The new policy is aimed at a wide range of residents, especially low-income families.

sentences.chinese: 企业的网站应面向客户，提供清楚可靠的信息。
sentences.traditional: 企業的網站應面向客戶，提供清楚可靠的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè de wǎngzhàn yīng miànxiàng kèhù, tígōng qīngchu kěkào de xìnxī.
sentences.translation: A company's website should be oriented towards customers and provide clear, reliable information.

sentences.chinese: 请你用三句话描述一下事故发生时的具体情况。
sentences.traditional: 請你用三句話描述一下事故發生時的具體情況。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ yòng sān jù huà miáoshù yíxià shìgù fāshēng shí de jùtǐ qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Please describe in three sentences the specific situation when the accident happened.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章描述了近代城市发展的过程。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章描述了近代城市發展的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng miáoshù le jìndài chéngshì fāzhǎn de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: This article describes the process of modern urban development.

sentences.chinese: 他描述得很清楚，连细节都没有忽视。
sentences.traditional: 他描述得很清楚，連細節都沒有忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Tā miáoshù de hěn qīngchu, lián xìjié dōu méiyǒu hūshì.
sentences.translation: He described it very clearly, without even overlooking the details.

sentences.chinese: 这个话题比较敏感，讨论时要特别谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 這個話題比較敏感，討論時要特別謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huàtí bǐjiào mǐngǎn, tǎolùn shí yào tèbié jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: This topic is quite sensitive, so one must be especially cautious when discussing it.

sentences.chinese: 她对气味很敏感，一进房间就发现不对劲。
sentences.traditional: 她對氣味很敏感，一進房間就發現不對勁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì qìwèi hěn mǐngǎn, yí jìn fángjiān jiù fāxiàn bú duìjìn.
sentences.translation: She is very sensitive to smells and noticed something was wrong as soon as she entered the room.

sentences.chinese: 过敏的人皮肤往往比较敏感。
sentences.traditional: 過敏的人皮膚往往比較敏感。
sentences.pinyin: Guòmǐn de rén pífū wǎngwǎng bǐjiào mǐngǎn.
sentences.translation: People with allergies often have relatively sensitive skin.

sentences.chinese: 请在表格里填写机构的正式名称。
sentences.traditional: 請在表格裡填寫機構的正式名稱。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé lǐ tiánxiě jīgòu de zhèngshì míngchēng.
sentences.translation: Please fill in the organisation’s official name in the form.

sentences.chinese: 这个产品换了名称，但功能基本没有变化。
sentences.traditional: 這個產品換了名稱，但功能基本沒有變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn huàn le míngchēng, dàn gōngnéng jīběn méiyǒu biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This product has changed its name, but its functions basically have not changed.

sentences.chinese: 文件上的名称必须和合同保持一致。
sentences.traditional: 文件上的名稱必須和合同保持一致。
sentences.pinyin: Wénjiàn shang de míngchēng bìxū hé hétóng bǎochí yízhì.
sentences.translation: The name on the document must be consistent with the contract.

sentences.chinese: 他不太追求名牌，更重视衣服是否舒服。
sentences.traditional: 他不太追求名牌，更重視衣服是否舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú tài zhuīqiú míngpái, gèng zhòngshì yīfu shìfǒu shūfu.
sentences.translation: He does not care much about famous brands; he values whether the clothes are comfortable more.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司虽然不是名牌，质量却很可靠。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司雖然不是名牌，質量卻很可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán bú shì míngpái, zhìliàng què hěn kěkào.
sentences.translation: Although this company is not a famous brand, its quality is very reliable.

sentences.chinese: 很多年轻人买名牌，是为了显示自己的品味。
sentences.traditional: 很多年輕人買名牌，是為了顯示自己的品味。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīngrén mǎi míngpái, shì wèile xiǎnshì zìjǐ de pǐnwèi.
sentences.translation: Many young people buy famous brands in order to show their taste.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，他主动递给客户一张名片。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，他主動遞給客戶一張名片。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, tā zhǔdòng dì gěi kèhù yì zhāng míngpiàn.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, he took the initiative to hand the client a business card.

sentences.chinese: 这张名片上印着公司的地址和联系方式。
sentences.traditional: 這張名片上印著公司的地址和聯繫方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng míngpiàn shang yìn zhe gōngsī de dìzhǐ hé liánxì fāngshì.
sentences.translation: This business card has the company’s address and contact details printed on it.

sentences.chinese: 在正式场合交换名片时，要注意礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 在正式場合交換名片時，要注意禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé jiāohuàn míngpiàn shí, yào zhùyì lǐmào.
sentences.translation: When exchanging business cards on formal occasions, you should pay attention to politeness.

sentences.chinese: 老板明确表示，这个季度必须降低成本。
sentences.traditional: 老闆明確表示，這個季度必須降低成本。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn míngquè biǎoshì, zhège jìdù bìxū jiàngdī chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The boss made it clear that costs must be reduced this quarter.

sentences.chinese: 计划里每个人的责任都写得很明确。
sentences.traditional: 計劃裡每個人的責任都寫得很明確。
sentences.pinyin: Jìhuà lǐ měi ge rén de zérèn dōu xiě de hěn míngquè.
sentences.translation: Everyone’s responsibilities are written very clearly in the plan.

sentences.chinese: 开会前，我们需要明确项目的目标和范围。
sentences.traditional: 開會前，我們需要明確項目的目標和範圍。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì qián, wǒmen xūyào míngquè xiàngmù de mùbiāo hé fànwéi.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting, we need to clarify the project’s aims and scope.

sentences.chinese: 这次调整以后，公司的效率有了明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 這次調整以後，公司的效率有了明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tiáozhěng yǐhòu, gōngsī de xiàolǜ yǒu le míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: After this adjustment, the company’s efficiency has clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 他脸色明显不好，可能昨晚没有休息够。
sentences.traditional: 他臉色明顯不好，可能昨晚沒有休息夠。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liǎnsè míngxiǎn bù hǎo, kěnéng zuó wǎn méiyǒu xiūxi gòu.
sentences.translation: His complexion is obviously not good; he probably did not get enough rest last night.

sentences.chinese: 两种方案的区别并不明显，需要进一步比较。
sentences.traditional: 兩種方案的區別並不明顯，需要進一步比較。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng zhǒng fāng'àn de qūbié bìng bù míngxiǎn, xūyào jìnyíbù bǐjiào.
sentences.translation: The difference between the two plans is not obvious, so further comparison is needed.

sentences.chinese: 那位明星虽然很有名，但生活十分低调。
sentences.traditional: 那位明星雖然很有名，但生活十分低調。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi míngxīng suīrán hěn yǒumíng, dàn shēnghuó shífēn dīdiào.
sentences.translation: Although that star is very famous, their life is extremely low-key.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片讲述了一位明星背后的艰苦经历。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片講述了一位明星背後的艱苦經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jiǎngshù le yí wèi míngxīng bèihòu de jiānkǔ jīnglì.
sentences.translation: This documentary tells the difficult experiences behind a star’s success.

sentences.chinese: 不少年轻人把明星看作努力奋斗的榜样。
sentences.traditional: 不少年輕人把明星看作努力奮鬥的榜樣。
sentences.pinyin: Bù shǎo niánqīngrén bǎ míngxīng kànzuò nǔlì fèndòu de bǎngyàng.
sentences.translation: Quite a few young people regard stars as examples of hard work.

sentences.chinese: 医生及时赶到，救了他的命。
sentences.traditional: 醫生及時趕到，救了他的命。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jíshí gǎn dào, jiù le tā de mìng.
sentences.translation: The doctor arrived in time and saved his life.

sentences.chinese: 在危险面前，他把同事的命看得比自己的利益更重要。
sentences.traditional: 在危險面前，他把同事的命看得比自己的利益更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wēixiǎn miànqián, tā bǎ tóngshì de mìng kàn de bǐ zìjǐ de lìyì gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In the face of danger, he regarded his colleague’s life as more important than his own interests.

sentences.chinese: 这场疾病差点要了他的命，也改变了他的人生态度。
sentences.traditional: 這場疾病差點要了他的命，也改變了他的人生態度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng jíbìng chàdiǎn yào le tā de mìng, yě gǎibiàn le tā de rénshēng tàidu.
sentences.translation: This illness almost took his life and also changed his attitude towards life.

sentences.chinese: 教育常常能改变一个人的命运。
sentences.traditional: 教育常常能改變一個人的命運。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù chángcháng néng gǎibiàn yí ge rén de mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: Education can often change a person’s destiny.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说反映了普通人在历史变化中的命运。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說反映了普通人在歷史變化中的命運。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō fǎnyìng le pǔtōng rén zài lìshǐ biànhuà zhōng de mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: This novel reflects the fate of ordinary people amid historical change.

sentences.chinese: 他相信命运不完全由环境决定，还要靠个人努力。
sentences.traditional: 他相信命運不完全由環境決定，還要靠個人努力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiāngxìn mìngyùn bù wánquán yóu huánjìng juédìng, hái yào kào gèrén nǔlì.
sentences.translation: He believes destiny is not entirely decided by the environment; it also depends on personal effort.

sentences.chinese: 他摸了摸杯子的外面，确认水已经不烫了。
sentences.traditional: 他摸了摸杯子的外面，確認水已經不燙了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mō le mō bēizi de wàimiàn, quèrèn shuǐ yǐjīng bú tàng le.
sentences.translation: He touched the outside of the cup to confirm the water was no longer hot.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆里写着“请勿触碰展品”，可是那个孩子还是忍不住摸了一下。
sentences.traditional: 博物館裡寫著「請勿觸碰展品」，可是那個孩子還是忍不住摸了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ xiě zhe “qǐng wù chùpèng zhǎnpǐn”, kěshì nà ge háizi háishi rěn bu zhù mō le yí xià.
sentences.translation: The museum sign said ‘please do not touch the exhibits’, but the child still could not help touching one.

sentences.chinese: 医生轻轻摸了摸他的额头，判断他是否发烧。
sentences.traditional: 醫生輕輕摸了摸他的額頭，判斷他是否發燒。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng qīngqīng mō le mō tā de étóu, pànduàn tā shìfǒu fāshāo.
sentences.translation: The doctor gently touched his forehead to judge whether he had a fever.

sentences.chinese: 雨太大，前方的路牌变得很模糊。
sentences.traditional: 雨太大，前方的路牌變得很模糊。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tài dà, qiánfāng de lùpái biàn de hěn móhu.
sentences.translation: The rain was so heavy that the road sign ahead became very blurry.

sentences.chinese: 如果目标过于模糊，团队就很难集中精力。
sentences.traditional: 如果目標過於模糊，團隊就很難集中精力。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ mùbiāo guòyú móhu, tuánduì jiù hěn nán jízhōng jīnglì.
sentences.translation: If the goal is too vague, the team will find it hard to concentrate its energy.

sentences.chinese: 这张老照片虽然有些模糊，却保存了重要的记忆。
sentences.traditional: 這張老照片雖然有些模糊，卻保存了重要的記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng lǎo zhàopiàn suīrán yǒuxiē móhu, què bǎocún le zhòngyào de jìyì.
sentences.translation: Although this old photo is a little blurry, it preserves important memories.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司正在探索新的经营模式。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司正在探索新的經營模式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài tànsuǒ xīn de jīngyíng móshì.
sentences.translation: This company is exploring a new business model.

sentences.chinese: 线上学习改变了传统的教学模式。
sentences.traditional: 線上學習改變了傳統的教學模式。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànshàng xuéxí gǎibiàn le chuántǒng de jiàoxué móshì.
sentences.translation: Online learning has changed the traditional teaching model.

sentences.chinese: 手机可以切换到省电模式，以延长使用时间。
sentences.traditional: 手機可以切換到省電模式，以延長使用時間。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī kěyǐ qiēhuàn dào shěngdiàn móshì, yǐ yáncháng shǐyòng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The phone can switch to power-saving mode to extend its usage time.

sentences.chinese: 刚到这座城市时，他对周围的一切都感到陌生。
sentences.traditional: 剛到這座城市時，他對周圍的一切都感到陌生。
sentences.pinyin: Gāng dào zhè zuò chéngshì shí, tā duì zhōuwéi de yíqiè dōu gǎndào mòshēng.
sentences.translation: When he first arrived in this city, everything around him felt unfamiliar.

sentences.chinese: 面对陌生客户，销售人员需要先建立信任。
sentences.traditional: 面對陌生客戶，銷售人員需要先建立信任。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì mòshēng kèhù, xiāoshòu rényuán xūyào xiān jiànlì xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: When facing unfamiliar clients, sales staff need to build trust first.

sentences.chinese: 这个词我不陌生，但用法还不够熟练。
sentences.traditional: 這個詞我不陌生，但用法還不夠熟練。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge cí wǒ bù mòshēng, dàn yòngfǎ hái bú gòu shúliàn.
sentences.translation: This word is not unfamiliar to me, but I am still not skilled enough in using it.

sentences.chinese: 某些问题看起来简单，实际处理起来却很复杂。
sentences.traditional: 某些問題看起來簡單，實際處理起來卻很複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Mǒu xiē wèntí kàn qǐlai jiǎndān, shíjì chǔlǐ qǐlai què hěn fùzá.
sentences.translation: Some problems look simple, but are actually very complicated to deal with.

sentences.chinese: 他在某家公司工作了十年，积累了丰富的经验。
sentences.traditional: 他在某家公司工作了十年，積累了豐富的經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài mǒu jiā gōngsī gōngzuò le shí nián, jīlěi le fēngfù de jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He worked at a certain company for ten years and accumulated rich experience.

sentences.chinese: 如果某个环节出了问题，整个计划都会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果某個環節出了問題，整個計畫都會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ mǒu ge huánjié chū le wèntí, zhěng ge jìhuà dōu huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If a certain part goes wrong, the whole plan will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息后，大家的目光都集中在经理身上。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息後，大家的目光都集中在經理身上。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè ge xiāoxi hòu, dàjiā de mùguāng dōu jízhōng zài jīnglǐ shēnshang.
sentences.translation: After hearing this news, everyone’s gaze focused on the manager.

sentences.chinese: 她的目光很坚定，让人感到她已经下定决心。
sentences.traditional: 她的目光很堅定，讓人感到她已經下定決心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de mùguāng hěn jiāndìng, ràng rén gǎndào tā yǐjīng xiàdìng juéxīn.
sentences.translation: Her gaze was very firm, making people feel that she had already made up her mind.

sentences.chinese: 他的文章目光长远，不只讨论眼前的问题。
sentences.traditional: 他的文章目光長遠，不只討論眼前的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de wénzhāng mùguāng chángyuǎn, bù zhǐ tǎolùn yǎnqián de wèntí.
sentences.translation: His article takes a long-term view and does not only discuss immediate problems.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子是用结实的木头做成的。
sentences.traditional: 這張桌子是用結實的木頭做成的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì yòng jiēshi de mùtou zuòchéng de.
sentences.translation: This table is made from solid wood.

sentences.chinese: 潮湿的木头不容易点着，最好先放干。
sentences.traditional: 潮濕的木頭不容易點著，最好先放乾。
sentences.pinyin: Cháoshī de mùtou bù róngyì diǎnzháo, zuìhǎo xiān fàng gān.
sentences.translation: Damp wood is not easy to light, so it is best to let it dry first.

sentences.chinese: 他把木头切成小块，准备生火。
sentences.traditional: 他把木頭切成小塊，準備生火。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ mùtou qiē chéng xiǎo kuài, zhǔnbèi shēng huǒ.
sentences.translation: He cut the wood into small pieces and prepared to make a fire.

sentences.chinese: 哪怕任务很艰苦，我们也不能轻易放弃。
sentences.traditional: 哪怕任務很艱苦，我們也不能輕易放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎpà rènwù hěn jiānkǔ, wǒmen yě bù néng qīngyì fàngqì.
sentences.translation: Even if the task is difficult, we must not give up easily.

sentences.chinese: 他哪怕只休息十分钟，也能恢复一点精力。
sentences.traditional: 他哪怕只休息十分鐘，也能恢復一點精力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǎpà zhǐ xiūxi shí fēnzhōng, yě néng huīfù yìdiǎn jīnglì.
sentences.translation: Even if he rests for only ten minutes, he can recover a little energy.

sentences.chinese: 哪怕结果不理想，这次经历也有它的价值。
sentences.traditional: 哪怕結果不理想，這次經歷也有它的價值。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎpà jiéguǒ bù lǐxiǎng, zhè cì jīnglì yě yǒu tā de jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Even if the result is not ideal, this experience still has its value.

sentences.chinese: 这么难得的机会，千万不要错过。
sentences.traditional: 這麼難得的機會，千萬不要錯過。
sentences.pinyin: Zhème nándé de jīhuì, qiānwàn bú yào cuòguò.
sentences.translation: Such a rare opportunity must not be missed.

sentences.chinese: 今天大家都准时到了，真是难得。
sentences.traditional: 今天大家都準時到了，真是難得。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān dàjiā dōu zhǔnshí dào le, zhēn shì nándé.
sentences.translation: Everyone arrived on time today; that really is rare.

sentences.chinese: 他在忙碌的工作中还能保持乐观，这一点很难得。
sentences.traditional: 他在忙碌的工作中還能保持樂觀，這一點很難得。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài mánglù de gōngzuò zhōng hái néng bǎochí lèguān, zhè yì diǎn hěn nándé.
sentences.translation: It is rare that he can still remain optimistic in his busy work.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目的难度比我们原来估计的高得多。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目的難度比我們原來估計的高得多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge xiàngmù de nándù bǐ wǒmen yuánlái gūjì de gāo de duō.
sentences.translation: The difficulty of this project is much higher than we originally estimated.

sentences.chinese: 老师根据学生水平调整了练习的难度。
sentences.traditional: 老師根據學生水平調整了練習的難度。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gēnjù xuéshēng shuǐpíng tiáozhěng le liànxí de nándù.
sentences.translation: The teacher adjusted the difficulty of the exercises according to the students’ level.

sentences.chinese: 虽然任务有一定难度，但只要合作就能完成。
sentences.traditional: 雖然任務有一定難度，但只要合作就能完成。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán rènwù yǒu yí dìng nándù, dàn zhǐyào hézuò jiù néng wánchéng.
sentences.translation: Although the task has a certain degree of difficulty, it can be completed as long as we cooperate.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定涉及个人利益，短时间内难以达成一致。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定涉及個人利益，短時間內難以達成一致。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng shèjí gèrén lìyì, duǎn shíjiān nèi nányǐ dáchéng yízhì.
sentences.translation: This decision involves personal interests, so it is hard to reach agreement in a short time.

sentences.chinese: 没有可靠的数据，我们难以判断方案是否合理。
sentences.traditional: 沒有可靠的數據，我們難以判斷方案是否合理。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu kěkào de shùjù, wǒmen nányǐ pànduàn fāng’àn shìfǒu hélǐ.
sentences.translation: Without reliable data, it is hard for us to judge whether the plan is reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 他把问题描述得过于模糊，大家难以理解他的真实想法。
sentences.traditional: 他把問題描述得過於模糊，大家難以理解他的真實想法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wèntí miáoshù de guòyú móhu, dàjiā nányǐ lǐjiě tā de zhēnshí xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: He described the problem too vaguely, so everyone found it hard to understand his real thoughts.

sentences.chinese: 那名男子在地铁上主动给老人让座，受到了好评。
sentences.traditional: 那名男子在地鐵上主動給老人讓座，受到了好評。
sentences.pinyin: Nà míng nánzǐ zài dìtiě shàng zhǔdòng gěi lǎorén ràngzuò, shòudào le hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: The man voluntarily gave his seat to an elderly person on the underground and received praise.

sentences.chinese: 这项比赛的男子决赛即将在体育馆举行。
sentences.traditional: 這項比賽的男子決賽即將在體育館舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng bǐsài de nánzǐ juésài jíjiāng zài tǐyùguǎn jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: The men’s final of this competition will soon be held in the sports hall.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒中年男子更要重视血压和体重管理。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒中年男子更要重視血壓和體重管理。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng zhōngnián nánzǐ gèng yào zhòngshì xuèyā hé tǐzhòng guǎnlǐ.
sentences.translation: Doctors remind middle-aged men to pay more attention to blood pressure and weight management.

sentences.chinese: 楼下装修太闹，影响了居民的正常休息。
sentences.traditional: 樓下裝修太鬧，影響了居民的正常休息。
sentences.pinyin: Lóuxià zhuāngxiū tài nào, yǐngxiǎng le jūmín de zhèngcháng xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The renovation downstairs is too noisy and has affected the residents’ normal rest.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在广场上又跑又笑，把气氛闹得很热烈。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在廣場上又跑又笑，把氣氛鬧得很熱烈。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài guǎngchǎng shàng yòu pǎo yòu xiào, bǎ qìfēn nào de hěn rèliè.
sentences.translation: The children ran and laughed in the square, making the atmosphere very lively.

sentences.chinese: 这件事本来不严重，别再闹大了。
sentences.traditional: 這件事本來不嚴重，別再鬧大了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì běnlái bù yánzhòng, bié zài nào dà le.
sentences.translation: This matter was not serious at first, so do not make it bigger.

sentences.chinese: 我把闹钟设在六点半，以免明天上班迟到。
sentences.traditional: 我把鬧鐘設在六點半，以免明天上班遲到。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ nàozhōng shè zài liù diǎn bàn, yǐmiǎn míngtiān shàngbān chídào.
sentences.translation: I set the alarm clock for half past six so that I will not be late for work tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他的闹钟响了三次，他却仍然没有起床。
sentences.traditional: 他的鬧鐘響了三次，他卻仍然沒有起床。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de nàozhōng xiǎng le sān cì, tā què réngrán méiyǒu qǐchuáng.
sentences.translation: His alarm clock rang three times, but he still did not get up.

sentences.chinese: 出差时，我习惯同时设置手机和闹钟，比较保险。
sentences.traditional: 出差時，我習慣同時設置手機和鬧鐘，比較保險。
sentences.pinyin: Chūchāi shí, wǒ xíguàn tóngshí shèzhì shǒujī hé nàozhōng, bǐjiào bǎoxiǎn.
sentences.translation: When travelling for work, I usually set both my phone and an alarm clock to be safe.

sentences.chinese: 公司内部正在讨论新的管理制度，暂时不对外公布。
sentences.traditional: 公司內部正在討論新的管理制度，暫時不對外公佈。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī nèibù zhèngzài tǎolùn xīn de guǎnlǐ zhìdù, zànshí bú duìwài gōngbù.
sentences.translation: The company is discussing a new management system internally and will not announce it externally for now.

sentences.chinese: 机器内部如果进了水，可能会影响正常运行。
sentences.traditional: 機器內部如果進了水，可能會影響正常運行。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì nèibù rúguǒ jìn le shuǐ, kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng zhèngcháng yùnxíng.
sentences.translation: If water gets inside the machine, it may affect normal operation.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告只供部门内部参考，请不要转发。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告只供部門內部參考，請不要轉發。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zhǐ gōng bùmén nèibù cānkǎo, qǐng bú yào zhuǎnfā.
sentences.translation: This report is only for internal departmental reference, so please do not forward it.

sentences.chinese: 她不但专业能力强，而且处理问题很冷静，特别能干。
sentences.traditional: 她不但專業能力強，而且處理問題很冷靜，特別能幹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búdàn zhuānyè nénglì qiáng, érqiě chǔlǐ wèntí hěn lěngjìng, tèbié nénggàn.
sentences.translation: She is not only professionally strong, but also calm when handling problems, and is especially capable.

sentences.chinese: 这位秘书非常能干，几乎把会议的每个环节都安排好了。
sentences.traditional: 這位秘書非常能幹，幾乎把會議的每個環節都安排好了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi mìshū fēicháng nénggàn, jīhū bǎ huìyì de měi ge huánjié dōu ānpái hǎo le.
sentences.translation: This secretary is very competent and has arranged almost every part of the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 别看他年纪不大，做起项目来却很能干。
sentences.traditional: 別看他年紀不大，做起項目來卻很能幹。
sentences.pinyin: Bié kàn tā niánjì bú dà, zuò qǐ xiàngmù lái què hěn nénggàn.
sentences.translation: Although he is not very old, he is very capable when working on projects.

sentences.chinese: 年初制定的计划，现在已经完成了一半。
sentences.traditional: 年初制定的計劃，現在已經完成了一半。
sentences.pinyin: Niánchū zhìdìng de jìhuà, xiànzài yǐjīng wánchéng le yí bàn.
sentences.translation: The plan made at the beginning of the year is now already half completed.

sentences.chinese: 公司年初招聘了一批新人，以支持业务扩大。
sentences.traditional: 公司年初招聘了一批新人，以支持業務擴大。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī niánchū zhāopìn le yì pī xīnrén, yǐ zhīchí yèwù kuòdà.
sentences.translation: The company recruited a group of new staff at the beginning of the year to support business expansion.

sentences.chinese: 他年初刚离职，近期正在准备新的简历。
sentences.traditional: 他年初剛離職，近期正在準備新的簡歷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā niánchū gāng lízhí, jìnqī zhèngzài zhǔnbèi xīn de jiǎnlì.
sentences.translation: He left his job at the beginning of the year and is recently preparing a new CV.

sentences.chinese: 上世纪八十年代，很多家庭还没有个人计算机。
sentences.traditional: 上世紀八十年代，很多家庭還沒有個人計算機。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng shìjì bāshí niándài, hěn duō jiātíng hái méiyǒu gèrén jìsuànjī.
sentences.translation: In the 1980s, many families still did not have personal computers.

sentences.chinese: 这张老照片记录了那个年代普通人的生活面貌。
sentences.traditional: 這張老照片記錄了那個年代普通人的生活面貌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng lǎo zhàopiàn jìlù le nà ge niándài pǔtōngrén de shēnghuó miànmào.
sentences.translation: This old photo records the lives of ordinary people in that era.

sentences.chinese: 不同年代的人对婚礼形式有不同观念。
sentences.traditional: 不同年代的人對婚禮形式有不同觀念。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng niándài de rén duì hūnlǐ xíngshì yǒu bùtóng guānniàn.
sentences.translation: People from different generations have different ideas about wedding formats.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然年纪不大，却已经具备丰富的工作经验。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然年紀不大，卻已經具備豐富的工作經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì bú dà, què yǐjīng jùbèi fēngfù de gōngzuò jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Although he is not very old, he already has rich work experience.

sentences.chinese: 随着年纪增长，保持规律的运动越来越重要。
sentences.traditional: 隨著年紀增長，保持規律的運動越來越重要。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe niánjì zēngzhǎng, bǎochí guīlǜ de yùndòng yuè lái yuè zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: As one gets older, maintaining regular exercise becomes increasingly important.

sentences.chinese: 别因为她年纪小就忽视她的观点。
sentences.traditional: 別因為她年紀小就忽視她的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Bié yīnwèi tā niánjì xiǎo jiù hūshì tā de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: Do not ignore her viewpoint just because she is young.

sentences.chinese: 每到春节前，家人都会提前商量年夜饭的菜单。
sentences.traditional: 每到春節前，家人都會提前商量年夜飯的菜單。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào Chūnjié qián, jiārén dōu huì tíqián shāngliang niányèfàn de càidān.
sentences.translation: Before every Spring Festival, the family discusses the menu for New Year’s Eve dinner in advance.

sentences.chinese: 今年的年夜饭由姥姥准备，大家都特别期待。
sentences.traditional: 今年的年夜飯由姥姥準備，大家都特別期待。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián de niányèfàn yóu lǎolao zhǔnbèi, dàjiā dōu tèbié qīdài.
sentences.translation: This year’s New Year’s Eve dinner will be prepared by Grandma, and everyone is especially looking forward to it.

sentences.chinese: 对很多中国家庭来说，年夜饭不仅是一顿饭，更是团聚的象征。
sentences.traditional: 對很多中國家庭來說，年夜飯不僅是一頓飯，更是團聚的象徵。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō Zhōngguó jiātíng lái shuō, niányèfàn bùjǐn shì yí dùn fàn, gèng shì tuánjù de xiàngzhēng.
sentences.translation: For many Chinese families, New Year’s Eve dinner is not only a meal but also a symbol of reunion.

sentences.chinese: 她站在台上念了一段给毕业生的祝福词。
sentences.traditional: 她站在臺上念了一段給畢業生的祝福詞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài tái shàng niàn le yí duàn gěi bìyèshēng de zhùfú cí.
sentences.translation: She stood on the stage and read aloud a short blessing for the graduates.

sentences.chinese: 每逢春节，他都会念着远在欧洲的家人。
sentences.traditional: 每逢春節，他都會念著遠在歐洲的家人。
sentences.pinyin: Měi féng Chūnjié, tā dōu huì niàn zhe yuǎn zài Ōuzhōu de jiārén.
sentences.translation: Every Spring Festival, he misses his family far away in Europe.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求学生先默读课文，再轮流念给大家听。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求學生先默讀課文，再輪流念給大家聽。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshēng xiān mòdú kèwén, zài lúnliú niàn gěi dàjiā tīng.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the students to read the text silently first, then take turns reading it aloud to everyone.

sentences.chinese: 这条牛仔裤虽然款式普通，但面料很舒服。
sentences.traditional: 這條牛仔褲雖然款式普通，但面料很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo niúzǎikù suīrán kuǎnshì pǔtōng, dàn miànliào hěn shūfu.
sentences.translation: Although these jeans have an ordinary style, the fabric is very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 他面试时没有穿牛仔裤，而是换上了西装。
sentences.traditional: 他面試時沒有穿牛仔褲，而是換上了西裝。
sentences.pinyin: Tā miànshì shí méiyǒu chuān niúzǎikù, ér shì huàn shàng le xīzhuāng.
sentences.translation: He did not wear jeans to the interview, but changed into a suit.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的牛仔裤正在打折，吸引了不少年轻客户。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的牛仔褲正在打折，吸引了不少年輕客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de niúzǎikù zhèngzài dǎzhé, xīyǐn le bù shǎo niánqīng kèhù.
sentences.translation: This shop’s jeans are on sale, attracting quite a few young customers.

sentences.chinese: 这杯咖啡太浓了，我需要加一点开水。
sentences.traditional: 這杯咖啡太濃了，我需要加一點開水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bēi kāfēi tài nóng le, wǒ xūyào jiā yìdiǎn kāishuǐ.
sentences.translation: This cup of coffee is too strong; I need to add a little boiled water.

sentences.chinese: 清晨湖面上雾很浓，远处的建筑几乎看不见。
sentences.traditional: 清晨湖面上霧很濃，遠處的建築幾乎看不見。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén húmiàn shàng wù hěn nóng, yuǎnchù de jiànzhù jīhū kàn bú jiàn.
sentences.translation: Early in the morning, the fog over the lake was very thick, and the buildings in the distance could hardly be seen.

sentences.chinese: 这首民歌带有很浓的地方特色。
sentences.traditional: 這首民歌帶有很濃的地方特色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu míngē dàiyǒu hěn nóng de dìfāng tèsè.
sentences.translation: This folk song has a strong local character.

sentences.chinese: 这位农民依靠科学技术提高了粮食产量。
sentences.traditional: 這位農民依靠科學技術提高了糧食產量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi nóngmín yīkào kēxué jìshù tígāo le liángshi chǎnliàng.
sentences.translation: This farmer relied on science and technology to increase grain production.

sentences.chinese: 农业发展离不开农民的经验和努力。
sentences.traditional: 農業發展離不開農民的經驗和努力。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngyè fāzhǎn lí bù kāi nóngmín de jīngyàn hé nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Agricultural development cannot be separated from farmers’ experience and efforts.

sentences.chinese: 政府为当地农民提供了新的培训机会。
sentences.traditional: 政府為當地農民提供了新的培訓機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ wèi dāngdì nóngmín tígōng le xīn de péixùn jīhuì.
sentences.translation: The government provided local farmers with new training opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 近年来，农业越来越重视环保和资源回收。
sentences.traditional: 近年來，農業越來越重視環保和資源回收。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, nóngyè yuè lái yuè zhòngshì huánbǎo hé zīyuán huíshōu.
sentences.translation: In recent years, agriculture has paid increasing attention to environmental protection and resource recycling.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区以农业为主，主要种植水稻和蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區以農業為主，主要種植水稻和蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū yǐ nóngyè wéi zhǔ, zhǔyào zhòngzhí shuǐdào hé shūcài.
sentences.translation: This region is mainly based on agriculture and chiefly grows rice and vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 科技进步正在改变传统农业的经营模式。
sentences.traditional: 科技進步正在改變傳統農業的經營模式。
sentences.pinyin: Kējì jìnbù zhèngzài gǎibiàn chuántǒng nóngyè de jīngyíng móshì.
sentences.translation: Technological progress is changing the operating model of traditional agriculture.

sentences.chinese: 那名女子在决赛中表现稳定，最终获得冠军。
sentences.traditional: 那名女子在決賽中表現穩定，最終獲得冠軍。
sentences.pinyin: Nà míng nǚzǐ zài juésài zhōng biǎoxiàn wěndìng, zuìzhōng huòdé guànjūn.
sentences.translation: That woman performed steadily in the final and eventually won the championship.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究只招收二十到三十岁的健康女子。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究只招收二十到三十歲的健康女子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū zhǐ zhāoshōu èrshí dào sānshí suì de jiànkāng nǚzǐ.
sentences.translation: This study only recruits healthy women aged twenty to thirty.

sentences.chinese: 警方正在寻找一名穿灰色外套的年轻女子。
sentences.traditional: 警方正在尋找一名穿灰色外套的年輕女子。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèngzài xúnzhǎo yì míng chuān huīsè wàitào de niánqīng nǚzǐ.
sentences.translation: The police are looking for a young woman wearing a grey coat.

sentences.chinese: 哦，原来这份合同还没有正式生效。
sentences.traditional: 哦，原來這份合同還沒有正式生效。
sentences.pinyin: Ò, yuánlái zhè fèn hétóng hái méiyǒu zhèngshì shēngxiào.
sentences.translation: Oh, so this contract has not officially taken effect yet.

sentences.chinese: 哦，我明白你的意思了，问题出在最后一个环节。
sentences.traditional: 哦，我明白你的意思了，問題出在最後一個環節。
sentences.pinyin: Ò, wǒ míngbai nǐ de yìsi le, wèntí chū zài zuìhòu yí ge huánjié.
sentences.translation: Oh, I understand what you mean now; the problem lies in the final step.

sentences.chinese: 哦，怪不得他今天没有来，原来是感冒了。
sentences.traditional: 哦，怪不得他今天沒有來，原來是感冒了。
sentences.pinyin: Ò, guàibude tā jīntiān méiyǒu lái, yuánlái shì gǎnmào le.
sentences.translation: Oh, no wonder he did not come today; it turns out he has caught a cold.

sentences.chinese: 欧洲市场对环保产品的需求正在扩大。
sentences.traditional: 歐洲市場對環保產品的需求正在擴大。
sentences.pinyin: Ōuzhōu shìchǎng duì huánbǎo chǎnpǐn de xūqiú zhèngzài kuòdà.
sentences.translation: The European market’s demand for environmentally friendly products is expanding.

sentences.chinese: 他计划毕业后去欧洲学习建筑设计。
sentences.traditional: 他計劃畢業後去歐洲學習建築設計。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìhuà bìyè hòu qù Ōuzhōu xuéxí jiànzhù shèjì.
sentences.translation: He plans to go to Europe to study architectural design after graduation.

sentences.chinese: 这家机构与多个欧洲大学建立了合作关系。
sentences.traditional: 這家機構與多個歐洲大學建立了合作關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jīgòu yǔ duō ge Ōuzhōu dàxué jiànlì le hézuò guānxì.
sentences.translation: This institution has established cooperative relationships with several European universities.

sentences.chinese: 这次偶然的相遇改变了他后来的命运。
sentences.traditional: 這次偶然的相遇改變了他後來的命運。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì ǒurán de xiāngyù gǎibiàn le tā hòulái de mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: This chance meeting changed his later fate.

sentences.chinese: 科学发现有时来自偶然，但也离不开长期观察。
sentences.traditional: 科學發現有時來自偶然，但也離不開長期觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué fāxiàn yǒushí láizì ǒurán, dàn yě lí bù kāi chángqī guānchá.
sentences.translation: Scientific discoveries sometimes come from chance, but they also depend on long-term observation.

sentences.chinese: 他偶然浏览到这篇论文，没想到很有价值。
sentences.traditional: 他偶然瀏覽到這篇論文，沒想到很有價值。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ǒurán liúlǎn dào zhè piān lùnwén, méi xiǎngdào hěn yǒu jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: He happened to browse this paper and unexpectedly found it very valuable.

sentences.chinese: 这个纪录片在西藏拍摄了将近半年。
sentences.traditional: 這個紀錄片在西藏拍攝了將近半年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jìlùpiàn zài Xīzàng pāishè le jiāngjìn bàn nián.
sentences.translation: This documentary was filmed in Tibet for nearly half a year.

sentences.chinese: 拍摄广告时，光线和角度都需要仔细控制。
sentences.traditional: 拍攝廣告時，光線和角度都需要仔細控制。
sentences.pinyin: Pāishè guǎnggào shí, guāngxiàn hé jiǎodù dōu xūyào zǐxì kòngzhì.
sentences.translation: When shooting an advert, both the light and the angle need to be controlled carefully.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护文物，博物馆禁止游客使用闪光灯拍摄。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護文物，博物館禁止遊客使用閃光燈拍攝。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù wénwù, bówùguǎn jìnzhǐ yóukè shǐyòng shǎnguāngdēng pāishè.
sentences.translation: To protect cultural relics, the museum forbids visitors from shooting with flash.

sentences.chinese: 图书馆管理员按照出版年份重新排列这些资料。
sentences.traditional: 圖書館管理員按照出版年份重新排列這些資料。
sentences.pinyin: Túshūguǎn guǎnlǐyuán ànzhào chūbǎn niánfèn chóngxīn páiliè zhèxiē zīliào.
sentences.translation: The librarian rearranged these materials according to their year of publication.

sentences.chinese: 为了让报告更清楚，我把数据排列成了表格。
sentences.traditional: 為了讓報告更清楚，我把數據排列成了表格。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ràng bàogào gèng qīngchu, wǒ bǎ shùjù páiliè chéng le biǎogé.
sentences.translation: To make the report clearer, I arranged the data into a table.

sentences.chinese: 这些座位不是随便排列的，而是根据小组分配安排的。
sentences.traditional: 這些座位不是隨便排列的，而是根據小組分配安排的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zuòwèi bú shì suíbiàn páiliè de, ér shì gēnjù xiǎozǔ fēnpèi ānpái de.
sentences.translation: These seats are not arranged at random, but organised according to the group allocation.

sentences.chinese: 公司派我去广州参加一个为期三天的培训。
sentences.traditional: 公司派我去廣州參加一個為期三天的培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī pài wǒ qù Guǎngzhōu cānjiā yí gè wéiqī sān tiān de péixùn.
sentences.translation: The company sent me to Guangzhou to attend a three-day training course.

sentences.chinese: 学校派了几名老师负责接待海外嘉宾。
sentences.traditional: 學校派了幾名老師負責接待海外嘉賓。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào pài le jǐ míng lǎoshī fùzé jiēdài hǎiwài jiābīn.
sentences.translation: The school sent several teachers to be responsible for receiving the overseas guests.

sentences.chinese: 这次任务很紧急，领导决定派一辆车立刻出发。
sentences.traditional: 這次任務很緊急，領導決定派一輛車立刻出發。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì rènwu hěn jǐnjí, lǐngdǎo juédìng pài yí liàng chē lìkè chūfā.
sentences.translation: This task is urgent, so the leader decided to send a car to set off immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他捡到钱包后，马上交到了附近的派出所。
sentences.traditional: 他撿到錢包後，馬上交到了附近的派出所。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎn dào qiánbāo hòu, mǎshàng jiāo dào le fùjìn de pàichūsuǒ.
sentences.translation: After finding a wallet, he immediately handed it in to the nearby police substation.

sentences.chinese: 派出所的民警耐心地向居民解释新规定。
sentences.traditional: 派出所的民警耐心地向居民解釋新規定。
sentences.pinyin: Pàichūsuǒ de mínjǐng nàixīn de xiàng jūmín jiěshì xīn guīdìng.
sentences.translation: The police officers at the police substation patiently explained the new regulations to the residents.

sentences.chinese: 如果身份证丢了，你需要去派出所办理相关手续。
sentences.traditional: 如果身分證丟了，你需要去派出所辦理相關手續。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shēnfènzhèng diū le, nǐ xūyào qù pàichūsuǒ bànlǐ xiāngguān shǒuxù.
sentences.translation: If your ID card is lost, you need to go to the police substation to handle the relevant procedures.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，学校跑道上积了不少水。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，學校跑道上積了不少水。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guò hòu, xuéxiào pǎodào shàng jī le bù shǎo shuǐ.
sentences.translation: After the rainstorm, quite a lot of water had collected on the school track.

sentences.chinese: 飞机进入跑道前，乘客都被要求系好安全带。
sentences.traditional: 飛機進入跑道前，乘客都被要求繫好安全帶。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī jìnrù pǎodào qián, chéngkè dōu bèi yāoqiú jì hǎo ānquán dài.
sentences.translation: Before the plane entered the runway, all passengers were asked to fasten their seat belts.

sentences.chinese: 他在跑道上连续训练了十圈，最后几乎没有力气了。
sentences.traditional: 他在跑道上連續訓練了十圈，最後幾乎沒有力氣了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài pǎodào shàng liánxù xùnliàn le shí quān, zuìhòu jīhū méiyǒu lìqi le.
sentences.translation: He trained for ten laps in a row on the track and had almost no strength left at the end.

sentences.chinese: 因为快递把货物弄丢了，公司必须赔客户的损失。
sentences.traditional: 因為快遞把貨物弄丟了，公司必須賠客戶的損失。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi kuàidì bǎ huòwù nòng diū le, gōngsī bìxū péi kèhù de sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: Because the courier lost the goods, the company must compensate the customer for the loss.

sentences.chinese: 这件事不能只靠道歉解决，还要按合同赔钱。
sentences.traditional: 這件事不能只靠道歉解決，還要按合同賠錢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù néng zhǐ kào dàoqiàn jiějué, hái yào àn hétóng péi qián.
sentences.translation: This matter cannot be solved just by apologising; compensation must also be paid according to the contract.

sentences.chinese: 如果是我们的责任，我们会依法赔给对方合理的费用。
sentences.traditional: 如果是我們的責任，我們會依法賠給對方合理的費用。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shì wǒmen de zérèn, wǒmen huì yīfǎ péi gěi duìfāng hélǐ de fèiyòng.
sentences.translation: If it is our responsibility, we will legally compensate the other party for reasonable costs.

sentences.chinese: 父母的陪伴对孩子的成长有长期影响。
sentences.traditional: 父母的陪伴對孩子的成長有長期影響。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ de péibàn duì háizi de chéngzhǎng yǒu chángqī yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Parents’ companionship has a long-term influence on a child’s growth.

sentences.chinese: 他辞职后回到故乡，主要是为了陪伴年纪大的父母。
sentences.traditional: 他辭職後回到故鄉，主要是為了陪伴年紀大的父母。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cízhí hòu huí dào gùxiāng, zhǔyào shì wèile péibàn niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
sentences.translation: After resigning, he returned to his hometown mainly to accompany his elderly parents.

sentences.chinese: 机器人可以提供基本服务，却无法真正代替人的陪伴。
sentences.traditional: 機器人可以提供基本服務，卻無法真正代替人的陪伴。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén kěyǐ tígōng jīběn fúwù, què wúfǎ zhēnzhèng dàitì rén de péibàn.
sentences.translation: Robots can provide basic services, but they cannot truly replace human companionship.

sentences.chinese: 新员工入职前要接受两周的系统培训。
sentences.traditional: 新員工入職前要接受兩週的系統培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng rùzhí qián yào jiēshòu liǎng zhōu de xìtǒng péixùn.
sentences.translation: New employees must receive two weeks of systematic training before starting work.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划开展线上培训，以节省差旅费用。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃開展線上培訓，以節省差旅費用。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà kāizhǎn xiànshàng péixùn, yǐ jiéshěng chāilǚ fèiyòng.
sentences.translation: The company plans to carry out online training in order to save travel expenses.

sentences.chinese: 这次培训内容很具体，能帮助我们提高客服质量。
sentences.traditional: 這次培訓內容很具體，能幫助我們提高客服質量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì péixùn nèiróng hěn jùtǐ, néng bāngzhù wǒmen tígāo kèfú zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The content of this training is very specific and can help us improve customer service quality.

sentences.chinese: 学校不仅传授知识，也重视培养学生的独立思考能力。
sentences.traditional: 學校不僅傳授知識，也重視培養學生的獨立思考能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bùjǐn chuánshòu zhīshi, yě zhòngshì péiyǎng xuésheng de dúlì sīkǎo nénglì.
sentences.translation: Schools not only pass on knowledge, but also attach importance to developing students’ ability to think independently.

sentences.chinese: 好习惯不是一天形成的，需要长期培养。
sentences.traditional: 好習慣不是一天形成的，需要長期培養。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎo xíguàn bú shì yì tiān xíngchéng de, xūyào chángqī péiyǎng.
sentences.translation: Good habits are not formed in a day; they need to be cultivated over a long period.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司愿意培养年轻员工，而不是只看他们的简历。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司願意培養年輕員工，而不是只看他們的簡歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yuànyì péiyǎng niánqīng yuángōng, ér bú shì zhǐ kàn tāmen de jiǎnlì.
sentences.translation: This company is willing to develop young employees rather than only looking at their CVs.

sentences.chinese: 这条领带和他的西装很配，显得比较正式。
sentences.traditional: 這條領帶和他的西裝很配，顯得比較正式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lǐngdài hé tā de xīzhuāng hěn pèi, xiǎnde bǐjiào zhèngshì.
sentences.translation: This tie matches his suit well and looks relatively formal.

sentences.chinese: 医生给他配了新药，并提醒他按时服用。
sentences.traditional: 醫生給他配了新藥，並提醒他按時服用。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi tā pèi le xīn yào, bìng tíxǐng tā ànshí fúyòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor prescribed him new medicine and reminded him to take it on time.

sentences.chinese: 这套设备需要配专业的软件才能正常运行。
sentences.traditional: 這套設備需要配專業的軟件才能正常運行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào shèbèi xūyào pèi zhuānyè de ruǎntǐ cái néng zhèngcháng yùnxíng.
sentences.translation: This set of equipment needs to be paired with professional software to operate normally.

sentences.chinese: 如果各部门能够密切配合，项目就能按时完成。
sentences.traditional: 如果各部門能夠密切配合，項目就能按時完成。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ gè bùmén nénggòu mìqiè pèihé, xiàngmù jiù néng ànshí wánchéng.
sentences.translation: If all departments can cooperate closely, the project can be completed on time.

sentences.chinese: 请大家配合海关检查，把相关文件提前准备好。
sentences.traditional: 請大家配合海關檢查，把相關文件提前準備好。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā pèihé hǎiguān jiǎnchá, bǎ xiāngguān wénjiàn tíqián zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.translation: Please cooperate with the customs inspection and prepare the relevant documents in advance.

sentences.chinese: 调查还在进行，希望居民积极配合工作人员。
sentences.traditional: 調查還在進行，希望居民積極配合工作人員。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá hái zài jìnxíng, xīwàng jūmín jījí pèihé gōngzuò rényuán.
sentences.translation: The investigation is still ongoing, and residents are asked to actively cooperate with the staff.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高效率，公司把市区的配送任务交给了本地机构。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高效率，公司把市區的配送任務交給了本地機構。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, gōngsī bǎ shìqū de pèisòng rènwu jiāo gěi le běndì jīgòu.
sentences.translation: To improve efficiency, the company handed the urban delivery tasks to a local organisation.

sentences.chinese: 客户可以在手机上查看货物的配送进度。
sentences.traditional: 客戶可以在手機上查看貨物的配送進度。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù kěyǐ zài shǒujī shang chákàn huòwù de pèisòng jìndù.
sentences.translation: Customers can check the delivery progress of their goods on their phones.

sentences.chinese: 如果地址不明确，配送时间可能会被推迟。
sentences.traditional: 如果地址不明確，配送時間可能會被推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dìzhǐ bù míngquè, pèisòng shíjiān kěnéng huì bèi tuīchí.
sentences.translation: If the address is not clear, the delivery time may be delayed.

sentences.chinese: 窗台上那盆玫瑰因为缺水，叶子已经有点黄了。
sentences.traditional: 窗臺上那盆玫瑰因為缺水，葉子已經有點黃了。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngtái shang nà pén méigui yīnwèi quē shuǐ, yèzi yǐjīng yǒudiǎn huáng le.
sentences.translation: The rose in that pot on the windowsill has turned a little yellow because it lacks water.

sentences.chinese: 他把一盆热水端进房间，准备给老人洗脚。
sentences.traditional: 他把一盆熱水端進房間，準備給老人洗腳。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yì pén rèshuǐ duān jìn fángjiān, zhǔnbèi gěi lǎorén xǐ jiǎo.
sentences.translation: He carried a basin of hot water into the room, ready to wash the elderly person’s feet.

sentences.chinese: 厨房里放着几个空盆，用来清洗海鲜和蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 廚房裡放著幾個空盆，用來清洗海鮮和蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfáng li fàngzhe jǐ gè kōng pén, yòng lái qīngxǐ hǎixiān hé shūcài.
sentences.translation: There are several empty basins in the kitchen for washing seafood and vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 在拥挤的地铁里，他不小心碰到了旁边的乘客。
sentences.traditional: 在擁擠的地鐵裡，他不小心碰到了旁邊的乘客。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yōngjǐ de dìtiě li, tā bù xiǎoxīn pèng dào le pángbiān de chéngkè.
sentences.translation: In the crowded underground train, he accidentally bumped into the passenger beside him.

sentences.chinese: 这个按钮很敏感，轻轻一碰机器就会启动。
sentences.traditional: 這個按鈕很敏感，輕輕一碰機器就會啟動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ànniǔ hěn mǐngǎn, qīngqīng yí pèng jīqì jiù huì qǐdòng.
sentences.translation: This button is very sensitive; one light touch will start the machine.

sentences.chinese: 搬运玻璃时要特别谨慎，千万别碰坏了。
sentences.traditional: 搬運玻璃時要特別謹慎，千萬別碰壞了。
sentences.pinyin: Bānyùn bōli shí yào tèbié jǐnshèn, qiānwàn bié pèng huài le.
sentences.translation: When carrying glass, you must be especially cautious and must not bump it and break it.

sentences.chinese: 我在剧场门口碰见了多年没联系的老同学。
sentences.traditional: 我在劇場門口碰見了多年沒聯繫的老同學。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài jùchǎng ménkǒu pèngjiàn le duō nián méi liánxì de lǎo tóngxué.
sentences.translation: I ran into an old classmate outside the theatre whom I had not contacted for years.

sentences.chinese: 如果你碰见负责人，请提醒他尽快回复邮件。
sentences.traditional: 如果你碰見負責人，請提醒他儘快回覆郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ pèngjiàn fùzé rén, qǐng tíxǐng tā jǐnkuài huífù yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: If you run into the person in charge, please remind him to reply to the email as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 她旅行时偶然碰见一位会说中文的欧洲游客。
sentences.traditional: 她旅行時偶然碰見一位會說中文的歐洲遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǚxíng shí ǒurán pèngjiàn yí wèi huì shuō Zhōngwén de Ōuzhōu yóukè.
sentences.translation: While travelling, she happened to meet a European tourist who could speak Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 这批货物已经通过海关，明天可以安排配送。
sentences.traditional: 這批貨物已經通過海關，明天可以安排配送。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī huòwù yǐjīng tōngguò hǎiguān, míngtiān kěyǐ ānpái pèisòng.
sentences.translation: This batch of goods has already passed customs and can be arranged for delivery tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 学校今年录取了一批来自海外的学生。
sentences.traditional: 學校今年錄取了一批來自海外的學生。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jīnnián lùqǔ le yì pī láizì hǎiwài de xuésheng.
sentences.translation: The school admitted a batch of students from overseas this year.

sentences.chinese: 第一批志愿者已经集合，准备前往灾区。
sentences.traditional: 第一批志願者已經集合，準備前往災區。
sentences.pinyin: Dì-yī pī zhìyuànzhě yǐjīng jíhé, zhǔnbèi qiánwǎng zāiqū.
sentences.translation: The first group of volunteers has already assembled and is preparing to go to the disaster area.

sentences.chinese: 经理没有直接批他的方案，而是要求他进一步修改。
sentences.traditional: 經理沒有直接批他的方案，而是要求他進一步修改。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ méiyǒu zhíjiē pī tā de fāng'àn, ér shì yāoqiú tā jìnyíbù xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: The manager did not directly approve his proposal, but instead asked him to revise it further.

sentences.chinese: 老师批作业时发现很多学生忽视了题目要求。
sentences.traditional: 老師批作業時發現很多學生忽視了題目要求。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī pī zuòyè shí fāxiàn hěn duō xuésheng hūshì le tímù yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: When marking homework, the teacher found that many students had ignored the question requirements.

sentences.chinese: 这笔费用领导已经批了，可以报销。
sentences.traditional: 這筆費用領導已經批了，可以報銷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ fèiyòng lǐngdǎo yǐjīng pī le, kěyǐ bàoxiāo.
sentences.translation: The leader has already approved this expense, so it can be reimbursed.

sentences.chinese: 这项建设计划已经得到政府批准。
sentences.traditional: 這項建設計劃已經得到政府批准。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jiànshè jìhuà yǐjīng dédào zhèngfǔ pīzhǔn.
sentences.translation: This construction plan has already received government approval.

sentences.chinese: 未经批准，任何人不得进入实验室内部。
sentences.traditional: 未經批准，任何人不得進入實驗室內部。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi jīng pīzhǔn, rènhé rén bùdé jìnrù shíyànshì nèibù.
sentences.translation: Without approval, no one may enter the inside of the laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 公司批准了他的离职申请，但要求他完成交接。
sentences.traditional: 公司批准了他的離職申請，但要求他完成交接。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī pīzhǔn le tā de lízhí shēnqǐng, dàn yāoqiú tā wánchéng jiāojiē.
sentences.translation: The company approved his resignation application, but required him to complete the handover.

sentences.chinese: 这匹马受过专业训练，性格比较稳定。
sentences.traditional: 這匹馬受過專業訓練，性格比較穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pǐ mǎ shòu guò zhuānyè xùnliàn, xìnggé bǐjiào wěndìng.
sentences.translation: This horse has received professional training and has a relatively stable temperament.

sentences.chinese: 店主拿出一匹灰色的布，让客户确认宽度。
sentences.traditional: 店主拿出一匹灰色的布，讓客戶確認寬度。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzhǔ ná chū yì pǐ huīsè de bù, ràng kèhù quèrèn kuāndù.
sentences.translation: The shop owner took out a bolt of grey cloth and asked the customer to confirm the width.

sentences.chinese: 草原上有几匹马正慢慢靠近湖边。
sentences.traditional: 草原上有幾匹馬正慢慢靠近湖邊。
sentences.pinyin: Cǎoyuán shang yǒu jǐ pǐ mǎ zhèng mànmàn kàojìn hú biān.
sentences.translation: There are several horses on the grassland slowly approaching the lakeside.

sentences.chinese: 网络交易时要谨慎，别被陌生人骗了。
sentences.traditional: 網絡交易時要謹慎，別被陌生人騙了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò jiāoyì shí yào jǐnshèn, bié bèi mòshēng rén piàn le.
sentences.translation: Be cautious in online transactions, and do not get cheated by strangers.

sentences.chinese: 他说自己被骗过一次，所以现在特别谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 他說自己被騙過一次，所以現在特別謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zìjǐ bèi piàn guò yí cì, suǒyǐ xiànzài tèbié jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: He said he had been cheated once, so he is especially cautious now.

sentences.chinese: 这种广告夸大效果，明显是在骗消费者。
sentences.traditional: 這種廣告誇大效果，明顯是在騙消費者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guǎnggào kuādà xiàoguǒ, míngxiǎn shì zài piàn xiāofèizhě.
sentences.translation: This kind of advert exaggerates its effect and is clearly deceiving consumers.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把地图拼完整后，终于看清了路线。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把地圖拼完整後，終於看清了路線。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ dìtú pīn wánzhěng hòu, zhōngyú kàn qīng le lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: After the child pieced the map together, he finally saw the route clearly.

sentences.chinese: 为了按时完成论文，他连续几天都在拼。
sentences.traditional: 為了按時完成論文，他連續幾天都在拼。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ànshí wánchéng lùnwén, tā liánxù jǐ tiān dōu zài pīn.
sentences.translation: To finish the paper on time, he worked flat out for several days in a row.

sentences.chinese: 这些零件需要按正确顺序拼在一起。
sentences.traditional: 這些零件需要按正確順序拼在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē língjiàn xūyào àn zhèngquè shùnxù pīn zài yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: These parts need to be pieced together in the correct order.

sentences.chinese: 学习汉语时，准确掌握拼音有助于纠正发音。
sentences.traditional: 學習漢語時，準確掌握拼音有助於糾正發音。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí Hànyǔ shí, zhǔnquè zhǎngwò pīnyīn yǒuzhù yú jiūzhèng fāyīn.
sentences.translation: When learning Chinese, accurately mastering pinyin helps correct pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 护照上的姓名需要同时填写汉字和拼音。
sentences.traditional: 護照上的姓名需要同時填寫漢字和拼音。
sentences.pinyin: Hùzhào shang de xìngmíng xūyào tóngshí tiánxiě Hànzì hé pīnyīn.
sentences.translation: The name on the passport needs to be written in both Chinese characters and pinyin.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们用拼音标出这些生词的声调。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們用拼音標出這些生詞的聲調。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen yòng pīnyīn biāo chū zhèxiē shēngcí de shēngdiào.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to use pinyin to mark the tones of these new words.

sentences.chinese: 他的人品可靠，所以大家都愿意和他合作。
sentences.traditional: 他的人品可靠，所以大家都願意和他合作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de rénpǐn kěkào, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu yuànyì hé tā hézuò.
sentences.translation: His character is reliable, so everyone is willing to work with him.

sentences.chinese: 这批新品一上市就受到了年轻客户的欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這批新品一上市就受到了年輕客戶的歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī xīnpǐn yì shàngshì jiù shòudào le niánqīng kèhù de huānyíng.
sentences.translation: This batch of new products was welcomed by young customers as soon as it went on the market.

sentences.chinese: 她喜欢在周末慢慢品茶，让自己安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 她喜歡在週末慢慢品茶，讓自己安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān zài zhōumò mànmàn pǐn chá, ràng zìjǐ ānjìng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: She likes to sip tea slowly at the weekend to calm herself down.

sentences.chinese: 这个品牌虽然年轻，但在海外市场增长很快。
sentences.traditional: 這個品牌雖然年輕，但在海外市場增長很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái suīrán niánqīng, dàn zài hǎiwài shìchǎng zēngzhǎng hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: Although this brand is young, it is growing quickly in overseas markets.

sentences.chinese: 客户选择品牌时，往往更看重品质和服务。
sentences.traditional: 客戶選擇品牌時，往往更看重品質和服務。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù xuǎnzé pǐnpái shí, wǎngwǎng gèng kànzhòng pǐnzhì hé fúwù.
sentences.translation: When choosing a brand, customers often value quality and service more.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划通过媒体宣传提高品牌的影响力。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃通過媒體宣傳提高品牌的影響力。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà tōngguò méitǐ xuānchuán tígāo pǐnpái de yǐngxiǎnglì.
sentences.translation: The company plans to increase the brand’s influence through media publicity.

sentences.chinese: 这款家电的品质稳定，因此获得了不少好评。
sentences.traditional: 這款家電的品質穩定，因此獲得了不少好評。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn jiādiàn de pǐnzhì wěndìng, yīncǐ huòdé le bù shǎo hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: The quality of this household appliance is stable, so it has received quite a few good reviews.

sentences.chinese: 如果只追求低价，产品品质可能难以保证。
sentences.traditional: 如果只追求低價，產品品質可能難以保證。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhuīqiú dījià, chǎnpǐn pǐnzhì kěnéng nányǐ bǎozhèng.
sentences.translation: If you only pursue a low price, product quality may be hard to guarantee.

sentences.chinese: 企业要长期发展，必须把品质放在利润之前。
sentences.traditional: 企業要長期發展，必須把品質放在利潤之前。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yào chángqī fāzhǎn, bìxū bǎ pǐnzhì fàng zài lìrùn zhīqián.
sentences.translation: For a business to develop in the long term, it must put quality before profit.

sentences.chinese: 这种玫瑰的品种适合在温暖地区种植。
sentences.traditional: 這種玫瑰的品種適合在溫暖地區種植。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng méigui de pǐnzhǒng shìhé zài wēnnuǎn dìqū zhòngzhí.
sentences.translation: This variety of rose is suitable for planting in warm regions.

sentences.chinese: 超市里的梨有好几个品种，口味差别明显。
sentences.traditional: 超市裡的梨有好幾個品種，口味差別明顯。
sentences.pinyin: Chāoshì li de lí yǒu hǎo jǐ ge pǐnzhǒng, kǒuwèi chābié míngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: There are several varieties of pears in the supermarket, and the taste differences are obvious.

sentences.chinese: 农业研究人员正在培养抗病能力更强的新品种。
sentences.traditional: 農業研究人員正在培養抗病能力更強的新品種。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngyè yánjiū rényuán zhèngzài péiyǎng kàngbìng nénglì gèng qiáng de xīn pǐnzhǒng.
sentences.translation: Agricultural researchers are cultivating new varieties with stronger disease resistance.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定聘请一位有海外经验的顾问。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定聘請一位有海外經驗的顧問。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng pìnqǐng yí wèi yǒu hǎiwài jīngyàn de gùwèn.
sentences.translation: The company decided to hire a consultant with overseas experience.

sentences.chinese: 学校聘请了几名专家来开展教师培训。
sentences.traditional: 學校聘請了幾名專家來開展教師培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào pìnqǐng le jǐ míng zhuānjiā lái kāizhǎn jiàoshī péixùn.
sentences.translation: The school hired several experts to carry out teacher training.

sentences.chinese: 如果项目规模继续扩大，我们可能需要聘请更多技术人员。
sentences.traditional: 如果項目規模繼續擴大，我們可能需要聘請更多技術人員。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiàngmù guīmó jìxù kuòdà, wǒmen kěnéng xūyào pìnqǐng gèng duō jìshù rényuán.
sentences.translation: If the project scale continues to expand, we may need to hire more technical staff.

sentences.chinese: 她把纸摊平，开始认真填写申请表。
sentences.traditional: 她把紙攤平，開始認真填寫申請表。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhǐ tān píng, kāishǐ rènzhēn tiánxiě shēnqǐngbiǎo.
sentences.translation: She spread the paper flat and began carefully filling in the application form.

sentences.chinese: 这条路修得很平，骑车经过时几乎没有颠簸。
sentences.traditional: 這條路修得很平，騎車經過時幾乎沒有顛簸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù xiū de hěn píng, qíchē jīngguò shí jīhū méiyǒu diānbǒ.
sentences.translation: This road has been made very level; there is almost no bumpiness when cycling over it.

sentences.chinese: 这块木板表面不平，做成柜子以前要先加工。
sentences.traditional: 這塊木板表面不平，做成櫃子以前要先加工。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài mùbǎn biǎomiàn bù píng, zuò chéng guìzi yǐqián yào xiān jiāgōng.
sentences.translation: The surface of this wooden board is uneven; it needs processing before being made into a cabinet.

sentences.chinese: 老师评作业时，不只看答案，还看学生的思路。
sentences.traditional: 老師評作業時，不只看答案，還看學生的思路。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī píng zuòyè shí, bù zhǐ kàn dá'àn, hái kàn xuésheng de sīlù.
sentences.translation: When marking homework, the teacher looks not only at the answer but also at the student’s reasoning.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片在网上获得了很高的评分。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片在網上獲得了很高的評分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zài wǎngshang huòdé le hěn gāo de píngfēn.
sentences.translation: This documentary received a very high rating online.

sentences.chinese: 专家需要客观地评价这个项目的社会价值。
sentences.traditional: 專家需要客觀地評價這個項目的社會價值。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā xūyào kèguān de píngjià zhège xiàngmù de shèhuì jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Experts need to evaluate the social value of this project objectively.

sentences.chinese: 凭这张票，你可以进入开幕式现场。
sentences.traditional: 憑這張票，你可以進入開幕式現場。
sentences.pinyin: Píng zhè zhāng piào, nǐ kěyǐ jìnrù kāimùshì xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: With this ticket, you can enter the opening ceremony venue.

sentences.chinese: 判断一个人不能只凭第一印象。
sentences.traditional: 判斷一個人不能只憑第一印象。
sentences.pinyin: Pànduàn yí ge rén bùnéng zhǐ píng dì-yī yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: You cannot judge a person only by first impressions.

sentences.chinese: 他凭长期积累的技能，顺利通过了面试。
sentences.traditional: 他憑長期積累的技能，順利通過了面試。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píng chángqī jīlěi de jìnéng, shùnlì tōngguò le miànshì.
sentences.translation: He passed the interview smoothly by relying on the skills he had built up over a long time.

sentences.chinese: 只要家人平安，其他困难都可以慢慢克服。
sentences.traditional: 只要家人平安，其他困難都可以慢慢克服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào jiārén píng'ān, qítā kùnnan dōu kěyǐ mànmàn kèfú.
sentences.translation: As long as the family is safe and well, other difficulties can be overcome gradually.

sentences.chinese: 旅行结束后，她给父母发消息报平安。
sentences.traditional: 旅行結束後，她給父母發消息報平安。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng jiéshù hòu, tā gěi fùmǔ fā xiāoxi bào píng'ān.
sentences.translation: After the trip ended, she sent her parents a message to let them know she was safe.

sentences.chinese: 医生说老人已经脱离危险，大家终于平安了。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說老人已經脫離危險，大家終於平安了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō lǎorén yǐjīng tuōlí wēixiǎn, dàjiā zhōngyú píng'ān le.
sentences.translation: The doctor said the elderly person was out of danger, and everyone was finally safe.

sentences.chinese: 这项工作需要平衡速度和品质，否则很难取得长期成功。
sentences.traditional: 這項工作需要平衡速度和品質，否則很難取得長期成功。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò xūyào pínghéng sùdù hé pǐnzhì, fǒuzé hěn nán qǔdé chángqī chénggōng.
sentences.translation: This work needs to balance speed and quality; otherwise it is hard to achieve long-term success.

sentences.chinese: 健康的生活方式应该在工作、运动和休息之间保持平衡。
sentences.traditional: 健康的生活方式應該在工作、運動和休息之間保持平衡。
sentences.pinyin: Jiànkāng de shēnghuó fāngshì yīnggāi zài gōngzuò, yùndòng hé xiūxi zhījiān bǎochí pínghéng.
sentences.translation: A healthy lifestyle should keep a balance between work, exercise and rest.

sentences.chinese: 如果地区发展不平衡，教育资源就会出现明显差距。
sentences.traditional: 如果地區發展不平衡，教育資源就會出現明顯差距。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dìqū fāzhǎn bù pínghéng, jiàoyù zīyuán jiù huì chūxiàn míngxiǎn chājù.
sentences.translation: If regional development is unbalanced, clear gaps in educational resources will appear.

sentences.chinese: 客户的评价直接影响品牌形象和销售结果。
sentences.traditional: 客戶的評價直接影響品牌形象和銷售結果。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù de píngjià zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng pǐnpái xíngxiàng hé xiāoshòu jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Customer evaluations directly affect brand image and sales results.

sentences.chinese: 老师评价学生时，不应该只看考试成绩。
sentences.traditional: 老師評價學生時，不應該只看考試成績。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī píngjià xuésheng shí, bù yīnggāi zhǐ kàn kǎoshì chéngjì.
sentences.translation: When teachers evaluate students, they should not only look at exam results.

sentences.chinese: 对这个政策的评价，必须建立在实际数据上。
sentences.traditional: 對這個政策的評價，必須建立在實際數據上。
sentences.pinyin: Duì zhège zhèngcè de píngjià, bìxū jiànlì zài shíjì shùjù shang.
sentences.translation: The evaluation of this policy must be based on actual data.

sentences.chinese: 他凭借丰富的经验，很快判断出了问题的来源。
sentences.traditional: 他憑藉豐富的經驗，很快判斷出了問題的來源。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píngjiè fēngfù de jīngyàn, hěn kuài pànduàn chū le wèntí de láiyuán.
sentences.translation: Relying on his rich experience, he quickly identified the source of the problem.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司凭借可靠的服务，在行业内建立了良好口碑。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司憑藉可靠的服務，在行業內建立了良好口碑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī píngjiè kěkào de fúwù, zài hángyè nèi jiànlì le liánghǎo kǒubēi.
sentences.translation: This company has built a good reputation in the industry by relying on dependable service.

sentences.chinese: 凭借一张身份证，居民可以领取新的社保卡。
sentences.traditional: 憑藉一張身份證，居民可以領取新的社保卡。
sentences.pinyin: Píngjiè yì zhāng shēnfènzhèng, jūmín kěyǐ lǐngqǔ xīn de shèbǎo kǎ.
sentences.translation: With one ID card, residents can collect a new social security card.

sentences.chinese: 听完医生的解释以后，家属的情绪渐渐平静下来。
sentences.traditional: 聽完醫生的解釋以後，家屬的情緒漸漸平靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng wán yīshēng de jiěshì yǐhòu, jiāshǔ de qíngxù jiànjiàn píngjìng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: After hearing the doctor’s explanation, the family members’ emotions gradually calmed down.

sentences.chinese: 湖面非常平静，几乎看不到一点波动。
sentences.traditional: 湖面非常平靜，幾乎看不到一點波動。
sentences.pinyin: Húmiàn fēicháng píngjìng, jīhū kàn bu dào yìdiǎn bōdòng.
sentences.translation: The surface of the lake was very calm; almost no movement could be seen.

sentences.chinese: 在紧急情况下，保持平静比急忙行动更重要。
sentences.traditional: 在緊急情況下，保持平靜比急忙行動更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, bǎochí píngjìng bǐ jímáng xíngdòng gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In an urgent situation, staying calm is more important than acting in a hurry.

sentences.chinese: 这个班学生的平均年龄大约是十六岁。
sentences.traditional: 這個班學生的平均年齡大約是十六歲。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bān xuésheng de píngjūn niánlíng dàyuē shì shíliù suì.
sentences.translation: The average age of the students in this class is about sixteen.

sentences.chinese: 如果把费用平均分给每个人，压力就不会太大。
sentences.traditional: 如果把費用平均分給每個人，壓力就不會太大。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bǎ fèiyòng píngjūn fēn gěi měi ge rén, yālì jiù bú huì tài dà.
sentences.translation: If the cost is divided equally among everyone, the pressure will not be too great.

sentences.chinese: 今年的降水量低于过去十年的平均水平。
sentences.traditional: 今年的降水量低於過去十年的平均水平。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián de jiàngshuǐliàng dī yú guòqù shí nián de píngjūn shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: This year’s precipitation is lower than the average level of the past ten years.

sentences.chinese: 长时间盯着屏幕会影响视力，所以应该定期休息。
sentences.traditional: 長時間盯著屏幕會影響視力，所以應該定期休息。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān dīngzhe píngmù huì yǐngxiǎng shìlì, suǒyǐ yīnggāi dìngqī xiūxi.
sentences.translation: Staring at a screen for a long time can affect eyesight, so you should rest regularly.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始前，请把资料投到大屏幕上。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始前，請把資料投到大屏幕上。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, qǐng bǎ zīliào tóu dào dà píngmù shang.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting starts, please project the materials onto the big screen.

sentences.chinese: 这个手机屏幕虽然很大，但放进口袋并不方便。
sentences.traditional: 這個手機屏幕雖然很大，但放進口袋並不方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shǒujī píngmù suīrán hěn dà, dàn fàng jìn kǒudai bìng bù fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: Although this phone’s screen is large, it is not convenient to put into a pocket.

sentences.chinese: 这个平台为年轻人提供了展示技能的机会。
sentences.traditional: 這個平臺為年輕人提供了展示技能的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège píngtái wèi niánqīng rén tígōng le zhǎnshì jìnéng de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: This platform has provided young people with opportunities to show their skills.

sentences.chinese: 很多商家通过网上平台销售海外产品。
sentences.traditional: 很多商家通過網上平臺銷售海外產品。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō shāngjiā tōngguò wǎngshàng píngtái xiāoshòu hǎiwài chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: Many merchants sell overseas products through online platforms.

sentences.chinese: 政府正在建设一个公共服务平台，方便居民办理业务。
sentences.traditional: 政府正在建設一個公共服務平臺，方便居民辦理業務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài jiànshè yí ge gōnggòng fúwù píngtái, fāngbiàn jūmín bànlǐ yèwù.
sentences.translation: The government is building a public service platform to make it easier for residents to handle services.

sentences.chinese: 过度开发可能会破坏当地的自然环境。
sentences.traditional: 過度開發可能會破壞當地的自然環境。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù kāifā kěnéng huì pòhuài dāngdì de zìrán huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Excessive development may damage the local natural environment.

sentences.chinese: 这些行为不仅影响秩序，还破坏了公司的形象。
sentences.traditional: 這些行為不僅影響秩序，還破壞了公司的形象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē xíngwéi bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng zhìxù, hái pòhuài le gōngsī de xíngxiàng.
sentences.translation: These actions not only affect order but also damage the company’s image.

sentences.chinese: 如果信任被破坏，合作关系就很难恢复。
sentences.traditional: 如果信任被破壞，合作關係就很難恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xìnrèn bèi pòhuài, hézuò guānxì jiù hěn nán huīfù.
sentences.translation: If trust is destroyed, the cooperative relationship will be hard to restore.

sentences.chinese: 随着网络技术普及，远程办公变得越来越常见。
sentences.traditional: 隨著網絡技術普及，遠程辦公變得越來越常見。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe wǎngluò jìshù pǔjí, yuǎnchéng bàngōng biàn de yuè lái yuè chángjiàn.
sentences.translation: As internet technology spreads, remote working is becoming more and more common.

sentences.chinese: 学校希望通过讲座普及健康饮食知识。
sentences.traditional: 學校希望通過講座普及健康飲食知識。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xīwàng tōngguò jiǎngzuò pǔjí jiànkāng yǐnshí zhīshi.
sentences.translation: The school hopes to spread knowledge about healthy eating through lectures.

sentences.chinese: 要让环保观念真正普及，不能只靠一次活动。
sentences.traditional: 要讓環保觀念真正普及，不能只靠一次活動。
sentences.pinyin: Yào ràng huánbǎo guānniàn zhēnzhèng pǔjí, bùnéng zhǐ kào yí cì huódòng.
sentences.translation: To truly popularise environmental awareness, we cannot rely on only one event.

sentences.chinese: 我很期待下个月的展览，因为听说有不少经典作品。
sentences.traditional: 我很期待下個月的展覽，因為聽說有不少經典作品。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn qīdài xià ge yuè de zhǎnlǎn, yīnwèi tīngshuō yǒu bù shǎo jīngdiǎn zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: I am really looking forward to next month’s exhibition because I hear there will be many classic works.

sentences.chinese: 客户期待我们尽快给出具体的解决方案。
sentences.traditional: 客戶期待我們盡快給出具體的解決方案。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù qīdài wǒmen jǐnkuài gěi chū jùtǐ de jiějué fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: The client expects us to provide a specific solution as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 对即将开始的新工作，她既紧张又充满期待。
sentences.traditional: 對即將開始的新工作，她既緊張又充滿期待。
sentences.pinyin: Duì jíjiāng kāishǐ de xīn gōngzuò, tā jì jǐnzhāng yòu chōngmǎn qīdài.
sentences.translation: Regarding the new job that is about to start, she is both nervous and full of expectation.

sentences.chinese: 合同最后一页需要双方负责人签名后才生效。
sentences.traditional: 合同最後一頁需要雙方負責人簽名後才生效。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong zuìhòu yí yè xūyào shuāngfāng fùzérén qiānmíng hòu cái shēngxiào.
sentences.translation: The contract only takes effect after the people in charge from both sides sign the final page.

sentences.chinese: 他的签名很难认，像是随便画了几笔。
sentences.traditional: 他的簽名很難認，像是隨便畫了幾筆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de qiānmíng hěn nán rèn, xiàng shì suíbiàn huà le jǐ bǐ.
sentences.translation: His signature is hard to recognise, as if he had drawn a few strokes casually.

sentences.chinese: 请在电子文件上完成签名，然后发回给秘书。
