sentences.traditional: 請在電子文件上完成簽名，然後發回給秘書。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài diànzǐ wénjiàn shang wánchéng qiānmíng, ránhòu fā huí gěi mìshū.
sentences.translation: Please complete the signature on the electronic document, then send it back to the secretary.

sentences.chinese: 如果你同意这些条款，就请在这里签字。
sentences.traditional: 如果你同意這些條款，就請在這裡簽字。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ tóngyì zhèxiē tiáokuǎn, jiù qǐng zài zhèlǐ qiānzì.
sentences.translation: If you agree to these terms, please sign here.

sentences.chinese: 没有经理签字，财务部门不能安排付款。
sentences.traditional: 沒有經理簽字，財務部門不能安排付款。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu jīnglǐ qiānzì, cáiwù bùmén bù néng ānpái fùkuǎn.
sentences.translation: Without the manager’s signature, the finance department cannot arrange payment.

sentences.chinese: 他已经签字确认，表示愿意承担相应责任。
sentences.traditional: 他已經簽字確認，表示願意承擔相應責任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng qiānzì quèrèn, biǎoshì yuànyì chéngdān xiāngyìng zérèn.
sentences.translation: He has already signed to confirm that he is willing to take the corresponding responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 即使遇到困难，团队也不能停止前进。
sentences.traditional: 即使遇到困難，團隊也不能停止前進。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ yùdào kùnnan, tuánduì yě bù néng tíngzhǐ qiánjìn.
sentences.translation: Even when facing difficulties, the team cannot stop moving forward.

sentences.chinese: 这条路虽然很窄，但车辆仍然可以缓慢前进。
sentences.traditional: 這條路雖然很窄，但車輛仍然可以緩慢前進。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù suīrán hěn zhǎi, dàn chēliàng réngrán kěyǐ huǎnmàn qiánjìn.
sentences.translation: Although this road is very narrow, vehicles can still move forward slowly.

sentences.chinese: 科技的前进改变了人们获取信息的方式。
sentences.traditional: 科技的前進改變了人們獲取信息的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Kējì de qiánjìn gǎibiàn le rénmen huòqǔ zīxùn de fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The advance of technology has changed the way people obtain information.

sentences.chinese: 欢迎各位嘉宾前来参加开幕式。
sentences.traditional: 歡迎各位嘉賓前來參加開幕式。
sentences.pinyin: Huānyíng gèwèi jiābīn qiánlái cānjiā kāimùshì.
sentences.translation: Welcome, honoured guests, to come and attend the opening ceremony.

sentences.chinese: 据说有许多海外学生前来申请这个项目。
sentences.traditional: 據說有許多海外學生前來申請這個項目。
sentences.pinyin: Jùshuō yǒu xǔduō hǎiwài xuésheng qiánlái shēnqǐng zhège xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: It is said that many overseas students have come to apply for this project.

sentences.chinese: 医院安排医生前来检查老人的恢复情况。
sentences.traditional: 醫院安排醫生前來檢查老人的恢復情況。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn ānpái yīshēng qiánlái jiǎnchá lǎorén de huīfù qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The hospital arranged for a doctor to come and check the elderly person’s recovery.

sentences.chinese: 只要继续提高技能，他的前途会很光明。
sentences.traditional: 只要繼續提高技能，他的前途會很光明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào jìxù tígāo jìnéng, tā de qiántú huì hěn guāngmíng.
sentences.translation: As long as he continues improving his skills, his future will be bright.

sentences.chinese: 这个行业发展迅速，年轻人在里面很有前途。
sentences.traditional: 這個行業發展迅速，年輕人在裡面很有前途。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hángyè fāzhǎn xùnsù, niánqīng rén zài lǐmiàn hěn yǒu qiántú.
sentences.translation: This industry is developing rapidly, and young people in it have good prospects.

sentences.chinese: 做决定时，不能只看工资，也要考虑长期前途。
sentences.traditional: 做決定時，不能只看工資，也要考慮長期前途。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò juédìng shí, bù néng zhǐ kàn gōngzī, yě yào kǎolǜ chángqī qiántú.
sentences.translation: When making a decision, you cannot only look at salary; you must also consider long-term prospects.

sentences.chinese: 代表团将于明日早晨前往上海参加会议。
sentences.traditional: 代表團將於明日早晨前往上海參加會議。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán jiāng yú míngrì zǎochén qiánwǎng Shànghǎi cānjiā huìyì.
sentences.translation: The delegation will head to Shanghai tomorrow morning to attend the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 乘客请根据屏幕提示前往相应的登机口。
sentences.traditional: 乘客請根據屏幕提示前往相應的登機口。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngkè qǐng gēnjù píngmù tíshì qiánwǎng xiāngyìng de dēngjīkǒu.
sentences.translation: Passengers should follow the screen prompts and go to the corresponding boarding gate.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，救护车立即前往现场。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，救護車立即前往現場。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, jiùhùchē lìjí qiánwǎng xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: After the accident happened, the ambulance immediately headed to the scene.

sentences.chinese: 这条河看起来很浅，但水流其实很急。
sentences.traditional: 這條河看起來很淺，但水流其實很急。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé kàn qǐlai hěn qiǎn, dàn shuǐliú qíshí hěn jí.
sentences.translation: This river looks shallow, but the current is actually very fast.

sentences.chinese: 他对这个问题的理解还比较浅，需要进一步学习。
sentences.traditional: 他對這個問題的理解還比較淺，需要進一步學習。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhège wèntí de lǐjiě hái bǐjiào qiǎn, xūyào jìnyíbù xuéxí.
sentences.translation: His understanding of this issue is still rather shallow, so he needs to study further.

sentences.chinese: 这件浅色外套适合春天穿，看起来很干净。
sentences.traditional: 這件淺色外套適合春天穿，看起來很乾淨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn qiǎnsè wàitào shìhé chūntiān chuān, kàn qǐlai hěn gānjìng.
sentences.translation: This light-coloured coat is suitable for spring and looks very clean.

sentences.chinese: 公司还欠供应商三万元，必须尽快付款。
sentences.traditional: 公司還欠供應商三萬元，必須盡快付款。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī hái qiàn gōngyìngshāng sān wàn yuán, bìxū jǐnkuài fùkuǎn.
sentences.translation: The company still owes the supplier thirty thousand yuan and must pay as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 我欠你一个解释，等会议结束后再详细说。
sentences.traditional: 我欠你一個解釋，等會議結束後再詳細說。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qiàn nǐ yí ge jiěshì, děng huìyì jiéshù hòu zài xiángxì shuō.
sentences.translation: I owe you an explanation; I will explain in detail after the meeting ends.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划欠考虑，所以执行过程中出了不少问题。
sentences.traditional: 這個計劃欠考慮，所以執行過程中出了不少問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà qiàn kǎolǜ, suǒyǐ zhíxíng guòchéng zhōng chū le bù shǎo wèntí.
sentences.translation: This plan is insufficiently thought through, so quite a few problems appeared during implementation.

sentences.chinese: 这面墙太薄，隔音效果并不理想。
sentences.traditional: 這面牆太薄，隔音效果並不理想。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè miàn qiáng tài báo, géyīn xiàoguǒ bìng bù lǐxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This wall is too thin, and the soundproofing is not ideal.

sentences.chinese: 他把新的日程表贴在办公室的墙上。
sentences.traditional: 他把新的日程表貼在辦公室的牆上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xīn de rìchéngbiǎo tiē zài bàngōngshì de qiáng shang.
sentences.translation: He stuck the new schedule on the office wall.

sentences.chinese: 这座古老的城墙见证了城市的发展。
sentences.traditional: 這座古老的城牆見證了城市的發展。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngqiáng jiànzhèng le chéngshì de fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: This ancient city wall has witnessed the city’s development.

sentences.chinese: 一个强大的团队需要清晰的目标和密切的合作。
sentences.traditional: 一個強大的團隊需要清晰的目標和密切的合作。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge qiángdà de tuánduì xūyào qīngxī de mùbiāo hé mìqiè de hézuò.
sentences.translation: A strong team needs clear goals and close cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器功能强大，但操作起来并不复杂。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器功能強大，但操作起來並不複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì gōngnéng qiángdà, dàn cāozuò qǐlai bìng bù fùzá.
sentences.translation: This machine is powerful in function, but it is not complicated to operate.

sentences.chinese: 知识能让普通人拥有改变命运的强大力量。
sentences.traditional: 知識能讓普通人擁有改變命運的強大力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhīshi néng ràng pǔtōng rén yōngyǒu gǎibiàn mìngyùn de qiángdà lìliàng.
sentences.translation: Knowledge can give ordinary people powerful strength to change their destiny.

sentences.chinese: 会议上，他反复强调安全意识的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 會議上，他反覆強調安全意識的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shang, tā fǎnfù qiángdiào ānquán yìshí de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: At the meeting, he repeatedly emphasised the importance of safety awareness.

sentences.chinese: 老师强调，写论文不能只堆资料，还要有自己的观点。
sentences.traditional: 老師強調，寫論文不能只堆資料，還要有自己的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī qiángdiào, xiě lùnwén bù néng zhǐ duī zīliào, hái yào yǒu zìjǐ de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: The teacher emphasised that writing a thesis cannot just be piling up materials; it also needs one’s own viewpoint.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告特别强调环境保护与经济发展之间的平衡。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告特別強調環境保護與經濟發展之間的平衡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào tèbié qiángdiào huánjìng bǎohù yǔ jīngjì fāzhǎn zhījiān de pínghéng.
sentences.translation: This report especially emphasises the balance between environmental protection and economic development.

sentences.chinese: 运动强度太高，初学者很容易受伤。
sentences.traditional: 運動強度太高，初學者很容易受傷。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng qiángdù tài gāo, chūxuézhě hěn róngyì shòushāng.
sentences.translation: If the exercise intensity is too high, beginners are very likely to get injured.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥能承受很大的风力强度。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋能承受很大的風力強度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo néng chéngshòu hěn dà de fēnglì qiángdù.
sentences.translation: This bridge can withstand very high wind strength.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他根据身体情况调整训练强度。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他根據身體情況調整訓練強度。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā gēnjù shēntǐ qíngkuàng tiáozhěng xùnliàn qiángdù.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to adjust his training intensity according to his physical condition.

sentences.chinese: 观众对这部纪录片反应强烈，很多人看完后都沉默了。
sentences.traditional: 觀眾對這部紀錄片反應強烈，很多人看完後都沉默了。
sentences.pinyin: Guānzhòng duì zhè bù jìlùpiàn fǎnyìng qiángliè, hěn duō rén kàn wán hòu dōu chénmò le.
sentences.translation: The audience had a strong reaction to this documentary, and many people fell silent after watching it.

sentences.chinese: 这里阳光强烈，出门最好戴帽子。
sentences.traditional: 這裡陽光強烈，出門最好戴帽子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yángguāng qiángliè, chūmén zuì hǎo dài màozi.
sentences.translation: The sunlight here is strong, so it is best to wear a hat when going out.

sentences.chinese: 他有强烈的责任感，所以很少把问题推给别人。
sentences.traditional: 他有強烈的責任感，所以很少把問題推給別人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǒu qiángliè de zérèngǎn, suǒyǐ hěn shǎo bǎ wèntí tuī gěi biérén.
sentences.translation: He has a strong sense of responsibility, so he rarely pushes problems onto others.

sentences.chinese: 节日期间，热门车票一放出来就被抢光了。
sentences.traditional: 節日期間，熱門車票一放出來就被搶光了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì qījiān, rèmén chēpiào yí fàng chūlai jiù bèi qiǎngguāng le.
sentences.translation: During the holiday period, popular train tickets were snapped up as soon as they were released.

sentences.chinese: 为了抢到前排位置，大家一大早就去排队。
sentences.traditional: 為了搶到前排位置，大家一大早就去排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile qiǎng dào qiánpái wèizhi, dàjiā yí dà zǎo jiù qù páiduì.
sentences.translation: To grab a front-row position, everyone went to queue very early in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 他们不是来抢市场，而是来提供新的合作方式。
sentences.traditional: 他們不是來搶市場，而是來提供新的合作方式。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bú shì lái qiǎng shìchǎng, ér shì lái tígōng xīn de hézuò fāngshì.
sentences.translation: They are not here to snatch market share, but to provide a new way of cooperating.

sentences.chinese: 医生们连续工作了六个小时，终于把病人抢救过来了。
sentences.traditional: 醫生們連續工作了六個小時，終於把病人搶救過來了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēngmen liánxù gōngzuò le liù ge xiǎoshí, zhōngyú bǎ bìngrén qiǎngjiù guòlai le.
sentences.translation: The doctors worked continuously for six hours and finally saved the patient.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，救护车立刻赶到现场抢救伤者。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，救護車立刻趕到現場搶救傷者。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, jiùhùchē lìkè gǎn dào xiànchǎng qiǎngjiù shāngzhě.
sentences.translation: After the accident happened, the ambulance immediately rushed to the scene to rescue the injured.

sentences.chinese: 这批古老资料被及时抢救下来，才没有在火灾中损失。
sentences.traditional: 這批古老資料被及時搶救下來，才沒有在火災中損失。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī gǔlǎo zīliào bèi jíshí qiǎngjiù xiàlái, cái méiyǒu zài huǒzāi zhōng sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: This batch of old materials was rescued in time, so it was not lost in the fire.

sentences.chinese: 她悄悄把礼物放在桌上，没有让孩子发现。
sentences.traditional: 她悄悄把禮物放在桌上，沒有讓孩子發現。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiāoqiāo bǎ lǐwù fàng zài zhuō shang, méiyǒu ràng háizi fāxiàn.
sentences.translation: She quietly put the present on the table without letting the child notice.

sentences.chinese: 为了不影响会议，他悄悄关上了门。
sentences.traditional: 為了不影響會議，他悄悄關上了門。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bù yǐngxiǎng huìyì, tā qiāoqiāo guān shàng le mén.
sentences.translation: In order not to disturb the meeting, he quietly closed the door.

sentences.chinese: 这个消息在公司里悄悄传开了。
sentences.traditional: 這個消息在公司裡悄悄傳開了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi zài gōngsī lǐ qiāoqiāo chuán kāi le.
sentences.translation: This news quietly spread through the company.

sentences.chinese: 做饭前，请先把黄瓜切成薄片。
sentences.traditional: 做飯前，請先把黃瓜切成薄片。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòfàn qián, qǐng xiān bǎ huángguā qiē chéng báo piàn.
sentences.translation: Before cooking, please first cut the cucumber into thin slices.

sentences.chinese: 他切水果时不小心伤到了手指。
sentences.traditional: 他切水果時不小心傷到了手指。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiē shuǐguǒ shí bù xiǎoxīn shāng dào le shǒuzhǐ.
sentences.translation: He accidentally hurt his finger while cutting fruit.

sentences.chinese: 这块木头太硬，普通工具很难切开。
sentences.traditional: 這塊木頭太硬，普通工具很難切開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài mùtou tài yìng, pǔtōng gōngjù hěn nán qiē kāi.
sentences.translation: This piece of wood is too hard; ordinary tools can hardly cut it open.

sentences.chinese: 她和邻居关系很亲，遇到困难都会互相帮助。
sentences.traditional: 她和鄰居關係很親，遇到困難都會互相幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hé línjū guānxi hěn qīn, yù dào kùnnan dōu huì hùxiāng bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: She is very close to her neighbours, and they help each other when difficulties arise.

sentences.chinese: 孩子睡前亲了妈妈一下，才安心躺下。
sentences.traditional: 孩子睡前親了媽媽一下，才安心躺下。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi shuì qián qīn le māma yí xià, cái ānxīn tǎng xià.
sentences.translation: The child kissed his mum before bed and only then lay down peacefully.

sentences.chinese: 多年没见，他见到亲人时忍不住流下泪水。
sentences.traditional: 多年沒見，他見到親人時忍不住流下淚水。
sentences.pinyin: Duōnián méi jiàn, tā jiàn dào qīnrén shí rěn bu zhù liú xià lèishuǐ.
sentences.translation: After not seeing them for many years, he could not help shedding tears when he saw his relatives.

sentences.chinese: 亲爱的各位嘉宾，欢迎光临今天的开幕式。
sentences.traditional: 親愛的各位嘉賓，歡迎光臨今天的開幕式。
sentences.pinyin: Qīn’ài de gèwèi jiābīn, huānyíng guānglín jīntiān de kāimùshì.
sentences.translation: Dear honoured guests, welcome to today’s opening ceremony.

sentences.chinese: 她在信的开头写下“亲爱的爸爸妈妈”。
sentences.traditional: 她在信的開頭寫下「親愛的爸爸媽媽」。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xìn de kāitóu xiě xià “qīn’ài de bàba māma”.
sentences.translation: At the beginning of the letter, she wrote, “Dear Mum and Dad.”

sentences.chinese: 亲爱的朋友们，谢谢你们一直以来的陪伴。
sentences.traditional: 親愛的朋友們，謝謝你們一直以來的陪伴。
sentences.pinyin: Qīn’ài de péngyoumen, xièxie nǐmen yìzhí yǐlái de péibàn.
sentences.translation: Dear friends, thank you for your companionship all this time.

sentences.chinese: 婚礼那天，许多亲朋好友都前来祝贺。
sentences.traditional: 婚禮那天，許多親朋好友都前來祝賀。
sentences.pinyin: Hūnlǐ nà tiān, xǔduō qīnpéng-hǎoyǒu dōu qiánlái zhùhè.
sentences.translation: On the day of the wedding, many relatives and friends came to offer congratulations.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，一家人会和亲朋好友一起吃年夜饭。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，一家人會和親朋好友一起吃年夜飯。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, yì jiā rén huì hé qīnpéng-hǎoyǒu yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
sentences.translation: During Spring Festival, the family eats New Year’s Eve dinner together with relatives and friends.

sentences.chinese: 遇到困难时，他最先想到的是自己的亲朋好友。
sentences.traditional: 遇到困難時，他最先想到的是自己的親朋好友。
sentences.pinyin: Yù dào kùnnan shí, tā zuì xiān xiǎng dào de shì zìjǐ de qīnpéng-hǎoyǒu.
sentences.translation: When he encounters difficulties, the first people he thinks of are his relatives and friends.

sentences.chinese: 这位护士说话很亲切，让病人紧张的情绪缓解了许多。
sentences.traditional: 這位護士說話很親切，讓病人緊張的情緒緩解了許多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi hùshi shuōhuà hěn qīnqiè, ràng bìngrén jǐnzhāng de qíngxù huǎnjiě le xǔduō.
sentences.translation: This nurse speaks very kindly, which eased the patient’s nervous feelings a lot.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他是领导，但态度亲切，从不让员工感到有距离。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他是領導，但態度親切，從不讓員工感到有距離。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā shì lǐngdǎo, dàn tàidu qīnqiè, cóng bù ràng yuángōng gǎndào yǒu jùlí.
sentences.translation: Although he is a leader, his attitude is kind, and he never makes employees feel distant.

sentences.chinese: 老师亲切地提醒我们，提交论文前要再检查一遍。
sentences.traditional: 老師親切地提醒我們，提交論文前要再檢查一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī qīnqiè de tíxǐng wǒmen, tíjiāo lùnwén qián yào zài jiǎnchá yí biàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher kindly reminded us to check once more before submitting the paper.

sentences.chinese: 无论工作多忙，他都尽量回家陪伴父母，因为亲情对他来说极其重要。
sentences.traditional: 無論工作多忙，他都盡量回家陪伴父母，因為親情對他來說極其重要。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn gōngzuò duō máng, tā dōu jǐnliàng huí jiā péibàn fùmǔ, yīnwèi qīnqíng duì tā lái shuō jíqí zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: No matter how busy work is, he tries to go home to accompany his parents, because family affection is extremely important to him.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影通过一个普通家庭的故事表现了深厚的亲情。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影通過一個普通家庭的故事表現了深厚的親情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng tōngguò yí ge pǔtōng jiātíng de gùshi biǎoxiàn le shēnhòu de qīnqíng.
sentences.translation: This film expresses deep family affection through the story of an ordinary family.

sentences.chinese: 在他最困难的时候，亲情给了他重新开始的力量。
sentences.traditional: 在他最困難的時候，親情給了他重新開始的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā zuì kùnnan de shíhou, qīnqíng gěi le tā chóngxīn kāishǐ de lìliàng.
sentences.translation: At his most difficult time, family affection gave him the strength to start again.

sentences.chinese: 她在海外工作多年，最想念的还是故乡的亲人。
sentences.traditional: 她在海外工作多年，最想念的還是故鄉的親人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài hǎiwài gōngzuò duōnián, zuì xiǎngniàn de háishi gùxiāng de qīnrén.
sentences.translation: After working overseas for many years, the people she misses most are still her relatives in her hometown.

sentences.chinese: 医生通知家属后，亲人们立刻赶到了急诊室。
sentences.traditional: 醫生通知家屬後，親人們立刻趕到了急診室。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngzhī jiāshǔ hòu, qīnrénmen lìkè gǎn dào le jízhěnshì.
sentences.translation: After the doctor notified the family, the relatives immediately rushed to the emergency room.

sentences.chinese: 对老人来说，亲人的陪伴比任何礼物都更有价值。
sentences.traditional: 對老人來說，親人的陪伴比任何禮物都更有價值。
sentences.pinyin: Duì lǎorén lái shuō, qīnrén de péibàn bǐ rènhé lǐwù dōu gèng yǒu jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: For older people, the companionship of family members is more valuable than any gift.

sentences.chinese: 这么重要的合同，他决定亲自去和客户谈。
sentences.traditional: 這麼重要的合同，他決定親自去和客戶談。
sentences.pinyin: Zhème zhòngyào de hétong, tā juédìng qīnzì qù hé kèhù tán.
sentences.translation: For such an important contract, he decided to go and speak with the client personally.

sentences.chinese: 校长亲自向获奖学生颁发了证书。
sentences.traditional: 校長親自向獲獎學生頒發了證書。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng qīnzì xiàng huòjiǎng xuésheng bānfā le zhèngshū.
sentences.translation: The headteacher personally presented certificates to the award-winning students.

sentences.chinese: 为了了解真实情况，记者亲自到现场进行了采访。
sentences.traditional: 為了了解真實情況，記者親自到現場進行了採訪。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile liǎojiě zhēnshí qíngkuàng, jìzhě qīnzì dào xiànchǎng jìnxíng le cǎifǎng.
sentences.translation: To understand the real situation, the reporter personally went to the scene to conduct interviews.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然基础一般，但学习十分勤奋，所以进步很快。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然基礎一般，但學習十分勤奮，所以進步很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán jīchǔ yìbān, dàn xuéxí shífēn qínfèn, suǒyǐ jìnbù hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: Although his foundation is average, he studies very diligently, so he improves quickly.

sentences.chinese: 勤奋并不等于盲目地花时间，还需要合理的方法。
sentences.traditional: 勤奮並不等於盲目地花時間，還需要合理的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Qínfèn bìng bù děngyú mángmù de huā shíjiān, hái xūyào hélǐ de fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: Being diligent does not mean blindly spending time; it also requires a reasonable method.

sentences.chinese: 公司更愿意培养那些既勤奋又有责任感的年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 公司更願意培養那些既勤奮又有責任感的年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gèng yuànyì péiyǎng nàxiē jì qínfèn yòu yǒu zérèngǎn de niánqīngrén.
sentences.translation: The company is more willing to develop young people who are both hardworking and responsible.

sentences.chinese: 远处的青山被薄雾遮住了，看起来像一幅国画。
sentences.traditional: 遠處的青山被薄霧遮住了，看起來像一幅國畫。
sentences.pinyin: Yuǎnchù de qīngshān bèi báo wù zhēzhù le, kànqǐlái xiàng yì fú guóhuà.
sentences.translation: The distant green hills were covered by thin mist, looking like a traditional Chinese painting.

sentences.chinese: 这件青色外套颜色比较淡，适合春天穿。
sentences.traditional: 這件青色外套顏色比較淡，適合春天穿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn qīngsè wàitào yánsè bǐjiào dàn, shìhé chūntiān chuān.
sentences.translation: This blue-green coat is fairly light in colour and is suitable for spring.

sentences.chinese: 他脸色发青，护士立刻安排他去急诊。
sentences.traditional: 他臉色發青，護士立刻安排他去急診。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liǎnsè fā qīng, hùshi lìkè ānpái tā qù jízhěn.
sentences.translation: His face had turned pale blue, so the nurse immediately arranged for him to go to emergency.

sentences.chinese: 没有充分证据，我们不能轻易下结论。
sentences.traditional: 沒有充分證據，我們不能輕易下結論。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu chōngfèn zhèngjù, wǒmen bù néng qīngyì xià jiélùn.
sentences.translation: Without sufficient evidence, we cannot easily draw a conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题涉及多方利益，恐怕不会轻易解决。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題涉及多方利益，恐怕不會輕易解決。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí shèjí duō fāng lìyì, kǒngpà bú huì qīngyì jiějué.
sentences.translation: This issue involves the interests of several parties, so it probably will not be solved easily.

sentences.chinese: 她不会轻易放弃已经坚持了多年的目标。
sentences.traditional: 她不會輕易放棄已經堅持了多年的目標。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú huì qīngyì fàngqì yǐjīng jiānchí le duōnián de mùbiāo.
sentences.translation: She will not easily give up the goal she has stuck to for many years.

sentences.chinese: 处理紧急事务时，必须先分清事情的轻重。
sentences.traditional: 處理緊急事務時，必須先分清事情的輕重。
sentences.pinyin: Chǔlǐ jǐnjí shìwù shí, bìxū xiān fēn qīng shìqing de qīngzhòng.
sentences.translation: When handling urgent matters, one must first distinguish their relative importance.

sentences.chinese: 医生会根据病情轻重安排病人就诊的顺序。
sentences.traditional: 醫生會根據病情輕重安排病人就診的順序。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng huì gēnjù bìngqíng qīngzhòng ānpái bìngrén jiùzhěn de shùnxù.
sentences.translation: The doctor will arrange the order of consultations according to the seriousness of the condition.

sentences.chinese: 他说话有些不知轻重，容易让别人误会。
sentences.traditional: 他說話有些不知輕重，容易讓別人誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà yǒuxiē bù zhī qīngzhòng, róngyì ràng biérén wùhuì.
sentences.translation: He sometimes speaks without judging the seriousness of things, which can easily make others misunderstand.

sentences.chinese: 这首歌表达了海外游子对故乡复杂的情感。
sentences.traditional: 這首歌表達了海外遊子對故鄉複雜的情感。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē biǎodá le hǎiwài yóuzǐ duì gùxiāng fùzá de qínggǎn.
sentences.translation: This song expresses the complex feelings of overseas travellers towards their hometown.

sentences.chinese: 在合作中，理性判断和个人情感都可能影响决定。
sentences.traditional: 在合作中，理性判斷和個人情感都可能影響決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zài hézuò zhōng, lǐxìng pànduàn hé gèrén qínggǎn dōu kěnéng yǐngxiǎng juédìng.
sentences.translation: In cooperation, rational judgement and personal feelings may both influence decisions.

sentences.chinese: 他不善于表达情感，但一直用行动照顾家人。
sentences.traditional: 他不善於表達情感，但一直用行動照顧家人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shànyú biǎodá qínggǎn, dàn yìzhí yòng xíngdòng zhàogù jiārén.
sentences.translation: He is not good at expressing emotions, but he has always looked after his family through actions.

sentences.chinese: 回想起毕业那天的情景，她仍然觉得很激动。
sentences.traditional: 回想起畢業那天的情景，她仍然覺得很激動。
sentences.pinyin: Huíxiǎng qǐ bìyè nà tiān de qíngjǐng, tā réngrán juéde hěn jīdòng.
sentences.translation: Thinking back to the scene on graduation day, she still feels very moved.

sentences.chinese: 这段视频真实记录了救护车赶到现场时的情景。
sentences.traditional: 這段視頻真實記錄了救護車趕到現場時的情景。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn shìpín zhēnshí jìlù le jiùhùchē gǎn dào xiànchǎng shí de qíngjǐng.
sentences.translation: This video truly recorded the scene when the ambulance arrived at the site.

sentences.chinese: 老师设计了一个购物情景，让学生练习如何跟店员交流。
sentences.traditional: 老師設計了一個購物情景，讓學生練習如何跟店員交流。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shèjì le yí ge gòuwù qíngjǐng, ràng xuésheng liànxí rúhé gēn diànyuán jiāoliú.
sentences.translation: The teacher designed a shopping situation so students could practise how to communicate with shop assistants.

sentences.chinese: 会议被临时取消后，他的情绪明显低落。
sentences.traditional: 會議被臨時取消後，他的情緒明顯低落。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì bèi línshí qǔxiāo hòu, tā de qíngxù míngxiǎn dīluò.
sentences.translation: After the meeting was cancelled at short notice, his mood was noticeably low.

sentences.chinese: 管理者需要学会控制情绪，否则容易影响判断。
sentences.traditional: 管理者需要學會控制情緒，否則容易影響判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐzhě xūyào xuéhuì kòngzhì qíngxù, fǒuzé róngyì yǐngxiǎng pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Managers need to learn to control their emotions; otherwise, their judgement is easily affected.

sentences.chinese: 音乐能缓解紧张情绪，让人慢慢平静下来。
sentences.traditional: 音樂能緩解緊張情緒，讓人慢慢平靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnyuè néng huǎnjiě jǐnzhāng qíngxù, ràng rén mànmàn píngjìng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: Music can ease nervous emotions and make people gradually calm down.

sentences.chinese: 如果你对合同条款不理解，可以向律师请教。
sentences.traditional: 如果你對合同條款不理解，可以向律師請教。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ duì hétong tiáokuǎn bù lǐjiě, kěyǐ xiàng lǜshī qǐngjiào.
sentences.translation: If you do not understand the contract terms, you can ask a lawyer for advice.

sentences.chinese: 她经常向经验丰富的同事请教工作方法。
sentences.traditional: 她經常向經驗豐富的同事請教工作方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng xiàng jīngyàn fēngfù de tóngshì qǐngjiào gōngzuò fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: She often asks experienced colleagues for advice on working methods.

sentences.chinese: 遇到技术难题时，他并不觉得请教别人丢人。
sentences.traditional: 遇到技術難題時，他並不覺得請教別人丟人。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào jìshù nántí shí, tā bìng bù juéde qǐngjiào biérén diūrén.
sentences.translation: When he runs into technical difficulties, he does not think asking others for advice is embarrassing.

sentences.chinese: 客户请求我们尽快确认配送时间。
sentences.traditional: 客戶請求我們盡快確認配送時間。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù qǐngqiú wǒmen jǐnkuài quèrèn pèisòng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The client requested that we confirm the delivery time as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 面对记者的提问，他拒绝了进一步说明的请求。
sentences.traditional: 面對記者的提問，他拒絕了進一步說明的請求。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jìzhě de tíwèn, tā jùjué le jìnyíbù shuōmíng de qǐngqiú.
sentences.translation: Faced with the reporter’s questions, he refused the request to explain further.

sentences.chinese: 如果需要延期提交论文，必须提前向老师提出请求。
sentences.traditional: 如果需要延期提交論文，必須提前向老師提出請求。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xūyào yánqī tíjiāo lùnwén, bìxū tíqián xiàng lǎoshī tíchū qǐngqiú.
sentences.translation: If you need to delay submitting the paper, you must make a request to the teacher in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区过去很穷，近年来发展速度明显加快。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區過去很窮，近年來發展速度明顯加快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū guòqù hěn qióng, jìnnián lái fāzhǎn sùdù míngxiǎn jiākuài.
sentences.translation: This region used to be poor, but in recent years its pace of development has clearly accelerated.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然出身穷，但靠勤奋改变了自己的命运。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然出身窮，但靠勤奮改變了自己的命運。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán chūshēn qióng, dàn kào qínfèn gǎibiàn le zìjǐ de mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: Although he came from a poor background, he changed his destiny through hard work.

sentences.chinese: 穷并不可怕，可怕的是失去继续前进的决心。
sentences.traditional: 窮並不可怕，可怕的是失去繼續前進的決心。
sentences.pinyin: Qióng bìng bù kěpà, kěpà de shì shīqù jìxù qiánjìn de juéxīn.
sentences.translation: Being poor is not frightening; what is frightening is losing the determination to keep moving forward.

sentences.chinese: 近年来，线上购物已经成为一种明显的趋势。
sentences.traditional: 近年來，線上購物已經成為一種明顯的趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, xiànshàng gòuwù yǐjīng chéngwéi yì zhǒng míngxiǎn de qūshì.
sentences.translation: In recent years, online shopping has become an obvious trend.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员通过数据观察市场变化的趋势。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員通過數據觀察市場變化的趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán tōngguò shùjù guānchá shìchǎng biànhuà de qūshì.
sentences.translation: Researchers observe the trend of market changes through data.

sentences.chinese: 如果这种趋势继续下去，传统行业也必须加速转型。
sentences.traditional: 如果這種趨勢繼續下去，傳統行業也必須加速轉型。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhè zhǒng qūshì jìxù xiàqù, chuántǒng hángyè yě bìxū jiāsù zhuǎnxíng.
sentences.translation: If this trend continues, traditional industries will also have to speed up their transformation.

sentences.chinese: 这个区域禁止停车，车辆只能临时通过。
sentences.traditional: 這個區域禁止停車，車輛只能臨時通過。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège qūyù jìnzhǐ tíngchē, chēliàng zhǐ néng línshí tōngguò.
sentences.translation: Parking is forbidden in this area; vehicles may only pass through temporarily.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划在海外市场扩大销售区域。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃在海外市場擴大銷售區域。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà zài hǎiwài shìchǎng kuòdà xiāoshòu qūyù.
sentences.translation: The company plans to expand its sales region in overseas markets.

sentences.chinese: 不同区域的客户口味差别很大，不能用同一种方案。
sentences.traditional: 不同區域的客戶口味差別很大，不能用同一種方案。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng qūyù de kèhù kǒuwèi chābié hěn dà, bù néng yòng tóng yì zhǒng fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: Customers in different regions have very different tastes, so the same plan cannot be used for all of them.

sentences.chinese: 听说那位著名作家去世了，许多读者都感到难过。
sentences.traditional: 聽說那位著名作家去世了，許多讀者都感到難過。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi zhùmíng zuòjiā qùshì le, xǔduō dúzhě dōu gǎndào nánguò.
sentences.translation: Hearing that the famous writer had passed away, many readers felt sad.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶去世以后，他更加珍惜和亲人在一起的时间。
sentences.traditional: 奶奶去世以後，他更加珍惜和親人在一起的時間。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai qùshì yǐhòu, tā gèngjiā zhēnxī hé qīnrén zài yìqǐ de shíjiān.
sentences.translation: After his grandmother passed away, he cherished his time with family even more.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片记录了他去世前最后几年的生活。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片記錄了他去世前最後幾年的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jìlù le tā qùshì qián zuìhòu jǐ nián de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This documentary records his life in the final years before he passed away.

sentences.chinese: 只有负责人有权批准这项交易。
sentences.traditional: 只有負責人有權批准這項交易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu fùzérén yǒu quán pīzhǔn zhè xiàng jiāoyì.
sentences.translation: Only the person in charge has the authority to approve this transaction.

sentences.chinese: 在法律面前，任何人都没有特权。
sentences.traditional: 在法律面前，任何人都沒有特權。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fǎlǜ miànqián, rènhé rén dōu méiyǒu tèquán.
sentences.translation: Before the law, no one has special privileges.

sentences.chinese: 这件事我权当一次教训，以后会更加谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 這件事我權當一次教訓，以後會更加謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ quándāng yí cì jiàoxun, yǐhòu huì gèngjiā jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: I will just take this matter as a lesson and be more cautious in future.

sentences.chinese: 消费者有权利要求商家提供清楚的说明。
sentences.traditional: 消費者有權利要求商家提供清楚的說明。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě yǒu quánlì yāoqiú shāngjiā tígōng qīngchu de shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: Consumers have the right to ask businesses to provide clear explanations.

sentences.chinese: 尊重他人的权利，是现代社会的重要观念。
sentences.traditional: 尊重他人的權利，是現代社會的重要觀念。
sentences.pinyin: Zūnzhòng tārén de quánlì, shì xiàndài shèhuì de zhòngyào guānniàn.
sentences.translation: Respecting other people’s rights is an important idea in modern society.

sentences.chinese: 合同应该明确双方的权利和责任。
sentences.traditional: 合同應該明確雙方的權利和責任。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong yīnggāi míngquè shuāngfāng de quánlì hé zérèn.
sentences.translation: The contract should clearly state both parties’ rights and responsibilities.

sentences.chinese: 医生正在全力抢救那名受伤的男子。
sentences.traditional: 醫生正在全力搶救那名受傷的男子。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài quánlì qiǎngjiù nà míng shòushāng de nánzǐ.
sentences.translation: Doctors are doing everything they can to rescue the injured man.

sentences.chinese: 为了完成这个项目，团队成员都付出了全力。
sentences.traditional: 為了完成這個項目，團隊成員都付出了全力。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile wánchéng zhège xiàngmù, tuánduì chéngyuán dōu fùchū le quánlì.
sentences.translation: To complete this project, all the team members put in their full effort.

sentences.chinese: 公司将全力支持新产品的开发和推广。
sentences.traditional: 公司將全力支持新產品的開發和推廣。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāng quánlì zhīchí xīn chǎnpǐn de kāifā hé tuīguǎng.
sentences.translation: The company will fully support the development and promotion of the new product.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告对项目风险进行了全面分析。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告對項目風險進行了全面分析。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào duì xiàngmù fēngxiǎn jìnxíng le quánmiàn fēnxī.
sentences.translation: This report carried out a comprehensive analysis of the project risks.

sentences.chinese: 学校希望培养学生全面发展的能力。
sentences.traditional: 學校希望培養學生全面發展的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xīwàng péiyǎng xuésheng quánmiàn fāzhǎn de nénglì.
sentences.translation: The school hopes to develop students’ ability to grow in an all-round way.

sentences.chinese: 新政策公布前，政府需要听取全面的意见。
sentences.traditional: 新政策公佈前，政府需要聽取全面的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè gōngbù qián, zhèngfǔ xūyào tīngqǔ quánmiàn de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Before announcing the new policy, the government needs to listen to comprehensive opinions.

sentences.chinese: 全体员工都参加了安全培训。
sentences.traditional: 全體員工都參加了安全培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Quántǐ yuángōng dōu cānjiā le ānquán péixùn.
sentences.translation: All staff members took part in the safety training.

sentences.chinese: 这项决定关系到全体居民的利益。
sentences.traditional: 這項決定關係到全體居民的利益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng juédìng guānxì dào quántǐ jūmín de lìyì.
sentences.translation: This decision concerns the interests of all residents.

sentences.chinese: 校长代表全体老师向毕业生表示祝贺。
sentences.traditional: 校長代表全體老師向畢業生表示祝賀。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng dàibiǎo quántǐ lǎoshī xiàng bìyèshēng biǎoshì zhùhè.
sentences.translation: The headteacher, on behalf of all the teachers, congratulated the graduates.

sentences.chinese: 公司推出了一套全新的客户服务系统。
sentences.traditional: 公司推出了一套全新的客戶服務系統。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī tuīchū le yí tào quánxīn de kèhù fúwù xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: The company launched a brand-new customer service system.

sentences.chinese: 搬进新办公室后，团队有了全新的工作环境。
sentences.traditional: 搬進新辦公室後，團隊有了全新的工作環境。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjìn xīn bàngōngshì hòu, tuánduì yǒu le quánxīn de gōngzuò huánjìng.
sentences.translation: After moving into the new office, the team had a brand-new working environment.

sentences.chinese: 这次改革给传统行业带来了全新的机会。
sentences.traditional: 這次改革給傳統行業帶來了全新的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gǎigé gěi chuántǒng hángyè dàilái le quánxīn de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: This reform has brought brand-new opportunities to traditional industries.

sentences.chinese: 朋友劝他不要轻易放弃这次机会。
sentences.traditional: 朋友勸他不要輕易放棄這次機會。
sentences.pinyin: Péngyou quàn tā bú yào qīngyì fàngqì zhè cì jīhuì.
sentences.translation: His friend advised him not to give up this opportunity too easily.

sentences.chinese: 医生反复劝老人按时吃药。
sentences.traditional: 醫生反覆勸老人按時吃藥。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng fǎnfù quàn lǎorén ànshí chī yào.
sentences.translation: The doctor repeatedly advised the elderly person to take medicine on time.

sentences.chinese: 我们劝客户先确认合同内容再签字。
sentences.traditional: 我們勸客戶先確認合同內容再簽字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen quàn kèhù xiān quèrèn hétong nèiróng zài qiānzì.
sentences.translation: We advised the client to confirm the contract details before signing.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划缺乏具体的执行步骤。
sentences.traditional: 這個計畫缺乏具體的執行步驟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà quēfá jùtǐ de zhíxíng bùzhòu.
sentences.translation: This plan lacks specific implementation steps.

sentences.chinese: 如果缺乏经验，就更应该谨慎处理。
sentences.traditional: 如果缺乏經驗，就更應該謹慎處理。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ quēfá jīngyàn, jiù gèng yīnggāi jǐnshèn chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: If you lack experience, you should handle it even more cautiously.

sentences.chinese: 部分地区仍然缺乏可靠的医疗资源。
sentences.traditional: 部分地區仍然缺乏可靠的醫療資源。
sentences.pinyin: Bùfen dìqū réngrán quēfá kěkào de yīliáo zīyuán.
sentences.translation: Some regions still lack reliable medical resources.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须确保所有数据都准确无误。
sentences.traditional: 我們必須確保所有數據都準確無誤。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū quèbǎo suǒyǒu shùjù dōu zhǔnquè wúwù.
sentences.translation: We must ensure that all the data is accurate and error-free.

sentences.chinese: 为了确保安全，工作人员会检查每个环节。
sentences.traditional: 為了確保安全，工作人員會檢查每個環節。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo ānquán, gōngzuò rényuán huì jiǎnchá měi ge huánjié.
sentences.translation: To ensure safety, staff will check every stage.

sentences.chinese: 公司采取新措施，确保货物按时送到。
sentences.traditional: 公司採取新措施，確保貨物按時送到。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī cǎiqǔ xīn cuòshī, quèbǎo huòwù ànshí sòngdào.
sentences.translation: The company adopted new measures to ensure the goods arrive on time.

sentences.chinese: 会议时间确定以后，请尽快通知全体成员。
sentences.traditional: 會議時間確定以後，請盡快通知全體成員。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shíjiān quèdìng yǐhòu, qǐng jǐnkuài tōngzhī quántǐ chéngyuán.
sentences.translation: After the meeting time is confirmed, please notify all members as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 我还不确定他是否已经收到文件。
sentences.traditional: 我還不確定他是否已經收到文件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái bù quèdìng tā shìfǒu yǐjīng shōudào wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: I am still not sure whether he has already received the document.

sentences.chinese: 负责人需要确定下一阶段的工作重点。
sentences.traditional: 負責人需要確定下一階段的工作重點。
sentences.pinyin: Fùzérén xūyào quèdìng xià yí jiēduàn de gōngzuò zhòngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The person in charge needs to determine the focus of the next stage of work.

sentences.chinese: 请你确认一下报名信息是否正确。
sentences.traditional: 請你確認一下報名信息是否正確。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ quèrèn yíxià bàomíng xìnxī shìfǒu zhèngquè.
sentences.translation: Please confirm whether the registration information is correct.

sentences.chinese: 客服会在发货前再次确认地址。
sentences.traditional: 客服會在發貨前再次確認地址。
sentences.pinyin: Kèfú huì zài fāhuò qián zàicì quèrèn dìzhǐ.
sentences.translation: Customer service will confirm the address again before shipping.

sentences.chinese: 收到邮件后，他立即确认了面试时间。
sentences.traditional: 收到郵件後，他立即確認了面試時間。
sentences.pinyin: Shōudào yóujiàn hòu, tā lìjí quèrèn le miànshì shíjiān.
sentences.translation: After receiving the email, he immediately confirmed the interview time.

sentences.chinese: 一群学生正在广场上讨论环保话题。
sentences.traditional: 一群學生正在廣場上討論環保話題。
sentences.pinyin: Yì qún xuésheng zhèngzài guǎngchǎng shang tǎolùn huánbǎo huàtí.
sentences.translation: A group of students are discussing environmental topics in the square.

sentences.chinese: 这群志愿者为社区做了很多工作。
sentences.traditional: 這群志願者為社區做了很多工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè qún zhìyuànzhě wèi shèqū zuò le hěn duō gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: This group of volunteers has done a lot of work for the community.

sentences.chinese: 人群渐渐安静下来，开始听讲座。
sentences.traditional: 人群漸漸安靜下來，開始聽講座。
sentences.pinyin: Rénqún jiànjiàn ānjìng xiàlái, kāishǐ tīng jiǎngzuò.
sentences.translation: The crowd gradually quietened down and began listening to the lecture.

sentences.chinese: 这个政策主要影响年轻消费群体。
sentences.traditional: 這個政策主要影響年輕消費群體。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè zhǔyào yǐngxiǎng niánqīng xiāofèi qúntǐ.
sentences.translation: This policy mainly affects young consumer groups.

sentences.chinese: 不同群体对同一问题可能有不同观点。
sentences.traditional: 不同群體對同一問題可能有不同觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng qúntǐ duì tóng yí wèntí kěnéng yǒu bùtóng guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: Different groups may have different views on the same issue.

sentences.chinese: 研究者需要观察目标群体的实际需求。
sentences.traditional: 研究者需要觀察目標群體的實際需求。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiūzhě xūyào guānchá mùbiāo qúntǐ de shíjì xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Researchers need to observe the actual needs of the target group.

sentences.chinese: 火焰在炉子里持续燃烧，释放出大量热量。
sentences.traditional: 火焰在爐子裡持續燃燒，釋放出大量熱量。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒyàn zài lúzi li chíxù ránshāo, shìfàng chū dàliàng rèliàng.
sentences.translation: The flame kept burning in the stove, releasing a large amount of heat.

sentences.chinese: 如果垃圾随意燃烧，会造成严重的空气污染。
sentences.traditional: 如果垃圾隨意燃燒，會造成嚴重的空氣污染。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ lājī suíyì ránshāo, huì zàochéng yánzhòng de kōngqì wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: If rubbish is burned carelessly, it can cause serious air pollution.

sentences.chinese: 他的热情像火一样燃烧，感染了整个团队。
sentences.traditional: 他的熱情像火一樣燃燒，感染了整個團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de rèqíng xiàng huǒ yíyàng ránshāo, gǎnrǎn le zhěng ge tuánduì.
sentences.translation: His enthusiasm burned like fire and inspired the whole team.

sentences.chinese: 为了避开施工路段，司机绕了很远的路。
sentences.traditional: 為了避開施工路段，司機繞了很遠的路。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìkāi shīgōng lùduàn, sījī rào le hěn yuǎn de lù.
sentences.translation: To avoid the roadworks, the driver went a long way round.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们绕着湖跑了一圈才回到集合点。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們繞著湖跑了一圈才回到集合點。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen ràozhe hú pǎo le yì quān cái huí dào jíhé diǎn.
sentences.translation: The children ran once around the lake before returning to the meeting point.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题不能绕过去，必须直接面对。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題不能繞過去，必須直接面對。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bù néng rào guòqu, bìxū zhíjiē miànduì.
sentences.translation: This problem cannot be avoided; it must be faced directly.

sentences.chinese: 她从小热爱美术，后来成了一名设计师。
sentences.traditional: 她從小熱愛美術，後來成了一名設計師。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo rè’ài měishù, hòulái chéng le yì míng shèjìshī.
sentences.translation: She loved art from childhood and later became a designer.

sentences.chinese: 真正热爱工作的人，往往愿意不断提高自己的技能。
sentences.traditional: 真正熱愛工作的人，往往願意不斷提高自己的技能。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng rè’ài gōngzuò de rén, wǎngwǎng yuànyì búduàn tígāo zìjǐ de jìnéng.
sentences.translation: People who truly love their work are often willing to keep improving their skills.

sentences.chinese: 因为热爱家乡，他决定回去创业。
sentences.traditional: 因為熱愛家鄉，他決定回去創業。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi rè’ài jiāxiāng, tā juédìng huíqù chuàngyè.
sentences.translation: Because he deeply loves his hometown, he decided to return and start a business.

sentences.chinese: 运动以后，身体会消耗更多热量。
sentences.traditional: 運動以後，身體會消耗更多熱量。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu, shēntǐ huì xiāohào gèng duō rèliàng.
sentences.translation: After exercise, the body consumes more heat energy.

sentences.chinese: 这种食品含有很高的热量，不适合减肥期间多吃。
sentences.traditional: 這種食品含有很高的熱量，不適合減肥期間多吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shípǐn hányǒu hěn gāo de rèliàng, bù shìhé jiǎnféi qījiān duō chī.
sentences.translation: This type of food contains a lot of calories and is not suitable to eat much of while losing weight.

sentences.chinese: 燃烧过程中释放的热量可以用来加热水。
sentences.traditional: 燃燒過程中釋放的熱量可以用來加熱水。
sentences.pinyin: Ránshāo guòchéng zhōng shìfàng de rèliàng kěyǐ yòng lái jiārè shuǐ.
sentences.translation: The heat released during burning can be used to heat water.

sentences.chinese: 演讲结束后，观众报以热烈的掌声。
sentences.traditional: 演講結束後，觀眾報以熱烈的掌聲。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng jiéshù hòu, guānzhòng bào yǐ rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
sentences.translation: After the speech ended, the audience responded with warm applause.

sentences.chinese: 双方进行了热烈讨论，但仍然保持理性。
sentences.traditional: 雙方進行了熱烈討論，但仍然保持理性。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng jìnxíng le rèliè tǎolùn, dàn réngrán bǎochí lǐxìng.
sentences.translation: Both sides held a lively discussion, but still remained rational.

sentences.chinese: 代表团受到当地居民的热烈欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 代表團受到當地居民的熱烈歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán shòu dào dāngdì jūmín de rèliè huānyíng.
sentences.translation: The delegation received a warm welcome from local residents.

sentences.chinese: 他对公益活动很热心，经常参加志愿服务。
sentences.traditional: 他對公益活動很熱心，經常參加志願服務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì gōngyì huódòng hěn rèxīn, jīngcháng cānjiā zhìyuàn fúwù.
sentences.translation: He is very enthusiastic about public welfare activities and often takes part in volunteer service.

sentences.chinese: 这位热心的邻居帮老人联系了救护车。
sentences.traditional: 這位熱心的鄰居幫老人聯繫了救護車。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi rèxīn de línjū bāng lǎorén liánxì le jiùhùchē.
sentences.translation: This warmhearted neighbour helped the elderly person contact an ambulance.

sentences.chinese: 热心并不等于随便干涉别人的生活。
sentences.traditional: 熱心並不等於隨便干涉別人的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Rèxīn bìng bù děngyú suíbiàn gānshè biéren de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Being warmhearted is not the same as casually interfering in other people’s lives.

sentences.chinese: 企业的发展离不开高水平的人才。
sentences.traditional: 企業的發展離不開高水平的人才。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè de fāzhǎn lí bù kāi gāo shuǐpíng de réncái.
sentences.translation: The development of an enterprise cannot be separated from high-level talent.

sentences.chinese: 这项计划旨在培养本地科技人才。
sentences.traditional: 這項計畫旨在培養本地科技人才。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìhuà zhǐ zài péiyǎng běndì kējì réncái.
sentences.translation: This plan aims to train local science and technology talent.

sentences.chinese: 只有尊重人才，机构才有可能持续创新。
sentences.traditional: 只有尊重人才，機構才有可能持續創新。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zūnzhòng réncái, jīgòu cái yǒu kěnéng chíxù chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: Only by respecting talent can an institution keep innovating.

sentences.chinese: 这条河流经过人工改造后，防洪能力提高了。
sentences.traditional: 這條河流經過人工改造後，防洪能力提高了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo héliú jīngguò réngōng gǎizào hòu, fánghóng nénglì tígāo le.
sentences.translation: After this river was artificially modified, its flood-control capacity improved.

sentences.chinese: 由于机器出故障，部分环节只能依靠人工完成。
sentences.traditional: 由於機器出故障，部分環節只能依靠人工完成。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú jīqì chū gùzhàng, bùfen huánjié zhǐ néng yīkào réngōng wánchéng.
sentences.translation: Because the machine broke down, some steps could only be completed manually.

sentences.chinese: 人工成本上升以后，公司开始考虑自动化方案。
sentences.traditional: 人工成本上升以後，公司開始考慮自動化方案。
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng chéngběn shàngshēng yǐhòu, gōngsī kāishǐ kǎolǜ zìdònghuà fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: After labour costs rose, the company began considering automation plans.

sentences.chinese: 良好的人际关系能缓解工作压力。
sentences.traditional: 良好的人際關係能緩解工作壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de rénjì guānxì néng huǎnjiě gōngzuò yālì.
sentences.translation: Good interpersonal relationships can ease work pressure.

sentences.chinese: 他性格开朗，所以在人际交往中比较主动。
sentences.traditional: 他性格開朗，所以在人際交往中比較主動。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xìnggé kāilǎng, suǒyǐ zài rénjì jiāowǎng zhōng bǐjiào zhǔdòng.
sentences.translation: He has a cheerful personality, so he is relatively active in interpersonal interactions.

sentences.chinese: 参加集体活动有助于提高孩子的人际能力。
sentences.traditional: 參加集體活動有助於提高孩子的人際能力。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā jítǐ huódòng yǒuzhù yú tígāo háizi de rénjì nénglì.
sentences.translation: Taking part in group activities helps improve children’s interpersonal skills.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市的人口近年来增长很快。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市的人口近年來增長很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de rénkǒu jìnnián lái zēngzhǎng hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: The population of this city has grown quickly in recent years.

sentences.chinese: 人口老龄化给医疗系统带来了新的挑战。
sentences.traditional: 人口老齡化給醫療系統帶來了新的挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Rénkǒu lǎolínghuà gěi yīliáo xìtǒng dàilái le xīn de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: Population ageing has brought new challenges to the healthcare system.

sentences.chinese: 政府需要根据人口变化来调整公共服务。
sentences.traditional: 政府需要根據人口變化來調整公共服務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xūyào gēnjù rénkǒu biànhuà lái tiáozhěng gōnggòng fúwù.
sentences.translation: The government needs to adjust public services according to population changes.

sentences.chinese: 科学技术的发展正在改变人类的生活方式。
sentences.traditional: 科學技術的發展正在改變人類的生活方式。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué jìshù de fāzhǎn zhèngzài gǎibiàn rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The development of science and technology is changing humanity’s way of life.

sentences.chinese: 保护环境关系到整个人类的未来。
sentences.traditional: 保護環境關係到整個人類的未來。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù huánjìng guānxì dào zhěng ge rénlèi de wèilái.
sentences.translation: Protecting the environment concerns the future of all humanity.

sentences.chinese: 面对疾病，人类需要加强国际合作。
sentences.traditional: 面對疾病，人類需要加強國際合作。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jíbìng, rénlèi xūyào jiāqiáng guójì hézuò.
sentences.translation: In the face of disease, humanity needs to strengthen international cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目规模太大，单靠人力很难完成。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目規模太大，單靠人力很難完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù guīmó tài dà, dān kào rénlì hěn nán wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This project is too large in scale to complete by manpower alone.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在利用机器减少对人力的依赖。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在利用機器減少對人力的依賴。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài lìyòng jīqì jiǎnshǎo duì rénlì de yīlài.
sentences.translation: The company is using machines to reduce its reliance on labour.

sentences.chinese: 灾后救援急需大量人力和物资。
sentences.traditional: 災後救援急需大量人力和物資。
sentences.pinyin: Zāi hòu jiùyuán jíxū dàliàng rénlì hé wùzī.
sentences.translation: Post-disaster rescue work urgently needs a large amount of manpower and supplies.

sentences.chinese: 政府的政策应该符合人民的根本利益。
sentences.traditional: 政府的政策應該符合人民的根本利益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ de zhèngcè yīnggāi fúhé rénmín de gēnběn lìyì.
sentences.translation: Government policies should accord with the fundamental interests of the people.

sentences.chinese: 人民对美好生活的期待越来越高。
sentences.traditional: 人民對美好生活的期待越來越高。
sentences.pinyin: Rénmín duì měihǎo shēnghuó de qīdài yuè lái yuè gāo.
sentences.translation: The people’s expectations for a better life are becoming higher and higher.

sentences.chinese: 这座纪念馆记录了人民艰苦奋斗的历史。
sentences.traditional: 這座紀念館記錄了人民艱苦奮鬥的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò jìniànguǎn jìlù le rénmín jiānkǔ fèndòu de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: This memorial records the history of the people’s arduous struggle.

sentences.chinese: 汇率变化会影响人民币的国际购买力。
sentences.traditional: 匯率變化會影響人民幣的國際購買力。
sentences.pinyin: Huìlǜ biànhuà huì yǐngxiǎng rénmínbì de guójì gòumǎilì.
sentences.translation: Exchange-rate changes can affect the international purchasing power of the Renminbi.

sentences.chinese: 这批货物的价格已经换算成人民币。
sentences.traditional: 這批貨物的價格已經換算成人民幣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī huòwù de jiàgé yǐjīng huànsuàn chéng rénmínbì.
sentences.translation: The price of this batch of goods has already been converted into Renminbi.

sentences.chinese: 他把奖金捐出一万元人民币给山区学校。
sentences.traditional: 他把獎金捐出一萬元人民幣給山區學校。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiǎngjīn juān chū yí wàn yuán rénmínbì gěi shānqū xuéxiào.
sentences.translation: He donated ten thousand yuan in Renminbi from his bonus to a mountain-area school.

sentences.chinese: 警察迅速把人群疏散到安全区域。
sentences.traditional: 警察迅速把人群疏散到安全區域。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá xùnsù bǎ rénqún shūsàn dào ānquán qūyù.
sentences.translation: The police quickly evacuated the crowd to a safe area.

sentences.chinese: 广场上的人群越来越密集，活动不得不推迟。
sentences.traditional: 廣場上的人群越來越密集，活動不得不推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng shang de rénqún yuè lái yuè mìjí, huódòng bùdébù tuīchí.
sentences.translation: The crowd in the square grew denser and denser, so the event had to be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 她在人群中一眼认出了自己的老同学。
sentences.traditional: 她在人群中一眼認出了自己的老同學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài rénqún zhōng yì yǎn rèn chū le zìjǐ de lǎo tóngxué.
sentences.translation: She recognised her old classmate at a glance in the crowd.

sentences.chinese: 适量运动有助于提高人体的免疫能力。
sentences.traditional: 適量運動有助於提高人體的免疫能力。
sentences.pinyin: Shìliàng yùndòng yǒuzhù yú tígāo réntǐ de miǎnyì nénglì.
sentences.translation: A moderate amount of exercise helps improve the human body’s immune ability.

sentences.chinese: 医学研究需要充分尊重人体安全和伦理原则。
sentences.traditional: 醫學研究需要充分尊重人體安全和倫理原則。
sentences.pinyin: Yīxué yánjiū xūyào chōngfèn zūnzhòng réntǐ ānquán hé lúnlǐ yuánzé.
sentences.translation: Medical research must fully respect human-body safety and ethical principles.

sentences.chinese: 这张图详细展示了人体主要器官的位置。
sentences.traditional: 這張圖詳細展示了人體主要器官的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng tú xiángxì zhǎnshì le réntǐ zhǔyào qìguān de wèizhi.
sentences.translation: This diagram shows in detail the positions of the main organs in the human body.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片采访了几位关键人物。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片採訪了幾位關鍵人物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn cǎifǎng le jǐ wèi guānjiàn rénwù.
sentences.translation: This documentary interviewed several key figures.

sentences.chinese: 小说中的主要人物性格非常鲜明。
sentences.traditional: 小說中的主要人物性格非常鮮明。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshuō zhōng de zhǔyào rénwù xìnggé fēicháng xiānmíng.
sentences.translation: The main characters in the novel have very distinctive personalities.

sentences.chinese: 他是近代历史上一位具有巨大影响的人物。
sentences.traditional: 他是近代歷史上一位具有巨大影響的人物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì jìndài lìshǐ shang yí wèi jùyǒu jùdà yǐngxiǎng de rénwù.
sentences.translation: He is a figure with enormous influence in modern history.

sentences.chinese: 疼痛虽然强烈，但他还是忍着完成了比赛。
sentences.traditional: 疼痛雖然強烈，但他還是忍著完成了比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Téngtòng suīrán qiángliè, dàn tā háishi rěnzhe wánchéng le bǐsài.
sentences.translation: Although the pain was intense, he still endured it and finished the competition.

sentences.chinese: 面对不公平的批评，她再也忍不下去了。
sentences.traditional: 面對不公平的批評，她再也忍不下去了。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì bù gōngpíng de pīpíng, tā zài yě rěn bù xiàqù le.
sentences.translation: Faced with unfair criticism, she could no longer put up with it.

sentences.chinese: 有些小问题可以忍一忍，但原则不能让步。
sentences.traditional: 有些小問題可以忍一忍，但原則不能讓步。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xiǎo wèntí kěyǐ rěn yi rěn, dàn yuánzé bù néng ràngbù.
sentences.translation: Some small problems can be tolerated for a while, but principles cannot be compromised.

sentences.chinese: 这份文件太模糊，我认不出签名是谁的。
sentences.traditional: 這份文件太模糊，我認不出簽名是誰的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn tài móhu, wǒ rèn bù chū qiānmíng shì shéi de.
sentences.translation: This document is too blurred; I cannot recognise whose signature it is.

sentences.chinese: 孩子已经能认很多汉字了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子已經能認很多漢字了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yǐjīng néng rèn hěn duō Hànzì le.
sentences.translation: The child can already recognise many Chinese characters.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然离职多年，客户还是一眼认出了他。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然離職多年，客戶還是一眼認出了他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán lízhí duō nián, kèhù háishi yì yǎn rèn chū le tā.
sentences.translation: Although he had left the job many years earlier, the customer still recognised him at a glance.

sentences.chinese: 我把会议日期写在日历上，免得忘记。
sentences.traditional: 我把會議日期寫在日曆上，免得忘記。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ huìyì rìqī xiě zài rìlì shang, miǎnde wàngjì.
sentences.translation: I wrote the meeting date on the calendar so that I would not forget it.

sentences.chinese: 手机上的日历会提前提醒你参加讲座。
sentences.traditional: 手機上的日曆會提前提醒你參加講座。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī shang de rìlì huì tíqián tíxǐng nǐ cānjiā jiǎngzuò.
sentences.translation: The calendar on your phone will remind you in advance to attend the lecture.

sentences.chinese: 新年快到了，公司给每位员工发了一本日历。
sentences.traditional: 新年快到了，公司給每位員工發了一本日曆。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnnián kuài dào le, gōngsī gěi měi wèi yuángōng fā le yì běn rìlì.
sentences.translation: The New Year is coming soon, so the company gave every employee a calendar.

sentences.chinese: 搬家前，我把牙刷、毛巾等日用品都装进了一个箱子。
sentences.traditional: 搬家前，我把牙刷、毛巾等日用品都裝進了一個箱子。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiā qián, wǒ bǎ yáshuā, máojīn děng rìyòngpǐn dōu zhuāng jìn le yí ge xiāngzi.
sentences.translation: Before moving house, I packed daily necessities such as toothbrushes and towels into one box.

sentences.chinese: 这家超市不仅卖食品，也卖各种日用品，购物很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這家超市不僅賣食品，也賣各種日用品，購物很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì bùjǐn mài shípǐn, yě mài gè zhǒng rìyòngpǐn, gòuwù hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This supermarket sells not only food but also all kinds of daily necessities, so shopping is convenient.

sentences.chinese: 疫情期间，居民更关注日用品的配送速度和质量。
sentences.traditional: 疫情期間，居民更關注日用品的配送速度和質量。
sentences.pinyin: Yìqíng qījiān, jūmín gèng guānzhù rìyòngpǐn de pèisòng sùdù hé zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: During the epidemic, residents paid more attention to the delivery speed and quality of daily necessities.

sentences.chinese: 如有疑问，请在会议结束前向工作人员提出。
sentences.traditional: 如有疑問，請在會議結束前向工作人員提出。
sentences.pinyin: Rú yǒu yíwèn, qǐng zài huìyì jiéshù qián xiàng gōngzuò rényuán tíchū.
sentences.translation: If there are any questions, please raise them with the staff before the meeting ends.

sentences.chinese: 这位老人的笑容如春天的阳光一样温暖。
sentences.traditional: 這位老人的笑容如春天的陽光一樣溫暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén de xiàoróng rú chūntiān de yángguāng yíyàng wēnnuǎn.
sentences.translation: The old person's smile is as warm as spring sunshine.

sentences.chinese: 如双方无法达成一致，合同将暂时不签。
sentences.traditional: 如雙方無法達成一致，合同將暫時不簽。
sentences.pinyin: Rú shuāngfāng wúfǎ dáchéng yízhì, hétong jiāng zànshí bù qiān.
sentences.translation: If the two sides cannot reach agreement, the contract will not be signed for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题如此复杂，不能只靠一次讨论解决。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題如此複雜，不能只靠一次討論解決。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí rúcǐ fùzá, bù néng zhǐ kào yí cì tǎolùn jiějué.
sentences.translation: This problem is so complicated that it cannot be solved through just one discussion.

sentences.chinese: 他居然能在如此短的时间内完成报告，真了不起。
sentences.traditional: 他居然能在如此短的時間內完成報告，真了不起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jūrán néng zài rúcǐ duǎn de shíjiān nèi wánchéng bàogào, zhēn liǎobuqǐ.
sentences.translation: He unexpectedly managed to finish the report in such a short time; that is really amazing.

sentences.chinese: 面对如此激烈的竞争，公司必须进一步提高品质。
sentences.traditional: 面對如此激烈的競爭，公司必須進一步提高品質。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì rúcǐ jīliè de jìngzhēng, gōngsī bìxū jìnyíbù tígāo pǐnzhì.
sentences.translation: Facing such intense competition, the company must further improve quality.

sentences.chinese: 我们还需要讨论如何降低成本、提高利润。
sentences.traditional: 我們還需要討論如何降低成本、提高利潤。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen hái xūyào tǎolùn rúhé jiàngdī chéngběn, tígāo lìrùn.
sentences.translation: We still need to discuss how to reduce costs and increase profit.

sentences.chinese: 面试官问她如何处理客户投诉。
sentences.traditional: 面試官問她如何處理客戶投訴。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshìguān wèn tā rúhé chǔlǐ kèhù tóusù.
sentences.translation: The interviewer asked her how she would handle customer complaints.

sentences.chinese: 这篇论文分析了社交媒体如何影响年轻人的情绪。
sentences.traditional: 這篇論文分析了社交媒體如何影響年輕人的情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān lùnwén fēnxī le shèjiāo méitǐ rúhé yǐngxiǎng niánqīng rén de qíngxù.
sentences.translation: This paper analyses how social media affects young people's emotions.

sentences.chinese: 如今，越来越多的企业重视环保和回收。
sentences.traditional: 如今，越來越多的企業重視環保和回收。
sentences.pinyin: Rújīn, yuè lái yuè duō de qǐyè zhòngshì huánbǎo hé huíshōu.
sentences.translation: Nowadays, more and more companies value environmental protection and recycling.

sentences.chinese: 如今人们通过手机就能办理很多业务。
sentences.traditional: 如今人們通過手機就能辦理很多業務。
sentences.pinyin: Rújīn rénmen tōngguò shǒujī jiù néng bànlǐ hěn duō yèwù.
sentences.translation: Nowadays people can handle many services through their phones.

sentences.chinese: 那座古老的工厂如今已经改造成了艺术中心。
sentences.traditional: 那座古老的工廠如今已經改造成了藝術中心。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zuò gǔlǎo de gōngchǎng rújīn yǐjīng gǎizào chéng le yìshù zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: That old factory has now been transformed into an arts centre.

sentences.chinese: 夜晚的湖面平静如同一面镜子。
sentences.traditional: 夜晚的湖面平靜如同一面鏡子。
sentences.pinyin: Yèwǎn de húmiàn píngjìng rútóng yí miàn jìngzi.
sentences.translation: At night the surface of the lake is as calm as a mirror.

sentences.chinese: 这段记忆如同一首老歌，过了多年仍然清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這段記憶如同一首老歌，過了多年仍然清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn jìyì rútóng yì shǒu lǎo gē, guò le duō nián réngrán qīngchu.
sentences.translation: This memory is like an old song; it is still clear after many years.

sentences.chinese: 在困难时期，朋友的支持如同一股力量。
sentences.traditional: 在困難時期，朋友的支持如同一股力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zài kùnnan shíqī, péngyou de zhīchí rútóng yì gǔ lìliàng.
sentences.translation: In difficult times, the support of friends is like a source of strength.

sentences.chinese: 本季度的工作重点如下：提高效率、控制成本、改善服务。
sentences.traditional: 本季度的工作重點如下：提高效率、控制成本、改善服務。
sentences.pinyin: Běn jìdù de gōngzuò zhòngdiǎn rúxià: tígāo xiàolǜ, kòngzhì chéngběn, gǎishàn fúwù.
sentences.translation: The key tasks for this quarter are as follows: improving efficiency, controlling costs, and improving service.

sentences.chinese: 申请材料如下，请在周五前全部提交。
sentences.traditional: 申請材料如下，請在週五前全部提交。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng cáiliào rúxià, qǐng zài zhōu wǔ qián quánbù tíjiāo.
sentences.translation: The application materials are as follows; please submit all of them before Friday.

sentences.chinese: 调查结论如下：多数居民支持扩大公共交通服务。
sentences.traditional: 調查結論如下：多數居民支持擴大公共交通服務。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jiélùn rúxià: duōshù jūmín zhīchí kuòdà gōnggòng jiāotōng fúwù.
sentences.translation: The conclusion of the survey is as follows: most residents support expanding public transport services.

sentences.chinese: 这张床太软，我睡了一晚反而腰疼。
sentences.traditional: 這張床太軟，我睡了一晚反而腰疼。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng chuáng tài ruǎn, wǒ shuì le yì wǎn fǎn'ér yāo téng.
sentences.translation: This bed is too soft; after sleeping on it for one night my back hurt instead.

sentences.chinese: 他语气很软，但态度并没有改变。
sentences.traditional: 他語氣很軟，但態度並沒有改變。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǔqì hěn ruǎn, dàn tàidù bìng méiyǒu gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: His tone was gentle, but his attitude did not change.

sentences.chinese: 这种材料既轻又软，适合做儿童用品。
sentences.traditional: 這種材料既輕又軟，適合做兒童用品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào jì qīng yòu ruǎn, shìhé zuò értóng yòngpǐn.
sentences.translation: This material is both light and soft, so it is suitable for making children's products.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件可以自动记录客户信息。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件可以自動記錄客戶信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ zìdòng jìlù kèhù xìnxī.
sentences.translation: This software can automatically record customer information.

sentences.chinese: 安装新软件前，最好先确认它是否可靠。
sentences.traditional: 安裝新軟件前，最好先確認它是否可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Ānzhuāng xīn ruǎnjiàn qián, zuìhǎo xiān quèrèn tā shìfǒu kěkào.
sentences.translation: Before installing new software, it is best to confirm whether it is reliable.

sentences.chinese: 学校开发的软件平台方便学生提交作业。
sentences.traditional: 學校開發的軟件平臺方便學生提交作業。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào kāifā de ruǎnjiàn píngtái fāngbiàn xuéshēng tíjiāo zuòyè.
sentences.translation: The software platform developed by the school makes it convenient for students to submit homework.

sentences.chinese: 这支队伍防守比较弱，所以需要加强训练。
sentences.traditional: 這支隊伍防守比較弱，所以需要加強訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī duìwu fángshǒu bǐjiào ruò, suǒyǐ xūyào jiāqiáng xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: This team's defence is relatively weak, so it needs to strengthen training.

sentences.chinese: 如果信号太弱，视频会议就容易中断。
sentences.traditional: 如果信號太弱，視頻會議就容易中斷。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xìnhào tài ruò, shìpín huìyì jiù róngyì zhōngduàn.
sentences.translation: If the signal is too weak, the video meeting can easily be interrupted.

sentences.chinese: 老人身体较弱，冬天要特别注意保暖。
sentences.traditional: 老人身體較弱，冬天要特別注意保暖。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shēntǐ jiào ruò, dōngtiān yào tèbié zhùyì bǎonuǎn.
sentences.translation: Older people with relatively weak health should pay special attention to keeping warm in winter.

sentences.chinese: 清洁工把水洒在地上，是为了减少灰尘。
sentences.traditional: 清潔工把水灑在地上，是為了減少灰塵。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngjié gōng bǎ shuǐ sǎ zài dìshang, shì wèile jiǎnshǎo huīchén.
sentences.translation: The cleaner sprinkled water on the ground in order to reduce dust.

sentences.chinese: 厨师在汤上洒了一点儿香菜，味道立刻丰富了。
sentences.traditional: 廚師在湯上灑了一點兒香菜，味道立刻豐富了。
sentences.pinyin: Chúshī zài tāng shang sǎ le yìdiǎnr xiāngcài, wèidào lìkè fēngfù le.
sentences.translation: The chef sprinkled a little coriander on the soup, and the flavour immediately became richer.

sentences.chinese: 不要把饮料洒到键盘上，否则电脑可能会坏。
sentences.traditional: 不要把飲料灑到鍵盤上，否則電腦可能會壞。
sentences.pinyin: Búyào bǎ yǐnliào sǎ dào jiànpán shang, fǒuzé diànnǎo kěnéng huì huài.
sentences.translation: Do not spill the drink onto the keyboard, otherwise the computer may break.

sentences.chinese: 决赛当天，赛场外聚集了大量兴奋的观众。
sentences.traditional: 決賽當天，賽場外聚集了大量興奮的觀眾。
sentences.pinyin: Juésài dāngtiān, sàichǎng wài jùjí le dàliàng xīngfèn de guānzhòng.
sentences.translation: On the day of the final, a large number of excited spectators gathered outside the arena.

sentences.chinese: 选手一进入赛场，情绪就立刻紧张起来。
sentences.traditional: 選手一進入賽場，情緒就立刻緊張起來。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnshǒu yì jìnrù sàichǎng, qíngxù jiù lìkè jǐnzhāng qǐlái.
sentences.translation: As soon as the competitor entered the venue, they immediately became nervous.

sentences.chinese: 这座新建的赛场可以同时容纳三万名观众。
sentences.traditional: 這座新建的賽場可以同時容納三萬名觀眾。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò xīnjiàn de sàichǎng kěyǐ tóngshí róngnà sān wàn míng guānzhòng.
sentences.translation: This newly built arena can hold thirty thousand spectators at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 这幅国画的色彩虽然不鲜艳，却很有层次。
sentences.traditional: 這幅國畫的色彩雖然不鮮豔，卻很有層次。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú guóhuà de sècǎi suīrán bù xiānyàn, què hěn yǒu céngcì.
sentences.translation: Although the colours in this traditional Chinese painting are not bright, they have a lot of depth.

sentences.chinese: 导演通过冷暖色彩的变化表现人物情绪。
sentences.traditional: 導演通過冷暖色彩的變化表現人物情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn tōngguò lěng nuǎn sècǎi de biànhuà biǎoxiàn rénwù qíngxù.
sentences.translation: The director shows the character's emotions through changes in warm and cool colours.

sentences.chinese: 广告的色彩设计会直接影响客户的第一印象。
sentences.traditional: 廣告的色彩設計會直接影響客戶的第一印象。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnggào de sècǎi shèjì huì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng kèhù de dì yī yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: The colour design of an advert directly affects a customer's first impression.

sentences.chinese: 在沙漠地区，水资源的管理尤其重要。
sentences.traditional: 在沙漠地區，水資源的管理尤其重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shāmò dìqū, shuǐ zīyuán de guǎnlǐ yóuqí zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In desert regions, the management of water resources is especially important.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片介绍了沙漠中动植物的生存方式。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片介紹了沙漠中動植物的生存方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jièshào le shāmò zhōng dòngzhíwù de shēngcún fāngshì.
sentences.translation: This documentary introduces how plants and animals survive in the desert.

sentences.chinese: 如果不控制过度放牧，草原可能逐渐变成沙漠。
sentences.traditional: 如果不控制過度放牧，草原可能逐漸變成沙漠。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù kòngzhì guòdù fàngmù, cǎoyuán kěnéng zhújiàn biàn chéng shāmò.
sentences.translation: If excessive grazing is not controlled, grassland may gradually turn into desert.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们用湿沙子在海边堆了一座小城堡。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們用濕沙子在海邊堆了一座小城堡。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yòng shī shāzi zài hǎibiān duī le yí zuò xiǎo chéngbǎo.
sentences.translation: The children used wet sand to build a small castle by the sea.

sentences.chinese: 大风把沙子吹进了眼睛，他只好停下来休息。
sentences.traditional: 大風把沙子吹進了眼睛，他只好停下來休息。
sentences.pinyin: Dàfēng bǎ shāzi chuī jìn le yǎnjing, tā zhǐhǎo tíng xiàlái xiūxi.
sentences.translation: The strong wind blew sand into his eyes, so he had to stop and rest.

sentences.chinese: 这种沙子颗粒很细，适合用于建筑材料加工。
sentences.traditional: 這種沙子顆粒很細，適合用於建築材料加工。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shāzi kēlì hěn xì, shìhé yòng yú jiànzhù cáiliào jiāgōng.
sentences.translation: The grains of this sand are very fine, making it suitable for processing building materials.

sentences.chinese: 别傻了，签合同前一定要仔细看清楚条款。
sentences.traditional: 別傻了，簽合同前一定要仔細看清楚條款。
sentences.pinyin: Bié shǎ le, qiān hétong qián yídìng yào zǐxì kàn qīngchu tiáokuǎn.
sentences.translation: Do not be silly; before signing a contract, you must read the terms carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他明明已经知道真相，却还装傻不回答。
sentences.traditional: 他明明已經知道真相，卻還裝傻不回答。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míngmíng yǐjīng zhīdào zhēnxiàng, què hái zhuāng shǎ bù huídá.
sentences.translation: He clearly already knew the truth, but still pretended to be foolish and did not answer.

sentences.chinese: 这种决定看起来有点傻，实际上是经过计算的。
sentences.traditional: 這種決定看起來有點傻，實際上是經過計算的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng juédìng kàn qǐlái yǒudiǎn shǎ, shíjì shang shì jīngguò jìsuàn de.
sentences.translation: This decision looks a bit foolish, but in fact it was calculated.

sentences.chinese: 天气终于放晴了，邻居把被子拿到阳台上晒。
sentences.traditional: 天氣終於放晴了，鄰居把被子拿到陽臺上曬。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì zhōngyú fàngqíng le, línjū bǎ bèizi ná dào yángtái shang shài.
sentences.translation: The weather finally cleared up, so the neighbour took the quilt to the balcony to air in the sun.

sentences.chinese: 长时间在海边晒太阳，皮肤容易过敏或受伤。
sentences.traditional: 長時間在海邊曬太陽，皮膚容易過敏或受傷。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān zài hǎibiān shài tàiyáng, pífū róngyì guòmǐn huò shòushāng.
sentences.translation: If you sunbathe by the sea for a long time, your skin can easily become irritated or injured.

sentences.chinese: 这些照片不能直接晒在强烈的阳光下，否则颜色会变淡。
sentences.traditional: 這些照片不能直接曬在強烈的陽光下，否則顏色會變淡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn bù néng zhíjiē shài zài qiángliè de yángguāng xià, fǒuzé yánsè huì biàn dàn.
sentences.translation: These photos cannot be exposed directly to strong sunlight, otherwise the colours will fade.

sentences.chinese: 这段话与主题无关，编辑建议把它删掉。
sentences.traditional: 這段話與主題無關，編輯建議把它刪掉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn huà yǔ zhǔtí wúguān, biānjí jiànyì bǎ tā shān diào.
sentences.translation: This paragraph is unrelated to the topic, so the editor suggested deleting it.

sentences.chinese: 文件发出去以前，请先删去里面的私人信息。
sentences.traditional: 文件發出去以前，請先刪去裡面的私人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Wénjiàn fā chūqu yǐqián, qǐng xiān shān qù lǐmiàn de sīrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Before sending out the document, please first delete the private information in it.

sentences.chinese: 他不小心把录音删了，只能重新采访嘉宾。
sentences.traditional: 他不小心把錄音刪了，只能重新採訪嘉賓。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bǎ lùyīn shān le, zhǐ néng chóngxīn cǎifǎng jiābīn.
sentences.translation: He accidentally deleted the recording, so he could only interview the guest again.

sentences.chinese: 老人坐在树下，一边聊天一边用扇子扇风。
sentences.traditional: 老人坐在樹下，一邊聊天一邊用扇子扇風。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén zuò zài shù xià, yìbiān liáotiān yìbiān yòng shànzi shān fēng.
sentences.translation: The old person sat under the tree, chatting while fanning themself with a fan.

sentences.chinese: 火刚点起来时，他轻轻地扇了几下，让火更旺。
sentences.traditional: 火剛點起來時，他輕輕地扇了幾下，讓火更旺。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒ gāng diǎn qǐlái shí, tā qīngqīng de shān le jǐ xià, ràng huǒ gèng wàng.
sentences.translation: When the fire had just been lit, he gently fanned it a few times to make it burn more strongly.

sentences.chinese: 天气太热，护士不停地给病人扇风。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太熱，護士不停地給病人扇風。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè, hùshi bùtíng de gěi bìngrén shān fēng.
sentences.translation: The weather was too hot, so the nurse kept fanning the patient.

sentences.chinese: 系统会在三十天后自动删除过期文件。
sentences.traditional: 系統會在三十天後自動刪除過期文件。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zài sānshí tiān hòu zìdòng shānchú guòqī wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: The system will automatically delete expired files after thirty days.

sentences.chinese: 如果发现错误记录，请不要私自删除，先通知负责人。
sentences.traditional: 如果發現錯誤記錄，請不要私自刪除，先通知負責人。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāxiàn cuòwù jìlù, qǐng búyào sīzì shānchú, xiān tōngzhī fùzérén.
sentences.translation: If you find an incorrect record, please do not delete it privately; notify the person in charge first.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护隐私，公司决定删除客户的旧数据。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護隱私，公司決定刪除客戶的舊數據。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù yǐnsī, gōngsī juédìng shānchú kèhù de jiù shùjù.
sentences.translation: To protect privacy, the company decided to delete the customers' old data.

sentences.chinese: 这个山区交通不方便，因此当地政府正在建设新的公路。
sentences.traditional: 這個山區交通不方便，因此當地政府正在建設新的公路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shānqū jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn, yīncǐ dāngdì zhèngfǔ zhèngzài jiànshè xīn de gōnglù.
sentences.translation: This mountain area has inconvenient transport, so the local government is building new roads.

sentences.chinese: 由于山区降水充足，那里适合发展茶叶产业。
sentences.traditional: 由於山區降水充足，那裡適合發展茶葉產業。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shānqū jiàngshuǐ chōngzú, nàli shìhé fāzhǎn cháyè chǎnyè.
sentences.translation: Because the mountain area has abundant precipitation, it is suitable for developing the tea industry.

sentences.chinese: 支教老师在山区小学工作了三年，帮助很多孩子走出大山。
sentences.traditional: 支教老師在山區小學工作了三年，幫助很多孩子走出大山。
sentences.pinyin: Zhījiào lǎoshī zài shānqū xiǎoxué gōngzuò le sān nián, bāngzhù hěn duō háizi zǒu chū dàshān.
sentences.translation: The volunteer teacher worked for three years at a primary school in the mountain area, helping many children leave the mountains.

sentences.chinese: 他不但擅长数据分析，还能把复杂结论讲得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 他不但擅長數據分析，還能把複雜結論講得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búdàn shàncháng shùjù fēnxī, hái néng bǎ fùzá jiélùn jiǎng de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: He is not only good at data analysis, but can also explain complex conclusions clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司擅长把传统工艺和现代设计结合起来。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司擅長把傳統工藝和現代設計結合起來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shàncháng bǎ chuántǒng gōngyì hé xiàndài shèjì jiéhé qǐlái.
sentences.translation: This company is skilled at combining traditional craftsmanship with modern design.

sentences.chinese: 如果你擅长沟通，做客户服务会更有优势。
sentences.traditional: 如果你擅長溝通，做客戶服務會更有優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ shàncháng gōutōng, zuò kèhù fúwù huì gèng yǒu yōushì.
sentences.translation: If you are good at communication, you will have an advantage in customer service.

sentences.chinese: 真正善良的人不会为了表现自己而帮助别人。
sentences.traditional: 真正善良的人不會為了表現自己而幫助別人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng shànliáng de rén bú huì wèile biǎoxiàn zìjǐ ér bāngzhù biérén.
sentences.translation: Truly kind people do not help others just to show themselves off.

sentences.chinese: 尽管他经历过很多困难，内心仍然非常善良。
sentences.traditional: 儘管他經歷過很多困難，內心仍然非常善良。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jīnglì guò hěn duō kùnnan, nèixīn réngrán fēicháng shànliáng.
sentences.translation: Although he has experienced many difficulties, his heart is still very kind.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影通过一个善良的角色表现了人性的光明面。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影通過一個善良的角色表現了人性的光明面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng tōngguò yí ge shànliáng de juésè biǎoxiàn le rénxìng de guāngmíng miàn.
sentences.translation: This film shows the bright side of human nature through a kind character.

sentences.chinese: 他善于观察细节，所以总能发现别人忽视的问题。
sentences.traditional: 他善於觀察細節，所以總能發現別人忽視的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shànyú guānchá xìjié, suǒyǐ zǒng néng fāxiàn biérén hūshì de wèntí.
sentences.translation: He is good at observing details, so he can always find problems others overlook.

sentences.chinese: 一个好的领导应该善于听取不同的观点。
sentences.traditional: 一個好的領導應該善於聽取不同的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge hǎo de lǐngdǎo yīnggāi shànyú tīngqǔ bùtóng de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: A good leader should be good at listening to different viewpoints.

sentences.chinese: 这名记者善于把普通人的故事写得有力量。
sentences.traditional: 這名記者善於把普通人的故事寫得有力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè míng jìzhě shànyú bǎ pǔtōng rén de gùshi xiě de yǒu lìliàng.
sentences.translation: This journalist is good at writing ordinary people's stories with power.

sentences.chinese: 她把那把旧扇子当作姥姥留下的纪念品。
sentences.traditional: 她把那把舊扇子當作姥姥留下的紀念品。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà bǎ jiù shànzi dàngzuò lǎolao liú xià de jìniànpǐn.
sentences.translation: She regarded that old fan as a keepsake left by her grandmother.

sentences.chinese: 天气闷热时，老人喜欢拿着扇子在院子里乘凉。
sentences.traditional: 天氣悶熱時，老人喜歡拿著扇子在院子裡乘涼。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì mēnrè shí, lǎorén xǐhuan názhe shànzi zài yuànzi lǐ chéngliáng.
sentences.translation: When the weather is muggy, older people like to hold fans and enjoy the cool air in the courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 这把扇子上画着一幅精致的国画。
sentences.traditional: 這把扇子上畫著一幅精緻的國畫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ shànzi shang huàzhe yì fú jīngzhì de guóhuà.
sentences.translation: This fan has an exquisite traditional Chinese painting on it.

sentences.chinese: 运动员的腿受了伤，但他仍然坚持完成比赛。
sentences.traditional: 運動員的腿受了傷，但他仍然堅持完成比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán de tuǐ shòu le shāng, dàn tā réngrán jiānchí wánchéng bǐsài.
sentences.translation: The athlete injured his leg, but still insisted on finishing the race.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败没有伤他的信心，反而让他更加努力。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗沒有傷他的信心，反而讓他更加努力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài méiyǒu shāng tā de xìnxīn, fǎn'ér ràng tā gèngjiā nǔlì.
sentences.translation: This failure did not damage his confidence; instead it made him work harder.

sentences.chinese: 医生说这只是轻伤，不会影响正常生活。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說這只是輕傷，不會影響正常生活。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè zhǐ shì qīngshāng, bú huì yǐngxiǎng zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: The doctor said this was only a minor injury and would not affect normal life.

sentences.chinese: 过分的批评可能会伤害孩子的自信心。
sentences.traditional: 過分的批評可能會傷害孩子的自信心。
sentences.pinyin: Guòfèn de pīpíng kěnéng huì shānghài háizi de zìxìnxīn.
sentences.translation: Excessive criticism may harm a child's self-confidence.

sentences.chinese: 如果只追求利润，企业可能会伤害客户的利益。
sentences.traditional: 如果只追求利潤，企業可能會傷害客戶的利益。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhuīqiú lìrùn, qǐyè kěnéng huì shānghài kèhù de lìyì.
sentences.translation: If it only pursues profit, a company may harm customers' interests.

sentences.chinese: 他说话太直接，有时会无意中伤害别人。
sentences.traditional: 他說話太直接，有時會無意中傷害別人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà tài zhíjiē, yǒushí huì wúyì zhōng shānghài biérén.
sentences.translation: He speaks too directly and sometimes unintentionally hurts others.

sentences.chinese: 一些商家为了吸引顾客，推出了限时优惠。
sentences.traditional: 一些商家為了吸引顧客，推出了限時優惠。
sentences.pinyin: Yìxiē shāngjiā wèile xīyǐn gùkè, tuīchū le xiànshí yōuhuì.
sentences.translation: Some businesses launched time-limited discounts to attract customers.

sentences.chinese: 平台要求商家在配送前确认货物的质量。
sentences.traditional: 平臺要求商家在配送前確認貨物的質量。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái yāoqiú shāngjiā zài pèisòng qián quèrèn huòwù de zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The platform requires merchants to confirm the quality of the goods before delivery.

sentences.chinese: 如果商家存在欺骗行为，消费者可以依法投诉。
sentences.traditional: 如果商家存在欺騙行為，消費者可以依法投訴。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shāngjiā cúnzài qīpiàn xíngwéi, xiāofèizhě kěyǐ yīfǎ tóusù.
sentences.translation: If a merchant engages in deceptive behaviour, consumers can make a legal complaint.

sentences.chinese: 一个成功的商人不仅要重视利润，也要重视信誉。
sentences.traditional: 一個成功的商人不僅要重視利潤，也要重視信譽。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge chénggōng de shāngrén bùjǐn yào zhòngshì lìrùn, yě yào zhòngshì xìnyù.
sentences.translation: A successful businessperson must value not only profit, but also reputation.

sentences.chinese: 这位商人年轻时在海外生活过，所以很了解国际市场。
sentences.traditional: 這位商人年輕時在海外生活過，所以很了解國際市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shāngrén niánqīng shí zài hǎiwài shēnghuó guò, suǒyǐ hěn liǎojiě guójì shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: This businessman lived overseas when he was young, so he understands international markets well.

sentences.chinese: 古代商人通过丝绸之路把货物带到不同地区。
sentences.traditional: 古代商人通過絲綢之路把貨物帶到不同地區。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔdài shāngrén tōngguò Sīchóu Zhī Lù bǎ huòwù dài dào bùtóng dìqū.
sentences.translation: In ancient times, merchants carried goods to different regions via the Silk Road.

sentences.chinese: 他这次去上海，主要是参加一个商务会议。
sentences.traditional: 他這次去上海，主要是參加一個商務會議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhè cì qù Shànghǎi, zhǔyào shì cānjiā yí ge shāngwù huìyì.
sentences.translation: This time he is going to Shanghai mainly to attend a business meeting.

sentences.chinese: 公司安排她负责与海外客户的商务联系。
sentences.traditional: 公司安排她負責與海外客戶的商務聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī ānpái tā fùzé yǔ hǎiwài kèhù de shāngwù liánxì.
sentences.translation: The company arranged for her to handle business communication with overseas clients.

sentences.chinese: 在正式的商务场合，穿着和讲话都要更加谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 在正式的商務場合，穿著和講話都要更加謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì de shāngwù chǎnghé, chuānzhuó hé jiǎnghuà dōu yào gèngjiā jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: In formal business settings, both dress and speech need to be more careful.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区的商业发展很快，吸引了大量客户和投资。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區的商業發展很快，吸引了大量客戶和投資。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de shāngyè fāzhǎn hěn kuài, xīyǐn le dàliàng kèhù hé tóuzī.
sentences.translation: Commercial development in this region is very fast, attracting many clients and investments.

sentences.chinese: 线上平台改变了传统商业模式。
sentences.traditional: 線上平臺改變了傳統商業模式。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànshàng píngtái gǎibiàn le chuántǒng shāngyè móshì.
sentences.translation: Online platforms have changed traditional business models.

sentences.chinese: 他研究商业管理，希望以后自己开公司。
sentences.traditional: 他研究商業管理，希望以後自己開公司。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yánjiū shāngyè guǎnlǐ, xīwàng yǐhòu zìjǐ kāi gōngsī.
sentences.translation: He studies business management and hopes to start his own company in the future.

sentences.chinese: 春天来临时，很多游客前往公园赏花。
sentences.traditional: 春天來臨時，很多遊客前往公園賞花。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān láilín shí, hěn duō yóukè qiánwǎng gōngyuán shǎng huā.
