sentences.translation: When spring arrives, many tourists go to the park to appreciate the flowers.

sentences.chinese: 这幅国画色彩柔和，值得慢慢欣赏。
sentences.traditional: 這幅國畫色彩柔和，值得慢慢欣賞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú guóhuà sècǎi róuhé, zhídé mànman xīnshǎng.
sentences.translation: This traditional Chinese painting has soft colours and is worth appreciating slowly.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定奖赏那些在项目中作出突出贡献的员工。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定獎賞那些在項目中作出突出貢獻的員工。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng jiǎngshǎng nàxiē zài xiàngmù zhōng zuòchū túchū gòngxiàn de yuángōng.
sentences.translation: The company decided to reward the employees who made outstanding contributions to the project.

sentences.chinese: 请把签名后的合同扫描后上传到系统。
sentences.traditional: 請把簽名後的合同掃描後上傳到系統。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ qiānmíng hòu de hétóng sǎomiáo hòu shàngchuán dào xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: Please scan the signed contract and upload it to the system.

sentences.chinese: 文件太大，上传过程可能需要几分钟。
sentences.traditional: 文件太大，上傳過程可能需要幾分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Wénjiàn tài dà, shàngchuán guòchéng kěnéng xūyào jǐ fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: The file is too large, so the upload process may take a few minutes.

sentences.chinese: 上传资料前，最好确认名称和格式都正确。
sentences.traditional: 上傳資料前，最好確認名稱和格式都正確。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngchuán zīliào qián, zuì hǎo quèrèn míngchēng hé géshì dōu zhèngquè.
sentences.translation: Before uploading the materials, it is best to confirm that the name and format are both correct.

sentences.chinese: 近期原材料价格持续上升，利润受到明显影响。
sentences.traditional: 近期原材料價格持續上升，利潤受到明顯影響。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnqī yuáncáiliào jiàgé chíxù shàngshēng, lìrùn shòu dào míngxiǎn yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Recently, raw material prices have continued to rise, and profits have been clearly affected.

sentences.chinese: 随着培训开展，员工的技能水平逐渐上升。
sentences.traditional: 隨著培訓開展，員工的技能水平逐漸上升。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe péixùn kāizhǎn, yuángōng de jìnéng shuǐpíng zhújiàn shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: As the training is carried out, employees’ skill levels gradually rise.

sentences.chinese: 河水突然上升，附近居民被要求尽快离开。
sentences.traditional: 河水突然上升，附近居民被要求盡快離開。
sentences.pinyin: Héshuǐ tūrán shàngshēng, fùjìn jūmín bèi yāoqiú jǐnkuài líkāi.
sentences.translation: The river water suddenly rose, and nearby residents were told to leave as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这座建筑上下共有二十层，内部结构很复杂。
sentences.traditional: 這座建築上下共有二十層，內部結構很複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò jiànzhù shàngxià gòng yǒu èrshí céng, nèibù jiégòu hěn fùzá.
sentences.translation: This building has twenty floors from top to bottom, and its internal structure is complicated.

sentences.chinese: 忙碌了一天后，他上下楼梯都觉得腿酸。
sentences.traditional: 忙碌了一天後，他上下樓梯都覺得腿酸。
sentences.pinyin: Mánglù le yì tiān hòu, tā shàngxià lóutī dōu juéde tuǐ suān.
sentences.translation: After a busy day, even going up and down the stairs made his legs ache.

sentences.chinese: 公司上下都在为这次开幕式做准备。
sentences.traditional: 公司上下都在為這次開幕式做準備。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī shàngxià dōu zài wèi zhè cì kāimùshì zuò zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: Everyone in the company, from top to bottom, is preparing for this opening ceremony.

sentences.chinese: 由于需求增加，黄金价格又上涨了。
sentences.traditional: 由於需求增加，黃金價格又上漲了。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú xūqiú zēngjiā, huángjīn jiàgé yòu shàngzhǎng le.
sentences.translation: Because demand has increased, the price of gold has risen again.

sentences.chinese: 如果房租继续上涨，很多年轻人会感到压力更大。
sentences.traditional: 如果房租繼續上漲，很多年輕人會感到壓力更大。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fángzū jìxù shàngzhǎng, hěn duō niánqīng rén huì gǎndào yālì gèng dà.
sentences.translation: If rent continues to rise, many young people will feel greater pressure.

sentences.chinese: 数据显示，本季度销售额比去年同期上涨了百分之十。
sentences.traditional: 數據顯示，本季度銷售額比去年同期上漲了百分之十。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù xiǎnshì, běn jìdù xiāoshòu'é bǐ qùnián tóngqī shàngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī shí.
sentences.translation: The data shows that this quarter’s sales rose by ten percent compared with the same period last year.

sentences.chinese: 别把锅烧得太热，不然黄瓜一下锅就会变软。
sentences.traditional: 別把鍋燒得太熱，不然黃瓜一下鍋就會變軟。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ guō shāo de tài rè, bùrán huángguā yí xià guō jiù huì biàn ruǎn.
sentences.translation: Do not heat the pot too much, otherwise the cucumber will soften as soon as it goes in.

sentences.chinese: 这场火烧坏了仓库里的部分货物。
sentences.traditional: 這場火燒壞了倉庫裡的部分貨物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng huǒ shāo huài le cāngkù li de bùfen huòwù.
sentences.translation: This fire burned and damaged some of the goods in the warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 她发烧以后，急忙去了门诊检查。
sentences.traditional: 她發燒以後，急忙去了門診檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāshāo yǐhòu, jímáng qù le ménzhěn jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: After she developed a fever, she hurried to the outpatient clinic for an examination.

sentences.chinese: 周末我们在户外吃烧烤，顺便讨论旅行计划。
sentences.traditional: 週末我們在戶外吃燒烤，順便討論旅行計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen zài hùwài chī shāokǎo, shùnbiàn tǎolùn lǚxíng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: At the weekend we ate barbecue outdoors and discussed the travel plan at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 这家烧烤店开业不久，就得到很多好评。
sentences.traditional: 這家燒烤店開業不久，就得到很多好評。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāokǎo diàn kāiyè bù jiǔ, jiù dédào hěn duō hǎopíng.
sentences.translation: This barbecue restaurant received many good reviews soon after opening.

sentences.chinese: 过度依赖烧烤和油炸食品，对健康不太合理。
sentences.traditional: 過度依賴燒烤和油炸食品，對健康不太合理。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù yīlài shāokǎo hé yóuzhá shípǐn, duì jiànkāng bú tài hélǐ.
sentences.translation: Relying too much on barbecue and fried food is not very sensible for health.

sentences.chinese: 山区里偶然出现了一条蛇，工作人员提醒游客不要靠近。
sentences.traditional: 山區裡偶然出現了一條蛇，工作人員提醒遊客不要靠近。
sentences.pinyin: Shānqū li ǒurán chūxiàn le yì tiáo shé, gōngzuò rényuán tíxǐng yóukè bú yào kàojìn.
sentences.translation: A snake happened to appear in the mountain area, and staff reminded tourists not to get close.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片详细介绍了蛇的生活习性。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片詳細介紹了蛇的生活習性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn xiángxì jièshào le shé de shēnghuó xíxìng.
sentences.translation: This documentary gives a detailed introduction to snakes’ living habits.

sentences.chinese: 孩子虽然好奇，但看到蛇时还是有点害怕。
sentences.traditional: 孩子雖然好奇，但看到蛇時還是有點害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi suīrán hàoqí, dàn kàn dào shé shí háishi yǒudiǎn hàipà.
sentences.translation: Although the child was curious, he was still a little afraid when he saw the snake.

sentences.chinese: 她在故乡住了很多年，离开时实在舍不得。
sentences.traditional: 她在故鄉住了很多年，離開時實在捨不得。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài gùxiāng zhù le hěn duō nián, líkāi shí shízài shěbude.
sentences.translation: She had lived in her hometown for many years, so when she left she really hated to part with it.

sentences.chinese: 这件旧衣服陪伴了他很久，他舍不得扔掉。
sentences.traditional: 這件舊衣服陪伴了他很久，他捨不得扔掉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn jiù yīfu péibàn le tā hěn jiǔ, tā shěbude rēngdiào.
sentences.translation: This old piece of clothing had accompanied him for a long time, so he was reluctant to throw it away.

sentences.chinese: 虽然机会难得，他还是舍不得放弃现在的团队。
sentences.traditional: 雖然機會難得，他還是捨不得放棄現在的團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán jīhuì nándé, tā háishi shěbude fàngqì xiànzài de tuánduì.
sentences.translation: Although the opportunity was rare, he was still reluctant to give up his current team.

sentences.chinese: 这篇报告不只列出数据，还分析了问题的深度。
sentences.traditional: 這篇報告不只列出數據，還分析了問題的深度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān bàogào bù zhǐ lièchū shùjù, hái fēnxī le wèntí de shēndù.
sentences.translation: This report not only lists data, but also analyses the depth of the problem.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有足够的深度，这次讨论很难产生实际效果。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有足夠的深度，這次討論很難產生實際效果。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu zúgòu de shēndù, zhè cì tǎolùn hěn nán chǎnshēng shíjì xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: If there is not enough depth, this discussion will find it hard to produce real results.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目需要深度合作，单靠一个部门无法完成。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目需要深度合作，單靠一個部門無法完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào shēndù hézuò, dān kào yí ge bùmén wúfǎ wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This project requires deep cooperation; one department alone cannot complete it.

sentences.chinese: 进入会场前，工作人员会检查每个人的身份。
sentences.traditional: 進入會場前，工作人員會檢查每個人的身份。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù huìchǎng qián, gōngzuò rényuán huì jiǎnchá měi ge rén de shēnfèn.
sentences.translation: Before entering the venue, staff will check everyone’s identity.

sentences.chinese: 无论身份如何，所有申请者都应该受到公平对待。
sentences.traditional: 無論身份如何，所有申請者都應該受到公平對待。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn shēnfèn rúhé, suǒyǒu shēnqǐngzhě dōu yīnggāi shòudào gōngpíng duìdài.
sentences.translation: Whatever their identity or status, all applicants should be treated fairly.

sentences.chinese: 他以志愿者的身份参加了这次社区活动。
sentences.traditional: 他以志願者的身份參加了這次社區活動。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐ zhìyuànzhě de shēnfèn cānjiā le zhè cì shèqū huódòng.
sentences.translation: He took part in this community event in the capacity of a volunteer.

sentences.chinese: 两国之间有深厚的文化联系，交流一直很频繁。
sentences.traditional: 兩國之間有深厚的文化聯繫，交流一直很頻繁。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng guó zhījiān yǒu shēnhòu de wénhuà liánxì, jiāoliú yìzhí hěn pínfán.
sentences.translation: There are deep cultural links between the two countries, and exchanges have always been frequent.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家拥有深厚的历史知识，所以作品特别有说服力。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家擁有深厚的歷史知識，所以作品特別有說服力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā yōngyǒu shēnhòu de lìshǐ zhīshi, suǒyǐ zuòpǐn tèbié yǒu shuōfúlì.
sentences.translation: This writer has profound historical knowledge, so the works are especially convincing.

sentences.chinese: 经过多年合作，他们建立了深厚的信任关系。
sentences.traditional: 經過多年合作，他們建立了深厚的信任關係。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián hézuò, tāmen jiànlì le shēnhòu de xìnrèn guānxì.
sentences.translation: After many years of cooperation, they established a deep relationship of trust.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败给他留下了深刻的教训。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗給他留下了深刻的教訓。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài gěi tā liúxià le shēnkè de jiàoxùn.
sentences.translation: This failure left him with a profound lesson.

sentences.chinese: 老师的批评虽然直接，但内容十分深刻。
sentences.traditional: 老師的批評雖然直接，但內容十分深刻。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de pīpíng suīrán zhíjiē, dàn nèiróng shífēn shēnkè.
sentences.translation: The teacher’s criticism was direct, but its content was very profound.

sentences.chinese: 通过这次调查，我们对市场变化有了更深刻的认识。
sentences.traditional: 通過這次調查，我們對市場變化有了更深刻的認識。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò zhè cì diàochá, wǒmen duì shìchǎng biànhuà yǒu le gèng shēnkè de rènshi.
sentences.translation: Through this investigation, we gained a deeper understanding of market changes.

sentences.chinese: 记者深入农村，采访了许多当地居民。
sentences.traditional: 記者深入農村，採訪了許多當地居民。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě shēnrù nóngcūn, cǎifǎng le xǔduō dāngdì jūmín.
sentences.translation: The reporter went deep into the countryside and interviewed many local residents.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要对事故原因进行深入分析，而不是急着下结论。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要對事故原因進行深入分析，而不是急著下結論。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào duì shìgù yuányīn jìnxíng shēnrù fēnxī, ér bú shì jízhe xià jiélùn.
sentences.translation: We need to conduct an in-depth analysis of the cause of the accident, rather than rush to a conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 随着讨论深入，大家逐渐发现问题比想象中复杂。
sentences.traditional: 隨著討論深入，大家逐漸發現問題比想像中複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe tǎolùn shēnrù, dàjiā zhújiàn fāxiàn wèntí bǐ xiǎngxiàng zhōng fùzá.
sentences.translation: As the discussion deepened, everyone gradually discovered that the problem was more complicated than imagined.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策对城市发展产生了深远影响。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策對城市發展產生了深遠影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè duì chéngshì fāzhǎn chǎnshēng le shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This policy had a far-reaching impact on the city’s development.

sentences.chinese: 教育改革的意义深远，不能只看眼前的成绩。
sentences.traditional: 教育改革的意義深遠，不能只看眼前的成績。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù gǎigé de yìyì shēnyuǎn, bù néng zhǐ kàn yǎnqián de chéngjì.
sentences.translation: The significance of education reform is far-reaching; we cannot look only at immediate results.

sentences.chinese: 一次正确的选择，可能会带来深远的变化。
sentences.traditional: 一次正確的選擇，可能會帶來深遠的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Yí cì zhèngquè de xuǎnzé, kěnéng huì dàilái shēnyuǎn de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: One correct choice may bring far-reaching changes.

sentences.chinese: 很多神话故事反映了古人对自然的想象。
sentences.traditional: 很多神話故事反映了古人對自然的想像。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō shénhuà gùshi fǎnyìng le gǔrén duì zìrán de xiǎngxiàng.
sentences.translation: Many myths reflect ancient people’s imagination about nature.

sentences.chinese: 他从小喜欢读希腊神话，对那些英雄人物很熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 他從小喜歡讀希臘神話，對那些英雄人物很熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xǐhuan dú Xīlà shénhuà, duì nàxiē yīngxióng rénwù hěn shúxī.
sentences.translation: He has liked reading Greek mythology since childhood and is very familiar with those heroes.

sentences.chinese: 不要把成功看成神话，它往往来自长期努力。
sentences.traditional: 不要把成功看成神話，它往往來自長期努力。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào bǎ chénggōng kàn chéng shénhuà, tā wǎngwǎng láizì chángqī nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Do not see success as a myth; it often comes from long-term effort.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城充满神秘色彩，吸引了大量游客。
sentences.traditional: 這座古城充滿神秘色彩，吸引了大量遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng chōngmǎn shénmì sècǎi, xīyǐn le dàliàng yóukè.
sentences.translation: This ancient city is full of mysterious colour and attracts large numbers of tourists.

sentences.chinese: 他突然收到一封神秘的信，却不知道是谁寄来的。
sentences.traditional: 他突然收到一封神秘的信，卻不知道是誰寄來的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán shōudào yì fēng shénmì de xìn, què bù zhīdào shì shéi jì lái de.
sentences.translation: He suddenly received a mysterious letter, but did not know who had sent it.

sentences.chinese: 科学的发展正在逐步揭开宇宙的神秘面纱。
sentences.traditional: 科學的發展正在逐步揭開宇宙的神秘面紗。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué de fāzhǎn zhèngzài zhúbù jiēkāi yǔzhòu de shénmì miànshā.
sentences.translation: The development of science is gradually lifting the mysterious veil of the universe.

sentences.chinese: 太阳慢慢升起来，海面变得越来越亮。
sentences.traditional: 太陽慢慢升起來，海面變得越來越亮。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng mànmàn shēng qǐlái, hǎimiàn biàn de yuè lái yuè liàng.
sentences.translation: The sun slowly rose, and the sea surface became brighter and brighter.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，他被升为部门经理。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，他被升為部門經理。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, tā bèi shēng wéi bùmén jīnglǐ.
sentences.translation: After the meeting, he was promoted to department manager.

sentences.chinese: 气温一下子升了好几度，大家都换上了薄衣服。
sentences.traditional: 氣溫一下子升了好幾度，大家都換上了薄衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Qìwēn yíxiàzi shēng le hǎo jǐ dù, dàjiā dōu huàn shàng le báo yīfu.
sentences.translation: The temperature rose by several degrees at once, and everyone changed into lighter clothes.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂主要生产环保设备，订单一直很稳定。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠主要生產環保設備，訂單一直很穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhǔyào shēngchǎn huánbǎo shèbèi, dìngdān yìzhí hěn wěndìng.
sentences.translation: This factory mainly produces environmental protection equipment, and its orders have been stable.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高效率，公司引进了新的生产技术。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高效率，公司引進了新的生產技術。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, gōngsī yǐnjìn le xīn de shēngchǎn jìshù.
sentences.translation: To improve efficiency, the company introduced new production technology.

sentences.chinese: 如果原材料不能及时到达，生产计划就会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果原材料不能及時到達，生產計劃就會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yuáncáiliào bù néng jíshí dàodá, shēngchǎn jìhuà jiù huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If the raw materials cannot arrive on time, the production plan will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 在极端环境中，任何生物都必须依靠适应能力生存。
sentences.traditional: 在極端環境中，任何生物都必須依靠適應能力生存。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jíduān huánjìng zhōng, rènhé shēngwù dōu bìxū yīkào shìyìng nénglì shēngcún.
sentences.translation: In an extreme environment, any organism must rely on its ability to adapt in order to survive.

sentences.chinese: 如果企业想长期生存，就不能只追求短期利润。
sentences.traditional: 如果企業想長期生存，就不能只追求短期利潤。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qǐyè xiǎng chángqī shēngcún, jiù bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú duǎnqī lìrùn.
sentences.translation: If an enterprise wants to survive long term, it cannot only pursue short-term profit.

sentences.chinese: 这片森林为许多动物提供了生存空间。
sentences.traditional: 這片森林為許多動物提供了生存空間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn sēnlín wèi xǔduō dòngwù tígōng le shēngcún kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: This forest provides living space for many animals to survive.

sentences.chinese: 老师用生动的例子解释了这个复杂的概念。
sentences.traditional: 老師用生動的例子解釋了這個複雜的概念。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng shēngdòng de lìzi jiěshì le zhège fùzá de gàiniàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher used vivid examples to explain this complex concept.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章语言生动，所以读起来一点也不枯燥。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章語言生動，所以讀起來一點也不枯燥。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng yǔyán shēngdòng, suǒyǐ dú qǐlái yìdiǎn yě bù kūzào.
sentences.translation: The language of this article is lively, so it is not at all dull to read.

sentences.chinese: 演员把人物的性格表现得非常生动。
sentences.traditional: 演員把人物的性格表現得非常生動。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnyuán bǎ rénwù de xìnggé biǎoxiàn de fēicháng shēngdòng.
sentences.translation: The actor portrayed the character’s personality very vividly.

sentences.chinese: 系统今晚会自动升级，明天早上就能使用新功能。
sentences.traditional: 系統今晚會自動升級，明天早上就能使用新功能。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng jīnwǎn huì zìdòng shēngjí, míngtiān zǎoshang jiù néng shǐyòng xīn gōngnéng.
sentences.translation: The system will upgrade automatically tonight, and the new functions can be used tomorrow morning.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高服务质量，酒店计划升级所有客房设备。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高服務質量，酒店計劃升級所有客房設備。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo fúwù zhìliàng, jiǔdiàn jìhuà shēngjí suǒyǒu kèfáng shèbèi.
sentences.translation: To improve service quality, the hotel plans to upgrade all guest-room equipment.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件升级以后，运行速度明显提高了。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件升級以後，運行速度明顯提高了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn shēngjí yǐhòu, yùnxíng sùdù míngxiǎn tígāo le.
sentences.translation: After this software was upgraded, its running speed clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 随着气候不断升温，极端天气出现得更频繁了。
sentences.traditional: 隨著氣候不斷升溫，極端天氣出現得更頻繁了。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe qìhòu búduàn shēngwēn, jíduān tiānqì chūxiàn de gèng pínfán le.
sentences.translation: As the climate keeps warming, extreme weather is appearing more frequently.

sentences.chinese: 两家公司合作之后，市场竞争迅速升温。
sentences.traditional: 兩家公司合作之後，市場競爭迅速升溫。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī hézuò zhīhòu, shìchǎng jìngzhēng xùnsù shēngwēn.
sentences.translation: After the two companies cooperated, market competition quickly heated up.

sentences.chinese: 这段时间关系逐渐升温，双方开始讨论更深入的合作。
sentences.traditional: 這段時間關係逐漸升溫，雙方開始討論更深入的合作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn shíjiān guānxì zhújiàn shēngwēn, shuāngfāng kāishǐ tǎolùn gèng shēnrù de hézuò.
sentences.translation: During this period relations gradually warmed, and both sides began discussing deeper cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 海洋里生活着各种生物，其中许多还没有被发现。
sentences.traditional: 海洋裡生活著各種生物，其中許多還沒有被發現。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎiyáng lǐ shēnghuó zhe gèzhǒng shēngwù, qízhōng xǔduō hái méiyǒu bèi fāxiàn.
sentences.translation: Various organisms live in the ocean, many of which have not yet been discovered.

sentences.chinese: 这位教授主要研究生物与环境之间的关系。
sentences.traditional: 這位教授主要研究生物與環境之間的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu zhǔyào yánjiū shēngwù yǔ huánjìng zhījiān de guānxì.
sentences.translation: This professor mainly studies the relationship between organisms and the environment.

sentences.chinese: 保护生物多样性，是保护人类未来的一部分。
sentences.traditional: 保護生物多樣性，是保護人類未來的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù shēngwù duōyàngxìng, shì bǎohù rénlèi wèilái de yí bùfen.
sentences.translation: Protecting biodiversity is part of protecting humanity’s future.

sentences.chinese: 按照中国传统，每个人都有自己的生肖。
sentences.traditional: 按照中國傳統，每個人都有自己的生肖。
sentences.pinyin: Ànzhào Zhōngguó chuántǒng, měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de shēngxiào.
sentences.translation: According to Chinese tradition, everyone has their own zodiac animal.

sentences.chinese: 春节前，商店里摆满了和生肖有关的装饰品。
sentences.traditional: 春節前，商店裡擺滿了和生肖有關的裝飾品。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qián, shāngdiàn lǐ bǎi mǎn le hé shēngxiào yǒuguān de zhuāngshìpǐn.
sentences.translation: Before Spring Festival, the shops were full of decorations related to the zodiac.

sentences.chinese: 他对生肖文化很感兴趣，尤其喜欢了解十二种动物的象征意义。
sentences.traditional: 他對生肖文化很感興趣，尤其喜歡了解十二種動物的象徵意義。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì shēngxiào wénhuà hěn gǎn xìngqù, yóuqí xǐhuan liǎojiě shíèr zhǒng dòngwù de xiàngzhēng yìyì.
sentences.translation: He is very interested in zodiac culture, especially in learning the symbolic meanings of the twelve animals.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物在温暖潮湿的环境中生长得最快。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物在溫暖潮濕的環境中生長得最快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù zài wēnnuǎn cháoshī de huánjìng zhōng shēngzhǎng de zuì kuài.
sentences.translation: This kind of plant grows fastest in a warm and humid environment.

sentences.chinese: 孩子的生长需要充足的营养和稳定的生活习惯。
sentences.traditional: 孩子的生長需要充足的營養和穩定的生活習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi de shēngzhǎng xūyào chōngzú de yíngyǎng hé wěndìng de shēnghuó xíguàn.
sentences.translation: A child’s growth needs sufficient nutrition and stable living habits.

sentences.chinese: 科学家正在观察珊瑚在不同水温下的生长情况。
sentences.traditional: 科學家正在觀察珊瑚在不同水溫下的生長情況。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài guānchá shānhú zài bùtóng shuǐwēn xià de shēngzhǎng qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Scientists are observing the growth of coral under different water temperatures.

sentences.chinese: 坐火车虽然慢一点，但可以省不少钱。
sentences.traditional: 坐火車雖然慢一點，但可以省不少錢。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē suīrán màn yìdiǎn, dàn kěyǐ shěng bù shǎo qián.
sentences.translation: Taking the train is a bit slower, but it can save quite a lot of money.

sentences.chinese: 为了省时间，他提前把所有资料都准备好了。
sentences.traditional: 為了省時間，他提前把所有資料都準備好了。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shěng shíjiān, tā tíqián bǎ suǒyǒu zīliào dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
sentences.translation: To save time, he prepared all the materials in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这种方法能省力，却不一定能保证质量。
sentences.traditional: 這種方法能省力，卻不一定能保證質量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ néng shěng lì, què bù yídìng néng bǎozhèng zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: This method can save effort, but it may not necessarily guarantee quality.

sentences.chinese: 这个省份以茶叶和山地风景闻名。
sentences.traditional: 這個省份以茶葉和山地風景聞名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shěngfèn yǐ cháyè hé shāndì fēngjǐng wénmíng.
sentences.translation: This province is famous for tea and mountain scenery.

sentences.chinese: 不同省份的饮食习惯差别很大。
sentences.traditional: 不同省份的飲食習慣差別很大。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng shěngfèn de yǐnshí xíguàn chābié hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The eating habits of different provinces vary greatly.

sentences.chinese: 旅行前，他查了几个省份的气候资料。
sentences.traditional: 旅行前，他查了幾個省份的氣候資料。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíng qián, tā chá le jǐ ge shěngfèn de qìhòu zīliào.
sentences.translation: Before travelling, he checked climate information for several provinces.

sentences.chinese: 杭州是浙江省的省会，也是一座历史文化名城。
sentences.traditional: 杭州是浙江省的省會，也是一座歷史文化名城。
sentences.pinyin: Hángzhōu shì Zhèjiāng Shěng de shěnghuì, yě shì yí zuò lìshǐ wénhuà míngchéng.
sentences.translation: Hangzhou is the provincial capital of Zhejiang Province and also a famous historical and cultural city.

sentences.chinese: 这个省会城市交通便利，吸引了很多外地企业。
sentences.traditional: 這個省會城市交通便利，吸引了很多外地企業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shěnghuì chéngshì jiāotōng biànlì, xīyǐn le hěn duō wàidì qǐyè.
sentences.translation: This provincial capital city has convenient transport and has attracted many companies from other places.

sentences.chinese: 会议将在省会举行，参加者来自全省各地。
sentences.traditional: 會議將在省會舉行，參加者來自全省各地。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiāng zài shěnghuì jǔxíng, cānjiāzhě láizì quán shěng gèdì.
sentences.translation: The meeting will be held in the provincial capital, with participants coming from all over the province.

sentences.chinese: 这场比赛能胜对手，关键在于团队合作。
sentences.traditional: 這場比賽能勝對手，關鍵在於團隊合作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài néng shèng duìshǒu, guānjiàn zàiyú tuánduì hézuò.
sentences.translation: Being able to defeat the opponent in this match depends mainly on teamwork.

sentences.chinese: 在经验方面，他比其他候选人略胜一筹。
sentences.traditional: 在經驗方面，他比其他候選人略勝一籌。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jīngyàn fāngmiàn, tā bǐ qítā hòuxuǎnrén lüè shèng yì chóu.
sentences.translation: In terms of experience, he is slightly better than the other candidates.

sentences.chinese: 这支队伍以三比二胜了去年冠军。
sentences.traditional: 這支隊伍以三比二勝了去年冠軍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī duìwǔ yǐ sān bǐ èr shèng le qùnián guànjūn.
sentences.translation: This team beat last year’s champions three to two.

sentences.chinese: 经过长期努力，项目终于取得了胜利。
sentences.traditional: 經過長期努力，項目終於取得了勝利。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò chángqī nǔlì, xiàngmù zhōngyú qǔdé le shènglì.
sentences.translation: After long-term effort, the project finally achieved success.

sentences.chinese: 胜利不只是运气，还需要充分准备。
sentences.traditional: 勝利不只是運氣，還需要充分準備。
sentences.pinyin: Shènglì bù zhǐshì yùnqì, hái xūyào chōngfèn zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: Victory is not just luck; it also requires full preparation.

sentences.chinese: 他们相信，只要坚持下去，胜利迟早会到来。
sentences.traditional: 他們相信，只要堅持下去，勝利遲早會到來。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiāngxìn, zhǐyào jiānchí xiàqù, shènglì chízǎo huì dàolái.
sentences.translation: They believe that as long as they keep going, victory will come sooner or later.

sentences.chinese: 这首诗表面写风景，其实表达了作者的孤独。
sentences.traditional: 這首詩表面寫風景，其實表達了作者的孤獨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī biǎomiàn xiě fēngjǐng, qíshí biǎodá le zuòzhě de gūdú.
sentences.translation: On the surface, this poem describes scenery, but it actually expresses the author’s loneliness.

sentences.chinese: 他把童年的记忆写成了一首很短的诗。
sentences.traditional: 他把童年的記憶寫成了一首很短的詩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ tóngnián de jìyì xiěchéng le yì shǒu hěn duǎn de shī.
sentences.translation: He turned his childhood memories into a very short poem.

sentences.chinese: 这首现代诗虽然不押韵，但节奏很自然。
sentences.traditional: 這首現代詩雖然不押韻，但節奏很自然。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu xiàndài shī suīrán bù yāyùn, dàn jiézòu hěn zìrán.
sentences.translation: Although this modern poem does not rhyme, its rhythm is very natural.

sentences.chinese: 雨后路面很湿，走路时要小心。
sentences.traditional: 雨後路面很濕，走路時要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu lùmiàn hěn shī, zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: After the rain, the road surface is very wet, so be careful when walking.

sentences.chinese: 衣服还没干，摸起来有点湿。
sentences.traditional: 衣服還沒乾，摸起來有點濕。
sentences.pinyin: Yīfu hái méi gān, mō qǐlái yǒudiǎn shī.
sentences.translation: The clothes are not dry yet; they feel a bit damp.

sentences.chinese: 南方的空气比较湿，让人觉得不太舒服。
sentences.traditional: 南方的空氣比較濕，讓人覺得不太舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Nánfāng de kōngqì bǐjiào shī, ràng rén juéde bú tài shūfu.
sentences.translation: The air in the south is relatively humid, which makes people feel rather uncomfortable.

sentences.chinese: 她失恋以后，把更多时间花在学习和运动上。
sentences.traditional: 她失戀以後，把更多時間花在學習和運動上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shīliàn yǐhòu, bǎ gèng duō shíjiān huā zài xuéxí hé yùndòng shang.
sentences.translation: After she went through a breakup, she spent more time on study and exercise.

sentences.chinese: 失恋并不代表失败，它也可能让人更了解自己。
sentences.traditional: 失戀並不代表失敗，它也可能讓人更了解自己。
sentences.pinyin: Shīliàn bìng bù dàibiǎo shībài, tā yě kěnéng ràng rén gèng liǎojiě zìjǐ.
sentences.translation: A breakup does not mean failure; it may also help someone understand themselves better.

sentences.chinese: 他朋友失恋了，我们都劝他出去散散心。
sentences.traditional: 他朋友失戀了，我們都勸他出去散散心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā péngyou shīliàn le, wǒmen dōu quàn tā chūqù sàn san xīn.
sentences.translation: His friend had a breakup, so we all advised him to go out and relax.

sentences.chinese: 最近工作压力太大，他经常失眠到半夜。
sentences.traditional: 最近工作壓力太大，他經常失眠到半夜。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì tài dà, tā jīngcháng shīmián dào bànyè.
sentences.translation: Recently the pressure at work has been too great, and he often cannot sleep until midnight.

sentences.chinese: 如果长期失眠，最好及时调整生活习惯。
sentences.traditional: 如果長期失眠，最好及時調整生活習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chángqī shīmián, zuì hǎo jíshí tiáozhěng shēnghuó xíguàn.
sentences.translation: If you suffer from insomnia for a long time, it is best to adjust your living habits promptly.

sentences.chinese: 她喝了浓茶以后，整晚都失眠了。
sentences.traditional: 她喝了濃茶以後，整晚都失眠了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hē le nóngchá yǐhòu, zhěng wǎn dōu shīmián le.
sentences.translation: After drinking strong tea, she suffered from insomnia all night.

sentences.chinese: 这位诗人用简单的语言写出了复杂的感情。
sentences.traditional: 這位詩人用簡單的語言寫出了複雜的感情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shīrén yòng jiǎndān de yǔyán xiě chū le fùzá de gǎnqíng.
sentences.translation: This poet used simple language to express complex feelings.

sentences.chinese: 很多诗人的作品都反映了他们所处的时代。
sentences.traditional: 很多詩人的作品都反映了他們所處的時代。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō shīrén de zuòpǐn dōu fǎnyìng le tāmen suǒ chǔ de shídài.
sentences.translation: The works of many poets reflect the era in which they lived.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然不是职业诗人，却写了不少优秀的诗。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然不是職業詩人，卻寫了不少優秀的詩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán bú shì zhíyè shīrén, què xiě le bù shǎo yōuxiù de shī.
sentences.translation: Although he is not a professional poet, he has written many excellent poems.

sentences.chinese: 一次小小的失误，可能会影响整个计划。
sentences.traditional: 一次小小的失誤，可能會影響整個計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Yí cì xiǎo xiǎo de shīwù, kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng zhěngge jìhuà.
sentences.translation: One small mistake may affect the whole plan.

sentences.chinese: 他承认了自己的失误，并向客户道歉。
sentences.traditional: 他承認了自己的失誤，並向客戶道歉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chéngrèn le zìjǐ de shīwù, bìng xiàng kèhù dàoqiàn.
sentences.translation: He admitted his mistake and apologised to the client.

sentences.chinese: 比赛最后一分钟的失误让他们失去了冠军。
sentences.traditional: 比賽最後一分鐘的失誤讓他們失去了冠軍。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài zuìhòu yì fēnzhōng de shīwù ràng tāmen shīqù le guànjūn.
sentences.translation: A mistake in the final minute of the match cost them the championship.

sentences.chinese: 经济不稳定时，很多人担心自己会失业。
sentences.traditional: 經濟不穩定時，很多人擔心自己會失業。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngjì bù wěndìng shí, hěn duō rén dānxīn zìjǐ huì shīyè.
sentences.translation: When the economy is unstable, many people worry that they will become unemployed.

sentences.chinese: 他失业以后，没有放弃，而是重新学习新技能。
sentences.traditional: 他失業以後，沒有放棄，而是重新學習新技能。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shīyè yǐhòu, méi yǒu fàngqì, ér shì chóngxīn xuéxí xīn jìnéng.
sentences.translation: After losing his job, he did not give up but started learning new skills again.

sentences.chinese: 政府推出培训计划，帮助失业人员重新就业。
sentences.traditional: 政府推出培訓計劃，幫助失業人員重新就業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū péixùn jìhuà, bāngzhù shīyè rényuán chóngxīn jiùyè.
sentences.translation: The government introduced a training plan to help unemployed people find work again.

sentences.chinese: 英国和中国之间有时差，开会前要确认时间。
sentences.traditional: 英國和中國之間有時差，開會前要確認時間。
sentences.pinyin: Yīngguó hé Zhōngguó zhījiān yǒu shíchā, kāihuì qián yào quèrèn shíjiān.
sentences.translation: There is a time difference between Britain and China, so confirm the time before the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 长途旅行后，他花了几天才适应时差。
sentences.traditional: 長途旅行後，他花了幾天才適應時差。
sentences.pinyin: Chángtú lǚxíng hòu, tā huā le jǐ tiān cái shìyìng shíchā.
sentences.translation: After the long journey, it took him several days to adjust to the time difference.

sentences.chinese: 因为时差问题，我们把会议推迟到了晚上。
sentences.traditional: 因為時差問題，我們把會議推遲到了晚上。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi shíchā wèntí, wǒmen bǎ huìyì tuīchí dào le wǎnshang.
sentences.translation: Because of the time-difference issue, we postponed the meeting until the evening.

sentences.chinese: 他时常提醒自己，不要因为一时的困难就放弃。
sentences.traditional: 他時常提醒自己，不要因為一時的困難就放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shícháng tíxǐng zìjǐ, bú yào yīnwèi yìshí de kùnnan jiù fàngqì.
sentences.translation: He often reminds himself not to give up because of a temporary difficulty.

sentences.chinese: 这位老师时常用真实例子帮助学生理解抽象概念。
sentences.traditional: 這位老師時常用真實例子幫助學生理解抽象概念。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī shícháng yòng zhēnshí lìzi bāngzhù xuésheng lǐjiě chōuxiàng gàiniàn.
sentences.translation: This teacher often uses real examples to help students understand abstract concepts.

sentences.chinese: 我们时常忽略身边的小变化，直到问题变得严重。
sentences.traditional: 我們時常忽略身邊的小變化，直到問題變得嚴重。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen shícháng hūlüè shēnbiān de xiǎo biànhuà, zhídào wèntí biàn de yánzhòng.
sentences.translation: We often ignore small changes around us until the problem becomes serious.

sentences.chinese: 这个时代变化太快，企业必须不断学习新技术。
sentences.traditional: 這個時代變化太快，企業必須不斷學習新技術。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shídài biànhuà tài kuài, qǐyè bìxū búduàn xuéxí xīn jìshù.
sentences.translation: This era is changing too quickly; companies must keep learning new technologies.

sentences.chinese: 每个时代都有自己的机会，也有自己的挑战。
sentences.traditional: 每個時代都有自己的機會，也有自己的挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jīhuì, yě yǒu zìjǐ de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: Every era has its own opportunities and its own challenges.

sentences.chinese: 他的小说真实地反映了那个时代普通人的生活。
sentences.traditional: 他的小說真實地反映了那個時代普通人的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiǎoshuō zhēnshí de fǎnyìng le nàge shídài pǔtōng rén de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: His novel realistically reflects the lives of ordinary people in that era.

sentences.chinese: 理论只有通过实践，才能真正变成能力。
sentences.traditional: 理論只有通過實踐，才能真正變成能力。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐlùn zhǐyǒu tōngguò shíjiàn, cái néng zhēnzhèng biàn chéng nénglì.
sentences.translation: Theory can truly become ability only through practice.

sentences.chinese: 学校鼓励学生把课堂上学到的知识用于实践。
sentences.traditional: 學校鼓勵學生把課堂上學到的知識用於實踐。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào gǔlì xuésheng bǎ kètáng shang xué dào de zhīshi yòngyú shíjiàn.
sentences.translation: The school encourages students to apply the knowledge they learn in class to practice.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策还需要在实践中不断调整和完善。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策還需要在實踐中不斷調整和完善。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè hái xūyào zài shíjiàn zhōng búduàn tiáozhěng hé wánshàn.
sentences.translation: This policy still needs to be continuously adjusted and improved in practice.

sentences.chinese: 关键时刻，他表现得非常冷静。
sentences.traditional: 關鍵時刻，他表現得非常冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Guānjiàn shíkè, tā biǎoxiàn de fēicháng lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: At the critical moment, he behaved very calmly.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该时刻注意网络安全，保护个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該時刻注意網絡安全，保護個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi shíkè zhùyì wǎngluò ānquán, bǎohù gèrén zīxùn.
sentences.translation: We should always pay attention to online security and protect personal information.

sentences.chinese: 离别的那一时刻，她突然不知道该说什么。
sentences.traditional: 離別的那一時刻，她突然不知道該說什麼。
sentences.pinyin: Líbié de nà yì shíkè, tā tūrán bù zhīdào gāi shuō shénme.
sentences.translation: At that moment of parting, she suddenly did not know what to say.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司虽然规模不大，但技术实力很强。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司雖然規模不大，但技術實力很強。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán guīmó bú dà, dàn jìshù shílì hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: Although this company is not large, its technical capability is strong.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结果证明了这支队伍的真实实力。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結果證明了這支隊伍的真實實力。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéguǒ zhèngmíng le zhè zhī duìwǔ de zhēnshí shílì.
sentences.translation: The result of the match proved the true strength of this team.

sentences.chinese: 提高实力不能只靠口号，还要靠长期训练。
sentences.traditional: 提高實力不能只靠口號，還要靠長期訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tígāo shílì bù néng zhǐ kào kǒuhào, hái yào kào chángqī xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: Improving capability cannot rely only on slogans; it also depends on long-term training.

sentences.chinese: 青少年时期的经历，往往会影响一个人的性格。
sentences.traditional: 青少年時期的經歷，往往會影響一個人的性格。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngshàonián shíqī de jīnglì, wǎngwǎng huì yǐngxiǎng yí ge rén de xìnggé.
sentences.translation: Experiences during adolescence often influence a person’s character.

sentences.chinese: 在经济困难时期，政府需要照顾低收入家庭。
sentences.traditional: 在經濟困難時期，政府需要照顧低收入家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jīngjì kùnnan shíqī, zhèngfǔ xūyào zhàogù dī shōurù jiātíng.
sentences.translation: During periods of economic difficulty, the government needs to look after low-income families.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区在历史上曾经有过非常繁荣的时期。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區在歷史上曾經有過非常繁榮的時期。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū zài lìshǐ shang céngjīng yǒu guo fēicháng fánróng de shíqī.
sentences.translation: This region once had a very prosperous period in its history.

sentences.chinese: 新规定将在下个月正式实施。
sentences.traditional: 新規定將在下個月正式實施。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn guīdìng jiāng zài xià ge yuè zhèngshì shíshī.
sentences.translation: The new rules will be officially implemented next month.

sentences.chinese: 为了实施这个计划，学校专门成立了工作小组。
sentences.traditional: 為了實施這個計劃，學校專門成立了工作小組。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shíshī zhège jìhuà, xuéxiào zhuānmén chénglì le gōngzuò xiǎozǔ.
sentences.translation: To implement this plan, the school set up a special working group.

sentences.chinese: 政策实施以后，交通拥堵情况有所改善。
sentences.traditional: 政策實施以後，交通擁堵情況有所改善。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè shíshī yǐhòu, jiāotōng yōngdǔ qíngkuàng yǒusuǒ gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: After the policy was implemented, the traffic congestion situation improved somewhat.

sentences.chinese: 他从海边捡了一块形状特别的石头。
sentences.traditional: 他從海邊撿了一塊形狀特別的石頭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng hǎibiān jiǎn le yí kuài xíngzhuàng tèbié de shítou.
sentences.translation: He picked up a specially shaped stone from the seaside.

sentences.chinese: 路中间有几块石头，司机不得不慢下来。
sentences.traditional: 路中間有幾塊石頭，司機不得不慢下來。
sentences.pinyin: Lù zhōngjiān yǒu jǐ kuài shítou, sījī bùdébù màn xiàlái.
sentences.translation: There were several stones in the middle of the road, so the driver had to slow down.

sentences.chinese: 这座老桥是用当地的石头建成的。
sentences.traditional: 這座老橋是用當地的石頭建成的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo qiáo shì yòng dāngdì de shítou jiànchéng de.
sentences.translation: This old bridge was built with local stone.

sentences.chinese: 大学最后一年，她在一家出版社实习。
sentences.traditional: 大學最後一年，她在一家出版社實習。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxué zuìhòu yì nián, tā zài yì jiā chūbǎnshè shíxí.
sentences.translation: In her final year at university, she interned at a publishing house.

sentences.chinese: 通过实习，学生可以提前了解真实的工作环境。
sentences.traditional: 通過實習，學生可以提前了解真實的工作環境。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò shíxí, xuésheng kěyǐ tíqián liǎojiě zhēnshí de gōngzuò huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Through an internship, students can understand the real working environment in advance.

sentences.chinese: 公司给每位实习学生安排了一名有经验的指导老师。
sentences.traditional: 公司給每位實習學生安排了一名有經驗的指導老師。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi měi wèi shíxí xuésheng ānpái le yì míng yǒu jīngyàn de zhǐdǎo lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: The company arranged an experienced mentor for each intern student.

sentences.chinese: 只要方向正确，目标就有可能实现。
sentences.traditional: 只要方向正確，目標就有可能實現。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào fāngxiàng zhèngquè, mùbiāo jiù yǒu kěnéng shíxiàn.
sentences.translation: As long as the direction is correct, the goal can possibly be achieved.

sentences.chinese: 他用了十年时间，终于实现了创业梦想。
sentences.traditional: 他用了十年時間，終於實現了創業夢想。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng le shí nián shíjiān, zhōngyú shíxiàn le chuàngyè mèngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: He spent ten years and finally achieved his dream of starting a business.

sentences.chinese: 实现公平教育，需要社会各方面共同努力。
sentences.traditional: 實現公平教育，需要社會各方面共同努力。
sentences.pinyin: Shíxiàn gōngpíng jiàoyù, xūyào shèhuì gè fāngmiàn gòngtóng nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Achieving fair education requires joint effort from all parts of society.

sentences.chinese: 学校决定从下学期开始实行新的考试制度。
sentences.traditional: 學校決定從下學期開始實行新的考試制度。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào juédìng cóng xià xuéqī kāishǐ shíxíng xīn de kǎoshì zhìdù.
sentences.translation: The school decided to carry out the new examination system from next term.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革如果实行得太快，可能会带来新的问题。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革如果實行得太快，可能會帶來新的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé rúguǒ shíxíng de tài kuài, kěnéng huì dàilái xīn de wèntí.
sentences.translation: If this reform is carried out too quickly, it may bring new problems.

sentences.chinese: 为了节约能源，公司实行了更严格的管理办法。
sentences.traditional: 為了節約能源，公司實行了更嚴格的管理辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiéyuē néngyuán, gōngsī shíxíng le gèng yángé de guǎnlǐ bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: To save energy, the company implemented stricter management measures.

sentences.chinese: 科学家通过多次实验，证明了这种材料的安全性。
sentences.traditional: 科學家通過多次實驗，證明了這種材料的安全性。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā tōngguò duō cì shíyàn, zhèngmíng le zhè zhǒng cáiliào de ānquánxìng.
sentences.translation: Through repeated experiments, scientists proved the safety of this material.

sentences.chinese: 做实验以前，学生必须先了解安全规则。
sentences.traditional: 做實驗以前，學生必須先了解安全規則。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò shíyàn yǐqián, xuésheng bìxū xiān liǎojiě ānquán guīzé.
sentences.translation: Before doing an experiment, students must first understand the safety rules.

sentences.chinese: 这个实验结果和老师的预测完全不同。
sentences.traditional: 這個實驗結果和老師的預測完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shíyàn jiéguǒ hé lǎoshī de yùcè wánquán bù tóng.
sentences.translation: The result of this experiment was completely different from the teacher’s prediction.

sentences.chinese: 进入实验室之前，大家要穿好防护服。
sentences.traditional: 進入實驗室之前，大家要穿好防護服。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù shíyànshì zhīqián, dàjiā yào chuān hǎo fánghùfú.
sentences.translation: Before entering the laboratory, everyone must put on protective clothing.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学的新实验室配备了先进的设备。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學的新實驗室配備了先進的設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué de xīn shíyànshì pèibèi le xiānjìn de shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The university’s new laboratory is equipped with advanced equipment.

sentences.chinese: 他每天在实验室工作到很晚，只为了完成研究项目。
sentences.traditional: 他每天在實驗室工作到很晚，只為了完成研究項目。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān zài shíyànshì gōngzuò dào hěn wǎn, zhǐ wèile wánchéng yánjiū xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: He works late in the laboratory every day just to complete the research project.

sentences.chinese: 这本书内容虽然不深，但非常实用。
sentences.traditional: 這本書內容雖然不深，但非常實用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū nèiróng suīrán bù shēn, dàn fēicháng shíyòng.
sentences.translation: Although the content of this book is not deep, it is very practical.

sentences.chinese: 我更喜欢实用的设计，而不是只追求好看。
sentences.traditional: 我更喜歡實用的設計，而不是只追求好看。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gèng xǐhuan shíyòng de shèjì, ér bú shì zhǐ zhuīqiú hǎokàn.
sentences.translation: I prefer practical design rather than only pursuing good looks.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法简单实用，适合大多数家庭。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法簡單實用，適合大多數家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ jiǎndān shíyòng, shìhé dàduōshù jiātíng.
sentences.translation: This method is simple and practical, and suits most families.

sentences.chinese: 野外采到的蘑菇不能随便食用。
sentences.traditional: 野外採到的蘑菇不能隨便食用。
sentences.pinyin: Yěwài cǎi dào de mógu bù néng suíbiàn shíyòng.
sentences.translation: Mushrooms picked in the wild must not be eaten casually.

sentences.chinese: 这种油可以食用，但不适合高温烹调。
sentences.traditional: 這種油可以食用，但不適合高溫烹調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yóu kěyǐ shíyòng, dàn bù shìhé gāowēn pēngtiáo.
sentences.translation: This oil is edible, but it is not suitable for high-temperature cooking.

sentences.chinese: 食用过期食品，可能会影响身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 食用過期食品，可能會影響身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyòng guòqī shípǐn, kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Eating expired food may affect your health.

sentences.chinese: 连续的暴雨使得道路交通受到了严重影响。
sentences.traditional: 連續的暴雨使得道路交通受到了嚴重影響。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù de bàoyǔ shǐde dàolù jiāotōng shòudào le yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Continuous heavy rain caused road traffic to be seriously affected.

sentences.chinese: 科技的发展使得远程办公变得越来越普遍。
sentences.traditional: 科技的發展使得遠程辦公變得越來越普遍。
sentences.pinyin: Kējì de fāzhǎn shǐde yuǎnchéng bàngōng biàn de yuèláiyuè pǔbiàn.
sentences.translation: The development of technology has made remote working increasingly common.

sentences.chinese: 他的解释使得复杂的问题变得容易理解。
sentences.traditional: 他的解釋使得複雜的問題變得容易理解。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiěshì shǐde fùzá de wèntí biàn de róngyì lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: His explanation made the complex problem easier to understand.

sentences.chinese: 无论遇到什么困难，她始终相信自己能成功。
sentences.traditional: 無論遇到什麼困難，她始終相信自己能成功。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn yùdào shénme kùnnan, tā shǐzhōng xiāngxìn zìjǐ néng chénggōng.
sentences.translation: No matter what difficulties she encounters, she always believes she can succeed.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目从开始到结束，负责人始终保持冷静。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目從開始到結束，負責人始終保持冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù cóng kāishǐ dào jiéshù, fùzérén shǐzhōng bǎochí lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: From start to finish, the person in charge of this project remained calm.

sentences.chinese: 公司的目标始终没有改变，就是提高产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 公司的目標始終沒有改變，就是提高產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī de mùbiāo shǐzhōng méi yǒu gǎibiàn, jiùshì tígāo chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The company’s goal has never changed: to improve product quality.

sentences.chinese: 这套公寓采用开放式设计，厨房和客厅连在一起。
sentences.traditional: 這套公寓採用開放式設計，廚房和客廳連在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù cǎiyòng kāifàngshì shèjì, chúfáng hé kètīng lián zài yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: This flat uses an open-plan design, with the kitchen and living room connected.

sentences.chinese: 这种家庭式旅馆价格不高，却让人觉得很温暖。
sentences.traditional: 這種家庭式旅館價格不高，卻讓人覺得很溫暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiātíngshì lǚguǎn jiàgé bù gāo, què ràng rén juéde hěn wēnnuǎn.
sentences.translation: This family-style guesthouse is not expensive, but it feels very warm.

sentences.chinese: 中式家具讲究对称，也常常使用木材。
sentences.traditional: 中式傢俱講究對稱，也常常使用木材。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngshì jiājù jiǎngjiū duìchèn, yě chángcháng shǐyòng mùcái.
sentences.translation: Chinese-style furniture values symmetry and often uses wood.

sentences.chinese: 在适当的时候提出建议，比一直批评更有效。
sentences.traditional: 在適當的時候提出建議，比一直批評更有效。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shìdàng de shíhou tíchū jiànyì, bǐ yìzhí pīpíng gèng yǒuxiào.
sentences.translation: Making suggestions at the appropriate time is more effective than constant criticism.

sentences.chinese: 老师会根据学生的水平，选择适当的练习材料。
sentences.traditional: 老師會根據學生的水平，選擇適當的練習材料。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī huì gēnjù xuésheng de shuǐpíng, xuǎnzé shìdàng de liànxí cáiliào.
sentences.translation: The teacher will choose appropriate practice materials according to the students’ level.

sentences.chinese: 运动以后喝适当的水，可以帮助身体恢复。
sentences.traditional: 運動以後喝適當的水，可以幫助身體恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu hē shìdàng de shuǐ, kěyǐ bāngzhù shēntǐ huīfù.
sentences.translation: Drinking an appropriate amount of water after exercise can help the body recover.

sentences.chinese: 他听到这个消息以后，像做梦似的半天说不出话。
sentences.traditional: 他聽到這個消息以後，像做夢似的半天說不出話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxi yǐhòu, xiàng zuò mèng shìde bàn tiān shuō bù chū huà.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news, he felt as if he were dreaming and could not speak for ages.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们一听到下课铃，就像风似的跑出教室。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們一聽到下課鈴，就像風似的跑出教室。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yì tīngdào xiàkè líng, jiù xiàng fēng shìde pǎo chū jiàoshì.
sentences.translation: As soon as the children heard the class bell, they ran out of the classroom like the wind.

sentences.chinese: 她把每个细节都记得清清楚楚，仿佛昨天发生似的。
sentences.traditional: 她把每個細節都記得清清楚楚，彷彿昨天發生似的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ měi ge xìjié dōu jì de qīngqīngchǔchǔ, fǎngfú zuótiān fāshēng shìde.
sentences.translation: She remembers every detail clearly, as if it happened yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 这起事故提醒我们，开车时不能一边看手机一边聊天。
sentences.traditional: 這起事故提醒我們，開車時不能一邊看手機一邊聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè qǐ shìgù tíxǐng wǒmen, kāichē shí bù néng yìbiān kàn shǒujī yìbiān liáotiān.
sentences.translation: This accident reminds us that we must not look at our phones and chat while driving.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，警察很快赶到现场进行调查。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，警察很快趕到現場進行調查。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, jǐngchá hěn kuài gǎn dào xiànchǎng jìnxíng diàochá.
sentences.translation: After the accident happened, the police quickly arrived at the scene to investigate.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免类似事故，工厂加强了安全培训。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免類似事故，工廠加強了安全培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn lèisì shìgù, gōngchǎng jiāqiáng le ānquán péixùn.
sentences.translation: To avoid similar accidents, the factory strengthened its safety training.

sentences.chinese: 这次事件引起了社会各界的广泛关注。
sentences.traditional: 這次事件引起了社會各界的廣泛關注。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiàn yǐnqǐ le shèhuì gè jiè de guǎngfàn guānzhù.
sentences.translation: This incident attracted widespread attention from all parts of society.

sentences.chinese: 在整个事件中，媒体的报道起到了重要作用。
sentences.traditional: 在整個事件中，媒體的報導起到了重要作用。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhěnggè shìjiàn zhōng, méitǐ de bàodǎo qǐ dào le zhòngyào zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: During the whole event, the media’s reporting played an important role.

sentences.chinese: 他把那天发生的事件详细地写进了报告里。
sentences.traditional: 他把那天發生的事件詳細地寫進了報告裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà tiān fāshēng de shìjiàn xiángxì de xiě jìn le bàogào li.
sentences.translation: He wrote the event that happened that day into the report in detail.

sentences.chinese: 考试结束后，老师马上开始批改试卷。
sentences.traditional: 考試結束後，老師馬上開始批改試卷。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì jiéshù hòu, lǎoshī mǎshàng kāishǐ pīgǎi shìjuàn.
sentences.translation: After the exam ended, the teacher immediately began marking the exam papers.

sentences.chinese: 这份试卷的阅读题比较难，需要认真分析。
sentences.traditional: 這份試卷的閱讀題比較難，需要認真分析。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn shìjuàn de yuèdú tí bǐjiào nán, xūyào rènzhēn fēnxī.
sentences.translation: The reading questions on this exam paper are fairly difficult and need careful analysis.

sentences.chinese: 学生交试卷以前，应该检查姓名和答案是否写清楚。
sentences.traditional: 學生交試卷以前，應該檢查姓名和答案是否寫清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Xuésheng jiāo shìjuàn yǐqián, yīnggāi jiǎnchá xìngmíng hé dá'àn shìfǒu xiě qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Before students hand in their exam papers, they should check whether their names and answers are written clearly.

sentences.chinese: 许多市民参加了周末的环保活动。
sentences.traditional: 許多市民參加了週末的環保活動。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō shìmín cānjiā le zhōumò de huánbǎo huódòng.
sentences.translation: Many citizens took part in the environmental protection activity at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 政府应该及时向市民公布真实的信息。
sentences.traditional: 政府應該及時向市民公佈真實的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yīnggāi jíshí xiàng shìmín gōngbù zhēnshí de xìnxī.
sentences.translation: The government should disclose truthful information to citizens in good time.

sentences.chinese: 为了方便市民出行，城市增加了夜间公交线路。
sentences.traditional: 為了方便市民出行，城市增加了夜間公交線路。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn shìmín chūxíng, chéngshì zēngjiā le yèjiān gōngjiāo xiànlù.
sentences.translation: To make travel more convenient for citizens, the city added night bus routes.

sentences.chinese: 事实证明，提前准备比临时努力更可靠。
sentences.traditional: 事實證明，提前準備比臨時努力更可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Shìshí zhèngmíng, tíqián zhǔnbèi bǐ línshí nǔlì gèng kěkào.
sentences.translation: Facts prove that preparing in advance is more reliable than making last-minute efforts.

sentences.chinese: 面对事实，他不得不承认自己的判断有误。
sentences.traditional: 面對事實，他不得不承認自己的判斷有誤。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shìshí, tā bùdébù chéngrèn zìjǐ de pànduàn yǒu wù.
sentences.translation: Faced with the facts, he had no choice but to admit that his judgement was wrong.

sentences.chinese: 这不是个人看法，而是已经确认的事实。
sentences.traditional: 這不是個人看法，而是已經確認的事實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bú shì gèrén kànfǎ, ér shì yǐjīng quèrèn de shìshí.
sentences.translation: This is not a personal opinion, but an already confirmed fact.

sentences.chinese: 他把失败视为学习过程中不可避免的一部分。
sentences.traditional: 他把失敗視為學習過程中不可避免的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ shībài shìwéi xuéxí guòchéng zhōng bùkě bìmiǎn de yí bùfen.
sentences.translation: He regards failure as an unavoidable part of the learning process.

sentences.chinese: 这种发现被科学界视为重要突破。
sentences.traditional: 這種發現被科學界視為重要突破。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fāxiàn bèi kēxuéjiè shìwéi zhòngyào tūpò.
sentences.translation: This discovery is regarded by the scientific community as an important breakthrough.

sentences.chinese: 在当地，保护古建筑被视为大家共同的责任。
sentences.traditional: 在當地，保護古建築被視為大家共同的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dāngdì, bǎohù gǔ jiànzhù bèi shìwéi dàjiā gòngtóng de zérèn.
sentences.translation: Locally, protecting ancient buildings is regarded as everyone’s shared responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 孩子对新鲜事物总是充满好奇。
sentences.traditional: 孩子對新鮮事物總是充滿好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi duì xīnxiān shìwù zǒng shì chōngmǎn hàoqí.
sentences.translation: Children are always full of curiosity about new things.

sentences.chinese: 理解复杂事物时，我们需要先抓住主要关系。
sentences.traditional: 理解複雜事物時，我們需要先抓住主要關係。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐjiě fùzá shìwù shí, wǒmen xūyào xiān zhuāzhù zhǔyào guānxi.
sentences.translation: When understanding complex things, we need to grasp the main relationships first.

sentences.chinese: 互联网让人们接触到更多不同的事物。
sentences.traditional: 互聯網讓人們接觸到更多不同的事物。
sentences.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng ràng rénmen jiēchù dào gèng duō bùtóng de shìwù.
sentences.translation: The internet allows people to come into contact with more different things.

sentences.chinese: 如果事先没有沟通好，合作时就容易产生误会。
sentences.traditional: 如果事先沒有溝通好，合作時就容易產生誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shìxiān méiyǒu gōutōng hǎo, hézuò shí jiù róngyì chǎnshēng wùhuì.
sentences.translation: If communication is not handled well in advance, misunderstandings can easily arise during cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 我们已经事先准备了几种解决方案。
sentences.traditional: 我們已經事先準備了幾種解決方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng shìxiān zhǔnbèi le jǐ zhǒng jiějué fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: We have already prepared several solutions in advance.

sentences.chinese: 参加活动的人需要事先在网上报名。
sentences.traditional: 參加活動的人需要事先在網上報名。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā huódòng de rén xūyào shìxiān zài wǎngshàng bàomíng.
sentences.translation: People participating in the activity need to register online in advance.

sentences.chinese: 新药上市以前，必须经过严格的临床试验。
sentences.traditional: 新藥上市以前，必須經過嚴格的臨床試驗。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yào shàngshì yǐqián, bìxū jīngguò yángé de línchuáng shìyàn.
sentences.translation: Before a new medicine goes on the market, it must go through strict clinical trials.

sentences.chinese: 工程师正在试验一种更节能的发动机。
sentences.traditional: 工程師正在試驗一種更節能的發動機。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zhèngzài shìyàn yì zhǒng gèng jiénéng de fādòngjī.
sentences.translation: Engineers are testing a more energy-saving engine.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术还处在试验阶段，不能马上投入生产。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術還處在試驗階段，不能馬上投入生產。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù hái chǔ zài shìyàn jiēduàn, bù néng mǎshàng tóurù shēngchǎn.
sentences.translation: This technology is still at the trial stage and cannot be put into production immediately.

sentences.chinese: 她把一生都献给了教育事业。
sentences.traditional: 她把一生都獻給了教育事業。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yìshēng dōu xiàn gěi le jiàoyù shìyè.
sentences.translation: She devoted her whole life to the cause of education.

sentences.chinese: 选择事业方向时，不能只看收入，还要看兴趣和价值。
sentences.traditional: 選擇事業方向時，不能只看收入，還要看興趣和價值。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnzé shìyè fāngxiàng shí, bù néng zhǐ kàn shōurù, hái yào kàn xìngqù hé jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: When choosing a career direction, you cannot only look at income; you also need to consider interest and value.

sentences.chinese: 一个国家的医疗事业发展，关系到每个人的生活质量。
sentences.traditional: 一個國家的醫療事業發展，關係到每個人的生活質量。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge guójiā de yīliáo shìyè fāzhǎn, guānxì dào měi ge rén de shēnghuó zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The development of a country’s medical services is connected to everyone’s quality of life.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件可以免费试用一个月，再决定是否购买。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件可以免費試用一個月，再決定是否購買。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ miǎnfèi shìyòng yí ge yuè, zài juédìng shìfǒu gòumǎi.
sentences.translation: This software can be tried free for one month before deciding whether to buy it.

sentences.chinese: 公司给新员工三个月的试用期，以便双方互相了解。
sentences.traditional: 公司給新員工三個月的試用期，以便雙方互相了解。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi xīn yuángōng sān ge yuè de shìyòng qī, yǐbiàn shuāngfāng hùxiāng liǎojiě.
sentences.translation: The company gives new employees a three-month probation period so both sides can understand each other.

sentences.chinese: 这种设备在正式采购前，最好先试用几天。
sentences.traditional: 這種設備在正式採購前，最好先試用幾天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shèbèi zài zhèngshì cǎigòu qián, zuì hǎo xiān shìyòng jǐ tiān.
sentences.translation: Before formally purchasing this equipment, it is best to try it out for a few days first.

sentences.chinese: 这条规定适用于所有参加考试的学生。
sentences.traditional: 這條規定適用於所有參加考試的學生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo guīdìng shìyòng yú suǒyǒu cānjiā kǎoshì de xuésheng.
sentences.translation: This regulation applies to all students taking the exam.

sentences.chinese: 这种教学方法并不适用每一个班级。
sentences.traditional: 這種教學方法並不適用每一個班級。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiàoxué fāngfǎ bìng bù shìyòng měi yí ge bānjí.
sentences.translation: This teaching method is not suitable for every class.

sentences.chinese: 请确认这张优惠券是否还适用。
sentences.traditional: 請確認這張優惠券是否還適用。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng quèrèn zhè zhāng yōuhuìquàn shìfǒu hái shìyòng.
sentences.translation: Please confirm whether this coupon is still applicable.

sentences.chinese: 这次实习让我收获了很多实际经验。
sentences.traditional: 這次實習讓我收穫了很多實際經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shíxí ràng wǒ shōuhuò le hěn duō shíjì jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: This internship allowed me to gain a lot of practical experience.

sentences.chinese: 经过一年的努力，团队终于有了不错的收获。
sentences.traditional: 經過一年的努力，團隊終於有了不錯的收穫。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò yì nián de nǔlì, tuánduì zhōngyú yǒu le búcuò de shōuhuò.
sentences.translation: After a year of hard work, the team finally had a decent harvest.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结果虽然一般，但他在心理上收获很大。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結果雖然一般，但他在心理上收穫很大。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéguǒ suīrán yìbān, dàn tā zài xīnlǐ shang shōuhuò hěn dà.
sentences.translation: Although the competition result was ordinary, he gained a great deal mentally.

sentences.chinese: 为了写论文，她收集了大量原始资料。
sentences.traditional: 為了寫論文，她收集了大量原始資料。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile xiě lùnwén, tā shōují le dàliàng yuánshǐ zīliào.
sentences.translation: In order to write her thesis, she collected a large amount of original material.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆正在收集当地居民的老照片。
sentences.traditional: 博物館正在收集當地居民的老照片。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhèngzài shōují dāngdì jūmín de lǎo zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: The museum is collecting old photos from local residents.

sentences.chinese: 做决定以前，我们应该先收集各方面的意见。
sentences.traditional: 做決定以前，我們應該先收集各方面的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò juédìng yǐqián, wǒmen yīnggāi xiān shōují gè fāngmiàn de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, we should first collect opinions from all sides.

sentences.chinese: 全国观众通过电视收看了这场开幕式。
sentences.traditional: 全國觀眾通過電視收看了這場開幕式。
sentences.pinyin: Quánguó guānzhòng tōngguò diànshì shōukàn le zhè chǎng kāimùshì.
sentences.translation: Viewers across the country watched the opening ceremony on television.

sentences.chinese: 如果你错过直播，还可以在网上收看重播。
sentences.traditional: 如果你錯過直播，還可以在網上收看重播。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ cuòguò zhíbō, hái kěyǐ zài wǎngshàng shōukàn chóngbō.
sentences.translation: If you miss the live broadcast, you can still watch the replay online.

sentences.chinese: 我们每周都会收看一档关于历史的节目。
sentences.traditional: 我們每週都會收看一檔關於歷史的節目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen měi zhōu dōu huì shōukàn yì dàng guānyú lìshǐ de jiémù.
sentences.translation: Every week we watch a programme about history.

sentences.chinese: 无论遇到什么困难，他都坚持守信用。
sentences.traditional: 無論遇到什麼困難，他都堅持守信用。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn yùdào shénme kùnnan, tā dōu jiānchí shǒu xìnyòng.
sentences.translation: No matter what difficulties he faces, he insists on keeping his word.

sentences.chinese: 士兵们整夜守在桥边，防止危险发生。
sentences.traditional: 士兵們整夜守在橋邊，防止危險發生。
sentences.pinyin: Shìbīngmen zhěng yè shǒu zài qiáo biān, fángzhǐ wēixiǎn fāshēng.
sentences.translation: The soldiers guarded the bridge all night to prevent danger from occurring.

sentences.chinese: 做生意不能只看利润，也要守规则。
sentences.traditional: 做生意不能只看利潤，也要守規則。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò shēngyi bù néng zhǐ kàn lìrùn, yě yào shǒu guīzé.
sentences.translation: When doing business, you cannot only look at profit; you must also keep to the rules.

sentences.chinese: 这是他首次独立负责这么重要的项目。
sentences.traditional: 這是他首次獨立負責這麼重要的項目。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì tā shǒucì dúlì fùzé zhème zhòngyào de xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: This is the first time he has independently taken charge of such an important project.

sentences.chinese: 该技术首次应用在公共交通系统中。
sentences.traditional: 該技術首次應用在公共交通系統中。
sentences.pinyin: Gāi jìshù shǒucì yìngyòng zài gōnggòng jiāotōng xìtǒng zhōng.
sentences.translation: This technology was applied in a public transport system for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 她首次出国旅行，就选择了一个完全陌生的城市。
sentences.traditional: 她首次出國旅行，就選擇了一個完全陌生的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒucì chūguó lǚxíng, jiù xuǎnzé le yí ge wánquán mòshēng de chéngshì.
sentences.translation: For her first trip abroad, she chose a completely unfamiliar city.

sentences.chinese: 解决问题的手段很多，关键是要选择最合适的。
sentences.traditional: 解決問題的手段很多，關鍵是要選擇最合適的。
sentences.pinyin: Jiějué wèntí de shǒuduàn hěn duō, guānjiàn shì yào xuǎnzé zuì héshì de.
sentences.translation: There are many means of solving a problem; the key is to choose the most suitable one.

sentences.chinese: 他用不正当的手段获得了竞争优势。
sentences.traditional: 他用不正當的手段獲得了競爭優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng bù zhèngdàng de shǒuduàn huòdé le jìngzhēng yōushì.
sentences.translation: He gained a competitive advantage by improper means.

sentences.chinese: 技术只是手段，真正的目的还是改善人的生活。
sentences.traditional: 技術只是手段，真正的目的還是改善人的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshù zhǐ shì shǒuduàn, zhēnzhèng de mùdì háishi gǎishàn rén de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Technology is only a means; the real aim is still to improve people’s lives.

sentences.chinese: 这家店卖的手工面包每天早上都很快卖完。
sentences.traditional: 這家店賣的手工麵包每天早上都很快賣完。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài de shǒugōng miànbāo měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hěn kuài mài wán.
sentences.translation: The handmade bread sold in this shop sells out quickly every morning.

sentences.chinese: 比起机器生产，我更喜欢手工制作的家具。
sentences.traditional: 比起機器生產，我更喜歡手工製作的傢俱。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐqǐ jīqì shēngchǎn, wǒ gèng xǐhuan shǒugōng zhìzuò de jiājù.
sentences.translation: Compared with machine production, I prefer handmade furniture.

sentences.chinese: 学校开设了手工课，让孩子们练习动手能力。
sentences.traditional: 學校開設了手工課，讓孩子們練習動手能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào kāishè le shǒugōng kè, ràng háizimen liànxí dòngshǒu nénglì.
sentences.translation: The school offered a handicraft class to let children practise practical skills.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他尽快接受手术，否则病情可能加重。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他盡快接受手術，否則病情可能加重。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā jǐnkuài jiēshòu shǒushù, fǒuzé bìngqíng kěnéng jiāzhòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to have surgery as soon as possible, otherwise his condition might worsen.

sentences.chinese: 手术前，护士向家属说明了需要注意的事项。
sentences.traditional: 手術前，護士向家屬說明了需要注意的事項。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒushù qián, hùshi xiàng jiāshǔ shuōmíng le xūyào zhùyì de shìxiàng.
sentences.translation: Before the operation, the nurse explained the points needing attention to the family members.

sentences.chinese: 这次手术很成功，病人恢复得比预期快。
sentences.traditional: 這次手術很成功，病人恢復得比預期快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shǒushù hěn chénggōng, bìngrén huīfù de bǐ yùqī kuài.
sentences.translation: This operation was very successful, and the patient recovered faster than expected.

sentences.chinese: 天气太冷了，骑车时最好戴上手套。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太冷了，騎車時最好戴上手套。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài lěng le, qí chē shí zuì hǎo dài shang shǒutào.
sentences.translation: The weather is too cold; it is best to wear gloves when cycling.

sentences.chinese: 进入实验室前，必须先戴好手套和口罩。
sentences.traditional: 進入實驗室前，必須先戴好手套和口罩。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù shíyànshì qián, bìxū xiān dài hǎo shǒutào hé kǒuzhào.
sentences.translation: Before entering the laboratory, you must first put on gloves and a mask properly.

sentences.chinese: 这副手套虽然不贵，但保暖效果很好。
sentences.traditional: 這副手套雖然不貴，但保暖效果很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fù shǒutào suīrán bú guì, dàn bǎonuǎn xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although this pair of gloves is not expensive, its warmth-retaining effect is very good.

sentences.chinese: 办理签证手续时，需要准备护照和照片。
sentences.traditional: 辦理簽證手續時，需要準備護照和照片。
sentences.pinyin: Bànlǐ qiānzhèng shǒuxù shí, xūyào zhǔnbèi hùzhào hé zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: When handling visa procedures, you need to prepare a passport and photos.

sentences.chinese: 公司已经完成了入职手续，明天可以正式上班。
sentences.traditional: 公司已經完成了入職手續，明天可以正式上班。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yǐjīng wánchéng le rùzhí shǒuxù, míngtiān kěyǐ zhèngshì shàngbān.
sentences.translation: The company has already completed the onboarding formalities, so work can officially begin tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 如果手续不齐全，银行可能会拒绝贷款申请。
sentences.traditional: 如果手續不齊全，銀行可能會拒絕貸款申請。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shǒuxù bù qíquán, yínháng kěnéng huì jùjué dàikuǎn shēnqǐng.
sentences.translation: If the paperwork is incomplete, the bank may reject the loan application.

sentences.chinese: 他不小心切到了手指，只好去医院处理伤口。
sentences.traditional: 他不小心切到了手指，只好去醫院處理傷口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn qiē dào le shǒuzhǐ, zhǐhǎo qù yīyuàn chǔlǐ shāngkǒu.
sentences.translation: He accidentally cut his finger, so he had to go to the hospital to have the wound treated.

sentences.chinese: 她的手指因为天气太冷而有点发麻。
sentences.traditional: 她的手指因為天氣太冷而有點發麻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shǒuzhǐ yīnwèi tiānqì tài lěng ér yǒudiǎn fāmá.
sentences.translation: Her fingers felt a little numb because the weather was too cold.

sentences.chinese: 手机屏幕太小，手指点起来不太方便。
sentences.traditional: 手機屏幕太小，手指點起來不太方便。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī píngmù tài xiǎo, shǒuzhǐ diǎn qǐlai bú tài fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The phone screen is too small, so tapping with fingers is not very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车的售价比去年下降了不少。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車的售價比去年下降了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de shòujià bǐ qùnián xiàjiàng le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: The selling price of this car has fallen quite a lot compared with last year.

sentences.chinese: 这款手机售价较高，但功能确实很强。
sentences.traditional: 這款手機售價較高，但功能確實很強。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī shòujià jiào gāo, dàn gōngnéng quèshí hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: This phone has a relatively high selling price, but its functions are indeed very strong.

sentences.chinese: 商品的售价必须清楚地标在包装上。
sentences.traditional: 商品的售價必須清楚地標在包裝上。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngpǐn de shòujià bìxū qīngchǔ de biāo zài bāozhuāng shang.
sentences.translation: The selling price of a product must be clearly marked on the packaging.

sentences.chinese: 为了保持健康，他每天至少吃两种蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 為了保持健康，他每天至少吃兩種蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎochí jiànkāng, tā měi tiān zhìshǎo chī liǎng zhǒng shūcài.
sentences.translation: In order to stay healthy, he eats at least two kinds of vegetables every day.

sentences.chinese: 这些蔬菜都是本地农民上午刚送来的。
sentences.traditional: 這些蔬菜都是本地農民上午剛送來的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shūcài dōu shì běndì nóngmín shàngwǔ gāng sòng lái de.
sentences.translation: These vegetables were all delivered by local farmers just this morning.

sentences.chinese: 如果蔬菜洗得不干净，可能会影响食品安全。
sentences.traditional: 如果蔬菜洗得不乾淨，可能會影響食品安全。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shūcài xǐ de bù gānjìng, kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng shípǐn ānquán.
sentences.translation: If vegetables are not washed cleanly, they may affect food safety.

sentences.chinese: 他从小练习书法，所以字写得很有风格。
sentences.traditional: 他從小練習書法，所以字寫得很有風格。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ zì xiě de hěn yǒu fēnggé.
sentences.translation: He has practised calligraphy since childhood, so his writing has a very distinctive style.

sentences.chinese: 这次展览展示了不同朝代的书法作品。
sentences.traditional: 這次展覽展示了不同朝代的書法作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn zhǎnshì le bùtóng cháodài de shūfǎ zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: This exhibition displayed calligraphy works from different dynasties.

sentences.chinese: 学习书法不只是写字，也能培养耐心和审美。
sentences.traditional: 學習書法不只是寫字，也能培養耐心和審美。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí shūfǎ bù zhǐ shì xiě zì, yě néng péiyǎng nàixīn hé shěnměi.
sentences.translation: Learning calligraphy is not just writing characters; it can also cultivate patience and aesthetic judgement.

sentences.chinese: 父亲每天晚上都在书房里处理工作邮件。
sentences.traditional: 父親每天晚上都在書房裡處理工作郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn měi tiān wǎnshang dōu zài shūfáng lǐ chǔlǐ gōngzuò yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: Every evening, Father handles work emails in the study.

sentences.chinese: 这套房子的书房虽然不大，但采光很好。
sentences.traditional: 這套房子的書房雖然不大，但採光很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi de shūfáng suīrán bú dà, dàn cǎiguāng hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: The study in this home is not large, but it gets very good natural light.

sentences.chinese: 她把阳台改成了一个安静的小书房。
sentences.traditional: 她把陽臺改成了一個安靜的小書房。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yángtái gǎi chéng le yí ge ānjìng de xiǎo shūfáng.
sentences.translation: She converted the balcony into a quiet small study.

sentences.chinese: 书架上摆满了历史和文学方面的书。
sentences.traditional: 書架上擺滿了歷史和文學方面的書。
sentences.pinyin: Shūjià shang bǎi mǎn le lìshǐ hé wénxué fāngmiàn de shū.
sentences.translation: The bookshelf is full of books on history and literature.

sentences.chinese: 搬家时，这个木制书架差点被碰坏。
sentences.traditional: 搬家時，這個木製書架差點被碰壞。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiā shí, zhè ge mùzhì shūjià chàdiǎn bèi pèng huài.
sentences.translation: When moving house, this wooden bookshelf was nearly damaged by a knock.

sentences.chinese: 为了节省空间，他在墙上安装了一排书架。
sentences.traditional: 為了節省空間，他在牆上安裝了一排書架。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng kōngjiān, tā zài qiáng shang ānzhuāng le yì pái shūjià.
sentences.translation: To save space, he installed a row of bookshelves on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 请在系统中输入你的身份证号码。
sentences.traditional: 請在系統中輸入你的身分證號碼。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài xìtǒng zhōng shūrù nǐ de shēnfènzhèng hàomǎ.
sentences.translation: Please enter your identity card number into the system.

sentences.chinese: 数据输入错误会导致最终结果不准确。
sentences.traditional: 數據輸入錯誤會導致最終結果不準確。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù shūrù cuòwù huì dǎozhì zuìzhōng jiéguǒ bù zhǔnquè.
sentences.translation: Data input errors can lead to inaccurate final results.

sentences.chinese: 如果密码连续输入三次错误，账户就会被锁定。
sentences.traditional: 如果密碼連續輸入三次錯誤，帳戶就會被鎖定。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ mìmǎ liánxù shūrù sān cì cuòwù, zhànghù jiù huì bèi suǒdìng.
sentences.translation: If the password is entered incorrectly three times in a row, the account will be locked.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒店的房间很舒适，价格也不算高。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店的房間很舒適，價格也不算高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de fángjiān hěn shūshì, jiàgé yě bú suàn gāo.
sentences.translation: The rooms in this hotel are comfortable, and the price is not too high either.

sentences.chinese: 舒适的工作环境能提高员工的效率。
sentences.traditional: 舒適的工作環境能提高員工的效率。
sentences.pinyin: Shūshì de gōngzuò huánjìng néng tígāo yuángōng de xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: A comfortable working environment can improve employees’ efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 这把椅子看起来普通，坐起来却非常舒适。
sentences.traditional: 這把椅子看起來普通，坐起來卻非常舒適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yǐzi kàn qǐlai pǔtōng, zuò qǐlai què fēicháng shūshì.
sentences.translation: This chair looks ordinary, but it is extremely comfortable to sit in.

sentences.chinese: 经过半年培训，她已经能熟练地操作这套系统。
sentences.traditional: 經過半年培訓，她已經能熟練地操作這套系統。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò bànnián péixùn, tā yǐjīng néng shúliàn de cāozuò zhè tào xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: After half a year of training, she can already operate this system proficiently.

sentences.chinese: 想要熟练掌握一门语言，光背单词是不够的。
sentences.traditional: 想要熟練掌握一門語言，光背單詞是不夠的。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shúliàn zhǎngwò yì mén yǔyán, guāng bèi dāncí shì bú gòu de.
sentences.translation: To master a language skilfully, merely memorising words is not enough.

sentences.chinese: 他动作熟练，一看就是有多年经验的师傅。
sentences.traditional: 他動作熟練，一看就是有多年經驗的師傅。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dòngzuò shúliàn, yí kàn jiù shì yǒu duō nián jīngyàn de shīfu.
sentences.translation: His movements are skilled; you can tell at once that he is a master with years of experience.

sentences.chinese: 在陌生城市里遇到熟人，会让人觉得特别亲切。
sentences.traditional: 在陌生城市裡遇到熟人，會讓人覺得特別親切。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mòshēng chéngshì lǐ yùdào shúrén, huì ràng rén juéde tèbié qīnqiè.
sentences.translation: Meeting an acquaintance in an unfamiliar city can make people feel especially close.

sentences.chinese: 这件事最好不要随便告诉熟人，以免传出去。
sentences.traditional: 這件事最好不要隨便告訴熟人，以免傳出去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zuì hǎo bú yào suíbiàn gàosu shúrén, yǐmiǎn chuán chūqu.
sentences.translation: It is best not to tell acquaintances about this casually, in case it gets spread around.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然只是个熟人，却在关键时候帮了我很大的忙。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然只是個熟人，卻在關鍵時候幫了我很大的忙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán zhǐ shì ge shúrén, què zài guānjiàn shíhou bāng le wǒ hěn dà de máng.
sentences.translation: Although he is only an acquaintance, he helped me a great deal at a crucial moment.

sentences.chinese: 老师让学生数一下教室里有多少把椅子。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓學生數一下教室裡有多少把椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng xuéshēng shǔ yí xià jiàoshì lǐ yǒu duōshǎo bǎ yǐzi.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the students to count how many chairs there were in the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 她把零钱认真数了两遍，确认金额没有错。
sentences.traditional: 她把零錢認真數了兩遍，確認金額沒有錯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ língqián rènzhēn shǔ le liǎng biàn, quèrèn jīn’é méiyǒu cuò.
sentences.translation: She counted the small change carefully twice to confirm that the amount was not wrong.

sentences.chinese: 孩子还小，只能从一数到二十。
sentences.traditional: 孩子還小，只能從一數到二十。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi hái xiǎo, zhǐ néng cóng yī shǔ dào èrshí.
sentences.translation: The child is still young and can only count from one to twenty.

sentences.chinese: 这个鼠标用了三年，按键已经不太灵敏了。
sentences.traditional: 這個鼠標用了三年，按鍵已經不太靈敏了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge shǔbiāo yòng le sān nián, ànjiàn yǐjīng bú tài língmǐn le.
sentences.translation: This mouse has been used for three years, and the buttons are already not very responsive.

sentences.chinese: 如果鼠标不能移动，先检查电池和连接。
sentences.traditional: 如果鼠標不能移動，先檢查電池和連接。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shǔbiāo bù néng yídòng, xiān jiǎnchá diànchí hé liánjiē.
sentences.translation: If the mouse cannot move, first check the battery and the connection.

sentences.chinese: 他习惯用无线鼠标，桌面看起来更整洁。
sentences.traditional: 他習慣用無線鼠標，桌面看起來更整潔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xíguàn yòng wúxiàn shǔbiāo, zhuōmiàn kàn qǐlai gèng zhěngjié.
sentences.translation: He is used to using a wireless mouse, so the desk looks tidier.

sentences.chinese: 这些资料属于公司，离职时必须交回。
sentences.traditional: 這些資料屬於公司，離職時必須交回。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīliào shǔyú gōngsī, lízhí shí bìxū jiāo huí.
sentences.translation: These materials belong to the company and must be returned when leaving the job.

sentences.chinese: 判断一件作品是否属于文学，要看它的表达方式。
sentences.traditional: 判斷一件作品是否屬於文學，要看它的表達方式。
sentences.pinyin: Pànduàn yí jiàn zuòpǐn shìfǒu shǔyú wénxué, yào kàn tā de biǎodá fāngshì.
sentences.translation: To judge whether a work belongs to literature, you need to look at its way of expression.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题属于历史原因造成的，短期内很难解决。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題屬於歷史原因造成的，短期內很難解決。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí shǔyú lìshǐ yuányīn zàochéng de, duǎnqī nèi hěn nán jiějué.
sentences.translation: This problem is due to historical causes and is difficult to solve in the short term.

sentences.chinese: 他给母亲买了一束鲜花，感谢她多年的照顾。
sentences.traditional: 他給母親買了一束鮮花，感謝她多年的照顧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi mǔqīn mǎi le yí shù xiānhuā, gǎnxiè tā duō nián de zhàogù.
sentences.translation: He bought his mother a bunch of fresh flowers to thank her for many years of care.

sentences.chinese: 清晨，一束阳光从窗帘缝里照进来。
sentences.traditional: 清晨，一束陽光從窗簾縫裡照進來。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén, yí shù yángguāng cóng chuānglián fèng lǐ zhào jìnlai.
sentences.translation: In the early morning, a beam of sunlight shone in through a gap in the curtains.

sentences.chinese: 理发师剪下了一束头发，准备检查发质。
sentences.traditional: 理髮師剪下了一束頭髮，準備檢查髮質。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐfàshī jiǎn xià le yí shù tóufa, zhǔnbèi jiǎnchá fàzhì.
sentences.translation: The hairdresser cut off a lock of hair and prepared to examine its quality.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员正在分析这些数据，以判断市场趋势。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員正在分析這些數據，以判斷市場趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán zhèngzài fēnxī zhèxiē shùjù, yǐ pànduàn shìchǎng qūshì.
sentences.translation: Researchers are analysing this data to judge market trends.

sentences.chinese: 如果数据来源不可靠，结论也可能有问题。
sentences.traditional: 如果數據來源不可靠，結論也可能有問題。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shùjù láiyuán bù kěkào, jiélùn yě kěnéng yǒu wèntí.
sentences.translation: If the data source is unreliable, the conclusion may also have problems.

sentences.chinese: 公司会根据销售数据调整明年的生产计划。
sentences.traditional: 公司會根據銷售數據調整明年的生產計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī huì gēnjù xiāoshòu shùjù tiáozhěng míngnián de shēngchǎn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The company will adjust next year’s production plan according to sales data.

sentences.chinese: 城市建设不能只追求速度，也要保护原有的树木。
sentences.traditional: 城市建設不能只追求速度，也要保護原有的樹木。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì jiànshè bùnéng zhǐ zhuīqiú sùdù, yě yào bǎohù yuányǒu de shùmù.
sentences.translation: Urban construction cannot only pursue speed; it must also protect the original trees.

sentences.chinese: 暴风雨过后，公园里有几棵树木被吹倒了。
sentences.traditional: 暴風雨過後，公園裡有幾棵樹木被吹倒了。
sentences.pinyin: Bàofēngyǔ guò hòu, gōngyuán lǐ yǒu jǐ kē shùmù bèi chuī dǎo le.
sentences.translation: After the storm, several trees in the park were blown over.

sentences.chinese: 这些树木生长得很慢，需要长期管理。
sentences.traditional: 這些樹木生長得很慢，需要長期管理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùmù shēngzhǎng de hěn màn, xūyào chángqī guǎnlǐ.
sentences.translation: These trees grow very slowly and need long-term management.

sentences.chinese: 他下楼时不小心摔了一跤，膝盖受了伤。
sentences.traditional: 他下樓時不小心摔了一跤，膝蓋受了傷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xià lóu shí bù xiǎoxīn shuāi le yì jiāo, xīgài shòu le shāng.
sentences.translation: He accidentally fell while going downstairs and injured his knee.

sentences.chinese: 别把手机随便放在桌边，容易摔坏。
sentences.traditional: 別把手機隨便放在桌邊，容易摔壞。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ shǒujī suíbiàn fàng zài zhuō biān, róngyì shuāi huài.
sentences.translation: Do not put your phone casually on the edge of the desk; it can easily get broken from falling.

sentences.chinese: 那个孩子一生气就摔东西，父母正在教他控制情绪。
sentences.traditional: 那個孩子一生氣就摔東西，父母正在教他控制情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge háizi yì shēngqì jiù shuāi dōngxi, fùmǔ zhèngzài jiāo tā kòngzhì qíngxù.
sentences.translation: That child throws things whenever he gets angry, and his parents are teaching him to control his emotions.

sentences.chinese: 合同签订后，双方都必须按照约定执行。
sentences.traditional: 合約簽訂後，雙方都必須按照約定執行。
sentences.pinyin: Héyuē qiāndìng hòu, shuāngfāng dōu bìxū ànzhào yuēdìng zhíxíng.
sentences.translation: After the contract is signed, both parties must carry it out according to the agreement.

sentences.chinese: 经过三轮谈判，双方终于达成了合作协议。
sentences.traditional: 經過三輪談判，雙方終於達成了合作協議。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò sān lún tánpàn, shuāngfāng zhōngyú dáchéng le hézuò xiéyì.
sentences.translation: After three rounds of negotiations, both sides finally reached a cooperation agreement.

sentences.chinese: 解决矛盾时，应该认真听取双方的意见。
sentences.traditional: 解決矛盾時，應該認真聽取雙方的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Jiějué máodùn shí, yīnggāi rènzhēn tīngqǔ shuāngfāng de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: When resolving a conflict, you should carefully listen to the opinions of both sides.

sentences.chinese: 这种水果水分很足，适合夏天吃。
sentences.traditional: 這種水果水分很足，適合夏天吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ shuǐfèn hěn zú, shìhé xiàtiān chī.
sentences.translation: This kind of fruit has plenty of moisture and is suitable for eating in summer.

sentences.chinese: 运动后身体会流失大量水分，应该及时补充。
sentences.traditional: 運動後身體會流失大量水分，應該及時補充。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng hòu shēntǐ huì liúshī dàliàng shuǐfèn, yīnggāi jíshí bǔchōng.
sentences.translation: After exercise, the body loses a large amount of water, so it should be replaced promptly.

sentences.chinese: 土壤水分不足时，植物的生长速度会明显下降。
sentences.traditional: 土壤水分不足時，植物的生長速度會明顯下降。
sentences.pinyin: Tǔrǎng shuǐfèn bùzú shí, zhíwù de shēngzhǎng sùdù huì míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: When the soil lacks moisture, the growth rate of plants drops noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 公司每年都要按规定交税，不能随便逃避。
sentences.traditional: 公司每年都要按規定交稅，不能隨便逃避。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī měi nián dōu yào àn guīdìng jiāo shuì, bùnéng suíbiàn táobì.
sentences.translation: The company has to pay tax according to the rules every year and cannot simply avoid it.

sentences.chinese: 这件商品的价格已经包括了税和运费。
sentences.traditional: 這件商品的價格已經包括了稅和運費。
