sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shāngpǐn de jiàgé yǐjīng bāokuò le shuì hé yùnfèi.
sentences.translation: The price of this product already includes tax and delivery costs.

sentences.chinese: 政府降低了部分行业的税，以鼓励企业投资。
sentences.traditional: 政府降低了部分行業的稅，以鼓勵企業投資。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiàngdī le bùfen hángyè de shuì, yǐ gǔlì qǐyè tóuzī.
sentences.translation: The government lowered taxes in some industries to encourage business investment.

sentences.chinese: 良好的睡眠有助于提高记忆力和工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 良好的睡眠有助於提高記憶力和工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de shuìmián yǒuzhù yú tígāo jìyìlì hé gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Good sleep helps improve memory and work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 长期睡眠不足会影响情绪，也会影响身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 長期睡眠不足會影響情緒，也會影響身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī shuìmián bùzú huì yǐngxiǎng qíngxù, yě huì yǐngxiǎng shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Long-term lack of sleep affects mood and also affects physical health.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他记录每天的睡眠时间，找出失眠的原因。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他記錄每天的睡眠時間，找出失眠的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā jìlù měi tiān de shuìmián shíjiān, zhǎo chū shīmián de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to record his daily sleep time to find the cause of his insomnia.

sentences.chinese: 请你顺着这条路一直走，就能看到地铁站。
sentences.traditional: 請你順著這條路一直走，就能看到地鐵站。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shùnzhe zhè tiáo lù yìzhí zǒu, jiù néng kàndào dìtiězhàn.
sentences.translation: Please go along this road and you will be able to see the underground station.

sentences.chinese: 他把文件按日期顺了一遍，查找起来方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 他把文件按日期順了一遍，查找起來方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wénjiàn àn rìqī shùn le yí biàn, cházhǎo qǐlai fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: He arranged the documents by date, making them much easier to look through.

sentences.chinese: 这次会议进行得很顺，没有出现大的争议。
sentences.traditional: 這次會議進行得很順，沒有出現大的爭議。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì jìnxíng de hěn shùn, méiyǒu chūxiàn dà de zhēngyì.
sentences.translation: This meeting went very smoothly, with no major disagreements.

sentences.chinese: 天气变化很快，说不定下午还会下雨。
sentences.traditional: 天氣變化很快，說不定下午還會下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài, shuōbudìng xiàwǔ hái huì xià yǔ.
sentences.translation: The weather changes very quickly; perhaps it will rain again this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 他现在没有回复，说不定正在开会。
sentences.traditional: 他現在沒有回覆，說不定正在開會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài méiyǒu huífù, shuōbudìng zhèngzài kāi huì.
sentences.translation: He has not replied yet; maybe he is in a meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案虽然冒险，但说不定能带来意想不到的效果。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案雖然冒險，但說不定能帶來意想不到的效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge fāng'àn suīrán màoxiǎn, dàn shuōbudìng néng dàilái yìxiǎng-búdào de xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: Although this plan is risky, it might bring unexpected results.

sentences.chinese: 经理花了很长时间才说服客户接受新的价格。
sentences.traditional: 經理花了很長時間才說服客戶接受新的價格。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ huā le hěn cháng shíjiān cái shuōfú kèhù jiēshòu xīn de jiàgé.
sentences.translation: The manager spent a long time persuading the client to accept the new price.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有充分的证据，你很难说服大家改变看法。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有充分的證據，你很難說服大家改變看法。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu chōngfèn de zhèngjù, nǐ hěn nán shuōfú dàjiā gǎibiàn kànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Without sufficient evidence, it is very hard to persuade everyone to change their view.

sentences.chinese: 她用自己的经历说服了许多年轻人继续学习。
sentences.traditional: 她用自己的經歷說服了許多年輕人繼續學習。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng zìjǐ de jīnglì shuōfú le xǔduō niánqīngrén jìxù xuéxí.
sentences.translation: She used her own experience to persuade many young people to continue studying.

sentences.chinese: 遇到复杂问题时，先冷静思考比马上行动更重要。
sentences.traditional: 遇到複雜問題時，先冷靜思考比馬上行動更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào fùzá wèntí shí, xiān lěngjìng sīkǎo bǐ mǎshàng xíngdòng gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When facing a complicated problem, thinking calmly first is more important than acting immediately.

sentences.chinese: 老师鼓励学生独立思考，而不是只记标准答案。
sentences.traditional: 老師鼓勵學生獨立思考，而不是只記標準答案。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì xuéshēng dúlì sīkǎo, ér bú shì zhǐ jì biāozhǔn dá'àn.
sentences.translation: The teacher encourages students to think independently rather than only memorise standard answers.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定关系到未来发展，需要认真思考后再公布。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定關係到未來發展，需要認真思考後再公佈。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge juédìng guānxì dào wèilái fāzhǎn, xūyào rènzhēn sīkǎo hòu zài gōngbù.
sentences.translation: This decision concerns future development and needs to be considered carefully before being announced.

sentences.chinese: 这是他的私人邮箱，不适合用来处理公司事务。
sentences.traditional: 這是他的私人信箱，不適合用來處理公司事務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì tā de sīrén yóuxiāng, bù shìhé yòng lái chǔlǐ gōngsī shìwù.
sentences.translation: This is his private email account and is not suitable for handling company business.

sentences.chinese: 未经允许，不要公开别人的私人信息。
sentences.traditional: 未經允許，不要公開別人的私人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Wèijīng yǔnxǔ, bú yào gōngkāi biérén de sīrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Do not make other people’s personal information public without permission.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然是公众人物，但仍然需要一定的私人空间。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然是公眾人物，但仍然需要一定的私人空間。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán shì gōngzhòng rénwù, dàn réngrán xūyào yídìng de sīrén kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: Although he is a public figure, he still needs a certain amount of private space.

sentences.chinese: 学习数学可以训练人的逻辑思维能力。
sentences.traditional: 學習數學可以訓練人的邏輯思維能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí shùxué kěyǐ xùnliàn rén de luóji sīwéi nénglì.
sentences.translation: Studying mathematics can train a person’s logical thinking ability.

sentences.chinese: 换一个角度思维，也许能找到新的解决办法。
sentences.traditional: 換一個角度思維，也許能找到新的解決辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Huàn yí ge jiǎodù sīwéi, yěxǔ néng zhǎodào xīn de jiějué bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Thinking from another angle may help you find a new solution.

sentences.chinese: 传统思维有时会限制创新，企业必须不断改变。
sentences.traditional: 傳統思維有時會限制創新，企業必須不斷改變。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīwéi yǒushí huì xiànzhì chuàngxīn, qǐyè bìxū búduàn gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: Traditional thinking sometimes limits innovation, so companies must keep changing.

sentences.chinese: 这本书记录了作者多年来形成的思想。
sentences.traditional: 這本書記錄了作者多年來形成的思想。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jìlù le zuòzhě duō nián lái xíngchéng de sīxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This book records the ideas the author has formed over many years.

sentences.chinese: 教育不只是传授知识，也要帮助学生形成独立的思想。
sentences.traditional: 教育不只是傳授知識，也要幫助學生形成獨立的思想。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù bú zhǐ shì chuánshòu zhīshi, yě yào bāngzhù xuéshēng xíngchéng dúlì de sīxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Education is not just about passing on knowledge; it should also help students form independent ideas.

sentences.chinese: 不同文化之间的交流能够丰富人们的思想。
sentences.traditional: 不同文化之間的交流能夠豐富人們的思想。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng wénhuà zhījiān de jiāoliú nénggòu fēngfù rénmen de sīxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Communication between different cultures can enrich people’s thinking.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，游客四处寻找有地方特色的小吃。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，遊客四處尋找有地方特色的小吃。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, yóukè sìchù xúnzhǎo yǒu dìfāng tèsè de xiǎochī.
sentences.translation: During Spring Festival, tourists looked everywhere for snacks with local characteristics.

sentences.chinese: 暴风雨过后，院子里四处都是被吹落的树叶。
sentences.traditional: 暴風雨過後，院子裡四處都是被吹落的樹葉。
sentences.pinyin: Bàofēngyǔ guò hòu, yuànzi lǐ sìchù dōu shì bèi chuīluò de shùyè.
sentences.translation: After the storm, fallen leaves were everywhere in the yard.

sentences.chinese: 他刚到新城市时，喜欢四处走走，熟悉周围环境。
sentences.traditional: 他剛到新城市時，喜歡四處走走，熟悉周圍環境。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng dào xīn chéngshì shí, xǐhuān sìchù zǒuzou, shúxī zhōuwéi huánjìng.
sentences.translation: When he had just arrived in the new city, he liked walking around to get familiar with the surroundings.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革似乎很简单，实际操作起来却不容易。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革似乎很簡單，實際操作起來卻不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé sìhū hěn jiǎndān, shíjì cāozuò qǐlai què bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: This reform seems simple, but it is not easy to carry out in practice.

sentences.chinese: 他最近似乎压力很大，连平时喜欢的活动也不参加了。
sentences.traditional: 他最近似乎壓力很大，連平時喜歡的活動也不參加了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn sìhū yālì hěn dà, lián píngshí xǐhuān de huódòng yě bù cānjiā le.
sentences.translation: He seems to be under a lot of pressure recently; he no longer even joins the activities he usually likes.

sentences.chinese: 这个解释似乎有道理，但还需要更多证据。
sentences.traditional: 這個解釋似乎有道理，但還需要更多證據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jiěshì sìhū yǒu dàolǐ, dàn hái xūyào gèng duō zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: This explanation seems reasonable, but more evidence is still needed.

sentences.chinese: 村子的四周都是山，交通以前很不方便。
sentences.traditional: 村子的四周都是山，交通以前很不方便。
sentences.pinyin: Cūnzi de sìzhōu dōu shì shān, jiāotōng yǐqián hěn bù fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: There are mountains all around the village, so transport used to be very inconvenient.

sentences.chinese: 他站在广场中央，观察四周的人群。
sentences.traditional: 他站在廣場中央，觀察四周的人群。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài guǎngchǎng zhōngyāng, guānchá sìzhōu de rénqún.
sentences.translation: He stood in the centre of the square and observed the crowd around him.

sentences.chinese: 为了安全，工作人员仔细检查了舞台四周的设备。
sentences.traditional: 為了安全，工作人員仔細檢查了舞臺四周的設備。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ānquán, gōngzuò rényuán zǐxì jiǎnchá le wǔtái sìzhōu de shèbèi.
sentences.translation: For safety, the staff carefully checked the equipment around the stage.

sentences.chinese: 警察在附近搜了两个小时，终于找到了丢失的孩子。
sentences.traditional: 警察在附近搜了兩個小時，終於找到了丟失的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá zài fùjìn sōu le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, zhōngyú zhǎodào le diūshī de háizi.
sentences.translation: The police searched nearby for two hours and finally found the missing child.

sentences.chinese: 我把整个抽屉都搜了一遍，还是没找到发票。
sentences.traditional: 我把整個抽屜都搜了一遍，還是沒找到發票。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhěng ge chōuti dōu sōu le yí biàn, háishi méi zhǎodào fāpiào.
sentences.translation: I searched the whole drawer once, but still could not find the invoice.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想了解更多资料，可以先在网上搜一下。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想了解更多資料，可以先在網上搜一下。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě gèng duō zīliào, kěyǐ xiān zài wǎngshàng sōu yíxià.
sentences.translation: If you want to learn more information, you can search online first.

sentences.chinese: 这个软件可以帮助用户快速搜索相关文件。
sentences.traditional: 這個軟件可以幫助用戶快速搜索相關文件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ bāngzhù yònghù kuàisù sōusuǒ xiāngguān wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: This software can help users quickly search for related files.

sentences.chinese: 搜索信息时，要注意资料的来源是否可靠。
sentences.traditional: 搜索信息時，要注意資料的來源是否可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Sōusuǒ xìnxī shí, yào zhùyì zīliào de láiyuán shìfǒu kěkào.
sentences.translation: When searching for information, you need to pay attention to whether the source is reliable.

sentences.chinese: 救援队正在山区搜索失踪的登山者。
sentences.traditional: 救援隊正在山區搜索失蹤的登山者。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùyuán duì zhèngzài shānqū sōusuǒ shīzōng de dēngshānzhě.
sentences.translation: The rescue team is searching in the mountain area for the missing climber.

sentences.chinese: 大学新生一般先住在学校安排的宿舍里。
sentences.traditional: 大學新生一般先住在學校安排的宿舍裡。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxué xīnshēng yìbān xiān zhù zài xuéxiào ānpái de sùshè lǐ.
sentences.translation: New university students usually first live in the dormitories arranged by the school.

sentences.chinese: 宿舍的空间虽然不大，但同学们布置得很整洁。
sentences.traditional: 宿舍的空間雖然不大，但同學們佈置得很整潔。
sentences.pinyin: Sùshè de kōngjiān suīrán bú dà, dàn tóngxuémen bùzhì de hěn zhěngjié.
sentences.translation: Although the dormitory space is not large, the students have arranged it very neatly.

sentences.chinese: 为了不影响别人，他回宿舍后尽量小声说话。
sentences.traditional: 為了不影響別人，他回宿舍後盡量小聲說話。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bù yǐngxiǎng biérén, tā huí sùshè hòu jǐnliàng xiǎoshēng shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: In order not to disturb others, he speaks as quietly as possible after returning to the dormitory.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说写出了普通人生活中的酸甜苦辣。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說寫出了普通人生活中的酸甜苦辣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō xiě chū le pǔtōngrén shēnghuó zhōng de suān-tián-kǔ-là.
sentences.translation: This novel describes the joys and sorrows in ordinary people’s lives.

sentences.chinese: 在外工作多年，他尝遍了人生的酸甜苦辣。
sentences.traditional: 在外工作多年，他嚐遍了人生的酸甜苦辣。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wài gōngzuò duō nián, tā cháng biàn le rénshēng de suān-tián-kǔ-là.
sentences.translation: After working away from home for many years, he experienced all the joys and hardships of life.

sentences.chinese: 只有经历过创业的酸甜苦辣，才会真正理解成功来之不易。
sentences.traditional: 只有經歷過創業的酸甜苦辣，才會真正理解成功來之不易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jīnglì guò chuàngyè de suān-tián-kǔ-là, cái huì zhēnzhèng lǐjiě chénggōng lái zhī bù yì.
sentences.translation: Only after experiencing the ups and downs of starting a business can one truly understand that success does not come easily.

sentences.chinese: 孩子太小，不能随父母一起参加这么长的会议。
sentences.traditional: 孩子太小，不能隨父母一起參加這麼長的會議。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tài xiǎo, bùnéng suí fùmǔ yìqǐ cānjiā zhème cháng de huìyì.
sentences.translation: The child is too young to go with his parents to such a long meeting.

sentences.chinese: 资料请随邮件一起发送给客户。
sentences.traditional: 資料請隨郵件一起發送給客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Zīliào qǐng suí yóujiàn yìqǐ fāsòng gěi kèhù.
sentences.translation: Please send the materials to the client together with the email.

sentences.chinese: 他决定随团队去山区做调查，而不是留在办公室。
sentences.traditional: 他決定隨團隊去山區做調查，而不是留在辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng suí tuánduì qù shānqū zuò diàochá, ér bú shì liú zài bàngōngshì.
sentences.translation: He decided to go with the team to the mountain area to carry out the survey rather than stay in the office.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，经理随后向大家公布了新的安排。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，經理隨後向大家公佈了新的安排。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, jīnglǐ suíhòu xiàng dàjiā gōngbù le xīn de ānpái.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, the manager then announced the new arrangements to everyone.

sentences.chinese: 火车先到达南京，随后继续开往上海。
sentences.traditional: 火車先到達南京，隨後繼續開往上海。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē xiān dàodá Nánjīng, suíhòu jìxù kāi wǎng Shànghǎi.
sentences.translation: The train first arrives in Nanjing and then continues on to Shanghai.

sentences.chinese: 他先检查了数据，随后才开始写报告。
sentences.traditional: 他先檢查了數據，隨後才開始寫報告。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiān jiǎnchá le shùjù, suíhòu cái kāishǐ xiě bàogào.
sentences.translation: He first checked the data and only afterwards began writing the report.

sentences.chinese: 如果有新的情况，请随时告诉我。
sentences.traditional: 如果有新的情況，請隨時告訴我。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu xīn de qíngkuàng, qǐng suíshí gàosu wǒ.
sentences.translation: Please tell me at any time if there is any new situation.

sentences.chinese: 这份资料放在共享文件夹里，大家可以随时查看。
sentences.traditional: 這份資料放在共享資料夾裡，大家可以隨時查看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn zīliào fàng zài gòngxiǎng wénjiànjiā lǐ, dàjiā kěyǐ suíshí chákàn.
sentences.translation: This material is in the shared folder, so everyone can check it at any time.

sentences.chinese: 设备运行过程中，技术人员要随时关注温度变化。
sentences.traditional: 設備運行過程中，技術人員要隨時關注溫度變化。
sentences.pinyin: Shèbèi yùnxíng guòchéng zhōng, jìshù rényuán yào suíshí guānzhù wēndù biànhuà.
sentences.translation: While the equipment is running, technicians must monitor temperature changes at all times.

sentences.chinese: 出门前请随手把灯关掉。
sentences.traditional: 出門前請隨手把燈關掉。
sentences.pinyin: Chūmén qián qǐng suíshǒu bǎ dēng guān diào.
sentences.translation: Please turn off the light on your way out.

sentences.chinese: 他随手把文件放在桌上，后来找了半天。
sentences.traditional: 他隨手把文件放在桌上，後來找了半天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suíshǒu bǎ wénjiàn fàng zài zhuō shang, hòulái zhǎo le bàntiān.
sentences.translation: He casually put the document on the desk and later spent ages looking for it.

sentences.chinese: 看到地上的垃圾，她随手捡起来扔进垃圾桶。
sentences.traditional: 看到地上的垃圾，她隨手撿起來扔進垃圾桶。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào dì shang de lājī, tā suíshǒu jiǎn qǐlai rēng jìn lājītǒng.
sentences.translation: Seeing rubbish on the ground, she picked it up and threw it into the bin without fuss.

sentences.chinese: 会议记录不能随意修改，必须先得到负责人同意。
sentences.traditional: 會議記錄不能隨意修改，必須先得到負責人同意。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jìlù bùnéng suíyì xiūgǎi, bìxū xiān dédào fùzérén tóngyì.
sentences.translation: Meeting records must not be changed casually; approval from the person in charge is required first.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅气氛轻松，客人可以随意选择座位。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳氣氛輕鬆，客人可以隨意選擇座位。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng qìfēn qīngsōng, kèrén kěyǐ suíyì xuǎnzé zuòwèi.
sentences.translation: This restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere, and customers can choose seats as they like.

sentences.chinese: 对待公共资源，不应该随意浪费。
sentences.traditional: 對待公共資源，不應該隨意浪費。
sentences.pinyin: Duìdài gōnggòng zīyuán, bù yīnggāi suíyì làngfèi.
sentences.translation: When dealing with public resources, we should not waste them casually.

sentences.chinese: 杯子掉到地上，碎成了好几块。
sentences.traditional: 杯子掉到地上，碎成了好幾塊。
sentences.pinyin: Bēizi diào dào dì shang, suì chéng le hǎo jǐ kuài.
sentences.translation: The cup fell to the ground and broke into several pieces.

sentences.chinese: 这些信息太碎，需要整理成完整的报告。
sentences.traditional: 這些信息太碎，需要整理成完整的報告。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīxùn tài suì, xūyào zhěnglǐ chéng wánzhěng de bàogào.
sentences.translation: This information is too fragmented and needs to be organised into a complete report.

sentences.chinese: 孩子不小心把盘子摔碎了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子不小心把盤子摔碎了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bù xiǎoxīn bǎ pánzi shuāi suì le.
sentences.translation: The child accidentally dropped the plate and broke it.

sentences.chinese: 虚假信息会损害公司的信誉。
sentences.traditional: 虛假信息會損害公司的信譽。
sentences.pinyin: Xūjiǎ zīxùn huì sǔnhài gōngsī de xìnyù.
sentences.translation: False information can damage a company’s reputation.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺乏睡眠可能损害身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺乏睡眠可能損害身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá shuìmián kěnéng sǔnhài shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Long-term lack of sleep may harm physical health.

sentences.chinese: 这种做法不仅损害环境，也影响居民生活。
sentences.traditional: 這種做法不僅損害環境，也影響居民生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ bùjǐn sǔnhài huánjìng, yě yǐngxiǎng jūmín shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This practice not only harms the environment but also affects residents’ lives.

sentences.chinese: 大雨给当地农民造成了严重损失。
sentences.traditional: 大雨給當地農民造成了嚴重損失。
sentences.pinyin: Dàyǔ gěi dāngdì nóngmín zàochéng le yánzhòng sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: The heavy rain caused serious losses for local farmers.

sentences.chinese: 如果不及时处理，公司可能损失更多客户。
sentences.traditional: 如果不及時處理，公司可能損失更多客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí chǔlǐ, gōngsī kěnéng sǔnshī gèng duō kèhù.
sentences.translation: If it is not dealt with promptly, the company may lose even more customers.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少损失，工厂决定暂时停止生产。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少損失，工廠決定暫時停止生產。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo sǔnshī, gōngchǎng juédìng zànshí tíngzhǐ shēngchǎn.
sentences.translation: To reduce losses, the factory decided to stop production temporarily.

sentences.chinese: 新系统可以缩短客户等待的时间。
sentences.traditional: 新系統可以縮短客戶等待的時間。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng kěyǐ suōduǎn kèhù děngdài de shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The new system can shorten the time customers spend waiting.

sentences.chinese: 为了赶上进度，经理决定缩短会议时间。
sentences.traditional: 為了趕上進度，經理決定縮短會議時間。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile gǎn shàng jìndù, jīnglǐ juédìng suōduǎn huìyì shíjiān.
sentences.translation: In order to catch up with the schedule, the manager decided to shorten the meeting time.

sentences.chinese: 高铁开通后，两地之间的通勤时间明显缩短了。
sentences.traditional: 高鐵開通後，兩地之間的通勤時間明顯縮短了。
sentences.pinyin: Gāotiě kāitōng hòu, liǎng dì zhījiān de tōngqín shíjiān míngxiǎn suōduǎn le.
sentences.translation: After the high-speed rail opened, the commuting time between the two places was clearly shortened.

sentences.chinese: 政府希望通过教育缩小城乡差距。
sentences.traditional: 政府希望通過教育縮小城鄉差距。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xīwàng tōngguò jiàoyù suōxiǎo chéngxiāng chājù.
sentences.translation: The government hopes to reduce the gap between urban and rural areas through education.

sentences.chinese: 他们把图片缩小后放进了报告。
sentences.traditional: 他們把圖片縮小後放進了報告。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bǎ túpiàn suōxiǎo hòu fàng jìn le bàogào.
sentences.translation: They reduced the size of the image and put it into the report.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在努力缩小成本与收入之间的差距。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在努力縮小成本與收入之間的差距。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài nǔlì suōxiǎo chéngběn yǔ shōurù zhījiān de chājù.
sentences.translation: The company is working hard to narrow the gap between costs and income.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校正在建设新的图书馆。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校正在建設新的圖書館。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào zhèngzài jiànshè xīn de túshūguǎn.
sentences.translation: This school is building a new library.

sentences.chinese: 市中心新开了一所专门培训技术人员的学院。
sentences.traditional: 市中心新開了一所專門培訓技術人員的學院。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhōngxīn xīn kāi le yì suǒ zhuānmén péixùn jìshù rényuán de xuéyuàn.
sentences.translation: A college specialising in training technical staff has newly opened in the city centre.

sentences.chinese: 这所医院引进了更先进的设备。
sentences.traditional: 這所醫院引進了更先進的設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ yīyuàn yǐnjìn le gèng xiānjìn de shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This hospital has introduced more advanced equipment.

sentences.chinese: 离开办公室前，请把门锁好。
sentences.traditional: 離開辦公室前，請把門鎖好。
sentences.pinyin: Líkāi bàngōngshì qián, qǐng bǎ mén suǒ hǎo.
sentences.translation: Please lock the door properly before leaving the office.

sentences.chinese: 我的自行车锁坏了，只能暂时放在家里。
sentences.traditional: 我的自行車鎖壞了，只能暫時放在家裡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de zìxíngchē suǒ huài le, zhǐ néng zànshí fàng zài jiā lǐ.
sentences.translation: My bicycle lock is broken, so I can only keep the bike at home for now.

sentences.chinese: 重要文件已经锁在柜子里了。
sentences.traditional: 重要文件已經鎖在櫃子裡了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhòngyào wénjiàn yǐjīng suǒ zài guìzi lǐ le.
sentences.translation: The important documents have already been locked in the cabinet.

sentences.chinese: 在公共场合说话时，要考虑他人的感受。
sentences.traditional: 在公共場合說話時，要考慮他人的感受。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gōnggòng chǎnghé shuōhuà shí, yào kǎolǜ tārén de gǎnshòu.
sentences.translation: When speaking in public, you should consider other people’s feelings.

sentences.chinese: 未经允许，不要使用他人的照片。
sentences.traditional: 未經允許，不要使用他人的照片。
sentences.pinyin: Wèijīng yǔnxǔ, bú yào shǐyòng tārén de zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: Do not use other people’s photos without permission.

sentences.chinese: 帮助他人也是一种社会责任。
sentences.traditional: 幫助他人也是一種社會責任。
sentences.pinyin: Bāngzhù tārén yě shì yì zhǒng shèhuì zérèn.
sentences.translation: Helping others is also a kind of social responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 我把台灯调暗了一点，这样晚上看书不会太刺眼。
sentences.traditional: 我把檯燈調暗了一點，這樣晚上看書不會太刺眼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ táidēng tiáo àn le yìdiǎn, zhèyàng wǎnshang kàn shū bú huì tài cìyǎn.
sentences.translation: I dimmed the desk lamp a little so that reading at night would not be too glaring.

sentences.chinese: 这盏台灯虽然不贵，但光线很稳定，适合写作业。
sentences.traditional: 這盞檯燈雖然不貴，但光線很穩定，適合寫作業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǎn táidēng suīrán bú guì, dàn guāngxiàn hěn wěndìng, shìhé xiě zuòyè.
sentences.translation: This desk lamp is not expensive, but its light is very stable and suitable for doing homework.

sentences.chinese: 办公桌上没有台灯，晚上处理文件很不方便。
sentences.traditional: 辦公桌上沒有檯燈，晚上處理文件很不方便。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngzhuō shang méiyǒu táidēng, wǎnshang chǔlǐ wénjiàn hěn bù fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: There is no desk lamp on the desk, so handling documents at night is inconvenient.

sentences.chinese: 老人上台阶时走得很慢，我们在旁边扶着他。
sentences.traditional: 老人上臺階時走得很慢，我們在旁邊扶著他。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shàng táijiē shí zǒu de hěn màn, wǒmen zài pángbiān fúzhe tā.
sentences.translation: The elderly man walked slowly up the steps, and we supported him beside him.

sentences.chinese: 雨后台阶很滑，进楼前一定要小心。
sentences.traditional: 雨後臺階很滑，進樓前一定要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu táijiē hěn huá, jìn lóu qián yídìng yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: The steps are slippery after the rain, so be careful before entering the building.

sentences.chinese: 这座图书馆门口的台阶设计得比较宽。
sentences.traditional: 這座圖書館門口的臺階設計得比較寬。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò túshūguǎn ménkǒu de táijiē shèjì de bǐjiào kuān.
sentences.translation: The steps at the entrance to this library are designed to be quite wide.

sentences.chinese: 李先生和他的太太下个月要搬到上海工作。
sentences.traditional: 李先生和他的太太下個月要搬到上海工作。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng hé tā de tàitai xià ge yuè yào bān dào Shànghǎi gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: Mr Li and his wife are moving to Shanghai for work next month.

sentences.chinese: 王太太对社区活动非常热心，经常帮助邻居。
sentences.traditional: 王太太對社區活動非常熱心，經常幫助鄰居。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng tàitai duì shèqū huódòng fēicháng rèxīn, jīngcháng bāngzhù línjū.
sentences.translation: Mrs Wang is very enthusiastic about community activities and often helps neighbours.

sentences.chinese: 他太太的意见很实际，最后大家都接受了。
sentences.traditional: 他太太的意見很實際，最後大家都接受了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tàitai de yìjiàn hěn shíjì, zuìhòu dàjiā dōu jiēshòu le.
sentences.translation: His wife’s suggestion was very practical, and in the end everyone accepted it.

sentences.chinese: 经理想和你谈话，了解项目为什么被推迟了。
sentences.traditional: 經理想和你談話，了解專案為什麼被推遲了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xiǎng hé nǐ tánhuà, liǎojiě zhuān’àn wèishénme bèi tuīchí le.
sentences.translation: The manager wants to talk with you to understand why the project was delayed.

sentences.chinese: 我和老师谈话以后，对自己的学习计划更清楚了。
sentences.traditional: 我和老師談話以後，對自己的學習計畫更清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé lǎoshī tánhuà yǐhòu, duì zìjǐ de xuéxí jìhuà gèng qīngchu le.
sentences.translation: After talking with the teacher, I became clearer about my study plan.

sentences.chinese: 这次谈话持续了两个小时，双方终于达成了一致。
sentences.traditional: 這次談話持續了兩個小時，雙方終於達成了一致。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tánhuà chíxù le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, shuāngfāng zhōngyú dáchéng le yízhì.
sentences.translation: This conversation lasted two hours, and both sides finally reached an agreement.

sentences.chinese: 这种桃水分足，味道也特别甜。
sentences.traditional: 這種桃水分足，味道也特別甜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng táo shuǐfèn zú, wèidao yě tèbié tián.
sentences.translation: This type of peach has plenty of juice and tastes especially sweet.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶把桃切成小块，放进了孩子的饭盒里。
sentences.traditional: 奶奶把桃切成小塊，放進了孩子的飯盒裡。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ táo qiē chéng xiǎo kuài, fàng jìn le háizi de fànhé lǐ.
sentences.translation: Grandma cut the peach into small pieces and put it in the child’s lunch box.

sentences.chinese: 市场上的桃刚上市，价格还比较高。
sentences.traditional: 市場上的桃剛上市，價格還比較高。
sentences.pinyin: Shìchǎng shang de táo gāng shàngshì, jiàgé hái bǐjiào gāo.
sentences.translation: Peaches have just come onto the market, so the price is still rather high.

sentences.chinese: 这套家具颜色统一，放在客厅里很协调。
sentences.traditional: 這套傢俱顏色統一，放在客廳裡很協調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào jiājù yánsè tǒngyī, fàng zài kètīng lǐ hěn xiétiáo.
sentences.translation: This set of furniture has a consistent colour and looks harmonious in the living room.

sentences.chinese: 天气突然变冷，他在外套里面又套了一件毛衣。
sentences.traditional: 天氣突然變冷，他在外套裡面又套了一件毛衣。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tūrán biàn lěng, tā zài wàitào lǐmiàn yòu tào le yí jiàn máoyī.
sentences.translation: The weather suddenly turned cold, so he put another jumper on inside his coat.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要设计一套更完整的管理制度。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要設計一套更完整的管理制度。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào shèjì yí tào gèng wánzhěng de guǎnlǐ zhìdù.
sentences.translation: We need to design a more complete set of management rules.

sentences.chinese: 这种茶是当地最有名的特产，游客几乎都会买。
sentences.traditional: 這種茶是當地最有名的特產，遊客幾乎都會買。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chá shì dāngdì zuì yǒumíng de tèchǎn, yóukè jīhū dōu huì mǎi.
sentences.translation: This kind of tea is the most famous local specialty, and almost all tourists buy it.

sentences.chinese: 出差回来时，他给同事带了一些家乡特产。
sentences.traditional: 出差回來時，他給同事帶了一些家鄉特產。
sentences.pinyin: Chūchāi huílai shí, tā gěi tóngshì dài le yìxiē jiāxiāng tèchǎn.
sentences.translation: When he came back from a business trip, he brought his colleagues some local specialties from his hometown.

sentences.chinese: 发展特产产业，可以增加农民的收入。
sentences.traditional: 發展特產產業，可以增加農民的收入。
sentences.pinyin: Fāzhǎn tèchǎn chǎnyè, kěyǐ zēngjiā nóngmín de shōurù.
sentences.translation: Developing specialty industries can increase farmers’ income.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒店最大的特色是所有房间都面向大海。
sentences.traditional: 這家飯店最大的特色是所有房間都面向大海。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn zuì dà de tèsè shì suǒyǒu fángjiān dōu miànxiàng dàhǎi.
sentences.translation: The biggest feature of this hotel is that all rooms face the sea.

sentences.chinese: 一个城市的发展不能失去自己的文化特色。
sentences.traditional: 一個城市的發展不能失去自己的文化特色。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge chéngshì de fāzhǎn bùnéng shīqù zìjǐ de wénhuà tèsè.
sentences.translation: A city’s development must not lose its own cultural characteristics.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜有四川特色，味道又麻又辣。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜有四川特色，味道又麻又辣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài yǒu Sìchuān tèsè, wèidao yòu má yòu là.
sentences.translation: This dish has Sichuan characteristics; it tastes both numbing and spicy.

sentences.chinese: 这位学生情况特殊，学校为他安排了单独的考试时间。
sentences.traditional: 這位學生情況特殊，學校為他安排了單獨的考試時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuésheng qíngkuàng tèshū, xuéxiào wèi tā ānpái le dāndú de kǎoshì shíjiān.
sentences.translation: This student’s situation is special, so the school arranged a separate exam time for him.

sentences.chinese: 在特殊情况下，医生会采用不同的治疗方案。
sentences.traditional: 在特殊情況下，醫生會採用不同的治療方案。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tèshū qíngkuàng xià, yīshēng huì cǎiyòng bùtóng de zhìliáo fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: In special circumstances, doctors will use different treatment plans.

sentences.chinese: 这份材料需要特殊处理，不能和普通垃圾放在一起。
sentences.traditional: 這份材料需要特殊處理，不能和普通垃圾放在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn cáiliào xūyào tèshū chǔlǐ, bùnéng hé pǔtōng lājī fàng zài yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: This material requires special handling and cannot be put together with ordinary rubbish.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物是当地特有的物种，受到严格保护。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物是當地特有的物種，受到嚴格保護。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù shì dāngdì tèyǒu de wùzhǒng, shòudào yángé bǎohù.
sentences.translation: This plant is a species unique to the local area and is strictly protected.

sentences.chinese: 他的声音有一种特有的温柔，让人很容易放松。
sentences.traditional: 他的聲音有一種特有的溫柔，讓人很容易放鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn yǒu yì zhǒng tèyǒu de wēnróu, ràng rén hěn róngyì fàngsōng.
sentences.translation: His voice has a distinctive gentleness that makes people relax easily.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市保留了港口城市特有的开放气氛。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市保留了港口城市特有的開放氣氛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì bǎoliú le gǎngkǒu chéngshì tèyǒu de kāifàng qìfēn.
sentences.translation: This city has kept the open atmosphere characteristic of a port city.

sentences.chinese: 这种鸟最明显的特征是头上有一圈白毛。
sentences.traditional: 這種鳥最明顯的特徵是頭上有一圈白毛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng niǎo zuì míngxiǎn de tèzhēng shì tóu shang yǒu yì quān bái máo.
sentences.translation: The most obvious feature of this bird is the ring of white feathers on its head.

sentences.chinese: 每个时代都有自己的社会特征和文化背景。
sentences.traditional: 每個時代都有自己的社會特徵和文化背景。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de shèhuì tèzhēng hé wénhuà bèijǐng.
sentences.translation: Every era has its own social features and cultural background.

sentences.chinese: 专家通过这些特征判断这件文物的年代。
sentences.traditional: 專家通過這些特徵判斷這件文物的年代。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā tōngguò zhèxiē tèzhēng pànduàn zhè jiàn wénwù de niándài.
sentences.translation: Experts judge the age of this cultural relic through these characteristics.

sentences.chinese: 如果疼痛持续加重，就应该及时去医院检查。
sentences.traditional: 如果疼痛持續加重，就應該及時去醫院檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ téngtòng chíxù jiāzhòng, jiù yīnggāi jíshí qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: If the pain continues to worsen, you should go to hospital for an examination promptly.

sentences.chinese: 他脚踝有些疼痛，所以暂时不能参加训练。
sentences.traditional: 他腳踝有些疼痛，所以暫時不能參加訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎohuái yǒuxiē téngtòng, suǒyǐ zànshí bùnéng cānjiā xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: His ankle is somewhat painful, so he cannot take part in training for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 这种药能减轻手术后的疼痛。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥能減輕手術後的疼痛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào néng jiǎnqīng shǒushù hòu de téngtòng.
sentences.translation: This medicine can reduce the pain after surgery.

sentences.chinese: 学校一直提倡学生多阅读、多思考。
sentences.traditional: 學校一直提倡學生多閱讀、多思考。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yìzhí tíchàng xuésheng duō yuèdú, duō sīkǎo.
sentences.translation: The school has always advocated that students read more and think more.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多城市提倡绿色出行，减少空气污染。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多城市提倡綠色出行，減少空氣污染。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō chéngshì tíchàng lǜsè chūxíng, jiǎnshǎo kōngqì wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: Many cities now advocate green travel to reduce air pollution.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家提倡用简单的语言表达深刻的思想。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家提倡用簡單的語言表達深刻的思想。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā tíchàng yòng jiǎndān de yǔyán biǎodá shēnkè de sīxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This writer advocates using simple language to express profound ideas.

sentences.chinese: 请在周五以前提交完整的申请材料。
sentences.traditional: 請在週五以前提交完整的申請材料。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhōu wǔ yǐqián tíjiāo wánzhěng de shēnqǐng cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Please submit the complete application materials before Friday.

sentences.chinese: 报告已经提交给领导，等他审核后再修改。
sentences.traditional: 報告已經提交給領導，等他審核後再修改。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào yǐjīng tíjiāo gěi lǐngdǎo, děng tā shěnhé hòu zài xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: The report has already been submitted to the leader; it will be revised after he reviews it.

sentences.chinese: 系统出错时，用户无法提交订单。
sentences.traditional: 系統出錯時，用戶無法提交訂單。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng chūcuò shí, yònghù wúfǎ tíjiāo dìngdān.
sentences.translation: When the system has an error, users cannot submit orders.

sentences.chinese: 这道题目的要求很清楚，但计算过程比较复杂。
sentences.traditional: 這道題目的要求很清楚，但計算過程比較複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tímù de yāoqiú hěn qīngchu, dàn jìsuàn guòchéng bǐjiào fùzá.
sentences.translation: The requirements of this question are clear, but the calculation process is quite complicated.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们围绕这个题目写一篇短文。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們圍繞這個題目寫一篇短文。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen wéirào zhège tímù xiě yì piān duǎnwén.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to write a short essay around this topic.

sentences.chinese: 会议的题目虽然普通，内容却很有深度。
sentences.traditional: 會議的題目雖然普通，內容卻很有深度。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì de tímù suīrán pǔtōng, nèiróng què hěn yǒu shēndù.
sentences.translation: Although the topic of the meeting is ordinary, the content has real depth.

sentences.chinese: 一提起那次旅行，他就忍不住笑起来。
sentences.traditional: 一提起那次旅行，他就忍不住笑起來。
sentences.pinyin: Yì tíqǐ nà cì lǚxíng, tā jiù rěnbuzhù xiào qǐlai.
sentences.translation: Whenever that trip is mentioned, he cannot help laughing.

sentences.chinese: 经理在会上提起了客户昨天提出的问题。
sentences.traditional: 經理在會上提起了客戶昨天提出的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huì shang tíqǐ le kèhù zuótiān tíchū de wèntí.
sentences.translation: The manager brought up the question the customer raised yesterday at the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 别再提起这件事了，大家都已经知道结果。
sentences.traditional: 別再提起這件事了，大家都已經知道結果。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zài tíqǐ zhè jiàn shì le, dàjiā dōu yǐjīng zhīdào jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Do not bring this matter up again; everyone already knows the result.

sentences.chinese: 坚持复习可以有效提升听力水平。
sentences.traditional: 堅持複習可以有效提升聽力水平。
sentences.pinyin: Jiānchí fùxí kěyǐ yǒuxiào tíshēng tīnglì shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: Persisting with revision can effectively improve listening ability.

sentences.chinese: 公司希望通过培训提升员工的服务质量。
sentences.traditional: 公司希望通過培訓提升員工的服務質量。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xīwàng tōngguò péixùn tíshēng yuángōng de fúwù zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The company hopes to improve employees’ service quality through training.

sentences.chinese: 新设备投入使用后，生产效率明显提升了。
sentences.traditional: 新設備投入使用後，生產效率明顯提升了。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn shèbèi tóurù shǐyòng hòu, shēngchǎn xiàolǜ míngxiǎn tíshēng le.
sentences.translation: After the new equipment was put into use, production efficiency improved noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 如果你有不明白的地方，可以随时提问。
sentences.traditional: 如果你有不明白的地方，可以隨時提問。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu bù míngbai de dìfang, kěyǐ suíshí tíwèn.
sentences.translation: If there is anything you do not understand, you can ask questions at any time.

sentences.chinese: 讲座结束后，听众开始向专家提问。
sentences.traditional: 講座結束後，聽眾開始向專家提問。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎngzuò jiéshù hòu, tīngzhòng kāishǐ xiàng zhuānjiā tíwèn.
sentences.translation: After the lecture ended, the audience began asking the expert questions.

sentences.chinese: 他提问的方式很直接，但并没有让人不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 他提問的方式很直接，但並沒有讓人不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tíwèn de fāngshì hěn zhíjiē, dàn bìng méiyǒu ràng rén bù shūfu.
sentences.translation: His way of asking questions is direct, but it does not make people uncomfortable.

sentences.chinese: 只有亲自参加，你才能体会这项工作的困难。
sentences.traditional: 只有親自參加，你才能體會這項工作的困難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu qīnzì cānjiā, nǐ cái néng tǐhuì zhè xiàng gōngzuò de kùnnan.
sentences.translation: Only by taking part yourself can you understand the difficulties of this work.

sentences.chinese: 这次实习让我深深体会到团队合作的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 這次實習讓我深深體會到團隊合作的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shíxí ràng wǒ shēnshēn tǐhuì dào tuánduì hézuò de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: This internship made me deeply realise the importance of teamwork.

sentences.chinese: 读完这本书，我写下了自己的学习体会。
sentences.traditional: 讀完這本書，我寫下了自己的學習體會。
sentences.pinyin: Dú wán zhè běn shū, wǒ xiě xià le zìjǐ de xuéxí tǐhuì.
sentences.translation: After reading this book, I wrote down my own study reflections.

sentences.chinese: 长时间照顾病人需要很好的体力和耐心。
sentences.traditional: 長時間照顧病人需要很好的體力和耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān zhàogù bìngrén xūyào hěn hǎo de tǐlì hé nàixīn.
sentences.translation: Taking care of patients for long periods requires good physical strength and patience.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作对体力要求很高，不适合所有人。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作對體力要求很高，不適合所有人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò duì tǐlì yāoqiú hěn gāo, bù shìhé suǒyǒu rén.
sentences.translation: This job has high physical demands and is not suitable for everyone.

sentences.chinese: 运动以后，他的体力恢复得比以前快多了。
sentences.traditional: 運動以後，他的體力恢復得比以前快多了。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu, tā de tǐlì huīfù de bǐ yǐqián kuài duō le.
sentences.translation: After exercising, his physical strength recovers much faster than before.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动充分体现了社区之间的合作精神。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動充分體現了社區之間的合作精神。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng chōngfèn tǐxiàn le shèqū zhījiān de hézuò jīngshén.
sentences.translation: This activity fully reflected the spirit of cooperation between communities.

sentences.chinese: 一个人的选择常常能体现他的价值观。
sentences.traditional: 一個人的選擇常常能體現他的價值觀。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge rén de xuǎnzé chángcháng néng tǐxiàn tā de jiàzhíguān.
sentences.translation: A person’s choices can often reflect their values.

sentences.chinese: 他的设计体现出对传统文化的尊重。
sentences.traditional: 他的設計體現出對傳統文化的尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shèjì tǐxiàn chū duì chuántǒng wénhuà de zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: His design shows respect for traditional culture.

sentences.chinese: 我想亲自体验一下当地人的日常生活。
sentences.traditional: 我想親自體驗一下當地人的日常生活。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qīnzì tǐyàn yíxià dāngdì rén de rìcháng shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: I want to personally experience the daily life of local people.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件的使用体验比旧版本顺畅很多。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件的使用體驗比舊版本順暢很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn de shǐyòng tǐyàn bǐ jiù bǎnběn shùnchàng hěn duō.
sentences.translation: The user experience of this software is much smoother than the old version.

sentences.chinese: 通过这次旅行，孩子们体验到了不同文化的魅力。
sentences.traditional: 通過這次旅行，孩子們體驗到了不同文化的魅力。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò zhè cì lǚxíng, háizimen tǐyàn dào le bùtóng wénhuà de mèilì.
sentences.translation: Through this trip, the children experienced the charm of different cultures.

sentences.chinese: 我今天替同事参加会议，他明天会给我资料。
sentences.traditional: 我今天替同事參加會議，他明天會給我資料。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān tì tóngshì cānjiā huìyì, tā míngtiān huì gěi wǒ zīliào.
sentences.translation: I am attending the meeting on behalf of my colleague today, and he will give me the materials tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 你不能总是替孩子做决定，要让他学会负责。
sentences.traditional: 你不能總是替孩子做決定，要讓他學會負責。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bùnéng zǒngshì tì háizi zuò juédìng, yào ràng tā xuéhuì fùzé.
sentences.translation: You cannot always make decisions for the child; you need to let him learn to take responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 我们先用这张椅子替那张坏的，等修好再换回来。
sentences.traditional: 我們先用這張椅子替那張壞的，等修好再換回來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān yòng zhè zhāng yǐzi tì nà zhāng huài de, děng xiū hǎo zài huàn huílai.
sentences.translation: We will use this chair to replace the broken one for now, and switch it back after it is repaired.

sentences.chinese: 雨后，天空变得特别晴朗。
sentences.traditional: 雨後，天空變得特別晴朗。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu, tiānkōng biàn de tèbié qínglǎng.
sentences.translation: After the rain, the sky became especially clear.

sentences.chinese: 傍晚的天空被晚霞染成了红色。
sentences.traditional: 傍晚的天空被晚霞染成了紅色。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngwǎn de tiānkōng bèi wǎnxiá rǎn chéng le hóngsè.
sentences.translation: The evening sky was dyed red by the sunset clouds.

sentences.chinese: 孩子抬头望着天空，想知道云后面有什么。
sentences.traditional: 孩子抬頭望著天空，想知道雲後面有什麼。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tái tóu wàng zhe tiānkōng, xiǎng zhīdào yún hòumian yǒu shénme.
sentences.translation: The child looked up at the sky, wanting to know what was behind the clouds.

sentences.chinese: 天上突然出现了一道很亮的彩虹。
sentences.traditional: 天上突然出現了一道很亮的彩虹。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānshàng tūrán chūxiàn le yí dào hěn liàng de cǎihóng.
sentences.translation: A very bright rainbow suddenly appeared in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 他指着天上的星星，给孩子讲神话故事。
sentences.traditional: 他指著天上的星星，給孩子講神話故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe tiānshàng de xīngxing, gěi háizi jiǎng shénhuà gùshi.
sentences.translation: He pointed at the stars in the sky and told the child a myth.

sentences.chinese: 飞机在天上飞过时，我们都听到了声音。
sentences.traditional: 飛機在天上飛過時，我們都聽到了聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī zài tiānshàng fēiguò shí, wǒmen dōu tīng dào le shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: When the plane flew through the sky, we all heard the sound.

sentences.chinese: 请把姓名和地址填在表格的第一栏。
sentences.traditional: 請把姓名和地址填在表格的第一欄。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xìngmíng hé dìzhǐ tián zài biǎogé de dì yī lán.
sentences.translation: Please fill in your name and address in the first column of the form.

sentences.chinese: 他用沙子把路上的小坑填平了。
sentences.traditional: 他用沙子把路上的小坑填平了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng shāzi bǎ lù shang de xiǎo kēng tián píng le.
sentences.translation: He filled in the small hole in the road with sand.

sentences.chinese: 如果答案不确定，可以先空着，最后再填。
sentences.traditional: 如果答案不確定，可以先空著，最後再填。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dá’àn bù quèdìng, kěyǐ xiān kōng zhe, zuìhòu zài tián.
sentences.translation: If you are not sure of the answer, you can leave it blank first and fill it in at the end.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的甜品不太贵，但味道很精致。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的甜品不太貴，但味道很精緻。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiánpǐn bú tài guì, dàn wèidào hěn jīngzhì.
sentences.translation: The desserts at this restaurant are not too expensive, but the taste is very refined.

sentences.chinese: 饭后吃一点甜品会让孩子特别开心。
sentences.traditional: 飯後吃一點甜品會讓孩子特別開心。
sentences.pinyin: Fàn hòu chī yì diǎn tiánpǐn huì ràng háizi tèbié kāixīn.
sentences.translation: Eating a little dessert after the meal will make the child especially happy.

sentences.chinese: 她学会做几种低糖甜品，准备在周末招待朋友。
sentences.traditional: 她學會做幾種低糖甜品，準備在週末招待朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuéhuì zuò jǐ zhǒng dītáng tiánpǐn, zhǔnbèi zài zhōumò zhāodài péngyou.
sentences.translation: She has learnt to make several low-sugar desserts and is preparing to entertain friends at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 买水果时，他总能挑到最甜的桃。
sentences.traditional: 買水果時，他總能挑到最甜的桃。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎi shuǐguǒ shí, tā zǒng néng tiāo dào zuì tián de táo.
sentences.translation: When buying fruit, he can always pick the sweetest peaches.

sentences.chinese: 这本书比较难，你可以先挑几章感兴趣的读。
sentences.traditional: 這本書比較難，你可以先挑幾章感興趣的讀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bǐjiào nán, nǐ kěyǐ xiān tiāo jǐ zhāng gǎn xìngqù de dú.
sentences.translation: This book is quite difficult, so you can first choose a few chapters that interest you to read.

sentences.chinese: 别只挑轻松的任务，重要的部分也要承担。
sentences.traditional: 別只挑輕鬆的任務，重要的部分也要承擔。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhǐ tiāo qīngsōng de rènwu, zhòngyào de bùfen yě yào chéngdān.
sentences.translation: Do not only pick easy tasks; you also need to take on the important parts.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们挑选一个题目做报告。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們挑選一個題目做報告。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen tiāoxuǎn yí ge tímù zuò bàogào.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to choose a topic for a presentation.

sentences.chinese: 为了挑选合适的礼物，他提前了解了朋友的兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 為了挑選合適的禮物，他提前了解了朋友的興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tiāoxuǎn héshì de lǐwù, tā tíqián liǎojiě le péngyou de xìngqù.
sentences.translation: To choose a suitable gift, he found out about his friend’s interests in advance.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在挑选有经验的员工参加这个项目。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在挑選有經驗的員工參加這個項目。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài tiāoxuǎn yǒu jīngyàn de yuángōng cānjiā zhège xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: The company is selecting experienced employees to take part in this project.

sentences.chinese: 请把温度调高一点，房间有点冷。
sentences.traditional: 請把溫度調高一點，房間有點冷。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wēndù tiáo gāo yì diǎn, fángjiān yǒu diǎn lěng.
sentences.translation: Please turn the temperature up a bit; the room is a little cold.

sentences.chinese: 演出开始前，师傅正在调吉他的声音。
sentences.traditional: 演出開始前，師傅正在調吉他的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnchū kāishǐ qián, shīfu zhèngzài tiáo jítā de shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: Before the performance began, the technician was tuning the sound of the guitar.

sentences.chinese: 如果味道太淡，可以再调一下盐的比例。
sentences.traditional: 如果味道太淡，可以再調一下鹽的比例。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wèidào tài dàn, kěyǐ zài tiáo yíxià yán de bǐlì.
sentences.translation: If the flavour is too weak, you can adjust the amount of salt a little more.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子虽然有点调皮，但心地很善良。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子雖然有點調皮，但心地很善良。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi suīrán yǒu diǎn tiáopí, dàn xīndì hěn shànliáng.
sentences.translation: Although this child is a bit naughty, he is very kind-hearted.

sentences.chinese: 小狗调皮地把鞋子拖到了院子里。
sentences.traditional: 小狗調皮地把鞋子拖到了院子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu tiáopí de bǎ xiézi tuō dào le yuànzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: The puppy mischievously dragged the shoes into the yard.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有生气，只是提醒他别太调皮。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有生氣，只是提醒他別太調皮。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu shēngqì, zhǐshì tíxǐng tā bié tài tiáopí.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not get angry, but simply reminded him not to be too naughty.

sentences.chinese: 根据新的计划，我们需要调整工作时间。
sentences.traditional: 根據新的計劃，我們需要調整工作時間。
sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù xīn de jìhuà, wǒmen xūyào tiáozhěng gōngzuò shíjiān.
sentences.translation: According to the new plan, we need to adjust the working hours.

sentences.chinese: 他把椅子的高度调整到最舒服的位置。
sentences.traditional: 他把椅子的高度調整到最舒服的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yǐzi de gāodù tiáozhěng dào zuì shūfu de wèizhi.
sentences.translation: He adjusted the height of the chair to the most comfortable position.

sentences.chinese: 政策实行后，市场价格很快进行了调整。
sentences.traditional: 政策實行後，市場價格很快進行了調整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè shíxíng hòu, shìchǎng jiàgé hěn kuài jìnxíng le tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: After the policy was implemented, market prices were quickly adjusted.

sentences.chinese: 这项任务很难，但对团队来说也是一次挑战。
sentences.traditional: 這項任務很難，但對團隊來說也是一次挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng rènwu hěn nán, dàn duì tuánduì lái shuō yě shì yí cì tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: This task is difficult, but it is also a challenge for the team.

sentences.chinese: 他决定挑战自己，报名参加半程马拉松。
sentences.traditional: 他決定挑戰自己，報名參加半程馬拉松。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, bàomíng cānjiā bànchéng mǎlāsōng.
sentences.translation: He decided to challenge himself and sign up for a half marathon.

sentences.chinese: 面对新的挑战，公司必须提升技术水平。
sentences.traditional: 面對新的挑戰，公司必須提升技術水平。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì xīn de tiǎozhàn, gōngsī bìxū tíshēng jìshù shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: Facing new challenges, the company must improve its technical standards.

sentences.chinese: 她从小学开始练习跳高，成绩一直很好。
sentences.traditional: 她從小學開始練習跳高，成績一直很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎoxué kāishǐ liànxí tiàogāo, chéngjì yìzhí hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: She has practised the high jump since primary school, and her results have always been good.

sentences.chinese: 运动会上，跳高比赛吸引了很多同学观看。
sentences.traditional: 運動會上，跳高比賽吸引了很多同學觀看。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndònghuì shang, tiàogāo bǐsài xīyǐn le hěn duō tóngxué guānkàn.
sentences.translation: At the sports meeting, the high jump competition attracted many students to watch.

sentences.chinese: 如果想提高跳高成绩，腿部力量非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 如果想提高跳高成績，腿部力量非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng tígāo tiàogāo chéngjì, tuǐbù lìliàng fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: If you want to improve your high jump results, leg strength is very important.

sentences.chinese: 他在跳远项目中获得了第一名。
sentences.traditional: 他在跳遠項目中獲得了第一名。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài tiàoyuǎn xiàngmù zhōng huòdé le dì yī míng.
sentences.translation: He won first place in the long jump event.

sentences.chinese: 教练告诉我们，跳远前的助跑不能太慢。
sentences.traditional: 教練告訴我們，跳遠前的助跑不能太慢。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoliàn gàosu wǒmen, tiàoyuǎn qián de zhùpǎo bùnéng tài màn.
sentences.translation: The coach told us that the run-up before the long jump must not be too slow.

sentences.chinese: 妹妹第一次参加跳远比赛，表现得很勇敢。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹第一次參加跳遠比賽，表現得很勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Mèimei dì yī cì cānjiā tiàoyuǎn bǐsài, biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒnggǎn.
sentences.translation: My younger sister took part in a long jump competition for the first time and performed bravely.

sentences.chinese: 请把通知贴在门口，让大家都能看见。
sentences.traditional: 請把通知貼在門口，讓大家都能看見。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ tōngzhī tiē zài ménkǒu, ràng dàjiā dōu néng kànjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please stick the notice on the door so that everyone can see it.

sentences.chinese: 她在笔记本上贴了一张旅行照片。
sentences.traditional: 她在筆記本上貼了一張旅行照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐjìběn shang tiē le yì zhāng lǚxíng zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: She stuck a travel photo in her notebook.

sentences.chinese: 包装上贴着价格和生产日期。
sentences.traditional: 包裝上貼著價格和生產日期。
sentences.pinyin: Bāozhuāng shang tiē zhe jiàgé hé shēngchǎn rìqī.
sentences.translation: The price and production date are stuck on the packaging.

sentences.chinese: 这条铁路连接了几个重要的省会城市。
sentences.traditional: 這條鐵路連接了幾個重要的省會城市。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù liánjiē le jǐ ge zhòngyào de shěnghuì chéngshì.
sentences.translation: This railway connects several important provincial capitals.

sentences.chinese: 铁路开通以后，当地的特产更容易运出去。
sentences.traditional: 鐵路開通以後，當地的特產更容易運出去。
sentences.pinyin: Tiělù kāitōng yǐhòu, dāngdì de tèchǎn gèng róngyì yùn chūqù.
sentences.translation: After the railway opened, local specialities became easier to transport out.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划修建新的铁路，以促进地区发展。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃修建新的鐵路，以促進地區發展。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà xiūjiàn xīn de tiělù, yǐ cùjìn dìqū fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: The government plans to build a new railway to promote regional development.

sentences.chinese: 我们只在上海停留了一天，就继续出发了。
sentences.traditional: 我們只在上海停留了一天，就繼續出發了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǐ zài Shànghǎi tíngliú le yì tiān, jiù jìxù chūfā le.
sentences.translation: We stayed in Shanghai for only one day before setting off again.

sentences.chinese: 这些游客想在古城多停留几天，深入了解当地文化。
sentences.traditional: 這些遊客想在古城多停留幾天，深入了解當地文化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē yóukè xiǎng zài gǔchéng duō tíngliú jǐ tiān, shēnrù liǎojiě dāngdì wénhuà.
sentences.translation: These tourists want to stay in the old city for a few more days to gain a deeper understanding of the local culture.

sentences.chinese: 车辆不得在医院门口长时间停留。
sentences.traditional: 車輛不得在醫院門口長時間停留。
sentences.pinyin: Chēliàng bùdé zài yīyuàn ménkǒu cháng shíjiān tíngliú.
sentences.translation: Vehicles must not remain at the hospital entrance for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他通常早上六点起床，然后去跑步。
sentences.traditional: 他通常早上六點起床，然後去跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngcháng zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng, ránhòu qù pǎobù.
sentences.translation: He usually gets up at six in the morning and then goes running.

sentences.chinese: 在这种情况下，通常需要先收集更多数据。
sentences.traditional: 在這種情況下，通常需要先收集更多資料。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, tōngcháng xūyào xiān shōují gèng duō zīliào.
sentences.translation: In this situation, it is usually necessary to collect more data first.

sentences.chinese: 这家商店的营业时间通常到晚上十点。
sentences.traditional: 這家商店的營業時間通常到晚上十點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de yíngyè shíjiān tōngcháng dào wǎnshang shí diǎn.
sentences.translation: This shop’s opening hours usually last until ten in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 大雪以后，这条山路暂时不能通行。
sentences.traditional: 大雪以後，這條山路暫時不能通行。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxuě yǐhòu, zhè tiáo shānlù zànshí bùnéng tōngxíng.
sentences.translation: After the heavy snow, this mountain road cannot be passed through for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 施工期间，行人需要从另一侧通行。
sentences.traditional: 施工期間，行人需要從另一側通行。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōng qījiān, xíngrén xūyào cóng lìng yí cè tōngxíng.
sentences.translation: During construction, pedestrians need to pass through on the other side.

sentences.chinese: 桥修好以后，车辆终于可以正常通行了。
sentences.traditional: 橋修好以後，車輛終於可以正常通行了。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáo xiū hǎo yǐhòu, chēliàng zhōngyú kěyǐ zhèngcháng tōngxíng le.
sentences.translation: After the bridge was repaired, vehicles could finally pass through normally.

sentences.chinese: 我和他同一天到北京，后来才发现住在附近。
sentences.traditional: 我和他同一天到北京，後來才發現住在附近。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā tóng yì tiān dào Běijīng, hòulái cái fāxiàn zhù zài fùjìn.
sentences.translation: He and I arrived in Beijing on the same day, and only later discovered that we were staying nearby.

sentences.chinese: 这份资料请同申请表一起提交。
sentences.traditional: 這份資料請同申請表一起提交。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn zīliào qǐng tóng shēnqǐngbiǎo yìqǐ tíjiāo.
sentences.translation: Please submit this material together with the application form.

sentences.chinese: 会议同培训都安排在周五下午。
sentences.traditional: 會議同培訓都安排在週五下午。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì tóng péixùn dōu ānpái zài Zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ.
sentences.translation: The meeting and the training have both been arranged for Friday afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 听说他遇到困难后，大家都很同情他。
sentences.traditional: 聽說他遇到困難後，大家都很同情他。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō tā yùdào kùnnan hòu, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
sentences.translation: After hearing that he had run into difficulties, everyone felt sympathy for him.

sentences.chinese: 我们不只是同情失业的人，还应该提供实际帮助。
sentences.traditional: 我們不只是同情失業的人，還應該提供實際幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bù zhǐshì tóngqíng shīyè de rén, hái yīnggāi tígōng shíjì bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: We should not only sympathise with people who are unemployed, but also provide practical help.

sentences.chinese: 没有亲身经历过，可能很难真正同情别人的痛苦。
sentences.traditional: 沒有親身經歷過，可能很難真正同情別人的痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu qīnshēn jīnglì guo, kěnéng hěn nán zhēnzhèng tóngqíng biérén de tòngkǔ.
sentences.translation: Without having experienced it personally, it may be hard to truly sympathise with another person’s pain.

sentences.chinese: 虽然来自不同部门，他们都在为同一目标努力。
sentences.traditional: 雖然來自不同部門，他們都在為同一目標努力。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán láizì bùtóng bùmén, tāmen dōu zài wèi tóngyī mùbiāo nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Although they come from different departments, they are all working towards the same goal.

sentences.chinese: 请把所有文件保存为同一格式，方便以后整理。
sentences.traditional: 請把所有文件保存為同一格式，方便以後整理。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ suǒyǒu wénjiàn bǎocún wéi tóngyī géshì, fāngbiàn yǐhòu zhěnglǐ.
sentences.translation: Please save all the files in the same format to make them easier to organise later.

sentences.chinese: 这两个说法其实指的是同一件事。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個說法其實指的是同一件事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge shuōfǎ qíshí zhǐ de shì tóngyī jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: These two expressions actually refer to the same thing.

sentences.chinese: 老师正在统计报名人数，看看是否需要换教室。
sentences.traditional: 老師正在統計報名人數，看看是否需要換教室。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài tǒngjì bàomíng rénshù, kànkan shìfǒu xūyào huàn jiàoshì.
sentences.translation: The teacher is counting the number of people who have signed up to see whether the classroom needs to be changed.

sentences.chinese: 公司每个月都会统计销售数据，再调整生产计划。
sentences.traditional: 公司每個月都會統計銷售資料，再調整生產計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī měi ge yuè dōu huì tǒngjì xiāoshòu zīliào, zài tiáozhěng shēngchǎn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The company tallies its sales data every month and then adjusts its production plan.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告统计了近十年来人口变化的趋势。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告統計了近十年來人口變化的趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào tǒngjì le jìn shí nián lái rénkǒu biànhuà de qūshì.
sentences.translation: This report tallied the trends in population change over the past nearly ten years.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高效率，学校决定统一考试时间。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高效率，學校決定統一考試時間。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, xuéxiào juédìng tǒngyī kǎoshì shíjiān.
sentences.translation: To improve efficiency, the school decided to unify the exam times.

sentences.chinese: 各部门使用统一标准，结果才更容易比较。
sentences.traditional: 各部門使用統一標準，結果才更容易比較。
sentences.pinyin: Gè bùmén shǐyòng tǒngyī biāozhǔn, jiéguǒ cái gèng róngyì bǐjiào.
sentences.translation: Only when each department uses a unified standard are the results easier to compare.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司希望通过新系统统一各地的管理方式。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司希望通過新系統統一各地的管理方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī xīwàng tōngguò xīn xìtǒng tǒngyī gèdì de guǎnlǐ fāngshì.
sentences.translation: This company hopes to unify its management methods in different places through the new system.

sentences.chinese: 失去亲人的经历对任何人来说都很痛苦。
sentences.traditional: 失去親人的經歷對任何人來說都很痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Shīqù qīnrén de jīnglì duì rènhé rén lái shuō dōu hěn tòngkǔ.
sentences.translation: The experience of losing a loved one is painful for anyone.

sentences.chinese: 手术后的几天，他一直感到非常痛苦。
sentences.traditional: 手術後的幾天，他一直感到非常痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒushù hòu de jǐ tiān, tā yìzhí gǎndào fēicháng tòngkǔ.
sentences.translation: For several days after the surgery, he felt extremely painful.

sentences.chinese: 谈起那段痛苦的回忆，她仍然忍不住流泪。
sentences.traditional: 談起那段痛苦的回憶，她仍然忍不住流淚。
sentences.pinyin: Tánqǐ nà duàn tòngkǔ de huíyì, tā réngrán rěn bu zhù liúlèi.
sentences.translation: When talking about that painful memory, she still cannot help crying.

sentences.chinese: 他站在线外，把球投进了篮筐。
sentences.traditional: 他站在線外，把球投進了籃筐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài xiàn wài, bǎ qiú tóu jìn le lánkuāng.
sentences.translation: He stood outside the line and threw the ball into the basket.

sentences.chinese: 这次选举中，很多年轻人第一次投了票。
sentences.traditional: 這次選舉中，很多年輕人第一次投了票。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhōng, hěn duō niánqīng rén dì yī cì tóu le piào.
sentences.translation: In this election, many young people voted for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 请把垃圾投进分类桶里，不要随手乱丢。
sentences.traditional: 請把垃圾投進分類桶裡，不要隨手亂丟。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ lājī tóu jìn fēnlèi tǒng lǐ, bú yào suíshǒu luàn diū.
sentences.translation: Please throw the rubbish into the sorting bin; do not casually drop it anywhere.

sentences.chinese: 政府投入大量资金改善铁路和公共设施。
sentences.traditional: 政府投入大量資金改善鐵路和公共設施。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tóurù dàliàng zījīn gǎishàn tiělù hé gōnggòng shèshī.
sentences.translation: The government invested a large amount of money to improve railways and public facilities.

sentences.chinese: 他工作时非常投入，几乎忘了休息。
sentences.traditional: 他工作時非常投入，幾乎忘了休息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò shí fēicháng tóurù, jīhū wàng le xiūxi.
sentences.translation: He is very absorbed when he works, almost forgetting to rest.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究需要长期投入，才能看到明显效果。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究需要長期投入，才能看到明顯效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū xūyào chángqī tóurù, cáinéng kàndào míngxiǎn xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: This research requires long-term investment before obvious results can be seen.

sentences.chinese: 他吃了不少苦头，才明白这个道理。
sentences.traditional: 他吃了不少苦頭，才明白這個道理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chī le bù shǎo kǔtou, cái míngbai zhège dàolǐ.
sentences.translation: He suffered quite a bit before he understood this principle.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目刚开始就有了好兆头。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目剛開始就有了好兆頭。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù gāng kāishǐ jiù yǒu le hǎo zhàotou.
sentences.translation: This project showed a good sign right from the beginning.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，他心里有了一个新的念头。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，他心裡有了一個新的念頭。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā xīnli yǒu le yí ge xīn de niàntou.
sentences.translation: After hearing this news, a new idea came into his mind.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章突出了环境保护的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章突出了環境保護的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng tūchū le huánjìng bǎohù de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: This article highlighted the importance of environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 他的语言能力很突出，因此被选为代表。
sentences.traditional: 他的語言能力很突出，因此被選為代表。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǔyán nénglì hěn tūchū, yīncǐ bèi xuǎn wéi dàibiǎo.
sentences.translation: His language ability is outstanding, so he was chosen as the representative.

sentences.chinese: 墙上有一块突出的石头，走路时要小心。
sentences.traditional: 牆上有一塊突出的石頭，走路時要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shang yǒu yí kuài tūchū de shítou, zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: There is a protruding stone in the wall, so be careful when walking.

sentences.chinese: 孩子用彩色铅笔画了一幅图画，准备送给老师。
sentences.traditional: 孩子用彩色鉛筆畫了一幅圖畫，準備送給老師。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yòng cǎisè qiānbǐ huà le yì fú túhuà, zhǔnbèi sòng gěi lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: The child drew a picture with coloured pencils and planned to give it to the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 这本书里的图画很生动，帮助读者理解故事。
sentences.traditional: 這本書裡的圖畫很生動，幫助讀者理解故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū lǐ de túhuà hěn shēngdòng, bāngzhù dúzhě lǐjiě gùshi.
sentences.translation: The pictures in this book are vivid and help readers understand the story.

sentences.chinese: 他把旅行中看到的风景变成了一张简单的图画。
sentences.traditional: 他把旅行中看到的風景變成了一張簡單的圖畫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǚxíng zhōng kàndào de fēngjǐng biànchéng le yì zhāng jiǎndān de túhuà.
sentences.translation: He turned the scenery he saw during the trip into a simple drawing.

sentences.chinese: 学校的阅览室最近增加了不少中文图书。
sentences.traditional: 學校的閱覽室最近增加了不少中文圖書。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào de yuèlǎnshì zuìjìn zēngjiā le bù shǎo Zhōngwén túshū.
sentences.translation: The school's reading room has recently added quite a few Chinese books.

sentences.chinese: 这些图书按主题分类，学生查找起来很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這些圖書按主題分類，學生查找起來很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē túshū àn zhǔtí fēnlèi, xuésheng cházhǎo qǐlái hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: These books are classified by topic, making them convenient for students to search.

sentences.chinese: 他把旧图书捐给社区，希望更多人能读到。
sentences.traditional: 他把舊圖書捐給社區，希望更多人能讀到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiù túshū juān gěi shèqū, xīwàng gèng duō rén néng dú dào.
sentences.translation: He donated his old books to the community, hoping more people could read them.

sentences.chinese: 这片土地曾经很贫瘠，现在已经种满了果树。
sentences.traditional: 這片土地曾經很貧瘠，現在已經種滿了果樹。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔdì céngjīng hěn pínjí, xiànzài yǐjīng zhòng mǎn le guǒshù.
sentences.translation: This piece of land used to be barren, but it is now full of fruit trees.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划合理利用城市周围的土地。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃合理利用城市周圍的土地。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà hélǐ lìyòng chéngshì zhōuwéi de tǔdì.
sentences.translation: The government plans to make reasonable use of the land around the city.

sentences.chinese: 农民对自己的土地有很深厚的感情。
sentences.traditional: 農民對自己的土地有很深厚的感情。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngmín duì zìjǐ de tǔdì yǒu hěn shēnhòu de gǎnqíng.
sentences.translation: Farmers have deep feelings for their own land.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜主要用土豆和牛肉做成，味道很浓。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜主要用土豆和牛肉做成，味道很濃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài zhǔyào yòng tǔdòu hé niúròu zuòchéng, wèidao hěn nóng.
sentences.translation: This dish is mainly made with potatoes and beef, and has a rich flavour.

sentences.chinese: 土豆保存得不好，很容易发芽。
sentences.traditional: 土豆保存得不好，很容易發芽。
sentences.pinyin: Tǔdòu bǎocún de bù hǎo, hěn róngyì fāyá.
sentences.translation: If potatoes are not stored well, they sprout easily.

sentences.chinese: 他把土豆切成小块，再放进汤里。
sentences.traditional: 他把土豆切成小塊，再放進湯裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ tǔdòu qiē chéng xiǎo kuài, zài fàng jìn tāng lǐ.
sentences.translation: He cut the potatoes into small pieces and then put them into the soup.

sentences.chinese: 小兔子躲在草丛里，直到周围安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 小兔子躲在草叢裡，直到周圍安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo tùzi duǒ zài cǎocóng lǐ, zhídào zhōuwéi ānjìng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: The little rabbit hid in the grass until the surroundings became quiet.

sentences.chinese: 她从小就喜欢兔子，还想学习怎样照顾它们。
sentences.traditional: 她從小就喜歡兔子，還想學習怎樣照顧它們。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐhuan tùzi, hái xiǎng xuéxí zěnyàng zhàogu tāmen.
sentences.translation: She has liked rabbits since childhood and wants to learn how to look after them.

sentences.chinese: 这只兔子看起来很温顺，但跑得特别快。
sentences.traditional: 這隻兔子看起來很溫順，但跑得特別快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī tùzi kàn qǐlái hěn wēnshùn, dàn pǎo de tèbié kuài.
sentences.translation: This rabbit looks gentle, but it runs especially fast.

sentences.chinese: 大家应该团在一起，共同解决眼前的困难。
sentences.traditional: 大家應該團在一起，共同解決眼前的困難。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā yīnggāi tuán zài yìqǐ, gòngtóng jiějué yǎnqián de kùnnan.
sentences.translation: Everyone should unite together to solve the immediate difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 这个团的成员来自不同省份。
sentences.traditional: 這個團的成員來自不同省份。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tuán de chéngyuán láizì bùtóng shěngfèn.
sentences.translation: The members of this group come from different provinces.

sentences.chinese: 她把面揉成一团，准备做包子。
sentences.traditional: 她把麵揉成一團，準備做包子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ miàn róu chéng yì tuán, zhǔnbèi zuò bāozi.
sentences.translation: She kneaded the dough into a ball, ready to make baozi.

sentences.chinese: 一个成功的项目离不开稳定的团队合作。
sentences.traditional: 一個成功的項目離不開穩定的團隊合作。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge chénggōng de xiàngmù lí bù kāi wěndìng de tuánduì hézuò.
sentences.translation: A successful project cannot be separated from stable teamwork.

sentences.chinese: 这个团队虽然年轻，但解决问题的能力很强。
sentences.traditional: 這個團隊雖然年輕，但解決問題的能力很強。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì suīrán niánqīng, dàn jiějué wèntí de nénglì hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: Although this team is young, its ability to solve problems is strong.

sentences.chinese: 经理鼓励团队成员提出不同意见。
sentences.traditional: 經理鼓勵團隊成員提出不同意見。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ gǔlì tuánduì chéngyuán tíchū bùtóng yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: The manager encouraged team members to put forward different opinions.

sentences.chinese: 新政策有助于推动当地经济发展。
sentences.traditional: 新政策有助於推動當地經濟發展。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè yǒu zhù yú tuīdòng dāngdì jīngjì fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: The new policy helps promote local economic development.

sentences.chinese: 技术进步正在推动教育方式的变化。
sentences.traditional: 技術進步正在推動教育方式的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshù jìnbù zhèngzài tuīdòng jiàoyù fāngshì de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Technological progress is driving changes in methods of education.

sentences.chinese: 要推动这个计划实施，需要各部门积极配合。
sentences.traditional: 要推動這個計劃實施，需要各部門積極配合。
sentences.pinyin: Yào tuīdòng zhège jìhuà shíshī, xūyào gè bùmén jījí pèihé.
sentences.translation: To push this plan through, each department needs to cooperate actively.

sentences.chinese: 公司打算通过网络推广新的服务。
sentences.traditional: 公司打算通過網絡推廣新的服務。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī dǎsuàn tōngguò wǎngluò tuīguǎng xīn de fúwù.
sentences.translation: The company plans to promote its new service online.

sentences.chinese: 这种节水方法值得在农村进一步推广。
sentences.traditional: 這種節水方法值得在農村進一步推廣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiéshuǐ fāngfǎ zhídé zài nóngcūn jìn yí bù tuīguǎng.
sentences.translation: This water-saving method is worth promoting further in rural areas.

sentences.chinese: 为了推广普通话，学校组织了朗读比赛。
sentences.traditional: 為了推廣普通話，學校組織了朗讀比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tuīguǎng Pǔtōnghuà, xuéxiào zǔzhī le lǎngdú bǐsài.
sentences.translation: To promote Mandarin, the school organised a reading-aloud competition.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想了解中国历史，我可以推荐几本书。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想了解中國歷史，我可以推薦幾本書。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě Zhōngguó lìshǐ, wǒ kěyǐ tuījiàn jǐ běn shū.
sentences.translation: If you want to learn about Chinese history, I can recommend a few books.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅是朋友推荐的，果然很有特色。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳是朋友推薦的，果然很有特色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng shì péngyou tuījiàn de, guǒrán hěn yǒu tèsè.
sentences.translation: This restaurant was recommended by a friend, and it really does have character.

sentences.chinese: 老师推荐他参加演讲比赛，因为他的表达能力很突出。
sentences.traditional: 老師推薦他參加演講比賽，因為他的表達能力很突出。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tuījiàn tā cānjiā yǎnjiǎng bǐsài, yīnwèi tā de biǎodá nénglì hěn tūchū.
sentences.translation: The teacher recommended that he take part in the speech competition because his ability to express himself is outstanding.

sentences.chinese: 政府正在推进城市交通系统的改革。
sentences.traditional: 政府正在推進城市交通系統的改革。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài tuījìn chéngshì jiāotōng xìtǒng de gǎigé.
sentences.translation: The government is advancing the reform of the urban transport system.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，项目终于可以继续推进。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，項目終於可以繼續推進。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, xiàngmù zhōngyú kěyǐ jìxù tuījìn.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, the project could finally continue to move forward.

sentences.chinese: 要推进这项计划，需要各方面的支持。
sentences.traditional: 要推進這項計劃，需要各方面的支持。
sentences.pinyin: Yào tuījìn zhè xiàng jìhuà, xūyào gè fāngmiàn de zhīchí.
sentences.translation: To push this plan forward, support from all sides is needed.

sentences.chinese: 听到警报后，人群慢慢向后退。
sentences.traditional: 聽到警報後，人群慢慢向後退。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào jǐngbào hòu, rénqún mànman xiàng hòu tuì.
sentences.translation: After hearing the alarm, the crowd slowly moved back.

sentences.chinese: 遇到困难时，他没有退，而是继续坚持。
sentences.traditional: 遇到困難時，他沒有退，而是繼續堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào kùnnan shí, tā méiyǒu tuì, ér shì jìxù jiānchí.
sentences.translation: When he met difficulties, he did not back down, but continued to persist.

sentences.chinese: 车辆太靠近墙了，请往后退一点。
sentences.traditional: 車輛太靠近牆了，請往後退一點。
sentences.pinyin: Chēliàng tài kàojìn qiáng le, qǐng wǎng hòu tuì yì diǎn.
sentences.translation: The vehicle is too close to the wall; please move back a little.

sentences.chinese: 他决定退出比赛，把机会让给队友。
sentences.traditional: 他決定退出比賽，把機會讓給隊友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng tuìchū bǐsài, bǎ jīhuì ràng gěi duìyǒu.
sentences.translation: He decided to withdraw from the competition and give the opportunity to his teammate.

sentences.chinese: 如果不想继续使用这个账户，可以随时退出。
sentences.traditional: 如果不想繼續使用這個帳戶，可以隨時退出。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù xiǎng jìxù shǐyòng zhège zhànghù, kěyǐ suíshí tuìchū.
sentences.translation: If you do not want to continue using this account, you can exit at any time.

sentences.chinese: 公司退出这个市场后，重点转向海外业务。
sentences.traditional: 公司退出這個市場後，重點轉向海外業務。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī tuìchū zhège shìchǎng hòu, zhòngdiǎn zhuǎn xiàng hǎiwài yèwù.
sentences.translation: After the company withdrew from this market, its focus shifted to overseas business.

sentences.chinese: 商店同意退还全款，因为商品有问题。
sentences.traditional: 商店同意退還全款，因為商品有問題。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn tóngyì tuìhuán quán kuǎn, yīnwèi shāngpǐn yǒu wèntí.
sentences.translation: The shop agreed to refund the full amount because there was a problem with the goods.

sentences.chinese: 押金会在房间检查后退还给你。
sentences.traditional: 押金會在房間檢查後退還給你。
sentences.pinyin: Yājīn huì zài fángjiān jiǎnchá hòu tuìhuán gěi nǐ.
sentences.translation: The deposit will be returned to you after the room has been inspected.

sentences.chinese: 活动取消后，主办方开始退还报名费。
sentences.traditional: 活動取消後，主辦方開始退還報名費。
sentences.pinyin: Huódòng qǔxiāo hòu, zhǔbànfāng kāishǐ tuìhuán bàomíngfèi.
sentences.translation: After the event was cancelled, the organiser began refunding the registration fees.

sentences.chinese: 父亲明年退休，打算去乡下生活。
sentences.traditional: 父親明年退休，打算去鄉下生活。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn míngnián tuìxiū, dǎsuàn qù xiāngxià shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: My father will retire next year and plans to live in the countryside.

sentences.chinese: 她退休以后仍然参加社区志愿活动。
sentences.traditional: 她退休以後仍然參加社區志願活動。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū yǐhòu réngrán cānjiā shèqū zhìyuàn huódòng.
sentences.translation: After retiring, she still takes part in community volunteer activities.

sentences.chinese: 很多人退休后才有时间发展自己的兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 很多人退休後才有時間發展自己的興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén tuìxiū hòu cái yǒu shíjiān fāzhǎn zìjǐ de xìngqù.
sentences.translation: Many people only have time to develop their own interests after retirement.

sentences.chinese: 进屋前请换上拖鞋，别把地板弄脏。
sentences.traditional: 進屋前請換上拖鞋，別把地板弄髒。
sentences.pinyin: Jìn wū qián qǐng huàn shang tuōxié, bié bǎ dìbǎn nòng zāng.
sentences.translation: Please change into slippers before entering, and do not make the floor dirty.

sentences.chinese: 酒店房间里准备了一双干净的拖鞋。
sentences.traditional: 酒店房間裡準備了一雙乾淨的拖鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn fángjiān lǐ zhǔnbèi le yì shuāng gānjìng de tuōxié.
sentences.translation: A clean pair of slippers has been prepared in the hotel room.

sentences.chinese: 下雨天穿拖鞋出门不太安全。
sentences.traditional: 下雨天穿拖鞋出門不太安全。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ tiān chuān tuōxié chūmén bú tài ānquán.
sentences.translation: It is not very safe to go out in slippers on a rainy day.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器外部有一层防水材料。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器外部有一層防水材料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì wàibù yǒu yì céng fángshuǐ cáiliào.
sentences.translation: There is a layer of waterproof material on the outside of this machine.

sentences.chinese: 公司需要先了解外部环境，再制定计划。
sentences.traditional: 公司需要先了解外部環境，再制定計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào xiān liǎojiě wàibù huánjìng, zài zhìdìng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The company needs to understand the external environment before making a plan.

sentences.chinese: 从建筑外部看，入口并不明显。
sentences.traditional: 從建築外部看，入口並不明顯。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng jiànzhù wàibù kàn, rùkǒu bìng bù míngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Seen from the outside of the building, the entrance is not obvious.

sentences.chinese: 外公年轻时在铁路部门工作。
sentences.traditional: 外公年輕時在鐵路部門工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wàigōng niánqīng shí zài tiělù bùmén gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: My maternal grandfather worked in the railway department when he was young.

sentences.chinese: 每次见到外公，他都会讲自己的经历。
sentences.traditional: 每次見到外公，他都會講自己的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Měi cì jiàn dào wàigōng, tā dōu huì jiǎng zìjǐ de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: Every time I see my maternal grandfather, he talks about his own experiences.

sentences.chinese: 外公喜欢书法，客厅里挂着他的作品。
sentences.traditional: 外公喜歡書法，客廳裡掛著他的作品。
sentences.pinyin: Wàigōng xǐhuan shūfǎ, kètīng lǐ guà zhe tā de zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: My maternal grandfather likes calligraphy, and his works hang in the living room.

sentences.chinese: 新手机的外观很简洁，但功能很强。
sentences.traditional: 新手機的外觀很簡潔，但功能很強。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn shǒujī de wàiguān hěn jiǎnjié, dàn gōngnéng hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: The new phone has a simple appearance, but its functions are strong.

sentences.chinese: 他们不仅检查产品外观，还测试性能。
sentences.traditional: 他們不僅檢查產品外觀，還測試性能。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bùjǐn jiǎnchá chǎnpǐn wàiguān, hái cèshì xìngnéng.
sentences.translation: They not only check the product's appearance, but also test its performance.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥的外观保留了传统特色。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋的外觀保留了傳統特色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo de wàiguān bǎoliú le chuántǒng tèsè.
sentences.translation: The appearance of this bridge has preserved traditional features.

sentences.chinese: 我小时候常去外婆家过暑假。
sentences.traditional: 我小時候常去外婆家過暑假。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou cháng qù wàipó jiā guò shǔjià.
sentences.translation: When I was little, I often went to my maternal grandmother's home for the summer holidays.

sentences.chinese: 外婆虽然年纪大了，但身体还很健康。
sentences.traditional: 外婆雖然年紀大了，但身體還很健康。
sentences.pinyin: Wàipó suīrán niánjì dà le, dàn shēntǐ hái hěn jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Although my maternal grandmother is old, she is still in good health.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜是外婆教妈妈做的。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜是外婆教媽媽做的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài shì wàipó jiāo māma zuò de.
sentences.translation: This dish is one my maternal grandmother taught my mother to make.

sentences.chinese: 这款电动车的外形很现代，内部空间也很大。
sentences.traditional: 這款電動車的外形很現代，內部空間也很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn diàndòngchē de wàixíng hěn xiàndài, nèibù kōngjiān yě hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The appearance of this electric car is very modern, and the interior space is also large.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这两种水果外形相似，味道却完全不同。
sentences.traditional: 雖然這兩種水果外形相似，味道卻完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhè liǎng zhǒng shuǐguǒ wàixíng xiāngsì, wèidào què wánquán bù tóng.
sentences.translation: Although these two kinds of fruit are similar in shape, their flavours are completely different.

sentences.chinese: 设计师先调整外形，再考虑材料和成本。
sentences.traditional: 設計師先調整外形，再考慮材料和成本。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī xiān tiáozhěng wàixíng, zài kǎolǜ cáiliào hé chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The designer first adjusts the shape, then considers materials and cost.

sentences.chinese: 这条山路又窄又弯，开车时要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 這條山路又窄又彎，開車時要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānlù yòu zhǎi yòu wān, kāichē shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: This mountain road is narrow and winding, so you must be especially careful when driving.

sentences.chinese: 他把铁丝弯成一个小钩子，用来挂钥匙。
sentences.traditional: 他把鐵絲彎成一個小鉤子，用來掛鑰匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ tiěsī wān chéng yí gè xiǎo gōuzi, yòng lái guà yàoshi.
sentences.translation: He bent the wire into a small hook to hang keys on.

sentences.chinese: 河水在村口转了一个弯，然后流向远处。
sentences.traditional: 河水在村口轉了一個彎，然後流向遠處。
sentences.pinyin: Héshuǐ zài cūnkǒu zhuǎn le yí gè wān, ránhòu liú xiàng yuǎnchù.
sentences.translation: The river makes a bend at the entrance to the village and then flows into the distance.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把玩具收进箱子里，房间立刻整齐多了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把玩具收進箱子裡，房間立刻整齊多了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ wánjù shōu jìn xiāngzi lǐ, fángjiān lìkè zhěngqí duō le.
sentences.translation: The child put the toys into the box, and the room immediately became much tidier.

sentences.chinese: 这种木制玩具虽然简单，却很受孩子欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這種木製玩具雖然簡單，卻很受孩子歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng mùzhì wánjù suīrán jiǎndān, què hěn shòu háizi huānyíng.
sentences.translation: Although this wooden toy is simple, it is very popular with children.

sentences.chinese: 购买儿童玩具时，安全性应该放在第一位。
sentences.traditional: 購買兒童玩具時，安全性應該放在第一位。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi értóng wánjù shí, ānquánxìng yīnggāi fàng zài dì yī wèi.
sentences.translation: When buying children's toys, safety should be put first.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划看起来并不完美，但已经足够实用。
sentences.traditional: 這個計劃看起來並不完美，但已經足夠實用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà kàn qǐlái bìng bù wánměi, dàn yǐjīng zúgòu shíyòng.
sentences.translation: This plan does not look perfect, but it is already practical enough.

sentences.chinese: 她的回答几乎完美，老师只改了一个小地方。
sentences.traditional: 她的回答幾乎完美，老師只改了一個小地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huídá jīhū wánměi, lǎoshī zhǐ gǎi le yí gè xiǎo dìfang.
sentences.translation: Her answer was almost perfect; the teacher only corrected one small point.

sentences.chinese: 别总追求完美，否则很难按时完成任务。
sentences.traditional: 別總追求完美，否則很難按時完成任務。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zǒng zhuīqiú wánměi, fǒuzé hěn nán ànshí wánchéng rènwu.
sentences.translation: Do not always pursue perfection, otherwise it will be hard to finish the task on time.

sentences.chinese: 学校正在完善网络系统，方便学生提交作业。
sentences.traditional: 學校正在完善網絡系統，方便學生提交作業。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhèngzài wánshàn wǎngluò xìtǒng, fāngbiàn xuéshēng tíjiāo zuòyè.
sentences.translation: The school is improving its network system to make it easier for students to submit homework.

sentences.chinese: 这项制度还不够完善，需要继续调整。
