sentences.traditional: 這項制度還不夠完善，需要繼續調整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhìdù hái bú gòu wánshàn, xūyào jìxù tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: This system is not yet complete enough and needs further adjustment.

sentences.chinese: 在正式推出之前，团队会进一步完善产品功能。
sentences.traditional: 在正式推出之前，團隊會進一步完善產品功能。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì tuīchū zhīqián, tuánduì huì jìn yí bù wánshàn chǎnpǐn gōngnéng.
sentences.translation: Before the official launch, the team will further improve the product's functions.

sentences.chinese: 请把完整的资料发给我，不要只发其中一部分。
sentences.traditional: 請把完整的資料發給我，不要只發其中一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wánzhěng de zīliào fā gěi wǒ, bú yào zhǐ fā qízhōng yí bùfen.
sentences.translation: Please send me the complete materials, not just one part of them.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告内容完整，数据也比较清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告內容完整，數據也比較清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào nèiróng wánzhěng, shùjù yě bǐjiào qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The content of this report is complete, and the data is also fairly clear.

sentences.chinese: 虽然盒子被摔过，里面的花瓶仍然完整。
sentences.traditional: 雖然盒子被摔過，裡面的花瓶仍然完整。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán hézi bèi shuāi guo, lǐmiàn de huāpíng réngrán wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: Although the box had been dropped, the vase inside was still intact.

sentences.chinese: 你把地址发给我，万一走丢了也方便联系。
sentences.traditional: 你把地址發給我，萬一走丟了也方便聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ dìzhǐ fā gěi wǒ, wànyī zǒu diū le yě fāngbiàn liánxì.
sentences.translation: Send me the address; if you get lost, it will also be easier to contact each other.

sentences.chinese: 万一下雨，我们就把活动改到室内举行。
sentences.traditional: 萬一下雨，我們就把活動改到室內舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Wànyī xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù bǎ huódòng gǎi dào shìnèi jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: If it rains, we will move the activity indoors.

sentences.chinese: 出门前检查一下门锁，以防万一。
sentences.traditional: 出門前檢查一下門鎖，以防萬一。
sentences.pinyin: Chūmén qián jiǎnchá yí xià ménsuǒ, yǐfáng wànyī.
sentences.translation: Check the door lock before going out, just in case.

sentences.chinese: 从这座城市到海边往返大约需要四个小时。
sentences.traditional: 從這座城市到海邊往返大約需要四個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhè zuò chéngshì dào hǎibiān wǎngfǎn dàyuē xūyào sì gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: A return trip from this city to the seaside takes about four hours.

sentences.chinese: 这张车票可以在两地之间往返一次。
sentences.traditional: 這張車票可以在兩地之間往返一次。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng chēpiào kěyǐ zài liǎng dì zhījiān wǎngfǎn yí cì.
sentences.translation: This ticket allows one return journey between the two places.

sentences.chinese: 为了节省时间，公司安排了往返班车。
sentences.traditional: 為了節省時間，公司安排了往返班車。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, gōngsī ānpái le wǎngfǎn bānchē.
sentences.translation: To save time, the company arranged a shuttle bus for return journeys.

sentences.chinese: 如果网络不稳定，视频会议就很难顺利进行。
sentences.traditional: 如果網絡不穩定，視頻會議就很難順利進行。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǎngluò bù wěndìng, shìpín huìyì jiù hěn nán shùnlì jìnxíng.
sentences.translation: If the network is unstable, the video meeting will be hard to carry out smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 这个平台通过网络把老师和学生联系起来。
sentences.traditional: 這個平臺通過網絡把老師和學生聯繫起來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège píngtái tōngguò wǎngluò bǎ lǎoshī hé xuéshēng liánxì qǐlái.
sentences.translation: This platform connects teachers and students through the internet.

sentences.chinese: 企业越来越重视网络安全，避免数据被盗。
sentences.traditional: 企業越來越重視網絡安全，避免數據被盜。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yuè lái yuè zhòngshì wǎngluò ānquán, bìmiǎn shùjù bèi dào.
sentences.translation: Companies are paying more and more attention to network security to avoid data being stolen.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺乏睡眠会危害身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺乏睡眠會危害身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá shuìmián huì wēihài shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Long-term lack of sleep can harm physical health.

sentences.chinese: 乱扔垃圾不仅影响环境，还会危害野生动物。
sentences.traditional: 亂扔垃圾不僅影響環境，還會危害野生動物。
sentences.pinyin: Luàn rēng lājī bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng huánjìng, hái huì wēihài yěshēng dòngwù.
sentences.translation: Littering not only affects the environment but also harms wild animals.

sentences.chinese: 如果不及时处理，这种化学物质可能危害水源。
sentences.traditional: 如果不及時處理，這種化學物質可能危害水源。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí chǔlǐ, zhè zhǒng huàxué wùzhì kěnéng wēihài shuǐyuán.
sentences.translation: If it is not dealt with in time, this chemical substance may harm the water source.

sentences.chinese: 面对观众时，她保持微笑，语气也很自然。
sentences.traditional: 面對觀眾時，她保持微笑，語氣也很自然。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì guānzhòng shí, tā bǎochí wēixiào, yǔqì yě hěn zìrán.
sentences.translation: When facing the audience, she kept smiling, and her tone was also natural.

sentences.chinese: 看到孩子主动道歉，老师满意地微笑了。
sentences.traditional: 看到孩子主動道歉，老師滿意地微笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Kàn dào háizi zhǔdòng dàoqiàn, lǎoshī mǎnyì de wēixiào le.
sentences.translation: After seeing the child apologise on his own initiative, the teacher smiled with satisfaction.

sentences.chinese: 一个真诚的微笑有时候比很多解释更有力量。
sentences.traditional: 一個真誠的微笑有時候比很多解釋更有力量。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè zhēnchéng de wēixiào yǒu shíhou bǐ hěn duō jiěshì gèng yǒu lìliàng.
sentences.translation: A sincere smile is sometimes more powerful than many explanations.

sentences.chinese: 网络攻击正在威胁许多公司的数据安全。
sentences.traditional: 網絡攻擊正在威脅許多公司的數據安全。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò gōngjí zhèngzài wēixié xǔduō gōngsī de shùjù ānquán.
sentences.translation: Cyberattacks are threatening the data security of many companies.

sentences.chinese: 如果海平面继续上升，沿海城市可能受到威胁。
sentences.traditional: 如果海平面繼續上升，沿海城市可能受到威脅。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ hǎipíngmiàn jìxù shàngshēng, yánhǎi chéngshì kěnéng shòu dào wēixié.
sentences.translation: If sea levels continue to rise, coastal cities may be threatened.

sentences.chinese: 他没有用威胁的语气，只是把后果讲得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有用威脅的語氣，只是把後果講得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu yòng wēixié de yǔqì, zhǐshì bǎ hòuguǒ jiǎng de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: He did not use a threatening tone; he simply explained the consequences clearly.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们围着老师，听她讲神话故事。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們圍著老師，聽她講神話故事。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen wéi zhe lǎoshī, tīng tā jiǎng shénhuà gùshi.
sentences.translation: The children gathered around the teacher and listened to her tell mythological stories.

sentences.chinese: 他们用木栏把菜地围了起来。
sentences.traditional: 他們用木欄把菜地圍了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yòng mùlán bǎ càidì wéi le qǐlái.
sentences.translation: They enclosed the vegetable plot with a wooden fence.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，警察迅速围住了现场。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，警察迅速圍住了現場。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, jǐngchá xùnsù wéi zhù le xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: After the accident happened, the police quickly surrounded the scene.

sentences.chinese: 为保护环境，工厂必须减少污染物的排放。
sentences.traditional: 為保護環境，工廠必須減少污染物的排放。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi bǎohù huánjìng, gōngchǎng bìxū jiǎnshǎo wūrǎnwù de páifàng.
sentences.translation: For the sake of protecting the environment, factories must reduce pollutant emissions.

sentences.chinese: 他为这次比赛准备了整整三个月。
sentences.traditional: 他為這次比賽準備了整整三個月。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèi zhè cì bǐsài zhǔnbèi le zhěngzhěng sān gè yuè.
sentences.translation: He prepared for this competition for a full three months.

sentences.chinese: 父母常常为孩子的未来考虑很多。
sentences.traditional: 父母常常為孩子的未來考慮很多。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ chángcháng wèi háizi de wèilái kǎolǜ hěn duō.
sentences.translation: Parents often think a great deal about their children's future.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店靠稳定的顾客维持经营。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店靠穩定的顧客維持經營。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎodiàn kào wěndìng de gùkè wéichí jīngyíng.
sentences.translation: This small shop relies on regular customers to maintain its operations.

sentences.chinese: 为了维持秩序，工作人员请大家排队进入。
sentences.traditional: 為了維持秩序，工作人員請大家排隊進入。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile wéichí zhìxù, gōngzuò rényuán qǐng dàjiā páiduì jìnrù.
sentences.translation: To maintain order, staff asked everyone to queue before entering.

sentences.chinese: 即使收入下降，公司仍努力维持员工的福利。
sentences.traditional: 即使收入下降，公司仍努力維持員工的福利。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ shōurù xiàjiàng, gōngsī réng nǔlì wéichí yuángōng de fúlì.
sentences.translation: Even though income has fallen, the company is still working hard to maintain employee benefits.

sentences.chinese: 在公共场所吸烟可能违法，也会影响他人。
sentences.traditional: 在公共場所吸煙可能違法，也會影響他人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ xīyān kěnéng wéifǎ, yě huì yǐngxiǎng tārén.
sentences.translation: Smoking in public places may be illegal, and it can also affect other people.

sentences.chinese: 公司如果违法生产，必须承担严重后果。
sentences.traditional: 公司如果違法生產，必須承擔嚴重後果。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī rúguǒ wéifǎ shēngchǎn, bìxū chéngdān yánzhòng hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: If a company produces goods illegally, it must bear serious consequences.

sentences.chinese: 我们不能因为方便就做违法的事情。
sentences.traditional: 我們不能因為方便就做違法的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng yīnwèi fāngbiàn jiù zuò wéifǎ de shìqing.
sentences.translation: We cannot do illegal things just because they are convenient.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同明确说明，不得违反保密规定。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同明確說明，不得違反保密規定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong míngquè shuōmíng, bùdé wéifǎn bǎomì guīdìng.
sentences.translation: This contract clearly states that confidentiality rules must not be violated.

sentences.chinese: 他因为违反交通规则，被罚了款。
sentences.traditional: 他因為違反交通規則，被罰了款。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi wéifǎn jiāotōng guīzé, bèi fá le kuǎn.
sentences.translation: He was fined because he violated traffic rules.

sentences.chinese: 如果方案违反事实，就很难获得支持。
sentences.traditional: 如果方案違反事實，就很難獲得支持。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāng'àn wéifǎn shìshí, jiù hěn nán huòdé zhīchí.
sentences.translation: If the proposal goes against the facts, it will be hard to gain support.

sentences.chinese: 天气突然降温，她出门时多带了一条围巾。
sentences.traditional: 天氣突然降溫，她出門時多帶了一條圍巾。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tūrán jiàngwēn, tā chūmén shí duō dài le yì tiáo wéijīn.
sentences.translation: The temperature suddenly dropped, so she took an extra scarf when she went out.

sentences.chinese: 这条围巾是手工织的，颜色很特别。
sentences.traditional: 這條圍巾是手工織的，顏色很特別。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo wéijīn shì shǒugōng zhī de, yánsè hěn tèbié.
sentences.translation: This scarf is hand-knitted, and its colour is very distinctive.

sentences.chinese: 他把围巾围好以后，才走进风雪里。
sentences.traditional: 他把圍巾圍好以後，才走進風雪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wéijīn wéi hǎo yǐhòu, cái zǒu jìn fēngxuě lǐ.
sentences.translation: Only after wrapping his scarf properly did he walk into the wind and snow.

sentences.chinese: 这次谈话主要围绕孩子的学习问题展开。
sentences.traditional: 這次談話主要圍繞孩子的學習問題展開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tánhuà zhǔyào wéirào háizi de xuéxí wèntí zhǎnkāi.
sentences.translation: This conversation mainly developed around the child's study issues.

sentences.chinese: 新书的内容围绕城市生活和个人成长。
sentences.traditional: 新書的內容圍繞城市生活和個人成長。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn shū de nèiróng wéirào chéngshì shēnghuó hé gèrén chéngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The content of the new book revolves around urban life and personal growth.

sentences.chinese: 会议围绕如何提升服务质量进行了深入讨论。
sentences.traditional: 會議圍繞如何提升服務質量進行了深入討論。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì wéirào rúhé tíshēng fúwù zhìliàng jìnxíng le shēnrù tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: The meeting held an in-depth discussion around how to improve service quality.

sentences.chinese: 电梯需要定期维修，才能保持安全运行。
sentences.traditional: 電梯需要定期維修，才能保持安全運行。
sentences.pinyin: Diàntī xūyào dìngqī wéixiū, cái néng bǎochí ānquán yùnxíng.
sentences.translation: Lifts need regular maintenance in order to operate safely.

sentences.chinese: 电脑出了问题以后，他马上联系技术人员维修。
sentences.traditional: 電腦出了問題以後，他馬上聯繫技術人員維修。
sentences.pinyin: Diànnǎo chū le wèntí yǐhòu, tā mǎshàng liánxì jìshù rényuán wéixiū.
sentences.translation: After the computer developed a problem, he immediately contacted technical staff to repair it.

sentences.chinese: 这辆旧车维修成本太高，所以我们决定不再使用。
sentences.traditional: 這輛舊車維修成本太高，所以我們決定不再使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng jiù chē wéixiū chéngběn tài gāo, suǒyǐ wǒmen juédìng bú zài shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: The maintenance cost of this old car is too high, so we decided not to use it any more.

sentences.chinese: 这是我们目前唯一可行的方案。
sentences.traditional: 這是我們目前唯一可行的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen mùqián wéiyī kěxíng de fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: This is currently our only feasible plan.

sentences.chinese: 他是唯一知道真相的人，但他一直保持沉默。
sentences.traditional: 他是唯一知道真相的人，但他一直保持沉默。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì wéiyī zhīdào zhēnxiàng de rén, dàn tā yìzhí bǎochí chénmò.
sentences.translation: He is the only person who knows the truth, but he has stayed silent.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的唯一缺点是位置太远。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的唯一缺點是位置太遠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de wéiyī quēdiǎn shì wèizhì tài yuǎn.
sentences.translation: The only drawback of this shop is that its location is too far away.

sentences.chinese: 小狗高兴的时候，尾巴摇得特别快。
sentences.traditional: 小狗高興的時候，尾巴搖得特別快。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu gāoxìng de shíhou, wěiba yáo de tèbié kuài.
sentences.translation: When the puppy is happy, its tail wags especially fast.

sentences.chinese: 猫把尾巴藏在身体下面，看起来有些害怕。
sentences.traditional: 貓把尾巴藏在身體下面，看起來有些害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Māo bǎ wěiba cáng zài shēntǐ xiàmiàn, kànqǐlái yǒuxiē hàipà.
sentences.translation: The cat tucked its tail under its body and seemed a little scared.

sentences.chinese: 这条鱼的尾巴受伤了，游得不太稳。
sentences.traditional: 這條魚的尾巴受傷了，游得不太穩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú de wěiba shòushāng le, yóu de bú tài wěn.
sentences.translation: The fish's tail was injured, so it swam a bit unsteadily.

sentences.chinese: 伟大的作品往往能影响几代人。
sentences.traditional: 偉大的作品往往能影響幾代人。
sentences.pinyin: Wěidà de zuòpǐn wǎngwǎng néng yǐngxiǎng jǐ dài rén.
sentences.translation: Great works can often influence several generations.

sentences.chinese: 他并不认为自己伟大，只觉得做了该做的事。
sentences.traditional: 他並不認為自己偉大，只覺得做了該做的事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù rènwéi zìjǐ wěidà, zhǐ juéde zuò le gāi zuò de shì.
sentences.translation: He does not consider himself great; he only feels he did what he should have done.

sentences.chinese: 这位科学家的伟大发现改变了医学的发展方向。
sentences.traditional: 這位科學家的偉大發現改變了醫學的發展方向。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā de wěidà fāxiàn gǎibiàn le yīxué de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: This scientist's great discovery changed the direction of medical development.

sentences.chinese: 他最近胃不舒服，所以吃得很清淡。
sentences.traditional: 他最近胃不舒服，所以吃得很清淡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn wèi bù shūfu, suǒyǐ chī de hěn qīngdàn.
sentences.translation: His stomach has felt unwell recently, so he has been eating very lightly.

sentences.chinese: 空腹喝咖啡可能会刺激胃。
sentences.traditional: 空腹喝咖啡可能會刺激胃。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngfù hē kāfēi kěnéng huì cìjī wèi.
sentences.translation: Drinking coffee on an empty stomach may irritate the stomach.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒她，胃的问题不能长期忽视。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒她，胃的問題不能長期忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, wèi de wèntí bù néng chángqī hūshì.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded her that stomach problems should not be ignored for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 她每天早上都会喂小猫，然后再去上班。
sentences.traditional: 她每天早上都會餵小貓，然後再去上班。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu huì wèi xiǎomāo, ránhòu zài qù shàngbān.
sentences.translation: She feeds the kitten every morning and then goes to work.

sentences.chinese: 别把太甜的东西喂给孩子，对牙齿不好。
sentences.traditional: 別把太甜的東西餵給孩子，對牙齒不好。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ tài tián de dōngxi wèi gěi háizi, duì yáchǐ bù hǎo.
sentences.translation: Do not feed children things that are too sweet; it is bad for their teeth.

sentences.chinese: 动物园的工作人员正在喂刚出生的小鹿。
sentences.traditional: 動物園的工作人員正在餵剛出生的小鹿。
sentences.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán de gōngzuò rényuán zhèngzài wèi gāng chūshēng de xiǎolù.
sentences.translation: The zoo staff are feeding the newborn fawn.

sentences.chinese: 未来五年，公司计划扩大生产。
sentences.traditional: 未來五年，公司計劃擴大生產。
sentences.pinyin: Wèilái wǔ nián, gōngsī jìhuà kuòdà shēngchǎn.
sentences.translation: In the next five years, the company plans to expand production.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人应该为未来的生活提前做准备。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人應該為未來的生活提前做準備。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén yīnggāi wèi wèilái de shēnghuó tíqián zuò zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: Young people should prepare in advance for their future lives.

sentences.chinese: 科技的发展会给未来带来很多机会。
sentences.traditional: 科技的發展會給未來帶來很多機會。
sentences.pinyin: Kējì de fāzhǎn huì gěi wèilái dài lái hěn duō jīhuì.
sentences.translation: The development of technology will bring many opportunities for the future.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学位于城市北部，交通很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學位於城市北部，交通很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué wèiyú chéngshì běibù, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This university is located in the north of the city, and transport is very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 新建的体育馆位于河边，外观很现代。
sentences.traditional: 新建的體育館位於河邊，外觀很現代。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnjiàn de tǐyùguǎn wèiyú hé biān, wàiguān hěn xiàndài.
sentences.translation: The newly built sports hall is located by the river and has a modern exterior.

sentences.chinese: 那家酒店位于地铁站附近，适合游客入住。
sentences.traditional: 那家酒店位於地鐵站附近，適合遊客入住。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā jiǔdiàn wèiyú dìtiě zhàn fùjìn, shìhé yóukè rùzhù.
sentences.translation: That hotel is located near the underground station and is suitable for tourists to stay in.

sentences.chinese: 这个位置离窗户近，光线比较好。
sentences.traditional: 這個位置離窗戶近，光線比較好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge wèizhì lí chuānghu jìn, guāngxiàn bǐjiào hǎo.
sentences.translation: This position is close to the window, so the light is relatively good.

sentences.chinese: 请把文件放回原来的位置，方便大家查找。
sentences.traditional: 請把文件放回原來的位置，方便大家查找。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn fàng huí yuánlái de wèizhì, fāngbiàn dàjiā cházhǎo.
sentences.translation: Please put the file back in its original place so everyone can find it easily.

sentences.chinese: 他在团队中的位置越来越重要。
sentences.traditional: 他在團隊中的位置越來越重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài tuánduì zhōng de wèizhì yuè lái yuè zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: His position in the team is becoming increasingly important.

sentences.chinese: 春天的阳光很温暖，让人心情变好。
sentences.traditional: 春天的陽光很溫暖，讓人心情變好。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān de yángguāng hěn wēnnuǎn, ràng rén xīnqíng biàn hǎo.
sentences.translation: The spring sunshine is warm and makes people feel better.

sentences.chinese: 这封信温暖了她的心，也给了她力量。
sentences.traditional: 這封信溫暖了她的心，也給了她力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn wēnnuǎn le tā de xīn, yě gěi le tā lìliàng.
sentences.translation: This letter warmed her heart and also gave her strength.

sentences.chinese: 家人的支持让这个冬天显得特别温暖。
sentences.traditional: 家人的支持讓這個冬天顯得特別溫暖。
sentences.pinyin: Jiārén de zhīchí ràng zhè ge dōngtiān xiǎnde tèbié wēnnuǎn.
sentences.translation: The support of family made this winter seem especially warm.

sentences.chinese: 他从小就喜欢文学，后来成为了一名作家。
sentences.traditional: 他從小就喜歡文學，後來成為了一名作家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐhuan wénxué, hòulái chéngwéi le yì míng zuòjiā.
sentences.translation: He has liked literature since childhood and later became a writer.

sentences.chinese: 这门课主要介绍中国现代文学。
sentences.traditional: 這門課主要介紹中國現代文學。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kè zhǔyào jièshào Zhōngguó xiàndài wénxué.
sentences.translation: This course mainly introduces modern Chinese literature.

sentences.chinese: 文学作品能帮助我们理解不同的生活经验。
sentences.traditional: 文學作品能幫助我們理解不同的生活經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Wénxué zuòpǐn néng bāngzhù wǒmen lǐjiě bùtóng de shēnghuó jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Literary works can help us understand different life experiences.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作虽然收入不高，但很稳定。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作雖然收入不高，但很穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò suīrán shōurù bù gāo, dàn hěn wěndìng.
sentences.translation: Although this job does not pay highly, it is very stable.

sentences.chinese: 政府采取措施稳定市场价格。
sentences.traditional: 政府採取措施穩定市場價格。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ cuòshī wěndìng shìchǎng jiàgé.
sentences.translation: The government adopted measures to stabilise market prices.

sentences.chinese: 情绪稳定以后，他才愿意谈刚才发生的事。
sentences.traditional: 情緒穩定以後，他才願意談剛才發生的事。
sentences.pinyin: Qíngxù wěndìng yǐhòu, tā cái yuànyì tán gāngcái fāshēng de shì.
sentences.translation: After his emotions became stable, he was willing to talk about what had just happened.

sentences.chinese: 请大家在会议结束前填写这份问卷。
sentences.traditional: 請大家在會議結束前填寫這份問卷。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā zài huìyì jiéshù qián tiánxiě zhè fèn wènjuàn.
sentences.translation: Please fill in this questionnaire before the meeting ends.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员通过问卷了解市民的出行习惯。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員通過問卷了解市民的出行習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán tōngguò wènjuàn liǎojiě shìmín de chūxíng xíguàn.
sentences.translation: Researchers used questionnaires to understand citizens' travel habits.

sentences.chinese: 这份问卷的问题设计得比较清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這份問卷的問題設計得比較清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn wènjuàn de wèntí shèjì de bǐjiào qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The questions in this questionnaire are designed fairly clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他紧紧握着孩子的手，穿过人群。
sentences.traditional: 他緊緊握著孩子的手，穿過人群。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǐnjǐn wòzhe háizi de shǒu, chuānguò rénqún.
sentences.translation: He held the child's hand tightly and walked through the crowd.

sentences.chinese: 只要握住机会，就可能改变自己的未来。
sentences.traditional: 只要握住機會，就可能改變自己的未來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào wò zhù jīhuì, jiù kěnéng gǎibiàn zìjǐ de wèilái.
sentences.translation: As long as you grasp the opportunity, you may be able to change your future.

sentences.chinese: 他手里握着一把旧钥匙。
sentences.traditional: 他手裡握著一把舊鑰匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ wòzhe yì bǎ jiù yàoshi.
sentences.translation: He was holding an old key in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 卧室的窗户朝南，所以白天很明亮。
sentences.traditional: 臥室的窗戶朝南，所以白天很明亮。
sentences.pinyin: Wòshì de chuānghu cháo nán, suǒyǐ báitiān hěn míngliàng.
sentences.translation: The bedroom window faces south, so it is very bright during the day.

sentences.chinese: 她把书架搬进卧室，方便睡前阅读。
sentences.traditional: 她把書架搬進臥室，方便睡前閱讀。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ shūjià bān jìn wòshì, fāngbiàn shuì qián yuèdú.
sentences.translation: She moved the bookshelf into the bedroom to make bedtime reading easier.

sentences.chinese: 这套公寓有两个卧室和一个小书房。
sentences.traditional: 這套公寓有兩個臥室和一個小書房。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù yǒu liǎng gè wòshì hé yí gè xiǎo shūfáng.
sentences.translation: This flat has two bedrooms and a small study.

sentences.chinese: 见面时，他主动和客人握手。
sentences.traditional: 見面時，他主動和客人握手。
sentences.pinyin: Jiànmiàn shí, tā zhǔdòng hé kèrén wòshǒu.
sentences.translation: When they met, he took the initiative to shake hands with the guest.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结束后，双方队员互相握手表示尊重。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結束後，雙方隊員互相握手表示尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù hòu, shuāngfāng duìyuán hùxiāng wòshǒu biǎoshì zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: After the match, players from both sides shook hands to show respect.

sentences.chinese: 她微笑着伸出手，准备握手。
sentences.traditional: 她微笑著伸出手，準備握手。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wēixiàozhe shēn chū shǒu, zhǔnbèi wòshǒu.
sentences.translation: She smiled and held out her hand, ready to shake hands.

sentences.chinese: 这件事与他的身份无关。
sentences.traditional: 這件事與他的身分無關。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǔ tā de shēnfèn wúguān.
sentences.translation: This matter has nothing to do with his identity.

sentences.chinese: 请回答与题目有关的问题，不要谈无关的内容。
sentences.traditional: 請回答與題目有關的問題，不要談無關的內容。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng huídá yǔ tímù yǒuguān de wèntí, bú yào tán wúguān de nèiróng.
sentences.translation: Please answer questions related to the topic and do not discuss irrelevant content.

sentences.chinese: 结果如何与运气无关，关键在于准备是否充分。
sentences.traditional: 結果如何與運氣無關，關鍵在於準備是否充分。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéguǒ rúhé yǔ yùnqì wúguān, guānjiàn zàiyú zhǔnbèi shìfǒu chōngfèn.
sentences.translation: How things turn out has nothing to do with luck; the key lies in whether the preparation is sufficient.

sentences.chinese: 面对复杂的情况，他显得很无奈。
sentences.traditional: 面對複雜的情況，他顯得很無奈。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì fùzá de qíngkuàng, tā xiǎnde hěn wúnài.
sentences.translation: Faced with the complicated situation, he appeared very helpless.

sentences.chinese: 票已经卖完了，我们无奈只好改天再来。
sentences.traditional: 票已經賣完了，我們無奈只好改天再來。
sentences.pinyin: Piào yǐjīng mài wán le, wǒmen wúnài zhǐhǎo gǎi tiān zài lái.
sentences.translation: The tickets had already sold out, so we had no choice but to come another day.

sentences.chinese: 她想继续解释，无奈时间不够，只能先离开。
sentences.traditional: 她想繼續解釋，無奈時間不夠，只能先離開。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng jìxù jiěshì, wúnài shíjiān bú gòu, zhǐ néng xiān líkāi.
sentences.translation: She wanted to continue explaining, but there was not enough time, so she had to leave first.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市有无数值得探索的小巷。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市有無數值得探索的小巷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu wúshù zhíde tànsuǒ de xiǎoxiàng.
sentences.translation: This city has countless small lanes worth exploring.

sentences.chinese: 他的成功来自无数次失败后的坚持。
sentences.traditional: 他的成功來自無數次失敗後的堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de chénggōng láizì wúshù cì shībài hòu de jiānchí.
sentences.translation: His success came from persistence after countless failures.

sentences.chinese: 夜空中闪着无数颗星星。
sentences.traditional: 夜空中閃著無數顆星星。
sentences.pinyin: Yèkōng zhōng shǎnzhe wúshù kē xīngxing.
sentences.translation: Countless stars were shining in the night sky.

sentences.chinese: 互联网让学习的机会变得几乎无限。
sentences.traditional: 互聯網讓學習的機會變得幾乎無限。
sentences.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng ràng xuéxí de jīhuì biàn de jīhū wúxiàn.
sentences.translation: The internet has made learning opportunities almost unlimited.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人的创造力有无限的可能。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人的創造力有無限的可能。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén de chuàngzàolì yǒu wúxiàn de kěnéng.
sentences.translation: Young people's creativity has infinite possibilities.

sentences.chinese: 这张会员卡可以无限次使用。
sentences.traditional: 這張會員卡可以無限次使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng huìyuán kǎ kěyǐ wúxiàn cì shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This membership card can be used an unlimited number of times.

sentences.chinese: 如果信息填写错误，申请可能会无效。
sentences.traditional: 如果信息填寫錯誤，申請可能會無效。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xìnxī tiánxiě cuòwù, shēnqǐng kěnéng huì wúxiào.
sentences.translation: If the information is filled in incorrectly, the application may be invalid.

sentences.chinese: 这种药对他的症状无效，医生建议换一种。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥對他的症狀無效，醫生建議換一種。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào duì tā de zhèngzhuàng wúxiào, yīshēng jiànyì huàn yì zhǒng.
sentences.translation: This medicine is ineffective for his symptoms, so the doctor suggested changing to another one.

sentences.chinese: 合同签字不完整，因此被视为无效。
sentences.traditional: 合同簽字不完整，因此被視為無效。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong qiānzì bù wánzhěng, yīncǐ bèi shìwéi wúxiào.
sentences.translation: The contract was signed incompletely, so it was regarded as invalid.

sentences.chinese: 她从小学习舞蹈，现在能在舞台上自信地表演。
sentences.traditional: 她從小學習舞蹈，現在能在舞臺上自信地表演。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xuéxí wǔdǎo, xiànzài néng zài wǔtái shang zìxìn de biǎoyǎn.
sentences.translation: She has studied dance since childhood and can now perform confidently on stage.

sentences.chinese: 这段舞蹈动作很有力量，给观众留下了深刻印象。
sentences.traditional: 這段舞蹈動作很有力量，給觀眾留下了深刻印象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn wǔdǎo dòngzuò hěn yǒu lìliàng, gěi guānzhòng liúxià le shēnkè yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: The movements in this dance are powerful and left a deep impression on the audience.

sentences.chinese: 学校准备开设新的舞蹈课程，鼓励学生参加。
sentences.traditional: 學校準備開設新的舞蹈課程，鼓勵學生參加。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhǔnbèi kāishè xīn de wǔdǎo kèchéng, gǔlì xuésheng cānjiā.
sentences.translation: The school is preparing to open a new dance course and encourage students to join.

sentences.chinese: 他练了多年武术，身体素质明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 他練了多年武術，身體素質明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liàn le duō nián wǔshù, shēntǐ sùzhì míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: He has practised martial arts for many years, and his physical fitness has clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 武术不仅是一种运动，也体现了中国文化。
sentences.traditional: 武術不僅是一種運動，也體現了中國文化。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔshù bùjǐn shì yì zhǒng yùndòng, yě tǐxiàn le Zhōngguó wénhuà.
sentences.translation: Martial arts are not only a kind of sport, but also embody Chinese culture.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校把武术课作为特色课程推广。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校把武術課作為特色課程推廣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào bǎ wǔshù kè zuòwéi tèsè kèchéng tuīguǎng.
sentences.translation: This school promotes martial arts classes as a special course.

sentences.chinese: 她第一次站上舞台时，紧张得说不出话。
sentences.traditional: 她第一次站上舞臺時，緊張得說不出話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì zhàn shàng wǔtái shí, jǐnzhāng de shuō bù chū huà.
sentences.translation: When she stepped onto the stage for the first time, she was so nervous that she could not speak.

sentences.chinese: 这个节目需要更大的舞台来展示效果。
sentences.traditional: 這個節目需要更大的舞臺來展示效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jiémù xūyào gèng dà de wǔtái lái zhǎnshì xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: This programme needs a larger stage to show its effect.

sentences.chinese: 舞台灯光一亮，观众立刻安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 舞臺燈光一亮，觀眾立刻安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔtái dēngguāng yí liàng, guānzhòng lìkè ānjìng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: As soon as the stage lights came on, the audience immediately quietened down.

sentences.chinese: 春天到了，公园里开满了五颜六色的花。
sentences.traditional: 春天到了，公園裡開滿了五顏六色的花。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, gōngyuán lǐ kāi mǎn le wǔyán-liùsè de huā.
sentences.translation: Spring has arrived, and the park is full of colourful flowers.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们用五颜六色的纸做了一面墙。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們用五顏六色的紙做了一面牆。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yòng wǔyán-liùsè de zhǐ zuò le yí miàn qiáng.
sentences.translation: The children used colourful paper to make a wall display.

sentences.chinese: 市场上摆着五颜六色的水果，看起来很新鲜。
sentences.traditional: 市場上擺著五顏六色的水果，看起來很新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Shìchǎng shang bǎizhe wǔyán-liùsè de shuǐguǒ, kàn qǐlái hěn xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: Colourful fruit was laid out in the market and looked very fresh.

sentences.chinese: 早上雾很大，开车要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 早上霧很大，開車要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang wù hěn dà, kāichē yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: The fog was heavy in the morning, so you need to be especially careful when driving.

sentences.chinese: 山里的雾慢慢散开，远处的村子露了出来。
sentences.traditional: 山裡的霧慢慢散開，遠處的村子露了出來。
sentences.pinyin: Shān lǐ de wù mànmàn sàn kāi, yuǎnchù de cūnzi lù le chūlái.
sentences.translation: The fog in the mountains slowly cleared, and the distant village appeared.

sentences.chinese: 因为有雾，今天的航班可能会延迟。
sentences.traditional: 因為有霧，今天的航班可能會延遲。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu wù, jīntiān de hángbān kěnéng huì yánchí.
sentences.translation: Because there is fog, today's flight may be delayed.

sentences.chinese: 最近物价上涨得比较快，很多家庭开始减少开支。
sentences.traditional: 最近物價上漲得比較快，很多家庭開始減少開支。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn wùjià shàngzhǎng de bǐjiào kuài, hěn duō jiātíng kāishǐ jiǎnshǎo kāizhī.
sentences.translation: Recently prices have been rising fairly quickly, and many families have started reducing spending.

sentences.chinese: 政府正在采取措施稳定物价。
sentences.traditional: 政府正在採取措施穩定物價。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài cǎiqǔ cuòshī wěndìng wùjià.
sentences.translation: The government is taking measures to stabilise prices.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的物价比我想象中低一些。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的物價比我想像中低一些。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de wùjià bǐ wǒ xiǎngxiàng zhōng dī yì xiē.
sentences.translation: Prices in this city are a little lower than I imagined.

sentences.chinese: 他对物理很感兴趣，常常自己做小实验。
sentences.traditional: 他對物理很感興趣，常常自己做小實驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wùlǐ hěn gǎn xìngqù, chángcháng zìjǐ zuò xiǎo shíyàn.
sentences.translation: He is very interested in physics and often does small experiments by himself.

sentences.chinese: 物理老师用生活中的例子解释了这个现象。
sentences.traditional: 物理老師用生活中的例子解釋了這個現象。
sentences.pinyin: Wùlǐ lǎoshī yòng shēnghuó zhōng de lìzi jiěshì le zhè ge xiànxiàng.
sentences.translation: The physics teacher used examples from daily life to explain this phenomenon.

sentences.chinese: 学好物理需要理解公式背后的意义。
sentences.traditional: 學好物理需要理解公式背後的意義。
sentences.pinyin: Xué hǎo wùlǐ xūyào lǐjiě gōngshì bèihòu de yìyì.
sentences.translation: To learn physics well, you need to understand the meaning behind the formulas.

sentences.chinese: 请把贵重物品放在安全的位置。
sentences.traditional: 請把貴重物品放在安全的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ guìzhòng wùpǐn fàng zài ānquán de wèizhì.
sentences.translation: Please put valuable items in a safe place.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者把收到的物品分类后送给需要的人。
sentences.traditional: 志願者把收到的物品分類後送給需要的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě bǎ shōu dào de wùpǐn fēnlèi hòu sòng gěi xūyào de rén.
sentences.translation: The volunteers sorted the items they received and then gave them to people in need.

sentences.chinese: 这些物品虽然不贵，但对我很有纪念意义。
sentences.traditional: 這些物品雖然不貴，但對我很有紀念意義。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē wùpǐn suīrán bú guì, dàn duì wǒ hěn yǒu jìniàn yìyì.
sentences.translation: Although these items are not expensive, they have great commemorative value for me.

sentences.chinese: 小区的物业负责维修电梯和打扫公共区域。
sentences.traditional: 小區的物業負責維修電梯和打掃公共區域。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoqū de wùyè fùzé wéixiū diàntī hé dǎsǎo gōnggòng qūyù.
sentences.translation: The residential property management is responsible for repairing lifts and cleaning public areas.

sentences.chinese: 如果水管坏了，可以先联系物业。
sentences.traditional: 如果水管壞了，可以先聯繫物業。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shuǐguǎn huài le, kěyǐ xiān liánxì wùyè.
sentences.translation: If the water pipe is broken, you can contact the property management first.

sentences.chinese: 这家物业公司的服务态度需要改善。
sentences.traditional: 這家物業公司的服務態度需要改善。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā wùyè gōngsī de fúwù tàidù xūyào gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: The service attitude of this property management company needs improvement.

sentences.chinese: 幸福不完全取决于物质条件。
sentences.traditional: 幸福不完全取決於物質條件。
sentences.pinyin: Xìngfú bù wánquán qǔjué yú wùzhì tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: Happiness does not depend entirely on material conditions.

sentences.chinese: 科学家正在研究这种物质的特殊作用。
sentences.traditional: 科學家正在研究這種物質的特殊作用。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài yánjiū zhè zhǒng wùzhì de tèshū zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Scientists are studying the special function of this substance.

sentences.chinese: 过度追求物质可能会让人忽视精神生活。
sentences.traditional: 過度追求物質可能會讓人忽視精神生活。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù zhuīqiú wùzhì kěnéng huì ràng rén hūshì jīngshén shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Excessively pursuing material things may cause people to neglect spiritual life.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的西餐做得很地道，但价格有点高。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的西餐做得很道地，但價格有點高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de xīcān zuò de hěn dìdao, dàn jiàgé yǒudiǎn gāo.
sentences.translation: The Western food at this restaurant is very authentic, but the prices are a little high.

sentences.chinese: 他刚到欧洲时，不太习惯每天吃西餐。
sentences.traditional: 他剛到歐洲時，不太習慣每天吃西餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng dào Ōuzhōu shí, bú tài xíguàn měi tiān chī xīcān.
sentences.translation: When he first arrived in Europe, he was not very used to eating Western food every day.

sentences.chinese: 为了接待外国客户，公司安排了一顿西餐。
sentences.traditional: 為了接待外國客戶，公司安排了一頓西餐。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiēdài wàiguó kèhù, gōngsī ānpái le yí dùn xīcān.
sentences.translation: To receive the foreign clients, the company arranged a Western meal.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少塑料污染，这家店不再提供一次性吸管。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少塑膠污染，這家店不再提供一次性吸管。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo sùliào wūrǎn, zhè jiā diàn bú zài tígōng yí cì xìng xīguǎn.
sentences.translation: To reduce plastic pollution, this shop no longer provides disposable straws.

sentences.chinese: 孩子用吸管喝果汁，不小心把杯子碰倒了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子用吸管喝果汁，不小心把杯子碰倒了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yòng xīguǎn hē guǒzhī, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ bēizi pèng dǎo le.
sentences.translation: The child drank juice with a straw and accidentally knocked the cup over.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他手术后先用吸管喝水。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他手術後先用吸管喝水。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā shǒushù hòu xiān yòng xīguǎn hē shuǐ.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to use a straw to drink water after the operation.

sentences.chinese: 植物通过根吸收水分和营养。
sentences.traditional: 植物通過根吸收水分和營養。
sentences.pinyin: Zhíwù tōngguò gēn xīshōu shuǐfèn hé yíngyǎng.
sentences.translation: Plants absorb water and nutrients through their roots.

sentences.chinese: 海绵能迅速吸收桌上的水。
sentences.traditional: 海綿能迅速吸收桌上的水。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎimián néng xùnsù xīshōu zhuō shang de shuǐ.
sentences.translation: A sponge can quickly absorb the water on the table.

sentences.chinese: 企业应该吸收员工的合理建议。
sentences.traditional: 企業應該吸收員工的合理建議。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīnggāi xīshōu yuángōng de hélǐ jiànyì.
sentences.translation: A company should absorb its employees’ reasonable suggestions.

sentences.chinese: 参加正式会议时，他通常会穿西装。
sentences.traditional: 參加正式會議時，他通常會穿西裝。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā zhèngshì huìyì shí, tā tōngcháng huì chuān xīzhuāng.
sentences.translation: When attending formal meetings, he usually wears a suit.

sentences.chinese: 这套西装虽然不便宜，但做工非常精细。
sentences.traditional: 這套西裝雖然不便宜，但做工非常精細。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xīzhuāng suīrán bù piányi, dàn zuògōng fēicháng jīngxì.
sentences.translation: Although this suit is not cheap, the workmanship is very fine.

sentences.chinese: 面试前，他特意把西装送去清洗。
sentences.traditional: 面試前，他特意把西裝送去清洗。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì qián, tā tèyì bǎ xīzhuāng sòng qù qīngxǐ.
sentences.translation: Before the interview, he specially sent his suit to be cleaned.

sentences.chinese: 这出戏的结尾很感人，很多观众都哭了。
sentences.traditional: 這齣戲的結尾很感人，很多觀眾都哭了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chū xì de jiéwěi hěn gǎnrén, hěn duō guānzhòng dōu kū le.
sentences.translation: The ending of this play is very moving, and many audience members cried.

sentences.chinese: 小时候，他常常跟朋友一起演戏。
sentences.traditional: 小時候，他常常跟朋友一起演戲。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou, tā chángcháng gēn péngyou yìqǐ yǎn xì.
sentences.translation: When he was little, he often acted in plays with his friends.

sentences.chinese: 学校礼堂今晚有一场戏，学生可以免费观看。
sentences.traditional: 學校禮堂今晚有一場戲，學生可以免費觀看。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào lǐtáng jīnwǎn yǒu yì chǎng xì, xuésheng kěyǐ miǎnfèi guānkàn.
sentences.translation: There is a play in the school hall tonight, and students can watch it for free.

sentences.chinese: 她是中文系的研究生，主要研究古代文学。
sentences.traditional: 她是中文系的研究生，主要研究古代文學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì Zhōngwén xì de yánjiūshēng, zhǔyào yánjiū gǔdài wénxué.
sentences.translation: She is a postgraduate in the Chinese department and mainly studies ancient literature.

sentences.chinese: 这个系每年都会举办一次学术会议。
sentences.traditional: 這個系每年都會舉辦一次學術會議。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge xì měi nián dōu huì jǔbàn yí cì xuéshù huìyì.
sentences.translation: This department holds an academic conference every year.

sentences.chinese: 进入大学后，他从物理系转到了计算机系。
sentences.traditional: 進入大學後，他從物理系轉到了計算機系。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù dàxué hòu, tā cóng wùlǐ xì zhuǎn dào le jìsuànjī xì.
sentences.translation: After entering university, he transferred from the physics department to the computer science department.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划的整体方向不错，但很多细节还需要调整。
sentences.traditional: 這個計畫的整體方向不錯，但很多細節還需要調整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jìhuà de zhěngtǐ fāngxiàng búcuò, dàn hěn duō xìjié hái xūyào tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: The overall direction of this plan is good, but many details still need adjusting.

sentences.chinese: 他写报告时特别重视数据和细节。
sentences.traditional: 他寫報告時特別重視資料和細節。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě bàogào shí tèbié zhòngshì shùjù hé xìjié.
sentences.translation: When writing reports, he pays particular attention to data and details.

sentences.chinese: 正是这些小细节体现了服务的水平。
sentences.traditional: 正是這些小細節體現了服務的水準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèng shì zhèxiē xiǎo xìjié tǐxiàn le fúwù de shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: It is precisely these small details that reflect the level of service.

sentences.chinese: 戏剧能够通过冲突表现复杂的人性。
sentences.traditional: 戲劇能夠通過沖突表現複雜的人性。
sentences.pinyin: Xìjù nénggòu tōngguò chōngtū biǎoxiàn fùzá de rénxìng.
sentences.translation: Drama can express complex human nature through conflict.

sentences.chinese: 她大学学的是戏剧，毕业后进入了剧院工作。
sentences.traditional: 她大學學的是戲劇，畢業後進入了劇院工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué xué de shì xìjù, bìyè hòu jìnrù le jùyuàn gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: She studied drama at university and entered a theatre after graduation.

sentences.chinese: 这部戏剧的语言很深刻，值得反复阅读。
sentences.traditional: 這部戲劇的語言很深刻，值得反覆閱讀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xìjù de yǔyán hěn shēnkè, zhíde fǎnfù yuèdú.
sentences.translation: The language of this drama is profound and worth reading repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 新系统上线后，处理订单的速度明显提高了。
sentences.traditional: 新系統上線後，處理訂單的速度明顯提高了。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng shàngxiàn hòu, chǔlǐ dìngdān de sùdù míngxiǎn tígāo le.
sentences.translation: After the new system went online, the speed of processing orders clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 学习语言需要系统的方法，不能只靠记忆单词。
sentences.traditional: 學習語言需要系統的方法，不能只靠記憶單詞。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yǔyán xūyào xìtǒng de fāngfǎ, bùnéng zhǐ kào jìyì dāncí.
sentences.translation: Learning a language requires a systematic method; you cannot rely only on memorising words.

sentences.chinese: 如果系统出现故障，请先保存重要数据。
sentences.traditional: 如果系統出現故障，請先儲存重要資料。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xìtǒng chūxiàn gùzhàng, qǐng xiān bǎocún zhòngyào shùjù.
sentences.translation: If the system has a fault, please save important data first.

sentences.chinese: 你可以在官网下载最新版本的软件。
sentences.traditional: 你可以在官網下載最新版本的軟件。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài guānwǎng xiàzài zuìxīn bǎnběn de ruǎnjiàn.
sentences.translation: You can download the latest version of the software from the official website.

sentences.chinese: 文件太大，下载可能需要几分钟。
sentences.traditional: 文件太大，下載可能需要幾分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Wénjiàn tài dà, xiàzài kěnéng xūyào jǐ fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: The file is too large, so downloading it may take a few minutes.

sentences.chinese: 请不要随意下载来源不明的资料。
sentences.traditional: 請不要隨意下載來源不明的資料。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào suíyì xiàzài láiyuán bù míng de zīliào.
sentences.translation: Please do not casually download materials from unknown sources.

sentences.chinese: 会议上，三位专家先后发表了意见。
sentences.traditional: 會議上，三位專家先後發表了意見。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shang, sān wèi zhuānjiā xiānhòu fābiǎo le yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: At the meeting, three experts expressed their opinions one after another.

sentences.chinese: 过去十年，这座城市先后建成了地铁和新区。
sentences.traditional: 過去十年，這座城市先後建成了地鐵和新區。
sentences.pinyin: Guòqù shí nián, zhè zuò chéngshì xiānhòu jiànchéng le dìtiě hé xīnqū.
sentences.translation: Over the past decade, this city built a metro and a new district one after another.

sentences.chinese: 他先后在两家公司工作，积累了丰富的经验。
sentences.traditional: 他先後在兩家公司工作，積累了豐富的經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiānhòu zài liǎng jiā gōngsī gōngzuò, jīlěi le fēngfù de jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He worked at two companies successively and accumulated rich experience.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司引进了先进的生产设备。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司引進了先進的生產設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǐnjìn le xiānjìn de shēngchǎn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This company introduced advanced production equipment.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该学习先进的管理经验。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該學習先進的管理經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi xuéxí xiānjìn de guǎnlǐ jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: We should learn advanced management experience.

sentences.chinese: 他的研究方法很先进，受到大家的重视。
sentences.traditional: 他的研究方法很先進，受到大家的重視。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yánjiū fāngfǎ hěn xiānjìn, shòu dào dàjiā de zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: His research method is very advanced and is valued by everyone.

sentences.chinese: 我最近不太闲，可能要下周才能见面。
sentences.traditional: 我最近不太閒，可能要下週才能見面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn bú tài xián, kěnéng yào xià zhōu cái néng jiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: I have not been very free recently, so I may not be able to meet until next week.

sentences.chinese: 别让设备闲着，下午可以继续使用。
sentences.traditional: 別讓設備閒著，下午可以繼續使用。
sentences.pinyin: Bié ràng shèbèi xiánzhe, xiàwǔ kěyǐ jìxù shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: Do not leave the equipment idle; it can continue to be used this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 他退休后并没有闲下来，而是参加了志愿服务。
sentences.traditional: 他退休後並沒有閒下來，而是參加了志願服務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu bìng méiyǒu xián xiàlái, ér shì cānjiā le zhìyuàn fúwù.
sentences.translation: After retiring, he did not become idle, but took part in volunteer service.

sentences.chinese: 他穿上西装后显得更加成熟。
sentences.traditional: 他穿上西裝後顯得更加成熟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān shang xīzhuāng hòu xiǎnde gèngjiā chéngshú.
sentences.translation: After putting on the suit, he appeared even more mature.

sentences.chinese: 房间里放了一束花，显得温暖多了。
sentences.traditional: 房間裡放了一束花，顯得溫暖多了。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ fàng le yì shù huā, xiǎnde wēnnuǎn duō le.
sentences.translation: A bunch of flowers in the room made it seem much warmer.

sentences.chinese: 这个解释显得有些简单，还需要补充细节。
sentences.traditional: 這個解釋顯得有些簡單，還需要補充細節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jiěshì xiǎnde yǒuxiē jiǎndān, hái xūyào bǔchōng xìjié.
sentences.translation: This explanation seems a little simple, and more details still need to be added.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定显然经过了深入考虑。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定顯然經過了深入考慮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge juédìng xiǎnrán jīngguò le shēnrù kǎolǜ.
sentences.translation: This decision clearly went through deep consideration.

sentences.chinese: 他没有按时提交报告，显然是忘记了。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有按時提交報告，顯然是忘記了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu ànshí tíjiāo bàogào, xiǎnrán shì wàngjì le.
sentences.translation: He did not submit the report on time; evidently, he forgot.

sentences.chinese: 从数据来看，问题显然比我们想象的严重。
sentences.traditional: 從數據來看，問題顯然比我們想像的嚴重。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng shùjù lái kàn, wèntí xiǎnrán bǐ wǒmen xiǎngxiàng de yánzhòng.
sentences.translation: Judging from the data, the problem is clearly more serious than we imagined.

sentences.chinese: 屏幕显示火车已经晚点十分钟。
sentences.traditional: 屏幕顯示火車已經晚點十分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Píngmù xiǎnshì huǒchē yǐjīng wǎndiǎn shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: The screen shows that the train is already ten minutes late.

sentences.chinese: 调查结果显示，年轻人更重视工作环境。
sentences.traditional: 調查結果顯示，年輕人更重視工作環境。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jiéguǒ xiǎnshì, niánqīng rén gèng zhòngshì gōngzuò huánjìng.
sentences.translation: The survey results show that young people value the working environment more.

sentences.chinese: 这张图清楚地显示了价格变化的趋势。
sentences.traditional: 這張圖清楚地顯示了價格變化的趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng tú qīngchǔ de xiǎnshì le jiàgé biànhuà de qūshì.
sentences.translation: This chart clearly shows the trend of price changes.

sentences.chinese: 他出生在一个离省会很远的小县。
sentences.traditional: 他出生在一個離省會很遠的小縣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chūshēng zài yí ge lí shěnghuì hěn yuǎn de xiǎo xiàn.
sentences.translation: He was born in a small county far from the provincial capital.

sentences.chinese: 这个县以茶叶和竹子闻名。
sentences.traditional: 這個縣以茶葉和竹子聞名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge xiàn yǐ cháyè hé zhúzi wénmíng.
sentences.translation: This county is famous for tea and bamboo.

sentences.chinese: 县里的学校正在升级网络系统。
sentences.traditional: 縣裡的學校正在升級網絡系統。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn lǐ de xuéxiào zhèngzài shēngjí wǎngluò xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: The schools in the county are upgrading their network systems.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，警察很快赶到现场。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，警察很快趕到現場。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, jǐngchá hěn kuài gǎn dào xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: After the accident happened, the police quickly arrived at the scene.

sentences.chinese: 记者在现场采访了几位市民。
sentences.traditional: 記者在現場採訪了幾位市民。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě zài xiànchǎng cǎifǎng le jǐ wèi shìmín.
sentences.translation: The reporter interviewed several citizens at the scene.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要到现场确认设备的损失情况。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要到現場確認設備的損失情況。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào dào xiànchǎng quèrèn shèbèi de sǔnshī qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: We need to go to the site to confirm the damage to the equipment.

sentences.chinese: 现代社会对网络的依赖越来越深。
sentences.traditional: 現代社會對網絡的依賴越來越深。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì duì wǎngluò de yīlài yuèláiyuè shēn.
sentences.translation: Modern society depends more and more deeply on networks.

sentences.chinese: 这座博物馆把传统艺术和现代设计结合起来。
sentences.traditional: 這座博物館把傳統藝術和現代設計結合起來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò bówùguǎn bǎ chuántǒng yìshù hé xiàndài shèjì jiéhé qǐlái.
sentences.translation: This museum combines traditional art with modern design.

sentences.chinese: 现代医学的发展提高了人们的生活质量。
sentences.traditional: 現代醫學的發展提高了人們的生活質量。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài yīxué de fāzhǎn tígāo le rénmen de shēnghuó zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The development of modern medicine has improved people's quality of life.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂正在进行现代化改造。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠正在進行現代化改造。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhèngzài jìnxíng xiàndàihuà gǎizào.
sentences.translation: This factory is undergoing modernisation.

sentences.chinese: 农村实现现代化不能只靠修路。
sentences.traditional: 農村實現現代化不能只靠修路。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngcūn shíxiàn xiàndàihuà bùnéng zhǐ kào xiū lù.
sentences.translation: Modernising rural areas cannot rely only on building roads.

sentences.chinese: 管理系统现代化以后，工作效率明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 管理系統現代化以後，工作效率明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐ xìtǒng xiàndàihuà yǐhòu, gōngzuò xiàolǜ míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: After the management system was modernised, work efficiency clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 这条线路连接市中心和新机场，乘客换车更方便。
sentences.traditional: 這條線路連接市中心和新機場，乘客換車更方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiànlù liánjiē shì zhōngxīn hé xīn jīchǎng, chéngkè huànchē gèng fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This route connects the city centre with the new airport, making transfers more convenient for passengers.

sentences.chinese: 由于施工，公交线路临时改到了另一条街上。
sentences.traditional: 由於施工，公交線路臨時改到了另一條街上。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shīgōng, gōngjiāo xiànlù línshí gǎi dào le lìng yì tiáo jiē shang.
sentences.translation: Because of roadworks, the bus route was temporarily moved to another street.

sentences.chinese: 我们先确认旅游线路，再预订酒店。
sentences.traditional: 我們先確認旅遊線路，再預訂飯店。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān quèrèn lǚyóu xiànlù, zài yùdìng jiǔdiàn.
sentences.translation: We will confirm the travel route first, then book the hotel.

sentences.chinese: 面对现实，他终于决定调整原来的计划。
sentences.traditional: 面對現實，他終於決定調整原來的計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì xiànshí, tā zhōngyú juédìng tiáozhěng yuánlái de jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Facing reality, he finally decided to adjust his original plan.

sentences.chinese: 虽然理想很重要，但我们也要考虑现实条件。
sentences.traditional: 雖然理想很重要，但我們也要考慮現實條件。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán lǐxiǎng hěn zhòngyào, dàn wǒmen yě yào kǎolǜ xiànshí tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: Although ideals are important, we also need to consider real conditions.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影反映了年轻人找工作的现实压力。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影反映了年輕人找工作的現實壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng fǎnyìng le niánqīngrén zhǎo gōngzuò de xiànshí yālì.
sentences.translation: This film reflects the real pressure young people face when looking for work.

sentences.chinese: 这种现象在大城市越来越常见。
sentences.traditional: 這種現象在大城市越來越常見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng zài dà chéngshì yuè lái yuè chángjiàn.
sentences.translation: This phenomenon is becoming more and more common in big cities.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求学生观察现象，并记录变化过程。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求學生觀察現象，並記錄變化過程。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshēng guānchá xiànxiàng, bìng jìlù biànhuà guòchéng.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the students to observe the phenomenon and record the process of change.

sentences.chinese: 网络购物兴起以后，快递数量增加成了一种社会现象。
sentences.traditional: 網絡購物興起以後，快遞數量增加成了一種社會現象。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò gòuwù xīngqǐ yǐhòu, kuàidì shùliàng zēngjiā chéng le yì zhǒng shèhuì xiànxiàng.
sentences.translation: After online shopping took off, the increase in parcel deliveries became a social phenomenon.

sentences.chinese: 学校限制学生在课堂上使用手机。
sentences.traditional: 學校限制學生在課堂上使用手機。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xiànzhì xuéshēng zài kètáng shang shǐyòng shǒujī.
sentences.translation: The school restricts students from using mobile phones in class.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护环境，政府开始限制一次性塑料袋的使用。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護環境，政府開始限制一次性塑膠袋的使用。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù huánjìng, zhèngfǔ kāishǐ xiànzhì yí cì xìng sùliào dài de shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: To protect the environment, the government has begun to limit the use of single-use plastic bags.

sentences.chinese: 预算有限会限制项目的发展速度。
sentences.traditional: 預算有限會限制專案的發展速度。
sentences.pinyin: Yùsuàn yǒuxiàn huì xiànzhì xiàngmù de fāzhǎn sùdù.
sentences.translation: A limited budget will restrict the speed at which the project develops.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要先了解公司的现状，再讨论改革方案。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要先了解公司的現狀，再討論改革方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào xiān liǎojiě gōngsī de xiànzhuàng, zài tǎolùn gǎigé fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: We need to understand the company’s current situation first, then discuss reform plans.

sentences.chinese: 报告详细分析了农村教育的现状。
sentences.traditional: 報告詳細分析了農村教育的現狀。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào xiángxì fēnxī le nóngcūn jiàoyù de xiànzhuàng.
sentences.translation: The report analyses the current state of rural education in detail.

sentences.chinese: 如果不改变现状，问题可能会更加严重。
sentences.traditional: 如果不改變現狀，問題可能會更加嚴重。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù gǎibiàn xiànzhuàng, wèntí kěnéng huì gèngjiā yánzhòng.
sentences.translation: If the current situation does not change, the problem may become more serious.

sentences.chinese: 他退休后回到乡里，过上了安静的生活。
sentences.traditional: 他退休後回到鄉裡，過上了安靜的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu huí dào xiāng lǐ, guò shàng le ānjìng de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: After retiring, he returned to the countryside and began a quiet life.

sentences.chinese: 每到春节，很多人都会从城市回乡看望家人。
sentences.traditional: 每到春節，很多人都會從城市回鄉看望家人。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào Chūnjié, hěn duō rén dōu huì cóng chéngshì huí xiāng kànwàng jiārén.
sentences.translation: Every Spring Festival, many people return from the city to their home villages to visit family.

sentences.chinese: 这个乡近年来修了新路，交通方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 這個鄉近年來修了新路，交通方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāng jìnniánlái xiū le xīn lù, jiāotōng fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: This township has built new roads in recent years, making transport much more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 只要彼此尊重，同事之间就能相处得很好。
sentences.traditional: 只要彼此尊重，同事之間就能相處得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào bǐcǐ zūnzhòng, tóngshì zhījiān jiù néng xiāngchǔ de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: As long as they respect each other, colleagues can get along very well.

sentences.chinese: 他性格温和，很容易和别人相处。
sentences.traditional: 他性格溫和，很容易和別人相處。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xìnggé wēnhé, hěn róngyì hé biérén xiāngchǔ.
sentences.translation: He has a gentle personality and is easy to get along with.

sentences.chinese: 这两个部门需要学会相处，才能顺利完成项目。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個部門需要學會相處，才能順利完成專案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge bùmén xūyào xuéhuì xiāngchǔ, cái néng shùnlì wánchéng xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: These two departments need to learn to work together before they can complete the project smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 越来越多的年轻人愿意回到乡村创业。
sentences.traditional: 越來越多的年輕人願意回到鄉村創業。
sentences.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō de niánqīngrén yuànyì huí dào xiāngcūn chuàngyè.
sentences.translation: More and more young people are willing to return to the countryside to start businesses.

sentences.chinese: 乡村旅游带动了当地经济的发展。
sentences.traditional: 鄉村旅遊帶動了當地經濟的發展。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngcūn lǚyóu dàidòng le dāngdì jīngjì de fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Rural tourism has driven the development of the local economy.

sentences.chinese: 政府正在改善乡村的医疗和教育条件。
sentences.traditional: 政府正在改善鄉村的醫療和教育條件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài gǎishàn xiāngcūn de yīliáo hé jiàoyù tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: The government is improving medical and educational conditions in the countryside.

sentences.chinese: 这次考试相当难，很多学生都没做完。
sentences.traditional: 這次考試相當難，很多學生都沒做完。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì xiāngdāng nán, hěn duō xuéshēng dōu méi zuò wán.
sentences.translation: This exam was quite difficult, and many students did not finish it.

sentences.chinese: 他的经验与部门经理相当。
sentences.traditional: 他的經驗與部門經理相當。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jīngyàn yǔ bùmén jīnglǐ xiāngdāng.
sentences.translation: His experience is comparable to that of the department manager.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店虽然不大，但菜的味道相当不错。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店雖然不大，但菜的味道相當不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn suīrán bú dà, dàn cài de wèidao xiāngdāng búcuò.
sentences.translation: Although this small restaurant is not big, the food tastes quite good.

sentences.chinese: 和去年相比，今年的销售情况相对稳定。
sentences.traditional: 和去年相比，今年的銷售情況相對穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Hé qùnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián de xiāoshòu qíngkuàng xiāngduì wěndìng.
sentences.translation: Compared with last year, this year’s sales situation is relatively stable.

sentences.chinese: 这两扇门相对而开，进出都很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這兩扇門相對而開，進出都很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng shàn mén xiāngduì ér kāi, jìnchū dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: These two doors open opposite each other, so going in and out is very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 相对来说，这个方案成本低，风险也小。
sentences.traditional: 相對來說，這個方案成本低，風險也小。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngduì lái shuō, zhège fāng'àn chéngběn dī, fēngxiǎn yě xiǎo.
sentences.translation: Relatively speaking, this plan has low costs and low risks.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题和环境保护密切相关。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題和環境保護密切相關。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hé huánjìng bǎohù mìqiè xiāngguān.
sentences.translation: This issue is closely related to environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 所有相关部门都参加了今天的会议。
sentences.traditional: 所有相關部門都參加了今天的會議。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu xiāngguān bùmén dōu cānjiā le jīntiān de huìyì.
sentences.translation: All relevant departments attended today’s meeting.

sentences.chinese: 研究结果显示，睡眠质量与工作效率相关。
sentences.traditional: 研究結果顯示，睡眠質量與工作效率相關。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū jiéguǒ xiǎnshì, shuìmián zhìliàng yǔ gōngzuò xiàolǜ xiāngguān.
sentences.translation: The research results show that sleep quality is correlated with work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 这两种产品的功能很相似，但价格差很多。
sentences.traditional: 這兩種產品的功能很相似，但價格差很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng hěn xiāngsì, dàn jiàgé chà hěn duō.
sentences.translation: The functions of these two products are similar, but their prices differ a lot.

sentences.chinese: 她和姐姐的性格并不相似。
sentences.traditional: 她和姐姐的性格並不相似。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hé jiějie de xìnggé bìng bù xiāngsì.
sentences.translation: Her personality is not similar to her older sister’s.

sentences.chinese: 如果情况相似，我们可以参考以前的处理办法。
sentences.traditional: 如果情況相似，我們可以參考以前的處理辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qíngkuàng xiāngsì, wǒmen kěyǐ cānkǎo yǐqián de chǔlǐ bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: If the situation is similar, we can refer to the previous way of handling it.

sentences.chinese: 离开家乡多年后，他越来越想念那里的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 離開家鄉多年後，他越來越想念那裡的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Líkāi jiāxiāng duō nián hòu, tā yuè lái yuè xiǎngniàn nàli de péngyou.
sentences.translation: After leaving his hometown for many years, he missed his friends there more and more.

sentences.chinese: 每到春节，她都会想念在外地工作的儿子。
sentences.traditional: 每到春節，她都會想念在外地工作的兒子。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào Chūnjié, tā dōu huì xiǎngniàn zài wàidì gōngzuò de érzi.
sentences.translation: Every Spring Festival, she misses her son who works away from home.

sentences.chinese: 我很想念以前和同学一起学习的日子。
sentences.traditional: 我很想念以前和同學一起學習的日子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎngniàn yǐqián hé tóngxué yìqǐ xuéxí de rìzi.
sentences.translation: I really miss the days when I studied together with my classmates before.

sentences.chinese: 半夜传来奇怪的响声，把孩子吵醒了。
sentences.traditional: 半夜傳來奇怪的響聲，把孩子吵醒了。
sentences.pinyin: Bànyè chuánlái qíguài de xiǎngshēng, bǎ háizi chǎo xǐng le.
sentences.translation: A strange sound came in the middle of the night and woke the child up.

sentences.chinese: 机器发出的响声越来越大，需要尽快维修。
sentences.traditional: 機器發出的響聲越來越大，需要盡快維修。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì fāchū de xiǎngshēng yuè lái yuè dà, xūyào jǐnkuài wéixiū.
sentences.translation: The sound made by the machine is getting louder and louder, so it needs repairing as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 听到门外的响声，他立刻停下了手里的工作。
sentences.traditional: 聽到門外的響聲，他立刻停下了手裡的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào mén wài de xiǎngshēng, tā lìkè tíng xià le shǒu lǐ de gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: Hearing the sound outside the door, he immediately stopped the work in his hands.

sentences.chinese: 周末的时候，我只想安静地享受一杯茶和一本书。
sentences.traditional: 週末的時候，我只想安靜地享受一杯茶和一本書。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng ānjìng de xiǎngshòu yì bēi chá hé yì běn shū.
sentences.translation: At the weekend, I just want to quietly enjoy a cup of tea and a book.

sentences.chinese: 他退休以后，终于可以享受比较自由的生活。
sentences.traditional: 他退休以後，終於可以享受比較自由的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū yǐhòu, zhōngyú kěyǐ xiǎngshòu bǐjiào zìyóu de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: After retiring, he can finally enjoy a relatively free life.

sentences.chinese: 旅游不只是拍照，更应该享受当地的文化。
sentences.traditional: 旅遊不只是拍照，更應該享受當地的文化。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚyóu bù zhǐshì pāizhào, gèng yīnggāi xiǎngshòu dāngdì de wénhuà.
sentences.translation: Travel is not just about taking photos; one should also enjoy the local culture.

sentences.chinese: 很难想象没有网络的生活会变成什么样。
sentences.traditional: 很難想象沒有網絡的生活會變成什麼樣。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn nán xiǎngxiàng méiyǒu wǎngluò de shēnghuó huì biàn chéng shénme yàng.
sentences.translation: It is hard to imagine what life without the internet would become.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们常常想象自己住在神话里的城堡中。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們常常想像自己住在神話裡的城堡中。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen chángcháng xiǎngxiàng zìjǐ zhù zài shénhuà lǐ de chéngbǎo zhōng.
sentences.translation: Children often imagine themselves living in castles from myths.

sentences.chinese: 你能想象这个小村庄十年后会变成现代化城市吗？
sentences.traditional: 你能想像這個小村莊十年後會變成現代化城市嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng xiǎngxiàng zhège xiǎo cūnzhuāng shí nián hòu huì biàn chéng xiàndàihuà chéngshì ma?
sentences.translation: Can you imagine this small village becoming a modernised city ten years later?

sentences.chinese: 我把旅行照片整理进一个新的相册。
sentences.traditional: 我把旅行照片整理進一個新的相冊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ lǚxíng zhàopiàn zhěnglǐ jìn yí ge xīn de xiàngcè.
sentences.translation: I organised the travel photos into a new photo album.

sentences.chinese: 翻开旧相册时，她想起了很多童年的事情。
sentences.traditional: 翻開舊相冊時，她想起了很多童年的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Fānkāi jiù xiàngcè shí, tā xiǎngqǐ le hěn duō tóngnián de shìqing.
sentences.translation: When she opened the old photo album, she remembered many things from her childhood.

sentences.chinese: 手机相册里存了太多照片，已经影响系统速度。
sentences.traditional: 手機相冊裡存了太多照片，已經影響系統速度。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī xiàngcè lǐ cún le tài duō zhàopiàn, yǐjīng yǐngxiǎng xìtǒng sùdù.
sentences.translation: There are too many photos stored in the phone album, and they are already affecting the system speed.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目已经进入最后阶段，团队压力很大。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目已經進入最後階段，團隊壓力很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yǐjīng jìnrù zuìhòu jiēduàn, tuánduì yālì hěn dà.
sentences.translation: This project has already entered the final stage, and the team is under great pressure.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定把重点项目交给更有经验的经理负责。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定把重點項目交給更有經驗的經理負責。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiàngmù jiāo gěi gèng yǒu jīngyàn de jīnglǐ fùzé.
sentences.translation: The company decided to give the key project to a more experienced manager to take responsibility for.

sentences.chinese: 如果资金不足，几个项目可能会被推迟。
sentences.traditional: 如果資金不足，幾個項目可能會被推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zījīn bùzú, jǐ ge xiàngmù kěnéng huì bèi tuīchí.
sentences.translation: If funding is insufficient, several projects may be delayed.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把橡皮放在书包里，却以为丢了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把橡皮放在書包裡，卻以為丟了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ xiàngpí fàng zài shūbāo lǐ, què yǐwéi diū le.
sentences.translation: The child put the eraser in the schoolbag, but thought it had been lost.

sentences.chinese: 这块橡皮太硬，擦不干净铅笔字。
sentences.traditional: 這塊橡皮太硬，擦不乾淨鉛筆字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài xiàngpí tài yìng, cā bù gānjìng qiānbǐ zì.
sentences.translation: This eraser is too hard and cannot erase pencil marks cleanly.

sentences.chinese: 考试前请准备铅笔、橡皮和身份证。
sentences.traditional: 考試前請準備鉛筆、橡皮和身分證。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì qián qǐng zhǔnbèi qiānbǐ, xiàngpí hé shēnfènzhèng.
sentences.translation: Before the exam, please prepare a pencil, an eraser and an ID card.

sentences.chinese: 电梯坏了，我们只能沿着楼梯向上走。
sentences.traditional: 電梯壞了，我們只能沿著樓梯向上走。
sentences.pinyin: Diàntī huài le, wǒmen zhǐ néng yánzhe lóutī xiàngshàng zǒu.
sentences.translation: The lift is broken, so we can only walk up along the stairs.

sentences.chinese: 价格连续三个月向上调整，消费者压力增加。
sentences.traditional: 價格連續三個月向上調整，消費者壓力增加。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé liánxù sān ge yuè xiàngshàng tiáozhěng, xiāofèizhě yālì zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: Prices have been adjusted upward for three months in a row, increasing pressure on consumers.

sentences.chinese: 这个箭头表示数据正在向上变化。
sentences.traditional: 這個箭頭表示數據正在向上變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiàntóu biǎoshì shùjù zhèngzài xiàngshàng biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This arrow indicates that the data is changing upward.

sentences.chinese: 这座雕塑象征自由和勇气。
sentences.traditional: 這座雕塑象徵自由和勇氣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò diāosù xiàngzhēng zìyóu hé yǒngqì.
sentences.translation: This sculpture symbolises freedom and courage.

sentences.chinese: 白色在很多文化中象征纯洁。
sentences.traditional: 白色在很多文化中象徵純潔。
sentences.pinyin: Báisè zài hěn duō wénhuà zhōng xiàngzhēng chúnjié.
sentences.translation: White symbolises purity in many cultures.

sentences.chinese: 这面旗子不仅是标志，也是国家团结的象征。
sentences.traditional: 這面旗子不僅是標誌，也是國家團結的象徵。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè miàn qízi bùjǐn shì biāozhì, yě shì guójiā tuánjié de xiàngzhēng.
sentences.translation: This flag is not only a sign but also a symbol of national unity.

sentences.chinese: 随着收入提高，居民消费能力明显增强。
sentences.traditional: 隨著收入提高，居民消費能力明顯增強。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe shōurù tígāo, jūmín xiāofèi nénglì míngxiǎn zēngqiáng.
sentences.translation: As income rises, residents’ ability to consume has clearly strengthened.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人越来越重视理性消费。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人越來越重視理性消費。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yuè lái yuè zhòngshì lǐxìng xiāofèi.
sentences.translation: Young people increasingly value rational consumption.

sentences.chinese: 节日期间，商场的消费金额比平时高很多。
sentences.traditional: 節日期間，商場的消費金額比平時高很多。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì qījiān, shāngchǎng de xiāofèi jīn'é bǐ píngshí gāo hěn duō.
sentences.translation: During the festival period, the shopping centre’s consumption amount is much higher than usual.

sentences.chinese: 企业应该认真听取消费者的意见。
sentences.traditional: 企業應該認真聽取消費者的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīnggāi rènzhēn tīngqǔ xiāofèizhě de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Companies should carefully listen to consumers’ opinions.

sentences.chinese: 这项新规定能更好地保护消费者权益。
sentences.traditional: 這項新規定能更好地保護消費者權益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn guīdìng néng gèng hǎo de bǎohù xiāofèizhě quányì.
sentences.translation: This new rule can better protect consumers’ rights and interests.

sentences.chinese: 如果服务不好，消费者很可能会选择别的品牌。
sentences.traditional: 如果服務不好，消費者很可能會選擇別的品牌。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fúwù bù hǎo, xiāofèizhě hěn kěnéng huì xuǎnzé bié de pǐnpái.
sentences.translation: If the service is poor, consumers are very likely to choose another brand.

sentences.chinese: 饭后散步有助于消化。
sentences.traditional: 飯後散步有助於消化。
sentences.pinyin: Fàn hòu sànbù yǒu zhù yú xiāohuà.
sentences.translation: Taking a walk after a meal helps digestion.

sentences.chinese: 老师讲得太快，学生一时难以消化这些内容。
sentences.traditional: 老師講得太快，學生一時難以消化這些內容。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng de tài kuài, xuéshēng yìshí nányǐ xiāohuà zhèxiē nèiróng.
sentences.translation: The teacher spoke too quickly, so the students found it hard to digest the material at once.

sentences.chinese: 公司需要时间消化这次合并带来的变化。
sentences.traditional: 公司需要時間消化這次合併帶來的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào shíjiān xiāohuà zhè cì hébìng dài lái de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The company needs time to absorb the changes brought by this merger.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难时，消极态度只会让问题更严重。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難時，消極態度只會讓問題更嚴重。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan shí, xiāojí tàidu zhǐ huì ràng wèntí gèng yánzhòng.
sentences.translation: When facing difficulties, a negative attitude will only make the problem more serious.

sentences.chinese: 他的回答显得有些消极，缺少解决问题的信心。
sentences.traditional: 他的回答顯得有些消極，缺少解決問題的信心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huídá xiǎnde yǒuxiē xiāojí, quēshǎo jiějué wèntí de xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: His answer seemed somewhat negative and lacked confidence in solving the problem.

sentences.chinese: 长期的消极情绪会影响身体健康。
sentences.traditional: 長期的消極情緒會影響身體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī de xiāojí qíngxù huì yǐngxiǎng shēntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Long-term negative emotions can affect physical health.

sentences.chinese: 这款手机的销量连续三个月排名第一。
sentences.traditional: 這款手機的銷量連續三個月排名第一。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī de xiāoliàng liánxù sān ge yuè páimíng dì yī.
sentences.translation: This phone’s sales volume has ranked first for three consecutive months.

sentences.chinese: 广告效果不错，产品销量明显提高了。
sentences.traditional: 廣告效果不錯，產品銷量明顯提高了。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnggào xiàoguǒ búcuò, chǎnpǐn xiāoliàng míngxiǎn tígāo le.
sentences.translation: The advertising effect was good, and product sales clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 如果售价过高，销量可能会下降。
sentences.traditional: 如果售價過高，銷量可能會下降。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shòujià guò gāo, xiāoliàng kěnéng huì xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: If the selling price is too high, sales volume may fall.

sentences.chinese: 太阳升起后，山谷里的雾慢慢消失了。
sentences.traditional: 太陽升起後，山谷裡的霧慢慢消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng shēngqǐ hòu, shāngǔ lǐ de wù mànmàn xiāoshī le.
sentences.translation: After the sun rose, the fog in the valley slowly disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 这种传统手工艺正在逐渐消失。
sentences.traditional: 這種傳統手工藝正在逐漸消失。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chuántǒng shǒugōngyì zhèngzài zhújiàn xiāoshī.
sentences.translation: This traditional craft is gradually disappearing.

sentences.chinese: 钥匙突然消失了，大家找了半天也没找到。
sentences.traditional: 鑰匙突然消失了，大家找了半天也沒找到。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi tūrán xiāoshī le, dàjiā zhǎo le bàn tiān yě méi zhǎodào.
sentences.translation: The key suddenly disappeared, and everyone searched for ages but could not find it.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划通过网络销售更多产品。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃通過網絡銷售更多產品。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà tōngguò wǎnglù xiāoshòu gèng duō chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: The company plans to sell more products through the internet.

sentences.chinese: 这家店主要销售本地特产。
sentences.traditional: 這家店主要銷售本地特產。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhǔyào xiāoshòu běndì tèchǎn.
sentences.translation: This shop mainly sells local specialities.

sentences.chinese: 他负责销售部门的日常管理。
sentences.traditional: 他負責銷售部門的日常管理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fùzé xiāoshòu bùmén de rìcháng guǎnlǐ.
sentences.translation: He is responsible for the daily management of the sales department.

sentences.chinese: 那位小姐正在前台办理手续。
sentences.traditional: 那位小姐正在前臺辦理手續。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi xiǎojiě zhèngzài qiántái bànlǐ shǒuxù.
sentences.translation: That young lady is handling the formalities at reception.

sentences.chinese: 服务员对客人说：小姐，请您稍等一下。
sentences.traditional: 服務員對客人說：小姐，請您稍等一下。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán duì kèrén shuō: Xiǎojiě, qǐng nín shāo děng yíxià.
sentences.translation: The waiter said to the customer: Miss, please wait a moment.

sentences.chinese: 李小姐提交的报告写得非常清楚。
sentences.traditional: 李小姐提交的報告寫得非常清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě tíjiāo de bàogào xiě de fēicháng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Miss Li’s submitted report was written very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 公司购买了一台小型打印机，放在办公室角落。
sentences.traditional: 公司購買了一臺小型打印機，放在辦公室角落。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gòumǎi le yì tái xiǎoxíng dǎyìnjī, fàng zài bàngōngshì jiǎoluò.
sentences.translation: The company bought a compact printer and put it in the corner of the office.

sentences.chinese: 这种小型会议适合深入讨论具体问题。
sentences.traditional: 這種小型會議適合深入討論具體問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiǎoxíng huìyì shìhé shēnrù tǎolùn jùtǐ wèntí.
sentences.translation: This kind of small-scale meeting is suitable for in-depth discussion of specific issues.

sentences.chinese: 他们正在开发一款小型电动车。
sentences.traditional: 他們正在開發一款小型電動車。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài kāifā yì kuǎn xiǎoxíng diàndòngchē.
sentences.translation: They are developing a compact electric vehicle.

sentences.chinese: 这次调查的误差小于百分之二。
sentences.traditional: 這次調查的誤差小於百分之二。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì diàochá de wùchā xiǎoyú bǎifēn zhī èr.
sentences.translation: The error in this survey is less than two percent.

sentences.chinese: 申请人的年龄必须小于六十岁。
sentences.traditional: 申請人的年齡必須小於六十歲。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng rén de niánlíng bìxū xiǎoyú liùshí suì.
sentences.translation: Applicants must be under sixty years old.

sentences.chinese: 如果费用小于预算，我们就可以增加培训项目。
sentences.traditional: 如果費用小於預算，我們就可以增加培訓項目。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fèiyòng xiǎoyú yùsuàn, wǒmen jiù kěyǐ zēngjiā péixùn xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: If the cost is less than the budget, we can add a training project.

sentences.chinese: 引入新系统后，团队的工作效率提高了不少。
sentences.traditional: 引入新系統後，團隊的工作效率提高了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐnrù xīn xìtǒng hòu, tuánduì de gōngzuò xiàolǜ tígāo le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: After introducing the new system, the team’s work efficiency improved quite a lot.

sentences.chinese: 会议时间太长，会影响办事效率。
sentences.traditional: 會議時間太長，會影響辦事效率。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shíjiān tài cháng, huì yǐngxiǎng bànshì xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Meetings that are too long can affect working efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 他习惯先安排重点任务，以保证效率。
sentences.traditional: 他習慣先安排重點任務，以保證效率。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xíguàn xiān ānpái zhòngdiǎn rènwù, yǐ bǎozhèng xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: He is used to arranging key tasks first in order to ensure efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子有点斜，杯子容易滑下来。
sentences.traditional: 這張桌子有點斜，杯子容易滑下來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi yǒudiǎn xié, bēizi róngyì huá xiàlai.
sentences.translation: This table is a bit slanted, so cups easily slide down.

sentences.chinese: 请把照片稍微斜一点，效果会更自然。
sentences.traditional: 請把照片稍微斜一點，效果會更自然。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhàopiàn shāowēi xié yìdiǎn, xiàoguǒ huì gèng zìrán.
sentences.translation: Please tilt the photo slightly; the effect will be more natural.

sentences.chinese: 山路又窄又斜，开车时要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 山路又窄又斜，開車時要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Shānlù yòu zhǎi yòu xié, kāichē shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: The mountain road is narrow and slanted, so you must be especially careful when driving.

sentences.chinese: 双方经过三轮谈判，终于签了协议。
sentences.traditional: 雙方經過三輪談判，終於簽了協議。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng jīngguò sān lún tánpàn, zhōngyú qiān le xiéyì.
sentences.translation: After three rounds of negotiations, both sides finally signed an agreement.

sentences.chinese: 这份协议明确规定了双方的责任。
sentences.traditional: 這份協議明確規定了雙方的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn xiéyì míngquè guīdìng le shuāngfāng de zérèn.
sentences.translation: This agreement clearly defines the responsibilities of both sides.

sentences.chinese: 他们同意按协议执行下一阶段的工作。
sentences.traditional: 他們同意按協議執行下一階段的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen tóngyì àn xiéyì zhíxíng xià yí jiēduàn de gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: They agreed to carry out the next stage of work according to the agreement.

sentences.chinese: 坚持阅读能提高学生的写作能力。
sentences.traditional: 堅持閱讀能提高學生的寫作能力。
sentences.pinyin: Jiānchí yuèdú néng tígāo xuéshēng de xiězuò nénglì.
sentences.translation: Keeping up reading can improve students’ writing ability.

sentences.chinese: 她每天花半小时练习中文写作。
sentences.traditional: 她每天花半小時練習中文寫作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi tiān huā bàn xiǎoshí liànxí Zhōngwén xiězuò.
sentences.translation: She spends half an hour practising Chinese writing every day.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章的写作风格很清楚，也很有逻辑。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章的寫作風格很清楚，也很有邏輯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de xiězuò fēnggé hěn qīngchu, yě hěn yǒu luóji.
sentences.translation: The writing style of this article is clear and also very logical.

sentences.chinese: 婚礼开始前，新郎一直在门口迎接客人。
sentences.traditional: 婚禮開始前，新郎一直在門口迎接客人。
sentences.pinyin: Hūnlǐ kāishǐ qián, xīnláng yìzhí zài ménkǒu yíngjiē kèrén.
sentences.translation: Before the wedding began, the bridegroom kept welcoming guests at the door.

sentences.chinese: 新郎紧张得差点忘了准备好的发言。
sentences.traditional: 新郎緊張得差點忘了準備好的發言。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnláng jǐnzhāng de chàdiǎn wàng le zhǔnbèi hǎo de fāyán.
sentences.translation: The bridegroom was so nervous that he almost forgot his prepared speech.

sentences.chinese: 大家举杯祝新郎和新娘未来幸福。
sentences.traditional: 大家舉杯祝新郎和新娘未來幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā jǔbēi zhù xīnláng hé xīnniáng wèilái xìngfú.
sentences.translation: Everyone raised their glasses and wished the bridegroom and bride future happiness.

sentences.chinese: 考试前保持良好的心理状态很重要。
sentences.traditional: 考試前保持良好的心理狀態很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoshì qián bǎochí liánghǎo de xīnlǐ zhuàngtài hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: It is important to maintain a good mental state before an exam.

sentences.chinese: 这件事对孩子的心理影响很深。
sentences.traditional: 這件事對孩子的心理影響很深。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì duì háizi de xīnlǐ yǐngxiǎng hěn shēn.
sentences.translation: This matter had a deep psychological effect on the child.

sentences.chinese: 管理者应该理解员工的心理需求。
sentences.traditional: 管理者應該理解員工的心理需求。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐ zhě yīnggāi lǐjiě yuángōng de xīnlǐ xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Managers should understand employees’ psychological needs.

sentences.chinese: 新娘穿着白色礼服，显得非常优雅。
sentences.traditional: 新娘穿著白色禮服，顯得非常優雅。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnniáng chuānzhe báisè lǐfú, xiǎnde fēicháng yōuyǎ.
sentences.translation: The bride was wearing a white dress and looked very elegant.

sentences.chinese: 摄影师正在为新娘拍照。
sentences.traditional: 攝影師正在為新娘拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Shèyǐngshī zhèngzài wèi xīnniáng pāizhào.
sentences.translation: The photographer is taking photos for the bride.

sentences.chinese: 新郎看见新娘走进大厅时，忍不住微笑了。
sentences.traditional: 新郎看見新娘走進大廳時，忍不住微笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnláng kànjiàn xīnniáng zǒu jìn dàtīng shí, rěn bù zhù wēixiào le.
sentences.translation: When the bridegroom saw the bride enter the hall, he could not help smiling.

sentences.chinese: 部门来了几位新人，需要安排培训。
sentences.traditional: 部門來了幾位新人，需要安排培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Bùmén lái le jǐ wèi xīnrén, xūyào ānpái péixùn.
sentences.translation: Several newcomers have joined the department, and training needs to be arranged.

sentences.chinese: 作为新人，他对公司的流程还不熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 作為新人，他對公司的流程還不熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi xīnrén, tā duì gōngsī de liúchéng hái bù shúxī.
sentences.translation: As a newcomer, he is not yet familiar with the company’s procedures.

sentences.chinese: 这对新人计划明年搬到新的城市生活。
sentences.traditional: 這對新人計劃明年搬到新的城市生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duì xīnrén jìhuà míngnián bān dào xīn de chéngshì shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This newly married couple plans to move to a new city next year.

sentences.chinese: 我很欣赏他面对困难时的冷静。
sentences.traditional: 我很欣賞他面對困難時的冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xīnshǎng tā miànduì kùnnan shí de lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: I really appreciate his calmness when facing difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 晚饭后，我们在河边欣赏夜景。
sentences.traditional: 晚飯後，我們在河邊欣賞夜景。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnfàn hòu, wǒmen zài hébiān xīnshǎng yèjǐng.
sentences.translation: After dinner, we enjoyed the night view by the river.

sentences.chinese: 老师鼓励学生学会欣赏不同的观点。
sentences.traditional: 老師鼓勵學生學會欣賞不同的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì xuéshēng xuéhuì xīnshǎng bùtóng de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: The teacher encouraged the students to learn to appreciate different viewpoints.

sentences.chinese: 面对失败时，保持积极的心态比抱怨更重要。
sentences.traditional: 面對失敗時，保持積極的心態比抱怨更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shībài shí, bǎochí jījí de xīntài bǐ bàoyuàn gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When facing failure, maintaining a positive mindset is more important than complaining.

sentences.chinese: 他的心态很稳定，所以在压力下也能作出合理决定。
sentences.traditional: 他的心態很穩定，所以在壓力下也能作出合理決定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xīntài hěn wěndìng, suǒyǐ zài yālì xià yě néng zuòchū hélǐ juédìng.
sentences.translation: His mindset is very stable, so he can make reasonable decisions even under pressure.

sentences.chinese: 换一个心态来看，这次变化也许是新的机会。
sentences.traditional: 換一個心態來看，這次變化也許是新的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Huàn yí ge xīntài lái kàn, zhè cì biànhuà yěxǔ shì xīn de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Seen with a different mindset, this change may be a new opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 这种新型材料既轻又结实，适合用于建筑。
sentences.traditional: 這種新型材料既輕又結實，適合用於建築。
