sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng cáiliào jì qīng yòu jiēshi, shìhé yòngyú jiànzhù.
sentences.translation: This new type of material is both light and strong, and is suitable for use in construction.

sentences.chinese: 医院引进了几台新型设备，用来提高检查效率。
sentences.traditional: 醫院引進了幾臺新型設備，用來提高檢查效率。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn yǐnjìn le jǐ tái xīnxíng shèbèi, yòng lái tígāo jiǎnchá xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The hospital introduced several new types of equipment to improve examination efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 新型交通工具正在改变城市居民的出行方式。
sentences.traditional: 新型交通工具正在改變城市居民的出行方式。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnxíng jiāotōng gōngjù zhèngzài gǎibiàn chéngshì jūmín de chūxíng fāngshì.
sentences.translation: New types of transport are changing the way city residents travel.

sentences.chinese: 请把申请表放进信封，再交给前台。
sentences.traditional: 請把申請表放進信封，再交給前臺。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shēnqǐngbiǎo fàng jìn xìnfēng, zài jiāo gěi qiántái.
sentences.translation: Please put the application form into an envelope, then hand it to reception.

sentences.chinese: 这个信封上没有写寄件人的姓名。
sentences.traditional: 這個信封上沒有寫寄件人的姓名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xìnfēng shang méiyǒu xiě jìjiànrén de xìngmíng.
sentences.translation: This envelope does not have the sender’s name written on it.

sentences.chinese: 她在信封里放了一张照片和一封短信。
sentences.traditional: 她在信封裡放了一張照片和一封短信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xìnfēng lǐ fàng le yì zhāng zhàopiàn hé yì fēng duǎnxìn.
sentences.translation: She put a photo and a short letter inside the envelope.

sentences.chinese: 长期合作建立在彼此信任的基础上。
sentences.traditional: 長期合作建立在彼此信任的基礎上。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī hézuò jiànlì zài bǐcǐ xìnrèn de jīchǔ shang.
sentences.translation: Long-term cooperation is built on mutual trust.

sentences.chinese: 经理很信任这位员工，把重要任务交给了他。
sentences.traditional: 經理很信任這位員工，把重要任務交給了他。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ hěn xìnrèn zhè wèi yuángōng, bǎ zhòngyào rènwù jiāo gěi le tā.
sentences.translation: The manager trusts this employee and gave him an important task.

sentences.chinese: 如果失去了信任，再解释也很难恢复关系。
sentences.traditional: 如果失去了信任，再解釋也很難恢復關係。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shīqù le xìnrèn, zài jiěshì yě hěn nán huīfù guānxì.
sentences.translation: If trust is lost, it is hard to restore the relationship even with further explanation.

sentences.chinese: 一个人的信用需要长期积累，不能随便损害。
sentences.traditional: 一個人的信用需要長期積累，不能隨便損害。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge rén de xìnyòng xūyào chángqī jīlěi, bù néng suíbiàn sǔnhài.
sentences.translation: A person’s credit needs to be built up over a long time and must not be damaged casually.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司信用良好，银行愿意提供贷款。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司信用良好，銀行願意提供貸款。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī xìnyòng liánghǎo, yínháng yuànyì tígōng dàikuǎn.
sentences.translation: This company has good credit, so the bank is willing to provide a loan.

sentences.chinese: 按时还款有助于保持良好的信用记录。
sentences.traditional: 按時還款有助於保持良好的信用記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Ànshí huánkuǎn yǒu zhù yú bǎochí liánghǎo de xìnyòng jìlù.
sentences.translation: Repaying on time helps maintain a good credit record.

sentences.chinese: 这次出差的行程安排得很紧，几乎没有休息时间。
sentences.traditional: 這次出差的行程安排得很緊，幾乎沒有休息時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì chūchāi de xíngchéng ānpái de hěn jǐn, jīhū méiyǒu xiūxi shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The itinerary for this business trip is very tight, with almost no time to rest.

sentences.chinese: 请提前确认行程，以免错过会议。
sentences.traditional: 請提前確認行程，以免錯過會議。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng tíqián quèrèn xíngchéng, yǐmiǎn cuòguò huìyì.
sentences.translation: Please confirm the itinerary in advance to avoid missing the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 导游根据天气调整了第二天的行程。
sentences.traditional: 導遊根據天氣調整了第二天的行程。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyóu gēnjù tiānqì tiáozhěng le dì èr tiān de xíngchéng.
sentences.translation: The tour guide adjusted the next day’s itinerary according to the weather.

sentences.chinese: 良好的习惯不是一天形成的，需要长期坚持。
sentences.traditional: 良好的習慣不是一天形成的，需要長期堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de xíguàn bú shì yì tiān xíngchéng de, xūyào chángqī jiānchí.
sentences.translation: Good habits are not formed in one day; they require long-term persistence.

sentences.chinese: 经过讨论，大家逐渐形成了统一的意见。
sentences.traditional: 經過討論，大家逐漸形成了統一的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò tǎolùn, dàjiā zhújiàn xíngchéng le tǒngyī de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: After discussion, everyone gradually formed a unified opinion.

sentences.chinese: 如果信息不完整，很容易形成错误的判断。
sentences.traditional: 如果信息不完整，很容易形成錯誤的判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xìnxī bù wánzhěng, hěn róngyì xíngchéng cuòwù de pànduàn.
sentences.translation: If the information is incomplete, it is easy to form a wrong judgement.

sentences.chinese: 发现问题以后，政府立刻采取了行动。
sentences.traditional: 發現問題以後，政府立刻採取了行動。
sentences.pinyin: Fāxiàn wèntí yǐhòu, zhèngfǔ lìkè cǎiqǔ le xíngdòng.
sentences.translation: After discovering the problem, the government immediately took action.

sentences.chinese: 光有计划不够，还必须马上行动起来。
sentences.traditional: 光有計劃不夠，還必須馬上行動起來。
sentences.pinyin: Guāng yǒu jìhuà bú gòu, hái bìxū mǎshàng xíngdòng qǐlái.
sentences.translation: Having a plan alone is not enough; one must also take action immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他的行动证明了他对这个项目的重视。
sentences.traditional: 他的行動證明了他對這個項目的重視。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xíngdòng zhèngmíng le tā duì zhège xiàngmù de zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: His actions proved how much he valued this project.

sentences.chinese: 这个路口行人很多，司机必须减速。
sentences.traditional: 這個路口行人很多，司機必須減速。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège lùkǒu xíngrén hěn duō, sījī bìxū jiǎnsù.
sentences.translation: There are many pedestrians at this junction, so drivers must slow down.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证行人安全，学校门口设置了红绿灯。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證行人安全，學校門口設置了紅綠燈。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng xíngrén ānquán, xuéxiào ménkǒu shèzhì le hónglǜdēng.
sentences.translation: To ensure pedestrian safety, traffic lights were installed outside the school gate.

sentences.chinese: 下雨天视线不好，行人过马路要更加小心。
sentences.traditional: 下雨天視線不好，行人過馬路要更加小心。
sentences.pinyin: Xià yǔ tiān shìxiàn bù hǎo, xíngrén guò mǎlù yào gèngjiā xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: On rainy days visibility is poor, so pedestrians should be even more careful when crossing the road.

sentences.chinese: 这座山的美很难用语言形容。
sentences.traditional: 這座山的美很難用語言形容。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān de měi hěn nán yòng yǔyán xíngróng.
sentences.translation: The beauty of this mountain is hard to describe in words.

sentences.chinese: 他用“复杂”来形容目前的情况。
sentences.traditional: 他用「複雜」來形容目前的情況。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng “fùzá” lái xíngróng mùqián de qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: He used “complicated” to describe the current situation.

sentences.chinese: 她的表情十分紧张，无法形容当时的压力。
sentences.traditional: 她的表情十分緊張，無法形容當時的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de biǎoqíng shífēn jǐnzhāng, wúfǎ xíngróng dāngshí de yālì.
sentences.translation: Her expression was extremely tense; it was impossible to describe the pressure at that moment.

sentences.chinese: 这种合作形式既灵活又高效，适合小型企业。
sentences.traditional: 這種合作形式既靈活又高效，適合小型企業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng hézuò xíngshì jì línghuó yòu gāoxiào, shìhé xiǎoxíng qǐyè.
sentences.translation: This form of cooperation is both flexible and efficient, and is suitable for small enterprises.

sentences.chinese: 报告的形式可以调整，但内容必须完整。
sentences.traditional: 報告的形式可以調整，但內容必須完整。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào de xíngshì kěyǐ tiáozhěng, dàn nèiróng bìxū wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: The form of the report can be adjusted, but the content must be complete.

sentences.chinese: 线上会议已经成为一种常见的工作形式。
sentences.traditional: 線上會議已經成為一種常見的工作形式。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànshàng huìyì yǐjīng chéngwéi yì zhǒng chángjiàn de gōngzuò xíngshì.
sentences.translation: Online meetings have already become a common form of work.

sentences.chinese: 当前的经济形势比去年更加复杂。
sentences.traditional: 當前的經濟形勢比去年更加複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngqián de jīngjì xíngshì bǐ qùnián gèngjiā fùzá.
sentences.translation: The current economic situation is more complicated than last year.

sentences.chinese: 在形势不明朗的时候，企业应该更加谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 在形勢不明朗的時候，企業應該更加謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xíngshì bù mínglǎng de shíhou, qǐyè yīnggāi gèngjiā jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: When the situation is unclear, companies should be even more cautious.

sentences.chinese: 领导要求各部门随时关注市场形势的变化。
sentences.traditional: 領導要求各部門隨時關注市場形勢的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo yāoqiú gè bùmén suíshí guānzhù shìchǎng xíngshì de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The leader asked all departments to pay attention to changes in the market situation at any time.

sentences.chinese: 车辆在高速公路上行驶时，必须保持安全距离。
sentences.traditional: 車輛在高速公路上行駛時，必須保持安全距離。
sentences.pinyin: Chēliàng zài gāosù gōnglù shang xíngshǐ shí, bìxū bǎochí ānquán jùlí.
sentences.translation: When vehicles are travelling on the motorway, they must keep a safe distance.

sentences.chinese: 这条线路正在维修，公交车需要绕路行驶。
sentences.traditional: 這條線路正在維修，公交車需要繞路行駛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiànlù zhèngzài wéixiū, gōngchē xūyào ràolù xíngshǐ.
sentences.translation: This route is under repair, so the bus needs to take a detour.

sentences.chinese: 雨雾天气行驶时，司机最好打开车灯。
sentences.traditional: 雨霧天氣行駛時，司機最好打開車燈。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔwù tiānqì xíngshǐ shí, sījī zuìhǎo dǎkāi chēdēng.
sentences.translation: When driving in rain and fog, drivers had better turn on their lights.

sentences.chinese: 这种行为不仅违法，也会损害公司的形象。
sentences.traditional: 這種行為不僅違法，也會損害公司的形象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xíngwéi bùjǐn wéifǎ, yě huì sǔnhài gōngsī de xíngxiàng.
sentences.translation: This kind of behaviour is not only illegal, but also damages the company’s image.

sentences.chinese: 学校会对学生的不文明行为进行教育。
sentences.traditional: 學校會對學生的不文明行為進行教育。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào huì duì xuéshēng de bù wénmíng xíngwéi jìnxíng jiàoyù.
sentences.translation: The school will educate students about uncivilised behaviour.

sentences.chinese: 一个人的行为往往能体现他的价值观。
sentences.traditional: 一個人的行為往往能體現他的價值觀。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge rén de xíngwéi wǎngwǎng néng tǐxiàn tā de jiàzhíguān.
sentences.translation: A person’s behaviour can often reflect his values.

sentences.chinese: 这次广告成功提升了品牌形象。
sentences.traditional: 這次廣告成功提升了品牌形象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì guǎnggào chénggōng tíshēng le pǐnpái xíngxiàng.
sentences.translation: This advertisement successfully improved the brand image.

sentences.chinese: 他在公众面前一直保持着专业的形象。
sentences.traditional: 他在公眾面前一直保持著專業的形象。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài gōngzhòng miànqián yìzhí bǎochí zhe zhuānyè de xíngxiàng.
sentences.translation: He has always maintained a professional image in public.

sentences.chinese: 小说里的母亲形象写得非常真实。
sentences.traditional: 小說裡的母親形象寫得非常真實。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshuō lǐ de mǔqīn xíngxiàng xiě de fēicháng zhēnshí.
sentences.translation: The image of the mother in the novel is written very realistically.

sentences.chinese: 这种石头的形状很特别，像一只小动物。
sentences.traditional: 這種石頭的形狀很特別，像一隻小動物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shítou de xíngzhuàng hěn tèbié, xiàng yì zhī xiǎo dòngwù.
sentences.translation: The shape of this stone is very special; it looks like a small animal.

sentences.chinese: 设计师根据房间的形状调整了家具的位置。
sentences.traditional: 設計師根據房間的形狀調整了傢俱的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī gēnjù fángjiān de xíngzhuàng tiáozhěng le jiājù de wèizhi.
sentences.translation: The designer adjusted the position of the furniture according to the shape of the room.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们用橡皮泥做出各种形状。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們用橡皮泥做出各種形狀。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yòng xiàngpíní zuò chū gè zhǒng xíngzhuàng.
sentences.translation: The children used modelling clay to make all kinds of shapes.

sentences.chinese: 老人腿脚不便，行走速度比较慢。
sentences.traditional: 老人腿腳不便，行走速度比較慢。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén tuǐjiǎo bùbiàn, xíngzǒu sùdù bǐjiào màn.
sentences.translation: The elderly man has difficulty with his legs, so his walking speed is quite slow.

sentences.chinese: 在山区行走时，最好穿舒适的鞋。
sentences.traditional: 在山區行走時，最好穿舒適的鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shānqū xíngzǒu shí, zuìhǎo chuān shūshì de xié.
sentences.translation: When walking in the mountains, it is best to wear comfortable shoes.

sentences.chinese: 机器人能够按照预定线路自动行走。
sentences.traditional: 機器人能夠按照預定線路自動行走。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén nénggòu ànzhào yùdìng xiànlù zìdòng xíngzǒu.
sentences.translation: The robot can walk automatically along a planned route.

sentences.chinese: 他很幸运，在最后一刻买到了票。
sentences.traditional: 他很幸運，在最後一刻買到了票。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn xìngyùn, zài zuìhòu yí kè mǎi dào le piào.
sentences.translation: He was very lucky and managed to buy a ticket at the last moment.

sentences.chinese: 这次成功不只是幸运，更是长期努力的结果。
sentences.traditional: 這次成功不只是幸運，更是長期努力的結果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì chénggōng bú zhǐ shì xìngyùn, gèng shì chángqī nǔlì de jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: This success was not just luck, but even more the result of long-term effort.

sentences.chinese: 能够遇到这么负责的老师，我们都觉得很幸运。
sentences.traditional: 能夠遇到這麼負責的老師，我們都覺得很幸運。
sentences.pinyin: Nénggòu yùdào zhème fùzé de lǎoshī, wǒmen dōu juéde hěn xìngyùn.
sentences.translation: We all feel very lucky to have met such a responsible teacher.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题的性质比较严重，不能简单处理。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題的性質比較嚴重，不能簡單處理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de xìngzhì bǐjiào yánzhòng, bù néng jiǎndān chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: The nature of this problem is quite serious, so it cannot be handled simply.

sentences.chinese: 不同性质的工作需要不同的管理方式。
sentences.traditional: 不同性質的工作需要不同的管理方式。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng xìngzhì de gōngzuò xūyào bùtóng de guǎnlǐ fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Jobs of different natures require different management methods.

sentences.chinese: 这项活动带有公益性质，所以不收取费用。
sentences.traditional: 這項活動帶有公益性質，所以不收取費用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng huódòng dài yǒu gōngyì xìngzhì, suǒyǐ bù shōuqǔ fèiyòng.
sentences.translation: This activity is public-interest in nature, so no fee is charged.

sentences.chinese: 请根据老师的意见修改作文。
sentences.traditional: 請根據老師的意見修改作文。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gēnjù lǎoshī de yìjiàn xiūgǎi zuòwén.
sentences.translation: Please revise the essay according to the teacher’s comments.

sentences.chinese: 合同提交以前，双方还需要修改几个细节。
sentences.traditional: 合約提交以前，雙方還需要修改幾個細節。
sentences.pinyin: Héyuē tíjiāo yǐqián, shuāngfāng hái xūyào xiūgǎi jǐ ge xìjié.
sentences.translation: Before the contract is submitted, both sides still need to revise several details.

sentences.chinese: 如果发现数据有误，请及时修改系统记录。
sentences.traditional: 如果發現數據有誤，請及時修改系統記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāxiàn shùjù yǒu wù, qǐng jíshí xiūgǎi xìtǒng jìlù.
sentences.translation: If you discover an error in the data, please correct the system record promptly.

sentences.chinese: 市政府计划在河边修建一座新的图书馆。
sentences.traditional: 市政府計畫在河邊修建一座新的圖書館。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhèngfǔ jìhuà zài hébiān xiūjiàn yí zuò xīn de túshūguǎn.
sentences.translation: The city government plans to build a new library by the river.

sentences.chinese: 这条铁路修建以后，两个城市之间的交通方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 這條鐵路修建以後，兩個城市之間的交通方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù xiūjiàn yǐhòu, liǎng ge chéngshì zhījiān de jiāotōng fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: After this railway was built, transport between the two cities became much more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 修建桥梁不仅需要资金，也需要先进的技术。
sentences.traditional: 修建橋樑不僅需要資金，也需要先進的技術。
sentences.pinyin: Xiūjiàn qiáoliáng bùjǐn xūyào zījīn, yě xūyào xiānjìn de jìshù.
sentences.translation: Building bridges requires not only funding, but also advanced technology.

sentences.chinese: 周末我们喜欢去海边休闲，顺便散步。
sentences.traditional: 週末我們喜歡去海邊休閒，順便散步。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen xǐhuan qù hǎibiān xiūxián, shùnbiàn sànbù.
sentences.translation: At weekends we like to relax by the seaside and go for a walk while we are there.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市正在发展休闲旅游，吸引更多年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市正在發展休閒旅遊，吸引更多年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì zhèngzài fāzhǎn xiūxián lǚyóu, xīyǐn gèng duō niánqīngrén.
sentences.translation: This city is developing leisure tourism to attract more young people.

sentences.chinese: 忙了一周以后，他需要一点休闲时间。
sentences.traditional: 忙了一週以後，他需要一點休閒時間。
sentences.pinyin: Máng le yì zhōu yǐhòu, tā xūyào yì diǎn xiūxián shíjiān.
sentences.translation: After a busy week, he needs a bit of leisure time.

sentences.chinese: 这项工作需在月底以前完成。
sentences.traditional: 這項工作需在月底以前完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò xū zài yuèdǐ yǐqián wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This task needs to be completed before the end of the month.

sentences.chinese: 申请签证时，需提交有效护照和照片。
sentences.traditional: 申請簽證時，需提交有效護照和照片。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng shí, xū tíjiāo yǒuxiào hùzhào hé zhàopiàn.
sentences.translation: When applying for a visa, you need to submit a valid passport and a photograph.

sentences.chinese: 如需帮助，请联系服务台。
sentences.traditional: 如需幫助，請聯繫服務臺。
sentences.pinyin: Rú xū bāngzhù, qǐng liánxì fúwùtái.
sentences.translation: If you need help, please contact the service desk.

sentences.chinese: 老年人的医疗需求正在不断增加。
sentences.traditional: 老年人的醫療需求正在不斷增加。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoniánrén de yīliáo xūqiú zhèngzài búduàn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: The medical needs of elderly people are constantly increasing.

sentences.chinese: 公司会根据市场需求调整生产计划。
sentences.traditional: 公司會根據市場需求調整生產計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī huì gēnjù shìchǎng xūqiú tiáozhěng shēngchǎn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The company will adjust its production plan according to market demand.

sentences.chinese: 了解用户需求是产品设计的第一步。
sentences.traditional: 了解用戶需求是產品設計的第一步。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎojiě yònghù xūqiú shì chǎnpǐn shèjì de dì yī bù.
sentences.translation: Understanding user needs is the first step in product design.

sentences.chinese: 虚心听取意见，才能不断提升自己。
sentences.traditional: 虛心聽取意見，才能不斷提升自己。
sentences.pinyin: Xūxīn tīngqǔ yìjiàn, cái néng búduàn tíshēng zìjǐ.
sentences.translation: Only by listening to opinions with an open mind can you keep improving yourself.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然经验丰富，但对新技术仍然很虚心。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然經驗豐富，但對新技術仍然很虛心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán jīngyàn fēngfù, dàn duì xīn jìshù réngrán hěn xūxīn.
sentences.translation: Although he is very experienced, he is still open-minded about new technology.

sentences.chinese: 面对批评，她表现得十分虚心。
sentences.traditional: 面對批評，她表現得十分虛心。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì pīpíng, tā biǎoxiàn de shífēn xūxīn.
sentences.translation: Faced with criticism, she behaved very modestly.

sentences.chinese: 学校将在下午三点宣布比赛结果。
sentences.traditional: 學校將在下午三點宣布比賽結果。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāng zài xiàwǔ sān diǎn xuānbù bǐsài jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: The school will announce the competition results at three o’clock in the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 政府宣布新的环保政策下个月开始实施。
sentences.traditional: 政府宣布新的環保政策下個月開始實施。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù xīn de huánbǎo zhèngcè xià ge yuè kāishǐ shíshī.
sentences.translation: The government announced that the new environmental policy will start to be implemented next month.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，经理正式宣布了人事调整。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，經理正式宣布了人事調整。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, jīnglǐ zhèngshì xuānbù le rénshì tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, the manager formally announced the personnel adjustment.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片通过真实故事宣传环保理念。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片通過真實故事宣傳環保理念。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tòuguò zhēnshí gùshi xuānchuán huánbǎo lǐniàn.
sentences.translation: This documentary promotes environmental ideas through true stories.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划在网络上宣传新产品。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃在網絡上宣傳新產品。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà zài wǎnglù shang xuānchuán xīn chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: The company plans to promote the new product online.

sentences.chinese: 社区用海报宣传垃圾分类的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 社區用海報宣傳垃圾分類的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Shèqū yòng hǎibào xuānchuán lājī fēnlèi de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: The community uses posters to publicise the importance of rubbish sorting.

sentences.chinese: 这位年轻选手在比赛中表现非常稳定。
sentences.traditional: 這位年輕選手在比賽中表現非常穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng xuǎnshǒu zài bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn fēicháng wěndìng.
sentences.translation: This young contestant performed very steadily in the competition.

sentences.chinese: 每位选手都需要提前提交个人资料。
sentences.traditional: 每位選手都需要提前提交個人資料。
sentences.pinyin: Měi wèi xuǎnshǒu dōu xūyào tíqián tíjiāo gèrén zīliào.
sentences.translation: Each contestant needs to submit their personal information in advance.

sentences.chinese: 观众为最后出场的选手鼓掌。
sentences.traditional: 觀眾為最後出場的選手鼓掌。
sentences.pinyin: Guānzhòng wèi zuìhòu chūchǎng de xuǎnshǒu gǔzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The audience applauded the contestant who appeared last.

sentences.chinese: 这门课程有三个学分，要求完成一次实践报告。
sentences.traditional: 這門課程有三個學分，要求完成一次實踐報告。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng yǒu sān ge xuéfēn, yāoqiú wánchéng yí cì shíjiàn bàogào.
sentences.translation: This course is worth three credits and requires the completion of one practical report.

sentences.chinese: 如果学分不够，学生可能无法按时毕业。
sentences.traditional: 如果學分不夠，學生可能無法按時畢業。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xuéfēn bú gòu, xuéshēng kěnéng wúfǎ ànshí bìyè.
sentences.translation: If the credits are not enough, the student may be unable to graduate on time.

sentences.chinese: 他通过暑期课程补上了缺少的学分。
sentences.traditional: 他通過暑期課程補上了缺少的學分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tòuguò shǔqī kèchéng bǔ shang le quēshǎo de xuéfēn.
sentences.translation: He made up the missing credits through a summer course.

sentences.chinese: 心理学是一门研究人类行为的学科。
sentences.traditional: 心理學是一門研究人類行為的學科。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnlǐxué shì yì mén yánjiū rénlèi xíngwéi de xuékē.
sentences.translation: Psychology is a discipline that studies human behaviour.

sentences.chinese: 不同学科之间的合作能带来新的发现。
sentences.traditional: 不同學科之間的合作能帶來新的發現。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng xuékē zhījiān de hézuò néng dài lái xīn de fāxiàn.
sentences.translation: Cooperation between different disciplines can bring new discoveries.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学在物理学科方面实力很强。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學在物理學科方面實力很強。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué zài wùlǐ xuékē fāngmiàn shílì hěn qiáng.
sentences.translation: This university is very strong in the discipline of physics.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作要求本科以上学历。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作要求本科以上學歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò yāoqiú běnkē yǐshàng xuélì.
sentences.translation: This job requires an undergraduate degree or higher.

sentences.chinese: 面试时，公司更看重实际能力，而不是学历。
sentences.traditional: 面試時，公司更看重實際能力，而不是學歷。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì shí, gōngsī gèng kànzhòng shíjì nénglì, ér bú shì xuélì.
sentences.translation: During interviews, the company values practical ability more than educational background.

sentences.chinese: 继续学习可以提升个人学历和竞争力。
sentences.traditional: 繼續學習可以提升個人學歷和競爭力。
sentences.pinyin: Jìxù xuéxí kěyǐ tíshēng gèrén xuélì hé jìngzhēnglì.
sentences.translation: Continuing to study can improve one’s educational background and competitiveness.

sentences.chinese: 新学年开始后，学校增加了几门选修课。
sentences.traditional: 新學年開始後，學校增加了幾門選修課。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xuénián kāishǐ hòu, xuéxiào zēngjiā le jǐ mén xuǎnxiūkè.
sentences.translation: After the new academic year began, the school added several elective courses.

sentences.chinese: 这个学年的实践活动比去年更多。
sentences.traditional: 這個學年的實踐活動比去年更多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xuénián de shíjiàn huódòng bǐ qùnián gèng duō.
sentences.translation: This academic year has more practical activities than last year.

sentences.chinese: 学年结束以前，学生必须提交研究报告。
sentences.traditional: 學年結束以前，學生必須提交研究報告。
sentences.pinyin: Xuénián jiéshù yǐqián, xuéshēng bìxū tíjiāo yánjiū bàogào.
sentences.translation: Before the academic year ends, students must submit a research report.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章的学术价值很高。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章的學術價值很高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de xuéshù jiàzhí hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: The academic value of this article is very high.

sentences.chinese: 大学鼓励学生参加学术交流活动。
sentences.traditional: 大學鼓勵學生參加學術交流活動。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxué gǔlì xuéshēng cānjiā xuéshù jiāoliú huódòng.
sentences.translation: The university encourages students to take part in academic exchange activities.

sentences.chinese: 做学术研究需要耐心和严谨的态度。
sentences.traditional: 做學術研究需要耐心和嚴謹的態度。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò xuéshù yánjiū xūyào nàixīn hé yánjǐn de tàidu.
sentences.translation: Doing academic research requires patience and a rigorous attitude.

sentences.chinese: 这位学者长期研究中国古代文学。
sentences.traditional: 這位學者長期研究中國古代文學。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuézhě chángqī yánjiū Zhōngguó gǔdài wénxué.
sentences.translation: This scholar has long studied ancient Chinese literature.

sentences.chinese: 许多学者认为，数据必须公开透明。
sentences.traditional: 許多學者認為，數據必須公開透明。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō xuézhě rènwéi, shùjù bìxū gōngkāi tòumíng.
sentences.translation: Many scholars believe that data must be open and transparent.

sentences.chinese: 会议邀请了几位国际学者发表演讲。
sentences.traditional: 會議邀請了幾位國際學者發表演講。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yāoqǐng le jǐ wèi guójì xuézhě fābiǎo yǎnjiǎng.
sentences.translation: The conference invited several international scholars to give speeches.

sentences.chinese: 天气太热了，孩子们都想吃雪糕。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太熱了，孩子們都想吃雪糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè le, háizimen dōu xiǎng chī xuěgāo.
sentences.translation: The weather is so hot that the children all want to eat ice cream.

sentences.chinese: 这种雪糕的售价比去年高了一点。
sentences.traditional: 這種雪糕的售價比去年高了一點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xuěgāo de shòujià bǐ qùnián gāo le yì diǎn.
sentences.translation: The selling price of this kind of ice cream is a little higher than last year.

sentences.chinese: 她把雪糕放进冰箱，免得它化掉。
sentences.traditional: 她把雪糕放進冰箱，免得它化掉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xuěgāo fàng jìn bīngxiāng, miǎnde tā huà diào.
sentences.translation: She put the ice cream into the fridge to stop it melting.

sentences.chinese: 有问题可以随时向工作人员询问。
sentences.traditional: 有問題可以隨時向工作人員詢問。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ suíshí xiàng gōngzuò rényuán xúnwèn.
sentences.translation: If you have questions, you can ask the staff at any time.

sentences.chinese: 警察正在询问事故现场的目击者。
sentences.traditional: 警察正在詢問事故現場的目擊者。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài xúnwèn shìgù xiànchǎng de mùjīzhě.
sentences.translation: The police are questioning witnesses at the scene of the accident.

sentences.chinese: 客户打电话询问产品的详细信息。
sentences.traditional: 客戶打電話詢問產品的詳細信息。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù dǎ diànhuà xúnwèn chǎnpǐn de xiángxì zīxùn.
sentences.translation: The customer phoned to ask for detailed information about the product.

sentences.chinese: 我们正在寻找解决问题的新方法。
sentences.traditional: 我們正在尋找解決問題的新方法。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài xúnzhǎo jiějué wèntí de xīn fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: We are looking for a new way to solve the problem.

sentences.chinese: 他花了一个下午寻找丢失的钥匙。
sentences.traditional: 他花了一個下午尋找丟失的鑰匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huā le yí ge xiàwǔ xúnzhǎo diūshī de yàoshi.
sentences.translation: He spent an afternoon looking for the lost keys.

sentences.chinese: 企业需要寻找适合自己的发展道路。
sentences.traditional: 企業需要尋找適合自己的發展道路。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè xūyào xúnzhǎo shìhé zìjǐ de fāzhǎn dàolù.
sentences.translation: Enterprises need to seek a path of development that suits them.

sentences.chinese: 运动员每天都要进行严格训练。
sentences.traditional: 運動員每天都要進行嚴格訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán měitiān dōu yào jìnxíng yángé xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: Athletes have to undergo strict training every day.

sentences.chinese: 这次训练帮助员工熟悉新的系统。
sentences.traditional: 這次訓練幫助員工熟悉新的系統。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì xùnliàn bāngzhù yuángōng shúxī xīn de xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: This training helped staff become familiar with the new system.

sentences.chinese: 经过长期训练，他的反应速度明显提升。
sentences.traditional: 經過長期訓練，他的反應速度明顯提升。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò chángqī xùnliàn, tā de fǎnyìng sùdù míngxiǎn tíshēng.
sentences.translation: After long-term training, his reaction speed improved noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 火车到站后，乘客迅速下车。
sentences.traditional: 火車到站後，乘客迅速下車。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē dào zhàn hòu, chéngkè xùnsù xià chē.
sentences.translation: After the train arrived at the station, passengers got off quickly.

sentences.chinese: 公司需要迅速回应市场变化。
sentences.traditional: 公司需要迅速回應市場變化。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào xùnsù huíyìng shìchǎng biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The company needs to respond quickly to changes in the market.

sentences.chinese: 消息传开以后，问题迅速引起了关注。
sentences.traditional: 消息傳開以後，問題迅速引起了關注。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāoxi chuán kāi yǐhòu, wèntí xùnsù yǐnqǐ le guānzhù.
sentences.translation: After the news spread, the issue quickly attracted attention.

sentences.chinese: 呀，你怎么把钥匙忘在办公室了？
sentences.traditional: 呀，你怎麼把鑰匙忘在辦公室了？
sentences.pinyin: Yā, nǐ zěnme bǎ yàoshi wàng zài bàngōngshì le?
sentences.translation: Oh, how did you leave the keys at the office?

sentences.chinese: 呀，原来这件事和他无关。
sentences.traditional: 呀，原來這件事和他無關。
sentences.pinyin: Yā, yuánlái zhè jiàn shì hé tā wúguān.
sentences.translation: Oh, it turns out this matter has nothing to do with him.

sentences.chinese: 呀，我差点把这份问卷删掉了。
sentences.traditional: 呀，我差點把這份問卷刪掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Yā, wǒ chàdiǎn bǎ zhè fèn wènjuàn shān diào le.
sentences.translation: Oh, I nearly deleted this questionnaire.

sentences.chinese: 租房时，房东要求我们先交两个月押金。
sentences.traditional: 租房時，房東要求我們先交兩個月押金。
sentences.pinyin: Zūfáng shí, fángdōng yāoqiú wǒmen xiān jiāo liǎng ge yuè yājīn.
sentences.translation: When renting, the landlord asked us to pay two months’ deposit first.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有损坏，押金会在退房后一周内退还。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有損壞，押金會在退房後一週內退還。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu sǔnhuài, yājīn huì zài tuì fáng hòu yì zhōu nèi tuìhuán.
sentences.translation: If there is no damage, the deposit will be returned within one week after checking out.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司收取押金，是为了确保设备能按时归还。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司收取押金，是為了確保設備能按時歸還。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shōuqǔ yājīn, shì wèile quèbǎo shèbèi néng ànshí guīhuán.
sentences.translation: This company takes a deposit to ensure the equipment is returned on time.

sentences.chinese: 春节时，长辈通常会给孩子压岁钱。
sentences.traditional: 春節時，長輩通常會給孩子壓歲錢。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié shí, zhǎngbèi tōngcháng huì gěi háizi yāsuìqián.
sentences.translation: At Spring Festival, elders usually give children lucky money.

sentences.chinese: 他把收到的压岁钱存进银行，打算以后买电脑。
sentences.traditional: 他把收到的壓歲錢存進銀行，打算以後買電腦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ shōudào de yāsuìqián cún jìn yínháng, dǎsuàn yǐhòu mǎi diànnǎo.
sentences.translation: He put the lucky money he received into the bank and plans to buy a computer later.

sentences.chinese: 压岁钱不只是钱，也代表家人对孩子的祝福。
sentences.traditional: 壓歲錢不只是錢，也代表家人對孩子的祝福。
sentences.pinyin: Yāsuìqián bù zhǐ shì qián, yě dàibiǎo jiārén duì háizi de zhùfú.
sentences.translation: Lucky money is not just money; it also represents the family’s blessings for the child.

sentences.chinese: 湖边有几只鸭子正在慢慢游来游去。
sentences.traditional: 湖邊有幾隻鴨子正在慢慢游來游去。
sentences.pinyin: Húbiān yǒu jǐ zhī yāzi zhèngzài mànmàn yóu lái yóu qù.
sentences.translation: There are several ducks swimming slowly back and forth by the lake.

sentences.chinese: 这种鸭子的羽毛很特别，在阳光下有绿色光泽。
sentences.traditional: 這種鴨子的羽毛很特別，在陽光下有綠色光澤。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yāzi de yǔmáo hěn tèbié, zài yángguāng xià yǒu lǜsè guāngzé.
sentences.translation: This kind of duck has very special feathers with a green shine in the sunlight.

sentences.chinese: 农场里养了很多鸭子，游客可以近距离观察。
sentences.traditional: 農場裡養了很多鴨子，遊客可以近距離觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngchǎng lǐ yǎng le hěn duō yāzi, yóukè kěyǐ jìn jùlí guānchá.
sentences.translation: The farm keeps many ducks, and visitors can observe them up close.

sentences.chinese: 保护牙齿最基本的方法是每天认真刷牙。
sentences.traditional: 保護牙齒最基本的方法是每天認真刷牙。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù yáchǐ zuì jīběn de fāngfǎ shì měitiān rènzhēn shuā yá.
sentences.translation: The most basic way to protect your teeth is to brush them carefully every day.

sentences.chinese: 如果牙齿一直疼痛，最好尽快去看牙医。
sentences.traditional: 如果牙齒一直疼痛，最好儘快去看牙醫。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yáchǐ yìzhí téngtòng, zuìhǎo jǐnkuài qù kàn yáyī.
sentences.translation: If your teeth keep hurting, it is best to see a dentist as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这只动物的牙齿很锋利，能轻松咬开坚硬的壳。
sentences.traditional: 這隻動物的牙齒很鋒利，能輕鬆咬開堅硬的殼。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī dòngwù de yáchǐ hěn fēnglì, néng qīngsōng yǎo kāi jiānyìng de ké.
sentences.translation: This animal’s teeth are very sharp and can easily bite open a hard shell.

sentences.chinese: 沿这条路一直走，就能到达火车站。
sentences.traditional: 沿這條路一直走，就能到達火車站。
sentences.pinyin: Yán zhè tiáo lù yìzhí zǒu, jiù néng dàodá huǒchēzhàn.
sentences.translation: Walk along this road, and you will reach the railway station.

sentences.chinese: 河边修了一条小路，游客可以沿河散步。
sentences.traditional: 河邊修了一條小路，遊客可以沿河散步。
sentences.pinyin: Hébiān xiū le yì tiáo xiǎolù, yóukè kěyǐ yán hé sànbù.
sentences.translation: A small path has been built by the river, so visitors can walk along it.

sentences.chinese: 公司沿用过去的管理方式，效果并不理想。
sentences.traditional: 公司沿用過去的管理方式，效果並不理想。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yányòng guòqù de guǎnlǐ fāngshì, xiàoguǒ bìng bù lǐxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The company continues to use the old management method, and the results are not ideal.

sentences.chinese: 因为天气原因，比赛时间被延长了半小时。
sentences.traditional: 因為天氣原因，比賽時間被延長了半小時。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì yuányīn, bǐsài shíjiān bèi yáncháng le bàn xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: Because of the weather, the match time was extended by half an hour.

sentences.chinese: 政府决定延长这项政策的试用期。
sentences.traditional: 政府決定延長這項政策的試用期。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juédìng yáncháng zhè xiàng zhèngcè de shìyòngqī.
sentences.translation: The government decided to extend the trial period of this policy.

sentences.chinese: 适当运动可以延长老年人的健康寿命。
sentences.traditional: 適當運動可以延長老年人的健康壽命。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdàng yùndòng kěyǐ yáncháng lǎoniánrén de jiànkāng shòumìng.
sentences.translation: Appropriate exercise can extend the healthy lifespan of elderly people.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司正在研发一种更安全的电池。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司正在研發一種更安全的電池。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài yánfā yì zhǒng gèng ānquán de diànchí.
sentences.translation: This company is developing a safer type of battery.

sentences.chinese: 研发新产品需要大量资金和专业人才。
sentences.traditional: 研發新產品需要大量資金和專業人才。
sentences.pinyin: Yánfā xīn chǎnpǐn xūyào dàliàng zījīn hé zhuānyè réncái.
sentences.translation: Developing new products requires a large amount of funding and professional talent.

sentences.chinese: 学校和企业合作研发适合老人的服务系统。
sentences.traditional: 學校和企業合作研發適合老人的服務系統。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào hé qǐyè hézuò yánfā shìhé lǎorén de fúwù xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: The school and the enterprise are jointly developing a service system suitable for elderly people.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始后，大家的表情都变得很严肃。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始後，大家的表情都變得很嚴肅。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ hòu, dàjiā de biǎoqíng dōu biàn de hěn yánsù.
sentences.translation: After the meeting began, everyone’s expressions became very serious.

sentences.chinese: 对待安全问题，管理人员必须保持严肃态度。
sentences.traditional: 對待安全問題，管理人員必須保持嚴肅態度。
sentences.pinyin: Duìdài ānquán wèntí, guǎnlǐ rényuán bìxū bǎochí yánsù tàidu.
sentences.translation: When dealing with safety issues, managers must maintain a serious attitude.

sentences.chinese: 老师严肃地提醒学生不要违反考试规则。
sentences.traditional: 老師嚴肅地提醒學生不要違反考試規則。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yánsù de tíxǐng xuéshēng bú yào wéifǎn kǎoshì guīzé.
sentences.translation: The teacher seriously reminded the students not to break the exam rules.

sentences.chinese: 研究团队花了三年时间研制这种设备。
sentences.traditional: 研究團隊花了三年時間研製這種設備。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū tuánduì huā le sān nián shíjiān yánzhì zhè zhǒng shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The research team spent three years developing this device.

sentences.chinese: 新药研制成功后，还需要进行严格试验。
sentences.traditional: 新藥研製成功後，還需要進行嚴格試驗。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yào yánzhì chénggōng hòu, hái xūyào jìnxíng yángé shìyàn.
sentences.translation: After the new medicine is successfully developed, strict testing is still needed.

sentences.chinese: 他们正在研制一套适用于山区的通信系统。
sentences.traditional: 他們正在研製一套適用於山區的通信系統。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài yánzhì yí tào shìyòng yú shānqū de tōngxìn xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: They are developing a communication system suitable for mountainous areas.

sentences.chinese: 她的眼里充满了对未来的期待。
sentences.traditional: 她的眼裡充滿了對未來的期待。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎn lǐ chōngmǎn le duì wèilái de qīdài.
sentences.translation: Her eyes were full of expectations for the future.

sentences.chinese: 那口井很深，村民们叫它一眼老井。
sentences.traditional: 那口井很深，村民們叫它一眼老井。
sentences.pinyin: Nà kǒu jǐng hěn shēn, cūnmínmen jiào tā yì yǎn lǎo jǐng.
sentences.translation: That well is very deep, and the villagers call it an old well.

sentences.chinese: 他的左眼有点红，医生建议他休息几天。
sentences.traditional: 他的左眼有點紅，醫生建議他休息幾天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zuǒ yǎn yǒudiǎn hóng, yīshēng jiànyì tā xiūxi jǐ tiān.
sentences.translation: His left eye is a bit red, so the doctor suggested that he rest for a few days.

sentences.chinese: 这位教授明天要在学校演讲。
sentences.traditional: 這位教授明天要在學校演講。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu míngtiān yào zài xuéxiào yǎnjiǎng.
sentences.translation: This professor is going to give a speech at the school tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他在会议上演讲时，重点介绍了新的研究成果。
sentences.traditional: 他在會議上演講時，重點介紹了新的研究成果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shàng yǎnjiǎng shí, zhòngdiǎn jièshào le xīn de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: When he gave a speech at the meeting, he focused on introducing the new research results.

sentences.chinese: 为了能自信地演讲，她提前练习了很多次。
sentences.traditional: 為了能自信地演講，她提前練習了很多次。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile néng zìxìn de yǎnjiǎng, tā tíqián liànxí le hěn duō cì.
sentences.translation: In order to speak confidently, she practised many times in advance.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，她的眼泪一下子流了下来。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，她的眼淚一下子流了下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhè ge xiāoxi, tā de yǎnlèi yíxiàzi liú le xiàlai.
sentences.translation: When she heard the news, her tears suddenly fell.

sentences.chinese: 那部电影太感人了，很多观众都忍不住掉眼泪。
sentences.traditional: 那部電影太感人了，很多觀眾都忍不住掉眼淚。
sentences.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng tài gǎnrén le, hěn duō guānzhòng dōu rěn bu zhù diào yǎnlèi.
sentences.translation: That film was so moving that many viewers could not help crying.

sentences.chinese: 他擦掉眼泪，努力让自己重新平静下来。
sentences.traditional: 他擦掉眼淚，努力讓自己重新平靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cādiào yǎnlèi, nǔlì ràng zìjǐ chóngxīn píngjìng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: He wiped away his tears and tried to calm himself down again.

sentences.chinese: 我喜欢早上坐在阳台上喝咖啡。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡早上坐在陽臺上喝咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zǎoshang zuò zài yángtái shàng hē kāfēi.
sentences.translation: I like sitting on the balcony and drinking coffee in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 这套公寓的阳台很宽，可以放一张小桌子。
sentences.traditional: 這套公寓的陽臺很寬，可以放一張小桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù de yángtái hěn kuān, kěyǐ fàng yì zhāng xiǎo zhuōzi.
sentences.translation: The balcony of this flat is wide enough for a small table.

sentences.chinese: 下雨前，他把阳台上的衣服都收了进来。
sentences.traditional: 下雨前，他把陽臺上的衣服都收了進來。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ qián, tā bǎ yángtái shàng de yīfu dōu shōu le jìnlai.
sentences.translation: Before it rained, he brought in all the clothes from the balcony.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套的样式很简单，但看起来很大方。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套的樣式很簡單，但看起來很大方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào de yàngshì hěn jiǎndān, dàn kàn qǐlai hěn dàfang.
sentences.translation: The style of this coat is simple, but it looks elegant.

sentences.chinese: 网站更新后，页面样式比以前更清楚。
sentences.traditional: 網站更新後，頁面樣式比以前更清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngzhàn gēngxīn hòu, yèmiàn yàngshì bǐ yǐqián gèng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: After the website was updated, the page style became clearer than before.

sentences.chinese: 请按照公司统一的样式修改这份报告。
sentences.traditional: 請按照公司統一的樣式修改這份報告。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào gōngsī tǒngyī de yàngshì xiūgǎi zhè fèn bàogào.
sentences.translation: Please revise this report according to the company's unified style.

sentences.chinese: 坐太久以后，他的腰有点疼。
sentences.traditional: 坐太久以後，他的腰有點疼。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò tài jiǔ yǐhòu, tā de yāo yǒudiǎn téng.
sentences.translation: After sitting for too long, his waist hurt a little.

sentences.chinese: 练习舞蹈时，老师提醒大家要放松腰部。
sentences.traditional: 練習舞蹈時，老師提醒大家要放鬆腰部。
sentences.pinyin: Liànxí wǔdǎo shí, lǎoshī tíxǐng dàjiā yào fàngsōng yāobù.
sentences.translation: When practising dance, the teacher reminded everyone to relax their waist.

sentences.chinese: 搬重物之前，最好先保护好腰。
sentences.traditional: 搬重物之前，最好先保護好腰。
sentences.pinyin: Bān zhòngwù zhīqián, zuìhǎo xiān bǎohù hǎo yāo.
sentences.translation: Before moving heavy things, it is best to protect your waist first.

sentences.chinese: 他用力摇瓶子，让里面的粉末混合均匀。
sentences.traditional: 他用力搖瓶子，讓裡面的粉末混合均勻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yònglì yáo píngzi, ràng lǐmiàn de fěnmò hùnhé jūnyún.
sentences.translation: He shook the bottle hard to mix the powder inside evenly.

sentences.chinese: 风很大，把窗外的树枝摇得不停。
sentences.traditional: 風很大，把窗外的樹枝搖得不停。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng hěn dà, bǎ chuāngwài de shùzhī yáo de bù tíng.
sentences.translation: The wind was strong and kept shaking the branches outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 不要摇桌子，电脑可能会掉下来。
sentences.traditional: 不要搖桌子，電腦可能會掉下來。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào yáo zhuōzi, diànnǎo kěnéng huì diào xiàlai.
sentences.translation: Do not shake the table; the computer might fall off.

sentences.chinese: 这只小狗还没有训练好，见到鞋子就想咬。
sentences.traditional: 這隻小狗還沒有訓練好，見到鞋子就想咬。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu hái méiyǒu xùnliàn hǎo, jiàndào xiézi jiù xiǎng yǎo.
sentences.translation: This puppy has not been trained yet and wants to bite whenever it sees shoes.

sentences.chinese: 吃苹果的时候，他不小心咬到了舌头。
sentences.traditional: 吃蘋果的時候，他不小心咬到了舌頭。
sentences.pinyin: Chī píngguǒ de shíhou, tā bù xiǎoxīn yǎo dào le shétou.
sentences.translation: When eating an apple, he accidentally bit his tongue.

sentences.chinese: 这种牙齿很锋利，可以轻松咬开坚硬的壳。
sentences.traditional: 這種牙齒很鋒利，可以輕鬆咬開堅硬的殼。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yáchǐ hěn fēnglì, kěyǐ qīngsōng yǎo kāi jiānyìng de ké.
sentences.translation: This kind of tooth is very sharp and can easily bite open a hard shell.

sentences.chinese: 我们现在出发吧，要不就会错过火车。
sentences.traditional: 我們現在出發吧，要不就會錯過火車。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài chūfā ba, yàobù jiù huì cuòguò huǒchē.
sentences.translation: Let’s set off now, otherwise we will miss the train.

sentences.chinese: 你先把文件保存，要不突然断电就麻烦了。
sentences.traditional: 你先把文件保存，要不突然斷電就麻煩了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ wénjiàn bǎocún, yàobù tūrán duàndiàn jiù máfan le.
sentences.translation: Save the file first, otherwise it will be troublesome if the power suddenly goes out.

sentences.chinese: 我们得把计划说清楚，要不双方容易产生误会。
sentences.traditional: 我們得把計畫說清楚，要不雙方容易產生誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen děi bǎ jìhuà shuō qīngchu, yàobù shuāngfāng róngyì chǎnshēng wùhuì.
sentences.translation: We need to explain the plan clearly, otherwise both sides may easily misunderstand each other.

sentences.chinese: 要不是你提醒我，我就把会议时间记错了。
sentences.traditional: 要不是你提醒我，我就把會議時間記錯了。
sentences.pinyin: Yàobúshì nǐ tíxǐng wǒ, wǒ jiù bǎ huìyì shíjiān jì cuò le.
sentences.translation: If it were not for your reminder, I would have remembered the meeting time wrongly.

sentences.chinese: 要不是天气突然变化，活动本来可以按时举行。
sentences.traditional: 要不是天氣突然變化，活動本來可以按時舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Yàobúshì tiānqì tūrán biànhuà, huódòng běnlái kěyǐ ànshí jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: If it were not for the sudden change in weather, the event could originally have been held on time.

sentences.chinese: 要不是大家共同努力，这个项目很难顺利完成。
sentences.traditional: 要不是大家共同努力，這個項目很難順利完成。
sentences.pinyin: Yàobúshì dàjiā gòngtóng nǔlì, zhè ge xiàngmù hěn nán shùnlì wánchéng.
sentences.translation: If it were not for everyone’s joint effort, this project would be hard to complete smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 这些药品必须放在阴凉干燥的地方。
sentences.traditional: 這些藥品必須放在陰涼乾燥的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē yàopǐn bìxū fàng zài yīnliáng gānzào de dìfang.
sentences.translation: These medicines must be kept in a cool, dry place.

sentences.chinese: 购买药品前，最好先了解它的使用方法。
sentences.traditional: 購買藥品前，最好先了解它的使用方法。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi yàopǐn qián, zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě tā de shǐyòng fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: Before buying medicine, it is best to understand how to use it.

sentences.chinese: 医院会定期检查药品的保存情况。
sentences.traditional: 醫院會定期檢查藥品的保存情況。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn huì dìngqī jiǎnchá yàopǐn de bǎocún qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The hospital regularly checks how medicines are stored.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他不要随意使用药物。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他不要隨意使用藥物。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā bú yào suíyì shǐyòng yàowù.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him not to use medication casually.

sentences.chinese: 这种药物可能会影响睡眠，服用前要看说明。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥物可能會影響睡眠，服用前要看說明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàowù kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng shuìmián, fúyòng qián yào kàn shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: This medication may affect sleep, so read the instructions before taking it.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员正在测试新药物的安全性。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員正在測試新藥物的安全性。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán zhèngzài cèshì xīn yàowù de ānquánxìng.
sentences.translation: Researchers are testing the safety of the new medication.

sentences.chinese: 夜间气温会下降，出门最好多穿一点。
sentences.traditional: 夜間氣溫會下降，出門最好多穿一點。
sentences.pinyin: Yèjiān qìwēn huì xiàjiàng, chūmén zuìhǎo duō chuān yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: At night, the temperature falls, so it is best to wear a little more when going out.

sentences.chinese: 这条铁路夜间也有列车通行。
sentences.traditional: 這條鐵路夜間也有列車通行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù yèjiān yě yǒu lièchē tōngxíng.
sentences.translation: This railway also has trains passing through at night.

sentences.chinese: 医院增加了夜间服务，方便急病患者。
sentences.traditional: 醫院增加了夜間服務，方便急病患者。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn zēngjiā le yèjiān fúwù, fāngbiàn jíbìng huànzhě.
sentences.translation: The hospital has added nighttime services to make things easier for emergency patients.

sentences.chinese: 周末的夜市很热闹，吸引了很多游客。
sentences.traditional: 週末的夜市很熱鬧，吸引了很多遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò de yèshì hěn rènao, xīyǐn le hěn duō yóukè.
sentences.translation: The night market is lively at weekends and attracts many tourists.

sentences.chinese: 他在夜市买了一份当地特产。
sentences.traditional: 他在夜市買了一份當地特產。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài yèshì mǎi le yí fèn dāngdì tèchǎn.
sentences.translation: He bought a local specialty at the night market.

sentences.chinese: 管理部门正在改善夜市的卫生条件。
sentences.traditional: 管理部門正在改善夜市的衛生條件。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐ bùmén zhèngzài gǎishàn yèshì de wèishēng tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: The management department is improving the hygiene conditions at the night market.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在扩大海外业务。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在擴大海外業務。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài kuòdà hǎiwài yèwù.
sentences.translation: The company is expanding its overseas business.

sentences.chinese: 这位员工对银行业务很熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 這位員工對銀行業務很熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yuángōng duì yínháng yèwù hěn shúxī.
sentences.translation: This employee is very familiar with banking business.

sentences.chinese: 新系统提高了业务处理效率。
sentences.traditional: 新系統提高了業務處理效率。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng tígāo le yèwù chǔlǐ xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The new system has improved the efficiency of business processing.

sentences.chinese: 她业余时间喜欢学习书法。
sentences.traditional: 她業餘時間喜歡學習書法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yèyú shíjiān xǐhuan xuéxí shūfǎ.
sentences.translation: She likes learning calligraphy in her spare time.

sentences.chinese: 这支球队虽然是业余的，但训练很认真。
sentences.traditional: 這支球隊雖然是業餘的，但訓練很認真。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì suīrán shì yèyú de, dàn xùnliàn hěn rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: Although this team is amateur, it trains very seriously.

sentences.chinese: 他把业余爱好发展成了事业。
sentences.traditional: 他把業餘愛好發展成了事業。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yèyú àihào fāzhǎn chéng le shìyè.
sentences.translation: He developed his hobby into a career.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该依据事实作出判断。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該依據事實作出判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi yījù shìshí zuòchū pànduàn.
sentences.translation: We should make judgements based on facts.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告提供了重要依据。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告提供了重要依據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào tígōng le zhòngyào yījù.
sentences.translation: This report provides an important basis.

sentences.chinese: 学校依据学生的成绩安排课程。
sentences.traditional: 學校依據學生的成績安排課程。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yījù xuéshēng de chéngjì ānpái kèchéng.
sentences.translation: The school arranges courses according to students’ results.

sentences.chinese: 很多企业依靠技术提升竞争力。
sentences.traditional: 很多企業依靠技術提升競爭力。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō qǐyè yīkào jìshù tíshēng jìngzhēnglì.
sentences.translation: Many enterprises rely on technology to improve competitiveness.

sentences.chinese: 解决这个问题不能只依靠经验。
sentences.traditional: 解決這個問題不能只依靠經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Jiějué zhè ge wèntí bù néng zhǐ yīkào jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Solving this problem cannot rely only on experience.

sentences.chinese: 家人的支持是他最大的依靠。
sentences.traditional: 家人的支持是他最大的依靠。
sentences.pinyin: Jiārén de zhīchí shì tā zuìdà de yīkào.
sentences.translation: His family’s support is his greatest source of support.

sentences.chinese: 当地政府正在改善农村医疗条件。
sentences.traditional: 當地政府正在改善農村醫療條件。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì zhèngfǔ zhèngzài gǎishàn nóngcūn yīliáo tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: The local government is improving medical conditions in rural areas.

sentences.chinese: 这项医疗服务对老人特别重要。
sentences.traditional: 這項醫療服務對老人特別重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yīliáo fúwù duì lǎorén tèbié zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This medical service is especially important for elderly people.

sentences.chinese: 医疗技术的进步提高了治疗效果。
sentences.traditional: 醫療技術的進步提高了治療效果。
sentences.pinyin: Yīliáo jìshù de jìnbù tígāo le zhìliáo xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: Progress in medical technology has improved treatment outcomes.

sentences.chinese: 过了很多年，他依然记得那个夜晚。
sentences.traditional: 過了很多年，他依然記得那個夜晚。
sentences.pinyin: Guò le hěn duō nián, tā yīrán jìde nà ge yèwǎn.
sentences.translation: After many years, he still remembers that night.

sentences.chinese: 天气很冷，但游客依然很多。
sentences.traditional: 天氣很冷，但遊客依然很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn lěng, dàn yóukè yīrán hěn duō.
sentences.translation: The weather is cold, but there are still many tourists.

sentences.chinese: 虽然计划遇到困难，团队依然没有放弃。
sentences.traditional: 雖然計畫遇到困難，團隊依然沒有放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán jìhuà yùdào kùnnan, tuánduì yīrán méiyǒu fàngqì.
sentences.translation: Although the plan encountered difficulties, the team still did not give up.

sentences.chinese: 他大学毕业后继续学习医学。
sentences.traditional: 他大學畢業後繼續學習醫學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè hòu jìxù xuéxí yīxué.
sentences.translation: After graduating from university, he continued to study medicine.

sentences.chinese: 现代医学让许多疾病变得可以治疗。
sentences.traditional: 現代醫學讓許多疾病變得可以治療。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài yīxué ràng xǔduō jíbìng biàn de kěyǐ zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: Modern medicine has made many diseases treatable.

sentences.chinese: 这位学者在医学领域很有影响力。
sentences.traditional: 這位學者在醫學領域很有影響力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuézhě zài yīxué lǐngyù hěn yǒu yǐngxiǎnglì.
sentences.translation: This scholar is very influential in the field of medicine.

sentences.chinese: 请把桌子往右移一点。
sentences.traditional: 請把桌子往右移一點。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhuōzi wǎng yòu yí yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Please move the table a little to the right.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划把部分业务移到线上。
sentences.traditional: 公司計畫把部分業務移到線上。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà bǎ bùfen yèwù yí dào xiànshàng.
sentences.translation: The company plans to move part of its business online.

sentences.chinese: 他把花盆从阳台移进了卧室。
sentences.traditional: 他把花盆從陽臺移進了臥室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ huāpén cóng yángtái yí jìn le wòshì.
sentences.translation: He moved the flowerpot from the balcony into the bedroom.

sentences.chinese: 这些一次性餐具虽然方便，但不太环保。
sentences.traditional: 這些一次性餐具雖然方便，但不太環保。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē yícìxìng cānjù suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn bù tài huánbǎo.
sentences.translation: These disposable utensils are convenient, but not very environmentally friendly.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定减少一次性用品的使用。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定減少一次性用品的使用。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng jiǎnshǎo yícìxìng yòngpǐn de shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: The company decided to reduce the use of disposable items.

sentences.chinese: 这张票是一次性的，进场后不能重复使用。
sentences.traditional: 這張票是一次性的，進場後不能重複使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào shì yícìxìng de, jìnchǎng hòu bù néng chóngfù shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This ticket is single-use; after entering, it cannot be used again.

sentences.chinese: 这一代年轻人更习惯通过网络获取信息。
sentences.traditional: 這一代年輕人更習慣通過網絡獲取信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yídài niánqīngrén gèng xíguàn tōngguò wǎngluò huòqǔ xìnxī.
sentences.translation: This generation of young people is more used to getting information through the internet.

sentences.chinese: 他的作品影响了一代读者。
sentences.traditional: 他的作品影響了一代讀者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zuòpǐn yǐngxiǎng le yídài dúzhě.
sentences.translation: His works influenced a generation of readers.

sentences.chinese: 每一代人都有自己的机会和挑战。
sentences.traditional: 每一代人都有自己的機會和挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Měi yídài rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jīhuì hé tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: Every generation has its own opportunities and challenges.

sentences.chinese: 一旦发现问题，就要立即向负责人报告。
sentences.traditional: 一旦發現問題，就要立即向負責人報告。
sentences.pinyin: Yídàn fāxiàn wèntí, jiù yào lìjí xiàng fùzérén bàogào.
sentences.translation: Once a problem is found, it should be reported to the person in charge immediately.

sentences.chinese: 一旦计划确定下来，大家就可以开始行动。
sentences.traditional: 一旦計畫確定下來，大家就可以開始行動。
sentences.pinyin: Yídàn jìhuà quèdìng xiàlái, dàjiā jiù kěyǐ kāishǐ xíngdòng.
sentences.translation: Once the plan is confirmed, everyone can start taking action.

sentences.chinese: 一旦天气转坏，比赛可能会被推迟。
sentences.traditional: 一旦天氣轉壞，比賽可能會被推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Yídàn tiānqì zhuǎn huài, bǐsài kěnéng huì bèi tuīchí.
sentences.translation: If the weather turns bad, the match may be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 请不要随便移动实验室里的设备。
sentences.traditional: 請不要隨便移動實驗室裡的設備。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bùyào suíbiàn yídòng shíyànshì lǐ de shèbèi.
sentences.translation: Please do not move the equipment in the laboratory casually.

sentences.chinese: 手机支付让人们在移动中也能处理很多业务。
sentences.traditional: 手機支付讓人們在移動中也能處理很多業務。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī zhīfù ràng rénmen zài yídòng zhōng yě néng chǔlǐ hěn duō yèwù.
sentences.translation: Mobile payment lets people handle many tasks while on the move.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件可以帮助用户移动大量数据。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件可以幫助用戶移動大量數據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ bāngzhù yònghù yídòng dàliàng shùjù.
sentences.translation: This software can help users move large amounts of data.

sentences.chinese: 很遗憾，我们没能按时完成这项任务。
sentences.traditional: 很遺憾，我們沒能按時完成這項任務。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn yíhàn, wǒmen méi néng ànshí wánchéng zhè xiàng rènwù.
sentences.translation: Unfortunately, we were unable to complete this task on time.

sentences.chinese: 没有参加那次交流活动，是他最大的遗憾。
sentences.traditional: 沒有參加那次交流活動，是他最大的遺憾。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu cānjiā nà cì jiāoliú huódòng, shì tā zuì dà de yíhàn.
sentences.translation: Not joining that exchange event is his greatest regret.

sentences.chinese: 结果虽然有些遗憾，但过程让我们学到了很多。
sentences.traditional: 結果雖然有些遺憾，但過程讓我們學到了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéguǒ suīrán yǒuxiē yíhàn, dàn guòchéng ràng wǒmen xué dào le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: Although the result was somewhat regrettable, the process taught us a lot.

sentences.chinese: 我们一路走到山顶，看到的风景越来越开阔。
sentences.traditional: 我們一路走到山頂，看到的風景越來越開闊。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yílù zǒu dào shāndǐng, kàn dào de fēngjǐng yuè lái yuè kāikuò.
sentences.translation: We walked all the way to the mountaintop, and the scenery became wider and wider.

sentences.chinese: 从机场到市中心，他一路都在介绍当地特色。
sentences.traditional: 從機場到市中心，他一路都在介紹當地特色。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng jīchǎng dào shì zhōngxīn, tā yílù dōu zài jièshào dāngdì tèsè.
sentences.translation: From the airport to the city centre, he introduced local features throughout the journey.

sentences.chinese: 感谢你一路支持这个项目。
sentences.traditional: 感謝你一路支持這個項目。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎnxiè nǐ yílù zhīchí zhège xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: Thank you for supporting this project all along.

sentences.chinese: 明天你就要出发了，祝你一路顺风。
sentences.traditional: 明天你就要出發了，祝你一路順風。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ jiù yào chūfā le, zhù nǐ yílù-shùnfēng.
sentences.translation: You are setting off tomorrow; have a safe trip.

sentences.chinese: 朋友去国外实习前，我们一起祝他一路顺风。
sentences.traditional: 朋友去國外實習前，我們一起祝他一路順風。
sentences.pinyin: Péngyou qù guówài shíxí qián, wǒmen yìqǐ zhù tā yílù-shùnfēng.
sentences.translation: Before our friend went abroad for an internship, we wished him a safe trip together.

sentences.chinese: 送别同事时，经理说：“一路顺风，到了以后记得联系。”
sentences.traditional: 送別同事時，經理說：「一路順風，到了以後記得聯繫。」
sentences.pinyin: Sòngbié tóngshì shí, jīnglǐ shuō: “Yílù-shùnfēng, dào le yǐhòu jìde liánxì.”
sentences.translation: When seeing off a colleague, the manager said, “Have a safe trip, and remember to get in touch after you arrive.”

sentences.chinese: 如果你对合同内容有疑问，可以先咨询律师。
sentences.traditional: 如果你對合約內容有疑問，可以先諮詢律師。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ duì hétong nèiróng yǒu yíwèn, kěyǐ xiān zīxún lǜshī.
sentences.translation: If you have questions about the contract content, you can consult a lawyer first.

sentences.chinese: 老师耐心回答了学生提出的每个疑问。
sentences.traditional: 老師耐心回答了學生提出的每個疑問。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī nàixīn huídá le xuéshēng tíchū de měi ge yíwèn.
sentences.translation: The teacher patiently answered every question raised by the students.

sentences.chinese: 这个数据来源不清楚，难免让人产生疑问。
sentences.traditional: 這個資料來源不清楚，難免讓人產生疑問。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shùjù láiyuán bù qīngchu, nánmiǎn ràng rén chǎnshēng yíwèn.
sentences.translation: The source of this data is unclear, so it inevitably raises doubts.

sentences.chinese: 双方在基本原则上保持一致。
sentences.traditional: 雙方在基本原則上保持一致。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zài jīběn yuánzé shàng bǎochí yízhì.
sentences.translation: Both sides remained consistent on the basic principles.

sentences.chinese: 专家们的意见并不完全一致。
sentences.traditional: 專家們的意見並不完全一致。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiāmen de yìjiàn bìng bù wánquán yízhì.
sentences.translation: The experts’ opinions are not completely unanimous.

sentences.chinese: 他的说法和调查结果基本一致。
sentences.traditional: 他的說法和調查結果基本一致。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shuōfǎ hé diàochá jiéguǒ jīběn yízhì.
sentences.translation: His statement is basically consistent with the investigation results.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同中，乙方负责提供设备。
sentences.traditional: 這份合約中，乙方負責提供設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong zhōng, yǐfāng fùzé tígōng shèbèi.
sentences.translation: In this contract, Party B is responsible for providing the equipment.

sentences.chinese: 请在选择题中把答案写在乙处。
sentences.traditional: 請在選擇題中把答案寫在乙處。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài xuǎnzétí zhōng bǎ dá’àn xiě zài yǐ chù.
sentences.translation: Please write the answer in position B in the multiple-choice question.

sentences.chinese: 甲组先发言，乙组随后补充意见。
sentences.traditional: 甲組先發言，乙組隨後補充意見。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎ zǔ xiān fāyán, yǐ zǔ suíhòu bǔchōng yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Group A speaks first, and Group B adds comments afterwards.

sentences.chinese: 我们以调查结果为依据。
sentences.traditional: 我們以調查結果為依據。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐ diàochá jiéguǒ wéi yījù.
sentences.translation: We use the investigation results as the basis.

sentences.chinese: 会议以线上形式举行。
sentences.traditional: 會議以線上形式舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yǐ xiànshàng xíngshì jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: The meeting is held in an online format.

sentences.chinese: 他努力学习，以取得更好的成绩。
sentences.traditional: 他努力學習，以取得更好的成績。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǔlì xuéxí, yǐ qǔdé gèng hǎo de chéngjì.
sentences.translation: He studies hard in order to achieve better results.

sentences.chinese: 会议讨论了预算以及人员安排。
sentences.traditional: 會議討論了預算以及人員安排。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì tǎolùn le yùsuàn yǐjí rényuán ānpái.
sentences.translation: The meeting discussed the budget as well as personnel arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告包括数据以及专家意见。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告包括資料以及專家意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào bāokuò shùjù yǐjí zhuānjiā yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: This report includes data as well as expert opinions.

sentences.chinese: 请提交身份证明以及相关文件。
sentences.traditional: 請提交身分證明以及相關文件。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng tíjiāo shēnfèn zhèngmíng yǐjí xiāngguān wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please submit proof of identity and the relevant documents.

sentences.chinese: 改革以来，城市发生了巨大变化。
sentences.traditional: 改革以來，城市發生了巨大變化。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎigé yǐlái, chéngshì fāshēng le jùdà biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Since the reform, the city has undergone huge changes.

sentences.chinese: 三年以来，他一直在研究这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 三年以來，他一直在研究這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: Sān nián yǐlái, tā yìzhí zài yánjiū zhège wèntí.
sentences.translation: For the past three years, he has been researching this issue.

sentences.chinese: 公司成立以来，业务发展很快。
sentences.traditional: 公司成立以來，業務發展很快。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī chénglì yǐlái, yèwù fāzhǎn hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: Since the company was founded, its business has developed quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目的投资超过十亿人民币。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目的投資超過十億人民幣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de tóuzī chāoguò shí yì rénmínbì.
sentences.translation: The investment in this project exceeds one billion yuan.

sentences.chinese: 全球有几十亿人使用网络。
sentences.traditional: 全球有幾十億人使用網絡。
sentences.pinyin: Quánqiú yǒu jǐ shí yì rén shǐyòng wǎngluò.
sentences.translation: Billions of people around the world use the internet.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司去年的销售额达到二十亿。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司去年的銷售額達到二十億。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī qùnián de xiāoshòu’é dádào èrshí yì.
sentences.translation: This company’s sales revenue last year reached two billion.

sentences.chinese: 他逐渐意识到健康的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 他逐漸意識到健康的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhújiàn yìshí dào jiànkāng de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: He gradually realised the importance of health.

sentences.chinese: 这次事故提高了大家的安全意识。
sentences.traditional: 這次事故提高了大家的安全意識。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù tígāo le dàjiā de ānquán yìshí.
sentences.translation: This accident raised everyone’s safety awareness.

sentences.chinese: 经理没有意识到这个决定会影响员工。
sentences.traditional: 經理沒有意識到這個決定會影響員工。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ méiyǒu yìshí dào zhège juédìng huì yǐngxiǎng yuángōng.
sentences.translation: The manager did not realise that this decision would affect the employees.

sentences.chinese: 这个结果让所有人都感到意外。
sentences.traditional: 這個結果讓所有人都感到意外。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu gǎndào yìwài.
sentences.translation: This result made everyone feel surprised.

sentences.chinese: 他在路上遇到了一场意外。
sentences.traditional: 他在路上遇到了一場意外。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài lù shàng yùdào le yì chǎng yìwài.
sentences.translation: He had an accident on the road.

sentences.chinese: 意外的是，销量比预期高很多。
sentences.traditional: 意外的是，銷量比預期高很多。
sentences.pinyin: Yìwài de shì, xiāoliàng bǐ yùqī gāo hěn duō.
sentences.translation: Unexpectedly, the sales volume was much higher than expected.

sentences.chinese: 价格上涨意味着成本也在增加。
sentences.traditional: 價格上漲意味著成本也在增加。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé shàngzhǎng yìwèizhe chéngběn yě zài zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: A rise in prices means that costs are also increasing.

sentences.chinese: 选择这条路意味着要承担更多责任。
sentences.traditional: 選擇這條路意味著要承擔更多責任。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnzé zhè tiáo lù yìwèizhe yào chéngdān gèng duō zérèn.
sentences.translation: Choosing this path means taking on more responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 成功不意味着不会再遇到困难。
sentences.traditional: 成功不意味著不會再遇到困難。
sentences.pinyin: Chénggōng bù yìwèizhe bù huì zài yùdào kùnnan.
sentences.translation: Success does not mean that you will not encounter difficulties again.

sentences.chinese: 每位市民都有遵守法律的义务。
sentences.traditional: 每位市民都有遵守法律的義務。
sentences.pinyin: Měi wèi shìmín dōu yǒu zūnshǒu fǎlǜ de yìwù.
sentences.translation: Every citizen has a duty to obey the law.

sentences.chinese: 这项工作属于义务服务，没有工资。
sentences.traditional: 這項工作屬於義務服務，沒有工資。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò shǔyú yìwù fúwù, méiyǒu gōngzī.
sentences.translation: This work is voluntary service and has no salary.

sentences.chinese: 企业有保护消费者信息的义务。
sentences.traditional: 企業有保護消費者信息的義務。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yǒu bǎohù xiāofèizhě xìnxī de yìwù.
sentences.translation: Companies have an obligation to protect consumers’ information.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动对当地社区有重要意义。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動對當地社區有重要意義。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng duì dāngdì shèqū yǒu zhòngyào yìyì.
sentences.translation: This event has important significance for the local community.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要了解这个词的真正意义。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要了解這個詞的真正意義。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào liǎojiě zhège cí de zhēnzhèng yìyì.
sentences.translation: We need to understand the true meaning of this word.

sentences.chinese: 只看成绩而不看过程，意义并不大。
sentences.traditional: 只看成績而不看過程，意義並不大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ kàn chéngjì ér bù kàn guòchéng, yìyì bìng bù dà.
sentences.translation: If you only look at results and not the process, the significance is not great.

sentences.chinese: 公司没有及时调整策略，因而失去了部分市场。
sentences.traditional: 公司沒有及時調整策略，因而失去了部分市場。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī méiyǒu jíshí tiáozhěng cèlüè, yīn’ér shīqù le bùfen shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: The company did not adjust its strategy in time, and therefore lost part of the market.

sentences.chinese: 天气突然升温，因而用电需求明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 天氣突然升溫，因而用電需求明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tūrán shēngwēn, yīn’ér yòngdiàn xūqiú míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: The weather suddenly heated up, so demand for electricity increased noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 他长期缺少训练，因而体力下降得很快。
sentences.traditional: 他長期缺少訓練，因而體力下降得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángqī quēshǎo xùnliàn, yīn’ér tǐlì xiàjiàng de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: He lacked training for a long time, and as a result his physical strength declined quickly.

sentences.chinese: 请把电视的音量调低一点，孩子已经睡了。
sentences.traditional: 請把電視的音量調低一點，孩子已經睡了。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ diànshì de yīnliàng tiáo dī yìdiǎn, háizi yǐjīng shuì le.
sentences.translation: Please turn down the television volume a little; the child is already asleep.

sentences.chinese: 会议室里的音量太小，后排的人听不清楚。
sentences.traditional: 會議室裡的音量太小，後排的人聽不清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì lǐ de yīnliàng tài xiǎo, hòupái de rén tīng bu qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The volume in the meeting room is too low, so people in the back row cannot hear clearly.

sentences.chinese: 手机提示音的音量可以在系统设置里调整。
sentences.traditional: 手機提示音的音量可以在系統設定裡調整。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī tíshìyīn de yīnliàng kěyǐ zài xìtǒng shèdìng lǐ tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: The volume of the phone notification sound can be adjusted in the system settings.

sentences.chinese: 价格不是消费者做决定的唯一因素。
sentences.traditional: 價格不是消費者做決定的唯一因素。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé bú shì xiāofèizhě zuò juédìng de wéiyī yīnsù.
sentences.translation: Price is not the only factor in consumers’ decisions.

sentences.chinese: 影响睡眠质量的因素有很多。
sentences.traditional: 影響睡眠質量的因素有很多。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngxiǎng shuìmián zhìliàng de yīnsù yǒu hěn duō.
sentences.translation: There are many factors that affect sleep quality.

sentences.chinese: 文化差异也是合作中需要考虑的重要因素。
sentences.traditional: 文化差異也是合作中需要考慮的重要因素。
sentences.pinyin: Wénhuà chāyì yě shì hézuò zhōng xūyào kǎolǜ de zhòngyào yīnsù.
sentences.translation: Cultural differences are also an important factor to consider in cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 学校计划引进一套新的教学系统。
sentences.traditional: 學校計劃引進一套新的教學系統。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jìhuà yǐnjìn yí tào xīn de jiàoxué xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: The school plans to introduce a new teaching system.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司从国外引进了先进设备。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司從國外引進了先進設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī cóng guówài yǐnjìn le xiānjìn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This company introduced advanced equipment from abroad.

sentences.chinese: 城市发展不能只靠引进资金，还要培养人才。
sentences.traditional: 城市發展不能只靠引進資金，還要培養人才。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì fāzhǎn bù néng zhǐ kào yǐnjìn zījīn, hái yào péiyǎng réncái.
sentences.translation: Urban development cannot rely only on bringing in capital; it must also cultivate talent.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他改善饮食，少吃油炸食品。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他改善飲食，少吃油炸食品。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā gǎishàn yǐnshí, shǎo chī yóuzhá shípǐn.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to improve his diet and eat less fried food.

sentences.chinese: 不同地区的饮食习惯差别很大。
sentences.traditional: 不同地區的飲食習慣差別很大。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng dìqū de yǐnshí xíguàn chābié hěn dà.
sentences.translation: Dietary habits vary greatly between different regions.

sentences.chinese: 保持合理的饮食有助于提高身体免疫力。
sentences.traditional: 保持合理的飲食有助於提高身體免疫力。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎochí hélǐ de yǐnshí yǒuzhù yú tígāo shēntǐ miǎnyìlì.
sentences.translation: Maintaining a reasonable diet helps improve the body’s immunity.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的封面印刷得很精美。
sentences.traditional: 這本書的封面印刷得很精美。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de fēngmiàn yìnshuā de hěn jīngměi.
sentences.translation: The cover of this book is printed very beautifully.

sentences.chinese: 请确认文件没有错误以后再印刷。
sentences.traditional: 請確認文件沒有錯誤以後再印刷。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng quèrèn wénjiàn méiyǒu cuòwù yǐhòu zài yìnshuā.
sentences.translation: Please confirm that the document has no errors before printing it.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂主要负责教材的印刷工作。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠主要負責教材的印刷工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhǔyào fùzé jiàocái de yìnshuā gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: This factory is mainly responsible for printing textbooks.

sentences.chinese: 遇到危险时，我们应当先保护自己的安全。
sentences.traditional: 遇到危險時，我們應當先保護自己的安全。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào wēixiǎn shí, wǒmen yīngdāng xiān bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán.
sentences.translation: When facing danger, we should first protect our own safety.

sentences.chinese: 企业应当依法保护消费者的个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 企業應當依法保護消費者的個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīngdāng yīfǎ bǎohù xiāofèizhě de gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Companies should protect consumers’ personal information according to the law.

sentences.chinese: 学生应当按时提交实验报告。
sentences.traditional: 學生應當按時提交實驗報告。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēng yīngdāng ànshí tíjiāo shíyàn bàogào.
sentences.translation: Students should submit their experiment reports on time.

sentences.chinese: 学校在门口迎新生和家长。
sentences.traditional: 學校在門口迎新生和家長。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zài ménkǒu yíng xīnshēng hé jiāzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The school welcomes new students and parents at the gate.

sentences.chinese: 大家站在车站外迎代表团到来。
sentences.traditional: 大家站在車站外迎代表團到來。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā zhàn zài chēzhàn wài yíng dàibiǎotuán dàolái.
sentences.translation: Everyone stood outside the station to welcome the delegation’s arrival.

sentences.chinese: 公司准备举办活动迎新员工。
sentences.traditional: 公司準備舉辦活動迎新員工。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhǔnbèi jǔbàn huódòng yíng xīn yuángōng.
sentences.translation: The company is preparing to hold an event to welcome new employees.

sentences.chinese: 机场安排工作人员迎接外国客人。
sentences.traditional: 機場安排工作人員迎接外國客人。
sentences.pinyin: Jīchǎng ānpái gōngzuò rényuán yíngjiē wàiguó kèrén.
sentences.translation: The airport arranged staff to welcome the foreign guests.

sentences.chinese: 为了迎接新的挑战，团队提前做了准备。
sentences.traditional: 為了迎接新的挑戰，團隊提前做了準備。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile yíngjiē xīn de tiǎozhàn, tuánduì tíqián zuò le zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: To meet the new challenge, the team made preparations in advance.

sentences.chinese: 全校师生一起迎接校庆的到来。
sentences.traditional: 全校師生一起迎接校慶的到來。
sentences.pinyin: Quánxiào shīshēng yìqǐ yíngjiē xiàoqìng de dàolái.
sentences.translation: Teachers and students across the whole school welcomed the arrival of the school anniversary together.

sentences.chinese: 这种蔬菜含有丰富的营养。
sentences.traditional: 這種蔬菜含有豐富的營養。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shūcài hányǒu fēngfù de yíngyǎng.
sentences.translation: This kind of vegetable contains rich nutrition.

sentences.chinese: 孩子生长发育需要均衡的营养。
sentences.traditional: 孩子生長發育需要均衡的營養。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi shēngzhǎng fāyù xūyào jūnhéng de yíngyǎng.
sentences.translation: Children need balanced nutrition for growth and development.

sentences.chinese: 长期饮食不规律可能会影响营养吸收。
sentences.traditional: 長期飲食不規律可能會影響營養吸收。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī yǐnshí bù guīlǜ kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng yíngyǎng xīshōu.
sentences.translation: Irregular eating over a long period may affect nutrient absorption.

sentences.chinese: 这家药店二十四小时营业，夜间也可以买到药品。
sentences.traditional: 這家藥店二十四小時營業，夜間也可以買到藥品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yàodiàn èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè, yèjiān yě kěyǐ mǎi dào yàopǐn.
sentences.translation: This pharmacy is open 24 hours, so medicine can also be bought at night.

sentences.chinese: 受天气影响，景区今天暂停营业。
sentences.traditional: 受天氣影響，景區今天暫停營業。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng, jǐngqū jīntiān zàntíng yíngyè.
sentences.translation: Due to the weather, the scenic area has stopped operating today.

sentences.chinese: 商场延长营业时间，方便下班后的顾客购物。
sentences.traditional: 商場延長營業時間，方便下班後的顧客購物。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngchǎng yáncháng yíngyè shíjiān, fāngbiàn xiàbān hòu de gùkè gòuwù.
sentences.translation: The shopping centre extended its opening hours to make shopping easier for customers after work.

sentences.chinese: 这部影片反映了普通人的真实生活。
sentences.traditional: 這部影片反映了普通人的真實生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù yǐngpiàn fǎnyìng le pǔtōng rén de zhēnshí shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This film reflects the real lives of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 影片结束后，观众还在讨论它的深刻意义。
sentences.traditional: 影片結束後，觀眾還在討論它的深刻意義。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngpiàn jiéshù hòu, guānzhòng hái zài tǎolùn tā de shēnkè yìyì.
sentences.translation: After the film ended, the audience was still discussing its profound meaning.

sentences.chinese: 这家网站提供很多高清影片下载。
sentences.traditional: 這家網站提供很多高清影片下載。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā wǎngzhàn tígōng hěn duō gāoqīng yǐngpiàn xiàzài.
sentences.translation: This website provides downloads of many high-definition films.

sentences.chinese: 影视行业的发展受到网络技术的推动。
sentences.traditional: 影視行業的發展受到網絡技術的推動。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngshì hángyè de fāzhǎn shòu dào wǎngluò jìshù de tuīdòng.
sentences.translation: The development of the film and television industry is driven by network technology.

sentences.chinese: 他大学学的是影视制作，毕业后进了电视台。
sentences.traditional: 他大學學的是影視製作，畢業後進了電視臺。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué xué de shì yǐngshì zhìzuò, bìyè hòu jìn le diànshìtái.
sentences.translation: He studied film and television production at university and entered a TV station after graduating.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市正在建设新的影视基地。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市正在建設新的影視基地。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì zhèngzài jiànshè xīn de yǐngshì jīdì.
sentences.translation: This city is building a new film and television base.

sentences.chinese: 这把椅子太硬，坐久了腰会疼。
sentences.traditional: 這把椅子太硬，坐久了腰會疼。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yǐzi tài yìng, zuò jiǔ le yāo huì téng.
sentences.translation: This chair is too hard; if you sit on it for long, your waist will hurt.

sentences.chinese: 他硬把所有行李塞进了小箱子里。
sentences.traditional: 他硬把所有行李塞進了小箱子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìng bǎ suǒyǒu xíngli sāi jìn le xiǎo xiāngzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: He forced all the luggage into the small suitcase.

sentences.chinese: 面包放了几天，已经变硬了。
sentences.traditional: 麵包放了幾天，已經變硬了。
sentences.pinyin: Miànbāo fàng le jǐ tiān, yǐjīng biàn yìng le.
sentences.translation: The bread has been left for a few days and has already gone hard.

sentences.chinese: 面对突发事件，政府需要迅速应对。
sentences.traditional: 面對突發事件，政府需要迅速應對。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā shìjiàn, zhèngfǔ xūyào xùnsù yìngduì.
sentences.translation: When facing a sudden incident, the government needs to respond quickly.

sentences.chinese: 公司制定了方案来应对物价上涨。
sentences.traditional: 公司制定了方案來應對物價上漲。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhìdìng le fāng’àn lái yìngduì wùjià shàngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The company made a plan to deal with rising prices.

sentences.chinese: 他经验丰富，能够冷静应对客户的投诉。
sentences.traditional: 他經驗豐富，能夠冷靜應對客戶的投訴。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīngyàn fēngfù, nénggòu lěngjìng yìngduì kèhù de tóusù.
sentences.translation: He is experienced and can calmly handle customer complaints.

sentences.chinese: 这台电脑的硬件已经无法支持新系统。
sentences.traditional: 這臺電腦的硬件已經無法支持新系統。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo de yìngjiàn yǐjīng wúfǎ zhīchí xīn xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: This computer’s hardware can no longer support the new system.

sentences.chinese: 升级软件之前，先检查硬件是否符合要求。
sentences.traditional: 升級軟件之前，先檢查硬件是否符合要求。
sentences.pinyin: Shēngjí ruǎnjiàn zhīqián, xiān jiǎnchá yìngjiàn shìfǒu fúhé yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: Before upgrading the software, first check whether the hardware meets the requirements.

sentences.chinese: 硬件成本下降以后，小型设备的售价也降低了。
sentences.traditional: 硬件成本下降以後，小型設備的售價也降低了。
sentences.pinyin: Yìngjiàn chéngběn xiàjiàng yǐhòu, xiǎoxíng shèbèi de shòujià yě jiàngdī le.
sentences.translation: After hardware costs fell, the selling price of small devices also dropped.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术已经应用到医疗领域。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術已經應用到醫療領域。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù yǐjīng yìngyòng dào yīliáo lǐngyù.
sentences.translation: This technology has already been applied in the field of medical treatment.

sentences.chinese: 这个专业重视知识的实际应用。
sentences.traditional: 這個專業重視知識的實際應用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhuānyè zhòngshì zhīshi de shíjì yìngyòng.
sentences.translation: This subject values the practical application of knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 手机应用太多，会占用大量存储空间。
sentences.traditional: 手機應用太多，會佔用大量儲存空間。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī yìngyòng tài duō, huì zhànyòng dàliàng cúnchǔ kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: Too many mobile apps will take up a large amount of storage space.

sentences.chinese: 久别重逢时，他们激动地拥抱在一起。
sentences.traditional: 久別重逢時，他們激動地擁抱在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔbié chóngféng shí, tāmen jīdòng de yōngbào zài yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: When they reunited after a long separation, they hugged each other excitedly.

sentences.chinese: 她给了孩子一个温暖的拥抱。
sentences.traditional: 她給了孩子一個溫暖的擁抱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi le háizi yí ge wēnnuǎn de yōngbào.
sentences.translation: She gave the child a warm hug.

sentences.chinese: 面对变化，我们要学会拥抱新的机会。
sentences.traditional: 面對變化，我們要學會擁抱新的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì biànhuà, wǒmen yào xuéhuì yōngbào xīn de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: In the face of change, we must learn to embrace new opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 拥有稳定的心态比一时的胜利更重要。
sentences.traditional: 擁有穩定的心態比一時的勝利更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yōngyǒu wěndìng de xīntài bǐ yìshí de shènglì gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Having a stable mindset is more important than a temporary victory.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司拥有先进的生产设备。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司擁有先進的生產設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yōngyǒu xiānjìn de shēngchǎn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This company has advanced production equipment.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都希望拥有被信任的感觉。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都希望擁有被信任的感覺。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu xīwàng yōngyǒu bèi xìnrèn de gǎnjué.
sentences.translation: Everyone hopes to have the feeling of being trusted.

sentences.chinese: 承认自己的失误需要很大的勇气。
sentences.traditional: 承認自己的失誤需要很大的勇氣。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngrèn zìjǐ de shīwù xūyào hěn dà de yǒngqì.
sentences.translation: Admitting one’s own mistake requires great courage.

sentences.chinese: 她鼓起勇气向老师提出了疑问。
sentences.traditional: 她鼓起勇氣向老師提出了疑問。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǔ qǐ yǒngqì xiàng lǎoshī tíchū le yíwèn.
sentences.translation: She gathered the courage to raise a question with the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难时，勇气和方法同样重要。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難時，勇氣和方法同樣重要。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan shí, yǒngqì hé fāngfǎ tóngyàng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When facing difficulties, courage and method are equally important.

sentences.chinese: 这个词的用法比较固定，不能随意改变。
sentences.traditional: 這個詞的用法比較固定，不能隨意改變。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cí de yòngfǎ bǐjiào gùdìng, bù néng suíyì gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: The usage of this word is quite fixed and cannot be changed casually.

sentences.chinese: 老师通过例句解释了这个语法点的用法。
sentences.traditional: 老師通過例句解釋了這個語法點的用法。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tōngguò lìjù jiěshì le zhège yǔfǎ diǎn de yòngfǎ.
sentences.translation: The teacher explained the usage of this grammar point through example sentences.

sentences.chinese: 说明书上写清楚了药品的正确用法。
sentences.traditional: 說明書上寫清楚了藥品的正確用法。
sentences.pinyin: Shuōmíngshū shàng xiě qīngchu le yàopǐn de zhèngquè yòngfǎ.
sentences.translation: The instructions clearly state the correct method of using the medicine.

sentences.chinese: 新系统上线后，用户数量迅速增加。
sentences.traditional: 新系統上線後，用戶數量迅速增加。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng shàngxiàn hòu, yònghù shùliàng xùnsù zēngjiā.
