sentences.translation: After the new system went online, the number of users increased rapidly.

sentences.chinese: 公司通过问卷了解用户的真实需求。
sentences.traditional: 公司通過問卷了解用戶的真實需求。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī tōngguò wènjuàn liǎojiě yònghù de zhēnshí xūqiú.
sentences.translation: The company used a questionnaire to understand users’ real needs.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护用户隐私，平台加强了安全管理。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護用戶隱私，平臺加強了安全管理。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù yònghù yǐnsī, píngtái jiāqiáng le ānquán guǎnlǐ.
sentences.translation: To protect users’ privacy, the platform strengthened security management.

sentences.chinese: 门被锁住了，他用力推也推不开。
sentences.traditional: 門被鎖住了，他用力推也推不開。
sentences.pinyin: Mén bèi suǒ zhù le, tā yònglì tuī yě tuī bu kāi.
sentences.translation: The door was locked; even when he pushed hard, he could not open it.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他运动时不要过分用力。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他運動時不要過分用力。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā yùndòng shí bú yào guòfèn yònglì.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him not to use too much force when exercising.

sentences.chinese: 她用力握住我的手，表示感谢。
sentences.traditional: 她用力握住我的手，表示感謝。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yònglì wò zhù wǒ de shǒu, biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
sentences.translation: She held my hand firmly to express her thanks.

sentences.chinese: 出差前，他准备好了所有日常用品。
sentences.traditional: 出差前，他準備好了所有日常用品。
sentences.pinyin: Chūchāi qián, tā zhǔnbèi hǎo le suǒyǒu rìcháng yòngpǐn.
sentences.translation: Before the business trip, he prepared all his daily-use items.

sentences.chinese: 学校统一购买了实验室用品。
sentences.traditional: 學校統一購買了實驗室用品。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào tǒngyī gòumǎi le shíyànshì yòngpǐn.
sentences.translation: The school bought laboratory supplies in a unified way.

sentences.chinese: 这些儿童用品必须符合安全标准。
sentences.traditional: 這些兒童用品必須符合安全標準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē értóng yòngpǐn bìxū fúhé ānquán biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: These children’s products must meet safety standards.

sentences.chinese: 这种材料用途广泛，可以用于建筑和医疗。
sentences.traditional: 這種材料用途廣泛，可以用於建築和醫療。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào yòngtú guǎngfàn, kěyǐ yòng yú jiànzhù hé yīliáo.
sentences.translation: This material has a wide range of uses and can be used in construction and medical treatment.

sentences.chinese: 购买设备之前，先要明确它的用途。
sentences.traditional: 購買設備之前，先要明確它的用途。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi shèbèi zhīqián, xiān yào míngquè tā de yòngtú.
sentences.translation: Before buying equipment, you must first clarify its purpose.

sentences.chinese: 老师让学生说明这个工具的实际用途。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓學生說明這個工具的實際用途。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng xuéshēng shuōmíng zhège gōngjù de shíjì yòngtú.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the students to explain the practical use of this tool.

sentences.chinese: 会员可以享受更多优惠服务。
sentences.traditional: 會員可以享受更多優惠服務。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyuán kěyǐ xiǎngshòu gèng duō yōuhuì fúwù.
sentences.translation: Members can enjoy more preferential services.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅周末推出了优惠套餐。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳週末推出了優惠套餐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zhōumò tuīchū le yōuhuì tàocān.
sentences.translation: This restaurant launched a discounted set meal at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 如果提前报名，学费会有一定优惠。
sentences.traditional: 如果提前報名，學費會有一定優惠。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tíqián bàomíng, xuéfèi huì yǒu yídìng yōuhuì.
sentences.translation: If you register in advance, there will be a certain discount on the tuition fee.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市拥有悠久的历史和独特的文化。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市擁有悠久的歷史和獨特的文化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yōngyǒu yōujiǔ de lìshǐ hé dútè de wénhuà.
sentences.translation: This city has a long history and unique culture.

sentences.chinese: 中国书法是一门历史悠久的艺术。
sentences.traditional: 中國書法是一門歷史悠久的藝術。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó shūfǎ shì yì mén lìshǐ yōujiǔ de yìshù.
sentences.translation: Chinese calligraphy is an art with a long history.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学以悠久的学术传统而闻名。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學以悠久的學術傳統而聞名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǐ yōujiǔ de xuéshù chuántǒng ér wénmíng.
sentences.translation: This university is famous for its long academic tradition.

sentences.chinese: 这种作物具有优良的生长特征。
sentences.traditional: 這種作物具有優良的生長特徵。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zuòwù jùyǒu yōuliáng de shēngzhǎng tèzhēng.
sentences.translation: This crop has excellent growth characteristics.

sentences.chinese: 企业要保持优良的产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 企業要保持優良的產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yào bǎochí yōuliáng de chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: An enterprise must maintain excellent product quality.

sentences.chinese: 这支团队形成了优良的工作作风。
sentences.traditional: 這支團隊形成了優良的工作作風。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī tuánduì xíngchéng le yōuliáng de gōngzuò zuòfēng.
sentences.translation: This team has formed an excellent work style.

sentences.chinese: 湖边的风景十分优美，吸引了很多游客。
sentences.traditional: 湖邊的風景十分優美，吸引了很多遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Húbiān de fēngjǐng shífēn yōuměi, xīyǐn le hěn duō yóukè.
sentences.translation: The scenery by the lake is very beautiful and attracts many tourists.

sentences.chinese: 她的舞蹈动作自然优美。
sentences.traditional: 她的舞蹈動作自然優美。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de wǔdǎo dòngzuò zìrán yōuměi.
sentences.translation: Her dance movements are natural and graceful.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章语言优美，思想也很深刻。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章語言優美，思想也很深刻。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng yǔyán yōuměi, sīxiǎng yě hěn shēnkè.
sentences.translation: This article has beautiful language and also profound ideas.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司在技术方面具有明显优势。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司在技術方面具有明顯優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zài jìshù fāngmiàn jùyǒu míngxiǎn yōushì.
sentences.translation: This company has an obvious advantage in technology.

sentences.chinese: 充分发挥本地特色，是这个项目的优势。
sentences.traditional: 充分發揮本地特色，是這個項目的優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Chōngfèn fāhuī běndì tèsè, shì zhège xiàngmù de yōushì.
sentences.translation: Making full use of local characteristics is the advantage of this project.

sentences.chinese: 面对激烈竞争，企业必须保持自己的优势。
sentences.traditional: 面對激烈競爭，企業必須保持自己的優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jīliè jìngzhēng, qǐyè bìxū bǎochí zìjǐ de yōushì.
sentences.translation: Facing fierce competition, an enterprise must maintain its own advantages.

sentences.chinese: 这家店只销售优质的本地特产。
sentences.traditional: 這家店只銷售優質的本地特產。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhǐ xiāoshòu yōuzhì de běndì tèchǎn.
sentences.translation: This shop only sells high-quality local specialities.

sentences.chinese: 优质服务能提高消费者的信任。
sentences.traditional: 優質服務能提高消費者的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Yōuzhì fúwù néng tígāo xiāofèizhě de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: High-quality service can increase consumers’ trust.

sentences.chinese: 企业要通过稳定生产提供优质产品。
sentences.traditional: 企業要通過穩定生產提供優質產品。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yào tōngguò wěndìng shēngchǎn tígōng yōuzhì chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: Enterprises should provide high-quality products through stable production.

sentences.chinese: 由此可见，数据分析对决策非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 由此可見，數據分析對決策非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yóucǐ kějiàn, shùjù fēnxī duì juécè fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: From this it can be seen that data analysis is very important for decision-making.

sentences.chinese: 他们加强了训练，由此提高了工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 他們加強了訓練，由此提高了工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jiāqiáng le xùnliàn, yóucǐ tígāo le gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: They strengthened their training and thus improved work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 这次事件显示了管理问题，由此引起了大家的思考。
sentences.traditional: 這次事件顯示了管理問題，由此引起了大家的思考。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiàn xiǎnshì le guǎnlǐ wèntí, yóucǐ yǐnqǐ le dàjiā de sīkǎo.
sentences.translation: This incident revealed management problems, thereby prompting everyone to think.

sentences.chinese: 请把合同通过邮寄的方式发送给我。
sentences.traditional: 請把合同通過郵寄的方式發送給我。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hétong tōngguò yóujì de fāngshì fāsòng gěi wǒ.
sentences.translation: Please send the contract to me by mail.

sentences.chinese: 这些药品不能随便邮寄到国外。
sentences.traditional: 這些藥品不能隨便郵寄到國外。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē yàopǐn bù néng suíbiàn yóujì dào guówài.
sentences.translation: These medicines cannot simply be mailed abroad.

sentences.chinese: 你可以在网上填写地址，然后选择邮寄服务。
sentences.traditional: 你可以在網上填寫地址，然後選擇郵寄服務。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài wǎngshàng tiánxiě dìzhǐ, ránhòu xuǎnzé yóujì fúwù.
sentences.translation: You can fill in the address online and then choose the mailing service.

sentences.chinese: 邮局离我家很近，步行五分钟就到。
sentences.traditional: 郵局離我家很近，步行五分鐘就到。
sentences.pinyin: Yóujú lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn, bùxíng wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào.
sentences.translation: The post office is very close to my home; it takes five minutes to walk there.

sentences.chinese: 他去邮局取一封重要的信。
sentences.traditional: 他去郵局取一封重要的信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qù yóujú qǔ yì fēng zhòngyào de xìn.
sentences.translation: He went to the post office to collect an important letter.

sentences.chinese: 如果要寄国际包裹，最好先问邮局的工作人员。
sentences.traditional: 如果要寄國際包裹，最好先問郵局的工作人員。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yào jì guójì bāoguǒ, zuìhǎo xiān wèn yóujú de gōngzuò rényuán.
sentences.translation: If you want to send an international parcel, it is best to ask the post office staff first.

sentences.chinese: 我们计划明天游览这座古老的城市。
sentences.traditional: 我們計劃明天遊覽這座古老的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà míngtiān yóulǎn zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì.
sentences.translation: We plan to tour this ancient city tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 游览博物馆时，请不要触摸展品。
sentences.traditional: 遊覽博物館時，請不要觸摸展品。
sentences.pinyin: Yóulǎn bówùguǎn shí, qǐng bú yào chùmō zhǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: When visiting the museum, please do not touch the exhibits.

sentences.chinese: 导游介绍了几条适合步行游览的线路。
sentences.traditional: 導遊介紹了幾條適合步行遊覽的線路。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyóu jièshào le jǐ tiáo shìhé bùxíng yóulǎn de xiànlù.
sentences.translation: The tour guide introduced several routes suitable for touring on foot.

sentences.chinese: 这张邮票的设计很有时代特色。
sentences.traditional: 這張郵票的設計很有時代特色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yóupiào de shèjì hěn yǒu shídài tèsè.
sentences.translation: The design of this stamp has a strong character of the times.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷年轻时喜欢收集各种邮票。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺年輕時喜歡收集各種郵票。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye niánqīng shí xǐhuān shōují gèzhǒng yóupiào.
sentences.translation: When Grandpa was young, he liked collecting all kinds of stamps.

sentences.chinese: 信封上少贴了一张邮票，所以被退回来了。
sentences.traditional: 信封上少貼了一張郵票，所以被退回來了。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnfēng shàng shǎo tiē le yì zhāng yóupiào, suǒyǐ bèi tuì huí lai le.
sentences.translation: One stamp was missing from the envelope, so it was sent back.

sentences.chinese: 早餐店的豆浆和油条很受欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 早餐店的豆漿和油條很受歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎocān diàn de dòujiāng hé yóutiáo hěn shòu huānyíng.
sentences.translation: The breakfast shop’s soya milk and fried dough sticks are very popular.

sentences.chinese: 他偶尔会买一根油条当早餐。
sentences.traditional: 他偶爾會買一根油條當早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ǒu'ěr huì mǎi yì gēn yóutiáo dāng zǎocān.
sentences.translation: He occasionally buys a fried dough stick for breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，油条虽然好吃，但不能天天吃。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，油條雖然好吃，但不能天天吃。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, yóutiáo suīrán hǎochī, dàn bù néng tiāntiān chī.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him that although fried dough sticks are tasty, he should not eat them every day.

sentences.chinese: 面对两个机会，他犹豫了很久。
sentences.traditional: 面對兩個機會，他猶豫了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì liǎng ge jīhuì, tā yóuyù le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.translation: Faced with two opportunities, he hesitated for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 如果决定已经成熟，就不要再犹豫。
sentences.traditional: 如果決定已經成熟，就不要再猶豫。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ juédìng yǐjīng chéngshú, jiù bú yào zài yóuyù.
sentences.translation: If the decision is already mature, do not hesitate any longer.

sentences.chinese: 她的语气有些犹豫，似乎还有些担心。
sentences.traditional: 她的語氣有些猶豫，似乎還有些擔心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǔqì yǒuxiē yóuyù, sìhū hái yǒuxiē dānxīn.
sentences.translation: Her tone was somewhat hesitant, as if she still had some worries.

sentences.chinese: 长时间缺少睡眠对健康有害。
sentences.traditional: 長時間缺少睡眠對健康有害。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān quēshǎo shuìmián duì jiànkāng yǒu hài.
sentences.translation: Long-term lack of sleep is harmful to health.

sentences.chinese: 这种物质如果处理不当，可能有害。
sentences.traditional: 這種物質如果處理不當，可能有害。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wùzhì rúguǒ chǔlǐ bùdàng, kěnéng yǒu hài.
sentences.translation: This substance may be harmful if it is not handled properly.

sentences.chinese: 我们应当减少对环境有害的行为。
sentences.traditional: 我們應當減少對環境有害的行為。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīngdāng jiǎnshǎo duì huánjìng yǒu hài de xíngwéi.
sentences.translation: We should reduce behaviour that is harmful to the environment.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告提供了有力的数据支持。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告提供了有力的數據支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào tígōng le yǒulì de shùjù zhīchí.
sentences.translation: This report provided strong data support.

sentences.chinese: 他的发言有力地回应了大家的疑问。
sentences.traditional: 他的發言有力地回應了大家的疑問。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fāyán yǒulì de huíyìng le dàjiā de yíwèn.
sentences.translation: His speech responded forcefully to everyone’s questions.

sentences.chinese: 政府采取了有力措施来稳定物价。
sentences.traditional: 政府採取了有力措施來穩定物價。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le yǒulì cuòshī lái wěndìng wùjià.
sentences.translation: The government took strong measures to stabilise prices.

sentences.chinese: 这种政策对中小企业的发展非常有利。
sentences.traditional: 這種政策對中小企業的發展非常有利。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhèngcè duì zhōngxiǎo qǐyè de fāzhǎn fēicháng yǒulì.
sentences.translation: This kind of policy is very favourable for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises.

sentences.chinese: 稳定的市场环境有利于吸引更多投资。
sentences.traditional: 穩定的市場環境有利於吸引更多投資。
sentences.pinyin: Wěndìng de shìchǎng huánjìng yǒulì yú xīyǐn gèng duō tóuzī.
sentences.translation: A stable market environment helps attract more investment.

sentences.chinese: 双方应当选择对合作最有利的方案。
sentences.traditional: 雙方應當選擇對合作最有利的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng yīngdāng xuǎnzé duì hézuò zuì yǒulì de fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: Both sides should choose the plan that is most favourable to cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 我们的时间有限，必须先处理最重要的问题。
sentences.traditional: 我們的時間有限，必須先處理最重要的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de shíjiān yǒuxiàn, bìxū xiān chǔlǐ zuì zhòngyào de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Our time is limited, so we must deal with the most important issue first.

sentences.chinese: 由于资金有限，项目只能分阶段推进。
sentences.traditional: 由於資金有限，項目只能分階段推進。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zījīn yǒuxiàn, xiàngmù zhǐ néng fēn jiēduàn tuījìn.
sentences.translation: Because funds are limited, the project can only be advanced in stages.

sentences.chinese: 每个人的精力都是有限的，不能什么事都亲自做。
sentences.traditional: 每個人的精力都是有限的，不能什麼事都親自做。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén de jīnglì dōu shì yǒuxiàn de, bù néng shénme shì dōu qīnzì zuò.
sentences.translation: Everyone’s energy is limited; you cannot do everything personally.

sentences.chinese: 适当运动对身心健康都有益。
sentences.traditional: 適當運動對身心健康都有益。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdàng yùndòng duì shēnxīn jiànkāng dōu yǒuyì.
sentences.translation: Appropriate exercise is beneficial to both physical and mental health.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的内容对提高写作能力很有益。
sentences.traditional: 這本書的內容對提高寫作能力很有益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng duì tígāo xiězuò nénglì hěn yǒuyì.
sentences.translation: The content of this book is very beneficial for improving writing ability.

sentences.chinese: 公开讨论不同意见，对解决问题是有益的。
sentences.traditional: 公開討論不同意見，對解決問題是有益的。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngkāi tǎolùn bùtóng yìjiàn, duì jiějué wèntí shì yǒuyì de.
sentences.translation: Openly discussing different opinions is beneficial for solving problems.

sentences.chinese: 清楚的目标有助于提高团队效率。
sentences.traditional: 清楚的目標有助於提高團隊效率。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchu de mùbiāo yǒuzhùyú tígāo tuánduì xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Clear goals help improve team efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 深入了解用户需求有助于改进产品设计。
sentences.traditional: 深入了解用戶需求有助於改進產品設計。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnrù liǎojiě yònghù xūqiú yǒuzhùyú gǎijìn chǎnpǐn shèjì.
sentences.translation: A thorough understanding of user needs helps improve product design.

sentences.chinese: 定期复习有助于把知识真正掌握。
sentences.traditional: 定期複習有助於把知識真正掌握。
sentences.pinyin: Dìngqī fùxí yǒuzhùyú bǎ zhīshi zhēnzhèng zhǎngwò.
sentences.translation: Regular review helps you truly master the knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 这所幼儿园重视孩子的语言发展。
sentences.traditional: 這所幼兒園重視孩子的語言發展。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ yòu’éryuán zhòngshì háizi de yǔyán fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: This kindergarten values children’s language development.

sentences.chinese: 妹妹明年九月要上幼儿园。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹明年九月要上幼兒園。
sentences.pinyin: Mèimei míngnián jiǔ yuè yào shàng yòu’éryuán.
sentences.translation: My younger sister will start kindergarten next September.

sentences.chinese: 家长们正在比较附近几家幼儿园的收费。
sentences.traditional: 家長們正在比較附近幾家幼兒園的收費。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāzhǎngmen zhèngzài bǐjiào fùjìn jǐ jiā yòu’éryuán de shōufèi.
sentences.translation: Parents are comparing the fees of several nearby kindergartens.

sentences.chinese: 现代城市需要更多适合家庭的娱乐空间。
sentences.traditional: 現代城市需要更多適合家庭的娛樂空間。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài chéngshì xūyào gèng duō shìhé jiātíng de yúlè kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: Modern cities need more entertainment spaces suitable for families.

sentences.chinese: 这档节目既能娱乐观众，也能传播知识。
sentences.traditional: 這檔節目既能娛樂觀眾，也能傳播知識。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dàng jiémù jì néng yúlè guānzhòng, yě néng chuánbō zhīshi.
sentences.translation: This programme can both entertain the audience and spread knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 过度娱乐会影响学习和工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 過度娛樂會影響學習和工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù yúlè huì yǐngxiǎng xuéxí hé gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Excessive entertainment can affect study and work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 他的语气很平静，但态度十分坚定。
sentences.traditional: 他的語氣很平靜，但態度十分堅定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǔqì hěn píngjìng, dàn tàidu shífēn jiāndìng.
sentences.translation: His tone was calm, but his attitude was very firm.

sentences.chinese: 请注意语气，不要让对方觉得被批评。
sentences.traditional: 請注意語氣，不要讓對方覺得被批評。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zhùyì yǔqì, bú yào ràng duìfāng juéde bèi pīpíng.
sentences.translation: Please pay attention to your tone, and do not make the other person feel criticised.

sentences.chinese: 从她的语气里，我听出了明显的不满。
sentences.traditional: 從她的語氣裡，我聽出了明顯的不滿。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng tā de yǔqì lǐ, wǒ tīng chū le míngxiǎn de bùmǎn.
sentences.translation: From her tone, I could hear obvious dissatisfaction.

sentences.chinese: 今年春天雨水充足，农作物生长得很好。
sentences.traditional: 今年春天雨水充足，農作物生長得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián chūntiān yǔshuǐ chōngzú, nóngzuòwù shēngzhǎng de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: There has been plenty of rain this spring, and the crops have grown very well.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统可以收集雨水，用来浇花。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統可以收集雨水，用來澆花。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng kěyǐ shōují yǔshuǐ, yòng lái jiāo huā.
sentences.translation: This system can collect rainwater to water flowers.

sentences.chinese: 连续几天的雨水使道路变得很湿。
sentences.traditional: 連續幾天的雨水使道路變得很濕。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jǐ tiān de yǔshuǐ shǐ dàolù biàn de hěn shī.
sentences.translation: Several days of continuous rain made the roads very wet.

sentences.chinese: 语文课不仅练习阅读，也训练表达能力。
sentences.traditional: 語文課不僅練習閱讀，也訓練表達能力。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔwén kè bùjǐn liànxí yuèdú, yě xùnliàn biǎodá nénglì.
sentences.translation: Chinese language class not only practises reading, but also trains expression skills.

sentences.chinese: 他从小喜欢语文，后来成为一名作家。
sentences.traditional: 他從小喜歡語文，後來成為一名作家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo xǐhuān yǔwén, hòulái chéngwéi yì míng zuòjiā.
sentences.translation: He liked Chinese language and literature from childhood and later became a writer.

sentences.chinese: 提高语文水平有助于理解复杂材料。
sentences.traditional: 提高語文水平有助於理解複雜材料。
sentences.pinyin: Tígāo yǔwén shuǐpíng yǒuzhùyú lǐjiě fùzá cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Improving Chinese language ability helps with understanding complex materials.

sentences.chinese: 这个应用可以识别用户的语音指令。
sentences.traditional: 這個應用可以識別用戶的語音指令。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng kěyǐ shíbié yònghù de yǔyīn zhǐlìng.
sentences.translation: This app can recognise users’ voice commands.

sentences.chinese: 老师让学生反复听语音材料。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓學生反覆聽語音材料。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng xuésheng fǎnfù tīng yǔyīn cáiliào.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the students to listen to the audio materials repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 清晰的语音能减少交流中的误会。
sentences.traditional: 清晰的語音能減少交流中的誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngxī de yǔyīn néng jiǎnshǎo jiāoliú zhōng de wùhuì.
sentences.translation: Clear pronunciation can reduce misunderstandings in communication.

sentences.chinese: 气象台预报明天沿海地区会有大风。
sentences.traditional: 氣象臺預報明天沿海地區會有大風。
sentences.pinyin: Qìxiàngtái yùbào míngtiān yánhǎi dìqū huì yǒu dàfēng.
sentences.translation: The weather station forecast that there will be strong winds in coastal areas tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 根据最新预报，周末的气温可能继续下降。
sentences.traditional: 根據最新預報，週末的氣溫可能繼續下降。
sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù zuìxīn yùbào, zhōumò de qìwēn kěnéng jìxù xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: According to the latest forecast, the temperature may continue to fall at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 专家预报今年玉米产量会有所提高。
sentences.traditional: 專家預報今年玉米產量會有所提高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā yùbào jīnnián yùmǐ chǎnliàng huì yǒu suǒ tígāo.
sentences.translation: Experts forecast that this year’s corn output will increase somewhat.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员正在预测未来十年的消费趋势。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員正在預測未來十年的消費趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán zhèngzài yùcè wèilái shí nián de xiāofèi qūshì.
sentences.translation: Researchers are predicting consumption trends for the next ten years.

sentences.chinese: 这些数据有助于我们预测市场变化。
sentences.traditional: 這些數據有助於我們預測市場變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù yǒuzhùyú wǒmen yùcè shìchǎng biànhuà.
sentences.translation: These data help us predict market changes.

sentences.chinese: 很难准确预测每一次技术升级的影响。
sentences.traditional: 很難準確預測每一次技術升級的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn nán zhǔnquè yùcè měi yí cì jìshù shēngjí de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: It is hard to accurately predict the impact of every technological upgrade.

sentences.chinese: 我们已经预订了明晚的酒店房间。
sentences.traditional: 我們已經預訂了明晚的飯店房間。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng yùdìng le míngwǎn de jiǔdiàn fángjiān.
sentences.translation: We have already booked a hotel room for tomorrow night.

sentences.chinese: 如果想坐靠窗的位置，最好提前预订。
sentences.traditional: 如果想坐靠窗的位置，最好提前預訂。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng zuò kào chuāng de wèizhi, zuì hǎo tíqián yùdìng.
sentences.translation: If you want a window seat, it is best to book in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅很受欢迎，周末必须预订。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳很受歡迎，週末必須預訂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn shòu huānyíng, zhōumò bìxū yùdìng.
sentences.translation: This restaurant is very popular, so you must book at weekends.

sentences.chinese: 接种疫苗是预防疾病的重要手段。
sentences.traditional: 接種疫苗是預防疾病的重要手段。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhòng yìmiáo shì yùfáng jíbìng de zhòngyào shǒuduàn.
sentences.translation: Vaccination is an important means of preventing disease.

sentences.chinese: 为了预防事故，工厂加强了安全培训。
sentences.traditional: 為了預防事故，工廠加強了安全培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile yùfáng shìgù, gōngchǎng jiāqiáng le ānquán péixùn.
sentences.translation: To prevent accidents, the factory strengthened safety training.

sentences.chinese: 充足的睡眠有助于预防压力带来的问题。
sentences.traditional: 充足的睡眠有助於預防壓力帶來的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Chōngzú de shuìmián yǒuzhùyú yùfáng yālì dài lái de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Adequate sleep helps prevent problems caused by stress.

sentences.chinese: 公司预计今年的销量会继续增长。
sentences.traditional: 公司預計今年的銷量會繼續增長。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yùjì jīnnián de xiāoliàng huì jìxù zēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The company expects sales volume to continue growing this year.

sentences.chinese: 会议预计在下午三点结束。
sentences.traditional: 會議預計在下午三點結束。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yùjì zài xiàwǔ sān diǎn jiéshù.
sentences.translation: The meeting is expected to end at three in the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 由于雨水增加，工程预计会推迟一周。
sentences.traditional: 由於雨水增加，工程預計會推遲一週。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú yǔshuǐ zēngjiā, gōngchéng yùjì huì tuīchí yì zhōu.
sentences.translation: Because of increased rainfall, the project is expected to be delayed by one week.

sentences.chinese: 这种玉米适合在温暖的地区生长。
sentences.traditional: 這種玉米適合在溫暖的地區生長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yùmǐ shìhé zài wēnnuǎn de dìqū shēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: This type of corn is suitable for growing in warm regions.

sentences.chinese: 农民正在比较不同玉米品种的产量。
sentences.traditional: 農民正在比較不同玉米品種的產量。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngmín zhèngzài bǐjiào bùtóng yùmǐ pǐnzhǒng de chǎnliàng.
sentences.translation: Farmers are comparing the yields of different corn varieties.

sentences.chinese: 玉米价格上涨会影响许多食品的成本。
sentences.traditional: 玉米價格上漲會影響許多食品的成本。
sentences.pinyin: Yùmǐ jiàgé shàngzhǎng huì yǐngxiǎng xǔduō shípǐn de chéngběn.
sentences.translation: Rising corn prices will affect the cost of many foods.

sentences.chinese: 看牙医之前需要先在网上预约。
sentences.traditional: 看牙醫之前需要先在網上預約。
sentences.pinyin: Kàn yáyī zhīqián xūyào xiān zài wǎngshàng yùyuē.
sentences.translation: Before seeing the dentist, you need to make an appointment online.

sentences.chinese: 他已经预约了明天下午的面试。
sentences.traditional: 他已經預約了明天下午的面試。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng yùyuē le míngtiān xiàwǔ de miànshì.
sentences.translation: He has already booked an interview for tomorrow afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 这项服务必须提前预约，不能现场办理。
sentences.traditional: 這項服務必須提前預約，不能現場辦理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fúwù bìxū tíqián yùyuē, bù néng xiànchǎng bànlǐ.
sentences.translation: This service must be booked in advance and cannot be handled on site.

sentences.chinese: 请把文件放回原位置。
sentences.traditional: 請把文件放回原位置。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn fàng huí yuán wèizhi.
sentences.translation: Please put the document back in its original place.

sentences.chinese: 原计划后来被临时调整了。
sentences.traditional: 原計畫後來被臨時調整了。
sentences.pinyin: Yuán jìhuà hòulái bèi línshí tiáozhěng le.
sentences.translation: The original plan was later temporarily adjusted.

sentences.chinese: 他仍然住在原地址。
sentences.traditional: 他仍然住在原地址。
sentences.pinyin: Tā réngrán zhù zài yuán dìzhǐ.
sentences.translation: He still lives at the former address.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们围成一个圆，开始做游戏。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們圍成一個圓，開始做遊戲。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen wéi chéng yí ge yuán, kāishǐ zuò yóuxì.
sentences.translation: The children formed a circle and began to play a game.

sentences.chinese: 这张圆桌适合小型会议使用。
sentences.traditional: 這張圓桌適合小型會議使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yuánzhuō shìhé xiǎoxíng huìyì shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This round table is suitable for small meetings.

sentences.chinese: 月亮又大又圆，挂在夜间的天空中。
sentences.traditional: 月亮又大又圓，掛在夜間的天空中。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèliang yòu dà yòu yuán, guà zài yèjiān de tiānkōng zhōng.
sentences.translation: The moon was large and round, hanging in the night sky.

sentences.chinese: 新系统保留了原有的数据和用户设置。
sentences.traditional: 新系統保留了原有的數據和用戶設定。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng bǎoliú le yuán yǒu de shùjù hé yònghù shèdìng.
sentences.translation: The new system retained the original data and user settings.

sentences.chinese: 改革不能简单地破坏原有的管理结构。
sentences.traditional: 改革不能簡單地破壞原有的管理結構。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎigé bù néng jiǎndān de pòhuài yuán yǒu de guǎnlǐ jiégòu.
sentences.translation: Reform must not simply destroy the previously existing management structure.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要在原有基础上进一步完善方案。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要在原有基礎上進一步完善方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zài yuán yǒu jīchǔ shàng jìnyíbù wánshàn fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: We need to further improve the plan on the original basis.

sentences.chinese: 元旦那天，学校会举行一场简单的庆祝活动。
sentences.traditional: 元旦那天，學校會舉行一場簡單的慶祝活動。
sentences.pinyin: Yuándàn nà tiān, xuéxiào huì jǔxíng yì chǎng jiǎndān de qìngzhù huódòng.
sentences.translation: On New Year’s Day, the school will hold a simple celebration.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定从元旦开始实行新的工作制度。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定從元旦開始實行新的工作制度。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng cóng Yuándàn kāishǐ shíxíng xīn de gōngzuò zhìdù.
sentences.translation: The company has decided to carry out a new work system from New Year’s Day.

sentences.chinese: 元旦假期虽然不长，但大家都想好好休息。
sentences.traditional: 元旦假期雖然不長，但大家都想好好休息。
sentences.pinyin: Yuándàn jiàqī suīrán bù cháng, dàn dàjiā dōu xiǎng hǎohǎo xiūxi.
sentences.translation: Although the New Year’s Day holiday is not long, everyone wants to have a good rest.

sentences.chinese: 公司为每位员工提供职业培训。
sentences.traditional: 公司為每位員工提供職業培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī wèi měi wèi yuángōng tígōng zhíyè péixùn.
sentences.translation: The company provides professional training for every employee.

sentences.chinese: 新来的员工很快适应了团队的工作方式。
sentences.traditional: 新來的員工很快適應了團隊的工作方式。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn lái de yuángōng hěn kuài shìyìng le tuánduì de gōngzuò fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The new employee quickly adapted to the team’s way of working.

sentences.chinese: 员工的意见有助于完善管理制度。
sentences.traditional: 員工的意見有助於完善管理制度。
sentences.pinyin: Yuángōng de yìjiàn yǒuzhùyú wánshàn guǎnlǐ zhìdù.
sentences.translation: Employees’ opinions help improve the management system.

sentences.chinese: 处理这类问题时，我们必须坚持公平原则。
sentences.traditional: 處理這類問題時，我們必須堅持公平原則。
sentences.pinyin: Chǔlǐ zhè lèi wèntí shí, wǒmen bìxū jiānchí gōngpíng yuánzé.
sentences.translation: When handling this kind of problem, we must uphold the principle of fairness.

sentences.chinese: 他的原则很清楚：不做损害他人的事。
sentences.traditional: 他的原則很清楚：不做損害他人的事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yuánzé hěn qīngchu: bù zuò sǔnhài tārén de shì.
sentences.translation: His principle is very clear: do nothing that harms others.

sentences.chinese: 合作双方应该事先确定基本原则。
sentences.traditional: 合作雙方應該事先確定基本原則。
sentences.pinyin: Hézuò shuāngfāng yīnggāi shìxiān quèdìng jīběn yuánzé.
sentences.translation: Both parties to the cooperation should determine the basic principles in advance.

sentences.chinese: 我愿承担这项任务带来的责任。
sentences.traditional: 我願承擔這項任務帶來的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yuàn chéngdān zhè xiàng rènwù dài lái de zérèn.
sentences.translation: I am willing to take on the responsibility brought by this task.

sentences.chinese: 只要对社会有益，他就愿投入更多时间。
sentences.traditional: 只要對社會有益，他就願投入更多時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào duì shèhuì yǒuyì, tā jiù yuàn tóurù gèng duō shíjiān.
sentences.translation: As long as it benefits society, he is willing to invest more time.

sentences.chinese: 愿每位学生都能找到适合自己的方向。
sentences.traditional: 願每位學生都能找到適合自己的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn měi wèi xuéshēng dōu néng zhǎodào shìhé zìjǐ de fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: May every student find a direction that suits them.

sentences.chinese: 她最大的愿望是成为一名医生。
sentences.traditional: 她最大的願望是成為一名醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì dà de yuànwàng shì chéngwéi yì míng yīshēng.
sentences.translation: Her greatest wish is to become a doctor.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目体现了当地居民改善环境的愿望。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目體現了當地居民改善環境的願望。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù tǐxiàn le dāngdì jūmín gǎishàn huánjìng de yuànwàng.
sentences.translation: This project reflects local residents’ desire to improve the environment.

sentences.chinese: 经过多年努力，他终于实现了自己的愿望。
sentences.traditional: 經過多年努力，他終於實現了自己的願望。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián nǔlì, tā zhōngyú shíxiàn le zìjǐ de yuànwàng.
sentences.translation: After many years of effort, he finally realised his wish.

sentences.chinese: 我们已经约定下周一提交修改后的方案。
sentences.traditional: 我們已經約定下週一提交修改後的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng yuēdìng xià zhōu yī tíjiāo xiūgǎi hòu de fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: We have already agreed to submit the revised plan next Monday.

sentences.chinese: 按照合同约定，运费由买方承担。
sentences.traditional: 按照合約約定，運費由買方承擔。
sentences.pinyin: Ànzhào hétong yuēdìng, yùnfèi yóu mǎifāng chéngdān.
sentences.translation: According to the contract agreement, the freight cost is borne by the buyer.

sentences.chinese: 这次约定只是口头的，最好写成文件。
sentences.traditional: 這次約定只是口頭的，最好寫成文件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì yuēdìng zhǐ shì kǒutóu de, zuì hǎo xiě chéng wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: This agreement is only verbal, so it is best to put it in writing.

sentences.chinese: 工人把设备运到新的实验室。
sentences.traditional: 工人把設備運到新的實驗室。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén bǎ shèbèi yùn dào xīn de shíyànshì.
sentences.translation: The workers transported the equipment to the new laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 这批药品必须用冷藏车运。
sentences.traditional: 這批藥品必須用冷藏車運。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī yàopǐn bìxū yòng lěngcángchē yùn.
sentences.translation: This batch of medicines must be transported by refrigerated vehicle.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司每天要运大量蔬菜到市区。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司每天要運大量蔬菜到市區。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī měitiān yào yùn dàliàng shūcài dào shìqū.
sentences.translation: This company has to transport large quantities of vegetables into the urban area every day.

sentences.chinese: 如果订单金额够高，商家会免收运费。
sentences.traditional: 如果訂單金額夠高，商家會免收運費。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dìngdān jīn’é gòu gāo, shāngjiā huì miǎnshōu yùnfèi.
sentences.translation: If the order amount is high enough, the seller will waive the shipping cost.

sentences.chinese: 运费上涨使产品的最终售价提高了。
sentences.traditional: 運費上漲使產品的最終售價提高了。
sentences.pinyin: Yùnfèi shàngzhǎng shǐ chǎnpǐn de zuìzhōng shòujià tígāo le.
sentences.translation: Rising shipping costs have increased the final selling price of the product.

sentences.chinese: 退还商品时，运费由谁承担需要事先说明。
sentences.traditional: 退還商品時，運費由誰承擔需要事先說明。
sentences.pinyin: Tuìhuán shāngpǐn shí, yùnfèi yóu shéi chéngdān xūyào shìxiān shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: When returning goods, who bears the shipping cost needs to be explained in advance.

sentences.chinese: 他能在最后一分钟赶上火车，真是运气好。
sentences.traditional: 他能在最後一分鐘趕上火車，真是運氣好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā néng zài zuìhòu yì fēnzhōng gǎn shàng huǒchē, zhēn shì yùnqi hǎo.
sentences.translation: He managed to catch the train at the last minute; that was really lucky.

sentences.chinese: 成功不能只依靠运气，还需要实力和准备。
sentences.traditional: 成功不能只依靠運氣，還需要實力和準備。
sentences.pinyin: Chénggōng bù néng zhǐ yīkào yùnqi, hái xūyào shílì hé zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: Success cannot rely only on luck; it also requires capability and preparation.

sentences.chinese: 今天的比赛中，他的运气似乎特别好。
sentences.traditional: 今天的比賽中，他的運氣似乎特別好。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de bǐsài zhōng, tā de yùnqi sìhū tèbié hǎo.
sentences.translation: In today’s competition, his luck seemed especially good.

sentences.chinese: 铁路运输能减少长距离货物的成本。
sentences.traditional: 鐵路運輸能減少長距離貨物的成本。
sentences.pinyin: Tiělù yùnshū néng jiǎnshǎo cháng jùlí huòwù de chéngběn.
sentences.translation: Rail transport can reduce the cost of long-distance freight.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司负责把医疗物资运输到山区。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司負責把醫療物資運輸到山區。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fùzé bǎ yīliáo wùzī yùnshū dào shānqū.
sentences.translation: This company is responsible for transporting medical supplies to mountain areas.

sentences.chinese: 极端天气会影响正常的运输安排。
sentences.traditional: 極端天氣會影響正常的運輸安排。
sentences.pinyin: Jíduān tiānqì huì yǐngxiǎng zhèngcháng de yùnshū ānpái.
sentences.translation: Extreme weather can affect normal transport arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该灵活运用这些数据来改进服务。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該靈活運用這些數據來改進服務。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi línghuó yùnyòng zhèxiē shùjù lái gǎijìn fúwù.
sentences.translation: We should apply this data flexibly to improve the service.

sentences.chinese: 他能把课堂上学到的理论运用到实际工作中。
sentences.traditional: 他能把課堂上學到的理論運用到實際工作中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā néng bǎ kètáng shang xué dào de lǐlùn yùnyòng dào shíjì gōngzuò zhōng.
sentences.translation: He can apply the theories learnt in class to practical work.

sentences.chinese: 正确运用法律知识有助于保护自己的权益。
sentences.traditional: 正確運用法律知識有助於保護自己的權益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngquè yùnyòng fǎlǜ zhīshi yǒuzhùyú bǎohù zìjǐ de quányì.
sentences.translation: Correctly applying legal knowledge helps protect one’s rights and interests.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束前，在场的代表都发表了意见。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束前，在場的代表都發表了意見。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù qián, zàichǎng de dàibiǎo dōu fābiǎo le yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting ended, the representatives present all expressed their opinions.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生时，几名工作人员正好在场。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生時，幾名工作人員正好在場。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng shí, jǐ míng gōngzuò rényuán zhènghǎo zàichǎng.
sentences.translation: When the accident happened, several staff members happened to be present.

sentences.chinese: 如果你当时在场，情况可能会更清楚。
sentences.traditional: 如果你當時在場，情況可能會更清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ dāngshí zàichǎng, qíngkuàng kěnéng huì gèng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: If you had been present at the time, the situation might be clearer.

sentences.chinese: 他表面上不说，其实很在乎别人对他的评价。
sentences.traditional: 他表面上不說，其實很在乎別人對他的評價。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biǎomiàn shang bù shuō, qíshí hěn zàihu biérén duì tā de píngjià.
sentences.translation: He does not say it openly, but he actually cares a lot about what others think of him.

sentences.chinese: 我们不仅看重结果，也很在乎过程是否公平。
sentences.traditional: 我們不僅看重結果，也很在乎過程是否公平。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bùjǐn kànzhòng jiéguǒ, yě hěn zàihu guòchéng shìfǒu gōngpíng.
sentences.translation: We value not only the result, but also care whether the process is fair.

sentences.chinese: 别太在乎一次失误，关键是从中吸取经验。
sentences.traditional: 別太在乎一次失誤，關鍵是從中吸取經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Bié tài zàihu yí cì shīwù, guānjiàn shì cóng zhōng xīqǔ jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Do not mind one mistake too much; the key is to learn from it.

sentences.chinese: 包括老师在内，现场一共有三十人。
sentences.traditional: 包括老師在內，現場一共有三十人。
sentences.pinyin: Bāokuò lǎoshī zàinèi, xiànchǎng yígòng yǒu sānshí rén.
sentences.translation: Including the teacher, there were thirty people at the scene altogether.

sentences.chinese: 所有费用，包括运费在内，都由买方承担。
sentences.traditional: 所有費用，包括運費在內，都由買方承擔。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu fèiyòng, bāokuò yùnfèi zàinèi, dōu yóu mǎifāng chéngdān.
sentences.translation: All costs, including shipping, are borne by the buyer.

sentences.chinese: 连新员工在内，部门共有二十六人。
sentences.traditional: 連新員工在內，部門共有二十六人。
sentences.pinyin: Lián xīn yuángōng zàinèi, bùmén gòng yǒu èrshíliù rén.
sentences.translation: Including the new employees, the department has twenty-six people altogether.

sentences.chinese: 客服人员每天上午九点到晚上六点在线。
sentences.traditional: 客服人員每天上午九點到晚上六點在線。
sentences.pinyin: Kèfú rényuán měitiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn dào wǎnshang liù diǎn zàixiàn.
sentences.translation: Customer service staff are online every day from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.

sentences.chinese: 现在很多课程都可以在线完成。
sentences.traditional: 現在很多課程都可以在線完成。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō kèchéng dōu kěyǐ zàixiàn wánchéng.
sentences.translation: Many courses can now be completed online.

sentences.chinese: 请确认用户是否在线，然后再发送文件。
sentences.traditional: 請確認用戶是否在線，然後再發送文件。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng quèrèn yònghù shìfǒu zàixiàn, ránhòu zài fāsòng wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please confirm whether the user is online, then send the file.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革的关键在于提高效率。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革的關鍵在於提高效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé de guānjiàn zàiyú tígāo xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The key to this reform lies in improving efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 成功的原因往往在于长期坚持。
sentences.traditional: 成功的原因往往在於長期堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Chénggōng de yuányīn wǎngwǎng zàiyú chángqī jiānchí.
sentences.translation: The reason for success often lies in long-term persistence.

sentences.chinese: 这门课的价值在于帮助学生形成独立思考。
sentences.traditional: 這門課的價值在於幫助學生形成獨立思考。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kè de jiàzhí zàiyú bāngzhù xuéshēng xíngchéng dúlì sīkǎo.
sentences.translation: The value of this course lies in helping students develop independent thinking.

sentences.chinese: 大多数市民赞成建设新的公园。
sentences.traditional: 大多數市民贊成建設新的公園。
sentences.pinyin: Dàduōshù shìmín zànchéng jiànshè xīn de gōngyuán.
sentences.translation: Most citizens support building a new park.

sentences.chinese: 我赞成你的想法，但还需要考虑成本。
sentences.traditional: 我贊成你的想法，但還需要考慮成本。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zànchéng nǐ de xiǎngfǎ, dàn hái xūyào kǎolǜ chéngběn.
sentences.translation: I agree with your idea, but we still need to consider the cost.

sentences.chinese: 委员会最终赞成实施这个方案。
sentences.traditional: 委員會最終贊成實施這個方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wěiyuánhuì zuìzhōng zànchéng shíshī zhège fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: The committee finally approved carrying out this plan.

sentences.chinese: 这次实验的结果比我们想象的还糟。
sentences.traditional: 這次實驗的結果比我們想像的還糟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shíyàn de jiéguǒ bǐ wǒmen xiǎngxiàng de hái zāo.
sentences.translation: The result of this experiment was even worse than we imagined.

sentences.chinese: 天气这么糟，比赛可能会推迟。
sentences.traditional: 天氣這麼糟，比賽可能會推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème zāo, bǐsài kěnéng huì tuīchí.
sentences.translation: The weather is so bad that the match may be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 如果情况继续变糟，公司必须调整计划。
sentences.traditional: 如果情況繼續變糟，公司必須調整計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qíngkuàng jìxù biàn zāo, gōngsī bìxū tiáozhěng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: If the situation keeps getting worse, the company must adjust its plan.

sentences.chinese: 这部影片的后半部分节奏很糟糕。
sentences.traditional: 這部影片的後半部分節奏很糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù yǐngpiàn de hòu bàn bùfen jiézòu hěn zāogāo.
sentences.translation: The rhythm of the second half of this film is terrible.

sentences.chinese: 由于准备不足，会议效果十分糟糕。
sentences.traditional: 由於準備不足，會議效果十分糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zhǔnbèi bùzú, huìyì xiàoguǒ shífēn zāogāo.
sentences.translation: Because preparation was insufficient, the result of the meeting was very poor.

sentences.chinese: 手机突然坏了，情况变得有点糟糕。
sentences.traditional: 手機突然壞了，情況變得有點糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī tūrán huài le, qíngkuàng biàn de yǒudiǎn zāogāo.
sentences.translation: The phone suddenly broke, and the situation became a bit awful.

sentences.chinese: 项目早期最重要的是确定需求。
sentences.traditional: 項目早期最重要的是確定需求。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù zǎoqī zuì zhòngyào de shì quèdìng xūqiú.
sentences.translation: In the early stage of a project, the most important thing is to determine the requirements.

sentences.chinese: 这种疾病在早期不容易被发现。
sentences.traditional: 這種疾病在早期不容易被發現。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jíbìng zài zǎoqī bù róngyì bèi fāxiàn.
sentences.translation: This disease is not easy to detect in its early stage.

sentences.chinese: 公司的早期发展主要依靠几位创始人。
sentences.traditional: 公司的早期發展主要依靠幾位創始人。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī de zǎoqī fāzhǎn zhǔyào yīkào jǐ wèi chuàngshǐrén.
sentences.translation: The company’s early development mainly relied on several founders.

sentences.chinese: 这家药店早晚都有人值班，买药很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這家藥店早晚都有人值班，買藥很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yàodiàn zǎowǎn dōu yǒu rén zhíbān, mǎi yào hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This pharmacy has someone on duty morning and evening, so buying medicine is very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 天气冷的时候，早晚温差特别明显。
sentences.traditional: 天氣冷的時候，早晚溫差特別明顯。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì lěng de shíhou, zǎowǎn wēnchā tèbié míngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: When the weather is cold, the temperature difference between morning and evening is especially obvious.

sentences.chinese: 只要坚持练习，你早晚会掌握这种方法。
sentences.traditional: 只要堅持練習，你早晚會掌握這種方法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào jiānchí liànxí, nǐ zǎowǎn huì zhǎngwò zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: As long as you keep practising, you will master this method sooner or later.

sentences.chinese: 这项规定早已公布，只是很多人没有注意。
sentences.traditional: 這項規定早已公佈，只是很多人沒有注意。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng zǎoyǐ gōngbù, zhǐshì hěn duō rén méiyǒu zhùyì.
sentences.translation: This regulation was announced long ago; it is just that many people did not notice.

sentences.chinese: 他早已准备好资料，只等会议开始。
sentences.traditional: 他早已準備好資料，只等會議開始。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǎoyǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo zīliào, zhǐ děng huìyì kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: He prepared the materials long ago and is only waiting for the meeting to begin.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题大家早已讨论过，不必再重复。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題大家早已討論過，不必再重複。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí dàjiā zǎoyǐ tǎolùn guo, búbì zài chóngfù.
sentences.translation: Everyone discussed this issue long ago, so there is no need to repeat it.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司计划在郊区造一座新工厂。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司計畫在郊區造一座新工廠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìhuà zài jiāoqū zào yí zuò xīn gōngchǎng.
sentences.translation: This company plans to build a new factory in the suburbs.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们用纸箱造了一个小城堡。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們用紙箱造了一個小城堡。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yòng zhǐxiāng zào le yí ge xiǎo chéngbǎo.
sentences.translation: The children made a small castle out of cardboard boxes.

sentences.chinese: 这条铁路是十年前造的，现在仍然运行良好。
sentences.traditional: 這條鐵路是十年前造的，現在仍然運行良好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù shì shí nián qián zào de, xiànzài réngrán yùnxíng liánghǎo.
sentences.translation: This railway was built ten years ago and still runs well now.

sentences.chinese: 连续的大雨造成了严重的交通问题。
sentences.traditional: 連續的大雨造成了嚴重的交通問題。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù de dàyǔ zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng wèntí.
sentences.translation: The continuous heavy rain caused serious traffic problems.

sentences.chinese: 错误的信息可能会造成公众误解。
sentences.traditional: 錯誤的信息可能會造成公眾誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Cuòwù de xìnxī kěnéng huì zàochéng gōngzhòng wùjiě.
sentences.translation: Incorrect information may cause public misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 这次事故造成的损失还在统计中。
sentences.traditional: 這次事故造成的損失還在統計中。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù zàochéng de sǔnshī hái zài tǒngjì zhōng.
sentences.translation: The losses caused by this accident are still being counted.

sentences.chinese: 这个月的销售额增了百分之十。
sentences.traditional: 這個月的銷售額增了百分之十。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yuè de xiāoshòu’é zēng le bǎifēnzhī shí.
sentences.translation: This month’s sales increased by ten percent.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息后，大家的信心增了不少。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息後，大家的信心增了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi hòu, dàjiā de xìnxīn zēng le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: After hearing this news, everyone’s confidence increased quite a lot.

sentences.chinese: 如果成本继续增，产品价格也会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果成本繼續增，產品價格也會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chéngběn jìxù zēng, chǎnpǐn jiàgé yě huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If costs continue to increase, product prices will also be affected.

sentences.chinese: 这次交流活动增进了双方的了解。
sentences.traditional: 這次交流活動增進了雙方的了解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jiāoliú huódòng zēngjìn le shuāngfāng de liǎojiě.
sentences.translation: This exchange activity enhanced mutual understanding between the two sides.

sentences.chinese: 共同完成项目有助于增进团队合作。
sentences.traditional: 共同完成項目有助於增進團隊合作。
sentences.pinyin: Gòngtóng wánchéng xiàngmù yǒuzhùyú zēngjìn tuánduì hézuò.
sentences.translation: Completing a project together helps promote teamwork.

sentences.chinese: 老师希望通过讨论增进学生对文化的认识。
sentences.traditional: 老師希望通過討論增進學生對文化的認識。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xīwàng tōngguò tǎolùn zēngjìn xuéshēng duì wénhuà de rènshi.
sentences.translation: The teacher hopes to enhance students’ understanding of culture through discussion.

sentences.chinese: 体育锻炼能够增强体力和耐力。
sentences.traditional: 體育鍛鍊能夠增強體力和耐力。
sentences.pinyin: Tǐyù duànliàn nénggòu zēngqiáng tǐlì hé nàilì.
sentences.translation: Physical exercise can strengthen physical strength and endurance.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在采取措施增强产品的竞争力。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在採取措施增強產品的競爭力。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài cǎiqǔ cuòshī zēngqiáng chǎnpǐn de jìngzhēnglì.
sentences.translation: The company is taking measures to strengthen the competitiveness of its products.

sentences.chinese: 公开信息有助于增强市民的信任。
sentences.traditional: 公開信息有助於增強市民的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngkāi xìnxī yǒuzhùyú zēngqiáng shìmín de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: Making information public helps strengthen citizens’ trust.

sentences.chinese: 校友会赠给图书馆一批珍贵的书。
sentences.traditional: 校友會贈給圖書館一批珍貴的書。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàoyǒuhuì zèng gěi túshūguǎn yì pī zhēnguì de shū.
sentences.translation: The alumni association gave a batch of valuable books to the library as a gift.

sentences.chinese: 他把自己写的诗赠给了老师。
sentences.traditional: 他把自己寫的詩贈給了老師。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ xiě de shī zèng gěi le lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: He gave the poem he wrote to his teacher as a gift.

sentences.chinese: 主办方将把纪念品赠予每位参加者。
sentences.traditional: 主辦方將把紀念品贈予每位參加者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǔbànfāng jiāng bǎ jìniànpǐn zèng yǔ měi wèi cānjiāzhě.
sentences.translation: The organiser will present a souvenir to each participant.

sentences.chinese: 商店会向会员赠送一张优惠券。
sentences.traditional: 商店會向會員贈送一張優惠券。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn huì xiàng huìyuán zèngsòng yì zhāng yōuhuìquàn.
sentences.translation: The shop will give members a voucher as a gift.

sentences.chinese: 公司每年都会给客户赠送日历。
sentences.traditional: 公司每年都會給客戶贈送日曆。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī měi nián dōu huì gěi kèhù zèngsòng rìlì.
sentences.translation: The company gives calendars to customers every year as gifts.

sentences.chinese: 出版社向学校赠送了许多儿童读物。
sentences.traditional: 出版社向學校贈送了許多兒童讀物。
sentences.pinyin: Chūbǎnshè xiàng xuéxiào zèngsòng le xǔduō értóng dúwù.
sentences.translation: The publisher donated many children’s books to the school.

sentences.chinese: 餐厅正在炸油条，门口已经排起了队。
sentences.traditional: 餐廳正在炸油條，門口已經排起了隊。
sentences.pinyin: Cāntīng zhèngzài zhá yóutiáo, ménkǒu yǐjīng pái qǐ le duì.
sentences.translation: The restaurant is frying youtiao, and a queue has already formed at the door.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈把土豆切成条，然后放进锅里炸。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽把土豆切成條，然後放進鍋裡炸。
sentences.pinyin: Māma bǎ tǔdòu qiē chéng tiáo, ránhòu fàng jìn guō lǐ zhá.
sentences.translation: Mum cut the potatoes into strips and then put them into the pan to fry.

sentences.chinese: 这种鱼适合用小火慢慢炸，口感会更好。
sentences.traditional: 這種魚適合用小火慢慢炸，口感會更好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yú shìhé yòng xiǎo huǒ mànmàn zhá, kǒugǎn huì gèng hǎo.
sentences.translation: This kind of fish is suitable for frying slowly over a low heat, which improves the texture.

sentences.chinese: 春天到了，孩子们在果园里摘草莓。
sentences.traditional: 春天到了，孩子們在果園裡摘草莓。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, háizimen zài guǒyuán lǐ zhāi cǎoméi.
sentences.translation: When spring arrived, the children picked strawberries in the orchard.

sentences.chinese: 请不要随便摘公园里的花。
sentences.traditional: 請不要隨便摘公園裡的花。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng búyào suíbiàn zhāi gōngyuán lǐ de huā.
sentences.translation: Please do not pick the flowers in the park casually.

sentences.chinese: 他把树上熟透的桃子摘下来送给客人。
sentences.traditional: 他把樹上熟透的桃子摘下來送給客人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ shù shang shútòu de táozi zhāi xiàlai sòng gěi kèrén.
sentences.translation: He picked the ripe peaches from the tree and gave them to the guests.

sentences.chinese: 这条巷子很窄，汽车开不进去。
sentences.traditional: 這條巷子很窄，汽車開不進去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàngzi hěn zhǎi, qìchē kāi bu jìnqu.
sentences.translation: This alley is very narrow, so cars cannot drive in.

sentences.chinese: 房间的门有点窄，搬书架时很费力。
sentences.traditional: 房間的門有點窄，搬書架時很費力。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān de mén yǒudiǎn zhǎi, bān shūjià shí hěn fèilì.
sentences.translation: The room door is a bit narrow, so moving the bookshelf was hard work.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得自己的知识面太窄，想多读一些书。
sentences.traditional: 他覺得自己的知識面太窄，想多讀一些書。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zìjǐ de zhīshimiàn tài zhǎi, xiǎng duō dú yìxiē shū.
sentences.translation: He feels that his knowledge is too narrow, so he wants to read more books.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆正在展出一批古代书画。
sentences.traditional: 博物館正在展出一批古代書畫。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhèngzài zhǎnchū yì pī gǔdài shūhuà.
sentences.translation: The museum is exhibiting a batch of ancient paintings and calligraphy.

sentences.chinese: 学生的优秀作品将在学校大厅展出。
sentences.traditional: 學生的優秀作品將在學校大廳展出。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēng de yōuxiù zuòpǐn jiāng zài xuéxiào dàtīng zhǎnchū.
sentences.translation: The students’ excellent work will be displayed in the school hall.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动展出了许多环保设计。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動展出了許多環保設計。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng zhǎnchū le xǔduō huánbǎo shèjì.
sentences.translation: This event displayed many environmentally friendly designs.

sentences.chinese: 听完介绍后，双方立即展开讨论。
sentences.traditional: 聽完介紹後，雙方立即展開討論。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng wán jièshào hòu, shuāngfāng lìjí zhǎnkāi tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: After listening to the introduction, the two sides immediately began a discussion.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者把地图展开，给游客指出路线。
sentences.traditional: 志願者把地圖展開，給遊客指出路線。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě bǎ dìtú zhǎnkāi, gěi yóukè zhǐ chū lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: The volunteer unfolded the map and pointed out the route to the tourists.

sentences.chinese: 调查工作已经全面展开，结果下周公布。
sentences.traditional: 調查工作已經全面展開，結果下週公佈。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá gōngzuò yǐjīng quánmiàn zhǎnkāi, jiéguǒ xià zhōu gōngbù.
sentences.translation: The investigation has already fully begun, and the results will be announced next week.

sentences.chinese: 这场展览介绍了城市发展的历史。
sentences.traditional: 這場展覽介紹了城市發展的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhǎnlǎn jièshào le chéngshì fāzhǎn de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: This exhibition introduced the history of the city’s development.

sentences.chinese: 学校正在展览学生的科技作品。
sentences.traditional: 學校正在展覽學生的科技作品。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhèngzài zhǎnlǎn xuéshēng de kējì zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: The school is exhibiting students’ science and technology projects.

sentences.chinese: 我们参观了一个关于传统手工的展览。
sentences.traditional: 我們參觀了一個關於傳統手工的展覽。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen cānguān le yí ge guānyú chuántǒng shǒugōng de zhǎnlǎn.
sentences.translation: We visited an exhibition about traditional handicrafts.

sentences.chinese: 经理用图表展示今年的销售情况。
sentences.traditional: 經理用圖表展示今年的銷售情況。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yòng túbiǎo zhǎnshì jīnnián de xiāoshòu qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The manager used charts to show this year’s sales situation.

sentences.chinese: 这个平台可以展示学生的学习成果。
sentences.traditional: 這個平臺可以展示學生的學習成果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège píngtái kěyǐ zhǎnshì xuéshēng de xuéxí chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: This platform can display students’ learning achievements.

sentences.chinese: 他的演讲展示了深厚的专业知识。
sentences.traditional: 他的演講展示了深厚的專業知識。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng zhǎnshì le shēnhòu de zhuānyè zhīshi.
sentences.translation: His speech showed deep professional knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影展现了普通人的真实生活。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影展現了普通人的真實生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zhǎnxiàn le pǔtōng rén de zhēnshí shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This film reveals the real lives of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 危机之中，他展现出很强的领导能力。
sentences.traditional: 危機之中，他展現出很強的領導能力。
sentences.pinyin: Wēijī zhī zhōng, tā zhǎnxiàn chū hěn qiáng de lǐngdǎo nénglì.
sentences.translation: In the crisis, he showed very strong leadership ability.

sentences.chinese: 城市的新面貌正在慢慢展现出来。
sentences.traditional: 城市的新面貌正在慢慢展現出來。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì de xīn miànmào zhèngzài mànmàn zhǎnxiàn chūlai.
sentences.translation: The city’s new appearance is slowly emerging.

sentences.chinese: 这项开支占总预算的三分之一。
sentences.traditional: 這項開支佔總預算的三分之一。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng kāizhī zhàn zǒng yùsuàn de sānfēnzhīyī.
sentences.translation: This expense accounts for one third of the total budget.

sentences.chinese: 他的书占了整整一面墙。
sentences.traditional: 他的書佔了整整一面牆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shū zhàn le zhěngzhěng yí miàn qiáng.
sentences.translation: His books took up an entire wall.

sentences.chinese: 服务业在本地经济中占重要地位。
sentences.traditional: 服務業在本地經濟中佔重要地位。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyè zài běndì jīngjì zhōng zhàn zhòngyào dìwèi.
sentences.translation: The service industry occupies an important position in the local economy.

sentences.chinese: 列车进站前，乘客都站在站台黄线后。
sentences.traditional: 列車進站前，乘客都站在站臺黃線後。
sentences.pinyin: Lièchē jìn zhàn qián, chéngkè dōu zhàn zài zhàntái huángxiàn hòu.
sentences.translation: Before the train enters the station, passengers all stand behind the yellow line on the platform.

sentences.chinese: 这个站台正在维修，旅客需要换到另一侧上车。
sentences.traditional: 這個站臺正在維修，旅客需要換到另一側上車。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhàntái zhèngzài wéixiū, lǚkè xūyào huàn dào lìng yí cè shàng chē.
sentences.translation: This platform is under repair, so passengers need to board from the other side.

sentences.chinese: 火车晚点时，站台上的人越来越多。
sentences.traditional: 火車晚點時，站臺上的人越來越多。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē wǎndiǎn shí, zhàntái shang de rén yuè lái yuè duō.
sentences.translation: When the train is delayed, there are more and more people on the platform.

sentences.chinese: 我刚才给客服打电话，一直占线。
sentences.traditional: 我剛才給客服打電話，一直佔線。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái gěi kèfú dǎ diànhuà, yìzhí zhànxiàn.
sentences.translation: I called customer service just now, but the line was busy the whole time.

sentences.chinese: 如果电话占线，请稍后再拨。
sentences.traditional: 如果電話佔線，請稍後再撥。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ diànhuà zhànxiàn, qǐng shāo hòu zài bō.
sentences.translation: If the phone line is busy, please dial again later.

sentences.chinese: 办公室的电话总是占线，客户很难联系到我们。
sentences.traditional: 辦公室的電話總是佔線，客戶很難聯繫到我們。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì de diànhuà zǒngshì zhànxiàn, kèhù hěn nán liánxì dào wǒmen.
sentences.translation: The office phone is always busy, so customers have difficulty contacting us.

sentences.chinese: 这几年房租一直在涨，年轻人的压力越来越大。
sentences.traditional: 這幾年房租一直在漲，年輕人的壓力越來越大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián fángzū yìzhí zài zhǎng, niánqīng rén de yālì yuè lái yuè dà.
sentences.translation: Rent has been rising over the past few years, and young people’s pressure is getting greater.

sentences.chinese: 河水一夜之间涨了很多，附近道路被封闭。
sentences.traditional: 河水一夜之間漲了很多，附近道路被封閉。
sentences.pinyin: Héshuǐ yí yè zhī jiān zhǎng le hěn duō, fùjìn dàolù bèi fēngbì.
sentences.translation: The river rose a lot overnight, and nearby roads were closed.

sentences.chinese: 天气转暖后，蔬菜的价格反而没怎么涨。
sentences.traditional: 天氣轉暖後，蔬菜的價格反而沒怎麼漲。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì zhuǎn nuǎn hòu, shūcài de jiàgé fǎn'ér méi zěnme zhǎng.
sentences.translation: After the weather warmed up, the price of vegetables did not really rise.

sentences.chinese: 油价又涨价了，运输公司的成本明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 油價又漲價了，運輸公司的成本明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Yóujià yòu zhǎngjià le, yùnshū gōngsī de chéngběn míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: Fuel prices have gone up again, and transport companies’ costs have clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 如果原材料继续涨价，产品售价可能也要调整。
sentences.traditional: 如果原材料繼續漲價，產品售價可能也要調整。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yuáncáiliào jìxù zhǎngjià, chǎnpǐn shòujià kěnéng yě yào tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: If raw materials continue to rise in price, the product’s selling price may also need to be adjusted.

sentences.chinese: 房东通知我们下个月开始涨价，租客都很不满。
sentences.traditional: 房東通知我們下個月開始漲價，租客都很不滿。
sentences.pinyin: Fángdōng tōngzhī wǒmen xià ge yuè kāishǐ zhǎngjià, zūkè dōu hěn bùmǎn.
sentences.translation: The landlord informed us that the price would rise from next month, and the tenants were all very dissatisfied.

sentences.chinese: 演讲结束后，现场响起了热烈的掌声。
sentences.traditional: 演講結束後，現場響起了熱烈的掌聲。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng jiéshù hòu, xiànchǎng xiǎngqǐ le rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
sentences.translation: After the speech ended, warm applause rang out at the venue.

sentences.chinese: 她的舞蹈赢得了全场观众的掌声。
sentences.traditional: 她的舞蹈贏得了全場觀眾的掌聲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de wǔdǎo yíngdé le quánchǎng guānzhòng de zhǎngshēng.
sentences.translation: Her dance won applause from the whole audience.

sentences.chinese: 请用掌声欢迎今天的特别嘉宾。
sentences.traditional: 請用掌聲歡迎今天的特別嘉賓。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng yòng zhǎngshēng huānyíng jīntiān de tèbié jiābīn.
sentences.translation: Please welcome today’s special guest with applause.

sentences.chinese: 学习语言不能只背词，还要掌握用法。
sentences.traditional: 學習語言不能只背詞，還要掌握用法。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yǔyán bù néng zhǐ bèi cí, hái yào zhǎngwò yòngfǎ.
sentences.translation: When learning a language, you cannot just memorise words; you also need to master usage.

sentences.chinese: 只有掌握准确的数据，才能做出合理判断。
sentences.traditional: 只有掌握準確的數據，才能做出合理判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhǎngwò zhǔnquè de shùjù, cái néng zuò chū hélǐ pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Only by grasping accurate data can you make a reasonable judgement.

sentences.chinese: 他已经基本掌握了这套系统的操作方法。
sentences.traditional: 他已經基本掌握了這套系統的操作方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng jīběn zhǎngwò le zhè tào xìtǒng de cāozuò fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: He has basically mastered how to operate this system.

sentences.chinese: 请先输入账号和密码，再点击登录。
sentences.traditional: 請先輸入帳號和密碼，再點擊登入。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān shūrù zhànghào hé mìmǎ, zài diǎnjī dēnglù.
sentences.translation: Please enter your account number and password first, then click log in.

sentences.chinese: 这个账号因为多次输错密码被暂时锁定。
sentences.traditional: 這個帳號因為多次輸錯密碼被暫時鎖定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhànghào yīnwèi duō cì shū cuò mìmǎ bèi zànshí suǒdìng.
sentences.translation: This account was temporarily locked because the password was entered incorrectly several times.

sentences.chinese: 公司会为每位员工建立一个内部账号。
sentences.traditional: 公司會為每位員工建立一個內部帳號。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī huì wèi měi wèi yuángōng jiànlì yí ge nèibù zhànghào.
sentences.translation: The company will create an internal account for every employee.

sentences.chinese: 转账前，请确认对方的账户信息是否正确。
sentences.traditional: 轉賬前，請確認對方的賬戶信息是否正確。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuǎnzhàng qián, qǐng quèrèn duìfāng de zhànghù xìnxī shìfǒu zhèngquè.
sentences.translation: Before transferring money, please confirm whether the other party’s account information is correct.

sentences.chinese: 银行提醒用户定期检查账户安全。
sentences.traditional: 銀行提醒用戶定期檢查帳戶安全。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng tíxǐng yònghù dìngqī jiǎnchá zhànghù ānquán.
sentences.translation: The bank reminds users to check their account security regularly.

sentences.chinese: 这个账户已经很久没有使用，需要重新激活。
sentences.traditional: 這個帳戶已經很久沒有使用，需要重新啟用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhànghù yǐjīng hěn jiǔ méiyǒu shǐyòng, xūyào chóngxīn qǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This account has not been used for a long time and needs to be reactivated.

sentences.chinese: 外面风很大，出门多穿点，别着凉。
sentences.traditional: 外面風很大，出門多穿點，別著涼。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng hěn dà, chūmén duō chuān diǎn, bié zháoliáng.
sentences.translation: It is very windy outside, so wear more when you go out and do not catch cold.

sentences.chinese: 他昨晚没盖好被子，早上起来就着凉了。
sentences.traditional: 他昨晚沒蓋好被子，早上起來就著涼了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuówǎn méi gài hǎo bèizi, zǎoshang qǐlai jiù zháoliáng le.
sentences.translation: He did not cover himself properly last night, and when he got up in the morning he had caught cold.

sentences.chinese: 孩子运动后出了汗，如果马上吹空调容易着凉。
sentences.traditional: 孩子運動後出了汗，如果馬上吹空調容易著涼。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yùndòng hòu chū le hàn, rúguǒ mǎshàng chuī kōngtiáo róngyì zháoliáng.
sentences.translation: After children sweat from exercise, they can easily catch cold if they immediately sit in air conditioning.

sentences.chinese: 学校将在周五下午召开家长会。
sentences.traditional: 學校將在週五下午召開家長會。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāng zài zhōu wǔ xiàwǔ zhàokāi jiāzhǎnghuì.
sentences.translation: The school will hold a parents’ meeting on Friday afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 为了解决这个问题，经理临时召开了一次会议。
sentences.traditional: 為了解決這個問題，經理臨時召開了一次會議。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le jiějué zhège wèntí, jīnglǐ línshí zhàokāi le yí cì huìyì.
sentences.translation: To solve this problem, the manager held a temporary meeting.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划召开新闻发布会，说明最新政策。
sentences.traditional: 政府計畫召開新聞發布會，說明最新政策。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà zhàokāi xīnwén fābùhuì, shuōmíng zuìxīn zhèngcè.
sentences.translation: The government plans to hold a press conference to explain the latest policy.

sentences.chinese: 这家书店周末有折扣，很多新书都便宜了。
sentences.traditional: 這家書店週末有折扣，很多新書都便宜了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā shūdiàn zhōumò yǒu zhékòu, hěn duō xīnshū dōu piányi le.
sentences.translation: This bookshop has discounts at the weekend, and many new books are cheaper.

sentences.chinese: 如果一次购买三件以上，可以享受更高的折扣。
sentences.traditional: 如果一次購買三件以上，可以享受更高的折扣。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yí cì gòumǎi sān jiàn yǐshàng, kěyǐ xiǎngshòu gèng gāo de zhékòu.
sentences.translation: If you buy three or more items at once, you can enjoy a bigger discount.

sentences.chinese: 这个折扣只适用于在线订单。
sentences.traditional: 這個折扣只適用於線上訂單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhékòu zhǐ shìyòng yú zàixiàn dìngdān.
sentences.translation: This discount only applies to online orders.

sentences.chinese: 哲学问题常常看起来简单，却很难回答。
sentences.traditional: 哲學問題常常看起來簡單，卻很難回答。
sentences.pinyin: Zhéxué wèntí chángcháng kàn qǐlai jiǎndān, què hěn nán huídá.
sentences.translation: Philosophical questions often look simple, but they are very hard to answer.

sentences.chinese: 他大学时学习哲学，对人生意义很感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 他大學時學習哲學，對人生意義很感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué shí xuéxí zhéxué, duì rénshēng yìyì hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: He studied philosophy at university and is very interested in the meaning of life.

sentences.chinese: 这本书用通俗的语言介绍西方哲学。
sentences.traditional: 這本書用通俗的語言介紹西方哲學。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yòng tōngsú de yǔyán jièshào xīfāng zhéxué.
sentences.translation: This book introduces Western philosophy in accessible language.

sentences.chinese: 他真诚地向同事道歉，大家都愿意原谅他。
sentences.traditional: 他真誠地向同事道歉，大家都願意原諒他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhēnchéng de xiàng tóngshì dàoqiàn, dàjiā dōu yuànyì yuánliàng tā.
sentences.translation: He sincerely apologised to his colleagues, and everyone was willing to forgive him.

sentences.chinese: 这封信的语言很真诚，让人感到温暖。
sentences.traditional: 這封信的語言很真誠，讓人感到溫暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn de yǔyán hěn zhēnchéng, ràng rén gǎndào wēnnuǎn.
sentences.translation: The language in this letter is very sincere, making people feel warm.

sentences.chinese: 真诚的态度比漂亮的话更重要。
sentences.traditional: 真誠的態度比漂亮的話更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnchéng de tàidu bǐ piàoliang de huà gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: A sincere attitude is more important than pretty words.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策主要针对中小企业的融资困难。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策主要針對中小企業的融資困難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè zhǔyào zhēnduì zhōngxiǎo qǐyè de róngzī kùnnan.
sentences.translation: This policy mainly targets the financing difficulties of small and medium-sized enterprises.

sentences.chinese: 老师针对学生的弱点设计了新的练习。
sentences.traditional: 老師針對學生的弱點設計了新的練習。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhēnduì xuéshēng de ruòdiǎn shèjì le xīn de liànxí.
sentences.translation: The teacher designed new exercises aimed at the students’ weak points.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要针对这个问题进行更深入的调查。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要針對這個問題進行更深入的調查。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zhēnduì zhège wèntí jìnxíng gèng shēnrù de diàochá.
sentences.translation: We need to conduct a more in-depth investigation into this issue.

sentences.chinese: 对很多人来说，家人的支持是最珍贵的财富。
sentences.traditional: 對很多人來說，家人的支持是最珍貴的財富。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō rén lái shuō, jiārén de zhīchí shì zuì zhēnguì de cáifù.
sentences.translation: For many people, their family’s support is the most precious wealth.

sentences.chinese: 这张老照片保存了珍贵的回忆。
sentences.traditional: 這張老照片保存了珍貴的回憶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng lǎo zhàopiàn bǎocún le zhēnguì de huíyì.
sentences.translation: This old photograph preserves precious memories.

sentences.chinese: 时间很珍贵，不能总是浪费在无意义的事情上。
sentences.traditional: 時間很珍貴，不能總是浪費在無意義的事情上。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn zhēnguì, bù néng zǒngshì làngfèi zài wú yìyì de shìqing shang.
sentences.translation: Time is precious and should not always be wasted on meaningless things.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影根据真实事件改编。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影根據真實事件改編。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng gēnjù zhēnshí shìjiàn gǎibiān.
sentences.translation: This film was adapted from real events.

sentences.chinese: 他说出了自己真实的想法。
sentences.traditional: 他說出了自己真實的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō chū le zìjǐ zhēnshí de xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: He expressed his true thoughts.

sentences.chinese: 报道必须尽量反映真实情况。
sentences.traditional: 報導必須盡量反映真實情況。
sentences.pinyin: Bàodào bìxū jǐnliàng fǎnyìng zhēnshí qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Reports must reflect the real situation as much as possible.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该珍惜现在拥有的学习机会。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該珍惜現在擁有的學習機會。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zhēnxī xiànzài yōngyǒu de xuéxí jīhuì.
sentences.translation: We should cherish the learning opportunities we have now.

sentences.chinese: 经过那次事故后，他更加珍惜生命。
sentences.traditional: 經過那次事故後，他更加珍惜生命。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì shìgù hòu, tā gèngjiā zhēnxī shēngmìng.
sentences.translation: After that accident, he cherished life even more.

sentences.chinese: 真正的朋友不多，遇到了就要珍惜。
sentences.traditional: 真正的朋友不多，遇到了就要珍惜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyou bù duō, yùdào le jiù yào zhēnxī.
sentences.translation: True friends are not many; when you meet them, you should cherish them.

sentences.chinese: 医生根据检查结果作出了初步诊断。
sentences.traditional: 醫生根據檢查結果作出了初步診斷。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gēnjù jiǎnchá jiéguǒ zuò chū le chūbù zhěnduàn.
sentences.translation: The doctor made a preliminary diagnosis based on the examination results.

sentences.chinese: 这种新设备能帮助医生更准确地诊断疾病。
sentences.traditional: 這種新設備能幫助醫生更準確地診斷疾病。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn shèbèi néng bāngzhù yīshēng gèng zhǔnquè de zhěnduàn jíbìng.
sentences.translation: This new equipment can help doctors diagnose illnesses more accurately.

sentences.chinese: 早期诊断对治疗非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 早期診斷對治療非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoqī zhěnduàn duì zhìliáo fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Early diagnosis is very important for treatment.

sentences.chinese: 门外传来一阵急促的脚步声。
sentences.traditional: 門外傳來一陣急促的腳步聲。
sentences.pinyin: Mén wài chuán lái yí zhèn jícù de jiǎobù shēng.
sentences.translation: A burst of hurried footsteps came from outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 午后下了一阵大雨，空气变得清新。
sentences.traditional: 午後下了一陣大雨，空氣變得清新。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔhòu xià le yí zhèn dàyǔ, kōngqì biàn de qīngxīn.
sentences.translation: There was a heavy shower in the afternoon, and the air became fresh.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，大家爆发出一阵掌声。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，大家爆發出一陣掌聲。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, dàjiā bàofā chū yí zhèn zhǎngshēng.
sentences.translation: Hearing this news, everyone burst into applause.

sentences.chinese: 两家公司正在争同一个项目。
sentences.traditional: 兩家公司正在爭同一個項目。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī zhèngzài zhēng tóng yí ge xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: Two companies are competing for the same project.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们为了谁先玩玩具争了起来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們為了誰先玩玩具爭了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen wèi le shéi xiān wán wánjù zhēng le qǐlai.
sentences.translation: The children started arguing over who could play with the toy first.

sentences.chinese: 做事不要只争面子，更要看实际效果。
sentences.traditional: 做事不要只爭面子，更要看實際效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò shì bú yào zhǐ zhēng miànzi, gèng yào kàn shíjì xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: When doing things, do not only fight for face; look at the actual results too.

sentences.chinese: 我们会继续争取客户的信任。
sentences.traditional: 我們會繼續爭取客戶的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen huì jìxù zhēngqǔ kèhù de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: We will continue to strive for the customer’s trust.

sentences.chinese: 她努力学习，是为了争取奖学金。
sentences.traditional: 她努力學習，是為了爭取獎學金。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǔlì xuéxí, shì wèi le zhēngqǔ jiǎngxuéjīn.
sentences.translation: She studies hard in order to strive for a scholarship.

sentences.chinese: 代表们希望通过谈判争取更多支持。
sentences.traditional: 代表們希望通過談判爭取更多支持。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎo men xīwàng tòuguò tánpàn zhēngqǔ gèng duō zhīchí.
sentences.translation: The representatives hope to win more support through negotiation.

sentences.chinese: 书架上的图书摆得很整齐。
sentences.traditional: 書架上的圖書擺得很整齊。
sentences.pinyin: Shūjià shang de túshū bǎi de hěn zhěngqí.
sentences.translation: The books on the bookshelf are arranged very neatly.

sentences.chinese: 请把桌上的资料整理整齐，再交给老师。
sentences.traditional: 請把桌上的資料整理整齊，再交給老師。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhuō shang de zīliào zhěnglǐ zhěngqí, zài jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: Please organise the materials on the desk neatly before giving them to the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 这支队伍走得很整齐，给观众留下了深刻印象。
sentences.traditional: 這支隊伍走得很整齊，給觀眾留下了深刻印象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī duìwu zǒu de hěn zhěngqí, gěi guānzhòng liú xià le shēnkè yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: This team marched in a very orderly way, leaving a deep impression on the audience.

sentences.chinese: 不能只看个别细节，还要把握整体方向。
sentences.traditional: 不能只看個別細節，還要把握整體方向。
sentences.pinyin: Bù néng zhǐ kàn gèbié xìjié, hái yào bǎwò zhěngtǐ fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: You cannot look only at individual details; you also need to grasp the overall direction.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划从整体上看比较合理，但还需要修改。
sentences.traditional: 這個計劃從整體上看比較合理，但還需要修改。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà cóng zhěngtǐ shang kàn bǐjiào hélǐ, dàn hái xūyào xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: Seen as a whole, this plan is fairly reasonable, but it still needs revision.

sentences.chinese: 这次改革关系到公司的整体利益。
sentences.traditional: 這次改革關係到公司的整體利益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gǎigé guānxì dào gōngsī de zhěngtǐ lìyì.
sentences.translation: This reform concerns the overall interests of the company.

sentences.chinese: 他为了完成报告，整整工作了一个晚上。
sentences.traditional: 他為了完成報告，整整工作了一個晚上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèi le wánchéng bàogào, zhěngzhěng gōngzuò le yí ge wǎnshang.
sentences.translation: To finish the report, he worked for a whole night.

sentences.chinese: 我们在机场等了整整三个小时。
sentences.traditional: 我們在機場等了整整三個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jīchǎng děng le zhěngzhěng sān ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: We waited at the airport for a full three hours.

sentences.chinese: 这本书她整整读了两个月才读完。
sentences.traditional: 這本書她整整讀了兩個月才讀完。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tā zhěngzhěng dú le liǎng ge yuè cái dú wán.
sentences.translation: It took her a full two months to finish reading this book.

sentences.chinese: 他暑假打工挣了一些生活费。
sentences.traditional: 他暑假打工掙了一些生活費。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǔjià dǎgōng zhèng le yì xiē shēnghuó fèi.
sentences.translation: He earned some living expenses by working during the summer holiday.

sentences.chinese: 靠体力挣钱并不容易。
sentences.traditional: 靠體力掙錢並不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Kào tǐlì zhèng qián bìng bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: It is not easy to earn money through physical labour.

sentences.chinese: 她希望毕业后能自己挣钱养活自己。
sentences.traditional: 她希望畢業後能自己掙錢養活自己。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng bìyè hòu néng zìjǐ zhèng qián yǎnghuo zìjǐ.
sentences.translation: She hopes to earn money herself after graduation and support herself.

sentences.chinese: 当地政府公布了新的交通规划。
sentences.traditional: 當地政府公佈了新的交通規劃。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì zhèngfǔ gōngbù le xīn de jiāotōng guīhuà.
sentences.translation: The local government announced a new transport plan.

sentences.chinese: 企业应当遵守政府制定的法律规定。
sentences.traditional: 企業應當遵守政府制定的法律規定。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīngdāng zūnshǒu zhèngfǔ zhìdìng de fǎlǜ guīdìng.
sentences.translation: Enterprises should obey the laws and regulations made by the government.

sentences.chinese: 警察需要更多证据才能判断事实。
sentences.traditional: 警察需要更多證據才能判斷事實。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá xūyào gèng duō zhèngjù cái néng pànduàn shìshí.
sentences.translation: The police need more evidence before they can judge the facts.

sentences.chinese: 这份文件是支持我们观点的重要证据。
sentences.traditional: 這份文件是支持我們觀點的重要證據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn shì zhīchí wǒmen guāndiǎn de zhòngyào zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: This document is important evidence supporting our view.

sentences.chinese: 没有可靠证据，我们不能随便下结论。
sentences.traditional: 沒有可靠證據，我們不能隨便下結論。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu kěkào zhèngjù, wǒmen bù néng suíbiàn xià jiélùn.
sentences.translation: Without reliable evidence, we cannot draw conclusions casually.

sentences.chinese: 正如老师所说，语言需要长期练习。
sentences.traditional: 正如老師所說，語言需要長期練習。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngrú lǎoshī suǒ shuō, yǔyán xūyào chángqī liànxí.
sentences.translation: As the teacher said, language requires long-term practice.

sentences.chinese: 正如数据显示，销量正在逐步上升。
sentences.traditional: 正如數據顯示，銷量正在逐步上升。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngrú shùjù xiǎnshì, xiāoliàng zhèngzài zhúbù shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: As the data shows, sales volume is gradually rising.

sentences.chinese: 正如大家看到的，项目已经取得明显进展。
sentences.traditional: 正如大家看到的，項目已經取得明顯進展。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngrú dàjiā kàn dào de, xiàngmù yǐjīng qǔdé míngxiǎn jìnzhǎn.
sentences.translation: As everyone can see, the project has already made clear progress.

sentences.chinese: 完成培训后，每位学员都会获得证书。
sentences.traditional: 完成培訓後，每位學員都會獲得證書。
sentences.pinyin: Wánchéng péixùn hòu, měi wèi xuéyuán dōu huì huòdé zhèngshū.
sentences.translation: After completing the training, every learner will receive a certificate.

sentences.chinese: 这份证书证明他具备相关资格。
sentences.traditional: 這份證書證明他具備相關資格。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn zhèngshū zhèngmíng tā jùbèi xiāngguān zīgé.
sentences.translation: This certificate proves that he has the relevant qualifications.

sentences.chinese: 她把毕业证书放在书房的抽屉里。
sentences.traditional: 她把畢業證書放在書房的抽屜裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ bìyè zhèngshū fàng zài shūfáng de chōuti li.
sentences.translation: She put her graduation certificate in the drawer in the study.

sentences.chinese: 他对国际政治很感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 他對國際政治很感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì guójì zhèngzhì hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: He is very interested in international politics.

sentences.chinese: 这门课程主要讨论现代政治制度。
sentences.traditional: 這門課程主要討論現代政治制度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng zhǔyào tǎolùn xiàndài zhèngzhì zhìdù.
sentences.translation: This course mainly discusses modern political systems.

sentences.chinese: 新闻报道应该避免传播极端政治观点。
sentences.traditional: 新聞報導應該避免傳播極端政治觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnwén bàodào yīnggāi bìmiǎn chuánbō jíduān zhèngzhì guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: News reports should avoid spreading extreme political views.

sentences.chinese: 请给我一支黑色的笔。
sentences.traditional: 請給我一支黑色的筆。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì zhī hēisè de bǐ.
sentences.translation: Please give me a black pen.

sentences.chinese: 她买了一支新的牙刷。
sentences.traditional: 她買了一支新的牙刷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì zhī xīn de yáshuā.
sentences.translation: She bought a new toothbrush.

sentences.chinese: 这支队伍在比赛中表现得很团结。
sentences.traditional: 這支隊伍在比賽中表現得很團結。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī duìwu zài bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn de hěn tuánjié.
sentences.translation: This team showed great unity in the competition.

sentences.chinese: 这位知名学者将到学校演讲。
sentences.traditional: 這位知名學者將到學校演講。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhīmíng xuézhě jiāng dào xuéxiào yǎnjiǎng.
sentences.translation: This well-known scholar will come to the school to give a speech.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司是国内知名的手机品牌。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司是國內知名的手機品牌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shì guónèi zhīmíng de shǒujī pǐnpái.
sentences.translation: This company is a well-known domestic mobile phone brand.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅因为特色菜而变得越来越知名。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳因為特色菜而變得越來越知名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng yīnwèi tèsè cài ér biàn de yuè lái yuè zhīmíng.
sentences.translation: This restaurant has become increasingly well-known because of its speciality dishes.

sentences.chinese: 这条路很直，开车过去比较省时间。
sentences.traditional: 這條路很直，開車過去比較省時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn zhí, kāichē guòqù bǐjiào shěng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: This road is very straight, so driving there saves time.

sentences.chinese: 他坐得很直，看起来特别认真。
sentences.traditional: 他坐得很直，看起來特別認真。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò de hěn zhí, kàn qǐlái tèbié rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: He sits very straight and looks especially serious.

sentences.chinese: 他直说自己的意见，没有绕弯子。
sentences.traditional: 他直說自己的意見，沒有繞彎子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhí shuō zìjǐ de yìjiàn, méiyǒu rào wānzi.
sentences.translation: He stated his opinion directly, without beating around the bush.

sentences.chinese: 这场比赛将在网上直播。
sentences.traditional: 這場比賽將在網上直播。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài jiāng zài wǎngshàng zhíbō.
sentences.translation: This match will be broadcast live online.

sentences.chinese: 公司通过直播介绍新产品。
sentences.traditional: 公司通過直播介紹新產品。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī tōngguò zhíbō jièshào xīn chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: The company introduces new products through live broadcasts.

sentences.chinese: 他第一次做直播，有点紧张。
sentences.traditional: 他第一次做直播，有點緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì zuò zhíbō, yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: It was his first time doing a live broadcast, so he was a little nervous.

sentences.chinese: 初入职场的人要学会主动沟通。
sentences.traditional: 初入職場的人要學會主動溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Chū rù zhíchǎng de rén yào xuéhuì zhǔdòng gōutōng.
sentences.translation: People new to the workplace need to learn to communicate actively.

sentences.chinese: 职场压力大时，更需要保持良好的心态。
sentences.traditional: 職場壓力大時，更需要保持良好的心態。
sentences.pinyin: Zhíchǎng yālì dà shí, gèng xūyào bǎochí liánghǎo de xīntài.
