sentences.translation: When workplace pressure is high, it is even more important to keep a good mindset.

sentences.chinese: 她在职场中积累了丰富的经验。
sentences.traditional: 她在職場中積累了豐富的經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhíchǎng zhōng jīlěi le fēngfù de jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: She has built up rich experience in the workplace.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂有三百多名职工。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠有三百多名職工。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng yǒu sānbǎi duō míng zhígōng.
sentences.translation: This factory has more than three hundred staff members.

sentences.chinese: 公司定期为职工提供安全培训。
sentences.traditional: 公司定期為職工提供安全培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī dìngqī wèi zhígōng tígōng ānquán péixùn.
sentences.translation: The company regularly provides safety training for staff.

sentences.chinese: 职工代表参加了今天的会议。
sentences.traditional: 職工代表參加了今天的會議。
sentences.pinyin: Zhígōng dàibiǎo cānjiā le jīntiān de huìyì.
sentences.translation: The staff representatives attended today’s meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划下周开始执行。
sentences.traditional: 這個計畫下週開始執行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà xià zhōu kāishǐ zhíxíng.
sentences.translation: This plan will start to be carried out next week.

sentences.chinese: 法院决定严格执行相关规定。
sentences.traditional: 法院決定嚴格執行相關規定。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎyuàn juédìng yángé zhíxíng xiāngguān guīdìng.
sentences.translation: The court decided to strictly enforce the relevant regulations.

sentences.chinese: 执行任务时，他们必须保持联系。
sentences.traditional: 執行任務時，他們必須保持聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhíxíng rènwu shí, tāmen bìxū bǎochí liánxì.
sentences.translation: When carrying out a task, they must stay in contact.

sentences.chinese: 这件事到此为止，不要再讨论了。
sentences.traditional: 這件事到此為止，不要再討論了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dào cǐ wéi zhǐ, bú yào zài tǎolùn le.
sentences.translation: Let this matter stop here; don’t discuss it further.

sentences.chinese: 医生说，出血已经止住了。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說，出血已經止住了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, chūxuè yǐjīng zhǐ zhù le.
sentences.translation: The doctor said the bleeding has already stopped.

sentences.chinese: 雨一直没有止，我们决定改天出发。
sentences.traditional: 雨一直沒有止，我們決定改天出發。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ yìzhí méiyǒu zhǐ, wǒmen juédìng gǎitiān chūfā.
sentences.translation: The rain did not stop, so we decided to set off another day.

sentences.chinese: 老师耐心指导学生完成实验。
sentences.traditional: 老師耐心指導學生完成實驗。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī nàixīn zhǐdǎo xuésheng wánchéng shíyàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher patiently guided the students in completing the experiment.

sentences.chinese: 这本书对写作有很强的指导作用。
sentences.traditional: 這本書對寫作有很強的指導作用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū duì xiězuò yǒu hěn qiáng de zhǐdǎo zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: This book has a strong guiding effect on writing.

sentences.chinese: 在专家的指导下，项目进展顺利。
sentences.traditional: 在專家的指導下，項目進展順利。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhuānjiā de zhǐdǎo xià, xiàngmù jìnzhǎn shùnlì.
sentences.translation: Under the expert’s guidance, the project progressed smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 会议时间由九点至十一点。
sentences.traditional: 會議時間由九點至十一點。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shíjiān yóu jiǔ diǎn zhì shíyī diǎn.
sentences.translation: The meeting time is from nine to eleven.

sentences.chinese: 这条铁路一直修至边境城市。
sentences.traditional: 這條鐵路一直修至邊境城市。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù yìzhí xiū zhì biānjìng chéngshì.
sentences.translation: This railway was built all the way to the border city.

sentences.chinese: 气温降至零度以下。
sentences.traditional: 氣溫降至零度以下。
sentences.pinyin: Qìwēn jiàng zhì líng dù yǐxià.
sentences.translation: The temperature dropped to below zero.

sentences.chinese: 这种药能治普通的头痛。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥能治普通的頭痛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào néng zhì pǔtōng de tóutòng.
sentences.translation: This kind of medicine can treat ordinary headaches.

sentences.chinese: 他花了半年时间才把胃病治好。
sentences.traditional: 他花了半年時間才把胃病治好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huā le bàn nián shíjiān cái bǎ wèibìng zhì hǎo.
sentences.translation: It took him half a year to cure his stomach illness.

sentences.chinese: 一个国家要依法治国，社会才会更稳定。
sentences.traditional: 一個國家要依法治國，社會才會更穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge guójiā yào yīfǎ zhì guó, shèhuì cái huì gèng wěndìng.
sentences.translation: A country should govern according to law so that society can be more stable.

sentences.chinese: 学校正在制订新的安全制度。
sentences.traditional: 學校正在制訂新的安全制度。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhèngzài zhìdìng xīn de ānquán zhìdù.
sentences.translation: The school is formulating a new safety system.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要根据实际情况制订计划。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要根據實際情況制訂計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào gēnjù shíjì qíngkuàng zhìdìng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: We need to formulate a plan according to the actual situation.

sentences.chinese: 政府将制订更严格的环保标准。
sentences.traditional: 政府將制訂更嚴格的環保標準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiāng zhìdìng gèng yángé de huánbǎo biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: The government will formulate stricter environmental protection standards.

sentences.chinese: 公司已经制定了新的培训计划。
sentences.traditional: 公司已經制定了新的培訓計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yǐjīng zhìdìng le xīn de péixùn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The company has already formulated a new training plan.

sentences.chinese: 学校需要制定更清楚的考试规则。
sentences.traditional: 學校需要制定更清楚的考試規則。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào xūyào zhìdìng gèng qīngchu de kǎoshì guīzé.
sentences.translation: The school needs to establish clearer exam rules.

sentences.chinese: 专家建议先调查需求，再制定方案。
sentences.traditional: 專家建議先調查需求，再制定方案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā jiànyì xiān diàochá xūqiú, zài zhìdìng fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: The expert suggested first investigating demand and then formulating a plan.

sentences.chinese: 完善的制度有助于减少管理失误。
sentences.traditional: 完善的制度有助於減少管理失誤。
sentences.pinyin: Wánshàn de zhìdù yǒuzhùyú jiǎnshǎo guǎnlǐ shīwù.
sentences.translation: A well-developed system helps reduce management errors.

sentences.chinese: 这项制度实施以后，效率明显提高了。
sentences.traditional: 這項制度實施以後，效率明顯提高了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhìdù shíshī yǐhòu, xiàolǜ míngxiǎn tígāo le.
sentences.translation: After this system was implemented, efficiency clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 任何单位都应该遵守安全制度。
sentences.traditional: 任何單位都應該遵守安全制度。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé dānwèi dōu yīnggāi zūnshǒu ānquán zhìdù.
sentences.translation: Every organisation should follow the safety system.

sentences.chinese: 真正的智慧不只是知识，还包括判断力。
sentences.traditional: 真正的智慧不只是知識，還包括判斷力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de zhìhuì bù zhǐ shì zhīshi, hái bāokuò pànduànlì.
sentences.translation: True wisdom is not only knowledge; it also includes judgement.

sentences.chinese: 老人用生活智慧解决了这个难题。
sentences.traditional: 老人用生活智慧解決了這個難題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén yòng shēnghuó zhìhuì jiějué le zhège nántí.
sentences.translation: The old person used life wisdom to solve this difficult problem.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市正在发展智慧交通系统。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市正在發展智慧交通系統。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì zhèngzài fāzhǎn zhìhuì jiāotōng xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: This city is developing an intelligent transport system.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究至今仍没有明确结论。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究至今仍沒有明確結論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū zhìjīn réng méiyǒu míngquè jiélùn.
sentences.translation: This research still has no clear conclusion so far.

sentences.chinese: 他离开家乡多年，至今没有回来。
sentences.traditional: 他離開家鄉多年，至今沒有回來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā líkāi jiāxiāng duō nián, zhìjīn méiyǒu huílái.
sentences.translation: He left his hometown many years ago and still has not returned.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥建成至今已经有一百年了。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋建成至今已經有一百年了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo jiànchéng zhìjīn yǐjīng yǒu yìbǎi nián le.
sentences.translation: It has been one hundred years since this bridge was completed.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他尽快接受治疗。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他盡快接受治療。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā jǐnkuài jiēshòu zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to receive treatment as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这种方法可以治疗轻度疼痛。
sentences.traditional: 這種方法可以治療輕度疼痛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ kěyǐ zhìliáo qīngdù téngtòng.
sentences.translation: This method can treat mild pain.

sentences.chinese: 长期治疗需要病人和医生互相信任。
sentences.traditional: 長期治療需要病人和醫生互相信任。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī zhìliáo xūyào bìngrén hé yīshēng hùxiāng xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: Long-term treatment requires mutual trust between the patient and the doctor.

sentences.chinese: 智能手机已经改变了人们的生活方式。
sentences.traditional: 智能手機已經改變了人們的生活方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìnéng shǒujī yǐjīng gǎibiàn le rénmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Smartphones have already changed people’s way of life.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统能根据数据做出智能判断。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統能根據數據做出智能判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng néng gēnjù shùjù zuòchū zhìnéng pànduàn.
sentences.translation: This system can make intelligent judgements based on data.

sentences.chinese: 人工智能正在被应用到医疗领域。
sentences.traditional: 人工智能正在被應用到醫療領域。
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng zhèngzài bèi yìngyòng dào yīliáo lǐngyù.
sentences.translation: Artificial intelligence is being applied to the medical field.

sentences.chinese: 很多志愿者参加了这次环保活动。
sentences.traditional: 很多志願者參加了這次環保活動。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō zhìyuànzhě cānjiā le zhè cì huánbǎo huódòng.
sentences.translation: Many volunteers took part in this environmental protection activity.

sentences.chinese: 她周末去医院做志愿者。
sentences.traditional: 她週末去醫院做志願者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōumò qù yīyuàn zuò zhìyuànzhě.
sentences.translation: She goes to the hospital at weekends to work as a volunteer.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者们耐心地为老人提供帮助。
sentences.traditional: 志願者們耐心地為老人提供幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě men nàixīn de wèi lǎorén tígōng bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: The volunteers patiently provided help to the elderly.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂主要制造医疗设备。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠主要製造醫療設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhǔyào zhìzào yīliáo shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This factory mainly manufactures medical equipment.

sentences.chinese: 不负责任的报道可能会制造恐慌。
sentences.traditional: 不負責任的報導可能會製造恐慌。
sentences.pinyin: Bú fùzérèn de bàodào kěnéng huì zhìzào kǒnghuāng.
sentences.translation: Irresponsible reporting may create panic.

sentences.chinese: 企业正在学习更环保的制造方式。
sentences.traditional: 企業正在學習更環保的製造方式。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè zhèngzài xuéxí gèng huánbǎo de zhìzào fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Enterprises are learning more environmentally friendly manufacturing methods.

sentences.chinese: 他们花了三个月制作这部纪录片。
sentences.traditional: 他們花了三個月製作這部紀錄片。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen huā le sān ge yuè zhìzuò zhè bù jìlùpiàn.
sentences.translation: They spent three months making this documentary.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件可以用来制作简单的图表。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件可以用來製作簡單的圖表。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ yòng lái zhìzuò jiǎndān de túbiǎo.
sentences.translation: This software can be used to make simple charts.

sentences.chinese: 手工制作的礼物更有意义。
sentences.traditional: 手工製作的禮物更有意義。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒugōng zhìzuò de lǐwù gèng yǒu yìyì.
sentences.translation: Handmade gifts are more meaningful.

sentences.chinese: 中华文化有着悠久的历史。
sentences.traditional: 中華文化有著悠久的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōnghuá wénhuà yǒuzhe yōujiǔ de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: Chinese culture has a long history.

sentences.chinese: 中华民族重视家庭和教育。
sentences.traditional: 中華民族重視家庭和教育。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōnghuá mínzú zhòngshì jiātíng hé jiàoyù.
sentences.translation: The Chinese nation values family and education.

sentences.chinese: 这本书介绍了中华文明的形成过程。
sentences.traditional: 這本書介紹了中華文明的形成過程。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jièshào le Zhōnghuá wénmíng de xíngchéng guòchéng.
sentences.translation: This book introduces the formation process of Chinese civilisation.

sentences.chinese: 中华民族的历史充满了交流与融合。
sentences.traditional: 中華民族的歷史充滿了交流與融合。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōnghuá Mínzú de lìshǐ chōngmǎn le jiāoliú yǔ rónghé.
sentences.translation: The history of the Chinese nation is full of exchange and integration.

sentences.chinese: 保护文化遗产是中华民族共同的责任。
sentences.traditional: 保護文化遺產是中華民族共同的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù wénhuà yíchǎn shì Zhōnghuá Mínzú gòngtóng de zérèn.
sentences.translation: Protecting cultural heritage is a shared responsibility of the Chinese nation.

sentences.chinese: 中华民族在困难面前表现出强大的力量。
sentences.traditional: 中華民族在困難面前表現出強大的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōnghuá Mínzú zài kùnnan miànqián biǎoxiàn chū qiángdà de lìliàng.
sentences.translation: The Chinese nation shows great strength in the face of difficulty.

sentences.chinese: 这门中级课程适合有基础的学习者。
sentences.traditional: 這門中級課程適合有基礎的學習者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén zhōngjí kèchéng shìhé yǒu jīchǔ de xuéxízhě.
sentences.translation: This intermediate course is suitable for learners with a foundation.

sentences.chinese: 他通过了中级汉语考试，准备继续学高级内容。
sentences.traditional: 他通過了中級漢語考試，準備繼續學高級內容。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngguò le zhōngjí Hànyǔ kǎoshì, zhǔnbèi jìxù xué gāojí nèiróng.
sentences.translation: He passed the intermediate Chinese exam and is preparing to continue with advanced content.

sentences.chinese: 这个职位要求申请人具备中级计算机能力。
sentences.traditional: 這個職位要求申請人具備中級計算機能力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhíwèi yāoqiú shēnqǐngrén jùbèi zhōngjí jìsuànjī nénglì.
sentences.translation: This position requires applicants to have intermediate computer skills.

sentences.chinese: 我们通过中介找到了这套房子。
sentences.traditional: 我們通過中介找到了這套房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen tōngguò zhōngjiè zhǎodào le zhè tào fángzi.
sentences.translation: We found this flat through an agency.

sentences.chinese: 找工作时，不要轻易相信收费很高的中介。
sentences.traditional: 找工作時，不要輕易相信收費很高的中介。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎo gōngzuò shí, bú yào qīngyì xiāngxìn shōufèi hěn gāo de zhōngjiè.
sentences.translation: When looking for work, do not easily trust agencies that charge very high fees.

sentences.chinese: 中介需要把买卖双方的信息说明清楚。
sentences.traditional: 中介需要把買賣雙方的信息說明清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngjiè xūyào bǎ mǎimài shuāngfāng de xìnxī shuōmíng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The intermediary needs to explain the information of both sides of the sale clearly.

sentences.chinese: 项目进入中期以后，资金压力明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 項目進入中期以後，資金壓力明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù jìnrù zhōngqī yǐhòu, zījīn yālì míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: After the project entered its middle stage, financial pressure clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 学期中期会有一次全面的学习检查。
sentences.traditional: 學期中期會有一次全面的學習檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéqī zhōngqī huì yǒu yí cì quánmiàn de xuéxí jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: There will be a full study check in the middle of the semester.

sentences.chinese: 中期目标实现以后，我们再讨论长期计划。
sentences.traditional: 中期目標實現以後，我們再討論長期計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngqī mùbiāo shíxiàn yǐhòu, wǒmen zài tǎolùn chángqī jìhuà.
sentences.translation: After the mid-term goal is achieved, we will discuss the long-term plan.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学重视中外文化交流。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學重視中外文化交流。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué zhòngshì zhōngwài wénhuà jiāoliú.
sentences.translation: This university values cultural exchange between China and other countries.

sentences.chinese: 展览展示了中外艺术家的优秀作品。
sentences.traditional: 展覽展示了中外藝術家的優秀作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎnlǎn zhǎnshì le zhōngwài yìshùjiā de yōuxiù zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: The exhibition displayed excellent works by Chinese and foreign artists.

sentences.chinese: 这本书比较了中外教育制度的不同。
sentences.traditional: 這本書比較了中外教育制度的不同。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bǐjiào le zhōngwài jiàoyù zhìdù de bùtóng.
sentences.translation: This book compares differences between Chinese and foreign education systems.

sentences.chinese: 会议中心离地铁站很近。
sentences.traditional: 會議中心離地鐵站很近。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì zhōngxīn lí dìtiězhàn hěn jìn.
sentences.translation: The conference centre is very close to the underground station.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题一直是讨论的中心。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題一直是討論的中心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yìzhí shì tǎolùn de zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: This issue has always been the centre of the discussion.

sentences.chinese: 市中心的交通在早高峰非常拥挤。
sentences.traditional: 市中心的交通在早高峰非常擁擠。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhōngxīn de jiāotōng zài zǎo gāofēng fēicháng yōngjǐ.
sentences.translation: Traffic in the city centre is very crowded during the morning rush hour.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他先试试中药治疗。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他先試試中藥治療。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā xiān shìshi zhōngyào zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested that he first try treatment with traditional Chinese medicine.

sentences.chinese: 有些中药需要按照说明认真煮。
sentences.traditional: 有些中藥需要按照說明認真煮。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu xiē zhōngyào xūyào ànzhào shuōmíng rènzhēn zhǔ.
sentences.translation: Some Chinese medicines need to be boiled carefully according to the instructions.

sentences.chinese: 这种中药味道苦，但效果还不错。
sentences.traditional: 這種中藥味道苦，但效果還不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhōngyào wèidào kǔ, dàn xiàoguǒ hái búcuò.
sentences.translation: This Chinese medicine tastes bitter, but the effect is quite good.

sentences.chinese: 这位中医给病人详细解释了病情。
sentences.traditional: 這位中醫給病人詳細解釋了病情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhōngyī gěi bìngrén xiángxì jiěshì le bìngqíng.
sentences.translation: This traditional Chinese medicine doctor explained the condition to the patient in detail.

sentences.chinese: 中医认为饮食和睡眠都很重要。
sentences.traditional: 中醫認為飲食和睡眠都很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngyī rènwéi yǐnshí hé shuìmián dōu hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Traditional Chinese medicine considers both diet and sleep very important.

sentences.chinese: 她学习中医已经五年了。
sentences.traditional: 她學習中醫已經五年了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuéxí zhōngyī yǐjīng wǔ nián le.
sentences.translation: She has been studying traditional Chinese medicine for five years.

sentences.chinese: 这个博物馆收藏了很多种类的作品。
sentences.traditional: 這個博物館收藏了很多種類的作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bówùguǎn shōucáng le hěn duō zhǒnglèi de zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: This museum has collected many types of works.

sentences.chinese: 商店里的甜品种类很丰富。
sentences.traditional: 商店裡的甜品種類很豐富。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn li de tiánpǐn zhǒnglèi hěn fēngfù.
sentences.translation: The shop has a rich variety of desserts.

sentences.chinese: 不同种类的植物需要不同的水分。
sentences.traditional: 不同種類的植物需要不同的水分。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng zhǒnglèi de zhíwù xūyào bùtóng de shuǐfèn.
sentences.translation: Different types of plants need different amounts of water.

sentences.chinese: 春天到了，农民开始把种子种进地里。
sentences.traditional: 春天到了，農民開始把種子種進地裡。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, nóngmín kāishǐ bǎ zhǒngzi zhòng jìn dì li.
sentences.translation: Spring has arrived, and farmers are starting to plant seeds in the fields.

sentences.chinese: 这些种子适合在温暖的环境中生长。
sentences.traditional: 這些種子適合在溫暖的環境中生長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhǒngzi shìhé zài wēnnuǎn de huánjìng zhōng shēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: These seeds are suitable for growing in a warm environment.

sentences.chinese: 每颗种子都有可能长成一棵树。
sentences.traditional: 每顆種子都有可能長成一棵樹。
sentences.pinyin: Měi kē zhǒngzi dōu yǒu kěnéng zhǎng chéng yì kē shù.
sentences.translation: Every seed may grow into a tree.

sentences.chinese: 这次事故造成了重大损失。
sentences.traditional: 這次事故造成了重大損失。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù zàochéng le zhòngdà sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: This accident caused major losses.

sentences.chinese: 政府宣布了一项重大决定。
sentences.traditional: 政府宣布了一項重大決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù le yí xiàng zhòngdà juédìng.
sentences.translation: The government announced a major decision.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目对公司发展有重大意义。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目對公司發展有重大意義。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù duì gōngsī fāzhǎn yǒu zhòngdà yìyì.
sentences.translation: This project has major significance for the company's development.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市吸引了众多游客。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市吸引了眾多遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì xīyǐn le zhòngduō yóukè.
sentences.translation: This city has attracted numerous tourists.

sentences.chinese: 众多专家参加了这次会议。
sentences.traditional: 眾多專家參加了這次會議。
sentences.pinyin: Zhòngduō zhuānjiā cānjiā le zhè cì huìyì.
sentences.translation: Numerous experts attended this meeting.

sentences.chinese: 在众多选择中，他最终选了最简单的方案。
sentences.traditional: 在眾多選擇中，他最終選了最簡單的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhòngduō xuǎnzé zhōng, tā zuìzhōng xuǎn le zuì jiǎndān de fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: Among numerous choices, he finally chose the simplest plan.

sentences.chinese: 这个包的重量超过了航空公司的限制。
sentences.traditional: 這個包的重量超過了航空公司的限制。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bāo de zhòngliàng chāoguò le hángkōng gōngsī de xiànzhì.
sentences.translation: The weight of this bag exceeds the airline's limit.

sentences.chinese: 机器会自动显示商品的重量。
sentences.traditional: 機器會自動顯示商品的重量。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì huì zìdòng xiǎnshì shāngpǐn de zhòngliàng.
sentences.translation: The machine will automatically display the weight of the product.

sentences.chinese: 这块石头的重量比我想象的大得多。
sentences.traditional: 這塊石頭的重量比我想像的大得多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài shítou de zhòngliàng bǐ wǒ xiǎngxiàng de dà de duō.
sentences.translation: The weight of this stone is much greater than I imagined.

sentences.chinese: 当地农民主要种植玉米和蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 當地農民主要種植玉米和蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì nóngmín zhǔyào zhòngzhí yùmǐ hé shūcài.
sentences.translation: Local farmers mainly plant corn and vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 种植树木有助于改善城市环境。
sentences.traditional: 種植樹木有助於改善城市環境。
sentences.pinyin: Zhòngzhí shùmù yǒuzhùyú gǎishàn chéngshì huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Planting trees helps improve the urban environment.

sentences.chinese: 这片土地适合种植水果。
sentences.traditional: 這片土地適合種植水果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔdì shìhé zhòngzhí shuǐguǒ.
sentences.translation: This piece of land is suitable for planting fruit.

sentences.chinese: 公司成立十周年那天举行了庆祝活动。
sentences.traditional: 公司成立十週年那天舉行了慶祝活動。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī chénglì shí zhōunián nà tiān jǔxíng le qìngzhù huódòng.
sentences.translation: The company held a celebration on the day of its tenth anniversary.

sentences.chinese: 今年是学校建校一百周年。
sentences.traditional: 今年是學校建校一百週年。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián shì xuéxiào jiànxiào yìbǎi zhōunián.
sentences.translation: This year is the school's hundredth anniversary.

sentences.chinese: 为了纪念结婚周年，他们一起去旅行。
sentences.traditional: 為了紀念結婚週年，他們一起去旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jìniàn jiéhūn zhōunián, tāmen yìqǐ qù lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: To celebrate their wedding anniversary, they went travelling together.

sentences.chinese: 农场里养了几头猪。
sentences.traditional: 農場裡養了幾頭豬。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngchǎng li yǎng le jǐ tóu zhū.
sentences.translation: There are several pigs on the farm.

sentences.chinese: 这种猪长得很快，适合大规模养殖。
sentences.traditional: 這種豬長得很快，適合大規模養殖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhū zhǎng de hěn kuài, shìhé dà guīmó yǎngzhí.
sentences.translation: This kind of pig grows quickly and is suitable for large-scale farming.

sentences.chinese: 小孩子在图画书里看到了一只粉色的猪。
sentences.traditional: 小孩子在圖畫書裡看到了一隻粉色的豬。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo háizi zài túhuàshū li kàn dào le yì zhī fěnsè de zhū.
sentences.translation: The child saw a pink pig in the picture book.

sentences.chinese: 我们将逐步提高产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 我們將逐步提高產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jiāng zhúbù tígāo chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: We will gradually improve product quality.

sentences.chinese: 新政策会逐步实施。
sentences.traditional: 新政策會逐步實施。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè huì zhúbù shíshī.
sentences.translation: The new policy will be implemented step by step.

sentences.chinese: 他逐步掌握了复杂系统的用法。
sentences.traditional: 他逐步掌握了複雜系統的用法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhúbù zhǎngwò le fùzá xìtǒng de yòngfǎ.
sentences.translation: He gradually mastered how to use the complex system.

sentences.chinese: 天气逐渐变冷，夜间也有雾。
sentences.traditional: 天氣逐漸變冷，夜間也有霧。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì zhújiàn biàn lěng, yèjiān yě yǒu wù.
sentences.translation: The weather is gradually getting colder, and there is also fog at night.

sentences.chinese: 他的态度逐渐变得积极起来。
sentences.traditional: 他的態度逐漸變得積極起來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tàidu zhújiàn biàn de jījí qǐlai.
sentences.translation: His attitude gradually became more positive.

sentences.chinese: 随着训练增加，成绩逐渐提升。
sentences.traditional: 隨著訓練增加，成績逐漸提升。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe xùnliàn zēngjiā, chéngjì zhújiàn tíshēng.
sentences.translation: As training increased, the results gradually improved.

sentences.chinese: 这些竹子在雨水充足的地方生长得很快。
sentences.traditional: 這些竹子在雨水充足的地方生長得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhúzi zài yǔshuǐ chōngzú de dìfang shēngzhǎng de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: This bamboo grows quickly in places with plenty of rainwater.

sentences.chinese: 熊猫主要吃竹子。
sentences.traditional: 熊貓主要吃竹子。
sentences.pinyin: Xióngmāo zhǔyào chī zhúzi.
sentences.translation: Pandas mainly eat bamboo.

sentences.chinese: 这种竹子可以用来制作家具。
sentences.traditional: 這種竹子可以用來製作傢俱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhúzi kěyǐ yòng lái zhìzuò jiājù.
sentences.translation: This kind of bamboo can be used to make furniture.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈正在厨房里煮面条。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽正在廚房裡煮麵條。
sentences.pinyin: Māma zhèngzài chúfáng li zhǔ miàntiáo.
sentences.translation: Mum is boiling noodles in the kitchen.

sentences.chinese: 这种中药需要煮半个小时。
sentences.traditional: 這種中藥需要煮半個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhōngyào xūyào zhǔ bàn ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: This Chinese medicine needs to be boiled for half an hour.

sentences.chinese: 水煮开以后再放蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 水煮開以後再放蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ zhǔ kāi yǐhòu zài fàng shūcài.
sentences.translation: After the water has boiled, add the vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 她负责主持今天下午的会议。
sentences.traditional: 她負責主持今天下午的會議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fùzé zhǔchí jīntiān xiàwǔ de huìyì.
sentences.translation: She is responsible for chairing this afternoon's meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这位记者主持的节目很受欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這位記者主持的節目很受歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhǔchí de jiémù hěn shòu huānyíng.
sentences.translation: The programme hosted by this reporter is very popular.

sentences.chinese: 会议由王主任主持。
sentences.traditional: 會議由王主任主持。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yóu Wáng zhǔrèn zhǔchí.
sentences.translation: The meeting is chaired by Director Wang.

sentences.chinese: 他主动提出帮助新同事。
sentences.traditional: 他主動提出幫助新同事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǔdòng tíchū bāngzhù xīn tóngshì.
sentences.translation: He proactively offered to help the new colleague.

sentences.chinese: 学生应该主动思考问题，而不只是等答案。
sentences.traditional: 學生應該主動思考問題，而不只是等答案。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēng yīnggāi zhǔdòng sīkǎo wèntí, ér bú zhǐshì děng dá'àn.
sentences.translation: Students should think about problems proactively, not just wait for answers.

sentences.chinese: 如果你想进步，就要主动练习。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想進步，就要主動練習。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng jìnbù, jiù yào zhǔdòng liànxí.
sentences.translation: If you want to improve, you need to practise actively.

sentences.chinese: 这个评价太主观，缺少实际数据。
sentences.traditional: 這個評價太主觀，缺少實際數據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège píngjià tài zhǔguān, quēshǎo shíjì shùjù.
sentences.translation: This evaluation is too subjective and lacks real data.

sentences.chinese: 做决定时，我们要减少主观判断的影响。
sentences.traditional: 做決定時，我們要減少主觀判斷的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò juédìng shí, wǒmen yào jiǎnshǎo zhǔguān pànduàn de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: When making decisions, we should reduce the influence of subjective judgement.

sentences.chinese: 他的说法带有明显的主观色彩。
sentences.traditional: 他的說法帶有明顯的主觀色彩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shuōfǎ dàiyǒu míngxiǎn de zhǔguān sècǎi.
sentences.translation: His statement has an obvious subjective tone.

sentences.chinese: 房子的主人不在家。
sentences.traditional: 房子的主人不在家。
sentences.pinyin: Fángzi de zhǔrén bú zài jiā.
sentences.translation: The owner of the house is not at home.

sentences.chinese: 主人热情地迎接了所有客人。
sentences.traditional: 主人熱情地迎接了所有客人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǔrén rèqíng de yíngjiē le suǒyǒu kèrén.
sentences.translation: The host warmly welcomed all the guests.

sentences.chinese: 这只狗一听到主人的声音就跑了过来。
sentences.traditional: 這隻狗一聽到主人的聲音就跑了過來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī gǒu yì tīngdào zhǔrén de shēngyīn jiù pǎo le guòlai.
sentences.translation: As soon as the dog heard its owner's voice, it ran over.

sentences.chinese: 王主任今天要参加一个重要会议。
sentences.traditional: 王主任今天要參加一個重要會議。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng zhǔrèn jīntiān yào cānjiā yí ge zhòngyào huìyì.
sentences.translation: Director Wang will attend an important meeting today.

sentences.chinese: 这个部门的主任经验很丰富。
sentences.traditional: 這個部門的主任經驗很豐富。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bùmén de zhǔrèn jīngyàn hěn fēngfù.
sentences.translation: The head of this department has rich experience.

sentences.chinese: 有问题可以先向主任反映。
sentences.traditional: 有問題可以先向主任反映。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ xiān xiàng zhǔrèn fǎnyìng.
sentences.translation: If there is a problem, you can report it to the director first.

sentences.chinese: 在中国北方，面食是常见的主食。
sentences.traditional: 在中國北方，麵食是常見的主食。
sentences.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó běifāng, miànshí shì chángjiàn de zhǔshí.
sentences.translation: In northern China, wheat-based foods are a common staple food.

sentences.chinese: 米饭不是他每天唯一的主食。
sentences.traditional: 米飯不是他每天唯一的主食。
sentences.pinyin: Mǐfàn bú shì tā měitiān wéiyī de zhǔshí.
sentences.translation: Rice is not his only staple food each day.

sentences.chinese: 为了控制体重，她减少了主食的分量。
sentences.traditional: 為了控制體重，她減少了主食的分量。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile kòngzhì tǐzhòng, tā jiǎnshǎo le zhǔshí de fènliàng.
sentences.translation: To control her weight, she reduced the portion of staple food.

sentences.chinese: 这次演讲的主题是环境保护。
sentences.traditional: 這次演講的主題是環境保護。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì yǎnjiǎng de zhǔtí shì huánjìng bǎohù.
sentences.translation: The theme of this speech is environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 文章的主题很清楚，结构也很完整。
sentences.traditional: 文章的主題很清楚，結構也很完整。
sentences.pinyin: Wénzhāng de zhǔtí hěn qīngchu, jiégòu yě hěn wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: The article's theme is clear, and its structure is also complete.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要围绕这个主题展开讨论。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要圍繞這個主題展開討論。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào wéirào zhège zhǔtí zhǎnkāi tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: We need to discuss things around this theme.

sentences.chinese: 主席宣布会议正式开始。
sentences.traditional: 主席宣布會議正式開始。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǔxí xuānbù huìyì zhèngshì kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: The chairperson announced the official start of the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这位主席在会后接受了记者采访。
sentences.traditional: 這位主席在會後接受了記者採訪。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhǔxí zài huì hòu jiēshòu le jìzhě cǎifǎng.
sentences.translation: This chairperson accepted a journalist's interview after the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 主席的讲话强调了合作的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 主席的講話強調了合作的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǔxí de jiǎnghuà qiángdiào le hézuò de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: The chairperson's speech emphasised the importance of cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 新用户需要先注册账号。
sentences.traditional: 新用戶需要先註冊帳號。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yònghù xūyào xiān zhùcè zhànghào.
sentences.translation: New users need to register an account first.

sentences.chinese: 公司已经完成了注册手续。
sentences.traditional: 公司已經完成了註冊手續。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yǐjīng wánchéng le zhùcè shǒuxù.
sentences.translation: The company has already completed the registration procedures.

sentences.chinese: 请用你的手机号注册这个应用。
sentences.traditional: 請用你的手機號註冊這個應用。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng yòng nǐ de shǒujī hào zhùcè zhège yìngyòng.
sentences.translation: Please register this app using your mobile number.

sentences.chinese: 政府正在改善城市的住房条件。
sentences.traditional: 政府正在改善城市的住房條件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài gǎishàn chéngshì de zhùfáng tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: The government is improving the city's housing conditions.

sentences.chinese: 对很多年轻人来说，住房压力很大。
sentences.traditional: 對很多年輕人來說，住房壓力很大。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō niánqīng rén lái shuō, zhùfáng yālì hěn dà.
sentences.translation: For many young people, housing pressure is very great.

sentences.chinese: 学校为外地教师提供临时住房。
sentences.traditional: 學校為外地教師提供臨時住房。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi wàidì jiàoshī tígōng línshí zhùfáng.
sentences.translation: The school provides temporary housing for teachers from other places.

sentences.chinese: 我们这次出差的住宿由公司统一安排。
sentences.traditional: 我們這次出差的住宿由公司統一安排。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè cì chūchāi de zhùsù yóu gōngsī tǒngyī ānpái.
sentences.translation: The accommodation for this business trip is arranged by the company.

sentences.chinese: 如果你需要住宿，可以提前在网上预订。
sentences.traditional: 如果你需要住宿，可以提前在網上預訂。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xūyào zhùsù, kěyǐ tíqián zài wǎngshàng yùdìng.
sentences.translation: If you need accommodation, you can book online in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这家学校为交换学生提供住宿。
sentences.traditional: 這家學校為交換學生提供住宿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xuéxiào wèi jiāohuàn xuéshēng tígōng zhùsù.
sentences.translation: This school provides accommodation for exchange students.

sentences.chinese: 请在表格上填写你的住址。
sentences.traditional: 請在表格上填寫你的住址。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé shang tiánxiě nǐ de zhùzhǐ.
sentences.translation: Please fill in your address on the form.

sentences.chinese: 他换了工作以后，住址也变了。
sentences.traditional: 他換了工作以後，住址也變了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huàn le gōngzuò yǐhòu, zhùzhǐ yě biàn le.
sentences.translation: After he changed jobs, his address also changed.

sentences.chinese: 报名时需要提供有效的住址。
sentences.traditional: 報名時需要提供有效的住址。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng shí xūyào tígōng yǒuxiào de zhùzhǐ.
sentences.translation: When registering, you need to provide a valid address.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司很注重产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司很注重產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī hěn zhùzhòng chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: This company pays close attention to product quality.

sentences.chinese: 学校越来越注重学生的身心健康。
sentences.traditional: 學校越來越注重學生的身心健康。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yuè lái yuè zhùzhòng xuéshēng de shēnxīn jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Schools are paying more and more attention to students’ physical and mental health.

sentences.chinese: 写作时要注重逻辑和细节。
sentences.traditional: 寫作時要注重邏輯和細節。
sentences.pinyin: Xiězuò shí yào zhùzhòng luóji hé xìjié.
sentences.translation: When writing, you should pay attention to logic and details.

sentences.chinese: 孩子伸手想抓桌上的玩具。
sentences.traditional: 孩子伸手想抓桌上的玩具。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi shēn shǒu xiǎng zhuā zhuō shang de wánjù.
sentences.translation: The child reached out to grab the toy on the table.

sentences.chinese: 警察很快抓到了小偷。
sentences.traditional: 警察很快抓到了小偷。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá hěn kuài zhuā dào le xiǎotōu.
sentences.translation: The police caught the thief very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他抓住机会，提出了自己的想法。
sentences.traditional: 他抓住機會，提出了自己的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhuā zhù jīhuì, tíchū le zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: He seized the opportunity and put forward his own idea.

sentences.chinese: 时间不多了，我们得抓紧完成报告。
sentences.traditional: 時間不多了，我們得抓緊完成報告。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān bù duō le, wǒmen děi zhuājǐn wánchéng bàogào.
sentences.translation: There is not much time left; we must hurry to finish the report.

sentences.chinese: 请抓紧机会报名，名额有限。
sentences.traditional: 請抓緊機會報名，名額有限。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zhuājǐn jīhuì bàomíng, míng’é yǒuxiàn.
sentences.translation: Please seize the opportunity to sign up; places are limited.

sentences.chinese: 项目进入最后阶段，大家都在抓紧推进。
sentences.traditional: 項目進入最後階段，大家都在抓緊推進。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù jìnrù zuìhòu jiēduàn, dàjiā dōu zài zhuājǐn tuījìn.
sentences.translation: The project has entered its final stage, and everyone is pushing ahead urgently.

sentences.chinese: 这位专家长期研究人工智能。
sentences.traditional: 這位專家長期研究人工智能。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhuānjiā chángqī yánjiū réngōng zhìnéng.
sentences.translation: This expert has long studied artificial intelligence.

sentences.chinese: 医院请来专家会诊。
sentences.traditional: 醫院請來專家會診。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn qǐng lái zhuānjiā huìzhěn.
sentences.translation: The hospital invited experts for a consultation.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要听取专家的意见。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要聽取專家的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào tīngqǔ zhuānjiā de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: We need to listen to the experts’ opinions.

sentences.chinese: 开会时请专心听别人发言。
sentences.traditional: 開會時請專心聽別人發言。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì shí qǐng zhuānxīn tīng biérén fāyán.
sentences.translation: During the meeting, please listen attentively to others speaking.

sentences.chinese: 他一旦开始学习，就能很专心。
sentences.traditional: 他一旦開始學習，就能很專心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yídàn kāishǐ xuéxí, jiù néng hěn zhuānxīn.
sentences.translation: Once he starts studying, he can be very focused.

sentences.chinese: 孩子太累了，没法专心做作业。
sentences.traditional: 孩子太累了，沒法專心做作業。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tài lèi le, méi fǎ zhuānxīn zuò zuòyè.
sentences.translation: The child is too tired to concentrate on doing homework.

sentences.chinese: 这次经历使他的态度发生了转变。
sentences.traditional: 這次經歷使他的態度發生了轉變。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì shǐ tā de tàidu fāshēng le zhuǎnbiàn.
sentences.translation: This experience caused a change in his attitude.

sentences.chinese: 企业需要根据市场变化转变经营方式。
sentences.traditional: 企業需要根據市場變化轉變經營方式。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè xūyào gēnjù shìchǎng biànhuà zhuǎnbiàn jīngyíng fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Enterprises need to change their business methods according to market changes.

sentences.chinese: 从学生到职场新人，他需要一个转变过程。
sentences.traditional: 從學生到職場新人，他需要一個轉變過程。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng xuéshēng dào zhíchǎng xīnrén, tā xūyào yí ge zhuǎnbiàn guòchéng.
sentences.translation: From student to workplace newcomer, he needs a process of transition.

sentences.chinese: 请你帮我把这个消息转告给李老师。
sentences.traditional: 請你幫我把這個消息轉告給李老師。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ zhège xiāoxi zhuǎngào gěi Lǐ lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: Please help me pass this message on to Teacher Li.

sentences.chinese: 如果他不在办公室，请转告他明天再联系我。
sentences.traditional: 如果他不在辦公室，請轉告他明天再聯繫我。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā bú zài bàngōngshì, qǐng zhuǎngào tā míngtiān zài liánxì wǒ.
sentences.translation: If he is not in the office, please tell him to contact me tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 主任让我转告大家，会议推迟到下午。
sentences.traditional: 主任讓我轉告大家，會議推遲到下午。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǔrèn ràng wǒ zhuǎngào dàjiā, huìyì tuīchí dào xiàwǔ.
sentences.translation: The director asked me to tell everyone that the meeting has been delayed until the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 她用鲜花装饰了客厅。
sentences.traditional: 她用鮮花裝飾了客廳。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng xiānhuā zhuāngshì le kètīng.
sentences.translation: She decorated the living room with fresh flowers.

sentences.chinese: 春节前，商场的装饰很有节日气氛。
sentences.traditional: 春節前，商場的裝飾很有節日氣氛。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qián, shāngchǎng de zhuāngshì hěn yǒu jiérì qìfēn.
sentences.translation: Before Spring Festival, the shopping centre’s decorations create a strong festive atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的装饰风格很特别。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的裝飾風格很特別。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhuāngshì fēnggé hěn tèbié.
sentences.translation: The decorative style of this restaurant is very distinctive.

sentences.chinese: 这套房子正在装修，暂时不能入住。
sentences.traditional: 這套房子正在裝修，暫時不能入住。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi zhèngzài zhuāngxiū, zànshí bù néng rùzhù.
sentences.translation: This flat is being renovated, so it cannot be lived in for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 我们计划明年把厨房重新装修一下。
sentences.traditional: 我們計劃明年把廚房重新裝修一下。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà míngnián bǎ chúfáng chóngxīn zhuāngxiū yíxià.
sentences.translation: We plan to renovate the kitchen again next year.

sentences.chinese: 装修费用比原来预计的高了不少。
sentences.traditional: 裝修費用比原來預計的高了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuāngxiū fèiyòng bǐ yuánlái yùjì de gāo le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: The renovation cost is much higher than originally estimated.

sentences.chinese: 他走得太急，不小心撞到了门。
sentences.traditional: 他走得太急，不小心撞到了門。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu de tài jí, bù xiǎoxīn zhuàng dào le mén.
sentences.translation: He was walking too quickly and accidentally bumped into the door.

sentences.chinese: 两辆车在路口撞在了一起。
sentences.traditional: 兩輛車在路口撞在了一起。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng liàng chē zài lùkǒu zhuàng zài le yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: Two cars collided at the crossroads.

sentences.chinese: 孩子跑进房间时撞倒了椅子。
sentences.traditional: 孩子跑進房間時撞倒了椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi pǎo jìn fángjiān shí zhuàng dǎo le yǐzi.
sentences.translation: The child knocked over the chair when running into the room.

sentences.chinese: 医生说他的身体状况已经稳定了。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說他的身體狀況已經穩定了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng yǐjīng wěndìng le.
sentences.translation: The doctor said his physical condition had already stabilised.

sentences.chinese: 项目的实际状况比报告里写的复杂。
sentences.traditional: 項目的實際狀況比報告裡寫的複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù de shíjì zhuàngkuàng bǐ bàogào li xiě de fùzá.
sentences.translation: The actual situation of the project is more complicated than what is written in the report.

sentences.chinese: 遇到紧急状况时，大家要保持冷静。
sentences.traditional: 遇到緊急狀況時，大家要保持冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Yù dào jǐnjí zhuàngkuàng shí, dàjiā yào bǎochí lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: When facing an emergency situation, everyone should stay calm.

sentences.chinese: 经过休息，他的工作状态好了很多。
sentences.traditional: 經過休息，他的工作狀態好了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò xiūxi, tā de gōngzuò zhuàngtài hǎo le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: After resting, his work state improved a lot.

sentences.chinese: 设备目前处于正常运行状态。
sentences.traditional: 設備目前處於正常運行狀態。
sentences.pinyin: Shèbèi mùqián chǔyú zhèngcháng yùnxíng zhuàngtài.
sentences.translation: The equipment is currently in a normal operating state.

sentences.chinese: 他的精神状态不太好，需要多休息。
sentences.traditional: 他的精神狀態不太好，需要多休息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jīngshén zhuàngtài bú tài hǎo, xūyào duō xiūxi.
sentences.translation: His mental state is not very good, so he needs more rest.

sentences.chinese: 警察追了很久，终于抓住了那个人。
sentences.traditional: 警察追了很久，終於抓住了那個人。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuī le hěn jiǔ, zhōngyú zhuā zhù le nà ge rén.
sentences.translation: The police chased him for a long time and finally caught that person.

sentences.chinese: 她一直在追自己的梦想。
sentences.traditional: 她一直在追自己的夢想。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài zhuī zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: She has always been pursuing her own dream.

sentences.chinese: 别追得太急，先弄清楚方向。
sentences.traditional: 別追得太急，先弄清楚方向。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhuī de tài jí, xiān nòng qīngchu fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: Do not chase too hurriedly; first work out the direction clearly.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人应该勇敢追求自己的目标。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人應該勇敢追求自己的目標。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén yīnggāi yǒnggǎn zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mùbiāo.
sentences.translation: Young people should bravely pursue their own goals.

sentences.chinese: 企业不能只追求短期利益。
sentences.traditional: 企業不能只追求短期利益。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú duǎnqī lìyì.
sentences.translation: Businesses cannot only pursue short-term benefits.

sentences.chinese: 他对艺术的追求从来没有停止。
sentences.traditional: 他對藝術的追求從來沒有停止。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì yìshù de zhuīqiú cónglái méi yǒu tíngzhǐ.
sentences.translation: His pursuit of art has never stopped.

sentences.chinese: 只有通过考试的人才有申请资格。
sentences.traditional: 只有通過考試的人才有申請資格。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu tōngguò kǎoshì de rén cái yǒu shēnqǐng zīgé.
sentences.translation: Only those who pass the exam have the qualification to apply.

sentences.chinese: 他因为经验不足，暂时没有参赛资格。
sentences.traditional: 他因為經驗不足，暫時沒有參賽資格。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi jīngyàn bùzú, zànshí méi yǒu cānsài zīgé.
sentences.translation: Because he lacks experience, he temporarily does not have the qualification to compete.

sentences.chinese: 公司会定期审查供应商的资格。
sentences.traditional: 公司會定期審查供應商的資格。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī huì dìngqī shěnchá gōngyìngshāng de zīgé.
sentences.translation: The company regularly reviews suppliers’ qualifications.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目需要大量资金支持。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目需要大量資金支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào dàliàng zījīn zhīchí.
sentences.translation: This project needs a large amount of financial support.

sentences.chinese: 资金不足是公司目前最大的困难。
sentences.traditional: 資金不足是公司目前最大的困難。
sentences.pinyin: Zījīn bùzú shì gōngsī mùqián zuì dà de kùnnan.
sentences.translation: Insufficient funds are currently the company’s biggest difficulty.

sentences.chinese: 政府把更多资金投入到公共交通。
sentences.traditional: 政府把更多資金投入到公共交通。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ bǎ gèng duō zījīn tóurù dào gōnggòng jiāotōng.
sentences.translation: The government is investing more funds into public transport.

sentences.chinese: 长时间看电脑时，要注意坐的姿势。
sentences.traditional: 長時間看電腦時，要注意坐的姿勢。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān kàn diànnǎo shí, yào zhùyì zuò de zīshì.
sentences.translation: When looking at a computer for a long time, you should pay attention to your sitting posture.

sentences.chinese: 教练纠正了他的跑步姿势。
sentences.traditional: 教練糾正了他的跑步姿勢。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoliàn jiūzhèng le tā de pǎobù zīshì.
sentences.translation: The coach corrected his running posture.

sentences.chinese: 她拍照时总能摆出自然的姿势。
sentences.traditional: 她拍照時總能擺出自然的姿勢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pāizhào shí zǒng néng bǎi chū zìrán de zīshì.
sentences.translation: When taking photos, she can always strike a natural pose.

sentences.chinese: 如果有法律问题，可以先咨询专业律师。
sentences.traditional: 如果有法律問題，可以先諮詢專業律師。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu fǎlǜ wèntí, kěyǐ xiān zīxún zhuānyè lǜshī.
sentences.translation: If there are legal issues, you can first consult a professional lawyer.

sentences.chinese: 客户可以通过电话咨询产品详情。
sentences.traditional: 客戶可以通過電話諮詢產品詳情。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù kěyǐ tōngguò diànhuà zīxún chǎnpǐn xiángqíng.
sentences.translation: Customers can consult by phone about the product details.

sentences.chinese: 学校为学生提供免费的心理咨询。
sentences.traditional: 學校為學生提供免費的心理諮詢。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi xuéshēng tígōng miǎnfèi de xīnlǐ zīxún.
sentences.translation: The school provides free psychological counselling for students.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目需要更多资源才能顺利完成。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目需要更多資源才能順利完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào gèng duō zīyuán cái néng shùnlì wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This project needs more resources to be completed smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 学校正在整理线上学习资源。
sentences.traditional: 學校正在整理線上學習資源。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhèngzài zhěnglǐ xiànshàng xuéxí zīyuán.
sentences.translation: The school is organising online learning resources.

sentences.chinese: 当地的旅游资源很丰富。
sentences.traditional: 當地的旅遊資源很豐富。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì de lǚyóu zīyuán hěn fēngfù.
sentences.translation: The local tourism resources are abundant.

sentences.chinese: 这条围巾有点紫。
sentences.traditional: 這條圍巾有點紫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo wéijīn yǒudiǎn zǐ.
sentences.translation: This scarf is a little purple.

sentences.chinese: 夕阳下的天空慢慢变紫了。
sentences.traditional: 夕陽下的天空慢慢變紫了。
sentences.pinyin: Xīyáng xià de tiānkōng mànmàn biàn zǐ le.
sentences.translation: The sky under the setting sun slowly turned purple.

sentences.chinese: 他把背景调得太紫，看起来不自然。
sentences.traditional: 他把背景調得太紫，看起來不自然。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ bèijǐng tiáo de tài zǐ, kàn qǐlái bù zìrán.
sentences.translation: He adjusted the background so purple that it looked unnatural.

sentences.chinese: 父母应该尊重子女的选择。
sentences.traditional: 父母應該尊重子女的選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ yīnggāi zūnzhòng zǐnǚ de xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: Parents should respect their children’s choices.

sentences.chinese: 成年子女也需要关心父母的健康。
sentences.traditional: 成年子女也需要關心父母的健康。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngnián zǐnǚ yě xūyào guānxīn fùmǔ de jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Adult children also need to care about their parents’ health.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策减轻了有子女家庭的压力。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策減輕了有子女家庭的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè jiǎnqīng le yǒu zǐnǚ jiātíng de yālì.
sentences.translation: This policy has reduced the pressure on families with children.

sentences.chinese: 自从换了工作，他每天都更忙了。
sentences.traditional: 自從換了工作，他每天都更忙了。
sentences.pinyin: Zìcóng huàn le gōngzuò, tā měitiān dōu gèng máng le.
sentences.translation: Since changing jobs, he has been busier every day.

sentences.chinese: 自从搬到这里以后，她认识了不少新朋友。
sentences.traditional: 自從搬到這裡以後，她認識了不少新朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zìcóng bān dào zhèlǐ yǐhòu, tā rènshi le bù shǎo xīn péngyǒu.
sentences.translation: Since moving here, she has got to know quite a few new friends.

sentences.chinese: 自从开始锻炼，他的身体状态好多了。
sentences.traditional: 自從開始鍛鍊，他的身體狀態好多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ duànliàn, tā de shēntǐ zhuàngtài hǎo duō le.
sentences.translation: Since starting to exercise, his physical condition has improved a lot.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器可以自动调整温度。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器可以自動調整溫度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì kěyǐ zìdòng tiáozhěng wēndù.
sentences.translation: This machine can automatically adjust the temperature.

sentences.chinese: 门会在十秒后自动关闭。
sentences.traditional: 門會在十秒後自動關閉。
sentences.pinyin: Mén huì zài shí miǎo hòu zìdòng guānbì.
sentences.translation: The door will close automatically after ten seconds.

sentences.chinese: 自动系统减少了人工操作的时间。
sentences.traditional: 自動系統減少了人工操作的時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zìdòng xìtǒng jiǎnshǎo le réngōng cāozuò de shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The automatic system reduces the time spent on manual operations.

sentences.chinese: 他很自觉，从来不用老师提醒。
sentences.traditional: 他很自覺，從來不用老師提醒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn zìjué, cónglái bú yòng lǎoshī tíxǐng.
sentences.translation: He is very self-disciplined and never needs the teacher to remind him.

sentences.chinese: 进入图书馆后，大家都自觉保持安静。
sentences.traditional: 進入圖書館後，大家都自覺保持安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù túshūguǎn hòu, dàjiā dōu zìjué bǎochí ānjìng.
sentences.translation: After entering the library, everyone consciously keeps quiet.

sentences.chinese: 企业应该自觉承担社会责任。
sentences.traditional: 企業應該自覺承擔社會責任。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīnggāi zìjué chéngdān shèhuì zérèn.
sentences.translation: Enterprises should consciously take on social responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 请把这些字母按顺序写下来。
sentences.traditional: 請把這些字母按順序寫下來。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē zìmǔ àn shùnxù xiě xiàlái.
sentences.translation: Please write these letters down in order.

sentences.chinese: 这个密码必须包含大写字母。
sentences.traditional: 這個密碼必須包含大寫字母。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège mìmǎ bìxū bāohán dàxiě zìmǔ.
sentences.translation: This password must include capital letters.

sentences.chinese: 孩子正在学习英文字母。
sentences.traditional: 孩子正在學習英文字母。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zhèngzài xuéxí Yīngwén zìmǔ.
sentences.translation: The child is learning English letters.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都要提高自身的安全意识。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都要提高自身的安全意識。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yào tígāo zìshēn de ānquán yìshí.
sentences.translation: Everyone should raise their own awareness of safety.

sentences.chinese: 企业的发展离不开自身的努力。
sentences.traditional: 企業的發展離不開自身的努力。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè de fāzhǎn lí bù kāi zìshēn de nǔlì.
sentences.translation: The development of an enterprise cannot be separated from its own efforts.

sentences.chinese: 他通过学习发现了自身的问题。
sentences.traditional: 他通過學習發現了自身的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngguò xuéxí fāxiàn le zìshēn de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Through studying, he discovered problems within himself.

sentences.chinese: 孩子需要一定的自由空间。
sentences.traditional: 孩子需要一定的自由空間。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi xūyào yídìng de zìyóu kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: Children need a certain amount of free space.

sentences.chinese: 在法律范围内，人人都有表达自由。
sentences.traditional: 在法律範圍內，人人都有表達自由。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fǎlǜ fànwéi nèi, rénrén dōu yǒu biǎodá zìyóu.
sentences.translation: Within the scope of the law, everyone has freedom of expression.

sentences.chinese: 周末的时间比较自由，可以自己安排。
sentences.traditional: 週末的時間比較自由，可以自己安排。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíjiān bǐjiào zìyóu, kěyǐ zìjǐ ānpái.
sentences.translation: The time at the weekend is relatively free, so you can arrange it yourself.

sentences.chinese: 老师综合了大家的意见，提出了新的方案。
sentences.traditional: 老師綜合了大家的意見，提出了新的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zōnghé le dàjiā de yìjiàn, tíchū le xīn de fāng’àn.
sentences.translation: The teacher combined everyone’s opinions and put forward a new plan.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要综合考虑成本和效果。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要綜合考慮成本和效果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zōnghé kǎolǜ chéngběn hé xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: We need to consider cost and results together.

sentences.chinese: 这是一份综合报告，内容比较全面。
sentences.traditional: 這是一份綜合報告，內容比較全面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí fèn zōnghé bàogào, nèiróng bǐjiào quánmiàn.
sentences.translation: This is a comprehensive report, and the content is relatively complete.

sentences.chinese: 公司总部位于上海，分公司遍布全国。
sentences.traditional: 公司總部位於上海，分公司遍布全國。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zǒngbù wèiyú Shànghǎi, fēngōngsī biànbù quánguó.
sentences.translation: The company headquarters is located in Shanghai, with branches across the country.

sentences.chinese: 明年他们会把总部搬到新的商业区。
sentences.traditional: 明年他們會把總部搬到新的商業區。
sentences.pinyin: Míngnián tāmen huì bǎ zǒngbù bān dào xīn de shāngyè qū.
sentences.translation: Next year they will move the headquarters to a new business district.

sentences.chinese: 总部已经批准了这项投资计划。
sentences.traditional: 總部已經批准了這項投資計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒngbù yǐjīng pīzhǔn le zhè xiàng tóuzī jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Head office has already approved this investment plan.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动总共有三百多人参加。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動總共有三百多人參加。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng zǒnggòng yǒu sānbǎi duō rén cānjiā.
sentences.translation: More than three hundred people took part in this activity in total.

sentences.chinese: 我们总共花了两个小时完成调查。
sentences.traditional: 我們總共花了兩個小時完成調查。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒnggòng huā le liǎng ge xiǎoshí wánchéng diàochá.
sentences.translation: We spent two hours in total completing the investigation.

sentences.chinese: 这些资料总共分为五个部分。
sentences.traditional: 這些資料總共分為五個部分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīliào zǒnggòng fēn wéi wǔ ge bùfen.
sentences.translation: These materials are divided into five parts altogether.

sentences.chinese: 学校公布了今年报名学生的总数。
sentences.traditional: 學校公佈了今年報名學生的總數。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào gōngbù le jīnnián bàomíng xuéshēng de zǒngshù.
sentences.translation: The school announced the total number of students who registered this year.

sentences.chinese: 报告只写了总数，没有列出详细分类。
sentences.traditional: 報告只寫了總數，沒有列出詳細分類。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào zhǐ xiě le zǒngshù, méiyǒu lièchū xiángxì fēnlèi.
sentences.translation: The report only gave the total and did not list the detailed categories.

sentences.chinese: 统计总数以后，我们发现数据有些问题。
sentences.traditional: 統計總數以後，我們發現數據有些問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tǒngjì zǒngshù yǐhòu, wǒmen fāxiàn shùjù yǒuxiē wèntí.
sentences.translation: After counting the total, we found some problems with the data.

sentences.chinese: 从总体来看，这个方案比较可行。
sentences.traditional: 從總體來看，這個方案比較可行。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zǒngtǐ lái kàn, zhège fāng’àn bǐjiào kěxíng.
sentences.translation: Overall, this plan is fairly feasible.

sentences.chinese: 项目的总体进展比计划快一些。
sentences.traditional: 項目的總體進展比計畫快一些。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù de zǒngtǐ jìnzhǎn bǐ jìhuà kuài yìxiē.
sentences.translation: The project’s overall progress is a little faster than planned.

sentences.chinese: 总体水平提高了，但细节还需要改进。
sentences.traditional: 總體水平提高了，但細節還需要改進。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒngtǐ shuǐpíng tígāo le, dàn xìjié hái xūyào gǎijìn.
sentences.translation: The overall level has improved, but the details still need improvement.

sentences.chinese: 总统在会议上发表了简短讲话。
sentences.traditional: 總統在會議上發表了簡短講話。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng zài huìyì shang fābiǎo le jiǎnduǎn jiǎnghuà.
sentences.translation: The president gave a brief speech at the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这位总统承诺会推动医疗改革。
sentences.traditional: 這位總統承諾會推動醫療改革。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zǒngtǒng chéngnuò huì tuīdòng yīliáo gǎigé.
sentences.translation: This president promised to promote medical reform.

sentences.chinese: 新闻里报道了总统的最新决定。
sentences.traditional: 新聞裡報導了總統的最新決定。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnwén lǐ bàodào le zǒngtǒng de zuìxīn juédìng.
sentences.translation: The news reported the president’s latest decision.

sentences.chinese: 总之，我们不能只看眼前的利益。
sentences.traditional: 總之，我們不能只看眼前的利益。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, wǒmen bù néng zhǐ kàn yǎnqián de lìyì.
sentences.translation: In short, we cannot only look at immediate interests.

sentences.chinese: 这次合作有困难，总之还算成功。
sentences.traditional: 這次合作有困難，總之還算成功。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì hézuò yǒu kùnnan, zǒngzhī hái suàn chénggōng.
sentences.translation: This cooperation had difficulties, but in short it can still be considered successful.

sentences.chinese: 总之，安全问题必须放在第一位。
sentences.traditional: 總之，安全問題必須放在第一位。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, ānquán wèntí bìxū fàng zài dì yī wèi.
sentences.translation: In short, safety issues must be put first.

sentences.chinese: 市中心的租金比去年又高了不少。
sentences.traditional: 市中心的租金比去年又高了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhōngxīn de zūjīn bǐ qùnián yòu gāo le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: Rent in the city centre has gone up quite a lot again compared with last year.

sentences.chinese: 这套房子的租金包括物业费吗？
sentences.traditional: 這套房子的租金包括物業費嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi de zūjīn bāokuò wùyè fèi ma?
sentences.translation: Does the rent for this flat include the property management fee?

sentences.chinese: 如果租金太贵，我们就换一个地方。
sentences.traditional: 如果租金太貴，我們就換一個地方。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zūjīn tài guì, wǒmen jiù huàn yí ge dìfang.
sentences.translation: If the rent is too expensive, we will change to another place.

sentences.chinese: 她对苗族的音乐很感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 她對苗族的音樂很感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì Miáo zú de yīnyuè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: She is very interested in Miao music.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区有汉族、藏族等多个群体。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區有漢族、藏族等多個群體。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yǒu Hàn zú, Zàng zú děng duō ge qúntǐ.
sentences.translation: This region has Han, Tibetan and several other groups.

sentences.chinese: 许多年轻人把自己称为追星族。
sentences.traditional: 許多年輕人把自己稱為追星族。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīngrén bǎ zìjǐ chēng wéi zhuīxīng zú.
sentences.translation: Many young people call themselves celebrity fans.

sentences.chinese: 只要准备足够，就不用太紧张。
sentences.traditional: 只要準備足夠，就不用太緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhǔnbèi zúgòu, jiù bú yòng tài jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: As long as the preparation is sufficient, there is no need to be too nervous.

sentences.chinese: 这笔资金足够支持项目运行半年。
sentences.traditional: 這筆資金足夠支持項目運行半年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ zījīn zúgòu zhīchí xiàngmù yùnxíng bàn nián.
sentences.translation: This funding is enough to support the project’s operation for half a year.

sentences.chinese: 房间不大，但空间足够一家三口使用。
sentences.traditional: 房間不大，但空間足夠一家三口使用。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān bú dà, dàn kōngjiān zúgòu yì jiā sān kǒu shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: The room is not large, but the space is enough for a family of three to use.

sentences.chinese: 这个团队由十名工程师组成。
sentences.traditional: 這個團隊由十名工程師組成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì yóu shí míng gōngchéngshī zǔchéng.
sentences.translation: This team is made up of ten engineers.

sentences.chinese: 不同的部分组成了一个完整的系统。
sentences.traditional: 不同的部分組成了一個完整的系統。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng de bùfen zǔchéng le yí ge wánzhěng de xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: Different parts form a complete system.

sentences.chinese: 委员会将由专家和市民共同组成。
sentences.traditional: 委員會將由專家和市民共同組成。
sentences.pinyin: Wěiyuánhuì jiāng yóu zhuānjiā hé shìmín gòngtóng zǔchéng.
sentences.translation: The committee will be jointly formed by experts and citizens.

sentences.chinese: 这两种颜色组合在一起，效果很自然。
sentences.traditional: 這兩種顏色組合在一起，效果很自然。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng yánsè zǔhé zài yìqǐ, xiàoguǒ hěn zìrán.
sentences.translation: These two colours combine together with a very natural effect.

sentences.chinese: 这个组合适合初学者使用。
sentences.traditional: 這個組合適合初學者使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zǔhé shìhé chūxuézhě shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This combination is suitable for beginners to use.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要重新组合这些资料。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要重新組合這些資料。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn zǔhé zhèxiē zīliào.
sentences.translation: We need to recombine these materials.

sentences.chinese: 警察及时阻止了事故的发生。
sentences.traditional: 警察及時阻止了事故的發生。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá jíshí zǔzhǐ le shìgù de fāshēng.
sentences.translation: The police stopped the accident from happening in time.

sentences.chinese: 没有人能阻止他追求自己的目标。
sentences.traditional: 沒有人能阻止他追求自己的目標。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén néng zǔzhǐ tā zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mùbiāo.
sentences.translation: No one can stop him from pursuing his own goal.

sentences.chinese: 新规定是为了阻止资源浪费。
sentences.traditional: 新規定是為了阻止資源浪費。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn guīdìng shì wèile zǔzhǐ zīyuán làngfèi.
sentences.translation: The new rule is intended to prevent the waste of resources.

sentences.chinese: 学校组织了一次去博物馆的活动。
sentences.traditional: 學校組織了一次去博物館的活動。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zǔzhī le yí cì qù bówùguǎn de huódòng.
sentences.translation: The school organised an activity to go to the museum.

sentences.chinese: 这个组织主要帮助失业青年。
sentences.traditional: 這個組織主要幫助失業青年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zǔzhī zhǔyào bāngzhù shīyè qīngnián.
sentences.translation: This organisation mainly helps unemployed young people.

sentences.chinese: 会议需要有人负责组织和记录。
sentences.traditional: 會議需要有人負責組織和記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì xūyào yǒu rén fùzé zǔzhī hé jìlù.
sentences.translation: The meeting needs someone to be responsible for organisation and records.

sentences.chinese: 他说话时嘴巴动得很快。
sentences.traditional: 他說話時嘴巴動得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà shí zuǐba dòng de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: When he speaks, his mouth moves very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 孩子的嘴巴上沾了巧克力。
sentences.traditional: 孩子的嘴巴上沾了巧克力。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi de zuǐba shang zhān le qiǎokèlì.
sentences.translation: The child has chocolate stuck around their mouth.

sentences.chinese: 她用手遮住嘴巴，忍不住笑了。
sentences.traditional: 她用手遮住嘴巴，忍不住笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu zhē zhù zuǐba, rěn bu zhù xiào le.
sentences.translation: She covered her mouth with her hand and could not help laughing.

sentences.chinese: 他只喝了一点酒就醉了。
sentences.traditional: 他只喝了一點酒就醉了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ hē le yìdiǎn jiǔ jiù zuì le.
sentences.translation: He got drunk after drinking only a little alcohol.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他喝醉以后不要开车。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他喝醉以後不要開車。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā hē zuì yǐhòu bú yào kāichē.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him not to drive after getting drunk.

sentences.chinese: 那种成功的感觉让人像醉了一样。
sentences.traditional: 那種成功的感覺讓人像醉了一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhǒng chénggōng de gǎnjué ràng rén xiàng zuì le yíyàng.
sentences.translation: That feeling of success makes a person feel as if they were drunk.

sentences.chinese: 最初的计划比较简单。
sentences.traditional: 最初的計畫比較簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìchū de jìhuà bǐjiào jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: The initial plan was relatively simple.

sentences.chinese: 我最初并不理解这个决定。
sentences.traditional: 我最初並不理解這個決定。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuìchū bìng bù lǐjiě zhège juédìng.
sentences.translation: At first, I did not understand this decision.

sentences.chinese: 项目最初由三名学生发起。
sentences.traditional: 項目最初由三名學生發起。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù zuìchū yóu sān míng xuéshēng fāqǐ.
sentences.translation: The project was initially started by three students.

sentences.chinese: 这是解决问题的最佳方法。
sentences.traditional: 這是解決問題的最佳方法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì jiějué wèntí de zuìjiā fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: This is the best method for solving the problem.

sentences.chinese: 她被选为今年的最佳选手。
sentences.traditional: 她被選為今年的最佳選手。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bèi xuǎn wéi jīnnián de zuìjiā xuǎnshǒu.
sentences.translation: She was chosen as this year's best contestant.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要在最佳时间提交申请。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要在最佳時間提交申請。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zài zuìjiā shíjiān tíjiāo shēnqǐng.
sentences.translation: We need to submit the application at the best time.

sentences.chinese: 他是一位受人尊敬的老师。
sentences.traditional: 他是一位受人尊敬的老師。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi shòu rén zūnjìng de lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: He is a teacher respected by others.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该尊敬不同领域的劳动者。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該尊敬不同領域的勞動者。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng bùtóng lǐngyù de láodòngzhě.
sentences.translation: We should respect workers in different fields.

sentences.chinese: 她用尊敬的语气提出了问题。
sentences.traditional: 她用尊敬的語氣提出了問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng zūnjìng de yǔqì tíchū le wèntí.
sentences.translation: She raised the question in a respectful tone.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都必须遵守交通规则。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都必須遵守交通規則。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu bìxū zūnshǒu jiāotōng guīzé.
sentences.translation: Everyone must obey the traffic rules.

sentences.chinese: 企业应该严格遵守相关法律。
sentences.traditional: 企業應該嚴格遵守相關法律。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīnggāi yángé zūnshǒu xiāngguān fǎlǜ.
sentences.translation: Enterprises should strictly comply with the relevant laws.

sentences.chinese: 只有遵守约定，合作才能继续。
sentences.traditional: 只有遵守約定，合作才能繼續。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zūnshǒu yuēdìng, hézuò cái néng jìxù.
sentences.translation: Only by keeping to the agreement can the cooperation continue.

sentences.chinese: 公司已经作出了正式回应。
sentences.traditional: 公司已經作出了正式回應。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yǐjīng zuòchū le zhèngshì huíyìng.
sentences.translation: The company has already made an official response.

sentences.chinese: 政府将根据证据作出决定。
sentences.traditional: 政府將根據證據作出決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiāng gēnjù zhèngjù zuòchū juédìng.
sentences.translation: The government will make a decision based on the evidence.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难，他作出了勇敢的选择。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難，他作出了勇敢的選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan, tā zuòchū le yǒnggǎn de xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: Facing difficulties, he made a brave choice.

sentences.chinese: 他把两条绳子结在一起，做成了一个临时把手。
sentences.traditional: 他把兩條繩子結在一起，做成了一個臨時把手。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ liǎng tiáo shéngzi jié zài yìqǐ, zuòchéng le yí ge línshí bǎshǒu.
sentences.translation: He tied two ropes together to make a temporary handle.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少损失，我们会尽量提前通知客户。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少損失，我們會盡量提前通知客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo sǔnshī, wǒmen huì jǐnliàng tíqián tōngzhī kèhù.
sentences.translation: To reduce losses, we will try to notify customers in advance.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，很多商店的营业时间会有所调整。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，很多商店的營業時間會有所調整。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, hěn duō shāngdiàn de yíngyè shíjiān huì yǒu suǒ tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: During Spring Festival, many shops will adjust their opening hours.

sentences.chinese: 会议期间，请把手机调成静音。
sentences.traditional: 會議期間，請把手機調成靜音。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì qījiān, qǐng bǎ shǒujī tiáo chéng jìngyīn.
sentences.translation: During the meeting, please set your phone to silent.

sentences.chinese: 实习期间，她学会了怎样和客户沟通。
sentences.traditional: 實習期間，她學會了怎樣和客戶溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Shíxí qījiān, tā xuéhuì le zěnyàng hé kèhù gōutōng.
sentences.translation: During her internship, she learnt how to communicate with customers.

sentences.chinese: 请把资料放齐，明天检查时会用到。
sentences.traditional: 請把資料放齊，明天檢查時會用到。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zīliào fàng qí, míngtiān jiǎnchá shí huì yòng dào.
sentences.translation: Please put the materials in order; they will be needed during tomorrow’s check.

sentences.chinese: 队伍排得很齐，看起来很有精神。
sentences.traditional: 隊伍排得很齊，看起來很有精神。
sentences.pinyin: Duìwu pái de hěn qí, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu jīngshén.
sentences.translation: The line is very neat and looks full of energy.

sentences.chinese: 人到齐以后，主任才开始讲话。
sentences.traditional: 人到齊以後，主任才開始講話。
sentences.pinyin: Rén dào qí yǐhòu, zhǔrèn cái kāishǐ jiǎnghuà.
sentences.translation: Only after everyone had arrived did the director begin speaking.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司及其员工都应遵守规定。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司及其員工都應遵守規定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jí qí yuángōng dōu yīng zūnshǒu guīdìng.
sentences.translation: This company and its employees should all follow the regulations.

sentences.chinese: 我们只看到了结果，其原因还需要调查。
sentences.traditional: 我們只看到了結果，其原因還需要調查。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǐ kàn dào le jiéguǒ, qí yuányīn hái xūyào diàochá.
sentences.translation: We have only seen the result; its cause still needs to be investigated.

sentences.chinese: 他介绍了项目的背景及其意义。
sentences.traditional: 他介紹了項目的背景及其意義。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jièshào le xiàngmù de bèijǐng jí qí yìyì.
sentences.translation: He introduced the background of the project and its significance.

sentences.chinese: 在医生看来，他的恢复几乎是一个奇迹。
sentences.traditional: 在醫生看來，他的恢復幾乎是一個奇蹟。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yīshēng kàn lái, tā de huīfù jīhū shì yí ge qíjì.
sentences.translation: In the doctor’s view, his recovery is almost a miracle.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市十年内发生了奇迹般的变化。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市十年內發生了奇蹟般的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì shí nián nèi fāshēng le qíjì bān de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This city has undergone miraculous changes within ten years.

sentences.chinese: 成功不是奇迹，而是长期努力的结果。
sentences.traditional: 成功不是奇蹟，而是長期努力的結果。
sentences.pinyin: Chénggōng bú shì qíjì, ér shì chángqī nǔlì de jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Success is not a miracle, but the result of long-term effort.

sentences.chinese: 这五份文件先提交，其余的明天再处理。
sentences.traditional: 這五份文件先提交，其餘的明天再處理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wǔ fèn wénjiàn xiān tíjiāo, qíyú de míngtiān zài chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: Submit these five documents first; deal with the rest tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 其中两个人负责设计，其余成员负责测试。
sentences.traditional: 其中兩個人負責設計，其餘成員負責測試。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng liǎng ge rén fùzé shèjì, qíyú chéngyuán fùzé cèshì.
sentences.translation: Two of them are responsible for design, and the remaining members are responsible for testing.

sentences.chinese: 请把其余问题写在报告最后。
sentences.traditional: 請把其餘問題寫在報告最後。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ qíyú wèntí xiě zài bàogào zuìhòu.
sentences.translation: Please write the remaining questions at the end of the report.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业正在扩大生产规模。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業正在擴大生產規模。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè zhèngzài kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó.
sentences.translation: This enterprise is expanding its production scale.

sentences.chinese: 政府鼓励企业提高产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 政府鼓勵企業提高產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gǔlì qǐyè tígāo chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The government encourages enterprises to improve product quality.

sentences.chinese: 中小企业在当地经济中很重要。
sentences.traditional: 中小企業在當地經濟中很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngxiǎo qǐyè zài dāngdì jīngjì zhōng hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Small and medium-sized enterprises are very important in the local economy.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把气球系在椅子上。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把氣球繫在椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ qìqiú jì zài yǐzi shang.
sentences.translation: The child tied the balloon to the chair.

sentences.chinese: 气球一碰到树枝就破了。
sentences.traditional: 氣球一碰到樹枝就破了。
sentences.pinyin: Qìqiú yì pèng dào shùzhī jiù pò le.
sentences.translation: The balloon burst as soon as it touched a branch.

sentences.chinese: 他们用五颜六色的气球装饰会场。
sentences.traditional: 他們用五顏六色的氣球裝飾會場。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yòng wǔyán-liùsè de qìqiú zhuāngshì huìchǎng.
sentences.translation: They decorated the venue with colourful balloons.

sentences.chinese: 汽油价格上涨后，很多人开始选择公共交通。
sentences.traditional: 汽油價格上漲後，很多人開始選擇公共交通。
sentences.pinyin: Qìyóu jiàgé shàngzhǎng hòu, hěn duō rén kāishǐ xuǎnzé gōnggòng jiāotōng.
sentences.translation: After petrol prices rose, many people began choosing public transport.

sentences.chinese: 这种机器不能使用普通汽油。
sentences.traditional: 這種機器不能使用普通汽油。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jīqì bù néng shǐyòng pǔtōng qìyóu.
sentences.translation: This kind of machine cannot use ordinary petrol.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少污染，城市逐步减少对汽油车的依赖。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少污染，城市逐步減少對汽油車的依賴。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo wūrǎn, chéngshì zhúbù jiǎnshǎo duì qìyóu chē de yīlài.
sentences.translation: To reduce pollution, the city is gradually reducing its reliance on petrol cars.

sentences.chinese: 请在表格最后一页签上你的名字。
sentences.traditional: 請在表格最後一頁簽上你的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé zuìhòu yí yè qiān shang nǐ de míngzi.
sentences.translation: Please sign your name on the last page of the form.

sentences.chinese: 合同还没签，双方仍在讨论细节。
sentences.traditional: 合同還沒簽，雙方仍在討論細節。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong hái méi qiān, shuāngfāng réng zài tǎolùn xìjié.
sentences.translation: The contract has not been signed yet, and both sides are still discussing the details.

sentences.chinese: 他已经签了确认书，所以不能随意改变决定。
sentences.traditional: 他已經簽了確認書，所以不能隨意改變決定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng qiān le quèrènshū, suǒyǐ bù néng suíyì gǎibiàn juédìng.
sentences.translation: He has already signed the confirmation letter, so he cannot change the decision casually.

sentences.chinese: 双方计划下周正式签订合作协议。
sentences.traditional: 雙方計劃下週正式簽訂合作協議。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng jìhuà xià zhōu zhèngshì qiāndìng hézuò xiéyì.
sentences.translation: Both sides plan to formally sign a cooperation agreement next week.

sentences.chinese: 签订合同前，律师会检查每一项条款。
sentences.traditional: 簽訂合同前，律師會檢查每一項條款。
sentences.pinyin: Qiāndìng hétong qián, lǜshī huì jiǎnchá měi yí xiàng tiáokuǎn.
sentences.translation: Before signing the contract, the lawyer will check every clause.

sentences.chinese: 公司与供应商签订了长期协议。
sentences.traditional: 公司與供應商簽訂了長期協議。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yǔ gōngyìngshāng qiāndìng le chángqī xiéyì.
sentences.translation: The company signed a long-term agreement with the supplier.

sentences.chinese: 他舍得花时间陪孩子读书。
sentences.traditional: 他捨得花時間陪孩子讀書。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shěde huā shíjiān péi háizi dúshū.
sentences.translation: He is willing to spend time reading with his child.

sentences.chinese: 这么好的机会，你真的舍得放弃吗？
sentences.traditional: 這麼好的機會，你真的捨得放棄嗎？
sentences.pinyin: Zhème hǎo de jīhuì, nǐ zhēn de shěde fàngqì ma?
sentences.translation: With such a good opportunity, are you really willing to give it up?

sentences.chinese: 她虽然收入不高，却舍得帮助有困难的人。
sentences.traditional: 她雖然收入不高，卻捨得幫助有困難的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán shōurù bù gāo, què shěde bāngzhù yǒu kùnnan de rén.
sentences.translation: Although her income is not high, she is still willing to help people in difficulty.

sentences.chinese: 实验室里的设备需要定期维修。
sentences.traditional: 實驗室裡的設備需要定期維修。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyànshì lǐ de shèbèi xūyào dìngqī wéixiū.
sentences.translation: The equipment in the laboratory needs regular maintenance.

sentences.chinese: 新设备投入使用后，生产效率明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 新設備投入使用後，生產效率明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn shèbèi tóurù shǐyòng hòu, shēngchǎn xiàolǜ míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: After the new equipment was put into use, production efficiency clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 如果设备出现故障，请马上联系技术人员。
sentences.traditional: 如果設備出現故障，請馬上聯繫技術人員。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shèbèi chūxiàn gùzhàng, qǐng mǎshàng liánxì jìshù rényuán.
sentences.translation: If the equipment develops a fault, please contact the technical staff immediately.

sentences.chinese: 这座图书馆的设计既现代又实用。
sentences.traditional: 這座圖書館的設計既現代又實用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò túshūguǎn de shèjì jì xiàndài yòu shíyòng.
sentences.translation: The design of this library is both modern and practical.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要重新设计网站的首页。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要重新設計網站的首頁。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn shèjì wǎngzhàn de shǒuyè.
sentences.translation: We need to redesign the website’s homepage.

sentences.chinese: 产品设计要考虑用户的真实需求。
sentences.traditional: 產品設計要考慮用戶的真實需求。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn shèjì yào kǎolǜ yònghù de zhēnshí xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Product design should consider users’ real needs.

sentences.chinese: 学校设立了新的奖学金，鼓励学生创新。
sentences.traditional: 學校設立了新的獎學金，鼓勵學生創新。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào shèlì le xīn de jiǎngxuéjīn, gǔlì xuésheng chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: The school established a new scholarship to encourage student innovation.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划在上海设立分部。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃在上海設立分部。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà zài Shànghǎi shèlì fēnbù.
sentences.translation: The company plans to establish a branch in Shanghai.

sentences.chinese: 设立明确目标以后，团队行动更有效率。
sentences.traditional: 設立明確目標以後，團隊行動更有效率。
sentences.pinyin: Shèlì míngquè mùbiāo yǐhòu, tuánduì xíngdòng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: After establishing clear goals, the team acted more efficiently.

sentences.chinese: 这个社区的公共设施很完善。
sentences.traditional: 這個社區的公共設施很完善。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèqū de gōnggòng shèshī hěn wánshàn.
sentences.translation: The public facilities in this community are very well developed.

sentences.chinese: 周末社区会组织一次环保活动。
sentences.traditional: 週末社區會組織一次環保活動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò shèqū huì zǔzhī yí cì huánbǎo huódòng.
sentences.translation: At the weekend, the community will organise an environmental protection activity.

sentences.chinese: 老人们喜欢在社区中心聊天。
sentences.traditional: 老人們喜歡在社區中心聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorénmen xǐhuan zài shèqū zhōngxīn liáotiān.
sentences.translation: The elderly like chatting at the community centre.

sentences.chinese: 新体育馆的设施非常先进。
sentences.traditional: 新體育館的設施非常先進。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn tǐyùguǎn de shèshī fēicháng xiānjìn.
sentences.translation: The facilities in the new sports hall are very advanced.

sentences.chinese: 医院正在更新急诊室的设施。
sentences.traditional: 醫院正在更新急診室的設施。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn zhèngzài gēngxīn jízhěnshì de shèshī.
sentences.translation: The hospital is updating the facilities in the emergency room.

sentences.chinese: 完善的交通设施有助于城市发展。
sentences.traditional: 完善的交通設施有助於城市發展。
sentences.pinyin: Wánshàn de jiāotōng shèshī yǒuzhù yú chéngshì fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Well-developed transport facilities help a city develop.

sentences.chinese: 他大学学的是摄影，毕业后成了记者。
sentences.traditional: 他大學學的是攝影，畢業後成了記者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué xué de shì shèyǐng, bìyè hòu chéng le jìzhě.
sentences.translation: He studied photography at university and became a journalist after graduation.

sentences.chinese: 摄影不仅需要技术，也需要耐心。
sentences.traditional: 攝影不僅需要技術，也需要耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Shèyǐng bùjǐn xūyào jìshù, yě xūyào nàixīn.
sentences.translation: Photography requires not only skill, but also patience.

sentences.chinese: 这张照片的摄影角度很特别。
sentences.traditional: 這張照片的攝影角度很特別。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn de shèyǐng jiǎodù hěn tèbié.
sentences.translation: The photographic angle of this photo is very special.

sentences.chinese: 请先设置密码，再登录系统。
sentences.traditional: 請先設置密碼，再登錄系統。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān shèzhì mìmǎ, zài dēnglù xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: Please set a password first, then log in to the system.

sentences.chinese: 这个功能可以在手机里设置。
sentences.traditional: 這個功能可以在手機裡設置。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngnéng kěyǐ zài shǒujī lǐ shèzhì.
sentences.translation: This function can be set on the phone.

sentences.chinese: 学校在门口设置了安全检查点。
sentences.traditional: 學校在門口設置了安全檢查點。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zài ménkǒu shèzhì le ānquán jiǎnchádiǎn.
sentences.translation: The school set up a security checkpoint at the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 坐久了以后，他站起来伸了伸腰。
sentences.traditional: 坐久了以後，他站起來伸了伸腰。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò jiǔ le yǐhòu, tā zhàn qǐlái shēn le shēn yāo.
sentences.translation: After sitting for a long time, he stood up and stretched his waist.

sentences.chinese: 请把手伸出来，让医生检查一下。
sentences.traditional: 請把手伸出來，讓醫生檢查一下。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shǒu shēn chūlái, ràng yīshēng jiǎnchá yíxià.
sentences.translation: Please stretch out your hand and let the doctor check it.

sentences.chinese: 她伸手关掉了台灯。
sentences.traditional: 她伸手關掉了檯燈。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēn shǒu guān diào le táidēng.
sentences.translation: She reached out and turned off the desk lamp.

sentences.chinese: 他坚持游泳，身材保持得很好。
sentences.traditional: 他堅持游泳，身材保持得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiānchí yóuyǒng, shēncái bǎochí de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: He keeps swimming, so he maintains a good figure.

sentences.chinese: 模特儿的身材比例很适合这套衣服。
sentences.traditional: 模特兒的身材比例很適合這套衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Mótèr de shēncái bǐlì hěn shìhé zhè tào yīfu.
sentences.translation: The model’s body proportions suit this outfit very well.

sentences.chinese: 她不追求完美身材，更重视健康。
sentences.traditional: 她不追求完美身材，更重視健康。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhuīqiú wánměi shēncái, gèng zhòngshì jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: She does not pursue a perfect figure; she values health more.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，岸边堆满了被洪水冲来的树枝和垃圾。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，岸邊堆滿了被洪水沖來的樹枝和垃圾。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, ànbiān duī mǎn le bèi hóngshuǐ chōng lái de shùzhī hé lājī.
sentences.translation: After the heavy rain, the riverbank was piled with branches and rubbish carried there by the floodwater.

sentences.chinese: 船一靠岸，等候多时的记者便围了上来。
sentences.traditional: 船一靠岸，等候多時的記者便圍了上來。
sentences.pinyin: Chuán yí kào'àn, děnghòu duōshí de jìzhě biàn wéi le shànglai.
sentences.translation: As soon as the boat reached the shore, the journalists who had been waiting for a long time gathered round.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市沿岸开发过快，湿地生态受到了明显影响。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市沿岸開發過快，濕地生態受到了明顯影響。
