sentences.chinese: 未经许可，任何人不得进入实验区域。
sentences.traditional: 未經許可，任何人不得進入實驗區域。
sentences.pinyin: Wèijīng xǔkě, rènhé rén bùdé jìnrù shíyàn qūyù.
sentences.translation: Without permission, no one may enter the experimental area.

sentences.chinese: 受保密协议限制，员工不得对外透露客户资料。
sentences.traditional: 受保密協議限制，員工不得對外透露客戶資料。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu bǎomì xiéyì xiànzhì, yuángōng bùdé duìwài tòulù kèhù zīliào.
sentences.translation: Bound by the confidentiality agreement, employees must not disclose client information externally.

sentences.chinese: 法院判决生效前，相关资产不得擅自转移。
sentences.traditional: 法院判決生效前，相關資產不得擅自轉移。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎyuàn pànjué shēngxiào qián, xiāngguān zīchǎn bùdé shànzì zhuǎnyí.
sentences.translation: Before the court ruling takes effect, the relevant assets must not be transferred without authorisation.

sentences.chinese: 救灾部队抵达后，受困群众终于得到及时转移。
sentences.traditional: 救災部隊抵達後，受困群眾終於得到及時轉移。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùzāi bùduì dǐdá hòu, shòukùn qúnzhòng zhōngyú dédào jíshí zhuǎnyí.
sentences.translation: After the disaster-relief troops arrived, the trapped people were finally evacuated in time.

sentences.chinese: 这支部队长期驻守边境，条件艰苦却纪律严明。
sentences.traditional: 這支部隊長期駐守邊境，條件艱苦卻紀律嚴明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī bùduì chángqī zhùshǒu biānjìng, tiáojiàn jiānkǔ què jìlǜ yánmíng.
sentences.translation: This unit has long been stationed at the border; conditions are hard, but discipline is strict.

sentences.chinese: 他退役多年，仍保留着在部队养成的作息习惯。
sentences.traditional: 他退役多年，仍保留著在部隊養成的作息習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuìyì duōnián, réng bǎoliú zhe zài bùduì yǎngchéng de zuòxí xíguàn.
sentences.translation: Many years after retiring from the army, he still keeps the daily routine he developed there.

sentences.chinese: 看到孩子把自己的零花钱捐出来，老师不禁红了眼眶。
sentences.traditional: 看到孩子把自己的零花錢捐出來，老師不禁紅了眼眶。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào háizi bǎ zìjǐ de línghuāqián juān chūlái, lǎoshī bùjīn hóng le yǎnkuàng.
sentences.translation: Seeing the child donate his own pocket money, the teacher could not help getting teary-eyed.

sentences.chinese: 面对如此草率的决定，许多专家不禁提出质疑。
sentences.traditional: 面對如此草率的決定，許多專家不禁提出質疑。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì rúcǐ cǎoshuài de juédìng, xǔduō zhuānjiā bùjīn tíchū zhìyí.
sentences.translation: Faced with such a hasty decision, many experts could not help raising doubts.

sentences.chinese: 当旧照片出现在屏幕上时，他不禁想起那段艰难岁月。
sentences.traditional: 當舊照片出現在屏幕上時，他不禁想起那段艱難歲月。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng jiù zhàopiàn chūxiàn zài píngmù shàng shí, tā bùjīn xiǎngqǐ nà duàn jiānnán suìyuè.
sentences.translation: When the old photos appeared on the screen, he could not help thinking of those difficult years.

sentences.chinese: 会议进行到深夜，走廊里不时传来低声讨论。
sentences.traditional: 會議進行到深夜，走廊裡不時傳來低聲討論。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jìnxíng dào shēnyè, zǒuláng lǐ bùshí chuánlái dīshēng tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: As the meeting continued late into the night, low voices of discussion could occasionally be heard from the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 这条山路年久失修，雨季不时发生小规模塌方。
sentences.traditional: 這條山路年久失修，雨季不時發生小規模塌方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānlù niánjiǔ shīxiū, yǔjì bùshí fāshēng xiǎo guīmó tāfāng.
sentences.translation: This mountain road has long been in disrepair, and small landslides occur from time to time during the rainy season.

sentences.chinese: 老人虽然已经退休，却不时被学校请回去作专题讲座。
sentences.traditional: 老人雖然已經退休，卻不時被學校請回去作專題講座。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén suīrán yǐjīng tuìxiū, què bùshí bèi xuéxiào qǐng huíqù zuò zhuāntí jiǎngzuò.
sentences.translation: Although the old man has already retired, he is still occasionally invited back by the school to give special lectures.

sentences.chinese: 手术前，医生必须准确确认受伤部位，以避免误伤周围组织。
sentences.traditional: 手術前，醫生必須準確確認受傷部位，以避免誤傷周圍組織。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒushù qián, yīshēng bìxū zhǔnquè quèrèn shòushāng bùwèi, yǐ bìmiǎn wùshāng zhōuwéi zǔzhī.
sentences.translation: Before surgery, the doctor must accurately confirm the injured part in order to avoid damaging surrounding tissue by mistake.

sentences.chinese: 这种疼痛如果集中在同一部位，就不应简单归因于疲劳。
sentences.traditional: 這種疼痛如果集中在同一部位，就不應簡單歸因於疲勞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng téngtòng rúguǒ jízhōng zài tóng yī bùwèi, jiù bù yīng jiǎndān guīyīn yú píláo.
sentences.translation: If this kind of pain is concentrated in the same area, it should not simply be attributed to fatigue.

sentences.chinese: 机器的关键部位一旦磨损，整条生产线都会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 機器的關鍵部位一旦磨損，整條生產線都會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì de guānjiàn bùwèi yídàn mósǔn, zhěng tiáo shēngchǎnxiàn dōu huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Once a key part of the machine wears out, the entire production line will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 施工现场不许随意进入，否则容易发生安全事故。
sentences.traditional: 施工現場不許隨意進入，否則容易發生安全事故。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōng xiànchǎng bùxǔ suíyì jìnrù, fǒuzé róngyì fāshēng ānquán shìgù.
sentences.translation: No one is allowed to enter the construction site at will, otherwise safety accidents may easily occur.

sentences.chinese: 合同明确规定，未经双方同意不许擅自修改付款条件。
sentences.traditional: 合同明確規定，未經雙方同意不許擅自修改付款條件。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong míngquè guīdìng, wèijīng shuāngfāng tóngyì bùxǔ shànzì xiūgǎi fùkuǎn tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: The contract clearly states that the payment terms must not be changed without both parties’ consent.

sentences.chinese: 她从小被教育，不许因为别人的出身而轻视对方。
sentences.traditional: 她從小被教育，不許因為別人的出身而輕視對方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo bèi jiàoyù, bùxǔ yīnwèi biérén de chūshēn ér qīngshì duìfāng.
sentences.translation: She was taught from childhood that one must not look down on others because of their background.

sentences.chinese: 这种药不宜与酒精同时服用，否则可能加重副作用。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥不宜與酒精同時服用，否則可能加重副作用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào bùyí yǔ jiǔjīng tóngshí fúyòng, fǒuzé kěnéng jiāzhòng fùzuòyòng.
sentences.translation: This medicine should not be taken with alcohol, otherwise it may worsen the side effects.

sentences.chinese: 在证据尚不充分的情况下，媒体不宜过早作出结论。
sentences.traditional: 在證據尚不充分的情況下，媒體不宜過早作出結論。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngjù shàng bù chōngfèn de qíngkuàng xià, méitǐ bùyí guòzǎo zuòchū jiélùn.
sentences.translation: When the evidence is still insufficient, the media should not draw conclusions too early.

sentences.chinese: 老旧建筑的改造不宜一味追求外观，而应优先考虑安全。
sentences.traditional: 老舊建築的改造不宜一味追求外觀，而應優先考慮安全。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎojiù jiànzhù de gǎizào bùyí yíwèi zhuīqiú wàiguān, ér yīng yōuxiān kǎolǜ ānquán.
sentences.translation: Renovation of old buildings should not blindly pursue appearance, but should prioritise safety.

sentences.chinese: 听完他的经历，现场观众感动不已。
sentences.traditional: 聽完他的經歷，現場觀眾感動不已。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng wán tā de jīnglì, xiànchǎng guānzhòng gǎndòng bùyǐ.
sentences.translation: After hearing his experience, the audience at the scene was deeply moved.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，家属悲痛不已，久久无法接受现实。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，家屬悲痛不已，久久無法接受現實。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, jiāshǔ bēitòng bùyǐ, jiǔjiǔ wúfǎ jiēshòu xiànshí.
sentences.translation: After the accident, the family were overcome with grief and could not accept reality for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革让各方争论不已，支持者和反对者各执一词。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革讓各方爭論不已，支持者和反對者各執一詞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé ràng gèfāng zhēnglùn bùyǐ, zhīchízhě hé fǎnduìzhě gèzhíyìcí.
sentences.translation: This reform has caused continuous debate among all sides, with supporters and opponents each sticking to their own view.

sentences.chinese: 为了迎接访问团，学校提前布置了会议室和展览区。
sentences.traditional: 為了迎接訪問團，學校提前佈置了會議室和展覽區。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile yíngjiē fǎngwèntuán, xuéxiào tíqián bùzhì le huìyìshì hé zhǎnlǎnqū.
sentences.translation: To welcome the visiting delegation, the school arranged the meeting room and exhibition area in advance.

sentences.chinese: 老师布置的任务并不复杂，关键在于如何收集可靠资料。
sentences.traditional: 老師佈置的任務並不複雜，關鍵在於如何收集可靠資料。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bùzhì de rènwù bìng bù fùzá, guānjiàn zàiyú rúhé shōují kěkào zīliào.
sentences.translation: The task assigned by the teacher is not complicated; the key lies in how to collect reliable materials.

sentences.chinese: 新家的客厅布置得很简洁，却处处体现出主人的审美。
sentences.traditional: 新家的客廳佈置得很簡潔，卻處處體現出主人的審美。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jiā de kètīng bùzhì de hěn jiǎnjié, què chùchù tǐxiàn chū zhǔrén de shěnměi.
sentences.translation: The living room in the new home is arranged very simply, yet it reflects the owner’s taste everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 雨下个不止，山区的救援队只能暂时停止搜救。
sentences.traditional: 雨下個不止，山區的救援隊只能暫時停止搜救。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ xià ge bùzhǐ, shānqū de jiùyuánduì zhǐ néng zànshí tíngzhǐ sōujiù.
sentences.translation: The rain kept falling without stopping, so the mountain rescue team could only temporarily stop the search and rescue.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题不止关系到成本，还关系到公众对公司的信任。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題不止關係到成本，還關係到公眾對公司的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bùzhǐ guānxì dào chéngběn, hái guānxì dào gōngzhòng duì gōngsī de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: This issue concerns not only costs, but also the public’s trust in the company.

sentences.chinese: 他咳嗽不止，医生建议他尽快做一次详细检查。
sentences.traditional: 他咳嗽不止，醫生建議他儘快做一次詳細檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Tā késou bùzhǐ, yīshēng jiànyì tā jǐnkuài zuò yí cì xiángxì jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: He could not stop coughing, so the doctor advised him to have a detailed examination as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 申请签证的步骤看似简单，但任何一项材料出错都可能导致延误。
sentences.traditional: 申請簽證的步驟看似簡單，但任何一項材料出錯都可能導致延誤。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng de bùzhòu kànsì jiǎndān, dàn rènhé yí xiàng cáiliào chūcuò dōu kěnéng dǎozhì yánwù.
sentences.translation: The steps for applying for a visa may look simple, but a mistake in any document could cause a delay.

sentences.chinese: 在正式发布之前，团队把测试步骤重新核对了一遍。
sentences.traditional: 在正式發布之前，團隊把測試步驟重新核對了一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì fābù zhīqián, tuánduì bǎ cèshì bùzhòu chóngxīn héduì le yí biàn.
sentences.translation: Before the official release, the team checked the testing procedure again.

sentences.chinese: 老师把解题步骤写得很清楚，学生即使自学也能跟上。
sentences.traditional: 老師把解題步驟寫得很清楚，學生即使自學也能跟上。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ jiětí bùzhòu xiě de hěn qīngchu, xuéshēng jíshǐ zìxué yě néng gēnshàng.
sentences.translation: The teacher wrote the problem-solving steps very clearly, so students can follow even if they study on their own.

sentences.chinese: 在缺乏证据的情况下，任何猜测都可能误导公众。
sentences.traditional: 在缺乏證據的情況下，任何猜測都可能誤導公眾。
sentences.pinyin: Zài quēfá zhèngjù de qíngkuàng xià, rènhé cāicè dōu kěnéng wùdǎo gōngzhòng.
sentences.translation: When evidence is lacking, any guess may mislead the public.

sentences.chinese: 他没有直接回答，只让我们自己猜测事情的真相。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有直接回答，只讓我們自己猜測事情的真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhíjiē huídá, zhǐ ràng wǒmen zìjǐ cāicè shìqing de zhēnxiàng.
sentences.translation: He did not answer directly, and only let us guess the truth of the matter for ourselves.

sentences.chinese: 外界猜测这家公司会裁员，但管理层一直保持沉默。
sentences.traditional: 外界猜測這家公司會裁員，但管理層一直保持沉默。
sentences.pinyin: Wàijiè cāicè zhè jiā gōngsī huì cáiyuán, dàn guǎnlǐcéng yìzhí bǎochí chénmò.
sentences.translation: People outside the company guess that it will make redundancies, but the management has remained silent.

sentences.chinese: 离婚协议中最难处理的，往往是共同财产的分配问题。
sentences.traditional: 離婚協議中最難處理的，往往是共同財產的分配問題。
sentences.pinyin: Líhūn xiéyì zhōng zuì nán chǔlǐ de, wǎngwǎng shì gòngtóng cáichǎn de fēnpèi wèntí.
sentences.translation: The hardest part of a divorce agreement is often the distribution of shared property.

sentences.chinese: 洪水过后，许多居民的私人财产遭受了严重损失。
sentences.traditional: 洪水過後，許多居民的私人財產遭受了嚴重損失。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngshuǐ guòhòu, xǔduō jūmín de sīrén cáichǎn zāoshòu le yánzhòng sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: After the flood, the private property of many residents suffered serious losses.

sentences.chinese: 法律不仅保护个人财产，也保护合法经营所产生的收益。
sentences.traditional: 法律不僅保護個人財產，也保護合法經營所產生的收益。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ bùjǐn bǎohù gèrén cáichǎn, yě bǎohù héfǎ jīngyíng suǒ chǎnshēng de shōuyì.
sentences.translation: The law protects not only personal property, but also income generated through lawful business activity.

sentences.chinese: 对一个国家来说，真正的财富不仅是资源，还有受过良好教育的人民。
sentences.traditional: 對一個國家來說，真正的財富不僅是資源，還有受過良好教育的人民。
sentences.pinyin: Duì yí gè guójiā lái shuō, zhēnzhèng de cáifù bùjǐn shì zīyuán, hái yǒu shòuguò liánghǎo jiàoyù de rénmín.
sentences.translation: For a country, true wealth is not only resources, but also a well-educated people.

sentences.chinese: 他积累了大量财富，却始终认为健康比金钱更重要。
sentences.traditional: 他積累了大量財富，卻始終認為健康比金錢更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīlěi le dàliàng cáifù, què shǐzhōng rènwéi jiànkāng bǐ jīnqián gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: He accumulated a great deal of wealth, yet always believed that health was more important than money.

sentences.chinese: 文化遗产是一种无形财富，不能只用市场价格来衡量。
sentences.traditional: 文化遺產是一種無形財富，不能只用市場價格來衡量。
sentences.pinyin: Wénhuà yíchǎn shì yì zhǒng wúxíng cáifù, bù néng zhǐ yòng shìchǎng jiàgé lái héngliáng.
sentences.translation: Cultural heritage is a form of intangible wealth and cannot be measured only by market price.

sentences.chinese: 她的才华早已得到认可，只是缺少一个真正展示自己的舞台。
sentences.traditional: 她的才華早已得到認可，只是缺少一個真正展示自己的舞臺。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de cáihuá zǎo yǐ dédào rènkě, zhǐshì quēshǎo yí gè zhēnzhèng zhǎnshì zìjǐ de wǔtái.
sentences.translation: Her talent has long been recognised; she simply lacks a stage on which to truly show herself.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有长期训练，再突出的才华也难以转化为稳定的成果。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有長期訓練，再突出的才華也難以轉化為穩定的成果。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu chángqī xùnliàn, zài tūchū de cáihuá yě nányǐ zhuǎnhuà wéi wěndìng de chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Without long-term training, even outstanding talent is difficult to turn into stable results.

sentences.chinese: 领导者要善于发现年轻人的才华，而不是只看他们的资历。
sentences.traditional: 領導者要善於發現年輕人的才華，而不是只看他們的資歷。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngdǎozhě yào shànyú fāxiàn niánqīngrén de cáihuá, ér bú shì zhǐ kàn tāmen de zīlì.
sentences.translation: Leaders should be good at discovering young people’s talent, rather than only looking at their seniority.

sentences.chinese: 他的才能没有被埋没，反而在困难环境中逐渐显现出来。
sentences.traditional: 他的才能沒有被埋沒，反而在困難環境中逐漸顯現出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de cáinéng méiyǒu bèi máimò, fǎn'ér zài kùnnán huánjìng zhōng zhújiàn xiǎnxiàn chūlai.
sentences.translation: His ability was not buried; on the contrary, it gradually revealed itself in a difficult environment.

sentences.chinese: 公司需要的不只是学历，更是能够承担责任的实际才能。
sentences.traditional: 公司需要的不只是學歷，更是能夠承擔責任的實際才能。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào de bù zhǐ shì xuélì, gèng shì nénggòu chéngdān zérèn de shíjì cáinéng.
sentences.translation: What the company needs is not just qualifications, but real ability to take responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 他把自己的音乐才能用在公益项目上，为孩子们开设免费课程。
sentences.traditional: 他把自己的音樂才能用在公益項目上，為孩子們開設免費課程。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ de yīnyuè cáinéng yòng zài gōngyì xiàngmù shàng, wèi háizimen kāishè miǎnfèi kèchéng.
sentences.translation: He used his musical talent in a public welfare project, setting up free classes for children.

sentences.chinese: 新任财务主管上任后，首先重新审查了公司的现金流。
sentences.traditional: 新任財務主管上任後，首先重新審查了公司的現金流。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnrèn cáiwù zhǔguǎn shàngrèn hòu, shǒuxiān chóngxīn shěnchá le gōngsī de xiànjīnliú.
sentences.translation: After taking up the role, the new finance director first reviewed the company’s cash flow.

sentences.chinese: 如果财务数据不透明，投资者很难判断企业的真实状况。
sentences.traditional: 如果財務數據不透明，投資者很難判斷企業的真實狀況。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ cáiwù shùjù bù tòumíng, tóuzīzhě hěn nán pànduàn qǐyè de zhēnshí zhuàngkuàng.
sentences.translation: If the financial data is not transparent, investors will find it hard to judge the company’s true situation.

sentences.chinese: 这次审计发现，财务报表中的几项支出缺乏凭证。
sentences.traditional: 這次審計發現，財務報表中的幾項支出缺乏憑證。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shěnjì fāxiàn, cáiwù bàobiǎo zhōng de jǐ xiàng zhīchū quēfá píngzhèng.
sentences.translation: This audit found that several expenses in the financial statements lacked supporting documents.

sentences.chinese: 火灾发生后，学校提醒学生不要回宿舍抢救财物。
sentences.traditional: 火災發生後，學校提醒學生不要回宿舍搶救財物。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒzāi fāshēng hòu, xuéxiào tíxǐng xuéshēng bú yào huí sùshè qiǎngjiù cáiwù.
sentences.translation: After the fire broke out, the school reminded students not to return to the dormitory to rescue belongings.

sentences.chinese: 旅客应妥善保管随身财物，尤其是在拥挤的车站。
sentences.traditional: 旅客應妥善保管隨身財物，尤其是在擁擠的車站。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚkè yīng tuǒshàn bǎoguǎn suíshēn cáiwù, yóuqí shì zài yōngjǐ de chēzhàn.
sentences.translation: Passengers should take proper care of their belongings, especially in crowded stations.

sentences.chinese: 警方公布了失窃财物的照片，希望失主尽快前来认领。
sentences.traditional: 警方公佈了失竊財物的照片，希望失主儘快前來認領。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng gōngbù le shīqiè cáiwù de zhàopiàn, xīwàng shīzhǔ jǐnkuài qián lái rènlǐng.
sentences.translation: The police released photos of the stolen property, hoping that the owners would come forward to claim it as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套的材质虽然轻薄，却能有效抵御寒风。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套的材質雖然輕薄，卻能有效抵禦寒風。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào de cáizhì suīrán qīngbáo, què néng yǒuxiào dǐyù hánfēng.
sentences.translation: Although the material of this coat is light and thin, it can effectively resist the cold wind.

sentences.chinese: 购买儿童家具时，家长最关心的往往是材质是否安全。
sentences.traditional: 購買兒童傢俱時，家長最關心的往往是材質是否安全。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi értóng jiājù shí, jiāzhǎng zuì guānxīn de wǎngwǎng shì cáizhì shìfǒu ānquán.
sentences.translation: When buying children’s furniture, parents are usually most concerned about whether the material is safe.

sentences.chinese: 设计师保留了木头原有的材质纹理，使空间显得更自然。
sentences.traditional: 設計師保留了木頭原有的材質紋理，使空間顯得更自然。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī bǎoliú le mùtou yuányǒu de cáizhì wénlǐ, shǐ kōngjiān xiǎnde gèng zìrán.
sentences.translation: The designer preserved the original texture of the wood, making the space appear more natural.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束时，他一不小心踩到了地上的电线，差点导致设备断电。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束時，他一不小心踩到了地上的電線，差點導致設備斷電。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù shí, tā yì bù xiǎoxīn cǎi dào le dìshàng de diànxiàn, chàdiǎn dǎozhì shèbèi duàndiàn.
sentences.translation: At the end of the meeting, he accidentally stepped on the cable on the floor and almost caused the equipment to lose power.

sentences.chinese: 在拥挤的车厢里，她被人踩了一脚，却连是谁都没看清。
sentences.traditional: 在擁擠的車廂裡，她被人踩了一腳，卻連是誰都沒看清。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yōngjǐ de chēxiāng lǐ, tā bèi rén cǎi le yì jiǎo, què lián shì shéi dōu méi kànqīng.
sentences.translation: In the crowded carriage, someone stepped on her foot, but she did not even see who it was.

sentences.chinese: 有些游客为了拍照踩进保护区，破坏了刚恢复的植被。
sentences.traditional: 有些遊客為了拍照踩進保護區，破壞了剛恢復的植被。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē yóukè wèile pāizhào cǎi jìn bǎohùqū, pòhuài le gāng huīfù de zhíbèi.
sentences.translation: Some tourists step into the protected area to take photos, damaging vegetation that has only just recovered.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定把设备采购流程公开，以减少内部操作的灰色空间。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定把設備採購流程公開，以減少內部操作的灰色空間。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng bǎ shèbèi cǎigòu liúchéng gōngkāi, yǐ jiǎnshǎo nèibù cāozuò de huīsè kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: The company decided to make the equipment procurement process public in order to reduce the grey area in internal operations.

sentences.chinese: 由于原材料价格上涨，采购部门不得不重新评估供应商的报价。
sentences.traditional: 由於原材料價格上漲，採購部門不得不重新評估供應商的報價。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng, cǎigòu bùmén bùdébù chóngxīn pínggū gōngyìngshāng de bàojià.
sentences.translation: Because raw material prices have risen, the procurement department has had to reassess suppliers’ quotations.

sentences.chinese: 政府采购若缺乏监督，很容易滋生浪费甚至腐败。
sentences.traditional: 政府採購若缺乏監督，很容易滋生浪費甚至腐敗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎigòu ruò quēfá jiāndū, hěn róngyì zīshēng làngfèi shènzhì fǔbài.
sentences.translation: If government procurement lacks supervision, it can easily give rise to waste and even corruption.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，远处的山谷上空出现了一道清晰的彩虹。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，遠處的山谷上空出現了一道清晰的彩虹。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, yuǎnchù de shāngǔ shàngkōng chūxiàn le yí dào qīngxī de cǎihóng.
sentences.translation: After the downpour, a clear rainbow appeared in the sky above the distant valley.

sentences.chinese: 孩子第一次看到双重彩虹，兴奋得连话都说不完整。
sentences.traditional: 孩子第一次看到雙重彩虹，興奮得連話都說不完整。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi dì-yī cì kàndào shuāngchóng cǎihóng, xīngfèn de lián huà dōu shuō bù wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: The child saw a double rainbow for the first time and was so excited that he could hardly speak properly.

sentences.chinese: 在不少文化中，彩虹常被看作希望与和解的象征。
sentences.traditional: 在不少文化中，彩虹常被看作希望與和解的象徵。
sentences.pinyin: Zài bù shǎo wénhuà zhōng, cǎihóng cháng bèi kànzuò xīwàng yǔ héjiě de xiàngzhēng.
sentences.translation: In many cultures, rainbows are often regarded as symbols of hope and reconciliation.

sentences.chinese: 科研团队在野外采集样本时，必须严格记录地点和时间。
sentences.traditional: 科研團隊在野外採集樣本時，必須嚴格記錄地點和時間。
sentences.pinyin: Kēyán tuánduì zài yěwài cǎijí yàngběn shí, bìxū yángé jìlù dìdiǎn hé shíjiān.
sentences.translation: When a research team collects samples in the field, it must record the location and time strictly.

sentences.chinese: 这款应用程序会采集用户的位置信息，因此隐私政策必须写得足够清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這款應用程序會採集用戶的位置信息，因此隱私政策必須寫得足夠清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yìngyòng chéngxù huì cǎijí shǐyòngzhě de wèizhì zīxùn, yīncǐ yǐnsī zhèngcè bìxū xiě de zúgòu qīngchu.
sentences.translation: This app collects users’ location information, so the privacy policy must be written clearly enough.

sentences.chinese: 调查人员需要先采集证据，再判断事故责任是否明确。
sentences.traditional: 調查人員需要先採集證據，再判斷事故責任是否明確。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá rényuán xūyào xiān cǎijí zhèngjù, zài pànduàn shìgù zérèn shìfǒu míngquè.
sentences.translation: Investigators need to collect evidence first, and only then judge whether responsibility for the accident is clear.

sentences.chinese: 委员会最终采纳了专家的建议，推迟实施新的收费制度。
sentences.traditional: 委員會最終採納了專家的建議，推遲實施新的收費制度。
sentences.pinyin: Wěiyuánhuì zuìzhōng cǎinà le zhuānjiā de jiànyì, tuīchí shíshī xīn de shōufèi zhìdù.
sentences.translation: The committee finally adopted the experts’ suggestion and postponed the implementation of the new charging system.

sentences.chinese: 如果企业愿意采纳一线员工的意见，很多管理问题其实可以提前避免。
sentences.traditional: 如果企業願意採納一線員工的意見，很多管理問題其實可以提前避免。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qǐyè yuànyì cǎinà yīxiàn yuángōng de yìjiàn, hěn duō guǎnlǐ wèntí qíshí kěyǐ tíqián bìmiǎn.
sentences.translation: If companies are willing to accept the opinions of frontline employees, many management problems can actually be avoided in advance.

sentences.chinese: 他的方案没有被采纳，并不是因为缺乏创意，而是预算太高。
sentences.traditional: 他的方案沒有被採納，並不是因為缺乏創意，而是預算太高。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fāng'àn méiyǒu bèi cǎinà, bìng bú shì yīnwèi quēfá chuàngyì, ér shì yùsuàn tài gāo.
sentences.translation: His proposal was not adopted, not because it lacked creativity, but because the budget was too high.

sentences.chinese: 他偶尔买一张彩票，但从不把中奖当成改变生活的计划。
sentences.traditional: 他偶爾買一張彩票，但從不把中獎當成改變生活的計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ǒu'ěr mǎi yì zhāng cǎipiào, dàn cóng bù bǎ zhòngjiǎng dàngchéng gǎibiàn shēnghuó de jìhuà.
sentences.translation: He occasionally buys a lottery ticket, but never treats winning as a plan for changing his life.

sentences.chinese: 彩票销售收入的一部分被用于支持公共福利项目。
sentences.traditional: 彩票銷售收入的一部分被用於支持公共福利項目。
sentences.pinyin: Cǎipiào xiāoshòu shōurù de yí bùfen bèi yòng yú zhīchí gōnggòng fúlì xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: Part of the revenue from lottery ticket sales is used to support public welfare projects.

sentences.chinese: 中奖者发现彩票遗失后，才意识到保存凭证的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 中獎者發現彩票遺失後，才意識到保存憑證的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhòngjiǎngzhě fāxiàn cǎipiào yíshī hòu, cái yìshí dào bǎocún píngzhèng de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: Only after discovering that the lottery ticket was missing did the winner realise the importance of keeping proof.

sentences.chinese: 这家初创公司首次参展，就获得了多家投资机构的关注。
sentences.traditional: 這家初創公司首次參展，就獲得了多家投資機構的關注。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā chūchuàng gōngsī shǒucì cānzhǎn, jiù huòdé le duō jiā tóuzī jīgòu de guānzhù.
sentences.translation: The start-up attracted the attention of several investment institutions the first time it exhibited.

sentences.chinese: 参展前，团队必须准备好样品、宣传册以及现场演示方案。
sentences.traditional: 參展前，團隊必須準備好樣品、宣傳冊以及現場演示方案。
sentences.pinyin: Cānzhǎn qián, tuánduì bìxū zhǔnbèi hǎo yàngpǐn, xuānchuáncè yǐjí xiànchǎng yǎnshì fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: Before taking part in the exhibition, the team must prepare samples, brochures and an on-site demonstration plan.

sentences.chinese: 虽然参展成本不低，但面对面交流带来的机会很难替代。
sentences.traditional: 雖然參展成本不低，但面對面交流帶來的機會很難替代。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán cānzhǎn chéngběn bù dī, dàn miànduìmiàn jiāoliú dàilái de jīhuì hěn nán tìdài.
sentences.translation: Although the cost of exhibiting is not low, the opportunities created by face-to-face communication are hard to replace.

sentences.chinese: 城市规划若忽视残疾人士的需求，就谈不上真正的公共服务。
sentences.traditional: 城市規劃若忽視殘疾人士的需求，就談不上真正的公共服務。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì guīhuà ruò hūshì cánjí rénshì de xūqiú, jiù tán bu shàng zhēnzhèng de gōnggòng fúwù.
sentences.translation: If urban planning ignores the needs of disabled people, it cannot be called genuine public service.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策旨在帮助残疾儿童获得更公平的教育机会。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策旨在幫助殘疾兒童獲得更公平的教育機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè zhǐ zài bāngzhù cánjí értóng huòdé gèng gōngpíng de jiàoyù jīhuì.
sentences.translation: This policy is intended to help disabled children obtain fairer educational opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 事故造成的残疾不仅改变了他的工作方式，也重塑了他的人生观。
sentences.traditional: 事故造成的殘疾不僅改變了他的工作方式，也重塑了他的人生觀。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù zàochéng de cánjí bùjǐn gǎibiàn le tā de gōngzuò fāngshì, yě chóngsù le tā de rénshēnguān.
sentences.translation: The disability caused by the accident not only changed the way he worked, but also reshaped his outlook on life.

sentences.chinese: 仓库管理混乱会直接影响发货速度，甚至造成库存数据失真。
sentences.traditional: 倉庫管理混亂會直接影響發貨速度，甚至造成庫存數據失真。
sentences.pinyin: Cāngkù guǎnlǐ hùnluàn huì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng fāhuò sùdù, shènzhì zàochéng kùcún shùjù shīzhēn.
sentences.translation: Chaotic warehouse management directly affects dispatch speed and can even distort inventory data.

sentences.chinese: 火灾发生后，附近仓库里的易燃材料被紧急转移。
sentences.traditional: 火災發生後，附近倉庫裡的易燃材料被緊急轉移。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒzāi fāshēng hòu, fùjìn cāngkù lǐ de yìrán cáiliào bèi jǐnjí zhuǎnyí.
sentences.translation: After the fire broke out, flammable materials in nearby warehouses were urgently moved.

sentences.chinese: 公司把旧厂房改造成自动化仓库，以降低长期运营成本。
sentences.traditional: 公司把舊廠房改造成自動化倉庫，以降低長期運營成本。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī bǎ jiù chǎngfáng gǎizào chéng zìdònghuà cāngkù, yǐ jiàngdī chángqī yùnyíng chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The company converted the old factory building into an automated warehouse to reduce long-term operating costs.

sentences.chinese: 夏季的草原看似平静，却隐藏着复杂而脆弱的生态系统。
sentences.traditional: 夏季的草原看似平靜，卻隱藏著複雜而脆弱的生態系統。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàjì de cǎoyuán kànsì píngjìng, què yǐncángzhe fùzá ér cuìruò de shēngtài xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: The summer grassland appears calm, yet it hides a complex and fragile ecosystem.

sentences.chinese: 牧民根据草原的恢复情况决定是否继续放牧。
sentences.traditional: 牧民根據草原的恢復情況決定是否繼續放牧。
sentences.pinyin: Mùmín gēnjù cǎoyuán de huīfù qíngkuàng juédìng shìfǒu jìxù fàngmù.
sentences.translation: Herders decide whether to continue grazing according to how well the grassland has recovered.

sentences.chinese: 如果过度开发，草原退化的速度可能比人们想象的更快。
sentences.traditional: 如果過度開發，草原退化的速度可能比人們想像的更快。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ guòdù kāifā, cǎoyuán tuìhuà de sùdù kěnéng bǐ rénmen xiǎngxiàng de gèng kuài.
sentences.translation: If it is overdeveloped, grassland degradation may happen faster than people imagine.

sentences.chinese: 他侧过身，让医护人员把担架顺利推了进去。
sentences.traditional: 他側過身，讓醫護人員把擔架順利推了進去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cè guò shēn, ràng yīhù rényuán bǎ dānjià shùnlì tuī le jìnqu.
sentences.translation: He turned sideways, allowing the medical staff to push the stretcher in smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 从建筑的西侧看，整座桥的结构更加清楚。
sentences.traditional: 從建築的西側看，整座橋的結構更加清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng jiànzhù de xī cè kàn, zhěng zuò qiáo de jiégòu gèngjiā qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Seen from the west side of the building, the structure of the whole bridge is clearer.

sentences.chinese: 请把照片从侧面再拍一张，以便专家判断伤口的深度。
sentences.traditional: 請把照片從側面再拍一張，以便專家判斷傷口的深度。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhàopiàn cóng cèmiàn zài pāi yì zhāng, yǐbiàn zhuānjiā pànduàn shāngkǒu de shēndù.
sentences.translation: Please take another photo from the side so that the specialist can judge the depth of the wound.

sentences.chinese: 这次公益活动策划得很细，连雨天的备用方案都考虑到了。
sentences.traditional: 這次公益活動策劃得很細，連雨天的備用方案都考慮到了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gōngyì huódòng cèhuà de hěn xì, lián yǔtiān de bèiyòng fāng'àn dōu kǎolǜ dào le.
sentences.translation: This public-interest event was planned very carefully; even a backup plan for rainy weather was considered.

sentences.chinese: 他负责策划公司的海外发布会，需要协调媒体、翻译和供应商。
sentences.traditional: 他負責策劃公司的海外發布會，需要協調媒體、翻譯和供應商。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fùzé cèhuà gōngsī de hǎiwài fābùhuì, xūyào xiétiáo méitǐ, fānyì hé gōngyìngshāng.
sentences.translation: He is responsible for planning the company's overseas launch event and needs to coordinate media, translators and suppliers.

sentences.chinese: 如果前期策划不足，项目进入执行阶段后会不断返工。
sentences.traditional: 如果前期策劃不足，項目進入執行階段後會不斷返工。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qiánqī cèhuà bùzú, xiàngmù jìnrù zhíxíng jiēduàn hòu huì búduàn fǎngōng.
sentences.translation: If the early-stage planning is insufficient, the project will keep needing rework once it enters the execution stage.

sentences.chinese: 工程师在施工前反复测量地基的高度，以免日后出现偏差。
sentences.traditional: 工程師在施工前反覆測量地基的高度，以免日後出現偏差。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zài shīgōng qián fǎnfù cèliáng dìjī de gāodù, yǐmiǎn rìhòu chūxiàn piānchā.
sentences.translation: Before construction, the engineer repeatedly measured the height of the foundation to avoid deviations later.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他每天固定时间测量血压，并记录变化趋势。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他每天固定時間測量血壓，並記錄變化趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān gùdìng shíjiān cèliáng xuèyā, bìng jìlù biànhuà qūshì.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to measure his blood pressure at a fixed time each day and record the trend.

sentences.chinese: 这套设备可以自动测量空气中的污染物浓度。
sentences.traditional: 這套設備可以自動測量空氣中的污染物濃度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào shèbèi kěyǐ zìdòng cèliáng kōngqì zhōng de wūrǎnwù nóngdù.
sentences.translation: This set of equipment can automatically measure the concentration of pollutants in the air.

sentences.chinese: 面对激烈竞争，公司调整了定价策略，不再单纯依靠低价吸引客户。
sentences.traditional: 面對激烈競爭，公司調整了定價策略，不再單純依靠低價吸引客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jīliè jìngzhēng, gōngsī tiáozhěng le dìngjià cèlüè, bú zài dānchún yīkào dījià xīyǐn kèhù.
sentences.translation: Facing fierce competition, the company adjusted its pricing strategy and no longer relies purely on low prices to attract customers.

sentences.chinese: 政府的环保策略若缺乏公众参与，很难长期发挥作用。
sentences.traditional: 政府的環保策略若缺乏公眾參與，很難長期發揮作用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ de huánbǎo cèlüè ruò quēfá gōngzhòng cānyù, hěn nán chángqī fāhuī zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: If the government's environmental strategy lacks public participation, it will be hard for it to work in the long term.

sentences.chinese: 他的谈判策略并不强硬，却能逐步争取对方让步。
sentences.traditional: 他的談判策略並不強硬，卻能逐步爭取對方讓步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tánpàn cèlüè bìng bù qiángyìng, què néng zhúbù zhēngqǔ duìfāng ràngbù.
sentences.translation: His negotiation strategy is not forceful, yet it can gradually win concessions from the other side.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章的论证层次清楚，但结论仍显得有些保守。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章的論證層次清楚，但結論仍顯得有些保守。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de lùnzhèng céngcì qīngchu, dàn jiélùn réng xiǎnde yǒuxiē bǎoshǒu.
sentences.translation: The levels of argument in this article are clear, but the conclusion still seems somewhat cautious.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆按历史层次布置展厅，使参观者更容易理解文明的发展。
sentences.traditional: 博物館按歷史層次布置展廳，使參觀者更容易理解文明的發展。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn àn lìshǐ céngcì bùzhì zhǎntīng, shǐ cānguānzhě gèng róngyì lǐjiě wénmíng de fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: The museum arranges its exhibition halls by historical layer, making it easier for visitors to understand the development of civilisation.

sentences.chinese: 解决住房问题不能停留在表面层次，还要考虑收入分配和公共服务。
sentences.traditional: 解決住房問題不能停留在表面層次，還要考慮收入分配和公共服務。
sentences.pinyin: Jiějué zhùfáng wèntí bù néng tíngliú zài biǎomiàn céngcì, hái yào kǎolǜ shōurù fēnpèi hé gōnggòng fúwù.
sentences.translation: Solving the housing problem cannot remain at a superficial level; income distribution and public services must also be considered.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定不仅影响企业层面，也会改变整个行业的竞争格局。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定不僅影響企業層面，也會改變整個行業的競爭格局。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng qǐyè céngmiàn, yě huì gǎibiàn zhěnggè hángyè de jìngzhēng géjú.
sentences.translation: This decision affects not only the enterprise level, but will also change the competitive pattern of the whole industry.

sentences.chinese: 在法律层面上，这份合同仍存在几个需要澄清的条款。
sentences.traditional: 在法律層面上，這份合同仍存在幾個需要澄清的條款。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fǎlǜ céngmiàn shàng, zhè fèn hétong réng cúnzài jǐ gè xūyào chéngqīng de tiáokuǎn.
sentences.translation: At the legal level, this contract still contains several clauses that need clarification.

sentences.chinese: 教育改革不能只从考试层面入手，否则很难真正减轻学生负担。
sentences.traditional: 教育改革不能只從考試層面入手，否則很難真正減輕學生負擔。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù gǎigé bù néng zhǐ cóng kǎoshì céngmiàn rùshǒu, fǒuzé hěn nán zhēnzhèng jiǎnqīng xuéshēng fùdān.
sentences.translation: Education reform cannot start only from the examination dimension, otherwise it will be hard to truly reduce students' burden.

sentences.chinese: 她不会用叉子吃面条，最后还是换回了筷子。
sentences.traditional: 她不會用叉子吃麵條，最後還是換回了筷子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú huì yòng chāzi chī miàntiáo, zuìhòu háishi huàn huí le kuàizi.
sentences.translation: She could not use a fork to eat noodles, so in the end she switched back to chopsticks.

sentences.chinese: 他在错误答案旁边画了一个叉，示意学生重新计算。
sentences.traditional: 他在錯誤答案旁邊畫了一個叉，示意學生重新計算。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài cuòwù dá'àn pángbiān huà le yí gè chā, shìyì xuéshēng chóngxīn jìsuàn.
sentences.translation: He drew a cross next to the wrong answer, signalling that the student should calculate it again.

sentences.chinese: 两条小路在山腰交叉，游客很容易在那里走错方向。
sentences.traditional: 兩條小路在山腰交叉，遊客很容易在那裡走錯方向。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng tiáo xiǎolù zài shānyāo jiāochā, yóukè hěn róngyì zài nàlǐ zǒu cuò fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: The two paths cross on the mountainside, and tourists can easily take the wrong direction there.

sentences.chinese: 不同地区的收入差异如果长期扩大，社会矛盾可能会加深。
sentences.traditional: 不同地區的收入差異如果長期擴大，社會矛盾可能會加深。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng dìqū de shōurù chāyì rúguǒ chángqī kuòdà, shèhuì máodùn kěnéng huì jiāshēn.
sentences.translation: If income differences between regions continue to widen over the long term, social tensions may deepen.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员比较了两种药物在副作用上的差异。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員比較了兩種藥物在副作用上的差異。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán bǐjiào le liǎng zhǒng yàowù zài fùzuòyòng shàng de chāyì.
sentences.translation: The researchers compared the differences in side effects between the two medicines.

sentences.chinese: 文化差异并不一定造成冲突，关键在于双方是否愿意理解彼此。
sentences.traditional: 文化差異並不一定造成衝突，關鍵在於雙方是否願意理解彼此。
sentences.pinyin: Wénhuà chāyì bìng bù yídìng zàochéng chōngtū, guānjiàn zàiyú shuāngfāng shìfǒu yuànyì lǐjiě bǐcǐ.
sentences.translation: Cultural differences do not necessarily cause conflict; the key is whether both sides are willing to understand each other.

sentences.chinese: 为了安全起见，厨房里的插座都安装了防水保护盖。
sentences.traditional: 為了安全起見，廚房裡的插座都安裝了防水保護蓋。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, chúfáng lǐ de chāzuò dōu ānzhuāng le fángshuǐ bǎohù gài.
sentences.translation: For safety's sake, the sockets in the kitchen have all been fitted with waterproof protective covers.

sentences.chinese: 会议室的插座不够用，大家只好轮流给电脑充电。
sentences.traditional: 會議室的插座不夠用，大家只好輪流給電腦充電。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì de chāzuò bú gòu yòng, dàjiā zhǐhǎo lúnliú gěi diànnǎo chōngdiàn.
sentences.translation: There were not enough sockets in the meeting room, so everyone had to take turns charging their laptops.

sentences.chinese: 如果插座发热或有焦味，应立即断电并请专业人员检查。
sentences.traditional: 如果插座發熱或有焦味，應立即斷電並請專業人員檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chāzuò fārè huò yǒu jiāowèi, yīng lìjí duàndiàn bìng qǐng zhuānyè rényuán jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: If a socket becomes hot or smells burnt, the power should be cut immediately and a professional should be asked to check it.

sentences.chinese: 乘客可以通过手机查询列车是否晚点。
sentences.traditional: 乘客可以通過手機查詢列車是否晚點。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngkè kěyǐ tōngguò shǒujī cháxún lièchē shìfǒu wǎndiǎn.
sentences.translation: Passengers can check on their phones whether the train is delayed.

sentences.chinese: 银行要求客户先查询交易记录，再决定是否申请退款。
sentences.traditional: 銀行要求客戶先查詢交易記錄，再決定是否申請退款。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng yāoqiú kèhù xiān cháxún jiāoyì jìlù, zài juédìng shìfǒu shēnqǐng tuìkuǎn.
sentences.translation: The bank asked the customer to check the transaction record first before deciding whether to request a refund.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统能实时查询库存，避免销售人员承诺不存在的商品。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統能即時查詢庫存，避免銷售人員承諾不存在的商品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng néng shíshí cháxún kùcún, bìmiǎn xiāoshòu rényuán chéngnuò bù cúnzài de shāngpǐn.
sentences.translation: This system can check inventory in real time, preventing sales staff from promising goods that do not exist.

sentences.chinese: 这座危楼已经被列入拆除计划，但居民安置问题还没有解决。
sentences.traditional: 這座危樓已經被列入拆除計畫，但居民安置問題還沒有解決。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò wēilóu yǐjīng bèi lièrù chāichú jìhuà, dàn jūmín ānzhì wèntí hái méiyǒu jiějué.
sentences.translation: This dangerous building has already been included in the demolition plan, but the issue of rehousing residents has not yet been resolved.

sentences.chinese: 在拆除旧桥之前，工程队先封闭了周围道路。
sentences.traditional: 在拆除舊橋之前，工程隊先封閉了周圍道路。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chāichú jiùqiáo zhīqián, gōngchéngduì xiān fēngbì le zhōuwéi dàolù.
sentences.translation: Before demolishing the old bridge, the engineering team first closed the surrounding roads.

sentences.chinese: 政府承诺拆除违章建筑，同时保留具有历史价值的部分。
sentences.traditional: 政府承諾拆除違章建築，同時保留具有歷史價值的部分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chéngnuò chāichú wéizhāng jiànzhù, tóngshí bǎoliú jùyǒu lìshǐ jiàzhí de bùfen.
sentences.translation: The government promised to demolish illegal buildings while preserving the parts with historical value.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究虽然投入不大，却产出了几项具有应用价值的成果。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究雖然投入不大，卻產出了幾項具有應用價值的成果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū suīrán tóurù bú dà, què chǎnchū le jǐ xiàng jùyǒu yìngyòng jiàzhí de chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Although the investment in this research was not large, it produced several results with practical value.

sentences.chinese: 如果生产线继续停工，本月产出将明显低于预期。
sentences.traditional: 如果生產線繼續停工，本月產出將明顯低於預期。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shēngchǎnxiàn jìxù tínggōng, běn yuè chǎnchū jiāng míngxiǎn dī yú yùqī.
sentences.translation: If the production line continues to stop work, this month’s output will be clearly lower than expected.

sentences.chinese: 教育的产出不能只用考试分数来衡量，还要看学生的长期发展。
sentences.traditional: 教育的產出不能只用考試分數來衡量，還要看學生的長期發展。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù de chǎnchū bù néng zhǐ yòng kǎoshì fēnshù lái héngliang, hái yào kàn xuésheng de chángqī fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: The output of education cannot be measured only by exam scores; students’ long-term development must also be considered.

sentences.chinese: 消费者越来越关心食品的产地以及生产过程是否透明。
sentences.traditional: 消費者越來越關心食品的產地以及生產過程是否透明。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě yuè lái yuè guānxīn shípǐn de chǎndì yǐjí shēngchǎn guòchéng shìfǒu tòumíng.
sentences.translation: Consumers are increasingly concerned about the origin of food and whether the production process is transparent.

sentences.chinese: 这批茶叶的产地在高山地区，因此香气比普通茶更浓。
sentences.traditional: 這批茶葉的產地在高山地區，因此香氣比普通茶更濃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī cháyè de chǎndì zài gāoshān dìqū, yīncǐ xiāngqì bǐ pǔtōng chá gèng nóng.
sentences.translation: The place of origin of this batch of tea is a mountainous area, so its aroma is stronger than ordinary tea.

sentences.chinese: 海关要求进口商注明商品产地，以便进行质量追溯。
sentences.traditional: 海關要求進口商註明商品產地，以便進行質量追溯。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎiguān yāoqiú jìnkǒushāng zhùmíng shāngpǐn chǎndì, yǐbiàn jìnxíng pǐnzhì zhuīsù.
sentences.translation: Customs requires importers to state the goods’ place of origin so that quality can be traced.

sentences.chinese: 医生怀疑他的肠受到了感染，建议尽快做进一步检查。
sentences.traditional: 醫生懷疑他的腸受到了感染，建議儘快做進一步檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng huáiyí tā de cháng shòudào le gǎnrǎn, jiànyì jǐnkuài zuò jìn yí bù jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The doctor suspected that his intestine had become infected and advised further checks as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这种手术需要先确认肠的位置，以免损伤周围组织。
sentences.traditional: 這種手術需要先確認腸的位置，以免損傷周圍組織。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shǒushù xūyào xiān quèrèn cháng de wèizhi, yǐmiǎn sǔnshāng zhōuwéi zǔzhī.
sentences.translation: This kind of surgery requires confirming the position of the intestine first to avoid damaging the surrounding tissue.

sentences.chinese: 长期饮食不规律会影响肠的功能，甚至引起更严重的问题。
sentences.traditional: 長期飲食不規律會影響腸的功能，甚至引起更嚴重的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī yǐnshí bù guīlǜ huì yǐngxiǎng cháng de gōngnéng, shènzhì yǐnqǐ gèng yánzhòng de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Irregular eating over the long term can affect intestinal function and even cause more serious problems.

sentences.chinese: 这根绳子的长短要根据窗户的高度来决定。
sentences.traditional: 這根繩子的長短要根據窗戶的高度來決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gēn shéngzi de chángduǎn yào gēnjù chuānghu de gāodù lái juédìng.
sentences.translation: The length of this rope should be decided according to the height of the window.

sentences.chinese: 发言的长短并不重要，关键是内容是否有说服力。
sentences.traditional: 發言的長短並不重要，關鍵是內容是否有說服力。
sentences.pinyin: Fāyán de chángduǎn bìng bù zhòngyào, guānjiàn shì nèiróng shìfǒu yǒu shuōfúlì.
sentences.translation: The length of the speech is not important; the key is whether the content is persuasive.

sentences.chinese: 影片长短不同，但都围绕同一个主题展开。
sentences.traditional: 影片長短不同，但都圍繞同一個主題展開。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngpiàn chángduǎn bù tóng, dàn dōu wéirào tóng yí gè zhǔtí zhǎnkāi.
sentences.translation: The videos vary in length, but they all develop around the same theme.

sentences.chinese: 按照常规，申请人需要先提交材料，再等待审核结果。
sentences.traditional: 按照常規，申請人需要先提交材料，再等待審核結果。
sentences.pinyin: Ànzhào chángguī, shēnqǐngrén xūyào xiān tíjiāo cáiliào, zài děngdài shěnhé jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: According to the usual procedure, applicants need to submit materials first and then wait for the review result.

sentences.chinese: 这不是一次常规检查，而是针对安全隐患的专项调查。
sentences.traditional: 這不是一次常規檢查，而是針對安全隱患的專項調查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bú shì yí cì chángguī jiǎnchá, ér shì zhēnduì ānquán yǐnhuàn de zhuānxiàng diàochá.
sentences.translation: This is not a routine inspection, but a special investigation targeting safety risks.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议先采用常规治疗，除非病情继续恶化。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議先採用常規治療，除非病情繼續惡化。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì xiān cǎiyòng chángguī zhìliáo, chúfēi bìngqíng jìxù èhuà.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested using conventional treatment first unless the condition continues to worsen.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区常年缺水，居民不得不依靠地下水和外地供水。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區常年缺水，居民不得不依靠地下水和外地供水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū chángnián quēshuǐ, jūmín bùdébù yīkào dìxiàshuǐ hé wàidì gōngshuǐ.
sentences.translation: This region lacks water all year round, so residents have to rely on groundwater and water supplied from elsewhere.

sentences.chinese: 他常年在外工作，与孩子相处的时间非常有限。
sentences.traditional: 他常年在外工作，與孩子相處的時間非常有限。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángnián zài wài gōngzuò, yǔ háizi xiāngchǔ de shíjiān fēicháng yǒuxiàn.
sentences.translation: He works away from home all year round, so the time he spends with his child is very limited.

sentences.chinese: 常年的风沙侵蚀使古城墙表面变得十分脆弱。
sentences.traditional: 常年的風沙侵蝕使古城牆表面變得十分脆弱。
sentences.pinyin: Chángnián de fēngshā qīnshí shǐ gǔ chéngqiáng biǎomiàn biànde shífēn cuìruò.
sentences.translation: Years of wind and sand erosion have made the surface of the ancient city wall extremely fragile.

sentences.chinese: 均衡饮食和稳定的社交关系被认为有助于长寿。
sentences.traditional: 均衡飲食和穩定的社交關係被認為有助於長壽。
sentences.pinyin: Jūnhéng yǐnshí hé wěndìng de shèjiāo guānxì bèi rènwéi yǒuzhù yú chángshòu.
sentences.translation: A balanced diet and stable social relationships are considered helpful for longevity.

sentences.chinese: 这个山村以居民长寿而闻名，吸引了不少医学研究者。
sentences.traditional: 這個山村以居民長壽而聞名，吸引了不少醫學研究者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shāncūn yǐ jūmín chángshòu ér wénmíng, xīyǐn le bù shǎo yīxué yánjiūzhě.
sentences.translation: This mountain village is famous for the longevity of its residents, attracting quite a few medical researchers.

sentences.chinese: 长寿并不只是活得久，还意味着晚年仍能保持尊严和自主。
sentences.traditional: 長壽並不只是活得久，還意味著晚年仍能保持尊嚴和自主。
sentences.pinyin: Chángshòu bìng bù zhǐ shì huó de jiǔ, hái yìwèizhe wǎnnián réng néng bǎochí zūnyán hé zìzhǔ.
sentences.translation: Longevity does not simply mean living a long time; it also means being able to maintain dignity and independence in old age.

sentences.chinese: 这种药应在常温下保存，避免阳光直射。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥應在常溫下保存，避免陽光直射。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào yīng zài chángwēn xià bǎocún, bìmiǎn yángguāng zhíshè.
sentences.translation: This medicine should be stored at room temperature and kept out of direct sunlight.

sentences.chinese: 实验开始前，样品必须先恢复到常温，以免影响测量结果。
sentences.traditional: 實驗開始前，樣品必須先恢復到常溫，以免影響測量結果。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyàn kāishǐ qián, yàngpǐn bìxū xiān huīfù dào chángwēn, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng cèliáng jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Before the experiment begins, the sample must first return to room temperature to avoid affecting the measurement results.

sentences.chinese: 食物在常温下放置太久，细菌繁殖速度会明显加快。
sentences.traditional: 食物在常溫下放置太久，細菌繁殖速度會明顯加快。
sentences.pinyin: Shíwù zài chángwēn xià fàngzhì tài jiǔ, xìjūn fánzhí sùdù huì míngxiǎn jiākuài.
sentences.translation: If food is left at room temperature for too long, the rate at which bacteria multiply will clearly increase.

sentences.chinese: 由于观众人数增加，主办方临时增加了两个场次。
sentences.traditional: 由於觀眾人數增加，主辦方臨時增加了兩個場次。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú guānzhòng rénshù zēngjiā, zhǔbànfāng línshí zēngjiā le liǎng gè chǎngcì.
sentences.translation: Because the audience numbers increased, the organiser temporarily added two sessions.

sentences.chinese: 购票系统会显示每个场次的剩余座位和入场时间。
sentences.traditional: 購票系統會顯示每個場次的剩餘座位和入場時間。
sentences.pinyin: Gòupiào xìtǒng huì xiǎnshì měi gè chǎngcì de shèngyú zuòwèi hé rùchǎng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The ticketing system will show the remaining seats and entry time for each session.

sentences.chinese: 电影节的场次安排得很密集，志愿者几乎没有休息时间。
sentences.traditional: 電影節的場次安排得很密集，志願者幾乎沒有休息時間。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐngjié de chǎngcì ānpái de hěn mìjí, zhìyuànzhě jīhū méiyǒu xiūxi shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The film festival’s sessions are scheduled very tightly, and the volunteers have almost no time to rest.

sentences.chinese: 由于原定场地临时维修，组委会不得不把论坛改到市图书馆举行。
sentences.traditional: 由於原定場地臨時維修，組委會不得不把論壇改到市圖書館舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú yuándìng chǎngdì línshí wéixiū, zǔwěihuì bùdébù bǎ lùntán gǎi dào shì túshūguǎn jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: Because the original venue was undergoing temporary maintenance, the organising committee had to move the forum to the city library.

sentences.chinese: 这片废弃的工厂场地经过改造后，成了年轻人聚集的创意园区。
sentences.traditional: 這片廢棄的工廠場地經過改造後，成了年輕人聚集的創意園區。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn fèiqì de gōngchǎng chǎngdì jīngguò gǎizào hòu, chéng le niánqīngrén jùjí de chuàngyì yuánqū.
sentences.translation: After being renovated, this abandoned factory site became a creative park where young people gather.

sentences.chinese: 举办大型演唱会不仅要考虑场地容量，还要评估交通和安全风险。
sentences.traditional: 舉辦大型演唱會不僅要考慮場地容量，還要評估交通和安全風險。
sentences.pinyin: Jǔbàn dàxíng yǎnchànghuì bùjǐn yào kǎolǜ chǎngdì róngliàng, hái yào pínggū jiāotōng hé ānquán fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: When holding a large concert, one must consider not only venue capacity but also traffic and safety risks.

sentences.chinese: 新建的体育场馆配备了无障碍通道，方便残疾观众进出。
sentences.traditional: 新建的體育場館配備了無障礙通道，方便殘疾觀眾進出。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnjiàn de tǐyù chǎngguǎn pèibèi le wú zhàng'ài tōngdào, fāngbiàn cánjí guānzhòng jìnchū.
sentences.translation: The newly built sports venue is equipped with accessible passages, making it easier for disabled spectators to enter and leave.

sentences.chinese: 展览期间，所有场馆之间都有免费接驳车，参展商可以提前预约。
sentences.traditional: 展覽期間，所有場館之間都有免費接駁車，參展商可以提前預約。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎnlǎn qījiān, suǒyǒu chǎngguǎn zhījiān dōu yǒu miǎnfèi jiēbó chē, cānzhǎnshāng kěyǐ tíqián yùyuē.
sentences.translation: During the exhibition, free shuttle buses run between all venues, and exhibitors can book them in advance.

sentences.chinese: 如果场馆的消防设施不达标，活动就不能如期开放。
sentences.traditional: 如果場館的消防設施不達標，活動就不能如期開放。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chǎngguǎn de xiāofáng shèshī bù dábiao, huódòng jiù bù néng rúqī kāifàng.
sentences.translation: If the venue's fire-safety facilities do not meet the required standard, the event cannot open as scheduled.

sentences.chinese: 在正式场合随便打断别人发言，往往会被认为缺乏基本礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 在正式場合隨便打斷別人發言，往往會被認為缺乏基本禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé suíbiàn dǎduàn biérén fāyán, wǎngwǎng huì bèi rènwéi quēfá jīběn lǐmào.
sentences.translation: Interrupting other people casually on a formal occasion is often regarded as a lack of basic manners.

sentences.chinese: 这件事不适合在公开场合讨论，我们可以会后再谈。
sentences.traditional: 這件事不適合在公開場合討論，我們可以會後再談。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù shìhé zài gōngkāi chǎnghé tǎolùn, wǒmen kěyǐ huì hòu zài tán.
sentences.translation: This matter is not suitable for discussion in public; we can talk about it again after the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 他能根据不同场合调整说话方式，这也是他受欢迎的原因之一。
sentences.traditional: 他能根據不同場合調整說話方式，這也是他受歡迎的原因之一。
sentences.pinyin: Tā néng gēnjù bùtóng chǎnghé tiáozhěng shuōhuà fāngshì, zhè yě shì tā shòu huānyíng de yuányīn zhī yī.
sentences.translation: He can adjust the way he speaks according to different situations, which is one of the reasons he is popular.

sentences.chinese: 消费者要求厂家公开检测报告，而不是只在广告中强调安全。
sentences.traditional: 消費者要求廠家公開檢測報告，而不是只在廣告中強調安全。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě yāoqiú chǎngjiā gōngkāi jiǎncè bàogào, ér bù shì zhǐ zài guǎnggào zhōng qiángdiào ānquán.
sentences.translation: Consumers demanded that the manufacturer publish the test report, rather than merely emphasise safety in advertisements.

sentences.chinese: 这批零件出现问题后，厂家承诺免费更换并延长保修期。
sentences.traditional: 這批零件出現問題後，廠家承諾免費更換並延長保修期。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī língjiàn chūxiàn wèntí hòu, chǎngjiā chéngnuò miǎnfèi gēnghuàn bìng yáncháng bǎoxiū qī.
sentences.translation: After problems appeared in this batch of parts, the manufacturer promised to replace them for free and extend the warranty period.

sentences.chinese: 与小型厂家合作虽然成本较低，但质量控制必须更加严格。
sentences.traditional: 與小型廠家合作雖然成本較低，但質量控制必須更加嚴格。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ xiǎoxíng chǎngjiā hézuò suīrán chéngběn jiào dī, dàn zhìliàng kòngzhì bìxū gèngjiā yángé.
sentences.translation: Although working with small manufacturers is cheaper, quality control must be even stricter.

sentences.chinese: 纪录片中最震撼的场景，是孩子们在废墟旁继续上课。
sentences.traditional: 紀錄片中最震撼的場景，是孩子們在廢墟旁繼續上課。
sentences.pinyin: Jìlùpiàn zhōng zuì zhènhàn de chǎngjǐng, shì háizimen zài fèixū páng jìxù shàngkè.
sentences.translation: The most shocking scene in the documentary is of the children continuing their lessons beside the ruins.

sentences.chinese: 这款应用可以根据用户的使用场景自动调整界面和提醒方式。
sentences.traditional: 這款應用可以根據用戶的使用場景自動調整界面和提醒方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yìngyòng kěyǐ gēnjù yònghù de shǐyòng chǎngjǐng zìdòng tiáozhěng jièmiàn hé tíxǐng fāngshì.
sentences.translation: This app can automatically adjust its interface and reminder settings according to the user's usage scenario.

sentences.chinese: 导演没有直接描写战争，而是通过日常场景表现人们的恐惧。
sentences.traditional: 導演沒有直接描寫戰爭，而是通過日常場景表現人們的恐懼。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn méiyǒu zhíjiē miáoxiě zhànzhēng, ér shì tōngguò rìcháng chǎngjǐng biǎoxiàn rénmen de kǒngjù.
sentences.translation: The director does not depict the war directly, but expresses people's fear through everyday scenes.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结束后，球迷冲进球场，场面一度相当混乱。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結束後，球迷衝進球場，場面一度相當混亂。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù hòu, qiúmí chōng jìn qiúchǎng, chǎngmiàn yídù xiāngdāng hùnluàn.
sentences.translation: After the match ended, fans rushed onto the pitch, and the scene became quite chaotic for a while.

sentences.chinese: 婚礼的场面并不奢华，却处处体现出家人之间的真诚。
sentences.traditional: 婚禮的場面並不奢華，卻處處體現出家人之間的真誠。
sentences.pinyin: Hūnlǐ de chǎngmiàn bìng bù shēhuá, què chùchù tǐxiàn chū jiārén zhījiān de zhēnchéng.
sentences.translation: The wedding scene was not luxurious, but it showed the sincerity between family members everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 面对突发火灾，主持人努力控制场面，避免观众恐慌。
sentences.traditional: 面對突發火災，主持人努力控制場面，避免觀眾恐慌。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā huǒzāi, zhǔchírén nǔlì kòngzhì chǎngmiàn, bìmiǎn guānzhòng kǒnghuāng.
sentences.translation: Faced with a sudden fire, the presenter tried hard to control the situation and prevent the audience from panicking.

sentences.chinese: 多家厂商已经宣布，将在明年推出更节能的电动汽车。
sentences.traditional: 多家廠商已經宣布，將在明年推出更節能的電動汽車。
sentences.pinyin: Duō jiā chǎngshāng yǐjīng xuānbù, jiāng zài míngnián tuīchū gèng jiénéng de diàndòng qìchē.
sentences.translation: Several manufacturers have already announced that they will launch more energy-efficient electric cars next year.

sentences.chinese: 平台必须审核厂商资质，否则假冒商品很容易流入市场。
sentences.traditional: 平臺必須審核廠商資質，否則假冒商品很容易流入市場。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái bìxū shěnhé chǎngshāng zīzhì, fǒuzé jiǎmào shāngpǐn hěn róngyì liúrù shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: The platform must review manufacturers' qualifications; otherwise counterfeit goods can easily enter the market.

sentences.chinese: 在价格压力下，一些厂商选择降低配置，这反而伤害了品牌信誉。
sentences.traditional: 在價格壓力下，一些廠商選擇降低配置，這反而傷害了品牌信譽。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jiàgé yālì xià, yìxiē chǎngshāng xuǎnzé jiàngdī pèizhì, zhè fǎn'ér shānghài le pǐnpái xìnyù.
sentences.translation: Under price pressure, some manufacturers choose to reduce specifications, which instead damages their brand reputation.

sentences.chinese: 台风过后，抢修人员连夜清理倒树，确保主干道尽快畅通。
sentences.traditional: 颱風過後，搶修人員連夜清理倒樹，確保主幹道盡快暢通。
sentences.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, qiǎngxiū rényuán liányè qīnglǐ dǎoshù, quèbǎo zhǔgàndào jǐnkuài chàngtōng.
sentences.translation: After the typhoon, repair crews cleared fallen trees overnight to ensure the main road became clear as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 只有信息渠道畅通，基层的问题才能及时反馈到管理层。
sentences.traditional: 只有信息渠道暢通，基層的問題才能及時反饋到管理層。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu xìnxī qúdào chàngtōng, jīcéng de wèntí cái néng jíshí fǎnkuì dào guǎnlǐ céng.
sentences.translation: Only when information channels are clear can problems at the grassroots level be reported to management in time.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证沟通畅通，项目组每周都会更新一次进度表。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證溝通暢通，項目組每週都會更新一次進度表。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng gōutōng chàngtōng, xiàngmù zǔ měi zhōu dōu huì gēngxīn yí cì jìndù biǎo.
sentences.translation: To keep communication smooth, the project team updates the progress sheet every week.

sentences.chinese: 这款小说虽然没有大规模宣传，却凭借读者口碑长期畅销。
sentences.traditional: 這款小說雖然沒有大規模宣傳，卻憑藉讀者口碑長期暢銷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xiǎoshuō suīrán méiyǒu dà guīmó xuānchuán, què píngjiè dúzhě kǒubēi chángqī chàngxiāo.
sentences.translation: Although this novel had no large-scale publicity, it has sold well for a long time thanks to readers' word of mouth.

sentences.chinese: 产品能否畅销，不仅取决于价格，也取决于售后服务。
sentences.traditional: 產品能否暢銷，不僅取決於價格，也取決於售後服務。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn néng fǒu chàngxiāo, bùjǐn qǔjué yú jiàgé, yě qǔjué yú shòuhòu fúwù.
sentences.translation: Whether a product sells well depends not only on its price but also on its after-sales service.

sentences.chinese: 由于设计符合年轻人的审美，这个品牌在海外市场十分畅销。
sentences.traditional: 由於設計符合年輕人的審美，這個品牌在海外市場十分暢銷。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shèjì fúhé niánqīngrén de shěnměi, zhège pǐnpái zài hǎiwài shìchǎng shífēn chàngxiāo.
sentences.translation: Because the design matches young people's aesthetic tastes, this brand sells extremely well in overseas markets.

sentences.chinese: 老师提醒学生，引用资料可以，但整段抄别人的文章就是学术不诚实。
sentences.traditional: 老師提醒學生，引用資料可以，但整段抄別人的文章就是學術不誠實。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng, yǐnyòng zīliào kěyǐ, dàn zhěng duàn chāo biérén de wénzhāng jiù shì xuéshù bù chéngshí.
sentences.translation: The teacher reminded the students that citing sources is fine, but copying whole passages from someone else's article is academic dishonesty.

sentences.chinese: 她把会议纪要抄在本子上，以防电脑突然没电。
sentences.traditional: 她把會議紀要抄在本子上，以防電腦突然沒電。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ huìyì jìyào chāo zài běnzi shàng, yǐfáng diànnǎo tūrán méi diàn.
sentences.translation: She copied the meeting minutes into her notebook in case the computer suddenly ran out of power.

sentences.chinese: 如果只是抄答案而不理解思路，考试成绩提高不了多少。
sentences.traditional: 如果只是抄答案而不理解思路，考試成績提高不了多少。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐshì chāo dá'àn ér bù lǐjiě sīlù, kǎoshì chéngjì tígāo bùliǎo duōshǎo.
sentences.translation: If you merely copy the answers without understanding the reasoning, your exam results will not improve much.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司的成功，并不只是超越了竞争对手，更改变了整个行业的规则。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司的成功，並不只是超越了競爭對手，更改變了整個行業的規則。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de chénggōng, bìng bù zhǐshì chāoyuè le jìngzhēng duìshǒu, gèng gǎibiàn le zhěnggè hángyè de guīzé.
sentences.translation: The company’s success did more than surpass its competitors; it changed the rules of the entire industry.

sentences.chinese: 真正的教育不应只追求分数，而应帮助学生超越自身的局限。
sentences.traditional: 真正的教育不應只追求分數，而應幫助學生超越自身的局限。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de jiàoyù bù yīng zhǐ zhuīqiú fēnshù, ér yīng bāngzhù xuéshēng chāoyuè zìshēn de júxiàn.
sentences.translation: True education should not only pursue grades, but should help students surpass their own limitations.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影试图超越商业片的框架，讨论更深层的社会问题。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影試圖超越商業片的框架，討論更深層的社會問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shìtú chāoyuè shāngyè piàn de kuàngjià, tǎolùn gèng shēncéng de shèhuì wèntí.
sentences.translation: This film tries to go beyond the framework of a commercial film and discuss deeper social issues.

sentences.chinese: 每个朝代都有自己的制度特色，但也会继承前人的政治经验。
sentences.traditional: 每個朝代都有自己的制度特色，但也會繼承前人的政治經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè cháodài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de zhìdù tèsè, dàn yě huì jìchéng qiánrén de zhèngzhì jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Every dynasty has its own institutional features, but it also inherits political experience from those before it.

sentences.chinese: 研究一个朝代的兴衰，不能只看皇帝个人的能力。
sentences.traditional: 研究一個朝代的興衰，不能只看皇帝個人的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū yí gè cháodài de xīngshuāi, bù néng zhǐ kàn huángdì gèrén de nénglì.
sentences.translation: When studying the rise and fall of a dynasty, one cannot look only at the emperor’s personal ability.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆按朝代排列文物，让参观者更容易理解历史脉络。
sentences.traditional: 博物館按朝代排列文物，讓參觀者更容易理解歷史脈絡。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn àn cháodài páiliè wénwù, ràng cānguānzhě gèng róngyì lǐjiě lìshǐ màiluò.
sentences.translation: The museum arranges the cultural relics by dynasty, making it easier for visitors to understand the historical sequence.

sentences.chinese: 年轻消费者追随潮流的同时，也越来越重视产品背后的价值观。
sentences.traditional: 年輕消費者追隨潮流的同時，也越來越重視產品背後的價值觀。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng xiāofèizhě zhuīsuí cháoliú de tóngshí, yě yuèláiyuè zhòngshì chǎnpǐn bèihòu de jiàzhíguān.
sentences.translation: While following trends, young consumers are also paying more and more attention to the values behind products.

sentences.chinese: 真正有影响力的设计，往往不是简单迎合潮流，而是提出新的审美方向。
sentences.traditional: 真正有影響力的設計，往往不是簡單迎合潮流，而是提出新的審美方向。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng yǒu yǐngxiǎnglì de shèjì, wǎngwǎng bú shì jiǎndān yínghé cháoliú, ér shì tíchū xīn de shěnměi fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: Truly influential design often does not simply cater to trends, but proposes a new aesthetic direction.

sentences.chinese: 在数字化潮流之下，许多传统企业不得不重新调整经营方式。
sentences.traditional: 在數字化潮流之下，許多傳統企業不得不重新調整經營方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shùzìhuà cháoliú zhī xià, xǔduō chuántǒng qǐyè bùdébù chóngxīn tiáozhěng jīngyíng fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Under the trend of digitalisation, many traditional businesses have had to readjust the way they operate.

sentences.chinese: 地下室长期潮湿，墙面已经出现了明显的霉斑。
sentences.traditional: 地下室長期潮濕，牆面已經出現了明顯的霉斑。
sentences.pinyin: Dìxiàshì chángqī cháoshī, qiángmiàn yǐjīng chūxiàn le míngxiǎn de méibān.
sentences.translation: The basement has been damp for a long time, and obvious mould marks have already appeared on the walls.

sentences.chinese: 这种药材如果存放在潮湿环境中，很容易变质。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥材如果存放在潮濕環境中，很容易變質。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàocái rúguǒ cúnfàng zài cháoshī huánjìng zhōng, hěn róngyì biànzhì.
sentences.translation: If this medicinal material is stored in a damp environment, it is very likely to deteriorate.

sentences.chinese: 南方的冬天虽然温度不低，但潮湿的空气让人觉得格外寒冷。
sentences.traditional: 南方的冬天雖然溫度不低，但潮濕的空氣讓人覺得格外寒冷。
sentences.pinyin: Nánfāng de dōngtiān suīrán wēndù bù dī, dàn cháoshī de kōngqì ràng rén juéde géwài hánlěng.
sentences.translation: Although winter temperatures in the south are not low, the damp air makes people feel especially cold.

sentences.chinese: 面对失败者，我们不该嘲笑，而应该分析失败背后的原因。
sentences.traditional: 面對失敗者，我們不該嘲笑，而應該分析失敗背後的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shībàizhě, wǒmen bù gāi cháoxiào, ér yīnggāi fēnxī shībài bèihòu de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: When facing someone who has failed, we should not mock them, but should analyse the reasons behind the failure.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候因为口音被同学嘲笑，所以后来特别注意发音。
sentences.traditional: 他小時候因為口音被同學嘲笑，所以後來特別注意發音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou yīnwèi kǒuyīn bèi tóngxué cháoxiào, suǒyǐ hòulái tèbié zhùyì fāyīn.
sentences.translation: When he was young, he was mocked by classmates because of his accent, so later he paid particular attention to pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 那篇文章表面上在讲故事，实际上是在嘲笑社会上的虚荣心理。
sentences.traditional: 那篇文章表面上在講故事，實際上是在嘲笑社會上的虛榮心理。
sentences.pinyin: Nà piān wénzhāng biǎomiàn shàng zài jiǎng gùshi, shíjì shàng shì zài cháoxiào shèhuì shàng de xūróng xīnlǐ.
sentences.translation: On the surface, that article is telling a story, but in fact it is mocking the vanity found in society.

sentences.chinese: 他原本只想把炒股当作兴趣，却逐渐投入了过多时间和精力。
sentences.traditional: 他原本只想把炒股當作興趣，卻逐漸投入了過多時間和精力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuánběn zhǐ xiǎng bǎ chǎogǔ dàngzuò xìngqù, què zhújiàn tóurù le guò duō shíjiān hé jīnglì.
sentences.translation: He originally only wanted to treat stock speculation as a hobby, but gradually put too much time and energy into it.

sentences.chinese: 如果缺乏基本的风险意识，盲目炒股很可能造成严重损失。
sentences.traditional: 如果缺乏基本的風險意識，盲目炒股很可能造成嚴重損失。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ quēfá jīběn de fēngxiǎn yìshí, mángmù chǎogǔ hěn kěnéng zàochéng yánzhòng sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: If one lacks basic awareness of risk, blindly speculating in stocks is very likely to cause serious losses.

sentences.chinese: 有些人靠炒股赚钱，但更多人是在情绪波动中做出错误决定。
sentences.traditional: 有些人靠炒股賺錢，但更多人是在情緒波動中做出錯誤決定。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén kào chǎogǔ zhuànqián, dàn gèng duō rén shì zài qíngxù bōdòng zhōng zuòchū cuòwù juédìng.
sentences.translation: Some people make money through stock speculation, but more people make wrong decisions amid emotional swings.

sentences.chinese: 夫妻偶尔吵架并不可怕，可怕的是双方从不真正沟通。
sentences.traditional: 夫妻偶爾吵架並不可怕，可怕的是雙方從不真正溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Fūqī ǒu'ěr chǎojià bìng bù kěpà, kěpà de shì shuāngfāng cóng bù zhēnzhèng gōutōng.
sentences.translation: It is not frightening for a couple to quarrel occasionally; what is frightening is that both sides never truly communicate.

sentences.chinese: 团队成员为了预算问题吵架，导致原定会议被迫推迟。
sentences.traditional: 團隊成員為了預算問題吵架，導致原定會議被迫推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Tuánduì chéngyuán wèile yùsuàn wèntí chǎojià, dǎozhì yuándìng huìyì bèipò tuīchí.
sentences.translation: Team members quarrelled over the budget issue, causing the originally scheduled meeting to be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 孩子看见父母吵架后，情绪变得十分不安。
sentences.traditional: 孩子看見父母吵架後，情緒變得十分不安。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi kànjiàn fùmǔ chǎojià hòu, qíngxù biàn de shífēn bù'ān.
sentences.translation: After seeing his parents quarrel, the child became extremely uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 由于证据不足，律师建议当事人暂时撤回起诉。
sentences.traditional: 由於證據不足，律師建議當事人暫時撤回起訴。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zhèngjù bùzú, lǜshī jiànyì dāngshìrén zànshí chèhuí qǐsù.
sentences.translation: Because the evidence was insufficient, the lawyer advised the client to withdraw the lawsuit temporarily.

sentences.chinese: 公司在发现广告内容可能误导消费者后，立即撤回了宣传材料。
sentences.traditional: 公司在發現廣告內容可能誤導消費者後，立即撤回了宣傳材料。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zài fāxiàn guǎnggào nèiróng kěnéng wùdǎo xiāofèizhě hòu, lìjí chèhuí le xuānchuán cáiliào.
sentences.translation: After discovering that the advertisement might mislead consumers, the company immediately withdrew the promotional materials.

sentences.chinese: 外交部要求对方撤回不负责任的言论，以避免局势进一步恶化。
sentences.traditional: 外交部要求對方撤回不負責任的言論，以避免局勢進一步惡化。
sentences.pinyin: Wàijiāobù yāoqiú duìfāng chèhuí bú fù zérèn de yánlùn, yǐ bìmiǎn júshì jìnyí bù èhuà.
sentences.translation: The foreign ministry asked the other side to withdraw its irresponsible remarks in order to avoid further deterioration of the situation.

sentences.chinese: 如果申请材料存在虚假信息，相关资格可能会被撤销。
sentences.traditional: 如果申請材料存在虛假信息，相關資格可能會被撤銷。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shēnqǐng cáiliào cúnzài xūjiǎ xìnxī, xiāngguān zīgé kěnéng huì bèi chèxiāo.
sentences.translation: If the application materials contain false information, the relevant qualification may be revoked.

sentences.chinese: 市政府决定撤销这项临时规定，以减轻小商户的负担。
sentences.traditional: 市政府決定撤銷這項臨時規定，以減輕小商戶的負擔。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhèngfǔ juédìng chèxiāo zhè xiàng línshí guīdìng, yǐ jiǎnqīng xiǎo shānghù de fùdān.
sentences.translation: The city government decided to abolish this temporary regulation in order to reduce the burden on small businesses.

sentences.chinese: 会议通过表决，正式撤销了原来的合作方案。
sentences.traditional: 會議通過表決，正式撤銷了原來的合作方案。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì tōngguò biǎojué, zhèngshì chèxiāo le yuánlái de hézuò fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: The meeting passed a vote and formally cancelled the original cooperation plan.

sentences.chinese: 听到事故消息后，整个办公室的气氛变得异常沉重。
sentences.traditional: 聽到事故消息後，整個辦公室的氣氛變得異常沉重。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào shìgù xiāoxi hòu, zhěnggè bàngōngshì de qìfēn biàn de yìcháng chénzhòng.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news of the accident, the atmosphere in the whole office became unusually heavy.

sentences.chinese: 对一个刚起步的企业来说，过高的租金是一种沉重负担。
sentences.traditional: 對一個剛起步的企業來說，過高的租金是一種沉重負擔。
sentences.pinyin: Duì yí gè gāng qǐbù de qǐyè lái shuō, guò gāo de zūjīn shì yì zhǒng chénzhòng fùdān.
sentences.translation: For a newly started business, excessively high rent is a heavy burden.

sentences.chinese: 这段历史给当地居民留下了沉重而复杂的记忆。
sentences.traditional: 這段歷史給當地居民留下了沉重而複雜的記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn lìshǐ gěi dāngdì jūmín liúxià le chénzhòng ér fùzá de jìyì.
sentences.translation: This period of history left local residents with heavy and complicated memories.

sentences.chinese: 趁雨还没下大，我们先把设备搬到室内吧。
sentences.traditional: 趁雨還沒下大，我們先把設備搬到室內吧。
sentences.pinyin: Chèn yǔ hái méi xià dà, wǒmen xiān bǎ shèbèi bān dào shìnèi ba.
sentences.translation: Before the rain gets heavy, let’s move the equipment indoors first.

sentences.chinese: 他趁会议休息的十分钟，悄悄和负责人交换了意见。
sentences.traditional: 他趁會議休息的十分鐘，悄悄和負責人交換了意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chèn huìyì xiūxi de shí fēnzhōng, qiāoqiāo hé fùzérén jiāohuàn le yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: He used the ten-minute break in the meeting to quietly exchange views with the person in charge.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该趁市场还稳定，尽快调整供应链。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該趁市場還穩定，儘快調整供應鏈。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chèn shìchǎng hái wěndìng, jǐnkuài tiáozhěng gōngyìngliàn.
sentences.translation: We should take advantage of the market’s current stability and adjust the supply chain as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这根旧木柱勉强撑着屋顶，但已经不适合继续使用。
sentences.traditional: 這根舊木柱勉強撐著屋頂，但已經不適合繼續使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gēn jiù mùzhù miǎnqiǎng chēngzhe wūdǐng, dàn yǐjīng bù shìhé jìxù shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This old wooden post is barely supporting the roof, but it is no longer suitable for continued use.

sentences.chinese: 没有稳定的现金流，小公司很难撑过淡季。
sentences.traditional: 沒有穩定的現金流，小公司很難撐過淡季。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu wěndìng de xiànjīnliú, xiǎo gōngsī hěn nán chēngguò dànjì.
sentences.translation: Without stable cash flow, it is hard for a small company to get through the off-season.

sentences.chinese: 为了撑起整个项目，他几乎承担了所有协调工作。
sentences.traditional: 為了撐起整個項目，他幾乎承擔了所有協調工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile chēng qǐ zhěnggè xiàngmù, tā jīhū chéngdān le suǒyǒu xiétiáo gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: In order to support the whole project, he took on almost all of the coordination work.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市获得“绿色示范区”的称号，并不是偶然的。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市獲得「綠色示範區」的稱號，並不是偶然的。
sentences.pinyin: "Zhè zuò chéngshì huòdé ""lǜsè shìfànqū"" de chēnghào, bìng bú shì ǒurán de."
sentences.translation: It was no accident that this city gained the title of “green demonstration zone”.

sentences.chinese: 对他来说，冠军称号远不如公众的信任重要。
sentences.traditional: 對他來說，冠軍稱號遠不如公眾的信任重要。
sentences.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, guànjūn chēnghào yuǎn bù rú gōngzhòng de xìnrèn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: For him, the title of champion is far less important than public trust.

sentences.chinese: 学校授予她“优秀志愿者”的称号，以表彰她长期的服务。
sentences.traditional: 學校授予她「優秀志願者」的稱號，以表彰她長期的服務。
sentences.pinyin: "Xuéxiào shòuyǔ tā ""yōuxiù zhìyuànzhě"" de chēnghào, yǐ biǎozhāng tā chángqī de fúwù."
sentences.translation: The school awarded her the title of “excellent volunteer” to recognise her long-term service.

sentences.chinese: 在正式场合，最好先确认对方希望别人怎样称呼他。
sentences.traditional: 在正式場合，最好先確認對方希望別人怎樣稱呼他。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé, zuìhǎo xiān quèrèn duìfāng xīwàng biérén zěnyàng chēnghu tā.
sentences.translation: In formal situations, it is best to first confirm how the other person wishes to be addressed.

sentences.chinese: 不同地区对外祖母的称呼不完全一样。
sentences.traditional: 不同地區對外祖母的稱呼不完全一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng dìqū duì wàizǔmǔ de chēnghu bù wánquán yíyàng.
sentences.translation: Different regions do not use exactly the same form of address for one’s maternal grandmother.

sentences.chinese: 这位编辑坚持使用作者本人认可的称呼，避免引起误会。
sentences.traditional: 這位編輯堅持使用作者本人認可的稱呼，避免引起誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi biānjí jiānchí shǐyòng zuòzhě běnrén rènkě de chēnghu, bìmiǎn yǐnqǐ wùhuì.
sentences.translation: This editor insisted on using the form of address approved by the author themselves to avoid misunderstandings.

sentences.chinese: 人们通常把这种转型称作产业升级，但过程远比口号复杂。
sentences.traditional: 人們通常把這種轉型稱作產業升級，但過程遠比口號複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Rénmen tōngcháng bǎ zhè zhǒng zhuǎnxíng chēngzuò chǎnyè shēngjí, dàn guòchéng yuǎn bǐ kǒuhào fùzá.
sentences.translation: People usually call this kind of transformation industrial upgrading, but the process is far more complex than the slogan.

sentences.chinese: 在当地传说中，那座山被称作“龙背”。
sentences.traditional: 在當地傳說中，那座山被稱作「龍背」。
sentences.pinyin: "Zài dāngdì chuánshuō zhōng, nà zuò shān bèi chēngzuò ""lóng bèi""."
sentences.translation: In local legend, that mountain is called “Dragon’s Back”.

sentences.chinese: 如果只是把价格上调称作改革，消费者未必会接受。
sentences.traditional: 如果只是把價格上調稱作改革，消費者未必會接受。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐshì bǎ jiàgé shàngtiáo chēngzuò gǎigé, xiāofèizhě wèibì huì jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: If simply raising prices is called reform, consumers may not necessarily accept it.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策实施后，企业投诉量减少了近三成。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策實施後，企業投訴量減少了近三成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè shíshī hòu, qǐyè tóusù liàng jiǎnshǎo le jìn sān chéng.
sentences.translation: After this policy was implemented, the number of company complaints fell by nearly thirty percent.

sentences.chinese: 受天气影响，今年茶叶产量只有去年的八成左右。
sentences.traditional: 受天氣影響，今年茶葉產量只有去年的八成左右。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng, jīnnián cháyè chǎnliàng zhǐyǒu qùnián de bā chéng zuǒyòu.
sentences.translation: Affected by the weather, this year’s tea output is only about eighty percent of last year’s.

sentences.chinese: 调查显示，超过六成受访者支持延长公共交通运营时间。
sentences.traditional: 調查顯示，超過六成受訪者支持延長公共交通運營時間。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá xiǎnshì, chāoguò liù chéng shòufǎng zhě zhīchí yáncháng gōnggòng jiāotōng yùnyíng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The survey shows that more than sixty percent of respondents support extending public transport operating hours.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少碳排放，越来越多的员工选择乘地铁上班。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少碳排放，越來越多的員工選擇乘地鐵上班。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo tàn páifàng, yuèláiyuè duō de yuángōng xuǎnzé chéng dìtiě shàngbān.
sentences.translation: In order to reduce carbon emissions, more and more employees choose to take the underground to work.

sentences.chinese: 由于道路封闭，代表团只好改乘火车前往下一站。
sentences.traditional: 由於道路封閉，代表團只好改乘火車前往下一站。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú dàolù fēngbì, dàibiǎotuán zhǐhǎo gǎi chéng huǒchē qiánwǎng xià yí zhàn.
sentences.translation: Because the road was closed, the delegation had no choice but to switch to taking the train to the next stop.

sentences.chinese: 游客若乘出租车进城，应保留电子发票以便报销。
sentences.traditional: 遊客若乘出租車進城，應保留電子發票以便報銷。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè ruò chéng chūzūchē jìn chéng, yīng bǎoliú diànzǐ fāpiào yǐbiàn bàoxiāo.
sentences.translation: If visitors take a taxi into the city, they should keep the electronic receipt for reimbursement.

sentences.chinese: 这个陶罐看似普通，却能盛下两升左右的水。
sentences.traditional: 這個陶罐看似普通，卻能盛下兩升左右的水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège táoguàn kànsì pǔtōng, què néng chéng xià liǎng shēng zuǒyòu de shuǐ.
sentences.translation: This clay pot looks ordinary, yet it can hold about two litres of water.

sentences.chinese: 服务员把热汤盛进碗里时，特意提醒顾客小心烫。
sentences.traditional: 服務員把熱湯盛進碗裡時，特意提醒顧客小心燙。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán bǎ rè tāng chéng jìn wǎn lǐ shí, tèyì tíxǐng gùkè xiǎoxīn tàng.
sentences.translation: When the waiter poured the hot soup into the bowl, he specially reminded the customer to be careful of the heat.

sentences.chinese: 这种容器不适合盛强酸，否则会发生腐蚀。
sentences.traditional: 這種容器不適合盛強酸，否則會發生腐蝕。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng róngqì bù shìhé chéng qiángsuān, fǒuzé huì fāshēng fǔshí.
sentences.translation: This kind of container is not suitable for holding strong acid; otherwise, corrosion may occur.

sentences.chinese: 这次国际论坛由本市大学承办，预计将吸引数百名学者。
sentences.traditional: 這次國際論壇由本市大學承辦，預計將吸引數百名學者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì guójì lùntán yóu běn shì dàxué chéngbàn, yùjì jiāng xīyǐn shù bǎi míng xuézhě.
sentences.translation: This international forum is being hosted by the city’s university and is expected to attract hundreds of scholars.

sentences.chinese: 由于缺乏大型活动经验，那家公司最终放弃了承办资格。
sentences.traditional: 由於缺乏大型活動經驗，那家公司最終放棄了承辦資格。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú quēfá dàxíng huódòng jīngyàn, nà jiā gōngsī zuìzhōng fàngqì le chéngbàn zīgé.
sentences.translation: Because it lacked experience with large-scale events, that company eventually gave up its right to host the event.

sentences.chinese: 谁来承办后续培训，仍需由委员会进一步讨论。
sentences.traditional: 誰來承辦後續培訓，仍需由委員會進一步討論。
sentences.pinyin: Shéi lái chéngbàn hòuxù péixùn, réng xū yóu wěiyuánhuì jìnyíbù tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: Who will undertake the follow-up training still needs further discussion by the committee.

sentences.chinese: 教育的目的不只是惩罚错误，更是帮助学生理解后果。
sentences.traditional: 教育的目的不只是懲罰錯誤，更是幫助學生理解後果。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù de mùdì bù zhǐ shì chéngfá cuòwù, gèng shì bāngzhù xuéshēng lǐjiě hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: The purpose of education is not only to punish mistakes, but also to help students understand the consequences.

sentences.chinese: 对故意泄露数据的员工，公司将按照规定予以惩罚。
sentences.traditional: 對故意洩露數據的員工，公司將按照規定予以懲罰。
sentences.pinyin: Duì gùyì xièlòu shùjù de yuángōng, gōngsī jiāng ànzhào guīdìng yǔyǐ chéngfá.
sentences.translation: The company will punish employees who deliberately leak data in accordance with the rules.

sentences.chinese: 过于严厉的惩罚可能导致孩子只学会逃避责任。
sentences.traditional: 過於嚴厲的懲罰可能導致孩子只學會逃避責任。
sentences.pinyin: Guòyú yánlì de chéngfá kěnéng dǎozhì háizi zhǐ xuéhuì táobì zérèn.
sentences.translation: Excessively severe punishment may lead children only to learn how to avoid responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 这笔交易最终以低于预期的价格成交，令卖方不得不重新评估市场走势。
sentences.traditional: 這筆交易最終以低於預期的價格成交，令賣方不得不重新評估市場走勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ jiāoyì zuìzhōng yǐ dī yú yùqī de jiàgé chéngjiāo, lìng màifāng bùdébù chóngxīn pínggū shìchǎng zǒushì.
sentences.translation: The deal was ultimately concluded at a lower-than-expected price, forcing the seller to reassess market trends.

sentences.chinese: 双方谈判了整整三周，直到付款条件明确后才正式成交。
sentences.traditional: 雙方談判了整整三週，直到付款條件明確後才正式成交。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng tánpàn le zhěngzhěng sān zhōu, zhídào fùkuǎn tiáojiàn míngquè hòu cái zhèngshì chéngjiāo.
sentences.translation: The two sides negotiated for a full three weeks and only formally concluded the deal after the payment terms were clarified.

sentences.chinese: 虽然客户当场表示满意，但销售经理知道这类订单未必马上成交。
sentences.traditional: 雖然客戶當場表示滿意，但銷售經理知道這類訂單未必馬上成交。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán kèhù dāngchǎng biǎoshì mǎnyì, dàn xiāoshòu jīnglǐ zhīdào zhè lèi dìngdān wèibì mǎshàng chéngjiāo.
sentences.translation: Although the client expressed satisfaction on the spot, the sales manager knew that orders of this kind would not necessarily be closed immediately.

sentences.chinese: 政府承诺在三年内改善老旧小区的公共设施，但居民更关心资金是否能落实。
sentences.traditional: 政府承諾在三年內改善老舊小區的公共設施，但居民更關心資金是否能落實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chéngnuò zài sān nián nèi gǎishàn lǎojiù xiǎoqū de gōnggòng shèshī, dàn jūmín gèng guānxīn zījīn shìfǒu néng luòshí.
sentences.translation: The government promised to improve public facilities in old residential communities within three years, but residents are more concerned about whether the funding will actually be put in place.

sentences.chinese: 他既然已经承诺负责到底，就不能在问题最复杂的时候退出。
sentences.traditional: 他既然已經承諾負責到底，就不能在問題最複雜的時候退出。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìrán yǐjīng chéngnuò fùzé dàodǐ, jiù bù néng zài wèntí zuì fùzá de shíhou tuìchū.
sentences.translation: Since he has already committed to taking responsibility to the end, he cannot withdraw when the problem is at its most complicated.

sentences.chinese: 企业的环保承诺只有转化为具体制度，才可能赢得公众信任。
sentences.traditional: 企業的環保承諾只有轉化為具體制度，才可能贏得公眾信任。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè de huánbǎo chéngnuò zhǐyǒu zhuǎnhuà wéi jùtǐ zhìdù, cái kěnéng yíngdé gōngzhòng xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: A company’s environmental commitment can win public trust only when it is turned into concrete systems.

sentences.chinese: 成千上万的志愿者在灾后赶到现场，协助分发物资和安置居民。
sentences.traditional: 成千上萬的志願者在災後趕到現場，協助分發物資和安置居民。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngqiān-shàngwàn de zhìyuànzhě zài zāihòu gǎndào xiànchǎng, xiézhù fēnfā wùzī hé ānzhì jūmín.
sentences.translation: Tens of thousands of volunteers arrived at the scene after the disaster to help distribute supplies and resettle residents.

sentences.chinese: 每到春天，成千上万只候鸟会沿着这条湿地走廊迁徙。
sentences.traditional: 每到春天，成千上萬隻候鳥會沿著這條濕地走廊遷徙。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào chūntiān, chéngqiān-shàngwàn zhī hòuniǎo huì yánzhe zhè tiáo shīdì zǒuláng qiānxǐ.
sentences.translation: Every spring, tens of thousands of migratory birds travel along this wetland corridor.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策影响的不只是少数企业，而是成千上万普通家庭的生活。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策影響的不只是少數企業，而是成千上萬普通家庭的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè yǐngxiǎng de bù zhǐ shì shǎoshù qǐyè, ér shì chéngqiān-shàngwàn pǔtōng jiātíng de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This policy affects not only a small number of companies, but the lives of numerous ordinary families.

sentences.chinese: 数据经过整理后，呈现出一种与最初假设完全不同的趋势。
sentences.traditional: 數據經過整理後，呈現出一種與最初假設完全不同的趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù jīngguò zhěnglǐ hòu, chéngxiàn chū yì zhǒng yǔ zuìchū jiǎshè wánquán bù tóng de qūshì.
sentences.translation: After being organised, the data revealed a trend completely different from the original hypothesis.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片没有直接下结论，而是把社会矛盾逐层呈现出来。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片沒有直接下結論，而是把社會矛盾逐層呈現出來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn méiyǒu zhíjiē xià jiélùn, ér shì bǎ shèhuì máodùn zhúcéng chéngxiàn chūlai.
sentences.translation: This documentary does not draw conclusions directly, but presents social contradictions layer by layer.

sentences.chinese: 随着灯光变化，舞台呈现出一种近乎梦境的视觉效果。
sentences.traditional: 隨著燈光變化，舞臺呈現出一種近乎夢境的視覺效果。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe dēngguāng biànhuà, wǔtái chéngxiàn chū yì zhǒng jìnhū mèngjìng de shìjué xiàoguǒ.
