sentences.translation: As the lighting changed, the stage took on a visual effect almost like a dream.

sentences.chinese: 如果培训只停留在形式上，即使投入再多资源也难以取得成效。
sentences.traditional: 如果培訓只停留在形式上，即使投入再多資源也難以取得成效。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ péixùn zhǐ tíngliú zài xíngshì shàng, jíshǐ tóurù zài duō zīyuán yě nányǐ qǔdé chéngxiào.
sentences.translation: If training remains merely a formality, it will be difficult to achieve results no matter how many resources are invested.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革的成效并不会立刻显现，需要通过长期数据来判断。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革的成效並不會立刻顯現，需要通過長期數據來判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé de chéngxiào bìng bú huì lìkè xiǎnxiàn, xūyào tōngguò chángqī shùjù lái pànduàn.
sentences.translation: The effects of this reform will not become apparent immediately and must be assessed through long-term data.

sentences.chinese: 社区治理能否见到成效，关键在于居民是否真正参与决策。
sentences.traditional: 社區治理能否見到成效，關鍵在於居民是否真正參與決策。
sentences.pinyin: Shèqū zhìlǐ néngfǒu jiàndào chéngxiào, guānjiàn zàiyú jūmín shìfǒu zhēnzhèng cānyù juécè.
sentences.translation: Whether community governance can produce results depends chiefly on whether residents truly take part in decision-making.

sentences.chinese: 在长期合作中，诚信往往比短期利润更能决定一家公司的声誉。
sentences.traditional: 在長期合作中，誠信往往比短期利潤更能決定一家公司的聲譽。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chángqī hézuò zhōng, chéngxìn wǎngwǎng bǐ duǎnqī lìrùn gèng néng juédìng yì jiā gōngsī de shēngyù.
sentences.translation: In long-term cooperation, integrity often does more than short-term profit to determine a company’s reputation.

sentences.chinese: 如果商家缺乏诚信，再精美的宣传也很难留住消费者。
sentences.traditional: 如果商家缺乏誠信，再精美的宣傳也很難留住消費者。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shāngjiā quēfá chéngxìn, zài jīngměi de xuānchuán yě hěn nán liúzhù xiāofèizhě.
sentences.translation: If a business lacks integrity, even the most polished advertising will struggle to keep consumers.

sentences.chinese: 学术诚信不只是个人品德问题，也关系到整个研究环境的质量。
sentences.traditional: 學術誠信不只是個人品德問題，也關係到整個研究環境的質量。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshù chéngxìn bù zhǐ shì gèrén pǐndé wèntí, yě guānxì dào zhěnggè yánjiū huánjìng de zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Academic integrity is not merely a matter of personal ethics; it also concerns the quality of the whole research environment.

sentences.chinese: 这个成语表面上讲的是动物，其实讽刺的是人的盲目自信。
sentences.traditional: 這個成語表面上講的是動物，其實諷刺的是人的盲目自信。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngyǔ biǎomiàn shàng jiǎng de shì dòngwù, qíshí fěngcì de shì rén de mángmù zìxìn.
sentences.translation: On the surface this idiom is about animals, but it actually satirises people’s blind self-confidence.

sentences.chinese: 老师让学生根据语境判断成语是否使用得自然，而不是只背解释。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓學生根據語境判斷成語是否使用得自然，而不是只背解釋。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng xuésheng gēnjù yǔjìng pànduàn chéngyǔ shìfǒu shǐyòng de zìrán, ér bú shì zhǐ bèi jiěshì.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked students to judge from context whether the idiom was being used naturally, rather than simply memorising its explanation.

sentences.chinese: 很多成语保留了古代汉语的结构，初学者不能完全按现代语法理解。
sentences.traditional: 很多成語保留了古代漢語的結構，初學者不能完全按現代語法理解。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō chéngyǔ bǎoliú le gǔdài Hànyǔ de jiégòu, chūxuézhě bù néng wánquán àn xiàndài yǔfǎ lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: Many chengyu preserve structures from classical Chinese, so beginners cannot understand them entirely through modern grammar.

sentences.chinese: 随着交通网络改善，偏远城镇与大城市之间的联系明显加强。
sentences.traditional: 隨著交通網絡改善，偏遠城鎮與大城市之間的聯繫明顯加強。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe jiāotōng wǎngluò gǎishàn, piānyuǎn chéngzhèn yǔ dà chéngshì zhījiān de liánxì míngxiǎn jiāqiáng.
sentences.translation: As the transport network improves, the links between remote towns and big cities have clearly strengthened.

sentences.chinese: 这个城镇曾经依靠煤矿发展，如今正在转向旅游和服务业。
sentences.traditional: 這個城鎮曾經依靠煤礦發展，如今正在轉向旅遊和服務業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngzhèn céngjīng yīkào méikuàng fāzhǎn, rújīn zhèngzài zhuǎnxiàng lǚyóu hé fúwùyè.
sentences.translation: This town once developed by relying on coal mines, but it is now turning towards tourism and services.

sentences.chinese: 许多年轻人离开城镇去城市工作，导致当地人口结构逐渐老化。
sentences.traditional: 許多年輕人離開城鎮去城市工作，導致當地人口結構逐漸老化。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīng rén líkāi chéngzhèn qù chéngshì gōngzuò, dǎozhì dāngdì rénkǒu jiégòu zhújiàn lǎohuà.
sentences.translation: Many young people leave towns to work in cities, causing the local population structure to age gradually.

sentences.chinese: 真正持久的竞争力来自制度创新，而不是一次性的营销活动。
sentences.traditional: 真正持久的競爭力來自制度創新，而不是一次性的營銷活動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng chíjiǔ de jìngzhēnglì láizì zhìdù chuàngxīn, ér bú shì yí cì xìng de yíngxiāo huódòng.
sentences.translation: Genuinely lasting competitiveness comes from institutional innovation, not from one-off marketing campaigns.

sentences.chinese: 这场谈判之所以陷入僵局，是因为双方都缺乏持久的信任基础。
sentences.traditional: 這場談判之所以陷入僵局，是因為雙方都缺乏持久的信任基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng tánpàn zhī suǒyǐ xiànrù jiāngjú, shì yīnwèi shuāngfāng dōu quēfá chíjiǔ de xìnrèn jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: The negotiations fell into a deadlock because both sides lacked a lasting foundation of trust.

sentences.chinese: 任何减肥方法若不能形成持久的生活习惯，效果通常很难维持。
sentences.traditional: 任何減肥方法若不能形成持久的生活習慣，效果通常很難維持。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé jiǎnféi fāngfǎ ruò bù néng xíngchéng chíjiǔ de shēnghuó xíguàn, xiàoguǒ tōngcháng hěn nán wéichí.
sentences.translation: If any weight-loss method fails to form lasting living habits, its effects are usually hard to maintain.

sentences.chinese: 投资者如果长期持有优质资产，往往比频繁买卖更容易获得稳定回报。
sentences.traditional: 投資者如果長期持有優質資產，往往比頻繁買賣更容易獲得穩定回報。
sentences.pinyin: Tóuzīzhě rúguǒ chángqī chíyǒu yōuzhì zīchǎn, wǎngwǎng bǐ pínfán mǎimài gèng róngyì huòdé wěndìng huíbào.
sentences.translation: Investors who hold high-quality assets over the long term are often more likely to obtain stable returns than those who trade frequently.

sentences.chinese: 他持有该公司的少量股份，因此有权参加股东大会。
sentences.traditional: 他持有該公司的少量股份，因此有權參加股東大會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chíyǒu gāi gōngsī de shǎoliàng gǔfèn, yīncǐ yǒu quán cānjiā gǔdōng dàhuì.
sentences.translation: He holds a small number of shares in the company, so he has the right to attend the shareholders’ meeting.

sentences.chinese: 未经许可持有这些资料，可能会违反公司的保密规定。
sentences.traditional: 未經許可持有這些資料，可能會違反公司的保密規定。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi jīng xǔkě chíyǒu zhèxiē zīliào, kěnéng huì wéifǎn gōngsī de bǎomì guīdìng.
sentences.translation: Possessing these materials without permission may violate the company’s confidentiality rules.

sentences.chinese: 为了复原古建筑，工匠特意查阅旧图纸，把梁柱的长度精确到一尺以内。
sentences.traditional: 為了復原古建築，工匠特意查閱舊圖紙，把樑柱的長度精確到一尺以內。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fùyuán gǔ jiànzhù, gōngjiàng tèyì cháyuè jiù túzhǐ, bǎ liángzhù de chángdù jīngquè dào yì chǐ yǐnèi.
sentences.translation: To restore the old building, the craftsmen consulted the original drawings and measured the beams and columns to within one chi.

sentences.chinese: 他从抽屉里拿出一把木尺，仔细核对布料是否裁斜了。
sentences.traditional: 他從抽屜裡拿出一把木尺，仔細核對布料是否裁斜了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng chōutì lǐ ná chū yì bǎ mù chǐ, zǐxì héduì bùliào shìfǒu cái xié le.
sentences.translation: He took a wooden ruler from the drawer and carefully checked whether the cloth had been cut at an angle.

sentences.chinese: 这块布只剩三尺多，若再裁错一次，整件衣服就做不成了。
sentences.traditional: 這塊布只剩三尺多，若再裁錯一次，整件衣服就做不成了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài bù zhǐ shèng sān chǐ duō, ruò zài cái cuò yí cì, zhěng jiàn yīfu jiù zuò bù chéng le.
sentences.translation: Only a little over three chi of this cloth is left, so if it is cut wrongly again, the whole garment will be impossible to make.

sentences.chinese: 这款书柜的尺寸虽然合适，但它的颜色与客厅整体风格并不协调。
sentences.traditional: 這款書櫃的尺寸雖然合適，但它的顏色與客廳整體風格並不協調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shūguì de chǐcùn suīrán héshì, dàn tā de yánsè yǔ kètīng zhěngtǐ fēnggé bìng bù xiétiáo.
sentences.translation: Although the size of this bookcase is suitable, its colour does not match the overall style of the sitting room.

sentences.chinese: 在签订合同之前，双方必须再次确认设备的尺寸和安装条件。
sentences.traditional: 在簽訂合同之前，雙方必須再次確認設備的尺寸和安裝條件。
sentences.pinyin: Zài qiāndìng hétong zhīqián, shuāngfāng bìxū zàicì quèrèn shèbèi de chǐcùn hé ānzhuāng tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: Before signing the contract, both sides must confirm the equipment’s size and installation conditions again.

sentences.chinese: 如果图片尺寸被压缩得过度，细节就会变得模糊，影响出版效果。
sentences.traditional: 如果圖片尺寸被壓縮得過度，細節就會變得模糊，影響出版效果。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ túpiàn chǐcùn bèi yāsuō de guòdù, xìjié jiù huì biàn de móhu, yǐngxiǎng chūbǎn xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: If the image size is compressed too much, the details will become blurred and the publishing result will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 他一时冲动辞了职，冷静下来后才意识到自己没有任何后续安排。
sentences.traditional: 他一時衝動辭了職，冷靜下來後才意識到自己沒有任何後續安排。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí chōngdòng cí le zhí, lěngjìng xiàlai hòu cái yìshí dào zìjǐ méiyǒu rènhé hòuxù ānpái.
sentences.translation: He quit his job on impulse, and only after calming down did he realise he had no follow-up plan at all.

sentences.chinese: 投资不能只凭冲动，否则市场一有波动就容易做出错误判断。
sentences.traditional: 投資不能只憑衝動，否則市場一有波動就容易做出錯誤判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Tóuzī bù néng zhǐ píng chōngdòng, fǒuzé shìchǎng yì yǒu bōdòng jiù róngyì zuò chū cuòwù pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Investment decisions cannot rely only on impulse; otherwise, as soon as the market fluctuates, it is easy to make a wrong judgement.

sentences.chinese: 面对批评时保持克制，比冲动地反驳更能显示一个人的成熟。
sentences.traditional: 面對批評時保持克制，比衝動地反駁更能顯示一個人的成熟。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì pīpíng shí bǎochí kèzhì, bǐ chōngdòng de fǎnbó gèng néng xiǎnshì yí gè rén de chéngshú.
sentences.translation: When facing criticism, staying restrained shows more maturity than replying impulsively.

sentences.chinese: 全球能源价格的波动，对制造业的成本结构造成了巨大冲击。
sentences.traditional: 全球能源價格的波動，對製造業的成本結構造成了巨大衝擊。
sentences.pinyin: Quánqiú néngyuán jiàgé de bōdòng, duì zhìzàoyè de chéngběn jiégòu zàochéng le jùdà chōngjī.
sentences.translation: Fluctuations in global energy prices have had a huge impact on the cost structure of manufacturing.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片用真实影像冲击观众的惯性认知，促使人们重新思考贫困问题。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片用真實影像衝擊觀眾的慣性認知，促使人們重新思考貧困問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn yòng zhēnshí yǐngxiàng chōngjī guānzhòng de guànxìng rènzhī, cùshǐ rénmen chóngxīn sīkǎo pínkùn wèntí.
sentences.translation: This documentary uses real images to challenge viewers’ habitual assumptions and prompts people to rethink poverty.

sentences.chinese: 新技术的出现往往会冲击原有行业，却也可能创造新的就业机会。
sentences.traditional: 新技術的出現往往會衝擊原有行業，卻也可能創造新的就業機會。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jìshù de chūxiàn wǎngwǎng huì chōngjī yuányǒu hángyè, què yě kěnéng chuàngzào xīn de jiùyè jīhuì.
sentences.translation: The emergence of new technology often disrupts existing industries, but it may also create new employment opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 志愿服务让他的暑假过得格外充实，也让他更理解社区工作的复杂性。
sentences.traditional: 志願服務讓他的暑假過得格外充實，也讓他更理解社區工作的複雜性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuàn fúwù ràng tā de shǔjià guò de géwài chōngshí, yě ràng tā gèng lǐjiě shèqū gōngzuò de fùzáxìng.
sentences.translation: Voluntary work made his summer holiday especially fulfilling and helped him better understand the complexity of community work.

sentences.chinese: 为了充实报告内容，研究小组又补充了三组对照数据。
sentences.traditional: 為了充實報告內容，研究小組又補充了三組對照數據。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile chōngshí bàogào nèiróng, yánjiū xiǎozǔ yòu bǔchōng le sān zǔ duìzhào shùjù.
sentences.translation: To enrich the report, the research team added three more sets of comparison data.

sentences.chinese: 一个充实的课程不应只是信息量大，还应引导学生独立分析。
sentences.traditional: 一個充實的課程不應只是信息量大，還應引導學生獨立分析。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè chōngshí de kèchéng bù yīng zhǐ shì zīxùn liàng dà, hái yīng yǐndǎo xuésheng dúlì fēnxī.
sentences.translation: A substantial course should not merely contain a lot of information; it should also guide students to analyse independently.

sentences.chinese: 当个人利益与公共规则发生冲突时，制度必须给出清晰的处理原则。
sentences.traditional: 當個人利益與公共規則發生衝突時，制度必須給出清晰的處理原則。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng gèrén lìyì yǔ gōnggòng guīzé fāshēng chōngtū shí, zhìdù bìxū gěi chū qīngxī de chǔlǐ yuánzé.
sentences.translation: When personal interests conflict with public rules, the system must provide clear principles for handling the situation.

sentences.chinese: 两个部门在预算分配上长期冲突，最终影响了项目进度。
sentences.traditional: 兩個部門在預算分配上長期衝突，最終影響了項目進度。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè bùmén zài yùsuàn fēnpèi shàng chángqī chōngtū, zuìzhōng yǐngxiǎng le xiàngmù jìndù.
sentences.translation: The two departments have long been in conflict over budget allocation, which eventually affected the progress of the project.

sentences.chinese: 文化差异本身并不可怕，可怕的是缺乏沟通而导致误解升级为冲突。
sentences.traditional: 文化差異本身並不可怕，可怕的是缺乏溝通而導致誤解升級為衝突。
sentences.pinyin: Wénhuà chāyì běnshēn bìng bù kěpà, kěpà de shì quēfá gōutōng ér dǎozhì wùjiě shēngjí wéi chōngtū.
sentences.translation: Cultural differences themselves are not frightening; what is frightening is a lack of communication that causes misunderstandings to escalate into conflict.

sentences.chinese: 他并不盲目崇拜名人，而是关注他们成功背后的长期努力。
sentences.traditional: 他並不盲目崇拜名人，而是關注他們成功背後的長期努力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù mángmù chóngbài míngrén, ér shì guānzhù tāmen chénggōng bèihòu de chángqī nǔlì.
sentences.translation: He does not blindly worship celebrities, but pays attention to the long-term effort behind their success.

sentences.chinese: 有些粉丝把运动员当成偶像崇拜，却忽略了他们也是会犯错的普通人。
sentences.traditional: 有些粉絲把運動員當成偶像崇拜，卻忽略了他們也是會犯錯的普通人。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē fěnsī bǎ yùndòngyuán dàngchéng ǒuxiàng chóngbài, què hūlüè le tāmen yě shì huì fàncuò de pǔtōng rén.
sentences.translation: Some fans idolise athletes as if they were icons, but overlook the fact that they are ordinary people who can make mistakes too.

sentences.chinese: 对权威的过度崇拜会削弱独立思考，使讨论变得缺乏活力。
sentences.traditional: 對權威的過度崇拜會削弱獨立思考，使討論變得缺乏活力。
sentences.pinyin: Duì quánwēi de guòdù chóngbài huì xuēruò dúlì sīkǎo, shǐ tǎolùn biàn de quēfá huólì.
sentences.translation: Excessive worship of authority can weaken independent thinking and make discussion lifeless.

sentences.chinese: 灾后重建不仅要恢复房屋，更要恢复居民对未来的信心。
sentences.traditional: 災後重建不僅要恢復房屋，更要恢復居民對未來的信心。
sentences.pinyin: Zāi hòu chóngjiàn bùjǐn yào huīfù fángwū, gèng yào huīfù jūmín duì wèilái de xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: Post-disaster reconstruction must restore not only houses, but also residents’ confidence in the future.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司试图通过公开道歉和赔偿，逐步重建消费者的信任。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司試圖通過公開道歉和賠償，逐步重建消費者的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shìtú tōngguò gōngkāi dàoqiàn hé péicháng, zhúbù chóngjiàn xiāofèizhě de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: The company is trying to gradually rebuild consumers’ trust through a public apology and compensation.

sentences.chinese: 要重建一套有效的管理体系，首先必须弄清原来的问题出在哪里。
sentences.traditional: 要重建一套有效的管理體系，首先必須弄清原來的問題出在哪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Yào chóngjiàn yí tào yǒuxiào de guǎnlǐ tǐxì, shǒuxiān bìxū nòng qīng yuánlái de wèntí chū zài nǎlǐ.
sentences.translation: To rebuild an effective management system, one must first work out where the original problems lay.

sentences.chinese: 他冲我笑了笑，似乎是在暗示会议已经结束。
sentences.traditional: 他衝我笑了笑，似乎是在暗示會議已經結束。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chòng wǒ xiào le xiào, sìhū shì zài ànshì huìyì yǐjīng jiéshù.
sentences.translation: He smiled at me, as if hinting that the meeting was already over.

sentences.chinese: 她冲着门口喊了一声，提醒大家不要把备用钥匙忘在屋里。
sentences.traditional: 她衝著門口喊了一聲，提醒大家不要把備用鑰匙忘在屋裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chòng zhe ménkǒu hǎn le yì shēng, tíxǐng dàjiā bú yào bǎ bèiyòng yàoshi wàng zài wū lǐ.
sentences.translation: She called towards the doorway, reminding everyone not to leave the spare key inside.

sentences.chinese: 就冲他这份坚持，团队也愿意再给这个方案一次机会。
sentences.traditional: 就衝他這份堅持，團隊也願意再給這個方案一次機會。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù chòng tā zhè fèn jiānchí, tuánduì yě yuànyì zài gěi zhège fāng'àn yí cì jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Just on the strength of his persistence, the team is willing to give this proposal another chance.

sentences.chinese: 活动结束前，主办方安排了一轮抽奖，奖品由参展商共同提供。
sentences.traditional: 活動結束前，主辦方安排了一輪抽獎，獎品由參展商共同提供。
sentences.pinyin: Huódòng jiéshù qián, zhǔbànfāng ānpái le yì lún chōujiǎng, jiǎngpǐn yóu cānzhǎn shāng gòngtóng tígōng.
sentences.translation: Before the event ended, the organisers arranged a lucky draw, with prizes jointly provided by the exhibitors.

sentences.chinese: 他买东西并不是为了抽奖，只是觉得这家店的售后保障比较可靠。
sentences.traditional: 他買東西並不是為了抽獎，只是覺得這家店的售後保障比較可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi dōngxi bìng bú shì wèile chōujiǎng, zhǐ shì juéde zhè jiā diàn de shòuhòu bǎozhàng bǐjiào kěkào.
sentences.translation: He did not buy things in order to enter the lucky draw; he simply felt that the shop’s after-sales guarantee was fairly reliable.

sentences.chinese: 线上抽奖必须公开规则，否则很容易被质疑缺乏公平性。
sentences.traditional: 線上抽獎必須公開規則，否則很容易被質疑缺乏公平性。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànshàng chōujiǎng bìxū gōngkāi guīzé, fǒuzé hěn róngyì bèi zhíyí quēfá gōngpíngxìng.
sentences.translation: Online prize draws must make their rules public; otherwise they are easily questioned for lacking fairness.

sentences.chinese: 这个概念过于抽象，如果没有案例支持，普通读者很难真正理解。
sentences.traditional: 這個概念過於抽象，如果沒有案例支持，普通讀者很難真正理解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gàiniàn guòyú chōuxiàng, rúguǒ méiyǒu ànlì zhīchí, pǔtōng dúzhě hěn nán zhēnzhèng lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: This concept is too abstract; without case support, ordinary readers find it hard to truly understand.

sentences.chinese: 她把抽象的理论转化成具体步骤，使培训效果明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 她把抽象的理論轉化成具體步驟，使培訓效果明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ chōuxiàng de lǐlùn zhuǎnhuà chéng jùtǐ bùzhòu, shǐ péixùn xiàoguǒ míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: She turned abstract theory into concrete steps, which noticeably improved the training results.

sentences.chinese: 艺术家并不追求写实，而是用抽象的线条表达情绪。
sentences.traditional: 藝術家並不追求寫實，而是用抽象的線條表達情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Yìshùjiā bìng bù zhuīqiú xiěshí, ér shì yòng chōuxiàng de xiàntiáo biǎodá qíngxù.
sentences.translation: The artist does not pursue realism, but uses abstract lines to express emotion.

sentences.chinese: 资金还没有到位，项目经理愁得整晚睡不着。
sentences.traditional: 資金還沒有到位，項目經理愁得整晚睡不著。
sentences.pinyin: Zījīn hái méiyǒu dàowèi, xiàngmù jīnglǐ chóu de zhěng wǎn shuì bù zháo.
sentences.translation: Since the funding has not yet arrived, the project manager is so worried that he cannot sleep all night.

sentences.chinese: 别只顾着愁，先把能解决的问题列出来。
sentences.traditional: 別只顧著愁，先把能解決的問題列出來。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhǐ gùzhe chóu, xiān bǎ néng jiějué de wèntí liè chūlai.
sentences.translation: Do not just sit there worrying; first list the problems that can be solved.

sentences.chinese: 他愁的不是工作量，而是团队之间长期缺乏信任。
sentences.traditional: 他愁的不是工作量，而是團隊之間長期缺乏信任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chóu de bú shì gōngzuòliàng, ér shì tuánduì zhījiān chángqī quēfá xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: What worries him is not the workload, but the long-term lack of trust between teams.

sentences.chinese: 为了筹备这次国际会议，秘书处提前半年联系了各国代表。
sentences.traditional: 為了籌備這次國際會議，秘書處提前半年聯繫了各國代表。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile chóubèi zhè cì guójì huìyì, mìshūchù tíqián bàn nián liánxì le gè guó dàibiǎo.
sentences.translation: To prepare for this international conference, the secretariat contacted representatives from various countries half a year in advance.

sentences.chinese: 新馆仍在筹备阶段，具体开放日期还没有正式公布。
sentences.traditional: 新館仍在籌備階段，具體開放日期還沒有正式公佈。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn guǎn réng zài chóubèi jiēduàn, jùtǐ kāifàng rìqī hái méiyǒu zhèngshì gōngbù.
sentences.translation: The new venue is still in the preparation stage, and the exact opening date has not yet been officially announced.

sentences.chinese: 如果筹备工作不够细致，开幕当天很容易出现混乱。
sentences.traditional: 如果籌備工作不夠細緻，開幕當天很容易出現混亂。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chóubèi gōngzuò bú gòu xìzhì, kāimù dāngtiān hěn róngyì chūxiàn hùnluàn.
sentences.translation: If the preparations are not sufficiently detailed, chaos can easily occur on the opening day.

sentences.chinese: 调查小组已经形成初步结论，但仍需进一步核实关键证据。
sentences.traditional: 調查小組已經形成初步結論，但仍需進一步核實關鍵證據。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá xiǎozǔ yǐjīng xíngchéng chūbù jiélùn, dàn réng xū jìnyí bù héshí guānjiàn zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: The investigation team has already formed a preliminary conclusion, but still needs to further verify key evidence.

sentences.chinese: 双方达成了初步协议，至于细节，还要在下周继续谈判。
sentences.traditional: 雙方達成了初步協議，至於細節，還要在下週繼續談判。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng dáchéng le chūbù xiéyì, zhìyú xìjié, hái yào zài xià zhōu jìxù tánpàn.
sentences.translation: The two sides reached a preliminary agreement; as for the details, they will continue negotiations next week.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告只是初步分析，不能作为最终决策的唯一依据。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告只是初步分析，不能作為最終決策的唯一依據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zhǐ shì chūbù fēnxī, bù néng zuòwéi zuìzhōng juécè de wéiyī yījù.
sentences.translation: This report is only a preliminary analysis and cannot serve as the sole basis for the final decision.

sentences.chinese: 主角还没出场，观众已经因为音乐和灯光变得紧张起来。
sentences.traditional: 主角還沒出場，觀眾已經因為音樂和燈光變得緊張起來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǔjué hái méi chūchǎng, guānzhòng yǐjīng yīnwèi yīnyuè hé dēngguāng biàn de jǐnzhāng qǐlai.
sentences.translation: The main character had not yet appeared, but the audience had already become tense because of the music and lighting.

sentences.chinese: 这名年轻球员首次出场就完成助攻，给教练留下了深刻印象。
sentences.traditional: 這名年輕球員首次出場就完成助攻，給教練留下了深刻印象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè míng niánqīng qiúyuán shǒucì chūchǎng jiù wánchéng zhùgōng, gěi jiàoliàn liúxià le shēnkè yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: This young player made an assist in his first appearance, leaving a deep impression on the coach.

sentences.chinese: 嘉宾出场的顺序经过反复调整，以免引起不必要的误解。
sentences.traditional: 嘉賓出場的順序經過反覆調整，以免引起不必要的誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Jiābīn chūchǎng de shùnxù jīngguò fǎnfù tiáozhěng, yǐmiǎn yǐnqǐ bù bìyào de wùjiě.
sentences.translation: The order in which the guests appear has been adjusted repeatedly to avoid unnecessary misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 这门课程虽然叫初等统计，但对数学基础薄弱的学生并不轻松。
sentences.traditional: 這門課程雖然叫初等統計，但對數學基礎薄弱的學生並不輕鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng suīrán jiào chūděng tǒngjì, dàn duì shùxué jīchǔ bóruò de xuésheng bìng bù qīngsōng.
sentences.translation: Although this course is called elementary statistics, it is not easy for students with a weak mathematical foundation.

sentences.chinese: 初等教育的水平，往往决定孩子以后学习习惯的形成。
sentences.traditional: 初等教育的水平，往往決定孩子以後學習習慣的形成。
sentences.pinyin: Chūděng jiàoyù de shuǐpíng, wǎngwǎng juédìng háizi yǐhòu xuéxí xíguàn de xíngchéng.
sentences.translation: The standard of elementary education often determines the formation of children’s later study habits.

sentences.chinese: 他把复杂的模型简化成初等公式，方便非专业人员理解。
sentences.traditional: 他把複雜的模型簡化成初等公式，方便非專業人員理解。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ fùzá de móxíng jiǎnhuà chéng chūděng gōngshì, fāngbiàn fēi zhuānyè rényuán lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: He simplified the complex model into elementary formulae, making it easier for non-specialists to understand.

sentences.chinese: 由于护照即将过期，他在出境前被工作人员拦了下来。
sentences.traditional: 由於護照即將過期，他在出境前被工作人員攔了下來。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú hùzhào jíjiāng guòqī, tā zài chūjìng qián bèi gōngzuò rényuán lán le xiàlai.
sentences.translation: Because his passport was about to expire, he was stopped by staff before leaving the country.

sentences.chinese: 部分文物未经批准不得出境，以防珍贵资料流失。
sentences.traditional: 部分文物未經批准不得出境，以防珍貴資料流失。
sentences.pinyin: Bùfen wénwù wèi jīng pīzhǔn bùdé chūjìng, yǐ fáng zhēnguì zīliào liúshī.
sentences.translation: Some cultural relics may not leave the country without approval, in order to prevent the loss of precious materials.

sentences.chinese: 旅行社提醒游客，出境时必须如实申报携带的贵重物品。
sentences.traditional: 旅行社提醒遊客，出境時必須如實申報攜帶的貴重物品。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíngshè tíxǐng yóukè, chūjìng shí bìxū rúshí shēnbào xiédài de guìzhòng wùpǐn.
sentences.translation: The travel agency reminds tourists that, when leaving the country, they must truthfully declare any valuables they are carrying.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革能否落实，关键在于各部门是否愿意真正出力。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革能否落實，關鍵在於各部門是否願意真正出力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé néngfǒu luòshí, guānjiàn zàiyú gè bùmén shìfǒu yuànyì zhēnzhèng chūlì.
sentences.translation: Whether this reform can be implemented depends on whether each department is truly willing to make an effort.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然不是负责人，却在最困难的时候出力最多。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然不是負責人，卻在最困難的時候出力最多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán bú shì fùzérén, què zài zuì kùnnán de shíhou chūlì zuì duō.
sentences.translation: Although he was not the person in charge, he contributed the most during the most difficult period.

sentences.chinese: 做公益不能只靠少数人出力，社会各界都应承担责任。
sentences.traditional: 做公益不能只靠少數人出力，社會各界都應承擔責任。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò gōngyì bù néng zhǐ kào shǎoshù rén chūlì, shèhuì gè jiè dōu yīng chéngdān zérèn.
sentences.translation: Public welfare work cannot rely on only a small number of people contributing; all sectors of society should take responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 这座小城因为传统手工艺而出名，每年都吸引大量游客。
sentences.traditional: 這座小城因為傳統手工藝而出名，每年都吸引大量遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò xiǎochéng yīnwèi chuántǒng shǒugōngyì ér chūmíng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn dàliàng yóukè.
sentences.translation: This small city is famous for its traditional handicrafts and attracts large numbers of tourists every year.

sentences.chinese: 他出名以后仍然保持低调，很少接受商业采访。
sentences.traditional: 他出名以後仍然保持低調，很少接受商業採訪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chūmíng yǐhòu réngrán bǎochí dīdiào, hěn shǎo jiēshòu shāngyè cǎifǎng.
sentences.translation: After becoming famous, he still kept a low profile and rarely accepted commercial interviews.

sentences.chinese: 一篇文章出名，并不代表其中的观点经得起严格检验。
sentences.traditional: 一篇文章出名，並不代表其中的觀點經得起嚴格檢驗。
sentences.pinyin: Yì piān wénzhāng chūmíng, bìng bù dàibiǎo qízhōng de guāndiǎn jīng de qǐ yángé jiǎnyàn.
sentences.translation: A piece of writing becoming famous does not mean that its arguments can withstand strict examination.

sentences.chinese: 两份财务报表的数字有明显出入，必须重新核对原始凭证。
sentences.traditional: 兩份財務報表的數字有明顯出入，必須重新核對原始憑證。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng fèn cáiwù bàobiǎo de shùzì yǒu míngxiǎn chūrù, bìxū chóngxīn héduì yuánshǐ píngzhèng.
sentences.translation: The figures in the two financial statements have an obvious discrepancy, so the original vouchers must be checked again.

sentences.chinese: 证人的说法与监控记录存在出入，警方因此扩大了调查范围。
sentences.traditional: 證人的說法與監控記錄存在出入，警方因此擴大了調查範圍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngrén de shuōfǎ yǔ jiānkòng jìlù cúnzài chūrù, jǐngfāng yīncǐ kuòdà le diàochá fànwéi.
sentences.translation: There is a discrepancy between the witness’s account and the surveillance records, so the police expanded the scope of the investigation.

sentences.chinese: 口头承诺和合同条款若有出入，应以书面文件为准。
sentences.traditional: 口頭承諾和合同條款若有出入，應以書面文件為準。
sentences.pinyin: Kǒutóu chéngnuò hé hétong tiáokuǎn ruò yǒu chūrù, yīng yǐ shūmiàn wénjiàn wéi zhǔn.
sentences.translation: If there is any discrepancy between a verbal promise and the contract terms, the written document should prevail.

sentences.chinese: 进入考场前，考生必须出示有效证件，否则不得参加考试。
sentences.traditional: 進入考場前，考生必須出示有效證件，否則不得參加考試。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù kǎochǎng qián, kǎoshēng bìxū chūshì yǒuxiào zhèngjiàn, fǒuzé bùdé cānjiā kǎoshì.
sentences.translation: Before entering the exam room, candidates must present valid ID; otherwise, they may not take the exam.

sentences.chinese: 律师要求对方出示原始合同，以确认条款是否被修改过。
sentences.traditional: 律師要求對方出示原始合同，以確認條款是否被修改過。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜshī yāoqiú duìfāng chūshì yuánshǐ hétong, yǐ quèrèn tiáokuǎn shìfǒu bèi xiūgǎi guò.
sentences.translation: The lawyer asked the other side to present the original contract in order to confirm whether the terms had been changed.

sentences.chinese: 如果乘客无法出示车票，工作人员有权按规定处理。
sentences.traditional: 如果乘客無法出示車票，工作人員有權按規定處理。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chéngkè wúfǎ chūshì chēpiào, gōngzuò rényuán yǒu quán àn guīdìng chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: If passengers cannot show their tickets, staff have the authority to handle the matter according to regulations.

sentences.chinese: 国庆期间，许多家庭选择错峰出游，以避开拥挤的交通。
sentences.traditional: 國慶期間，許多家庭選擇錯峰出遊，以避開擁擠的交通。
sentences.pinyin: Guóqìng qījiān, xǔduō jiātíng xuǎnzé cuòfēng chūyóu, yǐ bìkāi yōngjǐ de jiāotōng.
sentences.translation: During the National Day holiday, many families choose to travel outside peak times to avoid crowded transport.

sentences.chinese: 公司鼓励员工带薪出游，希望他们在放松之后提高工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 公司鼓勵員工帶薪出遊，希望他們在放鬆之後提高工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gǔlì yuángōng dàixīn chūyóu, xīwàng tāmen zài fàngsōng zhīhòu tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The company encourages employees to take paid trips, hoping they will work more efficiently after relaxing.

sentences.chinese: 天气预报显示周末有暴雨，原定的出游计划只好推迟。
sentences.traditional: 天氣預報顯示週末有暴雨，原定的出遊計劃只好推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào xiǎnshì zhōumò yǒu bàoyǔ, yuándìng de chūyóu jìhuà zhǐhǎo tuīchí.
sentences.translation: The weather forecast says there will be heavy rain at the weekend, so the planned trip has had to be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 出于安全考虑，主办方临时限制了现场观众的人数。
sentences.traditional: 出於安全考慮，主辦方臨時限制了現場觀眾的人數。
sentences.pinyin: Chūyú ānquán kǎolǜ, zhǔbànfāng línshí xiànzhì le xiànchǎng guānzhòng de rénshù.
sentences.translation: Out of safety considerations, the organiser temporarily limited the number of spectators at the venue.

sentences.chinese: 他拒绝采访并非出于傲慢，而是担心泄露案件细节。
sentences.traditional: 他拒絕採訪並非出於傲慢，而是擔心洩露案件細節。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jùjué cǎifǎng bìngfēi chūyú àomàn, ér shì dānxīn xièlòu ànjiàn xìjié.
sentences.translation: He refused the interview not out of arrogance, but because he was worried about revealing details of the case.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策出于长期利益，短期内却可能增加企业负担。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策出於長期利益，短期內卻可能增加企業負擔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè chūyú chángqī lìyì, duǎnqī nèi què kěnéng zēngjiā qǐyè fùdān.
sentences.translation: This policy is based on long-term interests, but in the short term it may increase the burden on companies.

sentences.chinese: 除少数紧急情况外，医院不接受没有预约的检查申请。
sentences.traditional: 除少數緊急情況外，醫院不接受沒有預約的檢查申請。
sentences.pinyin: Chú shǎoshù jǐnjí qíngkuàng wài, yīyuàn bù jiēshòu méiyǒu yùyuē de jiǎnchá shēnqǐng.
sentences.translation: Except for a small number of emergencies, the hospital does not accept examination requests without an appointment.

sentences.chinese: 机器启动前，技术人员必须除去表面的灰尘和杂物。
sentences.traditional: 機器啟動前，技術人員必須除去表面的灰塵和雜物。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì qǐdòng qián, jìshù rényuán bìxū chúqù biǎomiàn de huīchén hé záwù.
sentences.translation: Before starting the machine, technicians must remove the dust and debris from its surface.

sentences.chinese: 把全年总收入除以十二，才能估算出每月平均收入。
sentences.traditional: 把全年總收入除以十二，才能估算出每月平均收入。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎ quánnián zǒng shōurù chú yǐ shí'èr, cái néng gūsuàn chū měi yuè píngjūn shōurù.
sentences.translation: Only by dividing the total annual income by twelve can you estimate the average monthly income.

sentences.chinese: 除非证据更加充分，否则法院不会轻易改变原判。
sentences.traditional: 除非證據更加充分，否則法院不會輕易改變原判。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfēi zhèngjù gèngjiā chōngfèn, fǒuzé fǎyuàn bú huì qīngyì gǎibiàn yuánpàn.
sentences.translation: Unless the evidence is more sufficient, the court will not easily change the original judgement.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目除非获得额外资金，否则很难按期完成。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目除非獲得額外資金，否則很難按期完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù chúfēi huòdé éwài zījīn, fǒuzé hěn nán ànqī wánchéng.
sentences.translation: Unless this project obtains additional funding, it will be difficult to complete it on schedule.

sentences.chinese: 除非双方愿意让步，谈判很可能再次陷入僵局。
sentences.traditional: 除非雙方願意讓步，談判很可能再次陷入僵局。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfēi shuāngfāng yuànyì ràngbù, tánpàn hěn kěnéng zàicì xiànrù jiāngjú.
sentences.translation: Unless both sides are willing to compromise, the negotiations are likely to fall into deadlock again.

sentences.chinese: 数据必须储存在加密服务器上，以降低被盗取的风险。
sentences.traditional: 數據必須儲存在加密伺服器上，以降低被盜取的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù bìxū chǔcún zài jiāmì sìfúqì shàng, yǐ jiàngdī bèi dàoqǔ de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Data must be stored on encrypted servers to reduce the risk of being stolen.

sentences.chinese: 这种药品需要在低温环境中储存，否则药效会下降。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥品需要在低溫環境中儲存，否則藥效會下降。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàopǐn xūyào zài dīwēn huánjìng zhōng chǔcún, fǒuzé yàoxiào huì xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: This medicine needs to be stored in a low-temperature environment; otherwise, its effectiveness will decline.

sentences.chinese: 水库在雨季储存的水量，决定了旱季灌溉的能力。
sentences.traditional: 水庫在雨季儲存的水量，決定了旱季灌溉的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐkù zài yǔjì chǔcún de shuǐliàng, juédìng le hànjì guàngài de nénglì.
sentences.translation: The amount of water stored by the reservoir in the rainy season determines its irrigation capacity in the dry season.

sentences.chinese: 对于故意泄露客户资料的员工，公司将依法处罚。
sentences.traditional: 對於故意洩露客戶資料的員工，公司將依法處罰。
sentences.pinyin: Duìyú gùyì xièlòu kèhù zīliào de yuángōng, gōngsī jiāng yīfǎ chǔfá.
sentences.translation: The company will punish employees who deliberately leak customer data in accordance with the law.

sentences.chinese: 学校处罚学生时，应同时说明规则和教育目的。
sentences.traditional: 學校處罰學生時，應同時說明規則和教育目的。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào chǔfá xuéshēng shí, yīng tóngshí shuōmíng guīzé hé jiàoyù mùdì.
sentences.translation: When a school punishes students, it should also explain the rules and the educational purpose.

sentences.chinese: 交通部门不仅处罚违法驾驶者，也加强了安全宣传。
sentences.traditional: 交通部門不僅處罰違法駕駛者，也加強了安全宣傳。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāotōng bùmén bùjǐn chǔfá wéifǎ jiàshǐ zhě, yě jiāqiáng le ānquán xuānchuán.
sentences.translation: The transport department not only punishes illegal drivers, but also strengthens safety publicity.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人若能尽早养成储蓄习惯，抗风险能力会明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人若能盡早養成儲蓄習慣，抗風險能力會明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén ruò néng jǐnzǎo yǎngchéng chǔxù xíguàn, kàng fēngxiǎn nénglì huì míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: If young people can develop a habit of saving early, their ability to withstand risk will improve significantly.

sentences.chinese: 她把奖金的一半用于储蓄，另一半用于继续学习。
sentences.traditional: 她把獎金的一半用於儲蓄，另一半用於繼續學習。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiǎngjīn de yíbàn yòng yú chǔxù, lìng yíbàn yòng yú jìxù xuéxí.
sentences.translation: She used half of the bonus for savings and the other half for further study.

sentences.chinese: 高通胀时期，单靠银行储蓄很难保持资产价值。
sentences.traditional: 高通脹時期，單靠銀行儲蓄很難保持資產價值。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo tōngzhàng shíqī, dān kào yínháng chǔxù hěn nán bǎochí zīchǎn jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: During periods of high inflation, it is difficult to preserve asset value by relying on bank savings alone.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城处处保留着历史痕迹，却并不显得陈旧。
sentences.traditional: 這座古城處處保留著歷史痕跡，卻並不顯得陳舊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng chùchù bǎoliú zhe lìshǐ hénjì, què bìng bù xiǎnde chénjiù.
sentences.translation: This ancient city preserves traces of history everywhere, yet it does not seem outdated.

sentences.chinese: 企业改革不能处处依赖行政命令，还需要市场机制发挥作用。
sentences.traditional: 企業改革不能處處依賴行政命令，還需要市場機制發揮作用。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè gǎigé bùnéng chùchù yīlài xíngzhèng mìnglìng, hái xūyào shìchǎng jīzhì fāhuī zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Corporate reform cannot rely on administrative orders everywhere; market mechanisms also need to play a role.

sentences.chinese: 一个真正开放的城市，应该让游客处处感到便利和尊重。
sentences.traditional: 一個真正開放的城市，應該讓遊客處處感到便利和尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè zhēnzhèng kāifàng de chéngshì, yīnggāi ràng yóukè chùchù gǎndào biànlì hé zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: A genuinely open city should make visitors feel convenience and respect everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 调查小组穿过受灾地区，记录了道路和桥梁的损毁情况。
sentences.traditional: 調查小組穿過受災地區，記錄了道路和橋樑的損毀情況。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá xiǎozǔ chuānguò shòuzāi dìqū, jìlù le dàolù hé qiáoliáng de sǔnhuǐ qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The investigation team passed through the disaster-stricken area and recorded the damage to roads and bridges.

sentences.chinese: 火车穿过漫长的隧道后，乘客终于看见了海岸线。
sentences.traditional: 火車穿過漫長的隧道後，乘客終於看見了海岸線。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē chuānguò màncháng de suìdào hòu, chéngkè zhōngyú kànjiàn le hǎi'ànxiàn.
sentences.translation: After the train passed through the long tunnel, the passengers finally saw the coastline.

sentences.chinese: 只有穿过层层审批，方案才能真正进入实施阶段。
sentences.traditional: 只有穿過層層審批，方案才能真正進入實施階段。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu chuānguò céngcéng shěnpī, fāng'àn cái néng zhēnzhèng jìnrù shíshī jiēduàn.
sentences.translation: Only after going through layer upon layer of approval can the plan truly enter the implementation stage.

sentences.chinese: 这门手艺之所以能够传承数百年，是因为每一代工匠都愿意耐心打磨细节。
sentences.traditional: 這門手藝之所以能夠傳承數百年，是因為每一代工匠都願意耐心打磨細節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén shǒuyì zhī suǒyǐ nénggòu chuánchéng shù bǎi nián, shì yīnwèi měi yí dài gōngjiàng dōu yuànyì nàixīn dǎmó xìjié.
sentences.translation: This craft has been passed down for hundreds of years because every generation of artisans has been willing to polish the details patiently.

sentences.chinese: 教育不仅要传授知识，还要传承一个社会重视理性和责任的精神。
sentences.traditional: 教育不僅要傳授知識，還要傳承一個社會重視理性和責任的精神。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù bùjǐn yào chuánshòu zhīshi, hái yào chuánchéng yí gè shèhuì zhòngshì lǐxìng hé zérèn de jīngshén.
sentences.translation: Education should not only impart knowledge, but also carry forward the spirit of a society that values reason and responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 如果传统节日只剩下消费，它们原本承载的文化记忆就很难继续传承下去。
sentences.traditional: 如果傳統節日只剩下消費，它們原本承載的文化記憶就很難繼續傳承下去。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chuántǒng jiérì zhǐ shèngxià xiāofèi, tāmen yuánběn chéngzài de wénhuà jìyì jiù hěn nán jìxù chuánchéng xiàqu.
sentences.translation: If traditional festivals are reduced to consumption, the cultural memories they originally carried will be difficult to continue passing down.

sentences.chinese: 请把会议结论准确传达给各部门，以免执行时出现误解。
sentences.traditional: 請把會議結論準確傳達給各部門，以免執行時出現誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ huìyì jiélùn zhǔnquè chuándá gěi gè bùmén, yǐmiǎn zhíxíng shí chūxiàn wùjiě.
sentences.translation: Please accurately convey the meeting conclusions to each department, so that misunderstandings do not arise during implementation.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片通过普通人的经历，传达了对生命尊严的深切关注。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片通過普通人的經歷，傳達了對生命尊嚴的深切關注。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tōngguò pǔtōng rén de jīnglì, chuándá le duì shēngmìng zūnyán de shēnqiè guānzhù.
sentences.translation: Through the experiences of ordinary people, this documentary conveys deep concern for the dignity of life.

sentences.chinese: 领导的意思并不是责备个人，而是想传达改革已经势在必行。
sentences.traditional: 領導的意思並不是責備個人，而是想傳達改革已經勢在必行。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo de yìsi bìng bú shì zébèi gèrén, ér shì xiǎng chuándá gǎigé yǐjīng shì zài bì xíng.
sentences.translation: The leader did not mean to blame individuals, but wanted to convey that reform had already become imperative.

sentences.chinese: 这种病毒主要通过空气传染，因此室内通风显得尤为重要。
sentences.traditional: 這種病毒主要通過空氣傳染，因此室內通風顯得尤為重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìngdú zhǔyào tōngguò kōngqì chuánrǎn, yīncǐ shìnèi tōngfēng xiǎnde yóuwéi zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: This virus is mainly transmitted through the air, so indoor ventilation is especially important.

sentences.chinese: 恐慌情绪有时比疾病本身传染得更快，会迅速扰乱正常秩序。
sentences.traditional: 恐慌情緒有時比疾病本身傳染得更快，會迅速擾亂正常秩序。
sentences.pinyin: Kǒnghuāng qíngxù yǒushí bǐ jíbìng běnshēn chuánrǎn de gèng kuài, huì xùnsù rǎoluàn zhèngcháng zhìxù.
sentences.translation: Panic sometimes spreads faster than the disease itself and can quickly disrupt normal order.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒家长，孩子发烧期间不要去学校，以免传染给其他同学。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒家長，孩子發燒期間不要去學校，以免傳染給其他同學。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng jiāzhǎng, háizi fāshāo qījiān bú yào qù xuéxiào, yǐmiǎn chuánrǎn gěi qítā tóngxué.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded parents that children should not go to school while they have a fever, in case they infect other classmates.

sentences.chinese: 面对传染病，最有效的公共政策往往是早发现、早隔离、早治疗。
sentences.traditional: 面對傳染病，最有效的公共政策往往是早發現、早隔離、早治療。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì chuánrǎnbìng, zuì yǒuxiào de gōnggòng zhèngcè wǎngwǎng shì zǎo fāxiàn, zǎo gélí, zǎo zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: When facing an infectious disease, the most effective public policy is often early detection, early isolation, and early treatment.

sentences.chinese: 传染病的传播不分国界，任何国家都无法完全置身事外。
sentences.traditional: 傳染病的傳播不分國界，任何國家都無法完全置身事外。
sentences.pinyin: Chuánrǎnbìng de chuánbō bù fēn guójiè, rènhé guójiā dōu wúfǎ wánquán zhì shēn shì wài.
sentences.translation: The spread of infectious diseases does not respect national borders, and no country can completely stay out of it.

sentences.chinese: 这本书用通俗语言解释传染病如何影响社会结构和经济决策。
sentences.traditional: 這本書用通俗語言解釋傳染病如何影響社會結構和經濟決策。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yòng tōngsú yǔyán jiěshì chuánrǎnbìng rúhé yǐngxiǎng shèhuì jiégòu hé jīngjì juécè.
sentences.translation: This book uses accessible language to explain how infectious diseases affect social structures and economic decisions.

sentences.chinese: 老师并不急于传授技巧，而是先培养学生独立思考的习惯。
sentences.traditional: 老師並不急於傳授技巧，而是先培養學生獨立思考的習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bìng bù jí yú chuánshòu jìqiǎo, ér shì xiān péiyǎng xuésheng dúlì sīkǎo de xíguàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher is not eager to teach techniques, but first cultivates the students' habit of independent thinking.

sentences.chinese: 这位医生退休后，仍定期为年轻同事传授临床经验。
sentences.traditional: 這位醫生退休後，仍定期為年輕同事傳授臨床經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīshēng tuìxiū hòu, réng dìngqī wèi niánqīng tóngshì chuánshòu línchuáng jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: After retiring, this doctor still regularly passes on clinical experience to younger colleagues.

sentences.chinese: 有些知识可以通过教材传授，有些判断力却只能在实践中慢慢形成。
sentences.traditional: 有些知識可以通過教材傳授，有些判斷力卻只能在實踐中慢慢形成。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē zhīshi kěyǐ tōngguò jiàocái chuánshòu, yǒuxiē pànduànlì què zhǐ néng zài shíjiàn zhōng mànmàn xíngchéng.
sentences.translation: Some knowledge can be taught through textbooks, while some judgement can only gradually form through practice.

sentences.chinese: 由于网络不稳定，实验数据在传输过程中出现了明显延迟。
sentences.traditional: 由於網絡不穩定，實驗數據在傳輸過程中出現了明顯延遲。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú wǎngluò bù wěndìng, shíyàn shùjù zài chuánshū guòchéng zhōng chūxiàn le míngxiǎn yánchí.
sentences.translation: Because the network was unstable, there was an obvious delay during the transmission of the experimental data.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统可以加密传输文件，避免敏感信息被第三方截获。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統可以加密傳輸文件，避免敏感信息被第三方截獲。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng kěyǐ jiāmì chuánshū wénjiàn, bìmiǎn mǐngǎn xìnxī bèi dì sān fāng jiéhuò.
sentences.translation: This system can transmit files with encryption, preventing sensitive information from being intercepted by a third party.

sentences.chinese: 能源从西部向东部传输，既缓解了需求压力，也带来了管理挑战。
sentences.traditional: 能源從西部向東部傳輸，既緩解了需求壓力，也帶來了管理挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Néngyuán cóng xībù xiàng dōngbù chuánshū, jì huǎnjiě le xūqiú yālì, yě dàilái le guǎnlǐ tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: Transmitting energy from the west to the east both eases demand pressure and brings management challenges.

sentences.chinese: 虽然电子邮件已经普及，法院仍接受部分材料通过传真提交。
sentences.traditional: 雖然電子郵件已經普及，法院仍接受部分材料通過傳真提交。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán diànzǐ yóujiàn yǐjīng pǔjí, fǎyuàn réng jiēshòu bùfen cáiliào tōngguò chuánzhēn tíjiāo.
sentences.translation: Although email is already widespread, the court still accepts some materials submitted by fax.

sentences.chinese: 他在酒店前台等了半小时，只为确认那份合同的传真是否收到。
sentences.traditional: 他在酒店前臺等了半小時，只為確認那份合同的傳真是否收到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jiǔdiàn qiántái děng le bàn xiǎoshí, zhǐ wèi quèrèn nà fèn hétong de chuánzhēn shìfǒu shōudào.
sentences.translation: He waited at the hotel front desk for half an hour just to confirm whether the fax of that contract had been received.

sentences.chinese: 对年轻员工来说，传真像是一种已经被时代淘汰的办公工具。
sentences.traditional: 對年輕員工來說，傳真像是一種已經被時代淘汰的辦公工具。
sentences.pinyin: Duì niánqīng yuángōng lái shuō, chuánzhēn xiàng shì yì zhǒng yǐjīng bèi shídài táotài de bàngōng gōngjù.
sentences.translation: To young employees, a fax seems like an office tool that has already been eliminated by the times.

sentences.chinese: 台风靠近时，港口要求所有船只尽快返航并停止作业。
sentences.traditional: 颱風靠近時，港口要求所有船隻盡快返航並停止作業。
sentences.pinyin: Táifēng kàojìn shí, gǎngkǒu yāoqiú suǒyǒu chuánzhī jǐnkuài fǎnháng bìng tíngzhǐ zuòyè.
sentences.translation: When the typhoon approached, the port required all vessels to return as soon as possible and stop operations.

sentences.chinese: 这片海域船只密集，任何导航失误都可能引发严重事故。
sentences.traditional: 這片海域船隻密集，任何導航失誤都可能引發嚴重事故。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn hǎiyù chuánzhī mìjí, rènhé dǎoháng shīwù dōu kěnéng yǐnfā yánzhòng shìgù.
sentences.translation: Vessels are dense in this sea area, and any navigation error could lead to a serious accident.

sentences.chinese: 调查显示，非法捕捞船只经常在夜间关闭定位系统。
sentences.traditional: 調查顯示，非法捕撈船隻經常在夜間關閉定位系統。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá xiǎnshì, fēifǎ bǔlāo chuánzhī jīngcháng zài yèjiān guānbì dìngwèi xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: The investigation showed that illegal fishing vessels often turn off their positioning systems at night.

sentences.chinese: 他从市场买了一串葡萄，却发现有一半已经变质。
sentences.traditional: 他從市場買了一串葡萄，卻發現有一半已經變質。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng shìchǎng mǎi le yí chuàn pútao, què fāxiàn yǒu yíbàn yǐjīng biànzhì.
sentences.translation: He bought a bunch of grapes at the market, only to find that half of them had already gone bad.

sentences.chinese: 警方根据一串电话号码，追查到了诈骗团伙的核心成员。
sentences.traditional: 警方根據一串電話號碼，追查到了詐騙團伙的核心成員。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng gēnjù yí chuàn diànhuà hàomǎ, zhuīchá dào le zhàpiàn tuánhuǒ de héxīn chéngyuán.
sentences.translation: The police traced the core members of the fraud gang using a string of phone numbers.

sentences.chinese: 这些看似零散的证据，最后被检察官串成了一条完整的逻辑链。
sentences.traditional: 這些看似零散的證據，最後被檢察官串成了一條完整的邏輯鏈。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē kànsì língsǎn de zhèngjù, zuìhòu bèi jiǎncháguān chuàn chéng le yì tiáo wánzhěng de luójí liàn.
sentences.translation: These seemingly scattered pieces of evidence were eventually strung by the prosecutor into a complete chain of logic.

sentences.chinese: 市政府开设了网上服务窗口，方便居民查询办事进度。
sentences.traditional: 市政府開設了網上服務窗口，方便居民查詢辦事進度。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhèngfǔ kāishè le wǎngshàng fúwù chuāngkǒu, fāngbiàn jūmín cháxún bànshì jìndù.
sentences.translation: The municipal government opened an online service window, making it easier for residents to check the progress of administrative procedures.

sentences.chinese: 在谈判陷入僵局后，双方仍保留着重新沟通的窗口。
sentences.traditional: 在談判陷入僵局後，雙方仍保留著重新溝通的窗口。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tánpàn xiànrù jiāngjú hòu, shuāngfāng réng bǎoliú zhe chóngxīn gōutōng de chuāngkǒu.
sentences.translation: After the negotiations reached a deadlock, both sides still kept a window for renewed communication.

sentences.chinese: 银行窗口前排满了人，工作人员只好延长营业时间。
sentences.traditional: 銀行窗口前排滿了人，工作人員只好延長營業時間。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng chuāngkǒu qián pái mǎn le rén, gōngzuò rényuán zhǐhǎo yáncháng yíngyè shíjiān.
sentences.translation: People queued up in front of the bank window, so the staff had to extend business hours.

sentences.chinese: 那名男子没预约就闯进会议室，打断了正在进行的谈判。
sentences.traditional: 那名男子沒預約就闖進會議室，打斷了正在進行的談判。
sentences.pinyin: Nà míng nánzǐ méi yùyuē jiù chuǎng jìn huìyìshì, dǎduàn le zhèngzài jìnxíng de tánpàn.
sentences.translation: The man rushed into the meeting room without an appointment and interrupted the negotiations in progress.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人应该敢于闯出自己的道路，但不能把鲁莽当成勇气。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人應該敢於闖出自己的道路，但不能把魯莽當成勇氣。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén yīnggāi gǎnyú chuǎng chū zìjǐ de dàolù, dàn bù néng bǎ lǔmǎng dàngchéng yǒngqì.
sentences.translation: Young people should dare to forge their own path, but they must not mistake recklessness for courage.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司从小城市闯入国际市场，靠的不是运气，而是持续创新。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司從小城市闖入國際市場，靠的不是運氣，而是持續創新。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī cóng xiǎo chéngshì chuǎng rù guójì shìchǎng, kào de bú shì yùnqì, ér shì chíxù chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: This company broke into the international market from a small city by relying not on luck, but on continuous innovation.

sentences.chinese: 他辞去稳定工作后，和几位同学共同创办了一家环保科技公司。
sentences.traditional: 他辭去穩定工作後，和幾位同學共同創辦了一家環保科技公司。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cíqù wěndìng gōngzuò hòu, hé jǐ wèi tóngxué gòngtóng chuàngbàn le yì jiā huánbǎo kējì gōngsī.
sentences.translation: After resigning from a stable job, he and several classmates jointly founded an environmental technology company.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校最初由当地居民捐资创办，如今已成为地区教育的核心。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校最初由當地居民捐資創辦，如今已成為地區教育的核心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào zuìchū yóu dāngdì jūmín juānzī chuàngbàn, rújīn yǐ chéngwéi dìqū jiàoyù de héxīn.
sentences.translation: This school was originally founded with donations from local residents and has now become the core of education in the area.

sentences.chinese: 创办一家企业容易，真正难的是在竞争中长期生存下来。
sentences.traditional: 創辦一家企業容易，真正難的是在競爭中長期生存下來。
sentences.pinyin: Chuàngbàn yì jiā qǐyè róngyì, zhēnzhèng nán de shì zài jìngzhēng zhōng chángqī shēngcún xiàlai.
sentences.translation: Founding a company is easy; what is truly difficult is surviving in competition over the long term.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划创建一个公开数据库，以便公众查询污染源信息。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃創建一個公開數據庫，以便公眾查詢汙染源信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà chuàngjiàn yí ge gōngkāi shùjùkù, yǐbiàn gōngzhòng cháxún wūrǎnyuán xìnxī.
sentences.translation: The government plans to create a public database so that the public can check information about sources of pollution.

sentences.chinese: 这个团队创建的模型能够预测市场需求的长期变化。
sentences.traditional: 這個團隊創建的模型能夠預測市場需求的長期變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì chuàngjiàn de móxíng nénggòu yùcè shìchǎng xūqiú de chángqī biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The model created by this team can predict long-term changes in market demand.

sentences.chinese: 创建信任需要时间，而破坏信任往往只需一次失误。
sentences.traditional: 創建信任需要時間，而破壞信任往往只需一次失誤。
sentences.pinyin: Chuàngjiàn xìnrèn xūyào shíjiān, ér pòhuài xìnrèn wǎngwǎng zhǐ xū yí cì shīwù.
sentences.translation: Creating trust takes time, whereas destroying it often requires only one mistake.

sentences.chinese: 这位学者创立的理论改变了人们对城市发展的理解。
sentences.traditional: 這位學者創立的理論改變了人們對城市發展的理解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuézhě chuànglì de lǐlùn gǎibiàn le rénmen duì chéngshì fāzhǎn de lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: The theory founded by this scholar changed people’s understanding of urban development.

sentences.chinese: 创立品牌时，企业必须先明确自己想解决什么问题。
sentences.traditional: 創立品牌時，企業必須先明確自己想解決什麼問題。
sentences.pinyin: Chuànglì pǐnpái shí, qǐyè bìxū xiān míngquè zìjǐ xiǎng jiějué shénme wèntí.
sentences.translation: When establishing a brand, a company must first clarify what problem it wants to solve.

sentences.chinese: 他们并不满足于复制现有模式，而是希望创立一套新的合作机制。
sentences.traditional: 他們並不滿足於複製現有模式，而是希望創立一套新的合作機制。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bìng bù mǎnzú yú fùzhì xiànyǒu móshì, ér shì xīwàng chuànglì yí tào xīn de hézuò jīzhì.
sentences.translation: They are not content with copying existing models; instead, they hope to establish a new mechanism for cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 这个广告的创意并不复杂，却准确抓住了年轻人的心理。
sentences.traditional: 這個廣告的創意並不複雜，卻準確抓住了年輕人的心理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guǎnggào de chuàngyì bìng bù fùzá, què zhǔnquè zhuā zhù le niánqīng rén de xīnlǐ.
sentences.translation: The idea behind this advertisement is not complicated, but it accurately captures the psychology of young people.

sentences.chinese: 一项好的创意如果缺乏执行力，也很难转化为真正的产品。
sentences.traditional: 一項好的創意如果缺乏執行力，也很難轉化為真正的產品。
sentences.pinyin: Yí xiàng hǎo de chuàngyì rúguǒ quēfá zhíxínglì, yě hěn nán zhuǎnhuà wéi zhēnzhèng de chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: A good creative idea is still difficult to turn into a real product if it lacks execution.

sentences.chinese: 公司鼓励员工提出创意方案，而不是只按旧流程办事。
sentences.traditional: 公司鼓勵員工提出創意方案，而不是只按舊流程辦事。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gǔlì yuángōng tíchū chuàngyì fāng'àn, ér bú shì zhǐ àn jiù liúchéng bànshì.
sentences.translation: The company encourages employees to propose creative plans rather than merely follow old procedures.

sentences.chinese: 这条线必须与地面保持垂直，否则测量结果会出现偏差。
sentences.traditional: 這條線必須與地面保持垂直，否則測量結果會出現偏差。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàn bìxū yǔ dìmiàn bǎochí chuízhí, fǒuzé cèliáng jiéguǒ huì chūxiàn piānchā.
sentences.translation: This line must remain vertical to the ground; otherwise, the measurement results will deviate.

sentences.chinese: 电梯把人员在不同楼层之间垂直运送，大大提高了建筑的使用效率。
sentences.traditional: 電梯把人員在不同樓層之間垂直運送，大大提高了建築的使用效率。
sentences.pinyin: Diàntī bǎ rényuán zài bùtóng lóucéng zhījiān chuízhí yùnsòng, dàdà tígāo le jiànzhù de shǐyòng xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Lifts transport people vertically between different floors, greatly improving the building’s efficiency of use.

sentences.chinese: 在这张图中，蓝色箭头代表垂直方向的压力变化。
sentences.traditional: 在這張圖中，藍色箭頭代表垂直方向的壓力變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhāng tú zhōng, lánsè jiàntóu dàibiǎo chuízhí fāngxiàng de yālì biànhuà.
sentences.translation: In this diagram, the blue arrow represents changes in pressure in the vertical direction.

sentences.chinese: 这件衬衫是纯棉的，穿起来比化纤材料更舒服。
sentences.traditional: 這件襯衫是純棉的，穿起來比化纖材料更舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chènshān shì chúnmián de, chuān qǐlai bǐ huàxiān cáiliào gèng shūfu.
sentences.translation: This shirt is pure cotton, so it feels more comfortable than synthetic fibre materials.

sentences.chinese: 他的动机很纯，并没有借项目谋取私人利益。
sentences.traditional: 他的動機很純，並沒有藉項目謀取私人利益。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de dòngjī hěn chún, bìng méiyǒu jiè xiàngmù móuqǔ sīrén lìyì.
sentences.translation: His motives are pure; he did not use the project to seek personal gain.

sentences.chinese: 这并非纯技术问题，还涉及管理制度和公众信任。
sentences.traditional: 這並非純技術問題，還涉及管理制度和公眾信任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bìng fēi chún jìshù wèntí, hái shèjí guǎnlǐ zhìdù hé gōngzhòng xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: This is not a purely technical issue; it also involves management systems and public trust.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展出的那批瓷器保存完好，釉色至今仍十分鲜亮。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展出的那批瓷器保存完好，釉色至今仍十分鮮亮。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū de nà pī cíqì bǎocún wánhǎo, yòusè zhìjīn réng shífēn xiānliàng.
sentences.translation: The porcelain pieces exhibited by the museum are well preserved, and their glaze remains very bright to this day.

sentences.chinese: 运输瓷器时，包装稍有疏忽就可能造成无法修复的裂痕。
sentences.traditional: 運輸瓷器時，包裝稍有疏忽就可能造成無法修復的裂痕。
sentences.pinyin: Yùnshū cíqì shí, bāozhuāng shāo yǒu shūhu jiù kěnéng zàochéng wúfǎ xiūfù de lièhén.
sentences.translation: When transporting porcelain, even slight carelessness in packaging may cause cracks that cannot be repaired.

sentences.chinese: 这件瓷器不仅是生活用品，也反映了当时的审美和工艺水平。
sentences.traditional: 這件瓷器不僅是生活用品，也反映了當時的審美和工藝水平。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn cíqì bùjǐn shì shēnghuó yòngpǐn, yě fǎnyìng le dāngshí de shěnměi hé gōngyì shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: This piece of porcelain is not only a daily object, but also reflects the aesthetics and craftsmanship of its time.

sentences.chinese: 此刻最重要的不是追究责任，而是尽快把被困人员救出来。
sentences.traditional: 此刻最重要的不是追究責任，而是盡快把被困人員救出來。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐkè zuì zhòngyào de bú shì zhuījiū zérèn, ér shì jǐnkuài bǎ bèi kùn rényuán jiù chūlai.
sentences.translation: At this moment, the most important thing is not to assign blame, but to rescue the trapped people as quickly as possible.

sentences.chinese: 他站在领奖台上，此刻才真正意识到多年努力没有白费。
sentences.traditional: 他站在領獎臺上，此刻才真正意識到多年努力沒有白費。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài lǐngjiǎngtái shàng, cǐkè cái zhēnzhèng yìshí dào duōnián nǔlì méiyǒu báifèi.
sentences.translation: Standing on the podium, only at this moment did he truly realise that his years of effort had not been wasted.

sentences.chinese: 此刻的沉默并不代表同意，反而可能隐藏着更深的不满。
sentences.traditional: 此刻的沉默並不代表同意，反而可能隱藏著更深的不滿。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐkè de chénmò bìng bù dàibiǎo tóngyì, fǎn'ér kěnéng yǐncáng zhe gèng shēn de bùmǎn.
sentences.translation: The silence at this moment does not mean agreement; on the contrary, it may hide deeper dissatisfaction.

sentences.chinese: 玫瑰枝上的刺很锋利，修剪时最好戴上厚手套。
sentences.traditional: 玫瑰枝上的刺很鋒利，修剪時最好戴上厚手套。
sentences.pinyin: Méiguī zhī shàng de cì hěn fēnglì, xiūjiǎn shí zuì hǎo dài shàng hòu shǒutào.
sentences.translation: The thorns on the rose branches are sharp, so it is best to wear thick gloves when pruning them.

sentences.chinese: 他的话像一根刺，虽然说得轻，却让对方久久不能释怀。
sentences.traditional: 他的話像一根刺，雖然說得輕，卻讓對方久久不能釋懷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huà xiàng yì gēn cì, suīrán shuō de qīng, què ràng duìfāng jiǔjiǔ bù néng shìhuái.
sentences.translation: His words were like a thorn; although spoken lightly, they left the other person unable to let go for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 医生用针轻轻刺破皮肤，取了一点血样用于检测。
sentences.traditional: 醫生用針輕輕刺破皮膚，取了一點血樣用於檢測。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng yòng zhēn qīngqīng cì pò pífū, qǔ le yì diǎn xuèyàng yòngyú jiǎncè.
sentences.translation: The doctor gently pricked the skin with a needle and took a small blood sample for testing.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证数据可靠，研究团队把每次实验的次数控制在同一范围内。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證數據可靠，研究團隊把每次實驗的次數控制在同一範圍內。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng shùjù kěkào, yánjiū tuánduì bǎ měi cì shíyàn de cìshù kòngzhì zài tóng yī fànwéi nèi.
sentences.translation: To ensure the data was reliable, the research team kept the number of repetitions for each experiment within the same range.

sentences.chinese: 这类错误出现的次数虽然不多，却足以影响最终结论。
sentences.traditional: 這類錯誤出現的次數雖然不多，卻足以影響最終結論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lèi cuòwù chūxiàn de cìshù suīrán bù duō, què zúyǐ yǐngxiǎng zuìzhōng jiélùn.
sentences.translation: Although this type of error does not occur often, it is enough to affect the final conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 系统会自动记录用户登录的次数，以便分析使用习惯。
sentences.traditional: 系統會自動記錄用戶登錄的次數，以便分析使用習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng jìlù yònghù dēnglù de cìshù, yǐbiàn fēnxī shǐyòng xíguàn.
sentences.translation: The system automatically records the number of times users log in so that usage habits can be analysed.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，他匆匆收起资料，赶去参加下一场谈判。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，他匆匆收起資料，趕去參加下一場談判。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, tā cōngcōng shōu qǐ zīliào, gǎn qù cānjiā xià yì chǎng tánpàn.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, he hurriedly gathered up the documents and rushed to the next negotiation.

sentences.chinese: 她匆匆作出的决定后来被证明缺乏充分依据。
sentences.traditional: 她匆匆作出的決定後來被證明缺乏充分依據。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cōngcōng zuòchū de juédìng hòulái bèi zhèngmíng quēfá chōngfèn yījù.
sentences.translation: The decision she made in haste was later shown to lack sufficient basis.

sentences.chinese: 那封信写得太匆匆，连最关键的日期都漏掉了。
sentences.traditional: 那封信寫得太匆匆，連最關鍵的日期都漏掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà fēng xìn xiě de tài cōngcōng, lián zuì guānjiàn de rìqī dōu lòudiào le.
sentences.translation: That letter was written too hastily; even the most crucial date was left out.

sentences.chinese: 由于准备得过于匆忙，发布会上出现了几处技术失误。
sentences.traditional: 由於準備得過於匆忙，發布會上出現了幾處技術失誤。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zhǔnbèi de guòyú cōngmáng, fābùhuì shàng chūxiàn le jǐ chù jìshù shīwù.
sentences.translation: Because the preparation was too rushed, several technical mistakes occurred at the press conference.

sentences.chinese: 在匆忙之间签下合同，往往会埋下法律风险。
sentences.traditional: 在匆忙之間簽下合同，往往會埋下法律風險。
sentences.pinyin: Zài cōngmáng zhījiān qiān xià hétong, wǎngwǎng huì mái xià fǎlǜ fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Signing a contract in a rush often plants hidden legal risks.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然神色匆忙，却仍然耐心回答了记者的追问。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然神色匆忙，卻仍然耐心回答了記者的追問。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán shénsè cōngmáng, què réngrán nàixīn huídá le jìzhě de zhuīwèn.
sentences.translation: Although he looked hurried, he still answered the reporter’s follow-up questions patiently.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司从未公开承认过产品存在设计缺陷。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司從未公開承認過產品存在設計缺陷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī cóngwèi gōngkāi chéngrèn guò chǎnpǐn cúnzài shèjì quēxiàn.
sentences.translation: This company has never publicly admitted that the product has design flaws.

sentences.chinese: 他从未把个人荣誉看得比团队利益更重要。
sentences.traditional: 他從未把個人榮譽看得比團隊利益更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóngwèi bǎ gèrén róngyù kàn de bǐ tuánduì lìyì gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: He has never regarded personal honour as more important than the interests of the team.

sentences.chinese: 尽管经历了多次失败，她从未放弃继续研究的念头。
sentences.traditional: 儘管經歷了多次失敗，她從未放棄繼續研究的念頭。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jīnglì le duō cì shībài, tā cóngwèi fàngqì jìxù yánjiū de niàntou.
sentences.translation: Despite experiencing repeated failures, she never gave up the idea of continuing her research.

sentences.chinese: 医疗行业要求从业人员持续更新知识，否则很难应对新的挑战。
sentences.traditional: 醫療行業要求從業人員持續更新知識，否則很難應對新的挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Yīliáo hángyè yāoqiú cóngyè rényuán chíxù gēngxīn zhīshi, fǒuzé hěn nán yìngduì xīn de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: The medical profession requires practitioners to keep updating their knowledge; otherwise it is hard to respond to new challenges.

sentences.chinese: 他大学毕业后一直从业于金融领域，对风险控制十分熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 他大學畢業後一直從業於金融領域，對風險控制十分熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè hòu yìzhí cóngyè yú jīnróng lǐngyù, duì fēngxiǎn kòngzhì shífēn shúxī.
sentences.translation: After graduating from university, he has worked in the financial sector and is very familiar with risk control.

sentences.chinese: 平台应当为自由从业者提供更清晰的保障机制。
sentences.traditional: 平臺應當為自由從業者提供更清晰的保障機制。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái yīngdāng wèi zìyóu cóngyè zhě tígōng gèng qīngxī de bǎozhàng jīzhì.
sentences.translation: Platforms should provide clearer protection mechanisms for freelancers.

sentences.chinese: 这道凉菜只要加一点醋，味道就会立刻清爽许多。
sentences.traditional: 這道涼菜只要加一點醋，味道就會立刻清爽許多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào liángcài zhǐyào jiā yìdiǎn cù, wèidào jiù huì lìkè qīngshuǎng xǔduō.
sentences.translation: As long as a little vinegar is added to this cold dish, the taste immediately becomes much fresher.

sentences.chinese: 他不小心把醋洒在桌布上，酸味很快散开了。
sentences.traditional: 他不小心把醋灑在桌布上，酸味很快散開了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bǎ cù sǎ zài zhuōbù shàng, suānwèi hěn kuài sànkāi le.
sentences.translation: He accidentally spilt vinegar on the tablecloth, and the sour smell quickly spread.

sentences.chinese: 在这家老店里，醋是许多传统菜式不可缺少的调味品。
sentences.traditional: 在這家老店裡，醋是許多傳統菜式不可缺少的調味品。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā lǎo diàn lǐ, cù shì xǔduō chuántǒng càishì bùkě quēshǎo de tiáowèipǐn.
sentences.translation: In this old restaurant, vinegar is an essential seasoning for many traditional dishes.

sentences.chinese: 这块饼干受潮以后不再脆，口感明显差了许多。
sentences.traditional: 這塊餅乾受潮以後不再脆，口感明顯差了許多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài bǐnggān shòucháo yǐhòu bú zài cuì, kǒugǎn míngxiǎn chà le xǔduō.
sentences.translation: After this biscuit became damp, it was no longer crisp, and the texture was noticeably much worse.

sentences.chinese: 这种玻璃虽然透光性好，但质地太脆，运输时必须格外小心。
sentences.traditional: 這種玻璃雖然透光性好，但質地太脆，運輸時必須格外小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bōli suīrán tòuguāngxìng hǎo, dàn zhìdì tài cuì, yùnshū shí bìxū géwài xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: Although this type of glass has good light transmission, it is too brittle, so it must be transported with particular care.

sentences.chinese: 秋天的苹果又甜又脆，很受当地游客欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 秋天的蘋果又甜又脆，很受當地遊客歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān de píngguǒ yòu tián yòu cuì, hěn shòu dāngdì yóukè huānyíng.
sentences.translation: Autumn apples are both sweet and crisp, and are very popular with local tourists.

sentences.chinese: 在连续的冲击下，原本脆弱的供应链几乎陷入停顿。
sentences.traditional: 在連續的衝擊下，原本脆弱的供應鏈幾乎陷入停頓。
sentences.pinyin: Zài liánxù de chōngjī xià, yuánběn cuìruò de gōngyìngliàn jīhū xiànrù tíngdùn.
sentences.translation: Under repeated shocks, the originally fragile supply chain almost came to a standstill.

sentences.chinese: 儿童的心理有时比成年人想象的更脆弱，需要细心引导。
sentences.traditional: 兒童的心理有時比成年人想像的更脆弱，需要細心引導。
sentences.pinyin: Értóng de xīnlǐ yǒushí bǐ chéngniánrén xiǎngxiàng de gèng cuìruò, xūyào xìxīn yǐndǎo.
sentences.translation: Children’s psychology is sometimes more fragile than adults imagine and needs careful guidance.

sentences.chinese: 如果制度过于依赖个人能力，整个组织就会变得脆弱。
sentences.traditional: 如果制度過於依賴個人能力，整個組織就會變得脆弱。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhìdù guòyú yīlài gèrén nénglì, zhěnggè zǔzhī jiù huì biàn de cuìruò.
sentences.translation: If a system relies too heavily on individual ability, the whole organisation becomes fragile.

sentences.chinese: 地震过后，救援队首先赶往交通最不便的村庄。
sentences.traditional: 地震過後，救援隊首先趕往交通最不便的村莊。
sentences.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu, jiùyuán duì shǒuxiān gǎnwǎng jiāotōng zuì bù fāngbiàn de cūnzhuāng.
sentences.translation: After the earthquake, the rescue team first headed to the village with the most inconvenient transport links.

sentences.chinese: 这个村庄依山而建，至今仍保留着许多传统习俗。
sentences.traditional: 這個村莊依山而建，至今仍保留著許多傳統習俗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cūnzhuāng yī shān ér jiàn, zhìjīn réng bǎoliú zhe xǔduō chuántǒng xísú.
sentences.translation: This village is built against the mountain and still preserves many traditional customs.

sentences.chinese: 随着年轻人不断外出工作，村庄的人口结构发生了明显变化。
sentences.traditional: 隨著年輕人不斷外出工作，村莊的人口結構發生了明顯變化。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe niánqīngrén búduàn wàichū gōngzuò, cūnzhuāng de rénkǒu jiégòu fāshēng le míngxiǎn biànhuà.
sentences.translation: As young people keep leaving to work elsewhere, the population structure of the village has changed noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 为了防止资料丢失，公司把重要文件同时存储在本地和云端。
sentences.traditional: 為了防止資料丟失，公司把重要文件同時存儲在本地和雲端。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ zīliào diūshī, gōngsī bǎ zhòngyào wénjiàn tóngshí cúnchǔ zài běndì hé yúnduān.
sentences.translation: To prevent data loss, the company stores important files both locally and in the cloud.

sentences.chinese: 这种设备体积不大，却能够存储大量高清影像。
sentences.traditional: 這種設備體積不大，卻能夠存儲大量高清影像。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shèbèi tǐjī bú dà, què nénggòu cúnchǔ dàliàng gāoqīng yǐngxiàng.
sentences.translation: This device is not large, yet it can store a large amount of high-definition footage.

sentences.chinese: 系统会定期清理临时数据，以免存储空间被迅速占满。
sentences.traditional: 系統會定期清理臨時數據，以免存儲空間被迅速佔滿。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì dìngqī qīnglǐ línshí shùjù, yǐmiǎn cúnchǔ kōngjiān bèi xùnsù zhànmǎn.
sentences.translation: The system regularly clears temporary data so that storage space is not quickly filled up.

sentences.chinese: 这块屏幕只比旧款宽了半寸，使用体验却明显改善。
sentences.traditional: 這塊屏幕只比舊款寬了半寸，使用體驗卻明顯改善。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài píngmù zhǐ bǐ jiùkuǎn kuān le bàn cùn, shǐyòng tǐyàn què míngxiǎn gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: This screen is only half a cun wider than the old model, yet the user experience has clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 老木匠说，差一寸都可能影响整扇门的稳定性。
sentences.traditional: 老木匠說，差一寸都可能影響整扇門的穩定性。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo mùjiàng shuō, chà yí cùn dōu kěnéng yǐngxiǎng zhěng shàn mén de wěndìngxìng.
sentences.translation: The old carpenter said that even being one cun off could affect the stability of the whole door.

sentences.chinese: 在古代，寸既是长度单位，也常被用来形容极短的距离。
sentences.traditional: 在古代，寸既是長度單位，也常被用來形容極短的距離。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, cùn jì shì chángdù dānwèi, yě cháng bèi yòng lái xíngróng jí duǎn de jùlí.
sentences.translation: In ancient times, cun was both a unit of length and often used to describe a very short distance.

sentences.chinese: 一次挫折并不足以决定项目的最终命运。
sentences.traditional: 一次挫折並不足以決定項目的最終命運。
sentences.pinyin: Yí cì cuòzhé bìng bù zúyǐ juédìng xiàngmù de zuìzhōng mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: A single setback is not enough to decide the project’s eventual fate.

sentences.chinese: 长期的挫折使他重新思考自己的研究方向。
sentences.traditional: 長期的挫折使他重新思考自己的研究方向。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī de cuòzhé shǐ tā chóngxīn sīkǎo zìjǐ de yánjiū fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: Long-term setbacks made him rethink the direction of his research.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革虽然遭遇了许多挫折，但并没有因此停止。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革雖然遭遇了許多挫折，但並沒有因此停止。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé suīrán zāoyù le xǔduō cuòzhé, dàn bìng méiyǒu yīncǐ tíngzhǐ.
sentences.translation: Although this reform encountered many setbacks, it did not stop because of them.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者在体育馆里迅速搭起了临时救助站。
sentences.traditional: 志願者在體育館裡迅速搭起了臨時救助站。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě zài tǐyùguǎn lǐ xùnsù dā qǐ le línshí jiùzhùzhàn.
sentences.translation: The volunteers quickly set up a temporary aid station inside the sports hall.

sentences.chinese: 施工队先搭好脚手架，才开始修复外墙。
sentences.traditional: 施工隊先搭好腳手架，才開始修復外牆。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōng duì xiān dā hǎo jiǎoshǒujià, cái kāishǐ xiūfù wàiqiáng.
sentences.translation: The construction team first set up the scaffolding, and only then began repairing the outer wall.

sentences.chinese: 为了节省成本，公司决定与当地机构搭建共享平台。
sentences.traditional: 為了節省成本，公司決定與當地機構搭建共享平臺。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng chéngběn, gōngsī juédìng yǔ dāngdì jīgòu dājiàn gòngxiǎng píngtái.
sentences.translation: To save costs, the company decided to build a shared platform with local organisations.

sentences.chinese: 这套课程把理论讲解和实践训练搭配得很合理。
sentences.traditional: 這套課程把理論講解和實踐訓練搭配得很合理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào kèchéng bǎ lǐlùn jiǎngjiě hé shíjiàn xùnliàn dāpèi de hěn hélǐ.
sentences.translation: This course matches theoretical explanation with practical training very reasonably.

sentences.chinese: 颜色搭配过于复杂，反而削弱了海报的视觉重点。
sentences.traditional: 顏色搭配過於複雜，反而削弱了海報的視覺重點。
sentences.pinyin: Yánsè dāpèi guòyú fùzá, fǎn'ér xuēruò le hǎibào de shìjué zhòngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The colour matching is too complicated, which instead weakens the poster’s visual focus.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他注意饮食搭配，而不是单纯减少饭量。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他注意飲食搭配，而不是單純減少飯量。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā zhùyì yǐnshí dāpèi, ér bú shì dānchún jiǎnshǎo fànliàng.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to pay attention to dietary balance rather than simply reducing how much he eats.

sentences.chinese: 对方承诺会在三个工作日内给出正式答复。
sentences.traditional: 對方承諾會在三個工作日內給出正式答覆。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng chéngnuò huì zài sān ge gōngzuòrì nèi gěi chū zhèngshì dáfù.
sentences.translation: The other party promised to give a formal reply within three working days.

sentences.chinese: 面对记者的追问，发言人始终没有正面答复。
sentences.traditional: 面對記者的追問，發言人始終沒有正面答覆。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jìzhě de zhuīwèn, fāyánrén shǐzhōng méiyǒu zhèngmiàn dáfù.
sentences.translation: Faced with the reporter’s repeated questions, the spokesperson never gave a direct reply.

sentences.chinese: 这封邮件只是临时答复，具体方案还需进一步讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這封郵件只是臨時答覆，具體方案還需進一步討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng yóujiàn zhǐ shì línshí dáfù, jùtǐ fāng'àn hái xū jìnyí bù tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This email is only a temporary reply; the specific plan still needs further discussion.

sentences.chinese: 他长期和供应商打交道，特别了解行业里的潜规则。
sentences.traditional: 他長期和供應商打交道，特別了解行業裡的潛規則。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángqī hé gōngyìngshāng dǎ jiāodao, tèbié liǎojiě hángyè lǐ de qiánguīzé.
sentences.translation: He has dealt with suppliers for a long time and understands the industry’s hidden rules particularly well.

sentences.chinese: 与不同背景的人打交道，需要耐心，也需要边界感。
sentences.traditional: 與不同背景的人打交道，需要耐心，也需要邊界感。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ bùtóng bèijǐng de rén dǎ jiāodao, xūyào nàixīn, yě xūyào biānjiègǎn.
sentences.translation: Dealing with people from different backgrounds requires patience as well as a sense of boundaries.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作看似轻松，其实每天都要和复杂的数据系统打交道。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作看似輕鬆，其實每天都要和複雜的數據系統打交道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò kànsì qīngsōng, qíshí měitiān dōu yào hé fùzá de shùjù xìtǒng dǎ jiāodao.
sentences.translation: This job seems relaxed, but in fact every day involves dealing with complex data systems.

sentences.chinese: 真正打动观众的不是华丽的场面，而是人物之间的情感。
sentences.traditional: 真正打動觀眾的不是華麗的場面，而是人物之間的情感。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng dǎdòng guānzhòng de bú shì huálì de chǎngmiàn, ér shì rénwù zhījiān de qínggǎn.
sentences.translation: What truly moves the audience is not the magnificent spectacle, but the emotions between the characters.

sentences.chinese: 他的演讲虽然简短，却深深打动了在场的每一个人。
sentences.traditional: 他的演講雖然簡短，卻深深打動了在場的每一個人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng suīrán jiǎnduǎn, què shēnshēn dǎdòng le zàichǎng de měi yí ge rén.
sentences.translation: Although his speech was brief, it deeply moved everyone present.

sentences.chinese: 如果一个故事无法打动人心，再复杂的技巧也只是装饰。
sentences.traditional: 如果一個故事無法打動人心，再複雜的技巧也只是裝飾。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yí ge gùshì wúfǎ dǎdòng rénxīn, zài fùzá de jìqiǎo yě zhǐ shì zhuāngshì.
sentences.translation: If a story cannot move people, even the most complex techniques are merely decoration.

sentences.chinese: 连续降价对小型商家的利润造成了明显打击。
sentences.traditional: 連續降價對小型商家的利潤造成了明顯打擊。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jiàngjià duì xiǎoxíng shāngjiā de lìrùn zàochéng le míngxiǎn dǎjī.
sentences.translation: Repeated price cuts caused an obvious blow to the profits of small businesses.

sentences.chinese: 政府加大执法力度，重点打击网络诈骗和非法集资。
sentences.traditional: 政府加大執法力度，重點打擊網絡詐騙和非法集資。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiādà zhífǎ lìdù, zhòngdiǎn dǎjī wǎngluò zhàpiàn hé fēifǎ jízī.
sentences.translation: The government has strengthened law enforcement, focusing on cracking down on online fraud and illegal fundraising.

sentences.chinese: 批评应当帮助学生进步，而不应只是打击他们的自信。
sentences.traditional: 批評應當幫助學生進步，而不應只是打擊他們的自信。
sentences.pinyin: Pīpíng yīngdāng bāngzhù xuéshēng jìnbù, ér bù yīng zhǐ shì dǎjī tāmen de zìxìn.
sentences.translation: Criticism should help students improve, not merely damage their confidence.

sentences.chinese: 两名乘客因为座位问题在车厢里打架，导致列车临时停靠。
sentences.traditional: 兩名乘客因為座位問題在車廂裡打架，導致列車臨時停靠。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng míng chéngkè yīnwèi zuòwèi wèntí zài chēxiāng lǐ dǎjià, dǎozhì lièchē línshí tíngkào.
sentences.translation: Two passengers fought in the carriage over a seating issue, causing the train to stop temporarily.

sentences.chinese: 学校不仅处罚打架的学生，还安排他们接受心理辅导。
sentences.traditional: 學校不僅處罰打架的學生，還安排他們接受心理輔導。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bùjǐn chǔfá dǎjià de xuéshēng, hái ānpái tāmen jiēshòu xīnlǐ fǔdǎo.
sentences.translation: The school not only punished the students who fought, but also arranged for them to receive counselling.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候经常打架，后来才明白沟通比拳头更有力量。
sentences.traditional: 他小時候經常打架，後來才明白溝通比拳頭更有力量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou jīngcháng dǎjià, hòulái cái míngbai gōutōng bǐ quántou gèng yǒu lìliàng.
sentences.translation: He often fought when he was young; only later did he realise that communication is more powerful than fists.

sentences.chinese: 公司改用手机打卡后，外勤人员的考勤记录更准确了。
sentences.traditional: 公司改用手機打卡後，外勤人員的考勤記錄更準確了。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gǎi yòng shǒujī dǎkǎ hòu, wàiqín rényuán de kǎoqín jìlù gèng zhǔnquè le.
sentences.translation: After the company switched to mobile clock-ins, the attendance records for field staff became more accurate.

sentences.chinese: 这家书店因为设计独特，成了年轻人周末打卡的热门地点。
sentences.traditional: 這家書店因為設計獨特，成了年輕人週末打卡的熱門地點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā shūdiàn yīnwèi shèjì dútè, chéng le niánqīngrén zhōumò dǎkǎ de rèmén dìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Because of its distinctive design, this bookshop has become a popular weekend check-in spot for young people.

sentences.chinese: 他坚持每天学习后打卡，用公开记录来督促自己。
sentences.traditional: 他堅持每天學習後打卡，用公開記錄來督促自己。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiānchí měitiān xuéxí hòu dǎkǎ, yòng gōngkāi jìlù lái dūcù zìjǐ.
sentences.translation: He insists on checking in after studying every day, using public records to keep himself disciplined.

sentences.chinese: 昨晚打雷时，整栋楼的孩子都被惊醒了。
sentences.traditional: 昨晚打雷時，整棟樓的孩子都被驚醒了。
sentences.pinyin: Zuówǎn dǎléi shí, zhěng dòng lóu de háizi dōu bèi jīngxǐng le.
sentences.translation: During the thunder last night, all the children in the building were woken up.

sentences.chinese: 在山区露营时，一旦开始打雷，就应立即远离高处和水边。
sentences.traditional: 在山區露營時，一旦開始打雷，就應立即遠離高處和水邊。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shānqū lùyíng shí, yídàn kāishǐ dǎléi, jiù yīng lìjí yuǎnlí gāochù hé shuǐbiān.
sentences.translation: When camping in the mountains, once it starts thundering, you should immediately stay away from high places and the water’s edge.

sentences.chinese: 天气预报说下午可能打雷，所以航班提前调整了起飞时间。
sentences.traditional: 天氣預報說下午可能打雷，所以航班提前調整了起飛時間。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō xiàwǔ kěnéng dǎléi, suǒyǐ hángbān tíqián tiáozhěng le qǐfēi shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The weather forecast said there may be thunder this afternoon, so the flight’s departure time was adjusted in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司希望通过长期投入，打造一个面向年轻用户的学习平台。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司希望通過長期投入，打造一個面向年輕用戶的學習平臺。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī xīwàng tōngguò chángqī tóurù, dǎzào yí ge miànxiàng niánqīng yònghù de xuéxí píngtái.
sentences.translation: The company hopes to create a learning platform for young users through long-term investment.

sentences.chinese: 城市更新不只是修路建楼，更是打造居民愿意停留的公共空间。
sentences.traditional: 城市更新不只是修路建樓，更是打造居民願意停留的公共空間。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì gēngxīn bù zhǐ shì xiūlù jiàn lóu, gèng shì dǎzào jūmín yuànyì tíngliú de gōnggòng kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: Urban renewal is not just about repairing roads and constructing buildings; it is also about creating public spaces where residents want to stay.

sentences.chinese: 为了打造可信的品牌形象，企业必须在售后服务上保持稳定。
sentences.traditional: 為了打造可信的品牌形象，企業必須在售後服務上保持穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile dǎzào kěxìn de pǐnpái xíngxiàng, qǐyè bìxū zài shòuhòu fúwù shàng bǎochí wěndìng.
sentences.translation: To build a trustworthy brand image, a company must maintain consistency in its after-sales service.

sentences.chinese: 普通百姓最害怕的不是贫困，而是两个国家突然打仗。
sentences.traditional: 普通百姓最害怕的不是貧困，而是兩個國家突然打仗。
sentences.pinyin: Pǔtōng bǎixìng zuì hàipà de bú shì pínkùn, ér shì liǎng ge guójiā tūrán dǎzhàng.
sentences.translation: What ordinary people fear most is not poverty, but two countries suddenly going to war.

sentences.chinese: 历史课讨论的不只是哪些王朝打仗，还包括战争背后的经济原因。
sentences.traditional: 歷史課討論的不只是哪些王朝打仗，還包括戰爭背後的經濟原因。
sentences.pinyin: Lìshǐ kè tǎolùn de bù zhǐ shì nǎxiē wángcháo dǎzhàng, hái bāokuò zhànzhēng bèihòu de jīngjì yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The history class discussed not only which dynasties fought wars, but also the economic causes behind them.

sentences.chinese: 如果双方都把谈判看作软弱，冲突迟早会发展到打仗的地步。
sentences.traditional: 如果雙方都把談判看作軟弱，衝突遲早會發展到打仗的地步。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shuāngfāng dōu bǎ tánpàn kànzuò ruǎnruò, chōngtū chízǎo huì fāzhǎn dào dǎzhàng de dìbù.
sentences.translation: If both sides see negotiation as weakness, the conflict will sooner or later develop into war.

sentences.chinese: 那位大臣表面上支持改革，实际上却一直在拖延执行。
sentences.traditional: 那位大臣表面上支持改革，實際上卻一直在拖延執行。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi dàchén biǎomiàn shàng zhīchí gǎigé, shíjì shàng què yìzhí zài tuōyán zhíxíng.
sentences.translation: That minister publicly supports reform, but in reality has been delaying its implementation.

sentences.chinese: 皇帝听完几位大臣的意见后，决定暂时不增税。
sentences.traditional: 皇帝聽完幾位大臣的意見後，決定暫時不增稅。
sentences.pinyin: Huángdì tīng wán jǐ wèi dàchén de yìjiàn hòu, juédìng zànshí bù zēngshuì.
sentences.translation: After listening to the opinions of several ministers, the emperor decided not to raise taxes for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 在古代政治中，大臣的忠诚往往关系到整个朝廷的稳定。
sentences.traditional: 在古代政治中，大臣的忠誠往往關係到整個朝廷的穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài zhèngzhì zhōng, dàchén de zhōngchéng wǎngwǎng guānxì dào zhěnggè cháotíng de wěndìng.
sentences.translation: In ancient politics, a minister’s loyalty was often connected to the stability of the whole court.

sentences.chinese: 看到原本亏损的项目突然盈利，董事会成员都大吃一惊。
sentences.traditional: 看到原本虧損的項目突然盈利，董事會成員都大吃一驚。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào yuánběn kuīsǔn de xiàngmù tūrán yínglì, dǒngshìhuì chéngyuán dōu dà chī yì jīng.
sentences.translation: Seeing the project that had originally been losing money suddenly become profitable, the board members were all greatly surprised.

sentences.chinese: 她平时很少表露情绪，这次听到消息却大吃一惊。
sentences.traditional: 她平時很少表露情緒，這次聽到消息卻大吃一驚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píngshí hěn shǎo biǎolù qíngxù, zhè cì tīngdào xiāoxi què dà chī yì jīng.
sentences.translation: She rarely shows emotion, but this time she was greatly surprised when she heard the news.

sentences.chinese: 调查结果公布后，许多长期关注此事的记者也大吃一惊。
sentences.traditional: 調查結果公佈後，許多長期關注此事的記者也大吃一驚。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jiéguǒ gōngbù hòu, xǔduō chángqī guānzhù cǐ shì de jìzhě yě dà chī yì jīng.
sentences.translation: After the investigation results were released, many journalists who had long followed the matter were also greatly surprised.

sentences.chinese: 春雨过后，大地像被重新唤醒一样，到处充满生机。
sentences.traditional: 春雨過後，大地像被重新喚醒一樣，到處充滿生機。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnyǔ guòhòu, dàdì xiàng bèi chóngxīn huànxǐng yíyàng, dàochù chōngmǎn shēngjī.
sentences.translation: After the spring rain, the earth seemed to have been awakened again, full of life everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 地震发生时，整个大地剧烈摇晃，居民纷纷跑到空旷地带。
sentences.traditional: 地震發生時，整個大地劇烈搖晃，居民紛紛跑到空曠地帶。
sentences.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng shí, zhěnggè dàdì jùliè yáohuàng, jūmín fēnfēn pǎo dào kōngkuàng dìdài.
sentences.translation: When the earthquake struck, the whole earth shook violently, and residents rushed to open areas.

sentences.chinese: 这首诗把大地描写成一位沉默却宽厚的母亲。
sentences.traditional: 這首詩把大地描寫成一位沉默卻寬厚的母親。
