sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī bǎ dàdì miáoxiě chéng yí wèi chénmò què kuānhòu de mǔqīn.
sentences.translation: This poem describes the earth as a silent but generous mother.

sentences.chinese: 参加培训的员工大都来自基层岗位，因此课程设计必须贴近实际。
sentences.traditional: 參加培訓的員工大都來自基層崗位，因此課程設計必須貼近實際。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā péixùn de yuángōng dàdū láizì jīcéng gǎngwèi, yīncǐ kèchéng shèjì bìxū tiējìn shíjì.
sentences.translation: Most employees attending the training are from front-line positions, so the course design must be close to reality.

sentences.chinese: 这些古籍虽然保存完好，内容大都已经不适合直接用于现代教学。
sentences.traditional: 這些古籍雖然保存完好，內容大都已經不適合直接用於現代教學。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē gǔjí suīrán bǎocún wánhǎo, nèiróng dàdū yǐjīng bù shìhé zhíjiē yòng yú xiàndài jiàoxué.
sentences.translation: Although these ancient books are well preserved, most of their content is no longer suitable for direct use in modern teaching.

sentences.chinese: 新来的住户大都选择公共交通，因为小区附近停车位非常紧张。
sentences.traditional: 新來的住戶大都選擇公共交通，因為小區附近停車位非常緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn lái de zhùhù dàdū xuǎnzé gōnggòng jiāotōng, yīnwèi xiǎoqū fùjìn tíngchēwèi fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Most of the new residents choose public transport because parking spaces near the neighbourhood are very limited.

sentences.chinese: 他在会议上发言很大方，即使面对质疑也没有显得紧张。
sentences.traditional: 他在會議上發言很大方，即使面對質疑也沒有顯得緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shàng fāyán hěn dàfang, jíshǐ miànduì zhìyí yě méiyǒu xiǎnde jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: He speaks very naturally in meetings and does not seem nervous even when facing questions.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业对公益项目一向很大方，但对内部成本控制也很严格。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業對公益項目一向很大方，但對內部成本控制也很嚴格。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè duì gōngyì xiàngmù yíxiàng hěn dàfang, dàn duì nèibù chéngběn kòngzhì yě hěn yángé.
sentences.translation: This company has always been generous towards public welfare projects, but it is also very strict about internal cost control.

sentences.chinese: 她处理奖金分配时非常大方，主动把更多机会让给年轻同事。
sentences.traditional: 她處理獎金分配時非常大方，主動把更多機會讓給年輕同事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chǔlǐ jiǎngjīn fēnpèi shí fēicháng dàfang, zhǔdòng bǎ gèng duō jīhuì ràng gěi niánqīng tóngshì.
sentences.translation: When handling the bonus allocation, she was extremely generous and took the initiative to give more opportunities to younger colleagues.

sentences.chinese: 新政策实施后，小微企业的审批时间大幅缩短。
sentences.traditional: 新政策實施後，小微企業的審批時間大幅縮短。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè shíshī hòu, xiǎowēi qǐyè de shěnpī shíjiān dàfú suōduǎn.
sentences.translation: After the new policy was implemented, approval times for small and micro enterprises were greatly reduced.

sentences.chinese: 由于原材料价格上涨，公司的利润率在一年内大幅下降。
sentences.traditional: 由於原材料價格上漲，公司的利潤率在一年內大幅下降。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng, gōngsī de lìrùnlǜ zài yì nián nèi dàfú xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: Due to rising raw material prices, the company’s profit margin fell sharply within a year.

sentences.chinese: 只要物流系统稳定下来，库存压力就会大幅减轻。
sentences.traditional: 只要物流系統穩定下來，庫存壓力就會大幅減輕。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào wùliú xìtǒng wěndìng xiàlai, kùcún yālì jiù huì dàfú jiǎnqīng.
sentences.translation: As long as the logistics system stabilises, inventory pressure will be greatly reduced.

sentences.chinese: 听说项目终于通过审核，大伙儿都松了一口气。
sentences.traditional: 聽說項目終於通過審核，大夥兒都鬆了一口氣。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàngmù zhōngyú tōngguò shěnhé, dàhuǒr dōu sōng le yì kǒu qì.
sentences.translation: Hearing that the project had finally passed review, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

sentences.chinese: 天黑以前，大伙儿把临时帐篷搭好，并检查了备用电源。
sentences.traditional: 天黑以前，大夥兒把臨時帳篷搭好，並檢查了備用電源。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān hēi yǐqián, dàhuǒr bǎ línshí zhàngpeng dā hǎo, bìng jiǎnchá le bèiyòng diànyuán.
sentences.translation: Before dark, everyone set up the temporary tents and checked the backup power supply.

sentences.chinese: 这件事不能只靠负责人推动，还需要大伙儿一起配合。
sentences.traditional: 這件事不能只靠負責人推動，還需要大夥兒一起配合。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù néng zhǐ kào fùzérén tuīdòng, hái xūyào dàhuǒr yìqǐ pèihé.
sentences.translation: This matter cannot be driven only by the person in charge; it also needs everyone to cooperate.

sentences.chinese: 新任大使在记者会上强调，两国合作不应受短期分歧影响。
sentences.traditional: 新任大使在記者會上強調，兩國合作不應受短期分歧影響。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnrèn dàshǐ zài jìzhěhuì shàng qiángdiào, liǎng guó hézuò bù yīng shòu duǎnqī fēnqí yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The newly appointed ambassador stressed at the press conference that cooperation between the two countries should not be affected by short-term differences.

sentences.chinese: 这位大使长期关注气候议题，因此熟悉国际谈判的复杂性。
sentences.traditional: 這位大使長期關注氣候議題，因此熟悉國際談判的複雜性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi dàshǐ chángqī guānzhù qìhòu yìtí, yīncǐ shúxī guójì tánpàn de fùzáxìng.
sentences.translation: This ambassador has long focused on climate issues, so is familiar with the complexity of international negotiations.

sentences.chinese: 代表团抵达后，由中国大使亲自陪同参观科技园区。
sentences.traditional: 代表團抵達後，由中國大使親自陪同參觀科技園區。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán dǐdá hòu, yóu Zhōngguó dàshǐ qīnzì péitóng cānguān kējì yuánqū.
sentences.translation: After the delegation arrived, the Chinese ambassador personally accompanied them on a visit to the technology park.

sentences.chinese: 这位建筑大师的作品既尊重传统，又体现出现代城市的精神。
sentences.traditional: 這位建築大師的作品既尊重傳統，又體現出現代城市的精神。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiànzhù dàshī de zuòpǐn jì zūnzhòng chuántǒng, yòu tǐxiàn chū xiàndài chéngshì de jīngshén.
sentences.translation: This master architect’s work both respects tradition and reflects the spirit of the modern city.

sentences.chinese: 在音乐学院，他被学生们视为真正的大师，而不是单纯的名人。
sentences.traditional: 在音樂學院，他被學生們視為真正的大師，而不是單純的名人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yīnyuè xuéyuàn, tā bèi xuéshēngmen shìwéi zhēnzhèng de dàshī, ér bú shì dānchún de míngrén.
sentences.translation: At the music academy, he is regarded by students as a true master, not merely a celebrity.

sentences.chinese: 即使已经成为行业大师，他仍然坚持每天修改自己的设计稿。
sentences.traditional: 即使已經成為行業大師，他仍然堅持每天修改自己的設計稿。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ yǐjīng chéngwéi hángyè dàshī, tā réngrán jiānchí měitiān xiūgǎi zìjǐ de shèjìgǎo.
sentences.translation: Even after becoming a master in the industry, he still insists on revising his own design drafts every day.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划把可再生能源项目推广到大洋洲的一些岛国。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃把可再生能源項目推廣到大洋洲的一些島國。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà bǎ kě zàishēng néngyuán xiàngmù tuīguǎng dào Dàyángzhōu de yìxiē dǎoguó.
sentences.translation: The company plans to expand renewable energy projects to some island countries in Oceania.

sentences.chinese: 在地理课上，老师比较了大洋洲与亚洲在人口分布上的差异。
sentences.traditional: 在地理課上，老師比較了大洋洲與亞洲在人口分佈上的差異。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ kè shàng, lǎoshī bǐjiào le Dàyángzhōu yǔ Yàzhōu zài rénkǒu fēnbù shàng de chāyì.
sentences.translation: In geography class, the teacher compared the differences in population distribution between Oceania and Asia.

sentences.chinese: 受海平面上升影响，大洋洲部分地区的生存空间正受到威胁。
sentences.traditional: 受海平面上升影響，大洋洲部分地區的生存空間正受到威脅。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu hǎipíngmiàn shàngshēng yǐngxiǎng, Dàyángzhōu bùfen dìqū de shēngcún kōngjiān zhèng shòudào wēixié.
sentences.translation: Affected by rising sea levels, living space in some parts of Oceania is being threatened.

sentences.chinese: 调查结果大致符合我们的预期，但个别地区的数据仍需核实。
sentences.traditional: 調查結果大致符合我們的預期，但個別地區的數據仍需核實。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jiéguǒ dàzhì fúhé wǒmen de yùqī, dàn gèbié dìqū de shùjù réng xū héshí.
sentences.translation: The survey results roughly meet our expectations, but the data from some individual regions still needs to be verified.

sentences.chinese: 我把会议内容大致整理了一遍，详细纪要明天再发给大家。
sentences.traditional: 我把會議內容大致整理了一遍，詳細紀要明天再發給大家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ huìyì nèiróng dàzhì zhěnglǐ le yí biàn, xiángxì jìyào míngtiān zài fā gěi dàjiā.
sentences.translation: I have roughly sorted out the meeting content once; I will send everyone the detailed minutes tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 这两种方案方向大致相同，只是在执行步骤上有所区别。
sentences.traditional: 這兩種方案方向大致相同，只是在執行步驟上有所區別。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng fāng'àn fāngxiàng dàzhì xiāngtóng, zhǐ shì zài zhíxíng bùzhòu shàng yǒu suǒ qūbié.
sentences.translation: The general direction of these two proposals is roughly the same; they differ only in their implementation steps.

sentences.chinese: 他听到这个消息后整个人都呆住了，半天说不出一句话。
sentences.traditional: 他聽到這個消息後整個人都呆住了，半天說不出一句話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxi hòu zhěng gè rén dōu dāi zhù le, bàntiān shuō bù chū yí jù huà.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news, he was completely stunned and could not say a word for quite a while.

sentences.chinese: 面对突如其来的提问，他一时发呆，忘了原本准备好的答案。
sentences.traditional: 面對突如其來的提問，他一時發呆，忘了原本準備好的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de tíwèn, tā yìshí fā dāi, wàng le yuánběn zhǔnbèi hǎo de dá'àn.
sentences.translation: Faced with the sudden question, he blanked out for a moment and forgot the answer he had prepared.

sentences.chinese: 连续加班后，他的眼神有些呆，反应也比平时慢。
sentences.traditional: 連續加班後，他的眼神有些呆，反應也比平時慢。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jiābān hòu, tā de yǎnshén yǒuxiē dāi, fǎnyìng yě bǐ píngshí màn.
sentences.translation: After working overtime for several days, his eyes looked rather dull and his reactions were slower than usual.

sentences.chinese: 由于航班延误，乘客被要求待在候机区等候进一步通知。
sentences.traditional: 由於航班延誤，乘客被要求待在候機區等候進一步通知。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú hángbān yánwù, chéngkè bèi yāoqiú dài zài hòujīqū děnghòu jìnyí bù tōngzhī.
sentences.translation: Because the flight was delayed, passengers were asked to stay in the waiting area for further notice.

sentences.chinese: 这份文件还需要领导审批，暂时不能公开，先待几天再说。
sentences.traditional: 這份文件還需要領導審批，暫時不能公開，先待幾天再說。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn hái xūyào lǐngdǎo shěnpī, zànshí bù néng gōngkāi, xiān dài jǐ tiān zài shuō.
sentences.translation: This document still needs approval from leadership and cannot be made public for now, so wait a few days before deciding.

sentences.chinese: 他宁愿待在基层积累经验，也不急着争取管理职位。
sentences.traditional: 他寧願待在基層積累經驗，也不急著爭取管理職位。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nìngyuàn dài zài jīcéng jīlěi jīngyàn, yě bù jí zhe zhēngqǔ guǎnlǐ zhíwèi.
sentences.translation: He would rather stay at the grass-roots level to gain experience than rush to seek a management position.

sentences.chinese: 企业若忽视环保，最终会付出高昂的代价。
sentences.traditional: 企業若忽視環保，最終會付出高昂的代價。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè ruò hūshì huánbǎo, zuìzhōng huì fùchū gāo'áng de dàijià.
sentences.translation: If companies ignore environmental protection, they will eventually pay a heavy price.

sentences.chinese: 为了抢占市场，他们以牺牲质量为代价换来了短期增长。
sentences.traditional: 為了搶佔市場，他們以犧牲質量為代價換來了短期增長。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile qiǎngzhàn shìchǎng, tāmen yǐ xīshēng zhìliàng wéi dàijià huàn lái le duǎnqī zēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: To seize the market, they gained short-term growth at the cost of sacrificing quality.

sentences.chinese: 任何改革都可能有代价，关键是社会能否承受并公平分担。
sentences.traditional: 任何改革都可能有代價，關鍵是社會能否承受並公平分擔。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé gǎigé dōu kěnéng yǒu dàijià, guānjiàn shì shèhuì néngfǒu chéngshòu bìng gōngpíng fēndān.
sentences.translation: Any reform may have a cost; the key is whether society can bear it and share it fairly.

sentences.chinese: 这家初创公司依靠银行贷款度过了最困难的现金流阶段。
sentences.traditional: 這家初創公司依靠銀行貸款度過了最困難的現金流階段。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā chūchuàng gōngsī yīkào yínháng dàikuǎn dùguò le zuì kùnnán de xiànjīnliú jiēduàn.
sentences.translation: This start-up relied on a bank loan to get through the most difficult cash-flow stage.

sentences.chinese: 他申请贷款之前，仔细比较了利率、期限和提前还款条件。
sentences.traditional: 他申請貸款之前，仔細比較了利率、期限和提前還款條件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēnqǐng dàikuǎn zhīqián, zǐxì bǐjiào le lìlǜ, qīxiàn hé tíqián huánkuǎn tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: Before applying for a loan, he carefully compared the interest rate, term, and early repayment conditions.

sentences.chinese: 政府为小微企业提供低息贷款，以缓解经营压力。
sentences.traditional: 政府為小微企業提供低息貸款，以緩解經營壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ wèi xiǎowēi qǐyè tígōng dīxī dàikuǎn, yǐ huǎnjiě jīngyíng yālì.
sentences.translation: The government provides low-interest loans to small and micro enterprises to ease operating pressure.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司代理多个国际品牌，因此对售后服务要求很高。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司代理多個國際品牌，因此對售後服務要求很高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī dàilǐ duō gè guójì pǐnpái, yīncǐ duì shòuhòu fúwù yāoqiú hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: This company represents several international brands, so its requirements for after-sales service are very high.

sentences.chinese: 律师将代理受害者提起诉讼，并要求对方公开道歉。
sentences.traditional: 律師將代理受害者提起訴訟，並要求對方公開道歉。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜshī jiāng dàilǐ shòuhàizhě tíqǐ sùsòng, bìng yāoqiú duìfāng gōngkāi dàoqiàn.
sentences.translation: The lawyer will represent the victims in bringing a lawsuit and demand a public apology from the other side.

sentences.chinese: 如果本人无法出席，可以委托他人代理办理相关手续。
sentences.traditional: 如果本人無法出席，可以委託他人代理辦理相關手續。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ běnrén wúfǎ chūxí, kěyǐ wěituō tārén dàilǐ bànlǐ xiāngguān shǒuxù.
sentences.translation: If the person cannot attend in person, they may entrust someone else to handle the relevant procedures on their behalf.

sentences.chinese: 老教授带领团队完成了多年无人攻克的实验难题。
sentences.traditional: 老教授帶領團隊完成了多年無人攻克的實驗難題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo jiàoshòu dàilǐng tuánduì wánchéng le duōnián wú rén gōngkè de shíyàn nántí.
sentences.translation: The old professor led the team in solving an experimental problem that no one had overcome for years.

sentences.chinese: 这名队长不仅技术出色，还善于带领年轻队员建立信心。
sentences.traditional: 這名隊長不僅技術出色，還善於帶領年輕隊員建立信心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè míng duìzhǎng bùjǐn jìshù chūsè, hái shànyú dàilǐng niánqīng duìyuán jiànlì xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: This captain is not only technically outstanding, but is also good at leading young team members to build confidence.

sentences.chinese: 在灾后重建中，村干部带领居民清理道路、恢复供水。
sentences.traditional: 在災後重建中，村幹部帶領居民清理道路、恢復供水。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zāihòu chóngjiàn zhōng, cūn gànbù dàilǐng jūmín qīnglǐ dàolù, huīfù gōngshuǐ.
sentences.translation: During post-disaster reconstruction, village officials led residents in clearing roads and restoring the water supply.

sentences.chinese: 他的问题并不单纯是技术问题，而牵涉到管理和责任分配。
sentences.traditional: 他的問題並不單純是技術問題，而牽涉到管理和責任分配。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de wèntí bìng bù dānchún shì jìshù wèntí, ér qiānshè dào guǎnlǐ hé zérèn fēnpèi.
sentences.translation: His problem is not simply a technical issue, but involves management and the allocation of responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 她保持着一种单纯的热情，即使遇到挫折也没有轻易放弃。
sentences.traditional: 她保持著一種單純的熱情，即使遇到挫折也沒有輕易放棄。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎochí zhe yì zhǒng dānchún de rèqíng, jíshǐ yùdào cuòzhé yě méiyǒu qīngyì fàngqì.
sentences.translation: She maintains a pure enthusiasm and has not easily given up even when encountering setbacks.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策不能用单纯的成本计算来评价，还要考虑社会影响。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策不能用單純的成本計算來評價，還要考慮社會影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè bù néng yòng dānchún de chéngběn jìsuàn lái píngjià, hái yào kǎolǜ shèhuì yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This policy cannot be evaluated by simple cost calculations alone; its social impact must also be considered.

sentences.chinese: 如果课程内容过于单调，学生很难长期保持注意力。
sentences.traditional: 如果課程內容過於單調，學生很難長期保持注意力。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kèchéng nèiróng guòyú dāndiào, xuéshēng hěn nán chángqī bǎochí zhùyìlì.
sentences.translation: If the course content is too monotonous, students find it hard to maintain attention over the long term.

sentences.chinese: 他不喜欢单调的办公室工作，更愿意参与有挑战性的项目。
sentences.traditional: 他不喜歡單調的辦公室工作，更願意參與有挑戰性的項目。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuan dāndiào de bàngōngshì gōngzuò, gèng yuànyì cānyù yǒu tiǎozhànxìng de xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: He dislikes monotonous office work and is more willing to take part in challenging projects.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的建筑风格十分单调，缺少本土文化特色。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的建築風格十分單調，缺少本土文化特色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de jiànzhù fēnggé shífēn dāndiào, quēshǎo běntǔ wénhuà tèsè.
sentences.translation: The architectural style of this city is extremely monotonous and lacks local cultural features.

sentences.chinese: 由于前期沟通不足，项目整整耽误了两个月。
sentences.traditional: 由於前期溝通不足，項目整整耽誤了兩個月。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú qiánqī gōutōng bùzú, xiàngmù zhěngzhěng dānwu le liǎng gè yuè.
sentences.translation: Because early communication was insufficient, the project was delayed by a full two months.

sentences.chinese: 请尽快提交材料，以免耽误后续审批。
sentences.traditional: 請儘快提交材料，以免耽誤後續審批。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng jǐnkuài tíjiāo cáiliào, yǐmiǎn dānwu hòuxù shěnpī.
sentences.translation: Please submit the materials as soon as possible so as not to delay the subsequent approval process.

sentences.chinese: 他总觉得自己年轻时耽误了学习，现在想重新弥补。
sentences.traditional: 他總覺得自己年輕時耽誤了學習，現在想重新彌補。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒng juéde zìjǐ niánqīng shí dānwu le xuéxí, xiànzài xiǎng chóngxīn míbǔ.
sentences.translation: He always feels that he neglected his studies when he was young, and now wants to make up for it.

sentences.chinese: 专家担忧，长期干旱可能进一步影响粮食产量。
sentences.traditional: 專家擔憂，長期乾旱可能進一步影響糧食產量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā dānyōu, chángqī gānhàn kěnéng jìnyí bù yǐngxiǎng liángshi chǎnliàng.
sentences.translation: Experts are worried that prolonged drought may further affect grain output.

sentences.chinese: 面对收入下降，许多家庭开始担忧未来的教育支出。
sentences.traditional: 面對收入下降，許多家庭開始擔憂未來的教育支出。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shōurù xiàjiàng, xǔduō jiātíng kāishǐ dānyōu wèilái de jiàoyù zhīchū.
sentences.translation: Facing a decline in income, many families have begun to worry about future education expenses.

sentences.chinese: 他担忧的并非失败本身，而是团队因此失去信心。
sentences.traditional: 他擔憂的並非失敗本身，而是團隊因此失去信心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dānyōu de bìngfēi shībài běnshēn, ér shì tuánduì yīncǐ shīqù xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: What he worries about is not failure itself, but the team losing confidence because of it.

sentences.chinese: 运动后适量补充蛋白质，有助于肌肉修复和身体恢复。
sentences.traditional: 運動後適量補充蛋白質，有助於肌肉修復和身體恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng hòu shìliàng bǔchōng dànbáizhì, yǒuzhù yú jīròu xiūfù hé shēntǐ huīfù.
sentences.translation: A moderate amount of protein after exercise helps muscle repair and physical recovery.

sentences.chinese: 豆类和坚果都是植物性蛋白质的重要来源。
sentences.traditional: 豆類和堅果都是植物性蛋白質的重要來源。
sentences.pinyin: Dòulèi hé jiānguǒ dōu shì zhíwùxìng dànbáizhì de zhòngyào láiyuán.
sentences.translation: Beans and nuts are both important sources of plant-based protein.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议老人增加蛋白质摄入，以减缓肌肉流失。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議老人增加蛋白質攝入，以減緩肌肉流失。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì lǎorén zēngjiā dànbáizhì shèrù, yǐ jiǎnhuǎn jīròu liúshī.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised the elderly person to increase protein intake to slow muscle loss.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术的诞生，改变了人们处理信息的方式。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術的誕生，改變了人們處理信息的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù de dànshēng, gǎibiàn le rénmen chǔlǐ xìnxī de fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The birth of this technology changed the way people process information.

sentences.chinese: 新制度在长期讨论和反复修改中逐渐诞生。
sentences.traditional: 新制度在長期討論和反覆修改中逐漸誕生。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhìdù zài chángqī tǎolùn hé fǎnfù xiūgǎi zhōng zhújiàn dànshēng.
sentences.translation: The new system gradually emerged through long discussions and repeated revisions.

sentences.chinese: 许多伟大的作品往往诞生于社会剧烈变化的时代。
sentences.traditional: 許多偉大的作品往往誕生於社會劇烈變化的時代。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō wěidà de zuòpǐn wǎngwǎng dànshēng yú shèhuì jùliè biànhuà de shídài.
sentences.translation: Many great works are often born in eras of dramatic social change.

sentences.chinese: 质检人员发现问题后，当场要求厂家停止发货。
sentences.traditional: 質檢人員發現問題後，當場要求廠家停止發貨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìjiǎn rényuán fāxiàn wèntí hòu, dāngchǎng yāoqiú chǎngjiā tíngzhǐ fāhuò.
sentences.translation: After quality inspectors found the problem, they demanded on the spot that the manufacturer stop shipping goods.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个荒唐的解释，几位代表当场提出反对意见。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個荒唐的解釋，幾位代表當場提出反對意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège huāngtáng de jiěshì, jǐ wèi dàibiǎo dāngchǎng tíchū fǎnduì yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Hearing this absurd explanation, several representatives raised objections on the spot.

sentences.chinese: 如果报名信息与证件不符，工作人员会当场退回申请。
sentences.traditional: 如果報名信息與證件不符，工作人員會當場退回申請。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bàomíng xìnxī yǔ zhèngjiàn bù fú, gōngzuò rényuán huì dāngchǎng tuìhuí shēnqǐng.
sentences.translation: If the registration information does not match the documents, staff will reject the application on the spot.

sentences.chinese: 如果当初没有坚持改革，公司早就被市场淘汰了。
sentences.traditional: 如果當初沒有堅持改革，公司早就被市場淘汰了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dāngchū méiyǒu jiānchí gǎigé, gōngsī zǎo jiù bèi shìchǎng táotài le.
sentences.translation: If they had not persisted with reform at the time, the company would have been eliminated by the market long ago.

sentences.chinese: 他回忆当初创业时的艰难，仍然觉得不可思议。
sentences.traditional: 他回憶當初創業時的艱難，仍然覺得不可思議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huíyì dāngchū chuàngyè shí de jiānnán, réngrán juéde bùkěsīyì.
sentences.translation: When he recalls the hardships of starting the business back then, he still finds them unbelievable.

sentences.chinese: 当初看似冒险的决定，后来证明是十分必要的。
sentences.traditional: 當初看似冒險的決定，後來證明是十分必要的。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngchū kànsì màoxiǎn de juédìng, hòulái zhèngmíng shì shífēn bìyào de.
sentences.translation: The decision that seemed risky at the time later proved to be extremely necessary.

sentences.chinese: 当代文学越来越关注普通人在城市化进程中的困境。
sentences.traditional: 當代文學越來越關注普通人在城市化進程中的困境。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdài wénxué yuèláiyuè guānzhù pǔtōng rén zài chéngshìhuà jìnchéng zhōng de kùnjìng.
sentences.translation: Contemporary literature increasingly focuses on the difficulties ordinary people face in the process of urbanisation.

sentences.chinese: 这位导演善于用传统故事回应当代社会的问题。
sentences.traditional: 這位導演善於用傳統故事回應當代社會的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi dǎoyǎn shànyú yòng chuántǒng gùshì huíyìng dāngdài shèhuì de wèntí.
sentences.translation: This director is good at using traditional stories to respond to the problems of contemporary society.

sentences.chinese: 在当代教育中，批判性思维比机械记忆更受重视。
sentences.traditional: 在當代教育中，批判性思維比機械記憶更受重視。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dāngdài jiàoyù zhōng, pīpànxìng sīwéi bǐ jīxiè jìyì gèng shòu zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: In contemporary education, critical thinking is valued more than mechanical memorisation.

sentences.chinese: 当今世界，数据安全已经成为各国共同面对的挑战。
sentences.traditional: 當今世界，數據安全已經成為各國共同面對的挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngjīn shìjiè, shùjù ānquán yǐjīng chéngwéi gè guó gòngtóng miànduì de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: In today’s world, data security has become a challenge faced jointly by all countries.

sentences.chinese: 他认为，当今企业不能只追求利润，还必须承担社会责任。
sentences.traditional: 他認為，當今企業不能只追求利潤，還必須承擔社會責任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi, dāngjīn qǐyè bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú lìrùn, hái bìxū chéngdān shèhuì zérèn.
sentences.translation: He believes that enterprises today cannot only pursue profit; they must also take on social responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 在当今竞争激烈的环境下，持续学习显得尤其重要。
sentences.traditional: 在當今競爭激烈的環境下，持續學習顯得尤其重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dāngjīn jìngzhēng jīliè de huánjìng xià, chíxù xuéxí xiǎnde yóuqí zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In today’s highly competitive environment, continuous learning seems especially important.

sentences.chinese: 这么敏感的问题，最好还是当面解释，免得在邮件里产生误会。
sentences.traditional: 這麼敏感的問題，最好還是當面解釋，免得在郵件裡產生誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhème mǐngǎn de wèntí, zuìhǎo háishi dāngmiàn jiěshì, miǎnde zài yóujiàn lǐ chǎnshēng wùhuì.
sentences.translation: For such a sensitive issue, it is best to explain it face to face, to avoid misunderstandings in email.

sentences.chinese: 我想当面向他道歉，而不是让别人替我转达。
sentences.traditional: 我想當面向他道歉，而不是讓別人替我轉達。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dāngmiàn xiàng tā dàoqiàn, ér bú shì ràng biérén tì wǒ zhuǎndá.
sentences.translation: I want to apologise to him in person rather than ask someone else to pass on the message.

sentences.chinese: 经理要求当面核实签字，防止合同被人冒用。
sentences.traditional: 經理要求當面核實簽字，防止合同被人冒用。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yāoqiú dāngmiàn héshí qiānzì, fángzhǐ hétong bèi rén màoyòng.
sentences.translation: The manager required the signature to be verified in person to prevent the contract from being misused by someone else.

sentences.chinese: 当下最紧迫的任务，是稳定团队情绪并恢复正常生产。
sentences.traditional: 當下最緊迫的任務，是穩定團隊情緒並恢復正常生產。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngxià zuì jǐnpò de rènwu, shì wěndìng tuánduì qíngxù bìng huīfù zhèngcháng shēngchǎn.
sentences.translation: The most urgent task at the moment is to stabilise the team’s morale and restore normal production.

sentences.chinese: 面对突发危机，他当下没有犹豫，立刻启动应急方案。
sentences.traditional: 面對突發危機，他當下沒有猶豫，立刻啟動應急方案。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā wēijī, tā dāngxià méiyǒu yóuyù, lìkè qǐdòng yìngjí fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: Faced with a sudden crisis, he did not hesitate at that moment and immediately launched the emergency plan.

sentences.chinese: 我们不能只顾当下的利益，而忽略长期的风险。
sentences.traditional: 我們不能只顧當下的利益，而忽略長期的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zhǐ gù dāngxià de lìyì, ér hūlüè chángqī de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: We cannot focus only on immediate interests while ignoring long-term risks.

sentences.chinese: 他以微弱优势当选为新一届协会主席。
sentences.traditional: 他以微弱優勢當選為新一屆協會主席。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐ wēiruò yōushì dāngxuǎn wéi xīn yí jiè xiéhuì zhǔxí.
sentences.translation: He was elected chair of the new association by a narrow margin.

sentences.chinese: 这名年轻议员当选后，承诺优先推动教育改革。
sentences.traditional: 這名年輕議員當選後，承諾優先推動教育改革。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè míng niánqīng yìyuán dāngxuǎn hòu, chéngnuò yōuxiān tuīdòng jiàoyù gǎigé.
sentences.translation: After being elected, the young councillor promised to prioritise education reform.

sentences.chinese: 如果候选人当选，他的税收政策可能会立即引发争议。
sentences.traditional: 如果候選人當選，他的稅收政策可能會立即引發爭議。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ hòuxuǎnrén dāngxuǎn, tā de shuìshōu zhèngcè kěnéng huì lìjí yǐnfā zhēngyì.
sentences.translation: If the candidate is elected, his tax policy may immediately spark controversy.

sentences.chinese: 这些档案保存了工厂改制期间的关键决策过程。
sentences.traditional: 這些檔案保存了工廠改制期間的關鍵決策過程。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē dàng'àn bǎocún le gōngchǎng gǎizhì qījiān de guānjiàn juécè guòchéng.
sentences.translation: These records preserve the key decision-making process during the factory’s restructuring.

sentences.chinese: 医院建立电子档案后，患者的检查结果可以跨科室共享。
sentences.traditional: 醫院建立電子檔案後，患者的檢查結果可以跨科室共享。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn jiànlì diànzǐ dàng'àn hòu, huànzhě de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ kěyǐ kuà kēshì gòngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: After the hospital set up electronic files, patients’ test results can be shared across departments.

sentences.chinese: 律师建议先调取相关档案，再决定是否提起诉讼。
sentences.traditional: 律師建議先調取相關檔案，再決定是否提起訴訟。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜshī jiànyì xiān diàoqǔ xiāngguān dàng'àn, zài juédìng shìfǒu tíqǐ sùsòng.
sentences.translation: The lawyer suggested first retrieving the relevant files before deciding whether to bring a lawsuit.

sentences.chinese: 订单当天确认后，系统会自动安排发货。
sentences.traditional: 訂單當天確認後，系統會自動安排發貨。
sentences.pinyin: Dìngdān dàngtiān quèrèn hòu, xìtǒng huì zìdòng ānpái fāhuò.
sentences.translation: Once the order is confirmed on that day, the system will automatically arrange dispatch.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生当天，附近所有监控录像都被警方调走了。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生當天，附近所有監控錄像都被警方調走了。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng dàngtiān, fùjìn suǒyǒu jiānkòng lùxiàng dōu bèi jǐngfāng diàozǒu le.
sentences.translation: On the day the accident occurred, all nearby surveillance footage was taken away by the police.

sentences.chinese: 他当天就提交了辞职信，显然早已下定决心。
sentences.traditional: 他當天就提交了辭職信，顯然早已下定決心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàngtiān jiù tíjiāo le cízhíxìn, xiǎnrán zǎo yǐ xiàdìng juéxīn.
sentences.translation: He submitted his resignation letter that very day, clearly having made up his mind long before.

sentences.chinese: 这座岛虽然面积不大，却拥有非常独特的生态系统。
sentences.traditional: 這座島雖然面積不大，卻擁有非常獨特的生態系統。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo suīrán miànjī bú dà, què yōngyǒu fēicháng dútè de shēngtài xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: Although this island is not large, it has a very unique ecosystem.

sentences.chinese: 台风过后，岛上的交通和供电都受到了严重影响。
sentences.traditional: 颱風過後，島上的交通和供電都受到了嚴重影響。
sentences.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, dǎo shàng de jiāotōng hé gōngdiàn dōu shòudào le yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: After the typhoon, transport and power supply on the island were seriously affected.

sentences.chinese: 他们计划在岛周围设立保护区，限制过度开发。
sentences.traditional: 他們計劃在島周圍設立保護區，限制過度開發。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jìhuà zài dǎo zhōuwéi shèlì bǎohùqū, xiànzhì guòdù kāifā.
sentences.translation: They plan to establish a protected area around the island to restrict excessive development.

sentences.chinese: 如果资金链继续断裂，这家连锁企业可能在年底前倒闭。
sentences.traditional: 如果資金鏈繼續斷裂，這家連鎖企業可能在年底前倒閉。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zījīnliàn jìxù duànliè, zhè jiā liánsuǒ qǐyè kěnéng zài niándǐ qián dǎobì.
sentences.translation: If the cash flow chain continues to break, this chain company may go bankrupt before the end of the year.

sentences.chinese: 那家书店倒闭后，附近居民都觉得十分可惜。
sentences.traditional: 那家書店倒閉後，附近居民都覺得十分可惜。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā shūdiàn dǎobì hòu, fùjìn jūmín dōu juéde shífēn kěxī.
sentences.translation: After that bookshop went bankrupt, nearby residents all felt it was a great pity.

sentences.chinese: 政府提供贷款，是为了避免大量小企业集中倒闭。
sentences.traditional: 政府提供貸款，是為了避免大量小企業集中倒閉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tígōng dàikuǎn, shì wèile bìmiǎn dàliàng xiǎo qǐyè jízhōng dǎobì.
sentences.translation: The government provided loans to prevent large numbers of small businesses from going bankrupt at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 在狭窄的巷子里倒车时，他差点撞到墙角。
sentences.traditional: 在狹窄的巷子裡倒車時，他差點撞到牆角。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xiázhǎi de xiàngzi lǐ dǎochē shí, tā chàdiǎn zhuàngdào qiángjiǎo.
sentences.translation: While reversing in the narrow alley, he almost hit the corner of the wall.

sentences.chinese: 新司机倒车前应该先确认车后没有行人。
sentences.traditional: 新司機倒車前應該先確認車後沒有行人。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn sījī dǎochē qián yīnggāi xiān quèrèn chē hòu méiyǒu xíngrén.
sentences.translation: A new driver should first make sure there are no pedestrians behind the car before reversing.

sentences.chinese: 这个停车场设计不合理，大车很难顺利倒车。
sentences.traditional: 這個停車場設計不合理，大車很難順利倒車。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tíngchēchǎng shèjì bù hélǐ, dà chē hěn nán shùnlì dǎochē.
sentences.translation: This car park is poorly designed, so large vehicles find it hard to reverse smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 他的导师不仅指导论文，还帮助他规划未来的研究方向。
sentences.traditional: 他的導師不僅指導論文，還幫助他規劃未來的研究方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de dǎoshī bùjǐn zhǐdǎo lùnwén, hái bāngzhù tā guīhuà wèilái de yánjiū fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: His supervisor not only advises him on his thesis but also helps him plan his future research direction.

sentences.chinese: 选择导师时，学生应该考虑学术兴趣是否一致。
sentences.traditional: 選擇導師時，學生應該考慮學術興趣是否一致。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnzé dǎoshī shí, xuéshēng yīnggāi kǎolǜ xuéshù xìngqù shìfǒu yízhì.
sentences.translation: When choosing a supervisor, students should consider whether their academic interests match.

sentences.chinese: 这位创业导师经常提醒年轻人不要盲目扩张。
sentences.traditional: 這位創業導師經常提醒年輕人不要盲目擴張。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi chuàngyè dǎoshī jīngcháng tíxǐng niánqīng rén bú yào mángmù kuòzhāng.
sentences.translation: This entrepreneurship mentor often reminds young people not to expand blindly.

sentences.chinese: 技术的发展越快，相关的道德争议就越值得重视。
sentences.traditional: 技術的發展越快，相關的道德爭議就越值得重視。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshù de fāzhǎn yuè kuài, xiāngguān de dàodé zhēngyì jiù yuè zhíde zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: The faster technology develops, the more attention should be paid to the related ethical controversies.

sentences.chinese: 一个缺乏道德底线的企业，很难获得长期信任。
sentences.traditional: 一個缺乏道德底線的企業，很難獲得長期信任。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge quēfá dàodé dǐxiàn de qǐyè, hěn nán huòdé chángqī xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: A company lacking moral boundaries will find it hard to gain long-term trust.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究虽然合法，却引发了复杂的道德讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究雖然合法，卻引發了複雜的道德討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū suīrán héfǎ, què yǐnfā le fùzá de dàodé tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: Although this research is legal, it has triggered complex ethical discussions.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐馆环境一般，味道倒是比网上评价说的好很多。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐館環境一般，味道倒是比網上評價說的好很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānguǎn huánjìng yìbān, wèidào dàoshì bǐ wǎngshàng píngjià shuō de hǎo hěn duō.
sentences.translation: The restaurant’s environment is ordinary, but the food actually tastes much better than the online reviews suggest.

sentences.chinese: 他平时很少发言，今天倒是主动提出了几个有价值的问题。
sentences.traditional: 他平時很少發言，今天倒是主動提出了幾個有價值的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píngshí hěn shǎo fāyán, jīntiān dàoshì zhǔdòng tíchū le jǐ gè yǒu jiàzhí de wèntí.
sentences.translation: He rarely speaks up, but today he took the initiative to raise several valuable questions.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案风险不小，倒是可以作为讨论的起点。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案風險不小，倒是可以作為討論的起點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn fēngxiǎn bù xiǎo, dàoshì kěyǐ zuòwéi tǎolùn de qǐdiǎn.
sentences.translation: This proposal carries considerable risk, but it can serve as a starting point for discussion.

sentences.chinese: 任务虽然复杂，但只要分工明确，两天内做得了。
sentences.traditional: 任務雖然複雜，但只要分工明確，兩天內做得了。
sentences.pinyin: Rènwù suīrán fùzá, dàn zhǐyào fēngōng míngquè, liǎng tiān nèi zuò de liǎo.
sentences.translation: Although the task is complex, it can be completed within two days as long as responsibilities are clearly divided.

sentences.chinese: 这么大的压力，年轻团队未必承受得了。
sentences.traditional: 這麼大的壓力，年輕團隊未必承受得了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhème dà de yālì, niánqīng tuánduì wèibì chéngshòu de liǎo.
sentences.translation: A young team may not necessarily be able to withstand such great pressure.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告数据太乱，今晚恐怕整理得了初稿，改不了细节。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告數據太亂，今晚恐怕整理得了初稿，改不了細節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào shùjù tài luàn, jīnwǎn kǒngpà zhěnglǐ de liǎo chūgǎo, gǎi bù liǎo xìjié.
sentences.translation: The data in this report is too messy; tonight we can probably produce a draft, but not refine the details.

sentences.chinese: 在多方协调下，被困旅客终于得以安全撤离。
sentences.traditional: 在多方協調下，被困旅客終於得以安全撤離。
sentences.pinyin: Zài duōfāng xiétiáo xià, bèikùn lǚkè zhōngyú déyǐ ānquán chèlí.
sentences.translation: With coordination from several parties, the stranded passengers were finally able to evacuate safely.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术投入使用后，偏远地区的患者得以及时接受诊断。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術投入使用後，偏遠地區的患者得以及時接受診斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù tóurù shǐyòng hòu, piānyuǎn dìqū de huànzhě déyǐ jíshí jiēshòu zhěnduàn.
sentences.translation: After this technology was put into use, patients in remote areas were able to receive diagnoses in time.

sentences.chinese: 由于证据保存完整，案件真相才得以逐步还原。
sentences.traditional: 由於證據保存完整，案件真相才得以逐步還原。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zhèngjù bǎocún wánzhěng, ànjiàn zhēnxiàng cái déyǐ zhúbù huányuán.
sentences.translation: Because the evidence was preserved intact, the truth of the case was able to be gradually reconstructed.

sentences.chinese: 得知工厂即将搬迁后，许多员工开始重新规划生活。
sentences.traditional: 得知工廠即將搬遷後，許多員工開始重新規劃生活。
sentences.pinyin: Dézhī gōngchǎng jíjiāng bānqiān hòu, xǔduō yuángōng kāishǐ chóngxīn guīhuà shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: After learning that the factory was about to relocate, many employees began to re-plan their lives.

sentences.chinese: 警方得知嫌疑人可能已经出境，立即启动了国际合作程序。
sentences.traditional: 警方得知嫌疑人可能已經出境，立即啟動了國際合作程序。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng dézhī xiányírén kěnéng yǐjīng chūjìng, lìjí qǐdòng le guójì hézuò chéngxù.
sentences.translation: After learning that the suspect might have already left the country, the police immediately launched international cooperation procedures.

sentences.chinese: 他得知项目被撤销时，仍然保持冷静，并安排团队转向新的任务。
sentences.traditional: 他得知項目被撤銷時，仍然保持冷靜，並安排團隊轉向新的任務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dézhī xiàngmù bèi chèxiāo shí, réngrán bǎochí lěngjìng, bìng ānpái tuánduì zhuǎnxiàng xīn de rènwù.
sentences.translation: When he learned that the project had been cancelled, he remained calm and arranged for the team to move on to new tasks.

sentences.chinese: 春节前夕，老街两侧挂满了红灯笼，节日气氛格外浓厚。
sentences.traditional: 春節前夕，老街兩側掛滿了紅燈籠，節日氣氛格外濃厚。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qiánxī, lǎo jiē liǎng cè guà mǎn le hóng dēnglong, jiérì qìfēn géwài nónghòu.
sentences.translation: On the eve of Spring Festival, red lanterns hung all along both sides of the old street, making the festive atmosphere especially strong.

sentences.chinese: 这盏灯笼虽然由纸和竹子制成，却承载着当地人的集体记忆。
sentences.traditional: 這盞燈籠雖然由紙和竹子製成，卻承載著當地人的集體記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǎn dēnglong suīrán yóu zhǐ hé zhúzi zhìchéng, què chéngzǎi zhe dāngdì rén de jítǐ jìyì.
sentences.translation: Although this lantern is made of paper and bamboo, it carries the collective memories of local people.

sentences.chinese: 游客夜间穿过小巷时，头顶的灯笼把石板路照得十分柔和。
sentences.traditional: 遊客夜間穿過小巷時，頭頂的燈籠把石板路照得十分柔和。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè yèjiān chuānguò xiǎoxiàng shí, tóudǐng de dēnglong bǎ shíbǎnlù zhào de shífēn róuhé.
sentences.translation: When tourists pass through the alley at night, the lanterns above them cast a very soft light on the stone road.

sentences.chinese: 平台会根据用户信用等级决定是否提供更高额度的服务。
sentences.traditional: 平臺會根據用戶信用等級決定是否提供更高額度的服務。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái huì gēnjù yònghù xìnyòng děngjí juédìng shìfǒu tígōng gèng gāo édù de fúwù.
sentences.translation: The platform will decide whether to provide a higher service limit according to the user’s credit rating.

sentences.chinese: 这套培训课程按难度等级划分，学员可以循序渐进地学习。
sentences.traditional: 這套培訓課程按難度等級劃分，學員可以循序漸進地學習。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào péixùn kèchéng àn nándù děngjí huàfēn, xuéyuán kěyǐ xúnxùjiànjìn de xuéxí.
sentences.translation: This training course is divided by difficulty level, allowing learners to study step by step.

sentences.chinese: 灾害预警等级提高后，沿海居民被建议提前转移。
sentences.traditional: 災害預警等級提高後，沿海居民被建議提前轉移。
sentences.pinyin: Zāihài yùjǐng děngjí tígāo hòu, yánhǎi jūmín bèi jiànyì tíqián zhuǎnyí.
sentences.translation: After the disaster warning level was raised, coastal residents were advised to evacuate in advance.

sentences.chinese: 雨水沿着屋檐一滴一滴落下，打破了夜里的寂静。
sentences.traditional: 雨水沿著屋簷一滴一滴落下，打破了夜裡的寂靜。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔshuǐ yánzhe wūyán yì dī yì dī luò xià, dǎpò le yèli de jìjìng.
sentences.translation: Rainwater fell drop by drop along the eaves, breaking the silence of the night.

sentences.chinese: 护士小心地把药水滴进患者眼中，并提醒他暂时不要揉眼睛。
sentences.traditional: 護士小心地把藥水滴進患者眼中，並提醒他暫時不要揉眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi xiǎoxīn de bǎ yàoshuǐ dī jìn huànzhě yǎn zhōng, bìng tíxǐng tā zànshí bú yào róu yǎnjing.
sentences.translation: The nurse carefully dripped the medicine into the patient’s eye and reminded him not to rub his eyes for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 实验要求非常严格，哪怕多加一滴试剂，也可能影响结果。
sentences.traditional: 實驗要求非常嚴格，哪怕多加一滴試劑，也可能影響結果。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyàn yāoqiú fēicháng yángé, nǎpà duō jiā yì dī shìjì, yě kěnéng yǐngxiǎng jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: The experiment is extremely strict; even adding one extra drop of reagent may affect the result.

sentences.chinese: 许多城市正在推广低碳交通，以减少空气污染和能源消耗。
sentences.traditional: 許多城市正在推廣低碳交通，以減少空氣污染和能源消耗。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō chéngshì zhèngzài tuīguǎng dītàn jiāotōng, yǐ jiǎnshǎo kōngqì wūrǎn hé néngyuán xiāohào.
sentences.translation: Many cities are promoting low-carbon transport to reduce air pollution and energy consumption.

sentences.chinese: 低碳生活并不意味着降低生活质量，而是更理性地使用资源。
sentences.traditional: 低碳生活並不意味著降低生活質量，而是更理性地使用資源。
sentences.pinyin: Dītàn shēnghuó bìng bù yìwèizhe jiàngdī shēnghuó zhìliàng, ér shì gèng lǐxìng de shǐyòng zīyuán.
sentences.translation: A low-carbon lifestyle does not mean lowering quality of life, but using resources more rationally.

sentences.chinese: 如果企业想获得绿色融资，就必须证明自己的生产流程足够低碳。
sentences.traditional: 如果企業想獲得綠色融資，就必須證明自己的生產流程足夠低碳。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qǐyè xiǎng huòdé lǜsè róngzī, jiù bìxū zhèngmíng zìjǐ de shēngchǎn liúchéng zúgòu dītàn.
sentences.translation: If a company wants to obtain green financing, it must prove that its production process is sufficiently low-carbon.

sentences.chinese: 救援队连夜穿过山区，终于在清晨抵达受灾村庄。
sentences.traditional: 救援隊連夜穿過山區，終於在清晨抵達受災村莊。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùyuán duì liányè chuānguò shānqū, zhōngyú zài qīngchén dǐdá shòuzāi cūnzhuāng.
sentences.translation: The rescue team crossed the mountainous area overnight and finally reached the disaster-stricken village at dawn.

sentences.chinese: 代表团抵达机场后，没有接受采访，直接前往会议中心。
sentences.traditional: 代表團抵達機場後，沒有接受採訪，直接前往會議中心。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán dǐdá jīchǎng hòu, méiyǒu jiēshòu cǎifǎng, zhíjiē qiánwǎng huìyì zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: After the delegation arrived at the airport, they did not accept interviews and went directly to the conference centre.

sentences.chinese: 货物预计今晚抵达港口，明天完成清关手续。
sentences.traditional: 貨物預計今晚抵達港口，明天完成清關手續。
sentences.pinyin: Huòwù yùjì jīnwǎn dǐdá gǎngkǒu, míngtiān wánchéng qīngguān shǒuxù.
sentences.translation: The goods are expected to arrive at the port tonight, and customs clearance will be completed tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 面对外来压力，社区居民选择联合起来抵抗不合理的拆迁方案。
sentences.traditional: 面對外來壓力，社區居民選擇聯合起來抵抗不合理的拆遷方案。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì wàilái yālì, shèqū jūmín xuǎnzé liánhé qǐlái dǐkàng bù hélǐ de chāiqiān fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: Faced with outside pressure, the community residents chose to unite and resist the unreasonable demolition plan.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺乏睡眠会削弱身体抵抗疾病的能力。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺乏睡眠會削弱身體抵抗疾病的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá shuìmián huì xuēruò shēntǐ dǐkàng jíbìng de nénglì.
sentences.translation: Long-term lack of sleep weakens the body’s ability to resist disease.

sentences.chinese: 这支部队虽然人数不多，却抵抗了数小时才被迫撤退。
sentences.traditional: 這支部隊雖然人數不多，卻抵抗了數小時才被迫撤退。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī bùduì suīrán rénshù bù duō, què dǐkàng le shù xiǎoshí cái bèipò chètuì.
sentences.translation: Although this unit did not have many soldiers, it resisted for several hours before being forced to retreat.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店虽然不起眼，却能做出非常地道的川菜风味。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店雖然不起眼，卻能做出非常地道的川菜風味。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎodiàn suīrán bù qǐyǎn, què néng zuò chū fēicháng dìdao de Chuāncài fēngwèi.
sentences.translation: Although this small shop is unremarkable, it can produce very authentic Sichuan flavours.

sentences.chinese: 他在北京生活了十多年，普通话说得相当地道。
sentences.traditional: 他在北京生活了十多年，普通話說得相當地道。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài Běijīng shēnghuó le shí duō nián, Pǔtōnghuà shuō de xiāngdāng dìdao.
sentences.translation: He has lived in Beijing for more than ten years, and his Mandarin sounds quite authentic.

sentences.chinese: 纪录片追求地道的民间表达，而不是刻意包装出来的乡土气息。
sentences.traditional: 紀錄片追求地道的民間表達，而不是刻意包裝出來的鄉土氣息。
sentences.pinyin: Jìlùpiàn zhuīqiú dìdao de mínjiān biǎodá, ér bú shì kèyì bāozhuāng chūlái de xiāngtǔ qìxī.
sentences.translation: The documentary seeks authentic folk expression rather than a deliberately packaged rustic atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方曾经荒废多年，如今被改造成公共艺术空间。
sentences.traditional: 這個地方曾經荒廢多年，如今被改造成公共藝術空間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfāng céngjīng huāngfèi duō nián, rújīn bèi gǎizào chéng gōnggòng yìshù kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: This place was abandoned for many years and has now been transformed into a public art space.

sentences.chinese: 在制定政策时，中央与地方的利益需要得到合理协调。
sentences.traditional: 在制定政策時，中央與地方的利益需要得到合理協調。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhìdìng zhèngcè shí, zhōngyāng yǔ dìfāng de lìyì xūyào dédào hélǐ xiétiáo.
sentences.translation: When formulating policy, the interests of the central government and local areas need to be properly coordinated.

sentences.chinese: 她把合同放在一个安全的地方，以免被孩子随手拿走。
sentences.traditional: 她把合同放在一個安全的地方，以免被孩子隨手拿走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ hétong fàng zài yí gè ānquán de dìfāng, yǐmiǎn bèi háizi suíshǒu ná zǒu.
sentences.translation: She put the contract in a safe place so that the child would not pick it up casually.

sentences.chinese: 复杂的地形增加了救援难度，直升机也无法立即降落。
sentences.traditional: 複雜的地形增加了救援難度，直升機也無法立即降落。
sentences.pinyin: Fùzá de dìxíng zēngjiā le jiùyuán nándù, zhíshēngjī yě wúfǎ lìjí jiàngluò.
sentences.translation: The complex terrain increased the difficulty of the rescue, and helicopters could not land immediately.

sentences.chinese: 古城依山而建，特殊的地形决定了街道弯曲狭窄。
sentences.traditional: 古城依山而建，特殊的地形決定了街道彎曲狹窄。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔchéng yī shān ér jiàn, tèshū de dìxíng juédìng le jiēdào wānqū xiázhǎi.
sentences.translation: The old city was built against the mountains, and its distinctive terrain made the streets winding and narrow.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员根据地形变化判断洪水可能扩散的范围。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員根據地形變化判斷洪水可能擴散的範圍。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán gēnjù dìxíng biànhuà pànduàn hóngshuǐ kěnéng kuòsàn de fànwéi.
sentences.translation: Researchers judged the possible spread of the flood according to changes in terrain.

sentences.chinese: 不同地域的饮食习惯反映了气候、物产和历史的共同影响。
sentences.traditional: 不同地域的飲食習慣反映了氣候、物產和歷史的共同影響。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng dìyù de yǐnshí xíguàn fǎnyìng le qìhòu, wùchǎn hé lìshǐ de gòngtóng yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Dietary habits in different regions reflect the combined influence of climate, produce, and history.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究突破了地域限制，收集了来自多个国家的数据。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究突破了地域限制，收集了來自多個國家的數據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū tūpò le dìyù xiànzhì, shōují le láizì duō gè guójiā de shùjù.
sentences.translation: This study overcame regional limitations and collected data from several countries.

sentences.chinese: 企业在扩张时，必须考虑地域文化对消费行为的影响。
sentences.traditional: 企業在擴張時，必須考慮地域文化對消費行為的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè zài kuòzhāng shí, bìxū kǎolǜ dìyù wénhuà duì xiāofèi xíngwéi de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: When expanding, companies must consider the influence of regional culture on consumer behaviour.

sentences.chinese: 施工前，专家对隧道沿线的地质条件进行了详细评估。
sentences.traditional: 施工前，專家對隧道沿線的地質條件進行了詳細評估。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōng qián, zhuānjiā duì suìdào yánxiàn de dìzhì tiáojiàn jìnxíng le xiángxì pínggū.
sentences.translation: Before construction, experts conducted a detailed assessment of the geological conditions along the tunnel route.

sentences.chinese: 这座山体的地质结构不稳定，雨季容易发生滑坡。
sentences.traditional: 這座山體的地質結構不穩定，雨季容易發生滑坡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò shāntǐ de dìzhì jiégòu bù wěndìng, yǔjì róngyì fāshēng huápō.
sentences.translation: The geological structure of this mountain is unstable, so landslides are likely in the rainy season.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆通过岩石样本向公众介绍本地区的地质演变。
sentences.traditional: 博物館通過岩石樣本向公眾介紹本地區的地質演變。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn tōngguò yánshí yàngběn xiàng gōngzhòng jièshào běn dìqū de dìzhì yǎnbiàn.
sentences.translation: The museum uses rock samples to introduce the region’s geological evolution to the public.

sentences.chinese: 用户只需点击屏幕右上角的图标，就能进入账户设置页面。
sentences.traditional: 用戶只需點擊屏幕右上角的圖標，就能進入賬戶設置頁面。
sentences.pinyin: Yònghù zhǐ xū diǎnjī píngmù yòu shàng jiǎo de túbiāo, jiù néng jìnrù zhànghù shèzhì yèmiàn.
sentences.translation: Users only need to click the icon in the top right corner of the screen to enter the account settings page.

sentences.chinese: 如果链接无法打开，请不要反复点击，以免系统重复提交申请。
sentences.traditional: 如果鏈接無法打開，請不要反覆點擊，以免系統重複提交申請。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ liànjiē wúfǎ dǎkāi, qǐng bú yào fǎnfù diǎnjī, yǐmiǎn xìtǒng chóngfù tíjiāo shēnqǐng.
sentences.translation: If the link cannot be opened, please do not click repeatedly, in case the system submits the application more than once.

sentences.chinese: 学生点击答案后，平台会立即给出解析和相关练习。
sentences.traditional: 學生點擊答案後，平臺會立即給出解析和相關練習。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēng diǎnjī dá'àn hòu, píngtái huì lìjí gěi chū jiěxī hé xiāngguān liànxí.
sentences.translation: After students click the answer, the platform immediately provides an explanation and related practice.

sentences.chinese: 毕业典礼虽然简短，却让每位学生都感到庄重而难忘。
sentences.traditional: 畢業典禮雖然簡短，卻讓每位學生都感到莊重而難忘。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyè diǎnlǐ suīrán jiǎnduǎn, què ràng měi wèi xuéshēng dōu gǎndào zhuāngzhòng ér nánwàng.
sentences.translation: Although the graduation ceremony was brief, it made every student feel solemn and left a lasting impression.

sentences.chinese: 开幕典礼上，主办方回顾了这个项目十年的发展历程。
sentences.traditional: 開幕典禮上，主辦方回顧了這個項目十年的發展歷程。
sentences.pinyin: Kāimù diǎnlǐ shàng, zhǔbànfāng huígù le zhège xiàngmù shí nián de fāzhǎn lìchéng.
sentences.translation: At the opening ceremony, the organisers reviewed the ten-year development of the project.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，原定在广场举行的典礼被移到了室内。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣惡劣，原定在廣場舉行的典禮被移到了室內。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, yuándìng zài guǎngchǎng jǔxíng de diǎnlǐ bèi yí dào le shìnèi.
sentences.translation: Because of the severe weather, the ceremony originally scheduled for the square was moved indoors.

sentences.chinese: 一场公开辩论点燃了公众对教育公平的讨论。
sentences.traditional: 一場公開辯論點燃了公眾對教育公平的討論。
sentences.pinyin: Yì chǎng gōngkāi biànlùn diǎnrán le gōngzhòng duì jiàoyù gōngpíng de tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: A public debate ignited public discussion about educational fairness.

sentences.chinese: 消防员确认没有泄漏后，才允许工作人员点燃设备。
sentences.traditional: 消防員確認沒有洩漏後，才允許工作人員點燃設備。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán quèrèn méi yǒu xièlòu hòu, cái yǔnxǔ gōngzuò rényuán diǎnrán shèbèi.
sentences.translation: Only after confirming there was no leak did the firefighters allow the staff to ignite the equipment.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说用一个普通家庭的命运点燃读者对时代变迁的思考。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說用一個普通家庭的命運點燃讀者對時代變遷的思考。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō yòng yí gè pǔtōng jiātíng de mìngyùn diǎnrán dúzhě duì shídài biànqiān de sīkǎo.
sentences.translation: This novel uses the fate of an ordinary family to ignite readers’ reflection on historical change.

sentences.chinese: 这个案例是城市更新中兼顾商业开发与社区保护的典型。
sentences.traditional: 這個案例是城市更新中兼顧商業開發與社區保護的典型。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ànlì shì chéngshì gēngxīn zhōng jiāngù shāngyè kāifā yǔ shèqū bǎohù de diǎnxíng.
sentences.translation: This case is a model of balancing commercial development and community protection in urban renewal.

sentences.chinese: 她的发言反映了典型的消费者顾虑：价格、质量和售后服务。
sentences.traditional: 她的發言反映了典型的消費者顧慮：價格、質量和售後服務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fāyán fǎnyìng le diǎnxíng de xiāofèizhě gùlǜ: jiàgé, zhìliàng hé shòuhòu fúwù.
sentences.translation: Her remarks reflected typical consumer concerns: price, quality, and after-sales service.

sentences.chinese: 研究者选择这个村庄作为典型样本，以观察乡村治理的变化。
sentences.traditional: 研究者選擇這個村莊作為典型樣本，以觀察鄉村治理的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiūzhě xuǎnzé zhège cūnzhuāng zuòwéi diǎnxíng yàngběn, yǐ guānchá xiāngcūn zhìlǐ de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The researchers chose this village as a representative sample to observe changes in rural governance.

sentences.chinese: 她把米和水放进电饭锅后，便继续准备其他菜。
sentences.traditional: 她把米和水放進電飯鍋後，便繼續準備其他菜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ mǐ hé shuǐ fàng jìn diànfànguō hòu, biàn jìxù zhǔnbèi qítā cài.
sentences.translation: After putting the rice and water into the rice cooker, she continued preparing the other dishes.

sentences.chinese: 这款电饭锅可以预约时间，适合早出晚归的上班族。
sentences.traditional: 這款電飯鍋可以預約時間，適合早出晚歸的上班族。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn diànfànguō kěyǐ yùyuē shíjiān, shìhé zǎo chū wǎn guī de shàngbānzú.
sentences.translation: This rice cooker can be scheduled in advance, making it suitable for office workers who leave early and return late.

sentences.chinese: 宿舍规定不能使用电饭锅，主要是出于消防安全考虑。
sentences.traditional: 宿舍規定不能使用電飯鍋，主要是出於消防安全考慮。
sentences.pinyin: Sùshè guīdìng bù néng shǐyòng diànfànguō, zhǔyào shì chūyú xiāofáng ānquán kǎolǜ.
sentences.translation: Dormitory rules forbid using rice cookers, mainly for fire safety reasons.

sentences.chinese: 夏季用电高峰来临前，政府要求电力公司提前检查老旧线路。
sentences.traditional: 夏季用電高峰來臨前，政府要求電力公司提前檢查老舊線路。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàjì yòngdiàn gāofēng láilín qián, zhèngfǔ yāoqiú diànlì gōngsī tíqián jiǎnchá lǎojiù xiànlù.
sentences.translation: Before the summer peak in electricity use arrives, the government requires power companies to inspect ageing power lines in advance.

sentences.chinese: 如果电力供应中断，医院的备用系统必须立刻启动。
sentences.traditional: 如果電力供應中斷，醫院的備用系統必須立刻啟動。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ diànlì gōngyìng zhōngduàn, yīyuàn de bèiyòng xìtǒng bìxū lìkè qǐdòng.
sentences.translation: If the electricity supply is interrupted, the hospital’s backup system must start immediately.

sentences.chinese: 这座工厂通过节约电力降低了生产成本，也减少了碳排放。
sentences.traditional: 這座工廠通過節約電力降低了生產成本，也減少了碳排放。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gōngchǎng tōngguò jiéyuē diànlì jiàngdī le shēngchǎn chéngběn, yě jiǎnshǎo le tàn páifàng.
sentences.translation: By saving electricity, this factory has lowered production costs and reduced carbon emissions.

sentences.chinese: 这条街上的老店铺虽然面积不大，却保留着本地人的生活记忆。
sentences.traditional: 這條街上的老店鋪雖然面積不大，卻保留著本地人的生活記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē shàng de lǎo diànpù suīrán miànjī bú dà, què bǎoliúzhe běndì rén de shēnghuó jìyì.
sentences.translation: Although the old shops on this street are not large, they preserve the local people’s memories of everyday life.

sentences.chinese: 平台调整规则后，许多小店铺不得不重新设计销售策略。
sentences.traditional: 平臺調整規則後，許多小店鋪不得不重新設計銷售策略。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái tiáozhěng guīzé hòu, xǔduō xiǎo diànpù bùdébù chóngxīn shèjì xiāoshòu cèlüè.
sentences.translation: After the platform adjusted its rules, many small shops had to redesign their sales strategies.

sentences.chinese: 消防部门提醒店铺负责人，仓库通道不能被货物堵住。
sentences.traditional: 消防部門提醒店鋪負責人，倉庫通道不能被貨物堵住。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofáng bùmén tíxǐng diànpù fùzérén, cāngkù tōngdào bù néng bèi huòwù dǔzhù.
sentences.translation: The fire department reminded shop managers that warehouse passages must not be blocked by goods.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始前，请确认投影仪和音响都已经接上电源。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始前，請確認投影儀和音響都已經接上電源。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, qǐng quèrèn tóuyǐngyí hé yīnxiǎng dōu yǐjīng jiē shàng diànyuán.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting starts, please confirm that the projector and speakers have both been connected to the power supply.

sentences.chinese: 这款应急灯在停电后会自动切换到备用电源。
sentences.traditional: 這款應急燈在停電後會自動切換到備用電源。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yìngjí dēng zài tíngdiàn hòu huì zìdòng qiēhuàn dào bèiyòng diànyuán.
sentences.translation: This emergency lamp will automatically switch to its backup power source after a power cut.

sentences.chinese: 技术员怀疑故障不是软件造成的，而是电源接口松了。
sentences.traditional: 技術員懷疑故障不是軟件造成的，而是電源接口鬆了。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshùyuán huáiyí gùzhàng bú shì ruǎnjiàn zàochéng de, ér shì diànyuán jiēkǒu sōng le.
sentences.translation: The technician suspected that the fault was not caused by the software, but by a loose power connector.

sentences.chinese: 工人用起重机把沉重的设备吊到楼顶，整个过程十分谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 工人用起重機把沉重的設備吊到樓頂，整個過程十分謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén yòng qǐzhòngjī bǎ chénzhòng de shèbèi diào dào lóudǐng, zhěnggè guòchéng shífēn jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: The workers used a crane to hoist the heavy equipment to the roof, and the whole process was carried out very carefully.

sentences.chinese: 墙上吊着一盏旧灯，给空荡的房间增加了几分温暖。
sentences.traditional: 牆上吊著一盞舊燈，給空蕩的房間增加了幾分溫暖。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng diàozhe yì zhǎn jiù dēng, gěi kōngdàng de fángjiān zēngjiā le jǐ fēn wēnnuǎn.
sentences.translation: An old lamp hung on the wall, adding a little warmth to the empty room.

sentences.chinese: 桥梁维修期间，施工队需要把损坏的钢梁暂时吊起来。
sentences.traditional: 橋樑維修期間，施工隊需要把損壞的鋼樑暫時吊起來。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáoliáng wéixiū qījiān, shīgōngduì xūyào bǎ sǔnhuài de gāngliáng zànshí diào qǐlai.
sentences.translation: During the bridge repairs, the construction team needs to temporarily suspend the damaged steel beam.

sentences.chinese: 面对突发洪水，指挥部迅速调动附近的救援力量。
sentences.traditional: 面對突發洪水，指揮部迅速調動附近的救援力量。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā hóngshuǐ, zhǐhuībù xùnsù diàodòng fùjìn de jiùyuán lìliàng.
sentences.translation: Facing the sudden flood, the command centre quickly mobilised nearby rescue forces.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划调动几名有经验的工程师去支持海外项目。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃調動幾名有經驗的工程師去支持海外項目。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà diàodòng jǐ míng yǒu jīngyàn de gōngchéngshī qù zhīchí hǎiwài xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: The company plans to transfer several experienced engineers to support an overseas project.

sentences.chinese: 一篇好的演讲，不仅要提供信息，还要调动听众的情绪。
sentences.traditional: 一篇好的演講，不僅要提供信息，還要調動聽眾的情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Yì piān hǎo de yǎnjiǎng, bùjǐn yào tígōng xìnxī, hái yào diàodòng tīngzhòng de qíngxù.
sentences.translation: A good speech should not only provide information, but also stir the audience’s emotions.

sentences.chinese: 他周末常去河边钓鱼，但更享受安静等待的过程。
sentences.traditional: 他週末常去河邊釣魚，但更享受安靜等待的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōumò cháng qù hébiān diàoyú, dàn gèng xiǎngshòu ānjìng děngdài de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: He often goes fishing by the river at weekends, but he enjoys the quiet process of waiting even more.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护水域生态，公园规定繁殖季节禁止钓鱼。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護水域生態，公園規定繁殖季節禁止釣魚。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù shuǐyù shēngtài, gōngyuán guīdìng fánzhí jìjié jìnzhǐ diàoyú.
sentences.translation: To protect the aquatic ecosystem, the park forbids fishing during the breeding season.

sentences.chinese: 有些诈骗短信看似普通链接，实际上是在“钓鱼”获取个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 有些詐騙短信看似普通鏈接，實際上是在「釣魚」獲取個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē zhàpiàn duǎnxìn kànsì pǔtōng liànjiē, shíjìshang shì zài “diàoyú” huòqǔ gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Some scam text messages look like ordinary links, but are actually “phishing” to obtain personal information.

sentences.chinese: 受全球需求下降影响，原材料价格连续三个月下跌。
sentences.traditional: 受全球需求下降影響，原材料價格連續三個月下跌。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu quánqiú xūqiú xiàjiàng yǐngxiǎng, yuáncáiliào jiàgé liánxù sān gè yuè xiàdiē.
sentences.translation: Affected by the decline in global demand, raw material prices have fallen for three consecutive months.

sentences.chinese: 孩子在台阶上跌了一跤，幸好只是擦破了皮。
sentences.traditional: 孩子在臺階上跌了一跤，幸好只是擦破了皮。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zài táijiē shàng diē le yì jiāo, xìnghǎo zhǐshì cāpò le pí.
sentences.translation: The child fell on the steps; fortunately, he only scraped his skin.

sentences.chinese: 信心一旦动摇，市场指数可能会在短时间内急跌。
sentences.traditional: 信心一旦動搖，市場指數可能會在短時間內急跌。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnxīn yídàn dòngyáo, shìchǎng zhǐshù kěnéng huì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi jídiē.
sentences.translation: Once confidence is shaken, the market index may fall sharply in a short period of time.

sentences.chinese: 山顶的风非常大，队员们只停留了几分钟就下撤。
sentences.traditional: 山頂的風非常大，隊員們只停留了幾分鐘就下撤。
sentences.pinyin: Shāndǐng de fēng fēicháng dà, duìyuánmen zhǐ tíngliú le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù xiàchè.
sentences.translation: The wind at the mountaintop was extremely strong, so the team members stayed only a few minutes before descending.

sentences.chinese: 她在烈日下顶着一箱资料走进会场，脸上全是汗。
sentences.traditional: 她在烈日下頂著一箱資料走進會場，臉上全是汗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài lièrì xià dǐngzhe yì xiāng zīliào zǒu jìn huìchǎng, liǎn shàng quán shì hàn.
sentences.translation: She walked into the venue under the blazing sun with a box of documents balanced on her head, her face covered in sweat.

sentences.chinese: 他买了一顶草帽，准备在草原上拍摄纪录片时戴。
sentences.traditional: 他買了一頂草帽，準備在草原上拍攝紀錄片時戴。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì dǐng cǎomào, zhǔnbèi zài cǎoyuán shàng pāishè jìlùpiàn shí dài.
sentences.translation: He bought a straw hat to wear while filming a documentary on the grassland.

sentences.chinese: 系统显示订单已经生成，但仓库还没有开始发货。
sentences.traditional: 系統顯示訂單已經生成，但倉庫還沒有開始發貨。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng xiǎnshì dìngdān yǐjīng shēngchéng, dàn cāngkù hái méiyǒu kāishǐ fāhuò.
sentences.translation: The system shows that the order has been generated, but the warehouse has not yet started dispatching the goods.

sentences.chinese: 由于客户临时修改需求，这批订单被迫推迟交付。
sentences.traditional: 由於客戶臨時修改需求，這批訂單被迫推遲交付。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú kèhù línshí xiūgǎi xūqiú, zhè pī dìngdān bèipò tuīchí jiāofù.
sentences.translation: Because the customer temporarily changed the requirements, this batch of orders was forced to be delivered late.

sentences.chinese: 如果订单金额超过规定上限，财务部门必须重新审核。
sentences.traditional: 如果訂單金額超過規定上限，財務部門必須重新審核。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dìngdān jīn'é chāoguò guīdìng shàngxiàn, cáiwù bùmén bìxū chóngxīn shěnhé.
sentences.translation: If the order amount exceeds the prescribed upper limit, the finance department must review it again.

sentences.chinese: 他们订婚后并没有急着办婚礼，而是先一起规划未来。
sentences.traditional: 他們訂婚後並沒有急著辦婚禮，而是先一起規劃未來。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen dìnghūn hòu bìng méiyǒu jízhe bàn hūnlǐ, ér shì xiān yìqǐ guīhuà wèilái.
sentences.translation: After getting engaged, they did not rush to hold a wedding, but first planned their future together.

sentences.chinese: 订婚仪式虽然简单，却让双方家庭有机会正式见面。
sentences.traditional: 訂婚儀式雖然簡單，卻讓雙方家庭有機會正式見面。
sentences.pinyin: Dìnghūn yíshì suīrán jiǎndān, què ràng shuāngfāng jiātíng yǒu jīhuì zhèngshì jiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: Although the engagement ceremony was simple, it gave both families a chance to meet formally.

sentences.chinese: 她得知好友突然订婚，不由得大吃一惊。
sentences.traditional: 她得知好友突然訂婚，不由得大吃一驚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dézhī hǎoyǒu tūrán dìnghūn, bùyóude dàchī-yìjīng.
sentences.translation: She was greatly surprised when she learned that her close friend had suddenly got engaged.

sentences.chinese: 商品的定价如果脱离消费者的承受范围，哪怕品质再好也很难畅销。
sentences.traditional: 商品的定價如果脫離消費者的承受範圍，哪怕品質再好也很難暢銷。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngpǐn de dìngjià rúguǒ tuōlí xiāofèizhě de chéngshòu fànwéi, nǎpà pǐnzhì zài hǎo yě hěn nán chàngxiāo.
sentences.translation: If the pricing of a product is beyond what consumers can afford, it will be hard to sell well no matter how good its quality is.

sentences.chinese: 新药上市前，监管部门会对企业的定价方案进行严格审查。
sentences.traditional: 新藥上市前，監管部門會對企業的定價方案進行嚴格審查。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnyào shàngshì qián, jiānguǎn bùmén huì duì qǐyè de dìngjià fāng'àn jìnxíng yángé shěnchá.
sentences.translation: Before a new drug goes on the market, regulators will strictly review the company’s pricing plan.

sentences.chinese: 平台通过算法动态定价，却没有向用户充分解释其依据。
sentences.traditional: 平臺通過算法動態定價，卻沒有向用戶充分解釋其依據。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái tōngguò yǎnsuànfǎ dòngtài dìngjià, què méiyǒu xiàng yònghù chōngfèn jiěshì qí yījù.
sentences.translation: The platform uses algorithms for dynamic pricing, yet does not fully explain the basis for it to users.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他必须定时服药，否则治疗效果会大打折扣。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他必須定時服藥，否則治療效果會大打折扣。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā bìxū dìngshí fúyào, fǒuzé zhìliáo xiàoguǒ huì dà dǎ zhékòu.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him that he must take his medicine at fixed times, otherwise the treatment would be much less effective.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免资料丢失，系统会在后台定时备份所有档案。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免資料丟失，系統會在後臺定時備份所有檔案。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn zīliào diūshī, xìtǒng huì zài hòutái dìngshí bèifèn suǒyǒu dǎng'àn.
sentences.translation: To avoid data loss, the system regularly backs up all files in the background.

sentences.chinese: 定时会议看似占用时间，实际上能让各部门保持信息同步。
sentences.traditional: 定時會議看似佔用時間，實際上能讓各部門保持信息同步。
sentences.pinyin: Dìngshí huìyì kànsì zhànyòng shíjiān, shíjìshang néng ràng gè bùmén bǎochí zīxùn tóngbù.
sentences.translation: Regularly scheduled meetings may seem to take up time, but in fact they keep information aligned across departments.

sentences.chinese: 这款产品的定位过于模糊，既吸引不了年轻人，也留不住老客户。
sentences.traditional: 這款產品的定位過於模糊，既吸引不了年輕人，也留不住老客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn de dìngwèi guòyú móhu, jì xīyǐn bùliǎo niánqīngrén, yě liú bù zhù lǎo kèhù.
sentences.translation: This product’s positioning is too vague: it neither attracts young people nor keeps existing customers.

sentences.chinese: 救援人员通过手机信号定位被困游客的大致位置。
sentences.traditional: 救援人員通過手機信號定位被困遊客的大致位置。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùyuán rényuán tōngguò shǒujī xìnhào dìngwèi bèikùn yóukè de dàzhì wèizhi.
sentences.translation: Rescuers located the approximate position of the trapped tourists through mobile phone signals.

sentences.chinese: 企业重新定位品牌后，广告风格明显变得更年轻。
sentences.traditional: 企業重新定位品牌後，廣告風格明顯變得更年輕。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè chóngxīn dìngwèi pǐnpái hòu, guǎnggào fēnggé míngxiǎn biàn de gèng niánqīng.
sentences.translation: After the company repositioned the brand, the advertising style clearly became younger.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有先定义核心概念，后面的讨论很容易陷入混乱。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有先定義核心概念，後面的討論很容易陷入混亂。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu xiān dìngyì héxīn gàiniàn, hòumiàn de tǎolùn hěn róngyì xiànrù hùnluàn.
sentences.translation: If the core concepts are not defined first, the later discussion can easily fall into confusion.

sentences.chinese: 不同文化对成功的定义并不一致，不能只用财富来衡量。
sentences.traditional: 不同文化對成功的定義並不一致，不能只用財富來衡量。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng wénhuà duì chénggōng de dìngyì bìng bù yízhì, bù néng zhǐ yòng cáifù lái héngliang.
sentences.translation: Different cultures do not define success in the same way, so it cannot be measured only by wealth.

sentences.chinese: 法律条文必须把责任边界定义清楚，才能减少执行中的争议。
sentences.traditional: 法律條文必須把責任邊界定義清楚，才能減少執行中的爭議。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ tiáowén bìxū bǎ zérèn biānjiè dìngyì qīngchu, cái néng jiǎnshǎo zhíxíng zhōng de zhēngyì.
sentences.translation: Legal provisions must clearly define the boundaries of responsibility in order to reduce disputes during implementation.

sentences.chinese: 学校为不同水平的学生定制了分层阅读计划。
sentences.traditional: 學校為不同程度的學生定製了分層閱讀計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi bùtóng shuǐpíng de xuésheng dìngzhì le fēncéng yuèdú jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The school customised tiered reading plans for students at different levels.

sentences.chinese: 定制家具虽然价格较高，却能充分利用狭小空间。
sentences.traditional: 定製傢俱雖然價格較高，卻能充分利用狹小空間。
sentences.pinyin: Dìngzhì jiājù suīrán jiàgé jiào gāo, què néng chōngfèn lìyòng xiáxiǎo kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: Custom-made furniture is relatively expensive, but it can make full use of small spaces.

sentences.chinese: 这套软件可以根据企业流程定制审批权限和报表格式。
sentences.traditional: 這套軟件可以根據企業流程定製審批權限和報表格式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ gēnjù qǐyè liúchéng dìngzhì shěnpī quánxiàn hé bàobiǎo géshì.
sentences.translation: This software can customise approval permissions and report formats according to a company’s workflow.

sentences.chinese: 这栋楼在地震后出现裂缝，居民被临时转移到安全地点。
sentences.traditional: 這棟樓在地震後出現裂縫，居民被臨時轉移到安全地點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dòng lóu zài dìzhèn hòu chūxiàn lièfèng, jūmín bèi línshí zhuǎnyí dào ānquán dìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: This building developed cracks after the earthquake, and the residents were temporarily moved to a safe place.

sentences.chinese: 园区新建了三栋实验楼，用来支持生物技术研究。
sentences.traditional: 園區新建了三棟實驗樓，用來支持生物技術研究。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánqū xīnjiàn le sān dòng shíyànlóu, yòng lái zhīchí shēngwù jìshù yánjiū.
sentences.translation: The park has built three new laboratory buildings to support biotechnology research.

sentences.chinese: 那栋旧厂房经过改造，已经变成了开放式办公空间。
sentences.traditional: 那棟舊廠房經過改造，已經變成了開放式辦公空間。
sentences.pinyin: Nà dòng jiù chǎngfáng jīngguò gǎizào, yǐjīng biànchéng le kāifàngshì bàngōng kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: That old factory building has been renovated and has already become an open-plan office space.

sentences.chinese: 警方仍在调查嫌疑人的动机，暂时没有公布更多细节。
sentences.traditional: 警方仍在調查嫌疑人的動機，暫時沒有公佈更多細節。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng réng zài diàochá xiányírén de dòngjī, zànshí méiyǒu gōngbù gèng duō xìjié.
sentences.translation: The police are still investigating the suspect’s motive and have not released further details for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 学习的动机一旦从外部奖励转向内在兴趣，效果往往更持久。
sentences.traditional: 學習的動機一旦從外部獎勵轉向內在興趣，效果往往更持久。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí de dòngjī yídàn cóng wàibù jiǎnglì zhuǎnxiàng nèizài xìngqù, xiàoguǒ wǎngwǎng gèng chíjiǔ.
sentences.translation: Once the motivation for learning shifts from external rewards to inner interest, the results are often more lasting.

sentences.chinese: 他捐款的动机很单纯，只是希望受灾家庭尽快恢复生活。
sentences.traditional: 他捐款的動機很單純，只是希望受災家庭儘快恢復生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juānkuǎn de dòngjī hěn dānchún, zhǐshì xīwàng shòuzāi jiātíng jǐnkuài huīfù shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: His motive for donating was very simple: he just hoped that the disaster-hit families could return to normal life as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 清晰的目标能为团队提供持续推进项目的动力。
sentences.traditional: 清晰的目標能為團隊提供持續推進項目的動力。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngxī de mùbiāo néng wèi tuánduì tígōng chíxù tuījìn xiàngmù de dònglì.
sentences.translation: Clear goals can provide the team with the drive to keep pushing the project forward.

sentences.chinese: 经济增长的动力正在从低成本制造转向科技创新。
sentences.traditional: 經濟成長的動力正在從低成本製造轉向科技創新。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngjì zēngzhǎng de dònglì zhèngzài cóng dī chéngběn zhìzào zhuǎnxiàng kējì chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: The driving force of economic growth is shifting from low-cost manufacturing to technological innovation.

sentences.chinese: 失败并没有削弱他的动力，反而促使他重新审视策略。
sentences.traditional: 失敗並沒有削弱他的動力，反而促使他重新審視策略。
sentences.pinyin: Shībài bìng méiyǒu xuēruò tā de dònglì, fǎn'ér cùshǐ tā chóngxīn shěnshì cèlüè.
sentences.translation: Failure did not weaken his motivation; instead, it prompted him to re-examine his strategy.

sentences.chinese: 这部动漫不只面向儿童，也讨论了战争与记忆之间的关系。
sentences.traditional: 這部動漫不只面向兒童，也討論了戰爭與記憶之間的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù dòngmàn bùzhǐ miànxiàng értóng, yě tǎolùn le zhànzhēng yǔ jìyì zhījiān de guānxì.
sentences.translation: This anime is not only aimed at children; it also discusses the relationship between war and memory.

sentences.chinese: 国内动漫产业近几年发展迅速，但原创人才仍然不足。
sentences.traditional: 國內動漫產業近幾年發展迅速，但原創人才仍然不足。
sentences.pinyin: Guónèi dòngmàn chǎnyè jìn jǐ nián fāzhǎn xùnsù, dàn yuánchuàng réncái réngrán bùzú.
sentences.translation: The domestic animation industry has developed rapidly in recent years, but original creative talent is still insufficient.

sentences.chinese: 他通过分析动漫角色的成长线，写了一篇关于身份认同的论文。
sentences.traditional: 他通過分析動漫角色的成長線，寫了一篇關於身份認同的論文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngguò fēnxī dòngmàn juésè de chéngzhǎngxiàn, xiě le yì piān guānyú shēnfèn rèntóng de lùnwén.
sentences.translation: By analysing the growth arcs of anime characters, he wrote a paper on identity.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要及时掌握市场动态，才能调整采购计划。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要及時掌握市場動態，才能調整採購計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào jíshí zhǎngwò shìchǎng dòngtài, cái néng tiáozhěng cǎigòu jìhuà.
sentences.translation: We need to keep track of market trends in time so that we can adjust the procurement plan.

sentences.chinese: 动态管理不是频繁改变目标，而是根据现实情况作出修正。
sentences.traditional: 動態管理不是頻繁改變目標，而是根據現實情況作出修正。
sentences.pinyin: Dòngtài guǎnlǐ bú shì pínfán gǎibiàn mùbiāo, ér shì gēnjù xiànshí qíngkuàng zuòchū xiūzhèng.
sentences.translation: Dynamic management does not mean frequently changing goals, but making adjustments according to real conditions.

sentences.chinese: 这张地图可以动态显示雨量变化，为防洪决策提供依据。
sentences.traditional: 這張地圖可以動態顯示雨量變化，為防洪決策提供依據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú kěyǐ dòngtài xiǎnshì yǔliàng biànhuà, wèi fánghóng juécè tígōng yījù.
sentences.translation: This map can dynamically display changes in rainfall and provide a basis for flood-control decisions.

sentences.chinese: 这首民歌旋律动听，却隐藏着一段沉重的历史。
sentences.traditional: 這首民歌旋律動聽，卻隱藏著一段沉重的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu míngē xuánlǜ dòngtīng, què yǐncáng zhe yí duàn chénzhòng de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: The melody of this folk song is pleasant to listen to, yet it hides a heavy piece of history.

sentences.chinese: 她的声音并不高，却因情感真挚而格外动听。
sentences.traditional: 她的聲音並不高，卻因情感真摯而格外動聽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn bìng bù gāo, què yīn qínggǎn zhēnzhì ér géwài dòngtīng.
sentences.translation: Her voice is not high, but because the emotion is sincere, it sounds especially moving.

sentences.chinese: 广告词写得再动听，如果产品质量不过关也难以赢得信任。
sentences.traditional: 廣告詞寫得再動聽，如果產品質量不過關也難以贏得信任。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnggào cí xiě de zài dòngtīng, rúguǒ chǎnpǐn zhìliàng bú guòguān yě nányǐ yíngdé xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: No matter how appealing the advertising copy sounds, it is hard to win trust if the product quality is not up to standard.

sentences.chinese: 他故意逗孩子笑，想缓和紧张的气氛。
sentences.traditional: 他故意逗孩子笑，想緩和緊張的氣氛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gùyì dòu háizi xiào, xiǎng huǎnhé jǐnzhāng de qìfēn.
sentences.translation: He deliberately made the child laugh, hoping to ease the tense atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 这段对话看似很逗，实际上讽刺了职场里的形式主义。
sentences.traditional: 這段對話看似很逗，實際上諷刺了職場裡的形式主義。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn duìhuà kànsì hěn dòu, shíjìshang fěngcì le zhíchǎng lǐ de xíngshì zhǔyì.
sentences.translation: This dialogue may seem funny, but in fact it satirises formalism in the workplace.

sentences.chinese: 别再逗那只狗了，它已经明显不耐烦了。
sentences.traditional: 別再逗那隻狗了，它已經明顯不耐煩了。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zài dòu nà zhī gǒu le, tā yǐjīng míngxiǎn bú nàifán le.
sentences.translation: Stop teasing that dog; it is already clearly impatient.

sentences.chinese: 这场斗争不仅发生在市场上，也发生在观念层面。
sentences.traditional: 這場鬥爭不僅發生在市場上，也發生在觀念層面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dòuzhēng bùjǐn fāshēng zài shìchǎng shàng, yě fāshēng zài guānniàn céngmiàn.
sentences.translation: This struggle takes place not only in the market, but also at the level of ideas.

sentences.chinese: 他长期与疾病斗争，却从未放弃对生活的热情。
sentences.traditional: 他長期與疾病鬥爭，卻從未放棄對生活的熱情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángqī yǔ jíbìng dòuzhēng, què cóngwèi fàngqì duì shēnghuó de rèqíng.
sentences.translation: He has long struggled with illness, yet he has never given up his passion for life.

sentences.chinese: 在改革过程中，不同利益群体之间的斗争往往十分复杂。
sentences.traditional: 在改革過程中，不同利益群體之間的鬥爭往往十分複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǎigé guòchéng zhōng, bùtóng lìyì qúntǐ zhījiān de dòuzhēng wǎngwǎng shífēn fùzá.
sentences.translation: During the process of reform, struggles between different interest groups are often extremely complex.

sentences.chinese: 快节奏的都市生活让许多人渴望重新接近自然。
sentences.traditional: 快節奏的都市生活讓許多人渴望重新接近自然。
sentences.pinyin: Kuài jiézòu de dūshì shēnghuó ràng xǔduō rén kěwàng chóngxīn jiējìn zìrán.
sentences.translation: Fast-paced urban life makes many people long to reconnect with nature.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说描写了现代都市中人与人之间的疏离感。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說描寫了現代都市中人與人之間的疏離感。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō miáoxiě le xiàndài dūshì zhōng rén yǔ rén zhījiān de shūlí gǎn.
sentences.translation: This novel depicts the sense of alienation between people in the modern city.

sentences.chinese: 随着交通网络完善，周边城镇逐渐融入了大都市圈。
sentences.traditional: 隨著交通網絡完善，周邊城鎮逐漸融入了大都市圈。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe jiāotōng wǎngluò wánshàn, zhōubiān chéngzhèn zhújiàn róngrù le dà dūshì quān.
sentences.translation: As the transport network improves, surrounding towns are gradually being integrated into the metropolitan area.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物的毒主要集中在根部，处理时必须戴手套。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物的毒主要集中在根部，處理時必須戴手套。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de dú zhǔyào jízhōng zài gēnbù, chǔlǐ shí bìxū dài shǒutào.
sentences.translation: The poison of this plant is mainly concentrated in the roots, so gloves must be worn when handling it.

sentences.chinese: 网络上的恶意评论像毒一样，会慢慢伤害一个人的信心。
sentences.traditional: 網絡上的惡意評論像毒一樣，會慢慢傷害一個人的信心。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò shàng de èyì pínglùn xiàng dú yíyàng, huì mànmàn shānghài yí ge rén de xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: Malicious comments online are like poison: they can slowly damage a person’s confidence.

sentences.chinese: 工厂必须严格处理有毒废水，不能把风险转嫁给周边居民。
sentences.traditional: 工廠必須嚴格處理有毒廢水，不能把風險轉嫁給周邊居民。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng bìxū yángé chǔlǐ yǒudú fèishuǐ, bù néng bǎ fēngxiǎn zhuǎnjià gěi zhōubiān jūmín.
sentences.translation: Factories must strictly treat toxic wastewater and must not shift the risk onto nearby residents.

sentences.chinese: 船夫等风浪平息后，才把游客渡到对岸。
sentences.traditional: 船夫等風浪平息後，才把遊客渡到對岸。
sentences.pinyin: Chuánfū děng fēnglàng píngxī hòu, cái bǎ yóukè dù dào duì'àn.
sentences.translation: The boatman waited until the wind and waves had calmed before ferrying the tourists to the opposite bank.

sentences.chinese: 那座古桥见证了几代人渡河求学的艰辛。
sentences.traditional: 那座古橋見證了幾代人渡河求學的艱辛。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zuò gǔqiáo jiànzhèng le jǐ dài rén dù hé qiúxué de jiānxīn.
sentences.translation: That ancient bridge witnessed the hardship of several generations crossing the river to study.

sentences.chinese: 企业正试图渡过最困难的阶段，重新恢复现金流。
sentences.traditional: 企業正試圖渡過最困難的階段，重新恢復現金流。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè zhèng shìtú dùguò zuì kùnnán de jiēduàn, chóngxīn huīfù xiànjīnliú.
sentences.translation: The company is trying to get through the most difficult stage and restore its cash flow.

sentences.chinese: 服务员端来一壶热茶，请客人在大厅稍等。
sentences.traditional: 服務員端來一壺熱茶，請客人在大廳稍等。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán duān lái yì hú rèchá, qǐng kèrén zài dàtīng shāo děng.
sentences.translation: The waiter brought over a pot of hot tea and asked the guests to wait in the lobby.

sentences.chinese: 他端着相机站在路边，记录拆除旧楼的全过程。
sentences.traditional: 他端著相機站在路邊，記錄拆除舊樓的全過程。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duān zhe xiàngjī zhàn zài lùbiān, jìlù chāichú jiù lóu de quán guòchéng.
sentences.translation: He stood by the roadside holding a camera, recording the whole process of demolishing the old building.

sentences.chinese: 别总端着领导的架子，真正的合作需要平等沟通。
sentences.traditional: 別總端著領導的架子，真正的合作需要平等溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zǒng duān zhe lǐngdǎo de jiàzi, zhēnzhèng de hézuò xūyào píngděng gōutōng.
sentences.translation: Do not always put on the airs of a leader; real cooperation requires equal communication.

sentences.chinese: 由于芯片短缺，厂家不得不推迟新车交付。
sentences.traditional: 由於晶片短缺，廠家不得不推遲新車交付。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú jīngpiàn duǎnquē, chǎngjiā bùdébù tuīchí xīnchē jiāofù.
sentences.translation: Because of the chip shortage, the manufacturer had to delay delivery of the new cars.

sentences.chinese: 人才短缺已经成为制约本土企业创新的主要因素。
sentences.traditional: 人才短缺已經成為制約本土企業創新的主要因素。
sentences.pinyin: Réncái duǎnquē yǐjīng chéngwéi zhìyuē běntǔ qǐyè chuàngxīn de zhǔyào yīnsù.
sentences.translation: A shortage of talent has already become a major factor restricting innovation among local companies.

sentences.chinese: 雨季过后，部分地区仍然短缺干净的饮用水。
sentences.traditional: 雨季過後，部分地區仍然短缺乾淨的飲用水。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔjì guòhòu, bùfèn dìqū réngrán duǎnquē gānjìng de yǐnyòngshuǐ.
sentences.translation: After the rainy season, some areas are still short of clean drinking water.

sentences.chinese: 这座建筑的外观完全对称，却并不显得单调。
sentences.traditional: 這座建築的外觀完全對稱，卻並不顯得單調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò jiànzhù de wàiguān wánquán duìchèn, què bìng bù xiǎnde dāndiào.
sentences.translation: The exterior of this building is completely symmetrical, yet it does not look monotonous.

sentences.chinese: 设计师故意打破对称布局，让空间更有动感。
sentences.traditional: 設計師故意打破對稱佈局，讓空間更有動感。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī gùyì dǎpò duìchèn bùjú, ràng kōngjiān gèng yǒu dònggǎn.
sentences.translation: The designer deliberately broke the symmetrical layout to make the space feel more dynamic.

sentences.chinese: 数据分布并不对称，因此不能只看平均值。
sentences.traditional: 數據分佈並不對稱，因此不能只看平均值。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù fēnbù bìng bú duìchèn, yīncǐ bù néng zhǐ kàn píngjūnzhí.
sentences.translation: The data distribution is not symmetrical, so one cannot look only at the average.

sentences.chinese: 新系统上线前，技术团队要先完成与旧平台的对接。
sentences.traditional: 新系統上線前，技術團隊要先完成與舊平臺的對接。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng shàngxiàn qián, jìshù tuánduì yào xiān wánchéng yǔ jiù píngtái de duìjiē.
sentences.translation: Before the new system goes live, the technical team must first complete its integration with the old platform.

sentences.chinese: 两家公司正在对接供应链数据，以提高订单处理效率。
sentences.traditional: 兩家公司正在對接供應鏈數據，以提高訂單處理效率。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī zhèngzài duìjiē gōngyìngliàn shùjù, yǐ tígāo dìngdān chǔlǐ xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The two companies are linking up their supply-chain data to improve order-processing efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 政策发布后，地方部门需要尽快对接具体执行步骤。
sentences.traditional: 政策發布後，地方部門需要儘快對接具體執行步驟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè fābù hòu, dìfāng bùmén xūyào jǐnkuài duìjiē jùtǐ zhíxíng bùzhòu.
sentences.translation: After the policy is issued, local departments need to connect it with concrete implementation steps as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 面对不公平待遇，员工选择通过法律途径进行对抗。
sentences.traditional: 面對不公平待遇，員工選擇通過法律途徑進行對抗。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì bù gōngpíng dàiyù, yuángōng xuǎnzé tōngguò fǎlǜ tújìng jìnxíng duìkàng.
sentences.translation: Facing unfair treatment, the employees chose to confront it through legal channels.

sentences.chinese: 这场比赛不仅是体力的对抗，也是心理的较量。
sentences.traditional: 這場比賽不僅是體力的對抗，也是心理的較量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài bùjǐn shì tǐlì de duìkàng, yě shì xīnlǐ de jiàoliàng.
sentences.translation: This match is not only a physical confrontation, but also a psychological contest.

sentences.chinese: 他们试图用合作取代长期以来的对抗关系。
sentences.traditional: 他們試圖用合作取代長期以來的對抗關係。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shìtú yòng hézuò qǔdài chángqī yǐlái de duìkàng guānxì.
sentences.translation: They tried to replace the long-standing confrontational relationship with cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 在这个问题上，双方观点明显对立，短期内难以达成一致。
sentences.traditional: 在這個問題上，雙方觀點明顯對立，短期內難以達成一致。
