sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shàng, shuāngfāng guāndiǎn míngxiǎn duìlì, duǎnqī nèi nányǐ dáchéng yízhì.
sentences.translation: On this issue, the two sides’ views are clearly opposed, making agreement difficult in the short term.

sentences.chinese: 把传统与创新完全对立起来，是一种过于简单的理解。
sentences.traditional: 把傳統與創新完全對立起來，是一種過於簡單的理解。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎ chuántǒng yǔ chuàngxīn wánquán duìlì qǐlái, shì yì zhǒng guòyú jiǎndān de lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: Setting tradition and innovation in complete opposition is an overly simplistic understanding.

sentences.chinese: 两种制度长期对立，却也在交流中互相影响。
sentences.traditional: 兩種制度長期對立，卻也在交流中互相影響。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng zhǒng zhìdù chángqī duìlì, què yě zài jiāoliú zhōng hùxiāng yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The two systems have long been in opposition, yet they also influence each other through exchange.

sentences.chinese: 表格中的编号必须与合同条款一一对应。
sentences.traditional: 表格中的編號必須與合同條款一一對應。
sentences.pinyin: Biǎogé zhōng de biānhào bìxū yǔ hétong tiáokuǎn yīyī duìyìng.
sentences.translation: The numbers in the table must correspond one by one with the clauses in the contract.

sentences.chinese: 每项政策都应有对应的预算来源，否则难以执行。
sentences.traditional: 每項政策都應有對應的預算來源，否則難以執行。
sentences.pinyin: Měi xiàng zhèngcè dōu yīng yǒu duìyìng de yùsuàn láiyuán, fǒuzé nányǐ zhíxíng.
sentences.translation: Every policy should have a corresponding budget source; otherwise, it will be difficult to implement.

sentences.chinese: 这些数据和去年同期的数据并不完全对应。
sentences.traditional: 這些數據和去年同期的數據並不完全對應。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù hé qùnián tóngqī de shùjù bìng bù wánquán duìyìng.
sentences.translation: These figures do not fully correspond to the data from the same period last year.

sentences.chinese: 记者在医院门口蹲了一整夜，终于等到当事人出现。
sentences.traditional: 記者在醫院門口蹲了一整夜，終於等到當事人出現。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě zài yīyuàn ménkǒu dūn le yì zhěng yè, zhōngyú děngdào dāngshìrén chūxiàn.
sentences.translation: The reporter squatted outside the hospital entrance all night and finally waited for the person involved to appear.

sentences.chinese: 孩子蹲在地上观察蚂蚁，完全忘了时间。
sentences.traditional: 孩子蹲在地上觀察螞蟻，完全忘了時間。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi dūn zài dìshang guānchá mǎyǐ, wánquán wàng le shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The child squatted on the ground observing ants, completely losing track of time.

sentences.chinese: 消防员必须蹲低身体穿过浓烟，才能接近火源。
sentences.traditional: 消防員必須蹲低身體穿過濃煙，才能接近火源。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán bìxū dūn dī shēntǐ chuānguò nóngyān, cái néng jiējìn huǒyuán.
sentences.translation: The firefighter had to crouch low through the thick smoke in order to approach the source of the fire.

sentences.chinese: 消息一公布，会议室里顿时安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 消息一公佈，會議室裡頓時安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāoxi yì gōngbù, huìyìshì lǐ dùnshí ānjìng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: As soon as the news was announced, the meeting room immediately fell silent.

sentences.chinese: 他听到熟悉的旋律，顿时想起了童年的夏天。
sentences.traditional: 他聽到熟悉的旋律，頓時想起了童年的夏天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngdào shúxī de xuánlǜ, dùnshí xiǎngqǐ le tóngnián de xiàtiān.
sentences.translation: When he heard the familiar melody, he suddenly remembered the summers of his childhood.

sentences.chinese: 证据被展示出来后，局面顿时发生了变化。
sentences.traditional: 證據被展示出來後，局面頓時發生了變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngjù bèi zhǎnshì chūlai hòu, júmiàn dùnshí fāshēng le biànhuà.
sentences.translation: After the evidence was presented, the situation changed at once.

sentences.chinese: 这位演员多才多艺，不仅会表演，还能作曲和导演。
sentences.traditional: 這位演員多才多藝，不僅會表演，還能作曲和導演。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán duōcái-duōyì, bùjǐn huì biǎoyǎn, hái néng zuòqǔ hé dǎoyǎn.
sentences.translation: This actor is versatile: not only can he act, he can also compose and direct.

sentences.chinese: 学校不应只看成绩，也要鼓励学生变得多才多艺。
sentences.traditional: 學校不應只看成績，也要鼓勵學生變得多才多藝。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bù yīng zhǐ kàn chéngjì, yě yào gǔlì xuéshēng biàn de duōcái-duōyì.
sentences.translation: Schools should not look only at grades; they should also encourage students to become versatile.

sentences.chinese: 他表面上很低调，实际上是个多才多艺的人。
sentences.traditional: 他表面上很低調，實際上是個多才多藝的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biǎomiàn shàng hěn dīdiào, shíjì shàng shì ge duōcái-duōyì de rén.
sentences.translation: He appears modest on the surface, but in fact he is a very versatile person.

sentences.chinese: 多亏志愿者及时赶到，受伤的游客才得到了救助。
sentences.traditional: 多虧志願者及時趕到，受傷的遊客才得到了救助。
sentences.pinyin: Duōkuī zhìyuànzhě jíshí gǎndào, shòushāng de yóukè cái dédào le jiùzhù.
sentences.translation: Thanks to the volunteers arriving in time, the injured tourist received help.

sentences.chinese: 这次项目能顺利完成，多亏团队提前做了充分准备。
sentences.traditional: 這次項目能順利完成，多虧團隊提前做了充分準備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù néng shùnlì wánchéng, duōkuī tuánduì tíqián zuò le chōngfèn zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: This project was completed smoothly thanks to the team having made thorough preparations in advance.

sentences.chinese: 多亏那份旧档案，我们才查清了事情的来龙去脉。
sentences.traditional: 多虧那份舊檔案，我們才查清了事情的來龍去脈。
sentences.pinyin: Duōkuī nà fèn jiù dàng'àn, wǒmen cái cháqīng le shìqing de láilóng-qùmài.
sentences.translation: Thanks to that old file, we were able to clarify the whole sequence of events.

sentences.chinese: 这门课大量使用多媒体资料，帮助学生理解抽象概念。
sentences.traditional: 這門課大量使用多媒體資料，幫助學生理解抽象概念。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kè dàliàng shǐyòng duōméitǐ zīliào, bāngzhù xuéshēng lǐjiě chōuxiàng gàiniàn.
sentences.translation: This course makes extensive use of multimedia materials to help students understand abstract concepts.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆通过多媒体展览，让观众更直观地了解历史。
sentences.traditional: 博物館通過多媒體展覽，讓觀眾更直觀地了解歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn tōngguò duōméitǐ zhǎnlǎn, ràng guānzhòng gèng zhíguān de liǎojiě lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: The museum uses multimedia exhibitions to help visitors understand history more intuitively.

sentences.chinese: 会议室的多媒体设备突然坏了，演讲只好临时调整。
sentences.traditional: 會議室的多媒體設備突然壞了，演講只好臨時調整。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì de duōméitǐ shèbèi tūrán huài le, yǎnjiǎng zhǐhǎo línshí tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: The multimedia equipment in the meeting room suddenly broke down, so the presentation had to be adjusted on the spot.

sentences.chinese: 为了让文章更有力，编辑删掉了几段多余的说明。
sentences.traditional: 為了讓文章更有力，編輯刪掉了幾段多餘的說明。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ràng wénzhāng gèng yǒulì, biānjí shāndiào le jǐ duàn duōyú de shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: To make the article stronger, the editor deleted several unnecessary explanatory passages.

sentences.chinese: 在这种情况下，过多的解释反而显得多余。
sentences.traditional: 在這種情況下，過多的解釋反而顯得多餘。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, guòduō de jiěshì fǎn'ér xiǎnde duōyú.
sentences.translation: In this situation, too much explanation instead seems unnecessary.

sentences.chinese: 如果功能设计得不够清楚，再漂亮的装饰也是多余的。
sentences.traditional: 如果功能設計得不夠清楚，再漂亮的裝飾也是多餘的。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ gōngnéng shèjì de bú gòu qīngchu, zài piàoliang de zhuāngshì yě shì duōyú de.
sentences.translation: If the function is not designed clearly enough, even beautiful decoration is superfluous.

sentences.chinese: 一个多元的社会，应当允许不同声音被理性讨论。
sentences.traditional: 一個多元的社會，應當允許不同聲音被理性討論。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge duōyuán de shèhuì, yīngdāng yǔnxǔ bùtóng shēngyīn bèi lǐxìng tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: A diverse society should allow different voices to be discussed rationally.

sentences.chinese: 公司希望建立多元团队，以提升创新能力。
sentences.traditional: 公司希望建立多元團隊，以提升創新能力。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xīwàng jiànlì duōyuán tuánduì, yǐ tíshēng chuàngxīn nénglì.
sentences.translation: The company hopes to build a diverse team in order to improve its capacity for innovation.

sentences.chinese: 当代城市文化呈现出更加多元的发展趋势。
sentences.traditional: 當代城市文化呈現出更加多元的發展趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdài chéngshì wénhuà chéngxiàn chū gèngjiā duōyuán de fāzhǎn qūshì.
sentences.translation: Contemporary urban culture is showing a more pluralistic trend of development.

sentences.chinese: 在紧急情况下，他夺过方向盘，避免了车辆冲进河里。
sentences.traditional: 在緊急情況下，他奪過方向盤，避免了車輛衝進河裡。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, tā duó guò fāngxiàngpán, bìmiǎn le chēliàng chōng jìn hé lǐ.
sentences.translation: In the emergency, he grabbed the steering wheel and prevented the vehicle from rushing into the river.

sentences.chinese: 这支球队在最后一分钟夺得冠军，令全场观众沸腾起来。
sentences.traditional: 這支球隊在最後一分鐘奪得冠軍，令全場觀眾沸騰起來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì zài zuìhòu yì fēnzhōng duó dé guànjūn, lìng quánchǎng guānzhòng fèiténg qǐlái.
sentences.translation: This team won the championship in the final minute, making the whole crowd boil with excitement.

sentences.chinese: 战争夺去了许多人的家园，也改变了整座城市的命运。
sentences.traditional: 戰爭奪去了許多人的家園，也改變了整座城市的命運。
sentences.pinyin: Zhànzhēng duó qù le xǔduō rén de jiāyuán, yě gǎibiàn le zhěng zuò chéngshì de mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: The war took away many people’s homes and also changed the fate of the entire city.

sentences.chinese: 起义军经过数日激战，终于夺取了那座战略要塞。
sentences.traditional: 起義軍經過數日激戰，終於奪取了那座戰略要塞。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyìjūn jīngguò shù rì jīzhàn, zhōngyú duóqǔ le nà zuò zhànlüè yàosài.
sentences.translation: After several days of fierce fighting, the rebel army finally captured that strategic fortress.

sentences.chinese: 那家公司试图通过低价策略夺取更多市场份额。
sentences.traditional: 那家公司試圖通過低價策略奪取更多市場份額。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngsī shìtú tōngguò dījià cèlüè duóqǔ gèng duō shìchǎng fèn'é.
sentences.translation: That company is trying to seize more market share through a low-price strategy.

sentences.chinese: 运动员必须克服伤病，才有机会夺取金牌。
sentences.traditional: 運動員必須克服傷病，才有機會奪取金牌。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán bìxū kèfú shāngbìng, cái yǒu jīhuì duóqǔ jīnpái.
sentences.translation: The athlete must overcome injury and illness before having a chance to win the gold medal.

sentences.chinese: 行人纷纷跑进商店躲避突如其来的暴雨。
sentences.traditional: 行人紛紛跑進商店躲避突如其來的暴雨。
sentences.pinyin: Xíngrén fēnfēn pǎo jìn shāngdiàn duǒbì tūrúqílái de bàoyǔ.
sentences.translation: Pedestrians rushed into shops one after another to take shelter from the sudden downpour.

sentences.chinese: 他不愿面对问题，总是找借口躲避责任。
sentences.traditional: 他不願面對問題，總是找借口躲避責任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú yuàn miànduì wèntí, zǒng shì zhǎo jièkǒu duǒbì zérèn.
sentences.translation: He is unwilling to face problems and always finds excuses to avoid responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 车辆为了躲避落石，突然转向了右侧车道。
sentences.traditional: 車輛為了躲避落石，突然轉向了右側車道。
sentences.pinyin: Chēliàng wèile duǒbì luòshí, tūrán zhuǎnxiàng le yòu cè chēdào.
sentences.translation: To avoid falling rocks, the vehicle suddenly turned into the right-hand lane.

sentences.chinese: 闻到变质牛奶的味道后，他马上觉得恶心。
sentences.traditional: 聞到變質牛奶的味道後，他馬上覺得噁心。
sentences.pinyin: Wéndào biànzhì niúnǎi de wèidao hòu, tā mǎshàng juéde ěxin.
sentences.translation: After smelling the spoiled milk, he immediately felt nauseous.

sentences.chinese: 这种利用灾难赚钱的行为让人感到恶心。
sentences.traditional: 這種利用災難賺錢的行為讓人感到噁心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng lìyòng zāinàn zhuànqián de xíngwéi ràng rén gǎndào ěxin.
sentences.translation: This kind of behaviour, making money from disaster, makes people feel disgusted.

sentences.chinese: 他晕船晕得厉害，刚上岸还一直恶心。
sentences.traditional: 他暈船暈得厲害，剛上岸還一直噁心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yùnchuán yùn de lìhai, gāng shàng'àn hái yìzhí ěxin.
sentences.translation: He was badly seasick and still felt nauseous after just coming ashore.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，所有出海的船只都被要求返航。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣惡劣，所有出海的船隻都被要求返航。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, suǒyǒu chūhǎi de chuánzhī dōu bèi yāoqiú fǎnháng.
sentences.translation: Because the weather was severe, all vessels that had gone out to sea were ordered to return.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业因工作条件恶劣而受到媒体批评。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業因工作條件惡劣而受到媒體批評。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè yīn gōngzuò tiáojiàn èliè ér shòudào méitǐ pīpíng.
sentences.translation: This company was criticised by the media because of its poor working conditions.

sentences.chinese: 恶劣的竞争环境反而迫使公司加快创新。
sentences.traditional: 惡劣的競爭環境反而迫使公司加快創新。
sentences.pinyin: Èliè de jìngzhēng huánjìng fǎn'ér pòshǐ gōngsī jiākuài chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: A harsh competitive environment instead forced the company to speed up innovation.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院的儿科常年人满为患，预约非常困难。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院的兒科常年人滿為患，預約非常困難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de érkē chángnián rénmǎn-wéihuàn, yùyuē fēicháng kùnnan.
sentences.translation: The paediatrics department of this hospital is overcrowded all year round, so appointments are very difficult to get.

sentences.chinese: 她从医学院毕业后，决定留在儿科工作。
sentences.traditional: 她從醫學院畢業後，決定留在兒科工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng yīxuéyuàn bìyè hòu, juédìng liú zài érkē gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: After graduating from medical school, she decided to stay and work in paediatrics.

sentences.chinese: 儿科医生提醒家长，不要随意给孩子服用成人药。
sentences.traditional: 兒科醫生提醒家長，不要隨意給孩子服用成人藥。
sentences.pinyin: Érkē yīshēng tíxǐng jiāzhǎng, bú yào suíyì gěi háizi fúyòng chéngrén yào.
sentences.translation: Paediatric doctors remind parents not to give children adult medicine casually.

sentences.chinese: 她在典礼上戴了一对祖母留下来的银耳环。
sentences.traditional: 她在典禮上戴了一對祖母留下來的銀耳環。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài diǎnlǐ shang dài le yí duì zǔmǔ liú xiàlai de yín ěrhuán.
sentences.translation: At the ceremony, she wore a pair of silver earrings left to her by her grandmother.

sentences.chinese: 那副耳环虽然设计简单，却衬托出她的气质。
sentences.traditional: 那副耳環雖然設計簡單，卻襯托出她的氣質。
sentences.pinyin: Nà fù ěrhuán suīrán shèjì jiǎndān, què chèntuō chū tā de qìzhì.
sentences.translation: Although that pair of earrings is simple in design, it brings out her elegance.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展出的古代耳环反映了当时的审美观念。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展出的古代耳環反映了當時的審美觀念。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū de gǔdài ěrhuán fǎnyìng le dāngshí de shěnměi guānniàn.
sentences.translation: The ancient earrings displayed in the museum reflect the aesthetic ideas of that time.

sentences.chinese: 植物通过光合作用吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。
sentences.traditional: 植物通過光合作用吸收二氧化碳並釋放氧氣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhíwù tōngguò guānghé-zuòyòng xīshōu èryǎnghuàtàn bìng shìfàng yǎngqì.
sentences.translation: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen through photosynthesis.

sentences.chinese: 控制二氧化碳排放，是实现低碳发展的关键步骤。
sentences.traditional: 控制二氧化碳排放，是實現低碳發展的關鍵步驟。
sentences.pinyin: Kòngzhì èryǎnghuàtàn páifàng, shì shíxiàn dītàn fāzhǎn de guānjiàn bùzhòu.
sentences.translation: Controlling carbon dioxide emissions is a key step in achieving low-carbon development.

sentences.chinese: 会议室里的二氧化碳浓度过高，难怪大家都觉得头晕。
sentences.traditional: 會議室裡的二氧化碳濃度過高，難怪大家都覺得頭暈。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì lǐ de èryǎnghuàtàn nóngdù guò gāo, nánguài dàjiā dōu juéde tóuyūn.
sentences.translation: The carbon dioxide concentration in the meeting room was too high, so no wonder everyone felt dizzy.

sentences.chinese: 这种传染病通常在感染后三到五天发病。
sentences.traditional: 這種傳染病通常在感染後三到五天發病。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chuánrǎnbìng tōngcháng zài gǎnrǎn hòu sān dào wǔ tiān fābìng.
sentences.translation: This infectious disease usually appears three to five days after infection.

sentences.chinese: 老年人一旦突然发病，家属应立即拨打急救电话。
sentences.traditional: 老年人一旦突然發病，家屬應立即撥打急救電話。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoniánrén yídàn tūrán fābìng, jiāshǔ yīng lìjí bōdǎ jíjiù diànhuà.
sentences.translation: Once an elderly person suddenly falls ill, family members should immediately call emergency services.

sentences.chinese: 医生通过统计发病时间，判断污染源可能来自水源。
sentences.traditional: 醫生通過統計發病時間，判斷污染源可能來自水源。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngguò tǒngjì fābìng shíjiān, pànduàn wūrǎnyuán kěnéng láizì shuǐyuán.
sentences.translation: By analysing the time of onset, doctors judged that the source of contamination might be the water supply.

sentences.chinese: 面对不断上涨的成本，许多小店老板开始发愁。
sentences.traditional: 面對不斷上漲的成本，許多小店老闆開始發愁。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì búduàn shàngzhǎng de chéngběn, xǔduō xiǎodiàn lǎobǎn kāishǐ fāchóu.
sentences.translation: Faced with constantly rising costs, many small shop owners have begun to worry.

sentences.chinese: 与其为结果发愁，不如先把能做的步骤做好。
sentences.traditional: 與其為結果發愁，不如先把能做的步驟做好。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí wèi jiéguǒ fāchóu, bùrú xiān bǎ néng zuò de bùzhòu zuò hǎo.
sentences.translation: Rather than worrying about the result, it is better first to do the steps you can do properly.

sentences.chinese: 孩子迟迟不肯睡觉，父母为此发愁了好几天。
sentences.traditional: 孩子遲遲不肯睡覺，父母為此發愁了好幾天。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi chíchí bù kěn shuìjiào, fùmǔ wèi cǐ fāchóu le hǎo jǐ tiān.
sentences.translation: The child refused to go to sleep for days, and the parents worried about it for several days.

sentences.chinese: 风力发电虽然受天气影响较大，但在沿海地区仍具有明显优势。
sentences.traditional: 風力發電雖然受天氣影響較大，但在沿海地區仍具有明顯優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Fēnglì fādiàn suīrán shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng jiào dà, dàn zài yánhǎi dìqū réng jùyǒu míngxiǎn yōushì.
sentences.translation: Although wind power generation is greatly affected by weather, it still has clear advantages in coastal areas.

sentences.chinese: 这座水库不仅承担灌溉任务，还负责为附近城镇发电。
sentences.traditional: 這座水庫不僅承擔灌溉任務，還負責為附近城鎮發電。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò shuǐkù bùjǐn chéngdān guàngài rènwù, hái fùzé wèi fùjìn chéngzhèn fādiàn.
sentences.translation: This reservoir not only undertakes irrigation tasks, but is also responsible for generating electricity for nearby towns.

sentences.chinese: 如果太阳能板效率继续提高，家庭自主发电的成本会进一步下降。
sentences.traditional: 如果太陽能板效率繼續提高，家庭自主發電的成本會進一步下降。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tàiyángnéng bǎn xiàolǜ jìxù tígāo, jiātíng zìzhǔ fādiàn de chéngběn huì jìnyíbù xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: If solar panel efficiency continues to improve, the cost of households generating their own electricity will fall further.

sentences.chinese: 新政策能否发动社会力量参与养老服务，仍有待观察。
sentences.traditional: 新政策能否發動社會力量參與養老服務，仍有待觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè néngfǒu fādòng shèhuì lìliàng cānyù yǎnglǎo fúwù, réng yǒudài guānchá.
sentences.translation: Whether the new policy can mobilise social forces to participate in elderly care services remains to be seen.

sentences.chinese: 司机反复尝试发动车辆，可仪表盘始终没有亮起来。
sentences.traditional: 司機反覆嘗試發動車輛，可儀表盤始終沒有亮起來。
sentences.pinyin: Sījī fǎnfù chángshì fādòng chēliàng, kě yíbiǎopán shǐzhōng méiyǒu liàng qǐlái.
sentences.translation: The driver repeatedly tried to start the vehicle, but the dashboard never lit up.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划发动一场节能宣传活动，以减少高峰期用电压力。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃發動一場節能宣傳活動，以減少高峰期用電壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà fādòng yì chǎng jiénéng xuānchuán huódòng, yǐ jiǎnshǎo gāofēngqī yòngdiàn yālì.
sentences.translation: The government plans to launch an energy-saving publicity campaign to reduce pressure on electricity use during peak periods.

sentences.chinese: 学校将在开学前统一发放教材和校园卡。
sentences.traditional: 學校將在開學前統一發放教材和校園卡。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāng zài kāixué qián tǒngyī fāfàng jiàocái hé xiàoyuán kǎ.
sentences.translation: The school will distribute textbooks and campus cards uniformly before the start of term.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免拥挤，社区按楼栋分批发放生活物资。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免擁擠，社區按樓棟分批發放生活物資。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn yōngjǐ, shèqū àn lóudòng fēnpī fāfàng shēnghuó wùzī.
sentences.translation: To avoid crowding, the community distributed daily necessities in batches by building.

sentences.chinese: 奖学金是否发放，取决于申请材料是否经过最终审核。
sentences.traditional: 獎學金是否發放，取決於申請材料是否經過最終審核。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎngxuéjīn shìfǒu fāfàng, qǔjué yú shēnqǐng cáiliào shìfǒu jīngguò zuìzhōng shěnhé.
sentences.translation: Whether the scholarship is issued depends on whether the application materials have passed final review.

sentences.chinese: 深海生物会发光，是为了吸引猎物或躲避天敌。
sentences.traditional: 深海生物會發光，是為了吸引獵物或躲避天敵。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnhǎi shēngwù huì fāguāng, shì wèile xīyǐn lièwù huò duǒbì tiāndí.
sentences.translation: Deep-sea creatures emit light in order to attract prey or avoid natural enemies.

sentences.chinese: 这种材料在吸收阳光后会持续发光，适合用于安全标识。
sentences.traditional: 這種材料在吸收陽光後會持續發光，適合用於安全標識。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào zài xīshōu yángguāng hòu huì chíxù fāguāng, shìhé yòngyú ānquán biāozhì.
sentences.translation: After absorbing sunlight, this material continues to glow, making it suitable for safety signs.

sentences.chinese: 舞台中央的装置突然发光，观众顿时安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 舞臺中央的裝置突然發光，觀眾頓時安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔtái zhōngyāng de zhuāngzhì tūrán fāguāng, guānzhòng dùnshí ānjìng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: The installation in the centre of the stage suddenly lit up, and the audience immediately fell quiet.

sentences.chinese: 购买设备后，公司要求供应商开具正式发票。
sentences.traditional: 購買設備後，公司要求供應商開具正式發票。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi shèbèi hòu, gōngsī yāoqiú gōngyìngshāng kāijù zhèngshì fāpiào.
sentences.translation: After purchasing the equipment, the company asked the supplier to issue an official invoice.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有发票，这笔费用很难通过财务审核。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有發票，這筆費用很難通過財務審核。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu fāpiào, zhè bǐ fèiyòng hěn nán tōngguò cáiwù shěnhé.
sentences.translation: Without an invoice, this expense will be very difficult to pass the financial review.

sentences.chinese: 电子发票的普及减少了纸张浪费，也便于长期保存。
sentences.traditional: 電子發票的普及減少了紙張浪費，也便於長期保存。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzǐ fāpiào de pǔjí jiǎnshǎo le zhǐzhāng làngfèi, yě biànyú chángqī bǎocún.
sentences.translation: The spread of electronic invoices has reduced paper waste and also makes long-term storage easier.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片在海外发行后，引起了广泛讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片在海外發行後，引起了廣泛討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zài hǎiwài fāxíng hòu, yǐnqǐ le guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: After this documentary was released overseas, it sparked widespread discussion.

sentences.chinese: 央行决定发行新版硬币，以提高防伪能力。
sentences.traditional: 央行決定發行新版硬幣，以提高防偽能力。
sentences.pinyin: Yāngháng juédìng fāxíng xīn bǎn yìngbì, yǐ tígāo fángwěi nénglì.
sentences.translation: The central bank decided to issue a new version of the coin to improve anti-counterfeiting capability.

sentences.chinese: 小说尚未正式发行，预订量已经超出出版社预期。
sentences.traditional: 小說尚未正式發行，預訂量已經超出出版社預期。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshuō shàngwèi zhèngshì fāxíng, yùdìngliàng yǐjīng chāochū chūbǎnshè yùqī.
sentences.translation: The novel has not yet been officially released, but pre-orders have already exceeded the publisher's expectations.

sentences.chinese: 伤口如果处理不当，很容易发炎，甚至引发更严重的感染。
sentences.traditional: 傷口如果處理不當，很容易發炎，甚至引發更嚴重的感染。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngkǒu rúguǒ chǔlǐ bùdàng, hěn róngyì fāyán, shènzhì yǐnfā gèng yánzhòng de gǎnrǎn.
sentences.translation: If a wound is not treated properly, it can easily become inflamed and even cause a more serious infection.

sentences.chinese: 医生发现他的喉咙明显发炎，建议暂时不要说太多话。
sentences.traditional: 醫生發現他的喉嚨明顯發炎，建議暫時不要說太多話。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng fāxiàn tā de hóulóng míngxiǎn fāyán, jiànyì zànshí bú yào shuō tài duō huà.
sentences.translation: The doctor found that his throat was clearly inflamed and advised him not to talk too much for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 长期忽视牙龈清洁，可能导致局部组织反复发炎。
sentences.traditional: 長期忽視牙齦清潔，可能導致局部組織反覆發炎。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī hūshì yáyín qīngjié, kěnéng dǎozhì júbù zǔzhī fǎnfù fāyán.
sentences.translation: Long-term neglect of gum cleaning may cause local tissue to become repeatedly inflamed.

sentences.chinese: 儿童的身体发育受营养、睡眠和运动等多种因素影响。
sentences.traditional: 兒童的身體發育受營養、睡眠和運動等多種因素影響。
sentences.pinyin: Értóng de shēntǐ fāyù shòu yíngyǎng, shuìmián hé yùndòng děng duō zhǒng yīnsù yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Children's physical development is affected by many factors, including nutrition, sleep and exercise.

sentences.chinese: 科学家通过观察胚胎发育过程，研究器官形成的规律。
sentences.traditional: 科學家通過觀察胚胎發育過程，研究器官形成的規律。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā tōngguò guānchá pēitāi fāyù guòchéng, yánjiū qìguān xíngchéng de guīlǜ.
sentences.translation: Scientists study the patterns of organ formation by observing the process of embryonic development.

sentences.chinese: 当地旅游市场发育较晚，因此配套服务仍不完善。
sentences.traditional: 當地旅遊市場發育較晚，因此配套服務仍不完善。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì lǚyóu shìchǎng fāyù jiào wǎn, yīncǐ pèitào fúwù réng bù wánshàn.
sentences.translation: The local tourism market developed relatively late, so supporting services are still incomplete.

sentences.chinese: 法定假日加班，企业必须按照规定支付额外工资。
sentences.traditional: 法定假日加班，企業必須按照規定支付額外工資。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎdìng jiàrì jiābān, qǐyè bìxū ànzhào guīdìng zhīfù éwài gōngzī.
sentences.translation: For work on statutory holidays, companies must pay extra wages according to regulations.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同只有在双方达到法定年龄后才具有效力。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同只有在雙方達到法定年齡後才具有效力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong zhǐyǒu zài shuāngfāng dádào fǎdìng niánlíng hòu cái jùyǒu xiàolì.
sentences.translation: This contract only becomes valid after both parties have reached the legal age.

sentences.chinese: 法定程序虽然复杂，却能防止权力被随意滥用。
sentences.traditional: 法定程序雖然複雜，卻能防止權力被隨意濫用。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎdìng chéngxù suīrán fùzá, què néng fángzhǐ quánlì bèi suíyì lànyòng.
sentences.translation: Although statutory procedures are complex, they can prevent power from being abused arbitrarily.

sentences.chinese: 法官在宣判前，认真听取了双方律师的陈述。
sentences.traditional: 法官在宣判前，認真聽取了雙方律師的陳述。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎguān zài xuānpàn qián, rènzhēn tīngqǔ le shuāngfāng lǜshī de chénshù.
sentences.translation: Before pronouncing the verdict, the judge carefully listened to the statements of the lawyers on both sides.

sentences.chinese: 面对舆论压力，法官仍必须依据证据和法律作出判断。
sentences.traditional: 面對輿論壓力，法官仍必須依據證據和法律作出判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì yúlùn yālì, fǎguān réng bìxū yījù zhèngjù hé fǎlǜ zuòchū pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Facing pressure from public opinion, the judge must still make a judgement based on evidence and the law.

sentences.chinese: 这位法官以公正和专业著称，许多学生都把他视为榜样。
sentences.traditional: 這位法官以公正和專業著稱，許多學生都把他視為榜樣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi fǎguān yǐ gōngzhèng hé zhuānyè zhùchēng, xǔduō xuéshēng dōu bǎ tā shìwéi bǎngyàng.
sentences.translation: This judge is known for fairness and professionalism, and many students regard him as a model.

sentences.chinese: 所有平台都必须遵守当地的数据保护法规。
sentences.traditional: 所有平臺都必須遵守當地的數據保護法規。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu píngtái dōu bìxū zūnshǒu dāngdì de shùjù bǎohù fǎguī.
sentences.translation: All platforms must comply with local data protection regulations.

sentences.chinese: 新的环保法规要求企业公开排放数据。
sentences.traditional: 新的環保法規要求企業公開排放數據。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn de huánbǎo fǎguī yāoqiú qǐyè gōngkāi páifàng shùjù.
sentences.translation: The new environmental regulations require companies to disclose emissions data.

sentences.chinese: 如果不了解相关法规，项目很容易在审批阶段受阻。
sentences.traditional: 如果不了解相關法規，項目很容易在審批階段受阻。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù liǎojiě xiāngguān fǎguī, xiàngmù hěn róngyì zài shěnpī jiēduàn shòuzǔ.
sentences.translation: If the relevant regulations are not understood, the project can easily be blocked at the approval stage.

sentences.chinese: 经过一番讨论，委员会决定修改原来的方案。
sentences.traditional: 經過一番討論，委員會決定修改原來的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò yī fān tǎolùn, wěiyuánhuì juédìng xiūgǎi yuánlái de fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: After a round of discussion, the committee decided to revise the original plan.

sentences.chinese: 他这番话看似平淡，实际上提醒了我们风险的严重性。
sentences.traditional: 他這番話看似平淡，實際上提醒了我們風險的嚴重性。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhè fān huà kànsì píngdàn, shíjìshàng tíxǐng le wǒmen fēngxiǎn de yánzhòngxìng.
sentences.translation: His remarks seemed plain, but in fact they reminded us how serious the risk was.

sentences.chinese: 为了完成任务，团队又做了一番详细调查。
sentences.traditional: 為了完成任務，團隊又做了一番詳細調查。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile wánchéng rènwù, tuánduì yòu zuò le yī fān xiángxì diàochá.
sentences.translation: To complete the task, the team carried out another detailed investigation.

sentences.chinese: 城市中心的交通在节假日前夕格外繁忙。
sentences.traditional: 城市中心的交通在節假日前夕格外繁忙。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì zhōngxīn de jiāotōng zài jiéjiàrì qiánxī géwài fánmáng.
sentences.translation: Traffic in the city centre is especially busy on the eve of public holidays.

sentences.chinese: 即使工作繁忙，他仍坚持每天抽时间阅读。
sentences.traditional: 即使工作繁忙，他仍堅持每天抽時間閱讀。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ gōngzuò fánmáng, tā réng jiānchí měitiān chōu shíjiān yuèdú.
sentences.translation: Even when work is busy, he still insists on making time to read every day.

sentences.chinese: 由于港口繁忙，货物清关时间比预期长了两天。
sentences.traditional: 由於港口繁忙，貨物清關時間比預期長了兩天。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú gǎngkǒu fánmáng, huòwù qīngguān shíjiān bǐ yùqī cháng le liǎng tiān.
sentences.translation: Because the port was busy, customs clearance for the goods took two days longer than expected.

sentences.chinese: 凡是涉及个人隐私的数据，都应当受到严格保护。
sentences.traditional: 凡是涉及個人隱私的數據，都應當受到嚴格保護。
sentences.pinyin: Fánshì shèjí gèrén yǐnsī de shùjù, dōu yīngdāng shòudào yángé bǎohù.
sentences.translation: All data involving personal privacy should be strictly protected.

sentences.chinese: 凡是报名参加面试的人，都需要提前提交身份证明。
sentences.traditional: 凡是報名參加面試的人，都需要提前提交身份證明。
sentences.pinyin: Fánshì bàomíng cānjiā miànshì de rén, dōu xūyào tíqián tíjiāo shēnfèn zhèngmíng.
sentences.translation: Everyone who registers for the interview needs to submit proof of identity in advance.

sentences.chinese: 老师强调，凡是抄袭的作业一律不给成绩。
sentences.traditional: 老師強調，凡是抄襲的作業一律不給成績。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī qiángdiào, fánshì chāoxí de zuòyè yīlǜ bù gěi chéngjì.
sentences.translation: The teacher stressed that any copied homework would receive no grade at all.

sentences.chinese: 这种昆虫在潮湿环境中繁殖得特别快。
sentences.traditional: 這種昆蟲在潮濕環境中繁殖得特別快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kūnchóng zài cháoshī huánjìng zhōng fánzhí de tèbié kuài.
sentences.translation: This kind of insect reproduces especially quickly in damp environments.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有天敌，某些外来物种会迅速繁殖并破坏生态。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有天敵，某些外來物種會迅速繁殖並破壞生態。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu tiāndí, mǒuxiē wàilái wùzhǒng huì xùnsù fánzhí bìng pòhuài shēngtài.
sentences.translation: Without natural enemies, some invasive species can reproduce rapidly and damage the ecosystem.

sentences.chinese: 实验室正在研究这种细菌的繁殖条件。
sentences.traditional: 實驗室正在研究這種細菌的繁殖條件。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyànshì zhèngzài yánjiū zhè zhǒng xìjūn de fánzhí tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: The laboratory is studying the reproduction conditions of this type of bacterium.

sentences.chinese: 用户的反馈直接影响下一版产品的设计方向。
sentences.traditional: 用戶的反饋直接影響下一版產品的設計方向。
sentences.pinyin: Yònghù de fǎnkuì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng xià yī bǎn chǎnpǐn de shèjì fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: User feedback directly affects the design direction of the next version of the product.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，请把你的意见及时反馈给项目负责人。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，請把你的意見及時反饋給項目負責人。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, qǐng bǎ nǐ de yìjiàn jíshí fǎnkuì gěi xiàngmù fùzérén.
sentences.translation: After the meeting, please promptly feed back your opinions to the project manager.

sentences.chinese: 系统会根据学生的答题情况给出个性化反馈。
sentences.traditional: 系統會根據學生的答題情況給出個性化反饋。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì gēnjù xuéshēng de dātí qíngkuàng gěichū gèxìnghuà fǎnkuì.
sentences.translation: The system will provide personalised feedback based on the student’s answers.

sentences.chinese: 失败之后，团队没有互相指责，而是认真反思决策过程。
sentences.traditional: 失敗之後，團隊沒有互相指責，而是認真反思決策過程。
sentences.pinyin: Shībài zhīhòu, tuánduì méiyǒu hùxiāng zhǐzé, ér shì rènzhēn fǎnsī juécè guòchéng.
sentences.translation: After the failure, the team did not blame one another, but seriously reflected on the decision-making process.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片促使观众反思消费习惯与环境之间的关系。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片促使觀眾反思消費習慣與環境之間的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn cùshǐ guānzhòng fǎnsī xiāofèi xíguàn yǔ huánjìng zhījiān de guānxì.
sentences.translation: This documentary prompts viewers to reflect on the relationship between consumption habits and the environment.

sentences.chinese: 他每周都会写日记，反思自己在管理上的不足。
sentences.traditional: 他每週都會寫日記，反思自己在管理上的不足。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu dōu huì xiě rìjì, fǎnsī zìjǐ zài guǎnlǐ shàng de bùzú.
sentences.translation: He writes a diary every week to reflect on his shortcomings in management.

sentences.chinese: 任何人犯了错误，都应有改正的机会。
sentences.traditional: 任何人犯了錯誤，都應有改正的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé rén fàn le cuòwù, dōu yīng yǒu gǎizhèng de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Anyone who has made a mistake should have the chance to correct it.

sentences.chinese: 公司若犯了严重的安全规定，可能面临巨额罚款。
sentences.traditional: 公司若犯了嚴重的安全規定，可能面臨巨額罰款。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī ruò fàn le yánzhòng de ānquán guīdìng, kěnéng miànlín jù'é fákuǎn.
sentences.translation: If the company violates serious safety rules, it may face a huge fine.

sentences.chinese: 他并不是故意犯规，只是对新规则理解不够。
sentences.traditional: 他並不是故意犯規，只是對新規則理解不夠。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù shì gùyì fànguī, zhǐ shì duì xīn guīzé lǐjiě bù gòu.
sentences.translation: He did not break the rules deliberately; he simply did not understand the new rules well enough.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革涉及教育、医疗、就业等方方面面。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革涉及教育、醫療、就業等方方面面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé shèjí jiàoyù, yīliáo, jiùyè děng fāngfāngmiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: This reform involves all aspects including education, healthcare, and employment.

sentences.chinese: 在制定政策前，政府需要考虑社会的方方面面。
sentences.traditional: 在制定政策前，政府需要考慮社會的方方面面。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhìdìng zhèngcè qián, zhèngfǔ xūyào kǎolǜ shèhuì de fāngfāngmiànmiàn.
sentences.translation: Before formulating policy, the government needs to consider every aspect of society.

sentences.chinese: 他对公司运营的方方面面都很熟悉，因此适合担任总经理。
sentences.traditional: 他對公司營運的方方面面都很熟悉，因此適合擔任總經理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì gōngsī yùnyíng de fāngfāngmiànmiàn dōu hěn shúxī, yīncǐ shìhé dānrèn zǒngjīnglǐ.
sentences.translation: He is familiar with every aspect of the company’s operations, so he is suitable to serve as general manager.

sentences.chinese: 在陌生城市里，准确判断方位比盲目跟着地图走更重要。
sentences.traditional: 在陌生城市裡，準確判斷方位比盲目跟著地圖走更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mòshēng chéngshì lǐ, zhǔnquè pànduàn fāngwèi bǐ mángmù gēnzhe dìtú zǒu gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In an unfamiliar city, accurately judging direction is more important than blindly following a map.

sentences.chinese: 建筑物的方位会影响采光、通风和能源消耗。
sentences.traditional: 建築物的方位會影響採光、通風和能源消耗。
sentences.pinyin: Jiànzhùwù de fāngwèi huì yǐngxiǎng cǎiguāng, tōngfēng hé néngyuán xiāohào.
sentences.translation: The orientation of a building affects lighting, ventilation, and energy consumption.

sentences.chinese: 考古人员通过星象和地形推测古城的方位。
sentences.traditional: 考古人員通過星象和地形推測古城的方位。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎogǔ rényuán tōngguò xīngxiàng hé dìxíng tuīcè gǔchéng de fāngwèi.
sentences.translation: Archaeologists inferred the position of the ancient city through astrology and terrain.

sentences.chinese: 在不少地区，方言承载着地方记忆，也影响着人们的身份认同。
sentences.traditional: 在不少地區，方言承載著地方記憶，也影響著人們的身份認同。
sentences.pinyin: Zài bù shǎo dìqū, fāngyán chéngzài zhe dìfāng jìyì, yě yǐngxiǎng zhe rénmen de shēnfèn rèntóng.
sentences.translation: In many regions, dialects carry local memories and also influence people’s sense of identity.

sentences.chinese: 孩子若完全听不懂家乡方言，和祖辈交流时可能会少一层亲近感。
sentences.traditional: 孩子若完全聽不懂家鄉方言，和祖輩交流時可能會少一層親近感。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi ruò wánquán tīng bù dǒng jiāxiāng fāngyán, hé zǔbèi jiāoliú shí kěnéng huì shǎo yì céng qīnjìngǎn.
sentences.translation: If children cannot understand their hometown dialect at all, they may feel one layer less closeness when communicating with their grandparents’ generation.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影保留了大量方言对白，使人物显得更加真实。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影保留了大量方言對白，使人物顯得更加真實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bǎoliú le dàliàng fāngyán duìbái, shǐ rénwù xiǎnde gèngjiā zhēnshí.
sentences.translation: This film preserves a large amount of dialect dialogue, making the characters appear more authentic.

sentences.chinese: 过度审批会妨碍创新，甚至让优秀项目失去时机。
sentences.traditional: 過度審批會妨礙創新，甚至讓優秀項目失去時機。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù shěnpī huì fáng'ài chuàngxīn, shènzhì ràng yōuxiù xiàngmù shīqù shíjī.
sentences.translation: Excessive approval procedures can hinder innovation and may even make excellent projects miss their chance.

sentences.chinese: 施工期间请勿随意停车，以免妨碍救护车通行。
sentences.traditional: 施工期間請勿隨意停車，以免妨礙救護車通行。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōng qíjiān qǐng wù suíyì tíngchē, yǐmiǎn fáng'ài jiùhùchē tōngxíng.
sentences.translation: During construction, please do not park casually, so as not to obstruct the passage of ambulances.

sentences.chinese: 情绪化的争吵只会妨碍双方理性地解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 情緒化的爭吵只會妨礙雙方理性地解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Qíngxùhuà de zhēngchǎo zhǐ huì fáng'ài shuāngfāng lǐxìng de jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: An emotional quarrel will only hinder both sides from solving the problem rationally.

sentences.chinese: 房价持续上涨，使许多年轻人不得不推迟购房计划。
sentences.traditional: 房價持續上漲，使許多年輕人不得不推遲購房計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjià chíxù shàngzhǎng, shǐ xǔduō niánqīngrén bùdé bù tuīchí gòufáng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The continuous rise in housing prices has forced many young people to postpone their plans to buy a home.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的房价与收入水平严重脱节，引发了广泛讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的房價與收入水平嚴重脫節，引發了廣泛討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de fángjià yǔ shōurù shuǐpíng yánzhòng tuōjié, yǐnfā le guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: Housing prices in this city are seriously out of line with income levels, which has sparked widespread discussion.

sentences.chinese: 政府通过增加住房供应来稳定房价，而不是单纯限制交易。
sentences.traditional: 政府通過增加住房供應來穩定房價，而不是單純限制交易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tōngguò zēngjiā zhùfáng gōngyìng lái wěndìng fángjià, ér bú shì dānchún xiànzhì jiāoyì.
sentences.translation: The government is stabilising housing prices by increasing housing supply, rather than simply restricting transactions.

sentences.chinese: 防治传染病不能只依赖医院，还需要公众配合。
sentences.traditional: 防治傳染病不能只依賴醫院，還需要公眾配合。
sentences.pinyin: Fángzhì chuánrǎnbìng bù néng zhǐ yīlài yīyuàn, hái xūyào gōngzhòng pèihé.
sentences.translation: Preventing and controlling infectious diseases cannot rely only on hospitals; it also requires public cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 为了防治水污染，企业必须公开排放数据并接受监督。
sentences.traditional: 為了防治水污染，企業必須公開排放數據並接受監督。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fángzhì shuǐ wūrǎn, qǐyè bìxū gōngkāi páifàng shùjù bìng jiēshòu jiāndū.
sentences.translation: To prevent and control water pollution, companies must disclose emissions data and accept supervision.

sentences.chinese: 专家强调，近视防治应从儿童的日常用眼习惯抓起。
sentences.traditional: 專家強調，近視防治應從兒童的日常用眼習慣抓起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā qiángdiào, jìnshì fángzhì yīng cóng értóng de rìcháng yòngyǎn xíguàn zhuā qǐ.
sentences.translation: Experts emphasise that preventing and controlling myopia should start with children’s daily eye-use habits.

sentences.chinese: 在访谈中，她首次公开谈到创业初期所承受的压力。
sentences.traditional: 在訪談中，她首次公開談到創業初期所承受的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fǎngtán zhōng, tā shǒucì gōngkāi tándào chuàngyè chūqī suǒ chéngshòu de yālì.
sentences.translation: In the interview, she spoke publicly for the first time about the pressure she endured in the early days of starting the business.

sentences.chinese: 记者对三位专家进行了深入访谈，以了解政策的实际影响。
sentences.traditional: 記者對三位專家進行了深入訪談，以了解政策的實際影響。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě duì sān wèi zhuānjiā jìnxíng le shēnrù fǎngtán, yǐ liǎojiě zhèngcè de shíjì yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The journalist conducted in-depth interviews with three experts in order to understand the policy’s actual impact.

sentences.chinese: 这段访谈虽然只有十分钟，却揭示了行业转型的关键矛盾。
sentences.traditional: 這段訪談雖然只有十分鐘，卻揭示了行業轉型的關鍵矛盾。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn fǎngtán suīrán zhǐ yǒu shí fēnzhōng, què jiēshì le hángyè zhuǎnxíng de guānjiàn máodùn.
sentences.translation: Although this interview lasts only ten minutes, it reveals the key contradiction in the industry’s transformation.

sentences.chinese: 媒体报道若只强调个别案例，可能会放大公众的焦虑。
sentences.traditional: 媒體報導若只強調個別案例，可能會放大公眾的焦慮。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ bàodào ruò zhǐ qiángdiào gèbié ànlì, kěnéng huì fàngdà gōngzhòng de jiāolǜ.
sentences.translation: If media reports emphasise only individual cases, they may magnify public anxiety.

sentences.chinese: 这台仪器能把细胞结构放大数千倍，便于研究人员观察。
sentences.traditional: 這臺儀器能把細胞結構放大數千倍，便於研究人員觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái yíqì néng bǎ xìbāo jiégòu fàngdà shùqiān bèi, biànyú yánjiū rényuán guānchá.
sentences.translation: This instrument can magnify cell structures thousands of times, making it easier for researchers to observe them.

sentences.chinese: 管理层需要解决根本问题，而不是不断放大小范围的冲突。
sentences.traditional: 管理層需要解決根本問題，而不是不斷放大小範圍的衝突。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐcéng xūyào jiějué gēnběn wèntí, ér bú shì búduàn fàngdà xiǎo fànwéi de chōngtū.
sentences.translation: Management needs to solve the root problem rather than continually magnifying small-scale conflicts.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在草地上放飞风筝，笑声传得很远。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在草地上放飛風箏，笑聲傳得很遠。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài cǎodì shàng fàngfēi fēngzhēng, xiàoshēng chuán de hěn yuǎn.
sentences.translation: The children flew kites on the grass, and their laughter carried far.

sentences.chinese: 保护区工作人员会在鸟类康复后将它们放飞回自然环境。
sentences.traditional: 保護區工作人員會在鳥類康復後將牠們放飛回自然環境。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohùqū gōngzuò rényuán huì zài niǎolèi kāngfù hòu jiāng tāmen fàngfēi huí zìrán huánjìng.
sentences.translation: After the birds recover, reserve staff will release them back into the natural environment.

sentences.chinese: 毕业典礼上，同学们放飞气球，象征新的旅程即将开始。
sentences.traditional: 畢業典禮上，同學們放飛氣球，象徵新的旅程即將開始。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyè diǎnlǐ shàng, tóngxuémen fàngfēi qìqiú, xiàngzhēng xīn de lǚchéng jíjiāng kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: At the graduation ceremony, the students released balloons, symbolising the beginning of a new journey.

sentences.chinese: 数字技术飞速发展，迫使传统行业重新调整商业模式。
sentences.traditional: 數字技術飛速發展，迫使傳統行業重新調整商業模式。
sentences.pinyin: Shùzì jìshù fēisù fāzhǎn, pòshǐ chuántǒng hángyè chóngxīn tiáozhěng shāngyè móshì.
sentences.translation: Digital technology is developing rapidly, forcing traditional industries to readjust their business models.

sentences.chinese: 消息一经发布，便在社交平台上飞速传播。
sentences.traditional: 消息一經發布，便在社交平臺上飛速傳播。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāoxi yì jīng fābù, biàn zài shèjiāo píngtái shàng fēisù chuánbō.
sentences.translation: As soon as the news was released, it spread rapidly on social platforms.

sentences.chinese: 在资本推动下，这家公司飞速扩张，却忽视了管理风险。
sentences.traditional: 在資本推動下，這家公司飛速擴張，卻忽視了管理風險。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zīběn tuīdòng xià, zhè jiā gōngsī fēisù kuòzhāng, què hūshì le guǎnlǐ fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Driven by capital, this company expanded rapidly, but ignored management risks.

sentences.chinese: 这块土地太肥，种香草反而容易长得过旺。
sentences.traditional: 這塊土地太肥，種香草反而容易長得過旺。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài tǔdì tài féi, zhòng xiāngcǎo fǎn'ér róngyì zhǎng de guò wàng.
sentences.translation: This piece of land is too fertile; herbs planted there may actually grow too vigorously.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套显得人很肥，换成直线剪裁会更合适。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套顯得人很肥，換成直線剪裁會更合適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào xiǎnde rén hěn féi, huàn chéng zhíxiàn jiǎncái huì gèng héshì.
sentences.translation: This coat makes a person look rather fat; a straighter cut would be more suitable.

sentences.chinese: 农户把腐熟的有机肥撒进土里，以改善土壤结构。
sentences.traditional: 農戶把腐熟的有機肥撒進土裡，以改善土壤結構。
sentences.pinyin: Nónghù bǎ fǔshú de yǒujī féi sā jìn tǔ lǐ, yǐ gǎishàn tǔrǎng jiégòu.
sentences.translation: The farmer scattered matured organic fertiliser into the soil to improve its structure.

sentences.chinese: 肥胖不仅影响体形，也会增加多种慢性病的风险。
sentences.traditional: 肥胖不僅影響體形，也會增加多種慢性病的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Féipàng bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng tǐxíng, yě huì zēngjiā duō zhǒng mànxìngbìng de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Obesity not only affects body shape, but also increases the risk of various chronic diseases.

sentences.chinese: 儿童肥胖问题与饮食结构、睡眠时间和运动量密切相关。
sentences.traditional: 兒童肥胖問題與飲食結構、睡眠時間和運動量密切相關。
sentences.pinyin: Értóng féipàng wèntí yǔ yǐnshí jiégòu, shuìmián shíjiān hé yùndòngliàng mìqiè xiāngguān.
sentences.translation: Childhood obesity is closely related to diet structure, sleep duration, and the amount of exercise.

sentences.chinese: 与其简单责备个人，社会更应关注导致肥胖的环境因素。
sentences.traditional: 與其簡單責備個人，社會更應關注導致肥胖的環境因素。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí jiǎndān zébèi gèrén, shèhuì gèng yīng guānzhù dǎozhì féipàng de huánjìng yīnsù.
sentences.translation: Rather than simply blaming individuals, society should pay more attention to the environmental factors that lead to obesity.

sentences.chinese: 这片河谷土地肥沃，几乎每年都能获得稳定的收成。
sentences.traditional: 這片河谷土地肥沃，幾乎每年都能獲得穩定的收成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn hégǔ tǔdì féiwò, jīhū měi nián dōu néng huòdé wěndìng de shōuchéng.
sentences.translation: The soil in this river valley is fertile, and it can produce stable harvests almost every year.

sentences.chinese: 当地政府通过轮作和堆肥，使原本贫瘠的土地逐渐变得肥沃。
sentences.traditional: 當地政府通過輪作和堆肥，使原本貧瘠的土地逐漸變得肥沃。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì zhèngfǔ tōngguò lúnzuò hé duīféi, shǐ yuánběn pínjí de tǔdì zhújiàn biàn de féiwò.
sentences.translation: Through crop rotation and composting, the local government has gradually made the originally poor soil fertile.

sentences.chinese: 肥沃的土壤固然重要，但过度灌溉仍可能破坏生态平衡。
sentences.traditional: 肥沃的土壤固然重要，但過度灌溉仍可能破壞生態平衡。
sentences.pinyin: Féiwò de tǔrǎng gùrán zhòngyào, dàn guòdù guàngài réng kěnéng pòhuài shēngtài pínghéng.
sentences.translation: Fertile soil is of course important, but excessive irrigation may still damage the ecological balance.

sentences.chinese: 长期吸入污染空气会损害肺，并降低身体的运动耐力。
sentences.traditional: 長期吸入污染空氣會損害肺，並降低身體的運動耐力。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī xīrù wūrǎn kōngqì huì sǔnhài fèi, bìng jiàngdī shēntǐ de yùndòng nàilì.
sentences.translation: Long-term inhalation of polluted air can damage the lungs and reduce the body’s exercise endurance.

sentences.chinese: 医生用影像检查确认他的肺没有明显阴影。
sentences.traditional: 醫生用影像檢查確認他的肺沒有明顯陰影。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng yòng yǐngxiàng jiǎnchá quèrèn tā de fèi méiyǒu míngxiǎn yīnyǐng.
sentences.translation: The doctor used imaging tests to confirm that there were no obvious shadows on his lungs.

sentences.chinese: 她恢复训练前，先做了一次肺功能评估。
sentences.traditional: 她恢復訓練前，先做了一次肺功能評估。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huīfù xùnliàn qián, xiān zuò le yí cì fèi gōngnéng pínggū.
sentences.translation: Before resuming training, she first had her lung function assessed.

sentences.chinese: 老人感染肺炎后，家人立刻安排他住院观察。
sentences.traditional: 老人感染肺炎後，家人立刻安排他住院觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén gǎnrǎn fèiyán hòu, jiārén lìkè ānpái tā zhùyuàn guānchá.
sentences.translation: After the elderly man caught pneumonia, his family immediately arranged for him to be observed in hospital.

sentences.chinese: 及时接种疫苗可以降低严重肺炎的风险。
sentences.traditional: 及時接種疫苗可以降低嚴重肺炎的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshí jiēzhòng yìmiáo kěyǐ jiàngdī yánzhòng fèiyán de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Timely vaccination can reduce the risk of severe pneumonia.

sentences.chinese: 这次肺炎病例提醒医院加强对呼吸道疾病的监测。
sentences.traditional: 這次肺炎病例提醒醫院加強對呼吸道疾病的監測。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì fèiyán bìnglì tíxǐng yīyuàn jiāqiáng duì hūxīdào jíbìng de jiāncè.
sentences.translation: This pneumonia case reminded the hospital to strengthen monitoring of respiratory diseases.

sentences.chinese: 项目能按时完成，关键在于团队分工明确，责任落实到人。
sentences.traditional: 項目能按時完成，關鍵在於團隊分工明確，責任落實到人。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù néng ànshí wánchéng, guānjiàn zàiyú tuánduì fēngōng míngquè, zérèn luòshí dào rén.
sentences.translation: The project was completed on time mainly because the team’s division of labour was clear and responsibilities were assigned to individuals.

sentences.chinese: 如果分工过细，员工反而可能失去对整体流程的理解。
sentences.traditional: 如果分工過細，員工反而可能失去對整體流程的理解。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fēngōng guò xì, yuángōng fǎn'ér kěnéng shīqù duì zhěngtǐ liúchéng de lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: If the division of labour is too detailed, employees may instead lose their understanding of the overall process.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束前，负责人重新调整了各部门的分工。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束前，負責人重新調整了各部門的分工。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù qián, fùzérén chóngxīn tiáozhěng le gè bùmén de fēngōng.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting ended, the person in charge readjusted the division of labour among the departments.

sentences.chinese: 医院按照病情轻重对患者进行分级，以便优先处理急症。
sentences.traditional: 醫院按照病情輕重對患者進行分級，以便優先處理急症。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn ànzhào bìngqíng qīngzhòng duì huànzhě jìnxíng fēnjí, yǐbiàn yōuxiān chǔlǐ jízhèng.
sentences.translation: The hospital classified patients according to the severity of their condition so that emergencies could be dealt with first.

sentences.chinese: 这些数据经过分级处理后，普通员工只能看到必要信息。
sentences.traditional: 這些數據經過分級處理後，普通員工只能看到必要信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù jīngguò fēnjí chǔlǐ hòu, pǔtōng yuángōng zhǐ néng kàndào bìyào xìnxī.
sentences.translation: After this data has been classified, ordinary employees can only see the necessary information.

sentences.chinese: 课程分级不合理，会让初学者很快失去信心。
sentences.traditional: 課程分級不合理，會讓初學者很快失去信心。
sentences.pinyin: Kèchéng fēnjí bù hélǐ, huì ràng chūxuézhě hěn kuài shīqù xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: If course grading is unreasonable, beginners will quickly lose confidence.

sentences.chinese: 由于预算有限，我们决定把设备费用分期支付。
sentences.traditional: 由於預算有限，我們決定把設備費用分期支付。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, wǒmen juédìng bǎ shèbèi fèiyòng fēnqī zhīfù.
sentences.translation: Because the budget is limited, we decided to pay for the equipment in instalments.

sentences.chinese: 这项工程将分期建设，第一阶段主要改善交通设施。
sentences.traditional: 這項工程將分期建設，第一階段主要改善交通設施。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngchéng jiāng fēnqī jiànshè, dì yī jiēduàn zhǔyào gǎishàn jiāotōng shèshī.
sentences.translation: This project will be built in phases, with the first stage mainly improving transport facilities.

sentences.chinese: 分期付款虽然减轻了眼前压力，却可能增加长期负担。
sentences.traditional: 分期付款雖然減輕了眼前壓力，卻可能增加長期負擔。
sentences.pinyin: Fēnqī fùkuǎn suīrán jiǎnqīng le yǎnqián yālì, què kěnéng zēngjiā chángqī fùdān.
sentences.translation: Although paying in instalments eases immediate pressure, it may increase the long-term burden.

sentences.chinese: 为了降低风险，公司把供应商分散到不同地区。
sentences.traditional: 為了降低風險，公司把供應商分散到不同地區。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiàngdī fēngxiǎn, gōngsī bǎ gōngyìngshāng fēnsàn dào bùtóng dìqū.
sentences.translation: In order to reduce risk, the company spread its suppliers across different regions.

sentences.chinese: 资料分散在多个系统里，查找起来非常费时。
sentences.traditional: 資料分散在多個系統裡，查找起來非常費時。
sentences.pinyin: Zīliào fēnsàn zài duō ge xìtǒng lǐ, cházhǎo qǐlai fēicháng fèishí.
sentences.translation: The materials are scattered across several systems, making them very time-consuming to look up.

sentences.chinese: 领导提醒大家不要被细节分散注意力。
sentences.traditional: 領導提醒大家不要被細節分散注意力。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo tíxǐng dàjiā bù yào bèi xìjié fēnsàn zhùyìlì.
sentences.translation: The leader reminded everyone not to let details distract their attention.

sentences.chinese: 会议室里的氛围十分紧张，几乎没有人主动发言。
sentences.traditional: 會議室裡的氛圍十分緊張，幾乎沒有人主動發言。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì lǐ de fēnwéi shífēn jǐnzhāng, jīhū méiyǒu rén zhǔdòng fāyán.
sentences.translation: The atmosphere in the meeting room was very tense, and almost no one spoke voluntarily.

sentences.chinese: 良好的学习氛围能促使学生更愿意表达观点。
sentences.traditional: 良好的學習氛圍能促使學生更願意表達觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de xuéxí fēnwéi néng cùshǐ xuéshēng gèng yuànyì biǎodá guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: A good learning atmosphere can encourage students to be more willing to express their views.

sentences.chinese: 新来的经理试图改变部门长期沉闷的氛围。
sentences.traditional: 新來的經理試圖改變部門長期沉悶的氛圍。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn lái de jīnglǐ shìtú gǎibiàn bùmén chángqī chénmèn de fēnwéi.
sentences.translation: The new manager tried to change the long-standing dull atmosphere in the department.

sentences.chinese: 她把干辣椒磨成粉，装进密封罐里保存。
sentences.traditional: 她把乾辣椒磨成粉，裝進密封罐裡保存。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ gān làjiāo mó chéng fěn, zhuāng jìn mìfēng guàn lǐ bǎocún.
sentences.translation: She ground the dried chillies into powder and stored them in a sealed jar.

sentences.chinese: 这种粉色包装虽然醒目，却不太符合品牌原来的风格。
sentences.traditional: 這種粉色包裝雖然醒目，卻不太符合品牌原來的風格。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fěnsè bāozhuāng suīrán xǐngmù, què bù tài fúhé pǐnpái yuánlái de fēnggé.
sentences.translation: Although this pink packaging is eye-catching, it does not quite fit the brand’s original style.

sentences.chinese: 面粉受潮后会结成小块，影响烘焙效果。
sentences.traditional: 麵粉受潮後會結成小塊，影響烘焙效果。
sentences.pinyin: Miànfěn shòucháo hòu huì jié chéng xiǎo kuài, yǐngxiǎng hōngbèi xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: When flour gets damp, it forms small lumps and affects baking results.

sentences.chinese: 面对明显的不公，居民愤怒地要求政府公开调查结果。
sentences.traditional: 面對明顯的不公，居民憤怒地要求政府公開調查結果。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì míngxiǎn de bùgōng, jūmín fènnù de yāoqiú zhèngfǔ gōngkāi diàochá jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Faced with obvious injustice, the residents angrily demanded that the government publish the investigation results.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然感到愤怒，却仍然努力控制语气，避免冲突升级。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然感到憤怒，卻仍然努力控制語氣，避免衝突升級。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán gǎndào fènnù, què réngrán nǔlì kòngzhì yǔqì, bìmiǎn chōngtū shēngjí.
sentences.translation: Although he felt angry, he still tried hard to control his tone and avoid escalating the conflict.

sentences.chinese: 网络上的愤怒情绪如果缺乏事实基础，很容易被人利用。
sentences.traditional: 網絡上的憤怒情緒如果缺乏事實基礎，很容易被人利用。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò shàng de fènnù qíngxù rúguǒ quēfá shìshí jīchǔ, hěn róngyì bèi rén lìyòng.
sentences.translation: If anger online lacks a factual basis, it can easily be exploited by others.

sentences.chinese: 政府在暴雨来临前封闭了通往山区的几条道路。
sentences.traditional: 政府在暴雨來臨前封閉了通往山區的幾條道路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zài bàoyǔ láilín qián fēngbì le tōngwǎng shānqū de jǐ tiáo dàolù.
sentences.translation: The government closed several roads leading to the mountain area before the heavy rain arrived.

sentences.chinese: 这个社区长期封闭管理，外来人员必须登记后才能进入。
sentences.traditional: 這個社區長期封閉管理，外來人員必須登記後才能進入。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèqū chángqī fēngbì guǎnlǐ, wàilái rényuán bìxū dēngjì hòu cáinéng jìnrù.
sentences.translation: This residential community has long been managed as a closed area, so outsiders must register before entering.

sentences.chinese: 如果思想过于封闭，企业就很难适应迅速变化的市场。
sentences.traditional: 如果思想過於封閉，企業就很難適應迅速變化的市場。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ sīxiǎng guòyú fēngbì, qǐyè jiù hěn nán shìyìng xùnsù biànhuà de shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: If thinking is too closed, a company will find it hard to adapt to a rapidly changing market.

sentences.chinese: 这条沿海公路风光优美，却因为维护不足存在安全隐患。
sentences.traditional: 這條沿海公路風光優美，卻因為維護不足存在安全隱患。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yánhǎi gōnglù fēngguāng yōuměi, què yīnwèi wéihù bùzú cúnzài ānquán yǐnhuàn.
sentences.translation: This coastal road has beautiful scenery, but insufficient maintenance has created safety risks.

sentences.chinese: 影片通过缓慢的镜头展现了西北草原壮阔的风光。
sentences.traditional: 影片通過緩慢的鏡頭展現了西北草原壯闊的風光。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngpiān tōngguò huǎnmàn de jìngtóu zhǎnxiàn le xīběi cǎoyuán zhuàngkuò de fēngguāng.
sentences.translation: The film uses slow shots to present the magnificent scenery of the north-western grasslands.

sentences.chinese: 他退休后选择回到家乡，重新欣赏儿时熟悉的田园风光。
sentences.traditional: 他退休後選擇回到家鄉，重新欣賞兒時熟悉的田園風光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu xuǎnzé huídào jiāxiāng, chóngxīn xīnshǎng érshí shúxī de tiányuán fēngguāng.
sentences.translation: After retiring, he chose to return to his hometown and enjoy the rural scenery familiar from childhood.

sentences.chinese: 这里的风力资源充足，适合建设大型海上发电项目。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的風力資源充足，適合建設大型海上發電項目。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de fēnglì zīyuán chōngzú, shìhé jiànshè dàxíng hǎishàng fādiàn xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: Wind resources here are abundant, making the area suitable for large offshore power-generation projects.

sentences.chinese: 受强冷空气影响，今晚沿海地区风力将明显增强。
sentences.traditional: 受強冷空氣影響，今晚沿海地區風力將明顯增強。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu qiáng lěng kōngqì yǐngxiǎng, jīnwǎn yánhǎi dìqū fēnglì jiāng míngxiǎn zēngqiáng.
sentences.translation: Affected by a strong cold air mass, winds along the coast will strengthen noticeably tonight.

sentences.chinese: 工程师根据风力变化调整了风机叶片的角度。
sentences.traditional: 工程師根據風力變化調整了風機葉片的角度。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī gēnjù fēnglì biànhuà tiáozhěng le fēngjī yèpiàn de jiǎodù.
sentences.translation: The engineers adjusted the angle of the turbine blades according to changes in wind force.

sentences.chinese: 连续几场及时雨为今年的小麦丰收打下了基础。
sentences.traditional: 連續幾場及時雨為今年的小麥豐收打下了基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jǐ chǎng jíshíyǔ wèi jīnnián de xiǎomài fēngshōu dǎxià le jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: Several timely rains in succession laid the foundation for this year’s bountiful wheat harvest.

sentences.chinese: 农民并没有因为丰收而盲目扩大种植面积。
sentences.traditional: 農民並沒有因為豐收而盲目擴大種植面積。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngmín bìng méiyǒu yīnwèi fēngshōu ér mángmù kuòdà zhòngzhí miànjī.
sentences.translation: The farmers did not blindly expand their planting area just because of the good harvest.

sentences.chinese: 当地政府举办节庆活动，庆祝果园迎来多年未有的丰收。
sentences.traditional: 當地政府舉辦節慶活動，慶祝果園迎來多年未有的豐收。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì zhèngfǔ jǔbàn jiéqìng huódòng, qìngzhù guǒyuán yínglái duō nián wèi yǒu de fēngshōu.
sentences.translation: The local government held a festival to celebrate the orchard’s best harvest in many years.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥经历了百年风雨，依然稳稳地连接着两岸。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋經歷了百年風雨，依然穩穩地連接著兩岸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo jīnglì le bǎinián fēngyǔ, yīrán wěnwěn de liánjiē zhe liǎng'àn.
sentences.translation: This bridge has withstood a century of wind and rain and still firmly connects the two banks.

sentences.chinese: 公司一路走来历经风雨，才形成如今稳定的管理体系。
sentences.traditional: 公司一路走來歷經風雨，才形成如今穩定的管理體系。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yílù zǒu lái lìjīng fēngyǔ, cái xíngchéng rújīn wěndìng de guǎnlǐ tǐxì.
sentences.translation: The company has gone through many hardships on its way to forming today’s stable management system.

sentences.chinese: 无论前方有多少风雨，他们都不打算放弃这个公益项目。
sentences.traditional: 無論前方有多少風雨，他們都不打算放棄這個公益項目。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn qiánfāng yǒu duōshǎo fēngyǔ, tāmen dōu bù dǎsuàn fàngqì zhège gōngyì xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: No matter how many hardships lie ahead, they do not intend to give up this public-interest project.

sentences.chinese: 这位医生把一生都奉献给了偏远地区的公共卫生事业。
sentences.traditional: 這位醫生把一生都奉獻給了偏遠地區的公共衛生事業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīshēng bǎ yìshēng dōu fèngxiàn gěi le piānyuǎn dìqū de gōnggòng wèishēng shìyè.
sentences.translation: This doctor devoted his whole life to public health work in remote areas.

sentences.chinese: 真正的奉献并不总是轰轰烈烈，也可能体现在日常坚持中。
sentences.traditional: 真正的奉獻並不總是轟轟烈烈，也可能體現在日常堅持中。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de fèngxiàn bìng bù zǒng shì hōnghōnglièliè, yě kěnéng tǐxiàn zài rìcháng jiānchí zhōng.
sentences.translation: True dedication is not always dramatic; it may also be reflected in everyday persistence.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者无私奉献的精神感染了许多年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 志願者無私奉獻的精神感染了許多年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě wúsī fèngxiàn de jīngshén gǎnrǎn le xǔduō niánqīng rén.
sentences.translation: The volunteers’ spirit of selfless dedication inspired many young people.

sentences.chinese: 使馆举办招待会时，大使夫人也出席并发表了简短讲话。
sentences.traditional: 使館舉辦招待會時，大使夫人也出席並發表了簡短講話。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐguǎn jǔbàn zhāodàihuì shí, dàshǐ fūrén yě chūxí bìng fābiǎo le jiǎnduǎn jiǎnghuà.
sentences.translation: When the embassy held the reception, the ambassador’s wife also attended and gave a brief speech.

sentences.chinese: 王夫人虽然年事已高，却仍亲自管理家族基金会。
sentences.traditional: 王夫人雖然年事已高，卻仍親自管理家族基金會。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng fūrén suīrán niánshì yǐ gāo, què réng qīnzì guǎnlǐ jiāzú jījīnhuì.
sentences.translation: Although Madam Wang is advanced in age, she still manages the family foundation in person.

sentences.chinese: 在正式场合，人们常以“李夫人”来称呼他的妻子。
sentences.traditional: 在正式場合，人們常以「李夫人」來稱呼他的妻子。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé, rénmen cháng yǐ “Lǐ fūrén” lái chēnghu tā de qīzi.
sentences.translation: In formal settings, people often address his wife as “Madam Li”.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人依法服兵役，不仅是义务，也是一种责任教育。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人依法服兵役，不僅是義務，也是一種責任教育。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yīfǎ fú bīngyì, bùjǐn shì yìwù, yě shì yì zhǒng zérèn jiàoyù.
sentences.translation: Young people serving military service according to the law is not only an obligation but also a form of education in responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 被告对一审判决不服，已经向上级法院提出上诉。
sentences.traditional: 被告對一審判決不服，已經向上級法院提出上訴。
sentences.pinyin: Bèigào duì yìshěn pànjué bù fú, yǐjīng xiàng shàngjí fǎyuàn tíchū shàngsù.
sentences.translation: The defendant refused to accept the first-instance judgement and has appealed to a higher court.

sentences.chinese: 展览中的传统服饰反映了不同民族的审美和生活方式。
sentences.traditional: 展覽中的傳統服飾反映了不同民族的審美和生活方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎnlǎn zhōng de chuántǒng fúshì fǎnyìng le bùtóng mínzú de shěnměi hé shēnghuó fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The traditional clothing in the exhibition reflects the aesthetics and lifestyles of different ethnic groups.

sentences.chinese: 海面上浮着一层油污，环保部门立即展开清理。
sentences.traditional: 海面上浮著一層油污，環保部門立即展開清理。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎimiàn shàng fú zhe yì céng yóuwū, huánbǎo bùmén lìjí zhǎnkāi qīnglǐ.
sentences.translation: A layer of oil pollution was floating on the sea, and the environmental department immediately began the clean-up.

sentences.chinese: 他的回答过于浮在表面，没有触及问题的根本原因。
sentences.traditional: 他的回答過於浮在表面，沒有觸及問題的根本原因。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huídá guòyú fú zài biǎomiàn, méiyǒu chùjí wèntí de gēnběn yuányīn.
sentences.translation: His answer stayed too much on the surface and did not touch the root cause of the problem.

sentences.chinese: 木块能浮在水上，是因为它的密度小于水。
sentences.traditional: 木塊能浮在水上，是因為它的密度小於水。
sentences.pinyin: Mùkuài néng fú zài shuǐ shàng, shì yīnwèi tā de mìdù xiǎoyú shuǐ.
sentences.translation: A block of wood can float on water because its density is lower than that of water.

sentences.chinese: 军人必须服从命令，但命令本身也应符合法律原则。
sentences.traditional: 軍人必須服從命令，但命令本身也應符合法律原則。
sentences.pinyin: Jūnrén bìxū fúcóng mìnglìng, dàn mìnglìng běnshēn yě yīng fúhé fǎlǜ yuánzé.
sentences.translation: Soldiers must obey orders, but the orders themselves should also comply with legal principles.

sentences.chinese: 员工不是盲目服从机器，而是要学会判断系统建议是否合理。
sentences.traditional: 員工不是盲目服從機器，而是要學會判斷系統建議是否合理。
sentences.pinyin: Yuángōng bú shì mángmù fúcóng jīqì, ér shì yào xuéhuì pànduàn xìtǒng jiànyì shìfǒu hélǐ.
sentences.translation: Employees should not blindly obey machines, but learn to judge whether system suggestions are reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 在学术研究中，观点应服从证据，而不是服从权威。
sentences.traditional: 在學術研究中，觀點應服從證據，而不是服從權威。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xuéshù yánjiū zhōng, guāndiǎn yīng fúcóng zhèngjù, ér bú shì fúcóng quánwēi.
sentences.translation: In academic research, views should follow the evidence rather than authority.

sentences.chinese: 调整的幅度虽然不大，却足以改变企业的成本结构。
sentences.traditional: 調整的幅度雖然不大，卻足以改變企業的成本結構。
sentences.pinyin: Tiáozhěng de fúdù suīrán bú dà, què zúyǐ gǎibiàn qǐyè de chéngběn jiégòu.
sentences.translation: Although the scale of the adjustment was not large, it was enough to change the company's cost structure.

sentences.chinese: 今年降雨量增加的幅度超出了气象部门的预测。
sentences.traditional: 今年降雨量增加的幅度超出了氣象部門的預測。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián jiàngyǔliàng zēngjiā de fúdù chāochū le qìxiàng bùmén de yùcè.
sentences.translation: The extent of this year's increase in rainfall exceeded the meteorological department's forecast.

sentences.chinese: 政府希望把价格上涨的幅度控制在合理范围内。
sentences.traditional: 政府希望把價格上漲的幅度控制在合理範圍內。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xīwàng bǎ jiàgé shàngzhǎng de fúdù kòngzhì zài hélǐ fànwéi nèi.
sentences.translation: The government hopes to keep the scale of price increases within a reasonable range.

sentences.chinese: 这种符号在古代文书中常被用来表示身份等级。
sentences.traditional: 這種符號在古代文書中常被用來表示身份等級。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fúhào zài gǔdài wénshū zhōng cháng bèi yòng lái biǎoshì shēnfèn děngjí.
sentences.translation: This kind of symbol was often used in ancient documents to indicate social rank.

sentences.chinese: 公式里的每个符号都必须先定义清楚，否则读者很难理解。
sentences.traditional: 公式裡的每個符號都必須先定義清楚，否則讀者很難理解。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngshì lǐ de měi ge fúhào dōu bìxū xiān dìngyì qīngchu, fǒuzé dúzhě hěn nán lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: Every symbol in the formula must first be clearly defined, otherwise readers will struggle to understand it.

sentences.chinese: 交通符号的设计应当简洁，使不同语言背景的人都能看懂。
sentences.traditional: 交通符號的設計應當簡潔，使不同語言背景的人都能看懂。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāotōng fúhào de shèjì yīngdāng jiǎnjié, shǐ bùtóng yǔyán bèijǐng de rén dōu néng kàndǒng.
sentences.translation: The design of traffic signs should be simple, so that people from different language backgrounds can understand them.

sentences.chinese: 公司提高福利，并不只是为了吸引人才，也是为了降低人员流动率。
sentences.traditional: 公司提高福利，並不只是為了吸引人才，也是為了降低人員流動率。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī tígāo fúlì, bìng bú zhǐ shì wèile xīyǐn réncái, yě shì wèile jiàngdī rényuán liúdònglǜ.
sentences.translation: The company improved its benefits not only to attract talent, but also to reduce staff turnover.

sentences.chinese: 完善社会福利制度，需要财政能力和公共服务同时跟上。
sentences.traditional: 完善社會福利制度，需要財政能力和公共服務同時跟上。
sentences.pinyin: Wánshàn shèhuì fúlì zhìdù, xūyào cáizhèng nénglì hé gōnggòng fúwù tóngshí gēnshàng.
sentences.translation: Improving the social welfare system requires both fiscal capacity and public services to keep pace.

sentences.chinese: 新政策为残疾人提供了更稳定的福利保障。
sentences.traditional: 新政策為殘疾人提供了更穩定的福利保障。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè wèi cánjírén tígōng le gèng wěndìng de fúlì bǎozhàng.
sentences.translation: The new policy provides more stable welfare protection for people with disabilities.

sentences.chinese: 这种药必须饭后服用，否则可能刺激胃部。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥必須飯後服用，否則可能刺激胃部。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào bìxū fàn hòu fúyòng, fǒuzé kěnéng cìjī wèibù.
sentences.translation: This medicine must be taken after meals, otherwise it may irritate the stomach.

sentences.chinese: 患者在服用抗生素期间，不应随意中断疗程。
sentences.traditional: 患者在服用抗生素期間，不應隨意中斷療程。
sentences.pinyin: Huànzhě zài fúyòng kàngshēngsù qījiān, bù yīng suíyì zhōngduàn liáochéng.
sentences.translation: Patients should not casually interrupt the course of treatment while taking antibiotics.

sentences.chinese: 如果同时服用多种药物，最好先咨询医生。
sentences.traditional: 如果同時服用多種藥物，最好先諮詢醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tóngshí fúyòng duō zhǒng yàowù, zuì hǎo xiān zīxún yīshēng.
sentences.translation: If you are taking several medicines at the same time, it is best to consult a doctor first.

sentences.chinese: 导师不仅辅导论文写作，还帮助学生建立研究思路。
sentences.traditional: 導師不僅輔導論文寫作，還幫助學生建立研究思路。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoshī bùjǐn fǔdǎo lùnwén xiězuò, hái bāngzhù xuéshēng jiànlì yánjiū sīlù.
sentences.translation: The supervisor not only coaches students in thesis writing, but also helps them build a research framework.

sentences.chinese: 针对基础薄弱的孩子，学校安排了课后辅导。
sentences.traditional: 針對基礎薄弱的孩子，學校安排了課後輔導。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnduì jīchǔ bóruò de háizi, xuéxiào ānpái le kèhòu fǔdǎo.
sentences.translation: For children with weak foundations, the school arranged after-class tutoring.

sentences.chinese: 心理辅导不能只强调技巧，更要尊重当事人的感受。
sentences.traditional: 心理輔導不能只強調技巧，更要尊重當事人的感受。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnlǐ fǔdǎo bù néng zhǐ qiángdiào jìqiǎo, gèng yào zūnzhòng dāngshìrén de gǎnshòu.
sentences.translation: Psychological counselling should not only emphasise techniques; it should also respect the feelings of the person involved.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统可以辅助医生判断病情，但不能取代专业诊断。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統可以輔助醫生判斷病情，但不能取代專業診斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng kěyǐ fǔzhù yīshēng pànduàn bìngqíng, dàn bù néng qǔdài zhuānyè zhěnduàn.
sentences.translation: This system can assist doctors in judging a patient's condition, but it cannot replace a professional diagnosis.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高学习效率，他使用了几种辅助工具。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高學習效率，他使用了幾種輔助工具。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo xuéxí xiàolǜ, tā shǐyòng le jǐ zhǒng fǔzhù gōngjù.
sentences.translation: To improve study efficiency, he used several auxiliary tools.

sentences.chinese: 政策只是辅助措施，真正的改变还要依靠企业自身。
sentences.traditional: 政策只是輔助措施，真正的改變還要依靠企業自身。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè zhǐ shì fǔzhù cuòshī, zhēnzhèng de gǎibiàn hái yào yīkào qǐyè zìshēn.
sentences.translation: The policy is only an auxiliary measure; real change still depends on the enterprises themselves.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然只是副主任，却承担了整个项目的协调工作。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然只是副主任，卻承擔了整個項目的協調工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán zhǐ shì fùzhǔrèn, què chéngdān le zhěnggè xiàngmù de xiétiáo gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: Although he was only the deputy director, he took on the coordination work for the entire project.

sentences.chinese: 会议由副校长主持，校长只在最后作了总结。
sentences.traditional: 會議由副校長主持，校長只在最後作了總結。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yóu fùxiàozhǎng zhǔchí, xiàozhǎng zhǐ zài zuìhòu zuò le zǒngjié.
sentences.translation: The meeting was chaired by the vice-principal; the principal only gave a summary at the end.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的副标题揭示了作者真正关心的问题。
sentences.traditional: 這本書的副標題揭示了作者真正關心的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de fùbiāotí jiēshì le zuòzhě zhēnzhèng guānxīn de wèntí.
sentences.translation: The subtitle of this book reveals the issue that the author is truly concerned with.

sentences.chinese: 大雪覆盖了山区道路，救援车辆不得不放慢速度。
sentences.traditional: 大雪覆蓋了山區道路，救援車輛不得不放慢速度。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxuě fùgài le shānqū dàolù, jiùyuán chēliàng bùdébù fàngmàn sùdù.
sentences.translation: Heavy snow covered the mountain roads, forcing rescue vehicles to slow down.

sentences.chinese: 新政策覆盖的范围比原来广，许多小企业也能受益。
sentences.traditional: 新政策覆蓋的範圍比原來廣，許多小企業也能受益。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè fùgài de fànwéi bǐ yuánlái guǎng, xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè yě néng shòuyì.
sentences.translation: The scope covered by the new policy is broader than before, so many small businesses can also benefit.

sentences.chinese: 媒体连续报道此事，几乎覆盖了事件发展的每个阶段。
sentences.traditional: 媒體連續報導此事，幾乎覆蓋了事件發展的每個階段。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ liánxù bàodǎo cǐ shì, jīhū fùgài le shìjiàn fāzhǎn de měi ge jiēduàn.
sentences.translation: The media reported on the matter continuously, covering almost every stage of the event's development.

sentences.chinese: 详细报价已放在附件里，请您查收后再确认订单。
sentences.traditional: 詳細報價已放在附件裡，請您查收後再確認訂單。
sentences.pinyin: Xiángxì bàojià yǐ fàng zài fùjiàn lǐ, qǐng nín cháshōu hòu zài quèrèn dìngdān.
sentences.translation: The detailed quotation has been placed in the attachment; please check it and then confirm the order.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器的附件不全，安装时可能会遇到困难。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器的附件不全，安裝時可能會遇到困難。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì de fùjiàn bù quán, ānzhuāng shí kěnéng huì yùdào kùnnan.
sentences.translation: The accessories for this machine are incomplete, so installation may be difficult.

sentences.chinese: 法律文件的附件虽然只是补充材料，却同样具有参考价值。
sentences.traditional: 法律文件的附件雖然只是補充材料，卻同樣具有參考價值。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ wénjiàn de fùjiàn suīrán zhǐ shì bǔchōng cáiliào, què tóngyàng jùyǒu cānkǎo jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Although the attachment to the legal document is only supplementary material, it has reference value all the same.

sentences.chinese: 这起事故对公司的公众形象造成了明显的负面影响。
sentences.traditional: 這起事故對公司的公眾形象造成了明顯的負面影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè qǐ shìgù duì gōngsī de gōngzhòng xíngxiàng zàochéng le míngxiǎn de fùmiàn yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This accident had a clear negative impact on the company's public image.

sentences.chinese: 研究者提醒，过度依赖算法可能带来负面后果。
sentences.traditional: 研究者提醒，過度依賴算法可能帶來負面後果。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiūzhě tíxǐng, guòdù yīlài suànfǎ kěnéng dài lái fùmiàn hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: Researchers warn that excessive reliance on algorithms may bring negative consequences.

sentences.chinese: 面对负面评价，管理者应该先分析原因，而不是急于辩解。
sentences.traditional: 面對負面評價，管理者應該先分析原因，而不是急於辯解。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì fùmiàn píngjià, guǎnlǐzhě yīnggāi xiān fēnxī yuányīn, ér bú shì jíyú biànjiě.
sentences.translation: When facing negative comments, managers should first analyse the reasons rather than rush to defend themselves.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区并不富裕，但公共服务的覆盖率却相当高。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區並不富裕，但公共服務的覆蓋率卻相當高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bìng bù fùyù, dàn gōnggòng fúwù de fùgài lǜ què xiāngdāng gāo.
sentences.translation: This region is not wealthy, yet the coverage of public services is quite high.

sentences.chinese: 稳定的就业机会使许多农村家庭逐渐富裕起来。
sentences.traditional: 穩定的就業機會使許多農村家庭逐漸富裕起來。
sentences.pinyin: Wěndìng de jiùyè jīhuì shǐ xǔduō nóngcūn jiātíng zhújiàn fùyù qǐlai.
sentences.translation: Stable employment opportunities have gradually made many rural families better off.

sentences.chinese: 发展乡村产业的目的，是富裕当地群众，而不是只增加财政收入。
sentences.traditional: 發展鄉村產業的目的，是富裕當地群眾，而不是只增加財政收入。
sentences.pinyin: Fāzhǎn xiāngcūn chǎnyè de mùdì, shì fùyù dāngdì qúnzhòng, ér bú shì zhǐ zēngjiā cáizhèng shōurù.
sentences.translation: The aim of developing rural industries is to enrich local people, not merely to increase fiscal revenue.

sentences.chinese: 法律赋予公民监督公共权力的权利。
sentences.traditional: 法律賦予公民監督公共權力的權利。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ fùyǔ gōngmín jiāndū gōnggòng quánlì de quánlì.
sentences.translation: The law gives citizens the right to supervise public power.

sentences.chinese: 这段经历赋予了他面对挫折的耐心与勇气。
sentences.traditional: 這段經歷賦予了他面對挫折的耐心與勇氣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn jīnglì fùyǔ le tā miànduì cuòzhé de nàixīn yǔ yǒngqì.
sentences.translation: This experience gave him the patience and courage to face setbacks.

sentences.chinese: 新技术赋予传统制造业更大的想象空间。
sentences.traditional: 新技術賦予傳統製造業更大的想像空間。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jìshù fùyǔ chuántǒng zhìzàoyè gèng dà de xiǎngxiàng kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: New technology gives traditional manufacturing greater room for imagination.

sentences.chinese: 该项目若能按期完成，将显著改善沿岸交通。
sentences.traditional: 該項目若能按期完成，將顯著改善沿岸交通。
sentences.pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù ruò néng ànqī wánchéng, jiāng xiǎnzhù gǎishàn yán'àn jiāotōng.
sentences.translation: If this project can be completed on schedule, it will significantly improve transport along the coast.

sentences.chinese: 该规定自公布之日起生效，任何单位不得擅自变更。
sentences.traditional: 該規定自公佈之日起生效，任何單位不得擅自變更。
sentences.pinyin: Gāi guīdìng zì gōngbù zhī rì qǐ shēngxiào, rènhé dānwèi bùdé shànzì biàngēng.
sentences.translation: This regulation takes effect from the date of publication, and no organisation may alter it without authorisation.

sentences.chinese: 调查报告指出，该现象并非偶然，而是长期积累的结果。
sentences.traditional: 調查報告指出，該現象並非偶然，而是長期積累的結果。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá bàogào zhǐchū, gāi xiànxiàng bìngfēi ǒurán, ér shì chángqī jīlěi de jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: The investigation report points out that this phenomenon is not accidental, but the result of long-term accumulation.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说被改编成电视剧后，人物关系被处理得更复杂。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說被改編成電視劇後，人物關係被處理得更複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō bèi gǎibiān chéng diànshìjù hòu, rénwù guānxì bèi chǔlǐ de gèng fùzá.
sentences.translation: After this novel was adapted into a television drama, the relationships between the characters were handled in a more complex way.

sentences.chinese: 导演在改编经典作品时，既保留了原著精神，也加入了当代视角。
sentences.traditional: 導演在改編經典作品時，既保留了原著精神，也加入了當代視角。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn zài gǎibiān jīngdiǎn zuòpǐn shí, jì bǎoliú le yuánzhù jīngshén, yě jiārù le dāngdài shìjiǎo.
sentences.translation: When adapting a classic work, the director both preserved the spirit of the original and added a contemporary perspective.

sentences.chinese: 这首民歌经过重新改编，呈现出完全不同的舞台效果。
sentences.traditional: 這首民歌經過重新改編，呈現出完全不同的舞臺效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu míngē jīngguò chóngxīn gǎibiān, chéngxiàn chū wánquán bùtóng de wǔtái xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: After being newly adapted, this folk song presents a completely different stage effect.

sentences.chinese: 老旧小区经过改造后，排水系统和公共空间都有明显改善。
sentences.traditional: 老舊小區經過改造後，排水系統和公共空間都有明顯改善。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎojiù xiǎoqū jīngguò gǎizào hòu, páishuǐ xìtǒng hé gōnggòng kōngjiān dōu yǒu míngxiǎn gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: After the old residential compound was renovated, both the drainage system and the public spaces were clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 企业若想降低能耗，就必须改造原有的生产流程。
sentences.traditional: 企業若想降低能耗，就必須改造原有的生產流程。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè ruò xiǎng jiàngdī nénghào, jiù bìxū gǎizào yuányǒu de shēngchǎn liúchéng.
sentences.translation: If an enterprise wants to reduce energy consumption, it must transform its original production process.

sentences.chinese: 城市更新不应只是改造建筑外观，还要回应居民的真实需求。
sentences.traditional: 城市更新不應只是改造建築外觀，還要回應居民的真實需求。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì gēngxīn bù yīng zhǐ shì gǎizào jiànzhú wàiguān, hái yào huíyìng jūmín de zhēnshí xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Urban renewal should not merely transform the appearance of buildings; it should also respond to residents’ real needs.

sentences.chinese: 在样本量不足的情况下，计算出的概率并不可靠。
sentences.traditional: 在樣本量不足的情況下，計算出的概率並不可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yàngběnliàng bùzú de qíngkuàng xià, jìsuàn chū de gàilǜ bìng bù kěkào.
sentences.translation: When the sample size is insufficient, the calculated probability is not reliable.

sentences.chinese: 如果概率很低，保险公司仍会根据风险后果来定价。
sentences.traditional: 如果概率很低，保險公司仍會根據風險後果來定價。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ gàilǜ hěn dī, bǎoxiǎn gōngsī réng huì gēnjù fēngxiǎn hòuguǒ lái dìngjià.
sentences.translation: Even if the probability is very low, an insurance company will still price it according to the consequences of the risk.

sentences.chinese: 气候模型不能给出确定答案，只能估计极端天气发生的概率。
sentences.traditional: 氣候模型不能給出確定答案，只能估計極端天氣發生的概率。
sentences.pinyin: Qìhòu móxíng bù néng gěi chū quèdìng dá'àn, zhǐ néng gūjì jíduān tiānqì fāshēng de gàilǜ.
sentences.translation: Climate models cannot give a definite answer; they can only estimate the probability of extreme weather occurring.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，长期熬夜和饮酒都会增加肝的负担。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，長期熬夜和飲酒都會增加肝的負擔。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, chángqī áoyè hé yǐnjiǔ dōu huì zēngjiā gān de fùdān.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him that staying up late for long periods and drinking alcohol both increase the burden on the liver.

sentences.chinese: 这项检查主要用于评估肝功能是否受到损害。
sentences.traditional: 這項檢查主要用於評估肝功能是否受到損害。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jiǎnchá zhǔyào yòng yú pínggū gān gōngnéng shìfǒu shòudào sǔnhài.
sentences.translation: This examination is mainly used to assess whether liver function has been damaged.

sentences.chinese: 在中医理论中，肝与情绪调节有密切关系。
sentences.traditional: 在中醫理論中，肝與情緒調節有密切關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhōngyī lǐlùn zhōng, gān yǔ qíngxù tiáojié yǒu mìqiè guānxì.
sentences.translation: In Chinese medical theory, the liver is closely related to emotional regulation.

sentences.chinese: 他一听到对方继续推卸责任，干脆结束了会议。
sentences.traditional: 他一聽到對方繼續推卸責任，乾脆結束了會議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì tīng dào duìfāng jìxù tuīxiè zérèn, gāncuì jiéshù le huìyì.
sentences.translation: As soon as he heard the other side continue to shift responsibility, he simply ended the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 与其反复争论，不如干脆把问题交给第三方评估。
sentences.traditional: 與其反覆爭論，不如乾脆把問題交給第三方評估。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí fǎnfù zhēnglùn, bùrú gāncuì bǎ wèntí jiāo gěi dì sān fāng pínggū.
sentences.translation: Rather than arguing repeatedly, it would be better simply to hand the issue over to a third party for assessment.

sentences.chinese: 她的回答非常干脆，没有留下任何模糊的余地。
sentences.traditional: 她的回答非常乾脆，沒有留下任何模糊的餘地。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huídá fēicháng gāncuì, méiyǒu liú xià rènhé móhu de yúdì.
sentences.translation: Her answer was very straightforward and left no room for ambiguity.

sentences.chinese: 由于双方都误解了合同条款，谈判一度变得十分尴尬。
sentences.traditional: 由於雙方都誤解了合同條款，談判一度變得十分尷尬。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shuāngfāng dōu wùjiě le hétong tiáokuǎn, tánpàn yídù biàn de shífēn gāngà.
sentences.translation: Because both sides had misunderstood the contract terms, the negotiations became very awkward for a time.

sentences.chinese: 他没有当众指出错误，以免让新同事感到尴尬。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有當眾指出錯誤，以免讓新同事感到尷尬。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu dāngzhòng zhǐchū cuòwù, yǐmiǎn ràng xīn tóngshì gǎndào gāngà.
sentences.translation: He did not point out the mistake in public, so as to avoid making the new colleague feel embarrassed.

sentences.chinese: 最尴尬的是，系统恢复后，所有人都发现问题其实很简单。
sentences.traditional: 最尷尬的是，系統恢復後，所有人都發現問題其實很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì gāngà de shì, xìtǒng huīfù hòu, suǒyǒu rén dōu fāxiàn wèntí qíshí hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: Most awkwardly, after the system was restored, everyone discovered that the problem was actually very simple.

sentences.chinese: 连续几个月的干旱使当地粮食产量大幅下降。
sentences.traditional: 連續幾個月的乾旱使當地糧食產量大幅下降。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jǐ ge yuè de gānhàn shǐ dāngdì liángshi chǎnliàng dàfú xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: Several consecutive months of drought caused local grain production to fall sharply.

sentences.chinese: 该地区气候干旱，农民只能依赖地下水灌溉。
sentences.traditional: 該地區氣候乾旱，農民只能依賴地下水灌溉。
sentences.pinyin: Gāi dìqū qìhòu gānhàn, nóngmín zhǐ néng yīlài dìxiàshuǐ guàngài.
sentences.translation: The climate in this region is arid, so farmers can only rely on groundwater for irrigation.

sentences.chinese: 为了适应干旱环境，研究团队选择了耐旱作物品种。
sentences.traditional: 為了適應乾旱環境，研究團隊選擇了耐旱作物品種。
