sentences.pinyin: Wèile shìyìng gānhàn huánjìng, yánjiū tuánduì xuǎnzé le nàihàn zuòwù pǐnzhǒng.
sentences.translation: To adapt to an arid environment, the research team selected drought-resistant crop varieties.

sentences.chinese: 外界噪音不断干扰实验数据的采集，研究小组只好重新安排测试时间。
sentences.traditional: 外界噪音不斷干擾實驗數據的採集，研究小組只好重新安排測試時間。
sentences.pinyin: Wàijiè zàoyīn búduàn gānrǎo shíyàn shùjù de cǎijí, yánjiū xiǎozǔ zhǐhǎo chóngxīn ānpái cèshì shíjiān.
sentences.translation: External noise kept interfering with the collection of experimental data, so the research group had to reschedule the tests.

sentences.chinese: 任何未经许可的软件都可能干扰系统运行，甚至造成数据丢失。
sentences.traditional: 任何未經許可的軟件都可能干擾系統運行，甚至造成數據丟失。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé wèijīng xǔkě de ruǎntǐ dōu kěnéng gānrǎo xìtǒng yùnxíng, shènzhì zàochéng shùjù diūshī.
sentences.translation: Any unauthorised software may interfere with the operation of the system, and may even cause data loss.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免广告干扰读者判断，平台决定把推广内容标得更醒目。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免廣告干擾讀者判斷，平臺決定把推廣內容標得更醒目。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn guǎnggào gānrǎo dúzhě pànduàn, píngtái juédìng bǎ tuīguǎng nèiróng biāo de gèng xǐngmù.
sentences.translation: To prevent adverts from interfering with readers’ judgement, the platform decided to label promoted content more prominently.

sentences.chinese: 冬季室内空气过于干燥，很多人会觉得喉咙不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 冬季室內空氣過於乾燥，很多人會覺得喉嚨不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngjì shìnèi kōngqì guòyú gānzào, hěn duō rén huì juéde hóulóng bù shūfu.
sentences.translation: In winter, indoor air is too dry, and many people feel discomfort in their throats.

sentences.chinese: 这种药材必须放在干燥通风的地方，否则容易变质。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥材必須放在乾燥通風的地方，否則容易變質。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàocái bìxū fàng zài gānzào tōngfēng de dìfang, fǒuzé róngyì biànzhì.
sentences.translation: This medicinal ingredient must be kept somewhere dry and ventilated; otherwise, it can easily deteriorate.

sentences.chinese: 长期干燥的气候使当地农业面临更严峻的挑战。
sentences.traditional: 長期乾燥的氣候使當地農業面臨更嚴峻的挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī gānzào de qìhòu shǐ dāngdì nóngyè miànlín gèng yánjùn de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: The long-term dry climate has caused local agriculture to face more severe challenges.

sentences.chinese: 对于老师多年来的耐心指导，他始终心怀感激。
sentences.traditional: 對於老師多年來的耐心指導，他始終心懷感激。
sentences.pinyin: Duìyú lǎoshī duō nián lái de nàixīn zhǐdǎo, tā shǐzhōng xīnhuái gǎnjī.
sentences.translation: For his teacher’s patient guidance over the years, he has always felt grateful.

sentences.chinese: 我们非常感激志愿者在灾后重建中作出的贡献。
sentences.traditional: 我們非常感激志願者在災後重建中作出的貢獻。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen fēicháng gǎnjī zhìyuànzhě zài zāihòu chóngjiàn zhōng zuòchū de gòngxiàn.
sentences.translation: We are very grateful for the contribution made by volunteers during post-disaster reconstruction.

sentences.chinese: 得知邻居主动照顾他的父亲后，他感激得说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: 得知鄰居主動照顧他的父親後，他感激得說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: Dézhī línjū zhǔdòng zhàogù tā de fùqīn hòu, tā gǎnjī de shuō bù chū huà lái.
sentences.translation: After learning that his neighbour had taken the initiative to care for his father, he was so grateful that he could not speak.

sentences.chinese: 听到设备发出警报，工程师赶忙切断电源并通知同事撤离。
sentences.traditional: 聽到設備發出警報，工程師趕忙切斷電源並通知同事撤離。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào shèbèi fāchū jǐngbào, gōngchéngshī gǎnmáng qiēduàn diànyuán bìng tōngzhī tóngshì chèlí.
sentences.translation: Hearing the equipment sound an alarm, the engineer hurriedly cut off the power and notified his colleagues to evacuate.

sentences.chinese: 会议提前开始了，助理赶忙把修改后的文件发给所有参会人员。
sentences.traditional: 會議提前開始了，助理趕忙把修改後的文件發給所有參會人員。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì tíqián kāishǐ le, zhùlǐ gǎnmáng bǎ xiūgǎi hòu de wénjiàn fā gěi suǒyǒu cānhuì rényuán.
sentences.translation: The meeting started early, so the assistant hurriedly sent the revised documents to all participants.

sentences.chinese: 孩子一说肚子疼，母亲赶忙联系儿科医生。
sentences.traditional: 孩子一說肚子疼，母親趕忙聯繫兒科醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yì shuō dùzi téng, mǔqīn gǎnmáng liánxì érkē yīshēng.
sentences.translation: As soon as the child said his stomach hurt, his mother hurriedly contacted a paediatrician.

sentences.chinese: 这种病毒主要通过空气传播，老人和儿童更容易被感染。
sentences.traditional: 這種病毒主要通過空氣傳播，老人和兒童更容易被感染。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìngdú zhǔyào tōngguò kōngqì chuánbō, lǎorén hé értóng gèng róngyì bèi gǎnrǎn.
sentences.translation: This virus is mainly transmitted through the air, and older people and children are more easily infected.

sentences.chinese: 他的乐观态度感染了整个团队，大家重新恢复了信心。
sentences.traditional: 他的樂觀態度感染了整個團隊，大家重新恢復了信心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de lèguān tàidù gǎnrǎn le zhěnggè tuánduì, dàjiā chóngxīn huīfù le xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: His optimistic attitude influenced the whole team, and everyone regained their confidence.

sentences.chinese: 伤口如果处理不当，可能会感染并引发更严重的问题。
sentences.traditional: 傷口如果處理不當，可能會感染並引發更嚴重的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngkǒu rúguǒ chǔlǐ bú dàng, kěnéng huì gǎnrǎn bìng yǐnfā gèng yánzhòng de wèntí.
sentences.translation: If a wound is not treated properly, it may become infected and lead to more serious problems.

sentences.chinese: 参观完博览会后，每位学生都要写一篇感想。
sentences.traditional: 參觀完博覽會後，每位學生都要寫一篇感想。
sentences.pinyin: Cānguān wán bólǎnhuì hòu, měi wèi xuéshēng dōu yào xiě yì piān gǎnxiǎng.
sentences.translation: After visiting the exposition, every student has to write a reflection.

sentences.chinese: 他在会上分享了自己对乡村教育的真实感想。
sentences.traditional: 他在會上分享了自己對鄉村教育的真實感想。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài huì shàng fēnxiǎng le zìjǐ duì xiāngcūn jiàoyù de zhēnshí gǎnxiǎng.
sentences.translation: At the meeting, he shared his real thoughts on rural education.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片引发了观众关于环境保护的深刻感想。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片引發了觀眾關於環境保護的深刻感想。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn yǐnfā le guānzhòng guānyú huánjìng bǎohù de shēnkè gǎnxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This documentary prompted the audience to form deep reflections on environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 虽然电子签名越来越普遍，他仍习惯用钢笔签署重要文件。
sentences.traditional: 雖然電子簽名越來越普遍，他仍習慣用鋼筆簽署重要文件。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán diànzǐ qiānmíng yuè lái yuè pǔbiàn, tā réng xíguàn yòng gāngbǐ qiānshǔ zhòngyào wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: Although electronic signatures are becoming more common, he is still used to signing important documents with a fountain pen.

sentences.chinese: 这支钢笔是祖父留下来的，笔身上还刻着他的名字。
sentences.traditional: 這支鋼筆是祖父留下來的，筆身上還刻著他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī gāngbǐ shì zǔfù liú xiàlai de, bǐshēn shàng hái kè zhe tā de míngzi.
sentences.translation: This pen was left by his grandfather, and his name is still engraved on the body of the pen.

sentences.chinese: 老师提醒学生，考试只能使用黑色钢笔或签字笔。
sentences.traditional: 老師提醒學生，考試只能使用黑色鋼筆或簽字筆。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng, kǎoshì zhǐ néng shǐyòng hēisè gāngbǐ huò qiānzìbǐ.
sentences.translation: The teacher reminded the students that only black pens or signature pens may be used in the exam.

sentences.chinese: 这个港口经过改造后，货物吞吐能力大幅提升。
sentences.traditional: 這個港口經過改造後，貨物吞吐能力大幅提升。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gǎngkǒu jīngguò gǎizào hòu, huòwù tūntǔ nénglì dàfú tíshēng.
sentences.translation: After this port was renovated, its cargo handling capacity increased substantially.

sentences.chinese: 台风来临前，所有船只都被要求返回港口避风。
sentences.traditional: 颱風來臨前，所有船隻都被要求返回港口避風。
sentences.pinyin: Táifēng láilín qián, suǒyǒu chuánzhī dōu bèi yāoqiú fǎnhuí gǎngkǒu bìfēng.
sentences.translation: Before the typhoon arrived, all vessels were required to return to the port to shelter from the wind.

sentences.chinese: 港口的畅通关系到整个地区的进出口贸易。
sentences.traditional: 港口的暢通關係到整個地區的進出口貿易。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎngkǒu de chàngtōng guānxì dào zhěnggè dìqū de jìnchūkǒu màoyì.
sentences.translation: The smooth operation of the port is related to the import and export trade of the whole region.

sentences.chinese: 公司根据项目需求重新调整了每个人的岗位。
sentences.traditional: 公司根據項目需求重新調整了每個人的崗位。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gēnjù xiàngmù xūqiú chóngxīn tiáozhěng le měi gè rén de gǎngwèi.
sentences.translation: The company readjusted everyone’s post according to the needs of the project.

sentences.chinese: 在关键岗位上，员工必须接受更严格的培训和考核。
sentences.traditional: 在關鍵崗位上，員工必須接受更嚴格的培訓和考核。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guānjiàn gǎngwèi shàng, yuángōng bìxū jiēshòu gèng yángé de péixùn hé kǎohé.
sentences.translation: In key posts, employees must receive stricter training and assessment.

sentences.chinese: 她主动申请到基层岗位工作，希望更直接地了解群众需求。
sentences.traditional: 她主動申請到基層崗位工作，希望更直接地了解群眾需求。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǔdòng shēnqǐng dào jīcéng gǎngwèi gōngzuò, xīwàng gèng zhíjiē de liǎojiě qúnzhòng xūqiú.
sentences.translation: She took the initiative to apply for a grassroots post, hoping to understand people’s needs more directly.

sentences.chinese: 高层管理者必须对企业的长期发展方向作出判断。
sentences.traditional: 高層管理者必須對企業的長期發展方向作出判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Gāocéng guǎnlǐzhě bìxū duì qǐyè de chángqī fāzhǎn fāngxiàng zuòchū pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Senior managers must make judgements about the company’s long-term direction of development.

sentences.chinese: 这次谈判涉及高层决策，普通部门无法单独决定。
sentences.traditional: 這次談判涉及高層決策，普通部門無法單獨決定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn shèjí gāocéng juécè, pǔtōng bùmén wúfǎ dāndú juédìng.
sentences.translation: This negotiation involves high-level decision-making, so ordinary departments cannot decide on it alone.

sentences.chinese: 城市高层建筑越来越多，消防安全也变得更加重要。
sentences.traditional: 城市高層建築越來越多，消防安全也變得更加重要。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì gāocéng jiànzhù yuè lái yuè duō, xiāofáng ānquán yě biàn de gèngjiā zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: As cities have more and more high-rise buildings, fire safety has also become even more important.

sentences.chinese: 他的修复技术十分高超，几乎看不出瓷器曾经碎过。
sentences.traditional: 他的修復技術十分高超，幾乎看不出瓷器曾經碎過。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiūfù jìshù shífēn gāochāo, jīhū kàn bù chū cíqì céngjīng suì guò.
sentences.translation: His restoration skill is so superb that one can hardly tell the porcelain was ever broken.

sentences.chinese: 这位医生凭借高超的判断力，及时发现了病情的变化。
sentences.traditional: 這位醫生憑藉高超的判斷力，及時發現了病情的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīshēng píngjiè gāochāo de pànduànlì, jíshí fāxiàn le bìngqíng de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Relying on superb judgement, this doctor noticed the change in the patient’s condition in time.

sentences.chinese: 真正高超的谈判技巧，不是压倒对方，而是让双方都能接受结果。
sentences.traditional: 真正高超的談判技巧，不是壓倒對方，而是讓雙方都能接受結果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng gāochāo de tánpàn jìqiǎo, bú shì yādǎo duìfāng, ér shì ràng shuāngfāng dōu néng jiēshòu jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Truly superb negotiation skills are not about overpowering the other side, but about making the result acceptable to both sides.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学在高等教育改革中试行了更加灵活的课程制度。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學在高等教育改革中試行了更加靈活的課程制度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué zài gāoděng jiàoyù gǎigé zhōng shìxíng le gèngjiā línghuó de kèchéng zhìdù.
sentences.translation: This university has trialled a more flexible curriculum system in higher education reform.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有扎实的基础，就很难理解高等数学中的抽象概念。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有紮實的基礎，就很難理解高等數學中的抽象概念。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu zhāshi de jīchǔ, jiù hěn nán lǐjiě gāoděng shùxué zhōng de chōuxiàng gàiniàn.
sentences.translation: Without a solid foundation, it is very difficult to understand the abstract concepts in advanced mathematics.

sentences.chinese: 高等职业教育既要重视技能训练，也要培养学生的职业素养。
sentences.traditional: 高等職業教育既要重視技能訓練，也要培養學生的職業素養。
sentences.pinyin: Gāoděng zhíyè jiàoyù jì yào zhòngshì jìnéng xùnliàn, yě yào péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhíyè sùyǎng.
sentences.translation: Higher vocational education must value both skills training and the cultivation of students’ professional qualities.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司把普通零件重新设计后，成功打入了高端市场。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司把普通零件重新設計後，成功打入了高端市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī bǎ pǔtōng língjiàn chóngxīn shèjì hòu, chénggōng dǎrù le gāoduān shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: After redesigning ordinary components, this company successfully entered the high-end market.

sentences.chinese: 高端客户更重视服务的稳定性，而不只是产品的价格。
sentences.traditional: 高端客戶更重視服務的穩定性，而不只是產品的價格。
sentences.pinyin: Gāoduān kèhù gèng zhòngshì fúwù de wěndìngxìng, ér bù zhǐ shì chǎnpǐn de jiàgé.
sentences.translation: High-end clients pay more attention to the stability of the service, not just the price of the product.

sentences.chinese: 国内企业正在努力突破关键技术，减少对进口高端设备的依赖。
sentences.traditional: 國內企業正在努力突破關鍵技術，減少對進口高端設備的依賴。
sentences.pinyin: Guónèi qǐyè zhèngzài nǔlì tūpò guānjiàn jìshù, jiǎnshǎo duì jìnkǒu gāoduān shèbèi de yīlài.
sentences.translation: Domestic companies are working to break through key technologies and reduce their reliance on imported high-end equipment.

sentences.chinese: 春节前后是铁路客运的高峰，车票往往提前售空。
sentences.traditional: 春節前後是鐵路客運的高峰，車票往往提前售空。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qiánhòu shì tiělù kèyùn de gāofēng, chēpiào wǎngwǎng tíqián shòu kōng.
sentences.translation: The period around Spring Festival is the peak for railway passenger transport, and tickets are often sold out in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这座山的高峰终年积雪，只有经验丰富的队伍才敢攀登。
sentences.traditional: 這座山的高峰終年積雪，只有經驗豐富的隊伍才敢攀登。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān de gāofēng zhōngnián jīxuě, zhǐyǒu jīngyàn fēngfù de duìwu cái gǎn pāndēng.
sentences.translation: The peak of this mountain is covered with snow all year round, and only experienced teams dare to climb it.

sentences.chinese: 城市早晚高峰期间，地铁站入口经常排起长队。
sentences.traditional: 城市早晚高峰期間，地鐵站入口經常排起長隊。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì zǎowǎn gāofēng qījiān, dìtiězhàn rùkǒu jīngcháng pái qǐ chángduì.
sentences.translation: During the morning and evening urban peak periods, long queues often form at the entrances to underground stations.

sentences.chinese: 他把大部分奖金捐给山区学校，这种精神令人觉得十分高尚。
sentences.traditional: 他把大部分獎金捐給山區學校，這種精神令人覺得十分高尚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ dà bùfen jiǎngjīn juān gěi shānqū xuéxiào, zhè zhǒng jīngshén lìng rén juéde shífēn gāoshàng.
sentences.translation: He donated most of his prize money to schools in mountain areas, and this spirit feels truly noble.

sentences.chinese: 高尚的职业道德不只体现在口号里，更体现在日常选择中。
sentences.traditional: 高尚的職業道德不只體現在口號裡，更體現在日常選擇中。
sentences.pinyin: Gāoshàng de zhíyè dàodé bù zhǐ tǐxiàn zài kǒuhào lǐ, gèng tǐxiàn zài rìcháng xuǎnzé zhōng.
sentences.translation: Noble professional ethics are reflected not only in slogans, but even more in everyday choices.

sentences.chinese: 如果一个社会只崇拜财富，而忽视高尚的人格，就会失去方向。
sentences.traditional: 如果一個社會只崇拜財富，而忽視高尚的人格，就會失去方向。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yí gè shèhuì zhǐ chóngbài cáifù, ér hūshì gāoshàng de réngé, jiù huì shīqù fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: If a society worships only wealth and ignores noble character, it will lose its direction.

sentences.chinese: 在网络安全领域，他算得上是处理复杂攻击的高手。
sentences.traditional: 在網絡安全領域，他算得上是處理複雜攻擊的高手。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù ānquán lǐngyù, tā suàndeshàng shì chǔlǐ fùzá gōngjí de gāoshǒu.
sentences.translation: In the field of cyber security, he can be counted as an expert in handling complex attacks.

sentences.chinese: 真正的高手不会炫耀技巧，而能在关键时刻解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 真正的高手不會炫耀技巧，而能在關鍵時刻解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de gāoshǒu bú huì xuànyào jìqiǎo, ér néng zài guānjiàn shíkè jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: A true expert does not show off technique, but can solve problems at crucial moments.

sentences.chinese: 这场比赛聚集了各地高手，任何失误都可能影响排名。
sentences.traditional: 這場比賽聚集了各地高手，任何失誤都可能影響排名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài jùjí le gèdì gāoshǒu, rènhé shīwù dōu kěnéng yǐngxiǎng páimíng.
sentences.translation: This competition has gathered experts from all over, and any mistake could affect the ranking.

sentences.chinese: 政府设立基金，鼓励高新技术企业加快成果转化。
sentences.traditional: 政府設立基金，鼓勵高新技術企業加快成果轉化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ shèlì jījīn, gǔlì gāoxīn jìshù qǐyè jiākuài chéngguǒ zhuǎnhuà.
sentences.translation: The government has set up a fund to encourage high and new technology enterprises to speed up the transformation of research results.

sentences.chinese: 高新技术的发展正在改变传统制造业的生产方式。
sentences.traditional: 高新技術的發展正在改變傳統製造業的生產方式。
sentences.pinyin: Gāoxīn jìshù de fāzhǎn zhèngzài gǎibiàn chuántǒng zhìzàoyè de shēngchǎn fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The development of high and new technology is changing the production methods of traditional manufacturing.

sentences.chinese: 如果缺少人才和长期投入，高新技术很难真正形成竞争力。
sentences.traditional: 如果缺少人才和長期投入，高新技術很難真正形成競爭力。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ quēshǎo réncái hé chángqī tóurù, gāoxīn jìshù hěn nán zhēnzhèng xíngchéng jìngzhēnglì.
sentences.translation: Without talent and long-term investment, high and new technology can hardly form real competitiveness.

sentences.chinese: 初到高原地区的人，往往需要几天时间适应缺氧环境。
sentences.traditional: 初到高原地區的人，往往需要幾天時間適應缺氧環境。
sentences.pinyin: Chū dào gāoyuán dìqū de rén, wǎngwǎng xūyào jǐ tiān shíjiān shìyìng quēyǎng huánjìng.
sentences.translation: People who first arrive in plateau areas often need several days to adapt to the low-oxygen environment.

sentences.chinese: 这片高原的昼夜温差很大，农业生产条件相当有限。
sentences.traditional: 這片高原的晝夜溫差很大，農業生產條件相當有限。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn gāoyuán de zhòuyè wēnchā hěn dà, nóngyè shēngchǎn tiáojiàn xiāngdāng yǒuxiàn.
sentences.translation: The temperature difference between day and night on this plateau is very large, and agricultural production conditions are quite limited.

sentences.chinese: 许多河流发源于青藏高原，对下游地区具有重要意义。
sentences.traditional: 許多河流發源於青藏高原，對下游地區具有重要意義。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō héliú fāyuán yú Qīng-Zàng gāoyuán, duì xiàyóu dìqū jùyǒu zhòngyào yìyì.
sentences.translation: Many rivers originate on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and are of great significance to downstream regions.

sentences.chinese: 编辑收到稿件后，会先检查格式，再安排专家审阅。
sentences.traditional: 編輯收到稿件後，會先檢查格式，再安排專家審閱。
sentences.pinyin: Biānjí shōudào gǎojiàn hòu, huì xiān jiǎnchá géshì, zài ānpái zhuānjiā shěnyuè.
sentences.translation: After receiving a manuscript, the editor will first check the formatting and then arrange for an expert review.

sentences.chinese: 这篇稿件涉及敏感数据，发布前必须再次核实来源。
sentences.traditional: 這篇稿件涉及敏感數據，發布前必須再次核實來源。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān gǎojiàn shèjí mǐngǎn shùjù, fābù qián bìxū zàicì héshí láiyuán.
sentences.translation: This manuscript involves sensitive data, so the source must be verified again before publication.

sentences.chinese: 由于版面有限，报社只采用了其中三篇稿件。
sentences.traditional: 由於版面有限，報社只採用了其中三篇稿件。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú bǎnmiàn yǒuxiàn, bàoshè zhǐ cǎiyòng le qízhōng sān piān gǎojiàn.
sentences.translation: Because page space was limited, the newspaper office used only three of the manuscripts.

sentences.chinese: 她把稿子改了好几遍，还是觉得论证不够有力。
sentences.traditional: 她把稿子改了好幾遍，還是覺得論證不夠有力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ gǎozi gǎi le hǎo jǐ biàn, háishi juéde lùnzhèng bú gòu yǒulì.
sentences.translation: She revised the draft several times, but still felt the argument was not strong enough.

sentences.chinese: 临上台前，他突然发现稿子落在办公室，只好凭记忆发言。
sentences.traditional: 臨上臺前，他突然發現稿子落在辦公室，只好憑記憶發言。
sentences.pinyin: Lín shàngtái qián, tā tūrán fāxiàn gǎozi là zài bàngōngshì, zhǐhǎo píng jìyì fāyán.
sentences.translation: Just before going on stage, he suddenly realised the draft had been left in the office, so he had to speak from memory.

sentences.chinese: 这份稿子虽然还不成熟，但已经呈现出作者独特的视角。
sentences.traditional: 這份稿子雖然還不成熟，但已經呈現出作者獨特的視角。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gǎozi suīrán hái bù chéngshú, dàn yǐjīng chéngxiàn chū zuòzhě dútè de shìjiǎo.
sentences.translation: Although this draft is not yet mature, it already shows the author’s unique perspective.

sentences.chinese: 为了防止伤口扩大，医生先把坏死的组织割掉，再进行清创处理。
sentences.traditional: 為了防止傷口擴大，醫生先把壞死的組織割掉，再進行清創處理。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ shāngkǒu kuòdà, yīshēng xiān bǎ huàisǐ de zǔzhī gēdiào, zài jìnxíng qīngchuāng chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: To stop the wound from worsening, the doctor first cut away necrotic tissue and then cleaned the wound.

sentences.chinese: 他舍不得把祖上传下来的那块布割开，宁愿另买材料。
sentences.traditional: 他捨不得把祖上傳下來的那塊布割開，寧願另買材料。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shěbude bǎ zǔshàng chuán xiàlai de nà kuài bù gēkāi, nìngyuàn lìng mǎi cáiliào.
sentences.translation: He could not bear to cut open the piece of cloth passed down by his ancestors, and preferred to buy other material.

sentences.chinese: 谈判不能只顾眼前利益，把长期合作关系轻易割裂。
sentences.traditional: 談判不能只顧眼前利益，把長期合作關係輕易割裂。
sentences.pinyin: Tánpàn bù néng zhǐ gù yǎnqián lìyì, bǎ chángqī hézuò guānxì qīngyì gēliè.
sentences.translation: Negotiations must not focus only on immediate interests and casually split apart a long-term co-operative relationship.

sentences.chinese: 那位老人用沙哑的声音歌唱故乡，台下许多人都红了眼眶。
sentences.traditional: 那位老人用沙啞的聲音歌唱故鄉，臺下許多人都紅了眼眶。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎorén yòng shāyǎ de shēngyīn gēchàng gùxiāng, táixià xǔduō rén dōu hóng le yǎnkuàng.
sentences.translation: The elderly man sang of his hometown in a hoarse voice, and many people in the audience had tears in their eyes.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片通过孩子们的歌唱，呈现了灾后社区重新站起来的力量。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片通過孩子們的歌唱，呈現了災後社區重新站起來的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tōngguò háizimen de gēchàng, chéngxiàn le zāihòu shèqū chóngxīn zhàn qǐlai de lìliàng.
sentences.translation: Through the children’s singing, this documentary presents the strength with which the community stood up again after the disaster.

sentences.chinese: 比赛要求选手现场歌唱，不允许提前录音或后期修音。
sentences.traditional: 比賽要求選手現場歌唱，不允許提前錄音或後期修音。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài yāoqiú xuǎnshǒu xiànchǎng gēchàng, bù yǔnxǔ tíqián lùyīn huò hòuqī xiūyīn.
sentences.translation: The competition requires contestants to sing live and does not allow pre-recording or post-production tuning.

sentences.chinese: 隔壁那家公司倒闭后，整层楼突然安静了许多。
sentences.traditional: 隔壁那家公司倒閉後，整層樓突然安靜了許多。
sentences.pinyin: Gébì nà jiā gōngsī dǎobì hòu, zhěng céng lóu tūrán ānjìng le xǔduō.
sentences.translation: After the company next door went bankrupt, the whole floor suddenly became much quieter.

sentences.chinese: 他把钥匙留在隔壁邻居那里，以防家人临时需要进门。
sentences.traditional: 他把鑰匙留在隔壁鄰居那裡，以防家人臨時需要進門。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yàoshi liú zài gébì línjū nàli, yǐfáng jiārén línshí xūyào jìn mén.
sentences.translation: He left the key with the neighbour next door in case his family needed to get in at short notice.

sentences.chinese: 虽然只是隔壁部门的问题，项目经理仍然主动协调资源。
sentences.traditional: 雖然只是隔壁部門的問題，項目經理仍然主動協調資源。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhǐ shì gébì bùmén de wèntí, xiàngmù jīnglǐ réngrán zhǔdòng xiétiáo zīyuán.
sentences.translation: Although it was only a problem in the department next door, the project manager still took the initiative to co-ordinate resources.

sentences.chinese: 工业革命改变了生产方式，也重新塑造了城市结构。
sentences.traditional: 工業革命改變了生產方式，也重新塑造了城市結構。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyè gémìng gǎibiàn le shēngchǎn fāngshì, yě chóngxīn sùzào le chéngshì jiégòu.
sentences.translation: The Industrial Revolution changed methods of production and also reshaped urban structures.

sentences.chinese: 这项技术虽然被称为革命性的突破，但真正应用仍需时间验证。
sentences.traditional: 這項技術雖然被稱為革命性的突破，但真正應用仍需時間驗證。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù suīrán bèi chēngwéi gémìngxìng de tūpò, dàn zhēnzhèng yìngyòng réng xū shíjiān yànzhèng.
sentences.translation: Although this technology is called a revolutionary breakthrough, its real-world application still needs to be tested over time.

sentences.chinese: 那场社会革命不仅推翻了旧制度，也改变了普通人的命运。
sentences.traditional: 那場社會革命不僅推翻了舊制度，也改變了普通人的命運。
sentences.pinyin: Nà chǎng shèhuì gémìng bùjǐn tuīfān le jiù zhìdù, yě gǎibiàn le pǔtōng rén de mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: That social revolution not only overthrew the old system, but also changed the fate of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 在大规模调查中，研究者既关注整体趋势，也记录个体差异。
sentences.traditional: 在大規模調查中，研究者既關注整體趨勢，也記錄個體差異。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dàguīmó diàochá zhōng, yánjiūzhě jì guānzhù zhěngtǐ qūshì, yě jìlù gètǐ chāyì.
sentences.translation: In a large-scale survey, researchers pay attention to both overall trends and individual differences.

sentences.chinese: 个体的选择看似有限，却会在长期内影响社会的方向。
sentences.traditional: 個體的選擇看似有限，卻會在長期內影響社會的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Gètǐ de xuǎnzé kàn sì yǒuxiàn, què huì zài chángqī nèi yǐngxiǎng shèhuì de fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: An individual’s choices may seem limited, yet over the long term they can influence the direction of society.

sentences.chinese: 政策制定不能只看平均数，否则弱势个体很容易被忽视。
sentences.traditional: 政策制定不能只看平均數，否則弱勢個體很容易被忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè zhìdìng bù néng zhǐ kàn píngjūnshù, fǒuzé ruòshì gètǐ hěn róngyì bèi hūshì.
sentences.translation: Policy-making must not look only at averages, otherwise vulnerable individuals can easily be overlooked.

sentences.chinese: 学校应当给予贫困学生更多支持，而不是只强调成绩排名。
sentences.traditional: 學校應當給予貧困學生更多支持，而不是只強調成績排名。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yīngdāng jǐyǔ pínkùn xuéshēng gèng duō zhīchí, ér bú shì zhǐ qiángdiào chéngjì páimíng.
sentences.translation: Schools should give disadvantaged students more support, rather than emphasising only grade rankings.

sentences.chinese: 对勇于揭露问题的员工，公司不仅没有处罚，反而给予奖励。
sentences.traditional: 對勇於揭露問題的員工，公司不僅沒有處罰，反而給予獎勵。
sentences.pinyin: Duì yǒngyú jiēlù wèntí de yuángōng, gōngsī bùjǐn méiyǒu chǔfá, fǎn'ér jǐyǔ jiǎnglì.
sentences.translation: For the employee who had the courage to expose the problem, the company not only did not punish them, but instead gave them a reward.

sentences.chinese: 这段经历给予他重新审视人生的机会。
sentences.traditional: 這段經歷給予他重新審視人生的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn jīnglì jǐyǔ tā chóngxīn shěnshì rénshēng de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: This experience gave him an opportunity to re-examine his life.

sentences.chinese: 孩子站在老师跟前，紧张得一句话也说不出来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子站在老師跟前，緊張得一句話也說不出來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zhàn zài lǎoshī gēnqián, jǐnzhāng de yí jù huà yě shuō bù chūlái.
sentences.translation: The child stood in front of the teacher, so nervous that not a single word would come out.

sentences.chinese: 在事实跟前，再华丽的借口都显得苍白无力。
sentences.traditional: 在事實跟前，再華麗的藉口都顯得蒼白無力。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shìshí gēnqián, zài huálì de jièkǒu dōu xiǎnde cāngbái wúlì.
sentences.translation: In the face of the facts, even the most elegant excuses seem pale and powerless.

sentences.chinese: 他把文件推到经理跟前，要求当场给出答复。
sentences.traditional: 他把文件推到經理跟前，要求當場給出答覆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wénjiàn tuī dào jīnglǐ gēnqián, yāoqiú dāngchǎng gěi chū dáfù.
sentences.translation: He pushed the document in front of the manager and demanded an answer on the spot.

sentences.chinese: 新员工跟随师傅实习了三个月，才独立处理客户投诉。
sentences.traditional: 新員工跟隨師傅實習了三個月，才獨立處理客戶投訴。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng gēnsuí shīfu shíxí le sān ge yuè, cái dúlì chǔlǐ kèhù tóusù.
sentences.translation: The new employee followed a mentor for three months of practice before handling customer complaints independently.

sentences.chinese: 投资者不应盲目跟随市场情绪，而要判断企业本身的价值。
sentences.traditional: 投資者不應盲目跟隨市場情緒，而要判斷企業本身的價值。
sentences.pinyin: Tóuzīzhě bù yīng mángmù gēnsuí shìchǎng qíngxù, ér yào pànduàn qǐyè běnshēn de jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Investors should not blindly follow market sentiment, but should judge the value of the company itself.

sentences.chinese: 这支科研团队跟随候鸟迁徙路线，采集了大量环境数据。
sentences.traditional: 這支科研團隊跟隨候鳥遷徙路線，採集了大量環境數據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī kēyán tuánduì gēnsuí hòuniǎo qiānxǐ lùxiàn, cǎijí le dàliàng huánjìng shùjù.
sentences.translation: This research team followed the migration route of the birds and collected a large amount of environmental data.

sentences.chinese: 系统会自动跟踪订单状态，并在货物抵达时提醒客户。
sentences.traditional: 系統會自動跟蹤訂單狀態，並在貨物抵達時提醒客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng gēnzōng dìngdān zhuàngtài, bìng zài huòwù dǐdá shí tíxǐng kèhù.
sentences.translation: The system automatically tracks order status and reminds customers when the goods arrive.

sentences.chinese: 为了评估政策成效，研究机构连续五年跟踪同一批家庭。
sentences.traditional: 為了評估政策成效，研究機構連續五年跟蹤同一批家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile pínggū zhèngcè chéngxiào, yánjiū jīgòu liánxù wǔ nián gēnzōng tóng yì pī jiātíng.
sentences.translation: To assess the effectiveness of the policy, the research institution tracked the same group of households for five consecutive years.

sentences.chinese: 那名记者被发现私下跟踪受访者，报社随后撤销了他的采访资格。
sentences.traditional: 那名記者被發現私下跟蹤受訪者，報社隨後撤銷了他的採訪資格。
sentences.pinyin: Nà míng jìzhě bèi fāxiàn sīxià gēnzōng shòufǎngzhě, bàoshè suíhòu chèxiāo le tā de cǎifǎng zīgé.
sentences.translation: That journalist was found to have secretly followed an interviewee, and the newspaper office later revoked his permission to conduct interviews.

sentences.chinese: 这笔钱属于公款，任何人都不能私自挪用。
sentences.traditional: 這筆錢屬於公款，任何人都不能私自挪用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián shǔyú gōngkuǎn, rènhé rén dōu bù néng sīzì nuóyòng.
sentences.translation: This money is public funds, and no one may privately misappropriate it.

sentences.chinese: 面对利益冲突，他仍然坚持公正处理，没有偏向任何一方。
sentences.traditional: 面對利益衝突，他仍然堅持公正處理，沒有偏向任何一方。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì lìyì chōngtū, tā réngrán jiānchí gōngzhèng chǔlǐ, méiyǒu piānxiàng rènhé yì fāng.
sentences.translation: Faced with a conflict of interest, he still insisted on handling the matter fairly and did not favour either side.

sentences.chinese: 企业的招聘流程越公开，求职者对结果就越容易接受。
sentences.traditional: 企業的招聘流程越公開，求職者對結果就越容易接受。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè de zhāopìn liúchéng yuè gōngkāi, qiúzhízhě duì jiéguǒ jiù yuè róngyì jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: The more open a company’s recruitment process is, the easier it is for applicants to accept the outcome.

sentences.chinese: 这座古老的宫建在山腰上，游客需要沿石阶慢慢上去。
sentences.traditional: 這座古老的宮建在山腰上，遊客需要沿石階慢慢上去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de gōng jiàn zài shānyāo shàng, yóukè xūyào yán shíjiē mànmàn shàngqù.
sentences.translation: This ancient palace was built on the mountainside, so visitors need to slowly climb up the stone steps.

sentences.chinese: 故宫的修复工作既要保护文物，也要考虑游客安全。
sentences.traditional: 故宮的修復工作既要保護文物，也要考慮遊客安全。
sentences.pinyin: Gùgōng de xiūfù gōngzuò jì yào bǎohù wénwù, yě yào kǎolǜ yóukè ānquán.
sentences.translation: The restoration work at the Forbidden City must both protect cultural relics and consider visitor safety.

sentences.chinese: 传说中，海边那座宫曾是王室避暑的地方。
sentences.traditional: 傳說中，海邊那座宮曾是王室避暑的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Chuánshuō zhōng, hǎibiān nà zuò gōng céng shì wángshì bìshǔ de dìfang.
sentences.translation: According to legend, that palace by the sea was once where the royal family escaped the summer heat.

sentences.chinese: 公安部门提醒居民不要随意点击陌生链接。
sentences.traditional: 公安部門提醒居民不要隨意點擊陌生鏈接。
sentences.pinyin: Gōng'ān bùmén tíxǐng jūmín bú yào suíyì diǎnjī mòshēng liànjiē.
sentences.translation: The public security department reminded residents not to click unfamiliar links casually.

sentences.chinese: 案件发生后，当地公安立即封锁现场并展开调查。
sentences.traditional: 案件發生後，當地公安立即封鎖現場並展開調查。
sentences.pinyin: Ànjiàn fāshēng hòu, dāngdì gōng'ān lìjí fēngsuǒ xiànchǎng bìng zhǎnkāi diàochá.
sentences.translation: After the case occurred, the local public security authorities immediately sealed off the scene and began an investigation.

sentences.chinese: 他向公安机关报案，说明自己的财物被盗。
sentences.traditional: 他向公安機關報案，說明自己的財物被盜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng gōng'ān jīguān bào'àn, shuōmíng zìjǐ de cáiwù bèi dào.
sentences.translation: He reported the case to the public security authority, explaining that his belongings had been stolen.

sentences.chinese: 工地周围设置了围栏，防止行人误入危险区域。
sentences.traditional: 工地周圍設置了圍欄，防止行人誤入危險區域。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngdì zhōuwéi shèzhì le wéilán, fángzhǐ xíngrén wùrù wēixiǎn qūyù.
sentences.translation: Fencing was set up around the construction site to prevent pedestrians from entering a dangerous area by mistake.

sentences.chinese: 雨季一到，工地的排水问题就变得更加突出。
sentences.traditional: 雨季一到，工地的排水問題就變得更加突出。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔjì yí dào, gōngdì de páishuǐ wèntí jiù biàn de gèngjiā tūchū.
sentences.translation: Once the rainy season arrives, drainage problems on the construction site become even more prominent.

sentences.chinese: 经理每天都去工地检查进度，确保项目按期完成。
sentences.traditional: 經理每天都去工地檢查進度，確保項目按期完成。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ měitiān dōu qù gōngdì jiǎnchá jìndù, quèbǎo xiàngmù ànqī wánchéng.
sentences.translation: The manager goes to the construction site every day to check progress and ensure the project is completed on schedule.

sentences.chinese: 为了让这篇报告更有说服力，他在数据分析上下了不少工夫。
sentences.traditional: 為了讓這篇報告更有說服力，他在數據分析上下了不少工夫。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ràng zhè piān bàogào gèng yǒu shuōfúlì, tā zài shùjù fēnxī shàng xià le bù shǎo gōngfu.
sentences.translation: To make this report more persuasive, he put considerable effort into the data analysis.

sentences.chinese: 这份教材看似简单，其实编写者花了很大工夫。
sentences.traditional: 這份教材看似簡單，其實編寫者花了很大工夫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn jiàocái kàn sì jiǎndān, qíshí biānxiězhě huā le hěn dà gōngfu.
sentences.translation: This teaching material looks simple, but in fact the writers spent a great deal of effort on it.

sentences.chinese: 我没工夫陪你争论这些细节，先把主要问题解决。
sentences.traditional: 我沒工夫陪你爭論這些細節，先把主要問題解決。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi gōngfu péi nǐ zhēnglùn zhèxiē xìjié, xiān bǎ zhǔyào wèntí jiějué.
sentences.translation: I do not have time to argue with you about these details; let us solve the main problem first.

sentences.chinese: 学校在网站上发布公告，说明期末考试的具体安排。
sentences.traditional: 學校在網站上發佈公告，說明期末考試的具體安排。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zài wǎngzhàn shàng fābù gōnggào, shuōmíng qīmò kǎoshì de jùtǐ ānpái.
sentences.translation: The school published an announcement on its website explaining the detailed arrangements for the final exams.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司公告称，部分岗位将被取消。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司公告稱，部分崗位將被取消。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī gōnggào chēng, bùfen gǎngwèi jiāng bèi qǔxiāo.
sentences.translation: The company announced that some posts would be cancelled.

sentences.chinese: 公告一贴出，居民们便开始讨论补偿方案是否合理。
sentences.traditional: 公告一貼出，居民們便開始討論補償方案是否合理。
sentences.pinyin: Gōnggào yì tiē chū, jūmínmen biàn kāishǐ tǎolùn bǔcháng fāng'àn shìfǒu hélǐ.
sentences.translation: As soon as the notice was posted, residents began discussing whether the compensation plan was reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 如果电力供给不足，工厂的生产线就会被迫停下来。
sentences.traditional: 如果電力供給不足，工廠的生產線就會被迫停下來。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ diànlì gōngjǐ bùzú, gōngchǎng de shēngchǎnxiàn jiù huì bèipò tíng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: If the electricity supply is insufficient, the factory’s production line will be forced to stop.

sentences.chinese: 政府通过补贴农户来稳定粮食供给。
sentences.traditional: 政府通過補貼農戶來穩定糧食供給。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tōngguò bǔtiē nónghù lái wěndìng liángshi gōngjǐ.
sentences.translation: The government stabilises the food supply by subsidising farmers.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统能根据需求变化自动调整水资源供给。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統能根據需求變化自動調整水資源供給。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng néng gēnjù xūqiú biànhuà zìdòng tiáozhěng shuǐ zīyuán gōngjǐ.
sentences.translation: This system can automatically adjust the supply of water resources according to changes in demand.

sentences.chinese: 专家指出，网络攻击往往从一个看似普通的附件开始。
sentences.traditional: 專家指出，網絡攻擊往往從一個看似普通的附件開始。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā zhǐchū, wǎngluò gōngjī wǎngwǎng cóng yí gè kàn sì pǔtōng de fùjiàn kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: Experts pointed out that cyberattacks often begin with an attachment that appears ordinary.

sentences.chinese: 他没有正面回答问题，反而开始攻击对方的人格。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有正面回答問題，反而開始攻擊對方的人格。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhèngmiàn huídá wèntí, fǎn'ér kāishǐ gōngjī duìfāng de réngé.
sentences.translation: He did not answer the question directly; instead, he began attacking the other person’s character.

sentences.chinese: 敌军试图攻击港口，但被守军及时击退。
sentences.traditional: 敵軍試圖攻擊港口，但被守軍及時擊退。
sentences.pinyin: Díjūn shìtú gōngjī gǎngkǒu, dàn bèi shǒujūn jíshí jītuì.
sentences.translation: The enemy tried to attack the port, but was repelled in time by the defending troops.

sentences.chinese: 调查结果将于下周公开，任何人都可以查询。
sentences.traditional: 調查結果將於下週公開，任何人都可以查詢。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jiéguǒ jiāng yú xià zhōu gōngkāi, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ cháxún.
sentences.translation: The results of the investigation will be made public next week, and anyone will be able to check them.

sentences.chinese: 他在会议上公开承认自己的判断存在严重失误。
sentences.traditional: 他在會議上公開承認自己的判斷存在嚴重失誤。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shàng gōngkāi chéngrèn zìjǐ de pànduàn cúnzài yánzhòng shīwù.
sentences.translation: He openly admitted at the meeting that there had been serious errors in his judgement.

sentences.chinese: 公开透明的流程有助于减少不必要的猜测。
sentences.traditional: 公開透明的流程有助於減少不必要的猜測。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngkāi tòumíng de liúchéng yǒuzhù yú jiǎnshǎo bú bìyào de cāicè.
sentences.translation: An open and transparent process helps reduce unnecessary speculation.

sentences.chinese: 每个公民都应了解自己的权利，同时承担相应的责任。
sentences.traditional: 每個公民都應瞭解自己的權利，同時承擔相應的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge gōngmín dōu yīng liǎojiě zìjǐ de quánlì, tóngshí chéngdān xiāngyìng de zérèn.
sentences.translation: Every citizen should understand their rights while also taking on the corresponding responsibilities.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目旨在提高公民参与社区治理的积极性。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目旨在提高公民參與社區治理的積極性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù zhǐzài tígāo gōngmín cānyù shèqū zhìlǐ de jījíxìng.
sentences.translation: This project aims to increase citizens’ enthusiasm for participating in community governance.

sentences.chinese: 面对公共危机，公民之间的互相信任显得格外重要。
sentences.traditional: 面對公共危機，公民之間的互相信任顯得格外重要。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì gōnggòng wēijī, gōngmín zhījiān de hùxiāng xìnrèn xiǎnde géwài zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In the face of a public crisis, mutual trust between citizens becomes especially important.

sentences.chinese: 他是业内公认的高手，处理复杂故障尤其有经验。
sentences.traditional: 他是業內公認的高手，處理複雜故障尤其有經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yènèi gōngrèn de gāoshǒu, chǔlǐ fùzá gùzhàng yóuqí yǒu jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He is a recognised expert in the industry and is especially experienced in handling complex faults.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说被公认为当代文学的重要作品。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說被公認為當代文學的重要作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō bèi gōngrèn wéi dāngdài wénxué de zhòngyào zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: This novel is generally recognised as an important work of contemporary literature.

sentences.chinese: 尽管标准不同，诚信仍是社会公认的基本价值。
sentences.traditional: 儘管標準不同，誠信仍是社會公認的基本價值。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn biāozhǔn bùtóng, chéngxìn réng shì shèhuì gōngrèn de jīběn jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Although standards differ, honesty remains a basic value generally recognised by society.

sentences.chinese: 这种药物的功效仍需通过长期临床观察来验证。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥物的功效仍需通過長期臨床觀察來驗證。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàowù de gōngxiào réng xū tōngguò chángqī línchuáng guānchá lái yànzhèng.
sentences.translation: This medicine’s efficacy still needs to be verified through long-term clinical observation.

sentences.chinese: 广告夸大了产品的功效，导致消费者产生误解。
sentences.traditional: 廣告誇大了產品的功效，導致消費者產生誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnggào kuādà le chǎnpǐn de gōngxiào, dǎozhì xiāofèizhě chǎnshēng wùjiě.
sentences.translation: The advert exaggerated the product’s effects, causing consumers to misunderstand.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革的实际功效，要等数据公布后才能判断。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革的實際功效，要等數據公佈後才能判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé de shíjì gōngxiào, yào děng shùjù gōngbù hòu cái néng pànduàn.
sentences.translation: The actual effect of this reform can only be judged after the data is released.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂把每道工序都记录下来，方便追查质量问题。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠把每道工序都記錄下來，方便追查質量問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng bǎ měi dào gōngxù dōu jìlù xiàlai, fāngbiàn zhuīchá zhìliàng wèntí.
sentences.translation: This factory records every procedure so that quality problems can be traced more easily.

sentences.chinese: 如果某一道工序被省略，成品的稳定性就会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果某一道工序被省略，成品的穩定性就會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ mǒu yí dào gōngxù bèi shěnglüè, chéngpǐn de wěndìngxìng jiù huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If a particular process is omitted, the stability of the finished product will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 老师傅熟悉整套工序，所以一眼就看出了问题所在。
sentences.traditional: 老師傅熟悉整套工序，所以一眼就看出了問題所在。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo shīfu shúxī zhěng tào gōngxù, suǒyǐ yì yǎn jiù kàn chū le wèntí suǒzài.
sentences.translation: The experienced craftsman knew the whole process well, so he saw the problem at a glance.

sentences.chinese: 她长期参与公益项目，希望改善偏远地区儿童的教育条件。
sentences.traditional: 她長期參與公益項目，希望改善偏遠地區兒童的教育條件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángqī cānyù gōngyì xiàngmù, xīwàng gǎishàn piānyuǎn dìqū értóng de jiàoyù tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: She has long taken part in public welfare projects, hoping to improve educational conditions for children in remote areas.

sentences.chinese: 企业做公益不应只追求形象，更应解决真实需求。
sentences.traditional: 企業做公益不應只追求形象，更應解決真實需求。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè zuò gōngyì bù yīng zhǐ zhuīqiú xíngxiàng, gèng yīng jiějué zhēnshí xūqiú.
sentences.translation: When companies engage in public welfare, they should not merely pursue image, but solve real needs.

sentences.chinese: 这场公益演出所得收入将全部用于灾后重建。
sentences.traditional: 這場公益演出所得收入將全部用於災後重建。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng gōngyì yǎnchū suǒ dé shōurù jiāng quánbù yòng yú zāihòu chóngjiàn.
sentences.translation: All income from this charity performance will be used for post-disaster reconstruction.

sentences.chinese: 受天气影响，部分蔬菜的供应一度变得紧张。
sentences.traditional: 受天氣影響，部分蔬菜的供應一度變得緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng, bùfen shūcài de gōngyìng yí dù biànde jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Affected by the weather, the supply of some vegetables became tight for a time.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司负责向医院供应高端医疗设备。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司負責向醫院供應高端醫療設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fùzé xiàng yīyuàn gōngyìng gāoduān yīliáo shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This company is responsible for supplying high-end medical equipment to hospitals.

sentences.chinese: 只要原材料供应稳定，生产计划就不会被打乱。
sentences.traditional: 只要原材料供應穩定，生產計劃就不會被打亂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào yuáncáiliào gōngyìng wěndìng, shēngchǎn jìhuà jiù bú huì bèi dǎluàn.
sentences.translation: As long as the raw material supply is stable, the production plan will not be disrupted.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城大约建于公元前二世纪。
sentences.traditional: 這座古城大約建於公元前二世紀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng dàyuē jiàn yú gōngyuán qián èr shìjì.
sentences.translation: This ancient city was probably built in the second century BC.

sentences.chinese: 公元十世纪，海上贸易推动了多个港口城市的发展。
sentences.traditional: 公元十世紀，海上貿易推動了多個港口城市的發展。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán shí shìjì, hǎishàng màoyì tuīdòng le duō gè gǎngkǒu chéngshì de fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: In the tenth century AD, maritime trade drove the development of several port cities.

sentences.chinese: 这份资料把事件按公元年份重新排列，便于读者比较。
sentences.traditional: 這份資料把事件按公元年份重新排列，便於讀者比較。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn zīliào bǎ shìjiàn àn gōngyuán niánfèn chóngxīn páiliè, biànyú dúzhě bǐjiào.
sentences.translation: This material rearranges the events by AD year, making them easier for readers to compare.

sentences.chinese: 只有程序足够透明，结果才更容易被认为是公正的。
sentences.traditional: 只有程序足夠透明，結果才更容易被認為是公正的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu chéngxù zúgòu tòumíng, jiéguǒ cái gèng róngyì bèi rènwéi shì gōngzhèng de.
sentences.translation: Only when the procedure is sufficiently transparent is the result more likely to be regarded as fair.

sentences.chinese: 法官必须保持公正，不能受舆论或私人关系影响。
sentences.traditional: 法官必須保持公正，不能受輿論或私人關係影響。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎguān bìxū bǎochí gōngzhèng, bù néng shòu yúlùn huò sīrén guānxì yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Judges must remain impartial and must not be influenced by public opinion or private relationships.

sentences.chinese: 他要求公司给出一个公正的处理方案，而不是简单道歉。
sentences.traditional: 他要求公司給出一個公正的處理方案，而不是簡單道歉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqiú gōngsī gěi chū yí gè gōngzhèng de chǔlǐ fāng'àn, ér bú shì jiǎndān dàoqiàn.
sentences.translation: He asked the company to provide a fair solution, not simply apologise.

sentences.chinese: 政府在制定新法规前，应充分听取公众意见。
sentences.traditional: 政府在制定新法規前，應充分聽取公眾意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zài zhìdìng xīn fǎguī qián, yīng chōngfèn tīngqǔ gōngzhòng yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Before making new regulations, the government should fully listen to public opinion.

sentences.chinese: 这起事件引起公众关注，媒体连续报道了好几天。
sentences.traditional: 這起事件引起公眾關注，媒體連續報道了好幾天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè qǐ shìjiàn yǐnqǐ gōngzhòng guānzhù, méitǐ liánxù bàodào le hǎo jǐ tiān.
sentences.translation: This incident attracted public attention, and the media reported on it for several days in a row.

sentences.chinese: 科学信息若表达不清，公众很容易产生误解。
sentences.traditional: 科學信息若表達不清，公眾很容易產生誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué xìnxī ruò biǎodá bù qīng, gōngzhòng hěn róngyì chǎnshēng wùjiě.
sentences.translation: If scientific information is not expressed clearly, the public can easily misunderstand it.

sentences.chinese: 在这部改编电影中，公主不再等待救援，而是亲自领导反抗。
sentences.traditional: 在這部改編電影中，公主不再等待救援，而是親自領導反抗。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè bù gǎibiān diànyǐng zhōng, gōngzhǔ bú zài děngdài jiùyuán, ér shì qīnzì lǐngdǎo fǎnkàng.
sentences.translation: In this adapted film, the princess no longer waits to be rescued, but personally leads the resistance.

sentences.chinese: 传说中的公主被赋予了象征和平与勇气的意义。
sentences.traditional: 傳說中的公主被賦予了象徵和平與勇氣的意義。
sentences.pinyin: Chuánshuō zhōng de gōngzhǔ bèi fùyǔ le xiàngzhēng hépíng yǔ yǒngqì de yìyì.
sentences.translation: The princess in the legend was given the meaning of symbolising peace and courage.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展出了据说属于一位公主的瓷器和耳环。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展出了據說屬於一位公主的瓷器和耳環。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū le jùshuō shǔyú yí wèi gōngzhǔ de cíqì hé ěrhuán.
sentences.translation: The museum displayed porcelain and earrings said to have belonged to a princess.

sentences.chinese: 复习不是简单重复，而是为了巩固已经形成的理解。
sentences.traditional: 複習不是簡單重複，而是為了鞏固已經形成的理解。
sentences.pinyin: Fùxí bú shì jiǎndān chóngfù, ér shì wèile gǒnggù yǐjīng xíngchéng de lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: Revision is not simple repetition, but is intended to consolidate understanding that has already formed.

sentences.chinese: 这次合作巩固了双方在高端市场的领先地位。
sentences.traditional: 這次合作鞏固了雙方在高端市場的領先地位。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì hézuò gǒnggù le shuāngfāng zài gāoduān shìchǎng de lǐngxiān dìwèi.
sentences.translation: This cooperation consolidated both sides’ leading positions in the high-end market.

sentences.chinese: 经过多轮训练，他的基本功已经相当巩固。
sentences.traditional: 經過多輪訓練，他的基本功已經相當鞏固。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò duō lún xùnliàn, tā de jīběngōng yǐjīng xiāngdāng gǒnggù.
sentences.translation: After several rounds of training, his basic skills are already quite solid.

sentences.chinese: 本次调查共计回收有效问卷三千二百份。
sentences.traditional: 本次調查共計回收有效問卷三千二百份。
sentences.pinyin: Běn cì diàochá gòngjì huíshōu yǒuxiào wènjuàn sān qiān èr bǎi fèn.
sentences.translation: This survey collected a total of 3,200 valid questionnaires.

sentences.chinese: 两个项目共计投入资金超过一亿元。
sentences.traditional: 兩個項目共計投入資金超過一億元。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè xiàngmù gòngjì tóurù zījīn chāoguò yí yì yuán.
sentences.translation: The two projects invested more than 100 million yuan in total.

sentences.chinese: 参展厂商共计一百二十家，规模比去年大幅扩大。
sentences.traditional: 參展廠商共計一百二十家，規模比去年大幅擴大。
sentences.pinyin: Cānzhǎn chǎngshāng gòngjì yì bǎi èrshí jiā, guīmó bǐ qùnián dàfú kuòdà.
sentences.translation: There were 120 participating manufacturers in total, and the scale was much larger than last year.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨把路边的沟冲得更深，村民只好临时搭桥通行。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨把路邊的溝沖得更深，村民只好臨時搭橋通行。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ bǎ lùbiān de gōu chōng de gèng shēn, cūnmín zhǐhǎo línshí dā qiáo tōngxíng.
sentences.translation: The heavy rain washed the roadside ditch even deeper, so the villagers had to build a temporary bridge to pass.

sentences.chinese: 为了防止积水，工人们沿着田地挖了一条排水沟。
sentences.traditional: 為了防止積水，工人們沿著田地挖了一條排水溝。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ jīshuǐ, gōngrénmen yánzhe tiándì wā le yì tiáo páishuǐ gōu.
sentences.translation: To prevent standing water, the workers dug a drainage ditch along the fields.

sentences.chinese: 孩子一不小心把球踢进了沟里，急得直喊。
sentences.traditional: 孩子一不小心把球踢進了溝裡，急得直喊。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yí bù xiǎoxīn bǎ qiú tī jìn le gōu li, jí de zhí hǎn.
sentences.translation: The child accidentally kicked the ball into the ditch and shouted anxiously.

sentences.chinese: 工程师用轻型材料构造了一个可以快速拆卸的展台。
sentences.traditional: 工程師用輕型材料構造了一個可以快速拆卸的展臺。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī yòng qīngxíng cáiliào gòuzào le yí gè kěyǐ kuàisù chāixiè de zhǎntái.
sentences.translation: The engineers used lightweight materials to construct a display stand that can be quickly dismantled.

sentences.chinese: 这篇论文试图构造一个新的理论模型来解释数据差异。
sentences.traditional: 這篇論文試圖構造一個新的理論模型來解釋數據差異。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān lùnwén shìtú gòuzào yí gè xīn de lǐlùn móxíng lái jiěshì shùjù chāyì.
sentences.translation: This paper attempts to construct a new theoretical model to explain the differences in the data.

sentences.chinese: 如果算法设计不合理，就很难构造出稳定的系统。
sentences.traditional: 如果算法設計不合理，就很難構造出穩定的系統。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ suànfǎ shèjì bù hélǐ, jiù hěn nán gòuzào chū wěndìng de xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: If the algorithm is poorly designed, it will be difficult to construct a stable system.

sentences.chinese: 尽管身边有很多同事，他在异国工作时仍常感到孤独。
sentences.traditional: 儘管身邊有很多同事，他在異國工作時仍常感到孤獨。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shēnbiān yǒu hěn duō tóngshì, tā zài yìguó gōngzuò shí réng cháng gǎndào gūdú.
sentences.translation: Although he had many colleagues around him, he still often felt lonely while working in a foreign country.

sentences.chinese: 长期被排斥的孩子容易变得敏感而孤独。
sentences.traditional: 長期被排斥的孩子容易變得敏感而孤獨。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī bèi páichì de háizi róngyì biàn de mǐngǎn ér gūdú.
sentences.translation: Children who are excluded for a long time can easily become sensitive and lonely.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影把老人的孤独表现得十分克制，却令人难忘。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影把老人的孤獨表現得十分克制，卻令人難忘。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bǎ lǎorén de gūdú biǎoxiàn de shífēn kèzhì, què lìng rén nánwàng.
sentences.translation: The film presents the old person’s loneliness with great restraint, yet in an unforgettable way.

sentences.chinese: 我姑姑年轻时在报社工作，后来成了一名资深编辑。
sentences.traditional: 我姑姑年輕時在報社工作，後來成了一名資深編輯。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gūgu niánqīng shí zài bàoshè gōngzuò, hòulái chéng le yì míng zīshēn biānjí.
sentences.translation: My aunt worked at a newspaper office when she was young and later became a senior editor.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，姑姑特意从外地回来给爷爷拜年。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，姑姑特意從外地回來給爺爺拜年。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, gūgu tèyì cóng wàidì huílai gěi yéye bàinián.
sentences.translation: During the Spring Festival, my aunt came back specially from another place to pay a New Year visit to my grandfather.

sentences.chinese: 父亲去世后，姑姑在很多关键决定上给了我支持。
sentences.traditional: 父親去世後，姑姑在很多關鍵決定上給了我支持。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn qùshì hòu, gūgu zài hěn duō guānjiàn juédìng shàng gěi le wǒ zhīchí.
sentences.translation: After my father passed away, my aunt supported me in many important decisions.

sentences.chinese: 他对古典文学的兴趣，来自小时候听祖父讲《红楼梦》的经历。
sentences.traditional: 他對古典文學的興趣，來自小時候聽祖父講《紅樓夢》的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì gǔdiǎn wénxué de xìngqù, láizì xiǎoshíhou tīng zǔfù jiǎng Hónglóu Mèng de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: His interest in classical literature comes from listening to his grandfather talk about Dream of the Red Chamber when he was young.

sentences.chinese: 这座剧院的外观采用了古典风格，内部却配备了现代设备。
sentences.traditional: 這座劇院的外觀採用了古典風格，內部卻配備了現代設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò jùyuàn de wàiguān cǎiyòng le gǔdiǎn fēnggé, nèibù què pèibèi le xiàndài shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The theatre’s exterior uses a classical style, while the interior is equipped with modern facilities.

sentences.chinese: 她的演奏既保留了古典音乐的庄重，又加入了个人理解。
sentences.traditional: 她的演奏既保留了古典音樂的莊重，又加入了個人理解。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnzòu jì bǎoliú le gǔdiǎn yīnyuè de zhuāngzhòng, yòu jiārù le gèrén lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: Her performance preserved the solemnity of classical music while adding her own interpretation.

sentences.chinese: 修复古迹不能只追求速度，更要尊重原有的历史层次。
sentences.traditional: 修復古蹟不能只追求速度，更要尊重原有的歷史層次。
sentences.pinyin: Xiūfù gǔjì bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú sùdù, gèng yào zūnzhòng yuányǒu de lìshǐ céngcì.
sentences.translation: Restoring historic sites must not only pursue speed; it must also respect the original historical layers.

sentences.chinese: 这片古迹被列入保护范围后，周边建设受到严格限制。
sentences.traditional: 這片古蹟被列入保護範圍後，周邊建設受到嚴格限制。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn gǔjì bèi lièrù bǎohù fànwéi hòu, zhōubiān jiànshè shòudào yángé xiànzhì.
sentences.translation: After this historic site was included in the protected area, nearby construction became strictly restricted.

sentences.chinese: 导游提醒游客不要在古迹上刻字，以免造成无法弥补的损害。
sentences.traditional: 導遊提醒遊客不要在古蹟上刻字，以免造成無法彌補的損害。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyóu tíxǐng yóukè bù yào zài gǔjì shàng kè zì, yǐmiǎn zàochéng wúfǎ míbǔ de sǔnhài.
sentences.translation: The guide reminded tourists not to carve words on the historic site, lest they cause irreparable damage.

sentences.chinese: 他购买股票之前，会先研究公司的财务状况和长期战略。
sentences.traditional: 他購買股票之前，會先研究公司的財務狀況和長期戰略。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gòumǎi gǔpiào zhīqián, huì xiān yánjiū gōngsī de cáiwù zhuàngkuàng hé chángqī zhànlüè.
sentences.translation: Before buying shares, he first studies the company’s financial situation and long-term strategy.

sentences.chinese: 股票价格大幅波动时，投资者更需要保持冷静。
sentences.traditional: 股票價格大幅波動時，投資者更需要保持冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔpiào jiàgé dàfú bōdòng shí, tóuzīzhě gèng xūyào bǎochí lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: When share prices fluctuate sharply, investors need to remain even calmer.

sentences.chinese: 她没有把全部积蓄投入股票，而是分散到不同资产中。
sentences.traditional: 她沒有把全部積蓄投入股票，而是分散到不同資產中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu bǎ quánbù jīxù tóurù gǔpiào, ér shì fēnsàn dào bùtóng zīchǎn zhōng.
sentences.translation: She did not put all her savings into shares, but spread them across different assets.

sentences.chinese: 古人虽然没有现代仪器，却能通过长期观察总结自然规律。
sentences.traditional: 古人雖然沒有現代儀器，卻能通過長期觀察總結自然規律。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔrén suīrán méiyǒu xiàndài yíqì, què néng tōngguò chángqī guānchá zǒngjié zìrán guīlǜ.
sentences.translation: Although ancient people did not have modern instruments, they could still summarise natural laws through long-term observation.

sentences.chinese: 阅读古人的文章，可以看到他们面对困境时的价值选择。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀古人的文章，可以看到他們面對困境時的價值選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú gǔrén de wénzhāng, kěyǐ kàndào tāmen miànduì kùnjìng shí de jiàzhí xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: Reading the writings of ancient people allows us to see the values they chose when facing difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 我们引用古人的智慧时，也要考虑当代社会的现实条件。
sentences.traditional: 我們引用古人的智慧時，也要考慮當代社會的現實條件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐnyòng gǔrén de zhìhuì shí, yě yào kǎolǜ dāngdài shèhuì de xiànshí tiáojiàn.
sentences.translation: When we quote the wisdom of ancient people, we also need to consider the realities of contemporary society.

sentences.chinese: 股市在短期内受到情绪影响，但长期仍取决于经济基本面。
sentences.traditional: 股市在短期內受到情緒影響，但長期仍取決於經濟基本面。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔshì zài duǎnqī nèi shòudào qíngxù yǐngxiǎng, dàn chángqī réng qǔjué yú jīngjì jīběnmiàn.
sentences.translation: The stock market is affected by sentiment in the short term, but in the long term it still depends on economic fundamentals.

sentences.chinese: 新政策公布后，股市顿时出现明显反弹。
sentences.traditional: 新政策公佈後，股市頓時出現明顯反彈。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè gōngbù hòu, gǔshì dùnshí chūxiàn míngxiǎn fǎntán.
sentences.translation: After the new policy was announced, the stock market immediately showed a clear rebound.

sentences.chinese: 对普通人来说，进入股市前应先了解风险，而不是盲目跟风。
sentences.traditional: 對普通人來說，進入股市前應先了解風險，而不是盲目跟風。
sentences.pinyin: Duì pǔtōng rén lái shuō, jìnrù gǔshì qián yīng xiān liǎojiě fēngxiǎn, ér bú shì mángmù gēnfēng.
sentences.translation: For ordinary people, before entering the stock market they should first understand the risks rather than blindly following the crowd.

sentences.chinese: 医生检查后发现，他手腕的一块骨头出现了细小裂纹。
sentences.traditional: 醫生檢查後發現，他手腕的一塊骨頭出現了細小裂紋。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu fāxiàn, tā shǒuwàn de yí kuài gǔtou chūxiàn le xìxiǎo lièwén.
sentences.translation: After the examination, the doctor found that a small bone in his wrist had a hairline crack.

sentences.chinese: 这锅汤要用牛骨头慢慢熬，味道才会浓。
sentences.traditional: 這鍋湯要用牛骨頭慢慢熬，味道才會濃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè guō tāng yào yòng niú gǔtou mànmàn áo, wèidào cái huì nóng.
sentences.translation: This soup needs to be simmered slowly with beef bones for the flavour to become rich.

sentences.chinese: 他表面上很温和，骨头里却有一种不服输的精神。
sentences.traditional: 他表面上很溫和，骨頭裡卻有一種不服輸的精神。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biǎomiàn shàng hěn wēnhé, gǔtou lǐ què yǒu yì zhǒng bù fúshū de jīngshén.
sentences.translation: He seems gentle on the surface, but deep down he has a spirit that refuses to admit defeat.

sentences.chinese: 这封来自前线的信极大地鼓舞了救援队员的士气。
sentences.traditional: 這封來自前線的信極大地鼓舞了救援隊員的士氣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng láizì qiánxiàn de xìn jídà de gǔwǔ le jiùyuán duìyuán de shìqì.
sentences.translation: This letter from the front line greatly raised the morale of the rescue team.

sentences.chinese: 真正鼓舞人心的领导，不只是下命令，而是让大家看到希望。
sentences.traditional: 真正鼓舞人心的領導，不只是下命令，而是讓大家看到希望。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng gǔwǔ rénxīn de lǐngdǎo, bú zhǐ shì xià mìnglìng, ér shì ràng dàjiā kàndào xīwàng.
sentences.translation: Truly inspiring leadership does not merely give orders; it lets people see hope.

sentences.chinese: 他的经历很鼓舞人心，但不能简单复制到每个人身上。
sentences.traditional: 他的經歷很鼓舞人心，但不能簡單複製到每個人身上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jīnglì hěn gǔwǔ rénxīn, dàn bù néng jiǎndān fùzhì dào měi gè rén shēnshang.
sentences.translation: His experience is inspiring, but it cannot simply be copied onto everyone.

sentences.chinese: 他只顾追求短期利润，最终忽视了产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 他只顧追求短期利潤，最終忽視了產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ gù zhuīqiú duǎnqī lìrùn, zuìzhōng hūshì le chǎnpǐn pǐnzhì.
sentences.translation: He only cared about pursuing short-term profits and ultimately ignored product quality.

sentences.chinese: 会议现场一片混乱，主持人已经顾不上解释细节。
sentences.traditional: 會議現場一片混亂，主持人已經顧不上解釋細節。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì xiànchǎng yí piàn hùnluàn, zhǔchírén yǐjīng gù bu shàng jiěshì xìjié.
sentences.translation: The meeting venue was in chaos, and the host could no longer manage to explain the details.

sentences.chinese: 在制定政策时，政府必须顾及不同群体的利益。
sentences.traditional: 在制定政策時，政府必須顧及不同群體的利益。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhìdìng zhèngcè shí, zhèngfǔ bìxū gùjí bùtóng qúntǐ de lìyì.
sentences.translation: When making policy, the government must take the interests of different groups into account.

sentences.chinese: 在常温下，这种物质既不是液体，也不是固体。
sentences.traditional: 在常溫下，這種物質既不是液體，也不是固體。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chángwēn xià, zhè zhǒng wùzhì jì bú shì yètǐ, yě bú shì gùtǐ.
sentences.translation: At room temperature, this substance is neither a liquid nor a solid.

sentences.chinese: 科学课上，学生观察了固体受热后体积变化的过程。
sentences.traditional: 科學課上，學生觀察了固體受熱後體積變化的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué kè shàng, xuéshēng guānchá le gùtǐ shòurè hòu tǐjī biànhuà de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: In science class, the students observed the process by which a solid’s volume changes after being heated.

sentences.chinese: 固体废弃物如果处理不当，会长期污染土壤和地下水。
sentences.traditional: 固體廢棄物如果處理不當，會長期污染土壤和地下水。
sentences.pinyin: Gùtǐ fèiqìwù rúguǒ chǔlǐ bùdàng, huì chángqī wūrǎn tǔrǎng hé dìxiàshuǐ.
sentences.translation: If solid waste is handled improperly, it can pollute soil and groundwater for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 公司聘请了一位法律顾问，专门处理跨境合同问题。
sentences.traditional: 公司聘請了一位法律顧問，專門處理跨境合同問題。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī pìnqǐng le yí wèi fǎlǜ gùwèn, zhuānmén chǔlǐ kuàjìng hétong wèntí.
sentences.translation: The company hired a legal consultant to handle cross-border contract issues specifically.

sentences.chinese: 这名顾问提出的方案虽然保守，却降低了项目风险。
sentences.traditional: 這名顧問提出的方案雖然保守，卻降低了項目風險。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè míng gùwèn tíchū de fāng'àn suīrán bǎoshǒu, què jiàngdī le xiàngmù fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Although the plan proposed by this consultant was conservative, it reduced the project’s risks.

sentences.chinese: 在谈判之前，我们需要先听听财务顾问的意见。
sentences.traditional: 在談判之前，我們需要先聽聽財務顧問的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tánpàn zhīqián, wǒmen xūyào xiān tīngting cáiwù gùwèn de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Before the negotiation, we need to listen first to the financial advisor’s opinion.

sentences.chinese: 系统出现故障后，技术人员连夜恢复了数据。
sentences.traditional: 系統出現故障後，技術人員連夜恢復了數據。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng chūxiàn gùzhàng hòu, jìshù rényuán liányè huīfù le shùjù.
sentences.translation: After the system malfunctioned, the technicians restored the data overnight.

sentences.chinese: 这次故障暴露出公司在备用方案上的薄弱环节。
sentences.traditional: 這次故障暴露出公司在備用方案上的薄弱環節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gùzhàng bàolù chū gōngsī zài bèiyòng fāng'àn shàng de bóruò huánjié.
sentences.translation: This malfunction exposed the company’s weak points in its backup plan.

sentences.chinese: 机器运行前要先检查故障记录，避免重复出错。
sentences.traditional: 機器運行前要先檢查故障記錄，避免重複出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì yùnxíng qián yào xiān jiǎnchá gùzhàng jìlù, bìmiǎn chóngfù chūcuò.
sentences.translation: Before the machine runs, the fault records should be checked first to avoid repeated errors.

sentences.chinese: 司机在路口突然拐向小巷，差点撞上骑车的人。
sentences.traditional: 司機在路口突然拐向小巷，差點撞上騎車的人。
sentences.pinyin: Sījī zài lùkǒu tūrán guǎi xiàng xiǎoxiàng, chàdiǎn zhuàng shàng qí chē de rén.
sentences.translation: The driver suddenly turned into a small alley at the junction and nearly hit a cyclist.

sentences.chinese: 他脚受伤后走路有点拐，但仍坚持参加会议。
sentences.traditional: 他腳受傷後走路有點拐，但仍堅持參加會議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎo shòushāng hòu zǒulù yǒudiǎn guǎi, dàn réng jiānchí cānjiā huìyì.
sentences.translation: After injuring his foot, he walked with a slight limp, but he still insisted on attending the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这条河到村口时向东一拐，形成了天然的边界。
sentences.traditional: 這條河到村口時向東一拐，形成了天然的邊界。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé dào cūnkǒu shí xiàng dōng yì guǎi, xíngchéng le tiānrán de biānjiè.
sentences.translation: When this river reaches the village entrance, it turns east and forms a natural boundary.

sentences.chinese: 公交车快到桥头时突然拐弯，乘客都晃了一下。
sentences.traditional: 公交車快到橋頭時突然拐彎，乘客都晃了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngjiāochē kuài dào qiáotóu shí tūrán guǎiwān, chéngkè dōu huàng le yí xià.
sentences.translation: When the bus was almost at the bridgehead, it suddenly turned, and the passengers all swayed.

sentences.chinese: 他讲话从不拐弯抹角，所以有时显得过于直接。
sentences.traditional: 他講話從不拐彎抹角，所以有時顯得過於直接。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎnghuà cóng bù guǎiwān mòjiǎo, suǒyǐ yǒushí xiǎnde guòyú zhíjiē.
sentences.translation: He never beats around the bush when he speaks, so at times he seems overly direct.

sentences.chinese: 沿着围墙往前走，第二个路口拐弯就能看到仓库。
sentences.traditional: 沿著圍牆往前走，第二個路口拐彎就能看到倉庫。
sentences.pinyin: Yánzhe wéiqiáng wǎng qián zǒu, dì èr gè lùkǒu guǎiwān jiù néng kàndào cāngkù.
sentences.translation: Walk forward along the wall, and after turning at the second junction you will see the warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 这名地方官因长期忽视民生问题而受到调查。
sentences.traditional: 這名地方官因長期忽視民生問題而受到調查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè míng dìfāng guān yīn chángqī hūshì mínshēng wèntí ér shòudào diàochá.
sentences.translation: This local official was investigated for long ignoring issues affecting people’s livelihoods.

sentences.chinese: 在古代，读书人常把当官视为改变命运的途径。
sentences.traditional: 在古代，讀書人常把當官視為改變命運的途徑。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dúshūrén cháng bǎ dāng guān shìwéi gǎibiàn mìngyùn de tújìng.
sentences.translation: In ancient times, scholars often regarded becoming an official as a path to changing their fate.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然是个小官，却坚持把每一份档案处理得很认真。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然是個小官，卻堅持把每一份檔案處理得很認真。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán shì ge xiǎo guān, què jiānchí bǎ měi yí fèn dàng'àn chǔlǐ de hěn rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: Although he was only a minor official, he insisted on handling every file very carefully.

sentences.chinese: 社会应该给予残疾儿童更多关爱，而不仅仅是同情。
sentences.traditional: 社會應該給予殘疾兒童更多關愛，而不僅僅是同情。
sentences.pinyin: Shèhuì yīnggāi jǐyǔ cánjí értóng gèng duō guān'ài, ér bù jǐnjǐn shì tóngqíng.
sentences.translation: Society should give disabled children more care, not merely sympathy.

sentences.chinese: 真正的关爱不是替孩子决定一切，而是教会他们选择。
sentences.traditional: 真正的關愛不是替孩子決定一切，而是教會他們選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de guān'ài bú shì tì háizi juédìng yíqiè, ér shì jiāohuì tāmen xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: True care is not deciding everything for children, but teaching them how to choose.

sentences.chinese: 这项公益活动旨在关爱独居老人，改善他们的生活环境。
sentences.traditional: 這項公益活動旨在關愛獨居老人，改善他們的生活環境。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngyì huódòng zhǐ zài guān'ài dújū lǎorén, gǎishàn tāmen de shēnghuó huánjìng.
sentences.translation: This public welfare activity aims to care for elderly people living alone and improve their living environment.

sentences.chinese: 官方尚未公布事故原因，网络上的猜测不宜轻信。
sentences.traditional: 官方尚未公佈事故原因，網絡上的猜測不宜輕信。
sentences.pinyin: Guānfāng shàng wèi gōngbù shìgù yuányīn, wǎngluò shàng de cāicè bù yí qīngxìn.
sentences.translation: The authorities have not yet announced the cause of the accident, so online speculation should not be readily believed.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告采用了官方数据，因此更适合用于政策分析。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告採用了官方數據，因此更適合用於政策分析。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào cǎiyòng le guānfāng shùjù, yīncǐ gèng shìhé yòng yú zhèngcè fēnxī.
sentences.translation: This report uses official data, so it is more suitable for policy analysis.

sentences.chinese: 比赛规则以官方版本为准，个人解释不能作为依据。
sentences.traditional: 比賽規則以官方版本為準，個人解釋不能作為依據。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài guīzé yǐ guānfāng bǎnběn wéi zhǔn, gèrén jiěshì bù néng zuòwéi yījù.
sentences.translation: The competition rules are based on the official version; personal interpretations cannot serve as a basis.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城不再满足于单纯吸引游客观光，而是试图让他们理解当地文化。
sentences.traditional: 這座古城不再滿足於單純吸引遊客觀光，而是試圖讓他們理解當地文化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng bù zài mǎnzú yú dānchún xīyǐn yóukè guānguāng, ér shì shìtú ràng tāmen lǐjiě dāngdì wénhuà.
sentences.translation: This ancient city is no longer satisfied with simply attracting tourists to sightsee, but is trying to help them understand local culture.

sentences.chinese: 如果只匆匆观光，而不与居民交流，你很难真正认识这片土地。
sentences.traditional: 如果只匆匆觀光，而不與居民交流，你很難真正認識這片土地。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ cōngcōng guānguāng, ér bù yǔ jūmín jiāoliú, nǐ hěn nán zhēnzhèng rènshi zhè piàn tǔdì.
sentences.translation: If you merely sightsee in a hurry without speaking with residents, it is hard to truly understand this land.

sentences.chinese: 为减少交通压力，市政府计划开通一条专门服务观光客的环城线路。
sentences.traditional: 為減少交通壓力，市政府計畫開通一條專門服務觀光客的環城線路。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi jiǎnshǎo jiāotōng yālì, shì zhèngfǔ jìhuà kāitōng yì tiáo zhuānmén fúwù guānguāngkè de huánchéng xiànlù.
sentences.translation: To reduce traffic pressure, the city government plans to open a circular route specifically serving sightseeing visitors.

sentences.chinese: 制度的价值不只在于效率，更在于它能否体现对弱势群体的关怀。
sentences.traditional: 制度的價值不只在於效率，更在於它能否體現對弱勢群體的關懷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìdù de jiàzhí bù zhǐ zài yú xiàolǜ, gèng zài yú tā néng fǒu tǐxiàn duì ruòshì qúntǐ de guānhuái.
sentences.translation: The value of a system lies not only in efficiency, but also in whether it can show care for vulnerable groups.

sentences.chinese: 老师对学生的关怀如果缺乏边界，反而可能让他们失去独立判断。
sentences.traditional: 老師對學生的關懷如果缺乏邊界，反而可能讓他們失去獨立判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì xuésheng de guānhuái rúguǒ quēfá biānjiè, fǎn'ér kěnéng ràng tāmen shīqù dúlì pànduàn.
sentences.translation: If a teacher’s care for students lacks boundaries, it may instead cause them to lose independent judgement.

sentences.chinese: 企业在裁员后仍应关怀离职员工，尽量帮助他们平稳过渡。
sentences.traditional: 企業在裁員後仍應關懷離職員工，儘量幫助他們平穩過渡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè zài cáiyuán hòu réng yīng guānhuái lízhí yuángōng, jǐnliàng bāngzhù tāmen píngwěn guòdù.
sentences.translation: After layoffs, a company should still care for departing employees and help them make a smooth transition as far as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这两项政策表面上互不相关，实际上却与同一个财政问题密切关联。
sentences.traditional: 這兩項政策表面上互不相關，實際上卻與同一個財政問題密切關聯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng xiàng zhèngcè biǎomiàn shang hù bù xiāngguān, shíjì shang què yǔ tóng yí gè cáizhèng wèntí mìqiè guānlián.
sentences.translation: These two policies appear unrelated on the surface, but in fact they are closely connected to the same fiscal issue.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员正在分析空气污染与儿童发病率之间的关联。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員正在分析空氣污染與兒童發病率之間的關聯。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán zhèngzài fēnxī kōngqì wūrǎn yǔ értóng fābìnglǜ zhījiān de guānlián.
sentences.translation: Researchers are analysing the connection between air pollution and the incidence of illness among children.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有明确证据，就不宜把这次故障与供应商的改造方案关联起来。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有明確證據，就不宜把這次故障與供應商的改造方案關聯起來。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu míngquè zhèngjù, jiù bù yí bǎ zhè cì gùzhàng yǔ gōngyìngshāng de gǎizào fāng'àn guānlián qǐlai.
sentences.translation: Without clear evidence, it is inadvisable to connect this malfunction with the supplier’s renovation plan.

sentences.chinese: 这座园林最适合在雨后观赏，因为石阶与花木都会呈现出不同的层次。
sentences.traditional: 這座園林最適合在雨後觀賞，因為石階與花木都會呈現出不同的層次。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò yuánlín zuì shìhé zài yǔ hòu guānshǎng, yīnwèi shíjiē yǔ huāmù dōu huì chéngxiàn chū bùtóng de céngcì.
sentences.translation: This garden is best viewed after rain, because the stone steps, flowers and trees all reveal different layers.

sentences.chinese: 观赏瓷器时，除了看图案，还要注意它的釉色和烧制工艺。
sentences.traditional: 觀賞瓷器時，除了看圖案，還要注意它的釉色和燒製工藝。
sentences.pinyin: Guānshǎng cíqì shí, chúle kàn tú'àn, hái yào zhùyì tā de yòusè hé shāozhì gōngyì.
sentences.translation: When admiring porcelain, besides looking at the pattern, you should also notice its glaze colour and firing technique.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护草原生态，游客只能在指定区域观赏野生动物。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護草原生態，遊客只能在指定區域觀賞野生動物。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù cǎoyuán shēngtài, yóukè zhǐ néng zài zhǐdìng qūyù guānshǎng yěshēng dòngwù.
sentences.translation: To protect the grassland ecosystem, visitors may only view wild animals in designated areas.

sentences.chinese: 这位官员在记者会上承诺，所有补贴发放情况都会及时公开。
sentences.traditional: 這位官員在記者會上承諾，所有補貼發放情況都會及時公開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi guānyuán zài jìzhěhuì shang chéngnuò, suǒyǒu bǔtiē fāfàng qíngkuàng dōu huì jíshí gōngkāi.
sentences.translation: At the press conference, this official promised that the distribution of all subsidies would be made public promptly.

sentences.chinese: 地方官员如果只重视短期成效，就容易忽略环境治理的持久性。
sentences.traditional: 地方官員如果只重視短期成效，就容易忽略環境治理的持久性。
sentences.pinyin: Dìfāng guānyuán rúguǒ zhǐ zhòngshì duǎnqī chéngxiào, jiù róngyì hūlüè huánjìng zhìlǐ de chíjiǔxìng.
sentences.translation: If local officials focus only on short-term results, they are likely to neglect the long-term nature of environmental governance.

sentences.chinese: 那名官员被迫辞职，并对审批过程中的不规范行为作出解释。
sentences.traditional: 那名官員被迫辭職，並對審批過程中的不規範行為作出解釋。
sentences.pinyin: Nà míng guānyuán bèipò cízhí, bìng duì shěnpī guòchéng zhōng de bù guīfàn xíngwéi zuòchū jiěshì.
sentences.translation: That official was forced to resign and explain the irregular conduct in the approval process.

sentences.chinese: 由于地下管道老化，居民区不时出现供水中断的问题。
sentences.traditional: 由於地下管道老化，居民區不時出現供水中斷的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú dìxià guǎndào lǎohuà, jūmínqū bùshí chūxiàn gōngshuǐ zhōngduàn de wèntí.
sentences.translation: Because the underground pipes have aged, the residential area occasionally experiences interruptions to the water supply.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统通过专用管道传输液体，以避免样本受到污染。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統通過專用管道傳輸液體，以避免樣本受到污染。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng tōngguò zhuānyòng guǎndào chuánshū yètǐ, yǐ bìmiǎn yàngběn shòudào wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: This system transfers liquid through dedicated pipes in order to prevent the samples from being contaminated.

sentences.chinese: 信息公开应有稳定管道，否则公众只能依赖未经证实的传言。
sentences.traditional: 信息公開應有穩定管道，否則公眾只能依賴未經證實的傳言。
sentences.pinyin: Zīxùn gōngkāi yīng yǒu wěndìng guǎndào, fǒuzé gōngzhòng zhǐ néng yīlài wèijīng zhèngshí de chuányán.
sentences.translation: The disclosure of information should have stable channels; otherwise the public can only rely on unverified rumours.

sentences.chinese: 仓库里堆着上千罐备用燃料，必须定期检查密封情况。
sentences.traditional: 倉庫裡堆著上千罐備用燃料，必須定期檢查密封情況。
sentences.pinyin: Cāngkù li duīzhe shàng qiān guàn bèiyòng ránliào, bìxū dìngqī jiǎnchá mìfēng qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Thousands of cans of backup fuel are piled in the warehouse, and their seals must be checked regularly.

sentences.chinese: 他把那罐蜂蜜放在常温下保存，结果不到一周就变质了。
sentences.traditional: 他把那罐蜂蜜放在常溫下保存，結果不到一週就變質了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà guàn fēngmì fàng zài chángwēn xià bǎocún, jiéguǒ bú dào yì zhōu jiù biànzhì le.
sentences.translation: He stored that jar of honey at room temperature, and as a result it went bad in less than a week.

sentences.chinese: 这种瓷罐虽然看似普通，却反映了当地古代工艺的高超水平。
sentences.traditional: 這種瓷罐雖然看似普通，卻反映了當地古代工藝的高超水平。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cíguàn suīrán kàn sì pǔtōng, què fǎnyìng le dāngdì gǔdài gōngyì de gāochāo shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: Although this porcelain jar seems ordinary, it reflects the superb level of local ancient craftsmanship.

sentences.chinese: 站在高原上远望，广阔的草原一直延伸到天边。
sentences.traditional: 站在高原上遠望，廣闊的草原一直延伸到天邊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàn zài gāoyuán shang yuǎnwàng, guǎngkuò de cǎoyuán yìzhí yánshēn dào tiānbiān.
sentences.translation: Looking into the distance from the plateau, the vast grassland stretches all the way to the horizon.

sentences.chinese: 数字技术的发展为传统产业转型提供了更加广阔的空间。
sentences.traditional: 數位技術的發展為傳統產業轉型提供了更加廣闊的空間。
sentences.pinyin: Shùwèi jìshù de fāzhǎn wèi chuántǒng chǎnyè zhuǎnxíng tígōng le gèngjiā guǎngkuò de kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: The development of digital technology has provided broader room for the transformation of traditional industries.

sentences.chinese: 他的视野相当广阔，既关注本土问题，也熟悉国际潮流。
sentences.traditional: 他的視野相當廣闊，既關注本土問題，也熟悉國際潮流。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shìyě xiāngdāng guǎngkuò, jì guānzhù běntǔ wèntí, yě shúxī guójì cháoliú.
sentences.translation: His perspective is quite broad; he pays attention to local issues while also being familiar with international trends.

sentences.chinese: 这批出土文物最终归国家所有，任何个人不得私自买卖。
sentences.traditional: 這批出土文物最終歸國家所有，任何個人不得私自買賣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī chūtǔ wénwù zuìzhōng guī guójiā suǒyǒu, rènhé gèrén bùdé sīzì mǎimai.
sentences.translation: This batch of unearthed cultural relics ultimately belongs to the state, and no individual may trade them privately.

sentences.chinese: 事故责任不能简单归到司机身上，还应检查道路设计是否合理。
sentences.traditional: 事故責任不能簡單歸到司機身上，還應檢查道路設計是否合理。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù zérèn bù néng jiǎndān guī dào sījī shēn shang, hái yīng jiǎnchá dàolù shèjì shìfǒu hélǐ.
sentences.translation: Responsibility for the accident cannot simply be attributed to the driver; the road design should also be examined.

sentences.chinese: 无论比赛结果如何，荣誉都应归于整个团队，而不是某一个人。
sentences.traditional: 無論比賽結果如何，榮譽都應歸於整個團隊，而不是某一個人。
sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn bǐsài jiéguǒ rúhé, róngyù dōu yīng guī yú zhěnggè tuánduì, ér bú shì mǒu yí gè rén.
sentences.translation: Whatever the result of the competition, the honour should belong to the whole team, not to any single person.

sentences.chinese: 为了规范网约车市场，交通部门公布了新的审核标准。
sentences.traditional: 為了規範網約車市場，交通部門公佈了新的審核標準。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile guīfàn wǎngyuēchē shìchǎng, jiāotōng bùmén gōngbù le xīn de shěnhé biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: In order to regulate the ride-hailing market, the transport department announced new review standards.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同的措辞不够规范，容易在执行过程中引发争议。
sentences.traditional: 這份合約的措辭不夠規範，容易在執行過程中引發爭議。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn héyuē de cuòcí bú gòu guīfàn, róngyì zài zhíxíng guòchéng zhōng yǐnfā zhēngyì.
sentences.translation: The wording of this contract is not standardised enough and may easily cause disputes during implementation.

sentences.chinese: 企业应建立内部规范，明确财务审批和信息公开的基本步骤。
sentences.traditional: 企業應建立內部規範，明確財務審批和信息公開的基本步驟。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīng jiànlì nèibù guīfàn, míngquè cáiwù shěnpī hé zīxùn gōngkāi de jīběn bùzhòu.
sentences.translation: Companies should establish internal rules that clearly define the basic steps for financial approval and information disclosure.

sentences.chinese: 城市规划若只追求速度，往往会忽视居民长期生活的便利性。
sentences.traditional: 城市規劃若只追求速度，往往會忽視居民長期生活的便利性。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì guīhuà ruò zhǐ zhuīqiú sùdù, wǎngwǎng huì hūshì jūmín chángqī shēnghuó de biànlìxìng.
sentences.translation: If urban planning only pursues speed, it often overlooks the long-term convenience of residents’ lives.

sentences.chinese: 在项目启动前，团队需要把资金、场地和人员安排都规划清楚。
sentences.traditional: 在專案啟動前，團隊需要把資金、場地和人員安排都規劃清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xiàngmù qǐdòng qián, tuánduì xūyào bǎ zījīn, chǎngdì hé rényuán ānpái dōu guīhuà qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Before the project starts, the team needs to plan out the funding, site, and staffing clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这份五年规划不仅提出了目标，也列出了可操作的步骤。
sentences.traditional: 這份五年規劃不僅提出了目標，也列出了可操作的步驟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn wǔ nián guīhuà bùjǐn tíchū le mùbiāo, yě lièchū le kě cāozuò de bùzhòu.
sentences.translation: This five-year plan not only sets out goals but also lists actionable steps.

sentences.chinese: 借来的设备必须按时归还，否则会影响后续实验的安排。
sentences.traditional: 借來的設備必須按時歸還，否則會影響後續實驗的安排。
sentences.pinyin: Jiè lái de shèbèi bìxū ànshí guīhuán, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng hòuxù shíyàn de ānpái.
sentences.translation: Borrowed equipment must be returned on time, otherwise it will affect the arrangement of later experiments.

sentences.chinese: 图书馆系统会自动提醒读者归还即将到期的书籍。
sentences.traditional: 圖書館系統會自動提醒讀者歸還即將到期的書籍。
sentences.pinyin: Túshūguǎn xìtǒng huì zìdòng tíxǐng dúzhě guīhuán jíjiāng dào qī de shūjí.
sentences.translation: The library system will automatically remind readers to return books that are about to become due.

sentences.chinese: 这笔押金将在房间检查无误后全部归还给租客。
sentences.traditional: 這筆押金將在房間檢查無誤後全部歸還給租客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ yājīn jiāng zài fángjiān jiǎnchá wúwù hòu quánbù guīhuán gěi zūkè.
sentences.translation: This deposit will be returned in full to the tenant after the room has been checked and found to be in order.

sentences.chinese: 新员工刚入职时，最好先熟悉公司的规矩，再提出改进建议。
sentences.traditional: 新員工剛入職時，最好先熟悉公司的規矩，再提出改進建議。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng gāng rùzhí shí, zuìhǎo xiān shúxī gōngsī de guīju, zài tíchū gǎijìn jiànyì.
sentences.translation: When new employees first join, it is best for them to understand the company’s rules before suggesting improvements.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子在外人面前很规矩，但在家里却十分活泼。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子在外人面前很規矩，但在家裡卻十分活潑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi zài wàirén miànqián hěn guīju, dàn zài jiālǐ què shífēn huópo.
sentences.translation: This child is very well-behaved in front of outsiders, but is very lively at home.

sentences.chinese: 行业没有统一规矩，消费者维权时常常缺乏依据。
sentences.traditional: 行業沒有統一規矩，消費者維權時常常缺乏依據。
sentences.pinyin: Hángyè méiyǒu tǒngyī guīju, xiāofèizhě wéiquán shí chángcháng quēfá yījù.
sentences.translation: Without unified industry rules, consumers often lack a clear basis when defending their rights.

sentences.chinese: 卫星进入预定轨道后，地面控制中心开始接收数据。
sentences.traditional: 衛星進入預定軌道後，地面控制中心開始接收資料。
sentences.pinyin: Wèixīng jìnrù yùdìng guǐdào hòu, dìmiàn kòngzhì zhōngxīn kāishǐ jiēshōu zīliào.
sentences.translation: After the satellite entered its planned orbit, the ground control centre began receiving data.

sentences.chinese: 这条高铁轨道穿过山区，因此施工难度比预期更大。
sentences.traditional: 這條高鐵軌道穿過山區，因此施工難度比預期更大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gāotiě guǐdào chuānguò shānqū, yīncǐ shīgōng nándù bǐ yùqī gèng dà.
sentences.translation: This high-speed rail track passes through a mountainous area, so construction is harder than expected.

sentences.chinese: 政策调整使企业重新回到稳定发展的轨道上。
sentences.traditional: 政策調整使企業重新回到穩定發展的軌道上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè tiáozhěng shǐ qǐyè chóngxīn huí dào wěndìng fāzhǎn de guǐdào shang.
sentences.translation: The policy adjustment put the company back on a track of stable development.

sentences.chinese: 他跪在老人面前道歉，这一幕让在场的人都沉默了。
sentences.traditional: 他跪在老人面前道歉，這一幕讓在場的人都沉默了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā guì zài lǎorén miànqián dàoqiàn, zhè yí mù ràng zài chǎng de rén dōu chénmò le.
sentences.translation: He knelt in front of the old man to apologise, and the scene left everyone present silent.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，膝盖受伤后不要长时间跪着工作。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，膝蓋受傷後不要長時間跪著工作。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, xīgài shòushāng hòu bú yào cháng shíjiān guì zhe gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him not to work while kneeling for long periods after injuring his knee.

sentences.chinese: 在某些传统礼仪中，人们会跪下来表达敬意。
sentences.traditional: 在某些傳統禮儀中，人們會跪下來表達敬意。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mǒu xiē chuántǒng lǐyí zhōng, rénmen huì guì xiàlai biǎodá jìngyì.
sentences.translation: In certain traditional rituals, people kneel down to express respect.

sentences.chinese: 贵重物品应存放在酒店保险箱内，以免遗失。
sentences.traditional: 貴重物品應存放在酒店保險箱內，以免遺失。
