sentences.translation: Several small rivers converge at the foot of the mountain into a wide river flowing eastwards.

sentences.chinese: 来自不同部门的数据最终汇在一个平台上，便于统一分析。
sentences.traditional: 來自不同部門的數據最終匯在一個平臺上，便於統一分析。
sentences.pinyin: Láizì bùtóng bùmén de shùjù zuìzhōng huì zài yí gè píngtái shàng, biànyú tǒngyī fēnxī.
sentences.translation: Data from different departments finally converges on one platform, making unified analysis easier.

sentences.chinese: 他把调查结果整理成图表，准备在例会上向领导汇报。
sentences.traditional: 他把調查結果整理成圖表，準備在例會上向領導匯報。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ diàochá jiéguǒ zhěnglǐ chéng túbiǎo, zhǔnbèi zài lìhuì shàng xiàng lǐngdǎo huìbào.
sentences.translation: He organised the investigation results into charts and prepared to report them to the leadership at the regular meeting.

sentences.chinese: 项目进度一旦出现异常，各小组必须当天汇报，不得隐瞒。
sentences.traditional: 項目進度一旦出現異常，各小組必須當天匯報，不得隱瞞。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù jìndù yídàn chūxiàn yìcháng, gè xiǎozǔ bìxū dàngtiān huìbào, bùdé yǐnmán.
sentences.translation: Once any abnormality appears in the project schedule, each group must report it that same day and must not conceal it.

sentences.chinese: 她的汇报虽然不长，却清楚呈现了问题的核心和改进方向。
sentences.traditional: 她的匯報雖然不長，卻清楚呈現了問題的核心和改進方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huìbào suīrán bù cháng, què qīngchu chéngxiàn le wèntí de héxīn hé gǎijìn fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: Although her report was not long, it clearly presented the core of the problem and the direction for improvement.

sentences.chinese: 他从小学习绘画，后来把这种能力用于建筑和舞台设计。
sentences.traditional: 他從小學習繪畫，後來把這種能力用於建築和舞臺設計。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xuéxí huìhuà, hòulái bǎ zhè zhǒng nénglì yòng yú jiànzhú hé wǔtái shèjì.
sentences.translation: He studied painting from childhood and later used this ability in architecture and stage design.

sentences.chinese: 绘画不仅是一种技能，也是一种观察世界和表达情感的方式。
sentences.traditional: 繪畫不僅是一種技能，也是一種觀察世界和表達情感的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Huìhuà bùjǐn shì yì zhǒng jìnéng, yě shì yì zhǒng guānchá shìjiè hé biǎodá qínggǎn de fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Painting is not only a skill, but also a way of observing the world and expressing emotions.

sentences.chinese: 这次展览把古典绘画与多媒体技术结合起来，吸引了大量观众。
sentences.traditional: 這次展覽把古典繪畫與多媒體技術結合起來，吸引了大量觀眾。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn bǎ gǔdiǎn huìhuà yǔ duōméitǐ jìshù jiéhé qǐlai, xīyǐn le dàliàng guānzhòng.
sentences.translation: This exhibition combines classical painting with multimedia technology and has attracted a large audience.

sentences.chinese: 总理将在峰会期间会见多国代表，就气候合作交换意见。
sentences.traditional: 總理將在峰會期間會見多國代表，就氣候合作交換意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒnglǐ jiāng zài fēnghuì qījiān huìjiàn duō guó dàibiǎo, jiù qìhòu hézuò jiāohuàn yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: The premier will meet representatives from several countries during the summit to exchange views on climate cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家拒绝会见记者，只通过出版社发表了一份简短声明。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家拒絕會見記者，只通過出版社發表了一份簡短聲明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā jùjué huìjiàn jìzhě, zhǐ tōngguò chūbǎnshè fābiǎo le yí fèn jiǎnduǎn shēngmíng.
sentences.translation: The writer refused to meet journalists and issued only a brief statement through the publishing house.

sentences.chinese: 双方代表会见后，原本紧张的谈判气氛明显缓和。
sentences.traditional: 雙方代表會見後，原本緊張的談判氣氛明顯緩和。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng dàibiǎo huìjiàn hòu, yuánběn jǐnzhāng de tánpàn qìfēn míngxiǎn huǎnhé.
sentences.translation: After the representatives from both sides met, the originally tense negotiating atmosphere clearly eased.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免延误，请在汇款后把凭证上传到系统。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免延誤，請在匯款後把憑證上傳到系統。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn yánwù, qǐng zài huìkuǎn hòu bǎ píngzhèng shàngchuán dào xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: To avoid delays, please upload the proof to the system after making the remittance.

sentences.chinese: 这笔汇款来自海外账户，银行需要进一步核实来源。
sentences.traditional: 這筆匯款來自海外帳戶，銀行需要進一步核實來源。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ huìkuǎn láizì hǎiwài zhànghù, yínháng xūyào jìnyíbù héshí láiyuán.
sentences.translation: This remittance came from an overseas account, so the bank needs to further verify its source.

sentences.chinese: 他误把学费汇款到旧账户，只好联系学校财务处理退款。
sentences.traditional: 他誤把學費匯款到舊帳戶，只好聯繫學校財務處理退款。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wù bǎ xuéfèi huìkuǎn dào jiù zhànghù, zhǐhǎo liánxì xuéxiào cáiwù chǔlǐ tuìkuǎn.
sentences.translation: He mistakenly remitted the tuition fee to the old account, so he had to contact the school finance office to handle the refund.

sentences.chinese: 稳定的婚姻并不意味着没有冲突，而是双方愿意共同解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 穩定的婚姻並不意味著沒有衝突，而是雙方願意共同解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Wěndìng de hūnyīn bìng bù yìwèizhe méiyǒu chōngtū, ér shì shuāngfāng yuànyì gòngtóng jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: A stable marriage does not mean there are no conflicts; rather, both sides are willing to solve problems together.

sentences.chinese: 在现代社会，越来越多人把婚姻看作平等合作的关系。
sentences.traditional: 在現代社會，越來越多人把婚姻看作平等合作的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xiàndài shèhuì, yuè lái yuè duō rén bǎ hūnyīn kànzuò píngděng hézuò de guānxì.
sentences.translation: In modern society, more and more people regard marriage as a relationship of equal cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 法律应当保护婚姻中的弱势一方，防止权利被忽视。
sentences.traditional: 法律應當保護婚姻中的弱勢一方，防止權利被忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ yīngdāng bǎohù hūnyīn zhōng de ruòshì yì fāng, fángzhǐ quánlì bèi hūshì.
sentences.translation: The law should protect the weaker party in a marriage and prevent their rights from being ignored.

sentences.chinese: 不同来源的数据不能随便混在一起，否则结论会失去可信度。
sentences.traditional: 不同來源的數據不能隨便混在一起，否則結論會失去可信度。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng láiyuán de shùjù bù néng suíbiàn hùn zài yìqǐ, fǒuzé jiélùn huì shīqù kěxìndù.
sentences.translation: Data from different sources must not be casually mixed together, otherwise the conclusion will lose credibility.

sentences.chinese: 他原本只是想混过考试，没想到后来真的对这门课产生了兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 他原本只是想混過考試，沒想到後來真的對這門課產生了興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuánběn zhǐshì xiǎng hùn guò kǎoshì, méi xiǎngdào hòulái zhēn de duì zhè mén kè chǎnshēng le xìngqù.
sentences.translation: At first he only wanted to scrape through the exam, but later he genuinely became interested in the course.

sentences.chinese: 这种颜色如果和灰色混得太多，画面就会显得沉重。
sentences.traditional: 這種顏色如果和灰色混得太多，畫面就會顯得沉重。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yánsè rúguǒ hé huīsè hùn de tài duō, huàmiàn jiù huì xiǎnde chénzhòng.
sentences.translation: If this colour is mixed with too much grey, the picture will look heavy and gloomy.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员将两种材料混合后，观察其强度是否有所提升。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員將兩種材料混合後，觀察其強度是否有所提升。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán jiāng liǎng zhǒng cáiliào hùnhé hòu, guānchá qí qiángdù shìfǒu yǒu suǒ tíshēng.
sentences.translation: After mixing the two materials, the researchers observed whether their strength had improved.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的文化由本土传统和外来元素混合而成。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的文化由本土傳統和外來元素混合而成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà yóu běntǔ chuántǒng hé wàilái yuánsù hùnhé ér chéng.
sentences.translation: The culture of this city is formed by a mixture of local traditions and outside elements.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，不要把几种药随意混合服用，以免产生副作用。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，不要把幾種藥隨意混合服用，以免產生副作用。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, bú yào bǎ jǐ zhǒng yào suíyì hùnhé fúyòng, yǐmiǎn chǎnshēng fùzuòyòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him not to take several medicines mixed together at will, in case side effects occur.

sentences.chinese: 发布会现场一度十分混乱，工作人员不得不临时调整入场秩序。
sentences.traditional: 發布會現場一度十分混亂，工作人員不得不臨時調整入場秩序。
sentences.pinyin: Fābùhuì xiànchǎng yídù shífēn hùnluàn, gōngzuò rényuán bùdébù línshí tiáozhěng rùchǎng zhìxù.
sentences.translation: The press conference venue was extremely chaotic for a while, and staff had to temporarily adjust the entry order.

sentences.chinese: 如果文件命名不规范，后期管理就会变得非常混乱。
sentences.traditional: 如果文件命名不規範，後期管理就會變得非常混亂。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wénjiàn mìngmíng bù guīfàn, hòuqī guǎnlǐ jiù huì biànde fēicháng hùnluàn.
sentences.translation: If file naming is not standardised, later management will become very disorderly.

sentences.chinese: 这段历史资料来源复杂，不能在混乱的叙述中轻易下结论。
sentences.traditional: 這段歷史資料來源複雜，不能在混亂的敘述中輕易下結論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn lìshǐ zīliào láiyuán fùzá, bù néng zài hùnluàn de xùshù zhōng qīngyì xià jiélùn.
sentences.translation: The sources for this historical material are complex, so conclusions should not be drawn lightly from a confused account.

sentences.chinese: 新政策为传统产业注入了活力，使许多小企业重新获得订单。
sentences.traditional: 新政策為傳統產業注入了活力，使許多小企業重新獲得訂單。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè wèi chuántǒng chǎnyè zhùrù le huólì, shǐ xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè chóngxīn huòdé dìngdān.
sentences.translation: The new policy injected vitality into traditional industries, enabling many small businesses to regain orders.

sentences.chinese: 一个城市是否有活力，不能只看高楼和商场，也要看公共空间的使用情况。
sentences.traditional: 一個城市是否有活力，不能只看高樓和商場，也要看公共空間的使用情況。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè chéngshì shìfǒu yǒu huólì, bù néng zhǐ kàn gāolóu hé shāngchǎng, yě yào kàn gōnggòng kōngjiān de shǐyòng qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Whether a city has vitality cannot be judged only by its high-rise buildings and shopping centres; the use of public space must also be considered.

sentences.chinese: 这支年轻的团队虽然经验不足，却展现出难得的活力和创造力。
sentences.traditional: 這支年輕的團隊雖然經驗不足，卻展現出難得的活力和創造力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī niánqīng de tuánduì suīrán jīngyàn bùzú, què zhǎnxiàn chū nándé de huólì hé chuàngzàolì.
sentences.translation: Although this young team lacks experience, it has shown rare energy and creativity.

sentences.chinese: 春节过后，旅游市场迅速活跃起来，酒店订单大幅增加。
sentences.traditional: 春節過後，旅遊市場迅速活躍起來，酒店訂單大幅增加。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié guòhòu, lǚyóu shìchǎng xùnsù huóyuè qǐlai, jiǔdiàn dìngdān dàfú zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: After Spring Festival, the tourism market quickly became active, and hotel orders increased substantially.

sentences.chinese: 她在讨论中十分活跃，经常提出别人没有想到的问题。
sentences.traditional: 她在討論中十分活躍，經常提出別人沒有想到的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài tǎolùn zhōng shífēn huóyuè, jīngcháng tíchū biérén méiyǒu xiǎngdào de wèntí.
sentences.translation: She is very active in discussions and often raises questions that others have not thought of.

sentences.chinese: 为了活跃课堂气氛，老师把抽象概念改编成一个小游戏。
sentences.traditional: 為了活躍課堂氣氛，老師把抽象概念改編成一個小遊戲。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huóyuè kètáng qìfēn, lǎoshī bǎ chōuxiàng gàiniàn gǎibiān chéng yí gè xiǎo yóuxì.
sentences.translation: To liven up the classroom atmosphere, the teacher adapted an abstract concept into a small game.

sentences.chinese: 这盒火柴已经受潮，划了好几次都没有点燃。
sentences.traditional: 這盒火柴已經受潮，劃了好幾次都沒有點燃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè hé huǒchái yǐjīng shòucháo, huá le hǎo jǐ cì dōu méiyǒu diǎnrán.
sentences.translation: This box of matches has already become damp; even after striking them several times, none lit.

sentences.chinese: 在没有电源的山屋里，一根火柴显得格外珍贵。
sentences.traditional: 在沒有電源的山屋裡，一根火柴顯得格外珍貴。
sentences.pinyin: Zài méiyǒu diànyuán de shānwū lǐ, yì gēn huǒchái xiǎnde géwài zhēnguì.
sentences.translation: In a mountain hut without electricity, a single match seemed especially precious.

sentences.chinese: 孩子不能随便玩火柴，否则很容易引发火灾。
sentences.traditional: 孩子不能隨便玩火柴，否則很容易引發火災。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bù néng suíbiàn wán huǒchái, fǒuzé hěn róngyì yǐnfā huǒzāi.
sentences.translation: Children must not play with matches casually, otherwise they can easily cause a fire.

sentences.chinese: 这场火灾暴露了商场消防管理中的严重漏洞。
sentences.traditional: 這場火災暴露了商場消防管理中的嚴重漏洞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng huǒzāi bàolù le shāngchǎng xiāofáng guǎnlǐ zhōng de yánzhòng lòudòng.
sentences.translation: This fire exposed serious loopholes in the shopping centre’s fire safety management.

sentences.chinese: 火灾发生后，住户被迫撤离，整栋楼暂时封闭。
sentences.traditional: 火災發生後，住戶被迫撤離，整棟樓暫時封閉。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒzāi fāshēng hòu, zhùhù bèipò chèlí, zhěng dòng lóu zhànshí fēngbì.
sentences.translation: After the fire occurred, the residents were forced to evacuate and the whole building was temporarily sealed off.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少火灾风险，仓库内不许存放易燃材料。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少火災風險，倉庫內不許存放易燃材料。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo huǒzāi fēngxiǎn, cāngkù nèi bùxǔ cúnfàng yìrán cáiliào.
sentences.translation: To reduce the risk of fire, flammable materials must not be stored inside the warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 如果货币发行过快，普通家庭的购买力可能会被削弱。
sentences.traditional: 如果貨幣發行過快，普通家庭的購買力可能會被削弱。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ huòbì fāxíng guò kuài, pǔtōng jiātíng de gòumǎilì kěnéng huì bèi xuēruò.
sentences.translation: If currency is issued too quickly, the purchasing power of ordinary households may be weakened.

sentences.chinese: 数字货币的发展正在改变跨境支付和金融监管的方式。
sentences.traditional: 數字貨幣的發展正在改變跨境支付和金融監管的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Shùzì huòbì de fāzhǎn zhèngzài gǎibiàn kuàjìng zhīfù hé jīnróng jiānguǎn de fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The development of digital currency is changing the way cross-border payments and financial regulation work.

sentences.chinese: 央行通过调整利率来维护货币稳定，避免市场过度波动。
sentences.traditional: 央行通過調整利率來維護貨幣穩定，避免市場過度波動。
sentences.pinyin: Yāngháng tōngguò tiáozhěng lìlǜ lái wéihù huòbì wěndìng, bìmiǎn shìchǎng guòdù bōdòng.
sentences.translation: The central bank adjusts interest rates to maintain currency stability and avoid excessive market volatility.

sentences.chinese: 这辆货车在高速公路上突然爆胎，导致后方车辆紧急避让。
sentences.traditional: 這輛貨車在高速公路上突然爆胎，導致後方車輛緊急避讓。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng huòchē zài gāosù gōnglù shàng tūrán bàotāi, dǎozhì hòufāng chēliàng jǐnjí bìràng.
sentences.translation: This truck suddenly had a tyre blowout on the motorway, causing the vehicles behind it to swerve urgently.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少市区拥堵，政府限制大型货车在早高峰进入中心道路。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少市區擁堵，政府限制大型貨車在早高峰進入中心道路。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo shìqū yōngdǔ, zhèngfǔ xiànzhì dàxíng huòchē zài zǎo gāofēng jìnrù zhōngxīn dàolù.
sentences.translation: To reduce congestion in the city centre, the government restricts large trucks from entering central roads during the morning rush hour.

sentences.chinese: 冷藏货车如果温度控制不稳定，整批食品都可能被退回。
sentences.traditional: 冷藏貨車如果溫度控制不穩定，整批食品都可能被退回。
sentences.pinyin: Lěngcáng huòchē rúguǒ wēndù kòngzhì bù wěndìng, zhěng pī shípǐn dōu kěnéng bèi tuìhuí.
sentences.translation: If a refrigerated truck fails to keep its temperature stable, the whole batch of food may be returned.

sentences.chinese: 尽管对手准备充分，我们的队伍仍在决赛中击败了他们。
sentences.traditional: 儘管對手準備充分，我們的隊伍仍在決賽中擊敗了他們。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn duìshǒu zhǔnbèi chōngfèn, wǒmen de duìwu réng zài juésài zhōng jībài le tāmen.
sentences.translation: Although the opponents were well prepared, our team still defeated them in the final.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司靠更低的成本和更快的交付速度击败了多家竞争者。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司靠更低的成本和更快的交付速度擊敗了多家競爭者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī kào gèng dī de chéngběn hé gèng kuài de jiāofù sùdù jībài le duō jiā jìngzhēng zhě.
sentences.translation: This company defeated several competitors through lower costs and faster delivery.

sentences.chinese: 真正困难的不是击败别人，而是克服自己的恐惧和惰性。
sentences.traditional: 真正困難的不是擊敗別人，而是克服自己的恐懼和惰性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng kùnnán de bú shì jībài biérén, ér shì kèfú zìjǐ de kǒngjù hé duòxìng.
sentences.translation: The truly difficult thing is not defeating others, but overcoming one’s own fear and laziness.

sentences.chinese: 科研团队在海拔很高的地区建立了长期观测基地。
sentences.traditional: 科研團隊在海拔很高的地區建立了長期觀測基地。
sentences.pinyin: Kēyán tuánduì zài hǎibá hěn gāo de dìqū jiànlì le chángqī guāncè jīdì.
sentences.translation: The research team established a long-term observation base in a high-altitude area.

sentences.chinese: 这个港口不仅是贸易基地，也是周边产业链的重要支点。
sentences.traditional: 這個港口不僅是貿易基地，也是周邊產業鏈的重要支點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gǎngkǒu bùjǐn shì màoyì jīdì, yě shì zhōubiān chǎnyèliàn de zhòngyào zhīdiǎn.
sentences.translation: This port is not only a trade base, but also an important support point for the surrounding industrial chain.

sentences.chinese: 学校把旧工厂改造成创新基地，鼓励学生把想法变成产品。
sentences.traditional: 學校把舊工廠改造成創新基地，鼓勵學生把想法變成產品。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bǎ jiù gōngchǎng gǎizào chéng chuàngxīn jīdì, gǔlì xuésheng bǎ xiǎngfǎ biàn chéng chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: The school transformed an old factory into an innovation base, encouraging students to turn ideas into products.

sentences.chinese: 机动车进入校园前必须登记，以免影响学生安全。
sentences.traditional: 機動車進入校園前必須登記，以免影響學生安全。
sentences.pinyin: Jīdòngchē jìnrù xiàoyuán qián bìxū dēngjì, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng xuésheng ānquán.
sentences.translation: Motor vehicles must be registered before entering the campus so as not to affect student safety.

sentences.chinese: 这条路白天禁止机动车通行，只允许行人和自行车使用。
sentences.traditional: 這條路白天禁止機動車通行，只允許行人和自行車使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù báitiān jìnzhǐ jīdòngchē tōngxíng, zhǐ yǔnxǔ xíngrén hé zìxíngchē shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This road is closed to motor vehicles during the day and may only be used by pedestrians and bicycles.

sentences.chinese: 城市规划不能只考虑机动车效率，也要照顾老人和儿童的出行需求。
sentences.traditional: 城市規劃不能只考慮機動車效率，也要照顧老人和兒童的出行需求。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì guīhuà bù néng zhǐ kǎolǜ jīdòngchē xiàolǜ, yě yào zhàogu lǎorén hé értóng de chūxíng xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Urban planning must not consider only motor-vehicle efficiency; it must also take care of the travel needs of older people and children.

sentences.chinese: 连续工作十几个小时后，他又累又饥饿，几乎说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: 連續工作十幾個小時後，他又累又飢餓，幾乎說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù gōngzuò shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí hòu, tā yòu lèi yòu jī'è, jīhū shuō bù chū huà lái.
sentences.translation: After working continuously for more than ten hours, he was so tired and hungry that he could hardly speak.

sentences.chinese: 许多灾民处于饥饿状态，急需食物和干净的水。
sentences.traditional: 許多災民處於飢餓狀態，急需食物和乾淨的水。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō zāimín chǔyú jī'è zhuàngtài, jíxū shíwù hé gānjìng de shuǐ.
sentences.translation: Many disaster victims are in a state of hunger and urgently need food and clean water.

sentences.chinese: 长期饥饿的儿童更容易生病，也更难集中注意力。
sentences.traditional: 長期飢餓的兒童更容易生病，也更難集中注意力。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī jī'è de értóng gèng róngyì shēngbìng, yě gèng nán jízhōng zhùyìlì.
sentences.translation: Children who are hungry for a long time are more likely to become ill and find it harder to concentrate.

sentences.chinese: 一个好的问题往往能激发学生继续探索的兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 一個好的問題往往能激發學生繼續探索的興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè hǎo de wèntí wǎngwǎng néng jīfā xuésheng jìxù tànsuǒ de xìngqù.
sentences.translation: A good question can often inspire students’ interest in continuing to explore.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败没有让他放弃，反而激发了他重新开始的勇气。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗沒有讓他放棄，反而激發了他重新開始的勇氣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài méiyǒu ràng tā fàngqì, fǎn'ér jīfā le tā chóngxīn kāishǐ de yǒngqì.
sentences.translation: This failure did not make him give up; instead, it inspired his courage to start again.

sentences.chinese: 公共艺术能够激发居民对社区的认同感和参与感。
sentences.traditional: 公共藝術能夠激發居民對社區的認同感和參與感。
sentences.pinyin: Gōnggòng yìshù nénggòu jīfā jūmín duì shèqū de rèntónggǎn hé cānyùgǎn.
sentences.translation: Public art can stimulate residents’ sense of identification with and participation in the community.

sentences.chinese: 这项基金专门支持年轻科学家的早期研究。
sentences.traditional: 這項基金專門支持年輕科學家的早期研究。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jījīn zhuānmén zhīchí niánqīng kēxuéjiā de zǎoqī yánjiū.
sentences.translation: This fund is dedicated to supporting the early-stage research of young scientists.

sentences.chinese: 由于市场波动，他决定把一部分基金转换成风险较低的产品。
sentences.traditional: 由於市場波動，他決定把一部分基金轉換成風險較低的產品。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shìchǎng bōdòng, tā juédìng bǎ yí bùfen jījīn zhuǎnhuàn chéng fēngxiǎn jiào dī de chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: Because of market volatility, he decided to convert part of the fund into lower-risk products.

sentences.chinese: 教育基金的管理必须透明，否则很难获得公众信任。
sentences.traditional: 教育基金的管理必須透明，否則很難獲得公眾信任。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù jījīn de guǎnlǐ bìxū tòumíng, fǒuzé hěn nán huòdé gōngzhòng xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: The management of an education fund must be transparent; otherwise, it is hard to gain public trust.

sentences.chinese: 老师的一句话激励了他多年，直到他考上理想的大学。
sentences.traditional: 老師的一句話激勵了他多年，直到他考上理想的大學。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de yí jù huà jīlì le tā duōnián, zhídào tā kǎo shàng lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
sentences.translation: One sentence from the teacher motivated him for years, until he got into his ideal university.

sentences.chinese: 与其用压力控制员工，不如用清晰的目标激励他们。
sentences.traditional: 與其用壓力控制員工，不如用清晰的目標激勵他們。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí yòng yālì kòngzhì yuángōng, bùrú yòng qīngxī de mùbiāo jīlì tāmen.
sentences.translation: Rather than controlling employees through pressure, it is better to motivate them with clear goals.

sentences.chinese: 奖学金制度不仅是奖励优秀学生，也是在激励更多人努力学习。
sentences.traditional: 獎學金制度不僅是獎勵優秀學生，也是在激勵更多人努力學習。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎngxuéjīn zhìdù bùjǐn shì jiǎnglì yōuxiù xuésheng, yě shì zài jīlì gèng duō rén nǔlì xuéxí.
sentences.translation: A scholarship system not only rewards outstanding students; it also motivates more people to study hard.

sentences.chinese: 他演讲时充满激情，很快就调动了全场的情绪。
sentences.traditional: 他演講時充滿激情，很快就調動了全場的情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǎnjiǎng shí chōngmǎn jīqíng, hěn kuài jiù diàodòng le quánchǎng de qíngxù.
sentences.translation: When he spoke, he was full of passion and quickly stirred the emotions of the whole audience.

sentences.chinese: 创业需要激情，但更需要耐心、纪律和现实的计划。
sentences.traditional: 創業需要激情，但更需要耐心、紀律和現實的計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Chuàngyè xūyào jīqíng, dàn gèng xūyào nàixīn, jìlǜ hé xiànshí de jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Starting a business requires passion, but it requires patience, discipline and a realistic plan even more.

sentences.chinese: 随着年龄增长，她对音乐的激情没有减弱，反而更加稳定。
sentences.traditional: 隨著年齡增長，她對音樂的激情沒有減弱，反而更加穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe niánlíng zēngzhǎng, tā duì yīnyuè de jīqíng méiyǒu jiǎnruò, fǎn'ér gèngjiā wěndìng.
sentences.translation: As she grew older, her passion for music did not weaken; instead, it became steadier.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂正在更新机械，以减少能耗并提高生产效率。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠正在更新機械，以減少能耗並提高生產效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhèngzài gēngxīn jīxiè, yǐ jiǎnshǎo nénghào bìng tígāo shēngchǎn xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: This factory is updating its machinery in order to reduce energy consumption and improve production efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 他的回答太机械，听不出真正的情绪。
sentences.traditional: 他的回答太機械，聽不出真正的情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huídá tài jīxiè, tīng bù chū zhēnzhèng de qíngxù.
sentences.translation: His answer was too mechanical; you could not hear any real emotion in it.

sentences.chinese: 机械故障导致整条生产线停了半天。
sentences.traditional: 機械故障導致整條生產線停了半天。
sentences.pinyin: Jīxiè gùzhàng dǎozhì zhěng tiáo shēngchǎn xiàn tíng le bàn tiān.
sentences.translation: A mechanical failure caused the whole production line to stop for half a day.

sentences.chinese: 科学家发现，这种疾病与某些基因变化有关。
sentences.traditional: 科學家發現，這種疾病與某些基因變化有關。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāxiàn, zhè zhǒng jíbìng yǔ mǒu xiē jīyīn biànhuà yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: Scientists found that this disease is related to changes in certain genes.

sentences.chinese: 良好的生活习惯不能改变基因，却能影响健康结果。
sentences.traditional: 良好的生活習慣不能改變基因，卻能影響健康結果。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de shēnghuó xíguàn bùnéng gǎibiàn jīyīn, què néng yǐngxiǎng jiànkāng jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Good lifestyle habits cannot change genes, but they can influence health outcomes.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目需要收集大量基因数据，并严格保护参与者隐私。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目需要收集大量基因數據，並嚴格保護參與者隱私。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào shōují dàliàng jīyīn shùjù, bìng yángé bǎohù cānyùzhě yǐnsī.
sentences.translation: This project needs to collect a large amount of genetic data and strictly protect the privacy of participants.

sentences.chinese: 经济转型给小城市带来了新的发展机遇。
sentences.traditional: 經濟轉型給小城市帶來了新的發展機遇。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngjì zhuǎnxíng gěi xiǎo chéngshì dàilái le xīn de fāzhǎn jīyù.
sentences.translation: Economic transformation has brought new development opportunities to small cities.

sentences.chinese: 他没有等待机遇，而是主动去建立人脉和经验。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有等待機遇，而是主動去建立人脈和經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu děngdài jīyù, ér shì zhǔdòng qù jiànlì rénmài hé jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He did not wait for opportunities, but actively built connections and experience.

sentences.chinese: 对年轻研究者来说，国际合作既是挑战，也是难得的机遇。
sentences.traditional: 對年輕研究者來說，國際合作既是挑戰，也是難得的機遇。
sentences.pinyin: Duì niánqīng yánjiūzhě lái shuō, guójì hézuò jì shì tiǎozhàn, yě shì nándé de jīyù.
sentences.translation: For young researchers, international cooperation is both a challenge and a rare opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 公司建立了投诉处理机制，要求三天内给出答复。
sentences.traditional: 公司建立了投訴處理機制，要求三天內給出答覆。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jiànlì le tóusù chǔlǐ jīzhì, yāoqiú sān tiān nèi gěi chū dáfù.
sentences.translation: The company established a complaint-handling mechanism requiring a response within three days.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有监督机制，再好的规定也可能流于形式。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有監督機制，再好的規定也可能流於形式。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu jiāndū jīzhì, zài hǎo de guīdìng yě kěnéng liú yú xíngshì.
sentences.translation: Without a supervision mechanism, even good rules may become a mere formality.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要先弄清楚问题产生的机制，再决定如何干预。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要先弄清楚問題產生的機制，再決定如何干預。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào xiān nòng qīngchu wèntí chǎnshēng de jīzhì, zài juédìng rúhé gānyù.
sentences.translation: We need to understand the mechanism by which the problem arises before deciding how to intervene.

sentences.chinese: 即便预算有限，我们也不能降低安全标准。
sentences.traditional: 即便預算有限，我們也不能降低安全標準。
sentences.pinyin: Jíbiàn yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, wǒmen yě bùnéng jiàngdī ānquán biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: Even if the budget is limited, we must not lower safety standards.

sentences.chinese: 他即便受到批评，也很少在公开场合反驳别人。
sentences.traditional: 他即便受到批評，也很少在公開場合反駁別人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jíbiàn shòudào pīpíng, yě hěn shǎo zài gōngkāi chǎnghé fǎnbó biérén.
sentences.translation: Even when he is criticised, he rarely refutes others in public.

sentences.chinese: 即便结果不如预期，这次尝试仍然积累了宝贵经验。
sentences.traditional: 即便結果不如預期，這次嘗試仍然積累了寶貴經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Jíbiàn jiéguǒ bùrú yùqī, zhè cì chángshì réngrán jīlěi le bǎoguì jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Even if the result is not as expected, this attempt has still accumulated valuable experience.

sentences.chinese: 在极端天气下，老人和儿童需要特别照顾。
sentences.traditional: 在極端天氣下，老人和兒童需要特別照顧。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jíduān tiānqì xià, lǎorén hé értóng xūyào tèbié zhàogù.
sentences.translation: In extreme weather, elderly people and children need special care.

sentences.chinese: 他的观点太极端，很难得到多数人的支持。
sentences.traditional: 他的觀點太極端，很難得到多數人的支持。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de guāndiǎn tài jíduān, hěn nán dédào duōshù rén de zhīchí.
sentences.translation: His views are too extreme, so it is hard for them to gain the support of most people.

sentences.chinese: 这种做法极端危险，必须立刻停止。
sentences.traditional: 這種做法極端危險，必須立刻停止。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ jíduān wēixiǎn, bìxū lìkè tíngzhǐ.
sentences.translation: This practice is extremely dangerous and must be stopped immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他学过急救，所以在救护车到来前保持了冷静。
sentences.traditional: 他學過急救，所以在救護車到來前保持了冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xué guò jíjiù, suǒyǐ zài jiùhùchē dàolái qián bǎochí le lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: He had learnt first aid, so he stayed calm before the ambulance arrived.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒家长，发生意外时不要乱移动伤者，应先急救并拨打电话。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒家長，發生意外時不要亂移動傷者，應先急救並撥打電話。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng jiāzhǎng, fāshēng yìwài shí bùyào luàn yídòng shāngzhě, yīng xiān jíjiù bìng bōdǎ diànhuà.
sentences.translation: Doctors remind parents not to move an injured person carelessly after an accident; they should give first aid first and make a phone call.

sentences.chinese: 学校定期组织急救培训，教学生处理烫伤和出血。
sentences.traditional: 學校定期組織急救培訓，教學生處理燙傷和出血。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào dìngqī zǔzhī jíjiù péixùn, jiāo xuéshēng chǔlǐ tàngshāng hé chūxuè.
sentences.translation: The school regularly organises first-aid training, teaching students how to deal with burns and bleeding.

sentences.chinese: 她急切地想知道面试结果，一上午都没有安心工作。
sentences.traditional: 她急切地想知道面試結果，一上午都沒有安心工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jíqiè de xiǎng zhīdào miànshì jiéguǒ, yí shàngwǔ dōu méiyǒu ānxīn gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: She was eager to know the interview result and could not work at ease all morning.

sentences.chinese: 市民对改善交通的需求十分急切，政府不能再拖延。
sentences.traditional: 市民對改善交通的需求十分急切，政府不能再拖延。
sentences.pinyin: Shìmín duì gǎishàn jiāotōng de xūqiú shífēn jíqiè, zhèngfǔ bùnéng zài tuōyán.
sentences.translation: Citizens have a very urgent need for transport improvements, and the government cannot delay any longer.

sentences.chinese: 他语气急切，不断追问救援队什么时候能到。
sentences.traditional: 他語氣急切，不斷追問救援隊什麼時候能到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǔqì jíqiè, bùduàn zhuīwèn jiùyuánduì shénme shíhou néng dào.
sentences.translation: His tone was urgent, and he kept asking when the rescue team would arrive.

sentences.chinese: 这家集团计划在东南亚建立新的生产基地。
sentences.traditional: 這家集團計劃在東南亞建立新的生產基地。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jítuán jìhuà zài Dōngnányà jiànlì xīn de shēngchǎn jīdì.
sentences.translation: This corporation plans to establish a new production base in Southeast Asia.

sentences.chinese: 犯罪集团利用网络平台进行诈骗，受害者遍布多个城市。
sentences.traditional: 犯罪集團利用網絡平臺進行詐騙，受害者遍布多個城市。
sentences.pinyin: Fànzuì jítuán lìyòng wǎngluò píngtái jìnxíng zhàpiàn, shòuhàizhě biànbù duō gè chéngshì.
sentences.translation: The criminal group used online platforms to commit fraud, with victims spread across several cities.

sentences.chinese: 合并以后，集团内部的管理制度需要重新统一。
sentences.traditional: 合併以後，集團內部的管理制度需要重新統一。
sentences.pinyin: Hébìng yǐhòu, jítuán nèibù de guǎnlǐ zhìdù xūyào chóngxīn tǒngyī.
sentences.translation: After the merger, the management systems within the group need to be unified again.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告的数据来源极为复杂，需要逐项核对。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告的數據來源極為複雜，需要逐項核對。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de shùjù láiyuán jíwéi fùzá, xūyào zhúxiàng héduì.
sentences.translation: The data sources in this report are extremely complex and need to be checked item by item.

sentences.chinese: 在谈判中，保持冷静极为重要，尤其是在对方施压时。
sentences.traditional: 在談判中，保持冷靜極為重要，尤其是在對方施壓時。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tánpàn zhōng, bǎochí lěngjìng jíwéi zhòngyào, yóuqí shì zài duìfāng shīyā shí.
sentences.translation: In negotiations, staying calm is extremely important, especially when the other side is applying pressure.

sentences.chinese: 这位专家的意见极为谨慎，没有轻易作出结论。
sentences.traditional: 這位專家的意見極為謹慎，沒有輕易作出結論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhuānjiā de yìjiàn jíwéi jǐnshèn, méiyǒu qīngyì zuò chū jiélùn.
sentences.translation: This expert’s opinion was extremely cautious, and they did not draw a conclusion lightly.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，人们喜欢贴上吉祥的春联，表达对新年的期待。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，人們喜歡貼上吉祥的春聯，表達對新年的期待。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, rénmen xǐhuan tiē shàng jíxiáng de chūnlián, biǎodá duì xīnnián de qīdài.
sentences.translation: During the Spring Festival, people like to put up auspicious couplets to express their hopes for the new year.

sentences.chinese: 在传统文化中，红色常被看作吉祥的象征。
sentences.traditional: 在傳統文化中，紅色常被看作吉祥的象徵。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chuántǒng wénhuà zhōng, hóngsè cháng bèi kànzuò jíxiáng de xiàngzhēng.
sentences.translation: In traditional culture, red is often regarded as a symbol of good fortune.

sentences.chinese: 老人给孩子取了一个吉祥的名字，希望他一生平安。
sentences.traditional: 老人給孩子取了一個吉祥的名字，希望他一生平安。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén gěi háizi qǔ le yí gè jíxiáng de míngzi, xīwàng tā yìshēng píng'ān.
sentences.translation: The old man gave the child an auspicious name, hoping he would be safe throughout his life.

sentences.chinese: 他继承了父亲的手艺，却没有完全照搬旧方法。
sentences.traditional: 他繼承了父親的手藝，卻沒有完全照搬舊方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìchéng le fùqīn de shǒuyì, què méiyǒu wánquán zhàobān jiù fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: He inherited his father's craft, but he did not simply copy the old methods.

sentences.chinese: 年轻一代应当继承优秀传统，同时敢于创新。
sentences.traditional: 年輕一代應當繼承優秀傳統，同時敢於創新。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng yí dài yīngdāng jìchéng yōuxiù chuántǒng, tóngshí gǎn yú chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: The younger generation should inherit fine traditions while also daring to innovate.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司由兄妹共同继承，管理权需要重新安排。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司由兄妹共同繼承，管理權需要重新安排。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yóu xiōngmèi gòngtóng jìchéng, guǎnlǐquán xūyào chóngxīn ānpái.
sentences.translation: This company was jointly inherited by the brother and sister, so management rights need to be rearranged.

sentences.chinese: 虽然只获得季军，他仍然为国家赢得了荣誉。
sentences.traditional: 雖然只獲得季軍，他仍然為國家贏得了榮譽。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhǐ huòdé jìjūn, tā réngrán wèi guójiā yíngdé le róngyù.
sentences.translation: Although he only came third, he still won honour for his country.

sentences.chinese: 这位季军选手赛后表示，自己已经发挥出了最好水平。
sentences.traditional: 這位季軍選手賽後表示，自己已經發揮出了最好水平。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìjūn xuǎnshǒu sàihòu biǎoshì, zìjǐ yǐjīng fāhuī chū le zuì hǎo shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: After the competition, the bronze medallist said they had already performed at their best.

sentences.chinese: 球队连续两年拿到季军，距离冠军只差一步。
sentences.traditional: 球隊連續兩年拿到季軍，距離冠軍只差一步。
sentences.pinyin: Qiúduì liánxù liǎng nián nádào jìjūn, jùlí guànjūn zhǐ chà yí bù.
sentences.translation: The team has taken third place for two years in a row and is only one step away from the championship.

sentences.chinese: 没有严格的纪律，再优秀的团队也难以完成任务。
sentences.traditional: 沒有嚴格的紀律，再優秀的團隊也難以完成任務。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu yángé de jìlǜ, zài yōuxiù de tuánduì yě nányǐ wánchéng rènwu.
sentences.translation: Without strict discipline, even an excellent team will struggle to complete its tasks.

sentences.chinese: 学校强调课堂纪律，但也鼓励学生主动提问。
sentences.traditional: 學校強調課堂紀律，但也鼓勵學生主動提問。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào qiángdiào kètáng jìlǜ, dàn yě gǔlì xuéshēng zhǔdòng tíwèn.
sentences.translation: The school emphasises classroom discipline, but also encourages students to ask questions actively.

sentences.chinese: 违反工作纪律的人必须承担相应责任。
sentences.traditional: 違反工作紀律的人必須承擔相應責任。
sentences.pinyin: Wéifǎn gōngzuò jìlǜ de rén bìxū chéngdān xiāngyìng zérèn.
sentences.translation: Anyone who violates workplace discipline must bear the corresponding responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 搬到陌生城市后，她第一次感到真正的寂寞。
sentences.traditional: 搬到陌生城市後，她第一次感到真正的寂寞。
sentences.pinyin: Bān dào mòshēng chéngshì hòu, tā dì yī cì gǎndào zhēnzhèng de jìmò.
sentences.translation: After moving to an unfamiliar city, she felt truly lonely for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 老人并不缺钱，只是长期独居让他很寂寞。
sentences.traditional: 老人並不缺錢，只是長期獨居讓他很寂寞。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén bìng bù quē qián, zhǐshì chángqī dújū ràng tā hěn jìmò.
sentences.translation: The old man is not short of money; living alone for a long time just makes him very lonely.

sentences.chinese: 她用写作来排解寂寞，也记录生活中的细节。
sentences.traditional: 她用寫作來排解寂寞，也記錄生活中的細節。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng xiězuò lái páijiě jìmò, yě jìlù shēnghuó zhōng de xìjié.
sentences.translation: She uses writing to ease her loneliness and to record details of everyday life.

sentences.chinese: 掌握谈判技巧，可以帮助双方更快找到共同点。
sentences.traditional: 掌握談判技巧，可以幫助雙方更快找到共同點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎngwò tánpàn jìqiǎo, kěyǐ bāngzhù shuāngfāng gèng kuài zhǎodào gòngtóngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Mastering negotiation techniques can help both sides find common ground more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 学习语言没有神秘技巧，关键是长期稳定地输入和输出。
sentences.traditional: 學習語言沒有神秘技巧，關鍵是長期穩定地輸入和輸出。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí yǔyán méiyǒu shénmì jìqiǎo, guānjiàn shì chángqī wěndìng de shūrù hé shūchū.
sentences.translation: There is no mysterious trick to learning a language; the key is steady long-term input and output.

sentences.chinese: 这位摄影师很懂光线技巧，普通场景也能拍得很有层次。
sentences.traditional: 這位攝影師很懂光線技巧，普通場景也能拍得很有層次。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèyǐngshī hěn dǒng guāngxiàn jìqiǎo, pǔtōng chǎngjǐng yě néng pāi de hěn yǒu céngcì.
sentences.translation: This photographer understands lighting techniques well, so even ordinary scenes can be shot with depth.

sentences.chinese: 这位木匠的技艺十分精湛，细节处理得几乎无可挑剔。
sentences.traditional: 這位木匠的技藝十分精湛，細節處理得幾乎無可挑剔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi mùjiang de jìyì shífēn jīngzhàn, xìjié chǔlǐ de jīhū wú kě tiāotī.
sentences.translation: This carpenter's craftsmanship is highly refined, and the details are almost beyond criticism.

sentences.chinese: 传统技艺如果缺少年轻人学习，就可能逐渐失传。
sentences.traditional: 傳統技藝如果缺少年輕人學習，就可能逐漸失傳。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng jìyì rúguǒ quēshǎo niánqīng rén xuéxí, jiù kěnéng zhújiàn shīchuán.
sentences.translation: If young people do not learn traditional crafts, they may gradually be lost.

sentences.chinese: 舞台上的精彩表演离不开演员多年积累的技艺。
sentences.traditional: 舞臺上的精彩表演離不開演員多年積累的技藝。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔtái shàng de jīngcǎi biǎoyǎn lí bù kāi yǎnyuán duō nián jīlěi de jìyì.
sentences.translation: A brilliant stage performance depends on the artistry an actor has built up over many years.

sentences.chinese: 她把文件夹在书里，结果开会时怎么也找不到。
sentences.traditional: 她把文件夾在書裡，結果開會時怎麼也找不到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wénjiàn jiā zài shū lǐ, jiéguǒ kāihuì shí zěnme yě zhǎo bú dào.
sentences.translation: She tucked the document inside a book, and then could not find it at all during the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把铅笔夹在耳朵后面，看起来像个小木匠。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把鉛筆夾在耳朵後面，看起來像個小木匠。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ qiānbǐ jiā zài ěrduo hòumiàn, kàn qǐlai xiàng ge xiǎo mùjiang.
sentences.translation: The child tucked the pencil behind his ear and looked like a little carpenter.

sentences.chinese: 坐地铁时，他的手被车门夹了一下，幸好没有受伤。
sentences.traditional: 坐地鐵時，他的手被車門夾了一下，幸好沒有受傷。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò dìtiě shí, tā de shǒu bèi chēmén jiā le yí xià, xìnghǎo méiyǒu shòushāng.
sentences.translation: When riding the metro, his hand was briefly caught in the door, but luckily he was not injured.

sentences.chinese: 为了按时完成项目，团队决定加倍检查每一个细节。
sentences.traditional: 為了按時完成項目，團隊決定加倍檢查每一個細節。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ànshí wánchéng xiàngmù, tuánduì juédìng jiābèi jiǎnchá měi yí gè xìjié.
sentences.translation: To complete the project on time, the team decided to double-check every detail.

sentences.chinese: 成本上升后，企业必须加倍重视效率问题。
sentences.traditional: 成本上升後，企業必須加倍重視效率問題。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngběn shàngshēng hòu, qǐyè bìxū jiābèi zhòngshì xiàolǜ wèntí.
sentences.translation: After costs rise, companies must pay even greater attention to efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 如果市场需求继续扩大，工厂的订单可能会在半年内加倍。
sentences.traditional: 如果市場需求繼續擴大，工廠的訂單可能會在半年內加倍。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shìchǎng xūqiú jìxù kuòdà, gōngchǎng de dìngdān kěnéng huì zài bàn nián nèi jiābèi.
sentences.translation: If market demand continues to grow, the factory's orders may double within half a year.

sentences.chinese: 母亲最喜欢和邻居坐在门口聊家常。
sentences.traditional: 母親最喜歡和鄰居坐在門口聊家常。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn zuì xǐhuan hé línjū zuò zài ménkǒu liáo jiācháng.
sentences.translation: Mother most enjoys sitting at the doorway with neighbours and chatting about everyday life.

sentences.chinese: 这本散文集写的都是家常小事，却能打动读者。
sentences.traditional: 這本散文集寫的都是家常小事，卻能打動讀者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn sǎnwénjí xiě de dōu shì jiācháng xiǎoshì, què néng dǎdòng dúzhě.
sentences.translation: This essay collection is all about small everyday matters, yet it can move readers.

sentences.chinese: 多年以后，他最怀念的不是大场面，而是那些普通的家常时刻。
sentences.traditional: 多年以後，他最懷念的不是大場面，而是那些普通的家常時刻。
sentences.pinyin: Duō nián yǐhòu, tā zuì huáiniàn de bú shì dà chǎngmiàn, ér shì nàxiē pǔtōng de jiācháng shíkè.
sentences.translation: Many years later, what he missed most was not grand occasions, but those ordinary everyday moments.

sentences.chinese: 春节前，社区把消防提醒贴到了家家户户的门口。
sentences.traditional: 春節前，社區把消防提醒貼到了家家戶戶的門口。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qián, shèqū bǎ xiāofáng tíxǐng tiē dào le jiājiāhùhù de ménkǒu.
sentences.translation: Before Spring Festival, the community posted fire-safety reminders on the door of every household.

sentences.chinese: 这条老街的家家户户都保留着种花的习惯。
sentences.traditional: 這條老街的家家戶戶都保留著種花的習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lǎo jiē de jiājiāhùhù dōu bǎoliú zhe zhòng huā de xíguàn.
sentences.translation: Every household on this old street has kept the habit of growing flowers.

sentences.chinese: 停电后，家家户户只好点起蜡烛，等待维修人员。
sentences.traditional: 停電後，家家戶戶只好點起蠟燭，等待維修人員。
sentences.pinyin: Tíngdiàn hòu, jiājiāhùhù zhǐhǎo diǎn qǐ làzhú, děngdài wéixiū rényuán.
sentences.translation: After the power cut, every household had no choice but to light candles and wait for repair workers.

sentences.chinese: 连续高温加剧了城市用水的压力。
sentences.traditional: 連續高溫加劇了城市用水的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù gāowēn jiājù le chéngshì yòngshuǐ de yālì.
sentences.translation: Continuous high temperatures intensified the pressure on urban water use.

sentences.chinese: 如果双方继续互相指责，矛盾只会进一步加剧。
sentences.traditional: 如果雙方繼續互相指責，矛盾只會進一步加劇。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shuāngfāng jìxù hùxiāng zhǐzé, máodùn zhǐ huì jìnyíbù jiājù.
sentences.translation: If both sides keep blaming each other, the conflict will only intensify further.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒说，过度劳累可能加剧他的旧伤。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒說，過度勞累可能加劇他的舊傷。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng shuō, guòdù láolèi kěnéng jiājù tā de jiùshāng.
sentences.translation: The doctor warned that overwork might aggravate his old injury.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司专门设计适合小户型的智能家居。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司專門設計適合小戶型的智能家居。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhuānmén shèjì shìhé xiǎo hùxíng de zhìnéng jiājū.
sentences.translation: This company specialises in designing smart home products for small flats.

sentences.chinese: 她把展厅布置成温暖的家居场景，让顾客更容易想象效果。
sentences.traditional: 她把展廳佈置成溫暖的家居場景，讓顧客更容易想像效果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhǎntīng bùzhì chéng wēnnuǎn de jiājū chǎngjǐng, ràng gùkè gèng róngyì xiǎngxiàng xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: She arranged the showroom as a warm home setting so customers could more easily imagine the effect.

sentences.chinese: 受线上消费影响，家居行业的销售模式正在改变。
sentences.traditional: 受線上消費影響，家居行業的銷售模式正在改變。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu xiànshàng xiāofèi yǐngxiǎng, jiājū hángyè de xiāoshòu móshì zhèngzài gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: Influenced by online consumption, the sales model in the home-furnishing industry is changing.

sentences.chinese: 手术结束后，医生向家属详细说明了病人的情况。
sentences.traditional: 手術結束後，醫生向家屬詳細說明了病人的情況。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒushù jiéshù hòu, yīshēng xiàng jiāshǔ xiángxì shuōmíng le bìngrén de qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: After the operation, the doctor explained the patient’s condition in detail to the family members.

sentences.chinese: 公司为外派员工的家属提供住房和医疗咨询。
sentences.traditional: 公司為外派員工的家屬提供住房和醫療諮詢。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī wèi wàipài yuángōng de jiāshǔ tígōng zhùfáng hé yīliáo zīxún.
sentences.translation: The company provides housing and medical advice for the family members of employees sent abroad.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，政府安排专人安抚遇难者家属。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，政府安排專人安撫遇難者家屬。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, zhèngfǔ ānpái zhuānrén ānfǔ yùnànzhě jiāshǔ.
sentences.translation: After the accident, the government assigned staff to comfort the victims’ families.

sentences.chinese: 对于学生提出的合理建议，学校应该认真加以考虑。
sentences.traditional: 對於學生提出的合理建議，學校應該認真加以考慮。
sentences.pinyin: Duìyú xuéshēng tíchū de hélǐ jiànyì, xuéxiào yīnggāi rènzhēn jiāyǐ kǎolǜ.
sentences.translation: The school should seriously consider the reasonable suggestions put forward by students.

sentences.chinese: 发现问题后，管理层没有回避，而是及时加以解决。
sentences.traditional: 發現問題後，管理層沒有迴避，而是及時加以解決。
sentences.pinyin: Fāxiàn wèntí hòu, guǎnlǐcéng méiyǒu huíbì, ér shì jíshí jiāyǐ jiějué.
sentences.translation: After discovering the problem, management did not avoid it but dealt with it promptly.

sentences.chinese: 只有把理论和实践加以结合，培训才会产生真正的效果。
sentences.traditional: 只有把理論和實踐加以結合，培訓才會產生真正的效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu bǎ lǐlùn hé shíjiàn jiāyǐ jiéhé, péixùn cái huì chǎnshēng zhēnzhèng de xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: Only by combining theory and practice will the training produce real results.

sentences.chinese: 洪水退去后，村民们开始重建自己的家园。
sentences.traditional: 洪水退去後，村民們開始重建自己的家園。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngshuǐ tuìqù hòu, cūnmín men kāishǐ chóngjiàn zìjǐ de jiāyuán.
sentences.translation: After the floodwaters receded, the villagers began rebuilding their homes.

sentences.chinese: 保护自然环境，就是保护我们共同的家园。
sentences.traditional: 保護自然環境，就是保護我們共同的家園。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù zìrán huánjìng, jiù shì bǎohù wǒmen gòngtóng de jiāyuán.
sentences.translation: Protecting the natural environment means protecting our shared home.

sentences.chinese: 多年漂泊之后，他终于回到了熟悉的家园。
sentences.traditional: 多年漂泊之後，他終於回到了熟悉的家園。
sentences.pinyin: Duō nián piāobó zhīhòu, tā zhōngyú huí dào le shúxī de jiāyuán.
sentences.translation: After years of wandering, he finally returned to the home he knew so well.

sentences.chinese: 长期熬夜会加重身体的疲劳感。
sentences.traditional: 長期熬夜會加重身體的疲勞感。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī áoyè huì jiāzhòng shēntǐ de píláogǎn.
sentences.translation: Staying up late for a long time will worsen the body’s sense of fatigue.

sentences.chinese: 新的关税政策可能加重中小企业的经营负担。
sentences.traditional: 新的關稅政策可能加重中小企業的經營負擔。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn de guānshuì zhèngcè kěnéng jiāzhòng zhōngxiǎo qǐyè de jīngyíng fùdān.
sentences.translation: The new tariff policy may increase the operating burden on small and medium-sized enterprises.

sentences.chinese: 伤口还没完全恢复，剧烈运动只会加重病情。
sentences.traditional: 傷口還沒完全恢復，劇烈運動只會加重病情。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngkǒu hái méi wánquán huīfù, jùliè yùndòng zhǐ huì jiāzhòng bìngqíng.
sentences.translation: The wound has not fully healed, so intense exercise will only worsen the condition.

sentences.chinese: 我们先假设数据是准确的，再讨论结论是否合理。
sentences.traditional: 我們先假設數據是準確的，再討論結論是否合理。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān jiǎshè shùjù shì zhǔnquè de, zài tǎolùn jiélùn shìfǒu hélǐ.
sentences.translation: Let us first suppose the data is accurate, and then discuss whether the conclusion is reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究建立在一个关键假设之上。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究建立在一個關鍵假設之上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū jiànlì zài yí ge guānjiàn jiǎshè zhī shàng.
sentences.translation: This study is built on a key hypothesis.

sentences.chinese: 即使这种假设成立，我们仍然需要更多证据。
sentences.traditional: 即使這種假設成立，我們仍然需要更多證據。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ zhè zhǒng jiǎshè chénglì, wǒmen réngrán xūyào gèng duō zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: Even if this hypothesis holds, we still need more evidence.

sentences.chinese: 她并不急着嫁人，而是想先完成自己的学业。
sentences.traditional: 她並不急著嫁人，而是想先完成自己的學業。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù jí zhe jià rén, ér shì xiǎng xiān wánchéng zìjǐ de xuéyè.
sentences.translation: She is not in a hurry to marry; she wants to finish her studies first.

sentences.chinese: 在那个年代，许多女性嫁到外地后很少回娘家。
sentences.traditional: 在那個年代，許多女性嫁到外地後很少回娘家。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàge niándài, xǔduō nǚxìng jià dào wàidì hòu hěn shǎo huí niángjiā.
sentences.translation: In that era, many women rarely returned to their parents’ home after marrying into another area.

sentences.chinese: 父母希望她嫁给一个真正尊重她的人。
sentences.traditional: 父母希望她嫁給一個真正尊重她的人。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ xīwàng tā jià gěi yí ge zhēnzhèng zūnzhòng tā de rén.
sentences.translation: Her parents hope she will marry someone who truly respects her.

sentences.chinese: 这把刀的尖已经磨钝了，切东西不太方便。
sentences.traditional: 這把刀的尖已經磨鈍了，切東西不太方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ dāo de jiān yǐjīng módùn le, qiē dōngxi bù tài fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The tip of this knife has become blunt, so it is not very convenient for cutting things.

sentences.chinese: 他的问题很尖，直接触及了项目的核心风险。
sentences.traditional: 他的問題很尖，直接觸及了項目的核心風險。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de wèntí hěn jiān, zhíjiē chùjí le xiàngmù de héxīn fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: His question was sharp and directly touched on the project’s core risk.

sentences.chinese: 山路又窄又尖的石头很多，走起来必须格外小心。
sentences.traditional: 山路又窄又尖的石頭很多，走起來必須格外小心。
sentences.pinyin: Shānlù yòu zhǎi yòu jiān de shítou hěn duō, zǒu qǐlai bìxū géwài xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: The mountain path is narrow and has many sharp stones, so you must be especially careful when walking.

sentences.chinese: 长时间背着沉重的电脑包，他的肩膀开始酸痛。
sentences.traditional: 長時間背著沉重的電腦包，他的肩膀開始酸痛。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān bēi zhe chénzhòng de diànnǎobāo, tā de jiānbǎng kāishǐ suāntòng.
sentences.translation: After carrying a heavy laptop bag for a long time, his shoulders began to ache.

sentences.chinese: 面对突发危机，领导必须用自己的肩膀承担责任。
sentences.traditional: 面對突發危機，領導必須用自己的肩膀承擔責任。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā wēijī, lǐngdǎo bìxū yòng zìjǐ de jiānbǎng chéngdān zérèn.
sentences.translation: In the face of a sudden crisis, leaders must shoulder responsibility themselves.

sentences.chinese: 她轻轻拍了拍孩子的肩膀，示意他不要紧张。
sentences.traditional: 她輕輕拍了拍孩子的肩膀，示意他不要緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngqīng pāi le pāi háizi de jiānbǎng, shìyì tā bú yào jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: She gently patted the child on the shoulder, signalling that he should not be nervous.

sentences.chinese: 医院需要持续监测病人的血压和心率。
sentences.traditional: 醫院需要持續監測病人的血壓和心率。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn xūyào chíxù jiāncè bìngrén de xuèyā hé xīnlǜ.
sentences.translation: The hospital needs to continuously monitor the patient’s blood pressure and heart rate.

sentences.chinese: 研究团队在河边安装设备，监测水质变化。
sentences.traditional: 研究團隊在河邊安裝設備，監測水質變化。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū tuánduì zài hébiān ānzhuāng shèbèi, jiāncè shuǐzhì biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The research team installed equipment by the river to monitor changes in water quality.

sentences.chinese: 政府利用卫星监测森林火灾的蔓延范围。
sentences.traditional: 政府利用衛星監測森林火災的蔓延範圍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ lìyòng wèixīng jiāncè sēnlín huǒzāi de mànyán fànwéi.
sentences.translation: The government uses satellites to monitor the spread of forest fires.

sentences.chinese: 尽管外界压力很大，他的态度依然坚定。
sentences.traditional: 儘管外界壓力很大，他的態度依然堅定。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wàijiè yālì hěn dà, tā de tàidu yīrán jiāndìng.
sentences.translation: Although external pressure was great, his attitude remained firm.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败反而坚定了她继续研究的决心。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗反而堅定了她繼續研究的決心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài fǎn'ér jiāndìng le tā jìxù yánjiū de juéxīn.
sentences.translation: This failure instead strengthened her determination to continue the research.

sentences.chinese: 一个坚定的目标能帮助团队渡过困难时期。
sentences.traditional: 一個堅定的目標能幫助團隊渡過困難時期。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge jiāndìng de mùbiāo néng bāngzhù tuánduì dùguò kùnnan shíqī.
sentences.translation: A firm goal can help a team get through difficult periods.

sentences.chinese: 新制度要求第三方机构监督资金的使用情况。
sentences.traditional: 新制度要求第三方機構監督資金的使用情況。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhìdù yāoqiú dì sānfāng jīgòu jiāndū zījīn de shǐyòng qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The new system requires a third-party organisation to supervise the use of funds.

sentences.chinese: 家长可以适当监督孩子上网，但不应完全控制。
sentences.traditional: 家長可以適當監督孩子上網，但不應完全控制。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāzhǎng kěyǐ shìdàng jiāndū háizi shàngwǎng, dàn bù yīng wánquán kòngzhì.
sentences.translation: Parents may supervise their children’s internet use appropriately, but should not control it completely.

sentences.chinese: 媒体的监督有助于提高公共决策的透明度。
sentences.traditional: 媒體的監督有助於提高公共決策的透明度。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ de jiāndū yǒuzhù yú tígāo gōnggòng juécè de tòumíngdù.
sentences.translation: Media supervision helps increase the transparency of public decision-making.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥的结构非常坚固，可以承受强风和洪水。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋的結構非常堅固，可以承受強風和洪水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo de jiégòu fēicháng jiāngù, kěyǐ chéngshòu qiángfēng hé hóngshuǐ.
sentences.translation: The structure of this bridge is very solid and can withstand strong winds and floods.

sentences.chinese: 数据库的安全系统必须足够坚固，才能防止攻击。
sentences.traditional: 資料庫的安全系統必須足夠堅固，才能防止攻擊。
sentences.pinyin: Zīliàokù de ānquán xìtǒng bìxū zúgòu jiāngù, cái néng fángzhǐ gōngjī.
sentences.translation: A database security system must be solid enough to prevent attacks.

sentences.chinese: 他用坚固的木板把旧窗户临时封了起来。
sentences.traditional: 他用堅固的木板把舊窗戶臨時封了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng jiāngù de mùbǎn bǎ jiù chuānghu línshí fēng le qǐlai.
sentences.translation: He temporarily sealed the old window with sturdy wooden boards.

sentences.chinese: 公司坚决反对任何形式的商业贿赂。
sentences.traditional: 公司堅決反對任何形式的商業賄賂。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jiānjué fǎnduì rènhé xíngshì de shāngyè huìlù.
sentences.translation: The company firmly opposes any form of commercial bribery.

sentences.chinese: 面对不合理的要求，她选择了坚决拒绝。
sentences.traditional: 面對不合理的要求，她選擇了堅決拒絕。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì bù hélǐ de yāoqiú, tā xuǎnzé le jiānjué jùjué.
sentences.translation: Faced with an unreasonable demand, she chose to refuse firmly.

sentences.chinese: 如果发现数据造假，学校将采取坚决的处理措施。
sentences.traditional: 如果發現數據造假，學校將採取堅決的處理措施。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāxiàn shùjù zàojiǎ, xuéxiào jiāng cǎiqǔ jiānjué de chǔlǐ cuòshī.
sentences.translation: If data falsification is discovered, the school will take firm measures to deal with it.

sentences.chinese: 在经济下行时期，许多小企业面临艰难的选择。
sentences.traditional: 在經濟下行時期，許多小企業面臨艱難的選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jīngjì xiàxíng shíqī, xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè miànlín jiānnán de xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: During an economic downturn, many small businesses face difficult choices.

sentences.chinese: 经过艰难的谈判，双方终于达成了初步协议。
sentences.traditional: 經過艱難的談判，雙方終於達成了初步協議。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò jiānnán de tánpàn, shuāngfāng zhōngyú dáchéng le chūbù xiéyì.
sentences.translation: After difficult negotiations, the two sides finally reached a preliminary agreement.

sentences.chinese: 照顾重病的亲人是一段艰难但珍贵的经历。
sentences.traditional: 照顧重病的親人是一段艱難但珍貴的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàogù zhòngbìng de qīnrén shì yí duàn jiānnán dàn zhēnguì de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: Caring for a seriously ill family member is a difficult but precious experience.

sentences.chinese: 这项成果背后是科研人员多年的艰辛努力。
sentences.traditional: 這項成果背後是科研人員多年的艱辛努力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng chéngguǒ bèihòu shì kēyán rényuán duō nián de jiānxīn nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Behind this achievement lie many years of arduous effort by researchers.

sentences.chinese: 他很少向别人提起创业初期的艰辛。
sentences.traditional: 他很少向別人提起創業初期的艱辛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn shǎo xiàng biérén tíqǐ chuàngyè chūqī de jiānxīn.
sentences.translation: He rarely mentions to others the hardships of the early days of starting the business.

sentences.chinese: 在艰辛的训练中，运动员逐渐学会了自我管理。
sentences.traditional: 在艱辛的訓練中，運動員逐漸學會了自我管理。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jiānxīn de xùnliàn zhōng, yùndòngyuán zhújiàn xuéhuì le zìwǒ guǎnlǐ.
sentences.translation: Through arduous training, the athlete gradually learnt self-management.

sentences.chinese: 这块土地被太阳晒得很坚硬，必须先浇水再翻土。
sentences.traditional: 這塊土地被太陽曬得很堅硬，必須先澆水再翻土。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài tǔdì bèi tàiyáng shài de hěn jiānyìng, bìxū xiān jiāo shuǐ zài fān tǔ.
sentences.translation: This piece of land has been baked hard by the sun, so it must be watered before the soil is turned.

sentences.chinese: 他的语气虽然平静，却带着一种坚硬的立场。
sentences.traditional: 他的語氣雖然平靜，卻帶著一種堅硬的立場。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǔqì suīrán píngjìng, què dài zhe yì zhǒng jiānyìng de lìchǎng.
sentences.translation: Although his tone was calm, it carried a hard, uncompromising position.

sentences.chinese: 新材料既轻便又坚硬，适合用于航空设备。
sentences.traditional: 新材料既輕便又堅硬，適合用於航空設備。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn cáiliào jì qīngbiàn yòu jiānyìng, shìhé yòng yú hángkōng shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The new material is both light and hard, making it suitable for aviation equipment.

sentences.chinese: 她白天在公司上班，晚上兼职教中文。
sentences.traditional: 她白天在公司上班，晚上兼職教中文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā báitiān zài gōngsī shàngbān, wǎnshang jiānzhí jiāo Zhōngwén.
sentences.translation: She works at a company during the day and teaches Chinese part-time in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 大学生做兼职可以积累经验，但不能影响学业。
sentences.traditional: 大學生做兼職可以積累經驗，但不能影響學業。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxuéshēng zuò jiānzhí kěyǐ jīlěi jīngyàn, dàn bù néng yǐngxiǎng xuéyè.
sentences.translation: University students can gain experience from part-time work, but it must not affect their studies.

sentences.chinese: 这份兼职的时间比较灵活，适合需要照顾家庭的人。
sentences.traditional: 這份兼職的時間比較靈活，適合需要照顧家庭的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn jiānzhí de shíjiān bǐjiào línghuó, shìhé xūyào zhàogù jiātíng de rén.
sentences.translation: The hours for this part-time job are relatively flexible, making it suitable for people who need to care for family members.

sentences.chinese: 医院已经对样本进行了检测，结果明天上午公布。
sentences.traditional: 醫院已經對樣本進行了檢測，結果明天上午公佈。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn yǐjīng duì yàngběn jìnxíng le jiǎncè, jiéguǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ gōngbù.
sentences.translation: The hospital has already tested the sample, and the result will be announced tomorrow morning.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统能自动检测设备是否存在安全隐患。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統能自動檢測設備是否存在安全隱患。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng néng zìdòng jiǎncè shèbèi shìfǒu cúnzài ānquán yǐnhuàn.
sentences.translation: This system can automatically detect whether the equipment has any safety hazards.

sentences.chinese: 食品进入市场前，必须经过严格的质量检测。
sentences.traditional: 食品進入市場前，必須經過嚴格的質量檢測。
sentences.pinyin: Shípǐn jìnrù shìchǎng qián, bìxū jīngguò yángé de zhìliàng jiǎncè.
sentences.translation: Before food enters the market, it must go through strict quality testing.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高效率，公司决定简化审批流程。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高效率，公司決定簡化審批流程。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, gōngsī juédìng jiǎnhuà shěnpī liúchéng.
sentences.translation: To improve efficiency, the company decided to simplify the approval process.

sentences.chinese: 这份说明书过于复杂，需要进一步简化。
sentences.traditional: 這份說明書過於複雜，需要進一步簡化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn shuōmíngshū guòyú fùzá, xūyào jìnyíbù jiǎnhuà.
sentences.translation: This instruction manual is too complicated and needs to be simplified further.

sentences.chinese: 老师把复杂的理论简化成了几个容易理解的步骤。
sentences.traditional: 老師把複雜的理論簡化成了幾個容易理解的步驟。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ fùzá de lǐlùn jiǎnhuà chéng le jǐ gè róngyì lǐjiě de bùzhòu.
sentences.translation: The teacher simplified the complex theory into several easy-to-understand steps.

sentences.chinese: 请先看一下项目简介，再决定是否参加。
sentences.traditional: 請先看一下項目簡介，再決定是否參加。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān kàn yíxià xiàngmù jiǎnjiè, zài juédìng shìfǒu cānjiā.
sentences.translation: Please look at the project introduction first, then decide whether to take part.

sentences.chinese: 主持人用两分钟简介了这位科学家的主要成就。
sentences.traditional: 主持人用兩分鐘簡介了這位科學家的主要成就。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǔchírén yòng liǎng fēnzhōng jiǎnjiè le zhè wèi kēxuéjiā de zhǔyào chéngjiù.
sentences.translation: The host briefly introduced the scientist's main achievements in two minutes.

sentences.chinese: 网站首页上有公司的简介和联系方式。
sentences.traditional: 網站首頁上有公司的簡介和聯繫方式。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngzhàn shǒuyè shàng yǒu gōngsī de jiǎnjiè hé liánxì fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The website homepage has the company's introduction and contact details.

sentences.chinese: 随着距离增加，信号会逐渐减弱。
sentences.traditional: 隨著距離增加，信號會逐漸減弱。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe jùlí zēngjiā, xìnhào huì zhújiàn jiǎnruò.
sentences.translation: As the distance increases, the signal will gradually weaken.

sentences.chinese: 连续下雨减弱了森林火灾继续扩散的风险。
sentences.traditional: 連續下雨減弱了森林火災繼續擴散的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù xiàyǔ jiǎnruò le sēnlín huǒzāi jìxù kuòsàn de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Continuous rain reduced the risk of the forest fire spreading further.

sentences.chinese: 如果沟通不充分，改革带来的积极影响可能会被减弱。
sentences.traditional: 如果溝通不充分，改革帶來的積極影響可能會被減弱。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ gōutōng bù chōngfèn, gǎigé dài lái de jījí yǐngxiǎng kěnéng huì bèi jiǎnruò.
sentences.translation: If communication is insufficient, the positive impact of the reform may be weakened.

sentences.chinese: 他每天跑步半小时，用这种方式减压。
sentences.traditional: 他每天跑步半小時，用這種方式減壓。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān pǎobù bàn xiǎoshí, yòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì jiǎnyā.
sentences.translation: He runs for half an hour every day and uses this method to relieve pressure.

sentences.chinese: 学校开设心理课程，帮助学生在考试前减压。
sentences.traditional: 學校開設心理課程，幫助學生在考試前減壓。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào kāishè xīnlǐ kèchéng, bāngzhù xuésheng zài kǎoshì qián jiǎnyā.
sentences.translation: The school offers psychology courses to help students reduce stress before exams.

sentences.chinese: 企业可以通过合理分工为员工减压。
sentences.traditional: 企業可以通過合理分工為員工減壓。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè kěyǐ tōngguò hélǐ fēngōng wèi yuángōng jiǎnyā.
sentences.translation: Companies can reduce pressure on employees through reasonable division of work.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策的效果还需要时间来检验。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策的效果還需要時間來檢驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de xiàoguǒ hái xūyào shíjiān lái jiǎnyàn.
sentences.translation: The effect of this policy still needs time to be tested.

sentences.chinese: 实验数据必须反复检验，才能作为可靠依据。
sentences.traditional: 實驗數據必須反覆檢驗，才能作為可靠依據。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyàn shùjù bìxū fǎnfù jiǎnyàn, cái néng zuòwéi kěkào yījù.
sentences.translation: Experimental data must be checked repeatedly before it can serve as reliable evidence.

sentences.chinese: 危机往往会检验一个团队的合作能力。
sentences.traditional: 危機往往會檢驗一個團隊的合作能力。
sentences.pinyin: Wēijī wǎngwǎng huì jiǎnyàn yí gè tuánduì de hézuò nénglì.
sentences.translation: A crisis often tests a team's ability to cooperate.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆里展出了一把保存完好的古剑。
sentences.traditional: 博物館裡展出了一把保存完好的古劍。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ zhǎnchū le yì bǎ bǎocún wánhǎo de gǔjiàn.
sentences.translation: The museum displayed a well-preserved ancient sword.

sentences.chinese: 他在电影里扮演一名用剑的武士。
sentences.traditional: 他在電影裡扮演一名用劍的武士。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài diànyǐng lǐ bànyǎn yì míng yòng jiàn de wǔshì.
sentences.translation: He plays a swordsman in the film.

sentences.chinese: 这把剑虽然锋利，却只是一件艺术收藏品。
sentences.traditional: 這把劍雖然鋒利，卻只是一件藝術收藏品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ jiàn suīrán fēnglì, què zhǐ shì yí jiàn yìshù shōucángpǐn.
sentences.translation: Although this sword is sharp, it is only an art collectible.

sentences.chinese: 箭离弦以后，几乎没有回头的可能。
sentences.traditional: 箭離弦以後，幾乎沒有回頭的可能。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàn lí xián yǐhòu, jīhū méiyǒu huítóu de kěnéng.
sentences.translation: Once an arrow leaves the string, there is almost no possibility of turning back.

sentences.chinese: 运动员把箭射向靶心，全场立刻安静下来。
sentences.traditional: 運動員把箭射向靶心，全場立刻安靜下來。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán bǎ jiàn shè xiàng bǎxīn, quánchǎng lìkè ānjìng xiàlái.
sentences.translation: The athlete shot the arrow towards the bullseye, and the whole venue immediately fell quiet.

sentences.chinese: 这座山上的猎人过去常用弓和箭打猎。
sentences.traditional: 這座山上的獵人過去常用弓和箭打獵。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān shàng de lièrén guòqù cháng yòng gōng hé jiàn dǎliè.
sentences.translation: Hunters on this mountain used to hunt with bows and arrows.

sentences.chinese: 专家正在鉴定这幅画是否出自名家之手。
sentences.traditional: 專家正在鑑定這幅畫是否出自名家之手。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā zhèngzài jiàndìng zhè fú huà shìfǒu chūzì míngjiā zhī shǒu.
sentences.translation: Experts are identifying whether this painting was created by a famous artist.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，相关部门对车辆进行了技术鉴定。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，相關部門對車輛進行了技術鑑定。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, xiāngguān bùmén duì chēliàng jìnxíng le jìshù jiàndìng.
sentences.translation: After the accident, the relevant department carried out a technical appraisal of the vehicle.

sentences.chinese: 这份鉴定报告为案件提供了关键证据。
sentences.traditional: 這份鑑定報告為案件提供了關鍵證據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn jiàndìng bàogào wèi ànjiàn tígōng le guānjiàn zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: This appraisal report provided key evidence for the case.

sentences.chinese: 两次会议之间的间隔只有十分钟。
sentences.traditional: 兩次會議之間的間隔只有十分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng cì huìyì zhījiān de jiàngé zhǐ yǒu shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: The interval between the two meetings is only ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 为了保持安全，座位之间应适当间隔。
sentences.traditional: 為了保持安全，座位之間應適當間隔。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎochí ānquán, zuòwèi zhījiān yīng shìdàng jiàngé.
sentences.translation: To maintain safety, seats should be appropriately spaced apart.

sentences.chinese: 这条街上的树木按照固定间隔种植，显得很整齐。
sentences.traditional: 這條街上的樹木按照固定間隔種植，顯得很整齊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē shàng de shùmù ànzhào gùdìng jiàngé zhòngzhí, xiǎnde hěn zhěngqí.
sentences.translation: The trees on this street are planted at fixed intervals, making them look very neat.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策的间接影响可能要几年后才会显现。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策的間接影響可能要幾年後才會顯現。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de jiànjiē yǐngxiǎng kěnéng yào jǐ nián hòu cái huì xiǎnxiàn.
sentences.translation: The indirect impact of this policy may not become apparent until several years later.

sentences.chinese: 经理没有直接批评他，而是用间接的方式提醒他改进。
sentences.traditional: 經理沒有直接批評他，而是用間接的方式提醒他改進。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ méiyǒu zhíjiē pīpíng tā, ér shì yòng jiànjiē de fāngshì tíxǐng tā gǎijìn.
sentences.translation: The manager did not criticise him directly, but reminded him to improve in an indirect way.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告只提供了间接证据，还不足以得出结论。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告只提供了間接證據，還不足以得出結論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zhǐ tígōng le jiànjiē zhèngjù, hái bùzúyǐ déchū jiélùn.
sentences.translation: This report only provides indirect evidence, which is still not enough to draw a conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 一个健全的制度应该既有监督，也有纠错机制。
sentences.traditional: 一個健全的制度應該既有監督，也有糾錯機制。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge jiànquán de zhìdù yīnggāi jì yǒu jiāndū, yě yǒu jiūcuò jīzhì.
sentences.translation: A sound system should have both supervision and a mechanism for correcting errors.

sentences.chinese: 政府正在健全社区服务体系，让老人得到更稳定的照顾。
sentences.traditional: 政府正在健全社區服務體系，讓老人得到更穩定的照顧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài jiànquán shèqū fúwù tǐxì, ràng lǎorén dédào gèng wěndìng de zhàogù.
sentences.translation: The government is improving the community service system so that older people receive more stable care.

sentences.chinese: 孩子的成长需要健全的心理支持，而不只是成绩上的要求。
sentences.traditional: 孩子的成長需要健全的心理支持，而不只是成績上的要求。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi de chéngzhǎng xūyào jiànquán de xīnlǐ zhīchí, ér bù zhǐshì chéngjì shàng de yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: A child’s development needs healthy psychological support, not just academic demands.

sentences.chinese: 这片老城区里，许多建筑物都有上百年的历史。
sentences.traditional: 這片老城區裡，許多建築物都有上百年的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn lǎo chéngqū lǐ, xǔduō jiànzhùwù dōu yǒu shàng bǎi nián de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: In this old urban area, many buildings have a history of over a hundred years.

sentences.chinese: 地震后，工程师逐一检查受损建筑物的安全状况。
sentences.traditional: 地震後，工程師逐一檢查受損建築物的安全狀況。
sentences.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu, gōngchéngshī zhúyī jiǎnchá shòusǔn jiànzhùwù de ānquán zhuàngkuàng.
sentences.translation: After the earthquake, engineers checked the safety condition of the damaged buildings one by one.

sentences.chinese: 新规定要求公共建筑物必须配备无障碍通道。
sentences.traditional: 新規定要求公共建築物必須配備無障礙通道。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn guīdìng yāoqiú gōnggòng jiànzhùwù bìxū pèibèi wú zhàng'ài tōngdào.
sentences.translation: The new regulations require public buildings to be equipped with accessible passages.

sentences.chinese: 这位将军在战争结束后主动推动和平谈判。
sentences.traditional: 這位將軍在戰爭結束後主動推動和平談判。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiāngjūn zài zhànzhēng jiéshù hòu zhǔdòng tuīdòng hépíng tánpàn.
sentences.translation: This general actively promoted peace talks after the war ended.

sentences.chinese: 历史书把那位将军描写成既勇敢又谨慎的人。
sentences.traditional: 歷史書把那位將軍描寫成既勇敢又謹慎的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lìshǐshū bǎ nà wèi jiāngjūn miáoxiě chéng jì yǒnggǎn yòu jǐnshèn de rén.
sentences.translation: The history book describes that general as someone who was both brave and cautious.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始前，退役将军分享了他的救援经验。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始前，退役將軍分享了他的救援經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, tuìyì jiāngjūn fēnxiǎng le tā de jiùyuán jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting began, the retired general shared his rescue experience.

sentences.chinese: 老师把复杂的语法点讲解得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 老師把複雜的語法點講解得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ fùzá de yǔfǎ diǎn jiǎngjiě de hěn qīngchǔ.
sentences.translation: The teacher explained the complicated grammar point very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者在展厅入口为游客讲解参观路线。
sentences.traditional: 志願者在展廳入口為遊客講解參觀路線。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě zài zhǎntīng rùkǒu wèi yóukè jiǎngjiě cānguān lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: Volunteers explain the visiting route to tourists at the entrance to the exhibition hall.

sentences.chinese: 这段视频通过动画讲解了项目运作的基本原理。
sentences.traditional: 這段視頻通過動畫講解了項目運作的基本原理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn shìpín tōngguò dònghuà jiǎngjiě le xiàngmù yùnzuò de jīběn yuánlǐ.
sentences.translation: This video uses animation to explain the basic principles of how the project operates.

sentences.chinese: 运动员把奖牌挂在胸前，眼里含着泪。
sentences.traditional: 運動員把獎牌掛在胸前，眼裡含著淚。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán bǎ jiǎngpái guà zài xiōngqián, yǎn lǐ hán zhe lèi.
sentences.translation: The athlete hung the medal on his chest, with tears in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 这枚奖牌不仅属于他，也属于背后支持他的团队。
sentences.traditional: 這枚獎牌不僅屬於他，也屬於背後支持他的團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè méi jiǎngpái bùjǐn shǔyú tā, yě shǔyú bèihòu zhīchí tā de tuánduì.
sentences.translation: This medal belongs not only to him, but also to the team that supported him behind the scenes.

sentences.chinese: 她把第一块国际比赛奖牌献给了自己的教练。
sentences.traditional: 她把第一塊國際比賽獎牌獻給了自己的教練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ dì yī kuài guójì bǐsài jiǎngpái xiàn gěi le zìjǐ de jiàoliàn.
sentences.translation: She dedicated her first medal from an international competition to her coach.

sentences.chinese: 获胜者可以选择现金或等值奖品。
sentences.traditional: 獲勝者可以選擇現金或等值獎品。
sentences.pinyin: Huòshèng zhě kěyǐ xuǎnzé xiànjīn huò děngzhí jiǎngpǐn.
sentences.translation: The winner may choose cash or a prize of equal value.

sentences.chinese: 学校为科学竞赛准备了几份很有意义的奖品。
sentences.traditional: 學校為科學競賽準備了幾份很有意義的獎品。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi kēxué jìngsài zhǔnbèi le jǐ fèn hěn yǒu yìyì de jiǎngpǐn.
sentences.translation: The school prepared several meaningful prizes for the science competition.

sentences.chinese: 他并不在乎奖品贵不贵，只在乎自己的努力被认可。
sentences.traditional: 他並不在乎獎品貴不貴，只在乎自己的努力被認可。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù zàihu jiǎngpǐn guì bu guì, zhǐ zàihu zìjǐ de nǔlì bèi rènkě.
sentences.translation: He does not care whether the prize is expensive; he only cares that his effort is recognised.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜的酱太咸，盖住了蔬菜本身的味道。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜的醬太鹹，蓋住了蔬菜本身的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de jiàng tài xián, gàizhù le shūcài běnshēn de wèidào.
sentences.translation: The sauce in this dish is too salty and covers the flavour of the vegetables themselves.

sentences.chinese: 她把花生酱抹在面包上，给孩子做早餐。
sentences.traditional: 她把花生醬抹在麵包上，給孩子做早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ huāshēngjiàng mǒ zài miànbāo shàng, gěi háizi zuò zǎocān.
sentences.translation: She spread peanut butter on bread to make breakfast for the child.

sentences.chinese: 这家店自制的辣酱很受欢迎，很多顾客会单独购买。
sentences.traditional: 這家店自製的辣醬很受歡迎，很多顧客會單獨購買。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zìzhì de làjiàng hěn shòu huānyíng, hěn duō gùkè huì dāndú gòumǎi.
sentences.translation: The chilli sauce made by this shop is very popular, and many customers buy it separately.

sentences.chinese: 炒青菜时放一点酱油，就能增加香味。
sentences.traditional: 炒青菜時放一點醬油，就能增加香味。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎo qīngcài shí fàng yìdiǎn jiàngyóu, jiù néng zēngjiā xiāngwèi.
sentences.translation: Adding a little soy sauce when stir-frying greens can enhance the aroma.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他控制盐分，所以做饭时少放酱油。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他控制鹽分，所以做飯時少放醬油。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā kòngzhì yánfèn, suǒyǐ zuòfàn shí shǎo fàng jiàngyóu.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him to control his salt intake, so he uses less soy sauce when cooking.

sentences.chinese: 这瓶酱油采用传统工艺酿造，味道更醇厚。
sentences.traditional: 這瓶醬油採用傳統工藝釀造，味道更醇厚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè píng jiàngyóu cǎiyòng chuántǒng gōngyì niàngzào, wèidào gèng chúnhòu.
sentences.translation: This bottle of soy sauce is brewed using traditional techniques, so its flavour is richer.

sentences.chinese: 箱子封好后，再用胶带把边缘固定住。
sentences.traditional: 箱子封好後，再用膠帶把邊緣固定住。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngzi fēng hǎo hòu, zài yòng jiāodài bǎ biānyuán gùdìng zhù.
sentences.translation: After sealing the box, use tape to secure the edges.

sentences.chinese: 临时修理时，他只找到一卷透明胶带。
sentences.traditional: 臨時修理時，他只找到一卷透明膠帶。
sentences.pinyin: Línshí xiūlǐ shí, tā zhǐ zhǎodào yì juǎn tòumíng jiāodài.
sentences.translation: During the temporary repair, he could only find a roll of clear tape.

sentences.chinese: 请不要把胶带直接贴在旧照片表面，以免留下痕迹。
sentences.traditional: 請不要把膠帶直接貼在舊照片表面，以免留下痕跡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào bǎ jiāodài zhíjiē tiē zài jiù zhàopiàn biǎomiàn, yǐmiǎn liúxià hénjì.
sentences.translation: Please do not stick tape directly onto the surface of old photos, in case it leaves marks.

sentences.chinese: 这次会议的焦点不是预算，而是如何重新赢得公众信任。
sentences.traditional: 這次會議的焦點不是預算，而是如何重新贏得公眾信任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de jiāodiǎn bú shì yùsuàn, ér shì rúhé chóngxīn yíngdé gōngzhòng xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: The focus of this meeting is not the budget, but how to regain public trust.

sentences.chinese: 媒体把焦点集中在事故原因上，却很少讨论后续的救助安排。
sentences.traditional: 媒體把焦點集中在事故原因上，卻很少討論後續的救助安排。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ bǎ jiāodiǎn jízhōng zài shìgù yuányīn shàng, què hěn shǎo tǎolùn hòuxù de jiùzhù ānpái.
sentences.translation: The media focused on the cause of the accident, but rarely discussed the follow-up relief arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 在谈判陷入僵局时，双方需要把焦点放回共同利益上。
sentences.traditional: 在談判陷入僵局時，雙方需要把焦點放回共同利益上。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tánpàn xiànrù jiāngjú shí, shuāngfāng xūyào bǎ jiāodiǎn fàng huí gòngtóng lìyì shàng.
sentences.translation: When negotiations reach a deadlock, both sides need to put the focus back on their shared interests.

sentences.chinese: 良好的交际能力能帮助新人更快适应复杂的工作环境。
sentences.traditional: 良好的交際能力能幫助新人更快適應複雜的工作環境。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de jiāojì nénglì néng bāngzhù xīnrén gèng kuài shìyìng fùzá de gōngzuò huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Good social skills can help newcomers adapt more quickly to a complex work environment.

sentences.chinese: 他并不排斥交际，只是不喜欢在酒桌上谈生意。
sentences.traditional: 他並不排斥交際，只是不喜歡在酒桌上談生意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù páichì jiāojì, zhǐshì bù xǐhuān zài jiǔzhuō shàng tán shēngyì.
sentences.translation: He does not reject socialising; he just dislikes discussing business over drinks.

sentences.chinese: 在跨文化交际中，直接表达意见有时会被误解为不礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 在跨文化交際中，直接表達意見有時會被誤解為不禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Zài kuà wénhuà jiāojì zhōng, zhíjiē biǎodá yìjiàn yǒushí huì bèi wùjiě wéi bù lǐmào.
sentences.translation: In cross-cultural communication, expressing opinions directly is sometimes misunderstood as impolite.

sentences.chinese: 临近考试时，她明显变得焦虑，连睡眠质量都下降了。
sentences.traditional: 臨近考試時，她明顯變得焦慮，連睡眠質量都下降了。
sentences.pinyin: Línjìn kǎoshì shí, tā míngxiǎn biànde jiāolǜ, lián shuìmián zhìliàng dōu xiàjiàng le.
sentences.translation: As the exam approached, she clearly became anxious, and even the quality of her sleep declined.

sentences.chinese: 与其一直焦虑结果，不如先把能控制的部分做好。
sentences.traditional: 與其一直焦慮結果，不如先把能控制的部分做好。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí yìzhí jiāolǜ jiéguǒ, bùrú xiān bǎ néng kòngzhì de bùfen zuò hǎo.
sentences.translation: Rather than constantly feeling anxious about the result, it is better to first do well the parts you can control.

sentences.chinese: 过多的信息让消费者更加焦虑，反而难以作出理性的选择。
sentences.traditional: 過多的信息讓消費者更加焦慮，反而難以作出理性的選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Guòduō de xìnxī ràng xiāofèizhě gèngjiā jiāolǜ, fǎn'ér nányǐ zuòchū lǐxìng de xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: Too much information makes consumers even more anxious, and instead makes it hard for them to make rational choices.

sentences.chinese: 这款胶水干得很快，使用前必须先把材料的位置对准。
sentences.traditional: 這款膠水乾得很快，使用前必須先把材料的位置對準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn jiāoshuǐ gān de hěn kuài, shǐyòng qián bìxū xiān bǎ cáiliào de wèizhi duìzhǔn.
sentences.translation: This glue dries very quickly, so you must first align the materials before using it.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把胶水涂得太多，纸张干了以后还是皱皱的。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把膠水塗得太多，紙張乾了以後還是皺皺的。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ jiāoshuǐ tú de tài duō, zhǐzhāng gān le yǐhòu háishi zhòu zhòu de.
sentences.translation: The child applied too much glue, so the paper was still wrinkled after it dried.

sentences.chinese: 临时修补模型时，普通胶水不一定能承受那么大的重量。
sentences.traditional: 臨時修補模型時，普通膠水不一定能承受那麼大的重量。
sentences.pinyin: Línshí xiūbǔ móxíng shí, pǔtōng jiāoshuǐ bù yídìng néng chéngshòu nàme dà de zhòngliàng.
sentences.translation: When repairing a model temporarily, ordinary glue may not be able to bear that much weight.

sentences.chinese: 面试结束后，经理又和他交谈了十分钟，了解他的长期计划。
sentences.traditional: 面試結束後，經理又和他交談了十分鐘，了解他的長期計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì jiéshù hòu, jīnglǐ yòu hé tā jiāotán le shí fēnzhōng, liǎojiě tā de chángqī jìhuà.
sentences.translation: After the interview ended, the manager talked with him for another ten minutes to understand his long-term plans.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要找个安静的地方交谈，否则很难把问题说清楚。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要找個安靜的地方交談，否則很難把問題說清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zhǎo ge ānjìng de dìfang jiāotán, fǒuzé hěn nán bǎ wèntí shuō qīngchu.
sentences.translation: We need to find a quiet place to talk; otherwise it will be hard to explain the problem clearly.

sentences.chinese: 通过几次深入交谈，他们逐渐消除了之前的误会。
sentences.traditional: 通過幾次深入交談，他們逐漸消除了之前的誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò jǐ cì shēnrù jiāotán, tāmen zhújiàn xiāochú le zhīqián de wùhuì.
sentences.translation: Through several in-depth conversations, they gradually cleared up their previous misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 周末我们打算去郊外走走，暂时离开城市的噪音。
sentences.traditional: 週末我們打算去郊外走走，暫時離開城市的噪音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen dǎsuàn qù jiāowài zǒuzou, zànshí líkāi chéngshì de zàoyīn.
sentences.translation: At the weekend, we plan to take a walk in the suburbs and temporarily get away from the noise of the city.

sentences.chinese: 那家工厂建在郊外，附近居民受到的影响相对较小。
sentences.traditional: 那家工廠建在郊外，附近居民受到的影響相對較小。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng jiàn zài jiāowài, fùjìn jūmín shòudào de yǐngxiǎng xiāngduì jiào xiǎo.
sentences.translation: That factory was built in the suburbs, so the impact on nearby residents was relatively small.

sentences.chinese: 随着地铁延伸到郊外，越来越多人选择搬到那里生活。
sentences.traditional: 隨著地鐵延伸到郊外，越來越多人選擇搬到那裡生活。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe dìtiě yánshēn dào jiāowài, yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé bān dào nàli shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: As the metro extends into the suburbs, more and more people are choosing to move there to live.

sentences.chinese: 会议室的角落放着一台旧打印机，已经很少有人使用。
sentences.traditional: 會議室的角落放著一臺舊打印機，已經很少有人使用。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì de jiǎoluò fàngzhe yì tái jiù dǎyìnjī, yǐjīng hěn shǎo yǒu rén shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: There is an old printer in the corner of the meeting room, and very few people use it now.

sentences.chinese: 他把关键文件藏在书架后面的角落里，差点忘了拿出来。
sentences.traditional: 他把關鍵文件藏在書架後面的角落裡，差點忘了拿出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ guānjiàn wénjiàn cáng zài shūjià hòumiàn de jiǎoluò li, chàdiǎn wàng le ná chūlai.
sentences.translation: He hid the key documents in the corner behind the bookshelf and almost forgot to take them out.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的每个角落都能看到传统文化和现代商业的碰撞。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的每個角落都能看到傳統文化和現代商業的碰撞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de měi ge jiǎoluò dōu néng kàndào chuántǒng wénhuà hé xiàndài shāngyè de pèngzhuàng.
sentences.translation: In every corner of this city, you can see the collision between traditional culture and modern commerce.

sentences.chinese: 雨后的泥路上留下了一串清晰的脚印。
sentences.traditional: 雨後的泥路上留下了一串清晰的腳印。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu de nílù shàng liúxià le yì chuàn qīngxī de jiǎoyìn.
sentences.translation: A series of clear footprints was left on the muddy road after the rain.

sentences.chinese: 警方根据窗外的脚印判断，嫌疑人可能是从后门逃走的。
sentences.traditional: 警方根據窗外的腳印判斷，嫌疑人可能是從後門逃走的。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng gēnjù chuāng wài de jiǎoyìn pànduàn, xiányírén kěnéng shì cóng hòumén táozǒu de.
sentences.translation: Based on the footprints outside the window, the police judged that the suspect may have escaped through the back door.

sentences.chinese: 孩子在沙滩上追着自己的脚印跑，玩得非常开心。
sentences.traditional: 孩子在沙灘上追著自己的腳印跑，玩得非常開心。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zài shātān shàng zhuīzhe zìjǐ de jiǎoyìn pǎo, wán de fēicháng kāixīn.
sentences.translation: The child ran along the beach chasing his own footprints and had a wonderful time.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告的结论较为谨慎，没有轻易预测市场趋势。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告的結論較為謹慎，沒有輕易預測市場趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de jiélùn jiàowéi jǐnshèn, méiyǒu qīngyì yùcè shìchǎng qūshì.
sentences.translation: The conclusion of this report is relatively cautious and does not casually predict market trends.

sentences.chinese: 与传统方案相比，新系统在安全性方面较为可靠。
sentences.traditional: 與傳統方案相比，新系統在安全性方面較為可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ chuántǒng fāng'àn xiāngbǐ, xīn xìtǒng zài ānquánxìng fāngmiàn jiàowéi kěkào.
sentences.translation: Compared with the traditional plan, the new system is relatively reliable in terms of security.

sentences.chinese: 这类问题较为复杂，不能只从成本角度作判断。
