sentences.traditional: 這類問題較為複雜，不能只從成本角度作判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lèi wèntí jiàowéi fùzá, bù néng zhǐ cóng chéngběn jiǎodù zuò pànduàn.
sentences.translation: This type of issue is relatively complex and cannot be judged only from the perspective of cost.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败给团队留下了深刻的教训，尤其是在风险管理方面。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗給團隊留下了深刻的教訓，尤其是在風險管理方面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài gěi tuánduì liúxià le shēnkè de jiàoxùn, yóuqí shì zài fēngxiǎn guǎnlǐ fāngmiàn.
sentences.translation: This failure left the team with a profound lesson, especially in terms of risk management.

sentences.chinese: 父母不该只用批评来教训孩子，还要解释规则背后的原因。
sentences.traditional: 父母不該只用批評來教訓孩子，還要解釋規則背後的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù gāi zhǐ yòng pīpíng lái jiàoxùn háizi, hái yào jiěshì guīzé bèihòu de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: Parents should not only use criticism to teach children a lesson; they should also explain the reasons behind the rules.

sentences.chinese: 公司从那次事故中吸取教训，重新制定了安全流程。
sentences.traditional: 公司從那次事故中吸取教訓，重新制定了安全流程。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī cóng nà cì shìgù zhōng xīqǔ jiàoxùn, chóngxīn zhìdìng le ānquán liúchéng.
sentences.translation: The company learned a lesson from that accident and drew up new safety procedures.

sentences.chinese: 这棵苹果树去年没有开花，今年却结了不少果子。
sentences.traditional: 這棵蘋果樹去年沒有開花，今年卻結了不少果子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kē píngguǒ shù qùnián méiyǒu kāihuā, jīnnián què jiē le bù shǎo guǒzi.
sentences.translation: This apple tree did not blossom last year, but this year it has borne quite a lot of fruit.

sentences.chinese: 农民担心连续降雨会影响梨树结梨的数量。
sentences.traditional: 農民擔心連續降雨會影響梨樹結梨的數量。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngmín dānxīn liánxù jiàngyǔ huì yǐngxiǎng líshù jiē lí de shùliàng.
sentences.translation: The farmers worry that continuous rain will affect how many pears the pear trees bear.

sentences.chinese: 如果温度太低，葡萄藤就很难顺利结葡萄。
sentences.traditional: 如果溫度太低，葡萄藤就很難順利結葡萄。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wēndù tài dī, pútáoténg jiù hěn nán shùnlì jiē pútáo.
sentences.translation: If the temperature is too low, the grapevines will have difficulty bearing grapes smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 这片果园管理得当，三年后终于开始结果。
sentences.traditional: 這片果園管理得當，三年後終於開始結果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn guǒyuán guǎnlǐ dédàng, sān nián hòu zhōngyú kāishǐ jiēguǒ.
sentences.translation: This orchard was managed properly and finally began to bear fruit after three years.

sentences.chinese: 老师说，长期坚持阅读和写作，迟早会结果。
sentences.traditional: 老師說，長期堅持閱讀和寫作，遲早會結果。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, chángqī jiānchí yuèdú hé xiězuò, chízǎo huì jiēguǒ.
sentences.translation: The teacher said that long-term persistence in reading and writing will bear fruit sooner or later.

sentences.chinese: 如果政策只停留在口号上，就不可能真正结果。
sentences.traditional: 如果政策只停留在口號上，就不可能真正結果。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhèngcè zhǐ tíngliú zài kǒuhào shàng, jiù bù kěnéng zhēnzhèng jiēguǒ.
sentences.translation: If the policy remains only a slogan, it cannot truly produce results.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区接连发生强降雨，交通和供电都受到了影响。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區接連發生強降雨，交通和供電都受到了影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū jiēlián fāshēng qiáng jiàngyǔ, jiāotōng hé gōngdiàn dōu shòudào le yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This area experienced heavy rainfall one after another, affecting both transport and power supply.

sentences.chinese: 他接连三次修改方案，才让客户基本满意。
sentences.traditional: 他接連三次修改方案，才讓客戶基本滿意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiēlián sān cì xiūgǎi fāng'àn, cái ràng kèhù jīběn mǎnyì.
sentences.translation: He revised the proposal three times in a row before the client was basically satisfied.

sentences.chinese: 由于设备接连出故障，生产线不得不停下来检修。
sentences.traditional: 由於設備接連出故障，生產線不得不停下來檢修。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shèbèi jiēlián chū gùzhàng, shēngchǎnxiàn bùdébù tíng xiàlái jiǎnxiū.
sentences.translation: Because the equipment broke down repeatedly, the production line had to stop for repairs.

sentences.chinese: 这把椅子看起来普通，但结构很结实，用了十年也没坏。
sentences.traditional: 這把椅子看起來普通，但結構很結實，用了十年也沒壞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yǐzi kàn qǐlái pǔtōng, dàn jiégòu hěn jiēshi, yòng le shí nián yě méi huài.
sentences.translation: This chair looks ordinary, but its structure is very sturdy and it still has not broken after ten years of use.

sentences.chinese: 经过几个月训练，他的身体比以前结实多了。
sentences.traditional: 經過幾個月訓練，他的身體比以前結實多了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè xùnliàn, tā de shēntǐ bǐ yǐqián jiēshi duō le.
sentences.translation: After several months of training, his body is much stronger than before.

sentences.chinese: 这款行李箱外壳结实，适合频繁出差的人使用。
sentences.traditional: 這款行李箱外殼結實，適合頻繁出差的人使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xínglǐxiāng wàiké jiēshi, shìhé pínfán chūchāi de rén shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: The shell of this suitcase is sturdy, making it suitable for people who travel frequently on business.

sentences.chinese: 节日晚上，街头到处都是音乐声和欢笑声。
sentences.traditional: 節日晚上，街頭到處都是音樂聲和歡笑聲。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì wǎnshang, jiētóu dàochù dōu shì yīnyuè shēng hé huānxiào shēng.
sentences.translation: On the evening of the festival, the streets were full of music and laughter.

sentences.chinese: 这位摄影师喜欢在街头观察普通人的生活细节。
sentences.traditional: 這位攝影師喜歡在街頭觀察普通人的生活細節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèyǐngshī xǐhuān zài jiētóu guānchá pǔtōngrén de shēnghuó xìjié.
sentences.translation: This photographer likes observing the details of ordinary people's lives on the street.

sentences.chinese: 政府在街头增加了照明设备，以提高夜间安全。
sentences.traditional: 政府在街頭增加了照明設備，以提高夜間安全。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zài jiētóu zēngjiā le zhàomíng shèbèi, yǐ tígāo yèjiān ānquán.
sentences.translation: The government added lighting equipment on the streets to improve safety at night.

sentences.chinese: 她在公共卫生领域作出了杰出贡献，获得了国际认可。
sentences.traditional: 她在公共衛生領域作出了傑出貢獻，獲得了國際認可。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài gōnggòng wèishēng lǐngyù zuòchū le jiéchū gòngxiàn, huòdé le guójì rènkě.
sentences.translation: She made outstanding contributions in the field of public health and gained international recognition.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学培养了许多杰出的工程师和研究人员。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學培養了許多傑出的工程師和研究人員。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué péiyǎng le xǔduō jiéchū de gōngchéngshī hé yánjiū rényuán.
sentences.translation: This university has trained many outstanding engineers and researchers.

sentences.chinese: 评委认为他的表现最为杰出，因此一致推荐他获奖。
sentences.traditional: 評委認為他的表現最為傑出，因此一致推薦他獲獎。
sentences.pinyin: Píngwěi rènwéi tā de biǎoxiàn zuìwéi jiéchū, yīncǐ yízhì tuījiàn tā huòjiǎng.
sentences.translation: The judges considered his performance the most outstanding, so they unanimously recommended him for the award.

sentences.chinese: 新建办公楼采用了节能玻璃和智能空调系统。
sentences.traditional: 新建辦公樓採用了節能玻璃和智能空調系統。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnjiàn bàngōnglóu cǎiyòng le jiénéng bōli hé zhìnéng kōngtiáo xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: The newly built office building uses energy-saving glass and an intelligent air-conditioning system.

sentences.chinese: 企业通过更新设备来节能，同时降低长期运营成本。
sentences.traditional: 企業通過更新設備來節能，同時降低長期運營成本。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè tōngguò gēngxīn shèbèi lái jiénéng, tóngshí jiàngdī chángqī yùnyíng chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The enterprise saves energy by updating equipment while also reducing long-term operating costs.

sentences.chinese: 节能不是简单少用电，而是提高资源使用效率。
sentences.traditional: 節能不是簡單少用電，而是提高資源使用效率。
sentences.pinyin: Jiénéng bù shì jiǎndān shǎo yòng diàn, ér shì tígāo zīyuán shǐyòng xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Saving energy is not simply using less electricity; it is about improving the efficiency of resource use.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影的结尾出人意料，却让整个故事更加完整。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影的結尾出人意料，卻讓整個故事更加完整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéwěi chū rén yìliào, què ràng zhěnggè gùshì gèngjiā wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: The ending of this film is unexpected, but it makes the whole story more complete.

sentences.chinese: 演讲快要结尾时，他再次强调了合作的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 演講快要結尾時，他再次強調了合作的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng kuài yào jiéwěi shí, tā zàicì qiángdiào le hézuò de zhòngyàoxìng.
sentences.translation: As the speech was about to end, he once again emphasised the importance of cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 文章结尾部分提出了一个值得继续研究的问题。
sentences.traditional: 文章結尾部分提出了一個值得繼續研究的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Wénzhāng jiéwěi bùfen tíchū le yí ge zhídé jìxù yánjiū de wèntí.
sentences.translation: The ending section of the article raises a question worth further study.

sentences.chinese: 截至本月底，项目已经完成了百分之八十。
sentences.traditional: 截至本月底，項目已經完成了百分之八十。
sentences.pinyin: Jiézhì běn yuèdǐ, xiàngmù yǐjīng wánchéng le bǎifēn zhī bāshí.
sentences.translation: As of the end of this month, the project has already been eighty percent completed.

sentences.chinese: 截至目前，还没有证据表明系统存在严重漏洞。
sentences.traditional: 截至目前，還沒有證據表明系統存在嚴重漏洞。
sentences.pinyin: Jiézhì mùqián, hái méiyǒu zhèngjù biǎomíng xìtǒng cúnzài yánzhòng lòudòng.
sentences.translation: As of now, there is still no evidence showing that the system has a serious vulnerability.

sentences.chinese: 截至昨天，已有两百多名志愿者报名参加培训。
sentences.traditional: 截至昨天，已有兩百多名志願者報名參加培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Jiézhì zuótiān, yǐ yǒu liǎng bǎi duō míng zhìyuànzhě bàomíng cānjiā péixùn.
sentences.translation: As of yesterday, more than two hundred volunteers had signed up for the training.

sentences.chinese: 报名将在周五下午五点截止，请提前提交材料。
sentences.traditional: 報名將在週五下午五點截止，請提前提交材料。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng jiāng zài zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn jiézhǐ, qǐng tíqián tíjiāo cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Registration will close at five o'clock on Friday afternoon, so please submit the materials in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这项优惠活动今天截止，明天价格就会恢复原状。
sentences.traditional: 這項優惠活動今天截止，明天價格就會恢復原狀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yōuhuì huódòng jīntiān jiézhǐ, míngtiān jiàgé jiù huì huīfù yuánzhuàng.
sentences.translation: This promotional offer ends today, and the price will return to normal tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 会议主席宣布讨论截止，并要求各组提交最终意见。
sentences.traditional: 會議主席宣布討論截止，並要求各組提交最終意見。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì zhǔxí xuānbù tǎolùn jiézhǐ, bìng yāoqiú gè zǔ tíjiāo zuìzhōng yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: The meeting chair announced that the discussion was closed and asked each group to submit its final views.

sentences.chinese: 他故意放慢谈判节奏，以便为团队争取更多准备时间。
sentences.traditional: 他故意放慢談判節奏，以便為團隊爭取更多準備時間。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gùyì fàngmàn tánpàn jiézòu, yǐbiàn wèi tuánduì zhēngqǔ gèng duō zhǔnbèi shíjiān.
sentences.translation: He deliberately slowed the pace of the negotiations to win more preparation time for the team.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片的节奏很稳，不急不慢地展开了整个事件。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片的節奏很穩，不急不慢地展開了整個事件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn de jiézòu hěn wěn, bù jí bù màn de zhǎnkāi le zhěnggè shìjiàn.
sentences.translation: The rhythm of this documentary is steady, unfolding the whole event at an unhurried pace.

sentences.chinese: 城市生活节奏太快，让很多年轻人感到长期紧张。
sentences.traditional: 城市生活節奏太快，讓很多年輕人感到長期緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì shēnghuó jiézòu tài kuài, ràng hěn duō niánqīngrén gǎndào chángqī jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: The pace of city life is too fast, making many young people feel long-term tension.

sentences.chinese: 这道题看似复杂，其实换个角度就能解。
sentences.traditional: 這道題看似複雜，其實換個角度就能解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí kànsì fùzá, qíshí huàn gè jiǎodù jiù néng jiě.
sentences.translation: This problem seems complicated, but it can be solved from another angle.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有直接给答案，而是让学生自己解这个方程。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有直接給答案，而是讓學生自己解這個方程。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu zhíjiē gěi dá'àn, ér shì ràng xuéshēng zìjǐ jiě zhège fāngchéng.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not give the answer directly, but let the students solve the equation themselves.

sentences.chinese: 她耐心地把包上的结解了，才取出里面的文件。
sentences.traditional: 她耐心地把包上的結解了，才取出裡面的文件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nàixīn de bǎ bāo shàng de jié jiě le, cái qǔchū lǐmiàn de wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: She patiently untied the knot on the bag before taking out the documents inside.

sentences.chinese: 专家在线解答了居民关于养老金政策的疑问。
sentences.traditional: 專家在線解答了居民關於養老金政策的疑問。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā zàixiàn jiědá le jūmín guānyú yǎnglǎojīn zhèngcè de yíwèn.
sentences.translation: Experts answered residents' questions about the pension policy online.

sentences.chinese: 这本书不仅提出问题，还用案例逐步解答。
sentences.traditional: 這本書不僅提出問題，還用案例逐步解答。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bùjǐn tíchū wèntí, hái yòng ànlì zhúbù jiědá.
sentences.translation: This book not only raises questions, but also answers them step by step with case studies.

sentences.chinese: 面试官要求候选人现场解答一个真实业务难题。
sentences.traditional: 面試官要求候選人現場解答一個真實業務難題。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshìguān yāoqiú hòuxuǎnrén xiànchǎng jiědá yí gè zhēnshí yèwù nántí.
sentences.translation: The interviewer asked the candidate to answer a real business problem on the spot.

sentences.chinese: 媒体对这份报告的解读过于片面，忽视了长期背景。
sentences.traditional: 媒體對這份報告的解讀過於片面，忽視了長期背景。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ duì zhè fèn bàogào de jiědú guòyú piànmiàn, hūshì le chángqī bèijǐng.
sentences.translation: The media interpretation of this report was too one-sided and ignored the long-term background.

sentences.chinese: 教授从历史角度解读了这场改革的真正意义。
sentences.traditional: 教授從歷史角度解讀了這場改革的真正意義。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshòu cóng lìshǐ jiǎodù jiědú le zhè chǎng gǎigé de zhēnzhèng yìyì.
sentences.translation: The professor interpreted the true meaning of this reform from a historical perspective.

sentences.chinese: 观众可以按照自己的经历解读电影结尾。
sentences.traditional: 觀眾可以按照自己的經歷解讀電影結尾。
sentences.pinyin: Guānzhòng kěyǐ ànzhào zìjǐ de jīnglì jiědú diànyǐng jiéwěi.
sentences.translation: Viewers can interpret the ending of the film according to their own experiences.

sentences.chinese: 新技术把员工从重复劳动中解放出来。
sentences.traditional: 新技術把員工從重複勞動中解放出來。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jìshù bǎ yuángōng cóng chóngfù láodòng zhōng jiěfàng chūlái.
sentences.translation: New technology frees employees from repetitive labour.

sentences.chinese: 改革解放了市场活力，也带来了新的监管挑战。
sentences.traditional: 改革解放了市場活力，也帶來了新的監管挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎigé jiěfàng le shìchǎng huólì, yě dài lái le xīn de jiānguǎn tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: Reform released market vitality and also brought new regulatory challenges.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市解放后，教育和医疗条件逐渐改善。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市解放後，教育和醫療條件逐漸改善。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì jiěfàng hòu, jiàoyù hé yīliáo tiáojiàn zhújiàn gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: After the city was liberated, education and medical conditions gradually improved.

sentences.chinese: 导游用生动的语言解说了古城的防御体系。
sentences.traditional: 導遊用生動的語言解說了古城的防禦體系。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyóu yòng shēngdòng de yǔyán jiěshuō le gǔchéng de fángyù tǐxì.
sentences.translation: The guide explained the ancient city’s defence system in vivid language.

sentences.chinese: 比赛解说不仅要懂规则，还要能把气氛带起来。
sentences.traditional: 比賽解說不僅要懂規則，還要能把氣氛帶起來。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiěshuō bùjǐn yào dǒng guīzé, hái yào néng bǎ qìfēn dài qǐlái.
sentences.translation: Sports commentary not only requires understanding the rules, but also the ability to lift the atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 纪录片通过旁白解说，把复杂的科学过程讲得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 紀錄片通過旁白解說，把複雜的科學過程講得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Jìlùpiàn tōngguò pángbái jiěshuō, bǎ fùzá de kēxué guòchéng jiǎng de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The documentary uses narration to explain the complex scientific process very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 我们可以借鉴国外经验，但不能照搬他们的制度。
sentences.traditional: 我們可以借鑒國外經驗，但不能照搬他們的制度。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ jièjiàn guówài jīngyàn, dàn bù néng zhàobān tāmen de zhìdù.
sentences.translation: We can draw on foreign experience, but we cannot copy their system directly.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败值得借鉴，因为它暴露了流程中的关键漏洞。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗值得借鑒，因為它暴露了流程中的關鍵漏洞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài zhídé jièjiàn, yīnwèi tā bàolù le liúchéng zhōng de guānjiàn lòudòng.
sentences.translation: This failure is worth learning from because it exposed key flaws in the process.

sentences.chinese: 新方案充分借鉴了以往项目的成功做法。
sentences.traditional: 新方案充分借鑒了以往項目的成功做法。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn fāng'àn chōngfèn jièjiàn le yǐwǎng xiàngmù de chénggōng zuòfǎ.
sentences.translation: The new plan fully draws on the successful practices of previous projects.

sentences.chinese: 她把戒指放进抽屉里，决定暂时不谈那段关系。
sentences.traditional: 她把戒指放進抽屜裡，決定暫時不談那段關係。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jièzhi fàng jìn chōutì lǐ, juédìng zànshí bù tán nà duàn guānxì.
sentences.translation: She put the ring into the drawer and decided not to talk about that relationship for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 这枚戒指虽然不贵，却承载着他们多年的记忆。
sentences.traditional: 這枚戒指雖然不貴，卻承載著他們多年的記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè méi jièzhi suīrán bú guì, què chéngzài zhe tāmen duōnián de jìyì.
sentences.translation: Although this ring is not expensive, it carries many years of their memories.

sentences.chinese: 店员提醒他，戒指尺寸最好根据手指实际情况调整。
sentences.traditional: 店員提醒他，戒指尺寸最好根據手指實際情況調整。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyuán tíxǐng tā, jièzhi chǐcùn zuìhǎo gēnjù shǒuzhǐ shíjì qíngkuàng tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: The shop assistant reminded him that the ring size should preferably be adjusted according to the actual finger size.

sentences.chinese: 借助人工智能，医生可以更快发现早期风险。
sentences.traditional: 借助人工智能，醫生可以更快發現早期風險。
sentences.pinyin: Jièzhù réngōng zhìnéng, yīshēng kěyǐ gèng kuài fāxiàn zǎoqī fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: With the help of artificial intelligence, doctors can discover early risks more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这个小组借助社区力量，完成了老人饮食调查。
sentences.traditional: 這個小組借助社區力量，完成了老人飲食調查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiǎozǔ jièzhù shèqū lìliàng, wánchéng le lǎorén yǐnshí diàochá.
sentences.translation: This group used the community's strength to complete a dietary survey of elderly people.

sentences.chinese: 企业借助网络平台，把产品直接卖到海外市场。
sentences.traditional: 企業借助網絡平臺，把產品直接賣到海外市場。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè jièzhù wǎngluò píngtái, bǎ chǎnpǐn zhíjiē mài dào hǎiwài shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: Enterprises use online platforms to sell products directly to overseas markets.

sentences.chinese: 合同上写明了付款金额和最后期限。
sentences.traditional: 合同上寫明了付款金額和最後期限。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong shàng xiěmíng le fùkuǎn jīn'é hé zuìhòu qīxiàn.
sentences.translation: The contract clearly states the payment amount and the final deadline.

sentences.chinese: 这笔赔偿金额并不高，却体现了公司承认责任的态度。
sentences.traditional: 這筆賠償金額並不高，卻體現了公司承認責任的態度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ péicháng jīn'é bìng bù gāo, què tǐxiàn le gōngsī chéngrèn zérèn de tàidù.
sentences.translation: The compensation amount is not high, but it reflects the company’s attitude of admitting responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 财务部门需要核对每一张发票的金额。
sentences.traditional: 財務部門需要核對每一張發票的金額。
sentences.pinyin: Cáiwù bùmén xūyào héduì měi yì zhāng fāpiào de jīn'é.
sentences.translation: The finance department needs to check the amount on every invoice.

sentences.chinese: 她在国际比赛中赢得金牌后，仍然坚持每天训练。
sentences.traditional: 她在國際比賽中贏得金牌後，仍然堅持每天訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài guójì bǐsài zhōng yíngdé jīnpái hòu, réngrán jiānchí měitiān xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: After winning a gold medal in an international competition, she still kept training every day.

sentences.chinese: 这块金牌属于整个团队，而不只是最后冲线的运动员。
sentences.traditional: 這塊金牌屬於整個團隊，而不只是最後衝線的運動員。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài jīnpái shǔyú zhěnggè tuánduì, ér bù zhǐshì zuìhòu chōngxiàn de yùndòngyuán.
sentences.translation: This gold medal belongs to the whole team, not just the athlete who crossed the line last.

sentences.chinese: 他把金牌挂在学校展厅里，鼓励更多孩子参加体育。
sentences.traditional: 他把金牌掛在學校展廳裡，鼓勵更多孩子參加體育。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jīnpái guà zài xuéxiào zhǎntīng lǐ, gǔlì gèng duō háizi cānjiā tǐyù.
sentences.translation: He hung the gold medal in the school exhibition hall to encourage more children to take part in sport.

sentences.chinese: 在公共服务领域，金钱不能成为衡量一切的唯一标准。
sentences.traditional: 在公共服務領域，金錢不能成為衡量一切的唯一標準。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gōnggòng fúwù lǐngyù, jīnqián bù néng chéngwéi héngliáng yíqiè de wéiyī biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: In the field of public services, money cannot become the only standard for measuring everything.

sentences.chinese: 他对金钱的态度很理性，既不浪费，也不盲目节省。
sentences.traditional: 他對金錢的態度很理性，既不浪費，也不盲目節省。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì jīnqián de tàidù hěn lǐxìng, jì bù làngfèi, yě bù mángmù jiéshěng.
sentences.translation: His attitude towards money is very rational: he neither wastes it nor saves blindly.

sentences.chinese: 项目失败后，损失的不只是金钱，还有客户的信任。
sentences.traditional: 項目失敗後，損失的不只是金錢，還有客戶的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù shībài hòu, sǔnshī de bù zhǐshì jīnqián, hái yǒu kèhù de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: After the project failed, what was lost was not only money, but also the clients’ trust.

sentences.chinese: 金融市场的变化会影响企业融资和普通人的生活成本。
sentences.traditional: 金融市場的變化會影響企業融資和普通人的生活成本。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnróng shìchǎng de biànhuà huì yǐngxiǎng qǐyè róngzī hé pǔtōngrén de shēnghuó chéngběn.
sentences.translation: Changes in financial markets can affect corporate financing and ordinary people’s cost of living.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学开设了金融风险管理课程，吸引了许多学生。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學開設了金融風險管理課程，吸引了許多學生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué kāishè le jīnróng fēngxiǎn guǎnlǐ kèchéng, xīyǐn le xǔduō xuéshēng.
sentences.translation: This university has launched a course in financial risk management, attracting many students.

sentences.chinese: 监管部门要求金融机构提高透明度，保护消费者权益。
sentences.traditional: 監管部門要求金融機構提高透明度，保護消費者權益。
sentences.pinyin: Jiānguǎn bùmén yāoqiú jīnróng jīgòu tígāo tòumíngdù, bǎohù xiāofèizhě quányì.
sentences.translation: Regulators require financial institutions to increase transparency and protect consumer rights.

sentences.chinese: 这种金属耐高温，常用于航空发动机的关键部件。
sentences.traditional: 這種金屬耐高溫，常用於航空發動機的關鍵部件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jīnshǔ nài gāowēn, cháng yòng yú hángkōng fādòngjī de guānjiàn bùjiàn.
sentences.translation: This metal is resistant to high temperatures and is often used in key parts of aircraft engines.

sentences.chinese: 回收金属不仅节约资源，也能减少采矿造成的破坏。
sentences.traditional: 回收金屬不僅節約資源，也能減少採礦造成的破壞。
sentences.pinyin: Huíshōu jīnshǔ bùjǐn jiéyuē zīyuán, yě néng jiǎnshǎo cǎikuàng zàochéng de pòhuài.
sentences.translation: Recycling metal not only saves resources, but can also reduce the damage caused by mining.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员发现，这种金属在低温下会表现出特殊性质。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員發現，這種金屬在低溫下會表現出特殊性質。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán fāxiàn, zhè zhǒng jīnshǔ zài dīwēn xià huì biǎoxiàn chū tèshū xìngzhì.
sentences.translation: Researchers found that this metal shows special properties at low temperatures.

sentences.chinese: 他并不相信天上会掉金子，所以对投资承诺保持警惕。
sentences.traditional: 他並不相信天上會掉金子，所以對投資承諾保持警惕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù xiāngxìn tiānshàng huì diào jīnzi, suǒyǐ duì tóuzī chéngnuò bǎochí jǐngtì.
sentences.translation: He does not believe gold will fall from the sky, so he remains wary of investment promises.

sentences.chinese: 这件首饰看起来像金子，其实只是表面镀了一层。
sentences.traditional: 這件首飾看起來像金子，其實只是表面鍍了一層。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shǒushì kàn qǐlái xiàng jīnzi, qíshí zhǐshì biǎomiàn dù le yì céng.
sentences.translation: This piece of jewellery looks like gold, but actually only has a layer plated on the surface.

sentences.chinese: 老人把多年积攒的金子交给银行保管。
sentences.traditional: 老人把多年積攢的金子交給銀行保管。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén bǎ duōnián jīzǎn de jīnzi jiāo gěi yínháng bǎoguǎn.
sentences.translation: The elderly man handed the gold he had saved for many years to the bank for safekeeping.

sentences.chinese: 为了按时完成任务，团队已经尽了最大努力。
sentences.traditional: 為了按時完成任務，團隊已經盡了最大努力。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ànshí wánchéng rènwù, tuánduì yǐjīng jìn le zuìdà nǔlì.
sentences.translation: To complete the task on time, the team has already done its utmost.

sentences.chinese: 连续几天的谈判之后，双方的耐心都快尽了。
sentences.traditional: 連續幾天的談判之後，雙方的耐心都快盡了。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jǐ tiān de tánpàn zhīhòu, shuāngfāng de nàixīn dōu kuài jìn le.
sentences.translation: After several days of negotiations, both sides’ patience was almost exhausted.

sentences.chinese: 我们会尽一切可能帮助受灾居民恢复生活。
sentences.traditional: 我們會盡一切可能幫助受災居民恢復生活。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen huì jìn yíqiè kěnéng bāngzhù shòuzāi jūmín huīfù shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: We will do everything possible to help disaster-affected residents restore their lives.

sentences.chinese: 数据先被整理成图表，进而用于判断市场趋势。
sentences.traditional: 數據先被整理成圖表，進而用於判斷市場趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù xiān bèi zhěnglǐ chéng túbiǎo, jìn'ér yòng yú pànduàn shìchǎng qūshì.
sentences.translation: The data is first organised into charts, and then used to judge market trends.

sentences.chinese: 改善交通可以缩短通勤时间，进而提高城市运行效率。
sentences.traditional: 改善交通可以縮短通勤時間，進而提高城市運行效率。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎishàn jiāotōng kěyǐ suōduǎn tōngqín shíjiān, jìn'ér tígāo chéngshì yùnxíng xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Improving transport can shorten commuting time and then raise the efficiency of city operations.

sentences.chinese: 他先获得基层经验，进而承担更复杂的管理工作。
sentences.traditional: 他先獲得基層經驗，進而承擔更複雜的管理工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiān huòdé jīcéng jīngyàn, jìn'ér chéngdān gèng fùzá de guǎnlǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He first gained grassroots experience, and then took on more complex management work.

sentences.chinese: 项目进度比预期慢，主要原因是审批时间延长了。
sentences.traditional: 項目進度比預期慢，主要原因是審批時間延長了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù jìndù bǐ yùqī màn, zhǔyào yuányīn shì shěnpī shíjiān yáncháng le.
sentences.translation: The project progress is slower than expected, mainly because the approval time has been extended.

sentences.chinese: 经理每天查看进度，确保各部门之间配合顺畅。
sentences.traditional: 經理每天查看進度，確保各部門之間配合順暢。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ měitiān chákàn jìndù, quèbǎo gè bùmén zhījiān pèihé shùnchàng.
sentences.translation: The manager checks the progress every day to ensure smooth cooperation between departments.

sentences.chinese: 你可以在系统里更新学习进度，老师会根据情况调整作业。
sentences.traditional: 你可以在系統裡更新學習進度，老師會根據情況調整作業。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài xìtǒng lǐ gēngxīn xuéxí jìndù, lǎoshī huì gēnjù qíngkuàng tiáozhěng zuòyè.
sentences.translation: You can update your study progress in the system, and the teacher will adjust the homework accordingly.

sentences.chinese: 人类语言的进化与社会合作方式密切相关。
sentences.traditional: 人類語言的進化與社會合作方式密切相關。
sentences.pinyin: Rénlèi yǔyán de jìnhuà yǔ shèhuì hézuò fāngshì mìqiè xiāngguān.
sentences.translation: The evolution of human language is closely related to forms of social cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 这些鸟为了适应海岛环境，逐渐进化出更短的翅膀。
sentences.traditional: 這些鳥為了適應海島環境，逐漸進化出更短的翅膀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē niǎo wèile shìyìng hǎidǎo huánjìng, zhújiàn jìnhuà chū gèng duǎn de chìbǎng.
sentences.translation: To adapt to the island environment, these birds gradually evolved shorter wings.

sentences.chinese: 技术进化太快，相关法律往往来不及及时调整。
sentences.traditional: 技術進化太快，相關法律往往來不及及時調整。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshù jìnhuà tài kuài, xiāngguān fǎlǜ wǎngwǎng láibují jíshí tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: Technology evolves too quickly, and relevant laws often cannot be adjusted in time.

sentences.chinese: 近来天气变化很大，医院里呼吸道患者明显增多。
sentences.traditional: 近來天氣變化很大，醫院裡呼吸道患者明顯增多。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnlái tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, yīyuàn lǐ hūxīdào huànzhě míngxiǎn zēngduō.
sentences.translation: Recently, the weather has changed a great deal, and respiratory patients in hospitals have clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 公司近来调整了销售策略，线上订单增长很快。
sentences.traditional: 公司近來調整了銷售策略，線上訂單增長很快。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìnlái tiáozhěng le xiāoshòu cèlüè, xiànshàng dìngdān zēngzhǎng hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: The company has recently adjusted its sales strategy, and online orders have grown quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他近来很少参加聚会，似乎把精力都放在论文上了。
sentences.traditional: 他近來很少參加聚會，似乎把精力都放在論文上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìnlái hěn shǎo cānjiā jùhuì, sìhū bǎ jīnglì dōu fàng zài lùnwén shàng le.
sentences.translation: He has rarely attended gatherings recently and seems to have put all his energy into his thesis.

sentences.chinese: 很多孩子长期盯着电子屏幕，近视问题越来越普遍。
sentences.traditional: 很多孩子長期盯著電子屏幕，近視問題越來越普遍。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō háizi chángqī dīngzhe diànzǐ píngmù, jìnshì wèntí yuèláiyuè pǔbiàn.
sentences.translation: Nearsightedness is becoming increasingly common among children who stare at electronic screens for long periods.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然近视，但戴上眼镜后仍能清楚地阅读远处的标语。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然近視，但戴上眼鏡後仍能清楚地閱讀遠處的標語。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán jìnshì, dàn dàishang yǎnjìng hòu réng néng qīngchu de yuèdú yuǎnchù de biāoyǔ.
sentences.translation: Although he is nearsighted, he can still read distant signs clearly after putting on his glasses.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议近视学生每隔一段时间就望向窗外放松眼睛。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議近視學生每隔一段時間就望向窗外放鬆眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì jìnshì xuéshēng měi gé yí duàn shíjiān jiù wàng xiàng chuāngwài fàngsōng yǎnjing.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised nearsighted students to look out of the window at intervals to relax their eyes.

sentences.chinese: 谈判取得了明显进展，双方终于同意继续合作。
sentences.traditional: 談判取得了明顯進展，雙方終於同意繼續合作。
sentences.pinyin: Tánpàn qǔdé le míngxiǎn jìnzhǎn, shuāngfāng zhōngyú tóngyì jìxù hézuò.
sentences.translation: The negotiations made clear progress, and the two sides finally agreed to continue cooperating.

sentences.chinese: 项目进展比预期慢，主要是因为审批过程过于复杂。
sentences.traditional: 項目進展比預期慢，主要是因為審批過程過於複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù jìnzhǎn bǐ yùqī màn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi shěnpī guòchéng guòyú fùzá.
sentences.translation: The project is progressing more slowly than expected, mainly because the approval process is too complicated.

sentences.chinese: 研究小组每周汇报进展，以便及时调整实验方向。
sentences.traditional: 研究小組每週匯報進展，以便及時調整實驗方向。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū xiǎozǔ měi zhōu huìbào jìnzhǎn, yǐbiàn jíshí tiáozhěng shíyàn fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: The research team reports its progress every week so that the experimental direction can be adjusted promptly.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展出了许多精美的青铜器，吸引了大批游客。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展出了許多精美的青銅器，吸引了大批遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū le xǔduō jīngměi de qīngtóngqì, xīyǐn le dàpī yóukè.
sentences.translation: The museum displayed many exquisite bronze objects, attracting large numbers of visitors.

sentences.chinese: 这本书的插图十分精美，连细小的纹路都画得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這本書的插圖十分精美，連細小的紋路都畫得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de chātú shífēn jīngměi, lián xìxiǎo de wénlù dōu huà de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The illustrations in this book are very exquisite; even the tiny patterns are drawn clearly.

sentences.chinese: 她把普通礼盒包装得很精美，让客户感到格外重视。
sentences.traditional: 她把普通禮盒包裝得很精美，讓客戶感到格外重視。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ pǔtōng lǐhé bāozhuāng de hěn jīngměi, ràng kèhù gǎndào géwài zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: She packaged the ordinary gift box very beautifully, making the customer feel especially valued.

sentences.chinese: 这台仪器能够进行精确测量，误差几乎可以忽略。
sentences.traditional: 這臺儀器能夠進行精確測量，誤差幾乎可以忽略。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái yíqì nénggòu jìnxíng jīngquè cèliáng, wùchā jīhū kěyǐ hūlüè.
sentences.translation: This instrument can make precise measurements, with errors that can almost be ignored.

sentences.chinese: 报告中的数据必须精确，否则会影响整个判断。
sentences.traditional: 報告中的數據必須精確，否則會影響整個判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào zhōng de shùjù bìxū jīngquè, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng zhěnggè pànduàn.
sentences.translation: The data in the report must be accurate, otherwise it will affect the whole judgement.

sentences.chinese: 为了精确控制成本，财务部门重新核对了每项支出。
sentences.traditional: 為了精確控制成本，財務部門重新核對了每項支出。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jīngquè kòngzhì chéngběn, cáiwù bùmén chóngxīn héduì le měi xiàng zhīchū.
sentences.translation: To control costs precisely, the finance department checked every expense again.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司五年内的增长速度十分惊人。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司五年內的增長速度十分驚人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī wǔ nián nèi de zēngzhǎng sùdù shífēn jīngrén.
sentences.translation: This company’s growth rate over five years has been astonishing.

sentences.chinese: 他在压力下仍能保持冷静，这一点令人惊人。
sentences.traditional: 他在壓力下仍能保持冷靜，這一點令人驚人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài yālì xià réng néng bǎochí lěngjìng, zhè yì diǎn lìng rén jīngrén.
sentences.translation: The fact that he can remain calm under pressure is astonishing.

sentences.chinese: 新技术带来的效率提升达到了惊人的程度。
sentences.traditional: 新技術帶來的效率提升達到了驚人的程度。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jìshù dàilái de xiàolǜ tíshēng dádào le jīngrén de chéngdù.
sentences.translation: The improvement in efficiency brought by the new technology reached an astonishing level.

sentences.chinese: 他年轻时曾在东南亚经商，积累了丰富经验。
sentences.traditional: 他年輕時曾在東南亞經商，累積了豐富經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí céng zài Dōngnányà jīngshāng, jīlěi le fēngfù jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: When he was young, he once did business in Southeast Asia and gained rich experience.

sentences.chinese: 经商不仅需要胆量，也需要对市场变化的敏感判断。
sentences.traditional: 經商不僅需要膽量，也需要對市場變化的敏感判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngshāng bùjǐn xūyào dǎnliàng, yě xūyào duì shìchǎng biànhuà de mǐngǎn pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Engaging in business requires not only courage, but also sensitive judgement about market changes.

sentences.chinese: 她决定辞去稳定的工作，回乡和家人一起经商。
sentences.traditional: 她決定辭去穩定的工作，回鄉和家人一起經商。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng cíqù wěndìng de gōngzuò, huíxiāng hé jiārén yìqǐ jīngshāng.
sentences.translation: She decided to quit her stable job and return to her hometown to do business with her family.

sentences.chinese: 他精通多种编程语言，能迅速解决复杂问题。
sentences.traditional: 他精通多種程式語言，能迅速解決複雜問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīngtōng duō zhǒng biānchéng yǔyán, néng xùnsù jiějué fùzá wèntí.
sentences.translation: He is proficient in several programming languages and can quickly solve complex problems.

sentences.chinese: 要精通一门外语，必须长期接触真实材料。
sentences.traditional: 要精通一門外語，必須長期接觸真實材料。
sentences.pinyin: Yào jīngtōng yì mén wàiyǔ, bìxū chángqī jiēchù zhēnshí cáiliào.
sentences.translation: To master a foreign language, one must have long-term contact with authentic materials.

sentences.chinese: 这位工程师精通设备维护，工厂停工时间因此大大减少。
sentences.traditional: 這位工程師精通設備維護，工廠停工時間因此大大減少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi gōngchéngshī jīngtōng shèbèi wéihù, gōngchǎng tínggōng shíjiān yīncǐ dàdà jiǎnshǎo.
sentences.translation: This engineer is skilled in equipment maintenance, so the factory’s downtime has been greatly reduced.

sentences.chinese: 这次展览经过精心安排，参观路线非常清晰。
sentences.traditional: 這次展覽經過精心安排，參觀路線非常清晰。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn jīngguò jīngxīn ānpái, cānguān lùxiàn fēicháng qīngxī.
sentences.translation: This exhibition has been carefully arranged, and the visitor route is very clear.

sentences.chinese: 她为孩子精心准备了一份生日礼物，却没有提前透露。
sentences.traditional: 她為孩子精心準備了一份生日禮物，卻沒有提前透露。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèi háizi jīngxīn zhǔnbèi le yí fèn shēngrì lǐwù, què méiyǒu tíqián tòulù.
sentences.translation: She carefully prepared a birthday present for the child, but did not reveal it in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章是他精心修改后的结果，结构比原来清楚多了。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章是他精心修改後的結果，結構比原來清楚多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng shì tā jīngxīn xiūgǎi hòu de jiéguǒ, jiégòu bǐ yuánlái qīngchu duō le.
sentences.translation: This article is the result of his careful revision, and its structure is much clearer than before.

sentences.chinese: 听到公司突然改变计划，大家都感到十分惊讶。
sentences.traditional: 聽到公司突然改變計劃，大家都感到十分驚訝。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào gōngsī tūrán gǎibiàn jìhuà, dàjiā dōu gǎndào shífēn jīngyà.
sentences.translation: Everyone felt very surprised when they heard that the company had suddenly changed its plan.

sentences.chinese: 她惊讶地发现，自己多年前的建议已经被采纳。
sentences.traditional: 她驚訝地發現，自己多年前的建議已經被採納。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīngyà de fāxiàn, zìjǐ duō nián qián de jiànyì yǐjīng bèi cǎinà.
sentences.translation: She was surprised to find that the suggestion she had made years earlier had already been adopted.

sentences.chinese: 这个结果并不让专家惊讶，因为早期数据已经显示了趋势。
sentences.traditional: 這個結果並不讓專家驚訝，因為早期數據已經顯示了趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ bìng bù ràng zhuānjiā jīngyà, yīnwèi zǎoqī shùjù yǐjīng xiǎnshì le qūshì.
sentences.translation: This result did not surprise the experts, because the early data had already shown the trend.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店的菜量不大，但摆盘非常精致。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店的菜量不大，但擺盤非常精緻。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de cài liàng bú dà, dàn bǎipán fēicháng jīngzhì.
sentences.translation: The portions at this small restaurant are not large, but the presentation is very refined.

sentences.chinese: 她喜欢设计精致而实用的家具，而不是单纯追求豪华。
sentences.traditional: 她喜歡設計精緻而實用的傢俱，而不是單純追求豪華。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan shèjì jīngzhì ér shíyòng de jiājù, ér bú shì dānchún zhuīqiú háohuá.
sentences.translation: She likes designing furniture that is refined and practical, rather than simply pursuing luxury.

sentences.chinese: 这座老建筑的木雕十分精致，保存得也很完整。
sentences.traditional: 這座老建築的木雕十分精緻，保存得也很完整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo jiànzhù de mùdiāo shífēn jīngzhì, bǎocún de yě hěn wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: The wood carvings in this old building are very delicate, and they have also been preserved intact.

sentences.chinese: 这次广告投放非常精准，几乎直接触达了目标客户。
sentences.traditional: 這次廣告投放非常精準，幾乎直接觸達了目標客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì guǎnggào tóufàng fēicháng jīngzhǔn, jīhū zhíjiē chùdá le mùbiāo kèhù.
sentences.translation: This advertising campaign was very precise and almost directly reached the target customers.

sentences.chinese: 医生需要根据检查结果作出精准判断，不能只凭经验。
sentences.traditional: 醫生需要根據檢查結果作出精準判斷，不能只憑經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào gēnjù jiǎnchá jiéguǒ zuòchū jīngzhǔn pànduàn, bù néng zhǐ píng jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Doctors need to make accurate judgements based on test results, not merely rely on experience.

sentences.chinese: 为了提高预测的精准程度，研究人员增加了更多样本。
sentences.traditional: 為了提高預測的精準程度，研究人員增加了更多樣本。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tígāo yùcè de jīngzhǔn chéngdù, yánjiū rényuán zēngjiā le gèng duō yàngběn.
sentences.translation: To improve the precision of the prediction, the researchers added more samples.

sentences.chinese: 村里的老井已经不用了，但仍被保留下来作为历史记忆。
sentences.traditional: 村裡的老井已經不用了，但仍被保留下來作為歷史記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Cūn lǐ de lǎo jǐng yǐjīng bú yòng le, dàn réng bèi bǎoliú xiàlái zuòwéi lìshǐ jìyì.
sentences.translation: The old well in the village is no longer used, but it has still been preserved as a historical memory.

sentences.chinese: 连续干旱后，这口井的水位下降得十分明显。
sentences.traditional: 連續乾旱後，這口井的水位下降得十分明顯。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù gānhàn hòu, zhè kǒu jǐng de shuǐwèi xiàjiàng de shífēn míngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: After the continuous drought, the water level of this well dropped very noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 工作人员在井边设置了围栏，以免孩子靠近发生危险。
sentences.traditional: 工作人員在井邊設置了圍欄，以免孩子靠近發生危險。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngzuò rényuán zài jǐng biān shèzhì le wéilán, yǐmiǎn háizi kàojìn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
sentences.translation: Staff set up a fence beside the well to prevent children from approaching and being put in danger.

sentences.chinese: 系统多次警告用户密码过于简单，但他一直没有修改。
sentences.traditional: 系統多次警告用戶密碼過於簡單，但他一直沒有修改。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng duō cì jǐnggào yònghù mìmǎ guòyú jiǎndān, dàn tā yìzhí méiyǒu xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: The system repeatedly warned the user that the password was too simple, but he never changed it.

sentences.chinese: 老师警告学生不要随意传播未经证实的消息。
sentences.traditional: 老師警告學生不要隨意傳播未經證實的消息。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jǐnggào xuéshēng bú yào suíyì chuánbō wèijīng zhèngshí de xiāoxi.
sentences.translation: The teacher warned the students not to spread unverified information casually.

sentences.chinese: 气象部门提前发布警告，提醒居民减少不必要的外出。
sentences.traditional: 氣象部門提前發布警告，提醒居民減少不必要的外出。
sentences.pinyin: Qìxiàng bùmén tíqián fābù jǐnggào, tíxǐng jūmín jiǎnshǎo bù bìyào de wàichū.
sentences.translation: The meteorological department issued a warning in advance, reminding residents to reduce unnecessary trips outside.

sentences.chinese: 这条河两岸的景观经过改造后，成了市民散步的好地方。
sentences.traditional: 這條河兩岸的景觀經過改造後，成了市民散步的好地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé liǎng àn de jǐngguān jīngguò gǎizào hòu, chéng le shìmín sànbù de hǎo dìfang.
sentences.translation: After the landscape on both sides of the river was improved, it became a good place for residents to walk.

sentences.chinese: 设计师希望建筑能够融入周围景观，而不是显得突兀。
sentences.traditional: 設計師希望建築能夠融入周圍景觀，而不是顯得突兀。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī xīwàng jiànzhù nénggòu róngrù zhōuwéi jǐngguān, ér bú shì xiǎnde tūwù.
sentences.translation: The designer hopes the building can blend into the surrounding landscape rather than look abrupt.

sentences.chinese: 从山顶望去，城市夜晚的景观格外壮观。
sentences.traditional: 從山頂望去，城市夜晚的景觀格外壯觀。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng shāndǐng wàng qù, chéngshì yèwǎn de jǐngguān géwài zhuàngguān.
sentences.translation: Looking from the mountain top, the city’s night view is especially magnificent.

sentences.chinese: 洪水退去后，街道上一片混乱的景象令人心痛。
sentences.traditional: 洪水退去後，街道上一片混亂的景象令人心痛。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngshuǐ tuìqù hòu, jiēdào shàng yí piàn hùnluàn de jǐngxiàng lìng rén xīntòng.
sentences.translation: After the flood receded, the chaotic scene on the streets was heartbreaking.

sentences.chinese: 春节前的市场十分热闹，到处都是人们采购年货的景象。
sentences.traditional: 春節前的市場十分熱鬧，到處都是人們採購年貨的景象。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qián de shìchǎng shífēn rènào, dàochù dōu shì rénmen cǎigòu niánhuò de jǐngxiàng.
sentences.translation: The market before Spring Festival was very lively, with scenes of people buying New Year goods everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 清晨的雾慢慢散开，湖面呈现出宁静而开阔的景象。
sentences.traditional: 清晨的霧慢慢散開，湖面呈現出寧靜而開闊的景象。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén de wù mànmàn sànkāi, húmiàn chéngxiàn chū níngjìng ér kāikuò de jǐngxiàng.
sentences.translation: As the morning mist slowly dispersed, the lake presented a quiet and open scene.

sentences.chinese: 长期低头工作容易造成颈椎不适，需要定时活动。
sentences.traditional: 長期低頭工作容易造成頸椎不適，需要定時活動。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī dītóu gōngzuò róngyì zàochéng jǐngzhuī bùshì, xūyào dìngshí huódòng.
sentences.translation: Working with your head bent down for long periods can easily cause cervical spine discomfort, so regular movement is needed.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他注意坐姿，避免颈椎承受过大压力。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他注意坐姿，避免頸椎承受過大壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā zhùyì zuòzī, bìmiǎn jǐngzhuī chéngshòu guò dà yālì.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him to pay attention to his sitting posture and avoid putting too much pressure on the cervical spine.

sentences.chinese: 这套训练主要帮助放松肩膀和颈椎，适合办公室人群。
sentences.traditional: 這套訓練主要幫助放鬆肩膀和頸椎，適合辦公室人群。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xùnliàn zhǔyào bāngzhù fàngsōng jiānbǎng hé jǐngzhuī, shìhé bàngōngshì rénqún.
sentences.translation: This set of exercises mainly helps relax the shoulders and cervical spine, and is suitable for office workers.

sentences.chinese: 扣除各项成本后，公司今年的净利润仍然保持增长。
sentences.traditional: 扣除各項成本後，公司今年的淨利潤仍然保持增長。
sentences.pinyin: Kòuchú gè xiàng chéngběn hòu, gōngsī jīnnián de jìng lìrùn réngrán bǎochí zēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: After deducting all costs, the company’s net profit still maintained growth this year.

sentences.chinese: 这间屋子虽然面积不大，但收拾得很净，让人感觉舒服。
sentences.traditional: 這間屋子雖然面積不大，但收拾得很淨，讓人感覺舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiān wūzi suīrán miànjī bú dà, dàn shōushi de hěn jìng, ràng rén gǎnjué shūfu.
sentences.translation: Although this room is not large, it has been tidied very cleanly, making people feel comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 会议净讨论细节，却迟迟没有确定最终方案。
sentences.traditional: 會議淨討論細節，卻遲遲沒有確定最終方案。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jìng tǎolùn xìjié, què chíchí méiyǒu quèdìng zuìzhōng fāngàn.
sentences.translation: The meeting kept discussing only the details, but still did not settle on the final plan.

sentences.chinese: 几家企业在同一领域竞赛，推动了技术快速进步。
sentences.traditional: 幾家企業在同一領域競賽，推動了技術快速進步。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐ jiā qǐyè zài tóng yī lǐngyù jìngsài, tuīdòng le jìshù kuàisù jìnbù.
sentences.translation: Several companies compete in the same field, driving rapid technological progress.

sentences.chinese: 年轻选手在国际舞台上竞赛，不仅靠实力，也靠心理稳定。
sentences.traditional: 年輕選手在國際舞臺上競賽，不僅靠實力，也靠心理穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng xuǎnshǒu zài guójì wǔtái shàng jìngsài, bùjǐn kào shílì, yě kào xīnlǐ wěndìng.
sentences.translation: When young athletes compete on the international stage, they rely not only on ability but also on mental stability.

sentences.chinese: 团队之间良性竞赛，可以激发更多创新想法。
sentences.traditional: 團隊之間良性競賽，可以激發更多創新想法。
sentences.pinyin: Tuánduì zhījiān liángxìng jìngsài, kěyǐ jīfā gèng duō chuàngxīn xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: Healthy competition between teams can inspire more innovative ideas.

sentences.chinese: 导演用一个长镜头表现人物内心的变化。
sentences.traditional: 導演用一個長鏡頭表現人物內心的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn yòng yí ge cháng jìngtóu biǎoxiàn rénwù nèixīn de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The director used a long shot to show the character’s inner changes.

sentences.chinese: 摄影师调整镜头角度，想捕捉更自然的表情。
sentences.traditional: 攝影師調整鏡頭角度，想捕捉更自然的表情。
sentences.pinyin: Shèyǐngshī tiáozhěng jìngtóu jiǎodù, xiǎng bǔzhuō gèng zìrán de biǎoqíng.
sentences.translation: The photographer adjusted the lens angle to capture a more natural expression.

sentences.chinese: 新闻镜头记录了救援人员进入灾区的全过程。
sentences.traditional: 新聞鏡頭記錄了救援人員進入災區的全過程。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnwén jìngtóu jìlù le jiùyuán rényuán jìnrù zāiqū de quán guòchéng.
sentences.translation: The news footage recorded the whole process of rescue workers entering the disaster area.

sentences.chinese: 双方因合同细节产生纠纷，最终通过调解解决。
sentences.traditional: 雙方因合同細節產生糾紛，最終通過調解解決。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng yīn hétong xìjié chǎnshēng jiūfēn, zuìzhōng tōngguò tiáojiě jiějué.
sentences.translation: The two sides had a dispute over contract details and finally resolved it through mediation.

sentences.chinese: 社区设立了咨询窗口，专门处理邻里之间的纠纷。
sentences.traditional: 社區設立了諮詢窗口，專門處理鄰里之間的糾紛。
sentences.pinyin: Shèqū shèlì le zīxún chuāngkǒu, zhuānmén chǔlǐ línlǐ zhījiān de jiūfēn.
sentences.translation: The community set up an advice desk specifically to handle disputes between neighbours.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免纠纷，所有费用都应提前写进协议。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免糾紛，所有費用都應提前寫進協議。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn jiūfēn, suǒyǒu fèiyòng dōu yīng tíqián xiě jìn xiéyì.
sentences.translation: To avoid disputes, all fees should be written into the agreement in advance.

sentences.chinese: 老师耐心地纠正了我的发音，还给出了具体的练习方法。
sentences.traditional: 老師耐心地糾正了我的發音，還給出了具體的練習方法。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī nàixīn de jiūzhèng le wǒ de fāyīn, hái gěi chū le jùtǐ de liànxí fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: The teacher patiently corrected my pronunciation and also gave me specific practice methods.

sentences.chinese: 数据出现偏差后，团队立即纠正模型，并重新检验结果。
sentences.traditional: 數據出現偏差後，團隊立即糾正模型，並重新檢驗結果。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù chūxiàn piānchā hòu, tuánduì lìjí jiūzhèng móxíng, bìng chóngxīn jiǎnyàn jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: After a deviation appeared in the data, the team immediately corrected the model and tested the results again.

sentences.chinese: 他愿意公开纠正错误，这让合作伙伴更信任他。
sentences.traditional: 他願意公開糾正錯誤，這讓合作夥伴更信任他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuànyì gōngkāi jiūzhèng cuòwù, zhè ràng hézuò huǒbàn gèng xìnrèn tā.
sentences.translation: He is willing to correct mistakes openly, which makes his partners trust him more.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒我们，酒精只能用于外部消毒，不能随便饮用。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒我們，酒精只能用於外部消毒，不能隨便飲用。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒmen, jiǔjīng zhǐ néng yòng yú wàibù xiāodú, bùnéng suíbiàn yǐnyòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded us that alcohol can only be used for external disinfection and must not be drunk casually.

sentences.chinese: 这种消毒液的酒精含量超过百分之七十。
sentences.traditional: 這種消毒液的酒精含量超過百分之七十。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiāodúyè de jiǔjīng hánliàng chāoguò bǎi fēn zhī qīshí.
sentences.translation: The alcohol content of this disinfectant is over seventy per cent.

sentences.chinese: 长期过量摄入酒精会严重损害肝脏。
sentences.traditional: 長期過量攝入酒精會嚴重損害肝臟。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī guòliàng shèrù jiǔjīng huì yánzhòng sǔnhài gānzàng.
sentences.translation: Long-term excessive intake of alcohol can seriously damage the liver.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅的酒水价格偏高，点餐前最好先看清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的酒水價格偏高，點餐前最好先看清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de jiǔshuǐ jiàgé piān gāo, diǎncān qián zuìhǎo xiān kàn qīngchǔ.
sentences.translation: The alcoholic drinks in this restaurant are rather expensive, so it is best to check carefully before ordering.

sentences.chinese: 活动费用不包含酒水，客人需要另行购买。
sentences.traditional: 活動費用不包含酒水，客人需要另行購買。
sentences.pinyin: Huódòng fèiyòng bù bāohán jiǔshuǐ, kèrén xūyào lìngwài gòumǎi.
sentences.translation: The event fee does not include alcoholic beverages, so guests need to buy them separately.

sentences.chinese: 为了照顾不喝酒的人，主办方把酒水单独列出来。
sentences.traditional: 為了照顧不喝酒的人，主辦方把酒水單獨列出來。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile zhàogù bù hējiǔ de rén, zhǔbànfāng bǎ jiǔshuǐ dāndú liè chūlái.
sentences.translation: To consider people who do not drink, the organiser listed the alcoholic drinks separately.

sentences.chinese: 她目前就读于上海一所以医学闻名的大学。
sentences.traditional: 她目前就讀於上海一所以醫學聞名的大學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mùqián jiùdú yú Shànghǎi yì suǒ yǐ yīxué wénmíng de dàxué.
sentences.translation: She is currently studying at a university in Shanghai known for medicine.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校为外地学生提供宿舍，方便他们在本地就读。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校為外地學生提供宿舍，方便他們在本地就讀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào wèi wàidì xuéshēng tígōng sùshè, fāngbiàn tāmen zài běndì jiùdú.
sentences.translation: This school provides dormitories for students from other places, making it easier for them to study locally.

sentences.chinese: 他曾在德国就读三年，因此对当地教育制度很熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 他曾在德國就讀三年，因此對當地教育制度很熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng zài Déguó jiùdú sān nián, yīncǐ duì dāngdì jiàoyù zhìdù hěn shúxī.
sentences.translation: He once studied in Germany for three years, so he is very familiar with the local education system.

sentences.chinese: 舅舅从小就鼓励我读书，所以我一直很尊敬他。
sentences.traditional: 舅舅從小就鼓勵我讀書，所以我一直很尊敬他。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùjiu cóng xiǎo jiù gǔlì wǒ dúshū, suǒyǐ wǒ yìzhí hěn zūnjìng tā.
sentences.translation: My uncle encouraged me to study from a young age, so I have always respected him.

sentences.chinese: 每年春节，我都会和舅舅谈一谈家里的近况。
sentences.traditional: 每年春節，我都會和舅舅談一談家裡的近況。
sentences.pinyin: Měinián Chūnjié, wǒ dōu huì hé jiùjiu tán yì tán jiālǐ de jìnkuàng.
sentences.translation: Every Spring Festival, I talk with my uncle about how things are going in the family.

sentences.chinese: 他把创业计划先拿给舅舅看，希望听到真诚的意见。
sentences.traditional: 他把創業計劃先拿給舅舅看，希望聽到真誠的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ chuàngyè jìhuà xiān ná gěi jiùjiu kàn, xīwàng tīng dào zhēnchéng de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: He first showed his business plan to his uncle, hoping to hear sincere advice.

sentences.chinese: 在野外突然失温时，这种急救知识真的能救命。
sentences.traditional: 在野外突然失溫時，這種急救知識真的能救命。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yěwài túrán shīwēn shí, zhè zhǒng jíjiù zhīshi zhēn de néng jiùmìng.
sentences.translation: When hypothermia suddenly occurs outdoors, this kind of first-aid knowledge can genuinely save lives.

sentences.chinese: 对急救人员来说，最初几分钟往往决定能不能救命。
sentences.traditional: 對急救人員來說，最初幾分鐘往往決定能不能救命。
sentences.pinyin: Duì jíjiù rényuán lái shuō, zuìchū jǐ fēnzhōng wǎngwǎng juédìng néng bùnéng jiùmìng.
sentences.translation: For first responders, the first few minutes often determine whether a life can be saved.

sentences.chinese: 他立即拨打急救电话，不是多管闲事，而是在救命。
sentences.traditional: 他立即撥打急救電話，不是多管閒事，而是在救命。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lìjí bōdǎ jíjiù diànhuà, bùshì duōguǎn xiánshì, ér shì zài jiùmìng.
sentences.translation: He called the emergency number immediately; he was not interfering, he was saving a life.

sentences.chinese: 就算预算有限，我们也不能降低安全标准。
sentences.traditional: 就算預算有限，我們也不能降低安全標準。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, wǒmen yě bùnéng jiàngdī ānquán biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: Even if the budget is limited, we cannot lower safety standards.

sentences.chinese: 就算结果不理想，这次尝试也积累了宝贵经验。
sentences.traditional: 就算結果不理想，這次嘗試也積累了寶貴經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùsuàn jiéguǒ bù lǐxiǎng, zhè cì chángshì yě jīlěi le bǎoguì jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Even if the result is not ideal, this attempt has still built up valuable experience.

sentences.chinese: 就算没有人监督，他也会按时完成任务。
sentences.traditional: 就算沒有人監督，他也會按時完成任務。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùsuàn méiyǒu rén jiāndū, tā yě huì ànshí wánchéng rènwù.
sentences.translation: Even if no one supervises him, he will still complete the task on time.

sentences.chinese: 洪水发生后，救援队连夜赶往受灾村庄。
sentences.traditional: 洪水發生後，救援隊連夜趕往受災村莊。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngshuǐ fāshēng hòu, jiùyuán duì liányè gǎnwǎng shòuzāi cūnzhuāng.
sentences.translation: After the flood occurred, the rescue team rushed to the affected village overnight.

sentences.chinese: 由于道路被堵，直升机参与了这次救援行动。
sentences.traditional: 由於道路被堵，直升機參與了這次救援行動。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú dàolù bèi dǔ, zhíshēngjī cānyù le zhè cì jiùyuán xíngdòng.
sentences.translation: Because the roads were blocked, helicopters took part in this rescue operation.

sentences.chinese: 他们利用无人机寻找被困人员，提高了救援效率。
sentences.traditional: 他們利用無人機尋找被困人員，提高了救援效率。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen lìyòng wúrénjī xúnzhǎo bèikùn rényuán, tígāo le jiùyuán xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: They used drones to search for trapped people and improved rescue efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 地震发生后，各地志愿者迅速赶来救灾。
sentences.traditional: 地震發生後，各地志願者迅速趕來救災。
sentences.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng hòu, gèdì zhìyuànzhě xùnsù gǎnlái jiùzāi.
sentences.translation: After the earthquake occurred, volunteers from many places quickly came to provide disaster relief.

sentences.chinese: 政府建立了专门的救灾物资仓库，应对突发灾害。
sentences.traditional: 政府建立了專門的救災物資倉庫，應對突發災害。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiànlì le zhuānmén de jiùzāi wùzī cāngkù, yìngduì tūfā zāihài.
sentences.translation: The government set up dedicated warehouses for disaster-relief supplies to deal with sudden disasters.

sentences.chinese: 救灾不仅要抢时间，也要保证物资分配公平。
sentences.traditional: 救災不僅要搶時間，也要保證物資分配公平。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùzāi bùjǐn yào qiǎng shíjiān, yě yào bǎozhèng wùzī fēnpèi gōngpíng.
sentences.translation: Disaster relief must not only race against time, but also ensure fair distribution of supplies.

sentences.chinese: 这个基金会长期救助失学儿童。
sentences.traditional: 這個基金會長期救助失學兒童。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jījīn huì chángqī jiùzhù shīxué értóng.
sentences.translation: This foundation has long helped children who have dropped out of school.

sentences.chinese: 遇到受伤动物时，请联系专业机构救助。
sentences.traditional: 遇到受傷動物時，請聯繫專業機構救助。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào shòushāng dòngwù shí, qǐng liánxì zhuānyè jīgòu jiùzhù.
sentences.translation: When you encounter an injured animal, please contact a professional organisation for help.

sentences.chinese: 社区为独居老人提供紧急救助服务。
sentences.traditional: 社區為獨居老人提供緊急救助服務。
sentences.pinyin: Shèqū wèi dújū lǎorén tígōng jǐnjí jiùzhù fúwù.
sentences.translation: The community provides emergency assistance services for elderly people living alone.

sentences.chinese: 这局棋下到最后，他才发现自己已经没有退路了。
sentences.traditional: 這局棋下到最後，他才發現自己已經沒有退路了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jú qí xià dào zuìhòu, tā cái fāxiàn zìjǐ yǐjīng méiyǒu tuìlù le.
sentences.translation: Only at the end of this game of chess did he realise that he already had no way out.

sentences.chinese: 比赛第一局打得很胶着，双方比分一直没有拉开。
sentences.traditional: 比賽第一局打得很膠著，雙方比分一直沒有拉開。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài dì yī jú dǎ de hěn jiāozhuó, shuāngfāng bǐfēn yìzhí méiyǒu lākāi.
sentences.translation: The first set of the match was very close, and neither side managed to pull ahead in the score.

sentences.chinese: 我们只剩下一局，如果再输就没有机会晋级了。
sentences.traditional: 我們只剩下一局，如果再輸就沒有機會晉級了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǐ shèng xià yì jú, rúguǒ zài shū jiù méiyǒu jīhuì jìnjí le.
sentences.translation: We only have one game left; if we lose again, we will have no chance to advance.

sentences.chinese: 教育局发布了新的通知，要求学校加强心理健康教育。
sentences.traditional: 教育局發布了新的通知，要求學校加強心理健康教育。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù jú fābù le xīn de tōngzhī, yāoqiú xuéxiào jiāqiáng xīnlǐ jiànkāng jiàoyù.
sentences.translation: The education bureau issued a new notice requiring schools to strengthen mental-health education.

sentences.chinese: 他刚到局里工作时，对各项流程还不太熟悉。
sentences.traditional: 他剛到局裡工作時，對各項流程還不太熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng dào jú lǐ gōngzuò shí, duì gè xiàng liúchéng hái bú tài shúxī.
sentences.translation: When he had just started working in the bureau, he was still not very familiar with the various procedures.

sentences.chinese: 环保局将对排污严重的企业进行专项检查。
sentences.traditional: 環保局將對排污嚴重的企業進行專項檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Huánbǎo jú jiāng duì páiwū yánzhòng de qǐyè jìnxíng zhuānxiàng jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The environmental protection bureau will carry out special inspections of companies with serious pollution emissions.

sentences.chinese: 秋天一到，公园里的菊花便开得格外热闹。
sentences.traditional: 秋天一到，公園裡的菊花便開得格外熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān yí dào, gōngyuán lǐ de júhuā biàn kāi de géwài rènào.
sentences.translation: As soon as autumn arrives, the chrysanthemums in the park bloom especially vividly.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶喜欢把晒干的菊花泡成茶，饭后慢慢喝。
sentences.traditional: 奶奶喜歡把曬乾的菊花泡成茶，飯後慢慢喝。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai xǐhuān bǎ shài gān de júhuā pào chéng chá, fàn hòu mànmàn hē.
sentences.translation: Grandma likes to make tea from dried chrysanthemums and drink it slowly after meals.

sentences.chinese: 这幅画中的菊花虽然颜色淡，却显得很有精神。
sentences.traditional: 這幅畫中的菊花雖然顏色淡，卻顯得很有精神。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú huà zhōng de júhuā suīrán yánsè dàn, què xiǎnde hěn yǒu jīngshén.
sentences.translation: Although the chrysanthemums in this painting are lightly coloured, they look full of vitality.

sentences.chinese: 谈判进入关键阶段，双方都不愿意让局面失控。
sentences.traditional: 談判進入關鍵階段，雙方都不願意讓局面失控。
sentences.pinyin: Tánpàn jìnrù guānjiàn jiēduàn, shuāngfāng dōu bú yuànyì ràng júmiàn shīkòng.
sentences.translation: The negotiations have entered a critical stage, and neither side wants the situation to get out of control.

sentences.chinese: 新政策推出后，市场局面出现了明显变化。
sentences.traditional: 新政策推出後，市場局面出現了明顯變化。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè tuīchū hòu, shìchǎng júmiàn chūxiàn le míngxiǎn biànhuà.
sentences.translation: After the new policy was introduced, the market situation changed noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 面对复杂的局面，领导必须保持冷静判断。
sentences.traditional: 面對複雜的局面，領導必須保持冷靜判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì fùzá de júmiàn, lǐngdǎo bìxū bǎochí lěngjìng pànduàn.
sentences.translation: When facing a complex situation, leaders must maintain calm judgement.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究局限于小样本数据，还需要进一步验证。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究局限於小樣本數據，還需要進一步驗證。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū júxiàn yú xiǎo yàngběn shùjù, hái xūyào jìnyíbù yànzhèng.
sentences.translation: This study is limited to small-sample data and still needs further verification.

sentences.chinese: 传统经验可能会局限我们的视野，所以也要重视新证据。
sentences.traditional: 傳統經驗可能會局限我們的視野，所以也要重視新證據。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng jīngyàn kěnéng huì júxiàn wǒmen de shìyě, suǒyǐ yě yào zhòngshì xīn zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: Traditional experience may limit our perspective, so we should also value new evidence.

sentences.chinese: 他的专业背景并没有局限他的职业选择。
sentences.traditional: 他的專業背景並沒有局限他的職業選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zhuānyè bèijǐng bìng méiyǒu júxiàn tā de zhíyè xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: His professional background has not limited his career choices.

sentences.chinese: 他突然辞职的举动让整个团队都感到意外。
sentences.traditional: 他突然辭職的舉動讓整個團隊都感到意外。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán cízhí de jǔdòng ràng zhěnggè tuánduì dōu gǎndào yìwài.
sentences.translation: His sudden move to resign made the whole team feel surprised.

sentences.chinese: 这个小小的举动显示出他对老人很尊重。
sentences.traditional: 這個小小的舉動顯示出他對老人很尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo xiǎo de jǔdòng xiǎnshì chū tā duì lǎorén hěn zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: This small action shows that he is very respectful towards elderly people.

sentences.chinese: 公司公开道歉的举动缓和了公众的不满情绪。
sentences.traditional: 公司公開道歉的舉動緩和了公眾的不滿情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī gōngkāi dàoqiàn de jǔdòng huǎnhé le gōngzhòng de bùmǎn qíngxù.
sentences.translation: The company’s public apology helped ease the public’s dissatisfaction.

sentences.chinese: 这个剧本虽然情节简单，却把人物关系写得很细腻。
sentences.traditional: 這個劇本雖然情節簡單，卻把人物關係寫得很細膩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jùběn suīrán qíngjié jiǎndān, què bǎ rénwù guānxì xiě de hěn xìnì.
sentences.translation: Although this script has a simple plot, it portrays the relationships between the characters very delicately.

sentences.chinese: 导演要求演员先熟悉剧本，再讨论表演方式。
sentences.traditional: 導演要求演員先熟悉劇本，再討論表演方式。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn yāoqiú yǎnyuán xiān shúxī jùběn, zài tǎolùn biǎoyǎn fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The director asked the actors to become familiar with the script first, and then discuss how to perform it.

sentences.chinese: 他根据真实案件改写了剧本，使故事更有说服力。
sentences.traditional: 他根據真實案件改寫了劇本，使故事更有說服力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gēnjù zhēnshí ànjiàn gǎixiě le jùběn, shǐ gùshi gèng yǒu shuōfúlì.
sentences.translation: He rewrote the script based on a real case, making the story more convincing.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，许多居民聚集在临时安置点等待通知。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，許多居民聚集在臨時安置點等待通知。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, xǔduō jūmín jùjí zài línshí ānzhìdiǎn děngdài tōngzhī.
sentences.translation: After the heavy rain, many residents gathered at the temporary resettlement site to wait for notices.

sentences.chinese: 社交平台让相同兴趣的人更容易聚集起来。
sentences.traditional: 社交平臺讓相同興趣的人更容易聚集起來。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjiāo píngtái ràng xiāngtóng xìngqù de rén gèng róngyì jùjí qǐlái.
sentences.translation: Social platforms make it easier for people with the same interests to gather together.

sentences.chinese: 大量资金开始向新能源产业聚集。
sentences.traditional: 大量資金開始向新能源產業聚集。
sentences.pinyin: Dàliàng zījīn kāishǐ xiàng xīn néngyuán chǎnyè jùjí.
sentences.translation: Large amounts of capital have begun to gather in the new-energy industry.

sentences.chinese: 他加入了学校的辩论俱乐部，表达能力提高了很多。
sentences.traditional: 他加入了學校的辯論俱樂部，表達能力提高了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiārù le xuéxiào de biànlùn jùlèbù, biǎodá nénglì tígāo le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: He joined the school debating club, and his ability to express himself improved a lot.

sentences.chinese: 这个俱乐部定期组织公益活动，不只是为了娱乐。
sentences.traditional: 這個俱樂部定期組織公益活動，不只是為了娛樂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jùlèbù dìngqī zǔzhī gōngyì huódòng, bù zhǐshì wèile yúlè.
sentences.translation: This club regularly organises public-interest activities; it is not just for entertainment.

sentences.chinese: 足球俱乐部宣布更换主教练，引起了球迷热议。
sentences.traditional: 足球俱樂部宣布更換主教練，引起了球迷熱議。
sentences.pinyin: Zúqiú jùlèbù xuānbù gēnghuàn zhǔjiàoliàn, yǐnqǐ le qiúmí rèyì.
sentences.translation: The football club announced a change of head coach, causing heated discussion among fans.

sentences.chinese: 地震发生时，整栋楼都在剧烈摇晃。
sentences.traditional: 地震發生時，整棟樓都在劇烈搖晃。
sentences.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng shí, zhěng dòng lóu dōu zài jùliè yáohuàng.
sentences.translation: When the earthquake occurred, the whole building was shaking violently.

sentences.chinese: 运动后不要立刻喝冰水，以免身体产生剧烈反应。
sentences.traditional: 運動後不要立刻喝冰水，以免身體產生劇烈反應。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng hòu bú yào lìkè hē bīngshuǐ, yǐmiǎn shēntǐ chǎnshēng jùliè fǎnyìng.
sentences.translation: Do not drink ice water immediately after exercise, in case your body has a strong reaction.

sentences.chinese: 价格剧烈波动会影响投资者的判断。
sentences.traditional: 價格劇烈波動會影響投資者的判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé jùliè bōdòng huì yǐngxiǎng tóuzīzhě de pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Sharp price fluctuations can affect investors’ judgement.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定向受灾地区捐款，帮助居民重建家园。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定向受災地區捐款，幫助居民重建家園。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng xiàng shòuzāi dìqū juānkuǎn, bāngzhù jūmín chóngjiàn jiāyuán.
sentences.translation: The company decided to donate money to the disaster-hit area to help residents rebuild their homes.

sentences.chinese: 这笔捐款将用于购买急救设备和生活物资。
sentences.traditional: 這筆捐款將用於購買急救設備和生活物資。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ juānkuǎn jiāng yòng yú gòumǎi jíjiù shèbèi hé shēnghuó wùzī.
sentences.translation: This donation will be used to buy first-aid equipment and daily supplies.

sentences.chinese: 他没有公开自己的捐款金额，只希望能尽一份力。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有公開自己的捐款金額，只希望能盡一份力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu gōngkāi zìjǐ de juānkuǎn jīn'é, zhǐ xīwàng néng jìn yí fèn lì.
sentences.translation: He did not disclose the amount of his donation; he only hoped to do his bit.

sentences.chinese: 医院接受了企业捐赠的检测设备，提高了诊断效率。
sentences.traditional: 醫院接受了企業捐贈的檢測設備，提高了診斷效率。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn jiēshòu le qǐyè juānzèng de jiǎncè shèbèi, tígāo le zhěnduàn xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The hospital accepted testing equipment donated by a company, improving diagnostic efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 他们把旧书捐赠给乡村学校，希望孩子们有更多阅读机会。
sentences.traditional: 他們把舊書捐贈給鄉村學校，希望孩子們有更多閱讀機會。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bǎ jiù shū juānzèng gěi xiāngcūn xuéxiào, xīwàng háizimen yǒu gèng duō yuèdú jīhuì.
sentences.translation: They donated old books to a village school, hoping the children would have more chances to read.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆鼓励市民捐赠有历史价值的物品。
sentences.traditional: 博物館鼓勵市民捐贈有歷史價值的物品。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn gǔlì shìmín juānzèng yǒu lìshǐ jiàzhí de wùpǐn.
sentences.translation: The museum encourages residents to donate items of historical value.

sentences.chinese: 她把海报卷起来，放进纸筒里带走。
sentences.traditional: 她把海報捲起來，放進紙筒裡帶走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ hǎibào juǎn qǐlái, fàng jìn zhǐtǒng lǐ dài zǒu.
sentences.translation: She rolled up the poster and put it into a paper tube to take away.

sentences.chinese: 风太大，窗帘被卷到窗外，差点挂住。
sentences.traditional: 風太大，窗簾被捲到窗外，差點掛住。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng tài dà, chuānglián bèi juǎn dào chuāng wài, chàdiǎn guà zhù.
sentences.translation: The wind was so strong that the curtain was blown and rolled outside the window, almost getting caught.

sentences.chinese: 桌上放着一卷胶带，正好可以用来封箱。
sentences.traditional: 桌上放著一捲膠帶，正好可以用來封箱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng fàng zhe yì juǎn jiāodài, zhènghǎo kěyǐ yòng lái fēng xiāng.
sentences.translation: There is a roll of tape on the table, just right for sealing the box.

sentences.chinese: 这套小说一共有三卷，内容围绕同一个家族展开。
sentences.traditional: 這套小說一共有三卷，內容圍繞同一個家族展開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xiǎoshuō yí gòng yǒu sān juàn, nèiróng wéirào tóng yí gè jiāzú zhǎnkāi.
sentences.translation: This set of novels has three volumes in total, with the content centred on the same family.

sentences.chinese: 论文第二卷主要收录了调查数据和访谈记录。
sentences.traditional: 論文第二卷主要收錄了調查數據和訪談記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Lùnwén dì èr juàn zhǔyào shōulù le diàochá shùjù hé fǎngtán jìlù.
sentences.translation: The second volume of the thesis mainly includes survey data and interview records.

sentences.chinese: 老师让我们阅读第一卷的前两章，再写读书报告。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓我們閱讀第一卷的前兩章，再寫讀書報告。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen yuèdú dì yī juàn de qián liǎng zhāng, zài xiě dúshū bàogào.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to read the first two chapters of Volume One and then write a book report.

sentences.chinese: 重大项目启动前，管理层必须进行充分的决策讨论。
sentences.traditional: 重大項目啟動前，管理層必須進行充分的決策討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhòngdà xiàngmù qǐdòng qián, guǎnlǐcéng bìxū jìnxíng chōngfèn de juécè tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: Before a major project starts, management must hold thorough decision-making discussions.

sentences.chinese: 数据越完整，决策就越不容易受到个人情绪影响。
sentences.traditional: 數據越完整，決策就越不容易受到個人情緒影響。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù yuè wánzhěng, juécè jiù yuè bù róngyì shòudào gèrén qíngxù yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The more complete the data is, the less likely decision-making is to be influenced by personal emotions.

sentences.chinese: 是否扩建工厂，还要由董事会决策。
sentences.traditional: 是否擴建工廠，還要由董事會決策。
sentences.pinyin: Shìfǒu kuòjiàn gōngchǎng, hái yào yóu dǒngshìhuì juécè.
sentences.translation: Whether to expand the factory still needs to be decided by the board of directors.

sentences.chinese: 多次求助无果后，他一度感到绝望。
sentences.traditional: 多次求助無果後，他一度感到絕望。
sentences.pinyin: Duō cì qiúzhù wú guǒ hòu, tā yí dù gǎndào juéwàng.
sentences.translation: After seeking help many times without success, he once felt despair.

sentences.chinese: 即便处在绝望之中，她仍然没有放弃寻找出路。
sentences.traditional: 即便處在絕望之中，她仍然沒有放棄尋找出路。
sentences.pinyin: Jíbiàn chǔ zài juéwàng zhī zhōng, tā réngrán méiyǒu fàngqì xúnzhǎo chūlù.
sentences.translation: Even though she was in despair, she still did not give up looking for a way out.

sentences.chinese: 队友的鼓励让他从绝望中慢慢恢复过来。
sentences.traditional: 隊友的鼓勵讓他從絕望中慢慢恢復過來。
sentences.pinyin: Duìyǒu de gǔlì ràng tā cóng juéwàng zhōng mànmàn huīfù guòlái.
sentences.translation: His teammate’s encouragement helped him slowly recover from despair.

sentences.chinese: 军队迅速展开救援，确保道路恢复通行。
sentences.traditional: 軍隊迅速展開救援，確保道路恢復通行。
sentences.pinyin: Jūnduì xùnsù zhǎnkāi jiùyuán, quèbǎo dàolù huīfù tōngxíng.
sentences.translation: The army quickly launched a rescue operation to ensure the roads were reopened.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片记录了军队在边境巡逻的日常。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片記錄了軍隊在邊境巡邏的日常。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jìlù le jūnduì zài biānjìng xúnluó de rìcháng.
sentences.translation: This documentary records the army’s daily border patrols.

sentences.chinese: 灾害发生后，军队和地方政府共同转移受困群众。
sentences.traditional: 災害發生後，軍隊和地方政府共同轉移受困群眾。
sentences.pinyin: Zāihài fāshēng hòu, jūnduì hé dìfāng zhèngfǔ gòngtóng zhuǎnyí shòukùn qúnzhòng.
sentences.translation: After the disaster occurred, the army and local government jointly evacuated trapped residents.

sentences.chinese: 许多军人在退役后继续从事公益服务。
sentences.traditional: 許多軍人在退役後繼續從事公益服務。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō jūnrén zài tuìyì hòu jìxù cóngshì gōngyì fúwù.
sentences.translation: Many soldiers continue to take part in public service after leaving the military.

sentences.chinese: 他从小敬佩军人，希望长大后保卫国家。
sentences.traditional: 他從小敬佩軍人，希望長大後保衛國家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jìngpèi jūnrén, xīwàng zhǎngdà hòu bǎowèi guójiā.
sentences.translation: Since childhood he has admired soldiers and hopes to defend the country when he grows up.

sentences.chinese: 这位军人在危急时刻救出了被困儿童。
sentences.traditional: 這位軍人在危急時刻救出了被困兒童。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jūnrén zài wēijí shíkè jiù chū le bèikùn értóng.
sentences.translation: This soldier rescued the trapped child at a critical moment.

sentences.chinese: 搅拌时要让调料分布均匀，味道才不会忽淡忽重。
sentences.traditional: 攪拌時要讓調料分布均勻，味道才不會忽淡忽重。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎobàn shí yào ràng tiáoliào fēnbù jūnyún, wèidào cái bú huì hū dàn hū zhòng.
sentences.translation: When stirring, make sure the seasoning is evenly distributed so the flavour is not sometimes weak and sometimes strong.

sentences.chinese: 这块布的颜色染得很均匀，看不出明显色差。
sentences.traditional: 這塊布的顏色染得很均勻，看不出明顯色差。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài bù de yánsè rǎn de hěn jūnyún, kàn bù chū míngxiǎn sèchā.
sentences.translation: The colour of this cloth has been dyed very evenly, with no obvious colour difference visible.

sentences.chinese: 为了让植物受光均匀，他每天都会转动花盆。
sentences.traditional: 為了讓植物受光均勻，他每天都會轉動花盆。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ràng zhíwù shòu guāng jūnyún, tā měi tiān dōu huì zhuǎndòng huāpén.
sentences.translation: To make sure the plant receives light evenly, he turns the flowerpot every day.

sentences.chinese: 请把重要信息写在卡片上，方便复习时快速查看。
sentences.traditional: 請把重要信息寫在卡片上，方便複習時快速查看。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhòngyào xìnxī xiě zài kǎpiàn shàng, fāngbiàn fùxí shí kuàisù chákàn.
sentences.translation: Please write the important information on the card so it is easy to check quickly when reviewing.

sentences.chinese: 孩子亲手做了一张生日卡片，送给外公。
sentences.traditional: 孩子親手做了一張生日卡片，送給外公。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng shēngrì kǎpiàn, sòng gěi wàigōng.
sentences.translation: The child made a birthday card by hand and gave it to his grandfather.

sentences.chinese: 这套词汇卡片适合每天抽十张来练习。
sentences.traditional: 這套詞彙卡片適合每天抽十張來練習。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào cíhuì kǎpiàn shìhé měi tiān chōu shí zhāng lái liànxí.
sentences.translation: This set of vocabulary cards is suitable for drawing ten each day to practise.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革开创了社区治理的新模式。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革開創了社區治理的新模式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé kāichuàng le shèqū zhìlǐ de xīn móshì.
sentences.translation: This reform created a new model for community governance.

sentences.chinese: 年轻团队希望用技术开创更高效的服务方式。
sentences.traditional: 年輕團隊希望用技術開創更高效的服務方式。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng tuánduì xīwàng yòng jìshù kāichuàng gèng gāoxiào de fúwù fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The young team hopes to use technology to pioneer more efficient ways of providing services.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司敢于开创新市场，因此很快吸引了投资。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司敢於開創新市場，因此很快吸引了投資。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī gǎnyú kāichuàng xīn shìchǎng, yīncǐ hěn kuài xīyǐn le tóuzī.
sentences.translation: This company dares to open up new markets, so it quickly attracted investment.

sentences.chinese: 出门前请检查电源开关，避免设备长时间运行。
sentences.traditional: 出門前請檢查電源開關，避免設備長時間運行。
sentences.pinyin: Chūmén qián qǐng jiǎnchá diànyuán kāiguān, bìmiǎn shèbèi cháng shíjiān yùnxíng.
sentences.translation: Before going out, please check the power switch to avoid leaving the equipment running for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 这个开关设计得很隐蔽，第一次来的人不容易找到。
sentences.traditional: 這個開關設計得很隱蔽，第一次來的人不容易找到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège kāiguān shèjì de hěn yǐnbì, dì yī cì lái de rén bù róngyì zhǎodào.
sentences.translation: This switch is designed to be quite hidden, so people coming for the first time do not easily find it.

sentences.chinese: 维修人员更换了损坏的开关，电梯才恢复正常。
sentences.traditional: 維修人員更換了損壞的開關，電梯才恢復正常。
sentences.pinyin: Wéixiū rényuán gēnghuàn le sǔnhuài de kāiguān, diàntī cái huīfù zhèngcháng.
sentences.translation: The maintenance worker replaced the damaged switch, and only then did the lift return to normal.

sentences.chinese: 输入密码后，系统会自动开启安全验证。
sentences.traditional: 輸入密碼後，系統會自動開啟安全驗證。
sentences.pinyin: Shūrù mìmǎ hòu, xìtǒng huì zìdòng kāiqǐ ānquán yànzhèng.
sentences.translation: After the password is entered, the system will automatically start security verification.

sentences.chinese: 这次培训开启了他对金融行业的兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 這次培訓開啟了他對金融行業的興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì péixùn kāiqǐ le tā duì jīnróng hángyè de xìngqù.
sentences.translation: This training course sparked his interest in the finance industry.

sentences.chinese: 新政策将开启城市交通管理的新阶段。
sentences.traditional: 新政策將開啟城市交通管理的新階段。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè jiāng kāiqǐ chéngshì jiāotōng guǎnlǐ de xīn jiēduàn.
sentences.translation: The new policy will open a new stage in urban traffic management.

sentences.chinese: 学校计划下学期开设人工智能基础课程。
sentences.traditional: 學校計劃下學期開設人工智能基礎課程。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jìhuà xià xuéqī kāishè réngōng zhìnéng jīchǔ kèchéng.
sentences.translation: The school plans to offer a basic artificial intelligence course next term.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院新开设了急救咨询窗口，方便市民求助。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院新開設了急救諮詢窗口，方便市民求助。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn xīn kāishè le jíjiù zīxún chuāngkǒu, fāngbiàn shìmín qiúzhù.
sentences.translation: This hospital has newly opened a first-aid consultation desk to make it easier for residents to seek help.

sentences.chinese: 他在郊外开设了一间小型工作室，专门修复旧家具。
sentences.traditional: 他在郊外開設了一間小型工作室，專門修復舊傢俱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jiāowài kāishè le yì jiān xiǎoxíng gōngzuòshì, zhuānmén xiūfù jiù jiājù.
sentences.translation: He opened a small studio in the suburbs, specialising in repairing old furniture.

sentences.chinese: 演讲开头要抓住听众注意力，否则后面很难展开。
sentences.traditional: 演講開頭要抓住聽眾注意力，否則後面很難展開。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng kāitóu yào zhuā zhù tīngzhòng zhùyìlì, fǒuzé hòumiàn hěn nán zhǎnkāi.
sentences.translation: The beginning of a speech should catch the audience’s attention, otherwise it is hard to develop the rest.

sentences.chinese: 文章刚开头就提出了一个尖锐的问题。
sentences.traditional: 文章剛開頭就提出了一個尖銳的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Wénzhāng gāng kāitóu jiù tíchū le yí gè jiānruì de wèntí.
sentences.translation: The article raises a sharp question right at the beginning.

sentences.chinese: 故事的开头很平静，但结尾却出人意料。
sentences.traditional: 故事的開頭很平靜，但結尾卻出人意料。
sentences.pinyin: Gùshi de kāitóu hěn píngjìng, dàn jiéwěi què chū rén yìliào.
sentences.translation: The beginning of the story is calm, but the ending is unexpected.

sentences.chinese: 工人先把枯枝砍掉，避免大风时砸到路人。
sentences.traditional: 工人先把枯枝砍掉，避免大風時砸到路人。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén xiān bǎ kūzhī kǎn diào, bìmiǎn dàfēng shí zá dào lùrén.
sentences.translation: The workers first cut off the dead branches to prevent them hitting passers-by in strong winds.

sentences.chinese: 为了控制成本，公司不得不砍掉几个低效项目。
sentences.traditional: 為了控制成本，公司不得不砍掉幾個低效項目。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile kòngzhì chéngběn, gōngsī bùdébù kǎn diào jǐ gè dīxiào xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: To control costs, the company had to cut several inefficient projects.

sentences.chinese: 他挥起斧头砍向木桩，动作又稳又准。
sentences.traditional: 他揮起斧頭砍向木樁，動作又穩又準。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huī qǐ fǔtóu kǎn xiàng mùzhuāng, dòngzuò yòu wěn yòu zhǔn.
sentences.translation: He raised the axe and chopped towards the wooden post, his movement steady and accurate.

sentences.chinese: 不要因为别人学历低就看不起他们，能力需要时间证明。
sentences.traditional: 不要因為別人學歷低就看不起他們，能力需要時間證明。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào yīnwèi biérén xuélì dī jiù kànbuqǐ tāmen, nénglì xūyào shíjiān zhèngmíng.
sentences.translation: Do not look down on people just because their level of education is low; ability needs time to be proven.

sentences.chinese: 他表面客气，其实常常看不起基层员工的经验。
sentences.traditional: 他表面客氣，其實常常看不起基層員工的經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biǎomiàn kèqi, qíshí chángcháng kànbuqǐ jīcéng yuángōng de jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He is polite on the surface, but in fact he often looks down on the experience of front-line employees.

sentences.chinese: 真正有修养的人不会看不起从事普通工作的人。
sentences.traditional: 真正有修養的人不會看不起從事普通工作的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng yǒu xiūyǎng de rén bú huì kànbuqǐ cóngshì pǔtōng gōngzuò de rén.
sentences.translation: A truly well-cultivated person will not look down on people doing ordinary work.

sentences.chinese: 我们应该理性看待技术进步带来的风险和机会。
sentences.traditional: 我們應該理性看待技術進步帶來的風險和機會。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi lǐxìng kàndài jìshù jìnbù dài lái de fēngxiǎn hé jīhuì.
sentences.translation: We should view the risks and opportunities brought by technological progress rationally.

sentences.chinese: 不同年龄的人看待婚姻的方式可能很不一样。
sentences.traditional: 不同年齡的人看待婚姻的方式可能很不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng niánlíng de rén kàndài hūnyīn de fāngshì kěnéng hěn bù yíyàng.
sentences.translation: People of different ages may view marriage in very different ways.

sentences.chinese: 媒体不应只从商业角度看待教育问题。
sentences.traditional: 媒體不應只從商業角度看待教育問題。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ bù yīng zhǐ cóng shāngyè jiǎodù kàndài jiàoyù wèntí.
sentences.translation: The media should not view educational issues only from a commercial angle.

sentences.chinese: 老师看得起这个学生，不只是因为成绩好，更因为他肯努力。
sentences.traditional: 老師看得起這個學生，不只是因為成績好，更因為他肯努力。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī kàndeqǐ zhège xuésheng, bù zhǐ shì yīnwèi chéngjì hǎo, gèng yīnwèi tā kěn nǔlì.
sentences.translation: The teacher thinks highly of this student not only because of his good grades, but also because he is willing to work hard.

sentences.chinese: 他最希望别人看得起他的专业能力，而不是只关注背景。
sentences.traditional: 他最希望別人看得起他的專業能力，而不是只關注背景。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì xīwàng biérén kàndeqǐ tā de zhuānyè nénglì, ér bú shì zhǐ guānzhù bèijǐng.
sentences.translation: What he most hopes is that others value his professional ability rather than only paying attention to his background.

sentences.chinese: 先做出成绩，别人才会真正看得起你。
sentences.traditional: 先做出成績，別人才會真正看得起你。
sentences.pinyin: Xiān zuò chū chéngjì, biérén cái huì zhēnzhèng kàndeqǐ nǐ.
sentences.translation: First produce results, and only then will others truly think highly of you.

sentences.chinese: 分析师看好新能源行业未来几年的发展。
sentences.traditional: 分析師看好新能源行業未來幾年的發展。
sentences.pinyin: Fēnxīshī kànhǎo xīn néngyuán hángyè wèilái jǐ nián de fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Analysts are optimistic about the development of the new energy industry over the next few years.

sentences.chinese: 虽然市场波动很大，投资者仍然看好这家公司。
sentences.traditional: 雖然市場波動很大，投資者仍然看好這家公司。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán shìchǎng bōdòng hěn dà, tóuzīzhě réngrán kànhǎo zhè jiā gōngsī.
sentences.translation: Although the market fluctuates greatly, investors are still optimistic about this company.

sentences.chinese: 教练看好他的爆发力，决定让他参加决赛。
sentences.traditional: 教練看好他的爆發力，決定讓他參加決賽。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoliàn kànhǎo tā de bàofālì, juédìng ràng tā cānjiā juésài.
sentences.translation: The coach rates his explosive power highly and decided to let him take part in the final.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法看似简单，实际执行起来却需要很多协调。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法看似簡單，實際執行起來卻需要很多協調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ kànsì jiǎndān, shíjì zhíxíng qǐlái què xūyào hěn duō xiétiáo.
sentences.translation: This method seems simple, but actually carrying it out requires a lot of coordination.

sentences.chinese: 他的回答看似平静，其实隐藏着强烈的不满。
sentences.traditional: 他的回答看似平靜，其實隱藏著強烈的不滿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huídá kànsì píngjìng, qíshí yǐncáng zhe qiángliè de bùmǎn.
sentences.translation: His answer seemed calm, but in fact it hid strong dissatisfaction.

sentences.chinese: 看似偶然的成功，背后往往有长期的准备。
sentences.traditional: 看似偶然的成功，背後往往有長期的準備。
