sentences.pinyin: Kànsì ǒurán de chénggōng, bèihòu wǎngwǎng yǒu chángqī de zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: Success that appears accidental often has long-term preparation behind it.

sentences.chinese: 公司看中了他的国际经验，决定让他负责新市场。
sentences.traditional: 公司看中了他的國際經驗，決定讓他負責新市場。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī kànzhòng le tā de guójì jīngyàn, juédìng ràng tā fùzé xīn shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: The company took a liking to his international experience and decided to let him handle the new market.

sentences.chinese: 她一眼就看中这套房子的采光和位置。
sentences.traditional: 她一眼就看中這套房子的採光和位置。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì yǎn jiù kànzhòng zhè tào fángzi de cǎiguāng hé wèizhi.
sentences.translation: She took a liking to the lighting and location of this flat at first glance.

sentences.chinese: 导演看中了这座老厂房，准备把它改成拍摄场地。
sentences.traditional: 導演看中了這座老廠房，準備把它改成拍攝場地。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn kànzhòng le zhè zuò lǎo chǎngfáng, zhǔnbèi bǎ tā gǎi chéng pāishè chǎngdì.
sentences.translation: The director took a fancy to this old factory building and planned to turn it into a filming location.

sentences.chinese: 我们更看重候选人的责任感，而不是学历本身。
sentences.traditional: 我們更看重候選人的責任感，而不是學歷本身。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen gèng kànzhòng hòuxuǎnrén de zérèngǎn, ér bú shì xuélì běnshēn.
sentences.translation: We value a candidate's sense of responsibility more than the qualification itself.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校很看重学生的独立思考能力。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校很看重學生的獨立思考能力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào hěn kànzhòng xuéshēng de dúlì sīkǎo nénglì.
sentences.translation: This school places great value on students' ability to think independently.

sentences.chinese: 他看重承诺，所以答应过的事一定会做到。
sentences.traditional: 他看重承諾，所以答應過的事一定會做到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhòng chéngnuò, suǒyǐ dāying guò de shì yídìng huì zuòdào.
sentences.translation: He values promises, so he will definitely do what he has agreed to.

sentences.chinese: 手术后，他需要几个月的时间才能完全康复。
sentences.traditional: 手術後，他需要幾個月的時間才能完全康復。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒushù hòu, tā xūyào jǐ ge yuè de shíjiān cái néng wánquán kāngfù.
sentences.translation: After the operation, he will need several months before he can fully recover.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议她在康复期间不要进行剧烈运动。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議她在康復期間不要進行劇烈運動。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā zài kāngfù qījiān bú yào jìnxíng jùliè yùndòng.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised her not to do intense exercise during her recovery period.

sentences.chinese: 良好的睡眠有助于身体康复，也能稳定情绪。
sentences.traditional: 良好的睡眠有助於身體康復，也能穩定情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de shuìmián yǒu zhù yú shēntǐ kāngfù, yě néng wěndìng qíngxù.
sentences.translation: Good sleep helps the body recover and can also stabilise one's mood.

sentences.chinese: 代表团将前往沿海城市，考察当地的港口建设。
sentences.traditional: 代表團將前往沿海城市，考察當地的港口建設。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán jiāng qiánwǎng yánhǎi chéngshì, kǎochá dāngdì de gǎngkǒu jiànshè.
sentences.translation: The delegation will go to coastal cities to inspect the local port construction.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们实地考察河流污染的原因。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們實地考察河流污染的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen shídì kǎochá héliú wūrǎn de yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to investigate the causes of river pollution on site.

sentences.chinese: 在作出决策前，公司需要充分考察市场需求。
sentences.traditional: 在作出決策前，公司需要充分考察市場需求。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zuò chū juécè qián, gōngsī xūyào chōngfèn kǎochá shìchǎng xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, the company needs to fully investigate market demand.

sentences.chinese: 这支考古队在沙漠边缘发现了古代城市遗址。
sentences.traditional: 這支考古隊在沙漠邊緣發現了古代城市遺址。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī kǎogǔ duì zài shāmò biānyuán fāxiàn le gǔdài chéngshì yízhǐ.
sentences.translation: This archaeological team discovered the ruins of an ancient city on the edge of the desert.

sentences.chinese: 他从小喜欢历史，后来选择了考古专业。
sentences.traditional: 他從小喜歡歷史，後來選擇了考古專業。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xǐhuān lìshǐ, hòulái xuǎnzé le kǎogǔ zhuānyè.
sentences.translation: He liked history from childhood and later chose archaeology as his major.

sentences.chinese: 考古不仅要挖掘文物，还要解释它们背后的文化。
sentences.traditional: 考古不僅要挖掘文物，還要解釋它們背後的文化。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎogǔ bùjǐn yào wājué wénwù, hái yào jiěshì tāmen bèihòu de wénhuà.
sentences.translation: Archaeology involves not only excavating cultural relics, but also explaining the culture behind them.

sentences.chinese: 年底考核不仅看业绩，也会看团队合作能力。
sentences.traditional: 年底考核不僅看業績，也會看團隊合作能力。
sentences.pinyin: Niándǐ kǎohé bùjǐn kàn yèjì, yě huì kàn tuánduì hézuò nénglì.
sentences.translation: The year-end assessment looks not only at performance, but also at teamwork ability.

sentences.chinese: 新员工试用期结束后，公司会统一考核他们的表现。
sentences.traditional: 新員工試用期結束後，公司會統一考核他們的表現。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng shìyòngqī jiéshù hòu, gōngsī huì tǒngyī kǎohé tāmen de biǎoxiàn.
sentences.translation: After new employees finish their probation period, the company will assess their performance in a standardised way.

sentences.chinese: 这项考核标准过于单一，难以反映真实水平。
sentences.traditional: 這項考核標準過於單一，難以反映真實水平。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng kǎohé biāozhǔn guòyú dānyī, nányǐ fǎnyìng zhēnshí shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: This assessment standard is too one-dimensional and cannot easily reflect the real level.

sentences.chinese: 连续加班对他的体力和意志都是一种考验。
sentences.traditional: 連續加班對他的體力和意志都是一種考驗。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jiābān duì tā de tǐlì hé yìzhì dōu shì yì zhǒng kǎoyàn.
sentences.translation: Working overtime continuously is a test of both his physical strength and his willpower.

sentences.chinese: 突然出现的危机考验了管理层的判断力。
sentences.traditional: 突然出現的危機考驗了管理層的判斷力。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán chūxiàn de wēijī kǎoyàn le guǎnlǐcéng de pànduànlì.
sentences.translation: The sudden crisis tested the judgement of the management team.

sentences.chinese: 真正的友谊往往经得起时间的考验。
sentences.traditional: 真正的友誼往往經得起時間的考驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì wǎngwǎng jīngdeqǐ shíjiān de kǎoyàn.
sentences.translation: True friendship can often stand the test of time.

sentences.chinese: 他高中时选择了理科，后来进入工程学院。
sentences.traditional: 他高中時選擇了理科，後來進入工程學院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāozhōng shí xuǎnzé le lǐkē, hòulái jìnrù gōngchéng xuéyuàn.
sentences.translation: In high school he chose the science track and later entered an engineering college.

sentences.chinese: 医院的眼科门诊今天特别忙，很多病人在排队。
sentences.traditional: 醫院的眼科門診今天特別忙，很多病人在排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn de yǎnkē ménzhěn jīntiān tèbié máng, hěn duō bìngrén zài páiduì.
sentences.translation: The ophthalmology clinic at the hospital is especially busy today, with many patients queuing.

sentences.chinese: 学校鼓励不同科的老师共同设计综合项目。
sentences.traditional: 學校鼓勵不同科的老師共同設計綜合項目。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào gǔlì bùtóng kē de lǎoshī gòngtóng shèjì zōnghé xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: The school encourages teachers from different departments to design integrated projects together.

sentences.chinese: 这部科幻小说描写了人类移民火星后的社会冲突。
sentences.traditional: 這部科幻小說描寫了人類移民火星後的社會衝突。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù kēhuàn xiǎoshuō miáoxiě le rénlèi yímín Huǒxīng hòu de shèhuì chōngtū.
sentences.translation: This science fiction novel describes social conflicts after humans migrate to Mars.

sentences.chinese: 他喜欢科幻电影，因为它们常常提出关于未来的严肃问题。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡科幻電影，因為它們常常提出關於未來的嚴肅問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān kēhuàn diànyǐng, yīnwèi tāmen chángcháng tíchū guānyú wèilái de yánsù wèntí.
sentences.translation: He likes science fiction films because they often raise serious questions about the future.

sentences.chinese: 这个科幻设定虽然大胆，但背后的科学逻辑比较清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這個科幻設定雖然大膽，但背後的科學邏輯比較清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège kēhuàn shèdìng suīrán dàdǎn, dàn bèihòu de kēxué luójí bǐjiào qīngchu.
sentences.translation: This science fiction premise is bold, but the scientific logic behind it is fairly clear.

sentences.chinese: 这学期他选了三门科目，其中最难的是统计学。
sentences.traditional: 這學期他選了三門科目，其中最難的是統計學。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī tā xuǎn le sān mén kēmù, qízhōng zuì nán de shì tǒngjìxué.
sentences.translation: This term he chose three subjects, the hardest of which is statistics.

sentences.chinese: 学校计划把人工智能列为必修科目，以适应新的就业需求。
sentences.traditional: 學校計劃把人工智能列為必修科目，以適應新的就業需求。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jìhuà bǎ réngōng zhìnéng liè wéi bìxiū kēmù, yǐ shìyìng xīn de jiùyè xūqiú.
sentences.translation: The school plans to make artificial intelligence a compulsory subject to adapt to new employment needs.

sentences.chinese: 她对理科科目不太自信，但实验报告写得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 她對理科科目不太自信，但實驗報告寫得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì lǐkē kēmù bù tài zìxìn, dàn shíyàn bàogào xiě de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: She is not very confident in science subjects, but her lab reports are written clearly.

sentences.chinese: 这位医生经常在网上科普急救知识，语言简单却很准确。
sentences.traditional: 這位醫生經常在網上科普急救知識，語言簡單卻很準確。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīshēng jīngcháng zài wǎngshàng kēpǔ jíjiù zhīshi, yǔyán jiǎndān què hěn zhǔnquè.
sentences.translation: This doctor often popularizes first-aid knowledge online, using simple yet accurate language.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆通过短视频科普古代建筑的结构。
sentences.traditional: 博物館通過短視頻科普古代建築的結構。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn tōngguò duǎn shìpín kēpǔ gǔdài jiànzhù de jiégòu.
sentences.translation: The museum uses short videos to popularize knowledge about the structure of ancient buildings.

sentences.chinese: 做科普不能只追求热闹，还要保证内容可靠。
sentences.traditional: 做科普不能只追求熱鬧，還要保證內容可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò kēpǔ bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú rènào, hái yào bǎozhèng nèiróng kěkào.
sentences.translation: When popularizing science, one must not only chase popularity but also ensure the content is reliable.

sentences.chinese: 这道汤虽然做法家常，味道却十分可口。
sentences.traditional: 這道湯雖然做法家常，味道卻十分可口。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tāng suīrán zuòfǎ jiācháng, wèidào què shífēn kěkǒu.
sentences.translation: Although this soup is made in a home-style way, it tastes very delicious.

sentences.chinese: 餐厅把普通蔬菜做得清淡可口，很受老人欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 餐廳把普通蔬菜做得清淡可口，很受老人歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Cāntīng bǎ pǔtōng shūcài zuò de qīngdàn kěkǒu, hěn shòu lǎorén huānyíng.
sentences.translation: The restaurant makes ordinary vegetables light and tasty, which is very popular with elderly customers.

sentences.chinese: 可口的饭菜不一定昂贵，关键在于食材新鲜。
sentences.traditional: 可口的飯菜不一定昂貴，關鍵在於食材新鮮。
sentences.pinyin: Kěkǒu de fàncài bù yídìng ángguì, guānjiàn zài yú shícái xīnxiān.
sentences.translation: Delicious food does not have to be expensive; the key is fresh ingredients.

sentences.chinese: 那只流浪狗又瘦又脏，看起来很可怜。
sentences.traditional: 那隻流浪狗又瘦又髒，看起來很可憐。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī liúlànggǒu yòu shòu yòu zāng, kàn qǐlái hěn kělián.
sentences.translation: That stray dog is thin and dirty, and it looks very pitiful.

sentences.chinese: 他不需要别人可怜，只希望得到公平的机会。
sentences.traditional: 他不需要別人可憐，只希望得到公平的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xūyào biérén kělián, zhǐ xīwàng dédào gōngpíng de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: He does not need others to pity him; he only hopes to get a fair opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 可怜她年纪这么小，就要承担这么大的压力。
sentences.traditional: 可憐她年紀這麼小，就要承擔這麼大的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Kělián tā niánjì zhème xiǎo, jiù yào chéngdān zhème dà de yālì.
sentences.translation: It is sad that she is so young yet has to bear such great pressure.

sentences.chinese: 许多年轻人渴望在大城市找到发展的机会。
sentences.traditional: 許多年輕人渴望在大城市找到發展的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīngrén kěwàng zài dà chéngshì zhǎodào fāzhǎn de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Many young people long to find opportunities for development in big cities.

sentences.chinese: 经历失败后，他更加渴望证明自己的能力。
sentences.traditional: 經歷失敗後，他更加渴望證明自己的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglì shībài hòu, tā gèngjiā kěwàng zhèngmíng zìjǐ de nénglì.
sentences.translation: After experiencing failure, he longs even more to prove his ability.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区长期缺水，居民渴望稳定的供水系统。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區長期缺水，居民渴望穩定的供水系統。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū chángqī quē shuǐ, jūmín kěwàng wěndìng de gōngshuǐ xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: This area has long suffered from water shortages, and residents long for a stable water supply system.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案听起来大胆，但从技术上看是可行的。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案聽起來大膽，但從技術上看是可行的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn tīng qǐlái dàdǎn, dàn cóng jìshù shàng kàn shì kěxíng de.
sentences.translation: This plan sounds bold, but from a technical point of view it is feasible.

sentences.chinese: 在资金有限的情况下，分阶段建设比较可行。
sentences.traditional: 在資金有限的情況下，分階段建設比較可行。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zījīn yǒuxiàn de qíngkuàng xià, fēn jiēduàn jiànshè bǐjiào kěxíng.
sentences.translation: With limited funds, building in stages is relatively feasible.

sentences.chinese: 管理层认为这个可行的办法能够降低风险。
sentences.traditional: 管理層認為這個可行的辦法能夠降低風險。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐcéng rènwéi zhège kěxíng de bànfǎ nénggòu jiàngdī fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Management believes this feasible method can reduce risk.

sentences.chinese: 由于高速公路封闭，长途客车只能绕道行驶。
sentences.traditional: 由於高速公路封閉，長途客車只能繞道行駛。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú gāosù gōnglù fēngbì, chángtú kèchē zhǐ néng ràodào xíngshǐ.
sentences.translation: Because the motorway was closed, the long-distance bus had to take a detour.

sentences.chinese: 这款新能源客车已经在多个城市投入运营。
sentences.traditional: 這款新能源客車已經在多個城市投入運營。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīn néngyuán kèchē yǐjīng zài duō gè chéngshì tóurù yùnyíng.
sentences.translation: This new-energy passenger bus has already been put into operation in several cities.

sentences.chinese: 春节前，车站增加了前往山区的客车班次。
sentences.traditional: 春節前，車站增加了前往山區的客車班次。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qián, chēzhàn zēngjiā le qiánwǎng shānqū de kèchē bāncì.
sentences.translation: Before Spring Festival, the station added more passenger bus services to the mountain area.

sentences.chinese: 他的博士课题主要研究城市交通与空气质量的关系。
sentences.traditional: 他的博士課題主要研究城市交通與空氣質量的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de bóshì kètí zhǔyào yánjiū chéngshì jiāotōng yǔ kōngqì zhìliàng de guānxì.
sentences.translation: His doctoral research topic mainly studies the relationship between urban transport and air quality.

sentences.chinese: 这个课题涉及多个学科，需要团队合作完成。
sentences.traditional: 這個課題涉及多個學科，需要團隊合作完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège kètí shèjí duō gè xuékē, xūyào tuánduì hézuò wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This research topic involves several disciplines and requires teamwork to complete.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们把社会调查变成一个明确的课题。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們把社會調查變成一個明確的課題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen bǎ shèhuì diàochá biànchéng yí ge míngquè de kètí.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to turn the social survey into a clearly defined research topic.

sentences.chinese: 只要你肯认真练习，发音一定会慢慢改善。
sentences.traditional: 只要你肯認真練習，發音一定會慢慢改善。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ kěn rènzhēn liànxí, fāyīn yídìng huì mànmàn gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: As long as you are willing to practise seriously, your pronunciation will certainly improve gradually.

sentences.chinese: 公司肯投入资源，项目才有可能顺利推进。
sentences.traditional: 公司肯投入資源，項目才有可能順利推進。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī kěn tóurù zīyuán, xiàngmù cái yǒu kěnéng shùnlì tuījìn.
sentences.translation: Only if the company is willing to invest resources can the project move forward smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 他肯承认错误，这本身就是一种进步。
sentences.traditional: 他肯承認錯誤，這本身就是一種進步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kěn chéngrèn cuòwù, zhè běnshēn jiù shì yì zhǒng jìnbù.
sentences.translation: The fact that he is willing to admit his mistake is itself a kind of progress.

sentences.chinese: 面对未知的疾病，人们最初往往会感到恐惧。
sentences.traditional: 面對未知的疾病，人們最初往往會感到恐懼。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì wèizhī de jíbìng, rénmen zuìchū wǎngwǎng huì gǎndào kǒngjù.
sentences.translation: Facing an unknown disease, people often feel fear at first.

sentences.chinese: 她努力克服对公开演讲的恐惧。
sentences.traditional: 她努力克服對公開演講的恐懼。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǔlì kèfú duì gōngkāi yǎnjiǎng de kǒngjù.
sentences.translation: She works hard to overcome her fear of public speaking.

sentences.chinese: 恐惧会影响判断，因此救援人员必须保持冷静。
sentences.traditional: 恐懼會影響判斷，因此救援人員必須保持冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Kǒngjù huì yǐngxiǎng pànduàn, yīncǐ jiùyuán rényuán bìxū bǎochí lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: Fear can affect judgement, so rescue workers must stay calm.

sentences.chinese: 市中心很难找到大块空地，新的停车场只能建在郊外。
sentences.traditional: 市中心很難找到大塊空地，新的停車場只能建在郊外。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhōngxīn hěn nán zhǎodào dà kuài kòngdì, xīn de tíngchēchǎng zhǐ néng jiàn zài jiāowài.
sentences.translation: It is hard to find large open spaces in the city centre, so the new car park can only be built in the suburbs.

sentences.chinese: 这片空地暂时用作社区活动场所，周末会有集市。
sentences.traditional: 這片空地暫時用作社區活動場所，週末會有集市。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn kòngdì zànshí yòng zuò shèqū huódòng chǎngsuǒ, zhōumò huì yǒu jíshì.
sentences.translation: This open space is temporarily being used as a community activity venue, and there will be a market at the weekend.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划把废弃工厂旁的空地改造成小公园。
sentences.traditional: 政府計畫把廢棄工廠旁的空地改造成小公園。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà bǎ fèiqì gōngchǎng páng de kòngdì gǎizào chéng xiǎo gōngyuán.
sentences.translation: The government plans to turn the vacant land beside the abandoned factory into a small park.

sentences.chinese: 他工作很忙，只有晚上十点以后才有一点空闲。
sentences.traditional: 他工作很忙，只有晚上十點以後才有一點空閒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn máng, zhǐyǒu wǎnshang shí diǎn yǐhòu cái yǒu yìdiǎn kòngxián.
sentences.translation: He is very busy with work and only has a little free time after ten at night.

sentences.chinese: 设备处于空闲状态时，系统会自动降低耗电量。
sentences.traditional: 設備處於空閒狀態時，系統會自動降低耗電量。
sentences.pinyin: Shèbèi chǔyú kòngxián zhuàngtài shí, xìtǒng huì zìdòng jiàngdī hào diàn liàng.
sentences.translation: When the equipment is idle, the system automatically reduces power consumption.

sentences.chinese: 利用空闲时间学习一门新技能，比整天刷短视频更有价值。
sentences.traditional: 利用空閒時間學習一門新技能，比整天刷短視頻更有價值。
sentences.pinyin: Lìyòng kòngxián shíjiān xuéxí yì mén xīn jìnéng, bǐ zhěngtiān shuā duǎn shìpín gèng yǒu jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Using free time to learn a new skill is more valuable than scrolling short videos all day.

sentences.chinese: 这款面包的口感松软，但甜度对我来说有点高。
sentences.traditional: 這款麵包的口感鬆軟，但甜度對我來說有點高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn miànbāo de kǒugǎn sōngruǎn, dàn tiándù duì wǒ lái shuō yǒudiǎn gāo.
sentences.translation: This bread has a soft texture, but the sweetness is a little high for me.

sentences.chinese: 食材的新鲜程度会直接影响菜品的口感。
sentences.traditional: 食材的新鮮程度會直接影響菜品的口感。
sentences.pinyin: Shícái de xīnxiān chéngdù huì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng càipǐn de kǒugǎn.
sentences.translation: The freshness of the ingredients directly affects the texture and taste of a dish.

sentences.chinese: 这种米煮出来口感偏硬，更适合做炒饭。
sentences.traditional: 這種米煮出來口感偏硬，更適合做炒飯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng mǐ zhǔ chūlái kǒugǎn piān yìng, gèng shìhé zuò chǎofàn.
sentences.translation: This type of rice has a rather firm texture when cooked, making it more suitable for fried rice.

sentences.chinese: 这个口号听起来响亮，但如果没有行动就毫无意义。
sentences.traditional: 這個口號聽起來響亮，但如果沒有行動就毫無意義。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège kǒuhào tīng qǐlái xiǎngliàng, dàn rúguǒ méiyǒu xíngdòng jiù háo wú yìyì.
sentences.translation: This slogan sounds powerful, but it is meaningless without action.

sentences.chinese: 活动现场挂满了宣传口号，提醒大家注意环保。
sentences.traditional: 活動現場掛滿了宣傳口號，提醒大家注意環保。
sentences.pinyin: Huódòng xiànchǎng guà mǎn le xuānchuán kǒuhào, tíxǐng dàjiā zhùyì huánbǎo.
sentences.translation: The event site was covered with publicity slogans reminding everyone to pay attention to environmental protection.

sentences.chinese: 公司把“质量第一”作为新的服务口号。
sentences.traditional: 公司把“質量第一”作為新的服務口號。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī bǎ “zhìliàng dì yī” zuòwéi xīn de fúwù kǒuhào.
sentences.translation: The company has made “quality first” its new service slogan.

sentences.chinese: 口腔健康不仅影响牙齿，也会影响整体生活质量。
sentences.traditional: 口腔健康不僅影響牙齒，也會影響整體生活質量。
sentences.pinyin: Kǒuqiāng jiànkāng bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng yáchǐ, yě huì yǐngxiǎng zhěngtǐ shēnghuó zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Oral health affects not only the teeth, but also overall quality of life.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他饭后清洁口腔，避免炎症反复出现。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他飯後清潔口腔，避免炎症反覆出現。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā fàn hòu qīngjié kǒuqiāng, bìmiǎn yánzhèng fǎnfù chūxiàn.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him to clean his mouth after meals to prevent the inflammation from returning repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 这类药物可能导致口腔干燥，需要多喝水。
sentences.traditional: 這類藥物可能導致口腔乾燥，需要多喝水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lèi yàowù kěnéng dǎozhì kǒuqiāng gānzào, xūyào duō hē shuǐ.
sentences.translation: This type of medicine may cause dryness in the mouth, so it is necessary to drink more water.

sentences.chinese: 双方只是达成了口头协议，还没有签正式合同。
sentences.traditional: 雙方只是達成了口頭協議，還沒有簽正式合約。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zhǐshì dáchéng le kǒutóu xiéyì, hái méiyǒu qiān zhèngshì héyuē.
sentences.translation: The two sides have only reached a verbal agreement and have not yet signed a formal contract.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们做口头报告，不能只交书面材料。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們做口頭報告，不能只交書面材料。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen zuò kǒutóu bàogào, bù néng zhǐ jiāo shūmiàn cáiliào.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to give an oral report, not just hand in written materials.

sentences.chinese: 口头承诺如果没有记录，发生纠纷时很难证明。
sentences.traditional: 口頭承諾如果沒有記錄，發生糾紛時很難證明。
sentences.pinyin: Kǒutóu chéngnuò rúguǒ méiyǒu jìlù, fāshēng jiūfēn shí hěn nán zhèngmíng.
sentences.translation: If a verbal promise is not recorded, it is hard to prove when a dispute occurs.

sentences.chinese: 迟到超过十分钟，公司会从奖金里扣一部分钱。
sentences.traditional: 遲到超過十分鐘，公司會從獎金裡扣一部分錢。
sentences.pinyin: Chídào chāoguò shí fēnzhōng, gōngsī huì cóng jiǎngjīn lǐ kòu yí bùfen qián.
sentences.translation: If someone is more than ten minutes late, the company deducts part of the bonus.

sentences.chinese: 他扣好外套，才走出寒冷的车站。
sentences.traditional: 他扣好外套，才走出寒冷的車站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kòu hǎo wàitào, cái zǒu chū hánlěng de chēzhàn.
sentences.translation: He buttoned up his coat before walking out of the cold station.

sentences.chinese: 这道题少写一个单位，老师扣了两分。
sentences.traditional: 這道題少寫一個單位，老師扣了兩分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí shǎo xiě yí ge dānwèi, lǎoshī kòu le liǎng fēn.
sentences.translation: Because one unit was missing from this question, the teacher deducted two points.

sentences.chinese: 纯理论内容如果没有案例，会显得十分枯燥。
sentences.traditional: 純理論內容如果沒有案例，會顯得十分枯燥。
sentences.pinyin: Chún lǐlùn nèiróng rúguǒ méiyǒu ànlì, huì xiǎnde shífēn kūzào.
sentences.translation: Purely theoretical content can seem very dry if there are no examples.

sentences.chinese: 他把枯燥的数据整理成图表，汇报变得清楚多了。
sentences.traditional: 他把枯燥的數據整理成圖表，匯報變得清楚多了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ kūzào de shùjù zhěnglǐ chéng túbiǎo, huìbào biàn de qīngchu duō le.
sentences.translation: He organised the dry data into charts, making the report much clearer.

sentences.chinese: 重复练习虽然枯燥，却是掌握基本功的必要过程。
sentences.traditional: 重複練習雖然枯燥，卻是掌握基本功的必要過程。
sentences.pinyin: Chóngfù liànxí suīrán kūzào, què shì zhǎngwò jīběngōng de bìyào guòchéng.
sentences.translation: Although repeated practice is boring, it is a necessary process for mastering the basics.

sentences.chinese: 这款电动车外形很酷，但续航能力才是我最关心的。
sentences.traditional: 這款電動車外形很酷，但續航能力才是我最關心的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn diàndòngchē wàixíng hěn kù, dàn xùháng nénglì cái shì wǒ zuì guānxīn de.
sentences.translation: This electric car looks cool, but its range is what I care about most.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得穿得酷并不重要，重要的是干净舒服。
sentences.traditional: 他覺得穿得酷並不重要，重要的是乾淨舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde chuān de kù bìng bù zhòngyào, zhòngyào de shì gānjìng shūfu.
sentences.translation: He thinks looking cool is not important; what matters is being clean and comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 这个应用的界面很酷，操作起来也比较直观。
sentences.traditional: 這個應用的介面很酷，操作起來也比較直觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng de jièmiàn hěn kù, cāozuò qǐlái yě bǐjiào zhíguān.
sentences.translation: This app has a cool interface, and it is also fairly intuitive to use.

sentences.chinese: 别只夸孩子聪明，也要肯定他努力的过程。
sentences.traditional: 別只誇孩子聰明，也要肯定他努力的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhǐ kuā háizi cōngmíng, yě yào kěndìng tā nǔlì de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: Do not only praise a child for being clever; also acknowledge the effort he puts in.

sentences.chinese: 他喜欢在朋友面前夸自己的经验，听起来有点不谦虚。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡在朋友面前誇自己的經驗，聽起來有點不謙虛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān zài péngyou miànqián kuā zìjǐ de jīngyàn, tīng qǐlái yǒudiǎn bù qiānxū.
sentences.translation: He likes to boast about his experience in front of friends, which sounds a little immodest.

sentences.chinese: 客户夸这次服务效率高，态度也专业。
sentences.traditional: 客戶誇這次服務效率高，態度也專業。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù kuā zhè cì fúwù xiàolǜ gāo, tàidù yě zhuānyè.
sentences.translation: The client praised this service for being efficient and professional in attitude.

sentences.chinese: 经理公开夸奖他的细心，让团队更重视工作流程。
sentences.traditional: 經理公開誇獎他的細心，讓團隊更重視工作流程。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ gōngkāi kuājiǎng tā de xìxīn, ràng tuánduì gèng zhòngshì gōngzuò liúchéng.
sentences.translation: The manager publicly praised his carefulness, making the team pay more attention to work processes.

sentences.chinese: 别只在孩子考高分时夸奖他，也要肯定他的努力。
sentences.traditional: 別只在孩子考高分時誇獎他，也要肯定他的努力。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhǐ zài háizi kǎo gāo fēn shí kuājiǎng tā, yě yào kěndìng tā de nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Do not only praise a child when he gets high marks; also recognise his effort.

sentences.chinese: 客户夸奖这款产品设计实用，售后服务也及时。
sentences.traditional: 客戶誇獎這款產品設計實用，售後服務也及時。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù kuājiǎng zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn shèjì shíyòng, shòuhòu fúwù yě jíshí.
sentences.translation: The customer praised this product for its practical design and timely after-sales service.

sentences.chinese: 他的表达有些夸张，但问题本身确实值得重视。
sentences.traditional: 他的表達有些誇張，但問題本身確實值得重視。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de biǎodá yǒuxiē kuāzhāng, dàn wèntí běnshēn quèshí zhíde zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: His way of putting it is a little exaggerated, but the problem itself really deserves attention.

sentences.chinese: 广告把效果说得很夸张，消费者不一定会相信。
sentences.traditional: 廣告把效果說得很誇張，消費者不一定會相信。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnggào bǎ xiàoguǒ shuō de hěn kuāzhāng, xiāofèizhě bù yídìng huì xiāngxìn.
sentences.translation: The advertisement describes the effect in an exaggerated way, so consumers may not necessarily believe it.

sentences.chinese: 这个数字听起来夸张，其实有详细数据支持。
sentences.traditional: 這個數字聽起來誇張，其實有詳細數據支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shùzì tīng qǐlái kuāzhāng, qíshí yǒu xiángxì shùjù zhīchí.
sentences.translation: This figure sounds exaggerated, but it is actually supported by detailed data.

sentences.chinese: 会计仔细核对每一笔款项，避免月底结账出错。
sentences.traditional: 會計仔細核對每一筆款項，避免月底結帳出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Kuàijì zǐxì héduì měi yì bǐ kuǎnxiàng, bìmiǎn yuèdǐ jiézhàng chūcuò.
sentences.translation: The accountant carefully checks every payment to avoid errors when closing the accounts at the end of the month.

sentences.chinese: 公司请了一名经验丰富的会计来处理税务问题。
sentences.traditional: 公司請了一名經驗豐富的會計來處理稅務問題。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī qǐng le yì míng jīngyàn fēngfù de kuàijì lái chǔlǐ shuìwù wèntí.
sentences.translation: The company hired an experienced accountant to handle tax matters.

sentences.chinese: 如果发票信息不完整，会计很难按时完成报表。
sentences.traditional: 如果發票信息不完整，會計很難按時完成報表。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāpiào xìnxī bù wánzhěng, kuàijì hěn nán ànshí wánchéng bàobiǎo.
sentences.translation: If the invoice information is incomplete, it is difficult for the accountant to complete the report on time.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统让员工能够快捷地查找客户资料。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統讓員工能夠快捷地查找客戶資料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng ràng yuángōng nénggòu kuàijié de cházhǎo kèhù zīliào.
sentences.translation: This system allows employees to find customer records quickly.

sentences.chinese: 手机支付虽然快捷，但也要注意账户安全。
sentences.traditional: 手機支付雖然快捷，但也要注意帳戶安全。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī zhīfù suīrán kuàijié, dàn yě yào zhùyì zhànghù ānquán.
sentences.translation: Mobile payment is quick, but you still need to pay attention to account security.

sentences.chinese: 快捷的交通连接提高了周边地区的吸引力。
sentences.traditional: 快捷的交通連接提高了周邊地區的吸引力。
sentences.pinyin: Kuàijié de jiāotōng liánjiē tígāo le zhōubiān dìqū de xīyǐnlì.
sentences.translation: Fast transport links have increased the attractiveness of the surrounding area.

sentences.chinese: 这笔款已经到账，可以安排下一步采购。
sentences.traditional: 這筆款已經到帳，可以安排下一步採購。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ kuǎn yǐjīng dào zhàng, kěyǐ ānpái xià yí bù cǎigòu.
sentences.translation: This sum of money has already arrived in the account, so the next stage of purchasing can be arranged.

sentences.chinese: 他看中了一款轻便的背包，适合短途旅行。
sentences.traditional: 他看中了一款輕便的背包，適合短途旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhòng le yì kuǎn qīngbiàn de bèibāo, shìhé duǎntú lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: He took a fancy to a lightweight backpack suitable for short trips.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件功能全面，但价格对小公司来说偏高。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件功能全面，但價格對小公司來說偏高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn gōngnéng quánmiàn, dàn jiàgé duì xiǎo gōngsī lái shuō piān gāo.
sentences.translation: This piece of software has comprehensive functions, but its price is rather high for small companies.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套款式简单，适合正式和休闲场合。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套款式簡單，適合正式和休閒場合。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào kuǎnshì jiǎndān, shìhé zhèngshì hé xiūxián chǎnghé.
sentences.translation: This coat has a simple design and is suitable for both formal and casual occasions.

sentences.chinese: 消费者越来越重视家具的款式和环保材料。
sentences.traditional: 消費者越來越重視傢俱的款式和環保材料。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě yuè lái yuè zhòngshì jiājù de kuǎnshì hé huánbǎo cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Consumers are paying more and more attention to furniture design and environmentally friendly materials.

sentences.chinese: 这款手机的款式变化不大，主要升级了电池。
sentences.traditional: 這款手機的款式變化不大，主要升級了電池。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī de kuǎnshì biànhuà bù dà, zhǔyào shēngjí le diànchí.
sentences.translation: The design of this phone has not changed much; the main upgrade is the battery.

sentences.chinese: 由于原材料价格上涨，工厂连续两个季度亏损。
sentences.traditional: 由於原材料價格上漲，工廠連續兩個季度虧損。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng, gōngchǎng liánxù liǎng ge jìdù kuīsǔn.
sentences.translation: Because raw material prices rose, the factory lost money for two consecutive quarters.

sentences.chinese: 如果继续亏损，公司可能不得不缩小生产规模。
sentences.traditional: 如果繼續虧損，公司可能不得不縮小生產規模。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ jìxù kuīsǔn, gōngsī kěnéng bùdébù suōxiǎo shēngchǎn guīmó.
sentences.translation: If it continues to lose money, the company may have to reduce the scale of production.

sentences.chinese: 新店开业初期出现亏损并不一定意味着失败。
sentences.traditional: 新店開業初期出現虧損並不一定意味著失敗。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn diàn kāiyè chūqī chūxiàn kuīsǔn bìng bù yídìng yìwèizhe shībài.
sentences.translation: A loss in the early stage after a new shop opens does not necessarily mean failure.

sentences.chinese: 交通噪音长期困扰附近居民，投诉数量不断增加。
sentences.traditional: 交通噪音長期困擾附近居民，投訴數量不斷增加。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāotōng zàoyīn chángqī kùnrǎo fùjìn jūmín, tóusù shùliàng búduàn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: Traffic noise has long troubled nearby residents, and the number of complaints keeps rising.

sentences.chinese: 这个技术问题困扰了团队好几周，直到专家提出新方案。
sentences.traditional: 這個技術問題困擾了團隊好幾週，直到專家提出新方案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìshù wèntí kùnrǎo le tuánduì hǎo jǐ zhōu, zhídào zhuānjiā tíchū xīn fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: This technical problem troubled the team for several weeks until an expert proposed a new solution.

sentences.chinese: 睡眠不足会困扰很多上班族，并影响工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 睡眠不足會困擾很多上班族，並影響工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Shuìmián bùzú huì kùnrǎo hěn duō shàngbānzú, bìng yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Lack of sleep can trouble many office workers and affect work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划把业务扩展到东南亚市场。
sentences.traditional: 公司計畫把業務擴展到東南亞市場。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà bǎ yèwù kuòzhǎn dào Dōngnányà shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: The company plans to expand its business into the Southeast Asian market.

sentences.chinese: 这门课程不仅讲基础知识，还会扩展到实际案例。
sentences.traditional: 這門課程不僅講基礎知識，還會擴展到實際案例。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng bùjǐn jiǎng jīchǔ zhīshi, hái huì kuòzhǎn dào shíjì ànlì.
sentences.translation: This course not only teaches basic knowledge, but also expands into practical case studies.

sentences.chinese: 阅读英文资料可以扩展学生的国际视野。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀英文資料可以擴展學生的國際視野。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú Yīngwén zīliào kěyǐ kuòzhǎn xuéshēng de guójì shìyě.
sentences.translation: Reading English materials can broaden students' international perspective.

sentences.chinese: 他出门太急，把钥匙落在办公室了。
sentences.traditional: 他出門太急，把鑰匙落在辦公室了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chūmén tài jí, bǎ yàoshi là zài bàngōngshì le.
sentences.translation: He left his keys in the office because he went out in too much of a hurry.

sentences.chinese: 这次培训我落下了几页笔记，需要向同事借来补上。
sentences.traditional: 這次培訓我落下了幾頁筆記，需要向同事借來補上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì péixùn wǒ làxià le jǐ yè bǐjì, xūyào xiàng tóngshì jiè lái bǔshàng.
sentences.translation: I missed a few pages of notes during this training session and need to borrow them from a colleague to fill in the gaps.

sentences.chinese: 如果基础不扎实，学习进度很容易落在别人后面。
sentences.traditional: 如果基礎不紮實，學習進度很容易落在別人後面。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ jīchǔ bù zhāshi, xuéxí jìndù hěn róngyì là zài biéren hòumiàn.
sentences.translation: If the basics are not solid, study progress can easily fall behind other people.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜放了太多辣椒，味道刺激但很下饭。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜放了太多辣椒，味道刺激但很下飯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài fàng le tài duō làjiāo, wèidào cìjī dàn hěn xiàfàn.
sentences.translation: This dish has too many chilli peppers; the flavour is intense but goes very well with rice.

sentences.chinese: 有些品种的辣椒颜色鲜艳，却不一定特别辣。
sentences.traditional: 有些品種的辣椒顏色鮮豔，卻不一定特別辣。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē pǐnzhǒng de làjiāo yánsè xiānyàn, què bù yídìng tèbié là.
sentences.translation: Some varieties of chilli pepper are brightly coloured, but are not necessarily especially hot.

sentences.chinese: 他切完辣椒后忘了洗手，结果揉眼睛时特别难受。
sentences.traditional: 他切完辣椒後忘了洗手，結果揉眼睛時特別難受。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiē wán làjiāo hòu wàng le xǐshǒu, jiéguǒ róu yǎnjing shí tèbié nánshòu.
sentences.translation: After cutting chilli peppers he forgot to wash his hands, so it was very uncomfortable when he rubbed his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 别担心啦，这个问题我们已经找到解决办法了。
sentences.traditional: 別擔心啦，這個問題我們已經找到解決辦法了。
sentences.pinyin: Bié dānxīn la, zhège wèntí wǒmen yǐjīng zhǎodào jiějué bànfǎ le.
sentences.translation: Do not worry; we have already found a solution to this problem.

sentences.chinese: 票已经买好啦，明天我们直接在车站见。
sentences.traditional: 票已經買好啦，明天我們直接在車站見。
sentences.pinyin: Piào yǐjīng mǎi hǎo la, míngtiān wǒmen zhíjiē zài chēzhàn jiàn.
sentences.translation: The tickets have already been bought, so tomorrow we can meet directly at the station.

sentences.chinese: 会议终于结束啦，大家都松了一口气。
sentences.traditional: 會議終於結束啦，大家都鬆了一口氣。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì zhōngyú jiéshù la, dàjiā dōu sōng le yì kǒu qì.
sentences.translation: The meeting is finally over, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

sentences.chinese: 随着雨季来临，山区道路的安全风险明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 隨著雨季來臨，山區道路的安全風險明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe yǔjì láilín, shānqū dàolù de ānquán fēngxiǎn míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: As the rainy season arrives, the safety risks on mountain roads clearly increase.

sentences.chinese: 新学期即将来临，学校正在调整课程安排。
sentences.traditional: 新學期即將來臨，學校正在調整課程安排。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī jíjiāng láilín, xuéxiào zhèngzài tiáozhěng kèchéng ānpái.
sentences.translation: The new term is about to arrive, and the school is adjusting the course schedule.

sentences.chinese: 当挑战来临时，领导者的判断力往往最受考验。
sentences.traditional: 當挑戰來臨時，領導者的判斷力往往最受考驗。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tiǎozhàn láilín shí, lǐngdǎozhě de pànduànlì wǎngwǎng zuì shòu kǎoyàn.
sentences.translation: When challenges arrive, a leader's judgement is often tested the most.

sentences.chinese: 这条路上货车来往频繁，行人过马路要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 這條路上貨車來往頻繁，行人過馬路要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù shang huòchē láiwǎng pínfán, xíngrén guò mǎlù yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: Trucks come and go frequently on this road, so pedestrians need to be especially careful when crossing.

sentences.chinese: 两家公司过去来往不多，这次合作算是一个新开端。
sentences.traditional: 兩家公司過去來往不多，這次合作算是一個新開端。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī guòqù láiwǎng bù duō, zhè cì hézuò suàn shì yí ge xīn kāiduān.
sentences.translation: The two companies did not have much contact in the past, so this cooperation is a new beginning.

sentences.chinese: 港口每天都有大量船只来往，管理系统必须保持稳定。
sentences.traditional: 港口每天都有大量船隻來往，管理系統必須保持穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎngkǒu měi tiān dōu yǒu dàliàng chuánzhī láiwǎng, guǎnlǐ xìtǒng bìxū bǎochí wěndìng.
sentences.translation: A large number of ships come and go at the port every day, so the management system must remain stable.

sentences.chinese: 他总是赖在沙发上不肯起身，难怪身体越来越差。
sentences.traditional: 他總是賴在沙發上不肯起身，難怪身體越來越差。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì lài zài shāfā shang bù kěn qǐshēn, nánguài shēntǐ yuè lái yuè chà.
sentences.translation: He is always lounging on the sofa and unwilling to get up; no wonder his health is getting worse.

sentences.chinese: 这件事不能全赖天气，前期准备不足也是原因之一。
sentences.traditional: 這件事不能全賴天氣，前期準備不足也是原因之一。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù néng quán lài tiānqì, qiánqī zhǔnbèi bùzú yě shì yuányīn zhī yī.
sentences.translation: This matter cannot be blamed entirely on the weather; inadequate preparation was also one reason.

sentences.chinese: 小店生意不赖，周末经常要排队等位。
sentences.traditional: 小店生意不賴，週末經常要排隊等位。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo diàn shēngyì bú lài, zhōumò jīngcháng yào páiduì děng wèi.
sentences.translation: The little shop's business is not bad; at weekends people often have to queue for a table.

sentences.chinese: 保安把车辆拦在入口外，先核对预约信息。
sentences.traditional: 保安把車輛攔在入口外，先核對預約信息。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎo'ān bǎ chēliàng lán zài rùkǒu wài, xiān héduì yùyuē xìnxī.
sentences.translation: The security guard stopped the vehicles outside the entrance and first checked the booking information.

sentences.chinese: 洪水冲来时，村民用沙袋拦住了部分水流。
sentences.traditional: 洪水衝來時，村民用沙袋攔住了部分水流。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngshuǐ chōng lái shí, cūnmín yòng shādài lán zhù le bùfen shuǐliú.
sentences.translation: When the floodwater came rushing in, the villagers used sandbags to block part of the flow.

sentences.chinese: 记者试图拦下负责人，询问事故调查的最新进展。
sentences.traditional: 記者試圖攔下負責人，詢問事故調查的最新進展。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě shìtú lán xià fùzérén, xúnwèn shìgù diàochá de zuìxīn jìnzhǎn.
sentences.translation: The journalist tried to stop the person in charge to ask about the latest progress in the accident investigation.

sentences.chinese: 楼梯旁的栏有些松动，物业已经安排维修。
sentences.traditional: 樓梯旁的欄有些鬆動，物業已經安排維修。
sentences.pinyin: Lóutī páng de lán yǒuxiē sōngdòng, wùyè yǐjīng ānpái wéixiū.
sentences.translation: The railing beside the stairs is a little loose, and the property management has arranged repairs.

sentences.chinese: 请在表格最后一栏填写紧急联系人电话。
sentences.traditional: 請在表格最後一欄填寫緊急聯絡人電話。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé zuìhòu yì lán tiánxiě jǐnjí liánluòrén diànhuà.
sentences.translation: Please fill in the emergency contact phone number in the last column of the form.

sentences.chinese: 这家网站新增了法律咨询栏，方便读者提交问题。
sentences.traditional: 這家網站新增了法律諮詢欄，方便讀者提交問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā wǎngzhàn xīnzēng le fǎlǜ zīxún lán, fāngbiàn dúzhě tíjiāo wèntí.
sentences.translation: This website has added a legal advice column, making it convenient for readers to submit questions.

sentences.chinese: 办公室角落摆着一盆兰花，给严肃的环境增添了生气。
sentences.traditional: 辦公室角落擺著一盆蘭花，給嚴肅的環境增添了生氣。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì jiǎoluò bǎizhe yì pén lánhuā, gěi yánsù de huánjìng zēngtiān le shēngqì.
sentences.translation: There is a pot of orchids in the corner of the office, adding some life to the serious environment.

sentences.chinese: 兰花对温度和湿度比较敏感，照顾起来需要耐心。
sentences.traditional: 蘭花對溫度和濕度比較敏感，照顧起來需要耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Lánhuā duì wēndù hé shīdù bǐjiào mǐngǎn, zhàogù qǐlái xūyào nàixīn.
sentences.translation: Orchids are quite sensitive to temperature and humidity, so caring for them requires patience.

sentences.chinese: 展览会上有许多名贵兰花，吸引了不少植物爱好者。
sentences.traditional: 展覽會上有許多名貴蘭花，吸引了不少植物愛好者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎnlǎnhuì shang yǒu xǔduō míngguì lánhuā, xīyǐn le bù shǎo zhíwù àihàozhě.
sentences.translation: There were many valuable orchids at the exhibition, attracting quite a few plant lovers.

sentences.chinese: 这只苹果已经烂了，最好不要再吃。
sentences.traditional: 這隻蘋果已經爛了，最好不要再吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī píngguǒ yǐjīng làn le, zuìhǎo bú yào zài chī.
sentences.translation: This apple has already gone rotten, so it is best not to eat it.

sentences.chinese: 旧鞋底都快烂了，他还是舍不得扔。
sentences.traditional: 舊鞋底都快爛了，他還是捨不得扔。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù xiédǐ dōu kuài làn le, tā háishi shěbude rēng.
sentences.translation: The soles of the old shoes are almost worn out, but he still cannot bear to throw them away.

sentences.chinese: 土豆煮得太烂，已经不适合做沙拉了。
sentences.traditional: 土豆煮得太爛，已經不適合做沙拉了。
sentences.pinyin: Tǔdòu zhǔ de tài làn, yǐjīng bù shìhé zuò shālā le.
sentences.translation: The potatoes have been boiled too soft and are no longer suitable for making salad.

sentences.chinese: 夜里远处传来狼的叫声，牧民立刻检查羊圈。
sentences.traditional: 夜裡遠處傳來狼的叫聲，牧民立刻檢查羊圈。
sentences.pinyin: Yèlǐ yuǎnchù chuán lái láng de jiàoshēng, mùmín lìkè jiǎnchá yángjuàn.
sentences.translation: At night, the howl of a wolf came from the distance, and the herder immediately checked the sheep pen.

sentences.chinese: 在这部纪录片中，狼的合作捕猎方式令人印象深刻。
sentences.traditional: 在這部紀錄片中，狼的合作捕獵方式令人印象深刻。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè bù jìlùpiàn zhōng, láng de hézuò bǔliè fāngshì lìng rén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
sentences.translation: In this documentary, the wolf's cooperative hunting method leaves a deep impression.

sentences.chinese: 孩子第一次在动物园看到狼，既害怕又兴奋。
sentences.traditional: 孩子第一次在動物園看到狼，既害怕又興奮。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi dì yī cì zài dòngwùyuán kàndào láng, jì hàipà yòu xīngfèn.
sentences.translation: The child saw a wolf at the zoo for the first time and was both scared and excited.

sentences.chinese: 老师建议学生每天朗读一段新闻，以提高语感和表达能力。
sentences.traditional: 老師建議學生每天朗讀一段新聞，以提高語感和表達能力。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiànyì xuéshēng měi tiān lǎngdú yí duàn xīnwén, yǐ tígāo yǔgǎn hé biǎodá nénglì.
sentences.translation: The teacher suggested that students read a piece of news aloud every day to improve their language sense and ability to express themselves.

sentences.chinese: 她在比赛中朗读得很有感情，连评委都被打动了。
sentences.traditional: 她在比賽中朗讀得很有感情，連評委都被打動了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng lǎngdú de hěn yǒu gǎnqíng, lián píngwěi dōu bèi dǎdòng le.
sentences.translation: She read aloud with great feeling in the competition, and even the judges were moved.

sentences.chinese: 录音前，他把稿子朗读了几遍，确认语气自然流畅。
sentences.traditional: 錄音前，他把稿子朗讀了幾遍，確認語氣自然流暢。
sentences.pinyin: Lùyīn qián, tā bǎ gǎozi lǎngdú le jǐ biàn, quèrèn yǔqì zìrán liúchàng.
sentences.translation: Before recording, he read the script aloud several times to make sure the tone was natural and smooth.

sentences.chinese: 那个罪犯被关进牢里以后，才开始反思自己的行为。
sentences.traditional: 那個罪犯被關進牢裡以後，才開始反思自己的行為。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge zuìfàn bèi guān jìn láo li yǐhòu, cái kāishǐ fǎnsī zìjǐ de xíngwéi.
sentences.translation: Only after the criminal was put in prison did he begin to reflect on his actions.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥的基础打得很牢，几十年来都没有出现大问题。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋的基礎打得很牢，幾十年來都沒有出現大問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo de jīchǔ dǎ de hěn láo, jǐ shí nián lái dōu méiyǒu chūxiàn dà wèntí.
sentences.translation: The foundation of this bridge was built very solidly, and no major problems have appeared for decades.

sentences.chinese: 请把箱子绑牢，否则在运输途中可能会散开。
sentences.traditional: 請把箱子綁牢，否則在運輸途中可能會散開。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xiāngzi bǎng láo, fǒuzé zài yùnshū túzhōng kěnéng huì sànkāi.
sentences.translation: Please tie the box firmly, otherwise it may come apart during transport.

sentences.chinese: 随着年轻人外出工作，农村劳动力明显减少。
sentences.traditional: 隨著年輕人外出工作，農村勞動力明顯減少。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe niánqīngrén wàichū gōngzuò, nóngcūn láodònglì míngxiǎn jiǎnshǎo.
sentences.translation: As young people leave to work elsewhere, the rural labour force has clearly decreased.

sentences.chinese: 企业引进自动化设备，是为了缓解劳动力不足的压力。
sentences.traditional: 企業引進自動化設備，是為了緩解勞動力不足的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yǐnjìn zìdònghuà shèbèi, shì wèile huǎnjiě láodònglì bùzú de yālì.
sentences.translation: The company introduced automated equipment in order to ease the pressure caused by a shortage of labour.

sentences.chinese: 教育水平提高以后，劳动力的整体素质也会随之提升。
sentences.traditional: 教育水平提高以後，勞動力的整體素質也會隨之提升。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù shuǐpíng tígāo yǐhòu, láodònglì de zhěngtǐ sùzhì yě huì suí zhī tíshēng.
sentences.translation: Once education levels improve, the overall quality of the labour force will also rise accordingly.

sentences.chinese: 他为人老实，不会为了利益故意隐瞒事实。
sentences.traditional: 他為人老實，不會為了利益故意隱瞞事實。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wéirén lǎoshi, bú huì wèile lìyì gùyì yǐnmán shìshí.
sentences.translation: He is honest by nature and would not deliberately hide the facts for personal gain.

sentences.chinese: 孩子今天特别老实，整节课都认真听讲。
sentences.traditional: 孩子今天特別老實，整節課都認真聽講。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi jīntiān tèbié lǎoshi, zhěng jié kè dōu rènzhēn tīngjiǎng.
sentences.translation: The child was especially well-behaved today and listened carefully throughout the whole lesson.

sentences.chinese: 你老实告诉我，这份报告到底是谁写的？
sentences.traditional: 你老實告訴我，這份報告到底是誰寫的？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ lǎoshi gàosu wǒ, zhè fèn bàogào dàodǐ shì shéi xiě de?
sentences.translation: Tell me honestly, who actually wrote this report?

sentences.chinese: 仓库里发现了老鼠，管理人员马上安排了清理和消毒。
sentences.traditional: 倉庫裡發現了老鼠，管理人員馬上安排了清理和消毒。
sentences.pinyin: Cāngkù li fāxiàn le lǎoshǔ, guǎnlǐ rényuán mǎshàng ānpái le qīnglǐ hé xiāodú.
sentences.translation: A mouse was found in the warehouse, so the managers immediately arranged cleaning and disinfection.

sentences.chinese: 这部动画片把老鼠设计得非常聪明，深受孩子欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 這部動畫片把老鼠設計得非常聰明，深受孩子歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù dònghuàpiàn bǎ lǎoshǔ shèjì de fēicháng cōngming, shēn shòu háizi huānyíng.
sentences.translation: This animated film designed the mouse to be very clever, and it is very popular with children.

sentences.chinese: 听到墙角有声音，她怀疑家里进了老鼠。
sentences.traditional: 聽到牆角有聲音，她懷疑家裡進了老鼠。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào qiángjiǎo yǒu shēngyīn, tā huáiyí jiā li jìn le lǎoshǔ.
sentences.translation: Hearing a sound in the corner, she suspected that a mouse had got into the house.

sentences.chinese: 那位老太太每天清晨都会到公园里散步。
sentences.traditional: 那位老太太每天清晨都會到公園裡散步。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai měi tiān qīngchén dōu huì dào gōngyuán li sànbù.
sentences.translation: That old lady goes to the park for a walk every morning.

sentences.chinese: 公交车突然刹车，一位老太太差点摔倒。
sentences.traditional: 公交車突然剎車，一位老太太差點摔倒。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngjiāochē tūrán shāchē, yí wèi lǎotàitai chàdiǎn shuāidǎo.
sentences.translation: The bus braked suddenly, and an old lady almost fell over.

sentences.chinese: 邻居们都很尊敬这位老太太，因为她年轻时帮助过很多人。
sentences.traditional: 鄰居們都很尊敬這位老太太，因為她年輕時幫助過很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Línjūmen dōu hěn zūnjìng zhè wèi lǎotàitai, yīnwèi tā niánqīng shí bāngzhù guo hěn duō rén.
sentences.translation: The neighbours all respect this old lady because she helped many people when she was young.

sentences.chinese: 他乐于分享经验，所以新员工遇到问题都愿意请教他。
sentences.traditional: 他樂於分享經驗，所以新員工遇到問題都願意請教他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lèyú fēnxiǎng jīngyàn, suǒyǐ xīn yuángōng yùdào wèntí dōu yuànyì qǐngjiào tā.
sentences.translation: He is happy to share his experience, so new employees are willing to ask him for advice when they run into problems.

sentences.chinese: 优秀的管理者往往乐于倾听不同意见，而不是急着否定别人。
sentences.traditional: 優秀的管理者往往樂於傾聽不同意見，而不是急著否定別人。
sentences.pinyin: Yōuxiù de guǎnlǐzhě wǎngwǎng lèyú qīngtīng bùtóng yìjiàn, ér bú shì jízhe fǒudìng biérén.
sentences.translation: Good managers are often willing to listen to different opinions instead of rushing to reject others.

sentences.chinese: 这个社区的居民乐于参与公益活动，彼此关系很融洽。
sentences.traditional: 這個社區的居民樂於參與公益活動，彼此關係很融洽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèqū de jūmín lèyú cānyù gōngyì huódòng, bǐcǐ guānxì hěn róngqià.
sentences.translation: The residents of this community are willing to take part in public-interest activities, and their relationships are harmonious.

sentences.chinese: 半夜一声雷把孩子吓醒了，窗外很快下起大雨。
sentences.traditional: 半夜一聲雷把孩子嚇醒了，窗外很快下起大雨。
sentences.pinyin: Bànyè yì shēng léi bǎ háizi xià xǐng le, chuāngwài hěn kuài xià qǐ dàyǔ.
sentences.translation: A clap of thunder woke the child in the middle of the night, and soon it began raining heavily outside.

sentences.chinese: 远处的雷越来越响，登山队决定立刻下山。
sentences.traditional: 遠處的雷越來越響，登山隊決定立刻下山。
sentences.pinyin: Yuǎnchù de léi yuè lái yuè xiǎng, dēngshān duì juédìng lìkè xià shān.
sentences.translation: The thunder in the distance grew louder and louder, so the climbing team decided to go down the mountain at once.

sentences.chinese: 听见雷以后，工作人员马上暂停了户外竞赛。
sentences.traditional: 聽見雷以後，工作人員馬上暫停了戶外競賽。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngjiàn léi yǐhòu, gōngzuò rényuán mǎshàng zàntíng le hùwài jìngsài.
sentences.translation: After hearing thunder, the staff immediately suspended the outdoor competition.

sentences.chinese: 这些文件要按照类别整理，否则以后很难查找。
sentences.traditional: 這些文件要按照類別整理，否則以後很難查找。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē wénjiàn yào ànzhào lèibié zhěnglǐ, fǒuzé yǐhòu hěn nán cházhǎo.
sentences.translation: These documents need to be organised by category, otherwise they will be difficult to find later.

sentences.chinese: 不同类别的商品适用不同的税率，录入时不能混淆。
sentences.traditional: 不同類別的商品適用不同的稅率，錄入時不能混淆。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng lèibié de shāngpǐn shìyòng bùtóng de shuìlǜ, lùrù shí bù néng hùnxiáo.
sentences.translation: Different categories of goods are subject to different tax rates, so they must not be confused when entered.

sentences.chinese: 调查问卷把年龄分成几个类别，以便后续分析。
sentences.traditional: 調查問卷把年齡分成幾個類別，以便後續分析。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá wènjuàn bǎ niánlíng fēn chéng jǐ ge lèibié, yǐbiàn hòuxù fēnxī.
sentences.translation: The questionnaire divides age into several categories to make later analysis easier.

sentences.chinese: 他说得很有理，大家听完以后都改变了看法。
sentences.traditional: 他說得很有理，大家聽完以後都改變了看法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō de hěn yǒu lǐ, dàjiā tīng wán yǐhòu dōu gǎibiàn le kànfǎ.
sentences.translation: What he said made a lot of sense, and everyone changed their view after listening.

sentences.chinese: 这件事由她来理，比让外人插手更合适。
sentences.traditional: 這件事由她來理，比讓外人插手更合適。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yóu tā lái lǐ, bǐ ràng wàirén chāshǒu gèng héshì.
sentences.translation: It is more appropriate for her to handle this matter than to let an outsider interfere.

sentences.chinese: 即便情绪很激动，我们也要讲理，不能只靠声音大。
sentences.traditional: 即便情緒很激動，我們也要講理，不能只靠聲音大。
sentences.pinyin: Jíbiàn qíngxù hěn jīdòng, wǒmen yě yào jiǎng lǐ, bù néng zhǐ kào shēngyīn dà.
sentences.translation: Even if emotions are running high, we still need to be reasonable and not rely only on being loud.

sentences.chinese: 他开始理财以后，才意识到记录每一笔支出有多重要。
sentences.traditional: 他開始理財以後，才意識到記錄每一筆支出有多重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ lǐcái yǐhòu, cái yìshí dào jìlù měi yì bǐ zhīchū yǒu duō zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: After he started managing his money, he realised how important it is to record every expense.

sentences.chinese: 这门课程教年轻人如何理财，避免过度借款。
sentences.traditional: 這門課程教年輕人如何理財，避免過度借款。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng jiāo niánqīngrén rúhé lǐcái, bìmiǎn guòdù jièkuǎn.
sentences.translation: This course teaches young people how to manage their money and avoid excessive borrowing.

sentences.chinese: 家庭收入稳定以后，他们更重视长期理财规划。
sentences.traditional: 家庭收入穩定以後，他們更重視長期理財規劃。
sentences.pinyin: Jiātíng shōurù wěndìng yǐhòu, tāmen gèng zhòngshì chángqī lǐcái guīhuà.
sentences.translation: After the household income became stable, they paid more attention to long-term financial planning.

sentences.chinese: 他高中时选择理科，因为对物理和化学特别感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 他高中時選擇理科，因為對物理和化學特別感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāozhōng shí xuǎnzé lǐkē, yīnwèi duì wùlǐ hé huàxué tèbié gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: He chose the sciences in high school because he was especially interested in physics and chemistry.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校的理科成绩一直很突出，吸引了许多家长。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校的理科成績一直很突出，吸引了許多家長。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào de lǐkē chéngjì yìzhí hěn tūchū, xīyǐn le xǔduō jiāzhǎng.
sentences.translation: This school’s science results have always been outstanding, attracting many parents.

sentences.chinese: 理科训练不仅需要计算能力，也需要清晰的逻辑思维。
sentences.traditional: 理科訓練不僅需要計算能力，也需要清晰的邏輯思維。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐkē xùnliàn bùjǐn xūyào jìsuàn nénglì, yě xūyào qīngxī de luójí sīwéi.
sentences.translation: Science training requires not only calculation ability but also clear logical thinking.

sentences.chinese: 公司的管理理念发生变化后，员工的参与度明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 公司的管理理念發生變化後，員工的參與度明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī de guǎnlǐ lǐniàn fāshēng biànhuà hòu, yuángōng de cānyùdù míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: After the company’s management philosophy changed, employee participation clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 这位设计师把环保理念融入了每一个细节。
sentences.traditional: 這位設計師把環保理念融入了每一個細節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèjìshī bǎ huánbǎo lǐniàn róngrù le měi yí ge xìjié.
sentences.translation: This designer incorporated environmental ideas into every detail.

sentences.chinese: 教育理念如果只停留在口号上，就很难真正改变课堂。
sentences.traditional: 教育理念如果只停留在口號上，就很難真正改變課堂。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù lǐniàn rúguǒ zhǐ tíngliú zài kǒuhào shang, jiù hěn nán zhēnzhèng gǎibiàn kètáng.
sentences.translation: If educational ideas remain only as slogans, it is hard to truly change the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 面对激烈的争论，我们需要保持理性，而不是互相攻击。
sentences.traditional: 面對激烈的爭論，我們需要保持理性，而不是互相攻擊。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jīliè de zhēnglùn, wǒmen xūyào bǎochí lǐxìng, ér bú shì hùxiāng gōngjī.
sentences.translation: Faced with intense debate, we need to remain rational rather than attack one another.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然很生气，但最后还是作出了理性的决定。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然很生氣，但最後還是作出了理性的決定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn shēngqì, dàn zuìhòu háishi zuòchū le lǐxìng de juédìng.
sentences.translation: Although he was very angry, he still made a rational decision in the end.

sentences.chinese: 科学研究强调证据和理性，不能只依赖直觉。
sentences.traditional: 科學研究強調證據和理性，不能只依賴直覺。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū qiángdiào zhèngjù hé lǐxìng, bù néng zhǐ yīlài zhíjué.
sentences.translation: Scientific research emphasises evidence and reason, and cannot rely only on intuition.

sentences.chinese: 大厅中央立着一块纪念碑，记录了这座城市的历史。
sentences.traditional: 大廳中央立著一塊紀念碑，記錄了這座城市的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Dàtīng zhōngyāng lì zhe yí kuài jìniànbēi, jìlù le zhè zuò chéngshì de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: A monument stands in the centre of the hall, recording the history of the city.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划在新区立一所职业学校，培养技术人才。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃在新區立一所職業學校，培養技術人才。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà zài xīnqū lì yì suǒ zhíyè xuéxiào, péiyǎng jìshù réncái.
sentences.translation: The government plans to set up a vocational school in the new district to train technical talent.

sentences.chinese: 他在会议上立下承诺，年底前完成改革方案。
sentences.traditional: 他在會議上立下承諾，年底前完成改革方案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shang lì xià chéngnuò, niándǐ qián wánchéng gǎigé fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: At the meeting, he made a commitment to complete the reform plan before the end of the year.

sentences.chinese: 她把每一粒种子都埋进土里，希望春天能发芽。
sentences.traditional: 她把每一粒種子都埋進土裡，希望春天能發芽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ měi yì lì zhǒngzi dōu mái jìn tǔ li, xīwàng chūntiān néng fāyá.
sentences.translation: She buried every seed in the soil, hoping they would sprout in spring.

sentences.chinese: 药瓶里只剩三粒药，明天必须再去配一些。
sentences.traditional: 藥瓶裡只剩三粒藥，明天必須再去配一些。
sentences.pinyin: Yàopíng li zhǐ shèng sān lì yào, míngtiān bìxū zài qù pèi yìxiē.
sentences.translation: There are only three pills left in the bottle, so some more must be collected tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 这批米的每一粒都很饱满，质量比去年好多了。
sentences.traditional: 這批米的每一粒都很飽滿，質量比去年好多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī mǐ de měi yì lì dōu hěn bǎomǎn, zhìliàng bǐ qùnián hǎo duō le.
sentences.translation: Every grain of this batch of rice is full, and the quality is much better than last year.

sentences.chinese: 在这个问题上，他的立场一直很明确，没有轻易改变。
sentences.traditional: 在這個問題上，他的立場一直很明確，沒有輕易改變。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shang, tā de lìchǎng yìzhí hěn míngquè, méiyǒu qīngyì gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: On this issue, his position has always been clear and has not changed easily.

sentences.chinese: 谈判前，双方都需要说明自己的立场和底线。
sentences.traditional: 談判前，雙方都需要說明自己的立場和底線。
sentences.pinyin: Tánpàn qián, shuāngfāng dōu xūyào shuōmíng zìjǐ de lìchǎng hé dǐxiàn.
sentences.translation: Before negotiations, both sides need to state their position and bottom line.

sentences.chinese: 媒体报道应尽量客观，不能只代表某一方的立场。
sentences.traditional: 媒體報導應盡量客觀，不能只代表某一方的立場。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ bàodǎo yīng jǐnliàng kèguān, bù néng zhǐ dàibiǎo mǒu yì fāng de lìchǎng.
sentences.translation: Media reports should be as objective as possible and must not represent only one side’s position.

sentences.chinese: 政府加大了监管力度，以减少类似事故再次发生。
sentences.traditional: 政府加大了監管力度，以減少類似事故再次發生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiādà le jiānguǎn lìdù, yǐ jiǎnshǎo lèisì shìgù zàicì fāshēng.
sentences.translation: The government increased the intensity of supervision in order to reduce the recurrence of similar accidents.

sentences.chinese: 如果宣传力度不够，新政策很难被公众理解。
sentences.traditional: 如果宣傳力度不夠，新政策很難被公眾理解。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xuānchuán lìdù bú gòu, xīn zhèngcè hěn nán bèi gōngzhòng lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: If the publicity effort is not strong enough, the new policy will be hard for the public to understand.

sentences.chinese: 这次改革的力度比预期更大，许多部门都受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 這次改革的力度比預期更大，許多部門都受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gǎigé de lìdù bǐ yùqī gèng dà, xǔduō bùmén dōu shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The intensity of this reform is greater than expected, and many departments have been affected.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业历经多次危机，仍然坚持自主研发。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業歷經多次危機，仍然堅持自主研發。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè lìjīng duō cì wēijī, réngrán jiānchí zìzhǔ yánfā.
sentences.translation: This company has gone through many crises and still insists on independent research and development.

sentences.chinese: 这条古道历经千年风雨，至今仍保留着原来的石阶。
sentences.traditional: 這條古道歷經千年風雨，至今仍保留著原來的石階。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gǔdào lìjīng qiān nián fēngyǔ, zhìjīn réng bǎoliú zhe yuánlái de shíjiē.
sentences.translation: This ancient path has endured a thousand years of wind and rain, and still retains its original stone steps.

sentences.chinese: 他历经失败和质疑，最终完成了这项艰难的研究。
sentences.traditional: 他歷經失敗和質疑，最終完成了這項艱難的研究。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lìjīng shībài hé zhìyí, zuìzhōng wánchéng le zhè xiàng jiānnán de yánjiū.
sentences.translation: He went through failure and doubt, and finally completed this difficult research project.

sentences.chinese: 学校把历年考试题整理成册，供学生复习参考。
sentences.traditional: 學校把歷年考試題整理成冊，供學生複習參考。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bǎ lìnián kǎoshì tí zhěnglǐ chéng cè, gōng xuéshēng fùxí cānkǎo.
sentences.translation: The school organised past years’ exam questions into a booklet for students to use when revising.

sentences.chinese: 历年的销售数据表明，冬季需求通常会上升。
sentences.traditional: 歷年的銷售數據表明，冬季需求通常會上升。
sentences.pinyin: Lìnián de xiāoshòu shùjù biǎomíng, dōngjì xūqiú tōngcháng huì shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: Sales data over the years shows that demand usually rises in winter.

sentences.chinese: 这座博物馆保存了历年活动的照片和记录。
sentences.traditional: 這座博物館保存了歷年活動的照片和記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò bówùguǎn bǎocún le lìnián huódòng de zhàopiàn hé jìlù.
sentences.translation: This museum has preserved photos and records of events over the years.

sentences.chinese: 公司的报销规定很严格，任何人都不能例外。
sentences.traditional: 公司的報銷規定很嚴格，任何人都不能例外。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī de bàoxiāo guīdìng hěn yángé, rènhé rén dōu bù néng lìwài.
sentences.translation: The company’s reimbursement rules are strict, and no one can be an exception.

sentences.chinese: 在这项政策中，儿童和老人被列为例外情况。
sentences.traditional: 在這項政策中，兒童和老人被列為例外情況。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè xiàng zhèngcè zhōng, értóng hé lǎorén bèi lièwéi lìwài qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: In this policy, children and elderly people are listed as exceptional cases.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有特殊原因，迟到不会被视为例外。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有特殊原因，遲到不會被視為例外。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu tèshū yuányīn, chídào bú huì bèi shìwéi lìwài.
sentences.translation: Without a special reason, being late will not be treated as an exception.

sentences.chinese: 这笔贷款的利息不高，但还款期限比较短。
sentences.traditional: 這筆貸款的利息不高，但還款期限比較短。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ dàikuǎn de lìxī bù gāo, dàn huánkuǎn qīxiàn bǐjiào duǎn.
sentences.translation: The interest on this loan is not high, but the repayment period is relatively short.

sentences.chinese: 银行会根据账户余额计算每月利息。
sentences.traditional: 銀行會根據帳戶餘額計算每月利息。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng huì gēnjù zhànghù yú'é jìsuàn měi yuè lìxī.
sentences.translation: The bank calculates the monthly interest according to the account balance.

sentences.chinese: 如果提前还清欠款，就可以少付一些利息。
sentences.traditional: 如果提前還清欠款，就可以少付一些利息。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tíqián huánqīng qiànkuǎn, jiù kěyǐ shǎo fù yìxiē lìxī.
sentences.translation: If the debt is paid off early, less interest can be paid.

sentences.chinese: 联合国呼吁各国加强合作，共同应对气候变化。
sentences.traditional: 聯合國呼籲各國加強合作，共同應對氣候變化。
sentences.pinyin: Liánhéguó hūyù gè guó jiāqiáng hézuò, gòngtóng yìngduì qìhòu biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The United Nations called on all countries to strengthen cooperation and respond jointly to climate change.

sentences.chinese: 她大学毕业后，希望到联合国实习，参与国际项目。
sentences.traditional: 她大學畢業後，希望到聯合國實習，參與國際項目。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè hòu, xīwàng dào Liánhéguó shíxí, cānyù guójì xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: After graduating from university, she hopes to intern at the United Nations and take part in international projects.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告引用了联合国关于人口发展的最新数据。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告引用了聯合國關於人口發展的最新數據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào yǐnyòng le Liánhéguó guānyú rénkǒu fāzhǎn de zuìxīn shùjù.
sentences.translation: This report quoted the latest United Nations data on population development.

sentences.chinese: 新设备必须先联网，才能完成系统更新。
sentences.traditional: 新設備必須先聯網，才能完成系統更新。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn shèbèi bìxū xiān liánwǎng, cái néng wánchéng xìtǒng gēngxīn.
sentences.translation: The new device must connect to the internet first before it can complete the system update.

sentences.chinese: 这些监测仪器联网以后，数据可以实时传回基地。
sentences.traditional: 這些監測儀器聯網以後，數據可以實時傳回基地。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiāncè yíqì liánwǎng yǐhòu, shùjù kěyǐ shíshí chuán huí jīdì.
sentences.translation: After these monitoring instruments are networked, the data can be sent back to the base in real time.

sentences.chinese: 偏远地区学校联网困难，影响了线上课程的开展。
sentences.traditional: 偏遠地區學校聯網困難，影響了線上課程的開展。
sentences.pinyin: Piānyuǎn dìqū xuéxiào liánwǎng kùnnan, yǐngxiǎng le xiànshàng kèchéng de kāizhǎn.
sentences.translation: Schools in remote areas have difficulty connecting to the internet, which affects the development of online courses.

sentences.chinese: 一听到这首歌，我就联想到高中毕业那天的情景。
sentences.traditional: 一聽到這首歌，我就聯想到高中畢業那天的情景。
sentences.pinyin: Yì tīng dào zhè shǒu gē, wǒ jiù liánxiǎng dào gāozhōng bìyè nà tiān de qíngjǐng.
sentences.translation: As soon as I hear this song, I associate it with the scene on the day of my high school graduation.

sentences.chinese: 这个品牌的名字容易让人联想到健康和自然。
sentences.traditional: 這個品牌的名字容易讓人聯想到健康和自然。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái de míngzi róngyì ràng rén liánxiǎng dào jiànkāng hé zìrán.
sentences.translation: The name of this brand easily makes people associate it with health and nature.

sentences.chinese: 设计师希望这个颜色能让人联想到海岸、阳光和清新的空气。
sentences.traditional: 設計師希望這個顏色能讓人聯想到海岸、陽光和清新的空氣。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī xīwàng zhège yánsè néng ràng rén liánxiǎng dào hǎi'àn, yángguāng hé qīngxīn de kōngqì.
sentences.translation: The designer hopes this colour can make people think of the coast, sunshine, and fresh air.

sentences.chinese: 请把会议资料的链接发到工作群里。
sentences.traditional: 請把會議資料的鏈接發到工作群裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ huìyì zīliào de liànjiē fā dào gōngzuò qún lǐ.
sentences.translation: Please send the link to the meeting materials to the work group chat.

sentences.chinese: 这个网页的链接已经失效，无法打开。
sentences.traditional: 這個網頁的鏈接已經失效，無法打開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngyè de liànjiē yǐjīng shīxiào, wúfǎ dǎkāi.
sentences.translation: The link for this webpage has already expired and cannot be opened.

sentences.chinese: 老师在课后把阅读材料链接到了班级平台。
sentences.traditional: 老師在課後把閱讀材料鏈接到了班級平臺。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài kè hòu bǎ yuèdú cáiliào liànjiē dào le bānjí píngtái.
sentences.translation: After class, the teacher linked the reading materials to the class platform.

sentences.chinese: 这座大桥连接了两岸的工业区和居民区。
sentences.traditional: 這座大橋連接了兩岸的工業區和居民區。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàqiáo liánjiē le liǎng'àn de gōngyèqū hé jūmínqū.
sentences.translation: This bridge connects the industrial and residential areas on both sides.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，两岸亲友通过视频互相拜年。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，兩岸親友通過視頻互相拜年。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, liǎng'àn qīnyǒu tōngguò shìpín hùxiāng bàinián.
sentences.translation: During the Spring Festival, relatives and friends on both sides greeted one another by video.

sentences.chinese: 河水上涨以后，两岸的低洼地都被淹了。
sentences.traditional: 河水上漲以後，兩岸的低窪地都被淹了。
sentences.pinyin: Héshuǐ shàngzhǎng yǐhòu, liǎng'àn de dīwādì dōu bèi yān le.
sentences.translation: After the river rose, the low-lying land on both banks was flooded.

sentences.chinese: 他的评价呈现两极分化：有人很喜欢，也有人强烈反对。
sentences.traditional: 他的評價呈現兩極分化：有人很喜歡，也有人強烈反對。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de píngjià chéngxiàn liǎngjí fēnhuà: yǒu rén hěn xǐhuan, yě yǒu rén qiángliè fǎnduì.
sentences.translation: Opinions about him show polarisation: some people like him very much, while others strongly oppose him.

sentences.chinese: 地球的两极对气候变化特别敏感。
sentences.traditional: 地球的兩極對氣候變化特別敏感。
sentences.pinyin: Dìqiú de liǎngjí duì qìhòu biànhuà tèbié mǐngǎn.
sentences.translation: The Earth’s two poles are especially sensitive to climate change.

sentences.chinese: 收入差距如果继续扩大，社会可能会走向两极。
sentences.traditional: 收入差距如果繼續擴大，社會可能會走向兩極。
sentences.pinyin: Shōurù chājù rúguǒ jìxù kuòdà, shèhuì kěnéng huì zǒuxiàng liǎngjí.
sentences.translation: If the income gap keeps widening, society may move towards two extremes.

sentences.chinese: 雨停后，她把湿衣服拿到阳台上晾。
sentences.traditional: 雨停後，她把濕衣服拿到陽臺上晾。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tíng hòu, tā bǎ shī yīfu ná dào yángtái shang liàng.
sentences.translation: After the rain stopped, she took the wet clothes to the balcony to air-dry.

sentences.chinese: 这些草药需要先晾干，再装进密封袋。
sentences.traditional: 這些草藥需要先晾乾，再裝進密封袋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē cǎoyào xūyào xiān liàng gān, zài zhuāng jìn mìfēng dài.
sentences.translation: These herbs need to be dried first and then put into sealed bags.

sentences.chinese: 面条煮好后要稍微晾一下，口感才更好。
sentences.traditional: 麵條煮好後要稍微晾一下，口感才更好。
sentences.pinyin: Miàntiáo zhǔ hǎo hòu yào shāowēi liàng yíxià, kǒugǎn cái gèng hǎo.
sentences.translation: After the noodles are cooked, let them cool a little so the texture is better.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套的料很厚，适合冬天穿。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套的料很厚，適合冬天穿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào de liào hěn hòu, shìhé dōngtiān chuān.
sentences.translation: The material of this coat is thick, so it is suitable for winter.

sentences.chinese: 做这道菜要先备好料，否则炒的时候会手忙脚乱。
sentences.traditional: 做這道菜要先備好料，否則炒的時候會手忙腳亂。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò zhè dào cài yào xiān bèi hǎo liào, fǒuzé chǎo de shíhou huì shǒumáng jiǎoluàn.
sentences.translation: When making this dish, you need to prepare the ingredients first; otherwise you will be in a rush when stir-frying.

sentences.chinese: 厂家换了新的料，产品的质感明显提升。
sentences.traditional: 廠家換了新的料，產品的質感明顯提升。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎngjiā huàn le xīn de liào, chǎnpǐn de zhìgǎn míngxiǎn tíshēng.
sentences.translation: After the manufacturer changed to a new material, the feel of the product clearly improved.

sentences.chinese: 我早就料到这个方案会遇到阻力，所以提前准备了备用计划。
sentences.traditional: 我早就料到這個方案會遇到阻力，所以提前準備了備用計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo jiù liào dào zhège fāng'àn huì yùdào zǔlì, suǒyǐ tíqián zhǔnbèi le bèiyòng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: I had long anticipated that this plan would meet resistance, so I prepared a backup plan in advance.

sentences.chinese: 他没有料到一场小雨竟然让比赛被迫延期。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有料到一場小雨竟然讓比賽被迫延期。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu liào dào yì chǎng xiǎoyǔ jìngrán ràng bǐsài bèipò yánqī.
sentences.translation: He did not expect that a light rain would actually force the match to be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 谁也料不到市场变化会这么快。
sentences.traditional: 誰也料不到市場變化會這麼快。
sentences.pinyin: Shéi yě liào bu dào shìchǎng biànhuà huì zhème kuài.
sentences.translation: No one could have anticipated that the market would change so quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他忘了带伞，被突如其来的大雨淋得浑身湿透。
sentences.traditional: 他忘了帶傘，被突如其來的大雨淋得渾身濕透。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wàng le dài sǎn, bèi tūrúqílái de dàyǔ lín de húnshēn shītòu.
sentences.translation: He forgot to bring an umbrella and was soaked through by the sudden heavy rain.

sentences.chinese: 厨师把热油淋在鱼身上，香味一下子散开了。
sentences.traditional: 廚師把熱油淋在魚身上，香味一下子散開了。
sentences.pinyin: Chúshī bǎ rè yóu lín zài yú shēn shang, xiāngwèi yíxiàzi sàn kāi le.
sentences.translation: The chef poured hot oil over the fish, and the aroma spread immediately.

sentences.chinese: 这片草地每天清晨都会被喷头淋上一层水。
sentences.traditional: 這片草地每天清晨都會被噴頭淋上一層水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn cǎodì měitiān qīngchén dōu huì bèi pēntóu lín shang yì céng shuǐ.
sentences.translation: This patch of grass is sprayed with a layer of water by the sprinkler every morning.

sentences.chinese: 凌晨三点，救援队仍在山里搜索失踪人员。
sentences.traditional: 凌晨三點，救援隊仍在山裡搜索失蹤人員。
sentences.pinyin: Língchén sān diǎn, jiùyuán duì réng zài shān lǐ sōusuǒ shīzōng rényuán.
sentences.translation: At three in the early morning, the rescue team was still searching the mountains for the missing person.

sentences.chinese: 他习惯在凌晨写作，因为那时周围最安静。
sentences.traditional: 他習慣在凌晨寫作，因為那時周圍最安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài língchén xiězuò, yīnwèi nà shí zhōuwéi zuì ānjìng.
sentences.translation: He is used to writing in the early morning because the surroundings are quietest then.

sentences.chinese: 航班延误到凌晨才起飞，乘客都很疲惫。
sentences.traditional: 航班延誤到凌晨才起飛，乘客都很疲憊。
sentences.pinyin: Hángbān yánwù dào língchén cái qǐfēi, chéngkè dōu hěn píbèi.
sentences.translation: The flight was delayed until the early morning before taking off, and all the passengers were exhausted.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少错误，公司重新设计了报销流程。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少錯誤，公司重新設計了報銷流程。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo cuòwù, gōngsī chóngxīn shèjì le bàoxiāo liúchéng.
sentences.translation: In order to reduce errors, the company redesigned the reimbursement process.

sentences.chinese: 新员工入职前，需要先熟悉各部门的工作流程。
sentences.traditional: 新員工入職前，需要先熟悉各部門的工作流程。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng rùzhí qián, xūyào xiān shúxī gè bùmén de gōngzuò liúchéng.
sentences.translation: Before starting work, new employees need to become familiar with each department’s work process.

sentences.chinese: 这个审批流程太复杂，影响了项目进度。
sentences.traditional: 這個審批流程太複雜，影響了項目進度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shěnpī liúchéng tài fùzá, yǐngxiǎng le xiàngmù jìndù.
sentences.translation: This approval process is too complicated and has affected the project’s progress.

sentences.chinese: 节假日期间，城市人口流动明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 節假日期間，城市人口流動明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéjiàrì qījiān, chéngshì rénkǒu liúdòng míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: During public holidays, population movement in the city increases noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 空气不流动的房间容易让人感到沉闷。
sentences.traditional: 空氣不流動的房間容易讓人感到沉悶。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngqì bù liúdòng de fángjiān róngyì ràng rén gǎndào chénmèn.
sentences.translation: A room where the air does not circulate can easily make people feel stuffy.

sentences.chinese: 资金在市场中快速流动，带来了新的投资机会。
sentences.traditional: 資金在市場中快速流動，帶來了新的投資機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zījīn zài shìchǎng zhōng kuàisù liúdòng, dàilái le xīn de tóuzī jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Capital flowed quickly through the market, bringing new investment opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 如果网页打不开，先换一个浏览器试试。
sentences.traditional: 如果網頁打不開，先換一個瀏覽器試試。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǎngyè dǎ bù kāi, xiān huàn yí ge liúlǎnqì shìshi.
sentences.translation: If the webpage will not open, try changing to another browser first.

sentences.chinese: 这个浏览器会自动阻止不安全的链接。
sentences.traditional: 這個瀏覽器會自動阻止不安全的鏈接。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège liúlǎnqì huì zìdòng zǔzhǐ bù ānquán de liànjiē.
sentences.translation: This browser automatically blocks unsafe links.

sentences.chinese: 公司要求员工定期更新浏览器，以避免安全风险。
sentences.traditional: 公司要求員工定期更新瀏覽器，以避免安全風險。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú yuángōng dìngqī gēngxīn liúlǎnqì, yǐ bìmiǎn ānquán fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The company requires employees to update their browser regularly to avoid security risks.

sentences.chinese: 这个网站的流量突然上升，系统一度无法承受。
sentences.traditional: 這個網站的流量突然上升，系統一度無法承受。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn de liúliàng tūrán shàngshēng, xìtǒng yídù wúfǎ chéngshòu.
sentences.translation: Traffic to this website suddenly increased, and the system could not handle it for a while.

sentences.chinese: 他每个月都要购买额外的手机流量。
sentences.traditional: 他每個月都要購買額外的手機流量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè dōu yào gòumǎi éwài de shǒujī liúliàng.
sentences.translation: He has to buy extra mobile data every month.

sentences.chinese: 水库会根据河道流量调整放水速度。
sentences.traditional: 水庫會根據河道流量調整放水速度。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐkù huì gēnjù hédào liúliàng tiáozhěng fàngshuǐ sùdù.
sentences.translation: The reservoir adjusts the speed of water release according to the river flow rate.

sentences.chinese: 大量资金流入新能源行业，推动了技术创新。
sentences.traditional: 大量資金流入新能源行業，推動了技術創新。
sentences.pinyin: Dàliàng zījīn liúrù xīn néngyuán hángyè, tuīdòng le jìshù chuàngxīn.
sentences.translation: Large amounts of capital flowed into the new energy industry, driving technological innovation.

sentences.chinese: 雨水通过排水管流入附近的河道。
sentences.traditional: 雨水通過排水管流入附近的河道。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔshuǐ tōngguò páishuǐguǎn liúrù fùjìn de hédào.
sentences.translation: Rainwater flows through the drainpipe into the nearby watercourse.

sentences.chinese: 外来人口不断流入，使城市公共服务压力加大。
sentences.traditional: 外來人口不斷流入，使城市公共服務壓力加大。
sentences.pinyin: Wàilái rénkǒu búduàn liúrù, shǐ chéngshì gōnggòng fúwù yālì jiādà.
sentences.translation: The continuous inflow of people from outside has increased pressure on the city’s public services.

sentences.chinese: 货币只有在市场中流通，才能发挥作用。
sentences.traditional: 貨幣只有在市場中流通，才能發揮作用。
sentences.pinyin: Huòbì zhǐyǒu zài shìchǎng zhōng liútōng, cái néng fāhuī zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Currency can only play its role when it circulates in the market.

sentences.chinese: 这条新公路改善了农产品的流通效率。
sentences.traditional: 這條新公路改善了農產品的流通效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xīn gōnglù gǎishàn le nóngchǎnpǐn de liútōng xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: This new road has improved the circulation efficiency of agricultural products.

sentences.chinese: 信息流通不畅，会导致决策严重滞后。
sentences.traditional: 信息流通不暢，會導致決策嚴重滯後。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnxī liútōng bú chàng, huì dǎozhì juécè yánzhòng zhìhòu.
sentences.translation: Poor circulation of information can lead to serious delays in decision-making.

sentences.chinese: 请不要把自行车停在楼道里，以免影响逃生。
sentences.traditional: 請不要把自行車停在樓道裡，以免影響逃生。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào bǎ zìxíngchē tíng zài lóudào lǐ, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng táoshēng.
sentences.translation: Please do not park bicycles in the corridor, so as not to affect escape routes.

sentences.chinese: 深夜的楼道很安静，只能听见电梯运行的声音。
sentences.traditional: 深夜的樓道很安靜，只能聽見電梯運行的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnyè de lóudào hěn ānjìng, zhǐ néng tīngjiàn diàntī yùnxíng de shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: The corridor was very quiet late at night, and only the sound of the lift running could be heard.

sentences.chinese: 物业在楼道安装了新的照明设备。
sentences.traditional: 物業在樓道安裝了新的照明設備。
sentences.pinyin: Wùyè zài lóudào ānzhuāng le xīn de zhàomíng shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The property management company installed new lighting equipment in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 他一紧张就容易露出真实想法。
sentences.traditional: 他一緊張就容易露出真實想法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì jǐnzhāng jiù róngyì lòu chū zhēnshí xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.translation: As soon as he gets nervous, he easily reveals his true thoughts.

sentences.chinese: 演员不小心露了口音，被观众认出来自哪里。
sentences.traditional: 演員不小心露了口音，被觀眾認出來自哪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnyuán bù xiǎoxīn lòu le kǒuyīn, bèi guānzhòng rèn chū láizì nǎlǐ.
sentences.translation: The actor accidentally revealed his accent, and the audience recognised where he was from.

sentences.chinese: 他藏得很深，但最后还是露了马脚。
sentences.traditional: 他藏得很深，但最後還是露了馬腳。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cáng de hěn shēn, dàn zuìhòu háishì lòu le mǎjiǎo.
sentences.translation: He hid it very well, but in the end he still gave himself away.

sentences.chinese: 合同里有一个明显的漏洞，可能会引起纠纷。
sentences.traditional: 合同裡有一個明顯的漏洞，可能會引起糾紛。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong lǐ yǒu yí ge míngxiǎn de lòudòng, kěnéng huì yǐnqǐ jiūfēn.
sentences.translation: There is an obvious loophole in the contract, which may cause a dispute.

sentences.chinese: 系统更新修复了多个安全漏洞。
sentences.traditional: 系統更新修復了多個安全漏洞。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng gēngxīn xiūfù le duō ge ānquán lòudòng.
sentences.translation: The system update fixed several security vulnerabilities.

sentences.chinese: 这个解释听起来合理，其实存在逻辑漏洞。
sentences.traditional: 這個解釋聽起來合理，其實存在邏輯漏洞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiěshì tīng qǐlái hélǐ, qíshí cúnzài luójí lòudòng.
sentences.translation: This explanation sounds reasonable, but it actually contains a logical flaw.

sentences.chinese: 云散开后，远处的山峰慢慢露出轮廓。
sentences.traditional: 雲散開後，遠處的山峰慢慢露出輪廓。
sentences.pinyin: Yún sàn kāi hòu, yuǎnchù de shānfēng mànmàn lù chū lúnkuò.
sentences.translation: After the clouds dispersed, the distant mountain peaks slowly revealed their outline.

sentences.chinese: 他的话虽然很短，却露出对未来的担忧。
sentences.traditional: 他的話雖然很短，卻露出對未來的擔憂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de huà suīrán hěn duǎn, què lù chū duì wèilái de dānyōu.
sentences.translation: Although his words were brief, they revealed his worries about the future.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告露出了管理上的深层问题。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告露出了管理上的深層問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào lù chū le guǎnlǐ shang de shēncéng wèntí.
sentences.translation: This report revealed deeper problems in management.

sentences.chinese: 从车站到景区的路程大约需要两个小时。
sentences.traditional: 從車站到景區的路程大約需要兩個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng chēzhàn dào jǐngqū de lùchéng dàyuē xūyào liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: The journey from the station to the scenic area takes about two hours.

sentences.chinese: 这段路程虽然不远，但山路很陡。
sentences.traditional: 這段路程雖然不遠，但山路很陡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn lùchéng suīrán bù yuǎn, dàn shānlù hěn dǒu.
sentences.translation: Although this part of the journey is not far, the mountain road is very steep.

sentences.chinese: 导航会根据路程和路况选择最省时的路线。
sentences.traditional: 導航會根據路程和路況選擇最省時的路線。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoháng huì gēnjù lùchéng hé lùkuàng xuǎnzé zuì shěngshí de lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: Navigation will choose the most time-saving route based on the distance and road conditions.

sentences.chinese: 出发前最好查看一下高速公路的路况。
sentences.traditional: 出發前最好查看一下高速公路的路況。
sentences.pinyin: Chūfā qián zuìhǎo chákàn yíxià gāosù gōnglù de lùkuàng.
sentences.translation: Before setting off, it is best to check the motorway conditions.

sentences.chinese: 今天早高峰路况很差，很多路段都堵车。
sentences.traditional: 今天早高峰路況很差，很多路段都堵車。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎo gāofēng lùkuàng hěn chà, hěn duō lùduàn dōu dǔchē.
sentences.translation: Road conditions were very poor during this morning’s rush hour, and many sections were congested.

sentences.chinese: 司机根据实时路况改变了原来的行驶路线。
sentences.traditional: 司機根據實時路況改變了原來的行駛路線。
sentences.pinyin: Sījī gēnjù shíshí lùkuàng gǎibiàn le yuánlái de xíngshǐ lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: The driver changed the original route according to real-time road conditions.

sentences.chinese: 雨后路面很滑，骑车时一定要放慢速度。
sentences.traditional: 雨後路面很滑，騎車時一定要放慢速度。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu lùmiàn hěn huá, qí chē shí yídìng yào fàngmàn sùdù.
sentences.translation: After rain, the road surface is very slippery, so you must slow down when cycling.

sentences.chinese: 工人正在修补被重型货车压坏的路面。
sentences.traditional: 工人正在修補被重型貨車壓壞的路面。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén zhèngzài xiūbǔ bèi zhòngxíng huòchē yā huài de lùmiàn.
sentences.translation: Workers are repairing the road surface damaged by heavy trucks.

sentences.chinese: 这条路的路面比较平整，适合长距离骑行。
