sentences.traditional: 這條路的路面比較平整，適合長距離騎行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù de lùmiàn bǐjiào píngzhěng, shìhé cháng jùlí qíxíng.
sentences.translation: The surface of this road is fairly even, making it suitable for long-distance cycling.

sentences.chinese: 会议全程录像，方便缺席的人会后查看。
sentences.traditional: 會議全程錄像，方便缺席的人會後查看。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì quánchéng lùxiàng, fāngbiàn quēxí de rén huì hòu chákàn.
sentences.translation: The meeting was recorded throughout so that absent people could view it afterwards.

sentences.chinese: 警方调取了门口的监控录像。
sentences.traditional: 警方調取了門口的監控錄像。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng diàoqǔ le ménkǒu de jiānkòng lùxiàng.
sentences.translation: The police retrieved the surveillance footage from the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 请你把实验过程录像，作为报告的附件。
sentences.traditional: 請你把實驗過程錄像，作為報告的附件。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ shíyàn guòchéng lùxiàng, zuòwéi bàogào de fùjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please record the experimental process as an attachment to the report.

sentences.chinese: 经过三轮面试，公司决定录用她。
sentences.traditional: 經過三輪面試，公司決定錄用她。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò sān lún miànshì, gōngsī juédìng lùyòng tā.
sentences.translation: After three rounds of interviews, the company decided to hire her.

sentences.chinese: 新员工被录用后，还要接受两周培训。
sentences.traditional: 新員工被錄用後，還要接受兩週培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng bèi lùyòng hòu, hái yào jiēshòu liǎng zhōu péixùn.
sentences.translation: After being hired, new employees still have to receive two weeks of training.

sentences.chinese: 这项岗位只录用有相关经验的申请人。
sentences.traditional: 這項崗位只錄用有相關經驗的申請人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎngwèi zhǐ lùyòng yǒu xiāngguān jīngyàn de shēnqǐng rén.
sentences.translation: This position only hires applicants with relevant experience.

sentences.chinese: 节目将在今晚录制，明天正式播出。
sentences.traditional: 節目將在今晚錄製，明天正式播出。
sentences.pinyin: Jiémù jiāng zài jīnwǎn lùzhì, míngtiān zhèngshì bōchū.
sentences.translation: The programme will be recorded tonight and officially broadcast tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 老师录制了一段讲解视频，帮助学生复习。
sentences.traditional: 老師錄製了一段講解視頻，幫助學生複習。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī lùzhì le yí duàn jiǎngjiě shìpín, bāngzhù xuésheng fùxí.
sentences.translation: The teacher recorded an explanatory video to help students revise.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证效果，录制前需要先测试设备。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證效果，錄製前需要先測試設備。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng xiàoguǒ, lùzhì qián xūyào xiān cèshì shèbèi.
sentences.translation: To ensure the result, the equipment needs to be tested before recording.

sentences.chinese: 这次旅程让他重新思考了生活的意义。
sentences.traditional: 這次旅程讓他重新思考了生活的意義。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚchéng ràng tā chóngxīn sīkǎo le shēnghuó de yìyì.
sentences.translation: This journey made him rethink the meaning of life.

sentences.chinese: 长达十小时的旅程让孩子们都很疲惫。
sentences.traditional: 長達十小時的旅程讓孩子們都很疲憊。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng dá shí xiǎoshí de lǚchéng ràng háizimen dōu hěn píbèi.
sentences.translation: The ten-hour journey left all the children exhausted.

sentences.chinese: 她把整个旅程记录在日记里。
sentences.traditional: 她把整個旅程記錄在日記裡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhěngge lǚchéng jìlù zài rìjì lǐ.
sentences.translation: She recorded the whole journey in her diary.

sentences.chinese: 这次旅途虽然辛苦，却让他结识了许多朋友。
sentences.traditional: 這次旅途雖然辛苦，卻讓他結識了許多朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚtú suīrán xīnkǔ, què ràng tā jiéshí le xǔduō péngyou.
sentences.translation: Although this journey was tough, it allowed him to make many friends.

sentences.chinese: 漫长的旅途需要提前准备药品和食物。
sentences.traditional: 漫長的旅途需要提前準備藥品和食物。
sentences.pinyin: Màncháng de lǚtú xūyào tíqián zhǔnbèi yàopǐn hé shíwù.
sentences.translation: A long journey requires preparing medicine and food in advance.

sentences.chinese: 她把旅途中的见闻写成了一本游记。
sentences.traditional: 她把旅途中的見聞寫成了一本遊記。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǚtú zhōng de jiànwén xiě chéng le yì běn yóujì.
sentences.translation: She turned what she saw and heard on the trip into a travel journal.

sentences.chinese: 政府承诺会按时履行环保责任。
sentences.traditional: 政府承諾會按時履行環保責任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chéngnuò huì ànshí lǚxíng huánbǎo zérèn.
sentences.translation: The government promised to fulfil its environmental responsibilities on time.

sentences.chinese: 双方必须履行合同中规定的义务。
sentences.traditional: 雙方必須履行合同中規定的義務。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng bìxū lǚxíng hétong zhōng guīdìng de yìwù.
sentences.translation: Both parties must fulfil the obligations set out in the contract.

sentences.chinese: 他没有履行作为负责人的职责。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有履行作為負責人的職責。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu lǚxíng zuòwéi fùzérén de zhízé.
sentences.translation: He did not fulfil his duties as the person in charge.

sentences.chinese: 今年的就业率比去年有所提高。
sentences.traditional: 今年的就業率比去年有所提高。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián de jiùyèlǜ bǐ qùnián yǒu suǒ tígāo.
sentences.translation: This year’s employment rate has increased somewhat compared with last year.

sentences.chinese: 银行下调了贷款利率，企业融资压力减轻了。
sentences.traditional: 銀行下調了貸款利率，企業融資壓力減輕了。
sentences.pinyin: Yínháng xiàtiáo le dàikuǎn lìlǜ, qǐyè róngzī yālì jiǎnqīng le.
sentences.translation: The bank lowered loan interest rates, reducing financing pressure on businesses.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策提高了资源利用率。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策提高了資源利用率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè tígāo le zīyuán lìyònglǜ.
sentences.translation: This policy increased the rate of resource utilisation.

sentences.chinese: 城市绿化改善了居民的生活环境。
sentences.traditional: 城市綠化改善了居民的生活環境。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì lǜhuà gǎishàn le jūmín de shēnghuó huánjìng.
sentences.translation: Urban greening has improved residents’ living environment.

sentences.chinese: 学校计划在操场周围绿化一片空地。
sentences.traditional: 學校計劃在操場周圍綠化一片空地。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jìhuà zài cāochǎng zhōuwéi lǜhuà yí piàn kòngdì.
sentences.translation: The school plans to green an open space around the sports ground.

sentences.chinese: 社区通过种树和修草坪来绿化老旧小区。
sentences.traditional: 社區通過種樹和修草坪來綠化老舊小區。
sentences.pinyin: Shèqū tōngguò zhòng shù hé xiū cǎopíng lái lǜhuà lǎojiù xiǎoqū.
sentences.translation: The community is greening the old neighbourhood by planting trees and repairing lawns.

sentences.chinese: 比赛进入最后一轮，双方都很紧张。
sentences.traditional: 比賽進入最後一輪，雙方都很緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jìnrù zuìhòu yì lún, shuāngfāng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: The competition entered its final round, and both sides were very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 我们轮着负责楼道的卫生。
sentences.traditional: 我們輪著負責樓道的衛生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen lún zhe fùzé lóudào de wèishēng.
sentences.translation: We take turns being responsible for cleaning the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车的后轮需要立刻更换。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車的後輪需要立刻更換。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de hòulún xūyào lìkè gēnghuàn.
sentences.translation: The rear wheel of this vehicle needs to be replaced immediately.

sentences.chinese: 这艘轮船将沿海航行三天。
sentences.traditional: 這艘輪船將沿海航行三天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè sōu lúnchuán jiāng yánhǎi hángxíng sān tiān.
sentences.translation: This ship will sail along the coast for three days.

sentences.chinese: 轮船靠岸后，乘客排队下船。
sentences.traditional: 輪船靠岸後，乘客排隊下船。
sentences.pinyin: Lúnchuán kào àn hòu, chéngkè páiduì xià chuán.
sentences.translation: After the ship docked, the passengers queued to disembark.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，轮船的出发时间被推迟。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣惡劣，輪船的出發時間被推遲。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, lúnchuán de chūfā shíjiān bèi tuīchí.
sentences.translation: Because of bad weather, the ship’s departure time was delayed.

sentences.chinese: 小组成员轮流汇报研究进度。
sentences.traditional: 小組成員輪流匯報研究進度。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎozǔ chéngyuán lúnliú huìbào yánjiū jìndù.
sentences.translation: Group members take turns reporting on the research progress.

sentences.chinese: 为了公平，大家轮流使用会议室。
sentences.traditional: 為了公平，大家輪流使用會議室。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile gōngpíng, dàjiā lúnliú shǐyòng huìyìshì.
sentences.translation: For the sake of fairness, everyone takes turns using the meeting room.

sentences.chinese: 两名护士夜里轮流照顾病人。
sentences.traditional: 兩名護士夜裡輪流照顧病人。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng míng hùshi yèli lúnliú zhàogù bìngrén.
sentences.translation: Two nurses take turns looking after the patient at night.

sentences.chinese: 医院入口专门设置了轮椅通道。
sentences.traditional: 醫院入口專門設置了輪椅通道。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn rùkǒu zhuānmén shèzhì le lúnyǐ tōngdào.
sentences.translation: The hospital entrance has a special wheelchair passage.

sentences.chinese: 受伤后，他暂时需要坐轮椅出行。
sentences.traditional: 受傷後，他暫時需要坐輪椅出行。
sentences.pinyin: Shòushāng hòu, tā zànshí xūyào zuò lúnyǐ chūxíng.
sentences.translation: After being injured, he temporarily needs to travel in a wheelchair.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆为行动不便的游客提供轮椅。
sentences.traditional: 博物館為行動不便的遊客提供輪椅。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wèi xíngdòng bùbiàn de yóukè tígōng lúnyǐ.
sentences.translation: The museum provides wheelchairs for visitors with limited mobility.

sentences.chinese: 行李箱的轮子坏了，拖起来很费劲。
sentences.traditional: 行李箱的輪子壞了，拖起來很費勁。
sentences.pinyin: Xínglixiāng de lúnzi huài le, tuō qǐlái hěn fèijìn.
sentences.translation: The wheels of the suitcase are broken, so it is hard to pull.

sentences.chinese: 这台设备底下有四个轮子，移动起来很方便。
sentences.traditional: 這臺設備底下有四個輪子，移動起來很方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái shèbèi dǐxia yǒu sì ge lúnzi, yídòng qǐlái hěn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: There are four wheels under this piece of equipment, making it easy to move.

sentences.chinese: 孩子研究了半天，终于把小车的轮子装好了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子研究了半天，終於把小車的輪子裝好了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yánjiū le bàntiān, zhōngyú bǎ xiǎochē de lúnzi zhuāng hǎo le.
sentences.translation: The child studied it for ages and finally fitted the wheels onto the small cart.

sentences.chinese: 这个论坛聚集了许多年轻的创业者。
sentences.traditional: 這個論壇聚集了許多年輕的創業者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège lùntán jùjí le xǔduō niánqīng de chuàngyèzhě.
sentences.translation: This forum has brought together many young entrepreneurs.

sentences.chinese: 专家将在论坛上讨论人工智能的发展趋势。
sentences.traditional: 專家將在論壇上討論人工智能的發展趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā jiāng zài lùntán shang tǎolùn réngōng zhìnéng de fāzhǎn qūshì.
sentences.translation: Experts will discuss the development trends of artificial intelligence at the forum.

sentences.chinese: 请你把问题发到技术论坛，可能会有人解答。
sentences.traditional: 請你把問題發到技術論壇，可能會有人解答。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ wèntí fā dào jìshù lùntán, kěnéng huì yǒu rén jiědá.
sentences.translation: Please post the question on a technical forum; someone may answer it.

sentences.chinese: 飞机因天气原因比原计划晚了半小时落地。
sentences.traditional: 飛機因天氣原因比原計劃晚了半小時落地。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī yīn tiānqì yuányīn bǐ yuán jìhuà wǎn le bàn xiǎoshí luòdì.
sentences.translation: Because of the weather, the plane landed half an hour later than originally planned.

sentences.chinese: 新政策只有落地执行，才能真正解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 新政策只有落地執行，才能真正解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè zhǐyǒu luòdì zhíxíng, cái néng zhēnzhèng jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: Only when the new policy is put into practical effect can it truly solve the problem.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目从设计到落地，前后经历了三年。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目從設計到落地，前後經歷了三年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù cóng shèjì dào luòdì, qiánhòu jīnglì le sān nián.
sentences.translation: This project took three years from design to implementation.

sentences.chinese: 如果企业不持续创新，就很容易在竞争中落后。
sentences.traditional: 如果企業不持續創新，就很容易在競爭中落後。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qǐyè bù chíxù chuàngxīn, jiù hěn róngyì zài jìngzhēng zhōng luòhòu.
sentences.translation: If a company does not keep innovating, it can easily fall behind in competition.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区的交通条件相对落后，影响了经济发展。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區的交通條件相對落後，影響了經濟發展。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de jiāotōng tiáojiàn xiāngduì luòhòu, yǐngxiǎng le jīngjì fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Transport conditions in this region are relatively backward, which has affected economic development.

sentences.chinese: 他基础不好，但不愿意一直落后于同学。
sentences.traditional: 他基礎不好，但不願意一直落後於同學。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīchǔ bù hǎo, dàn bú yuànyì yìzhí luòhòu yú tóngxué.
sentences.translation: His foundation is weak, but he is unwilling to keep falling behind his classmates.

sentences.chinese: 财务报表不能马虎，一个小数点都可能造成损失。
sentences.traditional: 財務報表不能馬虎，一個小數點都可能造成損失。
sentences.pinyin: Cáiwù bàobiǎo bù néng mǎhu, yí ge xiǎoshùdiǎn dōu kěnéng zàochéng sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: Financial statements must not be handled carelessly; even one decimal point could cause losses.

sentences.chinese: 他做事太马虎，常常忘记检查细节。
sentences.traditional: 他做事太馬虎，常常忘記檢查細節。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuòshì tài mǎhu, chángcháng wàngjì jiǎnchá xìjié.
sentences.translation: He is too careless in his work and often forgets to check the details.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同关系重大，审核时千万不能马虎。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同關係重大，審核時千萬不能馬虎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong guānxì zhòngdà, shěnhé shí qiānwàn bù néng mǎhu.
sentences.translation: This contract is highly important, so you must not be careless when reviewing it.

sentences.chinese: 清晨的码头十分忙碌，货车一辆接一辆进出。
sentences.traditional: 清晨的碼頭十分忙碌，貨車一輛接一輛進出。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén de mǎtóu shífēn mánglù, huòchē yí liàng jiē yì liàng jìnchū.
sentences.translation: The dock is very busy in the early morning, with trucks coming in and out one after another.

sentences.chinese: 游客在码头排队，等待登上前往海岛的轮船。
sentences.traditional: 遊客在碼頭排隊，等待登上前往海島的輪船。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè zài mǎtóu páiduì, děngdài dēng shàng qiánwǎng hǎidǎo de lúnchuán.
sentences.translation: Tourists queued at the pier, waiting to board the ship to the island.

sentences.chinese: 老码头改造成了公共空间，保留了城市记忆。
sentences.traditional: 老碼頭改造成了公共空間，保留了城市記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo mǎtóu gǎizào chéng le gōnggòng kōngjiān, bǎoliú le chéngshì jìyì.
sentences.translation: The old dock was transformed into a public space, preserving the city’s memory.

sentences.chinese: 蚂蚁虽然很小，却能共同搬动比身体重很多的食物。
sentences.traditional: 螞蟻雖然很小，卻能共同搬動比身體重很多的食物。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎyǐ suīrán hěn xiǎo, què néng gòngtóng bāndòng bǐ shēntǐ zhòng hěnduō de shíwù.
sentences.translation: Although ants are very small, they can work together to move food much heavier than their bodies.

sentences.chinese: 下雨前，院子里的蚂蚁开始忙着搬家。
sentences.traditional: 下雨前，院子裡的螞蟻開始忙著搬家。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ qián, yuànzi lǐ de mǎyǐ kāishǐ máng zhe bānjiā.
sentences.translation: Before it rains, the ants in the yard begin busily moving home.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员观察蚂蚁的行为，以了解群体合作的机制。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員觀察螞蟻的行為，以了解群體合作的機制。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán guānchá mǎyǐ de xíngwéi, yǐ liǎojiě qúntǐ hézuò de jīzhì.
sentences.translation: Researchers observe the behaviour of ants to understand the mechanisms of group cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 这件事本来就是你的责任嘛，别再推给别人。
sentences.traditional: 這件事本來就是你的責任嘛，別再推給別人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì běnlái jiù shì nǐ de zérèn ma, bié zài tuī gěi biérén.
sentences.translation: This was your responsibility in the first place, so stop pushing it onto others.

sentences.chinese: 他只是想帮忙嘛，你不用对他说得那么重。
sentences.traditional: 他只是想幫忙嘛，你不用對他說得那麼重。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì xiǎng bāngmáng ma, nǐ bú yòng duì tā shuō de nàme zhòng.
sentences.translation: He was only trying to help, so you did not need to speak to him so harshly.

sentences.chinese: 既然已经答应了嘛，就应该尽力把事情做好。
sentences.traditional: 既然已經答應了嘛，就應該盡力把事情做好。
sentences.pinyin: Jìrán yǐjīng dāying le ma, jiù yīnggāi jìnlì bǎ shìqing zuò hǎo.
sentences.translation: Since you have already agreed, you ought to do your best to handle it well.

sentences.chinese: 工人把电缆埋在地下，以免影响路面交通。
sentences.traditional: 工人把電纜埋在地下，以免影響路面交通。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén bǎ diànlǎn mái zài dìxià, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng lùmiàn jiāotōng.
sentences.translation: The workers buried the cable underground so that it would not affect road traffic.

sentences.chinese: 他把童年的秘密埋在心里，从未向任何人提起。
sentences.traditional: 他把童年的秘密埋在心裡，從未向任何人提起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ tóngnián de mìmì mái zài xīnlǐ, cóngwèi xiàng rènhé rén tíqǐ.
sentences.translation: He buried the secret from his childhood in his heart and never mentioned it to anyone.

sentences.chinese: 大雪把山路埋住了，救援队只能绕道前进。
sentences.traditional: 大雪把山路埋住了，救援隊只能繞道前進。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxuě bǎ shānlù mái zhù le, jiùyuán duì zhǐ néng ràodào qiánjìn.
sentences.translation: Heavy snow buried the mountain road, so the rescue team could only take a detour.

sentences.chinese: 他迈出第一步后，发现困难并没有想象中那么大。
sentences.traditional: 他邁出第一步後，發現困難並沒有想像中那麼大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mài chū dì yī bù hòu, fāxiàn kùnnán bìng méiyǒu xiǎngxiàng zhōng nàme dà.
sentences.translation: After taking the first step, he found that the difficulty was not as great as he had imagined.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在迈向更加国际化的发展阶段。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在邁向更加國際化的發展階段。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài mài xiàng gèngjiā guójìhuà de fāzhǎn jiēduàn.
sentences.translation: The company is moving towards a more international stage of development.

sentences.chinese: 老人虽然年纪大了，仍然迈着坚定的步子向前走。
sentences.traditional: 老人雖然年紀大了，仍然邁著堅定的步子向前走。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén suīrán niánjì dà le, réngrán mài zhe jiāndìng de bùzi xiàng qián zǒu.
sentences.translation: Although the old man was elderly, he still walked forward with firm steps.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始前，请检查麦克风是否连接正常。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始前，請檢查麥克風是否連接正常。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, qǐng jiǎnchá màikèfēng shìfǒu liánjiē zhèngcháng.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting starts, please check whether the microphone is connected properly.

sentences.chinese: 她拿起麦克风，冷静地回答了记者的问题。
sentences.traditional: 她拿起麥克風，冷靜地回答了記者的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ màikèfēng, lěngjìng de huídá le jìzhě de wèntí.
sentences.translation: She picked up the microphone and calmly answered the reporter’s question.

sentences.chinese: 由于麦克风突然失灵，讲座被迫中断了几分钟。
sentences.traditional: 由於麥克風突然失靈，講座被迫中斷了幾分鐘。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú màikèfēng tūrán shīlíng, jiǎngzuò bèipò zhōngduàn le jǐ fēnzhōng.
sentences.translation: Because the microphone suddenly stopped working, the lecture was forced to pause for several minutes.

sentences.chinese: 漫长的谈判终于取得了实质性进展。
sentences.traditional: 漫長的談判終於取得了實質性進展。
sentences.pinyin: Màncháng de tánpàn zhōngyú qǔdé le shízhìxìng jìnzhǎn.
sentences.translation: The lengthy negotiations finally achieved substantial progress.

sentences.chinese: 在漫长的旅途中，音乐成了他最大的安慰。
sentences.traditional: 在漫長的旅途中，音樂成了他最大的安慰。
sentences.pinyin: Zài màncháng de lǚtú zhōng, yīnyuè chéng le tā zuì dà de ānwèi.
sentences.translation: During the long journey, music became his greatest comfort.

sentences.chinese: 科学研究往往需要漫长而耐心的积累。
sentences.traditional: 科學研究往往需要漫長而耐心的積累。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū wǎngwǎng xūyào màncháng ér nàixīn de jīlěi.
sentences.translation: Scientific research often requires lengthy and patient accumulation.

sentences.chinese: 这本漫画用幽默的方式讨论了环境问题。
sentences.traditional: 這本漫畫用幽默的方式討論了環境問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn mànhuà yòng yōumò de fāngshì tǎolùn le huánjìng wèntí.
sentences.translation: This comic discusses environmental issues in a humorous way.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候喜欢画漫画，后来成了职业插画师。
sentences.traditional: 他小時候喜歡畫漫畫，後來成了職業插畫師。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou xǐhuan huà mànhuà, hòulái chéng le zhíyè chāhuàshī.
sentences.translation: When he was young, he liked drawing comics and later became a professional illustrator.

sentences.chinese: 这部漫画虽然面向儿童，却包含了不少社会议题。
sentences.traditional: 這部漫畫雖然面向兒童，卻包含了不少社會議題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù mànhuà suīrán miànxiàng értóng, què bāohán le bù shǎo shèhuì yìtí.
sentences.translation: Although this cartoon is aimed at children, it contains quite a few social issues.

sentences.chinese: 城市设计应考虑盲人的出行需求。
sentences.traditional: 城市設計應考慮盲人的出行需求。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì shèjì yīng kǎolǜ mángrén de chūxíng xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Urban design should consider the travel needs of blind people.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件可以把文字读给盲人听。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件可以把文字讀給盲人聽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ bǎ wénzì dú gěi mángrén tīng.
sentences.translation: This software can read text aloud to blind people.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者陪盲人过马路，并提醒他们注意车辆。
sentences.traditional: 志願者陪盲人過馬路，並提醒他們注意車輛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě péi mángrén guò mǎlù, bìng tíxǐng tāmen zhùyì chēliàng.
sentences.translation: The volunteer accompanied the blind person across the road and reminded them to watch for vehicles.

sentences.chinese: 水壶刚烧开，壶口就冒出白色的热气。
sentences.traditional: 水壺剛燒開，壺口就冒出白色的熱氣。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐhú gāng shāokāi, húkǒu jiù mào chū báisè de rèqì.
sentences.translation: The kettle had just boiled, and white steam began to come out of its spout.

sentences.chinese: 他冒着被批评的风险，还是提出了不同意见。
sentences.traditional: 他冒著被批評的風險，還是提出了不同意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mào zhe bèi pīpíng de fēngxiǎn, háishì tíchū le bù tóng yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: He risked being criticised and still put forward a different opinion.

sentences.chinese: 地下管道破裂后，路面不断冒水。
sentences.traditional: 地下管道破裂後，路面不斷冒水。
sentences.pinyin: Dìxià guǎndào pòliè hòu, lùmiàn búduàn mào shuǐ.
sentences.translation: After the underground pipe burst, water kept coming up through the road surface.

sentences.chinese: 在没有足够准备的情况下登山，是一种不必要的冒险。
sentences.traditional: 在沒有足夠準備的情況下登山，是一種不必要的冒險。
sentences.pinyin: Zài méiyǒu zúgòu zhǔnbèi de qíngkuàng xià dēngshān, shì yì zhǒng bù bìyào de màoxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Climbing a mountain without enough preparation is an unnecessary risk.

sentences.chinese: 企业愿意冒险投资新技术，才能抓住机遇。
sentences.traditional: 企業願意冒險投資新技術，才能抓住機遇。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yuànyì màoxiǎn tóuzī xīn jìshù, cái néng zhuāzhù jīyù.
sentences.translation: Only by being willing to take risks and invest in new technology can a company seize opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影讲述了一群孩子在森林里的冒险经历。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影講述了一群孩子在森林裡的冒險經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎngshù le yì qún háizi zài sēnlín lǐ de màoxiǎn jīnglì.
sentences.translation: This film tells the story of a group of children’s adventure in the forest.

sentences.chinese: 两国之间的贸易往来受到汇率变化的影响。
sentences.traditional: 兩國之間的貿易往來受到匯率變化的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng guó zhījiān de màoyì láiwǎng shòudào huìlǜ biànhuà de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Trade between the two countries is affected by changes in the exchange rate.

sentences.chinese: 公司希望通过线上平台扩大国际贸易。
sentences.traditional: 公司希望通過線上平臺擴大國際貿易。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xīwàng tōngguò xiànshàng píngtái kuòdà guójì màoyì.
sentences.translation: The company hopes to expand its international trade through online platforms.

sentences.chinese: 稳定的贸易环境有助于企业制定长期计划。
sentences.traditional: 穩定的貿易環境有助於企業制定長期計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Wěndìng de màoyì huánjìng yǒuzhù yú qǐyè zhìdìng chángqī jìhuà.
sentences.translation: A stable trade environment helps companies make long-term plans.

sentences.chinese: 过去，这座城市主要依靠煤来供暖。
sentences.traditional: 過去，這座城市主要依靠煤來供暖。
sentences.pinyin: Guòqù, zhè zuò chéngshì zhǔyào yīkào méi lái gōngnuǎn.
sentences.translation: In the past, this city mainly relied on coal for heating.

sentences.chinese: 为了减少污染，许多工厂逐渐停止使用煤。
sentences.traditional: 為了減少污染，許多工廠逐漸停止使用煤。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo wūrǎn, xǔduō gōngchǎng zhújiàn tíngzhǐ shǐyòng méi.
sentences.translation: To reduce pollution, many factories have gradually stopped using coal.

sentences.chinese: 煤的价格上涨会影响电力企业的成本。
sentences.traditional: 煤的價格上漲會影響電力企業的成本。
sentences.pinyin: Méi de jiàgé shàngzhǎng huì yǐngxiǎng diànlì qǐyè de chéngběn.
sentences.translation: A rise in the price of coal will affect the costs of electricity companies.

sentences.chinese: 冬天一到，公园里的梅花就陆续开放。
sentences.traditional: 冬天一到，公園裡的梅花就陸續開放。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān yí dào, gōngyuán lǐ de méihuā jiù lùxù kāifàng.
sentences.translation: Once winter arrives, the plum blossoms in the park open one after another.

sentences.chinese: 这幅画把梅花画得很有生命力。
sentences.traditional: 這幅畫把梅花畫得很有生命力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú huà bǎ méihuā huà de hěn yǒu shēngmìnglì.
sentences.translation: This painting depicts plum blossoms with great vitality.

sentences.chinese: 梅花常被用来象征坚强和希望。
sentences.traditional: 梅花常被用來象徵堅強和希望。
sentences.pinyin: Méihuā cháng bèi yòng lái xiàngzhēng jiānqiáng hé xīwàng.
sentences.translation: Plum blossoms are often used to symbolise strength and hope.

sentences.chinese: 他皱起眉毛，似乎对这个决定并不满意。
sentences.traditional: 他皺起眉毛，似乎對這個決定並不滿意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhòu qǐ méimao, sìhū duì zhège juédìng bìng bù mǎnyì.
sentences.translation: He frowned, seeming not to be satisfied with the decision.

sentences.chinese: 画人物时，眉毛的形状会影响表情。
sentences.traditional: 畫人物時，眉毛的形狀會影響表情。
sentences.pinyin: Huà rénwù shí, méimao de xíngzhuàng huì yǐngxiǎng biǎoqíng.
sentences.translation: When drawing a person, the shape of the eyebrows affects the expression.

sentences.chinese: 她把眉毛修得太细，看起来有些不自然。
sentences.traditional: 她把眉毛修得太細，看起來有些不自然。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ méimao xiū de tài xì, kàn qǐlái yǒuxiē bù zìrán.
sentences.translation: She shaped her eyebrows too thinly, so they look a bit unnatural.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥不仅坚固，而且设计得十分美观。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋不僅堅固，而且設計得十分美觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo bùjǐn jiāngù, érqiě shèjì de shífēn měiguān.
sentences.translation: This bridge is not only solid but also very beautiful in design.

sentences.chinese: 产品包装要实用，也要美观，才能吸引顾客。
sentences.traditional: 產品包裝要實用，也要美觀，才能吸引顧客。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn bāozhuāng yào shíyòng, yě yào měiguān, cái néng xīyǐn gùkè.
sentences.translation: Product packaging needs to be practical as well as attractive in order to draw customers.

sentences.chinese: 旧楼改造后，外立面变得更加美观。
sentences.traditional: 舊樓改造後，外立面變得更加美觀。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù lóu gǎizào hòu, wàilìmiàn biàn de gèngjiā měiguān.
sentences.translation: After the old building was renovated, its exterior became more aesthetically pleasing.

sentences.chinese: 他通过加倍练习来弥补基础薄弱的不足。
sentences.traditional: 他通過加倍練習來彌補基礎薄弱的不足。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngguò jiābèi liànxí lái míbǔ jīchǔ bóruò de bùzú.
sentences.translation: He made up for his weak foundation through extra practice.

sentences.chinese: 这笔赔偿无法完全弥补家庭所承受的痛苦。
sentences.traditional: 這筆賠償無法完全彌補家庭所承受的痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ péicháng wúfǎ wánquán míbǔ jiātíng suǒ chéngshòu de tòngkǔ.
sentences.translation: This compensation cannot fully make up for the suffering endured by the family.

sentences.chinese: 学校开设辅导课，帮助学生弥补知识上的差距。
sentences.traditional: 學校開設輔導課，幫助學生彌補知識上的差距。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào kāishè fǔdǎo kè, bāngzhù xuésheng míbǔ zhīshi shang de chājù.
sentences.translation: The school offers tutoring classes to help students make up for gaps in their knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 这座小城的夜景格外迷人，吸引了不少游客。
sentences.traditional: 這座小城的夜景格外迷人，吸引了不少遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò xiǎochéng de yèjǐng géwài mírén, xīyǐn le bù shǎo yóukè.
sentences.translation: The night view of this small city is especially charming and attracts many tourists.

sentences.chinese: 她的演讲没有夸张的技巧，却有一种迷人的力量。
sentences.traditional: 她的演講沒有誇張的技巧，卻有一種迷人的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng méiyǒu kuāzhāng de jìqiǎo, què yǒu yì zhǒng mírén de lìliàng.
sentences.translation: Her speech had no exaggerated techniques, yet it had a fascinating power.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片把沙漠拍得既荒凉又迷人。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片把沙漠拍得既荒涼又迷人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn bǎ shāmò pāi de jì huāngliáng yòu mírén.
sentences.translation: This documentary makes the desert look both desolate and fascinating.

sentences.chinese: 山路两旁的树林很密，几乎看不到远处的村庄。
sentences.traditional: 山路兩旁的樹林很密，幾乎看不到遠處的村莊。
sentences.pinyin: Shānlù liǎng páng de shùlín hěn mì, jīhū kàn bu dào yuǎnchù de cūnzhuāng.
sentences.translation: The woods on both sides of the mountain road are so dense that you can hardly see the village in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 这块布织得很密，透气性不太好。
sentences.traditional: 這塊布織得很密，透氣性不太好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài bù zhī de hěn mì, tòuqìxìng bú tài hǎo.
sentences.translation: This piece of cloth is woven very tightly, so it is not very breathable.

sentences.chinese: 会议安排得太密，代表们几乎没有休息时间。
sentences.traditional: 會議安排得太密，代表們幾乎沒有休息時間。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì ānpái de tài mì, dàibiǎo men jīhū méiyǒu xiūxi shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The meetings are scheduled too closely together, so the delegates have hardly any time to rest.

sentences.chinese: 人口密度过高会给交通和住房带来压力。
sentences.traditional: 人口密度過高會給交通和住房帶來壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Rénkǒu mìdù guò gāo huì gěi jiāotōng hé zhùfáng dài lái yālì.
sentences.translation: Excessive population density will put pressure on transport and housing.

sentences.chinese: 科学家正在测量这种金属的密度。
sentences.traditional: 科學家正在測量這種金屬的密度。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài cèliáng zhè zhǒng jīnshǔ de mìdù.
sentences.translation: Scientists are measuring the density of this metal.

sentences.chinese: 森林的密度影响了野生动物的活动范围。
sentences.traditional: 森林的密度影響了野生動物的活動範圍。
sentences.pinyin: Sēnlín de mìdù yǐngxiǎng le yěshēng dòngwù de huódòng fànwéi.
sentences.translation: The density of the forest affects the range of activities of wild animals.

sentences.chinese: 蜜蜂在花丛中飞来飞去，帮助植物传播花粉。
sentences.traditional: 蜜蜂在花叢中飛來飛去，幫助植物傳播花粉。
sentences.pinyin: Mìfēng zài huācóng zhōng fēi lái fēi qù, bāngzhù zhíwù chuánbō huāfěn.
sentences.translation: Bees fly around among the flowers and help plants spread pollen.

sentences.chinese: 如果蜜蜂数量减少，许多农作物的产量都会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果蜜蜂數量減少，許多農作物的產量都會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ mìfēng shùliàng jiǎnshǎo, xǔduō nóngzuòwù de chǎnliàng dōu huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If the number of bees decreases, the yields of many crops will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 孩子被蜜蜂叮了一下，手指很快肿了起来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子被蜜蜂叮了一下，手指很快腫了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bèi mìfēng dīng le yí xià, shǒuzhǐ hěn kuài zhǒng le qǐlai.
sentences.translation: The child was stung by a bee, and his finger quickly swelled up.

sentences.chinese: 这一带工厂密集，空气质量长期受到关注。
sentences.traditional: 這一帶工廠密集，空氣質量長期受到關注。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yí dài gōngchǎng mìjí, kōngqì zhìliàng chángqī shòudào guānzhù.
sentences.translation: Factories are densely concentrated in this area, so air quality has long been a concern.

sentences.chinese: 比赛结束后，人群密集地向出口移动。
sentences.traditional: 比賽結束後，人群密集地向出口移動。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù hòu, rénqún mìjí de xiàng chūkǒu yídòng.
sentences.translation: After the match ended, the crowd moved densely towards the exits.

sentences.chinese: 医院把有限的资源密集投入到重症病房。
sentences.traditional: 醫院把有限的資源密集投入到重症病房。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn bǎ yǒuxiàn de zīyuán mìjí tóurù dào zhòngzhèng bìngfáng.
sentences.translation: The hospital concentrated its limited resources intensively in the intensive care wards.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套里面加了棉，冬天穿起来很暖和。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套裡面加了棉，冬天穿起來很暖和。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào lǐmiàn jiā le mián, dōngtiān chuān qǐlai hěn nuǎnhuo.
sentences.translation: This coat has cotton padding inside, so it is warm to wear in winter.

sentences.chinese: 棉是一种重要的天然纤维，广泛用于纺织业。
sentences.traditional: 棉是一種重要的天然纖維，廣泛用於紡織業。
sentences.pinyin: Mián shì yì zhǒng zhòngyào de tiānrán xiānwéi, guǎngfàn yòng yú fǎngzhīyè.
sentences.translation: Cotton is an important natural fibre and is widely used in the textile industry.

sentences.chinese: 新疆的棉品质很好，受到许多企业欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 新疆的棉品質很好，受到許多企業歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnjiāng de mián pǐnzhì hěn hǎo, shòudào xǔduō qǐyè huānyíng.
sentences.translation: Xinjiang cotton is of good quality and is welcomed by many companies.

sentences.chinese: 为了免受干扰，他把手机调成了静音。
sentences.traditional: 為了免受干擾，他把手機調成了靜音。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile miǎn shòu gānrǎo, tā bǎ shǒujī tiáo chéng le jìngyīn.
sentences.translation: To avoid being disturbed, he set his phone to silent.

sentences.chinese: 这种药可以免去患者多次往返医院的麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥可以免去患者多次往返醫院的麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào kěyǐ miǎn qù huànzhě duō cì wǎngfǎn yīyuàn de máfan.
sentences.translation: This medicine can save patients the trouble of going back and forth to the hospital many times.

sentences.chinese: 学校决定免收贫困学生的住宿费。
sentences.traditional: 學校決定免收貧困學生的住宿費。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào juédìng miǎn shōu pínkùn xuéshēng de zhùsùfèi.
sentences.translation: The school decided to exempt poor students from accommodation fees.

sentences.chinese: 他身体还没恢复，不要勉强参加训练。
sentences.traditional: 他身體還沒恢復，不要勉強參加訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēntǐ hái méi huīfù, bú yào miǎnqiǎng cānjiā xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: He has not recovered yet, so do not force him to take part in training.

sentences.chinese: 这个解释听起来很勉强，难以让人信服。
sentences.traditional: 這個解釋聽起來很勉強，難以讓人信服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiěshì tīng qǐlai hěn miǎnqiǎng, nányǐ ràng rén xìnfú.
sentences.translation: This explanation sounds rather forced and is hard to believe.

sentences.chinese: 她勉强笑了笑，还是没有回答问题。
sentences.traditional: 她勉強笑了笑，還是沒有回答問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā miǎnqiǎng xiào le xiào, háishì méiyǒu huídá wèntí.
sentences.translation: She forced a smile but still did not answer the question.

sentences.chinese: 这些商品在机场购买时可以免税。
sentences.traditional: 這些商品在機場購買時可以免稅。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shāngpǐn zài jīchǎng gòumǎi shí kěyǐ miǎnshuì.
sentences.translation: These goods can be bought tax-free at the airport.

sentences.chinese: 政府为小型企业提供了部分免税政策。
sentences.traditional: 政府為小型企業提供了部分免稅政策。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ wèi xiǎoxíng qǐyè tígōng le bùfen miǎnshuì zhèngcè.
sentences.translation: The government has provided some tax-free policies for small businesses.

sentences.chinese: 游客需要出示护照才能办理免税手续。
sentences.traditional: 遊客需要出示護照才能辦理免稅手續。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè xūyào chūshì hùzhào cái néng bànlǐ miǎnshuì shǒuxù.
sentences.translation: Tourists need to show their passports to complete duty-free procedures.

sentences.chinese: 接种疫苗后，人体会逐渐产生免疫反应。
sentences.traditional: 接種疫苗後，人體會逐漸產生免疫反應。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhòng yìmiáo hòu, réntǐ huì zhújiàn chǎnshēng miǎnyì fǎnyìng.
sentences.translation: After vaccination, the human body gradually develops an immune response.

sentences.chinese: 他对这种病毒并没有完全免疫。
sentences.traditional: 他對這種病毒並沒有完全免疫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhè zhǒng bìngdú bìng méiyǒu wánquán miǎnyì.
sentences.translation: He is not completely immune to this virus.

sentences.chinese: 长期压力可能会影响身体的免疫功能。
sentences.traditional: 長期壓力可能會影響身體的免疫功能。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī yālì kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng shēntǐ de miǎnyì gōngnéng.
sentences.translation: Long-term stress may affect the body’s immune function.

sentences.chinese: 面部表情往往比语言更能透露真实情绪。
sentences.traditional: 面部表情往往比語言更能透露真實情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Miànbù biǎoqíng wǎngwǎng bǐ yǔyán gèng néng tòulù zhēnshí qíngxù.
sentences.translation: Facial expressions often reveal real emotions more than words do.

sentences.chinese: 医生检查了他的面部伤口，确认没有感染。
sentences.traditional: 醫生檢查了他的面部傷口，確認沒有感染。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá le tā de miànbù shāngkǒu, quèrèn méiyǒu gǎnrǎn.
sentences.translation: The doctor examined his facial wound and confirmed there was no infection.

sentences.chinese: 寒风吹得她面部发红，只好把围巾拉高。
sentences.traditional: 寒風吹得她面部發紅，只好把圍巾拉高。
sentences.pinyin: Hánfēng chuī de tā miànbù fāhóng, zhǐhǎo bǎ wéijīn lā gāo.
sentences.translation: The cold wind made her face turn red, so she had to pull her scarf higher.

sentences.chinese: 这种面粉蛋白质含量较高，适合用来做面包。
sentences.traditional: 這種麵粉蛋白質含量較高，適合用來做麵包。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng miànfěn dànbáizhì hánliàng jiào gāo, shìhé yòng lái zuò miànbāo.
sentences.translation: This flour has a relatively high protein content and is suitable for making bread.

sentences.chinese: 把面粉过筛以后，蛋糕的口感会更细腻。
sentences.traditional: 把麵粉過篩以後，蛋糕的口感會更細膩。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎ miànfěn guòshāi yǐhòu, dàngāo de kǒugǎn huì gèng xìnì.
sentences.translation: After sifting the flour, the cake will have a finer texture.

sentences.chinese: 仓库受潮后，几袋面粉都结成了硬块。
sentences.traditional: 倉庫受潮後，幾袋麵粉都結成了硬塊。
sentences.pinyin: Cāngkù shòucháo hòu, jǐ dài miànfěn dōu jiéchéng le yìngkuài.
sentences.translation: After the warehouse became damp, several bags of flour formed hard lumps.

sentences.chinese: 他不愿当众承认错误，主要是怕丢面子。
sentences.traditional: 他不願當眾承認錯誤，主要是怕丟面子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù yuàn dāngzhòng chéngrèn cuòwù, zhǔyào shì pà diū miànzi.
sentences.translation: He was unwilling to admit his mistake in public mainly because he feared losing face.

sentences.chinese: 为了给客户留面子，经理没有直接批评他。
sentences.traditional: 為了給客戶留面子，經理沒有直接批評他。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile gěi kèhù liú miànzi, jīnglǐ méiyǒu zhíjiē pīpíng tā.
sentences.translation: To let the client save face, the manager did not criticise him directly.

sentences.chinese: 真正的合作不能只讲面子，还要解决实际问题。
sentences.traditional: 真正的合作不能只講面子，還要解決實際問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de hézuò bù néng zhǐ jiǎng miànzi, hái yào jiějué shíjì wèntí.
sentences.translation: Real cooperation cannot be only about reputation; it must also solve practical problems.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说细致地描绘了海边小镇的生活。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說細緻地描繪了海邊小鎮的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō xìzhì de miáohuì le hǎibiān xiǎozhèn de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This novel depicts life in a seaside town in great detail.

sentences.chinese: 报告用大量数据描绘了城市人口流动的趋势。
sentences.traditional: 報告用大量數據描繪了城市人口流動的趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào yòng dàliàng shùjù miáohuì le chéngshì rénkǒu liúdòng de qūshì.
sentences.translation: The report uses a large amount of data to depict trends in urban population movement.

sentences.chinese: 画家用柔和的色彩描绘清晨的田野。
sentences.traditional: 畫家用柔和的色彩描繪清晨的田野。
sentences.pinyin: Huàjiā yòng róuhé de sècǎi miáohuì qīngchén de tiányě.
sentences.translation: The painter uses soft colours to depict the fields in the early morning.

sentences.chinese: 作者通过细节描写，展现了人物内心的矛盾。
sentences.traditional: 作者通過細節描寫，展現了人物內心的矛盾。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòzhě tōngguò xìjié miáoxiě, zhǎnxiàn le rénwù nèixīn de máodùn.
sentences.translation: Through detailed description, the author shows the character’s inner conflict.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章描写了老人独自守护村庄的经历。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章描寫了老人獨自守護村莊的經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng miáoxiě le lǎorén dúzì shǒuhù cūnzhuāng de jīnglì.
sentences.translation: This article describes the experience of an old man guarding the village alone.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求学生用自己的语言描写观察到的景象。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求學生用自己的語言描寫觀察到的景象。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú xuésheng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán miáoxiě guānchá dào de jǐngxiàng.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the students to describe the scene they had observed in their own words.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法很妙，既省钱又节省时间。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法很妙，既省錢又節省時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ hěn miào, jì shěng qián yòu jiéshěng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: This method is excellent; it saves both money and time.

sentences.chinese: 她一句话说得很妙，立刻缓和了紧张气氛。
sentences.traditional: 她一句話說得很妙，立刻緩和了緊張氣氛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí jù huà shuō de hěn miào, lìkè huǎnhé le jǐnzhāng qìfēn.
sentences.translation: She put it wonderfully in one sentence, immediately easing the tense atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 这个设计的妙处在于它把复杂问题变简单了。
sentences.traditional: 這個設計的妙處在於它把複雜問題變簡單了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèjì de miàochù zài yú tā bǎ fùzá wèntí biàn jiǎndān le.
sentences.translation: The beauty of this design is that it makes a complex problem simple.

sentences.chinese: 消防员终于把仓库里的大火灭了。
sentences.traditional: 消防員終於把倉庫裡的大火滅了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán zhōngyú bǎ cāngkù lǐ de dàhuǒ miè le.
sentences.translation: The firefighters finally put out the big fire in the warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 离开实验室前，请确认所有酒精灯都已灭。
sentences.traditional: 離開實驗室前，請確認所有酒精燈都已滅。
sentences.pinyin: Líkāi shíyànshì qián, qǐng quèrèn suǒyǒu jiǔjīngdēng dōu yǐ miè.
sentences.translation: Before leaving the laboratory, please make sure all the alcohol lamps have gone out.

sentences.chinese: 这种昆虫会破坏庄稼，必须及时消灭。
sentences.traditional: 這種昆蟲會破壞莊稼，必須及時消滅。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kūnchóng huì pòhuài zhuāngjia, bìxū jíshí xiāomiè.
sentences.translation: This kind of insect damages crops and must be eliminated promptly.

sentences.chinese: 这首民歌在当地流传了几百年。
sentences.traditional: 這首民歌在當地流傳了幾百年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu míngē zài dāngdì liúchuán le jǐ bǎi nián.
sentences.translation: This folk song has been passed down locally for several hundred years.

sentences.chinese: 她把传统民歌改编成了现代舞台作品。
sentences.traditional: 她把傳統民歌改編成了現代舞臺作品。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ chuántǒng míngē gǎibiān chéng le xiàndài wǔtái zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: She adapted traditional folk songs into a modern stage work.

sentences.chinese: 音乐课上，老师讲解了这首民歌的历史背景。
sentences.traditional: 音樂課上，老師講解了這首民歌的歷史背景。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnyuè kè shang, lǎoshī jiǎngjiě le zhè shǒu míngē de lìshǐ bèijǐng.
sentences.translation: In music class, the teacher explained the historical background of this folk song.

sentences.chinese: 许多民间故事反映了普通人的愿望和想象。
sentences.traditional: 許多民間故事反映了普通人的願望和想像。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō mínjiān gùshi fǎnyìng le pǔtōng rén de yuànwàng hé xiǎngxiàng.
sentences.translation: Many folk stories reflect ordinary people’s wishes and imagination.

sentences.chinese: 这种手工艺起源于民间，后来进入了博物馆。
sentences.traditional: 這種手工藝起源於民間，後來進入了博物館。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shǒugōngyì qǐyuán yú mínjiān, hòulái jìnrù le bówùguǎn.
sentences.translation: This handicraft originated among the people and later entered museums.

sentences.chinese: 民间组织在救灾过程中发挥了重要作用。
sentences.traditional: 民間組織在救災過程中發揮了重要作用。
sentences.pinyin: Mínjiān zǔzhī zài jiùzāi guòchéng zhōng fāhuī le zhòngyào zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Non-governmental organisations played an important role in the disaster relief process.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，各地的民俗活动吸引了大量游客。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，各地的民俗活動吸引了大量遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, gèdì de mínsú huódòng xīyǐn le dàliàng yóukè.
sentences.translation: During the Spring Festival, folk custom activities in various places attracted many tourists.

sentences.chinese: 研究民俗可以帮助我们理解一个地区的历史记忆。
sentences.traditional: 研究民俗可以幫助我們理解一個地區的歷史記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū mínsú kěyǐ bāngzhù wǒmen lǐjiě yí gè dìqū de lìshǐ jìyì.
sentences.translation: Studying folk customs can help us understand the historical memory of a region.

sentences.chinese: 这本书系统介绍了西南地区的民俗文化。
sentences.traditional: 這本書系統介紹了西南地區的民俗文化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū xìtǒng jièshào le xīnán dìqū de mínsú wénhuà.
sentences.translation: This book systematically introduces the folk culture of south-western regions.

sentences.chinese: 我们在山村住了一晚民宿，房东还带我们参观了茶园。
sentences.traditional: 我們在山村住了一晚民宿，房東還帶我們參觀了茶園。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shāncūn zhù le yì wǎn mínsù, fángdōng hái dài wǒmen cānguān le cháyuán.
sentences.translation: We stayed one night in a homestay in the mountain village, and the host also took us to visit the tea garden.

sentences.chinese: 这家民宿虽然不豪华，但房间干净，服务也很周到。
sentences.traditional: 這家民宿雖然不豪華，但房間乾淨，服務也很周到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù suīrán bù háohuá, dàn fángjiān gānjìng, fúwù yě hěn zhōudào.
sentences.translation: Although this homestay is not luxurious, the rooms are clean and the service is very thoughtful.

sentences.chinese: 当地政府鼓励村民经营民宿，以增加旅游收入。
sentences.traditional: 當地政府鼓勵村民經營民宿，以增加旅遊收入。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì zhèngfǔ gǔlì cūnmín jīngyíng mínsù, yǐ zēngjiā lǚyóu shōurù.
sentences.translation: The local government encourages villagers to run homestays to increase tourism income.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策公布后，民众最关心的是医疗费用会不会下降。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策公佈後，民眾最關心的是醫療費用會不會下降。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè gōngbù hòu, mínzhòng zuì guānxīn de shì yīliáo fèiyòng huì bú huì xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: After this policy was announced, what the public cared about most was whether medical costs would fall.

sentences.chinese: 在灾害发生后，广大民众自发捐款捐物。
sentences.traditional: 在災害發生後，廣大民眾自發捐款捐物。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zāihài fāshēng hòu, guǎngdà mínzhòng zìfā juānkuǎn juān wù.
sentences.translation: After the disaster occurred, large numbers of people voluntarily donated money and goods.

sentences.chinese: 政府需要及时向民众解释新的交通规定。
sentences.traditional: 政府需要及時向民眾解釋新的交通規定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xūyào jíshí xiàng mínzhòng jiěshì xīn de jiāotōng guīdìng.
sentences.translation: The government needs to explain the new traffic rules to the public promptly.

sentences.chinese: 学生会通过民主投票决定活动的主题。
sentences.traditional: 學生會通過民主投票決定活動的主題。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēnghuì tōngguò mínzhǔ tóupiào juédìng huódòng de zhǔtí.
sentences.translation: The student union decided the theme of the activity through a democratic vote.

sentences.chinese: 在民主社会中，公开讨论是解决分歧的重要方式。
sentences.traditional: 在民主社會中，公開討論是解決分歧的重要方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mínzhǔ shèhuì zhōng, gōngkāi tǎolùn shì jiějué fēnqí de zhòngyào fāngshì.
sentences.translation: In a democratic society, open discussion is an important way to resolve differences.

sentences.chinese: 这次改革的目标之一是提高基层管理的民主程度。
sentences.traditional: 這次改革的目標之一是提高基層管理的民主程度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gǎigé de mùbiāo zhī yī shì tígāo jīcéng guǎnlǐ de mínzhǔ chéngdù.
sentences.translation: One goal of this reform is to raise the democratic level of grassroots management.

sentences.chinese: 这个培训班只有三十个名额，报名当天就满了。
sentences.traditional: 這個培訓班只有三十個名額，報名當天就滿了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège péixùn bān zhǐyǒu sānshí ge míng'é, bàomíng dāngtiān jiù mǎn le.
sentences.translation: This training course has only thirty places, and it filled up on the day registration opened.

sentences.chinese: 学校为贫困地区的学生保留了一部分名额。
sentences.traditional: 學校為貧困地區的學生保留了一部分名額。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi pínkùn dìqū de xuéshēng bǎoliú le yí bùfen míng'é.
sentences.translation: The school reserved some places for students from poor areas.

sentences.chinese: 如果有人放弃名额，候补名单上的学生就有机会补上。
sentences.traditional: 如果有人放棄名額，候補名單上的學生就有機會補上。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu rén fàngqì míng'é, hòubǔ míngdān shang de xuéshēng jiù yǒu jīhuì bǔ shàng.
sentences.translation: If someone gives up their place, students on the waiting list will have a chance to take it.

sentences.chinese: 这间办公室朝南，白天显得特别明亮。
sentences.traditional: 這間辦公室朝南，白天顯得特別明亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiān bàngōngshì cháo nán, báitiān xiǎnde tèbié míngliàng.
sentences.translation: This office faces south, so it looks especially bright during the day.

sentences.chinese: 孩子的眼神很明亮，听故事时总是充满好奇。
sentences.traditional: 孩子的眼神很明亮，聽故事時總是充滿好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi de yǎnshén hěn míngliàng, tīng gùshi shí zǒng shì chōngmǎn hàoqí.
sentences.translation: The child’s eyes are bright, and they are always full of curiosity when listening to stories.

sentences.chinese: 装修后，客厅的颜色比以前明亮多了。
sentences.traditional: 裝修後，客廳的顏色比以前明亮多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuāngxiū hòu, kètīng de yánsè bǐ yǐqián míngliàng duō le.
sentences.translation: After the renovation, the colours in the living room are much brighter than before.

sentences.chinese: 你明明答应今天交报告，为什么又推迟了？
sentences.traditional: 你明明答應今天交報告，為什麼又推遲了？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ míngmíng dāyìng jīntiān jiāo bàogào, wèishénme yòu tuīchí le?
sentences.translation: You clearly promised to hand in the report today, so why has it been delayed again?

sentences.chinese: 这道题明明很简单，他却因为紧张做错了。
sentences.traditional: 這道題明明很簡單，他卻因為緊張做錯了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tí míngmíng hěn jiǎndān, tā què yīnwèi jǐnzhāng zuò cuò le.
sentences.translation: This question was obviously very simple, but he got it wrong because he was nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他们明明有足够的证据，却没有及时公开。
sentences.traditional: 他們明明有足夠的證據，卻沒有及時公開。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen míngmíng yǒu zúgòu de zhèngjù, què méiyǒu jíshí gōngkāi.
sentences.translation: They clearly had enough evidence, but they did not make it public in time.

sentences.chinese: 这位医生名气很大，但他对每个病人都很耐心。
sentences.traditional: 這位醫生名氣很大，但他對每個病人都很耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīshēng míngqi hěn dà, dàn tā duì měi ge bìngrén dōu hěn nàixīn.
sentences.translation: This doctor has a strong reputation, but he is still very patient with every patient.

sentences.chinese: 这家小餐馆靠一道家常菜积累了不少名气。
sentences.traditional: 這家小餐館靠一道家常菜積累了不少名氣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo cānguǎn kào yí dào jiācháng cài jīlěi le bù shǎo míngqi.
sentences.translation: This small restaurant built quite a reputation through one home-style dish.

sentences.chinese: 对年轻演员来说，名气来得太快未必是好事。
sentences.traditional: 對年輕演員來說，名氣來得太快未必是好事。
sentences.pinyin: Duì niánqīng yǎnyuán lái shuō, míngqi lái de tài kuài wèibì shì hǎo shì.
sentences.translation: For young actors, fame coming too quickly is not necessarily a good thing.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城保存了许多名胜，每年吸引大量游客。
sentences.traditional: 這座古城保存了許多名勝，每年吸引大量遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng bǎocún le xǔduō míngshèng, měi nián xīyǐn dàliàng yóukè.
sentences.translation: This ancient city has preserved many famous scenic spots and attracts large numbers of tourists every year.

sentences.chinese: 导游把附近的名胜都标在了地图上。
sentences.traditional: 導遊把附近的名勝都標在了地圖上。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyóu bǎ fùjìn de míngshèng dōu biāo zài le dìtú shang.
sentences.translation: The guide marked all the nearby scenic spots on the map.

sentences.chinese: 我们计划用两天时间参观当地的历史名胜。
sentences.traditional: 我們計劃用兩天時間參觀當地的歷史名勝。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà yòng liǎng tiān shíjiān cānguān dāngdì de lìshǐ míngshèng.
sentences.translation: We plan to spend two days visiting the local historical scenic spots.

sentences.chinese: 指挥官命令队伍立即撤离危险区域。
sentences.traditional: 指揮官命令隊伍立即撤離危險區域。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐhuīguān mìnglìng duìwu lìjí chèlí wēixiǎn qūyù.
sentences.translation: The commander ordered the team to leave the dangerous area immediately.

sentences.chinese: 这个系统可以根据语音命令自动打开灯光。
sentences.traditional: 這個系統可以根據語音命令自動打開燈光。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xìtǒng kěyǐ gēnjù yǔyīn mìnglìng zìdòng dǎkāi dēngguāng.
sentences.translation: This system can turn on the lights automatically according to voice commands.

sentences.chinese: 他没有服从上级的命令，结果造成了严重后果。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有服從上級的命令，結果造成了嚴重後果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu fúcóng shàngjí de mìnglìng, jiéguǒ zàochéng le yánzhòng hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: He did not obey his superior’s order, which caused serious consequences.

sentences.chinese: 这条新街道以一位著名科学家的名字命名。
sentences.traditional: 這條新街道以一位著名科學家的名字命名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xīn jiēdào yǐ yí wèi zhùmíng kēxuéjiā de míngzi mìngmíng.
sentences.translation: This new street was named after a famous scientist.

sentences.chinese: 研究团队将新发现的物种命名为“蓝尾小蛙”。
sentences.traditional: 研究團隊將新發現的物種命名為「藍尾小蛙」。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū tuánduì jiāng xīn fāxiàn de wùzhǒng mìngmíng wéi “lánwěi xiǎo wā”.
sentences.translation: The research team named the newly discovered species “blue-tailed little frog”.

sentences.chinese: 给产品命名时，既要好记，也要避免误解。
sentences.traditional: 給產品命名時，既要好記，也要避免誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Gěi chǎnpǐn mìngmíng shí, jì yào hǎo jì, yě yào bìmiǎn wùjiě.
sentences.translation: When naming a product, it should be easy to remember and also avoid misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 孩子喜欢模仿大人的语气说话，有时让全家人都笑起来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子喜歡模仿大人的語氣說話，有時讓全家人都笑起來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi xǐhuān mófǎng dàrén de yǔqì shuōhuà, yǒushí ràng quán jiā rén dōu xiào qǐlai.
sentences.translation: Children like to imitate the way adults speak, sometimes making the whole family laugh.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影没有简单地模仿经典作品，而是加入了新的视角。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影沒有簡單地模仿經典作品，而是加入了新的視角。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiǎndān de mófǎng jīngdiǎn zuòpǐn, érshì jiārù le xīn de shìjiǎo.
sentences.translation: This film did not simply imitate a classic work, but added a new perspective.

sentences.chinese: 学习发音时，可以先模仿老师的口型和节奏。
sentences.traditional: 學習發音時，可以先模仿老師的口型和節奏。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí fāyīn shí, kěyǐ xiān mófǎng lǎoshī de kǒuxíng hé jiézòu.
sentences.translation: When learning pronunciation, you can first imitate the teacher’s mouth shape and rhythm.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员用电脑模拟城市洪水的扩散过程。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員用電腦模擬城市洪水的擴散過程。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán yòng diànnǎo mónǐ chéngshì hóngshuǐ de kuòsàn guòchéng.
sentences.translation: Researchers used computers to simulate the process by which floodwater spreads through a city.

sentences.chinese: 面试前，我们安排了一次模拟练习，帮助学生减轻紧张感。
sentences.traditional: 面試前，我們安排了一次模擬練習，幫助學生減輕緊張感。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì qián, wǒmen ānpái le yí cì mónǐ liànxí, bāngzhù xuéshēng jiǎnqīng jǐnzhāng gǎn.
sentences.translation: Before the interview, we arranged a simulation exercise to help the students reduce their nervousness.

sentences.chinese: 这个软件能模拟不同利率下的还款压力。
sentences.traditional: 這個軟件能模擬不同利率下的還款壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège ruǎntǐ néng mónǐ bùtóng lìlǜ xià de huánkuǎn yālì.
sentences.translation: This software can simulate repayment pressure under different interest rates.

sentences.chinese: 那位模特儿在发布会上展示了一款环保材料做成的外套。
sentences.traditional: 那位模特兒在發佈會上展示了一款環保材料做成的外套。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèr zài fābùhuì shang zhǎnshì le yì kuǎn huánbǎo cáiliào zuò chéng de wàitào.
sentences.translation: That model showed a coat made from environmentally friendly materials at the launch event.

sentences.chinese: 她以前做过兼职模特儿，所以面对镜头很自然。
sentences.traditional: 她以前做過兼職模特兒，所以面對鏡頭很自然。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐqián zuò guo jiānzhí mótèr, suǒyǐ miànduì jìngtóu hěn zìrán.
sentences.translation: She used to work part-time as a model, so she is very natural in front of the camera.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司不只看模特儿的外表，也重视他们的表达能力。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司不只看模特兒的外表，也重視他們的表達能力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī bù zhǐ kàn mótèr de wàibiǎo, yě zhòngshì tāmen de biǎodá nénglì.
sentences.translation: This company does not only look at models’ appearance; it also values their ability to express themselves.

sentences.chinese: 山路太窄，汽车进不去，只能骑摩托车上山。
sentences.traditional: 山路太窄，汽車進不去，只能騎摩托車上山。
sentences.pinyin: Shānlù tài zhǎi, qìchē jìn bu qù, zhǐ néng qí mótuōchē shàng shān.
sentences.translation: The mountain road is too narrow for cars to enter, so people can only ride motorcycles up the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他把摩托车停在楼下，却忘了锁好。
sentences.traditional: 他把摩托車停在樓下，卻忘了鎖好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ mótuōchē tíng zài lóu xià, què wàng le suǒ hǎo.
sentences.translation: He parked the motorcycle downstairs, but forgot to lock it properly.

sentences.chinese: 城市规定夜间摩托车不得进入部分住宅区。
sentences.traditional: 城市規定夜間摩托車不得進入部分住宅區。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì guīdìng yèjiān mótuōchē bùdé jìnrù bùfen zhùzhái qū.
sentences.translation: The city rules state that motorcycles may not enter some residential areas at night.

sentences.chinese: 这个建筑模型按照真实比例缩小，细节非常精致。
sentences.traditional: 這個建築模型按照真實比例縮小，細節非常精緻。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiànzhù móxíng ànzhào zhēnshí bǐlì suōxiǎo, xìjié fēicháng jīngzhì.
sentences.translation: This architectural model is reduced according to real proportions, and the details are extremely refined.

sentences.chinese: 科学家用模型解释复杂的气候变化过程。
sentences.traditional: 科學家用模型解釋複雜的氣候變化過程。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā yòng móxíng jiěshì fùzá de qìhòu biànhuà guòchéng.
sentences.translation: Scientists use models to explain complex processes of climate change.

sentences.chinese: 这套商业模型如果成功，可以推广到其他城市。
sentences.traditional: 這套商業模型如果成功，可以推廣到其他城市。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào shāngyè móxíng rúguǒ chénggōng, kěyǐ tuīguǎng dào qítā chéngshì.
sentences.translation: If this business model succeeds, it can be promoted in other cities.

sentences.chinese: 她默默照顾生病的父亲，从来没有向别人抱怨。
sentences.traditional: 她默默照顧生病的父親，從來沒有向別人抱怨。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mòmò zhàogù shēngbìng de fùqīn, cónglái méiyǒu xiàng biéren bàoyuàn.
sentences.translation: She silently cared for her sick father and never complained to others.

sentences.chinese: 很多志愿者在后台默默工作，保证活动顺利进行。
sentences.traditional: 很多志願者在後臺默默工作，保證活動順利進行。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō zhìyuànzhě zài hòutái mòmò gōngzuò, bǎozhèng huódòng shùnlì jìnxíng.
sentences.translation: Many volunteers work silently backstage to ensure the activity runs smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 他听完消息后默默低下头，半天没有说话。
sentences.traditional: 他聽完消息後默默低下頭，半天沒有說話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng wán xiāoxi hòu mòmò dī xià tóu, bàntiān méiyǒu shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news, he silently lowered his head and said nothing for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 几年不见，他的模样几乎没有变化，只是更成熟了。
sentences.traditional: 幾年不見，他的模樣幾乎沒有變化，只是更成熟了。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐ nián bú jiàn, tā de múyàng jīhū méiyǒu biànhuà, zhǐshì gèng chéngshú le.
sentences.translation: After not seeing him for several years, his appearance has hardly changed; he just looks more mature.

sentences.chinese: 孩子认真画画的模样，让老师觉得很可爱。
sentences.traditional: 孩子認真畫畫的模樣，讓老師覺得很可愛。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi rènzhēn huàhuà de múyàng, ràng lǎoshī juéde hěn kě'ài.
sentences.translation: The child’s look while drawing seriously made the teacher think they were very cute.

sentences.chinese: 从照片上看，这座老街还保留着过去的模样。
sentences.traditional: 從照片上看，這座老街還保留著過去的模樣。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhàopiàn shang kàn, zhè zuò lǎo jiē hái bǎoliú zhe guòqù de múyàng.
sentences.translation: Judging from the photos, this old street still keeps its former appearance.

sentences.chinese: 这只母猫刚生下三只小猫，需要安静的环境。
sentences.traditional: 這隻母貓剛生下三隻小貓，需要安靜的環境。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī mǔ māo gāng shēng xià sān zhī xiǎo māo, xūyào ānjìng de huánjìng.
sentences.translation: This female cat has just given birth to three kittens and needs a quiet environment.

sentences.chinese: 农场会记录每头母牛的产奶量和健康情况。
sentences.traditional: 農場會記錄每頭母牛的產奶量和健康情況。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngchǎng huì jìlù měi tóu mǔ niú de chǎnnǎiliàng hé jiànkāng qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The farm records the milk yield and health condition of every cow.

sentences.chinese: 母鸟把食物带回巢里，喂给刚出生的幼鸟。
sentences.traditional: 母鳥把食物帶回巢裡，餵給剛出生的幼鳥。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔ niǎo bǎ shíwù dài huí cháo lǐ, wèi gěi gāng chūshēng de yòu niǎo.
sentences.translation: The mother bird brings food back to the nest and feeds the newly hatched chicks.

sentences.chinese: 对他来说，汉语不是母语，但他已经说得很流利了。
sentences.traditional: 對他來說，漢語不是母語，但他已經說得很流利了。
sentences.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, Hànyǔ bú shì mǔyǔ, dàn tā yǐjīng shuō de hěn liúlì le.
sentences.translation: For him, Chinese is not his mother tongue, but he already speaks it very fluently.

sentences.chinese: 学习外语时，适当比较母语和目标语言会很有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 學習外語時，適當比較母語和目標語言會很有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiyǔ shí, shìdàng bǐjiào mǔyǔ hé mùbiāo yǔyán huì hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: When learning a foreign language, properly comparing your mother tongue with the target language can be very helpful.

sentences.chinese: 这所学校鼓励学生用母语讲述自己的家庭故事。
sentences.traditional: 這所學校鼓勵學生用母語講述自己的家庭故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào gǔlì xuéshēng yòng mǔyǔ jiǎngshù zìjǐ de jiātíng gùshi.
sentences.translation: This school encourages students to tell their own family stories in their mother tongue.

sentences.chinese: 这种木材密度高，适合做结实的家具。
sentences.traditional: 這種木材密度高，適合做結實的傢俱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng mùcái mìdù gāo, shìhé zuò jiēshi de jiājù.
sentences.translation: This kind of timber has a high density and is suitable for making sturdy furniture.

sentences.chinese: 工厂把回收木材加工成地板和装饰板。
sentences.traditional: 工廠把回收木材加工成地板和裝飾板。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng bǎ huíshōu mùcái jiāgōng chéng dìbǎn hé zhuāngshì bǎn.
sentences.translation: The factory processes recycled wood into flooring and decorative boards.

sentences.chinese: 价格上涨后，建筑公司开始寻找更便宜的木材来源。
sentences.traditional: 價格上漲後，建築公司開始尋找更便宜的木材來源。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé shàngzhǎng hòu, jiànzhù gōngsī kāishǐ xúnzhǎo gèng piányi de mùcái láiyuán.
sentences.translation: After prices rose, the construction company began looking for cheaper sources of timber.

sentences.chinese: 请先查看目录，确认需要复习的章节在哪里。
sentences.traditional: 請先查看目錄，確認需要複習的章節在哪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān chákàn mùlù, quèrèn xūyào fùxí de zhāngjié zài nǎlǐ.
sentences.translation: Please check the table of contents first to confirm where the chapter you need to review is.

sentences.chinese: 这本报告的目录设计得很清楚，读者能很快找到重点。
sentences.traditional: 這本報告的目錄設計得很清楚，讀者能很快找到重點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn bàogào de mùlù shèjì de hěn qīngchu, dúzhě néng hěn kuài zhǎodào zhòngdiǎn.
sentences.translation: The catalogue of this report is designed very clearly, so readers can quickly find the key points.

sentences.chinese: 出版社要求作者在交稿前补上完整的目录和参考资料。
sentences.traditional: 出版社要求作者在交稿前補上完整的目錄和參考資料。
sentences.pinyin: Chūbǎnshè yāoqiú zuòzhě zài jiāogǎo qián bǔ shàng wánzhěng de mùlù hé cānkǎo zīliào.
sentences.translation: The publisher asked the author to add a complete table of contents and references before submitting the manuscript.

sentences.chinese: 这种奶粉适合一岁以上的孩子，冲泡时水温不能太高。
sentences.traditional: 這種奶粉適合一歲以上的孩子，沖泡時水溫不能太高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng nǎifěn shìhé yí suì yǐshàng de háizi, chōngpào shí shuǐwēn bù néng tài gāo.
sentences.translation: This milk powder is suitable for children over one year old, and the water should not be too hot when preparing it.

sentences.chinese: 超市把奶粉放在显眼的位置，因为很多家长都会购买。
sentences.traditional: 超市把奶粉放在顯眼的位置，因為很多家長都會購買。
sentences.pinyin: Chāoshì bǎ nǎifěn fàng zài xiǎnyǎn de wèizhi, yīnwèi hěn duō jiāzhǎng dōu huì gòumǎi.
sentences.translation: The supermarket places milk powder in a prominent position because many parents buy it.

sentences.chinese: 受物流影响，部分进口奶粉的价格近来有所上涨。
sentences.traditional: 受物流影響，部分進口奶粉的價格近來有所上漲。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu wùliú yǐngxiǎng, bùfen jìnkǒu nǎifěn de jiàgé jìnlái yǒu suǒ shàngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: Affected by logistics, the price of some imported milk powder has risen recently.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目最大的难点不是技术，而是各部门之间的协调。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目最大的難點不是技術，而是各部門之間的協調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù zuì dà de nándiǎn bú shì jìshù, érshì gè bùmén zhījiān de xiétiáo.
sentences.translation: The biggest difficulty in this project is not technology, but coordination between departments.

sentences.chinese: 老师把课文中的语法难点单独列出来，方便学生复习。
sentences.traditional: 老師把課文中的語法難點單獨列出來，方便學生複習。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ kèwén zhōng de yǔfǎ nándiǎn dāndú liè chūlai, fāngbiàn xuéshēng fùxí.
sentences.translation: The teacher listed the difficult grammar points in the text separately to make review easier for students.

sentences.chinese: 只要先解决资金问题，后面的难点就会少很多。
sentences.traditional: 只要先解決資金問題，後面的難點就會少很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào xiān jiějué zījīn wèntí, hòumiàn de nándiǎn jiù huì shǎo hěn duō.
sentences.translation: As long as the funding problem is solved first, there will be far fewer difficulties later.

sentences.chinese: 南极洲的冰层变化对全球海平面有重要影响。
sentences.traditional: 南極洲的冰層變化對全球海平面有重要影響。
sentences.pinyin: Nánjízhōu de bīngcéng biànhuà duì quánqiú hǎipíngmiàn yǒu zhòngyào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Changes in Antarctica’s ice sheets have an important impact on global sea levels.

sentences.chinese: 科学家在南极洲建立观测站，长期监测气候变化。
sentences.traditional: 科學家在南極洲建立觀測站，長期監測氣候變化。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zài Nánjízhōu jiànlì guāncèzhàn, chángqī jiāncè qìhòu biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Scientists have established observation stations in Antarctica to monitor climate change over the long term.

sentences.chinese: 去南极洲考察需要严格的安全培训和充分准备。
sentences.traditional: 去南極洲考察需要嚴格的安全培訓和充分準備。
sentences.pinyin: Qù Nánjízhōu kǎochá xūyào yángé de ānquán péixùn hé chōngfèn zhǔnbèi.
sentences.translation: Going to Antarctica for field research requires strict safety training and thorough preparation.

sentences.chinese: 南美洲拥有丰富的自然资源和多样的文化传统。
sentences.traditional: 南美洲擁有豐富的自然資源和多樣的文化傳統。
sentences.pinyin: Nánměizhōu yōngyǒu fēngfù de zìrán zīyuán hé duōyàng de wénhuà chuántǒng.
sentences.translation: South America has rich natural resources and diverse cultural traditions.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司计划把贸易网络扩展到南美洲市场。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司計劃把貿易網絡擴展到南美洲市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìhuà bǎ màoyì wǎngluò kuòzhǎn dào Nánměizhōu shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: This company plans to expand its trade network into the South American market.

sentences.chinese: 他在南美洲旅行时，学会了几首当地民歌。
sentences.traditional: 他在南美洲旅行時，學會了幾首當地民歌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài Nánměizhōu lǚxíng shí, xuéhuì le jǐ shǒu dāngdì míngē.
sentences.translation: While travelling in South America, he learned several local folk songs.

sentences.chinese: 第一次负责这么大的项目，难免会有些紧张。
sentences.traditional: 第一次負責這麼大的項目，難免會有些緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī cì fùzé zhème dà de xiàngmù, nánmiǎn huì yǒu xiē jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: When being responsible for such a large project for the first time, it is hard to avoid feeling a little nervous.

sentences.chinese: 长期在高压环境下工作，情绪波动是难免的。
sentences.traditional: 長期在高壓環境下工作，情緒波動是難免的。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī zài gāoyā huánjìng xià gōngzuò, qíngxù bōdòng shì nánmiǎn de.
sentences.translation: When working in a high-pressure environment for a long time, mood swings are inevitable.

sentences.chinese: 改革初期难免出现问题，但不能因此放弃方向。
sentences.traditional: 改革初期難免出現問題，但不能因此放棄方向。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎigé chūqī nánmiǎn chūxiàn wèntí, dàn bù néng yīncǐ fàngqì fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: In the early stage of reform, problems are hard to avoid, but one must not abandon the direction because of that.

sentences.chinese: 他低着脑袋走进会议室，看起来有点不好意思。
sentences.traditional: 他低著腦袋走進會議室，看起來有點不好意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī zhe nǎodai zǒu jìn huìyìshì, kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎn bù hǎoyìsi.
sentences.translation: He walked into the meeting room with his head lowered, looking a little embarrassed.

sentences.chinese: 孩子撞了一下脑袋，老师马上带他去医务室检查。
sentences.traditional: 孩子撞了一下腦袋，老師馬上帶他去醫務室檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zhuàng le yí xià nǎodai, lǎoshī mǎshàng dài tā qù yīwùshì jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The child bumped his head, and the teacher immediately took him to the medical room for a check.

sentences.chinese: 别把所有问题都放在脑袋里，写下来会更清楚。
sentences.traditional: 別把所有問題都放在腦袋裡，寫下來會更清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ suǒyǒu wèntí dōu fàng zài nǎodai lǐ, xiě xiàlai huì gèng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Do not keep every problem in your head; writing them down will make things clearer.

sentences.chinese: 连续工作十几个小时后，我的脑子已经转不动了。
sentences.traditional: 連續工作十幾個小時後，我的腦子已經轉不動了。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù gōngzuò shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí hòu, wǒ de nǎozi yǐjīng zhuàn bu dòng le.
sentences.translation: After working continuously for more than ten hours, my brain could no longer function properly.

sentences.chinese: 他脑子很灵活，总能想出别人没想到的办法。
sentences.traditional: 他腦子很靈活，總能想出別人沒想到的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǎozi hěn línghuó, zǒng néng xiǎng chū biéren méi xiǎngdào de bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: His mind is very flexible, and he can always come up with solutions others have not thought of.

sentences.chinese: 遇到紧急情况时，保持脑子清醒比盲目行动更重要。
sentences.traditional: 遇到緊急情況時，保持腦子清醒比盲目行動更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng shí, bǎochí nǎozi qīngxǐng bǐ mángmù xíngdòng gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When facing an emergency, keeping a clear head is more important than acting blindly.

sentences.chinese: 这句话的内涵很丰富，不能只从字面上理解。
sentences.traditional: 這句話的內涵很豐富，不能只從字面上理解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jù huà de nèihán hěn fēngfù, bù néng zhǐ cóng zìmiàn shang lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: The connotation of this sentence is very rich, and it cannot be understood only literally.

sentences.chinese: 一个城市的魅力不仅在于景观，也在于文化内涵。
sentences.traditional: 一個城市的魅力不僅在於景觀，也在於文化內涵。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge chéngshì de mèilì bùjǐn zài yú jǐngguān, yě zài yú wénhuà nèihán.
sentences.translation: The charm of a city lies not only in its landscape, but also in its cultural meaning.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们解释成语的内涵，并举出实际例子。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們解釋成語的內涵，並舉出實際例子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen jiěshì chéngyǔ de nèihán, bìng jǔ chū shíjì lìzi.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to explain the connotation of the idiom and give practical examples.

sentences.chinese: 他咳嗽了两个星期，医生建议他去内科做进一步检查。
sentences.traditional: 他咳嗽了兩個星期，醫生建議他去內科做進一步檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Tā késou le liǎng ge xīngqī, yīshēng jiànyì tā qù nèikē zuò jìn yí bù jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: He had been coughing for two weeks, so the doctor advised him to go to internal medicine for further examination.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院的内科门诊每天早上八点开始挂号。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院的內科門診每天早上八點開始掛號。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē ménzhěn měi tiān zǎoshang bā diǎn kāishǐ guàhào.
sentences.translation: The internal medicine outpatient department of this hospital starts registration at eight every morning.

sentences.chinese: 如果只是普通的胃痛，可以先预约内科医生。
sentences.traditional: 如果只是普通的胃痛，可以先預約內科醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ shì pǔtōng de wèitòng, kěyǐ xiān yùyuē nèikē yīshēng.
sentences.translation: If it is just an ordinary stomach ache, you can first make an appointment with an internal medicine doctor.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城经过修复后，城墙内外都设置了清晰的导览标志。
sentences.traditional: 這座古城經過修復後，城牆內外都設置了清晰的導覽標誌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng jīngguò xiūfù hòu, chéngqiáng nèiwài dōu shèzhì le qīngxī de dǎolǎn biāozhì.
sentences.translation: After restoration, clear guide signs were installed both inside and outside the ancient city walls.

sentences.chinese: 公司内外对这次改革的反应并不完全一致。
sentences.traditional: 公司內外對這次改革的反應並不完全一致。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī nèiwài duì zhè cì gǎigé de fǎnyìng bìng bù wánquán yízhì.
sentences.translation: Inside and outside the company, reactions to this reform are not entirely the same.

sentences.chinese: 他长期研究家庭内外因素对儿童成长的影响。
sentences.traditional: 他長期研究家庭內外因素對兒童成長的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángqī yánjiū jiātíng nèiwài yīnsù duì értóng chéngzhǎng de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: He has long studied the impact of factors inside and outside the family on children’s development.

sentences.chinese: 出差前，她把内衣和洗漱用品单独放进一个小袋子里。
sentences.traditional: 出差前，她把內衣和洗漱用品單獨放進一個小袋子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Chūchāi qián, tā bǎ nèiyī hé xǐshù yòngpǐn dāndú fàng jìn yí ge xiǎo dàizi lǐ.
sentences.translation: Before the business trip, she put her underwear and toiletries into a separate small bag.

sentences.chinese: 这家店强调内衣面料的透气性和舒适度。
sentences.traditional: 這家店強調內衣面料的透氣性和舒適度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn qiángdiào nèiyī miànliào de tòuqìxìng hé shūshìdù.
sentences.translation: This shop emphasises the breathability and comfort of its underwear fabrics.

sentences.chinese: 洗内衣时最好使用温和的洗涤剂，避免刺激皮肤。
sentences.traditional: 洗內衣時最好使用溫和的洗滌劑，避免刺激皮膚。
sentences.pinyin: Xǐ nèiyī shí zuì hǎo shǐyòng wēnhé de xǐdíjì, bìmiǎn cìjī pífū.
sentences.translation: When washing underwear, it is best to use a mild detergent to avoid irritating the skin.

sentences.chinese: 充足的睡眠能帮助身体恢复能量，提高第二天的效率。
sentences.traditional: 充足的睡眠能幫助身體恢復能量，提高第二天的效率。
sentences.pinyin: Chōngzú de shuìmián néng bāngzhù shēntǐ huīfù néngliàng, tígāo dì èr tiān de xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Sufficient sleep can help the body restore energy and improve efficiency the next day.

sentences.chinese: 这场演讲充满了能量，很多听众听完后都受到鼓舞。
sentences.traditional: 這場演講充滿了能量，很多聽眾聽完後都受到鼓舞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǎnjiǎng chōngmǎn le néngliàng, hěn duō tīngzhòng tīng wán hòu dōu shòudào gǔwǔ.
sentences.translation: This speech was full of energy, and many listeners felt encouraged afterwards.

sentences.chinese: 运动饮料并不能真正替代均衡饮食提供的能量。
sentences.traditional: 運動飲料並不能真正替代均衡飲食提供的能量。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐnliào bìng bù néng zhēnzhèng tìdài jūnhéng yǐnshí tígōng de néngliàng.
sentences.translation: Sports drinks cannot truly replace the energy provided by a balanced diet.

sentences.chinese: 发展可再生能源是减少碳排放的重要途径。
sentences.traditional: 發展可再生能源是減少碳排放的重要途徑。
sentences.pinyin: Fāzhǎn kě zàishēng néngyuán shì jiǎnshǎo tàn páifàng de zhòngyào tújìng.
sentences.translation: Developing renewable energy is an important way to reduce carbon emissions.

sentences.chinese: 这个国家的能源结构正在从煤炭逐步转向风能和太阳能。
sentences.traditional: 這個國家的能源結構正在從煤炭逐步轉向風能和太陽能。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de néngyuán jiégòu zhèngzài cóng méitàn zhúbù zhuǎnxiàng fēngnéng hé tàiyángnéng.
sentences.translation: This country's energy structure is gradually shifting from coal to wind and solar power.

sentences.chinese: 如果能源价格继续上涨，许多小企业的成本压力会更大。
sentences.traditional: 如果能源價格繼續上漲，許多小企業的成本壓力會更大。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ néngyuán jiàgé jìxù shàngzhǎng, xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè de chéngběn yālì huì gèng dà.
sentences.translation: If energy prices continue to rise, cost pressure on many small businesses will become greater.

sentences.chinese: 雨后的小路全是泥，孩子们的鞋很快就脏了。
sentences.traditional: 雨後的小路全是泥，孩子們的鞋很快就髒了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu de xiǎolù quán shì ní, háizimen de xié hěn kuài jiù zāng le.
sentences.translation: After the rain, the path was full of mud, and the children's shoes quickly got dirty.

sentences.chinese: 他用手把花盆里的泥压实，再种下新的幼苗。
sentences.traditional: 他用手把花盆裡的泥壓實，再種下新的幼苗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu bǎ huāpén lǐ de ní yā shí, zài zhòng xià xīn de yòumiáo.
sentences.translation: He used his hands to press down the soil in the flowerpot, then planted new seedlings.

sentences.chinese: 车轮陷进泥里后，大家合力才把车推了出来。
sentences.traditional: 車輪陷進泥裡後，大家合力才把車推了出來。
sentences.pinyin: Chēlún xiàn jìn ní lǐ hòu, dàjiā hélì cái bǎ chē tuī le chūlai.
sentences.translation: After the wheels sank into the mud, everyone worked together to push the car out.

sentences.chinese: 年度报告显示，公司在研发方面的投入明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 年度報告顯示，公司在研發方面的投入明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Niándù bàogào xiǎnshì, gōngsī zài yánfā fāngmiàn de tóurù míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: The annual report shows that the company’s investment in research and development has clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 学校将在年度会议上公布新的课程安排。
sentences.traditional: 學校將在年度會議上公佈新的課程安排。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāng zài niándù huìyì shang gōngbù xīn de kèchéng ānpái.
sentences.translation: The school will announce the new course arrangements at the annual meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这位作家凭借新小说获得了年度文学奖。
sentences.traditional: 這位作家憑藉新小說獲得了年度文學獎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā píngjiè xīn xiǎoshuō huòdé le niándù wénxué jiǎng.
sentences.translation: This writer won the annual literature award for a new novel.

sentences.chinese: 年终总结不仅要列出成绩，也要分析存在的问题。
sentences.traditional: 年終總結不僅要列出成績，也要分析存在的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Niánzhōng zǒngjié bùjǐn yào liè chū chéngjì, yě yào fēnxī cúnzài de wèntí.
sentences.translation: A year-end summary should list achievements and also analyse existing problems.

sentences.chinese: 许多公司会在年终发放奖金，以感谢员工一年的努力。
sentences.traditional: 許多公司會在年終發放獎金，以感謝員工一年的努力。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō gōngsī huì zài niánzhōng fāfàng jiǎngjīn, yǐ gǎnxiè yuángōng yì nián de nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Many companies issue bonuses at the end of the year to thank employees for a year of effort.

sentences.chinese: 年终临近，各部门都在加班整理财务数据。
sentences.traditional: 年終臨近，各部門都在加班整理財務數據。
sentences.pinyin: Niánzhōng línjìn, gè bùmén dōu zài jiābān zhěnglǐ cáiwù shùjù.
sentences.translation: As year-end approaches, all departments are working overtime to organise financial data.

sentences.chinese: 她小时候在乡下念书，后来靠奖学金去了省城。
sentences.traditional: 她小時候在鄉下念書，後來靠獎學金去了省城。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎo shíhou zài xiāngxià niànshū, hòulái kào jiǎngxuéjīn qù le shěngchéng.
sentences.translation: She attended school in the countryside as a child, and later went to the provincial capital on a scholarship.

sentences.chinese: 父母希望他安心念书，不要太早承受经济压力。
sentences.traditional: 父母希望他安心念書，不要太早承受經濟壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ xīwàng tā ānxīn niànshū, bú yào tài zǎo chéngshòu jīngjì yālì.
sentences.translation: His parents hope he will focus on his studies and not face financial pressure too early.

sentences.chinese: 念书不只是为了考试，更是为了培养独立思考的能力。
sentences.traditional: 念書不只是為了考試，更是為了培養獨立思考的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Niànshū bù zhǐ shì wèile kǎoshì, gèng shì wèile péiyǎng dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì.
sentences.translation: Studying is not just for exams, but also for developing the ability to think independently.

sentences.chinese: 他下楼时不小心扭了脚，只好请假休息一天。
sentences.traditional: 他下樓時不小心扭了腳，只好請假休息一天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xià lóu shí bù xiǎoxīn niǔ le jiǎo, zhǐhǎo qǐngjià xiūxi yì tiān.
sentences.translation: He accidentally twisted his ankle while going downstairs, so he had to take a day off to rest.

sentences.chinese: 请把这个按钮向右扭一下，机器就会启动。
sentences.traditional: 請把這個按鈕向右扭一下，機器就會啟動。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhège ànniǔ xiàng yòu niǔ yí xià, jīqì jiù huì qǐdòng.
sentences.translation: Please turn this knob to the right, and the machine will start.

sentences.chinese: 孩子扭过头去，不肯回答老师的问题。
sentences.traditional: 孩子扭過頭去，不肯回答老師的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi niǔ guò tóu qù, bù kěn huídá lǎoshī de wèntí.
sentences.translation: The child turned his head away and refused to answer the teacher’s question.

sentences.chinese: 当地农产品通过直播平台销售，价格比以前更透明。
sentences.traditional: 當地農產品通過直播平臺銷售，價格比以前更透明。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì nóngchǎnpǐn tōngguò zhíbō píngtái xiāoshòu, jiàgé bǐ yǐqián gèng tòumíng.
sentences.translation: Local agricultural products are sold through live-streaming platforms, making prices more transparent than before.

sentences.chinese: 政府鼓励农产品加工企业提高质量标准，扩大出口。
sentences.traditional: 政府鼓勵農產品加工企業提高質量標準，擴大出口。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gǔlì nóngchǎnpǐn jiāgōng qǐyè tígāo zhìliàng biāozhǔn, kuòdà chūkǒu.
sentences.translation: The government encourages agricultural-product processing companies to raise quality standards and expand exports.

sentences.chinese: 这场展会集中展示了各地特色农产品，吸引了不少采购商。
sentences.traditional: 這場展會集中展示了各地特色農產品，吸引了不少採購商。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhǎnhuì jízhōng zhǎnshì le gèdì tèsè nóngchǎnpǐn, xīyǐn le bù shǎo cǎigòushāng.
sentences.translation: This exhibition showcased distinctive agricultural products from different regions and attracted many buyers.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片带有浓厚的地方色彩，很多细节都来自真实生活。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片帶有濃厚的地方色彩，很多細節都來自真實生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn dài yǒu nónghòu de dìfāng sècǎi, hěn duō xìjié dōu láizì zhēnshí shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This documentary has a strong local flavour, and many details come from real life.

sentences.chinese: 学生们对人工智能表现出浓厚兴趣，课后还继续讨论相关问题。
sentences.traditional: 學生們對人工智能表現出濃厚興趣，課後還繼續討論相關問題。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēngmen duì réngōng zhìnéng biǎoxiàn chū nónghòu xìngqù, kè hòu hái jìxù tǎolùn xiāngguān wèntí.
sentences.translation: The students showed strong interest in artificial intelligence and continued discussing related issues after class.

sentences.chinese: 这条老街保留了浓厚的历史氛围，不少游客特意来拍照。
sentences.traditional: 這條老街保留了濃厚的歷史氛圍，不少遊客特意來拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lǎojiē bǎoliú le nónghòu de lìshǐ fēnwéi, bù shǎo yóukè tèyì lái pāizhào.
sentences.translation: This old street has preserved a rich historical atmosphere, and many tourists come specially to take photos.

sentences.chinese: 春耕之前，村民们先清理排水沟，避免农田被雨水淹没。
sentences.traditional: 春耕之前，村民們先清理排水溝，避免農田被雨水淹沒。
sentences.pinyin: Chūngēng zhīqián, cūnmínmen xiān qīnglǐ páishuǐgōu, bìmiǎn nóngtián bèi yǔshuǐ yānmò.
sentences.translation: Before spring ploughing, the villagers first clear the drainage ditches to prevent the farmland from being flooded.

sentences.chinese: 无人机可以定期监测农田状况，帮助农户及时发现病虫害。
sentences.traditional: 無人機可以定期監測農田狀況，幫助農戶及時發現病蟲害。
sentences.pinyin: Wúrénjī kěyǐ dìngqī jiāncè nóngtián zhuàngkuàng, bāngzhù nónghù jíshí fāxiàn bìngchónghài.
sentences.translation: Drones can regularly monitor farmland conditions and help farmers detect pests and diseases in time.

sentences.chinese: 这片农田经过多年改良，土壤比以前更加肥沃。
sentences.traditional: 這片農田經過多年改良，土壤比以前更加肥沃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn nóngtián jīngguò duōnián gǎiliáng, tǔrǎng bǐ yǐqián gèngjiā féiwò.
sentences.translation: After years of improvement, the soil in this farmland is more fertile than before.

sentences.chinese: 太阳一出来，屋子里慢慢暖了起来。
sentences.traditional: 太陽一出來，屋子裡慢慢暖了起來。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng yì chūlai, wūzi lǐ mànmàn nuǎn le qǐlai.
sentences.translation: As soon as the sun came out, the room slowly warmed up.

sentences.chinese: 他把热汤递给老人，希望能让她的身体暖一点。
sentences.traditional: 他把熱湯遞給老人，希望能讓她的身體暖一點。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ rè tāng dì gěi lǎorén, xīwàng néng ràng tā de shēntǐ nuǎn yìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: He handed the hot soup to the old woman, hoping it would warm her body a little.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套很轻，却比看起来更暖。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套很輕，卻比看起來更暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào hěn qīng, què bǐ kàn qǐlai gèng nuǎn.
sentences.translation: This coat is very light, yet warmer than it looks.

sentences.chinese: 暖气突然坏了，整栋楼的居民都感到很不方便。
sentences.traditional: 暖氣突然壞了，整棟樓的居民都感到很不方便。
sentences.pinyin: Nuǎnqì tūrán huài le, zhěng dòng lóu de jūmín dōu gǎndào hěn bù fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The heating suddenly broke, and residents of the whole building found it very inconvenient.

sentences.chinese: 北方冬天室内有暖气，温度通常比南方稳定。
sentences.traditional: 北方冬天室內有暖氣，溫度通常比南方穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Běifāng dōngtiān shìnèi yǒu nuǎnqì, wēndù tōngcháng bǐ nánfāng wěndìng.
sentences.translation: In the north, indoor heating is available in winter, so temperatures are usually more stable than in the south.

sentences.chinese: 为了节省能源，办公室晚上会自动关闭暖气。
sentences.traditional: 為了節省能源，辦公室晚上會自動關閉暖氣。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng néngyuán, bàngōngshì wǎnshang huì zìdòng guānbì nuǎnqì.
sentences.translation: To save energy, the office automatically turns off the heating at night.

sentences.chinese: 他把那位科学家当作偶像，立志将来也从事研究工作。
