sentences.traditional: 他把那位科學家當作偶像，立志將來也從事研究工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà wèi kēxuéjiā dàngzuò ǒuxiàng, lìzhì jiānglái yě cóngshì yánjiū gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He regards that scientist as his idol and is determined to do research work in the future too.

sentences.chinese: 真正的偶像不只靠外表，更要用行动影响年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 真正的偶像不只靠外表，更要用行動影響年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de ǒuxiàng bù zhǐ kào wàibiǎo, gèng yào yòng xíngdòng yǐngxiǎng niánqīngrén.
sentences.translation: A true idol relies not only on appearance, but also influences young people through actions.

sentences.chinese: 这名运动员夺冠后，成了许多孩子心中的偶像。
sentences.traditional: 這名運動員奪冠後，成了許多孩子心中的偶像。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè míng yùndòngyuán duóguàn hòu, chéng le xǔduō háizi xīnzhōng de ǒuxiàng.
sentences.translation: After winning the championship, this athlete became an idol in the hearts of many children.

sentences.chinese: 在没有足够证据之前，警方不能排除任何可能性。
sentences.traditional: 在沒有足夠證據之前，警方不能排除任何可能性。
sentences.pinyin: Zài méiyǒu zúgòu zhèngjù zhīqián, jǐngfāng bù néng páichú rènhé kěnéngxìng.
sentences.translation: Before there is enough evidence, the police cannot rule out any possibility.

sentences.chinese: 医生需要先排除严重疾病，再决定是否采用保守治疗。
sentences.traditional: 醫生需要先排除嚴重疾病，再決定是否採用保守治療。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào xiān páichú yánzhòng jíbìng, zài juédìng shìfǒu cǎiyòng bǎoshǒu zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: The doctor needs to rule out serious disease first, then decide whether to use conservative treatment.

sentences.chinese: 项目组排除了几个风险较高的方案，选择了更稳妥的路线。
sentences.traditional: 項目組排除了幾個風險較高的方案，選擇了更穩妥的路線。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmùzǔ páichú le jǐ ge fēngxiǎn jiào gāo de fāng'àn, xuǎnzé le gèng wěntuǒ de lùxiàn.
sentences.translation: The project team eliminated several higher-risk plans and chose a safer route.

sentences.chinese: 工厂必须减少废气排放，否则将面临罚款。
sentences.traditional: 工廠必須減少廢氣排放，否則將面臨罰款。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng bìxū jiǎnshǎo fèiqì páifàng, fǒuzé jiāng miànlín fákuǎn.
sentences.translation: The factory must reduce exhaust emissions, otherwise it will face a fine.

sentences.chinese: 交通部门计划限制高排放车辆进入市中心。
sentences.traditional: 交通部門計劃限制高排放車輛進入市中心。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāotōng bùmén jìhuà xiànzhì gāo páifàng chēliàng jìnrù shì zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: The transport department plans to restrict high-emission vehicles from entering the city centre.

sentences.chinese: 如果污水未经处理就排放到河里，生态系统会受到破坏。
sentences.traditional: 如果污水未經處理就排放到河裡，生態系統會受到破壞。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wūshuǐ wèijīng chǔlǐ jiù páifàng dào hé lǐ, shēngtài xìtǒng huì shòudào pòhuài.
sentences.translation: If wastewater is discharged into the river without treatment, the ecosystem will be damaged.

sentences.chinese: 演出前一周，演员们每天都要排练到很晚。
sentences.traditional: 演出前一週，演員們每天都要排練到很晚。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnchū qián yì zhōu, yǎnyuánmen měitiān dōu yào páiliàn dào hěn wǎn.
sentences.translation: In the week before the performance, the actors have to rehearse until very late every day.

sentences.chinese: 这场辩论赛需要反复排练，才能把时间控制得更准确。
sentences.traditional: 這場辯論賽需要反覆排練，才能把時間控制得更準確。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng biànlùn sài xūyào fǎnfù páiliàn, cái néng bǎ shíjiān kòngzhì de gèng zhǔnquè.
sentences.translation: This debate competition requires repeated rehearsal in order to control the timing more accurately.

sentences.chinese: 合唱团正在排练新曲目，准备参加下个月的比赛。
sentences.traditional: 合唱團正在排練新曲目，準備參加下個月的比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Héchàngtuán zhèngzài páiliàn xīn qǔmù, zhǔnbèi cānjiā xià ge yuè de bǐsài.
sentences.translation: The choir is rehearsing new pieces in preparation for next month’s competition.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学在最新榜单中排名明显上升。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學在最新榜單中排名明顯上升。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué zài zuìxīn bǎngdān zhōng páimíng míngxiǎn shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: This university’s ranking has risen noticeably in the latest list.

sentences.chinese: 企业不能只追求排名，还要真正改善服务质量。
sentences.traditional: 企業不能只追求排名，還要真正改善服務質量。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú páimíng, hái yào zhēnzhèng gǎishàn fúwù zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: Companies should not only pursue rankings; they also need to genuinely improve service quality.

sentences.chinese: 他的成绩排名靠前，但仍然保持低调。
sentences.traditional: 他的成績排名靠前，但仍然保持低調。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì páimíng kào qián, dàn réngrán bǎochí dīdiào.
sentences.translation: His results rank near the top, but he still remains modest.

sentences.chinese: 服务员端上来一盘热菜，香味立刻飘满了房间。
sentences.traditional: 服務員端上來一盤熱菜，香味立刻飄滿了房間。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán duān shànglai yì pán rè cài, xiāngwèi lìkè piāo mǎn le fángjiān.
sentences.translation: The waiter brought up a plate of hot food, and the aroma immediately filled the room.

sentences.chinese: 这盘棋下了三个小时，双方都不肯轻易认输。
sentences.traditional: 這盤棋下了三個小時，雙方都不肯輕易認輸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pán qí xià le sān ge xiǎoshí, shuāngfāng dōu bù kěn qīngyì rènshū.
sentences.translation: This game of chess lasted three hours, and neither side was willing to give up easily.

sentences.chinese: 他把电线盘好放进工具箱，免得下次使用时打结。
sentences.traditional: 他把電線盤好放進工具箱，免得下次使用時打結。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ diànxiàn pán hǎo fàng jìn gōngjùxiāng, miǎnde xià cì shǐyòng shí dǎjié.
sentences.translation: He coiled the wire neatly and put it in the toolbox, so it would not tangle next time.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们盼望已久的春游终于确定了日期。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們盼望已久的春遊終於確定了日期。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen pànwàng yǐjiǔ de chūnyóu zhōngyú quèdìng le rìqī.
sentences.translation: The spring outing the children had long looked forward to finally had a confirmed date.

sentences.chinese: 他们盼望通过这次合作打开新的市场。
sentences.traditional: 他們盼望通過這次合作打開新的市場。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pànwàng tōngguò zhè cì hézuò dǎkāi xīn de shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: They hope to open up a new market through this cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 多年的努力让村民盼望的清洁饮水成为现实。
sentences.traditional: 多年的努力讓村民盼望的清潔飲水成為現實。
sentences.pinyin: Duōnián de nǔlì ràng cūnmín pànwàng de qīngjié yǐnshuǐ chéngwéi xiànshí.
sentences.translation: Years of effort made the clean drinking water the villagers longed for a reality.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司拥有庞大的销售网络，几乎覆盖全国。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司擁有龐大的銷售網絡，幾乎覆蓋全國。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yōngyǒu pángdà de xiāoshòu wǎngluò, jīhū fùgài quánguó.
sentences.translation: This company has a huge sales network that covers almost the whole country.

sentences.chinese: 庞大的数据量要求系统具备更强的处理能力。
sentences.traditional: 龐大的數據量要求系統具備更強的處理能力。
sentences.pinyin: Pángdà de shùjùliàng yāoqiú xìtǒng jùbèi gèng qiáng de chǔlǐ nénglì.
sentences.translation: The huge amount of data requires the system to have stronger processing capacity.

sentences.chinese: 城市管理面对庞大的人口压力，不能只靠临时措施。
sentences.traditional: 城市管理面對龐大的人口壓力，不能只靠臨時措施。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì guǎnlǐ miànduì pángdà de rénkǒu yālì, bù néng zhǐ kào línshí cuòshī.
sentences.translation: Urban management faces huge population pressure and cannot rely only on temporary measures.

sentences.chinese: 他把旧观念抛在一边，重新设计了整个方案。
sentences.traditional: 他把舊觀念拋在一邊，重新設計了整個方案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiù guānniàn pāo zài yìbiān, chóngxīn shèjì le zhěnggè fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: He put old ideas aside and redesigned the entire plan.

sentences.chinese: 演讲结束后，记者立刻向他抛出几个尖锐问题。
sentences.traditional: 演講結束後，記者立刻向他拋出幾個尖銳問題。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng jiéshù hòu, jìzhě lìkè xiàng tā pāo chū jǐ ge jiānruì wèntí.
sentences.translation: After the speech ended, reporters immediately threw several sharp questions at him.

sentences.chinese: 渔民把网抛进海里，希望今晚能有好收获。
sentences.traditional: 漁民把網拋進海裡，希望今晚能有好收穫。
sentences.pinyin: Yúmín bǎ wǎng pāo jìn hǎi lǐ, xīwàng jīnwǎn néng yǒu hǎo shōuhuò.
sentences.translation: The fisherman threw the net into the sea, hoping for a good catch tonight.

sentences.chinese: 她每天早晨都要泡一杯绿茶，让自己慢慢清醒。
sentences.traditional: 她每天早晨都要泡一杯綠茶，讓自己慢慢清醒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎochén dōu yào pào yì bēi lǜchá, ràng zìjǐ mànmàn qīngxǐng.
sentences.translation: Every morning she makes a cup of green tea to help herself wake up slowly.

sentences.chinese: 洗衣机里冒出的泡把地板弄湿了。
sentences.traditional: 洗衣機裡冒出的泡把地板弄濕了。
sentences.pinyin: Xǐyījī lǐ mào chū de pào bǎ dìbǎn nòng shī le.
sentences.translation: The bubbles coming out of the washing machine made the floor wet.

sentences.chinese: 这豆子需要提前泡一夜，第二天才容易煮烂。
sentences.traditional: 這豆子需要提前泡一夜，第二天才容易煮爛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dòuzi xūyào tíqián pào yí yè, dì èr tiān cái róngyì zhǔ làn.
sentences.translation: These beans need to be soaked overnight in advance, so they will be easy to cook soft the next day.

sentences.chinese: 由于合同违约，公司必须向客户赔偿损失。
sentences.traditional: 由於合同違約，公司必須向客戶賠償損失。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú hétong wéiyuē, gōngsī bìxū xiàng kèhù péicháng sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: Because of the breach of contract, the company must compensate the client for the losses.

sentences.chinese: 事故原因查清后，受害者家属提出了赔偿要求。
sentences.traditional: 事故原因查清後，受害者家屬提出了賠償要求。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù yuányīn cháqīng hòu, shòuhàizhě jiāshǔ tíchū le péicháng yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: After the cause of the accident was clarified, the victim's family made a compensation demand.

sentences.chinese: 保险公司是否赔偿，还要看具体条款。
sentences.traditional: 保險公司是否賠償，還要看具體條款。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎoxiǎn gōngsī shìfǒu péicháng, hái yào kàn jùtǐ tiáokuǎn.
sentences.translation: Whether the insurance company will compensate still depends on the specific terms.

sentences.chinese: 代表团访问期间，将由两名翻译全程陪同。
sentences.traditional: 代表團訪問期間，將由兩名翻譯全程陪同。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán fǎngwèn qījiān, jiāng yóu liǎng míng fānyì quánchéng péitóng.
sentences.translation: During the delegation's visit, two interpreters will accompany them throughout.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议家属陪同老人去医院复查。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議家屬陪同老人去醫院複查。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì jiāshǔ péitóng lǎorén qù yīyuàn fùchá.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested that a family member accompany the elderly person to the hospital for a follow-up check.

sentences.chinese: 校长亲自陪同专家参观新建的实验楼。
sentences.traditional: 校長親自陪同專家參觀新建的實驗樓。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng qīnzì péitóng zhuānjiā cānguān xīnjiàn de shíyànlóu.
sentences.translation: The headteacher personally accompanied the experts on a visit to the newly built laboratory building.

sentences.chinese: 学校不仅传授知识，也要培育学生的责任感。
sentences.traditional: 學校不僅傳授知識，也要培育學生的責任感。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bùjǐn chuánshòu zhīshi, yě yào péiyù xuéshēng de zérèngǎn.
sentences.translation: Schools should not only pass on knowledge, but also cultivate students' sense of responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 这片温室专门用于培育耐寒的新品种。
sentences.traditional: 這片溫室專門用於培育耐寒的新品種。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn wēnshì zhuānmén yòngyú péiyù nàihán de xīn pǐnzhǒng.
sentences.translation: This greenhouse is specially used to cultivate new cold-resistant varieties.

sentences.chinese: 良好的社会环境能够培育更多创新人才。
sentences.traditional: 良好的社會環境能夠培育更多創新人才。
sentences.pinyin: Liánghǎo de shèhuì huánjìng nénggòu péiyù gèng duō chuàngxīn réncái.
sentences.translation: A good social environment can cultivate more innovative talent.

sentences.chinese: 新建的救援队已经配备了先进的通讯设备。
sentences.traditional: 新建的救援隊已經配備了先進的通訊設備。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnjiàn de jiùyuánduì yǐjīng pèibèi le xiānjìn de tōngxùn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The newly formed rescue team has already been equipped with advanced communication equipment.

sentences.chinese: 每辆客车都应配备安全锤和灭火器。
sentences.traditional: 每輛客車都應配備安全錘和滅火器。
sentences.pinyin: Měi liàng kèchē dōu yīng pèibèi ānquán chuí hé mièhuǒqì.
sentences.translation: Every passenger bus should be equipped with a safety hammer and a fire extinguisher.

sentences.chinese: 这套设备的配备标准比去年提高了不少。
sentences.traditional: 這套設備的配備標準比去年提高了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào shèbèi de pèibèi biāozhǔn bǐ qùnián tígāo le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: The equipment standard for this set has improved quite a bit compared with last year.

sentences.chinese: 我很佩服她在困难面前仍然保持冷静。
sentences.traditional: 我很佩服她在困難面前仍然保持冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn pèifú tā zài kùnnan miànqián réngrán bǎochí lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: I really admire her for remaining calm in the face of difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 同事们都佩服他的专业能力和负责态度。
sentences.traditional: 同事們都佩服他的專業能力和負責態度。
sentences.pinyin: Tóngshìmen dōu pèifú tā de zhuānyè nénglì hé fùzé tàidu.
sentences.translation: His colleagues all admire his professional ability and responsible attitude.

sentences.chinese: 你能主动承认错误，这一点让我很佩服。
sentences.traditional: 你能主動承認錯誤，這一點讓我很佩服。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ néng zhǔdòng chéngrèn cuòwù, zhè yì diǎn ràng wǒ hěn pèifú.
sentences.translation: The fact that you can take the initiative to admit mistakes makes me admire you.

sentences.chinese: 新小区不仅房子建好了，配套设施也逐步完善。
sentences.traditional: 新小區不僅房子建好了，配套設施也逐步完善。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiǎoqū bùjǐn fángzi jiàn hǎo le, pèitào shèshī yě zhúbù wánshàn.
sentences.translation: In the new residential area, not only have the buildings been completed, but the supporting facilities are also being improved step by step.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有配套政策，改革很难真正落地。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有配套政策，改革很難真正落地。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu pèitào zhèngcè, gǎigé hěn nán zhēnzhèng luòdì.
sentences.translation: Without supporting policies, the reform will be difficult to implement in practice.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件需要配套的培训课程，用户才能用得顺手。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件需要配套的培訓課程，用戶才能用得順手。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn xūyào pèitào de péixùn kèchéng, yònghù cái néng yòng de shùnshǒu.
sentences.translation: This software needs matching training courses so that users can use it smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 园丁把水雾喷在花苗上，避免阳光太强时叶子被晒伤。
sentences.traditional: 園丁把水霧噴在花苗上，避免陽光太強時葉子被曬傷。
sentences.pinyin: Yuándīng bǎ shuǐwù pēn zài huāmiáo shàng, bìmiǎn yángguāng tài qiáng shí yèzi bèi shàishāng.
sentences.translation: The gardener sprayed mist onto the seedlings to prevent the leaves from being scorched when the sun was too strong.

sentences.chinese: 消防员先向仓库入口喷了泡沫，再进入现场检查。
sentences.traditional: 消防員先向倉庫入口噴了泡沫，再進入現場檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán xiān xiàng cāngkù rùkǒu pēn le pàomò, zài jìnrù xiànchǎng jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: The firefighters first sprayed foam at the warehouse entrance, then entered the scene to inspect it.

sentences.chinese: 这种清洁剂不能直接喷到皮肤上，否则可能引起过敏。
sentences.traditional: 這種清潔劑不能直接噴到皮膚上，否則可能引起過敏。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qīngjiéjì bù néng zhíjiē pēn dào pífū shàng, fǒuzé kěnéng yǐnqǐ guòmǐn.
sentences.translation: This cleaning product must not be sprayed directly onto the skin, otherwise it may cause an allergic reaction.

sentences.chinese: 她小心地捧着那只受伤的小鸟，等救助人员赶来。
sentences.traditional: 她小心地捧著那隻受傷的小鳥，等救助人員趕來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoxīn de pěng zhe nà zhī shòushāng de xiǎoniǎo, děng jiùzhù rényuán gǎnlái.
sentences.translation: She carefully held the injured bird in both hands and waited for the rescue staff to arrive.

sentences.chinese: 孩子从地上抓起一捧泥，好奇地观察里面的小虫。
sentences.traditional: 孩子從地上抓起一捧泥，好奇地觀察裡面的小蟲。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi cóng dìshang zhuā qǐ yì pěng ní, hàoqí de guānchá lǐmiàn de xiǎochóng.
sentences.translation: The child picked up a handful of mud from the ground and curiously observed the little insects inside.

sentences.chinese: 获奖运动员双手捧着金牌，激动得说不出话。
sentences.traditional: 獲獎運動員雙手捧著金牌，激動得說不出話。
sentences.pinyin: Huòjiǎng yùndòngyuán shuāngshǒu pěng zhe jīnpái, jīdòng de shuō bù chū huà.
sentences.translation: The winning athlete held the gold medal in both hands and was too excited to speak.

sentences.chinese: 两辆货车在路口发生碰撞，造成道路暂时封闭。
sentences.traditional: 兩輛貨車在路口發生碰撞，造成道路暫時封閉。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng liàng huòchē zài lùkǒu fāshēng pèngzhuàng, zàochéng dàolù zànshí fēngbì.
sentences.translation: Two trucks collided at the junction, causing the road to be temporarily closed.

sentences.chinese: 观点的碰撞往往能激发新的解决思路。
sentences.traditional: 觀點的碰撞往往能激發新的解決思路。
sentences.pinyin: Guāndiǎn de pèngzhuàng wǎngwǎng néng jīfā xīn de jiějué sīlù.
sentences.translation: A clash of viewpoints can often stimulate new ideas for solving problems.

sentences.chinese: 实验模拟了高速粒子碰撞后的能量变化。
sentences.traditional: 實驗模擬了高速粒子碰撞後的能量變化。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyàn mónǐ le gāosù lìzǐ pèngzhuàng hòu de néngliàng biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The experiment simulated the energy changes after high-speed particle collisions.

sentences.chinese: 他披上一件外套，匆匆走进寒冷的夜色。
sentences.traditional: 他披上一件外套，匆匆走進寒冷的夜色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pī shàng yí jiàn wàitào, cōngcōng zǒu jìn hánlěng de yèsè.
sentences.translation: He threw on a coat and hurried into the cold night.

sentences.chinese: 老太太披着毛毯坐在窗边，安静地听雷声。
sentences.traditional: 老太太披著毛毯坐在窗邊，安靜地聽雷聲。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎotàitai pī zhe máotǎn zuò zài chuāng biān, ānjìng de tīng léishēng.
sentences.translation: The old lady sat by the window wrapped in a blanket, quietly listening to the thunder.

sentences.chinese: 舞者披着红色长巾，在灯光下显得格外醒目。
sentences.traditional: 舞者披著紅色長巾，在燈光下顯得格外醒目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔzhě pī zhe hóngsè chángjīn, zài dēngguāng xià xiǎnde géwài xǐngmù.
sentences.translation: The dancer wore a long red scarf draped over her shoulders, looking especially striking under the lights.

sentences.chinese: 这种水果的皮很薄，轻轻一剥就能吃。
sentences.traditional: 這種水果的皮很薄，輕輕一剝就能吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ de pí hěn báo, qīngqīng yì bāo jiù néng chī.
sentences.translation: The skin of this fruit is very thin; it can be eaten after being peeled gently.

sentences.chinese: 他的皮肤比较敏感，不能随便换清洁产品。
sentences.traditional: 他的皮膚比較敏感，不能隨便換清潔產品。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de pífū bǐjiào mǐngǎn, bù néng suíbiàn huàn qīngjié chǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: His skin is relatively sensitive, so he cannot casually change cleaning products.

sentences.chinese: 这款皮包虽然款式简单，但做工非常精致。
sentences.traditional: 這款皮包雖然款式簡單，但做工非常精緻。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn píbāo suīrán kuǎnshì jiǎndān, dàn zuògōng fēicháng jīngzhì.
sentences.translation: Although this leather bag has a simple style, its workmanship is very refined.

sentences.chinese: 长时间盯着电脑屏幕容易造成眼睛疲劳。
sentences.traditional: 長時間盯著電腦屏幕容易造成眼睛疲勞。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān dīng zhe diànnǎo píngmù róngyì zàochéng yǎnjing píláo.
sentences.translation: Staring at a computer screen for a long time can easily cause eye fatigue.

sentences.chinese: 司机如果过度疲劳，就不应该继续开车。
sentences.traditional: 司機如果過度疲勞，就不應該繼續開車。
sentences.pinyin: Sījī rúguǒ guòdù píláo, jiù bù yīnggāi jìxù kāichē.
sentences.translation: If a driver is overly tired, they should not continue driving.

sentences.chinese: 适当休息可以缓解身体疲劳，提高工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 適當休息可以緩解身體疲勞，提高工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdàng xiūxi kěyǐ huǎnjiě shēntǐ píláo, tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: Proper rest can relieve physical fatigue and improve work efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 请你在门口等片刻，医生马上就会出来。
sentences.traditional: 請你在門口等片刻，醫生馬上就會出來。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài ménkǒu děng piànkè, yīshēng mǎshàng jiù huì chūlái.
sentences.translation: Please wait at the door for a short moment; the doctor will come out soon.

sentences.chinese: 会场安静了片刻，随后响起热烈的掌声。
sentences.traditional: 會場安靜了片刻，隨後響起熱烈的掌聲。
sentences.pinyin: Huìchǎng ānjìng le piànkè, suíhòu xiǎng qǐ rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
sentences.translation: The venue was quiet for a moment, and then warm applause rang out.

sentences.chinese: 他低头思考了片刻，才谨慎地作出回答。
sentences.traditional: 他低頭思考了片刻，才謹慎地作出回答。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dītóu sīkǎo le piànkè, cái jǐnshèn de zuòchū huídá.
sentences.translation: He lowered his head and thought for a moment before answering cautiously.

sentences.chinese: 只看销售数据就下结论，难免有些片面。
sentences.traditional: 只看銷售數據就下結論，難免有些片面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ kàn xiāoshòu shùjù jiù xià jiélùn, nánmiǎn yǒuxiē piànmiàn.
sentences.translation: Drawing a conclusion from sales data alone is inevitably rather one-sided.

sentences.chinese: 对复杂问题进行片面解读，可能会误导公众。
sentences.traditional: 對複雜問題進行片面解讀，可能會誤導公眾。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fùzá wèntí jìnxíng piànmiàn jiědú, kěnéng huì wùdǎo gōngzhòng.
sentences.translation: A one-sided interpretation of complex issues may mislead the public.

sentences.chinese: 他的评价并不客观，带有明显的片面色彩。
sentences.traditional: 他的評價並不客觀，帶有明顯的片面色彩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de píngjià bìng bù kèguān, dàiyǒu míngxiǎn de piànmiàn sècǎi.
sentences.translation: His evaluation is not objective and has an obvious one-sided element.

sentences.chinese: 那个骗子利用虚假链接骗走了不少人的钱。
sentences.traditional: 那個騙子利用虛假鏈接騙走了不少人的錢。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge piànzi lìyòng xūjiǎ liànjiē piàn zǒu le bù shǎo rén de qián.
sentences.translation: That swindler used fake links to cheat quite a few people out of their money.

sentences.chinese: 警方提醒民众，不要轻易相信自称客服的骗子。
sentences.traditional: 警方提醒民眾，不要輕易相信自稱客服的騙子。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng tíxǐng mínzhòng, bù yào qīngyì xiāngxìn zìchēng kèfú de piànzi.
sentences.translation: The police reminded the public not to easily trust swindlers who claim to be customer service staff.

sentences.chinese: 他一开始没有察觉对方是骗子，差点把资料发过去。
sentences.traditional: 他一開始沒有察覺對方是騙子，差點把資料發過去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì kāishǐ méiyǒu chájué duìfāng shì piànzi, chàdiǎn bǎ zīliào fā guòqù.
sentences.translation: At first he did not realise the other person was a swindler and almost sent the documents over.

sentences.chinese: 秋天一到，树叶就会从街头慢慢飘落。
sentences.traditional: 秋天一到，樹葉就會從街頭慢慢飄落。
sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān yí dào, shùyè jiù huì cóng jiētóu mànmàn piāo luò.
sentences.translation: As soon as autumn arrives, leaves slowly drift down from the street trees.

sentences.chinese: 厨房里飘出辣椒和酱油混合的香味。
sentences.traditional: 廚房裡飄出辣椒和醬油混合的香味。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfáng lǐ piāo chū làjiāo hé jiàngyóu hùnhé de xiāngwèi.
sentences.translation: The mixed aroma of chilli and soy sauce floated out of the kitchen.

sentences.chinese: 湖面上飘着一层薄雾，远处的山影若隐若现。
sentences.traditional: 湖面上飄著一層薄霧，遠處的山影若隱若現。
sentences.pinyin: Húmiàn shàng piāo zhe yì céng bówù, yuǎnchù de shānyǐng ruòyǐn ruòxiàn.
sentences.translation: A thin mist floated over the lake, and the distant mountains appeared faintly.

sentences.chinese: 一片树叶顺着河水慢慢漂向远处。
sentences.traditional: 一片樹葉順著河水慢慢漂向遠處。
sentences.pinyin: Yí piàn shùyè shùn zhe héshuǐ mànmàn piāo xiàng yuǎnchù.
sentences.translation: A leaf slowly drifted along the river towards the distance.

sentences.chinese: 救援人员发现木板还漂在海面上，判断船只可能离岸不远。
sentences.traditional: 救援人員發現木板還漂在海面上，判斷船隻可能離岸不遠。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùyuán rényuán fāxiàn mùbǎn hái piāo zài hǎimiàn shàng, pànduàn chuánzhī kěnéng lí àn bù yuǎn.
sentences.translation: The rescue workers found that the wooden board was still drifting on the sea and judged that the boat might not be far from shore.

sentences.chinese: 雾气从山谷里漂上来，整个村子显得格外安静。
sentences.traditional: 霧氣從山谷裡漂上來，整個村子顯得格外安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Wùqì cóng shāngǔ lǐ piāo shànglai, zhěnggè cūnzi xiǎn de géwài ānjìng.
sentences.translation: Mist drifted up from the valley, making the whole village seem especially quiet.

sentences.chinese: 这个频道专门播放科普节目，适合孩子和家长一起看。
sentences.traditional: 這個頻道專門播放科普節目，適合孩子和家長一起看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège píndào zhuānmén bōfàng kēpǔ jiémù, shìhé háizi hé jiāzhǎng yìqǐ kàn.
sentences.translation: This channel specialises in science programmes and is suitable for children and parents to watch together.

sentences.chinese: 公司开设了内部频道，方便员工了解项目进展。
sentences.traditional: 公司開設了內部頻道，方便員工了解項目進展。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī kāishè le nèibù píndào, fāngbiàn yuángōng liǎojiě xiàngmù jìnzhǎn.
sentences.translation: The company set up an internal channel to make it easier for employees to understand project progress.

sentences.chinese: 他把电视调到新闻频道，想确认暴雨后的路况。
sentences.traditional: 他把電視調到新聞頻道，想確認暴雨後的路況。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ diànshì tiáo dào xīnwén píndào, xiǎng quèrèn bàoyǔ hòu de lùkuàng.
sentences.translation: He switched the television to the news channel to check the road conditions after the heavy rain.

sentences.chinese: 近来系统故障频繁出现，技术部门决定重新检测服务器。
sentences.traditional: 近來系統故障頻繁出現，技術部門決定重新檢測服務器。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnlái xìtǒng gùzhàng pínfán chūxiàn, jìshù bùmén juédìng chóngxīn jiǎncè fúwùqì.
sentences.translation: System faults have appeared frequently recently, so the technical department decided to test the server again.

sentences.chinese: 如果频繁打断别人，交谈的效果会明显下降。
sentences.traditional: 如果頻繁打斷別人，交談的效果會明顯下降。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ pínfán dǎduàn biérén, jiāotán de xiàoguǒ huì míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: If you frequently interrupt others, the effectiveness of the conversation will clearly decline.

sentences.chinese: 这条航线因天气原因频繁延误，旅客对此十分不满。
sentences.traditional: 這條航線因天氣原因頻繁延誤，旅客對此十分不滿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hángxiàn yīn tiānqì yuányīn pínfán yánwù, lǚkè duì cǐ shífēn bùmǎn.
sentences.translation: This route is frequently delayed because of the weather, and passengers are very dissatisfied about it.

sentences.chinese: 这个基金主要帮助贫困地区的学生继续念书。
sentences.traditional: 這個基金主要幫助貧困地區的學生繼續念書。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jījīn zhǔyào bāngzhù pínkùn dìqū de xuésheng jìxù niànshū.
sentences.translation: This fund mainly helps students in poor areas continue their studies.

sentences.chinese: 长期贫困会限制孩子接受优质教育的机会。
sentences.traditional: 長期貧困會限制孩子接受優質教育的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī pínkùn huì xiànzhì háizi jiēshòu yōuzhì jiàoyù de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: Long-term poverty can limit children’s opportunities to receive high-quality education.

sentences.chinese: 政府通过发展农产品加工，努力减少农村贫困。
sentences.traditional: 政府通過發展農產品加工，努力減少農村貧困。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tōngguò fāzhǎn nóngchǎnpǐn jiāgōng, nǔlì jiǎnshǎo nóngcūn pínkùn.
sentences.translation: The government is trying to reduce rural poverty by developing agricultural product processing.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他记录头痛发生的频率，以便进一步诊断。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他記錄頭痛發生的頻率，以便進一步診斷。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā jìlù tóutòng fāshēng de pínlǜ, yǐbiàn jìnyíbù zhěnduàn.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to record how frequently the headaches occur for further diagnosis.

sentences.chinese: 这台机器运转的频率太高，难免会加快零件磨损。
sentences.traditional: 這臺機器運轉的頻率太高，難免會加快零件磨損。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì yùnzhuǎn de pínlǜ tài gāo, nánmiǎn huì jiākuài língjiàn mósǔn.
sentences.translation: This machine operates at too high a frequency, so it will inevitably speed up the wear of its parts.

sentences.chinese: 直播频道会根据观众反馈调整更新频率。
sentences.traditional: 直播頻道會根據觀眾反饋調整更新頻率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhíbō píndào huì gēnjù guānzhòng fǎnkuì tiáozhěng gēngxīn pínlǜ.
sentences.translation: The live-streaming channel will adjust its update frequency based on audience feedback.

sentences.chinese: 游客可以在展会上品尝不同地区的特色农产品。
sentences.traditional: 遊客可以在展會上品嘗不同地區的特色農產品。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè kěyǐ zài zhǎnhuì shàng pǐncháng bùtóng dìqū de tèsè nóngchǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: Visitors can taste special agricultural products from different regions at the exhibition.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜虽然看似普通，但品尝后才发现口感很丰富。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜雖然看似普通，但品嘗後才發現口感很豐富。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài suīrán kànsì pǔtōng, dàn pǐncháng hòu cái fāxiàn kǒugǎn hěn fēngfù.
sentences.translation: Although this dish seems ordinary, only after tasting it do you discover that its texture and flavour are rich.

sentences.chinese: 厨师请大家先品尝酱汁，再决定是否需要加辣椒。
sentences.traditional: 廚師請大家先品嘗醬汁，再決定是否需要加辣椒。
sentences.pinyin: Chúshī qǐng dàjiā xiān pǐncháng jiàngzhī, zài juédìng shìfǒu xūyào jiā làjiāo.
sentences.translation: The chef asked everyone to taste the sauce first before deciding whether chilli needed to be added.

sentences.chinese: 学校强调师生之间应当保持平等而尊重的沟通。
sentences.traditional: 學校強調師生之間應當保持平等而尊重的溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào qiángdiào shīshēng zhījiān yīngdāng bǎochí píngděng ér zūnzhòng de gōutōng.
sentences.translation: The school emphasises that communication between teachers and students should remain equal and respectful.

sentences.chinese: 在这家公司，员工不论职位高低，都享有平等的培训机会。
sentences.traditional: 在這家公司，員工不論職位高低，都享有平等的培訓機會。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā gōngsī, yuángōng bù lùn zhíwèi gāodī, dōu xiǎngyǒu píngděng de péixùn jīhuì.
sentences.translation: In this company, employees enjoy equal training opportunities regardless of their position.

sentences.chinese: 真正的合作建立在平等互利的基础上。
sentences.traditional: 真正的合作建立在平等互利的基礎上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de hézuò jiànlì zài píngděng hùlì de jīchǔ shàng.
sentences.translation: True cooperation is built on a foundation of equality and mutual benefit.

sentences.chinese: 他从事一份平凡的工作，却始终保持认真负责的态度。
sentences.traditional: 他從事一份平凡的工作，卻始終保持認真負責的態度。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóngshì yí fèn píngfán de gōngzuò, què shǐzhōng bǎochí rènzhēn fùzé de tàidu.
sentences.translation: He does an ordinary job, yet he has always maintained a serious and responsible attitude.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影关注平凡人的生活，因此特别容易引起共鸣。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影關注平凡人的生活，因此特別容易引起共鳴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng guānzhù píngfán rén de shēnghuó, yīncǐ tèbié róngyì yǐnqǐ gòngmíng.
sentences.translation: This film focuses on the lives of ordinary people, so it is especially easy to relate to.

sentences.chinese: 平凡的日子里，也可能藏着值得珍惜的幸福。
sentences.traditional: 平凡的日子裡，也可能藏著值得珍惜的幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Píngfán de rìzi lǐ, yě kěnéng cáng zhe zhídé zhēnxī de xìngfú.
sentences.translation: Even ordinary days may hide happiness worth cherishing.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间只有十二平方，家具摆放必须精心设计。
sentences.traditional: 這個房間只有十二平方，傢俱擺放必須精心設計。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān zhǐyǒu shí'èr píngfāng, jiājù bǎifàng bìxū jīngxīn shèjì.
sentences.translation: This room is only twelve square metres, so the arrangement of the furniture must be carefully designed.

sentences.chinese: 老师让学生计算八的平方，并说明解题过程。
sentences.traditional: 老師讓學生計算八的平方，並說明解題過程。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng xuésheng jìsuàn bā de píngfāng, bìng shuōmíng jiětí guòchéng.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked the students to calculate the square of eight and explain the solving process.

sentences.chinese: 这块空地的面积超过三百平方，可以改造成小型公园。
sentences.traditional: 這塊空地的面積超過三百平方，可以改造成小型公園。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài kòngdì de miànjī chāoguò sānbǎi píngfāng, kěyǐ gǎizào chéng xiǎoxíng gōngyuán.
sentences.translation: The area of this open space is over three hundred square metres, so it could be turned into a small park.

sentences.chinese: 这套公寓的面积是八十五平方米，适合三口之家居住。
sentences.traditional: 這套公寓的面積是八十五平方米，適合三口之家居住。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù de miànjī shì bāshíwǔ píngfāngmǐ, shìhé sānkǒu zhī jiā jūzhù.
sentences.translation: This flat is eighty-five square metres, making it suitable for a family of three to live in.

sentences.chinese: 展厅每平方米的租金都很高，参展企业必须控制预算。
sentences.traditional: 展廳每平方米的租金都很高，參展企業必須控制預算。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎntīng měi píngfāngmǐ de zūjīn dōu hěn gāo, cānzhǎn qǐyè bìxū kòngzhì yùsuàn.
sentences.translation: The rent for each square metre of the exhibition hall is high, so participating companies must control their budgets.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划增加五千平方米的绿化面积，改善周边景观。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃增加五千平方米的綠化面積，改善周邊景觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà zēngjiā wǔqiān píngfāngmǐ de lǜhuà miànjī, gǎishàn zhōubiān jǐngguān.
sentences.translation: The government plans to add five thousand square metres of green space to improve the surrounding landscape.

sentences.chinese: 在推出新政策之前，政府需要先评估它对中小企业的影响。
sentences.traditional: 在推出新政策之前，政府需要先評估它對中小企業的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tuīchū xīn zhèngcè zhīqián, zhèngfǔ xūyào xiān pínggū tā duì zhōngxiǎo qǐyè de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Before introducing a new policy, the government needs to first assess its impact on small and medium-sized businesses.

sentences.chinese: 医生会根据检测结果评估病人的康复进度。
sentences.traditional: 醫生會根據檢測結果評估病人的康復進度。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng huì gēnjù jiǎncè jiéguǒ pínggū bìngrén de kāngfù jìndù.
sentences.translation: The doctor will assess the patient’s recovery progress based on the test results.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告试图评估该项目是否具有长期价值。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告試圖評估該項目是否具有長期價值。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào shìtú pínggū gāi xiàngmù shìfǒu jùyǒu chángqī jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: This report attempts to evaluate whether the project has long-term value.

sentences.chinese: 他在会议上评论了这项改革的优点和不足。
sentences.traditional: 他在會議上評論了這項改革的優點和不足。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shàng pínglùn le zhè xiàng gǎigé de yōudiǎn hé bùzú.
sentences.translation: He commented on the strengths and shortcomings of this reform at the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这篇评论虽然尖锐，但提出的问题值得重视。
sentences.traditional: 這篇評論雖然尖銳，但提出的問題值得重視。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān pínglùn suīrán jiānruì, dàn tíchū de wèntí zhídé zhòngshì.
sentences.translation: Although this commentary is sharp, the issues it raises deserve attention.

sentences.chinese: 不要只看网络评论，最好亲自体验后再做判断。
sentences.traditional: 不要只看網絡評論，最好親自體驗後再做判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào zhǐ kàn wǎngluò pínglùn, zuìhǎo qīnzì tǐyàn hòu zài zuò pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Do not only look at online comments; it is best to experience it yourself before making a judgement.

sentences.chinese: 学校每年都会评选表现突出的志愿者。
sentences.traditional: 學校每年都會評選表現突出的志願者。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào měinián dōu huì píngxuǎn biǎoxiàn tūchū de zhìyuànzhě.
sentences.translation: The school selects volunteers with outstanding performance every year.

sentences.chinese: 评选结果公布后，几位候选人都表示接受。
sentences.traditional: 評選結果公佈後，幾位候選人都表示接受。
sentences.pinyin: Píngxuǎn jiéguǒ gōngbù hòu, jǐ wèi hòuxuǎnrén dōu biǎoshì jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: After the selection results were announced, several candidates said they accepted them.

sentences.chinese: 这次评选不只看成绩，也重视团队合作能力。
sentences.traditional: 這次評選不只看成績，也重視團隊合作能力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì píngxuǎn bù zhǐ kàn chéngjì, yě zhòngshì tuánduì hézuò nénglì.
sentences.translation: This selection considers not only grades, but also values teamwork ability.

sentences.chinese: 雨后这段坡很滑，骑车下去一定要减速。
sentences.traditional: 雨後這段坡很滑，騎車下去一定要減速。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu zhè duàn pō hěn huá, qí chē xiàqu yídìng yào jiǎnsù.
sentences.translation: After the rain, this slope is very slippery, so you must slow down when cycling down it.

sentences.chinese: 村子建在山坡上，从窗口可以看到整片农田。
sentences.traditional: 村子建在山坡上，從窗口可以看到整片農田。
sentences.pinyin: Cūnzi jiàn zài shānpō shàng, cóng chuāngkǒu kěyǐ kàn dào zhěng piàn nóngtián.
sentences.translation: The village is built on a hillside, and from the window you can see the whole stretch of farmland.

sentences.chinese: 施工队把门口的坡修平，方便轮椅进出。
sentences.traditional: 施工隊把門口的坡修平，方便輪椅進出。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōngduì bǎ ménkǒu de pō xiū píng, fāngbiàn lúnyǐ jìnchū.
sentences.translation: The construction team levelled the slope at the entrance to make it easier for wheelchairs to enter and exit.

sentences.chinese: 孩子不小心把水泼到了地毯上。
sentences.traditional: 孩子不小心把水潑到了地毯上。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bù xiǎoxīn bǎ shuǐ pō dào le dìtǎn shàng.
sentences.translation: The child accidentally splashed water onto the carpet.

sentences.chinese: 做实验时，老师提醒学生不要把化学液体泼出来。
sentences.traditional: 做實驗時，老師提醒學生不要把化學液體潑出來。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò shíyàn shí, lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng bú yào bǎ huàxué yètǐ pō chūlai.
sentences.translation: During the experiment, the teacher reminded the students not to splash the chemical liquid out.

sentences.chinese: 她急忙把一盆冷水泼在门口的火苗上。
sentences.traditional: 她急忙把一盆冷水潑在門口的火苗上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jímáng bǎ yì pén lěngshuǐ pō zài ménkǒu de huǒmiáo shàng.
sentences.translation: She hurriedly splashed a basin of cold water onto the flames at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 由于资金链断裂，那家小公司最终破产了。
sentences.traditional: 由於資金鏈斷裂，那家小公司最終破產了。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zījīnliàn duànliè, nà jiā xiǎo gōngsī zuìzhōng pòchǎn le.
sentences.translation: Because its funding chain broke, that small company eventually went bankrupt.

sentences.chinese: 如果市场继续低迷，更多企业可能面临破产风险。
sentences.traditional: 如果市場繼續低迷，更多企業可能面臨破產風險。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shìchǎng jìxù dīmí, gèng duō qǐyè kěnéng miànlín pòchǎn fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: If the market continues to be weak, more companies may face the risk of bankruptcy.

sentences.chinese: 他经历过破产，所以更加重视稳健的理财。
sentences.traditional: 他經歷過破產，所以更加重視穩健的理財。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīnglì guò pòchǎn, suǒyǐ gèngjiā zhòngshì wěnjiàn de lǐcái.
sentences.translation: He has experienced bankruptcy, so he places even more importance on cautious money management.

sentences.chinese: 偏远地区对稳定能源的需求十分迫切。
sentences.traditional: 偏遠地區對穩定能源的需求十分迫切。
sentences.pinyin: Piānyuǎn dìqū duì wěndìng néngyuán de xūqiú shífēn pòqiè.
sentences.translation: Remote areas have an extremely urgent need for stable energy supplies.

sentences.chinese: 面对人口老龄化，培养更多护理人员变得越来越迫切。
sentences.traditional: 面對人口老齡化，培養更多護理人員變得越來越迫切。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì rénkǒu lǎolínghuà, péiyǎng gèng duō hùlǐ rényuán biàn de yuè lái yuè pòqiè.
sentences.translation: Facing an ageing population, training more care workers has become increasingly urgent.

sentences.chinese: 他们迫切希望找到解决纠纷的办法。
sentences.traditional: 他們迫切希望找到解決糾紛的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pòqiè xīwàng zhǎodào jiějué jiūfēn de bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: They are urgently hoping to find a way to resolve the dispute.

sentences.chinese: 小狗一看见主人，就兴奋地扑了上去。
sentences.traditional: 小狗一看見主人，就興奮地撲了上去。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu yí kànjiàn zhǔrén, jiù xīngfèn de pū le shàngqu.
sentences.translation: As soon as the puppy saw its owner, it excitedly pounced forward.

sentences.chinese: 警察迅速扑向逃跑的嫌疑人，将他控制住。
sentences.traditional: 警察迅速撲向逃跑的嫌疑人，將他控制住。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá xùnsù pū xiàng táopǎo de xiányírén, jiāng tā kòngzhì zhù.
sentences.translation: The police quickly rushed at the fleeing suspect and brought him under control.

sentences.chinese: 一阵冷风扑面而来，大家都拉紧了外套。
sentences.traditional: 一陣冷風撲面而來，大家都拉緊了外套。
sentences.pinyin: Yí zhèn lěngfēng pūmiàn ér lái, dàjiā dōu lā jǐn le wàitào.
sentences.translation: A burst of cold wind rushed into everyone’s faces, and they all pulled their coats tighter.

sentences.chinese: 工人正在把新的路面铺得更加平整。
sentences.traditional: 工人正在把新的路面鋪得更加平整。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén zhèngzài bǎ xīn de lùmiàn pū de gèngjiā píngzhěng.
sentences.translation: The workers are paving the new road surface so that it is even smoother.

sentences.chinese: 她把地图铺在桌上，仔细研究接下来的旅程。
sentences.traditional: 她把地圖鋪在桌上，仔細研究接下來的旅程。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ dìtú pū zài zhuō shàng, zǐxì yánjiū jiē xiàlái de lǚchéng.
sentences.translation: She spread the map out on the table and carefully studied the journey ahead.

sentences.chinese: 施工前，技术人员先在地上铺了一层防水材料。
sentences.traditional: 施工前，技術人員先在地上鋪了一層防水材料。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōng qián, jìshù rényuán xiān zài dì shàng pū le yì céng fángshuǐ cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Before construction, the technicians first laid a layer of waterproof material on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 消防员花了两个小时才把大火扑灭。
sentences.traditional: 消防員花了兩個小時才把大火撲滅。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán huā le liǎng gè xiǎoshí cái bǎ dàhuǒ pūmiè.
sentences.translation: It took the firefighters two hours to extinguish the fire.

sentences.chinese: 如果不及时扑灭，小火苗也可能引发火灾。
sentences.traditional: 如果不及時撲滅，小火苗也可能引發火災。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí pūmiè, xiǎo huǒmiáo yě kěnéng yǐnfā huǒzāi.
sentences.translation: If it is not extinguished promptly, even a small flame may cause a fire.

sentences.chinese: 政府及时发布信息，试图扑灭网络谣言造成的恐慌。
sentences.traditional: 政府及時發佈信息，試圖撲滅網絡謠言造成的恐慌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jíshí fābù xìnxī, shìtú pūmiè wǎngluò yáoyán zàochéng de kǒnghuāng.
sentences.translation: The government released information promptly, trying to stamp out the panic caused by online rumours.

sentences.chinese: 他的衣着很朴素，但谈吐中透出不凡的气质。
sentences.traditional: 他的衣著很樸素，但談吐中透出不凡的氣質。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yīzhuó hěn pǔsù, dàn tántǔ zhōng tòu chū bùfán de qìzhì.
sentences.translation: His clothing is very plain, but his speech reveals an uncommon quality.

sentences.chinese: 这座纪念馆设计朴素，没有夸张的装饰。
sentences.traditional: 這座紀念館設計樸素，沒有誇張的裝飾。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò jìniànguǎn shèjì pǔsù, méiyǒu kuāzhāng de zhuāngshì.
sentences.translation: This memorial hall has a simple design, without exaggerated decoration.

sentences.chinese: 她保持朴素的生活方式，把更多收入用于公益。
sentences.traditional: 她保持樸素的生活方式，把更多收入用於公益。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎochí pǔsù de shēnghuó fāngshì, bǎ gèng duō shōurù yòng yú gōngyì.
sentences.translation: She maintains a simple way of life and uses more of her income for public welfare.

sentences.chinese: 虚假广告可能欺骗消费者，监管部门必须及时处理。
sentences.traditional: 虛假廣告可能欺騙消費者，監管部門必須及時處理。
sentences.pinyin: Xūjiǎ guǎnggào kěnéng qīpiàn xiāofèizhě, jiānguǎn bùmén bìxū jíshí chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: False advertising may deceive consumers, and regulators must deal with it promptly.

sentences.chinese: 他用复杂的合同条款欺骗了经验不足的客户。
sentences.traditional: 他用複雜的合同條款欺騙了經驗不足的客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng fùzá de hétong tiáokuǎn qīpiàn le jīngyàn bùzú de kèhù.
sentences.translation: He used complicated contract terms to deceive inexperienced clients.

sentences.chinese: 如果研究数据被故意修改，就等于欺骗公众。
sentences.traditional: 如果研究數據被故意修改，就等於欺騙公眾。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yánjiū shùjù bèi gùyì xiūgǎi, jiù děngyú qīpiàn gōngzhòng.
sentences.translation: If the research data is deliberately altered, it is equivalent to deceiving the public.

sentences.chinese: 家长对孩子有期望，但不应把压力全部转给他们。
sentences.traditional: 家長對孩子有期望，但不應把壓力全部轉給他們。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāzhǎng duì háizi yǒu qīwàng, dàn bù yīng bǎ yālì quánbù zhuǎn gěi tāmen.
sentences.translation: Parents have expectations for their children, but should not pass all the pressure on to them.

sentences.chinese: 公司期望新系统能提高流程效率。
sentences.traditional: 公司期望新系統能提高流程效率。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī qīwàng xīn xìtǒng néng tígāo liúchéng xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The company expects the new system to improve process efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 他的表现没有达到观众的期望。
sentences.traditional: 他的表現沒有達到觀眾的期望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de biǎoxiàn méiyǒu dádào guānzhòng de qīwàng.
sentences.translation: His performance did not meet the audience’s expectations.

sentences.chinese: 申请材料必须在规定期限内提交。
sentences.traditional: 申請材料必須在規定期限內提交。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng cáiliào bìxū zài guīdìng qīxiàn nèi tíjiāo.
sentences.translation: The application materials must be submitted within the specified time limit.

sentences.chinese: 合同中写明了付款期限和赔偿责任。
sentences.traditional: 合同中寫明了付款期限和賠償責任。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong zhōng xiěmíng le fùkuǎn qīxiàn hé péicháng zérèn.
sentences.translation: The contract states the payment deadline and compensation responsibilities.

sentences.chinese: 如果超过期限，系统会自动取消报名资格。
sentences.traditional: 如果超過期限，系統會自動取消報名資格。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chāoguò qīxiàn, xìtǒng huì zìdòng qǔxiāo bàomíng zīgé.
sentences.translation: If the deadline is exceeded, the system will automatically cancel the registration eligibility.

sentences.chinese: 会议持续了三个小时，其间没有人离开会场。
sentences.traditional: 會議持續了三個小時，其間沒有人離開會場。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì chíxù le sān gè xiǎoshí, qíjiān méiyǒu rén líkāi huìchǎng.
sentences.translation: The meeting lasted three hours, during which no one left the venue.

sentences.chinese: 项目试运行两周，其间技术人员每天监测数据。
sentences.traditional: 項目試運行兩週，其間技術人員每天監測數據。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù shì yùnxíng liǎng zhōu, qíjiān jìshù rényuán měitiān jiāncè shùjù.
sentences.translation: The project ran on a trial basis for two weeks, during which technicians monitored the data every day.

sentences.chinese: 他在国外生活了十年，其间积累了丰富的经商经验。
sentences.traditional: 他在國外生活了十年，其間積累了豐富的經商經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài guówài shēnghuó le shí nián, qíjiān jīlěi le fēngfù de jīngshāng jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: He lived abroad for ten years, during which he accumulated rich business experience.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院设备齐全，能处理多数急救情况。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院設備齊全，能處理多數急救情況。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn shèbèi qíquán, néng chǔlǐ duōshù jíjiù qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: This hospital is fully equipped and can handle most emergency treatment situations.

sentences.chinese: 资料准备得很齐全，审核过程因此顺利许多。
sentences.traditional: 資料準備得很齊全，審核過程因此順利許多。
sentences.pinyin: Zīliào zhǔnbèi de hěn qíquán, shěnhé guòchéng yīncǐ shùnlì xǔduō.
sentences.translation: The materials were prepared very completely, so the review process went much more smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 这套工具功能齐全，适合在野外维修设备。
sentences.traditional: 這套工具功能齊全，適合在野外維修設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngjù gōngnéng qíquán, shìhé zài yěwài wéixiū shèbèi.
sentences.translation: This set of tools has complete functions and is suitable for repairing equipment in the field.

sentences.chinese: 棋子虽小，却能影响整盘棋的局面。
sentences.traditional: 棋子雖小，卻能影響整盤棋的局面。
sentences.pinyin: Qízǐ suī xiǎo, què néng yǐngxiǎng zhěng pán qí de júmiàn.
sentences.translation: Although a chess piece is small, it can affect the situation of the whole game.

sentences.chinese: 他把棋子一个个摆回盒子里，准备结束练习。
sentences.traditional: 他把棋子一個個擺回盒子裡，準備結束練習。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ qízǐ yí gè gè bǎi huí hézi lǐ, zhǔnbèi jiéshù liànxí.
sentences.translation: He put the chess pieces back into the box one by one, preparing to end the practice.

sentences.chinese: 在这个比喻里，普通员工不该只是被动的棋子。
sentences.traditional: 在這個比喻裡，普通員工不該只是被動的棋子。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège bǐyù lǐ, pǔtōng yuángōng bù gāi zhǐ shì bèidòng de qízǐ.
sentences.translation: In this metaphor, ordinary employees should not merely be passive chess pieces.

sentences.chinese: 起初大家都反对这个方案，后来才逐渐理解它的价值。
sentences.traditional: 起初大家都反對這個方案，後來才逐漸理解它的價值。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐchū dàjiā dōu fǎnduì zhège fāng'àn, hòulái cái zhújiàn lǐjiě tā de jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: At first everyone opposed this plan, and only later did they gradually understand its value.

sentences.chinese: 他起初只是兼职帮忙，没想到最后成为项目负责人。
sentences.traditional: 他起初只是兼職幫忙，沒想到最後成為項目負責人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐchū zhǐ shì jiānzhí bāngmáng, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu chéngwéi xiàngmù fùzérén.
sentences.translation: At first he was only helping part-time; unexpectedly, he eventually became the project leader.

sentences.chinese: 这门课起初显得枯燥，但内容越学越有意思。
sentences.traditional: 這門課起初顯得枯燥，但內容越學越有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kè qǐchū xiǎnde kūzào, dàn nèiróng yuè xué yuè yǒu yìsi.
sentences.translation: This course seemed boring at first, but the more one studies it, the more interesting the content becomes.

sentences.chinese: 公平的教育机会是社会流动的重要起点。
sentences.traditional: 公平的教育機會是社會流動的重要起點。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngpíng de jiàoyù jīhuì shì shèhuì liúdòng de zhòngyào qǐdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Fair educational opportunities are an important starting point for social mobility.

sentences.chinese: 这次失败不是终点，而是重新调整的起点。
sentences.traditional: 這次失敗不是終點，而是重新調整的起點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài bú shì zhōngdiǎn, ér shì chóngxīn tiáozhěng de qǐdiǎn.
sentences.translation: This failure is not the end point, but the starting point for readjustment.

sentences.chinese: 旅程的起点设在旧码头附近，方便游客集合。
sentences.traditional: 旅程的起點設在舊碼頭附近，方便遊客集合。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚchéng de qǐdiǎn shè zài jiù mǎtóu fùjìn, fāngbiàn yóukè jíhé.
sentences.translation: The starting point of the journey is set near the old dock, making it convenient for tourists to gather.

sentences.chinese: 市政府明天将启动新的节能计划。
sentences.traditional: 市政府明天將啟動新的節能計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhèngfǔ míngtiān jiāng qǐdòng xīn de jiénéng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: The municipal government will launch a new energy-saving plan tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 系统启动后，用户需要先完成身份验证。
sentences.traditional: 系統啟動後，用戶需要先完成身份驗證。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng qǐdòng hòu, yònghù xūyào xiān wánchéng shēnfèn yànzhèng.
sentences.translation: After the system starts, users need to complete identity verification first.

sentences.chinese: 为了应对暴雨，救援队提前启动了应急机制。
sentences.traditional: 為了應對暴雨，救援隊提前啟動了應急機制。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile yìngduì bàoyǔ, jiùyuánduì tíqián qǐdòng le yìngjí jīzhì.
sentences.translation: To respond to the heavy rain, the rescue team activated the emergency mechanism in advance.

sentences.chinese: 导师的报告启发了几个年轻工程师重新思考设计方案。
sentences.traditional: 導師的報告啟發了幾個年輕工程師重新思考設計方案。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoshī de bàogào qǐfā le jǐ gè niánqīng gōngchéngshī chóngxīn sīkǎo shèjì fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: The tutor's report inspired several young engineers to rethink the design plan.

sentences.chinese: 失败的经历启发他们调整策略，而不是继续重复旧办法。
sentences.traditional: 失敗的經歷啟發他們調整策略，而不是繼續重複舊辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Shībài de jīnglì qǐfā tāmen tiáozhěng cèlüè, ér bú shì jìxù chóngfù jiù bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: The experience of failure inspired them to adjust their strategy rather than continue repeating old methods.

sentences.chinese: 课堂讨论常常能启发学生提出更深入的见解。
sentences.traditional: 課堂討論常常能啟發學生提出更深入的見解。
sentences.pinyin: Kètáng tǎolùn chángcháng néng qǐfā xuésheng tíchū gèng shēnrù de jiànjiě.
sentences.translation: Classroom discussions can often inspire students to put forward deeper insights.

sentences.chinese: 那起事故给管理层一个重要启示：安全不能只靠口号。
sentences.traditional: 那起事故給管理層一個重要啟示：安全不能只靠口號。
sentences.pinyin: Nà qǐ shìgù gěi guǎnlǐcéng yí gè zhòngyào qǐshì: ānquán bù néng zhǐ kào kǒuhào.
sentences.translation: That accident gave management an important lesson: safety cannot rely only on slogans.

sentences.chinese: 这本书关于城市更新的启示，值得许多地方借鉴。
sentences.traditional: 這本書關於城市更新的啟示，值得許多地方借鑑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū guānyú chéngshì gēngxīn de qǐshì, zhídé xǔduō dìfāng jièjiàn.
sentences.translation: The lessons this book offers on urban renewal are worth learning from in many places.

sentences.chinese: 历史告诉我们，每一次危机都可能带来新的启示。
sentences.traditional: 歷史告訴我們，每一次危機都可能帶來新的啟示。
sentences.pinyin: Lìshǐ gàosu wǒmen, měi yí cì wēijī dōu kěnéng dàilái xīn de qǐshì.
sentences.translation: History tells us that every crisis may bring new lessons.

sentences.chinese: 门口张贴了一则启事，通知居民本周停水。
sentences.traditional: 門口張貼了一則啟事，通知居民本週停水。
sentences.pinyin: Ménkǒu zhāngtiē le yì zé qǐshì, tōngzhī jūmín běn zhōu tíng shuǐ.
sentences.translation: A notice was posted at the entrance informing residents that the water would be cut off this week.

sentences.chinese: 他在报纸上登了一则寻物启事，希望找回丢失的证件。
sentences.traditional: 他在報紙上登了一則尋物啟事，希望找回丟失的證件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bàozhǐ shàng dēng le yì zé xúnwù qǐshì, xīwàng zhǎo huí diūshī de zhèngjiàn.
sentences.translation: He placed a lost-property notice in the newspaper, hoping to recover the missing documents.

sentences.chinese: 学校发布招聘启事，计划录用两名实验室助理。
sentences.traditional: 學校發布招聘啟事，計劃錄用兩名實驗室助理。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào fābù zhāopìn qǐshì, jìhuà lùyòng liǎng míng shíyànshì zhùlǐ.
sentences.translation: The school published a recruitment notice and plans to hire two laboratory assistants.

sentences.chinese: 这个节日的起源可以追溯到几百年前的民间习俗。
sentences.traditional: 這個節日的起源可以追溯到幾百年前的民間習俗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiérì de qǐyuán kěyǐ zhuīsù dào jǐ bǎi nián qián de mínjiān xísú.
sentences.translation: The origin of this festival can be traced back to folk customs from several hundred years ago.

sentences.chinese: 学者们仍在讨论这种文字起源于哪个地区。
sentences.traditional: 學者們仍在討論這種文字起源於哪個地區。
sentences.pinyin: Xuézhěmen réng zài tǎolùn zhè zhǒng wénzì qǐyuán yú nǎ ge dìqū.
sentences.translation: Scholars are still discussing which region this writing system originated in.

sentences.chinese: 研究起源问题时，不能只依赖传说，还要看证据。
sentences.traditional: 研究起源問題時，不能只依賴傳說，還要看證據。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū qǐyuán wèntí shí, bù néng zhǐ yīlài chuánshuō, hái yào kàn zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: When studying questions of origin, one cannot rely only on legends; evidence is also needed.

sentences.chinese: 比赛开始前，体育馆里的气氛已经十分紧张。
sentences.traditional: 比賽開始前，體育館裡的氣氛已經十分緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài kāishǐ qián, tǐyùguǎn lǐ de qìfēn yǐjīng shífēn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: Before the match began, the atmosphere in the stadium was already extremely tense.

sentences.chinese: 他的玩笑让原本严肃的会议气氛轻松了许多。
sentences.traditional: 他的玩笑讓原本嚴肅的會議氣氛輕鬆了許多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de wánxiào ràng yuánběn yánsù de huìyì qìfēn qīngsōng le xǔduō.
sentences.translation: His joke made the originally serious meeting atmosphere much more relaxed.

sentences.chinese: 团队气氛如果不好，再优秀的人也难以发挥作用。
sentences.traditional: 團隊氣氛如果不好，再優秀的人也難以發揮作用。
sentences.pinyin: Tuánduì qìfēn rúguǒ bù hǎo, zài yōuxiù de rén yě nán yǐ fāhuī zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: If the team atmosphere is poor, even excellent people will struggle to play their part.

sentences.chinese: 这种气体没有颜色，但大量吸入会危害健康。
sentences.traditional: 這種氣體沒有顏色，但大量吸入會危害健康。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qìtǐ méiyǒu yánsè, dàn dàliàng xīrù huì wēihài jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: This gas has no colour, but inhaling a large amount can harm health.

sentences.chinese: 实验室必须检测空气中是否含有有毒气体。
sentences.traditional: 實驗室必須檢測空氣中是否含有有毒氣體。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyànshì bìxū jiǎncè kōngqì zhōng shìfǒu hányǒu yǒudú qìtǐ.
sentences.translation: The laboratory must test whether the air contains toxic gas.

sentences.chinese: 工厂安装了设备，专门处理排放出的气体。
sentences.traditional: 工廠安裝了設備，專門處理排放出的氣體。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng ānzhuāng le shèbèi, zhuānmén chǔlǐ páifàng chū de qìtǐ.
sentences.translation: The factory installed equipment specifically to treat the gases it discharges.

sentences.chinese: 厨房里飘来咖啡的气味，让人立刻精神起来。
sentences.traditional: 廚房裡飄來咖啡的氣味，讓人立刻精神起來。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfáng lǐ piāo lái kāfēi de qìwèi, ràng rén lìkè jīngshen qǐlai.
sentences.translation: The smell of coffee drifted from the kitchen, immediately making people feel more alert.

sentences.chinese: 如果冰箱出现奇怪的气味，最好及时清理。
sentences.traditional: 如果冰箱出現奇怪的氣味，最好及時清理。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bīngxiāng chūxiàn qíguài de qìwèi, zuìhǎo jíshí qīnglǐ.
sentences.translation: If a strange smell appears in the fridge, it is best to clean it promptly.

sentences.chinese: 这种花的气味很淡，靠近时才能闻到。
sentences.traditional: 這種花的氣味很淡，靠近時才能聞到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huā de qìwèi hěn dàn, kàojìn shí cái néng wén dào.
sentences.translation: The scent of this flower is very faint; you can only smell it when you get close.

sentences.chinese: 她的气质安静而坚定，给人很深的印象。
sentences.traditional: 她的氣質安靜而堅定，給人很深的印象。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de qìzhì ānjìng ér jiāndìng, gěi rén hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
sentences.translation: Her temperament is quiet yet firm, leaving a deep impression on people.

sentences.chinese: 真正的气质不只来自外表，也来自长期的修养。
sentences.traditional: 真正的氣質不只來自外表，也來自長期的修養。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de qìzhì bù zhǐ láizì wàibiǎo, yě láizì chángqī de xiūyǎng.
sentences.translation: True temperament comes not only from appearance, but also from long-term cultivation.

sentences.chinese: 这位演员有一种独特的气质，很适合这个角色。
sentences.traditional: 這位演員有一種獨特的氣質，很適合這個角色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán yǒu yì zhǒng dútè de qìzhì, hěn shìhé zhège juésè.
sentences.translation: This actor has a unique temperament that suits this role very well.

sentences.chinese: 在正式场合，选择恰当的表达方式非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 在正式場合，選擇恰當的表達方式非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé, xuǎnzé qiàdàng de biǎodá fāngshì fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In formal settings, choosing an appropriate way of expressing oneself is very important.

sentences.chinese: 老师用一个恰当的例子解释了复杂的概念。
sentences.traditional: 老師用一個恰當的例子解釋了複雜的概念。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng yí gè qiàdàng de lìzi jiěshì le fùzá de gàiniàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher used an appropriate example to explain the complex concept.

sentences.chinese: 如果处理不恰当，小问题也可能变成大纠纷。
sentences.traditional: 如果處理不恰當，小問題也可能變成大糾紛。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ chǔlǐ bù qiàdàng, xiǎo wèntí yě kěnéng biàn chéng dà jiūfēn.
sentences.translation: If it is not handled appropriately, a small problem may also become a major dispute.

sentences.chinese: 我到车站时，下一班车恰好进站。
sentences.traditional: 我到車站時，下一班車恰好進站。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dào chēzhàn shí, xià yì bān chē qiàhǎo jìn zhàn.
sentences.translation: When I arrived at the station, the next bus was just pulling in.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套的尺寸恰好适合他，不用再修改。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套的尺寸恰好適合他，不用再修改。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào de chǐcun qiàhǎo shìhé tā, bú yòng zài xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: The size of this coat fits him just right, so it does not need altering.

sentences.chinese: 我们讨论的主题恰好与今天的新闻有关。
sentences.traditional: 我們討論的主題恰好與今天的新聞有關。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen tǎolùn de zhǔtí qiàhǎo yǔ jīntiān de xīnwén yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: The topic we discussed happens to be related to today's news.

sentences.chinese: 问题恰恰出在沟通不够，而不是技术本身太复杂。
sentences.traditional: 問題恰恰出在溝通不夠，而不是技術本身太複雜。
sentences.pinyin: Wèntí qiàqià chū zài gōutōng bú gòu, ér bú shì jìshù běnshēn tài fùzá.
sentences.translation: The problem lies exactly in insufficient communication, not in the technology itself being too complicated.

sentences.chinese: 他想避免风险，结果恰恰错过了最好的机遇。
sentences.traditional: 他想避免風險，結果恰恰錯過了最好的機遇。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng bìmiǎn fēngxiǎn, jiéguǒ qiàqià cuòguò le zuì hǎo de jīyù.
sentences.translation: He wanted to avoid risk, but as a result he happened to miss the best opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 这份朴素的报告恰恰反映了基层工作的真实情况。
sentences.traditional: 這份樸素的報告恰恰反映了基層工作的真實情況。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn pǔsù de bàogào qiàqià fǎnyìng le jīcéng gōngzuò de zhēnshí qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: This plain report is precisely what reflects the real situation of grassroots work.

sentences.chinese: 护士轻轻牵着老人，让他慢慢走进检查室。
sentences.traditional: 護士輕輕牽著老人，讓他慢慢走進檢查室。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi qīngqīng qiān zhe lǎorén, ràng tā mànmàn zǒu jìn jiǎncháshì.
sentences.translation: The nurse gently held the elderly man and led him slowly into the examination room.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策牵动着千家万户的切身利益。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策牽動著千家萬戶的切身利益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè qiāndòng zhe qiānjiā-wànhù de qièshēn lìyì.
sentences.translation: This policy affects the immediate interests of countless households.

sentences.chinese: 案件牵出了一系列管理漏洞，调查范围因此扩大。
sentences.traditional: 案件牽出了一系列管理漏洞，調查範圍因此擴大。
sentences.pinyin: Ànjiàn qiānchū le yì xìliè guǎnlǐ lòudòng, diàochá fànwéi yīncǐ kuòdà.
sentences.translation: The case brought out a series of management loopholes, so the scope of the investigation expanded.

sentences.chinese: 稳定的能源供应关系到千家万户的日常生活。
sentences.traditional: 穩定的能源供應關係到千家萬戶的日常生活。
sentences.pinyin: Wěndìng de néngyuán gōngyìng guānxì dào qiānjiā-wànhù de rìcháng shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: A stable energy supply concerns the daily lives of countless households.

sentences.chinese: 这首民歌曾经传遍千家万户，几代人都会唱。
sentences.traditional: 這首民歌曾經傳遍千家萬戶，幾代人都會唱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu míngē céngjīng chuánbiàn qiānjiā-wànhù, jǐ dài rén dōu huì chàng.
sentences.translation: This folk song once spread through countless households, and several generations could sing it.

sentences.chinese: 互联网让政策信息更快进入千家万户。
sentences.traditional: 互聯網讓政策信息更快進入千家萬戶。
sentences.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng ràng zhèngcè xìnxī gèng kuài jìnrù qiānjiā-wànhù.
sentences.translation: The internet allows policy information to reach countless households more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 即便取得了突出成绩，他在同事面前仍然很谦虚。
sentences.traditional: 即便取得了突出成績，他在同事面前仍然很謙虛。
sentences.pinyin: Jíbiàn qǔdé le tūchū chéngjì, tā zài tóngshì miànqián réngrán hěn qiānxū.
sentences.translation: Even though he achieved outstanding results, he remained modest in front of his colleagues.

sentences.chinese: 真正精通一门技术的人，往往更懂得谦虚。
sentences.traditional: 真正精通一門技術的人，往往更懂得謙虛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng jīngtōng yì mén jìshù de rén, wǎngwǎng gèng dǒngde qiānxū.
sentences.translation: People who truly master a technology often understand modesty better.

sentences.chinese: 老师提醒学生，讨论时要自信，也要保持谦虚。
sentences.traditional: 老師提醒學生，討論時要自信，也要保持謙虛。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuésheng, tǎolùn shí yào zìxìn, yě yào bǎochí qiānxū.
sentences.translation: The teacher reminded the students to be confident during discussions while also remaining modest.

sentences.chinese: 随着成本下降，新能源汽车的市场前景更加广阔。
sentences.traditional: 隨著成本下降，新能源汽車的市場前景更加廣闊。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe chéngběn xiàjiàng, xīn néngyuán qìchē de shìchǎng qiánjǐng gèngjiā guǎngkuò.
sentences.translation: As costs fall, the market prospects for new energy vehicles are becoming broader.

sentences.chinese: 如果缺乏核心技术，这个项目的前景并不乐观。
sentences.traditional: 如果缺乏核心技術，這個專案的前景並不樂觀。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ quēfá héxīn jìshù, zhège xiàngmù de qiánjǐng bìng bù lèguān.
sentences.translation: If it lacks core technology, the prospects for this project are not optimistic.

sentences.chinese: 报告评估了旅游业复苏后的就业前景。
sentences.traditional: 報告評估了旅遊業復甦後的就業前景。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào pínggū le lǚyóuyè fùsū hòu de jiùyè qiánjǐng.
sentences.translation: The report assessed employment prospects after the recovery of the tourism industry.

sentences.chinese: 这个年轻演员虽然经验不多，但发展潜力很大。
sentences.traditional: 這個年輕演員雖然經驗不多，但發展潛力很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège niánqīng yǎnyuán suīrán jīngyàn bù duō, dàn fāzhǎn qiánlì hěn dà.
sentences.translation: Although this young actor does not have much experience, he has great development potential.

sentences.chinese: 农村市场的消费潜力正在逐步释放。
sentences.traditional: 農村市場的消費潛力正在逐步釋放。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngcūn shìchǎng de xiāofèi qiánlì zhèngzài zhúbù shìfàng.
sentences.translation: The consumption potential of the rural market is gradually being released.

sentences.chinese: 只有持续投入研发，企业才能把潜力变成竞争力。
sentences.traditional: 只有持續投入研發，企業才能把潛力變成競爭力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu chíxù tóurù yánfā, qǐyè cái néng bǎ qiánlì biàn chéng jìngzhēnglì.
sentences.translation: Only by continuously investing in research and development can a company turn potential into competitiveness.

sentences.chinese: 前期准备越充分，后期执行时遇到的阻力就越小。
sentences.traditional: 前期準備越充分，後期執行時遇到的阻力就越小。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánqī zhǔnbèi yuè chōngfèn, hòuqī zhíxíng shí yùdào de zǔlì jiù yuè xiǎo.
sentences.translation: The more thorough the early-stage preparation is, the less resistance will be encountered during later implementation.

sentences.chinese: 项目组在前期调研中发现了几个关键问题。
sentences.traditional: 專案組在前期調研中發現了幾個關鍵問題。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmùzǔ zài qiánqī diàoyán zhōng fāxiàn le jǐ gè guānjiàn wèntí.
sentences.translation: The project team discovered several key problems during the early-stage research.

sentences.chinese: 这笔基金主要用于产品开发的前期投入。
sentences.traditional: 這筆基金主要用於產品開發的前期投入。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ jījīn zhǔyào yòngyú chǎnpǐn kāifā de qiánqī tóurù.
sentences.translation: This fund is mainly used for early-stage investment in product development.

sentences.chinese: 充分尊重事实，是展开理性讨论的前提。
sentences.traditional: 充分尊重事實，是展開理性討論的前提。
sentences.pinyin: Chōngfèn zūnzhòng shìshí, shì zhǎnkāi lǐxìng tǎolùn de qiántí.
sentences.translation: Fully respecting the facts is the premise for carrying out rational discussion.

sentences.chinese: 在安全得到保障的前提下，活动可以按计划举行。
sentences.traditional: 在安全得到保障的前提下，活動可以按計劃舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Zài ānquán dédào bǎozhàng de qiántí xià, huódòng kěyǐ àn jìhuà jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: On the premise that safety is guaranteed, the event can be held as planned.

sentences.chinese: 如果这个前提不成立，后面的推论也就失去了意义。
sentences.traditional: 如果這個前提不成立，後面的推論也就失去了意義。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège qiántí bù chénglì, hòumian de tuīlùn yě jiù shīqù le yìyì.
sentences.translation: If this premise does not hold, the following reasoning loses its meaning.

sentences.chinese: 网络课程和面授课程各有优势，前者更加灵活。
sentences.traditional: 網絡課程和麵授課程各有優勢，前者更加靈活。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò kèchéng hé miànshòu kèchéng gè yǒu yōushì, qiánzhě gèngjiā línghuó.
sentences.translation: Online courses and face-to-face courses each have advantages; the former is more flexible.

sentences.chinese: 传统能源与新能源相比，前者对环境的压力更大。
sentences.traditional: 傳統能源與新能源相比，前者對環境的壓力更大。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng néngyuán yǔ xīn néngyuán xiāngbǐ, qiánzhě duì huánjìng de yālì gèng dà.
sentences.translation: Compared with new energy, traditional energy puts greater pressure on the environment.

sentences.chinese: 如果只能在速度和准确性之间选择，前者未必更重要。
sentences.traditional: 如果只能在速度和準確性之間選擇，前者未必更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ néng zài sùdù hé zhǔnquèxìng zhījiān xuǎnzé, qiánzhě wèibì gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: If one can only choose between speed and accuracy, the former is not necessarily more important.

sentences.chinese: 警方在行动中缴获了一把枪，并控制了现场。
sentences.traditional: 警方在行動中繳獲了一把槍，並控制了現場。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zài xíngdòng zhōng jiǎohuò le yì bǎ qiāng, bìng kòngzhì le xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: During the operation, the police seized a gun and brought the scene under control.

sentences.chinese: 电影里的枪声突然响起，吓了观众一跳。
sentences.traditional: 電影裡的槍聲突然響起，嚇了觀眾一跳。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de qiāngshēng tūrán xiǎngqǐ, xià le guānzhòng yí tiào.
sentences.translation: The sound of a gun in the film suddenly rang out and startled the audience.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展出的那支旧枪，见证了一段动荡的历史。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展出的那支舊槍，見證了一段動盪的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū de nà zhī jiù qiāng, jiànzhèng le yí duàn dòngdàng de lìshǐ.
sentences.translation: The old gun displayed in the museum bears witness to a turbulent period of history.

sentences.chinese: 潮湿的天气使老房子的墙壁开始发霉。
sentences.traditional: 潮濕的天氣使老房子的牆壁開始發霉。
sentences.pinyin: Cháoshī de tiānqì shǐ lǎo fángzi de qiángbì kāishǐ fāméi.
sentences.translation: The damp weather caused the walls of the old house to start going mouldy.

sentences.chinese: 美术馆把灯光打在白色墙壁上，让画面更加清晰。
sentences.traditional: 美術館把燈光打在白色牆壁上，讓畫面更加清晰。
sentences.pinyin: Měishùguǎn bǎ dēngguāng dǎ zài báisè qiángbì shàng, ràng huàmiàn gèngjiā qīngxī.
sentences.translation: The art gallery shone the lights onto the white wall, making the picture clearer.

sentences.chinese: 他靠着墙壁思考了很久，才决定如何回应。
sentences.traditional: 他靠著牆壁思考了很久，才決定如何回應。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kào zhe qiángbì sīkǎo le hěn jiǔ, cái juédìng rúhé huíyìng.
sentences.translation: He leaned against the wall and thought for a long time before deciding how to respond.

sentences.chinese: 学校计划强化学生的实践能力，而不只是提高考试成绩。
sentences.traditional: 學校計劃強化學生的實踐能力，而不只是提高考試成績。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jìhuà qiánghuà xuésheng de shíjiàn nénglì, ér bù zhǐshì tígāo kǎoshì chéngjì.
sentences.translation: The school plans to strengthen students' practical abilities, rather than merely improve exam results.

sentences.chinese: 新法规强化了对个人信息的保护。
sentences.traditional: 新法規強化了對個人信息的保護。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn fǎguī qiánghuà le duì gèrén xìnxī de bǎohù.
sentences.translation: The new regulation strengthened the protection of personal information.

sentences.chinese: 长期训练可以强化肌肉，也能改善姿势。
sentences.traditional: 長期訓練可以強化肌肉，也能改善姿勢。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī xùnliàn kěyǐ qiánghuà jīròu, yě néng gǎishàn zīshì.
sentences.translation: Long-term training can strengthen muscles and also improve posture.

sentences.chinese: 经过康复训练后，他的身体比以前强壮多了。
sentences.traditional: 經過康復訓練後，他的身體比以前強壯多了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò kāngfù xùnliàn hòu, tā de shēntǐ bǐ yǐqián qiángzhuàng duō le.
sentences.translation: After rehabilitation training, his body became much stronger than before.

sentences.chinese: 这匹马看起来十分强壮，适合长途运输。
sentences.traditional: 這匹馬看起來十分強壯，適合長途運輸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pǐ mǎ kànqǐlai shífēn qiángzhuàng, shìhé chángtú yùnshū.
sentences.translation: This horse looks very strong and is suitable for long-distance transport.

sentences.chinese: 均衡饮食和规律运动能让孩子逐渐强壮起来。
sentences.traditional: 均衡飲食和規律運動能讓孩子逐漸強壯起來。
sentences.pinyin: Jūnhéng yǐnshí hé guīlǜ yùndòng néng ràng háizi zhújiàn qiángzhuàng qǐlai.
sentences.translation: A balanced diet and regular exercise can gradually make a child stronger.

sentences.chinese: 父母不该强迫孩子选择自己不喜欢的专业。
sentences.traditional: 父母不該強迫孩子選擇自己不喜歡的專業。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù gāi qiǎngpò háizi xuǎnzé zìjǐ bù xǐhuan de zhuānyè.
sentences.translation: Parents should not force children to choose a major they do not like.

sentences.chinese: 公司被指控强迫员工无偿加班。
sentences.traditional: 公司被指控強迫員工無償加班。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī bèi zhǐkòng qiǎngpò yuángōng wúcháng jiābān.
sentences.translation: The company was accused of forcing employees to work overtime without pay.

sentences.chinese: 真正的合作不能靠命令和强迫来维持。
sentences.traditional: 真正的合作不能靠命令和強迫來維持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de hézuò bù néng kào mìnglìng hé qiǎngpò lái wéichí.
sentences.translation: Real cooperation cannot be maintained through orders and force.

sentences.chinese: 你瞧，这些数据恰恰说明市场正在恢复。
sentences.traditional: 你瞧，這些數據恰恰說明市場正在恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ qiáo, zhèxiē shùjù qiàqià shuōmíng shìchǎng zhèngzài huīfù.
sentences.translation: Look, these figures show exactly that the market is recovering.

sentences.chinese: 他瞧了一眼合同，就发现了一个明显的漏洞。
sentences.traditional: 他瞧了一眼合同，就發現了一個明顯的漏洞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiáo le yì yǎn hétong, jiù fāxiàn le yí ge míngxiǎn de lòudòng.
sentences.translation: He glanced at the contract and immediately found an obvious loophole.

sentences.chinese: 别只瞧结果，也要分析过程中的关键变化。
sentences.traditional: 別只瞧結果，也要分析過程中的關鍵變化。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhǐ qiáo jiéguǒ, yě yào fēnxī guòchéng zhōng de guānjiàn biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Do not just look at the result; analyse the key changes in the process as well.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥梁连接了两岸，也带动了周边贸易。
sentences.traditional: 這座橋梁連接了兩岸，也帶動了周邊貿易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáoliáng liánjiē le liǎng'àn, yě dàidòng le zhōubiān màoyì.
sentences.translation: This bridge connects the two sides and has also boosted surrounding trade.

sentences.chinese: 翻译在不同文化之间起到了桥梁作用。
sentences.traditional: 翻譯在不同文化之間起到了橋梁作用。
sentences.pinyin: Fānyì zài bùtóng wénhuà zhījiān qǐdào le qiáoliáng zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Translation plays the role of a bridge between different cultures.

sentences.chinese: 工程师正在监测桥梁的安全状况。
sentences.traditional: 工程師正在監測橋梁的安全狀況。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zhèngzài jiāncè qiáoliáng de ānquán zhuàngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Engineers are monitoring the safety condition of the bridge.

sentences.chinese: 这个设计巧妙地利用了狭小空间。
sentences.traditional: 這個設計巧妙地利用了狹小空間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèjì qiǎomiào de lìyòng le xiáxiǎo kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: This design cleverly made use of the narrow space.

sentences.chinese: 她用一种巧妙的方法化解了双方的纠纷。
sentences.traditional: 她用一種巧妙的方法化解了雙方的糾紛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng yì zhǒng qiǎomiào de fāngfǎ huàjiě le shuāngfāng de jiūfēn.
sentences.translation: She used a clever method to resolve the dispute between the two sides.

sentences.chinese: 影片结尾安排得很巧妙，观众直到最后才明白真相。
sentences.traditional: 影片結尾安排得很巧妙，觀眾直到最後才明白真相。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngpiàn jiéwěi ānpái de hěn qiǎomiào, guānzhòng zhídào zuìhòu cái míngbai zhēnxiàng.
sentences.translation: The ending of the film was arranged very cleverly, and the audience did not understand the truth until the very end.

sentences.chinese: 政府需要采取切实措施，减轻小企业的压力。
sentences.traditional: 政府需要採取切實措施，減輕小企業的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xūyào cǎiqǔ qièshí cuòshī, jiǎnqīng xiǎo qǐyè de yālì.
sentences.translation: The government needs to take practical measures to reduce pressure on small businesses.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革是否有效，最终要看它能否切实改善民生。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革是否有效，最終要看它能否切實改善民生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé shìfǒu yǒuxiào, zuìzhōng yào kàn tā néngfǒu qièshí gǎishàn mínshēng.
sentences.translation: Whether this reform is effective ultimately depends on whether it can genuinely improve people's livelihoods.

sentences.chinese: 只有了解基层情况，才能提出切实可行的方案。
sentences.traditional: 只有了解基層情況，才能提出切實可行的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu liǎojiě jīcéng qíngkuàng, cái néng tíchū qièshí kěxíng de fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: Only by understanding conditions at the grassroots level can one put forward a practical and feasible plan.

sentences.chinese: 多年的合作让两家公司建立了亲密关系。
sentences.traditional: 多年的合作讓兩家公司建立了親密關係。
sentences.pinyin: Duōnián de hézuò ràng liǎng jiā gōngsī jiànlì le qīnmì guānxì.
sentences.translation: Years of cooperation allowed the two companies to build a close relationship.

sentences.chinese: 他们虽然住在不同城市，却一直保持着亲密联系。
sentences.traditional: 他們雖然住在不同城市，卻一直保持著親密聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen suīrán zhù zài bùtóng chéngshì, què yìzhí bǎochí zhe qīnmì liánxì.
sentences.translation: Although they live in different cities, they have always kept in close contact.

sentences.chinese: 过度干涉并不能增加亲密感，反而可能造成距离。
sentences.traditional: 過度干涉並不能增加親密感，反而可能造成距離。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù gānshè bìng bù néng zēngjiā qīnmì gǎn, fǎn'ér kěnéng zàochéng jùlí.
sentences.translation: Excessive interference does not increase intimacy; instead, it may create distance.

sentences.chinese: 医院要求患者的一名亲属在手术前签字。
sentences.traditional: 醫院要求患者的一名親屬在手術前簽字。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn yāoqiú huànzhě de yì míng qīnshǔ zài shǒushù qián qiānzì.
sentences.translation: The hospital requires one of the patient's relatives to sign before the operation.

sentences.chinese: 海外亲属寄来的照片让她想起了童年。
sentences.traditional: 海外親屬寄來的照片讓她想起了童年。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎiwài qīnshǔ jì lái de zhàopiàn ràng tā xiǎngqǐ le tóngnián.
sentences.translation: The photos sent by relatives overseas reminded her of her childhood.

sentences.chinese: 在重大灾害后，寻找失联亲属成了许多人的首要任务。
sentences.traditional: 在重大災害後，尋找失聯親屬成了許多人的首要任務。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhòngdà zāihài hòu, xúnzhǎo shīlián qīnshǔ chéng le xǔduō rén de shǒuyào rènwù.
sentences.translation: After a major disaster, finding missing relatives became the top priority for many people.

sentences.chinese: 勤劳的农民用多年的经验改善了这片土地。
sentences.traditional: 勤勞的農民用多年的經驗改善了這片土地。
sentences.pinyin: Qínláo de nóngmín yòng duōnián de jīngyàn gǎishàn le zhè piàn tǔdì.
sentences.translation: The hard-working farmer used years of experience to improve this piece of land.

sentences.chinese: 她虽然出身普通，却凭着勤劳和坚持建立了自己的事业。
sentences.traditional: 她雖然出身普通，卻憑著勤勞和堅持建立了自己的事業。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán chūshēn pǔtōng, què píng zhe qínláo hé jiānchí jiànlì le zìjǐ de shìyè.
sentences.translation: Although she came from an ordinary background, she built her own career through hard work and persistence.

sentences.chinese: 这个村子靠勤劳致富，生活条件一年比一年好。
sentences.traditional: 這個村子靠勤勞致富，生活條件一年比一年好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cūnzi kào qínláo zhìfù, shēnghuó tiáojiàn yì nián bǐ yì nián hǎo.
sentences.translation: This village became prosperous through hard work, and living conditions improve year by year.

sentences.chinese: 河水很清，能看见水底的石头。
sentences.traditional: 河水很清，能看見水底的石頭。
sentences.pinyin: Héshuǐ hěn qīng, néng kànjiàn shuǐdǐ de shítou.
sentences.translation: The river water is very clear, so you can see the stones at the bottom.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，大家一起把桌上的资料清掉。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，大家一起把桌上的資料清掉。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, dàjiā yìqǐ bǎ zhuō shàng de zīliào qīng diào.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, everyone cleared away the materials on the table together.

sentences.chinese: 这笔账必须先清，项目才能顺利结束。
sentences.traditional: 這筆帳必須先清，項目才能順利結束。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ zhàng bìxū xiān qīng, xiàngmù cái néng shùnlì jiéshù.
sentences.translation: This account must be settled first before the project can end smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 清晨的空气很凉，街上还没有多少行人。
sentences.traditional: 清晨的空氣很涼，街上還沒有多少行人。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén de kōngqì hěn liáng, jiē shàng hái méiyǒu duōshao xíngrén.
sentences.translation: The air in the early morning is cool, and there are still not many pedestrians on the street.

sentences.chinese: 他习惯在清晨跑步，然后再去公司。
sentences.traditional: 他習慣在清晨跑步，然後再去公司。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài qīngchén pǎobù, ránhòu zài qù gōngsī.
sentences.translation: He is used to running early in the morning and then going to the company.

sentences.chinese: 清晨的第一班车总是坐满上班的人。
sentences.traditional: 清晨的第一班車總是坐滿上班的人。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén de dì yī bān chē zǒngshì zuò mǎn shàngbān de rén.
sentences.translation: The first bus in the early morning is always full of people going to work.

sentences.chinese: 青春不只是年龄，也是一种愿意尝试的心态。
sentences.traditional: 青春不只是年齡，也是一種願意嘗試的心態。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchūn bù zhǐshì niánlíng, yě shì yì zhǒng yuànyì chángshì de xīntài.
sentences.translation: Youth is not only an age, but also a mindset of being willing to try things.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影记录了一代人的青春记忆。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影記錄了一代人的青春記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jìlù le yí dài rén de qīngchūn jìyì.
sentences.translation: This film records the youth memories of an entire generation.

sentences.chinese: 她把最宝贵的青春都投入到科研工作中。
sentences.traditional: 她把最寶貴的青春都投入到科研工作中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zuì bǎoguì de qīngchūn dōu tóurù dào kēyán gōngzuò zhōng.
sentences.translation: She devoted the most precious years of her youth to scientific research.

sentences.chinese: 青春期的孩子需要理解，也需要明确的界限。
sentences.traditional: 青春期的孩子需要理解，也需要明確的界限。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchūnqī de háizi xūyào lǐjiě, yě xūyào míngquè de jièxiàn.
sentences.translation: Adolescents need understanding, but they also need clear boundaries.

sentences.chinese: 进入青春期以后，很多学生会更加在意同伴的看法。
sentences.traditional: 進入青春期以後，很多學生會更加在意同伴的看法。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù qīngchūnqī yǐhòu, hěn duō xuésheng huì gèngjiā zàiyì tóngbàn de kànfǎ.
sentences.translation: After entering adolescence, many students care more about what their peers think.

sentences.chinese: 学校开设课程，帮助学生了解青春期的身心变化。
sentences.traditional: 學校開設課程，幫助學生了解青春期的身心變化。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào kāishè kèchéng, bāngzhù xuésheng liǎojiě qīngchūnqī de shēnxīn biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The school offers courses to help students understand the physical and mental changes of adolescence.

sentences.chinese: 这道汤味道清淡，适合刚康复的病人。
sentences.traditional: 這道湯味道清淡，適合剛康復的病人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào tāng wèidào qīngdàn, shìhé gāng kāngfù de bìngrén.
sentences.translation: This soup has a light flavour and is suitable for patients who have just recovered.

sentences.chinese: 最近我想吃得清淡一些，少放油和盐。
sentences.traditional: 最近我想吃得清淡一些，少放油和鹽。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ xiǎng chī de qīngdàn yìxiē, shǎo fàng yóu hé yán.
sentences.translation: Recently I want to eat a bit more lightly, with less oil and salt.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅主打清淡口味，老人和孩子都能接受。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳主打清淡口味，老人和孩子都能接受。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zhǔdǎ qīngdàn kǒuwèi, lǎorén hé háizi dōu néng jiēshòu.
sentences.translation: This restaurant specialises in light flavours, which both elderly people and children can accept.

sentences.chinese: 医院必须保持环境清洁，防止细菌传播。
sentences.traditional: 醫院必須保持環境清潔，防止細菌傳播。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn bìxū bǎochí huánjìng qīngjié, fángzhǐ xìjūn chuánbō.
sentences.translation: Hospitals must keep the environment clean to prevent bacteria from spreading.

sentences.chinese: 清洁的水源对村民的健康至关重要。
sentences.traditional: 清潔的水源對村民的健康至關重要。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngjié de shuǐyuán duì cūnmín de jiànkāng zhìguān zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: A clean water source is extremely important for the villagers' health.

sentences.chinese: 这台设备的表面要保持清洁，否则会影响检测结果。
sentences.traditional: 這臺設備的表面要保持清潔，否則會影響檢測結果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái shèbèi de biǎomiàn yào bǎochí qīngjié, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng jiǎncè jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: The surface of this device must be kept clean, otherwise it will affect the test results.

sentences.chinese: 暴风雨过后，工人们连夜清理道路上的树枝。
sentences.traditional: 暴風雨過後，工人們連夜清理道路上的樹枝。
sentences.pinyin: Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, gōngrénmen liányè qīnglǐ dàolù shàng de shùzhī.
sentences.translation: After the storm, the workers cleared the branches on the road overnight.

sentences.chinese: 请先清理电脑里的无用文件，再安装新的软件。
sentences.traditional: 請先清理電腦裡的無用文件，再安裝新的軟件。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān qīnglǐ diànnǎo lǐ de wúyòng wénjiàn, zài ānzhuāng xīn de ruǎnjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please first clear the useless files from the computer, then install the new software.

sentences.chinese: 政府开始清理河道垃圾，以改善水质。
sentences.traditional: 政府開始清理河道垃圾，以改善水質。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ kāishǐ qīnglǐ hédào lājī, yǐ gǎishàn shuǐzhì.
sentences.translation: The government began clearing rubbish from the river channel to improve water quality.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者每周六都会清扫社区周围的街道。
sentences.traditional: 志願者每週六都會清掃社區周圍的街道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě měi zhōu liù dōu huì qīngsǎo shèqū zhōuwéi de jiēdào.
sentences.translation: Volunteers sweep the streets around the community every Saturday.

sentences.chinese: 节日前，公司安排人员清扫办公区域。
sentences.traditional: 節日前，公司安排人員清掃辦公區域。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì qián, gōngsī ānpái rényuán qīngsǎo bàngōng qūyù.
sentences.translation: Before the festival, the company arranged for staff to sweep the office area.

sentences.chinese: 清晨，清洁工已经开始清扫广场上的落叶。
sentences.traditional: 清晨，清潔工已經開始清掃廣場上的落葉。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén, qīngjié gōng yǐjīng kāishǐ qīngsǎo guǎngchǎng shàng de luòyè.
sentences.translation: Early in the morning, the cleaners had already begun sweeping the fallen leaves in the square.

sentences.chinese: 管理者愿意倾听员工意见，团队才会更有活力。
sentences.traditional: 管理者願意傾聽員工意見，團隊才會更有活力。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐzhě yuànyì qīngtīng yuángōng yìjiàn, tuánduì cái huì gèng yǒu huólì.
sentences.translation: Only when managers are willing to listen carefully to employees' opinions will the team have more vitality.

sentences.chinese: 倾听并不等于同意，但能让对方感到被尊重。
sentences.traditional: 傾聽並不等於同意，但能讓對方感到被尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngtīng bìng bù děngyú tóngyì, dàn néng ràng duìfāng gǎndào bèi zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: Listening attentively does not mean agreeing, but it can make the other person feel respected.

sentences.chinese: 心理咨询师需要耐心倾听来访者的真实感受。
sentences.traditional: 心理諮詢師需要耐心傾聽來訪者的真實感受。
