sentences.pinyin: Xīnlǐ zīxúnshī xūyào nàixīn qīngtīng láifǎngzhě de zhēnshí gǎnshòu.
sentences.translation: A psychological counsellor needs to listen patiently to the visitor's true feelings.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院每天清洗手术器械，确保所有设备符合卫生标准。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院每天清洗手術器械，確保所有設備符合衛生標準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn měitiān qīngxǐ shǒushù qìxiè, quèbǎo suǒyǒu shèbèi fúhé wèishēng biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: This hospital washes surgical instruments every day to ensure all equipment meets hygiene standards.

sentences.chinese: 雨后要及时清洗车身，否则泥点会留下难看的痕迹。
sentences.traditional: 雨後要及時清洗車身，否則泥點會留下難看的痕跡。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔhòu yào jíshí qīngxǐ chēshēn, fǒuzé nídiǎn huì liú xià nánkàn de hénjì.
sentences.translation: After rain, you should wash the car body promptly, otherwise muddy spots will leave ugly marks.

sentences.chinese: 这些水果最好用流动的水清洗后再吃。
sentences.traditional: 這些水果最好用流動的水清洗後再吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ zuìhǎo yòng liúdòng de shuǐ qīngxǐ hòu zài chī.
sentences.translation: It is best to wash these fruits under running water before eating them.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告结构清晰，关键数据也列得很完整。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告結構清晰，關鍵數據也列得很完整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào jiégòu qīngxī, guānjiàn shùjù yě liè de hěn wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: This report has a clear structure, and the key data is also listed very completely.

sentences.chinese: 他说话条理清晰，几分钟就把问题解释清楚了。
sentences.traditional: 他說話條理清晰，幾分鐘就把問題解釋清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà tiáolǐ qīngxī, jǐ fēnzhōng jiù bǎ wèntí jiěshì qīngchu le.
sentences.translation: He speaks clearly and logically, and explained the problem in just a few minutes.

sentences.chinese: 监控录像不够清晰，很难判断事故责任。
sentences.traditional: 監控錄像不夠清晰，很難判斷事故責任。
sentences.pinyin: Jiānkòng lùxiàng bú gòu qīngxī, hěn nán pànduàn shìgù zérèn.
sentences.translation: The surveillance recording is not clear enough, so it is hard to judge responsibility for the accident.

sentences.chinese: 调查显示，年轻消费者更倾向于选择环保包装。
sentences.traditional: 調查顯示，年輕消費者更傾向於選擇環保包裝。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá xiǎnshì, niánqīng xiāofèizhě gèng qīngxiàng yú xuǎnzé huánbǎo bāozhuāng.
sentences.translation: The survey shows that young consumers tend more towards choosing environmentally friendly packaging.

sentences.chinese: 他的发言表现出一种保守的政策倾向。
sentences.traditional: 他的發言表現出一種保守的政策傾向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fāyán biǎoxiàn chū yì zhǒng bǎoshǒu de zhèngcè qīngxiàng.
sentences.translation: His remarks showed a conservative policy tendency.

sentences.chinese: 在证据不足的情况下，专家不倾向于过早下结论。
sentences.traditional: 在證據不足的情況下，專家不傾向於過早下結論。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèngjù bùzú de qíngkuàng xià, zhuānjiā bù qīngxiàng yú guòzǎo xià jiélùn.
sentences.translation: When the evidence is insufficient, experts do not tend to draw conclusions too early.

sentences.chinese: 休息半小时后，他的头脑终于清醒了一些。
sentences.traditional: 休息半小時後，他的頭腦終於清醒了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Xiūxi bàn xiǎoshí hòu, tā de tóunǎo zhōngyú qīngxǐng le yìxiē.
sentences.translation: After resting for half an hour, his mind finally became a little clearer.

sentences.chinese: 面对突发危机，领导者必须保持清醒的判断。
sentences.traditional: 面對突發危機，領導者必須保持清醒的判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā wēijī, lǐngdǎozhě bìxū bǎochí qīngxǐng de pànduàn.
sentences.translation: When facing a sudden crisis, leaders must maintain clear judgement.

sentences.chinese: 医生确认病人已经清醒，可以进行简单交流。
sentences.traditional: 醫生確認病人已經清醒，可以進行簡單交流。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng quèrèn bìngrén yǐjīng qīngxǐng, kěyǐ jìnxíng jiǎndān jiāoliú.
sentences.translation: The doctor confirmed that the patient was awake and could communicate simply.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说的情节紧凑，读者很难停下来。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說的情節緊湊，讀者很難停下來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō de qíngjié jǐncòu, dúzhě hěn nán tíng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: The plot of this novel is tight, making it hard for readers to stop.

sentences.chinese: 编剧修改了最后一集的情节，使结尾更合理。
sentences.traditional: 編劇修改了最後一集的情節，使結尾更合理。
sentences.pinyin: Biānjù xiūgǎi le zuìhòu yì jí de qíngjié, shǐ jiéwěi gèng hélǐ.
sentences.translation: The scriptwriter changed the plot of the final episode, making the ending more reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有这些细节，整个故事的情节就显得很单薄。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有這些細節，整個故事的情節就顯得很單薄。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu zhèxiē xìjié, zhěnggè gùshi de qíngjié jiù xiǎnde hěn dānbó.
sentences.translation: Without these details, the plot of the whole story would seem rather weak.

sentences.chinese: 天气晴朗时，从山顶可以看到远处的海岸线。
sentences.traditional: 天氣晴朗時，從山頂可以看到遠處的海岸線。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì qínglǎng shí, cóng shāndǐng kěyǐ kàn dào yuǎnchù de hǎi'ànxiàn.
sentences.translation: When the weather is clear, you can see the distant coastline from the mountaintop.

sentences.chinese: 连续几天阴雨后，今天终于变得晴朗起来。
sentences.traditional: 連續幾天陰雨後，今天終於變得晴朗起來。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jǐ tiān yīnyǔ hòu, jīntiān zhōngyú biàn de qínglǎng qǐlai.
sentences.translation: After several rainy days in a row, today has finally become sunny and clear.

sentences.chinese: 一个晴朗的早晨，志愿者们开始清理河岸。
sentences.traditional: 一個晴朗的早晨，志願者們開始清理河岸。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge qínglǎng de zǎochén, zhìyuànzhěmen kāishǐ qīnglǐ hé'àn.
sentences.translation: On a clear morning, the volunteers began clearing the riverbank.

sentences.chinese: 当前的情形比预想复杂，需要重新评估风险。
sentences.traditional: 當前的情形比預想複雜，需要重新評估風險。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngqián de qíngxing bǐ yùxiǎng fùzá, xūyào chóngxīn pínggū fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The current situation is more complex than expected and requires a reassessment of the risks.

sentences.chinese: 在这种情形下，保持公开沟通尤其重要。
sentences.traditional: 在這種情形下，保持公開溝通尤其重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngxing xià, bǎochí gōngkāi gōutōng yóuqí zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In this kind of situation, maintaining open communication is especially important.

sentences.chinese: 如果类似情形再次发生，公司必须立即启动应急机制。
sentences.traditional: 如果類似情形再次發生，公司必須立即啟動應急機制。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ lèisì qíngxing zàicì fāshēng, gōngsī bìxū lìjí qǐdòng yìngjí jīzhì.
sentences.translation: If a similar situation occurs again, the company must immediately activate its emergency mechanism.

sentences.chinese: 他不愿意求人帮忙，总想先靠自己解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 他不願意求人幫忙，總想先靠自己解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù yuànyì qiú rén bāngmáng, zǒng xiǎng xiān kào zìjǐ jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: He is unwilling to ask others for help and always wants to solve problems by himself first.

sentences.chinese: 科学研究不能只求速度，还要保证结果可靠。
sentences.traditional: 科學研究不能只求速度，還要保證結果可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū bù néng zhǐ qiú sùdù, hái yào bǎozhèng jiéguǒ kěkào.
sentences.translation: Scientific research cannot only seek speed; it must also ensure reliable results.

sentences.chinese: 为了求得更多支持，团队提前公布了详细计划。
sentences.traditional: 為了求得更多支持，團隊提前公佈了詳細計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile qiú dé gèng duō zhīchí, tuánduì tíqián gōngbù le xiángxì jìhuà.
sentences.translation: In order to seek more support, the team published a detailed plan in advance.

sentences.chinese: 他在两人的纪念日向女友求婚，现场没有安排得太夸张。
sentences.traditional: 他在兩人的紀念日向女友求婚，現場沒有安排得太誇張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài liǎng rén de jìniànrì xiàng nǚyǒu qiúhūn, xiànchǎng méiyǒu ānpái de tài kuāzhāng.
sentences.translation: He proposed to his girlfriend on their anniversary, and the scene was not arranged too extravagantly.

sentences.chinese: 求婚之前，他认真考虑了双方家庭的实际情况。
sentences.traditional: 求婚之前，他認真考慮了雙方家庭的實際情況。
sentences.pinyin: Qiúhūn zhīqián, tā rènzhēn kǎolǜ le shuāngfāng jiātíng de shíjì qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Before proposing marriage, he carefully considered the practical circumstances of both families.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得求婚不一定要豪华，真诚才最重要。
sentences.traditional: 她覺得求婚不一定要豪華，真誠才最重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde qiúhūn bù yídìng yào háohuá, zhēnchéng cái zuì zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: She feels that a marriage proposal does not have to be luxurious; sincerity is what matters most.

sentences.chinese: 登山队在暴风雪中迷路，只好通过卫星电话求救。
sentences.traditional: 登山隊在暴風雪中迷路，只好通過衛星電話求救。
sentences.pinyin: Dēngshān duì zài bàofēngxuě zhōng mílù, zhǐhǎo tōngguò wèixīng diànhuà qiújiù.
sentences.translation: The mountaineering team got lost in the snowstorm and had to call for help by satellite phone.

sentences.chinese: 孩子听到有人呼喊求救，立刻跑去找大人。
sentences.traditional: 孩子聽到有人呼喊求救，立刻跑去找大人。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tīng dào yǒu rén hūhǎn qiújiù, lìkè pǎo qù zhǎo dàrén.
sentences.translation: The child heard someone shouting for help and immediately ran to find an adult.

sentences.chinese: 发生火灾时，居民应先撤离危险区域，再拨打电话求救。
sentences.traditional: 發生火災時，居民應先撤離危險區域，再撥打電話求救。
sentences.pinyin: Fāshēng huǒzāi shí, jūmín yīng xiān chèlí wēixiǎn qūyù, zài bōdǎ diànhuà qiújiù.
sentences.translation: When a fire occurs, residents should first leave the dangerous area, then call for help.

sentences.chinese: 他毕业后没有急着求职，而是先整理作品集和实习经历。
sentences.traditional: 他畢業後沒有急著求職，而是先整理作品集和實習經歷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìyè hòu méiyǒu jízhe qiúzhí, ér shì xiān zhěnglǐ zuòpǐnjí hé shíxí jīnglì.
sentences.translation: After graduating, he did not rush to apply for jobs, but first organised his portfolio and internship experience.

sentences.chinese: 在网上求职时，她会根据岗位要求修改简历。
sentences.traditional: 在網上求職時，她會根據崗位要求修改簡歷。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǎngshàng qiúzhí shí, tā huì gēnjù gǎngwèi yāoqiú xiūgǎi jiǎnlì.
sentences.translation: When applying for jobs online, she revises her CV according to the requirements of each position.

sentences.chinese: 这次求职失败让他意识到，面试前的准备还不够充分。
sentences.traditional: 這次求職失敗讓他意識到，面試前的準備還不夠充分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì qiúzhí shībài ràng tā yìshí dào, miànshì qián de zhǔnbèi hái bú gòu chōngfèn.
sentences.translation: This failed job application made him realise that his preparation before the interview was still not sufficient.

sentences.chinese: 遇到法律问题时，许多人会先向社区服务中心求助。
sentences.traditional: 遇到法律問題時，許多人會先向社區服務中心求助。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào fǎlǜ wèntí shí, xǔduō rén huì xiān xiàng shèqū fúwù zhōngxīn qiúzhù.
sentences.translation: When they encounter legal problems, many people first ask the community service centre for help.

sentences.chinese: 系统突然崩溃后，工程师立刻向技术团队求助。
sentences.traditional: 系統突然崩潰後，工程師立刻向技術團隊求助。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng tūrán bēngkuì hòu, gōngchéngshī lìkè xiàng jìshù tuánduì qiúzhù.
sentences.translation: After the system suddenly crashed, the engineer immediately asked the technical team for help.

sentences.chinese: 真正成熟的人不是从不求助，而是知道什么时候需要别人支持。
sentences.traditional: 真正成熟的人不是從不求助，而是知道什麼時候需要別人支持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng chéngshú de rén bú shì cóng bù qiúzhù, ér shì zhīdào shénme shíhou xūyào biérén zhīchí.
sentences.translation: A truly mature person is not someone who never asks for help, but someone who knows when support is needed.

sentences.chinese: 研究者必须区分事实、推测和个人观点。
sentences.traditional: 研究者必須區分事實、推測和個人觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiūzhě bìxū qūfēn shìshí, tuīcè hé gèrén guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: Researchers must differentiate between facts, speculation, and personal opinions.

sentences.chinese: 孩子刚开始学习外语时，很难区分相近的发音。
sentences.traditional: 孩子剛開始學習外語時，很難區分相近的發音。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi gāng kāishǐ xuéxí wàiyǔ shí, hěn nán qūfēn xiāngjìn de fāyīn.
sentences.translation: When children first start learning a foreign language, it is hard for them to distinguish similar sounds.

sentences.chinese: 管理者要学会区分紧急任务和重要任务。
sentences.traditional: 管理者要學會區分緊急任務和重要任務。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐzhě yào xuéhuì qūfēn jǐnjí rènwu hé zhòngyào rènwu.
sentences.translation: Managers need to learn to distinguish urgent tasks from important tasks.

sentences.chinese: 公司希望通过更多线上渠道接触年轻消费者。
sentences.traditional: 公司希望通過更多線上渠道接觸年輕消費者。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xīwàng tōngguò gèng duō xiànshàng qúdào jiēchù niánqīng xiāofèizhě.
sentences.translation: The company hopes to reach young consumers through more online channels.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目缺少稳定的资金渠道，所以进展一直很慢。
sentences.traditional: 這個項目缺少穩定的資金渠道，所以進展一直很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù quēshǎo wěndìng de zījīn qúdào, suǒyǐ jìnzhǎn yìzhí hěn màn.
sentences.translation: This project lacks stable funding channels, so progress has been slow.

sentences.chinese: 投诉渠道越透明，公众对处理结果越有信心。
sentences.traditional: 投訴渠道越透明，公眾對處理結果越有信心。
sentences.pinyin: Tóusù qúdào yuè tòumíng, gōngzhòng duì chǔlǐ jiéguǒ yuè yǒu xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: The more transparent the complaint channel is, the more confidence the public has in the outcome.

sentences.chinese: 乐队在结尾演奏了一曲节奏明快的民歌。
sentences.traditional: 樂隊在結尾演奏了一曲節奏明快的民歌。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèduì zài jiéwěi yǎnzòu le yì qǔ jiézòu míngkuài de míngē.
sentences.translation: At the end, the band performed a folk song with a bright rhythm.

sentences.chinese: 这首曲改编自一段古老的民间旋律。
sentences.traditional: 這首曲改編自一段古老的民間旋律。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu qǔ gǎibiān zì yí duàn gǔlǎo de mínjiān xuánlǜ.
sentences.translation: This tune was adapted from an old folk melody.

sentences.chinese: 他一听到那首曲子，就想起了童年。
sentences.traditional: 他一聽到那首曲子，就想起了童年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì tīng dào nà shǒu qǔzi, jiù xiǎngqǐ le tóngnián.
sentences.translation: As soon as he heard that tune, he thought of his childhood.

sentences.chinese: 他决定先完成学业，再考虑娶谁共度一生。
sentences.traditional: 他決定先完成學業，再考慮娶誰共度一生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng xiān wánchéng xuéyè, zài kǎolǜ qǔ shuí gòngdù yìshēng.
sentences.translation: He decided to finish his studies first before considering whom to marry and spend his life with.

sentences.chinese: 在传统观念中，男人娶妻往往被看作家庭大事。
sentences.traditional: 在傳統觀念中，男人娶妻往往被看作家庭大事。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chuántǒng guānniàn zhōng, nánrén qǔ qī wǎngwǎng bèi kànzuò jiātíng dàshì.
sentences.translation: In traditional thinking, a man taking a wife is often seen as a major family matter.

sentences.chinese: 他不是因为压力才娶她，而是真心想和她建立家庭。
sentences.traditional: 他不是因為壓力才娶她，而是真心想和她建立家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì yīnwèi yālì cái qǔ tā, ér shì zhēnxīn xiǎng hé tā jiànlì jiātíng.
sentences.translation: He did not marry her because of pressure, but because he truly wanted to build a family with her.

sentences.chinese: 新技术不会完全取代教师，但会改变教学方式。
sentences.traditional: 新技術不會完全取代教師，但會改變教學方式。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jìshù bú huì wánquán qǔdài jiàoshī, dàn huì gǎibiàn jiàoxué fāngshì.
sentences.translation: New technology will not completely replace teachers, but it will change teaching methods.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业希望用清洁能源取代传统燃料。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業希望用清潔能源取代傳統燃料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè xīwàng yòng qīngjié néngyuán qǔdài chuántǒng ránliào.
sentences.translation: This company hopes to replace traditional fuels with clean energy.

sentences.chinese: 机器可以提高效率，却很难取代人类的判断力。
sentences.traditional: 機器可以提高效率，卻很難取代人類的判斷力。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì kěyǐ tígāo xiàolǜ, què hěn nán qǔdài rénlèi de pànduànlì.
sentences.translation: Machines can improve efficiency, but it is hard for them to replace human judgement.

sentences.chinese: 这本书把科学知识讲得很有趣味，适合青少年阅读。
sentences.traditional: 這本書把科學知識講得很有趣味，適合青少年閱讀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bǎ kēxué zhīshi jiǎng de hěn yǒu qùwèi, shìhé qīngshàonián yuèdú.
sentences.translation: This book presents scientific knowledge in an interesting way and is suitable for teenagers to read.

sentences.chinese: 课堂活动如果缺少趣味，学生很快就会失去注意力。
sentences.traditional: 課堂活動如果缺少趣味，學生很快就會失去注意力。
sentences.pinyin: Kètáng huódòng rúguǒ quēshǎo qùwèi, xuéshēng hěn kuài jiù huì shīqù zhùyìlì.
sentences.translation: If classroom activities lack interest, students will quickly lose attention.

sentences.chinese: 他收藏旧地图，不只是为了研究，也是一种个人趣味。
sentences.traditional: 他收藏舊地圖，不只是為了研究，也是一種個人趣味。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōucáng jiù dìtú, bù zhǐ shì wèile yánjiū, yě shì yì zhǒng gèrén qùwèi.
sentences.translation: He collects old maps not only for research, but also as a personal interest.

sentences.chinese: 请在表格里把错误的金额圈出来。
sentences.traditional: 請在表格裡把錯誤的金額圈出來。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé lǐ bǎ cuòwù de jīn'é quān chūlai.
sentences.translation: Please circle the incorrect amount in the form.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们围成一个圈，认真听老师讲故事。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們圍成一個圈，認真聽老師講故事。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen wéi chéng yí ge quān, rènzhēn tīng lǎoshī jiǎng gùshi.
sentences.translation: The children formed a circle and listened carefully as the teacher told a story.

sentences.chinese: 这个行业的圈很小，口碑很快就会传开。
sentences.traditional: 這個行業的圈很小，口碑很快就會傳開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hángyè de quān hěn xiǎo, kǒubēi hěn kuài jiù huì chuánkāi.
sentences.translation: This professional circle is small, so word of mouth spreads quickly.

sentences.chinese: 会议全程都有录音，方便之后整理纪要。
sentences.traditional: 會議全程都有錄音，方便之後整理紀要。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì quánchéng dōu yǒu lùyīn, fāngbiàn zhīhòu zhěnglǐ jìyào.
sentences.translation: The whole meeting was recorded, making it easier to organise the minutes afterwards.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，康复训练全程都要保持适度。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，康復訓練全程都要保持適度。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, kāngfù xùnliàn quánchéng dōu yào bǎochí shìdù.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him that the whole rehabilitation training process should be kept moderate.

sentences.chinese: 这趟旅程全程约三百公里，路况还算稳定。
sentences.traditional: 這趟旅程全程約三百公里，路況還算穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tàng lǚchéng quánchéng yuē sānbǎi gōnglǐ, lùkuàng hái suàn wěndìng.
sentences.translation: This journey is about three hundred kilometres in total, and the road conditions are fairly stable.

sentences.chinese: 过于集中的权力容易导致决策缺乏监督。
sentences.traditional: 過於集中的權力容易導致決策缺乏監督。
sentences.pinyin: Guòyú jízhōng de quánlì róngyì dǎozhì juécè quēfá jiāndū.
sentences.translation: Overly concentrated power can easily lead to decision-making that lacks oversight.

sentences.chinese: 他认为权力必须受到法律和制度的限制。
sentences.traditional: 他認為權力必須受到法律和制度的限制。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi quánlì bìxū shòudào fǎlǜ hé zhìdù de xiànzhì.
sentences.translation: He believes that power must be limited by law and institutions.

sentences.chinese: 在这个项目中，经理拥有较大的权力，也承担相应责任。
sentences.traditional: 在這個項目中，經理擁有較大的權力，也承擔相應責任。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù zhōng, jīnglǐ yōngyǒu jiào dà de quánlì, yě chéngdān xiāngyìng zérèn.
sentences.translation: In this project, the manager has considerable authority and also bears the corresponding responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 这张优惠券月底前有效，过期就不能使用了。
sentences.traditional: 這張優惠券月底前有效，過期就不能使用了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yōuhuìquàn yuèdǐ qián yǒuxiào, guòqī jiù bù néng shǐyòng le.
sentences.translation: This discount coupon is valid until the end of the month; after it expires, it cannot be used.

sentences.chinese: 入场券售罄后，主办方临时增加了一场演出。
sentences.traditional: 入場券售罄後，主辦方臨時增加了一場演出。
sentences.pinyin: Rùchǎngquàn shòuqìng hòu, zhǔbànfāng línshí zēngjiā le yì chǎng yǎnchū.
sentences.translation: After the entry tickets sold out, the organiser temporarily added another performance.

sentences.chinese: 公司发给员工餐券，方便他们在附近食堂吃午饭。
sentences.traditional: 公司發給員工餐券，方便他們在附近食堂吃午飯。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī fā gěi yuángōng cānquàn, fāngbiàn tāmen zài fùjìn shítáng chī wǔfàn.
sentences.translation: The company gives employees meal vouchers so they can have lunch conveniently at a nearby canteen.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件的安全缺陷已经在最新版本中修复。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件的安全缺陷已經在最新版本中修復。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn de ānquán quēxiàn yǐjīng zài zuìxīn bǎnběn zhōng xiūfù.
sentences.translation: This software’s security defect has already been fixed in the latest version.

sentences.chinese: 产品在设计上存在明显缺陷，导致用户体验很差。
sentences.traditional: 產品在設計上存在明顯缺陷，導致用戶體驗很差。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn zài shèjì shàng cúnzài míngxiǎn quēxiàn, dǎozhì yònghù tǐyàn hěn chà.
sentences.translation: The product has obvious design defects, resulting in a poor user experience.

sentences.chinese: 承认制度的缺陷，是改进工作的第一步。
sentences.traditional: 承認制度的缺陷，是改進工作的第一步。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngrèn zhìdù de quēxiàn, shì gǎijìn gōngzuò de dì yī bù.
sentences.translation: Acknowledging the defects in the system is the first step towards improving the work.

sentences.chinese: 这项法律确立了公民个人信息保护的基本原则。
sentences.traditional: 這項法律確立了公民個人信息保護的基本原則。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fǎlǜ quèlì le gōngmín gèrén xìnxī bǎohù de jīběn yuánzé.
sentences.translation: This law established the basic principles for protecting citizens’ personal information.

sentences.chinese: 企业应先确立长期目标，再制定具体计划。
sentences.traditional: 企業應先確立長期目標，再制定具體計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yīng xiān quèlì chángqī mùbiāo, zài zhìdìng jùtǐ jìhuà.
sentences.translation: A company should first establish long-term goals, then make specific plans.

sentences.chinese: 经过多年努力，他终于在学术界确立了自己的地位。
sentences.traditional: 經過多年努力，他終於在學術界確立了自己的地位。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò duōnián nǔlì, tā zhōngyú zài xuéshùjiè quèlì le zìjǐ de dìwèi.
sentences.translation: After years of effort, he finally established his position in the academic world.

sentences.chinese: 政策调整前，政府部门应充分听取群众意见。
sentences.traditional: 政策調整前，政府部門應充分聽取群眾意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè tiáozhěng qián, zhèngfǔ bùmén yīng chōngfèn tīngqǔ qúnzhòng yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Before adjusting policy, government departments should fully listen to the public’s views.

sentences.chinese: 消防员迅速疏散群众，避免了更严重的伤亡。
sentences.traditional: 消防員迅速疏散群眾，避免了更嚴重的傷亡。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán xùnsù shūsàn qúnzhòng, bìmiǎn le gèng yánzhòng de shāngwáng.
sentences.translation: Firefighters quickly evacuated the crowd, avoiding more serious casualties.

sentences.chinese: 这场公益活动吸引了大量群众参与。
sentences.traditional: 這場公益活動吸引了大量群眾參與。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng gōngyì huódòng xīyǐn le dàliàng qúnzhòng cānyù.
sentences.translation: This public welfare activity attracted a large number of people to take part.

sentences.chinese: 航空公司正在研究如何减少传统燃料的使用。
sentences.traditional: 航空公司正在研究如何減少傳統燃料的使用。
sentences.pinyin: Hángkōng gōngsī zhèngzài yánjiū rúhé jiǎnshǎo chuántǒng ránliào de shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: The airline is studying how to reduce the use of traditional fuels.

sentences.chinese: 这种新型燃料排放更低，但成本仍然较高。
sentences.traditional: 這種新型燃料排放更低，但成本仍然較高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng ránliào páifàng gèng dī, dàn chéngběn réngrán jiào gāo.
sentences.translation: This new type of fuel produces lower emissions, but its cost is still relatively high.

sentences.chinese: 在冬季，偏远地区必须提前储备足够的燃料。
sentences.traditional: 在冬季，偏遠地區必須提前儲備足夠的燃料。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dōngjì, piānyuǎn dìqū bìxū tíqián chǔbèi zúgòu de ránliào.
sentences.translation: In winter, remote areas must store enough fuel in advance.

sentences.chinese: 她把旧窗帘染成了深蓝色，看起来像新的一样。
sentences.traditional: 她把舊窗簾染成了深藍色，看起來像新的一樣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiù chuānglián rǎn chéng le shēn lán sè, kàn qǐlai xiàng xīn de yíyàng.
sentences.translation: She dyed the old curtains dark blue, and they looked like new.

sentences.chinese: 工厂排出的废水把河边的石头染黑了。
sentences.traditional: 工廠排出的廢水把河邊的石頭染黑了。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng páichū de fèishuǐ bǎ hébiān de shítou rǎn hēi le.
sentences.translation: The wastewater discharged by the factory stained the stones by the river black.

sentences.chinese: 他的手指被墨水染得发黑。
sentences.traditional: 他的手指被墨水染得發黑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shǒuzhǐ bèi mòshuǐ rǎn de fā hēi.
sentences.translation: His fingers were stained black by the ink.

sentences.chinese: 城市更新已经成为当地媒体讨论的热点。
sentences.traditional: 城市更新已經成為當地媒體討論的熱點。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì gēngxīn yǐjīng chéngwéi dāngdì méitǐ tǎolùn de rèdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Urban renewal has already become a hot topic discussed by the local media.

sentences.chinese: 这个社会热点牵动着许多家庭的利益。
sentences.traditional: 這個社會熱點牽動著許多家庭的利益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèhuì rèdiǎn qiāndòngzhe xǔduō jiātíng de lìyì.
sentences.translation: This social hot topic affects the interests of many families.

sentences.chinese: 记者需要区分真正的公共热点和短暂的网络热闹。
sentences.traditional: 記者需要區分真正的公共熱點和短暫的網絡熱鬧。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě xūyào qūfēn zhēnzhèng de gōnggòng rèdiǎn hé duǎnzàn de wǎngluò rènao.
sentences.translation: Journalists need to distinguish genuine public hot topics from brief online excitement.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影上映两周后，网络热度仍然很高。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影上映兩週後，網絡熱度仍然很高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shàngyìng liǎng zhōu hòu, wǎngluò rèdù réngrán hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: Two weeks after this film was released, its online popularity was still very high.

sentences.chinese: 品牌不能只追求一时的热度，还要保持产品质量。
sentences.traditional: 品牌不能只追求一時的熱度，還要保持產品質量。
sentences.pinyin: Pǐnpái bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú yìshí de rèdù, hái yào bǎochí chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: A brand cannot only pursue temporary popularity; it must also maintain product quality.

sentences.chinese: 活动现场的热度远远超过了主办方的预期。
sentences.traditional: 活動現場的熱度遠遠超過了主辦方的預期。
sentences.pinyin: Huódòng xiànchǎng de rèdù yuǎnyuǎn chāoguò le zhǔbànfāng de yùqī.
sentences.translation: The enthusiasm at the event far exceeded the organiser’s expectations.

sentences.chinese: 人工智能是近来最热门的研究方向之一。
sentences.traditional: 人工智能是近來最熱門的研究方向之一。
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng shì jìnlái zuì rèmén de yánjiū fāngxiàng zhī yī.
sentences.translation: Artificial intelligence has recently been one of the most popular research directions.

sentences.chinese: 这门课程太热门，名额很快就被报满了。
sentences.traditional: 這門課程太熱門，名額很快就被報滿了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng tài rèmén, míng'é hěn kuài jiù bèi bào mǎn le.
sentences.translation: This course is so popular that the places were filled very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 热门景点在节假日期间往往需要提前预约。
sentences.traditional: 熱門景點在節假日期間往往需要提前預約。
sentences.pinyin: Rèmén jǐngdiǎn zài jiéjiàrì qījiān wǎngwǎng xūyào tíqián yùyuē.
sentences.translation: Popular scenic spots often require advance booking during public holidays.

sentences.chinese: 这台热水器使用了节能技术，冬天洗澡也不会耗电太多。
sentences.traditional: 這臺熱水器使用了節能技術，冬天洗澡也不會耗電太多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái rèshuǐqì shǐyòng le jiénéng jìshù, dōngtiān xǐzǎo yě bú huì hàodiàn tài duō.
sentences.translation: This water heater uses energy-saving technology, so showering in winter does not use too much electricity.

sentences.chinese: 如果热水器漏水，应立即关闭电源并联系维修人员。
sentences.traditional: 如果熱水器漏水，應立即關閉電源並聯繫維修人員。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ rèshuǐqì lòushuǐ, yīng lìjí guānbì diànyuán bìng liánxì wéixiū rényuán.
sentences.translation: If the water heater leaks, you should immediately turn off the power and contact a repair worker.

sentences.chinese: 公寓里的热水器已经老化，房东答应下周更换。
sentences.traditional: 公寓裡的熱水器已經老化，房東答應下週更換。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyù lǐ de rèshuǐqì yǐjīng lǎohuà, fángdōng dāying xià zhōu gēnghuàn.
sentences.translation: The water heater in the flat has aged, and the landlord has agreed to replace it next week.

sentences.chinese: 遇到紧急情况时，可以拨打这条热线寻求帮助。
sentences.traditional: 遇到緊急情況時，可以撥打這條熱線尋求幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng shí, kěyǐ bōdǎ zhè tiáo rèxiàn xúnqiú bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: In an emergency, you can call this hotline to seek help.

sentences.chinese: 市民热线每天处理大量关于交通和医疗的咨询。
sentences.traditional: 市民熱線每天處理大量關於交通和醫療的諮詢。
sentences.pinyin: Shìmín rèxiàn měitiān chǔlǐ dàliàng guānyú jiāotōng hé yīliáo de zīxún.
sentences.translation: The citizens’ hotline handles a large number of enquiries about transport and healthcare every day.

sentences.chinese: 公司设立了售后服务热线，专门解决客户投诉。
sentences.traditional: 公司設立了售後服務熱線，專門解決客戶投訴。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī shèlì le shòuhòu fúwù rèxiàn, zhuānmén jiějué kèhù tóusù.
sentences.translation: The company set up an after-sales service hotline specifically to handle customer complaints.

sentences.chinese: 这项教育改革在网上引发热议，支持和反对的声音都很多。
sentences.traditional: 這項教育改革在網上引發熱議，支持和反對的聲音都很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jiàoyù gǎigé zài wǎngshàng yǐnfā rèyì, zhīchí hé fǎnduì de shēngyīn dōu hěn duō.
sentences.translation: This education reform sparked heated discussion online, with many voices both supporting and opposing it.

sentences.chinese: 新政策公布后，媒体连续几天热议其可能带来的影响。
sentences.traditional: 新政策公佈後，媒體連續幾天熱議其可能帶來的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè gōngbù hòu, méitǐ liánxù jǐ tiān rèyì qí kěnéng dài lái de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: After the new policy was announced, the media discussed its possible impact heatedly for several days.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影因为触及现实问题，成为观众热议的话题。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影因為觸及現實問題，成為觀眾熱議的話題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yīnwèi chùjí xiànshí wèntí, chéngwéi guānzhòng rèyì de huàtí.
sentences.translation: Because this film touches on real-life issues, it became a topic of heated discussion among viewers.

sentences.chinese: 人工智能正在改变医疗、教育和交通等多个行业。
sentences.traditional: 人工智能正在改變醫療、教育和交通等多個行業。
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng zhèngzài gǎibiàn yīliáo, jiàoyù hé jiāotōng děng duō gè hángyè.
sentences.translation: Artificial intelligence is changing many industries, including healthcare, education and transport.

sentences.chinese: 公司利用人工智能分析客户需求，提高了服务效率。
sentences.traditional: 公司利用人工智能分析客戶需求，提高了服務效率。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī lìyòng réngōng zhìnéng fēnxī kèhù xūqiú, tígāo le fúwù xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: The company uses artificial intelligence to analyse customer needs and improve service efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 人工智能的发展也带来了隐私保护和就业变化等问题。
sentences.traditional: 人工智能的發展也帶來了隱私保護和就業變化等問題。
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng de fāzhǎn yě dài lái le yǐnsī bǎohù hé jiùyè biànhuà děng wèntí.
sentences.translation: The development of artificial intelligence has also brought issues such as privacy protection and changes in employment.

sentences.chinese: 人家已经道歉了，你就别再追究这件事了。
sentences.traditional: 人家已經道歉了，你就別再追究這件事了。
sentences.pinyin: Rénjia yǐjīng dàoqiàn le, nǐ jiù bié zài zhuījiū zhè jiàn shì le.
sentences.translation: They have already apologised, so stop pursuing the matter.

sentences.chinese: 你不能只看见人家的缺点，却忽视自己的问题。
sentences.traditional: 你不能只看見人家的缺點，卻忽視自己的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng zhǐ kànjiàn rénjia de quēdiǎn, què hūshì zìjǐ de wèntí.
sentences.translation: You cannot only see other people’s shortcomings while ignoring your own problems.

sentences.chinese: 人家辛苦准备了这么久，我们至少应该认真听完。
sentences.traditional: 人家辛苦準備了這麼久，我們至少應該認真聽完。
sentences.pinyin: Rénjia xīnkǔ zhǔnbèi le zhème jiǔ, wǒmen zhìshǎo yīnggāi rènzhēn tīng wán.
sentences.translation: They worked hard to prepare for so long, so we should at least listen carefully until the end.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市的人均收入近年稳步提高。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市的人均收入近年穩步提高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de rénjūn shōurù jìnnián wěnbù tígāo.
sentences.translation: The per capita income of this city has risen steadily in recent years.

sentences.chinese: 报告显示，该地区人均用水量明显低于全国平均水平。
sentences.traditional: 報告顯示，該地區人均用水量明顯低於全國平均水平。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào xiǎnshì, gāi dìqū rénjūn yòngshuǐliàng míngxiǎn dī yú quánguó píngjūn shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: The report shows that per capita water use in this region is clearly below the national average.

sentences.chinese: 酒店按人均消费计算，团队价格比单独预订更划算。
sentences.traditional: 酒店按人均消費計算，團隊價格比單獨預訂更划算。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn àn rénjūn xiāofèi jìsuàn, tuánduì jiàgé bǐ dāndú yùdìng gèng huásuàn.
sentences.translation: The hotel calculates by per capita spending, and the group price is better value than booking separately.

sentences.chinese: 节日期间，景区入口处人山人海，排队至少要半小时。
sentences.traditional: 節日期間，景區入口處人山人海，排隊至少要半小時。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì qíjiān, jǐngqū rùkǒu chù rénshān-rénhǎi, páiduì zhìshǎo yào bàn xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: During the festival, the entrance to the scenic area was packed with people, and queuing took at least half an hour.

sentences.chinese: 演唱会还没开始，体育馆外已经人山人海。
sentences.traditional: 演唱會還沒開始，體育館外已經人山人海。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì hái méi kāishǐ, tǐyùguǎn wài yǐjīng rénshān-rénhǎi.
sentences.translation: The concert had not even started, but outside the stadium it was already a sea of people.

sentences.chinese: 广场上人山人海，志愿者不断提醒大家注意安全。
sentences.traditional: 廣場上人山人海，志願者不斷提醒大家注意安全。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng shàng rénshān-rénhǎi, zhìyuànzhě búduàn tíxǐng dàjiā zhùyì ānquán.
sentences.translation: The square was packed with people, and volunteers kept reminding everyone to stay safe.

sentences.chinese: 多位环保人士呼吁政府尽快限制污染排放。
sentences.traditional: 多位環保人士呼籲政府儘快限制污染排放。
sentences.pinyin: Duō wèi huánbǎo rénshì hūyù zhèngfǔ jǐnkuài xiànzhì wūrǎn páifàng.
sentences.translation: Several environmental figures called on the government to restrict pollution emissions as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 医疗界人士认为，基层医院需要更多专业培训。
sentences.traditional: 醫療界人士認為，基層醫院需要更多專業培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Yīliáojiè rénshì rènwéi, jīcéng yīyuàn xūyào gèng duō zhuānyè péixùn.
sentences.translation: People in the medical field believe that primary-level hospitals need more professional training.

sentences.chinese: 业内人士透露，市场需求正在逐渐恢复。
sentences.traditional: 業內人士透露，市場需求正在逐漸恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Yènèi rénshì tòulù, shìchǎng xūqiú zhèngzài zhújiàn huīfù.
sentences.translation: Industry insiders revealed that market demand is gradually recovering.

sentences.chinese: 公司人事部门正在审核新员工的入职材料。
sentences.traditional: 公司人事部門正在審核新員工的入職材料。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī rénshì bùmén zhèngzài shěnhé xīn yuángōng de rùzhí cáiliào.
sentences.translation: The company’s personnel department is reviewing the onboarding materials for new employees.

sentences.chinese: 这次改革涉及重大人事调整，管理层非常谨慎。
sentences.traditional: 這次改革涉及重大人事調整，管理層非常謹慎。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì gǎigé shèjí zhòngdà rénshì tiáozhěng, guǎnlǐcéng fēicháng jǐnshèn.
sentences.translation: This reform involves major personnel adjustments, so the management is very cautious.

sentences.chinese: 她负责人事培训，熟悉各部门的用人需求。
sentences.traditional: 她負責人事培訓，熟悉各部門的用人需求。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fùzé rénshì péixùn, shúxī gè bùmén de yòngrén xūqiú.
sentences.translation: She is responsible for personnel training and is familiar with the staffing needs of each department.

sentences.chinese: 调查结果表明，事故主要是人为操作失误造成的。
sentences.traditional: 調查結果表明，事故主要是人為操作失誤造成的。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jiéguǒ biǎomíng, shìgù zhǔyào shì rénwéi cāozuò shīwù zàochéng de.
sentences.translation: The investigation showed that the accident was mainly caused by human operational error.

sentences.chinese: 这片湿地受到人为开发影响，生态功能明显减弱。
sentences.traditional: 這片濕地受到人為開發影響，生態功能明顯減弱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn shīdì shòudào rénwéi kāifā yǐngxiǎng, shēngtài gōngnéng míngxiǎn jiǎnruò.
sentences.translation: This wetland has been affected by man-made development, and its ecological function has clearly weakened.

sentences.chinese: 数据出现异常，不一定是系统故障，也可能有人为因素。
sentences.traditional: 數據出現異常，不一定是系統故障，也可能有人為因素。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù chūxiàn yìcháng, bù yídìng shì xìtǒng gùzhàng, yě kěnéng yǒu rénwéi yīnsù.
sentences.translation: When data anomalies appear, it is not necessarily a system fault; there may also be human factors.

sentences.chinese: 施工期间，学校门口的人行道被临时封闭，学生只能从旁边绕行。
sentences.traditional: 施工期間，學校門口的人行道被臨時封閉，學生只能從旁邊繞行。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōng qījiān, xuéxiào ménkǒu de rénxíngdào bèi línshí fēngbì, xuésheng zhǐ néng cóng pángbiān ràoxíng.
sentences.translation: During construction, the pavement outside the school was temporarily closed, so students had to go round the side.

sentences.chinese: 许多城市正在拓宽人行道，以鼓励居民步行和骑车。
sentences.traditional: 許多城市正在拓寬人行道，以鼓勵居民步行和騎車。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō chéngshì zhèngzài tuòkuān rénxíngdào, yǐ gǔlì jūmín bùxíng hé qíchē.
sentences.translation: Many cities are widening pavements to encourage residents to walk and cycle.

sentences.chinese: 商店把广告牌放在人行道上，影响了老人和轮椅通行。
sentences.traditional: 商店把廣告牌放在人行道上，影響了老人和輪椅通行。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn bǎ guǎnggào pái fàng zài rénxíngdào shang, yǐngxiǎng le lǎorén hé lúnyǐ tōngxíng.
sentences.translation: The shop placed advertising boards on the pavement, affecting access for elderly people and wheelchairs.

sentences.chinese: 他无法忍受长期加班带来的压力，最终决定换工作。
sentences.traditional: 他無法忍受長期加班帶來的壓力，最終決定換工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wúfǎ rěnshòu chángqī jiābān dài lái de yālì, zuìzhōng juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He could not endure the pressure caused by long-term overtime, and finally decided to change jobs.

sentences.chinese: 居民已经忍受了三个月的噪音，要求工地夜间停工。
sentences.traditional: 居民已經忍受了三個月的噪音，要求工地夜間停工。
sentences.pinyin: Jūmín yǐjīng rěnshòu le sān gè yuè de zàoyīn, yāoqiú gōngdì yèjiān tínggōng.
sentences.translation: Residents have endured three months of noise and are demanding that the construction site stop work at night.

sentences.chinese: 面对无理批评，她选择忍受一时，却没有放弃维护自己的权利。
sentences.traditional: 面對無理批評，她選擇忍受一時，卻沒有放棄維護自己的權利。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì wúlǐ pīpíng, tā xuǎnzé rěnshòu yìshí, què méiyǒu fàngqì wéihù zìjǐ de quánlì.
sentences.translation: Facing unreasonable criticism, she chose to endure it for the moment, but did not give up defending her rights.

sentences.chinese: 项目出问题后，负责人主动认错，并提出了补救方案。
sentences.traditional: 項目出問題後，負責人主動認錯，並提出了補救方案。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù chū wèntí hòu, fùzérén zhǔdòng rèncuò, bìng tíchū le bǔjiù fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: After the project had problems, the person in charge admitted the mistake voluntarily and proposed a remedy.

sentences.chinese: 孩子肯认错已经不容易，父母应当给他改正的机会。
sentences.traditional: 孩子肯認錯已經不容易，父母應當給他改正的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi kěn rèncuò yǐjīng bù róngyì, fùmǔ yīngdāng gěi tā gǎizhèng de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: It is already not easy for a child to admit a mistake, so parents should give him a chance to correct it.

sentences.chinese: 如果公司犯了错误却不认错，公众的信任会迅速下降。
sentences.traditional: 如果公司犯了錯誤卻不認錯，公眾的信任會迅速下降。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ gōngsī fàn le cuòwù què bù rèncuò, gōngzhòng de xìnrèn huì xùnsù xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: If a company makes a mistake but refuses to admit it, public trust will fall rapidly.

sentences.chinese: 法院最终认定这份合同有效，双方都必须履行。
sentences.traditional: 法院最終認定這份合同有效，雙方都必須履行。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎyuàn zuìzhōng rèndìng zhè fèn hétong yǒuxiào, shuāngfāng dōu bìxū lǚxíng.
sentences.translation: The court finally determined that the contract was valid, and both parties must fulfil it.

sentences.chinese: 调查小组不能只凭个人印象认定事故原因。
sentences.traditional: 調查小組不能只憑個人印象認定事故原因。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá xiǎozǔ bù néng zhǐ píng gèrén yìnxiàng rèndìng shìgù yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The investigation team cannot determine the cause of the accident based only on personal impressions.

sentences.chinese: 他一直认定，教育公平是社会长期发展的基础。
sentences.traditional: 他一直認定，教育公平是社會長期發展的基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìzhí rèndìng, jiàoyù gōngpíng shì shèhuì chángqī fāzhǎn de jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: He has always believed that educational fairness is the foundation of long-term social development.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案得到了多数专家的认可，但仍需进一步检验。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案得到了多數專家的認可，但仍需進一步檢驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn dédào le duōshù zhuānjiā de rènkě, dàn réng xū jìnyíbù jiǎnyàn.
sentences.translation: This plan has won the approval of most experts, but still needs further testing.

sentences.chinese: 只有产品质量稳定，品牌才能真正获得消费者认可。
sentences.traditional: 只有產品質量穩定，品牌才能真正獲得消費者認可。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu chǎnpǐn zhìliàng wěndìng, pǐnpái cái néng zhēnzhèng huòdé xiāofèizhě rènkě.
sentences.translation: Only when product quality is stable can a brand truly gain consumers’ approval.

sentences.chinese: 她的专业能力受到公司认可，很快被提拔为部门主管。
sentences.traditional: 她的專業能力受到公司認可，很快被提拔為部門主管。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zhuānyè nénglì shòudào gōngsī rènkě, hěn kuài bèi tíbá wéi bùmén zhǔguǎn.
sentences.translation: Her professional ability was recognised by the company, and she was soon promoted to department manager.

sentences.chinese: 许多年轻人认同环保理念，却觉得生活中真正做到很难。
sentences.traditional: 許多年輕人認同環保理念，卻覺得生活中真正做到很難。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīngrén rèntóng huánbǎo lǐniàn, què juéde shēnghuó zhōng zhēnzhèng zuòdào hěn nán.
sentences.translation: Many young people identify with environmental ideas, but feel it is difficult to truly practise them in daily life.

sentences.chinese: 员工如果不认同公司的价值观，合作很难长期稳定。
sentences.traditional: 員工如果不認同公司的價值觀，合作很難長期穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Yuángōng rúguǒ bù rèntóng gōngsī de jiàzhíguān, hézuò hěn nán chángqī wěndìng.
sentences.translation: If employees do not identify with the company’s values, cooperation is unlikely to remain stable for long.

sentences.chinese: 这部小说让海外读者也能认同主人公的情感选择。
sentences.traditional: 這部小說讓海外讀者也能認同主人公的情感選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō ràng hǎiwài dúzhě yě néng rèntóng zhǔréngōng de qínggǎn xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: This novel enables overseas readers to identify with the protagonist’s emotional choices as well.

sentences.chinese: 儿童对时间的认知会随着年龄增长而逐渐形成。
sentences.traditional: 兒童對時間的認知會隨著年齡增長而逐漸形成。
sentences.pinyin: Értóng duì shíjiān de rènzhī huì suízhe niánlíng zēngzhǎng ér zhújiàn xíngchéng.
sentences.translation: Children’s understanding of time gradually forms as they grow older.

sentences.chinese: 这次经历改变了他对成功的认知，使他不再只追求收入。
sentences.traditional: 這次經歷改變了他對成功的認知，使他不再只追求收入。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì gǎibiàn le tā duì chénggōng de rènzhī, shǐ tā bú zài zhǐ zhuīqiú shōurù.
sentences.translation: This experience changed his understanding of success, so that he no longer pursued only income.

sentences.chinese: 提高公众的健康认知，是预防疾病的重要一步。
sentences.traditional: 提高公眾的健康認知，是預防疾病的重要一步。
sentences.pinyin: Tígāo gōngzhòng de jiànkāng rènzhī, shì yùfáng jíbìng de zhòngyào yí bù.
sentences.translation: Improving the public’s health awareness is an important step in preventing disease.

sentences.chinese: 尽管成本上涨，这家小店仍旧坚持使用新鲜原料。
sentences.traditional: 儘管成本上漲，這家小店仍舊堅持使用新鮮原料。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chéngběn shàngzhǎng, zhè jiā xiǎodiàn réngjiù jiānchí shǐyòng xīnxiān yuánliào.
sentences.translation: Although costs have risen, this small shop still insists on using fresh ingredients.

sentences.chinese: 他离开家乡多年，口音却仍旧没有明显改变。
sentences.traditional: 他離開家鄉多年，口音卻仍舊沒有明顯改變。
sentences.pinyin: Tā líkāi jiāxiāng duō nián, kǒuyīn què réngjiù méiyǒu míngxiǎn gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: He has been away from his hometown for many years, but his accent still has not changed noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 系统更新后，部分用户仍旧无法登录账户。
sentences.traditional: 系統更新後，部分用戶仍舊無法登錄帳戶。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng gēngxīn hòu, bùfen yònghù réngjiù wúfǎ dēnglù zhànghù.
sentences.translation: After the system update, some users still cannot log in to their accounts.

sentences.chinese: 这份记录必须妥善保存，以便日后查阅。
sentences.traditional: 這份記錄必須妥善保存，以便日後查閱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn jìlù bìxū tuǒshàn bǎocún, yǐbiàn rìhòu cháyuè.
sentences.translation: This record must be kept properly so that it can be consulted in the future.

sentences.chinese: 如果日后政策有变化，我们会及时通知所有申请人。
sentences.traditional: 如果日後政策有變化，我們會及時通知所有申請人。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ rìhòu zhèngcè yǒu biànhuà, wǒmen huì jíshí tōngzhī suǒyǒu shēnqǐngrén.
sentences.translation: If the policy changes in the future, we will promptly inform all applicants.

sentences.chinese: 眼前的选择可能会影响他日后的职业道路。
sentences.traditional: 眼前的選擇可能會影響他日後的職業道路。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnqián de xuǎnzé kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng tā rìhòu de zhíyè dàolù.
sentences.translation: The choice in front of him may affect his future career path.

sentences.chinese: 公司日前公布了年度报告，收入比去年增长了百分之八。
sentences.traditional: 公司日前公佈了年度報告，收入比去年增長了百分之八。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī rìqián gōngbù le niándù bàogào, shōurù bǐ qùnián zēngzhǎng le bǎifēn zhī bā.
sentences.translation: The company announced its annual report a few days ago, with revenue up eight per cent from last year.

sentences.chinese: 专家日前提醒，连续高温可能会加重能源压力。
sentences.traditional: 專家日前提醒，連續高溫可能會加重能源壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā rìqián tíxǐng, liánxù gāowēn kěnéng huì jiāzhòng néngyuán yālì.
sentences.translation: Experts warned a few days ago that continuous high temperatures could increase pressure on energy supplies.

sentences.chinese: 该项目日前通过审核，预计下个月正式启动。
sentences.traditional: 該項目日前通過審核，預計下個月正式啟動。
sentences.pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù rìqián tōngguò shěnhé, yùjì xià ge yuè zhèngshì qǐdòng.
sentences.translation: The project passed review a few days ago and is expected to officially start next month.

sentences.chinese: 为了赶在汛期前完成加固工程，施工队日夜在大坝上工作。
sentences.traditional: 為了趕在汛期前完成加固工程，施工隊日夜在大壩上工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile gǎn zài xùnqī qián wánchéng jiāgù gōngchéng, shīgōngduì rìyè zài dàbà shang gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: To finish the reinforcement project before flood season, the construction team worked day and night on the dam.

sentences.chinese: 医护人员日夜照顾病人，几乎没有完整休息过。
sentences.traditional: 醫護人員日夜照顧病人，幾乎沒有完整休息過。
sentences.pinyin: Yīhù rényuán rìyè zhàogù bìngrén, jīhū méiyǒu wánzhěng xiūxi guo.
sentences.translation: Medical staff cared for patients day and night and hardly got a full rest.

sentences.chinese: 这座港口日夜运转，支撑着周边地区的贸易。
sentences.traditional: 這座港口日夜運轉，支撐著周邊地區的貿易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǎngkǒu rìyè yùnzhuǎn, zhīchēng zhe zhōubiān dìqū de màoyì.
sentences.translation: This port operates day and night, supporting trade in the surrounding region.

sentences.chinese: 随着能源价格上涨，企业对节能技术的需求日益迫切。
sentences.traditional: 隨著能源價格上漲，企業對節能技術的需求日益迫切。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe néngyuán jiàgé shàngzhǎng, qǐyè duì jiénéng jìshù de xūqiú rìyì pòqiè.
sentences.translation: As energy prices rise, companies’ need for energy-saving technology is increasingly urgent.

sentences.chinese: 城市人口日益密集，公共交通必须进一步完善。
sentences.traditional: 城市人口日益密集，公共交通必須進一步完善。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì rénkǒu rìyì mìjí, gōnggòng jiāotōng bìxū jìnyíbù wánshàn.
sentences.translation: As urban populations become increasingly dense, public transport must be further improved.

sentences.chinese: 社会对数据安全的关注日益增强。
sentences.traditional: 社會對數據安全的關注日益增強。
sentences.pinyin: Shèhuì duì shùjù ānquán de guānzhù rìyì zēngqiáng.
sentences.translation: Public concern about data security is increasing day by day.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅把本地食材和东南亚风味巧妙融合在一起。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳把本地食材和東南亞風味巧妙融合在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bǎ běndì shícái hé Dōngnányà fēngwèi qiǎomiào rónghé zài yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: This restaurant cleverly blends local ingredients with Southeast Asian flavours.

sentences.chinese: 新课程强调理论与实践的融合。
sentences.traditional: 新課程強調理論與實踐的融合。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn kèchéng qiángdiào lǐlùn yǔ shíjiàn de rónghé.
sentences.translation: The new course emphasises the integration of theory and practice.

sentences.chinese: 不同部门如果缺乏融合，项目进度就容易受影响。
sentences.traditional: 不同部門如果缺乏融合，項目進度就容易受影響。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng bùmén rúguǒ quēfá rónghé, xiàngmù jìndù jiù róngyì shòu yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If different departments lack integration, project progress is likely to be affected.

sentences.chinese: 春天一到，山顶的积雪开始慢慢融化。
sentences.traditional: 春天一到，山頂的積雪開始慢慢融化。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān yí dào, shāndǐng de jīxuě kāishǐ mànmàn rónghuà.
sentences.translation: When spring arrives, the snow on the mountaintop begins to melt slowly.

sentences.chinese: 巧克力放在阳光下，很快就会融化。
sentences.traditional: 巧克力放在陽光下，很快就會融化。
sentences.pinyin: Qiǎokèlì fàng zài yángguāng xià, hěn kuài jiù huì rónghuà.
sentences.translation: Chocolate will melt quickly if placed in the sun.

sentences.chinese: 他的真诚让对方原本冷淡的态度逐渐融化。
sentences.traditional: 他的真誠讓對方原本冷淡的態度逐漸融化。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zhēnchéng ràng duìfāng yuánběn lěngdàn de tàidù zhújiàn rónghuà.
sentences.translation: His sincerity gradually melted the other person’s originally cold attitude.

sentences.chinese: 这个水库的容量有限，连续暴雨可能导致水位迅速上升。
sentences.traditional: 這個水庫的容量有限，連續暴雨可能導致水位迅速上升。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shuǐkù de róngliàng yǒuxiàn, liánxù bàoyǔ kěnéng dǎozhì shuǐwèi xùnsù shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: This reservoir has limited capacity, and continuous heavy rain may cause the water level to rise rapidly.

sentences.chinese: 手机存储容量不足时，系统会提醒用户清理文件。
sentences.traditional: 手機儲存容量不足時，系統會提醒用戶清理文件。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī chúcún róngliàng bùzú shí, xìtǒng huì tíxǐng yònghù qīnglǐ wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: When the phone’s storage capacity is insufficient, the system will remind users to clear files.

sentences.chinese: 会议室的最大容量是两百人，报名人数已经接近上限。
sentences.traditional: 會議室的最大容量是兩百人，報名人數已經接近上限。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì de zuìdà róngliàng shì liǎng bǎi rén, bàomíng rénshù yǐjīng jiējìn shàngxiàn.
sentences.translation: The meeting room’s maximum capacity is two hundred people, and the number of registrations is already close to the limit.

sentences.chinese: 刚到国外时，他努力学习当地语言，尽快融入新的环境。
sentences.traditional: 剛到國外時，他努力學習當地語言，儘快融入新的環境。
sentences.pinyin: Gāng dào guówài shí, tā nǔlì xuéxí dāngdì yǔyán, jǐnkuài róngrù xīn de huánjìng.
sentences.translation: When he first arrived abroad, he worked hard to learn the local language and integrate into the new environment as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 这项功能已经融入日常办公流程，提高了沟通效率。
sentences.traditional: 這項功能已經融入日常辦公流程，提高了溝通效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngnéng yǐjīng róngrù rìcháng bàngōng liúchéng, tígāo le gōutōng xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: This function has already been integrated into daily office processes, improving communication efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 传统艺术要想持续发展，需要融入现代生活。
sentences.traditional: 傳統藝術要想持續發展，需要融入現代生活。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng yìshù yào xiǎng chíxù fāzhǎn, xūyào róngrù xiàndài shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: For traditional art to keep developing, it needs to integrate into modern life.

sentences.chinese: 对这位科学家来说，真正的荣誉来自研究成果被社会使用。
sentences.traditional: 對這位科學家來說，真正的榮譽來自研究成果被社會使用。
sentences.pinyin: Duì zhè wèi kēxuéjiā lái shuō, zhēnzhèng de róngyù láizì yánjiū chéngguǒ bèi shèhuì shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: For this scientist, true honour comes from research results being used by society.

sentences.chinese: 获得奖牌只是荣誉的一部分，长期训练更值得尊敬。
sentences.traditional: 獲得獎牌只是榮譽的一部分，長期訓練更值得尊敬。
sentences.pinyin: Huòdé jiǎngpái zhǐ shì róngyù de yí bùfen, chángqī xùnliàn gèng zhíde zūnjìng.
sentences.translation: Winning a medal is only part of the honour; long-term training deserves even more respect.

sentences.chinese: 他把团队荣誉看得很重，从不只考虑个人利益。
sentences.traditional: 他把團隊榮譽看得很重，從不只考慮個人利益。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ tuánduì róngyù kàn de hěn zhòng, cóng bù zhǐ kǎolǜ gèrén lìyì.
sentences.translation: He values the team’s honour highly and never considers only his personal interests.

sentences.chinese: 这款面包外皮很薄，里面却十分柔软。
sentences.traditional: 這款麵包外皮很薄，裡面卻十分柔軟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn miànbāo wàipí hěn báo, lǐmiàn què shífēn róuruǎn.
sentences.translation: This bread has a thin crust, but the inside is very soft.

sentences.chinese: 婴儿的颈椎还很脆弱，抱的时候要用柔软的毛巾支撑。
sentences.traditional: 嬰兒的頸椎還很脆弱，抱的時候要用柔軟的毛巾支撐。
sentences.pinyin: Yīng'ér de jǐngzhuī hái hěn cuìruò, bào de shíhou yào yòng róuruǎn de máojīn zhīchēng.
sentences.translation: A baby’s cervical spine is still fragile, so use a soft towel for support when holding them.

sentences.chinese: 这块棉布洗过几次后变得更加柔软。
sentences.traditional: 這塊棉布洗過幾次後變得更加柔軟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài miánbù xǐ guo jǐ cì hòu biàn de gèngjiā róuruǎn.
sentences.translation: After being washed a few times, this cotton cloth became even softer.

sentences.chinese: 旅客入境时必须如实填写健康申报信息。
sentences.traditional: 旅客入境時必須如實填寫健康申報信息。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚkè rùjìng shí bìxū rúshí tiánxiě jiànkāng shēnbào xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Travellers must truthfully fill in health declaration information when entering the country.

sentences.chinese: 因为签证材料不齐全，他在入境时被要求补充说明。
sentences.traditional: 因為簽證材料不齊全，他在入境時被要求補充說明。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiānzhèng cáiliào bù qíquán, tā zài rùjìng shí bèi yāoqiú bǔchōng shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: Because his visa documents were incomplete, he was asked to provide additional explanation on entry.

sentences.chinese: 新政策简化了留学生入境后的登记流程。
sentences.traditional: 新政策簡化了留學生入境後的登記流程。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè jiǎnhuà le liúxuéshēng rùjìng hòu de dēngjì liúchéng.
sentences.translation: The new policy simplified the registration process for international students after entry.

sentences.chinese: 这本书适合人工智能入门，但后面的章节也有一定深度。
sentences.traditional: 這本書適合人工智能入門，但後面的章節也有一定深度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shìhé réngōng zhìnéng rùmén, dàn hòumiàn de zhāngjié yě yǒu yídìng shēndù.
sentences.translation: This book is suitable as an introduction to artificial intelligence, but later chapters also have some depth.

sentences.chinese: 学一门新语言，入门阶段最重要的是建立信心和习惯。
sentences.traditional: 學一門新語言，入門階段最重要的是建立信心和習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Xué yì mén xīn yǔyán, rùmén jiēduàn zuì zhòngyào de shì jiànlì xìnxīn hé xíguàn.
sentences.translation: When learning a new language, the most important things at the beginner stage are building confidence and habits.

sentences.chinese: 老师用简单的案例帮助学生快速入门编程。
sentences.traditional: 老師用簡單的案例幫助學生快速入門編程。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng jiǎndān de ànlì bāngzhù xuésheng kuàisù rùmén biānchéng.
sentences.translation: The teacher used simple examples to help students get started with programming quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片最终入选了国际电影节的竞赛单元。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片最終入選了國際電影節的競賽單元。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zuìzhōng rùxuǎn le guójì diànyǐngjié de jìngsài dānyuán.
sentences.translation: This documentary was eventually selected for the competition section of the international film festival.

sentences.chinese: 他能入选国家队，靠的不是运气，而是长期稳定的表现。
sentences.traditional: 他能入選國家隊，靠的不是運氣，而是長期穩定的表現。
sentences.pinyin: Tā néng rùxuǎn guójiāduì, kào de bú shì yùnqi, ér shì chángqī wěndìng de biǎoxiàn.
sentences.translation: His being selected for the national team depended not on luck, but on long-term stable performance.

sentences.chinese: 这项方案入选后，还需要接受公众监督和专家评估。
sentences.traditional: 這項方案入選後，還需要接受公眾監督和專家評估。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fāng'àn rùxuǎn hòu, hái xūyào jiēshòu gōngzhòng jiāndū hé zhuānjiā pínggū.
sentences.translation: After this proposal is selected, it still needs public supervision and expert evaluation.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告直接指出了公司管理机制中的弱点。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告直接指出了公司管理機制中的弱點。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zhíjiē zhǐchū le gōngsī guǎnlǐ jīzhì zhōng de ruòdiǎn.
sentences.translation: This report directly pointed out the weaknesses in the company’s management mechanism.

sentences.chinese: 承认自己的弱点并不可怕，可怕的是一直逃避改进。
sentences.traditional: 承認自己的弱點並不可怕，可怕的是一直逃避改進。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngrèn zìjǐ de ruòdiǎn bìng bù kěpà, kěpà de shì yìzhí táobì gǎijìn.
sentences.translation: It is not frightening to admit one’s weaknesses; what is frightening is constantly avoiding improvement.

sentences.chinese: 这个系统最大的弱点是数据更新不够及时。
sentences.traditional: 這個系統最大的弱點是數據更新不夠及時。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xìtǒng zuì dà de ruòdiǎn shì shùjù gēngxīn bú gòu jíshí.
sentences.translation: The biggest weakness of this system is that its data is not updated promptly enough.

sentences.chinese: 厨师在汤面上撒了一点葱花，颜色立刻好看多了。
sentences.traditional: 廚師在湯麵上撒了一點蔥花，顏色立刻好看多了。
sentences.pinyin: Chúshī zài tāngmiàn shàng sǎ le yìdiǎn cōnghuā, yánsè lìkè hǎokàn duō le.
sentences.translation: The chef sprinkled a little chopped spring onion on the noodle soup, and the colour immediately looked much better.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把种子均匀地撒在湿润的泥土上。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把種子均勻地撒在濕潤的泥土上。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ zhǒngzi jūnyún de sǎ zài shīrùn de nítǔ shàng.
sentences.translation: The child spread the seeds evenly over the moist soil.

sentences.chinese: 道路结冰后，工作人员及时撒盐，减少了事故风险。
sentences.traditional: 道路結冰後，工作人員及時撒鹽，減少了事故風險。
sentences.pinyin: Dàolù jiébīng hòu, gōngzuò rényuán jíshí sǎ yán, jiǎnshǎo le shìgù fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: After the road iced over, staff promptly spread salt, reducing the risk of accidents.

sentences.chinese: 他把文件塞进包里，匆匆赶往会议室。
sentences.traditional: 他把文件塞進包裡，匆匆趕往會議室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wénjiàn sāi jìn bāo li, cōngcōng gǎnwǎng huìyìshì.
sentences.translation: He stuffed the documents into his bag and hurried to the meeting room.

sentences.chinese: 瓶口没有塞紧，所以酱油洒了一桌。
sentences.traditional: 瓶口沒有塞緊，所以醬油灑了一桌。
sentences.pinyin: Píngkǒu méiyǒu sāi jǐn, suǒyǐ jiàngyóu sǎ le yì zhuō.
sentences.translation: The bottle opening was not stopped tightly, so soy sauce spilled all over the table.

sentences.chinese: 别把太多广告传单塞进居民的邮箱。
sentences.traditional: 別把太多廣告傳單塞進居民的郵箱。
sentences.pinyin: Bié bǎ tài duō guǎnggào chuándān sāi jìn jūmín de yóuxiāng.
sentences.translation: Do not stuff too many advertising leaflets into residents’ letterboxes.

sentences.chinese: 这项国际赛事吸引了来自三十多个国家的选手。
sentences.traditional: 這項國際賽事吸引了來自三十多個國家的選手。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guójì sàishì xīyǐn le láizì sānshí duō ge guójiā de xuǎnshǒu.
sentences.translation: This international competition attracted competitors from more than thirty countries.

sentences.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，赛事组织方临时调整了开赛时间。
sentences.traditional: 由於天氣惡劣，賽事組織方臨時調整了開賽時間。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, sàishì zǔzhīfāng línshí tiáozhěng le kāisài shíjiān.
sentences.translation: Because of the bad weather, the competition organisers temporarily adjusted the start time.

sentences.chinese: 大型赛事不仅带来游客，也考验城市的交通和救援能力。
sentences.traditional: 大型賽事不僅帶來遊客，也考驗城市的交通和救援能力。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxíng sàishì bùjǐn dài lái yóukè, yě kǎoyàn chéngshì de jiāotōng hé jiùyuán nénglì.
sentences.translation: Large competitions not only bring tourists but also test a city’s transport and rescue capacity.

sentences.chinese: 他把零钱散在桌上，仔细数了一遍。
sentences.traditional: 他把零錢散在桌上，仔細數了一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ língqián sǎn zài zhuō shàng, zǐxì shǔ le yí biàn.
sentences.translation: He scattered the small change on the table and counted it carefully.

sentences.chinese: 风一吹，刚整理好的资料又散了一地。
sentences.traditional: 風一吹，剛整理好的資料又散了一地。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng yì chuī, gāng zhěnglǐ hǎo de zīliào yòu sǎn le yí dì.
sentences.translation: As soon as the wind blew, the documents that had just been sorted scattered all over the floor again.

sentences.chinese: 请不要把垃圾散在草地上，活动结束后要统一清理。
sentences.traditional: 請不要把垃圾散在草地上，活動結束後要統一清理。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào bǎ lājī sǎn zài cǎodì shàng, huódòng jiéshù hòu yào tǒngyī qīnglǐ.
sentences.translation: Please do not scatter rubbish on the grass; it must be cleaned up together after the event.

sentences.chinese: 这篇散文语言朴素，却能描绘出很深的乡愁。
sentences.traditional: 這篇散文語言樸素，卻能描繪出很深的鄉愁。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān sǎnwén yǔyán pǔsù, què néng miáohuì chū hěn shēn de xiāngchóu.
sentences.translation: The language of this prose essay is plain, yet it can depict a deep homesickness.

sentences.chinese: 老师要求我们比较小说和散文在叙事节奏上的差异。
sentences.traditional: 老師要求我們比較小說和散文在敘事節奏上的差異。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen bǐjiào xiǎoshuō hé sǎnwén zài xùshì jiézòu shàng de chāyì.
sentences.translation: The teacher asked us to compare the differences in narrative rhythm between fiction and prose.

sentences.chinese: 他的散文常从日常小事出发，引出对社会的观察。
sentences.traditional: 他的散文常從日常小事出發，引出對社會的觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de sǎnwén cháng cóng rìcháng xiǎoshì chūfā, yǐnchū duì shèhuì de guānchá.
sentences.translation: His prose often starts from small everyday matters and leads into observations about society.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，人群很快散了，广场恢复了平静。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，人群很快散了，廣場恢復了平靜。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, rénqún hěn kuài sàn le, guǎngchǎng huīfù le píngjìng.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, the crowd quickly dispersed and the square became calm again.

sentences.chinese: 雾慢慢散去，远处的桥梁终于清晰可见。
sentences.traditional: 霧慢慢散去，遠處的橋梁終於清晰可見。
sentences.pinyin: Wù mànmàn sàn qù, yuǎnchù de qiáoliáng zhōngyú qīngxī kějiàn.
sentences.translation: The fog slowly dispersed, and the bridge in the distance finally became clearly visible.

sentences.chinese: 这个团队散了以后，很多成员去了不同的公司。
sentences.traditional: 這個團隊散了以後，很多成員去了不同的公司。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì sàn le yǐhòu, hěn duō chéngyuán qù le bùtóng de gōngsī.
sentences.translation: After this team broke up, many members went to different companies.

sentences.chinese: 新买的木材散发出淡淡的香味。
sentences.traditional: 新買的木材散發出淡淡的香味。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn mǎi de mùcái sànfā chū dàndàn de xiāngwèi.
sentences.translation: The newly bought timber gives off a faint fragrance.

sentences.chinese: 这座花园在清晨散发着湿润而清新的气息。
sentences.traditional: 這座花園在清晨散發著濕潤而清新的氣息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò huāyuán zài qīngchén sànfā zhe shīrùn ér qīngxīn de qìxī.
sentences.translation: This garden gives off a moist and fresh atmosphere in the early morning.

sentences.chinese: 演讲者平静的语气散发出一种坚定的力量。
sentences.traditional: 演講者平靜的語氣散發出一種堅定的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng zhě píngjìng de yǔqì sànfā chū yì zhǒng jiāndìng de lìliàng.
sentences.translation: The speaker’s calm tone gave off a kind of firm strength.

sentences.chinese: 他连续讲解了两个小时，嗓子有些发哑。
sentences.traditional: 他連續講解了兩個小時，嗓子有些發啞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liánxù jiǎngjiě le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, sǎngzi yǒuxiē fā yǎ.
sentences.translation: After explaining for two hours straight, his throat became a little hoarse.

sentences.chinese: 天气干燥时，多喝水可以缓解嗓子不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 天氣乾燥時，多喝水可以緩解嗓子不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì gānzào shí, duō hē shuǐ kěyǐ huǎnjiě sǎngzi bù shūfu.
sentences.translation: When the weather is dry, drinking more water can relieve throat discomfort.

sentences.chinese: 歌手在上台前特意休息了一会儿，以保护嗓子。
sentences.traditional: 歌手在上臺前特意休息了一會兒，以保護嗓子。
sentences.pinyin: Gēshǒu zài shàngtái qián tèyì xiūxi le yíhuìr, yǐ bǎohù sǎngzi.
sentences.translation: The singer deliberately rested for a while before going on stage to protect her voice.

sentences.chinese: 他在事故中丧失了部分听力，但仍坚持工作。
sentences.traditional: 他在事故中喪失了部分聽力，但仍堅持工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài shìgù zhōng sàngshī le bùfen tīnglì, dàn réng jiānchí gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He lost part of his hearing in the accident, but still kept working.

sentences.chinese: 如果企业丧失信誉，再低的价格也很难吸引客户。
sentences.traditional: 如果企業喪失信譽，再低的價格也很難吸引客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qǐyè sàngshī xìnyù, zài dī de jiàgé yě hěn nán xīyǐn kèhù.
sentences.translation: If a company loses its credibility, even very low prices will struggle to attract customers.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺乏沟通会让团队丧失合作的信心。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺乏溝通會讓團隊喪失合作的信心。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá gōutōng huì ràng tuánduì sàngshī hézuò de xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: A long-term lack of communication will cause a team to lose confidence in cooperating.

sentences.chinese: 请先扫描二维码，再填写个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 請先掃描二維碼，再填寫個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān sǎomiáo èrwéimǎ, zài tiánxiě gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Please scan the QR code first, then fill in your personal information.

sentences.chinese: 系统会自动扫描文件，检查是否存在安全漏洞。
sentences.traditional: 系統會自動掃描文件，檢查是否存在安全漏洞。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng sǎomiáo wénjiàn, jiǎnchá shìfǒu cúnzài ānquán lòudòng.
sentences.translation: The system will automatically scan the files to check whether there are security loopholes.

sentences.chinese: 医生安排他做一次全面扫描，以确定疼痛原因。
sentences.traditional: 醫生安排他做一次全面掃描，以確定疼痛原因。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng ānpái tā zuò yí cì quánmiàn sǎomiáo, yǐ quèdìng téngtòng yuányīn.
sentences.translation: The doctor arranged a full scan for him to determine the cause of the pain.

sentences.chinese: 这种药能杀死大部分细菌，但不能代替清洁。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥能殺死大部分細菌，但不能代替清潔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào néng shā sǐ dà bùfen xìjūn, dàn bù néng dàitì qīngjié.
sentences.translation: This medicine can kill most bacteria, but it cannot replace cleaning.

sentences.chinese: 寒潮一来，地里的害虫被杀了不少。
sentences.traditional: 寒潮一來，地裡的害蟲被殺了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Háncháo yì lái, dìli de hàichóng bèi shā le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: When the cold wave arrived, quite a few pests in the fields were killed.

sentences.chinese: 电影里的主角不愿杀人，因此选择了逃跑。
sentences.traditional: 電影裡的主角不願殺人，因此選擇了逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng li de zhǔjué bú yuàn shā rén, yīncǐ xuǎnzé le táopǎo.
sentences.translation: The main character in the film was unwilling to kill anyone, so he chose to run away.

sentences.chinese: 看到前方有人横穿马路，司机立刻刹车。
sentences.traditional: 看到前方有人橫穿馬路，司機立刻剎車。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào qiánfāng yǒu rén héngchuān mǎlù, sījī lìkè shāchē.
sentences.translation: Seeing someone crossing the road ahead, the driver braked immediately.

sentences.chinese: 这辆客车的刹车系统需要定期检测。
sentences.traditional: 這輛客車的剎車系統需要定期檢測。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng kèchē de shāchē xìtǒng xūyào dìngqī jiǎncè.
sentences.translation: The braking system of this passenger bus needs regular testing.

sentences.chinese: 如果路面湿滑，刹车距离会明显变长。
sentences.traditional: 如果路面濕滑，剎車距離會明顯變長。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ lùmiàn shīhuá, shāchē jùlí huì míngxiǎn biàn cháng.
sentences.translation: If the road surface is wet and slippery, the braking distance will become noticeably longer.

sentences.chinese: 纪录片展示了鲨鱼在海洋生态中的重要作用。
sentences.traditional: 紀錄片展示了鯊魚在海洋生態中的重要作用。
sentences.pinyin: Jìlùpiàn zhǎnshì le shāyú zài hǎiyáng shēngtài zhōng de zhòngyào zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: The documentary showed the important role sharks play in the marine ecosystem.

sentences.chinese: 这片海域偶尔会有鲨鱼出现，游客不能随意下水。
sentences.traditional: 這片海域偶爾會有鯊魚出現，遊客不能隨意下水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn hǎiyù ǒu'ěr huì yǒu shāyú chūxiàn, yóukè bù néng suíyì xià shuǐ.
sentences.translation: Sharks occasionally appear in this sea area, so tourists must not enter the water casually.

sentences.chinese: 人们对鲨鱼常有恐惧，其实很多种类并不主动攻击人。
sentences.traditional: 人們對鯊魚常有恐懼，其實很多種類並不主動攻擊人。
sentences.pinyin: Rénmen duì shāyú cháng yǒu kǒngjù, qíshí hěn duō zhǒnglèi bìng bù zhǔdòng gōngjī rén.
sentences.translation: People are often afraid of sharks, but in fact many species do not actively attack humans.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要先筛选数据，再进行深入分析。
sentences.traditional: 我們需要先篩選數據，再進行深入分析。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào xiān shāixuǎn shùjù, zài jìnxíng shēnrù fēnxī.
sentences.translation: We need to filter the data first, then carry out a deeper analysis.

sentences.chinese: 公司从三百份简历中筛选出十名候选人。
sentences.traditional: 公司從三百份簡歷中篩選出十名候選人。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī cóng sānbǎi fèn jiǎnlì zhōng shāixuǎn chū shí míng hòuxuǎnrén.
sentences.translation: The company screened ten candidates from three hundred CVs.

sentences.chinese: 平台会根据用户兴趣筛选推荐内容。
sentences.traditional: 平臺會根據用戶興趣篩選推薦內容。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái huì gēnjù yònghù xìngqù shāixuǎn tuījiàn nèiróng.
sentences.translation: The platform will filter recommended content according to users’ interests.

sentences.chinese: 他们终于爬到山顶，看见了壮丽的日出。
sentences.traditional: 他們終於爬到山頂，看見了壯麗的日出。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhōngyú pá dào shāndǐng, kànjiàn le zhuànglì de rìchū.
sentences.translation: They finally climbed to the mountaintop and saw a magnificent sunrise.

sentences.chinese: 山顶风很大，游客必须注意安全。
sentences.traditional: 山頂風很大，遊客必須注意安全。
sentences.pinyin: Shāndǐng fēng hěn dà, yóukè bìxū zhùyì ānquán.
sentences.translation: The wind is strong on the mountaintop, so tourists must pay attention to safety.

sentences.chinese: 从山顶往下看，整个城市显得格外安静。
sentences.traditional: 從山頂往下看，整個城市顯得格外安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng shāndǐng wǎng xià kàn, zhěnggè chéngshì xiǎnde géwài ānjìng.
sentences.translation: Looking down from the mountaintop, the whole city seemed especially quiet.

sentences.chinese: 远处的山峰被雪覆盖，轮廓十分清晰。
sentences.traditional: 遠處的山峰被雪覆蓋，輪廓十分清晰。
sentences.pinyin: Yuǎnchù de shānfēng bèi xuě fùgài, lúnkuò shífēn qīngxī.
sentences.translation: The distant mountain peak was covered with snow, and its outline was very clear.

sentences.chinese: 这座山峰海拔很高，普通游客不容易攀登。
sentences.traditional: 這座山峰海拔很高，普通遊客不容易攀登。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò shānfēng hǎibá hěn gāo, pǔtōng yóukè bù róngyì pāndēng.
sentences.translation: This mountain peak has a high altitude and is not easy for ordinary tourists to climb.

sentences.chinese: 夕阳照在山峰上，形成了迷人的景象。
sentences.traditional: 夕陽照在山峰上，形成了迷人的景象。
sentences.pinyin: Xīyáng zhào zài shānfēng shàng, xíngchéng le mírén de jǐngxiàng.
sentences.translation: The setting sun shone on the mountain peak, creating a charming scene.

sentences.chinese: 雨后山坡上的泥变得很滑，行人要小心。
sentences.traditional: 雨後山坡上的泥變得很滑，行人要小心。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu shānpō shàng de ní biàn de hěn huá, xíngrén yào xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: After the rain, the mud on the mountain slope became very slippery, so pedestrians should be careful.

sentences.chinese: 村民在山坡上种满了梅花和兰花。
sentences.traditional: 村民在山坡上種滿了梅花和蘭花。
sentences.pinyin: Cūnmín zài shānpō shàng zhòng mǎn le méihuā hé lánhuā.
sentences.translation: The villagers planted plum blossoms and orchids all over the mountain slope.

sentences.chinese: 这片山坡经过绿化后，生态环境改善了很多。
sentences.traditional: 這片山坡經過綠化後，生態環境改善了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn shānpō jīngguò lǜhuà hòu, shēngtài huánjìng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: After this mountain slope was greened, the ecological environment improved a great deal.

sentences.chinese: 一道光突然闪过，大家都抬头看向窗外。
sentences.traditional: 一道光突然閃過，大家都抬頭看向窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Yí dào guāng tūrán shǎn guò, dàjiā dōu táitóu kàn xiàng chuāngwài.
sentences.translation: A flash of light suddenly passed by, and everyone looked up towards the window.

sentences.chinese: 他的念头一闪而过，却给了团队新的启发。
sentences.traditional: 他的念頭一閃而過，卻給了團隊新的啟發。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de niàntou yì shǎn ér guò, què gěi le tuánduì xīn de qǐfā.
sentences.translation: The thought flashed through his mind, yet it gave the team new inspiration.

sentences.chinese: 警告灯不停地闪，说明设备出现了故障。
sentences.traditional: 警告燈不停地閃，說明設備出現了故障。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnggào dēng bùtíng de shǎn, shuōmíng shèbèi chūxiàn le gùzhàng.
sentences.translation: The warning light kept flashing, showing that the equipment had developed a fault.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨来临时，天空中划过一道闪电。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨來臨時，天空中劃過一道閃電。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ láilín shí, tiānkōng zhōng huá guò yí dào shǎndiàn.
sentences.translation: When the storm arrived, a bolt of lightning crossed the sky.

sentences.chinese: 闪电击中了山顶的树，随后引发了火灾。
sentences.traditional: 閃電擊中了山頂的樹，隨後引發了火災。
sentences.pinyin: Shǎndiàn jī zhòng le shāndǐng de shù, suíhòu yǐnfā le huǒzāi.
sentences.translation: Lightning struck the tree on the mountaintop and then caused a fire.

sentences.chinese: 孩子听见雷声后，立刻看见远处的闪电。
sentences.traditional: 孩子聽見雷聲後，立刻看見遠處的閃電。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tīngjiàn léishēng hòu, lìkè kànjiàn yuǎnchù de shǎndiàn.
sentences.translation: After hearing thunder, the child immediately saw lightning in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 这扇窗户朝南，清晨阳光能直接照进来。
sentences.traditional: 這扇窗戶朝南，清晨陽光能直接照進來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shàn chuānghu cháo nán, qīngchén yángguāng néng zhíjiē zhào jìnlai.
sentences.translation: This window faces south, so morning sunlight can shine directly in.

sentences.chinese: 办公室新装了两扇隔音门，环境安静多了。
sentences.traditional: 辦公室新裝了兩扇隔音門，環境安靜多了。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì xīn zhuāng le liǎng shàn géyīn mén, huánjìng ānjìng duō le.
sentences.translation: The office installed two new soundproof doors, making the environment much quieter.

sentences.chinese: 展厅入口有一扇玻璃门，需要刷卡才能打开。
sentences.traditional: 展廳入口有一扇玻璃門，需要刷卡才能打開。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎntīng rùkǒu yǒu yí shàn bōlí mén, xūyào shuākǎ cái néng dǎkāi.
sentences.translation: There is a glass door at the entrance to the exhibition hall, and you need to swipe a card to open it.

sentences.chinese: 这个商标已经注册，其他公司不能随便使用。
sentences.traditional: 這個商標已經註冊，其他公司不能隨便使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shāngbiāo yǐjīng zhùcè, qítā gōngsī bù néng suíbiàn shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This trademark has already been registered, so other companies cannot use it casually.

sentences.chinese: 产品包装上的商标设计得十分醒目。
sentences.traditional: 產品包裝上的商標設計得十分醒目。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn bāozhuāng shàng de shāngbiāo shèjì de shífēn xǐngmù.
sentences.translation: The trademark on the product packaging is designed to be very eye-catching.

sentences.chinese: 如果商标被侵犯，企业可以依法维权。
sentences.traditional: 如果商標被侵犯，企業可以依法維權。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shāngbiāo bèi qīnfàn, qǐyè kěyǐ yīfǎ wéiquán.
sentences.translation: If a trademark is infringed, the company can protect its rights according to the law.

sentences.chinese: 伤口虽然不深，但仍然需要及时清洗。
sentences.traditional: 傷口雖然不深，但仍然需要及時清洗。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngkǒu suīrán bù shēn, dàn réngrán xūyào jíshí qīngxǐ.
sentences.translation: Although the wound is not deep, it still needs to be cleaned promptly.

sentences.chinese: 医生检查了他的伤口，确认没有感染。
sentences.traditional: 醫生檢查了他的傷口，確認沒有感染。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá le tā de shāngkǒu, quèrèn méiyǒu gǎnrǎn.
sentences.translation: The doctor examined his wound and confirmed that there was no infection.

sentences.chinese: 她用干净的纱布轻轻包住伤口。
sentences.traditional: 她用乾淨的紗布輕輕包住傷口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng gānjìng de shābù qīngqīng bāo zhù shāngkǒu.
sentences.translation: She gently wrapped the wound with clean gauze.

sentences.chinese: 这次事故造成了多人伤亡，原因仍在调查。
sentences.traditional: 這次事故造成了多人傷亡，原因仍在調查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù zàochéng le duō rén shāngwáng, yuányīn réng zài diàochá.
sentences.translation: This accident caused many casualties, and the cause is still under investigation.

sentences.chinese: 救援队尽力减少伤亡，并及时转移群众。
sentences.traditional: 救援隊盡力減少傷亡，並及時轉移群眾。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùyuán duì jìnlì jiǎnshǎo shāngwáng, bìng jíshí zhuǎnyí qúnzhòng.
sentences.translation: The rescue team tried hard to reduce casualties and moved the public in time.

sentences.chinese: 官方公布了最新伤亡数字，提醒大家注意安全。
sentences.traditional: 官方公佈了最新傷亡數字，提醒大家注意安全。
sentences.pinyin: Guānfāng gōngbù le zuìxīn shāngwáng shùzì, tíxǐng dàjiā zhùyì ānquán.
sentences.translation: Officials released the latest casualty figures and reminded everyone to pay attention to safety.

sentences.chinese: 医护人员把伤员迅速送往附近医院。
sentences.traditional: 醫護人員把傷員迅速送往附近醫院。
sentences.pinyin: Yīhù rényuán bǎ shāngyuán xùnsù sòng wǎng fùjìn yīyuàn.
sentences.translation: Medical staff quickly sent the wounded person to a nearby hospital.

sentences.chinese: 现场设立了临时救助点，专门照顾伤员。
sentences.traditional: 現場設立了臨時救助點，專門照顧傷員。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànchǎng shèlì le línshí jiùzhù diǎn, zhuānmén zhàogù shāngyuán.
sentences.translation: A temporary aid station was set up at the scene specifically to care for the wounded.

sentences.chinese: 伤员情绪稳定后，开始配合医生治疗。
sentences.traditional: 傷員情緒穩定後，開始配合醫生治療。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngyuán qíngxù wěndìng hòu, kāishǐ pèihé yīshēng zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: After the wounded person's mood stabilised, they began to cooperate with the doctor’s treatment.

sentences.chinese: 他轻信了陌生人的承诺，结果上当了。
sentences.traditional: 他輕信了陌生人的承諾，結果上當了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngxìn le mòshēngrén de chéngnuò, jiéguǒ shàngdàng le.
sentences.translation: He trusted a stranger’s promise too easily and ended up being cheated.

sentences.chinese: 遇到便宜得离谱的商品时，要小心上当。
sentences.traditional: 遇到便宜得離譜的商品時，要小心上當。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào piányi de lípǔ de shāngpǐn shí, yào xiǎoxīn shàngdàng.
sentences.translation: When you come across a product that is unbelievably cheap, be careful not to be cheated.

sentences.chinese: 这类骗局专门利用老人的善良让他们上当。
sentences.traditional: 這類騙局專門利用老人的善良讓他們上當。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lèi piànjú zhuānmén lìyòng lǎorén de shànliáng ràng tāmen shàngdàng.
sentences.translation: This kind of scam specifically uses older people’s kindness to make them fall for it.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案需要得到上级批准才能实施。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案需要得到上級批准才能實施。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn xūyào dédào shàngjí pīzhǔn cái néng shíshī.
sentences.translation: This plan needs approval from higher levels before it can be carried out.

sentences.chinese: 他向上级汇报了项目的最新进展。
sentences.traditional: 他向上級匯報了項目的最新進展。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng shàngjí huìbào le xiàngmù de zuìxīn jìnzhǎn.
sentences.translation: He reported the latest progress of the project to his superior.

sentences.chinese: 上级部门要求各地加强安全监督。
sentences.traditional: 上級部門要求各地加強安全監督。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngjí bùmén yāoqiú gèdì jiāqiáng ānquán jiāndū.
sentences.translation: Higher-level departments required all areas to strengthen safety supervision.

sentences.chinese: 她工作认真，也很上进，所以进步很快。
sentences.traditional: 她工作認真，也很上進，所以進步很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò rènzhēn, yě hěn shàngjìn, suǒyǐ jìnbù hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: She works seriously and is very motivated, so she makes quick progress.

sentences.chinese: 这个学生虽然基础一般，但态度非常上进。
sentences.traditional: 這個學生雖然基礎一般，但態度非常上進。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xuésheng suīrán jīchǔ yìbān, dàn tàidu fēicháng shàngjìn.
sentences.translation: Although this student’s foundation is average, their attitude is very ambitious.

sentences.chinese: 团队需要更多积极上进的年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 團隊需要更多積極上進的年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Tuánduì xūyào gèng duō jījí shàngjìn de niánqīngrén.
sentences.translation: The team needs more positive and ambitious young people.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司计划明年在上海证券交易所上市。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司計劃明年在上海證券交易所上市。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìhuà míngnián zài Shànghǎi zhèngquàn jiāoyìsuǒ shàngshì.
sentences.translation: This company plans to go public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange next year.

sentences.chinese: 企业上市后，必须定期公开财务信息。
sentences.traditional: 企業上市後，必須定期公開財務信息。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè shàngshì hòu, bìxū dìngqī gōngkāi cáiwù xìnxī.
sentences.translation: After a company goes public, it must regularly disclose financial information.

sentences.chinese: 投资者看好这家即将上市的科技公司。
sentences.traditional: 投資者看好這家即將上市的科技公司。
sentences.pinyin: Tóuzīzhě kànhǎo zhè jiā jíjiāng shàngshì de kējì gōngsī.
sentences.translation: Investors are optimistic about this technology company that is about to go public.

sentences.chinese: 上述问题如果得不到解决，项目很难按时完成。
sentences.traditional: 上述問題如果得不到解決，項目很難按時完成。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngshù wèntí rúguǒ dé bù dào jiějué, xiàngmù hěn nán ànshí wánchéng.
sentences.translation: If the above-mentioned problems are not solved, the project will be difficult to complete on time.

sentences.chinese: 请根据上述原则修改合同中的相关条款。
sentences.traditional: 請根據上述原則修改合同中的相關條款。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng gēnjù shàngshù yuánzé xiūgǎi hétong zhōng de xiāngguān tiáokuǎn.
sentences.translation: Please revise the relevant clauses in the contract according to the above-mentioned principles.

sentences.chinese: 上述数据表明，居民消费信心正在恢复。
sentences.traditional: 上述數據表明，居民消費信心正在恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngshù shùjù biǎomíng, jūmín xiāofèi xìnxīn zhèngzài huīfù.
sentences.translation: The above-mentioned data show that consumer confidence among residents is recovering.

sentences.chinese: 新经理上台后，立即调整了公司的销售策略。
sentences.traditional: 新經理上臺後，立即調整了公司的銷售策略。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jīnglǐ shàngtái hòu, lìjí tiáozhěng le gōngsī de xiāoshòu cèlüè.
sentences.translation: After the new manager came into office, they immediately adjusted the company’s sales strategy.

sentences.chinese: 演员一上台，观众就报以热烈的掌声。
sentences.traditional: 演員一上臺，觀眾就報以熱烈的掌聲。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnyuán yí shàngtái, guānzhòng jiù bào yǐ rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
sentences.translation: As soon as the actor took the stage, the audience gave warm applause.

sentences.chinese: 这位年轻歌手第一次上台时非常紧张。
sentences.traditional: 這位年輕歌手第一次上臺時非常緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng gēshǒu dì yī cì shàngtái shí fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: This young singer was very nervous the first time they went on stage.

sentences.chinese: 报名时间安排在六月上旬，请提前准备材料。
sentences.traditional: 報名時間安排在六月上旬，請提前準備材料。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng shíjiān ānpái zài liù yuè shàngxún, qǐng tíqián zhǔnbèi cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Registration is scheduled for early June, so please prepare the materials in advance.

sentences.chinese: 公司计划在下月上旬公布年度报告。
sentences.traditional: 公司計劃在下月上旬公佈年度報告。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà zài xià yuè shàngxún gōngbù niándù bàogào.
sentences.translation: The company plans to release its annual report in the early part of next month.

sentences.chinese: 五月上旬的连续降雨缓解了旱情。
sentences.traditional: 五月上旬的連續降雨緩解了旱情。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔ yuè shàngxún de liánxù jiàngyǔ huǎnjiě le hànqíng.
sentences.translation: The continuous rainfall in early May eased the drought conditions.

sentences.chinese: 这家图书馆专门设立了少儿阅读区。
sentences.traditional: 這家圖書館專門設立了少兒閱讀區。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā túshūguǎn zhuānmén shèlì le shào'ér yuèdúqū.
sentences.translation: This library has set up a reading area especially for children.

sentences.chinese: 少儿节目应该兼顾知识性和趣味性。
sentences.traditional: 少兒節目應該兼顧知識性和趣味性。
sentences.pinyin: Shào'ér jiémù yīnggāi jiāngù zhīshixìng hé qùwèixìng.
sentences.translation: Children’s programmes should balance knowledge and fun.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒家长关注少儿的视力健康。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒家長關注少兒的視力健康。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng jiāzhǎng guānzhù shào'ér de shìlì jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Doctors remind parents to pay attention to children’s eyesight health.

sentences.chinese: 他喝汤太急，把舌头烫了一下。
sentences.traditional: 他喝湯太急，把舌頭燙了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hē tāng tài jí, bǎ shétou tàng le yí xià.
sentences.translation: He drank the soup too quickly and burned his tongue.

sentences.chinese: 这道菜辣得让我的舌头都发麻。
sentences.traditional: 這道菜辣得讓我的舌頭都發麻。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào cài là de ràng wǒ de shétou dōu fāmá.
sentences.translation: This dish is so spicy that it makes my tongue go numb.

sentences.chinese: 学习发音时，舌头的位置很重要。
sentences.traditional: 學習發音時，舌頭的位置很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí fāyīn shí, shétou de wèizhi hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When learning pronunciation, the position of the tongue is very important.

sentences.chinese: 学校的文学社吸引了许多喜欢写作的学生。
sentences.traditional: 學校的文學社吸引了許多喜歡寫作的學生。
