sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào de wénxuéshè xīyǐn le xǔduō xǐhuan xiězuò de xuésheng.
sentences.translation: The school’s literary society attracted many students who enjoy writing.

sentences.chinese: 这个村的合作社帮助农民统一销售农产品。
sentences.traditional: 這個村的合作社幫助農民統一銷售農產品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cūn de hézuòshè bāngzhù nóngmín tǒngyī xiāoshòu nóngchǎnpǐn.
sentences.translation: The village cooperative helps farmers sell agricultural products together.

sentences.chinese: 出版社决定重新印刷这本经典教材。
sentences.traditional: 出版社決定重新印刷這本經典教材。
sentences.pinyin: Chūbǎnshè juédìng chóngxīn yìnshuā zhè běn jīngdiǎn jiàocái.
sentences.translation: The publishing house decided to reprint this classic textbook.

sentences.chinese: 运动员稳定呼吸后才把箭射出去。
sentences.traditional: 運動員穩定呼吸後才把箭射出去。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán wěndìng hūxī hòu cái bǎ jiàn shè chūqu.
sentences.translation: The athlete only shot the arrow after steadying their breathing.

sentences.chinese: 阳光从窗外射进来，把地板照得很亮。
sentences.traditional: 陽光從窗外射進來，把地板照得很亮。
sentences.pinyin: Yángguāng cóng chuāngwài shè jìnlai, bǎ dìbǎn zhào de hěn liàng.
sentences.translation: Sunlight shone in from outside the window and made the floor very bright.

sentences.chinese: 他在训练中连续射中十环。
sentences.traditional: 他在訓練中連續射中十環。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xùnliàn zhōng liánxù shè zhòng shí huán.
sentences.translation: He hit the ten-ring several times in a row during training.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革涉及教育、医疗和住房等多个领域。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革涉及教育、醫療和住房等多個領域。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé shèjí jiàoyù, yīliáo hé zhùfáng děng duō ge lǐngyù.
sentences.translation: This reform involves several fields, including education, healthcare and housing.

sentences.chinese: 如果问题涉及个人隐私，工作人员必须谨慎处理。
sentences.traditional: 如果問題涉及個人隱私，工作人員必須謹慎處理。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wèntí shèjí gèrén yǐnsī, gōngzuò rényuán bìxū jǐnshèn chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: If a matter involves personal privacy, staff must handle it carefully.

sentences.chinese: 合同中涉及赔偿的条款需要重新审查。
sentences.traditional: 合同中涉及賠償的條款需要重新審查。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong zhōng shèjí péicháng de tiáokuǎn xūyào chóngxīn shěnchá.
sentences.translation: The clauses in the contract relating to compensation need to be reviewed again.

sentences.chinese: 射击比赛要求选手保持高度冷静。
sentences.traditional: 射擊比賽要求選手保持高度冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjī bǐsài yāoqiú xuǎnshǒu bǎochí gāodù lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: Shooting competitions require competitors to remain highly calm.

sentences.chinese: 这部影片的射击场面经过了严格的安全设计。
sentences.traditional: 這部影片的射擊場面經過了嚴格的安全設計。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù yǐngpiàn de shèjī chǎngmiàn jīngguò le yángé de ānquán shèjì.
sentences.translation: The shooting scenes in this film went through strict safety planning.

sentences.chinese: 他参加的是体育射击项目，不是军事训练。
sentences.traditional: 他參加的是體育射擊項目，不是軍事訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cānjiā de shì tǐyù shèjī xiàngmù, bú shì jūnshì xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: What he takes part in is a sports shooting event, not military training.

sentences.chinese: 记者在事故现场摄像，并采访了几位目击者。
sentences.traditional: 記者在事故現場攝像，並採訪了幾位目擊者。
sentences.pinyin: Jìzhě zài shìgù xiànchǎng shèxiàng, bìng cǎifǎng le jǐ wèi mùjīzhě.
sentences.translation: The reporter filmed at the accident scene and interviewed several witnesses.

sentences.chinese: 会议全程由专业人员摄像，资料将用于内部培训。
sentences.traditional: 會議全程由專業人員攝像，資料將用於內部培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì quánchéng yóu zhuānyè rényuán shèxiàng, zīliào jiāng yòngyú nèibù péixùn.
sentences.translation: The whole meeting was filmed by professionals, and the material will be used for internal training.

sentences.chinese: 手机摄像功能越来越强，短视频创作变得更加方便。
sentences.traditional: 手機攝像功能越來越強，短視頻創作變得更加方便。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī shèxiàng gōngnéng yuè lái yuè qiáng, duǎn shìpín chuàngzuò biàn de gèngjiā fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: Mobile phone camera and filming functions are becoming stronger, making short-video creation more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 政府在制定政策时，必须设想各种可能出现的后果。
sentences.traditional: 政府在制定政策時，必須設想各種可能出現的後果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zài zhìdìng zhèngcè shí, bìxū shèxiǎng gè zhǒng kěnéng chūxiàn de hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: When making policy, the government must imagine all kinds of possible consequences.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划听起来大胆，但并非无法设想。
sentences.traditional: 這個計畫聽起來大膽，但並非無法設想。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà tīng qǐlai dàdǎn, dàn bìngfēi wúfǎ shèxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This plan sounds bold, but it is not impossible to imagine.

sentences.chinese: 请设想一下，如果交通完全自动化，城市会发生什么变化。
sentences.traditional: 請設想一下，如果交通完全自動化，城市會發生什麼變化。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng shèxiǎng yíxià, rúguǒ jiāotōng wánquán zìdònghuà, chéngshì huì fāshēng shénme biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Please imagine what changes would happen to cities if transport became fully automated.

sentences.chinese: 办公楼入口安装了高清摄像头，以便记录进出情况。
sentences.traditional: 辦公樓入口安裝了高清攝像頭，以便記錄進出情況。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōnglóu rùkǒu ānzhuāng le gāoqīng shèxiàngtóu, yǐbiàn jìlù jìnchū qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: A high-definition camera was installed at the office building entrance to record people coming and going.

sentences.chinese: 这个摄像头可以自动识别人脸，但也引发了隐私讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這個攝像頭可以自動識別人臉，但也引發了隱私討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shèxiàngtóu kěyǐ zìdòng shíbié rénliǎn, dàn yě yǐnfā le yǐnsī tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: This camera can automatically recognise faces, but it has also sparked privacy discussions.

sentences.chinese: 维修人员检查后发现，后门的摄像头已经断电。
sentences.traditional: 維修人員檢查後發現，後門的攝像頭已經斷電。
sentences.pinyin: Wéixiū rényuán jiǎnchá hòu fāxiàn, hòumén de shèxiàngtóu yǐjīng duàndiàn.
sentences.translation: After checking, the maintenance worker found that the camera by the back door had lost power.

sentences.chinese: 长期加班会影响身心健康，管理者不应忽视这一点。
sentences.traditional: 長期加班會影響身心健康，管理者不應忽視這一點。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī jiābān huì yǐngxiǎng shēnxīn jiànkāng, guǎnlǐzhě bù yīng hūshì zhè yì diǎn.
sentences.translation: Long-term overtime can affect physical and mental health, and managers should not ignore this.

sentences.chinese: 运动不仅锻炼身体，也能让身心得到放松。
sentences.traditional: 運動不僅鍛鍊身體，也能讓身心得到放鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng bùjǐn duànliàn shēntǐ, yě néng ràng shēnxīn dédào fàngsōng.
sentences.translation: Exercise not only trains the body, but also allows body and mind to relax.

sentences.chinese: 学校应关注学生的身心发展，而不只是考试成绩。
sentences.traditional: 學校應關注學生的身心發展，而不只是考試成績。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yīng guānzhù xuéshēng de shēnxīn fāzhǎn, ér bú zhǐ shì kǎoshì chéngjì.
sentences.translation: Schools should pay attention to students’ physical and mental development, not just exam results.

sentences.chinese: 深夜的街道格外安静，只听得见远处车辆的声音。
sentences.traditional: 深夜的街道格外安靜，只聽得見遠處車輛的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnyè de jiēdào géwài ānjìng, zhǐ tīng de jiàn yuǎnchù chēliàng de shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: The streets late at night were especially quiet; only the sound of vehicles in the distance could be heard.

sentences.chinese: 他常在深夜写作，因为那时思路最清晰。
sentences.traditional: 他常在深夜寫作，因為那時思路最清晰。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng zài shēnyè xiězuò, yīnwèi nà shí sīlù zuì qīngxī.
sentences.translation: He often writes late at night because his thinking is clearest then.

sentences.chinese: 深夜收到紧急电话，医生立刻赶往医院。
sentences.traditional: 深夜收到緊急電話，醫生立刻趕往醫院。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnyè shōudào jǐnjí diànhuà, yīshēng lìkè gǎn wǎng yīyuàn.
sentences.translation: After receiving an emergency call late at night, the doctor immediately rushed to the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 老师的解释太神了，复杂的问题一下子变得清楚。
sentences.traditional: 老師的解釋太神了，複雜的問題一下子變得清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de jiěshì tài shén le, fùzá de wèntí yíxiàzi biàn de qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The teacher’s explanation was amazing; the complicated problem became clear at once.

sentences.chinese: 在古代传说中，这座山被认为住着神。
sentences.traditional: 在古代傳說中，這座山被認為住著神。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài chuánshuō zhōng, zhè zuò shān bèi rènwéi zhùzhe shén.
sentences.translation: In ancient legends, people believed that a god lived on this mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他没有把成功归功于神，而是归功于长期训练。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有把成功歸功於神，而是歸功於長期訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu bǎ chénggōng guīgōng yú shén, ér shì guīgōng yú chángqī xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: He did not credit his success to a god, but to long-term training.

sentences.chinese: 长期压力会使神经一直处于紧张状态。
sentences.traditional: 長期壓力會使神經一直處於緊張狀態。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī yālì huì shǐ shénjīng yìzhí chǔyú jǐnzhāng zhuàngtài.
sentences.translation: Long-term pressure can keep the nerves in a constant state of tension.

sentences.chinese: 这项手术必须避开重要神经，否则可能影响手臂活动。
sentences.traditional: 這項手術必須避開重要神經，否則可能影響手臂活動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng shǒushù bìxū bìkāi zhòngyào shénjīng, fǒuzé kěnéng yǐngxiǎng shǒubì huódòng.
sentences.translation: This operation must avoid important nerves; otherwise, it may affect arm movement.

sentences.chinese: 他一上台就神经绷紧，连准备好的开场白都忘了。
sentences.traditional: 他一上臺就神經繃緊，連準備好的開場白都忘了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yí shàngtái jiù shénjīng bēngjǐn, lián zhǔnbèi hǎo de kāichǎngbái dōu wàng le.
sentences.translation: As soon as he went on stage, his nerves tensed up and he even forgot his prepared opening lines.

sentences.chinese: 这种材料很神奇，遇水后会自动变硬。
sentences.traditional: 這種材料很神奇，遇水後會自動變硬。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào hěn shénqí, yù shuǐ hòu huì zìdòng biàn yìng.
sentences.translation: This material is magical; after it meets water, it automatically becomes hard.

sentences.chinese: 科学并不排斥神奇现象，而是试图解释它们。
sentences.traditional: 科學並不排斥神奇現象，而是試圖解釋它們。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué bìng bù páichì shénqí xiànxiàng, ér shì shìtú jiěshì tāmen.
sentences.translation: Science does not reject magical phenomena; it tries to explain them.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们觉得机器人会自己说话十分神奇。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們覺得機器人會自己說話十分神奇。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen juéde jīqìrén huì zìjǐ shuōhuà shífēn shénqí.
sentences.translation: The children found it very magical that the robot could speak by itself.

sentences.chinese: 艺术教育能帮助学生提高审美能力。
sentences.traditional: 藝術教育能幫助學生提高審美能力。
sentences.pinyin: Yìshù jiàoyù néng bāngzhù xuéshēng tígāo shěnměi nénglì.
sentences.translation: Arts education can help students improve their aesthetic appreciation.

sentences.chinese: 不同文化有不同的审美标准，不能简单比较高低。
sentences.traditional: 不同文化有不同的審美標準，不能簡單比較高低。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng wénhuà yǒu bùtóng de shěnměi biāozhǔn, bù néng jiǎndān bǐjiào gāodī.
sentences.translation: Different cultures have different aesthetic standards, and they cannot simply be ranked as high or low.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影在画面和音乐上都很有审美价值。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影在畫面和音樂上都很有審美價值。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zài huàmiàn hé yīnyuè shàng dōu hěn yǒu shěnměi jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: This film has aesthetic value in both its images and its music.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车每百公里大约耗油六升。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車每百公里大約耗油六升。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē měi bǎi gōnglǐ dàyuē hàoyóu liù shēng.
sentences.translation: This car uses about six litres of fuel per hundred kilometres.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他每天喝两升左右的水。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他每天喝兩升左右的水。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān hē liǎng shēng zuǒyòu de shuǐ.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested that he drink about two litres of water every day.

sentences.chinese: 这个桶最多能装十升液体。
sentences.traditional: 這個桶最多能裝十升液體。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tǒng zuìduō néng zhuāng shí shēng yètǐ.
sentences.translation: This bucket can hold at most ten litres of liquid.

sentences.chinese: 系统会根据用户输入自动生成报告。
sentences.traditional: 系統會根據用戶輸入自動生成報告。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì gēnjù yònghù shūrù zìdòng shēngchéng bàogào.
sentences.translation: The system will automatically generate a report based on user input.

sentences.chinese: 这些图片不是人工绘制的，而是由人工智能生成的。
sentences.traditional: 這些圖片不是人工繪製的，而是由人工智能生成的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē túpiàn bú shì réngōng huìzhì de, ér shì yóu réngōng zhìnéng shēngchéng de.
sentences.translation: These pictures were not drawn by hand, but generated by artificial intelligence.

sentences.chinese: 如果数据质量不高，生成的结果也可能不可靠。
sentences.traditional: 如果數據質量不高，生成的結果也可能不可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shùjù zhìliàng bù gāo, shēngchéng de jiéguǒ yě kěnéng bù kěkào.
sentences.translation: If the data quality is not high, the generated result may also be unreliable.

sentences.chinese: 普通话有四个基本声调，读错声调可能会改变词义。
sentences.traditional: 普通話有四個基本聲調，讀錯聲調可能會改變詞義。
sentences.pinyin: Pǔtōnghuà yǒu sì ge jīběn shēngdiào, dú cuò shēngdiào kěnéng huì gǎibiàn cíyì.
sentences.translation: Mandarin has four basic tones, and reading a tone incorrectly may change the meaning of a word.

sentences.chinese: 她练习声调时，会把每个音节都录下来反复听。
sentences.traditional: 她練習聲調時，會把每個音節都錄下來反覆聽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liànxí shēngdiào shí, huì bǎ měi ge yīnjié dōu lù xiàlai fǎnfù tīng.
sentences.translation: When practising tones, she records every syllable and listens to it repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 这款学习软件能自动检测声调是否准确。
sentences.traditional: 這款學習軟件能自動檢測聲調是否準確。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xuéxí ruǎnjiàn néng zìdòng jiǎncè shēngdiào shìfǒu zhǔnquè.
sentences.translation: This learning app can automatically test whether the tones are accurate.

sentences.chinese: 这片森林经历火灾后仍然显示出强大的生命力。
sentences.traditional: 這片森林經歷火災後仍然顯示出強大的生命力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn sēnlín lìjīng huǒzāi hòu réngrán xiǎnshì chū qiángdà de shēngmìnglì.
sentences.translation: After going through a fire, this forest still showed great vitality.

sentences.chinese: 一座城市的生命力，往往来自普通人的创造和坚持。
sentences.traditional: 一座城市的生命力，往往來自普通人的創造和堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Yí zuò chéngshì de shēngmìnglì, wǎngwǎng láizì pǔtōng rén de chuàngzào hé jiānchí.
sentences.translation: The vitality of a city often comes from the creativity and persistence of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 传统手工艺如果能融入现代设计，就会重新获得生命力。
sentences.traditional: 傳統手工藝如果能融入現代設計，就會重新獲得生命力。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng shǒugōngyì rúguǒ néng róngrù xiàndài shèjì, jiù huì chóngxīn huòdé shēngmìnglì.
sentences.translation: If traditional crafts can integrate with modern design, they will regain vitality.

sentences.chinese: 过度开发会破坏当地生态，影响长期发展。
sentences.traditional: 過度開發會破壞當地生態，影響長期發展。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù kāifā huì pòhuài dāngdì shēngtài, yǐngxiǎng chángqī fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Excessive development can damage the local ecology and affect long-term development.

sentences.chinese: 学校正在建设一个小型生态园，让学生观察植物和昆虫。
sentences.traditional: 學校正在建設一個小型生態園，讓學生觀察植物和昆蟲。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhèngzài jiànshè yí ge xiǎoxíng shēngtài yuán, ràng xuéshēng guānchá zhíwù hé kūnchóng.
sentences.translation: The school is building a small ecological garden so pupils can observe plants and insects.

sentences.chinese: 政府提出绿色政策，是为了恢复河流周围的生态。
sentences.traditional: 政府提出綠色政策，是為了恢復河流周圍的生態。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tíchū lǜsè zhèngcè, shì wèile huīfù héliú zhōuwéi de shēngtài.
sentences.translation: The government proposed green policies in order to restore the ecology around the river.

sentences.chinese: 许多家庭在孩子升学前，会认真比较不同学校的课程。
sentences.traditional: 許多家庭在孩子升學前，會認真比較不同學校的課程。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō jiātíng zài háizi shēngxué qián, huì rènzhēn bǐjiào bùtóng xuéxiào de kèchéng.
sentences.translation: Before their child goes on to higher education, many families carefully compare different schools' courses.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革减轻了升学压力，也给学生更多选择。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革減輕了升學壓力，也給學生更多選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé jiǎnqīng le shēngxué yālì, yě gěi xuéshēng gèng duō xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: This reform reduced the pressure of moving on to higher education and gave students more choices.

sentences.chinese: 老师建议他根据兴趣规划升学方向，而不是只看排名。
sentences.traditional: 老師建議他根據興趣規劃升學方向，而不是只看排名。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiànyì tā gēnjù xìngqù guīhuà shēngxué fāngxiàng, ér bú shì zhǐ kàn páimíng.
sentences.translation: The teacher advised him to plan his education path according to his interests, not just rankings.

sentences.chinese: 活动结束后，工作人员把剩余物资送给了社区中心。
sentences.traditional: 活動結束後，工作人員把剩餘物資送給了社區中心。
sentences.pinyin: Huódòng jiéshù hòu, gōngzuò rényuán bǎ shèngyú wùzī sòng gěi le shèqū zhōngxīn.
sentences.translation: After the event ended, the staff sent the remaining supplies to the community centre.

sentences.chinese: 请在系统中查看账户的剩余金额，再决定是否充值。
sentences.traditional: 請在系統中查看帳戶的剩餘金額，再決定是否儲值。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài xìtǒng zhōng chákàn zhànghù de shèngyú jīn'é, zài juédìng shìfǒu chōngzhí.
sentences.translation: Please check the remaining amount in the account in the system before deciding whether to top up.

sentences.chinese: 项目组需要在本周内完成剩余任务，否则进度会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 項目組需要在本週內完成剩餘任務，否則進度會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmùzǔ xūyào zài běn zhōu nèi wánchéng shèngyú rènwu, fǒuzé jìndù huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The project team needs to complete the remaining tasks this week, otherwise progress will be affected.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷喜欢朗读古代诗词，尤其欣赏其中的节奏和意境。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺喜歡朗讀古代詩詞，尤其欣賞其中的節奏和意境。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xǐhuan lǎngdú gǔdài shīcí, yóuqí xīnshǎng qízhōng de jiézòu hé yìjìng.
sentences.translation: Grandad likes reading ancient poetry aloud and especially appreciates its rhythm and imagery.

sentences.chinese: 学习诗词不仅能扩大词汇量，也能加深对文化的理解。
sentences.traditional: 學習詩詞不僅能擴大詞彙量，也能加深對文化的理解。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí shīcí bùjǐn néng kuòdà cíhuìliàng, yě néng jiāshēn duì wénhuà de lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: Studying poetry can not only expand vocabulary, but also deepen understanding of culture.

sentences.chinese: 这档节目通过现代音乐重新演绎经典诗词。
sentences.traditional: 這檔節目通過現代音樂重新演繹經典詩詞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dàng jiémù tōngguò xiàndài yīnyuè chóngxīn yǎnyì jīngdiǎn shīcí.
sentences.translation: This programme reinterprets classic poetry through modern music.

sentences.chinese: 如果室内湿度太高，墙壁和家具都容易发霉。
sentences.traditional: 如果室內濕度太高，牆壁和傢俱都容易發霉。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shìnèi shīdù tài gāo, qiángbì hé jiājù dōu róngyì fāméi.
sentences.translation: If indoor humidity is too high, walls and furniture can easily go mouldy.

sentences.chinese: 实验室必须控制温度和湿度，确保检测结果稳定。
sentences.traditional: 實驗室必須控制溫度和濕度，確保檢測結果穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyànshì bìxū kòngzhì wēndù hé shīdù, quèbǎo jiǎncè jiéguǒ wěndìng.
sentences.translation: The laboratory must control temperature and humidity to ensure stable test results.

sentences.chinese: 这种仪器可以实时显示空气中的湿度变化。
sentences.traditional: 這種儀器可以即時顯示空氣中的濕度變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yíqì kěyǐ jíshí xiǎnshì kōngqì zhōng de shīdù biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This instrument can display changes in air humidity in real time.

sentences.chinese: 这位师父从十六岁起学习木工，如今技艺十分精湛。
sentences.traditional: 這位師父從十六歲起學習木工，如今技藝十分精湛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shīfu cóng shíliù suì qǐ xuéxí mùgōng, rújīn jìyì shífēn jīngzhàn.
sentences.translation: This master began learning carpentry at sixteen, and his skill is now extremely refined.

sentences.chinese: 徒弟第一次独立完成作品后，马上请师父点评。
sentences.traditional: 徒弟第一次獨立完成作品後，馬上請師父點評。
sentences.pinyin: Túdì dì yī cì dúlì wánchéng zuòpǐn hòu, mǎshàng qǐng shīfu diǎnpíng.
sentences.translation: After completing a piece independently for the first time, the apprentice immediately asked his master to comment on it.

sentences.chinese: 在传统行业里，师父不仅教技巧，也教做人的道理。
sentences.traditional: 在傳統行業裡，師父不僅教技巧，也教做人的道理。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chuántǒng hángyè lǐ, shīfu bùjǐn jiāo jìqiǎo, yě jiāo zuòrén de dàolǐ.
sentences.translation: In traditional trades, the master teaches not only techniques, but also principles for life.

sentences.chinese: 这首诗歌用简单的语言表达了深厚的感情。
sentences.traditional: 這首詩歌用簡單的語言表達了深厚的感情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shīgē yòng jiǎndān de yǔyán biǎodá le shēnhòu de gǎnqíng.
sentences.translation: This poem uses simple language to express deep feelings.

sentences.chinese: 现代诗歌的形式较为自由，但仍然需要清晰的节奏。
sentences.traditional: 現代詩歌的形式較為自由，但仍然需要清晰的節奏。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài shīgē de xíngshì jiàowéi zìyóu, dàn réngrán xūyào qīngxī de jiézòu.
sentences.translation: The form of modern poetry is relatively free, but it still needs a clear rhythm.

sentences.chinese: 通过诗歌朗诵，学生学会了更细腻地表达情绪。
sentences.traditional: 通過詩歌朗誦，學生學會了更細膩地表達情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò shīgē lǎngsòng, xuéshēng xuéhuì le gèng xìnì de biǎodá qíngxù.
sentences.translation: Through poetry recitation, the students learnt to express emotions more delicately.

sentences.chinese: 纪录片展示了狮子在草原上合作捕猎的过程。
sentences.traditional: 紀錄片展示了獅子在草原上合作捕獵的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Jìlùpiàn zhǎnshì le shīzi zài cǎoyuán shàng hézuò bǔliè de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: The documentary showed the process of lions hunting together on the grassland.

sentences.chinese: 孩子第一次在动物园看见狮子时，既兴奋又有点害怕。
sentences.traditional: 孩子第一次在動物園看見獅子時，既興奮又有點害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi dì yī cì zài dòngwùyuán kànjiàn shīzi shí, jì xīngfèn yòu yǒudiǎn hàipà.
sentences.translation: When the child saw a lion at the zoo for the first time, he was both excited and a little scared.

sentences.chinese: 这座雕像把狮子的力量和王者气质表现得很生动。
sentences.traditional: 這座雕像把獅子的力量和王者氣質表現得很生動。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò diāoxiàng bǎ shīzi de lìliàng hé wángzhě qìzhì biǎoxiàn de hěn shēngdòng.
sentences.translation: This statue vividly expresses the strength and kingly temperament of a lion.

sentences.chinese: 他自幼识字不多，却凭经验把生意做得很稳。
sentences.traditional: 他自幼識字不多，卻憑經驗把生意做得很穩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zìyòu shízì bù duō, què píng jīngyàn bǎ shēngyì zuò de hěn wěn.
sentences.translation: He did not know many characters from childhood, yet he ran the business steadily through experience.

sentences.chinese: 初到异乡时，他只识几个当地朋友，生活并不容易。
sentences.traditional: 初到異鄉時，他只識幾個當地朋友，生活並不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Chū dào yìxiāng shí, tā zhǐ shí jǐ ge dāngdì péngyou, shēnghuó bìng bù róngyì.
sentences.translation: When he first arrived in a strange place, he knew only a few local friends, so life was not easy.

sentences.chinese: 这位老人识大局，关键时刻愿意作出让步。
sentences.traditional: 這位老人識大局，關鍵時刻願意作出讓步。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén shí dàjú, guānjiàn shíkè yuànyì zuòchū ràngbù.
sentences.translation: This older man understands the overall situation and is willing to compromise at crucial moments.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把地上的卡片拾起来，交还给老师。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把地上的卡片拾起來，交還給老師。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ dìshang de kǎpiàn shí qǐlai, jiāohuán gěi lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: The child picked up the card from the floor and returned it to the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者沿着海岸拾垃圾，记录下污染的来源。
sentences.traditional: 志願者沿著海岸拾垃圾，記錄下污染的來源。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě yánzhe hǎi'àn shí lājī, jìlù xià wūrǎn de láiyuán.
sentences.translation: Volunteers picked up rubbish along the coast and recorded the sources of pollution.

sentences.chinese: 他在旧书摊上拾到一本有价值的笔记。
sentences.traditional: 他在舊書攤上拾到一本有價值的筆記。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jiù shūtān shang shí dào yì běn yǒu jiàzhí de bǐjì.
sentences.translation: He picked up a valuable notebook at a second-hand book stall.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统能识别车辆牌照，并自动记录进出时间。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統能識別車輛牌照，並自動記錄進出時間。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng néng shíbié chēliàng páizhào, bìng zìdòng jìlù jìnchū shíjiān.
sentences.translation: This system can identify vehicle number plates and automatically record entry and exit times.

sentences.chinese: 阅读新闻时，要学会识别事实和观点。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀新聞時，要學會識別事實和觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú xīnwén shí, yào xuéhuì shíbié shìshí hé guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: When reading the news, you need to learn how to distinguish facts from opinions.

sentences.chinese: 医生通过检查结果识别出早期风险。
sentences.traditional: 醫生通過檢查結果識別出早期風險。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngguò jiǎnchá jiéguǒ shíbié chū zǎoqī fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The doctor identified early risks through the examination results.

sentences.chinese: 那段在乡下生活的时光，后来成了他写作的重要素材。
sentences.traditional: 那段在鄉下生活的時光，後來成了他寫作的重要素材。
sentences.pinyin: Nà duàn zài xiāngxià shēnghuó de shíguāng, hòulái chéng le tā xiězuò de zhòngyào sùcái.
sentences.translation: That period of living in the countryside later became important material for his writing.

sentences.chinese: 孩子长大以后，父母才发现陪伴的时光最珍贵。
sentences.traditional: 孩子長大以後，父母才發現陪伴的時光最珍貴。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zhǎngdà yǐhòu, fùmǔ cái fāxiàn péibàn de shíguāng zuì zhēnguì.
sentences.translation: Only after children grow up do parents realise that the time spent with them is most precious.

sentences.chinese: 忙碌的工作让他很少有安静读书的时光。
sentences.traditional: 忙碌的工作讓他很少有安靜讀書的時光。
sentences.pinyin: Mánglù de gōngzuò ràng tā hěn shǎo yǒu ānjìng dúshū de shíguāng.
sentences.translation: His busy work left him with little quiet time for reading.

sentences.chinese: 面对调查，他终于说了实话，承认数据有误。
sentences.traditional: 面對調查，他終於說了實話，承認數據有誤。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì diàochá, tā zhōngyú shuō le shíhuà, chéngrèn shùjù yǒu wù.
sentences.translation: Facing the investigation, he finally told the truth and admitted there was an error in the data.

sentences.chinese: 这听起来有些直接，但我只是想讲实话。
sentences.traditional: 這聽起來有些直接，但我只是想講實話。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tīng qǐlai yǒuxiē zhíjiē, dàn wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng jiǎng shíhuà.
sentences.translation: This may sound a little direct, but I just want to tell the truth.

sentences.chinese: 如果团队内部连实话都不能说，问题就很难解决。
sentences.traditional: 如果團隊內部連實話都不能說，問題就很難解決。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tuánduì nèibù lián shíhuà dōu bù néng shuō, wèntí jiù hěn nán jiějué.
sentences.translation: If even the truth cannot be spoken within the team, the problem will be hard to solve.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐馆价格不高，菜量又足，特别实惠。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐館價格不高，菜量又足，特別實惠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānguǎn jiàgé bù gāo, cài liàng yòu zú, tèbié shíhuì.
sentences.translation: This restaurant is not expensive, the portions are generous, and it is especially good value.

sentences.chinese: 促销活动不能只看折扣，还要看是否真正实惠。
sentences.traditional: 促銷活動不能只看折扣，還要看是否真正實惠。
sentences.pinyin: Cùxiāo huódòng bù néng zhǐ kàn zhékòu, hái yào kàn shìfǒu zhēnzhèng shíhuì.
sentences.translation: For a promotion, you cannot only look at the discount; you also need to see whether it is genuinely good value.

sentences.chinese: 对普通家庭来说，政策带来的实惠比口号更重要。
sentences.traditional: 對普通家庭來說，政策帶來的實惠比口號更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Duì pǔtōng jiātíng lái shuō, zhèngcè dài lái de shíhuì bǐ kǒuhào gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: For ordinary families, the tangible benefits brought by a policy matter more than slogans.

sentences.chinese: 公司选择在市场稳定后推出新产品，是为了等待更好的时机。
sentences.traditional: 公司選擇在市場穩定後推出新產品，是為了等待更好的時機。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xuǎnzé zài shìchǎng wěndìng hòu tuīchū xīn chǎnpǐn, shì wèile děngdài gèng hǎo de shíjī.
sentences.translation: The company chose to launch the new product after the market stabilised in order to wait for a better opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 谈判的时机如果掌握不好，双方都可能失去耐心。
sentences.traditional: 談判的時機如果掌握不好，雙方都可能失去耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Tánpàn de shíjī rúguǒ zhǎngwò bù hǎo, shuāngfāng dōu kěnéng shīqù nàixīn.
sentences.translation: If the timing of the negotiations is not handled well, both sides may lose patience.

sentences.chinese: 他没有急着表态，而是在合适的时机提出建议。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有急著表態，而是在合適的時機提出建議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu jízhe biǎotài, ér shì zài héshì de shíjī tíchū jiànyì.
sentences.translation: He did not rush to state his position, but offered a suggestion at the right moment.

sentences.chinese: 这位设计师把传统元素和现代时尚结合得很自然。
sentences.traditional: 這位設計師把傳統元素和現代時尚結合得很自然。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèjìshī bǎ chuántǒng yuánsù hé xiàndài shíshàng jiéhé de hěn zìrán.
sentences.translation: This designer combines traditional elements and modern fashion very naturally.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人追求时尚，但也越来越重视环保材料。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人追求時尚，但也越來越重視環保材料。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén zhuīqiú shíshàng, dàn yě yuè lái yuè zhòngshì huánbǎo cáiliào.
sentences.translation: Young people pursue fashion, but they also increasingly value environmentally friendly materials.

sentences.chinese: 她的穿着不算夸张，却显得很有时尚感。
sentences.traditional: 她的穿著不算誇張，卻顯得很有時尚感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de chuānzhuó bú suàn kuāzhāng, què xiǎnde hěn yǒu shíshàng gǎn.
sentences.translation: Her clothing is not exaggerated, yet it looks very stylish.

sentences.chinese: 平台会实时更新路况，帮助司机避开拥堵。
sentences.traditional: 平臺會實時更新路況，幫助司機避開擁堵。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái huì shíshí gēngxīn lùkuàng, bāngzhù sījī bì kāi yōngdǔ.
sentences.translation: The platform updates road conditions in real time, helping drivers avoid congestion.

sentences.chinese: 会议期间，字幕系统可以实时显示发言内容。
sentences.traditional: 會議期間，字幕系統可以實時顯示發言內容。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì qījiān, zìmù xìtǒng kěyǐ shíshí xiǎnshì fāyán nèiróng.
sentences.translation: During the meeting, the caption system can display speech content in real time.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证安全，工作人员需要实时监测设备温度。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證安全，工作人員需要實時監測設備溫度。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng ānquán, gōngzuò rényuán xūyào shíshí jiāncè shèbèi wēndù.
sentences.translation: To ensure safety, staff need to monitor the equipment temperature in real time.

sentences.chinese: 高铁在平稳路段的时速可以超过三百公里。
sentences.traditional: 高鐵在平穩路段的時速可以超過三百公里。
sentences.pinyin: Gāotiě zài píngwěn lùduàn de shísù kěyǐ chāoguò sānbǎi gōnglǐ.
sentences.translation: On stable sections of track, high-speed trains can exceed 300 kilometres per hour.

sentences.chinese: 车辆通过学校附近时，时速必须降到规定范围内。
sentences.traditional: 車輛通過學校附近時，時速必須降到規定範圍內。
sentences.pinyin: Chēliàng tōngguò xuéxiào fùjìn shí, shísù bìxū jiàng dào guīdìng fànwéi nèi.
sentences.translation: When vehicles pass near a school, their speed per hour must drop within the required range.

sentences.chinese: 报告显示，事故发生前列车时速明显偏高。
sentences.traditional: 報告顯示，事故發生前列車時速明顯偏高。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào xiǎnshì, shìgù fāshēng qián lièchē shísù míngxiǎn piān gāo.
sentences.translation: The report showed that before the accident, the train's speed was clearly too high.

sentences.chinese: 全球石油价格波动时，许多国家会重新评估能源战略。
sentences.traditional: 全球石油價格波動時，許多國家會重新評估能源戰略。
sentences.pinyin: Quánqiú shíyóu jiàgé bōdòng shí, xǔduō guójiā huì chóngxīn pínggū néngyuán zhànlüè.
sentences.translation: When global petroleum prices fluctuate, many countries reassess their energy strategies.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市过去依赖石油工业，如今正努力发展清洁能源。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市過去依賴石油工業，如今正努力發展清潔能源。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì guòqù yīlài shíyóu gōngyè, rújīn zhèng nǔlì fāzhǎn qīngjié néngyuán.
sentences.translation: This city used to rely on the petroleum industry and is now working hard to develop clean energy.

sentences.chinese: 石油泄漏会对海洋生态造成长期影响。
sentences.traditional: 石油洩漏會對海洋生態造成長期影響。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyóu xièlòu huì duì hǎiyáng shēngtài zàochéng chángqī yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: An oil leak can cause long-term effects on the marine ecosystem.

sentences.chinese: 连续加班让他食欲下降，医生建议他先调整作息。
sentences.traditional: 連續加班讓他食慾下降，醫生建議他先調整作息。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù jiābān ràng tā shíyù xiàjiàng, yīshēng jiànyì tā xiān tiáozhěng zuòxī.
sentences.translation: Working overtime continuously reduced his appetite, and the doctor advised him to adjust his routine first.

sentences.chinese: 这道清淡的汤很适合刚恢复食欲的病人。
sentences.traditional: 這道清淡的湯很適合剛恢復食慾的病人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào qīngdàn de tāng hěn shìhé gāng huīfù shíyù de bìngrén.
sentences.translation: This light soup is very suitable for patients who have just regained their appetite.

sentences.chinese: 孩子突然没有食欲，家长不应只责怪他挑食。
sentences.traditional: 孩子突然沒有食慾，家長不應只責怪他挑食。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tūrán méiyǒu shíyù, jiāzhǎng bù yīng zhǐ zéguài tā tiāoshí.
sentences.translation: If a child suddenly has no appetite, parents should not simply blame them for being picky.

sentences.chinese: 双方意见看似不同，实质上都希望降低风险。
sentences.traditional: 雙方意見看似不同，實質上都希望降低風險。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng yìjiàn kànsì bùtóng, shízhì shang dōu xīwàng jiàngdī fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The two sides’ opinions seem different, but in essence both hope to reduce risk.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革不能停留在口号上，必须产生实质效果。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革不能停留在口號上，必須產生實質效果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé bù néng tíngliú zài kǒuhào shang, bìxū chǎnshēng shízhì xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: This reform cannot remain at the level of slogans; it must produce substantial results.

sentences.chinese: 报告揭示了问题的实质，而不仅是列出现象。
sentences.traditional: 報告揭示了問題的實質，而不僅是列出現象。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào jiēshì le wèntí de shízhì, ér bùjǐn shì lièchū xiànxiàng.
sentences.translation: The report revealed the essence of the problem, rather than merely listing phenomena.

sentences.chinese: 这位年轻导演经验不多，但创作热情十足。
sentences.traditional: 這位年輕導演經驗不多，但創作熱情十足。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng dǎoyǎn jīngyàn bù duō, dàn chuàngzuò rèqíng shízú.
sentences.translation: This young director has little experience, but is full of creative enthusiasm.

sentences.chinese: 他的语气信心十足，让团队成员也安定下来。
sentences.traditional: 他的語氣信心十足，讓團隊成員也安定下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǔqì xìnxīn shízú, ràng tuánduì chéngyuán yě āndìng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: His tone was full of confidence, which also reassured the team members.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同条款清楚，诚意十足，值得认真考虑。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同條款清楚，誠意十足，值得認真考慮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong tiáokuǎn qīngchu, chéngyì shízú, zhídé rènzhēn kǎolǜ.
sentences.translation: The contract terms are clear and show real sincerity, so it is worth serious consideration.

sentences.chinese: 门被卡住了，他使劲推了几次才打开。
sentences.traditional: 門被卡住了，他使勁推了幾次才打開。
sentences.pinyin: Mén bèi qiǎ zhù le, tā shǐjìn tuī le jǐ cì cái dǎkāi.
sentences.translation: The door was stuck; he had to push hard several times before it opened.

sentences.chinese: 别只顾使劲工作，也要给身体留出恢复的时间。
sentences.traditional: 別只顧使勁工作，也要給身體留出恢復的時間。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhǐ gù shǐjìn gōngzuò, yě yào gěi shēntǐ liúchū huīfù de shíjiān.
sentences.translation: Do not focus only on working hard; you also need to leave your body time to recover.

sentences.chinese: 孩子使劲拉着妈妈的手，想快点穿过人群。
sentences.traditional: 孩子使勁拉著媽媽的手，想快點穿過人群。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi shǐjìn lāzhe māma de shǒu, xiǎng kuài diǎn chuānguò rénqún.
sentences.translation: The child pulled hard on his mother’s hand, wanting to get through the crowd quickly.

sentences.chinese: 那名士兵在救灾现场连续工作了十几个小时。
sentences.traditional: 那名士兵在救災現場連續工作了十幾個小時。
sentences.pinyin: Nà míng shìbīng zài jiùzāi xiànchǎng liánxù gōngzuò le shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.translation: That soldier worked at the disaster-relief site for more than ten hours continuously.

sentences.chinese: 士兵必须严格遵守纪律，不能擅自行动。
sentences.traditional: 士兵必須嚴格遵守紀律，不能擅自行動。
sentences.pinyin: Shìbīng bìxū yángé zūnshǒu jìlǜ, bù néng shànzì xíngdòng.
sentences.translation: Soldiers must strictly observe discipline and must not act without authorisation.

sentences.chinese: 电影没有美化战争，而是描写了普通士兵的恐惧与责任。
sentences.traditional: 電影沒有美化戰爭，而是描寫了普通士兵的恐懼與責任。
sentences.pinyin: Diànyǐng méiyǒu měihuà zhànzhēng, ér shì miáoxiě le pǔtōng shìbīng de kǒngjù yǔ zérèn.
sentences.translation: The film did not glorify war, but described the fear and responsibility of ordinary soldiers.

sentences.chinese: 适度运动有助于减压，但过量训练反而会造成疲劳。
sentences.traditional: 適度運動有助於減壓，但過量訓練反而會造成疲勞。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdù yùndòng yǒuzhù yú jiǎnyā, dàn guòliàng xùnliàn fǎn'ér huì zàochéng píláo.
sentences.translation: Moderate exercise helps reduce stress, but excessive training can instead cause fatigue.

sentences.chinese: 政府应对网络平台进行适度监管，保护用户权益。
sentences.traditional: 政府應對網絡平臺進行適度監管，保護用戶權益。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yīng duì wǎngluò píngtái jìnxíng shìdù jiānguǎn, bǎohù yònghù quányì.
sentences.translation: The government should carry out moderate regulation of online platforms to protect users’ rights and interests.

sentences.chinese: 表达不满是合理的，但语气要适度，避免激化矛盾。
sentences.traditional: 表達不滿是合理的，但語氣要適度，避免激化矛盾。
sentences.pinyin: Biǎodá bùmǎn shì hélǐ de, dàn yǔqì yào shìdù, bìmiǎn jīhuà máodùn.
sentences.translation: It is reasonable to express dissatisfaction, but the tone should be moderate to avoid intensifying conflict.

sentences.chinese: 老师先示范了一遍实验流程，再让学生自己操作。
sentences.traditional: 老師先示範了一遍實驗流程，再讓學生自己操作。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān shìfàn le yí biàn shíyàn liúchéng, zài ràng xuésheng zìjǐ cāozuò.
sentences.translation: The teacher first demonstrated the experiment procedure once, then let the students operate by themselves.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业的节能方案可以为同行示范。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業的節能方案可以為同行示範。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè de jiénéng fāng'àn kěyǐ wèi tóngháng shìfàn.
sentences.translation: This company’s energy-saving plan can serve as a demonstration for others in the industry.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者通过现场示范，教老人如何使用手机支付。
sentences.traditional: 志願者通過現場示範，教老人如何使用手機支付。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě tōngguò xiànchǎng shìfàn, jiāo lǎorén rúhé shǐyòng shǒujī zhīfù.
sentences.translation: Volunteers used on-site demonstrations to teach older people how to use mobile payments.

sentences.chinese: 改革释放了市场活力，也带来了新的监管挑战。
sentences.traditional: 改革釋放了市場活力，也帶來了新的監管挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎigé shìfàng le shìchǎng huólì, yě dàilái le xīn de jiānguǎn tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: The reform released market vitality, but also brought new regulatory challenges.

sentences.chinese: 长期压抑情绪会影响身心健康，应该找到合适的释放方式。
sentences.traditional: 長期壓抑情緒會影響身心健康，應該找到合適的釋放方式。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī yāyì qíngxù huì yǐngxiǎng shēnxīn jiànkāng, yīnggāi zhǎodào héshì de shìfàng fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Long-term suppression of emotions can affect physical and mental health, so one should find a suitable way to release them.

sentences.chinese: 工厂必须控制废气释放，避免加重空气污染。
sentences.traditional: 工廠必須控制廢氣釋放，避免加重空氣污染。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng bìxū kòngzhì fèiqì shìfàng, bìmiǎn jiāzhòng kōngqì wūrǎn.
sentences.translation: Factories must control the release of exhaust gases to avoid worsening air pollution.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，负责人事后才承认安全培训不足。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，負責人事後才承認安全培訓不足。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, fùzérén shìhòu cái chéngrèn ānquán péixùn bùzú.
sentences.translation: After the accident happened, the person in charge admitted only afterwards that safety training had been insufficient.

sentences.chinese: 与其事后道歉，不如提前把风险说明清楚。
sentences.traditional: 與其事後道歉，不如提前把風險說明清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí shìhòu dàoqiàn, bùrú tíqián bǎ fēngxiǎn shuōmíng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Rather than apologising afterwards, it is better to explain the risks clearly in advance.

sentences.chinese: 会议的关键决定要及时记录，避免事后产生纠纷。
sentences.traditional: 會議的關鍵決定要及時記錄，避免事後產生糾紛。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì de guānjiàn juédìng yào jíshí jìlù, bìmiǎn shìhòu chǎnshēng jiūfēn.
sentences.translation: Key decisions from the meeting should be recorded promptly to avoid disputes afterwards.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片通过强烈的视觉对比，表现了城市发展的速度。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片通過強烈的視覺對比，表現了城市發展的速度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tōngguò qiángliè de shìjué duìbǐ, biǎoxiàn le chéngshì fāzhǎn de sùdù.
sentences.translation: This documentary uses strong visual contrasts to show the speed of urban development.

sentences.chinese: 长时间盯着屏幕会造成视觉疲劳，工作时应定期休息。
sentences.traditional: 長時間盯著屏幕會造成視覺疲勞，工作時應定期休息。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān dīngzhe píngmù huì zàochéng shìjué píláo, gōngzuò shí yīng dìngqī xiūxi.
sentences.translation: Staring at a screen for a long time can cause visual fatigue, so one should rest regularly while working.

sentences.chinese: 设计师调整了页面的颜色和布局，使视觉重点更加清楚。
sentences.traditional: 設計師調整了頁面的顏色和佈局，使視覺重點更加清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī tiáozhěng le yèmiàn de yánsè hé bùjú, shǐ shìjué zhòngdiǎn gèngjiā qīngchu.
sentences.translation: The designer adjusted the page colours and layout to make the visual focus clearer.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区的地方势力复杂，改革推进得并不顺利。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區的地方勢力複雜，改革推進得並不順利。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de dìfāng shìlì fùzá, gǎigé tuījìn de bìng bù shùnlì.
sentences.translation: Local power structures in this region are complicated, so the reform has not advanced smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 他不愿依靠任何势力，只想凭自己的能力获得职位。
sentences.traditional: 他不願依靠任何勢力，只想憑自己的能力獲得職位。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù yuàn yīkào rènhé shìlì, zhǐ xiǎng píng zìjǐ de nénglì huòdé zhíwèi.
sentences.translation: He is unwilling to rely on any influence and wants to obtain the position through his own ability.

sentences.chinese: 媒体曝光后，隐藏在行业背后的利益势力逐渐浮出水面。
sentences.traditional: 媒體曝光後，隱藏在行業背後的利益勢力逐漸浮出水面。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ pùguāng hòu, yǐncáng zài hángyè bèihòu de lìyì shìlì zhújiàn fúchū shuǐmiàn.
sentences.translation: After the media exposure, the interest groups hidden behind the industry gradually came to light.

sentences.chinese: 儿童视力下降往往与户外活动不足和用眼时间过长有关。
sentences.traditional: 兒童視力下降往往與戶外活動不足和用眼時間過長有關。
sentences.pinyin: Értóng shìlì xiàjiàng wǎngwǎng yǔ hùwài huódòng bùzú hé yòngyǎn shíjiān guò cháng yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: A decline in children’s eyesight is often related to insufficient outdoor activity and excessive time using their eyes.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他每半年检查一次视力，及时调整眼镜度数。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他每半年檢查一次視力，及時調整眼鏡度數。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měi bànnián jiǎnchá yí cì shìlì, jíshí tiáozhěng yǎnjìng dùshù.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to have his eyesight checked every six months and adjust his glasses prescription in time.

sentences.chinese: 即使手术很成功，患者的视力恢复也需要一段时间。
sentences.traditional: 即使手術很成功，患者的視力恢復也需要一段時間。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ shǒushù hěn chénggōng, huànzhě de shìlì huīfù yě xūyào yí duàn shíjiān.
sentences.translation: Even if the operation is successful, the patient’s eyesight will still need some time to recover.

sentences.chinese: 公司试图通过降价吸引顾客，但效果并不明显。
sentences.traditional: 公司試圖通過降價吸引顧客，但效果並不明顯。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī shìtú tōngguò jiàngjià xīyǐn gùkè, dàn xiàoguǒ bìng bù míngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The company attempted to attract customers by lowering prices, but the effect was not obvious.

sentences.chinese: 他试图解释自己的决定，却发现大家已经失去了耐心。
sentences.traditional: 他試圖解釋自己的決定，卻發現大家已經失去了耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú jiěshì zìjǐ de juédìng, què fāxiàn dàjiā yǐjīng shīqù le nàixīn.
sentences.translation: He tried to explain his decision, but found that everyone had already lost patience.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员试图找出情绪与睡眠质量之间的关系。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員試圖找出情緒與睡眠質量之間的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán shìtú zhǎochū qíngxù yǔ shuìmián zhìliàng zhījiān de guānxì.
sentences.translation: Researchers attempted to identify the relationship between emotions and sleep quality.

sentences.chinese: 她负责处理公司的日常事务，工作内容非常繁杂。
sentences.traditional: 她負責處理公司的日常事務，工作內容非常繁雜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fùzé chǔlǐ gōngsī de rìcháng shìwù, gōngzuò nèiróng fēicháng fánzá.
sentences.translation: She is responsible for handling the company’s daily affairs, and the work is very complicated.

sentences.chinese: 在重大事务上，领导不能只听少数人的意见。
sentences.traditional: 在重大事務上，領導不能只聽少數人的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhòngdà shìwù shàng, lǐngdǎo bù néng zhǐ tīng shǎoshù rén de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: On major affairs, leaders cannot listen only to the opinions of a small number of people.

sentences.chinese: 因为私人事务太多，他暂时无法参加这个项目。
sentences.traditional: 因為私人事務太多，他暫時無法參加這個項目。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi sīrén shìwù tài duō, tā zànshí wúfǎ cānjiā zhège xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: Because he has too many private matters, he is temporarily unable to take part in this project.

sentences.chinese: 请在会议开始前确认所有事项，避免临时出现混乱。
sentences.traditional: 請在會議開始前確認所有事項，避免臨時出現混亂。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài huìyì kāishǐ qián quèrèn suǒyǒu shìxiàng, bìmiǎn línshí chūxiàn hùnluàn.
sentences.translation: Please confirm all items before the meeting starts to avoid last-minute confusion.

sentences.chinese: 合同中的保密事项必须写得清楚，不能留下模糊空间。
sentences.traditional: 合同中的保密事項必須寫得清楚，不能留下模糊空間。
sentences.pinyin: Hétóng zhōng de bǎomì shìxiàng bìxū xiě de qīngchu, bù néng liúxià móhu kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: The confidentiality items in the contract must be written clearly, leaving no vague areas.

sentences.chinese: 这些注意事项看似简单，却关系到实验结果的可靠性。
sentences.traditional: 這些注意事項看似簡單，卻關係到實驗結果的可靠性。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhùyì shìxiàng kànsì jiǎndān, què guānxì dào shíyàn jiéguǒ de kěkào xìng.
sentences.translation: These points for attention seem simple, but they affect the reliability of the experimental results.

sentences.chinese: 这片土地排水良好，很适宜种植薰衣草和其他耐旱植物。
sentences.traditional: 這片土地排水良好，很適宜種植薰衣草和其他耐旱植物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔdì páishuǐ liánghǎo, hěn shìyí zhòngzhí xūnyīcǎo hé qítā nàihàn zhíwù.
sentences.translation: This plot of land drains well and is very suitable for planting lavender and other drought-tolerant plants.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告的语气不太适宜，容易让客户产生误解。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告的語氣不太適宜，容易讓客戶產生誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de yǔqì bù tài shìyí, róngyì ràng kèhù chǎnshēng wùjiě.
sentences.translation: The tone of this report is not very appropriate and may easily cause clients to misunderstand.

sentences.chinese: 儿童节目应选择适宜的内容，既有趣又不过分刺激。
sentences.traditional: 兒童節目應選擇適宜的內容，既有趣又不過分刺激。
sentences.pinyin: Értóng jiémù yīng xuǎnzé shìyí de nèiróng, jì yǒuqù yòu bù guòfèn cìjī.
sentences.translation: Children’s programmes should choose appropriate content that is interesting without being overly stimulating.

sentences.chinese: 他收藏了许多老照片，记录了这座城市几十年的变化。
sentences.traditional: 他收藏了許多老照片，記錄了這座城市幾十年的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōucáng le xǔduō lǎo zhàopiàn, jìlù le zhè zuò chéngshì jǐ shí nián de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: He has collected many old photographs, recording several decades of changes in this city.

sentences.chinese: 与其盲目收藏名牌，不如先了解它背后的历史和价值。
sentences.traditional: 與其盲目收藏名牌，不如先了解它背後的歷史和價值。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí mángmù shōucáng míngpái, bùrú xiān liǎojiě tā bèihòu de lìshǐ hé jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Rather than blindly collecting famous brands, it is better to first understand their history and value.

sentences.chinese: 图书馆开始收藏本地作家的手稿，方便研究者查阅。
sentences.traditional: 圖書館開始收藏本地作家的手稿，方便研究者查閱。
sentences.pinyin: Túshūguǎn kāishǐ shōucáng běndì zuòjiā de shǒugǎo, fāngbiàn yánjiūzhě cháyuè.
sentences.translation: The library has begun collecting manuscripts by local writers for researchers to consult.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司计划收购一家小型科技企业，扩大自己的研发团队。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司計劃收購一家小型科技企業，擴大自己的研發團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìhuà shōugòu yì jiā xiǎoxíng kējì qǐyè, kuòdà zìjǐ de yánfā tuánduì.
sentences.translation: This company plans to acquire a small technology firm in order to expand its own research and development team.

sentences.chinese: 收购完成后，原来的品牌仍然会独立运营。
sentences.traditional: 收購完成後，原來的品牌仍然會獨立運營。
sentences.pinyin: Shōugòu wánchéng hòu, yuánlái de pǐnpái réngrán huì dúlì yùnyíng.
sentences.translation: After the acquisition is completed, the original brand will still operate independently.

sentences.chinese: 农民希望政府能提高粮食收购价格，保障基本收入。
sentences.traditional: 農民希望政府能提高糧食收購價格，保障基本收入。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngmín xīwàng zhèngfǔ néng tígāo liángshi shōugòu jiàgé, bǎozhàng jīběn shōurù.
sentences.translation: Farmers hope the government can raise grain purchase prices and protect their basic income.

sentences.chinese: 平台不得在用户不知情的情况下收取额外费用。
sentences.traditional: 平臺不得在用戶不知情的情況下收取額外費用。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái bùdé zài yònghù bù zhīqíng de qíngkuàng xià shōuqǔ éwài fèiyòng.
sentences.translation: Platforms must not collect extra fees without users being aware of it.

sentences.chinese: 学校只收取必要的材料费，并会公开具体用途。
sentences.traditional: 學校只收取必要的材料費，並會公開具體用途。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhǐ shōuqǔ bìyào de cáiliào fèi, bìng huì gōngkāi jùtǐ yòngtú.
sentences.translation: The school only collects necessary material fees and will make their specific use public.

sentences.chinese: 快递员上门时会收取包裹，并在系统里更新状态。
sentences.traditional: 快遞員上門時會收取包裹，並在系統裡更新狀態。
sentences.pinyin: Kuàidìyuán shàngmén shí huì shōuqǔ bāoguǒ, bìng zài xìtǒng lǐ gēngxīn zhuàngtài.
sentences.translation: The courier will collect the parcel when visiting and update its status in the system.

sentences.chinese: 这项投资短期内收益不高，但风险相对可控。
sentences.traditional: 這項投資短期內收益不高，但風險相對可控。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng tóuzī duǎnqī nèi shōuyì bù gāo, dàn fēngxiǎn xiāngduì kěkòng.
sentences.translation: This investment does not bring high returns in the short term, but the risk is relatively controllable.

sentences.chinese: 培训带来的收益不一定立刻体现在销售数字上。
sentences.traditional: 培訓帶來的收益不一定立刻體現在銷售數字上。
sentences.pinyin: Péixùn dài lái de shōuyì bù yídìng lìkè tǐxiàn zài xiāoshòu shùzì shàng.
sentences.translation: The benefits brought by training are not necessarily reflected immediately in sales figures.

sentences.chinese: 如果只看眼前收益，企业很容易忽视长期发展。
sentences.traditional: 如果只看眼前收益，企業很容易忽視長期發展。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ kàn yǎnqián shōuyì, qǐyè hěn róngyì hūshì chángqī fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: If a company only looks at immediate gains, it can easily neglect long-term development.

sentences.chinese: 连续搬了一下午箱子，他的手臂酸得几乎抬不起来。
sentences.traditional: 連續搬了一下午箱子，他的手臂酸得幾乎抬不起來。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù bān le yí xiàwǔ xiāngzi, tā de shǒubì suān de jīhū tái bu qǐlái.
sentences.translation: After carrying boxes all afternoon, his arms were so sore that he could hardly lift them.

sentences.chinese: 护士轻轻托住病人的手臂，帮他慢慢坐起来。
sentences.traditional: 護士輕輕托住病人的手臂，幫他慢慢坐起來。
sentences.pinyin: Hùshi qīngqīng tuō zhù bìngrén de shǒubì, bāng tā mànmàn zuò qǐlái.
sentences.translation: The nurse gently supported the patient’s arm and helped him sit up slowly.

sentences.chinese: 长期伏案工作的人，肩膀和手臂都容易感到僵硬。
sentences.traditional: 長期伏案工作的人，肩膀和手臂都容易感到僵硬。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī fú'àn gōngzuò de rén, jiānbǎng hé shǒubì dōu róngyì gǎndào jiāngyìng.
sentences.translation: People who work at a desk for a long time often feel stiffness in their shoulders and arms.

sentences.chinese: 这位导演的叙事手法很特别，观众需要耐心看完。
sentences.traditional: 這位導演的敘事手法很特別，觀眾需要耐心看完。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi dǎoyǎn de xùshì shǒufǎ hěn tèbié, guānzhòng xūyào nàixīn kàn wán.
sentences.translation: This director’s narrative technique is very unusual, so viewers need patience to watch it through.

sentences.chinese: 警方认为骗子的手法并不新，只是包装得更加专业。
sentences.traditional: 警方認為騙子的手法並不新，只是包裝得更加專業。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng rènwéi piànzi de shǒufǎ bìng bù xīn, zhǐshì bāozhuāng de gèngjiā zhuānyè.
sentences.translation: The police believe the fraudster’s methods are not new; they are just packaged more professionally.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章采用对比的手法，突出两种制度的差异。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章採用對比的手法，突出兩種制度的差異。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng cǎiyòng duìbǐ de shǒufǎ, tūchū liǎng zhǒng zhìdù de chāyì.
sentences.translation: This article uses contrast as a technique to highlight the differences between the two systems.

sentences.chinese: 他做了一个安静的手势，示意大家不要打断发言人。
sentences.traditional: 他做了一個安靜的手勢，示意大家不要打斷發言人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò le yí ge ānjìng de shǒushì, shìyì dàjiā bú yào dǎduàn fāyánrén.
sentences.translation: He made a quiet gesture to indicate that everyone should not interrupt the speaker.

sentences.chinese: 在国际会议上，有些手势可能被不同文化误解。
sentences.traditional: 在國際會議上，有些手勢可能被不同文化誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guójì huìyì shàng, yǒuxiē shǒushì kěnéng bèi bùtóng wénhuà wùjiě.
sentences.translation: At international meetings, some gestures may be misunderstood by different cultures.

sentences.chinese: 老师用简单的手势帮助学生理解声调变化。
sentences.traditional: 老師用簡單的手勢幫助學生理解聲調變化。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng jiǎndān de shǒushì bāngzhù xuésheng lǐjiě shēngdiào biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The teacher used simple gestures to help the students understand tone changes.

sentences.chinese: 发生事故后，首要任务是确认人员是否安全。
sentences.traditional: 發生事故後，首要任務是確認人員是否安全。
sentences.pinyin: Fāshēng shìgù hòu, shǒuyào rènwu shì quèrèn rényuán shìfǒu ānquán.
sentences.translation: After an accident, the primary task is to confirm whether people are safe.

sentences.chinese: 对这家医院来说，提高服务质量是首要目标。
sentences.traditional: 對這家醫院來說，提高服務質量是首要目標。
sentences.pinyin: Duì zhè jiā yīyuàn lái shuō, tígāo fúwù zhìliàng shì shǒuyào mùbiāo.
sentences.translation: For this hospital, improving service quality is the primary goal.

sentences.chinese: 改革的首要原则是公开透明，而不是追求速度。
sentences.traditional: 改革的首要原則是公開透明，而不是追求速度。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎigé de shǒuyào yuánzé shì gōngkāi tòumíng, ér bú shì zhuīqiú sùdù.
sentences.translation: The chief principle of the reform is openness and transparency, not the pursuit of speed.

sentences.chinese: 正确保养可以延长机器的寿命，减少维修成本。
sentences.traditional: 正確保養可以延長機器的壽命，減少維修成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngquè bǎoyǎng kěyǐ yáncháng jīqì de shòumìng, jiǎnshǎo wéixiū chéngběn.
sentences.translation: Proper maintenance can extend a machine’s lifespan and reduce repair costs.

sentences.chinese: 这种电池的寿命受温度和使用频率影响很大。
sentences.traditional: 這種電池的壽命受溫度和使用頻率影響很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng diànchí de shòumìng shòu wēndù hé shǐyòng pínlǜ yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The lifespan of this kind of battery is greatly affected by temperature and frequency of use.

sentences.chinese: 医学进步明显提高了人类的平均寿命。
sentences.traditional: 醫學進步明顯提高了人類的平均壽命。
sentences.pinyin: Yīxué jìnbù míngxiǎn tígāo le rénlèi de píngjūn shòumìng.
sentences.translation: Medical progress has clearly increased the average lifespan of humans.

sentences.chinese: 受灾群众被临时安置在学校体育馆里。
sentences.traditional: 受災群眾被臨時安置在學校體育館裡。
sentences.pinyin: Shòuzāi qúnzhòng bèi línshí ānzhì zài xuéxiào tǐyùguǎn lǐ.
sentences.translation: The people affected by the disaster were temporarily settled in the school gymnasium.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，政府向受灾地区运送了食品和药品。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，政府向受災地區運送了食品和藥品。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, zhèngfǔ xiàng shòuzāi dìqū yùnsòng le shípǐn hé yàopǐn.
sentences.translation: After the heavy rain, the government transported food and medicine to the disaster-hit area.

sentences.chinese: 由于道路中断，救援队暂时无法进入受灾村庄。
sentences.traditional: 由於道路中斷，救援隊暫時無法進入受災村莊。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú dàolù zhōngduàn, jiùyuán duì zànshí wúfǎ jìnrù shòuzāi cūnzhuāng.
sentences.translation: Because the roads were cut off, the rescue team was temporarily unable to enter the disaster-hit village.

sentences.chinese: 系统会自动输出一份报告，方便管理人员查看结果。
sentences.traditional: 系統會自動輸出一份報告，方便管理人員查看結果。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng shūchū yí fèn bàogào, fāngbiàn guǎnlǐ rényuán chákàn jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: The system will automatically output a report, making it easier for managers to view the results.

sentences.chinese: 这台设备能够同时输出图像和声音，适合远程教学。
sentences.traditional: 這臺設備能夠同時輸出圖像和聲音，適合遠程教學。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái shèbèi nénggòu tóngshí shūchū túxiàng hé shēngyīn, shìhé yuǎnchéng jiàoxué.
sentences.translation: This device can output images and sound at the same time, making it suitable for remote teaching.

sentences.chinese: 如果数据格式不一致，程序输出的结果可能会出错。
sentences.traditional: 如果數據格式不一致，程序輸出的結果可能會出錯。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shùjù géshì bù yízhì, chéngxù shūchū de jiéguǒ kěnéng huì chūcuò.
sentences.translation: If the data formats are inconsistent, the results output by the program may be wrong.

sentences.chinese: 这家博物馆新开设了书画展厅，吸引了不少游客。
sentences.traditional: 這家博物館新開設了書畫展廳，吸引了不少遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn xīn kāishè le shūhuà zhǎntīng, xīyǐn le bù shǎo yóukè.
sentences.translation: This museum has newly opened a calligraphy and painting exhibition hall, attracting quite a few visitors.

sentences.chinese: 他退休后开始学习书画，希望让生活更有情趣。
sentences.traditional: 他退休後開始學習書畫，希望讓生活更有情趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu kāishǐ xuéxí shūhuà, xīwàng ràng shēnghuó gèng yǒu qíngqù.
sentences.translation: After retiring, he began to study calligraphy and painting, hoping to make life more interesting.

sentences.chinese: 这幅书画作品虽然尺寸不大，却很有收藏价值。
sentences.traditional: 這幅書畫作品雖然尺寸不大，卻很有收藏價值。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fú shūhuà zuòpǐn suīrán chǐcùn bú dà, què hěn yǒu shōucáng jiàzhí.
sentences.translation: Although this calligraphy and painting work is not large, it has considerable collection value.

sentences.chinese: 电子书很方便，但纸质书籍仍然有稳定的读者群。
sentences.traditional: 電子書很方便，但紙質書籍仍然有穩定的讀者群。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzǐshū hěn fāngbiàn, dàn zhǐzhì shūjí réngrán yǒu wěndìng de dúzhě qún.
sentences.translation: E-books are very convenient, but printed books still have a stable readership.

sentences.chinese: 图书馆定期整理旧书籍，把不常用的资料转入仓库。
sentences.traditional: 圖書館定期整理舊書籍，把不常用的資料轉入倉庫。
sentences.pinyin: Túshūguǎn dìngqī zhěnglǐ jiù shūjí, bǎ bù chángyòng de zīliào zhuǎnrù cāngkù.
sentences.translation: The library regularly sorts old books and transfers less commonly used materials to storage.

sentences.chinese: 这些书籍记录了当地语言、习俗和历史的变化。
sentences.traditional: 這些書籍記錄了當地語言、習俗和歷史的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shūjí jìlù le dāngdì yǔyán, xísú hé lìshǐ de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: These books record changes in the local language, customs, and history.

sentences.chinese: 所有投诉都必须以书面形式提交，方便后续核查。
sentences.traditional: 所有投訴都必須以書面形式提交，方便後續核查。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu tóusù dōu bìxū yǐ shūmiàn xíngshì tíjiāo, fāngbiàn hòuxù héchá.
sentences.translation: All complaints must be submitted in written form to facilitate later verification.

sentences.chinese: 这份书面说明把责任范围写得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這份書面說明把責任範圍寫得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn shūmiàn shuōmíng bǎ zérèn fànwéi xiě de hěn qīngchǔ.
sentences.translation: This written explanation states the scope of responsibility very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 口头承诺不够，关键条款最好留下书面记录。
sentences.traditional: 口頭承諾不夠，關鍵條款最好留下書面記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Kǒutóu chéngnuò bú gòu, guānjiàn tiáokuǎn zuìhǎo liúxià shūmiàn jìlù.
sentences.translation: A verbal promise is not enough; key terms are best kept in written records.

sentences.chinese: 这条管道主要用于输送天然气，维护要求很高。
sentences.traditional: 這條管道主要用於輸送天然氣，維護要求很高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo guǎndào zhǔyào yòngyú shūsòng tiānránqì, wéihù yāoqiú hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: This pipeline is mainly used to transport natural gas, so its maintenance requirements are high.

sentences.chinese: 救援队利用直升机向山区输送食品和药品。
sentences.traditional: 救援隊利用直升機向山區輸送食品和藥品。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùyuán duì lìyòng zhíshēngjī xiàng shānqū shūsòng shípǐn hé yàopǐn.
sentences.translation: The rescue team used helicopters to transport food and medicine to the mountainous area.

sentences.chinese: 教育不只是传授知识，也是在输送价值观。
sentences.traditional: 教育不只是傳授知識，也是在輸送價值觀。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù bù zhǐ shì chuánshòu zhīshi, yě shì zài shūsòng jiàzhíguān.
sentences.translation: Education is not only about teaching knowledge; it also conveys values.

sentences.chinese: 孩子刚开始学习书写时，笔画顺序非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 孩子剛開始學習書寫時，筆畫順序非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi gāng kāishǐ xuéxí shūxiě shí, bǐhuà shùnxù fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: When children first learn to write, stroke order is very important.

sentences.chinese: 这位老人每天坚持书写日记，记录自己的身体变化。
sentences.traditional: 這位老人每天堅持書寫日記，記錄自己的身體變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén měitiān jiānchí shūxiě rìjì, jìlù zìjǐ de shēntǐ biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This elderly person keeps writing a diary every day to record changes in their health.

sentences.chinese: 电脑普及以后，很多人的书写能力明显下降。
sentences.traditional: 電腦普及以後，很多人的書寫能力明顯下降。
sentences.pinyin: Diànnǎo pǔjí yǐhòu, hěn duō rén de shūxiě nénglì míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: After computers became widespread, many people's writing ability clearly declined.

sentences.chinese: 这片湿地属国家保护区，任何开发都需要审批。
sentences.traditional: 這片濕地屬國家保護區，任何開發都需要審批。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn shīdì shǔ guójiā bǎohùqū, rènhé kāifā dōu xūyào shěnpī.
sentences.translation: This wetland belongs to a national protected area, so any development requires approval.

sentences.chinese: 这些费用属个人消费，不能由公司报销。
sentences.traditional: 這些費用屬個人消費，不能由公司報銷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē fèiyòng shǔ gèrén xiāofèi, bù néng yóu gōngsī bàoxiāo.
sentences.translation: These expenses count as personal spending and cannot be reimbursed by the company.

sentences.chinese: 从法律上看，这套房产仍属夫妻共同财产。
sentences.traditional: 從法律上看，這套房產仍屬夫妻共同財產。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng fǎlǜ shàng kàn, zhè tào fángchǎn réng shǔ fūqī gòngtóng cáichǎn.
sentences.translation: From a legal perspective, this property still belongs to the couple's shared assets.

sentences.chinese: 他一边看电影一边吃薯片，很快就吃完了一整包。
sentences.traditional: 他一邊看電影一邊吃薯片，很快就吃完了一整包。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān kàn diànyǐng yìbiān chī shǔpiàn, hěn kuài jiù chīwán le yì zhěng bāo.
sentences.translation: He ate potato crisps while watching a film and quickly finished a whole packet.

sentences.chinese: 这款薯片盐分太高，不适合经常给孩子吃。
sentences.traditional: 這款薯片鹽分太高，不適合經常給孩子吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǔpiàn yánfèn tài gāo, bù shìhé jīngcháng gěi háizi chī.
sentences.translation: This type of potato crisps is too high in salt and is not suitable to give to children often.

sentences.chinese: 超市把薯片放在收银台附近，是为了刺激临时购买。
sentences.traditional: 超市把薯片放在收銀臺附近，是為了刺激臨時購買。
sentences.pinyin: Chāoshì bǎ shǔpiàn fàng zài shōuyíntái fùjìn, shì wèile cìjī línshí gòumǎi.
sentences.translation: The supermarket puts crisps near the checkout to encourage impulse purchases.

sentences.chinese: 请把这张海报竖着贴，横着贴会挡住窗户。
sentences.traditional: 請把這張海報豎著貼，橫著貼會擋住窗戶。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng hǎibào shùzhe tiē, héngzhe tiē huì dǎngzhù chuānghu.
sentences.translation: Please put this poster up vertically; if you put it horizontally, it will block the window.

sentences.chinese: 工人先在路边竖起警示牌，再开始施工。
sentences.traditional: 工人先在路邊豎起警示牌，再開始施工。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén xiān zài lùbiān shù qǐ jǐngshìpái, zài kāishǐ shīgōng.
sentences.translation: The workers first put up warning signs by the road, then began construction.

sentences.chinese: 这个字的最后一笔是竖，不要写成撇。
sentences.traditional: 這個字的最後一筆是豎，不要寫成撇。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zì de zuìhòu yì bǐ shì shù, bú yào xiě chéng piě.
sentences.translation: The final stroke of this character is a vertical stroke; do not write it as a left-falling stroke.

sentences.chinese: 政府希望通过公开数据树立更透明的形象。
sentences.traditional: 政府希望通過公開數據樹立更透明的形象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xīwàng tōngguò gōngkāi shùjù shùlì gèng tòumíng de xíngxiàng.
sentences.translation: The government hopes to establish a more transparent image by releasing public data.

sentences.chinese: 老师的一句话帮助他重新树立了学习信心。
sentences.traditional: 老師的一句話幫助他重新樹立了學習信心。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī de yí jù huà bāngzhù tā chóngxīn shùlì le xuéxí xìnxīn.
sentences.translation: One sentence from the teacher helped him rebuild his confidence in studying.

sentences.chinese: 企业要树立长期信誉，不能只追求短期收益。
sentences.traditional: 企業要樹立長期信譽，不能只追求短期收益。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yào shùlì chángqī xìnyù, bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú duǎnqī shōuyì.
sentences.translation: A company should establish long-term credibility and not only pursue short-term profits.

sentences.chinese: 申请人数目超过预期，主办方不得不增加场次。
sentences.traditional: 申請人數目超過預期，主辦方不得不增加場次。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng rén shùmù chāoguò yùqī, zhǔbànfāng bùdébù zēngjiā chǎngcì.
sentences.translation: The number of applicants exceeded expectations, so the organisers had to add more sessions.

sentences.chinese: 这批样本的数目太小，结论还不够可靠。
sentences.traditional: 這批樣本的數目太小，結論還不夠可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī yàngběn de shùmù tài xiǎo, jiélùn hái bú gòu kěkào.
sentences.translation: The number of samples in this batch is too small, so the conclusion is not reliable enough.

sentences.chinese: 警方尚未公布失踪人员的准确数目。
sentences.traditional: 警方尚未公佈失蹤人員的準確數目。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng shàngwèi gōngbù shīzōng rényuán de zhǔnquè shùmù.
sentences.translation: The police have not yet announced the exact number of missing people.

sentences.chinese: 医院正在把旧病历数字化，以便医生快速查询。
sentences.traditional: 醫院正在把舊病歷數字化，以便醫生快速查詢。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn zhèngzài bǎ jiù bìnglì shùzìhuà, yǐbiàn yīshēng kuàisù cháxún.
sentences.translation: The hospital is digitising old medical records so doctors can look them up quickly.

sentences.chinese: 传统工厂完成数字化后，生产效率明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 傳統工廠完成數字化後，生產效率明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng gōngchǎng wánchéng shùzìhuà hòu, shēngchǎn xiàolǜ míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: After the traditional factory completed digitisation, production efficiency increased noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 这项计划的核心是数字化服务，而不是简单购买新设备。
sentences.traditional: 這項計劃的核心是數字化服務，而不是簡單購買新設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìhuà de héxīn shì shùzìhuà fúwù, ér bú shì jiǎndān gòumǎi xīn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The core of this plan is digitised services, not simply buying new equipment.

sentences.chinese: 适度运动可以减缓身体衰老，但不能完全阻止它。
sentences.traditional: 適度運動可以減緩身體衰老，但不能完全阻止它。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdù yùndòng kěyǐ jiǎnhuǎn shēntǐ shuāilǎo, dàn bù néng wánquán zǔzhǐ tā.
sentences.translation: Moderate exercise can slow physical ageing, but it cannot stop it completely.

sentences.chinese: 随着人口衰老，医疗和养老压力会逐渐增加。
sentences.traditional: 隨著人口衰老，醫療和養老壓力會逐漸增加。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe rénkǒu shuāilǎo, yīliáo hé yǎnglǎo yālì huì zhújiàn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: As the population ages, pressure on healthcare and elderly care will gradually increase.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究关注细胞衰老与慢性疾病之间的关系。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究關注細胞衰老與慢性疾病之間的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū guānzhù xìbāo shuāilǎo yǔ mànxìng jíbìng zhījiān de guānxì.
sentences.translation: This study focuses on the relationship between cellular ageing and chronic disease.

sentences.chinese: 军官率领救援队进入山区，寻找被洪水困住的村民。
sentences.traditional: 軍官率領救援隊進入山區，尋找被洪水困住的村民。
sentences.pinyin: Jūnguān shuàilǐng jiùyuán duì jìnrù shānqū, xúnzhǎo bèi hóngshuǐ kùn zhù de cūnmín.
sentences.translation: The officer led the rescue team into the mountain area to search for villagers trapped by the floodwater.

sentences.chinese: 这位年轻教练率领球队连续赢得三场重要比赛。
sentences.traditional: 這位年輕教練率領球隊連續贏得三場重要比賽。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng jiàoliàn shuàilǐng qiúduì liánxù yíngdé sān chǎng zhòngyào bǐsài.
sentences.translation: This young coach led the team to win three important matches in a row.

sentences.chinese: 总经理亲自率领谈判小组，与海外客户讨论合作细节。
sentences.traditional: 總經理親自率領談判小組，與海外客戶討論合作細節。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒngjīnglǐ qīnzì shuàilǐng tánpàn xiǎozǔ, yǔ hǎiwài kèhù tǎolùn hézuò xìjié.
sentences.translation: The general manager personally led the negotiation team to discuss the details of cooperation with overseas clients.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司率先推出环保包装，带动了整个行业的变化。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司率先推出環保包裝，帶動了整個行業的變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shuàixiān tuīchū huánbǎo bāozhuāng, dàidòng le zhěnggè hángyè de biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This company was the first to introduce eco-friendly packaging, driving changes across the whole industry.

sentences.chinese: 政府在沿海地区率先试行新的垃圾分类制度。
sentences.traditional: 政府在沿海地區率先試行新的垃圾分類制度。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zài yánhǎi dìqū shuàixiān shìxíng xīn de lājī fēnlèi zhìdù.
sentences.translation: The government first piloted the new waste-sorting system in coastal areas.

sentences.chinese: 谁能率先掌握核心技术，谁就更有可能占领市场。
sentences.traditional: 誰能率先掌握核心技術，誰就更有可能佔領市場。
sentences.pinyin: Shéi néng shuàixiān zhǎngwò héxīn jìshù, shéi jiù gèng yǒu kěnéng zhànlǐng shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: Whoever can be the first to master the core technology is more likely to capture the market.

sentences.chinese: 南方许多地区依靠水稻种植维持生计。
sentences.traditional: 南方許多地區依靠水稻種植維持生計。
sentences.pinyin: Nánfāng xǔduō dìqū yīkào shuǐdào zhòngzhí wéichí shēngjì.
sentences.translation: Many regions in the south rely on rice cultivation to make a living.

sentences.chinese: 如果雨季来得太晚，水稻的产量可能会明显下降。
sentences.traditional: 如果雨季來得太晚，水稻的產量可能會明顯下降。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǔjì lái de tài wǎn, shuǐdào de chǎnliàng kěnéng huì míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: If the rainy season comes too late, rice yields may drop noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员培育出更耐旱的水稻品种，以适应气候变化。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員培育出更耐旱的水稻品種，以適應氣候變化。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán péiyù chū gèng nàihàn de shuǐdào pǐnzhǒng, yǐ shìyìng qìhòu biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Researchers have developed more drought-resistant rice varieties to adapt to climate change.

sentences.chinese: 这座水库不仅供水，还承担防洪和发电的任务。
sentences.traditional: 這座水庫不僅供水，還承擔防洪和發電的任務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò shuǐkù bùjǐn gōngshuǐ, hái chéngdān fánghóng hé fādiàn de rènwù.
sentences.translation: This reservoir not only supplies water, but also undertakes flood-control and power-generation tasks.

sentences.chinese: 连续干旱使水库水位下降，城市供水面临压力。
sentences.traditional: 連續乾旱使水庫水位下降，城市供水面臨壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù gānhàn shǐ shuǐkù shuǐwèi xiàjiàng, chéngshì gōngshuǐ miànlín yālì.
sentences.translation: The continuous drought caused the reservoir’s water level to fall, putting pressure on the city’s water supply.

sentences.chinese: 工程师正在检查水库大坝，确保雨季来临前没有安全隐患。
sentences.traditional: 工程師正在檢查水庫大壩，確保雨季來臨前沒有安全隱患。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zhèngzài jiǎnchá shuǐkù dàbà, quèbǎo yǔjì láilín qián méiyǒu ānquán yǐnhuàn.
sentences.translation: Engineers are inspecting the reservoir dam to make sure there are no safety risks before the rainy season arrives.

sentences.chinese: 山谷里的水流很急，游客被提醒不要靠近河边。
sentences.traditional: 山谷裡的水流很急，遊客被提醒不要靠近河邊。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngǔ lǐ de shuǐliú hěn jí, yóukè bèi tíxǐng bú yào kàojìn hébiān.
sentences.translation: The current in the valley is very fast, so visitors are reminded not to go near the riverbank.

sentences.chinese: 科学家通过观察水流方向，判断污染物可能扩散到哪里。
sentences.traditional: 科學家通過觀察水流方向，判斷污染物可能擴散到哪裡。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā tōngguò guānchá shuǐliú fāngxiàng, pànduàn wūrǎnwù kěnéng kuòsàn dào nǎlǐ.
sentences.translation: Scientists judge where pollutants may spread by observing the direction of the water flow.

sentences.chinese: 修建桥墩时，必须考虑水流速度对结构的影响。
sentences.traditional: 修建橋墩時，必須考慮水流速度對結構的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Xiūjiàn qiáodūn shí, bìxū kǎolǜ shuǐliú sùdù duì jiégòu de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: When building bridge piers, the effect of water-flow speed on the structure must be considered.

sentences.chinese: 清晨的水面十分平静，远处的山影清晰可见。
sentences.traditional: 清晨的水面十分平靜，遠處的山影清晰可見。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngchén de shuǐmiàn shífēn píngjìng, yuǎnchù de shānyǐng qīngxī kějiàn.
sentences.translation: The water surface was very calm in the early morning, and the distant mountain shadows were clearly visible.

sentences.chinese: 一阵强风吹过，水面立刻泛起一层细小的波纹。
sentences.traditional: 一陣強風吹過，水面立刻泛起一層細小的波紋。
sentences.pinyin: Yí zhèn qiángfēng chuī guò, shuǐmiàn lìkè fàn qǐ yì céng xìxiǎo de bōwén.
sentences.translation: A strong gust of wind blew past, and tiny ripples immediately appeared on the water surface.

sentences.chinese: 救援人员发现水面上漂着几块木板，判断附近可能有人被困。
sentences.traditional: 救援人員發現水面上漂著幾塊木板，判斷附近可能有人被困。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùyuán rényuán fāxiàn shuǐmiàn shàng piāo zhe jǐ kuài mùbǎn, pànduàn fùjìn kěnéng yǒu rén bèi kùn.
sentences.translation: Rescuers found several wooden boards floating on the water surface and judged that someone nearby might be trapped.

sentences.chinese: 新铺的水泥还没有完全干，行人暂时不能通过。
sentences.traditional: 新鋪的水泥還沒有完全乾，行人暫時不能通過。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn pū de shuǐní hái méiyǒu wánquán gān, xíngrén zànshí bù néng tōngguò.
sentences.translation: The newly laid cement is not completely dry yet, so pedestrians cannot pass through for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 这条乡村道路改用水泥路面后，雨天出行方便多了。
sentences.traditional: 這條鄉村道路改用水泥路面後，雨天出行方便多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiāngcūn dàolù gǎi yòng shuǐní lùmiàn hòu, yǔtiān chūxíng fāngbiàn duō le.
sentences.translation: After this rural road was changed to a cement surface, travel on rainy days became much more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 建筑成本上涨，主要是因为钢材和水泥的价格都提高了。
sentences.traditional: 建築成本上漲，主要是因為鋼材和水泥的價格都提高了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiànzhù chéngběn shàngzhǎng, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi gāngcái hé shuǐní de jiàgé dōu tígāo le.
sentences.translation: Construction costs have risen mainly because the prices of both steel and cement have increased.

sentences.chinese: 灯光熄灭的瞬间，整个大厅陷入了短暂的安静。
sentences.traditional: 燈光熄滅的瞬間，整個大廳陷入了短暫的安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Dēngguāng xīmiè de shùnjiān, zhěnggè dàtīng xiànrù le duǎnzàn de ānjìng.
sentences.translation: The instant the lights went out, the whole hall fell into a brief silence.

sentences.chinese: 听到孩子平安的消息，她紧张的心情瞬间放松下来。
sentences.traditional: 聽到孩子平安的消息，她緊張的心情瞬間放鬆下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào háizi píng'ān de xiāoxi, tā jǐnzhāng de xīnqíng shùnjiān fàngsōng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: When she heard that the child was safe, her tense mood relaxed instantly.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生的瞬间，司机本能地把方向盘转向了空地。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生的瞬間，司機本能地把方向盤轉向了空地。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng de shùnjiān, sījī běnnéng de bǎ fāngxiàngpán zhuǎnxiàng le kòngdì.
sentences.translation: At the instant the accident happened, the driver instinctively turned the steering wheel towards an open area.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有直接给答案，而是引导学生整理自己的思路。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有直接給答案，而是引導學生整理自己的思路。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu zhíjiē gěi dá'àn, ér shì yǐndǎo xuéshēng zhěnglǐ zìjǐ de sīlù.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not give the answer directly, but guided the students to organise their own train of thought.

sentences.chinese: 会议讨论得太分散，主持人不得不把大家的思路拉回来。
sentences.traditional: 會議討論得太分散，主持人不得不把大家的思路拉回來。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì tǎolùn de tài fēnsàn, zhǔchírén bùdébù bǎ dàjiā de sīlù lā huílai.
sentences.translation: The discussion in the meeting became too scattered, so the host had to bring everyone’s train of thought back.

sentences.chinese: 写论文前先列提纲，可以让思路更加清晰。
sentences.traditional: 寫論文前先列提綱，可以讓思路更加清晰。
sentences.pinyin: Xiě lùnwén qián xiān liè tígāng, kěyǐ ràng sīlù gèngjiā qīngxī.
sentences.translation: Making an outline before writing a thesis can make the train of thought much clearer.

sentences.chinese: 离开家乡多年后，他依然思念那条安静的小河。
sentences.traditional: 離開家鄉多年後，他依然思念那條安靜的小河。
sentences.pinyin: Líkāi jiāxiāng duōnián hòu, tā yīrán sīniàn nà tiáo ānjìng de xiǎohé.
sentences.translation: After leaving his hometown for many years, he still misses that quiet little river.

sentences.chinese: 她把对母亲的思念写进信里，却一直没有寄出去。
sentences.traditional: 她把對母親的思念寫進信裡，卻一直沒有寄出去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ duì mǔqīn de sīniàn xiě jìn xìn lǐ, què yìzhí méiyǒu jì chūqù.
sentences.translation: She wrote her longing for her mother into the letter, but never sent it.

sentences.chinese: 每到春节，海外游子最思念的往往是家里的饭菜和声音。
sentences.traditional: 每到春節，海外遊子最思念的往往是家裡的飯菜和聲音。
sentences.pinyin: Měi dào Chūnjié, hǎiwài yóuzǐ zuì sīniàn de wǎngwǎng shì jiālǐ de fàncài hé shēngyīn.
sentences.translation: Every Spring Festival, what overseas travellers often miss most is the food and sounds of home.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，官方确认有三人死亡，另有多人受伤。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，官方確認有三人死亡，另有多人受傷。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, guānfāng quèrèn yǒu sān rén sǐwáng, lìng yǒu duō rén shòushāng.
sentences.translation: After the accident, officials confirmed that three people had died and several others were injured.

sentences.chinese: 如果得不到及时治疗，病人可能因感染而死亡。
sentences.traditional: 如果得不到及時治療，病人可能因感染而死亡。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ dé bù dào jíshí zhìliáo, bìngrén kěnéng yīn gǎnrǎn ér sǐwáng.
sentences.translation: If timely treatment is not received, the patient may die from the infection.

sentences.chinese: 冬季寒潮来临时，许多牲畜因缺少饲料而死亡。
sentences.traditional: 冬季寒潮來臨時，許多牲畜因缺少飼料而死亡。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngjì háncháo láilín shí, xǔduō shēngchù yīn quēshǎo sìliào ér sǐwáng.
sentences.translation: When the winter cold wave arrived, many livestock died because of a lack of feed.

sentences.chinese: 这颗螺丝有点松，机器运行时会发出噪音。
sentences.traditional: 這顆螺絲有點鬆，機器運行時會發出噪音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kē luósī yǒu diǎn sōng, jīqì yùnxíng shí huì fāchū zàoyīn.
sentences.translation: This screw is a bit loose, so the machine makes noise when it is running.

sentences.chinese: 你把绳子松一松，孩子的手腕已经被勒红了。
sentences.traditional: 你把繩子鬆一鬆，孩子的手腕已經被勒紅了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shéngzi sōng yì sōng, háizi de shǒuwàn yǐjīng bèi lēi hóng le.
sentences.translation: Loosen the rope a little; the child’s wrist has already been rubbed red.

sentences.chinese: 管理不能太松，否则制度很快就会失去约束力。
sentences.traditional: 管理不能太鬆，否則制度很快就會失去約束力。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnlǐ bù néng tài sōng, fǒuzé zhìdù hěn kuài jiù huì shīqù yuēshùlì.
sentences.translation: Management cannot be too lax, otherwise the system will soon lose its binding force.

sentences.chinese: 港口外停着一艘科研船，准备前往南海采集样本。
sentences.traditional: 港口外停著一艘科研船，準備前往南海採集樣本。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎngkǒu wài tíngzhe yì sōu kēyán chuán, zhǔnbèi qiánwǎng Nánhǎi cǎijí yàngběn.
sentences.translation: A research vessel was moored outside the port, preparing to go to the South China Sea to collect samples.

sentences.chinese: 这艘货船因天气恶劣被迫推迟出港。
sentences.traditional: 這艘貨船因天氣惡劣被迫推遲出港。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè sōu huòchuán yīn tiānqì èliè bèipò tuīchí chū gǎng.
sentences.translation: This cargo ship was forced to delay leaving port because of bad weather.

sentences.chinese: 救援队租用了一艘小船，把物资送到被困的岛上。
sentences.traditional: 救援隊租用了一艘小船，把物資送到被困的島上。
sentences.pinyin: Jiùyuán duì zūyòng le yì sōu xiǎochuán, bǎ wùzī sòng dào bèi kùn de dǎo shàng.
sentences.translation: The rescue team hired a small boat to deliver supplies to the stranded island.

sentences.chinese: 为了写报告，她花了两个月搜集第一手资料。
sentences.traditional: 為了寫報告，她花了兩個月搜集第一手資料。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile xiě bàogào, tā huā le liǎng gè yuè sōují dìyīshǒu zīliào.
sentences.translation: To write the report, she spent two months collecting first-hand materials.

sentences.chinese: 调查小组正在搜集证据，以判断企业是否违反规定。
sentences.traditional: 調查小組正在搜集證據，以判斷企業是否違反規定。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá xiǎozǔ zhèngzài sōují zhèngjù, yǐ pànduàn qǐyè shìfǒu wéifǎn guīdìng.
sentences.translation: The investigation team is collecting evidence to determine whether the company violated regulations.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆长期搜集民间故事，希望保存地方记忆。
sentences.traditional: 博物館長期搜集民間故事，希望保存地方記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn chángqī sōují mínjiān gùshi, xīwàng bǎocún dìfāng jìyì.
sentences.translation: The museum has long collected folk stories in the hope of preserving local memory.

sentences.chinese: 家庭教育会在很大程度上塑造孩子的价值观。
sentences.traditional: 家庭教育會在很大程度上塑造孩子的價值觀。
sentences.pinyin: Jiātíng jiàoyù huì zài hěn dà chéngdù shàng sùzào háizi de jiàzhíguān.
sentences.translation: Family education shapes children’s values to a great extent.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影成功塑造了一个坚强而复杂的女性形象。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影成功塑造了一個堅強而複雜的女性形象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng chénggōng sùzào le yí gè jiānqiáng ér fùzá de nǚxìng xíngxiàng.
sentences.translation: This film successfully shaped a strong and complex female character.

sentences.chinese: 城市更新不只是修路盖楼，更是在塑造新的公共生活。
sentences.traditional: 城市更新不只是修路蓋樓，更是在塑造新的公共生活。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì gēngxīn bù zhǐ shì xiū lù gài lóu, gèng shì zài sùzào xīn de gōnggòng shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Urban renewal is not just about repairing roads and constructing buildings; it is also shaping a new public life.

sentences.chinese: 员工的专业素质直接影响服务质量和客户信任。
sentences.traditional: 員工的專業素質直接影響服務質量和客戶信任。
sentences.pinyin: Yuángōng de zhuānyè sùzhì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng fúwù zhìliàng hé kèhù xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: Employees’ professional calibre directly affects service quality and customer trust.

sentences.chinese: 提高公民素质，需要教育、制度和社会环境共同发挥作用。
sentences.traditional: 提高公民素質，需要教育、制度和社會環境共同發揮作用。
sentences.pinyin: Tígāo gōngmín sùzhì, xūyào jiàoyù, zhìdù hé shèhuì huánjìng gòngtóng fāhuī zuòyòng.
sentences.translation: Improving citizens’ civic quality requires education, institutions and the social environment to work together.

sentences.chinese: 面试官更看重综合素质，而不只是学历背景。
sentences.traditional: 面試官更看重綜合素質，而不只是學歷背景。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshìguān gèng kànzhòng zōnghé sùzhì, ér bù zhǐ shì xuélì bèijǐng.
sentences.translation: Interviewers value overall calibre more, not just educational background.

sentences.chinese: 既然大家意见分歧这么大，这件事就算了吧。
sentences.traditional: 既然大家意見分歧這麼大，這件事就算了吧。
sentences.pinyin: Jìrán dàjiā yìjiàn fēnqí zhème dà, zhè jiàn shì jiù suànle ba.
sentences.translation: Since everyone’s opinions differ so much, let’s just drop this matter.

sentences.chinese: 他本来想继续争论，后来觉得没有意义，就说“算了”。
sentences.traditional: 他本來想繼續爭論，後來覺得沒有意義，就說「算了」。
sentences.pinyin: Tā běnlái xiǎng jìxù zhēnglùn, hòulái juéde méiyǒu yìyì, jiù shuō “suànle”.
sentences.translation: He originally wanted to keep arguing, but later felt it was pointless and said, “Forget it.”

sentences.chinese: 钱不多，弄丢了就算了，别再责怪孩子了。
sentences.traditional: 錢不多，弄丟了就算了，別再責怪孩子了。
sentences.pinyin: Qián bù duō, nòng diū le jiù suànle, bié zài zéguài háizi le.
sentences.translation: It was not much money; if it has been lost, just let it go and stop blaming the child.

sentences.chinese: 这次谈判虽然没有达成协议，但也算是取得了一些进展。
sentences.traditional: 這次談判雖然沒有達成協議，但也算是取得了一些進展。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn suīrán méiyǒu dáchéng xiéyì, dàn yě suànshì qǔdé le yìxiē jìnzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Although this negotiation did not reach an agreement, it can still be regarded as having made some progress.

sentences.chinese: 她在团队里算是最有经验的人，所以大家都愿意听她的建议。
sentences.traditional: 她在團隊裡算是最有經驗的人，所以大家都願意聽她的建議。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài tuánduì lǐ suànshì zuì yǒu jīngyàn de rén, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu yuànyì tīng tā de jiànyì.
