sentences.translation: She is considered the most experienced person in the team, so everyone is willing to listen to her suggestions.

sentences.chinese: 这个办法不完美，却算是目前最现实的选择。
sentences.traditional: 這個辦法不完美，卻算是目前最現實的選擇。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ bù wánměi, què suànshì mùqián zuì xiànshí de xuǎnzé.
sentences.translation: This method is not perfect, but it is still quite a realistic choice at present.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革虽有争议，但长期效果值得观察。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革雖有爭議，但長期效果值得觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé suī yǒu zhēngyì, dàn chángqī xiàoguǒ zhídé guānchá.
sentences.translation: Although this reform is controversial, its long-term effect is worth observing.

sentences.chinese: 他虽年纪不大，却能独立处理复杂事务。
sentences.traditional: 他雖年紀不大，卻能獨立處理複雜事務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suī niánjì bú dà, què néng dúlì chǔlǐ fùzá shìwù.
sentences.translation: Although he is not very old, he can handle complex matters independently.

sentences.chinese: 项目虽已完成，后续维护仍然不能放松。
sentences.traditional: 項目雖已完成，後續維護仍然不能放鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù suī yǐ wánchéng, hòuxù wéihù réngrán bù néng fàngsōng.
sentences.translation: Although the project has been completed, subsequent maintenance still cannot be relaxed.

sentences.chinese: 他岁数不小了，却依然每天坚持学习新技术。
sentences.traditional: 他歲數不小了，卻依然每天堅持學習新技術。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suìshu bù xiǎo le, què yīrán měitiān jiānchí xuéxí xīn jìshù.
sentences.translation: He is no longer young, but he still insists on learning new technology every day.

sentences.chinese: 不要只看岁数，判断一个人还要看经验和能力。
sentences.traditional: 不要只看歲數，判斷一個人還要看經驗和能力。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào zhǐ kàn suìshu, pànduàn yí gè rén hái yào kàn jīngyàn hé nénglì.
sentences.translation: Do not look only at age; judging a person also requires looking at experience and ability.

sentences.chinese: 随着岁数增长，他越来越重视身体检查和规律作息。
sentences.traditional: 隨著歲數增長，他越來越重視身體檢查和規律作息。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe suìshu zēngzhǎng, tā yuè lái yuè zhòngshì shēntǐ jiǎnchá hé guīlǜ zuòxī.
sentences.translation: As he gets older, he pays more and more attention to medical check-ups and regular routines.

sentences.chinese: 这些照片记录了父母年轻时一起走过的岁月。
sentences.traditional: 這些照片記錄了父母年輕時一起走過的歲月。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn jìlù le fùmǔ niánqīng shí yìqǐ zǒu guò de suìyuè.
sentences.translation: These photos record the years my parents spent together when they were young.

sentences.chinese: 经历了漫长的岁月，这座老桥依然保持着原来的样子。
sentences.traditional: 經歷了漫長的歲月，這座老橋依然保持著原來的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglì le màncháng de suìyuè, zhè zuò lǎo qiáo yīrán bǎochí zhe yuánlái de yàngzi.
sentences.translation: After many long years, this old bridge still keeps its original appearance.

sentences.chinese: 岁月改变了他的外貌，却没有改变他的幽默感。
sentences.traditional: 歲月改變了他的外貌，卻沒有改變他的幽默感。
sentences.pinyin: Suìyuè gǎibiàn le tā de wàimào, què méiyǒu gǎibiàn tā de yōumògǎn.
sentences.translation: The years changed his appearance, but they did not change his sense of humour.

sentences.chinese: 运输过程中包装被挤压，里面的设备没有受到损坏。
sentences.traditional: 運輸過程中包裝被擠壓，裡面的設備沒有受到損壞。
sentences.pinyin: Yùnshū guòchéng zhōng bāozhuāng bèi jǐyā, lǐmiàn de shèbèi méiyǒu shòudào sǔnhuài.
sentences.translation: The packaging was squeezed during transport, but the equipment inside was not damaged.

sentences.chinese: 请不要随意移动这些仪器，以免损坏精密部件。
sentences.traditional: 請不要隨意移動這些儀器，以免損壞精密部件。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào suíyì yídòng zhèxiē yíqì, yǐmiǎn sǔnhuài jīngmì bùjiàn.
sentences.translation: Please do not move these instruments casually, in case you damage the precision components.

sentences.chinese: 这场暴风雨损坏了多处路灯，维修人员正在逐一检查。
sentences.traditional: 這場暴風雨損壞了多處路燈，維修人員正在逐一檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bàofēngyǔ sǔnhuài le duō chù lùdēng, wéixiū rényuán zhèngzài zhúyī jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: This storm damaged many streetlights, and maintenance staff are checking them one by one.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺乏睡眠会损伤记忆力和判断力。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺乏睡眠會損傷記憶力和判斷力。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá shuìmián huì sǔnshāng jìyìlì hé pànduànlì.
sentences.translation: Long-term lack of sleep can harm memory and judgement.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒他，错误的训练方式可能造成膝关节损伤。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒他，錯誤的訓練方式可能造成膝關節損傷。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, cuòwù de xùnliàn fāngshì kěnéng zàochéng xīguānjié sǔnshāng.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded him that incorrect training methods could cause knee-joint injury.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策若处理不当，可能损伤公众对政府的信任。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策若處理不當，可能損傷公眾對政府的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè ruò chǔlǐ bùdàng, kěnéng sǔnshāng gōngzhòng duì zhèngfǔ de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: If this policy is handled improperly, it may damage public trust in the government.

sentences.chinese: 他所提出的建议虽然简单，却解决了最核心的问题。
sentences.traditional: 他所提出的建議雖然簡單，卻解決了最核心的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suǒ tíchū de jiànyì suīrán jiǎndān, què jiějué le zuì héxīn de wèntí.
sentences.translation: The suggestion he put forward was simple, but it solved the most central problem.

sentences.chinese: 我们不能只关注所得到的利益，也要考虑可能承担的责任。
sentences.traditional: 我們不能只關注所得到的利益，也要考慮可能承擔的責任。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zhǐ guānzhù suǒ dédào de lìyì, yě yào kǎolǜ kěnéng chéngdān de zérèn.
sentences.translation: We cannot focus only on the benefits obtained; we must also consider the responsibilities we may bear.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告反映了调查组所发现的主要问题。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告反映了調查組所發現的主要問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào fǎnyìng le diàocházǔ suǒ fāxiàn de zhǔyào wèntí.
sentences.translation: This report reflects the main problems discovered by the investigation team.

sentences.chinese: 把基础工作做好，心里才会觉得踏实。
sentences.traditional: 把基礎工作做好，心裡才會覺得踏實。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎ jīchǔ gōngzuò zuò hǎo, xīnli cái huì juéde tāshi.
sentences.translation: Only after doing the basic work well will you feel settled inside.

sentences.chinese: 他做事很踏实，从不为了表现自己而夸大结果。
sentences.traditional: 他做事很踏實，從不為了表現自己而誇大結果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn tāshi, cóng bù wèile biǎoxiàn zìjǐ ér kuādà jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: He is very steady in his work and never exaggerates results just to show off.

sentences.chinese: 这份收入虽然不高，但足够稳定，让一家人生活得比较踏实。
sentences.traditional: 這份收入雖然不高，但足夠穩定，讓一家人生活得比較踏實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn shōurù suīrán bù gāo, dàn zúgòu wěndìng, ràng yì jiā rén shēnghuó de bǐjiào tāshi.
sentences.translation: Although this income is not high, it is stable enough to let the family live fairly securely.

sentences.chinese: 这座古塔经历了多次地震，仍然保存得相当完整。
sentences.traditional: 這座古塔經歷了多次地震，仍然保存得相當完整。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔtǎ jīnglì le duō cì dìzhèn, réngrán bǎocún de xiāngdāng wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: This ancient pagoda has been through several earthquakes and is still preserved quite completely.

sentences.chinese: 城市中心新建了一座电视塔，夜里灯光十分醒目。
sentences.traditional: 城市中心新建了一座電視塔，夜裡燈光十分醒目。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì zhōngxīn xīnjiàn le yí zuò diànshìtǎ, yèlǐ dēngguāng shífēn xǐngmù.
sentences.translation: A television tower has been newly built in the city centre, and its lights are very striking at night.

sentences.chinese: 游客登上塔顶后，可以看到整片湖区的景色。
sentences.traditional: 遊客登上塔頂後，可以看到整片湖區的景色。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè dēng shàng tǎdǐng hòu, kěyǐ kàndào zhěng piàn húqū de jǐngsè.
sentences.translation: After climbing to the top of the tower, visitors can see the scenery of the whole lake area.

sentences.chinese: 台风登陆前，沿海居民被安排转移到安全地点。
sentences.traditional: 颱風登陸前，沿海居民被安排轉移到安全地點。
sentences.pinyin: Táifēng dēnglù qián, yánhǎi jūmín bèi ānpái zhuǎnyí dào ānquán dìdiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before the typhoon made landfall, coastal residents were moved to safe places.

sentences.chinese: 受台风影响，多条航线被临时取消。
sentences.traditional: 受颱風影響，多條航線被臨時取消。
sentences.pinyin: Shòu táifēng yǐngxiǎng, duō tiáo hángxiàn bèi línshí qǔxiāo.
sentences.translation: Affected by the typhoon, several flight routes were temporarily cancelled.

sentences.chinese: 气象部门提醒市民关注台风路径，减少不必要的外出。
sentences.traditional: 氣象部門提醒市民關注颱風路徑，減少不必要的外出。
sentences.pinyin: Qìxiàng bùmén tíxǐng shìmín guānzhù táifēng lùjìng, jiǎnshǎo bù bìyào de wàichū.
sentences.translation: The meteorological department reminded residents to follow the typhoon’s path and reduce unnecessary trips outside.

sentences.chinese: 他每周练习台球，不只是为了娱乐，也为了培养专注力。
sentences.traditional: 他每週練習臺球，不只是為了娛樂，也為了培養專注力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu liànxí táiqiú, bù zhǐshì wèile yúlè, yě wèile péiyǎng zhuānzhùlì.
sentences.translation: He practises billiards every week, not only for entertainment but also to develop concentration.

sentences.chinese: 这家俱乐部的台球桌保养得很好，比赛体验相当专业。
sentences.traditional: 這家俱樂部的臺球桌保養得很好，比賽體驗相當專業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jùlèbù de táiqiú zhuō bǎoyǎng de hěn hǎo, bǐsài tǐyàn xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
sentences.translation: The billiard tables at this club are well maintained, giving quite a professional competition experience.

sentences.chinese: 学习台球需要判断角度，也需要稳定的手感。
sentences.traditional: 學習臺球需要判斷角度，也需要穩定的手感。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí táiqiú xūyào pànduàn jiǎodù, yě xūyào wěndìng de shǒugǎn.
sentences.translation: Learning billiards requires judging angles and also a steady feel in the hands.

sentences.chinese: 人类对太空的探索推动了许多新技术的发展。
sentences.traditional: 人類對太空的探索推動了許多新技術的發展。
sentences.pinyin: Rénlèi duì tàikōng de tànsuǒ tuīdòng le xǔduō xīn jìshù de fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Human exploration of space has promoted the development of many new technologies.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片介绍了宇航员在太空中的日常生活。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片介紹了宇航員在太空中的日常生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jièshào le yǔhángyuán zài tàikōng zhōng de rìcháng shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This documentary introduces astronauts’ daily life in space.

sentences.chinese: 未来的太空旅行可能会逐渐从科学任务走向商业服务。
sentences.traditional: 未來的太空旅行可能會逐漸從科學任務走向商業服務。
sentences.pinyin: Wèilái de tàikōng lǚxíng kěnéng huì zhújiàn cóng kēxué rènwù zǒuxiàng shāngyè fúwù.
sentences.translation: Future space travel may gradually move from scientific missions towards commercial services.

sentences.chinese: 这个村庄利用太阳能供电，减少了对柴油发电机的依赖。
sentences.traditional: 這個村莊利用太陽能供電，減少了對柴油發電機的依賴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cūnzhuāng lìyòng tàiyángnéng gōngdiàn, jiǎnshǎo le duì cháiyóu fādiànjī de yīlài.
sentences.translation: This village uses solar energy for electricity, reducing its reliance on diesel generators.

sentences.chinese: 随着成本下降，越来越多家庭开始安装太阳能设备。
sentences.traditional: 隨著成本下降，越來越多家庭開始安裝太陽能設備。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe chéngběn xiàjiàng, yuè lái yuè duō jiātíng kāishǐ ānzhuāng tàiyángnéng shèbèi.
sentences.translation: As costs fall, more and more families are beginning to install solar-energy equipment.

sentences.chinese: 太阳能虽然清洁，但仍需要稳定的储能系统配合使用。
sentences.traditional: 太陽能雖然清潔，但仍需要穩定的儲能系統配合使用。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyángnéng suīrán qīngjié, dàn réng xūyào wěndìng de chǔnéng xìtǒng pèihé shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: Although solar energy is clean, it still needs to be used together with a stable energy-storage system.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，大家仍在走廊里谈论改革方案的细节。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，大家仍在走廊裡談論改革方案的細節。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, dàjiā réng zài zǒuláng lǐ tánlùn gǎigé fāng'àn de xìjié.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, everyone was still discussing the details of the reform plan in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 这本书谈论的不只是历史事件，还包括普通人的命运。
sentences.traditional: 這本書談論的不只是歷史事件，還包括普通人的命運。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tánlùn de bù zhǐ shì lìshǐ shìjiàn, hái bāokuò pǔtōngrén de mìngyùn.
sentences.translation: This book discusses not only historical events, but also the fate of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 他们避免公开谈论这个决定背后的商业压力。
sentences.traditional: 他們避免公開談論這個決定背後的商業壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bìmiǎn gōngkāi tánlùn zhège juédìng bèihòu de shāngyè yālì.
sentences.translation: They avoided publicly discussing the commercial pressure behind this decision.

sentences.chinese: 双方经过三轮谈判，终于在价格上达成了初步一致。
sentences.traditional: 雙方經過三輪談判，終於在價格上達成了初步一致。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng jīngguò sān lún tánpàn, zhōngyú zài jiàgé shàng dáchéng le chūbù yízhì.
sentences.translation: After three rounds of negotiation, the two sides finally reached initial agreement on the price.

sentences.chinese: 如果谈判陷入僵局，我们需要准备一个更灵活的方案。
sentences.traditional: 如果談判陷入僵局，我們需要準備一個更靈活的方案。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tánpàn xiànrù jiāngjú, wǒmen xūyào zhǔnbèi yí ge gèng línghuó de fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: If the negotiations reach a deadlock, we need to prepare a more flexible plan.

sentences.chinese: 他擅长在谈判中抓住对方真正关心的问题。
sentences.traditional: 他擅長在談判中抓住對方真正關心的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shàncháng zài tánpàn zhōng zhuāzhù duìfāng zhēnzhèng guānxīn de wèntí.
sentences.translation: He is good at grasping what the other side truly cares about during negotiations.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司允许员工弹性上班，以提高工作效率。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司允許員工彈性上班，以提高工作效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǔnxǔ yuángōng tánxìng shàngbān, yǐ tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: This company allows employees to work flexible hours to improve efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 橡胶的弹性会受到温度和使用时间的影响。
sentences.traditional: 橡膠的彈性會受到溫度和使用時間的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngjiāo de tánxìng huì shòudào wēndù hé shǐyòng shíjiān de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The elasticity of rubber can be affected by temperature and length of use.

sentences.chinese: 制定计划时要留出一定弹性，方便应对突发情况。
sentences.traditional: 制定計畫時要留出一定彈性，方便應對突發情況。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìdìng jìhuà shí yào liú chū yídìng tánxìng, fāngbiàn yìngduì tūfā qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: When making a plan, you should leave a certain amount of flexibility so you can deal with unexpected situations.

sentences.chinese: 科学家正在探索这种材料在医疗领域的应用。
sentences.traditional: 科學家正在探索這種材料在醫療領域的應用。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài tànsuǒ zhè zhǒng cáiliào zài yīliáo lǐngyù de yìngyòng.
sentences.translation: Scientists are exploring the applications of this material in the medical field.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人应该有机会探索不同职业，而不是过早被固定下来。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人應該有機會探索不同職業，而不是過早被固定下來。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yīnggāi yǒu jīhuì tànsuǒ bùtóng zhíyè, ér bú shì guò zǎo bèi gùdìng xiàlai.
sentences.translation: Young people should have the chance to explore different careers rather than being fixed in place too early.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片带观众探索海底世界的神秘景象。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片帶觀眾探索海底世界的神秘景象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn dài guānzhòng tànsuǒ hǎidǐ shìjiè de shénmì jǐngxiàng.
sentences.translation: This documentary takes viewers to explore the mysterious sights of the underwater world.

sentences.chinese: 专家们将在论坛上探讨城市老龄化带来的挑战。
sentences.traditional: 專家們將在論壇上探討城市老齡化帶來的挑戰。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiāmen jiāng zài lùntán shàng tàntǎo chéngshì lǎolínghuà dài lái de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.translation: Experts will discuss the challenges brought by urban ageing at the forum.

sentences.chinese: 这篇论文重点探讨教育公平与资源分配之间的关系。
sentences.traditional: 這篇論文重點探討教育公平與資源分配之間的關係。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān lùnwén zhòngdiǎn tàntǎo jiàoyù gōngpíng yǔ zīyuán fēnpèi zhījiān de guānxì.
sentences.translation: This paper mainly discusses the relationship between educational fairness and resource allocation.

sentences.chinese: 在作出决定之前，董事会还需要进一步探讨风险。
sentences.traditional: 在作出決定之前，董事會還需要進一步探討風險。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zuòchū juédìng zhīqián, dǒngshìhuì hái xūyào jìn yí bù tàntǎo fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, the board still needs to discuss the risks further.

sentences.chinese: 元宵节那天，奶奶亲手包了芝麻馅的汤圆。
sentences.traditional: 元宵節那天，奶奶親手包了芝麻餡的湯圓。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánxiāo Jié nà tiān, nǎinai qīnshǒu bāo le zhīma xiàn de tāngyuán.
sentences.translation: On the Lantern Festival, Grandma made sesame-filled tangyuan by hand.

sentences.chinese: 这些汤圆煮得太久，外皮已经变得有点软烂。
sentences.traditional: 這些湯圓煮得太久，外皮已經變得有點軟爛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē tāngyuán zhǔ de tài jiǔ, wàipí yǐjīng biàn de yǒudiǎn ruǎnlàn.
sentences.translation: These tangyuan were cooked for too long, and their outer skins have become a bit mushy.

sentences.chinese: 对很多家庭来说，一碗汤圆象征着团圆和新年的开始。
sentences.traditional: 對很多家庭來說，一碗湯圓象徵著團圓和新年的開始。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō jiātíng lái shuō, yì wǎn tāngyuán xiàngzhēng zhe tuányuán hé xīnnián de kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: For many families, a bowl of tangyuan symbolises reunion and the start of the new year.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他减少糖果摄入，以免影响牙齿健康。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他減少糖果攝入，以免影響牙齒健康。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā jiǎnshǎo tángguǒ shèrù, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng yáchǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to reduce his intake of sweets so as not to affect his dental health.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们把收到的糖果按照颜色和味道分成几堆。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們把收到的糖果按照顏色和味道分成幾堆。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen bǎ shōudào de tángguǒ ànzhào yánsè hé wèidào fēn chéng jǐ duī.
sentences.translation: The children divided the sweets they received into piles according to colour and flavour.

sentences.chinese: 这种糖果虽然包装漂亮，但味道并没有想象中特别。
sentences.traditional: 這種糖果雖然包裝漂亮，但味道並沒有想像中特別。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tángguǒ suīrán bāozhuāng piàoliang, dàn wèidào bìng méiyǒu xiǎngxiàng zhōng tèbié.
sentences.translation: Although this kind of sweet has attractive packaging, its flavour is not especially remarkable.

sentences.chinese: 刚倒出来的茶很烫，别急着喝。
sentences.traditional: 剛倒出來的茶很燙，別急著喝。
sentences.pinyin: Gāng dào chūlai de chá hěn tàng, bié jí zhe hē.
sentences.translation: The tea has just been poured and is very hot, so do not rush to drink it.

sentences.chinese: 她不小心被热油烫了一下，手背立刻红了。
sentences.traditional: 她不小心被熱油燙了一下，手背立刻紅了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bèi rè yóu tàng le yí xià, shǒubèi lìkè hóng le.
sentences.translation: She was accidentally scalded by hot oil, and the back of her hand immediately turned red.

sentences.chinese: 这家店把衬衫烫得很平整，细节处理得也很仔细。
sentences.traditional: 這家店把襯衫燙得很平整，細節處理得也很仔細。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn bǎ chènshān tàng de hěn píngzhěng, xìjié chǔlǐ de yě hěn zǐxì.
sentences.translation: This shop irons shirts very smoothly and handles the details carefully too.

sentences.chinese: 他从口袋里掏出一张皱巴巴的车票。
sentences.traditional: 他從口袋裡掏出一張皺巴巴的車票。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng kǒudài lǐ tāo chū yì zhāng zhòubābā de chēpiào.
sentences.translation: He pulled a crumpled ticket out of his pocket.

sentences.chinese: 小偷趁人群拥挤时掏走了游客的钱包。
sentences.traditional: 小偷趁人群擁擠時掏走了遊客的錢包。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎotōu chèn rénqún yōngjǐ shí tāo zǒu le yóukè de qiánbāo.
sentences.translation: The thief took advantage of the crowded situation to pick the tourist's wallet.

sentences.chinese: 工人先把管道里的淤泥掏干净，再进行维修。
sentences.traditional: 工人先把管道裡的淤泥掏乾淨，再進行維修。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén xiān bǎ guǎndào lǐ de yūní tāo gānjìng, zài jìnxíng wéixiū.
sentences.translation: The workers first dug the silt out of the pipe, and then carried out the repair.

sentences.chinese: 火警响起后，大家按照指示从安全通道逃了出去。
sentences.traditional: 火警響起後，大家按照指示從安全通道逃了出去。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒjǐng xiǎngqǐ hòu, dàjiā ànzhào zhǐshì cóng ānquán tōngdào táo le chūqu.
sentences.translation: After the fire alarm sounded, everyone escaped through the emergency exit according to the instructions.

sentences.chinese: 那名嫌疑人趁夜色逃离了现场，但很快被警方找到。
sentences.traditional: 那名嫌疑人趁夜色逃離了現場，但很快被警方找到。
sentences.pinyin: Nà míng xiányírén chèn yèsè táolí le xiànchǎng, dàn hěn kuài bèi jǐngfāng zhǎodào.
sentences.translation: The suspect fled the scene under cover of night, but was soon found by the police.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难时，一味想逃并不能真正解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難時，一味想逃並不能真正解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan shí, yíwèi xiǎng táo bìng bù néng zhēnzhèng jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: When facing difficulties, simply wanting to run away cannot truly solve the problem.

sentences.chinese: 嫌疑人试图从后门逃跑，却被警察及时拦住。
sentences.traditional: 嫌疑人試圖從後門逃跑，卻被警察及時攔住。
sentences.pinyin: Xiányírén shìtú cóng hòumén táopǎo, què bèi jǐngchá jíshí lán zhù.
sentences.translation: The suspect tried to run away through the back door, but was stopped by the police in time.

sentences.chinese: 火灾发生后，居民们按指示有序逃跑，没有造成踩踏。
sentences.traditional: 火災發生後，居民們按指示有序逃跑，沒有造成踩踏。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒzāi fāshēng hòu, jūmínmen àn zhǐshì yǒuxù táopǎo, méiyǒu zàochéng cǎità.
sentences.translation: After the fire broke out, the residents fled in an orderly way according to instructions, and no stampede occurred.

sentences.chinese: 面对问题时只想逃跑，往往会让压力变得更大。
sentences.traditional: 面對問題時只想逃跑，往往會讓壓力變得更大。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì wèntí shí zhǐ xiǎng táopǎo, wǎngwǎng huì ràng yālì biàn de gèng dà.
sentences.translation: Only wanting to run away when facing problems often makes the pressure greater.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子虽然有点淘气，但心地很善良。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子雖然有點淘氣，但心地很善良。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi suīrán yǒudiǎn táoqì, dàn xīndì hěn shànliáng.
sentences.translation: Although this child is a bit naughty, he is very kind-hearted.

sentences.chinese: 小猫太淘气了，把桌上的文件弄得到处都是。
sentences.traditional: 小貓太淘氣了，把桌上的文件弄得到處都是。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo māo tài táoqì le, bǎ zhuō shàng de wénjiàn nòng de dàochù dōu shì.
sentences.translation: The kitten was so naughty that it scattered the documents on the table everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有责骂那个淘气的学生，而是耐心地和他谈了一次。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有責罵那個淘氣的學生，而是耐心地和他談了一次。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu zémà nàge táoqì de xuésheng, ér shì nàixīn de hé tā tán le yí cì.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not scold the naughty student, but had a patient talk with him.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司如果不及时创新，很快就会被市场淘汰。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司如果不及時創新，很快就會被市場淘汰。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī rúguǒ bù jíshí chuàngxīn, hěn kuài jiù huì bèi shìchǎng táotài.
sentences.translation: If this company does not innovate in time, it will soon be eliminated by the market.

sentences.chinese: 经过三轮比赛，实力较弱的队伍已经全部被淘汰。
sentences.traditional: 經過三輪比賽，實力較弱的隊伍已經全部被淘汰。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò sān lún bǐsài, shílì jiào ruò de duìwu yǐjīng quánbù bèi táotài.
sentences.translation: After three rounds of competition, all the weaker teams have been eliminated.

sentences.chinese: 传统行业并不会自然淘汰，关键在于能否完成数字化转型。
sentences.traditional: 傳統行業並不會自然淘汰，關鍵在於能否完成數字化轉型。
sentences.pinyin: Chuántǒng hángyè bìng bú huì zìrán táotài, guānjiàn zàiyú néngfǒu wánchéng shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng.
sentences.translation: Traditional industries will not naturally be eliminated; the key is whether they can complete digital transformation.

sentences.chinese: 午餐套餐包括一份主菜、一碗汤和一杯饮料。
sentences.traditional: 午餐套餐包括一份主菜、一碗湯和一杯飲料。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔcān tàocān bāokuò yí fèn zhǔcài, yì wǎn tāng hé yì bēi yǐnliào.
sentences.translation: The lunch set meal includes a main dish, a bowl of soup, and a drink.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅新推出的家庭套餐价格实惠，分量也足。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳新推出的家庭套餐價格實惠，分量也足。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng xīn tuīchū de jiātíng tàocān jiàgé shíhuì, fènliàng yě zú.
sentences.translation: The family set meal newly launched by this restaurant is good value and has generous portions.

sentences.chinese: 订手机套餐前，最好先比较流量、通话时间和合约期限。
sentences.traditional: 訂手機套餐前，最好先比較流量、通話時間和合約期限。
sentences.pinyin: Dìng shǒujī tàocān qián, zuì hǎo xiān bǐjiào liúliàng, tōnghuà shíjiān hé héyuē qīxiàn.
sentences.translation: Before choosing a mobile phone package, it is best to compare data, call time, and contract length.

sentences.chinese: 这条山路特窄，两辆车很难同时通过。
sentences.traditional: 這條山路特窄，兩輛車很難同時通過。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānlù tè zhǎi, liǎng liàng chē hěn nán tóngshí tōngguò.
sentences.translation: This mountain road is especially narrow, so it is hard for two cars to pass at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 她今天特高兴，因为多年的研究终于有了结果。
sentences.traditional: 她今天特高興，因為多年的研究終於有了結果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān tè gāoxìng, yīnwèi duōnián de yánjiū zhōngyú yǒu le jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: She is particularly happy today because her years of research have finally produced results.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店的面条特香，难怪每天都有人排队。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店的麵條特香，難怪每天都有人排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de miàntiáo tè xiāng, nánguài měitiān dōu yǒu rén páiduì.
sentences.translation: The noodles in this small shop are especially fragrant, so it is no wonder people queue every day.

sentences.chinese: 每个学生都有自己的特长，学校不应该只看考试成绩。
sentences.traditional: 每個學生都有自己的特長，學校不應該只看考試成績。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge xuésheng dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tècháng, xuéxiào bù yīnggāi zhǐ kàn kǎoshì chéngjì.
sentences.translation: Every student has their own strengths, and schools should not look only at exam results.

sentences.chinese: 他的特长是数据分析，所以很适合负责这个项目。
sentences.traditional: 他的特長是資料分析，所以很適合負責這個項目。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tècháng shì shùjù fēnxī, suǒyǐ hěn shìhé fùzé zhège xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: His strength is data analysis, so he is very suitable for being responsible for this project.

sentences.chinese: 面试时，你可以结合具体经历说明自己的特长。
sentences.traditional: 面試時，你可以結合具體經歷說明自己的特長。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì shí, nǐ kěyǐ jiéhé jùtǐ jīnglì shuōmíng zìjǐ de tècháng.
sentences.translation: During the interview, you can explain your strengths by referring to specific experience.

sentences.chinese: 他特地请了一天假，陪母亲去医院复查。
sentences.traditional: 他特地請了一天假，陪母親去醫院複查。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tèdì qǐng le yì tiān jià, péi mǔqīn qù yīyuàn fùchá.
sentences.translation: He specially took a day off to accompany his mother to the hospital for a follow-up check.

sentences.chinese: 为了参加这次会议，她特地从外地赶了回来。
sentences.traditional: 為了參加這次會議，她特地從外地趕了回來。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā zhè cì huìyì, tā tèdì cóng wàidì gǎn le huílai.
sentences.translation: In order to attend this meeting, she made a special trip back from another place.

sentences.chinese: 我特地提醒你，是因为这个细节很容易被忽视。
sentences.traditional: 我特地提醒你，是因為這個細節很容易被忽視。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tèdì tíxǐng nǐ, shì yīnwèi zhège xìjié hěn róngyì bèi hūshì.
sentences.translation: I am reminding you specifically because this detail is very easy to overlook.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策只适用于特定行业，并不影响普通消费者。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策只適用於特定行業，並不影響普通消費者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè zhǐ shìyòng yú tèdìng hángyè, bìng bù yǐngxiǎng pǔtōng xiāofèizhě.
sentences.translation: This policy applies only to specific industries and does not affect ordinary consumers.

sentences.chinese: 在特定条件下，这种材料会表现出更强的弹性。
sentences.traditional: 在特定條件下，這種材料會表現出更強的彈性。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tèdìng tiáojiàn xià, zhè zhǒng cáiliào huì biǎoxiàn chū gèng qiáng de tánxìng.
sentences.translation: Under specific conditions, this material shows greater elasticity.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员需要观察儿童在特定环境中的语言反应。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員需要觀察兒童在特定環境中的語言反應。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán xūyào guānchá értóng zài tèdìng huánjìng zhōng de yǔyán fǎnyìng.
sentences.translation: Researchers need to observe children’s language responses in a particular environment.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物的最大特性是能在干旱环境中存活。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物的最大特性是能在乾旱環境中存活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de zuì dà tèxìng shì néng zài gānhàn huánjìng zhōng cúnhuó.
sentences.translation: The main characteristic of this plant is that it can survive in dry environments.

sentences.chinese: 不同用户群体的特性会直接影响产品设计。
sentences.traditional: 不同用戶群體的特性會直接影響產品設計。
sentences.pinyin: Bùtóng yònghù qúntǐ de tèxìng huì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng chǎnpǐn shèjì.
sentences.translation: The characteristics of different user groups directly affect product design.

sentences.chinese: 要理解一种材料，必须先了解它的物理和化学特性。
sentences.traditional: 要理解一種材料，必須先了解它的物理和化學特性。
sentences.pinyin: Yào lǐjiě yì zhǒng cáiliào, bìxū xiān liǎojiě tā de wùlǐ hé huàxué tèxìng.
sentences.translation: To understand a material, you must first understand its physical and chemical characteristics.

sentences.chinese: 她特意把声音压低，免得吵醒正在睡觉的孩子。
sentences.traditional: 她特意把聲音壓低，免得吵醒正在睡覺的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tèyì bǎ shēngyīn yā dī, miǎnde chǎo xǐng zhèngzài shuìjiào de háizi.
sentences.translation: She deliberately lowered her voice so as not to wake the sleeping child.

sentences.chinese: 我不是偶然路过，而是特意来向你道歉的。
sentences.traditional: 我不是偶然路過，而是特意來向你道歉的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì ǒurán lùguò, ér shì tèyì lái xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn de.
sentences.translation: I did not happen to pass by; I came specially to apologise to you.

sentences.chinese: 他们特意保留了老建筑的外观，以延续城市记忆。
sentences.traditional: 他們特意保留了老建築的外觀，以延續城市記憶。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen tèyì bǎoliú le lǎo jiànzhù de wàiguān, yǐ yánxù chéngshì jìyì.
sentences.translation: They deliberately preserved the appearance of the old building to continue the city’s memory.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片的题材虽然沉重，却引发了广泛讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片的題材雖然沉重，卻引發了廣泛討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn de tícái suīrán chénzhòng, què yǐnfā le guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: The subject matter of this documentary is heavy, but it sparked wide discussion.

sentences.chinese: 小说选择了城市更新这一题材，写出了普通人的焦虑。
sentences.traditional: 小說選擇了城市更新這一題材，寫出了普通人的焦慮。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshuō xuǎnzé le chéngshì gēngxīn zhè yī tícái, xiě chū le pǔtōng rén de jiāolǜ.
sentences.translation: The novel chose urban renewal as its theme and portrayed the anxieties of ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 这种题材很容易流于说教，关键是人物要真实。
sentences.traditional: 這種題材很容易流於說教，關鍵是人物要真實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tícái hěn róngyì liú yú shuōjiào, guānjiàn shì rénwù yào zhēnshí.
sentences.translation: This kind of subject matter can easily become preachy; the key is for the characters to feel real.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员从样本中提取了少量有效成分。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員從樣本中提取了少量有效成分。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán cóng yàngběn zhōng tíqǔ le shǎoliàng yǒuxiào chéngfèn.
sentences.translation: The researchers extracted a small amount of active ingredients from the sample.

sentences.chinese: 系统会自动提取关键词，帮助用户快速浏览内容。
sentences.traditional: 系統會自動提取關鍵詞，幫助用戶快速瀏覽內容。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng tíqǔ guānjiàncí, bāngzhù yònghù kuàisù liúlǎn nèiróng.
sentences.translation: The system automatically extracts keywords to help users browse the content quickly.

sentences.chinese: 提取现金前，他仔细核对了账户余额。
sentences.traditional: 提取現金前，他仔細核對了賬戶餘額。
sentences.pinyin: Tíqǔ xiànjīn qián, tā zǐxì héduì le zhànghù yú'é.
sentences.translation: Before withdrawing cash, he carefully checked the account balance.

sentences.chinese: 页面上的错误提示不够清楚，很多用户不知道该怎么操作。
sentences.traditional: 頁面上的錯誤提示不夠清楚，很多用戶不知道該怎麼操作。
sentences.pinyin: Yèmiàn shàng de cuòwù tíshì bú gòu qīngchu, hěn duō yònghù bù zhīdào gāi zěnme cāozuò.
sentences.translation: The error prompt on the page is not clear enough, so many users do not know what to do.

sentences.chinese: 老师提示我们，答题时要先看清题目要求。
sentences.traditional: 老師提示我們，答題時要先看清題目要求。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíshì wǒmen, dātí shí yào xiān kàn qīng tímù yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: The teacher reminded us to read the question requirements clearly before answering.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告没有直接下结论，只是提示了潜在风险。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告沒有直接下結論，只是提示了潛在風險。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào méiyǒu zhíjiē xià jiélùn, zhǐ shì tíshì le qiánzài fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: This report did not draw a direct conclusion; it merely pointed out the potential risks.

sentences.chinese: 她从小练体操，所以身体的平衡能力特别强。
sentences.traditional: 她從小練體操，所以身體的平衡能力特別強。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo liàn tǐcāo, suǒyǐ shēntǐ de pínghéng nénglì tèbié qiáng.
sentences.translation: She has practised gymnastics since childhood, so her balance is particularly strong.

sentences.chinese: 体操比赛不仅考验力量，也考验动作的稳定性。
sentences.traditional: 體操比賽不僅考驗力量，也考驗動作的穩定性。
sentences.pinyin: Tǐcāo bǐsài bùjǐn kǎoyàn lìliàng, yě kǎoyàn dòngzuò de wěndìngxìng.
sentences.translation: Gymnastics competitions test not only strength but also the stability of movements.

sentences.chinese: 学校每天上午安排十分钟体操，让学生放松眼睛和肩膀。
sentences.traditional: 學校每天上午安排十分鐘體操，讓學生放鬆眼睛和肩膀。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào měi tiān shàngwǔ ānpái shí fēnzhōng tǐcāo, ràng xuéshēng fàngsōng yǎnjīng hé jiānbǎng.
sentences.translation: The school arranges ten minutes of exercises each morning so students can relax their eyes and shoulders.

sentences.chinese: 这种设备体积小，适合安装在普通家庭里。
sentences.traditional: 這種設備體積小，適合安裝在普通家庭裡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shèbèi tǐjī xiǎo, shìhé ānzhuāng zài pǔtōng jiātíng lǐ.
sentences.translation: This device is small in volume and is suitable for installation in ordinary homes.

sentences.chinese: 液体冷冻后体积会发生变化，容器不能装得太满。
sentences.traditional: 液體冷凍後體積會發生變化，容器不能裝得太滿。
sentences.pinyin: Yètǐ lěngdòng hòu tǐjī huì fāshēng biànhuà, róngqì bù néng zhuāng de tài mǎn.
sentences.translation: After a liquid freezes, its volume changes, so the container should not be filled too full.

sentences.chinese: 箱子的体积虽然不大，但里面能装下不少工具。
sentences.traditional: 箱子的體積雖然不大，但裡面能裝下不少工具。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngzi de tǐjī suīrán bú dà, dàn lǐmiàn néng zhuāng xià bù shǎo gōngjù.
sentences.translation: Although the box is not large in volume, it can hold quite a few tools.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在建立一套更完善的培训体系。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在建立一套更完善的培訓體系。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài jiànlì yí tào gèng wánshàn de péixùn tǐxì.
sentences.translation: The company is building a more complete training system.

sentences.chinese: 要解决这个问题，不能只看个案，还要分析整个法律体系。
sentences.traditional: 要解決這個問題，不能只看個案，還要分析整個法律體系。
sentences.pinyin: Yào jiějué zhè ge wèntí, bù néng zhǐ kàn gè'àn, hái yào fēnxī zhěnggè fǎlǜ tǐxì.
sentences.translation: To solve this problem, we cannot look only at individual cases; we also need to analyse the whole legal system.

sentences.chinese: 这套理论体系比较复杂，需要结合实际案例来理解。
sentences.traditional: 這套理論體系比較複雜，需要結合實際案例來理解。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào lǐlùn tǐxì bǐjiào fùzá, xūyào jiéhé shíjì ànlì lái lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: This theoretical system is fairly complex and needs to be understood through practical examples.

sentences.chinese: 她在汤里添了一点盐，味道立刻更自然了。
sentences.traditional: 她在湯裡添了一點鹽，味道立刻更自然了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài tāng lǐ tiān le yì diǎn yán, wèidào lìkè gèng zìrán le.
sentences.translation: She added a little salt to the soup, and the flavour immediately became more natural.

sentences.chinese: 新成员的加入给团队添了不少活力。
sentences.traditional: 新成員的加入給團隊添了不少活力。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn chéngyuán de jiārù gěi tuánduì tiān le bù shǎo huólì.
sentences.translation: The arrival of new members added a great deal of energy to the team.

sentences.chinese: 这场意外给原本紧张的计划又添了一层压力。
sentences.traditional: 這場意外給原本緊張的計劃又添了一層壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yìwài gěi yuánběn jǐnzhāng de jìhuà yòu tiān le yì céng yālì.
sentences.translation: This accident added another layer of pressure to an already tight plan.

sentences.chinese: 他不是单靠天才成功的，背后还有长期训练。
sentences.traditional: 他不是單靠天才成功的，背後還有長期訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì dān kào tiāncái chénggōng de, bèihòu hái yǒu chángqī xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: He did not succeed through genius alone; there was long-term training behind it.

sentences.chinese: 真正的天才往往能把复杂问题解释得很简单。
sentences.traditional: 真正的天才往往能把複雜問題解釋得很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de tiāncái wǎngwǎng néng bǎ fùzá wèntí jiěshì de hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.translation: A true genius can often explain complex problems very simply.

sentences.chinese: 外界把她称为数学天才，但她自己更强调勤奋。
sentences.traditional: 外界把她稱為數學天才，但她自己更強調勤奮。
sentences.pinyin: Wàijiè bǎ tā chēng wéi shùxué tiāncái, dàn tā zìjǐ gèng qiángdiào qínfèn.
sentences.translation: The outside world calls her a mathematical genius, but she herself emphasises hard work more.

sentences.chinese: 请在申请表中添加你的联系方式和紧急联系人。
sentences.traditional: 請在申請表中添加你的聯繫方式和緊急聯繫人。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài shēnqǐng biǎo zhōng tiānjiā nǐ de liánxì fāngshì hé jǐnjí liánxì rén.
sentences.translation: Please add your contact details and emergency contact to the application form.

sentences.chinese: 软件更新后，系统添加了语音识别功能。
sentences.traditional: 軟件更新後，系統添加了語音識別功能。
sentences.pinyin: Ruǎntǐ gēngxīn hòu, xìtǒng tiānjiā le yǔyīn shíbié gōngnéng.
sentences.translation: After the software update, the system added a speech recognition function.

sentences.chinese: 厨师建议不要添加太多调味料，以免盖住食材本身的味道。
sentences.traditional: 廚師建議不要添加太多調味料，以免蓋住食材本身的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Chúshī jiànyì bú yào tiānjiā tài duō tiáowèi liào, yǐmiǎn gài zhù shícái běnshēn de wèidào.
sentences.translation: The chef suggested not adding too much seasoning, so as not to cover the ingredients’ own flavour.

sentences.chinese: 这种布料使用天然纤维，穿起来比较舒服。
sentences.traditional: 這種布料使用天然纖維，穿起來比較舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bùliào shǐyòng tiānrán xiānwéi, chuān qǐ lái bǐjiào shūfu.
sentences.translation: This fabric uses natural fibres and feels relatively comfortable to wear.

sentences.chinese: 山区的天然环境保存得很好，吸引了许多研究者。
sentences.traditional: 山區的天然環境保存得很好，吸引了許多研究者。
sentences.pinyin: Shānqū de tiānrán huánjìng bǎocún de hěn hǎo, xīyǐn le xǔduō yánjiū zhě.
sentences.translation: The natural environment in the mountain area has been well preserved, attracting many researchers.

sentences.chinese: 她有一种天然的亲和力，第一次见面就让人放松。
sentences.traditional: 她有一種天然的親和力，第一次見面就讓人放鬆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǒu yì zhǒng tiānrán de qīnhélì, dì yī cì jiànmiàn jiù ràng rén fàngsōng.
sentences.translation: She has a natural warmth that makes people feel relaxed the first time they meet her.

sentences.chinese: 许多城市正在逐步减少对天然气的依赖，转向更多可再生能源。
sentences.traditional: 許多城市正在逐步減少對天然氣的依賴，轉向更多可再生能源。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō chéngshì zhèngzài zhúbù jiǎnshǎo duì tiānránqì de yīlài, zhuǎnxiàng gèng duō kě zàishēng néngyuán.
sentences.translation: Many cities are gradually reducing their reliance on natural gas and turning to more renewable energy.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂改用天然气后，排放量明显下降。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠改用天然氣後，排放量明顯下降。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng gǎiyòng tiānránqì hòu, páifàngliàng míngxiǎn xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: After this factory switched to natural gas, its emissions fell noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 如果天然气供应不稳定，冬季取暖成本可能会上升。
sentences.traditional: 如果天然氣供應不穩定，冬季取暖成本可能會上升。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tiānránqì gōngyìng bù wěndìng, dōngjì qǔnuǎn chéngběn kěnéng huì shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: If the natural gas supply is unstable, winter heating costs may rise.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候迷恋天文，常常半夜起来观察星空。
sentences.traditional: 他小時候迷戀天文，常常半夜起來觀察星空。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou míliàn tiānwén, chángcháng bànyè qǐ lái guānchá xīngkōng.
sentences.translation: He was fascinated by astronomy as a child and often got up at midnight to observe the stars.

sentences.chinese: 天文研究让人意识到，人类在宇宙中只是极小的一部分。
sentences.traditional: 天文研究讓人意識到，人類在宇宙中只是極小的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānwén yánjiū ràng rén yìshí dào, rénlèi zài yǔzhòu zhōng zhǐ shì jí xiǎo de yí bùfen.
sentences.translation: Astronomical research makes people realise that humanity is only a tiny part of the universe.

sentences.chinese: 这座博物馆新开了一个天文展，专门介绍行星的形成。
sentences.traditional: 這座博物館新開了一個天文展，專門介紹行星的形成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò bówùguǎn xīn kāi le yí ge tiānwén zhǎn, zhuānmén jièshào xíngxīng de xíngchéng.
sentences.translation: This museum has opened a new astronomy exhibition dedicated to explaining how planets form.

sentences.chinese: 他走遍天下，最后还是觉得家乡的饭菜最让人安心。
sentences.traditional: 他走遍天下，最後還是覺得家鄉的飯菜最讓人安心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒubiàn tiānxià, zuìhòu háishì juéde jiāxiāng de fàncài zuì ràng rén ānxīn.
sentences.translation: He travelled all over the world, but in the end he still felt most comforted by the food of his hometown.

sentences.chinese: 天下没有完全免费的选择，每个决定都有代价。
sentences.traditional: 天下沒有完全免費的選擇，每個決定都有代價。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānxià méiyǒu wánquán miǎnfèi de xuǎnzé, měi ge juédìng dōu yǒu dàijià.
sentences.translation: There is no completely free choice in the world; every decision has a cost.

sentences.chinese: 这位老师常说，天下的知识都值得保持好奇。
sentences.traditional: 這位老師常說，天下的知識都值得保持好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī cháng shuō, tiānxià de zhīshi dōu zhídé bǎochí hàoqí.
sentences.translation: This teacher often says that all the knowledge in the world is worth being curious about.

sentences.chinese: 她的想法有些天真，但其中也包含真诚的善意。
sentences.traditional: 她的想法有些天真，但其中也包含真誠的善意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ yǒuxiē tiānzhēn, dàn qízhōng yě bāohán zhēnchéng de shànyì.
sentences.translation: Her idea is somewhat naive, but it also contains sincere kindness.

sentences.chinese: 不能因为孩子天真，就随便否定他们提出的问题。
sentences.traditional: 不能因為孩子天真，就隨便否定他們提出的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Bù néng yīnwèi háizi tiānzhēn, jiù suíbiàn fǒudìng tāmen tíchū de wèntí.
sentences.translation: We should not casually dismiss the questions children raise just because they are innocent.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影用天真的视角讲述了一个沉重的时代。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影用天真的視角講述了一個沉重的時代。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yòng tiānzhēn de shìjiǎo jiǎngshù le yí ge chénzhòng de shídài.
sentences.translation: This film tells the story of a heavy era from an innocent perspective.

sentences.chinese: 这片田经过多年耕作，土壤已经变得十分肥沃。
sentences.traditional: 這片田經過多年耕作，土壤已經變得十分肥沃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn tián jīngguò duō nián gēngzuò, tǔrǎng yǐjīng biàn de shífēn féiwò.
sentences.translation: After many years of cultivation, this field’s soil has become very fertile.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷每天清晨都会到田里看看庄稼的长势。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺每天清晨都會到田裡看看莊稼的長勢。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye měi tiān qīngchén dū huì dào tián lǐ kànkan zhuāngjia de zhǎngshì.
sentences.translation: Grandad goes to the field every morning to check how the crops are growing.

sentences.chinese: 城市扩张太快，周围不少田被改成了住宅区。
sentences.traditional: 城市擴張太快，周圍不少田被改成了住宅區。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì kuòzhāng tài kuài, zhōuwéi bù shǎo tián bèi gǎichéng le zhùzháiqū.
sentences.translation: The city expanded too quickly, and many fields around it were turned into residential areas.

sentences.chinese: 学校的田径队每天下午都在操场训练。
sentences.traditional: 學校的田徑隊每天下午都在操場訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào de tiánjìng duì měi tiān xiàwǔ dōu zài cāochǎng xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: The school’s track and field team trains on the sports ground every afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 田径比赛看似简单，其实对速度、耐力和技术都有要求。
sentences.traditional: 田徑比賽看似簡單，其實對速度、耐力和技術都有要求。
sentences.pinyin: Tiánjìng bǐsài kàn sì jiǎndān, qíshí duì sùdù, nàilì hé jìshù dōu yǒu yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: Track and field competitions may look simple, but they actually require speed, endurance and technique.

sentences.chinese: 他受伤后暂停了田径训练，先把身体恢复好。
sentences.traditional: 他受傷後暫停了田徑訓練，先把身體恢復好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shòushāng hòu zàntíng le tiánjìng xùnliàn, xiān bǎ shēntǐ huīfù hǎo.
sentences.translation: After being injured, he paused his track and field training and focused first on recovering physically.

sentences.chinese: 空调可以自动调节温度，保持室内舒适。
sentences.traditional: 空調可以自動調節溫度，保持室內舒適。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngtiáo kěyǐ zìdòng tiáojié wēndù, bǎochí shìnèi shūshì.
sentences.translation: The air conditioner can automatically adjust the temperature and keep the room comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 政府需要通过政策调节市场，避免价格波动过大。
sentences.traditional: 政府需要通過政策調節市場，避免價格波動過大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xūyào tōngguò zhèngcè tiáojié shìchǎng, bìmiǎn jiàgé bōdòng guò dà.
sentences.translation: The government needs to regulate the market through policy and avoid excessive price fluctuations.

sentences.chinese: 她学会了调节情绪，不再把工作压力带回家。
sentences.traditional: 她學會了調節情緒，不再把工作壓力帶回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuéhuì le tiáojié qíngxù, bú zài bǎ gōngzuò yālì dài huí jiā.
sentences.translation: She learnt to regulate her emotions and no longer brings work pressure home.

sentences.chinese: 他从十岁开始练跳水，动作一直非常稳定。
sentences.traditional: 他從十歲開始練跳水，動作一直非常穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng shí suì kāishǐ liàn tiàoshuǐ, dòngzuò yìzhí fēicháng wěndìng.
sentences.translation: He has practised diving since the age of ten, and his movements have always been very steady.

sentences.chinese: 跳水项目对心理素质要求很高，不能被观众的声音影响。
sentences.traditional: 跳水項目對心理素質要求很高，不能被觀眾的聲音影響。
sentences.pinyin: Tiàoshuǐ xiàngmù duì xīnlǐ sùzhì yāoqiú hěn gāo, bù néng bèi guānzhòng de shēngyīn yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Diving events require strong mental qualities and cannot be affected by the noise of the audience.

sentences.chinese: 比赛中她完成了一次难度很大的跳水，赢得了全场掌声。
sentences.traditional: 比賽中她完成了一次難度很大的跳水，贏得了全場掌聲。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài zhōng tā wánchéng le yí cì nándù hěn dà de tiàoshuǐ, yíngdé le quánchǎng zhǎngshēng.
sentences.translation: During the competition, she completed a very difficult dive and won applause from the whole audience.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片贴近普通人的生活，所以很容易引起共鸣。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片貼近普通人的生活，所以很容易引起共鳴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tiējìn pǔtōng rén de shēnghuó, suǒyǐ hěn róngyì yǐnqǐ gòngmíng.
sentences.translation: This documentary is close to ordinary people’s lives, so it easily resonates with viewers.

sentences.chinese: 新政策的设计更贴近实际需求，而不是只停留在文件上。
sentences.traditional: 新政策的設計更貼近實際需求，而不是只停留在文件上。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè de shèjì gèng tiējìn shíjì xūqiú, ér bú shì zhǐ tíngliú zài wénjiàn shàng.
sentences.translation: The design of the new policy is closer to real needs rather than staying only on paper.

sentences.chinese: 为了听清对方的话，他把手机贴近耳边。
sentences.traditional: 為了聽清對方的話，他把手機貼近耳邊。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tīng qīng duìfāng de huà, tā bǎ shǒujī tiējìn ěrbiān.
sentences.translation: To hear the other person clearly, he pressed the phone close to his ear.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子平时很听话，但今天显得有些不安。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子平時很聽話，但今天顯得有些不安。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge háizi píngshí hěn tīnghuà, dàn jīntiān xiǎnde yǒuxiē bù'ān.
sentences.translation: This child is usually very well-behaved, but today seems a little uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 老师希望学生听话，不是希望他们失去独立思考。
sentences.traditional: 老師希望學生聽話，不是希望他們失去獨立思考。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xīwàng xuéshēng tīnghuà, bú shì xīwàng tāmen shīqù dúlì sīkǎo.
sentences.translation: Teachers want students to be obedient, not to lose their independent thinking.

sentences.chinese: 狗狗经过训练后很听话，能在复杂环境里保持冷静。
sentences.traditional: 狗狗經過訓練後很聽話，能在複雜環境裡保持冷靜。
sentences.pinyin: Gǒugou jīngguò xùnliàn hòu hěn tīnghuà, néng zài fùzá huánjìng lǐ bǎochí lěngjìng.
sentences.translation: After training, the dog is very obedient and can stay calm in complicated environments.

sentences.chinese: 长期戴耳机音量过大，可能会逐渐损害听觉。
sentences.traditional: 長期戴耳機音量過大，可能會逐漸損害聽覺。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī dài ěrjī yīnliàng guò dà, kěnéng huì zhújiàn sǔnhài tīngjué.
sentences.translation: Using earphones at too high a volume for a long time may gradually damage one’s sense of hearing.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影特别重视听觉效果，让观众仿佛置身现场。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影特別重視聽覺效果，讓觀眾彷彿置身現場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng tèbié zhòngshì tīngjué xiàoguǒ, ràng guānzhòng fǎngfú zhìshēn xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: This film places special emphasis on auditory effects, making the audience feel as if they are on the scene.

sentences.chinese: 对失明的人来说，敏锐的听觉能帮助他们判断周围环境。
sentences.traditional: 對失明的人來說，敏銳的聽覺能幫助他們判斷周圍環境。
sentences.pinyin: Duì shīmíng de rén lái shuō, mǐnruì de tīngjué néng bāngzhù tāmen pànduàn zhōuwéi huánjìng.
sentences.translation: For people who are blind, a sharp sense of hearing can help them judge their surroundings.

sentences.chinese: 领导在作出决定前，应该认真听取基层员工的意见。
sentences.traditional: 領導在作出決定前，應該認真聽取基層員工的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo zài zuòchū juédìng qián, yīnggāi rènzhēn tīngqǔ jīcéng yuángōng de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Before making a decision, leaders should carefully listen to the opinions of frontline employees.

sentences.chinese: 调查组听取了多方陈述，才公布最终结论。
sentences.traditional: 調查組聽取了多方陳述，才公佈最終結論。
sentences.pinyin: Diàocházǔ tīngqǔ le duō fāng chénshù, cái gōngbù zuìzhōng jiélùn.
sentences.translation: The investigation team listened to statements from several sides before announcing its final conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 如果只是表面听取建议，却从不调整做法，大家很快会失去信任。
sentences.traditional: 如果只是表面聽取建議，卻從不調整做法，大家很快會失去信任。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ shì biǎomiàn tīngqǔ jiànyì, què cóng bù tiáozhěng zuòfǎ, dàjiā hěn kuài huì shīqù xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: If suggestions are only listened to on the surface but practices are never adjusted, people will soon lose trust.

sentences.chinese: 地铁站临时关闭了一条通道，乘客只能从东门进出。
sentences.traditional: 地鐵站臨時關閉了一條通道，乘客只能從東門進出。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtiězhàn línshí guānbì le yì tiáo tōngdào, chéngkè zhǐ néng cóng dōngmén jìnchū.
sentences.translation: The metro station temporarily closed one passage, so passengers could only enter and exit through the east gate.

sentences.chinese: 数据通过加密通道传输，外部人员无法直接读取。
sentences.traditional: 數據通過加密通道傳輸，外部人員無法直接讀取。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù tōngguò jiāmì tōngdào chuánshū, wàibù rényuán wúfǎ zhíjiē dúqǔ.
sentences.translation: Data is transmitted through an encrypted channel, so outside personnel cannot read it directly.

sentences.chinese: 医院为急救车辆保留了一条专用通道。
sentences.traditional: 醫院為急救車輛保留了一條專用通道。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn wèi jíjiù chēliàng bǎoliú le yì tiáo zhuānyòng tōngdào.
sentences.translation: The hospital reserved a dedicated passage for emergency vehicles.

sentences.chinese: 新装修的房间至少要通风几周，再让孩子长期居住。
sentences.traditional: 新裝修的房間至少要通風幾週，再讓孩子長期居住。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhuāngxiū de fángjiān zhìshǎo yào tōngfēng jǐ zhōu, zài ràng háizi chángqī jūzhù.
sentences.translation: A newly renovated room should be ventilated for at least several weeks before a child lives there long-term.

sentences.chinese: 厨房如果通风不好，油烟很容易积在墙上。
sentences.traditional: 廚房如果通風不好，油煙很容易積在牆上。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfáng rúguǒ tōngfēng bù hǎo, yóuyān hěn róngyì jī zài qiáng shàng.
sentences.translation: If the kitchen is not well ventilated, cooking fumes can easily build up on the walls.

sentences.chinese: 会议室人太多，工作人员打开窗户通风。
sentences.traditional: 會議室人太多，工作人員打開窗戶通風。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì rén tài duō, gōngzuò rényuán dǎkāi chuānghu tōngfēng.
sentences.translation: There were too many people in the meeting room, so the staff opened the windows to ventilate it.

sentences.chinese: 我们通话了将近两个小时，终于把误会解释清楚了。
sentences.traditional: 我們通話了將近兩個小時，終於把誤會解釋清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen tōnghuà le jiāngjìn liǎng ge xiǎoshí, zhōngyú bǎ wùhuì jiěshì qīngchu le.
sentences.translation: We talked on the phone for nearly two hours and finally cleared up the misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 客服会在工作日与申请人通话，确认材料是否完整。
sentences.traditional: 客服會在工作日與申請人通話，確認材料是否完整。
sentences.pinyin: Kèfù huì zài gōngzuòrì yǔ shēnqǐng rén tōnghuà, quèrèn cáiliào shìfǒu wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: Customer service will speak with the applicant by phone on a working day to confirm whether the materials are complete.

sentences.chinese: 信号太弱时，两个人很难稳定地通话。
sentences.traditional: 訊號太弱時，兩個人很難穩定地通話。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnhào tài ruò shí, liǎng ge rén hěn nán wěndìng de tōnghuà.
sentences.translation: When the signal is too weak, it is hard for two people to talk on the phone steadily.

sentences.chinese: 两家公司一直通过电子邮件通信，以便留下完整记录。
sentences.traditional: 兩家公司一直通過電子郵件通信，以便留下完整記錄。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī yìzhí tōngguò diànzǐ yóujiàn tōngxìn, yǐbiàn liú xià wánzhěng jìlù.
sentences.translation: The two companies have been communicating by email in order to leave a complete record.

sentences.chinese: 在网络中断期间，救援队只能用无线电通信。
sentences.traditional: 在網絡中斷期間，救援隊只能用無線電通信。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǎngluò zhōngduàn qījiān, jiùyuánduì zhǐ néng yòng wúxiàndiàn tōngxìn.
sentences.translation: During the network outage, the rescue team could only communicate by radio.

sentences.chinese: 他和海外导师定期通信，讨论论文进展。
sentences.traditional: 他和海外導師定期通信，討論論文進展。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hé hǎiwài dǎoshī dìngqī tōngxìn, tǎolùn lùnwén jìnzhǎn.
sentences.translation: He communicates regularly with his overseas supervisor to discuss the progress of his thesis.

sentences.chinese: 灾区的通讯一度中断，家属无法确认亲人的情况。
sentences.traditional: 災區的通訊一度中斷，家屬無法確認親人的情況。
sentences.pinyin: Zāiqū de tōngxùn yídù zhōngduàn, jiāshǔ wúfǎ quèrèn qīnrén de qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Communications in the disaster area were interrupted for a time, and families could not confirm their relatives’ situations.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司为偏远地区建设了新的通讯设施。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司為偏遠地區建設了新的通訊設施。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī wèi piānyuǎn dìqū jiànshè le xīn de tōngxùn shèshī.
sentences.translation: This company built new communications facilities for remote areas.

sentences.chinese: 现代通讯技术让跨国合作变得更加高效。
sentences.traditional: 現代通訊技術讓跨國合作變得更加高效。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàndài tōngxùn jìshù ràng kuàguó hézuò biàn de gèngjiā gāoxiào.
sentences.translation: Modern communication technology has made international cooperation more efficient.

sentences.chinese: 这套安全标准在多个行业通用，执行起来比较方便。
sentences.traditional: 這套安全標準在多個行業通用，執行起來比較方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào ānquán biāozhǔn zài duō ge hángyè tōngyòng, zhíxíng qǐ lái bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This set of safety standards is commonly used across several industries, making it fairly convenient to implement.

sentences.chinese: 这种充电接口已经基本通用，出差时不用再带很多线。
sentences.traditional: 這種充電接口已經基本通用，出差時不用再帶很多線。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chōngdiàn jiēkǒu yǐjīng jīběn tōngyòng, chūchāi shí bú yòng zài dài hěn duō xiàn.
sentences.translation: This kind of charging port is now basically in common use, so there is no need to carry many cables on business trips.

sentences.chinese: 如果格式不能在不同系统之间通用，数据交换就会很麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 如果格式不能在不同系統之間通用，數據交換就會很麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ géshì bù néng zài bùtóng xìtǒng zhījiān tōngyòng, shùjù jiāohuàn jiù huì hěn máfan.
sentences.translation: If a format cannot be used across different systems, data exchange becomes very troublesome.

sentences.chinese: 这座雕像表面覆盖着一层铜，几年后颜色会慢慢变深。
sentences.traditional: 這座雕像表面覆蓋著一層銅，幾年後顏色會慢慢變深。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò diāoxiàng biǎomiàn fùgài zhe yì céng tóng, jǐ nián hòu yánsè huì mànmàn biàn shēn.
sentences.translation: The surface of this statue is covered with a layer of copper, and its colour will slowly darken after a few years.

sentences.chinese: 铜的导电性能很好，因此常被用于电线制造。
sentences.traditional: 銅的導電性能很好，因此常被用於電線製造。
sentences.pinyin: Tóng de dǎodiàn xìngnéng hěn hǎo, yīncǐ cháng bèi yòng yú diànxiàn zhìzào.
sentences.translation: Copper conducts electricity very well, so it is often used in making electric wires.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展出了一面古代铜镜，保存得相当完整。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展出了一面古代銅鏡，保存得相當完整。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū le yí miàn gǔdài tóngjìng, bǎocún de xiāngdāng wánzhěng.
sentences.translation: The museum displayed an ancient bronze mirror that had been preserved quite completely.

sentences.chinese: 登山时要随时留意同伴的体力，不能只顾自己向前走。
sentences.traditional: 登山時要隨時留意同伴的體力，不能只顧自己向前走。
sentences.pinyin: Dēngshān shí yào suíshí liúyì tóngbàn de tǐlì, bù néng zhǐ gù zìjǐ xiàng qián zǒu.
sentences.translation: When climbing a mountain, you should always pay attention to your companion’s strength and not just push ahead yourself.

sentences.chinese: 在陌生城市里，有一个可靠的同伴会让人安心许多。
sentences.traditional: 在陌生城市裡，有一個可靠的同伴會讓人安心許多。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mòshēng chéngshì lǐ, yǒu yí ge kěkào de tóngbàn huì ràng rén ānxīn xǔduō.
sentences.translation: In an unfamiliar city, having a reliable companion can make one feel much more at ease.

sentences.chinese: 科研项目往往需要同伴之间长期合作，而不是个人单打独斗。
sentences.traditional: 科研項目往往需要同伴之間長期合作，而不是個人單打獨鬥。
sentences.pinyin: Kēyán xiàngmù wǎngwǎng xūyào tóngbàn zhījiān chángqī hézuò, ér bú shì gèrén dāndǎ dúdòu.
sentences.translation: Research projects often require long-term cooperation among companions rather than individuals fighting alone.

sentences.chinese: 作为同行，他能理解我在这个行业里遇到的压力。
sentences.traditional: 作為同行，他能理解我在這個行業裡遇到的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi tóngháng, tā néng lǐjiě wǒ zài zhège hángyè lǐ yùdào de yālì.
sentences.translation: As a colleague in the same profession, he can understand the pressure I face in this industry.

sentences.chinese: 这次培训吸引了许多法律同行前来交流经验。
sentences.traditional: 這次培訓吸引了許多法律同行前來交流經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì péixùn xīyǐn le xǔduō fǎlǜ tóngháng qiánlái jiāoliú jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: This training attracted many colleagues from the legal profession to come and exchange experience.

sentences.chinese: 虽然我们是同行，但在技术路线上有不同看法。
sentences.traditional: 雖然我們是同行，但在技術路線上有不同看法。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen shì tóngháng, dàn zài jìshù lùxiàn shàng yǒu bùtóng kànfǎ.
sentences.translation: Although we are in the same profession, we have different views on the technical direction.

sentences.chinese: 这部动画改编自一则北欧童话，但加入了现代环保主题。
sentences.traditional: 這部動畫改編自一則北歐童話，但加入了現代環保主題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù dònghuà gǎibiān zì yì zé Běi'ōu tónghuà, dàn jiārù le xiàndài huánbǎo zhǔtí.
sentences.translation: This animation is adapted from a Nordic fairy tale, but it adds a modern environmental theme.

sentences.chinese: 孩子听完童话后，开始讨论故事里的选择是否公平。
sentences.traditional: 孩子聽完童話後，開始討論故事裡的選擇是否公平。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tīng wán tónghuà hòu, kāishǐ tǎolùn gùshi lǐ de xuǎnzé shìfǒu gōngpíng.
sentences.translation: After listening to the fairy tale, the child began discussing whether the choices in the story were fair.

sentences.chinese: 她用童话的形式表达了对战争和贫困的反思。
sentences.traditional: 她用童話的形式表達了對戰爭和貧困的反思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng tónghuà de xíngshì biǎodá le duì zhànzhēng hé pínkùn de fǎnsī.
sentences.translation: She expressed her reflections on war and poverty in the form of a fairy tale.

sentences.chinese: 这种药物与同类产品相比，副作用更小。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥物與同類產品相比，副作用更小。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàowù yǔ tónglèi chǎnpǐn xiāngbǐ, fùzuòyòng gèng xiǎo.
sentences.translation: Compared with similar products, this medicine has fewer side effects.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员把同类样本放在一起，便于观察差异。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員把同類樣本放在一起，便於觀察差異。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán bǎ tónglèi yàngběn fàng zài yìqǐ, biànyú guānchá chāyì.
sentences.translation: The researchers put samples of the same kind together to make it easier to observe differences.

sentences.chinese: 平台会根据用户的阅读记录推荐同类内容。
sentences.traditional: 平臺會根據用戶的閱讀記錄推薦同類內容。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái huì gēnjù yònghù de yuèdú jìlù tuījiàn tónglèi nèiróng.
sentences.translation: The platform recommends similar content based on the user’s reading history.

sentences.chinese: 她在决赛中获得铜牌，赛后仍然激动得落泪。
sentences.traditional: 她在決賽中獲得銅牌，賽後仍然激動得落淚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài juésài zhōng huòdé tóngpái, sài hòu réngrán jīdòng de luòlèi.
sentences.translation: She won a bronze medal in the final and was still moved to tears afterwards.

sentences.chinese: 这枚铜牌虽然不是金牌，却代表了多年坚持。
sentences.traditional: 這枚銅牌雖然不是金牌，卻代表了多年堅持。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè méi tóngpái suīrán bú shì jīnpái, què dàibiǎo le duō nián jiānchí.
sentences.translation: Although this bronze medal is not a gold medal, it represents years of persistence.

sentences.chinese: 教练认为那块铜牌证明了年轻队伍的潜力。
sentences.traditional: 教練認為那塊銅牌證明了年輕隊伍的潛力。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoliàn rènwéi nà kuài tóngpái zhèngmíng le niánqīng duìwǔ de qiánlì.
sentences.translation: The coach believes that bronze medal proved the young team’s potential.

sentences.chinese: 把积压已久的问题说出来后，他感到十分痛快。
sentences.traditional: 把積壓已久的問題說出來後，他感到十分痛快。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎ jīyā yǐ jiǔ de wèntí shuō chūlái hòu, tā gǎndào shífēn tòngkuài.
sentences.translation: After saying aloud the problem that had been building up for a long time, he felt greatly relieved.

sentences.chinese: 这场比赛赢得痛快，队员们终于释放了压力。
sentences.traditional: 這場比賽贏得痛快，隊員們終於釋放了壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài yíng de tòngkuài, duìyuánmen zhōngyú shìfàng le yālì.
sentences.translation: The team won this match in a satisfying way, and the players finally released their pressure.

sentences.chinese: 老朋友见面后聊得很痛快，谁也不愿先离开。
sentences.traditional: 老朋友見面後聊得很痛快，誰也不願先離開。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo péngyou jiànmiàn hòu liáo de hěn tòngkuài, shéi yě bú yuàn xiān líkāi.
sentences.translation: After meeting up, the old friends chatted with great enjoyment, and no one wanted to leave first.

sentences.chinese: 他承认自己偷了公司的资料，但拒绝说明动机。
sentences.traditional: 他承認自己偷了公司的資料，但拒絕說明動機。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chéngrèn zìjǐ tōu le gōngsī de zīliào, dàn jùjué shuōmíng dòngjī.
sentences.translation: He admitted that he had stolen the company’s materials, but refused to explain his motive.

sentences.chinese: 在任何情况下，都不应该偷别人的研究成果。
sentences.traditional: 在任何情況下，都不應該偷別人的研究成果。
sentences.pinyin: Zài rènhé qíngkuàng xià, dōu bù yīnggāi tōu biérén de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
sentences.translation: Under no circumstances should one steal other people’s research results.

sentences.chinese: 他偷着把账本复印了一份，准备交给调查人员。
sentences.traditional: 他偷著把賬本複印了一份，準備交給調查人員。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōu zhe bǎ zhàngběn fùyìn le yí fèn, zhǔnbèi jiāo gěi diàochá rényuán.
sentences.translation: He secretly made a copy of the account book and prepared to hand it to the investigators.

sentences.chinese: 他偷偷把资料备份到私人邮箱，后来受到处分。
sentences.traditional: 他偷偷把資料備份到私人郵箱，後來受到處分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōutōu bǎ zīliào bèifèn dào sīrén yóuxiāng, hòulái shòudào chǔfèn.
sentences.translation: He secretly backed up the materials to a private email account and was later disciplined.

sentences.chinese: 孩子偷偷躲在门后，想听大人们怎么讨论这件事。
sentences.traditional: 孩子偷偷躲在門後，想聽大人們怎麼討論這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi tōutōu duǒ zài mén hòu, xiǎng tīng dàrénmen zěnme tǎolùn zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: The child secretly hid behind the door, wanting to hear how the adults discussed the matter.

sentences.chinese: 她偷偷练习了几个月，比赛时给所有人一个惊喜。
sentences.traditional: 她偷偷練習了幾個月，比賽時給所有人一個驚喜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōutōu liànxí le jǐ ge yuè, bǐsài shí gěi suǒyǒu rén yí ge jīngxǐ.
sentences.translation: She practised secretly for several months and surprised everyone during the competition.

sentences.chinese: 面对复杂局面，领导者必须保持清醒的头脑。
sentences.traditional: 面對複雜局面，領導者必須保持清醒的頭腦。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì fùzá júmiàn, lǐngdǎo zhě bìxū bǎochí qīngxǐng de tóunǎo.
sentences.translation: Facing a complex situation, a leader must keep a clear mind.

sentences.chinese: 他头脑灵活，很快就找到了降低成本的办法。
sentences.traditional: 他頭腦靈活，很快就找到了降低成本的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tóunǎo línghuó, hěn kuài jiù zhǎodào le jiàngdī chéngběn de bànfǎ.
sentences.translation: He is quick-minded and soon found a way to reduce costs.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告逻辑清楚，说明作者很有头脑。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告邏輯清楚，說明作者很有頭腦。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào luóji qīngchu, shuōmíng zuòzhě hěn yǒu tóunǎo.
sentences.translation: This report is logically clear, showing that the author is very capable and clear-headed.

sentences.chinese: 全体成员将在明天投票决定是否修改章程。
sentences.traditional: 全體成員將在明天投票決定是否修改章程。
sentences.pinyin: Quántǐ chéngyuán jiāng zài míngtiān tóupiào juédìng shìfǒu xiūgǎi zhāngchéng.
sentences.translation: All members will vote tomorrow to decide whether to revise the charter.

sentences.chinese: 许多居民通过网络投票表达了对新方案的态度。
sentences.traditional: 許多居民通過網絡投票表達了對新方案的態度。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō jūmín tōngguò wǎngluò tóupiào biǎodá le duì xīn fāng'àn de tàidu.
sentences.translation: Many residents expressed their attitude towards the new plan through online voting.

sentences.chinese: 投票前，候选人需要公开说明自己的政策主张。
sentences.traditional: 投票前，候選人需要公開說明自己的政策主張。
sentences.pinyin: Tóupiào qián, hòuxuǎn rén xūyào gōngkāi shuōmíng zìjǐ de zhèngcè zhǔzhāng.
sentences.translation: Before the vote, candidates need to publicly explain their policy positions.

sentences.chinese: 如果服务长期没有改善，消费者有权正式投诉。
sentences.traditional: 如果服務長期沒有改善，消費者有權正式投訴。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ fúwù chángqī méiyǒu gǎishàn, xiāofèi zhě yǒu quán zhèngshì tóusù.
sentences.translation: If the service does not improve for a long time, consumers have the right to make a formal complaint.

sentences.chinese: 他向平台投诉商家虚假宣传，并提交了相关证据。
sentences.traditional: 他向平臺投訴商家虛假宣傳，並提交了相關證據。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng píngtái tóusù shāngjiā xūjiǎ xuānchuán, bìng tíjiāo le xiāngguān zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: He complained to the platform about the seller’s false advertising and submitted relevant evidence.

sentences.chinese: 公司设立了热线，专门处理客户投诉。
sentences.traditional: 公司設立了熱線，專門處理客戶投訴。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī shèlì le rèxiàn, zhuānmén chǔlǐ kèhù tóusù.
sentences.translation: The company set up a hotline specifically to handle customer complaints.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司决定投资新能源项目，以降低未来的运营成本。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司決定投資新能源項目，以降低未來的運營成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī juédìng tóuzī xīn néngyuán xiàngmù, yǐ jiàngdī wèilái de yùnyíng chéngběn.
sentences.translation: This company has decided to invest in new energy projects in order to reduce future operating costs.

sentences.chinese: 这笔投资风险不低，但回报也相当可观。
sentences.traditional: 這筆投資風險不低，但回報也相當可觀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǐ tóuzī fēngxiǎn bù dī, dàn huíbào yě xiāngdāng kěguān.
sentences.translation: This investment carries considerable risk, but the return is also quite attractive.

sentences.chinese: 政府增加对职业教育的投资，是为了提升劳动者的技能水平。
sentences.traditional: 政府增加對職業教育的投資，是為了提升勞動者的技能水平。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zēngjiā duì zhíyè jiàoyù de tóuzī, shì wèile tíshēng láodòng zhě de jìnéng shuǐpíng.
sentences.translation: The government is increasing investment in vocational education in order to improve workers’ skill levels.

sentences.chinese: 光线太强，窗帘几乎挡不住，阳光全透进来了。
sentences.traditional: 光線太強，窗簾幾乎擋不住，陽光全透進來了。
sentences.pinyin: Guāngxiàn tài qiáng, chuānglián jīhū dǎng bú zhù, yángguāng quán tòu jìnlai le.
sentences.translation: The light is so strong that the curtains can hardly block it, and the sunlight is coming right through.

sentences.chinese: 这件白衬衫太薄，在强光下有点透。
sentences.traditional: 這件白襯衫太薄，在強光下有點透。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn bái chènshān tài báo, zài qiángguāng xià yǒudiǎn tòu.
sentences.translation: This white shirt is too thin and becomes a bit see-through under strong light.

sentences.chinese: 他把政策研究得很透，所以回答问题时特别有把握。
sentences.traditional: 他把政策研究得很透，所以回答問題時特別有把握。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhèngcè yánjiū de hěn tòu, suǒyǐ huídá wèntí shí tèbié yǒu bǎwò.
sentences.translation: He has studied the policy very thoroughly, so he is especially confident when answering questions.

sentences.chinese: 透过这组数据，我们能看到消费习惯正在发生变化。
sentences.traditional: 透過這組數據，我們能看到消費習慣正在發生變化。
sentences.pinyin: Tòuguò zhè zǔ shùjù, wǒmen néng kàndào xiāofèi xíguàn zhèngzài fāshēng biànhuà.
sentences.translation: Through this set of data, we can see that consumption habits are changing.

sentences.chinese: 她透过玻璃看见孩子们在院子里练习体操。
sentences.traditional: 她透過玻璃看見孩子們在院子裡練習體操。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tòuguò bōli kànjiàn háizimen zài yuànzi lǐ liànxí tǐcāo.
sentences.translation: She saw the children practising gymnastics in the courtyard through the glass.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片透过普通家庭的生活，展示了城市发展的另一面。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片透過普通家庭的生活，展示了城市發展的另一面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tòuguò pǔtōng jiātíng de shēnghuó, zhǎnshì le chéngshì fāzhǎn de lìng yí miàn.
sentences.translation: This documentary shows another side of urban development through the lives of ordinary families.

sentences.chinese: 经理在会议上透露，公司下半年可能会调整销售策略。
sentences.traditional: 經理在會議上透露，公司下半年可能會調整銷售策略。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huìyì shàng tòulù, gōngsī xià bànnián kěnéng huì tiáozhěng xiāoshòu cèlüè.
sentences.translation: The manager revealed at the meeting that the company may adjust its sales strategy in the second half of the year.

sentences.chinese: 这封邮件透露出团队内部沟通不够顺畅的问题。
sentences.traditional: 這封郵件透露出團隊內部溝通不夠順暢的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng yóujiàn tòulù chū tuánduì nèibù gōutōng bú gòu shùnchàng de wèntí.
sentences.translation: This email reveals the problem of poor communication within the team.

sentences.chinese: 警方没有透露案件细节，只确认调查仍在进行。
sentences.traditional: 警方沒有透露案件細節，只確認調查仍在進行。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng méiyǒu tòulù ànjiàn xìjié, zhǐ quèrèn diàochá réng zài jìnxíng.
sentences.translation: The police did not reveal the details of the case, only confirming that the investigation is still ongoing.

sentences.chinese: 这个机构承诺让预算使用更加透明，接受社会监督。
sentences.traditional: 這個機構承諾讓預算使用更加透明，接受社會監督。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jīgòu chéngnuò ràng yùsuàn shǐyòng gèngjiā tòumíng, jiēshòu shèhuì jiāndū.
sentences.translation: This organisation promises to make the use of its budget more transparent and accept public oversight.

sentences.chinese: 透明的沟通机制可以减少员工之间的误解。
sentences.traditional: 透明的溝通機制可以減少員工之間的誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Tòumíng de gōutōng jīzhì kěyǐ jiǎnshǎo yuángōng zhījiān de wùjiě.
sentences.translation: A transparent communication mechanism can reduce misunderstandings among employees.

sentences.chinese: 这种材料接近透明，适合用来制作展示窗口。
sentences.traditional: 這種材料接近透明，適合用來製作展示窗口。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào jiējìn tòumíng, shìhé yòng lái zhìzuò zhǎnshì chuāngkǒu.
sentences.translation: This material is nearly transparent and is suitable for making display windows.

sentences.chinese: 面对突发事件，学校必须及时通知家长并保护学生安全。
sentences.traditional: 面對突發事件，學校必須及時通知家長並保護學生安全。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā shìjiàn, xuéxiào bìxū jíshí tōngzhī jiāzhǎng bìng bǎohù xuéshēng ānquán.
sentences.translation: When facing a sudden incident, the school must promptly inform parents and protect students’ safety.

sentences.chinese: 会议因一项突发任务被临时推迟到下午。
sentences.traditional: 會議因一項突發任務被臨時推遲到下午。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yīn yí xiàng tūfā rènwù bèi línshí tuīchí dào xiàwǔ.
sentences.translation: The meeting was temporarily postponed until the afternoon because of an unexpected task.

sentences.chinese: 如果设备突发故障，系统会自动切换到备用通道。
sentences.traditional: 如果設備突發故障，系統會自動切換到備用通道。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shèbèi tūfā gùzhàng, xìtǒng huì zìdòng qiēhuàn dào bèiyòng tōngdào.
sentences.translation: If the equipment suddenly breaks down, the system will automatically switch to a backup channel.

sentences.chinese: 科研团队在电池技术上取得了重要突破。
sentences.traditional: 科研團隊在電池技術上取得了重要突破。
sentences.pinyin: Kēyán tuánduì zài diànchí jìshù shàng qǔdé le zhòngyào tūpò.
sentences.translation: The research team has made an important breakthrough in battery technology.

sentences.chinese: 如果想突破传统模式，企业需要更灵活的管理体系。
sentences.traditional: 如果想突破傳統模式，企業需要更靈活的管理體系。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng tūpò chuántǒng móshì, qǐyè xūyào gèng línghuó de guǎnlǐ tǐxì.
sentences.translation: To break through the traditional model, a company needs a more flexible management system.

sentences.chinese: 运动员在决赛中突破了个人最好成绩。
sentences.traditional: 運動員在決賽中突破了個人最好成績。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán zài juésài zhōng tūpò le gèrén zuì hǎo chéngjì.
sentences.translation: The athlete broke through his personal best in the final.

sentences.chinese: 这条围巾上的图案来自当地传统手工艺。
sentences.traditional: 這條圍巾上的圖案來自當地傳統手工藝。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo wéijīn shàng de tú'àn láizì dāngdì chuántǒng shǒugōngyì.
sentences.translation: The pattern on this scarf comes from local traditional handicrafts.

sentences.chinese: 设计师把几何图案和自然元素结合在一起。
sentences.traditional: 設計師把幾何圖案和自然元素結合在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī bǎ jǐhé tú'àn hé zìrán yuánsù jiéhé zài yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: The designer combined geometric patterns with natural elements.

sentences.chinese: 包装上的图案过于复杂，反而影响了品牌识别度。
sentences.traditional: 包裝上的圖案過於複雜，反而影響了品牌識別度。
sentences.pinyin: Bāozhuāng shàng de tú'àn guòyú fùzá, fǎn'ér yǐngxiǎng le pǐnpái shíbié dù.
sentences.translation: The pattern on the packaging is too complicated and actually affects brand recognition.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告通过图表展示了近五年的收入变化。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告通過圖表展示了近五年的收入變化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào tōngguò túbiǎo zhǎnshì le jìn wǔ nián de shōurù biànhuà.
sentences.translation: This report uses charts to show changes in income over the past five years.

sentences.chinese: 图表虽然简单，却能帮助读者迅速理解趋势。
sentences.traditional: 圖表雖然簡單，卻能幫助讀者迅速理解趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Túbiǎo suīrán jiǎndān, què néng bāngzhù dúzhě xùnsù lǐjiě qūshì.
sentences.translation: Although the chart is simple, it can help readers quickly understand the trend.

sentences.chinese: 开会前，请把关键数据整理成清晰的图表。
sentences.traditional: 開會前，請把關鍵數據整理成清晰的圖表。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì qián, qǐng bǎ guānjiàn shùjù zhěnglǐ chéng qīngxī de túbiǎo.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting, please organise the key data into clear charts.

sentences.chinese: 老师傅对徒弟要求严格，希望他真正掌握基本功。
sentences.traditional: 老師傅對徒弟要求嚴格，希望他真正掌握基本功。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo shīfu duì túdì yāoqiú yángé, xīwàng tā zhēnzhèng zhǎngwò jīběngōng.
sentences.translation: The old master is strict with his apprentice, hoping he will truly master the basic skills.

sentences.chinese: 这个年轻徒弟虽然经验不多，但学习态度非常认真。
sentences.traditional: 這個年輕徒弟雖然經驗不多，但學習態度非常認真。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège niánqīng túdì suīrán jīngyàn bù duō, dàn xuéxí tàidu fēicháng rènzhēn.
sentences.translation: Although this young apprentice does not have much experience, his attitude to learning is very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他收了三个徒弟，把传统书画技法传了下去。
sentences.traditional: 他收了三個徒弟，把傳統書畫技法傳了下去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōu le sān ge túdì, bǎ chuántǒng shūhuà jìfǎ chuán le xiàqu.
sentences.translation: He took on three apprentices and passed down the traditional calligraphy and painting techniques.

sentences.chinese: 解决这个问题不能只靠行政命令，还需要更稳定的法律途径。
sentences.traditional: 解決這個問題不能只靠行政命令，還需要更穩定的法律途徑。
sentences.pinyin: Jiějué zhège wèntí bùnéng zhǐ kào xíngzhèng mìnglìng, hái xūyào gèng wěndìng de fǎlǜ tújìng.
sentences.translation: Solving this problem cannot rely only on administrative orders; it also needs more stable legal channels.

sentences.chinese: 学校为学生提供了多种申请奖学金的途径。
sentences.traditional: 學校為學生提供了多種申請獎學金的途徑。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi xuéshēng tígōng le duō zhǒng shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn de tújìng.
sentences.translation: The school provides students with several ways to apply for scholarships.

sentences.chinese: 通过正规途径获得的信息，比网上的传言更可靠。
sentences.traditional: 通過正規途徑獲得的信息，比網上的傳言更可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò zhèngguī tújìng huòdé de xìnxī, bǐ wǎngshàng de chuányán gèng kěkào.
sentences.translation: Information obtained through formal channels is more reliable than rumours online.

sentences.chinese: 医生根据图像判断伤口是否已经影响到骨头。
sentences.traditional: 醫生根據圖像判斷傷口是否已經影響到骨頭。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gēnjù túxiàng pànduàn shāngkǒu shìfǒu yǐjīng yǐngxiǎng dào gǔtou.
sentences.translation: The doctor judged from the image whether the wound had already affected the bone.

sentences.chinese: 这台设备可以把卫星拍到的图像直接传回实验室。
sentences.traditional: 這臺設備可以把衛星拍到的圖像直接傳回實驗室。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái shèbèi kěyǐ bǎ wèixīng pāi dào de túxiàng zhíjiē chuán huí shíyànshì.
sentences.translation: This device can send images taken by the satellite directly back to the laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 经过处理后，模糊的图像变得清晰多了。
sentences.traditional: 經過處理後，模糊的圖像變得清晰多了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò chǔlǐ hòu, móhu de túxiàng biàn de qīngxī duō le.
sentences.translation: After processing, the blurry image became much clearer.

sentences.chinese: 在公共场所随地吐口水既不卫生，也很不礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 在公共場所隨地吐口水既不衛生，也很不禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ suídì tǔ kǒushuǐ jì bù wèishēng, yě hěn bù lǐmào.
sentences.translation: Spitting in public places is both unhygienic and very impolite.

sentences.chinese: 他说话太急，差点把嘴里的饭吐出来。
sentences.traditional: 他說話太急，差點把嘴裡的飯吐出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà tài jí, chàdiǎn bǎ zuǐ lǐ de fàn tǔ chūlái.
sentences.translation: He spoke in such a hurry that he almost spat out the food in his mouth.

sentences.chinese: 孩子不小心把牙膏吐到了洗手池外面。
sentences.traditional: 孩子不小心把牙膏吐到了洗手池外面。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bù xiǎoxīn bǎ yágāo tǔ dào le xǐshǒuchí wàimiàn.
sentences.translation: The child accidentally spat the toothpaste outside the sink.

sentences.chinese: 长期使用化学肥料，可能会改变土壤的结构。
sentences.traditional: 長期使用化學肥料，可能會改變土壤的結構。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī shǐyòng huàxué féiliào, kěnéng huì gǎibiàn tǔrǎng de jiégòu.
sentences.translation: Long-term use of chemical fertilisers may change the structure of the soil.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物适合种在排水良好的土壤里。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物適合種在排水良好的土壤裡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù shìhé zhòng zài páishuǐ liánghǎo de tǔrǎng lǐ.
sentences.translation: This kind of plant is suitable for growing in well-drained soil.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员正在检测这片土地的土壤污染程度。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員正在檢測這片土地的土壤污染程度。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán zhèngzài jiǎncè zhè piàn tǔdì de tǔrǎng wūrǎn chéngdù.
sentences.translation: Researchers are testing the level of soil pollution on this piece of land.

sentences.chinese: 他晕车很严重，刚下车就吐了。
sentences.traditional: 他暈車很嚴重，剛下車就吐了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yùnchē hěn yánzhòng, gāng xià chē jiù tù le.
sentences.translation: He gets carsick badly and vomited as soon as he got out of the car.

sentences.chinese: 食物如果不新鲜，吃了以后可能会让人吐。
sentences.traditional: 食物如果不新鮮，吃了以後可能會讓人吐。
sentences.pinyin: Shíwù rúguǒ bù xīnxiān, chī le yǐhòu kěnéng huì ràng rén tù.
sentences.translation: If food is not fresh, it may make people vomit after eating it.

sentences.chinese: 孩子半夜突然吐了两次，父母赶紧联系医生。
sentences.traditional: 孩子半夜突然吐了兩次，父母趕緊聯繫醫生。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bànyè tūrán tù le liǎng cì, fùmǔ gǎnjǐn liánxì yīshēng.
sentences.translation: The child suddenly vomited twice in the middle of the night, so the parents quickly contacted a doctor.

sentences.chinese: 面对困难时，团队越团结，解决问题的能力就越强。
sentences.traditional: 面對困難時，團隊越團結，解決問題的能力就越強。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan shí, tuánduì yuè tuánjié, jiějué wèntí de nénglì jiù yuè qiáng.
sentences.translation: When facing difficulties, the more united a team is, the stronger its ability to solve problems becomes.

sentences.chinese: 这次活动把不同部门的员工团结在了一起。
sentences.traditional: 這次活動把不同部門的員工團結在了一起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng bǎ bùtóng bùmén de yuángōng tuánjié zài le yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: This activity united employees from different departments.

sentences.chinese: 真正团结的班级，遇到压力时不会互相指责。
sentences.traditional: 真正團結的班級，遇到壓力時不會互相指責。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng tuánjié de bānjí, yù dào yālì shí bú huì hùxiāng zhǐzé.
sentences.translation: A truly united class will not blame each other when under pressure.

sentences.chinese: 这个团体长期关注儿童阅读和社区教育。
sentences.traditional: 這個團體長期關注兒童閱讀和社區教育。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège tuántǐ chángqī guānzhù értóng yuèdú hé shèqū jiàoyù.
sentences.translation: This group has long focused on children’s reading and community education.

sentences.chinese: 申请场地时，个人和团体需要提交不同的材料。
sentences.traditional: 申請場地時，個人和團體需要提交不同的材料。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng chǎngdì shí, gèrén hé tuántǐ xūyào tíjiāo bùtóng de cáiliào.
sentences.translation: When applying for a venue, individuals and groups need to submit different materials.

sentences.chinese: 任何团体都应遵守公开透明的财务制度。
sentences.traditional: 任何團體都應遵守公開透明的財務制度。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé tuántǐ dōu yīng zūnshǒu gōngkāi tòumíng de cáiwù zhìdù.
sentences.translation: Any group should follow an open and transparent financial system.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，许多人都会赶回家和亲人团圆。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，許多人都會趕回家和親人團圓。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, xǔduō rén dōu huì gǎn huí jiā hé qīnrén tuányuán.
sentences.translation: During the Spring Festival, many people rush home to reunite with their relatives.

sentences.chinese: 战乱结束后，这一家人才终于团圆。
sentences.traditional: 戰亂結束後，這一家人才終於團圓。
sentences.pinyin: Zhànluàn jiéshù hòu, zhè yì jiā rén cái zhōngyú tuányuán.
sentences.translation: After the war ended, this family was finally reunited.

sentences.chinese: 虽然大家住在不同城市，但每年中秋都会设法团圆。
sentences.traditional: 雖然大家住在不同城市，但每年中秋都會設法團圓。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán dàjiā zhù zài bùtóng chéngshì, dàn měi nián Zhōngqiū dōu huì shèfǎ tuányuán.
sentences.translation: Although everyone lives in different cities, they try to reunite every Mid-Autumn Festival.

sentences.chinese: 目前证据不足，警方只能根据现场情况进行推测。
sentences.traditional: 目前證據不足，警方只能根據現場情況進行推測。
sentences.pinyin: Mùqián zhèngjù bùzú, jǐngfāng zhǐ néng gēnjù xiànchǎng qíngkuàng jìnxíng tuīcè.
sentences.translation: At present there is not enough evidence, so the police can only speculate based on the situation at the scene.

sentences.chinese: 从他的表情看，我推测他已经知道结果了。
sentences.traditional: 從他的表情看，我推測他已經知道結果了。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng tā de biǎoqíng kàn, wǒ tuīcè tā yǐjīng zhīdào jiéguǒ le.
sentences.translation: Judging from his expression, I guess he already knows the result.

sentences.chinese: 科学家通过数据推测，气温还会继续上升。
sentences.traditional: 科學家通過數據推測，氣溫還會繼續上升。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā tōngguò shùjù tuīcè, qìwēn hái huì jìxù shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: Scientists speculate from the data that temperatures will continue to rise.

sentences.chinese: 他不喜欢那种夸大效果的推销方式。
sentences.traditional: 他不喜歡那種誇大效果的推銷方式。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuān nà zhǒng kuādà xiàoguǒ de tuīxiāo fāngshì.
sentences.translation: He does not like that kind of sales method that exaggerates the effects.

sentences.chinese: 销售人员不应只顾推销产品，而忽视客户的真实需求。
sentences.traditional: 銷售人員不應只顧推銷產品，而忽視客戶的真實需求。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāoshòu rényuán bù yīng zhǐ gù tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn, ér hūshì kèhù de zhēnshí xūqiú.
sentences.translation: Sales staff should not only focus on promoting products while ignoring customers’ real needs.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司通过短视频推销新款环保餐具。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司通過短視頻推銷新款環保餐具。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tōngguò duǎn shìpín tuīxiāo xīnkuǎn huánbǎo cānjù.
sentences.translation: This company promotes its new eco-friendly tableware through short videos.

sentences.chinese: 政府准备在全国范围内推行新的垃圾分类制度。
sentences.traditional: 政府準備在全國範圍內推行新的垃圾分類制度。
