sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhǔnbèi zài quánguó fànwéi nèi tuīxíng xīn de lājī fēnlèi zhìdù.
sentences.translation: The government plans to implement a new waste-sorting system nationwide.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革推行得太快，基层单位一时难以适应。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革推行得太快，基層單位一時難以適應。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé tuīxíng de tài kuài, jīcéng dānwèi yìshí nányǐ shìyìng.
sentences.translation: This reform was implemented too quickly, and local units found it hard to adapt for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定先在几个城市推行试点服务。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定先在幾個城市推行試點服務。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng xiān zài jǐ ge chéngshì tuīxíng shìdiǎn fúwù.
sentences.translation: The company decided to first carry out the pilot service in several cities.

sentences.chinese: 出口企业需要按规定提交材料，才能办理退税。
sentences.traditional: 出口企業需要按規定提交材料，才能辦理退稅。
sentences.pinyin: Chūkǒu qǐyè xūyào àn guīdìng tíjiāo cáiliào, cái néng bànlǐ tuìshuì.
sentences.translation: Export companies need to submit the required documents before they can process a tax refund.

sentences.chinese: 他在机场退税时发现发票上少盖了一个章。
sentences.traditional: 他在機場退稅時發現發票上少蓋了一個章。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jīchǎng tuìshuì shí fāxiàn fāpiào shang shǎo gài le yí ge zhāng.
sentences.translation: When claiming a tax refund at the airport, he found that one stamp was missing from the invoice.

sentences.chinese: 新政策缩短了游客退税所需的等待时间。
sentences.traditional: 新政策縮短了遊客退稅所需的等待時間。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè suōduǎn le yóukè tuìshuì suǒ xū de děngdài shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The new policy shortened the waiting time tourists need for tax refunds.

sentences.chinese: 他太饿了，几乎没嚼就把面包吞了下去。
sentences.traditional: 他太餓了，幾乎沒嚼就把麵包吞了下去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tài è le, jīhū méi jiáo jiù bǎ miànbāo tūn le xiàqu.
sentences.translation: He was so hungry that he swallowed the bread almost without chewing.

sentences.chinese: 这条蛇能够吞下比自己头部大得多的猎物。
sentences.traditional: 這條蛇能夠吞下比自己頭部大得多的獵物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shé nénggòu tūn xià bǐ zìjǐ tóubù dà de duō de lièwù.
sentences.translation: This snake can swallow prey much larger than its own head.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，他把想说的话又吞了回去。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，他把想說的話又吞了回去。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi, tā bǎ xiǎng shuō de huà yòu tūn le huíqu.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news, he swallowed back what he had wanted to say.

sentences.chinese: 他把沉重的行李一路拖到车站，累得满头是汗。
sentences.traditional: 他把沉重的行李一路拖到車站，累得滿頭是汗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ chénzhòng de xíngli yílù tuō dào chēzhàn, lèi de mǎn tóu shì hàn.
sentences.translation: He dragged the heavy luggage all the way to the station and was sweating heavily.

sentences.chinese: 别再拖椅子了，楼下的人会听得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 別再拖椅子了，樓下的人會聽得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zài tuō yǐzi le, lóuxià de rén huì tīng de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Stop dragging the chair; the people downstairs will hear it very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 由于缺乏资金，项目被拖到了明年春天。
sentences.traditional: 由於缺乏資金，項目被拖到了明年春天。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú quēfá zījīn, xiàngmù bèi tuō dào le míngnián chūntiān.
sentences.translation: Because of a lack of funding, the project was dragged on until next spring.

sentences.chinese: 不及时处理小问题，只会拖延整个工程的进度。
sentences.traditional: 不及時處理小問題，只會拖延整個工程的進度。
sentences.pinyin: Bù jíshí chǔlǐ xiǎo wèntí, zhǐ huì tuōyán zhěnggè gōngchéng de jìndù.
sentences.translation: Failing to deal with small problems promptly will only delay the progress of the whole project.

sentences.chinese: 他不断找借口拖延付款，最后失去了客户的信任。
sentences.traditional: 他不斷找藉口拖延付款，最後失去了客戶的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búduàn zhǎo jièkǒu tuōyán fùkuǎn, zuìhòu shīqù le kèhù de xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: He kept making excuses to delay payment and eventually lost the client's trust.

sentences.chinese: 会议已经拖延了半小时，大家都开始不耐烦。
sentences.traditional: 會議已經拖延了半小時，大家都開始不耐煩。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yǐjīng tuōyán le bàn xiǎoshí, dàjiā dōu kāishǐ bú nàifán.
sentences.translation: The meeting has already been delayed by half an hour, and everyone is getting impatient.

sentences.chinese: 这件行李太大，必须在柜台办理托运。
sentences.traditional: 這件行李太大，必須在櫃檯辦理托運。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn xíngli tài dà, bìxū zài guìtái bànlǐ tuōyùn.
sentences.translation: This piece of luggage is too large and must be checked in at the counter.

sentences.chinese: 旅客托运贵重物品前，最好先了解航空公司的规定。
sentences.traditional: 旅客托運貴重物品前，最好先瞭解航空公司的規定。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚkè tuōyùn guìzhòng wùpǐn qián, zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě hángkōng gōngsī de guīdìng.
sentences.translation: Passengers had better understand the airline's rules before checking in valuable items.

sentences.chinese: 由于系统故障，我们的箱子没能成功托运。
sentences.traditional: 由於系統故障，我們的箱子沒能成功托運。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú xìtǒng gùzhàng, wǒmen de xiāngzi méi néng chénggōng tuōyùn.
sentences.translation: Because of a system failure, our suitcase could not be checked in successfully.

sentences.chinese: 工人沿着道路挖了一条沟，准备铺设新的管道。
sentences.traditional: 工人沿著道路挖了一條溝，準備鋪設新的管道。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén yánzhe dàolù wā le yì tiáo gōu, zhǔnbèi pūshè xīn de guǎndào.
sentences.translation: The workers dug a ditch along the road to prepare for laying new pipes.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在沙滩上挖洞，想把贝壳藏进去。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在沙灘上挖洞，想把貝殼藏進去。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài shātān shang wā dòng, xiǎng bǎ bèiké cáng jìnqu.
sentences.translation: The children dug holes on the beach, wanting to hide shells inside.

sentences.chinese: 调查记者继续挖线索，终于发现了关键证据。
sentences.traditional: 調查記者繼續挖線索，終於發現了關鍵證據。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá jìzhě jìxù wā xiànsuǒ, zhōngyú fāxiàn le guānjiàn zhèngjù.
sentences.translation: The investigative reporter kept digging for clues and finally found key evidence.

sentences.chinese: 哇，这座图书馆比照片里看起来还要壮观。
sentences.traditional: 哇，這座圖書館比照片裡看起來還要壯觀。
sentences.pinyin: Wā, zhè zuò túshūguǎn bǐ zhàopiàn lǐ kàn qǐlai hái yào zhuàngguān.
sentences.translation: Wow, this library looks even more magnificent than it does in the photos.

sentences.chinese: 他说了一句“哇”，然后盯着屏幕半天没说话。
sentences.traditional: 他說了一句“哇”，然後盯著屏幕半天沒說話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō le yí jù “wā”, ránhòu dīngzhe píngmù bàntiān méi shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: "He said ""wow"" and then stared at the screen for a long time without speaking."

sentences.chinese: 听到门票这么贵，大家都忍不住哇了一声。
sentences.traditional: 聽到門票這麼貴，大家都忍不住哇了一聲。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào ménpiào zhème guì, dàjiā dōu rěn bu zhù wā le yì shēng.
sentences.translation: Hearing that the tickets were so expensive, everyone could not help letting out a 'wow'.

sentences.chinese: 这个布娃娃虽然旧了，却一直陪着她长大。
sentences.traditional: 這個布娃娃雖然舊了，卻一直陪著她長大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège bù wáwa suīrán jiù le, què yìzhí péizhe tā zhǎngdà.
sentences.translation: Although this cloth doll is old, it has accompanied her throughout her childhood.

sentences.chinese: 许多游客喜欢买当地手工做的娃娃作为纪念品。
sentences.traditional: 許多遊客喜歡買當地手工做的娃娃作為紀念品。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō yóukè xǐhuān mǎi dāngdì shǒugōng zuò de wáwa zuòwéi jìniànpǐn.
sentences.translation: Many tourists like buying locally handmade dolls as souvenirs.

sentences.chinese: 新生儿还只是个小娃娃，需要特别细心地照顾。
sentences.traditional: 新生兒還只是個小娃娃，需要特別細心地照顧。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnshēng'ér hái zhǐ shì ge xiǎo wáwa, xūyào tèbié xìxīn de zhàogù.
sentences.translation: The newborn is still just a little baby and needs especially careful care.

sentences.chinese: 墙上的画挂歪了，看起来有点不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 牆上的畫掛歪了，看起來有點不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shang de huà guà wāi le, kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎn bù shūfu.
sentences.translation: The picture on the wall is hanging crooked, which looks a bit uncomfortable.

sentences.chinese: 他走路时身体有点歪，可能是脚受伤了。
sentences.traditional: 他走路時身體有點歪，可能是腳受傷了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒulù shí shēntǐ yǒudiǎn wāi, kěnéng shì jiǎo shòushāng le.
sentences.translation: His body is a little crooked when he walks; perhaps his foot is injured.

sentences.chinese: 这棵树被台风吹歪了，但根还没有断。
sentences.traditional: 這棵樹被颱風吹歪了，但根還沒有斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kē shù bèi táifēng chuī wāi le, dàn gēn hái méiyǒu duàn.
sentences.translation: This tree was blown crooked by the typhoon, but its roots have not broken.

sentences.chinese: 他的外表看起来很冷淡，其实内心十分热情。
sentences.traditional: 他的外表看起來很冷淡，其實內心十分熱情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de wàibiǎo kàn qǐlai hěn lěngdàn, qíshí nèixīn shífēn rèqíng.
sentences.translation: His appearance seems rather cold, but in fact he is very warm-hearted inside.

sentences.chinese: 判断一个人不能只看外表，还要看他的态度和行动。
sentences.traditional: 判斷一個人不能只看外表，還要看他的態度和行動。
sentences.pinyin: Pànduàn yí gè rén bù néng zhǐ kàn wàibiǎo, hái yào kàn tā de tàidu hé xíngdòng.
sentences.translation: When judging a person, you cannot look only at appearance; you must also look at attitude and actions.

sentences.chinese: 这栋老房子的外表虽然普通，内部结构却保存得很好。
sentences.traditional: 這棟老房子的外表雖然普通，內部結構卻保存得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dòng lǎo fángzi de wàibiǎo suīrán pǔtōng, nèibù jiégòu què bǎocún de hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: Although the exterior of this old house is ordinary, its internal structure has been well preserved.

sentences.chinese: 两国通过外交渠道解决了边境地区的争议。
sentences.traditional: 兩國通過外交渠道解決了邊境地區的爭議。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng guó tōngguò wàijiāo qúdào jiějué le biānjìng dìqū de zhēngyì.
sentences.translation: The two countries resolved the border-area dispute through diplomatic channels.

sentences.chinese: 在复杂的国际局势下，外交往往需要极大的耐心。
sentences.traditional: 在複雜的國際局勢下，外交往往需要極大的耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fùzá de guójì júshì xià, wàijiāo wǎngwǎng xūyào jí dà de nàixīn.
sentences.translation: In a complex international situation, diplomacy often requires enormous patience.

sentences.chinese: 这次访问被认为是两国外交关系中的重要一步。
sentences.traditional: 這次訪問被認為是兩國外交關係中的重要一步。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì fǎngwèn bèi rènwéi shì liǎng guó wàijiāo guānxì zhōng de zhòngyào yí bù.
sentences.translation: This visit is regarded as an important step in the diplomatic relations between the two countries.

sentences.chinese: 公司暂时拒绝向外界透露收购的具体金额。
sentences.traditional: 公司暫時拒絕向外界透露收購的具體金額。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zànshí jùjué xiàng wàijiè tòulù shōugòu de jùtǐ jīn'é.
sentences.translation: The company has temporarily refused to reveal the specific acquisition amount to the outside world.

sentences.chinese: 这位科学家很少接受采访，因此外界对他的生活了解不多。
sentences.traditional: 這位科學家很少接受採訪，因此外界對他的生活了解不多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā hěn shǎo jiēshòu cǎifǎng, yīncǐ wàijiè duì tā de shēnghuó liǎojiě bù duō.
sentences.translation: This scientist rarely gives interviews, so the outside world knows little about his life.

sentences.chinese: 山区道路封闭以后，村子与外界的联系几乎中断了。
sentences.traditional: 山區道路封閉以後，村子與外界的聯繫幾乎中斷了。
sentences.pinyin: Shānqū dàolù fēngbì yǐhòu, cūnzi yǔ wàijiè de liánxì jīhū zhōngduàn le.
sentences.translation: After the mountain roads were closed, the village's connection with the outside world was almost cut off.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院的外科技术在当地很有名。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院的外科技術在當地很有名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de wàikē jìshù zài dāngdì hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.translation: The surgical techniques of this hospital are very well known locally.

sentences.chinese: 他原来学的是内科，后来转到外科工作。
sentences.traditional: 他原來學的是內科，後來轉到外科工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuánlái xué de shì nèikē, hòulái zhuǎn dào wàikē gōngzuò.
sentences.translation: He originally studied internal medicine, but later transferred to work in surgery.

sentences.chinese: 外科医生必须在压力很大的情况下保持稳定的判断。
sentences.traditional: 外科醫生必須在壓力很大的情況下保持穩定的判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Wàikē yīshēng bìxū zài yālì hěn dà de qíngkuàng xià bǎochí wěndìng de pànduàn.
sentences.translation: A surgeon must maintain steady judgement under great pressure.

sentences.chinese: 外来物种如果没有天敌，可能会破坏本地生态平衡。
sentences.traditional: 外來物種如果沒有天敵，可能會破壞本地生態平衡。
sentences.pinyin: Wàilái wùzhǒng rúguǒ méiyǒu tiāndí, kěnéng huì pòhuài běndì shēngtài pínghéng.
sentences.translation: If an introduced species has no natural enemies, it may damage the local ecological balance.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市吸收了许多外来文化，形成了开放的气质。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市吸收了許多外來文化，形成了開放的氣質。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì xīshōu le xǔduō wàilái wénhuà, xíngchéng le kāifàng de qìzhì.
sentences.translation: This city has absorbed many outside cultures and developed an open character.

sentences.chinese: 面对外来压力，团队反而表现得更加团结。
sentences.traditional: 面對外來壓力，團隊反而表現得更加團結。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì wàilái yālì, tuánduì fǎn'ér biǎoxiàn de gèngjiā tuánjié.
sentences.translation: Facing external pressure, the team instead became even more united.

sentences.chinese: 我外甥今年上小学，已经能自己读简单的故事书了。
sentences.traditional: 我外甥今年上小學，已經能自己讀簡單的故事書了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wàisheng jīnnián shàng xiǎoxué, yǐjīng néng zìjǐ dú jiǎndān de gùshìshū le.
sentences.translation: My nephew is in primary school this year and can already read simple storybooks by himself.

sentences.chinese: 姐姐出差时，外甥暂时住在我们家。
sentences.traditional: 姐姐出差時，外甥暫時住在我們家。
sentences.pinyin: Jiějie chūchāi shí, wàisheng zànshí zhù zài wǒmen jiā.
sentences.translation: When my older sister is on a business trip, my nephew stays at our home temporarily.

sentences.chinese: 这个周末我要带外甥去科技馆，他一直对太空很感兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 這個週末我要帶外甥去科技館，他一直對太空很感興趣。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ yào dài wàisheng qù kējìguǎn, tā yìzhí duì tàikōng hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: This weekend I am taking my nephew to the science museum; he has always been very interested in space.

sentences.chinese: 这条山路十分弯曲，新手开车时要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 這條山路十分彎曲，新手開車時要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānlù shífēn wānqū, xīnshǒu kāichē shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: This mountain road is very winding, so new drivers need to be especially careful.

sentences.chinese: 长期姿势不正确，可能会导致脊柱弯曲。
sentences.traditional: 長期姿勢不正確，可能會導致脊柱彎曲。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī zīshì bù zhèngquè, kěnéng huì dǎozhì jǐzhù wānqū.
sentences.translation: Poor posture over a long period may cause the spine to curve.

sentences.chinese: 河流在平原上弯曲前进，形成了许多湿地。
sentences.traditional: 河流在平原上彎曲前進，形成了許多濕地。
sentences.pinyin: Héliú zài píngyuán shang wānqū qiánjìn, xíngchéng le xǔduō shīdì.
sentences.translation: The river winds across the plain, forming many wetlands.

sentences.chinese: 这支球队在落后的情况下表现得十分顽强。
sentences.traditional: 這支球隊在落後的情況下表現得十分頑強。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì zài luòhòu de qíngkuàng xià biǎoxiàn de shífēn wánqiáng.
sentences.translation: This team showed great tenacity while falling behind.

sentences.chinese: 即使环境恶劣，这种植物仍能顽强地生长。
sentences.traditional: 即使環境惡劣，這種植物仍能頑強地生長。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ huánjìng èliè, zhè zhǒng zhíwù réng néng wánqiáng de shēngzhǎng.
sentences.translation: Even in a harsh environment, this plant can still grow tenaciously.

sentences.chinese: 他的顽强意志帮助他熬过了最困难的时期。
sentences.traditional: 他的頑強意志幫助他熬過了最困難的時期。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de wánqiáng yìzhì bāngzhù tā áo guò le zuì kùnnán de shíqī.
sentences.translation: His tenacious will helped him get through the most difficult period.

sentences.chinese: 春雨过后，万物似乎都重新有了生机。
sentences.traditional: 春雨過後，萬物似乎都重新有了生機。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnyǔ guòhòu, wànwù sìhū dōu chóngxīn yǒu le shēngjī.
sentences.translation: After the spring rain, all things seem to have regained vitality.

sentences.chinese: 在古人的想象中，天地万物之间都有某种联系。
sentences.traditional: 在古人的想像中，天地萬物之間都有某種聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔrén de xiǎngxiàng zhōng, tiāndì wànwù zhījiān dōu yǒu mǒu zhǒng liánxì.
sentences.translation: In the imagination of ancient people, there was some kind of connection between heaven, earth, and all things.

sentences.chinese: 科学并不能解释万物，但它提供了理解世界的重要途径。
sentences.traditional: 科學並不能解釋萬物，但它提供了理解世界的重要途徑。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxué bìng bù néng jiěshì wànwù, dàn tā tígōng le lǐjiě shìjiè de zhòngyào tújìng.
sentences.translation: Science cannot explain everything, but it provides an important way to understand the world.

sentences.chinese: 童话里的王子总是在最后一刻出现，解决所有困难。
sentences.traditional: 童話裡的王子總是在最後一刻出現，解決所有困難。
sentences.pinyin: Tónghuà lǐ de wángzǐ zǒng shì zài zuìhòu yí kè chūxiàn, jiějué suǒyǒu kùnnán.
sentences.translation: The prince in fairy tales always appears at the last moment and solves all the difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 这位年轻王子公开表示，他希望参与更多公益事务。
sentences.traditional: 這位年輕王子公開表示，他希望參與更多公益事務。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng wángzǐ gōngkāi biǎoshì, tā xīwàng cānyù gèng duō gōngyì shìwù.
sentences.translation: The young prince publicly stated that he hoped to take part in more charitable affairs.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把自己画成王子，还给旁边的城堡添了一条龙。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把自己畫成王子，還給旁邊的城堡添了一條龍。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ zìjǐ huà chéng wángzǐ, hái gěi pángbiān de chéngbǎo tiān le yì tiáo lóng.
sentences.translation: The child drew himself as a prince and added a dragon beside the castle.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司正在建立覆盖全国的物流网，以便更快地配送商品。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司正在建立覆蓋全國的物流網，以便更快地配送商品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài jiànlì fùgài quánguó de wùliú wǎng, yǐbiàn gèng kuài de pèisòng shāngpǐn.
sentences.translation: The company is building a nationwide logistics network in order to deliver goods more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 渔民清晨撒下网，希望能捕到足够的鱼。
sentences.traditional: 漁民清晨撒下網，希望能捕到足夠的魚。
sentences.pinyin: Yúmín qīngchén sā xià wǎng, xīwàng néng bǔ dào zúgòu de yú.
sentences.translation: The fishermen cast their nets early in the morning, hoping to catch enough fish.

sentences.chinese: 信息时代，谁能更好地利用网，谁就可能获得优势。
sentences.traditional: 信息時代，誰能更好地利用網，誰就可能獲得優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnxī shídài, shéi néng gèng hǎo de lìyòng wǎng, shéi jiù kěnéng huòdé yōushì.
sentences.translation: In the information age, whoever can make better use of networks may gain an advantage.

sentences.chinese: 往后遇到类似问题，你可以先查资料，再决定怎么处理。
sentences.traditional: 往後遇到類似問題，你可以先查資料，再決定怎麼處理。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnghòu yùdào lèisì wèntí, nǐ kěyǐ xiān chá zīliào, zài juédìng zěnme chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: From now on, when you encounter similar problems, you can check the information first and then decide how to handle them.

sentences.chinese: 这项制度一旦确定，往后就不能随便更改。
sentences.traditional: 這項制度一旦確定，往後就不能隨便更改。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhìdù yídàn quèdìng, wǎnghòu jiù bù néng suíbiàn gēnggǎi.
sentences.translation: Once this system is confirmed, it cannot be changed casually afterwards.

sentences.chinese: 往后几年，公司会把重点放在技术研发上。
sentences.traditional: 往後幾年，公司會把重點放在技術研發上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnghòu jǐ nián, gōngsī huì bǎ zhòngdiǎn fàng zài jìshù yánfā shang.
sentences.translation: Over the next few years, the company will focus on technological research and development.

sentences.chinese: 两地之间的商务往来日益频繁，航班也增加了不少。
sentences.traditional: 兩地之間的商務往來日益頻繁，航班也增加了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng dì zhījiān de shāngwù wǎnglái rìyì pínfán, hángbān yě zēngjiā le bùshǎo.
sentences.translation: Business exchanges between the two places are becoming more frequent, and quite a few flights have been added.

sentences.chinese: 他和邻居很少往来，但见面时总会礼貌地打招呼。
sentences.traditional: 他和鄰居很少往來，但見面時總會禮貌地打招呼。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hé línjū hěn shǎo wǎnglái, dàn jiànmiàn shí zǒng huì lǐmào de dǎ zhāohu.
sentences.translation: He rarely has contact with his neighbours, but he always greets them politely when they meet.

sentences.chinese: 这条通道方便工作人员往来，也提高了仓库效率。
sentences.traditional: 這條通道方便工作人員往來，也提高了倉庫效率。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tōngdào fāngbiàn gōngzuò rényuán wǎnglái, yě tígāo le cāngkù xiàolǜ.
sentences.translation: This passage makes it easier for staff to move back and forth and also improves warehouse efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 与往年相比，今年报名参加考试的人数明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 與往年相比，今年報名參加考試的人數明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ wǎngnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián bàomíng cānjiā kǎoshì de rénshù míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: Compared with previous years, the number of people signing up for the exam has clearly increased this year.

sentences.chinese: 往年的经验表明，提前准备能减少很多风险。
sentences.traditional: 往年的經驗表明，提前準備能減少很多風險。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngnián de jīngyàn biǎomíng, tíqián zhǔnbèi néng jiǎnshǎo hěn duō fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Experience from past years shows that preparing in advance can reduce many risks.

sentences.chinese: 这个地区往年雨水较少，今年却连续下了几场大雨。
sentences.traditional: 這個地區往年雨水較少，今年卻連續下了幾場大雨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìqū wǎngnián yǔshuǐ jiào shǎo, jīnnián què liánxù xià le jǐ chǎng dàyǔ.
sentences.translation: This region usually had little rainfall in past years, but this year it has had several heavy rains in a row.

sentences.chinese: 她站在窗前，静静地望着远处的海面。
sentences.traditional: 她站在窗前，靜靜地望著遠處的海面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài chuāng qián, jìngjìng de wàng zhe yuǎnchù de hǎimiàn.
sentences.translation: She stood by the window, quietly gazing at the sea in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 孩子抬头望了一眼天空，发现云层正在散开。
sentences.traditional: 孩子抬頭望了一眼天空，發現雲層正在散開。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi táitóu wàng le yì yǎn tiānkōng, fāxiàn yúncéng zhèngzài sàn kāi.
sentences.translation: The child looked up at the sky and noticed that the clouds were beginning to clear.

sentences.chinese: 他望向人群，努力寻找熟悉的面孔。
sentences.traditional: 他望向人群，努力尋找熟悉的面孔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wàng xiàng rénqún, nǔlì xúnzhǎo shúxī de miànkǒng.
sentences.translation: He looked towards the crowd, trying hard to find a familiar face.

sentences.chinese: 企业如果不能及时调整，可能会陷入严重的经营危机。
sentences.traditional: 企業如果不能及時調整，可能會陷入嚴重的經營危機。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè rúguǒ bù néng jíshí tiáozhěng, kěnéng huì xiànrù yánzhòng de jīngyíng wēijī.
sentences.translation: If an enterprise cannot adjust in time, it may fall into a serious business crisis.

sentences.chinese: 这场能源危机迫使许多国家重新考虑发展策略。
sentences.traditional: 這場能源危機迫使許多國家重新考慮發展策略。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng néngyuán wēijī pòshǐ xǔduō guójiā chóngxīn kǎolǜ fāzhǎn cèlüè.
sentences.translation: This energy crisis forced many countries to reconsider their development strategies.

sentences.chinese: 在危机面前，领导者的判断力尤其重要。
sentences.traditional: 在危機面前，領導者的判斷力尤其重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wēijī miànqián, lǐngdǎozhě de pànduànlì yóuqí zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: In the face of a crisis, a leader's judgement is especially important.

sentences.chinese: 实验中的微小变化都可能影响最终结果。
sentences.traditional: 實驗中的微小變化都可能影響最終結果。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyàn zhōng de wēixiǎo biànhuà dōu kěnéng yǐngxiǎng zuìzhōng jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: Even tiny changes in an experiment can affect the final result.

sentences.chinese: 她注意到合同里一个微小的数字错误，避免了损失。
sentences.traditional: 她注意到合同裡一個微小的數字錯誤，避免了損失。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhùyì dào hétong lǐ yí gè wēixiǎo de shùzì cuòwù, bìmiǎn le sǔnshī.
sentences.translation: She noticed a tiny numerical error in the contract and avoided a loss.

sentences.chinese: 虽然进步很微小，但坚持下去就会看到差别。
sentences.traditional: 雖然進步很微小，但堅持下去就會看到差別。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán jìnbù hěn wēixiǎo, dàn jiānchí xiàqu jiù huì kàn dào chābié.
sentences.translation: Although the progress is tiny, if you keep going you will see a difference.

sentences.chinese: 任何违规操作都必须记录，并向主管汇报。
sentences.traditional: 任何違規操作都必須記錄，並向主管匯報。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé wéiguī cāozuò dōu bìxū jìlù, bìng xiàng zhǔguǎn huìbào.
sentences.translation: Any rule-breaking operation must be recorded and reported to a supervisor.

sentences.chinese: 如果企业长期违规排放，最终会受到处罚。
sentences.traditional: 如果企業長期違規排放，最終會受到處罰。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qǐyè chángqī wéiguī páifàng, zuìzhōng huì shòudào chǔfá.
sentences.translation: If a company illegally discharges waste over a long period, it will eventually be punished.

sentences.chinese: 他因为违规使用公司资料，被取消了项目资格。
sentences.traditional: 他因為違規使用公司資料，被取消了項目資格。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi wéiguī shǐyòng gōngsī zīliào, bèi qǔxiāo le xiàngmù zīgé.
sentences.translation: Because he used company materials in violation of the rules, he was disqualified from the project.

sentences.chinese: 工程师每周都会维护系统，确保数据安全。
sentences.traditional: 工程師每週都會維護系統，確保資料安全。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī měi zhōu dōu huì wéihù xìtǒng, quèbǎo shùjù ānquán.
sentences.translation: Engineers maintain the system every week to ensure data security.

sentences.chinese: 维护公共秩序不仅靠法律，也靠每个人的自觉。
sentences.traditional: 維護公共秩序不僅靠法律，也靠每個人的自覺。
sentences.pinyin: Wéihù gōnggòng zhìxù bùjǐn kào fǎlǜ, yě kào měi gè rén de zìjué.
sentences.translation: Maintaining public order depends not only on the law, but also on everyone's self-discipline.

sentences.chinese: 他们花了很多时间维护客户关系，才赢得长期合作。
sentences.traditional: 他們花了很多時間維護客戶關係，才贏得長期合作。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen huā le hěn duō shíjiān wéihù kèhù guānxi, cái yíngdé chángqī hézuò.
sentences.translation: They spent a lot of time maintaining client relationships before winning long-term cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 这个要求让工作人员很为难，因为规定并不允许例外。
sentences.traditional: 這個要求讓工作人員很為難，因為規定並不允許例外。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yāoqiú ràng gōngzuò rényuán hěn wéinán, yīnwèi guīdìng bìng bù yǔnxǔ lìwài.
sentences.translation: This request put the staff in a difficult position because the rules do not allow exceptions.

sentences.chinese: 他不是故意为难你，只是需要更多证明材料。
sentences.traditional: 他不是故意為難你，只是需要更多證明材料。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bú shì gùyì wéinán nǐ, zhǐ shì xūyào gèng duō zhèngmíng cáiliào.
sentences.translation: He is not deliberately making things difficult for you; he just needs more supporting documents.

sentences.chinese: 如果预算不足，负责人就会在质量和速度之间感到为难。
sentences.traditional: 如果預算不足，負責人就會在質量和速度之間感到為難。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùsuàn bùzú, fùzérén jiù huì zài zhìliàng hé sùdù zhījiān gǎndào wéinán.
sentences.translation: If the budget is insufficient, the person in charge will feel torn between quality and speed.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷年轻时学过围棋，现在还经常和邻居下棋。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺年輕時學過圍棋，現在還經常和鄰居下棋。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye niánqīng shí xué guò wéiqí, xiànzài hái jīngcháng hé línjū xià qí.
sentences.translation: Grandad learnt Go when he was young and still often plays with his neighbours.

sentences.chinese: 围棋比赛不仅考技术，也考选手的耐心和判断力。
sentences.traditional: 圍棋比賽不僅考技術，也考選手的耐心和判斷力。
sentences.pinyin: Wéiqí bǐsài bùjǐn kǎo jìshù, yě kǎo xuǎnshǒu de nàixīn hé pànduànlì.
sentences.translation: A Go competition tests not only technique but also the players' patience and judgement.

sentences.chinese: 老师用围棋来训练学生的逻辑思维。
sentences.traditional: 老師用圍棋來訓練學生的邏輯思維。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng wéiqí lái xùnliàn xuésheng de luóji sīwéi.
sentences.translation: The teacher uses Go to train students' logical thinking.

sentences.chinese: 公司安排了一次为期两周的海外培训。
sentences.traditional: 公司安排了一次為期兩週的海外培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī ānpái le yí cì wéiqī liǎng zhōu de hǎiwài péixùn.
sentences.translation: The company arranged an overseas training course lasting two weeks.

sentences.chinese: 本次展览为期一个月，免费向公众开放。
sentences.traditional: 本次展覽為期一個月，免費向公眾開放。
sentences.pinyin: Běn cì zhǎnlǎn wéiqī yí gè yuè, miǎnfèi xiàng gōngzhòng kāifàng.
sentences.translation: This exhibition lasts for one month and is open to the public free of charge.

sentences.chinese: 双方将举行一场为期三天的谈判。
sentences.traditional: 雙方將舉行一場為期三天的談判。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngfāng jiāng jǔxíng yì chǎng wéiqī sān tiān de tánpàn.
sentences.translation: The two sides will hold negotiations scheduled to last three days.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他多吃蔬菜，以补充维生素。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他多吃蔬菜，以補充維生素。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā duō chī shūcài, yǐ bǔchōng wéishēngsù.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to eat more vegetables to get more vitamins.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺少某些维生素，身体可能会出现问题。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺少某些維生素，身體可能會出現問題。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēshǎo mǒuxiē wéishēngsù, shēntǐ kěnéng huì chūxiàn wèntí.
sentences.translation: If the body lacks certain vitamins for a long time, health problems may appear.

sentences.chinese: 这款饮料声称含有多种维生素，但糖分也不低。
sentences.traditional: 這款飲料聲稱含有多種維生素，但糖分也不低。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yǐnliào shēngchēng hányǒu duō zhǒng wéishēngsù, dàn tángfèn yě bù dī.
sentences.translation: This drink claims to contain several vitamins, but its sugar content is also not low.

sentences.chinese: 到目前为止，项目进展比预期顺利。
sentences.traditional: 到目前為止，項目進展比預期順利。
sentences.pinyin: Dào mùqián wéizhǐ, xiàngmù jìnzhǎn bǐ yùqī shùnlì.
sentences.translation: So far, the project has progressed more smoothly than expected.

sentences.chinese: 报名时间到本周五下午五点为止。
sentences.traditional: 報名時間到本週五下午五點為止。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng shíjiān dào běn zhōu wǔ xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn wéizhǐ.
sentences.translation: Registration lasts until 5 pm this Friday.

sentences.chinese: 截至去年年底为止，该公司已经开了二十家分店。
sentences.traditional: 截至去年年底為止，該公司已經開了二十家分店。
sentences.pinyin: Jiézhì qùnián niándǐ wéizhǐ, gāi gōngsī yǐjīng kāi le èrshí jiā fēndiàn.
sentences.translation: By the end of last year, the company had already opened twenty branches.

sentences.chinese: 她明明做了很多工作，却被批评得很委屈。
sentences.traditional: 她明明做了很多工作，卻被批評得很委屈。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míngmíng zuò le hěn duō gōngzuò, què bèi pīpíng de hěn wěiqu.
sentences.translation: She had clearly done a lot of work, yet she felt very wronged after being criticised.

sentences.chinese: 孩子受了委屈以后，需要有人认真听他说完。
sentences.traditional: 孩子受了委屈以後，需要有人認真聽他說完。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi shòu le wěiqu yǐhòu, xūyào yǒu rén rènzhēn tīng tā shuō wán.
sentences.translation: After a child has been wronged, someone needs to listen carefully while he explains.

sentences.chinese: 为了团队的结果，他暂时忍下了心里的委屈。
sentences.traditional: 為了團隊的結果，他暫時忍下了心裡的委屈。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tuánduì de jiéguǒ, tā zànshí rěn xià le xīnli de wěiqu.
sentences.translation: For the sake of the team result, he temporarily swallowed the grievance in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 客户委托律师处理合同纠纷。
sentences.traditional: 客戶委託律師處理合同糾紛。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù wěituō lǜshī chǔlǐ hétong jiūfēn.
sentences.translation: The client entrusted a lawyer to handle the contract dispute.

sentences.chinese: 我们可以委托第三方机构进行质量检测。
sentences.traditional: 我們可以委託第三方機構進行質量檢測。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ wěituō dì sānfāng jīgòu jìnxíng zhìliàng jiǎncè.
sentences.translation: We can commission a third-party organisation to carry out quality testing.

sentences.chinese: 由于时间有限，调查工作被委托给了专业团队。
sentences.traditional: 由於時間有限，調查工作被委託給了專業團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shíjiān yǒuxiàn, diàochá gōngzuò bèi wěituō gěi le zhuānyè tuánduì.
sentences.translation: Because time was limited, the investigation was entrusted to a professional team.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告尚未提交，经理已经开始催了。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告尚未提交，經理已經開始催了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào shàng wèi tíjiāo, jīnglǐ yǐjīng kāishǐ cuī le.
sentences.translation: This report has not yet been submitted, and the manager has already started urging them.

sentences.chinese: 合同未生效前，双方都可以提出修改意见。
sentences.traditional: 合同未生效前，雙方都可以提出修改意見。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong wèi shēngxiào qián, shuāngfāng dōu kěyǐ tíchū xiūgǎi yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Before the contract takes effect, both sides may propose amendments.

sentences.chinese: 会议未开始，门口已经排起了长队。
sentences.traditional: 會議未開始，門口已經排起了長隊。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì wèi kāishǐ, ménkǒu yǐjīng pái qǐ le cháng duì.
sentences.translation: The meeting had not yet begun, but a long queue had already formed at the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 价格高的产品未必适合所有用户。
sentences.traditional: 價格高的產品未必適合所有用戶。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé gāo de chǎnpǐn wèibì shìhé suǒyǒu yònghù.
sentences.translation: An expensive product is not necessarily suitable for every user.

sentences.chinese: 这个方案看起来简单，执行起来却未必容易。
sentences.traditional: 這個方案看起來簡單，執行起來卻未必容易。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn kàn qǐlai jiǎndān, zhíxíng qǐlai què wèibì róngyì.
sentences.translation: This plan looks simple, but it may not be easy to carry out.

sentences.chinese: 别人同意的做法，我们未必也要照着做。
sentences.traditional: 別人同意的做法，我們未必也要照著做。
sentences.pinyin: Biérén tóngyì de zuòfǎ, wǒmen wèibì yě yào zhào zhe zuò.
sentences.translation: We do not necessarily have to follow an approach just because others agree with it.

sentences.chinese: 平台必须保护未成年人的个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 平臺必須保護未成年人的個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Píngtái bìxū bǎohù wèichéngniánrén de gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: The platform must protect minors’ personal information.

sentences.chinese: 法律禁止向未成年人出售某些商品。
sentences.traditional: 法律禁止向未成年人出售某些商品。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ jìnzhǐ xiàng wèichéngniánrén chūshòu mǒuxiē shāngpǐn.
sentences.translation: The law prohibits selling certain goods to minors.

sentences.chinese: 未成年人参加活动时，最好有家长陪同。
sentences.traditional: 未成年人參加活動時，最好有家長陪同。
sentences.pinyin: Wèichéngniánrén cānjiā huódòng shí, zuìhǎo yǒu jiāzhǎng péitóng.
sentences.translation: When minors take part in activities, it is best for a parent to accompany them.

sentences.chinese: 生产成本不断上升，为此公司决定调整价格。
sentences.traditional: 生產成本不斷上升，為此公司決定調整價格。
sentences.pinyin: Shēngchǎn chéngběn búduàn shàngshēng, wèicǐ gōngsī juédìng tiáozhěng jiàgé.
sentences.translation: Production costs kept rising, so the company decided to adjust its prices.

sentences.chinese: 居民反映夜间噪音严重，为此社区组织了协调会。
sentences.traditional: 居民反映夜間噪音嚴重，為此社區組織了協調會。
sentences.pinyin: Jūmín fǎnyìng yèjiān zàoyīn yánzhòng, wèicǐ shèqū zǔzhī le xiétiáo huì.
sentences.translation: Residents reported serious noise at night, so the community organised a coordination meeting.

sentences.chinese: 数据安全关系到用户信任，为此我们增加了审核步骤。
sentences.traditional: 資料安全關係到用戶信任，為此我們增加了審核步驟。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù ānquán guānxì dào yònghù xìnrèn, wèicǐ wǒmen zēngjiā le shěnhé bùzhòu.
sentences.translation: Data security is connected to user trust, so we added review steps.

sentences.chinese: 他为何突然改变计划，会上没有人说明。
sentences.traditional: 他為何突然改變計畫，會上沒有人說明。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèihé tūrán gǎibiàn jìhuà, huì shàng méi yǒu rén shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: No one at the meeting explained why he suddenly changed the plan.

sentences.chinese: 我不明白他为何对这个决定如此反对。
sentences.traditional: 我不明白他為何對這個決定如此反對。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù míngbai tā wèihé duì zhège juédìng rúcǐ fǎnduì.
sentences.translation: I do not understand why he is so opposed to this decision.

sentences.chinese: 调查的重点是事故为何会在夜间发生。
sentences.traditional: 調查的重點是事故為何會在夜間發生。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá de zhòngdiǎn shì shìgù wèihé huì zài yèjiān fāshēng.
sentences.translation: The focus of the investigation is why the accident happened at night.

sentences.chinese: 感冒以后，他的味觉变得不太灵敏。
sentences.traditional: 感冒以後，他的味覺變得不太靈敏。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎnmào yǐhòu, tā de wèijué biàn de bú tài língmǐn.
sentences.translation: After catching a cold, his sense of taste became less sensitive.

sentences.chinese: 厨师需要依靠味觉判断菜是否过咸。
sentences.traditional: 廚師需要依靠味覺判斷菜是否過鹹。
sentences.pinyin: Chúshī xūyào yīkào wèijué pànduàn cài shìfǒu guò xián.
sentences.translation: A chef needs to rely on taste to judge whether a dish is too salty.

sentences.chinese: 这种药可能会暂时影响人的味觉。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥可能會暫時影響人的味覺。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào kěnéng huì zànshí yǐngxiǎng rén de wèijué.
sentences.translation: This medicine may temporarily affect a person's sense of taste.

sentences.chinese: 天气太热时，很多人的胃口都会下降。
sentences.traditional: 天氣太熱時，很多人的胃口都會下降。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè shí, hěn duō rén de wèikǒu dōu huì xiàjiàng.
sentences.translation: When the weather is too hot, many people's appetite drops.

sentences.chinese: 他病刚好，胃口还没有完全恢复。
sentences.traditional: 他病剛好，胃口還沒有完全恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng gāng hǎo, wèikǒu hái méi yǒu wánquán huīfù.
sentences.translation: He has just recovered from illness, and his appetite has not fully returned.

sentences.chinese: 这家小店的面条很合我的胃口。
sentences.traditional: 這家小店的麵條很合我的胃口。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎodiàn de miàntiáo hěn hé wǒ de wèikǒu.
sentences.translation: The noodles at this small restaurant are very much to my taste.

sentences.chinese: 这位教授态度温和，但要求非常严格。
sentences.traditional: 這位教授態度溫和，但要求非常嚴格。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu tàidu wēnhé, dàn yāoqiú fēicháng yángé.
sentences.translation: This professor has a gentle manner, but his standards are very strict.

sentences.chinese: 这种清洁剂比较温和，不容易刺激皮肤。
sentences.traditional: 這種清潔劑比較溫和，不容易刺激皮膚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qīngjiéjì bǐjiào wēnhé, bù róngyì cìjī pífū.
sentences.translation: This cleaning agent is relatively mild and is less likely to irritate the skin.

sentences.chinese: 当地气候温和，适合老人长期居住。
sentences.traditional: 當地氣候溫和，適合老人長期居住。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì qìhòu wēnhé, shìhé lǎorén chángqī jūzhù.
sentences.translation: The local climate is mild and suitable for older people to live in long term.

sentences.chinese: 她说话温柔，却很有原则。
sentences.traditional: 她說話溫柔，卻很有原則。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà wēnróu, què hěn yǒu yuánzé.
sentences.translation: She speaks gently, yet she has strong principles.

sentences.chinese: 他用温柔的语气安慰受惊的孩子。
sentences.traditional: 他用溫柔的語氣安慰受驚的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng wēnróu de yǔqì ānwèi shòujīng de háizi.
sentences.translation: He comforted the frightened child in a gentle tone.

sentences.chinese: 温柔并不等于没有力量。
sentences.traditional: 溫柔並不等於沒有力量。
sentences.pinyin: Wēnróu bìng bù děngyú méi yǒu lìliàng.
sentences.translation: Gentleness does not mean a lack of strength.

sentences.chinese: 请把会议纪要整理成正式文档。
sentences.traditional: 請把會議紀要整理成正式文檔。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ huìyì jìyào zhěnglǐ chéng zhèngshì wéndàng.
sentences.translation: Please organise the meeting minutes into a formal document.

sentences.chinese: 重要文档应该定期备份，避免丢失。
sentences.traditional: 重要文檔應該定期備份，避免丟失。
sentences.pinyin: Zhòngyào wéndàng yīnggāi dìngqī bèifèn, bìmiǎn diūshī.
sentences.translation: Important documents should be backed up regularly to avoid loss.

sentences.chinese: 共享文档方便团队成员同时修改。
sentences.traditional: 共享文檔方便團隊成員同時修改。
sentences.pinyin: Gòngxiǎng wéndàng fāngbiàn tuánduì chéngyuán tóngshí xiūgǎi.
sentences.translation: Shared documents make it convenient for team members to edit at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 开学前，家长们忙着给孩子准备文具。
sentences.traditional: 開學前，家長們忙著給孩子準備文具。
sentences.pinyin: Kāixué qián, jiāzhǎngmen máng zhe gěi háizi zhǔnbèi wénjù.
sentences.translation: Before school starts, parents are busy preparing stationery for their children.

sentences.chinese: 办公室的文具由行政部门统一采购。
sentences.traditional: 辦公室的文具由行政部門統一採購。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì de wénjù yóu xíngzhèng bùmén tǒngyī cǎigòu.
sentences.translation: The office stationery is purchased centrally by the administration department.

sentences.chinese: 这家店卖的文具设计简单又实用。
sentences.traditional: 這家店賣的文具設計簡單又實用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài de wénjù shèjì jiǎndān yòu shíyòng.
sentences.translation: The stationery sold in this shop is simple in design and practical.

sentences.chinese: 他高中选择了文科，后来读了法律。
sentences.traditional: 他高中選擇了文科，後來讀了法律。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāozhōng xuǎnzé le wénkē, hòulái dú le fǎlǜ.
sentences.translation: He chose liberal arts in senior secondary school and later studied law.

sentences.chinese: 文科教育能够培养学生的表达和分析能力。
sentences.traditional: 文科教育能夠培養學生的表達和分析能力。
sentences.pinyin: Wénkē jiàoyù nénggòu péiyǎng xuésheng de biǎodá hé fēnxī nénglì.
sentences.translation: A liberal arts education can develop students' expression and analytical abilities.

sentences.chinese: 有些文科专业也需要很强的数据意识。
sentences.traditional: 有些文科專業也需要很強的數據意識。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē wénkē zhuānyè yě xūyào hěn qiáng de shùjù yìshí.
sentences.translation: Some liberal arts majors also require a strong awareness of data.

sentences.chinese: 排队是一种基本的文明习惯。
sentences.traditional: 排隊是一種基本的文明習慣。
sentences.pinyin: Páiduì shì yì zhǒng jīběn de wénmíng xíguàn.
sentences.translation: Queuing is a basic civilised habit.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市正在建设更加文明的交通环境。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市正在建設更加文明的交通環境。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì zhèngzài jiànshè gèngjiā wénmíng de jiāotōng huánjìng.
sentences.translation: This city is building a more civilised traffic environment.

sentences.chinese: 不同文明之间的交流推动了科技和艺术的发展。
sentences.traditional: 不同文明之間的交流推動了科技和藝術的發展。
sentences.pinyin: Bù tóng wénmíng zhījiān de jiāoliú tuīdòng le kējì hé yìshù de fāzhǎn.
sentences.translation: Exchange between different civilisations has promoted the development of technology and art.

sentences.chinese: 这座小城因古老的桥梁而闻名。
sentences.traditional: 這座小城因古老的橋樑而聞名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò xiǎochéng yīn gǔlǎo de qiáoliáng ér wénmíng.
sentences.translation: This small city is famous for its ancient bridges.

sentences.chinese: 他的作品在海外也逐渐闻名。
sentences.traditional: 他的作品在海外也逐漸聞名。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zuòpǐn zài hǎiwài yě zhújiàn wénmíng.
sentences.translation: His works are gradually becoming famous overseas as well.

sentences.chinese: 这家医院以高水平的外科技术闻名全国。
sentences.traditional: 這家醫院以高水準的外科技術聞名全國。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn yǐ gāo shuǐzhǔn de wàikē jìshù wénmíng quánguó.
sentences.translation: This hospital is famous nationwide for its high-level surgical techniques.

sentences.chinese: 这件文物虽然残缺，却记录了重要的历史信息。
sentences.traditional: 這件文物雖然殘缺，卻記錄了重要的歷史信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wénwù suīrán cánquē, què jìlù le zhòngyào de lìshǐ xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Although this cultural relic is incomplete, it records important historical information.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆加强了对珍贵文物的保护。
sentences.traditional: 博物館加強了對珍貴文物的保護。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn jiāqiáng le duì zhēnguì wénwù de bǎohù.
sentences.translation: The museum has strengthened the protection of precious cultural relics.

sentences.chinese: 修复文物需要专业技术和足够的耐心。
sentences.traditional: 修復文物需要專業技術和足夠的耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Xiūfù wénwù xūyào zhuānyè jìshù hé zúgòu de nàixīn.
sentences.translation: Restoring cultural relics requires professional skills and sufficient patience.

sentences.chinese: 写论文前，学生必须查阅大量相关文献。
sentences.traditional: 寫論文前，學生必須查閱大量相關文獻。
sentences.pinyin: Xiě lùnwén qián, xuésheng bìxū cháyuè dàliàng xiāngguān wénxiàn.
sentences.translation: Before writing a thesis, students must consult a large amount of relevant literature.

sentences.chinese: 这些早期文献为研究当地历史提供了依据。
sentences.traditional: 這些早期文獻為研究當地歷史提供了依據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zǎoqī wénxiàn wèi yánjiū dāngdì lìshǐ tígōng le yījù.
sentences.translation: These early documents provide a basis for studying local history.

sentences.chinese: 报告的结论应当有可靠文献支持。
sentences.traditional: 報告的結論應當有可靠文獻支持。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào de jiélùn yīngdāng yǒu kěkào wénxiàn zhīchí.
sentences.translation: The report's conclusions should be supported by reliable literature.

sentences.chinese: 学校每年都会举办文艺演出，鼓励学生展示才华。
sentences.traditional: 學校每年都會舉辦文藝演出，鼓勵學生展示才華。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào měi nián dōu huì jǔbàn wényì yǎnchū, gǔlì xuésheng zhǎnshì cáihuá.
sentences.translation: The school holds a literary and artistic performance every year to encourage students to show their talents.

sentences.chinese: 这本杂志主要介绍当代文艺作品。
sentences.traditional: 這本雜誌主要介紹當代文藝作品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì zhǔyào jièshào dāngdài wényì zuòpǐn.
sentences.translation: This magazine mainly introduces contemporary literary and artistic works.

sentences.chinese: 社区准备组织一次面向老人的文艺活动。
sentences.traditional: 社區準備組織一次面向老人的文藝活動。
sentences.pinyin: Shèqū zhǔnbèi zǔzhī yí cì miànxiàng lǎorén de wényì huódòng.
sentences.translation: The community is preparing to organise a literary and artistic activity for older residents.

sentences.chinese: 这只乌龟动作很慢，却总能找到安全的地方。
sentences.traditional: 這隻烏龜動作很慢，卻總能找到安全的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī wūguī dòngzuò hěn màn, què zǒng néng zhǎodào ānquán de dìfang.
sentences.translation: This tortoise moves slowly, but it can always find a safe place.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把乌龟养在一个干净的小水池里。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把烏龜養在一個乾淨的小水池裡。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ wūguī yǎng zài yí ge gānjìng de xiǎo shuǐchí lǐ.
sentences.translation: The child keeps the tortoise in a clean little pool.

sentences.chinese: 在传统故事里，乌龟常常象征长寿。
sentences.traditional: 在傳統故事裡，烏龜常常象徵長壽。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chuántǒng gùshi lǐ, wūguī chángcháng xiàngzhēng chángshòu.
sentences.translation: In traditional stories, the tortoise often symbolises longevity.

sentences.chinese: 未经处理的污水不能直接排入河流。
sentences.traditional: 未經處理的污水不能直接排入河流。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi jīng chǔlǐ de wūshuǐ bù néng zhíjiē pái rù héliú.
sentences.translation: Untreated sewage must not be discharged directly into rivers.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市正在建设新的污水处理系统。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市正在建設新的污水處理系統。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì zhèngzài jiànshè xīn de wūshuǐ chǔlǐ xìtǒng.
sentences.translation: This city is building a new sewage treatment system.

sentences.chinese: 工厂排放污水会严重破坏周围生态。
sentences.traditional: 工廠排放污水會嚴重破壞周圍生態。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng páifàng wūshuǐ huì yánzhòng pòhuài zhōuwéi shēngtài.
sentences.translation: Factory discharge of sewage can seriously damage the surrounding ecology.

sentences.chinese: 你选择哪一天开会，我都无所谓。
sentences.traditional: 你選擇哪一天開會，我都無所謂。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xuǎnzé nǎ yì tiān kāihuì, wǒ dōu wúsuǒwèi.
sentences.translation: Whichever day you choose for the meeting, I do not mind.

sentences.chinese: 他表面上说无所谓，其实心里很失望。
sentences.traditional: 他表面上說無所謂，其實心裡很失望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biǎomiàn shàng shuō wúsuǒwèi, qíshí xīn lǐ hěn shīwàng.
sentences.translation: On the surface he said it did not matter, but in fact he was very disappointed.

sentences.chinese: 这点损失对大公司来说可能无所谓。
sentences.traditional: 這點損失對大公司來說可能無所謂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè diǎn sǔnshī duì dà gōngsī lái shuō kěnéng wúsuǒwèi.
sentences.translation: This small loss may not matter to a large company.

sentences.chinese: 这次合作无疑会提升公司的国际影响力。
sentences.traditional: 這次合作無疑會提升公司的國際影響力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì hézuò wúyí huì tíshēng gōngsī de guójì yǐngxiǎnglì.
sentences.translation: This cooperation will undoubtedly enhance the company's international influence.

sentences.chinese: 他的经验无疑是团队的一大优势。
sentences.traditional: 他的經驗無疑是團隊的一大優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jīngyàn wúyí shì tuánduì de yí dà yōushì.
sentences.translation: His experience is undoubtedly a major advantage for the team.

sentences.chinese: 这个决定无疑给项目带来了新的压力。
sentences.traditional: 這個決定無疑給項目帶來了新的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège juédìng wúyí gěi xiàngmù dài lái le xīn de yālì.
sentences.translation: This decision has undoubtedly brought new pressure to the project.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展示了古代士兵使用过的武器。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展示了古代士兵使用過的武器。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnshì le gǔdài shìbīng shǐyòng guo de wǔqì.
sentences.translation: The museum displays weapons once used by ancient soldiers.

sentences.chinese: 在现代商业竞争中，数据也可能成为一种武器。
sentences.traditional: 在現代商業競爭中，數據也可能成為一種武器。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xiàndài shāngyè jìngzhēng zhōng, shùjù yě kěnéng chéngwéi yì zhǒng wǔqì.
sentences.translation: In modern business competition, data can also become a kind of weapon.

sentences.chinese: 法律是维护普通人权益的重要武器。
sentences.traditional: 法律是維護普通人權益的重要武器。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ shì wéihù pǔtōng rén quányì de zhòngyào wǔqì.
sentences.translation: The law is an important weapon for protecting ordinary people's rights and interests.

sentences.chinese: 我误把他的沉默理解成了反对。
sentences.traditional: 我誤把他的沉默理解成了反對。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wù bǎ tā de chénmò lǐjiě chéng le fǎnduì.
sentences.translation: I mistakenly understood his silence as opposition.

sentences.chinese: 他误将旧版本文件发给了客户。
sentences.traditional: 他誤將舊版本文件發給了客戶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wù jiāng jiù bǎnběn wénjiàn fā gěi le kèhù.
sentences.translation: He mistakenly sent the old version of the file to the client.

sentences.chinese: 由于地址写错，快递被误送到别的小区。
sentences.traditional: 由於地址寫錯，快遞被誤送到別的小區。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú dìzhǐ xiě cuò, kuàidì bèi wù sòng dào bié de xiǎoqū.
sentences.translation: Because the address was written incorrectly, the parcel was mistakenly delivered to another residential area.

sentences.chinese: 如果不及时说明，双方的误解会越来越深。
sentences.traditional: 如果不及時說明，雙方的誤解會越來越深。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí shuōmíng, shuāngfāng de wùjiě huì yuè lái yuè shēn.
sentences.translation: Without a timely explanation, the misunderstanding between the two sides will deepen.

sentences.chinese: 我担心你误解了老师的意思。
sentences.traditional: 我擔心你誤解了老師的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dānxīn nǐ wùjiě le lǎoshī de yìsi.
sentences.translation: I am worried that you have misunderstood the teacher's meaning.

sentences.chinese: 面对批评时，他先解释事实，避免被进一步误解。
sentences.traditional: 面對批評時，他先解釋事實，避免被進一步誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì pīpíng shí, tā xiān jiěshì shìshí, bìmiǎn bèi jìnyíbù wùjiě.
sentences.translation: When facing criticism, he first explained the facts to avoid being further misunderstood.

sentences.chinese: 这个物体的表面很光滑，几乎看不出任何接缝。
sentences.traditional: 這個物體的表面很光滑，幾乎看不出任何接縫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wùtǐ de biǎomiàn hěn guānghuá, jīhū kàn bù chū rènhé jiēfèng.
sentences.translation: The surface of this object is very smooth, and hardly any seams can be seen.

sentences.chinese: 实验中，研究人员记录了物体下落的速度变化。
sentences.traditional: 實驗中，研究人員記錄了物體下落的速度變化。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyàn zhōng, yánjiū rényuán jìlù le wùtǐ xiàluò de sùdù biànhuà.
sentences.translation: In the experiment, the researchers recorded changes in the object's falling speed.

sentences.chinese: 雷达可以发现远处移动的物体。
sentences.traditional: 雷達可以發現遠處移動的物體。
sentences.pinyin: Léidá kěyǐ fāxiàn yuǎn chù yídòng de wùtǐ.
sentences.translation: Radar can detect moving objects in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 公司应当从这次失败中吸取教训，而不是急于找借口。
sentences.traditional: 公司應當從這次失敗中吸取教訓，而不是急於找藉口。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yīngdāng cóng zhè cì shībài zhōng xīqǔ jiàoxùn, ér bú shì jíyú zhǎo jièkǒu.
sentences.translation: The company should absorb the lessons from this failure rather than rush to make excuses.

sentences.chinese: 这种材料能够快速吸取水分，适合用于户外装备。
sentences.traditional: 這種材料能夠快速吸取水分，適合用於戶外裝備。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào nénggòu kuàisù xīqǔ shuǐfèn, shìhé yòng yú hùwài zhuāngbèi.
sentences.translation: This material can quickly absorb moisture and is suitable for outdoor equipment.

sentences.chinese: 年轻干部需要善于吸取群众的意见。
sentences.traditional: 年輕幹部需要善於吸取群眾的意見。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng gànbù xūyào shànyú xīqǔ qúnzhòng de yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: Young officials need to be good at taking in the public's opinions.

sentences.chinese: 她的媳妇在医院工作，平时很少有完整的周末。
sentences.traditional: 她的媳婦在醫院工作，平時很少有完整的週末。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xífu zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, píngshí hěn shǎo yǒu wánzhěng de zhōumò.
sentences.translation: Her daughter-in-law works at a hospital and rarely has a full weekend off.

sentences.chinese: 老人不想给媳妇增加负担，很多事情都自己处理。
sentences.traditional: 老人不想給媳婦增加負擔，很多事情都自己處理。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén bù xiǎng gěi xífu zēngjiā fùdān, hěn duō shìqing dōu zìjǐ chǔlǐ.
sentences.translation: The old man does not want to add to his daughter-in-law's burden, so he handles many things himself.

sentences.chinese: 在一些地区，媳妇和婆婆之间的关系仍然很受关注。
sentences.traditional: 在一些地區，媳婦和婆婆之間的關係仍然很受關注。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yìxiē dìqū, xífu hé pópo zhījiān de guānxi réngrán hěn shòu guānzhù.
sentences.translation: In some regions, the relationship between a daughter-in-law and her mother-in-law still receives much attention.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间贴春联是许多地方保留下来的习俗。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間貼春聯是許多地方保留下來的習俗。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān tiē chūnlián shì xǔduō dìfang bǎoliú xiàlai de xísú.
sentences.translation: Putting up Spring Festival couplets is a custom preserved in many places.

sentences.chinese: 了解当地习俗，有助于避免交流中的误会。
sentences.traditional: 了解當地習俗，有助於避免交流中的誤會。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎojiě dāngdì xísú, yǒuzhù yú bìmiǎn jiāoliú zhōng de wùhuì.
sentences.translation: Understanding local customs helps avoid misunderstandings in communication.

sentences.chinese: 随着城市化发展，一些传统习俗正在慢慢改变。
sentences.traditional: 隨著城市化發展，一些傳統習俗正在慢慢改變。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà fāzhǎn, yìxiē chuántǒng xísú zhèngzài mànmàn gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: With the development of urbanisation, some traditional customs are slowly changing.

sentences.chinese: 这部喜剧表面轻松，实际上讨论了很现实的社会问题。
sentences.traditional: 這部喜劇表面輕鬆，實際上討論了很現實的社會問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xǐjù biǎomiàn qīngsōng, shíjì shàng tǎolùn le hěn xiànshí de shèhuì wèntí.
sentences.translation: This comedy seems light on the surface, but actually discusses very real social issues.

sentences.chinese: 优秀的喜剧往往来自对生活细节的敏锐观察。
sentences.traditional: 優秀的喜劇往往來自對生活細節的敏銳觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Yōuxiù de xǐjù wǎngwǎng láizì duì shēnghuó xìjié de mǐnruì guānchá.
sentences.translation: Excellent comedy often comes from sharp observation of the details of life.

sentences.chinese: 导演希望用喜剧的方式减轻观众的压力。
sentences.traditional: 導演希望用喜劇的方式減輕觀眾的壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn xīwàng yòng xǐjù de fāngshì jiǎnqīng guānzhòng de yālì.
sentences.translation: The director hopes to reduce the audience's stress through comedy.

sentences.chinese: 家里有了喜事，亲戚朋友都赶来祝贺。
sentences.traditional: 家裡有了喜事，親戚朋友都趕來祝賀。
sentences.pinyin: Jiā li yǒu le xǐshì, qīnqi péngyou dōu gǎn lái zhùhè.
sentences.translation: When there was a happy event in the family, relatives and friends all came to offer congratulations.

sentences.chinese: 村里接连发生几件喜事，大家的心情都格外好。
sentences.traditional: 村裡接連發生幾件喜事，大家的心情都格外好。
sentences.pinyin: Cūn li jiēlián fāshēng jǐ jiàn xǐshì, dàjiā de xīnqíng dōu géwài hǎo.
sentences.translation: Several happy events happened one after another in the village, and everyone was in especially good spirits.

sentences.chinese: 结婚本是喜事，双方家庭却因为细节产生了争执。
sentences.traditional: 結婚本是喜事，雙方家庭卻因為細節產生了爭執。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéhūn běn shì xǐshì, shuāngfāng jiātíng què yīnwèi xìjié chǎnshēng le zhēngzhí.
sentences.translation: Marriage is supposed to be a happy event, but the two families had a dispute over the details.

sentences.chinese: 长途飞行结束后，她只想尽快洗漱休息。
sentences.traditional: 長途飛行結束後，她只想儘快洗漱休息。
sentences.pinyin: Chángtú fēixíng jiéshù hòu, tā zhǐ xiǎng jǐnkuài xǐshù xiūxi.
sentences.translation: After the long flight, she only wanted to wash up and rest as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 宿舍的洗漱区很小，早上经常需要排队。
sentences.traditional: 宿舍的洗漱區很小，早上經常需要排隊。
sentences.pinyin: Sùshè de xǐshù qū hěn xiǎo, zǎoshang jīngcháng xūyào páiduì.
sentences.translation: The wash area in the dormitory is very small, so people often have to queue in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 孩子学会自己洗漱以后，父母轻松了不少。
sentences.traditional: 孩子學會自己洗漱以後，父母輕鬆了不少。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi xuéhuì zìjǐ xǐshù yǐhòu, fùmǔ qīngsōng le bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: After the child learnt to wash up by himself, his parents had things much easier.

sentences.chinese: 科学家正在研究这种药物对癌细胞的影响。
sentences.traditional: 科學家正在研究這種藥物對癌細胞的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài yánjiū zhè zhǒng yàowù duì ái xìbāo de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: Scientists are studying the effect of this drug on cancer cells.

sentences.chinese: 人体由大量细胞组成，每种细胞都有不同功能。
sentences.traditional: 人體由大量細胞組成，每種細胞都有不同功能。
sentences.pinyin: Réntǐ yóu dàliàng xìbāo zǔchéng, měi zhǒng xìbāo dōu yǒu bùtóng gōngnéng.
sentences.translation: The human body is made up of a large number of cells, and each type of cell has different functions.

sentences.chinese: 显微镜让学生第一次清楚地看到了植物细胞。
sentences.traditional: 顯微鏡讓學生第一次清楚地看到了植物細胞。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎnwēijìng ràng xuésheng dì yī cì qīngchu de kàn dào le zhíwù xìbāo.
sentences.translation: The microscope allowed the students to see plant cells clearly for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 高温可以杀死部分细菌，降低食物中毒的风险。
sentences.traditional: 高溫可以殺死部分細菌，降低食物中毒的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Gāowēn kěyǐ shāsǐ bùfen xìjūn, jiàngdī shíwù zhòngdú de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: High temperatures can kill some bacteria and reduce the risk of food poisoning.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒大家，伤口感染往往与细菌有关。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒大家，傷口感染往往與細菌有關。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng dàjiā, shāngkǒu gǎnrǎn wǎngwǎng yǔ xìjūn yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded everyone that wound infections are often related to bacteria.

sentences.chinese: 并不是所有细菌都会危害人体健康。
sentences.traditional: 並不是所有細菌都會危害人體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Bìng bú shì suǒyǒu xìjūn dōu huì wēihài réntǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Not all bacteria harm human health.

sentences.chinese: 出版社计划推出一系列面向青少年的科普读物。
sentences.traditional: 出版社計畫推出一系列面向青少年的科普讀物。
sentences.pinyin: Chūbǎnshè jìhuà tuīchū yì xìliè miànxiàng qīngshàonián de kēpǔ dúwù.
sentences.translation: The publisher plans to release a series of popular science books for teenagers.

sentences.chinese: 这次培训包括一系列关于数据安全的课程。
sentences.traditional: 這次培訓包括一系列關於資料安全的課程。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì péixùn bāokuò yì xìliè guānyú zīliào ānquán de kèchéng.
sentences.translation: This training includes a series of courses on data security.

sentences.chinese: 政府采取了一系列措施来稳定就业市场。
sentences.traditional: 政府採取了一系列措施來穩定就業市場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le yì xìliè cuòshī lái wěndìng jiùyè shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: The government adopted a series of measures to stabilise the job market.

sentences.chinese: 中国戏曲不仅重视唱腔，也讲究身段和表情。
sentences.traditional: 中國戲曲不僅重視唱腔，也講究身段和表情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó xìqǔ bùjǐn zhòngshì chàngqiāng, yě jiǎngjiū shēnduàn hé biǎoqíng.
sentences.translation: Chinese traditional opera values not only singing style, but also posture and facial expression.

sentences.chinese: 年轻观众如果了解历史背景，往往更容易欣赏戏曲。
sentences.traditional: 年輕觀眾如果了解歷史背景，往往更容易欣賞戲曲。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng guānzhòng rúguǒ liǎojiě lìshǐ bèijǐng, wǎngwǎng gèng róngyì xīnshǎng xìqǔ.
sentences.translation: If young audiences understand the historical background, they often find it easier to appreciate traditional opera.

sentences.chinese: 学校邀请了一位演员来介绍地方戏曲的特色。
sentences.traditional: 學校邀請了一位演員來介紹地方戲曲的特色。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yāoqǐng le yí wèi yǎnyuán lái jièshào dìfāng xìqǔ de tèsè.
sentences.translation: The school invited an actor to introduce the features of local traditional opera.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告的分析很细致，连小样本的变化都注意到了。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告的分析很細緻，連小樣本的變化都注意到了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de fēnxī hěn xìzhì, lián xiǎo yàngběn de biànhuà dōu zhùyì dào le.
sentences.translation: The analysis in this report is very meticulous, even noting changes in small samples.

sentences.chinese: 她做事细致，所以客户很少需要反复确认。
sentences.traditional: 她做事細緻，所以客戶很少需要反覆確認。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuòshì xìzhì, suǒyǐ kèhù hěn shǎo xūyào fǎnfù quèrèn.
sentences.translation: She is meticulous in her work, so clients rarely need to confirm things repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 修复文物需要非常细致的观察和耐心。
sentences.traditional: 修復文物需要非常細緻的觀察和耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Xiūfù wénwù xūyào fēicháng xìzhì de guānchá hé nàixīn.
sentences.translation: Restoring cultural relics requires extremely careful observation and patience.

sentences.chinese: 别突然从门后出来吓孩子，他会哭的。
sentences.traditional: 別突然從門後出來嚇孩子，他會哭的。
sentences.pinyin: Bié tūrán cóng mén hòu chūlai xià háizi, tā huì kū de.
sentences.translation: Do not suddenly come out from behind the door to frighten the child; he will cry.

sentences.chinese: 这段视频把我吓了一跳，但内容其实并不可怕。
sentences.traditional: 這段視頻把我嚇了一跳，但內容其實並不可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn shìpín bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào, dàn nèiróng qíshí bìng bù kěpà.
sentences.translation: This video gave me a fright, but the content is not actually scary.

sentences.chinese: 医生说症状看起来严重，不过不要自己吓自己。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說症狀看起來嚴重，不過不要自己嚇自己。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhèngzhuàng kàn qǐlai yánzhòng, búguò bú yào zìjǐ xià zìjǐ.
sentences.translation: The doctor said the symptoms looked serious, but not to frighten yourself unnecessarily.

sentences.chinese: 要把发音练准，必须在声调上下功夫。
sentences.traditional: 要把發音練準，必須在聲調上下功夫。
sentences.pinyin: Yào bǎ fāyīn liàn zhǔn, bìxū zài shēngdiào shang xià gōngfu.
sentences.translation: To get pronunciation accurate, you must put effort into the tones.

sentences.chinese: 他以前成绩普通，但后来在阅读上下功夫，进步很快。
sentences.traditional: 他以前成績普通，但後來在閱讀上下功夫，進步很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐqián chéngjì pǔtōng, dàn hòulái zài yuèdú shang xià gōngfu, jìnbù hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: His grades used to be average, but later he put effort into reading and improved quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究不能只看数据，还要在实地调查上下功夫。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究不能只看數據，還要在實地調查上下功夫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū bù néng zhǐ kàn shùjù, hái yào zài shídì diàochá shang xià gōngfu.
sentences.translation: This research cannot just look at data; it also needs effort put into field investigation.

sentences.chinese: 顾客下单后，系统会自动发送确认邮件。
sentences.traditional: 顧客下單後，系統會自動發送確認郵件。
sentences.pinyin: Gùkè xiàdān hòu, xìtǒng huì zìdòng fāsòng quèrèn yóujiàn.
sentences.translation: After a customer places an order, the system will automatically send a confirmation email.

sentences.chinese: 这款产品太受欢迎，刚上架就有上千人下单。
sentences.traditional: 這款產品太受歡迎，剛上架就有上千人下單。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn tài shòu huānyíng, gāng shàngjià jiù yǒu shàng qiān rén xiàdān.
sentences.translation: This product is so popular that more than a thousand people placed orders as soon as it was listed.

sentences.chinese: 下单之前，请仔细核对地址和发票信息。
sentences.traditional: 下單之前，請仔細核對地址和發票信息。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàdān zhīqián, qǐng zǐxì héduì dìzhǐ hé fāpiào xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Before placing an order, please carefully check the address and invoice information.

sentences.chinese: 这个夏令营把科学实验和户外活动结合起来。
sentences.traditional: 這個夏令營把科學實驗和戶外活動結合起來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàlìngyíng bǎ kēxué shíyàn hé hùwài huódòng jiéhé qǐlai.
sentences.translation: This summer camp combines science experiments with outdoor activities.

sentences.chinese: 父母希望孩子在夏令营里学会独立生活。
sentences.traditional: 父母希望孩子在夏令營裡學會獨立生活。
sentences.pinyin: Fùmǔ xīwàng háizi zài xiàlìngyíng lǐ xuéhuì dúlì shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Parents hope their children will learn to live independently at summer camp.

sentences.chinese: 学校为来自不同国家的学生安排了中文夏令营。
sentences.traditional: 學校為來自不同國家的學生安排了中文夏令營。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèi láizì bùtóng guójiā de xuésheng ānpái le Zhōngwén xiàlìngyíng.
sentences.translation: The school arranged a Chinese-language summer camp for students from different countries.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，请把测试账号及时下线。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，請把測試帳號及時下線。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, qǐng bǎ cèshì zhànghào jíshí xiàxiàn.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ends, please take the test account offline promptly.

sentences.chinese: 这款旧软件将在月底下线，用户需要提前备份数据。
sentences.traditional: 這款舊軟件將在月底下線，用戶需要提前備份數據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn jiù ruǎnjiàn jiāng zài yuèdǐ xiàxiàn, yònghù xūyào tíqián bèifèn shùjù.
sentences.translation: This old software will go offline at the end of the month, so users need to back up their data in advance.

sentences.chinese: 客服系统临时下线，导致部分订单无法查询。
sentences.traditional: 客服系統臨時下線，導致部分訂單無法查詢。
sentences.pinyin: Kèfú xìtǒng línshí xiàxiàn, dǎozhì bùfen dìngdān wúfǎ cháxún.
sentences.translation: The customer service system went offline temporarily, causing some orders to be unsearchable.

sentences.chinese: 新规定预计五月下旬正式公布。
sentences.traditional: 新規定預計五月下旬正式公佈。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn guīdìng yùjì wǔ yuè xiàxún zhèngshì gōngbù.
sentences.translation: The new regulations are expected to be officially announced in late May.

sentences.chinese: 下旬的气温可能继续升高，农户要注意灌溉。
sentences.traditional: 下旬的氣溫可能繼續升高，農戶要注意灌溉。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàxún de qìwēn kěnéng jìxù shēnggāo, nónghù yào zhùyì guàngài.
sentences.translation: Temperatures may continue to rise in the last ten days of the month, so farmers should pay attention to irrigation.

sentences.chinese: 项目组计划在六月下旬完成最终测试。
sentences.traditional: 項目組計畫在六月下旬完成最終測試。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmùzǔ jìhuà zài liù yuè xiàxún wánchéng zuìzhōng cèshì.
sentences.translation: The project team plans to complete the final testing in late June.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片立场鲜明，却没有忽视复杂的事实。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片立場鮮明，卻沒有忽視複雜的事實。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn lìchǎng xiānmíng, què méiyǒu hūshì fùzá de shìshí.
sentences.translation: This documentary has a clear standpoint, yet it does not ignore complicated facts.

sentences.chinese: 她的设计风格很鲜明，观众一眼就能认出来。
sentences.traditional: 她的設計風格很鮮明，觀眾一眼就能認出來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shèjì fēnggé hěn xiānmíng, guānzhòng yì yǎn jiù néng rèn chūlai.
sentences.translation: Her design style is very distinctive, and the audience can recognise it at a glance.

sentences.chinese: 改革前后的变化十分鲜明，尤其体现在服务效率上。
sentences.traditional: 改革前後的變化十分鮮明，尤其體現在服務效率上。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎigé qiánhòu de biànhuà shífēn xiānmíng, yóuqí tǐxiàn zài fúwù xiàolǜ shang.
sentences.translation: The changes before and after the reform are very clear, especially in service efficiency.

sentences.chinese: 先前提交的材料不完整，需要重新补充证明。
sentences.traditional: 先前提交的材料不完整，需要重新補充證明。
sentences.pinyin: Xiānqián tíjiāo de cáiliào bù wánzhěng, xūyào chóngxīn bǔchōng zhèngmíng.
sentences.translation: The materials submitted previously were incomplete, so supporting evidence needs to be added again.

sentences.chinese: 这个结果与先前的预测基本一致。
sentences.traditional: 這個結果與先前的預測基本一致。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ yǔ xiānqián de yùcè jīběn yízhì.
sentences.translation: This result is basically consistent with the previous prediction.

sentences.chinese: 由于先前沟通不足，双方对合同条款产生了误解。
sentences.traditional: 由於先前溝通不足，雙方對合同條款產生了誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú xiānqián gōutōng bùzú, shuāngfāng duì hétong tiáokuǎn chǎnshēng le wùjiě.
sentences.translation: Because earlier communication was insufficient, both sides developed misunderstandings about the contract terms.

sentences.chinese: 春天的花坛颜色鲜艳，吸引了不少游客拍照。
sentences.traditional: 春天的花壇顏色鮮豔，吸引了不少遊客拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān de huātán yánsè xiānyàn, xīyǐn le bù shǎo yóukè pāizhào.
sentences.translation: In spring, the flowerbeds are brightly coloured and attract many visitors to take photos.

sentences.chinese: 这套海报采用鲜艳的对比色，使主题更加突出。
sentences.traditional: 這套海報採用鮮豔的對比色，使主題更加突出。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào hǎibào cǎiyòng xiānyàn de duìbǐsè, shǐ zhǔtí gèngjiā tūchū.
sentences.translation: This set of posters uses vivid contrasting colours, making the theme stand out more.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们喜欢鲜艳的包装，但家长更关注食品成分。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們喜歡鮮豔的包裝，但家長更關注食品成分。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan xiānyàn de bāozhuāng, dàn jiāzhǎng gèng guānzhù shípǐn chéngfèn.
sentences.translation: Children like brightly coloured packaging, but parents pay more attention to food ingredients.

sentences.chinese: 他嫌房间太吵，要求换到安静一点的楼层。
sentences.traditional: 他嫌房間太吵，要求換到安靜一點的樓層。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xián fángjiān tài chǎo, yāoqiú huàn dào ānjìng yìdiǎn de lóucéng.
sentences.translation: He found the room too noisy and asked to move to a quieter floor.

sentences.chinese: 警方目前只是嫌他与案件有关，还没有正式起诉。
sentences.traditional: 警方目前只是嫌他與案件有關，還沒有正式起訴。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng mùqián zhǐshì xián tā yǔ ànjiàn yǒuguān, hái méiyǒu zhèngshì qǐsù.
sentences.translation: The police currently only suspect that he is connected to the case and have not formally charged him.

sentences.chinese: 你别嫌步骤麻烦，安全检查本来就不能省。
sentences.traditional: 你別嫌步驟麻煩，安全檢查本來就不能省。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié xián bùzhòu máfan, ānquán jiǎnchá běnlái jiù bù néng shěng.
sentences.translation: Do not complain that the steps are troublesome; safety checks cannot be skipped.

sentences.chinese: 这次调整效果不显，需要继续观察几个月。
sentences.traditional: 這次調整效果不顯，需要繼續觀察幾個月。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tiáozhěng xiàoguǒ bù xiǎn, xūyào jìxù guānchá jǐ ge yuè.
sentences.translation: The effect of this adjustment is not obvious and needs to be observed for a few more months.

sentences.chinese: 他在公开场合显得很冷静，实际上压力很大。
sentences.traditional: 他在公開場合顯得很冷靜，實際上壓力很大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài gōngkāi chǎnghé xiǎnde hěn lěngjìng, shíjì shang yālì hěn dà.
sentences.translation: He appears very calm in public, but is actually under great pressure.

sentences.chinese: 比较之后，优势立刻显了出来。
sentences.traditional: 比較之後，優勢立刻顯了出來。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐjiào zhīhòu, yōushì lìkè xiǎn le chūlai.
sentences.translation: After comparison, the advantage immediately became apparent.

sentences.chinese: 山路又窄又险，司机必须放慢速度。
sentences.traditional: 山路又窄又險，司機必須放慢速度。
sentences.pinyin: Shānlù yòu zhǎi yòu xiǎn, sījī bìxū fàng màn sùdù.
sentences.translation: The mountain road is narrow and dangerous, so drivers must slow down.

sentences.chinese: 他险些错过最后一班车，幸好同事提醒了他。
sentences.traditional: 他險些錯過最後一班車，幸好同事提醒了他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎnxiē cuòguò zuìhòu yì bān chē, xìnghǎo tóngshì tíxǐng le tā.
sentences.translation: He nearly missed the last bus; luckily, a colleague reminded him.

sentences.chinese: 比赛最后一分钟很险，对方差点把比分追平。
sentences.traditional: 比賽最後一分鐘很險，對方差點把比分追平。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài zuìhòu yì fēnzhōng hěn xiǎn, duìfāng chàdiǎn bǎ bǐfēn zhuīpíng.
sentences.translation: The final minute of the match was risky; the other side nearly levelled the score.

sentences.chinese: 新药在降低血压方面取得了显著效果。
sentences.traditional: 新藥在降低血壓方面取得了顯著效果。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn yào zài jiàngdī xuèyā fāngmiàn qǔdé le xiǎnzhù xiàoguǒ.
sentences.translation: The new drug achieved a significant effect in lowering blood pressure.

sentences.chinese: 经过培训，员工的服务水平有了显著提高。
sentences.traditional: 經過培訓，員工的服務水平有了顯著提高。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò péixùn, yuángōng de fúwù shuǐpíng yǒu le xiǎnzhù tígāo.
sentences.translation: After training, employees’ service standards improved significantly.

sentences.chinese: 城市空气质量与十年前相比显著改善。
sentences.traditional: 城市空氣質量與十年前相比顯著改善。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì kōngqì zhìliàng yǔ shí nián qián xiāngbǐ xiǎnzhù gǎishàn.
sentences.translation: The city’s air quality has improved significantly compared with ten years ago.

sentences.chinese: 影院规定每人限购两张特价票。
sentences.traditional: 影院規定每人限購兩張特價票。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngyuàn guīdìng měi rén xiàngòu liǎng zhāng tèjià piào.
sentences.translation: The cinema stipulates that each person is limited to buying two discounted tickets.

sentences.chinese: 报名人数必须限在三十人以内，否则无法保证质量。
sentences.traditional: 報名人數必須限在三十人以內，否則無法保證質量。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng rénshù bìxū xiàn zài sānshí rén yǐnèi, fǒuzé wúfǎ bǎozhèng zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: The number of applicants must be limited to within thirty; otherwise, quality cannot be guaranteed.

sentences.chinese: 合同明确限期交货，逾期要承担责任。
sentences.traditional: 合同明確限期交貨，逾期要承擔責任。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong míngquè xiànqī jiāohuò, yúqī yào chéngdān zérèn.
sentences.translation: The contract clearly sets a deadline for delivery, and delays carry responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 这条线代表去年销售额的变化趋势。
sentences.traditional: 這條線代表去年銷售額的變化趨勢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàn dàibiǎo qùnián xiāoshòu'é de biànhuà qūshì.
sentences.translation: This line represents the trend in last year’s sales.

sentences.chinese: 他把重要信息用红线画出来，方便开会时说明。
sentences.traditional: 他把重要信息用紅線畫出來，方便開會時說明。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhòngyào xìnxī yòng hóng xiàn huà chūlai, fāngbiàn kāihuì shí shuōmíng.
sentences.translation: He marked the important information with a red line to make it easier to explain during the meeting.

sentences.chinese: 工厂新增了一条生产线，预计产量会明显提高。
sentences.traditional: 工廠新增了一條生產線，預計產量會明顯提高。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng xīnzēng le yì tiáo shēngchǎnxiàn, yùjì chǎnliàng huì míngxiǎn tígāo.
sentences.translation: The factory added a new production line, and output is expected to rise clearly.

sentences.chinese: 现存资料不足以证明这个判断完全正确。
sentences.traditional: 現存資料不足以證明這個判斷完全正確。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàncún zīliào bù zúyǐ zhèngmíng zhège pànduàn wánquán zhèngquè.
sentences.translation: The existing materials are insufficient to prove that this judgement is completely correct.

sentences.chinese: 这座寺庙是本地区现存最早的木结构建筑。
sentences.traditional: 這座寺廟是本地區現存最早的木結構建築。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò sìmiào shì běn dìqū xiàncún zuì zǎo de mù jiégòu jiànzhù.
sentences.translation: This temple is the earliest surviving wooden structure in the area.

sentences.chinese: 公司正在评估现存系统是否还能支持未来需求。
sentences.traditional: 公司正在評估現存系統是否還能支援未來需求。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài pínggū xiàncún xìtǒng shìfǒu hái néng zhīyuán wèilái xūqiú.
sentences.translation: The company is evaluating whether the existing system can still support future needs.

sentences.chinese: 忍耐也有一定限度，长期加班会影响健康。
sentences.traditional: 忍耐也有一定限度，長期加班會影響健康。
sentences.pinyin: Rěnnài yě yǒu yídìng xiàndù, chángqī jiābān huì yǐngxiǎng jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: Tolerance also has a certain limit; long-term overtime affects health.

sentences.chinese: 法律允许批评，但言论自由并非没有限度。
sentences.traditional: 法律允許批評，但言論自由並非沒有限度。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ yǔnxǔ pīpíng, dàn yánlùn zìyóu bìngfēi méiyǒu xiàndù.
sentences.translation: The law allows criticism, but freedom of speech is not without limits.

sentences.chinese: 在资源有限的情况下，项目规模必须控制在合理限度内。
sentences.traditional: 在資源有限的情況下，項目規模必須控制在合理限度內。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zīyuán yǒuxiàn de qíngkuàng xià, xiàngmù guīmó bìxū kòngzhì zài hélǐ xiàndù nèi.
sentences.translation: With limited resources, the project scale must be kept within reasonable limits.

sentences.chinese: 这款相机目前没有现货，需要等两周才能发货。
sentences.traditional: 這款相機目前沒有現貨，需要等兩週才能發貨。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xiàngjī mùqián méiyǒu xiànhuò, xūyào děng liǎng zhōu cáinéng fāhuò.
sentences.translation: This camera is currently not in stock and will take two weeks to dispatch.

sentences.chinese: 如果客户急用，我们优先推荐有现货的型号。
sentences.traditional: 如果客戶急用，我們優先推薦有現貨的型號。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kèhù jíyòng, wǒmen yōuxiān tuījiàn yǒu xiànhuò de xínghào.
sentences.translation: If customers need it urgently, we first recommend models that are in stock.

sentences.chinese: 仓库每天更新现货清单，避免销售人员误报库存。
sentences.traditional: 倉庫每天更新現貨清單，避免銷售人員誤報庫存。
sentences.pinyin: Cāngkù měitiān gēngxīn xiànhuò qīngdān, bìmiǎn xiāoshòu rényuán wùbào kùcún.
sentences.translation: The warehouse updates the in-stock list daily to prevent sales staff from reporting inventory incorrectly.

sentences.chinese: 如果缺乏清晰的目标，团队很容易陷入无休止的讨论。
sentences.traditional: 如果缺乏清晰的目標，團隊很容易陷入無休止的討論。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ quēfá qīngxī de mùbiāo, tuánduì hěn róngyì xiànrù wúxiūzhǐ de tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: If there is no clear goal, the team can easily fall into endless discussion.

sentences.chinese: 公司陷入资金周转困难后，不得不推迟扩张计划。
sentences.traditional: 公司陷入資金週轉困難後，不得不推遲擴張計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xiànrù zījīn zhōuzhuǎn kùnnan hòu, bùdébù tuīchí kuòzhāng jìhuà.
sentences.translation: After the company fell into cash-flow difficulties, it had to postpone its expansion plan.

sentences.chinese: 长期失业可能使人陷入自我怀疑，需要家人和社会的支持。
sentences.traditional: 長期失業可能使人陷入自我懷疑，需要家人和社會的支持。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī shīyè kěnéng shǐ rén xiànrù zìwǒ huáiyí, xūyào jiārén hé shèhuì de zhīchí.
sentences.translation: Long-term unemployment may cause people to fall into self-doubt and requires support from family and society.

sentences.chinese: 这条线索虽然很小，却帮助警方找到了关键证人。
sentences.traditional: 這條線索雖然很小，卻幫助警方找到了關鍵證人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiànsuǒ suīrán hěn xiǎo, què bāngzhù jǐngfāng zhǎodào le guānjiàn zhèngrén.
sentences.translation: Although this clue was small, it helped the police find a key witness.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员从旧档案中发现了新的线索。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員從舊檔案中發現了新的線索。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán cóng jiù dàng'àn zhōng fāxiàn le xīn de xiànsuǒ.
sentences.translation: The researchers discovered new clues in the old archives.

sentences.chinese: 他讲话前后矛盾，给调查留下了重要线索。
sentences.traditional: 他講話前後矛盾，給調查留下了重要線索。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎnghuà qiánhòu máodùn, gěi diàochá liúxià le zhòngyào xiànsuǒ.
sentences.translation: His contradictory statements left an important clue for the investigation.

sentences.chinese: 由于时间有限，今天的讨论只能限于预算问题。
sentences.traditional: 由於時間有限，今天的討論只能限於預算問題。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shíjiān yǒuxiàn, jīntiān de tǎolùn zhǐ néng xiànyú yùsuàn wèntí.
sentences.translation: Because time is limited, today's discussion can only be limited to budget issues.

sentences.chinese: 这项服务目前限于本市居民，外地用户暂时不能申请。
sentences.traditional: 這項服務目前限於本市居民，外地用戶暫時不能申請。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fúwù mùqián xiànyú běn shì jūmín, wàidì yònghù zànshí bù néng shēnqǐng.
sentences.translation: This service is currently limited to residents of this city, and users from other areas cannot apply for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告的结论限于公开数据，不能代表全部情况。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告的結論限於公開數據，不能代表全部情況。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de jiélùn xiànyú gōngkāi shùjù, bù néng dàibiǎo quánbù qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: The conclusions of this report are limited to public data and cannot represent the whole situation.

sentences.chinese: 两个方案的成本相差不大，但执行难度完全不同。
sentences.traditional: 兩個方案的成本相差不大，但執行難度完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng ge fāng'àn de chéngběn xiāngchà bù dà, dàn zhíxíng nándù wánquán bùtóng.
sentences.translation: The costs of the two plans do not differ much, but their difficulty of implementation is completely different.

sentences.chinese: 他们年龄相差十岁，却有很多共同话题。
sentences.traditional: 他們年齡相差十歲，卻有很多共同話題。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen niánlíng xiāngchà shí suì, què yǒu hěn duō gòngtóng huàtí.
sentences.translation: They differ in age by ten years, yet they have many topics in common.

sentences.chinese: 统计结果与实际情况相差太远，必须重新核实。
sentences.traditional: 統計結果與實際情況相差太遠，必須重新核實。
sentences.pinyin: Tǒngjì jiéguǒ yǔ shíjì qíngkuàng xiāngchà tài yuǎn, bìxū chóngxīn héshí.
sentences.translation: The statistical results differ too much from the actual situation and must be checked again.

sentences.chinese: 这家店的香肠味道很重，最好配一些清淡的蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 這家店的香腸味道很重，最好配一些清淡的蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de xiāngcháng wèidào hěn zhòng, zuìhǎo pèi yìxiē qīngdàn de shūcài.
sentences.translation: The sausages in this shop have a strong flavour, so they are best paired with some light vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他少吃香肠等加工肉类。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他少吃香腸等加工肉類。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā shǎo chī xiāngcháng děng jiāgōng ròulèi.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to eat less processed meat such as sausages.

sentences.chinese: 节日期间，市场上各种香肠的销量明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 節日期間，市場上各種香腸的銷量明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Jiérì qījiān, shìchǎng shang gè zhǒng xiāngcháng de xiāoliàng míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: During the holiday period, sales of all kinds of sausages in the market clearly increased.

sentences.chinese: 相传这座古桥是几百年前由当地工匠建成的。
sentences.traditional: 相傳這座古橋是幾百年前由當地工匠建成的。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāngchuán zhè zuò gǔqiáo shì jǐ bǎi nián qián yóu dāngdì gōngjiàng jiànchéng de.
sentences.translation: It is said that this ancient bridge was built hundreds of years ago by local craftsmen.

sentences.chinese: 村里相传山后有一眼不会干涸的泉水。
sentences.traditional: 村裡相傳山後有一眼不會乾涸的泉水。
sentences.pinyin: Cūn lǐ xiāngchuán shān hòu yǒu yì yǎn bú huì gānhé de quánshuǐ.
sentences.translation: People in the village say that behind the mountain there is a spring that never dries up.

sentences.chinese: 这个节日的习俗相传与一位诗人有关。
sentences.traditional: 這個節日的習俗相傳與一位詩人有關。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiérì de xísú xiāngchuán yǔ yí wèi shīrén yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: The customs of this festival are said to be connected with a poet.

sentences.chinese: 合同规定，双方的权利和责任基本相等。
sentences.traditional: 合同規定，雙方的權利和責任基本相等。
sentences.pinyin: Hétong guīdìng, shuāngfāng de quánlì hé zérèn jīběn xiāngděng.
sentences.translation: The contract states that the rights and responsibilities of both parties are basically equal.

sentences.chinese: 如果两个角的大小相等，这个图形就比较容易计算。
sentences.traditional: 如果兩個角的大小相等，這個圖形就比較容易計算。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ liǎng ge jiǎo de dàxiǎo xiāngděng, zhège túxíng jiù bǐjiào róngyì jìsuàn.
sentences.translation: If the two angles are equal in size, this figure is relatively easy to calculate.

sentences.chinese: 这两份工作的收入相等，但发展空间差别很大。
sentences.traditional: 這兩份工作的收入相等，但發展空間差別很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng fèn gōngzuò de shōurù xiāngděng, dàn fāzhǎn kōngjiān chābié hěn dà.
sentences.translation: The incomes of these two jobs are equal, but their development prospects differ greatly.

sentences.chinese: 两座城市由一条高速铁路相连，往来十分方便。
sentences.traditional: 兩座城市由一條高速鐵路相連，往來十分方便。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng zuò chéngshì yóu yì tiáo gāosù tiělù xiānglián, wǎnglái shífēn fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: The two cities are connected by a high-speed railway, making travel between them very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 这些问题彼此相连，不能只解决其中一个。
sentences.traditional: 這些問題彼此相連，不能只解決其中一個。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí bǐcǐ xiānglián, bù néng zhǐ jiějué qízhōng yí ge.
sentences.translation: These problems are connected with one another, so we cannot solve only one of them.

sentences.chinese: 互联网让偏远地区与外界更加紧密相连。
sentences.traditional: 互聯網讓偏遠地區與外界更加緊密相連。
sentences.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng ràng piānyuǎn dìqū yǔ wàijiè gèngjiā jǐnmì xiānglián.
sentences.translation: The internet connects remote areas more closely with the outside world.

sentences.chinese: 她不喜欢味道太浓的香水，觉得在办公室不太合适。
sentences.traditional: 她不喜歡味道太濃的香水，覺得在辦公室不太合適。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuan wèidào tài nóng de xiāngshuǐ, juéde zài bàngōngshì bù tài héshì.
sentences.translation: She does not like perfume with too strong a scent, and feels it is not very suitable for the office.

sentences.chinese: 这款香水的包装简洁，主要面向年轻消费者。
sentences.traditional: 這款香水的包裝簡潔，主要面向年輕消費者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xiāngshuǐ de bāozhuāng jiǎnjié, zhǔyào miànxiàng niánqīng xiāofèizhě.
sentences.translation: The packaging of this perfume is simple, and it is mainly aimed at young consumers.

sentences.chinese: 在公共场合使用香水时，也要考虑他人的感受。
sentences.traditional: 在公共場合使用香水時，也要考慮他人的感受。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gōnggòng chǎnghé shǐyòng xiāngshuǐ shí, yě yào kǎolǜ tārén de gǎnshòu.
