sentences.translation: When using perfume in public places, you should also consider other people's feelings.

sentences.chinese: 政策调整后，企业需要制定相应的培训计划。
sentences.traditional: 政策調整後，企業需要制定相應的培訓計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè tiáozhěng hòu, qǐyè xūyào zhìdìng xiāngyìng de péixùn jìhuà.
sentences.translation: After the policy adjustment, companies need to develop corresponding training plans.

sentences.chinese: 申请材料不完整的，相关部门会要求补交相应文件。
sentences.traditional: 申請材料不完整的，相關部門會要求補交相應文件。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng cáiliào bù wánzhěng de, xiāngguān bùmén huì yāoqiú bǔjiāo xiāngyìng wénjiàn.
sentences.translation: If the application materials are incomplete, the relevant department will require the applicant to submit the corresponding documents.

sentences.chinese: 风险增加时，保险费用也会相应提高。
sentences.traditional: 風險增加時，保險費用也會相應提高。
sentences.pinyin: Fēngxiǎn zēngjiā shí, bǎoxiǎn fèiyòng yě huì xiāngyìng tígāo.
sentences.translation: When risk increases, insurance costs will also rise accordingly.

sentences.chinese: 她把那条项链锁进保险箱，因为它是母亲留下的纪念品。
sentences.traditional: 她把那條項鍊鎖進保險箱，因為它是母親留下的紀念品。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà tiáo xiàngliàn suǒ jìn bǎoxiǎnxiāng, yīnwèi tā shì mǔqīn liú xià de jìniànpǐn.
sentences.translation: She locked that necklace in the safe because it was a keepsake left by her mother.

sentences.chinese: 这款项链的设计很低调，适合正式场合佩戴。
sentences.traditional: 這款項鍊的設計很低調，適合正式場合佩戴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xiàngliàn de shèjì hěn dīdiào, shìhé zhèngshì chǎnghé pèidài.
sentences.translation: The design of this necklace is understated and suitable for formal occasions.

sentences.chinese: 她发现项链上的扣子松了，便拿去店里维修。
sentences.traditional: 她發現項鍊上的釦子鬆了，便拿去店裡維修。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn xiàngliàn shàng de kòuzi sōng le, biàn ná qù diàn lǐ wéixiū.
sentences.translation: She noticed that the clasp on the necklace was loose, so she took it to a shop for repair.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷每天傍晚都在小区门口和邻居下象棋。
sentences.traditional: 爺爺每天傍晚都在社區門口和鄰居下象棋。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye měitiān bàngwǎn dōu zài shèqū ménkǒu hé línjū xià xiàngqí.
sentences.translation: Every evening, Grandpa plays Chinese chess with neighbours at the entrance of the community.

sentences.chinese: 象棋不仅考验记忆力，也考验对局势的判断。
sentences.traditional: 象棋不僅考驗記憶力，也考驗對局勢的判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngqí bùjǐn kǎoyàn jìyìlì, yě kǎoyàn duì júshì de pànduàn.
sentences.translation: Chinese chess tests not only memory, but also judgement of the overall situation.

sentences.chinese: 他通过网络平台学习象棋，水平进步得很快。
sentences.traditional: 他通過網絡平臺學習象棋，水平進步得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngguò wǎngluò píngtái xuéxí xiàngqí, shuǐpíng jìnbù de hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: He studies Chinese chess through online platforms, and his level is improving quickly.

sentences.chinese: 那段相声把日常生活中的矛盾说得很幽默。
sentences.traditional: 那段相聲把日常生活中的矛盾說得很幽默。
sentences.pinyin: Nà duàn xiàngsheng bǎ rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng de máodùn shuō de hěn yōumò.
sentences.translation: That crosstalk routine described conflicts in daily life in a very humorous way.

sentences.chinese: 相声演员需要反应快，还要有很强的语言能力。
sentences.traditional: 相聲演員需要反應快，還要有很強的語言能力。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngsheng yǎnyuán xūyào fǎnyìng kuài, hái yào yǒu hěn qiáng de yǔyán nénglì.
sentences.translation: Crosstalk performers need quick reactions as well as strong language skills.

sentences.chinese: 我听不懂所有包袱，但能感受到相声的节奏。
sentences.traditional: 我聽不懂所有包袱，但能感受到相聲的節奏。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng bu dǒng suǒyǒu bāofu, dàn néng gǎnshòu dào xiàngsheng de jiézòu.
sentences.translation: I cannot understand all the punchlines, but I can feel the rhythm of crosstalk.

sentences.chinese: 他一直向往一种更自由的生活方式。
sentences.traditional: 他一直嚮往一種更自由的生活方式。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìzhí xiàngwǎng yì zhǒng gèng zìyóu de shēnghuó fāngshì.
sentences.translation: He has always yearned for a freer way of life.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人向往大城市的机会，也担心那里的生活压力。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人嚮往大城市的機會，也擔心那裡的生活壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīngrén xiàngwǎng dà chéngshì de jīhuì, yě dānxīn nàlǐ de shēnghuó yālì.
sentences.translation: Young people yearn for the opportunities of big cities, but also worry about the pressure of life there.

sentences.chinese: 她并不向往名声，只希望作品能被认真阅读。
sentences.traditional: 她並不嚮往名聲，只希望作品能被認真閱讀。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù xiàngwǎng míngshēng, zhǐ xīwàng zuòpǐn néng bèi rènzhēn yuèdú.
sentences.translation: She does not yearn for fame; she only hopes her work will be read seriously.

sentences.chinese: 这项改革旨在消除城乡之间的教育差距。
sentences.traditional: 這項改革旨在消除城鄉之間的教育差距。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé zhǐ zài xiāochú chéngxiāng zhījiān de jiàoyù chājù.
sentences.translation: This reform aims to eliminate the education gap between urban and rural areas.

sentences.chinese: 充分沟通可以消除双方对合作的误解。
sentences.traditional: 充分溝通可以消除雙方對合作的誤解。
sentences.pinyin: Chōngfèn gōutōng kěyǐ xiāochú shuāngfāng duì hézuò de wùjiě.
sentences.translation: Full communication can eliminate both sides' misunderstandings about the cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 医生说这种药只能缓解症状，不能完全消除病因。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說這種藥只能緩解症狀，不能完全消除病因。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè zhǒng yào zhǐ néng huǎnjiě zhèngzhuàng, bù néng wánquán xiāochú bìngyīn.
sentences.translation: The doctor said this medicine can only relieve symptoms and cannot completely eliminate the cause of the illness.

sentences.chinese: 进入实验室前，所有工具都必须彻底消毒。
sentences.traditional: 進入實驗室前，所有工具都必須徹底消毒。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù shíyànshì qián, suǒyǒu gōngjù dōu bìxū chèdǐ xiāodú.
sentences.translation: Before entering the laboratory, all tools must be thoroughly disinfected.

sentences.chinese: 医院会定时给候诊区消毒，以降低感染风险。
sentences.traditional: 醫院會定時給候診區消毒，以降低感染風險。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn huì dìngshí gěi hòuzhěnqū xiāodú, yǐ jiàngdī gǎnrǎn fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: The hospital disinfects the waiting area regularly to reduce the risk of infection.

sentences.chinese: 水果切开之前，最好先把刀具清洗并消毒。
sentences.traditional: 水果切開之前，最好先把刀具清洗並消毒。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐguǒ qiē kāi zhīqián, zuì hǎo xiān bǎ dāojù qīngxǐ bìng xiāodú.
sentences.translation: Before cutting fruit open, it is best to wash and disinfect the knife first.

sentences.chinese: 商场每半年都会组织一次消防演练。
sentences.traditional: 商場每半年都會組織一次消防演練。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngchǎng měi bàn nián dōu huì zǔzhī yí cì xiāofáng yǎnliàn.
sentences.translation: The shopping centre organises a fire drill once every six months.

sentences.chinese: 老旧小区的消防通道经常被私家车堵住。
sentences.traditional: 老舊社區的消防通道經常被私家車堵住。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎojiù shèqū de xiāofáng tōngdào jīngcháng bèi sījiāchē dǔ zhù.
sentences.translation: The fire access routes in old residential communities are often blocked by private cars.

sentences.chinese: 学校把消防知识列入了新生培训内容。
sentences.traditional: 學校把消防知識列入了新生培訓內容。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào bǎ xiāofáng zhīshi lièrù le xīnshēng péixùn nèiróng.
sentences.translation: The school included fire safety knowledge in the training for new students.

sentences.chinese: 长时间开空调会消耗大量电力。
sentences.traditional: 長時間開空調會消耗大量電力。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān kāi kōngtiáo huì xiāohào dàliàng diànlì.
sentences.translation: Running the air conditioner for a long time consumes a large amount of electricity.

sentences.chinese: 这项工程消耗了太多人力和资金，必须重新评估。
sentences.traditional: 這項工程消耗了太多人力和資金，必須重新評估。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngchéng xiāohào le tài duō rénlì hé zījīn, bìxū chóngxīn pínggū.
sentences.translation: This project has consumed too much manpower and money and must be re-evaluated.

sentences.chinese: 反复争论只会消耗团队的耐心和信任。
sentences.traditional: 反覆爭論只會消耗團隊的耐心和信任。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎnfù zhēnglùn zhǐ huì xiāohào tuánduì de nàixīn hé xìnrèn.
sentences.translation: Repeated arguments will only consume the team's patience and trust.

sentences.chinese: 农民希望用更环保的方法消灭害虫。
sentences.traditional: 農民希望用更環保的方法消滅害蟲。
sentences.pinyin: Nóngmín xīwàng yòng gèng huánbǎo de fāngfǎ xiāomiè hàichóng.
sentences.translation: Farmers hope to eliminate pests using more environmentally friendly methods.

sentences.chinese: 这种疫苗曾帮助人类几乎消灭一种严重传染病。
sentences.traditional: 這種疫苗曾幫助人類幾乎消滅一種嚴重傳染病。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yìmiáo céng bāngzhù rénlèi jīhū xiāomiè yì zhǒng yánzhòng chuánrǎnbìng.
sentences.translation: This vaccine once helped humanity almost eliminate a serious infectious disease.

sentences.chinese: 要消灭贫困，光靠捐款远远不够。
sentences.traditional: 要消滅貧困，光靠捐款遠遠不夠。
sentences.pinyin: Yào xiāomiè pínkùn, guāng kào juānkuǎn yuǎnyuǎn bù gòu.
sentences.translation: To eliminate poverty, relying only on donations is far from enough.

sentences.chinese: 今年的干旱影响了小麦产量，农民很担心。
sentences.traditional: 今年的乾旱影響了小麥產量，農民很擔心。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián de gānhàn yǐngxiǎng le xiǎomài chǎnliàng, nóngmín hěn dānxīn.
sentences.translation: This year's drought affected the wheat yield, and the farmers are very worried.

sentences.chinese: 小麦价格上涨，可能会带动面包成本增加。
sentences.traditional: 小麥價格上漲，可能會帶動麵包成本增加。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomài jiàgé shàngzhǎng, kěnéng huì dàidòng miànbāo chéngběn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: A rise in wheat prices may drive up the cost of bread.

sentences.chinese: 这片土地原来种小麦，后来改种了蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 這片土地原來種小麥，後來改種了蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔdì yuánlái zhòng xiǎomài, hòulái gǎi zhòng le shūcài.
sentences.translation: This piece of land used to grow wheat, but later it was changed to vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 他并不是小气，只是觉得这笔费用没有必要。
sentences.traditional: 他並不是小氣，只是覺得這筆費用沒有必要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bú shì xiǎoqi, zhǐshì juéde zhè bǐ fèiyòng méiyǒu bìyào.
sentences.translation: He is not being stingy; he just thinks this expense is unnecessary.

sentences.chinese: 在朋友困难的时候还斤斤计较，难免显得有点小气。
sentences.traditional: 在朋友困難的時候還斤斤計較，難免顯得有點小氣。
sentences.pinyin: Zài péngyou kùnnan de shíhou hái jīnjīnjìjiào, nánmiǎn xiǎnde yǒudiǎn xiǎoqi.
sentences.translation: If you still haggle over every little thing when a friend is in difficulty, you will inevitably seem a bit stingy.

sentences.chinese: 老板如果过于小气，优秀员工迟早会离开。
sentences.traditional: 老闆如果過於小氣，優秀員工遲早會離開。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn rúguǒ guòyú xiǎoqi, yōuxiù yuángōng chízǎo huì líkāi.
sentences.translation: If a boss is too stingy, good employees will leave sooner or later.

sentences.chinese: 警察很快抓住了那个在车站偷钱包的小偷儿。
sentences.traditional: 警察很快抓住了那個在車站偷錢包的小偷兒。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá hěn kuài zhuāzhù le nà ge zài chēzhàn tōu qiánbāo de xiǎotōur.
sentences.translation: The police quickly caught the thief who had stolen wallets at the station.

sentences.chinese: 商店安装摄像头以后，小偷儿明显少了。
sentences.traditional: 商店安裝攝像頭以後，小偷兒明顯少了。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngdiàn ānzhuāng shèxiàngtóu yǐhòu, xiǎotōur míngxiǎn shǎo le.
sentences.translation: After the shop installed cameras, there were clearly fewer thieves.

sentences.chinese: 他以为对方是小偷儿，结果只是误会一场。
sentences.traditional: 他以為對方是小偷兒，結果只是誤會一場。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi duìfāng shì xiǎotōur, jiéguǒ zhǐshì wùhuì yì chǎng.
sentences.translation: He thought the other person was a thief, but it turned out to be only a misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 听到录取消息后，她脸上露出了久违的笑容。
sentences.traditional: 聽到錄取消息後，她臉上露出了久違的笑容。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào lùqǔ xiāoxi hòu, tā liǎn shàng lùchū le jiǔwéi de xiàoróng.
sentences.translation: After hearing the news of her admission, a long-absent smile appeared on her face.

sentences.chinese: 他的笑容很真诚，让紧张的气氛缓和了下来。
sentences.traditional: 他的笑容很真誠，讓緊張的氣氛緩和了下來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xiàoróng hěn zhēnchéng, ràng jǐnzhāng de qìfēn huǎnhé le xiàlai.
sentences.translation: His smile was very sincere and eased the tense atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 照片里的笑容虽然灿烂，却掩盖不了她的疲惫。
sentences.traditional: 照片裡的笑容雖然燦爛，卻掩蓋不了她的疲憊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ de xiàoróng suīrán cànlàn, què yǎngài bùliǎo tā de píbèi.
sentences.translation: Although the smile in the photo was bright, it could not hide her tiredness.

sentences.chinese: 这项政策的长期效应还需要进一步观察。
sentences.traditional: 這項政策的長期效應還需要進一步觀察。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de chángqī xiàoyìng hái xūyào jìnyíbù guānchá.
sentences.translation: The long-term effect of this policy still needs further observation.

sentences.chinese: 媒体报道引发了连锁效应，更多受害者站出来发声。
sentences.traditional: 媒體報導引發了連鎖效應，更多受害者站出來發聲。
sentences.pinyin: Méitǐ bàodào yǐnfā le liánsuǒ xiàoyìng, gèng duō shòuhàizhě zhàn chūlai fāshēng.
sentences.translation: The media report triggered a chain effect, and more victims came forward to speak out.

sentences.chinese: 专家提醒，任何药物都可能产生副效应。
sentences.traditional: 專家提醒，任何藥物都可能產生副效應。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiā tíxǐng, rènhé yàowù dōu kěnéng chǎnshēng fù xiàoyìng.
sentences.translation: Experts warn that any medicine may produce side effects.

sentences.chinese: 连续开了四个小时车，他决定在服务区歇一会儿。
sentences.traditional: 連續開了四個小時車，他決定在服務區歇一會兒。
sentences.pinyin: Liánxù kāi le sì ge xiǎoshí chē, tā juédìng zài fúwùqū xiē yíhuìr.
sentences.translation: After driving for four hours in a row, he decided to rest for a while at the service area.

sentences.chinese: 机器运转太久了，最好让它歇一歇。
sentences.traditional: 機器運轉太久了，最好讓它歇一歇。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì yùnzhuǎn tài jiǔ le, zuì hǎo ràng tā xiē yi xiē.
sentences.translation: The machine has been running for too long; it would be best to let it rest for a bit.

sentences.chinese: 大家忙了一整天，终于可以坐下来歇口气。
sentences.traditional: 大家忙了一整天，終於可以坐下來歇口氣。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā máng le yì zhěng tiān, zhōngyú kěyǐ zuò xiàlai xiē kǒu qì.
sentences.translation: Everyone had been busy all day and could finally sit down to catch their breath.

sentences.chinese: 乘客不得携带危险品进入地铁站。
sentences.traditional: 乘客不得攜帶危險品進入地鐵站。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngkè bùdé xiédài wēixiǎnpǐn jìnrù dìtiězhàn.
sentences.translation: Passengers may not carry dangerous goods into the underground station.

sentences.chinese: 这种病毒可能由野生动物携带，因此接触时要格外小心。
sentences.traditional: 這種病毒可能由野生動物攜帶，因此接觸時要格外小心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìngdú kěnéng yóu yěshēng dòngwù xiédài, yīncǐ jiēchù shí yào géwài xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: This virus may be carried by wild animals, so extra care is needed when coming into contact with them.

sentences.chinese: 出国开会时，她总是携带一份纸质邀请函。
sentences.traditional: 出國開會時，她總是攜帶一份紙質邀請函。
sentences.pinyin: Chūguó kāihuì shí, tā zǒng shì xiédài yí fèn zhǐzhì yāoqǐnghán.
sentences.translation: When travelling abroad for meetings, she always carries a paper invitation letter.

sentences.chinese: 行业协会发布了新的服务标准，要求会员单位认真执行。
sentences.traditional: 行業協會發布了新的服務標準，要求會員單位認真執行。
sentences.pinyin: Hángyè xiéhuì fābù le xīn de fúwù biāozhǔn, yāoqiú huìyuán dānwèi rènzhēn zhíxíng.
sentences.translation: The industry association issued new service standards and required member organisations to implement them carefully.

sentences.chinese: 这个协会经常组织公益活动，帮助偏远地区的学生。
sentences.traditional: 這個協會經常組織公益活動，幫助偏遠地區的學生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiéhuì jīngcháng zǔzhī gōngyì huódòng, bāngzhù piānyuǎn dìqū de xuésheng.
sentences.translation: This association often organises public-interest activities to help students in remote areas.

sentences.chinese: 加入协会以后，他获得了更多与同行交流的机会。
sentences.traditional: 加入協會以後，他獲得了更多與同行交流的機會。
sentences.pinyin: Jiārù xiéhuì yǐhòu, tā huòdé le gèng duō yǔ tóngháng jiāoliú de jīhuì.
sentences.translation: After joining the association, he gained more opportunities to communicate with people in the same profession.

sentences.chinese: 项目经理需要协调各部门的进度，避免资源浪费。
sentences.traditional: 項目經理需要協調各部門的進度，避免資源浪費。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù jīnglǐ xūyào xiétiáo gè bùmén de jìndù, bìmiǎn zīyuán làngfèi.
sentences.translation: The project manager needs to coordinate the progress of all departments to avoid wasting resources.

sentences.chinese: 这套家具的颜色很协调，放在客厅里并不突兀。
sentences.traditional: 這套傢俱的顏色很協調，放在客廳裡並不突兀。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào jiājù de yánsè hěn xiétiáo, fàng zài kètīng lǐ bìng bù tūwù.
sentences.translation: The colours of this furniture set are well coordinated, so it does not look out of place in the living room.

sentences.chinese: 如果双方利益无法协调，谈判就很难继续。
sentences.traditional: 如果雙方利益無法協調，談判就很難繼續。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shuāngfāng lìyì wúfǎ xiétiáo, tánpàn jiù hěn nán jìxù.
sentences.translation: If the interests of both sides cannot be coordinated, the negotiations will be hard to continue.

sentences.chinese: 警方请求市民协助寻找失踪儿童。
sentences.traditional: 警方請求市民協助尋找失蹤兒童。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngfāng qǐngqiú shìmín xiézhù xúnzhǎo shīzōng értóng.
sentences.translation: The police asked citizens to assist in searching for the missing child.

sentences.chinese: 新系统上线后，技术人员会协助员工完成培训。
sentences.traditional: 新系統上線後，技術人員會協助員工完成培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng shàngxiàn hòu, jìshù rényuán huì xiézhù yuángōng wánchéng péixùn.
sentences.translation: After the new system goes online, technical staff will assist employees in completing the training.

sentences.chinese: 感谢你协助我们整理这些复杂的资料。
sentences.traditional: 感謝你協助我們整理這些複雜的資料。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎnxiè nǐ xiézhù wǒmen zhěnglǐ zhèxiē fùzá de zīliào.
sentences.translation: Thank you for assisting us in organising these complicated materials.

sentences.chinese: 她把心爱的书包送给了刚上小学的妹妹。
sentences.traditional: 她把心愛的書包送給了剛上小學的妹妹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xīn'ài de shūbāo sòng gěi le gāng shàng xiǎoxué de mèimei.
sentences.translation: She gave her beloved schoolbag to her younger sister, who had just started primary school.

sentences.chinese: 那只心爱的玩具熊陪伴他度过了整个童年。
sentences.traditional: 那隻心愛的玩具熊陪伴他度過了整個童年。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī xīn'ài de wánjù xióng péibàn tā dùguò le zhěnggè tóngnián.
sentences.translation: That beloved teddy bear accompanied him throughout his childhood.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护心爱的家园，村民们决定共同维护这片森林。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護心愛的家園，村民們決定共同維護這片森林。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù xīn'ài de jiāyuán, cūnmínmen juédìng gòngtóng wéihù zhè piàn sēnlín.
sentences.translation: To protect their beloved home, the villagers decided to maintain this forest together.

sentences.chinese: 他心底一直记得那位老师当年的鼓励。
sentences.traditional: 他心底一直記得那位老師當年的鼓勵。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīndǐ yìzhí jìde nà wèi lǎoshī dāngnián de gǔlì.
sentences.translation: Deep in his heart, he has always remembered that teacher's encouragement from those years.

sentences.chinese: 她表面很平静，心底却充满了不安。
sentences.traditional: 她表面很平靜，心底卻充滿了不安。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biǎomiàn hěn píngjìng, xīndǐ què chōngmǎn le bù'ān.
sentences.translation: On the surface she was calm, but deep down she was full of unease.

sentences.chinese: 这个秘密藏在他心底多年，从未告诉任何人。
sentences.traditional: 這個秘密藏在他心底多年，從未告訴任何人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège mìmì cáng zài tā xīndǐ duō nián, cóngwèi gàosu rènhé rén.
sentences.translation: This secret stayed hidden in his heart for many years and was never told to anyone.

sentences.chinese: 这家店刚推出新款手机，价格比上一代高不少。
sentences.traditional: 這家店剛推出新款手機，價格比上一代高不少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn gāng tuīchū xīnkuǎn shǒujī, jiàgé bǐ shàng yí dài gāo bù shǎo.
sentences.translation: This shop has just launched a new phone model, and the price is quite a bit higher than the previous generation.

sentences.chinese: 新款运动鞋采用可回收材料，受到年轻消费者欢迎。
sentences.traditional: 新款運動鞋採用可回收材料，受到年輕消費者歡迎。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnkuǎn yùndòngxié cǎiyòng kě huíshōu cáiliào, shòudào niánqīng xiāofèizhě huānyíng.
sentences.translation: The new style of trainers uses recyclable materials and is popular with young consumers.

sentences.chinese: 如果预算有限，买旧款并不一定比买新款差。
sentences.traditional: 如果預算有限，買舊款並不一定比買新款差。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, mǎi jiùkuǎn bìng bù yídìng bǐ mǎi xīnkuǎn chà.
sentences.translation: If the budget is limited, buying the older model is not necessarily worse than buying the new one.

sentences.chinese: 音乐能安慰人的心灵，尤其是在压力很大的时候。
sentences.traditional: 音樂能安慰人的心靈，尤其是在壓力很大的時候。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnyuè néng ānwèi rén de xīnlíng, yóuqí shì zài yālì hěn dà de shíhou.
sentences.translation: Music can comfort the human heart, especially at times of great pressure.

sentences.chinese: 真正的教育不只传授知识，也应该滋养心灵。
sentences.traditional: 真正的教育不只傳授知識，也應該滋養心靈。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de jiàoyù bù zhǐ chuánshòu zhīshi, yě yīnggāi zīyǎng xīnlíng.
sentences.translation: True education does not only pass on knowledge; it should also nourish the soul.

sentences.chinese: 长期接触自然，对孩子的心灵成长很有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 長期接觸自然，對孩子的心靈成長很有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī jiēchù zìrán, duì háizi de xīnlíng chéngzhǎng hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: Long-term contact with nature is very helpful for the growth of a child's inner world.

sentences.chinese: 新媒体改变了公众获取新闻的方式。
sentences.traditional: 新媒體改變了公眾獲取新聞的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnméitǐ gǎibiàn le gōngzhòng huòqǔ xīnwén de fāngshì.
sentences.translation: New media has changed the way the public obtains news.

sentences.chinese: 企业越来越重视新媒体运营，以便接触年轻用户。
sentences.traditional: 企業越來越重視新媒體運營，以便接觸年輕用戶。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yuè lái yuè zhòngshì xīnméitǐ yùnyíng, yǐbiàn jiēchù niánqīng yònghù.
sentences.translation: Companies are placing increasing importance on new-media operations so that they can reach younger users.

sentences.chinese: 在新媒体环境下，谣言传播的速度更快。
sentences.traditional: 在新媒體環境下，謠言傳播的速度更快。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xīnméitǐ huánjìng xià, yáoyán chuánbō de sùdù gèng kuài.
sentences.translation: In a new-media environment, rumours spread more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 在很多学生心目中，他是一位严格但公平的老师。
sentences.traditional: 在很多學生心目中，他是一位嚴格但公平的老師。
sentences.pinyin: Zài hěn duō xuésheng xīnmù zhōng, tā shì yí wèi yángé dàn gōngpíng de lǎoshī.
sentences.translation: In the minds of many students, he is a strict but fair teacher.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市在游客心目中的形象正在改变。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市在遊客心目中的形象正在改變。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì zài yóukè xīnmù zhōng de xíngxiàng zhèngzài gǎibiàn.
sentences.translation: The image of this city in tourists' minds is changing.

sentences.chinese: 在我心目中，成功不只是赚钱，还包括自由和尊严。
sentences.traditional: 在我心目中，成功不只是賺錢，還包括自由和尊嚴。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǒ xīnmù zhōng, chénggōng bù zhǐ shì zhuàn qián, hái bāokuò zìyóu hé zūnyán.
sentences.translation: In my mind, success is not only about making money; it also includes freedom and dignity.

sentences.chinese: 新能源汽车的普及正在改变传统能源结构。
sentences.traditional: 新能源汽車的普及正在改變傳統能源結構。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnnéngyuán qìchē de pǔjí zhèngzài gǎibiàn chuántǒng néngyuán jiégòu.
sentences.translation: The spread of new-energy vehicles is changing the traditional energy structure.

sentences.chinese: 该公司计划继续扩大新能源项目的投资。
sentences.traditional: 該公司計劃繼續擴大新能源項目的投資。
sentences.pinyin: Gāi gōngsī jìhuà jìxù kuòdà xīnnéngyuán xiàngmù de tóuzī.
sentences.translation: The company plans to continue expanding its investment in new-energy projects.

sentences.chinese: 发展新能源有助于减少对煤炭的依赖。
sentences.traditional: 發展新能源有助於減少對煤炭的依賴。
sentences.pinyin: Fāzhǎn xīnnéngyuán yǒu zhù yú jiǎnshǎo duì méitàn de yīlài.
sentences.translation: Developing new energy helps reduce dependence on coal.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作的薪水不高，但学习机会很多。
sentences.traditional: 這份工作的薪水不高，但學習機會很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de xīnshui bù gāo, dàn xuéxí jīhuì hěn duō.
sentences.translation: The salary for this job is not high, but there are many learning opportunities.

sentences.chinese: 他决定换工作，主要是因为薪水长期没有提高。
sentences.traditional: 他決定換工作，主要是因為薪水長期沒有提高。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng huàn gōngzuò, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi xīnshui chángqī méiyǒu tígāo.
sentences.translation: He decided to change jobs mainly because his salary had not increased for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 面试时直接询问薪水并不一定不礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 面試時直接詢問薪水並不一定不禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: Miànshì shí zhíjiē xúnwèn xīnshui bìng bù yídìng bù lǐmào.
sentences.translation: Asking directly about salary during an interview is not necessarily impolite.

sentences.chinese: 看到孩子累得说不出话来，母亲十分心疼。
sentences.traditional: 看到孩子累得說不出話來，母親十分心疼。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào háizi lèi de shuō bù chū huà lái, mǔqīn shífēn xīnténg.
sentences.translation: Seeing the child so tired that he could not speak, his mother felt very distressed.

sentences.chinese: 他把刚买的手机摔坏了，心疼得半天没说话。
sentences.traditional: 他把剛買的手機摔壞了，心疼得半天沒說話。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ gāng mǎi de shǒujī shuāi huài le, xīnténg de bàntiān méi shuō huà.
sentences.translation: He broke the phone he had just bought and felt so upset that he said nothing for quite a while.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套太贵了，穿坏一点我都会心疼。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套太貴了，穿壞一點我都會心疼。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào tài guì le, chuān huài yìdiǎn wǒ dōu huì xīnténg.
sentences.translation: This coat is so expensive that I would feel distressed if I damaged it even a little.

sentences.chinese: 新兴行业往往需要更灵活的管理方式。
sentences.traditional: 新興行業往往需要更靈活的管理方式。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnxīng hángyè wǎngwǎng xūyào gèng línghuó de guǎnlǐ fāngshì.
sentences.translation: Emerging industries often need more flexible management methods.

sentences.chinese: 这座小城依靠新兴产业吸引了大量年轻人。
sentences.traditional: 這座小城依靠新興產業吸引了大量年輕人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò xiǎochéng yīkào xīnxīng chǎnyè xīyǐn le dàliàng niánqīng rén.
sentences.translation: This small city has attracted many young people by relying on emerging industries.

sentences.chinese: 对新兴市场而言，稳定的政策环境非常重要。
sentences.traditional: 對新興市場而言，穩定的政策環境非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Duì xīnxīng shìchǎng ér yán, wěndìng de zhèngcè huánjìng fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: For emerging markets, a stable policy environment is extremely important.

sentences.chinese: 这个广告的角度很新颖，难怪能引起讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這個廣告的角度很新穎，難怪能引起討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guǎnggào de jiǎodù hěn xīnyǐng, nánguài néng yǐnqǐ tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: The angle of this advertisement is very novel, so it is no wonder it can spark discussion.

sentences.chinese: 她的设计虽然新颖，但还需要考虑生产成本。
sentences.traditional: 她的設計雖然新穎，但還需要考慮生產成本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shèjì suīrán xīnyǐng, dàn hái xūyào kǎolǜ shēngchǎn chéngběn.
sentences.translation: Although her design is innovative, production costs still need to be considered.

sentences.chinese: 老题材也可以用新颖的方式表达出来。
sentences.traditional: 老題材也可以用新穎的方式表達出來。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo tícái yě kěyǐ yòng xīnyǐng de fāngshì biǎodá chūlái.
sentences.translation: Old subject matter can also be expressed in a novel way.

sentences.chinese: 她最大的心愿，是让父母安心地过上更轻松的生活。
sentences.traditional: 她最大的心願，是讓父母安心地過上更輕鬆的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì dà de xīnyuàn, shì ràng fùmǔ ānxīn de guò shàng gèng qīngsōng de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: Her greatest wish is to let her parents live a more relaxed life with peace of mind.

sentences.chinese: 多年的心愿终于实现时，他反而一时不知道该说什么。
sentences.traditional: 多年的心願終於實現時，他反而一時不知道該說什麼。
sentences.pinyin: Duōnián de xīnyuàn zhōngyú shíxiàn shí, tā fǎn'ér yìshí bù zhīdào gāi shuō shénme.
sentences.translation: When his long-held wish finally came true, he actually did not know what to say for a moment.

sentences.chinese: 孩子把自己的心愿写在纸上，小心地放进了瓶子里。
sentences.traditional: 孩子把自己的心願寫在紙上，小心地放進了瓶子裡。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ zìjǐ de xīnyuàn xiě zài zhǐ shàng, xiǎoxīn de fàng jìn le píngzi lǐ.
sentences.translation: The child wrote his wish on paper and carefully put it into the bottle.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺乏运动会增加心脏负担，也会影响整体健康。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺乏運動會增加心臟負擔，也會影響整體健康。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá yùndòng huì zēngjiā xīnzàng fùdān, yě huì yǐngxiǎng zhěngtǐ jiànkāng.
sentences.translation: A long-term lack of exercise can increase the burden on the heart and affect overall health.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议他定期检查心脏，以便尽早发现潜在问题。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議他定期檢查心臟，以便儘早發現潛在問題。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā dìngqī jiǎnchá xīnzàng, yǐbiàn jǐnzǎo fāxiàn qiánzài wèntí.
sentences.translation: The doctor advised him to have his heart checked regularly so that potential problems could be found early.

sentences.chinese: 紧张的时候，他能明显感觉到心脏跳得比平时快。
sentences.traditional: 緊張的時候，他能明顯感覺到心臟跳得比平時快。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnzhāng de shíhou, tā néng míngxiǎn gǎnjué dào xīnzàng tiào de bǐ píngshí kuài.
sentences.translation: When he is nervous, he can clearly feel his heart beating faster than usual.

sentences.chinese: 只有长期保持透明，企业才能赢得消费者的信赖。
sentences.traditional: 只有長期保持透明，企業才能贏得消費者的信賴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu chángqī bǎochí tòumíng, qǐyè cái néng yíngdé xiāofèizhě de xìnlài.
sentences.translation: Only by remaining transparent over the long term can a company win consumers' trust.

sentences.chinese: 他做事稳重可靠，所以领导很信赖他。
sentences.traditional: 他做事穩重可靠，所以領導很信賴他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuòshì wěnzhòng kěkào, suǒyǐ lǐngdǎo hěn xìnlài tā.
sentences.translation: He is steady and reliable in his work, so the leaders trust him very much.

sentences.chinese: 如果团队成员彼此信赖，合作效率自然会提高。
sentences.traditional: 如果團隊成員彼此信賴，合作效率自然會提高。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tuánduì chéngyuán bǐcǐ xìnlài, hézuò xiàolǜ zìrán huì tígāo.
sentences.translation: If team members trust each other, the efficiency of cooperation will naturally improve.

sentences.chinese: 面对连续失败，他依然没有放弃最初的信念。
sentences.traditional: 面對連續失敗，他依然沒有放棄最初的信念。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì liánxù shībài, tā yīrán méiyǒu fàngqì zuìchū de xìnniàn.
sentences.translation: Facing repeated failures, he still did not give up his original belief.

sentences.chinese: 共同的信念让这些来自不同地区的人走到了一起。
sentences.traditional: 共同的信念讓這些來自不同地區的人走到了一起。
sentences.pinyin: Gòngtóng de xìnniàn ràng zhèxiē láizì bùtóng dìqū de rén zǒu dào le yìqǐ.
sentences.translation: A shared belief brought these people from different regions together.

sentences.chinese: 教育不仅传授知识，也在塑造年轻人的价值信念。
sentences.traditional: 教育不僅傳授知識，也在塑造年輕人的價值信念。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoyù bùjǐn chuánshòu zhīshi, yě zài sùzào niánqīng rén de jiàzhí xìnniàn.
sentences.translation: Education not only passes on knowledge, but also shapes young people's values and beliefs.

sentences.chinese: 近几年，远程办公在许多行业迅速兴起。
sentences.traditional: 近幾年，遠程辦公在許多行業迅速興起。
sentences.pinyin: Jìn jǐ nián, yuǎnchéng bàngōng zài xǔduō hángyè xùnsù xīngqǐ.
sentences.translation: In recent years, remote working has rapidly risen in many industries.

sentences.chinese: 随着环保意识增强，二手交易平台开始兴起。
sentences.traditional: 隨著環保意識增強，二手交易平臺開始興起。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe huánbǎo yìshí zēngqiáng, èrshǒu jiāoyì píngtái kāishǐ xīngqǐ.
sentences.translation: As environmental awareness has grown, second-hand trading platforms have begun to rise.

sentences.chinese: 这股健身热潮的兴起，改变了很多年轻人的生活方式。
sentences.traditional: 這股健身熱潮的興起，改變了很多年輕人的生活方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gǔ jiànshēn rècháo de xīngqǐ, gǎibiàn le hěn duō niánqīng rén de shēnghuó fāngshì.
sentences.translation: The rise of this fitness trend has changed the lifestyle of many young people.

sentences.chinese: 购买配件前，请先确认设备的具体型号。
sentences.traditional: 購買配件前，請先確認設備的具體型號。
sentences.pinyin: Gòumǎi pèijiàn qián, qǐng xiān quèrèn shèbèi de jùtǐ xínghào.
sentences.translation: Before buying accessories, please first confirm the exact model of the device.

sentences.chinese: 同一品牌的不同型号，在性能和价格上差别很大。
sentences.traditional: 同一品牌的不同型號，在性能和價格上差別很大。
sentences.pinyin: Tóng yī pǐnpái de bùtóng xínghào, zài xìngnéng hé jiàgé shang chābié hěn dà.
sentences.translation: Different models of the same brand can vary greatly in performance and price.

sentences.chinese: 这款旧型号虽然已经停产，但维修零件仍然买得到。
sentences.traditional: 這款舊型號雖然已經停產，但維修零件仍然買得到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn jiù xínghào suīrán yǐjīng tíngchǎn, dàn wéixiū língjiàn réngrán mǎi de dào.
sentences.translation: Although this old model has been discontinued, repair parts can still be bought.

sentences.chinese: 城市的商业形态正在随着消费习惯的变化而调整。
sentences.traditional: 城市的商業形態正在隨著消費習慣的變化而調整。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì de shāngyè xíngtài zhèngzài suízhe xiāofèi xíguàn de biànhuà ér tiáozhěng.
sentences.translation: The commercial forms of the city are adjusting as consumption habits change.

sentences.chinese: 这种植物在不同气候下会呈现出完全不同的形态。
sentences.traditional: 這種植物在不同氣候下會呈現出完全不同的形態。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù zài bùtóng qìhòu xià huì chéngxiàn chū wánquán bùtóng de xíngtài.
sentences.translation: This plant will show completely different forms under different climates.

sentences.chinese: 研究者记录了细胞在实验过程中的形态变化。
sentences.traditional: 研究者記錄了細胞在實驗過程中的形態變化。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiūzhě jìlù le xìbāo zài shíyàn guòchéng zhōng de xíngtài biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The researchers recorded changes in the cells' form during the experiment.

sentences.chinese: 如果预算有限，这款电脑的性价比确实很高。
sentences.traditional: 如果預算有限，這款電腦的性價比確實很高。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, zhè kuǎn diànnǎo de xìngjiàbǐ quèshí hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: If your budget is limited, this computer really offers good value for money.

sentences.chinese: 消费者不只看品牌，也越来越重视产品的性价比。
sentences.traditional: 消費者不只看品牌，也越來越重視產品的性價比。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě bù zhǐ kàn pǐnpái, yě yuè lái yuè zhòngshì chǎnpǐn de xìngjiàbǐ.
sentences.translation: Consumers do not only look at brands; they increasingly value a product's cost-performance ratio.

sentences.chinese: 这家酒店位置普通，但服务好，性价比还算不错。
sentences.traditional: 這家酒店位置普通，但服務好，性價比還算不錯。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn wèizhi pǔtōng, dàn fúwù hǎo, xìngjiàbǐ hái suàn búcuò.
sentences.translation: This hotel is in an ordinary location, but the service is good, so its value for money is quite decent.

sentences.chinese: 新系统上线后，服务器的性能明显提升了。
sentences.traditional: 新系統上線後，伺服器的性能明顯提升了。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xìtǒng shàngxiàn hòu, sìfúqì de xìngnéng míngxiǎn tíshēng le.
sentences.translation: After the new system went online, the server's performance improved significantly.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车的安全性能很好，适合经常跑长途的人。
sentences.traditional: 這輛車的安全性能很好，適合經常跑長途的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de ānquán xìngnéng hěn hǎo, shìhé jīngcháng pǎo chángtú de rén.
sentences.translation: This car has very good safety performance and suits people who often drive long distances.

sentences.chinese: 工程师正在测试材料在高温环境下的性能。
sentences.traditional: 工程師正在測試材料在高溫環境下的性能。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zhèngzài cèshì cáiliào zài gāowēn huánjìng xià de xìngnéng.
sentences.translation: The engineers are testing the material's performance in a high-temperature environment.

sentences.chinese: 他深吸一口气，感觉胸里的压力终于轻了一些。
sentences.traditional: 他深吸一口氣，感覺胸裡的壓力終於輕了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēn xī yì kǒu qì, gǎnjué xiōng lǐ de yālì zhōngyú qīng le yìxiē.
sentences.translation: He took a deep breath and felt that the pressure in his chest had finally eased a little.

sentences.chinese: 运动前做几组扩胸动作，可以帮助身体慢慢热起来。
sentences.traditional: 運動前做幾組擴胸動作，可以幫助身體慢慢熱起來。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng qián zuò jǐ zǔ kuòxiōng dòngzuò, kěyǐ bāngzhù shēntǐ mànmàn rè qǐlai.
sentences.translation: Doing a few chest-expansion movements before exercise can help the body warm up gradually.

sentences.chinese: 听到这个消息，他把手按在胸口，半天没有说话。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這個消息，他把手按在胸口，半天沒有說話。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi, tā bǎ shǒu àn zài xiōngkǒu, bàntiān méiyǒu shuōhuà.
sentences.translation: Hearing the news, he pressed his hand to his chest and did not speak for quite a while.

sentences.chinese: 教材出版前，专家组还会根据试用反馈再次修订内容。
sentences.traditional: 教材出版前，專家組還會根據試用反饋再次修訂內容。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàocái chūbǎn qián, zhuānjiāzǔ hái huì gēnjù shìyòng fǎnkuì zàicì xiūdìng nèiróng.
sentences.translation: Before the textbook is published, the expert group will revise the content again based on trial feedback.

sentences.chinese: 这份合同经过多次修订，终于得到了双方认可。
sentences.traditional: 這份合同經過多次修訂，終於得到了雙方認可。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong jīngguò duō cì xiūdìng, zhōngyú dédào le shuāngfāng rènkě.
sentences.translation: After several revisions, this contract finally gained the approval of both sides.

sentences.chinese: 公司准备修订内部流程，以减少重复审批带来的浪费。
sentences.traditional: 公司準備修訂內部流程，以減少重複審批帶來的浪費。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī zhǔnbèi xiūdìng nèibù liúchéng, yǐ jiǎnshǎo chóngfù shěnpī dài lái de làngfèi.
sentences.translation: The company plans to revise its internal procedures to reduce waste caused by repeated approvals.

sentences.chinese: 技术人员正在修复数据库，部分功能暂时无法使用。
sentences.traditional: 技術人員正在修復資料庫，部分功能暫時無法使用。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshù rényuán zhèngzài xiūfù zīliàokù, bùfen gōngnéng zànshí wúfǎ shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: Technicians are repairing the database, so some functions are temporarily unavailable.

sentences.chinese: 古建筑的修复工作必须尊重原有结构和历史风貌。
sentences.traditional: 古建築的修復工作必須尊重原有結構和歷史風貌。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔ jiànzhù de xiūfù gōngzuò bìxū zūnzhòng yuányǒu jiégòu hé lìshǐ fēngmào.
sentences.translation: The restoration of ancient buildings must respect the original structure and historical appearance.

sentences.chinese: 这款软件更新后，已经修复了用户反映的几个严重问题。
sentences.traditional: 這款軟件更新後，已經修復了用戶反映的幾個嚴重問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn gēngxīn hòu, yǐjīng xiūfù le yònghù fǎnyìng de jǐ gè yánzhòng wèntí.
sentences.translation: After this software update, several serious problems reported by users have been fixed.

sentences.chinese: 他把袖子卷起来，亲自帮老人搬运箱子。
sentences.traditional: 他把袖子捲起來，親自幫老人搬運箱子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xiùzi juǎn qǐlai, qīnzì bāng lǎorén bānyùn xiāngzi.
sentences.translation: He rolled up his sleeves and personally helped the old man move the boxes.

sentences.chinese: 这件外套的袖子有点长，可能需要改短一些。
sentences.traditional: 這件外套的袖子有點長，可能需要改短一些。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào de xiùzi yǒudiǎn cháng, kěnéng xūyào gǎi duǎn yìxiē.
sentences.translation: The sleeves of this coat are a little long and may need to be shortened.

sentences.chinese: 做实验时不要让袖子碰到药品，以免发生危险。
sentences.traditional: 做實驗時不要讓袖子碰到藥品，以免發生危險。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò shíyàn shí bú yào ràng xiùzi pèng dào yàopǐn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
sentences.translation: When doing experiments, do not let your sleeves touch the chemicals, in order to avoid danger.

sentences.chinese: 未经学校许可，任何单位不得在校园内进行商业宣传。
sentences.traditional: 未經學校許可，任何單位不得在校園內進行商業宣傳。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi jīng xuéxiào xǔkě, rènhé dānwèi bùdé zài xiàoyuán nèi jìnxíng shāngyè xuānchuán.
sentences.translation: Without the school's permission, no organisation may carry out commercial promotion on campus.

sentences.chinese: 项目开工前，施工方必须取得环保部门的许可。
sentences.traditional: 項目開工前，施工方必須取得環保部門的許可。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù kāigōng qián, shīgōngfāng bìxū qǔdé huánbǎo bùmén de xǔkě.
sentences.translation: Before the project begins, the construction party must obtain permission from the environmental protection department.

sentences.chinese: 如果条件许可，我们希望明年把服务扩大到更多城市。
sentences.traditional: 如果條件許可，我們希望明年把服務擴大到更多城市。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tiáojiàn xǔkě, wǒmen xīwàng míngnián bǎ fúwù kuòdà dào gèng duō chéngshì.
sentences.translation: If conditions permit, we hope to expand the service to more cities next year.

sentences.chinese: 报告应当客观叙述事件经过，避免加入个人猜测。
sentences.traditional: 報告應當客觀敘述事件經過，避免加入個人猜測。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào yīngdāng kèguān xùshù shìjiàn jīngguò, bìmiǎn jiārù gèrén cāicè.
sentences.translation: The report should objectively describe the course of the incident and avoid adding personal speculation.

sentences.chinese: 小说通过孩子的视角叙述战争给普通家庭带来的影响。
sentences.traditional: 小說通過孩子的視角敘述戰爭給普通家庭帶來的影響。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshuō tōngguò háizi de shìjiǎo xùshù zhànzhēng gěi pǔtōng jiātíng dài lái de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The novel narrates, from a child's perspective, the impact of war on ordinary families.

sentences.chinese: 他的叙述很清楚，让听众很快理解了问题的关键。
sentences.traditional: 他的敘述很清楚，讓聽眾很快理解了問題的關鍵。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xùshù hěn qīngchu, ràng tīngzhòng hěn kuài lǐjiě le wèntí de guānjiàn.
sentences.translation: His account was clear, allowing the audience to quickly understand the key point of the problem.

sentences.chinese: 机器启动后，中心部件会高速旋转，操作时必须保持距离。
sentences.traditional: 機器啟動後，中心部件會高速旋轉，操作時必須保持距離。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì qǐdòng hòu, zhōngxīn bùjiàn huì gāosù xuánzhuǎn, cāozuò shí bìxū bǎochí jùlí.
sentences.translation: After the machine starts, the central component rotates at high speed, so a safe distance must be kept during operation.

sentences.chinese: 地球围绕太阳运动的同时，也在不断旋转。
sentences.traditional: 地球圍繞太陽運動的同時，也在不斷旋轉。
sentences.pinyin: Dìqiú wéirào tàiyáng yùndòng de tóngshí, yě zài búduàn xuánzhuǎn.
sentences.translation: While the Earth moves around the Sun, it is also constantly rotating.

sentences.chinese: 这把椅子可以自由旋转，适合放在办公室里使用。
sentences.traditional: 這把椅子可以自由旋轉，適合放在辦公室裡使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yǐzi kěyǐ zìyóu xuánzhuǎn, shìhé fàng zài bàngōngshì lǐ shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This chair can rotate freely and is suitable for use in an office.

sentences.chinese: 学校将通过公开比赛选拔代表队成员。
sentences.traditional: 學校將通過公開比賽選拔代表隊成員。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāng tōngguò gōngkāi bǐsài xuǎnbá dàibiǎoduì chéngyuán.
sentences.translation: The school will select members of the representative team through an open competition.

sentences.chinese: 这次选拔不仅看成绩，也重视候选人的合作能力。
sentences.traditional: 這次選拔不僅看成績，也重視候選人的合作能力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì xuǎnbá bùjǐn kàn chéngjì, yě zhòngshì hòuxuǎnrén de hézuò nénglì.
sentences.translation: This selection process looks not only at results but also values the candidates' ability to cooperate.

sentences.chinese: 企业需要建立公平的机制，选拔真正适合管理岗位的人才。
sentences.traditional: 企業需要建立公平的機制，選拔真正適合管理崗位的人才。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè xūyào jiànlì gōngpíng de jīzhì, xuǎnbá zhēnzhèng shìhé guǎnlǐ gǎngwèi de réncái.
sentences.translation: Companies need to establish a fair mechanism to select people who are truly suitable for management positions.

sentences.chinese: 大学期间，他选修了心理学课程，对后来工作很有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 大學期間，他選修了心理學課程，對後來工作很有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxué qījiān, tā xuǎnxiū le xīnlǐxué kèchéng, duì hòulái gōngzuò hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: During university, he took a psychology course as an elective, which was very helpful for his later work.

sentences.chinese: 这门课虽然是选修，但作业量并不比必修课少。
sentences.traditional: 這門課雖然是選修，但作業量並不比必修課少。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè mén kè suīrán shì xuǎnxiū, dàn zuòyèliàng bìng bù bǐ bìxiū kè shǎo.
sentences.translation: Although this course is an elective, its workload is no less than that of a required course.

sentences.chinese: 学生可以根据兴趣选修艺术、编程或经济类课程。
sentences.traditional: 學生可以根據興趣選修藝術、編程或經濟類課程。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéshēng kěyǐ gēnjù xìngqù xuǎnxiū yìshù, biānchéng huò jīngjì lèi kèchéng.
sentences.translation: Students can choose art, programming, or economics courses as electives according to their interests.

sentences.chinese: 这个学会每年都会举办一次国际学术会议。
sentences.traditional: 這個學會每年都會舉辦一次國際學術會議。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xuéhuì měinián dōu huì jǔbàn yí cì guójì xuéshù huìyì.
sentences.translation: This learned society holds an international academic conference every year.

sentences.chinese: 她加入了语言学学会，希望认识更多同行研究者。
sentences.traditional: 她加入了語言學學會，希望認識更多同行研究者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiārù le yǔyánxué xuéhuì, xīwàng rènshi gèng duō tóngháng yánjiūzhě.
sentences.translation: She joined the linguistics society, hoping to meet more fellow researchers.

sentences.chinese: 该学会发表的报告，对行业标准的修订产生了影响。
sentences.traditional: 該學會發表的報告，對行業標準的修訂產生了影響。
sentences.pinyin: Gāi xuéhuì fābiǎo de bàogào, duì hángyè biāozhǔn de xiūdìng chǎnshēng le yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: The report published by the society influenced the revision of industry standards.

sentences.chinese: 申请这个岗位时，硕士学位不是硬性要求，但会被优先考虑。
sentences.traditional: 申請這個崗位時，碩士學位不是硬性要求，但會被優先考慮。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng zhège gǎngwèi shí, shuòshì xuéwèi bú shì yìngxìng yāoqiú, dàn huì bèi yōuxiān kǎolǜ.
sentences.translation: When applying for this position, a master's degree is not a strict requirement, but it will be given priority consideration.

sentences.chinese: 他完成论文答辩后，终于获得了博士学位。
sentences.traditional: 他完成論文答辯後，終於獲得了博士學位。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wánchéng lùnwén dábiàn hòu, zhōngyú huòdé le bóshì xuéwèi.
sentences.translation: After completing his thesis defence, he finally obtained a doctoral degree.

sentences.chinese: 有些学生出国读书，是为了取得国外大学的学位。
sentences.traditional: 有些學生出國讀書，是為了取得國外大學的學位。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xuéshēng chūguó dúshū, shì wèile qǔdé guówài dàxué de xuéwèi.
sentences.translation: Some students study abroad in order to obtain a degree from a foreign university.

sentences.chinese: 做学问不能只追求速度，还要重视证据和方法。
sentences.traditional: 做學問不能只追求速度，還要重視證據和方法。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò xuéwen bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú sùdù, hái yào zhòngshì zhèngjù hé fāngfǎ.
sentences.translation: In serious study, one should not only pursue speed, but also value evidence and method.

sentences.chinese: 他虽然年纪不大，但在历史方面很有学问。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然年紀不大，但在歷史方面很有學問。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì bú dà, dàn zài lìshǐ fāngmiàn hěn yǒu xuéwen.
sentences.translation: Although he is not very old, he has a great deal of knowledge about history.

sentences.chinese: 真正的学问，往往来自长期的观察和思考。
sentences.traditional: 真正的學問，往往來自長期的觀察和思考。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de xuéwen, wǎngwǎng láizì chángqī de guānchá hé sīkǎo.
sentences.translation: Real knowledge often comes from long-term observation and reflection.

sentences.chinese: 本期培训共有三十名学员，其中一半来自基层单位。
sentences.traditional: 本期培訓共有三十名學員，其中一半來自基層單位。
sentences.pinyin: Běn qī péixùn gòng yǒu sānshí míng xuéyuán, qízhōng yíbàn láizì jīcéng dānwèi.
sentences.translation: This training programme has thirty trainees in total, half of whom come from grassroots organisations.

sentences.chinese: 教练会根据每位学员的水平调整训练内容。
sentences.traditional: 教練會根據每位學員的水平調整訓練內容。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoliàn huì gēnjù měi wèi xuéyuán de shuǐpíng tiáozhěng xùnliàn nèiróng.
sentences.translation: The coach adjusts the training content according to each trainee’s level.

sentences.chinese: 这所学院要求学员在结业前完成一份实践报告。
sentences.traditional: 這所學院要求學員在結業前完成一份實踐報告。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéyuàn yāoqiú xuéyuán zài jiéyè qián wánchéng yí fèn shíjiàn bàogào.
sentences.translation: This institute requires students to complete a practical report before graduation.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺乏运动会影响血管健康，增加患病风险。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺乏運動會影響血管健康，增加患病風險。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá yùndòng huì yǐngxiǎng xuèguǎn jiànkāng, zēngjiā huànbìng fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: A long-term lack of exercise can affect blood vessel health and increase the risk of illness.

sentences.chinese: 医生通过检查血管情况，判断是否需要进一步治疗。
sentences.traditional: 醫生通過檢查血管情況，判斷是否需要進一步治療。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngguò jiǎnchá xuèguǎn qíngkuàng, pànduàn shìfǒu xūyào jìnyíbù zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: The doctor judges whether further treatment is needed by examining the condition of the blood vessels.

sentences.chinese: 寒冷天气会使部分人的血管收缩，手脚更容易发凉。
sentences.traditional: 寒冷天氣會使部分人的血管收縮，手腳更容易發涼。
sentences.pinyin: Hánlěng tiānqì huì shǐ bùfen rén de xuèguǎn shōusuō, shǒujiǎo gèng róngyì fāliáng.
sentences.translation: Cold weather can cause some people’s blood vessels to contract, making their hands and feet feel cold more easily.

sentences.chinese: 献血前，工作人员会先确认志愿者的血型。
sentences.traditional: 獻血前，工作人員會先確認志願者的血型。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànxuè qián, gōngzuò rényuán huì xiān quèrèn zhìyuànzhě de xuèxíng.
sentences.translation: Before blood donation, staff first confirm the volunteer’s blood type.

sentences.chinese: 在紧急手术中，血型匹配关系到输血安全。
sentences.traditional: 在緊急手術中，血型匹配關係到輸血安全。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jǐnjí shǒushù zhōng, xuèxíng pǐpèi guānxì dào shūxuè ānquán.
sentences.translation: In emergency surgery, blood type matching is related to the safety of blood transfusion.

sentences.chinese: 她一直到办健康证明时，才知道自己的血型。
sentences.traditional: 她一直到辦健康證明時，才知道自己的血型。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìzhí dào bàn jiànkāng zhèngmíng shí, cái zhīdào zìjǐ de xuèxíng.
sentences.translation: She did not find out her blood type until she applied for a health certificate.

sentences.chinese: 父亲每天早晨都会测量血压，并把结果记录下来。
sentences.traditional: 父親每天早晨都會測量血壓，並把結果記錄下來。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn měitiān zǎochén dōu huì cèliáng xuèyā, bìng bǎ jiéguǒ jìlù xiàlai.
sentences.translation: My father measures his blood pressure every morning and records the result.

sentences.chinese: 情绪过于紧张时，血压可能会暂时升高。
sentences.traditional: 情緒過於緊張時，血壓可能會暫時升高。
sentences.pinyin: Qíngxù guòyú jǐnzhāng shí, xuèyā kěnéng huì zànshí shēnggāo.
sentences.translation: When emotions are too tense, blood pressure may temporarily rise.

sentences.chinese: 控制盐的摄入量，有助于保持血压稳定。
sentences.traditional: 控制鹽的攝入量，有助於保持血壓穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Kòngzhì yán de shèrùliàng, yǒu zhùyú bǎochí xuèyā wěndìng.
sentences.translation: Controlling salt intake helps keep blood pressure stable.

sentences.chinese: 血液检查可以帮助医生发现一些早期问题。
sentences.traditional: 血液檢查可以幫助醫生發現一些早期問題。
sentences.pinyin: Xuèyè jiǎnchá kěyǐ bāngzhù yīshēng fāxiàn yìxiē zǎoqī wèntí.
sentences.translation: Blood tests can help doctors discover some early-stage problems.

sentences.chinese: 这种药物会影响血液循环，所以必须按医嘱使用。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥物會影響血液循環，所以必須按醫囑使用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàowù huì yǐngxiǎng xuèyè xúnhuán, suǒyǐ bìxū àn yīzhǔ shǐyòng.
sentences.translation: This medicine affects blood circulation, so it must be used according to a doctor’s instructions.

sentences.chinese: 运动之后，血液流动加快，身体会慢慢暖起来。
sentences.traditional: 運動之後，血液流動加快，身體會慢慢暖起來。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng zhīhòu, xuèyè liúdòng jiākuài, shēntǐ huì mànmàn nuǎn qǐlai.
sentences.translation: After exercise, the blood flows faster and the body slowly warms up.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统可以让冷却水循环使用，减少浪费。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統可以讓冷卻水循環使用，減少浪費。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng kěyǐ ràng lěngquè shuǐ xúnhuán shǐyòng, jiǎnshǎo làngfèi.
sentences.translation: This system allows cooling water to be circulated and reused, reducing waste.

sentences.chinese: 如果问题一直得不到解决，矛盾就会进入恶性循环。
sentences.traditional: 如果問題一直得不到解決，矛盾就會進入惡性循環。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wèntí yìzhí dé bu dào jiějué, máodùn jiù huì jìnrù èxìng xúnhuán.
sentences.translation: If the problem is never solved, the conflict will enter a vicious cycle.

sentences.chinese: 适度运动能促进血液循环，对身体恢复有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 適度運動能促進血液循環，對身體恢復有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdù yùndòng néng cùjìn xuèyè xúnhuán, duì shēntǐ huīfù yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: Moderate exercise can promote blood circulation and help the body recover.

sentences.chinese: 企业正在寻求新的增长点，以应对市场变化。
sentences.traditional: 企業正在尋求新的增長點，以應對市場變化。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè zhèngzài xúnqiú xīn de zēngzhǎngdiǎn, yǐ yìngduì shìchǎng biànhuà.
sentences.translation: The company is seeking new growth points in order to respond to changes in the market.

sentences.chinese: 遇到法律纠纷时，最好及时寻求专业意见。
sentences.traditional: 遇到法律糾紛時，最好及時尋求專業意見。
sentences.pinyin: Yùdào fǎlǜ jiūfēn shí, zuì hǎo jíshí xúnqiú zhuānyè yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: When encountering a legal dispute, it is best to seek professional advice promptly.

sentences.chinese: 他离开家乡，是为了寻求更广阔的发展机会。
sentences.traditional: 他離開家鄉，是為了尋求更廣闊的發展機會。
sentences.pinyin: Tā líkāi jiāxiāng, shì wèile xúnqiú gèng guǎngkuò de fāzhǎn jīhuì.
sentences.translation: He left his hometown in order to seek broader opportunities for development.

sentences.chinese: 为了节省空间，我把照片压缩后再上传。
sentences.traditional: 為了節省空間，我把照片壓縮後再上傳。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng kōngjiān, wǒ bǎ zhàopiàn yāsuō hòu zài shàngchuán.
sentences.translation: To save space, I compressed the photos before uploading them.

sentences.chinese: 公司决定压缩不必要的开支，把资金用于研发。
sentences.traditional: 公司決定壓縮不必要的開支，把資金用於研發。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng yāsuō bù bìyào de kāizhī, bǎ zījīn yòngyú yánfā.
sentences.translation: The company decided to reduce unnecessary spending and use the funds for research and development.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告内容太长，需要压缩到三页以内。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告內容太長，需要壓縮到三頁以內。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào nèiróng tài cháng, xūyào yāsuō dào sān yè yǐnèi.
sentences.translation: The content of this report is too long and needs to be compressed to within three pages.

sentences.chinese: 虽然只获得亚军，队员们仍然赢得了观众的尊重。
sentences.traditional: 雖然只獲得亞軍，隊員們仍然贏得了觀眾的尊重。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhǐ huòdé yàjūn, duìyuánmen réngrán yíngdé le guānzhòng de zūnzhòng.
sentences.translation: Although they only won second place, the team members still earned the audience’s respect.

sentences.chinese: 她在全国比赛中拿到亚军，已经是很大的突破。
sentences.traditional: 她在全國比賽中拿到亞軍，已經是很大的突破。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài quánguó bǐsài zhōng nádào yàjūn, yǐjing shì hěn dà de tūpò.
sentences.translation: She came runner-up in the national competition, which was already a major breakthrough.

sentences.chinese: 去年的亚军今年表现更稳定，有望冲击冠军。
sentences.traditional: 去年的亞軍今年表現更穩定，有望衝擊冠軍。
sentences.pinyin: Qùnián de yàjūn jīnnián biǎoxiàn gèng wěndìng, yǒuwàng chōngjī guànjūn.
sentences.translation: Last year’s runner-up is performing more steadily this year and is expected to challenge for the championship.

sentences.chinese: 暴雨过后，低洼地区被积水淹了半米深。
sentences.traditional: 暴雨過後，低窪地區被積水淹了半米深。
sentences.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, dīwā dìqū bèi jīshuǐ yān le bàn mǐ shēn.
sentences.translation: After the heavy rain, low-lying areas were flooded half a metre deep.

sentences.chinese: 如果排水系统不及时修复，地下车库很容易被淹。
sentences.traditional: 如果排水系統不及時修復，地下車庫很容易被淹。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ páishuǐ xìtǒng bù jíshí xiūfù, dìxià chēkù hěn róngyì bèi yān.
sentences.translation: If the drainage system is not repaired promptly, the underground car park can easily be flooded.

sentences.chinese: 他把种子埋得太深，又浇了太多水，结果全淹坏了。
sentences.traditional: 他把種子埋得太深，又澆了太多水，結果全淹壞了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhǒngzi mái de tài shēn, yòu jiāo le tài duō shuǐ, jiéguǒ quán yān huài le.
sentences.translation: He buried the seeds too deeply and watered them too much, so they were all ruined by being waterlogged.

sentences.chinese: 巨大的海浪几乎淹没了岸边的旧码头。
sentences.traditional: 巨大的海浪幾乎淹沒了岸邊的舊碼頭。
sentences.pinyin: Jùdà de hǎilàng jīhū yānmò le ànbiān de jiù mǎtóu.
sentences.translation: The huge waves almost submerged the old pier by the shore.

sentences.chinese: 洪水淹没村庄之前，居民已经被转移到安全地区。
sentences.traditional: 洪水淹沒村莊之前，居民已經被轉移到安全地區。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngshuǐ yānmò cūnzhuāng zhīqián, jūmín yǐjing bèi zhuǎnyí dào ānquán dìqū.
sentences.translation: Before the flood submerged the village, residents had already been moved to a safe area.

sentences.chinese: 掌声淹没了他的最后一句话，现场气氛十分热烈。
sentences.traditional: 掌聲淹沒了他的最後一句話，現場氣氛十分熱烈。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎngshēng yānmò le tā de zuìhòu yí jù huà, xiànchǎng qìfēn shífēn rèliè.
sentences.translation: Applause drowned out his last sentence, and the atmosphere at the scene was very lively.

sentences.chinese: 这位老师要求很严，但学生都知道他是为大家好。
sentences.traditional: 這位老師要求很嚴，但學生都知道他是為大家好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī yāoqiú hěn yán, dàn xuésheng dōu zhīdào tā shì wèi dàjiā hǎo.
sentences.translation: This teacher is very strict, but the students all know he does it for their good.

sentences.chinese: 食品安全检查越来越严，企业不能抱有侥幸心理。
sentences.traditional: 食品安全檢查越來越嚴，企業不能抱有僥倖心理。
sentences.pinyin: Shípǐn ānquán jiǎnchá yuè lái yuè yán, qǐyè bù néng bàoyǒu jiǎoxìng xīnlǐ.
sentences.translation: Food safety inspections are becoming stricter, and companies cannot rely on luck.

sentences.chinese: 他对自己比对别人更严，所以进步一直很快。
sentences.traditional: 他對自己比對別人更嚴，所以進步一直很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ bǐ duì biérén gèng yán, suǒyǐ jìnbù yìzhí hěn kuài.
sentences.translation: He is stricter with himself than with others, so he has been improving quickly.

sentences.chinese: 沿海城市在发展贸易方面通常具有明显优势。
sentences.traditional: 沿海城市在發展貿易方面通常具有明顯優勢。
sentences.pinyin: Yánhǎi chéngshì zài fāzhǎn màoyì fāngmiàn tōngcháng jùyǒu míngxiǎn yōushì.
sentences.translation: Coastal cities usually have clear advantages in developing trade.

sentences.chinese: 台风登陆后，沿海不少地区出现了强风和暴雨。
sentences.traditional: 颱風登陸後，沿海不少地區出現了強風和暴雨。
sentences.pinyin: Táifēng dēnglù hòu, yánhǎi bù shǎo dìqū chūxiàn le qiáng fēng hé bàoyǔ.
sentences.translation: After the typhoon made landfall, many coastal areas saw strong winds and heavy rain.

sentences.chinese: 政府计划改善沿海港口的交通连接。
sentences.traditional: 政府計劃改善沿海港口的交通連接。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà gǎishàn yánhǎi gǎngkǒu de jiāotōng liánjiē.
sentences.translation: The government plans to improve transport links for coastal ports.

sentences.chinese: 在严寒的冬夜，救援人员仍然坚持搜寻失踪者。
sentences.traditional: 在嚴寒的冬夜，救援人員仍然堅持搜尋失蹤者。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yánhán de dōngyè, jiùyuán rényuán réngrán jiānchí sōuxún shīzōngzhě.
sentences.translation: On a bitterly cold winter night, rescuers still kept searching for the missing person.

sentences.chinese: 这种设备能够在严寒环境下保持稳定运行。
sentences.traditional: 這種設備能夠在嚴寒環境下保持穩定運行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shèbèi nénggòu zài yánhán huánjìng xià bǎochí wěndìng yùnxíng.
sentences.translation: This equipment can keep operating stably in extremely cold conditions.

sentences.chinese: 严寒让道路结冰，许多航班也被迫延期。
sentences.traditional: 嚴寒讓道路結冰，許多航班也被迫延期。
sentences.pinyin: Yánhán ràng dàolù jiébīng, xǔduō hángbān yě bèipò yánqī.
sentences.translation: Severe cold caused the roads to freeze, and many flights were also forced to be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 图书馆内严禁吸烟，违者将被请出场馆。
sentences.traditional: 圖書館內嚴禁吸煙，違者將被請出場館。
sentences.pinyin: Túshūguǎn nèi yánjìn xīyān, wéizhě jiāng bèi qǐng chū chǎngguǎn.
sentences.translation: Smoking is strictly prohibited in the library; violators will be asked to leave.

sentences.chinese: 施工现场严禁无关人员进入，以免发生危险。
sentences.traditional: 施工現場嚴禁無關人員進入，以免發生危險。
sentences.pinyin: Shīgōng xiànchǎng yánjìn wúguān rényuán jìnrù, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
sentences.translation: Unrelated personnel are strictly prohibited from entering the construction site to avoid danger.

sentences.chinese: 学校明确规定，考试期间严禁使用任何电子设备。
sentences.traditional: 學校明確規定，考試期間嚴禁使用任何電子設備。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào míngquè guīdìng, kǎoshì qījiān yánjìn shǐyòng rènhé diànzǐ shèbèi.
sentences.translation: The school clearly states that the use of any electronic devices is strictly prohibited during exams.

sentences.chinese: 面对数据造假，监管部门采取了严厉措施。
sentences.traditional: 面對數據造假，監管部門採取了嚴厲措施。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shùjù zàojiǎ, jiānguǎn bùmén cǎiqǔ le yánlì cuòshī.
sentences.translation: Facing data falsification, regulators took severe measures.

sentences.chinese: 父亲语气严厉，但他的担心并不是没有道理。
sentences.traditional: 父親語氣嚴厲，但他的擔心並不是沒有道理。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn yǔqì yánlì, dàn tā de dānxīn bìng bú shì méiyǒu dàolǐ.
sentences.translation: My father’s tone was stern, but his concern was not unreasonable.

sentences.chinese: 对恶意破坏公共设施的行为，社会舆论普遍要求严厉处罚。
sentences.traditional: 對惡意破壞公共設施的行為，社會輿論普遍要求嚴厲處罰。
sentences.pinyin: Duì èyì pòhuài gōnggòng shèshī de xíngwéi, shèhuì yúlùn pǔbiàn yāoqiú yánlì chǔfá.
sentences.translation: For deliberate damage to public facilities, public opinion generally calls for harsh punishment.

sentences.chinese: 由于材料没有及时到达，项目只能延期一周。
sentences.traditional: 由於材料沒有及時到達，項目只能延期一週。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú cáiliào méiyǒu jíshí dàodá, xiàngmù zhǐ néng yánqī yì zhōu.
sentences.translation: Because the materials did not arrive in time, the project can only be postponed by one week.

sentences.chinese: 会议是否延期，还要看明天的天气情况。
sentences.traditional: 會議是否延期，還要看明天的天氣情況。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shìfǒu yánqī, hái yào kàn míngtiān de tiānqì qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Whether the meeting will be postponed depends on tomorrow’s weather.

sentences.chinese: 申请延期提交报告，需要提前向导师说明理由。
sentences.traditional: 申請延期提交報告，需要提前向導師說明理由。
sentences.pinyin: Shēnqǐng yánqī tíjiāo bàogào, xūyào tíqián xiàng dǎoshī shuōmíng lǐyóu.
sentences.translation: To apply to postpone submitting the report, you need to explain your reasons to your supervisor in advance.

sentences.chinese: 炎热的天气使户外工作变得格外辛苦。
sentences.traditional: 炎熱的天氣使戶外工作變得格外辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Yánrè de tiānqì shǐ hùwài gōngzuò biàn de géwài xīnkǔ.
sentences.translation: Hot weather makes outdoor work especially hard.

sentences.chinese: 在炎热地区，建筑设计必须重视通风和遮阳。
sentences.traditional: 在炎熱地區，建築設計必須重視通風和遮陽。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yánrè dìqū, jiànzhù shèjì bìxū zhòngshì tōngfēng hé zhēyáng.
sentences.translation: In hot regions, architectural design must emphasise ventilation and shade.

sentences.chinese: 夏天过于炎热时，老人和儿童更需要补充水分。
sentences.traditional: 夏天過於炎熱時，老人和兒童更需要補充水分。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàtiān guòyú yánrè shí, lǎorén hé értóng gèng xūyào bǔchōng shuǐfèn.
sentences.translation: When summer is excessively hot, elderly people and children need to take in more fluids.

sentences.chinese: 这条地铁线将向北延伸，方便郊区居民出行。
sentences.traditional: 這條地鐵線將向北延伸，方便郊區居民出行。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dìtiě xiàn jiāng xiàng běi yánshēn, fāngbiàn jiāoqū jūmín chūxíng.
sentences.translation: This metro line will extend north, making travel easier for suburban residents.

sentences.chinese: 课堂讨论从课文内容延伸到了现实社会问题。
sentences.traditional: 課堂討論從課文內容延伸到了現實社會問題。
sentences.pinyin: Kètáng tǎolùn cóng kèwén nèiróng yánshēn dào le xiànshí shèhuì wèntí.
sentences.translation: The classroom discussion extended from the text to real social issues.

sentences.chinese: 城市绿道沿河延伸，连接了多个公园和社区。
sentences.traditional: 城市綠道沿河延伸，連接了多個公園和社區。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì lǜdào yán hé yánshēn, liánjiē le duō gè gōngyuán hé shèqū.
sentences.translation: The urban greenway extends along the river, connecting several parks and communities.

sentences.chinese: 专家们围绕城市老化问题进行了深入研讨。
sentences.traditional: 專家們圍繞城市老化問題進行了深入研討。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiāmen wéirào chéngshì lǎohuà wèntí jìnxíng le shēnrù yántǎo.
sentences.translation: The experts held an in-depth discussion on the problem of urban ageing.

sentences.chinese: 这次研讨不只关注技术，也涉及伦理和成本。
sentences.traditional: 這次研討不只關注技術，也涉及倫理和成本。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì yántǎo bù zhǐ guānzhù jìshù, yě shèjí lúnlǐ hé chéngběn.
sentences.translation: This discussion focused not only on technology, but also on ethics and cost.

sentences.chinese: 我们会根据研讨结果修改下一版方案。
sentences.traditional: 我們會根據研討結果修改下一版方案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen huì gēnjù yántǎo jiéguǒ xiūgǎi xià yí bǎn fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: We will revise the next version of the plan according to the results of the discussion.

sentences.chinese: 这项传统已经延续了几百年，至今仍有活力。
sentences.traditional: 這項傳統已經延續了幾百年，至今仍有活力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng chuántǒng yǐjing yánxù le jǐ bǎi nián, zhìjīn réng yǒu huólì.
sentences.translation: This tradition has continued for several hundred years and still has vitality today.

sentences.chinese: 如果资金到位，研究项目可以再延续两年。
sentences.traditional: 如果資金到位，研究項目可以再延續兩年。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zījīn dào wèi, yánjiū xiàngmù kěyǐ zài yánxù liǎng nián.
sentences.translation: If the funding is in place, the research project can continue for another two years.

sentences.chinese: 他的演讲延续了前一位嘉宾提出的观点。
sentences.traditional: 他的演講延續了前一位嘉賓提出的觀點。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng yánxù le qián yí wèi jiābīn tíchū de guāndiǎn.
sentences.translation: His speech continued the point raised by the previous guest.

sentences.chinese: 在紧张场合，谨慎的言语比激烈的态度更有效。
sentences.traditional: 在緊張場合，謹慎的言語比激烈的態度更有效。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jǐnzhāng chǎnghé, jǐnshèn de yányǔ bǐ jīliè de tàidu gèng yǒuxiào.
sentences.translation: In a tense situation, careful words are more effective than an aggressive attitude.

sentences.chinese: 他的言语虽然朴素，却让很多人感到安慰。
sentences.traditional: 他的言語雖然樸素，卻讓很多人感到安慰。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yányǔ suīrán pǔsù, què ràng hěn duō rén gǎndào ānwèi.
sentences.translation: Although his words were plain, they comforted many people.

sentences.chinese: 网络上的言语也可能对他人造成伤害。
sentences.traditional: 網絡上的言語也可能對他人造成傷害。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò shàng de yányǔ yě kěnéng duì tārén zàochéng shānghài.
sentences.translation: Language used online can also cause harm to others.

sentences.chinese: 如果炎症持续不退，最好及时去医院检查。
sentences.traditional: 如果炎症持續不退，最好及時去醫院檢查。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yánzhèng chíxù bú tuì, zuìhǎo jíshí qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
sentences.translation: If the inflammation continues and does not go down, it is best to go to hospital for a check promptly.

sentences.chinese: 医生说这种炎症通常和过敏反应有关。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說這種炎症通常和過敏反應有關。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè zhǒng yánzhèng tōngcháng hé guòmǐn fǎnyìng yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: The doctor said this kind of inflammation is usually related to an allergic reaction.

sentences.chinese: 长期熬夜可能会增加身体出现炎症的风险。
sentences.traditional: 長期熬夜可能會增加身體出現炎症的風險。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī áoyè kěnéng huì zēngjiā shēntǐ chūxiàn yánzhèng de fēngxiǎn.
sentences.translation: Staying up late over a long period may increase the risk of inflammation in the body.

sentences.chinese: 从长远眼光看，这项投资并不算冒险。
sentences.traditional: 從長遠眼光看，這項投資並不算冒險。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng chángyuǎn yǎnguāng kàn, zhè xiàng tóuzī bìng bù suàn màoxiǎn.
sentences.translation: From a long-term perspective, this investment is not really risky.

sentences.chinese: 她很有眼光，总能发现年轻设计师的潜力。
sentences.traditional: 她很有眼光，總能發現年輕設計師的潛力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu yǎnguāng, zǒng néng fāxiàn niánqīng shèjìshī de qiánlì.
sentences.translation: She has good judgement and can always spot the potential of young designers.

sentences.chinese: 评价一个项目，不能只用短期的眼光。
sentences.traditional: 評價一個項目，不能只用短期的眼光。
sentences.pinyin: Píngjià yí gè xiàngmù, bù néng zhǐ yòng duǎnqī de yǎnguāng.
sentences.translation: When evaluating a project, one cannot use only a short-term perspective.

sentences.chinese: 眼看会议就要开始，他才匆匆赶到现场。
sentences.traditional: 眼看會議就要開始，他才匆匆趕到現場。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnkàn huìyì jiù yào kāishǐ, tā cái cōngcōng gǎndào xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: Just as the meeting was about to begin, he hurriedly arrived at the scene.

sentences.chinese: 我们眼看着机会被竞争对手抢走，却来不及反应。
sentences.traditional: 我們眼看著機會被競爭對手搶走，卻來不及反應。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yǎnkàn zhe jīhuì bèi jìngzhēng duìshǒu qiǎngzǒu, què lái bu jí fǎnyìng.
sentences.translation: We watched the opportunity being taken by our competitor, but had no time to react.

sentences.chinese: 眼看天气越来越差，队长决定提前返回。
sentences.traditional: 眼看天氣越來越差，隊長決定提前返回。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnkàn tiānqì yuè lái yuè chà, duìzhǎng juédìng tíqián fǎnhuí.
sentences.translation: Seeing that the weather was getting worse, the team leader decided to return early.

sentences.chinese: 她今晚将在音乐厅演奏一首新改编的古曲。
sentences.traditional: 她今晚將在音樂廳演奏一首新改編的古曲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīnwǎn jiāng zài yīnyuètīng yǎnzòu yì shǒu xīn gǎibiān de gǔqǔ.
sentences.translation: Tonight she will perform a newly arranged traditional piece in the concert hall.

sentences.chinese: 乐队演奏得很稳，现场观众一直跟着节奏鼓掌。
sentences.traditional: 樂隊演奏得很穩，現場觀眾一直跟著節奏鼓掌。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèduì yǎnzòu de hěn wěn, xiànchǎng guānzhòng yìzhí gēnzhe jiézòu gǔzhǎng.
sentences.translation: The band performed very steadily, and the audience at the venue kept clapping along to the rhythm.

sentences.chinese: 这件乐器看似简单，真正演奏起来却很难控制。
sentences.traditional: 這件樂器看似簡單，真正演奏起來卻很難控制。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yuèqì kànsì jiǎndān, zhēnzhèng yǎnzòu qǐlai què hěn nán kòngzhì.
sentences.translation: This instrument looks simple, but it is very hard to control when actually performing on it.

sentences.chinese: 宴会开始前，工作人员再次核对了宾客名单。
sentences.traditional: 宴會開始前，工作人員再次核對了賓客名單。
sentences.pinyin: Yànhuì kāishǐ qián, gōngzuò rényuán zàicì héduì le bīnkè míngdān.
sentences.translation: Before the banquet began, the staff checked the guest list again.

sentences.chinese: 他不习惯正式宴会上的复杂礼节。
sentences.traditional: 他不習慣正式宴會上的複雜禮節。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xíguàn zhèngshì yànhuì shàng de fùzá lǐjié.
sentences.translation: He is not used to the complicated etiquette at formal banquets.

sentences.chinese: 这场宴会不仅是庆祝，也有重要的商务安排。
sentences.traditional: 這場宴會不僅是慶祝，也有重要的商務安排。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yànhuì bùjǐn shì qìngzhù, yě yǒu zhòngyào de shāngwù ānpái.
sentences.translation: This banquet is not only a celebration, but also includes important business arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 研究人员需要通过实验验证这个假设是否可靠。
sentences.traditional: 研究人員需要通過實驗驗證這個假設是否可靠。
sentences.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán xūyào tōngguò shíyàn yànzhèng zhè ge jiǎshè shìfǒu kěkào.
sentences.translation: Researchers need to verify through experiments whether this hypothesis is reliable.

sentences.chinese: 登录系统前，用户必须先验证身份。
sentences.traditional: 登錄系統前，用戶必須先驗證身份。
sentences.pinyin: Dēnglù xìtǒng qián, yònghù bìxū xiān yànzhèng shēnfèn.
sentences.translation: Before logging in to the system, users must first verify their identity.

sentences.chinese: 这些数据还没有经过验证，不能直接写进报告。
sentences.traditional: 這些數據還沒有經過驗證，不能直接寫進報告。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù hái méiyǒu jīngguò yànzhèng, bù néng zhíjiē xiě jìn bàogào.
sentences.translation: These data have not yet been verified, so they cannot be written directly into the report.

sentences.chinese: 他仰着头看夜空，试图找到那颗行星。
sentences.traditional: 他仰著頭看夜空，試圖找到那顆行星。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǎng zhe tóu kàn yèkōng, shìtú zhǎodào nà kē xíngxīng.
sentences.translation: He looked up at the night sky, trying to find that planet.

sentences.chinese: 老人坐在院子里，微微仰起脸晒太阳。
sentences.traditional: 老人坐在院子裡，微微仰起臉曬太陽。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén zuò zài yuànzi lǐ, wēiwēi yǎng qǐ liǎn shài tàiyáng.
sentences.translation: The old person sat in the courtyard and slightly tilted their face up to bask in the sun.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们仰着脸望向高塔，惊讶得说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們仰著臉望向高塔，驚訝得說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yǎng zhe liǎn wàng xiàng gāotǎ, jīngyà de shuō bu chū huà lái.
sentences.translation: The children looked up towards the tall tower, so surprised that they could not speak.

sentences.chinese: 最近换了洗衣液后，他的手臂一直很痒。
sentences.traditional: 最近換了洗衣液後，他的手臂一直很癢。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn huàn le xǐyīyè hòu, tā de shǒubì yìzhí hěn yǎng.
sentences.translation: After recently changing laundry detergent, his arms have been itchy.

sentences.chinese: 伤口快好的时候会有点痒，别总去抓。
sentences.traditional: 傷口快好的時候會有點癢，別總去抓。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngkǒu kuài hǎo de shíhou huì yǒudiǎn yǎng, bié zǒng qù zhuā.
sentences.translation: When a wound is nearly healed, it may itch a little, but do not keep scratching it.

sentences.chinese: 她对这种植物过敏，碰到叶子皮肤就痒。
sentences.traditional: 她對這種植物過敏，碰到葉子皮膚就癢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhè zhǒng zhíwù guòmǐn, pèngdào yèzi pífū jiù yǎng.
sentences.translation: She is allergic to this plant; if she touches its leaves, her skin becomes itchy.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市正在完善养老服务，让老人能在社区得到照顾。
sentences.traditional: 這個城市正在完善養老服務，讓老人能在社區得到照顧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge chéngshì zhèngzài wánshàn yǎnglǎo fúwù, ràng lǎorén néng zài shèqū dédào zhàogù.
sentences.translation: This city is improving elderly care services so that older people can be looked after in the community.

sentences.chinese: 他们年轻时就开始为养老做长期规划。
sentences.traditional: 他們年輕時就開始為養老做長期規劃。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen niánqīng shí jiù kāishǐ wèi yǎnglǎo zuò chángqī guīhuà.
sentences.translation: They began making long-term plans for old-age care while they were still young.

sentences.chinese: 养老不仅需要资金，也需要稳定的医疗和陪伴。
sentences.traditional: 養老不僅需要資金，也需要穩定的醫療和陪伴。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎnglǎo bùjǐn xūyào zījīn, yě xūyào wěndìng de yīliáo hé péibàn.
sentences.translation: Old-age care requires not only money, but also stable medical support and companionship.

sentences.chinese: 这家养老院离医院很近，家属探望也方便。
sentences.traditional: 這家養老院離醫院很近，家屬探望也方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yǎnglǎoyuàn lí yīyuàn hěn jìn, jiāshǔ tànwàng yě fāngbiàn.
sentences.translation: This nursing home is very close to the hospital, and it is also convenient for family members to visit.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者每周去养老院陪老人聊天、读报。
sentences.traditional: 志願者每週去養老院陪老人聊天、讀報。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě měi zhōu qù yǎnglǎoyuàn péi lǎorén liáotiān, dúbào.
sentences.translation: Volunteers go to the nursing home every week to chat with the elderly and read newspapers with them.

sentences.chinese: 选择养老院时，不能只看价格，还要看护理质量。
sentences.traditional: 選擇養老院時，不能只看價格，還要看護理質量。
sentences.pinyin: Xuǎnzé yǎnglǎoyuàn shí, bù néng zhǐ kàn jiàgé, hái yào kàn hùlǐ zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: When choosing a nursing home, you cannot look only at the price; you must also look at the quality of care.

sentences.chinese: 高原地区氧气稀薄，初到的人容易感到头晕。
sentences.traditional: 高原地區氧氣稀薄，初到的人容易感到頭暈。
sentences.pinyin: Gāoyuán dìqū yǎngqì xībó, chū dào de rén róngyì gǎndào tóuyūn.
sentences.translation: In plateau areas the oxygen is thin, and people who have just arrived easily feel dizzy.

sentences.chinese: 医生给病人接上氧气后，他的呼吸逐渐平稳。
sentences.traditional: 醫生給病人接上氧氣後，他的呼吸逐漸平穩。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi bìngrén jiē shàng yǎngqì hòu, tā de hūxī zhújiàn píngwěn.
sentences.translation: After the doctor connected the patient to oxygen, his breathing gradually became steady.

sentences.chinese: 森林能释放氧气，对改善城市空气很有帮助。
sentences.traditional: 森林能釋放氧氣，對改善城市空氣很有幫助。
sentences.pinyin: Sēnlín néng shìfàng yǎngqì, duì gǎishàn chéngshì kōngqì hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.translation: Forests can release oxygen, which is very helpful for improving urban air.

sentences.chinese: 展厅里展示了十几样传统手工艺品。
sentences.traditional: 展廳裡展示了十幾樣傳統手工藝品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǎntīng lǐ zhǎnshì le shí jǐ yàng chuántǒng shǒugōng yìpǐn.
sentences.translation: The exhibition hall displayed more than ten kinds of traditional handicrafts.

sentences.chinese: 这家店每天都会推出几样不同的素菜。
sentences.traditional: 這家店每天都會推出幾樣不同的素菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn měitiān dōu huì tuīchū jǐ yàng bùtóng de sùcài.
sentences.translation: This restaurant offers several different vegetarian dishes every day.

sentences.chinese: 我只带了两样工具，没想到已经够用了。
sentences.traditional: 我只帶了兩樣工具，沒想到已經夠用了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ dài le liǎng yàng gōngjù, méi xiǎngdào yǐjing gòu yòng le.
sentences.translation: I brought only two kinds of tools, but unexpectedly they were already enough.

sentences.chinese: 对很多孩子来说，太空仍然是一个遥远而神秘的地方。
sentences.traditional: 對很多孩子來說，太空仍然是一個遙遠而神秘的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Duì hěn duō háizi lái shuō, tàikōng réngrán shì yí gè yáoyuǎn ér shénmì de dìfang.
sentences.translation: For many children, space is still a distant and mysterious place.

sentences.chinese: 那段艰难的岁月已经变得遥远，但教训不能忘记。
sentences.traditional: 那段艱難的歲月已經變得遙遠，但教訓不能忘記。
sentences.pinyin: Nà duàn jiānnán de suìyuè yǐjing biàn de yáoyuǎn, dàn jiàoxun bù néng wàngjì.
sentences.translation: Those difficult years have already become distant, but their lessons must not be forgotten.

sentences.chinese: 虽然两座城市相隔遥远，合作却一直很紧密。
sentences.traditional: 雖然兩座城市相隔遙遠，合作卻一直很緊密。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán liǎng zuò chéngshì xiānggé yáoyuǎn, hézuò què yìzhí hěn jǐnmì.
sentences.translation: Although the two cities are far apart, their cooperation has remained very close.

sentences.chinese: 汇报前，请把这份材料的要点整理成一页纸。
sentences.traditional: 匯報前，請把這份材料的要點整理成一頁紙。
sentences.pinyin: Huìbào qián, qǐng bǎ zhè fèn cáiliào de yàodiǎn zhěnglǐ chéng yí yè zhǐ.
sentences.translation: Before the presentation, please organise the key points of this material onto one page.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有逐字解释，而是先讲清文章的要点。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有逐字解釋，而是先講清文章的要點。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu zhúzì jiěshì, ér shì xiān jiǎng qīng wénzhāng de yàodiǎn.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not explain it word by word, but first made the key points of the article clear.

sentences.chinese: 会议时间有限，我们只讨论最关键的要点。
sentences.traditional: 會議時間有限，我們只討論最關鍵的要點。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shíjiān yǒuxiàn, wǒmen zhǐ tǎolùn zuì guānjiàn de yàodiǎn.
sentences.translation: Meeting time is limited, so we will discuss only the most important key points.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题要么今天解决，要么就推迟到下周。
sentences.traditional: 這個問題要麼今天解決，要麼就推遲到下週。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí yàome jīntiān jiějué, yàome jiù tuīchí dào xià zhōu.
sentences.translation: This problem must either be solved today, or be postponed until next week.

sentences.chinese: 要么你亲自去谈判，要么派一个能做决定的人去。
sentences.traditional: 要麼你親自去談判，要麼派一個能做決定的人去。
sentences.pinyin: Yàome nǐ qīnzì qù tánpàn, yàome pài yí gè néng zuò juédìng de rén qù.
sentences.translation: Either you go to negotiate in person, or send someone who can make decisions.

sentences.chinese: 我们要么接受现有条件，要么重新寻找合作方。
sentences.traditional: 我們要麼接受現有條件，要麼重新尋找合作方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yàome jiēshòu xiànyǒu tiáojiàn, yàome chóngxīn xúnzhǎo hézuòfāng.
sentences.translation: We either accept the current conditions or look for a new partner.

sentences.chinese: 资金、技术和人才是这个项目成功的三大要素。
sentences.traditional: 資金、技術和人才是這個項目成功的三大要素。
sentences.pinyin: Zījīn, jìshù hé réncái shì zhè ge xiàngmù chénggōng de sān dà yàosù.
sentences.translation: Funding, technology and talent are the three major factors in the success of this project.

sentences.chinese: 诚信是长期合作中不可缺少的要素。
sentences.traditional: 誠信是長期合作中不可缺少的要素。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngxìn shì chángqī hézuò zhōng bù kě quēshǎo de yàosù.
sentences.translation: Honesty is an indispensable factor in long-term cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 评价一座城市，不能只看经济要素，也要看生活质量。
sentences.traditional: 評價一座城市，不能只看經濟要素，也要看生活質量。
sentences.pinyin: Píngjià yí zuò chéngshì, bù néng zhǐ kàn jīngjì yàosù, yě yào kàn shēnghuó zhìliàng.
sentences.translation: When evaluating a city, you cannot look only at economic factors; you must also look at quality of life.

sentences.chinese: 春天一到，路边的野花很快就开满了山坡。
sentences.traditional: 春天一到，路邊的野花很快就開滿了山坡。
sentences.pinyin: Chūntiān yí dào, lùbiān de yěhuā hěn kuài jiù kāi mǎn le shānpō.
sentences.translation: As soon as spring arrives, the wild flowers by the road quickly cover the hillside.

sentences.chinese: 这匹马性子太野，新手骑起来很危险。
sentences.traditional: 這匹馬性子太野，新手騎起來很危險。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pǐ mǎ xìngzi tài yě, xīnshǒu qí qǐlai hěn wēixiǎn.
sentences.translation: This horse is too wild in temperament; it is dangerous for a beginner to ride.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们在海边玩得太野，衣服全被浪打湿了。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們在海邊玩得太野，衣服全被浪打濕了。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài hǎibiān wán de tài yě, yīfu quán bèi làng dǎ shī le.
sentences.translation: The children played too wildly by the sea, and their clothes were completely soaked by the waves.

sentences.chinese: 你想先休息一下也好，等精神好了再处理这件事。
sentences.traditional: 你想先休息一下也好，等精神好了再處理這件事。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng xiān xiūxi yíxià yěhǎo, děng jīngshen hǎo le zài chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.translation: It’s fine if you want to rest first; handle this after you feel better.

sentences.chinese: 留在本地发展也好，去外地闯一闯也好，关键是你要清楚自己的目标。
sentences.traditional: 留在本地發展也好，去外地闖一闖也好，關鍵是你要清楚自己的目標。
sentences.pinyin: Liú zài běndì fāzhǎn yěhǎo, qù wàidì chuǎng yi chuǎng yěhǎo, guānjiàn shì nǐ yào qīngchu zìjǐ de mùbiāo.
sentences.translation: Whether you develop locally or try your luck elsewhere, the key is to be clear about your goals.

sentences.chinese: 方案不够完美也好，至少给我们提供了一个讨论的基础。
sentences.traditional: 方案不夠完美也好，至少給我們提供了一個討論的基礎。
sentences.pinyin: Fāng'àn bú gòu wánměi yěhǎo, zhìshǎo gěi wǒmen tígōng le yí gè tǎolùn de jīchǔ.
sentences.translation: It may be imperfect, but at least it gives us a basis for discussion.

sentences.chinese: 这里的湿地保护了许多野生鸟类的栖息地。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的濕地保護了許多野生鳥類的棲息地。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de shīdì bǎohù le xǔduō yěshēng niǎolèi de qīxīdì.
sentences.translation: The wetlands here protect the habitats of many wild birds.

sentences.chinese: 野生动物不应该被当作宠物随便饲养。
sentences.traditional: 野生動物不應該被當作寵物隨便飼養。
sentences.pinyin: Yěshēng dòngwù bù yīnggāi bèi dàngzuò chǒngwù suíbiàn sìyǎng.
sentences.translation: Wild animals should not be kept casually as pets.

sentences.chinese: 科研人员正在记录这种野生植物的分布情况。
sentences.traditional: 科研人員正在記錄這種野生植物的分佈情況。
sentences.pinyin: Kēyán rényuán zhèngzài jìlù zhè zhǒng yěshēng zhíwù de fēnbù qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: Researchers are recording the distribution of this wild plant.

sentences.chinese: 在野外工作时，团队必须随身携带通信设备。
sentences.traditional: 在野外工作時，團隊必須隨身攜帶通信設備。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yěwài gōngzuò shí, tuánduì bìxū suíshēn xiédài tōngxìn shèbèi.
sentences.translation: When working outdoors, the team must carry communication equipment with them.

sentences.chinese: 这次夏令营安排了野外观察和急救训练。
sentences.traditional: 這次夏令營安排了野外觀察和急救訓練。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì xiàlìngyíng ānpái le yěwài guānchá hé jíjiù xùnliàn.
sentences.translation: This summer camp has arranged outdoor observation and first-aid training.

sentences.chinese: 夜里在野外行走，最好不要离开主路。
sentences.traditional: 夜裡在野外行走，最好不要離開主路。
sentences.pinyin: Yèlǐ zài yěwài xíngzǒu, zuìhǎo bú yào líkāi zhǔlù.
sentences.translation: When walking outdoors at night, it is best not to leave the main road.

sentences.chinese: 旅游业恢复得很快，带动了当地餐饮和交通收入。
sentences.traditional: 旅遊業恢復得很快，帶動了當地餐飲和交通收入。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚyóuyè huīfù de hěn kuài, dàidòng le dāngdì cānyǐn hé jiāotōng shōurù.
sentences.translation: The tourism industry recovered quickly and boosted local catering and transport income.

sentences.chinese: 制造业升级需要稳定的技术人才和长期投资。
sentences.traditional: 製造業升級需要穩定的技術人才和長期投資。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìzàoyè shēngjí xūyào wěndìng de jìshù réncái hé chángqī tóuzī.
sentences.translation: Upgrading manufacturing requires stable technical talent and long-term investment.

sentences.chinese: 服务业的发展水平，往往能反映一座城市的活力。
sentences.traditional: 服務業的發展水平，往往能反映一座城市的活力。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyè de fāzhǎn shuǐpíng, wǎngwǎng néng fǎnyìng yí zuò chéngshì de huólì.
sentences.translation: The level of development in the service industry often reflects the vitality of a city.

sentences.chinese: 这种透明液体看起来像水，但不能直接饮用。
sentences.traditional: 這種透明液體看起來像水，但不能直接飲用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tòumíng yètǐ kàn qǐlai xiàng shuǐ, dàn bù néng zhíjiē yǐnyòng.
sentences.translation: This transparent liquid looks like water, but it cannot be drunk directly.

sentences.chinese: 实验前，必须确认容器里的液体没有泄漏。
sentences.traditional: 實驗前，必須確認容器裡的液體沒有洩漏。
