sentences.pinyin: Shíyàn qián, bìxū quèrèn róngqì lǐ de yètǐ méiyǒu xièlòu.
sentences.translation: Before the experiment, you must confirm that the liquid in the container has not leaked.

sentences.chinese: 高温会使这种液体迅速蒸发，操作时要特别小心。
sentences.traditional: 高溫會使這種液體迅速蒸發，操作時要特別小心。
sentences.pinyin: Gāowēn huì shǐ zhè zhǒng yètǐ xùnsù zhēngfā, cāozuò shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
sentences.translation: High temperatures cause this liquid to evaporate quickly, so you must be especially careful when handling it.

sentences.chinese: 多年过去了，这条老街依旧保留着从前的风貌。
sentences.traditional: 多年過去了，這條老街依舊保留著從前的風貌。
sentences.pinyin: Duō nián guòqù le, zhè tiáo lǎo jiē yījiù bǎoliú zhe cóngqián de fēngmào.
sentences.translation: Many years have passed, but this old street still preserves its former appearance.

sentences.chinese: 尽管市场变化很大，他对产品质量的要求依旧很严。
sentences.traditional: 儘管市場變化很大，他對產品質量的要求依舊很嚴。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shìchǎng biànhuà hěn dà, tā duì chǎnpǐn zhìliàng de yāoqiú yījiù hěn yán.
sentences.translation: Although the market has changed a great deal, his requirements for product quality remain strict.

sentences.chinese: 雨停以后，山路依旧湿滑，司机不敢开得太快。
sentences.traditional: 雨停以後，山路依舊濕滑，司機不敢開得太快。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ tíng yǐhòu, shānlù yījiù shīhuá, sījī bù gǎn kāi de tài kuài.
sentences.translation: After the rain stopped, the mountain road was still slippery, so the driver did not dare to drive too fast.

sentences.chinese: 如果企业过度依赖单一客户，经营风险会明显增加。
sentences.traditional: 如果企業過度依賴單一客戶，經營風險會明顯增加。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ qǐyè guòdù yīlài dānyī kèhù, jīngyíng fēngxiǎn huì míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
sentences.translation: If a company relies too much on a single customer, its business risk will clearly increase.

sentences.chinese: 孩子不能总是依赖父母解决所有问题。
sentences.traditional: 孩子不能總是依賴父母解決所有問題。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi bù néng zǒngshì yīlài fùmǔ jiějué suǒyǒu wèntí.
sentences.translation: Children cannot always rely on their parents to solve every problem.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统依赖稳定的网络，否则数据很难实时更新。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統依賴穩定的網絡，否則數據很難實時更新。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng yīlài wěndìng de wǎngluò, fǒuzé shùjù hěn nán shíshí gēngxīn.
sentences.translation: This system relies on a stable network; otherwise, the data is hard to update in real time.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学拥有一流的实验设备和研究团队。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學擁有一流的實驗設備和研究團隊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yōngyǒu yīliú de shíyàn shèbèi hé yánjiū tuánduì.
sentences.translation: This university has first-class laboratory equipment and research teams.

sentences.chinese: 一流的服务不只是态度好，还要能真正解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 一流的服務不只是態度好，還要能真正解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Yīliú de fúwù bù zhǐ shì tàidu hǎo, hái yào néng zhēnzhèng jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: First-class service is not just about having a good attitude; it must also truly solve problems.

sentences.chinese: 他希望把这家小工厂发展成一流的品牌。
sentences.traditional: 他希望把這家小工廠發展成一流的品牌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng bǎ zhè jiā xiǎo gōngchǎng fāzhǎn chéng yīliú de pǐnpái.
sentences.translation: He hopes to develop this small factory into a first-class brand.

sentences.chinese: 调查报告详细比较了两地居民在衣食住行方面的成本。
sentences.traditional: 調查報告詳細比較了兩地居民在衣食住行方面的成本。
sentences.pinyin: Diàochá bàogào xiángxì bǐjiào le liǎng dì jūmín zài yīshízhùxíng fāngmiàn de chéngběn.
sentences.translation: The survey report compared in detail the living costs of residents in the two places in terms of daily necessities.

sentences.chinese: 对新员工来说，公司提供的指南涵盖了衣食住行的基本信息。
sentences.traditional: 對新員工來說，公司提供的指南涵蓋了衣食住行的基本信息。
sentences.pinyin: Duì xīn yuángōng lái shuō, gōngsī tígōng de zhǐnán hángài le yīshízhùxíng de jīběn xìnxī.
sentences.translation: For new employees, the guide provided by the company covers basic information about daily life.

sentences.chinese: 城市规划不能只看道路，还要考虑居民的衣食住行。
sentences.traditional: 城市規劃不能只看道路，還要考慮居民的衣食住行。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì guīhuà bù néng zhǐ kàn dàolù, hái yào kǎolǜ jūmín de yīshízhùxíng.
sentences.translation: Urban planning cannot look only at roads; it must also consider residents’ basic necessities of life.

sentences.chinese: 医药行业的发展离不开严格的质量监管。
sentences.traditional: 醫藥行業的發展離不開嚴格的質量監管。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyào hángyè de fāzhǎn lí bù kāi yángé de zhìliàng jiānguǎn.
sentences.translation: The development of the pharmaceutical industry cannot be separated from strict quality supervision.

sentences.chinese: 这家公司把大量资金投入医药研究，希望开发新药。
sentences.traditional: 這家公司把大量資金投入醫藥研究，希望開發新藥。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī bǎ dàliàng zījīn tóurù yīyào yánjiū, xīwàng kāifā xīn yào.
sentences.translation: This company has invested a large amount of funding in medical research, hoping to develop new medicines.

sentences.chinese: 基层医院的医药供应必须稳定，不能影响日常治疗。
sentences.traditional: 基層醫院的醫藥供應必須穩定，不能影響日常治療。
sentences.pinyin: Jīcéng yīyuàn de yīyào gōngyìng bìxū wěndìng, bù néng yǐngxiǎng rìcháng zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: The medicine supply in primary-level hospitals must be stable and must not affect daily treatment.

sentences.chinese: 会议开始前，主持人把需要表决的事项一一说明清楚。
sentences.traditional: 會議開始前，主持人把需要表決的事項一一說明清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, zhǔchírén bǎ xūyào biǎojué de shìxiàng yīyī shuōmíng qīngchu.
sentences.translation: Before the meeting began, the host explained the items that needed to be voted on one by one.

sentences.chinese: 老师没有直接批评，而是把每个错误一一指出来。
sentences.traditional: 老師沒有直接批評，而是把每個錯誤一一指出來。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu zhíjiē pīpíng, ér shì bǎ měi gè cuòwù yīyī zhǐ chūlai.
sentences.translation: The teacher did not criticise directly, but pointed out each mistake one by one.

sentences.chinese: 面对居民的疑问，工作人员一一作出回应。
sentences.traditional: 面對居民的疑問，工作人員一一作出回應。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì jūmín de yíwèn, gōngzuò rényuán yīyī zuòchū huíyìng.
sentences.translation: Facing residents’ questions, the staff responded to them one by one.

sentences.chinese: 我姨退休后搬到海边，生活节奏比以前慢了很多。
sentences.traditional: 我姨退休後搬到海邊，生活節奏比以前慢了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yí tuìxiū hòu bān dào hǎibiān, shēnghuó jiézòu bǐ yǐqián màn le hěn duō.
sentences.translation: My aunt moved to the seaside after retiring, and her pace of life became much slower than before.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子从小由姨照顾，对她特别依赖。
sentences.traditional: 這個孩子從小由姨照顧，對她特別依賴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi cóng xiǎo yóu yí zhàogù, duì tā tèbié yīlài.
sentences.translation: This child was cared for by his aunt from a young age and is especially dependent on her.

sentences.chinese: 春节时，我姨总会准备一些家乡的小吃。
sentences.traditional: 春節時，我姨總會準備一些家鄉的小吃。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié shí, wǒ yí zǒng huì zhǔnbèi yìxiē jiāxiāng de xiǎochī.
sentences.translation: At Spring Festival, my aunt always prepares some snacks from our hometown.

sentences.chinese: 他一辈子都在研究地方戏曲，积累了大量珍贵资料。
sentences.traditional: 他一輩子都在研究地方戲曲，積累了大量珍貴資料。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yíbèizi dōu zài yánjiū dìfāng xìqǔ, jīlěi le dàliàng zhēnguì zīliào.
sentences.translation: He spent his whole life researching local opera and accumulated a large amount of valuable material.

sentences.chinese: 对许多人来说，买房是一辈子里最重大的决定之一。
sentences.traditional: 對許多人來說，買房是一輩子裡最重大的決定之一。
sentences.pinyin: Duì xǔduō rén lái shuō, mǎi fáng shì yíbèizi lǐ zuì zhòngdà de juédìng zhī yī.
sentences.translation: For many people, buying a home is one of the most important decisions of a lifetime.

sentences.chinese: 母亲常说，真正的朋友不是一时热闹，而是一辈子的信赖。
sentences.traditional: 母親常說，真正的朋友不是一時熱鬧，而是一輩子的信賴。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn cháng shuō, zhēnzhèng de péngyou bú shì yìshí rènao, ér shì yíbèizi de xìnlài.
sentences.translation: My mother often says that true friendship is not temporary excitement, but lifelong trust.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城保存着丰富的文化遗产，吸引了很多学者前来研究。
sentences.traditional: 這座古城保存著豐富的文化遺產，吸引了很多學者前來研究。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng bǎocún zhe fēngfù de wénhuà yíchǎn, xīyǐn le hěn duō xuézhě qiánlái yánjiū.
sentences.translation: This ancient city preserves a rich cultural heritage, attracting many scholars to come and study it.

sentences.chinese: 父亲留下的遗产不多，但其中包含了他一生的心血。
sentences.traditional: 父親留下的遺產不多，但其中包含了他一生的心血。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn liúxià de yíchǎn bù duō, dàn qízhōng bāohán le tā yìshēng de xīnxuè.
sentences.translation: The inheritance left by his father was not large, but it contained his life’s hard work.

sentences.chinese: 如何保护非物质遗产，已成为当地政府的重要课题。
sentences.traditional: 如何保護非物質遺產，已成為當地政府的重要課題。
sentences.pinyin: Rúhé bǎohù fēi wùzhì yíchǎn, yǐ chéngwéi dāngdì zhèngfǔ de zhòngyào kètí.
sentences.translation: How to protect intangible heritage has become an important issue for the local government.

sentences.chinese: 有些疾病与遗传因素有关，但生活习惯同样重要。
sentences.traditional: 有些疾病與遺傳因素有關，但生活習慣同樣重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē jíbìng yǔ yíchuán yīnsù yǒuguān, dàn shēnghuó xíguàn tóngyàng zhòngyào.
sentences.translation: Some diseases are related to genetic factors, but lifestyle habits are equally important.

sentences.chinese: 这孩子的音乐天赋似乎遗传自他的母亲。
sentences.traditional: 這孩子的音樂天賦似乎遺傳自他的母親。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè háizi de yīnyuè tiānfù sìhū yíchuán zì tā de mǔqīn.
sentences.translation: This child’s musical talent seems to have been inherited from his mother.

sentences.chinese: 科学家正在研究这种性状是如何遗传给下一代的。
sentences.traditional: 科學家正在研究這種性狀是如何遺傳給下一代的。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài yánjiū zhè zhǒng xìngzhuàng shì rúhé yíchuán gěi xià yí dài de.
sentences.translation: Scientists are studying how this trait is passed on to the next generation.

sentences.chinese: 学校附近一带交通复杂，放学时需要特别注意安全。
sentences.traditional: 學校附近一帶交通複雜，放學時需要特別注意安全。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yídài jiāotōng fùzá, fàngxué shí xūyào tèbié zhùyì ānquán.
sentences.translation: The area around the school has complicated traffic, so extra attention to safety is needed after school.

sentences.chinese: 沿海一带受台风影响，部分航班被迫延期。
sentences.traditional: 沿海一帶受颱風影響，部分航班被迫延期。
sentences.pinyin: Yánhǎi yídài shòu táifēng yǐngxiǎng, bùfen hángbān bèipò yánqī.
sentences.translation: The coastal area was affected by the typhoon, and some flights were forced to be postponed.

sentences.chinese: 这一带过去以种水稻为主，如今发展起了旅游业。
sentences.traditional: 這一帶過去以種水稻為主，如今發展起了旅遊業。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yídài guòqù yǐ zhòng shuǐdào wéi zhǔ, rújīn fāzhǎn qǐ le lǚyóuyè.
sentences.translation: This area used to be mainly devoted to growing rice, but now tourism has developed here.

sentences.chinese: 会议结束后，几位专家一道去现场查看情况。
sentences.traditional: 會議結束後，幾位專家一道去現場查看情況。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, jǐ wèi zhuānjiā yídào qù xiànchǎng chákàn qíngkuàng.
sentences.translation: After the meeting ended, several experts went together to the site to check the situation.

sentences.chinese: 这项工作需要技术部门和市场部门一道推进。
sentences.traditional: 這項工作需要技術部門和市場部門一道推進。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò xūyào jìshù bùmén hé shìchǎng bùmén yídào tuījìn.
sentences.translation: This work requires the technical department and the marketing department to advance it together.

sentences.chinese: 他愿意同我们一道承担风险，而不是只在旁边提意见。
sentences.traditional: 他願意同我們一道承擔風險，而不是只在旁邊提意見。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuànyì tóng wǒmen yídào chéngdān fēngxiǎn, ér bú shì zhǐ zài pángbiān tí yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: He is willing to share the risks with us, rather than merely offering opinions from the side.

sentences.chinese: 他一贯重视细节，所以负责审核这类文档很合适。
sentences.traditional: 他一貫重視細節，所以負責審核這類文檔很合適。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yíguàn zhòngshì xìjié, suǒyǐ fùzé shěnhé zhè lèi wéndàng hěn héshì.
sentences.translation: He has always valued detail, so it is very suitable for him to be responsible for reviewing such documents.

sentences.chinese: 公司一贯的原则是先保证质量，再考虑速度。
sentences.traditional: 公司一貫的原則是先保證質量，再考慮速度。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yíguàn de yuánzé shì xiān bǎozhèng zhìliàng, zài kǎolǜ sùdù.
sentences.translation: The company’s consistent principle is to guarantee quality first, and then consider speed.

sentences.chinese: 她对待学生一贯温和，却从不放松学术要求。
sentences.traditional: 她對待學生一貫溫和，卻從不放鬆學術要求。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duìdài xuéshēng yíguàn wēnhé, què cóng bù fàngsōng xuéshù yāoqiú.
sentences.translation: She is always gentle with students, but never relaxes her academic requirements.

sentences.chinese: 读完说明后，他仍然对收费标准感到疑惑。
sentences.traditional: 讀完說明後，他仍然對收費標準感到疑惑。
sentences.pinyin: Dú wán shuōmíng hòu, tā réngrán duì shōufèi biāozhǔn gǎndào yíhuò.
sentences.translation: After reading the explanation, he still felt confused about the charging standard.

sentences.chinese: 面对观众的疑惑，导演耐心解释了影片的创作思路。
sentences.traditional: 面對觀眾的疑惑，導演耐心解釋了影片的創作思路。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì guānzhòng de yíhuò, dǎoyǎn nàixīn jiěshì le yǐngpiàn de chuàngzuò sīlù.
sentences.translation: Facing the audience’s doubts, the director patiently explained the creative thinking behind the film.

sentences.chinese: 这份数据前后不一致，难免让人产生疑惑。
sentences.traditional: 這份數據前後不一致，難免讓人產生疑惑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn shùjù qiánhòu bù yízhì, nánmiǎn ràng rén chǎnshēng yíhuò.
sentences.translation: The data in this document is inconsistent, so it is hard to avoid causing doubt.

sentences.chinese: 进入实验室前，所有人员一律必须完成安全培训。
sentences.traditional: 進入實驗室前，所有人員一律必須完成安全培訓。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù shíyànshì qián, suǒyǒu rényuán yílǜ bìxū wánchéng ānquán péixùn.
sentences.translation: Before entering the laboratory, all personnel must complete safety training without exception.

sentences.chinese: 本次活动名额有限，过期报名一律不再受理。
sentences.traditional: 本次活動名額有限，過期報名一律不再受理。
sentences.pinyin: Běn cì huódòng míng'é yǒuxiàn, guòqī bàomíng yílǜ bú zài shòulǐ.
sentences.translation: Places for this event are limited, and late registrations will not be accepted under any circumstances.

sentences.chinese: 涉及个人隐私的内容，我们一律不会公开。
sentences.traditional: 涉及個人隱私的內容，我們一律不會公開。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjí gèrén yǐnsī de nèiróng, wǒmen yílǜ bú huì gōngkāi.
sentences.translation: We will not disclose any content involving personal privacy without exception.

sentences.chinese: 为了让孩子接受更好的教育，他们决定移民到另一个国家。
sentences.traditional: 為了讓孩子接受更好的教育，他們決定移民到另一個國家。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ràng háizi jiēshòu gèng hǎo de jiàoyù, tāmen juédìng yímín dào lìng yí gè guójiā.
sentences.translation: To let their child receive a better education, they decided to immigrate to another country.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市的移民社区保留了丰富的饮食和节日习俗。
sentences.traditional: 這座城市的移民社區保留了豐富的飲食和節日習俗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de yímín shèqū bǎoliú le fēngfù de yǐnshí hé jiérì xísú.
sentences.translation: The immigrant community in this city has preserved rich food and festival customs.

sentences.chinese: 移民政策的变化直接影响当地劳动力市场。
sentences.traditional: 移民政策的變化直接影響當地勞動力市場。
sentences.pinyin: Yímín zhèngcè de biànhuà zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng dāngdì láodònglì shìchǎng.
sentences.translation: Changes in immigration policy directly affect the local labour market.

sentences.chinese: 实验开始前，研究员必须校准所有仪器。
sentences.traditional: 實驗開始前，研究員必須校準所有儀器。
sentences.pinyin: Shíyàn kāishǐ qián, yánjiūyuán bìxū jiàozhǔn suǒyǒu yíqì.
sentences.translation: Before the experiment begins, researchers must calibrate all the instruments.

sentences.chinese: 这台仪器能在几秒钟内检测出空气中的细菌。
sentences.traditional: 這臺儀器能在幾秒鐘內檢測出空氣中的細菌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái yíqì néng zài jǐ miǎo zhōng nèi jiǎncè chū kōngqì zhōng de xìjūn.
sentences.translation: This instrument can detect bacteria in the air within a few seconds.

sentences.chinese: 医生根据仪器显示的数据调整了治疗方案。
sentences.traditional: 醫生根據儀器顯示的數據調整了治療方案。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gēnjù yíqì xiǎnshì de shùjù tiáozhěng le zhìliáo fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: The doctor adjusted the treatment plan according to the data shown by the instrument.

sentences.chinese: 毕业仪式上，校长向优秀学员颁发了证书。
sentences.traditional: 畢業儀式上，校長向優秀學員頒發了證書。
sentences.pinyin: Bìyè yíshì shang, xiàozhǎng xiàng yōuxiù xuéyuán bānfā le zhèngshū.
sentences.translation: At the graduation ceremony, the headteacher presented certificates to outstanding students.

sentences.chinese: 当地人用传统仪式欢迎远道而来的客人。
sentences.traditional: 當地人用傳統儀式歡迎遠道而來的客人。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngdì rén yòng chuántǒng yíshì huānyíng yuǎndào ér lái de kèrén.
sentences.translation: Local people used a traditional ceremony to welcome guests who had come from far away.

sentences.chinese: 签约仪式虽然简短，却标志着合作正式开始。
sentences.traditional: 簽約儀式雖然簡短，卻標誌著合作正式開始。
sentences.pinyin: Qiānyuē yíshì suīrán jiǎnduǎn, què biāozhì zhe hézuò zhèngshì kāishǐ.
sentences.translation: Although the signing ceremony was brief, it marked the official start of the cooperation.

sentences.chinese: 他一向说话谨慎，很少在公开场合随便表态。
sentences.traditional: 他一向說話謹慎，很少在公開場合隨便表態。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yíxiàng shuōhuà jǐnshèn, hěn shǎo zài gōngkāi chǎnghé suíbiàn biǎotài.
sentences.translation: He has always spoken cautiously and rarely expresses his position casually in public.

sentences.chinese: 这家企业一向重视环保，因此很早就使用了新能源。
sentences.traditional: 這家企業一向重視環保，因此很早就使用了新能源。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè yíxiàng zhòngshì huánbǎo, yīncǐ hěn zǎo jiù shǐyòng le xīnnéngyuán.
sentences.translation: This company has always valued environmental protection, so it began using new energy very early.

sentences.chinese: 母亲一向温柔，但在原则问题上绝不让步。
sentences.traditional: 母親一向溫柔，但在原則問題上絕不讓步。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn yíxiàng wēnróu, dàn zài yuánzé wèntí shang jué bù ràngbù.
sentences.translation: My mother has always been gentle, but she never gives way on matters of principle.

sentences.chinese: 政府推出了一系列措施，以缓解住房压力。
sentences.traditional: 政府推出了一系列措施，以緩解住房壓力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū le yíxìliè cuòshī, yǐ huǎnjiě zhùfáng yālì.
sentences.translation: The government introduced a series of measures to ease housing pressure.

sentences.chinese: 这部纪录片通过一系列采访展示了移民家庭的生活。
sentences.traditional: 這部紀錄片通過一系列採訪展示了移民家庭的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tōngguò yíxìliè cǎifǎng zhǎnshì le yímín jiātíng de shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This documentary shows the lives of immigrant families through a series of interviews.

sentences.chinese: 机器出现一系列故障后，技术人员决定暂停生产线。
sentences.traditional: 機器出現一系列故障後，技術人員決定暫停生產線。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì chūxiàn yíxìliè gùzhàng hòu, jìshù rényuán juédìng zàntíng shēngchǎnxiàn.
sentences.translation: After the machine had a series of faults, the technicians decided to pause the production line.

sentences.chinese: 老师一再提醒学生，实验过程中不得触碰危险仪器。
sentences.traditional: 老師一再提醒學生，實驗過程中不得觸碰危險儀器。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yízài tíxǐng xuéshēng, shíyàn guòchéng zhōng bùdé chùpèng wēixiǎn yíqì.
sentences.translation: The teacher repeatedly reminded the students not to touch dangerous instruments during the experiment.

sentences.chinese: 对方一再拖延付款，使谈判陷入僵局。
sentences.traditional: 對方一再拖延付款，使談判陷入僵局。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng yízài tuōyán fùkuǎn, shǐ tánpàn xiànrù jiāngjú.
sentences.translation: The other side repeatedly delayed payment, causing the negotiation to reach a deadlock.

sentences.chinese: 他一再强调，数据必须经过验证才能公开。
sentences.traditional: 他一再強調，數據必須經過驗證才能公開。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yízài qiángdiào, shùjù bìxū jīngguò yànzhèng cái néng gōngkāi.
sentences.translation: He repeatedly emphasised that the data must be verified before it can be made public.

sentences.chinese: 门外突然传来一阵急促的敲门声。
sentences.traditional: 門外突然傳來一陣急促的敲門聲。
sentences.pinyin: Ménwài tūrán chuánlái yízhèn jícù de qiāomén shēng.
sentences.translation: A sudden burst of urgent knocking came from outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 会议室里沉默了一阵，随后大家开始讨论解决方案。
sentences.traditional: 會議室裡沉默了一陣，隨後大家開始討論解決方案。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì lǐ chénmò le yízhèn, suíhòu dàjiā kāishǐ tǎolùn jiějué fāng'àn.
sentences.translation: The meeting room was silent for a while, and then everyone began discussing solutions.

sentences.chinese: 一阵强风吹过，水面立刻泛起了波纹。
sentences.traditional: 一陣強風吹過，水面立刻泛起了波紋。
sentences.pinyin: Yízhèn qiángfēng chuī guò, shuǐmiàn lìkè fànqǐ le bōwén.
sentences.translation: A gust of strong wind blew past, and ripples immediately rose on the water surface.

sentences.chinese: 考古队在山脚下发现了一处古代遗址。
sentences.traditional: 考古隊在山腳下發現了一處古代遺址。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎogǔduì zài shānjiǎo xià fāxiàn le yí chù gǔdài yízhǐ.
sentences.translation: The archaeological team discovered an ancient site at the foot of the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这片遗址虽然只剩下石墙，却仍能看出城市的规模。
sentences.traditional: 這片遺址雖然只剩下石牆，卻仍能看出城市的規模。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn yízhǐ suīrán zhǐ shèng xià shíqiáng, què réng néng kàn chū chéngshì de guīmó.
sentences.translation: Although only stone walls remain at this site, the scale of the city can still be seen.

sentences.chinese: 保护遗址需要限制游客数量，以免造成进一步损坏。
sentences.traditional: 保護遺址需要限制遊客數量，以免造成進一步損壞。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎohù yízhǐ xūyào xiànzhì yóukè shùliàng, yǐmiǎn zàochéng jìnyíbù sǔnhuài.
sentences.translation: Protecting the site requires limiting the number of visitors so as to avoid further damage.

sentences.chinese: 请提前提交申请材料，以便工作人员及时审核。
sentences.traditional: 請提前提交申請材料，以便工作人員及時審核。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng tíqián tíjiāo shēnqǐng cáiliào, yǐbiàn gōngzuò rényuán jíshí shěnhé.
sentences.translation: Please submit the application materials in advance so that staff can review them promptly.

sentences.chinese: 我把要点整理成图表，以便大家更快理解。
sentences.traditional: 我把要點整理成圖表，以便大家更快理解。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yàodiǎn zhěnglǐ chéng túbiǎo, yǐbiàn dàjiā gèng kuài lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: I organised the key points into a chart so that everyone could understand them more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 系统会自动保存文档，以便用户下次继续编辑。
sentences.traditional: 系統會自動保存文檔，以便用戶下次繼續編輯。
sentences.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng bǎocún wéndàng, yǐbiàn yònghù xià cì jìxù biānjí.
sentences.translation: The system will automatically save the document so that the user can continue editing next time.

sentences.chinese: 出发前请确认路线，以免在山里迷路。
sentences.traditional: 出發前請確認路線，以免在山裡迷路。
sentences.pinyin: Chūfā qián qǐng quèrèn lùxiàn, yǐmiǎn zài shān lǐ mílù.
sentences.translation: Please confirm the route before setting off so as not to get lost in the mountains.

sentences.chinese: 药品应放在儿童够不到的地方，以免发生误食。
sentences.traditional: 藥品應放在兒童夠不到的地方，以免發生誤食。
sentences.pinyin: Yàopǐn yīng fàng zài értóng gòu bù dào de dìfang, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wùshí.
sentences.translation: Medicines should be placed where children cannot reach them to avoid accidental ingestion.

sentences.chinese: 维修期间请关闭电源，以免造成更严重的损坏。
sentences.traditional: 維修期間請關閉電源，以免造成更嚴重的損壞。
sentences.pinyin: Wéixiū qījiān qǐng guānbì diànyuán, yǐmiǎn zàochéng gèng yánzhòng de sǔnhuài.
sentences.translation: Please turn off the power during repairs to avoid causing more serious damage.

sentences.chinese: 以往的经验提醒我们，任何改革都需要充分沟通。
sentences.traditional: 以往的經驗提醒我們，任何改革都需要充分溝通。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐwǎng de jīngyàn tíxǐng wǒmen, rènhé gǎigé dōu xūyào chōngfèn gōutōng.
sentences.translation: Past experience reminds us that any reform requires full communication.

sentences.chinese: 这项服务比以往更方便，很多手续都能在线完成。
sentences.traditional: 這項服務比以往更方便，很多手續都能在線完成。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fúwù bǐ yǐwǎng gèng fāngbiàn, hěn duō shǒuxù dōu néng zàixiàn wánchéng.
sentences.translation: This service is more convenient than in the past, and many procedures can be completed online.

sentences.chinese: 以往我们只关注价格，现在更重视质量和售后。
sentences.traditional: 以往我們只關注價格，現在更重視質量和售後。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐwǎng wǒmen zhǐ guānzhù jiàgé, xiànzài gèng zhòngshì zhìliàng hé shòuhòu.
sentences.translation: In the past, we only focused on price; now we pay more attention to quality and after-sales service.

sentences.chinese: 设备运行异常，工程师立即停止了实验。
sentences.traditional: 設備運行異常，工程師立即停止了實驗。
sentences.pinyin: Shèbèi yùnxíng yìcháng, gōngchéngshī lìjí tíngzhǐ le shíyàn.
sentences.translation: The equipment was operating abnormally, so the engineer stopped the experiment immediately.

sentences.chinese: 今年夏天异常炎热，用电量明显上升。
sentences.traditional: 今年夏天異常炎熱，用電量明顯上升。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnnián xiàtiān yìcháng yánrè, yòngdiànliàng míngxiǎn shàngshēng.
sentences.translation: This summer is extremely hot, and electricity consumption has risen noticeably.

sentences.chinese: 她对细节异常敏感，总能发现别人忽略的问题。
sentences.traditional: 她對細節異常敏感，總能發現別人忽略的問題。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì xìjié yìcháng mǐngǎn, zǒng néng fāxiàn biérén hūlüè de wèntí.
sentences.translation: She is exceptionally sensitive to details and can always notice problems others overlook.

sentences.chinese: 适度运动对心脏和血压都有明显益处。
sentences.traditional: 適度運動對心臟和血壓都有明顯益處。
sentences.pinyin: Shìdù yùndòng duì xīnzàng hé xuèyā dōu yǒu míngxiǎn yìchù.
sentences.translation: Moderate exercise has clear benefits for the heart and blood pressure.

sentences.chinese: 阅读文献的益处在于能拓宽思路。
sentences.traditional: 閱讀文獻的益處在於能拓寬思路。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèdú wénxiàn de yìchù zàiyú néng tuòkuān sīlù.
sentences.translation: The benefit of reading academic literature lies in being able to broaden one’s thinking.

sentences.chinese: 政策的长期益处可能要几年后才会显现。
sentences.traditional: 政策的長期益處可能要幾年後才會顯現。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngcè de chángqī yìchù kěnéng yào jǐ nián hòu cái huì xiǎnxiàn.
sentences.translation: The long-term benefits of the policy may only become apparent after several years.

sentences.chinese: 创业过程不可能总是一帆风顺，关键是及时调整方向。
sentences.traditional: 創業過程不可能總是一帆風順，關鍵是及時調整方向。
sentences.pinyin: Chuàngyè guòchéng bù kěnéng zǒng shì yìfān-fēngshùn, guānjiàn shì jíshí tiáozhěng fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: The process of starting a business cannot always go smoothly; the key is to adjust direction in time.

sentences.chinese: 他以为谈判会一帆风顺，没想到第一天就遇到分歧。
sentences.traditional: 他以為談判會一帆風順，沒想到第一天就遇到分歧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi tánpàn huì yìfān-fēngshùn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī tiān jiù yùdào fēnqí.
sentences.translation: He thought the negotiation would go smoothly, but unexpectedly met with disagreement on the first day.

sentences.chinese: 项目后来虽然一帆风顺，但前期准备非常辛苦。
sentences.traditional: 項目後來雖然一帆風順，但前期準備非常辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù hòulái suīrán yìfān-fēngshùn, dàn qiánqī zhǔnbèi fēicháng xīnkǔ.
sentences.translation: Although the project later went smoothly, the early preparation was extremely hard.

sentences.chinese: 他一口气跑到山顶，累得几乎说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: 他一口氣跑到山頂，累得幾乎說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìkǒuqì pǎo dào shāndǐng, lèi de jīhū shuō bù chū huà lái.
sentences.translation: He ran to the top of the mountain without stopping and was so tired he could barely speak.

sentences.chinese: 这本小说太吸引人了，我一口气读完了。
sentences.traditional: 這本小說太吸引人了，我一口氣讀完了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō tài xīyǐn rén le, wǒ yìkǒuqì dú wán le.
sentences.translation: This novel was so engaging that I read it all in one go.

sentences.chinese: 经理一口气提出了十几项修改意见。
sentences.traditional: 經理一口氣提出了十幾項修改意見。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yìkǒuqì tíchū le shí jǐ xiàng xiūgǎi yìjiàn.
sentences.translation: The manager put forward more than ten revision suggestions in one go.

sentences.chinese: 会后大家都在议论这项新政策会带来什么影响。
sentences.traditional: 會後大家都在議論這項新政策會帶來什麼影響。
sentences.pinyin: Huì hòu dàjiā dōu zài yìlùn zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè huì dàilái shénme yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: After the meeting, everyone was discussing what impact the new policy would bring.

sentences.chinese: 网络上的议论很多，但事实还需要进一步验证。
sentences.traditional: 網絡上的議論很多，但事實還需要進一步驗證。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngluò shàng de yìlùn hěn duō, dàn shìshí hái xūyào jìnyíbù yànzhèng.
sentences.translation: There is a lot of discussion online, but the facts still need further verification.

sentences.chinese: 老师鼓励学生理性议论社会现象，而不是只表达情绪。
sentences.traditional: 老師鼓勵學生理性議論社會現象，而不是只表達情緒。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì xuéshēng lǐxìng yìlùn shèhuì xiànxiàng, ér bú shì zhǐ biǎodá qíngxù.
sentences.translation: The teacher encourages students to discuss social phenomena rationally rather than merely express emotions.

sentences.chinese: 这两份文档的内容几乎一模一样，可能是复制出来的。
sentences.traditional: 這兩份文檔的內容幾乎一模一樣，可能是複製出來的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng fèn wéndàng de nèiróng jīhū yìmú-yíyàng, kěnéng shì fùzhì chūlái de.
sentences.translation: The contents of these two documents are almost exactly the same and may have been copied.

sentences.chinese: 他们的观点并非一模一样，但基本方向相同。
sentences.traditional: 他們的觀點並非一模一樣，但基本方向相同。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen de guāndiǎn bìngfēi yìmú-yíyàng, dàn jīběn fāngxiàng xiāngtóng.
sentences.translation: Their views are not exactly the same, but their basic direction is similar.

sentences.chinese: 双胞胎穿着一模一样的衣服，很容易被认错。
sentences.traditional: 雙胞胎穿著一模一樣的衣服，很容易被認錯。
sentences.pinyin: Shuāngbāotāi chuānzhe yìmú-yíyàng de yīfu, hěn róngyì bèi rèncuò.
sentences.translation: The twins were wearing exactly the same clothes, so they were easy to mix up.

sentences.chinese: 这位艺人虽然年轻，却已经积累了丰富的舞台经验。
sentences.traditional: 這位藝人雖然年輕，卻已經積累了豐富的舞臺經驗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìrén suīrán niánqīng, què yǐjīng jīlěi le fēngfù de wǔtái jīngyàn.
sentences.translation: Although this performer is young, they have already accumulated rich stage experience.

sentences.chinese: 公众对艺人的言行有更高期待。
sentences.traditional: 公眾對藝人的言行有更高期待。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngzhòng duì yìrén de yánxíng yǒu gèng gāo qīdài.
sentences.translation: The public has higher expectations for the words and actions of performers.

sentences.chinese: 许多艺人通过新媒体直接和观众交流。
sentences.traditional: 許多藝人通過新媒體直接和觀眾交流。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō yìrén tōngguò xīn méitǐ zhíjiē hé guānzhòng jiāoliú.
sentences.translation: Many performers communicate directly with audiences through new media.

sentences.chinese: 他淋了一身雨，却仍然坚持把资料送到会场。
sentences.traditional: 他淋了一身雨，卻仍然堅持把資料送到會場。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lín le yìshēn yǔ, què réngrán jiānchí bǎ zīliào sòng dào huìchǎng.
sentences.translation: He got soaked all over by the rain, but still insisted on delivering the materials to the venue.

sentences.chinese: 忙了一整天，她累得一身酸痛。
sentences.traditional: 忙了一整天，她累得一身酸痛。
sentences.pinyin: Máng le yì zhěng tiān, tā lèi de yìshēn suāntòng.
sentences.translation: After being busy all day, her whole body ached from exhaustion.

sentences.chinese: 那个孩子摔倒后弄了一身泥。
sentences.traditional: 那個孩子摔倒後弄了一身泥。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge háizi shuāidǎo hòu nòng le yìshēn ní.
sentences.translation: After falling over, that child got mud all over himself.

sentences.chinese: 他一时想不起密码，只好重新验证身份。
sentences.traditional: 他一時想不起密碼，只好重新驗證身份。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí xiǎng bù qǐ mìmǎ, zhǐhǎo chóngxīn yànzhèng shēnfèn.
sentences.translation: He could not remember the password for the moment, so he had to verify his identity again.

sentences.chinese: 这件事一时难以解决，需要各部门继续协调。
sentences.traditional: 這件事一時難以解決，需要各部門繼續協調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yìshí nányǐ jiějué, xūyào gè bùmén jìxù xiétiáo.
sentences.translation: This matter is difficult to resolve for the time being and requires the departments to continue coordinating.

sentences.chinese: 不要因为一时冲动做出重要决定。
sentences.traditional: 不要因為一時衝動做出重要決定。
sentences.pinyin: Bú yào yīnwèi yìshí chōngdòng zuòchū zhòngyào juédìng.
sentences.translation: Do not make an important decision because of a momentary impulse.

sentences.chinese: 我们将一同前往灾区，协助当地居民恢复生活。
sentences.traditional: 我們將一同前往災區，協助當地居民恢復生活。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen jiāng yìtóng qiánwǎng zāiqū, xiézhù dāngdì jūmín huīfù shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: We will go to the disaster area together to help local residents restore their lives.

sentences.chinese: 这项研究需要多所高校一同参与，才能获得可靠数据。
sentences.traditional: 這項研究需要多所高校一同參與，才能獲得可靠數據。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū xūyào duō suǒ gāoxiào yìtóng cānyù, cái néng huòdé kěkào shùjù.
sentences.translation: This study requires several universities to take part together in order to obtain reliable data.

sentences.chinese: 欢迎家长一同讨论课程安排，提出具体建议。
sentences.traditional: 歡迎家長一同討論課程安排，提出具體建議。
sentences.pinyin: Huānyíng jiāzhǎng yìtóng tǎolùn kèchéng ānpái, tíchū jùtǐ jiànyì.
sentences.translation: Parents are welcome to discuss the course arrangements together and make specific suggestions.

sentences.chinese: 这种界面设计简单清楚，易于老人操作。
sentences.traditional: 這種界面設計簡單清楚，易於老人操作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jièmiàn shèjì jiǎndān qīngchu, yìyú lǎorén cāozuò.
sentences.translation: This interface design is simple and clear, making it easy for elderly people to operate.

sentences.chinese: 报告把复杂数据做成图表，更易于公众理解。
sentences.traditional: 報告把複雜數據做成圖表，更易於公眾理解。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào bǎ fùzá shùjù zuò chéng túbiǎo, gèng yìyú gōngzhòng lǐjiě.
sentences.translation: The report turns complex data into charts, making it easier for the public to understand.

sentences.chinese: 规则如果写得太长，就不易于执行和监督。
sentences.traditional: 規則如果寫得太長，就不易於執行和監督。
sentences.pinyin: Guīzé rúguǒ xiě de tài cháng, jiù bù yìyú zhíxíng hé jiāndū.
sentences.translation: If the rules are written too lengthily, they will not be easy to implement or supervise.

sentences.chinese: 药物只能暂时抑制症状，不能代替正式治疗。
sentences.traditional: 藥物只能暫時抑制症狀，不能代替正式治療。
sentences.pinyin: Yàowù zhǐ néng zànshí yìzhì zhèngzhuàng, bù néng dàitì zhèngshì zhìliáo.
sentences.translation: Medicine can only temporarily suppress the symptoms; it cannot replace formal treatment.

sentences.chinese: 央行采取措施抑制通货膨胀，稳定市场预期。
sentences.traditional: 央行採取措施抑制通貨膨脹，穩定市場預期。
sentences.pinyin: Yāngháng cǎiqǔ cuòshī yìzhì tōnghuò péngzhàng, wěndìng shìchǎng yùqī.
sentences.translation: The central bank took measures to curb inflation and stabilise market expectations.

sentences.chinese: 长期压抑情绪，反而不利于抑制冲动行为。
sentences.traditional: 長期壓抑情緒，反而不利於抑制衝動行為。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī yāyì qíngxù, fǎn'ér bù lìyú yìzhì chōngdòng xíngwéi.
sentences.translation: Suppressing emotions for a long time may instead make it harder to control impulsive behaviour.

sentences.chinese: 航班因大雾延误，乘客只能在机场等候通知。
sentences.traditional: 航班因大霧延誤，乘客只能在機場等候通知。
sentences.pinyin: Hángbān yīn dàwù yánwù, chéngkè zhǐ néng zài jīchǎng děnghòu tōngzhī.
sentences.translation: The flight was delayed because of heavy fog, so passengers could only wait for notices at the airport.

sentences.chinese: 该项目因资金不足，被迫延期到明年春天。
sentences.traditional: 該項目因資金不足，被迫延期到明年春天。
sentences.pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù yīn zījīn bùzú, bèipò yánqī dào míngnián chūntiān.
sentences.translation: The project was forced to be postponed until next spring due to insufficient funds.

sentences.chinese: 他因长期表现优秀，被选拔为团队负责人。
sentences.traditional: 他因長期表現優秀，被選拔為團隊負責人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīn chángqī biǎoxiàn yōuxiù, bèi xuǎnbá wéi tuánduì fùzérén.
sentences.translation: He was selected as the team leader because of his long-term excellent performance.

sentences.chinese: 汉语拼音中，每个汉字通常对应一个音节。
sentences.traditional: 漢語拼音中，每個漢字通常對應一個音節。
sentences.pinyin: Hànyǔ pīnyīn zhōng, měi ge Hànzì tōngcháng duìyìng yí ge yīnjié.
sentences.translation: In Hanyu Pinyin, each Chinese character usually corresponds to one syllable.

sentences.chinese: 孩子学普通话时，常把两个音节读成一个音。
sentences.traditional: 孩子學普通話時，常把兩個音節讀成一個音。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi xué Pǔtōnghuà shí, cháng bǎ liǎng ge yīnjié dú chéng yí ge yīn.
sentences.translation: When learning Mandarin, children often read two syllables as one sound.

sentences.chinese: 这个词的第二个音节要读轻声，不能过分强调。
sentences.traditional: 這個詞的第二個音節要讀輕聲，不能過分強調。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge cí de dì-èr ge yīnjié yào dú qīngshēng, bù néng guòfèn qiángdiào.
sentences.translation: The second syllable of this word should be read in the neutral tone and not overemphasised.

sentences.chinese: 这只银手镯保存得很好，表面几乎没有划痕。
sentences.traditional: 這隻銀手鐲保存得很好，表面幾乎沒有劃痕。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī yín shǒuzhuó bǎocún de hěn hǎo, biǎomiàn jīhū méiyǒu huáhén.
sentences.translation: This silver bracelet has been preserved very well, with almost no scratches on the surface.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆展出了一批古代银器，吸引了不少游客。
sentences.traditional: 博物館展出了一批古代銀器，吸引了不少遊客。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū le yì pī gǔdài yínqì, xīyǐn le bù shǎo yóukè.
sentences.translation: The museum displayed a group of ancient silverware, attracting many visitors.

sentences.chinese: 这种金属含银量较高，因此价格也比较稳定。
sentences.traditional: 這種金屬含銀量較高，因此價格也比較穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jīnshǔ hán yín liàng jiào gāo, yīncǐ jiàgé yě bǐjiào wěndìng.
sentences.translation: This metal has a relatively high silver content, so its price is fairly stable.

sentences.chinese: 她在决赛中发挥稳定，最终获得一枚银牌。
sentences.traditional: 她在決賽中發揮穩定，最終獲得一枚銀牌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài juésài zhōng fāhuī wěndìng, zuìzhōng huòdé yì méi yínpái.
sentences.translation: She performed steadily in the final and eventually won a silver medal.

sentences.chinese: 这块银牌虽然不是最高荣誉，却见证了多年的努力。
sentences.traditional: 這塊銀牌雖然不是最高榮譽，卻見證了多年的努力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuài yínpái suīrán bú shì zuì gāo róngyù, què jiànzhèng le duō nián de nǔlì.
sentences.translation: Although this silver medal is not the highest honour, it bears witness to years of effort.

sentences.chinese: 代表队拿到三枚银牌，整体成绩超过预期。
sentences.traditional: 代表隊拿到三枚銀牌，整體成績超過預期。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎoduì nádào sān méi yínpái, zhěngtǐ chéngjì chāoguò yùqī.
sentences.translation: The representative team won three silver medals, and its overall results exceeded expectations.

sentences.chinese: 老师用一个真实案例引出今天的讨论主题。
sentences.traditional: 老師用一個真實案例引出今天的討論主題。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng yí ge zhēnshí ànlì yǐn chū jīntiān de tǎolùn zhǔtí.
sentences.translation: The teacher used a real case to lead into today’s discussion topic.

sentences.chinese: 这条小路可以把游客引向山顶的观景台。
sentences.traditional: 這條小路可以把遊客引向山頂的觀景臺。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiǎolù kěyǐ bǎ yóukè yǐn xiàng shāndǐng de guānjǐngtái.
sentences.translation: This small path can lead visitors towards the viewing platform at the top of the hill.

sentences.chinese: 他的发言引起了现场观众的强烈反应。
sentences.traditional: 他的發言引起了現場觀眾的強烈反應。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fāyán yǐn qǐ le xiànchǎng guānzhòng de qiángliè fǎnyìng.
sentences.translation: His remarks triggered a strong reaction from the audience at the scene.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护隐私，系统会自动隐藏部分个人信息。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護隱私，系統會自動隱藏部分個人信息。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù yǐnsī, xìtǒng huì zìdòng yǐncáng bùfen gèrén xìnxī.
sentences.translation: To protect privacy, the system automatically hides part of the personal information.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告没有隐藏问题，而是把风险讲得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 這份報告沒有隱藏問題，而是把風險講得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào méiyǒu yǐncáng wèntí, ér shì bǎ fēngxiǎn jiǎng de hěn qīngchu.
sentences.translation: This report did not hide the problems, but explained the risks very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 真正的动机被隐藏在一连串复杂的理由背后。
sentences.traditional: 真正的動機被隱藏在一連串複雜的理由背後。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de dòngjī bèi yǐncáng zài yì lián chuàn fùzá de lǐyóu bèihòu.
sentences.translation: The real motive was hidden behind a series of complicated reasons.

sentences.chinese: 家长不应只责备孩子，而要耐心引导他们解决问题。
sentences.traditional: 家長不應只責備孩子，而要耐心引導他們解決問題。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāzhǎng bù yīng zhǐ zébèi háizi, ér yào nàixīn yǐndǎo tāmen jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: Parents should not only blame their children, but should patiently guide them to solve problems.

sentences.chinese: 这篇文章通过数据引导读者重新思考城市规划。
sentences.traditional: 這篇文章通過數據引導讀者重新思考城市規劃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng tōngguò shùjù yǐndǎo dúzhě chóngxīn sīkǎo chéngshì guīhuà.
sentences.translation: This article uses data to guide readers to rethink urban planning.

sentences.chinese: 好的老师能够引导学生自己提出问题，而不是直接给答案。
sentences.traditional: 好的老師能夠引導學生自己提出問題，而不是直接給答案。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎo de lǎoshī nénggòu yǐndǎo xuéshēng zìjǐ tíchū wèntí, ér bú shì zhíjiē gěi dá'àn.
sentences.translation: A good teacher can guide students to raise their own questions, rather than giving the answers directly.

sentences.chinese: 这条消息在网上迅速传播，引发了公众对隐私保护的讨论。
sentences.traditional: 這條消息在網上迅速傳播，引發了公眾對隱私保護的討論。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiāoxi zài wǎngshàng xùnsù chuánbō, yǐnfā le gōngzhòng duì yǐnsī bǎohù de tǎolùn.
sentences.translation: The news spread quickly online and triggered public discussion about privacy protection.

sentences.chinese: 长期缺水可能引发粮食价格上涨，影响低收入家庭。
sentences.traditional: 長期缺水可能引發糧食價格上漲，影響低收入家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Chángqī quē shuǐ kěnéng yǐnfā liángshi jiàgé shàngzhǎng, yǐngxiǎng dī shōurù jiātíng.
sentences.translation: Long-term water shortages may cause food prices to rise and affect low-income families.

sentences.chinese: 一次小小的误会，竟然引发了两家公司之间的争议。
sentences.traditional: 一次小小的誤會，竟然引發了兩家公司之間的爭議。
sentences.pinyin: Yí cì xiǎoxiǎo de wùhuì, jìngrán yǐnfā le liǎng jiā gōngsī zhījiān de zhēngyì.
sentences.translation: A minor misunderstanding unexpectedly sparked a dispute between the two companies.

sentences.chinese: 学校计划引入新的评价体系，以便更全面地了解学生表现。
sentences.traditional: 學校計劃引入新的評價體系，以便更全面地了解學生表現。
sentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào jìhuà yǐnrù xīn de píngjià tǐxì, yǐbiàn gèng quánmiàn de liǎojiě xuésheng biǎoxiàn.
sentences.translation: The school plans to introduce a new evaluation system so that it can understand students' performance more fully.

sentences.chinese: 企业引入自动化设备后，生产效率显著提高。
sentences.traditional: 企業引入自動化設備後，生產效率顯著提高。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yǐnrù zìdònghuà shèbèi hòu, shēngchǎn xiàolǜ xiǎnzhù tígāo.
sentences.translation: After the company introduced automated equipment, production efficiency improved significantly.

sentences.chinese: 这本教材引入了真实案例，使理论更贴近生活。
sentences.traditional: 這本教材引入了真實案例，使理論更貼近生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn jiàocái yǐnrù le zhēnshí ànlì, shǐ lǐlùn gèng tiējìn shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: This textbook introduces real cases, making the theory closer to everyday life.

sentences.chinese: 医院必须严格保护患者隐私，未经许可不得公开资料。
sentences.traditional: 醫院必須嚴格保護患者隱私，未經許可不得公開資料。
sentences.pinyin: Yīyuàn bìxū yángé bǎohù huànzhě yǐnsī, wèijīng xǔkě bùdé gōngkāi zīliào.
sentences.translation: Hospitals must strictly protect patients' privacy and must not disclose information without permission.

sentences.chinese: 孩子长大后，也需要拥有一定的隐私空间。
sentences.traditional: 孩子長大後，也需要擁有一定的隱私空間。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi zhǎngdà hòu, yě xūyào yōngyǒu yídìng de yǐnsī kōngjiān.
sentences.translation: After children grow older, they also need to have a certain amount of private space.

sentences.chinese: 新媒体平台收集用户数据时，应明确说明隐私政策。
sentences.traditional: 新媒體平臺收集用戶數據時，應明確說明隱私政策。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnméitǐ píngtái shōují yònghù shùjù shí, yīng míngquè shuōmíng yǐnsī zhèngcè.
sentences.translation: When new media platforms collect user data, they should clearly explain their privacy policies.

sentences.chinese: 受灾地区最需要的是安全饮用水和基本药品。
sentences.traditional: 受災地區最需要的是安全飲用水和基本藥品。
sentences.pinyin: Shòuzāi dìqū zuì xūyào de shì ānquán yǐnyòngshuǐ hé jīběn yàopǐn.
sentences.translation: What the disaster-hit area needs most is safe drinking water and basic medicine.

sentences.chinese: 工厂若违规排放污水，可能污染附近的饮用水。
sentences.traditional: 工廠若違規排放污水，可能污染附近的飲用水。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngchǎng ruò wéiguī páifàng wūshuǐ, kěnéng wūrǎn fùjìn de yǐnyòngshuǐ.
sentences.translation: If a factory illegally discharges sewage, it may pollute nearby drinking water.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证饮用水质量，水库周围禁止开发旅游项目。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證飲用水質量，水庫周圍禁止開發旅遊項目。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng yǐnyòngshuǐ zhìliàng, shuǐkù zhōuwéi jìnzhǐ kāifā lǚyóu xiàngmù.
sentences.translation: To ensure the quality of drinking water, tourism projects are prohibited around the reservoir.

sentences.chinese: 文件上的印已经模糊，难以验证真伪。
sentences.traditional: 文件上的印已經模糊，難以驗證真偽。
sentences.pinyin: Wénjiàn shàng de yìn yǐjīng móhu, nányǐ yànzhèng zhēnwěi.
sentences.translation: The stamp on the document has become blurred, making it difficult to verify whether it is genuine.

sentences.chinese: 这批宣传册需要重新印，因为图像颜色不够鲜艳。
sentences.traditional: 這批宣傳冊需要重新印，因為圖像顏色不夠鮮豔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī xuānchuáncè xūyào chóngxīn yìn, yīnwèi túxiàng yánsè bú gòu xiānyàn.
sentences.translation: This batch of brochures needs to be printed again because the image colours are not vivid enough.

sentences.chinese: 请把二维码印在包装外侧，方便顾客扫码下单。
sentences.traditional: 請把二維碼印在包裝外側，方便顧客掃碼下單。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ èrwéi mǎ yìn zài bāozhuāng wàicè, fāngbiàn gùkè sǎo mǎ xiàdān.
sentences.translation: Please print the QR code on the outside of the packaging so customers can scan it to place an order.

sentences.chinese: 婴儿的听觉很敏感，突然的噪音容易把他吓醒。
sentences.traditional: 嬰兒的聽覺很敏感，突然的噪音容易把他嚇醒。
sentences.pinyin: Yīng'ér de tīngjué hěn mǐngǎn, tūrán de zàoyīn róngyì bǎ tā xià xǐng.
sentences.translation: A baby's sense of hearing is very sensitive, and sudden noise can easily wake him up with a fright.

sentences.chinese: 医生提醒父母，婴儿发烧时不要随便使用成人药物。
sentences.traditional: 醫生提醒父母，嬰兒發燒時不要隨便使用成人藥物。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng fùmǔ, yīng'ér fāshāo shí bú yào suíbiàn shǐyòng chéngrén yàowù.
sentences.translation: The doctor reminded parents not to use adult medicine casually when a baby has a fever.

sentences.chinese: 这个社区为婴儿家庭提供免费的健康咨询。
sentences.traditional: 這個社區為嬰兒家庭提供免費的健康諮詢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge shèqū wèi yīng'ér jiātíng tígōng miǎnfèi de jiànkāng zīxún.
sentences.translation: This community provides free health consultations for families with babies.

sentences.chinese: 消防员在火灾中救出老人，被大家称为英雄。
sentences.traditional: 消防員在火災中救出老人，被大家稱為英雄。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán zài huǒzāi zhōng jiù chū lǎorén, bèi dàjiā chēng wéi yīngxióng.
sentences.translation: The firefighter rescued an elderly person from the fire and was called a hero by everyone.

sentences.chinese: 真正的英雄不一定闻名，却总是在关键时刻站出来。
sentences.traditional: 真正的英雄不一定聞名，卻總是在關鍵時刻站出來。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de yīngxióng bù yídìng wénmíng, què zǒng shì zài guānjiàn shíkè zhàn chūlái.
sentences.translation: A real hero is not necessarily famous, but always steps forward at critical moments.

sentences.chinese: 这部电影塑造了一位普通人变成英雄的过程。
sentences.traditional: 這部電影塑造了一位普通人變成英雄的過程。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng sùzào le yí wèi pǔtōngrén biàn chéng yīngxióng de guòchéng.
sentences.translation: This film portrays the process of an ordinary person becoming a hero.

sentences.chinese: 傍晚的阳光把树的影子拉得很长。
sentences.traditional: 傍晚的陽光把樹的影子拉得很長。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngwǎn de yángguāng bǎ shù de yǐngzi lā de hěn cháng.
sentences.translation: The evening sunlight stretched the tree's shadow very long.

sentences.chinese: 孩子一看到墙上的影子，就以为有人站在窗外。
sentences.traditional: 孩子一看到牆上的影子，就以為有人站在窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi yí kàn dào qiáng shàng de yǐngzi, jiù yǐwéi yǒu rén zhàn zài chuāngwài.
sentences.translation: As soon as the child saw the shadow on the wall, he thought someone was standing outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 这段经历一直像影子一样跟着他，影响他的判断。
sentences.traditional: 這段經歷一直像影子一樣跟著他，影響他的判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn jīnglì yìzhí xiàng yǐngzi yíyàng gēnzhe tā, yǐngxiǎng tā de pànduàn.
sentences.translation: This experience has followed him like a shadow, affecting his judgement.

sentences.chinese: 早高峰时，地铁车厢异常拥挤，几乎无法转身。
sentences.traditional: 早高峰時，地鐵車廂異常擁擠，幾乎無法轉身。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎo gāofēng shí, dìtiě chēxiāng yìcháng yōngjǐ, jīhū wúfǎ zhuǎnshēn.
sentences.translation: During the morning rush hour, the underground carriage was unusually crowded and it was almost impossible to turn round.

sentences.chinese: 景区为了避免游客拥挤，开始实行预约制度。
sentences.traditional: 景區為了避免遊客擁擠，開始實行預約制度。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngqū wèile bìmiǎn yóukè yōngjǐ, kāishǐ shíxíng yùyuē zhìdù.
sentences.translation: To avoid crowding among tourists, the scenic area began to implement a booking system.

sentences.chinese: 城市人口过度集中，会导致住房和交通更加拥挤。
sentences.traditional: 城市人口過度集中，會導致住房和交通更加擁擠。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì rénkǒu guòdù jízhōng, huì dǎozhì zhùfáng hé jiāotōng gèngjiā yōngjǐ.
sentences.translation: Excessive concentration of urban population can make housing and transport even more crowded.

sentences.chinese: 新技术发展后，市场上涌现出许多创新型企业。
sentences.traditional: 新技術發展後，市場上湧現出許多創新型企業。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn jìshù fāzhǎn hòu, shìchǎng shàng yǒngxiàn chū xǔduō chuàngxīnxíng qǐyè.
sentences.translation: After new technologies developed, many innovative companies emerged in the market.

sentences.chinese: 灾难过后，全国各地涌现出大量志愿者。
sentences.traditional: 災難過後，全國各地湧現出大量志願者。
sentences.pinyin: Zāinàn guòhòu, quánguó gèdì yǒngxiàn chū dàliàng zhìyuànzhě.
sentences.translation: After the disaster, large numbers of volunteers emerged across the country.

sentences.chinese: 随着传统文化受到重视，越来越多年轻书画家涌现出来。
sentences.traditional: 隨著傳統文化受到重視，越來越多年輕書畫家湧現出來。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe chuántǒng wénhuà shòudào zhòngshì, yuè lái yuè duō niánqīng shūhuàjiā yǒngxiàn chūlái.
sentences.translation: As traditional culture receives more attention, more and more young calligraphy and painting artists are emerging.

sentences.chinese: 年轻研究者要勇于提出不同意见，而不是只重复前人的结论。
sentences.traditional: 年輕研究者要勇於提出不同意見，而不是只重複前人的結論。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng yánjiūzhě yào yǒngyú tíchū bùtóng yìjiàn, ér bú shì zhǐ chóngfù qiánrén de jiélùn.
sentences.translation: Young researchers should be brave enough to put forward different opinions rather than merely repeat the conclusions of those before them.

sentences.chinese: 面对失败，他没有逃避，而是勇于承担责任。
sentences.traditional: 面對失敗，他沒有逃避，而是勇於承擔責任。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shībài, tā méiyǒu táobì, ér shì yǒngyú chéngdān zérèn.
sentences.translation: Faced with failure, he did not run away, but was brave enough to take responsibility.

sentences.chinese: 一个成熟的团队应当勇于承认问题，并及时调整方向。
sentences.traditional: 一個成熟的團隊應當勇於承認問題，並及時調整方向。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge chéngshú de tuánduì yīngdāng yǒngyú chéngrèn wèntí, bìng jíshí tiáozhěng fāngxiàng.
sentences.translation: A mature team should be brave enough to admit problems and adjust direction in time.

sentences.chinese: 代表团抵达后，先在酒店用餐，然后参加欢迎仪式。
sentences.traditional: 代表團抵達後，先在酒店用餐，然後參加歡迎儀式。
sentences.pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán dǐdá hòu, xiān zài jiǔdiàn yòngcān, ránhòu cānjiā huānyíng yíshì.
sentences.translation: After the delegation arrived, they first had a meal at the hotel and then attended the welcome ceremony.

sentences.chinese: 为了避免拥挤，学校把学生用餐时间分成了三个时段。
sentences.traditional: 為了避免擁擠，學校把學生用餐時間分成了三個時段。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn yōngjǐ, xuéxiào bǎ xuésheng yòngcān shíjiān fēnchéng le sān ge shíduàn.
sentences.translation: To avoid crowding, the school divided students' mealtimes into three periods.

sentences.chinese: 医生建议胃口不好的人规律用餐，少吃过甜的食物。
sentences.traditional: 醫生建議胃口不好的人規律用餐，少吃過甜的食物。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì wèikǒu bù hǎo de rén guīlǜ yòngcān, shǎo chī guò tián de shíwù.
sentences.translation: Doctors advise people with poor appetite to eat regularly and consume less overly sweet food.

sentences.chinese: 这份旧资料虽然年代久远，但对研究项目仍有用处。
sentences.traditional: 這份舊資料雖然年代久遠，但對研究項目仍有用處。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn jiù zīliào suīrán niándài jiǔyuǎn, dàn duì yánjiū xiàngmù réng yǒu yòngchù.
sentences.translation: Although this old material is from long ago, it is still useful for the research project.

sentences.chinese: 他收藏这些工具不是为了好看，而是因为它们各有用处。
sentences.traditional: 他收藏這些工具不是為了好看，而是因為它們各有用處。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōucáng zhèxiē gōngjù bú shì wèile hǎokàn, ér shì yīnwèi tāmen gè yǒu yòngchù.
sentences.translation: He collects these tools not for appearance, but because each of them has its own use.

sentences.chinese: 如果数据不够准确，再复杂的图表也没有多大用处。
sentences.traditional: 如果數據不夠準確，再複雜的圖表也沒有多大用處。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shùjù bú gòu zhǔnquè, zài fùzá de túbiǎo yě méiyǒu duō dà yòngchù.
sentences.translation: If the data is not accurate enough, even complex charts are not of much use.

sentences.chinese: 她平时很用功，所以考试前并不显得紧张。
sentences.traditional: 她平時很用功，所以考試前並不顯得緊張。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píngshí hěn yònggōng, suǒyǐ kǎoshì qián bìng bù xiǎnde jǐnzhāng.
sentences.translation: She is usually very diligent, so she does not seem nervous before exams.

sentences.chinese: 只靠天分不够，真正的进步还需要长期用功。
sentences.traditional: 只靠天分不夠，真正的進步還需要長期用功。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ kào tiānfèn bú gòu, zhēnzhèng de jìnbù hái xūyào chángqī yònggōng.
sentences.translation: Relying on talent alone is not enough; real progress also requires long-term diligence.

sentences.chinese: 那位学员虽然基础薄弱，却比别人更用功。
sentences.traditional: 那位學員雖然基礎薄弱，卻比別人更用功。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi xuéyuán suīrán jīchǔ bóruò, què bǐ biérén gèng yònggōng.
sentences.translation: Although that student had a weak foundation, he worked harder than the others.

sentences.chinese: 企业用人不能只看学历，还要重视实际能力。
sentences.traditional: 企業用人不能只看學歷，還要重視實際能力。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐyè yòngrén bù néng zhǐ kàn xuélì, hái yào zhòngshì shíjì nénglì.
sentences.translation: When employing people, companies should not only look at qualifications, but also value practical ability.

sentences.chinese: 这个部门在用人方面非常谨慎，每个岗位都有明确标准。
sentences.traditional: 這個部門在用人方面非常謹慎，每個崗位都有明確標準。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge bùmén zài yòngrén fāngmiàn fēicháng jǐnshèn, měi ge gǎngwèi dōu yǒu míngquè biāozhǔn.
sentences.translation: This department is very cautious in hiring people, and each post has clear standards.

sentences.chinese: 领导若懂得用人，就能让团队的优势充分发挥出来。
sentences.traditional: 領導若懂得用人，就能讓團隊的優勢充分發揮出來。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo ruò dǒngde yòngrén, jiù néng ràng tuánduì de yōushì chōngfèn fāhuī chūlai.
sentences.translation: If a leader knows how to employ people well, the team's strengths can be fully brought out.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅虽然不大，但每道菜都做得很用心。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳雖然不大，但每道菜都做得很用心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng suīrán bú dà, dàn měi dào cài dōu zuò de hěn yòngxīn.
sentences.translation: Although this restaurant is not large, every dish is prepared with great care.

sentences.chinese: 老师用心设计课程，希望学生能真正理解这些概念。
sentences.traditional: 老師用心設計課程，希望學生能真正理解這些概念。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòngxīn shèjì kèchéng, xīwàng xuésheng néng zhēnzhèng lǐjiě zhèxiē gàiniàn.
sentences.translation: The teacher designed the course with care, hoping the students could truly understand these concepts.

sentences.chinese: 只要你用心听取意见，误解通常可以慢慢消除。
sentences.traditional: 只要你用心聽取意見，誤解通常可以慢慢消除。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ yòngxīn tīngqǔ yìjiàn, wùjiě tōngcháng kěyǐ mànmàn xiāochú.
sentences.translation: As long as you listen to opinions attentively, misunderstandings can usually be gradually eliminated.

sentences.chinese: 技术团队正在优化系统，以减少用户等待时间。
sentences.traditional: 技術團隊正在優化系統，以減少用戶等待時間。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshù tuánduì zhèngzài yōuhuà xìtǒng, yǐ jiǎnshǎo yònghù děngdài shíjiān.
sentences.translation: The technical team is optimizing the system to reduce users' waiting time.

sentences.chinese: 经过几轮测试，设计师决定进一步优化操作流程。
sentences.traditional: 經過幾輪測試，設計師決定進一步優化操作流程。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ lún cèshì, shèjìshī juédìng jìnyíbù yōuhuà cāozuò liúchéng.
sentences.translation: After several rounds of testing, the designer decided to further optimize the operating process.

sentences.chinese: 政府希望通过数字化服务优化公共事务管理。
sentences.traditional: 政府希望通過數字化服務優化公共事務管理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xīwàng tōngguò shùzìhuà fúwù yōuhuà gōnggòng shìwù guǎnlǐ.
sentences.translation: The government hopes to optimize the management of public affairs through digital services.

sentences.chinese: 受灾地区的饮用水供应应当优先恢复。
sentences.traditional: 受災地區的飲用水供應應當優先恢復。
sentences.pinyin: Shòuzāi dìqū de yǐnyòngshuǐ gōngyìng yīngdāng yōuxiān huīfù.
sentences.translation: The supply of drinking water in disaster-hit areas should be restored as a priority.

sentences.chinese: 报名人数有限，长期会员可以优先选择课程时间。
sentences.traditional: 報名人數有限，長期會員可以優先選擇課程時間。
sentences.pinyin: Bàomíng rénshù yǒuxiàn, chángqī huìyuán kěyǐ yōuxiān xuǎnzé kèchéng shíjiān.
sentences.translation: Places are limited, so long-term members can choose course times first.

sentences.chinese: 在资源不足的情况下，医院必须优先处理危重病人。
sentences.traditional: 在資源不足的情況下，醫院必須優先處理危重病人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zīyuán bùzú de qíngkuàng xià, yīyuàn bìxū yōuxiān chǔlǐ wēizhòng bìngrén.
sentences.translation: When resources are insufficient, hospitals must give priority to treating critically ill patients.

sentences.chinese: 他在田径比赛中表现优异，最终获得了银牌。
sentences.traditional: 他在田徑比賽中表現優異，最終獲得了銀牌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài tiánjìng bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn yōuyì, zuìzhōng huòdé le yínpái.
sentences.translation: He performed excellently in the track and field competition and finally won the silver medal.

sentences.chinese: 这款产品性能优异，但价格也比同类产品高。
sentences.traditional: 這款產品性能優異，但價格也比同類產品高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn xìngnéng yōuyì, dàn jiàgé yě bǐ tónglèi chǎnpǐn gāo.
sentences.translation: This product has excellent performance, but its price is also higher than similar products.

sentences.chinese: 由于成绩优异，她被选拔进入了重点实验室。
sentences.traditional: 由於成績優異，她被選拔進入了重點實驗室。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngjì yōuyì, tā bèi xuǎnbá jìnrù le zhòngdiǎn shíyànshì.
sentences.translation: Because of her excellent grades, she was selected to enter the key laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 关于这个地名的由来，当地老人有不同的说法。
sentences.traditional: 關於這個地名的由來，當地老人有不同的說法。
sentences.pinyin: Guānyú zhè ge dìmíng de yóulái, dāngdì lǎorén yǒu bùtóng de shuōfǎ.
sentences.translation: Regarding the origin of this place name, local elderly people have different explanations.

sentences.chinese: 这项习俗由来已久，至今仍在许多村庄延续。
sentences.traditional: 這項習俗由來已久，至今仍在許多村莊延續。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xísú yóulái yǐ jiǔ, zhìjīn réng zài xǔduō cūnzhuāng yánxù.
sentences.translation: This custom has a long history and still continues in many villages today.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆的讲解员详细介绍了这件文物的由来。
sentences.traditional: 博物館的講解員詳細介紹了這件文物的由來。
sentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn de jiǎngjiěyuán xiángxì jièshào le zhè jiàn wénwù de yóulái.
sentences.translation: The museum guide introduced the origin of this cultural relic in detail.

sentences.chinese: 春节期间，古镇里挤满了来自各地的游人。
sentences.traditional: 春節期間，古鎮裡擠滿了來自各地的遊人。
sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, gǔzhèn lǐ jǐ mǎn le láizì gèdì de yóurén.
sentences.translation: During the Spring Festival, the old town was packed with tourists from all over the country.

sentences.chinese: 为了保护文物，景区限制每天进入寺庙的游人数量。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護文物，景區限制每天進入寺廟的遊人數量。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù wénwù, jǐngqū xiànzhì měitiān jìnrù sìmiào de yóurén shùliàng.
sentences.translation: To protect the cultural relics, the scenic area limits the number of tourists entering the temple each day.

sentences.chinese: 雨后山路湿滑，管理处提醒游人不要单独前往危险区域。
sentences.traditional: 雨後山路濕滑，管理處提醒遊人不要單獨前往危險區域。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu shānlù shīhuá, guǎnlǐchù tíxǐng yóurén bú yào dāndú qiánwǎng wēixiǎn qūyù.
sentences.translation: After the rain, the mountain road was slippery, so the management office reminded tourists not to go to dangerous areas alone.

sentences.chinese: 夜色中的湖面平静得犹如一面镜子。
sentences.traditional: 夜色中的湖面平靜得猶如一面鏡子。
sentences.pinyin: Yèsè zhōng de húmiàn píngjìng de yóurú yí miàn jìngzi.
sentences.translation: The lake surface in the night was so calm that it was like a mirror.

sentences.chinese: 这场突发危机犹如警钟，提醒企业重视风险管理。
sentences.traditional: 這場突發危機猶如警鐘，提醒企業重視風險管理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng tūfā wēijī yóurú jǐngzhōng, tíxǐng qǐyè zhòngshì fēngxiǎn guǎnlǐ.
sentences.translation: This sudden crisis was like an alarm bell, reminding companies to value risk management.

sentences.chinese: 孩子的笑容犹如阳光，一下子消除了大家的疲惫。
sentences.traditional: 孩子的笑容猶如陽光，一下子消除了大家的疲憊。
sentences.pinyin: Háizi de xiàoróng yóurú yángguāng, yíxiàzi xiāochú le dàjiā de píbèi.
sentences.translation: The child’s smile was like sunshine and immediately removed everyone’s tiredness.

sentences.chinese: 这家农场主要种植有机蔬菜，并通过网络直接销售。
sentences.traditional: 這家農場主要種植有機蔬菜，並通過網絡直接銷售。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā nóngchǎng zhǔyào zhòngzhí yǒujī shūcài, bìng tōngguò wǎngluò zhíjiē xiāoshòu.
sentences.translation: This farm mainly grows organic vegetables and sells them directly online.

sentences.chinese: 城市发展需要把交通、住房和环保形成有机整体。
sentences.traditional: 城市發展需要把交通、住房和環保形成有機整體。
sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì fāzhǎn xūyào bǎ jiāotōng, zhùfáng hé huánbǎo xíngchéng yǒujī zhěngtǐ.
sentences.translation: Urban development needs to form transport, housing and environmental protection into an organic whole.

sentences.chinese: 这款食品虽然标着有机，但仍要查看具体的认证信息。
sentences.traditional: 這款食品雖然標著有機，但仍要查看具體的認證信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shípǐn suīrán biāo zhe yǒujī, dàn réng yào chákàn jùtǐ de rènzhèng xìnxī.
sentences.translation: Although this food is labelled organic, you should still check the specific certification information.

sentences.chinese: 喝完热汤后，他觉得身上又有劲了。
sentences.traditional: 喝完熱湯後，他覺得身上又有勁了。
sentences.pinyin: Hē wán rè tāng hòu, tā juéde shēnshang yòu yǒujìn le.
sentences.translation: After drinking the hot soup, he felt strong again.

sentences.chinese: 这部喜剧节奏很快，看起来特别有劲。
sentences.traditional: 這部喜劇節奏很快，看起來特別有勁。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù xǐjù jiézòu hěn kuài, kàn qǐlái tèbié yǒujìn.
sentences.translation: This comedy has a fast pace and feels particularly lively.

sentences.chinese: 新来的学员虽然年纪小，训练时却很有劲。
sentences.traditional: 新來的學員雖然年紀小，訓練時卻很有勁。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn lái de xuéyuán suīrán niánjì xiǎo, xùnliàn shí què hěn yǒujìn.
sentences.translation: Although the new trainee is young, he is very energetic during training.

sentences.chinese: 志愿者引导观众有序进入会场。
sentences.traditional: 志願者引導觀眾有序進入會場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhě yǐndǎo guānzhòng yǒuxù jìnrù huìchǎng.
sentences.translation: Volunteers guided the audience to enter the venue in an orderly way.

sentences.chinese: 事故发生后，乘客在工作人员安排下有序撤离。
sentences.traditional: 事故發生後，乘客在工作人員安排下有序撤離。
sentences.pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, chéngkè zài gōngzuò rényuán ānpái xià yǒuxù chèlí.
sentences.translation: After the accident occurred, passengers evacuated in an orderly way under staff arrangements.

sentences.chinese: 数据分类越清楚，后续分析就越有序。
sentences.traditional: 數據分類越清楚，後續分析就越有序。
sentences.pinyin: Shùjù fēnlèi yuè qīngchu, hòuxù fēnxī jiù yuè yǒuxù.
sentences.translation: The clearer the data classification is, the more orderly the later analysis will be.

sentences.chinese: 本次研讨会将于下月上旬在上海举行。
sentences.traditional: 本次研討會將於下月上旬在上海舉行。
sentences.pinyin: Běn cì yántǎohuì jiāng yú xià yuè shàngxún zài Shànghǎi jǔxíng.
sentences.translation: This seminar will be held in Shanghai in the first ten days of next month.

sentences.chinese: 这项规定适用于所有未成年人。
sentences.traditional: 這項規定適用於所有未成年人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shìyòng yú suǒyǒu wèichéngniánrén.
sentences.translation: This regulation applies to all minors.

sentences.chinese: 项目最终失败，不在于技术不足，而在于沟通混乱。
sentences.traditional: 項目最終失敗，不在於技術不足，而在於溝通混亂。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù zuìzhōng shībài, bú zài yú jìshù bùzú, ér zài yú gōutōng hùnluàn.
sentences.translation: The project ultimately failed not because of insufficient technology, but because of chaotic communication.

sentences.chinese: 付款前，请确认账户余额是否足够。
sentences.traditional: 付款前，請確認帳戶餘額是否足夠。
sentences.pinyin: Fùkuǎn qián, qǐng quèrèn zhànghù yú'é shìfǒu zúgòu.
sentences.translation: Before paying, please confirm whether the account balance is sufficient.

sentences.chinese: 这个应用会自动显示公交卡的余额。
sentences.traditional: 這個應用會自動顯示公交卡的餘額。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng huì zìdòng xiǎnshì gōngjiāokǎ de yú'é.
sentences.translation: This app automatically displays the balance on the bus card.

sentences.chinese: 公司月底要核对客户的未付余额。
sentences.traditional: 公司月底要核對客戶的未付餘額。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī yuèdǐ yào héduì kèhù de wèi fù yú'é.
sentences.translation: At the end of the month, the company needs to check customers’ unpaid balances.

sentences.chinese: 与其反复抱怨，不如把问题一一列出来。
sentences.traditional: 與其反覆抱怨，不如把問題一一列出來。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí fǎnfù bàoyuàn, bùrú bǎ wèntí yīyī liè chūlai.
sentences.translation: Rather than complaining repeatedly, it is better to list the problems one by one.

sentences.chinese: 与其急着扩大规模，公司更应该先优化内部流程。
sentences.traditional: 與其急著擴大規模，公司更應該先優化內部流程。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí jízhe kuòdà guīmó, gōngsī gèng yīnggāi xiān yōuhuà nèibù liúchéng.
sentences.translation: Rather than rushing to expand its scale, the company should first optimize its internal processes.

sentences.chinese: 与其依赖别人提醒，不如自己建立清晰的计划。
sentences.traditional: 與其依賴別人提醒，不如自己建立清晰的計劃。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔqí yīlài biérén tíxǐng, bùrú zìjǐ jiànlì qīngxī de jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Rather than relying on others to remind you, it is better to build a clear plan yourself.

sentences.chinese: 北方冬天严寒，出门最好穿厚一点的羽绒服。
sentences.traditional: 北方冬天嚴寒，出門最好穿厚一點的羽絨服。
sentences.pinyin: Běifāng dōngtiān yánhán, chūmén zuìhǎo chuān hòu yìdiǎn de yǔróngfú.
sentences.translation: Winters in the north are bitterly cold, so it is best to wear a thicker down jacket when going out.

sentences.chinese: 这件羽绒服很轻，但保暖效果相当好。
sentences.traditional: 這件羽絨服很輕，但保暖效果相當好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yǔróngfú hěn qīng, dàn bǎonuǎn xiàoguǒ xiāngdāng hǎo.
sentences.translation: This down jacket is very light, but its warmth is quite good.

sentences.chinese: 洗羽绒服时不要用力拧，以免损伤里面的填充物。
sentences.traditional: 洗羽絨服時不要用力擰，以免損傷裡面的填充物。
sentences.pinyin: Xǐ yǔróngfú shí bú yào yònglì nǐng, yǐmiǎn sǔnshāng lǐmiàn de tiánchōngwù.
sentences.translation: When washing a down jacket, do not wring it hard, so as not to damage the filling inside.

sentences.chinese: 参加宴会的人数较多，我们需要提前预定餐厅。
sentences.traditional: 參加宴會的人數較多，我們需要提前預定餐廳。
sentences.pinyin: Cānjiā yànhuì de rénshù jiào duō, wǒmen xūyào tíqián yùdìng cāntīng.
sentences.translation: Since many people are attending the banquet, we need to reserve the restaurant in advance.

sentences.chinese: 酒店房间已经全部预定，临时去可能没有空房。
sentences.traditional: 酒店房間已經全部預定，臨時去可能沒有空房。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn fángjiān yǐjīng quánbù yùdìng, línshí qù kěnéng méiyǒu kòngfáng.
sentences.translation: The hotel rooms have all been reserved, so if you go at the last minute there may be no vacancies.

sentences.chinese: 这批现货已被客户预定，暂时不能对外销售。
sentences.traditional: 這批現貨已被客戶預定，暫時不能對外銷售。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè pī xiànhuò yǐ bèi kèhù yùdìng, zànshí bù néng duìwài xiāoshòu.
sentences.translation: This batch of goods in stock has already been reserved by a customer and cannot be sold externally for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 我们早已预料到原材料价格会继续上涨，所以提前签了长期合同。
sentences.traditional: 我們早已預料到原材料價格會繼續上漲，所以提前簽了長期合同。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǎo yǐ yùliào dào yuáncáiliào jiàgé huì jìxù shàngzhǎng, suǒyǐ tíqián qiān le chángqī hétong.
sentences.translation: We had long predicted that raw material prices would continue to rise, so we signed a long-term contract in advance.

sentences.chinese: 这次谈判的结果超出了所有人的预料。
sentences.traditional: 這次談判的結果超出了所有人的預料。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn de jiéguǒ chāochū le suǒyǒu rén de yùliào.
sentences.translation: The result of this negotiation went beyond everyone's expectations.

sentences.chinese: 由于台风来得比预料中更快，沿海居民被要求提前撤离。
sentences.traditional: 由於颱風來得比預料中更快，沿海居民被要求提前撤離。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú táifēng lái de bǐ yùliào zhōng gèng kuài, yánhǎi jūmín bèi yāoqiú tíqián chèlí.
sentences.translation: Because the typhoon arrived faster than expected, coastal residents were required to evacuate early.

sentences.chinese: 新能源项目的收益没有达到投资者的预期。
sentences.traditional: 新能源項目的收益沒有達到投資者的預期。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnnéngyuán xiàngmù de shōuyì méiyǒu dádào tóuzīzhě de yùqī.
sentences.translation: The profit from the new energy project did not meet investors' expectations.

sentences.chinese: 如果市场需求继续下降，公司可能会下调全年预期。
sentences.traditional: 如果市場需求繼續下降，公司可能會下調全年預期。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shìchǎng xūqiú jìxù xiàjiàng, gōngsī kěnéng huì xiàtiáo quánnián yùqī.
sentences.translation: If market demand continues to fall, the company may lower its expectations for the whole year.

sentences.chinese: 团队预期下个月完成系统修复，并开始小规模测试。
sentences.traditional: 團隊預期下個月完成系統修復，並開始小規模測試。
sentences.pinyin: Tuánduì yùqī xià ge yuè wánchéng xìtǒng xiūfù, bìng kāishǐ xiǎo guīmó cèshì.
sentences.translation: The team expects to complete the system repair next month and begin small-scale testing.

sentences.chinese: 酒店的浴室通风不好，洗完澡后镜子上全是水汽。
sentences.traditional: 酒店的浴室通風不好，洗完澡後鏡子上全是水氣。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn de yùshì tōngfēng bù hǎo, xǐ wán zǎo hòu jìngzi shàng quán shì shuǐqì.
sentences.translation: The hotel bathroom was poorly ventilated, and after a shower the mirror was covered in steam.

sentences.chinese: 她把药品放在浴室外面，以免受潮。
sentences.traditional: 她把藥品放在浴室外面，以免受潮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ yàopǐn fàng zài yùshì wàimian, yǐmiǎn shòucháo.
sentences.translation: She put the medicine outside the bathroom to prevent it from getting damp.

sentences.chinese: 儿童进入浴室前，家长应先确认地面是否防滑。
sentences.traditional: 兒童進入浴室前，家長應先確認地面是否防滑。
sentences.pinyin: Értóng jìnrù yùshì qián, jiāzhǎng yīng xiān quèrèn dìmiàn shìfǒu fánghuá.
sentences.translation: Before children enter the bathroom, parents should first confirm whether the floor is non-slip.

sentences.chinese: 过度消费往往来自一时的欲望，而不是真正的需要。
sentences.traditional: 過度消費往往來自一時的欲望，而不是真正的需要。
sentences.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi wǎngwǎng láizì yìshí de yùwàng, ér bú shì zhēnzhèng de xūyào.
sentences.translation: Excessive consumption often comes from a momentary desire rather than a real need.

sentences.chinese: 他努力抑制内心的欲望，专心完成手头的事务。
sentences.traditional: 他努力抑制內心的欲望，專心完成手頭的事務。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǔlì yìzhì nèixīn de yùwàng, zhuānxīn wánchéng shǒutóu de shìwù.
sentences.translation: He worked hard to suppress his inner desires and concentrate on the matters at hand.

sentences.chinese: 对权力的欲望如果缺少限制，容易引发严重后果。
sentences.traditional: 對權力的欲望如果缺少限制，容易引發嚴重後果。
sentences.pinyin: Duì quánlì de yùwàng rúguǒ quēshǎo xiànzhì, róngyì yǐnfā yánzhòng hòuguǒ.
sentences.translation: If the desire for power lacks limits, it can easily cause serious consequences.

sentences.chinese: 这座园林原本属于私人住宅，后来才对公众开放。
sentences.traditional: 這座園林原本屬於私人住宅，後來才對公眾開放。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò yuánlín yuánběn shǔyú sīrén zhùzhái, hòulái cái duì gōngzhòng kāifàng.
sentences.translation: This garden originally belonged to a private residence and was only later opened to the public.

sentences.chinese: 会议原本安排在下旬举行，但因台风延期了。
sentences.traditional: 會議原本安排在下旬舉行，但因颱風延期了。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì yuánběn ānpái zài xiàxún jǔxíng, dàn yīn táifēng yánqī le.
sentences.translation: The meeting was originally arranged for the late part of the month, but was postponed because of the typhoon.

sentences.chinese: 他原本不想参加谈判，后来还是被委托出面协调。
sentences.traditional: 他原本不想參加談判，後來還是被委託出面協調。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuánběn bù xiǎng cānjiā tánpàn, hòulái háishi bèi wěituō chūmiàn xiétiáo.
sentences.translation: He originally did not want to take part in the negotiation, but later was still entrusted to step in and coordinate.

sentences.chinese: 这家工厂主要依赖进口原材料，因此成本容易受汇率影响。
sentences.traditional: 這家工廠主要依賴進口原材料，因此成本容易受匯率影響。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhǔyào yīlài jìnkǒu yuáncáiliào, yīncǐ chéngběn róngyì shòu huìlǜ yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: This factory mainly relies on imported raw materials, so its costs are easily affected by exchange rates.

sentences.chinese: 为了保证食品安全，企业必须严格检查原材料来源。
sentences.traditional: 為了保證食品安全，企業必須嚴格檢查原材料來源。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng shípǐn ānquán, qǐyè bìxū yángé jiǎnchá yuáncáiliào láiyuán.
sentences.translation: To ensure food safety, companies must strictly check the sources of raw materials.

sentences.chinese: 如果原材料损坏，后面的生产流程也会受到影响。
sentences.traditional: 如果原材料損壞，後面的生產流程也會受到影響。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ yuáncáiliào sǔnhuài, hòumian de shēngchǎn liúchéng yě huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.translation: If the raw materials are damaged, the later production process will also be affected.

sentences.chinese: 学生不仅要记住公式，还要理解背后的原理。
sentences.traditional: 學生不僅要記住公式，還要理解背後的原理。
sentences.pinyin: Xuésheng bùjǐn yào jìzhù gōngshì, hái yào lǐjiě bèihòu de yuánlǐ.
sentences.translation: Students should not only remember formulas, but also understand the principles behind them.

sentences.chinese: 这台仪器的工作原理并不复杂，关键在于精确调节。
sentences.traditional: 這臺儀器的工作原理並不複雜，關鍵在於精確調節。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái yíqì de gōngzuò yuánlǐ bìng bú fùzá, guānjiàn zàiyú jīngquè tiáojié.
sentences.translation: The working principle of this instrument is not complicated; the key lies in precise adjustment.

sentences.chinese: 老师用图表说明了太阳能发电的基本原理。
sentences.traditional: 老師用圖表說明了太陽能發電的基本原理。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng túbiǎo shuōmíng le tàiyángnéng fādiàn de jīběn yuánlǐ.
sentences.translation: The teacher used charts to explain the basic principle of solar power generation.

sentences.chinese: 这种药品的主要原料来自一种野生植物。
sentences.traditional: 這種藥品的主要原料來自一種野生植物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàopǐn de zhǔyào yuánliào láizì yì zhǒng yěshēng zhíwù.
sentences.translation: The main raw material for this medicine comes from a wild plant.

sentences.chinese: 厂家提高了原料标准，所以产品质量更加稳定。
sentences.traditional: 廠家提高了原料標準，所以產品質量更加穩定。
sentences.pinyin: Chǎngjiā tígāo le yuánliào biāozhǔn, suǒyǐ chǎnpǐn zhìliàng gèngjiā wěndìng.
sentences.translation: The manufacturer raised the standard for raw materials, so product quality became more stable.

sentences.chinese: 塑料瓶经过处理后，可以变成新的生产原料。
sentences.traditional: 塑料瓶經過處理後，可以變成新的生產原料。
sentences.pinyin: Sùliào píng jīngguò chǔlǐ hòu, kěyǐ biànchéng xīn de shēngchǎn yuánliào.
sentences.translation: After processing, plastic bottles can become new production raw materials.

sentences.chinese: 苏州园林以布局精巧、景色自然闻名。
sentences.traditional: 蘇州園林以佈局精巧、景色自然聞名。
sentences.pinyin: Sūzhōu yuánlín yǐ bùjú jīngqiǎo, jǐngsè zìrán wénmíng.
sentences.translation: Suzhou gardens are famous for their skilful layout and natural scenery.

sentences.chinese: 这所大学把旧校区改造成开放式园林，供市民休息。
sentences.traditional: 這所大學把舊校區改造成開放式園林，供市民休息。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué bǎ jiù xiàoqū gǎizàochéng kāifàngshì yuánlín, gōng shìmín xiūxi.
sentences.translation: This university turned its old campus into an open garden for residents to rest in.

sentences.chinese: 园林设计不能只追求外表，还要考虑水流和植物寿命。
sentences.traditional: 園林設計不能只追求外表，還要考慮水流和植物壽命。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánlín shèjì bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú wàibiǎo, hái yào kǎolǜ shuǐliú hé zhíwù shòumìng.
sentences.translation: Garden design should not only pursue appearance, but also consider water flow and the lifespan of plants.

sentences.chinese: 在双方共同努力下，谈判取得了圆满结果。
sentences.traditional: 在雙方共同努力下，談判取得了圓滿結果。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shuāngfāng gòngtóng nǔlì xià, tánpàn qǔdé le yuánmǎn jiéguǒ.
sentences.translation: With the joint efforts of both sides, the negotiation achieved a satisfactory result.

sentences.chinese: 这次国际会议组织有序，最终圆满结束。
sentences.traditional: 這次國際會議組織有序，最終圓滿結束。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì guójì huìyì zǔzhī yǒuxù, zuìzhōng yuánmǎn jiéshù.
sentences.translation: This international conference was organised in an orderly way and ended successfully.

sentences.chinese: 她实现了自己的心愿，脸上露出圆满的笑容。
sentences.traditional: 她實現了自己的心願，臉上露出圓滿的笑容。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shíxiàn le zìjǐ de xīnyuàn, liǎn shàng lùchū yuánmǎn de xiàoróng.
sentences.translation: She fulfilled her wish, and a satisfied smile appeared on her face.

sentences.chinese: 这份手稿保留了最原始的结构，能帮助学者理解作者的思路。
sentences.traditional: 這份手稿保留了最原始的結構，能幫助學者理解作者的思路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn shǒugǎo bǎoliú le zuì yuánshǐ de jiégòu, néng bāngzhù xuézhě lǐjiě zuòzhě de sīlù.
sentences.translation: This manuscript preserves the most original structure and can help scholars understand the author’s train of thought.

sentences.chinese: 在原始森林里，许多野生动物仍然保持着自然的生存状态。
sentences.traditional: 在原始森林裡，許多野生動物仍然保持著自然的生存狀態。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yuánshǐ sēnlín lǐ, xǔduō yěshēng dòngwù réngrán bǎochí zhe zìrán de shēngcún zhuàngtài.
sentences.translation: In the primitive forest, many wild animals still maintain their natural way of living.

sentences.chinese: 这个模型只采用原始数据，没有加入任何人为判断。
sentences.traditional: 這個模型只採用原始數據，沒有加入任何人為判斷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège móxíng zhǐ cǎiyòng yuánshǐ shùjù, méiyǒu jiārù rènhé rénwéi pànduàn.
sentences.translation: This model uses only original data and does not add any human judgement.

sentences.chinese: 信任是团队合作中不可缺少的元素。
sentences.traditional: 信任是團隊合作中不可缺少的元素。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnrèn shì tuánduì hézuò zhōng bùkě quēshǎo de yuánsù.
sentences.translation: Trust is an essential element in teamwork.

sentences.chinese: 这种矿石含有多种稀有元素，因此研究价值很高。
sentences.traditional: 這種礦石含有多種稀有元素，因此研究價值很高。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kuàngshí hányǒu duō zhǒng xīyǒu yuánsù, yīncǐ yánjiū jiàzhí hěn gāo.
sentences.translation: This ore contains several rare elements, so its research value is very high.

sentences.chinese: 设计师把传统元素和新媒体技术结合起来。
sentences.traditional: 設計師把傳統元素和新媒體技術結合起來。
sentences.pinyin: Shèjìshī bǎ chuántǒng yuánsù hé xīn méitǐ jìshù jiéhé qǐlai.
sentences.translation: The designer combined traditional elements with new media technology.

sentences.chinese: 原先的计划因台风延期，大家不得不重新安排日程。
sentences.traditional: 原先的計畫因颱風延期，大家不得不重新安排日程。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánxiān de jìhuà yīn táifēng yánqī, dàjiā bùdébù chóngxīn ānpái rìchéng.
sentences.translation: The original plan was postponed because of the typhoon, so everyone had to rearrange the schedule.

sentences.chinese: 这片土地原先是一座工厂，后来被改造成公园。
sentences.traditional: 這片土地原先是一座工廠，後來被改造成公園。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔdì yuánxiān shì yí zuò gōngchǎng, hòulái bèi gǎizàochéng gōngyuán.
sentences.translation: This piece of land was originally a factory and was later turned into a park.

sentences.chinese: 经过修订，报告比原先的版本更加清楚。
sentences.traditional: 經過修訂，報告比原先的版本更加清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò xiūdìng, bàogào bǐ yuánxiān de bǎnběn gèngjiā qīngchu.
sentences.translation: After revision, the report is clearer than the original version.

sentences.chinese: 北方人在正月十五常吃元宵，象征团圆。
sentences.traditional: 北方人在正月十五常吃元宵，象徵團圓。
sentences.pinyin: Běifāng rén zài zhēngyuè shíwǔ cháng chī yuánxiāo, xiàngzhēng tuányuán.
sentences.translation: People in northern China often eat yuanxiao on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, symbolising reunion.

sentences.chinese: 这家老店的元宵外皮软糯，馅料也很细致。
sentences.traditional: 這家老店的元宵外皮軟糯，餡料也很細緻。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo diàn de yuánxiāo wàipí ruǎnnuò, xiànliào yě hěn xìzhì.
sentences.translation: The yuanxiao from this old shop have soft, sticky skins and carefully made fillings.

sentences.chinese: 孩子们一边看灯会，一边等着锅里的元宵煮熟。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們一邊看燈會，一邊等著鍋裡的元宵煮熟。
sentences.pinyin: Háizimen yìbiān kàn dēnghuì, yìbiān děng zhe guō lǐ de yuánxiāo zhǔ shú.
sentences.translation: The children watched the lantern show while waiting for the yuanxiao in the pot to cook.

sentences.chinese: 他的创作灵感源于童年的海边生活。
sentences.traditional: 他的創作靈感源於童年的海邊生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de chuàngzuò línggǎn yuányú tóngnián de hǎibiān shēnghuó.
sentences.translation: His creative inspiration comes from his childhood life by the sea.

sentences.chinese: 这种习俗源于古代的农耕社会，后来逐渐传到各地。
sentences.traditional: 這種習俗源於古代的農耕社會，後來逐漸傳到各地。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xísú yuányú gǔdài de nónggēng shèhuì, hòulái zhújiàn chuán dào gèdì.
sentences.translation: This custom originated in ancient farming society and later gradually spread to different places.

sentences.chinese: 这场危机源于长期被忽视的管理问题。
sentences.traditional: 這場危機源於長期被忽視的管理問題。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chǎng wēijī yuányú chángqī bèi hūshì de guǎnlǐ wèntí.
sentences.translation: This crisis originated from management problems that had long been ignored.

sentences.chinese: 公司开始提供远程面试，以便吸引外地人才。
sentences.traditional: 公司開始提供遠程面試，以便吸引外地人才。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī kāishǐ tígōng yuǎnchéng miànshì, yǐbiàn xīyǐn wàidì réncái.
sentences.translation: The company began offering remote interviews in order to attract talent from other places.

sentences.chinese: 远程医疗能让偏远地区的病人更快获得专业建议。
sentences.traditional: 遠程醫療能讓偏遠地區的病人更快獲得專業建議。
sentences.pinyin: Yuǎnchéng yīliáo néng ràng piānyuǎn dìqū de bìngrén gèng kuài huòdé zhuānyè jiànyì.
sentences.translation: Remote healthcare allows patients in remote areas to obtain professional advice more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这套系统支持远程控制，维护人员不用到现场。
sentences.traditional: 這套系統支持遠程控制，維護人員不用到現場。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tào xìtǒng zhīchí yuǎnchéng kòngzhì, wéihù rényuán bú yòng dào xiànchǎng.
sentences.translation: This system supports remote control, so maintenance staff do not need to go to the site.

sentences.chinese: 她常常望着远方，思念在海外工作的父母。
sentences.traditional: 她常常望著遠方，思念在海外工作的父母。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángcháng wàng zhe yuǎnfāng, sīniàn zài hǎiwài gōngzuò de fùmǔ.
sentences.translation: She often gazes into the distance, missing her parents who work overseas.

sentences.chinese: 远方的山被月光照亮，水面也显得格外安静。
sentences.traditional: 遠方的山被月光照亮，水面也顯得格外安靜。
sentences.pinyin: Yuǎnfāng de shān bèi yuèguāng zhào liàng, shuǐmiàn yě xiǎnde géwài ānjìng.
sentences.translation: The distant mountains were lit by moonlight, and the water surface also seemed especially calm.

sentences.chinese: 从远方寄来的信，让他重新燃起了希望。
sentences.traditional: 從遠方寄來的信，讓他重新燃起了希望。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng yuǎnfāng jì lái de xìn, ràng tā chóngxīn ránqǐ le xīwàng.
sentences.translation: The letter sent from far away made hope rise in him again.

sentences.chinese: 法律不仅约束个人行为，也维护社会秩序。
sentences.traditional: 法律不僅約束個人行為，也維護社會秩序。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎlǜ bùjǐn yuēshù gèrén xíngwéi, yě wéihù shèhuì zhìxù.
sentences.translation: Law not only restrains individual behaviour but also maintains social order.

sentences.chinese: 缺乏预算约束，项目很容易超出原先计划。
sentences.traditional: 缺乏預算約束，項目很容易超出原先計畫。
sentences.pinyin: Quēfá yùsuàn yuēshù, xiàngmù hěn róngyì chāochū yuánxiān jìhuà.
sentences.translation: Without budget constraints, the project can easily exceed the original plan.

sentences.chinese: 家庭规则应当合理约束孩子，而不是限制他们的好奇心。
sentences.traditional: 家庭規則應當合理約束孩子，而不是限制他們的好奇心。
sentences.pinyin: Jiātíng guīzé yīngdāng hélǐ yuēshù háizi, ér bú shì xiànzhì tāmen de hàoqíxīn.
